<1.1>
atha prathamādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
vṛddhirādaic || 1.1.1||
tripadamidaṃ sūtram--vṛddhiḥ, ād, aij iti | atra cākāraḥ prayogasthairākārairthavān | jātyabhiprāyaṃ caikavacanam | aicchabdastu aikāraukārābhyām | saṃjñinordvitve'pi dvivacanaṃ na bhavati; dvayorapyekaśabdarūparūṣitatvenaikyamāpannayorivābhidhānāt | evaṃ sarveṣveva pratyāhāreṣvekavacanaṃ draṣṭayam | samāhāradvandve vā--ādaijiti | 'dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre' iti samāsāntastu na bhavati; samāsāntavidheranityatvād | anityatvaṃ ca 'dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu' iti mūrddhanśabdasya nirddeśādavasīyate | anyathā 'dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūrdhnaḥ' iti ṣapratyayāntatvānmūrdheṣviti nirddeśyaṃ syāt | ādaicchabdātsamāsatvādarthavattvādvā vibhaktyutpattau 'cauḥ kuḥ ' padasyeti kutvaṃ prāptam, ayasmayāditvena bhatvānna hi bhaviṣyati; chando vatsūtrāṇi bhavanti | vṛddhiśabdasya trayīśabdānāṃ pravṛttiriti pakṣe 'vadhu vṛddhau' ityasmādbhāve ktini vyutpāttiḥ, abhedopacārācca vṛddhiyukteṣvādaikṣu vṛttiḥ | na caivaṃ lakṣaṇayaivādaikṣu vṛddhiśabdasya vṛttisiddheḥ sūtrasyānarthakyam; niyamārthatvāt | anyathā varddhanakriyāyogiṣvikārādiṣu pluteṣu ca varteta | mā tatra vartiṣṭa, ādaikṣveva vartatāmiti niyamaḥ | catuṣṭayīpakṣe tu katham, yāvataśca saṃjñātvena viniyukte sati 'saci vṛddhiḥ' ityādau pradeśāntara eva vṛddhiśabdasyādaikṣu pravṛttiryuktā, na tvatraiva saṃjñāviniyuktikāle ? ucyate; 'nityaḥ śabdārthasambandhaḥ' iti darśanena kvacidapi puruṣavyāpārātprāg vācakaḥ san puruṣavyāpāreṇa vācakaḥ kriyate | ataḥ sarve śabdāḥ saṃjñārūpeṇa sarvānarthān pratipādayituṃ samarthāḥ | tatrāniyatārthena vyavahārāsiddherniyamārtha eva puruṣavyāpāraḥ--mayā prayuktasya vṛddhiśabdasyādaijartha iti | evaṃ tāvatpadārtho vyākhyātaḥ |
vākyaviṣayāḥ punaraṣṭau vikalpāḥ-anarthakam, sādhvanuśāsanam, prayoganiyamārtham, ādeśārtham, āgamārtham, viśeṣaṇārtham, tad‌guṇādhyāropārtham, saṃjñārthamiti | tatrānarthakābhidhānaṃ pramādāśrayadoṣādanavadhānādaśaktervā bhavati | na caitaccatuṣṭayaṃ bhagavataḥ sabhbhavati; ācāryo hi darbhapavitrapāṇiḥ śucāvavakāśe prāṅ‌mukha āsīno maṅgalapūrvakaṃ mahatā praṇidhānena sūtrāṇi praṇītavān | tatrāśakyaṃ varṇenāpyanarthakena bhavitum, kiṃ punariyatā sūtreṇa ! sādhvanuśāsanamapi na bhavati, siddhatvādvṛddhiśabdasya ktinnantatvāt, ādaicchabdasya cārthavattvāt | nanu chandovadbhāvena sūtra eva prayogaḥ siddhyati, sūtrādvahirapi kutvābhāvārthaṃ nipātanametat syāt, ucyāte; vṛddhiśabdasyaivamananvayaprasaṅgaḥ, saṃbhūyakāritvaṃ ca padānāṃ vyutpattisiddham, ato nāyaṃ pakṣaḥ | nāpi prayoganiyamārtham, yatra hi sahaprayogaprasaṅgastatra niyamaḥ karttavyaḥ | na ca vṛddhyādaicchabdayoḥ sahaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ, viniyogātprāgasambandhād uttarakālaṃ vṛddhiśabdenaiva gatatvāt | kiṃ ca neha prayoganiyama ārabhyate | nanvārabhyate,'paraśca' iti ? padasya nārabhyate | padasyāpyārabhyate 'upasarjanaṃ pūrvam ' iti ? yayoraikapadyaṃ nāsti tayornārabhyate | tayorapyārabhyate 'te prāgdhātoḥ' 'kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' iti ? naivaṃvidhenoccāraṇenārabhyate | evamapyārabhyate 'vidāṅ‌kurvantvityanyatarasyām' iti ? nātra kevalaḥ prayoga eva niyamyate, kintu āmādikamapi vidhīyate, ataḥ kevalasya prayoganiyamasya sākṣāduccāraṇena kvacidapyabhāvānnāyaṃ prayoganiyamaḥ | ādeśārthamapi na bhavati; sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaiva hyādeśatvam | na ca vṛddhiśabda ādaicām, te vā tasyārthamabhidhātuṃ samarthāḥ | nirdeśācca; yadayaṃ 'sici vṛddhiḥ' 'yātivātidrāti,' 'rāyaḥ','nāvaḥ', ityāha, tato jñāyate--'na vṛddhiśabda ādaicāṃ te vā tasyādeśāḥ' iti | athādaic‌śabdasya vṛddhiśabda ādeśaḥ kasmanna bhavati, na hyatra kiṃ cilliṅgamasti ? satyam; ayaṃ tu pakṣo na saṃbhavatyeva, aicchabdo hyādirantyeneti saṃjñātvena viniyuktaḥ kathamasya svarūpasya grahaṇam; aśabdasaṃjñeti niṣedhāt | etaireva liṅgairāgamārthatvaṃ na bhavati | ṣaṣṭhyabhāvācca, 'pūrvau tu tābhyām' iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyartho'vagamyate | ṭittvādiliṅgābhāvācca, na hi tadrahitaḥ kaścidāgamo dṛṣṭaḥ | viśeṣaṇatvamapi na bhavati, asaṃbhavādaprayojanatvācca | na hyasti saṃbhavo vṛddhiśabdaścāsāvādaicchabdaśceti, nāpi varddhanakriyā''daij iti | evaṃ viśeṣaṇe ca prayojanamapi nāsti | etena tad‌guṇādhyāropo'pi nirastaḥ | yathā hi siṃho māṇavaka iti siṃhaguṇā māṇavake āropyante, naivamatra sambhavaḥ prayojanaṃ vā'sti; ataḥ pāriśeṣyātsaṃjñāsaṃjñisambandha evetyālocyāha-vṛddhiśabda ityādi | viparyayastu na bhavati--vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñī, ādaicaḥ saṃjñati | sa hi tridhā syāt--ādaijityayaṃ śabdaḥ, ā ai au ityayaṃ samudāyaḥ, te vā pratyekamiti | tatrādaicchabhdastāvanna sambhavati; aijityasya saṃjñāśabdatvāt, svarūpagrahaṇāsambhavāt, gauravād, anāvṛtteśca | āvarttinyo hi saṃjñā bhavanti, vṛddhiḥ śabdaścāvarttate; nādaicchabdaḥ | nāpi samudāyaḥ, gauravādanāvṛtteśca | astu tarhi pratyekam, lāghavādāvṛtteśca--'aṣṭana ā vibhaktau', 'pūtakratoraica' 'manorau vā ' iti ? na; prayojanamantareṇaikasyānekasaṃjñākaraṇasyāyuktatvāt, na hyayaṃ vṛddhiśabdaḥ sahasreṇa nāmabhiḥ stotavyaḥ | śabdenārthasya saṃjñātvaṃ mā vijñāyīti śabdagrahaṇam, etaccārthe vyavahārāsambhavāllabhyate | tadiha vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena vidhīyata iti samudāyenānarthakādipakṣanirāsaḥ | vṛddhiśabda ityanena viparyayanirāsaḥ | vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñā, na punarādaicchabda iti vacanavyaktyā śabdagrahaṇenārthanarāsaḥ-vṛddhiśabdaḥ saṃjñā na punarartha iti | yatra samudāyasya kāryamicchati karoti tatra prayatnam--'ubhe abhyastam' iti | tatra hyubhegrahaṇaṃ samuditapratipattyartham | anvarthāṃ vā mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ karoti-'halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ' iti | iha tu mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ maṅgalārtham | atha eva prathamamuccāraṇam; anyathā hi sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti 'adeṅ‌ guṇaḥ' ityādivannirdiśyeta | ato yatnābhāvātpratyekameva saṃjñā | kiñca--laukikaprayoge vyavasthitānāmādaicāṃ saṃjñayā bhavitavyam | na ca samudāyasya kvacitprayogaḥ, ato'saṃbhavādapi pratyekameva saṃjñā | liṅgācca-kiṃ liṅgam ? 'prasthe vṛddha makarkyādīnām' 'mālādīnāṃ ca' iti | idaṃ hi 'mālāprasthaḥ' ityādāvavṛddhamiti paryudāse prāpte vacanam,ataḥ pratyekameva saṃjñā tadāha-pratyekamiti ||
tatrāpi trayaḥ prakārāḥ-lugādisaṃjñāvattadbhāvitānāmeva, ṭisaṃjñāvadvā'tadbhāvitānāmeva, anunāsikādisaṃjñāvadubhayeṣāṃ veti | tatra yadi tadbhāvitānāmeva--ye vṛddhisaṃjñayā bhāvyante, teṣāmeva syāt, śālīyo mālīya iti cho na syāt; āmramayaṃ raikulamayam--vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṇ na syāt; āmraguptāyaniḥ--'udīcāṃ vṛddhāt' iti phiñ na syāt | athātadbhāvitānāmeva--gārgīyaḥ, aitikāyaniyaḥ, aupagavīyaḥ-cho na syāt ; ato doṣadarśanādagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāccobhayeṣāṃ saṃjñetyāha-sāmānyeneti | ākāro'naṇtvādeva na bhinnakālānāṃ grāhaka iti na tannivṛrttyarthaṃ taparatvam, nāpi guṇāntarayuktānāṃ grahaṇārtham | abhedakatvācca guṇānām, loke hi muṇḍenāpi caurye kṛte saṃjātakeśo'pi pratyabhijñāya nigṛhyate | tathā 'aḍudāttaḥ' ityudāttavacanaṃ liṅgam, anyathā hyudāttaguṇamevāṭamuccārayet | ato'narthakaṃ taparakaraṇamityata āha--taparakaraṇamiti | taścāsau paraśca taparaḥ, tasya karaṇamuccāraṇam, ākārātparasya takārasyoccāraṇamityarthaḥ | atha vā-taḥ paro yasmāditi tad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ, takārasahitasyākārasyoccāraṇamityarthaḥ | aijarthamiti | aicorarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam | 'taparastatkālasya' ityatra taḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhirāśritaḥ | tatkathaṃ taparakaraṇamaijarthamityāśaṅkya pañcamīsamāso'pi tatrāśrita iti darśayati-tādapi para iti | itikaraṇo hetau | yasmāt tādapi parastasmādaijartha iti | aijarthatvameva prakaṭayati--khaṭvailakādiṣviti | asati taparakaraṇe trimātracaturmātrayorapyaicoḥ savarṇagrahaṇena grahaṇād vṛddhisaṃjñā syāt, tataśca vṛkṣailakaḥ, vṛkṣaudanaḥ, khaṭvailakā, khaṭ‌vaudana iti trimātracaturmātrasthāninostrimātracaturmātrāvevaikārokārausyātāmiti tannivṛrtyathaṃ taparakaraṇam | āśvalāyana ityādīni tadbhāvitānāmākārādīnāṃ krameṇa rūpodāharaṇāni | aśvaletikaśabdau naḍādī | upamanyuśabdo bidādiḥ | lakṣaṇasya bahuviṣayatvasūcanārthaṃ caturthasyodāharaṇasyopanyāsaḥ | ākārasyātadbhāvitasya kāryodāharaṇamāha--śālīyaḥ, mālīya iti | aikāraukārayostvatadbhāvitayorudāharaṇaṃ raikulamayaṃ naukulamayamiti, vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaḍ‌ bhavati ||
adeṅ‌ guṇaḥ || 1.1.2 ||
pūrveṇa tulyametat | taparakaraṇaṃ tviha sarvārthamiti | na tu pūrvavadanyatarārthamiti tuśabdasyārthaḥ | asati hi tasmin dīrghaplutayorapi guṇasaṃjñā syāt; tataśca taratīti kadācidakāraḥ syāt, kadācidākāraḥ, raparatve kṛta ekasyādhyardhamātratvādaparasyārdhatṛtīyamātratvāt | na cākārasya vṛddhisaṃjñā bādhikā; ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñāsamāveśāt | eṅaśca trimātracaturmātrasya guṇasaṃjñāyām-ratheṣā,khaṭ‌veṣā, aśvoḍhaḥ, vaḍavoḍha iti trimātraturmātrau syātām | taritetyādīni tadbhāvitānāmadeṅāṃ krameṇa rūpodāharaṇāni | pacanti jayantītyakārasya kāryodāharaṇe | atrāntyakāre parataḥ śabakāras 'ato guṇe' iti pararūpaṃ bhavati | ekārasyātadbhāvitasyodāharaṇam-ahaṃ pace iti | okārasya tu na saṃbhavati ||
iko guṇavṛddhī || 1.1.3 ||
paribhāṣeyamiti | nādhikāraḥ; asvaritatvāt, asaṃyujyanirdeśācca | adhikāre hi 'iko guṇavṛddhī na dhātulopaḥ' iti saṃyujyaiva nirdiśet | nāpi vidhiḥ, 'ikaḥ sthāne guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ' iti lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhāsyāmānatvāt | nanu yadāyaṃ svatantro vidhistadā teṣvika ityasyopasthāpakābhāvād yātetyādāvaniko'pi vidhiḥ syāt, iha tu sārvadhātukādyabhāve'pi dadhi madhvityādau vidhirastu ? evaṃ tarhi guṇavṛddhyadhikāre punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇānna vidhiḥ | yadyapi prakṛtaṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāparam, iha tvanuvṛttisāmarthyātsaṃjñiparaṃ bhaviṣyati | 'adeṅ guṇaḥ' ityatra cānuvarttamānamapi vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na saṃbadhyate, anyavacanāccakārākaraṇācca | anyā hi tatra guṇasaṃjñocyate, cakāraśca na kriyate; ato vidhipakṣe punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam | ata evādhikāro'pi na bhavati | paribhāṣāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ viśiṣṭaviṣayatvasiddhaye karttavyaṃ taditi vakṣyāmaḥ | ataḥ paribhāṣeyam |
yogo vāyaṃ vyapadiśyeta, sūtraṃ vā, tatkatham 'iyam' iti strīliṅganirddeśaḥ ? ucyate-yathāyaṃ yogaḥ, yathā vā sūtramidam, evaṃ paribhāṣāpi, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyādiyamiti nirdeśaḥ | nanu paribhāṣātvaṃ vidhitsitam, idaṃśabdastu uddeśakaḥ, siddharūpasya coddeśaḥ, sūtrarūpatā yogarūpatā vā siddheti punarapyuddeśakasya strīliṅgānupapatiḥ | kaścidatra paribhāṣeyamityanūdya sthāniniyamārthatā vidhīyate-'yeyaṃ paribhāṣā sā sthāniniyamārtheti, na tu paribhāṣārūpatā vidhīyate' ityāha, sa vācyaḥ-'asiddhaṃ paribhāṣātvaṃ kathamanūdyate' iti | avyāpakaścāyaṃ parihāraḥ 'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ityādau | tatra paribhāṣeyamityetāvacchrū yate, na punaretadartheti | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ-nirdiśyamānapratinirdiśyamānayoraikyamāpādayanti sarvanāmāni paryāyeṇa talliṅgabhāñji bhavanti | tatra yathā 'aṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karttā' iti karmākāraparāmarśino'pi tacchabdasya vadhīyamānasya kartrākārasya liṅgaṃ bhavati, tadvadihāpi sūtramevoddiśyata idaṃśabdasya vidhīyamānaparibhāṣākārasya liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati | sthāniniyamārtheti | igākhye sthānini guṇavṛddhyorniyamo'rthaḥ - prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā | 'dvandve ghi' iti vṛddhiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāptaḥ sūtranirdreśena nityaṃ bādhyate;'dharmādiṣu ubhayam' ṇati vacanāditi sūcayannāha-vṛddhiguṇāvityādi |
kiṃ punaranena granthenocyate ? nanu niyamarūpeṇāsya sūtrasya pravṛttiriti; yathā 'eca igraghrasvādeśe' hrasva ādiśyamāna eca igeveti | yadyevam, aniyamaprasaṅge niyama iti 'sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ','sici vṛddhiḥ' ityatraiva syāt, atra hyasatyasminyoge'lo'ntyasya bhavantau vṛddhiguṇāvanantyasyāviśeṣitatvādikaścānikaśva prāpnutaḥ, na tu midimṛjipugantaladhūpadharchidṛśikṣiprakṣudreṣvapi'atrālo; ntyasyetyanika eva prasaṅgaḥ | atha sarvavākyānāṃ sāvadhāraṇatvāt prāptamevāvadhāraṇamika evetyevaśabdenābhidhīyate, na punarniyamo'nena pradarśyate; yathā-'tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' iti | ato vidhirūpeṇaivāsya vyāpārau vivakṣitaḥ, paribhāṣātvācca guṇavṛddhividheḥ saṃskārakaṃ vidhyantaramidam, yathā 'idgoṇyāḥ' ityādeḥ'alo'ntyasya' ityayamiti pakṣaḥ | tato nāprāptāyāmalo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāmiyamārabhyamāṇā tasyā bādhikā syāt | tataśca yatraiṣā, na tatra sā pravartteteti jusi guṇo yatheha bhavati--abibhayuḥ abibharuriti, evamanenijuḥ paryaveviṣuratrāpi prāpnoti | 'sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' yatheha bhavati cetā stoteti; evamīhitā, ūhitā, umbhitā atrāpi prāpnoti |
atha tu sāmān.yaviśeṣayorasambhave bādyabādhakabhāvaḥ; asti cātra sambhavo yad alo'ntyasya guṇavṛddhī syātām ikaśca, tataḥ 'jusi ca' ityādau guṇavṛddhiliṅgādikparibhāṣāpyupatiṣṭhata, aṅgasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt, 'alo'ntyasya' ityeṣāpi | tatra ca na samuccayo'ṅgāntyasyāniko'pi guṇo bhavati, tadavayavasya ceko'nantyasyāpīti | nāpi vikalpaḥ;kadācidaṅgāntyasyāniko'pi, kadācittadavayavasyeko'nantyasyāpīti, ekatvāt ṣaṣṭhyarthasyaika eva hi sakṛcchru tāyā aṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā arthaḥ-sthāneyogo vā thaavayavayogo vā, na dvau samuccitau nāpi vikalpitau | tatra yadyaṅgasyetyetatpūrvamika ityanena vaiyadhikaraṇyena saṃbadhyeta-'aṅgasya ya ik, tasya guṇaḥ' iti, tato'lo'ntyasyetyetadananvitaṃ syāt | ataḥ pūrvamalontyasyetyanena saṃbadhyate, sa cāntyekā viśeṣyate 'aṅgāntyasyeko guṇaḥ' iti | yadvā-ikā'ṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhiḥ-igantasyāṅgasyeti | evamapi hi sthānaṣaṣṭhītvānapāyādalāntyasyetyavyāhataprasaraṃ sarvathāṅgāntyasyeko guṇa iti jusi sārvadhātukārdhadhātukagume na kaściddoṣaḥ | midādiṣu pūrvoktena prakāreṇa dvayoranvayāsaṃbhāvadanyataraddhātavyam | tatrāviśeṣādubhayamapi tyajyeta, ucyete ca vṛddhiguṇau 'mṛjervṛddhiḥ' 'miderguṇaḥ' iti, tau sarvādeśau syātām | ato vidhirūpeṇa niyamarūpeṇa vāsya sūtrasya vyāpāro nābhyupagantavyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? anena kriyate padopasthāpanam; yatra brūyād guṇo bhavatīti, vṛddhirbhavatīti; tatreka ityetat ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padamupatiṣṭhatāmiti | 'alo'ntyasya' ityasya tu vākyabhāvaḥ | evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne 'saci vṛddhiḥ' ityādau yatrāntya ik saṃbhavati, tatreka ityetenopasthitenāṅge viśeṣite tadantavidhau satīgantāṅgasya guṇa iti vākyavyāpāre pariniṣṭhate paścādalo'ntyasyetyetadigantasya prāptaṃ gaṇaṃ tato'pakṛṣyāṅgāntyasya vidhatte, na tvika ityasyopasthānavelāyāmupatiṣṭhate | 'miderguṇaḥ' ityādau tu yatrāntya iṅ‌ na saṃbhavati tatrāṅgeneki viśeṣite'ṅgasyeko guṇa iti vākyavyāpāre parisamāpte sthānaṣaṣṭhyabhāvātsvayaṃ na pravartate, na tvika ityanena sahopatiṣṭhate, yenāviśeṣādubhayornivṛttiḥ syāditi siddhamiṣṭam |
vṛttikāreṇa tvasya sūtrasya prayojanaṃ piṇḍīkṛtya pradarśitam-sarvathāntyasya vā'nantyasya veke eva guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ, na tvakṣaravyāpāraḥ | ata eva veditavyau ityāha | akṣaravyāpārapradarśane tu ika eva sthāne bhavata ityetāvadvaktavyaṃ syāt | svasaṃjñayā śiṣyamāṇāviti | vṛddhirbhavati guṇo bhavatītyevaṃ vidhīyamānāvityarthaḥ |
ika iti kimiti | pradhānāvayavākṣepeṇa samudāyasyaivākṣepaḥ-sūtraṃ kimarthamityarthaḥ | ātsandhyakṣaretyādi | nanu 'gāpoṣṭak' iti ṭakaḥ kitkaraṇaṃ sāmaga ityādāvāllope ca siddhaṃ syāt sāmaga iti | tathā glāyatītyādau sandhyakṣarāṇāmapyupadeśasāmarthyād guṇo na bhaviṣyati, itarathā prākriyālāghavārthamekāramevopadiśet | 'janerḍaḥ' iti ḍitkaraṇādvyañjanānāmapi guṇo na bhaviṣyati | yadi hi tasya syād, arddhamātrasya mātrike'kāre guṇe kṛte siddhaṃ syādupasaraja iti | yadyevam,miderguṇo'ntyādvyāvartitaḥ sarvādeśaḥ syāt | kiṃ ca gamerapyayaṃ ḍo bhavati, tasya ca sthānata āntaryādokāro guṇaḥ syāt; rainauglauśabdebhyaścācārākvibantebhyastṛjādau guṇaprasaṅgo yadyabhidhānamasti; tathā citaḥ, cinutaḥ,bhinnaḥ, bebhidyate ityādau 'kṅiti ca' iti pratiṣedhārthamapi guṇasyeglakṣaṇatvameṣitavyam |
atha vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? 'mṛjervṛddhiḥ' iko yathā syāt, alo'ntyasya mā bhūt | yogavibhāgātsiddham--'mṛjervṛddhiracaḥ', mṛjeraco vṛddhirbhavati, aṅgākṣiptena pratyayenāco viśeṣaṇāt 'nyāmārṭ' aṭo na bhaviṣyati, sici vṛddhistarhyakārasya mā bhūt, acikīrṣīt | ato lopo bhaviṣyati, 'ṇyallopāviyaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghebhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddham' iti vacanāt, yathā-cikīrṣaka iti | ākārasya nāsti viśeṣaḥ; sagvidhānādasaṃbhavaśca | ejantamapi na saṃbhavati; ātvavidhānāt | rainauglośabdānāmācārakvibantānāmaviśeṣaḥ, gośabdasya kvibantasya 'ṝta iddhātoḥ' ityataḥ 'dhātoḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ dhātureva yo dhāturiti vijñānāt sici vṛddhyabhāvaḥ | abhaitsīdityādau 'saci vṛddhiḥ' ityanena vyañjanasya nāprāptāyāṃ vṛddhau vidhīyamānā halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhirbādhikā, 'neṭi' ityayaṃ ca niṣedho yāvatī halantasya vṛddhiḥ, sici vṛddhiriti vā, halantasyāca iti vā, sā sarvā na bhavatīti vijñāyate | tena anardīdityādau antyasya vṛddhirna bhaviṣyati | tadevam 'iko vṛddhiryathā syād adeṅvyañḍanānāṃ mā bhūd' ityevamarthaṃ tāvad vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam | evaṃ tarhi mṛjyate, mṛṣṭa ityādau 'kṅiti ca' iti pratiṣedhārthaṃ mṛjervṛddheriglakṣaṇatvam | idamapi yogavibhāgātsiddham--mṛjervṛddhirityasyānantaramajādau kṅiti veti | vaktavyam--parimṛjanti parimārjjanti,parimamṛjatḥ parimamārjaturityevamartham | tatra yogavibhāgaḥ-'ajādau kṅiti mṛjeraco vṛddhirbhavati' | kimarthamidam ? niyamārtham--kṅiti yadi bhavati ajādāveveti | tena mṛjyate mṛṣṭa ityādau na bhaviṣyati, tato vā, ajādāvapi vikalpeneti | sici vṛddhestarhi pratiṣedhārthamiglakṣaṇatvam | 'ṇu stutau' 'dhū vidhūnane' kuṭādī, nyanuvīd nyadhuvīd | atrāpyantarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅga uvaṅi sati halantatvāt 'neṭi' iti niṣedhaḥ | yadi sicyantaraṅgaṃ bhavati, acaiṣīd ahauṣīd ahauṣīd-guṇaḥ syāt | astu, tasyaiva vṛddhiḥ kariṣyate ? akārṣīdityādau halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, atārīdityādau halantalakṣaṇāyāḥ 'neṭi' iti pratiṣedhe 'ato halādeḥ ' iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā 'ato lrāntasya' iti nityā vṛddhiḥ | alāvīdityādāvuvarṇānteṣu seṭi sicyantaraṅgatvād guṇāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorapi 'ato lrāntasya' ityatra vakārasyāpi luptanirdiṣṭatvānnityā vṛddhiḥ | yadyevam, mā bhavānavīt amavīdityatrāpi tarhi vakārapraśleṣānnatyā vṛddhiḥ syāt | sicyantaraṅgaṃ bhavatītyukte 'hmyantakṣaṇa' ityatra ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ nakarttavyam; aunayīt, aśvayīdityatrāntaraṅgatvād guṇāvayādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ netyeva siddhatvāt | tatsthāne 'avimavī'niveśayiṣyāmaḥ-'ato lrāntasya' ityatra vakārapraśleṣeṇa prāpta vṛddhiravimavyorneti | tadevamanarthakaṃ vṛddhigrahaṇam ? nānarthakam, sicyantaraṅgasya pravṛttimāśritya hi vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyate,yadi ca sicyantaraṅgaṃ syāt cinīprabhṛtibhyo yaṅgalugantebhyaściriṇotijiriṇotibhyāṃ ca luṅi sici acecāyīd; anenāyīd, acirāyīd, ajirājīditi na syād; guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ yāntānāṃ neti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgād | iglakṣaṇāyāṃ tu saci vṛddhau tayaivāntaraṅgaṃ bādhyate, yadi syād, na kvāpi sicīgantamaṅgaṃ bhavet, tataścācirāyīdityādi siddham | yathā ca tayā guṇāyadeśau bādhyete, evaṃ nyanuvīdityuvaṅapi bādhyeta | ataḥ pratiṣedhārthamapi vṛddheriglakṣaṇatvameṣitavyamiti sarvamavadātam | evaṃ bahuvaktavyatvād vṛttikāreṇa vṛddhigrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ na darśitam |
atha kathaṃ svasaṃjñayā śiṣyamāṇāvityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate ityāha-guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamityādi | iha pūrvasūtrābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamanuvartate | tenaivādeṅāmādaikṣāṃ ca grahaṇe siddhe yatpunarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ tatsvasaṃjñayā vidhānaniyamārtham; anyathā prakṛtaṃguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ taṭasthamupalakṣaṇaṃ syād--'vastuto ye guṇavṛddhī taddhidhau' iti | sa tu vidhirguṇavṛddhiśabdābhyāṃ prakārāntareṇa vetyeva viśeṣo nāśritaḥ syāt, punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyāttu śabdavyāpāro'pyāśrīyate--guṇavṛddhī ye guṇavṛddhī, evaṃ śabdite ye guṇavṛddhī ityanyatarasya guṇavṛddhigrahaṇasya svarūpapradhānatvaṃ sampadyate | tenāyaṃ viśeṣo labhyata ityarthaḥ | anyathā 'acaśca' ityasya svasaṃjñayā vidhāne niyamasya 'diva ut' ityādiṣvaguṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu; tatsaṃjñeṣu ca yatreṅ na saṃbhavati 'aṣṭana ā vibhaktau' ityādau, tatra caritārthatvāt 'diva aut' ityādiṣu guṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu yatrek saṃbhavati tatrāyaṃ niyamaḥ syāt | dyauḥ panthāḥ, saḥ,imamiti | sa ityetadanudāharaṇam, na hyatregasti |
evaṃ prakaṭito'smābhirbhāṣye paricayaḥ paraḥ |
tasya niḥśeṣato manye pratipattāpi durlabhaḥ ||
na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke || 1.1.4 ||
'durīṇo lopaśca' duḥśabda upapade iṇo dhātorapratyayo bhavati, dhātośca lopaḥ | duḥkhena īyate-prāpyate dūramityatra yadyapi kṛtsnasya dhātorlopaḥ saṃbhavati, tathāpyevaṃviṣaye guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptyabhāvādekadeśe dhātuśabdo varttata ityāha--dhātvekadeśa iti | 'dhātulopa' iti tatpuruṣe sati ārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ lopaviṣeṣaṇ, guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇ, ubhayaviṣeṣaṇaṃ vā-iti trayaḥ kalpāḥ | tatra yadi lopaviṣeṣaṇam--ārddhadhātukanimitte dhātulope sati yatkiñcid nimitte guṇavṛddhī na bhavata ityarthaḥ syāt | tataśca preddham ityatra prapūrvādindheḥ ktapratyaye tannimitte nalope sati prāpnuvata ād‌guṇasyāpi niṣedhaḥ syāt | yadyapīka ityanuvartate, tathāpi dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭayoḥ sthāne bhavannanyataravyapadeśaṃ labhata iti syādeva | na ceha sūtre 'ika' ityasya rūpaparatve pramāṇamasti | uttarasūtre tu pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | nanu 'pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' ityasmin darśane prathamopanatakta pratyayāpekṣatvādupadhālopo'ntaraṅga iti tadapekṣaḥ pratiṣedho'pyantaraṅgaḥ, 'pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate' iti tu darśane prathamopanatopasargāpekṣatvād guṇo'ntaraṅgaḥ, tataśca 'asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' iti pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; 'nājānantarthe' iti niṣedhāt | atha guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇamārddhadhātukagrahaṇam, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--yatkiñcana nimitte dhātulope satyārddhadhātukanimitte guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti ; tadā preddhamityatra doṣo na, guṇasyātannimittatvāt; kintu kranopayatītyatra 'vanūyī śabde' taityasmāṇṇici puki ca yalope pugantalakṣaṇasya guṇasya niṣedhaḥ syād | ata ubhayaviṣeṣaṇam--ārddhadhātukanimitte dhātulope satyārddhadhātukanimitte guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti |
tatra sakṛcchrutasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatvameva tāvad durlabham ? athāpi syād, evamapi lopaguṇavṛddhīnāmekārddhadhātukanimittatvaṃ na labhyate | tataśca vibhajyānvākhyānapakṣe bhedyata ityatra bhiderṇyantātkarmaṇi yaki bhida-i-ya iti sthite nityatvātpūva ṇilope kṛte yakamapekṣya pravṛtte pratyayalakṣaṇena ṇicamapekṣya prāpnuvato guṇasya niṣedhaḥ syād, dvayorapyārddhadhātukanimittatvāditi tatpuruṣe sati sarvathā doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha--tasya lopo yasminniti | asminpakṣe dhātorlopo yasminniti anyapadārthabhūtenārddhadhātukena lopo viśeṣyate, sākṣācca guṇavṛddhī, dhātorlopo yasmin tasminniti | ekārddhadhātukanimittatvaṃ ca lopaguthaṇavṛddhīnāṃ labhyata iti na kaścid doṣaḥ | tena bhavata iti | anena guṇavṛddhyorayaṃ niṣadhaḥ, na pūrvasūtravyāpārasyeti darśayati | padopasthāpanaṃ hi pūrvasūtravyāpāraḥ | na caivambhūta ārddhadhātuke tasya prasaṅgaḥ, 'dīdhīvevīṭām' iti cāsambaddhaṃ syādupasthānaniṣedhe | loluva ityādi | lupūbhyāṃ yaṅ‌, dvirvacanam, 'guṇo yaṅ‌lukoḥ' guṇe niṣiddhe upaṅ | marīmṛja iti | 'rīgṛdupadhasya ca' | lolūyādibhya ityādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇeṣu darśayati | nanu ca yaṅakārasyāto lope kṛte tasyā sathānivattvādeva guṇavṛddhī na bhaviṣyataḥ, yathā--pāpacaka iti 'ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ, na hyatrānena niṣedhaḥ sidhyati, kiṃ kārataṇam ? aniglakṣaṇatvāt | nālopo labhyate, 'yaṅo'ci ca ' iti samudāyalukā pratipadavihitena bādhitatvāt | yogavibhāgātsiddham--ato lopo bhavatyārddhadhātuke, tato 'yasya' ya ityasya samudāyasya yo'kārastasyāpi lopo bhavati | kimarthamidam ? viśeṣavihitena samudāyalukā'to lopo mā bādhīti | tena sthānivattvādeva guṇavṛddhī na bhaviṣyataḥ | yathaiva tarhi guṇavṛddhī na bhavata evaṃ kṣetriyaḥ, cekriyaḥ, loluvaḥ, toṣṭavaḥ, suśruva itīyaṅuvaṅāvapyacpratyayamapekṣya na syātām | mā bhūtāmaci, ya eva tvasau sthānyakārastadāśrayau bhaviṣyataḥ | sa hi yakāre lupte pratyayasaṃjñakaḥ | nanu kṣetriyaḥ toṣṭuva ityatrāntaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lug bādhata iti akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghāt prageva yaṅo luki kṛte sthānivadbhāve satyapi cekṣi a a, toṣṭu a a iti sthite sthānyakāreṇa saha laghūpadhamaṅgaṃ saṃjātamiti acpratyaye guṇaḥ syādevaḥ ; na antaraṅgāviyaṅuvaṅau bhaviṣyataḥ, aśiśriyad adudruvad iti yathā | ataḥ sthānivattvādeva siddham, nārtho'nena ? ucyate; sarvatra dīrghānteṣu hrasvānteṣu ceyaṅuvaṅoḥ kṛtayoḥ punarlaghūpadhalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ prāpnoti | na ca punarapi sthānivadbhāvaḥ, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | kiñca yadyato lopaḥ kriyeta, jaṅgama ityatra 'gamahan' ityudhālopaḥ syāt | athātrānaṅīti pratiṣedhastarhi darīdṛśa ityatra 'ṛdṛśoḥ' iti guṇaḥ syād; dedya ityatra 'dīṅo yuḍaci' iti yuṭ‌ syāt; sanīsraṃsaḥ, danīdhvaṃsa ityatra 'aniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ syāt; yāyāvara ityādiṣvākāralopaḥ syāt | yadā punarthogavibhāgamakṛtvā viśeṣavihitaḥ samudāyaluk kriyate, tadā halacorādeśasya sthānivattvābhāvādupadhālopādayo na bhavantītyavaśyaṃ samudāyasya lugeṣitavyaḥ | evaṃ ca loluva ityādāvapi guṇavṛddhī syātāmiti sūtramapi karttavyam || lūñ laviteti | prāgeva dhātusaṃjñāyā bhavannanubandhalopo dhātulopo na bhavati | reḍasīti | 'ruṣa riṣa hiṃsāyām' | 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti vic, verapṛktasya lopaḥ--na dhātulopo bhavati |
nanvasatyapi dhātugrahaṇe lupyate'sminnityadhikaraṇasādhanalopaśabdasyāśrayaṇādanaimittike'nubandhapratyayalope na bhaviṣyati | tatra lopaśabdo hi saṃjñaśabdaḥ, kathamasyādhikaraṇasādhanatā labhyate | roravītīti | 'ru śabde' yaṅ‌luki tipi rūpam | nanvasatyapyārdhadhātukagrahaṇe dhātorlopo yasminniti bahuvrīhirvijñāsyate, roravītītyatra ca yaṅ‌luganaimittikaḥ | na hyārddhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhitve pramāṇam; satyapi tasmiṃstatparuṣasambhavāt | idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--'turvī thurvī dharvī hiṃsārthāḥ', murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ, tebhyo yaṅ‌lugantebhyastibādau sārvadhātuke parato rāllope totorti momortītyādau chravorlopasya guṇasya caikanimittatvānniṣedhaḥ syādeva | ika ityeveti | ika ityasyānuvṛttiṃ prati na śaṅkā kāryetyevaśabdasyārthaḥ | ataḥ abhāji, rāga iti 'bhañjeśca ciṇi', 'ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' ityupadhālopaḥ ||
prakriyātarkagahanapraviṣṭo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
haradattahariḥ svairaṃ viharan kena vāryate ||
kṅiti ca || 1.1.5 ||
kṅid‌grahaṇaṃ yadi vidhīyamānasya pratiṣedhasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syād--guṇavṛddhī kṅiti na bhavata iti, tato vidhisaṃsparśāt ' tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' ityasyopasthānāt kṅityanantara eva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | yadyapi pratiṣedhasya vidhānadaśāyāṃ paurvāparyaṃ na saṃbhavati, tathā niṣedhyamānayorguṇavṛddhyorapi; tathāpi sthānina iko'nantare kṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | evaṃ hi vidhānottarakālamapi tāvad guṇavṛddhyabhāvarūpasya pratiṣedhasya kṅidanantaraḥ sambhavati, 'iko yaṇaci' ityādāvapyetāvadeva paurvāparyaṃ yadvidhānadaśāyāṃ tu sthāninaḥ, uttarakālaṃ tu vidheyasya | yadā tvanūdyamānayorguṇavṛddhyorviṣeṣaṇam-kṅiti sati ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste na bhavata iti, tadā'nuvādakatvāttasminnatyādikāyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anupasthānam | na hi 'kṅiti sati ye guṇavṛddhī' ityukte vidhivyāpāreṇa kṅitaḥ kaścit saṃsparśaḥ | vidhyaṅgabhūtāśca paribhāṣāstatraivopatiṣṭhante nānuvāde, tasyāpi parārthatvād,dvayośca parārthayoḥ parasparaṃ sabandhābhāvāt; anyathā 'vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham' ityatrekparibhāṣopasthāne śālīya iti vṛddhasaṃjñāyā abhāvāttallakṣaṇaścho na syāt | tathā ca 'udīcāmātaḥ sthāne; iti sthānegrahaṇaṃ kṛtam-ātaḥ sthāne yo'kāra ityanuvādakatvāt 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti sthāneyogo na labhyeteti | ato'smin pakṣe kṅitīti sati saptamī 'yasya ca bhāvena' iti | kṅitorhi sattālakṣaṇena bhāvena guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptalakṣaṇo bhāvo lakṣyate, nimittasya ca sattayā nimittinaḥ prāptirlakṣyata iti 'kṅiti sati ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ ' ityasya 'kṅinnimitte ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste na bhavata' ityartho bhavati | bhinnaḥ, mṛṣṭa ityādau copadhāyā api prāpnuvantyau guṇavṛddhī kṅitaṃ nimittamāśritya prāpnuta ityetatsarvamālocyāha--nimittasaptamyeṣeti | nimittātsāptamī nimittasamaptamī, pañcamyarthe śeṣatvena vivakṣite paṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | kṅinnimitte iti | etena guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇaṃ kṅidgrahaṇamiti darśayati | nanu ca vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt pratiṣedhasyaivaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam, naitadasti; yatra hi guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānopakārāya mahate prabhavati, tatrātmano'pi saṃskāramanubhūya pradhānena sambadhyate, yathā-pānīyamelādisaṃskṛtaṃ puruṣeṇa | uktaṃ ca-
"guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānaṃ pratipadyate |
pradhānasyopakāre hi tathā bhūyasi vartate ||" iti |
iha ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṅid‌grahaṇena viśeṣitayormahān pradhānapratiṣedhasyopakāro bhavati; vyavahitasyāpi tatsiddheḥ | bhinna iti-'radābhyām' iti natvam | mṛṣṭa iti - vraścādinā ṣatvam | cinvantīti-'sārvadhātukamapit' 'huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' | yadyeṣā nimittasaptamī, śacaṅante doṣaḥ; 'dhi dhāraṇe' 'ri gatau',tudādītābhyāṃ tipi 'tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' 'ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ' karttari caṅ' dhi a ti, ri a ti, śri a t, dru a t, iti sthite śacaṅantasyāṅgasya tipi laghūpadhalakṣaṇaśca guṇaḥ prāpnoti, śacaṅoḥ parataḥ pūrvasya sārvadhātukalakṣaṇaśca, tatra śacaṅ‌nimittasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syād, na tiṅ‌nimittasya | pakṣāntare tu tiṅ‌nimittasyāpi guṇasya śacaṅoḥ parataḥ pratiṣedho labhyate | na vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvādvahirbhūtatibāśrayo guṇo bahiraṅgo'ntarbhūtaśacaṅ‌nimittābhyāmiyaṅuvaṅ‌bhyāṃ bādhiṣyate | 'glājisthaśca vasnuḥ' ityatra vakṣyati--'giccāyaṃ pratyayo na kit, tena stha īkāro na bhavati' iti,'kasnorgittvānna stha īkāraḥ' iti ca | tataśca bhūṣṇurityatra pratiṣedho na syādityata āha--gakāro'pyatretyādi | cartve bhūtaḥ-cartvaṃ prāptaḥ | ata eva gakarapraśleṣāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavati; anyathā kṅitau dvau, guṇavṛddhī api dve iti saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti-kiti guṇasya, ṅiti vṛddheriti | jñāpakādvā, yadayaṃ 'miderguṇaḥ' iti śyani ṅiti guṇaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-'nātra saṃkhyātānudeśo bhavati' iti | yadi tarhi ksnupratyayo gid, bhūṣṇuritīṭ‌ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'śryukaḥ kiti' ityatrāpi gakāraścartvabhūto nirdiśyate, sautratvācca nirdeśasya cartvasyāsiddhatvātprāptamapi 'haśi ca' ityutvaṃ na bhavati, 'kupvoḥ' iti visarjanīyaśca bhavati | kāmayate iti-'kamerṇiṅ' | laigavāyana iti-liguśabdāt'naḍādibhyaḥ phak' iti phak | 'orguṇaḥ' iti guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ na bhavati yāvatokāra igeva ? naitadasti; atra hi cakāraḥ kriyate, sa ityartho vijñāyate, tenekaitīmaṃ śabdamuccārya vidhīyamānayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, na caivamorguṇaḥ | mṛjerityādi | iha trimuni vyākaraṇam, yathottaraṃ ca munīnāṃ prāmāṇyamiti darśanasthitistena sūtrakāreṇānuktaṃ vārttikakāra āha,taduktaṃ ca dūṣayati, evaṃ bhāṣyakāro vārtikakāreṇa | vyākhyātṛtvamapi dvayoścāstītyetāvat, 'yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇa' ityanena tadādividhau siddhe'pyādigrahaṇaṃ mukhye'jādau yathā syād vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādau mā bhūt | tundaparimṛjaḥ, pūyaṃ mamṛja, tvayā mamṛje | saṃkramo nāmetyādi | saṃkrāmato'pakrāmato guṇavṛddhī asmāditi kṛtvā | laghūpadhaguṇasyāpyatra pratiṣedha iti | atra sūtre laghūpadhaguṇasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu 'sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ' ityetasyaivetyarthaḥ | anena nimittasaptamyāḥ phalaṃ darśitam | atra ityanena sūtraṃ nirdiśyate | iha acinoditi ṅito laṅastibādeśaḥ, sthānivadbhāvād ṅiditi guṇapratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, iha 'acinavam' iti ṅito laṅo mipi tasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaparamparayā ṅittvād guṇapratiṣedhaḥ syādityata āha-acinavamityādi | yadi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tad ṅito lakārasyādeśe sthānivadbhāvātsyāt, yāsuṭo ṅidvacanamanarthakaṃ syād; liṅo ṅittvādeva tadādeśeṣu ṅitkāryasya siddhatvāt ||
dīdhīvevīṭām || 1.1.6||
dīdhīvevyoriti | 'dīdhīṅ‌ dīptadevanayoḥ' 'vevīṅ‌ vetinā tulye' ityetayoḥ | atha dīṅ‌ kṣaye' 'dhīṅ‌ anādare' 'veñ tantusantāne' vī gatyādiṣu'-eteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? dīṅastāvanna bhavati, 'mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca' iti cakāreṇaijviṣaya ātvavidhānāt | veño'pi na bhavati, guṇaprāptyabhāvāt, naitadasti; cakārastāvanmīnātiminotyarthaḥ syāt, dīṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ lyabarthaṃ syāt, veño'pi praveyamityatra 'īdyati' iti ītve kṛte guṇaḥ prāpnoti | evaṃ tarhi caturṇāṃ grahaṇe'bhiprete, asandehārthaṃ 'vīvedhīdīṭām' iti brūyāt | kiñca-'avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī' | iṭaśceti | ārdhadhātukasyeṅityāgamasya | nanu dhātusāhacaryāt 'iṭa kiṭa gatau' ityasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ yuktam, satyam; prasiddhyatiśayādagamasya grahaṇam, āgamo hi prasiddhataraḥ | śāstre'lpācaratvena pūrvanipātābhāvācca dhāturiṭ, dīdhīvevyostu dhātutvātprakṛtitvād 'abhyarhitaṃ ca' iti pūrvanipātaḥ | atha dīdhīvevyoḥ kimarthaṃ grahaṇ, yāvatā chāndasāvetau chandasi ca dṛśṭānuvidhiḥ, dṛśyate ca guṇaḥ 'hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet', 'adhīdhayurdāśarājñaḥ' iti, atastayoranarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ? kecidāhuḥ-'ādīdhyanamāvevyanam ityudāharato vṛttikārasya nānayośchāndasatvāmabhipretam, anyathā hi chandasyeva kiṃcidudāhāryam' iti, idaṃ tu vārttikaviruddham; yadāha-'dīdhīvevyośchandoviṣayatvād dṛṣṭānuvidhānācca chandasyadīdhedadīdhayuriti ca guṇadarśanādapratiṣedhaḥ' iti | ādīdhyanamiti | lyuṭi 'eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | kaṇiteti | 'kaṇiraṇī śabdarthau' luṭi tipau ḍādeśastāsi ṭilopaḥ, kaṇit-ā iti sthite takārantaṃ laghupadhamaṅgamiti prāptasya gusya pratiṣedhaḥ | nanu ca 'naḍ‌vaśi kṛti' ityata iḍityanuvarttamāne 'ārdhadhātukasyeṭ' iti punariḍgrahaṇam 'iḍeva yathā syād, vikāro mā bhūd' ityevamarthaṃ bhaviṣyati | yadyevam; alāvīt, pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvipi pipaṭhī rityatra 'akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' rvorupadhāyāḥ' iti ca dīrgho na syād | aṅgaprakaraṇe niyamādāṅga eva vikāro nivartyate, iha ca pipaṭhiṣaterapratyaye napuṃsake 'jasaḥ śī' ato lopasya sthānivattvānnumna bhavatīti 'sāntamahataḥ' iti dīrdhatvaṃ na bhavatīti pipaṭhiṃṣi brāhmaṇakulānīti bhavati ||
halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ || 1.1.7 ||
antaramavakāśāvidhiparidhānāntarddhibhedatādarthye |
chidrātmīyavinābahiravasaramadhye'ntarātmani ca ||
ityantaraśabdo'nekāryaḥ | iha chidravācino grahaṇam; itareṣāmasambhavāt | na vidyate'ntaraṃ yeṣāṃ te'nantarāḥ-niśchidrāḥ | etamevārthaṃ vyāktena śabdāntareṇa darśayati-bhinnajātīyairajbhiravyavahitāḥ śliṣṭoccāritā iti | evambhūtā hi haro niśchidrā bhavanti bhinnajātīyairiti vacanaṃ tatraiva vyavadhānaprasiddheḥ | śliṣṭoccāritā iti vacanādavagrahe'pi saṃjñā na bhavati-apsvityāpsu, vidyate hyatrāntaramarddhamātrākālaḥ | saṃyoga iti | yadyekaikasya halaḥ śilaṣṭoccāritasyaiṣā saṃjñā syād ? iha ca niryāyādityatra pratyakaṃ saṃjñitve sati rephe yakāraḥ saṃyoga iti 'vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ' ityetvaṃ syāt | samudāyasya saṃjñitve 'aco rahābhyām' iti yakārasya satyapi dvirvacane tasyāsiddhatvādetvābhāvaḥ, iha ca saṃskṛṣīṣṭa 'ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' itīṭ, saṃskriyata iti 'guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' iti guṇaḥ, dṛṣatkarotīti kakārasaṃnidhau dakārasya saṃyogādyoḥ' iti lopaḥ syāt, niryāta iti 'saṃyogāderātaḥ' niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt; samudāye tu saṃjñini naite doṣā ityālocyāha--samudāyaḥ saṃjñīti | mahāsaṃjñākāraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham-'saṃyujyante'sminmitho halaḥ' iti | nairantaryaṃ ca śrutaṃ saṃjñirūpe'nupraviśatīti yuktam | pratyekapakṣe tu tadupalakṣaṇaṃ syād | ataḥ samudāya eva saṃjñī yukta iti bhāvaḥ | 'halaḥ' iti bahuvacananirddeśād dvayoḥ saṃjñā na syādityāśaṅkyāha--jātau ceti | ca śabdo yasmādarthe, yasmājjātau bahuvacanam, tena dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti |
atha yatra bahavo halaḥ saṃśliṣṭāstatra kiṃ dvayorbahunāṃ cāviśeṣeṇa saṃjñā ? āhosvidvahūnāmeva ? yadi bahūnāmeva, iha 'masjinaśorjhali' ityantyādacaḥ pare numi mansj iti sthite nasajānāmekā saṃjñā, na tu sajayoriti 'skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopo na syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; masjerantyāt pūrvaṃ numeṣitavyaḥ, magna ityupadhālopo yathā syāt; anyathā dvayossaṃjñāśrayeṇa satyapi saṃyogādilope tasyāsiddhatvānnalopo na syād | iha tarhi nirgleyāt, saṃsvariṣīṣṭa, saṃsvaryate, nirglāna iti etveḍ‌guṇaniṣṭhānatvāni na syuḥ ? astu tarhyaviśeṣeṇa, kutaḥ ? niśchidratvasyāviśeṣāt !na ca dvirvacananyāyena samudāyasyaiva syāditi vācyam; yathā dviravacanaṃ samudāyāvayavaikācauryugapat karttumaśakyam, naivamatrāśaktiḥ, yathā ca samudāye dvirukte'payavā api dviruktā bhavanti--vṛkṣaḥ pracalan sahāvayavaiḥ pracalatīti nyāyena , na ca tatheha samudāye pravṛttayā saṃjñayā'vayavānāṃ tatkāryasiddhiḥ | ato nāyaṃ dvirvacananyāyasya viṣayaḥ | ato'viśeṣeṇa dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti sthitam | yadyevam, indramicchati indrīyati, tataḥ san indidrīyiṣatītyatra dvau saṃyogau-nadau, darau ca; tatra 'na ndrāḥ' iti pratiṣedho nakāravaddakārasyāpi syāt | na vājvidheḥ, ajāderiti varttate, tatra karmadhārayāt pañcamī, āderacaḥ pare nadarā na dvirucyanta ityarthaḥ | ūgnirityādīni rūpodāharaṇāni | tilānstryāvapatīti | 'he mapare vā' iti varttamāne 'ḍaḥ si dhuṭ' iti ca 'naśca' iti dhuṭ‌ cartvam | tatra yadā na dhuṭ, tadā nasatarayāḥ; yadā dhuṭ tadā natasatarayāḥ | titaucchatramiti | 'tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca' iti ḍaupratyayaḥ, vyastoccāraṇasāmarthyād guṇābhāvaḥ, sanvadbhāvād dvirvacanamitvaṃ ca, ṭilopaḥ | saṃyogāntalopaḥ syāditi | yadyacorapyanantarayoḥ saṃyogasaṃjñā syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ca 'che ca' iti tuki kṛte takāraḥ padānto na saṃyogaḥ, naitadasti, 'che ca' ityayaṃ tug hrasvamātrabhakto na tadantagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti padaṃ saṃyogāntameva | pacatīti rūpapratyudāharaṇam | panasamiti kāryapratyudāharaṇam | skossaṃyogādyoriti lopaḥ syāditi | yadi sakāramakārayoḥ sāntarayorapi saṃyogasaṃjñā syāditi bhāvaḥ ||
mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ || 1.1.8 ||
yadyatra 'mukhaṃ ca nāsikā ca' iti dvandvaḥ syād, 'dvandvaśca prāṇitūrya' ādisūtreṇaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca 'sa napuṃsakam' iti napuṃsakatve, 'hrasvo napuṃsake' iti hrasvatve ca 'mukhanāsikavacanaḥ' iti prāpnotītyuttarapadalopinaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati-mukhasahitā nāsiketi | tayoccāryata iti | etena 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karmaṇi lyuṭaṃ darśayati | 'tayā' iti karaṇe karttari vā tṛtīyā; karaṇasyaiva kartṛtvena vivakṣaṇāt | sūtre'pi 'mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ' iti 'kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā | anusvārasyaiva hi syāditi | tasminnuccāryamāṇe nāsikāyā eva vyāpāro na mukhasya, tena tasyaiva syād, na tu ñamaṅaṇanānām, nāpyabhra ām̐ apa ityasya; taduccāraṇe mukhasyāpi vyāpāridityevakāreṇa darśayati | nanu yathā 'prāsādavāsina ānīyantām' ityukte ye prāsāda eva nivasanti, ye ca prāsāde bhūmau ca, te dvaye'pyānīyante, prasādavāsānvaya ubhayeṣāmastīti, tathehāpi'nāsikāvacanaḥ' ityukte yaḥ kevalanāsikāvacanaḥ, yaśca mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ-ubhayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; nāsikānvayasya vivakṣitatvāt | tatkimucyate'nusvārasyaiva hi syāditi, anusvārasyāpi hi syāditi tu vaktavyam ? ucyate; iha trīṇi darśanāni-kṛtsna evānunāsiko mukhena nāsikayā coccāryate, pūrvo bhāgo mukhena paro nāsikayā, viparītaṃ vā | nāsikyabhāgānurāgāccetaro'pi bhāgastadvadeva bhāsate iti | tatrottarasmindarśanadvaye nāsikānvayasya bhāgaviṣayatvānnāsikāvacanagrahaṇenobhayavacano na gṛhyate iti suṣṭhūktam--anusvārasyaiva hi syāditi | kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūditi | te hi mukhenaivoccāryante ityasati nāsikāgrahaṇe teṣāmeva syāt, tataśca tarptumiti 'anudāttopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopa; syāt,'odanapak' iti 'anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' iti dīrghaḥ syāditi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham-'anu paścānmukhasya nāsikā vyāpriyate yasmin','nāsikāyā vā paścānmukhaṃ vyāpriyate yasmin' iti | tena bhāgaviṣayo nāsikāvyāpāra iti sūcanāt prāsādavāsinyāyasyāyamaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati |
tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam || 1.1.9 ||
tulyaśabdo'yaṃ yadyapi tulayā saṃmitaṃ tulyamiti 'nauvayodharma' iti yatamutpādya vyutpādyate, tathāpi vyutpattyarthameva tulopādīyate, rūḍhaśabdastvayaṃ pravīṇaḥ, pratilomādivadityāha-tulyaśabdaḥ sadṛśaparyāya iti | nanu 'nauvayodharma' ityatra vakṣyati--'yathā tulā dravyāntaraṃ paricchinatti, tathā tulyāmapi sādṛśyena paricchinattītyetattulayā tulyasya sādharmyam' iti, satyam; na hyovaṃ laukikāḥ pratiyanti | tathā hi -'tulya' ityukte 'sadṛśa' iti pratyayo bhavati, na tu kaścidavayavārthaḥ pratīyate | āsye bhavamāsyamiti | lokasiddhaṃ tāvadāsyamoṣṭhātprabhṛti prākkākalakād-asyante kṣipyante'nena varṇā iti kṛtvā | kākalakaṃ nāma grīvāyā unnatapradeśaḥ | iha tu tasminnāsye bhavamāsyamityarthaḥ | 'digādibhyo yat' 'śarīrāvayavācca' iti yatpratyayaḥ | kiṃ punastadityāha--tālvādisthānamiti | yasminvarṇā niṣpadyante tat sthānam | ādiśbdena nāsikādīnāṃ grahaṇam | nāsikāpi na bāhyā varṇotpattinimittam, kiṃ tarhi ? antarāsye carmavitatamasti, paṇavacarmavat, tatsaṃbaddhā rekhā nāsikā, tasyāṃ vāyunā'bhihatāyāṃ varṇotyattiḥ | yadi punarlaukikamāsyaṃ gṛhyeta, tadā tulyāsyapratnamiti dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ syāt-āsyaṃ ca pratnaśca āsyaprayatnau, tau tulyau yasyeti; tripado vā bahuvrīhiḥ - tulya āsya prayatno yasyeti | tatra dvandvagarbhe āsyagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt, sarveṣāṃ hi tattulyam | visarjanīyasyaikīyamatenorasyatvāt sāvarṇyābhāve'pi na doṣaḥ, tripade tu bahuvrīhāvāsyena prayatnasya viśeṣitatvādāsyādvāhyāḥ prayatnā hāpitā bhavanti, kintu tālvādisthānaṃ tulyatvenāviśeṣitaṃ syāt | tataśca bhinnasthānānāmapi jabagaḍadānāṃ savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnoti | tata ūrg‌ja iti 'jharo jhari' iti gakārasya jakāre lopaḥ syād | atastaddhitāntasyaiva grahaṇam | tatrāpi yadi dvandvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ syāt, sthānena prayatno na viśeṣitaḥ syāt; tataśca kakāraṅakārayormithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā na syāt; bāhyaprayatnasya bhinnatvāt | tataśca śaṅkiteti 'anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' iti ṅakāro na syāt | atha satyāpi bāhyaprayatnabhede ābhyantarasya prayatnasyābhedamāśritya saṃjñā syāt, cakāraśakārayorapi satyābhyantarabhede bāhyābhedamāśritya savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnoti | tataśca aruścyo tatīti vakṣyamāṇapratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate itīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tripado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiriti darśayati--tulya āsye prayatno yasyeti | taddhitānta āsyaśabdo na svāṅgavācyeveti'amūrddhamastakāt' ityuluṅga bhavati | nanvasminnapi pakṣe bhinnavibhaktikatvāt prādhānyāccāsyaṃ tulyātvenāviśeṣitaṃ syād; naivātrāsyaṃ tulyatayā viśeṣyate, bhedanibandhanā hi tulyatā | na ca kakhagaghaṅāṃ bhinnaṃ sthānam, ekatvātkaṇṭhasya, kintu taddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasyāśrayaṇasāmarthyādasya ityekatvaṃ vivakṣitam | tenaikasminneva tālvādike sthāne yaḥ prayatnaḥ, sa tulyo yayorityāśrayaṇānna kaściddoṣaḥ | samānajātīyaṃ pratīti | etacca saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāllabhyate, anyathā yatkiñcanavarṇāpekṣayā tulyāsyāprayatnatvena savarṇatve labdhe tadāśrayamanyasyāpi kāryaṃ syāt, savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | na ca rephoṣmanivṛttyarthaṃ vacanam; rephasyāpi rephaḥ savarṇa eva, evamūṣmasvapi draṣṭavyam | saṃbandhiśabdatvādvā sambandhiśabdo hi tulyāsyaprayatnaśabdaḥ, tataśca yathā tulyāya kanyā dātavyetyukte dātrā tulyāyeti gamyate, tathehāpi | atha vā, mahatī saṃjñā kriyate; anvarthā yathā vijñāyeta-samāno'sya varṇaḥ savarṇa iti | yadi ca samānajātīyameva prati savarṇasaṃjñā bhavati, evaṃ samāno'sya varṇo bhavati |
catvāra ityādi | dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ-bāhyāḥ, ābhyantarāśca | tatrābhyantarāścatvāro vṛttau darśitāḥ | ābhyantaratvaṃ punareṣām-sthānakaraṇavyāpāreṇa; utpattikāla eva bhāvāt | sthānaṃ tālvādi, karaṇaṃ jihvāyā agropāgramadhyamūlāni | bāhyāḥ punarekādaśa-vivāraḥ, saṃvāraḥ, śvāsaḥ, nādaḥ, ghoṣaḥ, aghoṣaḥ, alpaprāṇaḥ, mahāprāṇaḥ, udāttaḥ, anudāttaḥ, svaritaśceti | bāhyatvaṃ punareteṣām--varṇaniṣpattikālādūrdhvaṃ vāyuvaśenotpatteḥ | tatra spṛṣaṭakaraṇāḥ sparśāḥ, kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ | spṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭatāguṇaḥ, karaṇaṃ kṛtiruccāraṇaprakāraḥ, spṛṣṭatānugataṃ karaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | evamanyatrāpi - īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇā antaḥ sthāḥ; yaralavā antaḥsthāḥ | vivṛtakaraṇā ūṣmāṇaḥ svarāśca; śapasahā ūṣmāṇaḥ, svarāḥ sarva evācaḥ | vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ; śaṣasavisarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāḥ; yamau ca prathamadvitīyau; vivṛtakaṇṭhāḥ, śvāsānupradānāḥ aghoṣāḥ; vargayamānāṃ prathame'lpaprāṇāḥ, itare mahāprāṇāḥ | vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antaḥsthāḥ, hakārānusvārau,yamau tṛtīyacaturthau saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaśca | vargayamānāṃ tṛtīyā antaḥsthā alpaprāṇāḥ, itare mahāprāṇāḥ | yathā tṛtīyāstathā pañcamāḥ, ānunāsikyameṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ | tatra yamā nāma vargeṣvāditaścaturṇāṃ pañcameṣu parataḥ ta eva nāsikyā bhavanti | tadyathā--palikrīrin, cakhnatuḥ, āgmannāyaḥ, jaghnatuḥ, apnasvatīmityādi | ya ete dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ, teṣāmiha savarṇasaṃjñāyā mābhyantarāḥ spṛṣṭatādayaścatvāra evāśrīyante, na vivārādayo bāhyāḥ; āsyagrahaṇena teṣāṃ nivarttitatvāt | a a a ityādi | atra savarṇasaṃjño bhavatīti prakṛtaṃ bahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇatamanuṣajyate, trayo'kārā mithaḥ savarṇaṃsaṃjñā bhavantītyarthaḥ | kathaṃ trayo'kārāḥ, yāvatā pratyuccāraṇaṃ bhede'nantāḥ, abhede tveka eva ? tatrāha--udātteti | anena prakāreṇa traya ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca 'trayaḥ' ityasya 'trividhā'ityartho bhavati | tatrākuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ, icuyaśāstālavyāḥ, upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ, ṛṭuraṣā mūrddhanyāḥ, lṛtulasā dantyāḥ, eai kaṇṭhatālavyau, oau kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyau, vakāro dantoṣṭhyaḥ-ityevaṃ tulyasthānaprayatnāḥ sarve'kārādayo mithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā bhavantīti | antaḥsthā | dvaprabhedā iti | atrāpi pūrvavadanuṣaṅgaḥ, antaḥsthā ityukte'pi rephanivṛttyarthaṃ svarūpeṇa paṭhati | thavalā iti | rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santīti | vijātīyābhiprāyametat | sajātīyāstu rephoṣmāṇastulyasthānaprayatnāssavarṇā bhavantyeva | tatra rephasya tāvadyavalā bhinnasthānā ṛṭuraṣā bhinnaprayatnā anye bhinnasthānaprayatnāḥ | evamūṣmaṇāmapi savarṇābhāvo veditavyaḥ |
vargya ityādi | varge bhavo vargyaḥ, digāditvādyat | vargyeṇa--svavargāntaḥpātinā | tadyathā kakāraḥ khakāreṇa | tarpteti | 'tṛp prīṇane' | icuyaśānāmiti | eṣāṃ madhye yeṣāṃ prasaṅgaḥ, teṣāṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ | aruś ścayotatīti | 'ścyutir‌kṣaraṇe' | aruḥśabdasya rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ 'vā śari' iti sakāraḥ, tasyāpi ścutve śakāraḥ |
ṛkāralṛkārayoriti | sthānabhedānna prāpnotītyārambhaḥ | śrutatvāccānayorevamithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā vidhīyate, na tvetayoranyena saha | hotṝkāra iti | kathaṃ punaratra samudāyino'ntaratamo bhavati na samudāyasya, tatrāpi ṛkārasyaiva na lṛkārasyetyata āha-ubhayorityādi | ubhayorantaratamo dīrgho na sambhavati, lṛkārasyāpi dīrgho na sambhavatītyata ṝkāra eva bhavatyubhayorityarthaḥ | nanu ca naitatsavarṇasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam, katham ? 'akaḥ savarṇe' ityatra tu vakṣyati 'ṛti ṛ-vā vacanam, lṛti lṛ-vā vacanam' iti | tatra cāyamarthaḥ-akāṃ savarṇe ṛti parato vā ṛ-bhavati; dvimātro'yam, madhye dvau rephau tayorekā mātrā,abhito'jbhakteraparā, īṣatspṛṣṭaścāyam | tatra prayatnabhedādṛkāreṇāgrahaṇād anaṇtvāddīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaprāpto'yaṃ vidhīyate | lṛti lṛ-vā vacanamityayamapi dvimātra īṣatspṛṣṭaśca, madhye dvau lakārau, tayorekā mātrā'bhito'jbhakteraparā | pūrvavadaprāptau vidhīyate | tatra ṛti ṛ-vā vacanamityatra vanāśabdo dīrghasya samuccayārthaḥ, tenāprāpta eva dīrgho bhaviṣyati | nanu yadyavidhāyaiva savarṇasaṃjñāṃ taducyate, tato'ka iti sambandhādaṅ‌mātrasya lṛti tatkārya syād dadhylṛkāro madhvlṛkāra iti, saṃjñāvidhāne tu ṛkāra ṛkārasyaiva savarṇa iti tatraiva vyavasthitaṃ bhavati | tasmādivadheyā savarṇasaṃjñā ? na vidheyā, yadetad ṛtīti 'etadṛta iti vaktavyam, savarṇa ityeva ṛkārasya ṛkāra eva savarṇaḥ' iti ṛtyeva bhaviṣyati | tata lṛti, ṛta ityeva | idaṃ cāsavarṇārtham, tena lṛti rūpadvayaṃ siddham-hotṝkāraḥ, hotlṛkāra iti | tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati | katham ? ṛ-vā vacanam, lṛ-vā vacanamiti bruvatāpi tayoractvaṃ vaktavyam; anyathā vidhānamātramanayoḥ syād, na tvackāryaḥ plutaḥ | sati tvāctve tābhyāṃ trimātrayorapi sāvarṇyād‌ grahaṇe sati plutasaṃjñā bhavatīti plutasiddhiḥ | evaṃ ca hotṛ ṛkāra iti ṛkārayo rephadvayayuktatvādvivṛtatvācca kadācidrephadvayayukta ṛ-bhaviṣyati, kadācidvivṛtaḥ śuddho dīrghaḥ | lṛkāre'pi kadācidṛkārāntaratam ṛkāraḥ, kadācid lṛkārāntaratama lṛ-kāra iti, satyam; savarṇasaṃjñāyaṃ tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati, tadvocyeta, idaṃ vā, ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ | idaṃ vā'vaśyaṃ vaktavyam, idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati 'ṛtyakaḥ' - khaṭ‌valṛkāraḥ, mātṛlṛkāraḥ | 'vā supyāpiśaleḥ'-upalṛkārīyati, upālkārīyatīti | ṛditāmlṛditāṃ ca dhātūnāṃ pṛthagupadeśasāmarthyādanubandhakāryāṇāmasaṅkaraḥ ||
nājjhalau || 1.1.10 ||
atrājjhalau na kenāpi savarṇasaṃjñau bhavata iti tāvadartho na bhavati; saṃjñāyā nirviṣayatvāt | etāvanto varṇā acaśca halaśca | nāpyacāmajbhirhalāṃ halbhiḥ savarṇatvaniṣedhaḥ; ata eva nirdeśāt | anyathā'kārasyākāre dīrgho na syānnājiti, nāpyajjhalāviti pūrvasavarṇaḥ | tasmādacāṃ halāṃ ca mithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā niṣidhyate | tatra ca yadyapi 'nājjhalau' iti sāmānyenoktam, tathāpyakārahakārayorikāraśakārayośca prāptiriti tatraiva niṣedhaḥ | yadyevam, nāṇśalāviti vaktavyam ? na tāvadevaṃ lāghave viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ ca prāguktaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyeta | acca hal ceti | anena nātrājjhalornirdeśa iti darśayati | tatrāpi na doṣaḥ kaścit, kintu pakṣāntarasambhāvanaiva | tulyāsyāprayatnāviti prasaṅge hetumāha | savarṇadīrghatvaṃ na bhavatīti pratiṣedhasya phalaṃ darśayati | nanu dīrghavidhānavacītyanuvartate, taccāvaśyamanuvartyam, kumārī śete ityatra mā bhūditi, na hyātrānena viṣedhaḥ siddhyati | kiṃ kāraṇam ? vākyāparisamāpteḥ | iha hi varṇānāmupadeśaḥ pūrvam, tata itsaṃjñā, tataḥ 'ādirantyena sahetā' iti pratyāhāraḥ, tataḥ 'nājjhalau' ityasya niṣpattiḥ, tasmiṃśca niṣpanne satyapavādaviṣayaparihāreṇeṣṭaviṣaye savarṇasaṃjñā pravarttate, na tvetatsūtraniṣpattisamaye | tataśca 'aṇuditsavarṇasya ca' ityetatsasvāṅgabhūteṣu upadeśetsaṃjñāpratyāhārasavarṇatveṣu niṣpanneṣu 'asya cvau' ityādiṣu varttate, na tvaṅgeṣūpadeśādiṣviti 'nājjhalau' ityagṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇamiti siddham | avaśyaṃ cāgṛhītasavarṇānāmevācāṃ grahaṇameṣṭavyam, anyathā hyajiti gṛhyamāṇa ikāraḥ śakārasya grāhakaḥ syāt | na cāsminnapi sūtre'yameva niṣedhaḥ, svātmanikriyāvirodhāt | ato'jgrahaṇenāpi śakārasya grahaṇam, halṣu copadeśāddhalgrahaṇenāpīti śakāradvayasya mithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñā na syāt | tataśca 'paraḥśatāni kāryāṇi' ityatra śatātparāṇi, śatādadhikānīti vigṛhya 'kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti bahulavacanātsamāse pāraskarāditvātsuṭi kṛte 'anaci ca' iti śakārasya dvirvacane paraśasatānoti sthite madhyamasya śakārasya 'jharo jhari savarṇe' iti lopo na syāditi sarvadā śakāratrayaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | ato'gṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇādīkāraśakārayorapratiṣiddhaṃ savarṇatvamiti 'kumārī śete' ityatra mā bhūditi dīrghavidhau 'aci ' ityanuvatyaṃ tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāccājeva yo'j na kathañcana hal, tatraiva dīrghatvavijñānāddhakāraśakārayorakārekārābhyāṃ sāvarṇyena grahaṇādactve satyapi haltvasyāpi bhāvāddīrghābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, satyam; ajgrahaṇamapyanyārthamanuvartyam, idamapi vaipāśo matsyaḥ, ānaḍuhaṃ carmmetyatra yasyeti lopābhāvārthaṃ kartavyaṃ daṇḍahasto dadhiśītamityetadubhayathāpi siddhyatīti pradarśanārthamudāharaṇadvayamupanyastam | vaipāśā iti -bhavārthe'ṇ | ānaḍuhamiti-vikāre 'prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ||
īdūded dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam || 1.1.11 ||
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti-īdādi viśeṣyam, dvivacanaṃ viśeṣaṇam, tatra dvivacanantatvamīdāderna sambhavatīti dvivacanasaṃjñakamīdādi pragṛhyamiti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | īdādi viśeṣaṇam, dvivacanaṃ viśeṣyam, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhāvīdādyantaṃ dvivacanamiti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhau sati paścād dvivacanāntasyedādibhirviśeṣaṇādīdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti tṛtīyaḥ | īdādiviśiṣṭena dvivacanena tadantavidhāvīdādyantaṃ yad dvivacanam, tadantaṃ pragṛhyamiti caturthaḥ | tatrādye pakṣe-agnī, vāyū, khaṭ‌ve ityādāvena syāt; ekādeśasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvena dvivacanamīdādīti, pacete paceye pacāvahe ityādāvekāramātrasyādvivacanatvānna syāt | tṛtīye tu-kumāryoragāraṃ kumāryagāram, vadhvoragāraṃ vadhavagāram; ityatrāpi syāt-etaddhi pratyayalakṣaṇena dvivacanāntamīdādyantaṃ ca śrūyate | yathā hi 'tāvakīnaḥ' ityādāvādeśena saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyajyate, tathehāpi satyāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtatibhāvena dvitvamabhivyajyeteti syād dvivacanāntasyāpi samāsaḥ | caturthe kumāryagāramityādāvaprasaṅgaḥ; dvivacanasyānīdādyantatvāt, kintvaśulke śulke samapadyetāṃ śulkyāstāṃ vastre-atrāpi prāpnoti, katham ? śulkaśabdādvastravṛtterdvivacanamau, 'napuṃsakācca' iti śībhāvaḥ, tataścviḥ, śīśabdasya 'supo dhātu' iti luk, 'asya cvau' taddhitāntatvātsuḥ, avyayatvālluk; atra śīśabda īkārāntaṃ dvivacanam, tadantaśca samudāyaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇeneti pragṛhyasaṃjñā prāpnoti | ayaṃ ca tṛtīye'pi pakṣe samāno doṣaḥ | kiṃ ca-saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt tadantapakṣotthānameva nāsti, ato dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-īd ūd ed ityevamantaṃ dvivacanamiti | nanvasminnapi pakṣe īdūtoḥ kevalayoreva saṃbhava ityagnī ityādikaṃ yadyapi sidhyati, tathāpyekārāntasya tu dvivacanasya 'pacete' ityādau sambhāvāttatraiva syāt, na khaṭ‌ve ityādau; vyapadeśivadbhāvenātrāpi bhaviṣyati | kiṃ punaratra pramāṇamyameva pakṣa āśrīyata iti ? tṛtīyacaturthayostāvadasambhava eva; saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt | saṃjñāyāśca saṃjñyapekṣāyāmanantaraśrutaṃ dvivacanameva saṃjñītyuktamiti prathamasyāpyasambhavaḥ | atra caturthaḥ pakṣo'sambhavādeva nirastaḥ; na doṣavattvāt | śuklyāstāṃ vastra ityatra hi 'antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugvādhate' iti antaraṅgamapi śībhāvaṃ bādhitvā 'supo dhātu' iti luki kṛte'nīkārāntaṃ dvivacanaṃ bhavati | agnī ityādau pragṛhyatvāt 'plutaḥ pragṛhyā aci' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | pratyudāharaṇeṣu tadabhāvāt svarasandhiḥ | taparakaraṇaṃ guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tatkālānāṃ grahaṇārthamiti cet, na; abhedakatvād guṇānām | bhinnakālānāṃ nivṛttyarthamiti cet, na; īdūtoranaṇtvāt | syādetat-jātipakṣe yadyapi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt prayatnādhikyāt akurvahyatretyādau hrasvānāṃ na syāt, plutānāṃ tu syādeva | ekārasya tvaṇtvādapi plutasya prasaṅgaḥ, ataḥ plutanivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamiti, tanna; iṣṭatvāt |
kimarthaṃ punaḥ platānāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñeṣyate ? pragṛhyāḥ prakṛtyeti prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāt | mā bhūdevam, plataḥ prakṛtyetyeva bhaviṣyati | yatra tarhi plutāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate-'alputavadupasthite' iti, tatra pragṛhyāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvo yathā syādagnī3 itīti | iha ca agnī3 apragṛhyasyetyanunāsikaparyudāso yathā syāt | ataḥ plutānāmapi pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā iṣṭatvānna tannivṛttyarthamapi taparakaraṇamityata āha-taparakaraṇamasandahārthamiti | asati hi tasmin samāhāradvandeva napuṃsakahrasvatve ca kṛte yvīti nirdeśe sandehaḥ syāt | itaretarayogādvandve'pi sandeha eva | tasmādasandehārthaṃ taparakaraṇam | yadyasandehārthamapi taparatvaṃ kriyate, tadeva plutasyeṣṭāṃ saṃjñāṃ vyāvartayati,tat plutasya kathaṃ saṃjñā ? mā bhūt plutasya, tasya tvasiddhatvāt sthānini pravṛttā saṃjñā svārasandhimanunāsikaṃ ca pratibhantsyati, siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu,plutaḥ prakṛtyeti liṅgāt | anyathā kāryiṇo'sattvātkasya prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate ! yasya ca vikāraprasaṅgaḥ, plutaprakaraṇe tasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ, plutasyāsiddhatvena tasya vikārāprasahga iti plutasyāsataḥ prakṛtibhāvavidhānamanupapannam | astu, svarasandhiprakaraṇe plutaḥ siddhaḥ, saṃjñāvidhāvasiddhaḥ | saṃjñāvidhau ca siddhaḥ, katham ? kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam, tataśca pragṛhyāḥ prakṛtyetyatrāsyopasthānātsaṃjñāpi svarasandhiprakaraṇāntargatā | evaṃ tarhi siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣviti nāśrīyate, plutabhāvī prakṛtyeti sthānina eva prakṛtibhāvo vidhāsyate ? evamapyanunāsikaparyudāso na sidhyati, kāryakālapakṣe saṃjñāyāmapi plutasya siddhatvāt | evaṃ tarhi 'yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam' tataścāsmin pradeśe saṃjñāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ plutasyāsiddhatvāt sthānini pravṛttā saṃjñā svarasandhimanunāsikaṃ ca pratibhantsyati | nanu yadyapi saṃjñāyāmasiddhaḥ plutaḥ, anunāsikaparyudāse tu siddhaḥ, tataśca yasyānena saṃjñā kṛtā dvimātrasya, na so'nunāsikavidhiṃ prati sthānī, kintu trimātra eva | na ca sthānivadbhāvāttasyāpi pragṛhyatvam, alvidhitvāt | avaśyaṃ ca 'siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu' ityāśrayaṇīyam, daṇḍa-ā3ḍhakamiti plutasya savarṇadīrgheṇa nivṛttiryathā syāt | tathā ca 'aṅauṇa' ityatra sarvaireva granthakārairuktam | tathā suślokā3 iti suśloketi--atrāpi 'aplutavadupasthite' iti plutāśraye prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe guṇo bhavan plutameva nivarttayati, na tu sthāninam; anyathā hyādeśarūpe plutaḥ śrūyeta | tadiha yathoddeśe'pi saṃjñāparibhāṣe, kathamiveṣṭasiddhiḥ ? kathaṃ vā grantheṣu pūrvāparavirodhaparihāraḥ ? iti vipaścitaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ |
maṇīvādīnāmiti |'siddhaye' iti śeṣaḥ | na punarmaṇīvādīnāmaparaḥ pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ | na cedaṃ vacanam, bhāṣyavārttikakārābhyāmapaṭhitatvāt; kintu maṇīvādīnāṃ nirvāhaḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ | tatra 'maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete' ityatra vāśabdasyopamānārthasya prayogaḥ | rodasīvetyādau thachāndasatvāditi nirvāhaḥ ||
adaso māt || 1.1.12 ||
'svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityatra dvau pakṣau-arthādhikāraḥ, śabdādhikāraśceti | tatrārthādhikāro nāma-yasya yasminsūtre svaritatvaṃ pratijñātaṃ tatra tasya yo'rthaḥ sa uttaratrādhikriyata iti | śabdādhikārastu sa eva śabdo'vivakṣitārtho'dhikṛtastattatsūtrānuguṇamarthaṃ pratipādayatīti | tatrārthādhikāre pūrvatredādibhistadantaṃ pratyāyitam, ihānuvṛttam 'māt' ityanena viśeṣyeteti 'amuke'tra' ityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ, śabdadhikāre tvidādimātrasyehānuvṛttasyāpi viśeṣyābhāvādasati tadantavidhau 'māt' ityanena viśeṣaṇādadauṣa iti tamāśrityāha-tasmātpare īdūdedantā iti | pragṛhyasaṃjñā iti | pragṛhyaśabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | yadyapi pūrvasūtra eva pragṛhyaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena viniyuktaḥ, tathāpīha saṃjñino na pratyāyayati; svarūpapadārthakasyaiva tasyehānuvṛtteḥ | kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā strīnapuṃsakayordvivacane mutvasyāsiddhatve'pyekārāntatvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhā saṃjñā; svarasandhiprakaraṇe ca mutvasyāsiddhatvādekārasyaiva vikāraprasaṅge prakṛtibhāvo'pi siddhaḥ,anunāsikaparyudāsaśca kāryakālapakṣe liṅgatraye'pi dvivacane siddhaḥ ? 'aṇo'pragṛhyasya' ityatropasthitena pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ mutvasya siddhatvāt | ato'nunāsikaparyyudāse'dvivacanārtho'yamārambhaḥ, prakṛtibhāve tu puṃsi dvivacanārthaśca | nanvārabdhe'pyasminyathoddeśapakṣe saṃjñāyāṃ karttavyāyāṃ mutvamītvayorāśrayātsiddhatve'pi svarasandhiprakaraṇe tayorasiddhatvādayāvekādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, amī āsate ityayādeśaḥ, amū āsāte iti puṃsyāvādeśaḥ, amī atra iti 'eṅaḥ padāntādati' ityekādeśaḥ | na ca saṃjñāyā vaiyarthyam; anunāsikaparyudāsenārthavattvāt | tatra hi karttavye mutvamītvayorasiddhatvābhāvādyayoranena saṃjñā kṛtā tāvena, na taṃ prati | kāryakālapakṣe tu saṃjñāyāmapi karttavyāyāmāśrayāt siddhatvaṃ nāśrayaṇīyam;'aṇo'pragṛhyasya' ityatropasthite'smin kartavye mutvamītvayoḥ siddhatvāt, tāvatā cāsya caritārthatvāt | tadevamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ svarasandhiḥ syādeva ? ucyate; yadyanunāsikaparyudāsa eva prayojanamabhaviṣyad 'aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsiko'daso na ' ityevāvakṣyat | amuke, amuyetyādāvanaṇtvādanavasānatvāccāprasaṅgaḥ | ataḥ saṃjñārambhasāmarthyāt prakṛtibhāvārthatvāmapyasya vijñāyate, tacca svarasandhiprakaraṇe mutvamītvayoḥ siddhatvamantareṇānupapannamityubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ sāmarthyadasiddhatvabādhaḥ |
māditi kimiti | 'adasa' iti ṣaṣṭhī, amī amū ityatra ca mutvamītvayoḥ sthānināvekādeśābantavadbhāvādadas-śabdagrahaṇena gṛhyete iti tadādeśayorapi tadgrahaṇena grahaṇādasti tāvadiṣṭasiddhiḥ | editi ca nivartiṣyate, na ca mātparāvīdūtau sambhavata taityatiprasaṅgo'pi nāstīti praśnaḥ | taamuke'treti | ekayoganirddiṣṭānāmekadeśānuvṛttirdurjñāneti bhāvaḥ |tha na ca mādityasmin satyapi ed‌grahaṇasāmarthyādatra prasaṅgaḥ; mādityasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | na ca vikalpaḥ; atulyabalatvāt | taddhipūrvatra caritārtham, māditi tvakṛtārtham | na cānuvṛttisāmarthyam; anyānurodhenāpyanuvṛttisambhavāt ||
śe || 1.1.13 ||
'śe' iti śruteraviśeṣāt 'kāśe','kuśe' ityatrāpi prasaṅga iti matvā pṛcchati--kimidamiti | supāmādeśa iti | kāśe taityatra tu lākṣaṇikatvādagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | yuṣma iti | ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya 'supāṃ suluk' ityādinā śe ādeśaḥ,'śeṣe lopaḥ' | asme iti | caturthībahuvacanasya śe | tve me iti | saptamyekavacanasya tvamāvekavacane | asame indrābṛhaspatī iti | chāndasamudāharaṇamityuktvā, itarattu lokikamanukaraṇamityuktena yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ, tve rāyaḥ, me rāya ityeṣāmapyanukaraṇatvamuktaṃ syād | ato yadatretaraditi vivakṣitaṃ tatsvarūpeṇa paṭhati | yuṣme itītyādi | laukikamanukaraṇamityanena ca sūtrasyāvaśyārabhyātvaṃ darśaṃyati | 'asme indrābṛhaspatī' ityādi chāndasatvādapi siddhyet | idaṃ tu padakārairiti paraṃ prayujyamānaṃ laukikam, ato na chāndasatvātsiddhiriti ||
nipāta ekājanāṅ || 1.1.14 ||
' vyāharati mṛgaḥ', 'vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ' iti nirdeśādekājiti karmadhārayaḥ, na bahuvrīhirityāha-ekaścāsāviti | yadyevam, taekagrahaṇamanarthakam, nipāto'jityevāstu, tatra nipātenāj viśiṣyate | nipātasaṃjñako'jiti viparyayastu na bhavati; 'ajanto nipātaḥ' iti vyāvartyābhāvād halantānāṃ satyasati vā pragṛhyatve viśeṣābhāvāt | nanu purostīti halantasya prakṛtibhāvādro rutvaṃ na syāt,naitadasti; pragṛhyasaṃjñāyāṃ rutvasyāsiddhatvāt, sakārasya ca kāryāntarāprasaṅgāt | nanu cedamasti prayojanamacā nipātasya viśeṣaṇe kim ? ajantasya yathā syād, ajmātrasya mā bhūt iti | evaṃ satyanāṅityānarthakaṃ syāt, ato nipātenāj viśeṣyate, nārtha ekagrahaṇena, na; acsamudāyanivṛttyarthaṃ tarhyekagrahaṇam aiu apehīti samudāyasyaiva syād, nāvayavānām; ekājdvirvacanavadajantasyaiva prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt, pūrvayostu svarasandhiḥ syāt | nanu ca nipāto'jiti caikatvasya vivakṣitatvāt samudāyasya na bhaviṣyati, evaṃ tarhyacsamudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsārthamekagrahaṇaṃ kurvan jñāpayati-'varṇānirddeśeṣu vyaktisaṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, jātireva nirddiśyate' iti | tena dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvātsiddhamityupapannaṃ bhavati |
nipāta iti kimiti | nipātasyaivaikāco'rthavattvasambhava iti praśnaḥ | cakārārātreti--kṛño liṭi tipo ṇal | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pratyayasyāpyarthavattvamiti bhāvaḥ | ākāro'tra ṅidviśiṣṭa upāttaḥ, prayoge ca na kvacin ṅakāraḥ śrūyate | ato'rthavaśena ṅittvāṅittve vyavasthāpayati |
īṣadartha ityādi | īṣadarthe-ā-uṣṇāḥ - oṣṇaḥ | āṅīṣadartha iti coktam | kriyāyoge - ā-itaḥ - etaḥ | prādiṣu paṭhitaḥ | maryādābhividhau ceti | samāhāradvandva āgamasyānityatvānnumabhāvaḥ | maryādāsahito vā'bhividhiḥ | maryādāyām- ā-udakāntād - odakāntāt | abhividhau - ā-ahicchatrād -āhicchatrāt | āha ca --'vinā tena maryādā, saha tena ityabhividhiḥ' | 'āṅ‌maryādābhividhyoḥ' iti ca ṅinnirddiṣṭaḥ pūrvaprakrāntasya vākyasyānyathātvadyotanāya ākāraḥ prayujyate-ā evaṃ nu manyase, naivaṃ pūrvamamaṃsthāḥ, saṃprati tvevaṃ manyase iti | tathā smṛteḥ sūcakaḥ ākāraḥ prayujyate, tataḥ smṛto'rtho nirdiśyate-ā evaṃ kila taditi ||
ot || 1.1.15 ||
nanu cāhoprabhṛtayo nipātasamāhārāḥ, aha-u - aho, uta-āho-utāho, atha-u-atho, yā-u -yo, na-u - no, mā-u - mo, ca-u -co; yadyapyarthabhedo na pratīyate, tathāpyanarthakānāmapi nipātānāṃ darśanāt samāhāratvaṃ nānupapannam, tataścādivadbhāvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhā pragṛhyasaṃjñā, yathā--'eṣo uṣā apūrvyā' iti | eṣā-u - eṣo ityāśaṅkya, ekanipātā iti darśayati--odanto yo nipāta iti | cādiṣu tathā pāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ | samāhārapakṣe ca āho itītyādau 'uñaḥ' 'ūm̐' ityayaṃ vidhiḥ prāpnoti | athāpi samāhāra, evamapi sūtraṃ karttavyam 'o citsakhāyam' 'o ṣuṃ vartamarutaḥ' ityādyartham | ā-u - o ityatrāntavadbhāvādanāṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, atrāpi paryudāse siddham; āṅanāṅorekādeśa ādivadbhāvādanāṅ‌grahaṇena gṛhyata iti | ihānado'do'bhavaditi ? cvyantatvānnipātatve'ḍapi pratipadoktasyaukārasya grahaṇānna bhavati | evamapyagaurgauḥ samapadyata gobhavadityatra prāpnoti; gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayānna bhaviṣyati | atra hi jaḍyādidharmeṇāropitagotve vāhīke gośabdo varttate iti gauṇārthatvamasya | kathaṃ tarhi gaurvāhīkastiṣṭhati, gāṃ vāhīkamānayeti vṛddhyātve bhavatoḥ ? ucyate; svārthe pravṛttātprātipadikādvibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ kāryeṣu kṛteṣu śabdāntarasannidhānādatra gauṇatvaṃ pratīyate | kārakāṇāmapi hi kriyayā sambandhaḥ, na paraspareṇa; gāmānaya, vāhīkamānaya, gaustiṣṭhati, vāhīkastiṣṭhatīti | paścāttu vākyopanyāsāt sāmānādhikaraṇyādgauṇārthe prādurbhāvo bhavati | iha tu gauṇārthaprādurbhāvāduttarakālaṃ cvyantatve sati pragṛhyasaṃjñāprāptiriti viśeṣaḥ | ataḥ padakāryeṣvevāyaṃ nyāyaḥ, na prātipadikakāryeṣviti siddham |
saṃbuddhau śākalyasyetāvanārṣe || 1.1.16 ||
'saṃbuddhau' ityanenā'nūdyamāna okāro viśeṣyate, ataḥ kṅitītivannimittasaptamīyamityāha--saṃbuddhinimitta iti | parasaptamyāṃ tu trapo itītyādau napuṃsake na syāditi bhāvaḥ | avaidika iti | anāṣa ityasyārthamāha, ṛṣirvedaḥ taduktamṛṣiṇetyādau darśanāt | nanu ca gavityayamāhetyatrānukāryeṇārthavattvātprātipadikatve sati vibhaktyā bhāvyamityata taāha --atretyādi | ata eva hi vibhaktyabhāvādapadāntatvācchākalyasyāpi pratyudāharaṇe 'lopaḥ śākalyasya' iti lopo na bhavati |
bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāditi | bhedanibandhano hi pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ, sa tasminnavivakṣite na bhavati | asatyarthavattva iti | yadyanarthakaḥ; kathaṃ tarhi prayujyate ? prayojanavattvāt, prayojanamanukāryapratītiḥ | yadyapyabhidhānavyāpāro nāsti, tathāpi tadānīmuccāritaṃ rūpaṃ sādṛśyādanukāryapratipattiparam, bhedaśca sanneva na vivakṣita iti anukāryasyāpaśabdatve'pi nāsyāpaśbadatvam | śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārthamiti | tatra bahvṛ cāḥ pragṛhyamevādhīyate, taittirīyāstvapragṛhyam |
añaḥ || 1.117 ||
yadyayameko yogaḥ syād 'aña ūm̐' iti yathāpaṭhitaṃ sūtrakāreṇa, tataḥ 'uñaḥ' ityasya śrutenādeśena sambandhaḥ syād, na pragṛhyasaṃjñayā; sā tu 'nipāta ekājanāṅa' iti nityaiva syāt, śākalyaśrutyanuvṛttyā cādeśe vikalpite rūpadvayameva syād- u iti, ūm̐ itīti; na tu vitīti tṛtīya | ato vibhajya vyācaṣṭe | tatra yadyapi pūrvasūtreṣu sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśātpradeśeṣviva pragṛhyaśabdo dvivacanādyabhidheyaḥ, tathāpīha ṣaṣṭhīnirdeṣātsvarūpapadārthakaḥ sampadyate | ata evāha--uñaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā bhavatīti | pragṛhyamityeṣā saṃjñā bhavatītyarthaḥ | purvatra tu dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñaṃ bhavatītyuktam, anena ca pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā eva vikalpanād- u iti, vitīti sādhitaṃ rūpadvayam ||
ūm̐ || 1.1.18 ||
śākalyasya matena pragṛhyasaṃjñakaśceti | anenāsminnapi yoge dvayamapyetadanuvarttyamiti darśayati | yadi 'śākalyasya' iti nāpekṣyeta tadā pragṛhyasyoño nityamādeśaḥ syāt, anuvṛttasya pragṛhyaśabdasya paṣṭhyantatayā vipariṇāmāt, tataśca ūm̐ iti, vitīti dve eva rūpe syātām; u itīti na syāt | śākalyagrahaṇena tu vikalpe sati tadapi bhavati | tathā pragṛhyagrahaṇānanuvṛttau pragṛhyāpragṛhyayorapyādeśe vikalpaḥ syāt | tatra pragṛhyasyādeśe'pi siddhamiṣṭam, apragṛhyasya tu yaṇ sānunāsiko vakāraḥ syāt | ataḥ pragṛhyagrahaṇamapyanuvarttyam | trīṇi rūpāṇīti | trīṇyeva rūpāṇi bhavanti | trīṇi ca bhavantītyarthaḥ | iha yadetanūm̐ padakārairucyata ityanukaraṇe 'yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā ' ityeṣa vidhirbhavati |
īdūtau ca saptamyarthe || 1.1.19 ||
śākalyasyetāviti nivṛttamiti | asvaritatvāt | iha caśbdena pratnena prakṛtamanukṛṣyate, tatra saṃjñāyā ananuvṛttau vidheyaṃ nāstīti saivānukṛṣyate | māmakyāṃ tanvāmiti prāpta iti | saptamyarthaṃ darśayati | māmakītanūśabdau 'supāṃ suluk' iti luptasaptamīkau | māmakī iti, tanū itīti | kāryodāharaṇe | gaurī adhiśrita iti tu saṃhitāpāṭhe'pi kāryodāharaṇamiti | sa eva tatra darśataḥ |
agnā bhavātīti | rūpapratyudāharaṇam, kāryaṃ tu padakāle | dhītītyādi | dhīti-mati-suṣṭutiśabdebhyaḥ parasya tṛtīyekavacanasya pūrvasavarṇa īkāraḥ, taddarśayatidhītyā, matyetyādinā | vāpyaśvaḥ, nadyātiriti | 'saṃjñāyām' iti saptamīsamāsaḥ | atha kriyamāṇe'pyarthagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, asti hyatrāpi saptamyarthaḥ ? ucyate; jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti pakṣe samāsasyaivārthavattvātpūrvottarapadayorvarṇavadānarthakyamiti saptamyartho nāsti | ajahatsvārthāyāmapi vṛttāvupasarjanapadaṃ na svārthamātre paryavasyāti; kintu tatsaṃsṛṣṭe pradhānārthe |
tatrārthagrahaṇasāmarthyādyāvānartho vākye saptamyantenābhidhīyate kevalo'saṃsṛṣṭarūpastasayaiva grahaṇamiti saṃsṛṣṭe na bhaviṣyati | taparakaraṇaṃ guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tulyakālānāṃ grahaṇārthamiti cet, na; abhedakatvād guṇānām | bhinnakālānāṃ plutānāṃ nivṛttyarthamiti cet, na; anaṇtvādasaṃbhāvācca | na hi saptamyarthavṛtti plutāntaṃ sambhavatītyata āha-taparakaraṇamityādi |
īdūtāvityādi | 'īdūtau saptamī' ityevāstu, 'nārtho'rthagrahaṇena | lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavediti | asatyarthagrahaṇe saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt saptamyā eva saṃjñā syāt, tataśca 'somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ' ityatra na syālluptatvāt | arthagrahaṇe tvarthanimitteyaṃ saṃjñā, na tu pratyayaśravaṇanimittā | ataḥ 'lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavet'| nātra saptamī lupyate, pūrvasavarṇo'tra bhavati-supāṃ sulugiti | tato'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena tasyādivattvāt saptamīgrahaṇena grahaṇād astyeva saptamīti śaṅkatepūrvasya cediti | dūṣayati-āḍāmbhāva iti | yadi hyatra pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāt, dīrghā deśaṃ bādhitvā''ḍāmau syātām, ato lugeva yuktaḥ | tasmādarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ? na karttavyam, yasmātsarvatraiva lukā bhāvyamiti na kvacitsaptamyasti | ucyate cedam-"tatra vacanasāmarthyātsaṃjñāvidhāvapi tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati | nedaṃ vacanāllabhyam,yato vacanādyatra dīrghatvaṃ tatraiva syād-dṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasīśayānam " iti | atra hi saraḥ śabdātparasya ṅiśabdasya 'iyāḍiyājīkārāṇāmupasaṅkhyānam' itīkāre kṛte saptamyeva śrūyate iti tatraiva syād, na gaurī ityādau | tatrāpi sarasī yadi | tatrāpi siddham, katham ? yadi sarasīśabdo vidyate | asaṃdigdhe saṃdigdhābhadhānametad, śāstrāṇi cetpramāṇaṃ syuriti yathā | asti ca sarasīśabdaḥ, dakṣiṇāpathe mahānti sarāṃsi 'sarasyaḥ' ucyante | tataśca sarasīśabdo'pi luptasaptamīka eveti vacanāttadantavidhirityetadeva sthitam | evaṃ tarhi-jñāpakaṃ syāttadantatve | 'īdūded' ityatra catvāraḥ pakṣā upanyastāḥ, tatra tadantatve ityanena tṛtīyacaturthapakṣāvupalakṣayati | tatra jñāpakaṃ syād-iha pragṛhyaprakaraṇe pratyalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti; yadi syāt, pūrvoktanyāyena saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherāśrayaṇāt luptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena saptamyantamiti saṃjñā bhaviṣyati, kimarthagraṇena ? tena tadantatve yo doṣa uktaḥ-pratyayalakṣaṇena saṃjñā prāpnoti, sa na bhavatīti saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvādeva tadantapakṣastatra naiva sthita ityāha--mā veti ||
dādhā ghvadāp || 1.1.20 ||
kimidaṃ prayogasthānāmanukaraṇam-prayoge ye dādhārūpāḥ śrūyante, te ghusaṃjñā bhavantīti ? āhosvit upadeśe dhātupāṭhe'pasthitānāṃ yāvatāmanukaraṇaṃ dādhārūpaṃ saṃbhavati teṣāmiti ? kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadi prayogasthānāmanukaraṇam, śiti na prāpnoti, do-praṇidyati, deṅ-praṇidayate, dāṇ-praṇiyacchati, dheṭ-praṇidhayati; kiṃ kāraṇam ? adādhārūpatvāt | praṇidātā prakaṇidhātā ityādāveva tu syāt | kimucyate śiti na prāpnotīti, yāvatā dodeṅdheṭāmaśityapyātve kṛte'pi lākṣaṇikatvānna prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti dodeṅo tāvad‌gṛhyete | asyāśca paribhāṣāyā daipaḥ pittvaṃ liṅgam; anyathā hi lākṣaṇiktvādevāsya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati | 'do dad ghoḥ' ityatra ca 'daḥ' ityetad‌dheṇnivṛttyarthaṃ sattasya ghusaṃjñāṃ jñāpayati, dadhātestu 'dadhāterhiḥ' iti hyādeśāvidhānādeva dadbhāvāprasaṅgaḥ | yadi 'gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' tarhi arthavatparibhāṣāpi nivarteta, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? pranidārayati-atrāpi prāpnoti | astu, ṇatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? 'upasargāt' ityanuvartate, sambandhiśabdaścāyamupasarga iti, tasmādevaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ-gadādīnāṃ ya upasargastatrasthānnimittāduttarasya tāneva gadādīnpratyupasargasya neriti | pranidārayatītyatra ca yaṃ pratyupasargo nāsau dārūpaḥ, yaśca dārūpaḥ na taṃ pratyupasargaḥ, tasyānarthakatvād | ataḥ śityeva doṣaḥ | upadeśasthānāṃ tvanukaraṇe dodeṅ‌dheḍanukaraṇānāmapi 'ādeca upadeśeśiti' ityāttvasadbhāvātteṣāṃ dāṇdāñ‌dhāñāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ siddhyati | ātvadhiṣaye'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt siddham | sarveṣāṃ ca svarūpeṇānukriyamāṇatvāt lakṣaṇapratipadoktayorniranubandhaketi ca paribhāṣayoranupasthānam, nāpi pranidārayatītyatra prasaṅgaḥ, na hi 'dīṅ' ityetadanukaraṇasyātvamasti | kṛtātvamapi kiñcinmātrasādharmyādanukaraṇaṃ na virudhyate, yathā gavityayamāheti kṛtāvādeśamapi gośabdasyeti nirdoṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-dārūpāścatvāra ityādi | evaṃ ca dīṅo'nukaraṇasyātvābhāvāt tṛjādiṣu 'mīnātiminotidīṅām' ityāttve dārūpasyāpi ghusaṃjñā na bhavati, pranidātā-ṇatvaṃ na bhavati | upādāstāsya svaraḥ śikṣakasya-'sthādhvoricca' itīttvaṃ na bhavati |
kecitu saṃjñāmicchanti | teṣāmapyupādāstetyatra na bhavati, ' sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' iti | `praṇidadātītyādau nergadeti ṇatvam | praṇidyatīti-'otaḥ śyani' |
dātaṃ barhirati | lūnamityarthaḥ | ghusaṃjñāyā abhāvād 'do dad ghoḥ ' iti na bhavati | avadātamityatra ca 'aca upasargāttaḥ' iti na bhavati | nanu dābdaiporananukaraṇādeva na bhaviṣyati, asmadāyattaṃ khalvanukaraṇaṃ dāpdaiporna kariṣyāmaḥ, tanna; asati tasminpratipadoktameva dādhārūpamanukaraṇaṃ gṛhyate | sati tu tasmin yāvatāmanukaraṇaṃ dādhārūpaṃ sambhavati lākṣaṇikaṃ pratipadoktaṃ vā, tāvatāṃ sarveṣāmanukaraṇaṃ bhavati | 'udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre' iti ca meṅaḥ kṛtāttvāsya nirddeśo jñāpayati-'nānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam' iti | na hi 'māṅ māne' ityasya vyatīhāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati, tena daipaḥ pakāre śrūyamāṇa evāttvaṃ bhavatīti adābiti pratiṣedho bhavati | saṃjñāpravṛttisamaye ca yaddābrūpam, tasya pratiṣedha iti praṇidāpayatītyatra prageva pukaḥ pravṛttāṃ ghusaṃjñāmāśritya ṇatvaṃ bhavati | 'dādhā ghvapit' iti vaktavyam, pit ghusaṃjño na bhavatīti | bakāro vā dvayoranubandhaḥ, sūtramapi bakārāntameva paṭhitavyam | bhāṣyavārttikavirodhastu mahāpadamañjaryāmasmābhiḥ prapañcitaḥ ||
ādyantavadekasmin || 1.1.21 ||
'dvandve ghi' ityetadvādhitvā 'ajādyadantam ' ityantaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpno'smādeva nirddeśānna bhavati | na cātyantabādhaḥ, antādivacceti liṅgāt | asahāyasyetyādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha | sati parasmin yasmātpūrvaṃ nāsti sa ādiḥ, sati ca pūrvasminyasmātparaṃ nāsti so'ntaḥ, tadetadubhayamasahāye na sambhavati | tasmādādyantayoryānyupadiṣṭāni uktāni kāryāṇi tānyasahāyasyāpi yathā syurityayamārambhaḥ | asahāyasyetyanenāsahāyavacana ekaśabdo na saṃkhyāvacana iti darśayati | bahuṣvapi vyavasthitasyaikatvasaṃkhyāstīti 'ekasmin' iti vyarthaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | 'ekasmin' ityupameye saptamīśravaṇādupamānasyāpi saptamīsamarthatetyāha-saptamyarthe vatiriti | vartamānāditi śeṣaḥ | 'tatra tasyeva' iti ivārthe vatiḥ | pūrvaṃ tvasahāyasyeti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ saptamyarthasyaiva śeṣarūpavivakṣayā | kāryārthatvātsarvātideśānāṃ prādhānyātkāryātideśo'yamityāha-kārye bhavatīti | | ādyantavadvyapadeśo nimittam | 'pūrvavatsanaḥ' iti tu nirmūlam, vyapadeśātideśe hi kurute, kurve ityādau antavadvyapadeśe'pi antyo'jādirasyetyevaṃ rūpasya bahuvrīhyarthasyābhāvāṭṭisaṃjñāyā abhāve ṭeretvaṃ na syāt | kurvāte ityādau tu dṛṣṭasya ṭeretvākhyasya kāryasyātideśe na doṣaḥ | ābhyāmiti | atra dve antatve upayujyete-ākārāntasyāṅgasyālo'ntyasya dīrgha iti |
sabhāsannayana iti | asatyekagrahaṇe yatrādivyapadeśo nāsti madhye'sahāye ca so'tideśasya viṣayaḥ | 'vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' ityatrādigrahaṇasyāpyetadeva vyāvartyamiti vikalpaḥ syāt-kadācid vṛddhasaṃjñā, kadācinna iti | tasmādākāramāśritya pakṣe vṛddhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti granthārthaḥ ||
taraptamapau ghaḥ || 1.1.22 ||

taraptamapau ghaḥ || 1.1.22 ||
tarateḥ 'ṛdop' ityapi guṇe bhūtapūrveṇa pakāreṇa yadyapi tarabiti rūpaṃ bhavati, tathāpi tamapā sāhacaryāt pratyayasyaiva grahaṇamityāha --tarapatapau pratyayāviti | tena nadyāstaro nadītara iti hrasvo na bhavati | atha vā tarabiti rūpāśraya saṃjñā, rūpanirgrahaśca prayoge upadeśe vā | tatra na kvacitprayoge tarabiti rūpamastītyupadeśagataṃ gṛhyate | na cātraupadeśikaṃ tarabrūpamasti, satyāmapi vā ghasaṃjñāyāṃ na doṣaḥ, hrasvatvaṃ hi samānādhikaraṇe strīliṅge vidhīyate | ātiśāyanikaprakaraṇa eva tādī ghaḥ, pitau gha iti vā karttavye prakaraṇotkarṣeṇa saṃjñākaraṇamanyo'pi tarabastīti sūcanārtham, tena 'alpāctaram' 'lopaśca balavattaraḥ' ityādau svārthe tarap siddho bhavati ||
bahugaṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā || 1.1.23 ||
yadyapi 'vatuḍatī' iti saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇam, tathāpi kevalayoḥ pratyayayoḥ saṃjñāyāṃ prayojanābhāvāt tadantayoreva grahaṇam | vahukṛtva ityādi-'saṃkhyāyāḥ krayābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc,saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā' 'bahvalpārthāt' iti varttamāne 'saṃkhyaikavacanāt' iti śas | 'saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' | tāvatkṛtva iti-'yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup', 'ā sarvanāmnaḥ' | katikṛtva iti--'kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca' | bahugaṇaśabdayorityādi | kathaṃ punargahaṇaṃ nāsti ? saṃkhyetyanvarthasaṃjñeyam saṃkhyāyate'nayeti saṃkhyeti | na ca yo vaipulye bahuśabdaḥ--bahurodana iti, saṃkhyeye vā gaṇaśabdaḥ-ikṣūṇāṃ gaṇa iti, nābhyāṃ saṃkhyāyate | yadi tarhi saṃkhyāvācinoreva grahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ tayoriha saṃjñā vidhīyate ! yāvatā saṃkhyāpradeśeṣu laukikyapi saṃkhyā gṛhyate; anyathā pañcakaḥ, saptaka ityādau 'saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ' iti kan na syāt,'atiśadantāyāḥ' iti ca pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt, śāstrīyāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāstiśadantāyā abhāvādityata āha--bhūryādīnāmityādi | etena niyamārthametayorgrahaṇamiti darśayati | tulyajātīyāpekṣatvācca niyamasya; bhūryādīnāmevāniyatabahutvācināṃ nivṛttiḥ, nābahutvaviṣayayordvyekaśabdayoḥ, nāpi niyatabahutvavācināṃ tryādīnām, tadāha--bhūryādīnāmiti |
aghapūrvapadaśceti | ardhaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya, sa ca pūraṇapratyāntaḥ; pūraṇapratyayāntasyārdhaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ sambhavati, samāsa eva hi pūrvapadaṃ sambhavati | arghapañcamaśūpa iti | ardha pañcamaṃ yeṣāmiti vahuvrīhiḥ | ardhapañcamairardhādhikaiścaturbhiḥ śūrpaiḥ krīta iti 'taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ | 'śūrpādañanyatarasyām' iti vihita syāñaṣṭhaño vā 'adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' iti luk | kathaṃ punarluk, yāvatā nāyaṃ samāsaḥ nāpi kan ? samāsakanvidhyarthamiti sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī, tena samāse vidhīyamāne samāsanimitte vānyasminvidhīyamāna ityarthaḥ |
ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ || 1.1.24 ||
iha kasmānna bhavati-vipruṣaḥ, pāmāna iti ? saṅkhyeti vartate | nanu ca tatsaṅkhyāgrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāpradhānam, ihānuvṛttamapi ṣṇāntānāṃ saṃjñāmeva vidadhyād, na tu ṣṇāntetyasya viśeṣyaṃ samarpabhed; ata āha--strīliṅganirdeśāditi | 'ṣṇāntā' ityatra strīliṅgasya viśeṣyāpekṣāyāṃ sambadhyamānaṃ pradeśeṣviva saṃjñipradhāne bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | ata evātrāntagrahaṇam | itarathā varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhirityeva siddham |
iha kasmānna bhavati-śatāni, sahasrāṇi ? numi kṛte tasya pūrvabhaktatvānnāntā saṅkhyā bhavati | astu, lukkasmānna bhavati ? sarvanāmasthānasannipātakṛto num na tad vihanti | atheha kathaṃ saṃjñā-aṣṭānāmiti ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? aṣṭan-ām iti sthite paratvānnityatvācca 'aṣṭana ā vibhaktau' ityātve kṛte'nāntatvādasatyāṃ saṃmajñāyāṃ nuḍ‌ na syāt, aṣṭano dīrghagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-kṛtātvasyāpyaṣṭanaḥ saṃjñā bhavatīti | etacca tatraivopapādayiṣyāmaḥ | yadvā, prāgeva vibhaktyutpatteranuddiśya prayojanaviśeṣaṃ ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā bhaviṣyati | sā ca kṛte'pyātve na nivarttate ||
ḍati ca || 1.1.25 ||
ḍatyantā ca yā saṃkhyeti | anena saṃkhyāgrahaṇānuvṛttiṃ darśayati | asatyāṃ hyanuvṛttau pāterḍatiḥ patayaḥ-atrāpi syāt | atheha saṃkhyāgrahaṇānuvṛttāvapi kasmādevātra na bhavati, sāmānyena hi ḍateḥ saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā ? ucyate; saṃkhyāsaṃjñāyāṃ hi vatunā sāhacaryāttaddhitasya ḍatergrahaṇam, na tvauṇādikasya ||
ktaktavatū niṣṭhā || 1.1.26 ||
iha ktaktavaturūpāśrayeyaṃ saṃjñā, rūpanirgrahaśca prayoge upadeśe vā bhavati | na ca prayoge sānubandhakaṃ rūpamastītyupadeśagataṃ grāhyam | tatra 'napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' 'ñītaḥ' iti ktasya kvacidupadeśo'sti | yadi tasyaiva syād, liṅgāntare,kālāntare dhātvantare ca na syāt | ktavatostu na kvacidupadeśaḥ, tatkenavihitayoḥ ktaktavatvoreṣā saṃjñā vidhīyate ? anayaiva saṃjñayā | vakṣyati--niṣṭheti | yadyevam, itaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti-vihitayoḥ saṃjñā, saṃjñayā ca vidhānamiti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhāvinī saṃjñā vijñāyate sūtraśāṭakavat | tadyathā-kaścitkañcit tantuvāyamāha-asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti | sa paśyati-yadi śāṭako na vātavyaḥ; atha vātavyo na śāṭakaḥ; śāṭako vātavyaśceti vipratiṣiddham; sa manye vātavyo yasminnute śāṭaka ityetadbhavatīti | tadvadihāpi tau bhūte kāle bhavataḥ, yayorvihitayorniṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti ||
sarvādīni sarvanāmāni || 1.1.27 ||
dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapadaliṅgatvena napuṃsakatvāyogād bahuvacanāsaṃbhavācca sarvādīnīti bahuvrīhirityāha-sarvaśabda ityādi | ādiryeṣāmiti | yadyevaṃ bahuvrīheranyapadārthapradhānatvātsarvaśabdopalakṣitānāṃ viśvādīnāmeva saṃjñā syād, nopalakṣaṇasya sarvaśabdasya | yathā citragurānīyatāmityukte asya tā gāvaḥ sa evānīyate, na citrā gāva ityāśaṅkyāha-tānīmārnati | atra 'tāni' ityeva siddhe imānīti pratyakṣaviṣayeṇedaṃśabdena gaṇapaṭhiteṣu sarvaśabdasyāntarbhāvaṃ sūcayan tad‌guṇasaṃvijñānaṃ bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati | tasya - anyapadārthasya, guṇaḥ-vartipadārthaḥ, so'pi kāryī saṃvijñāyate yasmin bahuvrīhau sa tad‌guṇasaṃvijñānaḥ | matvarthe hi bahuvrīhiḥ | bhūmādiṣu ca matub vidhīyate | tadyatra svasvāmibhāvādisambandhaḥ pravṛttinimittam, na tatropasarjanasya kāryayogaḥ | yathā-gomantamānayeti, saṃbhavati hyaraṇyāvasthitābhirapi gobhiḥ svasvāmibhāvaḥ | yatra tu saṃyogasamavāyayo ranyatarat pravṛttinimittam, tatra svabhāvādevopasarjanasyāpi kāryoyogaḥ, yathā-daṇḍinamānaya, viṣāṇinamānayeti , no khalu gṛhāvasthitena daṇḍena daṇḍasaṃyuktaḥ puruṣo bhavati | evaṃ bahuvrīhāvapi-citraguḥ, śuklavāsā iti | ihāpyādiśabdo'vayavavacana ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ, tatra samudāyasya yugapallakṣye prayogābhāvattadantarbhūtānāṃ saṃjñā bhavantī viśvādīnāmiva sarvaśabdasyāpi bhaviṣyati | atra ca liṅgam-'adaḥ sarveṣām' iti nirdeśaḥ, 'āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' | sarve iti--'jasaḥ śīḥ | pūrvayostūpanyāso jasantatāmasya darśayitum | sarvasmai ityādi--'sarvanāmnaḥ sme' 'ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsinau' |
ubhaśabdo dvivacanaviṣaye eva prayujyate, asati dvivacane naiva prayujyate, na hi bhavati ubhau putrāvasya ubhaputra iti ubhayaśabdo'tra tatsthāne bhavati ubhayaputra ityādi | na ca dvivacane kiñcitsarvanāmakāryamasti; smaiprabhṛtīnāmekavacanabahuvacanaviṣayatvāt, kākacośca nāsti viśeṣa iti tasyeha pāṭhe prayojanamāha-ubhaśabdasyetyādi | ubhābhyāṃ hetubhyām,ubhayorhetvoriti tṛtīyāṣaṣṭhyau bhavataḥ | ubhayeṣām, ubhayasminniti | ubhāvavayavāvasyeti vyutpādyamāna ubhayaśabdo yadā tirohitāvayavabhedaṃ samudāyamācaṣṭe tadaikavacanaṃ bhavati-ubhayo maṇiriti | yadā tu vargadvayārabdhe samudāyini varttamāno vargyabhedānugataṃ samudāyamācaṣṭe tadā bahuvacanam-ubhaye devamanuṣyā iti |
ḍatara-ḍatameti | saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe'pi tadantayorgrahaṇam; kevalayoḥ prayojanābhāvāt |
vakṣyamāṇeneti | 'prathamacaram' ityādinā | sarvaśabdaparyāyasyeti | asti ca sarvaśabdaparyāsaḥ samaśabdaḥ 'nabhantāmanyake same','mā no vṛkāya vṛkye samasmai','uruṣyāṇo'ghāyataḥ samasmāt', 'uto samasminnāśiśī hi no vaso,' 'mā naḥ samasya dūḍhyaḥ' iti yathā | etacca 'sarveṣāṃ nāmāni' ityanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate | sa eva hi samaśabdaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāma bhavati yaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ | yadyanvarthasaṃjñā, 'pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām' iti ṇatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? asmādeva nipātanāt | yadi 'sarvādoti sarvanāmāni',tarhīhāpi prāpnoti-sarvo nāma kaścit tasmai sarvāya dehīti, iha cātikrāntaḥ sarvasmai atisarvāya dehīti; tasmātsaṃjñānāmupasarjanānāṃ ca sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñāpratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ | na kevalaṃ saṃjñāyāḥ, pāṭho'pi teṣāṃ gaṇe nāstīti vaktavyam; saṃjñāmātrapratiṣedhe hi sarvanāmaprayuktameva kāryaṃ teṣāṃ na syāt | pāṭhāśrayaṃ tu syādeva--'tyadādīnāmaḥ' tannāmakaḥ kaścit,tatsa,tadau, tadaḥ; atikrāntastamatitat, atitadau, atitadaḥ; 'adaḍḍatarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ', kataramatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamatikataramiti | saṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvanna vaktavyaḥ |
abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrā lokaviśrutāḥ |
śāstrārthasteṣu karttavyaḥ śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu ||
