tatra yathā bāhurnāma kaścittasyāpatyaṃ bāhavaḥ, 'bāhvādibhyaśca' itīñ na bhavati saṃjñā, śvaśurasyāpatyam 'rājaśvaśurādyat' na bhavati, dhānyamātuḥ svasā, 'mātupitṛbhyāṃ svāsā' iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati; evamihāpi saṃjñābhūtānāṃ sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā, tannibandhanaṃ ca kāryam, antargaṇakāryaṃ ca na bhaviṣyati |
yadvā-'vyavasthāyām' ityatra 'asaṃjñāyām' iti vibhajyate, tena ca gaṇapāṭho viśeṣyate-yānyetānyanukrāntāni sarvādīni tānyasaṃjñāyāṃ draṣṭavyānīti | upasaṃrjanapratiṣedho'pi na karttavyaḥ, sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo yat sarvādyantasya syāt ? sarvaśabdasya tu satyāmapi saṃjñāyāmaṅgasyāsarvanāmatvāt smāyādyaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyevam, paramasarvasmai ityādāvapi na syād; yato yadaṅgaṃ na tatsarvanāma, yacca sarvanāma na tadaṅgamiti | mā bhūdaṅgaṃ sarvanāma, taavayavasyaiva tu sravanāmatve 'aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' iti samudāyasya ca kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati; yathā--asthyādīnāmanaṅ paramāsthneti | na caivamatyasthnetyādivadatisarvāyetyādāvupasarjane'pi prasaṅgo'rthadvārakasya sambandhasyāśrayaṇātsarvanāmārthagatamekatvādikaṃ yā vimaktirāheti; yathā-'aṣṭābhya auś' 'ṣaḍ‌bhyo luk' iti paramāṣṭau paramapañcetyādau bhavati, priyāṣṭānaḥ priyapañcāna ityādau na bhavati; tadvadatrāpi | 'tyadādīnāmaḥ' ityādyantargaṇakāryamapyevameva draṣṭavyam | yattu rūpāśrayaṃ kāryam 'yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' iti, na pāṭhāśrayam, nāpi saṃjñāśrayaṃ tadasthyādyanaṅ‌vadupasarjane'pi bhavati | yattūpasarjanadaśāyāḥ prāgeva prāptaṃ tadapi bhavati atikrānto bhavakantamatibhavakāniti, tasmānnārthastadantasya saṃjñayā, ucyate; avyayasarvanāmnāmityakac paramabhavakāniti tadantānna syāt | 'pañcamyāstasil' paramasarvataḥ, 'saptamyāstral' paramasarvatra,'ā sarvanāmnaḥ' 'viṣvagdevayośca ṭeradryañcatau vapratyaye' paramatadryaṅ‌ paramayadryaṅityādau na syāditi tadantasya saṃjñeṣitavyā | kathaṃ punariṣyamaṇāpi labhyate ? jñāpakāditi vakṣyāmaḥ | tattadantasya ca bhavantī paramasarvādivad atisarvāderapi syāditi upasarjanapratiṣedho'pi vaktavyaḥ ? na vaktavyaḥ, anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādeva siddham | vṛttau hi pradhānārthasaṃsargādupasarjanāni na sarvārthāni, yathāsambhavaṃ ca sārvārthyāmiti pratyakṣaparokṣatādiviṣeṣavācitve'pi tadidamādīnāṃ bhavatyeva | anvarthatvādeva ca saṃjñābhūtānāmapi saṃjñābhāvaḥ | evaṃ tāvatsaṃjñānibandhanaṃ smāyādyupasarjanānāṃ nibāritam | tyadādyantargaṇakāryaṃ tu syādeva; pāṭhasya sthitatvāt | evaṃ tarhi tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇād dvitīyo'pi sarvanāmaśabda upāttaḥ, tena pāṭho viśeṣyate-yāni sarveṣāṃ nāmāni tāni sarvādīnīti, tena sarvādipāṭhopajīvanena pravartamānamantargaṇakāryamapi vyavasthāsyate | yadvā-saṃjñāyā anvarthatvāttattatsaṃbandhayogyānāṃ sarvārthānāṃ tāvatpāṭho'vaśyābhyupagantavyaḥ | tataśca prakārāntarajuṣāṃ pāṭhe pramāṇābhāvādeva siddhaḥ pāṭhātparyudāsaḥ ||
vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau || 1.1.28 ||
atra samāsāvayavānāṃ sarvādīnāṃ saṃjñā vikalpyata ita vṛttau lakṣyate, yathāha- digupadiṣṭa ityādi | diśāmupadiṣṭa ukte 'diṅ‌nāmānyatarāle' ityasminsamāse'vayavatvena vartamānānītyarthaḥ | na cāvayavānāṃ saṃjñāvikalpe kiñcitprayojanamasti, smāyādikaṃ tāvadaṅgāśrayam, kākacośca nāsti viśeṣaḥ, digvācināmakārāntatvāt | 'sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' iti pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvoṣa'pi na prayojanam, tatra hi mātragrahaṇaṃ kvacitsarvanāmatvena dṛṣṭānāṃ saṃpratyasarvanāmatve'pi yathā syāt, tathā ca dakṣiṇapūrvāyā iti saṃjñābhāvapakṣe'pi bhavati | syādetat--avayavānāmeva saṃjñā, kāryaṃ tu 'aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' iti | evamapi dakṣiṇapūrvataḥ, dakṣiṇapūrvatratyatra tasilādayo na syuḥ; tasmātsarvādyante bahuvrīhau saṃjñā vikalpyate | 'sarvādīni' ityayaṃ tu vṛttigranthaḥ 'sarvādyante pravartamānā saṃjñā sarvādīnyapi gocarayati' ityevaṃparo vyākhyeyaḥ | yadvā--avayavānāṃ saṃjñāvidhānena tadantasyāpi siddhyati, tadantavidherabhyupagamāditi |
samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | na bahuvrīhiḥ samāsatvaṃ vyabhicaratīti praśnaḥ | dakṣiṇadakṣiṇasyai iti | 'ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat' ityanuvṛttau 'ābādhe ca' iti dakṣiṇaśabdasya dvirvacanam 'na bahuvrīhau' ityayamapi niṣedho na bhavati, tatrāpi samāsādhikārāt | dakṣiṇottarapūrvākaṇāmiti | asati bahuvrīhigrahaṇe yathā 'na bahuvrīhau' iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, evaṃ 'dvandve ca' ityetamapi bādheta | atha kriyamāṇa'pi bahuvrīhigrahaṇe yā pūrvā sottarā yasyonmugdhasya tasmai pūrvottarāya dehītyatra kasmānna bhavati ? pratipadokto yo diksamāsaḥ-'diṅ‌nāmānyantarāle' iti, tasya grahaṇam | yadyevam, tata eva hetordvandve na bhaviṣyati ? satyam; uttarārthamavaśyaṃ karttavyaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇamihāpi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate ||
na bahuvrīhau || 1.1.29 ||
atra vṛttau dvidhā sūtrārtho lakṣyate--bahuvrīhāviti niṣedhādhikaraṇam-bahuvrīhi saṃjñā na bhavati, bahuvrīhyādhārā saṃjñā na bhavatīti; bahuvrīheḥ saṃjñā na bhavatīti | sarvādyadhikaraṇaṃ vā--bahuvrīhau yāni sarvādīni tāni sarvanāmasaṃjñāni na bhavantīti | tatra sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām ityādinā''dyaṃ pakṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūtrārthaṃ darśayati | kathaṃ punarjñāyate'bhyupagatastadantavidhiriti ? ata eva niṣedhāt | dvitīyaṃ sūtrārthaṃ darśayati--bahuvrīhāvityādi | prathamasyodāharaṇamāha--priyaviśvāyeti | 'sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam' iti sarvanāmnaḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte 'vā priyayasya' iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ | dvyanyāyeti | 'sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ' iti dvyanyayoḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte paratvāt saṅkhyāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ | dvitīyasyodaharaṇamāha--iha ceti | atra ca pratiṣedho'yamārabhyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ; atrāsati niṣedhe'kaci sati tvakatpitṛko makatpitṛka iti prāpnoti, sati tu 'prāgivātkaḥ' iti ke sati 'pratyayottarapadayośca' iti tvamādeśayostvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka iti siddhyati 'nadyṛtaśca' iti samāsānte kapi | nanu ca bahuvrīhāvayaṃ niṣedhaḥ, iha ca prāgeva; tatastvakaṃ pitā'sya ahakaṃ pitā'syeti vākyāvasthāyāmevākac prāpnoti ? evaṃ tarhi pratiṣedhasāmarthyāt yadvākyopamardena bahuvrīhirbhavati tasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ niṣedho bhaviṣyati | atra ca prathamaḥ sūtrārthastadantavivijñāpanāyaivopanyastaḥ, na tu priyaviśvāyetyādau samudāyasya saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ; asarvārthatvāt, yathā atisarvāyetyādau |
bahuvrīhāviti vartamāne punarbuhuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāha--bahuvrīhāvityādi vastrāntaravasanāntarā iti | vasanamantaraṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau dvandvaḥ | atrāsati bahuvrīhigrahaṇe vartamānadvandvāśrayo niṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca jasi vibhāṣā syāt | punarbahuvrīhigrahakaṇāttu yadanto dvandvaḥ, so'ntaraśabdo bahuvrīheḥ pūrvamatrāsīd iti bahuvrīhyāśrayo nitya eva niṣedho bhavati | idaṃ tu 'tadantasya saṃjñāniṣedha' iti prathamapakṣānurodhena pratyudāharaṇam | na tvatra prasaṅgaḥ; asarvārthatvāt | vasantyasminniti vasanaṃ gṛham, tena 'virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ityekaśeṣābhāvaḥ ||
tṛtīyāsamāse || 1.1.30 ||
samāse iti, varttamāne ityādi | mukhyasyaiva grahaṇe prāpte gauṇasyāpi grahaṇārthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇamityarthaḥ | na ca tṛtīyāsamāsamātrārthe vākye prasaṅga ityāha--pūrvasadṛśetyādi | etacca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate | tvayakā, mayaketi | 'yuṣmadasmadostṛtīyaikavacane','tvamāvekavacane', 'yo'ci' subantayoḥ prāk ṭerakac ||
dvandve ca || 1.1.31 ||
ayaṃ samudāyasyaiva niṣedho nāvayavānām, kutaḥ ? tyādādīnāṃ tāvat 'tyadādīni sarvairnityam' iti ekaśeṣeṇa bhāvyam, prāk ca tyādādibhyo'kārāntāḥ,tatra na kākacorviśeṣaḥ; 'sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' tviṣyata eva-dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmiti, so'yaṃ pratiṣedho jñāpayati-'asti sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhiḥ' iti ||
vibhāṣā jasi || 1.1.32 ||
jasaḥ kārya prati vibhāṣeti | tat katham ? vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam | yadvā, jasīti kāryāpekṣayādhikaraṇasaptamī--jasādhāraṃ yatkāryaṃ śībhāvākhyaṃ tatra kartavya iti | anye tvāhuḥ- jasa ī jasī śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakahrasvatve saptamyā lukā nirdeśaḥ-jasa īkāre kartavya iti | kiṃ punaḥ kārakaṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ? tatrāha--akajhīti | hi śabdo yasmādarthe | yadyaviśeṣeṇa vikalpaḥ syāt, katara katama as iti sthite kutsādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāmakaj‌vidhiṃ prati saṃjñā syāt, tataśca tanmadhyapatitatvāttad‌grahaṇe śībhāvaḥ syāt; ke tu sati na bhavati ||

prathamacaramatayālpārdhakatipayanemāśca || 1.1.33 ||
ubhayaśabdasyetyādi | ubhāvavayavāvasya 'ubhādudātto nityam' iti tayapo'yajādeśaḥ | sthānivadbhāvādbhavatyayaṃ tayabantaḥ, tathāpi gaṇe pāṭhād nityaiva saṃjñā bhavati | nanu gaṇe pāṭhasyobhayasminnubhayeṣāmityādiravakāśaḥ, iha tayabgrahaṇasya dvitaye dvitayā iti, ubhayaśabdājjasyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādiyameva vibhāṣā prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; antaraṅgā nityā saṃjñā vibhaktyanapekṣatvāditi saiva pravartate |
kākacoryathāyogaṃ vṛttiriti | nemaśabde'kaco vṛttiḥ, anyeṣu kasyetyeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ | kaḥ panardoṣo nemaśabde, yadi jasaḥ kāryaṃ prati na syāt, pakṣe ko'pi syāt ? astu; nemake, nemakāḥ'-nitye'pyakaci tasya tad‌grahaṇena grahaṇādasmin vikalpe sati etadrūpadvayaṃ bhavatyeva, satyam; prathamādiṣu pakṣe'kajna bhavatītyevamparo granthaḥ ||
pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām || 1.1.34 ||
asaṃjñāyāmiti | saṃjñāyāmasatyām, pūrvādayaścetsaṃjñārūpā na bhavantītyarthaḥ | vyavasthā - niyamaḥ, sa cātrārthādavadhyapekṣa ityāha-svāmidheyāpekṣa ityādi | pūrvādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ svābhidheyo digdeśakālasvabhāvo'rthastamapekṣate, tena vāpekṣyate yaḥ sa svābhidheyāpekṣaḥ | avadhiḥ - maryādā; pūrvadeśasya yatpūrvatvaṃ tatparadeśamapekṣya bhavati, parasyāpi yatparatvaṃ tatpūrvadeśam | evaṃ dikkālayorapi draṣṭavyam | tasmātpūrvādiśabdavācyo'rtho'vaśyamavadhiṃ kañcidapekṣya bhavati | tatra yo'yamapekṣāyā niyamaḥ sā vyavastheti tāvadvivakṣitam | tasyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ pūrvādiśabdānāṃ svābhidheya eva varttamānānāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati, na tu vācyāyām |
pravīṇā ityartha iti | anena vyavasthābhāvamāha | na hi pravīṇaśabda sāpekṣamarthamācaṣṭe | satyāmeva vyavasthāyāmityanenānvarthatāṃ darśayati | sumerumavadhimapekṣya kuruṣūttaraśabdo vartate, atra jasaḥ kāryaṃ pratīti noktam; viśeṣābhāvāt ||
svamajñātidhanākhyāyām || 1.1.35 ||
ajñātidhanākhyāyāmityasyārthamāha-na cedityādi | yatra śabdāntaranirapekṣaḥ svaśabdo jñātidhane svarūpeṇācaṣṭe tatrāsau saṃjñārūpeṇa pravartate | ātmāyā ityartha iti | putrāṇāṃ gavāṃ satyapi jñātidhanatve na tenākāreṇa tatra vartate, kintvātmīyākāreṇetyarthaḥ | ākhyāgrahaṇe tvasati jñātidhanayoḥ paryavasānādatrāpi prāpnoti |
dhūmāyanta ityādi | yatholmukānyaśliṣṭāni asaṃhatāni dhūmāyante, saṃhatāni prajvalanti; tadvat jñātayo'pītyarthaḥ | svā jñātaya iti | svaśabdasyānekārthasya vyaktīkaraṇāya paryāyasyāpi jñātiśabdasya prayogaḥ, sa eva tu na prayuktaḥ; niraṅkuśāḥ kavivāca iti ||
antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ || 1.1.36 ||
bahirityanāvṛto deśa ucyate | bahirityanena yogo bahiryoga itītiśabdādhyāhāreṇa vigṛhya samāsaḥ | sa cānāvṛtasya bāhyasya vastuno bhavati | upasaṃvīyate vidhīyate vāso'ntareṇetyupasaṃvyānam, karmaṇi lyuṭ | nagarabāhyā iti | bahiryogaṃ darśayati | paridhānīyamantarvāsaḥ, prāvaraṇīyaṃ bahirvāsaḥ | antare tāpasa iti | atra saṃjñābhāvād ṅeḥ sminna bhavati | 'jasi' iti vartamāne kathaṃ saptamāntaṃ pratyudāharaṇe dīyata ityata āha--gaṇasūtrasya cetyāda | gaṇasūtramapyevameva paṭhyate | kasmātpunaraprastutasya gaṇasūtrasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ dīyate, na sūtrasya ? 'apurīti vaktavyam' iti vakṣyati, tad‌ gaṇasūtraviṣayaṃ yathā syāditi; tasyāyaṃ prastāvaḥ | sūtrasyāpyanayā diśā pratyudāharaṇaṃ gamyata iti na pṛthagdarśitam | antarāyāmiti | prākārādvahirvartinyāmityarthaḥ | yadyapi gaṇasūtre'ntaraśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tathāpi tasyaiva sarvanāmatvāt ṭāpā sahaikādeśo'pi tad‌grahaṇena gṛhyata taiti syāt prasaṅgaḥ | liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā vā ṭābantasyaiva saṃjñāprasaṅge vacanam | vibhāṣāprakaraṇa ityādi | yathāyamarthaḥ siddhyati, tathā 'vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyābhyām' ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ ||
svarādinipātamavyayam || 1.1.37 ||
tasilādiriti | 'pañcamyāstasil' ityārabhya 'edhācca' ityetadantaḥ | śastasī -- 'bahvalpārthācchas', pratiyoge 'pañcamyāstasiḥ' | saṃkhyāyāḥ 'kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc','dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc' | āsthālāviti | 'iṇa āsiḥ' ayāḥ,'pratnapūrva'-tvaṃ pratnathāḥ | cvyarthāḥ-'saṃpadyakartari cviḥvibhāṣāsātiḥ kārtsye','deye trā ca', amu cacchandasi','kimettiṅavyayaghādāmu' | nipātā vakṣyanta iti | atha kimarthaṃ svarādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ kriyate, te cādiṣveva paṭhyeram ? na; cādīnāmasattvavacanānāṃ nipātasaṃjñā, svarādīnāṃ punaḥ sattvavacanānāmasattvavacanānāṃ cāvyayasaṃjñā-svasti vācayati, svaḥ praśyeti | kriyāsambandhe'nekaśaktidarśanāt sattvavācitvam | atha 'prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ svarādīni cādayo'sattve' ityevaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ kriyeta, kaḥ punaratra viśeṣastatra vā svarādigrahaṇaṃ kriyeta ? atra vā ? kiṃ ca 'nipāta ekājanāṅ‌' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā svarādīnāmapyekācāṃ prasajyeta-'kimo't','dakṣiṇādāc', 'ekācca taddhitaḥ'; kenprabhṛtayastu kṛta ekācassanti | atha 'cādirekājanāṅ' iti kriyate tadā cādīnāmasattvavacanatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na labhyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'cādayo'sattve' ityatrāsattvāgrahaṇaṃ cādīnāṃ pāṭhaviśeṣaṇam, yathā-'tiṅo gotrādīni' ityatra kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ gotrādīnām, tena yatra yatra cādigrahaṇaṃ tatra sarvatra viśiṣṭanāmeva grahaṇam, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--'ubhe saṃjñe na karttavaṃye bhavataḥ-avyayam, nipātaḥ' iti | katham ? 'prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ' iti vā 'avyayāni' iti vā sūtraṃ karttavyam, tataḥ svarādīni 'taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' yāvad 'avyayībhāvaśca' iti, tataḥ 'cādayo'sattve' ityārabhya yāvad 'adhirīśvare', vibhāṣā kṛñi' iti; tatra yasmin pradeśe nipātagrahaṇaṃ tatra cādigrahaṇamastu, avyayapradeśeṣvavyayagrahaṇaṃ nipātagrahaṇaṃ ceti, tattu tathā na kṛtamityeva |
avyayamityanvarthasaṃjñati | sadṛśam ityādi | śrutiśceyamātharvaṇī praṇavavidyāyāṃ triṣu liṅgeṣu strīpunnapuṃsakeṣu sadṛśam, liṅgaviśeṣapratipādane'sāmarthyāt | vibhaktiṣvati | kārakeṣu vacaneṣviti | ekatvādisaṃkhyāsu, avyayībhāvasya śaktilriṅgaviśeṣayoge'pi vacanādavyayatvam'yasmānna vyeti nānā na gacchati yattvadharmānna gṛhṇātītyarthastattasmādavyayam' iti | yacchabdarūpaṃ na vyeti tadavyayamiti vā | kiṃ punaḥ prayojanamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇe ? upasarjjanapratiṣedhaḥ-atyuccaisau, atyuccaisa iti | atikrāntapradhānasyātra sattvadharmaparigrahāt uccaiḥśabdaḥ paṭhyate, kaḥ prasaṅgastadantasya ? etaj‌ jñāpayatyācāryaḥ--'astyavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhiḥ' iti | tena paramasvaḥ, paramoccairiti svarādiprādhānye tadantasyāpi bhavati | kuśabdaḥ svarādiṣu paṭhitavyo'vyayasaṃjñārthaḥ ||
taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ || 1.1.38 ||
iha yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhastathāpi kevalasya taddhitasya saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvāt tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha-taddhitāntaḥ śabda iti | akac tāvatprātipadikasya subantasya vā vidhīyate | 'avyayādāpsupaḥ' ityatrāpyavyayādvihitasya supo luk, na tu parasya; atyuccaisāvityādāvapi prasaṅgāt | 'tatpuruṣe tulyārtha','nāvyayadikchabda','khityanavyayasya' ityatrāpi pūrvapadasyāvyayasya grahaṇam | sarvā vibhaktiryasya sambandhinī na bhavati so'sarvavibhaktiḥ |
kiṃ punaridaṃ taddhitasya vaśeṣaṇam ? āhosvittadāntasya ? kathañcedaṃ taddhitasya viśeṣaṇam, kathaṃ vā tadantasya ? yadi sarvā vibhaktiryasya sambandhinī na bhavati--kāraṇatvena yasyotpattau sarvā vibhaktiḥ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati, yathā 'pañcamyāstasil' ityādāviti kāryamanyapadārthaḥ, tadā taddhitasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati--taddhitasyaiva hyutpattirna tadantasya | evaṃviśiṣṭena taddhitena tadantavidhau-tādṛśataddhitānto'vyayamityartho bhavati | atha tu sarvā vibhaktiryasya kāryatvena sambandhinī na bhavati-yasmātsarvā vibhaktirnotpadyata iti kāraṇamanyapadārthaḥ, tadā tadantasāya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati | na hi taddhitamātrādvibhaktiyutpattiprasaṅgaḥ | tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe vinā, nānetyatra na syād; na hi vinañbhyamāmityatra pratiniyatā kācidvibhaktirāśrīyata iti sarvavibhaktyantābhyāṃ vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau bhavataḥ | avyayebhyastu niḥ saṅkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eveti pakṣe ye'pi bhavadādiprayoge tasilādayo vidhīyanta--'itarābhyoṣa'pi dṛśyanta' iti, te'pi sa bhavām̐stato bhavāṃstaṃ bhavantaṃ tato bhavantamityādisarvavibhaktyantebhya utpadyanta iti tatrāpi na syāt | 'tasyāpatyamtatra bhavaḥ' ityādau ca ṣaṣṭhyādikaikaiva vibhaktirnimittam, na tu sarvetatyaupagavādāvatiprasaṅgaśceti dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--yasmādityādi | tata ityādau 'prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' iti tasilādīnāṃ vibhaktitvāttyadādyatvam |
kathaṃ punarete'sarvavibhaktayaḥ; yāvatā yatra ca saṅkhyā sambhavati tatrāyamupadeśāḥ, avyayebhyastu niḥsaṅkhyebhya ityasminpakṣe 'avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti jñāpakāśrayaṇe ca sarvavibhaktayaḥ; atha saṅkhyākarmādayaśca svādīnāmarthāstena sahāsyaikavākyateti pakṣaḥ, tato'vibhaktitvamevāsattvabhūtārthānāmāpadyeta ? ucyate; 'dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane' ityatraikasminnityapanīya 'ekavacanam' iti pṛthak sūtraṃ karttavyam, tataḥ 'dvibahvordvivacanabahuvacane' iti, tataścaikavacanamekasminnapi bhaviṣyati, saṅkhyākarmādyabhāve cāprāptaprāpaṇārthatvādekavacanamityasya sūtrasya, dvitvabahutvayostu prāptaṃ dvivacanabahuvacanābhyāṃ bādhyate, tataścāsattvavacanebhyo'pi saptānāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ saptāpyekavacanāni bhavanti | avyayībhāvādapyevameva, tāvatāpi nāvyayībhāvāt 'tṛtīyāsaptamyoḥ' ityasyopapatteḥ, tadidamucyate-'ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate' iti | evaṃ sthite yasmātsarvā vibhaktirnotpadyata ityekavacanena vigraho'vayavakārtsnyavṛttiḥ sarvaśabdo yasya trikasya vibhaktiśaṃjñā vihitā tanniravaśeṣaṃ yasmānnotpadyate, kintu tadekadeśa evatyarthastadāha--yasmān sarvā vibhaktiriti | yadi tu sarvā vibhaktaya iti bahuvacanena vigṛhyeta tataḥ sarvānnīna itivat prakāra kārtsnya'pi sarvaśabdasya saṃbhavād ekavacanamātrotpattāvapi sarvā vibhaktayaḥ, saptāpyekavacanānyasattvavacanebhya utpadyanta iti na syādasarvavibhaktitvamiti bhāvaḥ | iha 'tenaika diktasiśca' ityekasminnarthe vidhīyamānayorapyaṇtasoraṇ dravyapradhānaḥ, tasistu dravyopasarjanatṛtīyārthapradhāna iti tasyāsattvavacanatā |
taddhita iti kimiti | asarvavibhaktiravyayamityevāstu, mā bhūtsarvameya prakaraṇaṃ ye hi svarādayaḥ, ye ca nipātāḥ, ye ca kṛnmejantāḥ, ye ca ktvādayaḥ, yaścāvyayībhāvaḥ, sarve te'sarvavibhaktaya iti praśnaḥ | ekaḥ dvau, bahava iti | etebhyo'pi saptasvapi vibhaktiṣvekaikameva vacanamutpadyata iti syādatiprasaṅga iti karttavyaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam | tasmiṃśca kṛte prakaraṇamapi karttavyamiti bhāvaḥ | viśatyādayastu kṛtaikaśeṣā dvivacanabahuvacanāntā api bhavantīti nāsarvavibhaktayāḥ | evaṃ dvayatrayobhayaśabdā ayajantāḥ | evamapi godayoradūrabhavo grāmaḥ 'adūrabhavaśca' ityaṇaḥ 'varaṇādibhyaśca' iti lupi yuktavadbhāvāt sarvāsu vibhaktiṣu dvivacanasyotpatterastyatiprasaṅgaḥ | syādayaṃ paryanuyogaḥ--yadi taddhitānto godaśabdaḥ,vayaṃ tu 'lubyogāprakhyānād' 'yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve darśanaṃ syāda' ityadhīyānā naivaṃ paryanuyojyāḥ; evamapi 'saṅkhāyāssaṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' saṃjñāyāṃ svārtha utpādyaḥ, pañcaiva pañcakāḥ śakunayaḥ--atra prāpnoti, pacatirūpaṃ pacatikalpamityādau ca ekavacanamevotpadyata iti syādevātiprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāttaddhitānāṃ pāṭha evāśrayaṇīyaḥ, tadāha--'siddhaṃ tu pāṭhāttasilādayaḥ prāk pāśapaḥ, śasprabhṛtayaḥ prāk samāsāntebhayaḥ, māntaḥ kṛtvorthāḥ, tasivatī nānāñāviti' ||
kṛnmejantaḥ || 1.1.39 ||
atrāpi pūrvavattadantasya saṃjñeti sthite mejantagrahaṇaṃ kadantasya viśeṣaṇam--'kṛdantammejantamabyayam' iti | kṛta eva vā-kṛdyo mejantastadantamavyamiti | tatrādyo pakṣe pratāmau pratāmaḥ, lavamācaṣṭe iti ṇici kvipi ṇilope ūṭhi 'etyedhatyūṭh‌su' iti vṛddhau lauratrāpi prāpnoti, bhavati hyotat pratyayalakṣaṇena kṛdantam, mejantaṃ ca śrūyata itīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--kṛdya iti | nanvatrāpi kārayāñcakāra--āmantasya na prāpnoti, pūrvatra tu liṭaḥ kṛttvātsiddham, atrāpi svarādiṣvāmiti pāṭhāt siddham | athāpi tatra taddhitasya pāṭhaḥ; evamapi kṛdantatvādutpannānāṃ supām 'āmaḥ' iti lugbhaviṣyati, 'leḥ' iti hi tatra nānuvarttate |
svāduṅkāramiti | 'svādumi ṇamul' svādumityarthagrahaṇātsampannaṅkāramityapi bhavati, svādumiti | nipātanātpūrvapadasya māntatvam | 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityeva siddherapārthakamantagrahaṇaṃ tatrāha-antagrahaṇamityādi | nityayoge bahuvrīhivijñānādaupadeśikapratipattiḥ | ādhaya iti | āṅ‌pūrvāddhāñaḥ 'upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ',caturthyekavacane 'gherṅiti' ādhaye, bhavatyayaṃ saṃpratyejantaḥ, nopadeśe | evaṃ cikīrṣave-karoteḥ sannantāt 'sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ ', kumbhakāraśabdaḥ karmaṇyaṇantaḥ 'bahuvacane jhalyet', atrāvyayasaṃjñāyām 'avyayāt' iti luk syāt, sannipātaparibhāṣayā'pyetatsiddham, tathā lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiveti | antagrahaṇaṃ tu yatnāntaraṃ draṣṭavyam ||

avyayībhāvaśca || 1.1.41 ||
luṅ‌mukhasvaropacārā iti | atra makhasvaropacārau nivartyapānatayā prayojanam, maśakārtho dhūma itivat | luk pravartyamānatayā | upāgnīti | avyayāditi luk | pūrvapadaprakṛtitvara eveti | samāsasvareṇāntodāttatvam | upapayaḥ kāma iti | 'śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ' karmaṇi ghañantena vā bahuvrīhiḥ, atra mukhasvaranivṛttireva sākṣātprayojanam, luk tu 'nāvyayībhāvādato'm' iti viśeṣapratiṣedhāt siddhaḥ, 'ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' ityatra ca 'anuttarapadasthasya' iti vartate | nanvanyadapyavyayakāryaṃ sambhavati-upāgnikamityakac, upakumbhamanya iti mumpratiṣedhaḥ, upakumbhībhūta iti 'asya cvau' itītvasyopasaṅkhyānikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, upāgnyadhīyāneti 'subāmantrite' ityasyaupasaṃkhyānikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tatkuto'yaṃ kāryaniyama ityata āha - sarvamidamityādi | iha cetyādinā 'na lokāvyaya' ityatra yadvakṣyati --'avyayapratiṣedhe tosunkasunorapratiṣedhaḥ' iti, tasyāvaktavyatāṃ darśayati ||
śi sarvanāmasthānam || 1.1.42 ||
kuṇḍānīti | 'jaśśasojha śiḥ' 'sarvanāmasthāne' iti vartamāne 'napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti num | 'sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' iti dīrgho yadyapi 'jasaḥ śīḥ' 'napuṃsakācca' iti vihitasya śīśabdasya śabdalūpāpekṣayā napuṃsaka hrasvatve 'śi' iti rūpaṃ sambhavati, tathāpi lākṣaṇikatvānna tasya grahaṇam, sarvanāmasthānapradeśeṣu śigrahaṇe suṭo grahaṇaṃ na syāt | śisuṭoriti vacane napuṃsakasuṭo'pi grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, ataḥ saṃjñā tāvatkarttavyā | kimarthaṃ tu mahatī kriyate ? ke cidāhuḥ-sarvanāma tiṣṭhatyasminnati sarvanāmasothānam, nāma pratipadikam, sarvaśabdo'vayavakārtsyavacanaḥ sarvāvayavayuktaṃ yatra nāma tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ, tenānyatra nyūnaṃ nāma tiṣṭhatītyartho gamyate, kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? 'upeyuṣaḥ' ityādau samprasāraṇe kṛte pūrvakṛtasyeṭo nivṛttiḥ siddhā bhavati; anyathā nivṛttikāraṇābhāvāt avatiṣṭheteti | evaṃ tu kasmin prātipadike kiṃ nyūnamiti na jñāyeta ! tasmātpūrvācāryānupālabdhumeṣā mahatī saṃjñā praṇītā ||
suḍanapuṃsakasya || 1.1.43 ||
suḍiti pañca vacanānīti | anenauṭaṣṭakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na ṭāśabdasyeti darśayati | ādirantyenetyatrāntyatvaprayuktā yasyetsaṃjñā tena pratyāhāraḥ | lakāre tvakārasyetsaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt pratyāhāra iti bhāvaḥ | napuṃsakādanyatreti | anena pūryudāsatāṃ darśayati | prajyapratiṣedhe hi kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhantīti jasaḥ śau, pūrveṇa yā prāptistasyā api pratiṣedhaśaṅkāyām 'anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti pariharttavyaṃ syād, asamarthasamāsaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt | napuṃsake na vidhiriti | strīpuṃsasambandhinaḥ suṭa upādānād | na pratiṣedha iti | vidhipradhānatvāt paryudāsasya | tenetyādi | yata evaṃ napuṃsakenāsya vyāpāraḥ tena jaso yaḥ śistasya pūrveṇa saṃjñā bhavatīti | sāmanī iti | napuṃsakācceti śībhāvaḥ | 'vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' ityallopābhāve dīrgho na bhavati ||
na-veti vibhāṣā || 1.1.44 ||
navāśabdo'yamekanipāto'pyasti pratiṣedhavāvī, navoktārthatvāditi yatā, tasya grahaṇe 'vibhāṣādiksamāse' iti prakṛte ' na bahuvrīhau' iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syād | vibhāṣāpradeśeṣu ca na śabda evopādeyaḥ syād | ata eva saṃkhyāvācino nakārāntasyāpyagrahaṇam | pratyagrastrīliṅgavacano'pi na gṛhyate; pradeśeṣvasambhavāt | na hi 'vibhāṣā śveḥ' ityādau vidheyasya navapurāṇtvaṃ strīliṅgatā vā sambhavati | tasmānnipātasamudāyo'yamityāha-neti | pratiṣedha ityādi | tayoḥ pratiṣedhavikalpayorityanenārthayoreṣā saṃjñeti darśatam | nanu ca 'sva rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanānnavāśabdayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tatrāha-itikaraṇa ityādi | karmāṇi lyuṭ‌, itiścāsau karaṇaśca so'rthasya saṃjñino nirdeśo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ | itiśabdo hi padārthaviparyāsakṛt | tatra loke bāhyārthapradhāneṣu śabdeṣvitiśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, arthapadārthakatvāt pracyāvya śabdapadārthakatve vyavasthāpayati gaurityayamāheti | iha tu vyākaraṇe 'svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanāt svarūpapadārthaḥ | tataśca navāśabdābhyāṃ paratra prayukta iti śabdastau svarūpapadārthakatvātpracyāvyārthapadārthakatve vyāvasthāpayati | tasmādarthayoreva saṃjñā |
vibhāṣāpradeśeṣu ityādinā pratiṣedhavikalpayorekasminneva yoge sahopasthāpanaṃ viṣayabhedeneti taṃ darśayati | tathā sati viṣayabhedo durjñānaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tatretyādinā pūrvaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ pravartate, pañcādvikalpa iti darśayati | yadi tu pūrvaṃ vikalpaḥ pravarteta paścātpratiṣedhaḥ, tato vikalpapravṛttiranarthikaiva syāt | ānupūrvī ca saṃjñāvidhivākye śrutaiva pradeśavākyeṣvapyāśrayituṃ yuktā | ubhayatravibhāṣāḥ prayojayantīti | prāptavibhāṣāyāmaprāptavibhāṣāyāṃ ca saṃjñākaraṇasyānupayogāt | tathā hi--prāptavibhāṣāyāṃ tāvad 'vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne' iti 'svaritañitaḥ' ityādinā nityamātmanepade prāpte vibhāṣā vidhīyate | vibhāṣāśabdaścāyaṃ 'vā' 'anyatarasyām' ityādivadvikalpavācitvena prasiddhaḥ | tena bhāvābhāvayoḥ pratipāditayorbhāvāṃśasya prāptatvādabhāvāṃśaparatā vijñāyate, bhāvāṃśaḥ sthita eva | aprāptavibhāṣāyāmapi 'vibhāṣorṇoḥ' ityabhāvāṃśasya prāptatvād bhāvāṃśaparatā vijñāyate 'vibhāṣā śveḥ' ityatra tu yadi vidhimukhena vibhāṣā śrutiḥ pravartate, pitsveva saṃprasāraṇaṃ vibhāṣā syāt, kitsu tu yajāditvānnityameva syāt | atha pratiṣedhamukhena pravṛttistadā kitsvena vikalpaḥ syānna pitsu | na ca śakyaṃ vaktum--pitsu vidhimukhena pravarttate, kitsu pratiṣedhamukheneti; ekatvādvākyasya tasya cānyataravikalpa evopakṣīṇatvāt | saṃjñākaraṇe tu pūrvaṃ pratiṣedhe kitsu pravṛtte kidakidākhyo liṭ sarva eva samīkṛto bhavati; sarvasyāsamprasāraṇanimittatvāt | tato vikalpaḥ sarvatra vidhimukhena pakṣe samprasāraṇaṃ sampādayati | etacca--'ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravartate' iti darśane prayojanam | yadā tu pratilakṣyaṃ 'vibhāṣā śveḥ' ityasya vyāpāraḥ, tadā kvacidvidhimukhena kvicitapratiṣedhamukhena pravartata iti saṃjñākaraṇamantareṇāpīṣṭaṃ siddhyati | tatā ca 'hṛkroranyatarasyām' ityādāvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe vā grahaṇe cobhayatravibhāṣāsviṣṭasiddhaḥ | sūtrārambhe tu saṃjñāpyarthaḥ, vibhāṣetyarthaḥ | saṃjñā navārthayoriti vyākhyeyam | śuśāveti | śvayaterliṭi tipo ṇali samprasāraṇe vṛddhyāvādeśau ||
igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam || 1.1.45 ||
yaṇaḥ sthāna iti | kathaṃ punaranuvāde sthānasambandho labhyate ? 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityatrādhikārāt | bhūta iti | kāryāntarārthamanūdyamāno bhūtaḥ, vidheyastu bhāvatī, tatra ca saṃjñino bhāvitvāt saṃjñāpi bhavinyeva | yathā-asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti | 'vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti' tadbhavati yasya bhūtasya samprasāraṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti | iṣṭam, uptamiti | 'vacisvapi' ityādinā samprasāraṇam | gṛhītamiti | 'grahijyā' ityādinā | 'graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' |
kecidityādi | evaṃvadatāṃ bhāvinī saṃjñā nāśrayaṇīyā, sthāneyogaśca labhyate | 'igyaṇaḥ' ityatra bhavatītyadhyāhārātpūrvasūtrāccetikaraṇānuvṛtteryaṇaḥ, sthāne igbhavatīti yo'yaṃ vākyārtha ityartho labhyate | kathaṃ punararthadvayamekasya sūtrasya bhavati ? tantreṇa,āvṛttyā vā | asya ca liṅgaṃ vibhaktiviśeṣanirdeśaḥ | yadayaṃ 'ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityādau bhāvyamānavibhaktyā nirdeśāṃ karoti, tato jñāpayati--vākyārthaḥ saṃjñeti | na hi tatra varṇasya sambhavaḥ | 'samprasāraṇasya' ityādau tu bhūtavibhaktyā nirdeśāt jñāyate --varṇaḥ saṃjñīti | na hi tatra vākyārthaḥ sambhavati | tatretyādinā dvayorarthayorviṣayavibhāgenopasthānaṃ darśayati | aduhitarāmiti | duherlaṅi karmakarttari uttamaikavacane iṭi 'na duhasnunamām' iti yaki pratiṣiddhe śabluki aduhi iti sthite 'tiṅaśca' iti tarapi 'kimettiṅavyayaghād' ityām | tatra lakārasya yaṇaḥ sthāne iṅ‌vihita iti saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyām 'halaḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnotīti codyamapākaroti | saṅkhyātānudeśāditi | tarapa upanyāso'ṅgasaṃjñārthaḥ | saṅkhyāsāmyāt saṃkhyātānudeśe sati yakārasthānikasyekārasya saṃjñayā bhāvyam, ayaṃ tu lakārasthānikaḥ | dyubhyāmityatra 'diva ut' ityutve yaṇādeśe 'halaḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāptaṃtaparakaraṇānna bhavati | akṣadyūḥ, akṣadyuvau, akṣadyuva ityādāvūṭhaḥ saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyām 'saṃprasāraṇācca' iti pūrvarūpatvaṃ prāptam 'vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iti uvaṅā bādhyate ||
ādyantau ṭakito || 1.1.46 ||
atra dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ-saṃjñā syāt, paribhāṣā veti | tatra saṃjñāpakṣe'yamarthaḥ-ṭakitāviti karmadhārayaḥ, itsaṃjñakau ṭakārakakārau ādyantayauḥ saṃjñeti | tatreḍityatrādyarthena ṭakāreṇa bahuvrīhau ikārādiḥ śabdo gṛhīta ādeśo vidhīyamānastavyasya sthāne'ntaratama itavyo bhavatīti siddhamiṣṭam | evaṃ ṣukyantavacanena kakāreṇa bahuvrīhau ṣakārānto gṛhīta ādeśo bhiyo bhīṣ bhavatīti siddham |
nanvasminpakṣe saṃjñā saṃjñipratyāyanārthā, saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyya svayameva nivartiṣyata iti kimid‌grahaṇena, ṭakāvityevāstu ? ucyate; itsaṃjñakatvena deśaviśeṣo lakṣyate, tenetsaṃjñakasya yo deśastaddeśāvasthitau ṭakau saṃjñe bhavata iti ālajāṭacau 'ṭhasyekaḥ' ityādau ṭakau saṃjñe na bhavataḥ | asminpakṣe doṣaḥ, 'luṅ‌laṅ‌lṛṅ‌kṣvaḍudāttaḥ' ityaḍityakārāderādeśasya vidhānāttasyaivodāttatvamalo'ntyasya syād, nākārasya ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'aḍudāttaḥ' iti tripado bahuvrīhiḥ-udātto'kāra ādirasyeti | viśeṣaṇasyāpyudāttasya sautraḥ parinipātaḥ | evamapi --'āḍajādīnām' ityatrodāttagrahaṇamevānuvarttata iti bahuvrīherasambhavāddoṣaḥ, tasmātparibhāṣāpakṣamāśrityāha-'ādiṣṭidbhavatīti | pareṇa paribhāṣāprakaraṇena sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā-'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityatredamanuvartyam, ata evāha-ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭasyeti | tena 'careṣṭaḥ','āto'nupasarge kaḥ' ityādayaḥ pratyayā ādyantabhūtā na bhavanti | evamapi 'gāpoṣṭak' 'vrīhiśālyorḍhak' ityatra prasaṅgaḥ, tatra ṭakaṣṭittvakittvayoge paratvādantyaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'purastādapavādā anantarānvidhīn bādhante na parān' iti | evamayaṃ sthāneyogaṃ bādhate, na pratyayaparatvam | bhīṣayata iti | 'ñibhī bhaye', ṇic | 'bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk' 'bhīsmyorhetubhaye' ||
midaco'ntyāt paraḥ || 1.1.47 ||
'acaḥ' iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, jātāvekavacanamityāha--acāmityādi | atrāpi jātau bahuvacanam | yadi punarantyādityānayā samānādhikaraṇā pañcamī syāt, tato haranteṣvasyāḥ pravṛttirna syāt | tataśca 'nupaṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti numihaivāntyātparaḥ syāt kuṇḍānīti, yaśāṃsītyatra tvalo'ntyasya syāt; evaṃ 'śe mucādīnām' ityādau | tataśca teṣu mittvamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | samānajātīyasyaiva nirddhāraṇaṃ bhavatītyantyo'pyajeva vijñāyata ityāha-antyādacaḥ para iti | purastādapavādanyāyena sthāneyogatvasyaivāyamapavādo yukta ityā śaṅkyāha--rathāneyogapratyayaparatvasyāpavāda iti | sthāneyogaśca pratyayaparatvaṃ ceti samāhāre dvandvaḥ | 'tṛṇahaḥ 'iti nirdeśāt śnamo makāro na śravaṇārthaḥ, ato mitkaraṇasāmarthyāt pratyayaparatvasyāpyayamapavādau yukta iti bhāvaḥ | masjerityādi | 'masjinaśorjhali' taiti num yadyantyādacaḥ paraḥ syāt tato niṣṭhāyāṃ man‌s‌ja iti sthite 'skossaṃyogādyorante ca ' iti salopo na syāt | vahūnāṃ samudāye samudāyasyaikā saṃyogasaṃjñā na dvayordvayorityasmin pakṣe satyapi vā salope tasyāsiddhatvādanupadhānakāra iti 'aniditām' ityanuṣaṅgalopo na syāt | nakārasyopadhāyāḥ ' anuṣaṅgaḥ' iti pūrvācāryāṇāṃ saṃjñā | tasmājjakārātpūrvo num karttavya ityarthaḥ |
magna iti | 'oditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam, tasyāsiddhatvātkutvam | atra 'ādyantau ṭakitau' ityataḥ 'anta' ityanuvṛttau pūrvasya saṅghātasya midantāvayavo bhavati | 'ādi' ityanuvṛttau tatra sannihitasya parasyādirbhavati | athobhayaṃ nivṛttaṃ tato'bhakta iti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ | tatrābhakte--tātā piṇḍānāmiti nalopo na syāt | tacchabdāt 'jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' tāni 'śeśchandasi bahulam' iti śerluk | vahaṃlihaḥ, arbhralihaḥ-'vahābhre lihaḥ' iti khaśi 'arurdviṣadajantasya muma' iti mum | asyāpadāntatvādanusvāro na syāt | trapuṇī ityatra paratvānnityatvācca numi kṛte tena vyavadhānādauṅaḥ śībhāvo na syāt | atha parādiḥ-trapuṇe, 'gherṅiti' iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, atisakhīni-'sakhyurasambuddhau' iti ṇidvadbhāve 'aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti | trapuṇi, 'acca gheḥ', śucīni, 'nopadhāyāḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti | tātā piṇḍānāmiti nalopaḥ vahaṃliha ityanusvāraḥ | tasmātpūrvānta evāyaṃ mideṣitavyaḥ ||
eca igghrasvādeśe || 1.1.48 ||
paribhāṣeyaṃ sthāniniyamārthā | 'hrasvo napuṃsake' ityādāvavupatiṣṭhate | ihaicāṃ pūrvo bhāgo mātrātmakaḥ kaṇṭhyo'kārasadṛśāḥ | edaitoruttarastālabya ikārasadṛśaḥ | odautoroṣṭhya ukārasadṛśaḥ | evamavayavasamāhārātmanāmecāṃ hrasvaśāsaneṣu samudāyāntaratamasyābhāvād avayavāntaratamo hrasvo bhavan kadācidakāraḥ syāt, kadācidikārokārau; mā kadācidakāro bhūdityevamarthamidamārabhyate, tadāha--igeva hrasvo bhavatīti | yadi tvayaṃ vidhiḥ syāt, tadā hrasvādeśa iti viṣayopalakṣaṇametatsyād--yasminviṣaya eco hrasvādeśaprasaṅgasta tregbhavatīti | tataśca dīrghāṇāṃ sthāne dīrdhā evakaḥ syuḥ savarṇagrahaṇāt, naiṣadoṣaḥ;'bhāvyamāno'ṇ sarvarṇānna gṛhṇāti' 'bhāvyamāno'pyakāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti' 'diva ut' ititaparakaraṇād amūbhyāmitivat; tathaicāmikāṃ ca sāmyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo'pi syād, ādeśagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt | tata ādeśagrahaṇasāmarthyād hrasvādeśe hrasvadeśanakāla ikkartavyaḥ, hrasvādeśaṃ kurvannikaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | yadvā -ādiśyata ityādeśaḥ, hrakvaścāsāvādeśaśca hrasvādeśaḥ | nirddhāraṇe saptamī, jātāvekavacanam | ādiśyamāneṣu hrasveṣu madhye igeva hrasvo bhavatīti sarvathā niyamarūpeṇāsya pravṛttiḥ | prāptipūrvakaśca niyama iti ye prāptā antaratamāsteṣveva niyamaḥ | na ca ṛkāralṛkārau prāptāviti kuto yathāsaṅkhyam ? kuto dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ ceṇityeva siddhe iggrahaṇaṃ pareṇa mā bhūditi | atiri | atinu | rāyamatikrāntaṃ nāvamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti pradisamāse napuṃsakahrasvatvam | upagviti | avyayībhāvaḥ | raiśabdaśchandasyeveti bhāṣyam | ekārasyāprasiddhatvādudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam | heśabdamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamatihi | atikhaṭva iti | upasarjanahrasvaḥ | deśvadetteti | āmantritādyudāttatvam | devada3tta | 'guroranṛta' ityādinā plutaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā | yoganiyamārtheti | yadyapi ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogaivetyasyāṃ vacanavyaktau yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti ṣaṣṭhīniyamaḥ śrutyā pratīyate tathāpi sthānanimittaka eva sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vācya ityarthātsambandhaniyamo'pi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yoge vā niyamo yoganiyamaḥ | yadi yoganiyamaḥ kriyate loke'pi niyamaḥ prāpnoti, avayavaṣaṣṭhyādayaśca na siddhyanti; tataśca 'śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' śāseścāntyasya syādupadhāmātrasya ca, 'ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ' goheścāntyasya syād upadhāmātrasya ca, tatrāha-iha śāstre yā ṣaṣṭhyaniyatayogeti | etena śāstre'yaṃ niyamaḥ, śāstrāṅgatvātparibhāṣāṇām; tatrāpyaniyamaprasaṅga iti darśayati | aniyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ karttavyo lokavat, tadyathā-loke grāmāntaraṃ jigamiṣuḥ kaścitkañcidāha-'panthānaṃ me bhavānupadiśatu' iti, sa yatra saṃdehaḥ, pathi dvaividhyāt, tatraivopadiśati-'amuṣminnavakāśe'nena pathā gaccha' iti; evamihāpi 'asterbhūḥ' asteḥ sthāne'nantaro veti saṃdehe niyamaḥ kriyate - sthāneyogaiveti | etadeva spaṣṭayati-sthāneyogasya nimittabhūta iti | nimittabhūte, nimittatvaṃ prāpte | nimittagrahaṇaṃ kurvan 'sthāne' iti nimittasaptamīti darśayati | sthānaśabdo'yamastyapakarṣavacanaḥ-gosthāne'śvo badhyatāmiti, asti ca nivṛttivacanaḥ-śleṣmaṇaḥ sthāne kaṭukamauṣadhamiti, asti ca prasaṅgavacanaḥ--darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śaraiḥ prastaritavyamiti, tadiha caramasya grahaṇamityāha--sthānaśabdaśceti | caśabdo'vadhāraṇe bhinnakramaśca vācītyasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | prasaṅgavācyeveti kathamivetyāha--yatheti | nivṛttivācī na gṛhyate, asterupadeśasāmarthyāt | na hyārdhadhātuke nivarttitasya sārvadhātuke śravaṇamupapadyate, na hi mathurāyāṃ vyāpāditaḥ srughne jīvati | nāpyapakarṣavacanaḥ, na hyarthena nityasambaddhasya tato'pakarṣaḥ sambhavati | nāpyārddhadhātukādapakarṣaḥ, na hi nitye prakṛtipratyayasamudāye prakṛterapakarṣaḥ sambhavati | svābhāvika eva hyasteraprayoga ārddhadhātuke bhūśabda sya ca prayogo'nena prakāreṇānvākhyāyate, ataḥ prasaṅgaḥ eva sthānam | prasaṅgaḥ prāptiḥ, asteḥ prāptau bhūḥ prayoktavya ityarthaḥ | astinārthaṃ pratipādayitumudyukta ārddhadhātuke viṣaye bhavatinā pratipādayediti yāvat | prasaṅgasambandhasyetyādinā sūtrārthamudrāharaṇe darśayati | bruva ityupalakṣaṇam |
kiṃ punarbahavaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthā yata idamucyata ityata āha --bahavo hīti | ekaśataṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthāḥ tatra svasvāmibhāvādayaḥ śabde na sambhavanti, samīpādaya eva tu sambhavantītyato yāvantaḥ śabde sambhavantītyuktam | vyavahitamapi samīpaṃ bhavatītyanantarādbhedenopādānam | sthāneyogetyasamāsaśced yogeti strīliṃgaṃ ṣaṣṭhīśabdena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannam | samāse'pi tatpuruṣaścet tau ca pūrvoktadoṣau, saptamyā lukprasaṅgaśca, bahuvrīhāvapi lukprasaṅgo'nivārya evetyata āha--ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogetyādi |
yadvā--ayogeti padacchedaḥ | na vidyate yogo yasyāḥ sā'yogā | tatra yogaḥ mantareṇa ṣaṣṭhyā evābhāvād viśiṣṭo yogo yasyā nāstītyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvāsaṃdeha evopasthānamityevaṃ sarvatra siddhaṃ bhavati | atha vā - yogavatī yogā, ṣaṣṭhyāścāvaśyambhāvī yoga iti sāmarthyād bhūmni matvarthīyo'kāraḥ, bahavo yogā yasyāḥ santīti | asminnapi pakṣe sandehaviṣaya upasthānamiti siddham |
bhāṣye sūtraṃ pratyākhyātam, katham ? 'asterbhūḥ' ityatra sandehaḥ --sthāne'nantaraḥ, samīpa iti ? lakṣyānurodhāt sthāna iti vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | idaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ yathā sthānena yujyeta; ataḥ ṣaṣṭhyuccāritā | tena 'nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' iti siddhaṃ bhavatīti | tatra sūtre ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ gṛhyate--ṣaṣṭhyantameva nirddiśyamānaṃ sthānena yujyate, na tu pratīyamānamiti | tena 'pādaḥ pat' ityasyāyamarthaḥ--pādantasyāṅgasya yo|vayavaḥ pācchabdaḥ sūtre ṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭaḥ, tasya pacchabda ādeśaḥ, na tu pratīyamānasya tadantasyeti ||
sthāne'ntaratamaḥ || 1.1.50 ||
yadyayaṃ svatantro vidhiḥ syād, atrāpi prāpnoti - daghi, maghu | astu; na kaścidanya ādeśaḥ pratinirddiśyate, tatrāntaryataḥ sa eva tasya bhaviṣyati, na; tasyāpyanya ityanavasthāprasaṅgāt | prayojanamantareṇa hi pravarttamānamasakṛdapi pravarttate | tataśca sarvasya nivṛttyunmukhatvādarthapratyāyanāya prayogo na syāt | api ca bisaṃ musalamityādau yadā samudāyasya samudāyastadā sakāramātrasyānādeśatvāt ṣatvāprasaṅge'pi sakāramātrasya sakāra iti ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti | ataḥ paribhāṣāprakaraṇāt paribhāṣeyaṃ yatra sthānaṣaṣṭhī tatropatiṣṭhate | tena vidhivākyānāmanena sūtreṇaikavākyatvād vidhānakāla evāntaratama ādeśo vidhīyata ityāha--sthāne prāpyamāṇānāmiti | atraivaśabdāprayogāt prāpyamāṇānāmiti vacanacca viśiṣṭavidhirevāyam, na niyamaḥ | arthāttvanantaratamavyudāsa iti darśitaṃ bhavati | antaratama ityasyārthamāha--sadṛśatama iti | kutaśceti | śabdatvasya sādhāraṇatvāt prāpatisvikaviśeṣasya cāsādhāraṇatvāt praśnaḥ | vataṇḍī cāsau yuvatiriti | vigrahavākyam, itaradudāharaṇam | atra vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī 'vataṇḍācca' 'luk striyām' iti yaño luk, śārṅgaravādipāṭhānṅīn | 'poṭāyuvati' iti samāse sati puṃvatkarmadhārayeti puṃśabdo nirddiśyamāno vataṇḍāpatyavācino vataṇḍaśabdasyatadapatyavācī vātaṇḍyaśabdo bhavati | cakārasyetyādi | alpaprāṇatvādikaṃ savarṇasaṃjñāyāmuktam | amuṣmai, amūbhyāmiti | adasaścaturthyekavacane tyadādyatvam, 'sarvanāmnaḥ smai', bhyāmi'supi ca' iti dīrghatvam |
sthāna iti vartamāna iti | pūrvasūtrād | yadyapi tatra samastam, tathāpi svaritatvānuṣaṅgādanuvṛttiriviruddhā | punaḥ sthānegrahaṇamiti | prakṛtena hi sthānaśabdena sthāne prāpyamāṇānāmityayamartho labhyate, ayaṃ tu tālvādisthānavacano vākyabhedena sambadhyate, sthānai'ntaratamo bhavati | yatrānekamāntarthaṃ tatra sthānakṛtāntarthamāśrīyata iti vākyabhedasya ca tamabgrahaṇaṃ liṅgam | sthānakṛta eva hi sādṛśye gṛhyamāṇe sādṛśyāntaraparityāgāt tamabgrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva syāt | tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti | sumadṛśyavyavahāradarśanāt tamabgrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | soṣmaṇaḥ, soṣmāṇa ityādi | ūṣmaśabdo'tra guṇamātravacanaḥ | itikaraṇo hetau | yasmādūṣmaguṇayuktāḥ, tasmādūṣmaguṇayuktasya hakārasya dvitīyāḥ prasaktā ityarthaḥ | 'śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ sasthānena dvitīyā hakāreṇa caturthāḥ' iti śikṣā | atroṣmaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ, sasthāneneti itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | haśaṣasāḥ khacchādīnāṃ dvitīyānāṃ sthānā yathā te ūṣmāṇa evaṃ dvitīyā apītyarthaḥ | phakārasya sasthāna ūṣmā nāsti, tasmāttasya viśeṣata ūṣmatvaṃ vaktavyam | hakāreṇa caturthā iti, yathāhakāra ūṣmā evaṃ te'pītyarthaḥ | evaṃ nādavato nādavanta itītyatrāpi hetvartho yojyaḥ | iha iṣṭam, uptam--āntaryato'rddhamātrasya vyañjanasyārddhamātrek saṃprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti; iha ca dadhyatra, kumāryatra, brahmabandhvartham--mātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikāṇāmikāṃ mātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikā yaṇaḥ prāpnuvantyāntaryataḥ | naiva loke vede'rddhamātra igasti, nāpi mātriko dvimātriko vā yaṇ, yo'sti sa bhaviṣyati | ihāntaratamaśabdaḥ saptamyanto'pi paṭhito bhāṣye | 'sthāne'ntaratama uraṇ raparaḥ' iti saṃhitāpāṭho'nityaḥ' tatra padacchede saptamyantamapi sambhavati | tatra cāyamarthaḥ-ṣaṣṭhīti varttate,antaratamo ya ādeśasya sthānī, tatra ṣaṣṭhī, tasyādeśa iti 'akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' ityādau vidhīyamānasya dīrghasyāntaratame sthāninyaka iti ṣaṣṭhyopasaṃhārāt siddhamiṣṭham | tathā 'vānto yi pratyaye' ityatraiva ityanuvṛttāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vāntādeśasyāntaratamayorodautorupasaṃhārāt siddham, itarathaijmātrasya vāntādeśaḥ syāt | atra yakṣe doṣaḥ -'iko yaṇaci' iti yaṇo ye'ntaramā ikastatra ṣaṣṭhīti dadhyatretyādāveva syāt, kumārthatretyādau na syāt | tathā 'iko guṇavṛddhī' guṇavṛddhyorye'ntaratamā ikastatra ṣaṣṭhīti ihaiva syād-netā, lavitā, nāyakaḥ, lāvakaḥ; cetā, stotā, cāyakaḥ, tāvaka ityatra na syāt | evaṃ doṣavattvādasya pakṣasya yathāvyākhyātameva sādhīyaḥ | 'vānto yi pratyaye' ityatra parihāraṃ vakṣyati ||
uraṇ raparaḥ || 1.1.51 ||
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti--'uḥ sthāne raparo'ṇ bhavatītyanena raparatvaviśiṣṭo'ṇ bhāvyate' iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | 'uḥ sthāne'ṇeva bhavati,sa ca rapara iti aṇanaṇprasaṅge'ṇ niyamyate, tasya ca rapatvaṃ vidhīyate' iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | 'ya uḥ sthāne'ṇvidhīyate ityanūdya tasya prasaṅgāvasthāyāmeva rapatvamātraṃ vidhīyate' iti caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ | tatra prathamapakṣe--nāprāpteṣūdāttādiṣu vidhīyamāno'ṇ teṣāṃ bādhakaḥ syāt, tairanavaruddhasya viṣayasyābhāvāt | evaṃ hi tadā vacanavyaktiḥ, ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭamātrasyābhāvānnādeśo'ntaratamo bhavati, ṛvarṇasya tvaṇ rapara iti, tataśca kṛtirityatra 'ñnityādirnityam' iti prāptamṛkāraṃ bādhitvāṇ raparaḥ syāt; prakṛtamiti śeṣanighātaḥ svaritaśca, nṛm̐ḥ pāhīti pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvamanunāsikaṃ ca bādhitvāṇ raparaḥ syāt, karttā, kāraka iti ca guṇavṛddhī bādhitvā'ṇ bhavannakāra eveti niyamābhāvādikārokārāvapi raparau syātām; ye cāmī prātipadamuḥ sthāna ādeśāḥ 'ṝta iddhātoḥ' ityādayaḥ-teṣu raparatvaṃ na syāt |
dvitīye tu kāmaṃ guṇavṛddhyordoṣo na syāt | tathā hi -- 'sarveṣu guṇavṛddhisaṃjñakeṣu prāpteṣu aṇeva bhavati' iti niyamādakārākārāveva guṇavṛddhī rapare bhavata iti siddhaṃ karttetyādi, śāstrāntareṇa yo'ṇ prasaktaḥ sa eva niyamādapi bhavatītīkārokārāvapi na prāpnutaḥ | nanu 'anuyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ' iti vṛddhāveva syād, asti tatrāniyamaprasaṅga iti kṛtvā; guṇastu karttetyādau mātrikasya mātriko'kāra eva prāpnoti;taritetyādau dvimātrasya dvimātra eva bhaved, aṇeveti tra niyamābhāvāt taritetyādāveṅeva guṇaḥ syāt; karttetyādau tu yadyapyakāra eva guṇo labhyate, tasya rapatvaṃ tu na labhyate, yo hyaṇanaṇprasaṅge'ṇeveti bhavatīti niyamato yo'ṇ tasyaiva raparatvaṃ vihitam; ato nimayamapakṣe'pi guṇaviṣaye doṣastadavastha eva ? ucyate, dve ete paribhāṣe ādeśaniyamārthe--'sthāne'ntaramaḥ' iti ca 'uraṇ raparaḥ' iti ca | tatra pūrvasyā avakāśaḥ 'cajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ' ityādi, asyā avakāśo yatrāntaratamye viśeṣo nāsti, yathā tāraka ityādau, vṛddhīnāṃ karttā tāritetyādau | guṇo bhavatītyukte sarveṣu guṇeṣu prāpteṣu 'sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' iti niyamo'stu, 'uraṇ raparaḥ' iti vā paratvāt 'uraṇraparaḥ' ityayameva bhaviṣyati | ataḥ suṣṭhūktam-'niyamapakṣe guṇaviṣaye na kaściddoṣaḥ' iti | kintūdāttādiṣu doṣastadavastha eva syāt,tathā hi-kṛtirityādāvudātto bhavatītyukte sarveṣadāttasaṃjñakeṣu prāpteṣu paratvādanenāṇa evodāttāḥ syuḥ te ca raparāḥ | evamanudāttādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam | ye ca pratipadāmādeśāḥ 'ṛta iddhātoḥ' ityevamādayaḥ, teṣvaniyamaprasaṅgābhāvādasti niyame rapatvaṃ na syāt, tadāha--'uraṇ raparavacanamanyanivṛttyarthaṃ cedudāttādiṣu doṣaḥ' iti |
tṛtīya pakṣe udāttādiṣu na doṣaḥ; ñnityādibhirantaratamasyaiva vidhānāt | kiratītyādau ca na dauṣaḥ | guṇavṛddhyoruktadoṣaḥ syādeva, tathā hi--vihitasya paścādanena raparatvaṃ vidhīyate, vidhānakāle tvāntaryato mātrikasya; mātrike guṇe rapare karttetyādi yadyapi sidhyati, taritetyādau tveṅeva guṇaḥ syād; vṛddhiṣu ca vidhānasamaye kasyāścidāntaryābhāvāt tisṛṣu pravṛttāsvākārasyāṇtvāt raparatve kārakastāraka iti yadyapi siddhati, vāyakastāvaka ityadyaniṣṭamanusajyata eva | ata evameteṣu pakṣeṣu doṣasadbhāvāccaturthaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--
uḥ sthāne'ṇprasajyamāna evetyādi | etacca sthānadvayagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate | tatraikamuḥ sthāne yo'ṇ vidhīyata ityanuvāde'pi sthānasambandhalābhāya | dvitīyaṃ tu so'ṇ prasaṅga eva prasajyamānāvasthāyāmeva raparo bhavatīti raparatvasya kālavidhānārtham | 'sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' ityatra hi yadyapi tālvādivacanaḥ sthānaśabdaḥ, tathāpi na tenātra kaścidartho'stīti prasaṅgavacana eveha sampadyate | evaṃ ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptyavasthāyāmevāṇo parapāḥ sampannā iti pramāṇato'ntaratamāveṅaicau bādhitvā sthānato'ntaratama eva bhaviṣyatīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | na cānekāltvātsarvādeśaprasaṅgaḥ; ānupūrvyā siddheḥ | yadāṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhī antye'lyanusaṃhṛtā tadāyamuḥ sthāne, yadāyamuḥ sthāne tadā raparaḥ, yadā raparastadānekāliti na punaḥ parāvṛttya sarvādeśo yujyate |
dvaimātura iti | 'māturutsaṅkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' | kheyamiti | 'ī ca khanaḥ' | saudhātakiriti | 'sudhāturakaṅ ca ' | atrāyamakaṅādeśo'naṇtvādraparo na bhavati | atha yo'trāṇ sa paraḥ kasmānna bhavati ? anādeśatvāt, samudāyo hyatrādeśaḥ | yadyevam, khaṭvaśrya ityādāvapi raparatvaṃ na syāt, pūrvaparayorhi samudāyo'tra sthānī nāvayava ṛkāraḥ, ucyate; pūrvaparayoriti dvivacananirddiśāttayoreva sthānitvaṃ na samudāyasya, anurdeśāt | ata eva dvayoḥ sthāninorbhinnādiṣu natvavat dvāvādeśau sāyātām iti tatraikagrahaṇaṃ kriyate | tata ṛkārasyāpi sthānitvamastyeva | tadidamucyate-'yo hyubhayoḥ sthāne bhavati labhate so'nyatarabyapadeśam' iti | atastatrāpi raparatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
alo'ntyasya || 1.1.52 ||
'alaḥ' iti jasantaṃ cedayamarthaḥ syāt-alātmakā ādeśā antyasyeti | tatra rahorajasāṃ lopaḥ sarvādeśaḥ syād--nīrajīkarotīti | antyasya caviśeṣitatvāt 'vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ' iti datvaṃ padasyāpyantyasya syāt--paramānaḍudbhyāmiti | asandehārthaṃ cālo'ntyasyeti vācyaṃ syād | ato'lontyasyetyanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ṣaṣṭhyantamiti sthitam | yadi 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityenaikavākyatā'sya syāt, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--'iha śāstre yā kācana ṣaṣṭhī sāntyasyālo bhavati sā sthāneyogā iti | tataśca 'ārddhadhātukasyeḍ‌valādeḥ' ityasyāpyante'lyanusaṃhārādārddhadhātukāntyasyaiveṭ syāt, sa ca bhavan 'ādyantau ṭakitau' ityantyātprāk syāt | 'ādyantau ṭakitau' ityanena hi sthāneyogātvameva ṣaṣṭhyā bādhyate, na punarantye'lyanusaṃhāro'pi | ato bhinnaṃ vākyam, tadāha--ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyetyādi | sāmānyavacane'pi 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityādhikārāt sthāna ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyeti veditavyam; anyathā ṣaṣṭhīmātrasyādhikāre yasya ṣaṣṭhonirdiṣṭasya yatkāryaṃ yathābhūtamucyate--ādeśarūpam, taāthagamarūpaṃ vā, tattathābhūtameva tadantasya bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | tataśca sa eva doṣo ya ekavākyatāyām | ataḥ 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti sarvamanuvarttyam | ayañcārtho bhavati--'sthānaṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya yaducyate tattadantyasyālo bhavati, na tasya kṛtsnasya' iti | so'yaṃ kāryasyāntye'lyanusaṃhāro vṛttikāreṇa darśitaḥ |
yadvā-'yā sthāneyogā ṣaṣṭhī sā'ntyasyālaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyā evānusaṃhāro veditavyaḥ | atra pakṣe 'ḍicca' ityasyāyamarthaḥ -'yatra ṅidādeśo vidhīyate tatra yā ṣaṣṭhī sāntyasyālaḥ' iti | evaṃ sarvatra | kāryānusaṃhāre tu yatāśrutameva ṣaṣṭhyāḥ syād, anusaṃhāre 'ḍicca' ityādāvasaṅgatiḥ | ataḥ kāryānusaṃhāro vṛttikāreṇa darśitaḥ ||
ṅicca || 1.1.53 ||
hotāpotārāviti | 'ṛto ṅisarvānāmasthānoyaḥ'iti guṇaḥ | 'aptṛn' ityādinā dīrghaḥ | mātāpitarāviti | 'pitāmātrā' ityekaśeṣābhāvapakṣe'bhyarhitatvānmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ; 'piturdaśaguṇaṃ mātā gauraveṇātiricyate'| atha tātaṅantyasya kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha--tātaṅītyādi | ananyārthaṅittveṣvanaṅādiṣu caritārthametad guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatayā caritārthaṅittve tātaṅi pareṇa 'anekālśitsarvasya' ityanena bādhyata ityarthaḥ | nanūtsargāpavādayorayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ, atulyakakṣatvāt, na cāntareṇa sarvādeśatāṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvasyonmeṣa eti caritārthatvamapi ṅittvasya cintyam ? na brūmo guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthasya niścitatvād durbalaṃ ṅittvamiti; ki tu sarvādeśe'pi tātaṅi guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ prayojanaṃ sambhāvyate | tāvatā ca kiyānapi vilambo bhavati | anaṅādiṣu sarvādeśatve na kiñcin ṅittvasya prayojanamiti sarvādeśārthatāsambhāvanāpi nāstīti | teṣveva sahasā pravarttate | tataśca tripratiṣedhopapattiḥ |
atha vā - 'eruḥ' ityasyānantaram 'tuhyostātaṅāśiṣi' iti vaktavyam, erityeva | evaṃ vaktavye ṅitkaraṇaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthameveti niścitamiti vipratiṣedhopapattistadāha--tātaṅi ṅitkaraṇasya sāvakāśatvādvipratiṣedhātsarvādeśa iti |
atha vā - yathopadarśitaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvaṃ sarvādeśatāmantareṇa nopapadyata iti antareṇaiva vipratiṣedhaṃ sarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati ||
ādeḥ parasya || 1.1.54 ||
śāstre na kvacitparasyetyuccāryya kāryaṃ vidhīyata iti nirviṣayametadityabhiprāyeṇāha--kva ceti | yatretyādi | pañcamīnirdeśeṣu 'tasmādityuttarasya' iti parasya kāryaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ | āsīna iti | 'āsa upaveśane' anudāttet | dvīpamiti | dvidhāgatā āpo|sminniti 'ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' iti akāraḥ samāsāntaḥ ||
anekālśitsarvasya || 1.1.55 ||
anekālagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? 'asterbhūḥ' sarvasya yathā syāt, alo'ntyasya mā bhūt; naitadasti prayojanam; 'ṅicca' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--'yadyanekālantyasya bhavati, ṅideva' iti | evamapyasatyanekāl‌grahaṇe 'ato bhisa ais' ityādiṣu pañcamīnirdeśeṣvanekālapyādeśa ādeḥ parasya syāt, sati tu tasmin dvāvetau 'alo'ntyasya' ityasyāpavādau--'ādeḥ parasya','anekāl‌śitsarvasya' iti; tatra 'ādeḥ parasya' ityasyāyamavakāśo ya ekāladeśo lopo vā--'ī dāsaḥ' 'bahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ' āsīnaḥ, bhūyān ; 'anekālśitsarvasya' ityasyāvakāśo yatra pañcamīnirdeśo nāsti-'asterbhūḥ' | ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti-'ato bhisa ais', apavādavipratiṣedhādanekālśitsarvasyetyayameva bhavatīti siddhamiṣṭam |
śid‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham ? 'jasaḥ śī' sarvasya yathā syāt, anekālityeva bhaviṣyati, śakāre lupte nānekāl, ānupūrvyātsiddham | yadāyaṃ sarvādeśastadā pratyayaḥ, yadā pratyayastadetsaṃjñā, yadetsaṃjñā tadālopaḥ, yadālopastadaikāl tadiha sarvādeśatvamantareṇa naikāltvamupapadyate | iha tarhi 'idama iś' 'idaṃ kimorīśkīḥ' ? atra hyantareṇāpi sarvādeśatāṃ pragevetsaṃjñā bhavati | nanvatrāpi śakāraḥ prayojanāntarābhāvād anekāltvamādeśasya saṃpādya nivarttiṣyate | iha tarhi 'ghvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca' iti ? lopaḥ śitsarvasya yathā syāt | 'idam iś' ityādāvapi prayojanābhāvaditsaṃjñaiva śakārasya na syāditi śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ||
sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau || 1.1.56 ||
nanu tatsthānāpannasya taddharmalābho lokavedayoḥ siddha eva | loke tāvadekasminnupādhyāye mṛte tatsthānaniviṣṭasyāpyabivādanādyupādhyāyadharmalābho bhavati, ekasmiṃśca rājani proṣite tatsthāne'bhiṣiktasya tatputrāderapi taddharmalābho bhavati | vede'pi vrīhisthānapatitā vīvārādayo'vaghātādīn vrīhidharmān labhante | tadvadatrāpyastisthānāpanno bhūrastidharmān dhātutvādīn lapsyate, nārtho'nenetyāśaṅkyāha--sthānyādeśayorityādi |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--upādhyāyatvaprayuktā upādyāyadharmā rājadharmāścābhiṣiktatvaprayuktā vrīhidharmācāpūrvasādhanatvanibandhanāḥ, na tattatsvarūpanibandhanā iti yuktaṃ tatprakārajuṣo bhavantīti | iha tu svaṃ rūpamitivacanādastyādisvarūpanibandhanā dhātutvādayo dharmā na bhavanādyarthābhidhānalakṣaṇakāryaprayuktāḥ, tacca svarūpamādeśānāṃ nāstīti tatsthānāpannānāmapi na syuriti tadāha--pṛthaktvāditi | rūpabhedādityarthaḥ |
nanvetatprakārajuṣo'pi tatsthānāpannasya taddharmalābho dṛṣṭate, yadā hyupādhyāyaḥ śiṣyeṇa yajñārthamupanimantritaḥ kāryavyāsaṅgāt svaśiṣyamanyaṃ prerayati tadā sa tatra gatvā'grāsanādīnupādhyāyadharmān labhate, atrāpyupādhyāyapratinidhitvāt tad‌buddhyaiva taddharmā anuṣṭhīyante; evaṃ kṛte tu satyupādhyāya iti na tatsthānāpannatayā, na caivamatra saṃbhavatītyārabdhavyameva sūtram | yuṣmadasmadorādeśaniṣedhātsiddham | yadayaṃ 'yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' ityāha, taj jñāpayati-'bhavati sthānikṛtamādeśaḥ' iti; alāśraye cāprasaṅgaḥ, 'ado jagdhiḥ' lyabgrahaṇāt | yadi hi sthānyalāśrayamapyādeśe syāt kitītyeva siddhe lyabgrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt, satyam; 'uttarārthaṃ tāvat sthānivadādeśa iti vaktavyam | ajādeśasya viṣayaviśeṣe sthānivattvaṃ vakṣyāmi, padāntādividhiṣu pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyāmi' iti | so'nyārthaḥ sannihaiva kriyate liṅgānāśrayaṇāya |
ṣoḍhātideśaḥ-nimittātideśaḥ, vyapadeśātideśaḥ, śāstrātideśaḥ, rūpātideśaḥ, tādātmyātideśaḥ, kāryātideśa iti | tatra nimittamaśakyamatideṣṭuṃ brāhmaṇyavat, na hi brāhmaṇasyāgrabhojanādinimittaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vacanaśatenāpi kṣatriye'tideṣṭuṃ śakyate | 'pūrvavatsanaḥ' ityatrāpi na prakṛtigataṃ nimittaṃ ṅitvādi sanante'tidiśyate, kintu prakṛtigatameva tat sanā vyavadhāne'pyātmanepadanimittamiti | etāvatā nimittātideśavāco'yuktiḥ |
vyapadeśātideśaḥ saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate, tatra ca vaterānarthakyaṃ vakṣyate, kaḥ punarāyuṣmato vyapadeśo'bhipretaḥ ? kiṃ sthānīti vyapadeśaḥ, yathā 'ādyantavadekasmin'ityatra vyapadeśātideśapakṣaḥ ? uta sthānino ye vyapadeśā dhāturaṅgamityādayaḥ, ta ādeśasya bhavanti ? iti | pūrvaḥ pakṣo bhavato'pyanabhipretaḥ, dvitīyasya tu saṃjñāpakṣānmahān bhedaḥ | tathāhi --saṃjñāpakṣe yatra sthānirūpamuccāryyate 'āṅo yamahanaḥ ' ityādau, tatraiva kāryaṃ syād, na dhātostavyādayo'hgasyenādaya ityādau; na hyatra saṃjñātvena viniyuktamastyādi sthānirūpamuccāritam; yaccoccāritaṃ na sā saṃjñā, taādeśasyaiva kāryaṃ syād na sthāninaḥ, na hi saṃjñoccāritā svayaṃ kāryeṇa yujyate, sthāninastu vyapadeśa ādeśastayātidiśyamāne dhātostavyādayo'ṅgasyenādaya ityādau sthānyādeśayorubhayorapi kāryaṃ siddhyati; ubhayorapi vyapadeśasadbhāvāt | 'āṅo yamahanaḥ' ityādikaṃ tu sthānisvarūpanibandhanaṃ kāryamādeśasya na syāt,na hyatra kāścid‌vyapadeśo ya ādeśasyātidiśyeta | athāpi 'svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanāddhannityapi hantervyapadeśa iti tasminnatidiṣṭe kāryaṃ sidhyatītyucyate; evamapi pūrvoktastāvadviśeṣo vidyata ityāstāmetat |
apradhānatvāttu vyapadeśo na bhavati | ata eva śāstrātideśo'pi na bhavati | sthānirūpe cā'tidiśyamāna ādeśavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | na ca vacanadvayaprāmāṇyādvikalpaḥ, 'vā liṭi' iti vikalpāraṃbhāt | tādātmyātideśo'saṃbhavānna bhavati, dvayorhi sahāvasthitayoranyo'nyatādātmyamatidiśyate, subāmantritayoriva, iha tvādeśena sthānī nivarttita ityasaṃbhavaḥ | ataḥ pāriśeṣyātprādhānyācca kāryātideśo'yam, tadāha-sthānyāśrayakāryamiti, sthānyāśrayeṣu kāryeṣviti ca | tātparyataścāyaṃ kāryātideśo varṇyate | akṣarāṇi tvādeśaḥ sthāninā tulyaṃ varttata ityetāvatyeva paryavasitāni | kena tu prakāreṇa tulyatvamityapekṣāyāṃ tatkāryāpattyeti tadāha--sthāninā tulya vartata iti | sthānivaditi | sthānyāśrayeṣviti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
analvidhāvityasyārthamāha--analāśrayeṣviti | etena vidhīyate iti vidhaḥ- kāryam, alāśrayo vidhiralvidhirityuttarapadalopī samāsa iti darśayati | kimarthaṃ punaruttarapadalopāśrayaṇam ? syādetat-sati tasmin, yaścāli vidhiḥ, yaścālo vidhiḥ,yaścālaḥ parasya vidhiḥ-yajeḥ ktaḥ, iṣṭaḥ, ka iṣṭa ityatra saṃprasāraṇasya sthānivatvāt ko yaṣṭetyādivat 'haśi ca'ityutvaṃ prāptaṃ na bhavati, sa iṣṭa ityatra 'etattadauḥ' sulopo na bhavati | alo vidhiḥ - dyukāmaḥ, ukārasya 'lopo vyorvali' iti na bhavati | uttvaṃ tu 'aharvimaladyu' ityatra caritārtham | alaḥ parasya vidhiḥ-dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ-halṅyābiti lopo na bhavati | alā vidhiḥ-vyūḍhoraskena | atra 'so'padādau' iti vasarjanīyasya sthāne vihitasya sthānivattvāt visarjanīyasyāṭasūpadeśād 'aḍ‌vyavāye' iti ṇatvaṃ prāptaṃ na bhavati | ataḥ sarvavibhaktyarthasaṃgrahāthaṃmuttarapadalopāśrayaṇam | anyathā hi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāśrīyate'lsthānika eva vidhirāśritaḥ syāditi, tanna; sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭha
īvijñānādapi sarvavibhaktyarthasaṃgrahasya siddhatvāt | anuvāde hi sthāneyogābhāvāt sarvo'l‌sambandhī vidhiḥ pratipatsyate | evaṃ tarhi yatra guṇabhāvenāpyalāśrīyate, tatrāpi niṣedho yathā syāt-prapaṭhyeti, atra hi valāderiti pratyayaḥ prādhānyanāśritaḥ, val tu guṇabhāveneti aprādhānyānna syāt | uttarapadalope tu bhavati; alāśrayatvādiḍ‌vidheḥ | yadyalāśrayeṣu sthānivattvaṃ na bhavati, vṛkṣāya--'supi ca' iti dīrgho na syāt; yañādau supītyalāśrayatvāt | aruditāmityatra sārvādhātukasya tasastāmādeśe
'rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke ' iti valāśraya iṇ na syāt, ata āha-sthānyalāśrayāṇīti | sthānino'l sthānyal, sa āśrayo yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ-yathā gurupad‌guruputre varttitavyamanyatrocchiṣṭabhojanāt pādepasaṃgrahaṇācceti atideśe pravṛtte, yadā guruputraḥ svayaṃ gururbhavati tadocchiṣṭaṃ bhujyate pādau copasaṃgṛhyete, tatkasya hetoḥ ? atideśenaikvākyatāmāpannaḥ pratiṣedha ātideśikīmeva prāptiṃ pratiṣedhatīti, tathehāpyātideśika evālvidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate | na ca vṛkṣāya, aruditāmityatrātideśāpekṣā; svayameva yañāditvādvalāditvācca | tataśca yatra sthānina evālāśrīyate sa eva niṣidhyate, yathā-prapaṭhyetyatra | na hyatra lyap‌ svayaṃ valādiriti | nanu ca guruputrasya svayaṃ gurutva ucchiṣṭabhojanādau na mātrayāpyatideśāpekṣā, iha tu satyapi syameva yañāditve nāntareṇātideśaṃ dirghaḥ siddhyati; asuptvāt | aruditāmityatrāpi satyapi svayaṃ valāditve'sārvadhātukatvādatideśenaiva veṭ prārthanīyaḥ, satyam; dve kārye-supsaṃjñā ca, dīrghatvaṃ ca | na hi 'prayogasamavāyyeva kāryamatideśyam ' iti niyamo'sti, yattu śāstrīyaṃ tadevātidiśyate | na ca supsaṃjñā'lāśrayeti; tasyāmatidiṣṭāyāṃ svāśrayaṃ yañāditvamāśritya dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | aruditāmityatrāpyātideśikaṃ sārvadhātukatvaṃ svāśrayaṃ ca valāditvamāśrityeḍ bhaviṣyati |
nanu ca vṛkṣāyetyatra sthānina ekārasyāltvāttadāśrayaṃ suptvamalāśrayameva, ucyate; kāryāpekṣamalvidhitvaṃ nodāharaṇāpekṣam | etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasmin kārye vidhīyamāne'la evāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpaṃ nimittādirūpeṇāśrīyate--'haśi' 'hali' 'vyorvalihalṅyābbhyaḥaḍ‌vyavāye' iti - sa evālvidhiḥ; 'supi ca' ityatra tu naivaṃvidhaṃ kiñcidasti, kevalaṃ vṛkṣāyetyatrodāhāraṇe'lātmakaḥ sthānīteyatāvat kimudāharaṇamiti praśnaḥ | dhātvādyādeśāḥ prayojanamityuttaram | tatra 'prayujyate'neneti prayojanam' udāharaṇaṃ na prayujyata ityarthātpraśnānurūpaṃ prativacanam |
nanu cāstibruvorārddhadhātuke parata ādeśābhyāṃ bhāvyam, tat kimatideśenetyata āha--ārddhadhātuke viṣaya ityādi |
dādhikam | dadhni saṃskṛtam 'dadhnaṣṭak' | avyayādeśa iti | ktvāmātrasya lyabādeśaḥ, ktvāntasyāvyayasaṃjñā, sa kathamavyayādeśaḥ, tasmāt ktvāgrahaṇena lyapo grahaṇāttadantasyāpi saṃjñā bhavatītyevamparametat | tatrāpi 'kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti prastutyeti saṃghātasya bhavati |
vakkaraṇaṃ kimiti | vināpi tena tadartho gamyate, yathā ṅitkidityādāviti praśnaḥ |
sthānītyādi | asati vatkaraṇe saṃjñāprakaraṇatvāt sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā vijñāyeta, maivaṃ vijñāyīti vatkaraṇamityarthaḥ | kimarthaṃ punaḥ sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā neṣyata ityāha--svāśrayamapīti | saṃjñāyāṃ hi sthānisvarūpanibandhanam 'āṅoyamahanaḥ' ityādi kāryamādeśa eva syād, na sthānini; na hi saṃjñoccāritā svayaṃ kāryeṇa yujyate | 'ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām' iti ca viṣayasaptamī vijñāyate | svāśrayamapīti | ko'rthaḥ ? sthāninyapītyarthaḥ | tathā cottaragranthe 'ubhayatra' iti saptamīnirddeśaḥ |
ādeśagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | yathā 'pitṛvatsthūlaḥ' ityukte sambandhiśabdātputra iti mamyate, tathehāpi sthānivadityukte ka ityapekṣāyām 'yadapekṣaṃ sthānitvaṃ sa evā deśaḥ' iti gamyata praśnaḥ | ānumānikasyetyādi | dvividho hi ādeśaḥ--pratyakṣaśca 'asterbhūḥ' ityādiḥ, ānumānikaśca 'eruḥ' ityādiḥ | atrekāreṇekārāntaḥ sthānyanumīyate, viṣaṇeneva gauḥ | ukāreṇa cokārānta ādeśaḥ tatastesturiti sampadyate | tatrāsatyādeśagrahaṇe pratyakṣasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syānnānumānikasya, punaḥśratestu vyāptyarthatvāt ādeśamātraṃ sthānivadbhavati | tena pacatvityatra 'tiṅantaṃ padam' iti padasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati | nanu cekāramātrasyokāramātramādeśo'stu, kiṃ tadantānumānana ? evaṃ hi 'eruḥ' ityetacca yathāśrutameva vyākhyātaṃ bhavati; ādeśagrahaṇaṃ ca na karttavyaṃ bhavati, 'ekadeśavikṛtisyānanyatvāt padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati | evaṃ tarhi punaḥśrutireva liṅgam, ekadeśavikāraḥ śāstre nāśrīyata iti, tena--
sarve sarvapadādeśā dākṣīputrasya pāṇineḥ |
ekadeśavikāre hi nityatvaṃ nopapadyate ||
iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
dyupithityadādeśā iti | 'diva aut', 'pathimathyubhukṣāmāt','tyadādīnāmaḥ-ityete | nanu sāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśaḥ, tataśca yathā brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye vartitavyamiti brāhmaṇamātrakāryameva bhavati, na māṭharādiviṣeṣakāryam; tathā 'sthānivadādeśaḥ' ityukte yaḥ sthānī yadākāraviśiṣṭaḥ sūtre śrūtastadādeśasya tadākāraprayuktenaiva kāryeṇa bhavitavyam | 'ktvo lyap' ityatra ca vastusthityā sannihitamapi valāditvaṃ sthānirūpeṇa nāśritam | tathā hi-iḍādirapi ktvā bhavatyeva,ktvā kevalo'pi datvāyeti yaganto'pi, iṣṭvīnamiti mānto'pi; tatra ktvāmātrapratibaddhaṃ yatkāryaṃ kṛttvapratyayatvādi, tadādeśe'tidiśyatām, valāditvasya tu kuto'tideśaḥ ? evaṃ ka iṣṭa ityādāvapi ca yaṇa ik bhavati, divo'lo'ntyasyotvautve bhavataḥ, pathyādīnāmantyasyādbhavati, tyadādīnāmantyasyākāraḥ, visarjjanīyasya satvamityevaṃ yaṇādirūpeṇa sthānina āśrayaṇam | tataśca tattadākāraprayuktasyaiva kāryasyāpi atideśaḥ, na haltvādiviśeṣanibandhanasyeti nārtho'nalvidhāvityanaina | yatra tarhi viśeṣarūpameva sthānitvenāśrīyate, yathā-'cch‌voḥ śūṭh' iti vakāraḥ, tatra tatkāryamādeśasya mā bhūd-akṣadyūbhyām | vali lopo na bhavati |
athātrāpi vakārāntasyāṅgasyālo'ntyasyoḍiti rūpeṇa sthānina āśrayaṇam, evamapi viśeṣātideśajñāpanārthamidamucyate; anyathā lyapo valāditvavat kittvasyāpyatideśo na syāt, devitvetyādāvakito'pi ktvaḥ sambhavāt | anubandhāśca sthāninyasanta eva kāryeṣu yujyanta iti tatkāryeṣvanalvidhāviti niṣedho na bhavati | liṅgācca | yadayaṃ 'serhyapicca' ityāha, tajjñāpayati-bhavatyanubandhakāryāṇāmatideśa iti ||
acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau | aca iti sthāninirdeśa iti | yadyapyanūdyamānādeśaviśeṣaṇatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī na labhyate, tathāpyaco ya ādeśa ityukte tatsthānika eva pratīyata iti | parasminniti nimittabhāve saptamī, na parasaptamī; paraśabdenaiva paratvasyoktatvāt, parasminya ādeśa iti anuvādatvācca, kiti ye guṇavṛddhī itivat; pūrvavidhāviti viṣaya iti prakṛtatvāt sthānivattvasya |
pūrvavidhau kartavye sthānivaditi | evaṃ padatātparyaṃ darśayitvā vākyārthamāha--ajādeśa itāyadi | kimarthamidamucyate, pūrvatra sthānikāryamādeśe'tidiṣṭam, iha tu sthānini sati pūrvasya yatkāryaṃ tadādeśe'pi sati purvasya bhavatītyatidiśyate | nanu tatrāpi sthāninimittamanyasya tadapyatidiśyate, yathā vṛkṣāyeti 'supi ca' iti dīrghatvam ? evaṃ tarhyālvidhyarthamidam | tathā hi-vavraścetyudatve 'na saṃprasāraṇe saṃprasāraṇam' iti vakārasya saṃprasāraṇapratiṣedhaḥ sthānyalāśrayo'smādvacanādbhavati | idaṃ ca 'saṃprasāraṇe paraḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti pakṣe prayojanam, 'saṃprasāraṇabhāvini yaṇyeva pratiṣedhaḥ' iti tu pakṣe na prayojanam | ihācitīkaḥ, bahucitīka iti citeḥ kapi dīrghatve kṛte 'hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam' iti sthānyalāśrayaḥ svaro bhavati | evaṃ yāteryaṅantāt ktici ato lope yalopavidhiṃ prati sthānivattvaniṣedhād yalope ca yā yā ti iti sthite yaṅakāralopasya sthānivattvāt 'āto lopa iṭi ca' ityākāralope punaryalope yātiriti bhavati | na ca punarākāralopaḥ, punaśca yalopa iti pratyayamātrasya śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, āllopasya sthānivattvācciṇoluṅ‌nyāyenāsiddhatvādvā | tathā ca varevidhau sthānivattvaṃ niṣidhyate-yāyāvara iti | sthānivadbhāvādāto lopo mā bhūditi | tathā tiṣṭha
teryaṅantāt ktic, allopayalopayosteṣṭhīti sthite allopasya sthānivattvādiyaṅ bhavati, tathā cottarasūtrekaṇḍūtirityatra upaṅprasaṅgaṃ codayitvā 'astu tasyaiva cchravoḥ śūḍityūṭh kariṣyate' ityuktam, iyaṅi ca kṛte yalope ca teṣṭhitiriti bhavati | na ca punariyaṅ, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | tathā pepīyateḥ ktici allopayalopayoḥ 'eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇi yalope peptiriti bhavati | 'śo tanūkaraṇe' yaṅantāt ktici allopayalopāllopeṣu pūrvatrāddhīye na sthānivaditi sthānivattvaniṣedhācchaśāṃ ṣa iti ṣatve śāṣṭiriti bhavati | evaṃ cicīyateścektirityeṣā dik |
tathā titaumācaṣṭa iti ṇici ṭilopasya sthānivattvādayo ñṇitītyasyābhāve 'ataḥ upadhāyāḥ' iti sthānyalāśrayā vṛddhirbhavati | na cātra kvilugupadhātvetyupadhāvidhi prati sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ, tasya pratyayavidhiviṣayatvāt, satyāṃ ca vṛddhau puki sati titāpayatīti bhavati | na ca pukyapi sthānivattvam; ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | nanu pūrvasya kārye karttavye sati sthānivattvena bhavitavyam, atra ca sarvatra sthānivattve sati pūrvasya kāryaprāptiriti itaretarāśrayam | nātra sthānivattvāt prageva pūrvasya kārye prāpte sthānivattvam, kiṃ tarhi ? prāgvā paścādvā pūrvasya kārye pūrvasya kārye cikīṣite | ata eva varevidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ | tadevamalvidhyarthamidam |
kiñca--brāhmaṇavadasminkṣatriye vartitavyamityatra brāhmaṇāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ prāpyate, na tu svāśrayaṃ yuddhādikaṃ vyāvartyate | pūrvasūtre'pi sthānyāśrayaṃ prāpyate, na svāśrayaṃ vyāvartyate, yathā--vṛkṣāyeti dīrghatvamādeśāśrayaṃ bhavati; bhavitā, bhavitum, bhavitavyamiti guṇaḥ | iha tu sthānyalāśrayameveṣyate, svāśrayaṃ neṣyate | tathā ca paṭayatīti ṭilope kṛte prāptā upadhāvṛddhirna bhavati, avadhīditi halantalakṣaṇā, bahukhaṭ‌vaka iti 'hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam' itisvaro na bhavati, vāyvoryalopo na bhavati, tanvantītīṇ na bhavati | evaṃ bahūni svāśrayanivṛttirudāharaṇāni | ata eva dvarvacanādividhau sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ | ato'jādeśaḥ paranimittakaḥ pūrvasya vidhau sthānivadeva yathā syāt, mā bhūtsvayaṃ nimittamiti niyamārthamapīdamārabdhavyam |
kathaṃ punarekena yatnenobhayaṃ labhyam, vidhiśca, niyamaśca ? vidhigrahaṇasāmarthyāditi tannirūpaṇe vakṣyāmaḥ | atha vā - vidhigrahaṇaṃ vidhimātre sthānivadbhāvā yathā syādaśāstrīyo ca viparīte ca | tena paṭayatītyādau sthānini dṛṣṭo vṛddhyabhāvādiraśāstrīyo'pyatidiśyate | tatra vṛttikāreṇa yatnasādhyatvādaśāstrīyodāharaṇani darśitāni | vidhiśabdaḥ karmasādhanaḥ, pūrvasyeti śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī; pūrvasya vyavasthitasya sataḥ sambandhini kārye karttavye iti | pūrvatvaṃ tvatrājapekṣamāśrīyate; nādeśāpekṣam, nimittāpekṣaṃ vā | na cājapekṣe pūrvatva vidhiśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ sambhavati | bāvasādhane hi tasmin, pūrvasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīvijñānāt pūrvasminvidhātvye sthānivadityarthaḥ syād | avasthite cāci tataḥ pūrvaṃ kiñci dvidheyaṃ bhavati, iha cādeśāḥ sthānivaditi vacanāt ādeśena sthānī nivartita iti nāyamarthaḥ sambhavati | atrādeśaḥ paranimittakaḥ, tasyaivādeśasya sthānibhūto yo'c, tataḥ pūrvasmin vidhātavya iti | tathā hi-'aco ya ādeśaḥ' ityādeśātprāgavasthānūdyate, tataśca saṃnidhānāt pratīyamānamavadhitvamapi tadavasthasyaivāco yuktam | ata evocyate-'yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaḥ' iti | ādeśanamādiṣṭaṃ tadakṛtaṃ yasya so'nādiṣṭaḥ, akṛtādeśādacaḥ pūrvasyetyarthaḥ | ādeśātprāgavasthāyāmiti yāvat | na cāsyā avasthāyāḥ pūrvasmin‌ vidhātavye tadādeśaḥ sthānivaditi sambhavati | nanu karmasādhane'pyajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati-akṛtādeśācaḥ pūrvasya vidhāviti nāyamarthaḥ sambhavati, sthānivadbhāvadaśāyāmaca ādeśena nivarttitatvāt | nātra sampratyacaḥ pūrvasyetyayamarthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? aco'vasthānadaśāyāṃ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasyājavasthāprabhṛtipūrvasyetyarthaḥ | tadevamajapekṣasya pūrvatvasyāśrayaṇāt karmasādhana eva vidhiśabdaḥ | ki punaḥ kāraṇamajapekṣameva pūrvatvamāśrīyate, na punarādeśāpekṣaṃ nimittāpekṣaṃ vā ? ucyate; tadapekṣe pūrvatve vaiyākaraṇaḥ, sauvaśva ityatra sthānivadbhāvādaicorāyāvau prāpnutaḥ, tāvapi hi yaṇādeśāttannimittācca parasmādacaḥ pūrvasya kāryam | na ca vācyam--'satyapi sthānivattve'ntarbhūtājnimittatayā'ntaraṅgayorāyāvoḥ karttavyayorbahibhūtataddhitāpekṣatayā bahiraṅgāvaicāvasiddhāvityāyāvau na bhaviṣyataḥ' iti; 'nājāntarye bahiraṅgapraklṛptiḥ' itivacanāt | yathā-akṣadyūriti bahirbhūtakvibavekṣo'pyūḍantarbhūtājapekṣeyaṇi nāsiddho bhavati | ajapekṣe tu pūrvatve vi-ākaraṇaḥ, su-aśva ityajavasthāyāṃ yvorabhāvenaicoradarśanādaprasaṅgastadāha-'acaḥ pūrvatvavijñānādaicauḥ siddham' iti | kiṃ ca --nimittāpekṣe pūrvatve dvābhyām, deyam, lavanamityatrātvetvaguṇāḥ svanimittātpūrveṣāṃ sveṣāmeva kāryeṣu dīrghaguṇāvādeśeṣu sthānivatsyuḥ | tathobhayorapi pakṣayorapīpacadityādau 'sanvallaghuni' iti sanvadbhāvo na syāt; upadhāhrasvasya sthānivattvādalaghūpadhatvāt | ajapekṣe tu pūrvatve pāci-at iti sthite dvirvacanamupadhāhrasvatvaṃ ṇilopaḥ-ityeteṣu prāpteṣu paratvādantaraṅgatvācca ṇilope kṛte para vānnityatvācca hrasvatve ca paścād dvirvacane'bhyāsasya sthānino'caḥ pūrvatvenādṛṣṭatvānnāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | tathā ca tatra tatrocyate-'yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāva ādiṣṭāccaiṣo'caḥ pūrvaḥ' iti | tasmādajapekṣameva pūrvatvam | yadyevam, tanvantītyatreṭi karttavye yaṇaḥ sthānivattvaṃ na syāt, tan u antītyajavasthāyāṃ yatpūrvamaṅgaṃ na tasyeṭ, kiṃ tarhi ? tataḥ parasyādeśasyaiva | nimittāpekṣe tu yaṇo nimittādantyakārātpūrvasya tasyaiva yaṇa iḍ vidheya iti karmasādhane bhāvasādhane ca vidhiśabde sthānivattvaṃ labhyate | ādeśāpekṣe'pi bhāvasādhane yaṇaḥ pūrvatveneṭo vidheyatvātsidhyati, naiṣa doṣaḥ, 'ārddhadhātukasyeḍ' ityatra 'ekāca upadeśe' ityataḥ 'upadeśe' ityanuvṛtterupadeśe valāderiḍ bhaviṣyati; tatrāpyupadeśa ityanuvṛtteḥ | evamapi coriṣyata ityādau valādilakṣaṇe ciṇvadiṭi ca prāpte nityatvācciṇvadiḍiti | vakṣyati-'nityaścāyaṃ valnimittavighātī' iti,tannopapadyate; uktena prakāreṇa valādilakṣaṇasyāpīṭo nityatvāt | evaṃ tarhi ahiraṅgasya yaṇo'siddhatvādiḍabhāvaḥ |
yadvā-pūrvasmādvidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti pañcamīsamāso'pyāśrīyate, tena pūrvasmādaṅgādiṭo nimittatvenanāśritātparasya yaṇa iti karttavye sthānivadbhaviṣyati || kāni punaḥ pañcamīsamāsaprayojanāni ? idaṃ tāvatprayojanam-tanvantīti | kiñca bebhiditā, mārthitikaḥ, apīpacan | bebhidyateryaṅantāttṛci allopasya sthānivattvānna bhavati, naitadasti; bebhidya tṛ iti sthitellopaśca pāpnoti iṭ ca; paratvādiṭ‌ | nityo'llopaḥ-kṛto'pīṭi prāpnoti; iṭ punaranityaḥ, na hi kṛte'llope prāpnoti, nityenāllopena bādhyate | yasya ca nimittaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa na vihanyate tad nityam, ata ubhayornityayoḥ paratvādiḍeva bhaviṣyati | idaṃ tarhi mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika iti ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte, yasyeti lope cekasya sthānivadbhāvena ṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇāt 'isusuktāntātkaḥ' iti kādeśaḥ prāpnoti, yasyeti lopasya sthānivadbhāvānna bhavati | etadapi sannipātaparibhāṣayā ṭhasyeti varṇagrahaṇenālvidhitvena sthānivadbhāvābhāvādvā siddham | idaṃ tarhi apīpacan, apīpaca-an iti sthite'ntyākārasya caṅakārasya ca 'ato guṇe' iti pararūpatve tasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāj jhigrahaṇena grahaṇe sati sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' iti jus prāpnoti, ṇilopasyaikādeśasya vā sthānivadbhāvānna bhavati | tadevamajapekṣameva pūrvatvamāśrīyate; vidhiśabdaśca karmasādhanaḥ, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā ca samāsa iti na kaścid doṣa iti sthitam |
paṭyatīti | ṇāviṣṭhavaditi ṭilopaḥ | avadhīditi | 'hano vadha liṅi' 'luṅi ca' iti vadhādeśaḥ | halantalakṣaṇeti | 'vadavraja' ityatra halantasyetyanuvṛtterhalantalakṣaṇā | bahukhaṭvaka ityatra 'svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivad' iti vacanāt svaravidhāvapyatra sthānivattvaṃ bhavatyeva |
praśna iti | 'yajayācayata' ityādinā naṅ‌, 'cchravoḥ śūṭh' iti chasya śaḥ | tuki na sthānivadbhavatīti | tuki karttavye na sthānivadbhavatītyarthaḥ | nanvantaraṅgatvāt pūrvaṃ tukā bhāvyam, tatra caikaṃ nimittīkṛtya yugapadāṅgavārṇayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ, tatra vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, yathā-karoterliṭi ṇali kṛ a iti sthite, gaurityatra sāvakāśām 'aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā'ntaraṅgatvātprāptaṃ yaṇaṃ vṛddhireva bādhate, praśna ityatra tu śasya naṅ‌ nimittaṃ tukastu chaḥ, bhinnakālā cānayoḥ prāptiriti nāyamasyā viṣaya iti tuki sati 'cch‌voḥ śūṭh' ityatra satukkacchakāranirdeśena tasyaivādeśaḥ evaṃ ca satyāpi sthānivattve satuktacchagrahaṇena śo gṛhyate, na kevalaṃ chagrahaṇeneti kutastukaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ! ata eva naṅo ṅitvamapi viśna iti guṇo mā bhūditi, tasmādapratyudāharaṇametaditi pratyudāharaṇāntaramāha-ākrāṣṭāmiti | 'spṛśamṛśakṛṣatṛp‌dṛṣāṃ sij vā vaktvyaḥ' iti ksāpavādaḥ pakṣe sic | anudāttasyetyam, yaṇi 'vadavraja' iti vṛddhiḥ | 'pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivad' iti vacanādatrāpyatṛpyannāha--āgatyeti | 'vā lyapi' |
yuvajāniriti | bahuvrīhau puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yuvatiśabdasya vayovacanatvenājātivācitvāt 'jāteśca' iti pratiṣedho na bhavati | yalope na sthānivaditi | nanu yo'trādeśo nāsau lopasya nimittam, tasya valmātranimittatvāt; yaśca nimittaṃ nakāraḥ nāsāvādeśa iti sthānivattvaṃ na bhaviṣyati | na ca jāyāśabdasya janerauṇādike yaṅ‌pratyaye 'ye vibhāṣā' ityātve ca vyutpāditatvād niṅaḥ sthānivattve satyāto lopaprasaṅgaḥ, na hyuṇādiṣu vyutpattikāryamavaśyaṃ bhavati, ata udāharaṇānataropanyāsaḥ--vaiyāghrapadya iti | vyāghrasyeva pādāvasyeti 'pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' ityaparanimittaḥ 'gargādibhyo yañ' | nanu satyapi sthānivattve vacanāt padbhāvo bhaviṣyati; yadyevam, pāde ityatrāpi prāpnoti; sati tu parasminnatyasminvaiyāghrapadya ityatra padbhāvasya caritārthatvād pāde ityekādeśasya sthānivattvāt padbhāvābhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punarekādeśasya sthānivattvam, na hyayamaca ādeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? acoḥ ucyate; varṇanirdeśeṣu jātigrahaṇād, 'aca' ityekatvāsyāvivakṣitatvād acorapyādeśaḥ sthānivat | dvayorapi vā sthānitve yadekasya sthānitvaṃ tadāśrayaṃ tasya sthānivattvaṃ bhaviṣyati | ata eva śrāyasau, gaumatau, cāturau, ānuḍuhāviti śrāyasādibhyo'ṇantebhaya aupratyaya ekādeśasyādivattvāt prāptau numāmau na bhavataḥ; udakaṃ vahati, 'karmaṇyaṇ' saṃjñāyāmudabhāvaḥ, saptamyekavacana ekādeśasyādivattvādbhatve sati prāptaḥ 'vāha ūṭh' na bhavati udavāhe iti | ādīghya iti | adāditvācchapo luk | parasminnatyucyamāne syānivadbhāvābhāvāt kṛte ṭeretve lopo na prāpnoti | ṭeretvaṃ tu kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityamiti tadeva bhavati | nanu ca parasminnatyasati śabluko'pi sthānivattvāt tadvyavadhānādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati, na; 'kvilugupadhātvacaṅpanihranirhrāsakutveṣu' iti lukā luptasya sthāmivattvapratiṣedhāt |
he gauriti | 'goto ṇit' | bābhravīyā iti | babhrorapatyamiti 'madhubabhvrorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' iti yañ, 'orguṇaḥ','vānto yi pratyaye' ityavādeśaḥ | avādeśo na sthānivadbhavatīti | nanu cāsatyapi sthānivadbhāve saṃnipātaparibhāṣayā na bhavitavyamevātra yalopena, naitadasti; 'acaḥ' ityayaṃ saṃghāto yādisannipātakṛtaḥ; na ca sa lopasya nimittam, kiṃ tarhi ? vakāramātram | yadyevam, sthānivadbhāvasyāpyaprasaṅgaḥ, yo'trādeśo nāsāvāśrīyate, yaścāśrīyate nāsāvādeśaḥ | naiveya iti | nipūrvāddhāñaḥ 'upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ','āto lopaḥ','dvyacaḥ' 'itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak | nanu ca pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivattvamuktam, tat kathametāni pratyudāharaṇāni ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atrāpyajapekṣasya pūrvasyāśrayaṇād yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastataḥ parasyeti | evamapi he gaurityatra prāpnoti vyavahite'pi paraśabdavṛttergakārātparasya sorlopaḥ, evamitarayorapi, naitadevam; pūrvasya vidhiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāyam, tatrānuvādatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhyabhāvāt sambhandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī-pūrvasambandhini vidhāviti | sambandhaśca dvividhaḥ-kāryitvena, nimittatvena vā | yatra kāryitvena sa pūrvasya vidhiḥ, yatra nimittatvena sa pūrvasmāt; tataśca yo'nādiṣṭādaca pūrvastannimittatvenāśritya yatkāryaṃ prāptaṃ sa eva pūrvasmādvidhiḥ, yathā-apīpacanniti | atra hi yo'nādiṣṭo ṇic caṅ vā, tataḥ pūrvamapīpac ityevābhyastaṃ parasya jherjuso nimittam | tanvantītyatra yo'nādiṣṭo'c upratyayastataḥ pūrvaṃ yat tannimittatvenāśrīyate tadvidhāvaṅgasyetyanuvṛtteḥ | etadeva tatrāṅgādhikārasya prayojanam | he gaurityādau tu yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo gakārādirna tatsambuddhilopādernimittam, yacca nimittamokārādirnāsāvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti na doṣaḥ | iha tarhi vetasvāniti, ṭilopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivatvāt sakārātpūrvasyānupadhātvād 'mādupadhāyāḥ' iti vatvaṃ na syāt | na ca sthānivadbhāvena sannihitamakāramapekṣyākārāntāditi labhyate, tasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāt tadapekṣatve sthānivadbhāvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivatad' |
vidhigrahaṇaṃ kim, nanu pūrvasūtrādevānuvarttate ? samāsadvayaparigrahārtham | asati hi tasmin pūrvasyetyukte pūrvasmādvidhau na syāt, pūrvasmādityukte pūrvasya vidhau na syāt, naitadasti; pūrvasyetyukte'pi anuvādatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhyabhāvāt sarvaḥ pūrvasambandhī vidhiḥ pratipatsyate | evaṃ tarhi vidhimātre sthānivadyathā syāt śāstrīye viparīte ca | yadvā-vidhigrahaṇaṃ dvitīyo yatnaḥ, tatrācaḥ parisminpūrvasyetyeko yogaḥ, vidhāvityeva | tena vavraścetyādau sthānyalāśrayamatidiśyate | tato vidhau, acaḥ parasminpūrvasyetyeva, niyamārthametat-ajādeśaḥ paranimittakaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadeva, na tu svayaṃ nimittamiti | tena paṭayatītyādi siddhaṃ bhavatīti | nanvasatyapi dvitīyayatne yathā colavat kāśmīreṣu vrīhayaḥ, marubhūmivadasminpradeśejalamityādau dṛṣṭānte prasiddhasya bhāvasyābhāvasya vā yathādarśanamatideśaḥ, evamatrāpi bhaviṣyati ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; yuktaṃ tatra bhāvasyaivābhāvasyaiva ca prasiddhatvād, iha tūdāharaṇabhedena bhāvābhāvayoḥ prasiddhāvapi 'sthānivadādeśaḥ' ityukte'śrutakriyāpadeṣu vākyeṣu bhāvatītyevādhyāhārasya prasiddhatvād bhāvātideśaḥ syād ityalamitaprabandhena ||
na padāntadvirvacanavareyalopasvarasavarṇānusvāradīrghajaścarvidhiṣu || 1.1.58 ||
dvirvacane yalopādau ca tāvat tadeva vidheyam, na tu tasya vyavasthitasya kiñ‍cit | kau sta ityādau tu padāntasya sataḥ kāryamāvādi padāntasya vā''vādervidhānamityubhayathā sambhavaḥ | evaṃ varevidhāvapi | tathāpi sarvagrahāya bhāvasādhana eva vidhiśabdaḥ | eteṣviti | padāntādividheyabhedena bhinnāni yāni vidhānāni eteṣvityarthaḥ | pūrvavidhāvityādi | yadyapi vyākaraṇe na padāni saṃskriyante, na vākyam, tathāpi vākyagate sta ityādike pade vyutpādyamāne kāvityādeḥ padasyāsatyapi nimittatve sannidhānamaviruddham | tataścānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasambhavādasti sthānivattvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ |
dadhyatreti | sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasāmarthyād 'asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityetadapi na pravartate | śacyāvityādāvapi bahirbhūtājapekṣatvādyaṇ bahiraṅga eva 'vara' iti nipātanādaluk | yāyāvara iti | 'nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau' iti yaṅ | ato lopaḥ paranimittaka iti | ' ārddhadhātuke' iti parasaptamīpakṣa iti bhāvaḥ | tathā ca 'anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' ityatrādigrahaṇam | asati hi tasmin halantāditi vijñāyeta, tataśca jugupsano mīmāṃsana ityatra yujna syāditi | yadi ca sā viṣayasaptamī syāt, prageva pratyayotpatterato lope sati halantatvādatrāpi yuc siddhaḥ syāt | yattu 'aco yat' ityatra vakṣyati--'aj‌grahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā halantāṇṇyaṃ vakṣyati ? ajantabhūtapūrvādapi yathā syād-ditsyam, dhitsyamiti | tadvipayasapsamīpakṣa iti veditavyam | parasaptamīpakṣe hi prākpratyayotpatterato lopābhāvādanupapannaṃ tatsyāt |
kaṇḍūyateḥ ktini kṛta iti | 'ktinnāvādibhyo vaktavyaḥ' ityaneneti bhāvaḥ | 'ktici' iti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ | kaṇḍūtirityatrāllopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ prāpnoti, astu; cchvoḥ śūṭh' ityūṭ bhaviṣyati | na coṭhyapi sthānivattvam, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | ata evoṭhaḥ punaruvaṅ‌ na bhavati |
parasavarṇe na sthānivadbhavatīti | nanu śnasorallope kṛte paścādanusvāro bhavannādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti kathamasya parasavarṇe karttavye sthānivattvaprasaṅgaḥ ? syādetatsthānino nakārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvādādeśo'nusvāro'pi sthānivadbhāvādanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti, tanna; na hyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvaṃ nāma śāstrīyaṃ yadatidiśyeta | evaṃ tarhyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāpekṣe'caḥ parasminnatyatideśe karttavye sthānivadādeśa ityetat pravarttate, ataḥ savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam |
śiṣantīti | yadyapi śiṇḍhītyevānusvāravidherapyudāharaṇam, tathāpi tasminnevodāhṛte parasavarṇavidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ, tasya sthānino'nusvārasyāpi vidhau sthānivattvapratiṣedhamantareṇānupapanna iti pṛthaganusvāragrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamityāśaṅkā nirākaraṇāya kevalānusvārodāharaṇaṃ darśitam |
pratidīvneti | pratipūrvāddiveḥ 'kaninyuvṛṣitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ' iti kaninpratyayaḥ bhasyetyadhikṛtyeti | paranimittakatvopapādanārthaḥ | kimidamuktam‌hali copadhāyāṃ ceti dīrghatvaṃ na syāditi, upadhāyāñcetyetallekhakaiḥ pramādāllikhitam, tathā copadhāyāñcetyatra vakṣyati-pratidīvnetyatra 'hali ca' iti dīrghatvamiti | asmādvacanādbhavatīti | 'na bhakurchurām' iti tu pratiṣedho rephavakārāntasya bhasyetyatra na pravarttate |
jhalo jhalīti salopa iti | sakāre sico lopa ityetattu nāśrīyate, tasmiṃstvāśrite chāndasatvādvarṇalopaḥ |
bahukhaṭ‌vaka iti | atra sthānivadbhāvad 'hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam' iti khakārā kārasyodāttatvaṃ na bhavati,'kapi pūrvam' ityetadeva tu bhavati | kiryoḥ, giryoriti | 'kṛgroricca' iti vyutpattipakṣa etadudāhṛtam | 'upādhāyāñca' (8|2|78) ityatratvavyutpattipakṣamāśritya vakṣyati--'uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni, iti kiryogiryorityādiṣu dīrgho na bhavati' iti |
'kvilugupadhātvacaṅ‌paranirhrāsakutveṣvajādeśo na sthānivadbhavati' iti vaktavyam | kvi-kvau yadvidhīyate tatra karttavye yatra kutracit kṛto'jādeśo na sthānivadbhavatīti; lavamācakṣāṇo lauḥ, atra ṇici yaṣṭilopaḥ, yaśca kvau ṇilopastadubhayamapi 'cchvoḥ śūṭh' iti vakārasya kvinimitte ūṭhi kartavye na sthānivadbhavatīti 'etyedhatyūṭhsu' iti vṛddhiḥ | ye tu 'kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat' iti paṭhanti teṣāmetanna syāt | tathā pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvau, ato lope napuṃsake bahuvacane jasijhallakṣaṇe numi jasnimitte'pi karttavye'yo lopasya sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ syāt, kvau kṛtatvāt | kvau vidhiṃ pratītyatra tu pakṣe pratiṣedho na bhavati, pipaṭhīṣi brāhmaṇakulāni, numyasati 'sāntamahataḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | devayaterdyūrityatrobhayathāpi sidhyati | luk-lukā lupte na sthānivat, āmalakyā vikāraphalam 'nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' iti mayaṭaḥ 'phale luk' 'luktaddhitaluki' iti ṅīpo luk parinimittakaḥ yasyeti lope na sthānivad bhavati | kecittvetadarthaṃ sūtre vara-ī - vare iti īkārapraśleṣaṃ varṇayanti, īvidhiṃ prati na sthānivaditi | upadhātveupadhātve kartavye na sthānivat | parikhāśabdāccāturarthike ṇikṛte pārikhe bhavaḥ pārikhīya iti 'vṛddhādakekāntakhopadhāt' iti cho na syāt, ākāralopasya sthānivattvādanupadhākhakāra iti | pratyayavidhiviṣayaṃ caitat, yatropadhāsaṃjñānibandhana pratyayo vidhātumiṣyate tatraivetyarthaḥ, ghaṭayatītyādau tu tanna bhavati | caṅ‌paro ye nirhāso hrasvastatra na sthānivadbhavati--vāditavantaṃ prayojitavān avīvadad vīṇāṃ parivādakena, yo'sau ṇau ṇirlupyate tasya sthānivadbhāvād ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvo na syāt, yaścaṅ‌paro ṇirna tasminnaṅgasyopadhā, yasmiṃścāṅgasyopadhā na caṅpara iti | kutvam--pācayateḥ ktici pāktiḥ | kutvamupalakṣaṇam | lehayaterleḍhiḥ, dohayaterdogdhiḥ, yācayateryāktiḥ, veśayaterveṣṭirityādi ||
dvirvacane'ci || 1.1.59 ||
