'acaḥ parasmin' ityatra 'yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ' iti sthitam | sāckasya dvirvacanaṃ na tvacaḥ pūrvasyetyaprāptaṃ sthānivattvaṃ vidhīyate, rūpātideśārtha ca |
atra ṣaṭ‌ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | acītyādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacana iti viṣayanirdeśaḥ, aci yo'jādeśaḥ sa dvirvacane sthānivadbhavatīti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | acītyetadapi sthānivadbhāvenaiva sambadhyate, dvirvacana iti viṣayanirdeśād, dvirvacane kartavye'jādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavatyaci para iti dvitīyaḥ | dvirvacananimittatvādajeva dvirvacanagrahaṇena viṣeṣyate, dvirvacanamasminnastītyarśaādyacpratyayāntena vā, adhikaraṇasādhanena vā, ādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśa- sa sthānivaditi tṛtīyaḥ | evaṃ viśeṣitaṃ vājgrahaṇaṃ sthānivadbhāvasya viśeṣaṇam, ajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati dvirvacananimitte'ci parata iti caturthaḥ | dvirvacanagrahaṇamā vartate, tatraikenājviśeṣyate, pareṇa viṣayī nirdiśyata iti sthite tadviśeṣitamajgrahaṇaṃ sthānivadbhāvasya viśeṣataṇam, dvirvacane kartavye'jādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati dvirvacananimitte'ci parata iti pañcamaḥ | evameva sthite'jgrahaṇamādeśopalakṣaṇam, dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśaḥ sa dvirvacane kartavye sthānivadbhavatīti ṣaṣṭhaḥ |
atrādye pakṣe'co dvirvacanenāviśeṣitatvād dvirvacananimitte'pyaci ādeśaḥ syānivatsyāt, tataścācikīrtad ityatra ṇici 'upadhāyāśca' itītvasya 'caṅi' iti dvirvacane sthānivadbhāvādacakīrttaditi syāt | dudyūṣati--ūṭhi yaṇādeśaḥ sthānivatsyāt | bhavanamicchati, bhavanīyateḥ san, bibhavanīyiṣati-lyuṭi kṛtayorguṇāvādeśāyoḥ sthānivattve bubhavanīyiṣatītyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti | dvitīye tu acikīrtadityatra na doṣaḥ, itvasya takāreṇa vyavahitatvāt sthānivadbhāvabhājo hyādeśasya sthānivattvavidhānavelāyāmacyacanantare sthānivattvena bhavitavyam | evaṃ hyaci parataḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ kṛto bhavati | dudyūṣatītyādau tu syādeva | yayāvityatra 'āta au ṇalaḥ' ityaukāreṇa vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ saṃpratyādeśātparo'jnāstīti sthānivattvaṃ na syāt | jagmaturityādau ca 'gamahana' ityupadhālopasya vyavahitatvānna syāt | tṛtīye tu kālāvadhāraṇaṃ kartavyam, anyathā dvirvacanāduttarakālamapi sthānirūpamevāvatiṣṭheta | caturthe tu yayau, jagmaturityādau pūrvoktanyāyena sthānivadbhāvo na prāpnoti, kālāvadhāraṇaṃ ca kartavyam | pañcame'pi yayau, jagmaturityādau na syāt, ata eteṣu pakṣeṣvevaṃ doṣasambhavāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-dvirvacananimitteḥ'cītyādi | atra hi pakṣe dvirvacanenāco viśeṣaṇādacikīrttat, dudyūṣati, bibhavanīyiṣatītyādau na doṣaḥ | ādeśopalakṣaṇatvācca yayāvityādāvapi na doṣaḥ punaśca dvirvacanagrahaṇāt kālāvadhāraṇamapi labhyate | nanu 'dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśaḥ' ityucyamāne nunāvayiṣati, cakṣāvayiṣati, pusphārayiṣatītyādau ṇeradvirvacananimittatvāttannimittāvādeśaḥ, ākāraśca na sthānivatsyāt; tataścābhyāsa ukāro na śrūyeta, naiṣa doṣaḥ;'puyaṇji' iti jñāpakād dvitvanimitte'pi ṇau sthānivattvāpāyāt | tathā hi- na hi ṇau kṛtasya sthānivadbhāvamantareṇa oḥ parāḥ puyaṇjyo'varṇaparāḥ sambhavanti; pipaviṣati, yiyaviṣati-ityatra sambhava iti cet, kimetāvatā pugrahaṇaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jagrahaṇaṃ cārthavadbhavatīti ? jñāpakamuktārthasya yadyevam; acikīrtadityatretvasya sthānivattvādacakīrtaditi syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakasya tulyajātīyāpekṣatvāt yatrottarabhāgasyādyo'varṇaparo bhāvastatraiva sthānivattvajñāpanāt | nanvevamapi 'oḥ puyaṇ' ityatra ṇerityaśravaṇātsāmānyena dvitvanimittaṃ sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca vibhavanīyiṣatītyatrāpi syāt, na hyatrājamātraṃ dvirvacananimittam, kva tarhi syāt ? cakāra, cakre ityādau hyajmātraṃ pratyayaḥ | syādetat-parasminnityanuva-ttamacītyanena viśeṣyate, tatra yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇamiti tadādividhirbhavati | ajādau parasminniti dvirvacananimittatvenāpi ajādyeva viśeṣyata iti | evamapi cakraturityatra syāt, yad dvirvacananimitamajādi na tadādeśasya nimittam; acyeva yaṇo vidhānāt | yaccādeśasya nimittaṃ na tad dvirvacanasya nimittam; papataḥ cakhnaturityādāvena tu syāt | kiñca 'yasminvidhiḥ' iti vacanādyatra kiñcidvidhīyate tatraiva tadādividhiḥ, iha tu aci yo'jādeśa ityanuvādatvāttadādividherevāsambhavastasyamādajeva gṛhyate, na tadādiḥ, ucyate; cakraturityādāvatusodvirvacanaṃ prati nimittatvenāśrayaṇe'pyaci paratrāvasthite dvirvacanaṃ dṛṣṭamityetāvatājeva dvirvacananimittamityucyate | samudāye'pyayaṃ dvirvacanaśabda upacāreṇa pravarttate | evamapi papaturityatra na syāt, āllopasyājādinimittaṃ nājmātram, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'aci yo'jādeśaḥ' iti ko'rthaḥ ? aci yo dṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | yaścāci vidhīyate, yaścājādau-dvāvapi aci dṛṣṭāveveti sarvatra sidhyati | atha vā-ajādāvāllopo na halādau, tatra prāptāprāptavivekenāca eva mimittatvam | dvirvacana eva karttavya iti evakāreṇaitaddarśayati--dvirvacanagrahaṇamacaṃ viśinaṣṭi,kālaṃ cāvadhārayatīti | ekasyobhayasambandhe hi bhavati evakāraḥ-devadatto grāmaṃ gacchatu sa eva gāmānayatviti | yadyatrāpi pūrvavatkāryātideśaḥ syāt; cakraturityādāvanackatvādaprāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ sthānivadbhāvād bhavadapi yaṇādyādeśayuktasyaiva syādityabhayāse sthānirūpaṃ na śrūyeta, tadarthamāha-rūpātideśaścāyamiti | 'ca' śabdo'vadhāraṇe | kathaṃ punaravagamyate rūpātideśo'yamiti ? aj‌grahaṇāt | taddhijeghrīyata ityatra 'ī ghrādhmoḥ' iti halādau vihitasyetvasya sthānivattvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate | yadi ca rūpaṃ sthānivat, tato'satyajgrahaṇe ghrāy‌ghrīy‌dhmāy‌dhmīy iti dvirvacanaṃ syāditi tannavṛttaye'jagrahaṇamarthavad bhavati | atha hi--kāryaṃ sthānivad bhavati, tasya satyapi sthānivattve īkārayuktasyaiva dvirvacanamiti nārtho'j‌grahaṇena | bhasestu kvasau 'ghasibhasorhali' ityupadhālope kṛte satyasati vā dvirvacanebhsvāniti śrutau viśeṣābhāvaḥ | chāndasaca kvasuḥ, chandasidṛṣṭānuvidhānamato jñāpakamevāj‌grahaṇam | tatra yadyapi sthānyeva svarūpamāpadyate, tathāpyātideśikānātideśikarūpabhedāśrayastu vatirdvirvacana eva karttavya ityetadeva spaṣṭayati | niyatakāla iti | kṛte dvirvacane ityādinā niyatakālatvameva darśayati | yadi kṛte dvirvacane punarādeśarūpamevāvatiṣṭhate, yathā--cakraturityādau dvirvacanādūrdhvaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛto yaṇādeśa eva śrūyate tathā ninyaturityādāvapi dvirvacanātpūrvamekāctvādi, yaṅādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacane'pi pūrvapravṛtta iyaṅeva syāt | astuḥ tasya 'asiddhavadatrābhāt' ityasiddhatvād 'eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇi sati śravaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati | yadvā-pūrvapravṛtto'pīyaṅ dvirvacanakāle'pahṛta iti punaḥ pravartayitavyaḥ, tasyāṃ ca daśāyāma nekāctvādyaṇā bādhyate | yadyevam, iyeṣa uvoṣeti iṣeruṣeśca liṭi tipi ṇali pravṛttsyāpi guṇasya dvirvacanakāle'pahṛtatvātkṛte dvirvacane punaḥ pravṛttiḥ, tataścānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvenābhyāso dṛṣṭa iti tasyābhyāsasya uvaṅi karttavye guṇasya sthānivadbhāvādasavarṇaṃ iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | asavarṇagrahaṇasāmarthyātsthānivattvaṃ na bhaviṣyati | asti vacanasyāvakāśaḥ-iyartti, iyṛtaḥ | hyekamudāharaṇamasavarṇegrahaṇaṃ prayojayati | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt, arttāvityeva brūyāt | ki tarhyucyate--dvirvacane punarādeśarūpamevāvatiṣṭhata iti, atra hi 'punaḥ' śabdād, 'avatiṣṭhate' iti vacanācca pūrvakṛtasyaivādeśasyonmajjanamevoktaṃ pratīyata iti ? nāyamarthaḥ; api tu kṛte dvirvacane sthānirūpaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate yatprāptaṃ tadbhavatītyevaṃparametat |
allopetyādi | upalakṣaṇametat | taturiḥ, papurirityadau 'ṝta īddhātoḥ' 'udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti itvotvayarapi sthānivattvaṃ bhavati |
āṭiṭaditi | aṭaterṇyantālluṅi caṅi 'ajāderdvitīyasya' iti ṭiśabdasya dvirvacanam, 'āḍajādīnām' | nināyetyādi | 'ṇaluttamo vā' iti yadā ṇittvaṃ nāsti tadā guṇaḥ, ṇittvapakṣe vṛddhiḥ |
nenailolāiti dvirvacanamiti | gṛṇavṛddhyostu sthānivadbhāve viśeṣābhāvānnoktaḥ |
jagle, mamla iti | bhāve liṭ, anaimittikamātvam, śiti tu pratiṣedha ityātvasya sthānivattvaṃ na bhavati | śravaṇamityādi | yadi kālo nāvadhāryeta, tadottarakālamapi sthānirūpaṃ prasajyeta, tataścākārasya śravaṇe sati pareṇa saha 'vṛddhireci' iti vṛddhiḥ syāt | ihādhijage iti 'gāṅ‌liṭi' iti dvilakāranirdeśena lakārādau liṭi gāṅādeśavidhānādajnimittatvābhāvāt sthānivattvābhāvaḥ ||
adarśanaṃ lopaḥ || 1.1.60 ||
iha darśanaṃ jñānamupalabdhiḥ | tacca śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdaviṣayaṃ sacchravaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha-aśravaṇamiti | śravaṇaṃ ca śrotṛvyāpāraḥ, tanniṣedhe 'lopo vyorvali' ityasya vakārayakārau valparau na śrotavyāvityarthaḥ syāt | tataśca prayoktṛvyāpāra uccāraṇamaniṣiddhaṃ syāt | asati śravaṇe uccāraṇamanarthakameva syāditi śravaṇaniṣedhena taddhetubhūtamuccāraṇameva niṣiddhaṃ bhavatītyāha-anuccāraṇamiti | 'lopo vyorvali' ityasya ko'rthaḥ ? vakārayakārau valparau noccārayitavyāviti | anenāpi prakāreṇāsminviṣaye tayorabhāva eva vyākhyāpito bhavati, na hi vidyamānayoranuccāraṇamupapadyata ityāha-abhāva iti | svābhāvika evābhāva ityarthaḥ | vināśa iti | kāryaśabdadarśana etat | anarthāntaramiti | śabdaviṣayāṇāmeṣāmartho na bhidyata ityarthaḥ | 'svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanād adarśanaśabdasyaiva saṃjñāyāṃ lopapradeśeṣu adarśanaśabda evādeśaḥ syādityata āha--etaiḥ śabdairiti | etacca 'naveti vibhāṣā' ityata itikaraṇānuvṛtterlabhyate | atha vā-mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthā yathā vijñāyeta-lopanaṃ lopa iti | na cādarśanaśabdo lopanakriyā bhavati | yadyevam, pradeśeṣvevārthagrahaṇamastu, kiṃ saṃjñayā ? tanna; asati saṃjñākaraṇe 'svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanāt pradeśeṣu lopaśabda evādeśaḥ syāt | sati tvaśabdasaṃjñeti niṣedhānna svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati | na śabdasyeti | arthasiddhamapyetadvispaṣṭārtha punaruktam | nanu vidhipradeśeṣvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti-sato'darśanasya saṃjñā, saṃjñayā cādarśanaṃ bhāvyata iti, tanna; na hi lopavidhānātpragasadevādarśanaṃ vacanena bhāvyate, anityatvaprasaṅgāt, kiṃ tarhi ? sadevādarśanaṃ sādhutvenānvārūyāyate | yadyevam, sarvasya svaviṣayādanyatra svabhāvato'darśanamastīti lopasaṃjñā syāt | tataśca dadhi, madhviti ṇico'darśanasya lopasaṃjñāyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena vṛddhiḥ syāt | aṅgasya vṛddhiḥ, aṅgasaṃjñā ca vidhānapratibaddhā | kvipastarhyadarśanasya lopasaṃjñāyāṃ tuk prāpnoti, tatrāha-prasaktasyeti | evaṃ manyate-'sthāne' iti vartate; sthānaṃ ca prasaṅgaḥ; tena prasaṅge yadadarśanaṃ tasya lopasaṃjñā, na ca dadhītyatra kvipaḥ kenacitprasaṅgo'sti | evamapi gramaṇīrityatra karmadhātukartṛsannidhānādasti aṇaḥ prasaṅga iti tadadarśanasya saṃjñāyāṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt | yo'trāṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, kvipā so'pāhriyate | sāmānyaśāstraṃ hi viśeṣasannidhau tadvyatirikta eva viṣaye pratītiṃ janayati | tena 'satsūdviṣa' ityasya sannidhau 'karmaṇyaṇ' ityanena nayateraṇ bhavatīti buddhireva na janyate ||
pratyayasya lukśalulupaḥ || 1.1.61 ||
'adarśanam' iti sambandhāt 'pratyayasya' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | yadi pratyayādarśanasya lugadisaṃjñāsaṅkaraḥ prāpnoti, vidhānadaśāyāṃ yayā kayācana saṃjñayā bhāvitasya pratyayādarśanasyānuvādapradeśeṣu yatkiñcanasaṃjñoccāraṇe'pi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca-attīti luksaṃjñāyā bhāvitasyāpi śapo'darśanasya 'ślau' ityatra grahaṇād dvirvacanaṃ syāt; juhotīti-'uto vṛddhirluki hali' iti vṛddhiḥ syāt; harītakyā phalāni-'luktaddhitaluki' iti ṅīṣo luk syāt; 'lavaṇāl luk' lavaṇassūpaḥ, yuktavadbhāvaḥ syāt; tathā lopasaṃjñayā bhāvitasyāpi luksaṃjñāyā agomati gomatī sampannā gomatībhūtā brāhmaṇīti cverlope 'luk taddhitaluki' iti luk syādityata āha-anekasaṃjñāvidhānāccetyādi | yadyatadbhāvitasyāpyetāḥ saṃjñāḥ syuḥ, nekasaṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | ekāmeva saṃjñāṃ kṛtvā tayaiva sarvāṇi kāryāṇi vidhīyeran ! tasmādanekasaṃjñāvidhānādyayā saṃjñayā yadadarśanaṃ bhavatitaṃ tasyaiva sā saṃjñeti saṃjñānāṃ saṅkaro na bhavati | yadyevam, vidhipradeśeṣvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti | na cātra nityatayā parihāraḥ sambhavāti; adarśanameva hi nityam; na punarlugādisaṃjñayā bhāvitam | tatra yadi tayā saṃjñayā bhāvitasyādarśanasya sā saṃjñeti, vyaktamitaretarāśrayo bhavati, tatrāha-vidhipradeśeṣu ceti | adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ parasya śapastadbhavati, yasya bhūtasya luksaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ bhāvinyāḥ saṃjñāyā vijñānānna bhavatītaretarāśrayatvadoṣaḥ | lopasaṃjñātvadarśanamātrasya vidhīyata iti lugādisaṃjñāviṣaye'pi bhavatyeva | na ca lugādisaṃjñābhibadhiḥ; ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñānāṃ samāveśāt | ata eva ' na lumatāṅgasya' iti niṣedhaḥ | varaṇā iti | 'adūrabhavaśca' ityaṇaḥ 'varaṇādibhyaśca' iti lup |
pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimati | na tāvadapratyayanivṛttyartham; lug, aṇiñoḥ, tadrājasya yañañośca, śapaḥ, yaṅaḥ, sicaḥ, leḥ, supaḥ iti sarvatra pratyayasyaiva nirdeśād, anuvādeṣu ca tadbhāvitasyaiva tasya saṃpratyayāt | 'gostriyorupasarjanasya' ityatra yogo vibhajyate--'gorupasarjanasya striyāḥ' iti, 'luk taddhitaluki' iti striyā ityeva;goriti nivṛttam; itarathā kṛte'pi pratyayagrahaṇe gamerḍo luk syāt, 'kaṃsīyaparaśabyayoryañañau luk ca' ityatra ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoḥ pratipadikātparasya bhāgasya lugvijñāsyate, na prakṛtibhāgasya; anyathā kṛte'pi pratyayagrahaṇe kameḥ saḥ kaṃsaḥ, parān śṛṇāti paraśuriti ukārasakārayorluk syāt, ato'pratyayanivṛttyartha tāvatpratyagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam | yatra tarhi na kaścinnirdiśyate--'atribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyaśca' iti, atra pratyayapratipattyarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ? naivam; tatrāpi 'yaskādibhyo gotre' ityayo gotragrahaṇānuvṛtteratryādibhyo gotre yo vihitastasya luk, tathā 'janapade lup' ityatra 'ṅyāpprātipadikātapratyayaḥ ' ityanuvṛtteḥ janapade vihitasya cāturarthikapratyayasyaiva lup | 'lavaṇālluk' ityadiṣvapi prakṛtasya, ataḥ pratyayasya pratipattyarthamapi na karttavyaṃ bhavati | sarvatra cātryādibhyaḥ pratipadikāllavaṇāditi pañcamyadhikāreṇa sannihitasya ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati, sā cāniyatayogatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyatīti sthānaṣaṣṭhīpratipattyarthamapi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ tarhi sarvādeśārthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam; asati tasmin 'yañañośca','supo dhātu prātipadikayoḥ' ityādiṣu yatrānekāl pratyayaḥ, tatrālo'ntyasya syāt, 'lavaṇālluk' ityādau tu ādeḥ syāt; sati tu pratyayagrahaṇe tatsāmarthyāt sarvādeśo lugādirbhavati ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam 'ghorlopo leṭi vā' iti lope prakṛte 'lugvā duhadiha' iti lukaṃ śāsti,tajjñāpayati--'lugādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ' iti | 'alo'ntyasya' hyadarśanaṃ prakṛtena lopenāpi siddham | viparyayastu na bhavati, 'ghorlopaḥ' ityatra tāvadasaṃjātavirodhitvād 'alo'ntyasya' iti pravartate, paścālluggrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva sarvādeśatāṃ gamayati | sāmānyena ca jñāpakaṃ samarthayiṣyate--'lopavyatiriktamadarśanaṃ sarvādeśaḥ' iti | ataḥ sarvādeśārthamapi pratyagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti praśnaḥ |
itaro'pi viditābhiprāyaḥ pariharati | āgastayaḥ kuṇḍinā iti | asati pratyayagrahaṇe āgastyakauṇḍinyayorityatra 'lugaṇiñoḥ' ityato luggrahaṇamanuvarttate vā ? na vā ?
anuvṛttau--sthāninau dvau, lukā saha traya ādeśā iti vaiṣamyādasati yathāsaṅkhye ekaikasya traya ādeśāḥ paryāyeṇa syuḥ | tataścāgastayo'pi kuṇḍināḥ syuḥ, kuṇḍināścāgastayaḥ syuḥ | luk ca kriyamāṇo yadi jñāpakātsarvādeśaḥ, tata ubhayatrāpi vibhaktimātraśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha nivṛttam--tato'gastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā ityatra na kaściddoṣaḥ | agastīnāṃ chātrā āgastīyā ityatra tu prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye vivakṣite'pyagastyādeśasya ni,edhābhāvāt pravṛttāvavṛddhatvāccho na syāt; pratyayagrahaṇe tu sati luggrahaṇānuvṛttyā''gastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ pratyayāṃśasya lugna bhavati | pariśiṣṭayorbhāgayoryathāsaṃkhyamagastikuṇḍinacāvityarthaḥ sampadyate; tenagastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā iti ca siddhyati | prāgdīvyatīye ca vivakṣite 'gotre lugaci' iti luki pratiṣiddhe tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvādagastyādeśe'pi nivṛtte āgastyaśabdasya vṛddhatvācche kṛte 'sūryatiṣyāgastya' iti yalope cagastīyā iti siddhyati | kauṇḍinye ca nāsti viśeṣaḥ, nivṛtte'pi kuṇḍinajādeśe kauṇḍinyaśabdādapi 'kaṇvādibhyo gotre' iti aṇi kṛte 'āpatyasya' iti yalope kauṇḍinā ityeva bhavitavyam | ata āgastyakauṇḍinyayorityatrāvaśyamanuvartyaṃ luggrahaṇam | tataśca pūrvoktadoṣaparihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamapi kartavyam |
vayantu brūmaḥ-'sarvādeśārthamapi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ sāmānyena jñāpakamagatikagati' ita ||
pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇamiti || 1.1.62 ||
sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha--pratyayanimittamityādi | lakṣaṇaśabdo'yamasti bhāvasādhanaḥ prādurbhāvavacanaḥ, asti ca karaṇasādhano nimittavacanaḥ | tatrādyasya grahaṇe pratyayalope sati pratyayasya prādurbhāvo bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | tatra luptasyaiva pratyayasya punaḥ prādurbhāvavidhau lopavidhirvyarthaḥ syāt | nanu ca yaḥ pratyasyaiva lopaḥ 'ṇeraniṭi' ityādi, tasya vaiyarthyaṃ nāmāstu; yastu 'ṭeḥ' ityādinā sāmānyena vihitaḥ, sa yadā pratyayasya bhavati--bhikṣumācaṣṭe bhikṣayatīti, tadā tasya punaḥ prādurbhāve'pi na tasya vaiyarthyam; upratyaye caritārthatvāt | evaṃ tarhi luptasyaiva pratyayasya punaḥ prādurbhāva iṣṭe, na pratyayasya lopa iti vaktavyam--sāmānyavihito lopaḥ pratyayasya na bhavatīti |
atha pratyayāntarasya luptapratyayanimittakasya pādurbhāvo vidhīyate, yathā--grāmaṇīriti kvipo lope tannimittasya sorvidhiḥ | evamapi 'pratyayalope pratyaya' ityeva vaktavyam--pratyayasya lope na tannimittakaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti | ato nimittaparyāyeṇa lakṣaṇaśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ, kāryaṃ cānyapadārthaṃ ityāha--pratyayahetukaṃ kāryamiti | pratyāsatteśca yaḥ pratyayo yasya kāryasya nimittaṃ tasya lope'pi tadbhavatītyarthaḥ |
padasaṃjñā bhavatīti | nanu ca sthānivadbhāvenāpi siddhā padasaṃjñā, iha tarhi tā tā piṇaaḍānāmiti-tacchabdātparasya jasaḥ śiḥ, 'śeśchandasi bahulam' iti lope 'napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti num, 'sarvanāmasthāne' iti dīrghaśca bhavati; anaḍ‌vān-- sorlope numbhavati; adhok--aḍ‌guṇau bhavataḥ; nyamārṭ-mṛjervṛddhiḥ; underlaṅi tilope śnamāṭau bhavataḥ; 'śnānnalopaḥ'--aunat; agnicit-kvipo lope tugbhavati ? etānyapi sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhyanti; alvidhitvāt | sarvatraivālmatrapratyayaḥ, tadāśrayo vidhiralvidhiriti | naitatsuṣṭhūcyate, uktaṃ hi kāryāpekṣamalvidhitvaṃ nodāharaṇāpekṣamiti | numādividhau ca sarvatra śāstre yadrūpamāśrīyate--sarvanāmasthāne sārvadhātuke piti kṛti suptiṅantamiti, sādhāraṇaṃ tadalaścānalaśca | kevalaṃ tātā piṇḍānāmityādyudāharaṇe'rthādalātmakaṃ tadityetāvat |
iha tarhi atṛṇeṭ-'tṛhi hisāyām', laṅ, tip, śnam,'itaśca' itīkāralopaḥ, takārasya halṅyādilope halādau piti sārvadhātuke vidhīyamāno'l‌vidhiḥ 'tṛṇahaim' asmādbhavati; tathā āśīrityatra 'śāsa īdaṅhaloḥ' itītvaṃ lupte'pi kvipi bhavati | nanu ca 'varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam'; naivaṃvidhaṃ vacanamasti | dvitīyasya pratyayagrahaṇasya prayojanamidaṃ paṭhyate - atra hi ' pratyayalope tallakṣaṇam' ityeva siddhe punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇādyatra pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate supi sārvadhātuke kṛti suptiṅantamiti tadeva yathā syāt | tena gohitamityavādeśo na bhavati | na hi 'eco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityatra pratyayasyāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpamupāttam, kintvacīti yadupāttaṃ tadgave hitamityasminnudāharaṇe arthātpratyayātmakamityetāvat | itvemāgamayostu halādau kṅiti halādau piti sārvadhātuka iti pratyaya eva prādhānyena nimittam, hal tu tadviśeṣaṇamiti nemau varṇāśrayau | tasmādalvidhyarthamidamārabdhavyam |
yadyevam, bhasaṃjñāṅīp‌ṣpheṣu doṣaḥ | bhasaṃjñāyāṃ tāvad-rājñaḥ puruṣo rājapuruṣa iti śrūyamāṇe pratyaye yathā saṃjñā bhavati, evaṃ lupte'pi syāt | tataśca tayā padasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvād lanopo na syāt | nanu ca dve atra padasaṃjñe--svādāviti ca, suptiṅantamiti ca | tatra yā svādau padamiti padasaṃjñā, sā'pavādabhūtayā bādhyate; yā tu 'suptiṅantam' iti padasaṃjñā, sā na bādhanīyā, yathā--śrūyamāṇe pratyaye 'rājñaḥ' iti samudāyasya ? naitadevam; śrūyamāṇe pratyaye tataḥ pūrvasya bhāgasya bhasaṃjñā, samudāyasya tu visarjanīyāntasya padasaṃjñeti yuktam-vibhinnāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñā na bādhyata iti | lupte tu pratyaye yasyaivāvadheḥ svādau padamiti padasaṃjñā,subantaṃ padamityapi tasyaivāvadheḥ padasaṃjñā | tatraivāvadhau bhasaṃjñā bhavantī yathā'yavadatvāt svādilakṣaṇāṃ padasaṃjñāṃ bādhate, tathā subantalakṣaṇāmapi paratvādvādhate |
evaṃ tarhi 'na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhād bhasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati, yacīti saptamīnirdeṣāt | tataḥ pūrvasya bhāgasya vastuto'sya pravartamānā bhasaṃjñāpyaṅgakāryameva | evaṃ ca budhvā 'na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' ityatra ṅau nalopaḥ pratiṣidhyate, yadi pratyayalakṣaṇena bhasaṃjñā syād, apavādatvādevārdre carmanniti nalopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tena pratiṣedhena ? iha tarhi citrāyāṃ jātā 'citrārevatīrohiṇībhyaḥ striyāmupasaṃkhyānam' ityaṇo luki 'luktaddhitaluki' iti ṭāpi lupte, citra iti sthite pratyayalakṣaṇenāṇantatvāt ṅīp prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityatra 'ataḥ' ityanuvartate, tatra cāṇākāro viśeṣyate--aṇo'kāra iti, tataścākāra eva ṅīpo nimittam; aṇ tu tadviśeṣaṇamiti pratyayalakṣaṇatvābhāvād ṅībabhāvaḥ |
iha tarhi vataṇḍasyātyaṃ strī 'vataṇḍācca' ityañaḥ 'luk striyām' iti luki vataṇḍī-śārṅgaravādilakṣaṇaṃ ṅīnaṃ bādhitvā 'prācāṃ ṣphastaddhitaḥ sarvatra' iti sarvatragrahaṇasya pūrvatrāpakarṣātprācāṃ matena yañantalakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ prāpnoti, yathā āvaṭyāccāpaṃ vā bādhitvā ṣpha eva bhavatīti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atrāpi yañākāro viśeṣyate-yaño'kāra iti, yañavayavo yo'kārastadantāditi | tenātrāpyakāra eva nimittam, tadviśeṣaṇantu yañiti ṣpho na bhavati | ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ-parivīriti, paripūrvāddhyeñaḥ kvipo lope yajāditvāt saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca tuk prāpnoti, 'halaḥ' iti dīrghaśca; tatra vipratiṣedhena dīrgha iṣyate, sa vipratiṣedho na siddhyati | kiṅkāraṇam ? iha pratyayalope sarvāṇi pratyayāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi paryavasannāni, tānyanena pratyutthāpyante, anenaiva tuk, anenaiva dīrghaḥ-tadekayogalakṣaṇayorayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avasthite pratyaye, tannibandhanaṃ yatkāryaṃ bhavatyeva tadevānena lupte tasmin pratyutthāpyate, na tu yasya prāptimātraṃ tadapi | parivīyetyādau śrūyamāṇe pratyaye dīrgha eva paratvād bhavati, na tuk; tataścātrāpi yadi kvibevāsthāsyad, dīrgha evābhaviṣyaditi sa evānena pratyutthāpyate | tadevamārabdhavyaṃ sūtraṃ na kaściddoṣa iti sthitam |
atrocyate--yaduktaṃ 'tṛṇaha im' halāśraya iti; nāyaṃ halāśrayaḥ, halīti nivartiṣyate | yadi nivartate, tṛṇahāni--atrāpi prāpnoti ? nābhyastasyācītyato nācītyanuvarttate, tataścānalvidhitvāt sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddha imāgamaḥ | āśīrityatrāpi 'āsāsaḥ kvāvupasaṃkhyānam' ityasmād vacanātsiddhamitvam | ārabdhe'pi khalvasmiṃstadavaśyaṃ vaktavyam | yadi tāvat 'śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ' ityatra śāsimātrasya grahaṇam, tato niyamārtham 'āśāsaḥ kvāveva yathā syād, āśāsta ityādā mā bhūt' iti | atha yasmācchāseraṅ vihitastasya grahaṇam, tato yathā''śāsta ityādau na bhavati tathā kvipyapi na syāditi vidhyarthamidam | iha tarhi bidasyāpatyāni bahūni 'anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ' bidāḥ, bidānāmapatyaṃ yuvā, 'ata iñ', tasya ṇyakṣatriyārṣañitaḥ' iti luki kṛte, año gotrabahutva utpannasya luki prāpte'gotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedha iṣyate, so'jādāviti lupte'pyasmādvacanādbhavati ? etadapi nāsti prayojanam; acīti viṣayasaptamī, tena gotra iti vivakṣite'nutpanna eva luki pratiṣiddhe paścādiño lugiti siddhamiṣṭam | tadevamalvidheḥ kasyacid darśanāt sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhamiti nārtho'nena |
evaṃ tarhi niyamārtamidam-'pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇameva yathā syāt pratyayāpratyalakṣaṇaṃ mā bhūt' iti | etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasminkārye vidhīyamāne pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpaṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate, tadeva pratyayalope'pi bhavati, na punaḥ pratyayāpratyasādhāraṇaṃ rūpamāśritya yadvidhīyate taditi | tena śobhanā dṛṣado yasya sudṛṣaditi 'sormanasī alomoṣasī' ityuttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati | anyathā lupte'pi jasi sthānivadbhāvenāsantamuttarapadamiti syātprasaṅgaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, 'aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti' ityasmāttasya grahaṇāt |
vṛttikāreṇa tu ' niyamārthamapyetat pratyayalope sarvatra pravartate' iti matvoktaṃ padasaṃjñā bhavatīti | āghnayeti | 'āṅo yamahanaḥ' | saṃgmīyeti | 'samo gamyacchi' ityātmanepadam, 'iṭo't', bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo luk, ubhayatra 'gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ ||
na lumatāṅgasya || 1.1.63 ||
'lumatā' iti luśabdo yasminnasti sa lumān-lugādiḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ | karaṇe ca tṛtīyā, lope ca karaṇatvam | 'pratyayalope' ityanuvṛtteḥ lumatā śabdena pratyayalope sati aṅgasya pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati | tatra ca pratyāsatterluptapratyayāpekṣayā yenāṅgasaṃjñā pratilabdhā tasya tannimittaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīsyarthaḥ | etadeva vastuto darśayati --lumatā lupte pratyaye yadaṅgamiti | tenotkrāmetyatra 'ato heḥ' iti luki kṛte parasmaipadāpekṣayā yayaṅgaṃśabantaṃ na tasya dīrghatvam, yasya ca dīrghatvaṃ na tatparasmaipadāpekṣayāṅgam | kiṃ tarhi ? śabapekṣayeti niṣedhābhāvāt pratyayalakṣaṇena 'kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' iti dīrgho bhavati, tathā 'gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu' 'na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ' iṭo vidhipratipredhau jigamiṣa vivṛtseti parasmaipadalukyapi bhavataḥ | lumatā lupte parasmaipade yadaṅgaṃ sanantaṃ na tasyeṭo vidhiniṣedhau, kiṃ tarhi ? sakārādeḥ pratyayasyeti | idaṃ cānyadasmin granthe darśitam-nāṅgasyetyanenāṅgādhikāraḥ pratinirdiśyate 'na lumatā lupte pratyaye āṅgaṃ bhavati' iti, kiṃ tarhi ? lumatā lupte pratyaye yadṅgaṃ tasyāṅgamanāṅgaṃ ca sarvaṃ pratiṣidhyate iti | tena gargāḥ, bidāḥ-yañañorluk, uṣṭragrīvaḥ-'ive pratikṛtau' iti kanaḥ 'devapathādibhyaśca' iti lup, panthāḥ priyo'sya pathipriyaḥ--'supodhātu' iti sarvanāmasthānasya luk | atra 'ñnityādirnityam','pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne' iti cādyudāttasyānāṅgasyāpi niṣedho bhavati | saptamīnirddeśāddhyetadvastuto'ṅgasya kāryam | tathā'hardadāti - 'roḥ supi' iti ratvapratiṣedho na bhavati | yadyanāṅgamapi pratiṣidhyate, avadhi bhavatā dasyuḥ, āgāyi bhavatā grāmaḥ, adhyagāyi bhavatā'nuvākaḥ; luṅi parato'ṅgasya vidhīyamānā haniṇiṅādeśāḥ 'ciṇo luk' iti luṅo luki na syuḥ | na luṅi haniṇiṅādeśā vidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? luṅi yadārdhadhātukaṃ tatra | tataśca luṅi yadaṅgaṃ ciṇantaṃ na tasya haniṇiṅādeśāḥ, yasya ca te na tallukyaṅgamiti niṣedhābhāvaḥ |
iha tarhi 'mā hi dātāṃ sarpirāgacchet' iti sijāmantritayorluki sati 'ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyāmāmantritasya ca' iti ādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt ? naitadaṅgasya ciṇantaṃ kāryam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadantasya; ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt | tena payaḥ sāmetyādau padasaṃjñā ca bhaviṣyati | nanu yadyapi tadantasyādyudāttatvam, padasaṃjñā'pi, tathā lupte idānīṃ pratyaye vastuto'ṅgasya prāpnuta iti bhavitavyaṃ niṣedhena ? nātra lupte pratyaye yadaṅgasya prāptaṃ tanniṣidhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? avasthite'pi pratyaye yattataḥ pūrvasyāṅgasya kāryaṃ tanniṣidhyate | vṛkṣā mā hi lābiṣṭāmityādau ca śrūyamāṇo pratyaye tadantasyaiva padasaṃjñā svaraśceti lupte'pi bhaviṣyataḥ | evaṃ ca rājñaḥ puruṣa iti śrūyamāṇe ṅasi, tataḥ pūrvasya bhasaṃjñā na tadantasyeti aṅgakāryatvāt lupte'pi tasmin pratyayalakṣaṇena prāptā'nena niṣidhyate ||
iha tarhi atrerapatyāni 'itaścāniñaḥ' iti ṭhakaḥ 'atribhṛgu' iti luki kṛte atraya iti taddhitasya 'kitaḥ' ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt, tadantakāryatvāt, naiṣadoṣā; taddhitasyaivāntodāttatvam, na tadantasya |
iha tarhi sarvaḥ stomo yasya sarvastomaḥ-'sarvasya supi' ityādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt, supīti saptamīnirddeśāt ? kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ | yatnaśca-sarvasya supa iti ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdaśe tu tadantakāryatvāt sicsvaravat sidhyati | nanu dvayoripa pakṣayoḥ-abhūvan, pratyayalakṣaṇena jusprāpnoti, 'ātaḥ' iti niyamānna bhaviṣyati |
iha tarhi devadattaṃ yājayāñcakāra--'āmaḥ' iti lukaṃ bādhitvā paritvāttibādhiṣu kṛteṣu teṣāṃ ca luki pratyayalakṣaṇena tiṅantatvādāmantasya ca vidhātaḥ, tataḥ parasyānighātaśca prāpnoti, lerityanuvṛtterlāvasthāyāmeva lugbhaviṣyati | iha ca devadatto yuṣmatputra iti ṣaṣṭhantasya vidhīyamānau vāṃnānau 'dvitīyāsthāyoḥ iti sthagrahaṇānna bhavataḥ | ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsvavasthānaṃ śrūyamāṇasyaiva sambhavati |
iha tarhi paramavācā, paramagauduhā, paramalihā, paramadaṇḍinā, paramadivāparamakumāryeti samāsārthā yā vibhaktiḥ, tāmāśrityottarapadasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptayām, 'coḥ kuḥ', 'dāderdhātorghaḥ','ho ḍhaḥ ', nalopaḥ pratipadikāntasya' 'diva ut','iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca' iti -ete vidhayaḥ prāpnuvanti naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhasaṃjñāviṣaye tāvatsaiva padasaṃjñāṃ bādhiṣyate | nanu ca samudāyasya padasaṃjñā svādiṣvati prāptā sā tulyāvidhikayā bhasaṃjñayā bādhyatām, yā tuttarapadasya subantamiti prāpta sā kathaṃ bādhyate, bhinnāvadhitvāt ? evaṃ tarhi 'suptiṅantam' ityataḥ subantamityanuvarttanīyam, tataścāyamartho bhavati-'yajādāvasarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pūrvassamudāyo bhasaṃjño bhavati | tatra ca samudāye yatsubantaṃ vartate tadapi bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavati yajādāvanantare' iti | tatra ca samudāyasya bhasaṃjñā pradhānaśiṣṭā, avayavasya tvanvāyaśiṣṭā | yatra ca subantaṃ paśyati tatra tasyāpīti, tena rājña ityādau subantābhāve'pi bhavati | subantasadbhāve tu tasya samudāyasya ceti vivektavyam | sarvanāmasthāne'pi 'asarvanāmasthāne' iti pratiṣedhāt padasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati | nanu 'svādiṣu' iti yā prāptiḥ samudāyasya, tasyā eva sa pratiṣedhaḥ, netyāha; tatrāpi subantamityanuvartate, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāśrīyate, tatsāmarthyāt 'anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti nāśrīyate; tataścāyamartho bhavati--'sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pūrvasay samudāyasaṃya svādiṣviti prāptā padasaṃjñā na bhavati | tatra ca yatsubantamavayavatvena varttate, tasya subantasya padasaṃjñā na bhavati' iti | yadyevam; suvāk, surājeti sāvapi samudāyasyāvayavasya ca svādiṣviti vā subantamiti vā padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt kutvādi na syāt | evaṃ tarhi 'asarvanāmasthāne' ityatra uttarasūtrādyacītyapakṛṣyate, tato yajādau sarvanāmasthāne yā ca yāvatī ca padasaṃjñā, sā sarvā pratiṣidhyate; sau tu svādiṣviti ca subantamiti ca bhavatyeva | yadyevam, śrūyamāṇae'pi sau pūrvasya padasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? 'eco'pragṛhyasya' ityatra padāntagrahaṇaṃ codayiṣyati-bhadraṃ karoṣi gaurityatra mā bhūditi | tatra kriyamāṇe'pi padāntagrahaṇe plutavikāraḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākyapadayorantyasyetyevametadvijñāyate, tadevaṃ samāseṣūttarapadasya padatvaṃ nāstīti sthitam | yadyevam, dadhisecau, dadhisecaḥ 'sātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedho na prāpnoti, naivaṃ vijñāyate-padasyādiḥ padādiḥ, padāderneti, kathaṃ tarhi ? padādādiḥ padādiḥ, dāderneti | kathamagniṣu, vākṣu, tvakṣu ? sātpratiṣedho jñāpayatisvādau yatpadaṃ tataḥ parasya neti | avaśyaṃ ca padādādirityevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā 'gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ' iti yatra subantamuttarapadaṃ tatra pratiṣedho na syāt |
iha tarhi bahusecau, bahusecam, bahuco'padatvāt, pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, vaktavyamevaitat 'bahucpūrvasya na' iti, tatrāyaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ-sāte saḥ ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, tato 'bahucaḥ',bahucaḥ parasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati; ādigrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, 'ādeḥ parasya' ityeva siddham | tadidaṃ bahujgrahaṇena nimātavyam |
kāryate, hāryate iti | ṇyantātkarmaṇi lakāraḥ, yak, ṇilopaḥ | nanu cātrāntaraṅgā vṛddhirutpannamātra eva ṇau bhavati, lopastu yaki bhavan bahiraṅgaḥ | evaṃ tarhi vibhajyānvākhyānapakṣe etatpratyudāhṛtam ||
aco'ntyādi ṭi || 1.1.64 ||
ante bhavo'ntyaḥ digāditvādyat, antyāditi bahuvrīhiḥ | yadyapyacāmityetadapekṣo'ntyaśabdastathāpi sambandhiśabdatvena nityasāpekṣatvādiviruddhaḥ samāsaḥ nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | yadyevaṃ nirddhāraṇasyānekāśrayatvād aca ityekavacanamunapapannam, tatrāha-jātāviti | yo'ntyo'jiti |nirddhāraṇasya sajātīyaviṣayatvādajiti labhyam | icchabda ityādi rūpodaharaṇam | kāryaṃ tvagnici tamācaṣṭe ṇici 'ṇāviṣṭhavat' iti ṭilopaḥ | pacete ityādi kāryodāharaṇam ||
alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā || 1.1.65 ||
samudāya evāntyo bhavatītyāha--dhātvādāviti | 'alaḥ' iti jasantaṃ ced antyasyāviśeṣitatvāt samudāyādapi pūrvasya saṃjñāyāṃ śiṣṭa iti śakārasyetvaṃ syād, asandehārthamalityeva ca brūyād; ato'ntyādityānayā samānādhikaraṇā pañcamītyāha--antyādala iti | yadyevam, pūrvasyāviśeṣitatvāt samudāyasyāpi saṃjñāyāṃ śiṣṭa iti ' śā' iti samudāyasyetvaṃ prāpnoti, 'alo'tyasya' ityantyasya bhaviṣyati | 'nānarthake'lontyavidhiranabhyāsavikāreṣu', tatra yathā-ābhyāmityatra 'hali lopaḥ' idrūpasya vidhīyamāno lopo'ntyasya na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syād; ato'lo'ntyātpūrvo'liti āha-aleveti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ, yathāntyo'l, evaṃ pūrvo'pyaleveti | kathaṃ punarddhitīyasalgrahaṇamantareṇāyamartho labhyate ? lokataḥ | loke hyamīṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāmantyātpūrva ānayatāmityukte eka evāntyātpūrvo'nantara ānīyate, na samudāyaḥ | saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ kṛñarthamityatrāvayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya saṃyogasyopadhāvyapadeśaḥ | akāra ityādīni rūpodāharaṇāni | kāryaṃ tu pācaka ityādau 'ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ | bhedaka ityādau 'punagantalaghūpadhasya ca' iti guṇaḥ | śiṣṭa iti | śāserniṣṭhā, 'śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ' itītvam, 'śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam ||
tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya || 1.1.66 ||
itikaraṇasya gaurityayamāhetyādau svarūpapadārthakatvena vyavasthāpakatvādarśanāt 'tasminnaṇi ca' ityatropāttasyaidamanukaraṇam, tataśca tatraivāsya pravṛttiḥ syād | asti ca tatra vyavacchedyaṃ he yauṣmākīṇamasmabhyaṃ dehi, āsmākīnaṃ yuṣmabhyaṃ dadāmīti paranivṛttiḥ, tāmināṃ bhrāntimapākaroti--tasminniti saptamyarthanirdeśa iti | etena 'tasyāpatyam' 'tatra bhavaḥ' ityādivat svatantrasya sarvanāmno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tadvadeva tasminniti sāmānyaviśeṣaṇamaci, halītyādīnāmupalakṣaṇam; na tvanukaraṇamiti darśayati | etaccetikaraṇāllabhyate | sa hi padārthaviparyāsakṛt | śāstre ca svārupapādarthaḥ, tasya viparyāso'rthapadārthakatā | yadi ca 'tasminnaṇi ca' ityatraivaitadupāsthāsyata tatraiva pūrvagrahaṇamakariṣyateti bhāvaḥ | kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyate ? 'iko yaṇaci' ityādau sandehaḥ-kiṃ satsaptamī ? kiṃ vā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti vadaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇe saptamī ? iti | tatra sattvaṃ parasya ca pūrvasya ca sambhavati, evamupaśleṣo'pi | tatra pūrvasya parasya ca vyavahitānantarasya yaṇ prāptaḥ, dadhyudakādiṣu tu yugapadekasya kāryitvanimittatvāyogātparyāyeṇa yaṇ prāptaḥ; iṣyate ca pūrvasyaiva syādanantarasyaiveti, tatra nimārthamidam--saptamīnirdeśe pūrvasya bhavati anantarasyaiveti | 'iko yaṇaci' ityādeśca sakṛtpravṝttiḥ, sā cevaṃ viśoṣiteti na kvāpyaniṣṭaśaṅkā | tatrādyaṃ niyamaṃ darśayati-pūrvasyaiveti | vyāvatyaṃ darśayati-nottarasyeti |
pacatyodanamiti | yadyapyatrāniyamaprasaṅgo nāsti, tathāpi 'iko yaṇaci' ityasminsūtre'niyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyata ityetadapi bhavatyevodāharaṇam | dvitīyaṃ niyamaṃ darśayati-nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamiti | diśiruccāraṇakriyaḥ, niḥśabdo nairantarye, nirantaraṃ diṣṭo nirdiṣṭa ityevamānantaryamartho bhavati, tatraivaṃ vacanavyaktiḥ-aci halītyādau pūrvasyaiva kāryaṃ bhavati, tatra nirdiṣṭe - nirantara evoccārita iti tatrārthātpūrvasyānantarasyetyartho bhavati | tadāha-vyavahitasya mā bhūditi | anyathā vyavahite mā bhūditi vaktavyam; pūrvapadasya vyavahite'pi vṛttestasya prasaṅgāt ||
tasmādityuttarasya || 1.1.67 ||
nirdiṣṭagrahathaṇamanuvarttata iti | tenātrāpi vyavahite kāryaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi itiparatvādanukaraṇamiti kasyācid bhrānti syāt; 'tasmānnuḍ‌ dvihalaḥ' ityatra 'ata ādeḥ' iti dīrghatpūrvasyāṅgasyāsambhavāt prayojanābhāvāt yadyapi tasyānukaraṇaṃ na bhavati; 'tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' 'tasmānnu ḍaci' ityatra tu vyavacchedyamasti, uccārito'nupalabhyate, gauranaśva iti pūrvasya mā bhūditi, atastayorevedamanukaraṇamiti tāmimā bhrāntipākaroti-tasmāditi pañcamyarthanirdeśa iti | etena pūrvasasūtravat svatantrasya sarvanāmno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ | tadvadeva ca tasmāditi sāmānyamatiṅa ityādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāmupalakṣaṇam, na tvanukaraṇamiti darśayati | etacchetikaraṇāllabhyata ityuktam | kimarthaṃma punaridamārabhyate ? 'tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' ityādau kārakavibhākterasambhāvaddigyogalakṣaṇā pañcamīti, dik‌chabdastvadhyāhāryaḥ; tatra pūrvottaraśabdayoradhyāhāraḥ sambhavatīti niyamārthā paribhāṣeyam | tadāha--uttarasyaiva kāryamiti | tadevaṃ pūrvasya cāsya ca vṛttikāreṇa niyamārthatvaṃ darśitam |
ṣaṣṭhīpraklṛptipakṣo'pi bhāṣye pradarśitaḥ | katham ? 'ṣaṣṭhī' iti vartate, saptamyarthanirdeśe pūrvasyānantarasya ṣaṣṭhī | pañcamyarthanirdeśe, uttarasyānantarasya ṣaṣṭhīti; tatra 'iko yaṇaci' ityādau yatra pūrvameva ṣaṣṭhī vidyate tatra pūrvasyānantarasya, nottarasyānantarasya sā ṣaṣṭhītyucyate | 'āne muk' 'īdāsaḥ' ityādau tu yatra ṣaṣṭhī nāsti, tatra ṣaṭhyapi prakalpyate sā cāniyatayogatvāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati | yasya ca sthānaṣaṣṭhī syaiva kāryamiti sarvatra kāryaniyamo'pi sidhyati | yatra tūbhayanirdeśa statra yā'navakāśā sā itarasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati, yathā-'āne muk' iti saptamī 'niravakāśā 'ato yeyaḥ' iti pañcamyāḥ pūrvasūtre sāvakāśāyāḥ | evam ' ī dāsaḥ' iti pañcamī 'āne muk' thaiti saptamyāḥ,ubhayostvanavakāśayoḥ paratvātpañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayati, yathā-'āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' iti sarvanāmna iti pañcamyanavakāśāmīti saptamyā anavakāśāyāḥ | atha saptamyuttarārthā tathāpyādityanuvṛttayā pañcamyā samānādhikaraṇā 'sarvānāmnaḥ' iti pañcamyapi sāvakāśā ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati | evaṃ niyamapakṣe'pi paratvānavakāśatvābhyāṃ vyavasthāṃ draṣṭavya | 'dīrghācche tugbhavati' ityatra ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne pañcamīvyākhyānād dīrghasyaiva tuk bhavati, na tu chasya; tathā ca 'surācchāyā' iti nirdeśa upapadyate ||
svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśbadasaṃjñā || 1.1.68 ||
svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇe prāpte niyamārthā paribhāṣeyam | śāstrāṅgatvācca paribhāṣāṇāṃ śāstra eva niyamaḥ, na loka ityāha--śāstre svamevetyādi, grāhyamiti | 'grāhmam' iti ṇijantād yat, etaccādhyāhāreṇa labdham | śabdasyeti 'kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā' iti ṣaṣṭhī, śabdaḥ svameva rūpaṃ grāhayati bodhayatītyarthaḥ | saṃjñāpakṣe tu vṛttāveva śabdaḥ saṃjñānuccāraṇaṃ ca nopapadyeta | sūtre ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśo'pi nātīva yuktaḥ syāt; saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhe prāyeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāt | rūpaśabdena cehāgniśabdatvādikaṃ śukasārikāpuruṣādibhirudīritā subhinnāsu śabdavyaktiṣu samavetaṃ sāmānyamibhidhīyate | 'agnerḍhak' iti sūtrakāreṇa yā vyaktiruccāritā, tasyāḥ sarvoccāraṇeṣvanugataṃ sāmānyaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ | sāmānyasya kāryayogo vyaktidvāraka iti tena tenoccāritāyā stasyāstasyā vyakterḍhag bhavatītyarthaḥ sampadyate |
evakārasya vyacchedyaṃ darśayati--na bāhyo'rtha iti | śabdasaṃjñāṃ varjayitveti | śabdasaṃjñāsu svarūpaṃ grāhyaṃ nabhavatītyarthaḥ | aniyamaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kartavyastaṃ darśayati-śabdenetyādi | loke gaurupalabhyatāmityukte'rtha eva kāryayogo gamyate, na hi śabdarūmupalabhya kṛtī bhavati; vyākaraṇe tu pratyayavidhānādikāryamarthe na sambhavati, tena saha paurvāparyāyogāt | tena 'agnerḍhak' ityukte lokavadartha eva tāvatpratīyate, tatra sambhavo nāsti; atastadvācināṃ sarveṣāṃ sampratyayaḥ syād, yathā-ākṛtiyodanāyāṃ vyaktīnām, mā bhūdeṣa doṣaḥ; upāttādeva yathā syāditi niyamārthamidamārabhyata ityarthaḥ |
audaśvitkamiti | udaśviti saṃskṛtamiti saptamīsamarthāṭṭak, 'isusuktāntātkaḥ' |
ghugrahaṇeṣvityādi | anyathā 'upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' iti kipratyayo dhātoreva ghoḥ śabdārthatsyāt, na tu dādhābhyaḥ | 'ī halyaghoḥ' ityatra tu ghuśabdasyānākārāntatvāddādhānāmeva grahaṇaṃ sidhyati | kumārīgha ityatra 'gharūpa' iti hrasvaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu ca pradeśeṣu saṃjñisampratyāyanārthaṃ saṃjñākaraṇamiti sāmarthyāt svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; ubhayagatiriha śāstre sambhavatīti saṅkhyākarmakaraṇādiṣviva svarūpasya saṃjñinaśca pradeśeṣu grahaṇaṃ syāt | jñāpakātsiddham; yadayaṃ 'ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ' iti ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāṃ vidadhāti, tajjñāpayati-saṃjñāśabdo na svarūpagrāhaka iti | anyathā 'ṣaḍbhyo lukṣaṭcaturbhyaśca' ityādau svarūpasyāpi ṣaḍityasya grahaṇāt ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ na vidadhyāt |
nanu ca ṣakārāntā saṃjñā ṣakārāntasya kāryamiṣyate, saṃjñāpi ṣakārāntaiva; ato nārtho'śabdasaṃjñetyanena ? satyam; pratipattigauravaparihārārthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | śabdaśabdena cābhedīpacārāt vyākaraṇamucyate, śabde saṃjñā śabdasaṃjñā; evaṃ ca karmakaraṇamityādiṣvarthasaṃjñāsvapi śāstrīyāsu svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati |
atha rūpagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, iha yāvatā pratītāvupadeśānapekṣatvādasādhāraṇatvānnityasambandhitvācca tadeva śabdasya svārtho hi svapratītau sambandhagrahaṇamapekṣate, paryāyairapi pratyāyanātsādhāraṇaścānityasaṃbandhaścānukaraṇadaśāyāmabhāvāt, na cārtho grāhakaḥ śakyate kartum, grāhyatve ca sūtramanarthakaṃ syāditi nārtho rūpagrahaṇena ? evaṃ tarhyotaj jñāpayati--śāstre svarūpeṇa samānakakṣyo'rthaḥ' iti | tenārthavad‌grahaṇenānarthakasyetyupapannaṃ bhavati | tatra jñāpakādartho'pi grāhyaḥ; svaṃ rūpamiti vacanād | rūpaṃ ceti sāmarthyādarthavato rūpasya grahaṇam | tena kāśe kuśe ityatra 'śe' pragṛhyasaṃjñābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
sittadviśeṣāṇāmiti vārttikaṃ vyācaṣṭe-sinnirdeśaḥ karttavya iti | vṛkṣas ityevam | tato vaktavyamiti | svaṃ rūpamityasyānantaram | nanu kiṃ prayojanamityukte vṛkṣādītivaktavyam, kimucyate-vṛkṣādyarthamiti ? vṛkṣādiṣu prayojanamasyetyukte vṛkṣādyasya prayojanamityarthāduktaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ | asyārthasya nyāyataḥ siddhiṃ vibhāṣetyatra vakṣyāmaḥ |
pitparyāyavacanasya ceti | cakārātsvasvarūvasya viśeṣāṇāṃ ca | idaṃ vācanikameva | jitparyāyasyetyāsyāpi nyāyataḥ siddhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
jhittasya ceti | idaṃ vācanikameva | mṛgapakṣiṇastu pinnirdeśaḥ karttavya ityāhuḥ | athaikasyeti | iyamiṣṭireva ||
aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ || 1.1.69 ||
saṃjñāsūtrametat na paribhāṣā; prasiddhārthaviniyogāt | pareṇa ṇakāreṇeti | etacca 'laṇ' ityatra pratipāditam | svasya ca rūpasyeti yadyapi prathamāntaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpi savarṇasya ceti ṣaṣṭhyantasyānantaraṃ śrūyamāṇaścaśabdo'nyasya ṣaṣṭhantasyābhāvāt tasyaiva ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ prakalpayatīti bhāvaḥ | pratyayaṃ varjayitveti | tena tatroccāritameva rūpaṃ gṛhyate | 'ād guṇaḥ' ityādi | yatheha bhavati devendra iti, evaṃ khaṭvendra ityādāvapi bhavati | asya cvo | yatheha bhavati śuklībhavatīti, evaṃ mālībhavatītyādāvapi bhavati | yasyeti ca | yatheha bhavati dākṣiḥ plākṣiriti, evaṃ cauḍirbālākirityādāvapi bhavati | jūḍābalākāśabdau bāhvādī |
nanu ca 'akaḥ' 'aci' ityādau pratyāhāragrahaṇe kathaṃ madhyavarttirikārādibhissavarṇagrahaṇam, uccārito hi saṃjñāśabdaḥ saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayati, na ca madhyavarttināmuccāraṇamasti | te hyagādisaṃjñābhiḥ saṃjñitvena pratyāyyante, kva tarhi syāt ? 'asya cvau' 'yasyeti' yatra saṃjñāyā uccāraṇamasti | pratyāhāre cādyo varṇa uccāritatvātsavarṇagrahāhakaḥ | syādetat-akṣarasamāmnāya uccāritā ikārādayaḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhakā iti | agādicodanāsu īkārādayo'pi hrasvavatsaṃjñitvenaiva pratīyante tvikārādibhiḥ pratītaiḥ pratyāyyanta iti, na; aparakālatvāt | iha varṇānāmupadeśastāvad, upadeśottarakālā itsaṃjñā, itsaṃjñottarakālamādirantyenaitatpravarttate, tato'ṇ savarṇasyeti | tadanenopadeśādiṣvaṅgeṣu niṣpanneṣu anyatra 'asya cvau' ityādau savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nāṅgeṣu, nāpi svātmani; aniṣpannatvāt | yadi tvasminnapi sūtre savarṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt,'ādṛgamahanaḥ','ṝdorap' ityādau akārādayo'pi savarṇān gṛhṇīyuḥ | ato'smin sūtre'kṣarasamāmnoye cāgṛhītasavarṇānāṃ grahaṇam | tataśca tadeva sthitam pratyāhāreṣu madhyavarttibhiḥ savarṇagrahaṇaṃ na syāditi, naiṣa doṣaḥ; uccāryamāṇaireva pratyāyakairbhavitavyamiti nāsti niyamaḥ, buddhyupārūḍhāstu pratyāyakāḥ | asti ca madhyavartināṃ buddhyupārohaḥ, tataśca saṃjñitvena pratyāyyamānasyāpi pratyāyakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | atra jñāpakam--'dīrghājjāsi ca' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | sa hi kumāryāvityādau 'prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' iti dīrgho mā bhūditi | tatra cāka iti varttate | khaṭve ityādau tu 'nādici' ityeva siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | 'dīdhīvevīṭāmlvādibhyaḥ' ityādayaśca nirddeśā evamevopapadyante,yadi madhyavarttibhirapi savarṇagrahaṇaṃ bhavati | svarānunāsiketyādirudāttaḥ sūtre gṛhītaḥ svarāntarabhinnamapi gṛhṇāti, evamanudāttasvaritau ca | tathā sānunāsiko niranunāsikam, so'pi tam |
dīrgho na bhavatīti | asati tvapratyaya ityasmin pratyayenāpi savarṇagrahaṇāt dīrgho'pi syāt | atyalpamidamucyate-'apratyayaḥ' iti, 'apratyayādeśaṭitkiṃnmita iti vaktavyam' | pratyaye pratyudāhṛtaṃ tatra | ādeśe-'idam iś',itaḥ; iha viśeṣa vihitatvātt‌yadādyatvaṃ bādhitvā trimātrika ādeśaḥ prāpnoti | ṭiti--'ārddhadhātu kasyeḍ valādeḥ', paṭhiteti dīrgho'pi syāt | 'graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' ityetattu graherdīrgha eva, na hrasva iti niyamārthaṃ syāt | 'vṝto vā' ityetadapi vavaritheti liṭi dīrgho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt | kiti-'bhuvo vugluṅ‌liṭoḥ' babhūva, anunāsiko'pi syāt | miti-'am sambuddho' he anaḍvan, āmapi syāt, evaṃ tarhyapratyaya iti neha saṃjñāgrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? anvarthagrahaṇam-pratīyate vidhīyata iti pratyayaḥ, bhāvyamānaḥ savarṇānna gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | iśādayopi bhāvyante | saṃjñāpratyayasya tu nāvaśyakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | yenārthampratiyanti sa pratyayaḥ, na hi dīrghaplutayorarthasyābhidhānamasti | 'kuhoḥ ścuḥ' ityādau bhāvyamānasyāpyudittvāsāmarthyādapratyaya iti niṣedhābhāvaḥ | tathā ca paṭhyate-'bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti' iti ||
taparastatkālasya || 1.1.70 ||
taḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati | tādapi parastapara iti pañcamītatpuruṣam || sa punarasmādeva nipātanādveditavyaḥ | ekasyāpi taparaśabdasya tantrāvṛttyoranyatarāśrayaṇādarthabhedo na viruddhaḥ | tatra bahuvrīherliṅgam--'ato bhisa ais' iti taparakaraṇam | tatpuruṣasya liṅgam-vṛddhirādaic' ityaijarthaṃ hi tadityuktam |
taparo varṇa iti | varṇasyaiva savarṇaṃsambhavādvarṇa ityuktam | tatkālasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ-sa kālo'syeti | ayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ | tadityanena taparo varṇaḥ parāmṛśyate, prasiddhaparimāṇā ca kriyā prasiddhaparimāṇasya kriyāntarasya paricchedikā | kālo yathā--divasamadhīta iti, divasaśabdenodayādirastamayānta ādityagatiprabandha ucyate | sa cādhyayanasya paricchedakatvāt kālaḥ; varṇastu kriyātmako na bhavatītyayuktaṃ varṇavācinastacchabdasya kālaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? evaṃ tarhyuttarapadalopī samāso draṣṭavyaḥ, uṣṭramukhavat | gamyamānārthatvācca prayoga eva lopaḥ, yathā-uṣṭro mukhamasyetyeva vigrahaḥ | na ca praṇī praṇyantarasya mukhamiti sāmarthyāt sādṛśyapratītiḥ | uṣṭra iva mukhamasyeti mukhenaiva mukhasya sādaḍaśyaṃ prasiddham, na kṛtsnenoṣṭreṇeti sāmarthyādayamartho bhavati-uṣṭramukhamiva mukhamasyeti | evamihāpi varṇaḥ kālo na bhavatīti sāmarthyāttadīyā kriyāntareṇa nimeṣādinā paricchinnā satī varṇāntarasya paricchediketi varṇa eva paricchedaka ityucyate | sa kālo'syetyasya ko'rthaḥ ? tatkālasaṃbandhinī kriyā paricchedikā asyetyarthaḥ | etadeva darśayati--ātmanetyādinā || taparavarṇasannadhāvuccārito'pyayamātmaśabdastatsahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyāṃ vartate, varṇena kriyāyāstulyatvānupapatteḥ | yādṛśī taparasya varṇasyoccāraṇakriyā nimeṣādiparicchinnā, tādṛśyuccāraṇakriyā'syetyarthaḥ |
guṇāntarayuktasyeti | yad‌graṇaka upāttastato guṇāntarayuktasyetyarthaḥ | kiṃ punaridaṃ niyamārtham ? ahosvidvidhyartham ? tatrāṇityanuvṛttau niyamārtham-taparo varṇastatkālasyaiveti | nivṛttau vidhyartham | tatrādye pakṣe 'āto dhātoḥ', 'ātāṃ puṅṇau' 'yasyeti ca' 'viḍvanoranuvāsikasyāt' ityādau 'bhedakā guṇāḥ' 'ityasmin darśane yadgraṇaka upāttastato guṇāntarayuktasya grahaṇaṃ na syāditi dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-vidhyarthamiti | atra hetumāha-aṇiti nānuvarttata iti | yadi vidhyarthamidam, tato'syānaṇsu caritārthatvādaṇsu pūrvameva pravartteta, tatrāha-aṇāmanyeṣāṃceti | etadeva viśadayati-ato bhisa aisityevamādiṣviti | na pravarttata eveti | pareṇānena bādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | virodho hyatra vartate-pūrvasūtreṇa hyaṣṭādaśānāṃ grahaṇam, anena tu ṣaṇṇāmiti |
kimudāharaṇamiti | abhedakatvāt guṇānāmanaṇsu siddhamiti praśnaḥ, aṇsu bhinnakālanivṛttyarthaṃ tāvadārabdhavyaṃ sūtram | tadevānaṇsvapi vidhimukhena pravartamānamiṣṭaṃ sādhayatītyuttaram | viḍ‌vanoranunāsikasyāditi | kasya punaratra savarṇasya grahaṇamiṣyata iti cintyam | tasmādupalakṣaṇametat | 'āto dhātoḥ' 'yasyeti ca' ityādāveva prayojanam |
tatkālasyeti kimiti | pradhānāvayavadvāreṇa sūtramevākṣipyate | khaṭvāmiriti | varṇāśrayavidhāvantādivadbhāvo na bhavati ||
ādirantyena sahetā || 1.1.71 ||
idamapi saṃjñāsūtram, ādyantayormadhyāpekṣatvānmadhyavartināṃ saṃjñitvaṃ vijñāyate, 'svaṃ rūpam' ityanuvṛtteḥ svarūpasya cetyāha-madhyavarttināmiti | yadyapyādyantāvavayavā avayavinaḥ samudāyarūpasya sambandhinau tathāpi tasya yugapallakṣye prayogābhāvātsamudāyināṃ saṃjñeti darśayati-varṇānāmiti | svasya ca rūpasyeti | svarūpamādereva gṛhyante, nāntyasya; aprādhānyāditi dadhyatreti kevala eva yakāraḥ pravarttate, na ṇakāreṇa sahitaḥ | sahagrahaṇādādyantau samuditau saṃjñeti samudāyādeva vibhaktirbhavati 'iko yaṇ' iti, nādimātrāt | ṭā ityanena grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi | tāvato'vadheravivakṣitatvānnāyamantyaḥ 'ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyaḥ' 'dvitīyāṭausvenaḥ' iti tṛtīyaikavacanasyāsau viśeṣaṇārthaḥ ||
yena vidhistadantasya || 1.1.72 ||
svarūpavidhiparihārāyāyamārambhaḥ | idamapi saṃjñāsūtram | yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyā | vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ, karmasādhanaḥ kipratyayaḥ | vidhirvidhīyata iti | vadhiśabdena vidhānayogyaṃ vastvabhidhīyate, tasya sāṃpratikakriyāviśeṣadyotanāyākhyātaprayogaḥ | āsane āste, karaṇena karotītivat | tadantasyesi bahuvrīhiḥ | tadityanena yeneti nirdiṣṭaḥ śabdo nirdiśyate, tadāha--ātmāntasyeti | antaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāttadākṣiptasya samudāyasyeyaṃsaṃjñetyāha --samudāyasya saṃjñā bhavatīti | avaśyalāvyamiti | mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ, 'lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti malopaḥ |
atheha kasmādejantasya saṃjñā na bhavati 'eco'yavāyāvaḥ' iti, kiṃ syāt ? anekāltvādayādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ syuḥ; tataśca cayanalavanādiṣvayanamiti prāpnoti, prakaraṇādivaśāccākṣādivadarthaviśeṣāvagatiḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; 'nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyanti | atha vā-yathā ecā tadantavidhiḥ, evamayādibhirapi bhaviṣyati | evamapi'ād guṇaḥ' ityatra ādityavarṇānto gṛhyate, acīti cājāderiti khaṭvendra ityādāvavarṇāntasya samudāyasyājādeśca guṇaprasaṅgaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyanirdeśānnirdiśyamānasyetyapi nāsti | evaṃ tarhi naivaṃvidho'sya viṣayaḥ | yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyetyuktam, karaṇaṃ ca paratantram; kartradhiṣṭhitasyaiva karaṇatvāt | na ca 'erac' ityādāvikārādīnāṃ pāratantryam, dhātvādīnāṃ ca svātantryaṃ svarūpato'vabhāsate |
vā syāditi | vṛkṣādīnāmato vivakṣānibandhanaṃ tadubhayamiti | viśeṣaṇatvena vivakṣitaṃ paratantramapradhānam, viśeṣyatvena vivakṣitaṃ svatantraṃ pradhānam | tena viśeṣaṇaṃ viṣeṣyasya tadantasya saṃjñetyuktaṃ sambhavati | viśeṣyasannidhau ca viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, sannidhiśca kutracitsākṣānnirdeśena, yathā-'īdūdeddvivacanam' iti dvivacanasya | kvacidadhikāradyathā-'erac' iti dhātoḥ | kvacidākṣepād, yathā-'iko jhal' iti sanā dhātoḥ | 'eco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityādau na kathaṃcidviśeṣyasaṃnidhiriti naitatpravarttate | yadi viśeṣaṇaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā, tataḥ 'udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' ityatra ṛkārastadantasya dhātoḥ saṃjñeti oṣṭhyapūrvagrahaṇaṃ dhātoreva viśeṣaṇaṃ syād, na ñakārasya; saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñipratyayanārthatvāt | tataśceha syāt-saṅkīrṇamiti; pūrtamityādau ca na syāt | evam 'utaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvād ' ityatrāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamaṅgasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, notaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ; iyaṃ hi saṃjñā guṇapradhānabhāvāpekṣā tataśca 'utaśca pratyayād' ityādau viśeṣaṇasambandhavelāyāṃ guṇabhāvāsphuraṇāttamanubhūya paścāt viśeṣyeṇa sambandhe saṃjñā bhavati |
samāseti | anenaitadāha-śritādayo paścāt viśeṣyāstadviśeṣaṇaṃ ca sup | evaṃ 'naḍādibhyaḥ phak' ityādau naḍādiviśeṣyaṃ prātipadikaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti | kaṣṭaṃ paramaśrita iti | śritāntametatsubantaṃ na bhavatīti sambuddhyantaṃ paṭhitavyam, taddhipratyayalakṣaṇena subantaṃ bhavati śritāntaṃ ca śrūyate |
netyāheti | kaḥ punarāha ? uttaravādī, ācāryo vā |
ugidvarṇeti | ugitā varṇena ca prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyamityarthaḥ | yasminvidhiriti tadantavidhyapavādastadādividhiḥ, ato viśeṣaṇenaiva bhavati ||
vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad vṛddham || 1.1.73 ||
samudāyasyaivācāmādiḥ sambhavatīti sa eva yasyetyanenocyata ityāha--yasyeti samudāya ucyata iti | saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ cedam; anyathā tacchabdena kiṃ parāmṛśyate, tadityasyānupādāne vṛddhereva sā vṛddhasaṃjñā syāt | acāṃ madhya ityādi | atra yasyetyasyācāmityanena sambandhaḥ, ādiśca nirdhāryate, vṛddhirvidheyo dharmaḥ | ādiśabdaścopakramavacanaḥ-upakramyata ityupakramaḥ, prathama uccāryata ityarthaḥ | yasya samudāyasya sambandhināmacāṃ madhye prathamata uccāryamāṇo vṛddhisaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ | acāmiti jātau bahuvacanamiti | tena dvayorapi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | ekasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvād bhavati | śālīya iti | atra samudāyasya halāditve'pyajapekṣayā prathamo'c vṛddhiriti saṃjñā bhavati | nanu ca nirddhāraṇasya tulyajātīyaviṣayatvānnirddhāryamāṇa ādirapyajeva pratīyate, na vā ākāro'c; akṣarasamāmnāye'nupadeśāt | kathaṃ tarhi somapaṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti ackāryaṃ hrasvatvaṃ bhavati; savarkaṇagrahaṇāt, na tvactvāt | ihāpi tarhi savarṇagrahaṇābhāvātpratīyate | astu, tathāpratīyamāna eva savarṇaṃ grahīṣyati yathājgrahaṇe maghyavarttīkārādiḥ | kiñca-acāmiti nirddhāraṇaāśraye tāvadakārasyoccāritatvād ākāro'pi pratīyate | tena nirddhāryamāṇasyāpyākārādestathābhūtamevāctvaṃ pratīyata iti yatkiñcidetaccodyam |
vā nāmadheyasyeti | nāmadheyaśabdaḥ sāṅketikeṣu ruḍhaḥ | devadattīyā iti | kāśyādiṣu deśavācī devadattaśabdaḥ paṭhyate | 'eṅ‌ prācāṃ deśe' iti vṛddhasaṃjñakaḥ kāśyādibhiḥ sāhacaryādityadeśavācinaścha eva bhavati | vāhīkagrāmavācino|ṣapi devadakattaśabdasaryānāditvenāsāṅketikatvād aprācāṃ deśavācitvācca vṛddhasaṃthajñāyā abhāvāt kāśyādilakṣaṇau ṭhaññiṭhau na bhavataḥ |
gotrāntādityādi | gotraśabdena gotrapratyayāntaṃ gṛhyate, tadantādasamastavat kevalāt gotrāntādyaḥ pratyayo bhavati sa eva tadantādapi bhavatītyarthaḥ |
ghṛtarauḍhīyā iti | rūḍhaṛsyāpatyam 'ata iñ' śauṣikeṣvartheṣviñaścetyaṇaḥ 'na dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu' iti niṣedhād 'vṛddhācchaḥ' | evaṃ vṛddhāmbhīyāḥ-ambhaso'patyam 'sambhūyo'mbhasoḥ salopaśca' iti bāhvādiṣu pāṭhādiñ, salopaśca | odanapāṇinīyā iti | paṇino'patyamityaṇ 'gāthividathi' iti prakṛtibhāvāt 'ṭeḥ'ca iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ, pāṇinasyāpatyaṃ paṇino yuveti iñ, tasya chātrā iti vivakṣite 'yūni lug' iti iño luki kṛte'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena 'iñaśca' ityaṇ prāpto gotrādhikārānna bhavati | 'kaṇvādibhyo gotre ' ityatra tāvat pāribhāṣikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate tadeva 'itaśca' ityatrāpyanuvarttate, tena yūnīñ na bhavati | kaśyapaśabdo bidādiḥ, kataśabdo gargādiḥ, jihvācapalo haritabhakṣaśca kātyastato'ṇena bhavati | kaḥ punaratra pratyayātideśaprastāvaḥ, yāvatā śeṣādhikāre prāgdīvyato'ṇetra caitadvaktavyam ? satyam; kaiścittu gautrāntasya vṛddhasaṃjñā vihitā, evamapi vṛddhāmbhīyā iti siddheḥ | vārttikakārastu--"vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ piṅgalakāṇavasya chātrāḥ paiṅgalakāṇvā iti 'vṛddhācchaḥ' syāt | pratyayātideśe tu 'kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ labhyate" iti manyamānaḥ pūrvavākyena paramatamupanyasyānena vākyena nirasyati sma; tadeva paṭhitaṃ vṛttikāreṇa ||
tyadādīni ca || 1.1.74 ||
uttarārthamiti | tatra prayojanavattvāt yasyācāmādireṅiti sambandhasambhavācca | iha tu na sambadhyata iti | ayogyatvād nirddhāraṇasya sajātīya vaṣayatvāt tyadādīnāṃ cājātmakatvābhāvād na hyasti sambhavaḥ | yasyācāmādayastyadādaya iti | na ca tyadādisthe'ci tyadādiśabdo vartata iti kliṣṭakalpanāyuktā; uttarārthamapyanuvṛttisambhavāt | taduktam - uttarārthamanuvartata iti | tyādāyanirati | 'udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrād' iti phañ, 'pratyayottarapadayośca' ||
eṅprācāṃ deśe || 1.1.75 ||
prācāṃ deśābhidhāna iti | prāci deśe ye vasanti te prācaḥ puruṣāsteṣāṃ sambandhī yo deśastadabidhāna ityarthaḥ | etena śrutasya viśeṣaṇaṃ prācāṃ grahaṇaṃ nācāryāṇāmiti darśayati | tathā hi sati matenetyadhyāhāryaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | eṇīpacanīya ityādi | eṇīpacanādibhyaśchaḥ | daivadattā iti | 'vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' iti vṛddhāditi vihitau ṭhaññiṭhau na bhavataḥ | kāśyādipāṭhādapi na bhavataḥ; tatrāpi vṛddhādhikārāt | evaṃ kroḍo nāma grāmastatra bhavaḥ krauḍa ityaṇeva bhavati | kuṇinā tu prācāṃgrahaṇamācāryanirdeśārthaṃ vyākhyātam, bāṣyakāro'pi tathaivāśiśriyat | tena sepuraṃ skonagaraṃ ca vāhīkagrāmau, tatra 'vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' iti ṭhaññiṭhau bhavataḥ--saipurikī, saupurikā; skaunāgarikī, skaunagarikā | asya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca kroḍadevadattaśabdayoraprāgdeśavācinoṣṭhañ‍ñiṭhau na bhavataḥ | śaiṣikeṣvevārtheṣviyaṃ vṛddhisaṃjñeṣyate | tenāpatyavikārayoḥ 'udīcāṃ vayavasthitavibhāṣayaiva siddham | vṛttikārapakṣe tvetsarvaṃ vacanātsādhyam | gaumatā iti |
gomatī pragdeśe nadī deśagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, 'nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ' iti nadyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt 'eḍ‌ prācāṃ deśe' 'udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrād' ityādiṣu prāgudañcau śrutau, tayorvibhāgajñānārthamāha-prāgudañcāviti | śarāvatī nāma nadī uttarapūrvābhimukhī, tasyā dakṣiṇapūrvaṃsyāṃ diśi vyavasthito deśaḥ prāgdeśa; uttaraparasyāmudagdeśaḥ, tau śarāvatī vibhajate; tayā maryādayā tayo rvibhāgo jñāyate | kṣīrodakamiti | 'jātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvaḥ | kvacit 'kṣīrodake' iti pāṭhāttatra niyatavyaktivivakṣayā jātiparatvābhāvād dvivacanam | kimarthaṃ vibhajate ? viduṣāṃ śabdasiddhyartham | yadyapi nadyā evamuddeśo na bhavati --viduṣāṃ śabdā vyavasthitāḥ siddhyanti; tathāpi tayā hetubhūtayā vyavasthitaṃ śabdasādhutvamiti uddeśo'dhyāropyate | saivaṃbhūtā sā no'smān pātu | kvacit prāgudīcāviti pāṭhaḥ, tatra 'acpratyanvavapūrvāt' ityatrājitiyogavibhāgādacpratyayaḥ | 'uda īt' itīttvam | pragudīcamiti pāṭhe samāhāradvandvaḥ | 'dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti ṭac | kvacit prāgudīca iti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāvayavabahutvasya samudāya āropaḥ prāgdeśānnudagdeśām̐ścetyarthaḥ ||
iti haradattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryā prathamadhyāyasya
prathamaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ
<1.2>
atha prathamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

gāṅkuṭādibhyo'ñṇinṅit || 1.2.1 ||

kuṭa ādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhāvantarvartinyā vibhaktyā padatve'pi jaśtvaṃ na bhavati; anukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt | atha vā 'kuṭa kauṭilye' iti dhātupāṭhe yo'kārastena saha sānubandhānukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
atra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti-itsaṃjñakena ṅakāreṇa saha sambandhapratipādanam, ṅito vā vidhiḥ, saṃjñākaraṇam, tadvadatideśo veti | tatrādye pakṣe gāṅ‌kuṭādibhyaḥ paro'ñṇitapratyayo ṅid -itsaṃjñakaṅakārayuktaḥ, itsaṃjñako ṅakārastasyāstītyarthaḥ | atra yeṣāmasti ṅakāro yaṅādīnāṃ teṣu vyartho'nuvādaḥ, yeṣāṃ nāsti tavyādīnāṃ teṣu mithyodyamityupakrimamātramayaṃ pakṣaḥ |
atha dvitīyaḥ ? 'gāṅ‌kuṭādibhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā 'añṇit' iti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyāṃ ṅidādeśaḥ prāpnoti | atra prathamāyā na ca vaiyarthyam, lāghavārthaṃtvāt | tatra ṅiditi karmadhāraye, asamāse vā 'ādeḥ parasya' iti tavyādīnāmāderṅakāraḥ prāpnoti, kathaṃ punaritsaṃjñako nāmādeśaḥ syāt svayaṃ nivṛttyabhimukhaḥ ? ko doṣaḥ ? sthāninaṃ nivartya nivartiṣyate ! syādetat-id‌grahaṇasāmarthyādādeśo na bhaviṣyati, ādeśatve hi 'laśakvataddhite' ityeva siddhetsaṃjñetyāgamo ṅakāro vidhāsyata iti, tanna; anenetsaṃjñā yathā syāt tena mā bhūdityevamarthamid‌grahaṇaṃ syāt | kaḥ punaratra viśeṣastena vā satyāmanena vā ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ-tena satyāṃ lopaḥ syāt, anena punarnaṃ | tasyeti prakṛtaparāmarśāt tasyaitasya prakṛtasyetsaṃjñakasyeti | evaṃ ca śrūyamāṇa eva ṅakāre ṅitkāryāṇi bhavanti | tatra 'neḍvaśi kṛti' ityatra varamanādau kṛtīti yadi parigaṇanam, tadātra pratiṣedhābhāvāt kuṭiṅā kuṭiṅamiti prāpnoti | atha tu sambhavodāharaṇapradarśanam, tadātrāpi pratiṣedhāt kuṭṅā kuṭṅmiti prāpnoti | bahuvrīhau tu ye'mī prasiddhā ṅitaśca ṅādayasya eva tṛjādīnāmādeśāḥ syuḥ | na cāntaryato vyavasthā, yatra khalvantaratamasyānantaratamasya ca prasaṅgastatrāntaratamaparibhāṣā | na cātrāntaratamānāṃ tavyaṅādīnāṃ prāptiḥ; loke śāstre vā teṣāmaprasiddheḥ | na cāntaratamaparibhāṣaiva tān kalpayitumarhati; niyāmakatvāttasyāḥ | santu vā tavyāṅadayaḥ, te'pi tvādeśā bhavantaḥ 'ḍicca' ityantyasyaiva syuḥ | nanu ca nātra śrautaḥ sthānyādeśabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ paro'ñṇitpratyayo ṅid itsaṃjñakaṅakārayukta iti siddhānuvādamātrākṣaravyāpāraḥ | sa tu siddhānuvādau vidhānamantareṇa nopapadyate iti ṅakārasyetsaṃjñakasya vidhiḥ kalpyate | kimataḥ ? yadyevam, idaṃ tato bhavati vidhivākyasyāśrutatvāt kva paribhāṣāṅgatāmupeyāt--'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vā, 'ādeḥ parasya' iti vā, 'ḍicca' iti vā ? naitadasti, yasmāt ṣaṣṭhīprakalpenena śrauta eva sthānyādeśabhāva upapāditaḥ | astu vā kalpitavidhānam, ya eva tvasau vidhiḥ kalpyate, tatraiva paribhāṣāṅgabhāvamupaiti; vidhyaṅgatvātparibhāṣāṇām | paribhāṣāḥ khalu vidheraṅgabhūtā anuvādavākyaśrutārthānyathānupapattyā vidhivākyameva kalpante iti sarvathā duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣaḥ |
saṃjñākaraṇe 'kṅiti ca' ityatrāsya grahaṇaṃ na syāt; saṃjñārūpasyānuccāritatvāt | ṅicchabdaḥ saṃjñā, ḍicchabdaścoccāritaḥ pratyekasambandhamapīd‌grahaṇaṃ k‌id yasyetyetāvadeva sampādayet | na bānvarthā'vayavadvayayuktā saṃjñeti pratyabhijñābhāvāt kṅitpradeśeṣvasya grahaṇaṃ na syādeva | tathā kevale ṅicchabda uccārite tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād, nayaṅādīnām; kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasampratyayāt | tataśca grahijyādisamprasāraṇaṃ gṛhṇātītyādāvena syād, na jarīgṛhyateta ityādau | na ca yaṅādīnāṃ ṅitkāraṇasya vaiyarthyam; kṅitpradeśeṣu yatra saṃjñārūpaṃ na pratyabhijñāyate tatra grahaṇārthatvāt | nanu caivaṃ gāhkuṭādibhyaḥ parasya ṅitsaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakamāpadyate, katham ? kṅitapradeśeṣvasya grahaṇaṃ nāstītyuktameva | kevalaśca hicchabdo grahijyādisūtra eva, na ca tatra gāṅ gṛhyate, nāpi sarve kuṭādayaḥ, kiṃ tu vyatireka eva satyam; nyāyāgate'rthe kiṃ kurmaḥ ! tyajyatāmayaṃ pakṣaḥ |
tadevameteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ duṣṭatvāt caturthaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-atideśo'yamiti | iṅādeśo gṛhyate iti | 'iṅaścagāṅ liṭi' 'vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅoḥ' iti vihitaḥ | ṅakārasyānanyārthatvāditi | iṅādeśasya hi yo ṅakārastasyaitadeva prayojanam--iha tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi | atha sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? asamānatvādādeśasya | ṅakāro'nyārthaḥ; ātmanepadasya sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvāt, dhātostucaritārthaḥ | yadyevam, āb‌grahaṇe cāpa eva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, pakārasyānanyārthatvāt,na; evaṃ hi cāpo'nubandhāvanarthakau syātām, ṭāpaśca ṭakāraḥ | ato yacca yāvacca samānaṃ sambhavati caritārthapittvamacaritārthapittvamapi tatsarvamāśrīyate, na cābrūpamevayāvat | kuṅśabda iti | tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇād 'ākūtam' iti prayogadarśanāt 'kūṅa dīrghānto ṅidvadbhavatītyarthaḥ' ityantareṇāpi vatiṃ vatyartho gamyate, yathā-siṃho māṇavaka iti | yadyayamatideśaḥ, 'asaṃyogālliṭ kid' iti prakaraṇe'pi kitkāryātideśo'ṅgīkarttavyaḥ, tataśca sisṛkṣatītyatra satyapi 'halantācca' iti sanaḥ kittvātideśe svāśrayamakittvamāśritya 'sṛjidṛśoḥ' ityamāgamaḥ prāpnoti | atideśena parāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ prāpyate, na tu svāśrayaṃ nivartyate | siddhaṃ tu prasajyapratiṣedhāt kiti na bhavatīti | tataśca svāśrayasya kāryasyābhāvādātideśikakittvāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi uccukuṭiṣati-'ṅitaḥ' ityātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti ? ṅito dhātorātmanepadamucyate, iha cātideśena sana eva ṅittvam, na dhātoḥ | yatrāvayave liṅgamacaritārthaṃ tatra samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati; iha tvavayava eva guṇapratiṣedhādikaṃ ṅittvasya prayojanamasti | yaṅantādapi tarhi na prāpnoti, tasmānnaivaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum--ṅito dhātoriti, tataścaikaṃ sanameva ṅitamāśrityātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ-ṅitīva ṅidvat | nanu ca nātra vatirnirdiśyate, satyam; paratra paraśabdaprayogāt kalpyamāno vatirvyākhyānāt saptamyantādāśrīyate | evamapi pratiyogini saptamī prāpnoti-añṇitīti ? evaṃ tarhi 'anudāttaṅitaḥ' ityatra 'upadeśe' iti varttate, upadeśe yo ṅit, tata ātmanepadaṃ bhavati |
adhyagīṣateti | 'vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅo' iti gāṅādeśaḥ,'ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ghumāsthādisūtreṇettvam |
vyacerityādi | 'vyaca vyājīkaraṇe' tudādau kuṭādibhyaḥ prāk paṭhyate | udviciteti | grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam |
uruvyacā iti bahuvrīhiḥ | kathaṃ vivyacitha ? 'anasi' iti paryudāso'yamasunpratyayasya kṛtvā tatsadṛśo kṛti kāryaṃ vijñāyate |
kathaṃ likhitum, svayameva likhiṣyate, yāvatā kuṭeḥ pūrvaṃ likhiḥ paṭhyate ? kaścidāha-" kuṭasyādiḥ, kuṭa ādiryeṣāṃ te kuṭādayaḥ, kuṭādiśśca kuṭādayaśceti bahūvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ sahavivakṣāyām 'svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottarasvaravidhiḥ sa śiṣyate' iti bahuvrīheḥ śeṣaḥ | tatra tatpuruṣavṛttayā saṃgṛhīto likhirapi ṅittvasya nimittam" iti | evaṃ tu likhitvā, lekhitvā; lilikhiṣati, lilekhiṣati; 'śakuniṣvālekhane' ityanupapannaṃ syāt | tasmādyadyavaśyamupapādanīyam--'saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti guṇo na bhaviṣyati | 'dhū vidhūnane', kuṭādiḥ, tasya 'arttilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ' itītrapratyaye guṇo na prāpnoti | nātra guṇa iṣyate, dhuvitramityeva bhavati, kalpasūtrakārāṇāṃ tu prayogāśchāndasatvādupapādanīyāḥ | atha vā -'bhañ‍jabhāsamido ghuracvidibhidicchiderṅid' iti vaktavye pratyayāntarakaraṇaṃ jñāpakam--ātideśikaṃ ṅittvamanityamiti ||

vija iṭ || 1.2.2 ||

ovijī bhayacalanayoriti | yastu 'sṛjiviji viddhyaniṭsvarān' it viciḥ, na sa gṛhyate; aniṭtvāt | itarastu īdittvasāmarthyāt seṭ, vṛddhasaṃjñāsūtrād yasyādiriti varttate, teneḍviśeṣyate-yasyādiriḍiti | tenottamaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hyasau kasyācidādiḥ | ata evāgamamātrasyāyaṃ ṅittvavidhirna bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? tadādeḥ pratyayasyetyāha--iḍādiḥ pratyaya iti | udviciteti | ṅittvāllaghūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ ||

vibhāṣorṇoḥ || 1.2.3 ||

'ūrṇuñ ācchādane' ñid, nopadhaḥ; 'raṣābhyām' iti ṇatvena pāṭhaḥ | prorṇunāva--rephaviyoge'bhyāsātparasya nakārasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati | prorṇuviteti | ṅittvapakṣe uvaṅ, anyatra guṇaḥ ||

sārvadhātukamapit || 1.2.4 ||

apiditi paryudāsaścet, cyavante ityatra cyu a ante iti sthane nityatvādantaṅgatvāccaikādeśaḥ | na ca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, nānāśrayatvāt | tatra kṛte parasyehāpit āśritatvāttaṃ pratyādivadbhāvāt pidapitorekādeśo'pidgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti śabekādeśavataḥ sārvadhātukasya ṅittvād guṇaniṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pittvanimitto niṣedhaḥ pūrvasya kāryamiti pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvād ṅittvābhāvaḥ | astu tarhi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ ? yadyevam, tudānītyatra vikaraṇottamayoḥ pidapitorekādeśaḥ parasya pito ṅittvaniṣedhe kartavye ādivatsyāt, ityaṅitamuttamamāśritya guṇaḥ prāpnoti | 'antādivacca' ityatra pūrvaparau samudāyāvabhipretau, nācau | kiṃ kāraṇam ? ādyantayoravayavatvāt, sthāninoracorekādeśena nivartitatvācca | ataḥ sthānināvacau pūrvaparau yayoḥ samudāyayorantādī, ekādeśo'pi tayorevāntādivadbhavatītyayamatideśārthaḥ | ata eva brahmabandhūrityatra ekādeśo'pi pratipadikaṃ pratyevāntavadbhavati, dhruvai tuvai ityatra ca uttaimaikavacane kṛtsnayoreva pidapitorekādeśa iti acāveva pratyādivattve syādeva doṣaḥ |

evaṃ tarhyakādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvātpakṣadvaye'pi yathā sthānikāle yathāyogaṃ guṇasya pravṛttinivṛttī bhavataḥ, tathā kṛte'pyekādeśe sthānibuddhyā bhaviṣyataḥ |
evamubhayornirdoṣatve'pi prayajyapratiṣedha evāśrayaṇīyaḥ | tatra hi--tadāśrayaṇasāmarthyādyacca yāvacca pito ṅittvaṃ prāptaṃ tasya sarvasya niṣedhādidamapi siddhaṃ bhavati-acinod, acinavamiti | atra hi ṅito laṅa ādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena prāptasya niṣedho bhavati | paryudāse tvatideśenaikavākyatvāt tasyaiva paryudāsāt sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ ṅittvaṃ syādeveti yāsuṭo ṅidvacanaṃ jñāpakamāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt | kiṃ ca 'ṅicca pinna bhavati' ityayamapyatrārtha iṣyate | ato na brūtādbhavānityatra tātaṅaḥ sthānivadbhāvātprāptasya pittvasya niṣedhāt pidāśrayo bruva iṇ na bhavati, tṛṇaaḍhādbhavān--tṛṇaha iṇ na bhavatītyeṣā dik | ata etadarthamapi prasajyapratiṣedha āśrayaṇīyaḥ | tatra hi pṛthakkṛtasya naño yatheṣṭamabhisambandho bhavati--pid ṅinna bhavati, ṅicca pinna bhavati | tatra yasyaupadeśikaṃ pittvaṃ tasyātideśaprāptaṃ sthānivadbhāvaprāptaṃ ca ṅittvaṃ niṣidhyate; yasya punaraupadeśikaṃ ṅittvaṃ tasya sthānivadbhāvaprāptaṃ pittvaṃ niṣidhyata iti vivektavyam |
kuruta iti | ṅittvādvikaraṇasya guṇābhāvaḥ, 'ata utsārvadhātuke' ityuttvaṃ ca bhavati | atra ca tṛtīyāsamarthādvatirāśrayaṇīyaḥ, na pūrvavatsaptamīsamarthāt | tena pacete ityatra 'āto ṅitaḥ' iti ṅito yatkāryaṃ tadapi bhavati | yadyevam, cinuta iti 'tāsyanudāttet' iti lasārvadhātukānudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; upadeśagrahaṇamubhābhyāmapi sambadhyate-ṅidupadeśād, adupadeśāditi | 'ah‌nviṅoḥ' iti vā paryudāsāt tatsadṛśasyopadeśaṅakāravato grahaṇamiti sarvamanavadyam ||
asaṃyogālliṭ kit || 1.2.5||
liṭā''kṣipto dhāturasaṃyogagrahaṇena viśeṣyata ityāha asaṃyogāntāddhātoriti | nanu cātra paryudāsatvamuktaṃ pratīyate, tataśca saṃyogāntasadṛśād halantadeva syād-bibhidatuḥ,bibhidurityādau; ninyaturityādau tu na syāt ? jñāpakāt siddham, yadayam 'ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ' iti sasmaraturityādau guṇaṃ vidhatte, tajjñāpayati-nātra nañivayuktanyāyo dhātumātrasyaiva grahaṇamiti | ṅittve prakṛte kittvātideśasya prayojanam --ījanam, ījatḥ, ījuḥ, yajādīnāṃ kitīti samprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāt; jajāgaratuḥ, jajāgaruḥ-'jāgroviciṇṇalṅitsu' iti guṇo yathā syāt | yadi punargāṅkuṭādibhyo'pi kittvamevātidiśyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syād--'ṇu stutaudhū vidhūnane' tṛc, nuvidā dhuvidā--'śryukaḥ kiti' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, yathā-lūtvā, lūnaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvasya kāryatideśo'yamityuktam | iha tarhi kuṭitvā, puṭitvā--'na ktvā seṭ' ityātideśikasyāpi kittvasya pratiṣedho nātideśikasya bhavatīti, satyam; asati ktvāgrahaṇe, sati tu tasmin sanaḥ 'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedho na labhyate ityajñāpakaṃ vakṣyate-'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedho nātideśikasya bhavatīti, satyam; asati katvāgrahaṇe, sati tu tasmin sanaḥ 'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedho na labhyate ityajñāpakaṃ tatra ḍhal‌grahaṇam | tathā 'sārvadhātukamapid' iti kittvātideśe jāgṛtaḥ, jāgratīti guṇaḥ syād, ṅittvātideśe tvaviciṇṇalṅitsviti paryudāso bhavati | 'ṛdupadhebhyo liṭaḥ kittvaṃ guṇāt pūrvavipratiṣedhena' | kittvasyāvakāśaḥ-ṛjatuḥ, ṛjuḥ na hyatra vidhyantarasya kasyacitprasaṅgaḥ; guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--varttitvā,vardhitvā; vavṛte, vavṛdhurityatrobhayaprasaṅage kittvaṃ bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena | iha tu bibidatuḥ bibhiduḥ, nityatvādeva kittvaṃ siddham; taddhi kṛte'pi guṇe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, guṇastu kittve sati na prāpnoti | vavṛte ityatra tu guṇe kṛte saṃyogāntatvāt kittvaṃ na prāpnotītyubhayamanityamiti pūrvavipratiṣedha ucyate | sa cāyaṃ kāryātideśapakṣe sphuṭameva vaktavyaḥ | tathā hi-anenaiva kitkāryātideśa ījaturityādau yatra vidhyantarasyāprasaṅgastatra samprasāraṇamitadiśya caritārthamatideśaṃ paratvād guṇo bādheta | śāstrātideśe vā 'kṅiti ca' ityetacchāstramatidiśyate, tacca yadyapi guṇasyāpavādabhūtam, tathāpyanyatra caritārthatvād durbalenātideśenātidiṣṭaḥ 'kṅiti ca' iti pratiṣedho durbala iti taṃ bādhitvā guṇaḥ syādeva ||
indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca || 1.2.6 ||
indheragantuka ikāro na tu 'ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe' itīk pratyayaḥ, tena 'aniditām' iti nalopo na bhavati | samīdha iti | 'ñiṅandhī dīptau' anudāttet, eśaḥ kittvād 'aniditām' ityupadhālopadvirvacane savarṇadīrghatvam | babhūviva, babhūvitheti | kittvādyathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇau na bhavataḥ | indheḥ saṃyogārthamityādinā pūrvaṇāsiddhaṃ darśayan sūtrārambhaṃ samarthayate |
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham ? indheranantaraśchandasyeva liḍ bhavati, bhāṣāyāṃ tvijādeścetyāmā bhavitavyam, chandasi ca 'chandasyubhayathā' iti liṭaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñā, 'sārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅittvādupadhālopaḥ | śnami tu kartavya ārdhadhatukasaṃjñā, chāndasatvādvā śnamabhāvaḥ | bhavaterapi 'bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ' iti vugvidhīyate, tatra bhūa, bhūitha iti sthite vuk prāpnoti, vṛddhiguṇau ca; kṛtākṛtapasaṅgitvena nityo vuk, naca śabdāntaraprāptaḥ, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād; vuki ca kṛte'najantatvādalaghūpadhatvācca vṛddhiguṇau na bhaviṣyataḥ | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam-'vukā vṛddhiguṇau bādhyete' iti | yo hi manyate-'kittvādime guṇavṛddheḥ kiti neti pratiṣedhaḥ, aniglakṣaṇatvāt | evaṃ tarhi jñāpakārthamindhigrahaṇam, etaj, jñāpayati-'indherbhāṣāyāmapyanitya ām' iti, samīdhe samīdhāñcakra iti bhāṣāyāmapi bhavati | bhavaterapi vuganityaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? uriti vartate, na ca guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoruvarṇānto bhavatirbhavati; uriti nivartiṣyate ? yadi vivartate; bobhāva, ahaṃ kila bobhava-yaṅlukyapi nityatvād vuk prāpnoti | anuvartamāne punarurityasmin ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoranuvarṇāntatvād vuṅna bhavati | athedānīṃ yaṅlukyapyanenaiva liṭaḥ kittvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? śtipā nirdeṣaśāt | yadi punarvugvidhāveva śtipā nirdeśaḥ kriyate ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syād-bobhūvat;, bobhūvuḥ | yadā punaḥ kittvavidhau śtipā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na vugvidhau; tadā yaṅluki pitsu vacaneṣu liṭaḥ kittvābhāvād guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayorurityadhikārād vuṅna bhavati | apitsu vacaneṣu 'asaṃyogālliṭ kit' iti kittve sati guṇābhāvāduvarṇāntatvādvug bhavati | nanu cokram--'ārabhyamāṇe'pi kittve vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho na siddhyati, agnilakṣaṇatvād' iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṅid‌grahaṇamapyanuvartate, tatsāmarthyādanaglikṣaṇāyā api vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, satyam; astyaṃ śuṣkastarkaḥ | vārttikakārastu na kṣamate, yadāha-'indheśchando viṣayatvād bhuvo vuko nityatvāttābhyāṃ liṭaḥ kidvacanānarthakyam' iti |
śranthigranthītyādi | 'śrantha grantha saṃdarbhe', 'dambu dambheṣvañja piraṣvaṅge' | śrethatu;, śrethuriti kittvādupadhālopaḥ, etvābhyāsalopāvapyatra vaktavāyau | debhaturiti | nalope kṛte 'ata ekahalmadhye'nādeśādeḥ' ityetvābhyāsalopau | na ca lopasyā siddhatvam, ābhācchāstrīyasyāsiddhatvasyānityatvāt | pariṣasvaja iti | 'ṣvañjapariṣvaṅge', anudāttet,'upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvam 'sadisvañjyoḥ parasya liṭi' iti parasya pratiṣedhaḥ | atra kecidveti paṭhanti, śaśranthaturityādyapi bhavati | atha pitsu vacaneṣu katham ? yadi saṃyogārthameva vacanam, pitsu na bhāvyam | atha saṃyogāntārthaṃ pidarthaṃ ca ? pitsvapi bhāvyam | kiṃ punaratrārthatattvaṃ devo jñātumarhati ||
mṛḍamṛdagudhakuṣakliśavadavasaḥ ktvā || 1.2.7 ||
'kliśa hiṃsāyām', anudātted, divādirakarmakaḥ; 'kliśū vibādhane' kryādiḥ sakarmakaḥ, parasmaipadī-dvyorapi grahaṇam | kimarthaṃ punaridam, tāvatā kideva hi ktvā ? tatrāha--na ktvā seḍityādi | apakarṣaḥ - apavādaḥ nanvidameva niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-'mṛḍādibhya eva ktvā kidbhavati nānyebhyaḥ' iti nārthaḥ 'na ktvā seṭ' ityanena; kathaṃ lūtvā pūtvā-tulyajātīyasya seṭo niyamaḥ ? nanu 'kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' iti vikalpeneḍvidhānādaniṭ ktvā sambhavati ? evaṃ tarhi mṛḍamṛdavadavasāṃ kittvāvidhānaṃ niyamārtham, itareṣāṃ tu 'ralo vyapadhāt' iti vikalpabādhena vidhisambhavānniyamo na bhaviṣyati | evamapi viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syād--mṛḍādibhyaḥ ktvaiva kiditi | uditvā, uṣitveti | yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam 'śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam, 'vasatikṣudhoriṭ' ||
rudavidamuṣagrahisvapipracchaḥ saṃśca || 1.2.8 ||
sannarthamiti | tatra caritārthatvādaniṭaḥ ktvāḥ kittvāvidhānaṃ niyamārthaṃ na bhavati ||

iko jhal || 1.2.9 ||
sanākṣiptasya dhātorikā viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--igantāddhātoriti | 'ik smaraṇe' ityāsya tu dhātorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hyataḥ paro jhalādisan sambhavati, katham ? 'iṇo gā luṅi' 'ṇau gamiravabodhane' 'sani ca' 'iṇvadika iti vaktavyam' 'gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu'--adhijegamiṣati | nanu ca bhāvakarmaṇaorātmanepade 'anudāttopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopārthametatsyāt, tatra tu rūpe vipratipattiḥ, gameriṅādeśasya grahaṇamiti vacanāt 'ajjhanagamāṃ sani' iti dīrgho na bhavati-adhijigaṃsyata iti kecit |
anye tvāhuḥ-```ajjhanagamān' ityatrājgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, katham ? 'sani dīrghaḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, acaśca , evaṃ siddhe'jagrahaṇaṃ pravṛttibhedena gamerapi viśeṣaṇaārtham--ajādeśasya gameriti; tenāsyāpi dīrgheṇa bhāvyam, ajādeśatvād-adhijigāṃsyata iti rūpamiti | tadevaṃ dhātorapi grahaṇaṃ yuktameva | evaṃ tarhi jhalā sāhacaryād gargādiṣu jigīṣuśabdasya pāṭhācca pratyāhārasya grahaṇamuttarasūtre ca iksamīpāddhalaḥ para ityanupapannaṃ dhātugrahaṇe | jhalādiriti | kathaṃ punassatsaptamīnirdeśe tadādividhiḥ śakyo vijñātum ? jhalmātrasya sano'sambhavāt | nanu ca cikīrṣitetyādavato lope sati sambhavati, apūrvavidhatvācca na lopasya sthānivattvām; evaṃ tarhi vṛddhisaṃjñāsūtrādyasyādiriti varttate san kidbhavati, kīdṛśaḥ ? yasya ḍhalādiriti | etena tadantavidhirapi nirasto veditavyaḥ | cicīṣatīti | 'ekācaḥ' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ | tuṣṭūṣatīti | 'śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' | śiśayiṣata iti | 'pūrvavatsanaḥ' | kimarthamiti | yogavibhāgaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ | sūtraṃ tūttarārthaṃ karttavyam | dīrghatvaguṇasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | nanu 'kuṅśabde' kaṭādiḥ, cukūṣata ityasmi dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ ? dīrghānto'yamityavocām | iha tarhi 'gu purīṣotsarge' 'dhru gatisthairyayoḥ' kuṭādī, jugūṣati, dudhūṣati | evamapi pratyāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam 'uto dīrgha' iti vaktvayam ? asti pratyāhāragrahaṇe prayojanam, kim ? pratibhedena gamimapi viśeṣayiṣyāmīti | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt 'uto dīrgha' ityuktvā iṅ‌hanyoriti vaktavyam-yeṣāṃ sameriṅādeśasya grahaṇamiti pakṣaḥ | yeṣāmaniṅādeśasyāpi grahaṇaṃ teṣāmihanyoriti vaktavyam, hanā sāhacaryādiriti dhāturgṛhyate, nekāraḥ, tasmādajgarahaṇasāmarthyāddīrghatvaṃ guṇasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti suṣṭhūktam | yathaiva tarhi jhalādau guṇo bādhyate, evamiṅādāvapi bādhyeta--jijaviṣayati, nātra dīrdhaḥ pravarttate, kiṃ asati hi kittve nāprāpte vidhyantare ārabhyamāṇaṃ dīrghatvaṃ yathā guṇaṃ bādhate evaṃ ṇilopamapi bādhena | nanu yatra nāprāpte tasya bādhakaḥ, kva ca nāprāpte ? dīrgha ārabhyate, guṇe ṇilope tu jñīpsatītyatra prāpte, cicīṣatītyatrāprāpte pākṣika eva parihāraḥ | yatra bādhyaṃ bhedenāpekṣyate--'idamasminviṣaye prāptamidamastinviṣaye' iti, tatraikabādhenopapattau satyāmanekabādho na nyāyya iti kimekaṃ bādhyatāmityapekṣāyām 'yena nāprāpte sa bādhanīṭaḥ' ityucyate, evaṃ hyapekṣitavidhirbhavati | yadi tu 'nāprāpte vidhyantare idamārabhyate' iti kāryasāmānyamapekṣyate, tadā sarvameva bādhanīyam | etena purastādapavādanyāyena ṇilopameva dīrghatvaṃ bādheta, na guṇamityapi codyaṃ nirastam; yasyādayamapi nyāyaḥ kāryasamānyacintāyāṃ nāstyeva | ataḥ suṣṭhūktam--ṇilopamapi bādheteti | dīrghatvasyāvakāśadānāyeti | etadeva sphuṭayati-cicīṣatītyādi ṣviti | sati hi kattve cicīṣatītyādau kittvenaiva guṇo bādhyate, na dīrgheṇetyabādhitvaiva vidhyantaraṃ sāvakāśo dīrghaḥ paratvāṇṇilopena bādhyata ityarthaḥ | jñīpsatīti | 'māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā', 'jñapa micca' iti curādiṣu pāṭhād ṇici puki 'mitāṃ hrasvaḥ', san, 'sanībantarddha' itīḍabhāvakṣe 'āpjñapṛdhāmīt' itīttvam, 'atra lopo'bhyāsasya ' | kimartho yogavibhāga ityaśaṅkya prayojanamāha--ikaḥ kittavamityādi | guṇo mā bhūdityevamarthamika uttarasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyataityarthaḥ | dūṣayati-dīrghārambhāditi | guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti śeṣaḥ | kṛte bhavediti | śāstramāvartamānaṃ japādivadbharme sādhanamiti bhāvaḥ | anarthakaṃ tviti | śāstrapūrvakātprayogāddharmo na tu pravṛttimātrāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ca 'sani mīmāghu' ityatra minoterapi mīgrahaṇaena grahaṇārthaṃ dīrghavidhiḥ syād, mā bhūnmīgrahaṇena grahaṇam, 'mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca' ityātve kṛte 'gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti māgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; tatrāyamapyartho mīgrahaṇamapi na karttavyaṃ bhavati | hrasvārthamiti | hrasvānāmeva dīrghavidhānāsāmarthyād guṇo na syād, dīrghāṇāṃ tu punaḥ prāpnoti--lulūṣati; na hi dorghānteṣu dīrghaśāstraṃ pravarttate, pūrvameva tadrūpasadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | sāmārthyāddhi punarbhāvyamiti | sāmarthyam - prayojanasadbhāvaḥ, yathā 'mo rāji samaḥ kvau' iti makārasyaiva makāro vidhīyate, vikārāntaraṃ mā bhūditi | tathā dīrghasyāpi guṇo mā bhūditi punardīrdho bhaviṣyati | yadi tarhi prāpnuvanvidhiḥ dīrgheṇa bādhyate, ṝdittvāmapi na prāpnoti-cikīrṣati, tatrāha--ṝdittvaṃ dīrghasaṃśrayamiti | dīrghaḥ saṃśrayo nimittaṃ yasya tattathoktam | yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate | na cātrākṛte dīrghe ṝdittvaṃ prāpnoti | iha tarhi-titīrṣati, akṛte'pi dīrghatve ṝdittvaṃ prāpnotīti ? ṝdittvānivṛttyarthameva dīrghatvaṃ syād, ata āha-dīrghāṇāṃ nākṛte dīrgha iti | dīrghāṇāmapyakṛte dīrghatve ṛdittvaṃ na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ittvottvābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedhena, ato yāvaddīrdheṇa guṇo na bādhitaḥ, tāvadittvaṃ na pāpnoti; tasmānnārtha eteneti sthite prayojanamāha--ṇilopastviti ||
halantācca || 1.2.10 ||
samīpavacano'ntaśabda iti | avayavavacanastu na bhavati, dhātāvanyapadārthe 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityeva tadantavidheḥ siddhatvāt | ikastvanyapadārthatvaṃ naiva sambhavati, na hi varṇo varṇāntarasyāvayava upapadyate | hal cāsāvantaśceti | karmadhārayaṃ darśayati | nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | tatra ca kasyānto halitayapekṣāyāmika iti pañcamyantaṃ sannihitaṃ ṣaṭhyantaṃ vipariṇamyata ityāha-igantāditi | ikamapekṣamāṇasyāpyantaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvāt sūtre karmadhārayaḥ, bahuvrīhau tu dhātoranyapadārthatvaṃ naiva sambhavati, antaśabdo hi niyatadeśameva samīpamācaṣṭe paraṃ nāma, na samīpamātram | na ca dhātoḥ parasamīpāvasthite hali tataḥ paraḥ sansambhavati; iki tvanyapadārthe-yasyekaḥ parasamīpe hal na tasyānantaraḥ sū sambhavatītyekena halā vyavadhāne vijñāyeteti dhipsatītyatra na syād | haliti jātigrahaṇāt siddhāvapi pratipattigauravaprasaṅgaḥ | nanu ca mā bhūdantagrahaṇam, 'halaḥ' ityevāstu, ikā halviśeṣyate, tena ca dhātuḥ-ikaḥ paro yo hal tadantāddhātoriti | na caivamatra śaṅkanīyam--"asatyantagrahaṇe igvato halantāditi vijñāyeta, tataśca yajeḥ san 'sanyataḥ' yiyakṣate ityatrāpi kittve sati saṃprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti" iti; na hīkchabdasya mukhye'rthe sambhavati tadvati vṛttiryuktā, kiṃ ca 'igvataḥ' ityasya vyāvartyamapi na sambhavati | yāyajyateḥ sani yāyajiṣata ityatra sanna jhalādiḥ | tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam |
iha dhīpsatīti ya ik‌samīpe hal nakāro na tataḥ paraḥ san, yataśca paraḥ san bhakārāt na sa iksamīpa iti kittvaṃ na syādityata āha-dambheriti | dambherapi parasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ siddham, kutaḥ ? halgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt | 'tatprayojakaḥ' itivatsamāsaḥ | jātivācī halśabdaḥ, ekaiva ca jātirnakārabhakārayoḥ | vyaktidvārakaṃ ca jāteriksamīpatvaṃ tadapekṣayātra sanaḥ paratvam | bhakāravyaktiriksamīpe vartata iti jātirapi vartate, bhakāravyakteḥ paraḥ sanniti jāterapi paraḥ | viparyayastu sannapi śāstreṇānāśritatvādakiñcitkaraḥ | nakāravyaktiriksamīpe na vartata iti jātirapi na vartate | nakāravyakteḥ paraḥ sanna bhavatīti jāterapi paro na bhavatīti | dhīpsatīti | 'dambha icca' kittvādupadhālopaḥ 'ekāco baśo bhaṣ jhaṣantasya sdhvoḥ' iti bhaṣbhāvaḥ, dvirvacanam, 'atra lopo'bhyāsasya' ||
liṅ‌sicāvātmanepadeṣu || 1.2.11 ||
ātmanepadeṣu parata iti | etatsica eva viśeṣaṇam, na liṅ‌parasmaipadasya; jhalgrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva vyāvartitatvāt | bhitsīṣṭeti | bhidiḥ svaritet, 'liṅaḥ sīyuṭ','suṭ tithoḥ' | bhutsīṣṭeti | budhiranudāttet, pūrvavad‌ bhaṣ | abuddheti | cleḥ sic', jhalo jhali', 'jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ','jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti dhakārasya dakāraḥ | yakṣīṣṭeti | svaritettvādātmanepadam, vraścādiṣatvam, 'ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' |
adrākṣīditi | amāgame yaṇi ca kṛte 'vadavraja' ityakārasya vṛddhiḥ ||
uśca || 1.2.12 ||
liṅ‌sijbhyāmākṣiptasya dhātorurityanena tadantavidhirityāha- ṛvarṇāntāditi | 'ṛ gatau' ityasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; 'sarttiśāstyarttiśca' ityaṅo vidhānena sico'sambhavāt | nanvaṅ‌vidhau kartarītyanuvṛtteḥ karmaṇi sijapi sambhavati, evaṃ tarhi śailīyamācāryasya yatrāsya dhātorgrahaṇamicchati tatra śtipā nirdeśaṃ karoti-'arttipiparttyośca','sartiśāstyartibhyaśca' iti svarūpeṇāpi grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam | evaṃ tarhi vyāptinyāyādvarṇagrahaṇam | akṛteti | 'hrasvādaṅgāt' iti sico lopaḥ | avariṣṭeti | 'liṅsicorātmanepadeṣu' itīṭ | 'vā gamaḥ' | saṃgaṃsīṣṭeti | 'samo gamyarcchi' ityātmanepadam ||
hanaḥ sic || 1.2.14 ||
sautratvānnirdeśasyāllopo na kṛtaḥ | āhasateti |'āṅo yamahana' ityātmanepadam, 'ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityadādeśaḥ | sijgrahaṇaṃ liṅnivṛttyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ liṅ‌saṃbaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ |
