nanu ca 'hano vadha liṅi' iti liṅi vadhādeśo nityaḥ, dhāniṣīṣṭeti ciṇvadiṭi vadhādeśābhāve'pyajhalāditvādaprasaṅgastat kiṃ liṅnivṛttyetyatrāha-ukṣaratreti | uttarārthamavaśyaṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, tadihaiva kriyate, nyāyānusaraṇe pratipattigauravaṃ mā bhūdityevamārthamityarthaḥ |
ātmanepadagrahaṇamityādi | yamaḥ parasmaipadeṣu 'yamaramanamātām' iti sagiṭau bhavata iti jhalādiḥ sijna bhavati | upayamane tu nityamātmanepadam, sthādhvoḥ parasmaipadeṣu sico lug bhavati,'vā gamaḥ' ityatrāpi parasmaipadeṣvaṅ‌ bhavati, liṅi yāsuṭnivṛttyarthameva ca jhalgrahaṇamanuvarttyam, evamasminnapyadhāniṣātāmiti ciṇvadiṭi mā bhūditi, tadevam 'vā gamaḥ' ityārabhyātmanepadagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | kimarthaṃ punaridam, yāvatā ātmanepadaṃ ṅiti sijantasyāṅgasya 'aniditām' ityeva nalopaḥ siddhaḥ, uccāraṇārtho hi sica ikāraḥ, nānubandhaḥ ? jñāpanārtham | etaj jñāpayati-'na sijantasyopadhālopo bhavati' iti | tenāmāsteti siddhaṃ bhavati | nanu ca sici 'anudāttopadeśa' iti lopo yathā syād, ātmanepade upadhālopo mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ syāt, kaḥ punaratra viśeṣaḥ-sici vā lopo bhavatu, ātmanepade vā ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ-ātmanepade lope sati 'ato lopaḥ' prāpnoti, sici tu na; ābhīyasyānunāsikalobasyāsiddhatvāt | yadyapi upadhālopo'pyābhīyastathāpi vyāśrayatvādasiddhatvaṃ na prāpnoti-ātmanepade upadhālopaḥ, sicyato lopaḥ | yadyevam, bahiraṅga upadhālopaḥ, bahirbhūtātmanepadāpekṣatvād; antaraṅgo'llopaḥ, antarbhūtasijapekṣatvāt 'asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' |
nanu caiṣā paribhāṣāpyābhācchāstrīyā 'vāha ūṭh' ityatra jñāpiteti tasyāmantaraṅgabahiraṅgayorasiddhatvād yathā papuṣa ityādāvallopādiṣu vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syāt, tataścāto lopaḥ syāditi sicyevānunāsikalopa eṣitavya iti vaktavyameva sicaḥ kittvamiti jñāpakānupapatteḥ, amaṃstetyādāvupadhālopaḥ syāt | tasmāt sica ikāro'nubandha eva, nauccāraṇārthaḥ | tena 'aditām' iti pratiṣedhādupadhālopābhāvaḥ | 'idito num' ityatra dhātugrahaṇaṃ sijantanivṛttyarthameva kriyate, na dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num yathā syādityevamartham | kuṇḍetyādisiddhaye ca yatnāntaramāstheyamiti kecit; neti vayam | upadhālope'pi nāto lopena bhavitavyam | kiṃ kāraṇam ? 'upadeśa' iti vartate upadeśe yo'kārāntastasya lopaḥ, ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti--'dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' dhinutaḥ, kṛṇutaḥ, nopadeśagrahaṇena prakṛtirabhisambadhyate--upadeśe yā prakṛtirakārānteti, kiṃ tarhi ? ārdhadhātukamabhisambadhyate--ārddhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntaṃ tasyeti | tadevamupadhālope'pi na kaściddoṣa iti jñāpakāryameva vacanamiti sarvamanākulam||yamo gandhane || 1.2.15 ||
nanu yamiruparame paṭhyate, kathaṃ gandhane vartata ityata āha--anekārthatvāditi | udāyateti | parāvadyaṃ svayaṃ prakāśitavānityarthaḥ | udāyaṃsta pādamiti | apakṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ ||
sthādhvoricca || 1.2.17 ||
cakāreṇa kittvaṃ samuccīyata ityāha--sicca kiditi | prayojanaṃ guṇo mā bhūditi | ittvaṃ tu guṇavidhānārthameva syāt; laghutvāt | upāsthiteti | 'upānmantrakaraṇe' 'akarmakācca' ityātmanepadam, 'hrasvādaṅgāt' iti sico lopaḥ | na cettvaṃ sijītyucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ikāraścāntādeśassicca kidbhavatītyetāvat | tenettvasyāsijnimittatvād bhavatyeva lopaḥ |
iccetyādi | takāra idyasya tasya bhāvaḥ takorettvam, iccetyatra nirdeśe kasya, kāryasya siddhaye ikārasya takārettvaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ | dīrgho mā bhūditi | āntaryataḥ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ṛte'pi sa iti | ikāravidhānenāpi vinetyarthaḥ | kittve hi ghumāsthādisūtreṇaiva dīrghassiddhaḥ, tasmādittvavidhānasāmarthyād anantaratamo'pi hrasva eva bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | bhāvyamāno'ṇsavarṇānna gṛhṇāti ityayamapyatra parihāraḥ saṃbhavati | anantara iti | asadṛśa ādeśe kriyamāṇe hrasva iva pluto'pi syāt,sa mā bhūdityarthaḥ | plutaśceti | anena taparatvaṃ pratyākhyāyate | yadyanena pluto vidhīyeta, tadā yatra viṣaye 'anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' ityādinā pluto vihitastatrāpyanenaiva syād, asminkarttavye tasyāsiddhatvāditi pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaḥ prāpnoti,tato hrasva eva bhaviṣyati | anye tu taparatvamanena samarthitaṃ manyanteasati takāra āntarayaṃto dīrghasya dīrghaḥ prāpnoti | nanu coktam-'siddho'tra dīrghaḥ' iti ? siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ syād-dīrgha eva yathā syāt pluto mā bhūditi tadidamuktam--anntara ityādinā | ghumāsthādisūtreṇānena vā dīrghe sati yadyapi viśeṣo nāsti, tathāpyanantare'vidyamāne'pi viśeṣe pluto mā bhūditi dīrghaḥ syādityarthaḥ | mā bhūd iti cet tatrāha-plutaśceti | sa cāsati taparatve na prāpnoti, sati tu tasmin dīrghasyāprasaṅgādvidhireva saṃpadyata iti svaviṣaye pluto na vyāvartyate | tadevamanyatra bhinnakālanivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇam, iha tu dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ plutapravṛttyarthaṃ ca vastubalātsamapādi ||
na ktvā seṭ || 1.2.18 ||
na kidbhavatīti | kitkāryaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ | na punaḥ kakārasyetsaṃjñābhāvāt kinna bhavatīti | prakṛto hi kicchabdaḥ kitkāryakāriṇi vartata iti tadarthasyaiva niṣedho yuktaḥ-devitvetyādau guṇapratiṣedhākhyaṃ kitkāryaṃ na bhavatīti |
nigṛhītiriti | atra 'titutra' itīṭpratiṣedho na bhavati, titutreṣvagrahadīnāmiti vacanāt | nikucitiriti | 'kuñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' | eṣūdāharaṇeṣu saṃprasāraṇam, guṇapratiṣedhaḥ, upadhālopaśca kittvādbhavanti |
na seḍityādi | pūrvāddhemeko granthaḥ, uttarārddhācca netyapakṛṣyate | na seḍityetāvatāpi yogenākittve kṛte gudhito gudhitavānityatra niṣṭhāyāmavadhāraṇānniyamānna bhaviṣyati | 'niṣṭhā śīṅsvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ' iti niyamaḥ-śīṅādibhya eva parā niṣṭhā na kiditi | viparītastu niyamaḥ-niṣṭhaiveti vyākhyānānna bhavati | liṭi tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca jagmiva, jagmima 'gamahana' ityupadhālopo na syād, ata āha-jñāpakāditi | pūrvācāryaprasiddhyā parokṣe liḍucyate, yathā-bhavantī laṭ, śvastanī luṭ | kiṃ jñāpakamityata āha-sanīti | 'iko jhal' ityatra jhalgrahaṇasyaitatprayojanam--śiśayiṣata ityatra mā bhūditi | yadi ca na seḍiti pratiṣedha ātideśikasyāpi kittvāsya syād jhalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | prāpnotvatra kittvam, 'na seṭ' iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | tadetad jhalgrahaṇamaupadeśikasya kittvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho nātideśikasyetyasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ viduḥ |
nanu cottarārthaṃ jhalgrahaṇam, sthāghvorittvaṃ jhalādau yathā syāt ciṇvadiṭi mā bhūditi-upāsthāyiṣātām, atra hi upāsthās ātāmiti sthite, ittvaṃ ca prāpnoti ciṇvadbhāvaśca, paratvācciṇvadbhāve yukca prāpnoti vṛddhiśca, kaapavādatvādyuki kṛte yakārasyettvaprasaṅgaḥ; na ca punarvṛddhirlabhyate, pūrvameva yukā bādhitvāt, tasmāduttarārthaṃ jhalgrahaṇam ? naitadasti; yasmādittvaṃ kittvasaṃyogenocyate, na cātra kittvamasti; na seḍiti pratiṣedhāt | na hyatrāsyāṃ daśāyāṃ jhalgrahaṇasya jñāpakatvaṃ sthitamityātideśikasyāpi kittvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati | reṇa tulyaṃ sudhīvanīti | śobhanā dhīvāno'syāḥ sudhīvā strī 'ano bahuvrīheḥ' iti prakṛtasya ṅīpo niṣedhe sati 'saṃniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāve ubhayorapyabhāvaḥ' iti yathā repho na bhavati tadvadihāpītyarthaḥ | vasvarthamiti | arthaśabdo nivṛttau | jagmivānityatra kvasauḥ kittvapratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tarhi ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | dūṣayati-kiṃdatīdeśāditi | siddhamiti śeṣaḥ | astvatraupadeśikasya kittvasya pratiṣedhaḥ, ātideśikaṃ kittvaṃ bhaviṣyati | yatratarhi tatpratiṣidhyate saṃyogāntaṣvañjeḥ, ājivān-atra hi nalope kṛte dvirvacana ekadeśe ca 'vasvekājāddhasām' itīḍāgamaḥ, tatra kṛte kittvapratiṣedhād nalopanivṛttau dvihaltāt nuṭi satyekāctvābhāvādiṇnivṛttau kittvanalopādīnāṃ cakrakaprasahgaḥ | evaṃ tarhi chāndasaḥ kvasuḥ, liṭ chandasi sārvadhātukamapi bhavati 'sārvadhātukamapid' iti ṅittvaṃ ṅitītyupadhālopaḥ | na ca saṃyogānteṣu kittvaṅittvayoḥ kaścidviśeṣaḥ, tasmādvasvarthamapi ktvāgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati | evaṃ tarhi-nigṛhītiḥ prayojanam | ktinktijnivṛttyarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ |
yadi punarupariṣṭādyogavibhāgaḥ kriyate-na seṇniṣṭā śīṅ‌svidimidi kṣvididhṛṣaḥ, mṛṣastitikṣāyām, udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām; tataḥ pūṅaśca-pūṅaśca parā niṣṭhā seṇ na kidbhavati; tataḥ ktvā ca, ktvā ca seṭ kinna bhavati | atra 'pūṅaḥ' iti nivṛttamiti, tataḥ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum ||
niṣṭhā śīṅ‌svidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ || 1.2.19 ||
' ñiṣvidā snehanamocanayoḥ' ityasya bhauvādikasya ñiddhātorgrahaṇam, na tu 'ṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe' iti daivādikasya; ñidbhiḥ sāhacaryāt, asya cāñitvāt | 'ñikṣvidā snehanamocanayoḥ' iti daivādikasya grahaṇam, na tu 'ñikṣvidā avyakte śabde' ityasya bhauvādikasya; midinā sāhacaryāt,'ñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye' | śayitavāniti | 'atvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ | prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, sa eva dhāturdvirucyata iti kṛtvā tatrāpavādaḥ smaryate |
śtipā śapā'nubandhena nirddiṣṭaṃ yad‌gaṇena ca |
yatraikājgrahaṇaṃ kiñcitpañcaitāni na yaṅ‌luki || iti |
tadahi śīṅo'nabandhanirdeśo yaṅluṅnivṛttyarthaḥ, śeśyitaḥ, śeśyitavān-- 'eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ ||
mṛṣastitikṣāyām || 1.2.20 ||
idameva titikṣāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-anekārthā dhātava iti; anyathā mṛṣistitikṣāyāmeva paṭhyeta iti tadapārthakaṃ syāt | apamṛṣitamiti | avispaṣṭamityarthaḥ ||
udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām || 1.2.21 ||
dyutitamiti | 'dyuta dīptau' napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ | pradyutita iti | 'ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca' iti karttari ktaḥ | muditamiti | 'mudī harṣe ' | likhitamiti | śabvikaraṇānāmeveti na tāvat sthitamityaśabvikaraṇo'pi likhiḥ pratyudāhṛtaḥ | evaṃ prabhukta itiṃ | sthite tasmin khiṭikiṭī bhauvādī, kruśiśca; khiṭitaṃ kruṣṭamiti prakyudāhartavyam ||
pūṅaḥ ktvā ca || 1.2.22 ||
ihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛttau seḍityasya ca nivṛttau iḍvidhau 'pūṅaśca' iti śakyamakarttum, uttarasūtre ca vāgrahaṇam; katham ? aniṭoreva ktvāniṣṭhayoranena kittvaṃ vikalpyate,tatra yadā kittvaṃ tadā 'śyakaḥ kiti' iti pratiṣedhāt pūtaḥ pūtavān pūtveti, akittvapakṣe tviṭi pavitaḥ pavitavān pavitveti bhavati, seḍgrahaṇaṃ tu vicchidyeta; tasmātseḍityasminnuttārthamanuvartamāne 'pūṅaśca' ityārabhya uttaratra vāgrahaṇamiha nityatāsiddhyartham, puvitveti pakṣe mā bhūttadāha-anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na svaryate; uttarasūtre punarvāvacanāditi | na seḍiti varttata iti | nanu pūṅaḥ parayoḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoriṭo na bhavitavyam, 'śyukaḥ kiti' iti pratiṣedhādata āha-pūṅaśceti | pūṅa paro niṣṭhāpratyaya ityādi |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sākṣāt śrutaṃ ktvāpratyayamapahārayānuvṛttasya niṣṭhāpratyayasyānvayo darśiyata udāharaṇaṃ ca ? ata āha-ktvāpratyayasyeti | etadeva draḍhayati-tathā coktamiti | iḍādyoḥ ktvāniṣṭhayornityamakittvamiṣyate, tataśca ktvāgraṇamuttarārthamiti bhāradvājīyairevamuktam | uttarārthamapi yadihaiva karttavyaṃ seḍityenena sambandhārtham; anyathā niṣṭhānivṛttau tatsambaddhaṃ seḍityetadapi nivartteta ! anubandhoccāraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ na pūño nivṛttyartham; iḍ‌vidhau pūṅa eva grahaṇāt | pūñaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ iḍabhāvānnāpi yaṅ‌luki nivṛttyartham; iḍ‌vidhāvanubandhanirdeśena yaṅ‌lukyapi 'na ktvā seṭ' iti pratiṣedhasya sthitatvāt | na ca ktvāgrahaṇasārthyāttasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ; tasyottaratrāpyupayogasambhavāt, anubandhanirdeśasya ca niṣṭhāyāṃ caritārthatvāt | evaṃ ca 'ktvāgrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti vṛttigranthasyāvirodhaḥ, tena popuvitavāniti niṣṭhāyāṃ bhavati | ktvāyāṃ tu guṇo popavitveti bhavati ||
nopadhātthaphāntādvā || 1.2.23 ||
niṣṭheti nivṛttamiti | pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt | guphitveti | 'gupha gumpha granthane' |
rephitveti | 'ripha katthanayuddhanindāhiṃsādāneṣu' | athaitadvikalpābhāve'pi 'ralo vyupadhād' iti vikalpo'tra kasmānna bhavati ? nopadhagrahaṇasāmarthyāt | nanu ṛkāropadho nopadhagrahaṇasya vyāvartyaḥ sambhavati 'ṛpha hiṃsāyām'- arphitveti, naitadasti; traiśabdyaṃ hyanayordhātvorbhavati | sati tāvat, anopadhasya 'na ktvā seṭ' iti niṣedhe sati arphitveti bhavati, nopadhasya tvasminvikalpe-ṛphitveti | asatyapi nopadhagrahaṇe sarvatrāsminvikalpe pravṛtte'pīdameva rūpatrayaṃ bhavati | antagrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārtham-yatnamantareṇāsminprakaraṇe na tadantavidhirbhavatīti, tenottarasūtre 'ṛtaḥ' iti dhāturgṛhyate, na ṛdantaḥ ||
vañciluñcyṛtaśca || 1.2.24 ||
'vañcu gatau' bhauvādiḥ, 'vañcu pralambhane' curādiḥ,so'pi gṛhyate, 'anityaṇyantāścurādayaḥ' iti | 'luñca apanayane', ṛtiḥ sautro dhātuḥ 'ṛterīyaṅ'iti, sa ca ghṛṇāyāṃ varttate ||
tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ kāśyapasya || 1.2.25 ||
'ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām','mṛṣa titikṣāyām', 'kṛśatanūkaraṇe' | kāśyapagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti | 'kāśyapasyaitadviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ nānyeṣām' ityasādhāraṇajñānodbhāvanamācāryasya pūjādvāreṇa śāstrasyāpi pāramparyapratipādanena prāmāṇyapritapādanāt pūjā bhavati ||
ralo vyupadhāddhalādeḥ saṃśca || 1.2.26 ||
ktvāpratyayasya 'na ktvā seṭ' iti kittve pratiṣiddhe sano'pyakittve svataḥ siddha ubhayatra vidhimukhenedaṃ pravarttata ityāha-vā kitau bhavata iti | didyotiṣate iti | 'dyutisvāpyoḥ saṃprasāraṇam' | eṣiṣiṣatīti | iṭi kṛte--'ajāderdvitīyasya' ||
ūkālojjhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ || 1.2.27 ||
ūḥ kālo yasya sa ūkālaḥ 'taparastatkālasya' itivannirdeśaḥ samarthanīyaḥ | etacca saṃjñino viśeṣaṇam, ca 'ū' ityekasyaiva śabdasyoccāraṇādviśeṣaṇasyaikatvāt saṃjñāpyekaiveti yaścodayet taṃ pratyāha--ū iti trayāṇāmityādi | praśleṣaṇam - praśliṣṭam, tena nirdeśaḥ - praśliṣṭanirdeśaḥ | tena viśeṣaṇatrayaparicchinnāstrayaḥ saṃjñina ityarthaḥ | praśleṣaṇe pramāṇamāha-hrasveti | hrasvadīrghapluta iti na tāvadekā saṃjñā; gauravādanāvṛtteśca | atastisṛṇāṃ saṃjñānāṃ dvandvo'yam | na caikasyānekasaṃjñākaraṇe prayojanamasti | lugādisaṃjñāsvapi tadbhāvitatvena pratyayādarśanasya bheda āśitaḥ, prakārāntarāsambhavād | iha tu nirdeśa eva trayāṇāṃ sambhavati | tasmātsaṃjñānāṃ tritvāt saṃjñināmapi tritvamanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ | 'bahuvacananirāsārthamekavadbhāvaḥ' ityuktam, samāhāradvandva ityarthaḥ | 'sa napuṃsakam' kaityetattu na bhavatītyāha-puṃlliṅgamanirdeśa iti | sautra iti bhāvaḥ |
praśleṣe kramamāha- u ū ū3 ityekaṃ kāla iti | ukārādīnāṃ paricchedako yaḥ kālo nimeṣādiḥ, tatkāla ityarthaḥ | kutaḥ punaravasitameṣa eva krama iti ? ādau madhye vā trimātre plutāśrayaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tathā madhye'nte vā mātrike 'dvandve ghi' ityetadvādhyeteti ceti, na; anena hi plutasaṃjñā, tataścādau madhye vā paṭhitasya trimātrasya plutasaṃjñaiva na, kutaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ ! yadi ca mātriko madhye'nte vā syāt, hrasvasaṃjñaiva na syāt kuto ghisaṃjñā ! kutastarāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ ! evaṃ tarhi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam 'vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ' iti heḥ plutaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati-nānte mātrika iti | kathaṃ yo'nte sa plutaḥ ? plutasya plutavacanamanarthakam | anantaratamaplutārthametatsyāditi cet, na hi satyāṃ gatau paribhāṣā bādhyā | yacca 'supi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati-na madhye mātrika iti | kathaṃ yo madhye sa dīrghaḥ ? dīrghasya dīrghavacanamanarthakam | yacca 'omabhyādāne' ityomaḥ plutaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati--dvimātriko nāntya iti | kathaṃ yo'nte sa plutaḥ ? plutasya plutavacanamanarthakam |
dadhi,madhviti | rūpodāharaṇe | kumārītyādi kāryodāharaṇam 'halṅyābbhyaḥ' iti dīrghāśrayaḥ sulopo bhavati | devadatta3 atra nvasīti | 'anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' iti plutaḥ | devadatta tvamatra bhavasīti praśnaḥ | nuśabda praśnaṃ dyotayati | devadattaśabdātparasya soḥ 'sasajuṣo ruḥ' iti rutvam, 'ato roraplutāt' ityutve pratiṣiddhe 'bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi' iti yatvam, 'lopaḥ śākalyasya' | ukāro'yamaṇ, tena dvimātrayorapi grahaṇād hrasvasaṃjñā prāpnoti | na ca dīrghaplutasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhaḥ; ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñānāṃ samāveśābhyupagamād, ata āha-kālagrahaṇamiti | kālagrahaṇaṃ tāvadukārādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate, ūkāla ityasminvākye satyapi savarṇagrahaṇe kālaśabdasya na punaḥ pratyekaparisamāptiryujyate, kutaḥ ? ekasyaiva śrutatvāt | dvimātratrimātrau hi saṃjñitvena pratīyete, na tu sākṣāduccaritau | evaṃ caikatvādvahuvrīhereka eva saṃjñī, tatraikasya viruddhakāladvayāsambhavena savarṇagrahaṇābhāvācchruta evokāraḥ kālaviśeṣaṇamiti kālagrahaṇaṃ saṃjñinaḥ parimāṇārtham |
yadvā-ū ajityeva kālārtho labhyate, katham ? ukārādayo'ctvaṃ na vyabhicarantīti nāctvena te viśeṣyante, api tu tairac | na cājmātrasyokārāditvamupapadyata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā tatsadṛśasyācaḥ pratipattiḥ | tatra ca sthānasāmyamasambhavānna gṛhyate, prayatnasāmyaṃ cāvyabhicārīti kālasāmyameva grahīṣyate, nārthaḥ kālagrahaṇena | tatkriyate śrūyamāṇenaiva kālaṃ viśeṣayitumiti kālagrahaṇaṃ parimāṇārtham |
āluyeti | hrasvāśrayastuṅ na bhavati | titaucchtramiti | asatyajgrahaṇe cadvayasamudāyasya pratyekavarṇakālasaṃkalanayā dvimātratvāddīrghasaṃjñā syād | yastu madhye'rddhamātrākālaḥ savarṇakālo na bhavatīti samudāyasya dvimātratvaṃ na vyāhantīti syādeva prasaṅge | ajgrahaṇe tu na bhavati; acsamudāyasyānactvāt | yadyapi varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇam, sā tu jātirekaikavyaktivyaṅgyā na samudāyavyaṅgyā, tena dīrghasaṃjñāyāmabhāvāt 'dīrghātpadāntādvā' iti tugvikalpo na bhavati | na ca satyapi vikalpe tena mukte hrasvāśrayastug labhyate; samudāye kāryamārabhyamāṇe'vayavānāṃ svakāryaṃ pratyavyāpārāt ||
acaśca || 1.2.28 ||
'iko guṇavṛddhī' ityanena samānamidam | svasaṃjñayā vidhāne niyamārthamityatra yuktimāha-ajiti varttata iti | tataśca hrasvādiśabdā ihānuvṛttā nācamupasthāparyānta, tasya svayamupasthānāditi svarūpapadārthakā āśrīyante | tena hrasva ityevaṃ yo'jvidhīyate so'caḥ sthāne bhavatītyayamarthaḥ sampadyate | evaṃ dīrghaplutayoḥ |
dyaurityādi | 'diva aut' 'pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt','tyadādīnāmaḥ','diva ut' iti aukārādayo na saṃjñayā vidhīyante iti hala eva sthāne bhavanti ||
uccairudāttaḥ || 1.2.29 ||
udāttādiśabdā ityādi | satyaṃ prasiddhā eva te, kutra prasiddhāḥ ? dharmamātre svare, na tu tadvatyaci | tatasca 'udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' iti svaritākhyasya dharmasyaiva vidhiḥ syāt, na ca dharmadharmiṇoḥ sthānyādeśabhāvaḥ saṃbhavatīti 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityasyānupasthānāt tadaṅgabhūtam 'tasmādityuttarasya' ityetadapi na pravarteteti pūrvasyāpyacaḥ svaritaprasaṅgaḥ | syādetat-yathā 'kṛpo ro laḥ' ityatra ṛkārasya rephasya lṛkārasthe lakāre'pi vihite kṛtsnasya varṇasya kṛtsna eva varṇo bhavati, tadvadihāpi dharmiṇoreva sthānyādeśabhāvo bhaviṣyatīti yuktaṃ tatra rephalakārāvṛkāralṛkārayorātmabhūtau na tāvantareṇa tāvuccārayituṃ śakyau, iha tūdāttādikamantareṇāpyaca uccāraṇaṃ śakyam, dṛṣṭaṃ ca bhāṣāyāmiti dharmamātramevādeśaḥ syāt | nanvevaṃ sthite sthānyapi dharma eveti yukta eva paribhāṣāvyāpāraḥ, satyam; varṇamātradharmo'yamudāttādiriti vyāmohanivarttanenācāmevāyaṃ dharmo na halāmiti darśayitumidamārabdham | ata eva varṇadharme iti sāmānyenoktam |
tad‌guṇe'cīti | sa udāttādirguṇo yasya | etena vastuto'jdharmatvamudāttāderdarśitam | tathā hi, antareṇāpi halamaca eṣa dharmā dṛśyate-ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnameru, yathā ākārasya, nāntareṇayaṃ vyañjanasyoccāraṇamapi bhavati, kuta eva svaraḥ ! yadi ca halāmapyete guṇāstato halāmacāṃ ca pṛthak svaro'pyupalabhyeta | yatastu khalvacāmeva svaramanuvidadhati halastato niścīyate-ajuparāgādeṣu svarapratibhāso na svata iti | ajuparagaśca pūrvaparasaṃnidhāne'pi pareṇaiva bhavati, na pūrveṇa |
paribhāṣyanta iti | kecidāhuḥ-pradeśe lokaprasiddhyā halāmacāṃ ca grahaṇe prāpte'cāmeva grahaṇaṃ niyamyate iti paribhāṣeyamiti |
anye tu -dharmiṇyaprasiddhatvāt saṃjñātvena paribhāṣyante iti vyācakṣate | uccai rityasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt kriyāpekṣatvāccādhikaraṇasyopalabhyamāna ityuktam ||
śrutiprarṣo na gṛhyata iti | yadi gṛhyate upāṃśuprayoge na syādityavyāptiḥ, śrutiprakarṣasya cānavasthitatvādyadeva kañcitpratyuccaistadeva kañcitprati nīcairiti sarvamudāttaṃ syāt, sarvaṃ cānudāttamityamativyāptivyasthā ca syād iti bhāvaḥ | sthānakṛtamityādi | uccatā nāma pramāṇaviśeṣa ūrdhvatāparyātaḥ, tatra tālvādibasaṃndho varṇānāmantaraṅga iti sthānasaṃbandhinyuccatā gṛhyate, tatkṛtamuccaistvaṃ saṃjñino viśeṣaṇam | nanu pūrvamuccairupalabhyamāna iti tālvādisthānavṛttiruccaiḥ-śabdo darśitaḥ, iha tūccaiḥsthānaniṣapannatvād ajevoccairityucyate iti uktivirodhaḥ, na; pūrvamakṣarārtha uktaḥ, iha tu vastvartho vyākhyātaḥ | nanu coccaiḥ sthāna upalabhyamāna ityāśrite'pi prāṃśupuruṣoccārito'nudāttopyudātta eva syād, vāmanapuruṣoccārita udātto'pyamudāttaḥ syāt; tatrānyo'nyamuccatānīcatāyogād, ata āha-tālvādiṣu hīti | tālvādīni sthānāni bhāgavanti, bhāgāścauttarādharyeṇa vyavasthitāḥ | tatra yaḥ samāna iti | ekaparyāyo'yaṃ samāna śabdaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ-ekasmim̐stālvādike sthāne ūrdhvādharabhagayukte ūrdhvabhāgenoccāryamāṇo'jadāttasaṃjño bhavati | evaṃ coccairityasyordhvabhāga ityarthaḥ | sarvaścāyamartho lokaprasiddhereva labhyate, sūtraṃ tu vyāmohanivṛttyartham | ūrdhvabhāganiṣpatterapratyakṣatvāt tanniścaye liṅgamāha-yasminniti | āyāma ityasya vivaraṇaṃ nigrahaḥ | rūkṣatetyasya vivaraṇam asnigdhateti | saṃvṛtateti | aṇutā | ata eva vāyuḥ śanairniṣkrāman galāvayavān śoṣayatīti svarasya rūkṣatā bhavati | ye te ke iti | yattatkiṃbhyo jasi tyādadyatvam, 'jasaḥ śī', ād‌guṇaḥ,'ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ ' ||
nīcairanudāttaḥ || 1.2.30 ||
ajiti varttate iti | tena hal sraṃsanadharmeṇānudāttasaṃjño na bhavati, anvavasarga ityasya vivaraṇaṃ mārdavamiti, śaithilyamityarthaḥ | mṛdutetyasya snigdhateti | urutetyasya mahatteti | mahattvādeva ca śīghraṃ vāyorniṣkramaṇādgalāvayavānāmaśoṣaṇātsvarasya snigdhatā bhavati | anuccānīti | sarvādāvevameva paṭhāt | phiṣi tu 'simasyātharvaṇe' ityanta udātta ityuktam | anātharvaṇe'pi tucchandasyantodāttatvaṃ dṛśyate, ādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai, ucchrukramajate simasmāditi, namaste rudreti, 'temayāvekavacanasya' ityatra 'anudāttaṃ sarvam' ityadhikārātteśabdo'nudāttaḥ | rudrādayo'pyāmantritanighātena | padakāle cānudāttasya śravaṇam | saṃhitāyāṃ tu 'svaritātsaṃhitāyām' ityaikaśrutyaṃ bhavati ||
samāhāraḥ svaritaḥ || 1.2.31 ||
sāmarthyāccātreti | pāribhāṣikayorudāttānudāttayoracoḥ samāhārūpasyācaḥ kvacidapyasambhavaḥ sāmarthyam | nanu ca samāharaṇaṃ samāhāraḥ, viprakīrṇānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇamekadharmayoryogo vā, yathā-pañcapūlī, ṣaṇṇagarī dṛṣṭeti | tatra pūrvo mūrttānāmeva, uttarastu dharmayorapi sambhavati; kiṃ tu acā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na ghaṭate, na hi varṇadharmayorudāttānudāttayoḥ samudāyarūpaḥ kaścidajbhavatītyata āha -tau samāhriyete asminnacīti | nānenādhikaraṇasādhanatvaṃ samāhāraśabdasya darśatam | tatra hi 'karaṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti lyuṭā bhavitavyam | vāsarūpavidhiśca nāsti; ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti vacanāt | tasmādarthakathanamātrametat | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tvarśaāditvādacpratyayāntatvena samarthaṃnīyam | śikyam, kanyeti | 'śilpaśikyakāśmaryadhānyakanyārā janyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ' iti phiṭsūtreṇāntaḥsvaritatvam | sāmānya iti | sāmasu sādhuḥ 'tatra sādhuḥ' iti yat, 'titsvaritam' | kveti | 'kimo't','kvāti' ||
tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam || 1.2.32 ||
ādau - āditaḥ, saptamyantāttasiḥ | arddhahrasvamiti | 'arddhaṃ napuṃsakam' iti samāsaḥ | hrasvaśabda ubhayaliṅgaḥ-'hrasvo napuṃsake', 'hrasvaṃlaghu' iti | tadiha paravalliṅgatvena napuṃsakatvam | uktaparimāṇasyāco hrasvasaṃjñā kṛteti yatraiva tasyārdhamiti dīrghaplutayoretadvibhāgavacanaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha--arddhahrasvamiti | cetyādi | hrasvasya hi mātrā bhavati ato'rddhahrasvagrahaṇenārddhamātropalakṣyate | iha prakṛtatvādeva svaritasya vibhāgākhyānasiddhe tasyeti vacanaṃ svaritamātraparigrahārtham | yadi cārddhahrasvagrahaṇamarddhamātropalakṣaṇaṃ tatra svaritamātraparigraho'rthavān bhavati |
hrasvagrahaṇamatantramiti | apradhānam upalakṣaṇatvād, yathā--kākebhyo dadhirakṣyatāmityatra kākāḥ | nanvevamapyāṣṭamikasvaritasya vibhāgo na siddhyati,tasyāsiddhatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ita ārabhya nava sūtrāṇi asiddhakāṇḍe 'udāttādanudāttasya' ityasmātparāṇi paṭhitavyāni, kiṃ prayojanam ? idaṃ tāvadvibhāgākhyānamāṣṭamikasyāpi bhavati | uttaratrāpi prayojanaṃ tatra tatra vakṣyāmaḥ |
ekaśrutirveti | udāttabhāgasya paṭutvātpaṭutvakṛtau vikalpaḥ | paṭutve hi taduparagāttadrūpatāmivāpanno nānudāttavyapadeśamarhati, nāpyudāttavyapadeśam; uparāgamātratvāt | tena bhedatirodhānalakṣaṇamaikaśrutyaṃ paro bhāgaḥ pratipadyate | anvarthaṃ vā ekaśrutitvam, pūrvabhāgaśruterekā'bhinnākārā śrutirasyeti kṛtvā |
adhyarthamātrānudātteti | ekaśrutirveti noktam; pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvāt, laghunā vā mahato'nuparagāt | māṇavakā3 māṇavaketi | 'svaritamāmreḍite'sūyā' iti plutaḥ svaritaḥ ||
ekaśruti dūrātsaṃbuddhau || 1.2.33 ||
iha yadyapyāmantritāntasya padasyāpyabhimukhīkaraṇaṃ prati sāmarthyam, tathāpi hyarthaviśeṣasya kasyacidanuṣṭheyatayā | saṃbodhanā-saṃbuddhiḥ, antarbhāvitaṇyartho buddhiḥ, tathā ca saṃbodhayati yeneti ṇic prayuktaḥ, tatra ca vākyasyaiva karaṇabhāvo na padasyeti matvāha--ekaśruti vākyaṃ bhavatīti | kataratpunastadityata āha--dūrāditi saṃbodhanaṃ saṃbuddhiriti | anenānvarthasya saṃbuddhiśabdagrahaṇaṃ na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati | pāribhāṣikasya hi grahaṇe, devā brāhmaṇā ityatra na syāt | anvarthagrahaṇaṃ ca dūrādityanena sambandhāllabhyate, na hyāmantritaikavacanasya dūratvamadūratvaṃ vā sambhavati | saṃbodhanasya tu kriyārūpatvād apādānatayā dūrāditi viśeṣaṇasambhavāt | dūratvaṃ ca na deśasvarūpāgatamāśrīyate, anavasthitatvāt; kintu sambodhanakriyāpekṣayā dūratvam | yāvati deśe prākṛtaprayatnoccāritaṃ sambodhyamānena na śrūyate, kintvadhikaṃ prayatnamapekṣyate, tatsaṃbuddhau dūraṃ bhavati | svarāṇāmityādi | ekaśruti-svarūpākhyānam, bhedītarodhānamityanantaroktasyaiva vivaraṇam |
āgacchatyādi | dūrāddhūte vākyasya ṭeḥ plutaḥ udāttaḥ, pariśiṣṭamekaśruti | nanu ca plutaikaśrutyordvayorapi dūrātsaṃbodhanaṃ dyotyamiti phalaikyādvikalpo yuktaḥ, kathaṃ samāveśaḥ ? ucyate, vākyameva pratipādakatvāt saṃbuddhau karaṇaṃ plutaikaśrutītyasyaiva saṃskāramātram, yathā-viṣayagrahaṇe cakṣuṣa unmīlanādi, tatkutaḥ samānaphalatvamiti vākyāpekṣayā ca samāveśaḥ | antyājapekṣayā tu bādhyabādhakabhāva eva | pratyudāharathaṇe traisvaryameva bhavati | tatrāṅ 'upasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyudāttaḥ | gaccheti tiṅantasya'tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ | bhoḥśabdaḥ 'nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' iti ādyudāttaḥ, śeṣayorāmantritanighātaḥ ||
yajñakarmaṇyajapanyūṅkhasāmasu || 1.2.34 ||
aikaśrutyamiti | bahuvrīherbhāvapratyayaḥ, cāturvarṇyāditvādvā karmadhārayātsvārthe ṣyañ |
saṃpāṭha iti | svādhyāyakāle agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut, 'aṅgernalopaśca' ityagniśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, 'murvīṃ bandhane', 'kaninyuvṛṣitakṣi' iti vartatamāne 'śvannukṣanpūṣantakṣan' ityatra sūtre mūrdhanśabdaḥ kaninpratyānto'ntodātto nipātitaḥ | 'divu krīḍādau', diveranto ḍiviḥ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanasya 'ūḍidam' ityudāttam, kakucchabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, 'pāterḍatiḥ',patiśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ, pratheḥ ṣivan saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca ṣittvāt ṅīṣ, ṣaṭhyekavacanasya 'udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' ityudāttatvam, idaṃśabdaḥ pratipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, āpnoteḥ kvib hrasvaśca, 'ūḍidam' iti vibhakterudāttatvam | 'ri gatau', 'sruribhyāṃ tuṭ ca' iti asun‌pratyayaḥ, nitsvareṇādyudātto retaḥ śabdaḥ | jinvatīti | jinvateḥ prīṇanārthasya tipi nighātaḥ 'praṇavaṣṭeḥ' iti prayogakāle praṇayaḥ |
mametyādi | 'yuṣmadasmadorṅasi' ityādyudāttatvam | agneśabdasyāmantrinighātaḥ, varcaśaśabdosunpratyayāntaḥ, vipūrvād hvayateḥ 'hvaḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca' ityappratyaye thāthādisūtreṇāntodāttatvam | japo'nukaraṇamantra iti | yadyapi sa eva mantra uccāryate, tathāpi varṇābhivyaktyanabhivyaktibhyāṃ bhedaparikalpanayā'nukaraṇavyavahāraḥ | ata evāha--upāṃśuprayoga iti | yathā jale nimagnasya pāṭhaḥ | kvacidakaraṇamantra iti pāṭhaḥ, anenedaṃ kuryāditi coditaḥ karaṇamantraḥ, tato'nyo'karaṇamantraḥ | prasiddhastu pāṭho'ntaḥ karaṇamantra iti | nanu vāgindriyeṇa śabda uccāryate sa kathamantaḥ karaṇena sarvendriyasādhāraṇena vyapadiśyate, satyam; vāgindriyasya sthūlo vyāpāra upāṃśuprayoge nāsti, sa eva ca tadvyāpāratvena prasiddha iti sūkṣmavyāpāre mana eva pradhānaṃ manyate |
nyūṅkhā ityādi | ṣoḍaśeti pāṭhaḥ, okārā iti ca, na tvete makārāntāḥ, teṣu prathamasaptamatrayodaśāstraya udāttāstrimātrāḥ, itare trayodaśā anudāttā ardhaukārāḥ | etacca āśvalāyanena caturthe'hanītyasmin khaṇḍe lakṣaṇenoktamudāhṛtaṃ ca | 'ṣaḍoṅkārāḥ' iti pāṭhe mūlāntaraṃ mṛgyam | e3 viśvamityādi | eśabdo gītipūraṇaḥ, nipāta ityanye | viśvaśabdaḥ kvanpratyayānta ādyudāttaḥ, viśvamantriṇaṃ pāpmānaṃ saṃdaheti sambandhaḥ, gītivaśādeśabdo'nekamātraḥ | vākyaviśeṣasthā gītaya iti | taduktamṛṣiṇā-'gītiṣu sāmākhyā' iti ||
uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭkāraḥ || 1.2.35 ||
vaṣaṭśabdena cātra vauṣaṭ‌śabdo lakṣyate iti | samānārthatvād dvāvapi hi tau devatāsaṃpradānasya dyotakau | kāragrahaṇaṃ tu jñāpakam-avarṇādapi kārapratyayo bhavatīti | tena evakāra ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati |
yadyevamiti | lakṣaṇāyāṃ hi pratipattigauravaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | vicitrā hīti | kvacidakṣaralāghavamāśrīyate, kvacitpratipattilāghavamiti vaicitryam | uccaistarāmiti | uccaiḥśabda udāttabhavane varttate, tatra bhavanakriyayāpekṣayā pratyayaḥ | udāttatara ityartho vivakṣitaḥ, prakarṣaśca vauṣaṭśabde 'brūhipreṣayaśrauṣaḍ‌vahānāmādeḥ' iti yaḥ pluto vihitaḥ tadapekṣayā veditavyaḥ | santyudāttāḥ, ayaṃ tūdāttataraḥ | antyasadeśasyetyeke | plutodāttasya ca vidhānasāmarthyāccheṣanighātābhāvo'siddhatvādvā dvayorapyacorudāttataro bhavatītyeke | tadā yājyāntāpekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ svārthi kastarabityanye | tato hyudāttamātramprathamasya siddhamiti dvitīyasyāco vidhīyate | vaṣaṭkāraśabdo'yaṃ mantrabrāhmamayoḥ kalpasūtreṣu vauṣaṭśabde nirūḍhaḥ | vaṣaṭ kriyate'neneti vaṣaṭkāraḥ | 'mā mānpramṛja' iti mantre, 'trayo vai vaṣaṭkārāḥ vauṣaḍiti vaṣaṭkaroti' iti brāhmaṇe ca vaṣaṭkāro'ntyaḥ | 'sarvatroccaistarāṃ balīyānyājyāyā' iti sūtre uccaistarāmiti śrutiprakarṣo vidhīyata ityāhuḥ ||
vibhāṣā chandasi || 1.2.36 ||
yajñakarmaṇītyasya nivṛttyarthamiti | nanu yadyayaṃ yogo yajñakarmaṇi syāt, pūrvo yogo nirviṣayaḥ syāt | na ca japanyūṅkhasāmānyasya viṣayaḥ, japādivyatiriktastu pūrvasya viṣaya iti vyavasthā; tathā hi satyatraiva japādigrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt, kiṃ chandograhaṇena ? chandograhaṇāttu chandomātro'yaṃ vikalpa iti gamyate, tataśca yajñakarmaṇītyasyānuvṛttau pūrvo nityo vidhirnirviṣayaḥ syāt ? evaṃ manyate--ūhamantrāṇāmacchandastvātte pūrvayogasya viṣayā iti chandorūpeṣu mantreṣvayameva vikalpaḥ syāditi | yadyūhamantreṣu sāvakāśaḥ pūrvo yogaḥ, tadā yajñakarmaṇītyasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇena virvṛttāvapi chandorūpeṣvanūhiteṣu mantreṣu paratvādayameva vikalpaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yajñakarmaṇītyatra karmagrahaṇaṃ yajñānuṣṭhānamātre sarvatra nityo vidhiryathā syādityevamartham | yadyapyūhyamānā mantrā na bhavanti, tathāpyamantrāṇāmeva teṣāṃ yajñakarmaṇi prayujyamānānāṃ pūrvayogasya viṣayatvaṃ bhavatyeva | ye tu japādiparyudāsena mantrāṇāmeva tatra grahaṇamicchanti, teṣāṃ sāmarthyalabhyā yajñakarmaṇītyasya nivṛttiriti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | iṣa ityādi | iḍannam, ūrg balam | caturthekavacanasya 'sāvekācaḥ' ityudāttatvam | 'tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ' iti tvādeśo'nudāttaḥ | agne ityāmantritādyudāttatvam | āṅupasargaḥ | yāhīti | 'tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' 'vī gatyādiṣu', 'mantre vṛṣeṣapaca' ityādinā ktinnudāttaḥ, agniśabdo'ntodāttaḥ | ami pūrvatvam 'ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' | īle iti | 'īḍastutau' laḍuttamaikavacanam | bah‌vṛcā dvayoracormadhye sthitasya ḍakārasya lakāraṃ vidadhati | purohitam | 'puro'vyayam ' iti gatisaṃjñā, 'gatiranantaraḥ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, puraḥ śabdo'sipratyayānto'ntodāttaḥ | śanśabdo nipātaḥ, nasādeśo'nudāttaḥ devaḍiti pacādiṣu paṭhyate, ṭittvān ṅīp,'anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' abhipūrvādiṣeḥ ktini śakandhvāditvāt pararūpe'bhiṣṭetyādau ca 'niti kṛtyatau' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇābhiśabdasyāntodāttatvaṃ caturthyekavacanam |
na subrahmaṇyāyāṃ svaritasya tūdāttaḥ || 1.2.37 ||
subrahmaṇyā nāma nigada iti | apādabandhe gadirvarttate, yathā gadyamiti, niśabdaḥ prakarṣe | uccairapādabandhaṃ yajurātmakaṃ yanmantravākyaṃ paṭhyate sa nigadaḥ, nitarāṃ gadyata iti karmaṇi 'nau gadanada' ityap, tasya ca subrahṇaṇyāśabdopalakṣitatvāt subrahmaṇyāśabdoparityaktistrīliṅga eva nāma | oṅkārastitsvareṇa svarita iti subrahmaṇi sādhuriti yatpratyayaḥ, titsvareṇa svaritaḥ | tasya ṭābekādeśaḥ svaritānudāttayorāntaryāt svaritaḥ, tato nipāternauśabdena 'omāṅośca' ityudāttasvaritayorekādeśaḥ svarita eva | 'āmantritamādyudāttam' iti āṣṭamikastu nighāto'samānavākyatvānna bhavati | tasyāneneti | na ca tasyāsiddhatvam, idaṃ hi prakaraṇamasiddhakāṇ‍ḍa utkraṣṭaḍavyamityuktam | ata evāsminnudātte kṛte śeṣanighāto'pi na bhavati; yathoddeśapakṣe'nudāttaparibhāṣāyāṃ karttavyāyām asiddhatvena varjyamānābhāvāt | teneha dvāvapyudāttau sampannau thaiti | paścima eko'nudātta iti | na ca tasya 'udattādanudāttasya' iti svaritaprasaṅgaḥ; prakaraṇotakarṣeṇasyāsiddhatvād, 'nodāttasvaritodayam' iti niṣedhācca | dvāvanudāttāviti | vakāracchakārau, śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam | 'asāvamuṣyetyantaḥ' etasminneva subrahmaṇyānigade prathamāntasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya cānta udātto bhavati | gārgyo yajate, dākṣeḥ pitā yajate--titsvare prāpte vacanam | 'syāntasyopottamaṃ ca' syaśabdāntasyopottamamuttamaṃ cobhayamudāttaṃ bhavati | gārgyasya pitā yajate 'vā nāmedhayasya' | devadattasya pitā yajate ||
devabrahmaṇoranudāttaḥ || 1.2.38 ||
svaritasyodātte prāpte iti | kathaṃ prāptaḥ, yāvatā'siddhaḥ svaritaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-'tasyāditaḥ' ityārabhya nabasūtrī 'udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' ityasmātparā draṣṭavyeti | uktāni prayojanāni, uttaratra ca vakṣyāmaḥ | sāmānyāpekṣatvājjñāpakasya navasūtryapyutkṛṣyate, na subrahmaṇyāsvara eva | dvayorapi padayoriti | dvitīyasya padatparasyāpi nighāto na bhavati; ' āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavad' iti pūrvasyāvidyamāntvāt | prathamasyāpi na bhavati; bhinnavākyatvāt ||
svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudāttānām || 1.2.39 ||
anudāttānāmiti bahuvacanaṃ jātau, tenaikasya dvayorbahūnāṃ ca bhavati--ekasya pacati, dvayorāgniveśyaḥ; bahūnāṃ tu vṛttāveva darśitam | itamityantodāttamiti | idaṃ-śabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, vibhaktiranudāttā, tyādādyatve 'ami pūrvaḥ' 'ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' | vidhikāla eveti | yadyapyatra vihitasyānudāttavidhāne'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ, tathāpi tattvena vyavaharttavyamityevamuktam | tasmāt svaritāditi | na ca tasyāsiddhatvam; utkṛṣṭatvād navasūtryāstena kāryaṃ devadattetyādāvivekaśrutirbhavatyeva | gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāmiti | na ca yamuneprabhṛtīnāṃ vyavadhānam; jāterekatvād, vyaktīnāṃ satīnāmapyanāśritatvād akiñcitkaratvam | tataḥ pareṣāmiti | 'nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe' iti māṇavakaśabdasyāvidyamānatvaṃ na bhavati |
ñavagrahe mā bhūditi | idameva ca saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam--pañcamīnirdeśe kālo na vyavadhyāyaka iti | tena 'tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' ityavagrahe'pi bhavati-agnimīle |
udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ || 1.2.40 ||
paraśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyata ityāha--udāttaḥ paro yasmāditi | sannaśabdena nīcairartha ucyate, tenānudāttatvaṃ lakṣyata ityāha--anudāttatara iti | prakarṣaḥ sthānyanudāttāpekṣaḥ | mātara ityanudātta iti | samāsaikadeśo niṣkṛṣṭānukṛtaḥ, devā ityādīnāṃ trayāṇāmāmantritānāmekībhūtānāmādyudāttatve śeṣanighātaḥ | 'vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣacane bahuvacanam' iti vidyamānapakṣe cāmantritanighātaḥ, jasaḥ sakārasya rutvam, tasya sraṃsanayuktasya 'ato roraplutāt, iti ukāro'nudāttaḥ, 'ād‌guṇaḥ' so'pyāntaryato'nudāttaḥ, acchabdākārasya śeṣanighātaḥ, tayoranudāttayoḥ 'eṅaḥ padāntādati' ityekādeśa āntaryato'nudāttaḥ | sarasvatīkārasyeti | nanu ca navasūtryutkṛṣyata iti jñāpitam, tataśca gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāmiva sarasvatīkārasyāpi pūrveṇaikaśrutireva prāpnoti, kaḥ punaḥ sannatarasyāvakāśaḥ, yaḥ svaritātparo na bhavati ? agniriti | na ca vipratiṣedhena sannataro labhyate; pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvāduttarasya | evaṃ tarhi 'na mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | iha devadattasya nyaṅ iti 'nyadhī ca' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare 'udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' ityañcatyakārasya svaritaḥ pūrvasya sannataraṃ pratyasiddho na bhavati; prakaraṇotkarṣād | 'udāttasvaritayoḥ' ityeva siddhe paragrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhāvekavacanavivakṣārthamiti gaṅgeprabhṛtīnāṃ sannatarābhāvaḥ ||
apṛkta ekāl pratyayaḥ || 1.2.41 ||
ghṛtaspṛgiti | 'kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' iti kutvam | arthabhāgiti | atra 'verepṛktasya' iti lopaḥ prayojanam | ekālgrahaṇaṃ kimiti | samudāyadvāreṇāyamekapadaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ, anyathā pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā syāditi pradeśeṣu pratyayagrahaṇameva kartavyaṃ syāt, kiṃ sañjñayā ! yatra yadyalantasya syāt, kevalasya cāpyantavadbhāvāt algrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi tatsāmarthyādalsamudāyasya na bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ |
darviriti | 'dṝ vidāraṇe' auṇādiko vin pratyayaḥ | varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇādalsamudāyā gṛhyante iti bhāvaḥ | syādetat-'verapṛktasya' ityatra 'vo'pṛktasya' ityastu, kvibādiṣu ca mā bhūdikāraḥ, na cānyaḥ pratyayo vakāro'stīti, tannaḥ 'rājani yudhikṛñaḥ' rājakṛtvā, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇici ṭilope kvipi ṇilope ca kṛte kvanipaḥ sambandhī pratyayo vakāro'sti | avaśyaṃ ca kvibādīnāmuccāraṇārthe kaścidajāsaṃjanīyaḥ, tatrākāre 'sṝśṛbhyāṃ vaḥ' ityādiṣvapi lopaḥ prasajyeta | ukāre tu ṇvulādiṣu | anyatra tu gauravamiti yathānyāsameva sādhīyaḥ | nanu ca yadyalsamudāyo'pi gṛhyate, algrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād | ato yadyapi 'nipāta ekājanāṅ' ityatraikagrahaṇādvarṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇaṃ jñāpitam, tathāpyatrālgrahaṇasāmarthyātsamudāyasya na bhaviṣyatīti cintyaprayojanamekagrahaṇam | tathā'pṛktapradeśaऱeṣvalgrahaṇenaiva siddhe nārthaḥ saṃjñayā; natarāmmahatyā, natamāmpūrvanirddiṣṭayā |
surā iti | surāṃ sunotīti kvipi tuk surāsutamācaṣṭe iti ṇici ṭilopaḥ kvib ṇilopaḥ, atra dhātusakārasya 'halṅyābbhya' iti lopo na bhavati, pratyayaparibhāṣayā siddham | tipā sāhacaryāccaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ siddhamiti pratyayagrahaṇamapi cintyaprayojanameva ||
tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ || 1.2.42 ||
atra 'tatpuruṣaḥ' 'samānādhikaraṇaḥ' iti dvayorapi padayormukhyārthatve brāhmaṇarājyaṃ śobhanamityādau yatra bāhyena padena tatpuruṣasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tatraiva saṃjñā syād, na tu paramarājyamityādau; śabdāntarasyāprayogādityanyataradgoṇārthamiti sthite kāmacārādyadi tatpuruṣaśabdo gauṇaḥ syāt tatpuruṣārthāni padāni samānādhikaraṇānīti, tataḥ sahagrahaṇābhāvāt pratyakaṃ saṃjñā iti śaṅkyeta, atastatpuruṣa iti padaṃ mukhyārthamityāha-tatpuṣa iti | samāsaviśeṣasyetyādi | itaradgauṇārthamityāha-samānādhikaraṇapada iti | samānādhikaraṇāni padānyāśrayatvena yasya santi sa tathoktaḥ; avayavadvārakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamaupacārikamapi padāntanirapekṣamantaraṅgamiti tadevāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | bhavati hyavayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya vyapadeśaḥ, yathā-samaṃ cūrṇamiti | atra hyavayavadvārakaṃ cūrṇasya sāmyam, na tu kṛtsnasya cūrṇasyānyena | paramarājyamiti, akarmadhārayerājyam ityatrākarmadhāraya iti niṣedhāduttarapadādyudāttatvābhāve samāsāntodāttameva bhavati | pācakavṛndāriketi | 'na kopadhāyāḥ' iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitvā 'puṃvatkarmadhāraya' iti puṃvadbhāvo bhavati |
tatpuruṣa iti kimiti | pratipadoktatvādadhikārāvagatervā samānādhikaraṇādhikāravihitastapuruṣa eva pratipatsyata iti praśnaḥ | pācikābhārya iti | ayamevārtho duravadhāra iti bhāvaḥ | brāhmaṇarājyamiti | atrottarapadādyudāttatvameva bhavati | atha 'pūrvakālaika' ityasya prakaraṇasyānte 'karmadhāraya' iti kasmānnoktam, yo'yaṃ samānādhikaraṇādhikāravihitastatpuruṣaḥ sa karmadhāraya iti, evaṃ hi 'tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇa' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati ? satyam; ekasaṃjñādhikārāttu karmadhārasaṃjñayā tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyā bādhaḥ syāditi dvigoriva punastatpuruṣasaṃjñāvidhānāya karmadhārayapadamupādeyam | punaśca paryāyaprasaṅge samāveśāya cakāro'pi vaktavyaḥ nanvevaṃ kariṣyate-dvigukarmadhārayau ceti ? evaṃ tu na kṛtamityeva ||
prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam || 1.2.43 ||
samāsa ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam | kaṣṭaśritādayaśca samāsāḥ, teṣu kiṃ prathamānirddeṣṭaṃ bhavitumarhati ? samāse sati yasmātprathamā vidhīyate, na ca tathābhūtaṃ sambhavati | samāse hi kṛte tata eva prathamotpadyate, na tadavayavād | antarvartinyā ca vibhaktyā śritaśabda eva prathamānirdiṣṭo na kaṣṭaśabdaḥ | sāpi na samāse satyutpannā, kiṃ tarhi ? vākyakāla eva | nirdiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, samāse prathamāntamityeva vācyaṃ syād, ato mukhyasyāsambhavādgauṇaḥ samāso gṛhyate ityāha-prathamayetyādi | kathaṃ punaḥ samāsa iti śāstrasya grahaṇamityāha-samāsavidhāyīti | samāsavidhāyitvāttādarthyāttācchabdyamityarthaḥ | nirdiṣṭagrahaṇādeva ca tulye'pi samāsārthatve vākyaṃ na gṛhyate, na hi tatra nirdeśārthā prathamā, arthaprayuktatvāt | dvitīyetyetatprathamānirdiṣṭamiti | prathamayā vibhaktyā uccāritam | yadyevam, tasyaiva saṃjñā syānna kaṣṭādīnām, na hi te śāstre prathamānirdiṣṭāḥ | ya eva dvitīyetyasya prathamānirdeśaḥ, sa eva kaṣṭādīnāmapi; tatparatvāttasya | yathā vakṣyati-'tasyeti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ tadīyaprāthamyaṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ vijñāyate' iti | kaṣṭaśritādiṣūpasarjanatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ | mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham | loke'pradhānamupasrajanamucyate, ihāpyapradhānamupasarjanam | pradhānamapradhānamiti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, tena yatprati yadapradhānaṃ tadeva prati tadupasarjanaṃ bhavati, tena rājñaḥ kumārīśrita iti 'dvitīyā śrita' ityatra prathamānirdiṣṭasyāpi kumārīśabdasya saṃjñā na bhavati | yadi syāt, pūrvanipātāniyama upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ ca syāt | anvarthatve tu śritādīnevāpekṣya dvitīyāntamupasarjanamiti na prasaṅgaḥ | evaṃ rājñaḥ kumāryā ityatra dvayorapi 'ṣaṣṭhī' ityatra prathamānirdeśe'pi kumārīmapekṣya rājña upasarjanatvam, na taṃ prati tasyāḥ | yadyanvarthasaṃjñā, nārtho'nena, pradeśeṣvevānvarthagrahaṇamastu | vākye'pi tarhi syāt-kumārīṃ śritā gavāṃ kulam | atha saṃjñāvidhirvākye kasmānna bhavati, yāvatā 'samāse' iti prathamānirdeśasyādhāro na saṃjñāyāḥ ? tathā gokulaṃ kumārīputra ityatra samāse'pi pūrvanipātavad hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tasmātsatyevopasarjanatve upasarjanagośabdantasyopasarjanatvāt strīpratyayāntāntasya prātipadikasya hrasvavidhānātsamāsādhikāre pūrvanipātavacanācca vākye tau na bhavata iti vācyam | saṃjñāvidhānaṃ tūnmattagaṅgamityādau dvayorapyaprādhānye pūrvanipātaniyamārtham | yatra cānanyārthaḥ prathamānirdeśastatra prathānasyāpi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ca | yathā-pācakavṛndārakaḥ, puruṣavyāghraḥ, arddhapiplī, pūrvakāya iti atra 'vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam', 'upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ','arddhaṃ napuṃsakam','pūrvāparādharottaram' iti prathamānirdeśasyedameva prayojanam; samāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa ṣaṣṭhītyeva siddhatvād | na ca pūjyamānatādiviṣaya eva yathā syāditi niyamārthastadārambhaḥ ? upasarjanasaṃjñārthatve'rddhādipūrvapadasya viśiṣṭarūpasyārddhapippalītyādeḥ samāsasya vidhisambhavāt tasmādetadarthāpi saṃjñā | anvarthatvaṃ tu sati saṃbhave vyavasthāpakam ||
ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte || 1.2.44 ||
vibhaktiśabdaḥ supāṃ vācakaḥ, kārakaśaktivacano vā; vibhajyate'nayā prātipadikārtha iti kṛtvā | samāse vidhīyamāne iti | yadupamardanena samāso bhavati tasmanvākya ityarthaḥ, samāsarūpaprāptyabhimukhe padatraya iti yāvat | etana samāsārthaṃ vākyamatra samāsaḥ, na pūrvasūtra iva śāstramiti darśayati | śāstre sarvamevibhaktimityekavibhaktītyanarthakaṃ syāt, mukhye'pi samāse pratyayalakṣaṇenaikavibhaktitvaṃ samarthanīyamiti vākyamevātra samāsaḥ | ekasmiṃśca prayoge sarvamekavibhaktikamiti viśeṣaṇaopādānasāmarthyataprayogabhedenāpi yasya na sarvavibhaktitvaṃ tadāśrīyata ityāha-yanniyatavibhaktikamiti | etadeva spaṣyayati-dvitīye sambandhinītyādi |
kecidāhuḥ-'yena saha samāsyate dvitīyasambandhī' iti, evaṃ tu pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakhaṭvīti vā ṭābanta iti strīliṅgapakṣe upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ na syāt | samāhāro hyatra nānāvibhaktiyukto na pañcañ‌śabdaḥ, tasmātapradhānārthavācī śabdo dvitīyaḥ sambandhaḥ | niṣkauśāmbiriti kauśāmbīśabdo niṣkramaṇakriyāpekṣayā'pādānaśaktiiyogāt pañcamyante eva, na tasya kriyāntaramapekṣya śaktyantarāveśaḥ sambhavati | niḥśabdastu niṣkrāntapradhāno nānāśaktibhiryujyate |
niṣkauśāmbiriti | kuśāmbena nirvṛttā nagarī kauśāmbī, 'gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvaḥ | nirvārāṇasiriti | ano jalaṃ tadvaraṃ yasyāḥ sā varāṇā gaṅgā, tasyā adūrabhavā nagarī vārāṇasī | purāṇe tu varaṇā cāsiśca nadyau, śakandhvādiḥ, tayoradūrabhavā pṛṣodarāditvādrephākārasya dīrghaḥ | nisaḥ pūrveṇopasarjanatvam, pradhānasyāpi hi prathamānirdeśasāmarthyāt bhavatītyuktam | ihāsyāvakāraśo'prathamānirddiṣṭaḥ, pūrvasyāvakāśo'nekavibhaktiḥ nīlotpalādiḥ, arddhipippalyādiśca; kaṣṭaśritādiṣu kaṣṭādaya ekavibhaktikāḥ prathamānirdiṣṭāścetyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādanenaiva prāpnoti, tataśca'apūrvanipāte' iti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, na; apratiṣedhāt | nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ-pūrvanipāte neti, kiṃ tarhi ? paryudāso'yam, pūrvanipāte na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ | prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyanantaraprāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate, kuta etad ? anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā bhavati, pūrvā prāptirapratiṣiddhā tayā bhaviṣyati | na ceyaṃ prāptiḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ bādhate, pratiṣiddhatvāt ||
arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipādakam || 1.2.45 ||
abhidheyavacano'rthaśabda iti | na prayojanavacano'vyabhicārāt; na nivṛttivacanaḥ, svayaṃ nivṛttasya kiṃ saṃjñayā ! na dhanavacanaḥ, svasvāmibhāvasyāsambhavāt | taccābhidheyaṃ caturddhā-cātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena; gauḥ, śulkaḥ, pācakaḥ, ḍittha iti | yadyarthavataḥ saṃjñā, abhāvaśaśaviṣāṇādīnāṃ na prāpnoti; arthābhāvāt | mā bhūdanena, samāsa iti bhaviṣyati ? na; arthaṃvadityanuvṛtteḥ | anyarthā'narthake'tra vidhisambhāvat samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ na syāt, ucyate; yeṣāṃ tāvad‌bhūtalādyāśrayaṃ ghaṭādipratiyogikaṃ nāstīti buddhibodhyaṃ tattvāntaramabhāvastanmate tenārthenārthavattvam; yeṣāmapyāśrayābhimataṃ bhūtalādisvarūpameva tad‌buddhiviśeṣo vā pratiyogino ghaṭāderabhāvastanmate tenaiva bhūtalādinārtha'vattvamityabhāvasya tāvatsiddhā saṃjñā | śaśaviṣāṇamityatrāpi gavādiṣvanubhūtaviṣāṇaṃ śaśamastakavartitayā buddhyotprekṣya tasyaivābhidhānāya śabdaprayogaḥ | buddhyupāroha eva cārthasya śabdaprayoge kāraṇam, na bahiḥ sattā | yadi bahiḥ santamevārthaṃ śabdā abhidadhati; ghaṭo nāstīti prayogo na syād; ekatra paunaruktyād, aparatra virodhād | buddhyuārūḍhasya bahiḥ sattvāsattvāpratipādanāyopapadyate prayogaḥ | evamapākṣīt, pakṣyati, asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayetyādāvapi buddhyupārūḍha eva pacyādīnāmarthaḥ; na tu śabdaprayogakāle bahiḥ siddhaḥ |
ḍitthādīnyavyutpannānyudāharaṇāni | vyutpattau kṛdantatvādeva siddham | sarvanāma dhātujamityatrāpi pakṣe'vyayārthamanukaraṇaśabdārthaṃ ca sūtramārabhyameva | nanu laukike prayoge śabdānāmarthavattādhyavasāyaḥ, sa ca vākyasyaiva padasya vā vibhaktyantasya; na tu prakṛtibhāgamātrasyeti kathaṃ tasya niṣkṛṣyārthavattvaniścayaḥ ! yeṣāṃ hi sahaiva prayogasteṣāṃ saṅghātasyaivārthavattā yathā varṇānām ? ucyate; anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdārthaniścayaḥ, yasya śabdasyānvaye yo'rthaḥ pratīyate, vyatireke ca vyatiricyate sa tasyārthaḥ | vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityādau ca pratyayasāmānyavyabhicāre'pi tadviśeṣavyabhicāraḥ, vṛttau sāmānyavyabhicāraśca vṛkṣakhaṇḍaṃ vārkṣī śākheti, arthastu mūlaskandhaphalapalāśādimān yāvadvṛkṣaśabdaṃ pratīyate |
nāntasyāvadheriti | nanu 'vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau','dhana dhānye' ityetayordhātvoretau śabdau pacādyaci vyutpāditau, tatrādhāturiti niṣedho bhaviṣyati | evaṃ tarhyavyutpattipakṣa etaduktam, ata evodāharaṇatvenāpyanayorupanyāsaḥ | kiṃ cāsatyartha vadgrahaṇe prativarṇaṃ saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, na ca prativarkaṇaṃ dhātusaṃjñā, na cādhāturapraratyaya iti paryudāsāśrayaṇād arthavato grahaṇam | anarthakayorapi dhātupratyayayoḥ sambhavād, yathā-adhīte, yāvaka iti | atra hyadhipūrvasyeṅo'rthavattvaṃ na tu iṅi; tasya kvacidapyaprayogād | yāvaka ityatrāpi yāvaśabdasyaivārthavattvaṃ na tu kanaḥ; antareṇāpi tadarthāvagamāt | na ca jñāyate-kena dharmeṇa sādṛśyamiti ! na cārthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayārthavato grahaṇam ? eṣā hi niyatarūpopādāne vyavasthāpayati, na cātra rūpaviśeṣopādānam | nanu satyāmapyanarthakasya saṃjñāyāṃ saṃkhyākarmādiṣu vidhīyamānāḥ svādayo na bhaviṣyanti, naitadasti; aviśeṣeṇotpadyante, utpannā nāmarthaniyamaḥ, tataścāvyayavat svādayaḥ syureva | nalopo hi syāditi | vibhaktestu śravaṇaṃ na bhavati, samudāyasyāpi pṛthak prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantarbhāvālluko bhāvāt | yadyevam, dvirvacananyāyenāvayavasya na bhaviṣyati, yuktaṃ tatra paj ityatra yenaivācā samudāya ekāc, tenaiva tadavayavo'cchabdaḥ paśabdaśca; na caikasyaikadā'nekaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ nirūpayituṃ śakyam | kiñca--samudāyadvirvacanenāvayavā api dvirucyante, tadātmakatvāttsya | iha tvavayavānāṃ samudāyasya ca saṃjñānibandhanaṃ śabdatvaṃ pṛthageva | tatra samudāyasya yat tena yasyaiva kāryaṃ nāvayavānām | nanu ca eti, ābhyām, aupagavaḥ, a apehīti, dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipātānāmekavarṇānāmarthadarśanāt vṛkṣādiṣvapi varṇā arthavantaḥ, tathā kūpa iti kakāre sati kaścidartho gamyate, yūpa iti yakāropajane'rthantaram, tena manyāmahe yaḥ kūpe kūpārthaḥ sa kakārasya, yo yūpe yūpārthaḥ sa yakārasyeti; tathā 'brāhmaṇa' ityukte yo'rtho gamyate nāsau bakārādīnāmanyatarāpāye'pi gamyate | yeṣāṃ ca saṃghāto yatkāryaṃ karoti pratyekamapi tat kurvanti, yathā-tilānāṃ khārī tailamutpādayati, pratyekaṃ ca tilāḥ | ye ca yasmin pratyekamasamarthāsteṣāṃ saṃghāto'pi tatrāsamarthaḥ, yathā-pratyekaṃ sikatāstailaṃ notpādayanti tathā khāryati tāsām | ataḥ saṃghātārthavattvāccārthavanto varṇāḥ, tatkathamarthavad‌grahaṇe satyapi teṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ | anarthakāstu, prativarṇānāmarthānupalabdheḥ, na hi 'brā' ityukte kaścidartho gamyate | ato dhātvādīnāmekavarṇānāmarthavattvād anya'pi varṇā arthavanta ityanupalabdhibādhitametad | evamanye'pi hetavo bādhitaviṣayāḥ | kiṃ ca kūpo yūpa ityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kakārayakārayorthavattve yūpa iti caturṇāṃ varṇānāmānarthakyamabhyupagataṃ syāt; atha teṣāmarthavattvaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaḥ kūpe yūpārthaḥ syāt, kūpārthaśca yūpe, yatra bhūyasāmarthavatāmanvayaḥ, vyatirekastu kasyacit; tatrārthānāmapi bhūyasānumapṛttirbhavati, vyatirekastu kasyacid; yathā devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklām, devadatta gāmabhāyāja kṛṣṇāmiti | ataḥ saṃghātā eva tenārthavantaḥ | saṃghātārthavattvācceti heturanaikāntikaḥ, tailāgnivartisaṃghātena dīpaḥ, na pratyekam, rathāvayavaiścakrādibhiḥ saṃhatairvrajikriyā | kiñcārthavatāṃ viparyāse'rthapratyayasyāpi viparyāsaḥ-āhara pātraṃ pātramāhareti, apāye cāpāyaḥ-gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ gāmabhyājeti, upajane copajanaḥ-gāmabhyāja śuklāmiti | varṇeṣu tu naivam, hinastīti siṃho hanti hataḥ ghnanti | ataḥ saṃghātā evārthavantaḥ |
ahanniti | hanterlaṅi tip 'itaśca' lope halṅyādilopo'ṭ, sa hangrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, atra prāgeva laṅutpatteḥ saṃjñāyāṃ tasyāmuttarakālaṃ padatve sati nalopaḥ syāt | yadvā prātipadikasaṃjñā padasaṃjñāsamakālemeva syāt, na vā'pratyaya iti pratiṣedhaḥ; 'na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' iti liṅgāt; anyathā he rājannityādāvapratyaya iti niṣedhādaprātipadikatvādeva nalopaprasaṅgāt |
adhāturiti śakyamakartum, 'supo dhātu' iti dhātugurahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-na dhātoriyaṃ saṃjñeti | naitadasti jñāpakam, pratiṣiddhārthametat syāt, śyenāyata ityādāvapratyaya iti niṣiddhā saṃjñeti bhid, bhūḥ, pūrityevamādau kvibantatve kṛdantatvāduttarasūtreṇa saṃjñā | na ca tasyā api pratiṣedho'yam, 'madhye'pavādāḥ' iti nyāyāt, paryudāsatvādvā |
kāṇḍe iti | prathamādvivacanasya 'napuṃsakācca' iti śībhāvaḥ, apratyaya iti ca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya niṣedhaḥ | yatra hi pratyayaḥ saṃjñirūpe'nupraviśati, yathā- 'taraptamapau ghaḥ' iti, tatra padasaṃjñāyāmantavacanena tadantavidhipratiṣedhaḥ | iha tu paryudāse pratyayavyatiriktaḥ saṃjñī, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi na saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagraṇaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratiṣedha iti, nāsti niṣedhaḥ | nanūttarasūtre kṛttaddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-pratyayāntasya yadi bhavati kṛttaddhitāntasyaiveti, ucyate; asmin satyapratiṣedhe saṃjñāvidhau tadantavidhipratiṣedhātpratyayasya yadi bhavati kṛttaddhitasyaiveti sthāniniyamaḥ syāt | sati tvasmin, atra tāvatpratyayāntasya niṣedha iti uttarasūtre'pi taddhitāntasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati | atha kriyamāṇe'pyapratyaya ityasminnapuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? paryudāse tāvatpratyayāpratyayayorekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyantaraṅgatvāt prāgeva pratyayotpatteḥ kāṇḍaśabdasya pravṛttā saṃjñeti ekādeśasyāntavadbhāva ityāstyeva prātipadikatvam | tathā ca brahmabandhūrityūṅekādeśasyāntavattvāt svādyutpattiḥ | na cāpratyaya ityasya vaiyarthyam; trapuṇī ityādau yatraikādeśatvaṃ nāsti tatrārthavattvāt | evaṃ tarhi napuṃsake yadvartate tasyahsvaḥ, vibhaktyantaṃ tu saṃkhyāpradhānaṃ kārakaśaktipradhānaṃ ca, na ca tayorliṅgayogaḥ, na cānyavadbhāvenārthaḥ śakyo'tideṣṭumiti na bhavati hsvaḥ | yadyevam, trapuṇī ityādāvapyevameva na bhaviṣyati, nārtho'nena, na cānyaḥ pratyayānto vyāvartyaḥ sambhavati | tathā hi, ṣaḍvidhāḥ pratyayāḥ--sanādayaḥ, kṛtaḥ tiṅaḥ, supaḥ, strīpratyayāḥ,taddhitāśceti | pratipadikakāryamapi 'hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' 'gaustriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvatvam, 'ṅyāpprātipadikāt' iti pratyayavidhiśca | tacca kṛttaddhitāntasyeṣyata thaeva | sanprabhṛtiṣu yeṣāṃ tāvaddhātutvaṃ teṣāmadhāturityeva pratiṣedhaḥ, śyanśabādīnāmapi vikaraṇānāṃ liṅgābhāvaḥ, saṃkhyākarmādyabhāvo'patyādyarthāyogaśca | evaṃ tiṅantānām, yathā-yaḥ pacatirūpam, tasyāpatyam iti rūpabantatvātsatyapi prātipadikatve | ye tu sambhavanti svārthikāste 'tiṅaśca' iti jñāpakānna bhavanti | strīpratyayānāṃ tu viruddhena napuṃsakenāyoga eva, kumārīputra ityatra 'gostriyoḥ' iti hrasvaḥ syāditi ced ? atha kriyamāṇe'pi pratiṣedhe rājakumārīputra ityatra kasmānna bhavati, atra hi samāsatvādastyeva prātipadikatvam ? ato yastatra parihāraḥ, sa evātrāpi bhaviṣyati | pratyayavidhistviṣyata eva | 'ṅayāpprātipadikāt' iti subantasya hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnotītyuktameva | supāṃ cāprasaṅgaḥ; tadvidhānadaśāyāṃ tadantasyāsambhavāt, liṅgābhāvāt strīpratyayābhāvaḥ | taddhitāstviṣyanta eva 'samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti | ato nārtho'nena, uttarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇena ca, ucyate; 'bahuṣu bahuvacanam' 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādināṃ svādividhivākyena bhinnavākyatāpakṣe sarvebhyaḥ pratyayāntebhyaḥ svādayaḥ syuḥ yathā-avyayebhyaḥ | vikaraṇāntācca svārthikāstaddhitāḥ syurevetyato'pratyayagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ taddhitagrahaṇaṃ ca | kāṇḍe kuḍya ityetayostu pratyudāharaṇatvam 'hasvo napuṃsake' ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ |
atha pratyāyamātrasya saṃjñā kasmānna bhaviṣyati, satyāṃ hi saṃjñāyāmuktena nyāyena bahupaṭava ityādau svādayaḥ syuḥ ? ucyate-vyapadeśivadbhāvena pratyayāntavadpratyaya iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | yadyevam, kṛttaddhitamātre'pi vidhisambhavāt uttarasūtre tadantavidhirna bhavati | atra parihāraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||
kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca || 1.2.46 ||
kṛto vihitāstadādaya iti veditavyam | atra hi kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate, tena mūlakenopadaṃśamiti vākyasya saṃjñā na bhavati | madhye'pavādanyāyena hyapratyaya iti niṣedhaḥ kṛd‌grahaṇena bādhyate, na tu samāsagrahaṇena kṛto niyamaḥ | saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe'pyatra tadantavidhirbhavatītyatrīpapattimāha--apratyaya iti | pratyayāntasya niṣedho na kevalasya pratyayasyetyāśrityaitaducyate | aprāptaprāpaṇaṃ vidhiḥ, na ca tadā kṛttaddhitamātrasyāprāptā saṃjñā tadantasyatvaprāpteti vidhyarthatvāttadantasyaiva grahaṇam | yeṣāṃ tu pūrvatra pratyayamātrasyāpi niṣedhasteṣāmarthavad‌grahaṇānevṛtterarthavadviśeṣasya tadantasya grahaṇaṃ samāsagrahaṇamanarthakam, arthavattvātpūrveṇaiva saṃjñāsiddherityata āha-arthavatsamudāyānāmiti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | niyamaḥ - vyāvṛttiḥ | nanu surājā atirājetyādau antarvattinyāṃ vibhaktau luptāyāṃ samudāyasya saṃjñā, tāmapekṣya sorutpannasya halṅyādilope tasyāmavasthāyāṃ nalopārthaṃ yā saṃjñā prāpnoti tasyāḥ pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti niṣedhe prāpte vidhyarthametatsyāt ? jñāpakātsiddham, 'na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti niṣedho jñāpayati-na pratyayalakṣaṇena niṣedha iti; anyathā uktena nyāyena he rājannityādau nalopaprasaṅgāt | naitadasti jñāpakam; hai surājannityādau yatra samāsagrahaṇena saṃjñā vihitā tatra nalopaprasaṅge niṣedhaḥ syād | evaṃ tarhyatrāpyapratyaya ityanuvarttate, tena pratyayānte samāse vidhyarthatvāsaṃbhavānniyamārthameva samāsagrahaṇam |
yadvā-anuddiśya prayojanaviśeṣaṃ na kṛtsaṃjñā pravartate, tasyāṃ tu satyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tasyāṃ tadbhavati, na pratikāryamāvarttanīyā saṃjñetyayaṃ pakṣa āśrīyate | atra ca pakṣe subutpattyarthaṃ nalopārthaṃ ca samāsasaṃjñānantarameva sakṛtsaṃjñā pravarttate, na tu nalopadaśāyāmiti vidhyarthatvāsambhavānniyamārthameva samāsagrahaṇam | tulyajātīyasya ca niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ, kaśca tulyajātīyo yasyārthavatsamudāyasya pūrvo bhāgastāvatpadam, yaścaiva hi subantānāṃ samāsaḥ-rājapuruṣa iti, yaścaiva hi tiṅantānām--"ākhyatamākhyātena kriyāsātatye', aśnītapibatā, khādatamodateti, yaśca subantānāṃ tiṅantānāṃ ca-'jahi karmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye', jahijoḍaḥ, jahiśakaṭa iti, yaśca subantānāṃ prātipadikānāṃ ca--gatikārakopapadānāmiti, vastrakrīti niṣkakrītīti, sarvatrātra pūrvo bhāgastāvatpadam | ataḥ sa tulyajātīyo niyamena vyāvartyate, tena bahupaṭava ityatra jasantasya purastādvahuci kṛte nottaratrata saṃghāte pūrvo bhāgaḥ padamityasati niyame īṣadasamāptilakṣaṇenārthenārthavattvātsatyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ pūrvotpannasya jasaḥ 'supo dhātu' iti luki kṛte citsvaro'pi bhavan 'catiḥ saprakṛterbahujakajarthamiti' paṭuśabdokārasya bhavati | pūrvotpannasya tu jaso'vasthāne tasyaiva syāt | vākyasyārthavata iti | pratyekaṃ padairapratītasya saṃsargasya vākyena pratīyamānatvāttasyārthavattvam, samudāyācca pratyayasyāvidhānānnāstyapratyaya iti niṣedhaḥ | na ca 'nāsti yasmin pratyayaḥ so'pratyayaḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ śakya āśrayitum; bahupaṭava ityatrāpi ni,edhaprasaṅgāt ||
hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya || 1.2.47 ||
sūtre napuṃsakaśabdena tadvad‌dravyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na liṅgamātramityāha-napuṃsakaliṅge'rthe iti | napuṃsakaṃ liṅgamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ |
grāmaṇīriti | 'satsūdiṣa' ityādinā kvip | prātipadikasyeti kimiti | napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ dravyasyaiva dharmaḥ, dravyavācitvaṃ ca prātipadikasyaiva, na subantasya; śaktisaṅkhyāprādhānyāt | na dhātostiḍantasya vākyasya vā; kriyāpradhānatvāt | varṇāstvanarthakāḥ, strīpratyayānāṃ tu viruddhena napuṃsakenāyoga iti praśnaḥ | kāṇḍe kuṇḍye iti | atra 'apratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhāt pratipadikatvaṃ nāsti | nanu ca ekādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt prātipadikagrahaṇena gṛhyate iti kriyamāṇe'pi prātipadikagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ syādevāt āha-prātipadikagrahaṇasāmarthyāditi | kathaṃ puna sāmarthyam, yāvatā yatrāntavadbhāvo nāsti-vāḥ vārī trapuṇī ityādau, tadvyāvartyaṃ syāt ? atha śaktisaṅkhyāpradhānatvāt tatra napuṃsakenāyogaḥ, kāṇḍe ityādāvapi evamape na bhaviṣyati | na hyantavadbhāvena prātipadikatve satyapi śaktisaṅkhyāprādhānyaṃ hīyate | evaṃ manyate-'asati prātipadikagrahaṇe napuṃsakavṛtteranapuṃsakavṛtteśca ya ekādeśaḥ sa napuṃsakavṛttigrahaṇena gṛhyate napuṃsaka iti syātprasaṅgaḥ | prātipadikagrahaṇe tu mukhyaprātipadikagrahaṇārthatvād atidiṣṭaprātipadikatvasya hrasvasyābhāvaḥ' iti | uttārthaṃ ca prātipadikagrahaṇam | iha vanāya, vanābhyām, vanārtham, vanebhya iti hrasvo na bhavati, bahiraṅgayordīrghatvayorasiddhatvāt | kāṇḍībhūtamityatra pūrvaṃ napuṃsakatve'pi cvyantadaśāyām avyayatvenāliṅgatvād hrasvābhāvaḥ ||
gostriyorupasarjanasya || 1.2.48 ||
strīti pratyayagrahaṇamiti | atra hetumāha-svaritatvāditi | 'svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityasya yatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatra tadadhikāro grāhya ityayamapyarthaḥ | iha ca strīgrahaṇaṃ svaryate, tena striyāmityadhikṛtya vihitānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati; nārthasya, nāpi svarūpasya | ktinnādīnāṃ tu hrasvabhāvitvābhāvādagrahaṇam | upasrjanagrahaṇaṃ tayorviśeṣaṇamiti | pratyekaṃ sambandhāttu dvivacanaṃ na bhavatītyāha-gorupasarjanasyetyādi | strīpratyayāntasyeti pāṭhaḥ | pāribhāṣikaṃ hyatropasarjanaṃ gṛhyate | na ca strīpratyayamātrasya pāribhāṣikopasarjanatvasambhavaḥ | tābhyāmiti | upasarjanena gośabdena strīpratyayāntena ca yadi tābhyāṃ tadantavidhirna vijñāyate, tadā upasarjanasya gośabdasya strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikasya hrasva ityarthaḥ syāt; tataśca gokulaṃ rājakumārīputra ityatrāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ | iha tu 'kumārīputraḥ' ityatra prātipadikatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ | upasarjanastrīpratyayāntāntasyeti pāṭhaḥ | upasarjanaṃ yat strīpratyayāntaṃ tadantasyetyarthaḥ | yadi tu laukikenopasarjanena strīpratyayamātraṃ viśeṣya paścāttena prātipadikasya tadantavidhirvijñāyate--upasarjanaṃ yaḥ strīpratyayastadantasya prātipadikasyeti, tato harītakyaḥ phalānītyatrāpi syāt; strīpratyayārthasya phalaṃ pratyupasarjanatvāttaddhitāntatvena prātipadikatvācca | ata evamevāśrayaṇīyam--strīpratyayāntaṃ yacchāstrīyamupasarjanaṃ tadantasya prātipadikasyeti | niṣkauśāmbiriti | kauśambītyekabibhaktītyupasarjanaṃ strīḥ tyayāntaṃ tadantaṃ samāsaprātipadikam | atheha kathaṃ hrasvatvam atirājakumāririti, yāvatā kumāraśabdān ṅībvihato na tu rājakumāraśabdāt ? satyam; anuparjane strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo nāsti | atha gośabdena strīpratyayāntena ca prātipadikasya tadantavidhau satyapi gokulaṃ rājakumārīputra ityatra kasmānna bhavati, yāvatā 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityatra 'svaṃ rūpam' ityanuvartate, tataśca yena tadantavidhiḥ tatsvarūpasyāpi grahaṇena bhāvyam ? evaṃ tarhi gośabdena prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt kevalasya na bhavati; anyathā gośabdasyaivopasarjanasya hrasvaṃ vidadhyād, 'yena vidhistadantasya' ityatra 'svaṃrupam' iti nivartyam | vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadike nāsti | rājakumārīputra ityatra tu parihāraḥ--śāstrīyamapyupasarjanaṃ sati sambhave'nvarthamevāpradhānamupasarjanamiti, pradhānaṃ cāpekṣyāpradhānaṃ bhavati | strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikatvaṃ samāsamantareṇānupapannam, samāsaścāvayavātmakaḥ; dvayaṃ cātra saṃnihitam-pradhānamapradhānamiti; tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ-yat strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadikaṃ tadantarbhūtamevāpekṣya strīpratyayāntasyāprādhānyamiti | iha tu tatrānantarbhūtaṃ putramapekṣyāprādhānyamiti na bhavati hrasvaḥ |
īyasa ityādi | īyasunnantādyaḥ strīpratyayo vihitastadantāntasyetyarthaḥ | bahuśreyasīti | 'praśasyasya śraḥ' ṅīp, bahvyaḥ śreyasyo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ, 'nadyṛtaśca' iti kap, 'īyasaśca' iti pratiṣedhaḥ, puṃsyapi sorhalṅyādilopaḥ | bahuvrīheriti kim ? atiśreyasiḥ ||
luktaddhitaluki || 1.2.49 ||
strīgrahaṇamanuvartate iti | na tu gograhaṇam, kutaḥ ? pratyayādarśanasya luksaṃjñāvidhānād gośabdasyāvyutpannatvād vyutpattipakṣe'pyasvaritatvāt | upasarjanasya ceti | 'anuvarttate' ityapekṣate | laukikaṃ cātropasarjanaṃ gṛhyate, na śāstrīyam | pūrveṇa hrasvatve prāpte iti kvacitpaṭhyate, tatra kvaciditi viśeṣaḥ | pūrvasūtreṇa hi śāstrīyamupasarjanaṃ gṛhītaṃ tasyāvakāśo yatra na taddhitalug‌niṣkauśāmbiriti; asyāvakāśo yatra śāstrīyamupasarjanam-āmalakamiti | taddhitalukca yathā--pañcendra iti, atra hi samāsārthe nānāvibhaktike pañcendrāṇītyekavibhaktikamiti astyupasarjanatvam; tatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayameva lug hrasvaṃ bādhata ityarthaḥ |
kecittvasmādeva granthāt pūrvasūtre'pi laukikasyoparjanasya grahaṇaṃ manyante, teṣāṃ harītakyaḥ phalāni iti lubviṣaye hrasvaprasaṅga ityuktam | syādevam--lupi yuktavaditi śabdārthayorapyatideśaḥ prakṛtyarthasya yalliṅgaṃ yaśca tadabhidhāyī pratyayaḥ tayordvayoratideśaḥ, tatraupadeśikasya hrasvatva ātideśikasya śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ? yadyevam, yuvatiriva puruṣaḥ 'lum munaṣye' yuvatiḥ, dvau tiśabdau śrūyeyātām; tasmāt 'lubyogāprakhyānāt' iti lupaḥ pratyākhyānena vātra parihāro vācyaḥ, śāstrīyaṃ vopasarjanaṃ grāhyam | granthasya ca vyākhyāta evārthaḥ |
abhāvarūpeṇa lukā paurvābharyāsambhavāllukīti satsaptamītyāha-luki satīti | pañcandra iti | 'taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ,'sāsya devatā' ityaṇaḥ 'dvigorluganapatye' iti luk, 'indravaruṇa' ityādinā vihitasya ṅīṣo'nena luk, sanniyogaviśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāva ityānuko nivṛttiḥ | pañcaśaṣkula iti | 'tena krītam' ityārhīyasya ṭhakaḥ 'adhyarddhapūrva' iti luk | āmalakamiti | 'nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' iti mayaṭaḥ 'phale luk' | badarīkuvalīśabdābhāyām 'anudāttādeśca' iti añ | śaṣkulyādayo gaurādiṅīṣantāḥ |
avantītyādi | avanti-kunti-śabdābhyāmapatye ' vṛddhetkosalājādāñ‍ñyaṅ' | kuroḥ 'kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ', striyāmavantīti luk, kuruśabdād 'ūṅutaḥ' ityuṅ | itarābhyām 'ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ | atrāpatyalakṣaṇā jātiḥ strīpratyayāntena prādhānyenābhidhīyate ||
id goṇyāḥ || 1.2.50 ||
pañcagoṇiriti | goṇiśabdaḥ parimāṇavacanaḥ, āvapanavacanaśca; tatrādyāt 'prāgvateṣṭhañ', dvitīyādārhīyaṣṭhak | tayoḥ pūrvalluk |
iditi yogāvibhāga iti | ihed‌grahaṇamanarthakam, goṇyā ityevāstu, hrasva ityeva, lukastu vacanāsāmarthyādananuvṛttiḥ ? tadetadid‌grahaṇameva liṅgaṃ yogavibhāgasya | yadi yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, sarvatretvaṃ prāpnoti, tatrāha-sa ceti | yadi sarvatra syād goṇīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu taddhitaluki lugapyuktaḥ, itvaṃ ceti, tayorvikalpaprasaṅge nityamitvameva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ goṇīgrahaṇaṃ syāt, tatkarthaṃ tato viśiṣṭaviṣayatvaṃ yogavibhāgasya ? ucyate; eka eva tāvadyogaḥ sūtrakāreṇa paṭhitaḥ, tatsāmarthyād vibhāgasaṃskāro'pyanuvarttate, avibhaktaśca yogo viśiṣṭaviṣayaḥ | id‌grahaṇasāmarthyātkriyamāṇo vibhāgo viśiṣṭaviṣaya eva kalpyate; ata evocyate--yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhariti | sa punarviśiṣṭo viṣayo vyākhyānādavaseyaḥ | taparakaraṇaṃ tatkālārtham--dīrghasya dīrgho mā bhūd | vacanaṃ tu lugghrasvabādhanārthaṃ syād | asati ca takāre, prāptapratiṣiddha īkāra evaṃ pratiprasūtaḥ syād, na tvapūrva ikāro vihitaḥ syād iti bhāvyamānatvameva na syāt ||
lupi yuktavadvyakticavane || 1.2.51 ||
abhidheyavalliṅgavacanayoḥ prāptayorayamārambhaḥ | abhāvarūpasya lupo liṅgasaṅkhyātideśāsambhavādāha--lupīti lupsaṃjñetyādi | kvacittu saptamyanto lupśabda upādīyate tatrāpi prakṛtyartha evābhidhātumiṣṭaḥ | saptamyupādānaṃ tu sūtre paṭhitatvād, yathā-matāviti matvartha ucyata iti | yuktavaditi niṣṭhāpratyenetyādi | atra hetumāha--sa hīti | yunakti sambadhnāti | yadyapi pratyayārtho'pi prakṛtyarthamātmanā yunakti, tathāpi na tasyeha grahaṇam; ānarthakyād, na hi tasyaiva liṅgasaṅkhye tasyaiva vidhātavye |
atha vetyādi | pūrvaṃ 'yujiryoge' ityasya ktavatvantasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāso darśataḥ, idānīṃ tu tasyaiva dhātoḥ ktāntasya vatinirdeśaḥ, asamāsaśceti pradaśyate | yuktaḥ prakṛtyartha iti | atra hetuḥ--pratyayārthena sambaddha iti | asminnapi pakṣe pūrvavadeva pratyayārthasyāgrahaṇam | saptamyarthe vatiriti | 'lupi' iti pratiyogini saptamī nirddeśāt saptamyarthe vartamānādivārthe vatirityarthaḥ | vyaktiśabda āvirbhāvādike'pyarthe vartate | vacanaśabdo'pi bhīmaseno bhīma itivad, ekavacanādiśabdānāṃ thaekadeśaprayogo'pi sambhāvyeta, tasya ca grahaṇe 'pañcālānāṃ nivāsaḥ' iti vākyāvasthāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīdarśanāttasyā evātideśaḥ syāt; kurupañcālā iti ca dvandve vākyā vasthāyāmatidiṣṭasya vacanasya luki samudāyād bahuvacanaṃ na syāt, tatastatsampratyayo mā bhūdityāha--vyaktivacane iti cetyādi | pūrvācāryanirdeśāśrayaṇe kāraṇamāha -tadīyamevetyādi | kuta ityata āha-tathā cetyādi | na hi svakṛtameva svayaṃ pratyācaṣṭa iti yuktam; 'viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvardhya svayaṃ chettumasāmpratam' iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ |
pañcālāḥ kṣatriyā iti | pañcālasyāpatyāni bahūni 'janapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādñ' 'te tadrājāḥ', 'tadrājasya bahuṣu' | teṣāṃ nivāso janapada iti | asya vakṣyamāṇena 'pañcālāḥ' ityanena sambandhaḥ | 'tasya nivāsa' ityaṇaḥ 'janapade lup' | kurava ityādi | 'kuravaḥ kṣatriyāḥ' ityādikaṃ tu pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam | kuruśabdādapatye 'kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' magadhādibhyaḥ 'dvayañmagadha' ityaṇ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat |
lupīti kimiti | taddhito'nuvṛttaḥ sāhacaryādarthamupasthāpayiṣyatīti praśnaḥ | luki mā bhūditi | anyathā 'taddhitaluki' ityanuvṛttestatraiva syāditi bhāvaḥ | lavaṇaḥ sūpa iti | 'saṃsṛṣṭelavaṇālluk' | vyaktivacane iti kimiti | yuktavaditi ktāntādvatirevāśrayiṣyate, ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśo vā kariṣyate iti manyate | śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhāva ityādi | arīhaṇādiṣu varāhādiṣu kumudādiṣu śirīṣaśabdasya pāṭhād vuñchaṇādisūtreṇa vañādayo'smādbhavanti, teṣāṃ ca viśeṣavihitatvāllukā na bhavitavyam, satyam; 'autsargiko'pi tata iṣyate' iti vakṣyati, tasya varaṇādidarśanāllup | asati vyaktivacanagrahaṇe śirīṣeṣu yadvanaspatitvaṃ tas.yāpi grāme'tideśaḥ syāt, tataśca ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti; ṇatvavidhau viphalī vanaspatiriti nāśrīyate viśeṣaḥ | ata eva vṛkṣavṛtterṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva | śirīṣavanamiti | nanu ca grāme'pi vartamāno guṇabhūtaṃ vanaspatitvamāheti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ, na cātra kiñcitpradhānāśrayaṃ kāryamasti yena guṇaḥ svakāryaṃ nārabheta | na ca vyaktivacanagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyam, asati hi tasminprakṛtyarthagatasya vyatirekasyāpyatideśāt ṣaṣṭhī prasajyeta; sati tu tasmin saṅkhyāmātrātideśe vyatirekasahitāyāḥ saṅkhyāyā anatideśād ? nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; evaṃ tarhi ṇatvavidhau pradhānavanaspatigrahaṇād atra tadabhāvaḥ |
harītakyaḥ phalānīti | harītakīśabdād gaurādiṅīṣantād 'anudāttādeśca' ityañaḥ 'harītakyādibhyaśśca' iti lup | atra vyaktireva yuktavadbhavati, vacanaṃ tvabhidheyavadeva | khalatikaṃ vanānīti | khalatikaśabdo varaṇādiḥ, samāse uttara padasya bahuvacanasya lupo niyamārthametad-lubarthasya bahutvātideśaḥ samāse yadi bhavati uttarapadasyaiveti, madhurāpañcālāḥ; iha na bhavati-pañcālamadhure iti, bahuvacanasyeti vacanād | dvitvātideśaḥ pūrvapadasyāpi bhavati-godau ca grāmaḥ madhurā ca godamadhurā iti ||

viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ ||1.2.52 ||
pūrvaṃ prakṛtyarthagatayorliṅgasaṅkhyayorlubarthe'tideśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tu lubante śabde iti tatra vartamānānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ siddha eva yuktavadbhāvaḥ | vacanaṃ tu jātipratiṣedhārtham | atha vyadhikaraṇānāṃ vidhyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati, brahmadattasya pañcālā iti ? 'tatpuruṣaḥ samāsanādhikaraṇaḥ' ityataḥ samānādhikaraṇānuvṛtteḥ | godāviti | godau hradau varaṇādiḥ, grāmajanapadaśabdau jātivācinau tābhyāṃ lubartho jātirūpeṇocyate | jātyarthasya cetyādi | jātirūpasya cārthasya, na jātivācinaḥ śabdasyetyarthaḥ | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha--teneti | dvāragrahaṇenaitaddarśayati --jātau prakrāntāyāṃ yadviśeṣaṇamupanipatitaṃ tajjātimeva sākṣādviśinaṣṭi, tad‌dvāreṇa tu lubartho viśiṣṭaḥ pratīyate; tatra viśeṣaṇaviṣeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacāra iti ramaṇīyādīnāṃ jātyupanipāte yuktavadbhāvo na bhavati; lubartho panipāte tu bhavati | yadyevam, nārtho'nena, lupo'nyatrāpyayaṃ prakāro dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā--badarī sūkṣmakaṇṭakā madhurāvṛkṣa iti, madhurādīnāṃ badaryupanipāte talliṅgasaṅkhyāyogaḥ, vṛkṣopanipāte vṛkṣaliṅgasaṅkhyogaḥ, vṛkṣasya ca niyataliṅgata ? evaṃ tarhi yattatratatrocyate--guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāṃ nāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavantīti, tadanena kriyate | viśeṣaṇānāṃ guṇavacanānāmityarthaḥ | yuktavadvyaktivacane | āśrayavalliṅgasaṃkhye ityarthaḥ | yadā tu jātiviśeṣaṇaṃ tadā neti | padasaṃskārapakṣe ca vācanikametat; pade hi padāntaranirapekṣe saṃskriyamāṇe liṅgasarvanāmanapuṃsakaṃ vastvantarānapekṣamekatvaṃ ca prāptamiti śuklaṃ paṭā iti prāpte bhāvino bahiraṅgasyāśrayasya liṅgasaṃkhye vidhīyete | vākyasaṃkāre tvayamanubāda eva; āśrayaviśeṣaniṣṭhatvena viśeṣaṇānāmapi talliṅgasaṃkhyayorasiddhatvāt |
manuṣyalupīti | munaṣyalakṣaṇe lubarthe viśeṣaṇānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ | lubantasya tu bhavatyeva-cañcābhirūpa iti, tṛṇapuruṣaścañcā tatsadṛśo manuṣyaścañcā 'saṃjñāyām' iti kan, 'lummanuṣye' iti lup | carmavikāraviśeṣo varghrikā ||
tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt || 1.2.53 ||
saṃjñāpramāṇatvāditi | pramāṇānām̐ hi pramāṇatvaṃ pratipādakatvaṃ svārthapratyāyanalakṣaṇam | etacca sarveṣāmeva śabdānāmasti, na saṃjñāśabdānāmeva | ucyate cedaṃ tatra viśeṣo vijñāyata ityāha--saṃjñāśabdā hītyādi | ye saṃjñāśabdāste nānāliṅgasaṃkhyā api svābhidheyagataliṅgasaṃkhyāpekṣayā bhinnaliṅgasaṃkhyā api pramāṇam, svārthasya pratipādakā ityarthaḥ | bhavatu saṃjñāśabdānāmevaṃvidhaṃ pramāṇatvam, kimāyātaṃ yaugikānāṃ pañcālādiśabdānāmitya āha-pañcālā varaṇā ityādi | tadanena pakṣadharmatvaṃ hetoruktam, pūrvaṃ tu dṛṣṭāntagato heturvyākhyātaḥ | dṛṣṭāntamāha--yatheti | yuktavadbhāvamārabhamāṇo'pi nātra kañcidyatnaṃ karoti, tadavaśyamayaṃ śabdasvabhāva evāśrayaṇīyaḥ | kaściddhi śabdaḥ svabhāvāt samudāyasaṃkhyāmabhidhatte, kaścidavayavasaṃkhyām, yathā-vanaṃ vṛkṣā iti | evaṃ liṅge'pi draṣṭavyam ||
lubyogāprakhyānāt || 1.2.54 ||
kiṃ kāraṇamiti | 'nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti prathamā dvitīyā vā | tathā ca yogāprakhyānādityuttaropapattiḥ | yogaḥ-janapadādeḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ, tasyāprakhyānādanupalabdherityarthaḥ | tadāha--na hīti | etadeva vivṛṇoti-naitaditi, saṃjñā etā iti | yadyapi saṃjñāśabdā api paṅkajādayo'pekṣitapravṛttinimittāḥ santi, tathāpīha prakaraṇādanepekṣitapravṛttinimittā apīti boddhavyam | ata evāha-tasmādatretyādi | nanu yogāprakhyāne'pi taddhita utpadyate, tadyathā--'kambalācca saṃjñāyām' kambalyamūrṇāpalaśatamiti, satyam; yatra rūpe viśeṣo'sti | nanu ca saṃjñāpramāṇatvāditi pañcālādiśabdānāmayaugikatvamupapāditamityarthāllubapi pratyākhyāt eva, kimanena kriyate ? ucyate; saṃjñāpramāṇatvādityanena dṛṣṭāntagato hetuḥ śabdenoktaḥ tasyaiva tvarthātpañcālādigatatvena pratīyamānasyāsiddhimāśaṅkaya yogāprakhyānāditi yaugikatvāmapākurvan hetumeva samarthayate ||
yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve darśanaṃ syāt || 1.2.55 ||
pañcālādaya ityādi | pūrvayogasyāpratibhāsa uktaḥ, yastu tamapajānīte taṃ pratyanenāniṣṭamāpadyata iti darśayati-yogapramāṇe hīti | 'hi' śabdo hetvarthe prayuñjānaḥ sūtre 'ca' śabdo hetau prayukta iti darśayati | etadeva vyācaṣṭe-yadīti, adarśanamayogaḥ casyāditi | darśanaṃ jñānaṃ tacca prayogasyoccāraṇasya phalam, ataḥ phalābhāvena hetvabhāvo vivakṣita ityācaṣṭe | yoganimittako hi yogābhāvena pradarśanaṃ yujyate, yathā-daṇḍīśabda iti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhūtapūrvamapi nimittaṃ bhavati, tataśca samprati varaṇādiyogābhāve'pi bhūtapūrvaḥ sa eva nimittaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitadevam; bhūtapūrvanimitto hi vyapadeśo gauṇaḥ syād, na cāyaṃ gauṇaḥ; padāntarasya prayogamantareṇā'pi pratīyamānatvāt | kiñca yaugikatve puruṣāntarasaṃbaṃdhanibaṃdhano'pi vyapadeśaḥ kasmānna pravartate ? viparyayo vā kasmānna bhavati ? deśasambandhādrājasu pañcālaśabda ityato'kṣādiśabdavadanekārtha evāyaṃ pañcālādiśabdaḥ ||
pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt || 1.2.56 ||
arthavacanamiti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | nanu ca pradhānapratyayayoḥ kartrornirdeśādubhayaprāptāvityanenātra ṣaṣṭhī, tataśca 'karmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; pradhānapratyayoratra karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kastarhi kartā, puruṣaḥ, samudāyo vā pradhānopasarjanayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayośca ? etaduktaṃ bhavati-pradhānapratyayābhyāṃ karaṇābhyāṃ puruṣeṇa samudāyena vā yadarthasya vacanaśabdena saha 'kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam', 'kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' itica samāsaḥ | nanu ca pratyayo'pi prakṛtyapekṣayā pradhānam, kasmādbhedenopādīyate ? ucyate; yadā 'prakṛtiḥ pratyayārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayā svārthamabhidhatte' iti siddhaṃ bhavati, tadā pratyayasya prādhānyam, tadevedānīṃ paribhāṣyata iti pūrvācāryaistāvatpratyayo bhedena nirdiṣṭaḥ-pradhānopasarjane, prakṛtipratyayāviti, tataśca tallakṣaṇanirākaraṇe pratyayo'pi bhedenopādeyaḥ | aśkyatvāditi | aśakyatvamanantaprakāratvāt | bahuvrīhāvanyapadārtha ucyate; plakṣanyagrodhamiti samāhāraḥ; kvacitpradhānayoreva sahābhidhānam-plakṣanyagrodhāviti | svārthikeṣu ca paprakṛtipratyayau prakṛtyarthaṃ saha brūtaḥ-śuklatara iti; tathā ākhyāteṣu kriyāpradhānamākhyātamiti; tathā 'karttari kṛt' 'kartari tṛtīyā', tatra 'kṛtsu śaktimad dravyaṃ pradhānamucyate' iti kriyābhede śaktyantarāvirbhāvaḥ; pācakaṃ paśyeti vibhaktiṣu śaktiprādhānyam-ityādyanantaprakāramarthābhidhānamaśakyaṃ paribhāṣitumiti lokata evārthāvagateḥ kathametadityāha-yairapītyādi ||
kālopasajane ca tulyam || 1.2.57 ||
arthasyānyapramāṇatvāditi | kathaṃ punarayamatra heturlabhyata ityāha-tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtha iti kathametadityāha --aśiṣyaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi | caśabdo hetau | ānyāyyāditi | rātreścaturddhā vibhaktāyāḥ paścime yāme nyāyyaṃ svāpādutthānam; śāstrīyatvāt | prathame gate ca saṃveśanaṃ śayanam | atra lakṣaṇe rātrermadhyayāmadvayaṃ nādyatanam, dvitīye tu tadapi | ubhayato'rddharātramiti | bahuvrīhiḥ kṛtsno divasa āgāminyā rātreḥ pūrvārdhenātītāyāḥ paścimārghena ca yukta ityarthaḥ | yadyevamiti | yadyarthasyānyapramāṇatvādityayamevātrāpi heturityarthaḥ | pūrvasūtra eveti | evaṃ hi tulyamiti na vaktavyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
jātyākhyāyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām || 1.2.58 ||
jātyākhyāyāmiti viṣayasaptamī | evamekasminnityapi vyadhikaraṇe caite saptamyau | jātirnāmetyādinā sūtrārambhasya kāraṇamāha-eko'rtha iti | yadyapi vaiśeṣikaparibhāṣitā saṃkhyā jāterna vidyate, tasyā dravyadharmatvāt; tathāpi bhedagaṇanarūpā saṃkhyā vidyata eva | yathoktam --
diṣṭiprasthasuvarṇādi mūrttabhedāya kalpate |
kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā || iti |
baiśeṣikāśca vyāvaharanti --pañca karmāṇi, catuviṃśatirguṇā iti | jāterākhyeti | ākhyānamākhyā- pratyayanam | ekasminnartha iti | jātyākhye bahuvacanaśabdo'yamanvartho na pāribhāṣikaḥ, uktirvacanam, bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacanam | tataścāyamarthaḥ -ekasminnarthe bahūnāmuktirbhavatīti sāmarthyādvatyartho gamyate-bahūnāmivoktiḥ | yadi ca jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti bahūnāmivoktirbhavatīti sāmarthyāt sa evārthaḥ saṃpadyata ityāha-jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha -teneti | yadi tu jātiśabdādvahuvacanaṃ jātyādi vidhīyeta, tato viśeṣaṇebhyaḥ saṃpannādibhyo na syāt, teṣāmajātiśabdātvāditi bhāvaḥ |
devadatta iti | yadyapi jātipadārthavādipakṣe hyatrāpyavasthābhedānugatā jātiḥ śabdavācyā, tathāpīha sāmarthyādabhinnapiṇḍasamavetā jātirāśrīyata ityanatideśaḥ | kāśyapa iti | kaśyapaśabdādvidādyañ, tata ivārthe saṃjñāyāṃ kan 'lummanuṣye' | bhavatyayaṃ jātiśabda iti | guṇabhūtāyā gotrajāterabhidhānāt | na tvanena jātirākhyāyata iti | pradhānyeneti bhāvaḥ | asatyākhyāgrahaṇe jātau varttamānādityarthaḥ syāt, tatra yathā vyaktiparyantābhidhāne gavādibhyo'pi bhavati, evamatrāpi syāt | sati tu tasmim̐statsāmarthyājjātiprādhānye bhavati | vrīhiyavāviti | nanu ca yathā kāśikosalīyā iti janapadalakṣaṇo vuñ vidhīyate, na ca janapadarūpaḥ samudāyo'vayavābhyāmārabhyate; ato yatsvatantraṃ prātipadikaṃ na tajjanapadavāci, yajjanavadavāci na tatsvatantraṃ prātipadikamiti kuto vuñaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ! ayaṃ tu jātipratyāyane vidhirna jātiśabdāditi syādeva prasaṅgaḥ |
saṃkhyāprayoge iti | ekasyaiva bahutvātideśe kriyamāṇa ekaśabdaprayoge'pi syāditi bhāvaḥ | ārabhyamāṇe'pyetasmin gotvaṃ vrīhitvamityādi niṣkṛṣya jātyabhidhānenaivāyaṃ vidhiriṣyate | vyaktiparyante tvabhidhāne jātivyaktyostādātmyaṃ sambandha iti jātirūpeṇa vyaktīnāmabhidhāne ekavacanaṃ siddham | vyaktyātmanā tu jāterabhidhāne bahuvacanamiti nārtho'nena ||
asmado dvayośca || 1.2.59 ||
'asmadaḥ' ityabhidheyasambandhena ṣaṣṭhītyāha--asmado yo'rtha iti | pañcamyāṃ tu tatra varttamānasya tiṅantasya na syāditi bhāvaḥ | ekatve dvitve ceti | nanu cāsmatacchabdaḥ pratyagātmani varttate, sa caikastasya kathaṃ dvitvayogaḥ, ekatvamapi tasyāyuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam, avyabhicārāt ? ucyate; yadā'nyatrātmatvamadhyāropyate-ayaṃ me dvitīya ātmeti, yadā vā 'tyadādīni sarvairnityam' iti ekaśeṣaḥ kriyate, tadā sambhavatyanekārthatvam | atha yatraivāsmacchabdo bahuvacanāntaḥ prayujyate, tatra kathaṃ dvitvaikatvaviśeṣāvasāyaḥ, prakaraṇādārācchabdasyeva dūrāntikayoḥ | ahamiti | 'ṅeprathamayoram', 'tvāhau sau' | vayamiti | 'maparyantasya','yūyavayau jasi', śeṣe lopaḥ' | āvāmiti | 'yuvāvau dvivacane', 'prathamāyāśca dvivacane' ityātvam |
saviśeṣaṇasyeti | 'tvaṃ rājā vayamapyupāsitaguruprajñābhimānonnatāḥ' ityatronnatatvameva vidhīyate | na ca vidheyo'rtho viśeṣaṇamiti atideśo bhavatyeva |
yuṣmadīti | bhāṣyavārttikayorapaṭhitamapi śiṣṭaprayogadarśanātpaṭhitam ||
phalgunīproṣṭhadānāṃ ca nakṣatre || 1.2.60 ||
cakāra ityādi | kecidāhuḥ--jyotiṣāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candrayoge sati bhavati, anyadā tu jyotiṣṭvameva | candrayogaśca dvayoḥ samuditayoriti dvayoreva bahuvacane siddhe cakāreṇa dvayorityanukarṣannācāryo jñāpayati--nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇamiti | upalakṣitajyotiṣṭvamekaikasyāpyastīti ekanivṛttyarthaṃ dvayorityanukarṣaṇīyamiti |
tatrocyate--satyapyekaikasya jyotiṣṭve na tatra phalgunīśabdo varttate, evaṃ proṣṭhapadādiśabda ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāya eva tābhyāmucyate | ata eva 'chandasi punarvasvorekavacanam' 'viśākhayośca' iti sūtrārambhaḥ | nakṣatraśabdaśca nighaṇṭuṣu tārakāparyāya eva paṭhitaḥ | vede'pi 'nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapaṃśan' 'tvaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ medhyasi citram' 'nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' ityatra vṛttikāro vakṣyati-'kathaṃ punarnakṣatreṇa puṣyādinā kālo yujyate' iti, tadapyanupapannam; āvasthike nakṣatrarūpe puṣyādibhiryosya kādācitkatvāt | 'tiṣyapunarvasvoḥ' ityatra ca uditau tiṣyādibhiryogasya kādācitkatvāt | 'tiṣyapurvasvoḥ' ityatra ca uditau tiṣyapunarvasū dṛśyete | itthaṃ candrayoge'pyudāhariṣyate | pratyudāharaṇe ca jyotiḥsvabhāvamevārthaṃ darśayati-tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakā iti, tasmānnāyaṃ vṛttikārasya pakṣaḥ--āvasthikī nakṣatrateti | jyotirmātravacana evāyam | cakāreṇa dvayorityasyānukarṣaṇamapi--ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyo'bhidhīyate, na tvekaikaṃ jyotiriti pradarśanārtham | proṣṭapadānāmiti saptamyarthe ṣa,ṭhī, nakṣatre iti vā ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamītyāha-phalgunyordvayorityādi | nakṣatrayoriti pratyekamabhisambaddhyate | sūtre tu vyatyayenaikavacanam | atrāpyarthasya bahutvātideśa iti viśeṣaṇasyāpi bhavati | pūrve phalgunyāviti | phalgunībhyāṃ phalgunībhirvā yuktaḥ kāla iti aṇ, 'lubaviśeṣe','lupi yuktavadvyaktivacane' |
phalgunyau māṇavike iti | phalgunyorjāte 'phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau vaktavyau' iti ṭapratyayaḥ, 'ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp ||
chandasi punarvasvorekavacanam || 1.2.61 ||
dvayordvivacane prāpta iti | pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭasya dvayorityasyehānanuvṛttāvapi punarvasuśabdenod‌bhūtāvayavabhedasya jyotirdvayasya samudāyasyābhidhānād dvayorevāyaṃ vidhiriti darśayati ||
viśākhayośca || 1.2.62 ||
kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ ? iha cakāreṇa chandasautyanuvartayiṣyāmīti tenottaratra 'chandasi' iti nānuvarttate |
tiṣyapunarvasvaurnakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam || 1.2.63 ||
tiṣyapunarvasvauḥ ityanenaiva sūtreṇa dvicanāpekṣayā saptamīdvivacanam | nakṣatradvandve iti satsaptamīḥ; nakṣatradvandve sati tiṣyapunarvasvorarthayordvayorivoktirbhavatīti dvandvāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanaṃ vā | teṣāṃ dvandva iti | atra tacchabdād dvivacanaṃ na bhavati, vākyasya prastutatvādadvandvārthavṛttitvād | atra pāribhāṣikayordvivacanabahuvacanayorgrahaṇe bahuvacanasya dvivacanamādeśaḥ syāt | tatra jasādeśe prathamādvivacane 'jasi ca' iti guṇaḥ syāt, viśeṣaṇānāṃ ca na syāditi matvāha-bahuvacanasya prasaṅga iti | bahūnāmarthānāmuktiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | dvivacanaṃ bhavati | dvayorivoktirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakā iti | tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ nakṣatraṇo lupi jātārthe sandhivelādisūtreṇaāṇ, tasya 'śraviṣṭāphalgunyanurādhā' ityādinā luk | nātra dvandvo nakṣatre varttate, kiṃ tarhi ? māṇavakeṣu | tatrāpi na gauṇaḥ; yogaparamparayā vṛtteḥ | paryāyāṇāmapīti | punarnakṣatragrahaṇasāmarthyādarthasyaivāyamanapekṣitopāttaśabdāsyātideśo bhavati, tena paryāyāṇāmapi grahaṇaṃ siddhyati |
