dvandva iti kimiti | tiṣyaśca punarvasūceti vākye samāse'pyuttarapadārthapradhāne bahutvaṃ na sambhavati, tādṛśaḥ samāsaśca na sulabhaḥ, bahuvrīhiśca na sambhavati vyadhikaraṇatvāt, 'saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' apyapūrvo'vyayapūrvaḥ, avyayībhāvaścāsambhāvya eveti dvandva eva bhaviṣyatīti manyate | yastiṣya ityādi | avayavena vigrahe ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyajha samāsārthaḥ | unmugdhāḥ puruṣāstadāha-tiṣyādaya eveti | kvicittu ime tiṣyapunavasavo magadhā iti paṭhyate, tatrāpi vaikṛtyavacanāmuheḥ karttari ktaḥ, aviviktā ityarthaḥ | ṛtavo muhyantīti yathā | nakṣatrasamāsa evāyamiti | samudāyasamudāyinorabhedāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvo dvandva iti | nanu ca ekavadbhāvaprakaraṇe prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva dvandvaḥ, dadhi-payaādaunāmitaretarayoga eveti niyama āśritaḥ; tataśca tasmin prakaraṇe'nupāttānām 'cāthedvandvaḥ' ityeva samāhāretaretarayogayordvandvasiddhaḥ, kiṃ jñāpakopanyāsena ? satyam; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sūtre sambhāvyeta--prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeva samāhāra iti | tasmādvahuvacanagrahaṇena prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ niyamyatvaṃ jñāpyate | vṛkṣādivibhāṣāprayojanaṃ tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ ||
sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau || 1.2.64 ||
samānaṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāmiti sarūpā iti | 'jyotirjanapada' ityādinā samānasya sabhāvaḥ | 'saha rūpeṇa vartanta iti sarūpāḥ' iti tu na bhavati; vyabhicārābhāvāt | rūpaśabdaścaiha śrotragrāhye śabdasambandhini svarūpe varttate, na cakṣurgrāhye śuklādau; śabdānuśāsanaprastāvāttadāha--sarupāṇāṃ śabdānāmiti | nirdhāraṇe caiṣā ṣaṣṭhī, samudāyāpekṣayā vā |
atra pañca pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | samānaparyāya ekaśabdaḥ 'tenaikadik' itivat | samiāntvaṃ ca bhedādhiṣṭhānamiti pṛthak sarvebhyaḥ samānāyāṃ vibhaktau parata ekaḥ śiṣyata iti prathamaḥ | 'dvandve' iti vartate, tatra virūpeṣu sāvakāśamapi dvandvamekaśeṣo na bādhte,nimittatvāt; sarūpāṇāṃ dvandve kṛte samāsādekasyāṃ vibhaktau parata iti dvitīyaḥ | atra pakṣe saḍkhyāvācyekaśabdaḥ | 'hrasvo napuṃsake' ityataḥ 'prātipadikasya' iti varttate, ekavibhaktāviti sārūpyopalakṣaṇam | ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇi dṛṣṭāni teṣāṃ prātipadikānāmevānaimittika ekaśeṣa iti tṛtīyaḥ | vibhaktiśabdaḥ kārakaśaktivacanaḥ, vibhajyate'nayā prātipadikārtha iti kṛtvā; ekasminkārake vivakṣiktiṃ prasūta iti ; pṛthag vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣa iti caturthaḥ | sarūpasamudāyādekasyāṃ vibhaktau parata iti pañcamaḥ |
tatrādye pakṣe-vṛkṣas vṛkṣas vṛkṣas iti sthite pūrvayornivṛttau s s vṛkṣas iti sthine madhyasambandhinaḥ sorhalṅyādilope taditarayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | evamādyantayorapi nivṛttau draṣṭavyam | parayordvayornivṛttāvapi śiṣyamāṇasambandhino lopapāsiddhireva | godau varaṇā ityādau ca pṛthag dvivacanayoḥ parata ekaśeṣe tayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | yatra hi pratyayanimittā prakṛtinivṛttistatra kevalasyāpi pratyasya prayogo bhavatyeva, yathā--iyāniti |
dvitīye tu--aśva aśva au iti sthite vibhaktyapekṣāccheṣātpūrvamantaraṅgatvātsamāsāntodāttatve kṛte yadi pūrvaśeṣaḥ sarvānudāttaṃ padaṃ syād paraśeṣe tu aśvaśabdāntodāttaḥ syāt, iha ca ṛkca ṛkca ṛcau antaraṅgatvāt 'ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' iti samāsānte kṛte vibhakterakāreṇa vyavadhānānnaikaśeṣaḥ syāt | samāsānto hi samāsagrahaṇena gṛhyamāṇastameva na vyavadadhyāt, sarūpaṃ tu vyavadadhāt‌yeva | ekagrahaṇaṃ vānarthakam, na hi dvandvādyugapadanekā vibhaktiḥ sambhavati | yadi punarekavibhaktāvityetadakṛtvā dvandvakriyānantaramevaikaśaṣa ityucyeta, evamapi pādau pādā ityādau dvivacanabahuvacane na syātām ; prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra iva dvandva iti niyamād |
tṛtīye tu pakṣe jananīvacano yo mātṛśabdaḥ, yaśca 'māṅ māne' ityasmāttṛci dhānyamātṛvacanaḥ, tayorapi mātā mātṛbhyām iti kvacidvibhaktau sarūpatvātsarvatraikaśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā haritaśabdādvarṇādanudāttāditi ṅībnakārayoryo harīṇīśabdaḥ sampadyate, yaśca hariṇaśabdājjātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi, tayorna syāt; ṅyantayoḥ sārūpye'pi prātipadikāvasthāyāmasārūpyāt |
caturthe tu nivarttamānaḥ śabdo yadyapi saha vibhaktyā nivarttate, śiṣyamāṇasya tvekavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
ataḥ pañcamaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--sarūpāṇāṃ śabdānāmekavibhaktau parata iti | sarūpasamūdāyādekasyāṃ vibhaktau parata ityarthaḥ | nanu 'ṅyāpprātipadikāt' ityekavacanāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ, tatra caikatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tatkathaṃ prātipadikasamudāyādvibhaktiḥ ? astu pratyekaṃ prātipadikatvam, samudāyo'pi tvarthavattvātprātipadikam, kaḥ punaḥ samudāyasyārthaḥ ? parasparasambandhaḥ, ekaikena viśakalito'rtha ucyate | samudāyena tu sambandhaḥ tulyajātīyasya cārthavatsamudāyasya samāsagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ | kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ ? yatra pūrvo bhāgaḥ padam | na cātraivamiti samudāyādvibhaktiraviruddhā | sā tvanud‌bhūtāvayavabhedatvād dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā, na tvekavacanam | nāvau janāvau kartārāvityādāvacparatvādāvādiṣvapi kṛteṣu virūpāṇāmapi samānārthatvādekaśeṣaḥ | śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nāgarāje anante apradhāne taupayuktādanyatra ca na varttate, kiṃ tarhi ? nivṛttimadavasthāna ityāha-ekaḥ śiṣyate itare nivarttante iti | nanvasmin pakṣe ekagrahaṇamanarthakam, na hi samudāyadyugapadenekā vibhaktiḥ sambhavati ? ucyate, asatyekagrahaṇae pṛthak sarvebhyo vibhaktau parata iti prathamo'pi pakṣaḥ sambhāvyeta | ato yatra pakṣa ekaiva vibhaktiḥ sarūpāṇāṃ sambhavati sa evaikagrahaṇādā śrīyate | atha vā caturthe pakṣe granthaḥ-kathaṃ tarhi vibhaktau parata iti, na hi kārakaśaktyā śabdānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ bhavati, ucyate; iṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ ekasyāṃ vibhaktāviṣyāyāṃ ekasminkārake vivakṣita iti yāvat | nanu coktam-śiṣyamāṇasyaikavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅga iti, na vedānīṃ nivarttamānasaṅkhyāveśādupajāyamāne dvitvabahutve dvivacanabahuvacane upajanayitumutsahete, pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ | kā punaḥ sahavivakṣā ? uktamatra-
anud‌bhūteva bhedānāmekā prakhyopajāyate |
yadā sahavivakṣāṃ tāmāhurdvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ || iti |
ayamarthaḥ--yadā bahavo'rthā ekasyāṃ buddhau upārūḍhāḥ, yathā--puro'vasthitasya hastasya pañcāṅ‌gulayaḥ, te caikasminguṇe kriyāyāṃ vā tathaiva viniyujyante-śobhanā iti vā, dṛśyanta iti vā, tadā sahavivakṣā | tathā hi-ātmano yā buddhistāṃ paratra saṃkramayituṃ prayoktrā śabdaḥ prayujyata iti | yadi cāvayavāḥ pṛthak pṛthagavadhāritāḥ syuḥ, yathā vātāyanagatena krameṇa gacchantaḥ tato bhinnaireva śabdaiḥ pratyakaṃ paryavasāyibhirekavacanāntairabhidhīyateran | samudāyākārā tvanusyūtāvayavabhaidaikā buddhiḥ tāṃ paratra saṅ‌kramayitumiticchatā tadanurūpaṃ śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ | na ca tādṛśasya samudāyasyāsādhāraṇaḥ kaścicchabdo'sstītyavayavaśabdairevāsau pratipādyaḥ | upapadāyte cāvayavaśabdairevābhidhānām; samudāyasamudāyinorabhedāt | sa caikaika evāvayavaśabda ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedasamudāyapratipādānād dvivacanānto bahuvacanānataśca pravartata iti naikavacanaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyevam, ekenaivāvayavaśabdena tādṛśasya samudāyasyābhidhātuṃ śakyātvānna yāvadavayavaśabdaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha matam-anyo'nyasannidhāveva samudāyarūpārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ prādurbhavati, kathaṃ tarhi ekaṣeṣārambhe ekasya sā bhavati, na hi sato'satī śaktirekaśeṣavacanena kartuṃ śakyate ? ucyate; virūpeṣvanyo'nyasannidhāne samudāyārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ prādurbhavati | paṭuguptāvityatrāpi hyud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaṃ samudāyaṃ pratipādayitumavayavaśabda eva pratyekaṃ dvivacanāntaḥ pravarttate, anyathā dvivacanabahuvacanāyogātsvārthamātraparyavasāyibhiravayavaśabdaiḥ krameṇaivoccaraṇādartho'pi pratīyate | krameṇa cānekārthapratītau dvivacanabahuvacane na bhavataḥ | samuccayaśca bhavati, tadyathā vākya- - paṭuśca guptaśceti | ato virūpeṣvevaṃ darśanātsarūpeṣvapi dvandvāśaṅkāyāṃ sarūpeṣvekasyaivānekārthapratipādanaśaktirastīti vacanena vyutpādyate |
anye tu tṛtīyamapi pakṣaṃ granthārūḍhaṃ varṇayanti | sarūpāṇāṃ śabdānāmekavibhaktau parata ekaśeṣo bhavati; ekavibhaktau parataḥ sarūpāṇāmityanvaḥ, na tvekaśeṣa iti | ekasminkārake vivakṣite, ekavibhaktau vā parato ye sarūpā dṛṣṭāḥ śabdāsteṣāmityarthaḥ | tatra ca śiṣyamāṇa eva nivarttamānasyāpyarthamācaṣṭe | agniciditi pratyayanivṛttau prakṛtivaditi dvivacanabahuvacane yathāyogaṃ bhavataḥ | tatra yaduktam-haritahariṇayarṅyantayorna syāditi, tanna; prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ nānuvarttate, tena ṅyantayoheva sārūpyād bhaviṣyati | yadapyuktam-mātṛśabdayoḥ prasaṅga iti, arthavipratiṣedhānna bhaviṣyati | kṛte hyekaśeṣe tābhirityanuprayoge punartho na gamyate, tairityukte stryarthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇasya vā evakārasyehānukarṣaṇādekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyevetyāśrayaṇātparicchetṛvācinaśca 'aptṛntṛc' iti sarvanāmasthāne dīrghavidhānādasārūpyādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | atra pakṣe ekagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | tadevaṃ pañcasu pakṣeṣu trayaḥ svīkṛtāḥ |
vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśceti | 'anaimittika ekaśeṣaḥ ' iti pakṣe vibhaktau sārūpyaṃ darśayituṃ vibhaktyantena vigrahaḥ | kathaṃ punarvigrahaḥ, yāvatā ekaśeṣavṛttirnityā ? naitadvṛttyā samānārthavākyam, pratyekamatra vivakṣā | ātaśca pratyekam; yato'tra bhedanibandhena samuccayaścaśabdena dyotyate, bhinnārthamapi kiñcinmātrāsādharmyādvākyaṃ bhavatyeva | samānārthantu bādhyata eva, yathā-vṛkṣau ca vṛkṣau vṛkṣāśca vṛkṣāśca vṛkṣā iti | nanu yadyetāvadekārthābhiniveśinaḥ śabdāḥ--ākāśadravyatvagotvādayaḥ, na teṣu dvivacanabahuvacanenāpyekaśeṣaḥ; ye tvanekārthābhiniveśinaḥ--gauḥ śuklaḥ, pācaka ityādayaḥ, teṣvanusyūtaṃ kiñcidarthagatamekaṃ gotvādinimittaṃ vaktavyam; anyathā sambandhagrahaṇāsambhavādatra gavādiṣu tad‌guṇatā jātirnimittaṃ na, yathā śuklādiṣvapi guṇamātraniṣṭhaṣu | guṇaniṣṭheṣu tu svagatayā jātyā ekībhūto guṇaḥ | evaṃ pācakādiṣvapi gotvāśvatve sāmānye, niḥ sāmyāni sāmānyānītyatra bhinneṣvabhinnapratyayahetutvaṃ tāvetāvityādau parokṣatvapratyakṣatvādikam |
abhāvāścatvāra ityatra nirūpākhyatvamityādi sarvatra draṣṭavyam | nimittatadvatośca tādātmyam, sarvaṃ hi vastu ekaṃ nānā ca gavādirūpeṇaikaṃ khaṇḍādi prātipadikarūpeṇa nānā | evaṃ sthite yadi tāvajjātireva śabdārthastadā tasyā ekatvānnānekaśabdaprasaṅgaḥ | athāpyubhayam, evamapi jātirūpeṇaiva śabdo dravyamabhidhatte na prātisvikenākāreṇeti nāstyanekaśabdaprasaṅgaḥ | kevaladravyapadārthapakṣe'pi asminviṣaye'nekārthābhidhānasāmarthyaṃ śabdasya dvyādipadavadabhyupagantavyam, anyathā satyapyekaśeṣe tanna syāditi siddhamekaśabdatvam | dravyagatasaṅ‌khyāpratipādanāya dvivacanabahuvacane bhaviṣyata; nārtha etenetyāśaṅkyāha -- pratyarthamityādi | ekaikasminnarthe yasmācchabdānāṃ niveśastato'nekena śabdenānekasyābhidhānaṃ siddhyati | tatraivaṃ sthite'nekārthābhidhāne karttavye yāvantaste'rthāstāvatāṃ śabdānāṃ prayogaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate caikaśabdatvam, tasmādekaśeṣa ārabhyate |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ--kevalaṃ jātipakṣe akṣāḥ pādāḥ māṣā ityādau anekaśabdatvaṃ syād, na hi bibhītakadevanaśakaṭākṣeṣvanusyūtaṃ kiñcitsāmānyamasti | ata eva tatra vyutpattirbhedenāpekṣyate, evamubhayapakṣe'pi | kevaladravyapakṣe'pi vṛkṣaśceti vākye'nekaśabdadarśanādvirūpeṣu dvandvadarśanāccārambhaṇīyametaditi |
rūpagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | antaraṅgatvādaheyatvādupadeśānapekṣatvācca rūpakṛtameva samānatvaṃ grahīṣyate iti praśnaḥ | pratipatilāghavaṃ ca samānānāmityucyamāne bhavati rūḍhiśabdatvena rūḍhiriti tulyārthāvagamāt | rūpagrahaṇe tu vartipadārthamavagamyānyapadārtho'vagantavya iti gauravaṃ bhavati | bhinne'pyarthe iti | 'svaṃ rūpam' ityatra rūpagrahaṇena jñāpitaṃ śāstre rūpavadartho'pi tantramiti | tataścārtharūpābhyāṃ samānatvaṃ gṛhyeteti bhāvaḥ |
ekagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | śeṣa ityekatvaṃ vivakṣyata iti praśnaḥ | dvibahvoriti |dvitvabahutvaviṣayasyānekasya śabdasyetyarthaḥ | nanu dvayorbahūnāṃ ceti bahuvacanaprasaṅgād iha śeṣavidhānadvāreṇa saṃskriyamāṇatvācchiṣyamāṇaṃ pradhānam, pradhāne ca saṅkhyā na vivakṣyate, yathā-grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭīti, viṣama upanyāsaḥ; saṃmārge vidhau dvitīyānirdeśāt grahāḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ, saṃmārgastu teṣāṃ saṃskāraḥ | saṃskāro nāma tasya bhavati yacchāstrāntare prayojanavatyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sādhanatvena viniyuktam, saṃskṛtasya vā yasya viniyogaḥ, dravyamātrasya rūpasaṃskāro'narthakaḥ syāt | yadiha saṃmārgasaṃkāro vidhīyamānaḥ śāstrāntare viniyuktaṃ grahamapekṣate tatar navasaṅkyā grahā śrutā iti tadapekṣaḥ saṃmārgavidhirnavānāmapi bhavitumarhati | grahamityekavacanaṃ tu karmatvamātramabhidhāyakatārthaṃ bhaviṣyati | iha tu śeṣasya vākyāntare'navadhāraṇādidamevotpattivākyāmiti vivakṣaṇīyā saṅ‌khyā, paśumālabhetetivat, satyam; idamevaikagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-śāstrāntarānavagate'pi pradhāne saṅkhyā na vivakṣyata iti, tena karturīpsitatamamityatra īpsitatamasya saṅkhyāyā avivakṣā siddhā bhavati |
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | sādhvanuśāsanaprakramātsarūpāṇāmekaḥ sādhurbhavatīti vijñāsyata iti bhāvaḥ | ādeśo mā bhūditi | asati hi śeṣagrahaṇe 'ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā' iti vacanāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt, tataścādeśaḥ syād, astu; śabdato'rthataścāntaratamo bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam, svare hi doṣaḥ syād dvayoraśvaśabdayoḥ samudāyaḥ sthānī, tatra ca dvāvudāttāviti dvyudātta ādeśaḥ syādetena dvyanudāttattvaṃ vyākhyātam |
ekavibhaktāviti kimiti | nānāvibhaktau vairūpyamavaśyaṃbhāvīti bhāvaḥ | payaḥ paya iti | ekavibhaktāvityasminnasati sarūpāṇāṃ sarvatra saha prayogo na syād | atha kriyamāṇe'pyasminnanaimittikapakṣe kasmādevātra na bhavati, etadapi hyekasyāṃ vibhaktau parataḥ sarūpaṃ dṛṣṭameva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekagrahaṇamasminpakṣe atiricyata ityuktam, tatsāmarthādekasyāmeva vibhaktau viṣayabhūtāyāṃ bhaviṣyati | atra tu satyekaśeṣe paryāyeṇa vibhaktiḥ syāt |
atha vā-kiṃ na etena pakṣeṇa kleśato vyākhyeyena ? stāṃ dvāveva pakṣau ? iha ekaśceti saṅ‌khyāśbadānāmekaśeṣo na bhavati, anibhidhānād | viṃśatyādīnāṃ tu bhavatyeva ||
vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ || 1.2.65 ||
vṛddhaśabdo'yaṃ loke carame vayasi prasiddhaḥ,yuvaśabdo dvitīye, tayoriha grahaṇe taruṇaśca vṛddhaśca yuvā ca sthaviraścetyādau syāt | 'vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddhamjīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā'- -anayoḥ śāstrīyayorgrahaṇe aupagavaścānantara aupagaviśca yuvetyādāvapi syāt | ato yuvaśabdasya tāvatkṛtrimasya vyavahitāpatyavācino'tra grahaṇam, tatsāhacaryādvṛddhaśabdasyāpi vyavahitāpatyavācinaḥ śāstrāntare prasiddhasya grahaṇamityāha--vṛddhaśabda ityādi | gotragrahaṇe tvapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikasya grahaṇamityapatyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ syāt | kvacitpunaradhiko'pi granthaḥ paṭhyate--yūneti sahayoga eṣā tṛtīyeti | sa idānīntanaiḥ prakṣiptaḥ, yūnā saha vacana iti sahaśabdaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sūtre sahayoge tṛtīyeti darśayati | ata eva jñāpyate-sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣa iti | viśeṣo vairūpyamiti | śabdasya vṛddhayuvanimittasya grahaṇānnānya iti bhāvaḥ | padārthaṃ darśayitvā tadayamartha ityāha-vṛddhayuvanimittakamevetyādi | samānāyāmākṛtāviti | ākṛtiḥ śabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ gargāpatyatvādi | kvacittu prakṛtāviti pāṭhaḥ, prakṛtiḥ mūlaprakṛtirgargaśabdādiḥ | gārgyaścetyādi | gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvādyañantābhyāṃ yūni 'yañiñośca' iti phak | gārgyāyaṇāviti | prakaraṇādinātra jīvadvaṃśyatāvasāyaḥ; śabdasya gotradvayasyāpi sādhāraṇatvād |
yadyevam, gārgyaśca gārgyaśceti gotraśabdayoreva pūrveṇaikaśeṣo'sti prakaraṇādinaiva yuvatvamanyatarasya gaṃsyate | yūno hi dvāvākārau-jīvadvaṃśyatvam, pautraprabhṛtyapatyatvaṃ ca; tatra viśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyaśabdo na nivartate, yathā-vastuto bhūtānadyatane'pi 'abhūnnṛpo vibudhasakhaḥ' iti luṅ bhavati, tasmānnārtha etena ? ucyate; prakaraṇānapekṣeṇa śabdena jīvadvaṃśyatvaṃ pratipādayitukāmo dvandvaṃ prayuñjīta gārgyāyaṇāviti | ato dvandvanivṛtyarthaṃ vacanam | pratyudāharaṇe tu sarvatra dvandvo bhavati--gārgyavātsyāyanāviti | nanvatra viśeṣāntarasadbhāve'pi tallakṣaṇo viśeṣo vidyata iti syādekaśeṣaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ; evamarthavacanaṃ vyajyate-yo'sau viśeṣo yasya sadbhāvātpūrveṇāpaprāptiḥ, sa tallakṣaṇaścediti | evaṃ ca yāvaduddeśyaṃ vidheyasambandhāt sūtrārambhahetubhūtasya kṛtsnasya viśeṣasya tallakṣaṇatvavidhānāt kuto'tra prasaṅgaḥ ! iha tu prāpnoti--bhāgavittibhāgavittikāviti, kṛtsnasya viśeṣaṇasya tallakṣaṇatvāt ? evakāreṇa tu vyāvartyate, na hyatra tallakṣaṇa eva viśeṣastadāha--kutsā sauvīratvaṃ cāparo viśeṣa iti | viśeṣaheturityarthaḥ ||
strī puṃvacca || 1.2.66 ||
strītvasya vairūpyakāraṇasyādhikyādvacanaṃ puṃvacceti vakṣyāmīti ca | atra strīśabdasya svaritve stryadhikāravihitānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ grahaṇādayamartho bhavati- puṃvat strīpratyayo na bhavati | yathā puṃvadasyāstanāvityabhāvātideśastadvat | tataśca strītvasyānivṛttatvād gārgyaśca striyo gārgyāyaṇaśca gargā ityatra 'yañañośca' iti lug na syāt | 'astriyām' ityadhikārāt prasajyapratiṣedhe'yaṃ doṣaḥ | paryudāse tu śiṣyamāṇasya nivarttamānārthābhidhāyitvādisti strīsadṛśo'yaṃ doṣaḥ |ca paryudāse tu śiṣyamāṇasya nivarttamānārthābhidhāyitvādasti strīsadṛśo'rthaṃ iti siddhyati | iha tu gargānpaśyeti strītvasyānivṛttatvānnāyaṃ puṃsāṃ bahutve śas utpanna iti natvaṃ na syāt | stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasya tu grahaṇe strīśabdasya puṃśabdasyeva rūpaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | strītvaṃ tvanuvṛttameva | tatra yadyapi gargā iti bahuṣu puṃśabdasya rūpamiti tasminnatidiṣṭe jasādiṣu na doṣaḥ, natvaṃ tu vibhaktikāryaṃ na syāt | evaṃ stryarthagrahaṇe tu pumarthātideśāttatpratibaddhānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ siddhiriti na kaścid doṣaḥ | strīti cokte'rtha eva pratiyate | śabdānāmarthaparatvātsvarūpagrahaṇaṃ tvanāśaṅkyameva; vṛddho yūnetyanuvarttanād | ato'rthasyaiva grahaṇamityāha-stryarthaḥ pumarthavadbhavatīti | gārgī cetyādi | gārgyavātsyaśabdābhyām | 'yañaśca' iti ṅīp | dākṣīti | 'ito manuṣyajāteḥ' dākṣī iti ṅīṣi nivṛtte iñantād dvicane 'prathamayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | itamapi dvandvanivṛttyarthameva vacanam ||
pumān striyā || 1.2.67 ||
strīpuṃsalakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣa iti | padāntaragamye'pi tallakṣaṇe viśeṣe bhavati, yathā-gauścāyaṃ gauśceyamiti etau gāvau carata iti | evaṃ kanyākhukṛkavākugrāmaṇīkhalapūprabhutiṣu puṃsaḥ śeṣo veditavyaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati-haṃsaśca varaṭā ca kacchapaśca ḍuliṣvaruśyaśca rohicca aśvaśca vaḍavā ca puruṣaśca yoṣiṃcceti, sarvatrāpyatra strīpuṃsakṛta eva viśeṣaḥ ? 'sarūpāṇām' iti varttate, tena samānāyāṃ prakṛtau yatra strīpuṃsakṛta eva viśeṣastatraiva bhavati | iha tu brāhmaṇavatsaśca brāhmaṇīvatsā cetyatra prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ' strīpuṃsayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ | sā ca pradhānayoreva bhavatīti yatra pradhānastrīpuṃsakṛtta eva viśeṣastatraivaikaśeṣaḥ, iha tvapradhānakṛto'pītyekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | ihāpi mṛgakṣīrādivajjātivivakṣāyāṃ kukkuṭāvityādi siddham | dvandvanivṛttyarthantu vacanam | prāgityavyayamiti | prapūrvādañcateḥ kvinnantādastāteḥ 'añcerluk' iti luki 'taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' ityavyayatvaṃ sattvāsattvayordvandvaikaśeṣau cintyau ||
bhrātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām || 1.2.68 ||
idamapi dvandvanivṛttyarthaṃ vacanam | svasṛśabdasya hyekāpatyatvaṃ nimittam, duhitṛśabdasyāpatyatvameva | bhrātṛputraśabdayoḥ strītvapuṃstvaṃ cobhayatra viśeṣaḥ | tatra 'bhrātarau putrau' iti strīpuṃstvāvivakṣāyāṃ siddhaṃ svasṛduhitrorabhidhānam | ekaśeṣārambhe'pyayameva nirvāhaḥ ||
napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām || 1.2.69 ||
śuklā ca śuklaṃ ceti | vibhaktau vibhaktyantayoścāsārūpyādaprāpta ekaśeṣaḥ, śuklaṃ ca śuklaśceti vibhakt‌yantayorasārūpyam | vibhaktau sārūpye'pi puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāditi vacanam, ekavadbhāvārthaṃ ca | tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣa iti vartata iti | śuklaṃ ca kṛṣṇaścetyatra mā bhūt | evākārastu himahimānyau araṇyāraṇyānyāvityatra mā bhūditi | 'atra himāraṇyayormahattve' iti mahattvamaparo viśeṣaḥ, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamānantaryādekavaccetyanena sambandhyate, na tvekaśeṣeṇa cetyāha-ekavaccetyādi | asya grahaṇamekavaccetyasyottaratrānuvṛttirmā bhūditi | iha śuklena ca vastreṇa śuklena ca kambalena tenānena śukleneti tallakṣaṇaviśeṣābhāvādekaśeṣo na prāpnoti, sāmānyavivakṣāyāmekaśabdatvamekavacanaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | yadyepam, tadidaṃ śuklamityatrāpyevameva bhaviṣyati, nārtha etena ? dvandvanivṛttyarthaṃ tu vacanam |
anapuṃsakeneti kimiti | napuṃsakenāpi sahavacane sarūpāṇāmityekaśeṣeṇa bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ, tena yathā syādenena mā bhūditi pratyuttaram | ko nvatra viśeṣa ityatra āha- ekavacceti ||
pitā mātrā || 1.2.70 ||
abhyarhitatvānmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ, 'piturdaśaguṇaṃ mātā gauraveṇātiricyate' | pitarāvityabhidhānaṃ janayitṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ liṅgāvivakṣāyāṃ samarthanīyam | ekaśeṣārambhe'pi dvandvastviṣyata eveti nārtha etena ||
śvaśuraḥ śvaśrvā || 1.2.71 ||
pitṛśvaśurau mātṛśvakṣūbhyāmiti noktam, lāghavārtham | śvaśrūśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ śvaśurasyokārākāralopaścetyūṅantatve pratyayāntatvād brahmabandhūrityādivadekadeśābhāvāccāprātipadikatve'pi śvaśretyasmādeva nirdeśālliṅgāt supastaddhitāśca bhavanti | śvaśrūśvaśurāviti | abhyarhitatvādeva pūrvanipātaḥ, 'śvaśrūḥ pūrvajapatnī ca mātṛtulyā prakīrtitā' atrāpi dampatyorjanayitṛtvamātravivakṣāyāṃ liṅgāvivakṣāyāṃ samarthanīyam | anārambhapakṣe'pi śvaśrūśvaśurāvityabhidhāne dvandvastviṣyata veti, nārtha etena ||
tyādādīni sarvaurnityam || 1.2.72 ||
sarvaśabdasyārthamāha--tyadādibhiranyaiśceti | etadeva prakaṭayati - sarvagrahaṇamiti | tyādibhiranyaiśceti | yadidaṃ sākalyamuktaṃ tadarthamityarthaḥ; anyathā pratyāsatteḥ 'tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ' ityadhikārādvā tyadādibhireva sahavacane syāditi bhāvaḥ | sa ca devadattaśceti | nanu devadatto'pi sāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ tacchabdenaiva nirdeṣṭuṃ śakyate, tataśca sarūpāṇāmityeva siddham | na cārabdhe'pi sūtre vṛttau viśeṣo'ntarbhāvayintuṃ śakyaḥ, tāvityasya sarūpasādhāraṇatvādvirūpāṇāṃ ca nānāvidhātvāt, satyam; taddevadattāvityādidvandvanivṛttyarthaṃ vacanam, anyathā 'tatputrastadīyaḥ' ityādivṛttyantaravad dvandvo'pi syāt |
yadyatparamiti | tyadādipāṭhe śabdaparavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | sa ca yaśca yāvityādi | bhāṣye tu 'pūrvaśeṣaḥ khalvapi dṛśyate - sa ca yaśca tau' ityuktam | iha cāhaṃ ca bhavāṃścāvāmiti bhavatītyāhuḥ |
tyadāditaḥ śeṣe puṃnapuṃsakato liṅgavacanāni | ādyāditvāttasiḥ, tyadādīnāṃ śeṣe saha vivakṣito yo'rthaḥ pumān, yacca napuṃsakaṃ tadvaśena liṅgavacanāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | sa ca devadatta ca tau, sā ca devadattaśca tau, tacca devadattā ca te | puṃnapuṃsakayostu sahavivakṣāyāṃ paratvānnapuṃsakavaśena vyavasthā | tacca devadattaśca te, iha sa ca kukkuṭaḥ sā ca mayūrī - kukkuṭamayūryāvete, ardhaṃ pippalyāstad ardhaṃpippalī ca sā ardhaṃpippalyau te iti paravalliṅgamiti samāsārthasya liṅgātideśāttadviśeṣaṇasyāpi sarvanāmnastadeva liṅgaṃ bhavati ||
grāmyapaśusaṃgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī || 1.2.73 ||
grāme bhavā grāmyāḥ | 'grāmādyakhañau' | puṃsaḥ śeṣe prāpta iti | 'pumān striyā' ityanena | sāmarthyāditi | pradhānasya saṃghasya tāruṇyātāruṇye na sambhavata ityasmātsāmarthyād guṇabhūtānāmapi paśūnāṃ viśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ |
etau gāvāviti | yadyapi dvayorapi saṃgho bhavatyeva, tathāpīha saṃghagrahaṇasāmarthyāṃdvahūnāṃ saṃgho gṛhyate, anyathā śeṣasyānekaviṣayatvād anarthakaṃ na syāt |
? anekaśapheṣviti | śaphāḥ - khurāḥ | uṣṭrāṇāṃ tvāraṇyatvādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ ||

dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ ||
<1.3>
atha prathamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ|| 1.3.1 ||
"bhū" ityevamādayaḥ śabdā ityanena pāṭhanibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñeti darśayati| yadi tvanāddatya, pāṭhām, kriyāvacano dhāturityucyeta, tata āṇaveduityādiṣvapi syāt| kathaṃ punarapabhraṃśānāmanuśāsanamāśaṅkyate? kuto tu khalvetad āṇavedvityādayo'pabhraṃśā iti, yāvatā ye śāstreṇānugamyante te sādhavaḥ? avaśyaṃ cātubandhādiviśiṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ pāṭhenaiva darśanīyam, na hi tadrūpaṃ prayoge sambhavati| ato'nyārthaḥ san gaṇapāṭha evāśrito bhavatīti dhātutve sati laḍ bhavati| edhate, sparddhate ityanudāttetau| yadi pāṭhamātranibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñā, yā-vā-div-śabdānāṃ sarvanāmavikalpasvargavācināṃ samānaśabdānāmapi prasaṅgaḥ? na ca prāpaṇādi rartho niyāmakaḥ, anārṣatvād, abhiyuktairuttarakālanirdiṣṭatvād, anekārthatvābhyupagamācca, satyam; saṃjñāyāṃ ko doṣaḥ? na tāvaddhātupratyayānāṃ laḍādīnāṃ prasaṅgaḥ; kartrādīnāmabhāvāt, icyate, yāḥ paśyeti `āto dhātoḥ' iti lopaḥ syāt| nanu adhātuḥ iti niṣedhād aprātipādikatvādvibhaktireva na syāt, nautadasti;vibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ tyadādyatve ṭāpi ca yārūpatve sati dhātutvam, subutpattidaśāyāṃ tu yadityasya nāsti dhātutvama; vāśabdāttu subeva na syāt; evaṃ div‌śabdādapi| na ca `diva aut; ityetaddhātutvābhāve liṅgam; kkibantasya dīvyatiḥ supi sambhavāt| sānubandhakatve'pi tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād, ataḥ samānaśabdānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityata āha-dhātuśabda ityādi| kkacittu `bhū'ityevamādayaḥ śabdā ityasyānantaraṃ kriyāvācina iti paṭhyate, tasmin pakṣe yāsya granthasya śaṅkā sā tasya draṣṭavyā| asya tu kathaṃ punaḥ sūtre'nupāttaḥ kriyāvacana ityayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate? ata āha-dhātuśabdaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñeti| tataḥ kimityāha- te ceti| tato'pi kimityāha-tadihāpīti| mahatyāḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñāyā āśrayaṇaṃ tadīyopādhipari-grahārthameveti bhāvaḥ||
yāvitsiddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate|
āśritakramarūpatvāt sā kriyetyabhidhīyate||
siddhaṃ vā bhavatvasiddhaṃ vā, śabdena tu yadvastu sādhyatvenābhidhīyate sā kriyā sādhyatve cāśritakramarūpatvāt pūrvāparībhūtāvayavatvaṃ vitatarūpatvaṃ yattadrūpamabhidhīyate tasyaikasmin kṣaṇe'navasthānam, yadāha-kriyā nāmeyam atyantāparihaṣṭa'śakyā ca sā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum iti| ekaikasya kriyākṣaṇasya pratyakṣatve'pi samūharūpā dhātuvācyā kriyā na pratyakṣetyarthaḥ| kramavanta eva kṣaṇā ekaphalo ddeśena saṃpādyāmānatvāt aikyamivāpannā dhātuvācyāḥ tadyathā-pacatītyadhiśrayaṇādayo'dhaḥ śrayaṇāntāḥ kledanaphalāvacchinnāḥ| evamapacadityatrāpi kriyā sādhyaiva| tāhaśasyaiva hi rūpasya tatrātyayaḥ pratīyate yatpūrvāparībhūtaṃ kriyate| ghaṭa ityatra tu ghaṭaśabdena cakrodaragato'pi ghaṭaḥ siddharūpa ucyate,ekasminneva kṣaṇe yaddarśanayogyaṃ rūpaṃ tena rūpeṇetyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ kriyāvacano dhāturityāśrayaṇādatiprasaṅgo nāstīti sthitam|
iha bhūrādiryaṣāmiti bahuvrīhau yaṇādeśe kṛte `bhūvādayaḥ'ityanupapanno nirdeśa ityata āha-bhūvādīnāṃ vakāro'yaṃ maṅgalārtha iti| abhidhānadharmasyāpyabhidheye upacāraḥ, yathā-bhramare dvirepha iti| bhūvādīnāṃ saṃjñīnāṃ sambandhī yo vakāraḥ, tadabhidhāyini bhūvādiśabde sthito'yaṃ prayujyate, lakṣaṇenāprapto nipātyata ityarthaḥ| sa ca maṅgalārthaḥ | apūrvasya lābho maṅgalam, sādhuśabdaprayoge'pi dharmo bhavati, bhūvādiśabdaśca sādhuḥ| kiṃ ca vakāre satyavikṛto bhūśabdo vyahṛtyādi smārayatītyapi dharmo bhavatīti|
prakārāntaramāha-bhuvo vārthaṃ vadantīti| bhuvo dhātorarthaṃ vadantīti vā, bhūvādaya iti nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| arthakathanaṃ caitad | vyutpattistu bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, kriyāsāmānyabhuvaṃ vadantītyauṇādiko'yam, `vasivapiyajirājivrajisadihanivāśivādivāribhya iñ'iti kartari vadeḥ iñ pratyayaḥ| yadi kriyāsāmānyaṃ ye vadanti te saṃjñinaḥ, astibhavatividyatīnāmeva syād, na pa catyādīnāṃ viśeṣavācinām? viśepakṣe gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāt so'pyaṅagīkriyate, anyathā śabvikaraṇā ye seṭo niranubandhakā antargaṇakāryavarjitā bhūprabhṛtayasteṣāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syād| bahuvīhestu bhūtvādiśabdasya pṛṣodarāditvātsādhutvam| tṛtīyaṃ prakāramāha-bhvarthā vā vādayaḥ smṛtā iti| bhavanaṃ bhūḥ so'rtho yeṣāṃ te bhvarthāḥ, evambhūtā vādayo vātra saṃjñinaḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ| kimidaṃ vādaya iti ? `vā gatigandhanayoḥ,' vā ādiryeṣāṃ te vādayaḥ vā gati ityārabhyā curādisamāpteḥ| tathā ca bhvādayo vādayaḥ bhūprabhṛtaya ā `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasmād| vādayaśca vādayaśca bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ sahavivakṣāyāṃ svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottaraḥ svaravidhiriti bahuvrīheḥ śeṣaḥ| tato bhuvo vādaya iti vācyavācakasambandhe śeṣaṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| asminpakṣe pāṭhaviśeṣo'rthaścetyubhayaṃ sūtrākṣarairevopāttaṃ bhavati||
padamañjarī
upadeśe'janunāsika it|| 1.3.2 ||
upadiśyate'nenetyupadeśa iti| akarttari ca kārake iti karaṇe ghañ | nanu ca neyaṃ saṃjñā, paratvācca karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ iti lyuṭ prāpnoti, halaśca ityatrāpi saṃjñāyāmityeva| lyuṭ tāvanna bhavati, kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam iti| akartari ca ityatra cakāro bhinnakramaḥ-saṃjñāyāṃ ceti, tena kkacidasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavati| athopadiśyate'nenetyatropadeśaḥ ko'rthaḥ? vidhānam| yadyevam laṇ edha vṛddhau ityādau na syāt, na hyatra kiñcidvidhīyate| athānirjñātasvarūpasya svarūpajñāpanaṃ tat, ācāre'vagalbhaklībahoḍebhyaḥ kkip ityatra galbhādyakārasa na syāt na hi galbhādīnāṃ svarūpajñāpanārthamuccāraṇam;pañcamīnirddeśena kkipo vidhānāt| yadyevam, kkibanenānirjñātarūpo jñāpte, tatra cāyaṃ bhavatyakāra iti bhaviṣyati| śāstravākyānīti| laṇ-edha-sparddhetyādīnāmapi viśiṣṭaprayojanaparatvenoccāraṇād vākyatvam| asyaiva vivaraṇam-sūtrapāṭha iti| khilapāṭhaḥ-dhātupāṭhaḥ prātipadikapāṭhaḥ, vākyapāṭhaśca| tatra sūtre matubāderukāraḥ, dhātuṣu edhādyakāraḥ prātipadikeṣu bhavacchabdasyokāraḥ,vākye galbhādyakāraḥ| nanu ca sarvatrātra śuddho'c paṭhyate, nānunāsika ityata āha-pratijñānunāsikyā iti| pratijñāmātreṇa samadhigamyamānunāsikyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| pratijñānunāsikā iti tu prasiddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ| tatra pratijñāsamadhigamyatvād anunāsike pratijñāśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| tataḥ samānādhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ| tacca pratijñānaṃ nāniyamena bhavati, ki tarhi? yatrācāryāḥ smaranti tatraiva| sūtrakāreṇa tāvadvivakṣitāḥ sarve'nunāsikāḥ paṭhitāḥ, ḍulabham̐ṣ prāptau itivat, lekhakaistu saṃkīrṇā likhitāḥ tatra smṛtiparamparayā nirṇeyamityarthaḥ|
abhra ām̐ apa iti| nāyaṃ sūtrādiṣu svarūpeṇoccarito|nunāsikaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? `āṅo'nunāsikaśchandasi'ityanunāsikaśabdena vihitaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe'pyupadeśagrahaṇe uñaḥ ūm̐ ityatra kasmānna bhavati ? vidhānasāmarthyād| itsaṃjñāyāṃ hi tasya lopaḥ iti lopaḥ syāt| yadyevam, atrāpi vidhānasāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi udāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśatā | idaṃ tatrodāharaṇam-aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ kadhīcchati brāhyaṇakulamiti kyajantātkvipi allope, vali lope, napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ dadhi iti| yadyatretsaṃjñā syāt `idito num dhātoḥ iti num syāt| atrāpyanunāsikavidhānasāmarthyādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati | nanu ca yatretsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ prayojanaṃ na sambhavati, yathā-dadhi, madhviti prātipadikeṣu tatretsaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ| atrānunāsikavidhānamarthavat, naitadevam; lopasyetkāryasya sarvatra sambhavāt | tasmādaṇo'pragṛhyasya itsaṃjñāyāmeva vidheyāyāmanunāsikavidhānasāmarthyādevātra lopo na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhyuttarārthamavaśyam `upadeśa' iti vaktavyam, tadihāpi vispaṣṭarthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate| āto maninniti| atra makārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi syād, anyebhyo'pi ddaśyante iti halante'ntyādacaḥ paraḥ syāt | sarvasyeti| daridrāprabhṛtisambandhino'pi ||
padamañjarī
halantyam|| 1.3.3 ||
antaśabdo'tra samāptau varttate;nāvayave;nāvayave asambhavāt| na samīpe;atiprasaṅgāt | yena samāpyate samudāyastadante bhavamanty, digāditvādyat| halantye sarvaprasaṅgaḥ, sarvasya halaḥ sāṃjñā prāpnoti| sarvo hi hal taṃ tamavadhiṃ pratyanto bhavati, antyagrahaṇaṃ tvādinivṛttyarthaṃ syād, ata āha-dhātvāderiti| ādiśabdana sūtraprātipadikapratyayanipātāgamādeśānāṃ grahaṇam| śīṅ, laṇ,nadaṭ, san, āṅ, trapujatunoḥ ṣuk, cakṣiḍaḥ khyāñ iti yo'yaṃ dhātvādirūpaḥ samudāyastadarthaḥ sa upadeśaḥ, na tu nāntarīyakāvāntarasamudāyārtha ityantyasya samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ prādhānyāddhātvādereva grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| agniciditi| atretsaṃjñāyāṃ lopaḥ syāt| na ca tuko vaiyarthyam;āgatyetyādau caritārthatvāt| na ca kvipaḥ pittvasya vaiyarthyam, āgnicitāvityādau caritārthatvāt| yadyapyatrobhayatrāpi tāvato'vadhestakāro'ntyaḥ, tathāpi mukhyasamudāyasya nāntya iti nāsti prasaṅgaḥ| iha ca daṇḍinniti nakārasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ'iti niṣedhāllopābhāve'pi samudāyasya nittvādādyudāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā-śrotriyaśabde vākyārthe padavacanamiti pakṣe | athopadeśānuvṛttāvapi sanutarityasya rephasya kasmānna bhavati? svarādiṣvantodāttapāṭhasāmarthyāt|
iha `śaṣasar' `hal'iti yo lakārastasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ halityayaṃ pratyāhāra upapadyate, sati ca pratyāhāre laṇityatra lakārasya haltvāttasyaiva `śaṣasarhal',ityatrānte nirdiṣṭatvāditsaṃjñā, tadāśrayaśca pratyāhāra iti itaretarāśrayatvāt pratyāhāro nopapannaḥ| tataśca sarveṣāmeva ṇakārādīnāmitsaṃjñā na syāditi sarva eva pratyāhāravyavahāro'nupapannaḥ, `ādirantyena'ityetasyāpi vaiyarthyam? syādetathalityatra hakārāt para lṛkāraḥ, tasya lṛkārasyaikādeśo laparaḥ, tasya `upadeśe'janunāsikaḥ'iti itsaṃjñā, sa eva `halantyam' ityatrāpyekādeśena lapareṇa nirdiṣṭa iti| evamapītaretarāśrayameva, lṛkārasyetsaṃjñeti tasmādvaktavyo'tra parihārastamāhahasya l halityādi| sādhāraṇaṃ bhavettantram, yathā-tulyakakṣyayorbhuñcānayo pradīpaḥ| sa ceha prayatnaviśeṣaḥ, yathā-śveto dhāvatītyatra sādhāraṇenaikenaiva prayatnena dvayorvākyayoruccāritayoḥ phalaṃ sampadyate, tathehāpyekena tantreṇa prabalena dvitīyaṃ halgrahaṇamupāttaṃ parigṛhītaṃ veditavyam | tasya dvitīyasyārthamāha-hasyeti| samīpasamīpisambandhe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa ityarthaḥ| tataḥkimityāha-tenetyādi| etad darśayati-hakārasamīpavartino lakārasya na pratyāhārasamāśyayoṇaenetsaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? sākṣādupādāneneti| pramāṇam? agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvameva| nanu gṛhyate viśeṣa:-`kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasya grahaṇam'iti, kṛtrimo hi pratyāhāraḥ satyam;sa evāsati tantre'nupapanna iti tvayaivoktam||
padamañjarī
na vibhaktau tusmāḥ|| 1.3.4 ||
vṛkṣāditi takārasyetsaṃjñāyām `titsvaritam'syāt| nanu cādeśottarakālaṃ sthānivadbhāvenāsya vibhaktisaṃjñā, upadeśānantaramevetsaṃjñā prāpneti? satyam; pratiṣedhasāmarthyattu bhāvinyapi vibhaktitve pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| vargagrahaṇaṃ kim?vṛkṣānityatrāpi yathā syāt kva punarupadeśe nakāro'yamantyaḥ, ma tāvattasya kvacidupadeśaḥ? `śaso na'ityatra tvakāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārtha iti śakyaṃ vaktum| iha tarhi `jhasya ran'paceranniti| brāhyaṇā iti| rūpodāharaṇametat| kāryodāharaṇaṃ tu bhavataḥ iti| atra `siti ca'iti padatve jaśtvaṃ syāt| pacataḥ pacatha ityatra prayojanābhāvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktum| apacatāmityādi| tāmādayastasādīnāmantyādacaḥ pare syuḥ| kimo't ityasya prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ iti vibhaktitvam| iṭo't ityasyāpi sthānivadbhāveneti tayorapi pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, tatrāha-kimo'dityādi| anityatvaṃ tu `idamasthamuḥ' iti thamorukāro'nubandhādvijñāyate| kvacittu vṛttāveva `idamasthamuḥ'ityukārānubandhanirdaśādanityatvamupalakṣyate iti paṭhyate| idānīṃ tadānīmiti| dānīmastu pratiṣredho bhavatyeva| anityatvaṃ hi jñāpitam, na punaḥ prāgdiśīyeṣvasyāpravṛttiḥ|| padamañjarī
ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ || 1.3.5 ||
ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbaddhyate, tenaikavacanamupapadyate iti bhāvaḥ| atra `ṭu' iti na ṭavargasya grahaṇam;ukārasyānanunāsikatvenānudittvāt,`cuṭū'ityuttaratra vargagrahaṇād, ñiḍubhyāṃ sāhacaryācca| minni iti| `āditaśca' `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ '| vepathuriti | ṭ‌vito'thuc| uptrimamiti| ḍ‌vitaḥ ktriḥ ktrermam nityam yajāditvātsaṃprasāraṇam|
paṭuyatīti| pṛthvādiṣu ṭuśabdasyopadeśaḥ, atretsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmavayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakamiti samudāyādathucprasaṅgaḥ| kevalasyānudāharaṇatvam;itkāryābhāvāt| kaṇḍūyatīti| nanu cāyaṃ dīrghāntaḥ kaṇḍ‌vādiṣūpadiśyate, evaṃ tarhi kaṇḍūmicchatīti kyajantāt kvipi kaṇḍu brāhmaṇakulaṃ tadicchatīti punaḥ kyaci draṣṭavyam, tatretsaṃjñāyāmantaraṅgatvādakṛta eva dīrdhe bhavatyayaṃ ḍuśabdaḥ, gaṇapaṭhitaśca kaṇḍūśabda ekadeśavikṛta iti syāt prasaṅgaḥ| ñikārīyatīti| nāyaṃ samudāyaḥ kvacidupadiṣṭaḥ||

ṣaḥ pratyayasya|| 1.3.6 ||
rajakīti| `ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca' iti ṅīṣ| kathaṃ punaratropadhālopaḥ, yāvatā aniditāṃ hala upadhāyāḥ kṅiti ityucyate? jñāpayatirañjerakṅityapi kvacidupadhālopo bhavatīti | ṣoḍa iti| ṣaḍ dantā asya vayasi dantasya datṛ ṣaṣa utvam, datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ ṣṭutvam | ṣaṣo'ntyasyotvam uttarapadāderḍakāraḥ, ṣoḍantamācaṣṭe iti ṇici ṭilope pacādyaci ṇilopaḥ| `ṣaṇu dāne'`ñamantāḍḍaḥ', uṇādayo bahulam iti bahulavacanāt itsaṃjñāsatvayorabhāvaḥ| ṣaḍika iti| anukampitaḥ ṣaḍṅguliḥ bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhaj vā `ṭhājādāvūrddhaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ' iti ṅguliśabdasya lopaḥ, yasyetilopasya sthānivadbhāvāt ṣakārānte'vadhau bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvādantarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padatvājjaśtvam| atretsaṃjñāyāṃ ṅīṣ‌prasaṅgaḥ| yadyapyete samudāyā na kvāpyupadiśyante, ṣakārastu ṣaṣa utvam, ṣaṇu dāne ityupadeśastho bhavati| aviṣaḥ mahiṣa iti| avimahyoṣṭiṣac | nanvatra prayojanābhāvādeva ṣakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati; īkārasya ṭittvādeva siddheḥ| na ca pakṣe ṅīṣarthaḥ ṣakāraḥ, ṅīpoṣa'pi citaḥ parasyodāttanivṛttisvareṇodāttatvāt, satyam; anyatarasyaiva śravaṇārtha upadeśaḥ syāditi ṭakārasyāpi śaṅkyota||

cuṭū|| 1.3.7 ||
ādī iditi| prārambhe varttamānāvityarthaḥ| kauñjāyanya iti| cphañantāt `vratacphañorastriyām'iti svārthe svarthe ñyaḥ| śaṇḍikādibhyo ñya iti| so'syā bhijanaḥ iti tatra varttate| manduraja iti | ḍyāpossaijñācchandasoḥ iti hrasvaḥ| annāṇṇa iti | `dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā'ityato labdheti tatrānuvartte| kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ,`cuṭūṣāḥ pratyayasya'ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyatāmata āha-pṛthagityādi| keśacuñcuḥ keśacaṇa iti | atra cakārasyetsaṃjñāyām `citaḥ'ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt, pitkaraṇantu paryāyārthaṃ syāt| avādityasyānuvṛttirdarśitā||

laśakvataddhite|| 1.3.8 ||
priyaṃvada iti| `arurdviṣadajantasya mum' | jiṣṇuriti| snupratyayasya gittvapakṣe gakārasyedamudāharaṇam| cūḍāla iti | matvarthe `prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām'iti | atra prayojanābhāvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktum| karṇiketi| `karṇalalāṭāt kanalaṅkāre'iti bhavārthe kan| atra `kiti ca' iti vṛddhiḥ syāt, rūpañca na sidhyet| atha tudirchidir‌prabhṛtiṣu irityasya samudāyasya kenetsaṃjñā?mā bhūtsamudāyasya, rephasya halantyam iti bhaviṣyati, ikārasya upadeśejanunāsika it iti| irito vā ityātrāpi-- iśca raścerau tāvitāvasyeti vigrahaḥ, na tu irityayaṃ samudāyaḥ sa idyasyeti| avaśyaṃ ca ikārasya pṛthagītsaṃjñeṣitavyā, svariteta ityātmanepadaṃ yathā syāditi| yadyevam, `idito num dhāttoḥ' iti num prāpnoti, kumbhīdhānyanyāyena na bhavati; yasya punaḥ kumbhyāṃ vānyatra vā, nāsau kumbhīdhānyaḥ| nāyaṃ nyāyo numvidhau śakya āśrayitum| iha hi na syāt-ṭunadi' nandathuriti| jñāpakāt siddham, yadayam `na haśaḥ' iti ksasya pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-neditāṃ numbhavati; anyathā haśeridittvānnumi sati anigupadhātvāt ksasya prāptireva nāsti, kiṃ tanniṣedhena| parihārāntaramapyatra numvidhau vakṣyate||

tasya lopaḥ|| 1.3.9 ||
tasya grahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'bhāvo lopaḥ, sa ca kasyacideva bhavati,tatra prakaraṇāditsaṃjñakasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyatītyata āha-tasya grahaṇamityādi| ādirñiṭuḍava iti | asati tasya grahaṇe ye'nekāla itsaṃjñakā ñiprabhṛtayasteṣvalo'ntyasya lopaḥ syāt, tasya grahaṇasāmarthyāttu sarvasya bhaviṣyati| etacca `nānarthake'lontyasya vidhīḥ' ityanāśrityoktam||

yathāsaṅkhyanudeśaḥ samānām|| 1.3.10 ||
saṅkhyāśabdenānna kramo lakṣyata iti| katham? avyabhicārāt | yatraika evoddeśyanuddeśī ca, yathā `mudrādaṇ'iti, na tatra niyamaprasaṅga ityanekatvasaṅkhyāyā
eveha grahaṇam| sā ca kramaṃ na vyabhicarati;yugapadanekasya śabdasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāt| mukhye tvarthe'yamarthaḥ syātsamānāṃ samasaṅkhyānāmuddeśināṃ yā saṅkhyā caturādilakṣaṇā tayā uddeśyaḥ tvādevāsyārthasya siddhatvād| ataḥ kramapara eva saṅkhyāśabda iti | yathākramagrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, saṅkhyādvārakaṃ sāmyaṃ yathā vijñāyeta;anyathā sthānaprayatnā dikṛtamapi samatvaṃ pratīyeta| nanu ca kriyamāṇamapi saṅkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kramaparamiti kathamataḥ saṃkhyāsāmyapratipattiḥ? satyam; krame śabdaḥ paryavasyati, mukhyo'pyarthaḥ pratīyate|sa hi pratīto lākṣaṇikaṃ gamayati; tasmāt saṃkhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāt tad‌dvārakameva sāmyaṃ gṛhyate| yathāsaṃkhyamiti| `yathā'sāhaśye' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| anudeśo bhavatīti | sambandhī bhavatīti draṣṭavyam | tathā ca vabhyati-anudeśinaḥ sambadhyante iti| anudiśyata ityanudeśa iti | akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām ityasaṃjñāyāpi karmapi ghañ| anuśabdaḥ paścādarthe, ddaśiruccākriya ityāha-paścaccāryata ityartha iti | yaduktaṃ saṃkhyādvārakaṃ sāmyaṃ gṛhyate iti taddarśayati-samānāṃ samasaṃkhyānām| asyaiva vivaraṇam-samaṃpaṭhitānāmiti | ud‌deśināmiti| kañciddharmaṃ vidhātuṃ prasiddhavacchabdaparāmarśayogyena rūpeṇa upādānamuddeśaḥ, tadvanta uddeśinaḥ, vidheyatayā paścāduccāraṇamanudeśaḥ, tadvanto'nudeśinaḥ| yadyapi sūtre uddeśino na śrutāstathāpyanudeśaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt samasaṃkhyatvasya ca pratiyogyapekṣatvāt ta eva gamyante| uddeśināmanudeśināṃ ceti yathākramamityetadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhyau| yathākramamiti| pūrvavadavyayībhāvastṛtīyāntaṃ caitat|
tadayamatrārthaḥ- samasaṃkhyānāmuddeśināmanudeśināṃ ca yoyaḥ kramaḥ-prathamacaramabhavastena tenānudeśinaḥ sambadhyante, uddeśibhiḥ sahetyarthād gamyate | kvacit uddeśibhiriti paṭhyate| tatra sahayoge tṛtīyā| prathamād prathama ityādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe yojayati| vahanti, varṣanti, nadantītyādau loka eva yathāsaṃkhyasambandhasya ddaṣṭatvānnārtha etena ? ucyate;vyutkrameṇāpi sambandho loke ddaśyate-kanyābrahmacāriṇau, daṇḍakandukahastāviti| yogyatāvaśādatra sambandha iti cet; krameṇāpi sambandhaḥ, tadvaśādeva yogyā hi nadyo vahane, ghanāśca varṣaṇe| ata evaikasya dharmiṇi bahuṣu dharmeṣu vihiteṣu vidhānakrameṇānyathā vā yogyatānurūpa eva sambandho bhavati-amumudvarttaya, snāpaya, bhojaya; bhojaya, snāpayaudvarttayeti syādetat-svataḥ prāptiriyaṃ yaduktakrameṇa sambandhaḥ| tathā hi, yogyatāviśeṣānavadhāraṇe prathamapratītayoḥ sambandhaḥ, bādhakābhāvāt| tāvatā hi dvayorapi caritārthatvam, dvitīyasya dharmiṇo dharmasya vā pratiyogyayekṣāyāṃ prathamaśrutasya caritārthatvād, acaritārthana dvitīyena pratiyogināṃ sambandhaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra tasmāt svataḥ prāptaḥ prāptyā kramasambandhaḥ siddhaḥ iti| yadyevam, lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyāna ityādau vaiṣamye'pyevameva syād, yāvatāṃ sāmyaṃ tāvatāmāditaḥ krameṇa sambandhaḥ, pariśiṣṭasya tu sarvairanantareṇa vetyataḥ samānāmiti vakṣyāmītyārambhaḥ|
svariteneti viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmīti| kvaciddhi sāmye'pi neṣyate| athārabhyamāṇe'pyasmin paramsaipadānāṃ ṇalādayaḥ, luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ,`eco'yavāyāva'ityatra kathamasya pravṛttiḥ, yāvatā parasmaipadādisaṃjñayā yugapadeva saṃjñināṃ pratītiḥ, na krameṇa? satyam; tibādisūtre, akṣaramāmnāye ca tibādayaḥ krameṇa pratītiḥ, sa eva kramo niyāmako bhaviṣyati| evaṃ dvandve'pi | pāghretyādau yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvandve'pi kramasya pratīteḥ sa eva niyāmakaḥ| nanu ca tipo ṇal, taso'tusa, paḥ pibaḥ, jighraḥ-ityevaṃ bhinnavākyatayopadeśo'stu, evaṃ hīdaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati?satyam; evaṃ tu gauravaṃ syāt tasya rūpeṇānidaśāt, tatra vibhakterbhedenoccāraṇācca| tathā `vido laṭo vā ' ityatrānantaryānmasometyeva sambadhyeta, tadāha-- saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśāt sarvaprasaṅgo'nudeśasya| tatra yathāsaṃkhyavacanaṃ niyamārtham, saṃjñāsamāsanirdeśacca pṛthagviktisaṃjñyanuccāraṇārthaḥ, prakaraṇe ca sarvasampratyārthaḥ iti| taudeya ityādau `so'syābhijanaḥ' ityatrārthepratyayaḥ|
ihetyādi| ekayogatvapakṣe codyam, bhinnayogapakṣe tu yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārtha iti vakṣyati| kecittu vibhajya yogaṃ paṭhanti, anye tvekameva| svaritenetyādi parihāraḥ| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyata ityāha--svaritenādhikāra ityādi| yadyevam, svarite ddaṣṭe sandehaḥ syāt, na jñāyate--kimayaṃ yathāsaṃkhyārthaḥ? āhosvidadhikārārthaḥ?iti| sandehamātrametad, bhavati, sarvasandeheṣu cedamupatiṣṭhate--`vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam'iti | tatra vyākhyānānnirṇayo bhaviṣyati||

svaritenādhikāraḥ|| 1.3.11 ||
atra pāribhāṣikasya `svaritasya grahaṇe raṣābhyānnoṇaḥ'ityādau nakārādervyañjanasyādhikāropalakṣaṇaṃ noktaṃ syād, pāribhāṣikasyāñdharmatvāditi matvāha--svarito nāma varṇadharma iti| varṇamātradharma ityarthaḥ| sa cāyaṃ dharmaḥ salādhmātāditulyaḥ kevalaṃ sūtreṣveva bhavati, na prayoge| kvacittu svarito nāma svaradoṣo varṇadharma iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra svaradoṣaḥ-uccāraṇadoṣaḥ, adhikāraśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ| viniyoga iti| vyāpāraṇam| atha śabdasyaviniyuktasya ko vyāpāra ityāha--adhikṛtatvāduttaratropatiṣṭhata iti | upasthānamapyetadeva yadutāsya tatrabuddhisthatā| uttaratretyulakṣaṇam, kvacit pūrvatrāpyupatiṣṭhate;sūtrakāreṇa paṭhitasyāsya svaritatvasya saṃkīrṇatvāt pāṭhasya viṣayavibhāgo durjñeya ityāha-pratijñāsvaritā iti| pratyāya ityādyudāharaṇāni|
kimartha punaridamucyate, yāvatā nirddiśyamānaṃ loke'dhikriyate, yathā-devadattāya gaurddīyatāṃ kambalaśceti devadattāyeti gamyate, tathā `sṛ sthire' ityādīnāṃ sākāṅ‌kṣatvādanuvṛttairghañādibhireva sambandho bhaviṣyati? anyanirdeśastannivarttakaḥ, tadyathā--devadattāya gaurddīyatām, viṣṇumitrāya kambala iti kambalo gornivarttako bhavati, tathehāpi `abhividhau bhāve' itīnuṇ ghaño nivarttakaḥ syāt, tataśca `ākrośe'vanyergrahaḥ' ityādiṣvanantara inuṇeva syāt, tasmātparibhāṣā| adhikāraparimāṇajñānaṃ tu na jñāyate-- kiyantamavadhimadhikāro'nuvarttata iti? yathā-prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgadhikāraḥ?, dhātoriti prāk lādeśebhyaḥ? utādhyāyasya parisamāpteḥ? evaṃ tarhyubhayārthamidam--adhikārārthaṃ ca nivṛttyarthaṃ ca | katham? svaritenādhikāraḥ svarite ddaṣṭe'dhikāro na bhavatītyarthaḥ, tena viṃśatikāt khaḥ| ityatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñeyaṃ taddarśanācca dvitripūrvādityasya nivṛttiraṣyate tatra tāvatitho'lanubandhanīyaḥ, yathā--dvitripūrvānniṣkāt ityatrekāraḥ| tena dvayoryogayoranuvṛttirbhaviṣyati | evamanyatrāpi yatra tāvatitho'l nāsti tatra prāgvacanaṃ karttavyam, yathā--aṅgasya prāk ṭeḥ iti tad guru bhavati| syādetat,vyākhyānāt parimāṇaṃ jñāsyate iti? adhikāro'pi tarhi vyākhyānāt jñāyatām| inuṇghañiti saṃdehe ghañiti vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, inuṇa ānantaryam, ghaño'pyanuvṛttisāmarthya ddaṣṭamityastyeva saṃdehaḥ| `grahavṛddaniścigamaśca'ityādiṣu tvanantarasyāpa evādhikāraḥ, na ddaṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyasyāpi ghañaḥ, siddhatvād, vyākhyānādvā| yadapyutprekṣitam--ākāṃkṣārahite'pi vākye prakṛtasya sambandhārthaṃ śāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ- yathā dūrāntikārthabhyo dvitīyā ca ityatra pañcamyadhikāra iti | tatrāpi vyākhyānameva śaraṇamiti tadeva sarvatrāstu nārtha etena ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--anyatra ddaṣṭasyādhikārasya svaritenopalakṣaṇaṃ yathā syād‌, yathā--`gostriyorupasarjanasya'ityatra strīgrahaṇasya, na hyetallaukikenādhikāreṇa siddham, ānuṣaṅgikaṃ vāsya prayojanaṃ yat sākākṣeṣu vyahitasya cānuvṛttiḥ||
padamañjarī
anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam|| 1.3.12 ||
aviśeṣeṇetyādi| lasya tibādayaḥ, `laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau'`liṭaḥ kānajvā'`kvasuśca'`lṛṭaḥdvā'ityātmanepadaparasmaipadayorvihitvādāpādaparisamāpterniyamārthaṃ prakaraṇamityarthaḥ | ekavākyatayā vidhāvitaretarāśrayaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat--yathā `bahuṣu bahuvacanam',`karmaṇi dvitīyā'`ṅyāpprātipadikāt'ityetairekavākyabhūtaiḥ svādīnāṃ viśiṣṭavidhiḥ, evamanena prakāreṇa lasya tibādaya ityādibhiśca tiṅāmapi viśiṣṭavidhirastu iti, yadyevam; ātmanepadaparasmaipadasaṃjñābhyāṃ tibādīnāṃ vidhiḥ, vihitānāṃ ca saṃjñābhyāṃ bhāvyamitītaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti| svarūpeṇa viśiṣṭavidhauśatrādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ| syānmatam-lasya tiptasjhisipthasthamipvasmam lasya tibādayo bhavanti, tataḥ `anuparabhyāṃkṛñaḥ'-karttaryanupūrvāt karoteḥ parasya lasya tibādayo bhavanti| kimarthamidam? `gandhanāvakṣepaṇasvaritañitaḥ'iti vakṣyati, tidvādhanārthaṃ kartṛgrahaṇam;`bhāvakarmeṇoḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇasya taṅo bādho mā bhūditi | evam `abhipratyatibhyaḥ kṣipaḥ' ityādi `luṭi ca klupaḥ' ityevamantaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ `anudāttaṅitastātāṃjhathāsāthāndhvamiḍvahimahiṅ', anudāttaṅitaḥ parasya lasya tādayo bhavanti, tibādīnāmapavādaḥ, tato `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ'ityādi, `vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne'ityevamantaṃ kariṣyate, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ-ātyanepadagrahaṇaṃ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ parasmaipadagrahaṇaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ bhavati| evamapi prakaraṇāntarāvasthitānāṃ śatrādīnāṃ niyamo na syād, ato na svarūpeṇa viśiṣṭavidhiryuktaḥ| saṃjñāśrayaṇe tu yatraitsaṃjñakayorvidhānaṃ tatra sarvatropasthānānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ, kiṃ tvitaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti| yadi tvasya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃvayetivad bhāvinī saṃjñā vijñāyeta, tato netaretarāśrayaṃ lāghavaṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣa iti kiṃ mudhā bhāvisaṃjñāśrayaṇakhedeneti bhinnavākyatayā niyamapakṣa evāśrito vṛttikāreṇa|
yadyevam, vikaraṇavyavadhāne niyamāprasaṅgaḥ, liṅ‌liṭ‌śnamślulukṣu vacanānubandhayorarthattvād | iha hi vikaraṇānāmavakāśaḥ- alādeśāścānaśādayaḥ;niyamasyāvakāśaḥ,yatra vikaraṇā na santi-sparddhiṣīṣṭa, pasparddhe, āste, śete, ararti,juhoti, bhinatti, bhūyadityādi;edhate, kurute, niviśate ityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvādvikaraṇeṣu kṛteṣu tairvyavadhānānniyamo na syād| asati niyame, yadi tāvat prakṛtiniyamo'nudāttaṅidādibhya ātmanepadameva, śeṣāddhātoḥ parasmaipadameveti,tato'smin viṣaye ubhayaprasaṅgaḥ;pratyayaniyame'pi tulyajātīyasya niyamena vyāvṛttiriti dhātoranantarasya lasya yadyātmanepadaparasmaipade bhavataḥ, anudāttaṅiccheṣānantaramevetyevaṃ niyamo vijñāyamāno dhātvantarādeva vyāvartayediti vikaraṇavyavadhāne niyamāpravṛttāvubhayaprasaṅga eva| ekavākyatayā vidhāne tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, vihiteṣu lādeśeṣu sārvadhātukāpekṣairvikaraṇairbhāvyam, vidhānaṃ cānena prakaraṇena saheti netaḥ prāgvikaraṇasambhavaḥ| syādayo lāvasthāyāṃ vidhīyamānā api lakāraviśeṣāpekṣatvadvahiraṅgā iti lamātrāpekṣeṣvantaraṅgeṣvādeśeṣu kṛteṣveva bhaviṣyantīti na tatrāpi doṣaḥ| jñāpakāt siddham, yadayaṃ `vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ'iti sye vikalpaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-vikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyāniti| etenaitadapi nirastam-caṅaṅ‌bhyāmātmanepadaprasaṅga iti, katham?pūrvaniyame pravṛtte paścāt caṅaṅau bhavata iti|
pratyekamicchabdasyānvaya ityāha-anudātteta iti| ye dhātavo ṅitaśceti| samudāyasambandhe tu cakṣiṅa eva syāt;sa hyanudāttena paṭhyate, vicakṣaṇa ityatra yujyathā syād| ñakārastvanudāttetvanibandhanasyātmanepadasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ, tena `evāyaṃ nāgaḥ sahati kalabhebhyaḥ paribhavam',`na sahāmi sāhasamasāhasiki'ityādi siddham|
dhātava ityetat kuto labhyate? kecidhuḥ-`bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' ityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, tacca `anudāttaṅitaḥ' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt pañcamyā vipariṇamyate, ata eva caṅaṅbhyāmātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti| yaṅantādapi tarhi na prāpnoti bebhidyata iti, yaṅeva hyatra ṅid, na tadanto dhātuḥ, avayave cācaritārthaṃ liṅagaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, tasmadiha dhātoriti nānuvartyam| prāyovṛttā tu vṛttau dhatava ityuktam| caṅaṅostu parihāra ukta eva| yadyayaṃ prakṛtiniyamaḥ syād anudāttaṅita ātmanepadameveti, tṛjādayo na syuḥ?vacanād bhaviṣyanti| asti vacanasyāvakāśa:-parasmaipadina:,tatrāpi niyama:-śeṣāt parasmaipadameveti, tena vacanād bhaviṣyanti| tulyajātīyasya ca niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ, kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? ātmanepadasya parasmaipadam, tasya ca tat| evamapi `śeṣāt kartari'iti śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ prakṛtiniyamapakṣe, katham? prakṛtayo niyatāḥ, ātmanepadaṃ parasmaipadaṃ cāniyatam, tato vakṣyāmi-parasmaipadamiti, tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-yatra parasmaipadaṃ cānyacca prāpnoti tatra parasmaipadameveti| pratyayaniyamastu nāntareṇa śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śakyo vijñātumiti śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya sa evābhipreta ityāha-tebhya ātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nānyebhya iti | yadi pratyayaniyamo'yam? `śeṣāt karttari parasmaipadam' ityatra yadi tāvadevaṃ niyama:-kartari yadi bhavati śeṣadeveti, tato'śeṣat kartari mā bhūd, bhāvakarmaṇostu śeṣācca parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti| atha śeṣādyadi bhavati kartaryeveti? tataḥ śeṣād bhāvakarmaṇormā bhūd, aśeṣāttu bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣvapi prāpnoti| na caikasminvākye niyamadvayaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum-śeṣādeva bhavati, tatrāpi karttaryeveti | evaṃ tarhi yogavibhāgena niyamadvayaṃ tatraiva sādhayiṣyāmaḥ| āsta ityādi| `āsa upaveśane' ,`vasa ācchādane',`ṣūṅ prāṇiprasave',śīṅsvapneadādayaḥ| `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ'||
padamañjarī
bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| 1.3.13 ||
bhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ, ṇyantād bhavateḥ karmaṇi ghañ| dhātvarthaḥ kriyātmaka ucyate, karma tu pāribhāṣikam| dhañādividhau tu `bhāva' iti śuddhād bhavaterbhāve ghañ| bhāva:-sattā,dhātvarthasya siddhatāvasthocyate| ayamapi niyama iti darśayitumanyataḥ siddhimāha-laḥ karmaṇi cetyādi | kathaṃ punarayaṃ niyamaḥ, yāvatā `anudāttaṅita evātmanepadm'iti pūrveṇa niyamena yathā śeṣāt karttaryātmanepadaṃ vyāvarttitam, evaṃ bhāvakarmaṇorapīti tadviṣaye vidhyarthamidaṃ yuktam?satyam;yadi pūrvasūtre pravṛtti:,viparyayo'pi śakyate vaktum-bhāvakarmaṇorevātmanepadamiti, asminniyame pravṛtte `anudāttaṅitaḥ'karttaryātmanepadamaprāptamiti pūrvasūtramapi vidhyarthamiti| tena dvayorapi lasya tibādaya ityetadapekṣayā niyamārthatvam, parasparāpekṣayā tu vidhyarthatvamevamāpādaparisamāpterdravyam| ata evasyānyathāsiddhaṃ darśayatāpyevaśabdo na prayuktaḥ| tibādisūtreṇa dhātusāmānyavihitaṃ ca lakāramāśritya tibādayo vihitāstatraibhya eva dhātubhya iti pūrve niyamaḥ, ayaṃ tvetayore vārthayoriti| nanu cātrārthaniyama eva granthe pratīyate, ayaṃ tvatrārtha:-`laḥ karmaṇi ca'iti bhāvakarmaṇoryo vihito lakāto lakārastasya sāmānyena tibādayaḥ sarve vakṣyante, na tvātmanepadameva, atastadeva yathā syādityamārambha iti| pratyayaniyame tu bhāvakarmakartṛṣvapi vihitasya lasya sāmānyena taṅ vakṣyata iti vācyaṃ syāt, satyam;ayaṃ tvatrārtha:-`bhāvakarmaṇoḥ'ityupalakṣaṇam, bhāvakarmakartṛṣvityarthaḥ, tibādaya iti sūtre tipaḥ prathamanirdeśādevamuktam| tibādiṣvantarbhūtāstaṅa ityarthaḥ, taṅānāviti yāvat | kiṃ punaḥ syād yadyayamarthaniyam syād? iha ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ, ko bhavatā dāyo datta iti karmaṇi ghañ na syād| `akarttari ca' ityasya tvapādānādiravakāśaḥ yadyapi tulyajātīyasya parasmaipadasya niyamena vyāvṛttiriti parihāro'sti;tathāpi pūrvasūtre tāvat pratyayaniyama itīhāpi sa evāśritaḥ| glāyata iti| `glai mlai harṣakṣaye'| supyata iti | `ñiṣvap śaye', `vacisvapi ityādinā saṃprasāraṇam| kriyata iti| `riṅ śayagliṅkṣu'yadā `karmavatkarmaṇā'ityayaṃ śāstrātideśoḥ vyapadeśātideśo vā, tadā śāstravyapadeśayoratidiṣṭayoḥ svena śāstreṇa tattatkaryaṃ bhavati tatra karmaṇyātmanepadamityasyāvakāśaḥ śuddhaṃ karma, karttari parasmaipadamityasya śuddhaḥ kartā,karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvātparasmaipadaṃ prāpneti, ata āha-kamakartarītyādi| dvitīyaṃ kartṛgrahaṇamanuvarttata iti| `karttari karmavyatīhāre'ityataḥ kāryātideśapakṣe tvātmanepadameva | paramiti | nāyaṃ parihāro vācyaḥ||
padasañjarī
karttari karmavyatīhāre|| 1.3.14 ||
atra laukikaṃ karma gṛhyate, na pāribhāṣikamityāha-karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācīti| nanu kṛtrimatvātpāribhāṣikasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ tato devadattasya dhānyaṃ vyatilunantītyatraiva syāt, evaṃ manyate-iha `karttari vyatīhāre'itīyatā siddhaṃ, karaṇādivyatīhāre kasmānna bhavati, ucyate;kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvāt prādhānyaṃ kriyayāptumiṣṭatamatvāttādarthyete;tadyadi sādhanaṃ karma gṛhyeta, tadā kriyāyā api saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvāt kṛtrimakarmatvamiti punarubhayorapi grahaṇāt karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| kiṃ cātmanepadenākṣipto'nuvṛtto vā dhātuḥ karmavyatihāreṇa viśeṣyate-tatra varttamānāddhātoriti, na ca sādhanakarmaṇi dhātorvṛttiḥ sambhavati, tasya kriyāvācitvāditi| vinimayo vyatyāsa ityarthaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭayati-yatreti| yogyatāvaśādasyedaṃ sādhanam, asyeyaṃ kriyā sādhyeti nirjñātayorviparyāsaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvasya sa vyatīhāra iti vivakṣitam| yatretyupakramāttu sa vyatīhārasya viṣayo vivakṣita ityarthaḥ| parasparakaraṇamapi karmavyatīhāra ucyate-saṃpraharante rājānaḥ, vyātyukṣīmabhisaraṇaglahāmadībyanniti| vyatilunata iti | `luñ chedane' `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ'ityadādeśaḥ, `śnābhyastayoḥ'ityākāralopaḥ, `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ'| anyonyayogyamanyonyaviṣaye vā lavanaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ | evaṃrūpaścārtho'nekakartṛkatve sati pratīyata ityekavacanaṃ na bhavatīti kecidāhuḥ| vyatyase, vyatihe ityekavacanamapi tatra tatrodāhariṣyate| `anyo vyatiste tu mamāpi dharmaḥ' iti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ|
karmavyatīhāra iti kimiti | kartṛgrahaṇameva vyatilunata ityādau prāpakatvenopayokṣyata iti bhāvaḥ|
atha kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? bhāvakarmanivṛttyarthaṃ na vā pūrveṇa bhāvād| bhāvakarmaṇorhi pūrveṇātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva--vyatilūyate vyatipūyat iti, tena yathā syād, anena mā mūt, kaḥ punaratra viśeṣaḥ ? tena vā syādanena vā ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ-anena sati `na gatihisārthebhyaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti--vyatigamyate grāmaḥ, vyatihanyante dasyava iti| na vānantarasya pratiṣedhād vyatihanyata ityatra dve prāptī--`bhāvakarmaṇoḥ'iti ca | tathā `anantarasya vidhirbhavati pratiṣedho vā'iti anantarā karmavyatīhāralakṣaṇa prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate, pūrvā tu bhaviṣyati, nārthaṃ etena kartṛgrahaṇenatyata āha--kartṛgrahaṇamiti| `śeṣātkartari'iti pradarśanametad | `āṅo do'nāsyavirahaṇo'ityādāvapyasyopayogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ||
padamañjarī
na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ|| 1.3.15 ||
vyatigacchantītyādi| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau'`tṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām' `hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ',gameḥ `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ'`che ca'iti tuk, sṛperladhūpadhaguṇaḥ, hantergamahanetyupadhālopaḥ, `ho hanteḥ'iti kutvam|
hasādīnāmiti| hasiprakārāṇaṃ śabdakriyāṇāmityarthaḥ|
upasaṃkhyānamiti| saṃkhyāyate-saṃkṣipya pratipādyate'nenārtha iti saṃkhyānam-sūtram, tasyopoccāritamupasaṃkhyānaṃ sūtram, samīpa idamapi sūtraṃ paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ| haraterapratiṣegha iti| arthagrahaṇasāmarthyāhyo śabdāntaranirapekṣāgatihisayorvartante ta iha gṛhyanta iti upasargavaśena hisārthatvāddharaterapratiṣedha ityāhuḥ| iha tu `tataḥ saṃprahariṣyan‌tau ddaṣṭvā karṇadhanañjayau'iti yotsyamānāviti vivakṣitam, na vyatīhāraḥ| iha ca saṃvyavaharante gargairiti vaheragatyarthatvādapratiṣedhaḥ, deśāntaraprāpaṇaṃ hi vaherarthaṃḥ- bhāraṃ vahatīti;nāntarīyakastu gatipratyayaḥ kanyāprāpaṇamukhena gargaiḥ sambadhyanta ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca|| 1.3.16 ||
upoccāritaṃ padamupadam, na pāribhāṣikam;asamvād| asatyupapadagrahaṇe pañcamītirdeśe parasyaivānantarasya syāt; `tasmādityuttarasya'iti vacanāt| saptamīnirdeśe tu `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya'iti pūrvasyaivānantarasya syāt| tatra yadyapi lakāro'nantaraḥ paro na sambhavati, dhātustu sambhavati;pūrvastu dhāturanantaro na sambhavati, lakārastu saṃbhavati| tṛtīyānirdeśastu pañcamīsādhāraṇatvādanadhyavasāna ityupapadagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| itaretarasyatyādi| laukike tu śabdavyavahāre lāghavaṃ pratyunādarād itaretarādiśabdastaṅ upasargāśca karmavyatīhāradyotanāya samuccīyante | karmavyatīhāre `sarvanāmno dve bhavatassamāsavacca bahulam'yadā na samāsavat prathamaikavacanaṃ tadā pūrvapadasyeti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntasyetaraśabdasya dvirvacane samāsavadbhāvena subluki samāsatvādeva prātipadikatvāt punaḥ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam| anyaśabdasya tu bahulagrahaṇādasamāsavad‌bhāve pūrvapadasthasya ṣaṣṭhyekavacanasya prathamaikavacanam| evaṃ parasparasyetyatrāpi sūtravākyayoḥ prakṛtibhāgamātrasyānukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam||
padamañjarī
nerviśaḥ|| 1.3.17 ||
śeṣātkarttari parasmaipade prāpte iti| anārambhasyāpi śeṣapakṣe nikṣepāt| ātmanepadaṃ vidhīyata iti| yadyapi tibādisūtrāpekṣayā sarvasyaiva prakaraṇasya niyamārthatvam, `anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam'`bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti sūtradvayāyekṣayā tu vidhyarthatvamapi sambhavatīti matvaivamuktam| evaṃ sarvatra draṣṭavyam|
nyaviśatetyatra laṅi niviś l iti sthite lādeśo lakāramātrāpekṣatvād antaraṅgaḥ, aḍāgamastu luṅādiviśeṣāpekṣatvādvahiraṅga iti pūrvaṃ lādeśe vikaraṇaśca prāpnoti aḍāgamaśca, nityatvādvikaraṇaḥ| aḍāgamo hi vikaraṇe kṛte tadantameva laṅi parato'ṅgam tadādigrahaṇasya syādinumarthatvāditi tasyaiva prāpnoti, akṛte vikaraṇe dhātumātrasyoti śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ;tataśca vikaraṇāntasya vidhīyamāno'ḍāgamo dhātumātraṃ pratyabhakta iti neśca dhātośca vyavadhāyaka ityātmanepadaṃ na prāpnotītyata āha-yadāgamā ityadi| evaṃ manyate-bāhyopasargasambandhāpekṣatvādayaṃ vidhirbahiraṅgaḥ, asmiṃścāpravṛtte lādeśo'pyapravṛtta eva, apavādaviṣayaparihāreṇa hi tena pravartitavayam| anirvṛttaśca lādeśo vikaraṇotpattau na nimittam, tena lāvasthāyāmevāḍ bhavan dhātumātrasyaiva bhavati, tataśca tadavayavatvānna tasyaiva vayavadhāyaka iti | kathaṃ tarhyuktam--vyavadhāne'pi bhavatīti? śrutimātrāpekṣayā| kvacittu-aṭā nāsti vyavadhānamityeva pāṭhaḥ| madhuni viśantīti aṅgabhakto num ṅeranavayava iti niśabdasyānarthakyam| kvacittu madhūni niviśanti bhramarā iti śasantaṃ paṭhyate||
padamañjarī
parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ|| 1.3.18 ||
paryādaya upasargā gṛhyanta iti kathaṃ `kriyaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī, usargaireva paryādibhirarthadvārako viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhaḥ, na ca kriyo ce upasargāstebhyaḥ paraṃ dhātvantaraṃ sambhavatīti krīṇāterevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| yadvā--paryādiviśeṣaṇāya ṣaṣṭhīmanubhūyātmanepadasambandhe `kriyaḥ'iti pañcamī sampadyate, tadāha--ityetebhya utarasmāt krīṇāteriti|
bahuvīti| bahavo vayaḥ pakṣiṇo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, karmapadaṃ caitat, pakṣivācino viśabdasya napuṃsakatvābhāvād vibhaktyāsya vyavadhānātkevalo nodāhṛtaḥ| nanu bahuvrīhāvapi jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau verānarthakyam, ajahastvārthāyāmapi tadarthasyopasarjanatvamiti na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā| ida tatrodāharaṇam-ve krīṇāsi, atraikadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātprasaṅgaḥ, vī krīṇītaḥ- atraikādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavad‌bhāvātprasaṅgaḥ||
padamañjarī
viparābhyāṃ jeḥ|| 1.3.19 ||
sāhacaryāditi| dvayorddaṣṭāpacāratve'pi parasparasāhacaryādityarthaḥ| `nerviśaḥ' ityādiprakaraṇasāhacaryādvā | bahuvīti| atrāpi ve jayasi, vī jayata ityudāhāryam| parā utkṛṣṭā| atha kathaṃ jeriti nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti `aci śnudhātu' ityādineyaṅādeśena bhavitavyam, na ca dīrgheṣu sāvakāśamiyaṅaṃ paratvād `gherṅati' iti guṇo bādhata iti yuktam;hṛsveṣvapi pūrvavipratiṣedhena iyaṅa iṣṭatvāt. tathā ca `kṣiyaḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ? ucyate; dhātutvaṃ tāvadarthāśrayam--kriyāvacano dhāturiti, iha vā vivakṣitārthaṃ rūpamātramanukṛtamiti| anukāryasyāpi dhātutvaṃ nāsti prāgevānukaraṇasya||
padamañjarī
āṅo do'nāsyaviharaṇe|| 1.3.20 ||
yathaivāvatsā dhenurānīyatāmityukte sambhavadvatsasambandhā godhenurevānoyate, na mahiṣyādidhenuḥ, tathehāpi sambhavadāsyaviharaṇasya `ḍudāñ dāne' ityasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti sarveṣāṃ dārūpāṇāmityāha-āṅpūrvāddāña iti|| ādatta iti | ślau dvirvacanam, pūrvavadākāralopaḥ, dakārasya cartvam| kvacid-āṅo ṅidriśiṣṭasya kim ? bhikkṣāmādadātīti paṭhyate, tatra smṛtāvākāraḥ|
āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapīti| kathamiha `āṅo do'nāsye'itīyatā siddhaṃ dravye dhātorvṛttyasambhavādāsyasamavāyinyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vartamānasya samudāyasya niṣedho vijñāyate, nacaivaṃ svaṃ mukhamādatta ityatrāpi mukhaviṣayatvādānasya pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, grāhyāsya eva samavetā kriyā, tasyāṃ vartamāno dadātirāsye vṛttirbhavati, grahaṇantu grāhyahiṇorubhayorapi samavetam| anāsya iti paryudāsaḥ, āsyānāsyasamudāyaścāsyādanya iti vidhireva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ siddhe viharaṇagrahaṇaṃ viharaṇaviśeṣopalakṣārtham, tenāsatyapyāsye tāddaśe viharaṇe bhaviṣyati yāddaśamāsyaviharaṇam āsyavyādānam| vipādiketi | pādasphoṭaḥ-vipādikā|
svāṅgakarmakācceti| svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgam na tu pāribhāṣikamadravādilakṣaṇam| etacca nyāyasiddhamevoktam, katham ? kartarīti vartate, āsyaśabdaścāyaṃ sambandhiśabdaḥ, kasyāsyamityapekṣāyāṃ yasmin kartaryātmanepadaṃ tasya cettadāsyamiti vijñāte tena parakīyāsyaviharaṇe vidhireva bhavati||
padamañjarī
krīḍo'nusaṃparibhyaśca || 1.3.21 ||
māṇavakamanukrīḍatīti| māṇavakena saha krīḍatītyarthaḥ| `tṛtīyārtha' ityanuḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakaḥ| āgameriti ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇam| āgamayasva tāvaditi| sahasva kañcitkālaṃ mā tvariṣṭhā ityarthaḥ|
śikṣeriti| `śikṣa vidyopādāne' ityasyānudattettvādeva siddhamiti śakeḥ sannantasya grahaṇam| śikṣata iti| `sani mīmāghu' ityaca is, `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' dhanurviṣaye jñāne śaktau bhavitumicchatītyarthaḥ| kriyāviṣayo hi śakeḥ prayogaḥ- bhoktuṃ śaknoti, gantuṃ śaknotīti| tadiha jñānaṃ viṣayaḥ, ātmanepadenaiva jñānaviṣayatvasya gamitatvājjñānamiti na prayujyate|
āśiṣi nātha iti| `nāthṛ nādhṛ yācñopatāpaiśvaryāśīḥṣu' anudāttet| niyamārthatu vacanam-āśiṣyeva yathā syād yāñcādiṣu mā bhūditi| anudāttettvaṃ yujartham| sarpiṣo nātha iti | `āśiṣi nāthaḥ' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī sarpirme bhūyādityāśāsta ityarthaḥ| harateriti| gatiḥ prakāraḥ| paitṛkamiti| piturāgataṃ prakāraṃ satataṃ śīlayantītyarthaḥ `ṛtaṣṭhañ'| pratyudāharaṇe sāddaśyamātraṃ vikṣitam, na prakāratācchīlyam|
kirateriti| vikṣepārthaḥ kiratiḥ| harṣādayastu viṣayatvenopattāḥ | tatra harṣo vikṣepasya kāraṇam| jīvikākulāyakaraṇe tu phalam| eteṣvartheṣu apāccatuṣpāt iti susuḍvidhīyate| āpṛcchata iti| `praccha jñīpsāyām' tudādiḥ, grahītyādinā samprasāraṇam| vācā śarīsparśanamiti | `tvatpādau spṛśāmi, naitanmayā kṛtam' ityevaṃrūpaḥ śapathaviśeṣaḥ| devadattāyeti| `ślāghahnuṅsthāśapām' iti sampradānasaṃjñā ||
padamañjarī
samavapravibhyaḥ syaḥ|| 1.3.22 ||
santiṣṭhata iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| atrāpyupasargagrahaṇādiha na bhavati-ve tiṣṭhasi, vī tiṣṭhata iti|
astiṃ sakāramiti| "staḥ santītyādau sakāramātrasya darśanāt `sa bhuvi' ityave dhātuḥ pāṭhyaḥ, astītyādau piti sārvadhātuke aḍāgamo vidheyaḥ, āstām āsannityādau āḍāgamaḥ syāt" iti āpiśalā manyante | guṇasya tvāgamatve udāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam||
padamañjarī
prakāśanastheyākhyayośca|| 1.3.23 ||
svābhiprāyakathanamiti| kathanamāviṣkaraṇamātraṃ na tu śabdenaiva, tenābhāṣamāṇāyāmapi kanyakāyāṃ bhavati| tiṣṭhatyasminniti| prakaraṇādinātra vivādapadanirṇetuḥ pratītiḥ, na tu śābdīti vigrahavākye ātmanepadaṃ na kṛtam| saṃśayya karṇādiṣviti| saṃśayasthāneṣu karṇādīn nirṇetṛtvenāśrayatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
udo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi|| 1.3.24 ||
karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācīti| sādhanakarmaṇi dhātorvṛttyasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| uda īhāyāmiti | īhā-parispandaḥ| īhāgrahaṇamityādi| īhātmakaṃ yadanūrdhvakarma ityevamanūrdhvakarmaṇa eva viśeṣaṇamīhāgrahaṇam, na punaranūrdhvakarmagrahaṇamapanīya īhāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityucyate ityarthaḥ| tathā hi satyāsanāduttiṣṭhatītyatrāpi syāt, parispandarūpatvādutthānasyeti bhāvaḥ| uda īhāyāmityetatkarmagrahaṇāt siddhamityāhuḥ| katham? `īhā'nūrdhva' ityetāvatā'nūrdhvatāviśiṣṭaṃ kriyāvācitvaṃ siddham, dhātoḥ kriyāvācitvāt| evaṃ siddhe karmagrahaṇāllokaprasiddhaṃ parispandātmakaṃ karma gṛhyata iti||
padamañjarī
upānmantrakaraṇe|| 1.3.25 ||
pāribhāṣikamatra karaṇaṃ gṛhyate, mantraḥ karaṇaṃ yasyārthasya tasminvarttamānādityarthaḥ|
upādityādi| amantrakaraṇārthamidam| saṅgatakaraṇamupaśleṣa iti| vināpi maitrīsambandhāt| stru ghnamupatiṣṭhate iti| prāpnotityarthaḥ|
bhikṣuka iti| lipsayā hetubhūtayā brahmaṇakulamupagacchatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
akarmakācca|| 1.3.26 ||
atrāsambhavāt kriyā karma na gṛhyate, na hyāsti sambhavaḥ-dhātuśca bhavatyakriyāvacanaśceti|| nanu ca sādhanakarmaṇāmyakarmakatvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam, na hi śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ karmaṇā yogaviyogau sambhavataḥ, sādhanayogasya kriyādharmatvādata āha-akarmakakriyāvacanāditi| etenādvārakametad dhātorviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| yāvad‌bhuktamiti| yathārthe yadavyayamiti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| saptamyantaṃ caitat| saṃnidhīyata ityartha iti| bhāve lakāraḥ| arthatovyākhyānaṃ caitat-yo hyupatiṣṭhate sa saṃnidhatte, yaśca saṃnidhatte tena saṃnidhīyate|
akamakāditi kimiti| pūrvasūtre `upāt' iti yogavibhāgādiṣṭasya siddhaṃpaśyati| na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, `mantrakaraṇe' ityasya niyamārthatvāt-sakarmakādyadi bhavati mantrakaraṇa eveti| rājānamupatiṣṭhatīti| viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syāt‌-karaṇe yadi bhavati mantrakaraṇa eveti, tataścātra syādeveti bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
udvibhyāṃ tapaḥ|| 1.3.27 ||
uttapati suvarṇamityatra santāpane vilāpane vā tapirvartata iti sakarmakatvam|
svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| yasminkartaryātmanepadaṃ tasya cet svamaṅgamityarthaḥ| yadyanvarthagrahaṇam? tato'prāṇinyapi karttari yasya yadaṅgaṃ tatkarmakādapi prasaṅgaḥ| pāribhāṣike tveṣa doṣo na bhavati; tasya prāṇisthatvāt| anvarthe'pi na doṣaḥ, tapeḥ prāṇikartṛkatvāt| pāribhāṣikasya tvasambandhiśabdatvāt kartuścetsvamaṅgamityevaṃ na pratīyeteti bhāvaḥ||

āṅo yamahanaḥ|| 1.3.28 ||
āhateti|`anudāttopadeśa'ityanunāsikalopaḥ| āghnata iti| pūrvavadādeśopadhālopau kutvaṃ ca | āhanti śiraḥ parakīyamiti| `ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ' ityatra tu gāṇḍīvī viṣamavilocanasya vakṣa etya svaṃ vakṣo hatavānityarthaḥ | mallo'pyutsāhavardhanāya svaṃ vakṣa etya evaṃ vakṣo hatavānityarthaḥ| mallo'pyutsāhavardhanāya svaṃ vakṣa āspālayati||
padamañjarī
samo gamyṛcchipracchisvaratyartiśruvidibhyaḥ|| 1.3.29 ||
`samo gamyacchibhyām' ityetāvatsūtram| pracchyādayastu vārttikaddaṣṭāḥ sūtrarūpeṇa paṭhitāḥ, sūtrakāravadvārttikakāro'pi śāstrasya kartā, na vyākhyāteti darśayitum| tatra hīti| uttarārthamanuvartamānamapi yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt tatra na sambadhyata ityarthaḥ|
na lābhārthasyeti| sattāvicāraṇārthayostvanudāttettvādātmanepadena bhāvyameveti bhāvaḥ| ddaśeścetyādi| idaṃ vaktavyarūpeṇaiva paṭhitam| vicitrā hi vṛtteḥ kṛtiḥ vṛttikāreṇa| athāsminnakarmakādhikāre ye sakarmakā hanigamiprabhṛtayaḥ, teṣāṃ kathamakarmakatvam? ucyate--
dhātorarthāntare vṛtterdhātvarthenopasaṃgrahāt|
prasidveravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā||
vahati bhāramiti-prāpaṇe sakarmako vahiḥ, syandane tvakarmakaḥ| vahanti nadya iti--prāpaṇe sakarmako vahiḥ, syandane tvakarmakaḥ| vahanti nadya iti--prāṇaviśiṣṭaṃ dhāraṇaṃ jīvatirāha,tatra prāṇānāṃ dhātunaivopāttatvānna tena karmaṇā sakarmakatvam, na ca prāṇakarmake dhāraṇe'nyasya karmatvamiti jīvatirakarmakaḥ| prasiddheryathā--varṣatītyanupātte karmāntare niyamena jalaṃ pratīyata iti na tena sakarmakatvam, tena `vṛṣṭe deve' iti kartari kto bhavati| vyabhacāriṇā tu rudhirādinā sakarmaka evaḥ rudhiraṃ varṣati, śarānvarṣatīti | karmavivakṣāyāṃ tatkarmikaiva kriyā pratiṣiddhā syād, na pākamātramityavivakṣā karmaṇaḥ||
padamañjarī
nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ|| 1.3.30 ||
nihvayate iti| kathaṃ punaratrātmanepadam, yāvatā `hvā' ityākārāntādiyaṃ pañcami, ekārāntaścāyam, na ca vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ saṃgṛhṇāti? satyam; ākārāntātpañcamī, na tvidaṃ prayogasthasyākārāntasyānukaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? dhātupāṭhe'vasthitaikārāntasya tasyaiva lakṣaṇavaśādātvam| na cātukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgaḥ; śāstravāsanayā tasyaiva pratīteḥ, yathā--`yasyeti ca' itīkārākārayoḥ||

sparddhāyāmāṅaḥ|| 1.3.31 ||

padamañjarī
gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ|| 1.3.32 ||
apakāraprayuktamiti apakāreṇa prayuktamanena me'pakṛtamityetayā buddhyā kṛtamityarthaḥ| atha vā--kathaṃ mayā'pakṛtaṃ syāditi buddhyā pravartitamityarthaḥ| hisātmakamiti| sūcitasya vadhabandhanādikā hiṃsā, iha tu tatkaraṇatvātsūcanameva hiṃsā svabhāvamityuktam| kathaṃ punarjñāyate gandhanaṃ hiṃsātmakamityata āha-- tathā hīti| curādāviti| svabhāvānuvādaḥ| sāhasikyamiti| sahasā vartate sāhasikaḥ `ojaḥsahombhasā vartate' iti ṭhak, tasya karmaṇi ṣyañ | vartikā-śakuniviśeṣaḥ| edhodakasyeti| samāhāradvandvaḥ| `kṛñaḥ pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī| upaskuruta iti| `upātpratiyatna' ityādinā suṭ||
padamañjarī
adheḥ prasahane|| 1.3.33 ||
prasāhanamabhibhava iti| `sā sāhayā yudhā nṛbhiḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ' ityādau darśanāt| kecittu `ṣaha marṣaṇe'bhibhave chandasi' iti paṭhanti, tatra `chandasi' iti prāyikaṃ draṣṭavyam| aparājayo veti| parājetuṃ samarthasyaiva kṣamayā yastadabhāvaḥ sa ityarthaḥ| tathā ca bhāraviḥ- `bhavāddaśāścedadhikurvate parān' iti, bhavāddaśāścetparānadhikurvate- kṣamayā na parājayante, kṣamanta ityarthaḥ, tadahana vā tena parājita ityartha iti| tenātmanepadavācyena kartrā tamityedvācyaḥ karmabhūto na parājita ityarthaḥ| pṛthagyogakaraṇamityādi| prakathanopayogaprasahaneṣu `adheḥ' ityucyamāne gandhanādiṣvapi adhipūrvādeva syāt| atha tatrādhigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, prasahane'pyadhyabhāve'pi prasaṅgaḥ;ata utsargeṇa prasahanaṃ viśeṣayisyāmīti prasahane vā utsargaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmīti yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ|| 1.3.34 ||
`udo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi' ityādivat karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī mā vijñāyītyāha-- karmaśabda ityādi| vipūrvasya karoteḥ śabdakriyāyāṃ vṛttyasambhavāt, kṛtrimasambhave laukikasya grahaṇāyogācca| kiṃca `veḥ śabdaḥ' ityeva vaktavyam, karmagrahaṇamanarthakam, vikareti paya iti sakarmakatvād uttareṇāpi na bhavati||
padamañjarī
akarmakācca|| 1.3.35 ||
odanasya pūrṇā iti| suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, jñāpanāt, yadayaṃ pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtheti suhitārthayoge yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyata ityāha, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ- bhavati suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhīti| akarmakāditi kimiti| pūrvasūtre veriti yogavibhāgeneṣṭasiddhiṃ manyate, na caivamatiprasaṅgaḥ, śabdakarmaṇa ityasya niyamārthatvāt--karmaṇi yadi bhavati śabda eveti, kaṭaṃ vikarotīti| viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta-śabde yadi bhavati karmaṇyeveti, tataścātrāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
sammānanotsañjānācāryakaraṇajñānamṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ|| 1.3.36 ||
sammānanādiṣuviśeṣaṇeṣu satsviti| yuktaṃ sammānanācāryakaraṇavetanānāṃ viśeṣaṇatvam, tatra hi prāpaṇameva dhātvarthaḥ, sammānanādīni tu tameva viṣayatayā vyavacchindanti| utsañjanādīnāṃ tvayuktam; teṣāmeva dhātvarthatvāt, tadvyatiriktasya viśeṣyasyāsambhavāt, ucyate; sammānanāderutsañjanādeśca viśeṣaṇatvaṃ samānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇam, uttarastu dhātuviśeṣaṇamiti viśeṣyamātraṃ bhidyate, ataḥ suṣṭhūktam--sammānanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣviti| cārvi buddhiriti| cāruśabdāt `voto guṇavacanāt'iti ṅīṣ| ācāryo'pi cārvīti | yathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti puruṣeṣvajahatsvaliṅga eva yaṣṭiśabdaḥ, tadvaccārvīśabdaḥ| te yuktibhirityādi| pūrvasmin vākye guṇabhāvenāpi prakṛte| te śiṣyāḥ yuktibhiḥ pratipādyamānāḥ, niṣpādyamānā ityarthaḥ| sthāpyamānā iti tu vyākhyāne padārthānāmacetanatvāt na mukhyaṃ sammānanam|
utkṣipatītyartha iti| tenotsañjanaṃ nayaterartha iti darśayati|
ācāryakaraṇamācāryakriyeti| sūtravṛttau ca kāraṇāvasthāyā vivakṣitatvāt cviḥ prāpto'pi vikalpādhikārānna kṛtaḥ| tathā cācāryīkurvanniti cviḥ prayuktaḥ| nanupanayanaṃ māṇavakasya saṃskāraḥ, yenāsāvadhyayane yogyo bhavati, na tvanenācārye kaścidatiśayo janyate; ācāryaśabdasya tu pravṛttinimittamupanīyādhyāpanaṃ nāma kriyāviśeṣaḥ, yathopādhyāyaśabdasyaikadeśādhyāpanaṃ tatkathamācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate ityata āha--māṇavakamīddaśenetyādi | evaṃ manyate--upaniyādhyāpanenāddaṣṭarūpaḥ kaścidatiśaya ācārye janyate, tadeva pravṛttinimittamācāryaśabdasyeti tadāha--svayamācāryaḥ sampadyate iti | `ātmānamācāryīkurvan' iti ca hetulakṣaṇe laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ| īddaśeneti | yāddaśaḥ śāstrokto vidhistāddaśenetyarthaḥ| nanu yadyācāryakamupanayanasya prayojanaṃ tatkartrabhiprāyamiti nārtha ācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadavidhānena? ucyate; nopanayanenācāryakaṃ janyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatpūrvakeṇādhyayanena| upanayanakriyāyāstu māṇavakasaṃskāraḥ sākṣātphalam| evaṃ saṃskṛtasya māṇavakasya yadadhyāpanaṃ tenācāryakaṃ janyate iti na tadupanayanāyaḥ kriyāyāḥ phalam| pacca tasyāḥ phalaṃ tanmāṇavakagāmi, na kartṛgāmi|
niścinotītyartha iti | anena jñānaṃ nayaterartha ityāha| kāraṃ vinayate iti| kara eva kāraḥ, prajñādiḥ, rājagrāhyo bhāgaḥ karṣakaiḥ kalpitaḥ||
padamañjarī
kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi|| 1.3.37 ||
nayaterātmanepadavidhānāttatsambandhyeva karttā lakāravācyaḥ pratyāsanno gṛhyata ityāha--nayateḥ kartteti. tadekadeśo'pi śarīramiti| apiśabdo'vadhāraṇe| iha śarīrasyaiva caitanyaviśiṣṭasya kartṛtvaṃ laukikāḥ pratiyanti, na tadvyatiriktasya buddhīndriyādimataścatanasya | na ca śarīramevaśarīrasthaṃ bhavati, atastadekadeśa eva tad‌grahaṇena gṛhyate ityarthaḥ| atra krodhādyapanayanaphalaṃ kartrabhiprāyamiti `svaritañitaḥ'ityeva siddhe niyamārthamidam-- kartṛsthe karmaṇyaśarīrastha eveti | atha katham `vigaṇyya nayanti pauruṣaṃ vijitakrodharayā jigīṣavaḥ' iti? kecidāhuḥ-apagame vartamānādidamātmanepadavidhānaṃ bhavati, atra tu karotyarthe prāptyarthe prāptyarthe vā vartate, anekārthatvāddhātūnāmiti||
padamañjarī
vṛttisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ|| 1.3.38 ||
sarga utsāha iti | `sṛṣṭaśced‌brāhmaṇavadhe', `yenendralokāpajayāya sṛṣṭaḥ'ityādau darśanātsṛjirutsahārthaḥ| vṛttyādiṣviti kim? apakrāmati||
padamañjarī
upaparābhyām|| 1.3.39 ||

padamañjarī
āṅa udramane|| 1.3.40 ||

padamañjarī
veḥ pādaviharaṇe|| 1.3.41 ||
vikrāmatyajinasandhiriti| dvidhā bhavati, sphuṭatītyarthaḥ||

propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām|| 1.3.42 ||
anyo'nyasāhacaryātpropayorupasargayorgrahaṇam, na prātipadikāntakarmapravacanīyayoḥ, nāpi kriyāntarasambandhinoḥ, nāpyanarthakayorityāha-pra upa ityetābhyāmupasargabhyāmiti| tulyārthāviti| etena samo'rtho yayoritisamarthau, śakandhvāditvātpararūpam, saṃśabdasyaiva vā'nekārthatvāttulyārthatvamiti darśayati| nanu `samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ'ityādau sambandhārthatvaṃ prasiddham, satyam; iha tu dhātvartha prati pāratantryānna paraspareṇa sambandhārthatvam | dhātunā copasargayoḥ sambandho'vyabhicārī, tasmātpūrvokta evārthaḥ| prakramate iti | ārabhata ityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
anupasargadvā|| 1.3.43 ||

padamañjarī
apahrave jñaḥ|| 1.3.44 ||
śeṣādityādi| asatyasmin sūtre ayamaviśeṣa eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sopasargāśceti| tena `anupasargāj jñaḥ' ityanena kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale na siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ| upajānīte iti | `jñājanorjā'||
padamañjarī
akarmakācca|| 1.3.45 ||
akartramiprāyārtamidamiti| atha kartrabhiprāye katham, tatrāha-kartrabhiprāyo hīti| nanu sopasargātkartrabhiprāye'pyanenaivātmanepadameṣitavyam--auṣadhasyānujānīte, auṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti; tasmātsarpiṣo jānīte ityudāharaṇābhiprāyametadvetavyam| kathaṃ cāyamakarmaka iti| `sarpiṣaḥ' iti karmaṇi śeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhī, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditivat| tena sarpirādinā jñeyena sakarmaka iti matvā praśnaḥ|
akarmakāditi kimiti| yadi sarpirādi karaṇatvena vivikṣitam, tarhi karaṇāditi vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| evamucyamāne sakarmakādapi syādeveti darśayatisvareṇeti||
padamañjarī
sampratibhyāmanādhyāne|| 1.3.46 ||
utkaṇṭhāsmaraṇam utkaṇṭhāpūrvakaṃ smaraṇam| māturiti| `adhīgarthadayeśām'iti ṣaṣṭhī | nanu `śeṣa' iti tatrānuvarttate, tena karma śeṣatvena vivakṣitavyamiti akarmakatvātpūrveṇātrātmanepadaprasaṅgaḥ| `anādhyāne' ityasya tu mātaraṃ saṃjānātīti vyāvartyaṃ syādyatra karmataiva vivakṣitā, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `anādhyāne'iti vibhajyate, tena pūrvayogasyāpi śeṣo bhaviṣyati||
padamañjarī
bhāsanopasaṃbhāṣājñānayatnavimatyupamantraṇeṣu vadaḥ|| 1.3.47 ||
bhāsanādiṣviti| atrāpi kiñciddhātorviśeṣaṇam, kiñciddhātvarthasya| upasāntvanam - upacchandanam, dhātoḥ, bhāsanādi dhātvarthasya | bhāsamāna iti | hetau laṭaḥ śānajādeśaprayogeṇa bhāsanaṃ hetutvena viśeṣaṇamityāha | śiṣyaiḥ stūyamāno bhāsate| tathā coparyupari śāstrārthasya pratibhāsanāt suṣṭhu vadanaṃ bhavati, tejobhaṅge tu na śaknuyādvaditum| jānāti vaditumiti| `śakavṛṣa' ityādinā tumun, atra vadatyartho jñānasya viṣayaḥ, jñānaṃ viṣayi| tadviṣayamityādi| atra yatnasyāviṣkaraṇarūpasya vadatyarthasya karma|
vimatipatitā iti hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇaṃ prayuñjāno vimatirhetutvena viśeṣaṇamityāha| vimatau hi satyāṃ vicitrabhāṣaṇarūpo vadatyartho nivartate| upacchandayatīti| `bhadre bhajasva mās, idaṃ te dāsyāmi' iti, svābhilaṣite pravartayatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe|| 1.3.48 ||
manuṣyāḥ prasiddhā iti| yadyapi kukkuṭādirutamapisvarūpema vyaktam-asyedaṃ rutamasyedamiti| manuṣyavāktu vyaktatarā bhavati, varṇātmakatvād, arthāvagatihetutvācca, atasta eva gṛhyante| śukaśārikādīnāṃ tu puruṣaprayatnavaśena kvācitkaṃ vyaktavāktvam, na svabhāvikamiti ne teṣāṃ grahaṇam|
varatanu sampravadanti kukkuṭā iti|
apanaya pādasarojamaṅkataḥ, śithilaya bāhulatāṃ galāddatām|
kva ca vadaneṃ'śukamākulīkṛtam,......iti pūrvapādāḥ|
kv‌ cittu kṛtsna eva ślokaḥ paṭhyate, tatra varatanuriti bahuvrīhau yadi hrasvantastanuśabdaḥ, tataḥ `saṃbuddhau ca' iti guṇaprasaṅgaḥ, dīrghānte tu nadīlakṣaṇaḥ kap prāpnoti| kecidāhaḥ-tanuśabdaḥ strījātau kavibhiḥ prayujyate, tasmād `ūṅutaḥ' iti ūṅi kṛte karmadhārayo'yamiti||
padamañjarī
anorakarmakāt|| 1.3.49 ||
vyaktavācāmiti varttata iti| na tu samuccāraṇa iti sarvānuvṛttau vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| tadvyaktavāksambandhino vaderiti sūtrārthamāha--vyaktavāgviṣayādidi| anuḥ sāddaśye iti| tena kalāpasyeti tulyārthayoge śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti bhāvaḥ| yathetyādi| vadanamātrasāddaśye tātparyamiti karma na vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ| anuvadati| punarvadatītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā vipralāpe|| 1.3.50 ||

avād‌ graḥ|| 1.3.51 ||
`gira:' iti pāṭhe dhātvanukaraṇatvād vibhaktāvitvam | `graḥ'iti tu pāṭhe rūpamātrānukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| tasya hyavapūrvasyeti| niyataviṣayāṇyapi kriyāviśeṣaṇāni bhavanti, yathā--uryādayaḥ kṛbhvastibhyo'nyaviṣayā na bhavantīti bhāvaḥ||

pratijñānamabhyupagama iti | kecidāhuḥ-"paropadeśanirapekṣamātmanaiva vipratipannasya pakṣaghya parigraho'bhyupagamaḥ, pareṇa prārthitasyārthasya niyamavacanam `etāvaddāsyāmi' iti, `asminkāle dāsyāmi' ityevaṃrūpaḥ pratiśravaḥ| pareṇa yuktyā sādhitasyārthasya sammānnam--samīcīnamuktamatra bhavatetyevaṃ rūpamaṅgīkaraṇamiti, pratijñāsāmānyāvāntarabhedā ete, na tu paryāyāḥ" iti| vṛttikārastu parasparaviṣayo'ṅgīkaraṇādivyahāradarśanāt paryāyatvameva manyate||

samastṛtīyāyuktāt|| 1.3.54||
vibhaktirgṛ hyate iti | tatraiva tṛtīyāśabdasya mukhyatvāt | yadyevam, tayā saha dhātoḥ sambandho na bhavati; na hi tṛtīyā dhātuvācyā, nāpi dhātustṛtīyānta ityata āha-tayetyādi| tṛtīyārthena dhātvarthasya yogādaupacāriko dhātostṛtīyāyoga ityarthaḥ| yadyapyatreti| na hi ceṣṭārūpasañcaraṇamantarema karaṇaṃ sambhavati, ato'śrute'pi karaṇapade tapasā śrutena veti gamyamānatvāttadarthayogasya sambhavaḥ| tṛtīyā tviti| etadarthameva hi pūrvamuktam--vibhaktirgṛ hyata iti| tṛtīyāyuktāditi vā'narthakaṃ stāt| yadi tadarthayogaḥ syāt, sarvatraivaṃ tadarthabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe|| 1.3.55 ||
vaktavyamevaitaditi| sūtre cecchabdaścaśabdaścārthe, anekārthatvānnipānāmiti| kecid-dāṇastṛtīyāyuktādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, sā ca tṛtīyā caturthyaveditavyācakṣate; evamapi `aśiṣṭavyavahāre' iti vaktavyameva, aśiṣṭānāṃ saṅkīrṇācārāṇāṃ yo vyavahāra ācāraḥ tasminnityarthaḥ| dāsyā samprayacchata iti | yo dāsyā saha bhuñjānastayā dattaṃ svayaṃ ca tasyai dadāti tadviṣayo'yaṃ prayoga ityāhuḥ| kathamātmanepadamiti| na kathañcit, `tasmādityuttarasya' ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti | evaṃ ca pūrvasūtre'pyaśvena samudācarata ityādāvapi bhavitavyam||
padamañjarī
upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe|| 1.3.56 ||
iha svasya sato rūpāntareṇa yatkaraṇaṃ tatsvakaraṇamiti na gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi? yadā'svaṃ svaṃ karoti tadā bhavitavyam, cvipratyayastu vikalpitatvānna bhavati| pāṇigrahaṇaviśiṣṭamiti| pāṇigrahaṇaṃ nāma kaścitkanyāsaṃskārastadviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ| bhāṣye tu-asvasya sataḥ svatvāpādanameva svakaraṇamityuktam| bhaṭṭikāvye'pi tadanuguṇaḥ prayogaḥ- upāyaṃsta mahāstrāṇi, upāyaṃsata nāsatam, nopāyaṃsta daśānana iti| devadatto yajñadattasya bhāryāmupayacchati, yajñadattasambandhinīṃ bhāryāṃ dāsyādirūpeṇa svīkarotītyarthaḥ| pāṇigrahaṇābhāvād vṛttikāramate yuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇ, bhāṣyakāramate tvatrāpi bhavitavyam||
padamañjarī
jñāśrusmṛkaddaśaṃ sanaḥ|| 1.3.57 ||

nānorjñaḥ|| 1.3.58 ||
pūrveṇeti| anantarasūtreṇa yatprāptaṃ tatpratiṣidhyate, kuta etat? `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti| tathā ceti| anantarasya pratiṣedha ityuktam, evaṃ sati sakarmakasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ sampadyate, anantarayogasya sakarmakaviṣayatvād, akarmakāviṣayatvād `akarmakācca' iti prāgeva vihitatvāt| tenākarmakāt `pūrvavatsanaḥ' ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva-auṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti| auṣadhena pravartitumicchatītyarthaḥ||
