pratyāṅ‌bhyā śruvaḥ|| 1.3.59 ||
upasargagrahaṇaṃ cedamiti| parasparasāhacaryāt| devadattaṃ pratīti| `lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūta' ityādinā pratiḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ, nopasargaḥ||
padamañjarī
śadeḥ śitaḥ|| 1.3.60 ||
yadyatra śadeḥ paro yaḥ śit, tata ātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ vyadhikaraṇe pañcamyāvāśritya vyākhyāyeta, tato'pi vikaraṇe satyanena vidhinā bhavitavyam| sārvadhātuke ca parato vidhīyate, tataśca prāgevāsmadvidheḥ sārvadhātukaṃ bhavaccheṣatvatparasmaipadaṃ syāt, tasmiṃśca sati tannimitte śiti vikaraṇe kṛte parasmaipadasya nivṛttirna siddhyet| na hi nirvṛttasya nirvṛttirvacanaśatenāpi śakyate kartumiti-imaṃ vyadhikaraṇapakṣe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā sāmānādhikaraṇye pañcamyāviti darśayannāha-śadiryaḥ śiditi| kathaṃ punaḥ śadiḥ śid‌bhavatī, vikaraṇe hi śakāra id bhavati, tatrāha-śid‌bhāvīti | śidbhāvī yasmāt sa tathoktaḥ| śidbhāvitvād upacāreṇa śadireva śidityuktamityarthaḥ| śito vā sambandhīti | `śitaḥ' ityasya ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ darśayati| kaśca śadiḥ śitaḥ sambandhī? yastasya prakṛtiḥ| prāgeva ca śidutpattiyogyatayā tatprakṛtitvamastyeva | śīyata iti | pāghrādisūtreṇa śīyādeśaḥ||
padamañjarī
mriyaterluṅliṅośca || 1.3.61 ||
luṅliṅoḥ iti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyam, viṣayasaptamī vā| niyamārthamiti| yadi niyamaḥ kriyate, ṅitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'prāpte vidhiravāstu? iha mā hi mṛteti luṅi `tāsyanudāttet' iti ṅillakṣaṇaḥ sārvadhātukanighāto yathā syāt| tiṅnighāto'tra `hi ca' iti pratiṣiddhaḥ||
padamañjarī
pūrvatsanaḥ|| 1.3.62 ||
pūrvavaditi| `tena tulyam' ityādinā tṛtīyacāntādvatiḥ, na pañcamyantāt; lakṣaṇābhāvāt | yathā ca brāhyaṇena tulyaṃ vaiśyādadhīta ityukte brāhmaṇādivad vaiśyādadhīte iti pañcamyartho gamyate, tathehāpi pūrvasmādiva sanantādapyātmanepadamityartho labhyate| `tulyārthaiḥ' iti hi tṛtīyā sarvavibhaktyarthānantarbhāvayati| yadi sanaḥ pūrvo yo dhāturiti| etena `sanaḥ' iti pūrvasyāvadhinirdeśaḥ., na tvātmanepadāpekṣayā parapañcamīti darśayati|
yadyevam, sanantādātmanepadamiti na labhyeta, `sanaḥ' ityasya sakṛcchrutasyāvadhinirdeśenopakṣīṇatvād, ata āha-tadvatsanantādapīti| avadhitvenāpi tāvatsanaḥ śrutatvāt pratyāsatyā tadantādeva vidhirvijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate sanantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, pūrvavaditi śrauto'nvayaḥ, tatra kutaḥ pūrvavadityapekṣāyāṃ sannihitatvātsana eva pūrvavaditi vijñāsyata iti ? evaṃ manyate-evaṃ vijñāyamāne'yameva yogaḥ pūrvasyāvadhiḥ sambhāvyeta, yathā-`pūrvatrāsiddham' ityatra tata eva yogāt pūrvatreti| tataścāyamarthaḥ syād-`anudārttaṅitaḥ' ityārabhyetaḥ pūrvaṃ ye dhātavo nirdiṣṭāstebhyaḥ sanantebhyastadvadevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, tataścottaro vidhiḥ sanantānna syāt-`bhujo'navane',babhukṣata iti,tasmātsanaḥ pūrvavadityeva śrauto'nvaya eṣṭavya iti| yadyayaṃ kāryātideśaḥ śāstrātideśo vā vijñāyeta, tadā sanprakṛtau prayogāntare ddaṣṭamityeva nimittanirapekṣaṃ kāryaṃ śāstraṃ vātidiśyamārnīmahāpyatidiśyeta-śiśatsati, mumurṣati; śīyate, mriyate ityatra ddaṣṭatvāditi mate'nayoḥ pakṣayordoṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā nimittātideśamāśrityāha-yena nimitteneti| nimittasya tulyatvāttad‌dvārakaṃ yadātmanepadāvidhestulyatvaṃ tadāśrīyate ityarthaḥ| pūrvamiti| sanutpatteḥ prāk prayogāntara ityarthaḥ| pūrvasmāditi yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, tathā ca sanantādapīti saṅgacchate| yadyapi prakṛtigataṃ ṅittvādikaṃ sanante dhātau vacanaśatenāpi prāpayitumaśakyam nimittaṃ bhavatītyatideśārthaḥ, tāvatā ca nimittātideśavācoyuktiḥ| āsisiṣata iti | iṭi kṛte `ajāderdvitīyasya' iti siśabdasya dvirvacanam| nivivikṣata iti|`halantācca' iti sanaḥ kittvam, vraścādiṣatvam, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si'| ācikraṃsata iti | āṅa ātmanepadanimittatvāt `snukramoḥ' itīḍ naiva bhavati|
nimittātideśāśrayaṇasya phalamāha-iheti| kāraṇamāha-na hīti | śidādyapīti| śidbhāvitvādikamapītyarthaḥ| ādiśabdena luṅliṅorgrahaṇam, tacceha nāsti| kṛte sani tadantameva śidbhāvi, na śadimriyatibhyāt| śiśayiṣata ityādau tu kṛte'pi sani tadānīmapi ṅittvādikaṃ prakṛtigataṃ vidyata iti bhāvaḥ|
yadi tarhi nimittātideśaḥ, anucikīrṣatītyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ; gandhanāderarthasya ṅittvasya cātmanepadanimittasya sanyapi parasmaipade nimittatvāt| kāryātideśe tu na doṣaḥ;`anuparabhyāṃ kṛñaḥ' iti parasmepadenāpavādenātmanepadasya bādhitatvādata āha--yasya ceti | na yogyatāmātreṇa nimittatvam, kiṃ tarhi? kurvadrūpasyeti snukramorityatra vakṣyata iti bhāvaḥ| yadi kurvadrūpaṃ nimittam, jugupsata ityādau katham, na hyatra prakṛtigatamanudāttettvaṃ tatrātmanepadaṃ kadācidapi karoti nityasanatvād gupādīnāmata āha--ihetyādi| na vātrānenātmanepadam, kiṃ tarhi? `anudāttaṅitaḥ' ityanenetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ samudāyasya jugupsāderanudāttettvamata āha--avayava iti| avayave hyacāritārthaṃ liṅgaṃ sāmarthyātsamudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati| yadyevam, gopayati tejayatītyadāvapi prasaṅgaḥ| atha yaṃ samudāyaṃ yo'vayavo na vyabhicarati, tatra kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ tasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati; ṇijantaṃ ca vyabhicarati, vināpi tena jugupsata iti gupeḥ prayogādityucyeta| vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ, ayamucyate-`gupa gopane' ityasya sanvidhau grahaṇam, tasmācca nityaṃ saneva bhavati, nāparaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyayaḥ| gopāyatītyādikastu prayogaḥ `gupū rakṣaṇe' ityasya, sa cānya eva| avaśyañcaitadevaṃ vijñeyam-anya eva sanprakṛtiḥ tasmācca saneva bhavatīti; anyathā nindāyā anyatra yathā ṇij bhavati tathā laṅādirapi syāt| evaṃ tijiprabhṛtayo'pi, kṣamādyarthe yatra sanniṣyate tatrānudātteto nityasanantāśca; kṣamādibhyo'nyatra tu tatra ṇijiṣyate tatrānanubandhakā eva curādau paṭhitavyāḥ||
padamañjarī
āmpratyayavatkṛño'nuprayogasya || 1.3 63 ||
nanvāmantasyādhātutvādaddaṣṭamātmanepadam, tatkathaṃ kṛño'tidiśyate? syādiyamanupapattiḥ, yadi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, kṛte'pi vā tasmin pratyayagrahaṇe karmadhārayastad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno vā bahuvrīhirāśrīyeta; iha tvatad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrihiḥ,dhāturanyapadārthastadāha--āmpratyayo yasmāditi| vigrahaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsārtha iti, ām pratyayo yasyeti vagrahaḥ syāt; pratiyogini ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśāt, `tatra tasya' iti ṣaṣṭhyāntādvatirityāha--āmpratyayasyaiveti kṛño'nuprayogasyeti| samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| anuprayogaśabdaḥ karmasādhanaḥ| īkṣāñcakra iti |`īkṣa darśane' `īha ceṣṭāyām' liṭ, `ijādeśca' ityām, `āmaḥ' iti lerluk| `akartrabhiprāyārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti bruvatā vidhyarthamevaitadityuktam| tatra doṣamud‌bhāvayitumāha--yadīti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vidhyarthatvamaṅgīkṛtya tadanuguṇo doṣa ud‌bhāvyate, na punarniyamārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya tadanuguṇo doṣa udbhāvyeta? satyam; akartrabhiprāye yācayāñcakre, ubjāñcakāreti prāpte āmpratyayavadeva, tatra vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyān, tasmādevamucyate--`ubja ārjave', `unbha pūraṇe'| ubhayamityādi parihāraḥ| kathamiti| naikenaiva yatnenobhayaṃ labhyamiti bhāvaḥ|
īkṣāmbabhūveti| `bhavateraḥ' `bhuvo vug luṅliṭoḥ'| kathaṃ punariti| `kṛñaḥ' ityatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ| pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti| yadi tatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syād, iha kṛñgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād; anyasyānuprayogasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eva viparyayo'pi na bhavati-tatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syād ihi pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti, iha hi pratyāhāragrahaṇe bhvastyorapyātmanepadavidhiḥ prayojanam| yadi cānuprayogavidhinā kṛñ evānuprayuktaḥ syāt, tadā bhvastyoranuprayogābhāvādātmanepadavidhiranupapannaḥ syāt| tasmādiha svarūpagrahaṇam, āmanuprayogavidhau pratyāhārasyeti siddham| `abhividhau sampadā ca' iti sampado'pi tatrāntarbhāvādanuprayogaḥ prāptaḥ `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' ityato dhātvadhikārāddhātūpasargasamudāyasya na bhavati| yo'tra dhātustasyāpi na bhavati; arthavipratiṣedhāditi tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ||
padamañjarī
propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu|| 1.3.64 ||
propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu|| yujiryoge iti | `yuja samādhau' ityasya,na daivādikasya, anudāttettvādeva siddham, yujariti ca vivakṣita ikāraḥ, na tvāgantukaḥ| yajñapātraviṣayatā cāsyaiva sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ| prayuṅkta iti| `rudhādibhyaḥ śnam' `śnasorallopaḥ' kutvacartve, anusvāraparasavarṇau|
svarādyantopasṛṣṭaditi| svaraḥ-a i, ādiranto vā yasya sa svarādyantaḥ| tenopasargeṇa sambandhaḥ, svarādyantopasṛṣṭaḥ- sam nis dus ityetān varjayitvā sarva evopasargāssaṃgṛhītāḥ||
padamañjarī
samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ|| 1.3.65 ||
iha `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasyāvakāśo yatra kupvorasambhavaḥ-puruṣaḥ tsarukaḥ; `kupvoḥḥ kaḥ pau ca' ityasya yatra śarparau kupū na sambhavataḥ- puruṣaḥ karotīti; śarparayorubhayoḥ prasaṅge pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedho'bhāvāduttarasyeti `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti nityaṃ visarjanīya eva bhavati | tena `samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ' na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| saṃkṣṇuvata iti| adāditvācchapo luk, `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' iti jhasyādādeśaḥ,`aci śnudhātu'ityādinovaṅ||
padamañjarī
bhujo'navane||1.3.66 ||
anavanapratiṣedhenetyādi| saṃsargavadviprayogo'pi viśeṣasmṛtihetuḥ| yathā dogdhrīparyāyo dhenuśabdaḥ saṃsargibhiḥ viśeṣe'vasthāpyate--savatsā dhenurānīyatāṃ sakiśorā savarkareti, tathā'vatsā'kiśorā'varkareti| yasyā ānayane ddaṣṭaḥ saṃsargaḥ saiva tatra gṛhītā ānīyate; tadvadihāpītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartānāghyāne || 1.3.67 ||
atra `ṇeḥ' iti yadyapi sāmānyanirdeśaḥ,tathāpi pucchabhāṇḍādiṇiṅ na gṛhyate; aṇau karmaṇo ṇāvasambhavāt, kamerṇi ṅastu`āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā' iti vacanādaṇyantāvasthā sambhavati| karmaṇaśca kartṛtvam--kamiṣyate yoṣitaṃ devadattaḥ kāmayiṣyate yoṣitsvayameveti, tathāpi ṅittvādeva siddhe so'pi na gṛhyata iti ṇica eva grahaṇamityāha--ṇicaśceti kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale siddhamevātsanepadamiti| akartrabhiprāyārtha iti| upalakṣaṇametat, kartrabhiprāye padāntareṇa dyotite `vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne' iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā nityo vidhiryathā syādityapi draṣṭavyam| atraikavākyatāyāmayamartho bhavati--ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatyaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ yatkarma ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ yadi sa karttā bhavati ādhyānādanyatreti| tatra karmāntaranivṛttirna kṛtā syāt, tataścehāpi prasajyeta--ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāstānārohayati hastīti| kiṃ ca ukte'rthe `ṇeraṇau karmaṇi' ityetāvadeva vācyam; karttarītyeva ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, `aṇau karmaṇi kartari' ityukte ko nāma vivakṣito'rtho na siddhyati| `saḥ' ityetaccānarthakam; yattadornityasambandhādevādhyāhārataḥ siddheḥ| tasmādyathāśrutamātraṃ na vivakṣitamiti matvā pṛcchati--kathamiti|
itaro'pi vākyabhedāśrayaṇena pariharati--aṇau yatkarmetyādi| ṇerātmanepadaṃ bhavati ādhyānādanyatretyekaṃ vākyam, tato'ṇau yatkarmeti dvitīyam| atra vākye yattadornityasambandhādyacchabdena tacchabda ākṣipyate| karmāntarasya cānirdeśād uddeśyatayāpi śrutaṃ karmatvameva vidhīyate| tacca vidhīyamānaṃ sāmarthyāṇṇoriti sannihitatvāṇṇayantāvasthāyāmeva vidhīyate | kiṃ tatsāmarthyam? aṇau yatkarmetyanuvādasāmarthyādevāṇau karmatvasiddhestatraiva tadvidhānasyāsambhavaḥ| tadevamaṇau yatkarmetyetāvata evāṇau yatkarma ṇau cettatkarmetyartho bhavati| anena ca karmāntaranivṛttiḥ kriyate, na tvaṇau karmaṇo ṇau karmabhāvaḥ pratipādyate| sa karteti vākyāntareṇa tasya kartṛtvapratipādanāt ekasya yugapadekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ karmatvakartṛtvayorubhayorasambhavāt| tato ṇau cediti tṛtīyaṃ vākyam--aṇau yadityeva, aṇau yatpratipādyaṃ vastu ṇau cettadeva pratipādyamityarthaḥ| tataḥ sa karteti caturtham| atrāṇau yatkarma ṇau cediti sarvamanuvarttate| `anādhyāne' ityetadapi prasajyapratiṣedhe pañcamaṃ vākyam|
tatra vṛttikāreṇa trīṇi vākyāni svavācā darśitāni-ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, aṇau yatkarma ṇau cettadeva karmeti dvitīyam, sa eva kartā bhavatīti tṛtīyam|`ṇau ced' grahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthamiti tu vakṣyati, atastadapi vākyamabhyupagatameva|
ārohantītyādi| aṇau karmapradarśanārthamidamuktam, idaṃ tatrodāharaṇam--ārohayate hastī svayameveti| āṅpūrvo ruhiḥ nyagbhavanopasajaṃne nyagbhāvane vartate, nyagbhavantaṃ hastinaṃ nyagbhavayatītyarthaḥ| yadā tu hastinaḥ saukaryātiśayapratipādanāya hastipakavyāpāro na vivakṣyate, tadā nyagbhavamātre ruhirvartate, tatra ca hastinaḥ kartṛtvam| uktaṃ ca--
nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam|
nivartamāne karmatve svakartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate|| iti
asya ca kartuḥ karmasthakriyeṣu karmakāryāṇyatidiśyante-`karmavatkarmaṇātulyakriyaḥ' iti, tadyathā-lūyate kedāraḥ svayeveti| lunātirhi dvidhābhavanopasarjane dvidhābhāvane vṛttaḥ kartṛvyāpārāvivakṣāyāṃ dvidhā bhavanamātre vartate| duhistu kartṛsthakriyatvāt karmakāryāṇi na labhata ityetāvat| tato nyagbhavanavṛtte ruherhastipakavyāpāre ṇijutpadyate, tadā ca ya evārtha ārohayanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, sa evārtha ārohayanti hastipakā iti | punaḥ saukaryātiśayavivakṣāyāmavivakṣite hastipakavyāpāre nyagbhavanamātre rohirvartate-ārohayate hastī svayameveti| suṣṭhu nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca-
nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ruhau śuddhe pratīyate|
nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyante'pi pratipadyate||
avasthāṃ pañcamīmāhurṇyantānāṃ karmakartari|
nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate|| iti|
evaṃ siñcaterapyārdrībhavanopasarjanamārdrībhāvanamarthaḥ| tato nivṛttapreṣaṇamityādi pūrvavat| secayate hastī svayameva, secane'tyantamanukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ddaśirapi karmavyāpāramātravṛttiḥ,ṇijutpanne punastatrāparo'pi, tadudāharaṇam-darśayate rājā svayameva, darśanenānukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ| so'yaṃ nivṛttapreṣapakṣa ucyate|
aparaḥ prakāraḥ-ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tān saukaryātiśayāddhastī prayuṅkte iti; hastivyāpāre ṇijutpadyate-ārohayati hastī hastipakāniti| tatra saukaryātiśayapratipādane tātparyamiti karma na vivakṣyate, tato'karmako bhavati; yathā-neha pacyate, neha bhujyate iti pākamātrapratiṣedhe tātparyamiti karmāvivakṣāyāṃ bhāve lo bhavati-ārohayate hastī svayameva, suṣṭhu nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| eṣa eva hi hastinaḥ prayojakavyāpāraḥ| evamitarayorapi draṣṭavyam| so'yamadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣa iti gīyate|
tadevamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ saiva kriyā, yā'ṇyantāvasthāyām| na ca karmāntaramasti, kartāpi sa evetyudāharaṇopapattiḥ| svayamiti vacanaṃ kartrantaravyudāsārtham|
ṇeriti kimiti| aṇau karmatvānuvādena ṇau kartṛtvavidhānāt prādhānyāṇṇyantādeva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| sādhvārohatīti| sāghu nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| atra karmavyāpāramātre ruhirvartate, kartṛsthakriyatvāttu karmavad‌bhāvābhāvādyagātmanepade na bhavataḥ, śapparasmaipade bhavataḥ, aṇau yatkarmetyaṇyantāvasthāyāmapi śrutatvāttato'pi syāditi bhāva| nanu prādhānyāṇṇyantādeva bhaviṣyatītyuktam, kimarthamaṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karteti? ayamupādhiryasminneva prayoge saṃbhavati, tatraivātmanepadaṃ yuktam, sādhvārohatītyatra ca nāyaṃ prakāraḥ sambhavati| ārohayate hastītyatra tu ṇicaḥ prakṛtibhūte ruhāvaṇyante yatkarma ṇyante sa eva kartteti tatraiva bhaviṣyati, satyam; tadevamuttarārthamavaśyaṃ ṇeriti vaktavyamihāpi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate|
aṇāviti kimiti| karmatvakarttṛtvayoryaugapadyāsambhavāt ṇau ca kartṛtvasya śrutatvādavasthāntare ṇāveva karmatvaṃ vijñāsyata iti praśnaḥ| gamayatīti| `gaṇasaṃkhyāne' curādāvadantaḥ paṭhyate, ato lopasya sthānivad‌bhāvād upadhāvṛddhyabhāvaḥ| gaṇyamāno gaṇo yadā gaṇanakriyāyāmānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tadā tadvyāpāramātravṛtterhetumaṇṇici punaḥ karmavyāpāramātre āropitasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ| gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameveti| atra ṇāveva gaṇeḥ karma, ṇāveva kartā ityātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| karmavad‌bhāvenāpi na bhavati; kartṛ sthakriyatvāt| gaṇanaṃ hi saṃkhyānimittaḥ paricchedo jñānaviveṣaḥ| bhāṣye tu bhāgaśo'vasthāpane gaṇirvartate| bhāgaśo'vatiṣṭhamānaṃ gaṇaṃ gopālako'vasthāpayatītyarthamaṅgīkṛtya tatrānukūlatvād gaṇasyaiva kartṛ tvavivakṣāyāmasti karmasthabhāvakatvamiti karmavad‌bhāvādātmanepadamudāhṛtam| nanu cāṇāvakarmakādityatra vakṣyati-`hetumaṇṇico vidhiḥ' iti, pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsattestasyaiva nyāyya iti, taccet, satyam; idamapi pratyudāharaṇamayuktameva, ucyate-yuktaṃ tatra hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti; tatra budhādisūtre `ṇaḥ' iti vartate, budhādibhyaśca hetumaṇṇijeva sambhavati| iha tu sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ viśeṣahetvabhāvāt| nanu cāṇau yatkarmetyucyate curādīnāṃ ca nityaṇyantatvātkevalānāṃ prayogābhavād aṇau karmaṇo'sambhavād atrāpi hetumaṇṇica eva vidhiḥ, netyāha; `ā dhṛṣādvā' iti vibhāṣitaṇicāmapi keṣāñcitsambhavāt| bhāṣye tu hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti sthitam| lāvayati dātraṃ svayameveti| karaṇasya dātrasyāpi taikṣṇyātiśayena lavane yadānukūlyaṃ tatpratipādanāya lāvakānprati prayojakatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇic|
iha ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatyaṇau yatkarma sa cetkartetyukte gamyata etad‌yasmād ṇyantādvidhiḥ tatraivāṇyante yatkarma sa cetkarteti, ato ṇau ced‌grahaṇamarthakam, tatrāha-ṇau ced‌grahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthamiti| prayojyaprayojakabhāvalakṣaṇe'pi kriyābhede mā bhūt, ṇicprakṛtyarthabhūtāyāmeva kriyāyāṃ yathā syādityarthaḥ| yathā punarayaṃ śabdārthastathoktaṃ purastāt| ārohayamāṇo hastī bhītān secayati mūtreṇeti| yena prayojyaprayojakabhāvalakṣaṇe'pi kriyābhede ātmanepadaṃ vāryata evānena dhātubhedādatyantabheda iti matvaitatpratyudāhṛtam, bhītāścātrārohayateḥ karma| ārohayamāṇa iti| `ṇicaśca' ityātmanepadaṃ śānac, bhītā hyārehyamāṇā bhītyā mūtrayanti, tena hastī sicyate| karmāvivakṣāyāṃ tu secayaterakarmakatvam|
uddeśapratinirdeśāt labdhe yat‌sagrahe punastad‌graho vākyabhedena karmāntaranivṛttaye ityāha-yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārthamiti| sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityatra karmāntaramapyasti manuṣyāḥ, ruhergatyarthatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñā| kathaṃ punaratrāṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvam,yāvatā sthalamaṇau karma hastī tu ṇau karttā? syādetat‌ārohayamāṇa ityatrāṇau karmaṇo hastina eva kartṛ tvam, sa eva ca sthalamārohayatītyatrāpi kartteti| evamapi pratyāsatterevātra na bhaviṣyati, tathā hi ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati| aṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa karttetyukte pratyāsatteretad gamyate-yena ṇicā ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitaṃ tenaiva ṇicā'ṇyante tatprakṛtibhūte dhātau yatkarma sa eva cetkartā tasminneva ṇyanta iti| atra ca yatrāyamupādhiḥ, kṛtameva tatrātmanepadam-ārohayamāṇa iti| yatratu na kṛtam-sthalamārohayatīti, na tatrāyamupādhiriti naivātmanepadaprasaṅgaḥ| iha tarhi-ārohanta hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tānārehayati hastīti? kiṃ punaratra neṣyate? vṛttikṛtā neṣyate, bhāgavṛttikāreṇa tviṣyate| tathā māghaḥ prayuṅkte-`kareṇurārohayate niṣādinam' iti|
kateti kimiti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ siddhatvāt karttaryeva bhaviṣyatīti manyate| aṇau yatkarma tasminneva karttari yathā syāt, kartrantare mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kartṛgrahaṇamiti darśayannāha-tānārohayati mahāmātra iti| gatyarthatvacca ruheḥ hastipakānāṃ karmasaṃjñā | yadyevam, karmāntarasambhavādevātra na bhaviṣyati? naitadevam? astītyatrāṇau karmaṇo hastino ṇāvapi karmatvenānvayaḥ| na vā sati kartṛ tvavidhau karmāntaravyāvṛttirlabhyate| yadvā-prayojakavyāpāramātre tātparyādyadā hastipakāḥ karmatvenāvivakṣitāḥ, tadedaṃ pratyudāhaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| vanagulmasyeti| karmopalakṣaṇametat, na tvatra vanagulmasya karmatvamasti; śeṣatvena vivakṣitvāt| tasmādvanagulmamiti pradarśanīyam| smarayatyenamiti| `smṛ ādhyāne' ghaṭādiḥ, vanagulmasya ramaṇīyatvapratipādanāya prayojakatve vivakṣite ṇic| enamiti| buddhyarthatvātkokilasya karmasaṃjñā| etadapyupalakṣaṇam, atrahi karmāntarasadbhāvādeva prāptirnāsti karmāvivakṣāyāṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
nanu cātra karmakartari mūlodāharaṇānīti| nanu cādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe ārohayato hastinaḥ karmatvābhāvātkarmaṇā samānadhātau tulyakriyatvābhāvāt pacatyodanaṃ devadatto rādhyatyodanaṃ svayamevetivatkarmavad‌bhāvo na prāpnoti, satyam; ārabdha evāsmin sūtre so'pi pakṣaḥ sambhavāt pradarśitaḥ, anārabdhe tu nivṛtapreṣaṇapakṣaprakriyaivāśrayiṣte| nanu tatrāpi vyāpāradvayābhidhāyiṣu ruhādiṣu bhavatyevam, ye tu kevalakartṛ vyāpāravācino ddaśyādayaḥ teṣu katham, na hi ddaśiḥ karmavyāpāraṃ kañcadācaṣṭe? syādetat-viṣayabhāvāpattiḥ karmavyāpārastadāpādanaṃ kartṛ vyāpāra iti| yadyevam, icchāpi ddaśyarthaḥ syāt| nanvatrāpi viṣayabhāvāpattiḥ, tadāpādanaṃ ca vidyate, atha darśanaviṣayabhāvāpādanaṃ ddaśyarthaḥ, nanu tadeva nirūpyate kiṃ nāma taddarśanam iti, atrocyate; mā nāmākhyātakarmavyāpāraḥ, asti tāvatkarmaṇo'pi vyāpāraḥ, kārakatvāt‌, tatra ṇijutpattidaśāyāṃ tāvatyeva varttiṣyate, udāharaṇadaśāyāṃ ṇyanto'pīti manyate| tathā ca ruhiḥ kartṛ yuk karmaṇābhidheya iti yuktaṃ kevalakartṛ vyāpāravācināṃ gamiddaśiprabhṛtīnāṃ kartṛ sthakriyatvam; kathaṃ tu viklityupasarjanavikledavacanaḥ paciḥ, dvidhābhavanopasarjanadvidhābhāvanavacanaśca lunātiḥ karmasthakiyaḥ, nyagbhavanopasarjananyagbhāvanavacanastu ruhiḥ kartṛ sthakriyaḥ? ucyate; ruhirapi gatyarthaḥ, tathā ca `yaddhitupariṃ chandasi' ityatra bhāṣyakāro vakṣyati-hastinamārohatītyatra hi uparigamanalakṣaṇa eva ruherarthaḥ, tatpunarnyagbhavanahetutvād nyagbhāvanamityucyate, uparigamanarahitaṃ tu nyagbhāvanamātraṃ ruherartho na bhavati, yadā khalu kvacid bhūmāveva tiṣṭhan vṛkṣasya śākhāṃ hastābhyāmavanamayati, tadā nāsāvārohatītyucyate| tasmād gativiśeṣa eva ruherarthaḥ| kastarhi kriyāṇāṃ karmakartṛ sthatāyāṃ hetuḥ? uktamatra-
viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā|
kriyāvyavasthā tvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakalpitā|| iti|
viśeṣadarśanena śabdānusāreṇa vā kriyāyāstātsthyaṃ kathyate| etacca kāraṇagatamārohasya kartṛsthatvaṃ pratipādayati, na tu karmasthatām| na hi hastināmārohati, vṛkṣamārohati, parvatamārohatītyādau karmabhede'pyārohaṇe rūpabhedaḥ pratīyate, yathā-ghṛtamāsataṇḍulādiṣu pākaḥ| na ca hastī nyagbhavatvityevaṃ kārakavyāpāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? hastipakā uparyāsīranniti| pāke tu taṇḍulādigato viklityādirūpo viśeṣo yathā syādityeva kārakavyāpāraḥ| tasmatkarmabhede rūpabhedāduddeśasya ca karmagatatvāt paciḥ karmasthakriyaḥ,viparyapādruhiḥ kartṛ sthakriya iti siddham| eva cāruhyate hastī svayameveti karmavad‌bhāvaṃ prarśayanto bhāṣyanyāyavirodhādupekṣyāḥ| ddaśikartṛ sthabhāvaka iti| atha siciḥ kasmādupekṣitaḥ? karmasthakriyatvād| ārdrībhavanaṃ hyatra pradhānam, tadarthatvātkārakavyāpārasya| kimarthaṃ tarhyudāhṛtaḥ? viśeṣābhāvāt| na hyatrānena `karmavatkarmaṇā' ityanena vā ātmanepade sati kaścidviśeṣaḥ, tenāpi sati yakciṇau na bhavataḥ, `ṇiśranthigranthi
'iti pratiṣedhāt| bhāṣye'pi karmavadbhāvāt siddhimāśaṅkyādhyānapratiṣedhārthamityuktvā smarateḥ kartṛ sthabhāvakatvāt karmavadbhāvasya prāptirnāstītyabhidhāyoktam| evaṃ tarhi siddhe sati yadādhyānapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ-bhavatyevañjātīyakānāmātmanepadamiti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam? paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānam; darśayate bhṛtyān rājā svayameva-atrātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatīti| evañjātīyakānāmiti kartṛ sthakriyāṇāmityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca bruvatā vidhyarthametadityuktaṃ bhavati, viśeṣapratiṣedhena sāmānyavidheranumānāt| atra darśayate bhṛtyān rājetyetadekamudāharaṇamanupapannam; karmāntarasadbhāvāt| tatra vṛttikāraḥ `tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe' iti nyāyād udāharaṇametadgamayitavyaṃ manyate| asminnudāharaṇe kamavyāpāramātre vivakṣite siddhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ-asmādevodāharaṇādaṇau ye kartṛ karmaṇī tadvyatiriktakarmāntarasadbhāva evātmanepadaṃ na bhavati, yathā-sthalamārohayati manuṣyāniti, iha tvaṇau kartṛṇāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ ṇau karmatvamiti| evaṃ smārayatyenamiti kokīlasya karmatve'pi pratyudāharaṇamupapannam, `kareṇurārohayate niṣādinam' iti prayogaścopapanna iti teṣāṃ sūtrākṣarāṇyeva tāvadadhikāni, bhāṣyaṃ ca sarvamudāharaṇavarjamanupapannam||
prayogāṇāṃ tu nirvāho ṇicaścetyātmanepadāt|
jayādityasya hṛdayaṃ gūḍhametatprakāśitam||
padamañjarī
bhīsmyorhetubhaye|| 1.3.68 ||
bhayamaniṣṭāpātaśaṅgāsādhanamātraṃ lokiko hetuḥ, na vāntareṇa sādhanaṃ kriyā sambhavatīti viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt kṛtrimatvācca pāribhāṣikasya hetorgrahaṇamityāha--hetuḥ prayojaka ityādi| tataścedbhayaṃ bhavatīti| yadyevam, smayatyartho na viśeṣitaḥ syāt, na hi smayaterbhayamarthaḥ, a'ta āha-bhayagrahaṇamiti| cittavikārasyopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| vismayo'pi tata eveti| atra cedbhavatītyanuṣaṅgaḥ| bhīṣayata iti| `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk'| bhāyayata iti|`bibheterhetubhaye' iti vaikalpikamātvam| evaṃ ca atra ṣuk na bhavati; tadvidhāvākārapraśleṣāt| vismāpayata iti| `nityaṃ smayateḥ' ityātvam| `artihrī' ityādinā puk| kuñcikayeti| kāraṇādatra bhayam, na hetoḥ| yadyapi tadvyāpāre ṇijvidhānāt prayojakasādhyameva bhayam, tathāpi viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādevaṃ vijñāyate-anyanirapekṣāddhetoreva yadbhayamiti| evaṃ ca mauṇḍyainaṃ bhāyayatītyatrāpi guṇaguṇinorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ na bhavati| udāharaṇe tu tādātmyasya vivakṣitatvāddhetoreva bhayam||
padamañjarī
gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane|| 1.3.69 ||
pariharatītyartha iti| varjayatīti yāvat||
padamañjarī
liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca|| 1.3.70 ||
viśeṣābhāvāditi| niranubandhakaparibhāṣā tu `vāmadevād ḍyaḍḍyau' ityatra jñāpitā pratyayagrahaṇaviṣayaiveti manyate| saṃmānane śālīnīkaraṇe ca vartamānāditi| saṃmānanaṃ viṣayaḥ,na dhātvarthaḥ| yadāha--pūjāmadhigacchatītyartha iti| dhātvarthe tu pūjayatīti vācyaṃ syāt, yathā nyakkarotītyartha iti| akarmakaścāyacamasmin prayoge pūjākhyasya karmaṇa ātmanepadasahitena dhātunaivopāttatvāt putrīyatītivadityāhuḥ| jaṭābhiriti| hetau tṛtīyā, yasya hi jaṭāḥ santi loke sa pūjyate||
padamañjarī
mithyopapadāt kṛño'bhyāse|| 1.3.71 ||
upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam,mithyāśabda upapadaṃyasya sa tathoktaḥ| mithyā kārayate iti ātmanepadenaivābhyāsasya dyotitatvāt `nityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| sadoṣamiti| etena mithyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| asyaiva vivaraṇam-svarādiduṣṭamiti| ādiśabdena rūpaṃ gṛhyate| asakṛditi abhyāsaṃ darśayati| uccārayatītyartha iti ṇyantasya karoteruccāraṇe vṛttiranekārthatvāddhātūnām| evaṃ ca prakṛtibhūtaḥ karotiruccāraṇe varttate, akarmakaśca||
padamañjarī
svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale|| 1.3.72 ||
kartāramabhipraitīti kartrabhiprāyam,`karmaṇyaṇ',kriyāphalaṃ ceha karmaiveti nāsti niyamaḥ tenākarmakebhyo'pi yajiprabhṛtibhyaḥ svargādike phale kartṛ gāminyayaṃ vidhirbhavatyeva| kartāraṃ cediti| kriyāphalasya kartṛ gāmitvahyotanāyātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadi yacca yāvacca kriyānantarabhāvi phalaṃ tatra kartṛ gāminyayaṃ vidhirbhavati, ihāpi syād-yajanti yājakāḥ, pacanti pācakā iti; dakṣiṇādeḥ kartṛ gāmitvādityatra āha-praghānabhūtamiti| kiṃ punastadityata āha-yadarthamiti| yaduddiśyetyarthaḥ| kriyā ārabhata iti| sāmagrīsamavadhānātmikā ādyā pravṛttiḥ-ārambhaḥ, yāmantareṇa yājakādīnāmapravṛtiḥ, svargādikaṃ hi phalaṃ prekṣuḥ sāmagrīṃ samavadhāpya pravartayati, sā pravartitā yathāyathaṃ pravarttate| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate-pradhāne phale kartrabhiprāyaiti? pradhānatvādeva| kiñca-yat kicana phalaṃ sarvatra kartrabhiprāyaṃ bhavati| nanu yatra kriyābhyāsamātre tātparyam, tatra na kiñcitpalaṃ kartṛgāmi, tatrāpi kiñcitphalaṃ kartṛgāmi, tatrāpi kiñcitphalaṃ kartṛgāmi, kiṃ kauśalam? punaḥ punarabhyāse hi kriyāsu kauśalaṃ bhavati, tasmātpradhāne phale kartrabhiprāya iti siddham| yajata iti| kecidāhuḥ- `devatāyai idaṃ na mama' ityevaṃvidho mānasaḥ saṅkalpo yāga iti, teṣāṃ yajanti yājakā iti ṛtvigvyāpāre prayogo nopapadyate| anye tvāhuḥ-`homādiṣvabhiṣṭvādiṛtvigvyāpāro yāgaḥ' iti, teṣāṃ yajativyāpāpāraprayogo nopapadyate| evaṃ tarhyubhayaṃ yajerarthaḥ-ṛtvagvyāpāraśca, yajamānavyāpāraśca| taduktam-yajādiṣu cāviparyāso nānākriyāṇāṃ yajyarthatvāditi|
na tadarthaḥ kriyāramma iti| nanu ṛtvijāmārambhastadartha eva, naitadevam; `ādyā pravṛttirārambhaḥ' ityuktam, sā ca yajamānasya- svargamahaṃ labheyeti, na punarime dakṣiṇāṃ labheranniti| yathā-avaghāte kriyamāṇe svedaśca bhavati vaituṣyaṃ ca bhavati, bhṛtiśca labhyate, atha ca vaituṣyārtha evāvaghāgaḥ, tadvadatrāpi| taduktaṃ hariṇā-
yasyārthasya prasiddhyarthamārabhyante pacādayaḥ|
tatpradhānaṃ phalaṃ na lābhādi prayojanam|| iti |
iha svāmidāsau pacata iti| kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ bhavati| svāmigate tu dharme dāsa āropite svāmidāsau pacete ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati|
athābhipragragaṇaṃ kimartham? viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale yathā syād| dvividhaṃ kriyāphalam, ddaṣṭam--annaputravṛṣṭiśatruvadhādikam, addaṣṭaṃ ca svargādi| tatra pūrvaṃ pratyāsannamavaśyaṃbhāvīti pradhānam, itarattu vidhurapratyayopanipāte sati vyabhicārasaṃbhavādviprakṛṣṭatvaccāpradhānam| saṃbhavati hyavikalamanuṣṭhātuṃ yāgasyāpi madhye vairāgyotpattau mokṣārthapravṛttau satyāmanutpattiḥ svargasya| tataśceha tasya grahaṇaṃ na syād| abhipragrahaṇe tu sati abhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdastvārambha iti karttāraṃ pratyābhimukhyena kriyāphalaṃ cettatpraiti etum ārabhate evamātmanedaṃ bhavatītyartho bhavati| tathā ca yadyapi svargādikaṃ svarūpeṇānnādivat tadānīṃ naiti tasya tvaṅkurāvasthā karttārametīti tad‌dvāreṇa phalamevaitumārabhata iti sarvatra siddhyati| phalasyaiva hyaṅkarāvasthā pūrvaśabdavācyā||
apādvadaḥ|| 1.3.73 ||

pacyate, gamyata iti| nanu kriyamāṇe'pi kartarigrahaṇe yadi tāvadevaṃ niyamaḥ- kartari yadi bhavati śeṣādeveti; tato'śeṣātkartari mā bhūt, śeṣāttu bhāvakarma kartṛ ṣu triṣvapi prāpnoti| athāpyevaṃ niyamaḥ- śeṣādyadi bhavati kartaryeveti, tataḥ śeṣādbhāvakarmaṇormā bhūd, aśeṣāttu triṣvapi prāpnoti | ukto'tra parihāraḥ-
`yogavibhāgo'trābhipretaḥ'iti| tatra prathame yoge śeṣādeveti niyamaḥ, dvitīye tu kartaryeveti| karmakartarītyapi bhāvakarmaṇorityatrokta evārtho vismaraṇaśīlānanugrahītuṃ punarapi smāritaḥ||

vā kyaṣaḥ|| 1.3.90 ||
lohitāyate iti| alohito lohito bhavatītyatrārthe kyaṣ, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| paṭapaṭāyatīti| paṭacchabdasya ḍājviṣaye dvirvacanam, `avyaktānukaraṇāt' iti ḍāc, ṭilopa; `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci'| kathamiti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-yāvateti| na niyamena vyāvarttitamātmanepadamanena śakyaṃ prāpayitum,na hyaśakyārthevacanasya vyāpāraḥ, vāvacanaṃ tu kevalasya lasya prayogartha syādidi bhāvaḥ| | evaṃ tarhītyādi parihāraḥ| vikalpitaṃ vibhāṣitam,pākṣikamityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ parasmaipadaprakaraṇena vicchinnamātmanepadaṃ śakyaṃ vidhātum,ata āha-tacceti| nanu śābdaḥ sannidhiḥ sambandhakāraṇam, pratiṣedhena cāpavādabhūtasya bhāvāmātraṃ pratipādyate, ātmanepadaṃ tu svenaśāstreṇa bhavati, na bhāvanā tasya sannidhirbhavati, ucyate; tātparyato'pi sannidhiḥ, sannidhirevāpavādāpanayanasya cotsargapravṛttau tātparyam, tena parasmaipadaṃ bhavatītyasyātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ| yadvā-ihāpi pratiṣedha eva vidheyaḥ, sa ca pūrvasūtravadihātmanepadaṃ pravarttayiṣyati| kiṃ tarhi ucyate-anantaraṃ sannidhāpitāmiti, nanvevamihaiva sannidhāpitaṃ bhavati? syādevam, yadi parasmaipadena kyaṣantādātmanepadaṃ bādhitaṃ syād, niyamena tadvyāvṛttiḥ, tatra svaviṣaye parasmaipadapratiṣedho vikalpyamānaḥ kiṃ kāraṇamātmanepadaṃ pravarttayet? pūrvatra tvapavādamapanayatā pratiṣedhenātmanepadaṃ pravarttyate, tasmādihāpi tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāt yāddaśaḥ pratiṣedha ātmanepadapravṛttyavinābhāvī prakṛtaḥ, tāddaśa eva vidhīyata iti matvoktam-`anantaraṃ sannidhāpitam' iti| yadyātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate, kenedānīṃ parasmaipadaṃ pakṣe bhavatītyata āha-tena mukta iti| iha `propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām' `anupasargādvā' ityanantaraṃ `kyaṣaḥ' iti sūtraṃ karttavyam- kyaṣantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, nedaṃ duḥkhamanubhavitavyaṃ bhavati, `vā' grahaṇañca na kartavyaṃ bhavati, uttaramapi yogadvayaṃ tatraiva kāryam? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva||
padamañjarī
dyudbhyo luṅi|| 1.3.91 ||
dyuterekatvādvahuvacanamanupapannamityāśaṅkyāha-tatsāhacaryāditi| chattrinyāyeneti bhāvaḥ| luṭhādayo'pīti| pratyāsannānāmeva sāhacaryāt pratītiḥ syādityāśaṅkāmapanetuṃ dūravartināmupādānam| kvacit śvityādaya ityanantarāṇāmeva pāṭhaḥṣa kṛpūparyantā iti| tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇāda etaduktaṃ bhavatītyāha-bahuvacananirdeśāditi| vyadyutaditi| `puṣādi' iti sūtreṇāṅ| na ca tata evāṅvidhānāt parasmaipadaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātuma; nityatvaprasaṅgāt, luṅo'nyatrāpi prasaṅgacca| anudāttettvaṃ tu yujarthaṃ syāt||
padamañjarī
vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ|| 1.3.92 ||
`syasanoḥ' iti satsaptamī| dyu tādiṣveva vṛtādayaḥ paṭhyanta iti| yadyevamiyaṃ prāptirvṛdbhyaḥ pūrvāṃ prāptiṃ bādheta, tataśca avṛtat, avarttiṣṭeti luṅi vikalpo na syāt tathā cottaratra cakāraḥ kriyate-imāṃ prāptiṃ pakṣe itarāprāptirna bādheteti, dyutādipāṭhasārthyātso'pi bhaviṣyati| yadvā-luṅītyatra svarayiṣyate, vartyatītyādau `na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ' iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ||
