evaṃ tarhīti| sāmānyasya viśeṣo vādhaka iti bhāvaḥ| kalptetyādau `tāsi ca klṛpaḥ' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ||
iti haradattaviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ||
<1.4>
atha prathamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
ā kaḍārādekā saṃjhā|| 1.4.1 ||
ā kaḍārādekā saṃjñā|| āṅmaryādābhividhyoriti| samāsasya vikalpitatvād| `ākaḍārāt' iti nirdeśaḥ, samāse tvākaḍāramiti syāt| iha dvau kaḍāraśabdau bhavataḥ-`prākkaḍārāt samāsaḥ', `kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye' iti ca, tatra ko'vadhirityata āha-`kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye' iti vakṣyatīti| kutaḥ punaretat? svātantryāt| svatantro hyasau prathamānirdeśena svayaṃ kāryayogitvāt| prākkaḍārādityayaṃ tu paratantro'vadhitvena svayaṃ kāryayogitvābhāvād,vyāpteśca nyāyād| evaṃ hi bhūyasāmanugraho bhavati| liṅgacca, yadayaṃ `tatpuruṣaḥ' `dviguśca' iti dvigostatpuruṣasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati-anuvarttate dvitīye'pyekasaṃjñādhikāra iti; anyathā `diksaṅkhye saṃjñāyām' ityatra tatpuruṣādhikārādeva samāveśasiddhestadartho yatno'pārthakaḥ syāt| kimartha, punariyānavadhirupādīyate, na ā dvandvāt ityevocyeta, na hi `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityataḥ paratrāsyopayogaḥ? ucyate; `dvandvaśca prāṇitūrya' ityayamapyavadhiḥ sambhāvyate, tataśca sambuddhisaṃjñāmantritasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt|
kā punarasāviti| ekā saṃjñā bhavatītyetāvat sūtravyāpāraḥ, tatra viśeṣādarśanāt praśnaḥ| `yā parānavakāśā ca' iti vacanād nyāyācca vyavastheti bhāvaḥ| nanu yadyārabdhe'pyasmin paratvānavakāśatvābhyāmeva vyavasthā vācyā, anārabdhe'pyasmin ābhyāmeva vyāvasthā bhaviṣyati,nārtha etena ? tatrāha-anyatreti| ayambhāvaḥ- yatra prayojanamekaṃ bhavati, sahānavasthānalakṣaṇe vā virodhaḥ, tatraivānavakāśaḥ sāvakāśaṃ bādhate, yathā-naivāraścarurnakhāvapūtānāmiti, nakhāvapanena vaituṣyaphalakena tatphalako'ghāto bādhyate| aṣṭāśriyūpaḥ karttavyaḥ, vājapeyasya tu caturaśra iti, aṣṭāśritvacaturaśratvayorvirodhāt bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ| vipratiṣedho'pi virodhātmakatvāttatraiva bhavati, tadyathā-kṛtkṛtyapratyasaṃjñānāṃ taddhitatadrājapratyayasaṃjñānāṃ ca| sati tvasmin sūtre ekasyaikaiveti niyamādvirodho jāyate, virodhe ca sati paratvānavakāśatvābhyāṃ vyavasthā śakyate vaktumiti, tatrānavakāśāyā udāharaṇamāha-vakṣyatīti| śikṣā, mikṣeti| `gurośca halaḥ' ityakārapratyayaḥ| yadyapyatra samāveśe'pi na kaściddoṣa, tathāpi vastutaḥ samāveśo nāstīsyetāvatā idamudāsamāveśe'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ, tathāpi vastutaḥ samāveśo nāstītyetāvatā idamudāharaṇam| samprati yatra samāveśe sati doṣaḥ, taddarśayati-atatakṣaditi| parasyāstūdāharaṇam-dhanuṣā vidhyatīti, śarāṇāmapāyaṃ pratyavadhibhūtasyaiva dhanuṣo vyadhanaṃ prati sādhakatamatvamityubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñāpādānasañjñāṃ bādhate| tathā `kāsyapātryāṃ bhuṅkte' ityadhikaraṇasañjñā, dhanurvidhyatīti kartṛsaṃjñā| uktaṃ ca-apādānamuttarāṇīti| iha gārgyo dhānuṣka iti anavakāśābhyāṃ bhapadasaṃjñābhyāmaṅgasaṃjñāyā dhātupratyayeṣu sāvakāśāyā bādhaḥ prāpnoti? jñāpa kātsiddham, yadayam`supi ca',bahuvacane jhalyet',`taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' iti svādiṣu taddhiteṣu cāṅgasya sataḥ kāryaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati-samāviśatyasaṃjñā bhapada saṃjñābhyāmiti| dvaye hi svādayaḥ-yajādayo halādayaśca; tatra yajādaṣu bhasaṃjñā, halādiṣu padasaṃjñeti aṅgasya sataḥ kāryavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt| gurulaghusaṃjñe varṇamātrasya vidhīyete, nadīghisaṃjñe tu tadantasyeti tābhyāṃ samāviśataḥ, tadyathā-vātsībandhuriti| `nadī bandhuni' iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ vātsībandho iti `guroranṛtaḥ' iti plutaśca bhavati| viśca nā ca vinarau, `dvandve ghi' iti pūrvanipātaḥ, vinnorbhāvo vainnam `igantācca laghupūrvāt' ityaṇ,vinarāvacaṣṭe iti vinayati, pravinayya gataḥ `lyapi laghupūrvāt' ityayādeśo bhavati|
bhāṣye tviṣṭaviṣaye samāveśo nyāsāntareṇa sādhitaḥ- prākkaḍārāt paraṃ kāryamiti| tatrāyamarthaḥ- prākkaḍārāt saṃjñākhyaṃ kārayaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti saṃjñāprakaraṇāt saṃjñaivātra kāryamityucyate, parā saṃjñetyeva tu noktam,`vipratiṣedhe vā' iti vakṣyati, tatra paraṃ kāryamityanuvṛttiryathā syāditi tatra yasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ parasyāḥ pūrvayā'nakāśayā bādhaḥ prāptaḥ, sā parā bhavatīti vidhirūpeṇāsya pravṛttiḥ| nanvanakāśayāpipūrvayā naiva parasyā bādhaḥ prāpnoti; virodhābhāvāt, virodhābhāvāt, phalaikyābhāvācca, saṃjñānāmanyatra samāveśasya ddaṣṭatvāt, satyam; etadeva jñāpayati--bhavatyatra prakaraṇe saṃjñānāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| tena parayānavakāśayā pūrvā bādhyate, dvayośca sāvakāśayorvipratiṣedhe paramiti paraiva bhavatīti| niyamaphalasyāpi siddhirasti nyāse'ṅgasaṃjñā parā kāryā, pūrve na bhapadasaṃjñe| evaṃ sarvatra yatra samāveśa iṣṭo'sminpakṣe-`ṛtoraṇ',`chandasi ghas',ṛtviya iti, atra`siti ca' iti-padasaṃjñāviṣaye paraṃ kāryamiti vacanād bhasaṃjñāpi syāt| tataśca `orguṇaḥ' prāproti, sitkaraṇaṃ padatve sati avagrahārthaṃ syāt| `śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ' ityatra ca śeṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, anyathā `anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' iti avyayībhāvasaṃjñaiva bādhiketi śeṣagrahaṇamanarthakam| tadevaṃ śeṣagrahaṇameva pramāṇam--nyāsāntaramapi sūtrakārasyavābhimatamiti||
padamañjarī
vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam|| 1.4.2 ||
vipratiṣedha iti| `ṣidhu śāstre',`ṣidhu gatyām' iti bhauvādikayoranyatarasya rūpam, tasya hi `sedhasicasañjasvañjām' iti ṣatvamiti| upasargavaśācca virodhārthatvam| dhātunāṃ hyupasargavaśādanyaścārtha upajāyate,tadyathā--prahāraḥ, upahāraḥ, anuhāraḥ, saṃhāra iti| `ṣidhū saṃrāddhau' ityasya tu daivādikasya ṣatvaṃ nāsti, `sedhaṣica' iti śapā nirdeśāt| `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti vihitasya tu `sātpadādyoḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ| nanu `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha sāmāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ'iti vacanānnāyaṃ sakāraḥ padādiḥ| ṣatvaviṣaye paribhāṣeyaṃ na bhavati, yadi syād, goṣṭhaḥ, bhūmiṣṭha ityādau sakārasyāpadāditvāt `ādeśapratyayayoḥ'ityeva ṣatvasiddherambādau gāvādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|
paraśabdo'yaṃ triliṅgaḥ-paro deśaḥ, parā senā, paraṃ kāryamiti| ato'yamavyutpannaḥ, pacādyajanto vā, na tu `ṛdorap' ityabantaḥ,tathā hi sati triliṅgatā na syāt||
kṛllyuṭ napuṃsake bhāve striyāṃ ktinnādayo yataḥ|
ato ghañādyāḥ puṃsyeva yathā pākaścayo lavaḥ||
vāsarūpavidhirnnāsti, kṛllyuṭtumun‌khalartheṣu vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti vacanāt| striyāmapi nāsti, `astriyām' iti pratiṣedhāt| ato bhāvaghañādayaḥ puṃsyeva| kartṛvarjite tu kārake puṃnapuṃsakayoḥ, na kathāñcit striyām| paraṃ kāryamiti | paraṃ yatkāryamettvādi tad‌bhavatītyarthaḥ, atha vā-yatparaṃ tatkāryaṃ bhavati, kartavyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ- na kriyāpadatvena kāryaśabdasyānvayaḥ, nāpi paraṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, na tu śāstramityevaṃ śāstrādivyāvṛttaye kāryaśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? yatkāryaṃ kṛtyarhaṃ paraṃ tadbhavatīti vacanavyaktiḥ| arhe kṛtyapratyayaḥ, kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? tulyabalavirodha iti siddhaṃ bhavati| na hyapavādādīnāṃ sannidhāvutsargādīnāṃ kṛtyarhatvam, tairbādhitatvāditi| viśedho vipratiṣedha iti| tadvācitvenaiva loke prasiddhatvād vipratiṣiddhamityukte viruddhamiti gamyate, tasya viṣayaṃ darśayati-yatretyādi| yatra viṣaye, vṛkṣābhyām, vṛkṣoṣvityādau caritārthāvityarthaḥ| vyaktipakṣe tu tadviṣayayoḥ- vidhyoranyatra caritārthatvāsambhavād anyo'rthaḥ prayojanamanayostāvanyārthau| dvau prasaṅgau-kārye dīrghatvettvādike yugapatprāpnutaḥ| sa vipratiṣedhaḥ, vipratiṣedhasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ, tulyabalayorvirodho yasmin sa tathoktaḥ| paraṃ kārye bhavatīti| yatkāryaṃ kṛtyarhaṃ paraṃ tadbhavatītyarthaḥ|
tulyabalavirodha ityasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati-utsargāpavādetyādi| tatra `śyādvyadha' ityākārāntalakṣaṇo ṇapratyaya utsargaḥ, taṃ paramapyanupasarga sāvakāśaṃ bādhitvā'navakāśatvāt `ātaścopasarge' iti ka eva bhavati-saglaḥ, samlaḥ| radherṇici `radhijabhoraci' iti num kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityaḥ, `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiranityā, numi kṛte'kārasyānupadhātvādaprāpteḥ| tatra pūrvo'pi numeva bhavati-randhayatīti| aśiśriyad, adudruvad ityātrāntarbhūtacaṅapekṣatvād iyaṅuvāntaraṅgau bahiraṅgaṃ laghūpadhaguṇaṃ paramapi bādhete, apavādādīnāṃ tu parasparasaṃpradhāraṇāyāṃ nityādapyantaraṅgam, tasmādapavādaḥ| uktaṃ ca--
paraṃ viduḥ pūrvaparopapattau parasya nityasya ca nityameva|
nityāntaraṅgopagame'ntaraṅgaṃ tasmādvidhiḥ prātipado balīyān|| iti|
dvayorekatropanipātaḥ-upapattiḥ, parasya nityasya ceti| atra upa samastadyākṛtau padārthe dvayorapyanyatra kṛtārthatvādvipratiṣedhe sati parasparapratibandhādapravṛttireva prapnoti, tadyathā--yo hi dvayostulyabalayorekaḥ preṣyo bhavati sa tayoḥ paryāyeṇa kāryaṃ kāroti; yadā tamubhau yugapatpreṣayato nānā dikṣu ca kārye bhavatastadā yadyasāvavirodhārtho bhavati ubhayorna karoti, tatra vidhyarthamidaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti tasmin kṛte yadi pūrvasyāpi nimittamasti tadapi bhavatyeva| yathā--bhindhakīti, bhin‌d hi iti sthite paratvāddhibhāvepunaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādakaj bhavati| vyaktau tu padārthe sarvavyaktyuddeśena śāstrasya pravṛttestadviṣayopanipātino'nyatra caritārthatvātparyāyeṇa pravṛttau prāptāyāṃ niyamārthamidam-vipratiṣedhe parameva bhavati, na pūrvamiti| etatsūtrārambhācca pūrvasya lakṣaṇasya tatrānārambho'numīyate, taducyate-`sakṛd‌gatau vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva' iti| tadyathā-juhutāt tvamiti paratvāttātaṅādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena prāptaṃ dhitvaṃ na bhavati| lakṣyānurodhena vyaktyākṛtipadārthāśrayaṇādanayoḥ paribhāṣayorviṣayavibhāgo'vaseyaḥ||
padamañjarī
yū stryākhyau nadī|| 1.4.3 ||
atra hrasvayoridutorgrahaṇe yadyapi savarṇagrahaṇāddīrghayorapi saṃjñā labhyate, hrasvayorapi tu syāt;tataśca he śakaṭe, he dheno atrāpi prāpnoti; iha ca śakaṭibandhuḥ-`nadī bandhuni' iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ prasajyate; iha ca bahuśakaṭiḥ bahudhenuriti-nadyṛtaśca' iti nityaḥ kapsyāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, `ṅiti hrasvaśca' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-ṅityeva hrasvau nadīsaṃjñau bhavataḥ, nānyatreti| kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati vidheyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā, iha cāsti vidheyam, kima? nityā nadīsaṃjñā prāpnoti, sā vibhāṣā vidheyā, ato husvayorapi syādeveti doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā dīrghayorgrahaṇamiti darśayati--ī ca ū ca yū iti| samāsavidhau subadhikārānnaitad dvandvasya vigrahavākyam, kiṃ tarhi? arthapradarśanam| atra cānukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā vibhaktirna kṛtā | kvacittu vibhaktyantameva paṭhyate| nanu dīrghayorgrahaṇe `yū' iti nirdeśo nopadyate, `dīrghājjasi ca' iti pūrvasavarṇapratiṣedhād, ata āha-avibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśa iti| `dīrghājjasisuluk' iti luptatvād `vā chandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇenāpahṛtatvādvā nāsmin vibhaktiḥ śruyate ityavibhaktikaḥ|
anye tu naivāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kintu pṛthak pade ityuktamityāhuḥ| avibhaktikatvaṃ cātukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā| striyamācakṣāte stryākhyāviti| nanu stryākhyā iti prāpnoti, `anupasarge' iti ko vidhīyate, yastu `ātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, ayamakarmopapade caritārthaḥ, karmaṇi tvaṇā bādhyate, yathā vakṣyati--akārādanupapadāt karmopapade vipratiṣedheneti tatrāha--mūlavibhujādiṣu darśanāditi| evaṃ ca kṛtvā idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati--
yasmin daśasahastrāṇi putre jāte gavāṃ dadau|
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyākhyebhyaḥ so'yamuñchena jīvati || iti||
iha īdūtoreveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyeta? tadantasya vā? ādye pakṣe kṛt striyāṃ na syād--ādhyai, brāhmaṇyai, he lakṣmi, he yavāgviti; samudāyo hyatra stryākhyaḥ, na tvīdūnmātram; ṅyūṅoreva tu syāt, striyāṃ vidhānādanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca stryākhyātvāditi dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśityāha--īkārāntamityādi| varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhiriti tadantavidhilābhaḥ, `suptiṅantam' ityatra suptiṅoḥ pratyayatvādanyatrāpi pratyayagrahaṇeṣu tadantavidhirnivāritaḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyatevarṇayorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na pratyayoriti, iyaṅuvaṅsthānapratiṣedhāt| yadi tadantasya saṃjñā, kathaṃ vakṣyati-śīnadyoḥ parataḥ nadyantādaṅgāduttarasya iti? samudāyasya nadītvāttadavayavabhūtāvīdūtāvapi tathoktau|
anye tvāhuḥ- varṇayoreva saṃjñā, samudāyadharmasya stritvasyāvayava āropāt| kṛt striyāmapi bhavati, atra ca liṅgam-iyaṅuvaṅsthānapratiṣedha iti; teṣāṃ gurunadīsaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syād, ekaviṣayatvāt|
yū iti kimiti| `ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' ityatra pṛthagābgrahaṇād āpo na bhaviṣyatīti manyate| mātre duhitre iti `ndyṛtaśca' iti ṛkāragrahaṇamastryartha syād| bahupitṛka ityatretyajñāpakam ṛkārāntānāṃ saṃjñābhāvasya| grāmaṇīḥ khalapūriti| rūpodāharaṇametatsambuddhyantaṃ vā draṣṭvyam| athākhyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā yu striyāmityetāvatā stryarthavṛttitvaṃ labhyate, tatrāha--ākhyāgrahaṇamiti| āṅpūrvaṃsya `khyā' ityasya dhātorgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| kvacittu ākhyagrahaṇaṃ kimiti praśnaḥ| śabdārthastrītva iti ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyātpadāntaramanapekṣya yau svayameva striyamācakṣāte ityāśrīyate| iṣvaśaniprabhṛtīnāṃ tūbhayaliṅgānāṃ śabdārtha eva strītvamiti `ṅiti hrasvaśca' iti nadīsaṃjñā bhavatyeva| evaṃ paṭurānīyatāmityukte striyamapyānīya kṛtībhavati|
anye tvāhuḥ-ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyānniyama āśrīyate-striyameva yāvācakṣāte na tu liṅgantarayuktam iti| grāmaṇīkhalapūśabdayostu kriyāśabdatvena triliṅgatvānna bhavati| iṣviśaniprabhṛtīnāṃ tu strīviṣayantavābhāve'pi `ṅiti hrasvaśca' ityāyatra kevalasya strīśabdasyaivānuvṛttirnākhyāgrahaṇasyeti bhavatīti teṣāmāṅpūrvasya dhyāyateḥ kvipi samprasāraṇe-ādhyai brāhmaṇyai ityatrāpi na syāt| tasmātpūrva eva prakāra āśrayaṇīyaḥ|
kathaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇam-grāmaṇyai striyai iti, khalapvai striyai iti? ucyate; kriyāśabdatve'pyetayoḥ puṃsi mukhyā vṛttiḥ, puṃsāmeva hyamucito dharmo yaduta grāmanayanaṃ nāma| evaṃ khalapavanamapi| ādhyānaṃ tu stripuṃsasādhāraṇamiti viśeṣaḥ|
`pathamaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ ca prayojanaṃ kviblupsamāsāḥ,' yaḥ śabdaḥ prathamastritvayuktadravyamabhidhāya paścādyena kenacitprakārāntareṇa liṅgāntarasaṃyuktaṃ dravyāntaramāha, tasya tadānīmastryākhyatvādaprāptā saṃjñā vidhīyate| kvip--kumārīmicchati kumārīyati, kumārīyateḥ kvip, kumārī brāhmaṇaḥ, tasmai kumāryai brāhyāṇāya| lup--`lummanuṣye' iti lup, kharakuṭyai brāhmaṇāya| yadyapyatra yacuktavadbhāvāt strītvamapyasti, tathāpi svāśrasya puṃstvasyānivṛtternā'yaṃ striyāmeva varttata ityākhyāgrahaṇādaprāptiḥ | samāsaḥ- atitantryai brāhmaṇāya| avayavastrīviṣayatvāt siddham, samāse tāvadavayavastantrīśabdaḥ striyāmeva vartata iti tadānīmeva saṃjñā, tataśca varṇasaṃjñāpakṣe samudāyasya nadyantatvāt kāryasiddhiḥ; tadantapakṣe tu `aṅgadhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' iti vacanād atitantrībandhurityatrāpi `nadī bandhuni' iti svaraḥ siddhaḥ; nadyā pūrvapadasya viśeṣaṇāt, kvibluporapi pūrva striyāmeva vartitvāt, paścādapi tadaparityāgenārthāntare vṛttiḥ| tatrārthāntarasaṃsargātprāgevāntaraṅgatvātpravṛttā saṃjñā satyapi paścālliṅgāntarayoge tasya ca bahiraṅgatvānna nivartiṣyate| yadyevam, iyaṅuvaṅsthānapratiṣedhe yaṇsthānapratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ; avayavayoriyaṅuvaṅsthānatvād| yathā hyavayavasya striviṣayatvātsamudāyasya saṃjñā bhavati, tathāvayavasyeyuvasthānatvāt samudāyasya yaṇsthānasyāpi pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā--dhiyau, ādhyāviti? siddhaṃ tvaṅgarūpagrahaṇād, yasyāṅgasyeyuvau tatpratiṣedhādaṅgasyeyaṅuvaṅ‌vidhanāsamarthyādaṅgasyākṣepaḥ, tena yasyāṅgasyeyaṅuvaṅau nirvarttetetasya nadīsaṃjñā niṣedhaḥ| ādhyai ityatra tvavayavasyāṅgatvaṃ nāsti, aṅgasya `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇvidhānād iyaṅuvaṅsthānatā nāstīti niṣedhābhāvaḥ| etadarthameva tatra sthānagrahaṇam--iyaṅuvaṅoryadā sthitistadā pratiṣedho yathā syād, yadā tvapavādena bādhastadā mā bhūditi| evaṃ `ṅiti hrasvaśca' ityatrāpyaṅgasyākṣepāt so'pi vidhiraṅgasyaiva strītve bhavati, nāvayavasya--śakaṭyai, atiśakaṭaye brāhmaṇāya; śriyai, atiśriye brāhmaṇāya||
padamañjarī
neyaṅuvaṅasthānāvastrī|| 1.4.4 ||
iyaṅuvaṅo sthānamanayoriti| vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ| anye tvadhikaraṇe lyuṭaṃ vidhāya kartari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaṃ kurvanti| atha katham `vimānanā subhru kutaḥ piturgṛhe' iti? pramāda evāyam| anyetvāhuḥ-anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, sakṛdvaddhatvāt | tathā ca paribhāṣā-`sakṛdvaddhamanityaṃ dvirbaddhañca subaddham' iti| atra jñāpakaṃ tado dāvacanamityāhuḥ||
padamañjarī
vā''mi|| 1.4.5 ||
saṃhitāsāmye'pi ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya grahaṇam‌, na tu dvitīyaikavacanasya, nadīkāryābhāvāt| nāpi saptamyekavacanasya; tasya nadīsaṃjñottarakālam`ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' iti vidhānāt| na ca `āmi iti viṣayasaptamī yujyate;`tasminnipinirdiṣṭe' iti vacanāt, tadāha-āmi parato vā nadīsaṃjñau na bhavata iti| śrīṇāmiti | nadīsañjñāpakṣe `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ'||
padamañjarī
ṅiti hrasvaśca|| 1.4.6 ||
yadyatra hrasvaviśeṣaṇārtham `yū' iti nānuvartyata, tadehāpisyād--mātre duhitre iti, tasmāttadihānuvartate| nanvevamapi viśeṣaṇaṃ na prakalpateyū hrasvāviti; yadi yū, na hrasvau; atha hrasvau, na yū;yū hrasvau ceti vipratiṣiddham; āhāyaṃ yū hrasvāviti, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ- yvoḥ hrasvāviti, kau ca yvoḥ hrasvau savarṇau ? tadāha--hrasvaśca yvoḥ sambandhī yaḥ stryākhya iti| atrāpi samudāyadharmasyāvayava āropād hrasvayoḥ stryākhyatvam, tadantaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā| iyavaṅuṅsthānau ca yū iti| nanvekaṃ `yū' grahaṇamanuvartate, tacca hrasvaviśeṣaṇa evopakṣīṇam, tatkathaṃ punaḥ `yū' iti labhyate ? ucyate; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa saṃjñinaḥ samuccayārthaḥ, iyaṅuvaṅsthānāviti prakṛtaṃ yvoreva ca tatsthānatvamityarthād `yū' iti labhyate| svaritatvādanuvṛttaṃ tu `yū' ityetad hrasvaviśeṣaṇamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ||
padamañjarī
śeṣo ghyasakhi|| 1.4.7 ||
`ā dhṛṣādvā' ityasminnadhikāre `śiṣa asarvopayoge, vipūrvo'tiśaye' iti paṭhyate, tatra ṇicpakṣe karmaṇi `erac', anyathā ghañ| hrasva iti varttata iti| anyathā grāmaṇyāderapi syād astryākhyatvena śeṣatvād, yasya nadīsaṃjñā na vihitā tasya śeṣatve mātre ityatrāpi syāditi matvā pṛcchati--kaśceti| itarastu hrasvaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ `yū' ityasyānanuvṛttimāśrityāha--hrasvamiti| hrasvāntamityarthaḥ| yadāha--ivarṇovarṇāntāditi| kvacittu hrasverṇovarṇāntamiti pāṭhaḥ, hrasvātmako ya ivarṇa uvarṇaśca tadantamityarthaḥ| hrasvena śeṣasya viśeṣaṇatvāt tadantavidhiḥ| evaṃ ca `asakhi' iti sakhiśabdasya pratiṣedho na tatsambandhina ikārasya, kiṃ saddhaṃ bhavati? iha śobhanassakhā asya susakhiḥ, susakherāgacchatīti ghisaṃjñā siddhā bhavati| na hyayaṃ samudāyaḥ sakhiśabdaḥ, tadantavidhiśca grahaṇavatā prātiṣedhādihāpi na syāt| yadi tadante niṣedho na bhavati `yasyeti ca' ityatra ivarṇasya ī iti yadudāharaṇaṃ sakhiśabdāt `sakhyaśiśrīti bhāṣāyām' iti ṅīṣi sakhi ī iti sthite ikārasya lopaḥ| asati tu lope savarṇadīrdhasya pūrva pratyantavadbhāvāt sakhīmatikrānto'tisakhiḥ, atisakherāgacchatītyatrāsakhīti dhisaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ syāditi tannepapadyate| satyapyantavadbhāvena sakhigrahaṇena grahaṇe samudāyasya sakhiśabdādanyatvāt| yadā khalu puṃlliṅgepyatisakhiriti bhavati, tadā kaḥ prasaṅgo yadantavad‌bhāvena syāt? yattu tatrodāhariṣyate so'nāsthāvādo draṣṭvyaḥ| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| ekasaṃjñādhikārādeva hi stryākhyasya ṅiti nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe ghisaṃjñā na bhavaṣyati||
padamañjarī
patiḥ samāsa eva|| 1.4.8 ||
siddhāyāmiti| prāptāyāmityarthaḥ, na punarniṣpannāyām, na hi niṣpannāyāṃ niyamena nivṛttiḥ śakyā vaktum| patiśabdaḥ samāsa eva ghisaṃjño bhavatīti| kiṃ punaridaṃ samāsāvayavasya patiśabdasya saṃjñā vidhīyate? āhosvittadantasamāsasya? yadi samāsasya ? patiśca gṛhaṃ ca patigṛhe-atra dvandve ghiḥ iti pūrvanipāto na prāpnoti; atha patiśabdasya? prajāpatinetyādikasya ghisaṃjñākārtha na prāpnoti| atha vā `patiḥ samāsaeva' iti niyamena kiṃ vyāvartyate? asamastaḥ patiśabdaḥ| patiśabdasya vyāvartyamānā kena tadantasya vyāvartyate? patiśabdasambandhī ya īkārastadāśrayā sā ghisañjñā bhavati, yadi samāsa evetyartho vivakṣitaḥ| tena samāse patiśabdasyānantyasyāpi bhavati-patiśca gṛhaśca patigṛhe, `dvandve ghiḥ' iti pūrvanipātaḥ| patiśabdāntasya samāsasyāpi bhavati-prajāpatineti, ata eva vṛttikṛtā patiśabdānurūpasūtrārtho darśitaḥ| udāharaṇantu tadantānurūpaṃ darśitam| atha katham
naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klībe'tha patite patau|
pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate|| iti?
chandovaddaṣayaḥ kurvanti| atha pūrvatraiva `asakhipatī' iti kasmānnoktam? uttaratra patyureva vikalpo yathā syāt| kiñca `asakhipatī' ityucyamāne patiśabdasya samāse'pi na syāt--patigṛhe iti| tathā ca sakhiśabdasya samāsāvayavasyāpi ghisañjñāyā abhāvāt--sakhigṛhe,gṛhasakhāyāviti cāniyamaḥ pūrvanipātasya||
padamañjarī
ṣaṣṭhīyuktaśchandasi vā|| 1.4.9 ||
ṣaṣṭhyantena śabdeneti| ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaghaktyā yukta iti tu na bhavati| tathā hi-ṣaṣṭhyāmityeva brūyād, yuktagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| atra kecidyogasyāvarjanīyatvādyukta ityeva viśiṣṭo yogaḥ pratyeṣyata iti manyante, vacanamantareṇa viśeṣo durjñāna ityutaram| ayamatra yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ-`ṣaṣṭhīyuktaḥ chandasi',ṣaṣṭhīyuktaḥ patiśabdaḥ chandasi ghisañjño bhavati; tato `vā', chandasītyeva, yacca yāvacca śāstre kāryaṃ tatsarvaṃ chandasi vikalpena bhavatiḥ sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyanta ityarthaḥ| ubhayatravibhāṣā ceyam, `bahulaṃ chandasi' ityādikastvasyā eva prapañcaḥ||
padamañjarī
hrasvaṃ laghu|| 1.4.10 ||
iha sarpiṣṭvāmityatra `hrasvāttādau taddhite' iti ṣatvārthaṃ hrasvasaṃjñayā garusaṃjñāyā samāveśa iṣyate| atatakṣadityatra tu sanvadbhāvanivṛttyarthaṃ laghusaṃjñāyā gurusaṃjñayā bādha iṣyate| ato hrasvapradeśeṣu saṃyogaparasyāpi mātrikasyagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, laghupradeśeṣu mā bhūditi yathāpradeśe saṃjñādvayaṃ karttavyam||
saṃyoge guru|| 1.4.11 ||
dīrgha ca|| 1.4.12 ||
padamañjarī
yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi pratyaye'ṅgam|| 1.4.13 ||
karteti| luṭ| kariṣyatīti| lṛṭ| akariṣyaditi| lṛṅ,`ṛddhanoḥ sye' itīṭ| yasmāditi saṃjñinirdeśāthamiti| nanu tadādītyanena saṃjñī nirdiśyate, na yasmādityanena tatrāha-tadādītisaṃbandhāditi| sati hi yasmādityasmin tadādītyanena saṃjñā nirdeṣṭuṃ śakyate, nānyathā | sati hi parāmarśanīye tadityanena parāmarśo bhavati, anyathā tadādītyasaṃbaddhameva syāt| `nerviśaḥ' ityupasargādvidhirastīti| yadyapi niratra dhātuviśeṣaṇam-- neḥ paro yo viśiriti, dhātostaṅ‌vidhānād niyamavidhirapi dhātoriva nopasargāt, tathāpyupasargasyāpi tatrānvayo'stīti matvā evamuktam|
vidhigrahaṇaṃ kimiti| `yasmātpratyaya' ityukate sākāṅkṣatvād yasmādvidhīyata ityadhyāhariṣyata iti praśnaḥ | paraśabdasyāpyadhyāhāraḥ syādityuttaram| strī iyatīti| idaṃ parimāṇamasyāḥ `kimidabhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' iyādeśaḥ,`idaṃkimorīśkī',`yasyetica' iti lopaḥ,`ugitaśca' iti ṅīp, strīśabdāt sorhalṅyādilopaḥ| atra iyacchabde parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syād bhasaṃjñā ceti tannimitto yasyeti lopaḥ prasajyeta| iśādeśasya yasyeti lopaḥ, tasyābhīyasyāpyasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati, prāgbhādasiddhatvamiti keṣāñcidabhyupagamād| sthānivadbāvo'pi nāsti, padāntaranirapekṣe hīyatīśabde vyutpādyamāne strīśabdo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ|
nanu kriyamāṇe vidhigrahaṇe syādeva saṃjñā, astyeva hyatra strīśabdād vibhakteḥ pratyayasya vidhiriyatpratyayaśca paraḥ, naiṣaḥ; sati vidhigrahaṇe pratyāsatteryasmādyaḥ pratyayo vihitastasminneva pratyaye paratastadādyaṅgamityartho bhavati| iha ca strīśabdādvihito luptaḥ, śruyamāṇaśca na tato vihitaḥ, tadādigrahaṇamanarthakam, yattadornityasambandhādeva yasmātpratyayo vidhīyate tadaṅgamityarthalābhād ata āha-tadādivacanamiti| syādayo vikaraṇāḥ| ādiśabdena śabādergrahaṇam| asati tadādigrahaṇe yacchabdavattacchabdasyādhyāhārād yasmātpratyayavidhistasyaiva saṃjñā syād na tu tata ārabhya ā tasmātprayayādyaḥ saṃghātaḥ tasya| tataśca kariṣyāvaḥ, pacāvaḥ, dīvyāvaḥ, tudāva ityādau `ato dīrgho yañi ' iti dīrgho na syāt; syādyantasya samudāyasyānaṅgatvāt| tataśca pāpāva ityādāveva syāt, `payagatau' yaṅlugantasya `lopo vyorvali' iti lope rūpam| kuṇḍānīti| yadā num parādiḥ, tadā `supi ca' iti dīrghaḥ sidhyati| dadhīnītyādāvanakārāntatvānna sidhyati, pūrvāntapakṣe sāmānītyādivatsidhyati| yadā tvabhaktapakṣaḥ tadaitatprayojanaṃ tadādigrahaṇasya, pūrvāntapakṣastu tatra sthita ityaprayojanametat|
nanu ca `prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca' iti numgrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasyābhakto numityabhiprāyo lakṣyate, anyathā māṣavāpāṇītyatra prātipadikāntatvādvibhaktinakāratvādvā ṇatvasiddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāt? naitatsūṣṭhūcyate; tatra hi samāsaprātipadikānto na gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvapadādityanuvṛttestadākṣiptasyottarapadaprātipadikasyānto gṛhyate, samudāyabhaktaśca num uttarapadaprātipadikānto na bhavati| tataśca yathā gargāṇāṃ bhaginī gargabhaginītyatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, tathā numo'pi na syāt| na tarhidānīmidaṃ bhavati-gargabhagiṇīti? bhavati, yadaitaddhākyaṃ bhavati-gargāṇāṃ bhago gargabhagaḥ so'syā astīti| tadā hyanuttarapadasthatvāt pūrvapadāt sañjñāyāmeveti niyamābhāvaḥ, tadyathā- mātṛbhogāya hito mātṛbhogīṇa iti| evamapi māṣān vaptuṃ śīlamasyāḥ māṣavāpiṇī-atra na prāpnoti, ṅībatrottarapadasyānto na tu nakāraḥ| nakāra evātrāntaḥ, katham? gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛd‌biḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ, ataḥ syādyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tadādigrahaṇaṃ numyapīṣṭaṃ sādhayatīti matvā numgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| yadi tadādītyucyate kartetyādau na prāpnoti, na hyatra tadādi kiñcidasti, kiṃ tarhi? tadeva, vyapadeśivadbhāvādbhaviṣyati, vākyabhedādvā, yasmātpratyayavidhistadaṅgam, tadādi ca| iha`prakṛtyādi pratyaye'ṅgam' iti iyatā siddhe gurunirheśa eva liṅgaṃ vākyabhedasya|
atha kathaṃ bhinatti, saṃcaskaraturityatra sanumkasya ca samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñā? kathaṃ ca na syād? iha tasya vā grahaṇaṃ bhavati? tadādervā? na cedaṃ tannāpi tadādi| idamapi tadādi, katham? naivaṃ vijñāyate-sa ādirasyatattadādīti| kathaṃ tarhi tasyādistadādistadādirasyeti? tathāpi uṣṭramukhavadekasyādiśabdasya lopaḥ| evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne bhinattītyatra yasmātpratyayavidhibhidestasya ādirbhakāraḥ, sa ādiḥ sannantasya samudāyasyeti sidhyati| evaṃ saṃcaskaraturityatrāpi `tanmadhyapatitastad‌grahaṇena gṛhyate' iti cātrobhayatra sajñāsiddhiḥ| athātra śnamaḥ pūrvasya bhiśabdasyaṅgasañjñā kasmānna bhavati? bhavatu, ko doṣaḥ? guṇastāvat`sārvadhātukamapid' iti ṅittvādeva na bhaviṣyati| iha anakti, bhanakti- `ato dīrgho yañi' iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, tiṅīti tatra varttate| atha vā-`yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, tiṅīti tatra varttate| atha vā-`yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti vacanādyasmin pratyaye vidhīyamāne yatpañcamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tatra tadevāṅgam, śnami ca vidhīyamāne ye pañcamyā nirdiṣṭā rudhirādayo na te tatra parataḥ, ye'tra śnami paratoti'prabhṛtayo na te pañcamyā nirdiṣṭā iti sañjñābhāvaḥ|
śyarthamiti| `caturthī tadartha' iti samāsaḥ| asti hyatra caturthyekavacanasya vidhirityasati punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇeṅgaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvābhāvāt vastuto'ṅgamātrāśraya iyaṅ syāt| sati tu saptamīnirddiṣṭapratyayagrahaṇe'ṅgaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdo bhavati, tataścāṅgasyeyaṅ bhavati| acītyakte yadapekṣaṃ yadaṅgam, tatra tasyājādāviti vijñānādarthaśabde parata imaṅuvaṅau na bhaviṣyataḥ|
kiṃ punaraṅgasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam? aṅgasyetyadhikāraḥ| naitadasti; yadetadaṅgasyetyetat pratyaya iti vakṣyāmīti| evamapi prākarot praihiṣṭa-sopasargasyāḍāṭau prāpnutaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ, pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādergrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| kva punareṣā paribhāṣā? nanveṣāpyatraiva yogavibhāgena siddhā, `yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi pratyaye' ityetāvāneko yogaḥ| pratyaye gṛhyamāṇe yasmāt tasya vidhistadādi gṛhyata ityarthaḥ, tena `ñnityādiḥ' ityādau yatra pratyayaḥ saptamyā nirdiśyate tatra tadādergrahaṇam, tena devadatto gārgya iti saṃghātasya ñitsvaro na bhavati| `supaātmanaḥ kyac' ityatra tu supā karmaṇo viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhau siddhe mahāntaṃ putramityādāvatiprasaṅge tadādiniyamena vyudāsaḥ| yadi tadādiniyamaḥ kriyate strīpratyaye'pi syāt, tataḥ ṣyaṅantasya pūrvapadasyocyamānaṃ saṃprasāraṇaṃ paramakārīṣagandhīputra ityatra na syād-yatpūrvapadaṃ na tatṣyaṅantam, yatṣyaṅantaṃ na tatpūrvapadam, naiṣa doṣaḥ, `neyaṅuvaṅsthānāvastrī' ityataḥ`astrī' ityanuvarttate, tacca svarūpapadārthakatvena prakṛtamapīhārthapadārthakaṃ saṃpadyate, tadayamartho bhavati-pratyayagrahaṇe tadādi gṛhyate prakṛtamapīhārthapadārthakaṃ saṃpadyate, tadayamartho bhavati-pratyayagrahaṇe tadādi gṛhyate strī cennābhidhīyate| strīpratyaye tadādiniyamo nāstītyarthaḥ| yadyevam,atikārīṣagandhyāputraḥ-atrāpi prāpnoti, pradhānaṃ yā strī tasyāmeva tadādiniyamapratiṣedhaḥ, apradhānastriyāṃ tu tadādiniyamo bhavatyeva| tena yāvānaṃśaḥ striyaṃ prādhānyena pratipādayati, tāvataḥ strīpratyayāntasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tadgrahaṇe tu gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti `gatiranantaraḥ' ityanantaragrahaṇaṃ jñāpayiṣyate|
padamañjarī
suptintaṃ padam|| 1.4.14 ||
suptiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti| subiti saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; yadi syāt, ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ padatvābhāvādeva nalopasyāprasaṅgāt `na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| saptamībahuvacanasya ca pakāreṇa pratyāhāro na kapaḥ pakāreṇa; tasyāhārastadā svaravidhāvapi tathaiveti suptvādeva svarasiddheḥ pittvamanarthakameva syāt| yadi ca subgrahaṇeṣu kapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāro'bhimataḥ syāt `supyasarvanāmasthāne' ityeva brūyāt, `svādiṣu' iti gurunirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt| brāhmaṇā iti| padatvādrutvaviśarjanīyau|
nanu yasmātpratyayavidhistadādītyanuvṛttasya suptiṅbhyāṃ viśeṣaṇādeva tadantasya grahaṇaṃ siddham, nārtho'ntagrahaṇena, tatrāha-padasaṃjñāyāmiti| ihāsatyantagrahaṇe suptiṅāmeva saṃjñā syāt, tataścāgniṣvityādau `sātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ syādityāśaṅgya kriyamāṇamantagrahaṇamuktasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ saṃpadyate| gaurībrāhmaṇitareti| tarabantasya ghasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tatrottarapade parato gaurīśabdasya puṃvad‌bhāvaṃ bādhitvā paratvād hrasvatvaṃ syāt| tarapi tu parato brāhmaṇīśabdasya na syāt; tataśca gaurībrāhmaṇatareti syād, gaurabrāhmaṇitareti ceṣyate| vṛttau tu samāsapradarśanaparaṃ vākyamupāttam, na tvetatkāryodāharaṇam| gaurabrāhmaṇitareti samāse rūpam||
padamañjarī
naḥ kyeḥ|| 1.4.15 ||
kya iti kyackyaṣkyaṅāmiti| `saṃjñāyāṃ samaja' ityasya tu kyapograhaṇaṃ na bhavati; prayojanabhāvāt| na tāvanmanyetyatra nalopaḥ prayojanam, satyapi padatve'prātipadikatvāt;subantamityanuvṛttervā kyapi vidhyarthametanna bhavati|
nanu kyajādayaḥ subantāddhidhīyanta iti pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhaṃ padatvam, nārtha etena tatrāha-siddhe satīti| nāntameveti| kya eva nāntamityevaṃ tu viparītaniyamo na bhavati; `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' iti niṣedhāt| vācyatīti| atra padatvābhāvātkutvajaśtve na bhavataḥ ye tu gosamānākṣaranāntādeva kyaj bhavati, nānyebhya ityāhuḥ, teṣāṃ kyaṅkyaṣoreva niyamasya vyāvarttyaṃ pradarśanīyam-tapasyatītyādau||
padamañjarī
siti ca || 1.4.16 ||
bhavadīya iti| padatvājjatvam| ūrṇāyuriti padasaṃjñāyā nirastatvād yasyeti lopābhāvaḥ| evam ṛtviya iti `orguṇaḥ' na bhavati, cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ tena bhuvad‌dhārayatormatośchandasi `tasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñāṃ bādhitvā padasaṃjñā bhavati, tena bhuvadvadbhyaḥ, dhārayadvad‌bhyaḥ||
padamañjarī
svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne|| 1.4.17 ||
svādiṣviti suśabdādekavacanāditi| saptamībahuvacanādārabhya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; `asarvanāmasthāne' iti niṣedhāt, yadi hi rājaśrita ityādau sarvanāmasthāne `subantam' iti prāptāyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ niṣedho'bhīṣṭaḥ syāt, tatraiva `asarvanāmasthāne' iti brūyāt| atha rājavānityādāvantarvartiniṣedha iti ced, na; lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt, `tasau matvarthe' iti padasaṃjñābādhanāya bhasaṃjñāvidhānācca| ā kapa iti| yadi punaḥ saptamībahuvacanaparyantā ekaviṃśatiḥ pratyayā gṛhyeran, tadā sub‌grahaṇameva kuryād, anuvarttayedvā; `asarvanāmasthāne' ityanena sambandhātsaptamyā vipariṇāmāt siddham| kimatha punarā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhyante, yāvatā subantāttaddhitotpattiḥ samarthādhikārāt, svārthikā api subantādeva,`ghakālataneṣu' iti liṅgat, tataśca rājatvaṃ rājatetyādāvantarvartinyā vibhaktyā subantaṃ padamityeva siddham? satyam; bhasaṃjñārthaṃ tvā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhītāḥ| rājatvamityādi| subantatve'pi| paratvādanena padatvaṃ yuktamityeṣāmupanyāsaḥ|
rājānau, rājāna iti| atrāpadatvānnalopābhāvaḥ, rājetyatra tu pratyayalakṣaṇena niṣedho na bhavati `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' iti liṅgānnaitalliṅgamupapadyate| he varmanniti napuṃsake lumatā lupte sarvanāmasthāne niṣedhābhāvādastyeva padatvamiti tatrārthavān pratiṣedhaḥ| evaṃ tarhi nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ- sarvanāmasthāne neti, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāso'yam-padanyatsarvanāmasthānaditi| sarvanāmasthāne na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ; yadi kenacitprāpnoti, bhavatyeva, pūrveṇa prāpnoti, atha vā-anantarā yā prāptiḥ sā pratiṣidhyate | kutaḥ punaretad? `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā'| atha vā-`sarvanāmasthāne' ityatra yacītyapakṛṣya sambadhyate, tena yajādau padasaṃjñā niṣidhyate, na halādāviti rājetyāte, svādau, evaṃ hi `asarvanāmasthāne' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? uttarārtha suṭhyapi napuṃsake bhasaṃjñā yathā syāt, sāmnī ityatra mā bhūd| bhasañjñā `vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' iti vacanasāmarthyādevābhasyāpyallopo bhaviṣyati| tatrāyamapyartho yasyetyādau `śyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati; abhatvādeva siddham| iha tarhi supadī brāhmaṇakule iti pad‌bhāvo na syādabhatvāt, iha ca sāmāni paśyeti bhatvādallopaḥ syāditi yathānyāsamevāstu||
padamañjarī
yaci bham|| 1.4.18 ||
yakārādāvityādi| `yasminvidhistadādāvalprahaṇe' iti tadādividhiḥ| gārgya ityādau bhatvādyasyeti lopaḥ| nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānamiti| dve apyete upasaṃkhyāne chandoviṣaye ityāhuḥ| nabha iveti| tṛtīyāsamarthādvatervidhānāt tulyārthāpadarśanametat, nabhasā tulyaṃ varttata iti vigrahaḥ| padanibandhanakāryanivṛrttyathameva caiṣāṃ bhasañjñā vidhīyate, na tu bhatvanimittaṃ kāryaṃ yathā syāditi; asambhavāt|
nabhasvad, aṅgirasvaditi| atrāpadatvādrutvābhāvo manuṣvadityatra padatve rutvaṃ syād na tu ṣatvam; apadāntasyeti vacanāt|
vṛṣaṇvasuḥ vṛṣaṇāśva iti| padatve sati `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhāṇṇatvaṃ na syāt, nalopaśca syād| bhatve'pyallopo na bhavati; anaṅgatvāt||
padamañjarī
tasau matvarthe|| 1.4.19 ||
nabhasvad, aṅgirasvaditi| atrāpadatvādrutvābhāvo manuṣvadityatra padatve rutvaṃ syād, na tu ṣatvam; apadāntasyeti vacanāt|
vṛṣaṇvasuḥ, vṛṣaṇaśva iti| padatve sati `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhāṇṇatvaṃ na syāt, nalopaśca syād| bhatve'pyallopo na bhavati; anaṅgatvāt||
tasau matvarthe|| matvarthīyenākṣiptāyāḥ prakṛtestakārasakārābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirityāha-takārasakārāntamiti| matvarthe pratyaye iti| vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, matorartho matvarthastatra yaḥ pratyayo varttate tasminnityarthaḥ| atha vā samānādhikaraṇe matuśabdena sāhacaryāttadartho lakṣyate-maturartho yasya tasminnityarthaḥ|
udaśvitvāniti| bhatvāt padatvābhāve jaśtvaṃ na bhavati, `jhayaḥ' iti vatvam| udakena śvayati varddhate udaśvit, kvipi `udaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti nipātanāt saṃprasāraṇābhāvaḥ, saṃjñāyāmudbhāvaḥ| payasvīti| `asmāyāmedhāstrājo viniḥ' bhatvādrutvābhāvaḥ|
athārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `matau'ityucyate, svādiṣviti varttate, vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, matau ye svādayaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ śabde nāma śabde varttate'sambhavāt, arthe vṛttirvijñāsyate? yadyevaṃ labhyeta, kṛtaṃ syāt; tattu na labhyam, na hi sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum, tataśca matāveva syāt-payasvān yaśasvāniti, iha tu na syāt-payasvī, yaśasvīti, ato'rthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| yadyarthagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, matupi na prāpnoti; tasyārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt, satyam; arthaviśeṣaṇaṃ matub, viśeṣyākāro'pi tatrāsti| asyāstyasminniti ca matupo'rthaḥ, sa ca vinyādīnāmiva matupo'pyaviśiṣṭaḥ, yathā-devadattaśālāyāmāsīnā brāhmaṇā ānīyantāmityukte viśeṣaṇabhūto'pi devadattaḥ sita brāhmaṇaye ānīyate| yatra upalakṣyākārasyāsambhavaḥ tatraivopalakṣaṇasya kārthāyogaḥ, tadyathā-citragurānīyatāmiti, na hi citragavīṇāṃ gāvaḥ santi||
padamañjarī
ayasmayādīnicchandasi|| 1.4.20 ||
yadi saṃjñā vidhīyeta ānantarthādbhasaṃjñāvidhānadvāreṇaiva nipātanaṃ syāt, padasaṃjñā na syād, bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt, tasmātsādhutvameva yuktaṃ vidhātumiti matvāha-ayasmayādinītyādi| sādhutve prakāraviśeṣaṃ darśayati| bhapadasaṃjñādhikāra ityādi| dvāram-upāyaḥ| ayasmayamiti| ayaso vikāraḥ `dvyacaśchandasi' iti mayaṭ||
padamañjarī
bahuṣu bahuvacanam|| 1.4.21 ||
bahuvacanaṃ vihitamiti| tataśca tasya vidheyavibhaktinirddiṣṭasyāpi prāptatvādanuvādyatvam, na tu vidheyatvamiti bhāvaḥ| bahutvasaṃkhyānubhūtavibhaktirnirdiṣṭāpyapratvādvidhīyata ityāha-tasyāneneti| ihaṃ cāparamanena granthena darśitam-svādividhivākyena hi bhinnametad vākyam,| tatrāpi vidhyarthaṃ na tu niyamārthamiti| yadāha-bahuvacanaṃ vihitamiti| bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyata iti ca| yadi punarekavākyatayā viśiṣṭavidhiḥ syād,itaretaraśrayaṃ prāpnoti-vihitānāṃ jasādīnāṃ bahuvacanasaṃjñā,saṃjñayā ca vidhānamiti| kiṃ cāvyayebhyo niḥsaṃbhyaḥ svadayo na syurato bhinnavākyatvameva yuktam,tatrāpi vidhyarthatvameva|
iha kecinmanyante-svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādyātmakaḥ pañcakaḥ prātipadikārtha iti| āditastrika ityanye| tatra śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ svārthaḥ, sa cāneka prakāraḥ- svarūpaṃ jātirguṇaḥ kriyā dravyaṃ sambandhaśceti, ḍittho gauḥ śuklaḥ pācakaḥ yaṣṭiḥ puruṣaḥ daṇḍīti| jātyādiśabdeṣvapi jātyādimātraniṣṭheṣu svarūpameva pravṛttinimittam| abhidhānābhidheyayorabhedādhyāsāt śabdarūpānurakto'rtho'bhidhīyate| asya gauriti nāma, ayaṃ gauriti ca pratītiveṣo bhidyate| atra heturvaiyadhikaraṇyam, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca| tatra jātyādivat svarūpamapi śabdata eva pratipannamapyarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ manyante| uktaṃ ca-
grāhyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ ca dve śaktī tejaso yathā|
tathaiva sarvaśabdānāmete pṛthagavasthite || iti|
tena svarūpamapi svārtho yujyate|
svārthasya yatra viśrāntirvācyaṃ dravyaṃ tadiṣyate||
paryavasānabhūmirityarthaḥ| taccānekaprakāram-jātirguṇaḥ kriyā dravyaṃ svarūpamiti; gau sūklaḥ, pākaḥ, ḍitthaḥ,`tūṣṇīmi bhūvaḥ' iti| liṅgaṃ strītvādi| saṃkhyāekatvādi, karmādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ kārakaviśeṣāḥ|
tadiha dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ vṛttikāreṇāśritam| anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi śabdārthaniścayaḥ, yasya śabdasyānvaye yo'rthaḥ pratīyate, vyatireke ca vyatiricyate sa tasyārthaḥ| vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau ityādau ca tattadvacanānvaye sā sā saṃkhyā pratīyate vayatireke ca vyatiricyate satyapi prakṛtyanvaye, tena manyāmahe-vacanārthaḥ saṃkhyeti| tathā vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣeṇa vṛkṣāyetyādau tattattrikānvaye sa sa karmādiḥ pratīyate, vyatireke ca vyatiricyate, tena manyāmahe-trikārthaḥ karmādiriti| yadyapi payo dadhi madhvityādāvantareṇa vacanamantareṇa ca trikaṃ sa so'rthaḥ pratīyate, naitāvatā vibhaktyarthatvaṃ hīyate , na hi gargā ityatrāntareṇāpi yañamapatyārthaḥ pratīyate iti gārgya ityatrāpi prakṛterivāpatyamartha iti yuktaṃ vaktum, pacati pacataḥ pacantītyādau vacanānvaye saṃkhyānvayādvyatireke ca vyatirekād vacanārtha eva saṃkhyā, na dhātvarthaḥ| abibharbhavānityādau yadyapyantareṇāpi tiṅaṃ karttā saṃkhyā ca pratīyate, tathāpi naitāvatā tarvatra prakṛtyarthatvaṃ yaktam| na hi bhit, chidityādau antareṇāpi pratyayaṃ karttā pratīyate iti bhettetyādāvapi karttā prakṛtyartho bhavati| tadevaṃ trika eva prātipadikārthaḥ|
dhātośca kriyaiva vācyetyasatyasminnanirddiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe trika eva jasādibahuvacanaṃ syād, na bahutva iti bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhiyate| sūtre'pyantareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, bahutva ityarthaḥ| āśrayāgatasya bahutvasya guṇe āropād bahuṣviti bahuvacanam| āropasya prayojanaṃ nānā''dhārasya saṃkhyārūpasya bahutvasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| tenaikāśrayaṃ vaipulyaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyaṃ na bhavatibahurodana iti|
kecinmanyante-saṃkhyākarmādayaśca parasparamananvitāḥ, prakṛtyarthena cānvitā vibhaktibhirabhidhīyante-vṛkṣānpaśya, ko'rthaḥ? bahavo vṛkṣāḥ karmeti, na tu karmībhūtā vṛkṣā bahava iti; nāpi bahavaḥ karmeti| evamekavacane'pi `paśunā cajeta' iti paśurekaḥ paśuḥ karaṇamityarthaḥ, na tu karaṇībhūtaḥ paśureka iti, nāpyekaḥ paśuḥ karaṇamiti karaṇatvaikatvayoryugapadabhidhānāditi tānnirākaroti-karmādayo'pyapara ityādi| tadīye bahutve iti| karmādigatameva bahutvaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyam, na tu kevalaprātipadīkārthagatamityarthaḥ| prakṛtyarthagatameva bahutvaṃ vācyam, vṛkṣaśabdasyāvayavī vācyaḥ, na tvavayavā iti dravyapadārthapakṣe tāvad vṛkṣaṃ paśyeti mūlaskandhaphalapalāśādīnāṃ bahutve'pi teṣāmanabhidheyatvādvahuvacanābhāvaḥ| ākṛtipakṣe'pi pratyāsattestadādhāragataṃ bahutvāmāśrīyate na tvavayavagatam, bhinnavākyatayā vidhirityuktaṃ tatprayojanamāha yatra cetyādi| bhāṣye tu pañcakapakṣāṅgīkāreṇa niyamapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ| tatra hyanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe iti svārthe'pi jasādi bahuvacanaṃ bahutve'pi siddham, tasyāpi svārthatvāttatrāpyarthaniyamād-bahuṣu bahuvacanameva, dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane eveti| evaṃ `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādāvapi karmaṇi dvitīyaivetyevamādiko'rthaniyamo veditavyaḥ| evaṃ hi pratyayānāmaniyatatvādavyayebhye niḥsaṃkhyebhyo niṣkārakebhyaśca svādayaḥ siddhyanti| atha vā, pratyayaniyamaḥ-bahuṣveva bahuvacanaṃ dvyekayoreva dvivacanaikavacane| tulyājātīyasya ca niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ-bahuṣveva bahuvacanaṃ na dvyekayoḥ, ekasminnevaikavacanaṃ na saṃkhyāntare, dvayoreva dvivacanaṃ na saṃkhyāntara iti| `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādāvapyevam-karmaṇyeva dvitīyā, na kārakāntara iti| evamapi hyavyayebhyaḥ svādayaḥ siddhyanti||
padamañjarī
dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane|| 1.4.22 ||
dviśabdena sāhacaryādekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācī| ayamapi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, ata eva`dvyekayoḥ' iti dvivacanam, tadāha-dvitvaikatvayoriti| etadapītyādi| anenāsyāpi vidhyarthatvaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ tarhi sāmānyavihitayoriti, yāvatā niyamārthatve etad ghaṭate? ucyate; sādhāraṇaparyāyaḥ sāmānyaśabdaḥ sasaṃkhyaniḥsaṃkhyasādhāraṇyena vihitayorityarthaḥ| arthābhidhānamiti| arthaḥ-vācyo'bhidhīyate-kathyate yena tadarthābhidhānam| dvyekayoritayatra `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyaḥ' ityekaśabdasya pūrvanipāto'smādeva nipātanānna bhavati| saṃkhyeyavacanaṣvevārthadvārakamalpīyastvamityanye||
padamañjarī
kārake|| 1.4.23 ||
adhikāro'nekaprakāraḥ| saṃjñā, viśeṣaṇam, sthānī, prakṛtiḥ, nimittam, ādeśa iti| `pratyayaḥ', `śeṣe', `pūrvaparayoḥ' `ṅyāpprātidikāt' `dhātoḥ'`ārddhadhātuke mūrddhanyaḥ' iti tadiha vidheyānirdeśāt svaritatvāccādhikāratve sthite prakāramāha-kāraka iti viśeṣaṇa...madhikriyata iti| na tāvatsañjñātvenādhikāraḥ; sañjñāyā bhāvyamānatvātsaptamyanupapatteḥ| atha sañjñānurūpaḥ prathamānirdeśa eva kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yuktaṃ caitad kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu vakṣyamāṇānāmapādānādīnāmeva ṣaṇṇāṃ grahaṇasyeṣṭatvād; anyathā naṭasya śṭaṇotīti kārakaśeṣasyāpi prasaṅgāt? ucyate; sañjñāpakṣe--apāye yad dhruvaṃ tat kārakasañjñaṃ bhavati, apādānasañjñaṃ cetyayamartho bhavati, evamanyatrāpi; tataśca kārakāpādānasañjñayoryugapadvidhānāt parasparaṃ nimittanimittibhāvābhāvādakārakasyāpi vyāpāraśūnyasyāpādānasañjñā prāpnoti| viśeṣaṇādhikāre tu-kārakeṣu madhye yadapāye dhruvaṃ sā na prāpnoti| ato viśeṣaṇānurūpa eva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tu sañjñānurūpaḥ|
kārakasañjñā tvanvarthatvād vyāpāraśūnyasya na bhavati| kiṃ ca kārakasaṃjñāyā apādānādisañjñābhiḥ samāveśo na prāpnoti, tataśca`stamberamaḥ' ityatra saptamyāṃ śruyamāṇāyāṃ gatikārakopapadāditi svaro na syāt, `kārake' iti nirdhāraṇe saptamī, sāmānyāpokṣaṃ caikavacanam| kārakaśabdo'yamasti ṇvulantaḥ-karotīti kārakamiti, astyavyatpannaḥ sañjñāśabdo nimittaparyāyaḥ; tatra pūrvasya grahaṇe'pādānādiṣu kārakaśabdo na pravarttota, yathā kartṛśabdaḥ, teṣāmasvatantratvāt; svātantrye vā pakṣe kartṛsañjñā prasajyeta, naiṣa doṣaḥ; sarvameva khalu kārakaṃ yathāyathamavāntaravyāpāraṃ nirvartayat pradhānakriyāyāmupayujyate, sā ca sakalakārakajanyā phalabhūtā viklityādirūpā kriyā pradhānakriyā| yadvā-sāmānyabhūtā kriyā pradhānakriyā phalajananā nāma, sarvāṇi hi kārakāṇi phalajananāya pravartante, ato yadyatphalajananārūpaṃ tatsarveṣveva kārakeṣvaviśiṣṭam| kiñcitkhalu kārakaṃ kenacideva rūpeṇa phalaṃ janayatīti phalajananā sarveṣāmabhinnarūpā| avāntarabhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu karaṇādirūponmeṣaḥ|
na ca vaiśeṣikāṇāmivāsmākamekā kriyā nānekatra samavetā, dhātvartho hi kriyā, na parispanda eva| dhātunā ca sakalakārakānuyāyyodanādiphalāvacchedena ekīkṛto vyāpāro'bhidhīyate| tasyāmekasyāṃ pradhānakriyāyāmupayogo yathāyathamavāntaravyāpāramukhena, tadyathā-apādānasyāvadhibhāvopagamanaṃ vyāpāraḥ, sampradānasyatu preraṇānumatyanirākaraṇādiḥ, karaṇasya kāṣṭhāderjvalanādiḥ, adhikaraṇasya sambhavanadhāraṇādiḥ, kamaṃṇo nirvṛttyādiḥ, kartuḥ prasiddha eva, prayojakasya preṣaṇādiḥ| na caivaṃ sati karaṇādīnāmapi kartṛsañjñāprasaṅgaḥ, paratantratvat| pradhānena hi kartrā samavāye karaṇādīni paratantrāṇi, vyavāye svatantrāṇi;tadyathā-amātyānāṃ rājñā saha samavāye pāratantram, vyavāye svātantryam| yadyevam, kārakavyapadeśo'pi karaṇādyavasthāyāṃ na syāt? karaṇam kārakamiti adhikārasāmarthyāt| kārakaśabdopanītasvātantryamavasthāntaragataṃ vijñāsyate| avasthāntare yat svatantraṃ tatsādhakatamaṃ karaṇamiti kartuṃreva tvekasya sāṃpratikaṃ svātantryam, tacca kartṛsañjñāṅgatayā coditam| yadi tarhi vyutpattipakṣe'pyavasthāntaragatameva svātantryam, evaṃ tarhi karaṇādyavasthāyāṃ nimittabhāva evābhyupagato bhavati? yadyevam, kiṃ doṣapratividhānavyasanena| nimittaparyāyasyaiva grahaṇamastviti manyamāna āha- kārakaśabdaśceti| kasya heturiti| dravyaguṇaviṣayo'pi hetuḥ kārakaṃ prāptamityabhiprāyaḥ| kārakaśabdo'yaṃ kriyāhetāveva prasiddha ityāha-kriyāyā iti| anāśritavyāpāraṃ nimittaṃ hetuḥ, āśritavyāpāraṃ kārakam, uktaṃ ca--
dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam| iti|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturiṣyate|| iti ca|
kathaṃ tarhi pūrvamuktam-anarthāntaramiti, na hi sāmānyaviśeṣavacanānāmanarthāntaravācitvam? satyam; sāmānyaśabdayorapi arthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣavṛttimabhipretya tu tathoktam| vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti| parṇaviśeṣaṇatvenātra vṛkṣo vivakṣitaḥ, na tvapāyasya nimittatvenetyapādānasaṃjñā na bhavati, na vāpāyasyāvivakṣitatvāt| sati hyavadhau gatirapāyo bhavati, nānyathā| na cātra vṛkṣo'vadhitvena vivakṣitaḥ| tathā hi--vṛkṣamajahatyapi parṇe vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatīti bhavati prayogo yadā vṛkṣaḥ chinnaḥ patatīti, satyam; ata evāsminnatṛptaḥ sannāha--māṇavakasya pitaramiti| atra pituḥ sambandhitvena māṇavako vivakṣitaḥ, na tu praśnakriyāṃ prati nimittatveneti karmasaṃjñā na bhavati; asati tu kārakādhikāre tasyāpi syāt| śeṣalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī akathite duhyādiparigaṇanādrājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau sāvakāśā| yadi tarhi viśeṣaṇamidam, dhruvādīnāṃ na saṃjñā, `kārakaddattaśrutayorevāśiṣi'--ityādau yatra kārakaśabdaḥ saṃśabdyate tatrāpādānādīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ paṇṇāmeva grahaṇamiṣyate, tanna siddhyati| saṃjñāpakṣe tu na doṣaḥ, saṃjñā hyāvartamānā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyati| syādetat-pradeśeṣvapi kriyānimittaparyāyasya kārakaśabdasyopādānam, tacca nimittamapādānādyeveti, tadasat; naṭasya śṭaṇotītyādau kārakaśeṣasya āha-kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu ceti| kārakagrahaṇaṃ pradeśeṣu svaryate, svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti bhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
dhruvamapāye'pādānam|| 1.4.24 ||
dhravamiti| dhru gatisthairyayoḥ ityasmātkuṭādeḥ pacādyaci rūpam| ye tu `dhruva gatisthairyayoḥ' iti paṭhanti, teṣāmigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ| apāyaḥ- viśleṣaḥ, vibhāgastaddhetubhūtaśca gativiśeṣo'vadhisāpekṣaḥ, tatra vibhāgasya dviṣṭhatvāt na kevalamapayanneva tena yuktaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? yato'paiti so'pi yukta evetyāha-dhruvaṃ yadapāyayuktamiti| kathaṃ punaḥ saptamīnirddeśe'pyapāyayuktamiti pratipadyemahītyatrāha-apāye sādhya iti| sādhyatvena viṣayatvāt sāmarthyalabhyo yoga iti bhāvaḥ| dhruvamityekarūpamucyate- dhruvamasya śīlam, dhruvamasya rūpamiti, iha tadapāyena viśeṣyate-upāye yad dhruvamiti, na tu sārvatrikam, taccāpāye dhruvamucyate-yadapāyenānāviśyate upayujyate cāpāye, taccārthādavadhibhūtamityāha-yadavadhibhūtamiti| evaṃ ca sārthād hīnaḥ, rathātpatitaḥ, dhāvataḥ patita ityādau kriyāntarāveśāccalatve tattaddhāvanādikriyānāveśāttannimittamapāyaṃ pratyaudāsīnyādastyeva dhruvatvamiti bhavatyeva saṃjñā| uktaṃ ca--
apāye yadudāsīnaṃ calaṃ vā cadi vā calam|
dhruvamevātadāveśāt padapādānamucyate|| iti|
patataḥ patita ityatrāpi paragatapātāpekṣayā dhrauvyameva| tathā hi-
patato dhruva evāśvo yasmādaśvātpatatyasau|
tasya tvaśvasya patane kuḍyādirdhruva ucyate||
iha tu parasparammānmeṣāvapasarpata iti
meṣāntarakriyāpekṣamavadhitvaṃ pṛthak pṛthak|
meṣayoḥ svakriyayāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak||
gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti kathyate||
jugupseti| praśleṣapūrvako viśleṣo'pāyaḥ, sa cātra nāsti; buddhiparikalpitastu gauṇaḥ, na ca mukhye saṃbhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| ata eva `bhītrārthānām' ityāderārambha iti vākyakārasyābhiprāyaḥ| atra ca kārakaśeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti-naṭasya śṭaṇotīti yathā| pratyākhyānaṃ tu sādhakatamamiti tamabgrahaṇaṃ liṅgama, kārakaprakaraṇe yathāsambhavameva sādhakatvamiti| tadiha-adharmājjugupsate ityādau jugupsādipūrvikāyāṃ nivṛttau jugupsādīnāṃ vṛttiriti sthite ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati, sa paśyati- duḥkhaheturadharmo nainaṃ kariṣyāmīti; sa buddhyā taṃ prāpnoti, prāpya taca tato nivarttate| dharmātpramādyati dharmānmuhyatīti| ya eṣa nāstikaḥ puruṣaḥ, sa paśyati-nānena dharmeṇa kiṃcidāpyate, nainaṃ kariṣyāmīti sa buddhyā taṃ prāpnoti, prāpya ca tato nivarttate, tatra dhrumapāyaityeva siddhamiti| taccaitat--
nirddiṣṭaviṣayaṃ kiñcidupāttaviṣayaṃ tathā|
apekṣitakriyaṃ ceti tridhā'pādānamucyate||
yatra dhātunāpāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃjñāviṣayo nirdiśyate, yathā-grāmādāgacchatīti, tannirdiṣṭaviṣayam| yatra dhāturdhātvantarārthāṅgaṃ svārthamāha, yathā-balāhakād vidyotate vidyud iti, atra hi niḥ saraṇāṅgavidyotane vidyutirvarttate-balāhakanniḥ-sṛtya vidyotata ityeva; kusulātpacatītyatrā''dānāṅage pāke pacirvarttate-kusūlādādāya pacatīti, tadupāttaviṣayam| apekṣitakriyaṃ tu-yatra kriyā na śruyate, pramāṇāntareṇa tu pratīyate, yathā-āgacchantaṃ puruṣaṃ pratyakṣeṇa paśyannāha-kuto bhavāniti, so'pi tadeva pratyakṣasiddhamāgamanamupajīvannāha-pāṭaliputrāditi|
dhruvagrahaṇaṃ kim? grāmādāgacchati śakaṭena--atra śakaṭasya mā bhūt| atha kriyamāṇe'pi dhruvagrahaṇa iha kasmānna bhavati--dhanuṣā vighyatīti, atra hi śarāṇāmapāyaṃ prati avadhibhāvenaiva dhanuṣaḥ sādhakatamatvam? satyam; ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkaraṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| nanvevamakriyamāṇe'pi śakaṭasya naiva bhaviṣyati, evaṃ saṃjñāntaraviṣaye sarvatra| vṛkṣasya patraṃ patatītyatra tvapāyasyāvivakṣitatvādakārakatvācca na bhaviṣyati | saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ tu na hi `kārake' iti saptamyantena śakyaḥ saṃjñī nirdeṣṭum, siddhaṃ tu nirddhāryamāṇasya saṃjñitvādapāyaviṣayeṣu kārakeṣu madhye yatkārakaṃ saṃjñāntarasyāviṣayastadapādānamiti, tadevaṃ dhruvagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam||
padamañjarī
bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ|| 1.4.25 ||
bhayaṃ bhīḥ, trāṇaṃ trāḥ, sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| bhītrau arthau yeṣāṃ te bhītrārthāḥ, ṣaṣṭhīprayogāpekṣayā kārakāpekṣayā cetyāha--bibhetyarthānāmityādi| atra bibhetitrāyatiśabdau tadarthayorvartete, tadartho'rtho yeṣāmityarthaḥ| trāṇaṃ bādhakebhyo rakṣaṇam, bādhakāśca bhayahetava iti trārthānāmapi bhayahetuḥ kārakaṃ bhavatyeva| corebhya iti | corayateḥ pacādyaci coraḥ| kvacit caurebhya iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra svārthikaḥ prajñādyaṇ| chattrādiṣu vā curāśabdaḥ paṭhyate, sa cā'pratyayādityasya `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' iti yuci bādhake prāpte tasmādeva nipātanādakārapratyaye ṇiluki ca vyutpādyate, tataścurā steyaṃ śīlamasyeti ṇe kṛte sa evārtho bhavati| bibhetīti| `ñibhī bhaye' juhotyādiḥ| udvijate iti| `ovijībhayacalanayoḥ' taudādiko'nudāttet| araṇye iti| atra tatsthebhyo vṛkṣādibhyo bhayam, nāraṇyāt| nanu ca dhruvamityanuvarttiṣyate, na cāraṇyamavidhitvena vivakṣitam, paratvāccādhikaraṇasañjñaiva bhaviṣyati, satyam; pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ, katham? bhayādipūrvikāyāṃ nivṛttau bhyādayo vartante-bibhetīti korthaḥ? bhītyā nivartata ityarthaḥ, trāyata iti ko'rthaḥ? corakṛtādvadhādestrāṇena nivarttayatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi coramadhyavarttini corebhyo bibhetīti prayogaḥ, na hyatra nivṛttirasti? atrāpi bhītyā nivarttitumicchatītyartho draṣṭavyaḥ| tadevaṃ buddhiparikalpito'pāyostītyupāttaviṣayamidamapādānamiti| kṛtasna eva prayogaprapañce kimavayavaparyanuyogena! ||
padamañjarī
parājerasoḍhaḥ|| 1.4.26 ||
atra dhātupāṭhagatasya jītyetāvanmātrasyānukaraṇam| tataḥ parāpūrvo jiḥ parājirityuttarapadalopī samāso draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' ityadhāturiti prātipadikasañjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhādasubantatvātsamāso na prāpnoti, na; apratiṣedhāt, nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ-dhātorneti, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāso'yam--yadanyad dhātoriti, dhātorna vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ| evamapīyaṅādeśaḥ prāproti, paratvād gherṅitīti guṇo bhaviṣyatīti, samudāyasya vā, samudāyo'nukaraṇam, kvasthasyasamudāyasya? prayogasya| yadyevam, adhyayanātparājayate-atra prāpnoti, na hyatra parājīti rūpamasti, kva tarhi syād? yatra parājīti rūpamasti-adhyayanātparājita iti| udāharaṇe parājirnyunībhāve vartate-adhyetuṃ hrasati glāyatītyarthaḥ| akarmakaścāyamatrārthe, tatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam, pratyudāharaṇe tvabhibhave vartate| `viparābhyāṃjeḥ' ityatrārthadvaye'pi vartamānasya grahaṇam| ayamapi prapañco nyūnībhāvapūrvikāyāṃ nivṛttau vṛtteḥ siddham| adhyayanātparājayate-ko'rthaḥ? nyūnībhāvena glānyā tato nivarttate ityarthaḥ| tena pratyudāharaṇe paratvātkarmasañjñā bhaviṣyatīti na codanīyam||
padamañjarī
vāraṇārthānamīpsitaḥ|| 1.4.27 ||
īpsitaśabdo'yamastyabhipretaparyāyaḥ, tasya grahaṇe yavānāmānmīyatve gavāṃ ca parakīyatva eva syād, na viparyate? na khalvasyaitadabhipretaṃ yadutātmīyā gāvaḥ parakīyānyavānmā ghasanniti, mā bhūvanyavā vārayitumīpsitāḥ; vāryamāṇānāṃ tu gavāmīpsitāḥ, na vātra viśeṣaḥ śrutaḥ karturīpsita iti| iha tarhi na syād-agnermāṇavakaṃ vārayati kūpādandhamiti, na hyagrikūpau vārayiturvāryamāṇasya vābhipretau? kriyāśabdasya tu grahaṇe vāryamāṇasyānthādergamanādikriyayā kūpāderāpyamānatvāt siddhyati, andhaścāpaśyannapi gantavyaṃ jigamiṣati, anyathā na kvacittasya pravṛttiḥ syāt| yavebhyo gā vārayatīti| `vṛñ āvaraṇe' curādiḥ| athātra gavāmapādānasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati, īpsitatamo'pīpsito bhavatyeva, yathā śuklatamo'pi śuklaḥ? paratvātkarmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ- vāraṇārthebhyo'nyatra, apādānasaṃjñāyāstu prakarṣarahitamītsitam, ipsitatamasya tūbhayaprasaṅage paratvātkarmasaṃjñā| ayamapi prapañcaḥ, asti hyatrapi buddhivyavasthito'pāyaḥ, katham? paśyatyayam-yadi gāvaḥ kṣetre gaccheyurdhruvaṃ sasyavināśaḥ, sasyavināśe'dharmaśca rājabhayaṃ ca; sa buddhyā saṃprāpya nivartayatītyato na codanīyam-pratyudāharaṇe kṣetrasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti||
padamañjarī
antarddhau yenādarśanāmacchati|| 1.4.28 ||
antarddhau iti neyaṃ `nimittātkarmayoge' iti saptamī, yathā hi-vetanena dhānyaṃ lunātītyatra vetanasya dhānyena yogo'sti,tathehāpyadarśanamicchatītīcchākarmaṇā'darśanenāntarddheryogo nāsti| athādarśanasya yatkarma ātmākhyamātmano'darśanamicchatīti tenāntarddheryogo'sti? yasyaivādarśanaṃtasyaivāntarddhānamityucyeta| evamapi `nimittātkarmayoge' iti kiṃ nimittaṃ gṛhyate, kāraṇam? prayejanaṃ vā? kāraṇaṃ cejjāḍyena baddhaḥ- atrāpi prāpnoti, ya eva baddhyate tatraiva jāḍyamiti; tasmāt prayojanasya tatra grahaṇam| yathā-carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hantīti carma dvīpihananasya prayojanam| iha tvantarddhānamadarśanasya kāraṇam, antarhitaḥ khalvasau na ddaśyate| tasmādviṣayasaptamyeṣā, satsaptamī vā| yeneti karttari tṛtīyā| nanu ca darśanena yogāt `kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhāvyam| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeveti niyamāt tṛtīyā bhaviṣyati| kama tvatrādarśanasyātmā| nanvātmane iti na śrūyate, mā śrāvi; yenādarśanamicchatītyukte kasyetyapekṣāyāmātmana iti gamyate| antarddhinimittamiti| antarddhinā kāraṇenetyarthaḥ| `nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti prathamā| atha vā-bahubrīhiradarśanasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam| sūtra'nupātto'pi tacchabdo yattadornityasambandhāllabhyata evetyāha-tatkārakamiti| antarddhatte iti| tirobhavatītyarthaḥ| nilīyate iti| `līṅ śleṣaṇe' daivādikaḥ|
caurānna diddakṣate iti| ātmānaṃ te mā drākṣurityevamartham| nanu paratvātkarmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, satyam; ayamapi prapañcaḥ, katham? paśyatyevam-yadyupādhyāyaḥ paśyed dhruvaṃ me preṣaṇamupālambho vā bhavediti, sa buddhyā saṃprāpya nivartate| yenetyasminnasatyadarśanamicchataḥ śiṣyasyaiva syāt, dhruvamityanuvartiṣyate| evaṃ tarhi sūtrasyāvācakatvaṃ mā bhūt| asati hi tasminnantarddhau dhruvamapādānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati tacced dhruvamadarśanamicchatītyarthaḥ syāt| na ca dhruvamicchati, yaccecchati na tad dhruvamityavācakaṃ syāt||
padamañjarī
ākhyātopayoge|| 1.4.29 ||
niyamapūrvakaṃ vidyāgrahaṇamiti| tatraivopayogaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| yathā teṣāṃ mantrāṇāmupayoge dvādaśāhamadhaḥ śayyoti niyamo bhikṣācaraṇādiḥ| naṭasya śrṛṇotīti| kiṃ punarnaṭaḥ kārakam? utāho na ?, yadi kārakam? karma saṃjñā prāpnoti-`akathitaṃ ca' iti| athākāram? upayogagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| astu kārakam, na hyupādhyāyānnaṭasya vyāpāre kaścidanyo viśeṣaḥ; anyadato niyamāt| duhyādiparigaṇanāttu karmasaṃjñā na bhavati| kvacittu naṭasya gāthāṃ śrṛṇoti, granthikasya kathāṃ śrṛṇotīti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpi naṭādinimittaṃ gāthādeḥ śravaṇaṃ karotītyartha; na tu gāthādiviśeṣaṇaṃ naṭādiḥ; akārakatvaprasaṅgāt| granthikaḥ-kathāyā vācayitā| ayamapi prapañcaḥ, katham? upādhyāyānnissarantaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇātīti sphuṭa evātrāpāyaḥ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-`upayoga iti vakṣyāmi, naṭasya mā bhūt' iti? nanu naṭasya satyapyavadhitve śeṣarūpeṇa vivakṣaṇāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, yathā na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditi vastutaḥ karmatvaṃ māṣāṇām, satyam; sa eva vivakṣāniyamaḥ sūtrakāreṇa pradarśyate-upayoge'vadhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, anyatra śeṣatvamiti||
padamañjarī
janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ|| 1.4.30 ||
janeḥ kartā janikarteti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| ayameva ca nirdeśo jñāpayati-`karttari ca' iti pratiṣedho'nitya iti| kaḥ punarasāvityata āha-janyarthasyeti| etaduktaṃ bhavati-janiśabdo'yam`iñjādibhyaḥ' iti janerbhāva iñamutpādya vyutpāditaḥ| `janivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedho janyārthavācī, na tu `ik‌stipau dhātunirdeśe' iti ikpratyayāntaḥ, `gamahana' ityupadhāyā lopaprasaṅgat| nāpyāgantukenekāreṇa dhātornirdeśaḥ; śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ kartrā sambandhāyogāt| athāpyarthadvārako yogaḥ syād? evamapi dhātunirdeśe tasyaiva prayoge syād, na paryāyasya; aṅgādaṅgāstambhavo'stīti| arthagrahaṇe tvatrāpi bhavatīti| prakṛtirityasya vivaraṇam--kāraṇamiti| upādānakāraṇamityarthaḥ|
anye tu dhruvagrahaṇānuvṛttereva prakṛtiparigrahe siddhe prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kāraṇamātraparigrahārthaṃ varṇayanti| ata eva vṛttāvuktam-kāraṇamiti, na punarupādānakāraṇamiti| tena ca putrātpramodo jāyata ityādāvapi bhavatīti| kiṃ punaḥ sat jāyate? utāsat? na tāvatsat; janmavaiyarthyāt| yadi janmanaḥ prāgeva sat, kiṃ janmanā? athaivamapi janma, jāyasva jāyasvetyeva ghaṭo jāyate| nāpyasat; asataḥ kartṛtvāyogāt, śaśaviṣaṇāderapi janmaprasaṅgacca| uktamatra--
pūrvāvasthāmavijahatsaṃspṛśan dharmamuttaram|
saṃmūrchita ivārthātmā jāyamāno'bhichīyate|| iti|
etacca `ānmahataḥ' ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| kiñcāsmākamanena dustarkeṇa, asti tāvat `śrṛṅgāccharo jāyate' iti prayogaḥ, sa upapādanīya ityetāvat! ayamapi prapañcaḥ| loke hi yadyasmājjāyate tattato nirgacchatītyucyate, lokaprasiddhyanusāreṇa śabdaprayogaḥ, arthatattvaṃ tu tathā bhavatvanyathā vā||
padamañjarī
bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ|| 1.4.31 ||
bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, sampadāditvātkvip| atrāpi praśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| na hi kovalasya bhavatyarthasya prabhavanena yogaḥ kiṃ tarhi? sopasargasya bhuvaḥ| karteti| bhavatyarthasya kartetyarthaḥ, bhuvo vā dhātoḥ| kathaṃ punardhātornāma karttā syād, dhāturvai śabdaḥ, śabde'sambhave'rthe kārthaṃ vijñāsyate| `tasu upakṣaye' bhāve ktaḥ, `vi gatau' tastā, vitasteti, aśoṣyetyarthaḥ| prathamata upalabhyate iti| upalabhateḥ karmavyāpāre prabhavatiḥ, pravartata ityarthaḥ| prakāśata iti yāvat| etena janyarthābhāvātpūrveṇāsiddhaṃ darśayati| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmasminnarthe vṛttiḥ| ayamapi prapañcaḥ| katham? bhavanapūrvake niḥsaraṇe prabhavatirvarttate||
padamañjarī
karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam|| 1.4.32 ||
karmaṇā karaṇabhūteneti| kathaṃ punarekameva vastu yugapatkarma ca karaṇaṃ ca bhavati? kriyābhedāddānakriyāyāṃ karmābhiprāyeṇa kriyāyāṃ karaṇam, dīyamānāyā hi gavā śiṣya upādhyāyāmabhipraiti saṃbadhnāti īpsati vā, abhaprapūrvo hīṇ īpsatinā samānārthaḥ| abhiprertāmatyukte īpsitamiti gamyate| uktaṃ ca--
anirākaraṇātkarttustyagāṅgaṃ karmaṇopsitam|
preraṇānumatibhyāṃ vā labhate sampradānatām|| iti|
tyāgo dānam, tyāgasyāṅgaṃ śeṣabhūtaṃ karmaṇā gavādinepsitamāptumiṣṭaṃ saṃpradānatāṃ labhate, anirākaraṇādvā, evamastviti anumānādvā, devebhyaḥ sumanaso dadāti, yācakāya bhikṣā dadāti, upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti; na tu nirākurvan saṃpradānaṃ bhavatīti ślokārthaḥ|
atra kecidāhuḥ- `kugatiprādayaḥ' ityatra vārtikam- `udāttavatā tiṅā gateḥ samāsavacanam' iti| yo jāta eva prathamomahasvāvo devā kratunā paryabhūṣat, yo yaḥ śambaramanvavindat, yasmānna ṛte kiṃ vajayante, yo vai prayavayatāmapyenaṃ pratipadyate-ityādyudāharaṇāni| atra sarvatra `yadvṛtānnityam' iti nipātapratiṣedhāt tiṅantamudāttavat, tataścāyamabhipraitītyatrāpi samāse sati prātipadikatvāt vibhaktyutpattiḥ syāditi|
neti vayam; tasya chandoviṣayatvāt| yadi karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam, ajāṃ nayati grāmamiti ajairnayatikriyā karmabhissaṃbadhyamānasya grāmasya saṃpradānatāṃ prāpnoti? na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam? karmaṇeti karaṇe tṛtīyetyaktam| na ca yathā śiṣyasyopādhyāyasambandhe gauḥ karaṇam, evamajā grāmasambandhe| īpsatinā samānārthe tu sutarāmaprāptiḥ| tathā hi- `yamabhipraiti' ityukte yamiti nirdiṣṭasya śeṣitvam, karmaṇeti nirdiṣṭasya gavādeḥ karaṇasya śeṣatvaṃ ca pratīyate; yathā-`kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale' iti kartuḥ śeṣitvaṃ kriyāphalasya śeṣatvam, na cātra śeṣaśeṣibhāvaḥ pratīyate| kiṃ ca `nīvahyorharateśca' iti dvikarmakeṣu nayatiḥ parigaṇyate, ato'pi grāmasya na bhaviṣyati|
atha kimarthaṃ mahatī saṃjñā kriyata ityāha-anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāditi| samyak‌pradīyate yasmai tatsaṃpradānamityanvarthatvātsañjñāyā dadātikarmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānamityarthaḥ| evamapi rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti, ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadātītyatra kasmānna bhavati? adānatvāt, kiṃ punardānam? dānaṃ kiñcaduddiśyāpunargrahaṇāya svadravyatyāgāḥ, yathā-vṛkṣāya jalaṃ dadāti, devebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ, yācakāya bhikṣām, upādhyāyāya gām, khaṇḍikopādhyāyastasmai capeṭikāṃ dadāti, na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāditi| karatalaprahāraḥ-capeṭikā| rajake tu punargrahaṇāddānābhāvaḥ, upamānāttu dadātipramogaḥ,tatra kārakaśeṣatvānnaṭasya śrṛṇotītivat ṣaṣṭhī
karmaṇeti kim, yāvatā upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātītyatra gorupādhyāyasya vābhipreyamāṇatvam,yato gaurdānakriyayā karaṇabhūtayābhipreyate, gavā tūpādhyāyaḥ; tatra paratvādroḥ karmasaṃjñeti pāriśeṣyād upādhyāyasyaiva saṃpradānasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati? naitadasti;satyapyubhayorabhipreyamāṇatve'ntaṅgatvātkarmaṇa eva gavādeḥ syāt| karmasajñā tu dadātikarmaṇo'nyatra sāvakāśā, kārakaprakaraṇe ca prakarṣo nāśrīyate, na tvantaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvo'pi | yaṃsagrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe'bhipretureva saṃpradānasaṃjñā syāt; śrutapadārthasambandhe sati tenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvādadhyāhārānupapatteḥ| satyapi vādhyāhāre yaḥ sa ityevādhyāhārāt tata upādhyāyāya śiṣyeṇa gaurdīyata ityatrārthe śiṣyāyopādhyāyasya gaurdīyata iti syāt| karmasaṃjñāyāṃ hi kartṛgrahaṇaṃ svatantropalakṣaṇārthamiti tena śiṣyasya kartṛ tvābhāve'pi goḥ karmasaṃjñā yujyata eva| tathā ca sārthāddhīyata iti karmaṇi lakārotpattiḥ|
abhipragrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā karmaṇā yameti gacchati prāpnoti saṃbadhnātītyarthaḥ, abhipraitītyukte sa eva? abhipragrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe kālavivakṣā syāt; tataśca yameva saṃpratyeti tatraiva syāt, yamagāt yaṃ caiṣyati tatra na syāt; abhipragrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe na doṣo bhavati| abhirābhimukhye vartate, praśabdaścādikarmaṇi, tataścopasargadvayopādānasāmarthyātkālāntarāvacchinnā kriyā nāśrīyate| nanu yathā `tena dīvyati' ityādau saṅkhyākālayoravivakṣā, tathehāpi saṃkhyāvatkālasyāpyavivakṣā siddhā, satyam; ayameva nyāyasiddho'rtha upasargadvayopādānena pradarśyate| yadā tvabhipraitītyasya īpsatītyarthaḥ, tadābhipragrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva|
kriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavyamiti vārttikam, etadvyācaṣṭe-kriyayetyādi| nanu kriyāmapi loke karmetyupacaranti-kiṃ karma kariṣyasi, kāṃ kriyāmiti, tatra karmaṇā yamabhipraitītyeva siddham| evamapi kartavyam; `kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayo bhavati' saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvāt| kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma, tathā hi-ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati, sa buddhyā tāvatkañcidarthaṃ saṃpaśyati-idamīddaśamiti, tad ddaṣṭaṃ prārthayate-ayi mamedaṃ syāditi, tatastadupāyabhūtāṃ kriyāṃ paśyati-asyā etatphalamiti, tataḥ prārthayate-kathamiyaṃ niṣpapādyatāmiti, tatastatsādhanāni samavadhārya kartumadhyavasyati| pratīyamānakriyāpekṣo'pi kārakabhāvo bhavatyeva, yathā-praviśa piṇḍīmityatra bhakṣayeti gamyate| sūtrakāraśca sūtrayati-`kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ' iti| evamapi kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam; dadātikarmatvāt| nigarhate iti| nāstikyānnindatītyarthaḥ| `garha galha kutsāyām' anudāttet| yuddhāyeti| yuddhaviṣayaṃ saṃnāhapūrvakaṃ niścayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| nahyatiḥ svaritet| patye śete iti| patimupasṛtya śeta ityarthaḥ| yadi tarhi kriyayābhipreyamāṇasyāpi bhavati kaṭaṅkarotītyādāvapi prāpnoti, vacanāddhi karmasaṃpradānasaṃjñayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt? naitatsārvatrikam, kiṃ tarhi? prayogadarśanavaśena niyataviṣayam|
karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñetyādi| etacchandoviṣayam, sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpante, iti yathāprāptamapi prayogo bhavati| bhāṣye tu dadātikarmaṇeti nāśritam, prayogāśca bahavaḥ-aryamṇe caruṃ nirvapet, devebhyo brahmodanamapakṣat, devebhyo havyaṃ vahantaḥ chandāṃsi vai devebhyo havyamūrdhā, yadaṅgamāśuṣe tvam, śaṃ naḥ karatparvate ityādayaḥ, tanmate kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam| kathaṃ yatra saṃpradānatvamiṣyate? tatra saṃdarśanādīnāṃ kriyāyāśca bhedo vivakṣyate, tataśca tairāpyamānā kriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karmeti siddhaṃ tayābhipreyamāṇasya saṃpradānatvam, yatra tu neṣyate tatra bhedo na vivakṣyate, tataścaudanādyekaphalāvacchedenaikīkṛtayā kriyayā''pyamānasya karmatvameva bhaviṣyati-kaṭaṅkaroti, odanaṃ pacatīti| gatyartheṣu tūbhayaṃ vivakṣyate-bhedaḥ, abhedaśca; tatra bhedavivakṣāyāṃ grāmaṃ gacchatīti prayoga iti `gatyarthakarmaṇi' ityetadapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati||
padamañjarī
rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ|| 1.4.33 ||
rucinā samānārthā iti| vastukathanametat| vigrahastu rucirartho yeṣāmiti| te ca rucinā dhātunā dhātunā samānārthā bhavanti| prīyamāṇa iti| `prīñ tarpaṇe' ityasmāt kraiyādikāt sakarmakātkarmaṇi laḥ| daivādikastu ṅidakarmakaḥ, tarpamāṇa ityarthaḥ| anyakartṛka iti| yo'bhilāṣasyāśrayaḥ prīyamāṇastato'nyakartṛka ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaranyāśrayasyābhilāṣasyānyaḥ karttā bhavati, yāvatā yadāśrayavyāpāraṃ dhātuḥ prādhānyenācaṣṭe sa karttā? nedaṃ kartṛ lakṣaṇam, kintu svātantryameva| tacca kvacidvāstavam, kvacidvaivakṣikam| tadatra mādhuryātiśayena svaviṣayaṃ devadattāśrayamabhilāṣaṃ janayanmodakastatra karteti gīyate| na caivaṃ laṣerapi prasaṅgaḥ, devadatto modakamabhilaṣyatīti? abhidhānaśaktivaicitryādāśrayakartṛ ko'bhilāṣo laṣervācyaḥ, rucestu viṣayakartṛkaḥ| ddaṣṭaścāyamabhidhānaprakāraniyamo'nyatrāpi, tadyathā-ghaṭaḥ paśyatīti ddaśerāśrayakartṛ kaṃ jñānaṃ vācyam| ghaṭaḥ prakāśate ityatra prakāśerviṣayakartṛkam| viṣaya eva hi spaṣṭālokamadhya vartitvādinā saukaryeṇa devadattāśraye jñāne karteti vyapadiśyate, na tu jñānena kaścidatiśayo viṣayo janyate|
ko'yaṃ prakāśo nāma, yaṃ prākaṭhyamācakṣate bhāṭṭāḥ, tatra kārakaśeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅge vacanam| anye tu prīyamāṇaṃ devadattaṃ modakaḥ prīṇayatīti karmasaṃjñāṃ prāptāṃ manyante| apare tvevamāhuḥ- devadatto rocayati modakamiti hetutve prāpte vacanamiti, devadattaṃ hi prāpya rocate modako na sarvān, nānecchā hi prāṇina iti| evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam| uktaṃ ca--
hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ śeṣatve cāpi kārakam|
rucyarthādiṣu śāstreṇa saṃpradānākhyamucyate|| iti|
pathīti| hetukarmasaṃjñāvadadhikaraṇasaṃjñā bādhyeteti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca prīyamāṇagrahaṇādevādityo rocata iti dīptivācināmagrahaṇam||
padamañjarī
ślāghahūnuṅasthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ|| 1.4.34 ||
jñīpsyamāna iti| `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' iti ghaṭādiṣu paṭhyate, tasmānniśāmane'rthe hetumaṇṇici sani `āpjñapṛdhāmīt',`atra lopo'bhyāsasya',karmaṇi laṭaḥ śānajādeśaḥ| niśāmanaṃ ceha jñānamātramucyate, na cakṣurvijñānameva, yadāha-boghayitumabhipreta iti| kathaṃ tarhi prayujyate--tajjñāpayatyācārthaḥ, vijñāpanā bhartṛṣu siddhimetīti? tasmānniśāneṣviti pāṭhaḥ| `śo tanūkaraṇe' lyuḍantaḥ, saṃjñapitaḥ paśurityudāharaṇam| jñīpsyamāno jñapayitumiṣyamāṇa iti prayogaḥ`jñapa micca' iti curādiṇijantasya| anye tu -`mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' ityatra `vā cittavirāge' ityato vetyanuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāccāniṣṭe viṣaye hrasvābhāvamāhuḥ| devadattaṃ prati ślāghamānāstāṃ ślāghāṃ tameva jñapayitumicchatītyartha iti| ślāghā stutiḥ, pratyakṣeṇa devadattaṃ stautīti yāvat| evaṃ hi tāṃ devadattaḥ śakyate jñāpayitum| anye tvāhuḥ- devadattāyātmānaṃ paraṃ ślāghyaṃ kathayatītyartha iti| tathā ca bhaṭṭikāvyam--
ślāghamānaḥ parastrībhyastatrāgādrākṣasādhipaḥ|| iti|
ātmānaṃ ślāghyaṃ parastrībhyaḥ kathayannityarthaḥ| evaṃ devadattāya nih‌nuta iti| `hnuṅ apanayane' devadattaṃ prati nihn‌vānastāṃ nihnutiṃ tameva jñāpayitumicchatītyarthaḥ| ityeṣa evaṃśabdasyārthaḥ| nihnutirapalāpaḥ, saṃnihitameva devadattaṃ dhanikāderapalapatītyarthaḥ| anye tu hnotavyaṃ kiñciddevadattaṃ jñāpayatītyartha ityāhuḥ- devadattāya tiṣṭhata iti| īddaśo'hamiti devadattasya sthanena prakāśayatītyarthaḥ| devadattāya śapate iti| śapathena kiñcitprakāśayatītyarthaḥ| devadattaḥ ślāghate iti| jñīpsyamānavacanāt karmasaṃjñaiva bādhyate, na kartṛsaṃjñetyarthaḥ| evaṃ gārgikayā ślāghate sabhāyāmiti karaṇādhikaraṇasaṃjñe na bādhyete| kvacittu devadattaṃ ślāghate iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāyaṃ bhāvaḥ-yasmāyākhyāyate sa jñīpsyamāna ityākhyāyāmānā dvinīyaiva nyāyyeti| ye tvākhyāyamānaṃ jñīpsyamānaṃ vadanti teṣāṃ yasmāyākhyāyate tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati--devadattāya ślāghate yajñadatto viṣṇumitrasyeti||
padamañjarī
dhāreruttamarṇaḥ|| 1.4.35 ||
uttamamṛṇaṃ yasyeti| uttamam-utkuṣṭatamam, utkṛṣṭārthavṛtterucchabdāttamapi dravyaprakarṣatvādāmabhāvaḥ| artteḥ ktaḥ, ṛṇam `ṛṇamādhamarṇye' ityatra kālāntare deyadravyavinimayopalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇamityuttamarṇe'pi natvaṃ bhavati| atra bahuvrīhau niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ'paravacanam iti sukhāderākṛtigaṇatvādasmādeva vā nipātanāddaṇaśabdasya paranipātaḥ| śataṃ dhārayatīti| `dhṛṅ avasthāne',dhriyamāṇaṃ svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhamānaṃ svabhāvādapracyavamānaṃ śataṃ prayuṅakta iti ṇic| grāma iti| nanvatra paratvādadhikaraṇasaṃjñaiva bhaviṣyati; uttamarṇe'pi tarhi hetusañjñā syāt||
padamañjarī
spṛherīpsitaḥ|| 1.4.36 ||
curādāvadantaḥ paṭhyata iti| tena spṛhayatītyatrāto lopasya sthānivadbhāvāllaghūpadhaguṇo neti bhāvaḥ| īpsita iti| `matibuddhi' ityādinā varttamāne ktaḥ| īpsitamātre iyaṃ saṃjñā| prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu paratvāt karmasaṃjñaiva bhavati--puṣpāṇi spṛhayatīti| yadā tvīpsitamīpsitatamaṃ vā śeṣatvena vivakṣyate, tadā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati||
padamañjarī
krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ|| 1.4.37 ||
guṇeṣviti| śaucācārādiṣuḥ dāṣā viṣkaraṇamiti| dambhādidoṣādhyāsa ityarthaḥ| tatra krudhadruhāvakarmakāviti kārakaśeṣatvānnaṭasya śrṛṇotītivat ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam, itarayostu sakarmakatvād dvitīyā prāpnoti| atra ca cittadoṣarūpatvaṃ yadyapi krodhādīnāmaviśiṣṭam, tathāpyanyeṣāmevañjātīyakānāṃ dveṣādīnāmagrahaṇārthamavāntarabhedavivakṣayā pṛthagime nirdiṣṭāḥ, na tu cittadoṣārthānāmiti| tenāsmān dveṣṭītyatra na bhavati, anabhinandanaṃ hyasyārthaḥ| tathā cācetaneṣvapi prayujyate--auṣadhaṃ dveṣṭīti| kathaṃ punarekena krudhinā sarve krudhādayaḥ śakyā viśeṣayitumata āha--krodhastāvaditi| bhāryāmīrṣyatītyatra kevalaṃ parairddaśyamānāṃ bhāryāṃ, na tu tāṃ prati kopaḥ||

krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma|| 1.4.38 ||
upasargeṇa sambaddhayoriti| `upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' upasṛjantītyupasargāḥ, pacādyaci nyaṅkvāditvāt kutvam| tenopasṛṣṭayorityasyopasargeṇa sambaddhayorityayamartho bhavati| svanikāyaprasiddhirvā||
padamañjarī
rādhākṣyeryasya vipraśnaḥ|| 1.4.39||
yasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, yadvividhaṃ pṛcchyata ityarthaḥ| yatsambandhītyādi| yatsambandhinaḥ śubhāśubhasya vipraśna iti| devadattāya rāghyatīti| `rādho'karmakādvadvāveva' iti divādau, tatra vṛddhāvityupalakṣaṇamakarmakāditi vacanād vṛddhāvakarmakatvāvyabhicārāt| evakārastu bhinnakramaḥ- rādho'karmakādeva śyan bhavati, yathā-vṛddhāviti| tena satyapyevakāre paryālocanasya vṛttiraviruddhā| tatra dhātvarthenopasaṃgrahājjīvatyādivad rādho'karmatvamaviruddham| nimittaṃ veda naimittikaḥ, uñchādiṣu vasantādiṣu vā nimittaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| yasyagrahaṇamanarthakam, yaṃ pratītyeva, tatra yaṃ prati vipraśna ityanvaye kiṃ nāma vivakṣitaṃ na sidhyati||
padamañjarī
pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā|| 1.4.40 ||
dvivacananirdeśāt pratyekamupasargasambandha ityāha-- āṅpūrvasya pratipūrvasya ceti| kaḥ punaratra pūrvo vyāpāra ityatrāha--pratyāṅpūrvaścetyādi pareṇa prayuktasyeti| idaṃ me dehītyevaṃ prārthitasyetyarthaḥ| pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyā iti| sūtre tu vyāpārarūpavivakṣayā pūrvasyeti nirdeśaḥ, yatra hetusañjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ devadattena pratiśrāvayatīti prayoganivṛttaye vacanamityāhuḥ| vivakṣāntare ca devadatto gāṃ pratiśrāvayatīti bhavatyeva||
padamañjarī
anupratigṛṇaśca|| 1.4.41 ||
pūrveṇa sāhacaryādatrāpi pratyekamupasargasambandha ityāha--anūpūrvasya pratipūrvasya ceti| kaḥ punaratra pūrvo vyāpāra ityatrāha--hotā prathamamityādi| anya iti| adhvaryuḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyate-anupratipūrvo gṛṇātiḥ śaṃsituḥ protsāhane varttata ityāha--anugaraḥ pratigara ityādi| anugīryate protsāhyate yena śabdena so'nugaraḥ| evaṃ pratigaraḥ, othāmo daivetyevamādikaḥ śabdaḥ; tena hi pratigīryate|
padamañjarī
sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam|| 1.4.42 ||
`ṣidhū saṃrāddhau' ityasya hetumaṇṇyantasya `siddhyaterapāralaukike' ityātve `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' ityasya vā ṇyantasya sādhakaśabdaḥ| kriyātmakaścārthaḥ| prayojyaḥ kartā, sidhyataḥ sādhyavato vā kriyātmano'rthasya prayojakatamaṃ sādhakatamam| nanu sāmagyradhīnā kriyāsiddhirno khalu kartrādīnāmanya tamāpāye'pi kriyā niṣyadyate, tatkimapekṣaḥ kārakāṇāṃ madhye ekasyātiśayayogaḥ syāt? ucyate; chedyadravyānupraveśo vyāpāraḥ, kāṣṭhāde pāke prajvalana janitoṣṇasparśānupraveśaḥ, tadanantarameva kriyāsiddhiḥ naivaṃ kārakāntareṣvanupraveśaḥ tadvyāpārānantaraṃ vā kriyāniṣpattiḥ samasti, ataḥ-
kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiryadvyāpārādanantaram|
vivakṣyate yadā tatra karaṇaṃ tattadā smṛtam||
`vivakṣyate' ityanenaitad darśayati-deśakālāvasthādivaśena yasya kriyā pratyupayogātiśayena vyāpāraḥ pratyāsīdan vivakṣye, tadā tasya karaṇatvaṃ bhavatīti| yathā sthālyadhikaraṇatvena prasiddhā, tasyā api tanutarakapālatayā prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ karaṇatvaṃ bhavati-sthālyā pacyata iti| uktaṃ ca--
vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam|
sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā ddaśyate yataḥ|| iti|
na caivaṃ karturapi karaṇatvavivakṣāprasaṅgaḥ; bhinnajātīyatvāt| sakalasādhanaviniyogakārī khalvasau, na ca śatadhano niṣkadhanena saha sparddhate!kathaṃ tarhyaśvena dīpikayā rathena sañcarate iti bahūnāṃ karaṇatvam, yāvatā teṣvapi yadāsannopakārakaṃ tadeva karaṇaṃ yuktam? ucyate; kārakāntarāpekṣaḥ karaṇasyātiśayaḥ, na svakakṣāyām; tena sarveṣāṃ kriyāniṣpattau saṃnipatyopakārakatvāt siddhaṃ karaṇatvam|
tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| kārakādhikārāt siddhe sādhakatve punaḥ sādhakaśrutiḥ prakarṣārthā bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| asati tamabgrahaṇe ādhāro nāma yatrādhārātmā vyāpto bhavatyādheyena, tenehaiva syāt- tileṣu tailam, payasi sarpiriti; gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra na syāt| tamabgrahaṇaṃ tu jñāpayati-iha prakaraṇe sāmarthyagamyaḥ prakarṣo nāśrīyate, tenehāpi bhavati| yadā ca deśadharmo ghoṣaṃ pratyādhārabhāvaḥ strotasyupacaryate, tadevaṃ tamabgrahaṇasya prayojanam; yadā tu gaṅgāśabdastīre varttate tadā na prayojanam. ādheyena vyāptisambhavānmukhya evādhārabhāva iti||
padamañjarī
divaḥ karma ca|| 1.4.43 ||
nanu cākṣān dīvyatītyatra pātayatītyarthastatra karmatvaṃ siddham; akṣairdīvyatīti, kriḍatītyarthaḥ, tatra karaṇatvaṃ siddham, kimarthamidamityāśāṅkyāha--pūrveṇa karaṇasaṃjñāyāmiti| akṣaiḥ krīḍatītyasyāmeva vivakṣāyāmakṣān dīvyatītīṣyate, atra ca karaṇasaṃjñaiva prāpnoti, akṣānpātayatītyatra cārthe'kṣairdīvyatīti neṣyate, ataḥ sādhakatamasyaiva karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambha ityarthaḥ| atha kimarthaścakāraḥ? karaṇasaṃjñāpi yathā syāt naitadasti prayojanam; vakṣyamāṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihaiva kariṣyāmi, tatrāha--cakārātkaraṇasaṃjñaṃ ceti| yugapatsaṃjñādvayaṃ yathā syāditi bhāvaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe tu paryāyaḥ syāt--yadā karma na tadā karaṇam, yadā karaṇaṃ na tadā karma; cakārāttu yugapadeva saṃjñādvayaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| yaugapadyaprayojanaṃ manasā dīvyatīti karmatvādaṇ pratyayaḥ, karaṇatvācca tṛtīyā`manasaḥ saṃjñāyām' ityaluk-manasā devaḥ| iha cākṣairdevayate devadatto yajñadatteneti, akṣairiti tṛtīyāprayoge'pi dhātoḥ sakarmakatvād `gatibuddhi' ityādinā'ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartturyajñadattasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati, `aṇāvakarmakāt' iti parasmaipadaṃ ca| yadi tarhi samāveśaḥ- akṣān dīvyatīti paratvāt tṛtīyā prāpnoti; paryāye tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, karmasaṃjñāpakṣe karaṇasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| samāveśe tu karaṇasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-videvanā akṣāḥ, `karaṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti lyuṭ; karmasaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ-dīvyante bhavatākṣāḥ, `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti yagātmanepade; akṣānityatra bhayasaṃjñākāryaprasaṅge paratvāttṛtīyā syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; kāryakālaṃ hi saṃjñāparibhāṣam, tataśca `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityatra yadasyopasthānaṃ tadanavakāśamiti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| ayaṃ tarhi samāveśe doṣaḥ- dīvyante'kṣā iti karmaṇyabhihite'pi karaṇasyānabhihitatvāttṛtīyā syāt, devanā akṣā iti lyuṭā karaṇasyābhidhāne'pi karmaṇo'nabhidhānena dvitīyā syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekaiva kārakaśaktiḥ saṃjñādvayayoginī| tataśyaikasmin kārake'bhihite kārakāntaramapyabhihitameva bhavati; śakterekatvāt||
padamañjarī
parikrayaṇe saṃpradānamanyatarasyām|| 1.4.44 ||
parikrayaṇaśabde dhātugatameva rephamāśritya `raṣābhyām' ityeva ṇatvam, prathamopanipatitatvād, yathopasargābhāve krayaṇamiti; na tūpasargasthamāśritya `kṛtyacaḥ' ityanena tasya paścādupanipatitatvena bahiraṅgatvāt| vetanādineti| vetanaṃ bhṛtiḥ, niyatakālatvameva spaṣṭayati| nātyantikaḥ kraya eveti| pariśabdaḥ sāmīpyaṃ dyotayati| krayo nāmātyantikaṃ svīkaraṇam, niyatakālaṃ tu tasya samīpameveti pariśabdasyārthaḥ||
padamañjarī
āghāro'dhikaraṇam|| 1.4.45 ||
ādhriyante'smin kriyā ityādhāra iti `adhyāyanyāyodyāva' ityādinā'dhikaraṇe ghañ| kriyāpekṣatvāt kārakabhāvasya kriyāgrahaṇam| yadi kriyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā, kartṛkarmaṇoreva syāt| kartṛsthā hi kriyā bhavati karmasthā vā| kartṛsaṃjñāyāḥ ko'vakāśaḥ? ye karmasthakriyāḥ- pacatyodanaṃ devadatta iti| nanvatrāpyadhiśrayaṇāderādhāraḥ karteti syādeva prasaṅgaḥ? ayaṃ tarhyavakāśaḥ- devadattāya rocate modaka ityuktam, atra devadattasthasyābhilāṣasya modakaḥ karteti| athāpyanavakāśā kartṛsaṃjñā? evamapi paryāyaḥ syāt| atha karmasaṃjñāyāḥ ko'vakāśaḥ? ye kartṛsthakriyāḥ-ādityaṃ paśyatīti| ataḥ kartṛkarmaṇorevādhikaraṇasaṃjñāprasaṅga ityata āha--kartṛ karmaṇorityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sākṣātkriyādhāre sambhavati kriyādhārabhūtakartṛ karmavyavadhānena kriyādhārasya gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum? karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitametad-yathākathañcitkriyādhārasyāpi karaṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti| mukhyasyāpi tu kasmānna syād? āsta iti kartṛsthāyāḥ kriyāyā udāharaṇam| pacatīti karmasthāyāḥ|
trividhaṃ ca tadadhikaraṇam--aupaśleṣikam, vaiṣayikam, abhivyāpakaṃ ceti| kaṭe āste,gurau āvasati, tileṣu tailamiti||
adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma|| 1.4.46 ||
padamañjarī
abhiniviśaśca|| 1.4.47 ||
neralpāctarasyāpūrvanipātād `abhini' iti samudāyānukaraṇamityāha--abhiniparvūsyeti| anyathā'bhipūrvasya nipūrvasya ceti brūyāt||
padamañjarī
upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ|| 1.4.48 ||
vasareśyarthasyeti| arthaśabdo nivṛttivacanaḥ, vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau, aśyarthasya yo vācakastasyetyarthaḥ| bhojananivṛttivācina iti yāvat| yadvā--śīṅo'rthaḥ śyarthaḥ, na śyarthastasya, asthānārthasyetyarthaḥ| sthāne'pi hi śīṅ vartate-jalāśayamiti| tena grāme tiṣṭhatītyatrārthe grāmamupavasatīti bhavati| asthānārthatve grāma upavasatīti, sa tarhi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, katham? nātropapūrvasya vaseḥ grāmo'dhikaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? anupasargasya--grāme vasan trirātramupavasati| etaduktaṃ bhavati--viśiṣṭādhārāvasthitatvena niścite devadatte bhojananivṛttiviśiṣṭakālaṃ pratipādayitumidaṃ prayujyate--grāma upavasatīti, tatrāntaraṅgatvāt pratīyamānavasikriyāpekṣo grāmasyādhikaraṇabhāvaḥ| upavasanaṃ tu svarūpeṇaiva kālamapekṣata iti kālenaivāntaraṅgaḥ sambandhaḥ, grāmādinā tu bahiraṅga ityaprayuktamapi trirātrādikaṃ karma bhavati||
padamañjarī
karturīpsitatamaṃ karma|| 1.4.49 ||
kartuḥ kriyayetyādi| karturyadāptumiṣṭatamamityanvayaḥ, karturiti cepsitāpekṣāyā `ktasya ca vartamāne' iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| īpsita iti `matibuddhi' ityādinā varttamāne ktaḥ| kriyayeti karaṇe tṛtīyā, kartā hi nāma yaḥ kriyāmanutiṣṭhati tena karturyadiṣṭatamamityukte tatkriyāveśādasau karttā bhavati tayā karaṇabhūtayeti gamyate, kartrā yadāptumiṣyate ātmīyayā kriyayetyarthaḥ| īpsitaśabdo'yamastyabhiprete rūḍhaḥ-īpsito'bhipreta iti; asti kriyāśabdaḥ- `āplṛvyāptau' san, `āp‌jñapṛdhāmīt', āptumiṣṭamīpsitamiti; tatra kriyāśabdasyeha grahaṇamiti darśitam--āptumiṣṭatamamiti|
karmaṇa iti| aśvasya| sa hi bhakṣaṇakriyayā māṣānāptumicchati| yadyevam, yathāśvasya vastuto bhakṣaṇe kartṛtve satyapi samprati bandhanaṃ prati karmatvena vivakṣitatvādakartṛtvād māṣāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñayā na bhavati, tathā sārthāddhīyata ityatrāpi hīyamānaṃ sārtho jahātīti vastuvṛttena tyāgena kartturapi sārthasya saṃpratyapādānarūpeṇa vivakṣitatvād akartṛtvātkarmaṇi yagātmanepade na syātām|
atrāhuḥ- karmakartaryatra yagātmanepade, katham? jahātirayaṃ gamanāyāṃ vartatedevadattaṃ sārtho jahāti, apagamayatītyarthaḥ, eṣaiva ca sārthasyāpagamanā yaduta kṣudupaghātādinā devadattasyāpagame tatsamarthācaraṇam| yadā tu kṣudhādinā svayamevāpagacchati, tadā karmakartṛ tvam, tadāyaṃ prayogaḥ| tataśca hīyata iti sārthaḥ svayamevāpagacchatīti, punaḥ kuto hīyate? ityapekṣāyāṃ sārarthena sambandha iti|
