tamabgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| īpsitatamasyāpīpsitatvasambhavād udāhaṇasiddhiṃ manyate| payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkta iti| karaṇasaṃjñā tu dātreṇa lunātītyādau sāvakāśā, na hi dātraṃ lavanepsitam| `tathā yuktam' ityanenāpi na bhavati, dveṣyodāsīnaprāpyayostatra gahaṇāt| satyapyatra payaso bhujikriyāyāṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakatve īpsāyāḥ prakarṣābhāvaḥ| yatra tarhi paya evepsitatamam, tatra prāpnoti, tadyathā kaścit kañcidāha-siddhaṃ bhujyatāmiti, sa āha-prabhūtaṃ bhuktamasmābhiriti, itara āha-payo bhaviṣyatīti, aparastvaramāṇa āha-payasā khalu bhuñjīyeti, atra prāptāprāptavivekena payasa evepsitatamatvaṃ na tvodanasya, atrāpyodanamevepsitatamam; payasastu saṃskārakatvātkaraṇatvam| na tvasya kevale guṇe ādaraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tatsaṃskṛte odane, na hyasau kevalasya payasaḥ pānena saṃtuṣyatīti| yadi tamabgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, payasaudanaṃ bhuṅkta ityatraiva syāt, pacatyodanamityādau na syāt, na hīpsitatamaṃ yuktam, asati pratiyogini vastu yattulyajātīyaṃ tadeva pratiyogitāṃ bhajate| kārakaṃ cātra na kiñcidiṣṭamīpsitaṃ payasastvīpsyamānātvād yujyate pratiyogitā,naiṣa doṣaḥ; atrāpi kriyāpekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ, ādau hi karttā phalārtha kriyāmabhīpsati, ataḥ phalārthamiṣyamāṇatvādīpsitā kriyā| phalaṃ tu svarūpeṇeṣyamāṇamīpsitatamaṃ kriyāyā api karmatvaṃ saṃdarśanādiviśeṣāntaraspardhayā| yatra tarhi phalābhāvastatra na syāt, kva ca phalābhāvaḥ ? vikārye-kāṣṭhani bhasmīkarotīti, na hi kāṣṭhāni phalarūpāṇi| mā bhūvan tāni svarūpeṇa phalāni, bhasmātmanā tu phalāni? prāpye tarhi na syāt--ādityaṃ paśyati, himavantaṃ śrṛṇotīti, na hyatra kriyayā kaścidatiśayo janyate| atrāpyatiśayo janyate--prākaṭyaṃ nāma? yo hi yaṃ paśyati śṛṇoti vā tasyāsau prakaṭo bhavati, pratipatrādyatiriktapuruṣāpekṣayā tu viśeṣonāstītyucyate| yadvā--tamabgrahaṇena yatrāpakṛṣṭecchā tadeva vyāvartyate, tena paśyatītyādāvādityādīnāmapi pratiyogino'sattvenāpakarṣābhāvād bhaviṣyati, atra ca liṅgam `lalāṭakukkuṭyau paśyati' iti|
karmetyanuvarttamāna iti| adhiśīṅsthāsāmityataḥ| ādhāranivṛttyarthamiti| prācyaṃ karmagrahaṇāmādhāreṇa saṃbaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| ādhārānuvṛttau ko doṣastatrāha--ādhārasyaiva hi syāditi| kvetyāha--gehamityādi| yatra tu na syāttadāha--odanaṃ pacatītyādi|
etaccepsitatamaṃ karma trividham--nirvartyam, vikāryam, prāpyamiti| tathāyuktamapi dvividham--dveṣyam, itaracca| `akathitaṃ ca' ityaparam| saṃjñāntaraprasaṅge cānyat--`divaḥ karma ca' ityādi| tadevaṃ saptavidhaṃ karma| uktaṃ ca--
nirvartya ca vikāryaṃ ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam|
taccepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhā'nyattu kalpitam||
audāsīnyena yatprāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam|
saṃjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam|| iti|
tathā--
yadasat, jāyate sadvā janmanā yat prakāśyate|
tannirvartyaṃ vikāryaṃ tu karma dvedhā vyavasthitam||
prakṛtyucchedasambhūtaṃ kiñcitkāṣṭhādi bhasmavat|
kiñcid guṇāntarotpattyā suvarṇādivikāravat||
kriyākṛtaviśeṣāṇāṃ siddhiryatra na gamyate|
darśanādanumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate || iti|
tatra nirvartyam--ghaṭaṃ karotīti, vyaktyabhiprāyoṇa janmasāmānyābhiprāyeṇa prakāśanam| nanu ca yadi ghaṭaḥ? na karttavyaḥ; atha kartavyaḥ? na ghaṭaḥ ; ityanupapanna ghaṭa karotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tathāvidhaṃ vastu karoti yasya niṣpannasya ghaṭa iti saṃjñeti--ayamatrārthaḥ| evamodanaṃ payatītyādāvapi| vikāryam--kāṣṭhāni bhasma karoti, suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ karotīti| prāpyam--ādityaṃ paśyatīti| na hyatra pratyakṣeṇa anumānena vā kriyājanyaḥ kaścidatiśayo gamyate, yathā--nirvartyavikāryayoḥ rajjuṃ sṛjati, kāṣṭhaṃ dahati, devadattaṃ roṣayatīti| kārakatvaṃ tu prāpyasyābhāsopagamādibhiḥ, ādityo hyabhāsamupagacchati, yato ddaśyate abhivyaktimupayāti, yato vyaktamupalabhyate sahate ca darśanam, yataḥ śakyate draṣṭuṃ tadevābhāsopagama; vyaktiḥ, soḍhatvamiti karmaṇo viśeṣāḥ prāpyamāṇasya kriyāsiddhau vivakṣitāḥ||
padamañjarī
tathā yuktaṃ cānīpsitam|| 1.4.50 ||
tatheti pṛthak padam, nopasamastam; lakṣaṇābhāvāt| cakāro'vadhāraṇe, anekārthatvānnipātānām, tathetyasya cānantare draṣṭavya ityāha--tenaiveti| īpsitādanyatsarvamanīpsitamiti|
yathā adharmānṛtādibhiruttarapadārthapratipakṣabhūtaṃ yadvastu tatpratiṣedhadvāreṇābhidhīyate, tathehānīpsitaśabdenepsitapratipakṣabhūtaṃ na dveṣyamevābhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? aśva--loṣṭa--ityādivadīpsitavyatiriktaṃ sarvamiti sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ| viṣaṃ bhakṣayatīti| na kasyāpi viṣamīpsitatamamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ya eva manuṣyo vyādhyādinā sarvataḥ pīḍito maraṇameva jyāyo manyate, tasya viṣamapīpsitatamameva; yadiṣṭaṃ guḍādibhrāntyā viṣe pravartate tasyāpi tadīpsitatamameva, yadiṣṭaṃ guḍādi, tad‌buddhireva tatra pravartate; ato'tra pūrveṇaiva siddhamityudāharaṇāntaropanyāsaḥ| grāmaṃ gacchanniti| nātra vṛkṣamūlānīpsitatamāni pūrvamanabhisaṃhitatvānnāntarīyakaṃ hi tadupasarpaṇam| na cātrāpi yāvad grāmaṃ gacchanniti na prayujyate tāvannāntarīyakatā na pratīyata iti pūrveṇaiva siddham, yathā--nadī kūlaṃ kaṣatītyatrācetanatvādīpsābhāvaḥ, padāntarasambandhātpratīyamāno bahiraṅgatvātkarmasaṃjñāṃ na pratibadhnāti? bhavatvayaṃ pratipattāraṃ prati upapādanaprakāraḥ, yastu prayuṅkte sa pūrvamevepsāprakarṣābhāvaṃ jānan tatkathaṃ prayuktamiti pūrveṇāsiddhireva| evaṃ ca nadīkūlamityatrāpi anenaiva karmasaṃjñā| tathā yatra kriyāyāmeva tātparyaṃ na phale, nāntarīyakā tu phalasiddhiḥ, tatrāpyanenaiva bhavati|
atha kriyāphalayogi karmeti kasmād noktam? yadīpsitatamaṃ yad dveṣyamitaracca tatra sarvatrānugatametad, yaduta kriyāphalayogitvaṃ karturapi tarhi karmatvaṃ syāt, kriyāphalasya saṃyogasya tatrāpi bhāvāt| bhāvāt| atha parasamavetakriyāphalayogīti lakṣaṇam? evamapyātmā jñātavya ityatra na syāt , saṃvidaśca svayaṃ prakāśābhimatāyāḥ karmatvaṃ syāt| ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmītyatra hi tritayameva bhāsate--ghaṭaḥ, jñānam, ātmā ceti| tatra jñānaṃ kriyā, tatphalaṃ śabdaprayogādirūpo vyavahāraḥ, tena yujyamānasya ghaṭasya yathā karmatvaṃ tathā jñānasyāpi syāt| jñānaṃ hi kriyā bhavati vyavahārūpasya phalasyāśrayabhūtam, tasyaiva jñānasya yat svarūpaṃ tadapekṣayā yaḥ para ātmā tatra ca samavaitītyalamiyatā| corānityatrāpi martṛkāmo vā mitrādirūpeṇa viparyasyamāno vā corānupasarpatīti pūrveṇaiva siddham||
padamañjarī
akathinaṃ ca|| 1.4.51 ||
akathitaśabdo'yamastyapradhāne rūḍhaḥ, tadyathā--akathito'hamasmin grāme, apradhānabhūta iti gamyate| asti ca kriyāśabdo'kīrtitaparyāyaḥ| `katha vākyapravandhe', curādāvadantaḥ paṭhyate, tatra pūrvasya grahaṇe `pāṇinā kāṃsapātryāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' ityatra pāṇikāṃsapātryorapi syāt| karaṇādhikaraṇasaṃjñayostu pacatyādiravakāśaḥ, na hi tatrāsya prasaṅgaḥ; `duhiyāci' iti parigaṇanāt, ato dvitīyasya grahaṇam, tadāha--kenākathitam? apadānādibhirviśeṣakathābhiriti| kimatra pramāṇaṃ tadāha--keneti| karaṇanirdeśaḥ| rūḍhiśabdeṣu hi vyutpattyarthameva kriyopādīyate; na tatra karaṇādi sambadhyate, na hi gacchatīti gaurityatra keneti praśno ratheneti prativacanaṃ vā bhavati| iha `kārake' ityanuvartanāt satyeva kārakatve'kathitasya saṃjñayā bhāvyamiti sāmarthyādviśeṣakathābhirityuktam|
parigaṇanaṃ kama dharmādīti| tasya tu prādhānyaṃ tadarthatvāt pravṛtteḥ| sambadhyata iti| sacata ityasyārthakathanametat,`ṣaca samavāye' svaritet| kecittu parasmaipadibhiḥ saha dhātumenaṃ paṭhanti `ṣaca savāye'`rapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' iti| tatrāhuḥ-`ṣacasevane' ityasyānudātteto'nekārthatvātsamavāye pravṛttiriti, sambadhnāteśca karmavyāpāre sacirvartata iti kartṛpadasya karmapadenārthakathanaṃ nānupapannam, yathā--rādhyatyodana ityasya pacyata iti| uktamiti| ācaritamityasya vivaraṇam| sūtrakāreṇeti| kaviśabdo medhāvimātravacano'pi prakaraṇāt sūtrakāre prayukta iti darśayati| gāṃ dogdhi paya iti| nanu cātrāyamarthaḥ- gauḥ payastyajati, dogdhā gavā payastyājayatīti; tatra prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt siddhā goḥ karmasaṃjñā| na ca vācyam--`prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasya yadi bhavati gatyarthādiṣvevetyuttarasūtre niyamādatra na prāpnopi, yathā--pacantaṃ devadattaṃ prayuṅkte, pācayati devadattenetyatra' iti;ṇyantaṣveva sa niyamaḥ, ayaṃ tu prakṛtyantaḥ, naitadasti; yathā ṇyanteṣu dhātuṣu kriyāviśiṣṭasya prayuktiḥ pratīyate--gamayatīti, naivamatra viṣkriyasyāpi gavāderdohananayanādiṣu viniyogāt| tathā hyaduhānāpi gaurduhyate, agacchanto bhārādayaḥ śirasā nīyante, tasmāddegdhītyekasyā eva kriyāyāḥ śravaṇād gopayasorbhedena karmatvaṃ na bhavati| ṇici tu sati prakṛtyaṃśasya pratyayāṃśasya ca bhedena dve vācye iti karmabhedopapattiḥ|
gamayati grāmaṃ devadattamiti| yadā tu duheḥ kṣaraṇamarthaḥ-kṣarati goḥ kṣīram, kṣīraṃ kṣārayati devadatta iti, tadā yadyapi gorapāye'vadhibhāvo vidyate; tathāpyavivakṣite tasminnimittatvamātrāpekṣāyāmudāharaṇopapattiḥ| evaṃ cāvadhitvavivakṣāyāmapādānasaṃjñāyāṃ bhavatyeva--gerduhyate paya iti| yadā tu payasyeva viśeṣaṇaṃ gauḥ, tadā ṣaṣṭhī--goḥ payo dogdhīti|
pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate iti| purorapatyaṃ pauravaḥ| nanu vihitātrāpādānasaṃjñā pauravādasau gāmādatte, na yācanādeva tata ādatte, yācito'sau yadi dadāti tata ādatte, nanu mā nāmāditā''ditsate tāvat, tadapi na; yataḥ svabhāvaparicicchitsuranāditsamāno'pi yācate| gāmavaruṇaddhi vrajamiti| nanu ca gāṃ vrajaṃ praveśayatītyayamatrārthaḥ, tataśca siddhaṃ vrajasya karmatvam? atha vraje gāmavasthāpayatītyarthaḥ, tarhi kathitātrādhikaraṇasaṃjñā; yadā tarhyavarodhanakriyāṃ prati nimittatvamātraṃ vivakṣyate na karmatvaṃ nādhikaraṇatvaṃ tadedamudāharaṇam| vrajena hetunā'vasthāpayatītyarthaḥ|
māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatīti| `praccha jñīpsāyām', tudādiḥ, grahijyādinā saṃprasāraṇam| nanu ca kathitātrāpādānasaṃjñā, sa hi tasmādupadeśamādatte na praśnamātrādādatte, pṛṣṭo'sau yadyupadiśati tata ādatte| mā nāmāditā, āditsate tāvat tadapi na, anāditsamāno'pi svabhāvaparijñānāyā pṛcchati| bhikṣiryācivadvyākhyeyaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaryācibhikṣyorubhayorupādānam, na hyanayorarthe bhedo'sti, arthāśrayā ceyaṃ saṃjñā, na duhyādisvarūpāśrayā| samānārthe'pi hi gṛhyate--devadattaṃ śataṃ prārthayata iti? ucyate, ananuyārthasya yācatergrahaṇārtham| tenāvinītaṃ vinayaṃ yācate, kruddhaṃ prasādaṃ yācata ityatrāpi bhavati| sakṛdupāttasya corabhayarūpānupapatteḥ bhikṣirapi gṛhītaḥ|
vṛkṣamavacinoti phalanīti| yadyapyavacinvad vṛkṣān phalamādatte ityapādānasaṃjñāyā ayaṃ viṣayaḥ, tathāpi yadā vṛkṣo nāvadhitvena vivakṣyate nimittarūpeṇaiva tu vivakṣyate, tadedamudāharaṇam|
brūte'nuśāstīti| `brūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci' `śāsu anuśiṣṭau', adādī, yadyadyapyatra dharmeṇa vacanānuśāsanakarmaṇā māṇavakasyābhipreyamāṇatvam, tathāpi dadātikarmābhāvātsaṃjñāyā aprasaṅgaḥ| ye tu tatra dadātikarmaṇeti nāśrayanti, teṣāmapi nimittatvamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ nābhipreyamāṇatvamityudāharaṇopapattiḥ||
athānye'pi dvikarmakāḥ-
nīvahyorharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca|
dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ||
`gatyarthānām' ityuttarasūtropalakṣaṇam| nī--ajāṃ nayati grāmam| vahivahati bhāraṃ grāmam| harati--bhāraṃ harati grāmam| cakāreṇa jayatyādayaḥ samuccīyante--śataṃ jayati devadattam, śataṃ muṣṇāti devadattam, śataṃ daṇḍayati devadattam, karṣati grāmaṃ śākhām|
idaṃ vicāryate--dvikarmakebhyo dhātubhyaḥ karmaṇi lādaya utpadyamānāḥ kimīpsitatame karmaṇi pradhāne utpadyante? āhosvidanena yasya karmatvaṃ tasmin guṇakarmaṇīti? tatroktam--
pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām|
apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ|| iti||
ayamarthaḥ- ye dvikarmakā dhātavasteṣāṃ pradhāne karmaṇīpsitatame vācye lādīnāhuḥ-lādayo bhavantītyāhuḥ| lādayaḥ-lakṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ| pradhānāpradhānayorbhinnakakṣayoryugapadabhidhānāsaṃbhave pradhānasyaivābhidhānaṃ nyāyyam, pradhānatvādeveti bhāvaḥ| nī--nīyate grāmamajā, neyā, nītā, sunayā| vahi--uhyate bhāro grāmam, voḍhavyaḥ, ūḍhaḥ, suvahaḥ| hṛñ--hriyate bhāro grāmam, harttavyaḥ, hṛtaḥ, suharaḥ| kṛṣ--kṛṣyate śākhā grāmam, kraṣṭavyā, kṛṣṭā, sukarṣā|
apradhāne duhādīnāmiti| atra daṇḍiprabhṛtayo'pi gṛhyante, na tu duhiyācīti ślokapaṭhitā eva| eteṣāṃ duhādīnāmapradhāne karmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhuḥ | etadapi nyāyasiddham; yataḥ payo'rthī pūrvaṃ gavi pravarttate, ataḥ śūddhasya duhergavābhisambandhaḥ, godohena tu payasa ityantaraṅgatvādakathitakarmaṇastatraiva lādayo bhavanti| evaṃ sarvatra|
duhi--gaurduhyate payaḥ, dohyā, dugdhā, sudohā| yāci--pauravo gāṃ yācyate, yācyaḥ, yācitaḥ, suyācaḥ| rudhi--vrajo'varudhyate gām, avarodhyaḥ, avaruddhaḥ,svavarodhaḥ| pracchi--māṇavakaḥ panthānaṃ pṛcchyate, praṣṭavyaḥ, pṛṣṭaḥ, supracchaḥ| bhikṣi--pauravo gāṃ bhikṣyate, bhikṣitavyaḥ, bhikṣitaḥ, subhikṣaḥ| ciñ--vṛkṣo'vacīyate phalāni, avacetavyaḥ, avacitaḥ, svavacayaḥ| brūñ‌--ucyate māṇavako dharmam, vaktavyaḥ, uktaḥ, suvacaḥ| śāmu--anuśiṣyate māṇavako dharmam, anuśāsitavyaḥ, anuśiṣṭaḥ, svanuśāsaḥ| daṇḍi--gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍyante, daśḍyāḥ, daṇḍitāḥ, sudaṇḍāḥ| ji-śataṃ jīyate devadattaḥ, jetavyaḥ, jitaḥ, sujayaḥ| muṣi--muṣyate devadattaḥ śatam, moṣitavyaḥ, muṣitaḥ, sumoṣaḥ|
ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇa iti| abhidhāna iti śeṣaḥ| aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karturṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇaḥ sato'bhidhāne lādīnāhurityarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-ye gatyarthādayo'ṇyantāvasthāyāmapi sakarmakā ṇyantāvasthāyāmuttarasūtreṇa dvikarmakā jātāḥ, teṣu ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ yaduttarasūtreṇopajātaṃ karma tatra lādayo bhavantītyarthaḥ| gamayati grāmaṃ devadattam, gamyate grāmaṃ devadattaḥ, gamayitavyaḥ, gamitaḥ; sugamaḥ| budhyarthaḥ- bodhyate māṇavako dharmam, bodhayitavyaḥ, bodhitaḥ, subodhaḥ| pratyavasānārthaḥ- bhojyate māṇavaka odanam, bhojayitavyaḥ, bhojitaḥ, subhojaḥ| śabdakarma-pāṭhyate māṇavako vedam, pāṭhayitavyaḥ, pāṭhitaḥ, supāṭhaḥ| akarmakaḥ- āsyate māṇavako māsam, āsayitavyaḥ, āsitaḥ, svāsaḥ|
buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇi lādaya iti matāntaram| bodhyate māṇavakaṃ dharmaḥ, bhojyate māṇavakamodanaḥ, pāṭhyate māṇavakaṃ veda ityādi|
tadayamatra nirṇayaḥ- nīvahihṛkṛṣibhyaḥ pradhānakarmaṇi lādayaḥ; tatsambandhasya pūrvabhāvitvāt| duhyādibhyo jidaṇḍamuṣibhyaścāpradhāne; tatsambandhasyānantaraṅgatvāt| buddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇi pradhāne vā yatheṣṭam; gatyarthākarmakayoḥ hṛkrośca ṇyantayoḥ prayojye karmaṇīti| prayojyasya ca prādhānyenābhidhīyamānāprayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānatvāt prādhānyam| guṇabhūtaprayojyavyāpārakarmaṇastu guṇabhāva ārthana nyayena prayojyavyāpāraprādhānyam, tadarthatvāt prayojakavyāpārasya| tatprādhānyācca tatkarmaṇo'pi prādhānyamityanye| sarvathā lādayaḥ prayojyakarmaṇīti sthitam|
akarmakāṇāṃ ca dhātūnāṃ kālabhāvādhvagantavyadeśāḥ karmasaṃjñakā iṣyante| uktaṃ ca--`kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām, deśaścākarmakāṇāṃ tu karmasaṃjño bhavatīti vaktavyam' iti| adhvagantavyeti--gantavyo'dhvā, adhvā gantavyaḥ, kaḍārādiṣvadhvaśabde draṣṭavyaḥ| gantavyatvena prasiddhasya niyataparimāṇasya krośādergrahaṇārthaṃ gantavyagrahaṇam, tenādhvānaṃ svapitīti na bhavati| nanu ca `kālādhvanoḥ' iti siddhā dvitīyā, kiṃ karmasaṃjñayā? deśasya tāvadvaktavyā| kālādhvanorapi lādividhānārtha karmatvameṣitavyam| āsyate māsaḥ, āsitaḥ, āsitavyaḥ,svāsaḥ| evaṃ śayyate krośa ityādi| bhāvaḥ- godohamāste| yāvatā kālena gaurduhyate tāvantaṃ kālamāsta ityarthaḥ| godohādīnāṃ māsādivat kālatvenāprasiddhatvādbhāvasya pṛthag grahaṇam| deśaḥ- kurūn svapiti, kuravaḥ supyanta ityādi| `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' iti tu sūtramakriyātyantasayogārtham--māsaṃ guḍadhānāḥ, sarvarātraṃ kalyāṇī, krośaṃ kuṭilā nadīti| na tarhi vaktavyam--kālābhāvādhvagantavyā iti? na vaktavyam, nātrāsirāsanamātre varttate, kiṃ tu tatpūrvake vyāpane varttate--māsamāste | ko'rthaḥ? māsamāsanena vyāpnotīti| evaṃ vademadhīte, māsaṃ vedādhyayanena vyāpnotītyarthaḥ| atha `kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī dvikarmakeṣu kiṃ pradhāne karmaṇi bhavati? āhosvid guṇe bhavati? āhosvidubhayoḥ? ubhayoriti prāptaṃ dvitīyāvadbhāṣyakāravacanāttu guṇakarmaṇi vikalpena ṣaṣṭhī| pradhānakarmaṇi nityā--netā'śvasya strughnamiti vā|
ihākathitaṃ karmetyetāvadastu, māstu pūrvasūtradvayam, tadviṣayasyāpyakathiitatvāt, satyam; naṭasya śrṛṇotītyatra mā bhūditi duhyādiparigaṇanamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe odanaṃ pacati, vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpatītyatra na syāditi pūrvamapi yogadvayamārabhyata iti||
padamañjarī
gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau|| 1.4.52 ||
gamayati māṇa vakaṃ grāmamiti| kathamatra grāmasya karmatvam, yāvatā karturīpsitatamaṃ karmetyucyate,na ca saṃprati māṇavakaḥ karttā; anena karmasaṃjñakatvāt| tatra yathā māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhnātītyatra vastuto bakṣaṇenepsitatamānāmapi māṣāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñā na bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ? aśvasya saṃpratyakartṛtvāt, tadvadatrāpi na prāpnoti; mā bhūṇṇicyutpanne māṇavakaḥ kartā, prāktadutpatteḥ prakṛtyarthe karttā bhavati, tadānīmeva ca grāmasyābhisambandhaḥ grāmakarmaṇyasau gamane preṣyate--grāmaṃ gaccheti| ato yasyāmavasthāyāṃ grāmasya karmatvaṃ na tasyāṃ māṇavakasya karmatvam, yasyāṃ ca ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ māṇavakasya karmatvaṃ na tasyāṃ grāmasya karmatvam; pūrvapravṛttatvād| māṣeṣvaśvamityatra tu naivaṃ saṃbhavati| yāpayatīti| `yā prāpaṇe' ityatra prāptyā gatirlakṣyataiti yātirgatyarthaḥ|
nīvahyoriti| nanvetayorgatiphalaṃ prāpaṇamartho na gatiḥ, `na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' ityatra ca bhāṣyam--na `vahirgatyarthaḥ' iti, satyam; guṇabhāvenāpi gatiḥ pratīyata iti matvā pratiṣedha uktaḥ|
vaheraniyantṛkasyeti| vakṣyāmīti copakṣepaḥ| vāhayati balīvardānyavānityatrāṇau balīvardāḥ karttāraḥ, ṇyante tu niyantā sārathiḥ karttāḥ, tatra pratiṣedhapratiṣedhādvidhireva bhavati| budhyarthagrahaṇena jñānamātravācināmeva grahaṇam, na tu tadviśeṣavācināṃ smaratyādīnāmityāhuḥ| vṛttāvapi tathaivodāhṛtam|
ādikhādyoriti| apara āha--sarvameva pratyavasānakāryamaderna bhavati, nāvaśyamiyameva karmasaṃjñeti `nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca' iti padamapi na bhavati, idamekamiṣyate--`kte'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ'--idameṣāṃ jagdhamiti|
bhakṣeriti| gatyarthādiṣu prāyeṇa hetumaṇṇica eva saṃbhavād hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsattestasyaiva nyāyya iti curādiṇijanto'pyaṇyantaeveti bhakṣeḥ prāptiḥ| bhakṣayati balīvardān sasyamiti| kṣetrasthānāṃ yavānāṃ bhakṣyamāṇānāṃ hisā bhavati, tasyāmavasthāyāṃ kaiściccaitanyābhyupagamāt| svāmino vā hisā draṣyavyā|
iha karmaśabdena kvacitkriyā gṛhyate, yathā--`karttari karmavyatīhāre' iti, kvacit sādhanakarmā--`veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ' iti, iha śabdakriyāṇāmiti cet? `hvayatyādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ'--hvayati putraṃ devadattaḥ, hvāpayati putraṃ devadattena; krandati putraṃ devadattaḥ, krandayati putraṃ devadattena; śabdāyate devadattaḥ, śabdāyayate devadattena| akarmakatvādathātra prasaṅgaḥ, śabdalakṣaṇakasya karmaṇo'ntarbhāvāt karmāntarāyogācca| `śrṛṇoteścopasaṅkhyānam' --aśabdakriyatvāt śrṛṇoti ślokaṃ devadattaḥ, śrāvayati ślokaṃ devadattam; na ca budhyarthatvādatra siddhiḥ, cetatyādayo hi jñānamātravacanā budhyarthāḥ| astu tarhi sādhanakarmaṇo grahaṇam, śabdakarmaṇa iti cet? jalpatiprabhṛtīnāmupasaṃkhyānam, jalpati putraṃ devadattaḥ, jalpayati putraṃ devadattam; vilapati putraṃ devadattaḥ, vilāpayati putraṃ devadattam; ābhāṣate putraṃ devadattaḥ ābhāṣayati putraṃ devadattam| ddaśeḥ sarvatra, yadyapi kriyāgrahaṇam athāpi sādhanagrahaṇam, athāpyubhayagrahaṇam-sarvathā ddaśerupasaṃkhyānam| paśyati rūpatarka kārṣāpaṇam, darśayati rūpatarkaṃ kārṣāpaṇam| yadā cāyaṃddaśiḥ cakṣuḥ sādhanake jñānaviśeṣe vartate tadetadvaktavyam; jñānamātravacanatve tu budhyarthatvādeva siddham; tadevamubhayorapi pakṣayorddoṣāntaṃ bhāṣyaṃ nānyataraḥ pakṣo niraṇāyi|
vṛttikārastu ye śabdakriyāḥ śabdasādhanakarmāṇaśca tānavivādasiddhānudāharativacanena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| emanyatrāpi| tatra buddhyarthatvādeva siddham| yadyapyanyā buddhiranyā bodhanā, upasarjanībhūtāpi tāvad‌buddhirastīti buddharthatvamastyeva, upasarjanībhūto'pi ca gatyādirartho gṛhyate, anyathā gamayatītyādīnāmagatyarthatvādevāprasaṅgādaṇigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi, astu cetanaviṣaye, evamacetanaviṣaye katham? yaḥ kaṃcijjalpati tamanyo jalpayati, na hyatra prabodhanāpyasti|
akarmakāṇāmiti| kālabhāvādhvagantavyadeśavyatiriktakarmarahitānāmityartho'tra grāhyaḥ, anyathā māsamāste devadattaḥ, māsamāsayati devadattam, godohamāsayati, krośamāsayati, kurūnāsayatītyatra na syāt; kālādikarmaṇā sakarmakatvāt| evaṃ `laḥ karmaṇi ca' ityādāvapi yatrākarmakagrahaṇaṃ tatra sarvatra draṣṭavyam, tena māsamāsyate devadattenatyādau bhāve lādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti| uktañca--siddhaṃ tu kālakarmaṇākarmakatvadvacanāditi| kālagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam| vatkaraṇātsvāśrayamapi bhavati--māsa āsyate devadattena--māsakarmaṇi lo bhavati| sa tarhyakarmakavacanād bhāve vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ; akarmakāṇāmityucyate, na ca kālādibhiḥ kecidakarmakāḥ| kālādibhirapyakarmakāḥ yadā te na vivakṣyante, tadyathā--śete devadatto na bhuṅkte iti| nāpyavivakṣitakarmāṇo'karmakāḥ, kiṃ tarhi? ye'tyantāvidyamānakarmāṇo dhātavo'karmakāḥ, nārthāḥ| yasya dhātoḥ svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvam, na ca kālādikarmakāḥ, nārthāḥ| yasya dhātoḥ svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvam, na ca kālādikarmaṇā svarūpāvadhikamakarmakatvaṃ kasyāpi sambhavatīti sāmarthyātadvyatiriktena karmaṇā'karmakatvaṃ vijñāyate| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā svavyāpāre svatantrasyāpi prayojyasya prayojakavyāpāre vivakṣite tena pradhānabhūtenāpyamānatvād antaraṅgatvena pūrvapravṛttāmapi kartṛ saṃjñāṃ bādhitvā karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti? evaṃ tarhi siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ-prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasya yadi bhavati ganyarthādīnāmeva, nānyeṣāmiti| tena pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadattenetyatra pūrvaṃ pravṛttāyā eva kartṛ saṃjñāyā avasthānāt kartari tṛtiyā bhavati| uktaṃ ca--
guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryātpreṣaṇe karmatāṃ gataḥ|
niyamāt karmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate|| iti|
kartuḥ svadharmārttṛtīyā| atha katham--
ayacitāraṃ na hi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka| iti?
svatantrāḥ kavayaḥ| yadvā--sutāṃ prati kiñcidudvāhaviṣaye grāhayituṃ bodhayituṃ na śaśāketyevaṃ vyākhyeyam; tatra budhyarthatvāt siddham||
padamañjarī
hṛkroranyatarasyām|| 1.4.53 ||
gatyarthādayo nivṛttāḥ tenobhayatra vibhāṣeyam| yadā haratirgatau vartate-harati bhāraṃ devadatta iti, abhyavahāre vā-abhyavaharati māṇavakamodanamiti| karotiścāpyakarmakaḥ- odanasya pūrṇāḥ chātrāḥ vikurvata iti, tadā pūrveṇa prāpte| nanu `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti niyamasyaiva vikalpo yuktaḥ, gatyarthādiṣveveti yo'yaṃ niyamaḥ sa `hṛkroranyatarasyām' iti, tataśca pakṣe niyamābhāvāt gatyādyarthādanyatra pakṣe karmatvaṃ pakṣāntare ca kartṛ tvaṃ bhavatu, gatyādyarthatve tu nityavat karmasaṃjñā prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhi vārttikakāreṇa ubhayatravibhāṣāsviyaṃ paṭhitā, tatsāmarthyādanantarasya vidhiriti nāśrīyate, aviśeṣeṇa hṛkrorvikalpaḥ pravartate|
abhivādiddaśoriti| abhivādayateraprāpte vibhāṣā ddaśerbudhyarthatvāt ddaśeḥ sarvatreti vā prāpte| abhivādayate iti| `ṇicaśca' ityātmanepadam| parasmaipade tu abhivādayati guruṃ devadetteneti kartṛ saṃjñaiva bhavati|
darśayate iti| karmasaṃjñābhāvapakṣe karmāntarasyābhāvāt `ṇeraṇau' ityātmanepadam, anyatra tu `ṇicaśca' iti||
padamañjarī
svatantraḥ kartā|| 1.4.54 ||
svatantraśabdo'yaṃ tantuvāyavacano'pyasti--svaṃ tantramasya svatantraḥ, vitatāstantavassvatantramityucyate; asti ca sādhāraṇadravye puruṣe vartate sādhāraṇaṃ bhavettantram, svaṃ dhanaṃ tantraṃ sādhāraṇamasya svatantraḥ; asti ca pradhānavacanaḥ- sva ātmā tantraṃ pradhānamasya svatantra iti| tatrādyayorgrahaṇe tayorapādānādiviṣaye kartṛsaṃjñā syāt, paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca tantuvāyādāgacchatītyādau; iha ca na syāt-devadatto gacchatīti, idamādyayorgrahaṇe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā tṛtīyamarthamāśrityāha--svatantra iti| pradhānabhūta ucyata iti| svatantraśabdasya tatraiva prasiddhataratvāditi bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca kārakadhikārāt kriyāviṣayaṃ svātantryaṃ gṛhyate, na ca tantuvāyastantuvāyatayā kriyāyāmupayujyate, kiṃ tarhi? pradhānatayaiveti tadvācina eva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| yadi pradhānabhūta ucyate, evaṃ satyapradhānāpekṣatvāt pradhānabhāvasya yatrādhikaraṇādīnyapradhānāni kārakāṇi santi--kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatīti atraivaḥ syāt; na tvāste śete ityādāvityaśaṅkya prādhānyenāguṇabhāvo lakṣyata iti darśayati--aguṇībhūta iti| tena yasya guṇabhāvo nāsti, sa karttā| kārakāntarāvivakṣāyāmapi cāguṇabhāvo'styeva| kaḥ punaratra kārakāṇāṃ guṇaguṇibhāvaḥ? yadā ekāpāye'pi kriyā na nirvartate, uktamatra--
prāganyataḥ śaktilābhānnyagbhāvāpādanādapi|
tadadhīnapravṛttitvāt pravṛttānāṃ nivartanāt||
addaṣṭatvātpratinidheḥ praviveke'pi darśanāt|
ārādapyupakāritvāt svātantryaṃ karturiṣyate || iti|
kāṣṭhādīni kartrā pravartitāni karaṇādiśaktiṃ pratilabhante, karttā tu prāgeva| kartṛ saṃnidhau ca karaṇādini nyagbhavanti, tadadhīne ca teṣāṃ pravṛttinivṛttī| pradhānakartṛśca pratinidhirna ddaṣṭaḥ, karaṇādīnāṃ tu ddaṣṭaḥ-vrīhyapacāre nīvārairijyate| pravivekaḥ- abhāvaḥ| karaṇādyabhāve'pyāste, śete ityādau kevalaḥ kartā ddaśyate, na tu karturabhāve karaṇādīni ddaśyante|
ārādapyupakāritvāditi| yadyapyasau taṭasthaḥ phalasiddhāvupakaroti, na tu karaṇādivadanupraviśya tathāpītyarthaḥ| etacca prāyeṇa cetaneṣveva sambhavati, nācetaneṣu--ratho yātītyādau, naiṣa doṣaḥ; uktalakṣaṇe karttari dvayaṃ ddaṣṭam--pradhānyam,āguṇabhāvaśca| tatrāguṇabhāvaḥ acetaneṣu cetaneṣvapi sambhavati| sa cāyamaguṇabhāvo na pratiniyataviṣayaḥ, yasyaiva tu vivakṣyate, tasyaivetyāha--svātantryeṇa vivakṣyata iti| vivakṣyata ityasyodāharaṇam--sthālī pacatīti|
anye tu vyācakṣate--aguṇabhāvenābhidhīyamānavyāpāro guṇabhūto guṇabhūtadhātūpāttavyāpāraḥ kartetyarthaḥ| kasya ca vyāpāro dhātunā'guṇabhāvenopādīyate? yasya vivakṣyate tasyeti sarvatra siddhamiti||
padamañjarī
tatprayojako hetuśca|| 1.4.55 ||
tadityanenana karttā sambaddhyate iti| kartṛ saṃjñāviśiṣṭaḥ svatantra ityarthaḥ| nanu ca prayojakasannidhau prayojyasya pāratantryaṃ kartṛ sanni dhāviva karaṇādīnām, tatkathaṃ svatantraḥ parāmṛśyate? kathantarāṃ ca kartṛ saṃjñāviśiṣṭaḥ? kathantamāṃ ca pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadatteneti? prayojye tṛtīyā bhavati, pūrvameva ca svatantrasya kartṛḥ sataḥ prayuktirapi kimarthā? māyaṃ viraṃsīditi prayuṅkte iti ced, bhavatvevaṃ pravṛttapravartane, yatra tu balātkāreṇa pravartyate tatra katham? ucyate; apravṛttapravartane'pi yāvatsvārthādarśanāt prayojye na pravartate tāvatprayojakaḥ pācayatīti na vyapadiśyate, tadānīmapi ca smṛtyārūḍhā prayuktirvidyata iti anuvartamānā hi prasaktiḥ prayojyasyāphalaniṣpatteḥ pravṛttau heturna madhye vicchinnā| loḍādivācyastu praiṣaḥ prayojyasyā pravṛttāvapi bhavati| uktaṃ ca--
dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchāderloḍ vidhīyate|
pravṛttasya yadā praiṣastadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ|| iti|
tadevaṃ ṇijvācyā prayuktiḥ pravṛttapravartanārūpeṇa pratīyata iti prakṛtyarthe kartṛḥ sataḥ prayojaka ityaviruddham| imameva cārtha darśayituṃ tacchabdopādānam; anyathā kasya prayojaka ityapekṣāyām, prakṛtatvādeva svatantrasya prayojaka iti lābhādanarthakaṃ tat syāt| tasya prayojakastatprayojaka iti| nanu `tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari'`kartari ca'
xxxxxtiṣedhāt kathamatra samāsa ityata āha-nipātanātsamāpta iti| atra vicaxxxxxxpāsaprakaraṇa eva vicārayiṣyāmaḥ|
saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāra iti| asati hi tasmin ekasaṃjñādhikārāt kartṛ saṃjñā na syāt| kurvāṇaṃ prayuṅkte iti| kurvāṇadaśāyāṃ yā prayuktiḥ smṛtyārūḍhā, saiva ṇijvācyetyevaṃ vigrahaḥ| hetutvādityādinā samāveśasya prayojanaṃ darśayati||
padamañjarī
prāgīśvarānnipātāḥ|| 1.4.56 ||
prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ|| prāci kāle deśe vā prāk| adhirīśvare iti vakṣyatīti| īśvaraprakṛtibhāgasya pūrvapadāntena repheṇa sahānukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| anukāryeṇārthenārthavattvāt vibhaktyatpattiḥ, ca vā ityatra nipātatve sati `svarādinipātamavyam' ityavyayasaṃjñā bhavati| `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' iti tu svaro na bhavati, udāhṛtānāmanudāttānāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt| anyeṣāṃ tu tadapi bhavati|
nanu yathā `pratyayaḥ' ityādiradhikāro vināpyavadhinirdeśenābhimataviṣaye pravartate, tathāyamapi pravartiṣyate, nipātāḥ' ityevāstu, nārtho'vadhinirdeśenetyata āha--
prāgvacanamiti| prāgvacanadvāreṇāvaghinirdeśasya prayojanamuktam| ayamarthaḥ- asatyavadhinirdeśe `nipātāḥ' ityasya pratiyogamanuvṛttau satyāmapyekasaṃjñādhikārāt paryāyaḥ syāt, na tu samāveśaḥ; sati tu tasmin īśvarāt prāgyāvantaḥ saṃjñinaḥ sarvāstānnaikadhyamihāpekṣya sakṛtsaṃjñā vidhīyate, pratisūtramadhikārāttvaparāvṛttiḥ, tasyāśca samāveśaḥ prayojanamiti|
atha vā prāgvacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pañcamyeva prāgiti dikśabde'dhyāhariṣyate, parāgityasya tvadhyāhāro na bhaviṣyati, `cādayo'satve' ,`prādayaḥ' ityanayorvidheyāsambhavenānarthakyaprasaṅgāt? ata āha--prāgvacanamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ- adhyāhāreṇa siddhe prāggrahaṇasāmarthyāttantreṇa dvau prākchabdāvuccāryete| tenāyamartho bhavati--prāgrīśvarādye vyavasthitāste prāk nipātasaṃjñā bhavanti, nipātāḥ santo gatyādisaṃjñā iti| tena nimittameva nipātasaṃjñā gatyādisaṃjñānāmiti samāveśasiddhiriti|
rīśvarāditi saha repheṇānukaraṇe prayojanamāha--rīśvarādvīśvarānmā bhūditi| rīśvarādityucyate, `adhirīśvare' ityayamīśvaraśabdo'vadhiryathā syāt,`śakiṇyamulkamulau' `īśvare tomunkasunau' ityayaṃ mā bhūd ityevamarthamityarthaḥ| yadā saṃhītayā sūtrāṇi paṭhyante, tadā śīśvaraśabdo'stītyabhipretya rīśvarādityuktam| jñāpakāt, siddham, yadayaṃ `kṛnmejantaḥ' iti kṛto māntasyaijantasya vā'vyayasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--anantara īśvaraśabdo'vadhirna vyavahita iti, anyathā sesenprabhṛtīnāṃ ṇamulkamulośca nipātatvādevāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt? naitadasti jñāpakam, kṛnmejantaḥ paro'pi saḥ, `īśvare tosunkasunau' ityasmātparo'pi kṛnmānta ejantaścasti kṛtyārthe tavaikenityādyejantaḥ, ṇamulādiśca māntaḥ, tadarthametat syāt| yattarhyavyayībhāvasyāvyayatvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--anantarasya grahaṇamiti; anyathā dvitīye nipātasaṃjñāvyāpārād avyayībhāvasya nipātatvādevāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt, naitadasti; `samāseṣvavyayībhāvaḥ' tulyajātīyavyāvṛttaye niyamārthametatsyāt, na tvanantarasya grahaṇe jñāpakamityarthaḥ| evaṃ tarhi laukikanyāyādevānantarasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, laukike hyodakāntātpriyaṃ prāpyamanuvrajediti ya evānantara udakānta ā tato'nuvrajya bāndhavā nivartante tadvadatrāpi? tatrāha--laukikaṃ cātivartate iti| laukikaṃ nyāyaṃ loka evātivarttate; yato dvitīyamapyudakāntaṃ snohātiśayādanuvrajya nivartante tasmādrīśvarādityucyate vīśvarānmā bhūditi sthitam| nanu ca `na lokāvyaya' ityatra lokādīnāmavyayatvādeva ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe siddhe punarupādānaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyatī--anantarasya grahaṇamiti, naitadasti; avyayasaṃjñāyā evābhāvaṃ jñāpayet, nipātasaṃjñā tu syādeva; tataśca cikīrṣvartha ityādau`nipāta ekājanāṅ' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā syātu| prothamiti| paryāptamityarthaḥ| `protha yaryāptau', pacādyaci kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam||
padamañjarī
cādayo'sattve|| 1.4.57 ||
na cetsattve varttate iti| sattve ced vartate tadā saṃjñā na bhavatītyarthastadāha--prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti| atha paryudāse ko doṣaḥ? paśuśabde'tra paṭhyate sā jātiviśiṣṭe dravye vartate, tasya nipātatvaṃ syāt, jātidravyasamudāyarūpo hyarthaḥ kevalādanyo bhavati; tathā prādaya ityatra viprātīti vipraḥ, `ātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ| atra praśabdaḥ kriyāviśiṣṭe dravye vartate| tatra kriyādravyasamudāyasya dravyādanyatvānnipātvānnipātatve satyavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidherabhyupagamāt vipraśabdasyāvyayasaṃjñā syāt, prasajyapratiṣedhe tu yatra dravyagandhastatra sarvatra pratiṣedho bhavati| kva tarhi vartamānaḥ paśuśabde'sattvavacano bhavati? ddaśyarthe, lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānā ityatra ddaśyarthena mananaṃ viśeṣyate--darśanametanmananam, samyak manyamānā ityarthaḥ| sattvaśabdo'yaṃ sato bhāvaḥ sattvamiti sattājātivacano gṛhyata iti bhrāntimapanayati--sattvamiti ca dravyamucyate iti| idaṃ taditi sarvanāmaparāmarśayogyaṃ vastu dravyamucyate| uktañca--
vastupalakṣaṇaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate|
dravyamityucyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ|| iti|
svārtheneti śeṣaḥ| siddharūpo yo'rthaḥ svārthena viśeṣyatayā vivakṣitastad dravyamityarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca--
svārthasta yatra viśrāntirvācyaṃ dravyaṃ taducyate| iti|
evaṃ ca kṛtvā--sīdati, niviśate yatra jātyādikaṃ śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāveneti sattvaṃ dravyam| saderauṇādikastvaprakyayaḥ `tābhyāmānyatroṇādayaḥ' ityadhikaraṇasādhanaḥ| caṇiti paṭhyate, sa cedarthe vartate, ṇakāraścaṇkaccidyatrayuktamiti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| naño ñakāraḥ `nalopo nañaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| nalopo nasyetyucyamāne vāmanaputraḥ- atrāpi prāpnoti? pākṣika eṣa doṣaḥ; `aluguttarapade' iti vartate, tatra yadottarapadenākṣiptaṃ pūrvapadaṃ nasya viśeṣaṇam, tadā pūrvapadabhūtasya nasya lopa ityucyamāne naivātra prāpnoti, naśabdena pūrvapade viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhisadbhāvādatrāpi syāt| athāsminpakṣe `nañaḥ' ityucyamāne'pi straiṇaputra ityatra nañaḥ kasmānna bhavati? atulyatvātpratyayasya ñakāro vṛddhisvarayoścaritārthaḥ, nipātasya tvacaritārthaḥ| tatheti paṭhyate, so'vyutpannaḥ samuccaye vartate, tasya tu thālantasya litsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ siddham| avyayatvamapi `taddhitaścasarvavibhaktiḥ' ityeva siddham| nanvavyutpannasyāpi vibhaktapratirūpakā ityeva siddham, satyam; prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ velāyām, mātrāyāmityāderapi|
svarapratirūpakā iti| ṛti ṛ vā vacanamityādayaḥ, teṣāṃ nipātasaṃjñāvidhānadvāreṇa sadbhāva eva pratipādyate, na punareṣāṃ nipātatve kiñcitprayojanamastīti||
padamañjarī
prādayaḥ|| 1.4.58 ||
ayaṃ yoga uttarasmādvibhajyate, pūrvasmācca; yadi punaḥ`prādaya upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' ityucyate, naivaṃ śakyamityāha-pṛthagyogakaraṇamiti| uttarasyā upasargasaṃjñāyā eva `kriyāyoge' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāt, nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamuttarasmād yogādasya vibhāga ityarthaḥ| atha vā--cādiṣveva prādīnapi paṭhitvā pūrvasmādyogāt kimartha vibhajyate, tatrāpyāha--upasargāḥ kriyāyoga iti| vādīnāmiti| calopo'tra draṣṭavya iti ca--vadīnāmiti| parā jayanti senā iti| parā utkuṣṭāḥ| paradeśasthitā vā dravyatvāttatra vartamānasya parāśabdasya na bhavati, yatra tvekavacanaṃ paṭhyate--parā jayati seneti, tatra rūpodāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam; halṅyābiti sulopāt, parāśabdasyādyudāttatvācca||
padamañjarī
upasargāḥ kriyāyoge|| 1.4.59 ||
kriyāyoge iti tṛtīyā, nipātanāt samāsaḥ, `kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā' iti bahulavacanādvā| yadvā--kriyayā karaṇabhūtayā prādīnāṃ dhātubhiryogāt karaṇe tṛtīyayā eva samāsaḥ| praṇayatīti| `upasargādasamāse'pi iti ṇatvam| pranāyaka iti| nanvatrāpi gamikriyāyogo'styeva, satyam; prādayaḥ punarevamātmakāḥ, yaduta śrutāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tāmeva viśiṃṣanti, aśrutāyāṃ tu sasādhanāṃ kriyāmākṣipanti| tatra kriyāyogagrahaṇasāmarthyād yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā bhavatītyayamartho bhavati| atra ca yatkriyāyuktaḥ prādiḥ sa gamirna prayujyate, yaśca prayujyate na tatkriyāyukta iti nāsti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
marucchabdasyeti| upasargasaṃjñaiveṣyate, na nipātasaṃjñā| tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ nipātādyudāttatvam`tṛtīyā karmaṇi' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa syāt, antodāttaśca maruttaśabda iṣyate| nanūpasargasaṃjñāyāmapi `upasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyudāttatvaṃ syādeva, na; nānenāpūrvamādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? `nipātāḥ' ityeva siddhe'theḥ pratiṣedhārthametat| kiṃ ca nipātasaṃjñāyāmavyayasaṃjñā syāt| atha `upasarge dhoḥ kiḥ'`ātaścopasarge' ityetau vidhī kasmānna bhavataḥ? anabhidhānāt|
marutta iti| marucchabdatakārasya `anaci ca' iti dvirvacane `jharo jhari' iti madhyamasya madhyamayormadhyamānāṃ vā lope trairūpyaṃ bhavati, kathaṃ punaratra tatvam, yāvatāyamanajanta ityata āha--saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāditi| uktaḥ prayojanāntarābhāvaḥ| evaṃ tu marunnayatīti takāravyavāye'pi ṇatvaṃ prāproti tasmāttatvavidhāveveṣyate|
śracchabdasyeti| aṅ‌vidhāveveṣyate, kipratyayo hi na bhavati, tadāha--ātaścopasarge iti| bhidādipāṭhāt `prajñāśraddhārcā' iti nipātanādvā siddham||
padamañjarī
gatiśca|| 1.4.60 ||
`gatiranantaraḥ' iti puṃlliṅganirdeśād gamyata iti gatiḥ, `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām' iti kticama, nipātanācca `na ktici dīrdhaśca' iti na bhavati| prakṛtyeti| atra gatitvāt kṛtsvaro bhavati, samāsastu prāditvādeva siddhaḥ| prādibhyo'nyatra samāso'pi prayojanam| prakṛtamiti| `gatiranantaraḥ' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| yat prakarotīti| tiṅlakṣaṇasya nighātasya `nipātairyadyadi' iti niṣedhe tipaḥ pittvādanudāttatvam, vikaraṇasya pratyayasvaro dhātoḥ śeṣanighātaḥ, `tiṅicodāttavati' iti praśabdasyānudāttatvam| etacca prayojanacatuṣṭayaṃ gatisaṃjñā prakaraṇe sarvatra draṣṭavyam|
cakāraḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārtha iti| anyathaikasaṃjñādhikārādekatra saṃjñādvayavidhānācca paryāyaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| kārikāśabdasyeti| kārikā kriyā maryādāsthitirityarthaḥ| yatna ityapare, dhātvarthanirdeśa iti ṇvul| yastu kartari kārikāśabdaḥ kārikā dāsīti, yacca ślokavācī--tayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; kriyāyogagrahaṇena kārikāśabdasya viśeṣaṇāt kriyāvṛttargrahaṇāt| yatkārikāṃ karotīti| nipātatvādavyayatve sati vibhakterluk|
punarutsyūtamiti| gatitvātsamāsaḥ| `gatirgatau' iti nighāto bhavatīti| yadyapyatra `pravṛddhādīnāṃ ca' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvena śeṣanighātaḥ siddhaḥ, tathāpi paratvādayameva nighāto yukta iti bhāvaḥ| iha ca punarādheyamiti| gatitvātsamāse kṛte kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa`yato'nāvaḥ' iti dheyaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| canohita iti| nipātatvādādyudāttasya canaḥśabdasya `gatiranantaraḥ' iti prakṛtisvaraḥ||
padamañjarī
ūryādicviḍācaśca|| 1.4.61 ||
cvyantā ḍājantāśceti| yadyapi padasaṃjñāyāmantagrahaṇena `saṃjñāvidhau pratayayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' iti jñāpitam, tathāpi`kriyāyoge' ityanuvṛttestadantagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| na hi pratyayamātrasya kriyāyogaḥ sambhavati, svārthikatvena svayamanarthakatvāt, cveraśrāvitvācca| kṛbhvastiyoga iti| na kevalam, saṃjñāprayogo'pyanyatra bhavati, na hi bhavati urīsaṃpadyate iti, śrauṣaḍādīnāṃ svāhāparyantānāṃ cādiṣu pāṭhād akriyāyoge'pi nipātatvam| āviḥśabdasya sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhāt kṛño yoge vikalpaḥ, kṛbhvastiyoge tvanena nityam| kathaṃ tarhi `āviścakṣuṣo'bhavadasāviva rāgaḥ', `abhavan yugapadvilolajihvā yugalīḍhobhayasṛkkadhāramāviḥ iti? svatantrā kavayaḥ| śuklīkṛtyeti| `asya cvau' itītvam| paṭapaṭāśabdaḥ `vā kyaṣaḥ' ityatra vyutpāditaḥ||
padamañjarī
anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam|| 1.4.62 ||
itiḥ paro yasmāditi| pañcamīsamāsastu lakṣaṇābhāvānnāśritaḥ| teneti khāṭkṛtyetyatra iteḥ paratve'pi bhavati| khāḍiti kṛtvā niraṣṭhīvaditi| atrāsati pratiṣedhe gatisaṃjñāyāṃ samāsaḥ syāt, dhātoścānantaraḥ prayoga iti rūpamevaitanna sidhyet| `ṣṭhivu nirasane', `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' iti dīrghaḥ| bhūtakālopanyāsaḥ kimarthaḥ? kasyacitkaverayaṃ prayoga udāhṛtaḥ-
`cumbanasaktaḥ so'syāḥ cyutamūlaṃ daśanamātmano vadane|
jihvāmūlaspṛṣṭaṃ khāḍiti kṛtvā niraṣṭhīvat||'
padamañjarī
ādarānādarayoḥ sadasatī|| 1.4.63 ||
prītisaṃbhrama iti| prītipūrvikā pratyutthānādiviṣayā tvaretyarthaḥ| paribhavaudāsīnyamiti| avajñayā kartavyaṃ pratyatthānādika pratyupekṣetyarthaḥ| asadanādaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham? asatkṛtyetyatrāpi yathā syāt| mā bhūdasacchabdasya gatisaṃjñā, satkṛtyetyanena nañsamāso bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; sati śiṣṭatvāt kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ syād| asatkṛtamityatra tu satkṛtaśabde `gatiranantaraḥ' iti svare pravṛtte praścānnañsamāse'pi tasyeva svaraḥ| asacchabdasyāpi kṛtaśabdenāpi samāse tasya nipātatvādādyudāttasya gatitvātprakṛtibhāve'pi sa eva svara iti nāsti viśeṣaḥ| iha ca yadāsatkarotītyasacchabdasya nighāto na syād, avyayasaṃjñāpi tasya na syādityasacchabdasyaiva gatinipātasaṃjñe eṣitavye| na cātra sacchabdena tadantavidhirlabhyate; viśeṣyasyābhāvāt|
nanvatra sacchabdasyaiva saṃjñāstu, kāryapradeśeṣu prakṛtasya tena tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati, avyasaṃjñāyāṃ tāvadastyeva tadantavidhiḥ-paramoccairiti, yathā `kugatiprādayaḥ' ityatrāpi subiti pravartate, supetyeva nivṛttam, tadratinā viśeṣyate `gatiranantaraḥ' ityatra pūrvapadam `gatirgatau' ityatrāpi padasyeti prakṛtam| bhavatu tadantavidhinā kāryam, anādarāvagatistu kutaḥ? asatyanādaragrahaṇe, na sadasadityādaraniṣedhānnaiva śakyam, ādaraprasaṅga eva hi syāt, gurumasatkṛtyeti cāṇḍālamasatkṛtyetyatra na syāt| yathā'brāhmaṇa iti kṣatriyādirevocyate, na loṣṭādiḥ, anādaragrahaṇe tu sati bahuvrīhirvijñāyate--avidyāmānādaro'nādara iti| bahuvrīhiścātyantābhāve, prasaktābhāve, aprasaktābhāve ca bhavatīti sarvatra saṃjñā sidhyati, tasmādanādaragrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| asad‌grahaṇaṃ tu śakyamakartum| ādarānādarayoḥ sadityevāstu, tatra yathā goṣpadaṃ sevityatrāsevite goṣpadaśabdo na saṃbhavatītyagoṣpadārthamasevitagrahaṇam; evamanādare'pi sacchabdo na sambhavatītyasacchabdārthamānadaragrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|
satkṛtvā, asatkṛtveti| śobhanavacano vidyamānavacano vā sacchabdaḥ tadviparītavacano'sacchabdaḥ||
padamañjarī
bhūṣaṇe'lam|| 1.4.64 ||
alamiti pratiṣedha ityādi| tadyathā alaṃ--kṛtvā, alaṃ bhoktum, alaṃ bhuṅkte, alaṃ karoti kanyāmiti||
padamañjarī
antaraparigrahe|| 1.4.65 ||
antarhatvā, madhye hatvetyarthaḥ| antaḥ śabdasyetyādi| upasargasaṃjñāyāmevaitannoktam--antaḥ śabdaprasaṅgena vakṣyāmīti| yadā copasargasaṃjñocyate; tadāntarṇayatītyādivadantarhaṇyāt, antarhaṇanamityādāvapi `hanteratpūrvasya' iti ṇatvaṃ siddham| antarayaṇamityatrāpi `kṛtyacaḥ' ityeva siddhamiti `antaradeśe'`ayanaṃ ca' iti sūtradvayamapi deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ draṣṭavyam||
padamañjarī
kaṇemanasī śraddhāpratīghāte|| 1.4.66 ||
kaṇeśabdaḥ saptamīpratirūpako nipāto'bhilāṣātiśaye vartate| manaḥśabdo'pi sāhacaryādabhilāṣāvṛttireva vijñeyaḥ| kaṇehatyeti| atiśayenābhilaṣya tannivṛttiparyantaṃ pibatītyarthaḥ| tadāha--tāvaditi| śraddhā pratihanyata ityarthaḥ| iti yāvadasyetyapekṣate| pratyudāharaṇe kaṇeśabdaḥ pūkṣmataṇḍulāvayavo'dhikaraṇabhūte varttate| manaḥśabdo'pi cetasi||
padamañjarī
puro'vyayam|| 1.4.67 ||
asipratyayāntaḥ puraḥ śabdo'vyayamiti| `pūrvādharāvārāṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' ityasipratyayaḥ, pūrvaśabdasya purādeśaḥ, `taddhitaścāsarvavibhakti' ityavyayasaṃjñā, visarjanīyasthānikaḥ sakāra upacāraḥ| puraskṛtyeti| pūrvasmindeśe kṛtvetyarthaḥ| pūḥ purau, puraḥ kṛtveti| etadatra pratyudāharaṇam| itarayostūpanyāsastatsāhacaryātpura iti śasantam, nāvyayamiti pradarśanārthaḥ| atra `namaspurasorgatyoḥ' iti satvaṃ na bhavati, samāsaśca na bhavati||
padamañjarī
astaṃ ca|| 1.4.68 ||
astaṃ kṛtveti| `asu kṣepaṇe',niṣṭhā, udito vā' `yasyavibhāṣā' iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ| nanu lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhavati, kimavyayagrahaṇānuvṛttyā? evaṃ tarhyastaṃśabdoḥ avyayamiti jñāpyate| na hyayaṃ cādiṣu svarādiṣu vā paṭh‌yate||
padamañjarī
accha gatyarthavadeṣu|| 1.4.69 ||
acchetyanukaraṇatve'vibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, `supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakterlu ptatvāt| abhiśabdasyārtha iti| ābhimukhye| acchodyoti| yajāditvāt saṃprasāraṇam, udakamacchaṃ gacchati, akaluṣamityarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
ado'nupadeśe|| 1.4.70 ||
upadeśaḥ parārthaḥ iti| vākyaprayoga ityarthād gamyate| adaḥ- kṛtyeti| etatkartavyamiti svayamālocyetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
tiro'ntarddhau|| 1.4.71 ||
tirobhūyeti| samāsakṛtsvarau prayojanam| tirobhūtamiti| bhavaterakarmakatvātkarttari ktaḥ `gatiranantaraḥ' ityatra ca karmaṇīti vartate, tasmāt samāsathāthādisvarāvatra prayojanam| tiro bhūtveti| pārśvato bhūtvetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā kṛñi|| 1.4.72 ||
tiraskṛtyeti| `tiraso'nyatarasyām' iti satvam| pratyudāharaṇe tu na bhavati, tatra gatyanukāryānukaraṇayorbhodasyāvivakṣitatvāt sūtre vibhaktyabhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
upāje'nvāje|| 1.4.73 ||
sākṣātpramṛtīni ca|| 1.4.74 ||
sākṣātprabhṛtiṣviti| asākṣād‌bhūtaṃ yadā sākṣātkriyate tadā yathā syāt yadā yattu sākṣādbhūtameva rūpāntareṇa kriyate tadā mā bhūdityevamartham| mithyāprabhṛtiṣvapi draṣyavyam| etaccāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate, tathā hi--sākṣātkṛtamityukte śrutasya tasyaiva rūpasya karaṇaṃ pratīyate, na tvaśrutarūpāntarasya|
nanvasatyāmapi prakṛtivivakṣāyāṃ tasyaiva rūpasya karaṇaṃ pratīyate, atha ca cvyarthavṛttitā nāsti, tasmāccvyarthagrahaṇameva kartavyam| atha cvyanteṣvapi sākṣādādiṣu ayaṃ vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati? astu, anena mukte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānād `ūryādicviḍācaśca' ityeṣā bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam, yadetallavaṇādīnāṃ makārāntatvanipātanaṃ tadapi cvyanteṣu syāt| evaṃ lavaṇādīnāṃ māntā lavaṇādaya ādeśāḥ kariṣyante, tatra yadyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvālllavāṇīśabdasyāpi pakṣe lavaṇamādaśaḥ kriyate na kaścid doṣaḥ; traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam--lavaṇaṃkṛtya, lavaṇaṃ kṛtvā, lavaṇīkṛtyeti, taccaivaṃ siddham| vṛttikārastu `makārāntatvaṃ nipātyate' iti vadati, sa manyate--cvyanteṣu pūrvavipratiṣedhena nityā saṃjñā bhavati, vikalpena tu sanniyuktaṃ māntatvaṃ nipātanamiti| agnau, vaśeprabhṛtayo vibhaktipratirūpakā nipātāḥ, prādurāviśabdayorūryāditvāt prāpte vibhāṣā||
padamañjarī
anatyādhāna urasimanasī|| 1.4.75 ||
urasimanasiśabdau nipātau| urasikṛtyeti| abhyupagamyetyarthaḥ| manasikṛtya, niścityetyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
madhye pade nivacane ca|| 1.4.76 ||
maghye pade nivacane ca || avibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, madhyepadeśabdau nipātau| nivacanaṃ vacanābhāva iti| tatra nipātanādekārāntatvaṃ na punareṣā saptamī| vācaṃ niyamyeti| vyākhyānānnipātanaṃ cāviśeṣeṇa, na tu saṃjñāsanniyuktaṃ nivacane kṛtveti udāhṛtatvādityāhuḥ||
padamañjarī
nityaṃ haste pāṇāvupayamane|| 1.4.77 ||
dārakarmeti| anye tu svīkaraṇamātramicchantihastekṛtya mahāstrāṇīti, hastepāṇau śabdau nipātau||
padamañjarī
prādhvaṃ bandhane|| 1.4.78 ||
makārāntamavyayamiti| cādiṣu pāṭhāt| ānukūlye vartate iti| tena bandhane vartamānaḥ prādhvaṃśabdaḥ ityayamartho na bhavati| kathaṃ tarhi bandhane ityasyānvaya ityata āha--taditi|
bandhana iti| satsaptamyarthadvārakaśca prādhvamityanena sambandhaḥ, bandhane sati yadānukūlyaṃ tadvandhanahetukamiti bhāvaḥ|
prādhvaṃ kṛtvā gata iti| prasthito'dhvānaṃ prādhvaḥ, `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe' iti samāsaḥ, `upasargādadhvanaḥ' ityac lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati; tasmādavyayasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ, ānukūlyaṃ tu bandhanahetukaṃ na vivakṣitamiti vyācakṣate||
padamañjarī
jīvikopaniṣadāvaupamye|| 1.4.79 ||
jīvikā-jīvanopāyaḥ, `saṃjñāyām' iti karaṇe ṇvul| ṇyantādvā karttari upinipūrvātsadeḥ `satsūdviṣa' iti kvip, `sadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam, upaniṣad-rahasyaṃ vedāntajanyaṃ jñānam, vedāntabhāgo vā| āpamya iti| upamīyate'nayetyupamā `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅ, tasyā bhāva aupamyam| viṣayasaptamī caiṣā, upamānopameyasambandhanimittādabhedopacārādyāvupameyaniṣṭhau bhavataḥ, tāvaupamyaviṣayau| jīvikākṛtya, upaniṣatkṛtyeti| jīvikāmiva kṛtvā, upaniṣadamiva kṛtvetyarthaḥ| yadyapi gatisamāso nityaḥ, tathāpīvaśabdaprayoge svārthaniṣṭhatvādīddaśavākyaṃ bhavatyeva||
padamañjarī
te prāgdhātoḥ|| 1.4.80 ||
niyamārthamidam| sa punarniyamaḥ saṃjñāniyamo vā syāt, prayoga niyamo vā syāt? tatra saṃjñāniyame teśabdena prādaya upaniṣatparthantāḥ svarūpeṇa parāmṛśyante, na gatyupasargasaṃjñāviśiṣṭena rūpeṇā; saṃjñayoraniṣpādanāt| anenekavākyatāpannaiḥ pūrvasūtraistayorvidhānāt| te prādaya upaniṣatparyantā dhātoḥ prāgeva prayujyamānā gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavantītyarthaḥ| prayoganiyame tu labdhagatyupasargasaṃjñāḥ parāmṛśyante| te gatyupasargasaṃjñakā dhātoḥ prāgeva prayoktavyā ityarthaḥ|
tatrādye pakṣe svarūpeṇa parāmarśaḥ prādīnāmiva cādīnāmapi syāt, tataśca nipātasaṃjñāyā api niyamaḥ syāt| athāpi gatyupasargasaṃjñayoreva niyamaḥ, evamapyanarthakaṃ vacanam, prayoga eva hi teṣāmaprāṅ neṣyate| na punaraprāk prayujyamānānāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| `chandasi pare'pi' vyavahitāśca' iti rūpadvayaṃ cānarthakam,paravyavahitānāṃ saṃjñaiva niṣiddhā, na tu prayogaḥ| na ca tenāpi saṃjñaiva vidhīyate, niṣprayojanatvāt| kiṃca `anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam' ityanitiparagrahaṇa manarthakaṃ syāt, `khāḍiti kṛtvā niraṣṭhīvat' ityatra vyavahitasyānukaraṇasya gatisaṃjñaiva niṣiddhā, prayogastu kena vāryate! prayoganiyame tu dhātoḥ prāgevānukaraṇasya prayogaḥ syād, na tvitiśabdena vyavahitasyeti anitiparamiti vaktavyam| ataḥ prayoganiyama evāyaṃ yukta iti matvāha--te gatyupasargasaṃjñakā iti|
athāsminnapi pakṣe nipātānāmapi teśabdena parāmarśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? vyavahitatvāt| kathaṃ tarhyupasargāṇāṃ parāmarśaḥ, nopasargāstena rūpeṇa parāmṛśyante, kiṃ tarhi? gatirūpeṇa, teṣāmapi gatitvāt| anenaivābhiprāyeṇa vṛttāvupasargāṇāṃ pṛthag grahaṇam| cādayastu naivamiti na te parāmṛśyante| nanu yatra loke saṃkīrṇaḥ prayogaḥ- gaurgāvīti, tatra sādhuparijñānāya śāstramarthavat| yatra tvasaṃkīrṇa eva prayogo na tatra śāstrakṛtyamasti; na ca kaścit prapacatīti prayoktavye pacatīti preti prayuṅkte| yadyapi loke prayogo na ddaśyate viparītaḥ, chandasi tu paravyavahitaprayogadarśanād bhāṣāyāmapi tathā prayogaḥ śaṅkyeta, darśitaścādyatve'pi bhāṣāyāmeva gaterāviḥśabdasya paravyavahitaprayoga ūryādisūtre| kiṃ ca `udi kūle rujivahoḥ' kūlamudvaha ityatra `udi' `kūla' iti dvayorapi saptamīnirdeśādupapadatvātsamāse kṛte `upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' iti śāstravaśātparyāyeṇa pūrvanipātaṃ manyeran ityupasarjanasaṃnipāte pūrvaparavyavasthārthamidaṃ vaktavyam| yadyevam, `kartṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛño':- sukhena kaṭaḥ kriyate, sukaṭaṃkarāṇi vīraṇāni, duṣkaṭaṃkarāṇi, atra sudusoḥ prāgdhātoḥ prayogaḥ prāpnoti--kaṭaṃ sukarāṇīti| khalaḥ khitkaraṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt? anavyayasya hi mumucyate, khitkaraṇasāmarthyād avyayasya bhavatu, yadi vā `kṛdrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti sukaraśabde parataḥ kaṭasya bhaviṣyati, karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ|
dhātugrahaṇamanartakam, kutaḥ? prāgityapekṣāyāṃ yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastataḥ prāgiti vijñāsyate; naivaṃ śakyam, iha ca kartuṃ precchati pracikīrṣatīti sanvācyayā icchayā praśabdasya yoga iti sana eva prāk praśabdaḥ prayujyeta, dhātugrahaṇāt tu dhātoreva cikīrṣateḥ prāk prayujyate|
tegrahaṇamupasargārthamiti| nanu yadi gatisaṃjñārahitāḥ kevalopasargasaṃjñā eva prādayaḥ syuḥ, tato'sati tegrahaṇe gatīnāmanantaratvātta eva saṃbadhyeran, na tūpasargā iti tadarthaṃ tegrahaṇaṃ kartavyam? te'pi tu gatisaṃjñakāḥ, tataścānantarāṇāṃ gatīnāmapi sambandhe prādīnāmapi gatitvādeva grahaṇaṃ siddham| syādetat--asati tegrahaṇe gatisaṃjñaiva kevalā yeṣām, teṣāmeva syād; nobhayasaṃjñakānāṃ prādīnāmiti? na; kevalagaterabhāvāt| nanu cāyamasti `anukaraṇaṃ cāniti param' iti, na; tasyāpi nipātatvāt, ucyate; asati tegrahaṇe prakṛteṣvapekṣā cet katipaye saṃbadhyeran; nopasargaparyantāḥ| vyāptinyāyāttu bhūyasāmapekṣāyāṃ na prādiṣveva paryavasāne kāraṇamastīti cādayo'pyapekṣyeran | tegrahaṇe tu sati gatisaṃjñāyā anantaratvāttena rūpeṇa parāmarśo na katipayānāmeva bhavatīti prādīnapi vyāpnoti, cādīṃśca parisaṃcaṣṭe iti tegrahaṇamupasargārthaṃ bhavati| tatparyantānāṃ ca yathā syāt teṣāmeva ca yathā syādityarthaḥ| gatayo hyanantarā iti| ye'nantarāsta eva katipaye gṛhyeran, pratyāsattāviti bhāvaḥ| vyāptau tu doṣaḥ sujñānatvānna kaṇṭhoktaḥ||
padamañjarī
chandasi pare'pi || 1.4.81 ||
na ca pareṣāmiti| naca `gatirgatau' ityasyāpi sambhavaḥ, parabhūtānāmekākināmeva darśanāditi manyate||
padamañjarī
vyavahitāśca|| 1.4.82 ||
dik‌chabdānāmavyavahite mukhyā vṛttiriti prāk parastācca vyavahitānāṃ prayogārthamidaṃ vacanam| ata eva bhāṣāyāṃ vyavahitānāmaprayogaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi gativyavāye prayogaḥ-abhyuddharati, samudāharatīti? na tulyajātīyaṃ vyavadhāyakaṃ bhavati, tadyathā--kimanantare ete brāhmaṇakule iti pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha--nānantare, vṛṣalakulamanayormadhya iti vijātīyaṃ vyavadhāyakaṃ nirdiśati, jātervā samāśrayaṇānnāsti vyavadhāyakatvam| evaṃ ca gatiranantaragrahaṇam, `gatirgatau' iti vacanam, `abhipraiti' itinirdeśaścopapanno bhavati||
padamañjarī
karmapravacanīyāḥ|| 1.4.83 ||
vakṣyāmāṇānāṃ saṃjñināṃ bahutvādvahuvacanam, yathā--nipātāḥ, kṛtyā iti| kvacitu sāmānyavivakṣayaikavacanam, `gatiśca',`pratyayaḥ'`kṛt' iti| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham--karma-kriyāṃ proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyā iti| bhūte `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karttari kṛtyaḥ| ke ca karma proktavantaḥ? ye prayujyamāne kriyāpade--`anubhūyate kambalaḥ' ityādau kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na saṃprati kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotayanti, kiṃ tarhi? sambandhaviśeṣam, tadyathā--śākalyasya saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣaditi| na hyatrānuranubhūyate ityādāviva kriyāviśeṣaṃ dyotayati, kriyāpadābhāvāt; nāpi ṣaṣṭhīvatsambandhamācaṣṭe--saṃhitāmiti; dvitīyāyāstadarthatvāt| nāpi kriyāpadamākṣipati, yathā--prādeśaṃ viparilikhatīti, viśabdo vimānakriyāṃ prādeśaṃ vimāya parilikhatīti | tathā hi--sati prādeśamitivat kārakavibhaktiprasaṅgaḥ, śeṣasambandhasya vā pratītiprasaṅgaḥ| tadevamanuḥ saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayoryaḥ śeṣasambandho dvitīyābhihitastaṃ viśeṣe'vasthāpayati| hetuhetumadbhāvena rūpeṇa viśiṣṭakriyājanitatvena vā sambandhasya tatsaṃnidhau sampratyayāt saṃhitāmanuniśamya prāvarṣaditi| uktaṃ ca--
kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ na sambandhasya vācakaḥ|
nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī sambandhasya tu bhedakaḥ|| iti|
kvacittu pravṛttinimittābhāve'pi vacanasāmarthyādiyaṃ saṃjñā pravartate, yathā--`suḥ pūjāyām' `atiratikramaṇe ca iti||
padamañjarī
anurlakṣaṇe|| 1.4.84 ||
yāvateti| yāvatāśabdo nipāto nanvityarthe| anyetyartha ityanye| lakṣaṇetthabhbhūtākhyānetiṣa siddheti| tatra cāvaśyamanorgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamirtthabhūtākhyānādiṣu yāthā syāt| lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ ca pratyādyartham, ato'rthāntarasaṃjñāntarasaṃjñāntarasādhāraṇatvāttadevāstu, idaṃ tu na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ| hetvarthantviti | tu śabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati| hetuḥ- karaṇam, arthaḥ- prayojanaṃ prayojako'sya vacanasyetyarthaḥ| nanu ca tatra cātra ca lakṣaṇagrahaṇameva kriyate, tadyadi heturlakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati, ihāpi na gṛhyate, atha bhavati tatrāpi nārtha etena? tatrāha--hetutṛtīyāmiti| satyam; lakṣyate'nena tallakṣaṇam- cihnaṃ jñāpakam, kāraṇamapi niyataṃ kāryaviśeṣāvagatihetutvād lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| uktaṃ bhāṣye--lakṣaṇena heturapi vyāpto nāvaśyaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ yena punaḥ punarlakṣyate,kiṃ tarhi? yatsakṛdapi nimittatvāya kalpate padapi lakṣaṇamiti| kintu yena nāprāptinyāyena karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhyā evāpavādaḥ| tataśca lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtetyanorlakṣaghaṇe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā avakāśo yo heturna bhavati-vṛkṣamanuvidyotate, hetutṛtīyāyā avakāśaḥ- dhanena kulamiti; hetubhūte tu lakṣaṇe ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt tṛtīyā syāt, tāmapi bādhitvā dvitīyaiva yathā syāt| punaḥ saṃjñāvidhāne kakṣāntaraprāptatvād dvitīyaiva tṛtīyā bādhate| uktaṃ ca--
hetuhetumatoryogaparicchedo'nunā kṛte|
ārambhādvādhyate prāptā tṛtīyā hetulakṣaṇā|| iti|
`tṛtīyārtha' ityanena tu purastādapavādanyāyena `sahayukte'pradhāne' ityasyaiva bādhaḥ, na hetutṛtīyāyā iti vaktavyametat||
padamañjarī
tṛtīyārthe|| 1.4.85 ||
nadīmanvavasiteti| sahārtho'tra tṛtīyārthaḥ| anvavapūrvāt`ṣiñ‌ bandhane' ityasmāt karttari ktaḥ||
padamañjarī
hīne|| 1.4.86 ||
hīnetkṛṣṭasambandhe saṃjñeti| karmapravacanīyavibhaktistu tena vyatiricyamāna utkṛṣṭa eva bhavati, na hīne, abhidhānāśaktisvābhāvyāt nobhābhyāmekayaiva dvitīyayā dviṣṭhasyāpi sambandhasyābhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīt||
padamañjarī
upo'dhike ca|| 1.4.87 ||
atrāpyadhikinā vinādhikasyāsambhāvad adhikādhikisambandhe saṃjñā vidhīyate| vibhaktirapyadhikina eva bhavati, nādhikāt| upakhāryo droṇa iti| khāraśabdo gaurādiḥ, khārī tāvadasti, adhiko'pi tasyāṃ droṇo'stītyarthaḥ| `yasmādadhikam' iti saptamī||
apaparī varjane|| prakṛtena vākye pratipādyamānenetyarthaḥ| pariparitrigarttebhya iti `pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī, `parervarjane' iti dvirvacanam, karmapravacanīyena pañcamīsahitena dyotite'pi varjane bhavati, ubhayorapi vidhānasāmarthyāt| pariṣiñcatīti| pariḥ sarvato bhāve, atrāsyāḥ saṃjñāyā abhāvād upasargatve sati `upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ bhavati, `śe mucādīnām' iti num||
padamañjarī
āṅ maryādāvacane|| 1.4.89 ||
maryā maraṇadharmāṇo manuṣyāḥ, auṇadiko yapratyayaḥ, tairādīyate maryādā, `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅpratyayaḥ| avadhirmaryādeti| nanu yatrāvadhiḥ kāryeṇa yujyate so'bhividhiḥ, yatra na sā maryādā; avadhistu sādhāraṇaṃ tatkāthamavadhirmaryādā? nāyamatrārtho yo'vadhiḥ sā saryādeti, kiṃ tarhi? yā maryādā so'vadhirityarthaḥ| vacanagrāṇaditi| iha maryādāyāmiti vācye vacanagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasyaitatprayojanamevaṃ yathā vijñāyeta--ucyate'sminniti vacanam, maryādāyā vacanamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| maryādāśabdo yatrocyate `āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ' iti tasyāṅo grahaṇam, sa cābhividhivṛttirapītyatrāpyabhividhergraṃhaṇaṃ bhavati|
yadvā--vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyādavāntarabhedo na vivakṣyate, avadhimātraṃ gṛhyate| ā mathurāyā iti| vṛṣṭo deva ityapekṣyate, `mantha viloḍane' auṇādikaḥ kurac pratyayaḥ| īṣadarthe kriyāyoge ca mā bhūditi| vākyasmaraṇayostvaṅittvādevāprasaṅgaḥ, tatreṣadarthe ā kaḍāraḥ pañcamī na bhavati, kriyāyoge samāhāra iti `gatirgatau' iti nighāto bhavati||
padamañjarī
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsasu pratiparyanavaḥ|| 1.4.90 ||
lakṣyate yena tallakṣaṇam- cihnaṃ jñāpakam| ayaṃ prakāra ittham, prathamāntādidamasthamuḥ iha tvidamā pratyavamṛśyasya sannihitasya kasyacidabhāvātprakāraviśeṣamātravṛttiritthaṃśabdaḥ| `bhū prāptau' ātmanepadī, `ā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣe gatyarthatvātkartari ktaḥ| tata itthaṃśabdādavyayādapi vṛttiviṣaye sattvadharmopādānātkarmaṇi dvitīyā, śritādiṣu gamyādīnāmiti sāmasaḥ, kañcit prakāraṃ prāpta itthaṃbhūtaḥ, itthaṃbhūtasyākhyānamitthaṃbhūtākhyānam| svīkriyamāṇoṃ'śo bhāgaḥ, yastvaṃśamātre prayogaḥ priyaṅgorbhāga iti sa bhāgasāddaśyāt| vyāptumicchā vīpsā, sā cāṣṭame sṣaṣṭayiṣyate, ete lakṣaṇādayo yathā vibhaktisamīpādayo'vyayārthā nevaṃ pratyādīnāmarthāḥ, kiṃ tarhi? saṃjñāyāḥ pratyādīnāṃ viṣayatvena nirdiṣṭāḥ ityāha--vīpsāyāṃ ca viṣayabhūtāyāmiti| etacca liṅgavipariṇāmena lakṣataṇādibhirapi sambandhanīyam| vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| atra vṛkṣo lakṣaṇaṃ vidyotanasya, pratyādayastu prāptikrayājanito lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāva ityevaṃ sambandhaviśeṣe'vasthāpayanti--vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotate, vṛkṣe pradeśe vidyotata ityarthaḥ| sādhuriti| atrāpi prāptikriyājanita eva viṣayaviṣayibhāvasambandhaḥ, yathā vṛkṣe ddaṣṭe vidyotanaṃ lakṣyate, naivamatrāsādhutvāpattiritītthambhūtākhyānagrahaṇam| yadatra māmiti| yo mama bhāgaḥ sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| atra svīkaraṇakriyājanitaḥ svasvāmisambandhaḥ| vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣamiti| vīpsā dvirvacanena dyotyate| pariśabdastu kriyayaiva sambadhyate, dvitīyā ceha karmaṇi| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tūpasargasaṃjñā--nivṛttyarthā tena `upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati| aśabdasāhacaryāditi| pariśabdo'yaṃ ddaṣṭāpacāro varjane cāvarjane ca karmapravacanīyaḥ| apaśabdastu varjane eva| karmapravacanīyādhikāre pañcamī vidhīyate, tatra sāhacaryaṃ vyavasthāhetuḥ||
padamañjarī
abhirabhāge|| 1.4.91 ||
abhāgaiti kimiti| abhidheyaṃ prayojanaṃ ca parijñātuṃ praśnaḥ| ata evobhayaṃ darśayati | bhāgaḥ svīkriyamāṇoṃ'śaḥ| yadatra mamābhiṣyāditi| nanu anvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādevātra na bhaviṣyati, saṃpratyeva hyasau vibhajanakriyāṃ dyotayati? pratyādīnāmapi tarhi na syād? vacanādbhaviṣyati| abherapi tarhi prāpnoti, tasmād `abhāge' iti vaktavyam, tatropasargatvāt `upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacparaḥ' iti ṣatvam| athaivaṃ kasmānna kṛtam--`lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyānavīpsāsvabhiḥ, pratiparī bhāge ca, cakārāllakṣaṇādiṣu ca, anurlakṣaṇatṛtīyārthayośca, cakārādbhāge lakṣaṇādiṣu ca, tato hīne, upo'dhike ca'; ityevaṃ hi dviranorgrahaṇam, abhāga iti ca na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi dviścagrahaṇaṃ kriyate iti padayoḥ sāmyam, akṣaralāghavaṃ tu nāddatam||
padamañjarī
pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ|| 1.4.92 ||
mukhasaddaśa iti| mukhyaḥ kvacitkārye śatruvadhādau ddaṣṭasāmarthyaḥ| yastu tadabhāve tatkāryakaraṇāya pratinidhīyate upādāyate sa pratinidhiḥ, karmaṇi kipratyayaḥ| dattasyeti uttamarṇena | pratiniryātanamiti| pratyarpaṇam| arjunataḥ pratīti| `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmād' iti pañcamī, pratiyogo pañcamyāstasiḥ| māṣāniti| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
adhiparī anarthakau|| 1.4.93 ||
nanu cānarthakayoḥ kriyāyogābhāvād gatyupasargasaṃjñayoḥ prāptyabhāvānna tadvodhanārtha karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānamupapadyate, nāpi pariśabdayoge pañcamīvidhānārtham, tadvidhau varjanārthasya grahaṇād| apādānatvācca siddhā pañcamī, yathā'dhiśabdasya prayoge--kuto'dhyāgacchatīti| ata eva dvitīyāvidhānārthamapi nopapadyate; tasmādanarthakayoḥ saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakamityata āha--anarthāntaravācināviti| yathā tiṣṭhati, nitiṣṭhati, paribhavatītyādau dhātūpāttādarthādarthāntaravācitvam, naivamatrārthāntaravācitvam; kintvāgacchatīti prayoge yo'rthaḥ sa evādhipariyoge tābhyāmucyate tadatra viṣaye dhātoradhiparyośca sahābhidhāyitvam; yathāgajaśabde yo'rthaḥ sa eva mataṅgaja iti sarvaiḥ sahābhidhīyate| evaṃ vṛṣaśabde yo'rthaḥ sa eva vṛṣabhaśabde| tadevamanarthāntaravācitvādanarthakakalpatvādanarthakāvityuktam, na tvabhāvāt| tayośca gatisaṃjñābādhāya karmaṃpravacanīyasaṃjñā vidheyeti darśitaṃ bhavati| kuto'dhyāgacchatīti| kiṃśabdāt `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasiḥ, tasya `taseśca' iti tasilādeśaḥ, `gatirgatau' iti nighātābhāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
suḥ pūjāyām|| 1.4.94 ||
susiktaṃ bhavateti| bhavacchabdātkarttari tṛtīyā| karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā na bhavati; `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti| suṣiktaṃ kiṃ tavātreti| kṣepo'yam, na pūjā||
padamañjarī
atiratikramaṇe ca|| 1.4.95 ||
padamañjarī
apiḥ padārthasaṃbhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccayeṣu|| 1.4.96 ||
padāntarasyetyādi| svārthastāvadavyabhicārānna gṛhyate iti padāntarasyārthaḥ padārthaḥ| tatrāpi padāntaraprayoge satyapiḥ prayujyamānastadarthe kañcidviśeṣamādhatte| yathā--nīlaśabda utpale, na tu tasminnevānyūnānatirikte vartate; tathā sati paryāyatvaprasaṅgenāprayogārhatvāt| ataḥ padāntarasyāprayoga eva tadarthe pravṛtto bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sarpiṣo'pi syāditi| prārthanāyāṃ liṅ, tasyā eva durlabhaviṣayatāmapiśabdo dyotayan syādityanena sambadhyate iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, durlabhatvaṃ ca viṣayasyaiva bhavati, yadi tasyā bindumātramapi na labhyata ityatrāpiśabdasāmarthyādvinduriti gamyate, tadāha--mātrābindustokamityasthārthe'piśabdo varttata iti| tadupajanite ca vyatireke sarpiṣa iti ṣaṣṭhī| dvitīyā tu na bhavati, apinā yogābhāvāt| sa hi syādityanena sambadhyata ityuktam| adhikārthavacaneneti tatsambhāvanamityarthaḥ| api siñcediti| sambhāvane liṅā tasyaiva duṣkaraviṣayatāmapirāha| kāmacāra icchāpravṛttiḥ| api siñcedeti | siñca vā mā vā, stuhi vā mā vā, yatheṣṭaṃ kurvityarthaḥ| jālmo'paśabdaḥ| api siñcediti| garhārthe liṅ| upasargasaṃjñābādhanāditi| syādityatra `upasargaprādurbhyām' iti sicaḥ `upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ||
padamañjarī
adhirīśvare|| 1.4.97 ||
tadayamiti| yathā `hīne ityatra hīnotkṛṣṭasambandhe saṃjñā, `upo'dhike ca' ityatrādhikādhikisambandhe, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ| vibhaktistu tatrānyatarasmāducyate, iha tu na tathetyāha--tatra kadāciditi| `yasya ceśvaravacanam' ityatrārthadvayam--īśvaraśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, yasya svasyeśvara ucyate tammātsvātsaptamītyaparaḥ| tatra yadā svāmyarthe vyatirekavivakṣā tadā tataḥ saptamī, svasya tu vyatireke tata iti| na punarubhābhyāṃ yugapadbhavati, ekayaiva vibhaktyā dviṣṭhasyāpi sambandhasyābhidhānāditi matvā `kadācid' ityaktam| brahmadatta iti| brahmadattasya svāḥ pañcālā ityarthaḥ| ādhapañcāleṣviti| pañcālanāṃ brahmadattaḥ svāmītyarthaḥ||
padamañjarī
vibhāṣā kṛñi|| 1.4.98 ||
`adhirīśvare' ityanuvṛtteḥ prāpte vibhāṣeyam| yadatra māmadhikariṣyatīti| adhipūrvaḥ karotirviniyoge varttate, yathā--adhikṛto'yamiha grāme| `svaritenādhikāraḥ' iti ca, īśvaro bhavatyevamatra māṃ viniyokṣyata ityarthaḥ| karmaṇi dvitīyaiṣā| yadyevam, saṃjñāvidhānasya kiṃ prayojanaṃ tatrāha--karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāpakṣa iti| `nipātairyadyadi' iti nidhātapratiṣedhāt syapratyayasvareṇa tiṅantamudāttavat||
padamañjarī
laḥ parasmaipadam|| 1.4.99 ||
la iti ṣaṣṭhīti| atha prathamābahuvacane ko doṣaḥ, `āmaḥ' iti lāvasthāyāmeva lupyamānasya liṭaḥ saṃjñā syāt| tataścekṣāmityatrāmna syād, na hyato liṭparaḥ sambhavati, śeṣādeva, śeṣādeva parasmaipadamiti niyamāt? jñāpakāt siddham, yadayamāmpratyayavadityāha, taj jñāpayati--bhavatyātmanepadibhyo'pyāmiti| ayaṃ tarhi doṣo lakārasyaiva saṃjñā syānna tadādeśānāṃ tibādīnāmiti? sthānivadbhāvātteṣāmapi bhaviṣyati| `taṅānāvātmanepadam' ityatra tarhi `la' iti prathamāntasya taṅānābhyāṃ sambandho na syāt, na hi taṅānau lau bhavataḥ| nanu caivaṃ vijñāsyatetaṅānabhāvī lakāra eva, taṅānāvityakta iti| evamapi gatyantare sati na kliṣṭakalpanā yuktā, tasmāt `laḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī| ādeśāpekṣeti| na ca saṃjñāpekṣā, lakārasya parasmaipadamiti saṃjñā bhavatīti, kutaḥ? sāmānādhikaraṇyena prāyeṇa saṃjñāvidhānāt| kiñca--jasi yo doṣaḥ, so'sminnapi syāt; ubhayatra lakārasya saṃjñitvāt| tasmādādeśāpekṣā ṣaṣṭhī| yadyevam, anavakāśā puruṣasaṃjñā parasmaipadasaṃjñāṃ śatṛkvasoḥ sāvakāśāṃ bādheta| jasi tu lakārasya parasmaipadasaṃjñā tiṅāṃ tu puruṣasaṃjñeti bhinnaviṣayatvānnāsti bādhaprasaṅgaḥ| yadyapi jaspakṣe'pi tibādīnāmādeśānāmapi `sthānivadādeśaḥ' ityanena parasmaipadasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati; tathāpi tasyā anākaḍārīyatvātsamāveśasiddhiḥ| ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'pi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' ityāha, taj jñāpayati--bhavati tiṅāmapyeṣā saṃjñeti| na hi sijviṣaye śatṛkvasū sambhavataḥ, sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakamiti ātmanepadasaṃjñayā puruṣasaṃjñānāṃ samāveśasiddhiḥ, anyathā parasmepadeṣu sāvakāśāḥ puruṣasaṃjñāḥ taṅkṣvanavakāśayātmanepadasaṃjñayā bādhyeran| atha vā--puruṣasaṃjñāyāṃ parasmaipadātmanepadagrahaṇānuvṛtterayamartho bhavati, laṭaḥ parasmaipadātmanepadasaṃjñakāḥ satastrīṇi trīṇi padāni bhūtvā prathamādisaṃjñā bhavantīti tena samāveśasiddhiḥ||
padamañjarī
taṅānāvātmanepadam|| 1.4.100 ||
atha kasmāllasyetyasyānantaramete saṃjñe na vihite, evaṃ hi puruṣasaṃjñābhiranyatrasiddho'nayoḥ samāveśo bhavati, tatrāha--pūrveṇeti| ātmanepadasaṃjñayā parasmaipadasaṃjñāyā bādho yathā syādityevamarthamasmin prakaraṇe'nayorvidhānamiti bhāvaḥ| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānurodhena||
padamañjarī
tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamottamāḥ|| 1.4.101 ||
trīṇi trīṇīti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam| tatra ca samudāyasyāvayavasca pṛthakpadatvamiṣyate, ā pacasi pacasi devadattetyekāntatā yathā syāt, kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāg apacannapacannityādau pūrvapade'pyanusvārādi padakāryaṃ yathā syāditi; tena padacchedakāle trīṇitrīṇītyekaṃ padam, dve vā| iha tiṅāṃ trikāḥ saṃjñāstu tistra iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti| atra yadyapyekaikasya trikasyānekasaṃjñāvidhāne prayojanaṃ nāsti, naitāvatā yathābhimataviṣayalābhaḥ, tatrāha--tiṅo'ṣṭādaśa pratyayā iti|
evaṃ manyate--saṃjñā api ṣaḍeva, kathamekaśeṣanirdeśo'yam? tatra yadi prathamaśca prathamaśca prathamau, madhyamaśca madhyamaśca madhyamau, uttamaśca uttamaścottamau; prathamamadhyamottamā iti kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ dvandvaḥ kriyeta, tato nābhimatasaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ syāt| tasmātkṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣaḥ-prathamamadhyamottamāśca prathamamadhyamottamāśca prathamamadhyottamā iti| na caivamapi vijñāyate, kimādita ārabhya trīṇi vacanāni gṛhyante? āhosvidicchatastrikaparigrahe'pi yathāsaṃkhyaśāstraṃ kramate, kiṃ tarhi? vihiteṣu saṃjñānāṃ krameṇa sambandhaṃ vidhatte| evaṃ tarhi lokata etatsiddham, tadyathā--vihavyasya dvābhyāmagnirupastheya iti, na cocyate ānupūrvyaṇeti, atha ca vihavyākhyasya sūtrasyādita ārabhya ānupūrvyeṇa dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmṛgbhyāmagnirupasthīyate, na yābhyāṃ kābhyāñcit; tatra tiṅo'ṣṭādaśa pratyayā ityanenādita ārabhya trikāṇāmānupūrvyeṇa grahaṇaṃ necchāta iti darśayituṃ tiṅgrahaṇena saṃniveśo'stīti darśitam| na ca `parasmaipadasaṃjñakaḥ' ityādinā tu kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣo na kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ dvandva iti darśitam| yadi vā parasmaipadagrahaṇamātmanepadagrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate, tiṅgrahaṇaṃ tu satṛkvasornivṛttyartham| tadanuvṛttau ca dvau rāśī bhavataḥ, tayośca vyāpārabhedena sūtrametatpravartate| tatra caikaikaṃ trayastrikā iti| yathāsaṃkhyasiddhiḥ| tatra na cetyādinā rāśidvayaṃ dvarśitam| tatretyādinā tu vyāpārabhedaḥ| atrāpi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvavat||
padamañjarī
tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ|| 1.4.102 ||
ekaśa iti| `saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām' iti prathamāntācchas| prakṛtatvādeva trīṇītyasya sambandhe siddhe tānivacanaṃ puruṣavacanasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśārtham, anyathā hyekasaṃjñādhikāre vacanaprāmāṇyātparyāyaḥ syāt, tataśca `āḍuttamasya picca' `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' iti kāryaṃ vacanasaṃjñāpakṣe uttamasaṃjñāyā abhāvānna syāt| tānītyasmistu sati tānyetāni prathamādisaṃjñāviśiṣṭāni trīṇitrīṇītyevaṃ parāmarśāllabdhaprathamādisaṃjñāvidhānād bhavati samāveśaḥ|
nanu trikāṇāṃ puruṣasaṃjñā ekaikasya vacanasaṃjñeti viṣayabhedānnāyamekasaṃjñādhikāraviṣayaḥ, tanna; yathā vṛddhisaṃjñā pratyekamādaicāṃ bhavati, tathā puruṣasaṃjñāpi trīpitrīṇīti vacanāt triṣu pravartamānāpi tibādiṣu pratyekameva pravarttate, na samudāye; tasya prayoge'bhāvāt, pratyekameva teṣāṃ dhātorutpatteḥ| trigrahaṇaṃ tu maryādārthamādita ārabhya trayāṇāṃ prathamasaṃjñā bhavatīti, na punaḥ samudāye saṃjñāpravṛttarthaṃ tāni tiṅastrīṇitrīṇi padāni bhūtveti| tibādisūtre samāhāradvandve'ṣṭādaśāvayavapadāni tiṅśabdasya trīṇitrīṇīti samānādhikaraṇasyāpi puṃlliṅgatāpi sūtravadbhavati||
padamañjarī
supaḥ|| 1.4.103 ||
subiti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ prathamaikavacanādārabhya supaḥ pakārāt| kapastu pakāreṇa na bhavati, prāgdiśīyānāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāvidhānāt; anyathā vibhaktisaṃjñāyāmapi idameva subgrahaṇamanuvarttata iti suptvādeva siddhe'narthakaṃ tatsyāt| tiṅāṃ trikeṣviti| kimarthaṃ punaridamuktam? iha kaścinmanyate--sūtre cakārasyākaraṇātsaṃjñāmātramiha sambadhyate, nānyatkiñciditi tatra ddaṣṭāntapradarśanena trīṇitrīṇyekaśa ityanayoranuvṛttiṃ yathā tiṅāṃ vacanasaṃjñā vihitā tathaiva supāmapītyarthaḥ| tathā ca svayaṃ ca śabdaṃ paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe--supaścetyādi||
padamañjarī
vibhaktiśca|| 1.4.104 ||
cakāraḥ puruṣavacanasaṃjñābhyāṃ samāveśārthaḥ| tiṅāṃ vyavahitānāmapi svaritatvādanuvṛttiḥ| tiṅāṃ vibhaktitve prayojanam--ātāmādau `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ, supāṃ tu tyadādyatvādikamapi||
padamañjarī
yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ|| 1.4.105 ||
`lasya tibādayaḥ' ityanenaikavākyatāmāpannenānena tibādīnāṃ viśiṣṭavidhānam, uta vihitānāṃ tibādīnāṃ bhinnenānena vākyena niyamaḥ? iti saṃśaye niyama ityāha--lasyetyadhikṛtyeti| viśiṣṭavidhāne tvitaretarāśrayaṃ syāt--satāṃ tibādīnāṃ prathamādisaṃjñā, saṃjñāyāṃ ca tibādayo bhāvyanta iti| sa punarniyama upapadaniyamo vā syād--yuṣmadi madhyama eva asmadyuttama eva, śeṣe prathama eveti; puruṣaniyamo vā--yuṣmadyeva madhyamaḥ, asmadyevottamaḥ, śeṣa eva prathama iti| tatrād‌ye pakṣe kurvaṃstvaṃ kurvāṇastvamiti yuṣmadi śatṛśānacau ca na syātām, tṛjādayaśca na syuḥ--kartā tvaṃ kārakastvamiti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; etāvān viṣayo yuṣmadasmadupapadaṃ śeṣaśca sarvaścāsau puruṣeṣu niyataḥ| ucyante ca tṛjādayaste vacanādbhaviṣyanti| tulyajātīyasya ca niyanena vyāvṛttiḥ--yuṣmadi madhyama eva, na prathamottamau; asmadyuttama eva, na prathamamadhyamau; śeṣe prathamottamāviti| evaṃ tarhi tibādisūtre vidhīyamānatvāt prādhānyātteṣāmeva niyamo yukaḥ, śeṣagrahaṇāccopapadaniyame hi yuṣmadasmadī niyate, puruṣā aniyatāḥ, śeṣaścāniyataḥ| tatra prathama ityetāvadapyucyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ vijñāyate, tatra ca niyamāntarasyāsaṃbhavāt prathama eveti niyamaḥ; yatra ca prathamāprathamaprasaṅgastatraivaṃvidho niyamaḥ karttavyaḥ; śeṣa eva ca tathā prasaṅga iti tatraiva niyamo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena! puruṣaniyame tu madhyamottamau niyatau yuṣmadasmadī vā niyate, prathamaśca tatra yuṣmadasmadorapi prathamaprasaṅgo śeṣa eva prathama ityevaṃ prathamaniyamaḥ karttavyaḥ| na cāntareṇa śeṣagrahaṇamevaṃniyamaḥ śakyate karttumiti karttavyameva śeṣagrahaṇam| ataḥ śeṣagrahaṇam|
sūtrakārasyāpi puruṣaniyama evābhipreta iti tamevāśrayati--teṣāmayaṃ puruṣaniyamaḥ kriyata iti| teṣāmityud‌bhūtāvayavabhedastibādisamudāya ucyate, puruṣāpekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī| teṣāṃ tibādīnāmavayavo yo madhyamapuruṣastasyopapadaniyamaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ, sāpekṣasyāpi puruṣaśabdasya gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| atha vā teṣāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, puruṣadvārako niyamaḥ puruṣaniyamaḥ, puruṣadvāreṇa te niyamyanta ityarthaḥ| upoccaritaṃ tadamupapadam, śākapārthivāditvāduttarapadalopī samāsaḥ, upaśabdaḥ sāmīpye, tataśca vyavahite na bhavitavyamiti śaṅgāmapanayati| vyavahite ceti| samīpa ityeva siddhe upapadagrahaṇādāpekṣikasyāpi sāmīpyasya grahaṇam| vyavahitamapi ca vyavahitatarāpekṣayā saṃnikṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ| upapadagrahaṇaṃ tu pūrvabhūte'pi yuṣmadi yathā syād, anyathā `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti parabhūte eva syāt| nanu yathā sthāninyapīti vacanāt sarvathā'prayujyamāne'pi bhavati tathā pūrvaprayoge'pi parabhūtasyāprayogāt sthāninīti bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; saptamīnirdeśāt prayogapakṣe parabhūta eva syāt|
samānābhidheya iti| adhikaraṇaśabdo'bhidheyavacana iti darśayati| punaḥ samānābhidheye lakāreṇa niyimyamānena vā puruṣeṇaḥ trividhaṃ cābhidheyaṃ lakārāṇām‌bhāvaḥ karma kartā ca, tatra dravyavācinoryuṣmadasmadorbhāvavācinā lāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyāsaṃbhavāt kartṛkarmaṇoreva grahaṇamityāha--tulyakāraka iti| tulyamekaṃ kārakaṃ yasya tattathoktam, sthāninyapīti sthānaśabda prasaṅgavācī, sthānamasyāstīti sthānī| tatra ca prayujyamānasyāprayujyamānasya ca prasaṅgo'sti| ucyate cedaṃ sthānamasyāstīti, tatra sāmarthyādavadhāraṇaṃ vijñāyate--prasaṅga eva yasya, na tu prayoga iti| yadvā svanikāyaprasiddhireṣā--yasya sthāne ādeśo vidhīyate sa sthānīti| iha tvaprayujyamānatā sāddaśyāt yuṣmadi prayujyate, sarvathā sthāninyapītyasyāprayujyamāne'pītyarthaḥ| apiśabdātprayujyamāne'pi, tadāha--sthāninyapītyādinā| sthāninyapīti ko'rthaḥ? prayujyamāne'pyaprayujyamāne'pītyarthaḥ| upapadagrahaṇaprāptasya cārthasyāpiśabdo'nuvādaḥ| samānādhikaraṇa iti kim? tvayā gamyata ityatra mā bhūt|
kvacittu vṛttāvevāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭhyate, iha ca atitvaṃ pacati atyahaṃ pacatītyatrātikrāntapradhāne samāse yuṣmadasmadorasāmānādhikaraṇyāt prathama eva bhavati, iha tvīṣadasamāptastvaṃ tvatkalpaḥ pacasi, matkalpaḥ pacāmīti kālāntaraddaṣṭaguṇarahito yuṣmadasmadartha eva tvatkalpamatkalpaśabdābhyāmucyata iti madhyamottamau bhavataḥ, tatsaddaśapadārthāntarābhidhāne tu prathamaḥ, tathā tvattaraḥ pacasi, mattaraḥ pacāmi, paramatvaṃ pacasi,paramāhaṃ pacāmīti, kālāntarāddaṣṭaguṇātiśayaviśiṣṭo yuṣmadasmadartha evocyate iti bhavatyeva| evaṃ ca yuṣmadarthe madhyamaḥ, asmadartha uttama itīyatā siddhaṃ yuṣmadasmadarthe cellakāra utpannastarhyeva madhyamottamāvityarthaḥ, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva| iha cātvaṃ tvaṃ saṃpadyata iti tvadbhavatīti bhavati; prakṛtereva vikārarūpeṇa sampattau kartṛtvāt| etacca ` ānmahataḥ' ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| tathā ca mantre--`yadagne syāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ vāsyā aham' iti, ahaṃ tva syāṃ tvaṃ vāhaṃ syām' iti prakṛtyāśrayaḥ puruṣo ddaśyate| iha bhavānpacatviti yuṣmadarthapratīteḥ sthāninyapīti madhyamaḥ prāpnoti, na vā yuṣmadarthatvāt, aliṅgaḥ sambodhanaviṣayaśca yuṣmadarthaḥ| bhavadarthastu liṅgavān na ca sambodhanaikaviṣayaḥ| yathaiva hi māṇavakādhīṣṭetyabhimukhībhāvo gamyate, evaṃ tvamadhīṣvetyapi| tathā ca yuṣmadaḥ sarvatraiva saṃbodhane prathamā āmantritādyudāttatvaṃ ca bhavati, padātparatve ca nighāta iti kecidāhuḥ| uktaṃ ca---
sambodhanārthaḥ sarvaṃnna madhyame kaiścidiṣyate|
tathā sambodhane sarvāṃ prathamāṃ yuṣmado viduḥ||
yuṣmadarthasya siddhatvānniyatāvādyudāttatā|
yuṣmadaḥ prathamāntasya paraścenna padādasau || iti|
satyam; sambodhanaikaviṣayo yuṣmacchabdaḥ, prathamā tu śuddhaiva; abhimukhībhāve'syāpi prātipadikārtha evāntarbhāvāt, yatra tvanantarbhāvaḥ, tatra tadabhidyotanāya sambodhane ceti prathamā vidhīyate svaropi; anyathā yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī, yūyaṃ yāta svastibhiḥ, haye devā yūyamidāpayastha' iti pādādāvapyantodāttatvaṃ padātparatve'pyanighātaḥ| tadevaṃ bhavacchabdasyāsambodhanaviṣayatvālliṅgavattvāccāyuṣmadarthatvād madhyamo na bhavatīti sthitam||
padamañjarī
prahāse ca manyopapade manyateruttama ekavacca|| 1.4.106 ||
prahāse gamyamāna iti| yatra bhūtārthābhāvādvañcanaiva kevalaṃ tatra vakturabhiprāyāviṣkaraṇe prahāso gamyate| manyati śabdasyekadeśānukaraṇaṃ manyeti, manya upapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| lasya dhātorvidhānāttadādeśatvācca madhyamasya dhāturanyapadārtha ityāha| manyopapade dhātāviti| prakṛtibhūte satītyarthaḥ| sa caikavaditi| arthadvārakaścottamasyaikavadbhāvaḥ, ekasya vācako bhavatītyarthaḥ, dvayorbahuṣu mantṛṣu ekavacanameva bhavatīti yāvat| yatra hi dvau mantārau bahavo vā, tatraikavadbhāvo vidheyaḥ; anyatra tu manturekatvādeva siddham| ekavacceti| ca śabdenvācaye, tenaikavadbhāvāve'pi ekasminnapi mantari pradhānaśiṣṭau madhyamottamau bhavataḥ|
anvācayameva darśayitumayatnasādhyamekaṃ mantāramudāharati--ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti| satyapyodane bhoktumāgataṃ śyālādikaṃ prati etatprayujyata iti parihāsāvagatiḥ| dvibahvostūdāharaṇe--ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣaghyethe nahi bhokṣyethe bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiḥ; ehi manye rathena yāsyatha yātastena pitā iti| madhyamottamayoḥ prāptayoriti| yuṣmadasmadarthasya gamyamānatvāt pratyudāharaṇavat prakṛtamupapadagrahaṇaṃ yuṣmadā sambaddham| tacca tathaivaihāpyanuvartyamiha mā bhūt--etu bhavānmanyate odanaṃ bhokṣye bhuktaḥ so'tithibhiriti| tadaśakyaṃ manyatinā sambandhumiti punarihopapadagrahaṇam, anayathā manyatau parata eva syāt| śyanānirdeśānmana jñānaityasya grahaṇam, na tu `manu avabodhane' ityasya, ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmīti evaṃ tasya bhavati| pratyudāharaṇe atithiṃ prati tathābhūtārthavācanam||
padamañjarī
asmadyuttamaḥ|| 1.4.107 ||
yatra yuṣmadasmadī dve apyupapade bhavatastatra yadi kartṛśaktī svādhāraniyate vivakṣyete, tadā lakāro'pi bhedenotpadyate--tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca pacasi, pacāmi ceti| sahavivakṣāyāṃ tu dvayorapi śaktyoreko lakāra utpadyate| tatra yuṣmadi madhyamaḥ, asmadyuttamo vipratiṣedhena--tvaṃ cāhaṃ pacāvaḥ, ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan saṃyujyāvaḥ' iti| yadāpi tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparamityasmadaḥ śeṣastadāpi syāninyapīti madhyamaprāptau paratvāduttama eva bhavati--āvāṃ pacāvaḥ||
padamañjarī
śeṣe prathamaḥ|| 1.4.108 ||
upapada iti nivṛttam| śeṣa iti viṣayasaptamī, na punaḥ parata iti tadāha--śeṣa iti| madhyamottamaviṣayādanya ucyata iti| anyo viṣaya ityarthaḥ| yatra yuṣmadasmadī samānādhikaraṇe na stastatra śeṣa ityanena yuṣmadasmadorabhāvaḥ śeṣaḥ, na punaranyasadbhāva iti darśayati| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? tvaṃ ca devadattaśca pacathaḥ, ahaṃ ca devadattaśca pacāvaḥ, tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca devadattaśca pacāma iti| atra yadyapi yuṣmadasmadoranyasya ca yaḥ samudāyaḥ sa yuṣmadasmadbhyāmanyaḥ, tathāpi yuṣmadasmadī tāvatsta iti tatsadbhāvanimitte syādeva prathamaḥ| yadāha--tatra yuṣmadanyeṣu prathamapratiṣedhaḥ śeṣatvāditi||
padamañjarī
paraḥ sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā|| 1.4.109 ||
paraśabdo'tiśaye varttata iti| yathā paraṃ sukhaṃ paraṃ duḥkhamiti, digādiṣu vartamānasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati sannikarṣasya digdeśakālāyogāt| arthāntarāpekṣamanyatvam, avyabhicārisannikarṣaḥ pratyāsattiriti, na tu saṃśleṣaḥ, tasya varṇeṣvasaṃbhavāt| sa hi saṃyogaśced dravyadharmatvānna śabdasya guṇasya saṃbhavati| samavāyaścenna varṇe varṇaḥ samavaiti; śabdasyākāśasamavāyitvāt| yeṣāṃ tu śabdo dravyaṃ teṣāṃ na kvāpi śabdaḥ samavaiti| atiśayo'pi saṃyogasamavāyayoḥ kīddaśa iti na vidmaḥ| pratyāsattestvapekṣābhedāt sambhavati prakarṣāprakarṣayogaḥ, tasmātpratyāsattireva sannikarṣaḥ|
nanu ca krameṇoccāryamāṇeṣu varṇeṣu pūrvasya varṇasya ye niṣpādakāḥ sthānādayasteṣāṃ vyāparoparatau varṇāntarasya ye niṣpādakāsteṣāṃ vyāpārārambhaḥ| tatrāvaśyaṃmadhye kiyatyapi kālakalā bhavati, sūkṣmatvāttu nopalabhyate; padmapatraśatavyaktibhedavat, tatkathaṃ paraḥ sannikarṣa ityatrāha--ardhamātrākālavyavadhāna iti| satyam, etāvadvyavadhānamavarjanīyatvātsahyate, adhikena tu kālena vyavadhānaṃ paragrahaṇena vyāvartyata ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, drutāyāmeva vṛttau syānna madhyamāyāṃ vilambitāyāṃ vā, na hi tathā tayoḥ sannikarṣo yathā drutāyāṃ tulyaḥ sannikarṣaḥ| sarvāsu vṛttiṣu nairantaryeṇoccāraṇādyavarṇopalambhakabhedāttu vṛttiviśeṣaḥ| drutāyāṃ svalpa upalabdhikālaḥ, madhyamāyāmadhikaḥ, vilambitāyāmadhikataraḥ| dvividhā hi dhvanayaḥ- prākṛtāḥ, vaikṛtāśca| prākṛtā varṇānāmutpādakāḥ, vaikṛte tu punaḥ punarupalambhaḥ, madhyavartī tu kālaḥ sarvāsu vṛttiṣu tāvāneva| yadvā--yasyāṃ vṛttau yāvatā kālena vyavāyo'vaśyambhāvī, tatodhikena vyavāyaḥ paragrahaṇena vyāvartyate| padasya padāntareṇa yadānantarthaṃ tatraiva loke saṃhitāśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ| tathā ca--saṃhitāmadhīte na padāni, tataśca kumāryāvityādau padāvayave saṃhitākāryaṃ na syāditisūtrārambhaḥ||
padamañjarī
virāmo'vasānam|| 1.4.110 ||
viratirvirāma iti| virāma iti bhāve ghañ| virāmaḥ- varṇoccāraṇābhāvaḥ| arthāntaramāha--viramyate'neneti vā virāma iti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' ityasaṃjñāyāmapi `halaśca' iti karaṇe ghañ, pūrvatrābhāvaḥ saṃjñī uttaratrāntyo varṇaḥ, tena hi viramyate| tatrādye pakṣe`kharavasānayoḥ' iti parasaptamī, kathaṃ punaravasānena, paurvāparyamabhāvo hi saḥ, kharā vā, katham? na hi yadā kharasti tadā rephaḥ, yadā rephastadā khar; varṇānāṃ kramabhāvitvād, uccaritapradhvaṃsitvācca| atha tatra buddhiparikalpitaṃ paurvāparyaṃ tadabhāve'pi samānam| evaṃ `vāvasāne' ityatrāpi| dvitīye tu pakṣe kharavasānayorityekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhadyate--khari parato rephasya visarjanīyo bhavati, avasāne ca rephe sthānini visarjanīya iti sthanyādeśasya viṣayatā vivakṣyate| evaṃ `vā'vasāne' ityatrāpi| dadhim̐ madhum̐ iti | `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ' atra `vāvasāne' iti vartate| nanu ca lokaevāvasānaśabdo virāme prasiddhaḥ, yadyapyavapūrvaḥ syatiravagatau vartate kenaitadavasīyata iti? parābhave'pi avasito devadatta iti| avasānaśabdastu virāma eva prasiddhaḥ| na ca rephasyāvagatiparābhavayoḥ karaṇatvaṃ sambhavatīti nārthaḥ saṃjñākaraṇena, tadāha--saṃhitāvasānayorlokaviditatvāt siddhamiti| saṃhitāśabdo'pi sannikarṣamātre prasiddhaḥ, na padayoreva sannikarṣa iti vārttikakāro manyate||
haradattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ||

<2.1>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ - 2
padamañjarī
atha dvitīyādhyāye prathama pādaḥ
1 samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ || 2-1-1 ||
paribhāṣeyamiti| nādhikāraḥ, padavidhigrahaṇāt, anyathā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ parāṅvadbhāvadīnāṃ padavidhitvāvyabhicārādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| paritaḥ - sartatra, paratra, vyavahite ca, anantare ca - bhāṣyate kāryamānayeti karaṇe `gurośca halaḥ' atyakārapratyayaḥ| bhāvasādhana eva vā'bhedopacārātsūtre prayujyate| idaṃśabdasya sūtre prayuktasyāpi vidheyaparibhāṣāśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt strīliṅgatā| sa karva iti| nanu yaḥ kaścitpadavidhiriti sāmānyanirdeśenaiva tadhdarmabhūtā vyāptiruktā, kiṃ karmagrahaṇena? naitadastiḥ `yaḥ kaścid brāhmaṇa ānīyatām' ityukte kṣatriyādinivṛttiḥ pratīyate, na vyāptiḥ| prathamapaṭhitamapi samarthasabdamullaṅghyoddeśyasamarpakatvabalādārthena krameṇa prathame bhāvinaṃ padavidhiśabdaṃ vyākhyāsyānvidhiśabdaḥ karmasādhana iti darśayati-vidhīyata iti vidhiriti| kāryamityarthaḥ| padānāmiti| śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| padānāṃ satāṃ yatkāryaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ| yadi tu bhāvasādhano vidhiśabda āśrīyeta-vidhānaṃ vidhiriti, tataḥ padeṣu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī-padānāmasatāṃ niṣpādanaṃ padavidhiriti, tatra samāsatadhditasubdhātuvṛttayo na saṃgṛhītāḥ syuḥ| tatra hi padānāṃ satāṃ samāsādikāryaṃ vidhīyate, na punaḥ padatvam| nanu ca karmasādhanapakṣe'pi vibhaktividhānamasaṃgṛhītaṃ syāt, padānyeva hi tatra vidhīyante na tu padānāṃ satāṃ kiñcid? ucyate-`karmaṇi dvitāyā' ityādinā tu niyamaḥ kriyate, na padavidhiḥ| athāpyekavākyatayā svādisūtreṇa
