vibhaktīnāṃ vidhānam? evamapi kārakavibhaktiṣu tāvatkriyākārakayoravinābhūtaḥ sambandhaḥ, upapadavibhaktīnāṃ tu `anatarāntareṇayukte' ityādīnāmupasargavibhaktīnāṃ ca `nerviśaḥ' ityādīnāmekavākyatāyāṃ bhinnavākyatāyāṃ ca padavidhitvamastyeva; upapadānāmupasargāṇāṃ ca padatvāt| samāsādirityādiśabdena tadhditavṛttyādīnāṃ grahaṇam, tadhditā api subantādutpadyante| `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityasya tu samarthagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| evam `isusoḥ' sāmarthye' ityādīnāmapi samarthaḥ śakta iti; tatraiva samarthasabdasya rūḍhatvāt| svakāryaniṣpādanakṣamo hi loke `samarthaḥ' ityucyate| arthapratipādanaṃ ca śabdānāṃ svakāryavyutpādyatvena cādhikṛtā laukikāḥ vaidikāñca yasya kasyacitpratipādane samarthāḥ, ucyate cedaṃ samartha iti, tatra sāmarthyādviśeṣo'vagamyate, sa tu viśeṣaḥ pratyāsatterevaṃrūpa ityāha-vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne iti| viśeṣeṇa gṛhyate - jñāyate'nena samāsārtha iti vigrahaḥ| tādṛśaṃ ca tadvākyaṃ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| yadvā-viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vigrahaḥ, tadarthaṃ vākyaṃ vigrahavākyam, aśvaghāsādivatṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atha vā-abhedopacārādvigrahārthavākyaṃ vigraha iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, tadyathā-rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ samāsaḥ, tadarthaṃ vigrahavākyaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa iti, asya yo'rthastadabhidhāne rājapuruṣaśabda samarthaḥ, ato'pi tatpratīteḥ, sa punā rājaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ| samartho veditavya iti| sādhutveneti śeṣaḥ| yaḥ padavidhiḥ sa vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne samarthaḥ sanāsādhurbhavatītyasminpakṣe sūtrārthaḥ, nārthāntaraṃ sādhīyaḥ paśyāmaḥ| tattu sāmarthyaṃ prayogato'nusarttavyam| na punariyaṃ vṛttirasya vākyasyārthābhidhānasamarthā, nānyasyetyetatsūtrākṣarairlabhyate| ata evāsminvyākhyāne'parituṣṭaḥ sanvyākhyānāntaramāha--atha veti| atra pakṣe upacaritavṛttiḥ samarthaśabdaḥ, tadāhasamarthapadāśrayatvāditi| samarthānāṃ padānāṃ sambadhdārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthānāsiti| yaḥ padānāṃ vidhiḥ sa samarthānāṃ viditavyaḥ| samarthānāmiti ko'rthaḥ? saṃbadhdārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthānāṃ vetyarthaḥ| tatra vākye saṃbadhdārthatā| vyapekṣā hi tatra sāmarthyam| anyo'nyāpekṣā - vyapekṣā| ākāṃkṣāmannidhiyogyatveṣu satsuḥ yaḥ parasparasambandhaḥ sā vyapekṣā| vākye hi `rājñaḥ' iti padaniyatasaṃbandhyapekṣayod‌bhūtasaṃbandhaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtamarthamācaṣṭe, svasaṃnihitaṃ yogyaṃ ca puruṣamapekṣate| mamāyamiti `puruṣaḥ' ītyenenāpi puruṣaḥ svaniṣṭho'bhidhīyamānaḥ svasaṃnihitaṃ rājatvamavacchedakatvenāpekṣate-ahamasyeti| ato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena sambandho'niyatasaṃbandhiviṣayatvāccāpekṣayā yo yaḥ sannihito yogyaśca tena sambadhyate-rājñaḥ puruścāścaśca, rājño dedattasya ca puruṣa iti, nārthāntarasya| vṛtto tu saṃsṛṣṭārthatā| ekārthībhāvo hi tatra sāmarthyam| vṛttau hi rājapadaṃ rājānamabhidhāya na tāvati paryavasyati, puruṣamapyācaṣṭe, yathā-`gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti gaṅgāpadaṃ tīram| yadi tu tāvatyeva paryavasyettato yathā vākye rājñaḥ puruṣo'śvaśceti dvābhyāṃ sambandho bhavati, tathā rājapuruṣo'śvaścetyatrāpi syāt| svaviśeṣaṇasambandho'pi syād-ṛdhdasya rāḍapuruṣa iti yathā ṛdhdasya rājñaḥ puruṣa iti tathā puruṣapadamapi rājaviśiṣṭameva puruṣamācaṣṭe, na puruṣamātram| yadi tathā syāttato yathā vākye rājñaḥ puruṣo devadattasya ceti dvābhyāṃ sambandho bhavati, tathā rāpuruṣo devadattasya cetyapi syāt| ato yasya viśeṣasya bhāvādayaṃ viśeṣaḥ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ| bhāṣyoktāścāpare viśeṣāḥ-`subalopo vyavadhānaṃ yatheṣṭamanyatareṇābhisambandhaḥ svarabhedaśca saṃkhyāviśeṣo vyaktābhidhānamupasarjanaviśaṃṣaṇaṃ ca yogaśca ' iti| tathā supi alopaśca bhavati vākye-rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, nīlamutpalamiti samāse tu dyorekasminviśiṣṭe'rthe vṛtteḥ pṛthagarthābhāvātsvabhāvata eva vibhktanivarttate| saiva ca svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ śāstreṇānvākhyāyate-`supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti pratyayalakṣaṇena nalopādikārthaṃ yathā syāditi| pṛthagarthābhāve tu pathagvibhaktirna bhavati| tathā varṇeṣu vyavadhānaṃ ca pṛthagaparthatva eva dṛṣṭaḥ--rājñaḥ puruṣa iti dvāvapi nitsvareṇādyudāttī| abhedena dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā--puruṣa iti vṛttau caikasvaryaṃ dṛśyate| kiṃ ca, saṃkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyate pṛthagaretheṣu--rājñaḥ rājñoḥ rājñāṃ puruṣa iti| vṛttau tvavyaktamabhidhānaṃ viṣṭhati, brāhmaṇakambala iti mandeho bhavati-saṃbudhdirvā syāt? ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā? iti, na cātrasvarānnarṇayaḥ| vākye'pyāmantritanighātaḥ kambalaśabdo ghṛtāditāvādantodāttaḥ, samāse'pyantodāttatā| upasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca vyākhyātam| yogaśca bhavati pṛthagartheṣu-rājño gauścāścaśca kambalaśceti| vṛttau tvekārthyādbhedanibandhanasya samucca yasyābhāvāccaśabdo nivarttata-rājño gavāśvakambalā iti, tadetairviśeṣairvajñāyate saṃbhinnobhayarūpaḥ pāsūdakavadavibhāgāpanno vṛttāvartha iti| tena rājñaḥ puruṣamānaya rājapuruṣamānayeti ca yadyacapyeka evānīyata iti kāryayogino'bhedastathācyabhidhānaprakāro bhidyate, yathā-brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ bhojyatāmiti| tadevaṃ vṛttivākyayorartho bhidyata iti sthitam| evaṃ ca tra tatra vāvacanaṃ cintyaprayojanam; bhinnārthayā vṛttyā vākyasya bādhā'prasaṅgāt| anye tu jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti vadanto varttipadānāmānarthakyamevāhuḥ, tattu na rocayāmahe| kiṃ rājapuruṣa ityatra rājārtho na gamyate? omiti cet, puruṣamātrānayanaṃ prāpnoti| atha gamyate? kiṃnibandhanā tasyāvagatiḥ? na tāvat samāsasya tatra śāktiḥ kalpyā; rājaśabdanibandhanāyāmapi tasyāmanarthābhāvāt| na ca vākye rājapadaṃ vyutpannaṃ punaḥ samāse viyutpattimapekṣate, tāvatyeva ca pratipadyate rājārthaḥ| ate na jahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ, arthābhidhānaprakārabheda ityetadeva sāṃpratam| tatra sambadhdārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭārthānāmiti sthataṃ paribhāṣāpravṛttau heturnānyatarat, yato mā bhūdvyapekṣāmātrāśrayeṇa sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ| yadeyevam, parāṅgavadbhāve vibhaktividhāne ca sā na pravartteta; tatraikārthībhāvasyāsambhavāt| mā pravarttiṣṭa, parāṅgavadbhāvetnnimittagrahaṇaṃ nodayiṣyati| vibhaktividhāne'pi kriyākārakayorvyapekṣā'vinābhāvinī kvacidyuktagrahaṇam; kvacidyogagrahaṇam, kvacit‌-tṛtīyayā yogasyākṣepa iti na kvāpi doṣaḥ| ata evānantaramapi parāṅgavadbhāvamullaṅghya samāsamudāharati--vakṣyatīti| samarthagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| sūtraṃ kimarthamityarthaḥ| na hi kevalena padavidhigrahaṇena kiñcatkriyate| paśyetyādi| nanu ca śritādibhirdvitīyāṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-śritādiyoge yā dvitīyoti| evamapi sāpekṣas prasaṅgaḥ-mahatkaṣṭaṃ śrita iti, bhavati hyatra śritādinimittā dvitīyā, samarthagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati| yadyapyatra vākyāvasthāyāṃ vyapekṣānakṣaṇasāmarthyamasti, vṛttyavasthāyāntu naikārthībhāvaḥ saṃbhavatītyavocāma| kathaṃ tarhi devadattasya gurukulamiti sāpekṣasya vṛtta? nātra guruṇa devadattasya sambandhaḥ; kiṃ tarhi? samudāyena, gurudvārakaśca sulena sambandha ityarthād guruṇāpi yogo bhavati| uktaṃ ca-
samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā|
saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste'pi yujyante tadvatā saha|| iti
atha vā--pariparūrṇārthasyānyena sahaikārthībhāvaḥ svārthaparipūrttiśca samābandhi śabdasya pratiyogineti bhavati tadapekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ| uktaṃ ca -
sambandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo ntyaṃ sarvaḥ prayujyate|
svārthavatsā vyapekṣā'sya vṛttāvapi na hāyate|| iti
kiṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasītyādi atra śakyaṃ vaktum| tatkṛtārtheneti| tacchabdaḥ prakṛtaparāmrśāya tṛtīyāntaṃ samasyata--tadarthena yaḥ kṛco guṇastadvacaneneti| atra ca yasya samāsaḥ śahkyate--śaṃkulayeti, na tadarthena kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanam; yadathaṃna ca kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamupaleneti, na tasya samāsaḥ śaṅkyaca iti na bhaviṣyatīti| tasmānmahatyā śaṃkulayā khaṇḍa iti sāpekṣamudāharttavyam| gaccha tvaṃ yūpāyeti| `gatyarthakarmaṇi' iti caturthī| tadvā-`kriyārthāpapadasya ca karmaṇi' iti, yūpamāharttu gaccheti, atrāpyetadarthatvādeva dāruṇo na bhaviṣyatīti sāpekṣaṃ pratyudāharttavyam-mahate yūpāya dārviti| yaṇādeśo nityaśca tugbhavatīti| dvāvapyetau varṇavidhī, nityastuk ca `dīrghāt' ityāyameva, yastu `padāntādvā' iti vikalpitastuk sa padavidhitvādatra na bhavati| anye tu yaṇādeśo'nityaśca tugabhavatītyakārapraśleṣaṃ varṇayantaḥ `padāntādvā' iti vikalpitastugbhavatīti vyācakṣate| nanvasau padavidhirneti? āha-tatrantagrahaṇaṃ evaṃ sidhde'ntagrahaṇasyaitatprayojanam-padāntasya dūrghasya varṇasya vidhistug yathā syāti, dīrghāntasya padasya mā bhūditi||

2 subāmantrite parāṅvatsvare || 2-1-2 ||
parasyāṅgavaditi| tasyaiva padasyāmantritasyāṅgavadekadeśavadbhavati, tad‌grahaṇena gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| tādātmyātideśo'yamiti| aṅgaśbadasyāvayavavacanatvāt tasyāmantritasyātmā tadātmā, tasya bhāvastādātmyam, tatsvabhāvatvamityarthaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭayati-subantamiti| anupraviśati - antarbhavati, subantāmantritasamudāya ekasminnāmantrite saṃpanne yaḥ svaraḥ śakyate kartuṃ sa karttavya ityarthaḥ| kaḥ punarasau? ādyudāttatvam, samudāyasya ca padātparatve nighātaḥ| kuṇḍenāṭanniti| nanvatra sati tāvatparāṅgavadbhāve samudāyasyādyudāttatvaṃ śeṣanighāmantritaṃ nihanyate| yadā tarhyaṭannityetatpādādau varttate tadā nāsti nighāta iti dvayorādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| kiṃ ca puṃlliṅgo'pi kuṇḍaśabdo'sti-patyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syānmṛte bharttari golakaḥ| iti|
kuṇḍīti ca jānapadādisūtreṇa ṅīṣi bhavati| paraśunā vṛścanniti| `āṅparayoḥ khaniśrṛbhyāṃ ḍicca' iti kupratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ paraśuśabdaḥ, madraśabdaḥ `madeśca' iti rak‌pratyayāntaḥ, kaśmīraśabdo dhṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ, `subantasya parāṅgavadbhāve tannimittagrahaṇam' tasyāmantritavācyasyārthasya yannimittaṃ tadabhdhāyyeva subantaṃ parāṅgavadityarthaḥ| udāharaṇeṣu tṛtīyāntasya tāvannimittatvamastyeva;ṣaṣṭhyantasyāpyasti, bhṛtyanimittā hi rājatā, deśanimittā vā| evaṃ goṣu svāminnityatrāpi bhavati| tannimittatvābhāve tu na bhavati-maruttvāṃ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya, marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astu, māyābhirindramāyinam, etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva, kṣettreṇāgne svāyussambharasva, mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva| subiti kimiti| tannimittagrahaṇādeva tiṅntasya sidhdo nirāsa iti praśnaḥ| pīḍye pūḍyamāneti| na hi sūtrakāro vārttikakāravacanenātivyāptinivāraṇaṃ manyata iti bhāvaḥ| `pīḍa avagārahane' curādiṇic, ubhayatra karmaṇi laṭ, ekatrottamaikavacanamiṭ, avapatra śānac, yaki ṇilopaḥ, `tāsyanudāttet' iti iṭo' nudāttatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' ityekāra udāttaḥ, pīḍyamānetyatrāmantritanighātaḥ| nanu ca samarthagrahaṇānuvattayaivātra na bhaviṣyati, astya trāpi sāmarthyam, katham? sambodhanapadaṃ kriyāyā eva viśeṣakam, tathā ca brajāni devadattetyatrāmantritanidhāto bhavati| uktaṃ ca
sambodhanapadaṃ yadyattatkriyāyā viśeṣakam|
brajāni devadatteti nidhāto'tra tathā sati|| iti|
atha vā- hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇo'tra sambandhaḥ, he pīḍyamāna tvatpīḍayāhamapi pīḍya iti| gete gārgya iti| gehaśabda uñchāditvādantodāttaḥ, ekasyāmāsanādikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ dvayorapi kārakatvāttad‌dvāreṇāsti sāmarthyam| paragrahaṇaṃ kimiti| sannidhānādāmantritasyayaiva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| pūrvasya mā bhūditi| nimittabhāva evāmantritasyopakṣīṇatayā pūrvasyāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ. evaṃ ca pūrvasyāmantritatvamatantram| gārgyaḥ kuṇḍenāṭannityādāvapi bhavati sannidhānāt| amantritatvamapi tantramiti ceta; yadyevam, parameva saṃnihitamiti na pūrvaṃ pratyaṅgatvaprasahgaḥ| devadattaḥ kuṇḍenāṭannityatra pūrvaṃ pratyaṅgatve sati samudāyasyādyudāttatvaṃ śeṣanighātaḥ| aṭannityāmantritanighāta iti svaraḥ. paragrahaṇe tu sati devadattaśabdasyāmantritādyudāttatvam| tathā kuṇḍenāṭannityamyāpi nidhātastu na bhavati; `amantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti devadattaśabdasyāvidyamānavattvād| chansi tu paramapi pūrvasyāṅgavadṣyate-ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu| putarityanena saha marutāmityasyāpi nighātaḥ| yathā matpuṇḍībhūtaḥ| tatra subantasya mṛtpiṇḍātmanā paraṇāmāsambhavādekībhāvapratipādanaparametat| mṛtpiṇḍa ivaikatāmāpanna ityarthaḥ| yadvā, piṇḍīśabdo'pyasti-praviśa piṇḍīmiti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ. bhūtaśabdaupamārthaḥ-pitṛbhūta iti yathā| kimarthaṃ punarevaṃbhūtasyasvaraprāptaye yatna ityata āha-ubhayorapīti| asatyaṅgagrahaṇe kāryavyapadeśaśāstrāṇāmanyatamātideśaḥ syād| yathā parasya kāryamāmantritasya svaraḥ āmantritavyapadeśaḥ svaraśāstraṃ vā, tathā subantasyāpi tadbhavatīti| evaṃ cobhayorādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| nanu ca padātparasya nighātādubhayoranudttatvaṃ mā bhūdti vācyam; satyam, āmantritasyāpādāditve sati, pādāditve taduktam| vatkaraṇaṃ kimiti| paratra paraśabdaprayogādeva vatyartho lapsyata iti praśnaḥ| svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi| nānena kvācitkatvamasyocyate| evaṃ hi viṣayavibhāge na jñāyate-kvāhgavadbhavati? kva neti? nāpi kādācatkatvam-kadācidaṅgavat, kadācinneti, evaṃ hi sarvatra vikalpaḥ syāt| tasmādamayatrārtha--asati vad‌grahaṇe ām kuṇḍenāṭanniti sthite aṭannityasya nighāte prāpte kūṇḍenetyasyānupraveśātkuṇḍenāṭannityekamāmantritaṃ sampannam| na ca tadekāntaramiti pratiṣedhābhāvānnighāta eva syāt| vatkaraṇe tu sati aṭannityasya tāvadekāntaratvānnighātapratiṣedhe ādyudāttatvaṃ prāptam| tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ kuṇaḍenetyamyānupraveśātsamudāyasyādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ samudāyasyānaikāntaratve'pi aṭannityasya yadekāntaratvaṃ vatkaraṇena labdhaṃ tenaiva samudāyasya nighātanivṛttirādyudāttatvaṃ ca bhavati| kūpe sñcanniti| atra parāṅgavadbhāve sati aikapadyatṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, svāśrayaṃ padāditvaṃ bhaviṣyati, sarvātideśeṣu hyavirudhdaṃ svāśrayaṃ bhavati| kiṃ ca nātrātideśikaṃ sakārasya kiñcicchāstrīyaṃ kāryamasti, ato'pi svāśrayaṃ bhavatyeva, yathā namate daṇḍaḥ svayamevetyatra yakpratiṣedhe śap| idaṃ tarhi-`carma namn', atra parāṅgavadbhāve sati samānapadasthatvāṇṇātvaṃ syāt| satyapi samānapadatve `parvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti niyamādasaṃjñāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati| nāyaṃ niyamasya viṣayaḥ, pūrvapadaśabdo hi samāsāvayave rūḍhaḥ| tena samāsa e niyam| atha tu pūrvaṃ padaṃ pūrvapadaṃpūrvapadādatyaviśeṣeṇa niyamo vyākhyāyeta, tataḥ svaragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| akriyamāṇe ca tasmin, samānādhikaraṇasyopasaṃkhyānamityetadamapi śakyamakarttum| kathaṃ parasyāṅgavadbhāve kṛte ciṇo luṅnyāyena viṣyabhedāllakṣaṇasyāvṛttau pūrvasyāpi parāṅgavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati? sati tu svaragrahaṇe svahādanyatra paraśunā vṛścannityatra vṛścanniti pratipadikam; na ca pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti pratiṣeṣaḥ, `na ṅigaṃbudhdyoḥ' iti niṣedhālliṅgāt; tatra parāṅgavadbhāvena prātipadikānupraveśāt `supo dhātuprātapadikayoḥ' iti subluk prasajyeta; svahagrahaṇe tu satu subluki karttavye parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvaḥ? naitadasti; parāṅgavadityāmantritaṃ saṃnidhānātparaśabdena gṛhyate; tasya rūpasya sūbantaikāntatvātsubantakārya eva parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ, na prātipadikakārye| uccairadhīyāneti| uccairnīcaiḥ śabdau svarādṣvantodāttau paṭhitau, adhikaraṇaśaktiprādhānyāñca tasminnimittaṃ ca ||

3 prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ || 2-1-3 ||`yathā'sādṛśye' iti anantarasūtrātikrame na kiñcatkāraṇam| nanu `pratyayaḥ' ityādivatsamāsa ityeva svaritatvādadhkāro'stu, kiṃ prāgvacanena? tatrāha-prāgāvacanamiti| prākkaḍārādityavadhitanirdeśa ityarthaḥ| saṃjñāsamāveśārthamiti| anyathaikasaṃjñādhkārātparyāyaḥ syāt| avadhinirdeśe tu sati tatsāmarthyātprāggrahaṇamāvarttate| tena prāk samāsasaṃjñā bhavanti, samāsāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñā iti samāveśasidhdiḥ. atha vā-kaḍārāditi pañcamyaiva prāgiti dikśabdo'dhyāhariṣyate| na ca prāgityasyādhyāhāraprasaṅgaḥ, tadadhyāhāre hi `diksamāse bahuvrīhau' `tṛtīyāsamāse' `dvandve ca ' samāsa ityādyanupapannaṃ syāt; kaḍārātprāṅnirdiṣṭānāṃ samāsasaṃjñāyā abāvāt| tasmātprāgityevādhyāhariṣyate, nārthaḥ prāgvacanena, tatrāha-prāgvacanamiti||

4 saha supā || 2-1-4 ||
sahavacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tṛtīyaiva sahārthamākṣepsyati, yathā `vṛdhdo yūnā' iti? sahabhūtayoḥ samāsasaṃjñā yathā syād ekaikasya mā bhūd; anyathā pūtreṇa sahāgataḥ pitetyatra yathā dvayorapyāgamanena sambandhaḥ, evaṃ samāsasaṃjñāpi pratyekameva syāt, sahagrahaṇe tu sahabhūtayorekā saṃjñā bhavati| kiṃ ca syād yadyekaikasya saṃjñā syāt? iha ṛkpāda iti samāsāntaḥ prasajyeta, dvau ca svarau syātām| `kṛttadhditasamāsāśca' ityatra tu samāsaśca samāsaścotyokaśeṣo vyākhyāsyate, tena samāsasamūhasya saṃjñāvidhiniyamārtha iti vākyasya na bhaviṣyati; anyathā tvekaikasya samāsasya pratyayāntatvādvidhyarthaṃ samāsakagrahaṇaṃ syat| `samāsāñca tadviṣayāt' ityatrāpi prātipadikādityanuvarttate, samūhasya ca prātipadikatvam, na tvekākasya samāsasyeti samāsādityekatvādivakṣayā samūhādeva sidhdaḥ pratyayaḥ| tadevaṃ samudāyasya yathā syādekaikasya mā bhūditi sahagrahaṇam| naitadasti prayojanam, `samāsaḥ' iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate-anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta|
yasminsamudāyo dapadvayaṃ parasparaṃ samasyate sa samāsaḥ| `halaśca' ityadhikaraṇe ghañ| tasmādanarthakaṃ sahagrahaṇam tatrāha-sahagrahaṇaṃ yogavibhāgārthamiti| sahetyeko yogaḥ, subityeva, sup saha samasyate, kena? padavidhitvātsamarthena| anuvyacaladiti| tatra subityekatvasya vivakṣitatvādhdeḥ pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ, paścādanoḥ, tatra nityasamāsatvādhdeḥ śākalābhāvaḥ| samāsānyodāttatvaṃ tu na bhavati;`tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātāt| anoḥ `gatirgatau' iti nighātaḥ, veairyaṇādeśe `udāttasvaritayoḥ' ityaṭaḥ svaritatvam| anye tu-satiśiṣṭaṃ samāsānyodāttatvaṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ| vibhaktistu satyapi samāsatvena prātipadikatvena bhavati; tiṅaikatvasyoktatvāt| yadvā-vacanagrahaṇamukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu yathā syāditi prathamaikavacanam, halṅyādilopaḥ| evaṃ caikapadyādāmanuvyacaladdevadatteti `āma ekantaramāmantritamanantike' iti nighātapratiṣedho bhavati| yaugavibhāgaśceṣṭasidhdyartha ityatiprasaṅgo nīdbhāvanīyaḥ||

5 avyayībhāvaḥ || 2-1-5 ||
iha laghvartha saṃjñākaraṇamityekākṣarā saṃjñāṃ kāryā, kimarthaṃ mahatī kriyate ityāhṛ-anvathasaṃjñā ceyamiti| anavavyayamavyayaṃ bhavatītyavyayībhāvaḥ, `bhevaterṇa upasaṃkhyānam' iti ṇapratyayaḥ| anvarthatve kiṃ sidhyatītyata āhateneti| pūrvapadagraṅaṇamavyayasyopalakṣaṇārtham| sūpaprati, śākapratītyādāvuttarapadārthapradhānyānna syāttasmādavyayībhāve'vyayārthaḥ pradhānamiti sūtyate| evaṃ hyavyayānavyayasamudāyo'vyayadharmabhādavyayaṃ bhavatīti| kiṃ sidhdaṃ bhavati? samṛdhdā madrāḥ samadrā ityādāvuttarapadārthapradhānye'vyayībhāvasyātiprasaṅgaḥ parihṛto bhavati| pāregaṅgam, dvimuni, unmattagaṅgamityādau caca vacanādavyayībhāvaḥ| evaṃ cānavyayamavyayaṃ bhavatītyanvarthatayaivāvyayakāryasyāpi lābhād `avyayībhāvaśca' ityetadapi na taditi cot, na; atraiva parigaṇayyānvarthatvena vā viśiṣṭakāryaviṣayamavyayatvamanunīyatām||

6 avyayaṃ vibhāktasamīpasamṛdhdivyṛdhdyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyampattisākanyāntavacaneṣu || 2-1-6 ||
śrutatvādavyayasyaiva vibhaktyadayo viśeṣaṇāni, na samāsasyetyāha-vibhaktyādiṣviti| samasyata iti| yadyapi `samāsa' iti saṃjñāmātraṃ vidhūyate, tathāpyayamabudhavodhanāya bhnnayoḥ śabdayoḥ saṃśleṣaḥ prakriyāyāṃ kriyata iti `samasyate' ityuktam| vacanagrahaṇaṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyata iti| tañca karmasādhanaṃ vibhaktyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇam| vibhaktyādiṣu vācyeṣu yadavyayaṃ varattate - vibhaktyādīnarthānyadavyayaṃ vakti, dyautayatītyarthaḥ| vibhaktiśabdena kārakaśaktirabhidhāyate vibhajyate'nayā pratipadikārtha iti kṛtvā| strīṣvadhikṛtyeti| strīṣu kathā pravartyata ityanvayaḥ| adhikṛtyeti, prastutyetyarthaḥ| saṃnidhānāñca striya eva prasutatyeti gamyate, strīviṣayā kathā pravartyata ityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu pravarttate iti| atrāhuḥ-adhikṛtya yā kathā mā strīṣu pravarttata ikatyarthaḥ, tatra prastāvane kathane ca karturekatvātsidhdaḥ kttvāpratyaya iti| anye tvāhuḥ-kṛtyasya kathā kartavyakathetyarthaḥ, sā strīṣu adhipravartate strīṣvadhāti ca prakriyāvākyam, na tvetatprayogārham; samāsasya nityatvāt| adhistrīti| `avyayūbhāvaśca' iti napuṃsakatvāda `hrasvo napuṃsasake' iti hrasvaḥ| saptamyarthe yadavyayamiti| vibhaktivacanatāṃ darśayati| upakumbhamiti| kumbhasyopeti prakriyāvākyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantena samāsaḥ| duḥśakam duryavanamiti| manuṣyajātivacanau śakayavanaśabdau, kimarthaṃ punarvṛdhdigrahaṇam, arthābhāva ityeva sidhdam? na sidhdyati; yena samasyate tadrathasyābhāvo'rthābhāvaḥ, na cātra śakānāmabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadīyāyā ṛdhdeḥ| arthābhāva ityarthagrahaṇaṃ yatra dharmisvarūpasyaivābhāvastatra yathā syāt, dharmamātrapratiṣedhe mā bhūt, tadyathā-brāhmaṇena brāhmaṇyāmutpāditatvena kasyacid‌brāhmaṇatvaṃ prasajya pratiṣedhati-nāyaṃ brāhmaṇo yastiṣṭhanmūtrayati| itaretarābhāve ca mā bhūt-gauraśco na bhavatīti; atrāpi vastvantanaṃ pratiṣidhyate, na dharmisvarūpam| atiśītamityarithābhāvaḥ| kālanavacchinno'bhāva āśvīyate, iha tu saṃpratyabhāva ityayasya bhedenopādānam| atitaisṛkamiti| tisṛkā nāma grāmaḥ, `tisṛbhāve saṃjñāyāṃ kanyupasaṅkhyānam' tatra bhavaṃ taisṛkam - ācchādanam| tacca kālaviśeṣa upabhogyam| uṣṇe śīte vā atiśabdo nedānīmityasyārthe vartate| upabhogakriyā ca vṛttau svāvādevāntarbhavati, yathā-dadhyupasikta odano dadhyodana iti| tad‌dhdareṇa pūrvottarapadayoḥ sāmarthyam, nedānūmupabhogārhaṃ taisṛkamācchādanamityarthaḥ| ācchādanāpekṣasyāpi daisṛkaśabdasya gamakatvātsamāsaḥ| nātra taisṛkasya kālānavacchinno bhāvaḥ, nāpi saṃprati tasāyābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadupabhogasyetyarthābhāvādatyayāccāsaṃpratibhidyate| tatpāṇinīti| tacchabdo nipāto'pyasti| pratyarthamiti| arthamarthaṃ pratīti vākyamapyatra bhavati; bhāṣyaprayogāt| yadi vā nātrāvyayaṃ vīpsāvṛtti, kiṃ tarhi? karmapravacanūyatvātsamvandhamavacchinatti| vīpsā tu dvirvacanadyotyā| anupūrvasya bhāva ānupūrvyam-brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ, ṣyañaḥ ṣitkaraṇātstriyāmapi bhavati tasya prayogaḥ| evaṃ jyeṣṭha
ānupūrvyeṇeti| sacakramita. sahaśabdasasya samāsaḥ, `avyībhāve cākāle' iti sabhāvaḥ, evamuttareṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu| guṇabhūte'pītyādi| yadi `sādṛśye' iti nocyate, ipūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāva iti yadā sādṛśyaṃ viśaṃṣyatvātpradhāvanaṃ tadaiva syāt sādṛśyaṃ kikhyeti, guṇabhūte na syāt| sadṛśaḥ kikhyeti| sādṛśyavataḥ prādhānyadarśanena sādṛśyasya guṇabhāvaṃ darśayacati| sarikhīti| pūrvavad‌dhrasvaḥ| apacitaparimāṇaḥ śrṛṃgālaḥ kikhī| aprasidhdodāhaṇam; cirantanaprayogāt| sampattiśabdasya samṛdhdau rūḍhatvātpunarupādānaṃ vyarthamityāśṅkyāha-sampattiranuparūpa ātmabhāva iti| sabrahma brābhravāṇāmiti| teṣāmanurūpo brahmabhāva ityarthaḥ| satṛṇāmiti| na cātra tṛṇabhakṣaṇaṃ vāstavamityāha--na kiñcidati| tṛṇabhakṣaṇamadhiko'rthaḥ, tadvacanena kiṃcidabhyavahāryaṃ na parityajatītyayamarthaḥ pratipadyate tṛṇāni bhakṣayankathamanyatparityajediti| paragrahāpekṣayeti| `idānīmetāvānpradeśo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti yāvataḥ pradeśasya paragrahastadapekṣayā samāptiḥ - anutaḥ, sa cāsakale'pyadhyayane bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| sāgnīti| agnyādayaḥ śabdāstadarthe granthā varttante, tadānīṃ parigṛpītasya pradeśasyāgnyādirantaḥ, na tu tataḥ pareṇādhyayanaṃ nāsti; tataśca na sākalyamityāha iyamiti||

7 yathā'sādṛśye || 2-1-7 ||
sādṛśye samāsasya pūrveṇaiva sidhdatvādasaṃdehārthaṃ sādṛśye yathetyavacanācca naño'tra praśleṣaḥ| asādṛśye iti kititi| sūtraṃ kimarthamityarthaḥ| yathā devadatta iti | devadattasya yajñadattaṃ pratyupamānatvaṃ yathāśabdo dyotayati| tatropamānasyopameyāpekṣatve'pi yathā-devadattaśabdayoḥ sāmarthyātparasparema samāsaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| atha pūrveṇātra sādṛśya iti vā, yathārtha iti vā kasmānna bhavatītyāha pūrveṇaiveti||

8 yāvadavadhāraṇe || 2-1-8 ||
yāvanti pātrāṇīti| yāvadityavyayaṃ cāsti, tadhditāntaṃ ca vidyate, ato nityamasāse'pi tadhditāntena vigrahaḥ|

9 suppratinā mātrārthe || 2-1-9 ||
astyatra kicitsūpa iti kiñcidityavyayaṃ sūpa iti puṃlliṅgena samānādhikaraṇam| subiti varttamāna iti| `subāmantrite' ityataḥ| avyayanivṛttyarthamiti| pūrvahi subgrahaṇamavyayagrahaṇena saha vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ| svarādīnāṃ ca doṣāmanyamahaḥ, divāmanyā rātririti vṛttiviṣayo sattvapradhānatādarśanānmātrāvati vṛttiravirudhdetyavyasyaiva samāsaḥ syāt||

10 akṣaśalākāsaṅkhyā pariṇā || 2-1-10 ||
akṣaśālākāsaṅkyāśabdā iti| akṣaśalākāśabdau sahkyāvācinaśca śabdā ityarthaḥ| kvacittu-akṣaśabdaḥ śalākāśabdaḥ saṅkhyāśabdāścoti pāṭhaḥ| kitavavyavahāra iti kitavā - dyūtakārāḥ, teṣāṃ vyavahāle'kṣaśalākānāṃ pātataṃ tatraivāyaṃ samāsa iṣyate, etaccābhudhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate| karva uttānā iti| śalākānāmapi prakṛtatvātsarve ca sarvāśca sarve, uttānāśca uttānāśca uttānāḥ, avāścaścāvācyaśācāvāñcaḥ, `pumānstriyā' iti puṃsaḥ śeṣaḥ| tasyaivāsyeti| pātayiturityarthaḥ| vipātaḥ - parājayaḥ| anyathāpāte sati, jaye yādṛśaḥ pātaḥ sarve uttānāḥ patantyavāñco veti tato'nyādṛśeṣu keṣucjuttāneṣu, keṣucidavākṣu patatsivatyarthaḥ| akṣeśeti| vṛttāpekṣayā karttari tṛtīyā| parameṇeti| atiśayenātaḥ paramityarthaḥ pañcaparūti na bhavatīti yāvat| asyopapadānaṃ slokena kriyate| pañcasu tvekarūpeṣviti| atrāpi puṃsaḥ śeṣaḥ| ekarūpāsviti prāyeṇa pāṭhaḥ| tatra śalākānāmeva grahaṇam| jaya eva bhaviṣyatīti| lṛṭo'rtho mṛgyaḥ, yataḥ pañcasvekarūpeṣu jaya eva bhavati, tena parameṇa catuḥparītyanvayaḥ| akṣādayastṛcīyāntā iti| anyathā vṛttāvayaṃ samāsa iṣyate, tatra cākṣādīnāṃ kartṛtvāttṛtīyaiva yukteti bhāvaḥ| pūrvektasyeti| pūrvavṛttasyetyarthaḥ| anekārthatvādhdātūnāṃ vaciriha varttane varttate, tadeva yathā na taditi tacchabdena parāmṛśyate| pūrvajaye vṛttasyākṣāderyathā dat‌vṛttamabhūt, yadi saṃprati tathā na bhavati evaṃ samāso bhavatītyarthaḥ| pūrvoktasyeti sāmānyāpekṣamekavacanam| jayakāle'kṣādīnāṃ yadekarūpaṃ varttanaṃ tadhdiparīte varttane pariṇā dyotye samāsa iti yāvat| ekateva'kṣaśalākayoriti| akṣaśalākāśabdayorekavacanāntayoḥ samāsa ityarthaḥ| idamapyabhidhānasvābhāvyādeva labhyate, anthā `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādāvivābhedaikatvamavagamyeta, na tu śudhdamekatvam| prāyeṇa tu `kitavavyavahāre ca ekatve'kṣaśalākayoḥ' iti ślokarūpema paṭhyate, tatrārthāntaraṃ mṛgyaṃ saṃhitākāryaprasaṅgaśca| kitavavyavahāra iti kim? akṣeṇedaṃ na tathā vattaṃ yathā pūrvaśakaṭe| ekatva iti kim? akṣābhyāmakṣairvā idaṃ na tathā vṛttam| akṣādaya iti kim? prasaṅgenedaṃ na tathā pūrvajaye, pariṇeti vacanātsubantamātreṇa na bhavati||

11 vibhāṣā || 2-1-11 ||

12 apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā || 2-1-12 ||
nanu bahiḥśabdena yoge na kenacitpañcamī vidhīyate, tatkathaṃ yasya pañcamyantena samāsaḥ? bahirgato grāmādityatra tvasāmarthyānnaiva samāsena bhavitvayamata āha-bahiḥśabdeneti| na ca vacanasāmarthyādvahiḥ śabdasyāpañcamyantena samāso bhavatviti vācyam; pañcamīgrahaṇād| iha hyapapariśabdau parasparasāhacaryayādvarjanārthau gṛhyate, tau ca karmapravacanīyau, tadyauge ca pañcamyeva vihitā| añcatirapyapaparisāhacaryādavyayameva gṛhyate, tadyoge'pyañcūttarapadalakṣaṇā pañcamyevāsti| tadetatpañcamīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati-ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye bahiryoge pañcamī bhavatīti|

13 āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ || 2-1-13 ||
`maryādābhividhyoḥ' iti śakyamakattuṃm, katham? pañcamyeti varttate, āṅā ca karmapravacanūyenaiva yoge pañcamī vihitā, etayośyaivārthayorāṅaḥ karmapravacīyasaṃjñā-`āṅ maryādāvacane' iti| tatra hi vacanagrahaṇaṃ maryādoktimātre yathā syād ityabhividhāvapi bhavati| tatraiva vā'bhividhigrahaṇamevāstu||

14 lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye || 2-1-14 ||
abhyāgna, pratyagnīti| agni pratīti vigrahaḥ, `abhirabhāge' `lakṣaṇetthambhūta' iti abhipratyoḥ karmapravacanīyatvād dvitīyā| tatrāgnirlakṣaṇam, tena hi śalābhānāṃ pāto lakṣyate, abhipratī ca lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaṃ dyotayitvābhimukhyamapi dyotayataḥ| srughnaṃ pratigata iti yena deśenāgnirgatasteneti pratītirbhavati, gamanasyāgnirlakṣaṇabhābhimukhyaṃ cāsti, `yena-tena' śabdena saha samāsaḥ syāt| abhyaṅkāḥ, pratyaṅkāḥ iti| abhinavo'ṅka āsām, pratinavo'ṅka āsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| aṅko'tra bhavati gavāṃ lakṣaṇam, ābhimukhyaṃ tu nāsti| nanu ca sati saṃbhave'vyayārthe pradhāne'vyībhāva ityuktam, kathamatra prasaṅgaḥ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-bhavatiyatra prakaraṇe bahuvrīhiviṣaye'vyayībhāva iti| tena `saṃkhyā vaṃśyena', dvimuni vyākaraṇamityetatsidhdaṃ bhavati||

15 anuryatsamayā || 2-1-15 ||
yatsamayeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| kathaṃ punaḥ samāyāśabdena yoge ṣaṣṭhī, yāvatā `abhitaḥ paritaḥ samayā' iti dvitāyayā bhavitavyam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; samayāśbadasya mukhyo'rthaḥ sāmīpyam, tadyoge dvitīyā| iha tu samayāśabdavācinyanuśabde samayāśabdo varttate, tadāha--anaryatsamayā| samayāvācīti| yasya samayeti ko'rthaḥ? samayāvācītyarthaḥ, tadiha mukhyenārthenāyogad dvitīyā na bhavati, ṣaṣaṭhyeva tu bhavati, tasyāśca samāsaḥ| na ca pūraṇaguṇeti pratiṣedhaḥ; anavyayatvāt| sāmīpye hi varttamāna- samayāśabdo'sattavavācitvādavyayam| iha tvanūśabdārthe varttate, tatra yathā `abhirābhāge' ityādāvanukaraṇasyāvyayasaṃjñā na bhavati, tathāsyāpi| evaṃ ca yatsamayetyavibhaktikaḥ sautro nirdeśaḥ| vṛttāvapi yatsamayeti sūtrānukaraṇena vibhaktyabhāvaḥ| teneti| tadvācinā śabdenetyarthaḥ. anuvanamiti| vanasyānviti sāmūpyasambandhe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, asyārthamāha-vanaṃ samayeti||

16 yasya cāyāmaḥ || 2-1-16 ||
lakṣaṇeneti varttata iti| anyathā āyāmo gaṅgāyā ityasyārthe'nugaṅgamiti syāt| atrāpyāyāmavācitvādanurevāyāmaśabdenocyate, ityāha anuryasyāyāmavācīti| anugaṅga vārāṇasīti| ṣaṣṭhyantena gaṅgāśabdena samāsaḥ| gaṅgāyā anviti| āyāmo lakṣamatvaṃ cānunā dyotyate, lakṣaṇasya lakṣyāpekṣatvāllakṣyaṃ samāsārtha ityarthādupamānopameyabhāve samāsa iti vārāṇasyā sāmānādhikaraṇyam-gaṅgāyā ivāyāmo yasyāḥ, gaṅgevāyatā vārāṇasītyarthaḥ| tadvadatyantāyatetyartha iti kecit| tathā ca `anugaṅgametatsutram' ityekaśeṣasūtre bhāgavṛttikāraḥ prayuṅkte| neti vayam| kiṃ prāgāyatā vārāṇasī? utodagāyatā? iti saṃdehe idamucyate-anugaṅgaṃ vārāṇāsīti, yathodagāyatā gaṅgā tathodagāyatā vārāmasītyarthaḥ| gaṅgāyāmānusāreṇa vārāṇasyāyāma ityarthaḥ| yamunāyāmena mathurāyāmo lakṣyata iti| na yamunā svarūpeṇa lakṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? āyāmena, mathurāpi na svarūpeṇa lakṣyam, kiṃ tarhi? āyāmena| tatra prāptāptavivekenedamucyate-yamunāyāmena mathurāyāmo lakṣyata iti||

17 tiṣṭhad‌guprabhṛtīni ca || 2-1-17 ||
samudāyā eva nipātyanta iti | gaṇe tathā pāṭha eva teṣāṃ nipātanam| tena śatṛśānajādyapi bhavati| `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti ca prakriyākāryaṃ na karttavyamiti bhāvaḥ| avyayībhāvasaṃjñāni bhavantīti| samāsasaṃjñāpi vidheyā, antodāttatvaṃ ca | prātipadakasaṃjñā ca yathā syāditi| tiṣṭhad‌gu kālaviśeṣa iti| kālaviśeṣa ityetaduttarairapi sambadhyate, ata evānte vakṣyati-`ete kālaśabdāḥ' iti, etāvānkālaviśeṣa ityasyādhikāra ityarthaḥ| vibhaktyantareṇa na samābadhyante iti| avyatirikta eva prātipadikārthe prayoga eṣāṃ karttavyaḥ, nānyatretyarthaḥ| anyapadārthe ca varttanta iti| tiṣṭhad‌gu, vahad‌gu, āyatīgavamityetairapyasya sambandhaḥ; anyathā kālaśabdatvāyogāt| cakāro'vadhāraṇārtha iti| anekārthatvānnipātānām| aparaḥ samāso na bhavatīti| vṛttyantaraṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| `ātiṣṭhadgujapansadhyām' iti tu pañcamyā `avyayāt' iti luk, na samāsaḥ| tiṣṭhad‌gu, vahadgviti| laṭaḥ śatrādeśo nipātanāt, `gostriyoḥ' iti hrasvaḥ| āyatīvagamityatra tu puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ śatrādeśayaḥ samāsantaśca| khaleyavaṃ khalebusamiti saptamyā aluk| lūyamānayavādiṣu śānajādeśaḥ| samabhūmi, samapadātīti|| samatvaṃ bhūmeriti pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| kacit samaṃbhūmi samaṃpadātīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra pūrvapadasya mumāgamaḥ. anye tu saṃbhūmi saṃpadātīti paṭhanti, tatra samasyāntalopaḥ, saṃśabdasya vā samāsaḥ| suṣāmādau śobhanatvaṃ samasya vigatatvaṃ duṣṭatvaṃ nirgatatvamapagatatvaṃ samasyeti| vigrahaḥ| āyatosamā āyatīsamam, śatrādeśaḥ, pūrvavat puṃvadbhāvaśca | samā - saṃvatsaraḥ| evaṃ pāpasamaṃ puṇyasamamiti| prāhvādiṣu caturṣu pragatatvamahna ityādivigrahaḥ| saṅgataṃ pratigatamasya samprati| viparītam asamprati| ic karmavyatīhāra iti| ayameva dvidaṇḍyādiṣvapi vidhīyata iti tatrāpyavyayībhāvaḥ. daṇḍādaṇḍīti| daṇḍeśca daṇḍaiśca prahṛtyedaṃ yudhdaṃ pravṛttam, `tatra tenedamiti sarūpe' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ| ica avyayībhāvatvenāvyayatvātsupo luk||

18 pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā || 2-1-18 ||
vāvacanāditi| nanu mahāvibhāṣayaivāpavāde'vyayībhāve vikalpite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī samāso'pi bhaviṣyati, so'pi vikalpita iti vākyamapi bhaviṣyati? ucyate--iha vākyenābhidhāne prāpte vṛttirārabhyamāṇā vākyasya bādhikā prāpnotīti vikalpena vākyameva pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate| tatrāpavādavikalpo vākyasyaiva prāpaka ityutsargasya nityo bādhakaḥ syād, vāvacanātso'pi pakṣe'bhyanujñāyata iti trairūpyasidhdiḥ| etadeva vāvacanaṃ jñapakam--yatrotsargāpavādau mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpitau tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na bhavatīti| tena pūrvaṃ kāyasyetyatraikadeśisamāsena mukte ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati, dakṣasyāpatyaṃ dākṣirityatra iñā mukte'ṇna bhavati| ekārāntatvanipātanaṃ yatra saptamyartho na sambhavatipāregaṅgādānayeti, tadartham| mbave tu `tutpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' iti bahulavacanādalukā sidhdam ||

19 saṃkhyā vaṃśyena || 2-1-19 ||
ekalakṣaṇa iti| ekasvabhāvaḥ santānaḥ - sambandhaḥ, santānināmekalakṣaṇatvātsantānasyaikalakṣaṇatvam| dvau munī iti| pāṇinikātyāyanau| trimunīti| tau ca bhāṣyakāraśca| janmanā tvekalakṣaṇasyodāharaṇam‌-ekaviṃsati bhāradvājamiti| yadā tu vidyayā saheti `lakṣaṇenābhipratī' ityatra prakārāntareṇāpyayamarthaḥ sādhitaḥ ||

20 nadībhiśca || 2-1-20 ||
nadīvacanaiḥ śabdairiti| nadībhiriti bahuvacananirdeśātsvarūpasya saṃjñā nadyāśca grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| samāhāre cāyamiṣyata iti| anyathā purastādapavādanyāyena `pūrvakālaika' ityasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ syāt| samāhāre tu paratvād dviguheva syāt, tataścaikanadītyatrāvyayībhāve sati tannibandhanaḥ `nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ' iti ṭac prāpnoti napuṃsakatvaṃ ca, na hyatra viśeṣavācināmeva grahaṇamiti pramāṇamasti| yastu `godāvaryāśca nadyaśca' ityac samāsāntaḥ, sa pañcanadamityādāvavyayībhāva eva bhavati, ekanadītyatra tatpuruṣe na bhavati| samāhāravivakṣāyāṃ ca ekāpūpīvadekanadamityapi bhavati| tathānyapadārthe'pyavyayībhāvaḥ syād dvīrāvatīko deśa iti| na cātra paratvādvahuvrīhiḥ; aśeṣatvāt, na hyasati samāhāragraṇe'yaṃ śeṣo bhavati| tasmātsuṣṭhūktam - samāhare cāyamiṣyata iti| etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate||

21 anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām || 2-1-21 ||

22 tatpuruṣaḥ || 2-1-22 ||
uttarapadārthapradhāna iti| pūrvākāyaḥ, ardhdapippalītyādau tvadhikāra vaśāttatpuruṣa iti saṃjñā||

23 dviguśca || 2-1-23 ||
samāsāntā iti| yadyapi `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' `tatpuruṣasyāṃguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' iti ṭajacau tatpuruṣanibandhanau, tathāpi prakṛtibhedādbhedavivakṣayāṃ vahuvacanam| pañcarājamiti| ukattarapadasyānakārāntatvātstrītvābhāvaḥ. samāsārthottarapadasyāntāḥ samāsāntā iti tu pakṣe pātrāditvāt| kvacat pañcarājīti strīlṅgasya pāṭhaḥ, sa bhāṣyavirodhādapapāṭhaḥ| dvyaha iti| 1`ahnaṣṭakhoreva' iti ṭilopaḥ, `rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi'| pañcagavamiti| `goratadhditaluki' iti ṭac, pūrvavatstrītvābhāvaḥ||

24 dvitīyāḥ śritātītapatitagatātyastaprāptāpannaḥ || 2-1-24 ||
śritādiṣu gatyarthatvātkarttari ktaḥ| patirapi sakarmakaḥ, nejjihmāyanto narakaṃ patāmeti yathā| atyāsaḥ - vyatikramaḥ, gativiśeṣa eva| prāptirapyatra gatireva, na phalam| evamāpattirapi| iha śritapatitagatairayaṃ sāso na vidheyaḥ, katham? yaḥ kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ kaṣṭaṃ tena śritaṃ bhavati tatra bahuvrīhiṇā sidhdam; nārthabhedaḥ, na rūpabhedaḥ, na svarabhedaḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi `ahīnedvitīyā' iti śritapatitāgebhyaḥ purvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| atītādibhistu svarasidhdaye vidheyaḥ, tathā hi- taistatpuruṣe thāthādisvareṇa bhāvyam, nāhīnasvareṇa; `atītātyastayorahīne' iti niṣedhāt, prāptāpannayostvahīne dvitīyānupasarga iti vacanāt| bahuvrīhau tu pūrvapadaprakṛtitasvareṇa bhāvyam, tasmācchritādibhirayaṃ samāso na vidheyaḥ| tatrāyamabyarthaḥ, `ahīne dvitīyā' ityetadapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| jātisvaraprasaṅgastu, yadā jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ pare śritādayo bhavanti tadā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā `jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt' ityantodāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu ca tatpuruṣārambho'pi bahuvrīhyarthavivakṣāyāṃ na daṇḍavārito bahuvrīhiriti jātisvaraḥ syādeva? evamapyasti bhedaḥ, tatpuruṣe `ahīne dvitīyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, bahuvrīho `jātikāla' ityantodāttatvamiti dvausvarau bhavataḥ; anārambhe tu jātisvara eva syāditi| evaṃ tarhi yadetadvā jāta iti tadvā jātaśritapatitagateṣviti vaktavyam? evamapi `ahīne dvitīyā' ityetadapi na vaktavyamityastyeva lāghavam| etāvām̐stu viśeṣaḥ - tatpuruṣārambhe tatra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, bahuvrīhau tu jātisvara iti dvayoḥ samāsayordvaisvaryam; anārambhe tu bahuvrīhāveva dvaisvaryamiti? atrocyate - jātikālasukhādivyatiriktaiḥ saha bahuvrīhau śritādīnāṃ niṣṭheti pūrvanipādaprasaṅgādrūpabhetaḥ, tathā sarvatra kabapi prāpnoti| nanvasau `śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti vikalpitaḥ, sa ca tatpuruṣārambhe'pi bhavatyeva, bahuvrīherapyabhyupagamāt? evamapi bahuvrīhāvapi dvaisvaryābhyupagamātpurvapadaprakṛtisvarapakṣe'pi bahuvrīhitvānapāyātpakṣe kapaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; tatpuruṣārambhe tu tatraiva `ahīne dvanitāyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, bahuvrīhau tu jātisvara eva nityamityantodāttādeva kabna pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarādityastyeva viśeṣaḥ| tathā'rthabhejo'pi `gatyarthākarmaka' iti kartari kto dhātvarthasya sarvātmanā'niṣṭhitatve'pi bhavati - āruḍho vṛkṣaṃ devadatta iti vṛkṣasya evocyate| karmaṇi tu bhavansarvātmanā niṣṭhtatve bhavati - ārūḍho vṛkṣo devadatteneti, tathehāpi kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti kaṣṭamanubhavannevamucyate, kaṣṭaṃ śritamanenetyanubhūtakaṣṭaḥ śritaśabadavivakṣitasyārthasya sākṣādavagatirbhavati tatpuruṣe| bahuvrīhau tvarthāt, tadyathā - rājñaḥ sakhetyukte nūnaṃ hājāpyasya sakheti sa eṣa sūkṣmadṛśāmeva viṣayaḥ| gamigāmyādīnāmiti| uṇādīnāmanyeṣāṃ ca saṃgrahārthamubhayorupādānam| grāmaṃ gamīti| `gameriniḥ' ityauṇādika inipratyayaḥ `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' iti bhaviṣyati kāle| grāmaṃ gāmīti| āvaśyake ṇini| `gatyārthakarmaṇi' ityatra dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānārthamiti kṛtprayoge dvitīyaiva bhavati| oganaṃ bubhukṣuriti| bhujeḥ san, `sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ'| `na lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ||

25 svayaṃ ktena || 2-1-25 ||
`dhāvu gatiśudhdyoḥ', `udito vā' iti ktvāyāṃ vikalpiteṭ‌tvāt `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' ityūṭh, `etyedatyūṭhsu' iti vṛdhdiḥ| svayaṃvilīnamiti| `līṅ śleṣaṇe', `svādayaoditaḥ', `oditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam, kṛdayrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇādvilīnaśabdaḥ ktāntaḥ| aikapadyamaikasvarye samāsatvāditi| samasanaṃ samāsaḥ, saṃjñā vā, tato hetorityarthaḥ ||

26 khaṭvā kṣepe || 2-1-26 ||
khaṭvārohaṇaṃ catyādi| vinindito mārgaḥ - vimārgaḥ| bhūmiśayanārho brahmacārī, vedādhyayanakāle tenādhītya snātvā gurubhiranujñātena khaṭvā roḍhavyā| yattvanyathā khaṭvārohaṇaṃ tadvimārgaprasthānam| taccodāharaṇamanyasyāpyevaṃvidhasyopalakṣaṇam, tena khaṭvāmārohatu mā vā'rukṣadvimārgaprasthitaḥ khaṭvārūḍha ityucyata ityarthaḥ|

27 sāmī || 2-1-27 ||
tasyāsattvavācitvāditi| dravyādhārā hi karmaśaktiḥ; ato dravyavācina eva dvitāyā bhavati, nādravyavācina ityarthaḥ||

28 kālāḥ || 2-1-28 ||
iha `kālā atyantasaṃyoge' ityeko yogaḥ karttavyaḥ, tatra `ktena' ityasya nivṛttatvātsarvatra samāsaḥ sidhdyati, kimarthaṃ yogavibhāge ktāntena samāso vidhīyata ityata āha - anatyantasaṃyogārtha vacanamiti| anatyantasaṃyogameva darśayati - ṣaṇmuhūrttā iti| carācarā iti| careḥ pacādyaci `caricalipativadīnāmupasaṃkhyānamāk cābhāyāsasya' iti dvirvacanamāgāgamaścābhyāsasyeti| caranto'navasthitā ityarthaḥ| kadācidahariti| uttarāyaṇe| kadācidrātrimiti| dakṣiṇāyane| tatastaiśca ṣaḍbhirmuhūrtairahno rātreśca nāstyatyantasaṃyogaḥ| māsapramita iti| māṅa ādikarmaṇi karttari ktaḥ, māsaṃ paricchettumārabdhavānityarthaḥ| pratipaccandramā iti| na ca tena māsasyātyantasaṃyoga iti bhāvaḥ||

29 atyantasaṃyoge ca || 2-1-29 ||

30 tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena || 2-1-30 ||
tṛtīyāyāśchandase luki `gūṇavacanena' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyam| artheneti pṛthak padam, ata eva guṇavacanenārthaśabdena ceti| kīdṛśena guṇavacanena? tatkṛteneti| taditi sarvanāmnā prakṛtasya tṛtīyāntasya pratyavamarśaḥ, sa ca śabdaḥ| na ca śabdena guṇavacanasya karaṇaṃ sambhavatītyataḥ sāmarthyāttadarthakṛteneti vijñāyata ityāha - tṛtīyāntārthakṛteneti| yāvaditi| yāvacchabado nipātastātparyaparyāyatāṃ darśayati| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ guṇavacanasya viśeṣayaṇam, artha eva hi tṛtīyārthena kriyate, na guṇavacanaḥ śabdaḥ| vacanagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvārthena samāsāsambhavād guṇavacanevaiva bhaviṣyati? evaṃ yathā vijñāyetaguṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭaḍo bahulam' iti lakṣito gṛhyate, na tu yasya guṇasya hi bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśa iti tacchabdapravṛttinimittam; tṛtāyāntārthakṛte sarvatraiva tasya bhāvāt| śaṃkulākhaṇḍaḥ, kirikāṇa iti| `khaḍi bhedane', `kaṇa nimīlane' ityābhyāṃ ghañi vyutpāditāvetau kriyārūpāpanne gaṇe varttitvānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tdavati dravye vartteta iti guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| dhānyenārtha iti| arthyata ityarthaḥ - prayojanam, arthanaṃ vārthaḥ - prārthanā, abhilāṣaḥ| sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyāyāḥ samāsaḥ| akṣṇā kāṇa iti| nātrākṣṇatm, kiṃ tarhi? anyenaiva kenāpi kiryādinā, akṣṇā tu kevalaṃ kāṇo lakṣyata iti tatkṛtatvābhāvaḥ| kiṃca daghnā paṭunityatra mā bhūdityevamarthamapi tatkṛtagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| nanu yadi dadhikṛtaṃ pāṭavaṃ vivakṣitam - dadhnā kṛtaḥ paṭuriti, tato bhavitavyameva samāsena; atha bhojanādyapekṣo dadhnaḥ karaṇabhāvaḥ - dadhnā bhuṅkte paṭuriti, tato'sāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati? ihāpi tarhi na syāt - kuṃkumena lohitaṃ kopenaṃ mukhamiti, atrāpi hi korotikriyayā karaṇsaya sambandhaḥ - kuṃkumena kṛtaṃ lohitāmiti| kva tarhi syāt? śaṃkulayā khaṇḍa ityādāveva tu syāt, yatra pūrvottarapadayoḥ kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ| tasmādyatrottarapade kriyā na gamyate tatrāpi tatkṛtatve sati yathā syādbhojanādidvārake sāmarthye mā bhūditi tatkṛtagrahaṇam| guṇavacaneneti kimiti| jātivacaneṣu jāternityatvāttatkṛtasyāsambhavaḥ| kriyāvacane tviṣyata eva| `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti dravyavāciṣvapi tatkṛtasyāsambhava eva| na hyākāśasya tattvaṃ kenacit kriyate, ato guṇavacanenaiva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| gobhirvapāvāniti| gosambandhidadhyādyupayogādeva tasya vapāvattvaṃ pūvaratvamityasti tatkṛtatvam, na tvasau guṇavacanaḥ||

31 pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ || 2-1-31 ||
pūrvasūtre'rthaśabdena samāsasya sādhtatvādihārthagrahaṇamarthanirdeśārtam| taccānantareṇonaśabdenaiva sambadhyate, na pūrvādibhiḥ; samasadṛśabdayoḥ pṛthagupādānāt| etadevetyādi| samasadṛśaśabdābhyāmnyatredaṃ tadyoge tulyārthairiti tṛtīyāsti| iha tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭhyapi pakṣe vidhīyate, tatastasyāḥ samāse mātuḥ sadṛśo mātṛsadṛśa iti sidhdam, kimarthamiha sadṛśagrahaṇam? `tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro yathā syāt, sidhdo'tra prakṛtisvaraḥ - `satṛśapratirūpayoḥ sādṛśye' iti | tacca tatra sadṛśagrahaṇamavaśyaṃ karttavyam, yadā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastadāntodāttatvaṃ mā bhūditi| nanu cedānīmanabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam, anuksamāse hi doṣaḥ syāt,
`ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe' - dāsyāḥ sadṛśaḥ, vṛṣalyāḥ sadṛśa iti, tasmāttatkartavyam, idaṃ tu na karttavyam? idamapi karttavyam, hetutṛtīyārthaṃ vidyayā hetunā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti, na hyatra `tulyārthaiḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, pratiyoginyeva hi sā vidhīyate| evamapi na karttavyam - tatkṛtatatvātpurveṇaiva sidhdam, yo hi vidyayā sadṛśaḥ, vidyākṛtaṃ hi tatsādṛśyam, tatra pūrveṇaiva sidhdam| `miśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇam' guḍasaṃmiśrā dhānā ityevamartham? jñāpakātsidhdam, yadayaṃ `miśraṃ cānupasargamasandhau' ityanupasargagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati - miśragrahaṇe sopasargasyāpi grahaṇamiti| pūrvādiṣviti| avaraśabdo'pi sūtre paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ||

32 kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam || 2-1-32 ||
`kartṛkaraṇe' iti prathamādvivacanam| vṛttau vastuvyākhyānaṃ kṛtam - karttari karaṇe ca yā tṛtīyeti| tathā cottaratra vakṣyati `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtyaiḥ sahādhikārthavacane samasyete' iti| parvopādhivyabhicārārthamiti| avyāptyativyāptiparihārthamityarthaḥ| pādahāraka iti| hriyata iti hāraka iti `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karmaṇi ṇvul, pādābhyāmityapādānapañcamyantasya samāsaḥ| gale copaka iti| `cupa mandāyoṃ gatau', hetumaṇṇijantātkarmaṇi ṇvul, `amūrdhdamastakāt' yatyulk| kṛdrahaṇamanartakam; anyasyābhāvāt| iha kartṛkaraṇa kriyāyā eva bhavataḥ kriyā ca dhātuvcyā, dhtośca dvaye pratyayāḥ - kṛtastiṅaśca| tatra supetyadhikārāttiṅante na prasaṅgaḥ| tadvitanivṛtyarthaṃ tu - iha kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatitarām, kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatirūpam, kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatideśyam, hastena kṛtapūrvī, dadhnā bhuktapūrvī, dhṛteneṣṭīti||

33 kṛtyairadhikāryavacane || 2-1-33 ||
stutinindāprayuktamiti| stutyā nindayā ca pravarttitaṃ stotuṃ ninditaṃ ca kṛtamityarthaḥ| adhyāropitārthavacanamiti| asannevāropito'dhyāropitaḥ| kākapeyeti| evaṃ nāma pūrṇatoyā nadī yattaṭasthaiḥ kākairapi śakyā pātumiti stutiḥ; evaṃ nāmālpatoyā catkākairapi śakyā pātumiti nindā; ubhayatra śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| śvalehya iti| evaṃ nāmāśuciḥ kūpo yajjalaṃ śvāna eva leḍhumarhantīti nindā; ahrārthe kṛtyaḥ| bāṣpacchedyānīti| evaṃ nāma komalāni tṛṇāni yadvāṣpeṇāpi chettuṃ śakyānīti stutiḥ; evaṃ nāma kathitāni tṛṇāni yadvāṣpeṇāpi chettuṃ śakyānīti nindā| kaṇṭakasaṃceya iti| evaṃ nāma klinna odano yatkaṇṭakaiḥ śakyaḥ saṃcetumiti stutiḥ; evaṃ nāmālpa odano yatkaṇṭakaiḥ saṃcīyata iti nindā| pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti| yadyapi stutinindāparatvātkriyopādānasya kartṛkaraṇayorgauṇatvam, tathāpi bahulavacanātpūrveṇaiva sidhdam, tathā ca kākapītā nadātyatrākṛtyairapyadhikārthavacanaiḥ samāso dṛśyate, ataḥ prapañca evāyam, nāprāptavidhiḥ, nāpi niyama ityarthaḥ||

34 annena vyañjanam || 2-1-34 ||
dadhyodana iti| nanu ca neha kriyā śrūyate, na cāntareṇa kriyāṃ dravyāṇāṃ paraspareṇa sambandha ityasāmarthyādatra samāso na prāpnoti, athāsapyapi sāmarthye vacanāpsamāsaḥ? ihāpi tarhi syāt - kiṃ dadhnā, odano bhūjyatāmiti, tatrāha - vṛttau kriyāyā antarbhāvāditi| svabhāvādeva vṛttāvantarbhūtā kriyeti tad‌dvārakasya sambandhasya sadbhāvātsāmarthyamityarthaḥ||

35 bhakṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam || 2-1-35 ||
kharaviśadamiti| kharam - kaṭhinam, vibhaktāvayavam; kharaṃ ca tadviśadaṃ ca kharaviśadam, hanucalanenādanīyamityarthaḥ| yadabhyavahāryaṃ tadbhakṣyamityucyate; tatraiva yadantasya erajantasya ca bhakṣayate rūḍhatvāt| bhakṣayatistvanyatrāpi bhavati-abbhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣa iti| gauṇo'tra bhakṣayatirityanye ||

36 caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣatai || 2-1-36 ||
arthaḥ parābhṛśyata iti| yadyapi caturthīti caturthyantaḥ śabdaḥ sannihitaḥ, tathāpi śabdaṃ prati tādarthyāsambhāvāttadartha eva parāmṛśyate ityarthaḥ| ityetaiḥ śabdaiḥ saheti| tatra tadarthena subantenetyarthadhdarakaṃ viśeṣamam, svarūpeṇa subantasya tādarthyāsambhavāt| dvitīyastvarthaśabdaḥ pṛthageva nibhattam| prakṛtivikārabhāve samāsa iṣyata iti| jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati - vikṛtiścaturthyantā prakṛtyā samasyata iti; anyathā kuberabaliḥ, gorakṣitamityatrāpi tādarthyasambhavādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| hitasukhagrahaṇaṃ tu `hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā', `caturthī cāśiṣi' ityatādarthye'pi caturthīsambhavānna jñāpakam| yadi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtyā samasyate - aśvebhyo ghāsaḥ, aśvebhyaḥ surā 'śvasuram, `vibhāṣāsenā' iti napuṃsakatvam, hastibhyo vidhā hastividhā, vidhā - annaviśeṣaḥ; atra na prāpnoti? aśvaghāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā bhaviṣyanti| nanu svare viśeṣo bhavati caturthīsamāse hi sati `caturthī tadartha' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bhāvyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu samāsāntodāttatvena? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; caturthīsamāse'pi naiva pūrvapadaprakṛti svareṇa bhāvyam; jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ `kte ca' iti caturthyantaṃ pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatityāha, tajjñāpayati - prakṛtivikārabhāvābhāva eṣa svaro na bhavatīti; anyathā gorakṣitamityatrāpi `caturthī tadartha' ityeva sidhderanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| naitadasti jñāpakam; hitārthametatsyāt - gohitamityatra hi tādarthyaṃ nāsti| evamapi `hite ca' iti vaktavye `kte ca' iti sāmnyavacanaṃ jñāpakameva, sarvathā kuberavalirityāda au mā bhūdityevamartha prakṛtivikārabhāve svara eṣitavyaḥ| atha randhanāya sthālītyatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kasmānna bhavati? kaścidāha bhavatyeva, tadyathā - gogrāsaḥ, lālāmbujam, krīḍāsaraḥ, vāsabhavanam, nāṭyaśāleti| apara āha - randhanasthālyādayo'nabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa na bhavantīti| ubhāvapi pratibrūmaḥ yeṣu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣyate teṣu caturthīsamāsa evāstu, yeṣu tu neṣyate teṣu tu caturthīsamāsa evānabhidhānānneṣyatām, mākārijñāpanārthaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇam, svarastu caturthīsamāse'pi pūrvoktena prakāreṇa prakṛtivikārabhāva eva vyavasthāsyate| kiṃ caivaṃ sati sūtremevaitadanarthakam, yūpadārvādāvapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāstu, `caturthī tadartha' ityetattu `ṣaṣṭhī tadartha' iti kriyatām, jñāpakācca svarasya vyavasthā kriyatm| nanvarthabheda| bhavati-ṣaṣṭhīsamāse sambandhamātraṃ gamyate, caturthīsamāse tu tādarthyaṃ sambandhaviśeṣaḥ? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ, ārabhyamāṇe'pi caturthīsamāse na daṇḍavārita- ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tatrārthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣo'vaseyaḥ| yadyevam, kevale'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tathā viśeṣo'vasaṃsyate, kiñca sidhdante'śvavaghāsādiṣu tāvadarthaprakaraṇādinā tādarthyavisāyaḥ sarvatraiva tathāstu, nārthau'nena? ucyate-hitaśabdena tāvatṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati; tadyoge caturtyā nityatvāditi caturthīsamāsa eva vaktavyaḥ| tataśca `kte ca' ityatrāpi caturthīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ gohitamityādyartham| evaṃ ca gorakṣitamityatra na syāt, caturthyā asambhavāt| `ṣaṣṭhī tadartha' ityasya cāprasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtivikārābhāvāditi rakṣitenāpi caturthīsamāsa eva vidheyaḥ| arthaśabdenāpi yoge tādarthyasaṃbavdhaviśeṣasyaniyamena pratīyamānatvāccaturthyā sambhavitavyamiti nenāpi caturthīsamāsa eva cartavyaḥ| balisukhagrahaṇamapi karttavyam, tādarthyasya samāse niyamena pratītiryathā samayādityevamartham| tasmādāravdhavyameva sūtram| prakṛtivkārabhāva eva samāsa ityasya tu prayojanaṃ cintyam| arthena nityasamāsavacanamiti| anthā mahāvibhāṣādhikārād brāhmaṇāyārtha iti vākyamapi syāt| sarveliṅgatā ceti| paraliṅgatāyā apavādaḥ, abhideyavaśena ca sarvaliṅgatā na sarvatreti darśayati| brāhmaṇārthe paya ityādi| sarthabiti cet, itsaṃjñābhāvaḥ, iyaṅuvaṅprasaṅśca| syādetat - tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtāvityatra tadarthe sarthaviti sūtraṃ kartavyam, caturthī vartate, caturthasimarthāttadarthe'bhidheye sarthappratyayo bhavati, sakāraḥ padasaṃjñārthaḥ - rājārthaḥ, gavārthaḥ, pittvādanudāttatvam; evaṃ cārtha iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na vidheyaḥ, pratyayatvācca na tena vigrahaḥ, tadhditatvāccābhidheyavalliṅgatā sidhdyatīti? tanna; sakārasyetsaṃjñābhāvaprasaṅgāt| atha `ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ' `ṣaḥ pratyayasya' iti dviṣakārakanirdeśāśrayaṇenetsaṃjñā syād? evamapi vuñchaṇādiṣu tṛṇādibhyaḥ se prasaṅgaḥ, śryartham bhvarthamityatra ceyaṅuvaṅau syātām, bahuvrīhāvātvakapoḥ prasaṅgaḥ| syaidetat - yadbrāhmaṇārthaḥ payastasya brāhmaṇo'rthaḥ prayojaka iti śakyate vaktum, ato brāhmaṇo'rtho'syeti vigṛhya bahuvrīhiḥ kariṣyate, tena caturthyantena | vigrahābhāvaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvamabhidheyavannaṅgatā ca sidhdyatīti? tanna; mahadarthamityatratvakapoḥ prasaṅgāt| tadarthasyārthādeśa udabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat - `caturthī tadartha' ityanena samāsaṃ vidhāyārtha ityanenāśena tadarthavācana uttarapadasyārthaśabda ādeśo vidhīyate, vibhāṣādhikārācca yūpārthaṃ dāru yūpadārvituyabhayaṃ bhāviṣyati, tato balirakṣitayorapi vibhāṣārthaśabda ādeśo bhavati kuberārtho baliḥ kuberabalirityādi| kimarthamidam, pūrveṇaiva sidhdam? jñāpakārtham, etaj jñāpayati - prakṛtivikārābhāvādanyatra nityo'rthādeśa iti| tena randhanārthā sthālītyādi bhavati, na tu randhanasthālītyādi| aśvaghāsādayastu pūrvavat| atra samāse kṛte uttarapadasya vidhīyamānenārthaśabdena vigraho na bhaviṣyati, yasyāvasthāne'rthādeśastalliṅgatā sthānivadbhādhena bhaviṣyati, arta iti pūrvapradaprakṛtisvarastu vidheya eveti, tanna; udakārtho vīvadha iti vīvadhaśabdasyārthādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena manthaudanādisūtreṇodabhāvaprasaṅgāt| ataścaturthīsamāsa eva vidhayaḥ| tathā cārtena nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā? na vaktavyā, brāhmaṇāyeti caturthyā tādarthyasyoktatvādarthaśabdena vigraro na bhaviṣyati| `liṅgamaśaiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti karvaliṅgatā ca sidhdā|
tadetatpratipadyantāṃ bhāṣye kṛtapariśramāḥ|
nānye sahastramapyandhāḥ sūryaṃ paśyanti nāñjasā||

37 pañcamī bhayena || 2-1-37 ||
bheyeneti svarūpagrahaṇādavyāptiriti matvā''ha -- bhayabhībhītibhībhiriti vaktavyamiti| evaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāttvarthagraṇe `vṛkebhyastrāsaḥ' ityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| sa tarhi tathā nyāsaḥ kartavya? netyāha - pūrvasyaiva bahulagrahaṇasyeti| yathā hi `pādahārakaḥ' ityādai bahulagrahaṇātsarvepādhivyabhicārārthādbhavati, evamatrāpi bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ| adhamajugupsuriti `jugupsāvirāma' ityadharmasyāpādānasaṃjñā||

38 apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ || 2-1-38 ||
alpaśabdād `bahvalpārthāt' iti śasa, `śasi bahvalpārthasya' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| kārakatvaṃ tu samasanakriyāyāṃ karmatvāt| ata eva pañcamī samasyata iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| tatra tu bahvalpārthānmaṅgale vacanamiti vakṣyati| tasmādata eva nipādanādatra śasati yuktam| alpā pañcamīti| alpābhyaḥ prakatṛtibhya utpannetyarthaḥ|

39 stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena || 2-1-39 ||

40 saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ || 2-1-40 ||
atra sāhacaryād dhūrttādiṣvajahatsvārtha eva śauṇaḍaśabdaḥ prayujyate, yathā - chattriṇo gacchantīti| atra ca pramāṇaṃ bahuvacananirddeśaḥ, ate'ntareṇāpyādiśabdaṃ tadartho gamyate ityāha - śauṇhādibhiriti| gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāttu bahuvacananirdeśo'rthanirdeśāryaḥ, bahuvacanāntasya vā samāsārtha iti na cānyatsaptamyā nimttamasti| na caitadeva jñāpakaṃ śakyamāśrayitum; śauṇḍo devadatta ityādāvapi prasaṅgād, ata āha - vṛttāviti| antaḥśabdo'tra paṭhyate, tadyoge'vayavina ādhāratvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī, yathā vṛkṣe śākheti, vane'ntarvanāntaḥ| asya vikalpitatvādavyayībhāvo'pi bhavati, antarvaṇam, `pranirantaḥ' iti ṇatvam| adhiśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tasyāvikaraṇaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ - adhisat‌rīti| ādheyaprādhānye hyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ - brāhmaṇādhaīnamiti| `adyuttarapadātkhaḥ' iti khaḥ| brāhmaṇeṣvadhīti vākyam||

41 sidhdaśuṣkapakvandhaiśca || 2-1-41 ||
sāṅkāśyasidhdiḥ kāmpilyasidhda iti| saṅkāśena nirvṛttaṃ vanaṃ sāṅkāyam| kampilena nirvṛttaṃ kāmpilyam| cāturthikaḥ saṅkāśādibhyoṇyaḥ tatra tapasā sidhda ityarthaḥ||

42 dhvāṅkṣeṇa || 2-1-42 ||
`svaṃ pūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanātparyāyāṇāṃ na prāpnetītya āha - dhvāṅkṣeṇetyarthagrahaṇamiti| vyākhyānāccaitadavasīyate| tīrthe dhvāṅkṣa iveti| upamānopamoyabhāve sati kṣepo gamyate, nānyathetīvaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| yathā tīrthe dhvāṅkṣā na ciraṃ sthātāro bhavanti, evaṃ kāryeṣvanavasthitastīrthadhvāṅkṣa irtarthaḥ, tadāha - anavasthita ityartha iti| vṛttau tvivārthasyāntarbhāvādivaśabdsayāprayogaḥ||

43 kṛtyairṛṇe || 2-1-43 ||
yatpratyayāntenaiveṣyate iti | `alpaśaḥ' ityanuvṛtteretallabhyate| kṛtyairiti bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibheprāyam| ṛṇagrahaṇaṃ ca niyogopalakṣaṇārthamiti| niyogaḥ - avaśyambhāvaḥ| ṛṇamavaśyadeyamiti niyogasāhacaryānniyogamātramupalakṣayati| tena kiṃ sidhdaṃ bhavatītyāha - ihāpīti| pūrvāhṇogeyamiti| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityuluk| yathā ṛṇamavaśyaṃ deyam, evamidamapi pūrvāhṇe'vaśyaṃ geyamiti niyogo'sti||

44 saṃjñāyām || 2-1-44 ||

45 ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ || 2-1-45 ||
divā vṛttamiti| aikapadyamaikasvaryaṃ ca na bhavati| nanu ca divāśabdo'dhikaramaśaktipradhānaḥ tatrabhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sampanna iti prathamaivāsmādbhavati, ataḥ saptamyabhāvādevātrāprasaṅgaḥ| naiṣo'sti niyamaḥ - adhikaraṇaktipradhāna iti; divāmanyā rātrirityapi darśanāt| kathaṃ `rātrivṛttamanuyoktumudyata' iti? `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti manyate| evaṃ cānyajanmakṛtamityādyapi bhavati||

46 tatra || 2-1-46 ||
tatretyetatsaptamyantamiti| tatrabhavānityādau vibhaktyantare'pi darśanādadhrakaṇapratipādane tatraśabdādapi saptamyevāpekṣyeti manyate||

47 kṣepe || 2-1-47 ||
avataptenakulasthitaṃ tavaitaditi cirantanaprayogaḥ, tasyārthamāha - cāpalametattavetyartha iti| yathā avatapte pradeśe nakulā na ciraṃ kthātāro bhavanti, evaṃ kāryāṇyārabhyayaścāpalena na ciraṃ tiṣṭhati sa evamucyata ityartaḥ| `kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti nakulasthitaśabdena samāsaḥ, pūrvavadaluk||

48 pātresamitādayaśca || 2-1-48 ||
yuktārohyādiparigragarthamiti| yuktārohyādayaścetyatraiṣāmapi parigraho yathā syādityarthaḥ| pratra eva samitā iti| bhojanasamaya eva saṅgatā ityarthaḥ| pātrebahulā iti| bhojanasamaya eva saṅghībhavanti, nānyakārya ityarthaḥ| ubumbaramaśakādiṣviti| yastatraiva tṛpto nāsmātparamastīti manyate, so'yamadṛṣṭavistāraḥ puruṣa udumbaramaśakādirucyata ityarthaḥ| pratiṣidhdasevaneneti| śatruṣu bhāryāyāṃ vā puruṣāyitavyam, mātari puruṣāyitaṃ pratiṣidhdap| nirīhatayeti| piṇḍī - odanapiṇḍaḥ, tatraiva śūro nānyatreti nirīhatā| paramapātresamitā iti| evaṃrūpaṃ vṛttyantaraṃ na bhavati, paramāḥ pātresamitā iti vākyameva bhavatītyarthaḥ||

49 pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāḥ samānādhikaraṇena || 2-1-49 ||
bhinnapravṛttinimittasyetyādi| bhinnagrahaṇaṃ paryānivṛttyartham| ekagrahaṇaṃ gauraśca ityādinivṛttyartham| kvacid bhinnanmittaprayuktasyeti pāṭhaḥ, bhinnena nimittena pravṛttinimittena pravarttitasyetyarthaḥ| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' iti sidhde pūrvakālādīnāṃ pūrvanipātārthaṃ vacanam, ekaśabdasya tu `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti niyamātprāptyarthameva| pūrvakāla ityarthagrahaṇamiti| pūrvaḥ kālo'sya pūrvakālaḥ, pūrvamanuṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| sa ca caramānuṣṭhitamapekṣya bhavatītyarthāttenaiva samāso vijñāyata ityāha - parakāleneti| snātānulipta iti| pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanulipta ityarthaḥ| atra kriyāśabdatvātpācakapāṭhakādivatpūrvanipātaḥ paryāyātsyāt| ekaśāṭiti| śāṭaśabdājjatilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ, `ekatadhdite ca' iti hrasvaḥ| sarvamanuṣya iti| atra viśeṣaṇamityapi samese na doṣaḥ, tasmātkriyāvācināṃ kūṇavācināṃ vā samāso darśanīyaḥ| evaṃ jaradādiṣvapi ekasyāḥ śāṭīti| atra bhavitavyameva ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena, tasmādekarasyāḥ śauklyagiti pratyudāharttavyam| atra hi guṇena neti pratiṣedhaḥ||

50 diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām || 2-1-50 ||
`viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇa' iti sidhde niyamārthametat - saṃjñāyāmeva ,nānyatreti| pūrvasūtramityādau tvadigvācitvāt samāsaḥ||

51 tadhditārthottarapadasamāhāre ca || 2-1-51 ||
tadhditārthottarapadasamāhāre ca || `viśeṣyeṇa' iti sidhdasya pūrveśāniyamādaprāptavidhirayam| agṛhyamāṇaviṣayatvādvāyamapi niyamaḥ śakyate vaktum - ayaṃ niyamaḥ pūrvo vidhiriti| ekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyata ityāha - tadhditīrthe viṣayabhūta ityādinā| tadhditārthe'bhidheya ityevaṃ tu vijñāyāmāne pāñcanīpitirityādau dadhdito durlabhaḥ syāt; tadarthasya samāmenaivoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| asmin pakṣe'rthagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| dadhdite viṣaya ityevāstu, tadhdite parata iti tu vijñāyamāne itaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti - samāsāttadhdito vidheyaḥ, tadhdite ca samāsa iti| kiñca - `tadhditārthe'bhidheye' ityāsman pakṣe na doṣaḥ, `dvigorlugalapatye' iti lugvacanaṃ jñāpakamutpadyate - dvigostadhdita iti sarvatadhditasādhāraṇo dviguḥ, tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣābhidhaānāya tadhdita utpadyata ityapi śkayaṃ vijñātum| athevaṃ kasmānna vajñāyate - tadhditārthe dvigurbhavati, tadhdito yathā syāditi dvigurbhavatīti, yathādārārthaṃ ghaṭāmahe, dārā yathā syuriti ghaṭāmaha iti? nevaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne dadhditotpattaye vidhīyamānā samāsasaṃjñā viṣayāntare na syāt| evaṃ tasyaiva samāsasya vidhīyamānā dvigusaṃjñāpi, tataśca pañcāratnirityatra igante dvigāviti svaro na syāt, tasya tu samāhāradviguravakāśaḥ, yathā - svare vidhīyamānaḥ parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ ṣatvaṇatvayorna bhavati, tathātrāpi| paurvaśāla iti| pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhava iti tadhditārthe vivakṣate samāsaḥ, tatastadhditaḥ| pūrvaśālāpriya iti| pūrvā śālā priyāsyeti tripade bahuvrīhau priyaśabde uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayostatparuṣe sati samāsāntodāttatvaṃ śālāśabdasya bhavati, asati tvavāntaratatparuṣe satadi samāsāntodāttatvaṃ śālāśabdasya bhavati, asati tvavāntaratatpuruṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa pūrvaśabdasyādyudāttatvamavatiṣṭheta| samāhāre dikśabdo na sambhavatīti| sa hi samūharupatvādbhedanibandhanaḥ, saṃkhyaiva ca bhedamācaṣṭe, dikśabdastu pratyarthaniyataḥ| vibhaktirapi samāse nivarttate| nanu yathā `kākasamūhaḥ' ityatra vibhaktyabhāve'pi bhedāvagatistathātrāpi bhaviṣyati, tasmātprayogābhāvādityevātra heturvaktavyaḥ| pāñcanāpitiriti| pañcānāṃ nīpitānāmapatyamiti samāse, ata iñ| pañcakapāla iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti samāse `saṃskṛta bhakṣāḥ' ityaṇaḥ `dvigorlugalapatye' iti luk| pañcagavadhana iti| pañca gāvo dhavamasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte dhanaśabda uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayostatpuruṣe `goratadhditaluki' iti ṭaci| ayamuttarapade tatpuruṣo mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena prāpnoti, nityo baktavyaḥ; anyathā pañcagodhana ityapi syāt| uktaṃ ca `dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam' iti, vākca dṛṣacca priye asya vāgdṛṣadapriya iti tripadabahuvrīhau pūrvayordvandvaḥ, sa ca nitya iṣyate - nityaṃ samāsānto yathā syāditi| pañcapūliti| pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samāhāra iti vigrahaḥ, na tu pañcapūlāḥ samāhṛtā iti| bhāvasādhano hi samāhāraśabdaḥ - samāharaṇaṃ samāhāraḥ - viprakīrṇānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇam| pañcagrāmaḥ, ṣaṇṇagarī, tripurītyatraikasmin kṣaṇe kriyāyāṃ samanvayādbhinnadeśānāmapi budhdyā rāśokaraṇaṃ bhavati| atha karmasādhane ko doṣaḥ? iha pañcakumārīti, kumāryarthapradhānyātsamāsaśāstre cāpradhamānirddiṣṭatvādekavibhaktitvābhāvāccopasarjanatvābhāvād `gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvo na syāt, kāmamatra nupaṃsakahrasvatvaṃ sidhdam| iha pañca khaṭvāḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcakhaṭvīti vā ṭābanta iti satrīliṅgapakṣe hrasvābhāvād `dvigoḥ' iti ṅīb na syāt| bhāvasādhane tu samāsārthe samāhāre nānāvibhaktibhiryujyamāne'pi kumārīśabdasya nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhyaiva yoga iteyakavibhktikatvātsidhdamupasarjanatvam| tasmādbhāvasādanaḥ| dvigurekavacanamityetattu `sa napuṃsakam' iti vakṣyāmītyāhabhyate, kathaṃ pañcapūlāmānayotyukte pūlānāmānayanam, nāntareṇa dravyānayanaṃ bhāvānayanaṃ sambhavati, yathā nāntareṇa pratrānaynamagnerānayanaṃ sambhavati? evamapi samāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam, bhāvasādhano hi samāhāraśabdaḥ samūhaparyāyayaḥ, samūhaśca tadhditārthastatra `tadhditārtha' ityeva sidhdam| yadyevam, dadhditotpattiḥ prāpnoti? utpadyatāṃ dadhditaḥ, `dvigoḥ' iti lugbhaviṣyati| lukkṛtāni prāpnuvanti, pañcapūlī-`aparimāṇabistācita' iti ṅīpprātiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, `pañcagavam, `goratadvitaluki' iti ṭac na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aparimāṇetyatra na tadhditalukītyapāsya `samāhāra' iti vaktavyam, tanniyamārtham - aviśeṣeṇa dvigoṅībbhavati, aparimāṇāntādvistācitakambalyāntācca samāhāra eveti, pañcānāmaśvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcaśvī| kva mā bhūt? pañcabhiraśvaiḥ krītā pañcāśvā| `goratadvitaluk' ityatrāpyatadhditalukītyapāsya `dvigoḥ samāhāra' iti vaktavyam, tanniyamārtham - gośabdantasya tatpuruṣasyāviśeṣeṇa ṭaj bhavati, dvigostu samāhāra eveti, pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcagavam| kva mā bhūt? pañcabhirgobhiḥ krītaḥ pañcaguḥ paṭaḥ| evamapi pañcakumārītyatra `luk tadhditaluki' iti strīpratyayasya luk prāpnoti| tasmāttadhditanivṛttyartham| samāhāragraṇāttu samāsasyaiva samāhāro vācyaḥ, na tadhditasyeti vyākhyānāttadhdito notpadyata iti sidhdamiṣṭam| iha pañca gāvo'sya santi pañcaguḥ puruṣa iti matvarthamya tadhditārthatvādayaṃ samāsaḥ prāpnoti, na bahuvrīhiḥ; aśeṣatvāt, tasya tu citragvādiravakāśaḥ, yatra diksaṃkhye na staḥ| sati cāsminsamāse matupaḥ śravaṇa syāt| aprāgdīvtīyatvād dvigorlugāpi nāsti| tasmānmatvarthe pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ||

52 saṃkhyāpūrvo dvigaḥ || 2-1-52 ||
kvacidanantaro'pokṣyate, yatraitaducyate - 'anantasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti; kvacitsamudāyaḥ, yathā - `na ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ' ityatra vakṣyate - tasmānnobhāviti, tadiha samudāyo'pekṣte? anantaro vā? iti saṃśaye'nantara ityāha - tadhditārtha ityādi| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ - samudāyāpekṣāyāṃ saṃkhyāpūrvapadasamānādhikaramasamāsamātraparigrahe dvimuni vyākaraṇasyetyavyayībhāvasyāpi syāditīgante dvigāviti svaraprasaṅgaḥ| samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣāpekṣāyāmapi ekaśāṭītyatrāpi syāt| saṃkhyāśabdopādanavihitatpuruṣaparigrahe'pi `diksakhye saṃjñāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇātsaptaraṣaya ityatra dvigusvaraprasaṅgaḥ| yogavibhāgaścānarthakaḥ, `diksakhye saṃjñāyāṃ tadhditārthottarapadasamāhāre' ityekayogaḥ karttavyaḥ syāditi| kathamekāpūpīti? atra hyekaścāsāvapūpaśceti pūrvakāleti samāse kṛte dvigatve sati `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' iti `dvigoḥ' itaīkāraḥ sidhdyati, nānyathā| na caikaśāṭītivajjātiṅīṣnena samāsaḥ sakyatekartum, kevalasyāpūpaśabdasya pūṃlliṅgatvāt? ucyate - atrānantarasūtreṇa samāhāra eva samāsaḥ| nanvanekaviṣayaḥ samāhāro nekasya sambhavati, katham? ehaisamapyapūpaṃ kaścitkṛpaṇo dadadanekaṃ manyate, tathā dānaśradhdātiśayādapūpamahattavādvā'nekasminyaḥ saṃgamastamekasminnapi karoti| anena pratigrahītā kṛpaṇo vyākhyātaḥ, tatraropitabahutvāśrayaḥ samāhāra iti sidhdam ||

53 kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ || 2-1-53 ||
kutsitānīti| `kutsa avakṣepaṇe' matyādisutre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvarttamāne ktaḥ| bahuvacananirdeśādubhayatrārthagrahaṇaṃ na svarūpagrahaṇamityāha - kutsitavācīnīti| vaiyākaraṇakhasūciriti| sūcayateḥ `icca' itīkāraḥ| yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ san praśnaṃ vismārayituṃ khaṃ sūcayati - khaṃ nirīkṣate - aho nirmalaṃ gagalamiti, sa evasucyate| atra vyākaraṇasya vedāṅgasyādhyayanaṃ praśastamapi pratibhānābhāvena niṣphalatvātkutsyate| yājñikakitava iti| kiṃ tavāstīti dhanamātrapraśnena jātyādinirapekṣo dyūte pravarttamānaḥ kitavaḥ| iha tu kitava iva kitavaḥ, yo yājñiko yājyasya dhanasattāmevāpekṣate na yāgārhatām, sa yājñikakitava ityucyate, tadāha - ayājyayājakastṛṣṇapapara iti| mīmāṃsakadurdurūṭa iti| `dula utkṣepe', duḥpurvaḥ auṇādikaḥ kūṭapratyayaḥ| `bahulamanyatrāpi' iti ṇiluk, larayorekaviṣayatvasmaraṇād durduruṭa iti bhavati| vaiyākaraṇaścaura iti| kathametatpratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā cauratavena garhyamāṇatvādbhavatyeva vaiyākaraṇakutsā, tatraha - na hyatreti| pratyāsatteḥ śabdapravṛtteḥ śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ samāsena bhavitavyam, atra ca vaiyākaraṇaḥ kutsyate cauratvena, na tu vaiyākaraṇatvam| kutsino brāhmaṇa iti| atra `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṇa' iti bhavitavyameva samāsena| yadi neṣyate, bahulagrahaṇaṃ śaraṇam||

54 pāpāṇake kutsitaiḥ || 2-1-54 ||

55 upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ || 2-1-55 ||
upamīyatene'netyupamānamiti| upapūrvānmāṅaḥ karaṇe lyuṭi samāsa iti darśayati| bhāṣye tu mānasya samīpamupamānamityarthakathanamātram| avyayībhāve upamānānīti rūpāsidhidiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ| upapūrvakaśca māṅsādṛśyahetuke paricchede rūḍhaḥ| yena vastvantaraṃ sādṛśyena paricchidyate tadupamānam, tadyathā - gauriva gavaya iti; gauḥ karaṇam, puruṣaḥ paricchettā, sa hi goḥ sādṛśyena gavayaṃ paricchinatti - gosadṛśo gavaya iti| sāmānyavacanairiti| samānaśabdaḥ dharmaḥ - sāmānyam, caccopamānasya śrutatvāttasya copameyāpekṣatvāttayoreva sādhāraṇo dharmo vijñāyata ityāha - upamānopamayayorityādi| tadviśiṣṭopameyavanairiti| tena sādhāraṇena dharmeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ yadupameyaṃ tadvacanaiḥ, na tu sādhāraṇadharmamātravacanairitiyarthaḥ| vacanagrahaṇāccāyamarthau labhyate, sāmānyamuktavantaḥ - sāmānyavacanāḥ| ye sāmānyamuktvā tadvati dravye paryavasyanti te tathoktāḥ, yathā guṇamuktavān guṇavacana iti| tacca sāmānyavadupamānaśabdasya saṃbandhiśbadatvāttadākṣiptamupameyameva vijñāyata iti suṣṭhūktam - tadviśiṣṭopamevacanairiti| śastrīśyāmeti| atra śyāmaguṇaviśiṣṭatvena pramidhdatvādupamānaṃ śastrī, upameyā devadattā, tayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ śyāmatvam, tadabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭāyāṃ śyāmāśabdaḥ paryavasyātīti bhavati sāmānyavacanaḥ| nanu ca samānādhikaraṇeneti| varttate, iha ca śastrīśabdaḥ śastryāṃ varttate, śyāmāśabdastu devadattāyām, yadāha - `upamānavācīni subantāni tadviśiṣṭopameyavacanaiḥ' iti; tathā vigrahavākye ivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ - śastrīva śyāmeti? satyam; vacanasāmarthyāttu vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi samāsaḥ| yadyevam, mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapalā, haṃsīva gadgadā haṃsagadgadā, puṃvatkarmadhārayeti sāmānādhikaraṇyalakṣaṇaḥ puvadbhāvo na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; jātāyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ strītvamakiñcitkaram, tatra kukkuṭāṇḍam, mṛgakṣīramityādivadidamapi sidhdam| nanu cānyadeva cāpalaṃ striyāḥ, anyadeva puṃsaḥ? satyam; jātimātropādāne'pi prakaraṇādivaśāt strītvaṃ pratyāyiṣyate, tacca bahiraṅgatvānna strīpratyayasya nimittam| anyathā puṃvadbhāvena nivṛttau strīpratyayasya tavāpi kathaṃ viśaṃṣāvagatiḥ| astvevam, yadi tu mṛgīva capaleti strīpratyayāntasya samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā mṛgīcapaleti prāpnoti, na hi tena samāso daṇḍavāritaḥ, samānādhikaraṇādhikāraśca bādhyeta| evaṃ tarhi samānādhirakaṇasamāsa evāyam - śastrī cāsau śyāmā ceti, kathaṃ punardevadattāyāṃ śastrīśbadaḥ, jātivacano hyasau sādṛśyanimittādabhodopacārāt, yathā - gaurvāhīka iti| yadyevam, śastraśabdo'pyupameye saṃkrānta ityupamānavācitvaṃ nopapadyate? satyam; pūrvāvasthāśrayeṇa tūpamānatvaṃ draṣṭavyam| ivaśabdaprayogastūpamānapradarśanārthaḥ, na prakriyāvākyāṅgamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ| nanu śyāmaguṇatvena sādharmyeṇa śastrīśabdo devadattāyāṃ prayujyata iti śyāmaśabdo na prayogārhaḥ, tanna; bahavo hi śastryāṃ guṇāḥ - tīkṣṇā sūkṣmā pṛthuḥ śyāmeti, tatrāsati śyāmaguṇena śastrītvasāropitamiti| nanu sadapi śyāmapadaṃ devadattāmupasthāpya caratārthamiti naiva śastrīguṇo nirddiśyate, naitadasti; naivamatra vacanaṃ vyajyate yā śyāmā sā śastrīveti| kathaṃ tarhi śastrīva śyāmā devadatteti? asyāṃ tu vacanavyaktāvivaśabdena tāvadupameyaniṣṭhatvena pratīyate, upameyaniṣṭho guṇa upamānaṃ spṛśatyeva| atha vā candramukhītyādāvanirdiṣṭo'pi guṇaḥ priyadarśanatvādiḥ prasidhdivaśādupamānanimittatvena pratīyate, tadopameye'pi tāvacśrutaḥ kathamupamānaṃ na sprakṣyati| phālā iva taṇḍulā| dīrghatvādinā dharmeṇa||

56 upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge || 2-1-56 ||
upamitamityatra bhūtakālo na vivakṣyata ityāha - upamoyamupamitamiti| sāmarthyāditi| upameyamupamānāpekṣamityetatsāmarthyena cetsāmānyavācīti yadā prakaraṇādivaśānniyataḥ sādhāraṇaguṇaḥ pratīyate tadā samāsaḥ, yadā tu guṇāntaravyavacchedāya viśiṣṭaḥ sādhāraṇaguṇavacanaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate tadā na samāsa ityarthaḥ| puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iveti| upamānapradarśanametat, atra hi vaiyadhikaraṇyātsamāsasyāprasaṅgaḥ| yadā tu vyāghraśbadastādhdarmyātpuruṣe varttate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇye sati samāsaḥ| ata evoktam - viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāpte iti| puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūra iti| nanu sāmānyaśabdaprayoge sati tadapekṣatvādasāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati, evaṃ tarhyatajjñāpayati - bhavati pradhānasya sāpekṣasya vṛttiriti| tena rājapuruṣo'bhirupa aupagavaḥ śobhana ityādi sidhdaṃ bhavati| nyāyasidhda evārthe liṅgadarśanamidam| prādhānyādevānekopakāryatvasambhavātpuruṣavyāghro'bhirupa iti bhavatyeva| śauryaṃ hyatra samānadharmaḥ, nābhirupam| ata eva `sāmānyāprayoge' ityuktam, na tu `guṇāprayoge' iti||

57 viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam || 2-1-57 ||
bhedakamiti| asiśchinattītivat karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇval| viśeṣaṇamiti| `śiṣ‌lṛ śeṣaṇe' vipūrvaḥ, viśeṣyate'neneti viśeṣaṇam, karaṇe lyaṭ| yatsādhāraṇākāreṇa pratipannaṃ bahuprakāraṃ vastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchadya ekasminprakāre vyavasthāpayati tatpadaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhedakamiti cocyate| viyavasthāpyamānaṃ viśeṣyaṃ bhedyamiti ca| nanu ca viśeṣyamiti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, tataśca viśeṣaṇamityukte gamyata eva - viśeṣyeṇeti, evaṃ viśeṣyeṇetyukte gamyate-viśeṣaṇamiti, tatkimarthamubhayamupādīyate? yatra pūrvottarapadayordvayorapi pratyakaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastatraiva yathā syād, yathā-nīlotpalamiti| atra hi nīlārtho bhramarādisādhāraṇarupeṇa pratipanna utpalārthenotpale vyavasthāpyate, utpalārtho hi raktādisādhāraṇarupeṇa pratipanno nīlārthena nīle vyapasthāpyata iti bhavati pratyekamubhayabhāvaḥ| yatra tu sa nāsti na tatra samāso bhavati, yathā pratyudāharaṇe-takṣakaḥ sarpa iti, na hi takṣakaḥ sarpatvaṃ vyabhicarati| nanu vyabhicarati, kriyānimittako'pi takṣakaśabdo'sti - takṣṇotīti takṣata iti? satyamasti; na tvasau nāmadheyena gāhate tulyakakṣatām, drāgeva rūḍhau pratibhā kriyāśabdo vilambitā| iha tu śiṃśapāvṛkṣa iti, śiśaṃpāśabdasya phale'pi darśanādvakṣavyabhicārādbhavatyeva samāsaḥ, na cātra vṛkṣapratītipūrvikā phale pratītiryena bahiraṅgā syāt| yatheva hi pañcālādayaḥ śabdā janapadināṃ janapadasya ca sādhāraṇyenānyo'nyayogamapekṣante tadvadede'pi| yathovāca bhagavān-`lubyogāprakhyānāt' iti iha tarhi katham `atha jayāya nu merumahībhṛtaḥ' iti, na merurmahībhṛttvaṃ vyabhicarati? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ| yadi tarhi yatra pratyekamubhayabhāvastatra samāsaḥ, ubhayorapi viśeṣaṇatvamiti prathamānirdiṣṭatvādupasarjanatve sati pūrvanipātāniyamaḥ syād - nīlotpalam? artha taścāprādhānyam| tadiha dravyaguṇopanipāte dravyaṃ pradhānam, apradhānaṃ guṇaḥ| dravyaṃ hi kriyāsidhdau sākṣādupayujyate, guṇastu dravyāvacchedadvāreṇa| ato guṇavacanasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ, na dravyavacanasya| nanūtpalaśabdo'pi jātiśabdaḥ, na dravyaśabdaḥ; yadi tu jātiviśiṣṭe dravye paryavasānād dravyaśabdatvam, hantaivaṃ nīlaśabdo'pi guṇiviśiṣṭe dravye paryavasyan dravyaśabdaḥ syāt? atrocyate-utpatteḥ prabhṛtyā vināśājjātirdravyaṃ na jahāti, na tu bhavati śābaleyasya gauriti| tasmājjātyātmakameva dravyaṃ pratīyata iti jātiśabdo dravyatvena vyavasthāpyate| guṇāḥ punaḥ satyeva dravye kadācidupayanti, kadācidapayanti - paṭasya śakla iti, vyatiriktā api dravyātsvaśabdaiḥ pratyāyyanta iti na guṇātmakaṃ dravyaṃ bhavatīti na guṇaśabdo dravyaśabdatve vyavasthātumarhati| ata eva `śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta' iti codanāyāṃ śvetābhāve kṛṣṇāśchāga ālabhyate, na tu chāgābhāve piṣṭapiṇḍīmālabhya kṛtī bhavati| kriyādravyayorupanipāte'pyevameva draṣṭavyam - yācakabrāhmaṇa iti| yatra tu guṇaśabdayoḥ, kriyāśabdayoḥ, gaṇakriyāśabdayoścopanipātaḥ, tatrāniyama eva bhavati - khañjakubjaḥ, kubjakhañjaḥ; pācakapāṭhakaḥ, pāṭhakapācakaḥ; khañjapācakaḥ, pācakakhañja iti| śiśapāvṛkṣa iti| dravyaśabdayorevopanipāte'pi vṛkṣatvasya vyāpakatvānmahāviṣayatvād dūrātprathamata evopalambhācca prādhānyam, śiśapātvasya tu viparyayādapradhānyamiti na tatrāpyaniyamaḥ| viśeṣaṇamiti kimiti|| viśeṣyaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādeva viśeṣaṇamiti lapsyata iti praśnaḥ| takṣakaḥ sarpa iti| nanu takṣakaśabdo'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva? evaṃ manyate-viśeṣyaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādeva pūrvapadasya viśeṣaṇatve labdhe punarviśeṣaṇagrahaṇamuttarapadasya viśeṣaṇatvapratipattyartham-viśeṣeyeṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ samasyate, taccedviśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| na cātrottarapadaṃ viśeṣaṇam; takṣakasya tapaṃtvāvyabhicārāditi| lohitastakṣaka iti| nātra takṣato viśeṣyaḥ, tasya lohitatvāvyabhicārāt| yadyevam lohito viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; tasyāpi viśeṣyāpekṣatvāt? evaṃ tarhi `pāṭhakramādathakramo balāyam' iti takṣako lohita iti pāṭho draṣṭavyaḥ, atra hi takṣako viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati; lohitatvasya takṣatakatvavyabhicārāt| yadyevam, lohitatvasya viśeṣyatvamapi syāt? astyeva tasya viśeṣyatvam, pūrvapadasya tu viśeṣyatvābhāvātpratyudāhaṇatvam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā takṣakaḥ karpa ityetadevāsminnapi praśne pratyudāharaṇaṃ bhavati| vispaṣṭārthaṃ tūbhayorupādānam||

58 pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca || 2-1-58 ||
pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti| guṇakriyāśabdena saha samāse pūrvādīnāṃ pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ tu na bhavati, bahuṃlagrahaṇenaiva sidhdatvāditi manyate||

59 śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ || 2-1-59 ||
ekena śilpena paṇyena vā yedīvanti, teṣāṃ samūraḥ - śreṇiḥ| tatra pṛthak‌sthitānāṃ śreṇikaraṇe yathā syāt, śreṇisthānāmeva tu daṇḍādirūpeṇa karaṇe mā bhūdityāha - śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavcanamiti iti| śraṇyādayaḥ paṭhyante iti| tena tatrādiśabdo vyavasthāvācī| kṛtādirākṛtigaṇa iti| prayogadarśanenākṛtigrāhyo gaṇaḥ - ākṛtigaṇaḥ| atrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| cvyantānāmityādi| paratvāditi bhāvaḥ| ākṛtigaṇe'pyudāharaṇarupeṇa katipayānpaṭhati| kṛta...matetyādi||

60 ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ || 2-1-60 ||
viśiṣṭaśabdo'yamadhike varttate, taccādhikyaṃ kvacitsāvadhāraṇam, tadyathā - devadatto yajñadattātsvādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyenaiva viśiṣṭo'nye guṇāḥ samā iti gamyate| kvacinniravadhāraṇam, tadyathā - devadatto yajñadatsvādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyena tāvadviśiṣṭo'nye guṇāḥ samā bhūyāṃso vā netannirupyate| vākyasyaikarūpatve'rthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣanirṇayaḥ| tatra nirañdhāraṇapakṣe - sidhdaṃ ca tadabhaktaṃ cetyatrāpi syāt, ktāntayoḥ prakṛtibhede'pi nava tāvadhika iti viśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, ktena sanañā nañityeva vācyaṃ syāt, ataḥ sāvadhāraṇapakṣamāśrityāha - nañaiva viśeṣo yasyeti| prakṛtyādikamityādiśabdena pratyayopasargayorgrahaṇam tatra sidhdaṃ ca tadabhaktaṃ ceti prakṛtiratulyā, karttavyamakṛtamiti pratyayaḥ, prakṛtaṃ cānapakṛtaṃ cetyupasargaḥ, evaṃ ca pūrvapadamapi ktāntameva labhyata ityāha - anañktāntamiti| anañiti śakyamakarttum, na hi pūrvapade sanañi uttarapade nañadhiko bhavati| kṛtaṃ ca tadakṛtaṃ ceti| avayavadharmeṇāyaṃ samudāyasya vyapadeśaḥ, ekameva ca vastvekadeśakaraṇātkṛtaṃ ca bhavatyekadeśākaraṇādakṛtaṃ ceti nātra kaścidvirodhaḥ| yadi tarhi sāvadhāraṇapakṣa āśrīyate, evaṃ sati yasya nuḍaparo|dhikaiḍāgame vā, tena saha samāso na syādityata āha -- nuḍiṭāviti| nuḍiḍgrahaṇamāgamopalakṣaṇam, nyāyasya tulyatvāttenacchannācchannamiti tugadhikasyāpi gahaṇam‌| aśitānaśiteneti| `aśa bhojane' `tasmannuḍaci'| kliṣṭākliśitaneti| `kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' iti pakṣe iṭ; tatra nuṭ pratyayāntabhaktaḥ, iṭ pratyayabhaktastuk nañ‌bhakta iti sarveṣāmuttarapade'ntarbhāvaḥ| iha tu chātācchitamiti `śācchoranyatarasyām' itītve kṛte nenādhikyātsamāso na prāpnoti? atra kecidāhuḥ - nuḍiḍgrahaṇa marthābhedakasya vikāramātrasyopalakṣaṇam, tenehāpi samāso bhavatīti| trātātrāṇa marthābhedakasya vikāramātrasyopalakṣaṇam, tenehāpi samāso bhavatīti| trātātrāṇamityatra tu niṣṭhānatvasyāsidhdatvādbhedakatvābhāvaḥ, gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya pūrveṇa na prāpnotītyārambhaḥ| pūrvanipātaniyamārthaśca - kṛtākṛtamityeva yathā syāt, akṛtamiti mā bhūt| kṛtāpakṛmiti| ekadeśasyeṣṭasya karaṇādekadeśasya cāniṣṭasya karaṇādekamavavastu kṛtaṃ bhavatyapakṛtaṃ ca| bhuktaṃ ca tadatyavahaṛtatvāt, vibhuktaṃ cāśobhanatvādbhuktavibhuktam, viśabdo'trośobhanatvaṃ dyotayati virūpam| evaṃ pīnavipītam| gamanam - gatam, pratyāgamanam - pratyāgatam, tat kṣuṇṇabhuvā pratyāgamanena saha caritaṃ gamanaṃ gatapratyāgatam, yātaṃ ca tadanuyātaṃ tadānīmeva punargamanāt yātānuyātam| krayākrayiketi| `alpe' iti kapratyayaḥ, tadantaśca svabhāvātstriyāṃ varttate| krayākrayiketi `anyepāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghaḥ| mahān krayaḥ krayaśabdenocyate gobalīvardanyāyena| evaṃ puṭāpuṭikā, phalāphalikā, mānonmāniketi| śākapārthavādīnāmiti| `sidhdaye' iti śeṣaḥ| pṛthorapatyaṃ pārthavaḥ, kecitpāthiveti paṭhanti, pṛthivyā īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ, `tasyeśvaraḥ' ityañ, tasyābhyavahāryeṣu śākaṃ priyatvātpradhānam| tatra sāhacaryādeva tadvyapadeśatvalābhāduttarapadalopo na vaktavyaḥ| samāsastu vaktavyaḥ, gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya||

61 sanmahatparamottamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ || 2-1-61 ||
pūjyamānairiti vacanāditi| pūjyamānasya pūjāpekṣatvāditi bhāvuḥ| ata eva saditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na śatṛśānacoḥ, na hi tau pūjāmāhatuḥ| utkṛṣṭo goriti| udhdṛta ityarthaḥ| mahājanaḥ, mahodadhirityādau pūjābhāve'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti samāsaḥ| vacanaṃ tu guṇakriyāśbadairapi samāse sadādīnāmeva pūrvanipātaniyamārtham||

62 vṛndarakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam || 2-1-62 ||
vṛndākaraśbado devajātivacajanaḥ, itarau hastijātivacanau, tatropamānatve sati pūjāvacanatā sambhavati| tatra vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvātsidhde samāse pūjāyāmeva yathā syānnindāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vacanam| iha mā bhūt - māṇavako'yaṃ nāgo yasmānmūrka iti| samānyaprayoge'pi yathā syādityanye| suṣīma iti saṃjñeyaṃ nāgaviśeṣasya| yadyevam, viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇetyadhikārādevātra na bhaviṣyati, na hyanāgaḥ suṣīmo'sti? tasyam; pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, māṇavako'yaṃ nāga iti pratyudāharaṇam||

63 katarakatamau jātiparipraśne || 2-1-63 ||
katarakaṭha iti| `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātiḥ tathā ca pratyudāharaṇamiti| pūrvaṃ vṛttiṣūpanyastamupapannaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ||

64 kiṃ kṣepe || 2-1-64 ||

65 poṭāyuvatistokakatipayakṛṣṭidhenuvaśāvehabdaṣkayaṇīpravaktṛśrotriyādhyāpakadhūrtairjātiḥ || 2-1-65 ||
ubhayavyañjaneti| vyajyate'nena strītvādikamiti vyañjanam - stanādi, ubhayoḥ strīpuṃsayorvyañjanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā, napuṃsake poṭetyarthaḥ| poṭāśabdastu tatrapi strītvayuktaḥ pravartate| śabdānāṃ citraśaktitvāt ṣaṇḍaśabdo yathā pumān|| dhūrttagrahaṇamakutsārthamiti| kutmāyāṃ tu `kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ' iti sidhdamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra kaṭhadhūrtta iti| yaḥ kaṭhaḥ sa dhūrtta ityarthaḥ, na tu kaṭhatvaṃ kutsyate||

66 praśaṃsāvacanaiśca || 2-1-66 ||
rūḍhiśabdāḥ praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyanta iti| praśaṃsayeti vaktavye vacanagrahaṇādiha grahaṇaṃ rūḍhiśabdānāṃ praśaṃsāmātravācimām| tena ye yaugikāḥ praśastaśobhanaramaṇīyādayaḥ, ye ca viśeṣavacanāḥ śucimṛdvāyaḥ, ye ca jātiśabdāḥ santaḥ paratra prayogātpraśaṃsāṃ gamayanti siṃho māṇavaka iti, te sarve vyudastā bhavanti| matallikādaya iti| `matallikā macarcikā prakāṇḍamudhdatallajau| praśastavācakānyamūni' ityamaraḥ| āviṣṭaliṅgatvāditi| niyataliṅgatvādityarthaḥ| svaliṅgopādānā iti| svasyaiva liṅgasyopādānaṃ yeṣu te tathoktāḥ| `praśaṃsāvacanapoṭāyuvati' ityekayoge karttavye yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ||

67 yuvā khalatipālitavalinajaratībhiḥ || 2-1-67 ||
saṃjñāyūno gahaṇe gārgyāyaṇaḥ khalatirityādābeva tu syānna ca tasya jaratīśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam| na ca gārgyāyaṇī yuvatirasti; satriyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāprātiṣedhāt, ato yuveti svarūpagrahaṇamityāha - yuvāśabda iti| khalatyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇairiti| kathaṃ punaryuvaśabdasya jaratīśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam puṃlliṅgasya strīliṅgeneti, tatrāha - strīliṅganirdeśa iti| asyāṃ hi paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ yuvaśabdasya grahaṇe yuvatiśabdasyāpi grahaṇādupapadyate yuvatijaratīśabdayoḥ samānādhikaraṇyam, asatyāṃ tu nopapadyata ityarthāpattyā parabhāṣā jñāyate| yuvakhalatīti| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' iti ṅīṣ| valiśabdaḥ pāmādiḥ| yuvajaranniti| jaradbhirityapi pāṭhaḥ kenacidācāryeṇa bodhita iti pulliṅgenāpi samāso bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yuvatirjaratīti| kathaṃ virudhdavācanoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, anyo'nyādharmopalambhāttadrūpatvāropādbhaviṣyati| yadyevam, vibhinnaliṅgayorapyevameva samānādhikaraṇyasambhavātkathaṃ paribhāṣā jñāpyata iti cintyam; yuvaśabdasya pūrvānipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam, aniyamo hi guṇaśabdatvātsyāt||

68 kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā || 2-1-68 ||
tulyāparyāyāśceti| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ svarūpanirākaraṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ| bhojyoṣṇādāvaniyame prāpte pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ vacanam| tulyamahāniti| `sanmahat' ityasyākṛtyatulyākhyeṣu sāvakāśatvātkṛtyatulyākhyeṣu paratvādayameva samāso yakta iti bhāvaḥ| bhojya odana iti| pratiṣedhasāmarthyād viśeṣaṇamityapi na bhavati||

69 varṇo varṇena || 2-1-69 ||
`viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' iti varttate, tatra dvayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇena viśeṣaṇatā bhavet| varṇaścāsau varṇaiti| kiṃ vyāvṛttam? kimanvitam? athaikatra viśeṣāṇāṃ rūpasyānyatra ca grahaḥ? śaklaścāsau varṇa iti na syāt, varṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ śuklasya varṇatvāvyabhicārāt, tasmādubhayatra viśeṣagrahaṇamityāha - varṇaviśeṣavācītyādi| kṛṣṇasāraṅga ityādi| nānāvarṇasamāhāraḥ sāraṅgaḥ, tathā sabalaḥ, tasya varṇāntarasamāhāre'pi bhāvātkārṣyānvayo niyate na syāditi kṛṣṇo viśeṇam| evaṃ lohitāśabde'pi draṣṭavyam| nanu ca kṛṣṇaśabdo'trāvayave varttate, na samudāye; tasya sāraṅgatvāt, tatkathamavayavavṛtteḥ kṛṣṇaśabdasya samudāyavṛttinā sāraṅgaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyamata āha - avayavadvāreṇetyādi| kṛṣṇāvayavasambandhātsamudāya eva kṛṣṇa ucyata ityarthaḥ| ata evātra gauṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti sūtrārambhaḥ| nanu `tṛtīyā tatkṛtena' ityevātra sidhdaḥ samāsaḥ katham?
