sāraṅgaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ sāraṅgatvaṃ kṛṣṇāvayvakṛmityastyeva sidhdiḥ; tatrāyamapyarthaḥ - `varṇo varṇeṣvanete' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na vaktavyo bhavati, tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyetyeva sidhdatvāt, tadavayavaṃ vaktavyametatpratiṣedhārtham, iha mā bhūt - kṛṣṇaito lohitaita iti| idaṃ tu na vaktavyam? idamapi vaktavyam, ihāpi yathā syāt-śuklababhruḥ kṛṣṇaśuklā haritaśuklaḥ babhrūkapilaḥ, yasya kaścidavayavaḥ śuklaḥ kaścid babhruḥ sa samudāyo'vayavayvaśabdābhyāṃ tathocyata iti nātra tatkṛtatvasaṃbhavaḥ| atra kṛṣṇasāraṅga ityādau yatraiko'vayavayavaśabdaḥ, aparaḥ samudāyaśabdaḥ, tatrāvyavasyāpradhānatvādupasarjanatvātpurvanipātaḥ| dvayostvavayavaśabdayoḥ paryāya iti draṣṭavyam| iha yasmin prayoge vīraiḥ puraṣaṃstadvān grāmaḥ pratipādayitamiṣṭastatra prathamamevānyapadārthavivakṣā kāryā vīrāḥ puruṣā asminsantīti vīrapuruṣako grāma iti bahuvrīhireva nityaṃ yathā syāt; anyathā pūrvamanapekṣite'nyapadārthe vīrāḥ puruṣā vīrupuruṣā iti karmadhāraye kṛte paścādanyapadārthavivakṣāyāṃ matvarthīye sati vīrapuruṣavān grāma ityādyaniṣṭamapi kadācidanuṣajyeta| sarvaśabdasya tvakārāntaiḥ karmadhārayo'pīṣyate| tasmācca matvarthavivakṣāyām `ata iniṭhanau' iti ṭhanaṃ bādhitvā inireva bhavatīti vaktavyam sarva dhanaṃ sarvadhanaṃ tadasyāstīti sarvadhanī, sarvabījī, karvakeśī| yatra karmadhārayo jātiviśeṣavacanaḥ, tatra karmadhārayānmatvarthīyo bhavati - kṛṣṇasarpavānvalmīkaḥ, lohitaśālimān grāmaḥ, gaurakharavadaraṇyam, gauramṛgavaditi| na hi bahuvrīhiṇā tajjātyā tadvattavaṃ śakyaṃ pratipādayitum||

70 || kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ || 2-1-70 ||
kumāraśabdasya pūrvanipātaniyamārtha vacanam ||

71 catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā || 2-1-71 ||
catuṣpājjātiriti| kecidāhuḥ - poṭādisūtrājjātigragaṇamanuvartyamiti| anye tvāhuḥ - ye śabdāntaranirapekṣāścatuṣpājjātivacanāḥ, ta evāntaraṅgatvād gṛhyante, na tu kālākṣyādayo yaugikāḥ śabdāntarasaṃnidhānāccatuṣpādviṣayā iti| garbhiṇīśabdasya paranipādārthaṃ vacanam||

72 mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca || 2-1-72 ||
vyaṃsakaḥ - dhūrttaḥ, mayūraścāsau vyaṃsakaśyeti vyaṃsakaśabdasya guṇavacanatvātpurvanipāte prāpte vacanam| evaṃ chātravyasakādīnāṃ kambojamuṇḍaparyantānām| anye tvāhuḥ - mayūraiva vyaṃsakaḥ, chātraiva vyaṃsakaḥ kamboja iva muṇḍaḥ, yavana iva muṃḍaḥ, umānasamāso'yam, `upamānāni samānyavacanaiḥ' ityeva sidhde pūnarvidhānaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ tulyārthatṛtīyeti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro mā bhūditi, sa hyupamānasaṃśbadenena vihite samāse vidhīyata iti| punardāyeti| `punaścanasau chandasi' iti gatisaṃjñā vārttikakārīyeti|| gaṇakāreṇedaṃ paṭhitam, ehi iḍeti yasminkarmaṇi tad ehīḍam, evam ehīyavam| ehi vāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ehivāṇijā| evam-apehi vāṇijā, prehivāṇijā| ehi svāgatamiti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā ehisvāgatā| ihavitarkā, loṇmadhyamaikavacanam| proha karaṭamiti yasyāṃ sā prohakaraṭā; evaṃ prohakardamādaya āharavasanāntāḥ| `kṛtī chedane' tadeva vacanam, mucāditvānnum| kṛnta vicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā kṛntavicakṣaṇā| udhdara utsṛjeti yasyāṃ sodhdarotsṛjā| `ākhyātamākhyātena' iti sidhde'sātatyārtha vacanam| evam udhdamavidhamā, utpacavipacā, utpatanipatā| udakca avākca uccāvacam, uccaiśca nīcaiśca uccanīcam, ācitaṃ copacitaṃ ca ācopacam, niścitaṃ ca pracitaṃ ca niścapracam - sarva ete nipātyate| na kiñcana vidyate yasya so'kiñcanaḥ, snātvākālakādiṣu samāsāntodāttatvaṃ lyababhāvaśca nipātanāt| pratīyamānakriyāpekṣaṃ ca samānakatṛkatvam-snātvākālakaḥ saṃpanna iti| jahi karmaṇeti| jahīti loṇyamadhyamaikavacanam; tadetatkarmaṇā bahulaṃ samasyate ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkartā vidhīyate| jahi joḍamityābhīkṣṇyena ya āha sa jahijoḍaḥ| aśnīta pibatetyevaṃ yatra satatamabhidhīyate sā aśrātapibatā| evaṃ pacatabhṛjjatā, `bhrasja pāke' bhindhi lavaṇamiti yasyāmabhidhīyate sā bhindhilavaṇā| evaṃ pacalavaṇā| avihitalakṣamastatpuruṣa iti| yasya tattapuruṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ na kṛtam, prāptaprayogaśca bhavati, sa mayūrakhyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvādatraiva draṣṭavya ityarthaḥ||
iti śrīharadattamiśravicitāyāṃ padamañjayau dvitīyādhyāyasya prathama pādaḥ ||
<2.2>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ
dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ padamañjarī

atha dvitīyādhyāye dvitāyaḥ pādaḥ
1 pūrvāparādharottaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe || 2.2.1 ||
ekadeśo'syāstītyekadeśīti| ekagopūrvāditi ṭhañ prāpnoti, ata eva nirdeśādinirdraṣṭavyaḥ| ekadaṇḍītyayaṃ tvapaśabdaḥ eko daṇḍo yasyeti bahuvrīhiṇaiva gatatvānmatvartha eva durlabhaḥ, kiṃ punariniṣṭhañā bādhitaḥ? ekadeśabdastu karmadhāraya evāvayavavacana iti na tatra bahuvrīhiṇā gatatvam, yathā - kṛṣṇasarpavāniti| sāmarthyādekadeśavacanā iti| ekadeśamapekṣyaikadeśī bhavati, nānyathetyetatsāmarthyam| ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇamekadeśino viśeṣaṇamiti| satsaptamyantavaiyadhikaraṇyeneti bhāvaḥ, tadāha - eka cediti| ekatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ| samānābhidheyavacana ekādhikaraṇaśabdo na bhavati, avayavāvayaviśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ, samānādhikaraṇyeneti prakṛtatvācca| syādetat - `samudāyeṣu hi dṛṣṭāḥ śabdāḥ avayaveṣvapi varttante' iti nyāyena samānādhikaraṇye sati pūrvaścāsau kāyaśceti viśeṣaṇamityeva sidhdaḥ samāso nārtha etena, evaṃ ca kṛtvā paravalliṅgamityatra tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, katham? uttarapadārthapradhānatvādeva sidhdamiti, tatraha - ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yaṃ yoga iti| sidhdaṃ tu kathañcitpūrvakāya iti, kāyapūrva ityasya nivṛttyarthameva tu sūtraṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| pūrve kāyasyeti| yadyapi diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda ityāśrayaṇātsampratyadigvṛttinīpi yoge pañcamī bhavati, `tasya paramāmreḍitam' iti liṅgādavayavavṛttibhiryoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| pūrve nābheḥ kāyasyeti| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī, māyasambandhī nābhyapekṣayā pūrvo bhāga ityarthaḥ| tatra nābhirekadeśī na bhavatīti na tena samāso bhavati| yastvekadeśī kāyastena samāso bhavatyeva - pūrvakāyo nābheriti, pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvena nityasāpekṣatvāditi kecidāhuḥ| anye tu - yatrārthaprakaraṇādināvadhirgamyate tatraiva samāsaḥ, na śabdopādāne ityāhuḥ| pūrve chātrāṇāmiti| neyaṃ nirdhdāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī, kiṃ tarhi? samudāyaḥ chātrāṇāmityanenocyata iti bahuvacanam, yathā-chātrāṇāṃ pañcama iti, tataśca chātrāṇāmekadeśitvamastyeva, kiṃ tu bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭānāmiti samāsābhāvaḥ| saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyetyādi| na hyanyathā sāyapūrvatvamahvasyopapadyate iti bhāvaḥ| kecittu - sarveṇaikadeśavācinā kālavācinaḥ samāso bhavati, na tvamahanśabdasyaiveti jñāpakaśarīraṃ varṇayanti, tena madhyarātra ityapi sidhdaṃ bhavati||

2 ardhdaṃ napuṃsakam || 2.2.2 ||
āviṣṭaliṅga iti| niyataliṅga ityarthaḥ| tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| tatraivārthe napuṃsakatvasyāvyabhicārād| avayavavācī hyabhidheyavuśena triliṅgaḥ - apūpārdhdaṃ mayā bhakṣitam, dantārdhdamāsyātpatitam, grāmārdhdaḥ, nagarārdhaḥ, sarpiṣārdhyayā vyanaktatoti| `tasyārdhdāḥ śastvārdhdāḥ pariśiṣya madhye nividaṃ dadhāti' iti| bhāṣye tvavayavavācī puṃliṅga ityupalakṣaṇam | kvacittu samapravibhāge strīliṅgatā dṛśyate - ekāntṛcerdhdā yugmāsu' iti, yagmāsu ṛkṣu ardhdāḥ śastvā nividaṃ dadhyādityarthaḥ, tasyārṣatvena nirvāhaḥ| ardhamiti napusakanirdeśaḥ śabdarūpāpekṣayāpi sambhāvyeta, yathā `svamajñātidhanākhyāyām' `bandhuni bahuvrīhau' iti, tasmānnapuṃsakamityuktam| ardhdapippalīti| pippalīśabdasya `ekavibhakti ca' ityupasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati; ekavibhkāyavaṣaṣṭhyantamiti vacanāt| ardhdaṃ pippalīnāmiti| na tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati - ardhdāni pippalīnāmardhdapippalya iti; naitadasminvigrahe bhavati, khaṇḍasamudāye bhavati - ardhdapippalī cārdhdapiplī cārdhdapippalya iti| devadadattaśabdena samāso na bhavatīti| devadatto'tra svāmī, na tvekadeśī| yastvekadeśī paśustena bhavatyeva samāsaḥ - ardhdapaśurdevatadattasyeti, devadattasvāmikaṃ paśorardhdamityarthaḥ| tatra samudāyena sambandhānnāsti sāpekṣatvam| ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| kathamardhdapippalī? sāmānādhikaraṇye bhaviṣyati ardhdaṃ cāsau pippalī ceti| nanu ca yadyardhdaṃ na pippalī, atha pippalī nārdhdam, ardhdaṃ pippalī ceti vipratiṣidhdam? nāsti viprātiṣedhaḥ; samudāye hi dṛṣṭāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante| kiñca samapravibhāgādanyatrārdhdandrādāvayameva gatiprakāraḥ, samapravibhāge'pi tathāstu| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam -- mpravibhāge ṣaṣṭhīsamāso mā bhūditi? iṣyate ṣaṣṭhīsamāsoṣa'pi, tathā ca bhagavānpiṅgalanāgaḥ prayuṅkte `svarārdhdaṃ cāryārdhdam' iti| evaṃ tarhi gauṇatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya viśeṣaṇasamāso na kila syādityamārambhaḥ||

3 dvitāyatṛtīyācaturthaturyāṇyanyatarasyām || 2.2.3 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātso'pi bhavatīti| nanu ca pūraṇapratyayāntā evaite dvitīyādayaḥ, tatra pūraṇaguṇasuhitetyādinā pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam, yadāpi `pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan' iti svārthiko'npratyayaḥ kriyate, tadāpi `pūraṇagumasuhitārtha' ityarthaśabdasya pratyekanabhisambandhātpūraṇārthagrahaṇam, na tu tadadhikāravihitapratyayagahaṇamiti bhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena, tatkathaṃ so'pi bhavatītyāha - pūraṇagumetyādi| vākyasya mahāvibhāṣayaiva sidhdatvātṣaṣṭhīsamāsaprāptyarthamevānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| pūrvaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapavādo yoga ityādyaprāptyabhiprāyeṇoktam| yadvā - satyasminyoge ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhasyāsya ca ṣaṣṭhīsamāsabodhakatvamaviṇiṣṭamiti matvā tathoktam| ayamapi yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? samudāyāvayavayoraupacārike sāmānādhikaraṇye sati dvitīyabhikṣādi sidhdam, mukhyārthavṛttau ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu bhikṣādvītīyamityādi bhaviṣyatīti| nātatsuṣṭhūcyate, anenaiva khalvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ prāpyate, kathamasminyege'sati bhaviṣyati||

4 prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā || 2.2.4 ||
prāptajīvika iti| `ekavibhakti' ityupasarjanatvād hrasvatm| prāptā jīvikā yeneti karmaṇi ktāntena bahuvrīhāvapyetatsidhdam, samāsāntodāttatvārthaṃ tu vacanam| iha prāptasukhaḥ, prāptaduḥkha ityādiṣu `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' iti prāptāpannayoḥ paranipātaprasaṅgaśca| iha liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā prāptāśabdasyāpyayaṃ samāso bhavati--prāptā jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikā iti puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ| bhāṣye tvākaraḥ pūrvasya vidhīyata ityuktam| cakāreṇa samuccayārthenākārapraśleṣo'numīyate, sautratvācca nirdeśasya prakṛtibhāvābhāvaḥ, prāptāpanne dvitīyāntena saha samasyete, a ca atvaṃ ca bhavati prāptāpannayorityarthaḥ||

5 kālāḥ parimāṇinā || 2.2.5 ||
sāmarthyātparimāṇavacanā iti| parimāṇamapekṣya parimāṇe bhavati, nānyathetyetatmāmarthyam| tatra ca yadyapi kālaḥ prasthādivatsarvato mānaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi paricchedahetutvātpirimāṇamityucyate| māso jātasyeti| kasya punarayaṃ māsaḥ paricchedakaḥ, na tāvajjātasya, tasya hi diṣṭyādi parimāṇaṃ na tu māsaḥ; nāpi jananakriyā, tasyā ekakṣaṇabhāvitvānmāsena sambandhābhāvāt? ucyate-jananakriyāvadhirmāse na paricchadyate| māso jātasyeti, ko'rthaḥ| jananakriyayā ūrdhvamasya māso jātaḥ, atīte māse'sya jananamiti yāvat| anena pkāreṇa māso jātasya paraṇāmam, yathā-māse deyamṛṇamiti ṛṇadānasyāvadhirmāsena paricchidyate| māsajāta iti| yathā gāvo'sya santīti gomāniti vākye ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyāpi tadvato vṛttau prādhānyam, tatkasya hetoḥ? abhihitaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthau'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti, yathā - citrā gāvo'sya citraguḥ paruṣa iti bahuvrīhāviti, tadvadatrāpi vākye ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyāpi tadvato jātasya vṛttau prādhānyaṃ draṣṭavyam| tathā ca māsajāto dṛśyatāmiti kriyāyogo jātasyaiva bhavati, na punarardhdapippalyādivatpūrvapadārthasya| dvyahajāta iti| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāraḥ `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac' `na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' ityahnādeśasya pratiṣadhaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi dvyahajāta iti, dve ahanī asya jātasyeti trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ yugapadanena samāse kṛte jātaśabda uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayordvigurbhaviṣyati? nanu ca `supsupā' ityekatvasaṃkhyāyā vivakṣitatvād dvayordvayoḥ samāsaḥ, na bahūnāṃ yagapat? ucyate - vaktavyamevaitad uttarapadena parimāṇinā dvayoḥ samāsavacanamiti; parimāṇivacanenottarapadena dvigoḥ sidhdaye samāso vaktavyaḥ| atha dvayoryugapaditi gamyate, tasmādvacanādvahūnāmapyayaṃ samāso bhavati| evaṃ dvau māsau jātasya dvimāsajātaḥ, tripade tatpuruṣe jātaśabda uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayostatpuruṣe sati kālānte dvigāvapi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati| dvayormāsayoḥ samāhāro dvimāsam pātrādi, dvimāsaṃ jātasyeti vigṛhya samāse kriyamāṇe sati śiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodāttatvaṃ samāso bhavati| vṛttau vibhaktau nivṛttāyāṃ dvitvabahutvāvagatau pramāṇābhāvād abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāpyatrana bhavati, śudhdameva tvekatvaṃ gamyate| yatra dvayorbahuṣu vānusyūta ekaḥ śabdārthatsatraivābhedaikatvasaṃkhyā, māsaśabdastvaktaparimāṇamarthamācaṣṭa ita dvitvabahutvāvagatau vibhaktimapekṣate, svatastvekatvasyaivāsādhāraṇaḥ||

6 nañ || 2.2.6 ||
vibhaktiñakārayorviśeṣābhāvād ñakāreccāraṇam| supānaśabdasya viśeṣaṇātpāmādilakṣaṇasya nasyāsuvantatvādevāgrahaṇaṃ sidhdam| ihābrāhmaṇādiśabdaiḥ kṣatriyādyabhidhānamiṣyate, tatra jātimātrapare brāhmaṇaśabde na vidyate brāhmaṇyaṃ yasya so'brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyādirityanyapadārthapradhānaḥ samāso bhavati| tatra nāprāpte bahuvrīhāvārambhādena tasya bādhanādabrāhmaṇako deśa ityāpi na sidhdyati; na hi pravṛttinimittamātraniṣṭheṣu brāhmaṇādiśabdeṣvayaṃ samāsaḥ, na tadvanniṣṭheṣvati niyāmakamasti| iha cāvarṣā hemanta iti hemantasya yadvacane tatsamāsasya prāpnoti, liṅge tu paravalliṅgamiti vacanāddoṣabhāvaḥ| iha ca aso'sarvasmai ityuttarapadārthasyopasarjanatvāttyadādikāryaṃ sarvādikāryaṃ ca na syāt| yadā tvasatsāmānāyavartamāno nañ brāhmaṇādibhirviśeṣyate, brāhmaṇatvenāsatkriyāntareṇa tu san kṣatriyādiko'brāhmaṇa iti, tadā pūrvapadārthapradhānam; tatra ऩñarthasya prādhānyātsaṃkhyāyogaḥ samāsasya na syāt, vācanikī tu paravalliṅgatā bhavatu| syādetat - śabdaktisvābhāvyādasattvarūpamarthaṃ vākye na nañācaṣṭe, samāse tu sattvarūpam, tena sidhdaḥ saṃkhyāyogaḥ? evamapyapavādenānenāvyayībhāvasya bādhādamakṣikamiti na sidhdyati, tasya tu nirmakṣikamityādiravanakāśaḥ, aso'sarvasmai iti ca pūrvavatsmāyādyasidhdiḥ| astu tarhyatrottarapadārthapradhānaḥ? yadyevam, brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? yadyuttarapadārthapradhānatā tatra hetuḥ, ihāpi tarhi rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puraṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? astyatra viśeṣaḥ, rājā viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate| ihāpi tarhi nañ viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate? kathaṃ nañ nāma syāt, aniyataguṇasya guṇaviśeṣapratipādanāya hi viśeṣaṇaṃ pravarttate, na tadupaghātāya| nañā ca brāhmaṇārthaḥ sarvātmanā pratiṣidhyamānaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti kathamasataḥ prādhānyaṃ syāt! tasmāduttarapadārthaprādhānyamicchatā'sminviṣaye nañanarthakaḥ, anvākhyanasāmarthyāttu sādhutvamevaṃbhūtasyārthavadanarthakāvayavasya samāsasyeti vācyam, tataśca brahmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa deṣaḥ; nivṛttapadārthako'tra brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ prasidhdivaśānmukhyameva brāhmaṇamācaṣṭe; nañ‌prayogeṇa tu kṣatriyādau sādṛśyādinā nimittenādhyāropitaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ na tāttvikamiti dyetyate| tadevaṃ mukhyo brāhmaṇaśabdasyārtho nivṛttaḥ jātaścāmukhyaḥ kṣatriyādiriti na brāhmaṇamātrānayanam, nāpi na kasyacidānayanamiti sidhdam| uktaṃ ca -
`prāk samāsātpadārthānāṃ nivṛttirdyotyate nañā|
svābhāvato nivṛttānāṃ rūpabhedālakṣitā' || iti |
syādetat - arthapratyāyanāya śabdaḥ prayudyate brāhmaṇārthaścennivṛttaḥ, kiṃ mudhā brāhmaṇapadaṃ prayujyate? tanna; asati brāhmaṇapade netyetāvatyucyamāne kasyārtho'tra nivarttayitumiṣṭa iti na jñāyate| brāhmaṇapade tu sati datarthasya kṣatriyādau mukhyaḥ sattāvirahaḥ pratiyate| anyaddarśanam - sarva ete śabdā guṇasamudāye varttante, smaryante ca -
`tapaḥ śrutaṃ ca yoniścetyetadrabrāhmaṇyakāraṇam|
tapaḥśrutābhyāṃ yo hīno jātibrāhmaṇa eva saḥ' || iti |
tathā ca śrutiḥ -
`ṣaḍ vyādhayo yaṃ puruṣaṃ tapanti daihvo hārda audaro raitasaśca|
taptaśca dharmaḥ śiśiraśca śītaḥ brāhmaṇastaṃ smarārthaṃ garutman|| iti|
gauraḥ śucyācāraḥ piṅgalakeśa ityādayaśca dharmāḥ, tadeṣāṃ samudāye brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, evaṃ kṣatriyādiśabdeṣvapi draṣṭavyam| evaṃ sthite samudāyeṣu vṛttāḥ śabdāḥ avayaveṣvapi varttanta iti nyāyājjātibhinne guṇabhinne vā yadā brāhmaṇaśabdo varttate tadā svābhāvikī jātigaṇanivṛttirnañā dyotyate, aviṣṭāṃśasadbhāvapratipādanāya brāhmaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ| yadyevam, dvayorapi bhinnaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaḥ, katham? yasyāṃśasya sadbhāvaṃ brāhmaṇaśabda āha, na tasyābhāvaṃ nañāha; yasyābhāvaṃ nañāha, na tasya sadbhāvaṃ brāhmaṇaśabda āha? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dvāvapyetau samudāyāvalambinau kṛtavat, tadyathaikadeśakaraṇākaraṇābhyāmekameva vastu kṛtaṃ cākṛtaṃ ca bhavati, tathehāpyekadeśavibhāgāt samudāya eva nivṛtta ucyate, ekadeśasadbhāvācca sa eva sannabhidhāyata iti sarvamanavadyam| ihāneko jana āgata ita dvyādiṣvekatvamāropitaṃ pratīyate, mukhyaṃ ti pratiṣidhyate, kṣatriyādāviva brāhmaṇyamityekavacanameva bhavati dvyādisaṃkhyā pratīyate| tadevamuttarapadārthapradhāna iti sthitam| atra ca liṅgam - `etattadoḥ sulopo'koranañ' ityatrānañsamāsagrahaṇam' anyathaitattadorarthadvāreṇa sambandhinaḥ sorlopo vidhīyamāno naiṣo dadātyaso dadātītyatra kathaṃ prāpnuyāt| iha na brāhmaṇasya bhāva iti bhāvena nañā ca yugapatsambandhe vivakṣite tvatalau ca prāpnutaḥ, samāsaśca; tatra yadi paratvāttvatalau kṛtvā paścātpunaḥ prasaṅgavijñānānnañsamāsaḥ kriyate, tataḥ `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarṇaādyudāttaṃ padaṃ syāt, pratyayasvaro nañsvaraśceṣyata iti samāse kṛte tvatalau kāryau| āha ca - tvatalbhyāṃ nañsamāsaḥ pūrvavipratiṣidhdaṃ tvatalo svarasidhdyarthamiti| tatra bhāvapratyayastāvatprakṛtyarthasya sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyānna bhavati, nañsamāsastu pradhānasya sāpekṣatvādbhavati||

7 īṣadakṛtā || 2.2.7 ||
īṣad guṇavacaneneti vaktavyamiti| akṛtetyapanāya sūtre guṇavacanagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| akṛteti cocyamāna īṣadrārgya ityādāvativyāptiḥ, īṣadunnata ityādāvavyāptiḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| īṣadrārgya iti| nanu ca gārgyo bhavati vā na vā na punarīṣadrārgyaḥ kaściti? ucyate; gārgyatvena saha ya ekārthasamavetāḥ kriyāguṇāstadapekṣayā jāteḥ prakarṣīdiyogaḥ - gārgyataraḥ, gārgyakalpaḥ, īṣadrārgyaḥ, gārgyapāśa iti; yathā - gotaraḥ, gokalpaḥ, gopāśa iti||

8 ṣaṣṭhī || 2.2.8 ||
kṛdyogā cetyādi| `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti kṛcchabdopādānena yā vihitā sā kṛdyogā| idhmapravraścana iti| `ovraścū cchedane', karaṇe lyuṭ| palāśaśātana iti| palāśāni śātyante - yena daṇḍādinā sa palāśaśātanaḥ| kimarthamidamucyata iti| sūtreṇa sidhdiṃ manvānasya praśnaḥ| pratipadavidhānācetyādi| yadā tasya vaktavyasyārambhaḥ tadedamapi vaktavyam| tasya tvanārabhyatāṃ tataiva vakṣyāmaḥ| apakarṣa iti| apavāda ityarthaḥ||

9 yādakādibhiśca || 2.2.9 ||
pratiprasavārthamiti| anyena nivartitasya punaḥ pravṛttyabhyanujñānam - pratiprasavaḥ| tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti vaktavyamiti kvacidvṛttau paṭhyate, tasmārthaḥ - tacchabdaina sannidhānād guṇā eva parāmṛśyante, tasmistvātmani ye guṇāḥ sthitāstaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| na ca svātmanyavasthānaṃ kasyacitsambhavati, bhedanibandhano hyādhārādheyabhāvaḥ; viśeṣato guṇānāṃ dravyāśritatvāt| tasmādabhidhānavyāpārāpekṣayā tatsthatvamucyate| gandhādayo hi guṇāḥ svaśabdairdravyātpṛthakkṛtā eva ca pratyāyyante - candanasya gandha iti, na tu kadācid dravyeṇaikatvamāpannāḥ, na hi bhavati candanaṃ gandha iti| śuklādayastu kadācid dravyātpṛthagbhūtāḥ pratyāyyante - paṭasya śukla iti, kadācid dravyasyoparañjakāstenaikatvamāpannāḥ śaklaḥ paṭa iti| tatra ye guṇā dravyātpṛthagbhūtā eva svāśadvena pratyāyyante tatparigrahāya `tatsthaiḥ' ityuktam| balākāyāḥ śaukalyamityatra tu yadyapi śauklyaśabdena dravyātpṛthagbhūtasyaivābhidhānam, tathāpi tadeva śauklyaṃ paṭa ityatra dravyemaikatāmāpannaṃ pratyāyyate| arthasya tatsthatvamāśrīyate, iti śabdabhede'pyarthaḥ sa eteti nāsti śauklyasya tatsthatvamiti samāsābhāvaḥ| pūpavānpaṭa ityatra bhedāśrayeṇaiva matvarthīyenābhedo'dhyavasīyate iti tatsthameva rūpamiti paṭarūpamiti bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| ayamapi `gaṇana na' iti pratiṣedhasya parastādapakarṣaḥ| candagandha iti| `gandhaṃ vikrīṇīte' iti candanagandhādau gandhaśabdo jātinimttakaḥ, na guṇaśabdaḥ; mālatīkusumādiṣvadarśanāditi tatstha eva gandhaḥ| bhāṣye tu `na tu tadviśeṣaṇaiḥ' iti paṭhitam, teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yāni viśeṣaṇāni taiḥ saha samāso na bhavati ghṛtasya tīvro gandhaḥ, candanasya mṛduḥ sparśa iti tīvramṛduśabdābhyāṃ samāso na bhavati| tadidamanyathāsidhdamiti vṛttikārṇa upekṣitam, katham? ghṛtasya gandhena sambandhaḥ, na tadviśeṣaṇena tīvreṇa| yadāpi prakaraṇādivaśāttīvraśabdaḥ eva viśeṣe gandhe vartate, tadupajanita eva vyatireke ghṛ-tasyeti ṣaṣṭhī; tathāpi tīvra ghṛtamiti darśanāttatsthatvābhāvādeva samāsāprasaṅgaḥ||

10 na nirghāraṇe|| 2.2.10 ||
na nirddhāraṇe|| jātiguṇakriyābhiriti| upalakṣaṇametat; kataro bhavatordevadatta iti saṃjñāyāmapi nirddhāraṇadarśanāt| kṣatriyo manuṣyāṇāṃ śūratama iti| atra kṣatriyaśabdena samāsaprasaṅgaḥ; tadapekṣayā hi manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhī, na śūratamāpekṣayā, guṇaśabdatvācca na tena samāsaprasaṅgaḥ| kṛṣṇā gavāmiti| nātrāyamarthaḥ----gavāṃ madhye yā kṛṣṇā sā sampannakṣīratameti, evaṃ hi kṛṣṇāśabdasya gavāmityanena sambandhaḥ| na ca tasya samāsaprasaṅgaḥ; guṇena neti pratiṣedhāt| tasmādravāṃ madhye yā sampannakṣīratamā sā kṛṣṇetyayamatrārthaḥ| dhāvannadhvagānāmiti| atra dhāvacchabdena samāsāprasaṅgaḥ; satsaṃjñakatvāt| śīghratamaśabdastu guṇaśabdo na veti cintyam| pratipadavidhānā ceti| śeṣalakṣaṇāṃ muktvā sarvānyā pratipadavidhānā ṣaṣṭhī| kathaṃ gṛhasvāmī, vidyādāyādaḥ, pṛthivīśvara iti, yāvatā `svāmīśvara' ityādinā pratipadamatra ṣaṣṭhī ? nānena ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? saptamī| sā tu ṣaṣṭhīṃ mā bādhiṣṭeti cakāreṇa śeṣalakṣaṇaivābhyanujñāyate| ata eva `na nirddhāraṇe' iti sūtrārambhaḥ| `yataśca nirddhāraṇam' ityatrāpi hi cakāreṇa śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī pratiprasūyate; anyathā sāpi pratipadavidhānaiva syāditi kiṃ `na nirddhāraṇe' ityanena| sarpiṣo jñānamiti| `jño'vidarthasya karaṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhī| atrāhuḥ---`jño'vidarthasya karaṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe `śeṣe' iti varttate, tatra na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditivat `ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' ityanenaiva siddhā ṣaṣṭhī, prakaraṇaṃ tu niyamārtham| ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva śrūyata eva, na tasyāḥ samāso bhavatītyarthaḥ| samāse `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti subluk syāt| tasmātpratipadavidhānā ceti na vaktavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā `kṛdyogā ca' ityapi na vaktavyam, `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityatra hi `śeṣe' iti nivṛttamiti vakṣyate, tena kartṛkarmavivakṣāyāmaprāptaiva ṣaṣṭhī tena vidhīyata iti kutaḥ samāsanivṛttiriti||
pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena|| 2.2.11 ||
pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena|| pratyekamiti| pūraṇādibhirityarthaḥ| svarūpavidhiriti| pūraṇādīnāmarthaparyantānāṃ caturṇāmityarthaḥ| ata eva guṇaśabdena nādeṅāṃ grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? `sattve niviśate'paiti' ityādilakṣaṇalakṣitasya guṇasya grahaṇam; nāpi naño guṇapratiṣedhe yasya guṇasya hi bhāvādivatpravṛttinimittamātrasya grahaṇam, sāmānyāderapi prasaṅgāt; nāpi lokaprasiddhasya śuklādereva grahaṇam, kaṇṭakasya taikṣṇyamityāderapīṣṭatvāt; guṇaśabdena ca kevalaguṇavācino guṇopasarjanadravyavācinaśca vyāptinyāyāśrayeṇa gṛhyante| tatra guṇasya guṇyapekṣatvātkevalaguṇavacanairguṇena samāsaniṣedhaḥ----kaṇṭakasya taikṣṇyamiti| guṇavacanaistu tatsambandhino niṣedhaḥ----brāhmaṇasya śuklā dantā iti, na cātra dantāpekṣayā brāhmaṇasyeti ṣaṣṭhī, tataśca śuklenāsambandhādaprasaṅga eva samāsasya| yadā tarhyarthātprakaraṇādvā dantā dyarthaṃ eva śuklādiśabdasya vṛttirvijñātā bhavati, tadā tatsambandha eva ṣaṣṭhītyasti samāsaprasaṅgaḥ, `śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt', `krośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānam' `khārīśatamapi na dadāti' ityādi munitrayaprayogād goviṃśatirityādau saṃkhyayā samāso na niṣidhyate| saṃjñāpramāṇatvāduttarapadārthaprādhānyamityādiprayogadarśanādanityo guṇena niṣedha iti karaṇapāṭavaṃ buddhimāndyaṃ yatnagauravamityādisiddhiḥ|
phalānāṃ suhita iti| karaṇasyaiva śeṣatvavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, śeṣatvavivakṣaiva ca niyatā suhitārthayoge karaṇasyetyāhuḥ, kṛdyogalakṣaṇāyā eva ṣaṣṭhyā niṣṭhāyoge niṣedhaḥ| brāhmaṇasya kurvanniti| neyaṃ ghaṭādyapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī---brāhmaṇasya ghaṭaṃ kurvanniti, evaṃ hyasāmarthyādeva samāsasyāprasaṅgaḥ; kiṃ tarhi? kurvanniti kiṅkara ucyate, sa hi kurvan bhavati, tato yathā brāhmaṇasya pācaka iti sākṣādeva pācakena sambandho na punarodanadvāreṇa, tadvadihāpatīti draṣṭavyam| corasya dviṣanniti ca sata udāharaṇam, atra `dviṣaḥ śaturvā vacanam' iti pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| brāhmaṇasya kṛtveti| brāhmaṇārthaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ, sambandhasāmānyarūpeṇa vivakṣitatvāt ṣaṣṭhī| purā sūryasyodetoriti codāharaṇam, atra hyavyayaprapiṣedhe `tosunorapratiṣedhaḥ' iti karttaryeva ṣaṣṭhyasti| evaṃ vṛkṣasyoparītyādikamapyudāharaṇam| tavyatā sānubandhakeneti| `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya grahaṇam' iti bhāvaḥ| brāhmaṇakarttavyamiti| karttari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntasvaritametat, niranubandhakena tu samāse uttarapadaṃ madhyodāttaṃ syāt, so'yaṃ svarārthastavyenaniṣedhaḥ| śukasya mārāvikasyeti| mā rāvītyāheti mārāvikaḥ, `tadāheti mā śabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' iti ṭhak, śabdena kriyāyāḥ pratiṣedhako mārāvikaḥ, saṃjñaiṣā śukaviśeṣasya, kvacittu mārāvidasyeti pāṭhaḥ, tatra mārāviśabdaṃ dadātīti mārāvidaḥ, sa evārthaḥ| kiṃ ca syāditi| bhavitavyamevātra viśeṣaṇasamāsena, tat ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa evāstu, ko doṣa iti praśnaḥ| pūrvanipātāniyamaḥ syāditi| dvayorapi prathamānirdiṣṭatvenopasarjanatvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu viśeṣaṇasamāse'pi dvayorapi yatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastatreṣyuktam, atastenāpi samāse viśeṣaṇamiti prathamānirdeśo dvayorapi tulyaḥ| atha tatrāpradhānamupasarjanamārthaṃ cāprādhānyamiti dravyaguṇādiṣu tena prakāreṇa vyavasthā, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'pi tathaiva vyavasthā bhaviṣyati| tasmādyattatra pratyudāharaṇam---takṣakaḥ sarpa iti, tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhyantayoḥ samāsaprasaṅga eva doṣaḥ, tannivṛttaye ca pratiṣedha iti vācyam| tadiha `kiṃ ca syāt' ityādikamevānupapannam, udāharaṇaṃ tūpapannam yadi mārāvikaśabdaḥ saṃjñā| atha so'pi yogavṛttiḥ tarhi tadapyanupapannam| evaṃ pāṭaliputrake'pi draṣṭavyam||
ktena ca pūjāyām|| 2.2.12 ||
ktena ca pūjāyām|| tasyeti| matyādisūtravihitasya sarvasyaiva ktasya grahaṇaṃ na tu pūjāyāmeva vihitasyetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi pūjāgrahaṇamityāha----pūjāgrahaṇamiti| vivakṣitasya ktasya taṭasthamupalakṣaṇaṃ pūjāgrahaṇam, gṛhasyeva kākaḥ, na tu samāsaniṣedhārthamityarthaḥ| tena matibuddhyorapi vihitasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| pūjāyāṃ vihita iti| varttamānāditi śeṣaḥ| rājñāmiti| `ktasya ca vartamāne' iti ṣaṣṭhī| kathaṃ rājābhimata iti, asti hi bhaṭṭikāvye prayogaḥ----`kānahaṃ sa rāmamahitaḥ kṛtavān' iti, `maha pūjāyām' rāmasya mahita ityarthaḥ? kaścidāha----"yadā vartamāne ktastadā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhaśca, yadā bhūte ktastadā kartari tṛtīyaiva bhavati, yathā----`pūjito yaḥ surairapi' iti, tasyāḥ `kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ" iti| syādevaṃ yadi bhūte kto labhyaḥ, na; nāprāpte tasminnārabhyamāṇaḥ `bhatibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti vartamāne ktastasya bādhako bhavati, yathā ca vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācya iti apatye prāpto ṭhak tato'pakṛṣya vidhīyate, apatye tvaṇeva bhavatīti vakṣyati| evaṃ ca `pūjito yaḥ surairapi' ityacikatsyo'paśabdaḥ| tvayā jñāto mayā jñāta tu bhavatyeva; tenetyadhikāre upajñāta iti nirdeśāt|
apara āha---`ktena ca pūjāyām' ityādiṣu kārakaṣaṣṭhyā eva niṣedhaḥ| tadeva tu karttādikārakaṃ yadā śeṣarūpeṇa vivakṣyate tadā bhavatyeva samāsa iti| tatra svare viśeṣaḥ, kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāse kṛtsvaro bhavati, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāse samāsāntodāttatvamiti| evaṃ tu yat `janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ', `tatprayojako hetuśca' ityādāvucyate---`nipātanātsamāsaḥ' iti, tadanupapannam; śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā eva samāsasya siddhatvāt| atha ye'mī navīnā vaiyākaraṇā ārabhante tadapārthakamāpadyeta| tasmādāptaprayogasya yathākathaṃcinnirvāhaḥ, na tu yathāruci padyayoga iti dhīrā manyante||
`ktena' iti nivṛttam| karmagrahaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇam| karmaṇi ca yā ṣaṣṭhī sā na samasyate| `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti ṣaṣṭhyā idaṃ graharagam| āścaryo gavāṃ doho'gopālakena| rocate odanasya bhojanaṃ devadattena| sādhu khalu payasaḥ pānaṃ devadattena| vicitrā sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇininā||
adhikaraṇavācinā ca|| 2.2.13 ||
adhikaraṇavācinā ca|| `adhikaraṇa' ityeva siddhe vācigrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, katham? `kavṛtte lipsāyām',`yad‌vṛttānnityam' iti, nāyamadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, ka tarhi? bhāve| kimo vṛtaṃ yasmin yado vṛtaṃ yasminniti vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ||
karmaṇi ca|| 2.2.14 ||
karmaṇi ca || ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti| anekārthatvānnipātānāmitītyarthe caśabdo'yam, tena karmaṇītyuccārya yā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate sā na samasyata ityarthaḥ| yadi ca yā kācana karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī gṛhyeta `kartari ca' iti niṣedhaṃ na kuryād; aneneva siddhatvāt| sādhu payasaḥ pānamiti| karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśāditi nityasamāsārthavacanamiti vakṣyati, tatra payaḥ sukhamityudāhariṣyate| idaṃ tu śarīrasukhasyāvivakṣāyāṃ rogādyabhibhūto'śaknuvanneva yadā sādhu pibati, tadā draṣṭavyama||
tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari|| 2.2.15 ||
tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari|| kartṛ grahaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇamiti| atha kasmādviparyayayo nāśrīyate---iha tṛjakaviśeṣaṇaṃ kartṛ grahaṇamuttaratra ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣaṇamiti, evaṃ tṛjgrahaṇamuttarārthamiti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? ucyate; `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' ityatra tṛjgrahaṇasyānanuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta `karttari ca' ityatra sambandhāsambhavāt, na hi tṛjprayoge kartari ṣaṣṭhī sambhavatīti| nanu ca `tṛjkrīḍājīvikayornāstītyakaevodāhriyate' iti vakṣyati, evaṃ tarhi tathānāśritamityeva| bhavataḥ śāyiketi| `paryāyārhaṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc'| tṛcprayoge karttari ṣaṣṭhī nāstīti| tenaiva karturabhihitatvāt|
ikṣubhakṣikāmiti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| ma iti| `dhāreruttamarṇa' iti saṃpradāne caturthī||
karttari|| 2.2.16 ||
karttari|| sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavatītyāha sāmarthyāditi| sambandhiśabdasyeti| avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasīti bhāvaḥ| anyastvāha---hotṛśabdasāhacaryāditi; tanna, na hi tatra bahvaco hotā gṛhyate| sa eva sambandhiśabdaḥ kṣīrahotetyādau kṣīptetyeva gamyate||
nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ|| 2.2.17 ||
nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ|| neti nivṛttamiti| nityagrahaṇād, mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvilakpenaiva pākṣikasya pratiṣedhasya siddhatvānnityaḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, kiṃ nityagrahaṇena ! tṛc krīḍājīvikayornāstīti| vāmanastu `ake jīvikārtha' ityatra `aka iti kiṃ ramaṇīyakartā' iti jīvikāyāṃ tṛcaṃ pratyudāhariṣyati| sa manyate---mā bhūtkrīḍāyāṃ tṛc, lakṣaṇābhāvāt, jīvikāyāṃ tu ṇvultṛcāviti ṇvuliva tṛc kasmānna syāditi| anye tu tadanusāreṇedamapyevaṃ vyācakṣate---krīḍājīvikayornāstīti dvyornāsti, kintvanyataratraivetyarthaḥ| aka evodāhriyata iti| ubhayatretyarthaḥ| uddālakapuṣpabhañjiketyādau| saṃjñāyāmiti ṇvula| nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham| na hi vākyena krīḍājīvikayoravagatirasti, kriyākārakasambandhamātrāvagamāt||
kugatiprādayaḥ|| 2.2.18 ||
kugatiprādayaḥ|| kuśabdo'vyayaṃ gṛhyata iti| svarādiṣvapaṭhito'pyayaṃ paṭhitavya iti bhāvaḥ| nityasamāsaviṣayasyāsya pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāṇāmavyayatvam, yathā vakṣyati---avyaye nañkunipātānāmiti vaktavyamiti| na dravyavacana iti| pṛthivyādidravye yo vartate sa na gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| durnindāyāmiti| praśapte dveṣānnindā bhavati, pāpaṃ tu vastusthityā garhitamiti dvayorapyupādānam|
prāyikamiti| anyatheṣadarthe ceti koḥ kādeśavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt| duṣkṛtamiti| durnindāyāmiti viṣayanirdeśo gatitvena prāptasyāpi samāsasya niyāmakaḥ syāditi manyate| yadā tu prādigrahaṇaprāptasyaiva niyāmakastadā gatitvādevātra siddhaḥ samāsaḥ| duratra kṛcchrārtho'nabhidhānātkṛteḥ khal na bhavati, duṣkara ityādāvupapadasamāsaḥ, āmandrairindra haribhirityāṅo mandraṃ pratyagatitvādanīṣadarthatvācca samāsābhāva ityaikasvarthaṃ na bhavati| suṣṭutamiti| suśabdo'tiśaye, na pūjāyām| ata evopasarganibandhanaṃ ṣatvam| atistutamiti| `atiratikramaṇe ca' iti karmapravacanīyatvātṣatvābhāvaḥ||
prādayo gatādyartha iti| vṛttiviṣaye gatādyarthavṛttayaḥ prādayo gatitvābhāve'pi prādigrahaṇena samasyanta iti|
paryadhyayana iti| pariśrānto'dhyayanārthamityarthaḥ|
vāsasī iveti| `vaserṇicca' ityasunpratyayānto vāsaḥ śabdaḥ, vastraśabdaḥ ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ, dvāvapi nityādyudāttau|
prādiprasaṅga iti| sūtre prādigrahaṇamagatyarthamiti karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedha ucyate, pratyādiviṣayaścāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| svatyostu samāso bhavatyeva| vṛkṣaṃ pratīti| karmapravacanīyena yogād dvitīyāvatsamāsasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ, udāttavatā siṅā gateḥ samāsavacanam---yo jāta eva paryabhūṣat, yaḥ śambaramanvavindat, yo'ntarikṣaṃ vimame, yau vai prajavaṃ yātām, apathena pratipadyate||
upapadamatiṅ|| 2.2.19 ||
upapadamatiṅ|| edhānāhārako vrajatīti| `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' iti ṇvul| atiṅiti kimiti| yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭaṃ tamāviṣkaroti|
nanu ceti| etajjñāpayatīti| syādetat---mukhyasya tiṅantasya pratiṣedho'narthaka iti| yastena samānārthaḥ subantastasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate| tatra yadyapi kālakārakasaṃkhyopagrahayuktaḥ pūrvāparībhūtaḥ kriyārūpastiṅantārthapradhāno'rtho na subantasya sambhavati, tathāpi kriyāvācitvamātreṇa tadarthatvamāśrīyate, kriyāvācyupapadaṃ na samasyata ityarthaḥ| tena kārako gataḥ, kārakasya vrajyeti gatabrajyāśabdayoḥ kārakaśabdena samāso na bhavati; anyathā hi kriyārthāyāmiti saptamīnirdeśenopapadatvādanayorapi samāsaḥ syāditi? tanna; anupapadatvāt| kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmiti saptamīnirdeśena kriyāvācina upapadatvam, dhāturevātra kriyāvacanastadāśrayaśca ṇvul pratyayaḥ| gataśabdastu kriyopasarjanaṃ karttāramāha, vrajyāśabdo'pi yastasya siddhatā nāma dharmastatra dhañādayo bhavantīti dhātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ vartante, ato yatkriyāvācitvādupapadaṃ na tatsubantam, yatmubantaṃ na tatkriyāvāci nāpyupapadamiti nārtha evamanātiṅgrahaṇena|
etayoryogayoriti| nanu cāsminneva yoge tadanabhisambandho yuktaḥ, yatrātiṅgrahaṇamasti, na pūrvatra? evaṃ manyate---yogavibhāgenātiṅgrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtreṇāpi sambandhanīyamiti| yadyevam, kuśabde prādiṣu cātiprasaṅgaḥ, tatrāpi prāk subutpatteḥ samāsaḥ syāt? evaṃ tarhi pūrvasūtre gatigrahaṇaṃ pṛthakkṛtya tenaivātiṅgrahaṇaṃ sambandhanīyam|
gatikārakopapadānām, asyāyamarthaḥ---gatīnāṃ kārakāṇāmupapādānāṃ ca kṛdbhiḥ saha yaḥ samāsastenatena lakṣaṇena sa uttarapadātsubutpatteḥ prāgeva kāryaḥ, pūrvapadantu subantameva samasyata iti| gatīnāṃ tāvat---vyājighratīti vyāghrī,`pāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ' iti prāptasya jighrateḥ `saṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti niṣedhāt `ātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, vyāṅorghraśabdena gatisamāsaḥ, sa yadyuttarapade subante jāte paścātsyāt, tataḥ subutpattaye saṃkhyākarmādiyogo vivakṣitavyaḥ, tadyogācca prāgeva liṅgayogaḥ svārthamabhidhāya śabda iti nyāyāt, tataśca liṅganimittaḥ pratyayo bhavan ghraśabdamātrasyājātivācitvādāp syāt, tataśca vyāṅorghrāśabdena samāsaḥ, tato vyāghrāśabdasya jātitve'pyanakārāntatvājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ na syāt; prāk subutpatteḥ samāso bhavan liṅgayogamapi nāpekṣata ityantaraṅgatvātsa eva tāvadbhavati paścātstrīpratyayo bhavanṅīṣeva bhavati, pūrvapadasya tu subantatvātpadakāryāṇi bhavanti, nirgata iti rutvam, saṃyyanteti parasavarṇavikalpa ityādīni| kārakāṇām‌ abhrerliptā'bhraliptī, `kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, yadyuttarapadasya subantatvaṃ syātpūrvavaṭṭāp syāt, tataḥ `krītātkaraṇapūrvāt' `ktādalpākhyāyām' iti ṅīṣ na syād; ata ityadhikārāt, vacanasāmārthyādvā pūrvaśabdaṃ vyavasthāvacanamāśritya vākyāvasthāyāmeva syāt, ata ityadhikāro vā vyavacchidyeta| prāk‌ subutpatteḥ samāse pūrvavatsiddhamiṣṭam| atrāpi pūrvapadasya subantātvāccarmakrītītyādau nalopādikāryāṇi bhavanti| upapadānām--kacchena pibatīti `supi sthaḥ' ityatra supīti yogavibhāgātkaḥ, kacchapī, vyāghrītulyam, māṣānvapati `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' māṣavāpiṇī, ṅīpaḥ prāk samāse prātipadikasyānto nakāra iti ṇatvaṃ bhavati| subantasya tu samāse ṅīpsamāsasyānto na tu nakāra iti na syāt| atrāpi pūrvapadasyasubantatvāccarmakārādau nalopādipadakārya bhavatyeva| atropapadagrahaṇaṃ gatikārakavyatiriktopapadaparigrahārtham--mṛṣāvāpiṇī, iṣaddarśāyā apatyaṃ aiṣaddarśeyaḥ, atra darśaśabdena samāse sati samudāyātstrībhyo ḍhakaṃ bādhitvā darśāśabdāt strīpratyayalakṣaṇo ḍhak syāt, strīpratyaye tadādiniyamābhāve'pi darśāśabdādapi kadācitsyādityeṣā dik|
jātānyasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ prayojanāni| kathaṃ punatiṅgrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ, yāvatā prathamāntamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ prathamāntasyaiva subgrahaṇasya nivṛttiṃ sūcayediti pūrvapade padakāryāṇi na syuḥ, uttarapade coktamiṣṭaṃ na sidhyati, tadetatkriyamāṇamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ viparyayameva sādhayati, tadapi gatyupapadayoreva kārakeṣu tu `kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityādāvasyāḥ kathāyā aprasaṅga eva? ucyate---yogavibhāgenātiṅgrahaṇaṃ gatināpi saṃbadhyata ityuktam, evaṃ sthite yogadvayavihitasamāsamatiṅgrahaṇena viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ----gatiḥ samasyate atiṅ samāso bhavati, upapadaṃ samasyate atiṅ ca samāso bhavatīti| tadevam` māṅi luṅ' mā kārṣīdityādau tiṅantena samāso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyamāṇamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ supeti tṛtīyāntasya nivṛttiṃ sādhayatīti gatyupapadayostāvatsiddhimiṣṭam| vṛttāvapi `sup supeti na saṃbadhyate' iti samudāyasya nivṛttirvivakṣitā, na kevalasya subgrahaṇasya| pratyudāharaṇamapi diṅmātraṃ pradarśitam, na hi tatra tiṅantena samāsaḥ, ki tarhi? tiṅantasya subannena, `karttṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityatrāpi kṛteti na vaktavyam, katham ? karttṛ karaṇayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvātkriyāvacanena tāvatsamāsaḥ,dhātuśca kriyāvacanaḥ, dhātośca dvaye pratyayāḥ---kṛtastiṅaśca, tatra subadhikārāttiṅantenāprasaṅgaḥ, tadetat kṛd‌grahaṇaṃ kṛdantāvasthāyāmeva yathā syādityevamarthamiti kecit|
neti vayam| kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatitarām, dadhnā bhuktapūrvītyādau taddhitāntena samāso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛd‌gahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ kaṣṭaśritādiṣu prāksubupatteḥ samāso na sādhita iti kaṣṭaśritetyādi na siddhyati| eva tarhi gatikārakopapadānāmiti paribhāṣā pūrvācāryaiḥ paṭhitā sūtrakāreṇāpyatiṅgrahaṇena taddeśa āśrītā| tatra sāmānyāpekṣāṃ jñāprakamiti kṛtsnameva paribhāṣārthaṃ jñāpayatīti siddhamiṣṭam|
tadetatpratipadyantāṃ bhāṣye kṛtapariśramāḥ|
nānye sahasramapyandhāḥ sūrya paśyanti nāñjasā||
amaivāvyayena || 2.2.20 ||
amaivāvyayena|| svāduṅkāramiti| svādumi ṇamul, svādumītyata eva nipātanātpūrvapadasya māntatvam| svādumītyarthagrahaṇam, tena saṃpannakāramityatrāpi bhavati| nanu siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamāya bhavati, evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ? iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ yathā vijñāyeta---amaivāvyayeneti, maivaṃ vijñāyi---amāvyayenaiveti| anavyayasyāsambhavādevāyaṃ niyamo na bhaviṣyati| nanu cāyamasti svaśayaṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti---`adhikaraṇe śeteḥ' ityac, `ato'm' iti sorambhāvaḥ, anenānavyavena samāso mā bhūdityevamartho niyamaḥ syāt, na; atra hyantaraṅgatvādanutpanna eva sāvupapadasamāsena bhāvyam, paścātsupeti vidhānavelāyāmanavyayasyāmo'sambhavānniyamāntareṇa vacanasya caritārthatvādviparītaniyamo na bhaviṣyatītyata āha----evakārakaraṇamiti| amaiva yadupapadaṃ tatsamasyate, tadeva samasyata ityakṣarārthaḥ, na punaramaiva samasyata iti| tatrāmaiva yadupapadamityatra tulyavidhānamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ| kiṃ cāmaiva tulyavidhānaṃ yena vākyenāmeva kevalo vidhīyate, na pratyayāntarasahitastena vākyena yadupapadaṃ vidhīyate tatra saptamīnirdeśāttadamaiva tulyavidhānam| niyamāṅgabhūtastvevakāro niyamasvabhāvādeva labhyate---amaiva yattulyavidhānaṃ na tu pratyayāntarotpattau nimittamiti tadapekṣayā'nupapadatvād avyayāntareṇa samāso nāśaṅkanīyaḥ| agre bhojamiti| `vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu' iti ktvāṇamulau| avyayagrahaṇaṃ kim? asatyavyayagrahaṇe `amaiva tulyavidhānaṃ tadevopapadaṃ samasyate' ityucyamāne kumbhakārādāvipi na syāt| atha pūrvasūtrasyānavakāśatvādamaiva tulyavidhānasyopapadasyāvyayaviṣayatvāttadviṣaya eva niyamo vijñāsyata ityucyate? evaṃ tvamaiva niyamaḥ syād---amantenopapadasya yaḥ samāsaḥ so'maiva tulyavidhānasyeti, tatra ko doṣaḥ? agrebhojamityatraiva na syāt, agre bhuktvā, kālo bhoktumityatra tu syādeva; avyayagrahaṇe tu sati avyayenopapadasya yaḥ so'maiva tulyavidhānasyeti vijñānānna kaścidoṣaḥ||
tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyatarasyām|| 2.2.21 ||
tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyatarasyām|| tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnīti| yatpunaramā cānyena tasyāprāpta iti upapadaviśeṣaṇārtha evakāro'tra nānuvarttata iti bhāvaḥ| uccaiḥ kāramiti| yadā samāsastadā kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, `ādirṇamulyanyatarasyām' ityādyudāttatvam| yadā tu na samāsaḥ, tadoccairityantodāttam; svarādiṣu tathā pāṭhāt| kāramityādyudāttam||
ktvā ca|| 2.2.22 ||
ktvā ca|| ktveti tṛtīyāntam| `ātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ, yathā---`samāse'nañpūrve ktve lyap' iti `ktvi skandisyandyoḥ' iti||
śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ|| 2.2.23 ||
śeṣe bahuvrīhiḥ|| upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa iti| `śiṣa asarvopayoge' ityasmātkarmaṇi ghañ| kaśca śeṣa iti| nanu copayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa ityuktam, satyam, sarveṣāmeva padānāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣarūpeṇopayogātsarveṣu ca pūrvottarānyapadārtheṣu yathāyogaṃ tatpuruṣāvyayībhāvayorvidhānādupayuktādanyo na sambhavatīti punaḥ praśnaḥ| uktaṃ ca---`śeṣagrahaṃ padataścennābhāvādarthataścedaviśiṣṭam' iti| yatrānyaḥ samāso nokta iti| yeṣāṃ padānāṃ yasminnarthe'vyayībhāvādikaḥ samāso na vihitaḥ sa śeṣa ityarthaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate----spatasu supāṃ trikeṣu yasya trikasya śrṛṅgagrāhikayā samāso noktaḥ, yathā---prathamāyāḥ,sa śeṣa iti? kaṇṭhekāla ityādāvaprathamāntānāmapi samāsasyeṣṭatvāt| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ prākkaḍārātparaṃ kāryamityasminpakṣe kartavyam, ekasaṃjñādhikārapakṣe na kartavyamityākaḍārasūtra eva pratipāditam||
anekamanyapadārthe|| 2.2.24 ||
anekamanyapadārthe|| anekaṃ subantaṃ saha samasyata iti| parasparamityarthaḥ| tadanena subityetadatrānuvartate, na supetyetad; uttarapadasyāpyanekamityanenaiva pratipāditatvāditi darśayati| sarveṣu vibhaktyartheṣviti| padena prakṛtyarthopasarjanaḥ pratyayārtho'bhidhīyata iti vibhaktyarthasya prādhānyāttasyaivānyapadārthagrahaṇena prahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| ata eva prāptodako'yaṃ grāma iti grāmaśabdānuprayogaḥ, anyathā yāvānevārtho grāmapadasya tāvato'bhidhāne gatārthatvānna syāt, yathā---dvandve ca--śabdasya| yadā tu samāsena vibhaktyartha eva sambandhādirabhīpsyate tadā vibhaktirmānuprayoji, dravyasyānabhihitatvāttadvācino'nuprayogaḥ kasmānna syāt yadi vibhaktyartho'bhidhīyate, kathaṃ grāmādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ talliṅgasaṃkhyāyoge vā bahuvrīhirbhavatiprāptodako grāmaḥ, ud‌dhṛtaudanā sthālīti? ucyate---vibhaktyarthasya sambandhāderāśritatvena guṇatvādabhedopacārātsāmānādhikaraṇyamāśrayataśca liṅgavacanāni bhaviṣyanti śuklādivat, yathā---śuklaṃ vastram, śuklā paṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklaiḥ, śuklā iti| nanvevaṃ yathā śuklaśabdena kadācid‌guṇa ucyate, kadācit guṇī; tathā bahurvīhāvapi prāpnoti| naiṣo'sti niyamaḥ----guṇaśabdena kadācid‌guṇamātramabhidhīyat iti, paṭvādiṣvadarśanāt, na hi bhavati devadattasya paṭuriti; tadvadihāpi nityameva guṇiniṣṭhatā bhaviṣyati| evamapi bahuvrīhiṇā yathā vibhaktyarthasyābhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhyādayo na bhavanti, tathā liṅgasaṃkhyayorapyabhidhānāttayorvācakāḥ pratyayā na prāpnuvanti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; svāthiṃkāṣṭābādayaḥ, striyāṃ yadvartate tasmātsvārthikāṣṭabādayo bhavantīti tena bahuvrīhiṇā'bhihite'pi strītve bhaviṣyanti| evaṃ ca kṛtvā `ano bahuvrīheḥ' ityādyupapannaṃ bhavati|
samāsena ca bāhyakriyāpekṣā yā karmādiśaktistadrahitasamāsaprātipadikārthamātrasyaivaikatvāderuktatvāditi karmādigataikatvādipratipādanāya vacanāni bhaviṣyanticitraguṃ paśya, citraguṇā kṛtamiti| evamapi prathamā na prāpnoti, samāsena saṃkhyāyā abhidhānāt? vacanagrahaṇādekaḥ, dvau, bahava itivadbhaviṣyati| atha vā----liṅgamātraṃ saṃkhyāmātraṃ bahuvrīhiṇābhihitaṃ na viśeṣastatrāvaśyaṃ viśaiṣārthinā tadvācī śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, evaṃ ca kṛtvā saha prakṛtvā saha prakṛtyarthena vibhaktyarthe bahuvrīhiṇābhidhīyamāne'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ| kathaṃ sāmānyamanabhihitaṃ viśeṣasyānuprayogaḥ? sāmānyasya tarhi na prāpnoti----devadattaḥ kaściditi, sāmānyamapi viśeṣaḥ, yathā viśeṣeṇa viśeṣāntaraṃ vyāvartyate tadvatsāmānyena viśeṣo vyāvartyate, anyathā sandehaḥ syāt---sāmānyamatra vivakṣitam? viśeṣo vā ? iti|
prāptodako grāma ityādini dvitīyādyartheṣu yathākramamudāharaṇāni| ūḍho ratho yena, upahṛtaḥ paśuryasmai, ud‌dhṛta odano yasyāḥ, citrā gāvo yasya, vīrāḥ puruṣā yasminniti vigrahāḥ| prathamārthe tu na bhavatīti| anabhidhānāt, evamanantarādiṣu na bhavati----citrā gāvo yasyānantarā iti| anekamiti kimiti| supsupetyadhikārādeva tatpuruṣavadvahuvrīhirapyekasya na bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| bahūnāmapi yathā syāditi| anyathā supsupeti saṃkhyāyā vivakṣitatvādyathā tatpuruṣo bahūnāṃ na bhavati---mahatkaṣṭaṃ śrita iti, tathā bahuvrīhirapi na syāditi bhāvaḥ| jñāpakātsiddhim, yadayaṃ taddhitārthetyuttarapade dviguṃ rāsti tajjñāpayati---bahūnāmapi samāsa iti| yadyevam, tatpuruṣe'pi prasaṅgaḥ, atha citragurityatrottarapadasyāpyupasarjanasaṃjñā prayojanaṃ kasmānna bhavati, satyanekagrahaṇe supetyasya nivartitatvāduttarapadamapi tenaiva pratyāyyate, tadapi samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ bhavati, nānyathā? evaṃ manyate----citragustiṣṭhati, citraguṃ paśyeti pradhānasyānyapadārthasya nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi varttipadayornityaprathamāntatvādekavibhaktītyeva siddhamupasarjanatvamiti|
susūkṣmajaṭakeśeneti| suṣṭhu sūkṣmā jaṭāḥ keśā asyeti caturṇāṃ bahuvrīhau `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam' iti bahulavacanād‌hrasvatvam,yadvā suṣṭhu sūkṣmā jaṭā yeṣu te susūkṣmajaṭāstāddaśāḥ keśā asyeti punarbahuvrīhiḥ| evaṃ suṣṭhu gajājinaṃ vāsa ācchādanaṃ yasya tena sugajājinavāsasā, tṛtīyāntodāharaṇam; śloke tathā paṭhitatvāt|
`susūkṣmajaṭakeśena sugajājinavāsasā|
samantaśitirandhreṇa dvayorvṛttau na siddhyati'||
iti bhāṣye ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ tatra tu ślokapūraṇārthaṃ tṛtīyānirdeśaḥ| anyagrahaṇaṃ bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorviṣayavibhāgārtham, asati tasmin kaṇṭhekāla ityādau vyadhikaraṇapade sāvakāśaṃ bahuvrīhi svapadārtha iva nīlotpalaṃ sara ityādau samānādhikaraṇe tatpuruṣo bādheta| anyagrahaṇe tu sati svapadārthe sāvakāśaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ paratvādvahuvrīhirbādhata iti na kaściddoṣaḥ|
padagrahaṇaṃ kim? padārthe yathā syādvākyārthe mā bhūt| kaścitkañcinnadyāṃ siṣṇāsumāha----nadyāṃ grāhāḥ santīti, etāni padāni`tasmāttatra mā snāsīḥ' iti vākyārthaṃ gamayantīti teṣāṃ bahuvrīhisaṃjñā prāpnoti| arthagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā padepadāntarasya vṛttyasambhavādeva padārthe bhaviṣyati? kṛtsne padārthe yathā syāt, anyathā prādhānyādvibhaktyartha eva syānna prakṛtyarthe dvavye| tatra yaduktam----abhedopacārāddharmiṇo'bhidhāne siddhe'pi śuklādivaddharmamātrasyāpi kadācidabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, tadanenāpākriyate| paṭvādiśabdavannityaṃ dharminiṣṭho bahuvrīhiriti pratipādanena bahuvrīhiḥ samānādhikaraṇānāmityādirabhidhānasiddhasyārthasya prapañcaḥ|
uccairmukha iti| uccaiso'thikaraṇapradhānatvādvaiyadhikaraṇyādvacanam|
saptamyupamāneti| saptamyantamupamānavāci ca pūrvapada yasya tasya śabdāntareṇa samāsastatrasthasyottarapadasya lopa ityarthaḥ| kaṇṭhestha iti| `supi sthaḥ' iti kaḥ| `amūrddhamastakāt' ityaluk| kaṇṭhesthita iti pāṭhetu saptamīti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| samānādhikaraṇatvātsamāse siddhe vacanamuttarapadalopārtham, tena vaiyadhikaraṇye'pyatra gamakatvamastīti pradarśyate| uṣṭrakhamivoti| avayavadharmeṇa samudāyavyapadeśāduṣṭrasyopamānatetyupamānapūrvapadamuṣṭramukhaśabdaḥ, atropamānopameyayorvauyadhikaraṇyavadvacanamuttarapadalopārthaṃ ca| uṣṭramukha iti| uṣṭro mukhamasyeti| vigrahaḥ, na ca prāṇī prāṇyantarasya mukhamupapadyata iti sāmarthyāt sāddaśyāvagatiḥ, mukhena ca sukhasya sāddaśyaṃ prasiddhamityuṣṭramukhamiva mukhamasyetyayamartho bhavati| tasmāduttarapadalopo na vaktavyaḥ|
samudāyavikāraṣaṣṭhyā iti| samudāyāvayavasaṃbandhe prakṛtivikārasaṃbandhe ca yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantātparaṃ yaduttarapadaṃ tadantasya samāsasya śabdāntareṇa saha bahuvrīhirityarthaḥ| keśacūḍa iti| idamapi keśasamāhāre keśaśabdasya vṛtteḥ siddham| evaṃ svarṇavikāre svarṇaśabdasya vṛtteḥ svarṇālaṅkāra iti siddham| vacanaṃ tu keśamasāhāracūḍaḥ, svarṇavikārālaṅkāra ityuttarapadasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi|
prādibhyo dhātujasyeti| idaṃ na vaktavyameva, prādayo hi sasādhanāṃ kriyāṃ prāhuḥ---yathā niṣkauśāmbīḥ, nirvārāṇasiḥ, prācārya iti| evaṃ naño'styarthānāmityetadapi|
subadhikāra iti| astīti tiṅantamiti matvā vacanaṃ nipātatvātsiddham| upasargavibhaktipratirūpakā nipātāḥ, svarādiṣu cāstiśabdaḥ paṭhyate| iha kiṃ sabrahmacārīti? bahuvrīhirayam| ke sabrahmacāriṇastava, kiṃ sabrahmacārī tvamiti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro hyatreṣyate, tatra kaṭhasabrahmacāryahamiti sambhāvitamprativacanam| yattu kaṭho'hamiti na tatsākṣātprativacanam,kiṃ tarhi? ārthikam| ahaṃ tāvatkaṭha ityukte gamyata etannatu te'pi kaṭhā iti| kaṭhasya hi kaṭhā eva sabrahmacāriṇo bhavanti, nānye| samāne brahmaṇi vratacāryeva sabrahmācārī bhavati| ke sabrahmacāriṇastaveti vākyena tu praśne kaṭhā iti prativacanam| samāsena tu praśne kaṭhā iti prativacanaṃ kadācidapi na bhavati; vartipadārthānāmupasarjanatvāt, kiṃ sabrahmacārītisamāsena sabrahmacāriṇāmabhidhānāt| iha dvau droṇāvarddhadroṇāścārddhatṛtīyā droṇā iti? arddhastṛtīyo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhāvud‌bhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsārtha iti bahuvacanaṃ droṇaśabdaśca droṇayorarddhadroṇe'pi lakṣaṇayā varttata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bhavati||
saṃkhyayāvyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye|| 2.2.25 ||
saṃkhyayāvyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye|| upadaśā iti| `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' iti ḍaci ṭilopaḥ, daśānāṃ samīpe ye bhavanti ta ucyante, te punarnavaikādaśa vā| pūrvapadārthapradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ| upaśabdo'yamārācchabdenaikārthatvātsamīpe samīpini ca vartate| tatra samīpiprādhānye'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| sāmīpyaprādhānye `avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpa' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| upadaśaṃ dantoṣṭhā iti| atra dharmadharmiṇopabhedopacārātsāmānādhikaraṇyam| upaviśā iti| `ti viṃśaterḍiti' iti lopaḥ| āsannā daśānāmāsannadaśāḥ, te'pi navaikādaśa vā| adhikadaśāstvekādaśa| dvau vā trayo vā dvitrāḥ, vārthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| vārthaśca yadi vikalpaḥ syāt, tato yadi dvau bhavatastadā bahuvacanaṃ na syāt| tasmātsaṃśayo'tra vārthaḥ, sa cāniyatasaṃkhyāvimarśaḥ, tatra tu trayo'pi sarvadā parisphurantīti tadapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam| atha vā----pañcaivātra sarvadā bhavanti, katham? vimarśajñānamubhayapakṣālambi ekaṃ ca tatra, yathā---dvau vā trayo vā puruṣā ānīyantāmityatra puruṣaśabde tiṅante ca bahuvacanameva bhavati, kasya hetoḥ? miśriteṣu tayorvṛteḥ| evaṃ dvitripadamapi miśriteṣu vartata iti saiṣā pañcādhiṣṭhānā vāk, ato bahuvacanameva bhavati| ānayanādikārthaṃ tu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā yathāruci bhavati| vākyavadeva samāsasya caiṣā hi āpat, atasteṣu miśriteṣu vṛttiḥ, tena dvau vā puruṣā ānīyantāmiti vākye dviśabdād dvivacanameva bhavati| tricaturā iti| `caturo'cprakaraṇe tryupābhyāmupasaṃkhyānam' ityac| dvidaśā iti| atra dviśabdena daśatvāvṛttigatā dvitvasaṃkhyā pratipādyate, na daśatvasaṃkhyā; ekatvāt| nāpi saṃkhyāyuktāḥ, bahutvāt| tatra vākye sucamantareṇābhyā vṛtteranavagamātsuc bhavati, tataścāsvapadavigrahaḥ kriyate---dvirdaśa dvidaśā iti| vṛttau tu svabhāvādeva sucamantareṇābhyāvṛttisaṃkhyāṃ dviśabda evāheti saṃkhyāvācitvātsamasyate|
nanvatra vārthaḥ sujarthaścānyapadārthe iti pūrveṇaiva siddham, tanna; sucaḥ svārthikatvāttadartho'pi padārtha eva| matvarthe pūrvayogaḥ; amatvarthārtho'yamārambhaḥ| nanu prāptodakādi prathamārthaṃ varjayitvā sarvavibhaktyartheṣu yathābhidhānaṃ bhavatītyuktam, evaṃ tarhi prathamārthe'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ| atha prathamārthaṃ varjayitvetyetadanāddatya yathābhidhānaṃ bhavatītyucyate, evaṃ tarhi tasyaiva prapañcaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ samāsaḥ, avyayānāṃ tu caturdaśādibhiḥ saṃkhyeyavācibhiḥ samāso vidheya eva| kecittu ye viṃśatyādayaḥ saṃkhyāne varttante taiḥ pūrveṇaiva siddham---adhikā viṃśatiryeṣāṃ ta ime'dhikaviṃśāḥ, viṃśatisaṃkhyā āsannā yeṣāṃ te āsannaviṃśā iti, tatra `sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ' iti viṃśatiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, tasmādviṃśatyādyarthamapyavyayādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ kartavyameva||
diṅnāmānyantarāle|| 2.2.26 ||
diṅnāmānyantarāle|| dakṣiṇapūrveti| antarālasyānyapadārthatvātpūrvaṇaiva siddhe vacanamidaṃ tvamatvarthepi yathā syātprathamārthepi yathā syādvaiyadhikaraṇye'pi yathā syāt| kiṃ ca `vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau' ityatra diśāṃ pratipadoktasya bahuvrīhergraharṇa yathā syāt, yāsa pūrvā sottarāsyonmugdhasya tasmai uttarapūrvāya dehītyatra mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| atastadartho'pyayamārambhaḥ| kababhāvārthaṃ ca `śeṣādvibhāṣā' ityatra śeṣādhikāravihitasya bahuvrīhergrahaṇam| `anekamanyapadārthe' ityatraiva śeṣagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenātra kamna bhavati| `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' iti mātragrahaṇād `vibhāṣā dik‌samāse' iti yadā sarvanāmasaṃjñā nāsti tadāpi bhavati||
tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|| 2.2.27 ||
tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|| itikaraṇa ityādi| tataḥ samāsāllaukikasya yadi vivakṣā bhavati---evamarthaṃ samāso bhavati, nānyārthamityevamarthaṃ sūcayitumitiśabda ityarthaḥ, tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha---laukikamarthamiti| kaḥ punarasau laukiko'rtha ityāha---tataścetyādi| etadeva vivṛṇoti---yattatretyādi| gṛhyate'sminniti grahaṇam-keśādi, praharaṇam-daṇḍādi, karmavyatīhāraḥ---parasparagrahaṇaṃ parasparapraharaṇaṃ ca| sa cāvyayamiti| tiṣṭad‌guprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhenāvyayatvāt| nanvatra yuddhasyānyapadārthatvātpūrveṇaiva siddham, na; vaiyadhikaraṇyādekaśeṣaprasaṅgācca| tathā hi---grahaṇapraharaṇe ca keśādīnāṃ sahavivakṣitatvādekavibhaktitvāccaikaśeṣaḥ prāpto'nena vacanena bādhyate| katham? na samūhavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrīhisaṃjñā, samūhaścaikaśeṣe nopapadyate| nanu cāsatyasminpūrvayogenaiva paratvādekaśeṣo bādhiṣyate? na śakyate bādhitum; antaraṅga ekaśeṣaḥ bahuvrīhiścānyapadārthāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgaḥ||
tena saheti tulyayoge|| 2.2.28 ||
tena saheti tulyayoge|| tulyayoga iti| tulyayogaḥ--samānasambandhaḥ| saputra iti| `vopasarjanasya' iti sabhāvaḥ| nanvatra pitā pradhānamanyapadārtho'bhidheyaḥ, satyam; vyadhikaraṇayoḥ prathamārthe'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ, kababhāvārthaṃ ca| uktaścātra kababhāvaḥ| daśabhiḥ putrairiti| itthambhūtetyarthaḥ| prāyikamiti| jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ `vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe', `chandasyanekamapi sākāṅkṣam', `pūrvādiniḥ' `sapūrvācca', `sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ',`vibhāṣā sapūrvasya' iti vidyamānārthe'pi samāsaṃ nirddiśati, tajjñāpayati----prāyikaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti||
cārthe dvandvaḥ|| 2.2.29 ||
cārthe dvandvaḥ|| samuccayetyādi| yadā parasparanirapekṣāḥ padārthā ekasminpratisambandhini samuccīyante tadā samuccayaḥ, yathā---aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ puśuṃ vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva durmadīti| durmadī yathā surāyā na tṛpyati tathā yamo gavādīnnayamāna ityarthaḥ| atra nayatikriyāyāmekasyāṃ gavādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ, gamyamānatvācca ca--śabdasyāprayogaḥ| evaṃ rājño gauścāśvaśceti dravye dravyayoḥ, raktaḥ śuklaśceti dravye guṇayoḥ, raktaḥ paṭaḥ kuṇḍalaṃ ceti guṇe dravyayoḥ samuccaya ityādi draṣṭavyam| yadānekasya prādhānyāttadanurodhena tvitaradanvācīyate tadānvācayaḥ, yathā---bhikṣāmaṭa gāñjānayeti| atra hyadarśanādanānayannapi gāmaṭatyeva bhikṣām, anaṭam̐stu bhikṣāṃ na gāmānayati,aṭannapi nānviṣya gāmānayati| itaretarayogastu parasparāpekṣāṇāmavayavabhedānupagamena samudāyarūpatāmāpannānāmekasminnarthe'nvaye sati bhavati, yathā----devadattayajñadattābhyāmidaṃ kāryamiti| tathaikāpāye'pi tadbhavati, ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedatvācca dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ, tāddaśānāmevāvayavatirodhānasaṃhatirūpeṇānvaye tatsamāhāraḥ, yathā---chattropānahamiti, saṃhatipradhānatvāttvekavacanam| tatretyādi| syādetat----samuccaye parasparānapekṣatve'pi gavādīnāmekakriyādvārakaṃ sāmarthyaṃ dadhyodanādivadastyeveti, tanna yuktam; dadhyodanādāvekatvāt kriyāyāḥ| iha tu karmabhedātkriyā bhidyate, tathā ca ` samuccaye'nyatarasyām' ityatra bhrāṣṭramaṭa maṭhamaṭetyādikaṃ karmabhedanibandhanaṃ kriyābhedamāśrityodāhariṣyate| anvācaye tvapradhānameva cārthe varttate, na pradhānamityanekasya padasya cārthe vṛttyabhāvādapi samāsābhāvaḥ| iha paṭuścāsau khañjaścetyekasmindharmiṇyanekadharmasamuccayāccārthasadbhāvātsamānādhikaraṇayorapi dvandvasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca `dvandve ghi' iti niyamaḥ syāt, viśeṣaṇamityādinā tu tatpuruṣakaraṇe khañjapaṭurityapi siddhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasaṃjñādhikārādviśeṣavihitatvāttetpuruṣasaṃjñaiva bhaviṣyati, anyathā nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ cetyādāvapi dvandvaḥ syāt| yadvā---`śeṣa' iti varttate, ato viśeṣaṇamityatropayuktatvānna bhaviṣyati| sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāve tu dvandva eva---paṭukhañjāvāgatāviti|
plakṣanyagrodhāviti| caśabdasyāvyayatve'pi tadarthe vidhīyamānasya dvandvasya svabhāvādeva liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ| kathaṃ puna ratra dvivacanam, yāvatā śabdapaurvāparyādarthābhidhāne'pi paurvāparyam, tataśca plakṣaśabdaḥ sahārthena nivṛttaḥ nyagrodhaśabda upasthitaḥ, eka evārthastasyaikatvādekavacanameva prāpnoti, tathā ca `ādyantau ṭakitau' iti krameṇa pratītimaṅgīkṛtya yathāsaṃkhyamityasya pravṛttiḥ, na ca krameṇa dvayorarthayoḥ pratītau dvivacanaṃ bhavati;yathā vā vākye plakṣaśca nyagrodhaśceti, atra nyagrodhārthapratītidaśāyāṃ plakṣārthasyāpratītitareva kāraṇam? astu tarhi yugapadadhikaraṇavacane dvandvaḥ| kimidaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacana iti? adhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ, adhikaraṇe yugapadvacanaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanam, tatra dvandvo bhavati| kena punaryugapad dvayorvacanam? ekaikena padena| etaduktaṃ bhavati---yāvatāṃ padānāṃ dvandvo yadi tāvatāmanyo'nyārthābhidhānaṃ yugapadbhavatyevaṃ dvandvo bhavatīti| atra hi dvivacanabahuvacanānyathānupapattireva pramāṇam; vigrahe cāpi darśanāt| vigrahe khalvapi yugapadvacanatā ddaśyate---pramitrayorvaruṇayoḥ, dyāvācidasmai pṛthivī namete iti; kiṃ punaḥ samāse, yatra cānyācānyā ca śaktiḥ prādurbhavati! kathaṃ punaḥ plakṣaśabdena nyagrodhābhidhānam, tena vā tasya? sāhacaryāditi| yadvā tadvā nimittaṃ bhavatu, yadyapi ya lokavyavahāre kevalasya plakṣaśabdasya nyagrodhābhidhāyitvaṃ na ddaṣṭaṃ nyagrodhaśabdasya vā plakṣābhidhāyitvam, dvandvāvayavānāṃ tvanekārthābhidhāyitvaṃ na kevalānāmityadoṣaḥ| niyataviṣayāścāpi śabdārthā bhavanti, yathā---bhrātṛśabdasyaikaśeṣa eva svasari vṛtti, putraśabdasya duhitari| etenaitadapi nirastam----ekenoktatvāttasyārthasya parasya prayogo nopapadyata iti|
kathaṃ dvandvāvayavānāmeva parasparasannidhānādeṣā śaktirvahnisannidhāviva ghṛte dravatā, no khalu vahnivigatau bhavati, yadi tarhi plakṣo'pi dvyartho nyagrodho'pi dvyarthaḥ, bahutvādvahucanaṃ prāpnoti? nātra catvāro'rthāḥ, kiṃ tarhi? yābhyāmevātraiko dvyarthastābhyāmevāparo'pi| syādetat---ubhayoratra paryāyatve yathā plakṣanyagrodhau plakṣanyagrodhāviti dvirvacane pratītiḥ, evaṃ plakṣanyagrodhāvityatrāpi prāpnoti, tanna; yugapadutpādāt| tadyathā dvayorakṣṇoryugapadvisphāritayoḥ purovarttinyarthadvaye yugapadekā pratītirjanyata tathehāpi draṣṭavyam| nanu yadā plakṣaśabdo na tadā nyagrodhaśabdaḥ, yadā nyagrodhaśabdo na tadā plakṣaśabda iti kathamatra yugapadvyāpāraḥ? smṛtisthayoryugapadvyāpārādadoṣaḥ| padāni hi śrutamātrāṇi svaṃ svamarthaṃ smārayanti, paścādākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatveṣu parāmṛṣṭeṣu smṛtisthānyabhidadhati, tasyāmeva smṛtau yugapadārohātsambhavatyeva yugapadvyāpāraḥ| yā ca sā padārthānāṃ smṛtiḥ sā kramabhāvinīti tatkrameṇaiva yathāsaṃkhyādivyavasthā yugapadabhidhāne'pyupapadyate| tadevaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacane dvandva iti sthitam| ihaikaviṃśatirdvāviśatiriti, yadyayaṃ dvandva syād ekaṃ ca viṃśatiścetītaretarayoge dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ, samāhāre ca `sa napuṃsakam' iti napaṃsakaprasaṅgaḥ, ata eva ekādhikā viṃśatirekaviśatiriti śākapārthivāditvātsamāsaḥ kriyate? naivaṃ śakyam, `rājanyabahuvacanadvandve'ndhakavṛṣṇiṣu saṃkhyā' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na syāt| tasmād dvandva evāyam| sa samāhāre netaretarayoge, anabhidhānāt| napuṃsakatvantu `liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti na bhavati||
upasarjanaṃ pūrvam|| 2.2.30 ||
upasarjanaṃ pūrvam|| ānayamo hi syāditi| yadyapi viparītaprayogo loke na ddaṣṭaḥ parapuruṣāparādhāttu vākyavatsambhāvyetetyarthaḥ| iha rājñaḥ puruṣasya putro rājāpuruṣaputra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaśāstre dvayorapi prathamānirddiṣṭatve'pyupasarjanasaṃjñā'nvarthatvādapradhānasyaiva bhavati, puruṣaścātra rājāpekṣayā pradhānamiti pūrvanipātaniyamaḥ||
rājadantādiṣu param|| 2.2.31 ||
rājadantādiṣu param|| na kevalamityādi| atra vihitapūrvanipātasyeti pāṭhe vihitaḥ pūrvanipāto yasya tasyetyarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu vihitasyeti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpavāda iti śeṣaḥ| anyasyāpi ghyāderyaḥ pūrvanipāto yathālakṣaṇaṃ vihitastasyāpyapavāda ityarthaḥ| agre vaṇamiti| `vanaṃ puragā' ityādinā ṇatvam| tadeva tarhi ṇatvavidhānaṃ paranipātasya jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyati? tanna, `upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' iti niyamo na pravarttata ityetāvato'pyarthasya jñāpakatvena tadupapannam, tasmātkathaṃ niyamena paranipātaḥ syāt! iha ca nipātanādalugiva ṇatvamapi na bhaviṣyatīti tatrāgregrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| pūvekālasyeti| `pūrvakālaika' iti prathamānirddeśādupasarjanasyetyarthaḥ| ulūkhalamusalādidvandveṣu kvacidalpākṣaratvātkvacid ghyantatvātkvacidajādyadantatvātpūrvanipātaprasaṅgaḥ, kvacidaniyamaḥ| ddaṣadupalamiti| pramāda pāṭhaḥ; tena paranipātasyāpi siddhatvādiha pāṭhaḥ śakyo'kartum||
dvandve ghi|| 2.2.32 ||
dvandve ghi|| dvandve'nekamiti prathamānirdeśātsarveṣāmevopasarjanatvādaniyame prāpte vacanam| anekaprāptāviti| ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate, na prativyaktyāvṛttyā| tatraikasyaiva pūrvanipātena jātau lakṣaṇaṃ pravṛttameveti na punaḥ pravartate| nanvākṛtipakṣe'pi paṭuguptau mṛduguptāvityādiṣu bahuṣu vyaktiṣu yathā yugapatpravartate, tathātrāpi pravartatām? evaṃ manyate---ekasya yugapadavadhyavadhimadbhāvo virodhānna sambhavati| na cāntamapekṣyobhayoḥ pūrvatvamanyatareṇa vyavadhānāditi, atra ca yadā paṭumṛdvordvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścācchuklaśabdasya dvandvaḥ kiyate tadālpāctaratvāttasya pūrvanipāte śuklamṛdupaṭavaḥ, śuklapaṭumṛdava iti ca bhavati| vispaṣṭapaṭuriti| vispaṣṭaśabdaḥ pravṛttinimittasya pāṭavasya viśeṣaṇamiti vispaṣṭaṃ paṭuriti vigṛhya `supsupā' iti samāsaḥ||
ajādyadantam|| 2.2.33 ||
ajādyadantam|| ajādīti pṛthak padam, viśeṣaṇasamāso vā| aśvendrarathā iti| rathaśabdasya paścātsamāse rathāśvendrā ityapi bhavati| dvandve ghyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedheneti| `dvandve ghi' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---paṭuguptau; `ajādyadantam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---uṣṭrakharam; indrāgnī ityatrobhayaprāptau paratvād `ajādyadantam' ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedheneti||
alpāctaram|| 2.2.34 ||
alpāctaram|| ata eva nipānatātsvārthe tarap, kutvābhāvaśca| yadi tu prakarṣe tarap cettadā `dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ' ityādau bahuṣu sannihiteṣu dvivacanopapadatvābhāvādasyāpravṛttāvaniyamaḥ syāt| dvayoreva tu syāt---plakṣanyagrodhāviti| śaṅkhadundubhivīṇā iti| tūryāṅgānāmityekavadbhāvo na bhavati; tūryaśilpopajīvināmeva tatra grahaṇāt| niyatadravyavivakṣāyāṃ jātiratvābhāṃvāt `jātiraprāṇinām' ityetadapi na bhavati| śaṅkhavīṇābhyāṃ dundubherdvandve dundubhiśaṅkhavīṇā ityapi bhavati| evaṃ mṛdaṅgaśca śaṅkhapaṇavau ca mṛdaṅgaśapaṇaṅkhavāḥ, dhanapatiśca rāmakeśavau ca prāsādo dhanapatirāmakeśavānāmityādi bhavati| tathā hotā ca potā ca neṣṭā codrātā ceti bahūnāṃ yugapad dvandve tṛtīyasyottarapadamanantaramiti tasyaivānaṅ bhavati, netarayoḥ---hotṛpotṛneṣṭodrātāraḥ| dvayordvayordvandve trayāṇāmapyānaṅ bhavati---hotāpotāneṣṭodrātāra iti| evamanyatrāpi dvandvakriyāyāmānupūrvyaviśeṣādrūpaviśeṣo vedatavyaḥ| pūrvābhyāmalpāctaramityetatpūrvānusāreṇa gamya mānatvād vṛttau na paṭhitam| `dvandve ghi' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---paṭuguptau, `alpāctaram' ityāsyāvakāśaḥ---plakṣanyagrodhau; vāgagnī ityatrobhayaprāptau alpāctaramityetadbhavati| ajādyadantamityasyāvakāśaḥ----uṣṭrakharam, alpāctaramityasya sa eva; vāgindrāvityatrobhayaprāptau `alpāctaram'ityetadbhavati|
ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmiti| ṛtūnāmānupūrvyaṃ prādurbhāvakṛtam, nakṣatrāṇāmudayakṛtam| mātāpitarāviti| `ācāyaṃ!śreṣṭho gurūṇām, mātetyeke, iti smṛtiḥ| `piturddaśaguṇaṃ mātā gauraveṇātiricyate' iti ca|
śraddhāmedhe iti| satyāṃ śraddhāyāmarthakriyākāriṇī medhetyabhyarhitatvaṃ śraddhāyāḥ| dīkṣātapasī iti dīkṣārthaṃ tapa ityabhyarhitatvaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ| laghvakṣarādapi tapaso vipratiṣedhādabhyarhitamityetadeva bhavati|
samānākṣarāṇāmityatra nāstīti| tena ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmityatraiva varṇagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| varṇānāmutpattikṛtamānupūrvyaṃ śrūyata eva---`mukhato brāhmaṇamasṛjadvāhubhyāṃ rājanyamūrubhyāṃ vaiśyaṃ padbhyāṃ śūdram' iti|
saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyā iti| dvandve cādvandve cetyāhuḥ| alpīyasa iti pāṭhe alpīyaso'rthasya vācikāyā ityarthaḥ| navatiśatamiti| dvandvaḥ, `dvyekayoḥ' iti tu sautro nirdeśaḥ||
saptamīviśeṣame bahuvrīhau|| 2.2.35 ||
saptamīviśeṣame bahuvrīhau|| kaṇṭhekāla iti| yadā kaṇṭhe kiñcidastīti nirjñāte kāla iti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayujyate tadā saptamīgrahaṇena prayojanam, anyadā tu viśeṣaṇatvādeva siddham| sampradhāraṇāyāmiti| idamastu idameveti nirūpaṇā---sampradhāraṇā| paratvāditi| śabdaparavipratiṣedhādityarthaḥ| evamarthameva ca `saṃkhyāsarvanāmnoḥ' iti noktam| gaḍvādibhya iti gaḍvādayaḥ prayogato draṣṭavyāḥ||
niṣṭhā|| 2.2.36 ||
niṣṭhā|| avamuktopānatka iti| uraḥ prabhṛtitvātkap| nanu cetyādi| yathā citraguriti| guṇadravyaśabdayorupanipāte guṇaśabdasya viśeṣaṇatvam, kriyādravya śabdayorapi kriyāyā eva viśeṣaṇatvam| tataśca pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti bhāvaḥ| vivakṣānibandhanatvāditi| yadā kṛta kiñcidaneneti nirjñāte kaṭa iti prayujyate tadā kaṭo viśeṣaṇamiti manyate| kaṭe kaṭena kṛtamiti vā vigrahītavyamiti| evaṃ vigrahe kṛtasya viśeṣaṇatvaśaṅkaiva nāstīti bhāvaḥ| kvacittu vāśabdo na paṭhyate, tatra vivakṣānibandhanatvādityukte tāmeva vivakṣāṃ darśayatīti vyākhyeyam|
jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanamiti| jñāpakātsiddham, `jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanād' ityāha, tajjñāpayati---jātyādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā nipatatīti| śārṅgajagdhīti| śārṅga jagghamanayeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ktādalpākhyāyām',`asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā' iti ṅīṣ| atrāhuḥ----niṣṭhāśabdena yā vihitā niṣṭhā tasyā grahaṇam| tena susthitam, cāruhasitamityādau `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' ityasya paranipāta iti||
vā''hitāgnyādiṣu|| 2.2.37 ||
kaḍāśaḥ karmadhāraye|| 2.2.38 ||
kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye|| bahuvacananirddaśādādyartho'vagamyata ityāha---kaḍārādaya iti||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ
dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ||
<2.3>
kāśikāvṛttau
atha dvitīyādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
anabhihite|| 2.3.1 ||
anabhihite|| anabhihitaśabdo'yamanekārthaḥ, tathā hi---abhipūrvasya dadhāterhinoteścaitadrūpaṃ sambhavati; abhipūrvaśca dadhātirbandhane'pi ddaṣṭaḥ----aśvābhidhānīmādatta iti, uccāraṇe'pi---abhihitaḥ śloka iti, pratipādane'pi----abhihito'rtha iti; hinotirapi gatau vṛddhau ca vartate, iha tu vakṣyamāṇānāṃ karmādīnāṃ bandhanādyarthacatuṣṭayāsambhavātpratipādanavacano'bhihitaśabda ityāha---anabhihite anirdiṣṭe anukta iti| vaciratra pratipādanavacanaḥ| uktārthānāmaprayoga iti yathā sāmānyena `abhihite' ityetāvatyucyamāne kaṭaṃ karoti bhīṣṇamudāraṃ darśanīyamityatra kaṭaśabdādviśeṣyavācina utpadyamānayā dvitīyayā'navayavena kaṭagatasya karmatvasyābhihitatvādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā na syāditi manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---kenānabhihita iti| itaro'pi viditābhiprāya āha---tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairiti| bahuṣu prayukteṣu keṣāñcidvarjanena keṣāñcitkāryānvapratipādanam---parisaṃkhyānam, pratyudāharaṇeṣu sarvatra dvitīyā na bhavati|
kaṭaṃ karoti bhīṣmamityādi| kaṭaḥ kṛto bhīṣma udāro darśanīya iti karoterutpadyamānaḥ ktapratyayo'navayavena sarvakarmābhidhatte tadvad dvitīyāpīti yo mandadhīrmanyate taṃ pratīdaṃ parigaṇanabh, sūkṣmaddaśastu prati na vaktavyameva| tathā hi prātipadikādutpadyamānā dvitīyā yadākāraviśiṣṭo'rthaḥ prātipadikenābhidhīyate tadākāraviśiṣṭasyaiva karmabhāvamācaṣṭe| kaṭhaśabdena kaṭatvajātiviśiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate,na bhīṣmādyākāraviśiṣṭa iti tatpratipādanāya yathā bhīṣmādiśabdaprayogo bhavati tathā tadākāraviśiṣṭasya karmatvābhidhānāya dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| ktapratyayastu prakṛtyarthasya na karmatāmācaṣṭe, kintu prakṛtyarthaṃ prati yasya karmabhāvaḥ tamiti yuktaṃ yadanavayavena sarvakarmābhidhatte| nanu ca karmādayo vibhaktyarthāsteṣāṃ ca tiṅādibhirabhiritavacanamanarthakam, anyatrāpi vihitasyābhāvādabhihite, yatrāpyanabhihitādhikāro na kriyate tatrāpi śabdāntarapratipādite'rthe naiva vihitaṃ bhavati, tad yathā---bahupaṭuriti bahucoktatvādīṣadasamāpteḥ satyapi sambhave kalpabādayo na bhavanti, dvirdaśa dvidaśāḥ---samāsenoktatvātsujarthasya sujna bhavati, paṭuguptau---dvandvenoktatvāccārthasya ca--śabdo na prayujyate; tadvadatrāpi tiṅādibhirabhihitatvādeva dvitīyādayo na bhaviṣyanti|
nanvabhihitārthasyāpi prayogo ddaṣṭaḥ----apūpau dvāviti, satyam; ayaṃ tu nyāyaḥ yadutābhihite vihitaṃ na syāt, na hi vyasanitayā śabdaḥ prayujyate, api tvarthābhidhānāya, sa cedarthaḥ śabdāntareṇābhihitaḥ kimiti śabdāntaraṃ prayujyate, akṣinikocādibhirapyavagate'rthe śabdo naiva prayujyate, kiṃ punaḥ śabdenaivābhihite| apūpau dvāvityādau tu dvāvānaya kau dvau tāviti sāmānyopakrame vākyamiti yathākathañcidupapādanīyam, tasmānnārtha etenetyāśaṅkya saṃkhyāpi vibhaktyartha iti darśayannāha---bahuṣu bahuvacanamityevamādineti|
ayamarthaḥ----`trikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ' ityasmindarśane karmādivadekatvādisaṃkhyāvibhaktyarthaḥ, tatra karmādīnāṃ yugapadvibhaktibhirabhidhīyamānānāṃ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvamanāpannānāṃ kevalaprātipadikārthagatānāmabhidhānaṃ vṛkṣa eko vṛkṣaḥ karma paśurekaḥ paśuḥ karaṇamiti vābhidhānam, paścāccaikakriyānvayabalena parasparasambandha iti prābhākarā manyante|
bhāṭṭāstu paramparāsambaddhasya svatantrasyānekārthasyākṣāḥ, pādāḥ, māṣā ityādāvabhidhānadarśane'pyekaśeṣamantareṇādarśanāt yajetetyādau ca kṛtikāryayoryugapalliṅābhidhīyamānayorapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya prābhākarairapyabhyupagamāttadvadeva viśiṣṭābhidhānaṃ manyante|
asmākamapyayameva pakṣaḥ| tatra karmādayo viśeṣaṇam, ekatvādayo viśeṣyāḥ, karmaṇi yadekatvaṃ tatra dvitīyaikavacanamiti| viparyayo vā---ekatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ yatkarma tatra dvitīyeti| tatra yadyapi karmādiprādhānyapakṣe tiṅādibhiḥ pradhānabhūtānāṃ karmādināmabhihitatvādaprasaṅgaḥ, dvitīyādīnāṃ saṃkhyāprādhānyapakṣe karmādiṣvabhihiteṣvapi pradhānabhūtasaṃkhyābhidhānāya dvitīyādayaḥ syureva| prābhākare tu pakṣe karmādyaṃśābhidhāne'pi saṃkhyāṃśasyānabhihitasyābhidhānāya dvitīyādayaḥ syuriti| anabhihitakarmāśrayeṣviti| anabhihitāni karmādīnyāśrayo yeṣāṃ teṣvityarthaḥ| etena karmaṇītyādisaptamīnirddeśa ekatvādīnāmādhāratayā, na punarabhidheyatayeti darśitam| anabhihita iti| yadi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ syāttato dvayoḥ kriyayoḥ kārake'nyatareṇābhihite'pi vibhaktyabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, prāsāda āste ityatra sadikriyāyā āsikriyāyāścaikamadhikararagaṃ prāsādākhyaṃ taccānyatareṇa sadipratyayena ghañābhihitam---prasīdantyasminprāsāda iti, tatrābhihite na bhavatītyucyamāne saptamī na syāt| paryudāse tvāsipratyayena yadanabhidhānaṃ tadāśrayā saptamī sidvyati| nanu ca prāsādākhyasya dravyasya kārakatvādabhihitatva danyatvaṃ nāsti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; śaktiḥ kārakam, tatra sadikriyāśaktyabhidhāne'pyāsikriyāśakteranabhidhānam| nanvevaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi yā śaktirabhihitā tatra mā bhūdvibhaktiḥ, yā tvanabhihitā tatra bhaviṣyati? ucyate---anabhihite karmaṇītyekatvādīnāmādhāranirddeśaḥ saṃkhyā ca dravyadharmaḥ, ato'nabhihite karmaṇītyādibhirapi śaktidvāreṇa dravyamevocyate----anabhihitā yā karmādiśaktistadādhārabhūtaṃ yad dravyaṃ tasyaikatvādiṣu vibhaktaya iti| evaṃ ca yadi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ syāttato'bhihitaśaktidvāreṇa dravyasyābhihitatvātpratiṣedhaḥ syāt; paryudāse tu anabhihitaśaktidvāre vidhiriti spaṣṭa eva phalabhedaḥ| yatra tarhi śaktibhedo nāsti tatra katham---āsane āste, śayane śeta iti? atrāpyāsanaśayanādiśabdairāsanādikriyāyogyaṃ vastumātramanudbhutaśaktikamabhihitamiti tasya śaktyudbhavapratipādanāya vibhaktirbhaviṣyati|
yadi tarhi paryudāso'yamiti nirmīyate, iha paktvā bhujyata odanā iti bhujipratyayenāpyabhihita odane ktvāpratyayenānabhidhānamāśritya dvitīyā prāpnoti, bhāve hi ktvāpratyayaḥ; prasajyapratiṣedhe tu bhujipratyayenābhidhānamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ siddhyati? ucyate; nātraudanasya yugapadubhābhyāṃ śābda evānvayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? bhujinaiva, sannidhānāttu pacinānvayaḥ| kevalaśabdavyāpāranirūpaṇe tu kimiṣṭakāḥ paktvaudano bhujyate, utaudanameveti na jñāyate, ataḥ śabdavyāpārāpekṣayābhidhānameveti dvitīyā na bhaviṣyati| anabhihitavacanamanarthakam; prathamāvidhānasyānavakāśatvāt| kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādiṣu dvitīyādayo mā bhūvinniti sūtrārambhaḥ| yadi cātrāpi syuḥ, kvedānīṃ prathamā syāt| nanvanavakāśatvātprathamā bhavantī kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādāveva bhavatīti na punaḥ kaṭaṃ karotītyādāvapīti kuto'yaṃ niyamaḥ? ucyate---kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādau yadyapi kṛtaśabdasannidhāne kaṭasya karmatā pratīyate, tathāpi tatra vākyārthatvādavyatirikta eva prātipadikārtha iti prathamā bhaviṣyati, yathā---viraḥ puruṣa iti| kaṭaṃ karotītyatra tu kaṭaśabdenaiva karmaśaktimānartho'bhidhīyata iti vyatiriktatvātprātipadikārthasya prathamā na bhaviṣyati| nanvakārakeṣu sāvakāśā prathamā,yathā---vṛkṣa iti? atrāpyastīti pratīteḥ kartṛ tvāttṛtīyāprasaṅgaḥ| yatra hyanyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāntaraṅgatvādastīti gamyate, labdhasattākasya hi viśeṣaṇāntarayogo bhaviṣyati| athāpi yatra viśeṣaṇāntaranivṛttau tātparyam, na kriyāsambandhe, yathā---nīlamutpalaṃ na raktam, rājño'yaṃ puruṣo na devadattasyeti, na hyatra nīlamutpalamutpalamasti, rājñaḥ puruṣo'stīti pratītiḥ, atostyevākārakamavakāśa ityucyeta? evamapi vipratiṣedhātprathamā bhaviṣyati| dvitīyādīnāmavakāśo yatra prātipadikārthasya vyatirekaḥ----kaṭaṃ karotīti; prathamāyāstvakārakamavakāśaḥ----nīlamutpalamiti; kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityatrobhayaprasaṃge paratvātprathamaiva bhaviṣyati| nanu tāmapi bādhitvā paratvāt, ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prātipadikārthamātrasya prathamāvidhāvupayogādaśeṣatvānna bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi karttavyaḥ kaṭa iti kṛtprayoge prathamāṃ bādhitvā `kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhi syāt, tatpratiṣedhārthamanabhihitādhikāraḥ kartavyaḥ| tadevaṃ saṃkhyāvibhaktyartha ityasminpakṣe kartavyaṃ sūtramiti sthitam||
karmaṇi dvitīyā|| 2.3.2 ||
karmaṇi dvitīyā|| dvitīyādayaḥ śabdā iti| svanikāyaprasiddhireṣetyarthaḥ|
ubhasarvatasoriti| ubhayasarvaśabdayostasilantayoḥ prayoga ityarthaḥ| ubhayaśabdaikadeśa ubhaśabdo'nukṛtaḥ; ubhaśabdasya tasilantasyābhāvāt, tasya dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt| dhigityavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ| āmroṅitānteṣviti| kṛtidvarvacaneṣvityarthaḥ| ubhayataḥ sarvata iti| pañcamyāstasil| dhigiti| nindārtho'yam| uparyuparīti| `uparyadhyadhasassāmīpye' iti dvirvacanam| tato'nyatrāpītyuktam, tānevānyānparigaṇayati---abhita ityādi| abhito grāmamiti| ubhayata ityarthaḥ| parita iti| sarvata ityarthaḥ| `paryabhibhyāṃ ca' iti tasil| ābhimukhyavṛttirapi vibhaktipratirūpako nipāto'bhitaḥ śabdo'sti, so'pi gṛhyate| samayānikaṣāśabdau samīpavacanau gṛhyete| hāśabdaḥ śokādivṛttiḥ hā kanye ityādau kārakavibhaktitvādantaraṅgatvātsambodhanavibhaktirmavati| bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhātīti| pratiratra kriyāviśeṣakatvā dupasargo na karmapravacanīya iti paṭhyate|
tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi|| 2.3.3. ||
tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi|| yavāgvāgnihotramiti| kva punaragnihotraśabdo varttate? haviṣi; teṣvagnihotramadhiśrayet, agnihotraṃ śaraśarāyat, tadāhuryasyāgnihotramadhiśritamamedhyamāpadyetetyādiṣu darśanāt| juhotirapi prakṣepe| ekasminneva prayoge yavāgūśabdāt tṛtīyā, agnihotraśabdād dvitīyā; yavāgvākhyaṃ havirdevatoddeśena prakṣipatītyarthaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? agnihotraśabdo jyotiṣyati varttate---agnihotraṃ prajvalitamiti| juhotirapi prīṇane| tadyadā yavāgūśabdāt tṛtīyā tadā yavāgvāgnihotraṃ prīṇayatītyarthaḥ, yadā tu dvitīyā tadā yavāgvākhyaṃ dravyamagnihotraṃ haviragnau prakṣipatītyarthaḥ|
mīmāṃsakāstvāhuḥ----agnihotraśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyamiti, ddaśyate ca---sa eṣa yajña pañcavidho'gnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāvityādi| tasya vā etasyāgnihotrasya sapta ca śatāni ca, etadvā agnihotramanyedyurhūyate ajarāmarya vā etadyadagnihotramiti ca ta ityāhuḥ| karaṇatvāt tṛtīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ pakṣe dvitīyārthaṃ vacanam| idaṃ ca sūtrānuguṇaṃ na bhavati, karmaṇīti hi varttate||
antarāntareṇa yukte|| 2.3.4 ||
antarāntareṇa yukte|| antarāntareṇaśabdāvityādi| nanu yathā naurnāvi baddhā netaretaratrāṇāya bhavati tāddagetat, dvayorapi nipātatvavyabhicārāt, satyam; sāhacaryātsājātyaṃ lakṣyate, sajātīyavijātīyabhāve sajātīyapratyayo bhavati, tadyathā--gurubhārgavāvityukte grahayoreva pratītirbhavati, na tvācāryaparaśurāmayoḥ| yadvā antarāśabdenātṛtīyāntena sāhacaryādantareṇetyasyāpyatṛtīyāntasya grahaṇam, sa ca nipāta eva| tathāntareṇa śabdenāṭābantena sāhacaryādantarāśabdasyāpyaṭābantasyaiva grahaṇam, sa ca nipāta eva| ṣaṣṭheyapavādo yoga iti| asatyasminyoge śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti| sati tvasminnupayuktatvāt ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyapavādatvametat| madhyamādheyeti| ādheyaparatantramityarthaḥ| sapabtamyantasya madhyaśabdasyārthe varttata iti yāvat| antarā tvāṃ ca māṃ ca kamaṇḍaluriti. tava ca mama ca madhye kamaṇḍalurityarthaḥ| atra yathā madhyasyāvadhyapebhāyāmavadhibhūtābhyāṃ yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ yogaḥ, tathā''dhārasyādheyaparatantratvādādheyena kamaṇḍalunāpi yogattato'pi dvitīyā prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ, kamaṇḍalurityatra tiṣṭhatyastīti vā kriyāpadānuṣaṅgātkamaṇḍaluḥ karttā, sa ca tiṅābhihita iti prathamaiva bhaviṣyati, kārakavibhaktitvāt| tadetat `sahayukte'pradhāne' ityatropapādayiṣyāmaḥ| nipātayorgrahaṇādiha na bhavati, kiṃ tena tayorantareṇa jñātena! viśeṣavacano'yam---antarāyāṃ puri vasatīti srughnasya prākāra iti, nātra srughnasyāntarāśabdārthena yogaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prākāreṇa||
kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge|| 2.3.5 ||
kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge|| māsamadhīta iti| nanu karmatvādevātra dvitīyā siddhā, katham? `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām'| avaśyaṃ karmasaṃjñaivāśrayaṇīyā---āsyate māsaḥ, āsitavyaḥ āsita iti karmaṇi lakṛtyaktakhalarthā yathā syuriti, satyam; idamapyavaśyaṃ vaktavyam---dravyaguṇābhyāmatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyāyathā syāditi| tatra kriyātyantasaṃyoge'pi paratvādanenaiva yuktā dvitīyā| māsasyeti`kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhī||
apavarge tṛtīyā|| 2.3.6 ||
apavarge tṛtīyā|| apavargaḥ phalaprāptau satyāṃ kriyāparisamāptiriti| tatraivāpavargaśabdo loke prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ| kartṛvyāvṛttāviti| aśaktyādinā kartturuparamādityarthaḥ, tatra madhye kriyā vicchinneti pravṛttyapāyaḥ, na tvapavṛkteti||
saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye|| 2.3.7 ||
saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye|| kārakamadhya iti| madhyasyāvadhidvayāpekṣatvād dvivacanāntena samāsaḥ, kālādhvanoścaitadviśeṣaṇamityāha---kārakayormadhye yau kālādhvānāviti| adya bhuktvetyādi| nanuṃ cātra devadatta ekaḥ karttāḥ tatkathaṃ kārakayormadhye kāla ityāha---kartṛśakatyoriti| syādevaṃ yadi dravyaṃ kārakaṃ syāt, śaktistu kārakam, seha bhidyate--ekā adya bhujeḥ sādhanam, aparā dvyahabhujeḥ, tenānayormadhye kāla ityarthaḥ| kartṛkarmaṇoriti| iṣūnasyatīṣvāsaḥ puruṣaḥ sa karttā, iṣvasane vyadhane sthāne vā karma lakṣyam| armāpādānayoriti| karma tadeva sāmarthyād gamyamānaṃ dhanurapādānaṃ yataḥ śarā apayanti| karmādhikaraṇayorveti| karma tadevādhikaraṇamiheti nirddiṣṭaḥ pradeśaḥ| iha kālādhvānau dvau, saptamīpañcamyāvapi dve, tataśca saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti---kālātsaptamī, adhvanaḥ prañcamīti, ata āha---saṃkhyātānudeśa ityādi| asvaritatvāditi| svaritena liṅkena yathāsaṃkhyamityetat tatraiva pratipāditam||
karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā|| 2.3.8 ||
yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī|| 2.3.9 ||
yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī || yasmādadhikaṃ tadasminnadhikamiti ca nirdeśādadhikaśabdayoge paryāyeṇa saptamīpañcamyau bhavataḥ| upakhārtho droṇa iti| `upo'dhike ca' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| yasya ceśvaravacanamityādi| dvayamanenocyate, dvayorapi bhavati, tatrāpi paryāyeṇeti tatra dvayorapi tāvadbhavati, katham? īśvara ucyate yena tadośvaravacanamaiśvaryam, atha vā īśvaraśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ īśvaraḥ tasyoktirīśvaracanam, yasya svāmina īśvaratvamucyate tataḥ saptamītyarthaḥ| atha vā---yasyeti svaṃ nirdiśyate, yasya svasyeśvara ucyate tataḥ svātsaptamītyarthaḥ| paryāyeṇa vā bhavati; śeṣaviṣaye karmapravacanīyavibhaktyārambhādekata utpannayā vibhaktyā dviṣṭhasyāpi saṃbandhasyābhidhānāt| adhi brahmadatta iti| `saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ' iti samāsapakṣe brahmadattādhīnā iti bhavati vibhaktyarthavṛttitve|dhibrahmadattamityavyayībhāvaḥ| ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, svāminyādhāre pañcālāḥ sthitā sveṣvādhāreṣu brahmadattaḥ sthitaḥ, tatra yadā yadadhikaraṇaṃ tatra saptamī bhaviṣyati, evaṃ ca kṛtvā `adhirīśvare' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā na vaktavyā, aisvaryavaṣayaścādhiḥ kriyayā naiva yujyate| ato gatyupasargatvabādhārthāpi na yujyate||
pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ|| 2.3.10 ||
pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt|| 2.3.11 ||
pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt|| yasmādityanenaiva sūtraiṇa pañcamī| mukhyasaddaśaḥ pratinidhiriti| mukhyaḥ kva citkārye rūḍhaḥ, yaśca tadabhāve tatkārye pratinidhīyate sa tatpratinidhiḥ| karmaṇi `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ'| evaṃ pratidānamityapi, karmaṇyevalyuṭ| dattasyeti| athātrānenaiva sūtreṇa pañcamī prāpnoti, yathā----yasmāditi, evaṃ tarhi karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| nanu na dattameva pratyarpyate, kiṃ tarhi? dravyāntaram, satyam; tulyamūlyatvāttadeva pratyapitamiti pratipattiḥ, pratiniryātanam-pratyapaṃṇam, atra bhāve lyuṭa| yasmātpratinidhiriti| sūtravadeva pañcamī| evaṃ yataścetyatrāpi| urjunataḥ| pratīti| pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| arjuno yuddhādau prasiddhastatsaddaśo'bhimanyurityarthaḥ| māṣānityādi| ye pūrva gṛhītāstilāstebhyo māṣāḥ pratidānam| saṃbandhisaṃbhabandhāditi| pratinidhirmukhyamapekṣya bhavati, pratidānamapi pūrvadattam, tataśca yasya karmapravacanīyasya pratinidhipratidānābhyāṃ yogastasya tābhyāmapi mukhyapūrvadattābhyāṃ tad‌dvārako yogo'stītyarthaḥ||
gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani|| 2.3.12 ||
gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācatuthyauṃ ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani|| ceṣṭākriyāṇāmiti| vastu vyākhyānametat, sūtre tu saptamī ceṣṭāyāmiti| parispandanakriyāṇāmiti| parispandana eva ceṣṭāśabdaḥ prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ| `svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanātsvarūpagrahaṇāśaṅkāyāmāha---adhvanyarthagrahaṇamiti| saptamīnirdeśāditi bhāvaḥ| saptamīnirdeśe hyanadhvanikarmaṇītyanvayaḥ| nānadhvanaḥ prakṛteriti artha eva karma nādhvaśabdaḥ, tenādhvaparyāyebhyo'pari caturthī na bhavati| dvitīyā tu `karmaṇi dvitīyā' iti bhavati|
āsthitaḥ saṃprāpta iti gantrādhiṣṭhita ityarthaḥ| yatra tviti| yadotpathena panthā evākramitumiṣyate tadā bhavatyeva caturthītyarthaḥ| iha kasmānna bhavati---ajāṃ nayati gramamiti? agatyarthatvāt| pratītā hyatra gatirna tvasau nayaterarthaḥ; prāpaṇavācitvāt| iha tarhi striyaṃ gacchatīti caturthī prāpnoti? siddhaṃ tvasaṃprāptavacanāt, asaṃprāptaṃ yadvastu gamanena saṃprepsyate tasminkarmaṇīti vaktavyam, strī tu saṃprāptaiveti caturthyabhāvaḥ| adhvanaścānapavādaḥ| saṃprāpto hyadhvā, yadā tvasaṃprāptaḥ saṃprepsyate tadā bhavitavyameva caturthyetyuktaṃ purastāt|
na caturthyeveti| nañaḥ kākvā prayogādvikalpetetyanenānvayaḥ| karmaṇi caturthyāṃ vikalpitāyām ` tathāyukte karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityeva dvitīyā bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| grāmāya ganteti| dvitīyā tāvatkṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhate, tayā ca tulyakakṣā caturthī dvandvena pratipādyata iti caturthyapi kṛhyoge bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvātkriyāpi kṛtrimaṃ karma| tatra yadā gamanasya saṃdarśanādīnāṃ ca svarupabhedo vivakṣyate tadā saṃdarśanādikarmaṇā gamanenābhipreyamāṇasya grāmasya saṃpradānatvāccaturthī| abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu gamanasya karmatvābhāvād grāmaḥ karmaiva bhavatīti dvitīyā siddhā nārtha eteneti bhā,yakārasya pakṣaḥ| tatra kṛtprayoge ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati|
caturthī saṃpradāne|| 2.3.13 ||
