caturthī saṃpradāne|| tādarthya iti| tacchabdena kārthaṃ prati nirdiśyate, tasmai idaṃ tadarthamiti samāsena viśiṣṭakāryaprayojanaṃ kāraṇamabhidhīyate| tadarthasya bhāvastādarthyamiti ṣyañā kāryakāraṇasambandho'bhidhīyate; samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānāṃ bhāvapratyayeneti vacanāt| tatra dviṣṭhatve'pi sambandhasya ṣaṣṭhīvadviśeṣaṇādeva caturthī bhavatī---yūpāya dārviti| hetutṛtīyāpi viśeṣyānna bhavati| hetuhetumadbhāvasyāpi caturthyaiva pratyāyitatvāt, ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye ca hetutṛtīyā| iha tu prātipadikārthasyāvyatirekātprathamaiva bhavati| yadi tarhi tādarthya upasaṃkhyānaṃ kriyate, nārthaḥ saṃpradāne caturthyā, yo'pi hyupādhyāyāya gaurdīyate upādhyāyārthaḥ sa bhavati| avaśyaṃ saṃpradānagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam `rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' ityādyartham|
valṛpi saṃpadyamāna iti| saṃpattirabhūtaprādurbhāvarūpotpattiriha gṛhyate, tatra yadrūpamupajāyate tato vikārāccaturthī| mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti | prakṛtivikārayorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ caturthī| abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu mūtraṃ saṃpadyate yavāgūriti prathamaiva bhavatīti kecidāhuḥ| anye tvabhedavivakṣāyāmeva caturthīmicchanti| yadā tu `janikarttuḥ prakṛtiḥ' ityapādānatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā vikārāccaturthī na bhavatīti kecidāhuḥ---mūtraṃ saṃpadyate yavāgvā iti| anye tatrāpi caturthīmicchanti---mūtrāya saṃpadyate yavāgvā iti|
utpāteneti| prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhayo sūcako bhūtavikāra utpātaḥ| arocakina iti| aruciḥ-arocakam, `rogākhyāyām' iti ṇvul, bahulavacanādastrīliṅgatā||
kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ|| 2.3.14 ||
kriyārthopapadāsya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ|| kriyā kriyārthopapadaṃ yasyeti| nanu nāsminnarthe'kṣarāṇi santi tatrāha---tumunṇvulāvityādi| paribhāṣitamupapadaṃ kriyārthamanyatra sambhavatītyayameva viṣayo gṛhyate| atra ca viṣaye kriyaiva kriyārthopapadaṃ tenāyamartho labhyate iti bhāvaḥ| `yatra gamyate cārtho na ca prayujyate śabdaḥ sa sthānī' iti svanikāyaprasiddhimāśrityāha---sthānino'prayujyamānasyeti| edhebhyo vrajatīti| nanu cātra `tādarthye' ityeva caturthī siddhā, ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti--edhānāharttu vrajatīti? haraṇārthā vrajikriyā, na punaredhārthā cedudāharaṇe'pi tarhyevameva| etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ---pratyudāharaṇe śabdaḥ prayujyate, udāharaṇe tu neti pratīyamānā ca kriyā kārakavyapadeśasya nimittam| tatra yathā pratyudāharaṇe āharaṇāpekṣayā dvitīyā sambhavatyevamudāharaṇe'pi pratīyamānaharaṇāpekṣā dvitīyaiva syādityayamārambhaḥ| bhakṣiratra sthānīti| praviśa gṛhaṃ piṇḍīṃ bhakṣayeti gamyamānatvāt| na tu kriyārthopapada iti| yadyapi piṇḍībhakṣaṇārtha gṛhapraveśanaṃ tathāpi pāribhāṣikamupapadaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| śakaṭeneti| nanu `madhye'pavādāḥ' iti dvitīyāmeva caturtī bādhiṣyate, na karaṇatṛtīyām, evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā| idaṃ tvatra pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭ‌vyam---brāhmaṇasyaidhebhyo vrajatīti| asati karmagrahaṇe itaropapadavibhaktivadiyamapi śeṣaviṣayaiva syāt||
tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt|| 2.3.15 ||
tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt|| tumunā samānārthastumartha iti| vastuvyākhyānametat, vigrahastu tumartho'syeti tumśabdena tumartho lakṣyate| tumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāditi| tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ pratyayo'nte'sya tattathoktam| tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| sa eva hi tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ, nānyaḥ| pākāya vrajatīti| nanvatra tādarthyaiva siddham; na caivaṃ pācako vrajatītyabhāvavacanādapi prasaṅgaḥ, atra karttā pradhānaṃ na ca taṃ prati tādarthyamasti, kiṃ tu praka-tyartha prati; evaṃ tarhi bhāvavacanenaiva tādarthyasya dyotitatvāccaturthī na siddhyatīti sūtrārambhaḥ| na hyotallakṣaṇanetro jñātumarhati---dhañādīnāṃ caturthīsāpekṣāṇāmeva tādarthyaprakāśane śaktiriti|
tumarthagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum, katham? pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ, rāga iti kriyārtho papadagrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate| nanvetat ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭam, pañcamīnirdeṣeṭena cehārthaḥ; arthādvipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati, bhāvavacanādityanena sambandhāt| na vai bhāvavacanasya kriyārthopapadatvaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? dhātoḥ| dhātorbhāvavacanasyāsambhavādevaṃ vijñāsyate--kriyārthopapadāddhātoryo vihito bhāvavacana iti||
namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍyogācca|| 2.3.16 ||
namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍyogācca|| alamiti paryāptyarthagrahaṇamiti| alamityarthagrahaṇaṃ tatrāpi paryāptigrahaṇamityarthaḥ| tatra tāvadarthagrahaṇaṃ tasmai prabhavatīti nirdeśāt, iha cālaṃ kurute kanyāmiti `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| evamalamodanenetyatrāpi karaṇe tṛtīyā, odanena na kiñcitsādhyamityarthāvagamāt, tena bhūṣaṇapratiṣedhayoragrahaṇātparyāpterevagrahaṇam| cakāraḥ punarityādi| anyathā svastiyoge caturthyā avakāśaḥ---svasti jālmāya, jālmatvādāśīrabhāvād bhūtakathanametat; kuśalārthairāśiṣi caturthī cetyasyāvakāśaḥ---anye kuśalārthāḥ, kuśalaṃ devadattasya kuśalaṃ devadattāya; svasti gobhyo bhūyāt, ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt||
manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu|| 2.3.17 ||
manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu|| manyateḥ karma manyakarmeti| `mana jñāne'ityasya daivādikasya dhātoḥ śyanā upalakṣaṇam, na tu prayogasthasya śyanantasyānukaraṇamityarthaḥ| tena śyano'bhāve'pi bhavati---`tṛṇāya matvā raghunandano'pi bāṇena rakṣaḥ pradhanānnirāsthat' iti| śyānā tu tānādikasya ` manu avabodhane' ityasyaiva nirāsaḥ| anādarastiraskāra iti| na tvādarābhāvamātram, katham? anṛtādivannañaḥ pratipakṣavācitvāditi bhāvaḥ| manyakarmaṇi prakṛṣṭakutsitagrahaṇamiti vārttikam, yadvācinaścaturthī vidhīyate tataḥ prakarṣeṇa yadi kutsā pratipādayitumiṣyate tadā caturthī bhavati, na tu sāmānyavivakṣāyām| tena pratiṣedhayuktāyāṃ kutsāyāṃ caturthīvidhānaṃ saṃpadyata iti matvāha---na tvā tṛṇāyeti| `manyakarmaṇyanādara upamāne vibhāṣā prāṇiṣu' iti āpiśaliradhīte sma, na tatra pratiṣedhāpekṣā, tathā ca bhaṭṭiprayogo nidarśanīyaḥ|
aśmānaṃ ddaṣadamityādi| tattvākhyānametat| yasya mātā na paśyatīti| darśanayogyam| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceti| nanu yeṣu prāṇiṣu neṣyate, te nāvādayo bhaviṣyantīti kiṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā? vṛttikāra evātra sākṣātprayojanaṃ vakṣyati|
natvā nāvamiti| nāvā tāryamudakaṃ nāvyaṃ tadyadaiva tīrṇaṃ tadaiva nāvamapi santīṃ tvāṃ nāhaṃ nāvaṃ manye, prayojanasya niṣpannatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ yāvannabhuktaṃ śrāddhimityatrāpi draṣṭavyam| prāṇiṣu tūbhayamiti| viṣayavibhāgena| etadapīti| etadeva sākṣātprayojanamanyatra nāvāditvādeva siddherityavocāma||
kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā|| 2.3.18 ||
kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā|| prakṛtyābhirūpa iti| kriyāyā aśravaṇātkartṛkaraṇayorabhāvātṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti|
prāyeṇa yājñika iti| prāyaśabdo bahvarthaḥ, bahavo yājñikā ityarthaḥ| gārgyo'smīti| prathamā ṣaṣṭhī vā prāpnoti| sameneti| atra dvitoyā prāpnoti| dvidroṇeneti| dvayordroṇayoḥ samāhāro dvidroṇaṃ pātrādiḥ, dvau droṇau kṛtvetyarthaḥ, atrāpi dvitīyā prāpnoti| pañcakeneti| pañca pātrādiḥ, dvau droṇau kṛtvetyarthaḥ, atrāpī dvitīyā prāpnoti| pañcakeneti| pañca parimāṇamasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ, tatra saṃghasaṃghinorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ paśūnityanenaitatsamānādhikaraṇamityatrāpi dvitīyaiva prāpnoti| sāhasreṇeti| sahasraparimāṇaḥ saṃghaḥ sāhasraḥ| sarvamanyatpūrvavat| ityupasaṃkhyānamārabhamāṇasyābhiprāyaḥ|
pratyākhyānaṃ tu---iha tāvatprakṛtyābhirūpa iti gamyamānāpi kriyā karaṇādivyapadeśasya nimittam| iha ca karotikriyā gamyate, karaṇāntaravyudāsāya ca prakṛteḥ karaṇatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ svabhāvenāyamabhirūpaḥ kṛtaḥ, na vastrālaṅkārādinetyarthaḥ| prāyeṇetyayamarthaḥ---asmin grāme ye viprāḥ santi te bāhulyena yajñamavīyata iti tatra yājñikaśabdābhidheyamadhyayanaṃ prati bāhulyasya karaṇatvaṃ saṃdhībhūya yajñamadhīyata iti tatra yājñikaśabdābhidheyamadhyayanaṃ prati bāhulyasya karaṇatvaṃ saṃdhībhūya yajñamadhīyata ityarthaḥ| iha tarhi kathaṃ viśiṣṭaveṣaṃ kaṃcit ddaṣṭvādhyavasyati---prāyeṇāyaṃ yājñika iti? atrāpyayamarthaḥ----asmistāvadyājñikānāmācārādibāhulyamupalabhyate, ato'nenācārādibāhulyena yājñiko'yaṃ janairjñāyata iti| tatra pratīyamānajñānaṃ prati karaṇatvam| kecit---prāyeṇaśabdo vibaktipratirūpako nipāto jñātamityasyārthe varttate ityāhuḥ| ddaśyate ca prāyeṇa sāmagryavidhau guṇānāmiti, prāyeṇa niṣkrāmati cakrapāṇāviti ca| gātreṇeti| anenāhaṃ jñāye iti jñānakriyāyāmasmīti bhavanakriyāyāṃ vā gotrasya karaṇatvam| sameneti| patho gamane karaṇatvaṃ samena pathetyarthaḥ| dvidroṇeneti| dvidroṇādyarthe mūlye dvidroṇādiśabdastasya ca krayaṃ prati kāraṇatvam, dvidroṇādīnāṃ ca mūlyam, tena dvidroṇādyeva krīyate ityarthabhedo'pi nāsti||
sahayukte'pradhāne|| 2.3.19 ||
sahayukte'pradhāne|| kriyāguṇadravyairdvayoḥ sambandhe sati sahaśabdasya prayogo bhavati, ataḥ `putreṇa sahagataḥ pitāḥ' ityādīni kriyādisambandhe yathākramamudāhaṇānyupanyastāni| nanvatra sarvataḥ sahārthasvabhāvādeva pituḥ putrasya vā gamanādinā sambandhaḥ pratīyate, tatkutaḥ pituḥ prādhānyam? kecidāhuḥ----yasya kriyādisambandho viśiṣṭakālaḥ prajñātaḥ sa yadānyasyāprajñātaviśiṣṭakālakriyāsambandhasya tatpratipādanārthamupādīyate, yathā---`ayaṃ puruṣaḥ kadāgataḥ' ityapekṣāyām `rājñā sahāgataḥ' iti puruṣāgamanaṃ viṣiṣṭakālamupapādayituṃ vākyaṃ pravarttata iti puruṣasya prādhānyam, rājñastūpalakṣaṇatvenopāttatvādaprādhānyamiti| evaṃ tu `bhṛtyaiḥ saha rājāgataḥ' ityatra na syād, na hi bhṛtyāgamanaṃ prasidvakālaṃ yena tatkālatvaṃ rājāgamanasya pratipādyeta| yatra cobhayorapyajñātakriyādisambandhastatrāpi na syāt---putreṇa sahāgataḥ piteti| tasmādvaktavyamaprādhānyamata āha----pituratretyādi| pūrvaṃ prajñāto'prajñāto vā yasya kriyādisambandhaḥ śabdenocyate tasya prādhānyam| yasya tu sahārthānyathānupapattyā pratīyate tasyāpradhānyam|
kasya tunaḥ śabdenocyate? kasya vā pratoyate? yasya vivakṣyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati---dvayostāvatkriyāsambandhe sati sahaśabdasya prayogaḥ, tatra yadā dvayorapi kriyādisambandhaḥ śabdenocyate--sahāgatau pitāputrāviti, tadā dvayorapi prādhānyānna bhavati; yadā tvekasya kriyādisambandhaṃ śabdena pratipipādayiṣatyaparasya sahārthānyathānupapattyā tadā tasyāprādhānyāttadvācinastṛtīyeti| evaṃ ca kṛtvā saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharatīti yadyapi prastarasya praharaṇasambandhaḥ prajñātaḥ, sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharatīti, śākhāyāstvajñātaḥ; tathāpyuktena nyāyena śākhāśabdāttṛtīyā siddhyatīti vibhaktivyatyāso na vācyaḥ| nanu putreṇa sahāgata ityādau pitureva karttuḥ ktādibhirabhidhānam, na tvapradhānasya putrādestasyāpi tu sahārthasāmarthyātkartṛtvaṃ pratīyata--ityanabhihite kartṛkaraṇayoriti tṛtīyā siddhā| iha tarhi putreṇa sahāgamanaṃ pituriti `kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, iha ca tilaiḥ saha māṣānvapati tilānmāṣānvapatītyarthapratīterddhitīyā prāpnoti, iha ca putreṇa saha sthūlaḥ, putreṇa saha gomāniti dravyaguṇasambandhapratipādana eva tātparthamiti kriyāgandhasyaivābhāvātkartṛgandho'pi nāstītyārabhyamevāvaśyaṃ sūtram| sahārthena yoge vidhānāditi| yuktagrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ labhyate, anyathā `sahe pradhāne' ityeva vācyaṃ syāt| vināpi sahaśabdena vṛddho yūnoti nipātanāditi kvacitpaṭhyate|
ihāpradhānavacanaṃ pradhānanivṛttyartha kriyate, pitustṛtīyā mā bhūditi; tatra prātipadikamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvātprathamā bhaviṣyati, nārtho'pradhānavacaneneti manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---ū pradhāna iti kimiti| śiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gauriti| yathātrāpradhāne ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye tṛtīyā, evaṃ pradhāne'pi syāditi manyate| atrāhuḥ----yathā grāmaṃ na gacchatītyādau grāmagamanayoḥ pūrvamabhisambandhaḥ praścānnañā prati ṣidhyate, evamupādhyāyasya pūrvaṃ gavā sambandhaḥ paścāttatsambandhaviṣiṣṭasya goḥ sahārthena yogaḥ; anyathā kasya sahatvaṃ pratipādyeta, ato gavā sambandhasyāntaraṅgatvā dupādhyāyāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena||
yenāṅgavikāraḥ|| 2.3.20 ||
yenāṅgavikāraḥ|| aṅgaśabdo'vayavavācī prasiddha; tataścāyaṃ sūtrārthaḥ syād---yena guṇenāṅgasyākṣyādervikārastatastṛtīyeti, tataścākṣi kāṇamasyetyādāveva tu syāt, kāṇāderguṇavacanādeva ca syād; akṣṇā kāṇa ityādāvakṣyāderna syādityālocyānyathā vyācaṣṭe--aṅgaśabdo'tretyādi| arśa ādyacpratyayāntaḥ śarīravacano'ṅgaśabdaḥ sūtre upātta ityarthaḥ| yeneti ca yadapekṣamaṅgino'ṅgitvaṃ sa hetutvena nirddaśyate, hetutvenetivadanyeneti hetau tṛtīyeti darśayati| vikṛteneti| sāmarthyādevaitallabhyate, na hyavikṛtamaṅgamaṅgino vikāraṃ prati hetuḥ| akṣṇā kāṇa iti| kathaṃ punaḥ puruṣaḥ kāṇaḥ yāvatākṣidharmaḥ kāṇatā, tenākṣyeva kāṇaṃ bhavati na puruṣaḥ? ityāha---avayavadharmeṇeti| tadevaṃ yadaṅgagato vikāro'vayavadharmaḥ samudāya āropādaṅginaḥ pratipādyate, tatra yadaṅgagato vikārastatastṛtīyā bhavati| kathaṃ punarakṣiśabdaḥ prayujyate, yāvatā kāṇaśabdo'kṣigatameva vikāramācaṣṭe, tatra kāṇo devadatta ityukte naiva saṃdeho bhavati---kiṃ svayameva kāṇaḥ, kiṃ vākṣṇaḥ kāṇatayeti,nāpyevaṃ saṃdehaḥ----kimakṣṇaḥ kāṇatayāsau kāṇaḥ, kiṃ vā pādasyeti,tadanarthako'kṣiśabdasya prayogaḥ? evaṃ pādena khañjaḥ, pāṇinā kuṇirityādau pādādīnām? ucyate---akṣyādyupakrame vākye'kṣṇetyukte na jñāyate kiṃ nirūpayati? kiṃ vā kāṇa iti? tatra nirūpayatyādinivṛttaye kāṇaśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā---dvāvānaya kau tau dvāvityukte brāhmaṇāvati| aṅgavikāra iti kimiti| aṅgagahaṇaṃ prati praśnaḥ| kvacittu tathaiva pāṭhaḥ| akṣi kāṇamasyeti| nanvatra paratvātprathamā bhaviṣyati, na; asatyaṅgrahaṇe'vaiva syāt mukhyo hyatra vikāraḥ| udāharaṇe tu gauṇaḥ, avayavadharmasyāvayavinyāropāt||
itthambhūtalakṣaṇe|| 2.3.21 ||
itthambhūtalakṣaṇe|| idaṃśabdātsannihitavācinaḥ prakāravacane thāl, `idamasthamuḥ' iti thamupratyaye kṛte itthamiti bhavati| na cātra kiñcitsannihatamastītītthaṃśabdaḥ sannihitaparityāgena prakāraviśeṣamācaṣṭe, `bhū prāptāvātmanepadī ca',`ā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣe gatyarthatvātkarttari ktapratyayastadāha--kañciditi| tasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| lakṣyate yeneti lajñaṇam| yena śvetacchattrādinā rājatvādiprakāraviśeṣāpannatayānyo lakṣyate taditthambhūtalakṣaṇam| tatreti| varttamānādityarthaḥ| kamaṇḍalunā chāttropādhyāyayorgacchatośchāttrasya haste kamaṇḍalurbhavati, kamaṇḍalunā chāttro'yamiti jñātavānityarthaḥ| yadyevam, īddaśe jñāne kamaṇḍaloḥ karaṇatvādeva tṛtīyā siddhyati? evaṃ tarhi pramātā pramiti daśāyāmevātmanaḥ pramitiviśeṣaṃ pratipādayituṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte--kamaṇḍalunāyaṃ chāttra iti, tadā jñānakriyāyā apratibhāsādapratipādyatvācca karaṇatvāsambhavaḥ| udāharaṇaṃ tvevaṃ vyākhyeyam---kamaṇḍalunā chāttra ityevaṃ rūpaṃ jñānamabhūditi| ko'rthaḥ? adrākṣīditi nidiṣṭasya draṣṭurjñānaviśepo'tra kathyate, na prayokturityarthaḥ|
iha kamaṇḍalupāṇiśchātra iti bahuvrīhau kṛte kamaṇḍaluśabdāttṛtīyā prāpnoti; na ca pratyalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ, `na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti liṅgat; na ca `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti saṃpratyutpannāyāstṛtacīyāyā luglabhyate, tasyāḥ samāsprātipadikaṃ pratyanavyavatvādityata āha---iha na bhavatīti| samāse'ntabhūtatvāditi| samāsārthaṃ prati guṇabhūtatvādityarthaḥ| itthambhūtasya lakṣaṇaṃ yatpradhānaṃ tatra tṛtīyā| bahuvrīhau tu varttipadānāṃ svārthopasarjanānyapadārthābhidhāyitvānnāsti prādhānyam||
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi|| 2.3.22 ||
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi|| saṃjānīta iti| `saṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne' ityātmanepadam, `jñājanorjā' iti jādeśaḥ| ādhyāne tu `adhīgarthadayeśām' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---mātuḥ saṃjānātīti| kṛtprayoge tvanādhyāne'pi paratvāt`kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---mātuḥ saṃjñāteti||
hetau|| 2.3.23 ||
hetau|| `tatprayojako hetuśca' śāstrīyasya hetoścakāreṇa kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānātkartṛkaraṇayorityeva tṛtīyāyāḥ siddhatvāllaukikau heturgṛhyata ityāha---phalasādhanayogya ityādi| loke hyaṅkurādikāryotpādane yogyatāmātraprayukto'nāśritavyāpāro dravyaguṇakriyāviṣayo bījādirhetuḥ| uktaṃ ca----
dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam| iti|
anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturucyate|| iti ca|
udāharaṇeṣu kriyāyā abhāvātkaraṇatvamanāśaṅkanīyam| yūpāya dārvityatra tādarthya vivakṣitam, na tu sadapi hetutvamiti dāruśabdāt prathamaiva bhavati||
akartaryṛṇe pañcamī|| 2.3.24 ||
akartaryṛṇe pañcamī|| bandhita iti| bandherṇyantasya niṣṭhāntasya rūpam' śatamṛṇaṃ ca bhavatīti| uttamarṇāya dhāryamāṇatvāt| prayojakatvācca kartṛsaṃjñakamiti| `tatprayojako hetuśca' iti cakāreṇa kartṛ saṃjñāvidhānāt| nanu ca pūrvasūtre laukikasya hetorgrahaṇam, ayaṃ tu śāstrīyaḥ; śāstrīyasyāpi laukikatvamastyeva| atha vā kasya hetoḥ pūrvasūtre śāstrīyasyāgrahaṇam---karttari siddhā tṛtīyeti? na tvevam, pañcamyā asiddhatvādihārthameva sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ syāt||
vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām|| 2.3.25 ||
vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām|| `sattve niviśate'paiti' iti lakṣitasya guṇasya grahaṇam; tadanurūpatvādudāharaṇapratyudāharaṇayoriti kecit| anye tu `parvato vahnimān dhūmavattvāt' ityādāvanenaiva pañcamīmicchantaḥ paratantramātrasya grahaṇaṃ varṇayanti, yathā---yasya hi guṇasya bhāvāditi| `vibhāṣā guṇe' iti yogavibhāgāt `nāstīha paṭo'nupalabdheḥ' iti striyāmapi kvacidbhavati| kecittvapādānapañcamīmetāmicchanti, tathā ca `nāstīha ghaṭo'nupalabdhitaḥ' iti `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasilapi bhavati, yogavibhāgavādināṃ tvādyāditvāttasiḥ||
ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge|| 2.3.26 ||
ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge|| hetuśabdasyeti| prayogasya śabdadharmatvādevamuktam, na tvanenārthagrahaṇaṃ vyāvarttyate; yaryāyaprayoge'pi `nimittakāraṇahetuṣu' iti vakṣyamāṇena ṣaṣṭhyā iṣṭatvāt| hetuśabdasya prayoge sati hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇasyaiva sambandhaviśeṣasya niyamena pratītau `hetau' iti tatīyāpavādo yogaḥ||
sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca|| 2.3.27 ||
sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca|| `sarvanāmnaḥ' iti prayogāpekṣā ṣaṣṭhī| sarvanāmnī hetuśabdasya ca prayoga iti| pañcamyāṃ tu hetuśabdādayaṃ vidhirna syāt| kathaṃ tarhi sarvanāmnastṛtīyā bhavatīti? atrāpi sarvanāmnaḥ prayoga ityartho draṣṭvyaḥ|
nimittakāraṇahetuṣviti| yadyapyasmin sūtra idaṃ vṛttikāreṇa paṭhitam, bhāṣyakāreṇa tu `hetau' ityatra paṭhitatvādasarvanāmno'pyetadvibhaktividhānaṃ gamyate, tatra ca prāyagrahaṇādevāsarvanāmnaḥ prathamādvitīye na bhavataḥ, anyāstu yathādarśanaṃ bhavanti---annena kāraṇena vasati, annāya kāraṇāya vasati, annātkāraṇād, annasya kāraṇasya, anne kāraṇe iti|
paryāyopādānaṃ tviti| nanu viparītamidaṃ svarūpavidhau paryāyopādānaṃ karttavyam, arthagrahaṇe tu na karttavyamiti; kiṃ cārthagrahaṇe satyekaśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ, virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānāmekaśeṣavacanāt? evaṃ manyate---yathā ākṛtigameṣu kecidupalakṣaṇārthaṃ paṭhyante, evamihāpi svarūpaparā eva nimittādiśabdā upalakṣaṇārthāḥ----evamarthānāṃ śabdānāmiti||
apādāne pañcamī|| 2.3.28 ||
apādāne pañcamī|| prāsādāditi| atra lyabantasyāprayoge'pyartho gamyata iti dvitīyā prāpnoti|
āsanāditi| saptamyatra prāpnoti| pratyākhyānaṃ tu---prekṣaṇam-cakṣuṣā padārthānāṃ jñānam, taijasaṃ cakṣurbahirniḥ sṛtya viṣayān gṛhṇāti, niḥsaraṇāṅgake ca prekṣaṇe dhāturvartate, tatrāṅgabhūtaniḥ saraṇaṃ prati prāsāda upāttaviṣayamapādānaṃ bhavati---prāsādātprekṣata iti, korthaḥ? prāsādapradeśāccākṣuṣaṃ tejo niḥ sārya padārthān gṛhṇātīti|
praśnākhyānayośceti| viśiṣṭe praśnākhyāne gṛhyete yatra loke pañcamī prayujyate| iha na bhavati--kasyāyamartho rājño'rtha iti| kuto bhavāniti| kriyāyā abhāvādanapādānatvāt phalavadvacanapratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhāmāgamanādikriyāmapekṣyedaṃ prayujyate, tatra prayokturākhyātuśca manasi viparivartamānamāgamanaṃ pratyapekṣitakriyamapādānam---pāṭaliputrāditi|
yataśceti| yadavadhitvenāśrityādhvakālayoḥ paricchedastata ityarthaḥ| gavīdhumannāma nagaram, sāṃkāśyaṃ tapovanam|
kṛttikāyuktā paurṇamāsī kārttikī, paurṇamāsyām `lubaviśeṣe' iti lubna bhavati `sāsminpaurṇamāsī' ityadhikāre `vibhāṣā phalgunīśravaṇākārttikīcaitrībhyaḥ' iti nirdeśāt| agre hāyanamasyā ityāgrahāyaṇī, prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvātsvārthiko'ṇ, `āgrahāyaṇyaśvatthāt' iti nipātanāṇṇatvam| tadyu ktāditi| tena pañcamyantārthenārthadvāreṇa yuktātkāle varttamānānmāsādiśabdādityarthaḥ| yadvā---tayā pañcamyā yukto yo'rthaḥ kārttikyādistataḥ paro yaḥ kālo māsādistatra varttamānādityarthaḥ| arthataśca paratvaṃ na śabdata iti vyavahite'pi bhavati, kārttikyāgrahāyaṇyormadhyavarttī māsaḥ kārttikyāḥ paro bhavati|
adhvana iti| tadyuktādityapekṣyate| pratyākhyānaṃ tu-vākyaikadeśasyātra prayogaḥ| tadayamarthaḥ----gavīdhumato niḥsṛtya yadā catvāri yojanāni gatāni bavanti tataḥ sāṃkāśyam, caturṣu yojaneṣu gateṣu satsu sāṃkāśyamitiṣa gatāniti ka karmaṇi niṣṭhā, yadā janairyojanāni gatāni bhavanti tatastaiḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ prāpyata ityarthaḥ| yadvā----adhvavarttināṃ niḥ saraṇaṃ gamanaṃ vādhvanyāropya niḥsṛtya gatāniti lyapaḥ karttari ktasya ca prayogaḥ tasya pratīyamānaniḥ saraṇakriyāpekṣapāpādānatvam, gatānīti ca prātipadikārthasyāvyatirekātprathamā gateṣu satsviti `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' iti saptamī, āgrahāyaṇī māma iti kārttikyāḥ paratra māse gate sati āgrahāyaṇī bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatra digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī, saptamī pūrvavat||
anyārāditararttedikśabdāñcṛttarapadājāhiyukte|| 2.3.29 ||
anyārāditararttedikśabdāñcṛttarapadājāhiyukte|| anya ityathegrahaṇamiti| vyākhyānāt| nirddiśyamānapratiyogīti| yathā devadattayajñadattayoḥ prakṛtayorāha---devadattaḥ śūraḥ, itaraḥ kātara iti; tasyānyārthāntarbhāvo'stīti cintyam| ṛte yajñadattāditi| kathaṃ yatkiñcidrājasūyamṛte somamiti? chāndasatvāt, kathaṃ `na māmṛte rāma bālī'iti? kva karma pradhvastaṃ phalati puruṣārādhanamṛte' iti ca? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ|
śabdagrahaṇamiti| sati hi tasmin diśi ddaṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda ityuttarapadalopī samāso labhyate, tena yadā kadāciddiśi ddaṣṭena saṃprati deśakālavarttināpi yoge bhavati---grāmātpūrvo deśaścaitrātpūrvaḥ phālguna iti| avayavavācibhistu yoge na bhavati---pūrva kāyasyeti, `tasya paramāmreḍitam' iti nirdeśāt|
nanu cāyamapīti| sadhyraṅ devadattenetyādāvadik‌śabdārthamañcūttarapadagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, dikśabdaiḥ sāhacaryādasyāpi dikśabdasyaiva grahaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| dakṣiṇeti| `dakṣiṇādāc' ; āhi ca dūre' uttarācca' ityājāhī pratyayau||
ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena|| 2.3.30 ||
ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena|| atra tasyaternañpūrvasya kvipyatasiti rūpasambhave'pi pratyakṣaśrutatvātpratyayāpratyayaparibhāṣayā ca pratyayasyaiva grahaṇamiti siddhaṃ nārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇena| purastāditi| `pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' `astāti ca' iti pūrvaśabdasya purādeśaḥ| uparya pariṣṭāditi| ūrdhvaśabdasyopaśabda ādeśo ril‌riṣṭātilau pratyayau bhavataḥ, `tataḥ paścāddhastī' iti bhāṣyakāraprayogātpañcamī||
enapā dvitīyā|| 2.3.31 ||
enapā dvitīyā|| `tatrāgāraṃ dhanapatigṛhāduttareṇāsmadīyam'---stryadhikārātpareṇa vāsarūpavidhinā'vaśyaṃ bhavati, tataḥ pareṇa nāyamanuvartata ityādīnāṃ cintyaṃ sādhutvam||
pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām|| 2.3.32 ||
pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām|| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pakṣe yathāprāptasyābhyanujñānāt tṛtīyayā mukte śeṣatvātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti| atha syādanekārthatvā nnipātānāmanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham, na vikalpārthamiti? evamapyanantarā dvitīyā samuccīceta| athāpi yogavibhāgenāsyā api siddhiḥ, evamapi tadanantarā ṣaṣṭhī samuccīyeta na kathañcana pañcamī, sā ceṣyate, tatkathamityāha---pañcamīgrahaṇamiti| iheti| na pūrvayoryogayoḥ maṇḍūkagatayo'dhikārā bhavanti, yadyanuvṛttisāmarthyātpañcamī, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ tarhi kimartham? samuccayārtham| tatra kiṃ samuccīyate? ityapekṣāyām `pañcamīgrahaṇamihānuvarttate' ityucyate| yogavibhāgaḥ karttavya iti| asatyapi munitrayavacane prayogabāhulyādevaṃ vyākhyātam||
karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya|| 2.3.33 ||
karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya|| yadā dharmamātramiti| yadyogād dravyaṃ stokādivyapadeśamāsādayati te guṇā dharmāḥ, ubhayavacanā hyete dravyamāhurguṇaṃ ca śuklādivat| yadā guṇavacanāstadā'sattvavacanatetyarthaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇe karmaṇīti| ākhyātena hi kriyā sādhyamānāvasthocyate---calati, calanaṃ karotīti| atastadviśeṣaṇaṃ stokādi karma bhavati---stokaṃ calanaṃ ,karotīti| evaṃ tu viśeṣyavacanasstokaśabdo dravyavacana iti nātra prasaṅgaḥ| yatra ca phalāntaraṃ sāvyaṃ prati dhātvarthaḥ karaṇatayā vivakṣyate tatra viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na syāt--śobhanaṃ jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeteti| atra hi yathā phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇabhūtasya yāgasyābhidhāyakād jyotiṣṭomaśabdāt tṛtīyā bhavati, tathā tadviśeṣaṇācchobhanaśabdādapi syāt| anyastvāha---saṃdarśanaprārthanādhyavasāyairāpyamānatvātkriyāyāḥ karmatvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya karmatvaṃ syāditi tasyāpi saṃdarśanādīnāṃ kriyāyāścābhedavivakṣāyāṃ karmatvaṃ na syād, na hi tatra kriyāyāḥ karmatvamasti||
dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyantarasyām|| 2.3.34||
dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyantarasyām|| pakṣe pañcamyarthe vacanam, ṣaṣṭhī tu śeṣatvādeva siddhā| yadyovam, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ ṣaṣṭhīmātravacane vaiyyarthyādeva prakṛtā pañcamī vidhāyiṣyate, tatrāha---anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiti| vacanasāmarthyāddhi prakṛtavidhāne vijñāyamāne tṛtīyāyā api vidhiḥ syāt| nanu kṛtamapyanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham, samuccayārtha vā; vikalpārthe tāvat ṣaṣṭhyā mukte svādisūtreṇā prāptāḥ sarvā eva vibhaktayaḥ syuḥ, samuccayārthe'pi prakṛtā tṛtīyā kasmānna samuccīyate? ucyate---`pṛthagvinānānabhiḥ' ityatra tāvad `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pañcamī samuccīyate' ityuktam, ata ihāpyekapraghaṭṭakatvātsaiva samuccīyate| ata etadapi na codanīyam---`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe prakṛte punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimartham' iti; tatrāpi hi pakṣe tṛtīyā syāt||
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca|| 2.3.35 ||
dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca|| prātipadikārthe vidhānamiti| arthāntarasyānirddeśāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvanirdeśe'pyarthāntarasya śeṣaviṣaye pūrvavibhaktiviṣaye ca vidhānametadyṛktam, prathamāviṣaye tu paratvātsaiva prāptoti? neṣa doṣaḥ; uttaratrāpyetadanuvarttate, tenottaravibhaktiviṣaye'pi sarvatra yathābhidhānaṃ bhavati| tathā ca dūrādāvasathānmūtramityadhikaraṇe'pi bhavati----āvasathasya dūra ityarthaḥ| prātipadikārthe vidhānamityetattadāhṛtaviṣayaṃ draṣṭavyam| tathā ca---`sattvavacanebhyo yathāyathaṃ vibhaktayo bhavanti' iti vakṣyati, pratipadikārtha eva tu vidhāne yathāyathamityanupapannam, prathamaiva bhavatīti vācyaṃ syāt||
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca|| 2.3.36 ||
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca|| ktasyenviṣayasyeti| innantaḥ śabdo viṣayo vṛttibhūmiryasyaktāntasya tasyetyarthaḥ| adhītī vyākaraṇa iti| adhītamaneneti vigṛhya śrāddhamanenabhuktamityato'neneti varttamāne `iṣṭādibhyaśca' itīnipratyaye kṛte taddhitārthena kartrā sahaikībhūtasyādhītasya niṣkṛṣya vyākaraṇādinā sambandhābhāvāt ktapratyayenānabhihite vyākaraṇādau guṇabhūtayāpi prakṛtivācyayā'dhyayanakriyayā'dhītavān vyākaraṇamitivat karmatayā sambandhamāne kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivad dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ saptamī vidhīyate| iha māsamadhītī vyākaraṇa iti kālakarmaṇorbahiraṅgatvātsaptamyabhāvaḥ|
sādhurdevadatto bhātarīti| atra sādhutvāsādhutvayormātāpitṛviṣayatve'pi kriyāyā abhāvādadhikaraṇatvābhāvādvacanam| `sādhunipuṇābhyām' ityeva siddhe'narcārthamatra sādhugrahaṇam, tena tattvakathane'pi bhavati| arcāgrahaṇaṃ tatra nipuṇārtham| kathaṃ tarhi tatra pratyudāhariṣyate--arcāyāmiti kiṃ sādhurbhṛtyo rājña iti? ucyate,rājñau bhṛtyena saha śābdo'nvayaḥ, na sādhunā---rājño bhṛtyaḥ sa sādhuriti| tatra rājani vānyatra veti naitacchabdena spṛśyate, pratyāsattyā tu rājaviṣayameva sādhutvaṃ gamyata ityetāvatā taṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
kārakārhāṇāmiti| kārakaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, kārakatvārhāṇāmityarthaḥ| ṛddheṣviti| ṛddhā bhojanakriyāmarhantīti kārakarhāḥ, lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāmapi yathā syāditi vacanam| daridreṣvāsīneṣviti daridrā bhoktuṃ nārhantītyakārakārhāḥ|
tadviparyāse ceti| kārakārhāṇāmakārakatve'kārakārhāṇāṃ ca kārakatva ityarthaḥ|
nimittātkarmayoga iti| yat kriyāprayojanaṃ yadarthaḥ kriyārambhastatphalamiha nimittam, tadvācinaḥ saptamī bhavati| yadi tasya nimittasya karmaṇā kartturīpsitatamena saha samavāyādilakṣaṇaḥ sambandho bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra hetutṛtīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam, tatra hantikarmaṇā dvīpyādinā carmādernimittasya samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ| camarīmiti| camaraśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅoṣ| puṣkalakaḥ-śaṃkuḥ, sa sīmni sīmājñānārtha hato nikhāta ityarthaḥ, tena ca nihanyamānena śaṅkunā sīmnaḥ saṃyogaḥ sambandhaḥ| karmasambandha iti kim? vetanena dhānyaṃ lunāti||
yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam|| 2.3.37 ||
yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam|| iha bhūyo darśanāśrayo lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ, yathā---agnidhūmayoḥ, tataścodita āditye tamo naṣṭam, udite candramasi samudraḥ pravṛddha ityādāveva syād; tvagniṣu hūyamāneṣu gata ityagnihavanaṃ yadā gamanena saha punaḥ punarna ddaṣṭacanaṃ tadā na tattasya lakṣaṇamitīha na syādityāśaṅkyāha---prasiddhā ca kriyeti| prasiddhireva kriyāyāḥ kriyāṃ prati lakṣaṇatve upayujyate, na punardarśanam, etaduktaṃ bhavati---nirjñātakālā kriyā anirjñātāyā kriyāyāḥ sakṛdapi kālaparicchedahetutvenopāttā bhavatyeva lakṣaṇamiti||
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare|| 2.3.38 ||
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare|| `anādare' iti pūrveṇa saptamī, etacca bhāvalakṣaṇabhāvasya viśeṣaṇam, yaścānādare sati bhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, so'nādarādhiko bhavatītyāha---anādarādhika iti| anādaraviṣiṣṭe'nādriyamāṇa ityarthaḥ| rudataḥ prāvrājīditi| pitrādikasye rodanamanāddatya pravrajyāṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ||
svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca|| 2.3.39 ||
svāmīśvarādhiparidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca|| gavāṃ dāyāda iti| dīyata iti dāyaḥ- aṃśaḥ, dāyamādatta iti sopasargādapi dāyāda iti nipātanātkaḥ| gavāmityetatsamudāyasya viśeṣaṇamavayavamapi dāyāṃśaṃ spṛśatīti gavātmakasya dāyasyādātetyayamartho bhavati| gavāṃ prasūta iti| gā evānubhavituṃ jāta ityarthaḥ||
āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām|| 2.3.40 ||
āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām|| āyukto gauḥ śakaṭa iti| āṅīṣadarthe īṣadyukta ityarthaḥ||
yataśca nirdhāraṇam|| 2.3.41 ||
yataśca nirdhāraṇam|| jātiguṇakriyābhiriti| pradarśanametat| amīṣāṃ chāttrāṇāṃ devadattaḥ paṭuriti saṃjñayāpi nirdhāraṇadarśanāt||
pañcamī vibhakte|| 2.3.42 ||
pañcamī vibhakte|| vibhaktamasyāstīti| nirddhāryamāṇāt| etaduktaṃ bhavati---nirddhāryamāṇasya nirddhāraṇāśrayasya ca vibhāge sati nirddhāraṇaṃ bhavati, tataśca sarvatraiva nirddhāraṇāśraye vibhaktamastīti sāmarthyādavadhāraṇamāśrīyate---yasminnirdhāraṇāśraye vibhāga eva, na kenacidātmabhāva iti| tena gavāṃ kṛṣṇetyādau yadyapi gomaṇḍalātkṛṣṇā gauḥ pṛthak kriyate, tathāpi gavātmanāntarbhāvo'stīti na bhavati| udāharaṇe cu māthupāṭaliputreṣu prāṇitvenāntarbhāve'pi śabdopāttākārāpekṣayānantarbhāvādvibhāga eva bhavati| pratyākhyātaṃ caitatsūtramapādānaprakaraṇe---
buddhyā samīhitaikatvātpañcālān kurubhiḥ pṛthag|
yadāḥ vibhajate vaktā tadā'pāyaḥ pratīyate|| iti||
sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ|| 2.3.43 ||
sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ|| sādhuśabdaḥ `kṛvāpājimi' ityuṇantaḥ, `puṇa karmaṇi śubhe' ityasmānnipūrvāt `igupapadha' iti ke, nipuṇa iti bhavati| `arca bhāvyam' ityasmādbhauvādikāt`gurośca halaḥ' ityakāraḥ, caurādikāttu yucā bhāvyam| apraterityatra prayoga ityadhyāhāryam, tadāha---na cetpratiḥ prayujyata iti sādhurmṛtyo rā5 iti| pūrvamevaitad dūṣitamupapāditaṃ ca| nipuṇaḥ putro māturiti tu tatatvakathane nyāyyaṃ pratyudāharaṇam||
prasidotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|| 2.3.44 ||
prasidotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|| `ṣiñ bandhane' prakarṣeṇa baddhaḥ---prasitaḥ, tadāha---yastatranityamavabaddha iti nityamityanena praśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| avabaddha ivāvabaddhaḥ, yo hi yatra prasaktaḥ sa tatrāvabaddha iva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| tena prakaṣaṇa mitaḥ śuklatara ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti pradarśitaṃ bhavati| keśeṣu prasita iti| tatpara ityarthaḥ|
nakṣatre ca lupi|| 2.3.45 ||
nakṣatre ca lupi|| nakṣatre prakṛtyarthe sati yo lupsaṃjñayā lupyamānasya prakyayasyārthastatra varttamānāditi sūtrākṣarānvayaḥ| yaccocyate---nakṣatre lupītita pañcamyarthe saptamī lubantānnakṣatravācina ityartha iti, tatrottarābhyāṃ phalgunībhyāṃ nottarā gacchediti viśeṣaṇānnasyāt, tasyālubantatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi lubantānnakṣatrābhidhāyinaḥ śabdāditi vṛttiḥ? prāyovṛttyaitaduktam---lubantārthābhidhāyī prāyeṇa lubanto bhavati| lubarthābhidhāyinaḥ śabdamātrādityarthaḥ| lubantāditi| lubante samāptāvasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, sthānirvārakaṃ ca lupo'ntyāvayavatvaṃ draṣṭavyam|
adhikaraṇa iti varttata iti| evaṃ ca puṣpaṃ pratīkṣate, puṣpāya spṛhayati, puṣpasya samīpa ityādāvapi na bhavati||
prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā|| 2.3.46 ||
prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā|| prātipadikāthaḥ satteti| atra jighṛkṣitasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam, na prātipadikārthamātrasya; gauḥ, śuklaḥ, pācakaḥ, ḍittha ityādāvasambhavāt| yo'rthaḥ sanneva kevalaṃ na jātyādirūpo na liṅgasaṃkhyākārakaśaktiyogī, sa iha prātipadikārthatvena vivakṣitaḥ, yathā---avyayārtha ityarthaḥ| avyayārtho hi kevalamastīti śakyate vaktum, na punarīddaśastāddaśa iti| gauḥ śukla ityādau tu sattvarūpe'rthe liṅgagrahaṇādeva siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ|
anye tvāhuḥ----anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yasya yo'rthaḥ pratīto yamarthaṃ prātipadikaṃ na vyabhicarati yena vinā prātipadikasyāprayogaḥ, sa sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ| sattāgrahaṇaṃ tūpalakṣaṇam, tena sattā gotvaṃ śoklyaṃ śuklo guṇaḥ pācako ḍittho gauḥ śukla ityādikamapyudāharaṇamiti| nanvatra sarvatra liṅgagrahaṇādeva siddham, na; mātragrahaṇaṃ kriyate, taccāvadhāraṇārtham, payomātraṃ vratayatītivat| tataśca strī pumānnapuṃsakamityādāveva tu syād---yatra liṅgamevārthaḥ, sattetyādau tu jātyādyavikārthasadbhāvānna syāt| atha kanyāmātraṃ varayatītivanmātraśabdasya vyāptivacanatvālliṅgamātre prathamā liṅgamastītyeva prathamā bhavatīti vyākhyānādadhikārthasadbhāve'pi prathamā bhavatīti? ucyate---hantaivaṃ vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau karmādisadbhāve'pi caliṅgamastītyeva prathamā syāt; karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyasminpratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādīnāṃ dvitīyādiṣvaniyatatvāt! vacanamekatvādīti| pūrvācāryaprasiddheriti bhāvaḥ|
uccairiti| atra prathamāyāṃ satyāṃ grāma uccaistava svamityādau `sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā' iti temayādivikalpo bhavati, padatvaṃ tu ṣaṭhyāpi siddham, yasmin hyarthe dvitīyādayo na vihitāḥ sa śeṣaḥ| nanvasaṅkhyatvādavyayārthasya kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhī syāt? ekatvādyarthaniyame ṣaṭhyāḥ saṅkhyāyāmaniyatatvāt, pratyayaniyame'pi tulyajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasyaikatvādibhiḥ parasparameva vyāvarttanāt| vidhivākyapakṣe tu svādisūtreṇa bhinnavākyasya `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityādeḥ saṅkhyāsambhave vidhyarthatvāt|
nanu ṅyāpprātipadikātsvādayo vidhāsyante, tatrārthe prathametyukte kasyārtha ityapekṣāyāṃ yasmātsvādividhistadartha iti vijñāsyate, nārthaḥ prātipadikagrahaṇena,tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---liṅgagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati kumārī sīmetyādāvapyata eva siddham, prātipadikagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe sīmādiśabdānāṃ strīyuktārthāvyabhicāre'pi pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāttadarthe prathamāsiddhyarthaṃ liṅgagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt? ucyateprātipadikagrahaṇaṃ tāvadarthapadenāsambaddhamityatraiva vakṣyate, liṅgahaṇamanekaliṅgārtham‌--taṭaḥ, taṭam, taṭī; kumāraḥ, kuṇḍam, kuṇḍaḥ, kuṇḍikā; anyathā yenārthena vinā prakṛteraprayogastadarthamātre vidhīyamānā prathamā nānāliṅgebhyastattadviśeṣamantareṇa prayujyamānebhyo na syāt| atha mātragrahaṇamakṛtvā vyāptivacanaṃ vāṅgīkṛtyādhikārthasadbhāve'pi prakṛtyarthasyānvaya iti syāt? yadyevam, vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau karmādyādhikye'pi syātpratyayaniyamapakṣe, tadiha vṛttau kumārī, kuṇḍamityudāharaṇam, vṛkṣaśabdastvarthādudāhṛtaḥ| nanu mā bhūnmātragrahaṇam, mā ca bhūlliṅgagrahaṇam, mā ca kāri `saṃbodhane ca' iti sūtram, sarvatrārtha ityeva prathamā bhaviṣyati; na caivaṃ karmādiṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ, karmaṇi dvitīyevetyevamarthaniyamasyāśrayaṇāt? evamapi `rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe'pi syāt, śeṣalakṣaṇā hi ṣaṣṭhī, upayuktādanyaśca śeṣaḥ, tatra yadi prakṛtyarthasyādhikye'pi prathamā syāt| tatastasyāpi prathamāvidhāvupayuktatvātṣaṣṭhī na syāt| atha vacanasāmarthyātsvasvāmibhāvādau ṣaṣṭhī bhavantī liṅgādhiko'pi syād| ato mātragrahaṇaṃ tāvatkarttavyam, tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe liṅgagrahaṇam, `saṃbodhane ca' iti sūtraṃ ca karttavyam; tadādhikye'pi yathā syāditi|
parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| artha iti vā liṅga iti vā siddhiṃ manyate| droṇaḥ, khārīti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ----yenārthena vinā prakṛteraprayogastasminnarthe prathamā| droṇādayaśca lauhaṃ dārumayaṃ parimāṇamevārtha na vyabhicaranti| yadā tu droṇādiparimite vrīhyādau varttante tadā tasya vyabhicāritvānna syāt| na ca liṅgagrahaṇādapi siddhiḥ----tadādhikyamātre hi tena syāditi, parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ conmānādīnāmupalakṣaṇam, tena ghṛtaṃ palamityādāvapi bhavati| atha lavaṇena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ, lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ, lavaṇaṃ śākamityatra kathaṃ prathamā, lavaṇaśabdo hi lavaṇajātīyameva dravyaṃ na vyabhicarati, vyabhicarati tu saṃsṛṣṭam? ucyate---sādhāraṇaśabdo'yam, lavaṇajātīyasya saṃsṛṣṭasya cākṣādiśabdavat| evaṃ ca `lavaṇālluk' iti vacanādvijñāyate| tatra yathā dadhidādikaśabdayoḥ prathamā bhavatyevamatrāpi bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi kathaṃ śuklaḥ paṭa iti, śuklaśabdo guṇameva na vyabhicarati, vyabhicarati tu tadvantam, paṭasya śukla iti darśanāt? atrāpi `guṇavacanebhyo matupo lug vācyaḥ' iti vacanātsādhāraṇaśabdataiva| iha tarhi kathaṃ gaurvāhīka iti, gośabdo hi sāsnādimantameva na vyabhicarati, vyabhicarati tu vāhīkam? atrāpi vāhīke sāsnādimadrūpāropādrośabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra yathā sāsnādimad‌vṛtterbhavatyevaṃ vāhīkavṛtterapi bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, droṇaḥ khārītyādāvapyevameva bhaviṣyati, lavaṇādiśabdavatsādhāraṇaśabdāḥ syuḥ gaurvāhīka ityādivadrauṇā vā, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa itivallākṣaṇikā vā; nānyā gatirasti, sarvathā siddhā prathamā| kiṃ ca parimeyavṛttibhyo dvitīyādayo yathā bhavanti tathā prathamāpi bhavati| atha prasthena parimitā vrīhaya ityevaṃ prātipadikārthavyatireke'pi yathā syāditi parimāṇagrahaṇam| yadyevam, prastheneti tṛtīyā na syāt, śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhī na syāt, prāstika iti taddhitaśca na syāt tadetatparimāṇagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam|
ukteṣvapīti| anyathānabhihitādhikārāt `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityādināsyaikavākyatvāttiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanasya pratyākhyātatvādekādiśabdairekatvādīnāmabhihitatvāduktārthatvād vā na syāditi bhāvaḥ| ekaḥ dvo bahava iti| atha kathamekaṃ kṛtamityādau dvitīyādayo bhavanti, na hi tatra kaścidyatno'sti? ucyate, tatrārthadvayamasti---karmādayaḥ, ekatvādayaśca| tatraikatvādīnāmabhidhāne'pi karmādipratipādanāya dvitīyādayo bhaviṣyanti; iha tvanabhihitārthāntarābhāvānna syāt| nanvatrāpyekādibhiḥ śabdairekatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidhīyate tatraikatvādiguṇasya niṣkṛṣyābhidhānāya prathamā bhaviṣyati, yathā guṇopasarjanadravyavacanācchuklādiśabdātpravṛttinimittabhūtasya guṇasya niṣkṛṣyābhidhāne bhāvapratyayaḥ---paṭasya śauklamiti| tadevaṃ vacanagrahaṇamapi śakyamakartum|
prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| ukto'tra praṣṭurabhiprāyaḥ| nipātasyānarthakasyeti| anyathārthābhāvānna syāditi bhāvaḥ| pralambata iti| kiṃ punaratra prathamayā prārthyate? padatvam; ṣaṣṭhyāmapyetatsiddham, tathā hi--karmādiṣu dvitīyādayo vihitāḥ praka-tyarthamātre prathamā, tatra prakṛtyarthābhāve svasvāmibhābādirsabandhasadbhāve cāpayuktādanyatvātsiddhā ṣaṣṭhī| na ca tasyā ekatvādiṣu niyamaḥ; uktottaratvāt| tadevamarthaliṅgamātre prathametyetāvadevāvaśyaṃ karttavyam, mātragrahaṇamapi na karttavyam| karmādyādhikye kasmānna bhavati? jñāpakāt, yadayam `saṃbodhane ca' ityāha| yadi hyādhikye'pi syāttadanartharka syāt| uttarārthe hi `saṃbodhane sāmantritam' ityeva vaktavyaṃ kiṃ yogavibhāgena! ihāvadhāraṇārthānmātragrahaṇāt `saṃbodhane ca' iti jñāpakādvā''dhikye prathamayā na bhavitavyam, tataśca `vīraḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādau padasāmānādhikaraṇye viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasyādhikārthasya pratīteḥ prathamā na prāpnoti, na; vākyārthatvāt| yadatrādhikyaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ, pūrva svārthamātraniṣṭhābhyāmubhābhyāṃ prathamā vidhīyate, paścāttvākāṃkṣāvaśenānyonyānvaye viśeṣāvagatirupajāyamānā bahiraṅgatvātprathamapravṛttaṃ saṃskāraṃ na bādhata ityarthaḥ|
apara āha---abhihite prathameti lakṣaṇaṃ karttavyam, tiṅādibhirabhihite kartrādau vṛkṣastiṣṭhati, kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ, śatyaḥ, prāptodako grāma ityādau prathamā bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra vīraḥ puruṣaḥ ityādāvādhikye'pyabhihitatvātsiddhā prathameti| atra ko doṣaḥ? yatra kriyā nāsti tatra na syāt---vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ| tatrāpi kriyā'sti, katham? vṛkṣaḥ plakṣaḥ, astīti gamyate| iha tarhi prāsāda āsta iti sadikrayāyāḥ, āsikriyāyāścaikamadhikaraṇaṃ prāsādākhyam, tacca sadipratyayena ghañābhihitaṃ prasīdatyasminprāsāda iti āsipratyayena tiṅānabhihitam, tatra sadipratyayena yadabhidhārna tadāśrayā prathamā prāpnoti| yatra ca viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhe tātparyam---nīlamutpalaṃ na raktamiti, tatrāpi na syāt; kriyāyā abhāvāt|
anyastvāha---tiṅsamānādhikaraṇe prathameti lakṣaṇaṃ tiṅantena yatsamānābhidheyaṃ devadattaḥ pacatīti, tatra prathamā; prāsāda āsta ityatra tu vaiyadhikaraṇyāttadabhāvaḥ, vīraḥ puruṣa ityādau cādhikye'pi tiṅsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ prati yogyatvādbhavatīti| atra ko doṣaḥ? devadattaḥ pacatīti devadattaḥ pac laṭ iti sthite yāvattiṅāmutpattirnāsti tāvattiṅsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvātprathamaiveti niyamasyāpravṛttau devadattaśabdādaviśeṣeṇa vihitāḥ svādayaḥ sthitā iti śatṛśānacornimittasyāprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyasya vidyamānatvāttāveva syātām, tiṅāṃ tvābhāvaḥ syāt| na ca tiṅ‌vidherānarthakyam; tiḍādiṣu sāvakāśatvāt| prathamaiveti| niyamasyāpi sa eva viṣayaḥ syāditi doṣa| pakṣe cāyaṃ doṣaḥ, katarasmin pakṣe? `laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau' ityatra dvau pakṣau--aprathameti paryudāsaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedho veti| tathā `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādāvapi prakaraṇe dvaitaṃ bhavati--vibhakti niyamaḥ syāt, arthaniyamo veti; tadyadārthaniyamaḥ paryudāsaścāśrīyate tadā'yaṃ doṣaḥ| katham? armaṇi dvitīyevetyasmin niyame dvitīyādīnāmaniyatatvāt prātipadikārthamātre'pi bhāvāttadāśrayau śatṛśānacau prāpnutaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedhe tu prathamāyā api tatra bhāvāttadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pravarttata iti na doṣaḥ; śatṛśānacorabhāvāttiṅkṣu satsu tatsāmānādhikaraṇyātprathamaiveti niyamena dvitīyādīnāṃ vyāvarttitatvāt| yadā tu dvitīyādīnāṃ karmādiṣu niyamaḥ---karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti, tadā tadabhāve tāsāmabhāvādaniyatāyāśca prathamāyāḥ sannidhānātparyudāse prasajyapratiṣedhe ca nāsti śatṛśānacoḥ prasaṅgaḥ; tadabhāve ca tiḍbhu satsu tatsāmānādhikaraṇyāttatraiva prathamā bhavatīti niyamena karmādiṣu prathamāvyāvṛttiriti na doṣaḥ|
nanu ca vibhaktiniyame karmādyabhāvena yadyapi dvitīyādīnāṃ tatrābhāvastathāpi śeṣaṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, tathā hi---yadi tiṅsāmānādhikaraṇya eva prathametyasmānniyamātprāgeva dvitīyādivat ṣaṣṭhyapi niyatā syāt? syāttatrāprasaṅgastasyāḥ| sā tu śeṣalakṣaṇā| yatra ca vibhaktyantarasya niyamo na kṛtaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tataśca tiṅsāmānādhikaraṇyātprāk śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāpnotīti tatsamānādhikaraṇyācchatṛśānacāveva syātām| paryudāse prasajyapratiṣedhe tu na doṣaḥ, prathamāyā api bhāvāt? satyam; dvayorapi pakṣayoḥ paryudāse bhavatyeva doṣaḥ| bhāṣye tu vibhaktiniyame paryudāse'pi na doṣa ityanāsthāvādaḥ pākṣika eṣa doṣa ityatraiva tātparyam| kṣantavyaṃ ca kiñcidudgranthābhidhānamityuparamyate||
sambodhane ca|| 2.3.47 ||
sambodhane ca|| ābhimukhyakaraṇamiti| yadvastu yenākāreṇa siddhaṃ tasya tenākāreṇābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ sambodhanam, na tvekaśrutividhāviva kasyacidarthasyānuṣṭheyatā pratyāyanam; vākyārtho hi saḥ| abhimukhīkaraṇaṃ tu na vākyārthaḥ, yena vīraḥ puruṣa ityādivadyadatrādhikyaṃ sa vākyārtha iti prathamā siddhyet| yasya padāntarasaṃprayoge satyeva pratītiḥ sa vākyārthaḥ| iha tu devadattetyetāvatyukte ābhimukhyakaraṇaṃ gamyate, ataḥ padārtha padārtha evātrādhikyamiti ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vacanaṃ tadāha---tadadhike prātipadikārtha iti| asiddhena cākāreṇābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ na saṃbhavati---rājā bhava yudhyasva svāhendraśatrurvarddhasveti| he pacan he pacamānetyādau śatṛśānacoḥ saṃbodhane vidhāne'pi vibhaktirahitayostayoḥ kartrādyabhidhāna eva sāmarthyam; yathā loṭo dvirvacananirapekṣasyetyanena prathamā bhavati| yadvā---abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntabhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti pūrveṇa bhaviṣyati, yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ||
sā''mantritam|| 2.3.48 ||
sāmantritam|| tadantaṃ yacchabdarūpamiti| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham--āmantraṇamāmantritamiti| abhedopacārāttatsādhane śabde varttate vibhaktyantena kevalayā saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantasya grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| udāharaṇeṣu `āmantritasya ca' ityādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati, seti vacanaṃ prātipadikārthasūtreṇāpi saṃbodhane vihitā yā prathamā tadantasyāpi saṃjñā yathā syāt---he pacan! he pacamāna!;asati tu tasmin `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā' ityanantarasūtravihitāyā eva syāt||
ekavacanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ|| 2.3.49 ||
ekavacanaṃ saṃbuddhiḥ|| he paṭo iti| saṃbuddhau ca `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' iti guṇaḥ, `suḥ saṃbuddhiḥ' iti vaktavye ekavacanagrahaṇameko'rtha ucyate yena tāvanmātrasya pratyayasya saṃjñārtham; agnyathā prakramābhedāya tadantasya syāt||
ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe|| 2.3.50 ||
ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe|| upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ, karmādayaśca prātipadikārthaparyantā upayuktā ityāha---karmādibhyo'nya iti| nanu na karmādibhyo'nyaḥ prātipadikārthasya vyatirakaḥ saṃbhavati, katham? kriyāmantareṇa saṃbandhānupapatteḥ, sarvatra syāstannimittānāṃ karmādīnāṃ cāvaśyambhāvāt| tathā hi---rājñaḥ puruṣa iti rājā karttā; rājā dravyaṃ puruṣāya dadātītyarthasaṃpratyayāt| vṛkṣasya śākheti| lokaprasiddhyā vṛkṣo'dhikaraṇam, tārkikaprakriyayā tu śākhā| devadattasya gaurityādau tu pratigrahaṇādau kartṛtvaṃ pratīyate---devadattaḥ pratigrahītā kretā vinimātā'paharttā veti; ucyate, naṭasya śṛṇotītyatra tāvatkriyākārakasaṃbandharūpa eva śeṣaḥ, katham? `ākhyātopayoge' ityupayogagrahaṇānnaṭasyāpādanasaṃjñā nāsti, duhyādiparigaṇanāccākathitatve'pi karmasaṃjñā nāsti, tadayaṃ naṭaḥ kārakameva śeṣaḥ| yaccoktam---kriyāyāstannimittānāṃ ca sarvatra bhāvānnānyaḥ prātipadikārthasya vyatireka iti, tanna;pratigrahakrayādijanyasya sarvalokaprasiddhasya svasvābhibhāvādisaṃbandhasyāpi durapalāpatvāt| yadi ca parasparamupakāryopakārakabhāve saṃbandhānupapatteḥ kriyākārakasaṃbandho'pi sarvatra vastusthityā'stītyucyet, astu tathā, na kaściddoṣaḥ; na hi yadyadvastusthityāsti tattadabhidhātavyam, yadeva tu vivakṣitaṃ tadeva svanimittāṃ vibhaktiṃ prasūte| tatra svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ sannapi kriyākārakasaṃbandho na vivakṣyata iti dvitīyādyabhāve ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati| evaṃ ca mātuḥ smarati, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt, anukaroti bhagavato nārāyaṇasyetyādau śrūyamāṇe'pi kriyāśabde mātṛsaṃbaddhaṃ smaraṇamiti saṃbandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam, karmatvaṃ tu sadapyavivakṣitamiti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| uktaṃ ca---
saṃbandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ|
śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ ca kriyāyāṃ so'bhidhīyate|| iti||
`ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' iti cedviśeṣyasya pratiṣedhaḥ svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ, sa ca dviṣṭhaḥ| tatra yadyapyekasmādapyutpannayāpi ṣaṣṭhyā dviṣṭhasyāpi saṃbandhasyāvagamādubhābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati, tathāpi kadācidviśeṣyādapi prāpnoti, prathamā ca na prāpnoti; saṃbandhasyādhikasya bhāvāt, na vā vākyārthatvāt| yadatra puruṣasyādhikyaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ, rājña ityetatpadasannidhānātpuruṣasya saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate, puruṣaprātipadikaṃ tu svārthamātre varttata iti tatra prathamā ca bhaviṣyati, ṣaṣṭhī ca na bhaviṣyatīti| etaduktaṃ bhavati---rājña iti kevalapada uccāryamāṇe saṃbandhitvamaniyatapratiyogikamavagamyate, puruṣapadasannidhau tu saviśeṣasya pratītirityetāvat, tataścāniyataṃ svamapekṣya prathamameva saṃbandhāśrayā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| nanu ca ṣaṣṭhyuccāraṇānuccāraṇakṛto yo viśeṣo'ṅga bhavān puruṣapadādapi ṣaṣṭhīmuccārayatu, gaṃsyate sa viśeṣaḥ? naitatsuṣṭhūcyate, na hi śabdasya bhāvābhāvābhyāmarthasya bhāvābhāvau kriyete, kiṃ tarhi? vidyamāna evārthaḥ pratipipādayiṣitaśca vācakapadaprayoge heturbhavati| tatra guṇasya paropakākatvena vivakṣitatvāttadante ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, puruṣasya tūpakāryatvātvātsvaniṣṭhatvena vivakṣitatvātprathamā bhavati| tatra ca saṃbandho guṇe padaṃ nidhāya pradhānamapi spṛśati, guṇaśca pradhānopakārāya pravṛtto'nyathānupapatte rūpāntaramāśrayati| pradhānaṃ tu svaniṣṭhatvena na rūpāntaraṃ bhajate, uktaṃ ca----
dviṣṭho'pyasau parārthatvād guṇeṣu vyatiricyate|
tatrābhidhīyamānaḥ san pradhāne'pyupayujyate|| iti|
yadā tu puruṣasyāpradhānyaṃ rājñaśca prādhānyaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā puruṣasya rājetyapi bhavatyeva; yadā ca rājñaḥ puruṣasya gṛhamiti tatpuruṣasya gṛhādisaṃbandho vivakṣyate tadaikasyāpi vastuno bhinnaviṣayo guṇapradhānabhāvo na viruddhyata iti dvābhyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| rājña iti hi ṣaṣṭhyā rājapuruṣayoreva saṃbandho'bhihitaḥ, na puruṣasya gṛhasya ca| iha pañcake prātipadikārthe `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādau cārthaniyamapakṣe śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, katham? karmādayo niyatāḥ, śeṣo'niyataḥ, tataśca svādisūtreṇa dvitīyādiṣu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca śeṣe prāpteṣu ṣaṣṭhītyetāvadapyucyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ sampadyate---ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavatīti| yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī ca pratyayāntaraṃ ca prāpnoti tatraivaṃvidadho niyama ityarthāccheṣa eva bhaviṣyatīti uttarārthameva tadavaśyaṃ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| trikapakṣe tu svārthe ṣaṣṭhī mā bhūditi dvitīyādīnāmiva karmādiḥ śeṣo vācyatvena vidhātavyaḥ| tathā pratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādīnāmaniyatatvātteṣvapi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ śeṣa eva ṣaṣṭhī na karmādiṣviti ṣaṣṭhīniyamārthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam||
jño'vidarthasya karaṇe|| 2.3.51 ||
jño'vidarthasya karaṇe|| asaṃdehārthaṃ vidarthasya jñaḥ karaṇa ityeva vaktavye tadakaraṇādavidarthasyeti padaccedaḥ, lugvikaraṇaśca vidirgṛhyate tadartha eva jānātervṛttisaṃbhavāt, tadāha---avidartasyājñānārthasyeti| sarpiṣo jānīta iti| `apahnave jñaḥ' `akarmakācca' ityātmanepadam| pravṛttivacana iti jñānapūrvikāyāṃ pravṛttau varttamāna ityarthaḥ| sarpiṣi rakta iti| rāgo mithyājñānasya hetuḥ, draupadyāṃ rakto hi kīcako rahasi bhīmasenamāliṅgyāvocad---aho uttamāṅganāmīddaśī susparśateti| pratihito veti| pratighāto dveṣasya hetuḥ, dveṣaśca mithyājñānasya hetuḥ, yo hi parihāsaśīlena kenacitpūyādikamaśuci dravyaṃ nirddiśyoktaḥ----sarpiretatpibeti, sa tatra pratihatastata ārabhya sarpidveṣṭi, dviṣataścātasminnapi tajjñānamutpadyate| yadi sarvameva grāhyam, tadātmanā sarpiḥ svabhāvatayā pratipadyate, evaṃ satyavidarthatvaṃ nopapadyate tatrāha--mithyājñānameveti| jñānakāryākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ| aviplutaviṣayaparicchedo hi jñānakāryam, tacca mithyājñānena na kriyate, asminpakṣe udakādikarmaṇāsakarmakatvād `akarmakācca' ityātmanepadānupatteḥ parasmaipadamudāhāryaṃ manyate||
adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi|| 2.3.52 ||
adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi|| `ik smaraṇe' kakāro'traiva viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, adhipūrvasyaivoccāraṇamevamevāyaṃ prayoktavya iti jñāpanārtham| śeṣatvena vivakṣita iti| nanu śeṣatvena vivakṣite pūrveṇaiva siddhā ṣaṣṭhī, yathā---na māṣāṇāmaśnīyād, anukaroti bhagavato nārāyaṇasyeti? satyam, prakaraṇaṃ tu niyamārtham----asminviṣaye ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva śrūyata eva na lupyata iti| kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? samāso nivarttito bhavati---mātuḥ smaraṇamiti| evaṃ pūrvasūtre paratra ca prakaraṇe sarvatra draṣṭavyam| samāse sati `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī lupyeta, tena pratipadavidhānaṣaṣṭhī na samasyata iti siddhaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ tarhi viśeṣasmṛteḥ saṃśaya iti samāsaḥ? ucyate; śeṣaṣṭhyā eva samāsaniṣedhaḥ iha tu `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti karmarūpavivakṣāyāmeva ṣaṣṭhī samāso bhaviṣyati| kaḥ punaratra viśeṣaḥ---śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ syāt, kārakaṣaṣṭhyā vā? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ---kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāse kṛtsvaro bhavati, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāse tu samāsāntodāttatvaṃ syāt, antodāttasamāsanivṛttaye pkaraṇam| yatra ca kārakaṣaṣṭhī pratiṣidhyate, yathā---mātuḥ smṛtamiti, tatra samāso'pi mā bhūt| evaṃ cātra prakaraṇe ye'nupāttāḥ, yāni cātra pratyudāharaṇāni, teṣūbhayeṣvapi niṣṭhāyoge śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ, anyatra kārakaṣaṣṭhyā apīti veditavyam| guṇairiti| guṇeṣu śeṣatvena vivakṣiteṣu asya niyamasyābhāvātsamāso bhavatyevetyarthaḥ| iyamevāsminprakaraṇe pratyudāharaṇagatiriti||
kṛñaḥ pratiyatne|| 2.3.53 ||
kṛñaḥ pratiyatne|| edhodakasyeti| `jātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvaḥ| upaskuruta iti| gandhanādisūtreṇātmanepadam| `upātpratiyatna'ityādinā suṭ||
rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvare|| 2.3.54 ||
rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvare|| `rujo bhaṅge'bhidādipāṭhādasmādeva nipātanādvā'ṅ| bhāvavacanānāmiti| nāyamartho bhāvavācināmiti, dhātūnāṃ bhāvavācitvāvyabhicārāt| kiṃ tarhi? bhāvaśabdena ghañādivācyaḥ siddharūpo bhāva ucyate| vacana iti karttari lyuṭ| tatra prakṛtyartho na vivakṣyate, na hi rujārthānāṃ bhāvo vaktā pratipādayitoccārayitā vopapaddāte| tasmātpratyayārtha eva kartā vivakṣitaḥ--bhāvo vacanaḥ karttā yeṣāmityarthaḥ, tadāha--bhāvakartṛkāṇāmiti| caurasyāmayatīti| `ama roge' curādiḥ,`nānye mito'hetau' iti curādau vacanāt `janījṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' iti mittvaṃ na bhavati| `jñapa micca' ityārabhya `nānye mito'hetau' itaḥ prāgye paṭhitāsta eva curādiṣu mito bhavanti, nānya ityarthaḥ| āmaya iti āṅpūrvasya mīnāterec, `mīnātiminoti' ityātvasya `nimimīlīyāṃ khalacoḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ| nadīkūlaṃ rujatīti| atra nadī kartrī, na bhāvaḥ| nanu rujāśabdo vyādhau rūḍha iti nātra prasaṅgaḥ? evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, idaṃ tu pratyudāharaṇam---śleṣmā puruṣaṃ rujatīti, vyādhinā kāsādinā grāhayatītyarthaḥ| jvarayatīti| `jvara roge' ghaṭādiḥ| santāpayatīti| `hetumati ca' iti ṇic, santāpo'tra bhāvaḥ, karttā ca||
āśiṣi nāthaḥ|| 2.3.55 ||
āśiṣi nāthaḥ|| nāthata iti| `āśiṣi nāthaḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānādātmanepadam, taccānudāttettvādeva siddhe niyamārtham---āśiṣyeva nātha iti, tena pratyudāharaṇe parasmaipadam||
jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām|| 2.3.56 ||
jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām|| na daivādikasyeti| `jāsi' iti nirdeśād `hisāyām' iti vacanācca niprābhyāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamupasṛṣṭo hano niprahaṇaḥ, `hanteratpūrvasya' iti ṇatvam| praṇihantīti| `nergada' ityādinā ṇatvam| `naṭa avasyandane' curādiḥ, `naṭa nṛttau' ityasya tu ghaṭādipaṭhitasyāgrahaṇam, vikṛtanirdeśāt| nipātanādvaddhiriti| ghaṭādipāṭhastu `ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ' ityātideśiko'ṅyathā syāt, `ciṇṇamulordīrgho'nyatarasyām' iti dīrghaśca yathā syādityevamarthaḥ||
vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ|| 2.3.57 ||
vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ|| samarthayoriti| saṃśabdo vṛttau samānārthaḥ, samaśabdasya vā nipātanātpararupamiti bhāvaḥ| saṃbaddhārthayoriti tu na vijñāyate, vyākhyānāt| saṃbhavati hi vyavahṛpaṇorhetuhetumadbhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| śatasya vyavaharatīti| śataṃ krayavikrayarūpeṇa viniyuṅkte, dīvyati vetyarthaḥ| śalākāṃ vyavaharatigaṇayatītyarthaḥ||
divastadarthasya|| 2.3.58 ||
divastadarthasya|| atra `śeṣa' iti nānuvarttate, uttarasūtradvayārambhasāmathyati| atha pūrvasūtra eva divirapi kasmānna paṭhitaḥ, evaṃ hi tadarthasyeti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? tatrāha---yogavibhāga iti||
vibhāṣopasarge|| 2.3.59 ||
vibhāṣopasarge|| śalākāṃ pratidīvyatīti| atra vijigīṣādau divirvarttate, na vyavahāre||
dvitīyā brāhmaṇe|| 2.3.60 ||
dvitīyā brāhmaṇe|| mantravyatiriko vedabhāgaḥ---brāhmaṇam| gāmasya tadahaḥ sabhāyāmiti| gāmasya sabhāyāmityanvayaḥ| tadaharityetadudāharaṇam, `svamornapuṃsakāt' iti luk, `ahan' iti rutvam|
anupasargasya nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmiti| `divastadarthasya' ityanena' atha sopasargasyāpi pūrveṇa ṣaṣṭhyāmapi prāptāyāṃ nityadvitīyārthaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha--sopasargasyetyādi||
preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne|| 2.3.61 ||
preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne|| iṣyaterdaivādikasyeti| `iṣu gatau' ityasya śyanā nirdeśa icchatīṣṇātyoricchābhīkṣṇyārthayornivṛttyarthaḥ| tadviṣaya eveti| loṇmadhyamaikavacanāntaḥ| devatāsaṃpradāna iti| devatā saṃpradānaṃ yasyārthasya tatra vartamānayoḥ karmaṇi kāraka ityanvayaḥ| haviṣaḥ havirviśeṣavācina ityarthaḥ| pre3ṣyeti| `brūhipreṣya' ityādinā plutaḥ| agyaye gomayāni preṣyeti| gomayaṃ haviṣṭvena kvāpi na coditam| haviṣaḥ prasthitasyeti| prasthitaśabdena yadviśeṣyate tasyetyarthaḥ| idaṃ ca bhāṣāyāmapi bhavati; uttaratra chandograhaṇāt||
caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi|| 2.3.62 ||
caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi|| yā kharveṇeti| rajasvalāyāḥ kharvapānādipratiṣedhārto'yamarthavādaḥ| tattarhi vaktavyam---ṣaṣṭhyarthe caturthīti? na vaktavyam, yogavibhāgātsiddham| caturthyartha iti nāyaṃ samāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? caturthī artha iti yogo vibhaktavyaḥ, ṣaṣṭhītyanuvarttate---arthe ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, caturthī ceti, tatra svārtha eva ṣaṣṭhīcaturthyorvidhānamanarthakamityanyo'nyasannidhānādanyo'nyārthe vibhaktidvayaṃ vijñāyate||
yajeśca karaṇe|| 2.3.63 ||
kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe|| 2.3.64 ||
kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe|| kṛtvasuco'rtho lakṣyate, kṛtvo'rtho yeṣāṃ te kṛtvo'rthāḥ| pañcakṛtva iti| `saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' dviriti| `dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc' arthagrahaṇametadartham||
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti|| 2.3.65 ||
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti| iha kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ bhavatīti| kartṛkarmabhyāṃ kriyā sannidhāpyate, dhātureva kriyāvācī, dhātośca dvaye pratyayāḥ---kṛtastiṅaśca| tatra tiṅprayoge `na lokāvyaya' iti lapratiṣedhena bhāvyam| sa cāvaśyaṃ lapratiṣedhaḥ karttavyaḥ, ye kṛto lādeśāstadartham---odanaṃ pacan, odanaṃ pacamānaḥ papiḥ somam,dadirgā iti, iha tu nārthaḥ kṛd‌grahaṇeneti matvā pṛcchati---kṛtīti kimiti| kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamanenetyasminvigrahe ktasya karmaṇi vidhānāttenaiva karmaṇo'bhihitatvānnaiva dvitīyā bhāvyam, evaṃ ca tadapavādaḥ ṣaṣṭhyapi na prāpnoti; ihāpyanabhihitādhikārāt, kṛtaśabdasya ca kaṭāpekṣasya samāso durlabhaḥ, etena taddhito vyākhyātaḥ, tasmādayamasādhureva pyogaḥ? satyam, viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ naiva samāsataddhitau bhavataḥ, yadā tu kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti karmasāmānye bhāve vā kta utpadyate tadā sāpekṣatvābhāvātsamāsaḥ, kena? `supsupā' iti, tataḥ `purvādiniḥ',`sapūrvācca'itīniḥ pratyayaḥ| na ca kaṭasya ktenābhidhānaṃ karoterutpadyamānaḥ ktapratyayaḥ karmasāmānyamevāha, viśeṣakarmasaṃbandhāttu tasyābhidhānam, na cātra taddhitenaikārthībhūtasya niṣkṛṣya kaṭena saṃbandhaḥ sambhavati, kriyayā tu guṇabhūtayā kārakāṇāṃ sambandho bhavati, yathā---kaṭaṃ kṛtavāniti| kṛtapūrvīśabdaścāyaṃ pūrva kṛtamanetyasminnarthe vyutpāditaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtavānityanena samānārthaḥ saṃpadyate, tatra karotikriyāpekṣamasti kaṭasya karmatvam, anabhihitaṃ ca taditi kṛd‌grahaṇe ṣaṣṭhī syād| yatra ca niṣṭhāntena śabdena kartṛkarmaṇoḥ saṃbandhastatraiva niṣṭhāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, yathā----kaṭaṃ kṛtavān, kṛtaḥ kaṭo devadatteneti, iha tu kṛtasya kaṭena saṃbandho na bhavatītyuktameva| atha tu vastuto niṣṭhānte pade dhātuvācyakriyāpekṣe ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tathā sati nedaṃ kṛdgrahaṇasya prayojanam, tenaitadapi nirastam|
asati kṛdgrahaṇe, kaṭaṃ kārayati pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadatteneti ṇicprakṛteḥ pacerartha prati kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ| sati tu kṛdgrahaṇe, ṇico'kṛttvānna bhavatīti kathamiva nirastam `na loka' ityatra naivaṃ jñāyate---laprakṛtibhūtasya dhātorye kartṛkarmaṇī iti, kiṃ tarhi? lānte pade yā kriyocyate prādhānyena guṇabhāvena vā, tatra ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatīti tenedamapyaprayojanam|
atha syād--`nalokāvyaya' ityatrāvyayaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇam, tenoccaiḥ kaṭānāṃ spraṣṭetyatrākṛto'pyavyayasya prayoge niṣedhābhāva iti, tadapi na; avyayena kartṛkarmaṇī viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ----avyayasya ye kartṛkarmaṇī tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī neti, na cākṛta uccaisaḥ kartṛkarmaṇī sambhavataḥ| iha tarhi karotīti kṛditi kṛcchabdena karttocyate, tatra kartṛkarmaṇorityeva ṣaṣṭhyāmapi siddhāyāṃ punarvidhānaṃ guṇabhūte'ti karttari yathā syāt----bhedikādevadattasya yajñadattasya kāṣṭhānāmiti, bhiderṇyantātparyāyādināṇvuc, atra ṇyarthasya prādhānyātprayojakakarttā pradhānam, prayojyakarttā tu prakṛtyarthasya guṇabhāvādguṇabhūta iti pradhānetarasannidhau pradhānādeva syāt, kṛdgrahaṇādapradhānādapi bhavati, etadapi nāsti prayojanam; tṛtīyāvat siddham, tadyathā---pācita odano devadattena yajñadattenetyādau pradhānāpradhānayordvayorapi kartrostṛtīyā bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ? ekaśabdavācyatvābhāvena virodhābhāvāt tathā ṣaṣṭhyapi bhaviṣyati|
iha tarhi prayojanam, `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti bahuvrīhiryathā syād, anyathānyapadārthasyānupāttatvāttatpuruṣaḥ syāttatra cāniṣṭaṃ vakṣyate| yadyevam, uttaratraiva kṛd‌grahaṇam karttavyam, atha vā---anupātte'pyanyapadārthe vyākhyānād bahuvrīhirbhaviṣyati, yathā---`ekāco dve prathamasya' iti, tadetatkṛdgrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam|
kecidāhuḥ---ihaiva taddhitanivṛttyarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇamiti prajānātiti prajñaḥ prajña eva prājñaḥ `prajñādibhyaśca'iti svārthike'ṇi kṛte vyākaraṇaṃ prājña ityatra ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| nanu kriyamāṇe'pi kṛdgrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā bhavatyeva kṛto'tra prayogaḥ,na hyatraitacchakyaṃ vaktum---pratyayārthenaikārthībhūtasya kṛdantasya niṣkṛṣya vyākaraṇena saṃbandho na sambhavatīti pratyayasya svārthikatvenārthāntarābhāvāt? naiṣa doṣa;kṛdgrahaṇasāmarthyātkṛdantenaiva yoge ṣaṣṭhī vijñāsyate, iha tu kṛtā taddhitena caikarūpaḥ saṃbandha iti na bhaviṣyatītyalamatikṣodena!
śeṣa iti nivṛttamiti| tenāprāptā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyata ityasyāḥ samāso bhavatīti kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati||
ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi|| 2.3.66 ||
ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi|| ubhayaśabdena prakṛtatvātkartṛ karmaṇī saṃbadhyete| ubhayaprāptāviti bahuvrīhiriti| na tatpuruṣaḥ| ubhayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīprāptau satyāmiti| atra prayojanaṃ vakṣyati---karmaṇyeveti| viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---ubhayaprāptāveva karmaṇīti| evaṃ hi pūrvasūtre karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syād, anenaiva viśiṣṭavidhānamāśrayaṇīyaṃ bhāvaḥ| āścarya iti| sakarmakebhyo bhāve kṛti vihite karmaṇi karttari ca ṣaṣṭhī prāptā niyamena kartturapanīyate| prāptigrahaṇācca prāptimātre niyama iti kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prayoge'pi karttari tṛtīyā bhavati, `antardhau yenādarśanamicchati' iti atra hyātmana iti gamyamānatvādastyubhayoḥ prāptiḥ| atra ca `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā' iti kartṛkarmaṇoriti prāptirniyamyate, śeṣaṣaṣṭhī tu karmaryati bhavatyeva| niyamasya prayojanaṃ pakṣe tṛtīyāśravaṇam| karmāpi yadā śeṣatvena vivakṣyate tadā tatrāpi śeṣaṣaṣṭhī bhavatyeva| tasyāśca `karmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhābhāvātsamāse'pi bhavati| niṣedhasya tu prayojanaṃ kṛtsvaro mā bhūditi| etadapi sūcitam---pūrveṇa ṣaṣṭhī prāptau niyamyata iti| āścaryamidamityetāvadekaṃ vākyam, kiṃ tadityāha---odanarayeti| atra pāke odanasya karmatvam, prādurbhāve ca brāhmaṇānāṃ kartṛtvamityanekatvātkṛdubhayaprāptirbhavati bhediketi| paryāyādiṣu ṇvuc| cikīrṣeti| `a pratyayāt'| atrobhayatrāpi karttari tṛtīyā na bhavati| ṣaṣṭhī tu śeṣavivakṣayāpi siddhyati| samāso'pyatra bhavati---dharmajijñāsā devadattasya, śiṣyasyācāryaśuśrūṣeti `śeṣe vibhāṣā' iti| tatra yadā niyamena karttari tṛtīyā tadā `karmaṇi ca' iti niṣedhātpāṇininā sūtrakṛtiḥ, ācāryeṇa śabdānuśāsanamityasādhuḥ samāsaḥ; pāṇineḥ sūtrakṛtiḥ, ācāryasya śabdānuśāsanamiti tu sādhuḥ||
ktasya ca vartamāne|| 2.3.67 ||
ktasya ca vartamāne|| rājñāṃ mata iti| `matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti vartamāne ktaḥ| śeṣavijñānāditi| upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, sadapyatra chāttrasya kartṛtvamavivakṣāyāṃ tirodhīyate, saṃbandhitvamātrameva tu vivakṣiṣyate, tataśca na māṣāṇāmaśnīyaditivatsiddhā ṣaṣṭhītyarthaḥ| tathā ceti| upasaṃkhyāne tvetanna siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ||
adhikaraṇavācinaśca|| 2.3.68 ||
adhikaraṇavācinaśca|| tasya ca prayoge ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktirbhavatīti| yathāsambhavaṃ yatra kartaiva sambhavati tatra kartari--idameṣāmāsitamiti, sakarmakebhyastvadhikaraṇe kte vihite dvayorapi kartṛkarmaṇoranabhihitanvād dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati---idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasyeti| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇītyayaṃ tu niyamaḥ `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityasyā eva prāpteḥ| vācigrahaṇaṃ kim? adhikaraṇa' ityucyamāne ktopalakṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta, tataścārthāntaravṛtterapi dhrauvyāderutpannasya ktasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt; vācigrahaṇe tu sati yadādhikaraṇaṃ karti tadaiva ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, padārthāntare tadā kartari tṛtīyā karmaṇi dvitīyā bhavati---ihaibhirāsitaṃ grāme gata iti; iha gatyarthe cātuśśabdyaṃ bhavati--idameṣāṃ gatamityadhikaraṇe, idamete gatā iti kartari, ihaibhirgatamiti napuṃsake bhāve, kartṛvivakṣāyāṃ idameṣāṅgatamiti tatraiva śeṣavivakṣāyām||
na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām|| 2.3.69 ||
na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām|| jighṛkṣitarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt tṛnāmityatra ṇatvābhāvaḥ| u uketi| anenokārapraślaṣaṃ darśayati| tatra laśceti pūrvadvandve ukārasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt, paranipāte'pi lavuketi syāt; tasmātparayordvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścāllaśabdasya dvandaḥ kāryaḥ, ukāreṇa ca kṛto viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ, vyapadeśivadbhāvātkevalasyāpi grahaṇam| śatṛśānacāviti| tena śānajarthaṃ tṛnniti pratyāhāro nāśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ| kikinau ceti| nanu lagrahaṇena lakārāstadādeśāśca grahītuṃ yuktāḥ---kaṭaṃ kārayāñcakāra, odanaṃ pācayati; kikinostvayuktaṃ grahaṇam, alatvādalādeśatvācca, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `kikinau liṭ ca' ityanena liṭtvātideśaḥ kriyate, na liṭsaṃjñā| tatra `kārayām' `pacānaḥ' ityādau liṭi tadādeśe ca ddaṣṭaḥ pratiṣedha kikinorapi bhaviṣyati| udāharaṇeṣu sarvatra kārakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| śeṣaṣaṣṭhī tu bhavatyeva---brāhmaṇasya kurvan, odanasya pacan, apāṃ perurasi, narakasya jiṣṇavo guṇaiḥ, tāni dviṣadvīryanirākariṣṇuriti| āgāmukamiti| `laṣapatapada' itāyadinokañ, rakṣāṃsi vārāṇasīṃ pratyāgamanaśīlāni bhavanti, śāpādimokṣārthamityarthaḥ| dāsyāḥ kāmuka iti| dvitīyā nivṛttyartha vacanam, ṣaṣṭhī tu śeṣavijñānādeva siddhā| purā sūryasyeti| `bhāvalakṣaṇe' ityādinā tosun| visṛpa iti| `sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' `pūṅyajoḥ śānan' `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś' `iṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi' ityeteṣu `la' iti nānuvarttata iti sthāpayiṣyate, tena lagrahaṇādasiddhiriti matvā''ha----tṛnniti pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti|
dviṣaḥ śaturvā vacanamiti| `dviṣo'mitre' iti yo'yaṃ śatṛpratyayaḥ, tatprayoge vikalpena pratiṣedho vaktavya ityarthaḥ| pratyākhyānaṃ tu śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyanyatra dvitīyeti, satā ca samāsapratiṣedhātsamāse kṛtsvarārtha kārakaṣaṣṭhī vidheyetyapi nāsti||
akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ|| 2.3.70 ||
akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ|| akasya bhaviṣyati kāle inastu ādhamarṇye ceti| saṃkhyātānudeśastu vyākhyānānna bhavatīti bhādaḥ| grāmaṃ gamīti| `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' nanuca nātra ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prasaṃgaḥ, katham? gatyarthakarmaṇītyatroktam---`dvitīyāgraharagaṃ kim? na cutarthyeva vikalpyeta, apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syādgrāmasya gantā' iti, satyam; śraute tāvat pratiṣedhe labhyamāne kiṃ dvitīyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāśrayaṇeneti manyate||
kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā|| 2.3.71 ||
kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā|| karttaroti kimiti| `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti vacanādakarmakebhyo bhāve sakarmakebhyaśca karmaṇi kṛtyānāṃ vidhānātkarttureva tairanabhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti kartṛkarmaṇordvayoradhikāre'pi kartayeva ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| geya iti| `bhavyageya' ityādinā karttari yatpratyayaḥ| sāmnāmiti| karmaṇi nityameva ṣaṣṭhī bhavati|
ubhayaprāptau kṛtya iti| ubhayo kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prāptiryasmin kṛtye tatra dvayorapi kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyarthaḥ| kraṣṭavyeti| kṛṣedvikarmakatvātpradhāne karmaṇi kṛtyapratyayaḥ, na tvapradhāna iti tasmin karmaṇi kartari ca prāptā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| etaccayogavibhāgāllabhyate, katham? kṛtyānāmityeko yogaḥ, atrobhayaprāptau neti ca vartate, yugapadubhayaprāptīnāṃ kṛtyānāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyarthaḥ; tataḥ kartari vā, atra ṣaṣṭhītyevānuvartate, anyatsarvaṃ nivṛttam||
tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyānyatarasyām|| 2.3.72 ||
tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyām|| śeṣaviṣaye vidhānāditi| śeṣaityadhikriyata iti bhāvaḥ| bahuvacananirdeśādeva svarūpagrahaṇābhāve siddhe'rthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣā ye tulyānāhustatparigrahārtham| tena dyotakā ivādayo nivarttitā bhavanti---gauriva gavayaḥ, yathā gaustathā gavaya iti| tulā devadattasyeti| tulopamāśabdau karmasādhanau tulyārthau tatra pratiṣedhyā tṛtīyā, ṣaṣṭhī tu bhavatyeva| iha `sphuṭopamaṃ bhūtisitena śambhunā' iti śmbhunā sphuṭopamā yasyetyupamāśabdenāpi yoge karaṇe tṛtīyā bhavati, bhāvasādhanatvāttasya, yathā---upamīyate'nenetyādau; itarathā hi tṛtīyānukṛṣyeteti tasyānantarasūtre śrutatvād anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe tu sati tasya prayojanāntarābhāvāttadeva cakāreṇānukṛṣyate||
caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ|| 2.3.73 ||
caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ|| āyuṣyādīnāṃ sukhaparyantānāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvārthaśabdena bahuvrīhīvidhānādarthaśabdenāyuṣyādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ| tatra madrabhadraśabdayoḥ paryāyatvātsūtre bhadraśabdo na paṭhitavya iti kecidāhuḥ| anye tvarthaśabdo'pi pṛthageva nimittam, vyākhyānācca sarvatrārthagrahaṇaṃ varṇayanti| vṛttāvapi kvacidarthaśabdo'pyudāhriyate|
hitaṃ devadattasyeti| `hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' ityasyānāśiṣi caritārthatvādāśiṣi hitayoge'pyanena vikalpena bhāvyam; anyathā'tra hitagrahaṇamanarthakamiti manyate||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryā
dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ||
