kāśikāvṛttau? padamañjarī?
atha dvitīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
dvigurekavacanam|| 2.4.1 ||
dvigurekavacanam|| atra yadi pāribhāṣikamekavacanaṃ gṛhyetānuprayogata ekavacanaṃ na syān---pañcapūlīyaṃ śobhaneti, tasyādvigutvād `dvigoḥ' iti pañcamyā ca nirddeśaḥ syāt, ato'nvarthasyaikavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti matvā''ha---ekasya vacanamekavacanamiti| vaktīti vacanam, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karttari lyuṭ, ekasyārthasya vacanamekavacanamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| tatra caikasyārthasya vācarka bhavatīti sāmānyanopakramaḥ, paścātkiṃ tadityapekṣāyāṃ dvigurityasya puṃlliṅgasya sambandha ityekavacanamiti napuṃsakopapattiḥ| etadeva vyanakti---ekasyārthasyeti| evaṃ ca dvigurekārthasya vācako bhavati| yadi dvigvartha eko bhavati, na ca vastuto'nekārthasya vacanaśatenāpyekārthatvāmāpādayituṃ śakyamiti sāmarthyādatideśo vijñāyate, tadāha--tadanena prakāreṇeti| taditi vākyopanyāse kimuktaṃ bhavatītyāhadvigvartha ekavadbhavatīti| samāhāradvigoścedaṃ grahaṇamiti| tadvitārthe yo dvigustasyaikavadbhāvo mā bhūdityevamartha pañcabhairgobhiḥ krītāḥ pañcagavaḥ paṭā iti| atha kriyamāṇe'pi samāhāragrahaṇe iha kasmānna bhavati---pañcapūlī ca pañcapūlī ca pañcapūlya iti, śiṣyamāṇasyadvigutvāttadarthasyaikavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti? na vā; bahiraṅgatvād, bahiraṅgo'yaṃ dvigvarthaḥ satyeva dvigāvekaśeṣātpragabhāvādekaśeṣe sati paścādupajāyamāntavādantaraṅge prāthamakalpike dvigvarthe caritārtha ekavadbhāvo'tra na bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, pañcagavaḥ paṭā ityatrāpyevameva bhaviṣyati? satyam; yadā paṭāḥ pratyekaṃ pañcabhirgobhiḥ kritāḥ, yadā tu bahavaḥ paṭāḥ saṃhatāḥ pañcabhirgobhiḥ kriyante tadā'yamekaśeṣasyāviṣayaḥ| yadi tarhi samāhāradvigorgrahaṇam, nārtho'nena, katham? samāhāraḥ- samūhaḥ, tasyaikatvādyūthaṃ vanamityādivadekavacanaṃ bhaviṣyati|
yadi tarhi samāhriyata iti samāhāra iti karmasādhanaḥ samāhāraśabdaḥ, tadā'pekṣitaparasparāḥ pañcapūlāḥ samāsārtha iti bahuvacanaprasaṅge'tideśa ārabhyate, tadāha---pratyadhikaraṇaṃ vacanotpatteḥ saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca dvigorekavacanavidhānamiti| adhikaraṇaṃ dravyam, saṃkhyāvācī pañcādiśabdaḥ, yatsaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidhīyate tadabhidhānayogyaṃ vacanamutpadyate| pañcapūlīśabdena pañcapūlāḥ samāhriyamāṇā ucyante, ataḥ samāsārthasya pañcādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyād dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅge ekavacanaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ| saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyādityanena karmasādhanatvaṃ samāhāraśabdasya darśayati, bhāvasādhane tu vaiyadikaraṇyaṃpañcānāṃ pūlānām| na vā samāhāraikatvāditi, ayamarthaḥ----tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ samūharūpaḥ samāhāro dvigvarthastasyaikatvādvanādivadekavacanasiddhernātra sūtreṇa prayojanam| avaśyaṃ ca tad bhāvasādhanaḥ samāhāra āśrayaṇīyaḥ anyathā pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakhaṭvītyatra vā ṭābanta iti strītvapakṣekhaṭvāśabdasyānupasarjanatvāt hrasvo na syāt| anupasarjanatvaṃ cāprathamānirddiṣṭatvādanekavibhaktitvācca| bhāvasādhane tu pañcānāṃ khaṭvānāṃ samāhāraḥ, samāhāraṃ samāhāreṇeti samāsārthasya nānāvibhaktiyoge'pi khaṭvāśabdasya nityaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt `eka vibhakti ca' ityupasarjanatvād hrasvatvaṃ sidhyati, ekavacanamityetaduttarārthaṃ kartavyameva| pañcapūlīti| `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' iti strīliṅgatvād `dvigoḥ' iti ṅīp||
dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām|| 2.4.2 ||
dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām|| iha yasya dvandvasya kaścidavayavaḥ prāṇyaṅgavācī, kaścittūryāṅgavācī, kaścitsenāṅgavācī; yathā---pāṇimārdaṅgikāśvārohā iti, sa vyatikīrṇāvayavo'pi prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ dvandvī bhavatyevetyekavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tatrāha---aṅgaśabdasyetyādi| nanu pūrvapakṣe'pi pratyekameva parisamāptiraṅgaśabdasya, na hiprāṇitūryasenānāmekamaṅgaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ tarhyaṅgānāmeva rūpasya bahuvacanāntasya sato'ṅgaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ, na tu pratyekaparisamāptasya paścādvahuvacanasambandhaḥ| trīṇi vākyāni saṃpadyanta iti| sūtraṃ tu teṣāmeva grahaṇakavākyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra prathamena vākyena prāṇyaṅgānāṃ prāṇyaṅgayoreva dvandvaḥ kṛtastasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate, dvitīyena tūryāṅgānāṃ tūryāṅgaireva, tṛtīyena senāṅānāṃ senāṅgaireveti na saṃkaraprasaṅgaḥ| tathā tūryāṅgānāmiti dvandva ekavadbhavatītyapekṣate, atrāṅgabda upakārakavacanaḥ pūrvatrottaratra cāvayavavacanaḥ senāṅgānāṃ ceti pūrvavadapekṣā| pāṇipādamiti| atra `jātiraprāṇinām' ityeva siddhe vyatikaranirāsārthaṃ vacanam| mārdaṅgikapāṇavikamiti| `śilpam' iti ṭhak| vīṇāvādaketi| `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' iti samāsaḥ, vipañcī parivādinī, tajjīvikaḥ- parivādakaḥ| paṇavamṛdaṅgamityādau tu `jātiraprāṇinām' ityeva siddham| rathikāśvārohamiti| kathaṃ rathavājipattikariṇīsamākulamiti, yāvataikavadbhāve sati napuṃsakahrasvatvena bhāvyam? niraṅkuśāḥ kavayaḥ| rathavājipattisahitāḥ kariṇyo rathavājipattikariṇyastābhiḥ samākulamiti vā samarthanīyam|
dvandvaścetyārabhya `vibhāṣā samīpe' ityantasya prakaraṇasyānārambhaṇīyatāṃ śaṅkateitaretarayoga ityādi| siddhamevaikavacanamiti| tataścānārambhaṇīyaṃ prakaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| pariharati--idaṃ tviti| kaḥ punarasau viṣayavibhāga ityāha---prāṇyaṅgādīnāmiti| kathaṃ punaḥ prāṇyāṅgādīnāṃ dvandva ekavacano bhavatītyasya vacanasya prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra evetyartho bhavatīti? vacanavyaktibhedāt| evaṃ hyatra vacanaṃ vyajyate--ya ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ bhavatīti, na punaḥ prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ yo dvandva ityanūdya tasyaikavacanatā vidhīyate| ekavacanāntaśca dvandvaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ, sa prāṇyaṅgadīnāmapi `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityeva siddha iti sa evaiṣāmiti niyamaḥ saṃpadyate; dadhipaya ādiṣvapi yeṣāṃ brahmaprajāpatyādīnāmanena prakaraṇena niyamasyāprāptisteṣāṃ tāvat `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena prāpto dvandvaḥ pratiṣidhyate| ya ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ na bhavatīti vacanavyaktyā śrayeṇa yeṣāmapi dadhipayasī ityādīnāṃ `jātiraprāṇinām' iti niyamasya prāptisteṣām `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti yadyapi niyamasya pratiṣedho yuktaḥ, tathāpi brahmaprajāpatyādibhiḥ sāhacaryādekavacano dvandva ityetāvanmātrasyāpekṣaṇātsamāhāradvandva eva pratiṣidhyate, na niyamaḥ| vṛkṣādivibhāṣāprayojanaṃ tu tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ|
athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate----itaretarayogapakṣe'prāpta ekavadbhāvo vidhīyata iti? ucyate--yadītaretarayogavihitadvandvasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyeta, `dvandvāccudaṣahānta' ityādinā samāhāranibandhanaṃ kārtha na syād| dadhipayaādiṣu tu yasya dvandvasyaikavacanaprāptistasya pratiṣidhyeteti samāhāradvandvasyaikavacanatāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāmapi dvitvabahutvābhāvād dvivacanabahuvacane na syātāmato niyama evāṅgīkarttavyaḥ| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| atha niyamo'pi bhavannevameva kasmādbhāvati---prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti? na punaḥ-----prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeva samāhāra iti? ucyate---evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne dadhipayaādiṣu yeṣāmanena prakaraṇena niyamo na prāpnoti teṣu pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt tiṣyapunarvasvoriti buvacanagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhitasamāhāradvandvapakṣe tiṣyapunarvasvidamityatraikavacanasya prasaṅge dvivacanaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham yadi ca tvadukto niyamaḥ syāttiṣyapunarvasvoratra prakaraṇe'saṅkīrttitayoḥ samāhāradvandvābhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt, ato vṛttikāroktameva niyamasvarūpamiti niravadyam||
anuvāde caraṇānām|| 2.4.3 ||
anuvāde caraṇānām|| caraṇasabdaḥ kaṭhakālāpādiṣu śākhābhedeṣu mukhyaḥ, tadadhyāyiṣu puruṣeṣu gauṇaḥ| ubhayeṣāṃ caiṣāṃ `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti cātisaṃjñā, tatra śākhābhedavācinaḥ `jātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvasya siddhatvād gauṇo'pi puruṣavṛttireva gṛhayata ityāha---caraṇaśabdaḥ śākhānimittaka iti| śākhādhyayananimittaka ityarthaḥ| gauṇa iti kvacitpaṭhyate, kvacinna| pramāṇāntarāvagatasyeti| śabdādanyatpramāṇaṃ pramāṇāntaram- pratyakṣādi| saṅkīrttinamātramiti| mātraśabdo'vagativyudāsāya| nanvarthapratipādanāya prayogaḥ, sa cedarthuḥ pramāṇāntareṇāvagataḥ, kimiti śabdaḥ prayujyate? kāryāntaravidhānārtham| yadā hi kaṭhakālāpeṣūditeṣu āvābhyāṃ tatra gantavyamiti saṃvādaḥ kṛto bhavati, sa ca vismṛtyodāste tadā taṃ pratīdamucyate---nanūdasthātkaṇṭhakālāpaṃ kimāsyate iti| kaṭhena proktamadhīyate kaṭhāḥ, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ, `kaṭhacarakālluk', kalāpiśabdāt `kalāpino'ṇa', nāntasya ṭilope sabrahmacārītyādinā ṭilopaḥ, ubhayatrādhyetraṇo luk| etena kauthumo vyākhyātaḥ| yadā tu prathamata eva śabdopadeśa iti| pramāṇāntareṇānavagatasya śabdenādyaṃ pratyāyanamityarthaḥ| udaguriti| `ātaḥ' iti jherjus, `usyapadāntāt' iti pararūpatvam| `adyatanī' iti luṅaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| anandiṣariti| `ṭunadi samṛddhau',`sijabhyasta' iti jus|
adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam|| 2.4.4 ||
adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam|| adhvaryuśabda ṛtvigviśeṣe prasiddhaḥ, na ca tena kratorviśeṣaṇamupapadyate, na hi so'sti kraturyatrādhvaryorananvayaḥ, nāpi so'sti yatrādhvaryorevānvaya iti mukhyārthāsambhavādaupacārikagrahaṇamityāha---adhvaryuveda iti| yajurveda ityarthaḥ| tatra hyādhvaryavaṃ vidhīyate| karmasvarūpasyetikarttavyatāyāḥ| phalasya copadeśaḥ---vidhānam| adhvaryukratuvācināṃ śabdānāmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāmiti| kathaṃ tarhi sūtre sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha---adhvaryukraturiti| tāddaśāvayavatvād dvandva eva tathokta ityarthaḥ| yadi punaranapuṃsakamityanena mukhyayā vṛttyā dvandva evocyeta tadā `sa napuṃsakam' ityasyāyamapavādo vijñāyeta| na vā'bādhenopapattau satyāṃ bādho nyāyyaḥ| arkaścāśvamedhaśca arkāśvamedham| sāyāhnaścātirātraśca sāyāhnātirātram|
iṣuvajrāviti| sāmavede eṣāṃ vidhānam| rājasūyavājapeyaśabdāvarddharcādiṣu paṭhitau, tatastau napuṃsakaliṅgau pratyudāharaṇam||
adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām|| 2.4.5 ||
adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām|| ākhyāyate'nenetyākhyeti śabdamātramihākhyāśabdenocyate, na rūḍhiśabda eva| asaṃdehārthaṃ viprakṛṣṭākhyānāmadhyayanata ityakaraṇādaviprakṛṣṭeti padacchedaḥ| ākhyānañca na svarūpeṇāviprakarṣaḥ, kintu pravṛttinimittadvāreṇa, taccehādhyayanam, tadāha---adhyayanata iti| adhītiḥ-adhyayanam, adhyayanenādhyayanataḥ, ādyāditvāttasiḥ, pravṛttinimittabhūtasyādhyayanasyāviprakṛṣṭatvāttaddvāreṇāviprakṛṣṭā ākhyā yeṣāṃ te'dhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyāḥ| etadevāha---adhyayanena nimittenetyādi| padakakramakamiti| padānyadhīte padakaḥ, `kramādibhyo vun,' evaṃ kramakaḥ| vṛttiḥ- saṃhitā, tāmadhīte vārttikaḥ, ukthāditvāṭ ṭhak, atra pravṛttinimittasyādhyayanasyāviprakarṣaṃ darśayati---saṃpāṭha iti| saṃpāṭha iti| saṃpaṭhanaṃ saṃpāṭhaḥ, adhyayanamityarthaḥ| pratyāsanna iti| padānyadhītya kramo'dhyetavya iti kṛtvā| evaṃ kramakavārtikamityatrāpi nānadhotya saṃhitāṃ kramo'dhyetuṃ śakya iti pratyāsattirvijñeyā||
jātiraprāṇinām|| 2.4.6 ||
jātiraprāṇinām|| jātivācyavayavatvājjātirdvandva iti gauṇo nirddeśaḥ| ārāśastrīti| ārā-pratodaḥ| dhānāśaṣkulīti| ṣaṇṇāṃ rasānāṃ kulaṃ śaṣkulī, gaurādipāṭhādrūpasiddhiḥ| nandakapāñcajanyāviti| sañjñāśabdāvetau, `khaṅgo'syanandakaḥ, śaṅkhaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ|
jātiparatve ceti| jātiprādhānye ityarthaḥ| na niyatadravyavivakṣāyāmiti| yadā kvaciddeśādau niyatānāṃ dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ vivakṣā tadā jātiśabdatve'pyekavadbhāvo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| badarāmalakānīti| phalajātivācināvetau||
viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadī deśo'grāmāḥ|| 2.4.7 ||
viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadī deśo'grāmāḥ|| viśiṣṭaliṅgānāmityasya vivaraṇam---bhinnaliṅgānāmiti| vipūrvaḥ śiṣirbhidinā samānārthaḥ| tathā ca bhedaka viśeṣaṇaṃ bhedyaṃ viśeṣyamityucyate| `ktena nañviśiṣṭena' ityatrāpi bhedadvāreṇaivādhikyamartho vyākhyātaḥ---yasya hi nañ bhedakaḥ sa nañādhiko bhavati| nadīvācināmityādi| kathaṃ tarhi sūtre viśiṣṭaliṅgādiśabdānāṃ dvandvena sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha---nadyavayava ityādinā| agrāmāvayavo'grāma ityapi draṣṭavyam| agrāmā iti caikavacanasthāne bahuvacanam| asamāsanirdeśa evāyamiti| samāse hi vyatikīrṇāvayo dvandva ekavatsyāt| gaṅgākurukṣetre iti samāso hi bhavannitaretarayoge ced dvivacanaprasaṅgaḥ, samāhāre cennapuṃsakatvaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| udhyairāvatīti| `ujjha utsarge', `bhidyodhyau nade'| deśaḥ khalvapīti| udāhriyata iti śeṣaḥ
jāmbavaśālūkinyāviti| jāmbavaṃ nagaram, śālūkinī grāmaḥ, tatrobhayataśca grāmāṇāmiti pratiṣedha eva bhavati| grāmobhayāvayavastu dvandvo nodāhṛtaḥ| janapado hi deśa iti| janā yatra sañcaranti sa deśa ityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ janapado deśa ityaṅgīkarttavyamityāha---tathā ceti| grāme nādhyeyam|
abhakṣyā grāmakukkuṭā ityādau grāmagrahaṇena nagaramapi gṛhyate, tadvadihāpinagarāvayavasyāpi dvandvasyātra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `prācāṃ grāmanagarāvayasyāpi dvandvasyātra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, jñāpakātsiddham, `prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' iti grāmagrahaṇe nagaragrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati----iha śāstre grāmagrahaṇe na nagaraṃ gṛhyata iti? naitatsuṣṭhūcyate, vakṣyati hi tatra `grāmatvādeva siddhe nagaragrahaṇaṃ pravṛttibhedajñāpanārtham, grāmagrahaṇamaṅgaviśeṣaṇam----pūrvaiṣukāmaśamī, nagaragrahaṇaṃ tūttarapadaviśeṣaṇam---pūrvapāṭaliputrakaḥ' iti, vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca udīcyagrāmāccetyādau grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇaṃ na syāttasmādāha---agrāma ityatra nagarapratiṣedha iti| grāmāśrayasya pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ|
ubhayataśceti| grāmanagarātmake ubhayasminsati grāmāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha eva vaktavyaḥ, na punarnagarāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ||
kṣudrajantavaḥ|| 2.4.8 ||
kṣudrajantavaḥ|| kṣudraśabdo'yamastyeva kṛpaṇe---kṣudro'yaṃ puruṣa iti, astyaṅgahone śīlahīne ca---`kṣudrābhyo vā' iti, asti parimāṇāpacaye---kṣudrāstaṇḍulā iti; iha tu jantuśabdasamabhivyāhārādantimasya grahaṇamityāha--apacitaparimāṇaḥ kṣudra iti| alpaśarīra ityarthaḥ|
apacayasyāpekṣikatvādanavasthā mā bhūditi smṛtimupanyasyati---kṣudrajanturanasthiḥ syāditi| yasyāsthīti na vidyante so'nasthiḥ| smṛtyantaramāha---atha veti| kṣottavyaḥ kṣudraḥ, arhārthe'pi `sphāyītañci' ityādinā rak pratyayaḥ, yaḥ kṣudyamāno'pi na mriyate, yathā---jalūkā, sa kṣudrajantuḥ; yastu mriyate sa pāpanimittatvānna kṣodārhaḥ| kṣudra eva ya iti vyutpattivaśādevāyaṃ prasiddha ityarthaḥ| smṛtyantaramāha----śataṃ veti| prasṛtirañjalerarddhaṃ yeṣāṃ śataṃ prasṛtau bhavati, śatenārddhāñjaliḥ pūryata ityarthaḥ| smṛtyantaramāha---kecidā nakulādapīti| nakulaparyantāḥ kṣudrajantava ityarthaḥ|
itarāsāṃ tadvirodhāditi| anasthādibhiḥ smṛtibhirye prayogā upadarśitā na te sarve tābhiḥ saṃgṛhyanta ityayamatra virodhaḥ||
yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ|| 2.4.9 ||
yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ|| virodho vairamiti| na sahānavasthānādiḥ, chāyātapāvityādāvapi prasaṅgāt| pūrvasūtrāccānuvṛttena jantugrahaṇena virodhasya viśeṣaṇāt| jantūnāṃ hi virodho vairameva bhavati| śāśvatiko nitya iti| śaśvaditi traikālyamāha| `tatra bhavāḥ' iti kālāṭṭhañi tāntādapi nipātanādikādeśaḥ, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopābhāvaśca| gopālasyāpatyāni gaupālayaḥ, atra kādācitko virodhaḥ| cakāraḥ punārityādi| paśuśakunidvandvāvakāśaḥ----mahājorabhraṃ mahājorabhrāḥ, haṃsacakravākaṃ haṃsacakravākāḥ; virodhināmekavadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ---śramaṇabrāhmaṇam, mārjāramūṣikam; aśvamahiṣaṃ kākolūkamityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvātpaśuśakunivibhāṣā syāt, cakārādayameva bhavati||
śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām|| 2.4.10 ||
śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām|| śūdraśabdo'tra traivarṇikavyatiriktajātimātravacanaḥ, na vṛṣalaparyāyaḥ, niravasitapratiṣedhāt| niravasita iti| niravapūrvātsyateḥ karmaṇiktaḥ| tatra prakṛtyarthamāha----niravasānaṃ bahiṣkaraṇamiti| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmupasargavaśādveti bhāvaḥ| pātrādvahiṣkaraṇamiha vivakṣitamityāha---yairiti| saṃskāreṇāpīti| `bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyam' ityādinā smṛtikārairuktena na śudhyati, tena tatra bhoktuṃ na labhanta iti tato bahiṣkṛtā bhavanti||
gavāśvaprabhṛtīti ca|| 2.4.11 ||
gavāśvaprabhṛtīti ca|| dvandvarūpāṇīti anvayātprabhṛtīnīti napuṃsakopapattiḥ| gavāśvaprabhṛtīni kṛtaikavadbhāvānyeva paṭhyante, teṣāmanena sādhutvamātraṃ vidhīyate, na tvekavadbhāva ityāha---gavāśvaprabhṛtīnīti| gavāśvādīnāṃ caturṇāmpaśudvandve vibhā ṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| evamuṣṭrakharam, uṣṭraśaśamiti| darbhaśarādīnāṃ tṛṇolapaparyantānāṃ tṛṇadvandve vibhāṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ dāsīdāsādīnām `pumānstriyā' ityekaśeṣābhāvo'pi nipātanāt| śāṭīpaṭīkamityādīnāmaprāṇijātivacanānāmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| anyeṣāṃ kubjavāmanādīnāmaprāpte vacanam| yathoccāritaṃ dvandvavṛttamiti| gaṇe yāddaśāḥ kṛtāvaṅādeśāḥ paṭhitāstāddaśānāmeva dvandvavṛttaṃ dvandvakāryamekavadbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| rūpāntareṣviti| `avaṅ sphoṭāyanasya' iti vikalpitatvādyadā nāsti tadetyarthaḥ| etena gaṇapāṭhe rūpameṣāṃ vivakṣitam, na pūrvottarapadanirdeśamātre tātparyamityuktaṃ bhavati||
vibhāṣā vṛjñamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍapūrvāparādharottarāṇām|| 2.4.12 ||
vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍapūrvāparādharottaraṇām|| atra vṛbhādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ dvandve viśeṣyate| na caiko vṛkṣaśabdo dvandvaḥ, na ca dvayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ, ekaśeṣāt| na ca paryāyāṇāmapi sahayogaḥ, virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ekaśeṣavacanāt, nāpi viśeṣeṇa sahaprayogaḥ----vṛkṣaśca dhavaśceti, vṛkṣaśabdenaivāśeṣaviśeṣākṣepāddhavādiśabdaprayogasya niṣphalatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi `gobalīvardau' ityādau sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ saha prayogaḥ? balīvardaśabdasaṃnidhau gośabdasya strīgavīṣveva vṛtterddhayorapi viśeṣavacanatvāditi ced, ihāpi tarhi dhavapadasaṃnidhau vṛkṣaśabdasya tadvyatiriktaviṣayatayā dvandvaprasaṅgaḥ? kiṃ ca vākye'pi kathaṃ sahaprayogaḥ----brāhmaṇā āgatā vasiṣṭho'pyāgata iti ? prādānyakhyāpanārthamuktārthasyāpi prayoga iti ced, dvandve'pi tarhi prāpnoti| tasmānadanabhidhānamevāśrayaṇīyam, na hi vṛkṣadhavamiti loke'bhidhānamasti, ato vṛkṣaviśeṣavācināṃ grāhaṇam| evaṃ mṛgādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam|
ityeteṣāṃ dvandva iti| eteṣāmityekāpi ṣaṣṭhī viṣayabhedādbhidyate---vṛkṣādīñchakuniparyantānpratyavayavaṣaṣṭhī, aśvavaḍavādīn prati nirddhāraṇaṣaṣṭhī| ye'trāprāṇinasteṣāṃ `jātiraprāṇinām' iti nityaṃ samāhāradvandve prāpte ubhayatra vidhīyate | yo vibhāṣāprāptaikavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāṃ bhavatīti vacanavyaktyāśrayaṇena teṣāmeva vṛkṣādīnāmanyaiḥ saha dvandve yathāprāptaṃ nityo vikalpito vā ekavadbhāvo bhavati----vrīhikuśaplakṣamiti, `jātiraprāṇinām' iti nityaḥ, plakṣaśabdasparśā ityatrādravyavācitvāt`jātiraprāṇinām' ityasyāpravṛttau `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityubhayatra prāpto bhavati| paśugrahaṇaṃ hastyaśvādiṣu paratvāt senāṅgalakṣaṇasya nityavidherbādhanārtham|
mṛgaśakunigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na hyeteṣāmanena prakaraṇena nitya ekavadbhāvaḥ prāptaḥ, yadvādhanāya vikalpo'bhyanujñāyate, anyatra prāptyabhāvādeṣāmubhayatraiva dvandva iti niyamo na sambhavati? athaiṣāmevobhayatra dvandva iti niyamaḥ syāt, kva tarhyeṣāṃ syāt? kvaciditi cet, yadyevam, `cārthe dvandvaḥ' iti sāmānyalakṣaṇamanavakāśasyāt, viṣiṣṭavidhānameva tadānīmāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāre dadhipayaādīnāmitaretarayoge vṛkṣādīnāmubhayatreti? athaiṣāmevobhayatretyanenānyeṣāmubhayatrāpi dvandvo vāryate, anyataratra tu bhavatyeva| evamapi kvānyatreti na jñāyate, `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati' iti cānupapannaṃ syāt? ucyate---yattulyajātīyānāmevāyaṃ vikalpastatraiva niyamaḥ pravartate---mṛgaviśeṣavācināṃ mṛgaviśeṣavācibhirevobhayatra dvandvaḥ, anyaistu sahānyataratreti| nanvemapi na jñāyate---kvānyataratreti, syādetad evam, yadyubhayatraiṣāṃ dvandva iti śrutaṃ syāt| iha tu vibhāṣaikavacano dvandva iti śrūyate, tataśca yo vibhāṣāprāpta ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa mṛgaviśeṣavācināṃ mṛgaviśeṣavācibhireva nānyairiti vacanavyaktau vyaktameva jñāyate---anyaiḥ sahetaretarayogadvandva iti| athāsyāṃ vacanavyaktau vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā vibhāṣaivaikavacanānto dvandvaḥ prāptastatraitāvadevāstu--ya ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa eṣāmebhireveti ? ucyate---asati vibhāṣāgrahaṇe vacanavyaktyantaramapi sambhāvyeta---eṣāmebhiḥ sahaikavacana eva dvandva iti, yathā prāṇyaṅgadiṣu| sati tu tasya niyamasyāsambhavādabhimato niyamaḥ saṃpadyate| evaṃ pūrvāparam, adharottaramityatrāpi niyamasvarūpaṃ vijñeyam|
`paśudvandva' ityeva siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham| tatra pratipadavidhānādaśvavaḍavamityekavadbhāvapakṣe `pūrvavadaśvaḍavau' ityetadvādhitvā `sa napuṃsakam' ityetadeva bhavati, tacchabdena hyekavadbhāvabhājaṃ parāmṛśya vidhīyamānaṃ napuṃsakatvamekavadbhāvavadeva pratipadavihitaṃ bhavati| `pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityetattu ekavadbhāvābhāvapakṣe pravartate----aśvaḍavau, aśvavaḍavān iti| etadevābhipretya vṛttikārastatra vakṣyati---aśvavaḍavayorvibhāṣaikavadbhāva ukta ityādi|
bahuprakṛtiriti| bahavo bahutvasaṃkhyāyuktā varttipadārthāḥ prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya dvandvārthasya sa bahuprakṛtiḥ, tadarthābhidhāyitvād dvandvo'pi bahuprakṛtiḥ| nedaṃ svatantraṃ lakṣaṇam, svātantrye nityaṃ cedvanaspatyādīnāmapi etatsūtravihitaṃ vikalpaṃ bādhitvā bahuprakṛtitve nitya ekavadbhāvaḥ syāt, vikalpe phalādīnāmapi `jātiraprāṇinām' ityādilakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptaṃ nityamekavadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā bahuprakṛtitve vikalpaḥ syāt| ato lakṣaṇāntarasya śeṣo'yam| tatrāpi yadi `vibhāṣā vṛkṣa' ityatra paṭhitatvādasyaiva śeṣatvaṃ syāttato vanaspatyādiṣvabahuprakṛtitve evadvikalpābhāve'pi `jātiraprāṇinām' iti nityo vidhiḥ syāt, phalādiṣu tu na doṣaḥ; etadvikalpaprāptyabhāvāllakṣaṇāntaraprāptereva niyamanāt tasmātsarvasyaiva prakaraṇasyārthaśeṣastadetadāha---eṣāṃ bahuprakṛtireveti| eṣāṃ phalādīnāṃ dvandvo'nena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vā ekavadbhavan bahuprakṛtirevaikavadbhavatītyarthaḥ| badarāmalake iti| atra `jātiraprāṇinām' iti na bhavati| rathikāśvārohāviti| atra senāṅgalakṣaṇaḥ| plakṣanyagrodhāviti| atrāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, `jātiraprāṇinām' nityaśca na bhavati| avanaspatīnāṃ tu vṛkṣiviśeṣāṇāmabuhuprakṛtitve'pyayaṃ vikalpo bhavatyeva---āmrapalāśam, āmrapalāśau| anye tu vanaspatigrahaṇaṃ vṛkṣamātropalakṣaṇaṃ manyante| rurupṛṣatau, haṃsacakravākāviti| atrāpyasya vikalpasyābhāvaḥ| yūkālikṣe iti| `kṣudrajantavaḥ' ityasyābhāvaḥ| vrīhiyavau, kuśakāśāvityatra tūbhayoḥ||
vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci|| 2.4.13 ||
vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci|| pasparaviruddhamiti| sahānavasthānādilakṣaṇo virodhaḥ, `vipratiṣiddhānām' ityādisūtre tu tadvācyavayavatvād dvandvarūpameva tathoktamiti bhāvaḥ| adravyavācināmiti| etenādhikaraṇaśabdo dravye vartate, nādhāra iti darśayati| na hi dvandvāvayavānāmādhāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati; vibhaktyarthatvādādhārasyeti bhāvaḥ| ayamapi niyamārthaḥ prārambha; niyamasvarūpaṃ ca---ya ekavacano dvando vibhāṣāprāptaḥ sa yadi vipratiṣiddhavācināṃ bhavatyadravyavācināmeva, dravyavācināṃ tvitaretarayoga iti||
na dadhipaya ādīni|| 2.4.14 ||
na dadhipaya ādīni|| yathāyathamiti| vyañjanatvādvikalpasya prāptistatrāditistriṣu, pūrvasūtravikalpasya śuklakṛṣṇāviti, na tviha| yadyevam, pratiṣiddhe'sminvikalpe jātilakṣaṇo nityaḥ syādekavadbhāvaḥ? parihāro'tra vakṣyate---striyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanneti| yathā ṣaṭsvabhidhāsyate tathātrāpyekavadbhāvamātrameva niṣidhyate | kiṃ ca, brahmaprajāpatyādiṣvatra paṭhiteṣu samāhāradvandvaniṣedhamukhenetaretayogadvandvo vyavasthāpyate, tatsāhacaryādeteṣvapi caturṣu tadeva yuktam||
adhikāraṇaitāvattve ca|| 2.4.15 ||
adikāraṇaitāvattve ca|| vṛttirvartaḥ- samāsaḥ, so'syāstīti samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ varttipadam, tasyārtho'dhikaraṇamityucyate, kathaṃ punastadadhikaraṇamityāha--sa hīti| niyamasya cātra pratiṣedhaḥ prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti niyamo varttipadārthasyeyattāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ na bhavatīti, na punaḥ pūrvasūtravatsamāhāradvandvasya pratiṣedhaḥ| yadyevam, pratiṣiddhe'pi niyame `daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ' ityadhikaraṇaitāvattve'pi `cāthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena samāhāre'rthe dvandvaḥ syādeva, ye cātra prakaraṇe'saṃkīrttitāsteṣu niyamasyāprasaṅgādasatyasminpratiṣedhe `cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityanena samāhāre dvandvaḥ syādeva---daśa brāhmaṇakṣattriyā iti, ataḥ prakṛtānāmanyeṣāṃ ca sarveṣāmekavacano dvandvo na bhavati, `adhikaraṇaitāvattve' iti samāhāradvandva eva pratiṣedhyaḥ? ucyate---`adhikaraṇaṃ varttipadārthaḥ' ityuktam, na ca samāhāradvandve vattipadārthasyaitāvattvaṃ śakyaṃ pratipādayitum, daśādiśabdaprayoge'pi hi tasyaiva dvandvārthasya samāhārasya saṅkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyate, na vartipadārthasya, yathā dvigau---daśapañcapūlya iti| ato vartipadārthasya saṅkhyāviśeṣaṃ pratipipādayiṣatā'vaśyamitaretarayoga dvandvo vidheya iti daśabrahmāṇakṣattriyā ityādau tāvadadoṣaḥ| yadyevam, anenaiva nyāyena `daśa dantoṣṭhaḥ' ityādāvapi samāhāradvandvo na bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ pratiṣedhena? maivam; asatyasminpratiṣedhe prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eveti niyamāditaretarayogadvandvo na syāt| na ca samāhāradvandve daśādiprayoge'pi varttipadārthasya saṅkhyāviśeṣaḥ pratipādayituṃ śakya iti adhikaraṇaitāvattve pratipipādayiṣite dvandva eva na syādityārabhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| daśa dantoṣṭhā iti| atra daśaśabdasya pratyekaṃ sambandhādvarttipadārthasyeyattā gamyate, samudāyasambandhe'pi dantoṣṭhātmakavarttipadārthagataiva saṅkhyā||
vibhāṣā samīpe|| 2.4.16 ||
vibhāṣā samīpe|| `adhikaraṇaitāvattve' ityadhikārātsamīparūpa etasminniti gamyate, vṛttau tvarthamātraṃ darśitam| adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya samīpa iti| atra ca bhāvapradhānaḥ samīpaśabdaḥ, adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya sāmīpye paricchittāvityarthaḥ| atra vispaṣṭa eva niyamasya pratiṣedhaḥ, na hi vibhāṣā samāhāradvandvaḥ pratiṣedhyaḥ| avyayībhāvo vihita iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' ityādinā| yadyapyatra saṅkhyayeti nāsti, saṅkhyayāpi tu bhavatyeva| bahuvrīhiriti| `saṅkhyayāvyayāsanna' ityādinā| tatraikavadbhāvapakṣe'vyayībhāvo'nuprayujyata iti ekārthasyaikārtha iti bhāvaḥ| aikārthyañca tasya sāmīpyapradhānatvāt| yadyapyavyayībhāvo'vyayatvānniḥ----saṅkhyastathāpi bhedābhāvarūpamaikārthyamastyeva| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca sāmīpyatadvatorabhedāśrayeṇa pratipādyam| adhikaraṇaitāvattvamapi samāhārasamāhāriṇorbhedāvivakṣayaivopapādyam| itaratra bahuvrīhiriti| bahvarthasya bahvartha iti bhāvaḥ| bahvarthatvaṃ ca tasya samīpipradhānatvāt| nanu dvandvārthasyaikavadbhāvādanuprayogasyāpyekavacanatā siddhā, kimetayā kliṣṭakalpanayā? ucyate--avyayībhāvasyaivānuprayoge tasyāvyayatvā dvahutvābhāvād bahuvacanaṃ na syāt,satyapi vā tasminnambhāve kṛte upadaśā iti na syāt| bahuvrīhereva cānuprayoge upadaśasya pāṇipādasyeti ṣaṣṭhī syād, upadaśampāṇipādasyeti ceṣyate; ato yathoktameva sādhīyaḥ||
sa napuṃsakam|| 2.4.17 ||
sa napuṃsakam|| paravalliṅgatāpavādo yogaḥ| sagrahaṇaṃ vyavahitasya dvigorapi yathā syād, anyathā'vyavahitasya dvandvasyaiva syāt, naitadasti; ekavacanamityetāvanmātramevāpekṣiṣyāmahe, naikavacanaviśeṣaṃ dvandvam| evaṃ tarhi yo'tra prakaraṇe'saṅkīrtitaḥ samāhāradvandvastasyāpi yathā syāt? anyathā prakṛtasyaiva dvandvasya dvigośca syāt| nanu prakaraṇamapi nāpekṣiṣyate, yadyevam, ekasaṅkhya ityādāvekārthasya syāt, ato'vaśyāpekṣyaṃ prakaraṇam| tasmiṃścāpekṣyamāṇe prāṇyaṅgādisambandhādirūpeṇa dvandvaḥ prakṛta iti tasyaiva syāt| sa ityetasmiṃstu sati apekṣyamāṇe'pi prakaraṇe prāṇyaṅgādisambandhaparityāgena yo'tra prakaraṇe saṃkīrtito dvandvo dviguśca `sa napuṃsakam' iti sarvasya samāhāradvandvasya napuṃsakatvaṃ labhyate, ekādau cātiprasaṅgo na bhavati| tathā ca `yuvoranākau' ityādāvucyate---yuvoriti samāhāradvandve sa napuṃsakaprasaṅgaḥ| ato yāvānkaścana samāhāradvandvaḥ prāṇyaṅgādisambandhī, anyo vā, sarvasyāsya napuṃsakatvaṃ vidhīyata iti siddham|
akārāntottarapada iti| atrāta ityadhikāre `dvigoḥ' iti ṅībvidhānaṃ liṅgam| pañcakhaṭvīti| strītvapakṣe upasarjanahrasvatvam|
ano nalopaśceti| `uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātpadatbābhāvānnalopavacanam|
pātrādibhya iti tādarthya eṣā caturthī pātrādyantānāṃ dvigūnāṃ siddhaya ityarthaḥ| pātrādirākṛtigaṇaḥ||
avyayībhāvaśca|| 2.4.18 ||
avyayībhāvaśca|| pūrvapadārthapraghānasyeti| adhistrītyādau pūrvapadārthasyāliṅgatvādiliṅgataiva prāpnoti| anyapadārthapradhānasyeti| unmattgaṅgamityādeḥ. puṣyāhamiti| karmadhāraye `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac', `rātrāhnāhāḥ pusi' ityasyāpavādaḥ| sudinamiti| sudinaśabdaḥ praśastavacanaḥ| sudināsu samāsu kāryametaditi tathā| tripathamiti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| dvigoḥ pātrāditvātsiddham| virūpaḥ panthā vipatham,prādisamāsaḥ|
kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ ceti| kriyādvāreṇa strīliṅgatve prāpte vacanam||
tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ|| 2.4.19 ||
tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ|| asandehārthaṃ nañkarmadhārayastatpuruṣa ityanyāsādanañkarmadhāraya iti padacchedaḥ| atra karmadhārayaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, nañca karmadhārayaśca nañkarmadhārayau, tau na vidyete yasmiṃstatpuruṣe so'nañkarmadhāraya iti bahuvrīhiḥ| tatpuruṣe tvasminnañmātrasya tatpuruṣasyābhāvāttadyuktatatpuruṣo nañśabdena lakṣaṇoyaḥ syāt, liṅgavacanayoścānyatarasya vyatyayo vācyaḥ syāt, ato bahuvrīhireva nyāyyaḥ| vṛttau vastumātraṃ darśitam---nañsamāsaṃ karmadhārayaṃ ca varjayitveti| vibhāṣā seneti| anantareṣu sūtreṣvasya nātīvopayogaḥ, `sañjñāyāṃ kanthā' ityatra tāvadanādiḥ sañjñā gṛhyate, na vā tatpuruṣo nañsamāsaḥ karmadhārayo vā uśīnareṣu sañjñāsti, upajñopakramamityatrāpi ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādvinā tadāditvāsampratyayaḥ| `chāyā bāhulye' ityatrāpi pūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣamantareṇa na gamyate| sabhārājetyatra tu rājā'manuṣyapūrveti vacanānnañsamāsasya karmadhārayasya ca sabhāntasyāprasaṅgaḥ| dvandvasya tu prāpnoti---īśvaraśca sabhā ca īśvarasabhe iti, atastatrāpi tatpuruṣa ityasyāṃśasyopayogo'styeva| `aśālā ca' ityatra samūhavacanaḥ sabhāśabdaḥ, samūhasya ca samūhyapekṣā sphuṭatareti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nānyasya, brāhmaṇaśca sabhā ca brāhmaṇasabhe, asabhā, paramasabheti| ataḥ `vibhāṣāsenā' ityatraivāsya sākṣādupayoga iti bhāvaḥ||
saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu|| 2.4.20 ||
saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu|| tatpuruṣasya kanthayā viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirityāha---kanthāntastatpuruṣa iti| sauśamikanthamiti| suśamasyāpatyāni sauśamayaḥ||
upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām|| 2.4.21 ||
upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām|| upajñāyata ityupajñeti| karmaṇi `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅpratyayaḥ| upakramyata ityupakrama iti karmaṇyeva ghañ | `nodāttopadeśasya' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| upajñā copakramaśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ| tadantastatpuruṣa iti| sūtre tu upajñopakramaṃ tatpuruṣarūpamityevaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇam,tayaurupajñopakramayorityādervivaraṇam---yadīti| ādiḥ-prāthamyam| pāṇinyupajñamiti| kartari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| pūrvāṇi vyākaraṇānyadyatanādikālaparibhāṣāyuktāni, tadrahitaṃ tu vyākaraṇaṃ pāṇiniprabhṛtipravṛttamityasti tadāditvasyākhyānam| vyāḍyu pajñamiti| aḍaḥ vṛścikalāṅgūlam, tena ca taikṣṇyaṃ lakṣyate, vigatāḍo vyaḍaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃvyāḍirācāryaḥ| svāgatādipāṭhāt `na yvābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati| duṣiti saṅketaśabdaḥ, yathātra vṛtkaraṇam| nando rājā| mānāni prasthādīni| vālmīkiślokā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| astyatra tadāditvasyācikhyāsā; vālmīkiḥ prathamaṃ ślokaprabandhaṃ dadarśati prasiddheḥ| devadatto yajñadattenopajñāyate yajñadattenopakramyate iti kriyāsambandhamātramatra vivakṣitam||
chāyā bāhulye|| 2.4.22||
chāyā bāhulye|| pūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyamiti| katham? bāhulya iti nimittasaptamī| bāhulye sati yā chāyā tadvācī yaśchāyāśabdastadantastatpuruṣa iti sūtre'kṣarānvayaḥ| tatra kasya bāhulyamityapekṣāyāmāvārakaradravyanimittakatvācchāyāyāstadvāhulya iti gamyate| tena yāni bahūni sambhūyopalambhayogyāmupajīvyāṃ vā chāyāmārabhante teṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ||
sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā|| 2.4.23 ||
sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā|| iha sabhāśabdaḥ śālāvacanaḥ| iha kasmānna bhavatīti| `svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanādihaiva bhavituṃ yuktamiti praśnaḥ| paryāyavacanasyaiveti| na svarūpasya, nāpi viśeṣāṇāṃ candraguptādīnāmityarthaḥ| etadevāptoktena draḍhayati----taduktamiti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? dvāvatra nañau---arājapūrvā, amanuṣyapūrvāceti, tatra nañivayuktanyānayena rājaśabdasaddaśāḥ paryāyā eva gṛhyante, amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhirūpeṇeti| kathaṃ tarhi `amanuṣyakartṛke ca' ityatra pittaghnaṃ ghṛtamityudāhariṣyate? vyākhyānāttatra manuṣyādanyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ na rūḍhirityarthaḥ||
aśālā ca|| 2.4.24 ||
aśālā ca|| sabhāśabdo'yaṃ śālāvacanaḥ, saṃghavacanaśca, tatra śālāpratiṣedhāditarasya grahaṇamityāha---saṃghātavacana ityādi| tatra pūrvasūtreṇa rājāmanuṣyapūrvatve śālāvacanasyāpi bhaviṣyati, aśālāvacanasya tvanena rājāmanuṣyapūrvatvābhāve'pīti||
vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām|| 2.4.25 ||
vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām|| tatpuruṣa iti prakṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate, napuṃsakamiti ca bhāvapradhānaṃ saṃpadyate| senādyantānāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ napuṃsakatvamityakṣarārthaḥ| vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ daśitam| yadvā---prathamāsthāne ṣaṣṭhī| kuḍyacchāyamiti| bāhulyābhāve'nena vikalpaḥ, bāhulye nityārtham `chāyā bāhulye' ityuktam| śvaniśamiti| yasyāṃ niśāyāṃ śvāna upavasanti sā śvaniśamityucyate| sā punaḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśī tasyāṃ hi śvāna upavasantīti prasiddhiḥ||
paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ|| 2.4.26 ||
paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ|| kimarthamidam? iha dvandve trīṇi darśanāniavayavārthā evāpekṣitaparasparāḥ dvandvārtho na tu tadvyatiriktaḥ samudāyo nāmetyekam; avayavārthavyatirikta eva samudāyo dvandvarthaḥ, sa cāvayavaliṅgena liṅgavāniti dvitīyam; sa eva svayaṃ liṅgaśūnya iti tṛtīyam| tatra pūrvake darśanadvaye vibhinna liṅgāvayavadvandve yugapadubhayaliṅgatānupapatteḥ paryāyeṇa liṅgadvayaprasaṅge parasyaiva liṅgaṃ bhavatīti niyamārtha bhavati| tṛtīye tu samāsārthasyāliṅgasya paravalliṅgatā bhavatīti vidhyarthaḥ| tatpuruṣo'pi dvividhaḥ----pūrvapadārthapradhāno'rdhapippālyādiḥ; uttarapadārthapradhāno rājakumāryādiḥ| tatrottarapadārthapradhāne prādhānyādeva paravalliṅgasya siddhatvātpūrvapadārthapradhāne vidhyartha bhavati| tatra vṛttikāreṇa vidhipakṣa āśritastadāha---parasya yalliṅgaṃ tadbhavatīti| evaṃ hi sūtrasyaikarūpā vacanavyaktirbhavati, itarathā tatpuruṣe vidhirūpā dvandve niyamarūpeti vacanavyaktibhedaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| dvandvasya tatpuruṣasya veti| etena dvandvatatpuruṣayoriti ṣaṣṭhīyamiti darśayati| saptamyāṃ tvayamartho bhavati---dvandve tatpuruṣe ca yatparaṃ tadvalliṅgaṃ bhavatīti| tatra kāryiṇo'nupādānātparaśabdatvāttadākṣiptasya pūrvapadasya liṅgavidhirbhavati|
yadvā---dvandve tatpuruṣe ca viṣaye parasyaiva liṅgaṃ bhavatītyakṣarārthaḥ| tatrāpi pūrvapadasyaiva liṅgavidhiḥ| atra pakṣe mayūrīkukkuṭāvityatrottarapadārthaliṅge pūrvapadārthasyātidiṣṭe strīpratyayasya nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti; kukkuṭamayūryau, rājakumārī, arddhapippalītyādau pūrvapade strīpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ| ki punarasminpakṣe kiṃcidiṣṭaṃ sidhyati? āhosviddoṣāntameva? sidhyatītyāha| iha pūrvakāyaḥ ardhadroṇa iti, yatra pūrvapadaṃ napuṃsakamuttarapadaṃ ca puṃlliṅgam, tatra parasya liṅge pūrvasyātidiṣṭe samāsasyāpi tadeva bhavati, na ca pūrvavadiha kiṃcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| dvandve'pi pūrvake darśanadvaye guṇakarmaṇī dravyaguṇāvityādau yatra puṃnapuṃsakābhyāṃ bhinnaliṅge pūrvottarapade, yatra vā'varṇāntaṃ strīpratyayāntaṃ vā padaṃ na bhavati----gatisthāne, yoṣitpūruṣau, tittiribalāke iti, tatrottarapadārthaliṅge pūrvapadārthasyātidiṣṭe dvandvasya paryāyeṇa dvayorapi liṅge pravṛtte'pi sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyati, pūrvavadeva na kiṃ ñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| `vyatirikto dvandvārthaḥ svayaṃ liṅgaśūnyaḥ' ityatra tu pakṣe dvandvārthasyāliṅgatvaṃ tadavasthameveti doṣāntameva| dvandvasya tatpuruṣasya ceti| dvandvārthasya tatpuruṣārthasya cetyarthaḥ| tenānuprayoge'pi tadevaṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇena samāsārthasya paravalliṅgamatidiśyate, `pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityatrāpi pūrvapadārthaliṅgaṃ samāsārthe'tidiśyate, tataścottarapadārthasya strītvaṃ sthitameveti ṭāpaḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| saptamīpakṣe tu `pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' ityatrāpi pūrvapadārthaliṅgamuttarapadārthasyātidiśyata iti vaḍavāśabdasya puṃstvātideśāt strītvābhāve ṭāponivṛttiḥ sidhyati| nipātanātsiddham| kiṃ nipātanam? na tāvat `pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau' iti nipātanamāśrayitumucitam, vacanāntare'natideśaprasaṅgād aśvavaḍavān, aśvavaḍavairiti| evaṃ tarhyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇāmityatra ṭāpo'nuccāraṇānnipātānādaśvavaḍavayordvandve ṭābnivartiṣyate|
apara āha---`cārthe dvandvaḥ' ityatrānekamityadhikārātsarveṣāmeva vartipadārthaṣyati| ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti----kukkuṭamayūryāviti? astu, kā rūpasiddhiḥ? paravalliṅkamiti śabdaśabdārtho, ko'rthaḥ? liṅgaśabdena liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo'rthaścatantreṇaikaśeṣeṇa vācyate| tadayamartho bhavati---dvandvārthasya tatpuruṣārthasya parasyeva liṅgaṃ bhavati, tadabhidhāyī pratyayaśca parasyaiva bhavati tābhyāmiti| tatra ca yatra dravyaguṇau guṇakarmaṇī----arddhadroṇa ityādau, liṅgābhidhāyī pratyayo na saṃbhavati tatrārtha evātidiśyate, ubhayasambhave tūbhayam---yathā kukkuṭamayūryāviti, tataścaupadeśikasya hrasvatve'pyātideśikasya śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; tasya cānupasarjanatvāttadantasya cāprātipadikatvātpunarhrasvatvābhāvaḥ| iha tarhi dattāgārgyāyaṇyau, dattākārīṣagandhye iti hrasvatve kṛte samāsātpunaḥ ṣphaṣyaṅau prāpnutaḥ? stām, `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti pūrvotpannayornivṛttirbhaviṣyati| yatra tarhi puṃvadbhāvo nāsti abhatvād, yathā---dattā ca yuvatiśca datāyuvatī iti, tatra dvayoḥ strīpratyayayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmādupasarjanahrasvatvaṃ dvandve na bhavati| anvarthā hyupasarjanasaṃjñā'pradhānasya vidhīyate, dvandve cāvayavārthānāmeva kāryānvayādaprādhānyābhāvaḥ| paravalliṅgamiti cārtha evātidiśyate, aśvavaḍavāviti ca nipātanādityetadeva samprati|
dviguprāptāpannetyādi| sa tarhi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, tatpuruṣagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvasyetyeva| kathaṃ pūrvakāyaḥ, ardhapippalīti? ekadeśisamāso nārapsyate, karmadhāraya evātra bhaviṣyati---pūrvaścāsau kāyaśca, ardhaṃ cāsau pippalī ceti| pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśe varttante, kāyādayastu samudāye, kathameṣāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam? avayavena samudāyopacārāt| tadevaṃ karmadhāraye kṛte prādhānyādevottarapadārthasya liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati, nārthastatpuruṣagrahaṇena, nāpyekadeśisamāsena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapraṅgaḥ iti cenna; iṣṭatvādanabhidhānācca| tatraitsyāt--yadyapi pūrvakāya ityādīti rūpāṇi karmadhārayeṇāpi sidhyanti, tathāpi mukhyārthavṛttiṣu kāyādiśabdeṣu yathā pūrvaṃ kāyasyetyevamādi vākyaṃ bhavati, tathā kāyapūrva ityādi ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi syād, atastannivṛttaye ekadeśisamāsa ārabdha iti? tacca naivam; iṣṭatvādanabhidhānācca| tatra tāvad `dvitīyatṛtīya' ityatrānyatarasyāṃprahaṇātsūtrakārasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣṭaḥ---bhikṣādvitīyamiti, `arddhaṃ napuṃsakam' ityatrāpi bhāṣyakāra āha---`iṣyate'tra ṣaṣṭhī samāso'pi, tadyathā---apūpārdhaṃ mayā bhakṣitam' iti| asti ca paiṅgalesūtre prayogaḥ---svarārdhaṃ cāryārdhamiti| pūrvāparetyatra tvanabhidhānāt ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati||
pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau|| 2.4.27 ||
pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau|| aśvaḍavayoriti| `vibhāṣā vṛkṣa' ityatra `paśudvandva' ityeva siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ pratipadavidhānārtham, tatra pratipadavidhānādaśvavaḍavamityekavadbhāvapakṣe imaṃ vidhaṃ bādhitvā `sa napuṃsakam' ityetadeva bhavati| tacchabdena hyekavadbhāvabhājaṃ parāmṛśya vidhīyamānaṃ napuṃsakatvamapyekavadbhāvavadeva pratipadavihitaṃ bhavati| yastu pūrvavadityatideśaḥ sa ekabadbhāvābhāvapakṣe caritārthaḥ, tadāha---tatraikavadbhāvādanyatreti| na nipātanamiti| nipātane hi pūrvavaditi vacanamanarthakam, avivakṣitamityarthaḥ| nipātane tu tadvivakṣitaṃ syād, yathoccāritarūpaviṣayatvānnipātasya||
hemantaśiśirāvaherātre ca cchandasi|| 2.4.28 ||
hemantaśiśirāvaherātre ca cchandasi|| hemantaśiśirāviti| atra napuṃsakatvaṃ prāptaṃ śiśiraśabdasya napuṃsakatvāt| kecittu `hemantaḥ śiśiro'striyām' ityubhayaliṅgaṃmanyante, teṣāmatra hemantaśiśirāvityanarthakam| ahorātre iti| atra `rātrāhnāhāḥ pu`sa' iti puṃstvaṃ prāptam| liṅgavyatyaya ukta iti | `vyatyayo bahulam' ityanena||
rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi|| 2.4.29 ||
rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi|| ityete puṃsi bhāṣyante iti| kecidāhuḥ---rātrādīnāmevānena puṃstvaṃ vidhīyate, tadantasya tu paravalliṅgamityeva siddhamiti| evaṃ tu samāhāre `sa napusakam' ityetadeva syāt, paravalliṅgapavādatvāttasya, tasmādrātrādyantasya samāsasyaivedaṃ liṅgavidhānaṃ yuktam,| evaṃ hi samāhāre'pi paratvādidameva pravarttate| ityete puṃsi bhāṣyante ityatra tvetadantā ityartho draṣṭavyaḥ| trirātra iti| samāhāre dviguḥ, `ahaḥ sarvaikadeśe' ityac samāsāntaḥ| pūrvāhṇa iti| ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ, ekadeśisamāsaḥ| `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac',`ahnehna etebhyaḥ' ityahnādeśaḥ, `ahno'dantāt' iti ṇatvam| dvyaha iti| `na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' ityahnādeśābhāvaḥ, `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' iti ṭilopaḥ|
anuvākādayaḥ puṃsiti| vākyaviśeṣasya tāḥ saṃjñāḥ karmaṇi ghañantā iti napuṃsakatve prāpte vacanam||
apathaṃ napuṃsakam|| 2.4.30 ||
apathaṃ napuṃsakam|| `pathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' ityasyāparakālabhāvitvādayamārambhaḥ| apathamiti| `patho vibhāṣā' iti yadā samāsāntapratidheṣo na bhavati tadā `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' samāsāntaḥ| samāsāntanirdeśācca tadabhāvapakṣe puṃstvameva bhavati--apanthā iti| tatpuruṣa iti vartataiti| etadarthameva `sa napuṃsakam' ityasyānantaraṃ na kṛtam||
ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca|| 2.4.31 ||
ardharcāḥ puṃsi ca|| sāhacaryācchattrinyāyena kārṣāpaṇādīnāmapyardharcaśabdena grahaṇamityāha----ardharcādaya iti bahuvacanamatra pramāṇam| śabdarūpāśrayā ceyaṃ dviliṅgateti| asmiṃśchabdarūpe liṅgadvayaṃ bhavatītyetāvadatra vivakṣitam, na punarasya śabdasya yāvānarthastatra sarvatra liṅgadvayaṃ bavatītyevamapītyarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha----kvaciditi| arthabhedena vyavasthayāpi bhavalliṅgadvayaṃ tatraiva śabde saṃpravṛttamiti bhāvaḥ| atrodaharaṇamāha---yatheti| `śaṅkhaḥ padmaśca vijñeyau dhanadasya mahānidhī'| kriyāśabdasyeti| tadyathā---bhūtaṃ kāṇḍam, bhūtā śālā, bhūto ghaṭa iti| yaugikasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti| yadyapi lavaṇavṛtterapi saindhavaśabdasya yogo'pi nimittam, tathāpi rūḍhiśaktirapi tatra nimittam| ato yaugikasyeti kevalayoganimittasyetyarthaḥ| abhidheyavalliṅgamiti, yathā---sindhau bhavaṃ saindhavaṃ jalam, saindhavo matsyaḥ, saindhavī śapharīti| utkarṣe tuṃlliṅga iti| candanasāraḥ, khadirasāra iti| dharma ityapūrve puṃlligā iti| yāgādikriyājanyaḥ svargādiphalānuguṇaḥ kartaryutpannaḥ saṃskāraviśeṣaḥ--apūrvam| bhāṭṭāstu apūrvasādhane yāgādāveva dharmaśabdaṃ puṃlliṅgammanyante----`codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ', `dravyakriyāguṇādīnāṃ dharmanvaṃ sthāpayiṣyate' iti| śābare'pyuktam----`yo yāgamanutiṣṭhati taṃ dhārmika ityācakṣate' iti||
idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtīyādau|| 2.4.32 ||
idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtīyādau|| anvādeśo'nukathanamiti| śabdārthakathanametat, yāddaśastvatrābhipretastāddaśaṃ paścādvakṣyati| ābhyāṃ chāttrābhyāmiti| ādeśa eṣaḥ| atho āchabhyāmiti| eṣo'nvādeśaḥ| athośabdena cātrānvādeśa'bhivyajyate|

vā yau|| 2.4.57 ||
ṇyakṣattriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ|| 2.4.58 ||
ṇyakṣattriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ|| ṇyādayo gotrapratyayā iti| `gotrādyūnyastriyām' iti gotrapratyayāntādeva yūni pratyayavidhānāt| kṣattriyagotrasyakṣattriyādabhedopacārāt kṣattriyaśabdenābhidhānam| ṛṣerapatyamārṣam, `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhaki prāpte śivādipāṭhādaṇ| ḍhagapīṣyate----ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte iti| tasmācchubhrādiṣvapi paṭhanīyaḥ| evaṃ gotrarūpābhyāṃ kṣattriyārṣābhyāṃ pratyayasyopalakṣaṇād ṇyādayo gotrapratyayā ityuktam| kṣattriyāditi| kṣattriyagotrapratyayāntādityarthaḥ| ārṣāditi| ṛṣyabhidhāyino gotrapratyayāntādityarthaḥ| prathamanirdiṣṭād ṇyāntādaṇo'sambhavāccaramanirddiṣṭo'pīñeva prathamamudāhṛtaḥ| kṣattriyagotrasya tatra grahaṇamiti| aurasaśabdena sāhacaryāt| sa hi `janapadaśabdāt kṣattriyādañ' ityañantatvātkṣattriyaśabdaḥ| urasaśabdaḥ sakāropadho janapadavācī, tasmādyūni prāgdīvyatīyo'ṇiti| `pheścha ca' iti ca ñacchau tu na bhavataḥ, yamundaśca suyāmā ceti parigaṇanāt| kaṇvādibhyo gotre iti śaiṣiko'ṇiti| vāmarathasya kaṇvādivatsvaravarjamiti kurvādiṣu pāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ|
abrāhmaṇagotramātrāditi| atra bhāṣye trīṇi vākyānyupanyastāni---aṇiñorluki tadrājāhyuvapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānamiti prathamam, asyodāharaṇam---baudhiḥ pitā, baudhiḥ putrā; audumbariḥ pitā, audumbariḥ putraḥ, budhodumbarābhyāṃ śālvavayavālakṣaṇa iñ `yañiñośca' iti phak, tasya luk| anaṇiñarthametadvacanabh| śālvāvayayavetyatrodumbarāstilakhilā ityādi saṃbhavodāharaṇaṃ na parigaṇanamiti budhaśabdādapīñ bhavati| kṣattriyagotramātrādyuvapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānamiti dvitīyam| mātraśabdo vyāptyarthaḥ, tadrājāditi niyamo nāsti---kṣattriyagotramātrāditi| tena jābālaśabdādata iño'tadrājādapi parasya phako lug bhavati---jābāliḥ pitā, jābāliḥ putraḥ| vṛttikāreṇonyastaṃ tṛtīyam| atrāpi mātraśabdo vyāptyarthaḥ| kṣattriyādityāpi niyamo nāsti---abrāhmaṇagotramātrāditi, tena vaiśyagotrādapi bhavati| bhāṇḍijaṅghakarṇakharakau vaiśyau, tābhyāmata iñ tadantātphako luk| vyāpakatvāccedamupanyastaṃ vṛttikāreṇa||
pailādibhyaśca|| 2.4.59 ||
pailādibhyaśca|| pīḍayateḥ pacādyaci kapilādidarśanādasya latve pīlā| anye pailādaya iñantā iti| tatra bāhvādiṣu `udañcu' iti paṭhyate| ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ,kvini nopadhatvaṃ nipātyate| audañciḥ| `acaḥ' ityakāralopaḥ, `uda īt' itīttvaṃ ca na bhavati; luptanakārasya tatra grahaṇāt| bhūliṅgaśabdaḥ śālvāvayavaḥ| sātyakiśabdamapi kecitpaṭhanti, so'pi bāhvādīñantaḥ| satyakaśabdād `ṛṣyandhaka' ityaṇā bhāvyam| śeṣā ata iñantāḥ| śālaṅkiriti| asmādeva nipātanācchalaṅkoriñ, śalaṅkādeśaśca| tadrājāccāṇa iti| tadrājasaṃjñakādaṇaḥ parasya yuvapratyayasya lugbhavati| `dvañmagadha' ityaṇantādāṅgaśabdāt `aṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiño luk| āṅgaḥ pitā, āṅgaḥ putraḥ| tadevaṃ gaṇavākyametadekam, pūrvapataṭha
itāni trīṇīti catvāri yathottaramadhikaviṣayāṇi||
iñaḥ prācām|| 2.4.60 ||
iñaḥ prācām|| `prācāmavṛddham' ityādau prāggrahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham, iha tu na tathetyāha---gotraviśeṣaṇamiti| yuvapratyayasya lugvidhānādarthādākṣiptaṃ gotramiti bhāvaḥ| pannam - prāptam agāraṃ yena sa pannāgāraḥ| mantharā - mandībhūtā eṣaṇā yasya sa mantharaiṣaṇaḥ||
na taulvalibhyaḥ|| 2.4.61 ||
na taulvalibhyaḥ|| `tula upamāne', auṇādiko valac| tulvalaḥ| dhārayatipārayatibhyāṃ nandyādilyuḥ---dhāraṇaḥ, pāraṇaḥ| devā mitramasyeti devamitraḥ| devebhyo yajño'sya devayajñaḥ| `puṣa puṣṭau', kyap, puṣyaḥ| vilakṣaṇau karṇāvasya vikarṇaḥ| kareṇuṃ pālayati kareṇupālaḥ| `asu kṣepaṇe', kurac---asuraḥ| `hṛñ‌haraṇe', anupūrvāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, puṣkare sīdatīti puṣkarasat, bāhvādī anuśatikādī ca| pariśiṣṭāḥ pārāyaṇe draṣṭavyāḥ||
tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām|| 2.4.62 ||
tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām|| iha bahuṣvityanena jasādibahuvacanaṃ vā gṛhyeta? artho vā ? ādye pakṣe'yamartho bhavati---jasādiṣu bahuvacaneṣu paratastadrājasyāstrīliṅgasya lugiti| dvitīye---bahuṣvartheṣu vartamānasyeti| bahuvacanaśabde hi jasādiṣu viniyukte tadekadeśena bahuśabdenāpi jasādi śakyaṃ lakṣayitum| saṃjñānāmekadeśasyāpi prayogadarśanād bhīmo bhīmasenaḥ, satyā satyabhāmeti| jasādīnāṃ ca bahutvād bahuṣviti bahuvacanopapattiḥ| nanvevamapi mukhyatvādarthagrahaṇameva yuktam? satyam; tenaiva grahaṇādasya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| taddhi priyavāṅgā ityādau bahuvacanaṃ paramiti lukaḥ prasaktasya nivṛttaye kṛtam| arthagrahaṇe cātra tadrājasya bahutve vṛttyabhāvādeva luko'prasaṅgaḥ| yadyevam, asmādeva liṅgād bahuvacanasyaiva niścayādartagrahaṇasyāsambhavaḥ? ucyate---astriyāmiti pratiṣedhādasya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| taddhyāṅgyaḥ striya ityādau tadrājasya bahuṣu vartamānasya luṅmā bhūditi kṛtam| bahuvacanagrahaṇe cātra strīpratyayena vyavadhānādeva luko'prasaṅgaḥ| na cāmbaṣṭhasyāpatyāni bahvyaḥ striyaḥ `vṛddhetkosalājādāñ ñyaṅ' `yaṅaścāp' āmbaṣṭhyā ityatrekādeśasyāntavadbhāvādavyavadhānāllukprasaṅgaḥ; ekādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvādatrāpi cāpā vyavadhānāt| tadevaṃ liṅgadvayadarśanātpakṣadvayasambhavaḥ|
evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam| tatrādyo pakṣe'tikrānto'ṅgānatyaṅgaḥ, atigargaḥ, aṅgebhya āgato'ṅgarūpyaḥ, gargarūpya ityādau bahuvacanaparatvābhāvālluṅna syāt| na caca vṛttyarthe vākye yacchasādi bahuvacanaṃ tatraiva paratastasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ luglabhyate'ntaraṅgatvāditi vācyam; `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate' iti vacanāt| na ca lupte'pi tasminpratyayalakṣaṇena luglabhyaḥ, `na lumatāṅgasya' iti niṣedhāt| nanu ca na lugaṅgasya kāryam, kiṃ tarhi? tadekadeśasya pratyayamātrasya, aṅgarūpya ityādau ca samarthāttaddhitotpatteḥ vṛttyarthe vākye yadvahuvacanamaṅgebhya ityādi tatraiva luk bhaviṣyati| idaṃ tarhi----atrerapatyāni bahūni `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak, tasya `kitaḥ' ityantodāttatvam, tasya jasi parataḥ `attribhṛgu' iti luki kṛte udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ prāpnoti, tasmād dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---bahuṣu vartamānasyeti|
nanvatrāpi pakṣe āṅgaśca vāṅgaśca sauhmaśra aṅgavaṅgasuhmāḥ, gārgyaśca vātsyaśca vājayaśca gargavatsavājā ityādau dvandve lugna syāt; atra hyekaikasminnevārthe pratyaya utpannaḥ, pūrvatra tu pakṣe'ntimasyāpi tāvatsiddhyati, bahuvacanaparatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yugapadadhikaraṇatāyāṃ dvandvaḥ, tatraikaikasya varttipadasya bahvarthakatvāllugbhaviṣyati| nanvevamapi taddhite utpattidaśāyāmekaikasminnevārthe utpanna iti tadrājo yo bahuṣu yañ yo bahuṣu añ yo bahuṣvityucyamāno luṅ na syādeva| nanvatra bahuṣvityanena na pratyayamātraṃ viśeṣyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantagrahaṇe sati tadantaṃ viśeṣyate---tadrājāntaṃ yadvahuṣu yañantaṃ yadbahuṣu añantaṃ yadvahuṣviti| yadyevam, kaśyapasyāpatyaṃ kāśyapaḥ bidādyañ, tasya pratikṛtaya iti `ive pratikṛtau' iti kan, tasya `jīvikārthe cāpaṇye' iti devapathādiṣu arcāsu pūjanārthāsviti pāṭhādvā lupi kṛte kāśyapā ityañantasya pratikṛtibahutve luk prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `yañañośca' ityatra `yaskādibhyo gotre' ityato `gotre' ityanuvartate, tena gotrabahutve luk pratikṛtibahutve na bhaviṣyati| nanvevamapyāṅgasyaikasya pratikṛtayo bahvya iti tadrājāntasya bahuṣu vṛtterlukprasaṅgaḥ| nahmatredamasti---tadrājāntaṃ yadapatyaṃ bahutve vartata iti | evaṃ tarhi tenaiva grahaṇamasminpakṣe na kartavyamityuktaṃ tadatropayokṣyāmahe---yasminnarthe lugbhāvī pratyaya utpannastenaiva cetkṛtaṃ bahutvamiti| iha cāpatye pratyaya utpannaḥ pratikṛtikṛtaṃ ca bahutvam, yadyevam, āṅgasyāpatyāni `aṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ, tasyābrāhmaṇagovamātrāditi vā `tadrājāccāṇaḥ' iti vā luk, aṅgāḥ, baidasyāpatyāni `ata iñ', `ṇyakṣattriya' iti luk, bidāḥ, atra gotre pratyaya utpanno yuvakṛtaṃ cātra bahutvāmiti luṅ na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tenaivetyasya tajjātīyenaivetyarthaḥ, yuvā cāpatyatayā tajjātīyo na pratikṛtiḥ| evaṃ ca kṛttvā dvandvo yadā lopināmalopināṃ ca bhavati tadā na bhavati----āṅgadevadattayajñadattāḥ, gārgyadevadattayajñadattāḥ| iha tu bhārgavaśca vātsyaścāgrāyaṇaśca bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇā iti, yadyapi nalopibhireva kṛtaṃ bahutvam, āgrāyaṇe naḍādiphako lugabhāvāt; tathāpyapatyatayā tajjātīyatvamastīti lugbhavatyeva| yadyevam, gārgyaśca kāśyapaśca gālavaśca gārgyakāśyapagālavānāmityatra gālave ṛṣyaṇo lugabhāve'pyapatyatayā tajjātīyatvādyañañorlukprasaṅgaḥ| evaṃ tarhi bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu `agārgyakāśyapagālavānām' iti nirdeśadvayāllopibhirapatyapratyayaiḥ kṛte bahutve vikalpaḥ| tadevaṃ tadrājāntasya bahutve vartamānasyeti sthitam| vṛttau tu tadrājasañjñakasya pratyayasya bahuṣu vartamānasyeti vyadhikaraṇo ṣaṣṭhyo, bahuṣu vartamānasyāstrīliṅgasya tadrājāntasya yo'vayavaḥ pratyayastasyetyarthaḥ| tenaiva cettadrājeneti| atrāpi tadrājāntenetyarthaḥ| tadrājetyāpi lopipratyayopalakṣaṇam| aṅgagargalohadhvajā ityādāvapi bhavatītyāhuḥ| ihāṅgasyāpatyāni bahūnyaṅgāsteṣāmapatyaṃ yuvā yuvānau vā āṅgaḥ āṅgāviti yuvasaṅkrānteḥ prāggotre'lugacīti pratiṣedhāllugabhāvaḥ, paścāttu bahutvābhāvād| acīti ca viṣayasaptamī, tena yuvapratyaye paścāllumatā lupte'pi viṣayabhūta eva tasmin prāgeva lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, lupte'pi vā pratyayalakṣaṇena| nanvacīti vacanādvarṇāśrayo'yam, netyāha; acīti prāgdīvyatīyasya pratyayasya viśeṣaṇaṃ pratyayaśca luki nimittam|
āṅgyaḥ striya iti| iha ca āṅgī ca vāṅgaśca sauhmaśceti dvandre āṅgotiśabdena strītvayuktānāmabhidhānāttadaṇo lugna bhavati, āṅgīvaṅgasuhmā iti bhavatītyāhuḥ||
yaskādibhyo gotre|| 2.4.63 ||
yaskādibhyo cagotre|| pratyayavidheścānyatreti| gotre yatra pratyayo vidhīyate `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ' ityato'nyatretyarthaḥ| tatra tāvadapatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇādeva pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam, anyatra laukikasyetyatra jñāpakaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ| puṣkarasacchabdasyeti| kimartha punarayamatra paṭhyate, yāvatā `bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu' ityeva siddhaṃ puṣkarasadaḥ prācyatvāt, tathā cetaḥ prācāmiti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhāya taulvalyādiṣu paṭhitaḥ? evaṃ tarhi gopanādiṣu kecittaulvalyādayaśceti paṭhanti, taulvalyādiṣu prakṛtibhāgā api gopavanādiṣu draṣṭavyā ityarthaḥ| tena `na gopavanādibhyaḥ' iti niṣedhe prāpte'trāsya pāṭhaḥ| ayameva ca pāṭho jñāpayati---gopavanādiṣu taulvalyādayo'pi paṭhitā iti||
yañañośca|| 2.4.64 ||
yañañośca|| gotrapratyayasya bahuṣu vartamānasyeti| atrāpi vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| bahuṣu vartamānasya samudāyasya sambandhī yo gotrapratyayo yatra añ ca tasyetyarthaḥ| tena dvandve'pi bhavati---gargavatsavājāḥ, bidaurvabharadvājā iti| gārgyaḥ striya iti| `yañaśca' iti ṅīp, `halastaddhitasya'| baidya iti| `śāṅgarravādyaño ṅīn'|
ekadvayoriti| ekatvadvitvayorityarthaḥ| `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' ityekaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ| `dvyekayoḥ' iti nirdeśād dviśabdasyāpi bhavati| gārgyayoḥ kulaṃ gārgyakulamiti| prakaraṇādivaśād dvitvāvagatau dvivacanāntasyāpi viruddhaḥ samāsaḥ||
attribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyaśca|| 2.4.65 ||
bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu|| 2.4.66 ||
bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu|| bharatāpatyeṣu bharataśabdā'bhedopacārādvartate, yathā----`raghūṇāmanvayaṃ vakṣye' iti| yudhiṣṭhirārjunaśabdābhyāṃ kurvāṇo'pavādo bāhvādilakṣaṇa iñ| balākāśabde'pi bāhvādiḥ|
bharatāḥ prācyā eveti| `prācyabharateṣu' iti dvandvastu sāmānyaviśeṣavācinorgobalīvardanyāyeneti bhāvaḥ||
na gopavanādibhyaḥ|| 2.4.67 ||
na gopavanādibhyaḥ|| pariśiṣṭānāṃ haritādīnāṃ pramādapāṭha iti| nanu ceha sthāne na gopavanādayaḥ paṭhyante, kiṃ tarhi? caturtha eva bidādiṣu tadupajīvanenaitatpravartate| atha caturtha pāṭhaḥ pramādaja ityujyate, bidādyañapi tarhi na prāpnoti| atha gopavanādibhyaḥ paratra pāṭhaḥ pramādajaḥ pūrvatra pāṭhyaḥ----ityucyet, evamapi `haritādibhyo'ñ' ityeṣa vidhirgopavanādīnāmapi prāpnoti| tasmādyathāvyavasthita eva pāṭhe madhye vṛtkaraṇaṃ vartavyam, iha vā prāk haritādibhya iti vaktavyam| yathoktam----`gopavānādibhyaḥ pritiṣedha prāggharitādibhyaḥ' iti| vṛttikārastu caturthe'tra capṛthak pāṭhaṃ manyate||
tikakitavādibhyo dvandve|| 2.4.68 ||
tikakitavādibhyo dvandve|| dvandvarūpāṇyeva gaṇe paṭhyante| tikādīni pūrvapadāni kitavādīnyuttarapadāni, tatra `tikādibhyo dvandve' ityucyamāne pūrvapadeṣveva lugāśaṅkyeta uttarapadeṣvapi yathā syāditi tikakitavādibhya ityuktam| ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate, tadāha---tikādibhyaḥ kitavādibhyaśceti||
upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve|| 2.4.69 ||
upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve|| dvandve cādvandve ceti| katham `advandve' ityucyamāne dvandve cādvandve ca bhavati, tadāha----advandvagrahaṇaṃ dvandvādhikāranivṛttyarthamiti| nātra śāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ svaritatvanibandhano vivakṣitaḥ na hi pūrvasūtre dvandvaśabda āsaktasvarita, tasmāllaukiko'dhikāro vyapekṣālakṣaṇaḥ| tadiha dvandvaśabdena tadviṣayā vyapekṣābhidhīyate, tasyā nañā niṣedhaḥ---advandve iti| kimuktaṃ bhavati? dvandva iti nāpekṣyata iti, tadanapekṣāyāṃ dvadve cādvandve ca bhavati| `advandva' ityasminnasati laukiko'dhikāro dvandvasya śaṅkyet, dvandvacaiṣāmeva parasparaṃ gṛhyate, teṣāṃ pūrveṇa nityaṃ lugbhavatīti| bhāṣye tu bhrāṣṭakikāpiṣṭhalaya ityudāharaṇāttikakitavādiṣvasya pāṭho'nārṣa iti niścayaḥ||
āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac|| 2.4.70 ||
āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac|| kuṇḍinośabdasya yañi `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāve `nastaddhite' iti lope kauṇḍya iti prāpnoti, asmādeva nipātanātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ| asati ca tasminnīkārasya yasyeti lopaḥ, tasya sthānivattvādābhīyatvenāsiddhatvādvā ṭilopābhāvaḥ| āgastyakauṇḍinyetyetayorgotrapratyayayoriti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau, etayoryāvavayavāvītyarthaḥ| tāveva svarūpeṇa darśayati---aṇaśca yañaśceti| madhyodātto hi kuṇḍinīśabda iti| kuṇḍamasyātīti `atainiṭhanau' pratyayasvaraḥ, ṅībanudāttaḥ| nanu mānuvṛttaṃ luggrahaṇam, pratyayāntayoravādeśau stāmata āha---tayorityādi| yadi hi pratyayāntayorevādeśau syātām---`gotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedho na syād, luko hyasau niṣedho nādeśasya, tataścādeśe satyavṛddhatvādaṇeva syāt; luki tu sati tasya pratiṣedhe tatsanniyogaśiṣṭasyādeśasyāpyabhāvāddhṛddhalakṣaṇaśco bhavati| tatra viśeṣo nāstīti kimartha tarhīdamuktam---aṇaśca yañaśca bahuṣu lugbhavatīti? evaṃ manyate----yadi kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ samudāyasya syād agastyādeśo'pi tathā syād; ato'vaśyaṃ luganuvarttyaḥ, anuvṛttasya ca kauṇḍinyenāpi saṃbandhaḥ; virodhābhāvāditi||
supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ|| 2.4.71 ||
supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ|| atra `supaḥ' iti saptamībahuvacanaṃ na gṛhyate; `pañcamyā stokādibhyaḥ' ityādinā pañcamyādīnāmalugvidhānāt| nāpi kapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, taddhitānāṃ vidhānasāmarthyāt; anyathā taddhitāntasya prātipadikatvāttadavayavasya sarvasyaiva taddhitasya luk syāt, `dvigorluganapatye' ityetaccānarthakaṃ syāt| ataḥ suśabdādārabhya supaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāra ityāha--supo vibhakteriti| dhātuprātipadikayoriti yadi saptamī syād dhātuprātipadikayoḥ parataḥ supau luk syāt---kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati, śobhanaiḥ kāṣṭhairiti, tasmātṣaṣṭhīyamityāha---supo vibhakterdhātusaṃjñāyāḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyā iti| dhātuḥ saṃjñā yasyāstasyā ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarvibhaktirdhātusaṃjñā prātipadikasaṃjñā vā bhavati, tatrāha---tadantargatā iti| evamapi dhātuprātipadikayoravayavabhūtā vibhaktayaḥ syurna tatsaṃjñāḥ? neṣa doṣaḥ; samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi vartante. dhātuprātipadikayoravayavasya supa ityapi vyākhyāne na kaściddoṣaḥ| pratyuta `supaḥ' ityasya dvivacanāntena sambandho na durupapādo bhavati, tathā tu na vyākhyātamityeva||
adiprabhṛtibhya śapaḥ|| 2.4.72 ||
adiprabhṛtibhya śapaḥ|| katham ` na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste'pi na viśvased' iti, tathā bhaṭṭikāvye---`āśvaseyurniśācarāḥ' iti, tathā `na viśvasetpūrvavirodhitasya' iti? niraṅgaśāḥ kavayaḥ| apara āha---`kṣamūṣ sahane' ghaṭādiḥ; tatra `ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ' iti siddhe ṣitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam---anityaṃ gaṇakārthamiti, tenaivamādiprayogopapattiriti nātra kiñṭacidapabhāṣitamasti||
bahulaṃ chandasi|| 2.4.73 ||
yaṅo'ci ca|| 2.4.74 ||
yaṅo'ci ca|| aci pratyaye parata iti| pacādyacītyarthaḥ| etadeva jñāpakam---sarvadhātubhyaḥ pacādyac bhavatīti| pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, tathā hi sati---aṇītyeva vaktavyam; anyājādeḥ pratyayasyāsaṃbhavāt| na tu chandasīti| `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' ityatra vārttikam---`huśnugrahaṇamanarthakamanyasyābhāvāt'| yānti vātītyatra kṅitītyadhikārānna bhaviṣyati, yātaḥ vātaḥ, acītyanuvartate| yānti vānti, oriti| yuvanti ruvanti, anekāca iti vartate| ayuvan, aruvan, aḍāgamo'siddhaḥ| prorṇavanti, asaṃyogapūrvasyeti vartate| yaṅluṅ‌nivṛttyartha tarhi huśnugrahaṇam---yoyuvati, roruvati| yaṅlugarthamiti cedārdhadhātukatvāstiddham, chāndaso yaṅluk, tatra `chandasyubhayathā' ityārdhadhātukatvādeva na bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ yaṅlukaśchāndasatvamabhyupagamya huśnugrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ vārttikakāreṇa| sa manyate---cakāreṇātra `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti sarvamanuvarttiṣyate, tenāci pratyaye parataḥ chandasi bhāṣāyāṃ yaṅo lug bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, chandasi bahulamanaimittiko lugiti dvitīyam, prasiddhaśca tathā chāndaso yaṅlugiti| prayogaśca cirantanaḥ padye gadye ca kāvyākhyāyikādau vikaṭapadopanyāsapradhānairapi kavibhirna kṛto ddaśyate|
bhāṣyakārastu `huśnuvoriti vakṣyanti, evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati---bhāṣāyāmapi yaṅluk' iti, tena cecidīti, cecchidīti, yoyavītītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| vṛttikārastu manyate----`yadi jñāpakenāpi tāvadbhāṣāyāmapi yaṅlukaḥ prayoge bhavati, hantaivamatraiva chandograhaṇaṃ mānuvṛtat! prayegastu jñāpakāśrayeṇaiva yathābhidhānaṃ vyavasthāsyate' iti, ato na bhāṣyavārttikavirodho vṛtteḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ||
juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ|| 2.4.75 ||
juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ|| śabanuvarttate, na yaḍiti| ślāviti dvirvacanavidhānāt| yaṅnuvṛttau hi ślunā tatra lupte'pi `sanyaṅoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇād dvirvacanasiddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāt| bibhartīti| `bhṛñāmit' ityabhyāsasyettvam| nenektīti| `ṇijir‌śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ',`ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau'||
bahulaṃ chandasi|| 2.4.76 ||
gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| 2.4.77 ||
gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| abhūditi| `bhūsuvostiṅi' iti guṇapratiṣedhaḥ| luganuvarttate, na śluriti| vyākhyānāt|
iṇ‌pibatyorgrahaṇamiti| iṇādeśo gā iṇityuktaḥ, tatra gātītyādāvikasyeṇoya ādeśastadanukaraṇo gā tipi śablukā nirdiṣṭaḥ, sthānivadbhāvātprakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti caca| tena `gāmādāgraha8ṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti lākṣaṇikasyāpi gārupasya yadyapi grahaṇaṃ prāptam, tathāpi gātīti nirdeśādeva tasya nivṛttiḥ| tathā `lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam' iti pibatereva grahaṇam| agāsīt, apāsīditi| `kai gai rai śabde' pā rakṣaṇe' yamaramanamātāṃ sakca' iti sagāgamaḥ, sicaśceṭ, `astisico'pṛkte' itīṭ, `iṭa īṭi'| pai ovai śoṣaṇe' ityasya lākṣaṇikaṃ pārūpamiti grahaṇābhāvaḥ|
agāsātāmiti| karmaṇyātmanepadam, ātām||
vibhāṣā ghrāgheṭśācchāsaḥ|| 2.4.78 ||
vibhāṣā ghrāgheṭśācchāsaḥ|| dheṭaḥ sānubandhakasya nirdeśa ātvaparihārārthaḥ| `dhā' ityucyamāne pratipadoktatvāddhāña eva grahaṇaṃ syāt| nanu satyapyanubandho ccāraṇe'nubandhānāmanekāntatvāt `nānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam' ityudīcāṃ māṅa itivadāttvaṃ prāpnoti? satyam; ayameva nirdeśo jñāpayati---sānubandhānukaraṇe nāvaśyakamāttvamiti| tena sūtrādvahirapi veñaḥ, dheṭaḥ, daipa ityādi prayogopapattiḥ| aghrāsātāmiti| karmaṇyātmanepadam, ātām| sumanasāviti| `striyaḥ sumanasaḥ puṣpam' ityamarasiṃhaḥ, `apsumanassamāsikatāvarṣāṇāṃ bahutvaṃ ca' iti pāṇinīyaṃ sūtram| tadvahutvaṃ prāyikaṃ manyate, ekā ca sikatā tailadāne samarthā' iti bhāṣye prayogāt||
tanādibhyastathāsoḥ|| 2.4.79 ||
tanādibhyastathāsoḥ|| udāharaṇeṣu svaritettvādātmanepadam| thāsā sāhacaryāditi| yadyapi tāvadayaṃ taśabdo ddaṣṭāpacāraḥ---astyātmanepadamasti ca parasmaipadam, asti caikavacanamasti ca bahuvacanam| ayaṃ tu khalu thāḥ śabdo'ddaṣṭāpacāra---ātmanepadamekavacanaṃ ca, tasyāsya ko'nyaḥ sahāyo bhavitumarhati, anyadata ātmanepadādekavacanācceti bhāvaḥ| ātmanepadasyeti| upalakṣaṇametat| ekavacanasyetyapi draṣṭavyam||
mantre ghasahvaraṇaśavṛdahād‌vṛcakṛgamijanibhyo leḥ|| 2.4.80 ||
mantre gasahvaraṇaśavṛdahād‌vṛcakṛgamijanibhyo leḥ|| clerevātra grahaṇamiṣyate, na liṅādīnām, tadarthaṃ `sicaḥ' ityanuvartayanti---sico yo liḥ sthānibhūtastasyeti vyācakṣate| sici prakṛte ligrahaṇam `ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' ityādisickāryaṃ mā bhūditi| pūrvatra hi mā hi dātāmiti sicsvaro bhavatyeva| hvareti vihitaguṇasyānukaraṇam, akāraścāgntuka uccāraṇārthaḥ| akṣanniti| `luṅsanorghaslṛ', `gamahan' ityupadhālopaḥ, `śāsivasi' iti ṣatvam| prāṇaḍiti| braścādinā ṣatve jaśtvacatve| prāṇagiti pāṭhe `naśervā' iti kutvam| āprāditi| `prā pūrttau' āṅpūrvaḥ| ajñateti| `janī prādurbhāve', anudāttet| bahuvacanasya `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityadādeśaḥ, pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, ścutvam| brāhmaṇe prayogo'yamiti| mantravyatirikto vedabhāgaḥ-brāhmaṇam| yathāha bhagavāñjaimaniḥ----`yaccodakeṣu mantrākhyā iti mantralakṣaṇāntaram, śeṣe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ' iti| bahvacānāṃ hariścandrabrāhmaṇe hariścandraṃ prati varuṇasyaitadvākyam---ajñata vā asya dantā iti| kathaṃ punarmantragrahaṇe brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ bhavati? tatrāha---mantragrahaṇantviti| mantrasya chandorūpatvāttena tadupalakṣyate| bāhulyena tu mantre darśanānmantrāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam||
āmaḥ|| 2.4.81 ||
āmaḥ|| āma uttarasya lerlugbhavatīti| yadyapi sicā lirviśeṣitaḥ, tathāpīha lerityevānuvartata iti bhāvaḥ| vidāmakranvidāṅgurvantvityatra luṅloṭornipātanāllugbhavati| tarabādīnāṃ cāmantādanutpattireva, tasyānabhivyaktapadārthatvāt| ayaṃ ca lugnāprāpteṣu tibādiṣu vidhīyamānatvāllādeśānāmapavādaḥ| tenāmantasyātiṅntatvāccakṣuḥ kāmam, yājayāñcakāretyatra `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti, tasya cānighātaḥ, tasmācca nighātaḥ siddho bhavati| kathamāmantasya padatvam? subantatvāt| lakārasya kṛttvātprātipadikatvam| tiṅbhāvino hi lakārasyātiṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ, na cāyaṃ tiṅbhāvī| supaḥ śravaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? āmaḥ svarādiṣu pāṭhādavyayatvāt| taddhitenāmā sāhacarye'pi taddhita eva na gṛhyate, api tu vyāpterataddhito'pi nañā tuca samāsaprasaṅgaḥ, na kārayāṃ na hārayāṃ `ऩñ' subantena samasyata iti samāsaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; abhivyaktapadārthena hi yājayāñcakāreti nañaḥ sāmarthyam, na tvanabhivyaktapadārthenāmantamātreṇa| āmantebhyo ṇalaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ----śaśāma, tatāma;vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ sthānivadbhāvena ṇalo ligrahaṇena grahaṇe luk prāpnoti? arthavad grahaṇātsiddham| arthavata āmantasya grahaṇam, na caiṣo'rthavān| evamapi `amagatyādiṣu', tipo ṇal, āma----atra prāptoti, arthavattvāt? `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam' iti atra na bhaviṣyati||
avyayādāpsupaḥ|| 2.4.82 ||
avyayādāpsupaḥ|| tatra śālāyāmiti| śālāśabdasannidhau strītvayuktadravyagatakārakaśaktyabhidhānāttasyāmitivattatretyatrāpi yadi strīpratyayaḥ syātpadādeva strītvaṃ pratīyeteti vyāmohanivṛttyartha ṭāpo lugvaktavyaḥ, yathā----ṣaṭsañjñakebhyaḥ pratiṣedha iti bhāvaḥ| vārttikakārastvāha----`avyayādāpo lugvacanānarthakyaṃ liṅgābhāvāt' iti| kṛtvā, hṛtveti| yadā `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityādeḥ svādividhivākyenaikavākyatā, tadā nissaṅkhyebhyo niṣkārakebhyaścāvyayebhyo'smādeva lugvidhānālliṅgatsvādayo bhavanti, bhinnavākyatāyāmapi niyamapakṣe tulyajātīyasya niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ----bahuṣveva bahuvacanaṃ na dvayorekasmin, dvayoreva dvicanaṃ naikasminna bahuṣu, ekasminnevaikavacanaṃ na dvayorna bahuṣu, ityavyayebhyaḥ svādīnāṃ sambhavaḥ| trikapakṣe tu yatra saṅkhyā sambhavati tatraiva sā vācyatvena vidhīyate, avyayebhyastu niḥ saṅkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eveti sarvathāvyayebhyaḥ subutpattireṣitavyā---pratyayalakṣaṇena padasañjñā yathā syāditi| tubiti ca saptamībahuvacanasya pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na kapaḥ; āpaḥ pṛthagupādānāt||
nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ|| 2.4.83 ||
nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ|| kimarthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ? pūrvasūtreṇa luṅmābhūditi| amatra vidhīyate, sa nāprāpte lukārabhyamāṇastasya bādhako bhaviṣyati, yatra tarhi pratiṣidhyate, pañcamyāstatra luk prāpnoti| pratiṣedhe tu satita tatsāmarthyād dve vākye bhavataḥ-----nāvyayībhāvādityekam, amtvapañcamyā iti dvitīyam| atra cāta ityapekṣyate| tatrāpañcamyā ityanenānantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho veti pañcamyā ādeśaḥ pratiṣiddhyate, na pūrvavākyavihitaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| imamevārtha tuśabdena dyotayati---aviśeṣeṇa pritaṣedhaḥ amtvapañcamyā iti, tadetaduktam----tasminpratiṣiddhe pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva bhavatīti| vākyabhedastu vṛttāveva spaṣṭaḥ| upakumbhāditi| samīpabhūtātkumbhādityarthaḥ| kumbhasya samīpādityapare| unmattagaṅgādiranyapadārthapradhānaḥ sattvavācyavyayībhāvaḥ kriyāsambandhasadbhāvādapādānatvātpañcamyā mukhyamudāharaṇam||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam|| 2.4.84 ||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam|| subhadramiti| madrāṇāṃ samṛddhirityavyayībhāvaḥ, tataḥ saptamī, tasyā nityamambhāvaḥ| ekaviśatibhāradvājamiti| ekaviśatirbharadvājā vaṃśyā iti `saṅkhyā vaṃśyena' iti samāsaḥ| tatra varttipadārthānāṃ svārthopasarjanārthāntarābhidhāyitvādbhāradvājaśabda ekatvaviśaṣṭārthāntare saṅkrānta ityaño lugabhāvaḥ| neti vayam, gargāṇāṃ kulaṃ gargakulamityādāvapi prasaṅgāt| tasmād bhāṣyakāraprayogādatra lugabhāvaḥ||
luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍārīrasaḥ|| 2.4.85 ||
luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍārīrasaḥ|| parasmīpadasyātmanepadasya ceti| yadyevaṃ parasmaipade trayaḥ prathamapuruṣasaṃjñakāstibādayaḥ, ātmanepadeṣvapi trayastādaya iti ṣaṭ sthāninastraya ādeśā iti vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti| mā bhūtsaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ, āntaryato vyavasthā bhaviṣyati? arthataścāntaryam, ekārthasyaikārtho dvyarthasya dvyartho bahvarthasya bahvarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarḍādīnāmaikārthyādhyavasāyaḥ, yāvatā yastipaḥ sthāne sa ekārthaḥ, yastassthāte sa dvyarthaḥ yo jheḥ sthāne sa bahvarthaḥ? netyāha, prayogadarśanādapyaikārthyādikamadhyavasātuṃ śakyam| atha vā''deśā api ṣaḍeva nirdiśyante, katham? ekaśeṣanidaśāt, ḍāraurasaśca ḍāraurasaśceti kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣaḥ| yadi tu ḍā ca ḍā ca ḍā, rau ca rau ca rau, ras ca ras ca ras, ḍā ca rau ca ras ca ḍāraurasa iti kṛtaikaśeṣaṇāṃ dvandvaḥ syāt? aniṣṭaḥ saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti tiptasorḍā, jhitayo rau, ātāṃjhayo rasiti| kartiti| luṭ,tip, tasya ḍā ityayaṃ sarvādeśaḥ| nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam| astu tarhmantyasyaiva, tipastakāreṇa saha ṭilopo bhavati| nanu takārāntamaṅgaṃ na bhavati, ḍitkaraṇasāmarthādanaṅgasyāpi bhaviṣyati, yathā---siddhānte'bhasyāpi| atha vā''nupūrvyātsiddham, katham? antyasyāpyayaṃ sthāne bhavannapratyayaḥ syād, asatyāṃ pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ ḍakārasyetsaṃjñā nāsti, asatyāṃ cetsaṃjñāyāmanekāl, yadānekāl tadā sarvādeśaḥ, yadā sarvādeśastadā pratyayaḥ, yadā pratyayastadetsaṃjñā, yadetsaṃjñā tadā lopastadaikāl, na cedānīṃ pratyāvṛttyāntādeśo bhavitumarhati? tadetadānupūrvyātsiddham| kartārau, kartāra iti| `ri ca' iti tāsastyorlopaḥ| adhyeteti| `iṅ adhyayane'| athātra ḍāraurassu kṛteṣu ṭerettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? pūrvamevāsminyoge sthāniṣu pravṛttatvāt| iha hi taśabdasya ṭerettvaṃ ca prāpnoti, ḍādeśaśca; dvayorapi śabdāntaraprāpteranityatvātparatvāṭṭerettve kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāḍḍādeśaḥ| evaṃ raurasorapi draṣṭavyam| atha vā--- pūrvameva ḍārauraso bhavantu, thāsaḥ sevacanaṃ jñāpakam----ye tiṅādeśāsteṣāṃ ṭerettvaṃ na bhavatīti, anyathā `thāsaḥ sa' ityeva vācyaṃ syāt| kartāsīti| `tāsastyoḥ' iti salopaḥ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañcaryāṃ dvitīyādhyāyasya turīyaścaraṇaḥ||

atha tṛtīyādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ padamañjarī
pratyayaḥ|| 3.1.1 ||
pratyayaḥ|| iha yadi sarvāneva saṃjñinaḥ svarūpeṇa nirddiśya saṃjñā vidhīyeta---san pratyayaḥ kyac pratyayaḥ, kyaṅ pratyaya iti, tato gauravaṃ syāt| atha `sap' pratyaya iti sanaḥ saśabdādārabhya kapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhārāśrayeṇātra vā pradeśāntare vā saṃjñā vidhīyeta, tadānekasya pakārasya sambhavātsandehaḥ syāt| tathā hi pryāsattinyāye āśrīyamāṇe sipaḥ pakāreṇa syād, vyāptau tu `taptanaptanathanāśca' iti tanapaḥ| syādetat----vyāptirevāśrayiṣyate, atha ca tanapaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāro na bhaviṣyati; jñāpakāt, yadayam `ica ekāco'mpratyayavacca' ityamaḥ pratyayavadbhāvaṃ śāsti, anyathā ṣaṣṭhe'pi pratyayasaṃjñāvyāpārādamo'pi svata eva pratyayatvāttadvadbhāvo nātideśyaḥ syāditi ? tanna; tatra hyamiti dvirāvarttate, tataścāpratyayapratibaddham `auto'mśasoḥ' ityādiviśiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ yathā syāditi so'tideśaḥ syāt| nanvevamapi pratyayagrahaṇamanarthakam, amvaditi vaktavyam, ataḥ pratyayagrahaṇātpratyayaprayuktamapi kāryamatideśyamati pratīyate, tajjñāpakamuktārthasya bhaviṣyati? evamapyama āgamatvātpugādivadaprāpteḥ pratyayatvātideśaḥ syāt| astu vā jñāpakam, evamapi kuta etadvyāptirāśrīyate, na punaḥ pratyāsattiriti? kiñca yathānyāsādrauravaṃ sthitameva, sabityasyādhikasya karaṇāt? ato gauravātiprasaṅgaparihārāyādhikāreṇeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate| tadāha---pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvenādhikriyate iti|`kārake' iti tadviśeṣaṇamadhikriyate, svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu prakṛtiriyamadhikriyata itivat| `pratyayaśabdaḥ saṃjñādhikriyate' iti vaktavye saṃjñātveneti vacanamanarthabhedāt| tathā hyamatra karmakaratvenādhikṛtaḥ, ayamatra karmakaro'dhikṛtaḥ, nārthabhedo'sti; kintu `karmakaro'dhikṛtaḥ' ityukte yaḥ karmakaraḥ so'dhikṛto rūpāntareṇetyapi gamyate, karmakaratveneti punarucyamāne tasyaivākārasyādhikṛtatvaṃ gamyate| adhikriyate- viniyujyate sūtrakāreṇa| yān- nādīnanukramiṣyāmaḥ- anukrameṇa vidhāsyāmaḥ| sūtrakārāyamāṇasya vṛttakārasyaitadvacanam|
yadi tarhyadhikāreṇa saṃjñā kriyate, pratiyogamupasthānātprakṛtyupapadopādhivikārāgamānāmapi prāpnoti---`haraterddatināthayoḥ paśau' harateriti prakṛtiḥ, ddatināthayorityupapadam, paśāvityupādhiḥ; `hanasta ca' ityādirvikāraḥ, `trapujatunoḥ puk' ityāgamaḥ| satyāṃ ca saṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtipratyayayoḥ taryāyeṇa parasparāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ syāt; śabdāntarāpekṣaṃ vā prakṛteḥ, prakṛtyapekṣaṃ tu pratyayasya? upapadasyāpi paratvāt `upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' ityetadrājapuruṣādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ bādhitvā paratvaṃ syāt, yatra samāsābhāvāt`upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ, tatropapadasya paratvaṃ syāt? evaṃ ca sati bhoktuṃ vrajatītyevameva nityaṃ syānna tu vrajati bhoktumiti, upādherapyarthasya paratvāsambhave'pi tadvācinaḥ prayogāniyame prāpte paraśceti niyamaḥ syāt? ādyudāttatvaṃ ca yathāyathaṃ svarāntaraṃ bādhitvā syāt? aṅgasaṃjñā tu vidhānapratibaddhā, na ceha prakṛtyādayaḥ kutaścidvidhīyante iti na sā prakṛtyādiṣu parataḥ pūrvasya prāpnoti? nanu ca pratiyogamupasthāne'pi vākyabhedaprasaṅgātprakṛtyādīnāṃ saṃjñā na bhaviṣyati, tathā hi---haraterddatināthayoḥ karmaṇorupapadayoḥ paśau karttarīn pratyayo bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam, te ca haratyādayaḥ pratyayasaṃjñakā iti dvitīyam, sambhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedastu neṣyate? naitadasti; sanādīnāmapyasatāṃ saṃjñānupapattervākyabhedenaiva saṃjñā vidheyā, tataśca sanādīnāmekena vākyena vidhirapareṇa saṃjñāvidhiḥ, evaṃ prakṛtyādīnāmapi prāpnoti? tatrāha---prakṛtyupapadetyādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ----prakṛtyādīnāṃ sanādyutpattau nimittatvenopādānātpārārthyātsvasaṃskāraṃ prati prayojakatvābhāvaḥ yathā--yaḥ pīṭhe sa devadatta iti pīṭhasya devadattasaṃjñā na bhavati|
nanu sanādyutpattivākye prathame teṣāṃ pārārthyam, na dvitīye saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipādanapare vākye, tataśca saṃjñāvidhānaparamevaṃrūpameva---guptijkidbhyaḥ san pratyaya iti, tataśca tatrāpi bhūtavibhaktyānirddeśānnimittatvātpārārthyaṃ sthitameva| kiñca, yogyavibhaktyabhāvācca na prakṛtyādīnāṃ saṃjñā, prathamāntasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya vā saṃjñāsambandhaḥ `vṛddhirādec' `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti| na ca dvitīye vākye yogyavibhaktyadhyāhāreṇa saṃjñā bhavitumarhati; yogyavibhaktinirddiṣṭeṣu sanādiṣu caritārthatvāt| upapadasaṃjñā tu saptamīniddiṣṭasya vidhīyamānā yuktaṃ yadvākyabhedena yogyavibhaktyadhyāhāreṇa ca bhavatīti| kiñca, pradhānetarasannidhau pradhāne kāryasaṃpratyayo bhavati, yasya cāpūrvavidhānaṃ tatpradhānam; ataḥ prathamavākye tāvatsanādīnāmeva prādhānyam, dvitīye'pi saṃjñā saṃjñinamapekṣamāṇā yatpūrvavākye pradhānatayāvagataṃ tadevāpekṣate, na tu pāratantryādapradhānamiti siddhamiṣṭam| evamapi vikārāgamānāṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta---pratiyantyanenārthamiti pratyaya iti| na ca vikārāgamābhyāmarthaṃ pratiyanti| yadyevam, `aveḥ kaḥ' ityādīnāṃ samāsāntānāṃ ca na syād, na hyeṣāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kaścidartho'vadhāryate, tadabhāve'pi kevalāyā eva prakṛtestadarthāvagamāt|
yadapyucyate----anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti svārtha evaiṣāmartha iti, tadapi kalpanāmātram; anvayavyatirekagamyatvādarthavattvasya| itaretarāśrayatvaṃ ca bhavati---sati pratyayatve svārthe vidhānam, svārthe vidhānāccārthavattve sati pratyaya saṃjñeti| evaṃ tarhi prayojanābhāvānna bhaviṣyati? tathā hi teṣāṃ sthānaṣaṣṭhyāsambandhasyāvayasambandhasya ca pratipādanātparatvaṃ tāvanna sambhavati, āgamānāṃ cānudāttatvavidhānādādyudāttatvasyāsambhavaḥ, sati tu prayojane āgamasyāpi śnamaḥ śakārasyetsaṃjñārtha bhavatyeva saṃjñā| atha `hanaśca vadhaḥ' `nābhi nabhañca' `virāga viraṅgañca' ityādau vadhādīnāmanekālānāmādeśānāṃ saṃjñā kasmānna bhavati, sambhavati hi teṣu paratvaṃ prayojanam? yadyapi sthānina ādeśena nivarttitatvānna tadapekṣaṃ paratvam, śabdāntarāpekṣayā syādeva paratvam| yathoktaṃ prāk--gupādiṣu arthavattvaṃ ca teṣāmasti, vidheyatvātprādhānyaṃ ca, yogyā ca vibhaktiḥ| ataḥ sarvathā vadhādiṣu saṃjñānivṛttaye yatnaḥ karttavyaḥ| karttavyam, karaṇīyāmati| atra pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ dhātoraṅgasaṃjñā, aṅgasya guṇaḥ| anantaramapi sanādikamatikramya vyavahito'pi tavyadādirudāhṛtaḥ, tatrādyudāttāderapi pratyayakāryasya sambhavāt| sanādau tu nitsvareṇa dhātusvareṇa ca tadvādhyate||
paraśca|| 3.1.2 ||
paraśca|| ayamapyadhikāra iti| na kevalam `pratyaya' ityayamevetyapiśabdārthaḥ| yoge yoge upatiṣṭhate iti| anena paribhāṣāto'dhikārasya bhedako dharmo darśitaḥ| paribhāṣā hi na pratiyogamupatiṣṭhate, kintvekadeśasthitaiva sarvaśāstre vyāpriyate| paraśca sa bhavatītyādi| anenehasthāyā evāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ pratyayavidhau sarvatra vyāpāro darśitaḥ| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā, pratyayasaṃjñā ca liṅgam| dhātorveti| kriyāvācinyāḥ prakṛtestiṅantāderapyupalakṣaṇametat| prātipadikādveti| akriyāvācinyāḥ prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam, tena ṅyāporapi grahaṇam| taittirīyamiti| tittiriṇā proktamadhīte, `tittirivarantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ' `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi',`tadadhīte tadveda', `proktālluk', brāhmaṇakulasyābhidheyatvānnapuṃsakanvam| cakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārtha iti| anyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvāt| teneti| anyathā bahulavacanasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvāduṇādiṣu paratvasyāpi vikalpaḥ sambhāvyeta, iha `guptijkidbhyaḥ san' ityādau digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī, tatra pūrvaḥ para iti vā dikśabdasyāśravaṇādaniyamenādhyāhāre satyaniyamena prayogaprasaṅge niyamārthamidam---para eva pratyayo na pūrva iti| `gāpoṣṭak' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pyānantaryasambandhe ṣaṣṭhīvijñānādānantaryasya ca pūrvatve'pi bhāvādaniyamaprasaṅga eveti tatrāpi niyamārthameva| naitadasti prayojanam, `vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāttu' ityetanniyamārtha bhaviṣyati---bahujeva purastādbhavati nānyaḥ pratyaya iti, tataśca bahuci pūrvatvasya niyatatvādanyaḥ pratyayaḥ para eva bhaviṣyati, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu madhyaśabdādhyāhāreṇa madhye'pi prasaṅga iti cet, na;`avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk‌ṭeḥ' iti niyamāt akajeva prakṛtimadhye bhavati, nānya iti? naitadevam; yadi tāvadevaṃ niyamaḥ----bahujeva purastādakajeva madhye iti, tato bahujakacorniyamo na syāt| atha bahuc purastādeva akajmadhya eveti, tato deśasyāniyatatvāttatra pratyayāntaraṃ syādeveti sarvathāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca akajeva prāk ṭerityevaṃ niyame prāk ṭeḥ pratyayāntaraṃ mā bhūt, madhyāntare tu syādeva; madhyaviśeṣāśrayatvānniyamasya| na ca `tasmādityuttarasya' ityanayā paribhāṣayātra paratvaṃ siddhyati, yatra hi prāgova sataḥ kasyacit kiñcidvidhīyate, yathā---padātparayorapādādau varttamānayoryuṣmadasmadorvānāvau bhavata iti, sa tasyā viṣayaḥ; iha tu prāgasanta eva sanādayo vidhīyante, na teṣāṃ sambandhi kiñcit, pratyayasaṃjñaiva teṣāṃ kāryamiti cet, na; evamapi prāgutpattiranivāritā syāt| tathā hi---asatāṃ sanādīnāṃ sajñāvidhiranupapanna ityekena vākyena sanādīnāṃ vidhirdvitīyena ca teṣāmeva saṃjñāvidhirityaṅgokaraṇīyam, tataśca dvitīye vākye sataḥ kāryamiti kṛtvā paribhāṣopasthānena prāk prayuktānāṃ saṃjñaiva kevalaṃ na syādutpattistvaniyatadeśaiva syāt; prathamavākye paribhāṣānupasthānāt| syādetat---`guptijkidbhyaḥ san' ityādāvekaiva pañcamī, sā caikameva dikśabdamadhyāharet, tatra pūrvaḥ paro veti saṃśaye pūrvaśabdādhyāhāre dvitīyasya vākyasya svarasabhaṅgaḥ syāt| gupādibhyaḥ paraḥ san pratyayasaṃjño bhavatīti hi tasya svarasataḥ prāpto'rthaḥ, sa ca pūrvavākye pūrvaśabdādhyāhāre sati bhagnaḥ syāt, atastatparirakṣaṇāya paraśabda evādhyāhariṣyate| bhavatu votpattiraniyatadeśā, paścāttu sata eva parasya yatkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñādiśāstrakāryam, tannānyadeśasya,yaddeśasya ca śāstrīyaṃ kāryaṃ taddeśo'nyadeśaṃ nivarttayiṣyati; viśeṣaśāstrānvitatvena tasyaiva sādhutvāditi? astvevam, atha yeṣu pratyayasaṃjñaiva na bhavati----`śameḥ khaḥ' śaṅkhaḥ, `kaṇeṣṭhaḥ' kaṇṭha ityādiṣu, teṣu kathaṃ paratdam, dvitīyavākyavyāpārābhāvāt? bhavato vā kathaṃ bhavānapi hi `yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa paraḥ' iti pratyayapūrvakaṃ paratvaṃ paribhāṣate? satyam; paribhāṣāpakṣe na syātparatvam, adhikārapakṣe tu pratyayatvapūrvakaṃ paratvaṃ na bhavati; kintu paratvaviśiṣṭasyaivotpannasya paścātpratyayasaṃjñā, iha tu bahulavacanātpratyayatvābhāve'pi paratvamavirūddham| evamapi nārtha etena, bahulavacanādeva paratvamevātra vyavasthāsyate? evaṃ tarhi prayoganiyamārthamidam---para eva pratyayo na kevala iti; anyathā pratyayārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ kevalo'pi pratyayaḥ prayujyeta, yathā---kimasya dvayasam, kimasya mātramiti; yathā vā prakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ taratamabhāvaḥ tāratamyamiti| nanu prakṛtiviśeṣaṃ nirddiśyaiva vidhīyate, tatra pūrvoktayā nītyā paratvaviśiṣṭasyaiva vidhānamiti nāsti kevalasya prayogaḥ? evamapi prakṛtyarthamātravivakṣāyāṃ kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ syādeva, yathā---pac, vṛkṣeti| yatra punarubhayaṃ vivakṣitam----prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaśca, na tatra kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaprasaṅgaḥ ; na kevalā prakṛtiḥ pratyayārthamabhidhātuṃ samartheti| lakṣaṇayā samartheti cet? no khalvārabhyamāṇamapyetallakṣaṇayā prayogaṃ nivārayitumarhati, ataḥ kevalaprakṛtyarthavivakṣāyāṃ kevalā prakṛtirmā prayojīti sūtrārambhaḥ| caśabdaścāvadhāraṇe, pratyayaḥ paro bhavatyeva, na tu kadācinna bhavatīti vacanavyaktiḥ| ā padatvaniṣpatteścāyaṃ niyamaḥ, niṣpanne tu pade tāvadeva prayujyate| apatyādyarthāntaravivakṣāyāṃ tu tasmādapi pratyayāntaraṃ bhavati||
ād‌yudāttaśca|| 3.1.3 ||
ād‌yudāttaśca|| uhāsvarakasyāca uccāraṇāsambhavātsarva eva svaravidhirniyamārthaḥ, tatra `citaḥ' evānta udāttaḥ, rityeva madhya udāttaḥ, tideva svaritaḥ, suppitāvevānudātto, dūrātsambuddhāvevaikaśrutyamati| svarāntarāṇāmanyatra niyamāt pāriśeṣyādādyudātta eva pratyayo bhaviṣyati, nāsvarakaḥ nāpyanyasvarakaḥ, tatrāha---aniyatasvarapratyayaprasaṅga iti| aniyataḥ svaro yasya so'niyatasvaraḥ, sa cāsau pratyayaścāniyatasvarapratyayaḥ tasya prasaṅge pratyayo'niyatasvaro mā bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ| aniyatasvaraprasaṅga iti pāṭhe tvaniyatasya svarasya prasaṅga ityarthaḥ| ayamabhiprāyaḥ---ādyudāttatvamapi `ñnityādirnityam' ityādau niyatatvānna syād, anyatrāniyamaḥ syādeva yatrāyaṃ niyamo nāsti| kiñca tvadukte niyame cidātīnāmaniyamaḥ syād| ataścito'nta eva, titsvarita evetyādikaṃ tatra tatra niyamasvarūpamāśraṇīyam, tataśca pratyayasyāniyatasvaratvameva syāt| kiñca, rityevopottamanudāttamityapi niyame'nyatropottamanudāttaṃ mā bhūd| madhyāntaraṃ tu syādeva; madhyaviśeṣāśrayatvānniyamasya| tasmādye ekācaḥ pratyayāsteṣvaniyatasvaraprasaṅge vacanamidamudāttārtham| ye punaranekācaḥ pratyayāsteṣu deśasyāpyaniyamaḥ prāpnotikadācidādeḥ, kadācinmadhyasya, kadācidantyasyeti| teṣu vacanamidamudāttārtham, tatrāpyaderudāttārthamiti| kimartha punaḥ pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenāyaṃ svara ucyate, na `ñnityādirnityam' pratyayasya ca lasārvadhātukamanudāttaṃ suppitau ceti svaraprakaraṇa evocyeta, evaṃ hi prakaraṇamabhinnaṃ bhavati? kiñca, dvirādyudāttagrahaṇaṃ dviścādyudāttagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati?
syādetat--tatra kriyamāṇe pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya svaraḥ prāpnoti, iha tu kriyamāṇe nāyaṃ doṣo bhaved, utpanno hi pratyayastadāśrayāṇāṃ tadantavidhyādīnāṃ nimittaṃ bhavati, na tūtpadyamānaḥ, na khalūtpadyamāno ghaṭa udakāharaṇādīnāṃ nimittamavakalpate, tataśca `ādyudāttaśca' ityasya pratiyogamupasthāne sati utpadyamāna eva tavyadādirādyudātto bhavati, evaṃ tibādiranudātta iti doṣābhāvaḥ, ataḥ pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogena casvaro vidhīyata iti? tanna; jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ ñnityādirudātto bhavatītyāha, taj jñāpayati---pratyayasya cetyatra na tadantavidhirbhavatītyanudāttatvamapi tadantasya na bhaviṣyati; dhātoranta udātto bhavatītyādeḥ prakṛtisvarasya vidhānasāmarthyāt| yatra hyanudāttaḥ pratyayaḥ----yāti, vṛkṣābhyāmityādau, tatra prakṛtisvaraḥ śrūyate; yātaḥ, yānti, vṛkṣatvamityādau satiśiṣṭena pratyayādyudāttatvena bādhyate| yadi ca pratyayāntasyānudāttatvaṃ syād nirviṣayaṃ dhātuprātipadikāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---lavitavyamityādau pratyayotpattikāle evāgyudāttatve kṛte paścādbhavanniḍanudātto yathā syāt, anyathā lū-tavya iti sthite ādyudāttatvaṃ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, iṭ tu svarabhinnasya prāpnoti, ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādiṭi kṛte tasya pratyayagrahaṇena grahaṇe sati iṭa evādyudāttatvaṃ syāt? etadapi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `yāsuṭparasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca' ityāha, tajjñāpayati---āgamā anudāttā iti; anyathā cinuyātāmityādau yāsuṭaḥ pratyayāditvātsiddhamudāttatvamityanarthakaṃ tatsasyāt| nanu pidarthametatsasyāt, anyathā cinuyādityādau pidbhakto yāsuṅanudāttaḥ syāt?
