yadyotāvatprayojanaṃ syād, yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣu bhavati, apicca liṅbhavatīti pittvameva pratiṣedhet| avaśyaṃ caitajjñāpakamāśrayaṇīyam, anyathā pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenādyudāttatvavidhāvapi laviṣīyetyādau lāvasthāyāmanackatvādasati svare viśeṣavihitatvātparatvācca sīyuṭi kṛte paścāllādeśe pratyayādyudāttatvamityānupūrvyā sīyuṭa eva syāt| jñāpakāśrayaṇe tu sīyuḍanudāttaḥ `iṭo't' ityakāra udātto bhavati| kathaṃ bhavati, yāvatā sīyuṭi kṛte'kārasya vicchinnamāditvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yāsuṭa udāttavacanaṃ jñāpakam---pratyayādyudāttatve karttavye āgamā avidyamānavadbhavantīti; anyathā cinuyātāmityādau yāsuṭaḥ pratyayāditvātsiddhamudāttatvamityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| kiñca, lavitavyamityādau pūrvamādyudāttatve satyapi paścādbhavanniṭ kimityanudātto bhavati śeṣanighātena? nāyaṃ śeṣanighātasya viṣayaḥ, svaravidhiśeṣatvāttasya| yasminpade yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yasyāca udāttaḥ svarito vā vidhīyate tasminpade tasyāmavasthāyāṃ sannihitamajantaraṃ nihanyata ityarthaḥ| na cāyaṃ prakāro'tra sambhavati| iha tarhi strughne bhavā straughnī pratyayasanniyogenāṇa udāttatve sati ṅīpa udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ siddho bhavati; anyathā straughna ī iti sthite `pratyayasya ca' ityādyudāttatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope kṛte udāttanivṛttyabhāvānna syāt, na vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt| lopo hi ṅīpa utpattimapekṣate, svarastu nirapekṣaḥ| avaśyaṃ cātrāntaraṅgatvamevāśrayaṇīyam, anyathā kaṃsena krītā `kaṃsāṭṭiṭhan' ṭita iti ṅīp, kaṃsa ṭha ī iti sthite `ñnityādiḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lopaḥ syāt, tataśca nitsvare lopena bādhite pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogena vidhīyamānamādyudāttatvamakārasya sthitamiti tasya lope ṅīpa udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ syāt| nanu ca ṭhacaścitkaraṇātpūrvamikāradeśastataḥ pratyayādyudāttatvamiti nāstyudāttalopaḥ| iha tarhi utse jātā `utsādibhyo'ñ',ṅīp, utsa a ī iti sthite ñitsvaraṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope pūrvāktayā nītyā ḍīpa udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nitsvaro hi pratyayasvarasyāpavādaḥ, na cāpavādaviṣaya utsargo'bhiniviśate, tatra tāvadatra pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati, apavādaṃ ñnitsvaraṃ pratīkṣyata iti kuta udāttalopaḥ! iha tarhi atrerapatyam `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak, āyannādiṣūpadeśivacanaṃ svarasiddhyarthamiti pratyayasvarātpūrvameyādeśaḥ, ṅīp ātreya ī iti sthite taddhitasya kita iti svaraṃ bādhitvā paratvādyasyeti lope kṛte udāttanivṛttisvara īkārasya na prāpnoti tasmādāntaraṅgatvamevāśrayaṇīyam| evaṃ ca sraughnītyatrāpi antaraṅgatvādeva siddhamiṣṭamiti nārtha etadarthena pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogenādyudāttavacanena| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---gopāyāti dhūpāyati, utpattisanniyogenādyudāttatve paścāt `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ dhātorityantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| yadi tu ñnityādirnityaṃ pratyayasya cetyucyeta, paratvāddhātusvaraṃ pratyayasvaro bādheta| syādetat|
anudāttasya tarhyatra pradeśe karaṇe kiṃ prayojanam? syādetat----kāryaśabdāṭṭāpi svaritatvātprāgekādeśe kṛte tasya pūrva pratyantavadbhāvāttitsvaritaśca prāpnoti, paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvātpitsvaraśca, paratvātsvarito bhavati| yadi tu lasārvadhātukamanudāttaṃ suppitau cetyucyeta paratvādanudāttvaṃ syāditi? tanna; tatra hi ṭābu tpatterapi prāgeva svarito bhavati, satyapi vā ṭāpi svaritaikādeśayorubhayoranityayoḥ paratvātsvaritatve kṛte āntaryataḥ svaritānudāttayorekādeśaḥ svarito bhaviṣyati| idaṃ tarhi---āmbaṣṭhyā yaṅaścāpyekādeśe kṛte pitsvaraśca prāpnoti citsvaraśca, paratvāccitsvaro bhavati, anyatra kriyamāṇo pitsvaraḥ syāt? atrāpi cāpaścitkaraṇasāmarthyādevaca citsvaro bhaviṣyati| sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthe hi cakāre ṭāpprakaraṇa eva yaṅaṣṭāpaṃ vidadhīta| evaṃ tarhi tadeva tasminprayojanaṃ tadantavidhirmā bhūditi| yadukta prakṛtisvarasya vidhānasāmarthyāditi? tatra āste śeta ityādau lasārvadhātukamātrasyānudāttatve sati dhātusvarasya sāvakāśatvāt| prātipadikāntodāttatvamapi agnimān, vāyumān, agrīnāmityādau `hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' `nāmanyatarasyām' iti svarasiddhyartha syāt, atra hyantodāttāditi varttata ityalamapi karkaśena kṣodena||
anudāttau suppitau|| 3.1.4 ||
anudāttau suppitau|| subiti pratyāhārasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na spatamībahuvacanasya; pittvādevānudāttatvasya siddhatvāt| ata eva vṛttau `supaḥ' iti bahuvacanam| pita etattu prakramānurodhena bahuvacanam| supaśca pakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ, na kapa; ṭābādīnāṃ pitkaraṇāt| pacatīti| śabantodāharaṇam, tipastvadupadeśāt `lasārvadhātukam' ityeva siddham||
guptijkidbhyaḥ san|| 3.1.5 ||
guptijkidbhyaḥ san|| gupa gopane iti| `gupa vyākulatve', `gupū rakṣaṇe'ityetayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; tijinā saha gaṇe paṭhitasyānudāttena eva guperihāpi grahaṇāt| pratyayasaṃjñā cādhikṛtaiveti| kā punaratra vismaraṇāśaṅkā, kintvanvarthā pratyayasaṃjñā, anarthakasya gupādisano na syādityāśaṅkānena nivāryate| adhikārasāmarthyādanarthakasyāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ| anvarthatā tvarthavadanarthakasambhave'rthavato grahaṇehetuḥ| nindādayastu gupādīnāmarthā na sanaḥ, anyathā gupādīnāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| dhātūnāṃ cānekārthatvaṃ tatra tatra ddaśyate| pratyayāstu svārthikā api bhavanti samāsāntādivat| jugupsate iti| dhātorityevamanabhidhānādasya sano'nāddhadhātukatvādiḍabhāvaḥ| nindākṣameti| prāyikametadupādhivacanam| tathā ca `kṣetriyac parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ' ityatra granthaḥ----`atha vā kṣetriyāṇi tṛṇāni sasyārthe kṣetre jātāni cikitsyāni vināśayitavyāni, atha vā kṣetriyaḥ pāradārikaḥ, paradārāḥ parakṣetrem, tatra cikitsyo nigṛhītavyaḥ' iti| saṃśaye'pi ddaśyate----tadvyacikitsan, ya evaṃ vidvānvicikitsati, tacchuśruvānṛṣirvyacikitsaditi ca| anyatreti| arthāntaravṛtterddhātvantarādityarthaḥ| etacca `pūrvavatsanaḥ' ityatra nipūṇataramupapāditam| gupādiṣvanubandhakaraṇamātmanepadārthamiti| etadapi tatraivopapāditam| gupādīṣviti bahuvacanaṃ mānvadhādisūtrābhiprāyam| kitistuparasmaipadī, tathā cānantarameva prayogā darśitāḥ| sano nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, nitkaraṇasāmarthyāddhātusvaro na bhavati---yatstotāraṃ jighāṃsasi sakhāyam| viśeṣaṇārthaśca---`ajjhanagamāṃ sani' `haneḥ saḥ' haṃsa ityatra mā bhūt| `stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇyabhyāsāt',suṣupiṣa indramityatra mā bhūt| `sanyaṅoḥ' ityatrāpi `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityato dhātorityanuvṛttairyadyapi tṛṇādibhyaḥ se'prasaṅgaḥ| haṃsaḥ, vatsa ityādau tu syādevoṇādīnāṃ vyutpattipakṣe| pratīṣiṣatītyatra pratipūrvādiṇaḥ sani vihite `ajāderdvitīyasya' iti śabdasya dvirvacanaṃ yathā syādevamarthaḥ| `yathaṣṭaṃ nāmadhātūnāmiti vaktavyam' putrīyiṣiṣati| an‌yatra tvārddhadhātuke `ato lopaḥ' sārvadhātuke śapā sahaikādeśa iti nāsti viśeṣaḥ||
mānbadhadānśānbhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya|| 3.1.6 ||
mānbadhadānśānbhyo dīrghaścābhyāsasya|| atra mānbadhī anudāttetau, śeṣau svaritetau| abhyāsasya cekārasyadīrgho bhavatīti| `sanyataḥ' itītve dīrgho bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu viśeṣavihito dīrghaḥ sāmānyavihitamittvaṃ bādhitvā'varṇasyaiva prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ `dīrgho'kitaḥ', ityatrākita ityāha, tajjñāpayati----nābhyāsavikāreṣu bādhyabādhakabhāva iti| taddhi yaṃyamyate ityādau nuki kṛte mā bhūditi| yadi cābhyāsavikāreṣu bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syāttato viśeṣavihitatvānnuki kṛte'najantatvādeva na bhaviṣyati dīrghaḥ, kiṃ pratiṣedhena? ata eva ḍīḍhokyate ityādau hrasvatve kṛte guṇo bhavati, anyathā babādhe caritārthaṃ hrasvaṃ pāpacyate ityādau caritārtho dīrghaḥ paratvādvādheta|
apara āha---sūtropātta evārtho vṛttikāreṇokta iti kathamabhyāsasyeti padacchedaḥ, abhyāsasya vikāra abhyāsaḥ, sa cettvameva| tathā hi---lopasya tāvadabhāvarūpatvādadaiśo vidhātumaśakyaḥ, yadi ca hrasvasya dīrghatvaṃ syātca taddhitanirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt, dīrghaśrutyā `acaśca' ityupasthānādajantasya dīrghavidhānāddīrghasya hrasvasya vā dīrgho viśeṣābhāvāttasmādittvameva taddhitena pratyāyyate| atha vā sanyāhatya vihitasya vikārasya grahaṇaṃ tadāha---abhyāsasya cekārasyeti| sarvaśeṣa iti | na kevalaṃ tasyaivāpi tu pūrvayorapi dvayorityarthaḥ| tena kvacinna bhavatīti| arthāntaravṛttibhyo dātvantarebhya ityarthaḥ| etacca `pūrvavatsanaḥ' ityatropapāditam| mānayatītyādayaścurādiṇyantāḥ| niśāna iti ṇyantādeva pacādyac| mānerjijñāsāyāmiti| yadyevam, jñānārthavṛttermāneruttarasūtreṇaiva san siddhaḥ? satyam, dīrghavighānārtha vacanamiḍabhāvārtha ca| badhervairupye iti| cittasya durgandhādyanubhavanimitto vikāro vairūpyam| śāneniṃśāne iti| niśānam-tīkṣṇīkaraṇam, yatraivāyaṃ paṭhitaḥ `śāna tejane' iti tatraivetyarthaḥ||
dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā|| 3.1.7 ||
dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā|| karmatvasamānakartṛkatvayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvādicchāyāyaśca pratyayārthatvenāpi tāvacchutatvāttadapekṣe eva te vijñāyete ityāha ---iṣikarma yo dhāturiṣiṇaiva samānakartṛka iti| arthaddhārakamiti| dhātvarthasya karmatvātsamānakartṛkatvācca dhātustathā vyapadiśyate na svarūpeṇetyarthaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam? asambhavāt| yadyapi karotimicchatītyādau dhātoḥ svarūpeṇāpi karmatvasambhavaḥ, tathāpi na tasya svarūpeṇārthadvāreṇa vā samānakartṛkatvaṃ sambhavati| kiṃ cātra śtipā nirdeśātsvarūpaparatvam, sanprakṛtestu lokavyutpattyanusāreṇārthaparatvameva, ataḥ suṣṭhūktam---dhātorarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| icchāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ karmabhūta icchayaiva samānakartṛko'rtho yasya dhātostasmātsan bhavatītyarthaḥ| cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatīti| kṛhṛñbhyāṃ san, `iko jhal' iti kittvam, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani'iti dīrghaḥ, `ṛta idvātoḥ',`hali ca' iti dīrgha;, sanaḥ ṣatvam, dvirvacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ, hrasvaḥ, `kuhoścuḥ' iti cutvam---kakārasya cakāraḥ, hakārasya jhakāraḥ, `abhyāse carca' iti jaśtvam---jakāraḥ, `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ laḍādiḥ|
dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimiti| `karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkāt' iti vacanādvākyānna bhaviṣyati| na hyetadubhayaṃ vākyārthasya sambhavati, subantādapi---putramicchatītyādau asamānakartṛkatvānna bhaviṣyati, yatrāpi samānakartṛkatvam---gamanamicchati, āsanamicchatītyādau, tatrāpi kyajbādhako bhaviṣyati| yadyapi putramicchatītyādau asamānakartṛke kyac sāvakāśaḥ tathāpi cikīrṣatītyādāvasubante sāvakāśaṃ sanaṃ subanteṣu samānakartṛkeṣu paratvādvādhiṣyate| yatrāpi kyac pratiṣidhyate kyaci māntāvyayapratiṣedha iti----karttumicchatīti, tatrāpi kāmyajbādhakaḥ|ṅyāp‌prātipadikeṣvapi khaṭvākumārīputrādiṣu na samānakartṛkatvam| āsanaśayanādau tvakarmatvam, na hi ṅyāppratipadikaṃ karmābhidhāyi, vibhaktyabhidheyatvātkarmādīnām| dhātorapi tarhi na syāt? atha tatra vastuto dhātvarthasyecchayā vyāpyamānatvātkarmatvam, prātipadikādapi syāt, athātra karmarūpānabhidhānānna syāt, dhātorapi na syāditi samānaṃ vacaḥ? evaṃ tarhyasamānakartṛkatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati| śayanāsanādau hi prakṛtyarthasyaiva samānakartṛkatvakriyārūpatvād, na pratyayārthasyākriyārūpasya, `kriyārūpasya siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayaḥ' iti smaraṇāt| tiṅantādapi yata eva hetoḥ pākamicchatītyatrārthe pacatīcchatīti na bhavati, tata eva hetoḥ sannapi na bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ na dhātumapahāya kvacidapi prasaṅga iti praśnaḥ|
sopasargādutpattirmā bhūditi| anyathā saṅghātasya viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvāttata eva sansyāt, tataśca sannantatvena tasyaiva dhātutvāttata eva laṅyupasargātpūrvo'ḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti| nanu liṅyapyupasargasya dvirvacanaprasaṅgo doṣaḥ śakyo darśayitum? satyam; aṭprasaṅgamapyaparaṃ doṣaṃ darśayituṃ laṅudāhṛtaḥ| nanu dhātureva viśiṣṭakriyāvācī, upasargastu sannidhimātreṇopakārako na tu kasyacidarthasyābhidhānena, yathā---bhuṅkte ityatra bhujirevābhyavahāre varttate, ātmanepadaṃ tu kartari, atha cāntareṇātmanepadaṃ nābhyavahāro gamyate; tadvadupapasargasannidhāne dhātureva viśiṣṭāṃ kriyāmāha, tataścārthadvārake karmatvasamānakartṛkatve api dhātoreva, na saṅghātasya, avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam----dhātureva ca kriyāvacī, katham? yo hi manyate saṅghātaḥ kriyāvācīti, kriyamāṇe'ti, kriyamāṇe'pi tasya dhātugrahaṇe yo'tra dhāturna tasmādutpattiḥ prāpnoti, akarmatvādasamānakartṛtvācca? evaṃ manyate---praśabdasannidhau tāvatprakarṣākhyo viśeṣo gamyate, na ca prakarṣamapi dhāturevācaṣṭe; praśabdasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt; sati caivaṃ samudāyasyaiva karmatvam| na hyasau karotyarthamātreṇa santuṣyati, nāpi prakarṣamātreṇa| na caivaṃ yo'tra dhātustasmādanutpattiprasaṅgaḥ, tasyāpi karmatvāt| tathā ca kaṭaṃ karoti, bhīṣmamudāraṃ darśanīyamiti samudāyacikīrṣāyāmapi bhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā bhavati; teṣāmapi karmatvāt| nanvevamapi yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, tathā karmasamudāyasyākarmatvātsamudāyādutpattirna bhaviṣyati| yatra tarhi samudāyasyaiva karmatvaṃ tatra katham, yathā---prasthātumicchati pratiṣṭhāsata iti, atra hi tiṣṭhatīti gatinivṛttiḥ pratīyate, praśabdāsannidhau tu gatiḥ, tatra yathā jigamiṣatītyekameva karma tadvadatrāpi tataśca samudāyādeva syāt? yadyevam, yo'tra dhātuḥ kathaṃ tataḥ san, na hyasau karma, karmaṇa iti naiṣā dhātusamānādhikaraṇā pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? ṣaṣṭhī---karmaṇo'vayavāddhātoriti? cikīrṣatītyādāvapi kevalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena karmāvayavatvam| evamapyasamānakartṛtvānna prāpnoti, dhātumātrasyākriyāvācitvāt| ataḥ samānakartṛkādityapi ṣaṣṭhyarthe pañcamīti vyākhyeyam| tadevaṃ saṅghātanivṛttyartha dhātugrahaṇamiti sthitam|
karmama iti kimiti| jigamiṣatītyādau prayoge pratyayavācyāyā icchāyāḥ karmāpekṣāyāṃ pratyāsattyā prakṛtyartha eva karma pratyeṣyate| yadyapi kriyā karaṇamapyapekṣate, sphuṭatarā tvicchāyāḥ karmāpekṣeti saiva prakṛtyarthena pūrayiṣyate, nārthaḥ karmagrahaṇeneti praśnaḥ| gamanenecchatīti| asyāṃ vivakṣāyāṃ gamermā bhūdityarthaḥ| asati hi karmagrahaṇe satyāparīcchāyāḥ karmāpekṣāyāṃ yathaitadvākyaṃ bhavati---gamanenecchatīti, tathā sannapi syāditi bhāvaḥ| icchāyāmiti kimiti| śabdavairādisūtre yat `karaṇe' iti tadihaivāstu, abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyācca karaṇaviśeṣa icchāyāmeva san bhaviṣyati, namasprabhṛtibhyaḥ kyajiti praśnaḥ| kartujānātīti| lakṣaṇaikaśaraṇo naivaṃ pratipādyeteti bhāvaḥ|
vāvacanādvākyamapi bhavatīti| nanu `samānakartṛkeṣu tumun' iti tumunvidhānasāmarthyādeva vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati, asti tasyāvakāśaḥ---cikīrṣitumicchatīti| na hyatra sanaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; `sanantānna saniṣyate' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| dhātoriti vidhānādityādinā dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanāntaraṃ darśayati| na pūrvatreti| tathā ca jugupsate ityādāviḍabhāvaḥ|
āśaṅkāyāmiti| āśaṅkā-sambhāvanā, prayoktṛdharmaḥ, tadviśiṣṭakriyāvacanātsvārthe pratyayaḥ| kūlaṃ pipatiṣatīti| kūlasyācetanatvādicchāyā asambhavaḥ| śvāmumūrṣatīti| śunaścetanatve'pi jīvitasya priyatvādvyādhyādyabhibhave'pi tiryaktvānmartumicchā na bhavatīti, śaṅke patiṣyati kūlam, śaṅke mariṣyati śvetyatrārthaḥ| pratyākhyānaṃ tu---yo yadicchati sa tasya pūrvarūpāṇi karoti, yathā---devadattaḥ kaṭaṃ cikīrṣuḥ sannahyati rajjukīlapūlādikaṃ cādatte; kūlasyāpi ca pūrvarūpāṇi ddaśyante---loṣṭāḥ śīryante, bhidā jāyante| śvānaḥ khalvapi mumūrṣava ekāntaśīlāḥ sthūlākṣāśca bhavanti, tadiha pūrvarūpadarśanādicchādhyāropyate---icchatyevāyaṃ ya evamicchāvinābhūtāni pūrvarūpāṇi karoti| gauṇamukhyanyāyaśca kvacillakṣyāpekṣayā nāśrīyate, tataścādhyāropitecchāśrayaḥ pratyaya iti|
viśeṣaṇaṃ kimiti| icchāgrahaṇaṃ kimityarthaḥ|
śeṣikāditi| sanprasaṅgādanyo'niṣṭaḥ pratyayo vāryate| śeṣādhikāravihitaḥ śaiṣikaḥ maturbanthe bhavo matubarthīyaḥ, gahāderākṛtigamatvācchaḥ, matupo'rtho matubarthaḥ, so'syāstīti matubarthikaḥ| `ata iniṭhanau'| śaiṣikapratyayāntācchaiṣikaḥ sarūpapratyayo neṣṭaḥ, tadyathā---śālāyāṃ bhavo ghaṭaḥ śālīyaḥ, tatra bhavamudakam, punaścho na bhavati; virūpastu bhavatyeva---ahicchatre bhavamāhicchatram, tatra bhavamāhicchatrīyam, aṇantāccho bhavati| tathā daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍikaḥ, `ata iniṭhanau' so'syāstīti punaṣṭhanna bhavati; virūpastu bhavatyeva---daṇḍimatī seneti| sananantānna saniṣyate iti| sarūpa ityeva| sārūpyeṇa cātra sāddaśyaṃ lakṣyate, taccārthadvārakamiti icchāsanantāditi pūrvokta evārtho bhavati, etacca nyāyasiddham| tathā hi---jātau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate, tataśca tatpravṛtteḥ prāk tatpratyayāntaprakṛtyasambhavāttadantānnāsti tatpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ| iha yo grāmaṃ gantumicchati tasya yadyapi grāmo na svarūpeṇeṣṭaḥ----grāmo me syāditi, tathāpi gamyamānatārūpeṇa so'pīṣṭa eva| grāmo jigaṃsyate, jigamiṣitaḥ, jigamiṣitavyaḥ, sujigamiṣa iti icchā vācinaḥ sanantāt grāme karmaṇi lādayo bhavanti| gamiṃ prati karmatvaṃ grāmasya spaṣṭameva| ata eva grāmaṃ jigamiṣati, grāmāya jigamiṣatīti `gatyarthakarmaṇi' iti dvitīyācaturthyau bhavataḥ||
supa ātmanaḥ kyac|| 3.1.8 ||
supa ātmanaḥ kyac|| atrāpīcchāyāmityanuvṛttestadapekṣameva subantasya karmatvaṃ vijñāyate ityāha---iṣikarmaṇa iti| ātmaśabdo'yaṃ paravyāvṛttivacanaḥ svaśabdaparyāyo gṛhyate, na cetanadravyavacanaḥ| sa hi gṛhyamāṇa icchayā vā sambadhyeta, subantena vā| tatrecchayā sambandhe karttari ṣaṣṭhī, ātmanaḥ icchāyāmātkakartṛkāyāmicchāyāmātmā cedicchatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataścātmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvaivehecchā''tmakartṛkā, tasyāstaddharmatvāt| subantasambandhe tu devadattasya putramicchati yajñadatta ityatrāpi prāpnoti, parasyāpi hīṣyamāṇa ātmana eveṣṭo bhavati; tasyāpyātmatvāt| anarthakaṃ cātmagrahaṇaṃ syād; vyāvarttyābhāvāt| vṛkṣasya jalamicchati, khaṭvāyāḥ pādamicchatītyādau yatrācetanārtha kiñcidiṣyate tadvyāvarttyamiti cet, na; tatrāpi cetanasyaiva paramaśeṣitvāt| sarvameva hi bhogyaṃ cetanānāmeva śeṣabhūtaṃ khaṭvāyāḥ pādamicchatītyatrāpi yasya tat khṭavādikamupabhogyaṃ tadarthameva tadiṣyate, khaṭvādikaṃ tu tasyaiva dvāramātram; ataḥ paravyāvṛttivacana evātmaśabdaḥ| tatrāpi yadīcchayā sambandhaḥ syāt, pūrvavat karttari ṣaṣṭhyāmātmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvasyā evecchāyā eṣitṛkartṛkatvā diti subantena sambadhyate, subantātkarmaṇa icchāyāmabhidheyāyāṃ kyaj bhavali, taccetsubantamātmanaḥ svasya sambandhi bhavati| kasya svasyetyapekṣāyāmicchayā eṣituḥ sannidhāpitatvāt tasyevaiṣiturātmanaḥ sambandhi iti vijñāyate, tadāha----eṣiturevātmasamambandhinaḥ subantāditi| na caivamātmanaḥ putraṃ parasya dāsamicchatītyatrāpi subantasyātmasambandhitvātprasaṅgaḥ, nātra yathākathaṃcidātmasambandhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? iṣyamāṇameva rūpamātmasambandhitvena yadeṣyate tadā pratyayaḥ| putrīyatīti| `kyaci ca' itīttvam|
supa iti kimiti| karmaṇa iti vacanāttiṅantādaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi tiṅantaṃ karma| dhātoścāprasaṅgaḥ viśeṣavihitena sanā bādhitatvāt| ṅyāpprātipadikādutpattāvapi na kaściddoṣaḥ; `naḥ kye' iti padasaṃjñāvidhānāt| tacca kriyamāṇe subgrahaṇe niyamārtham---nāntameva kye padamiti| tadeva ṅyāpprātipadikādutpattau vidhyartha bhaviṣyati| nanvasati subgrahaṇe ṅyāpprātipadikātsubantāccotpattvyamaviśeṣāt, tataśca `naḥ kye' ityetadyadyevaṃ vidhyartham, ubhayathāpi doṣaḥ; niyamārthe hi vācyatītyādau prātipadikātsubantāccotpattau yadyapi doṣābhāvaḥ, nakārānteṣu prātipadikādutpattipakṣe nalopo na syāt| atha teṣu prātipadikā dupttau vidhyartham, evaṃ sati vācyatītyādau subantādutpattipakṣe jaśtvādipadakāryaṃ syāt, ataḥ subantādeva yathā syātprātipadikānmā bhūditi niyamārthaṃ subgrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva| evaṃ tarhi karmagrahaṇād ṅyapprātipadikādaprasaṅgaḥ subantameva hi karmābhidhāyi; pañackapakṣe'pi dyotakavibhakterapekṣitatvāt| tadevaṃ subantamapahāya na kvacitprasaṅga iti matvā praśnaḥ|
vākyāditi| padasamūhādityarthaḥ| mahantaṃ putramicchatīti| kiṃ ca syādyadyatra syāt? pratyayārthe guṇabhūtayormahatputraśabdayorasati parasparasambandhe samāso na syāt, tathā ca tannibandhanamātvaṃ na syāt| kimidānīṃ na bhavati---mahāputrīyatīti? bhavati, yadaitadvākyaṃ bhavati----mahānputro mahāputraḥ mahāputramicchīti| atha kriyamāṇe'pi subgrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati? pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā samudāyasyāsubantatvāt| kiṃ punarayaṃ karmaṇoḥ samudāyaḥ? āhosvitsamudāyaḥ karma? kiṃ cātaḥ? yadi karmaṇoḥ samudāyaḥ, na karmagrahaṇena gṛhyate iti samudāyādaprasaṅga? atha samudāyaḥ karma, avayavād dvitīyā na prāpnotyakarmatvāt? evaṃ tarhi karmaṇorevāyaṃ samudāyaḥ, subgrahaṇaṃ tu yadatra karma tasmānmā bhūditi| atha kriyamāṇe'pi subgrahaṇe kasmādeva tasmānna syāt, subantameva hi tat? asāmarthyāt| kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamartha bhavatīti| akriyayāṇe punaḥ subgrahaṇe nāyaṃ padavidhirbhavati| yatra hi padasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ kiñcidrūpamāśritaṃ sa padavidhiḥ, karmagrahaṇaṃ tu na padasyaivāsādhāraṇam, `dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ' ityapadepi ddaṣṭatvāt|
anye tvāhuḥ----samudāyasyāpi karmatvamavayavayośca mahattvaviśiṣṭasya putrasyaiṣyamāṇatvāditi teṣāṃ samudāyādavayavācca mā bhūditi subgrahaṇam| rājñaḥ putramicchatīti| nanvasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyati, kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatīti? yatra tarhyantareṇāpi tṛtīyasya padasya prayogaṃ parasyeti gamyate tatra mā bhūt yathā---aghamicchati, vyasanamicchatīti, na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| kakāra ityādi| syādetat----`naḥ kye' ityatrāpi mā kāri kakāra iti? yadyevam, sāmasu sādhuḥ atrāpi prāpnoti| cakātstadavighātārtha iti| svarastu pratyayasvareṇa siddho dhātusvareṇa vā, akārastu ddaṣadamicchati ddaṣyadyati, ddaṣadyaterṇvul, `ato lopaḥ',`yasya halaḥ',`kyasya vibhāṣā'----ddaṣadakaḥ, atrāto lopasya sthānivadbhāvāt `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhirmā bhūt| mṛdamicchati mṛdyati, mṛdyateḥ `aco yat', ato lopādi pūrvavat---mṛdyam, `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi| putrīyatītyādau ca śapā sahaikādeśa udātto bhavati|
kyaci māntāvyayapratiṣedha iti| māntagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇam, na subantasya | tena putramicchatītyādau kyaj bhavati, kāvicchati kānicchatītyādau ca na bhavati| uccaurnīcairiti| adhikaraṇapradhānayorapyanayorādheye yadā vṛttistadā karmatvam, gosamānākṣaranāntādityeke| gośabdātsamānākṣarānnāntācca kyaj bhavatītyeke manyante| akārādayo daśa samānākṣarāḥ; tatra lṛvarṇāntasya, ṛkārāntasya ca prātipadikasyābhāvādekārānpūrveṣāṃ saptānāmacāṃ grahaṇam| asminpakṣe vācyatītyādi na siddhyati, tasmānnāyaṃ sthitaḥ pakṣa ityāhuḥ| ata evāsya vṛttāvanupanyāsaḥ| parecchāyāmiti| śeṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāso na kartṛṣaṣṭhyāḥ, subantadvārakaśca parasyecchayā sambandhaḥ, parasya subantārthā yā icchā tasyāmityarthaḥ| aghāyava iti| `kyācchandasi' ityupratyayaḥ, `aśvāghasyāt' ityātvam| etadeva kyaci parata ātvavidhānaṃ jñāpakam chandasi parecchāyāmapi kyaj bhavatīti, na hi kaścidātmano'ghamicchati| na cācārakyajartham, chandasyaghaśabdācāre kyaco'darśanāt| athāsmātkyajantāllakṛtyaktakhalarthā bhavantaḥ kva bhavanti? yathāyogaṃ bhāve karttari ca, na tu karmaṇi| prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭāyā niyataviṣayāyā icchāyāḥ kyajantenābhidhānam, na sā vastvantaraṃ viṣīyakaroti, ato jīvatyādivadakarmakaḥ kyajantaḥ| ācārakyajante tūpamānakarmaṇaḥ putrāderantarbhāve'pi upameyasyacchātrāderanantarbhāvāttasminkarmaṇi lādayo bhavantyeva---putrīyyatecchātraḥ putrāyitavya ityādi, yathā----śyenāyate kāka iti upamānakarturantarbhāve'pi upameyakarttarilo bhavati, tadvat| iha ca māṇavakaṃ muṇḍaṃ karoti muṇḍate māṇavakaḥ, muṇḍayitavyo māṇavaka iti ṇyanto dhāturmauṇḍyaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyamātramantarbhāvayituṃ śaktaḥ, na tu māṇavakādikaṃ viśeṣamiti tasya dhātāvanantarbhāvāttatra lādayo bhavanti| yadyevam, anena hetunā kyajantādapi prāpnoti| māṇavakaṃ muṇḍamicchati muṇḍīyati māṇavakam, muṇḍīyyate māṇavaka iti, nātra kyacā bhavitavyamasāmarthyāt? kathamasāmarthyam? sāpekṣamasamartha bhavatīti| ṇijapi tarhi na prāpnoti? syādetat----nobhau karotiyuktau mauṇḍyaṃ māṇavakaśca, na hi māṇavakatvaṃ kriyate, tataśca muṇḍaṃ karotītyatraivārthe muṇḍyatoti ṇijutpadyate| muṇḍaṃ karoti māṇavakamityatra vākye'pi muṇḍasyaiva karmatvam, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyāttu māṇavakād dvitīyotpattiḥ| tadevaṃ māṇavakādayo mauṇḍyasyādhāraviśeṣapratipādanārthamupādīyamānāḥ karotiyuktā na bhavanti| yadā punarubhau karotiyuktau bhavataḥ, na bhavati tadā vṛttiḥ, tadyathā---balīvarddaṃ karoti taṃ ca muṇḍaṃ karoti muṇḍayati balīvaddamiti ṇijbhavati| yadyevam, anenaiva hetunā kyajapi na prāpnoti| yadi cādhāratvenāpi māṇavako'pekṣyate, punarapi sāpekṣatā|
kiñca, yadi na māṇavakaḥ karotiyuktaḥ, kathaṃ tat lakāra utpadyate---muṇḍyate māṇavaka iti? kaścāyaṃ nyāyo na māṇavakaḥ karotiyukta iti? na hyasau mauṇḍyamātreṇa santuṣyati,māṇavakasthamasau mauṇḍyabhinirvatttayati, tataśca svarūpeṇākriyamāṇo'pi māṇavako muṇḍaparūpeṇa kriyate, iṣyate ca| tadevaṃ sati yadi ṇij bhavati kyajapi syād atha kyajna bhavati ṇijapi na syāditi samānaṃ vacaḥ| evaṃ tarhi muṇḍādayo guṇavacanāśca sāpekṣāḥ, ucyate ca ṇic, sa vacanātsāpekṣebhyo'pi bhaviṣyati, kyac punaranapekṣebhyaḥ putrādibhyaḥ sāvakāśa iti māṇavakaṃ muṇḍamicchatītyādau sāpekṣebhyo na bhaviṣyatīti? yadyapyayamapi ṇij guṇamātrakaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ sāvakāśaḥ---muṇḍayatyayaṃ nāpitaḥ pravīṇo mauṇḍyakaraṇaiti, tathāpi tatkarotīti siddhe ṇici punarvidhānamidaṃ sāpekṣebhyo'pi yathā syādityevamarthameva| yadvā--dvividhā muṇḍādyaḥ---dhātavaḥ, prātipadikāni ca| tatra sūtre dhātava upāttāstebhyaḥ svabhāvata eva viśiṣṭakriyāvacanebhyo ṇijbhaviṣyati, prātipadikānāṃ tu vigraha eva---māṇavakaṃ muṇḍaṃ karotīti| atha vā nedaṃ yugapadubhayaṃ bhavati----vākyaṃ ca pratyayaśca, tataśca muṇḍayatīti dravyamātraṃ pratīyate, tatra viśeṣārthinā viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ| atha vā---muṇḍasyaiva śuddhena karotinā'nvayaḥ, mauṇḍyaviśiṣṭena tu māṇavakasya, yathā---gāṃ dogdhi paya iti śuddhasya duheḥ pūrvaṃ gavabhisambandhaḥ, paścāttu goduhinā payasaḥ| kyacpratyayastvanabhidhānānna bhavati| māṇavakaṃ muṇḍayatītyukte māṇavakaṃ muṇḍamivācaratītyarthāntarameva pratīyate| tadevamicchākyajantādbhāve karttari ca lādaya iti sthitam||
kāmyacca|| 3.1.9 ||
kāmyacca|| kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na `supa ātmanaḥ kyackāmyacau' ityekayoga eva kriyate, evaṃ hi cakāro na karttavyo bhavati? tatrāha---yogavibhāga ityādi| ekayoge hi sati uttarasūtre dvayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| nanu yogavibhāge'pyānantaryātkāmyaca evānuvṛttiḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa kyaco'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tadanukarṣaṇasya caitadeva prayojanam--uttaratrānuvṛttiryathā syāt| kāmyacastu yogavibhāgasāmarthyādananuvṛttiḥ| prayojānābhāvāditi| agnikāmyatītyādau guṇaniṣedho na prayojanam, anārddhadhātukatvādeva guṇasyāpraṅgat| `vijupe chandasi' upayaṭ, upayajamicchati upayaṭkāmyatītyatra na saṃprasāraṇaṃ prayojanam; yajādibhiḥ kito viśeṣaṇāt---yajādibhyo yo vihitaḥ kiditi| vākkāmyatītyatrāpi dhātoḥ sarūpagrahaṇe kāryavijñānānna saṃprasāraṇaṃ prayojanam|
cakārāditvādveti| kecidvyācakṣate---ante'sya cakāro'narthakaḥ, dhātusvareṇaivāntodāttatvasya siddhtvāt, sa ādau karttavyaḥ| atha vā---ante'pi kṛto niyamārthaḥ saṃpadyate---cidvāyaṃ vyapadeṣṭavyo nānubandhāntareṇeti tenānte kṛta āditvaphalasaṃpādanādāditaḥ saṃpadyata iti| anye tu `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' `kāmyacca' iti dvicakārakanirdeśāśrayeṇa cakārāditvaṃ varṇayanti' citkaraṇaṃ tu putrakāmiṣyatītyatra sati śiṣṭamapi syasvaraṃ citsvara eva yathā syāditi||
upamānādācāre|| 3.1.10 ||
upamānādācāre|| `kuḍye' ityupameye saptamīśravaṇādupamānamapi saptamyantameveti karmavivakṣāyāmetatprayogasambhavādvacanārambhaḥ| kuṭyāmiti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ||
karttuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca|| 3.1.11 ||
karttuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca|| ācāra iti varttata iti tena tadapekṣamupamānasya kartṛtvaṃ vijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ| salopaśceti| yadyayaṃ caśabdaḥ samuccayavṛttirgṛhyeta tadekameva vākyaṃ syāt----kyaṅsalopau bhavati iti, tataśca yatraiva salopastatraiva kyaṅpi syād---ojāyata iti, iha tu na syāt----śyenāyate kāka iti| ato'nvācaye caśabde vākyabhedaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ---aviśeṣeṇopamānātkartuḥ kyaṅ bhavati, yatra tu sakāraḥ sambhavati tatra tasya lopa iti tadidamuktam| anvācayaśiṣṭaḥ salopastadasambhave'pi kyaṅ bhavatīti| śyenāyata iti `akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ'|
salopavidhāvapīti| salopasyānvācayaśiṣṭatvena vākyabhede satyayamapi guṇo bhavatītyartaḥ|
apiśabdenaitaddarśayati---kyaṅ‌vidhau tāvatsambaddhyate vākyasaṃpādanāya, evaṃ salopavidhāvapīti| ojāyata iti| ojaḥ śabdo vṛttiviṣaye tadvati varttate|
ojasopsarasonityaṃ payasastu vibhāṣayeti| anyasya tu yaśaḥ prabhṛternaiva bhavatītyeke, neti vayam| ojopsarovyatiriktasya sakārāntasyopalakṣaṇārthaṃ payograhaṇam| ata eva salopo vā| ojasopsarasornityamiti sāmānyena vārttikam; tena yaśāyate ityādyapi bhavatisalopo'psarasa evetyayaṃ tu pakṣo bhāṣye'pi na sthitaḥ| salopavidho kartturiti sthānaṣaṣṭhī saṃpadyate iti| pratyayavidhau yatpañcamyantaṃ tadeva lopena sambandhe'rthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ sampadyata ityarthaḥ| tatrālo'ntyasyeti niyame satīti| sakāreṇa karturviśeṣaṇāttadantavidhivijñānāttadarthameva ca seti pṛthak padaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| kvacit alo'ntyaniyame satīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra sūtraikadeśānukaraṇatvātsamāse'pi vibhakterlugabhāvaḥ, yathā----asyavāmīyamiti|
ācāra ityādi| kyaṅpavādo'yam| `galbha dhārṣṭye, `klībṛ adhārṣṭye' `hoḍṛ anādare'---ete pacādyajantā gṛhyante, tsaya cākārasya vākye'nudāttatvānunāsikatve pratijñāyete, tena kvibantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati| vāvācanātkvipā mukte kyaṅ bhavati, kvipsanniyogenānunāsikatvapratijñānāt kyaṅpakṣe itsaṃjñā na bhavati| kimartha punaridam, yāvatā galbhādayo dhātava evānudāttenaḥ paṭhyante, tebhyo galbhata ityādi siddhyati, etebhya eva pacādyajantebhyaḥ kyaṅi avagalbhāyate ityādi, yadyapi dhārṣṭyādāvarthe galbhādayaḥ paṭhyante, tathāpyanekārthatvāddhātūnām avagalbha ivācaratītyatrārthe'pi ta eva varttiṣyante? satyam; avagalbhāṃcakre ityādau pratyayāntatvādāmyathā syādityevamartha kvib vidhīyate|
atha yadā dhātubhya eva liḍ vidhīyate tadā kathaṃ bhavitavyam? avajagalbhe, viciklībe, vijuhoḍe iti| anye tu---dhātubhya eva kvib vidhīyate iti vadanta etāni rūpāṇi na sambhavantītyāhuḥ, bhāṣyavirodhāt| bhāṣyakārastāvatsarvaprātipadikebhya ityanena siddhimāśaṅkate---na tarhīdānīmityādinā| na hi dhātugrahaṇe sati tena siddhiśaṅkopapadyate| vārttikakāro'pi `sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ' iti vadan galbhādiṣvapi prāpitadikagrahaṇameva manyate| na kevalaṃ galbhādibhya eva, api tarhi sarvebhya eva prātipadikebhya iti hi tasyārthaḥ| `sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ' ityatra `sarvebhyaḥ' iti vaktavye prātipadikagrahaṇāt prātipadikādeva kvib vidhīyate, na subantāt; tena padatvābhāvādaśvatīti `ato guṇe' iti śapā pararūpaṃ bhavati, vidhuraviśabdābhyāṃ kvipi śapi gupe `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti na bhavati| vidhavati, ravayati, rājanatīti nalopo na bhavati| vācatītyādau tu kutvajaśtvādi na bhavati| ye'pi sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ kvipamicchanti, tairapi galbhādyanukramaṇaṃ karttavya mātmanepadārthānanubandhānāsaṃkṣyāmīti||
bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacverlopaśca halaḥ|| 3,1,12 ||
bhṛśādibhyo buvyacverlopaśca halaḥ|| lopavidhau `bhṛśādibhyaḥ' iti pañcamī sthānaṣaṣṭhyā viriṇamyate, halā ca bhṛśādayo viśeṣyante, tatra tadantavidhau sati halantānāṃ lopo vidhīyamāno bhṛśāyate ityādāvahalantena cabhavati, tadāha----halantānāṃ ca vijñāyamāne'halantānāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| acveriti pratyekamabhisambandhayate iti| tenaikavacanamupapadyate iti bhāvaḥ| kimarthe punaridamucyate iti| `acveḥ' ityetadadhikṛtya praśnaḥ| teneti| anuprayujyamānena bhavatinetyarthaḥ| na ca bhavateranuprayogaṃ bādhitvā kyaṅ bhavitumarhati, acvyanteṣu sāvakāśatvāt| kiñca, bhavaterabhāve cverapi nivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, tadyoge tasya vidhānāt| kathaṃ tarhi ḍājantātkyaṣ bhavati, yāvatā ḍājapi bhavatiyoge vidhīyate? atra parihāraṃ vakṣyati---kṛbhvastibhiriva kyaṣāpi yoge ḍāj bhavatītyetadeva jñāpakamiti| tatsaddaśapratipattyartha tarhīti| nañivayuktanyāyena cvyantasaddaśā bhṛśādayaḥ kathannāma pratīyeranniti cvyantaparyudāsaḥ kriyate, sāddaśyaṃ cābhūtadbhāvaviṣayatvenetyāha---abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayebhyo mṛśādibhya ityādi| bhṛśāyate ityādi| ajantānām `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ, halantānāṃ tu lopaḥ----asumanāḥ sumanā bhavati sumanāyate, durmanāyate ityādi|
bhṛśībhavatīti| idānīmevoktam---nāstyatra prasaṅgaḥ iti, tasmādacvyarthaviṣayaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ pradarśanīyam----kva divā bhṛśā bhavantīti| ye rātrau bhṛśā nakṣatrādayaste divā kva pradeśe bhavantītyarthaḥ| iha manaḥ śabdaḥ sopasargaḥ paṭhyate----sumanas, durmanas, abhimanas, unmanas; atra kiṃ sopasargātsaṅghātātpratyayo bhavati? āhosvidupasargaravitānmanaḥ sabdādeva? iti vicāraḥ tadartha ca kimupasargaḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ sumanaḥ śabdāditi? uta pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam---subhavato, durbhavatau, abhibhavatau, udbhavatāviti ? kathaṃ punarmanaḥ śabdena saha paṭhita upasarge pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamāśaṅkyate, tadviśeṣaṇatve hiprāgbhavateḥ paṭhyeta? naiṣa śakyaḥ prāgbhavateḥ paṭhitum, evaṃ hi sarvebhya eva bhaśādibhya upasargaviśiṣṭa eva bhavatyarthe pratyayaḥ syād, manaḥ śabdādeva ca viśiṣṭe'rthe iṣyata ityevamartho manaḥ----śabdena saha pāṭhaḥ syāt| tatra yadā manāḥ śabdena svādīnāṃ bahuvrīhīstadā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ te bhavanti; yadā tvasamastā eva tadā pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| manaḥ śabdaśca vṛttiviṣaye tadvati varttate manasvī suṣṭhu bhavatītyādāvarthe kyaṅ pratyayaḥ| prāptyarthasya vā bhavateḥ `ā dhṛṣādvā' iti vikalpitaṇico'tra viṣaye grahaṇam, tena manaḥ karma śobhanaṃ prāpnotītyādirartho bhavati| tatrādye pakṣe'ḍāḍlyabdvirvacaneṣu doṣaḥ, aṭ---svamanāyata, duramanāyata| āṭ---abhyamanāyata, udamanāyata| upasargasyāpi kyaṅnte dhātāvantarbhāvāttataḥ pūrvamaḍāṭau prāpnutaḥ, parau ceṣyete| lyap---sumanāyya, abhimanāyya, upasargasya ktvānte'nupraveśāttadvyatiriktapadābhāvādasati samāse lyapo'bhāvātsumanāyitveti syāt| dvirvacanam---kyaḍantātsani kṛte upasargasya sanante'nupraveśāttasya dvirvacane sati susumanāyiṣate abibhimanāyiṣate iti syād, sumimanāyiṣate abhimimanāyiṣata iti ceṣyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, curādau `saṃgrāma yuddhe' iti paṭhyate, sa na pāṭhyaḥ; saṃgrāmaśabdād yuddhavācinaḥ `tat karoti tadācaṣṭe' ityeva ṇicaḥ siddhatvāt| paṭhyamānastu jñāpayati----sopasargātsaṅghātāddhātusaṃjñānimittakapratyaye vidhitsite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante, pariśiṣṭādeva tu pratyaya iti| saṃgrāmaśabdo hi sopasargaḥ saṃghāta eva curādāvapi paṭhyate, na tūpasargasaddaśāvayavaṃ śabdāntaram| tathā ca `vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇavikalpo bhavati, anyathā sa na syāt| sa evamarthaḥ paṭhyate---asaṃgrāmayata śūraḥ, saṃgrāmayitvā, sisaṃgramayiṣata ityādi rūpaṃ yathā syāditi, tataścoktasyārthasya jñāpakaḥ| niyamārtho vā---dhātusaṃjñāhetuḥ pratyayaḥ sopasargādyadi bhavati saṃgrāmaśabdādeveti| nanu cātrānudāttedayaṃ saṃgrāmayatiriṣyate, tataścātmanepadārthamanubandhamāṃkṣyāmīti pāṭhaḥ syāditi kathaṃ jñāpako niyamārtho vā bhavet? syādetat---anubandhāsañjanārthe hi pāṭhe `grāma yuddhe' ityeva paṭhitavyam, saṃśabdastu dyotakaḥ prayogadarśanādeva labhyate iṅikorivādhiḥ, niyamārthastu saṃgrāmeti pāṭha iti| evamapi yathā iṅikoradheḥ pūrvamāṇ na bhavati, tathā'syāpi na syāt, tasmād dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate| yadyevam, yathā śyenāyata iti ācārārthasya kyaṅoktatvādāṅaḥ prayogo na bhavati tathā svadīnāmapi na syāt| tadviśiṣṭa evārthe kyaṅo vidhānād yuktameko pasargeṇa viśiṣṭārthe kyaṅutpadyata iti tasya tenābhidhānam, iha punaranekena| tatra---manāyata ityukte saṃdehaḥ syāt subhavatau durbhavatau veti? tatrāsaṃdehārthamupasargaḥ prayoktavyaḥ| ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ---manaḥ śabdātkyaṅi kṛte manāyata ityasya tiṅantasya svāderatiṅantāduttarasya nighātaḥ prāpnoti| pakṣāntare tu sumanāyata ityādi tiṅantaṃ saṃpadyate iti tadvyatiriktābhāvānnighātābhāvaḥ| evaṃ tarhi bhṛśādiṣūpasargasya parāṅgavabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi `subāmantrite' ityasyānantaraṃ bhṛśādiṣūpasarga iti| ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti---abhibhṛśāyate subhṛśāyata iti? yadi neṣyate `manasyupasarge' iti vakṣyāmi, manaḥ śabde parata upasargastasyaiva parasya manaḥ śabdasyāṅgavadbhavati svare karttavye iti| evaṃ ca devadattaḥ sumanāyata ityādau upasargasyāpi `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto bhavati| yo'pyāha---sumanaḥśabdātpratyaye vidhitsite upasargaḥ pṛthak kriyate, pariśiṣṭādeva pratyaya iti, tenāpi svare parāṅgavadbhāvo vaktvya eva| tadevaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ svādayaḥ, manaḥ śabdādeva kevalātpratyaya iti sthitam| yadi tu sāmānyena jñāpakamiṣyate saṅghātātpratyaye vidhitsite upasargāḥ pṛthak kriyante iti, nātraiva, yathā `prabhau parivṛḍhaḥ' ityatra vakṣyate----parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe iti ṇici katvāpratyaye kṛte parivṛḍhayyeti lyab bhavatīti, tato jñāpakāntaraṃ mṛgyam| ca kiṃcidudgranthābhidhānaṃ sūribhirityuparamyate||
lohitādiḍhānbhyaḥ ksaṣ|| 3.1.13 ||
lohitādiḍājabhyaḥ ksaṣ|| paṭapaṭāyatīti| avyaktānukaraṇāditi ḍāci vivakṣite `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve bhavataḥ' iti dvirvacanam, tato ḍāp, paṭatpaṭā iti sthite `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti paṭacchabdasya yastakāre yaśca paraḥ pakārastayoḥ pararūpaṃ pakāraḥ, lohitaḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣvacanaṃ bhṛśādiṣvitarāṇi' iti vārttikam, tadetatpaṭhitābhiprāyaṃ na punaranenādigrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyāyata ityāha---yāni paṭhyante iti| nidrākaruṇākṛpāśabdā vṛttiviṣaye tadvati varttante, anidro nidrāvān bhavati, akaruṇaḥ karuṇāvān bhavati, akṛpaḥ kṛpāvān bhavatītyatrārthe pratyayaḥ| ūparipaṭhitebhyastu kyaṣeva bhavatītyasyopapādanam| ākṛtigaṇaścāyamiti| kuta ityata āha---tathā ceti| kva punaḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ kakāraḥ? kyacvyośceti| `āpatyasya' iti varttate, na cāyamāpatyādiṣyate| iha tarhi `kyasya vibhāṣā'? `halaḥ' iti vartate, na cāyaṃ halantādiṣyate| iha tarhi `kyācchandasi' ? etadyācchandasīti vaktavyam----bhuraṇyusturaṇyuriti, kaṇḍvādiyagantādapi yathā syāditi| `vā kyaṣaḥ' ityetadvā yādityevāstu| na caivam `pāśādibhyo yaḥ' pāśyā, atra prasaṅgaḥ? sāmānyavihitānāntiṅāṃ niyamārtha prakaraṇam| na ca pāśādiyātparasmaipadamātmanepadaṃ vā prāptamasti| athāpyācārakvibantātsambhaved? evamapi `vā yaṣaḥ' ityevāstu tatrāha--naḥ kye iti| kakāramanubandhamāsañjataḥ sūtrakārasyāpyākṛtigaṇatvamabhipretamityāha---na hīti| bhāṣye tvādigrahaṇapratyākhyānaparameva vārttikaṃ vyākhyātam| kakāro'pi pratyākhyātaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ paṭapaṭāyatāti kyaṣyoge ḍāj bhavati, yāvatā kṛbhvastiyoge sa vidhīyate? tatrāha---kṛbhvastibhirivetyādi| bhavatyarthe kyaṣ vidhīyate, sa bhavatiprayoge na bhavati, tenaivoktatvāttasyārthasya| ato bhavateraprayoga eva kyaṣā bhavitavyam| yadi ca kyaṣā yogo ḍājca na syāḍḍājantāt kyaṣvidhānamanupapannaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| atha kimartham `vā kyaṣa'iti sūtramārabhyate, na kyaṣ ceti cakāro'tra kartavyaḥ, lohitādibhyaḥ kyaṣ bhavati cakārāt kyaṅ ca, tatra kyaṅpakṣe ātmanepadam, kyaṣpakṣe parasmaipadamiti siddhamiṣṭam? aho sūkṣmadarśī devānāṃpriyaḥ, yadidamapi na ddaṣṭam---`kyaṅmāninośca' iti| iha tarhi `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti lohinīśabdādapyayaṃ kyaṣ bhavati, sati caivaṃ kyaṅantādātmanepadaṃ kyaṣantātparasmaipadamiti vijñāyamāne ātmanepadapakṣe `kyaṅmāninośca' iti puṃvadbhāve sati alohinī lohinī bhavati lohitāyata iti prāpnoti, adya punaḥ kyaṣantādātmanepade vikalpite lohinīyate lohinīyatītīṣṭaṃ siddhyatīti spaṣṭa eva phalabhedaḥ||
kaṣṭāya kramaṇe|| 3.1.14 ||
kaṣṭāya kramaṇe|| caturthīsamarthāditi| saṅgatārthaḥ---samarthaḥ, `caturthyā samartha' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| pratyayārthena kramaṇena saha saṅgatārthatvaṃ yasya caturthīkṛtaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| etacca `kaṣṭāya' iti nirdeśādeva labhyate| kramaṇaśabdasya pādaviharaṇe prasiddhatvāttatraiva pratyayo mā vijñāyītyāha---kramaṇe'rthe'nārjava iti| anārjavaṃ kauṭilyam, iha tvanārjavaśabdo'nākaraṇarūpe kramaṇe paryavasyatyarthāt| kiṃ punaḥ kramaṇam? utsāhaḥ, yathā vyākaraṇādhyayanāya kramate utsahata ityartha iti vyākhyātam| kaṣṭāya karmaṇe kramata iti| `kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ' iti kṛcchra iḍabhāvaḥ, kṛcchram-duḥ kham| iha tu tatkāraṇaṃ pāpaṃ karma, kṛcchraṃ pāpaṃ karma kartumutsahata ityarthaḥ| `vṛttisarga' ityātmanepadam| prāyeṇa tu parasmaipadaṃ paṭhyate, tatra pāpaṃ karma kartukāmaḥ kuṭilamācaratītyarthaḥ anutsāhatvātparasmaipadam|
atyalpamidamucyata iti| sarvalakṣyāsaṃgrahāt| kathaṃ tarhi vaktavyamityāha---sattrakakṣetyādi| asminpakṣe dvidīyāntebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ; cikīrṣāṃ prati karmatvāt| kaṇvacikīrṣāyāmiti| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāyamarthanirdeśaḥ| kaṇvam-pāpam| sattrādayo hi vṛttiviṣaye pāpaparyāyāstebhyaścikīrṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ, pāpaṃ cikīrṣatītyasvapadena vigrahaḥ| ajaḥ kaṣṭaṃ krāmatīti| kramiratra pādaviharaṇe vartate, kaṣṭaṃ gahanadeśaṃ krāmati gacchatītyarthaḥ||
karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ|| 3.1.15 ||
karmaṇo romanthatapobhyāṃ varticaroḥ|| `karmaṇaḥ' iti pañcamī, romanthatapobhyāmityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| pratyekasambandhāttvekavacanam| varttīti| ṇyantād vṛteḥ `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' iti yuci prāpte'smādeva nipātanāt ktin| yujapi bhavati---vartanā | caraṇaṃ car, saṃpāditvādbhāve kvip| hanucalana iti| hanucalanasahacaritaṃ carvitasya mukhapradeśe ākṛṣya carvaṇaṃ tatretyarthaḥ| kīṭo romanthaṃ vartayatīti| avagīrṇamapādānapradeśānniḥ sṛtaṃ romanthākhyaṃ dravyaṃ vartayati- vṛttaṃ karoti, gulikāṃ karotītyarthaḥ| nātra hanucalanamasti| tapasaḥ parasmaipadaṃ ceti| evaṃ ca `namovarivaḥ' ādisūtre tapaḥ śabdaḥ paṭhitavyastathā tu na kṛtamityeva| iha `tapasyate lokaṃ jigīṣuragneḥ' iti `tapasyate lokaṃ jigīṣuragneḥ' iti chāndasatvādātmanepadam||
bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvamane|| 3.1.16 ||
śabdavairakalahābhrakaṇvameghebhyaḥ karaṇe|| 3.1.17 ||
sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām|| 3.1.18 ||
sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām|| vedanāyāmiti| `vida cetanākhyānanivāseṣu' ityasmāccurādiṇyantādbhāve `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' , `ghaṭṭivandividibhyaśca' ityaupasaṃkhyāniko vā| vedanāyāmarthe'nubhava iti| pratyakṣajñānam-anubhavaḥ| yadyapi vedanāśabdo jñānamātravacanastathāpi kartṛgrahaṇena sukhādīni viśeṣyante, kartṛgatānāṃ ca sukhādīnāṃ vedanā'nubhavarūpaiveti matvaivamuktam| kriyāpekṣaṃ kartṛtvaṃ vedanāsaṃnidhānāttadapekṣameva vijñāyate| kartrā ca sukhādīni viśeṣyante na vedanā; vyabhicārābhāvāt| sarvaiva hi vedanā vedayitureva bhavati, tadetadāha----vedayituścetkartuḥ sukhādīti bhavantīti| āśrayāśrayibhāvalakṣaṇaśca sambandhaḥ, na janyajanakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| evaṃ ca kartṛgrahaṇaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ pṛthakpadam| vedayata iti| `ā kusmādātmanepadī' ityadhikāre vediḥ paṭhitaḥ| evaṃ ca pratyudāharaṇe parasmaipadapāṭhaḥ pramādajaḥ| prasādhakaḥ - abhyaṅgādeḥ karttā, saṃprasādhyamānasya netravikārādinā sukhamanumānato jānāti||
namovarivaścitraṅaḥ kyac|| 3.1.19 ||
namovarivaścitraḍaḥ kyac|| karaṇaviśeṣe pūjādāviti| `karaṇe' iti sāmānyānuvṛttāvapyabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyādviśeṣa upalabhya iti bhāvaḥ| namasyati devāniti| `namaḥ svastisvāhā' iti caturthī na bhavati, pratyayārthe guṇībhūtasya namaḥ śabdasya niṣkṛṣya sambandhābhāvāt| atha vā---namasyati namaskāreṇa pūjayatītyarthaḥ| tatra `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti dvitīyeva bhavati| evaṃ ca namaskaroti devānityādāvapi dvitīyeva bhavati| paricaryāyāmiti| paricaryā- śuśrūṣā| citrīyate iti| avayavakṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavatīti kyajantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, `kyaci ca' itīttvam| etadarthameva ca śabdavairādisūtre citraśabdo na paṭhitaḥ| citrīyata iti| vismayata ityartha ityeke| vismāpayata ityartha ityanye| tathā ca bhaṭṭikāvye māyāmṛgaṃ prakṛtya bhavati `tataścitrīyamāṇo'sau' iti||
pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ|| 3.1.20 ||
pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ|| pucchādudasane paryasane veti| udasanam-utkṣepaṇam| paryasanam-paritaḥ kṣepaṇam| utpucchayata iti| nanu yathā''cāre kyaṅi vihite āṅaḥ prayogo na bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ? āṅ‌viśiṣṭasyaiva caratyarthasya kyaṅābhidhānāt, tadvadihāpyutkṣepaṇe ṇiṅo vidhānādudaḥ prayogo na prāpnotīti? astyatra viśeṣaḥ----paryasane'pyayaṃ vidhīyate| tatrodasanaṃ dyotayitumucchabdaḥ, paryasanaṃ dyotayituṃ pariśabdaśca prayoktavyaḥ| samācayanam-rāśīkaraṇam, arjanam- dravyalābhopāyaḥ, yācñādi| ṅakāra ātmanepadārtha iti| tenottarasūtre pucchādayo na śakyāḥ paṭhitumiti bhāvaḥ||
maṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇavratavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic|| 3.1.21 ||
maṇḍamiśraślakṣṇalavaṇavratavastrahalakalakṛtatūstebhyo ṇic|| kimarthamidam, na prātipadikāddhātvartha ityeva siddham; na ca tatkarotītyādinā tatra dhātvarthaniyamaḥ kriyate, rājānamatikrāntavānatyararājadityapi darśanāt? muṇḍaṃ karoti māṇavaka mityādau' sāpekṣebhyo'pi ṇij yathā syādityevamartha prapañcārtha vā| halikalyostvadantatvanipātanārtham, anyathā hali i kali i iti sthite `aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, `ṇāviṣṭhavat' iti ṭilopaśca; tatra lopaḥ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityaḥ, vṛddhistu ṭilope kṛte'prāptevaityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaikārasya lopastannāglopyaṅgaṃ bhavatīti `sanvallaghuni' iti sanvadbhāvaḥ syāt, `dīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghaśca, atvanipātane tu yadyapi paratvād vṛddhistathāpyageva lupyate iti sanvadbhāvo na bhavati, tadāha---halikalyoradantatvanipātanaṃ sanvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthamiti| upalakṣaṇametat, `dīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghābhāvārtha ca| `dīrgho laghoḥ' ityatrāpyanaglopa iti varttate| evaṃ ca balipaṭuprabhṛtibhyo ṇici abivalat, apīpaṭaditi bhavati, na tvababalat apapaṭaditi| `satyāpapāśa' ityatra muṇḍādayaḥ paṭhitavyāstathā tu na kṛtamityeva||
dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ|| 3.1.22 ||
dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ|| `halādeḥ' iti viśeṣaṇādekāca iti bahuvrīhiḥ| kriyāsamabhihāre varttata iti| samabhihriyamāṇāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ hi varttata ityartaḥ| anena samabhihārasya prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayati| kriyā hi dhātuvācyā| samabhihāraviśiṣṭāpi kriyaiva bhavati, ataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣaṇatvameva yuktam, yathā atiśayena śuklo'pi śukla evetyatiśayānaṃ prakṛtyarthastadvat| tasmādyaṅpratyayo bhavatīti| kva? anirdiṣṭāryāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti tatraiva| samabhihāre dyotye prakṛtyarthasamabhihriyamāṇatvadyotanāyetyarthaḥ, yathā prakṛtyarthasyātiśayadyotanāya tarabādayastadvat| iha biprakīrṇānaṃ mūrttānāmekakālānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇaṃ samudāyabhāvāpattirmukhyaḥ samabhihāraḥ, yathā---pūlādīnām| dhātuvācyā tu kriyaikaiva| yadyapi `divu krīḍāvijigīṣāvyavahāradyutistutikāntigatiṣu' ityanekārthe diviḥ paṭhyate, tathāpi na yugapadanekārthamācaṣṭe, kiṃ tarhi? prayogabhedena| yadyapi cāśrayabhedādviṣayabhedācca bhidyate pākaḥ----anya eva hi devadattakartṛkaḥ pākaḥ, anya eva cānyakartṛkaḥ, anyaścaudanasya pāko'nya eva tailādīnām; tathāpi dhātunā nivṛttabhedaiva sā pratyāyyate| ata eva bhavadbhirāsyata ityādau bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati| na khalu kartṛbhedaḥ kartṛ-bhedaḥ kriyāvyaktibhedena vyāptaḥ, ekaphalāvacchinnāmekāmeva kriyāṃ kurvatsvapi bahuṣu pacantīti darśanāt| tadevaṃ dhātuvācyā samūharūpā pradhānakriyaikaiveti samabhihārābhāvaḥ| adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu guṇakriyāṇāṃ yugapadekadhātuvācyatve'pi kramajanyatvādutpannāpavargitvena yugapadavasthānābhāvādamūrttatvācca kadhātuvācyatve'pi kramajanyatvādutpannāpavargitvena yugapadavasthānābhāvādamūrttatvācca samabhihārābhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ mukhyasya samabhihārasya dhātvarthaviṣaye'sambhavād gauṇo gṛhyate, taddarśayati, taddarśayati---paunaḥ punyaṃ bhṛśārtho veti| dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntarairavyapetānāṃ samabhihāro bhavati, tathā kriyāṇāmapi kriyāntarairavyapetānāmetadubhayaṃ bhavati| tatra pradhānakriyāṇāṃ paunaḥ yunyaṃ samabhihāraḥ, punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyamānaviṣayaṃ hi tat| pradhānakriyaiva ca punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyate| avayavakriyāṇāṃ tu bhṛśārthatā samabhihāraḥ, buddhigocarānekasakalāvayavakriyāviṣayā hi sā| pāpacyata iti| `dīrgho'kitaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| dedīpyata iti| `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' yaṅaiva samabhihārasya dyotitatvāt| `kriyāsamabhihāre dve bhavataḥ ' iti vā `nityavīpsayoḥ' iti vā dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| dhātoriti kimiti| anyasya kriyāsamabhihāre vṛt‌tyasaṃbhavātpraśnaḥ| bhṛśaṃ prāṭatīti| atra dhātūpasargasamudāyasya viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvāttato yaṅsyāt, tataścopasargasya dvirvacanaṃ syāt| yadi sopasargasaṃghātasyaiva kriyāsamabhihāre vṛttiḥ, prapāpacyata ityādau yaṅ na prāpnoti ? yo'tra dhātuḥ sa na kriyāsamabhihāre, yaśca kriyāsamabhihāre na sa dhāturiti| tasmādvātureva samabhihāraviśiṣṭakriyāvācī, upasargastu sannidhimātreṇopakārakaḥ| tataśca saṃghātātprāptyabhāvānnārtho dhātugrahaṇena| yatra tarhi saṃghātenaiva viśiṣṭā kriyocyate----prateṣṭhīyata iti, atra hi kevalastiṣṭhatirgatinivṛttivacanaḥ prapūrveṇa tu saṃghātena gatikriyaivocyate, yathā---jaṅgamyata iti? atrāpyanekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ tiṣṭhatireva gatau tannivṛttau ca varttate, upasargastu sannidhimātreṇopakāraka iti dhātorutpattiraviruddhā, tasmādārdhadhātukasaṃjñārthameva dhātugrahaṇam| tena `bruvo vaciḥ' ityādi bhavati| ānuṣaṅgikī tvathātunivṛttiḥ|
atha kathaṃ yaṅantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati? kathaṃ ca na syāt? ṅito dhātorātbhanepadamucyate, yaścātra dhāturna sa ṅit, na hyayaṃ samudāyasyānubandhaḥ| yaśca ṅitpratyayo nāsau dhātuḥ| yatra cāvayave kṛtaṃ liṅgamacaritārtha tatra samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, ayaṃ ṅakārastu bebhidyata ityādau guṇaniṣedhādau caritārthaḥ? kaścidāha---kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅityakāro'tra praśliṣyate, sa cānudātto'nunāsikaḥ pratijñāyate,tatrānudāttatvamavayave'caritārtha samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' ityetacca na bhavati `jucaṅkramyadandramya' ityatra caṅkramyadandramyagrahaṇālliṅgaditi, sa vaktavyaḥ| atha kathaṃ ṛteroyaṅantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati, so'pi hi ṅakāro guṇanivṛttau caritārtha iti? sa ced brūyāttasyāpyādita ikāra īkāre vā anudāttaḥ praśliṣyata iti, pratibrūyādenam---ikāre numprasajyeta, īkare `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' niṣṭhāyām' itīṇ‌niṣedhaḥ syāditi? naiṣa doṣaḥ; numvidhau `gauḥ pādānte' ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartate, tenānte ikāra itsañjñako yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ num| `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' ityatrāpyekāca iti vartate? satyama; prativihitamāyuṣmatā, mudhā punarayaṃ prayāsaḥ, tathā hi---`anudāttaṅitaḥ' ityatra na dhātugrahaṇamasti, tataḥ kima? idaṃ tato bhavati---pratyayameva ṅitamāśrityātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| na caivamaśiśriyad avocadityādau caṅaṅbhyāmapi prasaṅgaḥ; prāgeva vikaraṇebhyaḥ `anudāttaṅitaḥ' ityetatprakaraṇaṃ pravarttate; anyathā `vartate' ityādau vikaraṇavyavadhānānniyamo na syāt| yathā ca prāgeva vikaraṇebhyo niyamaḥ pravarttate, pravṛtte tu niyame vikaraṇa iti tathā tatraiva pratipāditamityalamiyatā|
sūcisūtrītyādi| sūcyādibhyo yaṅ vaktavyaḥ, kimartham? sūcyādīnāmanekājartham, aśādīnāmahalādyartham, ūrṇotestvanekājarthamahalādyarthaṃ ca| sosūcyata iti| `sūca paiśunye', sūtra avamocane', mūtra prasravaṇe' curādiṇyantāḥ| atra ṇilopo'pi yaṅa ārdhadhātukatve prayojanam| aṭāṭyate| `aṭa paṭa gatau', `ajāderdvitīyasya'iti ṭyaśabdasya dvirvacanam| aśaryate iti| `ṛ gatau' `guṇo'ttisaṃyogādyoḥ' `yaṅi ca' iti guṇaḥ, ` na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' ityatra `yadā raparasya pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanādrephasya dvirvacanam| aśāśyate iti| aśnoteraśeśca grahaṇamityāgamaḥ| prorṇonūyate iti| `ūrṇuñ ācchādane' nopadho'yam, āṣṭamikaṃ tu ṇatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānnuśabdasya dvirvacanam| nanu `pūrvatrāsiddhayimadvirvacane? syādetat----āṣṭamikaṃ tu dvirvacanamabhipretya taducyate, yathā caujaḍhadityatra ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāddhata ityetad dvirucyate iti? tanna; evaṃ hi ṣupibhūto dvirucyata iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ vyāhanyeta| evaṃ tarhi pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacana ityetadanityam, `ubhau sābhyāsasya' iti liṅgāt; anyathā `aniteḥ' iti ṇatve kṛte tasya siddhatvāṇṇiśabdasya dvirvacane sati siddhaṃ syātprāṇiṇiṣatīti| iha kasmānna bhavati---lunīhi lunīhityevāyaṃ lunātīti? bhavatyeva| lolūyata iti loṭ tarhi na prapnoti yaṅā bādhitatvāt, antaraṅgo yaṅ kriyāsamabhihāramātrāpekṣatvāt; loṭ tu bahiraṅgaḥ, kriyābhedāśraye dhātusambandhe bhāvakarmakartṛṣu ca vidhānāt| sāvakāśaśca loṭ, ko'vakāśaḥ? anekājahalādiśca---jāgṛhi jāgṛhītyevāyaṃ jāgartti, īkṣasvekṣasvetyevāyamīkṣata iti| evaṃ tarhi vetyanuvṛtteḥ pakṣe paṅ, yadā na yaṅ tadā loḍ bhaviṣyati| yaṅo'kāro'ṭāṭyate ityādau dvirvacanārthaḥ||
nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau|| 3.1.23 ||
nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau|| `dhātoḥ' iti vartte, gatāviti tasya viśeṣaṇam, gatau varttamānāddhātoriti| kauṭilye iti| saṃnidhānād gativiṣayameva kauṭilyaṃ gamyate| cakramyate, dandramyata iti `kramu pādavikṣepe', drama mīmṛ gatau, `nugatā'nunāsikāntasya', yo'lpīyasyadhvani gatāgatānikaroti sa kuṭilāṃ gati sampādayannevamucyate|
nityagrahaṇamanarthakam, anabhidhānādeva vākyaṃ na bhaviṣyati, na hi caṃkramyata iti vṛtterartha kuṭilaṃ kramātīti vākyaṃ śaknoti gamayitum; saṃśayo hi vākyādbhavati----kiṃ gatikauṭilyam? uta vakrahṛdayatvanibandhanaṃ jihvācaraṇamiti? vṛttau tu gatikoṭilyameva niyataṃ gamyate, kauṭilyamātrapratipādane ca vākyaṃ nivārayitumaśakyamaniṣṭaṃ cāta āha---nityagrahaṇaṃ viṣayaniyamārthamiti| gatikauṭilyaṃ viṣayaḥ, tatraiva yaṅ yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ, tadāha---gativacanānnityaṃ kauṭilya eva bhavatīti| vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati---na tu kriyāsamabhihāra iti| nanu yathā `vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' ityapatyeprāptastato'pakṛṣya vidhīyate, yathā vā `ñītaḥ kta' bhūte prāptastato'pakṛṣya varttamāne vidhīyate, evamatrāpi dhātumātrātkriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ vihitaḥ, gativacanāt tu kauṭilya iti? takrakauḍinyanyāyenaiva bādhaḥ siddhaḥ| yathā vā vivakṣitārthānabhidhānādvākyaṃ na bhavati tathā samabhihārānavagamādtra pratyayo na bhaviṣyati| athaivamapi vacanāpekṣā? vākyanivṛttāvapi vacanamapekṣasva! tadetannityagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam||
lupasadacarajapajabhadahadaśagṛbhyo bhāvagarhāyām|| 3.1.24 ||
lupasadacarajapajabhadahadaśagṛbhyo bhāvagarhāyām|| luplṛ cchedane', `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu'| `āṅaḥ sadiḥ padyarthe' ityasya tu corādikaṇijantasya ekāca ityasyānuvṛtteragrahaṇam| `cara gatyarthaḥ',`japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci',`jabhī jṛbhī gātravināme',`daha bhasmīkaraṇe', `danśa daśane'| anunāsikalopanirdeśo yaṅlukyapyanunāsikalopārtha---dandaśītīti| `gṛ nigaraṇe' tudādiḥ, `gṛ śabde' kryādiḥ, tatrākārāntavikaraṇena sāhacaryādādyasya grahaṇamityeke| dvayorapītyapare| dhātvarthagarhāyāmiti| bhāvaśabdo dhātvarthe varttata iti darśayati| garhitamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam, tena bhāvagarhā'tra gamyate| garhitatvaṃ tu chedanasya, niṣiddhatṛṇādiviṣayatvāt, `loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ' iti evamuttaratrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ garhitatvaṃ bhedena draṣṭavyam| cañcūryate iti| `caraphalośca' iti nuk, `utparasyātaḥ', `hali ca' iti dīrghaḥ| jañjapyate ityādau `japajabhadahadaśabhañjapaśāṃ ca' iti nuk| nijegilyata iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ', raparatvam, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya guṇaḥ, jegir‌ya iti sthite `gro yaṅi' iti latvaṃ ca prāpnoti, `hali ca' iti dīrghaśca, tatra dīrghasyāsiddhatvāllatve kṛte vihatanimittatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ| anye tu `na mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgenāsiddhatvaṃ bādhitvā dīrghe kṛte latvāmicchanti, nātrāptavākyamasti|
garhāyāmiti kimiti| bhāvasyetyeva taddharmaviśeṣo lapsyate iti praśnaḥ| dharmaviśeṣānupādāne praśaṃsāyāmapi syādityāha---sādhu japatīti| japati vṛṣalo mantramiti| atra svaravarṇādibhreṣābhāvādbhāvagarhā nāsti| vaidikamantrajapaṃ prati śūdrasyānadhikārāttu sādhanabhāve garhitaḥ, yasya khalvīddaśī gatiḥ----`śūdrasya vedamupaśrṛṇvatastrapujatubhyāṃ śrotrapratipūraṇam, uccāraṇe jihvācchedaḥ dhāraṇe śarīrabhedaḥ' iti nāsau japitumarhati| nityagrahaṇamityādi| pūrvavadetadvyākhyeyam||
satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavamavarṇacūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic|| 3.1.25 ||
satyāpapāśarūpavīṇātūlaślokasenālomatvacavamavarṇacūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic|| styāpetyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| satyamācaṣṭa iti| nanu bhāṣye satyasya kṛñyāpuk, satyaśabdātkṛñi karotyarthe ṇijbhavati āpukca, satyaṃ karoti satyāpayatītyuktam? satyam; kṛñ‌grahaṇamanārṣam, pradarśanārtho vā karotirdraṣṭavya iti manyate|
āpugvaktavya iti| āpugvacanasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na bhavati| kvacittu vṛttāvevāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭhyate| atha kathaṃ punaḥ śabdāpayediti? chandovaddaṣayaḥ kurvanti| etena prakṣālāpayediti gṛhyaprayogo vyākhyātaḥ| pāśādvimocane iti| prāyiko'yamarthanirdeśaḥ, anyatrāpi bhavati; anyathā vipāśatīti viśabdasya prayogo na syāt, viśabdaviśiṣṭasyaiva mocanasya ṇyarthatvāt, yathācārakyacyāṅaḥ prayogo na bhavati| evamupavīṇayadītyādāvapi draṣṭavyam| tūlam-tṛṇāgraṃ tenānukṛṣṇāti anughaṭṭayatītyarthaḥ| anugṛhaṇātīti tu pāṭheṃ na samīcīno'rthaḥ| abhiṣeṇayatīti| `upasargāt sunoti' ityādinā ṣatvam| akārāntastvacaśabda iti| `tvaca saṃvaraṇe' ityasmāddhātoḥ `puṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti ghaḥ| avaghvaṃsayatīti| vikiratītyarthaḥ| `prātipadikāddhātvarthe' ityeva siddhe satyasyāpugvidhānārtha vacanamanyeṣāṃ prapañcārtham| bhālinyo hyupaślokayantītyādau sāpekṣebhyo yathā syādityevamartha vā| kathaṃ punarvimocanādirartho'nirdiṣṭo labhyata ityata āha---svābhāvikatvāditi| pratyayārtho nirdiśyata iti| sūtrakāreṇānirdiṣṭo'pi pratyayārtho vyākhyākārairnirdiśyata ityarthaḥ||
hetumati ca|| 3.1.26 ||
hetumati ca|| loke phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārtho heturityucyate, tasya grahaṇe adhyayanena vasatītyatrāpi prasajyeta, hetumadgrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, katham? `karaṇe' iti varttate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ hatumatīti, karaṇaṃ kriyā, sarvaiva ca kriyā hetumatoti kiṃ viśeṣaṇopādānena ! nanu śabdopātte hetau yathachā syādityevamarthametatsyādyathā `samastṛtīyāyuktāt' ityatra śrayamāṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmātmanepadaṃ yathā syāttadarthayogamātre mā bhūdityevamartha tṛtīyāyuktagrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhyasati virodhe kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti `tatprayojako hetuśca' iti yasya saṃjñā vihitā tasyaiva pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇamiti matvā''ha---hetuḥ svatantrasya karttuḥ prayojaka iti| tadīyo vyāpāra iti| pravarttanā| tasyāstvavāntarabhedamāha----preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādilakṣaṇa iti| bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya pravarttanā-preṣaṇam, ājñetyarthaḥ| gurvāderārādhyasya pravarttanā- aghyeṣaṇam, prārthanetyarthaḥ| ādiśabdena tatsthamarthācaraṇaṃ gṛhyate, tacca bahudhā bhidyate---anumatiḥ, upadeśaḥ, anugraha iti| tatra yasyānumatimantareṇārtho na nirvarttate tasya rājāderanumatyā prayojakatvam, vaidyādestu `mustāparpaṭakaṃ pibejjvaritaḥ' ityādyupadeśena pravarttakatvam, yaḥ punaḥ kenacijjighāṃsitaṃ palāyamānaṃ niruṇaddhi, niruṇaddhiśca hanyate, tatra niroddhā hanturanugrahaṃ karotītyanugraheṇa tasya pravarttakatvam| sarvaścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ prakaraṇādigamyaḥ| sarvatrānugataṃ pravarttamānameva tu ṇijarthaḥ| nanu yathā pitṛmānityukte yaṃ prati pitṛtvaṃ sa eva gamyate tathātrāpi yaṃ prati hetutvaṃ sa eva hetumāniti yuktam, kañca prati hetutvam? `tatprayojakam' iti vacanātkarttāraṃ pratīti prāptaṃ `kārake' ityadhikārātkriyāpekṣatvācca kārakabhāvasya yasminvyāpāre prayojakarūpeṇopayujyate tameva prati, sa ca prayojyavyāpāro'dhiśrayaṇādiḥ sarvasādhanasādhyo viklityādirveti tayoreva hetumattvaṃ yuktam, na punaḥ prayojakavyāpārasya| na hi tatrāsau prayojakarūpeṇopayujyate, kiṃ tarhi? kartṛrūpeṇa, yathā kāṣṭhasya pākāpekṣaṃ karaṇatvaṃ na tu jvalanāpekṣam, tadapekṣaṃ tu kartṛtvameva? ucyate---ṇicaḥ prakṛtibhūtena dhātunaivābhidhīyate so'rthastena phalābhāvāttatra ṇijna bhaviṣyati| nanu pacatītyukte na jñāyate----kiṃ svayameva pacati? utānyena pravarttitaḥ? ityato'nyena pravarttitasyeyaṃ pravṛttiriti dyotanāya ṇij bhavatu? evaṃ tarhi hetoriti vaktavyam, `karaṇe' ityeva, hetoḥ karaṇe vyāpāre abhidheye ṇij bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā tu na kṛtam| kā gatiridānīṃ sūtrasya? abhidhānasvābhāvyamatra hetuḥ, svabhāvato hi ṇic pratyayaḥ prayojakavyāpāramācaṣṭe| tena pākādyapekṣayā yo labdhahetuvyapadeśaḥ sa hetutvenopalakṣito yasyāstītyevaṃ prayojakavyāpāra eva matupocyate| atra dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ----hetumatīti prakṛtyarthanirddeśaḥ----hetumati yo dhāturvartata iti, pratyayārtho vā---hetumati karaṇe'bhidheye ṇij bhavatīti|
nanu pacati pācayatīti ca vyaktamarthāntaraṃ gamyate, tatkathamasya prakṛtyarthatvaṃ śaṅkyate? ucyate---iha hi kaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ? yāsau taṇḍulānāṃ viklittiḥ, adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu tādarthyāttadavacchedena pacyarthatā| yo hi pānārthamudakamāharati, vikrayārtha ca kāṣṭhānyāharati, śītaṃ cāpanetumagniṃ samindhe nāsau pacatītyucyate, tatkasya hetoḥ? viklitti prati tādarthyābhāvāt tadavacchedābhāvācca| atastādarthyādevādhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ pacyarthatā, tadvatprayojakavyāpāro'pi tādarthyādeva pacyādivācyo bhaviṣyati| ṇicpratyayastu dyotakaḥ, tathā ca yo'pyekānte tūṣṇīmāsīno bhaktabījabalīvarddaiḥ pratividhatte, sa ucyate----pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatīti| tadevaṃ pakṣadvayasambhave yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato yathā prakṛtyabhihite ṇij bhavati, evamuktapreṣitādiśabdābhirite'pi syād--uktaḥ karoti, preṣatitaḥ karotīti, hetumadviṣayatvātkarotyarthasya, pratyayārthapakṣe tūktārthatvāṇṇijabhāvaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prayojakavyāpārasya dyotanāya ṇijvidhīyate tasya svaśabdena dyotitatvād dyotyābhāvānna bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadattena dvayoḥ kartrorlenābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, dhātuvācyavyāpāre hi kartari lo bhavati pacinā ca prayojakavyāpāro'pyabhidhīyate, pratyayastu dyotaka iti dhātuvācyavyāpāratvasāmyāt kartrorapi sāmyamiti dvayorapyabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti---pācayato devadattayajñadattāviti| pratyayārthapakṣe tu prakṛtyarthopasarjanasya ṇyarthasya prādhānyāttasyaiva karttari lakāraḥ| iha ca gamito grāmaṃ devadatto yajñadatteneti prayojakavyāpārasyāpi gamivācyatvādavyatirikto gatyartha iti kṛtvā gatyarthānāṃ karttari ktaḥ prāpnoti, prayojyasya tu karmatvāttatraiveṣyate| uktaṃ hi `ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ' iti| iha ca vyaticchedayante, vyatibhedayante---avyatirikto hisārtha iti kṛtvā prayojakavyāpāravyatihāravivakṣāyāmapi `na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti|
tadevamādye pakṣe doṣadarśanād dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---tasminnabhidheya iti| kiṃ cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdārthāvasāyaḥ| na ca pacati paṭhati gacchatītyādāvantareṇa ṇicaṃ kvacidapi prayojakavyāpāro'vasīyate, utpanne tu ṇici pratīyate, atastadarthatvameva yuktam| pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatītyatra tvanekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ kṛṣireva pratividhāne'pi varttata iti yuktam, na punastaddarśanena sarvatra prakṛtyarthatvam| nanvatrāpi pakṣe pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadattenetyatra ṇyarthasya prādhānyāttena vyāpyamānasya prayojyasya karmasañjñā prāpnoti? gatibuddhipratyavasānārtheti niyamānna bhivaṣyati| iha tarhi grāmaṃ gamayati, grāmāya gamayatīti vyatirikto gatyartha iti kṛtvā `gatyarthakarmaṇi' iti dvitīyācaturthyau na prāpnutaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; grāmo'tra gamereva karma, grāmakarmakaṃ gamanaṃ kurviti praiṣārthaḥ| iha tarhi edho dakasyopaskārayatīti vyatiriktaḥ karotyarthe iti `kṛñaḥ pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, suṭ tu karotidhātumātrāśrayatvāṇṇijutpattāvapi tasya rūpasya bhāvātsiddhyati? atrāpyedhodakakarmake karotyarthe prayujyate iti ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi abhiṣāvayatīti vyatiriktaḥ sunotyartha iti `upasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti? athātrāpyabhiṣavaṃ kurvityupasargaviśiṣṭe prakṛtyarthe prayuktiriti siddhaṃ ṣatvam, yadā tu ṇyattainaivopasargasya saṃbandhastadā ṣatvaṃ bhavati na veti cintyam| iha tarhi bhedikā devadattasya yajñadattasya kāṣṭhānāmiti prayojye karttari kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, apradhānatvāt? tṛtīyāvadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---pācayatyodanaṃ devadatto yajñadatteneti prayojye karttaryañadhāne'pi tṛtīyā bhavati vyāptestathā ṣaṣṭhyapi bhaviṣyati| atheha kathaṃ ṇij bhavati----bhikṣā vāsayanti, kārīṣognidhyāpayatīti? kathaṃ ca na syāt? acetanatvāt, cetanāvata etadbhāvati---preṣaṇam, adhyeṣaṇamiti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nāvaśyaṃ sa eva vāsaṃ prayājayati ya āha---uṣyatāmiti, yo'pi tūṣṇīmāsīnastatsamarthamā carati so'pi vāsaṃ prayuṅkte, bhikṣāśca pracurāśca vyañjanavatyaśca labhyamānā vāsaṃ prayuñjate| tathā kārīṣo'gnirnirvāta ekānte suprajvalitaḥ śītakṛtamadhyayanavirodhinamupadravamapanayan adhyayane'nukūlo bhavati| tatra yathā--anumatirupadeśo'nugrahaḥ----ityeteṣu ṇij bhavati tathā'trāpi bhaviṣyati| yadyapyanumatyādiṣu prayojyavyāpāracoddeśena pravṛttiḥ, iha tu na tathā; tathāpyanukūlācaraṇameva prayojakavyāpāratvenādhyāropyate| iha kaścitkañcidāha---pṛcchatu māṃ bhavān, anuyuktāṃ māṃ bhavāniti, tatra praṣṭā prayojyastasya prerakaḥ prayojaka iti tadvyāpāre ṇij prāpnoti, ekaviṣayatvacca ṇico loḍādīnāṃ ca paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, karttuḥ prayojako heturityuktam, prayojyaścātra na karttā| na hyasau samprati pṛcchati tūṣṇīmāste tasya nirvyāpāratvāt kārakatvameva nāsti kutastadviśeṣaḥ kartṛtvam? karttṛtvameva hi tasya vidhīyate praśnakriyāyāṃ karttā bhaveti, yathā----rājā bhava yudhyasveti rājatvameva vidhīyate tatra tadevaṃ prayojyo'karteti prayojako'pi na hetuḥ, kimidānīṃ pūrvameva karttuḥ sataḥ prayojako hetuḥ! yadyevam, vyarthā prayuktiḥ| athāpyuparatiśaṅkayā kacitprayukterarthavattvaṃ tathāpi yatrāpravṛtto balādinā pravarttyate tatra ṇij na prāpnoti? na brūmaḥ----pravṛttipravarttana eva ṇijiti, kintu pravartattito'pi prayojyo yatra pravarttata eva, na tu nivarttate tatra ṇij bhavati| anuvarttamānā prayuktiḥ prayojyapravṛttau hetuḥ, na madhye vicchinnā| ataḥ prayojyapravṛ-ttivelāyāmapi buddhau viparivarttamānā saiva pravṛttihetustasyāmeva ca daśāyāṃ ṇijvācyo bhavati| tadevaṃ prayojyapravṛttyupahitaprayuktirṇijarthaḥ, kevalā tu loḍartha iti vivekaḥ| uktaṃ ca----
dravyamātrasya tu praiṣe pṛcchyāderloḍ vidhīyate|
sakriyasya yadā praiṣestadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ|| iti||
kiśca---prayoktṛdharmaḥ prayuktirloḍarthaḥ aniyatakartṛkātu prayuktirṇijarthaḥ|
tatkarotītyupasaṃkhyānamiti| taditi karmaparametat, tena dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ karotītyatra prakṛtyarthamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ na pratyayārthaḥ, tena ṇyantādbhāvakarmaṇorbhūtabhaviṣyatorddhitvabahutvayośca lo bhavati| sūtraṃ karoti sūtrayatīti| iha vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karotīti vākye dravyarūpaṃ sūtraṃ sūtraśabdenocyate, tatra vyapadeśivadbhāvena vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭho, vṛttau tu vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayatīti pratyayārthabhūtakarotyarthābhidhāyī sūtraśabdaḥ sampadyate| uktaṃ hi`parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiḥ' iti| tena sattvabhāvo nivṛtta iti sūtravyākaraṇayorabhisambandho nivarttate| asti ca vyākaraṇasya karotinā sāmarthyamiti dvitīyā bhavati| yadi tu vyākaraṇaṃ sūtraṃ karotīti vākye eva sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadā māṇavakaṃ muṇḍayatītivad vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayatītyayatnasiddham| `sūtra avamocane'`mūtra prasravaṇe' iti curādau pāṭhādeva sūtrayatīti sidhyati| anekārthatvāccārthāntare'pi bhaviṣyati| gaṇapāṭhasiddha eva tvartha upasaṃkhyānenāpi pradarśitaḥ|
ākhyānāditi vākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe----ākhyānātkṛdantāditi| ākhyāyata ityākhyānam, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karmaṇi tluṭ| yatkiñcidākhyāyate tatsarvaṃ rājāgamanādikamapyākhyānamihābhipretam,na kaṃsavadhanalocapākhyānādikameva saṃjñā bhūtam| kṛdantāditi kṛdgrahaṇena gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇamiti kaṃsavadharājāgamanasūryodgamanāderari kṛdantatvam| prakṛtipratyāpattiriti| kṛto yā prakṛtiḥ sā vikāraparityāgena svenaiva rūpeṇāvatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| prakṛtivacca kārakamiti| yattatra kṛdante saṃnihitaṃ kārakaṃ tatprakṛtivadbhavati| kṛtprakṛteḥ śuddhe ṇici yāddaśaṃ bhavati tāddaśamasyāpi ṇyantasya bhavatītyarthaḥ| kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti hanteḥ `hanaśca vadhaḥ' ityap pratyayo vadhādeśaśca| hananam-vadhaḥ , kaṃsasya vadha iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ, tato ṇic, kṛto luk, prakṛteḥ pratyāpattirvadhādeśaparityāgena hantirūpeṇāvasthānam| yadyapyatra sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābhāvādubhayorapyabhāva ityeva vadhādeśanivṛttiḥ siddhyati; tathāpi puṣyeṇa yogaṃ jānāti, puṣyeṇa yojayatītyatra kutvasyāsanniyoga śiṣṭatvāttannivṛttirna siddhyatīti prakṛtipratyāpattavicanam| atha kathaṃ kaṃsamaghātayat, rājānamajīgamat, yāvatā kaṃsavadharājāgamanaśabdābhyāṃ ṇici vihite'ṅgasaṃjñā nāmadhātutvaṃ ca tayoreva syātām, tataścāḍdvirvacane api tayoreva syātām? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `prakṛtivacca kārakam'ityuktam| kṛtprakṛteśca śuddhe ṇici vihite kaṃsādikārakaṃ kīddaśaṃ bhavati? dhātāvanantarbhūtaṃ dvitīyādyantam, tenātrāpi tāddaśenaiva rūpeṇa bhavitavyam| tena rājānamāgamayatītyatra nalopābhāvo'pyupapanno bhavati| evamapi kaṃsaṃ ghātayatītyatra `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam, `hanasto ciṇṇaloḥ' iti tatvaṃ ca na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam? dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kārya vijñāyate| evaṃ tarhi prakṛtivacca kārakamiti cakārobhinnakramaḥ kārakamityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, kāryaśabdaścādhyāhāryaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati----kṛtprakṛtirhantyādiḥ, tasyāḥ śuddhe ṇici yāddaśaṃ rūpaṃ bhavati tathā'syāpi ṇyantasya bhavati, kāryaṃ ca tadvadeva bhavatīti | etenāḍdvirvacane api vyākhyāte| balibandhamiti| bandhanam-bandhaḥ, pūrvavatkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| rājāgamanamiti| atra kartari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| rājānamāgamayatīti| atra kṛtprakṛtau rājā kartā, tasya gameḥ śuddhe ṇici `gatibuddhi'ityādinā karmasaṃjñā bhavatītyasminnapyaupasaṃkhyānike ṇici tathaiva karmasaṃjñā bhavati| iha tu devadatta pākamācaṣṭe iti ṇici vihite devadattena pācayatīti bhavati| na hi devadattasya śuddhe ṇici karmasaṃjñā'sti; gatyarthādīnāmeveti niyamāt| iha tu mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭe mṛgān ramayatīti yadā pratipādyasya darśanārthamākhyānaṃ tadā ṇijiṣyate, nānyadā| tatra yadā'raṇyastho ramamaṇānmṛgānpratipādyamācaṣṭe----eta sminnavakāśe evaṃ mṛgā ramanta iti, tadā tasya pratipādyadarśanārthā pravṛttiriti ṇij bhavati| yadā tu grāme mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭe tadā tatra mṛgāṇāmasambhavānna taddarśanārthā pravṛttiriti mṛgaramaṇamācaṣṭa iti vākyakeva bhavati| etacca mṛgaramaṇādiviṣayameva, rājāgamanādau tvanyadāpi bhavati|
āṅlepa iti| atrākhyānāditi na sa sambaddhyate, maryādāyāṃ ya ākārastasya lopo bhavati| kṛllugityādi pūrvavat| ārātrivivāsa iti| vivasanam-vivāsaḥ, atikramaṇam, rātrervivāso rātrivivāsaḥ, karttari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ, tataḥ `āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| yāvadrātreratikramaṇaṃ tāvatkathāḥ kathayatītyarthaḥ| vaserakarmakatvād `gatibuddhi' ityādinā rātreḥ karmasaṃjñā hetumaṇṇici bhavati, tadvadasminnapi ṇici bhavati---rātri vivāsayatīti|
citrīkaraṇe prāpīti| tadityeva| citrīkaraṇam-āścaryakaraṇam| prāpi-prāpnotyarthe citrīkaraṇe gamyamāne tatprāpnotītyasminnarthe ṇic bhavati, kṛllugityādi pūrvavat| sambhāvayate iti `bhū prāptāvātmanepadī', ujjayityā māhiṣmatī vidūre deśa iti tāvato deśasya prāgudayādatikramaṇamāścaryam| sūryamudgamayatīti|
`prakṛtivacca kārakam' iti sūryaśabdasya pṛthakkaraṇam| saṃgrāmayatereva sopasargāditi nyāyāducchabdasyāpi pṛthakkaraṇam| atrāpi sūryasya hetumaṇṇici karmatvādasminnapi ṇici karmatvam|
nakṣatrayoge jñīti| tadityeva| jñi jānātyarthenakṣatrayoge yatkṛdantaṃ varttate tasmāttajjānātītyasminnarthe ṇij bhavati, kṛllugityādi pūrvavat| puṣyayogamiti| puṣyeṇa candramaso yogaḥ puṣyayogaḥ, puṣyeṇeti kartari tṛtīyā, `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti niyamāt ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| candramasa iti| niyamena gamyamānatvādubhayaprāptiḥ, puṣyo hi candramasaṃ yunanakti-sambadhnāti, tatra yujergatyādiṣvanantarbhāvādaṇau karttuḥ puṣyasya suddhe ṇici kartṛtvamevetyasminnapi ṇici kartṛtvāttṛtīyā bhavati| puṣyeṇa yojayatīti| lakārastu pradhāna eva karttari bavati, yathā śuddhe ṇici| tattarhīdaṃ bahu vaktavyam? vaktavyam, iha tāvatsūryamud‌gamayatīti yo yasya pravarttyaḥ sa tasyābhiprāyaṃ nirvarttayati| gantuścāyamabhiprāyaḥ---māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamanaṃ sambhāvayeyamiti, taṃ ca sūryo nirvarttayati, enadeva pravarttyasya pravarttyatvaṃ yaduta pravarttayiturabhiprāyasampādanam| na hi kaścitparo'nugṛhītavya iti pravarttante sarva ime svabhūtyartham| ye tāvadete gurūn śuśrūṣante, te'pīha---prīto gururadhyāpayiṣyati paratra cābhyudeṣyābha iti pravarttante| dāsāścāpi---bhaktaṃ ca lapsyāmahe, paribhāṣāśca na no bhaviṣyantīti pravarddhante| `yaḥ saninda upālambhastatra syātparibhāṣaṇam'| śilpino'pi---mitrāṇi ca no bhaviṣyanti vetanaṃ ca lapsyāmaha iti pravarttante| yadyapyatra sarvatra tattaduddeśena pravṛttiḥ, sūrye tu naḥ tathāpyabhiprāyasaṃpattimātreṇa prayojyaprayojakabhāvādhyāropeṇa ṇij bhaviṣyati| iha ca kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti----ye tāvadete kaṃsadhātānukāriṇāṃ naṭānāṃ vyākhyānopādhyāyāste kaṃsānukāriṇaṃ naṭaṃ sāmājikaiḥ kaṃsabuddhya gṛhītaṃ tāddaśenaiva vāsudevena ghātayanti, ye'pi citraṃ vyācakṣate---ayaṃ mathurāprāsādaḥ, ayaṃ kaṃsaḥ ayaṃ bhagavānvāsudevaḥ praviṣṭaḥ, etāḥ kasaṃkarṣiṇyo rajjavaḥ, ete ud‌gūrṇā nipātitāśca prahārāḥ, ayaṃ hataḥ kaṃsaḥ ayamākṛṣṭa iti, te'pi citragataṃ kaṃsaṃ tāddaśenaiva vāsudevena ghātayanti, citre'pi hi tad‌buddhireva paśyatām| etena citralekhalā vyākhyātāḥ| ye'pi granthaṃ vācayantaḥ kaṃsavadhamācakṣate kāthikā nāma, te'pyutpattiprabhṛtyā vināśātkaṃsādīn varṇayanti, te'pi varṇyamānāḥ śrotṛṇāṃ buddhisthāḥ pratyakṣavadbhavanti| cittamapi teṣāṃ tadātmakamiva bhavati, ata eva vyāśritāśca bhavanti|nānāpakṣasamāśrayaḥ-vyāśrayaḥ| kecitkaṃsabhaktāḥ, kecidvāsudevaktāḥ| varṇānyatvaṃ khalvapi puṣyanti---kecidraktamukhāḥ kecitkālamukhāḥ| traikālyamapi loke lakṣyate, kathāyāṃ vācyamānāyāṃ hi vaktāro bhavanti---gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ, gaccha ghāniṣyate kaṃsaḥ, kiṃ gatena---hataḥ kaṃsaḥ! iti| tadevaṃ kāthako'pi buddhisthena vāsudevena ghātayati, śrotāpi||
śabdopahitarūpām̐śca buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān|
pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhanatvena manyate||
evaṃ rājānamāgamayatītyādāvapi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam||
kaṇḍvādibhyo yak|| 3.1.27 ||
kaṇḍavādibhyo yak|| yadīme kaṇḍvādayo dhātava eva syustato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate vā? na vā? anuvṛttau yagabhāvapakṣe laḍādiṣu satsu kaṇḍavatītyādyaniṣṭaṃ prasajyet, kaṇḍūrityādi ca na syāt; dhāto- subabhāvāt| kvibantātsupsambhave'pi kaṇḍūriti na vedanāmātraṃ gamyate; kartari kvipo vidhānāt? saṃpadāditvādbhāve kvib‌bhaviṣyati| evamipa kaṇḍvau kaṇ‍ḍvaḥ, `aciśnudhātu' ityuvaṅ prāpnoti, kaṇḍvā, kaṇḍve `noṅdhātvoḥ' iti vibhakterudāttaniṣedhaḥ syāt, mantuvalgurityatra ca tuk prasaṅgaḥ? atha nānuvarttate, kaṇḍūriti na sidhyati, yagantātsampadāditvādbhāve kvipyallopayalopayoḥ kṛtayorbhaviṣyati? na caivamallopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ `kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat' iti vacanāt| nanu ca kvau vidhi prati sa pratiṣedhaḥ, anyathā lavamācakṣāṇo laurityatra kvau luptasya ṇeḥ sthānivattvābhāve'pi sthānivattvābhāve'pi ṇau kṛtasya ṭilopasya sthānivattvādūṭh na syāt, ato'tra sthānivattve satyuvaṅ syādeva? chastu `cchvoḥ śūṅ' ityūṭh kariṣyate| na coṭhyapi kartavye sthānivattvam; tasyakvau vidhitvād ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvācca, ata evoṭhi kṛte punaruvaṅo'prasaṅgaḥ| evamapi kaṇḍvau, kaṇḍvaḥ, kaṇḍve---dhātuvidhiḥ prāpnoti, manturvalguriti ca na siddhyati, yaki dīrghe kṛte mantūrvalgūriti syāt| atha prātipadikānyeva? tatrāpi vāgrahaṇānanuvṛttau sa eva doṣo yo dhātupakṣe| anuvarttatāṃ tarhi vāgrahaṇam, santu ca prātipadikānyeva, tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-----kakāro nānubandhavyo bhavati anārddhadhātukatvādeva guṇo na bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi sukhyati, duḥkhyati, magadhyatītyato lopo na syād; anārdhadhātukatvādeva| na ca vyañjanānta eva śakyaḥ paṭhitum, yagabhāvapakṣe'pi tathā prayogaprasaṅgadata ubhaye kaṇḍvādaya ityāha----dvividhāḥ kaṇḍvādaya iti| dhātubhya eva pratyayo vidhīyata iti| nityamiti bhāvaḥ| tena pakṣe kaṇḍavatītyādi na bhavati| na tu prātipadikebhya iti| tena kaṇḍvau, kaṇḍvaḥ, manturityādiprayogasiddhiḥ| na cāsminnapi pakṣe yagantātsampadādikvibvidhīyate tadā pūrvoktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam? ddaśigrahaṇādetebhyaḥ kvib syād, na caitebhya idānīṃ kvib ddaśyate| pūrvatra tu pakṣe kaṇḍūrityādisiddhyarthameva kvib draṣṭavyaḥ|
kathaṃ punarjñāyate---ubhaye kaṇḍvādaya iti? taccalokena darśayati----ghātuprakaraṇāditi| anuvṛttena dhātugrahaṇena viśeṣaṇātkakārāsañjanācca dhātutvameṣābhimatamiti vijñāyata ityarthaḥ| yatastu khalvayamācāryaḥ kvaciddīrghamuccārayati---kaṇḍūñ hṛṇīñ mahīṅiti, tato manye---dhāturvibhāṣita iti| dhātutvameṣāṃ vibhāṣitamiti manya ityarthaḥ|
atha kaṇḍvādīnārthanirdeśaḥ| kaṇḍūñ gātravikarṣaṇe| mantu aparādhe| hṛṇīṅ roṣe| valgu pūjāmādhuryayoḥ| asmanas upatāpe| mahīṅ vṛddhipūjanayoḥ| leṭa
loṭ dhaurtye pūrvabhāve svapne| irasa iraj irañ īrṣyāyām| dravas paricaraṇe. medhā āśugrahaṇe| kuṣubha kṣepe| magadha pariveṣṭane| tantas pampas duḥkhe| sukha duḥ kha tatkriyāyām| sapara pūjāyām| arara ārākarmaṇi| bhiṣaj cikitsāyām| bhiṣṇajupasevāyām| iṣudha śaradhāraṇe| caraṇa bhuraṇa gatau| curaṇa caurye ca| turaṇa tvarāyām| bhuraṇa dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ| gad‌gada vāk‌ssvalane| elā kelā khelā vilāse| liṭ alpārthe kutsāyāṃ ca| loṭ dīptau||
gupūdhūpavicchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ|| 3.1.28 ||
gūpūdhūpavicchipaṇipanibhya āyaḥ|| vicchāyatīti| vicchirayaṃ tudādau paṭhyate, tatsāmarthyādāyapratyayāntādapi śavikaraṇo bhavati, na tu śap, yathā---jugupsate ityātmanepadam, tena vicchāyantī vicchāyatīti `ācchīnadyornum' iti numvikalpo bhavati| anye tu sārvadhātuke'pyāyapratyayasyaiva tudādipāṭhasāmarthyena vikalpamāhuḥ| stutyartheneti| bhaṭṭikāvye tu vyavahārārthādapyāyaḥ---`na capolebhe vaṇijāṃ paṇāyān' iti| anubandhaḥ kevale'caritārtha iti| avayaveṣvacaritārtha liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yathā---gupādīnāmanudāttatvamiti bhāvaḥ| ye tu vyavahārārthādapyāyamicchanti teṣāmapi paṇiṣyate pāṇayiṣyatītyādāvanubandhaḥ kevale caritārthaḥ||
ṛterīyaṅ|| 3.1.29 ||
ṛterīyaṅ|| sautra iti| asminneva sūtre uccarita ityarthaḥ| ghṛṇāyāṃ varttata iti| nātra kṛpāyāṃ ghṛṇāśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? jugupsāyāsa; `ghṛṇā jugupsākṛpayoḥ' iti vacanāt| jugupsā-nindā, bībhatsetyarthaḥ| ṛtīyāśabdo bībhatsāparyāyo nighaṇṭuṣu paṭhitaḥ| atha kasmādīyaṅucyate na chaṅevocyate, tasya īyādeśe kṛte ṛtīyata iti siddham, paratvādiḍāgame kṛte satyapratyayāditvādīyādeśoca na syāditi cet? na; antaṅgatvāt, āyannadiṣūpadeśivadvacanaṃ svarasiddhyarthamiti vacanādantaraṅgatvam| jñāpanārtha tu, etajjñāpayati---dhātupratyayānāmayannādayo na bhavantīti, tena `kaṇeṣṭhaḥ' ityatrekādeśo na bhavati| kvacittu vṛttāvevaṃ paṭhyate---`ṛteśchaṅ' ityeva siddhe īyaṅvacanaṃ jñāpak---dhātuvihitānāmāyannādayo na bhavantīti| atra brūmaḥ---`dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarapchasunau' ityeva siddhe īyasunvacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ prātipadikapratyayānāmāyannādayo na bhavantīti| ucyante cāyannādayaste vacanādubhayeṣāmapi syuḥ, tasmāddateśchaṅityādi vṛttau na paṭhanīyamiti||
kamerṇiṅ|| 3.1.30 ||
kamerṇiṅ|| iha ṇiṅo ṇakāraḥ `ṇeraniṭi' iti viśeṣaṇe caritārtho ṅakāro'pyātmanepadārtha ityubhayoścaritārthayoḥ prāpnoti, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `na kamyamicamām' iti kamermitsaṃjñāyāṃ pratiśedhaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati---bhavatyatra vṛddhiriti, tasya hi prayojanam---`mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvo mā bhūditi yadi cātra vṛddhirna syād hrasva evopadheti kṛtvā nitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'narthakassyāt| naitadasti jñāpakam, yadā ṇiṅantāddhetumaṇṇic kriyate tadā ṇiṅantasya ṇici yā vṛddhistasyā hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthametatsyāt, na ca ṇijapekṣāyā api vṛddherṇiṅameva ṅitamapekṣya pratiṣedhaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ṅitīti nimittasaptamī| nanu ca na ṇiṅantasya ṇici vṛddhyā bhavitavyam; ṇiṅā vyavahitatvāt, ṇilope kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva| yadā tarhi ṇiḍantācciṇṇamulau savatastadā `ciṇṇamulodīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityeva vidhirmā bhūdityevamartho mitsaṃjñāprātiṣedhaḥ syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam? tatra `dīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityucyate na prakṛto hrasva eva vikalpyeta, evaṃ hi kamermitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho na rtavyo bhavati| katham? yadā ṇiṅi vṛddhirnāsti tahā hrasva evopadheti satyapi hrasvavikalpe naivāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ, aśami aśāmītyādi ca siddham? naivaṃ śakyam; yadā śamiprabhṛtibhyo ṇijantebhyo dvitīyo ṇic kriyate tadā na syāt| yaśca ṇamulparo ṇij dvitīyaḥ, na tasmin prathamena ṇicā vyavahitatvāt| yasmiśca midaṅgaṃ prathame ṇici, nāsau ciṇṇamulparaḥ, dvitīyena vyavahitatvāt| ṇilope'pi kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva| `dīrgho'nyatarasyām' ityucyamāne punaratrāpi bhavati, dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhāt| tathā śamiprabhṛtibhyo yaṅantebhyo ṇicyallopayalopayorallāpasya sthānivadbhāvādasatyāṃ vṛddhau ciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayoraśaṃśami, asaṃśāmi, śaṃśamam, śaṃśāmamiti na syāt| dīrghaḥ punarvikalpyamāno'trāpi bhavati; tadvidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāt| tathā `heḍṛ anādare' ghaṭādiḥ, `eca igghrasvādeśe', hiḍyati, tatra ciṇṇamuloḥ kṛtayorhrasve vikalpyamāne ahiḍi, aheḍīti syāt; dīrghe tu punarahiḍi, ahīḍīti bhavati| tasmāddīrgha eva vikalpanīyaḥ, tataśca mitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi tannivṛttaye vaktavyaḥ| tathā `āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā' iti ṇiṅabhāve ṇici sati vṛddhau kṛtāyām `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvo mā bhūdityevamartho'pi sitsaṃjñāpratiṣedho vaktavya evetyajñāpakametat| evaṃ tarhyasthāne'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate, naivātra pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam? iglakṣaṇayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na caiṣā iglaṅaṇā vṛddhirityalamati karkaśaprakriyātarkānusaraṇena||
āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā|| 3.1.31 ||
āyādaya ārddhadhātuke vā|| `ārddhadhātuke' iti parasaptamyāmāyādividhibhirekavākyatā syāt, bhinnavākyatāyāmayamartho bhavati----gupādibhya ārddhadhātuke parato vā''yapratyayo bhavati, evamuttaratrāpi, tataścārddhadhātuke eva vikalpenāyādayaḥ syuḥ, sārvadhātuke naiva syuḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, pṛthāgārambhādyadi hyārddhadhātuka evāyādīnāmutpattiḥ syāttato gupādibhiḥ saṃyujyaiva nirdiśet---gupādibhya ārddhadhātuke veti, evaṃ hi āyādaya iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| pṛthakataṃ nirdiśati, tena manyāmahe---vyāpārabhedenaikavākyateti| tataścāyamartho bhavati---gupādibhyo nityamāyādayo bhavantyārddhadhātuke veti| evamapi gupāderyadārddhadhātukaṃ prāptaṃ tatra tato vihite vikaraṇavikalpe nāyādayaḥ syu; tataśca strībhāvavivakṣāyaṃ guperapratyayāntatvābhāvāt ktini kṛte yadāyapratyayo na bhavati tadā guptiriti kāmamiṣṭaṃ siddhyati| yadā tu bhavati tadā'llopayalopayorgopātirityaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti, gopāyeti ceṣṭaṃ na siddhyati| bhinnavākyatāyāmāyādyantādyadārddhadhātukaṃ praptaṃ tatra tato vihite āyādayo vā bhavantītyarthaḥ syāt| tatra cāyādyāntādyadārddhadhātukamiti vadatā teṣāmutpattistāvadaṅgīkṛtā| na cotpannānāmutpattivikalpaḥ śakyate kartumiti lokanyāyena nivṛttivikalpo bhavati| tataścāyapratyayāntāt strībhāvavivakṣāyāmapratyayādityakāre kṛte nivṛttyabhāvapakṣe gopāyeti kāmamiṣṭaṃ siddhyati| nivṛttipakṣe tu gopetyaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti, guptiriti ceṣṭaṃ na siddhyati| liṭi ca nivṛttyabhāvapakṣe gopāyāñcakāreti kāmamiṣṭaṃ siddhyati, nivṛttipakṣe tu yadi liṭi parato nivṛttistathāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena kāspratyayādityāmā bhavitavyam, athāpyāmi kṛte nivṛttistathāpi tasyaiva śravaṇaṃ prāpnotīti sarvathā gopāṃcakāretyaniṣṭaṃ prāpnotīti, jugopeti ceṣṭaṃ na siddhyati| tasmād duṣṭa evāyaṃ parasaptamīpakṣa iti matvāha---ārddhadhātuke viṣaya iti| ko'rthaḥ? ityāha---ārddhadhātukavivakṣāyāmiti| ārdhadhātukamihotpādayiṣyāmīti buddhau satyāmityarthaḥ| viṣayasaptamīpakṣe'pi bhinnavākyatāyāmārddhadhātuke vidhitsite āyādayo bhavantītyukte, kuto vidhitsite? ityapekṣāyāmāyādyantasyāpi dhātutvāttata iti gamyate tataśca nivṛttipakṣa evāśrita iti sa eva doṣo yaṃ pūrvamavocāma| tasmādekavākyatayotpattivikalpa ityāha---nityapratyayaprasaṅge tadutpattirārddhadhātukaviṣeye vikalpyata iti| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha--tatreti||
sanādyantā dhātavaḥ|| 3.1.32 ||
