sanādyantā dhātavaḥ|| sanādayo'nte yeṣāmiti| antaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ, vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ| atha vā---vṛttāvarthamātraṃ darśitam, sūtre tvavayavavācino'ntaśabdasya samānādhikaraṇasyaiva bahuvrīhiḥ| sanādayo'ntāvayavā yeṣāṃ samudāyānāmityanena tad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiriti darśayati| dhātusaṃjñā iti| dhātuśabdo'tra svarūpapadārthaḥ, na bhūvādipadārthakaḥ; tāvatīnāṃ saṃjñānāṃ vidhāne prayojanābhāvāt| `suptiṅantam' ityatrāntagrahaṇajñāpitā saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravartata iti, tataścāsatyantagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna syādityatrāntagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| evaṃ sthite yadyapūrva evānena tadantavidhiḥ kriyate, tato devadattaścikīrṣatītyatra devadattādeḥ samudāyasya saṃjñā prasajyeteti matvāha----pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣaivetyādi| apūrvavidhau gauravam, pratiprasave tu yatnasya lāghavaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `bhūvādayaḥ' ityasyānantaraṃ sanādyāntāścetyucyamāne sanādīnāmiyattāparicchedo na syāt| evaṃ tarhi `saṅantāśca' ityucyatām, saṅiti pratyāhāraḥ sanaḥ saśabdārabhyā ṇiṅo ṅakārāt| evamapi sandehassyāt, caṅādiṣvapi ṅakārasya bhāvāt| evaṃ tarhi `sanādyantāḥ' ityasyānantaram `bhūvādayaśca' iti vaktavyam| syādetat----evamucyamāne sanādyantaśabdavad bhūvādiśabdo'pi prakṛtāpekṣaḥ syāttataścānukrāntānāṃ gupādīnāmeva syāditi? evamapi bhūvādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ gupādayaśceti vaktavyam| nānarthakam; bhuvo vādayo bhūvādaya ityevamarthameva syād| bhūvādipāṭha idānīṃ kimarthaḥ syād ? antargaṇakāryārthaḥ, anubandhāsañjanārthaśca| yeṣāṃ tarhi tadubhayaṃ na saṃbhavati bhūraṇiprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ? alamatinirbandhena||
syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ|| 3.1.33 ||
syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ|| iha yadyapi `lṛ' ityanukaraṇamuccāritamekameva, tathāpi tasya pratipādyabhūtamanukārthaṃ bhidyate---lṛṭ, lṛṅ iti| yatra ca pratipādyānāṃ saṃkhyāṃsāmyaṃ tatra saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ, na tūcvāritarūpasāmye; anyathā parasmaipadānāmityekaṃ ṇalādayastu naveti vaiṣamyānta syāt| tathā ḍāraurasaḥ prathamasyetyatrāpi na syāt| tadevam `lṛ' ityasya dve pratipādye, luṭiti cāparamiti trīṇi nimittāni, nimittinau tu dvāviti vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnotītyatrāha----lṛrūpamutsṛṣṭānubandha sāmānyamekameveti| nātra pratipādyaṃ bhidyate yattadubhayānugatamutsṛṣṭānubandham `lṛ' iti sāmānyarūpaṃ tadanukriyate| etacca lṛluṭoriti dvivacana nirdeśādavasīyate, tatrayathānukaraṇe na bhedastathānukārye'pītyarthaḥ| kariṣyatīti| `ṛddhanoḥ sye' itīṭ| śvaḥ kartteti| `śvaḥ' ityasyopanyāsastṛjantaśaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ| iditkaraṇamiti| itsaṃjñakasyekārasya karaṇamityarthaḥ| anunāsikalopapratiṣedhārthamiti| anyathā mantās ā iti sthite ṭilope kṛte nakāra upadhetyātmanepade ṅiti parataḥ `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ prāpnoti, tasya `aniditām' itīdittvanibandhanaḥ pratiṣedho yathā syādityarthaḥ| mantā, saṅganteti| ko'rthaḥ? mantetyetatpadaṃ saṅgantaṃ bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ, na tu saṅgantetyetadudāharaṇam; anopadhatvāt| anusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayorapi tayorasiddhatvādanopadha eva|
anye tvāhuḥ----yadyasiddhatvātsaṅgantetyetadanudāharaṇam, mantetyetadapi udāharaṇaṃ na bhavati, atrāpi ṭilopasyābhīyasyāsiddhatvād mantās ā iti sthite nakāra upadhā na bhavatīti|
yadi matam----ā bhācchāstrīyamasiddhatvamanityam, `śnasorallopaḥ' iti taparakaraṇāt? taddhyāstāmāsannityādau mā bhūdityevamartham, tatrāṭo'siddhatvādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena taparatvena! tajjñāpayati----asiddhatvamanityamiti| tena debhaturdebhurityatra `śranthigranthidambhisvañjinām' iti liṭaḥ kittvānnalope tasyāsiddhatvābhāvādettvābhyāsalopau bhavataḥ, tadatra ṭilopasyāsiddhatvānmanta ā iti sthite upadhaiva nakāra ityudāharaṇamiti| yadyevam, pūrvatrāsiddhīyamasiddhatvamapyanityam `na mu ne' ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt, tathā caikādeśasvaro'ntaraṅgaḥ siddho bhavati, sijlopa ekādeśe siddho bhavati, niṣṭhādeśaḥ ṣatvādiṣu siddho bhavati, dvirvacanaviṣaye ca pūrvatrāsiddhīyaṃ na bhavati, tataścānusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ siddhatvāt saṅgantetyetadapyudāharaṇameveti|
anye tu saṃhanteti paṭhanti, hanteḥ `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityātmanepadam, tatra sampūrvasya pāṭhe prayojanaṃ mṛgyam| evaṃ tāvajjayādityenāsiddhatvamanityamāśritya `tāseriditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratiṣedhārtham' ityuktam| vāmanastu ṭilopasya siddhatvādeva nalopo na bhaviṣyatīti manyamānaḥ `iditoo' ityatra vakṣyati---`tāsi sicoriditkārya nāstītyuccāraṇārtho niranunāsika ikāraḥ paṭhyate' iti| yadi tu tāserikāro'nubandhaḥ syāttato numvidhau dhātostāsermā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt, tataścadhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num bhavatītyayamartho na sādhitaḥ syāditi tasyābhiprāyaḥ| jayādityastu `numvidhāvupadeśivadvacanaṃ pratyayasidvyartham' iti vacanameva śaraṇamaśiśrayat|
iha vikaraṇāḥ kecana lakāropādānena vidhīyante, yathā-----syādayaḥ, te kiṃ lāvasthāyāmeva bhavanti ? utāho ādeśeṣu kṛteṣu? yadi lāvasthāyāmeva, tatastāsyanudāttedityatra yadvakṣyate----tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttavacanaṃ jñāpakam, satiśiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaro lasārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhata ityasyārthasyeti, tannopapadyate; lāvasthāyāmeva tāsau kṛte tasya ca pratyayādyudāttatve paścāllādeśeṣu kriyamāṇeṣu teṣāmeva svaraḥ satiśiṣṭo bhavati, tataścānudāttavacanamaprāptavidhireva syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ? cinutaḥ cinvantiḥ, cinvanti; krīṇītaḥ, krīṇanti, satiśiṣṭo vikaraṇasvara eva prāpnoti, dvitīye tu pakṣe pūrva tibādayaḥ paścāttāsiriti tasyaiva svaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ, tataśca nighātasvareṇaiva sārvadhātukānudāttatve siddhe tāsigrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamuktā rthasya jñāpakaṃ sampadyate| astu tarhi tathā| yadyevam, dhātumātrātsārvadhātukamātre bhāvakarmaṇoryak karttari tu śabvidhīyata iti yakśapāvutsargau teṣvevārtheṣu dhātumātrātsārvadhātukaviśeṣe syādaya iti te'pavādāḥ? tathā divāderdhātuviśeṣātkartari śyanādayaḥ śapo'pavādāḥ, tatra deviṣyati taniṣyatītyādāvubhayaprasaṅge'pavādavipratiṣedhāt śyanādayaḥ syuḥ? pakṣāntare tvantaraṅgāḥ syādaya eva siddhyanti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `divādibhyaḥ śyan' ityādiṣu syādayo'nuvartiṣyante---divādibhyaḥ śyan bhavati, lṛluṭostu syatāsī bhavato divādibhya iti| evaṃ sarvatra| etenaitadapi nirastaṃ yatkhalvidamāśaṃkyate----pareṇa lāvasthāyāṃ vidhīyamānāḥ syādayaḥ kimiti sārvadhātukotpattiṃ pratīkṣanta iti, katham? uttaratrānuvṛttereva, sārvadhātuke yagbhavati, bhāvakarmaṇorlṛ luṭostu syatāsī bhavataḥ sārvadhātuke| evaṃ sijādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam| tadevamādeśeṣu kṛteṣu syādaya iti sthitam||
sibbahulaṃ leṭi|| 3.1.34 ||
sibbahulaṃ leṭi|| joṣiṣanmandiṣaditi| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' `madi stutimodasvapnagatiṣu', anudāttau, vyatyayena parasmaipadam, sica iṭ `leṭo'ḍāṭau' iti tipo'ṭ, `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' itīkāralopaḥ, tatra ca veti vartate| tāriṣaditi| `tṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ',`sibbahulaṃ chandasi ṇidvaktavyaḥ' iti vacanādvṛddhiḥ, amīṣāṃ bhavitā bhāviṣaditi yathā| chāndaso vā dīrghaḥ| patātīti| `śala hula patlṛ gatau', leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityāṭ śapāsahaikādeśaḥ| cyāvayātīti| `cyuṅ pruh pluṅ gatau' ṇyantaḥ| ihāvayāsiṣīṣṭhā iti yāteravapūrvālliṅi bahulavacanāstip, thāsaḥ sīyuṭ, iṭ| `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' iti tu pratiṣedho na bhavati; sipā vyavadhānāt||
kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi|| 3.1.35 ||
kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi|| ām pratyayo bhavatīti| halantapakṣe etaduktam, adantapakṣe tvāmaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti vaktavyam| amantraviṣaya iti| mantraviṣayaścetprayogo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṛgyajuḥ sāmalakṣaṇo mantram, tatraivābhiyuktairmantraśabdasya prayogāt| ātharvaṇā api mantrā ṛgyajuṣa evāntarbhavanti| tāntrikeṣu mantraśabdaprayogo mantravadupacārāt| chandasīti noktam, brāhmaṇe'pi yathā syāt---atha ha śunaḥ śepa īkṣāṃcakre te ha tadantarvedyāsāñcakrire avijñātāni ca darśayāñcakāra| kāsāñcakra iti| āmantasya padatvam` āmaḥ' ityatropapāditam| nonāveti| nauteryaṅlugantātpratyayalakṣaṇena prāpta ām na bhavati| kārayanekāca iti vaktavyamiti| yathānyāse hi kaśabdādaśabdādvāgādibhyaścācārakvibantebhya ekājbhyo'pi pratyayāntatvādām‌prasaṅga, culumpādibhyaścāpratyayāntatvādaprasaṅgaḥ; ato'vyāptyativyāptipahihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamapanīyānekāj‌grahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatra kaśabdasya ṇali `aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhau `āta au ṇalaḥ' cakau, anyatra `ato lopaḥ' cakatuḥ, cakuḥ; aśabdasya ṇali rūpam---au iti, anyatra `ata ādeḥ' iti dīrdhatve `āto lopa iṭi ca'atuḥ, uḥ| cakāsāṃcakāreti| `cakāsṛdīptau'| daridrāñcakāreti| `āta au ṇalaḥ' ityatra okāre vidhātavye aukāravidhānaṃ daridrāterārddhadhātukalopa utyākāralope'pyaukārasya śravaṇārtham, tena dadaridrāvityapi bhavatītyāhuḥ| culumpāñcakāreti! culumpatirvārttikakāravacanātsādhuḥ|
āmo makārasya `halantyam' itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavatītyāha---āmo mittvamiti| kārayāścakāretyādau prayoge ya āmśabdastasyāmittvaṃ makāra itsaṃjñako yasya nāsti so'mit tasya bhāvaḥ amittvam| kuta ityāha? adantatvāditi| ad ante samīpe yasya so'dantaḥ, sūtre vidhānavelāyāṃ samīpe'kāravattvādityarthaḥ| tenaitanna codanīyam---ām cetkathamadantaḥ, athādantaḥ kathamāmiti| sūtre vidhīyamānasyaiva vā pratyayasyopalakṣaṇamāma iti| aguṇatvaṃ videstatheti| vidāñcakāretyatra viderāmi guṇābhāvo'pi tathā, adantatvādevetyarthaḥ| adantatvādityetatprasaṅgena cedamihoktam, `uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām' ityatra tu vaktavyam| tatra hi viderakārāntatvamāmpratyayasanniyogena nipātyate, tatrāto lopasya sthānivattvād guṇo na bhavati| na punaḥ `vida jñāne' ityakāro vivakṣita ityucyate; vettītyādau śravaṇaprasaṅgāt| abhyupetyāpi makārāntatvamitsaṃjñābhāvamāha---āskāsorāmvidhānācceti| āmo'mittvamityanuṣaṅgaḥ, sati hi mittve āskāsorām bhavannapyacāmantyātparaḥ syāt, tathā ca savarṇadīrghatve satyakiñcitkaraḥ syāt| ataḥ `dayāyāsaśca' kāspratyayāditi āskāsorāmvidhānādapyāma'mittvamavasīyate ityarthaḥ| āscakāsorvidhānācca ityanye paṭhanti, tadayuktam; na hi sūtre cakāsa āmvidhānamasti| yadapi kāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ tadapi culumpādau sāvakāśam| nanvadantatvapakṣe āmāmantra iti nirdeśyaṃ syāttatrāha---pararūpaṃ katantavaditi| yathā `sarvatra lohītādikatantebhyaḥ' ityatra pararūpam, evamatrāpi nipātanātpararūpamityuktaṃ bhavati||
ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ|| 3.1.36 ||
ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ|| ṛcchativarjita iti| ṛcchatinā tyaktaḥ tadrūparahita ityarthaḥ| ṛcchateranya iti yāvat| iyaja, uvapeti| yajivapyoruttame ṇali `ṇaluttamo dhā' iti ṇittvābhāvapakṣe vṛddhyabhāvād gurūpottamatvābhāvaḥ| atha thali pratyudāharaṇam---iyajitha, iyaṣṭha; uvapitha, uvaptheti| nanvatra sannipāta paribhāṣayaiva na bhaviṣyati, liṭsannipātajaṃ hi abhyāsamya saṃprasāraṇaṃ tadvighātakasyāmo nimittaṃ na bhavati, āmi hi sati lerlukā bhavitavyamiti liṭsannipātamasau vihanyāt? idaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇam---iyeṣeti, na hyatra liṭsannipātajamijāditvam| atha kriyamāṇe'pi gurumad‌grahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā guṇe kṛte gurumāneṣa bhavati? evamīṣaturityādāvapi savarṇadīrdhatve kṛte gurumāneva bhavati? satyam; sati garumad‌grahaṇe sannipātaparibhāṣayaivātrāpyām na bhavati, liḍānantaryahetukatvād gurumattāyāḥ| atha vā `gurunataḥ' iti nityayoge matup, nityaṃ yasya guruṇābhisambandhaḥ| yadyevam, `uchī vivāse' vyucchāñcakāra, `ucha uñche' ucchāñcakāra āgamanimittā cāsya gurumatā, tasmādām na prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamanṛccha ityāha, tajjñāpayati---bhavatyevañjātīyake āmiti| sa tarhi jñāpakārthamṛcchatipratiṣedho vaktavyo bhavati| nanu cacāmnivṛtyartha evāsau kartavyaḥ, nārtha āmnivṛttyarthena? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `ṛcchatyṛtām' iti liṭi parato guṇaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---nāsmādām bhavatīti| na ca tatrarchatītyartteśtipānirddeśaḥ; `ṛcchati ṛ ṛtām' ityarterapi svarūpeṇaiva praśleṣāt| praśleṣe bahuvacanamatra pramāṇam| arteśca liṭi guṇavi dhāne prayojanaṃ tatreva vakṣyāmaḥ| tasmāddacchaterguṇavidhānaṃ jñāpakameva| tasmādāmna bhavatīti sa eṣo'nṛccha iti pratiṣedho jñāpakārtha eva kartavyaḥ syāt| evaṃ hi liṭīti vihitaviśeṣaṇam----ijādergurumato yo liḍvihitastatreti| tena liḍ‌nimittā yasya gurumattā tasmācca na bhaviṣyati, āgamanimittā yasya gurumattā tasmācca bhaviṣyati| `anṛccha' iti pratiṣedhastu kriyatām, mā vā kāri| kvacittu gurumata iti kim, uboṣeti paṭhyate, tatra uvoṣetyudāharaṇamayuktam, `uṣavidajāgṛbyaḥ' iti vikalpavidhānamanavakāśaṃ syāt|
prorṇunāveti|`ajāderddhitīyasya' `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' iti nuśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ kāryāntarasiddhyartham, avaśyamūrṇoterṇuvadbhāvavo vācyaḥ, tenaivāmo'pi pratiṣedhaḥ siddha ityāha---atha vā vācya iti| tatra yaṅi bhāvātideśaḥ, āmiṭostvabhāvātidaśaḥ; nautestayorabhāvāt| uḍupagrahaḥ---iṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `vibhāṣā guṇe' iti pañcamī| phalasya cātra hetutvaṃ yathā---adhyayanena vasatīti| ekāca iti vartamāne `śryukaḥ kiti' iti ya iṭpratiṣedhaḥ tato'pi hetorṇuvadbhāvo vācya ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇāni---prorṇonūyate, prorṇunāva, prorṇutaḥ, prorṇutavāniti||
dayāyāsaśca|| 3.1.37 ||
dayāyāsaśca|| dayāyāsaḥ sarva'pyanudāttetaḥ| palāyāñcakre iti| `upasargasyā yatau' ityupasargasya latvam||
uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām|| 3.1.38 ||
uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām|| vida jñāne iti| sattāvicāraṇārthayostvātmanepadinorlābhārthasya cobhayapadino grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, parasmaipadibhyāmuṣijāgṛbhyāṃ jāgartinā''dādikena sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ| vivedeti| āmpratyayasanniyogenādantatvapratijñānādatra guṇo bhavatyeva| ata evāha---videradantatvapratijñānādāmi guṇo na bhavatīti||
bhīhrībhṛhuvāṃ śluvacca|| 3.1.39 ||
bhīhrībhṛhuvāṃ śluvacca|| śluvatkāryāpekṣayā sūtre ṣaṣṭhī, sanniyogariṣṭatvāccām, pratyayo'pi tebhya eva vijñāyate| dvitvettve iti| `ślau' iti dvirvacanam, `bhṛñāmit' itīttvam, tatra `ślau' iti vartate| `na lumatāṅgasya' iti guṇapratiṣedhastu na bhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam? `pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam' ityasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| śrūyamāṇatvādāmaḥ'||
kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi|| 3.1.40 ||
kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi|| anuprayujyata ityanuśabdaḥ paścādarthe| tatra kasya paścādityapekṣāyāmāmaḥ prakṛtatvāttasyaiveti vijñāyata ityāha---āmpratyayasyeti| yo'yamāmpratyayo vihitaḥ----karmadhārayo'yam, na tu bahuvrīhiḥ---āmpratyayo yasmātso'yamāmpratyayastasyeti| tathā hi satyāmpratyayavaditivādamaḥ pratyayasya prakṛtyupalakṣaṇatvāddhātorāmaśca madhye kṛñaḥ prayoga uktaḥ syāt| paścātkṛñanuprayujyata iti| paścācchabdasannidhāvanuśabdo'yamanuvādaḥ| liṭi parata iti| liṭi parataḥ sthito yaḥ kṛñ so'nuprayujyata ityarthaḥ| sūtre'pi liṭīti nānuprayogasya nimittanirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `parokṣe liṭ' ityanena vihite liṭi parabhūte yaḥ kṛñ so'nuprayujyata iti vacanavyaktiḥ| cakāretyādipadamanuprayujyata iti yāvat| kṛjiti pratyāhāreṇeti| `kṛbhvastiyoge' iti kṛśabdādārabhya' kṛño dvitīya' ityā kṛño ñakārātpratyāhāraḥ| atra ca pramāṇamāmpratyaya ityatra kṛñgrahaṇam| yadi hyatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāttadānyasyānuprayogasyābhāvādanartharka tatra kṛñ‌grahaṇaṃ syāt| ata eva viparyayo'pi na bhavati---tatra pratyāhāragrahaṇam, iha svarūpagrahaṇamiti; na hyatra svarūpamātrgagrahaṇe tatra kṛbhvastīnāmanṛprayogatvānuvāda upapadyate| tatsāmarthyāditi| pratyāhāragrahaṇamāmarthyetyarthaḥ| asterbhūbhāvo na bhavatīti| anyathā'sandehārtha `kṛbhvanuprayujyate liṭi' ityeva brūyāditi bhāvaḥ| tatra eṣi iṭi ca rūpe vipratipannā ubhayatra `ha eti----īkṣāmāha iti kecit| anye tu tāsimāhacaryādiṭyeva hatvamiti! apare tu sāhacaryādeva sārvadhātuka eveti hatvamityubhayatra īkṣāmāsa iti rūpamiti sthitāḥ|
ihāmantametadanabhivyaktapadārthakam, nāsmādbhāvakarmakartṛviśeṣaḥ puruṣaviśeṣaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣo vā gamyate, kevalaṃ pūrvāparībhūtānadyatanakālaṃ parokṣe sādhanādiviśeṣākāṅkṣaṃ kriyārūpamarthamāha| tatrāvaśyaṃ tadākāṅkṣanivṛttaye viśeṣavācipadamanuprayoktavyam, tasmādanuprayujyata ityaṃśo na vidhātavyaḥ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-----kṛbhvastīnāmeva yathā syāddhātvantarasya mā bhūt| kasya punaḥ prāpnoti? sāmānyavacanasyānuprayujyeta---kārayāṃ papāceti| viśeṣavacanasya vā, tatrāpi so'nuprayujyeta----uṣāmuvoṣa, vidāṃviveda, jāgarāñjajāgāreti| tatsamānārtho vā---uṣāndadāhe tītyādi| arthāntaravacano vā---uṣāmpapāceti| prathame pakṣe yāvadapekṣameva nānuprayuktaṃ syādadhiko'pyartho gamyeta pākādiviśeṣo nāma, dvitīyatṛtīyayostvanuprayogeṇaiva sakalārthāvagaterāsaprayogo vyarthaḥ syāt, caturthe tvarthāntaragata eva viśeṣo gamyeta, na tvāmavagataḥ, tadrataviśeṣābhidhānāya tvāmanuprayogavyasanam| ata eva pratyāhārāntarbhūtasyāpi sampadyateranuprayogo na bhavati, anyathā tasyāpi syāt| `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' ityato dhātvadhikārādvā dhātūpasargasamudāyasya na bhaviṣyati| evamapi yo'tra dhānuprayokṣyate| evaṃ hi sāmānyasya sannihite eva viśeṣe paryavasānāttadratasādhanādiviśeṣābhidhānamāmantargataviśeṣābhidhānameva saṃvarttate| tathā bhvastyoranuprayujyamānayorāmantavaśena sakarmakatvaṃ bhavati----`tasyātapatraṃ vibharāmbabhūve,' `ahaṃ kila vyapekṣāmāsa' iti, tadupapadyate, tena dvayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ| yadi tu sāmānyavacana eva prayujyeta; kriyāviśeṣo na gamyeta, āmantasyaivānabhivyaktiḥ| tasmātkṛñcetyayamapyaṃśo na vidheyaḥ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanaṃ liṭparasyaiva yathā syāt, pratyayāntaraparasya mā bhūt| kiṃparasya punaḥ prāpnoti? kṛtparasya| na kṛtparasyānuprayokṣyamāṇapuruṣaviśeṣābhivyaktiḥ| liṭi tu viruddhakālataiva lṛluṭorapi| liṅādiṣvapi vidhyādyarthāntarapratītiprasaṅgaḥ, luṅi bhūtamātraṃ gamyeta nānadyatanaviśeṣaḥ, laṭi na pārokṣyaṃ gamyeta|
nanu ca yathānuprayoge prakṛtivācyasya sāmānyasyāmantarvācye viśeṣe paryavasānam, evaṃ pratyayavācyasyāpyāmantarvācye'nadyatane parokṣe ca viśeṣe paryavasānādyujyata eva luṅo'nuprayogaḥ, tathā `haśaśvatorlaṅ ca' iti liḍartha eva laṅ vidhīyate, laṅantasyānuprayogaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayogo dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāścabhaviṣyati| ko'rthaḥ? yayā prakṛtyā prayogaḥ prārabhyate tayaiva samāpanīyaḥ, yathā---khādire badhnāti pālāśe baghnātīti yūpadravyavikalpe khādireṇa prayoge prārabdhe daivānmānuṣādvā kasmāccidaparādhātkhādirāpacāre mukhye palāśe labhyamāne'pi tatparityāgenālabhyamānasyāpi khādirasya pratinidhinā bādarādinā prayogaḥ parisamāpyate| evaṃ hi prārabdhaḥ prayogaḥ parisamāpito bhavati| dravyāntaropādāne tu prayogāntaraṃ syād; dravyabhede kriyābhedāt| pratinidhistu mukhyabuddhyaivopādīyate; tadavayavānāṃ tatra bhūyasāṃ sambhavāt| tathehāpyāmantena liṭ‌prayogaḥ prārabdho'parisamāptaḥ sākāṅkṣaḥ tasyākāṅkṣāpūraṇena sa eva prayogo'nuprayogeṇa parisamāpyamāno yuktaṃ yalliṭparasyaivānuprayogeṇa parisamāpyate, tasmānnāsti pratyayāntaraparasyānuprayogaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmālliṭītyayamapyaṃśo na vidhātavyaḥ| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--anuprayogaḥ-paścātprayogo yathā syāt-īkṣāṃcakre, cakreīkṣāmiti mā bhūt| vyavahitanivṛttyartha ca--īkṣāṃ devadattaścakre| kathaṃ vyavahitanivṛttiḥ? āmapekṣayā paścādbhāvasya tatraiva mukhyatvāt| tadevaṃ pūrvanivṛttirvyavahitanivṛttiśca prayojanamiti sthitam| iha tu tānha rājā madayāmeva cakāreti bah‌bṛcavrāhmaṇe vyavahitaprayogaśchāndasaḥ| kathaṃ bhaṭṭikāvye `ukṣāṃ pracakre nagarasya mārgān, `bibhayāṃ pracakārāsau' iti? kathaṃ vā `taṃ tātayāṃ prathamamāsa',`prabhraṃśayāṃ yo nahuṣaṃ cakāra' iti? vārttikakāraḥ pṛcchyatām, yaḥ paṭhati---`viparyāsanivṛttyartha vācyam, vyavahitanivṛttyartha ca' iti!||
vidāṃkurvantvityanyatarasyām|| 3.1.41 ||
vidāṃkurvantvityanyatarasyām|| ihottaratra cānuprayogānusāreṇa āmante lakāra unneyaḥ| viderloṭyāmpratyaya iti| nipātyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ, tathā guṇābhāvaścetyatra| evaṃ loṭo lugityatra, tathā kṛñaśca loṭparasyānuprayoga ityatra| sarvametadaprāptamiti nipātyate| itikaraṇaḥ pradarśanārtha iti| sarveṣāṃ loḍvacanānāmupalakṣaṇārtha ityarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha---na kevalamiti| pracuraprayogatvāttu sūtre bahuvacanaṃ paṭhitam| kaścittu bhāṣyavārttikakārānuktatvādupalakṣaṇatvaṃ necchati, sa itikaraṇasya prayojanaṃ bravītu||
abhyutsādayāṃprajanayāṃcikayāṃramayāṃmakaḥ pāvayāṃkriyādvidāmakrinniticchandasi|| 3.1.42 ||
abhyutsādayāṃprajanayāṃcikayāṃramayāṃmakaḥ pāvayāṃkriyādvidāmakrinniticchandasi|| akariti| kṛño sipi cleḥ `mantre ghasa' ityādinā lukū, sipo halṅyādilopaḥ| kranniti| tatraiva bahuvacanaṃ jhiḥ| kriyāditi| tasyaivāśiṣi liṅ, `liṅāśiṣi' ityārddhadhātukatvādvikaraṇābhāvaḥ, `riṅśaya' iti riṅ| dvirvacanaṃ ceti| cakārātkutvaṃ na| abhyudasīṣadaditi! saderṇyantālluṅi caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ, `caṅi' iti dvirvacanam| `halādiḥ seṣaḥ',`sanballaghuni' itīttvam, `dīrgho laghoḥ'| bhāṣāyāmiti| anyatarasyāmityanuvṛtteśchandasyapi yathādarśanaṃ bhavatyeva| bhāṣāyāṃ tvetadeva rūpamiti abhyudasīṣadaditi bhāṣāyāmityuktam||
cli luṅi|| 3.1.43 ||
cchi luṅi|| ikāra uccāraṇātha iti| cakāralakārasaṃyogacasyakevalasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāt| na tvayamanubandhaḥ, prayojanābhāvāt| cakāraḥ svarārtha iti| etaduttarasūtre vakṣyāmaḥ| asya sijādīnādeśānvakṣyatīti| yadyevam, kimartho'yamu padiśyate, yāvatā śravaṇārtho vā bhavatyupadeśaḥ? kāryārtho vā? na cāyaṃ cliḥ kvacicśruyate, nāpi kvibādīnāmivāśrīyamāṇasyaivāsya kiñcitkārya ddaśyate, tasmāt sicamevotsṛjya tasyāpavādāḥ ksāpavādāḥ vidhīyeran? naivaṃ śaṅkyam, evaṃ hi `mantre ghasa' ityādisūtre bahūnāṃ grahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syād---gamyarthamaṅo grahaṇam, ākārānteṣu dheṭontarbhāvāttadarthaṃ ca caṅo grahaṇam, tasya hi `vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ' iti caṅ, dhātvantarārtha sico grahaṇam, yadi janeḥ----`dīpajana' iti vihitasya ciṇo luk chandasi ddaśyate tatastasyāpi; tānyetāni trīṇi catvāri vā grahaṇāni bhavanti| clyutsarge punaḥ sarveṣāṃ sthānibhūtasya tasyaivaikasya grahaṇam| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pyutsarge tānyeva trīṇi grahaṇāni bhavanti----`cli luṅi', `cleḥ' sic',`mantre ghasa' ādisūtre ca yadetalleriti| evaṃ tarhi yadetad `gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ' iti cleriti vakṣyāmi, tadeva ca mantreghasādisūtre'pyanuvartiṣyate, tallāghavaṃ bhavati| yadi lerityucyate, kiṃ lyavasthāyāmeva lukaṃ kariṣyati? utāho ādeśeṣu kṛteṣu sthānivadbhāvena? yadi lyavasthāyāmeva luk; aguḥ, asthuḥ----`sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' iti jus na prāpnoti ? mā bhūt `sij' ityevam, `ātaḥ' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati? tatrāpi sijgrahaṇamanuvarttate| sijgrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate? yadi nivartate, abhūvannityatrāpi prāpnoti| kena? `sijabhyasta' iti| netyāha; idānīmeva hyuktam---lyavasthāyāmeva lugiti|
tadevam `ātaḥ' ityatra `ṅitaḥ' ityevānuvarttate, na `sicaḥ' iti, laṅyapi tathaiva syāt| dheṭaśca `vibhāṣā dheṭ' `laṅa śākaṭāyanasyaiva' iti niyamādvikalpo bhaviṣyati| evamapi mā hi sthātām, `ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' ityeva svaro na prāpnoti| athādeśeṣu kṛteṣu tatoḥ `vibhāṣā ghrādheṭ' ityatrāpi tathaiva syāt, dheṭaśca `vibhāṣā dheṭśvyeḥ' iti caṅapi vikalpitaḥ| tatra yathā sicā lugalukau, tathā'dhāt adhātām adhuḥ, adhāsīt adhasiṣṭāṃ ādhāsiṣuriti siddhamiṣṭam; caṅo'pi lugabhāvapakṣe adadhat, adadhatām, adadhan iti siddham, lukpakṣe tu pratyayalakṣaṇena dvirvacane'dadhādityapi caturtha rūpaṃ prāpnoti? na caṅo luki dvirvacanam; `na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhāt| bahuvacane tarhi caṅo luki adhānityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti, traiśabdyameva ceṣyate----adhuḥ, adhāsiṣuḥ, adadhanniti? nanu ca caṅo'pi luki āta iti jus bhaviṣyati, yathā sicaḥ? naitadasti; sijgrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvarttate| nivartiṣyate sijgrahaṇam? yadi nivartate, `ātaḥ' ityetaddheṭaścaṅo luki vidhyarthatvasambhavānniyamārtha na syāt, tataścābhūvannityatra pratyayalakṣaṇena sica iti jus prāpnoti, idānīmeva hyaktaṃ kṛteṣvādeśeṣu lugiti? evaṃ tarhi yadetastijabhyasteti, enat `clyabhyasta' iti vakṣyāmi| kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? luṅlukyapi clyabhyasteti jus siddho bhavati, `ātaḥ' ityatrāpi sijgrahaṇānuvṛtterniyamādabhūvannityatra jusabhāvaśca siddho bhavati| kṛteṣvādeśeṣu lugiti sijlakṣaṇaḥ svaraḥ siddho bhavati| yadi clyabhyastetyucyate, clyaṅcaṅkṣu doṣaḥ----adhukṣan, avocan, apīpacannatrāpi jus prāpnoti| tasmātsijabhyastetyeva vaktavyam| `ātaḥ' ityatrāpi sijgrahaṇamevānuvarttanīyam----niyamo yathā syādvidirmā bhūditi| tataśca tadeva sthitam----bahuvacane'dhāniti prāpnoti| yadā ca dheṭaścaṅo luk kriyate tadā na kevalaṃ bahuvacane, sarveṣveva vacaneṣu sijlakṣaṇasvarābhāvātsvare cātuḥ śabdyaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmād `gātisthāghupā' ityatra sica ityeva vaktavyam, tataśca tadeva sthitam----tānyeva trīṇi grahaṇāniti|
pratyutākriyamāṇe utsarge mantreghasādisūtre dvayoreva grahaṇam, katham? dheṭo janeśca caṅ‌ciṇau vikalpitau, tatra yāni luka udāharaṇāni, sica eva tāni bhaviṣyanti | ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ---sico luki `ādiḥ siconyatarasyām' ityanena svareṇa bhavitavyam, caṅ‌ciṇostu neti| tasmād dvayorapi pakṣayostrīmi grahaṇāni, nārthaścotsargeṇa? taducyate---asati hyutsarge `mantreghasa' ityatra yebhyaḥ sico luk kriyate teṣām `ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' ityeṣa svaraḥ prāpnoti| sati tvasmiṃlleriti tadavasthāyāmeva lugvidhānāt sijabhāvāt yathāyathaṃ svaraḥ siddho bhavati| tathā''kārānte sico luki kriyamāṇe `sijabhyasta' `ātaḥ' iti jus prāpnoti, lestu lukyantarbhāva eva bhavati| tasmādutsargaḥ karttavyaḥ| tathā `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' ityatrāniṭa iti lerviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syād| asati punaśclyutsarge tasyaiva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati dhātoḥ na vidyate yasmātparasyeḍiti, tatra ca luṅādeśānāṃ sārvadhātukatvātsampratipannamaniṭtvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti pratyayāntaragataṃ tadāśrayaṇīyam----na vidyate pratyayāntarasya yasmātparasyeḍiti| tato guherna syāt---aghukṣaditi, vidyate hyasmātparasya gūhitetyādāviṭ svaratyādisūtreṇa vikalpitam| athāpi pākṣikeṇeḍabhāvenāniḍiti vyapadiśyeta? nityaṃ ksaḥ prāpnoti, hyutsarge punaraniḍ iti tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| sa ca kadācidaniṭ kadācitseṭ| yadāniṭ tadā ksaḥ, yadā seṭ tadā sijiti siddhamiṣṭam---aghukṣat, aguhīditi| tasmācclyutsargaḥ kartavya iti| sthānitvena vidhānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ||
cleḥ sic|| 3.1.44 ||
cleḥ sic|| ikāra uccāraṇārtha iti| na tvanubandhaḥ| yadyevam, asaṃstetyatra sijantasyāṅgasyātmanepadaṃ ṅitamapekṣya `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ prapānoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam, `hanaḥ sic' iti hanteḥ parasya sicaḥ kittvaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati---na sijantasyopadhālopo bhavatīti| yathā caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā tatraivoktamiti tatraivāvadhāryam| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ iti| antodāttārthaḥ| nanu sico'nackatvāt kathaṃ cakārāḥ svarārthaḥ, iti kṛte sācko bhavati? evamapi pratyayasvareṇa siddham| na siddhyati, nāprāpte svarāntare vidhīyamānamāgamānudāttatvaṃ pratyayasvaraṃ bādhena? evaṃ tarhi cleścittvātsthānivadbhāvāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati, tatrāha---āgamānudāttatvaṃ hīti| citsvaramapi bādheteti| sthānivadbhāvakṛtam| nanu ca yadi mā hi lāvīdityatrāgamānudāttatvaṃ syāt, cleściktaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? evaṃ manyate---cleścakāro mantreghasādisūtre sāmānyagrahaṇe caritārthaḥ; anyathā niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na liṭaḥ, tataśca `āmaḥ' ityatra niranubandhakasya lerasambhavālleriti nānuvarteta, tataśca paratvādantaraṅgatvācca tibādiṣu kṛteṣu paścālluki kārayāmityasya pratyayalakṣaṇena tiṅantatvād devadattaḥ kārayāñcakāreti tasya ca nighātaḥ, tasmāccānighātaḥ syāt| tasmādāma ityatra lerityanuvarttanīyam| tasya ca tatrānuvṛttiḥ pūrvatrasāmānyagrahaṇe satyupapadyate| tasmāccleścakārasya caritārthatvātsthānivadbhāvātprāptaṃ citsvaramapi bādheteti sambhāvane liṅ, sambhāvyeta bādhanamityarthaḥ| anubandhāntareṇāpi sāmānyagrahaṇasiddhe cakārānurodhena citsvara eva bhaviṣyatīti śakyate vaktumiti bhāvaḥ|
spṛśabhṛśeti| `spṛśa sparśane',`mṛśa āmarśane' `kṛṣa vilekhane'---- ityetebhyaḥ kse āpte,`tṛpa prīṇane' `ddapa harṣavimocanayoḥ' ----ābhyāṃ puṣāditvādaṅi prapte sijapi pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate| aspṛkṣaditi| vraścādiṣatve `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' katvam| kaasprākṣīditi| `anudāttasya cardupadhasya ca' iti pakṣe amāgamaḥ, ṛkārasya yaṇa, `vadavraja' ityādinākārasya vṛddhiḥ, amabhāvapakṣe ṛkārasyaiva vṛddhiḥ| evamuttaratrāpi||
śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ|| 3.1.45 ||
śala ṅagupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ|| śalanto yo dhāturigupadha iti nanu clerguṇanimittatvādakṛta eva kse lāvasthāyāmeva guṇaḥ prapnoti, tataścegupadhāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ na prakalpyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprāgeva guṇāt kso bhaviṣyati| nanu ca kṛte'pi guṇe bhūtapūrvagatyā vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇena vā kso bhaviṣyati, kitkaraṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt? `ksasyāci' iti viśeṣaṇārtham| `sasyāci' ityucyamāne punarvadihanikamikaṣibhyaḥ se vatsau vatsāḥ---atrāpi prāpnoti? `uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni' ityanarthakatvānna bhaviṣyati| evamapi vuñchaṇādiṣu tṛṇādibhyaḥ se prasaṅgaḥ---tṛṇānyasmindeśe santi tṛṇasau tṛṇasā iti? naitadevam; `ghorlopo leṭi vā' iti prakaraṇe---dhātupratyayānāṃ grahaṇam, kiṃ ca `lugvāduhadiha' ityatrāci' ityataḥ ksasyeti varttate, teca duhādiṣu yasya sambhavaḥ, pūrvasūtre'pi tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| tadevaṃ kitkaraṇasāmarthyād guṇo na bhavatīti sthitam| cleraniṭa iti| yadyapi cleḥ sijādibhirādeśairbhavitavyamiti kvacidapyaśravaṇānna seṭtvamaniṭtvaṃ vā, tathāpi duh la iti sthite ksasyāyaṃ viṣaya iti sicā na bhāvyam| kso'pi tāvanna bhavati, yāvadasyāniṭtvaṃ na jñātam, tatra lakārasyaiveṭaḥ prāptau tanniṣedhātseṭtvamaniṭtvaṃ ca nirūpyate iti viśeṣaṇopapattiḥ| aghukṣadityādi| `dāderddhātorghaḥ', `ekāco vaśo bhaṣ'| alikṣaditi| `liha āsvādane' `ho ḍhaḥ'| `bhidir vidāraṇe' `chidir dvaidhīkaraṇe',`kuṣa niṣkarṣe',`muṣa steye'||
śliṣa āliṅgane|| 3.1.46 ||
śliṣa āliṅgane|| śliperdhātoriti| `śliṣa āliṅgane' ityasya, na tu `śriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' ityasya; āliṅgane vṛttyabhāvād, aniṭa iti cādhikārātsānubandhakatvācca| atra niyamārthametaditi| nanu śliṣirayaṃ puṣādiḥ, tathā ca pratyudāharaṇe aṅ bhavati, tataśca puṣādipāṭhātpraptamaṅaṃ bādhitvā''liṅgane kso yathā syādityevaṃ vidhisambhavānniyamo nopapadyate| astu vidhiḥ, evamapyāliṅgane ksaḥ, anyatrāṅiti siddhamiṣṭam? satyam; siddhaṃ parasmaipade, ātmanepade tvaṅabhāvādāliṅgane'nāliṅgane ca pūrveṇa ksaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate ca tatrāpyāliṅgane kso'nyatra sic, tacca niyame satyupapadyate| sa ca niyamo nopapadyate; vidheyabhāvāt? yoga vibhāgātsiddham---`śliṣaḥ ityako yogaḥ śliṣaśca kso bhavati| kimarthamidam? puṣādyaṅo bādhanārtham| yathaiba tarhyaṅaṃ bādhate tathā ciṇamapi bādheta---samāśleṣi kanyā devadatteneti? `purastādapavādā anantarānvidhīnbādhante nottarān' iti tatrāliṅgane'nāliṅgane ca śliṣaḥ kso bhavati| idamidānīṃ kimartham? niyamārtham---āliṅgana eva, nānyatra| yogavibhāgasāmarthyādyā ca yāvatī ca ksasya prāptiḥ sā sarvā niyamyate, na tvanantarasya vidhirvā bhavatīti| śliṣa iti yā prāptiḥ, ṅbādhanārthā saiva| evamapi niyamo nopapadyate, katham? śliṣa ityetadaṅbādhanārtham| na ca tadatyantāyāṅaṃ bādhituṃ prabhavati; puṣādipāṭhasāmarthyāt, tataścāṅksayoḥ sarvatra vikalpe prāpte, dvitīyo yogaḥ-----āliṅgane ksa eva nityaṃ yathā syānmā kadācidaṅ bhūdityevamarthaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhyucyate---niyamo nopapadyate iti! nanu tatrabhavatāpi mukhāntareṇa niyama evoktaḥ? etāvāṃstu viśeṣuḥ----mayā pratyayaniyama uktaḥ---āliṅgana eva ksa iti, tvayā punararthaniyamaḥ---āliṅgane ksa eveti, sarvathā niyamānna mucyāmahe| tatra lakṣyānurodhādvidheyavibhaktinirddeśena pradhānatvādvā pratyayaniyama eva bhaviṣyati||
na ddaśaḥ|| 3.1.47 ||
na ddaśaḥ|| pūrveṇeti| `śala igupadhāt' ityanena| aṅ‌sicau bhavata iti| parasmaipadeṣvanyatra sijeva| adarśaditi| `ṛddaśo'ṅi guṇaḥ'| adrākṣīditi| `sṛjiddaśorjhalyamakiti'| atha `cleḥ sic' ityasyānantaraṃ ksasya bādhanārtha sijeva kasmānna vihitaḥ, irittvasāmarthyādaṅapi bhaviṣyati? satyam; tatrāpi `ddaśaśca' iti cakāraḥ karttavya iti lāghave nāsti viśeṣaḥ||
ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ kartari caṅ|| 3.1.48 ||
ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ kartari caṅ|| cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| `caṅi' ityatra `aṅi' ityucyamāne `asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ' `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ' atrāpi prāpnoti| yadi punarayaṃ ṅo vidhīyate cakāraḥ śakyo'kartum| cintyaṃ prayojanamasya| aśiśriyadityādi| atra caṅi dhāturaṅgaṃ caṅantaṃ tu tipi tatra caṅāśrayasya guṇasya caṅameva ṅitamapekṣya pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam, kṅitīti nimittasaptamī? naiṣa doṣaḥ; antaraṅgaviyaṅuvaṅau antarbhūtacaṅapekṣatvāt, bahiraṅgo guṇo bahirbhūtatibapekṣatvāt| akārayiṣātāmiti| ṇyantātkarmaṇi luṅ, dvivacanam, ātām| kamerupasaṅkhyānamiti| nanu kamerṇiṅ vihitaḥ, na ca prakṛtyantaraṃ kamiḥ sambhavati, ṇiṅantāttu sūtreṇaiva siddhaṃ tatrāha---āyādaya ārddhadhātuke veti yadā ṇiṅ nāstīti| ṇiṅpakṣe sanvadbhāva iti| sanvatsūtre caṅparo ṇirityāśrayaṇāt| tatra hi `sanvallaghuni caṅi' iti vaktavye paragrahaṇaṃ bahubrīhyartham, tatra ṇiranyapadārthaḥ, anyasyāsambhavāt||
vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ|| 3.1.49 ||
vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ|| aṅo'pyatra vikalpa iti| `jṝstambhu' ityādinā| aśvaditi| `śvayateraḥ'| aśvayīditi| `hmyanta'ityādinā sici vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhād guṇaḥ| adhiṣātāmiti| karmaṇi dvivacanam, ātām| `sthāghvoricca' iti kittvettve||
gupeśchandasi|| 3.1.50||
gupeśchandasi|| yasmādāyapratyayo nāmti tatrāyaṃ vidhiriti| sūtre kevalasyoccāraṇād `gupa gopane' `gupa vyākulatve' ityanayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; chandasi ddaṣṭānuvidhānāt| darśane tu tayorapi grahaṇam| ajūgupatamiti| `gupū rakṣaṇe' `tasthasthamipām' iti thasastam, `tujādīnāṃ dīrgho'bhyāsasya'| agauptamiti| ūdittvādiḍabhāvapakṣe `jhalo jhali' iti sico lopaḥ| agopāyiṣṭamiti| āyapratyayāntātsic||
nonayatidhvanayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ|| 3.1.51 ||
nonayatidhvanayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ|| ardda gatau yācane ceti| `ardda hiṃsāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇam, yadicchandasi darśanamasti| etebhya iti| tatronayatiścurādiḥ,dhvanirapi `garva māne iti prāgetasmādadantāḥ' ityadhikāre curādiḥ paṭhitaḥ, ghaṭādau cāpi paṭhyate| elayatiścurādiḥ, arddayatirhetumaṇṇyantaḥ| pūrveṇeti| `ṇiśri'ityādinā| ūnayīriti| madhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, pūrvavadvṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāṃ guṇaḥ, `na māṅyoge' ityāḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ---idaṃ pratisavyasya ṛṣervacanam| tvāyataḥ--tvāmicchataḥ, jarituḥ--stoturmama, kāmam-abhilāṣaṃ mā ūnayīḥ-ūnaṃ mā kārṣīrityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu tibantaṃ paṭhyate, kṛtāḍāgamaṃ ca, tadanyatra draṣṭavyam| aunina iti| sipi caṅi `ajāderddhitīyasya' iti naśabdasya dvirvacanam| prāyeṇa tūdāharaṇavadidamapi tibantaṃ paṭhyate| dhvanayīditi| tip, `na māṅyoge' ityaḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| ārddidaditi| `ajāderdvitīyasya' `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' iti daśabdasya dvirvacanam||
asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ|| 3.1.52 ||
asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ|| brūñādeśo veti| vāśabdaḥ samuccaye| evamuttaratrāpi| puṣāditvādeva siddha iti| parasmaipadeṣu| paryāsthateti| `upasargādasyatyūhyorvāvacanam' ityātmanepade'ṅi `asyatesthuk'| avocaditi| `vaca um'| ākhyaditi| `āto lopa iṭi ca'||
lipisicihvaśca|| 3.1.53 ||
lipisicihvaśca|| lipisicisahito hvā---iti `mayūravyaṃsakādayaḥ' iti samāsaḥ| samāhāradvandve tu napuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ syāt, itaretarayoge bahuvacanam| ṅasau `āto dhātoḥ' ityākāralopaḥ| yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti| `asyativaktikhyātilipisicihvaḥ' ityekayoge tvasyādīnāmapyuttaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca tebhyo'pyātmanepade vikalpaḥ syāt||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| 3.1.54 ||
ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām|| alipta, asikteti| `jhalo jhali' iti salopaḥ, `liṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu' iti kittvād guṇābhāvaḥ||
puṣādidyutādy‌lṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| 3.1.55 ||
puṣādidyutādylṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|| ekenaivādiśabdena pratyekaṃ sambandhādeva siddhe dvayorupādānaṃ cintyaprayojanam| divādyantargaṇa iti| `puṣa puṣṭau' `śuṣa śoṣaṇo' ityevamādirā gaṇasamāpteḥ| yattu madhye `ṣṇiha prītau vṛt' iti vṛtkaraṇaṃ tadradhādiparisamāptyartham| etacca `asyatigrahaṇamātmanepadārtha puṣāditvāt' iti vārttikāravacanādvijñāyate| na bhūvādiriti| `puṣa puṣṭau',`śriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' ityevamādiḥ, asya yadi grahaṇaṃ syātpuṣādyanantaraṃ pāṭhād dyutādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt| kryādyantargaṇo veti| `puṣa puṣṭau' `muṣa steye' ityevamādiḥ| tatra hi catvāra eva paṭhyante, tatra yadi te jighṛkṣitāḥ syurlṛdita eva tān kuryāt; svaritettvāderapi nenaiva siddhatvāt| atha puṣādayo dyutādayaśca lṛdita eva kasmānna paṭhitāḥ? aśakyaste tathā paṭhitum; āditāmauditāmuditāmūditāṃ ca tatra bhāvāt| tadyathā---puṣādiṣu tāvat `ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe',`madī harṣe',`samu upaśamane',`ṣidhū rāddhau' iti; dyutādiṣvapi `śvitā varṇe',`ñimidā snehane' `ñikṣvidā snehavimocanayoḥ',`sraṃsu dhvaṃsu bhraṃsu avasraṃsane' `syandū prasravaṇe' `kṛpū sāmarthye' iti| ad‌yut, aśvitaditi| `dyudbhyo luṅi' iti pakṣe parasmaipadam| aloṭiṣṭeti| `luṭa luṭha pratighāte'||
sarttiśāstyarttibhyaśca|| 3.1.56 ||
sarttiśāstyarttibhyaśca|| śāseradāditvācchapo luk, itaratra nipātanāt| śāsu anuśiṣṭāviti| sarttyarttibhyāṃ parasmaipadibhyāṃ sāhacaryādasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu `āṅaḥ śāmu icchāyām' ityātmanepadina iti darśayati| ṛ gatāviti| `ṛ gatiprāṇayoḥ' iti bhauvādikaḥ, `ṛ sṛ gatau' iti jauhotyādikaḥ| duyorapyatra nirddeśa iti kecit, vayaṃ tu jauhātyādikayorevārttisarttyorgrahaṇaṃ manyāmahe| asaraditi| `ṛddaśo'ṅi guṇaḥ'| aśiṣaditi| `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ'| `śāsivasighasīnāñca' iti ṣatvam|
pṛthagyogakaraṇamātmanepadārthamiti| anyathā puṣādidyutādy‌lṛditsarttiśāstyarttibhyaḥ' ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāt| evaṃ hi pṛthagvibhaktinirddeśaścakaraśca na karttavyo bhavati| samaranteti| `samo gamyṛcchi' ityātmanepadam, `bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityāḍbhāvaḥ, chāndasatvādasya prayogasya----samanyavo yatsamaranta senāḥ, saṅkalpā asya samaranta| tathā bhaṭṭikāvye `samāranta mamābhīṣṭāḥ saṅkalpāstvayyupāgate' iti| kaścidāha---bhāṣyaviruddhamidam, bhāṣyakāreṇa hi `samo gamyucchi' ityatra māsamṛṣātāṃ māsamṛpateti ātmanepade sijudāhṛta iti| atrāhuḥ--śāsisāhacaryādarttisarttyoravidyamānaśapojauhotyādikayoriha grahaṇam; `samo gamyṛcchi' ityatra tu bhauvādikasyāpyarttergrahaṇam, tatra bhauvādike'rttau sica udāharaṇamaviruddhamiti||
irito vā|| 3.1.57 ||
irito vā|| abhitteti| svarittvādātmanepadam||
jṝstambhumrucumlucugrucuglucugluñcuśvibhyaśca|| 3.1.58 ||
jṝstambhumrucumlucugrucuglucugluñcuśvibhyaśca|| astambhaditi| `aniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ| anyataropādāne'pi rūpatrayaṃ siddhyatīti| katham? yadi tāvad glucirupādīyate tasmādaṅ‌sicoḥ----glucat, aglocīdityetad dvayaṃ siddhyati, gluñcestu sici tṛtīyamagluñcīditi| atha gluñcirupādīyate tasyāglucat agluñcoditi rūpadvayaṃ siddhyati, glucestu sici tṛtīyamaglocīditi, kimartha tarhi ubhayorupādānamityatrāha---arthabhedāttviti| kecidityādi| idaṃ bhāṣyaviruddham; bhāṣyakāro hi `anekārthatvāddhātūnāmarthabhedo na prayojaka ubhayopādānasya' ityanyataropādānaṃ pratyākhyātavān||

dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo'nyatarasyām|| 3.1.61 ||
dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo'nyatarasyām|| janī prādurbhāve, budha avagamane iti | `jana janane' budha bodhane' saityetayostu parasmaipadinoriha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dīpyādibhirātmanepadibhiḥ sāhacaryāt| tena parasmaipadibhyāṃ karmavyatīhāre ātmanepadaikavacane'pi taśabde ciṇ na bhavati| yadi parasmaipadinoriha grahaṇaṃ syāt, ātmanepadinorna syāt; sānubandhakatvāt| kartari cāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, bhāvakarmaṇostu `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti nityameva ciṇ bhavati, paratvādiha kartarītyanuvṛttervā||
acaḥ karmakarttari|| 3.1.62 ||
acaḥ karmakarttari|| karmakarttarīri| yatkarma bhūtvā karttā bhavati tatraityarthaḥ| prāptavibhāṣeyamiti| `karmavatkarmaṇā' ityatideśena nityaṃ ciṇaḥ prāpteḥ| akāri kaṭo devadatteneti| atra śuddhe karmaṇi `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti nityameva ciṇ bhavati| nanviha karttarotyanuvarttiṣyate, yadyevam, śuddhe karttari syāt, karmaṇīti vākyabhedena kartā viśeṣayiṣyate----karmaṇi kartarīti ? naitadevaṃ śakyate labdhum; karmaṇītyucyamāne karturnivṛttireva syāt, cakāre'pi kriyamāṇe karmaṇi ca bhavati kartari ca bhavatītyadhikaraṇayoreva samuccayaḥ syād, na sāmānādhikaraṇye pramāṇamasti||
duhaśca|| 3.1.63 ||
duhaśca|| aprāptavibhāṣeyam `na duhasnunamāṃ yak‌ciṇau' iti ciṇaḥ pratiṣedhāt| tatra duhigrahaṇe yak‌pratiṣedhārtha ciṇ‌grahaṇaṃ snvādyartham| adugdheti| `ksasyāci'`lugvā duhadiha' iti ksasya luk||
na rudhaḥ|| 3.1.64 ||
na rudhaḥ|| rudhira āvaraṇe iti| `ano rudha kāme' ityasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kartṛsthabhāvakatvena karmakarturabhāvāt||
tapo'nutāpe ca|| 3.1.65 ||
tapo'nutāpe ca|| karmakartarīti| `tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' iti yatra karmavadbhāvovihitaḥ| tatra bhāvakarmaṇorapīti| apiśabdāt `karmavatkarmaṇā' iti yatra karmavadbhāvo'tidiṣṭastatrāpi bhavati| atapta tapastāpasa iti| asyārtham `tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' ityatra vṛttikāra eva vakṣyati| anvavātapta pāpeneti| pāpeneti pūrva yatpāpaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena paścāttapto'bhyāhata ityarthaḥ| śuddhe karmaṇi lakāraḥ, pāpeneti karttari tṛtīyā| karmāvivakṣāyāntu śokārthe vā tapau bāve lakāraḥ, pāpeneti hetau tṛtīyā| yadābhyāhananārthasya karmakarttā vivakṣyate, tadā karmavatkarmaṇetyatideśādātmanepadam, tadāpi hetau tṛtīyā||
ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| 3.1.66 ||
ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ|| ciṇgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti| `ciṇ te padaḥ' ityatasteśabdavadanuvṛtteḥ| yattu dīpajanetyādāvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam, tanna; `rudha' iti tatpratiṣedhavidhāveva nivṛttam, anyathā pratiṣedhavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| na ca pratiṣedhasyānuvṛttiśaṅkā, prāptipūrvako hi pratiṣedhaḥ| na ca bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kenacicciṇaḥ prāptirasti||
sārvadhātuke yak|| 3.1.67 ||
sārvadātuke yak|| ihāśiṣi liṅi liṭi cāntareṇāpi vikaraṇaṃ sarveṣveva dhātuṣu tiṅāmeva sadbhāve bhāvakarmakarttārastrayo'pi pratīyante-----bhaviṣīṣṭa tvayā, kṛṣīṣṭa ghaṭaḥ, bhūyāt, kriyāt, babhūve, cakre ghaṭaḥ, babhūva, cakāreti| attijuholyādau karttā|
kvacittiṅāmabhāve'pi pratīyante trayo'pyamī|

evaṃ sthite bhūyoviṣayābhyāmantavayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdārthāvasāyaḥ| vyabhicārabhūmiṣu tu tasmiṃstasminviṣaye tasya tasya śabdasya sa sa mahimeti kalpayitumuci tam| na punaḥ kvacidvyabhicāradarśanena sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ| tāddaśau cānvayavyatirekau tiṅāmeveti teṣāmeva bhāvakarmakarttāro vācyāḥ| sūtrakāro'pyāha---`laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti, lādeśāśca tiṅaḥ, tato'pi teṣāmeva te'rthā iti manyamāna āha----bhāvakarmavācigi sārvadhātuke parata iti| uttarasūtre ca kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke parata iti śayyata iti| `ayaṅ ci kṅiti'| atha yadā dvau karttārau bahavo vā, tadā kathamāsyate bhavadbhyām, āsyate bhavadbhiḥ----dvivacanabahuvacane kasmānna bhavataḥ? bhāve bhedābhāvād| dhatvartho hi bhāvaḥ|
kartṛbhede'pi nāvaśyaṃ dhātvartho bhidyate yataḥ|
ekāmeva kriyāvyakti bahuṣūtpādayatsvapi||

śruteraśakyā bhedānāṃ pravibhāgaprakalpanā|| iti|

kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārtha iti| mṛjyata ityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| yagvidhāna iti| nanu ca `karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' ityatideśādeva yak siddhaḥ, kimupasaṅkhyānena tatrāha---vipratiṣedhāddhīti| yadā `karmavatkarmaṇā' ityayaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ, tadā tenatena śāstreṇa karmakāryāṇi bhavanti| tatra karmaṇi yagbhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ----śuddhaṃ karma, pacyate odana iti; karttari śabityasyāvakāśaḥ----śuddhaḥ karttā, bhavati pacatīti; karmakarttaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvācchabeva syādityarthaḥ| tattarhi upasaṅkhyānaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; `na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti yakpratiṣedho jñāpayati----bhavati karmakarttari yagiti| kāryātideśe tu tasmiṃstenaiva sūtreṇa bhavanyageva paro bhavati||
karttari śap|| 3.1.68 ||
karttari śap|| pakāraḥ svarārtha iti| upalakṣaṇametat, ṅittvapratiṣedhārthaḥ, `śapśyanornityam' iti viśeṣaṇārthaśca| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukārtha iti| sañjñāparo'tra sārvadhātukaśabdo na sañjñiparaḥ, sārvadhātukasañjñārtha ityarthaḥ| kartṛgrahaṇasya `karmavatkarmaṇā' ityatropayogaḥ| iha tu sārvadhātuke śab bhavati, śyan bhavatīti sāmānyavidhāne'pi bhāvakarmaṇoryagapavāda iti karttaryeva śabādayo bhaviṣyanti||
divādibhyaḥ śyan|| 3.1.69 ||

yaso'nupasargāt|| 3.1.71 ||

saṃyasaśca|| 3.1.72 ||

rudhādibhyaḥ śnam|| 3.1.78 ||
rudhādibhyaḥ śnam|| śnampratyayo bhavatīti| yadyapi pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtyupapadopādhikārāgamānvarjayitvetyuktam, tathāpi vidhīyamānatvena prādhānyāt śabādivadarthavattvācśnamaḥ pratyayasaṃjñā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| tena śakārasya pratyayāditvāditsaṃjñā| śapo'pavāda iti| deśabhedenobhayoḥ satyapi sambhave nāprāpte tasminnārabhyamāṇatvādekārthatvāccāpavādatvam| vikaraṇā hi sārvadhātukasya dhātoścārthābhidhāne sahāyatāṃ pratipadyante| śakāraḥ śrānnalopa iti viśeṣaṇārtha iti| athārddhadhātukasaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ kasmānna bhavati? satyāṃ hi tasyāmanakti, bhanakti----`ato lopaḥ'syāt, ruṇaddhi, guṇaḥ syāt; hinasti, tṛṇeḍhi---iḍāgamaḥ syāt; `neḍ‌vaśi kṛti' ityetadapi nāsti, akṛttvāt? sarvametat śramaḥ pūrvabhāgasyānaṅgatvānna bhaviṣyati| kathamaṅgatvam? yasmātpratyayavidhiriti| ko'rthaḥ? pratyaye vidhīyamāne yatpañcamyā nirddiṣṭaṃ dhātoḥ prāripadikāditi tadādi tasminpratyaye parato'ṅgamiti| yaccāmyā nirddiṣṭaṃ rudhādibhyo dhātubhya iti na tasmātpratyayaḥ, yasmācca pratyayaḥ pūrvabhāgātsa na tasminvidhīyamāne pañcamyā nirddiṣṭaḥ, tasmācchanāditi viśeṣaṇārtha eva śakāraḥ| `nānnalopaḥ' ityucyamāne `yajayācayatavicchapraccharakṣo naṅ' yajñānām, yatnānāmatrāpi prāpnoti, `nāmi' iti dīrghatve kṛte nāditi vyapadeśābhānna bhaviṣyati, paratvāllopa eva prāpnoti| yattu `ato dīrgho yañi',`supi ca' iti dīrdhatvam, na ca tadatra pravarttate, kiṃ kāraṇam? `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' iti| ihāpi tarhi na syād---vṛkṣāyeti? `kaṣṭāya kramaṇe' iti nirdeśādbhaviṣyati| ihāpi tarhi---yatnānāmiti? nirddiśātsāmānyāpekṣāyā jñāpanāddīrgho bhaviṣyati| evamapi tasya pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivatvānnaśabda evāyamiti nalopaḥ syādeva| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaḥ śakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe'pi śakāre iha kasmānna bhavati----viśnānām, praśnānāmiti? `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasya grahaṇam'||
tanādikṛñbhya uḥ|| 3.1.79 ||
tanādikṛñbhya uḥ|| tanītītyādi| `tanu vistāre',`ṣaṇu dāne',`kṣaṇu hisāyām'|

dhinvikṛṇvyora ca|| 3.1.80 ||
dhinvikṛṇvyora ca|| ato lopasya sthānivadbhāvād guṇo na bhavatīti| tena prakriyālāghavāya dhinviṇvyorlopa eva nokta iti bhāvaḥ| lope hi guṇassyāt| na caca `na dhātulopa ārddhadhātuke' iti niṣedhaḥ, pratyayasanniyogaśiṣṭatvena lopasyānārddhadhātukanimittatvāt| nanu numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? numi kṛte'tvaṃ yathā syād, `dhivikṛvyoḥ' ityucyamāne'tve kṛte'ta eva paro num prasajyeta; atvaṃ hyantaraṅgaṃ pratyayasanniyogena vidhānāt; numāgamastu bahiraṅgaḥ, utpanne pratyaye'ṅgasya sato vidhānāt| nanu cāstvaṅgasya num, lāvasthāyāmeva bhaviṣyati; tibādīnāmantaraṅgatvāt| tibādiṣveva tarhi bhaviṣyati, na; nityenātvena bādhanāt| numāgamastu śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ| antaraṅgastarhi numāgamastadvidhau dhātugrahaṇāt? taddhi dhātusaṃjñāpravṛttikāla eva num yathā syādityevamartham; anyasyodito'sambhavāt| kathamasambhavaḥ? yadidānīmevoktam----tāseriditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratiṣedhārthamiti| nanvatrāpi pakṣe `numvidhāvupadeśivadvavacanaṃ pratyayasiddhyartham' iti vacanādupadeśa eva num bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyantaraṅgatvādeva prāptasya numo'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ||
kryādibhyaḥ śrā|| 3.1.81 ||
stambhustumbhumkambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca|| 3.1.82 ||
stambhustumbhuskambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca|| udittvipratijñānāditi| eṣāṃ hyukāro'nunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ pratijñāyate, tasya prayojanam----`udito vā' iti ktvāpratyaye iḍ‌vikalpaḥ| yadi caitadvikaraṇaviṣayā evaite syustannopapadyate| tasmādudittvena pratijñānātsarvārthatvaṃ vijñāyate, sarve pratyayāḥ prayojanameṣāmityarthaḥ| sarvapratyayaśeṣatvabhiti vā||
halaḥ śraḥ śānajjhau || 3.1.83 ||
halaḥ śraḥ śānajjhau|| puṣāṇ, muṣāṇeti| loṭ, sip, tasya hiḥ, `kryādibhyaḥ śnā',tasya śānac| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| atra sannipātaparibhāṣayā anityatvād `ato heḥ' iti herluk|
nanu ca śnāpratyayasya prakṛtatvāttasyaiva śānajādeśo bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ śna iti sthāninirddeśenāta āha---śra iti sthānītyādi| ādeśa ityeṣa saṃpratyayaḥ---avagamo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| asati tu tasmin kiṃ syādityāha---pratyayāntaramiti| astu pratyayāntaram, `kryādibhyaḥ' ityanuvṛttestebhya eva halantebhyo bhaviṣyatīti na kaściddoṣa ityata āha----sarvaviṣayamiti| akryādiviṣayamapītyarthaḥ| kryādyanuvṛttirdurjñāneti manyate| śānacaḥ śitkaraṇañcintyaprayojanam; sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddheḥ| iha `ñimidā snehane' divādiḥ, vyatyayena chandasi śnā, tasya śānajādeśaḥ, midāna| `miderguṇaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaviṣaye vidhīyamāno guṇo na bhavati, punaḥ śitkaraṇena `sārvadhātukamapit' ityasyāpi punaḥ pravṛtteriti kecit| neti vayam; yathaiva vyatyayena śnā bhavati, evaṃ guṇaviṣaye ikāro bhaviṣyati||
chandasi śāyajapi|| 3.1.84 ||
chandasi śāyajapi|| gṛbhāyeti| grahijyādisūtreṇa saṃprasāraṇam, `hṛgrahorbhaśchandasi' iti hakārasya bhakāraḥ| badhāneti| `bandha bandhane',`aniditām' iti nalopaḥ||
vyatyayo bahulam|| 3.1.85 ||
vyatyayo bahulam|| yathāyathamiti| svasmin svasminviṣaye ityarthaḥ| vyatigamanaṃ vyatyaya iti| vyatipūrvādiṇo bhāve `erac'| anyo'nyaviṣayāvagāhanamityarthaḥ| kvacidityādinā vyatyayasya prakāraṃ darśayati| na maratīti| parasmaipadamapyatra vyatyayena| neṣatviti| nayaterloṭi śap‌sipau| taruṣemeti| taratervidhyādau liṅ, tathā ca `taremeti prāpte' iti vṛttiḥ;itarathā `tīryāsmeti prāpte' iti vaktavyaṃ syāt, tataśśap sip u tyaya iti trayo vikaraṇāḥ, dhātorguṇaḥ| taruṣamas, tato yāsuṭ, `liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' `ato yeyaḥ' yalopaḥ, `ād‌guṇaḥ' taruṣema|
bahulagrahaṇamanarthakam, pūrvasūtrādapiśabdasyānuvṛttau chandasi vyatyayo'pi bhaviṣyati, apiśabdādyathāprāptañceti sarvamiṣṭaṃ siddhyati| ata āha----bahula grahaṇamiti| sarvasya prakṛtasyāprakṛtasya ca vidhervyabhicāro vyatyayalakṣaṇo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ|
evamarthe bahulagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ siddhyati tatślokena darśayati---suptiṅupagrahetyādi| tatra supām vyatyayaḥ---dhuri dakṣiṇāyāḥ| dakṣiṇasyāmiti prāpte| tiṅām----caṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati| takṣantīti prāpte| lādeśavyaṅgyaḥ kriyāsādhanaviśeṣaḥ svārthaparārthatvavyaktavāktvādiko yaḥ sa mukhya upagrahaḥ| yathoktam----
ya ātmanepadādbhedaḥ kvacidarthasya gamyate||
anyataścāpi lādeśānmanyante tamupagraham|| iti|
ātmanepadāddhetorityarthaḥ| evamanyataścāpi lādeśaditi, iha tu tadvyaktinimittatvātparasmaipadātmanepadayorupagrahaśabdo varttate| sa brahmacāriṇamicchate| icchatīti prāpte| ūrmiryuvyati, yudhyata iti prāpte| liṅgama---madhostṛptā ivāsate, madhuna iti prāpte| bhāṣāyāmapi madhuśabdaṃ puṃlliṅgaṃ prayuñjate----`madhūṃśca bibhrati rmayasuraviṭapina iti', taccintyam| naraḥ-puruṣaḥ----adhā sa vīrerddaśabhirviyūyāḥ, viyūyāditi prāpte, `yu miśraye' `vipūrvaḥ, āśiṣi liṅ| kālavācī pratyayaḥ kālaḥ----śvo'gnīnādhāsyamānena, luṭo viṣaye lṛṭ| hal‌---triṣṭubhaujaḥ śuphitamugravīram,`śubha śobhārthe' bhakārasya phakāraḥ| āśvalāyanasūtre taittirīye ca bhakāra eva paṭhyate ac----upagāyanti mā patnayo garbhiṇayaḥ, dīrghasya hrasvaḥ| svaravyatyayaḥ----`parādiśchandasi bahulam' ityatra vakṣyate| kartṛ śabdaḥ kārakamātrasyopalakṣaṇārthaḥ, tadvācināṃ śabdānāṃ vyatyaya ityarthaḥ| vibhaktīnāṃ vyatatya iti yāvat| yaṅām---yaṅiti pratyāhāraḥ yaṅo yaśabdādārabhya `liṅyāśiṣyaṅ' iti ṅakāreṇa, teṣāṃ vyatyayaḥ----āṇḍā śuṣmasya bhedatītyādinā vṛttāveva darśitaḥ| eṣāṃ suprabhṛtīnāṃ vyatyayamicchati caśāstrakṛt pāṇinirācāryaḥ| so'pi tathāvidho vyatyayo bāhulakena siddhyati| bahulasya bhāvo bāhulakam, manojñāditvādruñ| tatpunarbahulaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ yadvahvarthādānam| ca---śabdo hetau| yasmādevamuktaprakāro vyatyayo bahulagrahaṇenaiva siddhyati, tasmādvahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ||
liṅyāśiṣyaṅ|| 3.1.86 ||
liṅyāśiṣyaṅ|| śaṣo'pavāda iti| liṅāśiṣītyārddhidhātukatvātkathamatra śapaḥprāptirityata āha---chandasyubhayatheti| śabgrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇam| śakeḥ śnorapavādaḥ, sthādiṣvevāyamaṅ prāyeṇa ddaśyata ityāha----sthāgāgamītyādi| upastheyamiti| upapūrvāttiṣṭhaterāśiṣi liṅ, mipombhāvaḥ, yāsuṭassārvadhātukatvāt `liṅaḥ ssalopo'nantyasya', aṅi `āto lopa iṭi ca', `ato yeyaḥ',`ād‌guṇaḥ'| evamupageyamiti| gamemeti| mas| vocemeti| aṅ, `vaca um', yāsuṭ, iyādeśaḥ,vali lopaḥ| ddaśeragvaktavya iti| aṅi hi sati `ṛddaśo'ṅi' iti guṇassyāt||
karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ|| 3.1.87 ||
karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ|| karmaṇā, tulyaṃ varttata iti karmavat `tena tulyam' ityādinā vatiḥ,na tu `tatra tasyeva' iti; tulyakriya iti pratiyogini prathamānirdeśāt| anyathā tulyakriye tulyakriyasyeti vā nirddeśyaṃ syāt| tathā hi vākye tāvadyato vatirbhavati, yaśya pratiyogī---ubhābhyāmapi tābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau bhavataḥ,viprasyevāsya śīlam, mathurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prākāra iti; ubhayorapi sambandhitvād, ādhāratvācca| tataścotpanne'pi vatau pratiyoginaste eva ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāvupatiṣṭhete| tulyārthayoge tu yā tṛtīyā sopamānādeva bhavati, nopameyāt; tulyaśabdasyopameyaniṣṭhatvāt, tadyathā---candreṇa tulyaṃ mukhamiti tataśyotpanne'pi vatāvupameyātprathamaivāvatiṣṭhate|
karmaṇeti paribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhyate, na laukikaṃ kriyā karma; tasya hi grahaṇe kriyayā tulyā kriyā yasyeti kimuktaṃ syāt kriyāyāḥ, yayā kayācana kriyayā tulyatvād! atassādhanakarmaṇo grahaṇam| tatra sādhyasādhanayoratyantabhedānmukhyena karmaā kriyāyāḥ sāddaśyāsambhavātkarmaśabdena tatsthā kriyā lakṣyate| bhavati hi tātsthyāttācchabdyam, yathā---mañcāḥ krośantīti| tadetadāha---karmaṇi kriyā karmeti|
viśeṣaṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ na cedānīṃ prasajyate|
karmaṇaḥ kriyayā tulyā na sarvasya kriyā yataḥ|| iti ||
karmaṇaḥ kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ, na sādhānāntarasyetyevaṃ pratipattyarthatvādityāha---karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriya iti| tulyaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvātkarmasthayā kriyayetyetadapekṣasyāpi sūtravadvahuvrīhirnānupapannaḥ| tulyaśabdo'yamasti sādhāraṇavacanaḥ----etau tulyadhanāviti, sāddaśyavacanastu prasiddha eva; tatrādyasya grahaṇe karmaṇeti yadi mukhyavṛttistadā karttuḥ karmaṇaśca yā sādhāraṇī kriyā, tatra yaḥ karttā karmaṇā saha sādhāraṇakriyaḥ sakarmakeṣu yaḥ karttetyuktaṃ bhavati| tatra tulyakriya ityanarthakam, karmaṇetyeva vācyaṃ syāt| karmaṇā saha yaḥ karttā pratipādyata ityarthaḥ| atha gauṇavṛttistadāyamartha----kriyayā hetunā sādhāraṇakriyaḥ| kayā kriyayā? karmasthayā kriyayeti| evamapi pacatyodanaṃ devadatta ityatrāpi prāpnoti, yāsau karmasthā viklittirūpā kriyā tayā sādhāraṇakriyatvāt| ato'sminpakṣe'niṣṭraprasaṅgaḥ, prasiddhataraśca saddaśaparyāyastulyaśabda iti prayuñjānaḥ `sāddaśyavacanastulyaśabdaḥ, na sādhāraṇavacanaḥ' ityācaṣṭe| kartṛbhūta iti| karttari sampanna ityarthaḥ| cvervikalpitatvādatrābhāvaḥ| atha vā--kartṛśabdaḥ kartṛtve vartate, bhūta iti `bhū prāptau' ityasya `ā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāve rūpam, kartṛtvaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ| tatra pacatyodanamityatra kartṛkarmavyāpāraha yoratanyantabhedena sāddaśyābhāvātkarmavadbhāvābhāvaḥ| evamapi bhidyamānaḥ kusulaḥ pātrāṇi bhinnattītyatrāpi prāpnoti, yāddaśī hi pātreṣu kriyā'vayavaviśaraṇātmikā tāddaśyeva kusūle'pi karttari lakṣyata iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; karmasthayā kriyayā tulyā kriyā yasya kartturityukte kartutvopayoginī yā kriyā yadāveśādasau karttā bhavati saiva kriyā gamyate; iha tu pātreṣu ddaśyamānaṃ dvidhābhavanaṃ kusūle'pi daivagatyā ddaṣṭamityetāvanna punastatsamāveśādasau bhinatti, svayamabhidyamāno'pi kusūla upari patan pātrāṇi bhinattyeva| evamapyanyo'nyamāśliṣataḥ, anyo'nyaṃ spṛśataḥ, anyo'nyaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ ----atra prāpnoti, atra hi yatkriyāveśātkarttā bhavati saiva karmaṇyapi dṛśyate? satyaṃ ddaśyate; na sā karmatvopayoginī, na hyasau tadāveśātkarma bhavati; svayamanāśliṣyato'pi pareṇāśliṣyamāṇasya karmatvasambhavāt| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati----karmaṇaḥ karmatvopayoginī yā kriyā tayā tulyā yasya kartṛtvopayoginī kriyā sa karmaṇa tulyakriyaḥ| evañca yasyaiva karmaṇaḥ karmāvasthāyāṃ yā kriyā kartravasthāyāmapi yadi saiva kriyā bhavati sa karttā karmavadityuktaṃ bhavati| idamapyatraivoktam----`yasmin karmaṇi kartṛbhūte'pi' iti| tasminneva karmaṇi kartravasthāṃ prāpta iti hyatrārthaḥ| evañca kartṛkarmāvasthābhedādekasyā api kriyāyā bhedāśrayaṃ sāddaśyamupapādyam|
atideśo rūpanimittatādātmyavyapadeśaśāstrakāryātideśabhedenānekavidhaḥ, tavādistrayāṇāmasambhavaḥ| vyapadeśātideśastu saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate| tatra vaktaraṇamanarthakam| ataḥ śāstrātideśaḥ, kāryātideśa iti dvāveva pakṣau| tatra śāstrātideśe `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityādiṣu śāstreṣvatidiṣṭeṣu tena tena śāstreṇa tattatkāryaṃ pravarttate, tataśca `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaṃ karma, pacyate odanaḥ, `śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaḥ karttā, pacati paṭhati; karmakarttaryubhayaprasaṅge paratvātparasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `karttari karmavyatīhāhe ityataḥ kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate, tena kartaiva yaḥ karttā tatra parasmaipadam, karmakartari na bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi karmaṇi yag bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaṃ karma, pacyate, odanaḥ, `kartari śap' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---śuddhaḥ karttā, pacati paṭhati; karmakartaryubhayaprasaṅe paratvācchap prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `kartari śap' ityatra kartṛgrahaṇanna kartavyam, sārvadhātuke śabiti sāmānyasya bhāvakarmaṇoryagapavādo bhaviṣyati, evaṃ siddhe yatkartṛgrahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitatprayojanam----kartaiva yaḥ kartā tatra śabādayo yathā syuḥ, karmāpadiṣṭe mā bhūvanniti? satyaṃ prativihitamāyuṣmatā! vṛthā punarayamprayāsaḥ, kāryātideśāśrayeṇaiva siddheḥ| tatra hyanenaivātmanepadam, anenaiva yagiti paratvādyagātmanepade siddhyataḥ| pradhānaṃ ca kāryam, tadarthatvādatideśāntarāṇām| ataḥ kāryātideśa kartṛgrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtam`kartari śap' iti, tadapi saptamyantam `tulyakriya' iti prathamāntena sambaddhuṃ nārhati, tatrāha---kartari śabityata iti|
yagātmanepadetyādi| lāntasya karttā karmavaditi vakṣyamāṇatvādyagādīnāmeva sambhava iti bhāvaḥ| midyate ityādīni trīṇyātmanepadasyodāhaṇāni yagādīnāṃ krameṇa| kathaṃ punaḥ kāṣṭhasya bhidāṃ prati kartṛtvam, yāvatā bhidyate'sau devadattena? yo hyudyamananipātanādi kuṭhārasya karoti sa bhedane karttā ucyate| sarveṣāmeva kārakāṇāṃ prātisviko'vāntaravyāpāro'sti, akiṃcitkarasya kārakatvānupapatteḥ| etacca kārakaprakaraṇe evopapāditam| tatra ca svavyāpāre svatantratvaṃ sarvatraivāsti| kārake kartṛvyāpāreṇa tiraskṛtatvāttu nyagbhūtaṃ svātantryamiti kartṛtvaṃ na bhavati, karaṇādisaṃjñaiva bhavatītyetāvat| sakarmakāstu keciddhātavaḥ karmavyāpāramapyabhidhāya tāvatyevāparyavasyantastadupasarjanaṃ kartṛvyāpāramācakṣate, tadyathā----bhidirddhidhābhavanopasarjanaṃ dvidhābhāvanamāha| na khalvayamudyamananipātanamātravacanaḥ; rajake'pi prasaṅgāt, sopi hi vastramudyacchati nipātayati ca| atha ca na bhinattītyucyate; dvidhābhavanābhāvāt| etena chinattilunattī vyākhyātau| tathā pacirapi viklityupasarjanaṃ vikledanamāha| tatra yadā karmaṇaḥ saukaryātiśayapratipādanāya kartṛvyāpāro na vivakṣyate, tadā nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayavasthitaṃ nivarttamāne karmatve sve kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate| dhāturapi tadvyāpāramātre vartate| kathaṃ punarubhayavacano dhātuḥ karmavyāpāramātravacano bhavati? ko virodhaḥ? anekārthā dhātavaḥ, samudāyeṣu ca vṛttāḥ śabdā avayeṣvapi vartante, tadevaṃ karmavyāpāramātravāciṣu kartṛtvameva kāṣṭhādīnām, na tu karmatvagandho'pyasti; dhātavaścaite prayoge'sminnakarmakāḥ, yathā---viklidyati dvidhā bhavatīti; kathaṃ tarhi karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ karttā? na brūmaḥ----asmin prayoge yatkarma tena tulyakriya iti, kiṃ tarhi? prayogāntare yatkarma tena tulyakriya iti| nanvevaṃ pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ, rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameva---atrāpi prāpnoti? atra parihāraṃ vakṣyati---dhātvadhikārāditi| kartṛkarmaṇordhātoranyatrāsambhavādeva siddhestadanuvṛttirekatvavikṣārthā----yasminneva dhātau yatkarma tena tulyakriyastasyaiva dhātoḥ karteti| tena dhātubhede na bhaviṣyati?
āha--adhyāropo'yamastu, ko'rthaḥ? kṛtsna eva dhātvarthaḥ karmaṇyadhyāropyate kimatra devadattena odana eva pākaṃ karotīti| evaṃ hi saukaryātiśayaḥ sutarāṃ pratipādito bhavati, karaṇādhikaraṇavat, yathā---sādhvasiśchinatti, sādhu sthālī pacatīti| tatra yeṣu tāvatkṛtsna eva dhātvarthaḥ karmaṇyapi sambhavati---ātmanā buddhyate, ātmanā mucyate, ātmanā hanyate, ātmanā tāḍyate iti, teṣu śuddhe karmaṇi lakāraḥ kena cidrūpeṇa kartṛtvam, kenacidrūpeṇa karmatvamiti| tathā bhidyate kusūla iti yatrāpi cetano bhettā na ddaśyate tatra vātātapakālābhivarṣaṇānāmanyatamasya kartṛtvam, adhyāropo vā| pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, lūyate kedāraḥ svayamevetyādāvadhyāropa eva, ātmanaivovanaḥ pacyate, na tu devadatteneti, kaevaṃ nāma pāke'nukūlo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ śuddhe karmaṇi lakārotpatternārtha etena| yadyevam, bhidyate kusūleneti bhāve lo na syāt, sakarmakatvāt? athāpyatra bhidyate kusūlenātmeti karmaṇi vyākhyāyeta| evamapi bhettavyaṃ kusūlena, īṣadbhedaṃ kusūleneti bhāve kṛtyaktakhalarthā na syuḥ? na ca tatrāpi karmaṇīti śakyamāśrayituṃ napuṃsakaliṅgadarśanāt| tathā namate daṇḍaḥ svayameva, kārayate kaṭaḥ svayameva, acīkarata kaṭaḥ svayameva---yakciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayorapi śap‌caṅau na syātām, akartṛtvāt| tasmātkarmavyāpāramātravācibhyaḥ kartari bhāve ca lādaya ityetadeva sādhīyaḥ| tathā ca śrṛtaṃ pāka ityatra paceḥ karmavyāpāre kartṛvyāpāre ca śrṛtamiti bhavati; dvayorapi pākaśabdābhidheyatvāt|
evaṃ hi yā vimṛṣṭā śāstraṃ na kariṣyāmiti matiḥ, sāpi tyājyā| asati sūtre `na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na pradarśitaḥ syāt| kiñca, yadyapi pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetyādikaḥ prayogaḥ karmaṇi samarthyate, kartari tu lakārotpattau pacatyodana ityādikaḥ prayogo'pi prasajyeta| tasmādārabdhavyaṃ sūtram|
atrodāharaṇeṣu kartrantaravyudāsārtha svayamiti prayujyate, na tvetadudāharaṇāṅgam| prayukta etasminnātmanetyasyārthe vṛtteḥ prākṛtamevaitatkarma syāt---svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi| asati vatkaraṇe kartuḥ karmasaṃjñā jñāyeta, tataścānena karmaṇā sakarmakatvād `bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti bhāve lo na syāt| sati tu tasminsvataḥ prāptasyākarmakavyapadeśasyānivartanādakarmakāṇāṃ bhāve laḥ siddho bhavati, akarma kāṇāṃ bhāve yo lo vidhīyate sa siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ siddho bhavati, yāvatā nityo'yamatideśaḥ, nitye cāsmiṃstatra lavidhirapi karmakāryameveti syādevātideśaḥ? ātideśikāviruddhaṃ svāśrayaṃ vatinā prāptate, na tu viruddhamapi| na hyayaṃ vikalpārthaḥ---kadācitkarmavat, kadācinneti| atha lāntasya karteti vakṣyamāṇatvādetatsūtrapravṛtteḥ prāgeva `laḥ karmaṇi ca' ityetatpravṛttiraṅgīkriyate, tacca pravartamānamakarmakatvādbhāve kartari ca pravartate, yadā karttari tadā'yamatideśa iti bhāve lavidhiḥ samarthyeta| yadyevam, mā bhūdvatiḥ, lakāravācyasya karttuḥ karmasañjñaivāstu, yagātmanepadayostvaprasiddhiḥ paratvācchabādīnāṃ parasmaipadasya ca prasaṅgaḥ; na ca karmasañjñayā kartṛsañjñāyā bādhaḥ, ekasañjñādhikārādanyatra sañjñānāṃ samāveśāt? satyam; ukto'tra parihāraḥ----tadetadvatkaraṇaṃ sarvasāddaśyārtham| tenodāharaṇeṣu kāṣṭhādibhyo dvitīyā na bhavati; ityarathā karmakāryatvātprāpnoti, abhihitatvānna bhaviṣyati| bhavedayaṃ parihāraḥ śāstrātideśe, kāryātideśe tvanenaiva karmakāryāṇi prāpyante, na cātrānabhihitādhikāro'stīti syādeva dvitīyā| vatkaraṇāttu sarvasāddaśyārthādyathā karmaṇyabhihitena bhavati, evaṃ kartaryapīti dvitīyābhāvaḥ| yadā tarhyakarmakatvādbhāve lakārastadā prāpnoti, tatrāha-----liṅyāśiṣyaṅityādi| tatra lagrahaṇamanuvṛtta ṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇamyate ityabhiprāyeṇāha---lāntasya kartteti| lakāravācyaḥ kartetyarthaḥ| kusūlād dvitīyā na bhavatīti| bhidyate kusūlenetyanantarodāhṛteṣu udāharaṇeṣu tu vatkaraṇādeva sarvasāddaśyārthād dvitīyāyā abhāva iti bhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ vṛttikārasyābhipretam----etadvatiḥ sarvasāddaśyārtha iti| kiñca, nāvaśyaṃ dvitīyaiva, kṛtyaktakhalarthā apyasminviṣaye kartaryatideśena prāpnuvanti----bhettavyaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameva, bhinnaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameva, īṣadbhedaḥ kusūlaḥ svayameveti; bhāva eva ceṣyante---bhettavyaṃ kusūlena kusūlasya vā, `kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā',`bhinnaṃ kusūlena, īṣadbhedaṃ kusūleneti| atra vārtike ktagrahaṇamanyatra sahapāṭhātpaṭhitam, yathā-----kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārtha iti| bhavatyeva hyebhyo'karmakatvād `gatyarthākakarmaka' iti kartari ktaḥ| tathā ca `sinotergrāsakarmakartṛkasyeti vaktavyam' iti niṣṭhā---natve| sino grāsaḥ svayameveti kartari kta udāhariṣyate| tasmātkṛtyakhalartheṣvevaiṣa doṣaḥ, atastatra lāntasya kartetyāśrayaṇādevātideśābhāvaḥ|
karmaṇeti kimiti| dhātuvācyā kriyā kartṛ karmaṇoreva samavetā, tatra sāddaśyasya bhedādhiṣṭhānatvātkartṛsthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā na sambhavatīti karmasthaiva kriyā āśrayiṣyata iti matvā praśraḥ| karaṇādhikaraṇābhyāmiti| tatsthakriyayetyarthaḥ| sādhvasiśchinattīti| kiṃ punaratra karaṇādhikaraṇavyāpāramātre dhāturvartate? āho svittatra kṛtsnadhātvarthādhyāropaḥ? na tāvadādyakalpaḥ, tāvati dhātoravṛtterasinā chinattatyatrāpi naiva karaṇavyāpāro dhātunopādīyate, kevalaṃ karaṇatvādavāntaravyāpāro'stītyetāvat| dvitīye tu bhinnakriyatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ| tasmātkaraṇādhikaraṇavyāpāramātre'pi dhātorvṛttimaṅgīkṛtya pratyudāhṛtaṃ draṣṭavyam| kvacitu karaṇenāpi tulyakriyasya karmavadbhāva iṣyate, yadāha---karaṇena tulyakriyaḥ karttā bahulamiṣyate, parivārayati kaṇṭa
kairvṛkṣam, parivārayante kaṇṭakā vṛkṣam----ātmanepadaṃ bhavati| vṛttikārastu `ṇicaśca' ityātmanepadamupapadyata iti manyamāno naitadupasamacaṣṭa|
dhātvadhikārātsamāne dhātāviti| ekasyaiva dhātorityarthaḥ| etacca prāgeva vyākhyātam|
karmasthabhāvakānāmityādi| yadyapi kriyābhāvaśabdayorabhinna evārthaḥ, tathā ca `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' iti kriyāpi gṛhyate, `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' `karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' iti ca vāco'pi; tathāpyasmin granthe bhedenopādānādarthabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ---aparispandarūpo dhātvartho bhāvaḥ, parispandarūpastu kriyā| kva punarasau karmasthaḥ? kva vavā kartṛ sthaḥ? kecidāhuḥ----yeṣu karmabyāpāropasarjanaḥ kartṛvyāpāro'bhidhīyate teṣu karmasthaḥ, yeṣu kartṛ vyāpāra eva teṣu kartṛ stha iti| neti vayam; pradhānakriyā yatra samavaiti kartari karmaṇi vā tatstho dhātvarthaḥ, yaduddeśena kārakavyāpāraḥ sā pradhānakriyā, yathā---pacerviklittiḥ, gamerdeśāntaraprāptiḥ| evañca kṛtvā nyagbhavanopasarjananyagbhāvavacano'pi ruhiḥ kartṛsthakriyaḥ---ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā iti; uparideśaprāpteruddeśyāyāḥ kartari samavāyāt, tatreha karmasthena vyāpāreṇa kartṛvyāpārasyopamānāt|
asya cārthasya kartṛsthavyāpāreṣvasambhavānnyāyaprāpta evārtho vṛttikāreṇa darśitaḥ| tatra kartasthavyāpārasya kartṛsthasya codāharaṇamātraṃ ślokena darśayati----karmasthaḥ pacaterbhāva iti| pacyate ghaṭa ityatra taddeśasyaiva ghaṭasya pāka iti bhāvo'sau bhavati, karmasthaśca---pacyate odana ityatra parispandata eva, pākyasya pākābhinirvṛttiriti karmasthaiva paceḥ kriyā bhavati| karmasthā ca bhideḥ kriyeti| bhidyate kusūla ityatrāvayavaviśaraṇātmikā bhidikriyā bhedasya parispande sati bhavatīti karmasthā ca bhideḥ kriyā bhavati| māsāsibhāvaḥ kartṛstha iti| māsamāste ityatra `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasañjñā hyakarmaṇām' iti māsakarmako'yamāsidhātuḥ, tatra māsāsidhātau pratīyamāno'rtho bhāvaḥ; aparispandarūpatvāt, sa ca kartṛstha ityarthaḥ| kartṛ sthā ca gameḥ kriyeti| gamerarthaḥ kriyā, sā ca kartṛ sthetyarthaḥ| tenāsyate māsaḥ svayameva, gamyate grāmaḥ svayameveti na bhavati| atheha kathaṃ karmavadbhāvaḥ---tasmādudumbaraḥ salohitaṃ pacyate phalamiti? atrāhuḥ---paciratra viṣaye dvikarmakaḥ, vṛkṣasya pākamantareṇa phalasya pākāsambhavāt| tatra `apradhāne duhādīnām' iti vṛkṣo'kathitaṃ karmeti tatra lakāraḥ, kālastu kartteti| idaṃ tu vaktavyameva, `sṛjiyujyoḥ śyaṃstu' iti `sṛji visarge',`yujiryoge'---anayoḥ sakarmakayoḥ karttā karmavadbhavati; tatra sṛjeḥ śraddhopapanne karttari karmavadbhāvaḥ, yagviṣaye ca śyan, ciṇviṣaye tu ciṇeveṣyate; sṛjyate mālāṃ devadattaḥ, śraddhayā niṣpādayatītyarthaḥ| śyani sati prakṛterādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati, yaki tu sārvadhātukānudāttatve yaka evodāttatvaṃ syāt-----asaji mālām, śraddhayā niṣpādayati smetyarthaḥ| `yujir'---yujyate brahmacārī yogena||
tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva|| 3.1.88 ||
tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva|| `kriyābhedādvidhyarthamidam' iti vakṣyati| kathaṃ tarhyevakārasyānvaya ityāśaṅkya vākyabhedena vyācaṣṭe---tapa santāpe, asya karttā karmavadbhavati, sa ca tapaḥ karmakasyaiveti| evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati----nānyakarmakasyeti| etacca śrutasyaivakārasyānvayo vaktavya iti matvoktam, na punarasya kiñcitpratojanamasti| kriyābhedāditi| atyantabhedādityarthaḥ| niyamapakṣe'pi kriyāṇāṃ ca bhedo'pekṣitaḥ; tulyatvasya bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt| kriyābhedameva darśayati---upavāsādīnīti| duḥ khayantītyartha iti| `sukhaduḥkha tatkriyāyām' iti curādipāṭhāṇṇic| anena tāpasasya karmatve taperduḥ khanamartha iti darśitam| arjayatītyartha iti| anenāpi tāpasasya kartṛtve taperarjanamartha iti darśitam| kvacittu ārjayatīti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāṅpūrvasya prayogaḥ| nanvemapi śarīrasantāpalakṣaṇā kriyā'vasthādvayo'pi tulyā, na hi śarīrasantāpādanyadarjanaṃ tāpasasya vyāpāraḥ? tadasat; vastusthityā sato'pi śarīrasantāpasyāśabdārthatvāt, kathamanyathā tapasaḥ karmatvam! tasmādarjanam- niṣpādanam, alabdhasya lābhaḥ; duḥkhaṃ tu śarīrasantāpa eveti spaṣṭa eva kriyābhedaḥ| vidhyarthametaditi yaduktaṃ tadevopasaṃharati---pūrveṇāprāptaḥ karmavadbhāvo vidhīyata iti| atapta tapastāpasa iti| `tapo'nutāpe ca'iti ciṇaḥ pratiṣedhātsic, `jhalo jhali' iti lopaḥ||
na duhasnanamāṃ yakciṇau|| 3.1.89 ||
na duhasnanamāṃ yakciyau|| `duha prapūraṇe',`ṣṇu prasravaṇe'| `ṭudu upatāpe', `hame hasane',`ṇu stavane' ityeteṣāṃ tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, nautihasatyorakarmasthakriyatvāt| yadi ca teṣāṃ grahaṇāmiṣṭaṃ syādasandehārtham `na dunuhasnamām' ityeva brūyāt, avayavaprasiddheśca samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī| karmavadbhāvāpadiṣṭāviti| etena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti karmavatkarmaṇeti prāptayoryakciṇorayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ; na tu `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ', `sārvadhātuke yak'iti śuddhe karmaṇi bhāve prāptayoriti darśayati| dugdha iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap, tasya adāditvālluk, `dāderdhātorghaḥ', `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' jaśtvam| duhirayaṃ dvikarmakaḥ, tatra `apradhāne duhādīnām' iti yasminkarmaṇi lakārastasya kartṛtvavivakṣā, pradhānaṃ tu karma karmaiveti, yathā----`svayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī' iti| adugdheti| ṇic bhāve ksaḥ, `lugvā duha' ityādinā tasya luk| nanvidānīmevoktam----`duheranena yak pratiṣidhyate, ciṇ tu `duheśca' iti pūrvameva vikalpitaḥ' iti, tasmānnaitadatrodāharttavyam| prasnuta iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe pūrvavacchapo luk prāsnoṣṭeti| ciṇpratiṣedhe sic| namata iti| antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra namiḥ| tatra yathā nayamati daṇḍaṃ devadattaḥ, namayate daṇ‍ḍaḥ svayameveti ṇyantasya karmasthakriyatvam, evamasyāpi draṣṭavyam|
ṇiśranthigranthītyādi| ṇīti ṇiṅo ṇicaśca sāmānyena grahaṇam| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe' curādāvādhṛṣīyau, tayorṇijabhāvapakṣe grahaṇam| tathā kryādiṣvapi paṭhyete tayorapi grahaṇam| `brūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci'| ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā ye dhātavo nirddiṣṭāste yadāntarbhāvitaṇyarthāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti ta ime ātmanepadākarmakāḥ| vṛttau kvacideṣāmudāharaṇāni paṭhyante, kvacinna| ṇici-----kāryate kaṭaḥ svayameva, acīkarata kaṭaḥ svayameva, yakciṇoḥ pratiṣiddhayoḥ śapcaṅau bhavataḥ| ṇiṅ-----pucchamudasyati, utpucchayate gauḥ, sa yadāntarbhāvitaṇyarthastadā utpucchayate gām| punaḥ saukaryātiśayena kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmutpucchayate gauḥ svayameva, udapupucchata gauḥ svayameva| śranthigranthyorādhṛṣīyayoḥ-----granthati granthaṃ devadattaḥ, śranthati mekhalām, granthate granthaḥ svayameva, agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ svayameva; śranthate mekhalā svayameva, aśranthiṣṭa mekhalā svayameva| kraiyādikayostu----grathnīte granthaḥ svayameva, śrathnīte mekhalā svayameva| brañ---bravīti kathāṃ devadattaḥ, brūte kathā svayameva| vacanaṃ śabdaprakāśanaphalatvātkarmastham| ātmanepadākarmaka-----`veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ' `akarmakācca' vikurvate saindhavāḥ, valgantītyarthaḥ| tānyadā'nyo valgayati tadā teṣāṃ karmatvam| punaḥ saukaryātiśayātkartṛtvavivakṣāyām----vikurvate saindhavāḥ svayameva, vyakṛṣata saindhavāḥ svayameva, yakciṇau na bhavataḥ| kvacittu bṛttau---āhanti māṇavakam, āhate māṇavakaḥ svayameveti paṭhyate, tadayuktam; āhanti māṇavakamiti sakarmakatvādātmanepadābhāvācca| anye punarāhuḥ-----ātmanepadākarmaketi dhātupalakṣaṇam, hantiśrāyam `āṅo yamahanaḥ' ityatra yadā karmāvivakṣayā'karmakastadātmanepadasya nimittaṃ syāt, tasyādyasakarmakatve'pyaviruddhamudāharaṇamiti|
bhūṣākarmakirādisanāṃ yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī, bhūṣāphalaṃ ca śobhākhyaṃ karmaṇi ddaśyata iti karmasthā bhūṣā| alaṃkurute kanyā svayameva, alaṃkariṣyate kanyā svayameva, alamakṛta kanyā svayameva; avakirate hastī svayameva, avākīrṣṭa hastī svayameva, avakariṣyate hastī svayameva----yakciṇciṇvadbhāvā na bhavanti| san---mumukṣate vatsaḥ svayameva, amumukṣiṣṭa vatsaḥ svayameva; cikīrṣate kaṭaḥ svayameva, acikīrṣiṣṭa kaṭaḥ svayameva----prakṛtyarthāpekṣamatra karmasthakriyatvam, icchā tu kartṛsthā| ārtha ca prakṛtyarthasya prādhānyam; tadarthathvādicchāyāḥ||
kuṣirajoḥ prācāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca|| 3.1.90 ||
kuṣirajoḥ prāyāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca|| yagātmanepadayorapavādāviti| śyanyako'pavādaḥ, parasmaipadamātmanepadasya| śyanyakoścātra numisvare ca viśeṣaḥ----kuṣyantī jaṅghā, śyani `śapśyanornityam' iti nityaṃ numāgamaḥ, nittvāccādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati; yaki tu `ācchīnadyornum' iti numvikalpaḥ, laḥ sārvadhātukānudāttatve ca yaka evodāttatvaṃ syāt|rajyatīti| `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ| kuṣyate, rajyate iti pakṣe yagātmanepade bhavataḥ|
liṅliṭoriti| āśiṣi liṅtra gṛhyate, yaduktam---kuṣairajoḥ śyanvidhāne sārvadhātukavacanam, avacane hi liṅ‌liṭoḥ pratiṣedha iti| syādiviṣaye ceti| ādiśabdena sijādīnāṃ grahaṇam| cukuṣe, rarañca iti| liṭ, ātmanepadam, tasya eśādeśaḥ| koṣiṣīṣṭeti| `liṅaḥ sauyuṭ', `suṭ tithoḥ' laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| raṅ‌kṣīṣṭeti| `ekācaḥ' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam gakāraḥ, tasya carttvamkakāraḥ| akoṣi, arañcīti| ciṇ||
dhātoḥ|| 3.1.91 ||
dhātoḥ|| ā kuto'yamadhikāraḥ kiṃ prāglādeśād? āhosvidādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ? iti vicāre dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrayati--ā tṛtīyādhyāyaparisamāpteriti|
eśaḥ śitkaraṇāt, taddhi dhātorityadhikāre sati `tasmādityuttarasya' `ādeḥ parasya' takārasya sthāne etve sati akārasya sthāne ṭeretve ayādeśe ca satyayeśabdasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartha kiyate| prāglādeśātpunarddhātvadhikāre'lo'ntyasya vidhayo bhavantīti ekārasyaikāravacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti kṛtvāntareṇāpi śakāramantye'lyanusaṃhāraṃ bādhitvā sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati, kiṃ śakāreṇa! yadyādhyāyaparisamāpterayamadhikāraḥ? ādye yoge na vyavāye tiṅaḥsyuḥ, ādye yoge tibādisūtre ye'mī lāvasthāyāṃ syādayo vidhīyante teṣu kṛteṣu tairvyavadhāne tibādayo na syuḥ| kariṣyati, hariṣyati, karttā, śabādiṣu tu na doṣaḥ; teṣāṃ sārvadhātukāśrayatvādakṛte lādeśe prāptyabhāvāt; tibādayaśca tatra sāvakāśāḥ|
na syādetvam, ṭeṣṭitāṃ vyavāya ityeva---pacate yajate, kva tarhi syāt? āste, śete, dhatte, rundhe, bebhidāte ityādau yatra na vikaraṇāḥ santi|
eśaḥ śittvam `liṭastajhayoreś' ityayameś śitkartavyaḥ| etaccopakrama eva vyākhyātam|
yacca loṭo vidhatte tacca vikaraṇavyavāye na syāt---`loṭo laṅvat'`eruḥ' `serhyapicca' ityādi, pacatu, pacatamityādi, stautu, juhotu, bhinattu, āstāmityādāveva syāt|
yaccāpyuktaṃ laṅliṅostacca na syāt---`nityaṃ ṅitaḥ',`itaśca',`tasthasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ' `liṅaḥ sīyuṭ' `yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca' ityādi, tathā `thāsaḥ se' pacase ityādau na syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate---dhātorvihitasya loṭa iti| yadyevam, `vido laṭo vā' ityatrāpi viderddhātorvihatasya laṭastibādīnāṃ ṇalādaya iti vijñāyamāne vindati, vindataḥ, vindantīti lābhārthasya vikaraṇena vyavāye'pi ṇalādayaḥ prāptuvanti? na kvaciddhihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ dhātugrahaṇamiti sarvatra tathā bhavitavyam| atha vātra dhātunā vihitaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, vidinā''nantaryam---dhātorvihitasya laṭo videranantarasyeti, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' ityavāpi dhātunā vihitaṃ viśeṣyate, abhyastena cānantaryam---dhātorvihitasyābhyastādanantarasya ṅito jheriti; tenājakṣiṣyan, ajāgariṣyannityādau na bhaviṣyati| `ātaḥ' ityatra katham, yadi tāvaddhātorvihitasyākārādanantarasyeti, alunan apunan atrāpi prāpnoti? atha ākārāntādvātorvehitasyeti, apibannityatra prāpnoti? astu dhātorvihitasyākārādanantarasyeti, alunan ityatra lunā jhi iti sthite `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' iti lope kṛte ākārābhāvānna bhaviṣyati, nātra lopaḥ prāpnoti? `ī halyaghoḥ' itītvena bādhyate| evamapyākārānna bhaviṣyati? nātretvaṃ prāpnoti, antibhāvena bādhyate? nātrāntibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, jūs‌bhāvena bādhanāt? tadevaṃ lopa ītven, ītvamantibhāvena, antibhāvo jusbhāvena, jusbhāvo lopena, lopa ītveneti lopa ītveneti cakrakamavyavasthā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āyannādiṣūpadeśivadvacanādupadeśakāla eva jhasyāntibhāve kṛte lopaḥ, lopena vyavasthā| kiṃ cāta ityatra sijgrahaṇamanuvartate---ākārāntātsijlugantāditi, tena na kvāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| tadevamādhyāyaparisamāpterdhātvadhikāra iti sthitam|
vakṣyati tavyattavyānīyara iti| kiṃ ca syāt yadi tavyādividho dhātoritita nānuvartteta ṅyāpprātipadikādapi tavyādyaḥ syuḥ? sādhane tavyādayo vidhīyante, sādhanaṃ ca kriyāyāḥ| kriyāyā abhāvātsādhanābhāvaḥ, sādhanābhāvād ṅyāpprātipadikāttavyādayo na bhaviṣyanti| kathaṃ tarhi karmādiṣu vidhīyamānā dvitīyādayo bhavanti, naiva prātipadikārthasya sādhane dvitīyādayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? śabdāntaravācyakriyāpekṣe tasyaiva karmādibhāve; tavyādayastu prakṛtivācyakriyāpekṣe sādhane caritārthā na ṅyāpprātipadikādbhaviṣyanti? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam----satyāṇavayetyādayo ye'pabhraṃśāḥ kriyāvacanāstebhyastavyādayo mā bhūnniti; na hi te dhātavaḥ, bhūvādipāṭhāśrayatvāddhātusaṃjñāyāḥ| kiñca, sopasargāllaṅādayo mā bhūvanniti dhātvadhikāraḥ kriyate; anyathā prākarota, prāsthita, adhyaiṣṭeti dhātūpasargasamudāyasya viśiṣṭakriyāvacanatvāttataḥ pratyayavidhāvaṅgasaṃjñāyāmaḍādiprasaṅgaḥ| codayati----dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam, yaṅ‌vidhau dhātvadhikārāditi| `dhātorekācaḥ' ityatra yaṅ‌vidhau dhātvadhikārāditi `dhātorekācaḥ' ityatra yaṅ‌vidhau yaddhātugrahaṇaṃ tasyehādhikārādityarthaḥ| parihārati-----kṛdupapadasaṃjñārtha tviti| etadeva vyācaṣṭe----asminniti| asminnevetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| taddarśayati---pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti| asatyasminnadhikāre dhātvadhikāre yatsaptamyā nirddiṣṭaṃ tadupapadamityetāvānarthaḥ syāt, tataśca pūrvatrāpi syāt-----`cli luṅi' luṅanta upapade cliriti| evaṃ kṛtsaṃjñāpi dhātorvihitasyātiṅo bhavatīti pūrvatrāpi syāt, tataśca kariṣyatītyatra syapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ kṛdantaṃ prātipadikamiti prātipadikatve sati tiṅokte'pyekatve vacanagrahaṇādekavacanasya cotsargatvātsorutpattiḥ prasajyeta| tasmādasmindhātvadhikāre yathā syātāṃ pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti punarddhātvadhikāraḥ kriyate|
nanu cādhikāreṇa te saṃjñe vidhāsyete, pratyayasaṃjñā ca tatra, te pūrvatra bhaviṣyata ityāśaṃkya prayojanāntaramāha----ārddhadhātukasaṃjñārthe ceti| kaḥ punarārddhadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ dvitīyadhātugrahaṇasyopayoga ityata āha----dhātorityevaṃ vihitasyeti| lūbhiriti| atra satyapi prātipadikatve dhātutvamapyasti; pūrvapravṛttāyā dhātusaṃjñāyā anivartanāt| tataśca dhātorevāyaṃ vihita iti ārdhadhātukasaṃjñā syādeva| yadi tu śamidhātorityatra dhātugrahaṇasya dvitīyasyārddhadhātukasaṃjñārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, ayamapyadhikāraḥ śakyo'kartum| vāsarūpavidhirapyadhikāreṇa siddhaḥ, tena ksādibhiḥ sicaḥ samāveśo na bhaviṣyati||
tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham|| 3.1.92 ||
tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham|| `saptamostham' ityasyārthamāha--saptamyā nirdiṣṭamiti| saptamyā vibhaktyoccāritamityarthaḥ| saptamyantena padena pripāditamiti vā| asminpakṣe sūtre saptamośabdena saptamyantamucyate| saptamyantepade karmaṇītyādau pratipādyatvena sthitaṃ kumbhādikamityarthaḥ| prathame tu pakṣe kamaṇītyāderyaḥ saptamyā nirdeśaḥ, sa eva kumbhamityāderapi prayogagatasya saptamyā nirdeśaḥ, yathā----`tasyāpatyam' ityādau tasyeti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣāpalakṣaṇārthamiti tadoyameva prāthamyaṃ viśeṣāṇāmapi bhavati, tadvadatrapi| kumbhakāra iti atropapadatvātsamāsaḥ, kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca bhavati|
sthagrahaṇamityādi| sūtreṣu yaḥ saptamyā vibhaktyā nirdeśa uccāraṇaṃ saptamyantena vā padena pratipādanaṃ tadeva saṃjñāṅgamiti pratipattyarthamityarthaḥ| nanu saptamīśabdena sāhacaryātsūtrādiṣu saptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ grahīṣyate, nārtha etadarthena grahaṇena? tatrāha----anyathā hīti| mukhyārthasambhave gauṇasyāgrahaṇāt saptamyā eva saṃjñāsyāt; saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt| na cāsatassaṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāśakyā vidhātumiti yatra saptamī śrūyate tatraiva syādityarthaḥ| stamberama iti| `stambakarṇayoramijapoḥ' ityac, `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk| yatra veti| yatra sūtre saptamīśrutiḥ, saptamīśabdasya śravaṇamityarthaḥ| aśabdasaṃjñeti svarūpagrahaṇapratiṣedhādabhyupagamyavādo'yam, sarvatheṣṭaṃ sidhyatītyatra tātparyam| sthagrahaṇāttviti| sthagrahaṇe sati sautrasaptamyupalakṣitasya saṃjñāvidhānātsarvatra sidhyatītyarthaḥ|
nanu ca laghvartha saṃjñākaraṇam, tatkimartha gurvī saṃjñā kriyata ityata āha----gurusaṃjñākaraṇamiti| `upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam'---ityevamarthānugatā saṃjñā anvarthasaṃjñā| samarthaparibhāṣāvyāpārārthamiti| iha yadā svārthadravyaliṅgātmakastrikaḥ| prātipadikārtaḥ, tadā nāntareṇa vibhakriṃ karmādhikaraṇādyupapadamupapadyata ityavaśyamutpādyā vibhaktiriti padavidhitvādeva siddhaḥ paribhāṣāvyāpāraḥ, pañcakapakṣe'pi tu prātipadikasyaiva karmādyabhidhāyitvena padavidhitvābhāvātparibhāṣāvyāpāro na syādityanvarthayā saṃjñayā balātpravarttyate? naitadasti; pañcakapakṣe'pi vibhakyutpattyā padatve satyeva pratyaya iti pratipādanāt| nanu `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ' iti vacanātkathamupapadasya mubantatvam----sāmi smarttā bhavān? `upapadamadiṅ' ityatra hi supeti tṛtīyāntameva nivṛttam, subiti prathamāntamanuvartata ityavocāma, kathamaparathā carmakārādau nalopādi syāt! paśya kumbhaṃ karoti kaṭamiti| dhātoriti varttate, karmādiśabdāśca sambandhiśabdāḥ, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ----yasya dhātoryatkarmeti| evamapi mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotītyatra prāpnoti? na vā bhavati; dhātoryatkarmeti| evamapi mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotītyatra prāpnoti? na vā bhavati; mahākumbhakāra iti bhavati, yadetadvākyam----mahān kumbho mahākusbhaḥ mahākumbhaṃ karotīti| yadā tvetadvākyam-----mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karotīti, tadā neṣyate| kiṃ ca syād yadyatra syāt? kumbhaśabdasya kāraśabdena samāse kṛte tadartha ekārthībhāvāt mahaccabdena samāso na syād, anvarthatvādeva saṃjñāyāḥ saptamīnirdiṣṭatve'pi prakṛtyarthaviśeṇāttadviśeṣaṇānāṃ ca upoccāritapadatvābhāvādupapadasaṃjñā na bhavati|
atha tatra---grahaṇaṃ kimartham? dhātvadhikāraḥ pratinirdiśyate------tatraitasmiṃstṛtīye dhātvadhikāra iti| naitadasti prayojanam, adhikārādapyetatsiddham? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---saptamīsthasya pratyayotpattiṃ prati nimittatvaṃ yathā syāditi, katham? pratyaya iti varttate---saptamīsthamupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, tatra copapade satyeva pratyaya iti| atha karmaṇītyādikā satsaptamī, tatkuto'satyupapade pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ? na; karmaṇītyādikā sautrī spatamyarthāpekṣā, tathā hi satyaṇpratyayasyābhidheyaṃ karma syāt----yathā---`dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran' iti, tathā copapadatvaṃ na pratīyeta, ato yathetsaṃjñārthamanunāsikatvaṃ pratijñāyate tathārthanirapekṣā kevalamupapadasaṃjñāyā liṅgaṃ saptamī, tathā na chātoraṇ bhavati karma copapadamityetāvānarthaḥ syāt| karmaṇaḥ pratyayotpattiṃ prati nimittatvaṃ na pratīyeta, tasmāttadarthaṃ tatra---grahaṇam, kimidānīṃ heya evāyaṃ granthastatraitasmindhātvadhikāra iti? na brūmo heya iti, sopaskārastu bhavati---eta---smindhātvadhikāre yatsaptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, tatra ca sati pratyaya iti||
kṛdatiṅ|| 3.1.93 ||
kṛdatiṅ|| tiṅvarjita iti| tiṅtvena tyaktastiṅtvena rahitaḥ, tiṅo'nya iti yāvat|
