atiṅiti kimiti| iha kriyamāṇo'pyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ svāśrayāmeva tiṅaḥ kṛtsañjñaṃ bādhītuṃ prabhavati, na tu lakārasya kṛttvātsthānivadbhāvena prāptām; `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti vacanāditi matvā praśnaḥ| tiṅ‌bhāvino lakārasyaiva kṛtasañjñā pratiṣiddhyate, pratiṣedhasāmarthyādvā sthānivadbhāvo na bhaviṣyatītyuttaram| cīyātstūyāditi| nanu ca jñāpakādetatsiddham, yadayam `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti pṛthak sārvadhātuke pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tad jñāpayati----akṛditi pratiṣedho na tiṅkṣu bhavatīti| yadi syāt; cinuyāt, sunuyādityādau sārvadhātuke'pi kṛtpratiṣedhādeva dīrdho na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ pṛthak‌ sārvadhātukaparyudāsena! iha tarhi pacati, paṭhati----`hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' iti tuṅ mā bhūditi? tugvidhau dhātvāderityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate| evamapi---cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatītyatra prāpnoti? śapā vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyati| ekādeśe kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam? `ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavati' iti vyavadhānameva| nātra sthānivadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti; paratvādantavadbhāvena bāddhyate| tasmāccikīrṣatītyādau tuṅmā bhūdityatiṅiti pratiṣedhaḥ karttavyaḥ| kiñca, tiṅantasya kṛdantaṃ prātipadikamiti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ paceran---nalopaḥ prāpnoti, papāca brāhmaṇī-----ṭāpprāpnoti, sarvatra ca svadyutpattiḥ prasajyeta, tadetadasmādanyārthādatiṅiti pratiṣedhādeva siddhe cīyādityādau jñāpakaṃ nāśrayitavyamiti vṛttikāro manyate sma||
vā'sarūpo'striyām|| 3.1.94 ||
vā'sarūpo'striyām|| `asarūpaḥ' iti padacchedaḥ, anyathā lādhave viśeṣābhāvalādasandehartha `sarūpo'striyāṃ vā' iti brūyāt| apavādaviṣaye'pi keṣāñcitkṛtāṃ pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanam| yathoktam-----asarūpasya vāvacanamutsargasya bādhakaviṣaye nivṛttyarthamiti| paribhāṣā ceyam, asmindhātvadhikāre stryadhikāravyatirekeṇa yānyasarūpasyāpavādasya vidhāyakāni śāstrāṇi taccheṣabhūtā, tatra tatra vacane kriyamāṇe gauravaṃ syāditi sādhāraṇarūpeṇa paribhāṣyate| tatra ca `asarūpaḥ' iti vyartha kṛṇmātrasya vikalpane sarvasyaivāsarūpatvādyatkiñcitkṛdapekṣayā; asarūpapadaṃ caitatsāpekṣaṃ pratiyogini yato'tra bhinnarūpatvamasarūpatvamityate| kenaciddhi kiñcitsarūpamasarūpaṃ vā bhavati, tatra kenāsarūpa ityapekṣāyāṃ svavidhānavelāyāṃ yaḥ svasminviṣaye prāptaḥ sa eva buddhisthaḥ pratiyogī gamyate, apavādavidhānasamaye cotsargaḥ, tamapi viṣayamavāgāṛḍhumuḍhaukamāna upārūḍho buddhau bhavatīti tadapekṣayā bhinnarūpo'pavāda evātrāsarūpo vivakṣita ityāha---asarūpo'pavādapratyaya iti| evaṃ sthite yadyayamutpattivikalpassyād, apavādapratyayo vā bhavatīti, tataḥ svaviṣaye kāmaṃ vikalpastasya labhyate, na tūtsargaḥ pravartteta| tatrātadviṣayo hyasau, utsargāpavādaśāstrayorhi pramitivyāpāre paryavasite paścādiyamatraiva pradeśesthitā'pavādasya pakṣe pravṛrtti pratibadhnāti| apavādaśāstreṇa yaḥ svīkṛto viṣayastadvyatiriktaviṣayā sāmānyaśāstrasya pramitirityapavādasyāpravṛttāvapi naivotsargasya tasminviṣaye pramitiḥ pravṛttirvopapadyate, taddhitavat; tadyathā----dakṣasyāpatyam ata iñi vikalpite pakṣe'ṇ na bhavati, api tu vākyameva bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ? `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti taṭasthena pakṣe pravṛttirniruddhyate, na punarekavākyatayā prāptireva vikalparūṣiteti, tathehāpīti| apavādābhāvapakṣe prakṛtireva kartrādyabhidhānāyānujñātā syād, yathāgnicidityādau kvibādilope, tadāha---tatrotpattirvā prasaṅgo yathā taddhita iti|
tamimamutpattivikalpapakṣe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā bādhakatvaṃ vikalpyata ityāha---vābādhako bhavatīti| uktaṃ ca `siddhaṃ tvasarūpabādhakasya vāvacanāt' iti, asarūpo vā bādhako bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ| nanu tatratatrocyate---yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāstirbhavatipara iti, tataścāsarūpo vetyukte bhavatītyevādhyāhāro yuktaḥ, na punarvā bādhaka iti? ucyate---utpattivikalpasya prayojanaṃ kevalāyāḥ prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ, kevalā ca prakṛtiḥ svārthamātramabhidhātumasamarthā, kiṃ punaḥ kartrādikamabhidhāsyati! prakṛtipratyayasamudāye hi prayujyamāne'nvayavyatirekābhyāmayaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, ayaṃ pratyayārtha iti vyavasthāpyate; anutpannapratyayā tu prakṛtirna kañcidapyartha gamayati| prayogo'pi hi tasyā durlabhaḥ; paraśceti niyamāt| taddhite tvanutpattipakṣe'pyutsargapravṛttivyatirekeṇa pratyayāntaramasti ṣaṣṭhī, iha tu na tatheti sāmarthyādvahiraṅgamapi bādhakatvamapi kalpyate| nanu caca śāstraṃ śāstreṇa bāddhyate, na punaḥ kārya kāryeṇa, nidānocchedenaiva hi nidānina ucchedaḥ śakyate karttum, na hi pradīpe'nucchinne tatprakāśa ucchidyate, tatkimucyate---apavādapratyaya iti, evaṃ tu vaktavyam----apavādaśāstramiti? ucyate----sarvasyaivāpavādaśāstrasya svagatamasārūpyamavyabhicārīti pratyayadvārakaṃ tadāśrayaṇīyamityapavādapratyaya ityuktam| evambhūtasya pratyayasya vidhāyakaṃ śāstramityarthaḥ|
yadvā----pratyayasya bādhakatvavikalpasāmārthyācchāstramapi pakṣe bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati|
atha vā vṛttau vastumātraṃ darśitam; yathā tvayamartha upapadyate tathā sūtraṃ vyākhyeyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam---paribhāṣeyamityuktam, tatrekparibhāṣāvadiyamapi padamupasthāpayati----asmindhātvadhikāre yatrāsarūpo'pavādapratyayo vidhīyate tatra vetyupatiṣṭhate, stryadhikāre tu neti| kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? `dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā' ityādivat pramitireva vikalparūṣitā bhavati, tatastadvadevotsargasya pravṛttisidviriti| atha `asarūpa utsargapratyayo'pavādaviṣaye vā bhavati' iti vijñāyamāne ko doṣaḥ? na khalu kaściddoṣaḥ; apavādavikalpe prāpte vibhāṣā, utsargavikalpe tvaprāptavibhāṣeti, kintu pratiyogyapekṣamasarūpapadamapyapavādameva gocarayatītyuktam|
`astriyām' ityatra pakṣatrayaṃ sambhavati---abhidheyasaptamī vā syāt---striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ vāsarūpo na bhavatīti, striyāmityeva vā vihitasyāsarūpasya niṣedhaḥ syāt---striyāmityuccārya ye vidhīyante te neti, strīgrahaṇaṃ vā svaryate svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti---striyāṃ ktaninnityasminnadhikāre neti| tatrādye pakṣe vikṣipā, vikṣopikā, vikṣepteti kaviṣaye ṇvultṛcau na syātām| dvitīye tu `karmavyatihāre ṇac striyām' vyāvakrośī, vyāvakruṣṭiriti ṇayo viṣaye ktin na syāt, dvayorapi striyāmityuccārya vidhānāditi, mamādyayoḥ pakṣayordoṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā tṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha----stryadhikāravihitapratyayaṃ varjayitveti| kecidāhuḥ----apavādapratyayaṃ varjiyitveti vaktavye pratyayaṃ varjayitveti vacanaṃ pratyayamātraparigrahārtham, tenotsargāpavādayordvayorapi stryadhikāraniveśinorayaṃ pratipedhaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? āsanā, āsyā-----stryadhikāravihitenāpi yucāpavādena ṛhalorṇyataḥ samā veśaḥ siddho bhavati| ghañastu ktinnādibhiranabhidhānādasamāveśa iti| anye tu----apavādo vā bādhako bhavatīti prakṛtatvātsa evātra pratyaya iti vyācakṣate, tena ghañaḥ ktinnādibhirasamāveśaḥ| āsyetyatra kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti ṇyaditi| ṇvultṛcāvutsargāviti| cāvutsargāviti| dhātumātre vidhānāt| igupaghajñāprīkiraḥ ka ityapavāda iti| dhātuviśeṣe vidhānāt| kiṃ punaḥ prayogagatamasārūpyam? āhośvidupadeśagatam? kiṃ cātaḥ? prayoge lādeśeṣu pratiṣedhaḥ----hyo'pacadityatra luṅapi prāpnoti, prayoge hyasarūpatvāt, laṅyanackastakāraḥ pratyayaḥ luṅi apākṣīditīcchabdaḥ; śvaḥ kartetyatra lṛḍapi prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `haśaśvatorlaṅ ca' iti liḍviṣaye laṅaṃ śāsti, taj jñāpayati----na lādeśeṣu vāsarūpavidhiriti| evamapi grāmaṇīḥ, grāmanāya iti kvibādiviṣaye'ṇādayo na syuḥ, na hi kvibādayaḥ prayoge rūpavantaḥ, lopavidhānātteṣām| tasmādupadeśagatamasārūpyam| yadyevam, anubandhabhinneṣu vibhāṣāprasaṅgaḥ, kāṇorapi hyupadeśe bhinnaṃ rūpam, prayoge tu samānam, tatrāha---nānubandhakṛtamiti| anubandhānāmanekāntatvāttatkṛtamasārūpyaṃ nāśrīyate, tathā ca `udīyāṃ māṅaḥ' iti śrūyamāṇe'pi ṅakāre tasyānekāntatvādavyāhatamejantatvamityātvaṃ prayuktam| `dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā' iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ ca liṅgamasyārthasya; anyathā'nubandhakṛtādasārūpyādeva śaviṣaye ṇo bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tena!
iha ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu vāsarūpavadhiḥ prāpnoti| hasitaṃ chātrasya śobhanaṃ hasanaṃ chātrasya, atra ktalyuḍaviṣaye ghañapi prāpnoti| tumuna----icchati bhoktum, atra `icchārtheṣu liṅaloṭau' iti loṭ prāpnoti, tumunā ca bādha iṣyate, liṅ tu `liṅ ca' iti vacanādbhavātyeva| yadyevam, asmādeva niyamālloḍapi na bhaviṣyati| kalartha----āto yuc' īṣatpānaḥ, atra khalapi prāpnoti| nanu stryadhikāre tāvadastriyāmiti pratiṣedhādasyāpravṛttiḥ parastādapi vicchinnatvādeva na bhaviṣyati? syādetadevam, yadyayamadhikāraḥ syāt, paribhāṣā tveṣetyuktam| iṣyate ca stryadhikārādūrdhvamapi vāsarūpavidhiḥ-----āsitvā bhuṅkte,āsyate bhoktumityapi yathā syād; anyathā bhojanārthatvādāsanasya paurvakālyamavagamyate tumarthādhikārādbhāve ktvāpratyayastatraiva ca lakāra iti samānaviṣayatvādvādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ syāt| tathā kālo bhoktum, kālo bhojanasya---mumunā lyuṭo bādhaḥ syāt| tasmāt stryadhikārasya parastādapi vāsarūpavidhireṣitavyaḥ, `arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' ityatra kṛtyatṛjgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---stryadhikārasya parastādanityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| tasmāt ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu pratiṣedho'vaktavya eva||
kṛtyāḥ prāṅ ṇvulaḥ|| 3.1.95 ||
kṛtyāḥ prāṅ ṇvulaḥ|| ṇvulatṛcāviti vakṣyatīti| `rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvul bahulam' mityayaṃ tvavadhirna bhavati; `arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' iti pṛthak tṛco grahaṇāt| yadyevam, `prāṅ ṇvulaḥ' iti na vaktavyam, `kṛtyāḥ' ityevāstu, tṛjgrahaṇādeva jñāpakātparato'nuvṛttirna bhaviṣyati, yogāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakam `ṇvul‌tṛcau' ityasmādyogātprāk kṛtyasañjñādhikāra iti? satyam; `kṛtyāḥ' ityetāvadeva paṭhitaṃ sūtrakāreṇa| vṛttikārastu, bhāṣye pūrvapakṣarūpeṇa paṭhitaṃ sūtre pracikṣepa| vicitrā hi vṛtteḥ kṛtirvṛttikāreṇa! `kṛtyāḥ' iti bahuvacanamanuktasamuccayārtham, tena `kelimara upasaṅkhyānam' ityādi nopasaṃkhyeyaṃ bhavati||
tavyattavyānīyaraḥ|| 3.1.96 ||
tavyattavyānīyaraḥ|| vaseriti| `vasa nivāse' ityasya grahaṇam, na tu `vasa ācchādane' ityasya lugvikaraṇasya| `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti vacanāttkarttari na prāpnotīti vacanam, ṇidvadbhāvārthaṃ ca| vāstavya iti| tadvitānto vā punareṣabhaviṣyati, vāstuni bhāvo vāstavyaḥ, digāditvādyat| avāstavya ityatra svarabhedo nāsti, `kṛtyokeṣṇuc' iti yadantodāttatvaṃ tadeva `yayatoścātadarthe' ityanena bhaviṣyati| kelimara iti| kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaḥ, rephassvarārthaḥ|
karmakarttari cāyamiṣyata iti| bhāṣye tu `pacelimā māṣāḥ, paktavyāḥ; bhidelimāssaralāḥ, bhettavyāḥ' iti śuddhe karmaṇi pradarśitam||
aco yat || 3.1.97 ||
aco yat|| ajgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| pūrvasūtra eva yadgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti praśnaḥ| yāvatetyādi| dvaye hi dhātavaḥ----ajantāḥ, halantāśca| tatra halantād ṇyataṃ vakṣyati, ataḥ pāriśeṣyādajantādeva yadbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|
ajantabhūtapūrvādapīti| pūrva bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ sup supā' iti samāsaḥ, ajantaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśca ajantabhūtapūrvaḥ| ditsyaṃ dhitsyamiti| dāño dhāñaśca san, dvirvacanam, `sanimīmāghu' ityādinā isa, `saḥ syārddhadhātuke' iti tatvam, `atra lopo'bhyāsamya' ditsa dhitsa iti sthite, anutpanna evārddhadhātuke buddhisthe evāto lope kṛte sampratyayaṃ kṛte sampratyayaṃ halanta hi ṇyat syād; ajgrahaṇāttu bhūtapūrvamajantatvamāśritya yadbhavati| tena `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvam, ṇyati tu titsvaritaṃ syāt| cikīrṣyamityādau tu ṇyadyatorviśeṣābhāvaḥ| `yato'nāvaḥ' ityatra hi `dvyacaḥ' iti varttate| yadā tvāddhaṃdhātuke parato lopaḥ, tadaitadaj‌grahaṇaṃ na kartavyameva|
takiśasītyādi| `taki hasane',`śasu hisāyām',`cate cade yācane',`yatī prayatne',`janī prādurbhāve',`yato'nāvaḥ' iti svarārtha janeryadvidhānaṃ janyamiti rūpam, na tu ṇyatāpi siddham; `janivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhāt| śasimapi kecitpaṭhanti-----tadvā nārāśaṃsyaṃ rādvyaṃ ca|
hano vā vadha ceti| hantervā yatpratyayo bhavati, tatsanniyogena ca vadhādeśaḥ| vadhyamiti| taddhitānto vā punareṣa bhaviṣyati---vadhamarhatīti vadhyaḥ, `daṇḍādibhyaḥ' iti yat|yadi taddhitaḥ, samāso na prāpnoti---asivadhyaḥ, musalavadhya iti, kṛti punaḥ sati `kṛrtṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ siddho bhavati| ghātyamiti| `hanastociṇṇaloḥ' iti tatvam, `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam||
poradupadhāt || 3.1.98 ||
poradupadhāt|| pākyaṃ vākyamiti| `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam| kopyaṃ gopyamiti| `kupa kopane', `gupa vyākulatve'| āpyamiti| `āplṛ vyāpto' eṣu triṣu `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati, titsvarita eva tu bhavati||
śakisahośca|| 3.1.99 ||
śakisahośca|| śaklṛ śaktāviti| upalakṣaṇametat, `śaka vibhāṣito marṣaṇe' ityasyāpi grahaṇam| ṣaha marṣaṇa iti| nanu `ṣaha śakyarthe' ityasyaiva parasmaipadino'nanubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ prāptam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyayavidhiviṣayatvādananubandhakaparibhāṣāyāḥ, tasmād dvayorapi grahaṇam| anye tu `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti vṛttikāroktayoreva grahaṇamicchanti||
gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge|| 3.1.100 ||
gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge|| anupasargemya iti| sūtre `anupasarge' iti vyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamīti bhāvaḥ| ata evopasargādanyo'nupasargastasminnanupasarge upapada ityartho na bhavati| evaṃ hi kevalebhyo na syāt, `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' ityatra subgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt? `anupasarge' iti hi varttate tatra nañivayuktanyāyeyenopasargasaddaśasya subantasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati|
niyamārthamiti| anupasargādeva yathā syātsopasargānmā bhūditi| kathaṃ tarhi tena na tatra bhavedviniyamyamiti? pramādapāṭho'yam, viniyāmyamiti pāṭhaḥ| etena `iti yatnopacaryam' iti vyākhyātam|
carerāṅi cāgurāviti| sopasargārtha vacanam| ācayā deśa iti gantavya ityarthaḥ| upanetā-guruḥ||
avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu|| 3.1.101 ||
avadyapaṇyavaryā gahyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu|| avadyamiti| nipātyata iti| vadernañyupapade `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' iti yatkapoḥ prāptayoryadeva yathā syād----garhya eva ca yathā syādityubhayārtha nipātanam| avadyaṃ pāpamiti| avadanārhatvāt| anudyamanyaditi| gurunāmādi| taddhi garhyaṃ na bhavatyatha ca vadanārhamapi na bhavati| atra kyabeva bhavati, yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, `nalopo nañaḥ',`tasmānnuḍaci'| paṇyaṃ vyavaharttavyamiti| nipātanasya rūḍhyarthatvāt paṇyaśabdasya ca tatraiva rūḍhatvāt| uktaṃ ca-----
dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyartha niyamasya ca|
anubandhavikārāṇāṃ rūḍhyarthaṃ ca nipātanam|| iti|
pāṇyamanyaditi| stutyamityarthaḥ| varyeti striyāṃ nipātyata iti| sūtre'vadyādīni avibhaktikāni pṛthak padāni, na tu dvandvasya jasantanirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ| śatena varyeti| `vṛṅ sambhaktau' ityasyedaṃ nipātanam; tatraivānirodhasambhavāt| vṛtyānyeti| `vṛñ varaṇe' `etistuśāsvṛ' ityādinā kyap| vāryā ṛtvija iti| `etistuśāsvṛ' ityatra vṛño grahaṇam, vṛṅastu strīliṅgādanyatra ṛhalorṇyadeva bhavati| bhaṭṭikāvye tu pum̐lliṅge'pi yadeva prayuktaḥ----`sugrīvo nāma varyo'sau bhavatā cāruvikramaḥ' iti||
vahyaṃ karaṇam|| 3.1.102 ||
vahyaṃ karaṇam|| vaherddhātoḥ karaṇe yatpratyayo nipātyata iti| arthavyākhyānametat| `vahyamiti nipātyate karaṇaṃ cedbhavati' iti vaktuṃ yuktam||
aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ|| 3.1.103 ||
aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ|| svaminyantodāttatvañceti| atha yo vaiśyaḥ svāmī ca, tatra katham? ucyate-----vaiśyākhyāyāmādyudāttatvam, svāmyākhyāyāmantodāttatvam| tathā ca `aryasya svāmyākhyāyām' iti phiṭsūtre ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| āryo brāhmaṇa iti| prāptavya ityarthaḥ||
upasaryā kālyā prajane|| 3.1.104 ||
upasaryā kālyā prajane|| upapūrvātsartteriti| bhauvādikasya jauhotyādikasya ca `sarttiśāstyarttibhyaśca' iti nirdeśātsūtrādvahirapi lukā nirddeśaḥ| prāptakālā kālyeti| `tadasya prāptam' iti varttamāne `kālādyat' iti yat| prajananam-prajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ, `janivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| upasaryā gauriti| garbhādhānārtha vṛṣabheṇopagantuṃ yogyetyarthaḥ, vṛṣabhopagamanasya prāptakāleti yāvat| upasāryeti| upasaraṇīyā, prāptavyetyarthaḥ||
ajarya saṅgatam|| 3.1.105 ||
ajarya saṅgatam|| saṅgamane karttarīti| sūtre `saṅgatam' iti `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ|' iti darśayati| karttarīti `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti bhāve bhā bhūditi nipātanāśrayaṇam| tena bhāve saṅgatakartṛke'pi ṇyadeva bhavati----ajārya saṅgateneti| ajariteti| tṛc||
vadaḥ supi kyap ca|| 3.1.106 ||
vadaḥ supi kyap ca|| anupasarge iti varttata iti| `satsūdviṣa' ityādau sūtre vakṣyati----upasargagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamanyatra subgrahaṇe upasargagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti| taccāvaśyaṃ tathaivāśrayaṇīyam----`supyajātau' `spṛśo'nudake kvin' ityādāvupasargagrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi, tataśca nārtha ihānupasargagrahaṇānuvṛttyā| subante upapade anupasarga iti| yadyapi pūrva bahuvrīheḥ pañcamyarthe saptamīti vyākhyātam, iha tu virodhābhāvāttatpuruṣātsvārtha eva saptamīti bhāvaḥ| brahmodyamiti| bhāve kyap, pūrvavatsaṃprasāraṇam| brahmavedaḥ, tasya vadanamityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sakarmakādbhāve kṛtyapratyayaḥ yāvatā bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti vakṣyati; na ca karmāvivakṣayā'karmakatvam; brahmeti karmaṇaḥ śrutatvāt? tasmāduttarasūtrādiha bhāvagrahaṇamapekṣaṇīyamityāhuḥ||
bhuvo bhāve|| 3.1.107 ||
bhuvo bhāve|| yattu nānuvartata iti pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt| nanu `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kṛtyā vidhīyante, `anupasarge' iti cānuvarttate, anupasargaśca bhavatirakarmaka eva, ataḥ sāmarthyādbhāva eva bhaviṣyati? nanu ca prāptyarthaḥ sakarmaka eva? satyam; vyaktinirddeśāt, prāthamyācca sattārthasyaiva grahaṇam| na caca kālādikarmaṇi prasaṅgaḥ anabhidhānāt, tatkimartha bhāvagrahaṇam? ityatrāha---bhāvagrahaṇamuttarārthamiti| `hanasta ca' iti sakarmakādapi hano bhāve yathā syād---brāhmahatyā vartata iti, karmaṇi mā bhūt----tvayā ghātyo vṛṣala iti||
hanasta ca|| 3.1.108 ||
hanasta ca|| brahāmahatyeti| svabhāvataḥ strīliṅgatvamasya kyabantasya, yathānyeṣāṃ bhāve kṛtyānāṃ napuṃsakatvam| chandasi tu kyabantasyāpi napuṃsakatvamiṣyate----sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe| chandisa ca striyāṃ cidvaktavyaḥ----asyai brahmahatyāyai tṛtīyaṃ parigṛhāṇeti| praghāto vartata iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ghañ pratyudāhriyate, na ṇyadityata āha----ṇyattu bhāve na bhavatīti| karmāvivakṣāyāmakarmakatve satyapīti bhāvaḥ| sakarmakāttu bhāve ṇyataḥ prāptireva nāsti||
etistuśāsvṛddajuṣaḥ kyap|| 3.1.109 ||
etistuśāsvṛddajuṣaḥ kyap|| `eti' iti tipā nirddeśaḥ kimarthaḥ? dhātograṃhaṇaṃ yathā syādivarṇāntasya mā bhūditi| atra ceṇa eva grahaṇam, neṅikoḥ, tayoradhipūrvayoreva prayogādetīti nirdeśānupapatteḥ| tathā ca----`rakṣārtha vedānāmadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam' iti bhāṣye yadeva prayuktaḥ| kecittu `iṇvadika iti vaktavyam' iti vacanādadhītyā mātetyapyudāharanti| stutya iti| hrasvasya tuk| śiṣya iti| `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' itīttvam, `śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam, `āṅaḥ śāsu icchāyām' ityasyāpi grahaṇamaviśeṣāt| tenāśāsyamiti dhātusvareṇa madhyodāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati| ṇyati tu `gatikārakopapadātkṛt' iti antasvaritatvaṃ syāt| kecittu `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' ityasyaiva grahaṇamicchanti| orāvaśyaka ityādi| iha stugrahaṇasyāvakāśa āvaśyakāvivakṣāyām----stutya iti; `orāvaśyake' ityasyāvakāśaḥ----avaśyalāvyamiti; avaśyastutya ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvād ṇyatsyāt, punaḥ kyabgrahaṇātkyabeva bhavati| vṛgrahaṇe vṛño grahaṇamiṣyate na vṛṅa iti| jñāpakāt, yadayam `īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ' iti vāryaśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ śāsti, tatra ceḍivandibhyāṃ sāhacaryādātmanepadino vṛṅo grahaṇam|
śaṃsiduhītyādi| `śaṃsu stutau' `duha prapūraṇe' guhū `saṃvaraṇe' | śasyamiti| kyappakṣe upadhālopaḥ| bhāṣye etadupasaṅkhyānaṃ na ddaṣṭam|
āṅpūrvāditi| `añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu'| ājyamiti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe kyap, pūrvadupadhālopaḥ| atha kasmād ṇyatyevopadhālopo noktaḥ? kutvaprasaṅgāttitsvaraprasaṅgācca| tasmātkyabanta eṣaḥ| yadyevam, avagrahaḥ prāpnoti---ājyamityā ajyamiti? avagṛhyatām, ko doṣaḥ? na hi lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ, kintu padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvarttyam| padavicchedo hi pauruṣeyaḥ, saṃhitaiva tu nityā| artha cārthaniścayābhāve nāvagṛhṇanti; yathā---- hariva iti, kiṃ hariśabda ikārānta uta haricchabdastakārānta iti sandehāt|
kathamiti| iṇa evaitadrūpamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| eriti| `i gatau' ityasya||
ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ|| 3.1.110 ||
ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ|| klṛpicṛtī varjayitveti| `klṛpū sāmarthye' `cṛtī hiṃsāgranthanayoḥ' kṛperlatvasyāsiddhatvāddakāralṛkārayossavarṇasaṃjñāvidhānācca ṛdupadhātvam| kṝta saṃśabdane ṇyadeva bhavatīti| `anityaṇyantāścurādaya' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣa iti bhāvaḥ| idameva ca taparakaraṇaṃ liṅgam----anityaṇyantāścurādaya iti| ṇijantāttu ṇilope kṛte cākṛte ca ditsyaṃ dhitsyamitivadyadeva bhavati|
pāṇisargyeti| pāṇibhyāṃ sṛjyata ityupapadasamāsaḥ, pūrvavatkutvam| evaṃ samavasargyetyatrāpi||
ī ca khanaḥ|| 3.1.111 ||
ī ca khanaḥ|| dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na `i ca khanaḥ' ityevocyeta, dīrghasya hrasvasya vā ādguṇe nāsti viśeṣaḥ, hrasvādeśe `ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' ityekādeśasyāsiddhatvād dhrasvāśrayastuk syāditi cet? na; padāntapadādyorekādeśastugvidhāvasiddhaḥ, anyathā vṛkṣecchatramiti ṅāvād‌guṇasyāsiddhatvād `che ca' iti hrasvāśrayo nityastuk syādityata āha----dīrghanirddeśa ityādi| etena hrasvadvayamatra vidhīyate, na dīrgha iti darśayati| pūrva tu yathāśrutāśrayaṇenoktamīkāraścāntādeśa iti| tatreti| praśleṣe sati| ye vibhāṣetyātvabādhanārtha iti| anyathā `ye vibhāṣā' ityasyāvakāśaḥ---khāyate, khanyate; asya tvavakāśaḥ----yasminpakṣe ātvaṃ nāsti; ātvapakṣe ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādantaraṅgatvāccātvaṃ syāt| etacca `ye vibhāṣā' iti viṣayasaptamīpakṣa ucyate| tadā hi yakārādau buddhistha eva bhavadāttvamantaraṅgam, ayaṃ tvikāraḥ kyapā saha vidhānādvahiraṅgaḥ| parasaptamīpakṣe tvidamevettvamantaraṅgam, paranimittamanapekṣya vidhānāt||
bhṛño'saṃjñāyām|| 3.1.112 ||
bhṛño'saṃjñāyām|| bhartavyā ityartha iti| etena kriyāśabdatvaṃ darśayan saṃjñātvamapākaroti| saṃpūrvādvibhāṣeti| asaṃjñāyāmeva sūtreṇa nityaṃ prasaktasya kyapo'yaṃ vikalpaḥ| prāptavibhāṣetyarthaḥ|
saṃjñāyāmityādi| pratiṣedhasyeti śeṣaḥ| asaṃjñāyāmityasya pratiṣedhasya bhāryo nāma kṣatriya ityatra puṃsi ddaṣṭatvāccaritārthatvānna te-sūtrakārasya bhāryā śabdaḥ siddhyatītyaparthaḥ| puṃsi caritārthe hi pratiṣedhe striyāṃ kyapā bhavitavyam| nanu bhāryāśabdo'pi saṃjñā, abhriyamāṇāpi hi bhāryā bhāryetyucyate, tatkuto'sya kyapaḥ prasaṅgaḥ? na brūmo'nena kyapā bhavitavyamiti; yastu saṃjñāyāmeva vidhīyate `saṃjñāyāṃ samajani' ityādinā, tasyātra prasaṅgaḥ| na ca tasyāpi pratiṣedhasāmarthyānnivṛttiḥ, puṃsi pratiṣedhasya caritārthathvāditi codyam| uttaramāha---striyāṃ bāvādhikāro'stīti| nanu `sañjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada' ityatra vakṣyati---`bhāva iti na svaryate pūrvaka evārthādhikāraḥ' iti, yathā---samajanti tasyāmiti samajyā, niṣadanti tasyāmiti niṣadyetyādi bhavati, tatkathamidamucyate----striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'stīti? nedamapūrva codyam, vṛttikāra eva hi tatra vakṣyati----kathaṃ taduktaṃ striyām bhāvādhikāro 'stīti| striyāṃ strīprakaraṇe `saṃjñāyāṃ samajani' ityādinā kyapi vidhīyamāne bhāvasyādhikāro'bhidheyabhāvopagamalakṣaṇo vyāpāro'sti; śabdaśaktisvābhāvyād| bhāva eva tena kyab bhavati, na karmaṇi, tena bhāryā prasiddhyatīti karmaṇītyabhiprāyaḥ| `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' iti `bhṛñ bharaṇe' ityasyaiva kyabvidhau grahaṇam, na `ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' ityasya| atastasmādvā `bhṛñ bharaṇe' ityasmāddīrghāntādvā bhāryeti prasiddhyatīti parihārāntaramapyatra sambhavati||
mṛjervibhāṣā|| 3.1.113 ||
mṛjervibhāṣā|| parimārgya iti| `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' pūrvavatkutvabh||
rājasūyasūryamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ|| 3.1.114 ||
rājasūyasūryamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ|| rājñā sotavya iti| abhiṣiktaḥ kṣatriyo rājā, tena sotavyo'bhiṣavadvāreṇa niṣpādayitavya ityarthaḥ, karmaṇi kyab dīrghatvaṃ ca nipātyate| rājā vā iha sūyata iti| atra pakṣe latātmakaḥ somo rājā, rājānaṃ krīṇantītyādau darśanāt| sunotiratrāpyabhiṣave| adhikaraṇe kyab‌nipātanaṃ rūḍhyartham, tena jyotiṣṭomādau na bhavati| pūrvasminnapi pakṣe'śvamedhādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| sūsatibhyāmiti| nanu `sarterutvaṃ suvatervā ruḍāgamaḥ' ityabhidhānādvikalpo'trābhipreta iti cārthābhāvād dvandvānupapattiḥ? bhāṣyakāraprayogāttu dvandvaḥ| prayuktaṃ hi bhāṣye `sūsarttibhyāṃ ca sartterutvaṃ suvatervā ruḍāgamaḥ' iti| sartarutvamiti| dīrghatvaṃ tu raparatve sati `hali ca' ityeva siddham| suvatervā ruḍāgama iti| suvateriti pañcamī, suvateḥ parasya kyapa ityarthaḥ| rugāgama iti pāṭhe ṣaṣṭhī| saratīti ākāro| `ṣū preraṇe' tudādiḥ, karmaṇi lokaṃ prerayatītyarthaḥ, udite hi tasminkriyāsu lokasya pravṛttiḥ| kartṛ pratyayena karttari nipātanaṃ darśayati| evaṃ rucyāvyathyayorapi draṣṭavyam| āha ca `sūryarucyāvyathyāḥ karttari' iti| kupyamiti| saṃjñāyāmetadiṣyate, suvarṇarajatavyatiriktasya dhanasyeyaṃ saṃjñā| sarvatrātiprasaṅgo nipātanāśrayeṇa parihāryaḥ| karmakartari nipātanamiti| antodāttasya ceti draṣṭavyam| āha hi----`kṛṣṭapacyasyāntodāttatvaṃ karmakartari ca' iti| śuddhe tu karmaṇi kṛṣṭapākya ityeva bhavati||
bhidyoddhyau nade|| 3.1.115 ||
puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre|| 3.1.116 ||
puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre || puṣyantyasminnarthā iti| ārabdhā iti śeṣaḥ| siddhantyasminniti| atrārthā ityapekṣyate| puṣpasiddhaśabdau paryāyau| svarūpaparatvāttu sūtre dvandvaḥ||
vipūyavinīyajityā muñjakalkahaliṣu|| 3.1.117 ||
lipūyavinīyajityā muñjakalkahaliṣu|| vipūyo muñja iti| rajvādikaraṇāya śodhayitavya ityarthaḥ| vinīyaḥ kalka iti| kalkaśabdo'yamasti piṣṭa auṣadhe----`pathyā suṇṭhī saindhavāṃśasya kalkaḥ peyo nityaṃ sarvarogakṣayāya' iti, taile ghate vā auṣadhe prakṣipte yadajīṣaṃ tatrāpi varttate, tāpe ca prasiddhaḥ----`tapo na kalko'dhyayanaṃ na kalkaḥ' ityādau; iha tu prathamasya grahaṇamiti kecit| viśeṣeṇeti vayam, tathā ca māghaḥ prāyuṅkta----`avinīya saṃbhramavikāsibhaktibhiḥ' iti| jitya iti| balenākraṣṭavyaḥ| kṛṣṭasamīkaraṇārthaṃ sthūlaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ haliricyutyate||
pratyapibhyāṃ graheśchandasi|| 3.1.118 ||
padāsvairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca|| 3.1.119 ||
padāsvairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca|| asvairiṇīti| `īra preraṇe' svayameverituṃ śīlamasyā iti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ, `svādīreriṇoḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ| bāhyāyāmiti| bahirbhavā `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' iti yañṭilopau, pakṣe bhavaḥ pakṣyaḥ digāditvādyat| yasya pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihiteti| nanu padāvayavasya dvivacanādeḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā, na tu padasya? satyam; yaugikastvayaṃ padaśabdaḥ----padyate magyate'nenārtha iti| yadvā prātiśākhye dvivacanānte pada eva prakṛhyaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ| sannikarṣo'tra gṛhṇāterarthaḥ| svarasandhyabhāvādagnī ityādau kiyatāpi kālena vyavadhānātparasparamaco na sannikṛṣyante| avagṛhyamiti| samāse pūrvapadam, tatra hi padakāle'vagraho vicchedaḥ gṛhyakā ime gṛhītikā ityartha iti| ubhayatrānukampāyāṃ kan| pañjarādibandhena paratantrīkṛtāḥ śukādaya ucyante| grāmagṛhyeti| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| vāsudevagṛhyetyatra tu karttari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā vā samāsaḥ||
vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ|| 3.1.120 ||
vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ|| vṛṣyamiti| `vṛṣu secane'||
yugyaṃ ca pattre|| 3.1.121 ||
yugyaṃ ca pattre|| patatyaneneti pattramiti| `dāmnīśasa' ityādinā karaṇe ṣṭran| `tadvahati rathayugaprasaṅgam' iti prāgdīvyatīyenaiva yathā siddham| svare'pi nāsti bhedaḥ----kyapi dhātusvaraḥ, yatyapi `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvam, ayugyamityatrāpi na svare bhedaḥ, `yayatoścātadarthe' `kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca' ityubhayatrāntodāttavidhānāt||
amāvasyadanyatarasyām|| 3.1.122 ||
amāvasyadanyatarasyām|| amāśabdaḥ sahārthe vartata iti| amātya ityādau darśanāt| tasminnupapada iti| upapadatvamapi nipātanādeva, ameti vā saptamyā lukā nirdeśaḥ| takāroccāraṇātprakṛtasya kyapastāvannipātanaṃ na bhavati| yadi tu paramaprakṛtasya yato nipātanaṃ syāt svare doṣaḥ----syāt---yati sati vasyāśabde `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvam; kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve'pi sa eva svaro'vatiṣṭheta, ṇyati tvantasvaritatvaṃ bhavati| tathā yatā mukte'māvāsyetyadhikaraṇe ṇyanna prāpnoti, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bhaviṣyati| evamapyupapadasamāso na prāpnoti? mayūravyaṃsakāditvādbhaviṣyati| evamapi `gatikārakopapadāt' iti svaro na prāpnoti? tathā `amāvāsyāyā vā' iti ṇyadantasya yatkārtha tadyadantasyāmāvasyaśabdasya na syād, bhinnatvāt? iti yadantapakṣe doṣaṃ ddaṣṭvā prakṛtasyāpi ṇyata eva nipātanamityāha----ṇyatpratyayo bhavatīti| kiṃ tarhi ucyate-----ṇyatpratyayo bhavatīti, na punarṇyatpratyayo nipātyata iti? satyam, sa evārthaḥ, nipātanād ṇyatpratyo bhavatītyarthaḥ| anyatarasyāṃ vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyata iti| ṇyatpratyayo nityaḥ, vṛddhyabhāvastu pākṣika ityarthaḥ| saha vasata iti| sannikṛṣṭau vasata ityarthaḥ| yaduktam---ṇyatprayayo nipātyata iti, tatrāyaṃ guṇa ityāha---ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi| ṇyati hyamāvāsyeti svataḥ prāptaṃ rūpam, vṛddhyabhāvastu tasyaiva vikāra iti bhāvaḥ| yadvā-----ṇyati vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ pakṣe hrasvo'pi nipātyate, sa eva vṛddhyabhāva uktaḥ| evaṃ śloke'pyavṛddhitāmiti|
kimatra nipātyata ityāśaṅkāyāṃ ślokaḥ-----amāvasorityādi| vṛddhibhāvābhāvakṛtaviśeṣāśrayo dvivacananirddeśaḥ| nipātayāmīti| ekasyaiveti śeṣaḥ, abhāpūrvayorvasorṇyantayormadhya ekasya vṛddhyabhāvamahaṃ nipātayāmītyarthaḥ| sūtrakāreṇaikyamāpannasyaitadvacanam| tathā sati kiṃ siddhamityatrāha---tatheti| ekā taddhitavṛttirekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād etayordvayorapi siddhyatītyarthaḥ| svaraśca me prasiddhyatīti| evaṃ nipātayato mama svaro'pi siddhyati| vyākhyātaḥ svaraḥ||
chandasi niṣṭarkyadevahūyapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamarthastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchacyapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛḍāni|| 3.1.123 ||
chandasi niṣṭarkyadebahuyacapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamaryastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchyapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛdāni|| nugabhāvaśceti| yadā juhotestadeti bhāvaḥ| upacāyyapṛḍamiti| `mṛḍa sukhe'`pṛḍa ca' ityetasmāt `igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, upacāyyaṃ ca tatpṛḍaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ| hiraṣye ceti vaktavyamiti| hiraṇye'bhidheya ityarthaḥ| vyatyayamiti| ādyantaviparyāsa ityarthaḥ|
ṇyadekasmāditi| ekasmādvātorṇyatpratyayo nipātyate, tadanantareṣu devahūyādiṣu caturṣu caturbhyo dhātubhyaḥ kyab nipātyate, upasargabhedānnayaterbhedaḥ| dvau kyapāviti| dvābhyāṃ dhātubhyāṃ dvau kyapau nipātyete ityarthaḥ| ṇyadvidhiścaturiti| sujantametat, kriyābhyāvṛttivācicaturo vā ṇyadvidhīyata ityarthaḥ||
ṛhalorṇyat|| 3.1.124 ||
ṛhalorṇyat|| ṛvarṇāntāditi| arttestu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; halā sāhacaryāt, paraṃ kāryamiti nirddeśād, `īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ' iti liṅgācca||
orāvaśyake|| 3.1.125 ||
orāvaśyake|| avaśyaṃ bhāva āvaśyakamīti| manojñāditvād vuñ, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ| kiṃ punaravaśyārthavācinyupapade pratyaye? āhosvidāvaśyake dyotye? tatrādye pakṣe upapadarahitātpratyayo na syāt---lāvyaṃ pāvyamiti, tasmād dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyata ityāha---āvaśyake dyotya iti|
svarasamāsānupapattiriti| upapadapakṣe upapadasamāso labhyate, gatikārakopapadātkṛdityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca; dyotyapakṣe tvetadubhayamapi na siddhyatītyarthaḥ| avaśyalāvyamīti| `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti malopaḥ| dyotitārthasyāpi kvacitprayogo ddaśyate, lāghavaṃ pratyanādarāt| na tvetadatra vaktavyam; `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti vacanādeva dyotite avaśyamaḥ prayoga iti tasyāvaśyakarttavyādau caritārthatvāt| mayūravyaṃsakāditvāditi| tasyākṛtigaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ| uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve ceti | mayūravyaṃsakādinipātanādeva svaro'pi bhaviṣyatītyapi śakyaṃ vaktum||
āsuyuvapirapilapitrapicamaśca|| 3.1.126 ||
āsuyuvapirapilapitrapicamaśca|| puprabhṛtīnāṃ dvandvena āsunoterdvandva ityāhuḥ| sunoterabhisambandhastadāha---āṅpūrvātsunoteriti| `ṣu prasavaiśvaryayoḥ' ityasyatvagrahaṇam `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti| `yu' iti `yumiśraṇe ityasya grahaṇam| `yuñ bandhane' ityasya tu sānubandhakatvādagrahaṇam| yato'pavāda iti| `aco yat' `poradupadhāt' iti yathāyogaṃ prāptasya| dābhyamiti| dabherdhātuṣvapaṭhitasyāpi curādau `bahulametannidarśanam' iti vacanācchiṣṭaprayogācca kṣapayatyarthayatyavadhīrayatyādivaddhātutvaṃ draṣṭavyam||
ānāyyo'nitye|| 3.1.127 ||
ānāyyo'nitye|| rūḍhireṣeti| tena ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīya iti| nipātanācca rūḍhitvam| uktaṃ hi----rūḍhyarthaṃ ca nipātanamiti| kutaḥ punaranityatvamityatrāha---tasya cānityatvamiti| nityamajāgaraṇāditi| satatamajvalanādityarthaḥ, jvalanameva hi tasya jāgaraṇam| dakṣiṇāgnāvapi viśiṣṭa eveṣyate, na sarvatraiveti darśayati---yaśceti| yoniḥ-utpattisthānam| vaiśyakulādityādināyonivikalpaṃ darśayati|
ānāyyo'nitya iti cediti| ghaṭādiṣvapi prasaṅga iti śeṣaḥ| bhavediti| sambhāvane liṅ| nipātanādeva sambhāvyata ityarthaḥ| ekayonāviti| āhavanīyena| āneyo hyanyathā bhavediti| ghaṭādāvanityebhinnayonau ca dakṣiṇāgnau, `aco yat' iti yadeva bhavatītyarthaḥ||
praṇāyyo'sammatau|| 3.1.128 ||
praṇāyyo'sammatau|| asammatāviti bahubrīhityāha---avidyamānā saṃmatirasminniti| sammatiścātra saṃmananaṃ prītiviṣayabhāvopagamanaṃ karmavyāpāro vivakṣyate, na saṃmantṛvyāpāraḥ; tathā satyasaṃmantari nipātanaprasaṅgāt, tasya cāniṣṭatvādityabhiprāyeṇāha----saṃmatatā saṃmatiriti| saṃmatiramilāṣo'pyucyata iti| bhogaviṣayo'pyādaraḥ sammatiśabdenocyate, tantreṇetyarthaḥ||
pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu|| 3.1.129 ||
pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu|| mīyate'neneti mānam, hūyata iti haviḥ, nivasatyasminniti nivāsaḥ, samidhāmādhānī ṛk sāmidhenī| māṅo ṇyatpratyaya iti| karaṇe tatra `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk| meyamanyaditi| bhāvakarmaṇoryadeva bhavatītyarthaḥ| sānnāyyamiti| samyagnīyate homārthamagniṃ pratīti karmaṇi ṇyat| havirviśeṣa iti| aindraṃ dadhyamāvāsyāyāmaindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyāmiti vihitayordadhipayasoḥ| māghastu yathāśrutārthagrāhī havirmātre prāyuṅkta----`hutamayamavalīḍhe sādhu sānnāyyamagniḥ' iti| nicīyate'smindhānyādikamiti adhikaraṇe ṇyat| dhāyyeti| dhīyate'nayā samiditi karaṇe ṇyat, pūrvavadyuk| ṛgviśeṣasyeti| `pravovājā abhidyavaḥ' ityādikasya| ki tarhi kācideveti| samidhyamānavatīṃ samiddhavatīṃ cāntareṇa vikṛtiṣu prakṣipyamāṇā pṛthuyājā amartya ityādikā| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyata ityāha----rūḍhiśabdohya yamiti| ata eva nipātanāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| rūḍhitvameva draḍhayati----tathā ceti| dhāyyāḥ śaṃsatīti jyotiṣṭome maruttvatīye śastre vidhānametat| sāmidhenīgrahaṇaṃ prayogaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ||
kratau kuṇ‍ḍapāyyasaṃcāyyau|| 3.1.130 ||
kratau kuṇyapāyyasaṃcāyyau||ṇyati prakṛte yatpratyayāntaḥ kuṇḍapāyyaśabdo nipātya ityuktam, tatra prayojanamāha---yato'nāva itīti| yaduttarapadasyādyudāttatvaṃ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa sa eva svaraḥ siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṇyati tu svaritatvaṃ syāt||
agnī paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyāḥ|| 3.1.131 ||
agnī paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyaḥ|| agnāviti| na jvalane, kiṃ tarhi? tadarthaiṣṭakācayanaviśeṣe; tatraiva rūḍhatvāt| iha saṃpūrvāt `ūha vitarke, ityasmādanekārthatvādvaherarthe varttamānāddhalantatvād ṇyati samūhyamiti siddham| tathā ca----`samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmaḥ paśavo vai puruṣaḥ paśūnevāsya tatsamūhati' iti vahyarthenohinā brāhmaṇe samūhyaśabdo niruktaḥ||
cityāgnicitye ca|| 3.1.132 ||
cityāgnicitye ca|| cityo'gniriti| karmaṇi yadapavādaḥ kyab nipātyate, tenādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| bhāve yakārapratyaya iti| kimartha punaratrāpi kyabeva na nipātitaḥ, evaṃ hi tuga nipātyo na bhavati, tatrāha---tenāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| agnāvityeveti| tacca cityaśabdasyaiva viśeṣaṇārtham, nāgnicityāśabdasya; tasya bhāve nipātitatvāt| tadetaddarśitam---ceyamanyaditi||
ṇvul‌tṛcau|| 3.1.133 ||
nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ|| 3.1.134 ||
nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ|| ādiśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhyata iti| gaṇapāṭhāditi bhāvaḥ| apod‌dhṛtya ye paṭhyanta iti| te gṛhyanta ityanvayaḥ| apoddhṛtyeti buddhyā pṛthakkṛtyetyarthaḥ| kimartha punarapoddhṛtya pratyayavidhānam, yāvatā nandanādīnāṃ gaṇapāṭhādeva siddhaṃ sādhutvam? ucyate---asatyasminnaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ kvacidapyanupayogādraṇatrapayāṭho'nārṣo'dhyavasīyeta|
nandivāśītyādi| `ṭunadi samṛddhau', `vāśrṛ śabde',`madī harṣe', `duṣa vaikṛtye',`rādha sādha saṃsiddhau',`vṛdhu vṛddhau',`śubha śumbha śobhārthe',`ruca dīptau'| dūṣaṇa iti| `doṣo ṇau' ityūtvam| sahitapītyādi| `ṣaha marṣaṇe', tapa santāpe',`śamu damu upaśame'| jalpana ityādi| `jalpa japa vaktāyāṃ vaci'| `ramu krīḍāyām',`ddapa harṣavimocanayoḥ',`kradi āhvāne rodane ca'| `kṛṣa vilekhane',`hṛṣu alīke'| `ardda hiṃsāyām',janamarddayatīti janārdanaḥ, karmaṇyaṇi prāpte| evamuttaratrāpi karmaṇyupapade draṣṭavyam| `yu miśraṇe',`ṣūda kṣaraṇe'| madhunā'suraḥ, taṃ sūdayatīti madhusūdanaḥ| `ñibhī bhaye', ṇici `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk'| `lūñ chedane',`ṇaśa adarśane',`damu upaśame,----ṇyantau, cittaṃ nāśayatīti cittanāśanaḥ, kulaṃ damayatīti kuladamanaḥ|
grāhītyādi| `graha upadāne',`ṣaha marṣaṇe',`tasu upakṣaye',`dasu ca',`bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ'| tiṣṭhaterāto yuk| `matri guptabhāṣaṇe' curādiḥ, ardda hisāyām| rakṣetyādi| `rakṣa pālane',`śru śravaṇe',`ḍuvap bījasantāne',`śo tanūkaraṇe'---eṣā niśabda upapade ṇiniḥ| yācītyādi| `ṭuyācṛ yācñāyām',`hṛñ haraṇe',`vraja gato'`vadavyaktāyāṃ vāci',`vasa nivāse'---eṣāṃ pratiṣiddhānāṃ ṇinibhavati, prātaṣiddhārthānāmityarthaḥ| pratiṣiddhārthatā ca nañpūrvāṇāṃ bhavatīti darśayati| ayācītyādi| yadyapi viśabdo'pi vigarddabharathirityādau pratiṣedhe ddaṣṭaḥ, yācyādīnāṃ tu vipūvāṇā ṇinirna ddaśyata iti nañyeva ṇinirvijñāyate| acāmityādi| ajantānāṃ dhātūnāmacittakartṛkāṇāṃ pratiṣiddhārthānāṃ ṇinirbhavati, na vidyate cittamasyetyacittaḥ sa karttā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| viśayī viṣayīti| `śīṅ svapne',`ṣiñ bandhane', vṛddhyabhāvo nipātanāt| abhibhāvī bhūta iti| abhibhūtavānabhibhāvī| aparādhī, avarodhī| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau',`rudhir āvaraṇe'| paribhavī, paribhāvīti| pakṣe vṛddhyabhāvaḥ|
pacetyādi| `ḍupacaṣpāke'| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe',ḍuvapiruktārthaḥ, evaṃ vadirapi| `cala kampane',`patlṛ gatau'| nadaḍiti| `nada avyakte śabde'| ṭhakāro ṅībarthaḥ, evamuttaratrāpi| `bhaṣa bhartsane',pluṅ gatau',`cara gatyarthaḥ',`gṝ nigaraṇe',`tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ',`cura steye',`divu krīḍādau',`sūdiruktārthaḥ,`jṝṣ vayohānau',mṛṅ prāṇatyāge',`kṣamūṣ sahane',`ṣivu tantusantāne',`miṣa sparddhāyām',`kupa krodhe',`midhṛ medhāhisanayoḥ',`vraṇa gātracūrṇane'curādiḥ, `nṛtī gātravikṣepe',`ddaśir prekṣaṇe',`sṛplṛgatau'| `ḍubhṛjh dhāraṇapoṣaṇayāḥ',jāraṃ vibhartīti jārabharā| evaṃ śvānaṃ pacatīti śvapacā, nyaṅkvadiṣu śvapākaśabdasya pāṭhātpakṣe karmaṇyaṇapi bhavati| pacādirākṛtigaṇa iti| tatsambandhina ādiśabdasya prakāravacanatvāt| tathā ca `śivaśamariṣṭasya kare' iti kṛño'c pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ| ghaṭeśca `karmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac' iti| tathā yaṅantānāṃ `yaṅo'ci ca' iti yaṅo'sminnaci luguktaḥ| bhāṣye ca `ajapi sarvadhātubhyo vaktavyaḥ' ityuktam| pacādyanukramaṇaṃ tu nadaḍityādāvanubandhāsañjanārtham, karmopapadānām igupadhānāṃ ca bādhakabādhanārtham, deveḍityubhayārtham, anyeṣāṃ tu prapañcārtha draṣṭavyam||
igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ|| 3.1.135 ||
igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ|| igupadhādīnāṃ samāhāradvandve napuṃsakatvena hrasvaprasaṅgaditaretarayoge dvandvaḥ, vyatyayena bhyasaḥ pañcamyekavacanam| tatra kṛśabdasya dhātvanukaraṇatvātprakṛtivadanukaraṇam, vibhaktāvitvam| jña iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' priya iti| `prīñ tarpaṇe',iyaṅādeśaḥ| kira iti| `kṝ vikṣepe',`ṛta iddhātoḥ'| pacādiṣu draṣṭavyā iti yadyapyajapi tṛjādivatsarvadhātubhyo bhavati, tathāpyapavādabādhanārthamete pacādiṣvavaśyaṃ pāṭhyā ityarthaḥ||
ātaścopasarge|| 3.1.136 ||
pāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ|| 3.1.137 ||
pāghrādhmādheṭddaśaḥ śaḥ|| `pā pāne',`ghrā gandhopadāne',`dhmā śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ',`dheṭ pāne',`ddaśir prekṣaṇe'|`pā rakṣaṇe' ityasya tu lugvikaraṇatvādagrahaṇam| utpiba ityādi| pāghrādisūtreṇa yathāyogaṃ pibādaya ādeśāḥ| vyāghra iti| atra `ātaścopasarge' iti ka eva bhavati; atra ca `vyāghrādibhiḥ' iti vacanaṃ liṅgam||
anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca|| 3.1.138 ||
anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca|| `anupasargāt' iti vyatyayenaikavacanamityāha----anupasargebhya iti| `lipa upadehe',`vid‌lṛ lābhe'āgāminā numā sanumkayorgrahaṇam, tena vidhyantarāṇāmagrahaṇam| `dhṛñ dhāraṇe',`dhṛñ avasthāne'----ṇyantayordvayorapi grahaṇam| `pāra tīra karmasamāptau',`vida cetanākhyānādiṣu' curādiḥ, jñānādyarthānāmanyatamo vā hetumaṇṇyantaḥ| `ejṛ kampane'ṇyantaḥ, `citī saṃjñāne' curādiḥ, sātirhetumaṇṇyantaḥ, `ṣaha marṣaṇe' curādirhetumaṇṇyanto vā| limpaḥ, vinda iti| `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' `śe mucādīnām' iti num| dhārayādiṣu śabguṇāyādeśāḥ|
nau limperiti| chandasi tu `charttā ca vidharttā ca vidhāraya' iti ddaśyate|
aravinda iti| arākārāṇi dalānyaraśabdenocyante||
dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā|| 3.1.139 ||
dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā|| dadaḥ, dadha iti| śapaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ| `dada dāne',`dadha dhāraṇe'ityetābhyāmaci kṛte dadaḥ dadha iti siddham, dādhābhyāmapi ṇe kṛte dāyo dhāya iti, idaṃ tu vacanaṃ svarārtham---adadaḥ adadha iti `ackāvaśaktau' ityantodāttvaṃ mā bhūt, nañsvara eva yathā syāditi||
jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ|| 3.1.140 ||
jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ|| itiśabda ādyartha iti| anekārthatvānnipātānām `uccāvaceṣvartheṣu nipatantīti nipātāḥ' iti niruktakāro nipātaśabdaṃ nirāha| jvalitītyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ, jvalādibhya ityarthaḥ| kasirante yeṣāṃ te kasantāḥ, tatra ye kasamadhītya vṛditi paṭhanti teṣāṃ mate kasantagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam| nanu ca `jvala dīptau' iti dviḥ paṭhyate----ghaṭādiṣu, parastācca; teṣāmasatyasminviśeṣaṇe sandehaḥ syāt----kiṃ pūrvo jvalirādiḥ? uta para iti? ataḥ kasaḥ samīpabhūtebhyo jvalādibhya iti viśeṣaṇamarthavat, naitatsuṣṭhūcyate; yadyantaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ, bahuvrohau tatpuruṣe ca kasergrahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti, pūrvatra jvalatāvādāvabhiprete tadanantara eva dhāturupādīyeta; paropadeśenaiva jvalatergrahaṇasiddheḥ| ghaṭādipāṭhaśca mitsaṃjñāyāṃ caritārthaḥ, itarastvacaritārtha iti sa evādirbhaviṣyati| aco'pavāda iti| tasyāpi sarvadhātuviṣayatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `bhramu calane' ityasya jvalādipāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ,yāvatā pacādyaci bhrama iti siddham, ṇe'pyetadeva rūpam, `nodāttopadeśasya' iti pṛddhipratiṣedhāt? ihābhrama iti `ackāvaśaktau' iti svaro mā bhūditi||
śyādvyadhāsru saṃsvatīṇavasāvahṛlihaśliṣaśvasaśca|| 3.1.141 ||
śyādvyadhāsu saṃsvatīṇavasāvahṛlihaśliṣaśvasaśca|| anupasargāditi nivṛttamiti| uttarasūtre punaranupasargagrahaṇāt| vibhāṣeti ceti| nivṛttamityapekṣyate| vibhāṣā grahaṇaṃ hyanupasargagrahaṇena sambaddham, atastannivṛttāvasyāpi nivṛttiḥ| śyaiṅ iti | `śyaiṅ gatau' ityasmāt śī āt śyāditi śīṅo yaṇādeśena grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; vyākhyānāt, jhaṭiti pratītāvanārohācca| ākārāntebhya iti| etena atteracchabdāntānāṃ patiprabhṛtīnāmakārāntānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati| etadapi vyākhyānādeva| `vyadha tāḍane',`sru gatau' āṅpūrvaḥ, saṃpūrvaśca, `iṇ gatau' atipūrvaḥ, `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' `hṛñ haraṇe' avapūrvau, `liha āsvādane',`śliṣa āliṅgane',`śvasaprāṇane'| ye'tra sopasargāstebhyaḥ sopasargebhya eva bhavati, śeṣebhyastvaviśeṣeṇa| bādhakabādhanārthamiti| `ātaścopasarge' iti viśeṣavihitaḥ kaḥ sāmānyavihitasya ṇasya bādhakaḥ, tadvādhanārthamidam| etenāvasyaterupādānaṃ vyākhyātam| avaśyāya iti| pūrvavadyuk||
dunyoranupasarge|| 3.1.142 ||
dunyoranupasarge|| dāva iti| vanavahniḥ| kathaṃ tatraiva dava iti? nayatisāhacaryātsānubandhakasya dunoteriha grahaṇam| niranubandhakāddavateḥ pacādyaci bhaviṣyati| karaṇasādhano vā `ṛdorap' ityabantaḥ||
vibhāṣā grahaḥ|| 1.3.143 ||
vibhāṣā grahaḥ|| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| etadeva spaṣṭayati---jalacara iti| bhava iti| bhavatyeva na tu kadācinna bhavatīti bhavaḥ-devaḥ, saṃsāraśca| bhāvāḥ-padārthāḥ||
gehe kaḥ|| 3.1.144 ||
gehe kaḥ|| geha iti| pratyayāthaṃsya kartturviśeṣaṇam, nopapadam; `gṛhapatinā saṃyuktaḥ' iti nirdeśādityāha---gehe karttarīti| tāstthyāddārāśceti| gehamityapekṣyate, tena gauṇasyāpi gehasya grahaṇamiti darśayati| tacca tantrāvṛttyoranyata rāśrayaṇena labhyate, tatra veśmani puṃlliṅgabahuvacanānta eva----gṛhānha dāhako bhavati, gṛhānuttarayā saṃkāśayate, gṛhāngaccha, gṛhānahaṃ sumanasaḥ prapadya iti| napuṃsakaliṅgo'bhidheyavacanaḥ, evaṃ dāreṣvapi| anye tu---gṛhaśabdo veśmanyeva mukhyaḥ, dāreṣu gauṇa iti vadanti, tathā `na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityāhurgṛ hiṇī gṛhamucyate' iti veśmanyeva mukhyatāṃ darśayanti| yathā vṛttikāreṇoktaṃ tathā dāreṣvapi mukhya eveti lakṣyate||
śilpini ṣvun|| 3.1.145 ||
śilpini ṣvun|| pūrveṇa sāhacaryāt silpinītyapi pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇam, nopapadamityāha----śilpini karttarīti| kriyāsu kauśalaṃ śilpaṃ tadyasyāstīti silpo|
nṛtikhanītyādi| etadvacanameva; tenāhvātā, āhvāyaka ityādau na bhavati| rañjenunāsikalopaśceti| etattu jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `janījṝṣknusurañjo'mantāśca' iti mitsaṃjñāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati----rañjerakittve'pyanunāsikalopo bhavatauti||
gasthakan|| 3.1.146 ||
gasthakan|| gāyateriti| `kai gai śabde',`gāmādāgrahaṇe ṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti `gāṅ gatau' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāptam, anabhidhānānna bhavati| thakanpratyayo hi gāyatyarthaviṣayameva śilpinamabhidhātuṃ samarthaḥ||
ṇyuṭ ca|| 3.1.147 ||
ṇyuṭ ca|| ṇakāro yugarthaḥ, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti| uttaratra ṇyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, thakano mā bhūditi||
haśca vrīhikālayoḥ|| 3.1.148 ||
haśca vrīhikālayoḥ|| jahāteriti| `ohāk tyāge'| jihāteriti| `ohāṅgatau'| prāyeṇa jihīteriti pāṭhaḥ, sa tvayuktastipaḥ pittvādītvābhāvāt| jahāteḥ kakāro'tra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, anyathā ekānubandhakatvādasyaiva syāt| atha hāṅa ityucyeta, evamapi tasyagrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tasmād dvayorapi grahaṇam| `brīhikālayoḥ' iti kartturviśeṣaṇam, nopapadam; tricaturbhyo hāyanasya `dāmahāyanāntācca' iti vacanāditi matvāha---vrīhau kāle ca karttarīti| jahatyudakamiti| kṛtveti| vrīhau hāyanaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ darśitam| jāṅgaladeśodbhavāḥ kecid vrīhayo hāyanā ityāhuḥ| jihīte bhāvāniti| bhāvāḥ padārthāstān jihīte gacchati paricchedakatvena vyāpnotītyarthaḥ||
prusṛlvaḥ samabhihāre vun|| 3.1.149 ||
prusṛlvaḥ samabhihāre vun|| `prusṛlva' iti pañcamyāḥ sthāne jas, `ossupi' iti yaṇādeśaḥ| sādhukāritvaṃ lakṣyata iti| prāyaḥ sahacaritvāt punaḥ punaranuṣṭhānaṃ samabhihāraḥ, yaśca yāṃ kriyāṃ punaḥ punaranutiṣṭhati tasya prāyeṇa kauśalamupajāyate, ataḥ prāyaḥ sāhacaryātsādhukāritvaṃ lakṣyate, lakṣaṇayā tatra varttata ityarthaḥ, tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyāha----sakṛdapīti||
āśiṣi ca|| 3.1.150 ||
āśiṣi ca|| āśiṣi gamyamānāyāmiti| na vācyāyām; karttari kṛt' iti karttureva vācyatvāt| prārthanāviśeṣa iti| aprāptasyābhilaṣitasya prāptumicchā prārthanā-āśīḥ| sa cetkriyāviṣaya iti| `dhātoḥ' ityadhikārād, dhātośca kriyāvacanatvāt| amuṣyāḥ kriyāyā iti| jīvanādikāyāḥ, anena prayoktṝdharmatvamāśiṣo darśayati| jīvatāditi| āśiṣi loṭprayogeṇodāharaṇe āśiṣaṃ darśayati||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ||
<3.2>
kāśikāvṛttau
atha tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ padamañjarī
karmaṇyaṇ|| 3.2.1 ||
karmaṇyaṇ|| karmaṇīti| nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam; aśabdasaṃjñā iti pratiṣedhāt| nanu cārthasyeyaṃ sañjñā na śabdasya, aśabdasañjñeti naivaṃ vijñāyate-----śabdasya sañjñā śabdasañjñeti, kiṃ tarhi? śabde saṃjñā sabdasaṃjñeti| śabdaśabdena śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ vyākaraṇamucyate, asati ca bādhe kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| tasmātpāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇamaṅgīkṛtya tasyāvāntarabhedamāha----trividhaṃ karmeti| tā eva tisro vidhā darśayati---nirvartye vikārye prāpyaṃ coti| yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā yatprakāśate tannirvattyam, yathā-----kumbhaṃ karoti, putraṃ prasūta iti| yasya tu sata eva kaścidvikāraḥ kriyate tadvikāryam, sa ca vikāraḥ kvacitpratyakṣagamyaḥ, yathā---kāṣṭhāni bhasma karoti, suvarṇa kuṇḍalaṃ karotīti, kvacicchāstragamyaḥ----brīhīn prokṣatīti, atra prokṣaṇena brīhīṣu kaścidatiśayo janyata iti śāstrādeva gamyate| etāvatā ca bhedena saṃskāryametatkarmeti cāturvidhyaṃ mīmāṃsakā manyante| kriyākṛtaviśeṣābhāve tu prāpyaṃ karma, yathā-----vedamadhīte, carccāṃ pārayatīti| nanu na `kartturīpsitatamam' ityetadeva karma trividham, anyadapyasti `tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam' iti, tacca dvividham---dveṣyamitaracca; tathā `akathitaṃ ca', evaṃ `divaḥ karma ca', tathā `adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma' iti| tadevamavāntarabhedavivakṣāyāṃ saptavidhaṃ karma| uktaṃ ca----
nirvartya ca vikārya ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam|
tatrepsitatamaṃ karma caturdhānyattu sañjñitam||
audāsīnyena yatprāpyaṃ yacca kartturanīpsitam|
sañjñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyanyapūrvakam|| iti|
tatkimucyate trividhaṃ karmeti? kecidāhuḥ----kartturīpsitatamamevātra gṛhyate'nyatrāṇ na bhavatīti| anye tvāhuḥ-----ādityaṃ paśyatītyādau mā bhūdityevamartha karmaṇi nirvartyamāne vikriyamāṇa iti vaktavyamityāśaṅkya vārttikakāreṇoktam----karmaṇi nirvarttyamānevikrīyamāṇa iti cedvedādhyāyānāmupasaṃkhyānamityādi| tadanena pradarśyate trividhamapi karma gṛhyate, na punaḥ prāpyaṃ na gṛhyata iti, na tu sūtrāntaroktaṃ vyāvarttyate| tathā ca `divaḥ karma ca' ityatra samāveśasya prayojanamuktam---manasā deva ityatra karmatvādaṇ, karaṇatvāttṛtīyeti| evaṃ ca vṛkṣāvāsaḥ parvatādhivāsa ityādyapi yathādarśanaṃ bhavatīti| anabhidhānāditi| taccānabhidhānaṃ yatrāptairuktaṃ tatraiva| anyatra tu yathālakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, tathā ca paṭhati----yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte'iti|
śīlikāmītyādi| `śīla samādho',`bhakṣa adane' curādiḥ, `kamu kāntau' ṇiṅantaḥ, `cara gatyarthe' āṅpūrvaḥ, ṇasya ṇitkaraṇaṃ carervṛddhyartham| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ceti| kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvarasyāpavādaḥ| māṃsaśīleti| atrāṇi sati ṅīpsyāt, ṇe'pi kvacidaṇkṛtaṃ bhavatītyetattu tācchīlika eva ṇe bhavati| `manerdīrghaśca' iti sapratyayānto māṃsaśabdaḥ| kalyāṇaśabdaḥ `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' iti madhyodāttaḥ| asyāyamarthaḥ----ante laghoḥ parato dvayoścāntayorlaghvoḥ parato bahvaṣaḥ śabdasya yo guruḥ sa udātto bhavati| bahvaṣa iti bahvaca ityarthaḥ|`aṣ' ityacaḥ pūrvācāryasañjñā|
īkṣikṣamibhyāṃ ceti| atrāpi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ cetyeva, vākyabhedastu vaicitryārthaḥ| iha yo māsaṃ bhakṣayati māṃsaṃ tasya bhakṣo bhavati, tatra bhakṣayateḥ karmaṇyerajantasya bahuvrīhiṇā siddham| evamanyatrāpi| yaḥ punaraṇyantastasya ghañantasya bahuvrīhiḥ, nārtha etena| nanu bahubhakṣa ityatra bahornañvadityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? evaṃ tarhi bhāve'jantena vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhirbhaviṣyati----bahuṣu bhakṣo'sya bahubhakṣa iti, tatrottarapadārthasya bahutvābhāvādvahusvaro na bhaviṣyati? satyam; aṇbādhanārtha tu vacanam, akārādanupapadātkarmotapapado vipratiṣedhena| pacādibhyo'c, anupapado'kārastasyāvakāśaḥ----pacatīti pacaḥ, karmopapadasyāvakāśaḥ----kāṇḍalāvaḥ śaralāvaḥ; odanapāva ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| tenopadhāvṛddhiḥ, upapadasamāsaśca nityo bhavati| aci tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vikalpitaḥ syāt| na caca vācyaṃ yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ bhavatu vipratiṣedhaḥ, kevale pacyarthe vivakṣite'ci kṛte paścādodanasambandhe vivakṣite odanapaca ityapi prāpnoti? ekatvātprayogasya| na hi tasminneva prayoge vivakṣitaṃ cāvivakṣitaṃ ca karma bhavati| tasmādodanapaca ityasādhureva| gaṅgādharaḥ, śrīdharaḥ, vajradharaḥ, bhūdharaḥ, sragdhareti tu sañjñāśabdāḥ| yadā tvajapi sarvadhātubhya iti pakṣaḥ, tadāpavādatvādeva tasyāṇ bādhakaḥ| tathā `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' anupapadastasyāvakāśaḥ---vikṣipaḥ, vilikhaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva; kāṣṭhabheda ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| tathā `anupasargāllimpavinda' ityanupapadaḥ śastasyāvakāśaḥ----limpatīti limpaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva; kuṅmalepa ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati| `ātaścopasarge' iti ko'nupapadastasyāvakāśaḥ----suglaḥ suglaḥ, karmopapadasya sa eva; gosandāya ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādayamevāṇ bhavati||
hvāvamaśca|| 3.2.2 ||
hvāvamaśca|| veñ tantusantāne iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; akarmakatvāt| bhramaṇārtho hyasau----sarvā diśa āvāti vāta āvātu bheṣajamiti| sopasargasya tu sakarmakatve'pyagrahaṇam; pūrveṇaivāṇaḥ siddhatvāt| vātā vānti diśo daśeti prayogaścintyaḥ| athāpi kvacitkathañcitsakarmakatvam, tathāpi hveñā sāhacaryātsānubandhakasyaiva veño grahaṇam| māṅ māne iti| ṅito mārūpasyopalakṣaṇametat, tena `meṅ praṇidāne' ityasyāpi grahaṇam| `mā māne' ityasya tu saṃbhāvanārthasyākarmakatvādagrahaṇam|
āto'nupasarge kaḥ|| 3.2.3 ||
āto'nupasarge kaḥ|| kavidhau sarvatra prasāraṇibhyo ḍo vaktavyaḥ| saṃprasāraṇabhājaḥ---prasāraṇinaḥ| `jyā vayohānau' brahma jinātīti brahmajyaḥ, sarvatragrahaṇānnāvaśyamihaiva `ātaścopasarge'āhvaḥ prahvaḥ, ke hi saṃprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, āhva a iti sthite saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca kṛte uvaṅādeśe āhuvaḥ prahuva iti prāpnoti, evaṃ brahmajiya iti prāpnoti| nanu saṃprasāraṇe kṛte āto lopastasya sthānivadbhāvādiyaṅuvaṅau na bhaviṣyataḥ, lopo na siddhyati----antaraṅgatvātpūrvatvaṃ prāpnoti, samānāśraye ca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya iti? evaṃ tarhi prāgeva saṃprasāraṇādāto lopo bhaviṣyati, paratvād nityaṃ saṃprasāraṇam, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt' āto lopastvanityaḥ, kṛte saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatvena bāddhyate---yasya ca nimittaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate tadanityam| tadevaṃ paratvādāto lopaḥ, tataḥ saṃprasāraṇam, tata iyaṅuvaṅau prasaktāvāllopasya sthānivattvānna bhaviṣyataḥ| nanu yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvaḥ, ādiṣṭāccaiṣo'caḥ pūrvam---idānīmeva hyuktaṃ pūrvamallopaḥ paścāt saṃprasāraṇamiti? evaṃ tarhyākāralopasyāsiddhatvāduvaṅ na bhaviṣyati| ihāpi tarhi juhuvatuḥ juhuvatuḥ āllopasyāsiddhatvāduvaṅ na prāpnoti? ābhīyamasiddhatvamanityamityatra na bhaviṣyati| atha vā `saṃprasāraṇācca' `eḍaḥ padāntāt' ityatra eṅa iti yogavibhāgaḥ---saṃprasāraṇādeṅi parataḥ pūrvaparayoḥ pūrvamekādeśo bhavatīti| kimarthamidam, na `saṃprasāraṇācca' ityeva siddham? jñāpanārtham-----yatra saṃprasāraṇātpara eṅ saṃbhavati tatra `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' ityātvaṃ na bhavatīti| yadi syātpūrvatvena tasya nivṛttividhānamanupapannaṃ syāt| tena juhuvaturityatrānaimittikatvenāntaraṅgamapyātvamakṛtvā eṅ‌bhāvādeva liṭi vihite saṃprasāraṇe pūrvatve na sthānivattvaṃ nāsiddhatvamiti siddhamiṣṭam| āhvaḥ, prahvaḥ, brahmajya ityatra tvākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayo nāsatyātve bhavitumarhatīti pūrvamātvam, tataḥ pratyayaḥ, āllopaḥ, saṃprasāraṇam, asiddhatvādiyaṅuvaṅorabhāvaḥ||
supi sthaḥ|| 3.2.4 ||
supi sthaḥ|| supīti na saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? pratyāhārasya; `suptiṅantaṃ padam',`supa ātmanaḥ kyac',`supo dhātupratipadikayoḥ',`avyayādāpsupaḥ' ityādau tasyaiva prasiddhvāt| dvābhyaṃ pibatīti| nanu rūḍhiśabdā dvipādayaḥ, tataścāsantamapyavayavārtamāśritya karmopapada eva kaḥ kariṣyate? naitadevam; dvābhyāṃ pibatītyāderavayavārthasya sambhavato'parityāgenaiva vyutpattau sambhavatyāmasyāḥ kalpanāyā ayuktatvāt| yatra tvatyantamasambhavaḥ, yuktā tatraiva sā kalpanā, yathā---tailatapāyikādau| anena bhāve yathā syāditi| ārambhasāmarthyāttāvadayaṃ karturapakṛṣyate, na cānyo'rtho nirddiśyate| anirddiṣṭārthāśca pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, svārthasca dhātūnāṃ bhāva eva| nanu `ghañarthe kavidhānam' iti bhāve kaḥ siddhaḥ? satyam; nityasamāsārthantu vacanam, anyarthā pākṣikaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syād| nitya eva tūpapadasamāso bhavati, tathā cākhūnāmutthānamityasvapadena vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ| ghañarthe kavidhānamityatra sthagrahaṇaṃ kartṛvarjite kārake'pi yathā syāditi||
tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ|| 3.2.5 ||
tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ|| tundaparimṛja iti| mṛjerajādau saṃkrama ityatra `yasminvidhistadādau' ityeva siddhe ādigrahaṇaṃ mukhyājādiparigrahārtham, tena vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādāvatra ke vṛraddhirna bhavati|
ālasya ityādi| ālasye gamyamāne sukhotpādane ca pratyaya ityarthaḥ| tatra sāmarthyādalase karttari sukhasya cāhartari pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| śokāpanoda evānya iti| yassaṃsārānityatādyupadeśena śokameva kevalamapanudati, na tu sukhamutpādayati sa śokāpanodaḥ| mūlavibhujādibhya iti| tādarthya eṣā caturthī, mūlavibhujādisiddhyarthamirtthaḥ| ākṛtigaṇaścāyam, tena mahīdhra---kudhra---śiroruhādi siddhaṃ bhavati| kākaguhā iti| kākebhyo gūhitavyā iti karmaṇi kapratyaya iṣyate, ato ghañarthe kavidhānamityatredaṃ draṣṭavyam||
pre dājñaḥ|| 3.2.6 ||
pre dājñaḥ|| dadāteriti| upalakṣaṇametat| `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti sarveṣāmeva dārūpāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyate| jānāteśceti| janestvallopenāyaṃ nirdeśo na bhavati; `khano gha ca' `hanaśca vadhaḥ' ityādau dhātunirddeśe'llopasyākaraṇāt| preṇopasṛṣṭāditi| praśabdenopasargeṇa sambadbhādityarthaḥ| `anupasarge' iti cānuvartate, tena kevalena preṇopasṛṣṭādityarthaḥ| ataśca gosampradāya ityaṇeva bhavati||
sami khyaḥ|| 3.2.7 ||
gāpoṣṭak|| 3.2.8 ||
gāpoṣṭak|| gāyateriti| `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti gāṅo lugvikara raṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ pibatisāhacaryāttu na bhavati| sāmagīti| ṭakaḥ kittvādāto lopaḥ, ṭittvān ṅīp|
surāśīdhvoḥ pibateriti vaktavyamitya| pibateriti lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇaparibhāṣālabhyasyaivārthasya kathanam, upapadaparigaṇanaṃ tu vācanikameva| kṣīrapeti| striyāmeva viśeṣāt strīliṅgamudāhṛtam||
harateranudyamane'c|| 3.2.9 ||
harateranudyamane'c|| acprakaraṇa iti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayaiva ghaṭagrahaṇena ghaṭīgrahaṇe'pi siddhe ghaṭīgrahaṇam paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham| sūtragrāha evānya iti| yassūtraṃ kevalamupādatte, na tu dhārayati tatrāṇeva bhavatītyarthaḥ||
vayasi ca|| 3.2.10 ||
vayasi ca|| saṃbhāvyamānaṃ veti| tenāsatyapi kavacagrahaṇe vayasi gamyamāne kavacahara iti bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||
āṅi tācchīlye|| 3.2.11 ||
āṅi tācchīlye|| puṣpādyāharaṇe ityādinā tācchīlyamudāharaṇe darśayati| svābhāvikīti| svabhāve bhavā svābhāvikī, adhyātmādiḥ| svaśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhyate, tadādividhiśca tatreṣyate| bhāṣyakāraprayogāttu dvārādikāryābhāvaḥ, svārthikasvābhāvikaśbdau bhāṣye prayuktau| asya vivaraṇam---phalānapekṣeti| kathaṃ punaḥ phalamanapekṣya tatra pravarttate, na hi svabhāvaḥ paryanuyogamarhati||
arhaḥ|| 3.2.12 ||
stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ|| 3.2.13 ||
stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ|| ramerakarmakatvāditi| nanu `vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ' `upācca' ityatrodāhṛtam---devadattamuparamatīti? evaṃ manyate---`anupasarge' iti vartata iti| japeśca śabdakarmakatvāditi| mantraṃ japatītyādau tatraiva prayogadarśanāt| karma na saṃbhavatīti| kevalasya ramerjapeśca karmādyaśabdātmakamiti bhāvaḥ| sūcakaḥ--piśunaḥ| stamberama iti| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk| karṇe japitā maśaka iti| upāṃśuśabdāyitetyarthaḥ||
śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām|| 3.2.14 ||
śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām|| dhātumātrāditi| mātragrahaṇenāpavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānaṃ bhavatīti darśayati| śaṅkara iti| ehikamāmuṣmikaṃ mokṣākhyaṃ ca sukhaṃ karotīti śaṅkaraḥ| dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayanmātragrahaṇapratipāditamevārtha spaṣṭīkaroti---śamisaṃjñāyāmiti| asminsūtra ityarthaḥ| asati dhātugrahaṇe śamiśaṃjñāyāmityasyāvakāśaḥ----śambhavaḥ, śaṃvada iti, `kṛño hetutācchīlye' ityasyāvakāśaḥ----śrāddhakara iti; śaṅkarā ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvāṭṭa eva syād, dhātugrahaṇasāmarthyādajeva bhavati| kuṇḍakhāḍavastvācāryo manyate---gṛṇāteḥ śabdakarmaṇa etadrūpam, pṛṣodarāditvādrakārasya kakāra iti, tanmate dhātugrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam||
adhikaraṇe śeteḥ|| 3.2.15 ||
adhikaraṇe śeteḥ|| parśvādiṣviti| anadhikaraṇārthamidam| tadvigraheṇa darśayati----pārśvābhyāmiti| digdhasahaśaya iti| digdhena saha śete ityaci kṛte mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| digdasahaśabdo mayūravyaṃsakādistasyopapadasamāsaḥ| avamūrddhaśaya iti| avanatāṃ mūrddhā yasya avamūrddhā adhomukhaḥ śeta ityarthaḥ| girau ḍaścandasīti| yadi chandasītyucyate, katham `giriśamupacacāra pratyahaṃ sā sukeśī',`āropitaṃ yadririśena paścāt' iti? niraṃkuśāḥ kavayaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ-----iha yo girau śete giristasyāstīti lomādiṣu darśanācchapratyayaḥ| tathā cātraiva vārttikam----taddhito veti| na ca lomādiṣvapi chandograhaṇamasti, tena bhāṣāyāmapi giriśa iti bhavati| evaṃ ca kṛtvā nighaṇṭuṣu pāṭho'pyupanno bhavati| girau śeta iti| girāvāsta ityarthaḥ||
careṣṭaḥ|| 3.2.16 ||
bhikṣāsenādāyeṣu ca|| 3.2.17 ||
bhikṣāśenādāyeṣu ca|| bhikṣācara iti| caratiratra tatpūrvake arjane varttate, caraṇena bhikṣāmarjayatītyarthaḥ| senācara iti| senāṃ praviśannucyate| ādāyacara iti| ādāya gacchatītyarthaḥ, bhakṣayatīti vā| kathaṃ sahacaraḥ, sahacarīti? pacādiṣu caraḍiti paṭhyate, supsupeti samāsaḥ||
puro'grato'greṣu sartteḥ|| 3.1.18 ||
puro'grato'greṣu sartte|| agre ityeteṣviti| etenāgraśabdasyaikārāntatvaṃ nipātyata iti darśayati| etaccāgreśabdasyaca paranipātanādeva vijñāyate, anyathā `ajādyadantam' iti pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| kimartha punarekārāntatvaṃ nipātyate, yāvatā saptamyā alukāpyagresara iti siddham? yadā tarhyagraṃ sarati agreṇa saratīti vā vigṛhyate tadāpyagresara ityeva yathā syāt| kathaṃ `yūthaṃ tadagrasaragarvitakṛṣṇasāram' iti? `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti samarthanīyam||
pūrve karttari|| 3.2.19 ||
kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu|| 3.2.20 ||
kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu|| karoterddhātoriti| prasiddhataratvād dvyanubandhakasyāpyasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu `kṛñ hisāyām' ityasyeti bhāvaḥ| ānulomye ca gamyamāna iti| etena hetvādīni nopapadānīti darśayati, etacca `śami dhātoḥ' ityatra dhātugrahaṇātkṛño hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthādvijñāyate| upapadatve hi śamyapapade ṭapratyasya prāptyabhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyād| atau naiṣāmupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam,`karttari kṛt' itsasya bādhaprasaṅgāt| na cāsati virodhe bādhā yuktā| heturaikāntika kāraṇamiti| ekāntaśabdo vinayādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ, niyatamavyabhicārītyarthaḥ| etena laukikasya hetorgrahaṇamiti darśayati| na hi kevale kṛñi prayojakakarttā sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu laukikenāpi hetunā kartturviśeṣaṇamayuktam, avyabhicārāt, na hi karturanimittatvamasti? satyam; punarhetuśabdopādanādaikāntikatvamāśrīyate, anyathā nimittamātramupādīyeta| anukūlatā--ārādhyacittānuvartanam| yaśaskarī vidyeti| `ataḥ kṛkami' ityādinā visarjanīyasya satvam||
divāvibhāniśāprabhābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃlipilibibalibhaktikartṛcitrakṣetrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyattaddhanuraruṣṣu|| 3.2.21 ||
divāvibhāniśāprabhābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃlipilibibalibhaktikartṛcitratretrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyattaddhanuraruṣṣu|| yathāyogamiti| tatra divāśabdo'hrīti saptamyantasyārthe vartata iti tasya karmatvānupapatteḥ `supi' ityanenābhisambandhaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ tu karmaṇītyanena| yadi tu doṣāmanyamahaḥ, divāmanyā rātriritivad vṛttiviṣaye karmatvamabhyupagamyeta, tadā divāśabdasyāpi karmaṇītyanena saṃbandhaḥ| sakārasyeti| bhāskarānteti bhāśabdasya pratyayasanniyogena sakāro nipātyate, tasmādbhāskara ityatra visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyau na bhavataḥ| atha vā----sakārasya visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyau na bhavataḥ, kutaḥ? nipātanāt| bhāskarānteti sūtre sakāroccāraṇameva nipātanam| kārakara iti| kara eva kāraḥ, prajñāditvātsvārthe'ṇa| anantakara iti| antakaraśabdena nañsamāse'pyetadrūpaṃ sambhavati, svare hi doṣaḥ syāt----satiśiṣṭo'vyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prasajyeta, iṣyate hi gatikārakopapadātkṛditi kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvam| bahukara iti| bahuśabdo vaipulyavacanaḥ, saṃkhyāvacanasya tu casaṃkhyāgrahaṇenaiva siddham| lipilibiśabdau paryāyau| ahaskara iti| ahan `roḥ supi' iti rophaḥ, pūrvavatsatvam| dhanuṣkaraḥ, aruṣkara iti|
`nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvam, `kiṃyattadvahuṣu kṛño'jvidhānam' iti vārttikena sūtrasya bādhitatvāṭṭasyābhāvāddhetvādiṣvanyatra kiṃkarītyasādhurityāhuḥ| kvacid granthaḥ---atha vā vacādiṣu pāṭhaḥ kariṣyata iti| tatrāyamarthaḥ----iha kimādigrahaṇamapanīya pacādiṣveva `kiṃyattadvahuṣu kṛñaḥ' iti paṭhitavyamiti||
karmaṇi bhṛtau|| 3.2.22 ||
karmaṇi bhṛtau|| karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇamiti| anuvṛttena karmaṇītyanena viśeṣaṇāt| karmanirveśa iti| karma kriyā, tasya niṣkrayāya deyaṃ bhaktādidravyamityarthaḥ||
na śabdaślokakalahagāthāvairacāṭumūtramantrapadeṣu|| 3.2.23 ||
stambaśakṛtorin|| 3.2.24 ||
stambaśakṛtorin|| stambakaririti| nittvātkṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇottarapadamādyudāttaṃ bhavati||
haraterddatināthayoḥ paśau|| 3.2.25 ||
haraterddatināthamoḥ paśau|| paśau karttarīti| etena pratyayārthasya kartuḥ paśurviśeṣaṇam, na tu tasya bādhaka iti darśayati| dhātorhi pratyayavidhānāttadarthasya yena sambandhastatra vācye pratyayo bhavitumarhati| dhātvarthasya ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanena sambandhaḥ| paśuśabdastu catuṣpājjātīyaṃ vastusvarūpeṇācaṣṭe, na śaktimadrūpeṇa, natarāṃ śaktirūpeṇeti| na paśvarthaḥ svarūpeṇa pratyayārtho bhavitumarhatīti yuktamuktam‌paśau kartarīti| evaṃ sarvatra pratyayārtaviśeṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam||
phalegrahirātmambhariśca|| 3.2.26 ||
phalegrahirātmambhariśca|| upapadasyaikārāntamiti| chandasyakārāntatvamapi ddaśyate---yā vanaspatīnāṃ phalagrahiriti| sa kukṣimbharivaccakāreṇa samuccetavyaḥ||
chandasi vanasanarakṣimathām|| 3.2.27 ||
chandasi vanasanarakṣimathām|| vana ṣaṇa saṃbhaktāviti| gaṇe sahapaṭhitayo rbhauvādikayoreva grahaṇam, na tu `vanu yācane' `ṣaṇu dāne' iti tānādikayoriti bhāvaḥ| atra sāhacaryameva hetuḥ, niranubandhakatvaṃ ca| brahmavanimiti| brahma vanati, kṣatraṃ vanatīti vivakṣayāmin pratyayaḥ, tadantād dvitīyaikavacanam| gausanimiti| gāṃsanatoti vigrahaḥ| pathirakṣī iti| panthānaṃ rakṣata iti vigrahaḥ| havirmathantīti havirmathayasteṣāṃ hadirmathīnām||
ejeḥ khaśa|| 3.2.28 ||
ejeḥ khaśa|| ṇyantāditi| ejestvayamikā nirdeśo na bhavati; khaśaḥ śitkaraṇāt| taddhi sārvadhātukatve sati śabyathā syāditi| na caijeḥ prakṛtyantarasya śapi satyasati vā viśeṣo'sti| na cevamihārthatve sambhavati, kevalottarārthatvaṃ yuktam| sitkaraṇaṃ mumarthamiti| khitkāryopalakṣaṇametat| śunindhayaḥ nāḍindhayaḥ, nāsikandhaya iti hrasvatvamapi prayojanam| śakāraḥ sāvadhātukārtha iti| sārvadhātukasaṃjñārtha ityarthaḥ| vātaśunītyādi| vātādiṣu yathāsaṃkhyamupapadeṣu ajādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaś pratyayo bhavati| śarddhajahā iti| `ohāk tyāge' juhotyāditvācchapaḥ ślau dvirvacane `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ||
nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ|| 3.2.29 ||
nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ|| nāsikandhama iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa dhamādeśaḥ| taccaitadityādinā yathāsaṃkhyābhāve hetumāha, taccaitat yathāsaṃkhyābhāvalakṣaṇaṃ kāryam| etena ca vyākhyātṝṇāṃ mūlatvena sūtrakārasyāpyatra kiṃcidabhipretamityetāvatpradarśyate| tenaitanna nodanīyam-----uttarasūtravatpratyekamabhisambandhaḥ kasbhānna bhavati, viparyayo vā kasmānna bhavatīti| stanandhayati| atraiva ṅībiṣyate, nānyatretyāhuḥ||
nāḍīmuṣṭyośca|| 3.2.30 ||
nāḍīmuṣṭyośca|| ghaṭindhamaḥ, kharindhama iti| ghaṭī-ghaṭaḥ, kharī-garddabhī, jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ| khārītyanye paṭhanti sa ca parimāṇavacanaḥ| vātaśabdo na ddaṣṭaḥ||
udi kūle rujivahoḥ|| 3.2.31 ||
udi kūle rujivahoḥ|| yatra pratyekamupapadatvamicchati tatra samudāyātsaptamīmuccārayati, yathā---nāḍīmuṣṭyoriti| iha tu viparyayaḥ kṛtaḥ; tasmāt `udi' iti satsaptamī| `kūle' iti tvarthanirapekṣaivopapadasaṃjñāyāṃ liṅgam| tatra ca `te prāgdhātoḥ' iti ucchaśabdasya dhātoḥ prāk prayogaḥ| tataḥ pūrvaḥ kūlaśabdaḥ| tadetaddarśitam----utpūrvābhyāṃ kūle karmaṇyupapada iti||
vahābhre lihaḥ|| 3.2.32||
parimāṇe pacaḥ|| 3.2.33 ||
parimāṇe pacaḥ|| parimāṇaśabdaḥ kāṣṭhādinirmite prasthādau varttate, na tasya likledavācinā pacinā karmatvenānvayaḥ| ato na svarūpagrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? tadviśeṣāḥ prasthādayo gṛhyante, te ca parimeye parimeye vrīhyādau ca varttante| tatra parimāṇaniṣṭhānāṃ na pacinānvaya iti parimeyaniṣṭheṣu pratyayaḥ| na tarhi parimāṇavācitvam, na; parimāmādhyāropeṇa parimeye prasthādiśabdasya pravṛtteḥ||
mitanakhe ca|| 3.2.34 ||
mitanakhe ca|| nakhampaceti| paciratra tāpavacanaḥ||
vidhvaruṣostudaḥ|| 3.2.35 ||
vidhvaruṣostudaḥ|| aruntuda iti| `arurdviṣadajantasya mum' iti ukārātparo mum, saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ||
asūryalalāṭayorddaśitapoḥ|| 3.2.36 ||
asūryalalāṭayorddaśitapoḥ|| asūryampaśyā iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa paśyādeśaḥ| guptaparaṃ caitaditi| yadvacanam---`asūryampaśyā rājadārāḥ' iti, etad guptipradhānam; tena satyapi sūryadarśane prayogo na viruddhyata iti bhāvaḥ| guptiparatvameva prakaṭayati evaṃ nāmeti||
ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca|| 3.2.37 ||
ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca|| ugra paśyatīti| kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| irammada iti| `madī harṣe' divāditvācchyani prāpte tadabhāvo nipātanāt| irā-udakam| pāṇindhamāḥ panthāna iti| te punaryeṣu gacchadbhiḥ sarpādyapanodanāya pāṇayo dhmāyante-śabdyante||
priyavaśe vadaḥ khac|| 3.2.38 ||
priyavaśe vadaḥ khac|| cakāraḥ khaci hrasvaḥ iti viśeṣaṇārtha iti| `khe hrasvaḥ' ityucyamāne `ejeḥ khaś' aṅgamejayaḥ, janamejayaḥ---atrāpi prāpnoti?`ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' ityatra na bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi---`kulātkhaḥ' kulīnaḥ, yasyeti lopanivṛttaye hrasvaḥ syāt? tatra dhātupratyayasya grahaṇaṃ tatprakaraṇasāhacaryādeṣa cintyaprayojanaścakāraḥ| pratyayāntarakaṇamuttarārthamiti| `dviṣantapaḥ' ityatra hrasvaṇilopauyayāsyātām, śap ca mā bhūditi| yadyevam, uttaratraiva kartavye iha karaṇe kiṃ prayojanam? anyebhyo'pi bhavatīti jñāpanārtham| tena `gameḥ supyupasaṃkhyānam' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|
mitaṅgama iti| asaṃjñārthamidam, saṃjñāyāṃ tu `gamaśca' iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva siddham|
dviṣatparayostāpeḥ|| 3.2.39 ||
dvipatparayostāpeḥ|| dviṣantapa iti| mumi saṃyogāntalopaḥ| dvitakārako nirdeśa iti| tatraikena dviṣacchabdo viśeṣyate-----takārānto yo dviṣacchabda iti, sautratvānnirddeśasya viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ| tena striyāṃ na bhavatīti| anyathā liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā syādeva prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ||
vāci yamo vrate|| 3.2.40 ||
vāci yamo vrate|| śāstri iti| śāstraśabdādvidhāne dhātvarthe ṇic, tadantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ| śāstre vihitaḥ, śāstreṇa vā-śāstritaḥ| niyama iti| saṅkalpaviśeṣaḥ| vācaṃyama iti| `vācaṃyamapurandarau ca' iti pūrvapadasyāmantatvam| tata eva tarhi nipātanātpratyayo bhaviṣyati| vratādanyatrāpi tarhi prāpnoti? tatraiva bratagrahaṇaṃ kariṣyate----`vācaṃyamo brate purandaraśca' iti, tadetaccintyaprayojanam| etena purandaro vyākhyātaḥ|
vāgyāma iti| yo'śaktyādinā vācaṃ yacchati tatrāṇeva bhavati||
pūḥ sarvayordārisahoḥ|| 3.2.41 ||
pūḥ sarvayordārisahoḥ|| `dda vidāraṇe' ityasya grahaṇam; na `dda bhaye',`ddaṅ ādare'-----ityetayorityupadeśaḥ| asaṃjñārthaṃ sahigrahaṇam, saṃjñāyāṃ tu vakṣyati| sarvesaho rājeti| sarva saṃpādayituṃ samartha ityarthaḥ||
sarvakūlābhrakarīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ|| 3.2.42 ||
megharttibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ|| 3.2.43 ||
megharttibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ|| karoteriti| kṛṇotestu pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam| śivaṃkara ityapi chandasi ddaśyate----śiva eko dhyeyaḥ śivaṃkara iti||
kṣemapriyamadre'ṇ ca|| 3.2.44 ||
āśite bhuvaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ|| 3.2.45 ||
āśite bhuvaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ|| atra supītyupatiṣṭhate iti| na tu karmaṇīti, bhavaterakarmakatvāt| sopasargātprāptyarthācca khacā na bhavitavyam, anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ| āśitaśabdo'yam `aśa bhojane' ityasmādāṅpūrvādavivakṣite karmaṇi ktapratyayānto gṛhyate---āśitaḥ kartteti, yasyādyudātatvaṃ vidhāsyate| yastu `dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ' iti bhāvakarmādhikaraṇeṣu ktaḥ, na tadanto gṛhyate, anabhidhānādityāhuḥ| anye tvaśerṇyāntātprayojye karmaṇi ktapratyaye kṛte ya āśitaśabdaḥ sa gṛhyate| evamāśitaḥ karteti yasyādyudāttatvaṃ tatrāpi prayojya eva bhūtapūrvagatyā karttocyate, `gatibuddhipratyavasānārtha'iti aṇau karturṇau karmasaṃjñāvidhānāt| tathā ca kṛṣannitphāla āśitaṃ kṛṣṇotīti ādyudāttasyāvagraho na ddaśyate| kartṛgrahaṇaṃ tu tatra bhāvanivṛttyarthamiti| āśitambhava odana iti| yāvataudanenātithyādirāśito bhavati sa evamucyate||
saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṝvṛjidhārisahitapidamaḥ|| 3.2.46 ||
saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṝvṛjidhārisahitapidamaḥ|| saṃjñāvaśādityādi| `śatruntapaḥ' ityādau yatra karmārthānugamastatra karmaṇīti sambadhyate| yatra tu na rathantaramityādau tatra supīti| arindama iti| antarbhāvitaṇyartho damiḥ sakarmako bhavati||
gamaśca|| 3.2.47 ||
gamaśca|| yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti| uttaratra gamerevānuvṛttiryathā syād, bhṛtṝprabhṝtīnāṃ mā bhūt||
antātyantādhvadūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ|| 3.2.48 ||
antātyantādhvadūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ|| anubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāditi| śravaṇārthastu ḍakāro na bhavati, `pādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' iti kṛtaṭilopasya ḍapratyayāntasya nirdeśāt| atrātyantānantagrahaṇamanarthakam, antaśabdo'tra gṛhyate, tena karmaṇo viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirbhaviṣyati| upapadavidhau tu na sarvatra tadantavidhiḥ, upapadavidhau tadādyādigrahaṇamiti niyamāt| pannaṃ patitaṃ yathā gacchatīti pannagaḥ| `suduroradhikaraṇe' iti karmaṇi khaleva bhavati----sugamaḥ, durgama iti| anyatrāpi ddaśyata iti| evaṃ ca sūtramapi prapañcārtham||
āśiṣi hanaḥ|| 3.2.49 ||
āśiṣi hanaḥ|| dārāviti| dāruśabda ityarthaḥ| śabdāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgaḥ,ṭavidhānārtha vacanam, aṇ `karmaṇyaṇ' ityeva siddhaḥ| antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham, `alo'ntyasya' ityeva siddham||
ape kleśatamasoḥ|| 3.2.50 ||
kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ|| 3.2.51 ||
kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ|| `supyajātau' iti siddhe'tācchītyārthamidaṃ vacanam,śirasaḥ, śīrṣabhāvārtha ca||
lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak|| 3.2.52 ||
lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak|| lakṣaṇavatīti| etenārśa ādyacpratyayānto lakṣaṇaśabda iti darśayati| etacca sūtrārambhādevāvasīyate, kevale hi lakṣaṇe uttareṇaiva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ| jāyādhno brāhmaṇa iti| yasya tilakālādi jāyāmaraṇaliṅgamasti sa tāṃ hantīti gauṇo gadaḥ| etena patighnī vyākhyātā| `gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ, ṭittvānṅīp||
amanuṣyakartṛke ca|| 3.2.53 ||
amanuṣyakartṛke ca|| amanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu rūḍha iti pūrvamuktam, iha tu manuṣyādanyaḥ sarva eva gṛhyate| nanu yathā pūrvasūtre lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartuviśeṣaṇam, evamihāpyamanuṣyagrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ kartṛgrahaṇena? `amanuṣye' ityucyamāne upapadatvamapi vijñāyeta, tasmātkartṛ grahaṇam| kṛtaghnaśabdo mūlavibhujādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ||
śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ|| 3.2.54 ||
śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ|| viṣeṇa hastinaṃ hantīti| nanvatrāpyaśaktasya kartṛtvānupapatterastyeva śaktiḥ? satyam; śaktigrahaṇasāmarthyātprakarṣavijñānādanyatirapekṣasvabalenaiva hantuṃ yā śaktiḥ sā gṛhyate, taddarśayati----hastinaṃ hantuṃ samartho hastidhno manuṣya iti| evaṃ ca hastinaṃ hantu mā vā vadhīt sāmarthyayogāddhastighna ityucyate|
kaṃ pāṭayati praviśata iti| kapāṭaśabdaṃ vyutpādayati| kavāṭamiti tu prasiddhaḥ, tatrāṭateḥ pacādyac| `kavaṅ coṣṇo' iti yogavibhāgātkoḥ kavādeśaḥ||
pāṇighatāḍaghau śilpini|| 3.2.55 ||
āḍhyasubhagasthūlapalitanagnāndhapriyeṣu cvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe khyun|| 3.2.56 ||
āḍhyasubhagasthūlapalitanagnāndhapriyeṣu cvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe khyun|| āḍhyādiṣviti| anena āḍhyādīnāmupapadatvaṃ darśayati| karaṇe kārake ityanenāpi karaṇasya pratyayārthatvam| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate---karaṇa upapade āḍhyādiṣu kartṛṣviti? ucyate----`cvyartheṣvaccau' iti vacanād āḍhyādiśabdāḥ svarūpapradhānāḥ, na ca śabdānāṃ kartṛtvamupapadyate| nanu ca śravaṇena karoti sukhamāḍhyāśabda ityatra śabdasyāpi kartṛtvaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ tarhi vyākhyānāttathā nāśrīyate| acvāviti tatpuruṣo bahuvrīhirvā, acvyanta ityarthaḥ| pratyekaṃ sambandhāttvekavacanam| kathaṃ punacvyarthāśca bhavantyacavyantāśca bhavantītyāha----cvevikalpena vidhānāditi| āḍhyaṅkaraṇamiti| khyunaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ, liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strāliṅgaṣvāḍhyādiṣūpapadeṣu hrasvārthaśca| nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| yoranādaśaḥ|
abhyañcayantītyartha iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnām| tenātra prāganāḍhyaḥ sannāḍhyaḥ kriyata iti abhūtatadbhāvābhāvaḥ| bhavatu vā'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ, tathāpi yuktamevedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamityāha---prakṛteravivakṣāyāmiti| prakṛtireva pariṇāmitvena yatra vivakṣyate, yathā-----tantavaḥ paṭo bhavatīti, tadā cvipratyayaḥ, tathā ca vārttikam----`prakṛtivivakṣāgrahaṇaṃ ca' iti, prakṛtiḥ kāryasya pūrvāvasthā|
acvāviti kimiti| asya vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ, tamāviṣkaroti----nanu ceti| lyuṭātra bhavitavyamiti| `karaṇādhikaraṇayośca' iti| na ca lyuṭaḥ khyunaśca viśeṣo'stīti, lyuṭi tāvadāḍhyokaraṇamiti rūpam, svaro'pi litsvareṇottarapadādyu9dāttatvam; khyunyapi nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam, `khityanavyayasya' `arurdviṣadajantasya mum' iti hrasvatvam, mum cānavyayasya vidhīyate, cvyantāścāvyayam; `ūryādi cviḍācaśca' iti nipātatvāt| striyāmapyubhayatra `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīb bhavati, ato rūpe svare ca nāsti viśeṣaḥ| uttarārthaścoti| uttarasūtre khiṣṇuc‌khukañbhyāṃ mukte tṛjādibhirbhavitavyamityasti viśeṣaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi pūrvamuktam---pratiṣedhasāmarthyāditi? asminsūtre pratiṣedhasāmarthyāditi bhāvaḥ| kevalottarārthatve hi tatraiva `acvau' ityavakṣyat, yathā vakṣyate----iha kiṃcittrapo iti| bhāṣye tūttarārthameva sthitam||
karttari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau|| 3.2.57 ||
karttari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhulañau||karttagrahaṇaṃ karaṇanivṛttyartham, uttarārthaṃ ca, khakāro mumarthaḥ, cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, ñakāro vṛddhyarthaśca| kimarthaṃ khiṣṇujikārādiḥ kriyate, na khsnurityevocyeta, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---svarārthaścakāro na karttavyo bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham? kenedānīmikārāditvaṃ siddhyati? tatrāha---udāttatvāditi| bhavatirayamudāttaḥ, tasyodāttatvādiḍ bhaviṣyati| nañastviti| `nañaḥ' iti pañcamī, naña uttarasya khiṣṇujantasya svaramiddhyarthamityarthaḥ| yadyayamikārādirnakriyet, tataḥ satyapīṭi `kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na syād asya cakārābhāvāt| athāsyāpi cakāraḥ kriyeta? evamapi lākṣaṇikatvāt ṣatvaṇatvayoścāsiddhatvādiṣṇujiti rūpābhāvād grahaṇaṃ na syādeva, tata ikārāditvaṃ kriyate| nanu ca satyapīkārāditve `tadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandhakasya',`ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' iti vā alaṃkṛñādīṣṇuca eva grahaṇena bhavitavyam,nāsya? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti manyate| yadyevam, khṣṇujayamastu, tatra ṣatvaṇatvayoścakārasya caja karaṇasāmarthyādiṭi kṛte'syāpi grahaṇaṃ siddhamiti cintyaprayojanamikārāditvam||
spṛśo'nudake kvin|| 3.2.58 ||
spṛśo'nudake kvin|| nanu cetyādi| `supi sthaḥ' ityatroktam----sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyupatiṣṭhate'nyatra supīti, tataśca subanta upapade kvin pratyaya ityuktamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ| tatkartṛpracayārthamiti| `karttari kṛt' ityeva karttari kvinaḥ siddhatvātkartranuvṛtternānyatprayojanamastīti bhāvaḥ| kartṛpracayo labhyata iti| karmaṇyupapada ekaḥ karttā, karaṇādau cāpara ityevaṃ pracayo bhavati| ghṛtaspṛgiti| `kvin‌pratyayasya kuḥ' iti śakārasya ṣakāraḥ soṣmatvenāntaratamyāt, `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte'| kvinaḥ kakāro guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaḥ, ikāraḥ `verapṛktasya' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| nakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, ekājbhyo hyayaṃ vidhīyate tatra dhātusvareṇaiva siddham? yastarhyanekāj----dadhṛgiti, vakṣyatyetaddhṛṣerddhirvacanamantodāttatvañceti? evaṃ tarhi `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' `kvipratyayasya' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt----kveḥ kvipo vā nirdeśa iti| kverapi nirdeśe pakārasya `anaci ca' iti dvirvacanam||
ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca|| 3.2.59 ||
ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca|| ṛtau yajatīti| vasantādike| ṛtuṃ yajatīti| yasminyāge ṛturddevatā, yathā-----vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate piśaṅgāstrayo vāsantā ityṛtupaśūnālabhate, grīṣmo hemanta uta no vasantaḥ śaradvarṣā ityādau tadabhiprāyametat| ṛtuprayukto veti| vasante vasante jyotiṣā yajetetyādau yatkartṛtvaṃ tadabhiprāyametat| ṣatvañceti| anyathā `sātpadādyoḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ syāt| subantamātra iti| anyathā sakarmakatvātkarmaṇyeva syāt| kevalādeveti| etattu kvinvidhānasāmarthyādapi labhyate, na hi sopapadādyujeḥ kvini kvipi vā viśeṣo'sti, kutvasya `coḥ kuḥ' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| anupapade tu `yujerasamāse' iti numi kṛte nakārasya kutvārtha kvino vidhānaṃ bhavati sārthakam| yadi tu nipātanasāhacaryātsopapadādanupapadācca yujeḥ kvin bhavatītyucyeta, tadā `satsūdviṣa' ityatra yujigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum| nalopaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti| `kuñca kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' iti nopadhāvetau dhātū| tathā nikucitiriti nalopo ddaśyate, cutvena tu jakārasya śravaṇam, tasyāsiddhatvāccakāre parataḥ `coḥ kuḥ'iti kutvaṃ na bhavati| kuñcau kuñca ityādau nakāropadhaṃ tu paṭhatāṃ syāt, tatra saṅijhalīti vacanānna bhavatīti vaktavyam| saṅiti pratyāhāraḥ sanaḥ saśabdādārabhyā mahiṅo ṅakārāt| anye tu kuñcireka eva dhātuḥ, tasya kakārātparo repho'pi kvinsanniyogena nipātyate ityāhuḥ| tadetat `coḥ kuḥ' ityatra vāmano vakṣyati||
tyadādiṣu ddaśo'nālocane kañca|| 3.2.60 ||
tyadādiṣu ddaśo'nālocane kañca|| `paśyārthaiśca' ityatra vakṣyati----ālocanaṃ cakṣustādhanaṃ vijñānamiti, iha tu jñānamātrapratiṣedhaṃ manyate| yāddak tāddagiti| `ddagddaśavatuṣu' iti varttamāne `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam| ñakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| ādyudāttatvasya nakāreṇāpi siddhatvāt ñakāropadhasya prayojanaṃ viśeṣaṇamevetyarthaḥ, na tu svaro na prayojanamityucyate| taṃ paśyati taddarśa iti cakṣurvijñāne'ṇeva bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ prayujyamānasyaiva ddaśeranālocanārthatvamityāha---tāddaśādayo rūḍhiśabdā iti| tataḥ kimityāha---naivātreti| rūḍhiśabdā hyasatāpyavayavārthena vyutpādyante, yathā----tailapāyikādayaḥ| etadarthamevānālocana ityuktam| ddaśyarthābhāve'yaṃ vidhiḥ, sati tu ddaśyarthe'ṇeva bhavatīti| bhāṣye tu karmakartari vyutpattirdarśitā----tamivemaṃ paśyanti janāḥ so'yaṃ sa iva ddaśyamānastamivātmānaṃ paśyatīti| tatra karmavyāpāramātre vā ddaśervṛttiḥ, kṛtsnadhātvarthādhyāropo vā saukaryādiśayapratipādanāyeti draṣṭavyam|
samānānyośceti| samānasya ddagddaśavatuṣu sabhāvavidhānātsiddham|
ksaśceti| tyadādiṣu samānānyośca| tāddakṣaḥ, saddakṣaḥ, anyāddakṣa iti| `ddakṣe ceti' vaktavyam' iti sabhāva ātvaṃ ca||
satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip|| 3.2.61 ||
satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip|| ataḥ prabhṛtīti| bhāṣyakāraprayogātprabhṛtiśabdayoge pañcamī| vadaḥ supi kyap ceti| prayojanadigiyaṃ darśitā| atra hyanupasarga iti varttate, tasmāt `spṛśo'nudake kvin' ityādau prayojanaṃ draṣṭavyam| suvateriti| nyāyasya tulyatvāddaivādikasyāpyagrahaṇam|
śuciṣaditi| chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ-----haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi| `pūrvapadāt' iti ṣanvam| śucisaditi pāṭhe laukikaḥ prayogaḥ| kathamatra ṇatvamiti| grāmaṇīviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ| praṇīrityatra tu `upasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvamastyeva| jñāpakāditi| pūrvapadasthānnimittāduttarasya nayatinakārasyāsañjñāyāmapi ṇatvaṃ bhavatīti sāmānyena jñāpakamityarthaḥ| tenāgraṇīrityatrāpi bhavati| karmaṇyaṇi tu na bhavati, nīrūpaviṣayatvāj jñāpanasya | anye tu `agragrāmābhyāṃ nayateriti vaktavyam' iti vacanājjñāpanamapi tadviṣayam, tatrāpi nīrūpaviṣayamiti sthitāḥ||
bhajo ṇivaḥ|| 3.2.62 ||
chandasi sahaḥ|| 3.2.63 ||
chandasi sahaḥ|| turāsāhaṃ purodhāya, pṛtanāṣāṭ dviṣo yod‌dhuṃ puruhūtaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ iti bhāṣāyāṃ prayogāścintyāḥ||
vahaśca|| 3.2.64 ||
kavyapurīṣapurīṣyeṣu ñcuṭ|| 3.2.65 ||
havye'nantaḥ pādam|| 3.2.66 ||
janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ|| 3.2.67 ||
janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ|| viśeṣaṇārthaścoti| `vivanoḥ' ityucyamāne hi kvibādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| athātra niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇam? `verapṛktasya' ityatrāpyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| athātra kvibādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt? `viḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' ityatrāpi syāditi samānaṃ vaca iti bhāvaḥ| goṣā iti| `sanoteranaḥ' iti ṣatvam| agregā iti| pūrvavadaluk||
ado'nanne|| 3.2.68 ||
ado'nanne|| annāda iti| bhāṣāyāmaṇeva bhavati| chandasi tvakārādanupapadādityaṇi prāpte pacādyajiṣyate, tenānnāda ityanna ityanna ada ityavagraho bhavati||
kravye ca|| 3.2.69 ||
kravye ca|| vā'sarūpabādhanārthamiti| tathā ca vārttikam----ado'nanne kravyagrahaṇaṃ vāsarūpanivṛttyarthamiti| kathaṃ tarhīti| yadi vā'sarūpavidhibādhanārthamiti bhāvaḥ| kṛttavikṛtteti| kṛttaṃ chinnaṃ tadeva punarviśeṣataḥ kṛttamiti `pūrvakāla' iti samāsaḥ, tasya pakvaśabdena punaḥ sa eva samāsaḥ, tato māṃsaśabdena punarviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pṛṣodarāditvātkravyabhāva iti| yadyevam, kravyāda ityasya rūpasyāvarjanīyatvādalaṃ vā'sarūpabādhanārthenānena vacanena, vārttikavirodhaścaivaṃ vadata ityāśaṅkyāha----kṛttavikṛttetyādi| arthamedādubhayamapi nāsti kiletyayamabhiprāyaḥ||
duhaḥ kabdhaśca|| 3.2.70 ||
duhaḥ kabdhaśca|| kāmadudheti| kāmyante iti kāmāḥ, tān dugdhe kāmadughā arghaḥ-madhuparkaḥ||
mantreśvetavahokśāspurāḍāśo ṇvin|| 3.2.71 ||
