mantreśvetavahokśāspurāḍāśo ṇvin|| etebhya iti| śvetādipūrvebhyo vahādibhyo dhātubhya ityarthaḥ| dhātūpapadasamudāyā iti| kimarthamityāha---alākṣaṇiketi| `śvetavāḥ' ityādiṣu `avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca' iti nipātanādrutvam| ukthaśā iti| nalope `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ, rutvam|
ḍaspadasyeti| pratyekamabhisambaddhyate, bhāvipadatvāśrayeṇa cedamucyate, yatra ḍasantasya padatvaṃ bhaviṣyati tatra ṇvino'pavādo ḍaspratyayo vaktavya ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, anena ḍasi kṛte sau `atvasantasya' iti dīrghe rutve ca śvetavā ityādi siddham, nārthaḥ `avayāḥ śvetavāḥ' iti nipātanena? evaṃ tarhi sambuddhyartha nipātanam---he śvetavā indreti, `atvasantasya' ityatra hi `asambuddhau' iti vartate, ḍasapi vaktavyaḥ| utvārtham----śvetavobhyām, ukthaśobhyāmiti| evaṃ cokyaśā ityapi sambuddhyartha nipātanaṃ kartavyaṃ yadi mantre darśanamastri||
ave yajaḥ|| 3.2.72 ||
ave yajaḥ|| avayā iti| nipātanādrutvam| yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti| `puroḍāśavayajo ṇvin' ityekayoge śvetavahādīnāmapyuttaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt, yajeścāvapūrvasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syāt, kevalasyaiva ceṣyate, tadartho yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ||
vijupe chandasi|| 3.2.73 ||
vijupe chandasi|| atha chandograhaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā mantra ityanuvṛtterevabhāṣāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati, tatrāha---chandograhaṇaṃ brāhmaṇārthamiti| mantravyatirikto vedabhāgaḥ-brāhmaṇam, yathoktam---taccodakeṣu mantrākhyā, śeṣe brāhmaṇaśabda iti|
kimartha punaridamiti| uttarasūtra eva vijgrahaṇaṃ chandograhaṇaṃ ca kriyatāmiti praśnaḥ| niyamārthamiti| nanu ddaśigrahaṇādeva bhāṣāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati, satyam; tasyaiva prapañcārthamidam||
āto maninkvanibvanipaśca|| 3.2.74 ||
āto maninkvanibvanipaśca|| aśva iva tiṣṭhati aśvatthāmā, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ| sudhīvā, supīveti| ghumāsthādisūtreṇa ītvam| cakāro vico'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| yadyevam, uttaratrānuvṛttirna syāt? evaṃ tarhi cakāro'pyuttaratrānuvarttiṣyate||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| 3.2.75 ||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| apiśabdaḥ sarvavidhivyabhicārārtha iti| vidhīyate'neneti vidhiḥ-upādhiḥ| sarvopādhivyabhicārārtha iti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ| ddaśigrahaṇaṃ prayogānusaraṇārthamiti| `yathā prayoge ddaśyante tathaiva bhavanti' iti vacanavyaktyāśrayeṇeti bhāvaḥ||
kvip ca|| 3.2.76 ||
kvip ca|| nirupapadebhyaśceti| etadapiśabdasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthaśyānuvṛtterlabhyate, na tu supītyasya nivṛtteḥ; uttarasūtre `supyupasarge'pīti varttate' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt, `chandasi bhāṣāyāñca' iti pūrvasūtra eva `chandasi' ityasya nivṛttatvāt| ukhāsraditi| `sraṃsu dhvaṃsu bhraṃsu avasraṃsane',`aniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ, `vasusraṃsu' ityādinā datvam| vāhabhraḍiti| `bhraṃśu adhaḥ patane',vraścādinā ṣatvam, `anyeṣāmapi ddaśyate' iti dīrghaḥ| ukhāyāḥ sraṃsate parṇāni, dhvaṃsate, vāhād bhraśyatīti vigrahaḥ| dhvaṃsirantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ sakarmakaḥ| kvacittu vṛttāveva vigrahavākyāni paṭhyante||
sthaḥ ka ca|| 3.2.77 ||
sthaḥ ka ca|| ketyavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ| anyebhyo'pi ddaśyata iti| kvibiti siddha evetyapekṣate| nanu tacchīlādigrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvarttate, tasmāt `kvip ca' iti kvip siddha eveti vaktavyam| yadvā tacchīlādigrahaṇaṃ tatra na sambandhanīyamiti manyate| nanvevamapi `supi sthaḥ' iti viśeṣavihitaḥ kaḥ sāmānyavihitaṃ kvipaṃ bādheta? vā'sarūpavidhinā so'pi bhaviṣyati| śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyāmacam bādhata iti| anyathā yathā kṛño hetvādiṣu ṭaṃ bādhate dhātugrahaṇāttathā tiṣṭhaterapi kakvipau bādheta, atastamapyacaṃ bādhitvā kakvipāveva yathā syātāmiti punarvacanamityarthaḥ| śaṃsthā iti| kvipi lupte pratyayalakṣaṇena ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvamatra prāpnoti, bhāṣyakāraprayogāttu na bhavati| kecittu---ītvamavakārādāviti vacanaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ supīvā sudhīvā, atrāpi na syāt||
supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye|| 3.2.78 ||
supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye|| brāhmaṇānāmantrayiteti| tācchīlyasya vivakṣitatvāttṛn pratyudāhṛtaḥ, `na lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ|
utpratibhyāmiti| punaḥ subgrahaṇasyopasarganivṛttyarthatvādayamārambhaḥ|
sādhukāriṇi ceti| atācchīlyārthamidam, taccaitajjñāpakātsiddhaṃ yadayam `ākvestacchīla' ityatra tacchīletyabhidhāya sādhukārigrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati---sādhukāriṇyatācchīlye'pi ṇinirbhavatīti|
brahmaṇi vada iti| brahma-vedaḥ| idamapyatācchīlyārtham||
karttaryupamāne|| 3.2.79 ||
karttaryupamāne|| upamānasyopemeyāpekṣatvāt kartari ca pratyayavidhānāttasyaivopapadakarttopamānaṃ vijñāyeta ityāha---upapadakartteti| uṣṭrakrośīti|
ivaśabdo gatārthatvādvṛttau naiva prayujyate|
samāsa upamānānāṃ śastrīśyāmādike yathā||
vrate|| 3.2.80 ||
vrate|| samudāyopādhiścāyamiti| na pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| tathā hi sati vrata eva kartari pratyayaḥ syānna tadvatīti bhāvaḥ| samudāyopādhitvameva spaṣṭayati---dhātūpapadetyādi| kāmacāraḥ-icchāpravṛttiḥ, tatprāptau satyāṃ niyamaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ sambhavati---sthaṇḍile śete eva aśrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte evetyevaṃrūpo vā| tatra pūrvake niyame yadaivāsāvaśaktyādinā'śrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte tadaiva vratalopaḥ prāpnoti| na caivaṃvidhaṃ śāstramasti---sthaṇḍile śayitavyameva, aśrāddhaṃ bhoktavyameveti| asti tu sthaṇḍila eva śayitavyam, aśrāddhameva bhoktavyamiti| `vrate' iti tu śāstrito niyamāḥ---ityuktam, tasmād dvitīyo niyamo vijñāyata ityāha---sati śayana ityādi||
bahulamābhīkṣṇye|| 3.2.81 ||
bahulamābhīkṣṇyo|| ābhīkṣṇyaṃ paunaḥ punyamiti| punaḥ punarbhavitari vartamānābhyāmavyayābhyāṃ bhāve ṣyañ, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ| tācchīlyādanyaditi| etena`supyajātau' ityanenāgatārthatvaṃ darśayati| phalānapekṣā pravṛttiḥ-tācchīlyam| gāndhārādayastu vātādisāmyārtha deśācāravaśena kaṣāyādipāne pravartante| udāharaṇeṣu `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk, `prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca' iti ṇatvam||
manaḥ|| 3.2.82 ||
manaḥ|| manyatergrahaṇamiti| `mana jñāne' ityasya daivādikasya| na manuteriti| `manu avabodhane' ityasya tānādikasya| tipi guṇena bhavitavyam| yadi neṣyate, saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prayatnena manotergrahaṇaṃ nivāryate, yāvatā iha dvayorapi ṇiniḥ tadeva rūpam, na cārthabheda ityāha----uttarasūtra iti||
ātmamāne khaśca|| 3.2.83 ||
ātmamāne khaśca|| cakārāṇṇiniśceti| vā'sarūpavidhinā siddho'pi ṇiniravicchedāya samuccīyate| tena `karaṇe yajaḥ' ityatra ṇinerevānuvṛttirbhavati, nānantarasya khaśaḥ| ātmaśabdo'yaṃ paravyāvṛttiṃ kurvāṇo yastatpratiyoginamarthamācaṣṭe sa svaśabdaparyāyo gṛhyate, na cetanadravyavacanaḥ| mananaṃ mānaḥ, bhāve ghañ, ātmano māna ātmamānaḥ----karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| tatra kasyetyapekṣāyāṃ pratyayārthasya sannihitasya manturevātmana iti gamyate, tadāha---pratyayārthaḥ kartteti| darśaniyatvādinā dharmeṇeti viśiṣṭamiti śeṣaḥ| kartari ṣaṣṭhyāstu samāso na bhavati, sarvasyā eva matermantṛkartṛkatvāvyabhicārād| evaṃ cetanadravyavacane'pyātmaśabde kartari ṣaṣṭhyāmavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇaṃ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā, na tu cetanāntare karmaṇi pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmātsvaśabdaparyāya evātmaśabdaḥ| darśanīyammanya iti| śarīradharmamapi darśanīyatvādikamātmadharmameva manyante saṃsāriṇaḥ śarīraśarīriṇoragnyayogolakayorivābhedaṃ manyamānāḥ| paṇḍitammanya iti| ekasyāpyātmanassvarūpeṇa kartṛtvaṃ paṇḍitatvādiviśiṣṭarūpeṇa karmatvaṃ ca yujyata eva| yathoktamācāryaiḥ----
asmatprayogasambhinnā jñānasyaiva ca kartari|
bhavantī tatra saṃvittiryujyetāpyātmakartṛkā|| iti|
khaśaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ, darśanīyammanyā kumārītyādau hrasvārthaśca| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, divāditvācchyan| svarastu satiśiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate iti khaśa eva bhavati, na nitsvaraḥ| darśanīyamānī devadatto yajñadattasyeti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tadapekṣayāsyāpi darśanīyaśabdasya gamakatvātsamāsaḥ||
bhūte|| 3.2.84 ||
bhūte|| yasya sattā vyapavṛktā tatsarva bhūtaśabdenocyate, tatra na jñāyate kasmin bhūte? kiṃ vā dhātvarthe? tatrāha---dhātvadhikārācceti| caśabdaḥ pūrvoktenārthenāsya saṅgatiṃ dyotayati| dhātvarthabhūta iti| nanu dhātvadhikārāddhātau bhūta iti yuktam, na dhātvarthe bhūta iti? ucyate---prayoge pratyayasya dyotyaṃ bhūtatvamarthasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviturhati, viśeṣaṇāntaravat, na tu śabdasya; tasya svābhidheyapratipādane vyagratvādviśeṣaṇasambandhaṃ pratyayogyatvāt| kiñca---nityodhāturanityatve'pi bhūtātpratyayavidiranupapannaḥ, uccāritalakṣaṇe bhūtatve viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartha tarhyanuccāritātpratyayavidhiḥ sambhavati| nityaścāyaṃ bhūtaśabdo'tikrāntavācīti niṣṭhāyāmitaretarāśrayatvādaprasiddhirityacodyam||
karaṇe yajaḥ|| 3.2.85 ||
karaṇe yajaḥ|| ṇiniranuvartate na khaśiti| atrokto hetuḥ| agniṣṭomayājīti| nanu cāgniṣṭomaśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyam, tatkathamagniṣṭomasya yajiṃ prati karaṇatvam, na hi tadeva tatra karaṇaṃ bhavati; idaṃ tu yuktamudāharaṇam---someneṣṭavān somayājī, sānnāyyeneṣṭavān sānnāyyayājīti? tatrāha---agniṣṭomaḥ phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇaṃ bhavatīti| satyaṃ yāga evāgniṣṭomaḥ; yāgo'pi phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇam, phalasya svargāderbhavato yā bhāvanā utpādanā tasyāmityarthaḥ| nanu dīkṣaṇīyādirudavasānīyānto jyotiṣṭomākhyo yāga eva svargabhāvanā na tadatiriktaḥ kaścidvyāpāro yajanasyāsti yatraḥ yāgaḥ kāraṇyamaśnute? ucyate, dvividho yajamānavyāpāraḥ---sāmānyarūpaḥ, viśeṣarūpaśceti| tatra samānyarūpa ābhyantara audāsīnyapracyutirūpaḥ kṛtiprayatnādipadābhilapyaḥ; bāhmastu dīkṣaṇīyādirudavasānīyāntaḥ prasiddha eva| evamodanaṃ pacanītyādiṣvapyātmaguṇaḥ prayatnaḥ bāhyaścādiśrayaṇādirdraṣṭavyaḥ| phalaṃ hi prepsan tadartha prayatate, nodāste; yato'yamupāyaṃ jijñāsate, jānīte ca, jñātvā copāyamanutiṣṭhati| saiṣā svargādiphaloddeśena pravṛttā kṛtirbhāvanetyucyate| sā ca bhāvyam, karaṇam, itikartavyatāṃ ceti tritayamapekṣate---idamanenetthaṃ bhāvayediti| yathāha----
bhāvanāpekṣyamāṇā hi sādhanaṃ ki phalasya me|
sādhanānugrahaḥ ko vetyanṛsyūtamapekṣate|| iti||
saiṣā sāmānyarūpā vṛttirna śāstrakaṭākṣamapekṣate| viśeṣarūpā tvapekṣate, tathā hi---phalārthī tadupāyaṃ jijñāsate, tadupāyaṃ jijñāsamānaḥ śrṛṇoti---jyotiṣṭomenasvargakāmo yajeteti| tatra ca puruṣapravartanārūpo vidhiḥ śrūyate, na cāpuruṣārthe puruṣaḥ pravartata iti vidhyavarūddhā bhāvanā bhāvyāpekṣāyāṃ samānapadopāttamapi duḥkharūpaṃ dhātvartamapahāya padāntaropāttamapi puruṣopasarjanamapi sukharūpaṃ svargamevāvalambate| tataḥ karaṇāpekṣāyāṃ samānapadopātto dhātvarthaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati, paścātsannidhisamāmnātaṃ dīkṣaṇīyādītikartavyatayānvetītyeṣā mīmāṃsakamaryādā| yatra tu na vidhyavarodho bhāvanāyāstatra dhātvartha eva bhāvyo bhavati, yathā---pacati pākaṃ karoti, gacchati gamanaṃ karotītyādi nirdiśyate| nanu bhāvanayā sampadyamānasya brāhyavyāpārasya kathaṃ tatra karaṇatvam? ko doṣaḥ? karaṇaṃ khalu sarvatra kartṛvyāpāragocaraḥ, kuṭhāreṇa chinattītyatrāpi udyamananipātanarūpeṇa kartṛvyāpāreṇāpyamānasyaiva kuṭhārasya tatra karaṇatvam, tadeva kathaṃ dvidhābhavanarupeṇa phalenāvacchinnayostayośchedanarūpatvaṃ na svarūpatvam, na svarūpeṇa rajake darśanāt, so'pi hi vastramudyacchate nipātayati ca| atha dvidhābhavanābhāvānna chinattītyucyate, tadevamudyamananipātayośchedarūpatvaṃ kuṭhāragocaratvanibandhanamiti tasya tatra karaṇatvam, tathehāpi bhāvanāyāṃ svargabhāvanārūpatvamagnigṭomākhyayāgagocaratvanibandhanamiti tasya tatra karaṇatvam| tadidamuktam---phalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇamiti| iyaṃ hi phalaṃ dhātvarthaṃ ca sampādayati, tatra phalabhāvanārūpatve brāhyo vyāpāraḥ karaṇamityarthaḥ| nanvevamapi yajyartha prati agniṣṭomaḥ karaṇaṃ na bhavati? mā bhūttatra karaṇatvam, karaṇaṃ tāvat sambandhi ca yajinā sāmānādhikaraṇyena | atha vā---bhāvanāpi dhātoreva vācyā, na pratyayasya; tatra dhātvarthaikadeśa ekadeśāntarasya karaṇam, agniṣṭomaśabdaśca tatraikadeśāntare vartata iti na kiñcidanupapannam||
karmaṇi hanaḥ|| 3.2.86 ||
karmaṇi hanaḥ|| kutsitagrahaṇamiti| pitṛvyavadhādinā yaḥ karttā kutsyate tatrāyaṃ pratyaya iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ||
brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip|| 3.2.87 ||
brahmabhrūmavṛtreṣu kvip|| dhātūpapadakālapratyayaviṣayaḥ| bhāṣye tūpapadaviṣayaniyamadvayaṃ pradarśitam, tadupalakṣaṇam, na tu niyamāntaravyāvṛttyarthamiti gamyate| brahmādiṣveva hanteriti dhātuniyamaḥ, atrāpi niyame bhūta ityāśrayaṇāt kālāntare upapadāntare'pi bhavatyeva----puruṣaṃ hanti haniṣyati vā puruṣaheti| brahmādiṣu hanterevetyupapadaniyamaḥ, atrāpi bhūta ityāśrayaṇātkālāntare dhātvantarādapi bhavatyeva---vṛtraṃ jayati jeṣyati vā vṛtrajiditi| bhūtakāle kvibeveti kālaniyamaḥ| nānyaḥ pratyaya iti| yathā `karmaṇi hanaḥ' `karṇaṇyaṇ' iti| upapadāntare tu bhate'pi pratyayāntaraṃ bhavatyeva--pitṛvyaṃ hatavānpitṛvyaghātīti, sopapadaśca pratyayo niyamena vyāvarttyate| niṣṭhā tu bhavatyeva---vṛtraṃ hatavāniti| tathā bhūta eveti pratyayaniyamaḥ, atrāpi brahmādiṣu hanterityāśrayaṇādupapadāntare dhātvantarācca kālāntare'pi bhavatyeva| kathaṃ punarekasminneva yoge caturvidho niyamo labhyate? ityāha---tadetaditi| agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādeva caturvidho niyamo labdhuṃ śakyate, tatraiva tūpodvalakametaduktaṃ veditavyam|
bahulaṃ chandasi|| 3.2.88 ||
sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ|| 3.2.89 ||
sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ|| svādiṣviti| suśabdaṃ varjayitvetyanantaramevābhidhānādatad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ, bāhulyāśrayaṇenaivamuktam, āḍhyo grāma itivat|
trividhaśceti| etadvahulagrahaṇānuvṛttereva labhyate| kālopapadapratyayaviṣaya iti| tatra kālaniyamātkarma kṛtavānkarmakāra ityaṇ na bhavati| upapadaniyamāt mantramadhīmadhītavānmantrādhyāya ityaṇeva bhavati, na tu kvip| pratyayaniyamāt mantraṃ karoti kariṣyati veti vivakṣāyāmaṇeva bhavati, na tu kvip śāstrakṛditi| `kvip‌ ca' iti kvip||
some suñaḥ|| 3.2.90 ||
some suñaḥ|| kāladhātūpapadapratyayaviṣaya iti| tatra bhūtakālasya kvipi niyatatvātsomaṃ sutavānsomasāva ityaṇ na bhavati| tathā dhātoḥ soma evopapade niyatatvātsurāṃ sutavānsurāsāva ityaṇeva bhavati| tathā somasya sunotāveva dhātau niyatatvātsomaṃ krītavān somakrīriti kvib na bhavati, aṇeva tu bhavati| tathā kvipo bhūte niyatatvātsomaṃ sunoti soṣyati veti vivakṣāyāṃ kvib na bhavati, aṇeva tu bhavati||
agnau ceḥ|| 3.2.91 ||
agnau ceḥ|| atrāpītyādi| tatra bhūtakālasya kvipi niyatatvādagniṃ citavānagnicāya ityaṇ na bhavati| dhātoścāgnāvupapade niyatatvādiṣṭakāciditi na bhavati| agneścinotāveva niyatatvādagnibhṛditi na bhavati| kvipaśca bhūta eva niyatatvādagniṃ cinoti ceṣyati vetyatrābhāvaḥ||
karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām|| 3.2.92 ||
karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām|| `karmaṇi hanaḥ' ityato'nuvṛttaṃ karmagrahaṇamupapadam, idaṃ tu karmapratyayārthamityāha---kamaṇyeva kāraka iti| evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ| upapadaṃ tāvatkarmapratyayārtho'pi karmaiveti| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhisampratyayārthamiti| agniśabdo loke jvalane rūḍhaḥ, vede tvagnyartha iṣṭakācaye'pi pracuraḥ prayogaḥ----ya evaṃ vidviānagniṃ cinute, agniṃ ceṣyamāṇa iti, sa mukhyo jaghanyo vā bhavatu; iha tvasatyākhyāgrahaṇe lokaprasiddhivaśena jvalana eva gṛhyeta, mā grāhi, iṣṭakācaya eva gṛhyatāmityākhyāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ||
karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ|| 3.2.93 ||
karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ|| karmaṇīti vartamāna iti| `karmaṇi hanaḥ' ityataḥ karttuḥ kutsānimitte karmaṇīti yatkarma kriyāsambaddhaṃ kartuḥ kutsāmāvahati tatretyarthaḥ| somādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ śāstre niṣiddhaḥ||
ddaśeḥ kvanip|| 3.2.94 ||
ddaśeḥ kvanip|| pratyayāntaranivṛttyarthamiti| pratyayāntaraṃ saha nirdiṣṭaṃ maninādi, aṇādi ca| sopapadānniṣṭhā tu bhavatyeva---palokaṃ ddaṣṭavāniti||
rājani yudhikṛñaḥ|| 3.2.95 ||
rājani yudhikṛñaḥ|| nanu ca yudhirakarmaka iti| tatkathaṃ rājan‌śabde karmavācinyupapada ityuktamiti bhāvaḥ| antarbhāvitaṇyartha iti| anekārthathvāddhātūnāṃ lakṣaṇayā vā yadā ṇyarthamapi yudhirevāntarbhāvayati tadā prayojyena karmaṇā sakarmako bhavatītyarthaḥ||
sahe ca|| 3.2.96 ||
sahe ca|| asattvavacanatvānnopapadaṃ karmaṇā viśeṣyata iti| ataśca `karmaṇi'iti nānuvartate iti bhāvaḥ| na punaranuvartamānasyaivānnāsambandhaḥ, uttaratrāpyanupayogāt||
saptamyāṃ janeīḥ|| 3.2.97 ||
saptamyāṃ janeīḥ|| manduraja iti| `vājiśālā tu mandurā'| `ṅyāpossaṃjñāchandasorbahulam' iti hrasvaḥ||
pañcamyāmajātau|| 3.2.98 ||
pañcamyāmajātau|| buddhyādaya ātmaguṇāḥ, khedaḥ-rāgaḥ, khedāt streṣu pravṛttiriti darśanāt||
upasarge ca saṃjñāyām|| 3.2.99 ||
upasarge ca saṃjñāyām|| prajeti prāṇijātasyaiṣā saṃjñā||
anau karmaṇi|| 3.2.100 ||
anau karmaṇi|| pumāṃsamanujāta iti| pumāṃsamanuruddhya jāta ityarthaḥ, tenāsya sakarmakatvam| pumanuja iti puṃsaḥ saṃyogāntalopaḥ||
anyeṣvapi ddaśyate || 3.2.101 ||
anyeṣvapi ddaśyate|| dvirjāta iti|
māturagre vijananaṃ dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhanam|
tatrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tvācārya ucyate||
niṣṭhā|| 3.2.102 ||
niṣṭhā ktaktavatū niṣṭhetyuktamiti| kakāraḥ kitkāryārthaḥ, ukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ, `atvasantasya' iti viśaṣaṇārthaśca| niṣṭhāyāmityādi| aprasiddhiḥ-aniṣpattiḥ, kasya? saṃjñāyāḥ, saṃjñino vā| kathamityāha---saṃjñayeti| yadi dviḥ ktaktavatūpagrahaṇaṃ kriyeta--iha, saṃjñāvidhau ca, tato na syāditaretarāśrayatvamiti saṃjñayetyuktam| satośca tayoriti| loke śāstre vā na tāvalloke sānubandhāvetau staḥ, śāstre'pi yadyapi `ñītaḥ ktaḥ' `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ'iti ktaḥ svarūpeṇa vihito'sti, bhūte tu kāle nāsti, ktavatustu na kvāpyastīti bhāvaḥ| bhāvinī saṃjñeti| saṃjñino bhāvitvāt saṃjñāpi bhāvinī sūtraśāṭakavat tadyathā----asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti tantuvāya uktaḥ, sa paśyati yadi śāṭako na vātavyaḥ, atha vātavyo na śāṭakaḥ, śāṭako vātavyaśceti vipratiṣiddham, manye sa vātavyo yasminnute śāṭaka ityetadbhavatīti| sāmarthyāditi| `ktaktavatū niṣṭhā'iti vacanāt anyasyotpannasya niṣṭheti saṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ-sāmarthyam| ādikarmaṇīti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī, ekaphaloddeśapravṛttakṣaṇasamūharūpā kriyā, tatrādye kriyākṣaṇe'pavṛkte'pi dhātvartharūpāyāḥ kriyāyā anapavṛktatvādvacanam| nyāyyā tvādyapavargāt| nyāyyā tveṣā bhūtakālatā, kutaḥ? ādyapavargāt| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇo'pavṛktaḥ tasminneva cāvayave samūharūpo dhātvarthaḥ parisamāptaḥ uktaṃ ca----
samūhaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu|
samāpyate tato bhede kālabhedasya sambhavaḥ|| iti|
tathā ca prākārṣītkaṭaṃ devadatta iti luṅapi prayujyate| kaṭāvayave vā kaṭaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tataḥ keṣāñcitkaṭāvayavakṣaṇānāmaparisamāpteḥ prakariṣyati kaṭaṃ devadatta iti lṛṭ‌prayogo'pyaviruddhaḥ|
apara āha---jñāpakātsiddhaṃ yadayam `ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ' `kartari ca'`udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām' iti cāha, tajjñāpayati---bhavatyādikarmaṇi kta iti| naitadasti jñāpakam, `ñītaḥ ktaḥ' iti yo'yaṃ vartamāne ktastadviṣayametatsyāt? yadi tadviṣayameva syādvartamānagrahaṇameva kuryāt||
suyajoṅ‌rvanip|| 3.2.103 ||
suyajoṅ‌rvanip|| sunoteriti| `su stru gatau',`su prasavaiśvaryayoḥ'----ityanayoreva niranubandhakayorgrahaṇaṃ prāptam; anabhidhānādubhayapadinā sāhacaryādvā na bhavati| ṅakāraḥ sunoterguṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, pakāraḥ svarārthastugarthaśca||
jīryateratṛn|| 3.2.104 ||
chandasi liṭ|| 3.2.105 ||
chandasi liṭ|| ātatāneti| `ṇaluttamo vā' iti ṇittvapakṣe vṛddhiḥ| dhātusambandhe sa vidhiriti| `dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ' ityadhikārāt| liṭa ikāraṭakārau viśeṣaṇārthau, `liṭaḥ kānajvā' `liṭyabhyāsamyobhayeṣām' ityādau `la' ityucyamāne'nyeṣāmapi laṅādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, niranubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| parokṣe liṭo'pi tarhi na prāpnoti? ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaśca||
liṭaḥ kānajvā|| 3.2.106 ||
liṭaḥ kānajvā|| cikyāna iti| `ciñ cayane',`vibhāṣā ceḥ' iti kutvam, `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ| na ca bhavatīti| vāvacanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| vā'sarūpavidhiśca lādeśeṣu nāsti, `haśaśvatorlaṅ ca' iti vacanādityuktam| nanvanantarasūtravihitasya liṭo nityamādeśostu, yastu `chandasi luṅlaṅ‌liṭaḥ' iti liṭ, tatra tiṅāṃ śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati? na; tasya dhātusambandhaviṣayatvādadhātusambandhe tiṅāṃ śravaṇaṃ na syāt| liṇmātrasya ca grahaṇamityanantarameva vakṣyati|
pūrvasyaivetyādi| pratyayāntaraṃ tu kānaj na bhavati, vāvacanādvā'sarūpavidhinaiva luṅādīnāṃ siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| liṇmātrasyeti| bhāṣye tvantarasyaiva liṭo'yamādeśaḥ, liṅgrahaṇaṃ ca pratyayāntaratvaṃ mā vijñāyīti| vāvacanaṃ cottarārthamiti sthitam|
kānacaścitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham| kitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, na `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' ityeva siddham, tena ījānastepāna ityādau saṃprasāraṇaitvābhyāsalopādikārya bhaviṣyati? saṃyogāntārtham----`bandha bandhane' `vṛttasya yadvadvadhānasya, tvamarṇavān badvadhānā aramṇā'atra `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ, chāndasatvādabhyāsadhakārasya halādiśśeṣeṇa nivṛttyabhāve `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' iti jaśtvaṃ dakāraḥ| nanu chāndasaḥ kānac‌ liṭ ca chandasi sārvadhātukamapi bhavati, `chandasyubhayathā'iti vacanāt, tatra `sārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅittvaṃ ṅitītyupadhālopo bhaviṣyati? na ca saṃyogānteṣu kittvaṅittvayorviśeṣo'sti| ṛkārāntaguṇapratiṣedhārtha tu, `ṛcchatyṝtām'iti ṛkārāntānāṃ pratiṣedhaviṣaye guṇa ārabhyate sa yatheha bhavati---paritastare iti, evamihāpi syāt----paritistirāṇa iti, tasmātkitkaraṇam| kitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhāṣāyāmapi kānajastītyetattu bhāṣyavirodhātupekṣyam||
kvasuśca|| 3.2.107 ||
kvasuśca|| kvasorukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ, jakṣivānityādau `ugidacām' iti num, upaseduṣītyādau `ugitaśca' iti ṅīp, `vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam'ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇamapyukārasya prayojanam| kitkaraṇaṃ kimartha na `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' ityeva siddham? saṃyogāntārtham|añjeḥ ājivān---upadhālopo bhavati, chāndasaḥ kvasuḥ liṭ| chandasi sārvadhātukamapi tatra `sārvadhātukamapit' iti| tattvaṅitītyupadhālopo bhaviṣyati| ṛkārāntaguṇapratiṣedhārthantu', `ṛcchatyṝtām' ityayaṃ guṇaḥ pratiṣedha ārabhyate sa yatheha bhavati---teratusteruriti, tathā titīrvānityatrāṃpi syāt| kitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhāṣāyāmapi kvasurbhavatītyettu bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| uttarasūtrānarthakyaṃ ca, yadi bhāṣāyāmapi kvasurbhavati||
bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ|| 3.2.108 ||
bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ|| ādeśavidhānādevetyādi| yadi bhāṣāyāṃ sadādibhyo bhūtasāmānye liṇna syāt, tatastāddaśasya liṭa ādeśavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāditi manyate| nanu ca `liṭaḥ kānajvā' ityatra punarliḍgahaṇasya prayojanamuktam---yo'pi parokṣe liḍ‌vihitastasyāpyayamādeśo bhavatīti, taccetsatyam, ihāpi yaḥ parokṣe liṭ sa bhāṣāyāmapi sadādibhyaḥ sambhavatīti tasyevedamādeśavidhānaṃ syāt? ucyate---liṅ‌liḍ‌viṣaye'pi parastādanuvṛtterbhavatīti vakṣyati, tato nānena parokṣe liṭa ādeśābhidhānam, kiṃ tarhi? bhūtasāmānye, tataścādeśavidhānādeva liḍapi tadviṣayo'numātavyaḥ| yadyevam, tasya pakṣe kvasvādeśaḥ pakṣāntare tiṅāṃ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti? na vāvacanena kvasurabhisambaddhyate kvasurvā bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi? liḍabhisambaddhyate, bhāṣāyāṃ sadādibhyo vā liṭ; tasya nityaṃ svasurādeśo bhavatīti| vṛttigrantho'pyasminnevārtha yojanīyaḥ| upāsadaditi| lṛdittvādaṅ| upāsīdaditi pāghrādisūtreṇa sīdādeśaḥ| anūṣivāniti| yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam`śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam| anvavātsīditi| `sasyārddhadhātuke' iti tatvam| anūvāseti| `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇam| luṅlaṅ viṣaye'pi parastādanuvṛtterbhavatīti| anyathā bhūtasāmānye luṅ vihitastraiva dhātuviśeṣe'nenādeśavidhānenānumito liḍapavādaḥ| tathā bhūtaviśeṣe laṅ‌liṭau luṅ evāpavādau| sadādibhyastu bhūtaviśeṣe etatsūtravihitaṃ ca kārya prāpnoti, laṅ‌liṭau ca; apavādavipratiṣedhāllaṅ‌liṭāveva syātām||
upeyivānāśvānanūcānaśca|| 3.2.109 ||
upeyivānāśvananūcānaśca|| upapūrvādiṇaḥ kvasuriti| nipātyata ityarthaḥ| liḍādeśaścāyam; anyathā dvirvacanābhyāsadīrghatve api nipātayitavye syātām| tathā grāmamupeyivānityatra `na lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho na syāt| dvirvacanamiti| iḍāgamātpūrva nityatvātkrita ityarthaḥ| abhyāsadīrghatvamiti| `dirghaiṇaḥ kiti' ityanena| tatsāmarthyāditi| yadi hyekādeśaḥ syāddīrghavidhānamanarthakaṃ syād; ekādeśenaiva dīrghasya siddhtvāt| nanu cābhyāsadīrghatvasyeyaturityādiravakāśaḥ syāt, atra hi i i atus iti sthite dīrghatvamekādeśaśca prāpnoti, `iṇo yaṇ' iti yaṇādeśaśca; tatra `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iti bahvāśrayatvenaikādeśasya bahiraṅgatvādvā yaṇeva bhavati, tataśca dīrghavidhānamarthavadbhavati ? evaṃ manyate----atrāpi pūrvaparavidhirekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhiriti, tatra karttavye yaṇādeśasya sthānivattvātsyādevaikādeśaḥ; tadevamabhyāsadīrghatvamanavakāśatvātsavarṇadīrghatvaṃ bādhata iti| tasmātsuṣṭhūktam-----tatsāmarthyādekādeśapratibandha iti| tatreti| evaṃ satītyarthaḥ| sa nipātyata iti| nipātanāśrayaṇamiḍartham| anyatsarvaṃ pūrvatraiveṇgrahaṇādeva siddhamityarthaḥ|
yadi tahīḍarthametannipātanaṃ saṃprasāraṇaviṣaye'pi prāpnoti; atra valāderiti viśeṣānupādānāt, yathā vakṣyati----nityaścāyaṃ valnimitto vighātīti, tatrāha-----krādiniyamātprāptaśceti| caśabdo hetau| nātrāpūrva iṅ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? yo'yaṃ valādilakṣaṇa iṭ krādiniyamena prāptaḥ `vasvekājāddhasām' iti niyamena pratiṣiddhaḥ, sa eva pratiprasūyate-pratibandhapanayanena punaḥ pravarttyate| tenājādā vatiprasaṅgo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| anye tu----abhyāsadīrghatve kṛte dhātvikārasya vyañjanaṃ yaṇādeśaṃ nipātayanti, īyvasu iti sthite `vasvekājāddhasām' ityeveṭ siddhaḥ, sa ca valādilakṣaṇa iti nāstyatiprasaṅgaḥ|
apara āha---pūrvasūtra evegrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, nārtho nipātanāśrayaṇena| atra yaduktam---īyaturityatrābhyāsadīrghatve kṛte ekādeśātpūrva vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya iti yaṇi kṛte'pi tasya sthānivattvādekādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tataścāvaśyamabhyāsadīrghatvena bādhitavya ekādeśa iti, tanna; na hi sthānivadbhāvena rūpamatidiśyate, rūpāśrayaśca pūrvaparayorekādeśo na yakārasya bhavitumarhati| kiñca, yaṇādeśena bādhitasyaikādeśasya punassthānivadbhāvenāpi pravṛttyabhāvo bādhitatvādeva| kimato yadyevāmidaṃ tato bhavati? iṇaḥ kvasau vihite dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, `vasvekājād‌ghasām' itīḍāgamaśca| kimatra karttavyam? paratvādiṭ nityaṃ dvirvacanaṃ kṛte'pīṭi prāpnoti, akṛte'pi prāpnotīti| iḍapi nityaḥ, kṛte dvirvacane'bhyāsadīrghatve ekādeśe ca ekāctvātprāpnoti; idānīgeva hyuktam---abhyāsadīrghatvena na bādhitavya ekādeśa iti| tadevamubhayornityayoḥ paratvādiṭ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsadīrghatvaṃ parasya yaṇādeśaḥ īyaturityādivatsiddhamupeyivāniti| bibhidvānityādau nityatvātpūrva dvirvacanameva bhavati|
na cātropasargastantramiti| evamācāryāṇāmupadeśa iti bhāvaḥ| anupasargācceti| `īyivāṃsamatistridhaḥ' iti hi chandasi ddaśyate| luṅādayo bhavantīti| laṅ‌liḍ‌viṣaye'pi parastādanṛvṛtterayaṃ vidhirbhavatīti darśayati| upāgāditi| `iṇo gāluṅi',`gātisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ' iti sico luk| upaiditi| adāditvācchapo luk,`āḍajādīnām',`āṭaśca'| upeyāyeti| tipo ṇali vṛddhyāyādeśau, `dvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivadbhāvādikārasya dvivacanam `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe'|
aśnāteriti| `aśa bhojane'| nañpūrvāditi| tenānyapūrvātkevalācca na bhavati| nāśīditi| tipi sici `neṭi' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, `āḍajādīnām' `āṭaśca', nañā saha savarṇadīrghatvam| nāśeti| tipi ṇali dvirvacane `ata ādeḥ' ityabhyāsadīrghaḥ, nañā pareṇa ca savarṇadīrghatvam|
vaceriti| `bruvo vaciḥ' ityasya| tathā ca laṅi anvabravīdityudāhariṣyate| anye tu `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' ityasyāpi grahaṇamicchanti| karttarīti| na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| etacca nipātanāllabhyam| anvavocaditi| `vaca um'| anvabravīditi| `bru va īṭ'| anūvāceti| pūrvavadabhyāsasaṃprasāraṇam|
luṅ|| 3.2.110 ||
luṅ|| iha bhūtasāmānye luṅ vidhīyate, tasya viśeṣe'nadyatane laṅ‌liṭāvapavādau, tadviṣaye'pi luṅ ddaśyate, āgamāma ghoṣāt, apāsa payaḥ, aśeyiṣmahi pūtīkatṛṇeṣu, abhūnnṛpo vivudhasakhaḥ parantapaḥ, iti ciravṛttaṃ kathayataḥ prayuñcate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣe sāmānyamasti, tatra viśeṣāvivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyāśrayaṇena vastuto'nadyatane'pi luṅupapadyate, drūpavivakṣāyāmeva tu laṅ‌liṭau, vivakṣopārūḍho hyarthaḥ śabdaprayoganimittaḥ, na vastutaḥ sanniti| gatametat| vaseriti| `vasa nivāse' rātreścaturthe yāme pṛṣṭo yadā vākyaṃ prayuṅkte tadā tasyātikrāntarātripraharatrayavasanamanadyatanamiti laṅprayoge luṅ vaktavyaḥ| laṅ‌nivṛttiparaṃ caitat luṅ bhūtasāmānyavivakṣayā siddhaḥ|
jāgaraṇasantatāviti| yadā prayoktā sakalamatikrānta rātripraharatrayaṃ jāgarivatān tadā luṅprayogaḥ yadā suptvā prabuddhya tadā laṅpratyaya evetyarthaḥ||
anadyatanelaṅ|| 3.2.111 ||
anadyatanelaṅ|| `anadyatane' iti tatpuruṣapakṣe paryudāsaścedvyāmiśre'pi prāpnoti---adya hyo vā'bhukṣmahīti, bhavati hyadyatanānadyatanasamudāyo'dyatanādanyaḥ, prasajya pratiṣedhe tu yo'trādyatanastadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, kintu bhūtasamānye prāpnoti, bhūtaviśeṣe hi pratiṣedhaḥ| na ca sāmānyaṃ viśeśo bhavati| paryudāse'pyayaṃ doṣo draṣṭavyaḥ| bahuvrīhau na vidyate'dyatano yasmin so'nadyatano bhūto dhātvarthaḥ, tatra varttamānāllaṅ bhavati, tataścādyatanasamudāye'dyatanasyaikadeśasya sambhavānna bhavati prasaṅgaḥ| bhūtasāmānye'pi na bhavatyeva, vidyate hi sāmānye viśeṣaḥ, ato bahuvrī---hirevāyaṃ yukta ityāha---anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa iti| bahuvrīhiṇā vivakṣitārthasya pratipādanaṃ bahuvrīhervoccāraṇamityarthaḥ| yadi bahuvrīhinirddeśaḥ, evaṃ satyadyatane prāpnoti, na hyadyatane'dyatano vidyate? adyatane'pi muhūrttādiradyatano vidyate, muhūrttādāvapi kṣaṇādiḥ, katham? vyapadeśivadbhāvena yathā mukhye bhede ādhārādheyabhāvo bhavati---taṭe tiṣṭhatīti, tathehāpi samudāyāvayavabhedāśrayeṇa samudāye'dyatane'vayavā adyatanāḥ santītyanadyatano na bhavatītyucyate, na tu tattvataḥ avayavavyatirikto'tra samudāya ādhāro'sti| taduktaṃ hariṇā-----
kālasyāpyaparaṃ kālaṃ nirddiśantyeva laukikāḥ|
na ca nirddeśamātreṇa vyatireko'nugamyate|| iti|
adya hya iti|| adya hyaścetyarthaḥ| gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ nayamāna itivaccaśabdasyāprayogaḥ| abhukṣmahīti| `bhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, mahiṅi `liṅ‌sicāvātmanepadeṣu' iti sicaḥ kittvād guṇābhāvaḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' iti kutvam---gakāraḥ, `khari ca' iti carttvam----kakāraḥ, sicaḥ sasya ṣatvam| parokṣe cetyādi| parokṣaśabdo'yamatīndriyārthe varttate, lokavijñāte lokaprasiddhe prayokturdarśanaviṣaye laṅantasya śabdarūpasya yaḥ prayoktā tasya darśanaviṣaye laṅ vaktavyaḥ| nanu vipratiṣiddhamidam yadi parokṣaḥ, kathaṃ darśanaviṣayaḥ? atha darśanaviṣayaḥ, kathaṃ parośraḥ? śakyadarśanatvāddarśanaviṣayaḥ, kvacidvyāsaṅgādananubhūtatvātparokṣaiti virodhābhāvaḥ| aruṇaditi| `rudhir āvaraṇe',`rudhāditvāt śnam, tipo halṅyādinā lopaḥ| sāketarodhastadānīṃ prayokturdarśanaviṣayaḥ, śakyadarśanatvāt| lokaprasiddhaśca, kvacidvyāsaṅgādananubhūtatvātparokṣaśca| parokṣa iti kim? udagādādityaḥ, iṇo luṅ, gādeśādikāryam|
lokavijñāta iti| kima? cakāra kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ| prayoktudarśanaviṣaye iti| kim? jaghāna kaṃsaṃ kila vāsudevaḥ, hanteḥ parokṣe liṭ,dvirvacanam,`abhyāsācca'iti kutvam---hakārasya ghakāraḥ| kaṃsavadhaścirakālāntaravṛttatvādidānīṃ prayokturdarśanaviṣayo na bhavati| yastu kaṃsavadhena tulyakālaḥ prayoktā sa laṅameva prayuktavān----āhata kaṃsaṃ vāsudeva iti| mūlodāharaṇe'pi prayoktā sāketarodhena tulyakālo veditavyaḥ, tasyeva hyasau darśanaviṣayaḥ, nānyasya||
abhijñāvacane lṛṭ|| 3.2.112 ||
abhijñāvacane lṛṭ|| vatsyāma iti| vaselṛṭ mas, `syatāsāṃ lṛluṭoḥ' iti syapratyayaḥ, `sasyārddhadhātuke' iti sasya takāraḥ, `ato dīrgho yañi' iti dīrghaḥ|
vacanagrahaṇamityādi| asati vacanagrahaṇe'bhijñāśabda evopapade syāt, tasmiṃstu sati yāvanto'bhijñānavacanāsteṣu bhavati| buddhyase cetayase iti| arthaprakaraṇādinā smṛtirūpe jñāne yadānayorvṛttistadātrāpi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||
na yadiḥ|| 3.2.113 ||
na yadi|| yadīti satisaptamīyam| abhijñāvacanaṃ cānuvarttate, tena yatra yacchabdo'sti, tatra yadabhijñāvacanaṃ tanniyogato yacchabdena sahitaṃ bhavatītyabhipretyāha-----yacchabdasahita ityādi| avasāmeti| vesarlaṅ mas, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' iti salopaḥ, dīrghaḥ, vāsamātramityādinottarasūtrasya nāyaṃ viṣaya iti darśayati| yadi tatrāparaṃ kiñcillakṣyamapekṣyeta tadottarasūtreṇa pākṣiko vidhissyāt, tacca neṣyate, tasmānna tasya viṣayaḥ||
vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe|| 3.2.114 ||
vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe|| ubhayatravibhāṣeyamiti| prāpte cāprāpte ca| asati yacchabde `abhijñāvacane lṛṭ' iti prāpte sati yacchabde pratiṣedhe prāpte| ākāṅkṣaṇam-ākāṅkṣā, ākāṅkṣayā saha varttate sākāṅkṣaḥ| ākākṣaṅkṣā ca cetanāvato dharmaḥ, tasmātsākākṣaṅkṣa ityetatprayoktṛviśeṣaṇam, tena sakarmaka ityādivatsamāsaḥ| sākāṅkṣaścetprayokteti| `aṅgayuktaṃ tiṅākāṅkṣam' ityatra tu prayoktṛgatākāṅkṣādhyāropeṇa tiṅantamākāṅ‌kṣamiti vakṣyate| iha tu mukhye prayoktari sambhavati, gauṇakalpanayā dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ| īddaśe punarviṣaye prayoktā sākāṅkṣo bhavatītyāha---lakṣyalakṣaṇayoḥ sambandhe iti| yatraiko dhātvartho lakṣyaḥ, aparo lakṣaṇam, tatra dvayorlakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvena sambandhe sati prayokturākāṅkṣā bhavati, tatra na vāsamātraṃ pratipādya prayoktā caritārtho bhavati, kintu tena prasiddhena bhojanādikaṃ smārayituṃ pravarttate||
parokṣe liṭ|| 3.2.115 ||
parokṣe liṭ|| parokṣaśabdo'yamatīndriyavāco prasiddhaḥ| vyutpattistu paramakṣṇaḥ parokṣam, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ, `acpratyanvavapūrvāt' ityatrājiti yogavibhāgādac samāsāntaḥ| vṛttiviṣaye cākṣiśabdaḥ sarvendriyavacanaḥ, na cakṣuḥ paryāyaḥ; anyathendriyāntaravijñātaṃ vastu parokṣamāpadyeta | evaṃ ca kṛtvā darśanaparyāyo'kṣiśabdo na bhavatīti `akṣṇo'darśanāt' ityevāc samāsānto'stu| anye tu `pratiparasamanubhyo'kṣṇaḥ' iti śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhādac samāsānta ityāhuḥ| sa ca yadyapyavyayībhāve vidhīyate, tathāpi paraśabdenāvyayībhāvāsambhavātsamāsāntare vijñāyate| evaṃ tu `kriyāyāṃ parokṣāyām' iti bhāṣyaprayoge ṭillakṣaṇo ṅīp prāpnoti, tasmādajanta evāyam| tatra parataḥ paraśabdasya paro bhāvo'smādeva nirddeśādbhavati, paraśabdāduttarasyākṣiśabdasyāderutvaṃ vā|
nanu cetyādi| ekaphaloddeśena pravṛttatvādaikyamivāpannā vitatarūpaḥ kṣaṇapravāho dhātvarthaḥ, sa kārtsnyenaikasminkṣaṇe na sambhavatīti sadvastuviṣayairindriyairna gahyate, tataścaikaikasya kriyākṣaṇasya pratyakṣatve'pi samūharūpo dhātvarthaḥ sarvaḥ parokṣa eva, tataścāvyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| satyametaditi| anantaroktaṃ manyate| kimartha tarhi parokṣagrahaṇamityāha---astviti| yatra sādhanaśaktyāśrayabhūtaṃ phūtkārasītkārādiviśiṣṭaṃ saṃrabdharūpaṃ dravyaṃ pratyakṣam, tatra dhātvartha eva pratyakṣābhimāno laukikānām| abhimānaḥ-mithyājñānam, tadvyāvṛttaye parokṣagrahaṇam| yadi tarhi yatra sādhanaśaktyāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ parokṣam, tatra liṅ bhavati tarhi uttamo na prāpnoti, tatra hi buddhīndriyaśarīrādisaṃghātaḥ kartā, sa cātmanaḥ pratyakṣa eva| `parasmaipadānām' iti tu ṇalādeśavacanaṃ `ṇaluttamo vā' iti ca, `chandasi luṅlaṅ‌liṭaḥ',`atyantāpahnave' iti cāparokṣe yo liṭ tadviṣayaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha---uttamaviṣaye'pi cittavyākṣepāditi| madasvapnādibhiścitte vyākṣipte bhavati vai kaścitsvakṛtameva na jānāti, paścādeva tvayā kṛtamiti pārśvasthebhyaḥ śrutvā prayuṃkte---supto'haṃ kila vilalāpeti| kiletyajñānaṃ sūcayati| atyantāpahnava iti| apahnavaḥ-alāpaḥ| kaliṅgo nāmajugupsito deśaḥ, tatra praviśya tvayā cirakālaṃ sthitamiti kaściduktassannāha---nāhaṃ kaliṅgaṃ jagāmeti| na kevalamavasthānameva pratiṣidhyate, kiṃ tarhi? taddhetubhūtagamanamapīti bhavatyatyantāpahnavaḥ| tathā dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviśyāyājyayānādikaṃ tvayā kṛtamiti kaściduktaḥ sannāha---nāhaṃ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviveśeti| atrāpyayājyayājanāderhetubhūtaḥ praveśa eva pratiṣiddhyata ityatyantāpahnavaḥ| kvacit dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviṣṭo'sīti vṛttāveva paṭhyate, tatra praviśyedaṃ kṛtavānityarthaḥ||

haśaśvatorlaṅ ca|| 3.2.116 ||
praśne cāsannakāle || 3.2.117 ||
praśne cāsannakāle|| bhūtānadyatanaparokṣa iti varttata iti| ayamartho'nuvarttata ityarthaḥ,na punarevaṃvidhassamāsaḥ prakṛto'sti| praṣṭavyaḥ praśna iti| karmasādhanaṃ praśnaśabdaṃ darśayati| karaṇasādhane tu praśnakriyāsādhanabhūte dhātāvāsannakāla ityarthassyāt, tatrāsannakāla ityanarthakam, na hyanuccāritātpratyayavidhānam, uccāritaścāsannakāla eva| bhāvasādhane'pyāsannakāle praśre varttamānādityarthassyāt, tataścārthāntaravācibhyo laṅ na syāt, ataḥ karmasādhano'yaṃ praśraśabdaḥ| tatra pañcavarṣābhyantaramāsannakālam, pañcavarṣātītaṃ tu viprakṛṣṭakālamiti varṇayanti||
laṭ sme|| 3.2.118 ||
laṭ sme|| naḍena sma purādhīyate iti| adhipūrvādiṅaḥ karmaṇi lakāraḥ, karmāvivakṣāyāṃ vā bhāve, naḍeneti karttari tṛtīyā| atha vā---adhīyate iti karttari bahuvacanam, `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityadādeśaḥ, naḍeneti sahayoge tṛtīyā| anye tu vyācakṣate---purākalpe---purākalpe naḍākhyaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaṃ haste gṛhītvādhīyānā adhīyate smeti||
aparokṣe ca|| 3.2.119 ||
aparokṣe ca|| pūrvasūtreṇa parokṣe vidhānādaparokṣe na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ, pūrvasūtra eva parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate| yadyevam, tatsambandhādanadyatanagrahaṇamapi nivarteta mā nivṛtadityevamarthamidam, dvayorhi prakṛtayorekanivṛttiryatnena kriyamāṇā itarasyānivṛttimanumāpayati||
nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane|| 3.2.120 ||
nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane|| pṛṣṭamiti karmaṇi ktaḥ, pṛṣṭasya prativacanaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam| vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ darśitam| praśnapūrvake prativacana iti| udāharaṇe pūrvaśaḥ praśraḥ,uttara udāharaṇam| pṛṣṭagrahaṇārthakaṃ praśnapūrvakameva prativacanam? tanna; viruddhamapi vacanaṃ prativacanaṃ vacanābhimukhaṃ prativacanamityapi sambhavāt| tasmāt pṛṣṭagrahaṇam| atyantāsannakāle cāyaṃ vidhiriṣyate, tatra nirvṛttāyāmapi pākādikriyāyāṃ tatkṛtasya śramādarenuvṛttiḥ| evaṃ ca śramādidarśanena saiva kriyā varttata iti śakyaṃ vaktumiti| `varttamāne laṭ' ityeva siddheḥ pratyākhyātamidama----`nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane'ityaśiṣyam, kriyāsamāpteravivakṣitatvāditi||
nanvorvibhāṣā|| 3.2.121 ||
puri laṅ cāsme|| 3.2.122 ||
puri laṅ cāsme|| anadyatanagrahamamityādi| luṅgrahaṇaṃ cātra liṅgam| yadi hi bhūtamātre'yaṃ vidhiḥ syāt vibhāṣā laṭo vidhānāttena mukte luṅapi bhaviṣyati, ki luṅgrahaṇena! anadyatanagrahaṇānuvṛttau tu laṭā mukte laṅeva syāditi karttavyaṃ luṅgrahaṇam| anye'pīti| laṅ‌liṭau, abhijñāvacane lṛṭ---abhijānāsi devadatta vatsyantīha purā chātrā iti||
varttamāne laṭ|| 3.2.123 ||
varttamāne laṭ|| prārabdho'parisamāptaśceti| adhiśrayaṇādiradhaḥ śrayaṇaparyanta odanaphalāvacchinno vitatarūpo vyāpāranicayaḥ pacerarthaḥ| evaṃ sarvatra sa yāvatā kālena nivartate sa kālo varttamānaḥ, tadyogādvarttamāno dhātvartha ityarthaḥ| tena niṣpannasyārthasya bhūtatvādaniṣpannasya ca bhāvitvānniṣpannāniṣpannavyatirekeṇa rāśyantarasyābhāvādvarttamānābhāva iti codyaṃ parihṛtam| ihādhyayane pravṛttā yadā bhojanādikriyāṃ kurvanto nādhīyate tadā adhīyata iti prayogo na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āphalaniṣpatteradhyayanamaparisamāptamantarālavartitu bhojanādikvaṃ nāntarīyakaṃ tasyaiva vāvayavakriyā| yamapi bhavānmuktasaṃśayaṃ varttamānakālaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyate----bhuṅkte devadatta iti, atrāpyavaśyaṃ bhuñjāno hasati jalpati pānīyaṃ vā pibati, tatra cedyuktā varttamānakālatā, ihāpi yuktā ddaśyatām| uktaṃ ca----
vyavadhānamivopaiti nivṛtta iva ddaśyate|
kriyāsamūho bhujyādirantarālapravṛttibhiḥ||
na ca vicchinnarūpo'pi sa virāmānnivarttate|
sarvaiva hi kriyā'nyena saṅkīrṇaivopalabhyate||
tadantarāladdaṣṭā vā sarvaivāvayavakriyā|
sāddaśyātsati bhede tu tadaṅgatvena gṛhyate|| iti|
etadapyanenaivoktaṃ prārabdho'parisamāptaśca vartamāna iti| iha tiṣṭhanti parvatāḥ, sravanti sindhava iti parvatādisthityādeḥ sarvadābhāvād bhūtabhaviṣyadabhāvāttatpratidvandvirūpasya vartamānasyāpyabhāva iti laṇ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kālatrayavartināṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ pālanādikā bhūtādibhedena bhinnāstāḥ parvatasthityāderbhedikāḥ, tataśca ye samprati rājānastatkriyābhedena bhinnāyā parvatādisthitervartamānatvam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā bhūtabhaviṣyatkālayogo'pyupapadyate-----tasthuḥ parvatā naladuṣyantādikāle, sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kalkiviṣṇukāle| laṭaṣṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ||
laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|| 3.2.124 ||
laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe|| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ, cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| prathamāśabdassupāmādye trike prasiddhaḥ, prathamāyā anyā'prathamā-dvitīyādiḥ, tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhiḥ, aprathamāntaṃ dvitīyādyantamityarthaḥ| adhikaraṇam-abhidheyam, samānam-sādhāraṇam, abhidheyaṃ yasya tatsamānādhikaraṇam, aprathamāntena samānādhikaraṇamaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇam| tṛtīyeti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| dvipado vā bahuvrīhīḥ-----aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇaṃ yasyeti| `yasya ca bhāvena' iti saptamī aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe laṭi sati, tasya laṭa iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī| eṣa paryudāsapakṣo darśitaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe tu naño bhavatinā saṃbandhaḥ| prathamāśabdena prathamāntaṃ gṛhyate| śeṣaṃ samānam|
tatrādye pakṣe kurvato'patyaṃ kaurvataḥ, pācataḥ, kurvato bhaktiḥ kurvadbhaktiḥ kurvāṇabhaktiriti pratyayottarapadayoḥ śatṛśānacau na syātām, na hyatra dvitīyādyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, na hi kurvato devadattasya bhaktiḥ kurvato devadattasyāpatyamityatra samāsataddhitau bhavataḥ, sāpekṣatvāt padāntaranirapekṣatve prathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu prathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādadoṣaḥ| astu tarhi sa eva? evamapi kurvato bhaktirasya kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇabhaktiratra na prāpnoti, ye cāpyete samānādhikaraṇavṛttayastaddhitāsteṣu na syāt---kurvattaraḥ, kurvāṇataraḥ; kurvadrūpaḥ kurvatkalpa iti? paryudāse'pyeṣa doṣo draṣṭavyaḥ|
evaṃ tarhi `pratyayottarapadayośca' iti lakṣaṇaśeṣaḥ karttavyaḥ, tatra pṛthaguttarapadagrahaṇam `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate' iti samāsārthāyā vibhakterlukikṛte pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātpratyayaparatvārtham| nanu ca pratyayottarapadayoḥ satoḥ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ, tayośca kṛttvātprātipadikatve sati vibhaktyutpattau satyāṃ taddhitāḥ, samāsaśca, samāse ca satyuttarapadaṃ taditaretarāśrayaṃ bhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ḍyāp‌pratipadikāttaddhitāḥ, te lakārasya kṛttvādbhaviṣyanti, uttarapade'pi vidhānasāmarthyāttiṅādeśaṃ bādhitvā lāntasya prātipadikatvamāśritya subutpattau samāsa iti siddham| evamapi vīkṣamāṇasyāpatyaṃ vaikṣamāṇirityakṛte śānaci akārāntatvābhāvādata iño'prasaṅgaḥ, pacatitarāmityatra śatṛśānacau prāpnutaḥ, tathā pacatirūpamityādau `tiṅaśca' ityetattu laṅādiviṣayameva syāt|
tadevaṃ sarvatra doṣasadbhāve samāso'pi tāvannyāyyo bhavatīti paryudāsamāśrityāha----aprathamāntena cedityādi| tasyeti| laṭaḥ| kathaṃ punarlaṭo dvitīyādyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatā `laḥ karmaṇi ca' ityanena kartṛkarmaṇorvidhīyamāno lakāraḥ kriyāṃ prati guṇabhūte kartṛkarmaṇī pratipādayati, tathā ca kriyāpradhātvādākhyātasya kriyāntarayogābhāvācchaktyantarāveśābhāvaḥ, na hi bhavati pacatyodanaṃ devadattaṃ paśya pacyate odanena tṛptaḥ apacadodanaṃ devadattaṃ paśya pacyate odanena tṛpta iti, yathā----anyeṣu kṛtsu pākaṃ paśya, pākena tṛpta iti? satyam; tiṅbhāvino lakārasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ yaduktaguṇabhūte kartṛkarmaṇī pratipādayati, śatrādiviṣayasya kriyopasarjanakartrādyabhidhānam, tataśca kriyāntarayoge sati tannimittaṃ dvitīyādyantasāmānāghikaraṇyamupapadyate| yadyapi kevalasya laṭaḥ prayogābhāvādaprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na kvacidupalabdham, tathāpi tadādeśayoḥ śatṛśānacordarśanāt sthānino lakārasyāpi tadyogyatvamanumīyate, tena laṭaḥ prakriyārtha vihitasya kālpanikaprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyamastīti doṣābhāvaḥ|
atha laḍgrahaṇaṃ kimartham----ādeśau yathā syātāṃ pratyayāntaraṃ mā bhūtāmiti? naitadasti; pūrvasūtrata eva laḍgrahaṇaṃ svarayiṣyate, tasyehānuvṛttasyārthāt ṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇāme tasyaivādeśau bhaviṣyataḥ, na pratyayāntaramata āha----laḍiti vartamāne punarlaḍgrahaṇamiti| kvacitprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye'pi bhavata iti| aprathamāsamānādhakaraṇatvābhāvopalakṣaṇamidam, tena kaurvataḥ, kurvadbhaktirityādayo'pi bhavanti| sanniti| `as bhuvi',`śnasorallopaḥ'| vidyamāna iti| `vida sattāyām',`divādiranudāttet| juhvaditi| `nābhyastācchatuḥ' iti numabhāvaḥ|
māṅyākrośa iti| māṅi luṅo'pavādaḥ, tathā punarlaḍgrahaṇādyo'pi bhūte laṭ `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' iti tasyāpi bhavataḥ----nanu māṃ kurvantaṃ paśya, nanu māṃ kurvāṇampaśyeti| etacca `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' ityatra bhāṣyakāreṇoktam|
kecidityādi| na caivaṃ pacantampaśyetyādāvapi vikalpaprasaṅga ityata āha---vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| yathādarśanamiti| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe vikalpaḥ, pacantaṃ paśyetyādau `pratyayottarapadayośca'nityampacatitarāmityādau naiva bhavataḥ, anyathā tiṅo'pi sthānivadbhāvātsyātprasaṅgaḥ| na tarhīdānīmidaṃ vaktavyam---aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇa iti? vaktavyaṃ ca| kiṃ prayojanam? nityārtham| nanvetadapi vibhāṣayaiva siddham? satyam; sa evārtho vacanena spaṣṭīkriyate| etena `sambīdhanai ca' `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti ca vyākhyātam||
sambodhane ca|| 3.2.125 ||
sambodhane ca|| he pacanniti| saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvānnalopābhāvaḥ| atra sambhodhane prathamā, ayamādeśaścetyubhayaṃ militaṃ sambodhanaṃ dyotayati||
lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ|| 3.2.126 ||
lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ|| lakṣyate cihnyate yeneti| cihnayatiravadhārayatyādivaccurādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| nopapadaṃ kriyāyā iti vacanāt| upapadaṃ hi dhātorbhavati, sa ca kriyāvacana iti kriyāgrahaṇamanarthakamupapadatve syāt| kriyāyāśca lakṣaṇāpekṣayā karmatvam, hetvapekṣayā tu śeṣatvam, tatrobhayānugrahāya karmaṇo'pi śeṣatvavivakṣayā śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī, vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ prādarśi| kriyāviṣayāviti| śayānā bhuñjata iti| atra śayanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhojanasya| tiṣṭhanto'nuśāsatīti| atrāpi sthānamanuśāsanasya| arjayanvasatīti| `arja pratiyatne' curādirāṅpūrvaḥ|
lakṣaṇahetvoriti kimiti| kriyāsambandhinyarthe vartamānāditi vijñāyamāne lakṣaṇahetvorapi bhaviṣyata iti praśnaḥ, atiprasaṅgena tūttaram| pacati ca paṭhaticeti| atra dvayoḥ kriyayorekasminsādhane samuccayāttaddvāreṇa parasparasambandho'pyastītyubhayatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ| yaḥ kampate so'śvattha iti| bahuṣu vṛkṣeṣu tiṣṭhatsu kampanenāśvattho lakṣyate, tacca dravyam| yadutplavate tallaghviti| atrāpyutplavanena lāghavaṃ guṇo lakṣyate| niṣadanaṃ nimajjanaṃ tena gauravaṃ guṇo lakṣyate| iha tu yo'dhīyāna āste sa devadatta iti āsikriyāyā evādhyayanakriyālakṣaṇam, na devadattasya, āsikriyā tu tasya lakṣaṇam| evaṃ yastiṣṭhanmūtrayati sa brāhmaṇabruva iti, atrāpi sthitikriyā mūtraṇakriyāyā eva lakṣaṇam, saiva tu devadattasyāśau cāderlakṣaṇaṃ na sthitikriyeti sūtreṇaiva siddha ādeśaḥ| kathaṃ śayānā vardhate dūrvā, āsīnaṃ vardhate viṣamiti, na hyāsanaśayate vṛddherlakṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? svabhāvamātrakathanametat? bhavati vai svabhāvākhyānamapi lakṣaṇam, yathā----caitanyalakṣaṇaṃ puruṣa iti| pūrvanipātavyamicāraliṅgamiti| `dvandve ghi',`alpāctaram' iti yau pūrvanipātau tayorvyabhicāre liṅgamityarthaḥ| tena dhūmāgnī, mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhapaṇavā ityādiprayogopapattiḥ||
tau sat|| 3.2.127 ||
tau sat|| taugrahaṇaṃ kimartham, saṃjñāvidhiryathā syāt sadityasya pratyayasya vidhirmā bhūditi? naitadasti prayojanam, pūrvasūtre śatṛśānacau svarayiṣyete, tatsāmarthyāttayoranuvṛttayoḥ saṃjñaiva bhaviṣyati, tatrāha----taugrahaṇamupādhyasaṃsargārthamiti| laṭsthānikatvād varttamānakālavihitatvaṃ copādhiḥ, tenopādhinā'saṃbandhārthaḥ, taugrahaṇamityarthaḥ, kiṃ siddhamityāha---śatṛśānajmātrasyeti| asati taugrahaṇe yāddaśau śatṛśānacauprakṛtau laṭsthānikau varttamānakālau ca tāddaśayoreva saṃjñā syāt, tataśca lṛḍādeśayorna syāt| `lṛṭassadvā' ityetattu vacanaṃ satsaṃjñakapratirūpayorvidhānārtha syāt, yathā----amī piṣṭapiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantāmiti tadākārāḥ kriyante| vihitayostūttarakālaṃ saṃjñā na sidhyati, tataśca brāhmaṇasya pakṣyan, brāhmaṇasya pakṣyamāṇa iti samāsapratiṣedho na syāt; tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ satsaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| evaṃ bhūtakālayorapi na syāt| `varttamānasāmīpye varttamānavadvā' iti vacanād‌bhūte'pi śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ| evaṃ tatrāpi varttamānavadityatideśena vidhānameva tayorbhūte siddhyati, na tu saṃjñā| pratyayādhikārādvi pratyaya evātidiśyate, na sajñā| tathā `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane'ityapi laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavata ityuktam, tayorapi saṃjñā na bhavet, taugrahaṇe sati tayorapi saṃjñā bhavati----nanu māṃ brāhmaṇasya kurvantampaśya nanu māṃ brāhmaṇasya kurvāṇampaśyeti| atha kriyamāṇe'pi taugrahaṇe kathamiva kālāntaravihitayoḥ saṃjñā siddhyati, yāvatā prakṛtasyaiva vastunassarvanāmnā parāmarśaḥ? satyam; taugrahaṇasāmarthyāttu viśeṣaṇāṃśarityāgena śatṛśaṣānaco rūpamātraṃ parāmṛśyate||
pūṅyajoḥ śānan|| 3.2.128 ||
pūṅyajoḥ śānan|| ihaite śānannādayo yadi laṭo'nuvṛttimāśritya tasyaivādeśāḥ kriyeran, veti vaktavyam, pavamānaḥ yajamānaḥ, pavate yajata ityapi yathā syāt, vā'sarūpavidhinā tiṅo baviṣyanti, na lādeśeṣu vā'sarūpavidhirastītyuktam| sādhanābhidhānam---sādhanasya cābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti bhāvakarmaṇorapi prasaṅgaḥ| parassvaraśca na siddhyati---katīha pavamānāḥ, `adupadeśāllasārvadhātukam' ityanudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| ātmanepadasaṃjñā---`taṅānāvātmanepadam' ityātmanepadasaṃjñā ca prāpnoti, tataśca parasmaipadibhyaścānaś na syātkatīha nandamānāḥ| tasmādaśakyā evaite lādeśā vijñātumiti matvāha---śānanpratyayo bhavatīti| śakārassārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ, nakārassvarārthaḥ|
yadītyādi| `na lokāvyaya' ityatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ| tṛnniti pratyāhāranirdeśāditi| ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedha ityanuṣaṅgaḥ|
dviṣaśśaturvā vacanamiti| `dviṣo'mitre' iti yo'yaṃ śatṛpratyayastasya prayoge vā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, pratyāhāre'ntarbhāvānnityaṃ pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanam| yasyāpi tanniti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tenāpyetadvaktavyam---pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī yathā syānnityaṃ mā bhūditi| śeṣavijñānātsiddham, karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī, karmarūpeṇa vivakṣite dvitīyeti||
tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś|| 3.2.129 ||
tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś|| maṇḍayamānā ityādi| `maḍi bhūṣāyām',`bhūṣa alaṅkāre' curādī, `asu kṣepaṇe',paryāsaḥ---sannahanam, śikhāparyāyaḥ śikhaṇḍaśabdaḥ| vacanagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham||
iṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi|| 3.2.130 ||

spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc|| 3.2.158 ||
spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc.| curādāvadantāḥ paṭhyanta iti| tena ṇau kṛtasyāto lopasya sthānivadbhāvātpatayateḥ `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhirna bhavati, spṛhayatigṛhayatyośca laghūpadhaguṇo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| śratpūrvo dhāñiti| dheṭastu śratpūrvasyāprayoga eva| atha kimarthamālujvidhīyate, na lujevocyeta? kā rūpasiddhiḥ? spṛhayāluḥ śapi kṛte `ato dīrgho yañi' iti dīrgho bhaviṣyati? tatra hi `turustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke' iti sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartate, na tu tiṅgrahaṇam, lakārasyetsaṃjñāprayojanābhāvānna bhaviṣyati, yakārāditvādvā| kiṃ yakāro na śrūyate? luptanīrdiṣṭo yakāraḥ, evamapi śraddhālurna siddhyati, katham? śapaḥ ślurdvirvacanam, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' śraddadhluriti prāpnoti? athāpi `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti dvirvacanaṃ na pravartiṣyata ityucyeta? evamapi jñāpanārthamāluj vidhīyate, etaj jñāpayati---yatrālucaiva rūpasiddhistato'pyayaṃ bhavatīti| tenāluci śīṅo grahaṇamityetanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati||

āddagamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca|| 3.2.171 ||
āddagamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca|| kikinau liṭ cāparārthe prayujyamānāḥ śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyartha gamayanti, gaurvāhīka itivadityāha---liḍvacca tau bhavati iti| kikinau bhavataḥ, liṭ ca pratyayo bhavatītyayaṃ tvartho na bhavati; tathā hi sati `liṭ kikinaḥ' ityeva brūyāt| kāryātideśaścāyam| yadyevam, `laḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñā kikinoḥ syāt, tataśca deṅddaṅādibhya ātmanepadibhyo na syātām| na lakārasya parasmaipadasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? tadādeśānām, na caitāvādeśau| evamapi bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣvapi liḍvadbhāvātkikinau prāpnutaḥ? naiṣaḥ;utpannayorliṭkāryamatideśyam| utpattiśca tayoḥ karttaryeva bhavati; `kartari kṛt' ityanenāsyaikavākyatvāt| anabhidhānādvā bhāvakarmaṇorna bhaviṣyataḥ| vartamānādhikārācca vartamāne kikinorvidhānamiti bhūtakālatāpi virodhānnātidiśyate| svarūpābādhena ca kāryādideśaḥ pravartata iti tibādīnāṃ kānackvasvoścābhāvaḥ| āditi dakāro mukhasukhārtha iti| ādityayaṃ dakāraḥ, sa ca mukhasukhārtha ityarthaḥ| na tvayaṃ tapara iti| taścāsau paraśca taparo nāyamakārātparastakāro jaśtvena nirddiṣṭa ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha---mā bhūditi| takāro mukhasukhārtha iti pāṭhe tu ādityayaṃ takāraḥ sa mukhasukhārthaḥ, na tu taparakāryasampādanārtha ityarthaḥ| papiḥ somamiti| `na lokāvyaya' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho liṭaḥ kāryamiti somaśabdād dvitīyā| tatuririti| `bahulaṃ chandasi' ityutvam| `dvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivadbhāvāt `tṝ' ityetad dvirucyate| jajñiriti| `gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ, cutvam|
tadvāghanārtha kittvamiti| arterṛkārāntānāṃ ca kikinorguṇo mā bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ|
utsarga iti| dhātumātrādvidhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kasmādityatrāha---sadādibhyo daśanāditi| sediḥ nemiriti| sadernameścaitvābhyāsalopau|
sahivahityādi| atra bhāṣāyāmityapekṣyate| pāpatiriti| `nīgvañcu' ityādinā nīgāgamaḥ prāptaḥ sāsahivāvahicācalipāpatīnāṃ nipātanam' iti vārttikakāravacanānna bhavati| idaṃ tu vṛttau paṭhitaṃ vākyam| apara āheti bhāṣye paṭhitam, tatrāpi bhāṣyakāravacanānnīgabhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hi tena---tānyevodāharaṇānīti||

bhrājabhāsadhurvidyu torjipṝjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip|| 3.2.177 ||
bhrājabhāsadhurvidyu torjipṝjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip|| `bhrājṛ dīptau',`bhāsṛ dīptau',`turvī thurvī dhurvī hiṃsāyām',`dyuta dīptau',`urja balaprāṇanayoḥ',`pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ',`ju' iti sautro dhātuḥ,`ṣṭuñ stutau' grāvapūrvaḥ|
javaterdīrghatvaṃ ceti| kecidāhuḥ---sūtre `jū' iti dīrghaḥ paṭhitavya iti| vidhya ntaropasaṃgrahārtha ddaśigrahaṇamuttarasūtrādapakraṣṭavyamityanye| grāvastuditi| grāvaśabdaḥ saptamīnirdeśābhāve'pyupapadasaṃjña iṣyate| anye tu sūtranirdeśāddhātunaiva samāse paścātkvipaṃ kurvanti||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| 3.2.178 ||
anyebhyo'pi ddaśyate|| vidhyantaropasaṃgrahārthamiti| ddaśigrahaṇe sati yathā kvibantā dhātavo ddaśyante, tathaiva te'nugantavyā ityartho bhavati| evaṃ ca te tathānugatā bhavanti yadi yathāyogaṃ dvirvacanādayo--bhavanti| vidhyantarameva darśayatikvaciditi| tathā cāheti| vārttikakāraḥ| āyataṃ stautyāyatastūḥ| kaṭaṃ pravate kaṭaprūḥ| did‌yuditi| `dyutisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇam' ityabhyāsya sampasāraṇam| kathaṃ punarabhyāsasaṃjñā, yāvatā pratyāsatteḥ ṣāṣṭhika eva dvirvacane sā vidhīyate, ata evāṣṭamike na bhavati? evaṃ tarhi ddaśigrahaṇādeva samprasāraṇam, abhyāsasaṃjñā ca draṣṭavyā| jagaditi| `gamaḥ kvau' iti malopaḥ| atrāpi pūrvavadexxxxxxsakāryam|
dve ceti cakāreṇa dīrghaḥ samuccīyamāno dīrghaśrutyā `acaśca' ityupasthānādacā ca tadantavidhyāśrayaṇājjuhoterevājantasya vijñāyate, na dyutigamyorityāha---juhoterdīrghitvaṃ ceti| juhūriti| karaṇasyātra kartṛtvavivakṣā|

bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ|| 3.2.179 ||

viprasaṃbhyo ṅvasaṃjñāyām|| 3.2.180 ||

dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran|| 3.2.181 ||
dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran|| karmaṇi kāraka iti| upapadaṃ tu karma na smabhavati, yadi syāt `karmaṇyaṇ' ityasminneva prakaraṇe ṣṭranaṃ vidadhyāt| nanu cottarasūtre punaḥ ṣṭrangrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt, astu laghīyo hi karmagrahaṇātṣṭrangrahaṇam| na ceha varttamānakāle ṣṭranpratyayaḥ, dhātrītyukte kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ gamyate| ataḥ `karmaṇi' iti pratyayārtha eva, nopapadam||
dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicamihapatadaśanahaḥ karaṇe|| 3.2.182 ||
dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicamihapatadaśanahaḥ karaṇe|| dāp lavana iti| `daip śodhane' ityasya tvagrahaṇam, anabhidhānāt| yujiryoga iti| `yuja samādhau' ityasya tu pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam, anabhidhānāt| yujiryoga iti| `yuja samādhau' ityasya tu pūrvavadevāgrahaṇam| karaṇe kārake iti| upapadaṃ tu karaṇaṃ na bhavati, ajādiṣu daṃṣṭrāśabdasya pāṭhāt| ata eva ca pāṭhātsūtre'nunāsikalopena nirddeśe'pi ṣṭrani na bhavati lyuṭyeva tu bhavati| yo'tra seṭ tataḥ `titutra' ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ||

ñītaḥ ktaḥ|| 3.2.187 ||
ñītaḥ ktaḥ|| bhūte niṣṭhā vihitetyādi| tatra yenanāprāptinyāyena ktasyaiva varttamānaviṣayatayā bhūtaviṣayatā bādhyate, yathā---`vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' ityatra vakṣyate---apatye prāptastato'pakṛṣya vṛṣe vidhīyata iti| evamuttaravihitasyāpi| jñātamityetattu bhūte'pi bhavati, tenetyadhikāre upajñāta iti taddhitavidhānāt| varttamāne hi `ktasya ca varttamāne' iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhāvyam| evaṃ ca `pūjito yaḥ surairapi' ityādīnāṃ sādhutvaṃ cintyam||
matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca|| 3.2.188 ||
matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca|| matiriccheti| buddheḥ pṛthagupādānād buddhirna gṛhyate| mata iti| `anudāttopadeśa' ityanunāsikalopaḥ|
śīlita ityādi| `śīla samādhau',`rakṣa pālane',`kṣamūṣ sahane',`kruśa āhvāne rodane ca',`juṣī prītisevanayoḥ',`ruṣa roṣe',`hṛñ haraṇe';`hṛṣu alīke',`hṛṣ tuṣṭau' iti vā; `tuṣa tuṣṭau',`kamu kāntau',`yama uparame',`kaṣa hiṃsāyām' mṛṅ prāṇatyāge'| tatrādyau seṭau, uditāmuditāṃ ca `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, īditaḥ `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' iti| hṛṣṭa iti| `hṛṣerlomasu' iti| kaṣeḥ `kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ' iti| ruṣeḥ `ruṣyamatvarasaṃdhuṣāsvanām' iti vikalpaḥ|
supta iti| supeḥ `trītaḥ ktaḥ' ityeva siddhe najiṅā tacchīlādiṣu bādyā mā bhūditi samuccīyate| kvacittu sṛpta iti paṭhyate||

uṇādayo bahulam || 3.3.1 || padamañjarī
varttamāne ityeveti | `varttamāne laṭ‌' ityato varttamānagrahaṇānuvṛtteravicchedamevakāreṇa darśayati | saṃjñāyāmiti ceti | `puvaḥ saṃjñāyām' ityataḥ ||
`uṇādayaḥ' ityeva sūtramuṇādīnāṃ śāstrāntaraparipaṭhitānāṃ sādhutvānujñānārthamastu, kiṃ bahulagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---bāhulakamiti | `lā ādāne', bahūnarthān‌ lāti---bahulam, tasya bhāvo bāhulakam, manojñāditvād‌ vuñ‌ | tatpunarbahvarthādānaṃ bahulaśabdapravṛttinimittam | bahavaḥ punararthāḥ---kvacitpravṛttiḥ, kvacidapravṛttiriti vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāḥ | prakṛteriti | jātāvekavacanam | tanuśabdo'tra vṛttiviṣaye guṇamātravacanaḥ | prakṛtīnāṃ tānavamalpatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbāhulakamuktam, tenāpaṭhitābhyo'pi prakṛtibhya uṇādayo bhavanti, yathā---hṛṣerulajuktaḥ śakerapi bhavati---śaṅ‌kuleti | tathā teṣāmuṇādīnāṃ pañcapādyāṃ prāyeṇa samuccayanaṃ kṛtam, na tu sākalyena; bahulavacanāttvavihitā api bhavanti, yathā---arteḥ phiḍaphiḍ‌ḍau bhavataḥ---ṛphiḍaḥ, ṛphiḍ‌ḍa iti | kāryasaśeṣavidheśca | kāryāṇi ca saśeṣāṇi vihitāni na niḥ śeṣāṇi | bahulavacanāttvavihitānyapi bhavanti | `ṣaṇu dāne', `ñamantāḍ‌ḍaḥ', `dhātvādeḥ paḥ sa' iti satvaṃ na bhavati, kṛte vā satve ṣatvaṃ bhavati | syādetat‌---yāvatyaḥ prakṛtayaḥ pañcapādyāmupāttāḥ, yāvantaśca pratyayāḥ, yāvanti ca kāryāṇi vihitāni tāvantyeva bhavantu, mā bhūdanyeṣāṃ bahulagrahaṇena saṃgraha iti ? tatrāha---naigamarūḍhibhavaṃ hi susādhviti | nigamaḥ-chandaḥ, tatra bhavā naigamāḥ | nigamaśabdasthāthādisvareṇāntodātta iti `bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ‌' iti ṭhañi prāpte ṛgayanādipāṭhādaṇ‌ | rūḍhiḥ-prasiddhiḥ, tatra bhavā rūḍhibhavāḥ-saṃjñāśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ sādhutvamanupāttānāṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ bahulagrahaṇena saṃgrahe sati bhavati, nānyathā | hiśabdo hetau | yasmādevaṃ tasmādvāhulakamuktamityarthaḥ |
anyairapyācāryairnaigamarūḍhibhavānāṃ prakṛtyādivibhāgena vyutpādanaṃ kṛtam, ato'smābhirapi tatkarttavyamevetyabhiprāyeṇāha---nāma ceti | niruktakāro hi yāska ācāryaḥ svaśāstre niruktaiḥ sarvameva nāma dhātujamāha | tokamityapatyaṃnāma | śakaṭasya tokam śākaṭāyanaḥ | yanneti | padamarthaḥ prayojanamaptya vyutpādyatveneti padārthaḥ-prakṛtyādiḥ, padārthaścāsau viśeṣaśca padārthaviśeṣaḥ, tasmātsamutthitaṃ padārthaviśeṣasamuttham | yadevaṃvidhaṃ na bhavati, prakṛtyādiviśeṣopādānenāvyutpāditamityarthaḥ, taddhātujatvenohyam | kathamūhyam ? pratyayataḥ prakṛteśca | yatra śabdarūpe parabhāgaḥ pratyayatvena prasiddhena kenacitsadṛśaḥ śrutaḥ, tatra taṃ bhāgaṃ pratyayaṃ kalpayitvā pariśiṣṭo bhāgaḥ prakṛtitvenohyate | `hṛṣerulac' iti pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkiḥ prakṛtirūhyate, tena siddhaṃ śaṅ‌kuletyasya dhātujatvam | yatra tu pūrvo bhāgo dhātutvena prasiddhena kenacitsadṛśastatra taṃ bhāgaṃ prakṛtiṃ kalpayitvā pariśiṣṭo bhāgaḥ pratyayanvenohyaḥ | yathā----ṛphiḍaḥ, ṛphiḍ‌ḍa iti, phiḍaphiḍ‌ḍau pratyayau |
sa cāyamūho'nādipratyuktāsveva saṃjñāsu, na sarvatretyāha---saṃjñāsviti | kāryād‌ guṇapratiṣedhādikād‌ anūbandhaṃ kakārādikaṃ vidyāt‌ | tena phiḍaphiḍ‌ḍau kitāvūhyau | etadevānantaroktamūhātmakaṃ śāstramuṇādiṣvanukteṣu ||
bhūte'pi dṛśyante || 3.3.2 ||
pūrvatra vartamānādhaikārāditi | tatraiva vartamānagrahaṇaṃ na nivarttitam, bāhulyena vartamāne bhavanti, kvacideva bhūte bhavantīti kila vivekapradarśanāyeti bhāvaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu `tābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ' iti saṃpradānāpādānavyatirikte kārake manin‌ pratyayaḥ, `neḍ‌vaśi kṛti' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ || 3.3.3 ||
yathā `syado jave' ityukte javaśabdaparyāyaḥ syadaśabdo bhavati, tathehāpi bhaviṣyacchabdaparyāyā gamyādayaḥ prāpnuvantītyāśaṅkyāha---pratyayasyaivetyādi | prakṛtyarthagatā bhaviṣyatkālatā | pratyayasyaiva dyotyatvena vidhīyate, na punaḥ prakṛtyarthaparityāgena samudāyasyetyarthaḥ | na prakṛteriti | na prakṛterapītyarthaḥ | gamyādiṣu keciduṇādayaḥ, kecidaṣṭādhyāyīgatāḥ | gamī, āgāmīti | `gameriniḥ' `āṅi ṇicca' itīniḥ | bhāvī, prasthāyīti | asminnevādhikāre `bhuvaśca' `prātsthaḥ' itīniḥ, ṇittvād‌ vṛddhiryukca | rudhibudhiyudhiyātibhyaḥ pratipūrvebhyo prahādiniḥ | asmādeva nipātanādityanye | `supyajātau' ityanye | pratiyogīti | saṃpṛcādisūtreṇa ghinuṇi `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | ṇini pratyaya eva nyaṅ‌kvādipāṭhādasmādeva nipātanādvā kutvamityanye |
anadyatana upasaṃkhyānamiti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na siddhyati ? lṛṭāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate lṛ
ṭ‌ cānadyatane luṭā bādhyate, tena lṛṭa eva viṣaye ete syuḥ | na vā vākyārthatvād gamyādayaḥ śabdā viśeṣe yatsāmānyaṃ tadāśrayeṇa pravattante | anadyatanākhyastu viśeṣaḥ śvaḥ śabdamahimnā gamyate | viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu luḍeva bhavati---śvo gantā grāmamiti | vāsarūpavidhinā ca lṛḍapi bhavati | tena bhaviṣyati, gamiṣyatītyādayaḥ prayogā upapadyante ||
yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ‌ || 3.3.4 ||
`purā' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ, karmadhārayo vā | nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | nipātau caitau niścayaṃ dyotayataḥ | etayośca prayoge varttamāne laṇna bhavati; bhaviṣyatkālatayā varttamānakālatāyā bādhanāt |
yāvaddāsyatīti | yatparimāṇamasya `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌', `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam | purā vrajiṣyatīti | `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' `bhrājabhāsa' ityādinā kvip‌, `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' ityutvam | asya tṛtīyāntatvaṃ dyotayituṃ karaṇabhūtayetyuktam | pratipadoktatvādeva nipātayorgrahaṇe siddhe nipātagrahaṇaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham | tena `ātāṃ pugṇau' ityatra lākṣaṇikarayāpyākārāntasya pugbhavati, `krīṅ‌jīnāṃ ṇau' krāpayati, jāpayatīti ||
vibhāṣā kadākarhyoḥ || 3.3.5 ||
`anadyatane luṭ' ityatrāpyayaṃ yogo'nuvarttanīyaḥ, tena luḍ‌viṣaye'pi pakṣe laḍ‌ bhavati | ata eva pakṣe luḍapyudāhṛtaḥ | etacca pūrvayoge'pi draṣṭavyam | kahiṃ bhokṣyate iti | nanu ca karhiśabdo'nadyatanaviṣayaḥ, tatprayoge luḍeva bhavitumarhati, na lṛṭ; na vā vākyarthatvāt‌ | bhokṣyata iti padaṃ bhaviṣyatsāmānye varttate, anadyatanāvagatistu karhi-śabdādhīnā | na ca vākyārthaḥ padasaṃskāra upayujyate ||
kivṛtte lipsāyām || 3.3.6 ||
kimo vṛttaṃ kivṛttamiti | varttate'sminniti vṛttam, `kto'dhikaraṇe ca' ityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ | asmādeva nipātanād‌ `adhikaraṇavāciṃnā ca' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhābhāva, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā vā samāsaḥ | yatra kiṃśabdo'vayavatvena varttate tatsarvaṃ kiṃvṛttam | tataśca kīdṛśaḥ, kimīyaḥ, kintarāmityādāvatiprasaṅgātparigaṇanam | vṛttagrahaṇeneti | taditi śabdarūpāpekṣaṃ napuṃsakatvam | ḍataraḍatamauceti | ḍataraḍatamāntaṃ kiṃśabdarūpamityarthaḥ | kaṃ bhavanto rbhojayitāra iti | asyāpi `anadyatane luṭ‌' ityatrānuvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ | evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam ||
lipsyamānasiddhau ca || 3.3.7 ||
`lipsyamānasiddhau' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | vṛttau tu vastumātramadarśi | lipsyamānātsiddhiriti | asmādeva nipātanādvā pañcamīsamāsaḥ | lipsyamānaṃ bhaktādi tannimittā yā svargādeḥ siddhistasyāmityarthaḥ | nanu ca yatra lipsyamānasya siddhirgamyate, lipsāpi tatra bhavati, tataśca pūrveṇaiva siddhaṃ nārtha etena ? tatrāha---akiṃvṛttārtho'yamārambha iti | pūrvasūtre kivṛttagrahaṇaṃ lipsyamānasiddhirahite lipsāmātre kiṃvṛtta eva yathā syād‌, akiṃvṛtte mā bhūdityevamartham ||
loḍarthalakṣaṇe ca || 3.3.8 ||
adhyayanapraiṣasyeti | `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityatra sādhanaṃ kṛteti vā pādahārakādyarthamiti vacanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ ||
liṅ‌ caurdhvamauhūrttike || 3.3.9 ||
nipātanātsamāsa uttarapadavṛddhiśceti | ṭhañ‌pratyayaścādhyātprāditvāt | `bahvaco'ntodāttāt‌' ityatra tu `vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ' iti varttate | upādhyāyaścedāganteti | ūrdhvamauhūrttike'nadyatanatvaṃ sambhavatīti cintyam ||
tumun‌ṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām || 3.3.10 ||
bhikṣiṣya ityasya jaṭā iti | atra bhikṣaṇakriyārthatvaṃ jaṭānām, na tu kriyātvam; dravyatvājjaṭānām | dhāvataste patiṣyati daṇḍa iti | astyatra dhāvanakriyopapadam, na tvasau daṇḍapātanārthaṃ dhāvati, kiṃ tarhi ? dhāvato'rthātpatiṣyati daṇḍaḥ | udde śena hi tādarthyaṃ vivicyate, na tu hetutvamātreṇa tādarthyam | athetyādi codyam | pariharati---lṛṭā kriyārthopapadeneti | tumunā tu bādho nāśaṅkanīyaḥ; bhinnārthatvāt‌---karttari ṇvul‌, tumun‌ punarbhāve | katham ? `tumarthe sesen‌' ityatra tumarthagrahaṇāt‌ | yadi hi `karttari kṛt‌' iti vacanātkarttari tumun‌ syāttadvadeva sesenprabhṛtayo'pi karttari bhaviṣyanti | atastumarthagrahaṇātkarttustāvadayamapakṛṣyate | na cānyo'rtho nidiśyate, anidiṣṭārthāśca pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti | kaśca dhātoḥ svārthaḥ ? bhāva eva | lṛṭ‌ tu yadyapi bhāvakarmaṇoścaritārthastathāpi kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade bhaviṣyati kāle ca vidhānādviseṣavihitaḥ | ṇvulvidhau tu karttarīti na śrūyate, ato'sau viśeṣavihitena lṛṭā bādhyate | atha vā kiṃ na etena viśeṣavihita iti, dvayoḥsāvakāśatve'pi paratvāllṛṭ‌ ṇvulaṃ bādheta | punaścodayati---vāsarūpavidhineti | pariharati---evaṃ tarhīti | nanvasati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti cātra prayojanam, kim ? `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya prayoge yathā syāt‌, varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ puttrapauttrāṇāṃ darśaka ityatra mā bhūditi ? evaṃ manyate---padāntarasannidhānādatra bhaviṣyatkālatvaṃ gamyate | yadā hi bālaviṣayametatprayujyate tadā tasyāmavasthāyāṃ varṣaśatapūraṇasya puttrapauttradarśanasya cāsambhavāttāvantamasau kālaṃ jīviṣyatītyarthādgamyate, na tvatra padārtho bhaviṣyatkālatvamiti | sthite tvasmin‌ ṇvulvidhāne `vaṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ' ityādau bhaviṣyatkālasya padārthatve'pi na doṣa ityabhiprāyeṇa `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' ityatroktam---bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasyedaṃ grahaṇam, tena varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ puttrapauttrāṇāṃ darśaka ityatra na bhavatīti ||
bhāvavacanāśca || 3.3.11 ||
vaktīti vacanaḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karttari lyuṭ‌, karaṇa eva vā---bhāva ucyate yena sa bhāvavacanaḥ | atra puruṣāḥ karttāraḥ, bhāvādhikāravihitā eva bhāvavacanā bhavantītyāha---bhāva iti prakṛtyeti | tumunā bādhyeranniti | lṛṭ tu bhāvakarmakartṛṣu triṣu vidhānādasamānārthaḥ | kiñci, dhātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ ghañādayaḥ, śuddhe tu dhātvarthe lakāraḥ, ato'pyasamānārthatvam |
iha `bhāve' ityetāvadvaktavyam, evamapi hyucyamāne bhāve ye vihitāste kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade bhavantītyartho labhyata eva, tadapārthakaṃ vacanagrahaṇamiti matvā pṛcchati---atheti | vācakā yathā syuriti | vacanagrahaṇe hi sati bhāvavacanāḥ santo ghañādayo'sminviṣaye bhavantītyartho bhavati, bhāvasya vācakāḥ santo bhavantītyarthaḥ | etadeva praśnapūrvakaṃ vivṛṇoti---kathaṃ ceti | yābhya prakṛtibhya iti | ivarṇāntebhyo'c‌, ṛvarṇāntebhya uvarṇāntebhyaścābiti | evam yena viśeṣaṇeneti | `hastādāne cerasteye', `śriṇībhuvo'nupasarge' ityādinā | asāmañjasyam-vyatikaraḥ, anyo'nyaviṣayāvagāhanamiti yāvat‌ | pākāyetyādau `tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt‌' iti caturtho ||
aṇ‌ karmaṇi ca || 3.3.12 ||
cakāraḥ sanniyogārtha iti | anyathā paryāyeṇa syāt‌---kadācitkriyārthāyāmeva kriyāyāmupapade, kadācitkarmaṇyeva kevale; vacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati kāle kādīnāmapavādānāṃ bādhanārthaṃ syāt | cakārāttu sanniyogārthātsamudāyasyaiva pratyayotpatti prati nimittatvam | upapadasaṃjñā tu pratyekameva bhavati; pratyekaṃ saptamīnirdeśāt‌ | tena kevalasyāpi karmaṇaḥ samāso bhavati | kāṇḍalāvo vrajatīti | so'pavādatvāt‌ ṇvulaṃ vādhata iti | ṇvulvidhāne ca kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantīti jñāpitam, na punarasmin‌ prakaraṇe vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti | tena yo'yam‌ `tumun‌ṇvulau' iti ṇvul‌, so'syāṇo viṣaye'pi vāsarūpavidhinā bhavatyeva---edhānāhārako vrajatīti | tathā ca `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya bhaviṣyati prayoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣiddhyate | paratvācca kādīniti | nanu cāpūrvavidhānātpratiprasavavacanasya lāghavamastīti aṇviṣaya eva ṇvulaṃ bādhitvāṇa syānnāpavādaviṣaye ? evaṃ manyate---iha karmaṇīti na vaktavyaṃ vacanagrahaṇānuvṛttereva yo vacane'ṇ‌ so'sminviṣaye bhavatīti vacanavyaktathā karmaṇyevopapade'ṇ‌ siddhaḥ, tatra punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ karmamātraparigrahārthamityapavādaviṣaye'pi bhavatīti | evaṃ ca paratvāditi ko'rthaḥ ? utkṛṣṭatvādādhikyādityarthaḥ | anye tu vipratiṣedhameva vyācakṣate ||
lṛṭ‌ śeṣe ca || 3.3.13 ||
śeṣaḥ kriyārthopapadādanya ucyate iti | kriyā kriyārthopapadaṃ yasmin‌ bhaviṣyati kāle tato'nyo bhaviṣyadityarthaḥ | cakārāditi | yadi tahi śeṣe cāśeṣe ca bhavati lṛḍityevāstu, kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmiti nivarttiṣyate, tena sarvatra bhaviṣyati ? evamapi śeṣa eva syāt‌, aśeṣe tu tumun‌ṇvulau bādhakausyātām | vāsarūpavidhinā lṛḍapi bhaviṣyati | tadetat‌ `śeṣe ca' iti vacanaṃ cintyaprayojanam | kariṣyāmīti vrajatīti | itiśabdaḥ parasparasambandhajñāpanārthaḥ ||
lṛṭaḥ sadvā || 3.3.14 ||
`lṛṭaḥ' iti vacanaṃ sthāninirdeśārtham, anyathā satsaṃjñakau pratyayau svatantrau syātāṃ na tvādeśau | aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇādiṣviti | ādiśabdena `sambodhane ca' `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' ityasminviṣaye, tathā `pratyayottarapadayośca'---kariṣyato'patyaṃ kāriṣyataḥ, kāriṣyamāṇiḥ, kariṣyato bhaktiḥ kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyantī bhaktirasya kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇā bhaktirasya kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyattaraḥ, kariṣyamāṇataraḥ, kariṣyamāṇatamaḥ, kariṣyadrūpaḥ, kariṣyamāṇarūpaḥ, kariṣyatkalpaḥ, kariṣyamāṇakalpaḥ | kathaṃ `śvo'gnīnādhāsyamānena' ityanadyatane śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ ? ukto'tra parihāraḥ---`vyatyayo bahulam' iti kālavyatyayena lṛṭ‌ | atha vā---uttaratrānadyatana iti yogavibhāgaḥ, `lṛṭaḥ sadvā' ityeva anadyatane yo lṛṭ‌ tasyāpi satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ | kena punaranadyatane lṛṭ‌ bhavati ? etadeva jñāpayati---bhavatyanadyatane lṛḍiti, yadayamanadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau śāsti ||
anadyatane luṭ‌ || 3.3.15 ||
anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirddeśa iti | `anadyatane laṅ‌' ityatraivaitadvyākhyātaṃ tata evāvadhāryam |
paridevane iti | paridevanam-anuśocanam | śvastanīti | luṭaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | bhaviṣyantyartha iti | bhaviṣyantīti lṛṭaḥ saṃjñā, tasyā arthe bhaviṣyatsāmānyaityarthaḥ | bhāvaṣyadartha iti vā pāṭhaḥ | bhaviṣyatsāmānyarūpe'rtha ityarthaḥ | yevamiti | vilambitam | anabhiyuktaḥ-paricayarahitaḥ ||
padaruḍaviśaspṛśo ghañ‌ || 3.3.16 ||
padyate'sāviti | karaṇasyātra kartṛtvena vivakṣā | padamityetattu `khano gha ca' ityatra sādhayiṣyate | roga iti | `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | spṛśa upatāpe iti | upatāpaḥ-rogaḥ ||
sṛsthire || 3.3.17 ||
`sṛ' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | sartteriti | `sṛ gatau', `ṛ sṛ gatau' iti dvayorapi grahaṇam | sthire karttarīti | etena sthiragrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartturviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadamiti darśayati | etaccārdharcādiṣu sāraśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate | nanu sthiraśabdastiṣṭhatergatinivṛttivācina uṇādiṣu karicpratyayānto nipātitaḥ, sattistu gativacanaḥ, tatkathaṃ saraṇasya sthirakarttā yujyate ? ityāha---sthira iti kālāntarasthāyītyādi | yataḥ kālāntaragamanaṃ sambhavati, tataśca sartterdhātorarthasya karttā yujyata ityarthaḥ | tiṣṭhanniti ca hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ | khadirasāra iti khadirāsthi, tat dṛḍhatvāt‌ sthiram | atīsāro vyādhiriti | śarīrāntarāvasthitaṃ rudhirādidravyamatiśayena sārayatīti kṛtvā | antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra saratiḥ | `upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' iti dīrghaḥ | visāro matsya iti | vividhaṃ saratīti kṛtvā | sāro balamiti | sārayati ceṣṭayatīti kṛtvā | atrāpyantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ | saratiḥ | balavānhi ceṣṭate, sāraśabda utkarṣe puṃlliṅgaḥ, nyāyādanapete napuṃsakaliṅga iti ca dṛśyate ||
bhāve || 3.3.18 ||
nityānāmeva śabdānāṃ sāṅkaryasya nivṛttaye |
anvākhyānādbhāvaśabde ghañi nānyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ ||
rāga iti | `ranjeśca' `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nalopaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ pākādirudāharaṇaṃ bhavati, yāvatā bhavatinārthanirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇo'stibhavatividyativiṣaya eva kṛto bhavati, na pacādiviṣayaḥ ? tatrāha---kriyāsāmānyavācī bhavatiriti | sattākhyaṃ sāmānyamapi bhavatinā sādhyatvenābhidhīyata iti kriyāsāmānyavācī bhavatirbhavati | tenārthanirddeśaḥ kriyamāṇa iti | hetau śānac‌, yasmātsāmānyavācinārthanirdeśaḥ kriyate, na viśeṣavācinā pacādinā; tasmātsarvadhātuviṣayaḥ kṛto bhavati sāmānyasya, sarveṣve viśeṣeṣu bhāvāt‌, ṣaṇḍādiṣu gotvavat‌ viśeṣarūpāśrayaniṣedhasyābhāvācca | iha bhāvo dhātvarthaḥ, sa ca pūrvāparībhūto'pariniṣpannaḥ, tasya ghañvācyasya kathaṃ liṅgasaṅkhyāyoga ityāha---dhātvarthaśceti | yathā pacati pācaka ityādau prakṛtibhāgena kriyocyate, pratyayabhāgena tu tadīyaṃ sādhanam; tathā pākādiṣu prakṛtibhāgaḥ sādhyarūpamarthamāha, pratyayabhāgastu tasyaiva siddharūpatāṃ dravyadharmairliṅgasaṅkhyākārakaśaktibhiḥ sambandhayogyamākāramāhetyathaḥ | uktaṃ ca---
ākhyātaśabde bhāgābhyāṃ sādhyasādhanavarttitā |
prakalpitā yathā śāstre sa ghañādiṣvapi kramaḥ ||
sādhyatvena kriyā tatra dhāturūpanibandhanā |
sattvabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādinibandhanaḥ || iti ||
bahuvaktavyo'yamarthaḥ | iha `bhāve' iti puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, ekavacanena ca tatra puṃlliṅga eva, bhāve ekavacana eva ca pratyayāḥ syurna liṅgāntare, na ca saṅghyāntare; tataśca `striyāṃ ktin‌' ityatra striyāṃ bhāva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambandhāsambhavāt‌---striyāmakarttari kārake ktin‌ pratyayaḥ syāt‌, bhāve tu puṃsīva `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' ityatra `akarttari ca kārake' ityasya nivṛttatvānnapuṃsake karttari ktaḥ syādbhāve tu puṃsi, dvitvabahutvayośca pākau pākā ityādau pratyayā na syurityata āha---puṃlliṅgamekavacanaṃ cātantramiti ||
na vinā liṅgasaṅkhyābhyāṃ sattvabhūto'rtha ucyate |
ityatantramupādānaṃ tayorna tu vivakṣitam ||
dhānyāthināmupādānaṃ palālāderyathā matam |
śabdasaṃskāramātraṃ tu tannirdeśaprayojanam ||
akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām || 3.3.19 ||
prāsaḥ-kuntaḥ, prasevaḥ-sūcyā prasevanena niṣpādya āvapanaviśeṣaḥ | madhurāhāra iti | karmadhārayaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā |
meṣa iti | pacādiṣu pāṭhamanapekṣyaitadudāhṛtam, tathā ca `igupadhajñāprī' ityatroktam---devasevameṣādayaḥ pacādiṣu draṣṭavyā iti | na hi pāṭhe sati draṣṭavyatvavacanamupapadyate | atha vā---pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, idaṃ tu pratyudāharaṇam---bibhartyasau bhartteti |
cakāra ityādi | cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ---`saṃjñāyāṃ ca' iti, tenāsaṃjñāyāmapi ghañ‌ bhavati | yadyevam, mā bhūtsaṃjñāyāmiti, mā ca bhūccakāraḥ `akarttari kārake' ityevāstu ? satyam; bāhulyena saṃjñāyāṃ bhavati, kvacidevāsaṃjñāyāmiti sūcayituṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | dāya iti | dīyamānaṃ sarvamucyata iti neyaṃ saṃjñā, evaṃ lābha ityatrāpi, ubhayatra karmaṇi ghañ‌ | kārakagrahaṇamityādi | paryudāse hi nañivayuktanyāyena karturanyasmiṃstatsadṛse kāraka eva pratītirbhavati, yathā---abrāhmaṇa iti kṣatriyādau | tasmātparyudāse kārakagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu vākyabhedena saṃjñāyāṃ ghañ‌ bhavati, karttari tu na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho bhavati | tatra prathame vākye'rthanirdeśābhāvād‌ `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' iti svārtha eva syāt‌ | nanu ca vihitaḥ svārthe pūrveṇaiva ? netyāha; dhātvarthasya hi siddhatākhye dharme ghañādayo bhavantītyuktam, iha tu sādhyarūpe śuddhe prakṛtyarthesyāt‌ | nanu ca karttari pratiṣedhasāmarthyādanirdiṣṭārtho'pi ghañ‌ dhātvarthasambandhini kāraka eva vijñāsyate ? naitadasti; asati hi pratiṣedhe `karttari kṛt‌' iti vacanānnāyamanirdiṣṭāthaḥ syād‌ | ataḥ prasajyapratiṣedhārthaṃ kākagrahaṇam | paryadāse tu na karttavyam | yadyevam, sa evāśrayiṣyate, kiṃ kārakagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---tatkriyata iti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhe pratyatnalabhyaḥ samāsaḥ ? asāmarthyāttatra hi nañaḥ kriyayā sanbandhaḥ, kartri na bhavatīti na kartṛśabdena | ādeca upadeśe'śitīti | atra yadi `aśiti' iti paryudāsaḥ syāt‌, tadā śito'nyatra tṛjādau pratyayo parata ātvena bhavitavyam | tataśca suglaḥ, sumla ityatra `ātaścopasarge' iti ko na syāt‌, prāk‌ pratyayotpatteranākārāntatvāt| pratiṣedhetvanaimittikamātvam, śiti tu pratiṣedha iti siddhamiṣṭam ||
parimāṇākhyāyā sarvebhyaḥ || 3.3.20 ||
parimāṇākhyāyāmiti | bhāvasādhanaḥ parimāṇaśabdaḥ, ākhyānamākhyā - uktiḥ, paricchitteruktau satyāmityarthaḥ | kasya punaḥ paricchittiḥ ? pratyayārthasya bhāvasya kartṛvajitasya kārakasya ca | parimāṇākhyāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti vṛtterapyayamevārthaḥ | taṇḍulanicāya iti | nicīyate rāśīkriyate iti nicāyaḥ-rāśiḥ, taṇḍulānāṃ nicāya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | atra rāśyekatvena paricchittirgamyate | atrairaci prāpte ghañ‌ | prāyeṇa tu niścāya iti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpyarthaḥ sa eva, `grahavṝdṛniścigamaśca' ityapi prāpte ghañ‌ śūrpanaṣpāvāviti | niṣpūyate śoddhyate tuṣādyapanayanena yastaṇḍulādiḥ | śūrpeṇa niṣpāvaḥ śūrpaniṣpāva iti `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ | atra śūrpasaṅkhyayā paricchittiḥ | yadyapyatra `nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ' iti ghañ‌ sidhyati, tathāpi sarvāpavādārthasarvagrahaṇopādānādanenaiva ghañ‌ bhavitumarhatītyasyopanyāsaḥ | kārāviti | `ka vikṣepe' karmaṇi ghañ, vikṣipto dhānyādiḥ- kāraḥ, atrāpi saṅkhyayā paricchittiḥ | nanu ca dhātoriti sāmānyādhikārādantareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ dhātumātrād‌ ghañ‌ bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ sarvagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---sarvagrahaṇamiti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamapo bādhanaṃ yatnasādhyamityata āha---purastāditi niścaya iti | atra na kenacidiyattā gamyate | nanu ca parimāṇaśabdasya prasthādiṣu rūḍhatvātprasthastaṇḍulaniścāya ityādāveva yuktaṃ bhavitum, na tu dvau śūrpaniṣpāvāvityatra ? ityata āha---ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhinirāsārthamiti | prasthādiṣu jighṛkṣiteṣu parimāṇa ityeva vaktavyaṃ kimākhyāgrahaṇena ? ākhyāgrahaṇāttu mātraco lopo vijñāyate parimāṇamātrasyākhyāyāmuktau satyāmiti | tena parimāṇaśabdaḥ kriyāśabda upajāyate---parimitiḥ-parimāṇam paricchittiriti, saṅkhyayāpi paricchittirbhavati | evañconmānādāvapi yathābhidhānaṃ ghañ‌ bhavati | yadi tarhi sarvagrahaṇātparamapyayaṃ ghañamaṃ bādhate, strīpratyayānapi bādheta, tatrāha---ghañanukramaṇamajaporviṣaya iti | etacca `sarvebhyaḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśāllabhyate | pañcamyanto hi sarvaśabdo dhātuśabdena samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tena prakṛtyāśraya evāpavādo bādhyate, nārthāśrayaḥ | tilocchittiriti | karmaṇi bhāve vā ktin‌ | ūrdhvīkṛto rāśiḥ |
ṇilukceti | ṇilope sati tasya sthānivadbhāvād‌ ghañāśrayā vṛddhirna syāditi lugvidhīyate, tasya paranimittakatvātkvilugupadhātveti pratiṣedhādvā sthānivattvābhāvājjāraśabdaḥ sidhyati | jarayantīti | `janījṝṣ‌knasurañjo'mantāśca' iti mittvād‌ hrasvatvam | jāraḥ- pracchannapatiḥ ||
iṅaśca || 3.3.21 ||
upādhyāya iti | upetyasyādadhīyata iti apādāne ghañ‌ | adhyāya ityatra karmaṇi ghañ‌ |
apādāne striyāmiti | `ghañanukramaṇamajaporviṣaye' iti vacanāt‌ striyāmaprāpto ghañ‌ vidhīyate | upādhyāyā, upādhyāyīti | yā svayamadhyāpayati tasyāmetadrūpam | puṃyoge tu nityameva ṅīṣ‌ bhavati | atra ca `upādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ vā' iti vacanātpakṣe ānugāgamaḥ---upādhyāyī, upādhyāyānī |
`śṝvāyuvarṇanivṛtedhviti | śṝ' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | śāro vāyuriti | karaṇe ghañ| śāro varṇa iti | citrīkaraṇamatra dhātvarthaḥ---citrīkriyate'nenāśraya iti, atrāpi karaṇe ghañ‌ | varṇāntarasaṃpṛktaśced‌varṇaḥ śāraḥ | nivriyate āvriyate'nena śarīramiti nivṛtamāvaraṇamucyate, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe ktaḥ | nīśāra iti | pūrvavaddīrghaḥ | akṛtanīśāra iti | akṛtaprāvaraṇa ityarthaḥ | `pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināṃ śārāṇām' iti vārttikakāraprayogādakṣeṣvapi śāra iti bhavati ||
sami yudruduvaḥ || 3.3.23 ||
saṃyāvaḥ-piṣṭavikāro'pūpaviśeṣaḥ, sampūyate miśrīkriyate guḍajīrakādibhiriti kṛtvā ||avodorniyaḥ || 3.3.26 ||
adho nayanamavanāyaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ nayanamunnāyaḥ, unnayastu utprekṣā ||
nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ || 3.3.28 ||
