unyorgraḥ || 3.3.29 ||
udgāraḥ-atipravṛddhaḥ śabdaḥ; nigāroḥ-bhakṣaṇam ||
kṝ dhānye || 3.3.30 ||
dhānyamiha prakṛtyartho vā syātpratyayārthasya vā kārakasyopādhiḥ ? prakṛtyarthastāvannopapadyate, dhānyasya dravyatvāt‌, dhātośca kriyāvācitvāt‌ | pratyayārthopādhitve tu pratyayenābhihitātvādutkāro dhānyasyeti dhānyaśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti | athāpi vispaṣṭapratipattyarthaṃ prayogaḥ syāt‌ | evamapi pratyayārthe'ntarbhūtatvāddhanye ṣaṣṭhī na syāt‌, dṛtihariḥ paśuritivatsāmānādhikaraṇyameva tu syāt‌ | tasmānnāyaṃ pratyayārthasyopādhiḥ; nāpi prakṛtyarthaḥ; kintu pratyayārthasya viṣayatvena viśeṣaṇamityāha---dhānyaviṣayaścediti | upapadatvamapi na na bhavati, vyākhyānāt | anabhidhānāditi | śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt‌ | utkaranikāraśabdābhyāṃ dhānyaviṣayo vikṣepa evābhidhīyate, na hiṃsā | sāpi dhānyasya kīdṛśīti cintyam ||
yajñe sami stuvaḥ || 3.3.31 ||
sametya stuvanti yasmindeśa iti | adhikaraṇe lyuṭo'pavādo ghañiti darśayati | saṃstavaḥ-paricayaḥ ||
pre stro'yajñe || 3.3.32 ||
`yajñe' iti prakṛtatvād‌ `ayajñe' iti padacchedaḥ | śaṅkhādiṣu prastāraḥ-vistāraḥ |
barhiṣprastara iti | prastaraḥ-muṣṭiviśeṣaḥ | barhirvikāraḥ prastaro barhiṣprastaraḥ, `ṛdorap‌' ityap‌, `idudupadhasya ca' iti ṣatvam ||
prathane vāvaśabde || 3.3.33 ||
vistāraḥ- tiryagāyatiḥ ||
chandonāmni ca || 3.3.34 ||
akṣarāṇāmiyattāviśiṣṭo vinyāsaviśeṣoḥ-vṛttam | yasya gāyatryādaya iti | prasadiddhatvādevamuktam | na mantrabrāhmaṇamiti | `bahulaṃ chandasi' ityādau yadyapi teṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ prasiddhaṃ tathāpīha teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ ? ityāha---nāmagrahaṇāditi | viṣṭārapaṅ‌ktiriti | vistīryante'sminnakṣarāṇītyadhikaraṇe ghañ‌, tataḥ karmadhārayaḥ, `chandonāmni ca' iti ṣatvam | yadyapyatra prathanaṃ gamyate, tathāpi śabdaviṣayatvātpūrveṇa na sidhyati | kecittu `vau' iti nānuvarttayanti, tena prastārapaṅ‌ktiḥ, āstārapaṅ‌ktiḥ, saṃstārapaṅ‌ktirityapi bhavatītyāhuḥ | `karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām' ityādau yathā pratyayayāntaścedākhyā bhavatītyayamartho bhavati, evamihāpi pratyayāntaścecchandonāma bhavatītyarthaḥ syād‌ ? iti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyāha---viṣṭārapaṅ‌ktiśabdo'tra chandonāmeti | avayavatvena varttata iti | ghañantaśabdarūpamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | kvacittu tadvarttata iti tacchabdaḥ paṭhyate, tatra nānuṣaṅgaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi chandonāmnītyasya nirvāhaḥ ? ityāha---chandonāmnītyādhakaraṇasaptamyeṣeti | pratyayāntasyādhikaraṇaṃ chandonāma, avayavāścāvayavini varttanta iti laukikā manyante, tena na kācidanupapattiriti bhāvaḥ ||
udi grahaḥ || 3.3.35 ||
apavāda iti | `grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' iti prāptasya |
chandasi nītyādi | avayavasanniveśaviśiṣṭā yajñapātraviśeṣāḥ srucaḥ | iha tu juhūpabhṛtorgrahaṇam; `ud‌grābhaṃ ceti juhūmudyacchati nigrābhaṃ cetyupabhṛtaṃ niyacchati' iti vacanāt‌ | `hṛgrahorbhaśchandasi' iti bhatvam ||
sami muṣṭau || 3.3.36 ||
muṣṭiviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatīti | `kṛ dhānye' ityatra dhānyaviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatīti etadanusāreṇāyaṃ grantho yojyaḥ | muṣṭiśabdo'yamastyeva parimāṇe---caturo muṣṭīnnirvapatīti, aṅ‌gulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣavacano'pyasti---muṣṭinā hantīti; tatra pūrvasya grahaṇe parimāṇākhyāyāmityeva siddhatvād‌ dvitīyasya grahaṇamityāha---muṣṭiraṅ‌gulisanniveśa iti | ahośabda āścarye | muṣṭau kuśalo muṣṭikaḥ, ākarṣādipāṭhātkan||
parinyornīṇordyūtābhreṣayoḥ || 3.3.37 ||
akṣādibhiḥ krīḍanaṃ dyūtam | `bhrepa calane' bhreṣaṇaṃ bhreṣaḥ-calanam | abhreṣaḥ-acalanam | bhreṣaviṣayaścediti | ayamapi granthaḥ pūrvānusāreṇa yojyaḥ | anapacāra iti | kutsitaścāro'pacāraḥ, tasmādanyaḥ praśastaḥ cāro'napacāraḥ | etadevaspaṣṭayati---yathāprāptasyeti | yathā yena prakāreṇa prāptiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | avyayībhāve tvambhāvaḥ prāpnoti | kvacittu yathāprāptakaraṇamiti paṭhyate | pariṇāyeneti | `upasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvam | hantīti bādhate | samantānnayaneneti | pariṇāyenetyasyedamarthakathanam | eṣo'tra nyāya iti | etadatra yathāprāptamityarthaḥ | pariṇayaḥ-vivāhaḥ | nyayaḥ-nāśaḥ ||
parāvanupātyaya iṇaḥ || 3.3.38 ||
iha dviḥ parigrahaṇam, dviśceṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, sakṛdeva tu karttavyam, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---parau niyo dyute iṇo'nupātyaye nāvabhreṣa iti ? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
vyupayoḥ śeteḥ paryāye || 3.3.39 ||
pūrvasūtreṇānupātyaye paryāyaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ, tataścānupātyaya ityadhikāreṇaiva siddhe paryāyagrahaṇaṃ punarvidhānārtham | tenābhividhivivakṣāyāṃ paramapīnuṇaṃ bādhitvā'yameva ghañ‌ bhavati | rājānamupaśayituṃ paryāya ityartha iti | `kālasamayavelāsu tumun‌' ityatra kāle'tyarthagrahaṇam | paryāyopādānaṃ tu prapañcārtham, yathā---`nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti | tena paryāyaśabdayoge'pi tumun‌ bhavati | tathā cāvasaro bhoktum, avakāśo bhoktumityādyapi dṛśyate | viśayaḥ- saṃśayaḥ, upaśayaḥ-samīpaśayanam ||
hastādāne cerasteye || 3.3.40 ||
hastādānagrahaṇenetyādi | yatropāyāntaranirapekṣeṇa hastenaivādeyamādīyate, tatrāvaśyamādeyasya grāhyasya pratyāsattirbhavati, ataḥ sāhacaryaṃ lakṣaṇāhetuḥ | vṛkṣaśikhara iti | vṛkṣāgre yāni phalāni teṣāṃ yaṣṭyādinā pracayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | yadvā---āruhya hastenādāne'pyādeyasya pratyāsattyabhāvād‌ ghañabhāvaḥ ||
nivāsacitiśarīropasamādhāneṣvādeśca kaḥ || 3.3.41 ||
eteṣvartheṣviti | atropasamādhānaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, anye pratyayārthasya kārakasyopādhibhūtāḥ | cikhallinikāya iti | cikhalliḥ---janapadaviśeṣaḥ, tatsambandhī grāmādirnivāsadeśa ityarthaḥ | ākāyamiti | ācīyate'sminnaṣṭakā ityadhikaraṇe ghañ‌ | kāya iti | cīyante'sminnasthyādīni, adhikaraṇa eva ghañ‌ | gomayanikāya iti | prakīrṇānāṃ gomayānāmekatra rāśīkaraṇamityarthaḥ |
bahutvamatra gamyate iti | tatra tatra vikṣiptānāmeva kāṣṭhānāmityarthaḥ | `caḥ kaḥ' iti vaktavye āderiti vacanaṃ yaṅ‌lugante'pyāderekyathā syād‌, anantyasyābhyāsasya cobhayormā bhūditi---gomayānāṃ nikecāyaḥ, gomayānāṃ punaḥ punā rāśīkaraṇamityarthaḥ ||
saṅ‌ghe cānauttarādharye || 3.3.42 ||
prāṇināṃ samudāyaḥ saṅgha iti | `saṅgod‌ghau gaṇapraśaṃsayoḥ' iti gaṇamātre nipātito'pi saṅghaśabdaḥ prāṇināmeva samudāye rūḍha iti bhāvaḥ | ekadharmasamāveśeneti | ekadharmo'nugataḥ | auttarādharyeṇeti | uttare cādhare cottarādharāḥ, teṣāṃ bhāva auttarādharyam |
sūkaranicaya iti | stanapānāya yadottarādharabhāvena śerate tadedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, yadā tu bhikṣuvatpṛthakpṛthageva tiṣṭhanti, tadedamudāharaṇameva bhavati ||
karmavyatihāre ṇac‌ striyām || 3.3.43 ||
`dhātuḥ' iti varttate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ karmavyatihāragrahaṇam, karmavyatihāre varttamānādityarthaḥ | dhātośca kriyāvācitvam, na tasya sādhanakarmavyatihāre vṛttiḥ sambhavati, ato laukikasya kriyākarmaṇo grahaṇamityāha---karmavyatihāraḥ kriyāvyatihāra iti | strīliṅge bhāve iti | kartūvarjite tu kārake na sa bhavati; anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | na svārārthaḥ, pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvāt‌ | asya cākāro na kvāpi śrūyate, ṇajantāñca nityamañ‌ vidhīyate, tatra satiśiṣṭatvāññitsvareṇaiva bhavitavyam | ṇacaḥ striyāmityatra ṇātstriyāmityucyamāne `jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | vyāvakrośītyādi | `kruśa āhvāne', `likha akṣaravinyāse', `hase hasena' ṇajantādañ‌ | sa ca kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayā sopasargādapi bhavati, taddhitatvādādivṛddhiḥ | `na yvābhyām' ityayaṃ tu vidhirna bhavati; na karmavyatihāra iti pratiṣedhāt‌ | `striyāṃ ktin‌' ityatra prakaraṇa etannoktam vāsarūpavidhiryathā syāt‌, tena vyāvakruṣṭiriti ktinnapi bhavati | vyāvacorītyatra `ṇyāsaśranthoyuc‌' iti yuc‌ prāpnoti, ktino'pavādaḥ, tathā'yamapi ṇac‌ yena nāprāptinyāyena ktina evāpavādaḥ, tatrāpavādavipratiṣedhādyuci prāpte'yameva ṇajiṣyate | vyatīkṣā, vyatīheti | atra ktinapavādaḥ `gurośca halaḥ' ityakāra eveṣyate | vyātyukṣīti `ukṣa secane', atrākāraviṣaye'pyayameveṣyate | tadetadvaicitryaṃ kathaṃ bhavatīti | na kathañciditi bhāvaḥ | kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti | evaṃvidhaṃ vaicitryaṃ karttuṃ bahulagrahaṇameva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
abhividhau bhāva inuṇ‌ || 3.3.44 ||
kriyāguṇābhyāmiti | abhividhisvarūpakathanametat, iha tu dhātoḥ pratyayavidhānātkriyāviṣaya evābhividhirgṛhyate | sāṃkūṭinamiti | `kūṭa dāhe' dīrghopadhādinuṇ‌, `aṇinuṇaḥ' itīnuṇantātsvāthiko'ṇ‌ pratyayaḥ, sa ca pūrvavatsagatikārakādbhavati, `inaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ | samantāddāha ityarthaḥ saṃśabdo'bhividhidyotakaḥ | sāṃrāviṇamiti | `upasarge ruvaḥ' iti ghañ‌ upasargāntare'nabhivaidhau caritārthaḥ | saṃrāva iti | atra saṃśabdaḥ pūjāyām | kvacitsandrāva iti pratyudāhaṇaṃ paṭhyate, tadayuktam; `samiyudruduvaḥ' ityasyānavakāśāt‌ | nanu ca `bhāve kārake' iti dvaye'pi prakṛte śabdasvābhāvyātpūrvavatkārake na bhaviṣyati, tat‌ ki bhāvagrahaṇena ? tatrāha---bhāva iti varttamāna iti | tena ghañ‌, `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' iti ktaśca na bhavati | lyuṭā tvityādi | gatārtham | svabhāvataścedaminuṇantaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgam ||
ākośe'vanyorgrahaḥ || 3.3.45 ||
`grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityāpi prāpte'yamārambhaḥ | dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāditi | dṛṣṭamanuvṛttisāmarthyaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau `dvyekayoḥ' itivadbhāvapratyayamantareṇāpi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśo dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyatvādityarthaḥ | yadvā---anuvṛttau sāmaऱtyamanuvṛttisāmarthyam, tato dṛṣṭaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ | ākrośaḥ śapanamiti | na kṣepaḥ, svabhāvato ghañantasya śapanaviṣayatvāt‌ | śapanam-aniṣṭāśaṃsanam | avagrahaḥ-abhibhavaḥ | nigrahaḥ-bādhaḥ | hantaśabdaḥ kopaṃ dyotayati | avagrahaḥ-padasya chedaḥ | nigrahaḥ nirodhaḥ ||
pre lipsāyām || 3.3.46 ||
labdhumicchā lipsā | pātrapragrāheṇa caratīti | bhikṣāpātropādānena gṛhītapātra iti yāvat‌ | sruvagrahaṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇārthino liṅgam, dākṣiṇahomasya sruvasādhanatvāt‌ | pragraho devadattasyeti | pragraho madaḥ, prakṛṣṭo vābhineveśaḥ ||
parau yajñe || 3.3.47 ||
uttaraparigrāha iti | bhāve ghañ‌ | vedeḥ sphyena svīkaraṇaṃ parigrāhaḥ, tataḥ karmadhārayaḥ | kvaciduttaraḥ parigrāha ityasamāsa eva paṭhyate ||
nau vṛ dhānye || 3.3.48 ||
nīvārā nāma vrīhaya iti | dhānyasāmānyoktāvapi dhānyaviśeṣarūpavrīhiviśeṣe svabhāvato ghañantasya vṛttiriti darśayati | atra karmaṇi ghañ‌, pūrvavadupasargasya dīrghaḥ | nivarā kanyeti | `grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' ityap‌ karmaṇyeva | nanu ca ktinā striyāṃ bhavitavyam, `ajabbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalanau vipratiṣedhena' iti vacanāt‌ ? satyam; `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bahulavacanāt‌ kvacit‌ ktinādiviṣaye'pyac‌ bhavati, pravarā senā, pravarā gauritivat‌ | evaṃ ca `ghañajabantāḥ puṃsi' iti prāyikaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
udi śrayatiyautipūdruvaḥ || 3.3.49 ||
vakṣyamāṇamiti | evaṃ ca yautiprabhṛtibhyo vikalpaḥ prāpnoti | yadi neṣyate, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti na bhaviṣyati ||
anye tu bhāṣye'nuktatvādasādhurevāyaṃ prayogaḥ | pradarśitastu bhārataprayoga ārṣatvena nirvāhya ityāhuḥ ||
ave graho varṣapratibandhe || 3.3.51 ||
kutaścinnimittāditi | `sattvakarmāparādhāderanāvṛṣṭirbhavennṛṇām'| sattvaśabdaḥ prāṇivacanaḥ, karmāparādhaḥ-karmaviṣayo doṣaḥ, vihitānācaraṇapratiṣiddhācaraṇanimittaṃ pāpaṃ sattvakarmāparādhaḥ | ādiśabdena `tayormadhyagato bhānuḥ samudramapi śoṣayet‌' ityādergrahaṇam |
avagrāho devasyeti | devakartṛko varṣābhāva ityarthaḥ ||
pre vaṇijām || 3.3.52 ||
paṇante vyavaharantīti vaṇijaḥ, `paṇerijyādeśca vaḥ', `paṇa vyavahāre' ityasmādijipratyayo bhavatyādeśca vakāraḥ | vaṇiksambandheneti | tulāsūtraṃ prāyeṇa vaṇijāṃ bhavatīti sāhacaryaṃ lakṣaṇāhetuḥ | anayo veti | na tu vaṇijastantramityasyedaṃ prayojanam ||
raśmau ca || 3.3.53 ||
rathādiyuktānāmiti | ādiśabdena śakaṭasya grahaṇam | aśvāderiti | anuḍudāderapyupalakṣaṇametat | saṃyamanam-niyamanam | sā raśmiriha gṛhyata iti | raśmiśabdaḥ puṃlliṅgaḥ, seti rajjuparāmarśātstrīliṅgatā | candrādisambandhināṃ tu raśmīnāmagrahaṇam; anabhidhānāt‌ | iha tu bahukṛtvo grahirupādīyate, sakṛdeva tu karttuṃ śakyam; katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi `udi grahaḥ sami muṣṭau ākrośe'vanyo pre lipsāyāṃ parau yajñe've varṣapratibandhe vibhāṣā pre vaṇijām' ityādi, `parau bhuvo'vajñāne' ityasyānantaramāṅi rupluvoriti ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
vṛṇoterācchādane || 3.3.54 ||
atrāpyācchādana iti sāmānyenoktāvapi pūrvavadviśeṣapratipattirityāha---pratyayāntena cediti | prāvāra iti | pūrvavaddīrghaḥ | pravarā gauriti | praśastetyarthaḥ ||
erac‌ || 3.3.56 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | vinā hi tena thāthādisūtre'pratyayādityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | varṣamiti | vṛṣabho varṣaṇāditi bhāṣyakāraprayogādūrṣaṇamityapi bhavati | javasavāviti | api prāpte'j‌ vidhīyate | svare viśeṣaḥ | erajaṇyantānāmiti tu nāsti vacanam, `kalpyādibhyaḥ pratiṣedhavacanam' ityetadevāsti | kalpyate iti kalpaḥ, arthyate ityarthaḥ, mantryate iti mantraḥ | aci pratiṣiddhe ghañeva bhavati ||
ṛdorap‌ || 3.3.57 ||
lava iti | na ca tādapi parastapara iti ukārasya taparatvānnātrāpā bhavitavyam ? tatrāha---dakāro mukhasukhārtha iti | nāyaṃ takāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dakāraḥ | etacca `nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ' ityādyārambhādvijñāyate | mukhaśabdena tālvādiśthānamucyate, tasya sukhamanāyāsaḥ | acorhi halvyavahitayoruccāraṇe mukhasya lāghavaṃ bhavati | asandehaḥ, yasyānuṣaṅgikaṃ prayojanam ||
grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca || 3.3.58 ||
niścinotestvacopavāda iti | `erac' iti prāptasya yastu `hastādāne cerasteye' iti ghañ‌ sa nipūrvādapi pūrvavipratiṣedheneṣyate, yathoktam---asteyārthamiti cennāniṣṭatvāditi | kaḥ punarniścaya ityatrājaporviśeṣaḥ, yāvatā tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva svaro'pi; thāthādisūtreṇobhayatrāntodāttatvavidhānādityata āha---niścigrahaṇaṃ svarārthamiti | niścigrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌ thāthādisvaro'tra na pravarttate, kṛtsvareṇa tu madhyodāttatvameva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
vaśiraṇyoriti | ghañi prāpte vacanam | vaśanaṃ vaśaḥ | raṇanti śabdāyante'sminniti raṇaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ |
dhañartha iti | bhāvaḥ kartṛvarjitaṃ ca kārakaṃ ghañarthaḥ | prasthaḥ sānuḥ, prasnaḥ kaṭāhaḥ, prapā pānīyaśālā---sarvatra `āto lopa iṭi ca' ityākāralopaḥ | āvidha iti | grahijyādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam | āyudhaśabdaparyāyo'yam ||
upasarge'daḥ || 3.3.59 ||
aderdhātoriti | dārūpāṇāṃ dhātūnāmayaṃ nirdeśo na bhavati; `ghañapośca' ityapi parato'derghaslādeśavidhānāt‌ | vyadyata iti vighasaḥ- vaiśvadevaśiṣṭamannam |
ghāsastu catuṣpadāṃ bhakṣyam | ghasiḥ prakṛtyantamasti tasmādevābvidheyaḥ | evaṃ hyaderapi ghaslṛbhāvo na vaktavyo bhavati | uttarārthaṃ tvadergrahaṇam---nau ṇa `ca' aderyathā syād‌, ghasermā bhūditi ||
vyadhajaporanupasarge || 3.3.61 ||
vyadhajaporiti pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī, anupasarga iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ---upasarge sati na bhavatīti | tena kevalābhyāmeva bhavati, na tūpasargavyatirikte'nyasminnupapade | vṛttigrantho'pyasminnevārthe vyākhyeyaḥ | upajāpaḥ-mantrabhedaḥ ||
kvaṇo vīṇāyāṃ ca || 3.3.65 ||
sopasargārthamidaṃ vīṇāgrahaṇamiti | nivyatiriktopasargārthamidaṃ draṣṭavyam; nipūrvādanupasargācca sāmānyena vidhānāt‌ | kalyāṇaprakvāṇeti bahuvrīhiḥ ||
mado'nupasarge || 3.3.67 ||
vidyāmada ityādi | `kartṛkaraṇe' ityādinā samāsaḥ | `kvaṇo vīṇāyāṃ ca' ityasyānantaraṃ `nityaṃ madaḥ pramadasaṃmadau harṣe paṇaḥ parimāṇe' iti yadi sūtranyāsaḥ kriyeta, atrānupasargagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum‌, anuvṛttereva siddhatvāt ? satyam; evaṃ vinyāse hi kriyamāṇe `paṇaḥ parimāṇe' ityatrāpyanupasarga ityasyānuvṛttiḥ śaṅ‌kyeta | yathānyāse tūttaratrāpyanupasarga iti vacanāt‌ `nityaṃ paṇaḥ parimāṇe' ityatrānupasarga iti na saṃbaddhyata iti vijñāyate | tenopasarge'pi bhavati yadi parimāṇābhidhānamasti |
apara āha---"mado'nupasarge' iti sūtrapraṇayanamasya vidheranityatvajñāpanārtham, tena māda iti siddhaṃ bhavati" iti, nātrāptabhāṣitamasti ||
pramadasaṃmadau harṣe || 3.3.68 ||
nipātanaṃ rūḍhyarthamiti | upāttasyaiva rūḍhirūpasya sādhutvaṃ yathā syādityarthaḥ | `prasaṃbhyām' ityucyamāne prasaṃmadaḥ, saṃpramadaḥ, vipramada ityādāvapi prāpnotīti manyate ||
akṣeṣu glahaḥ || 3.3.70 ||
akṣasya glaha iti | bhāve'p‌, akṣasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ | anye tvāhuḥ---akṣaśabdenātra tatsādhanaṃ devanaṃ lakṣyate, akṣakarmaṇi devanaviṣaye yatpaṇarūpeṇa grāhyaṃ tad‌ glahaśabdenocyate | tathā ca māghaḥ---`vyātyukṣīmabhiraṇaglahāmadīvyan‌' iti | vṛttāvapyakṣasya glaha ityakṣasādhanasya devanasya paṇabandha ityarthaḥ ||
prajane sarteḥ || 3.3.71 ||
prajananaṃ prajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌, `janivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, ṇyantādvairac‌ | praśabdo dhātvarthaṃ viparītayati, yathā---pratiṣṭhate ityatra prādurbhāvasya ca vaiparītyaṃ garbhagrahaṇam, tadāha---prajanaḥ prathamaṃ garbhagrahaṇamiti | kathamavasaraḥ, prasara iti ? adhikaraṇe `puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' ||
hvaḥ saṃmprasāraṇaṃ ca nyabhyupaviṣu || 3.3.72 ||
nihava ityādi rūpaṃ tu juhotereva siddham; anekārthatvāddhātūnām | athebhedo'pyakiñcitkaraḥ | idaṃ tu vacanaṃ hvayaterghañi nihvāya iti rūpaṃ mā bhūditi ||
nipānamāhāvaḥ || 3.3.74 ||
āhāva iti rūpaṃ tu juhotereva siddham, anekārthatvāddhātūnām | arthabhedo'pyakiñcitkaraḥ | idaṃ tu vacanaṃ hvayaterghañi āhvāya iti rūpaṃ mā bhūditi | āhāva ityadhikaraṇe nipātanamityāha---tatra hīti ||
bhāve'nupasargasya || 3.3.75 ||
bhāvagrahaṇamityādi | nanu ca dvaye'pyadhikṛte lakṣyadarśanavaśādbhāva evārthe vidhirbhaviṣyati, yathā---`karmavyatihāre ṇac‌ striyām' ityatra ? satyameṣa evārtho bhāvagrahaṇenākyāyate | atha yathā---`abhividhau bhāva hanuṇ‌' ityatra vāsarūpanivṛttyarthaṃ bhāvagrahaṇam, tathehāpi kasmānna bhavati ? asarūpasya bādhanīyasyābhavāt‌ | ghañ‌ tāvatsarūpaḥ, ktalyuṭ‌ktinastu nāsyotsargāḥ, na hi teṣu nāprāpteṣvasyārambhaḥ, iṣyante ca te---hūtaḥ, hvānam, hūtiriti ||
hanaśca vadhaḥ || 3.3.76 ||
sa cāntodātta iti | sūtre tathaivoccāraṇāt‌ | kimarthaṃ punarakārāntatvam, kimarthaṃ cāntodāttatvam, yāvatā nāyamakāraḥ kvacicchra yato'to lopo'sya bhavati ? tatrāha---tatreti | antodāttatve satītyarthaḥ | udāttanivṛttisvareṇeti | `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' ityeva udāttanivṛttinimittatvādudāttanivṛttisvaraḥ | ghāta iti | atra karmādau kārake ghañ‌ | kiṃ tarhi prakṛtena pratyayeneti | atha dhātoranantaraṃ śrutaḥ prakṛtena dhātunā kasmānna sambaddhayate---hanaśca vadhādeśo bhavati, hvayateśceti ? pūrvasūtre' samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāt‌ ||
mūrttau ghanaḥ || 3.3.77 ||
abhraghana iti | abhrasya kāṭhinyamityarthaḥ | dharmaśabdeneti | śulkādivaditi bhāvaḥ | yadyevam, guṇeneti pratiṣedhātsamāso na prāpnoti, tatsthaiśca guṇairityetadapi nāsti ? idānīmeva hyuktam---`dharmaśabdena dharmī bhaṇyate' iti vaktavyo'tra samāsaḥ ||
antarghano deśe || 3.3.78 ||
tadapi grāhyameveti | ubhayathāpyācāryeṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipāditatvāt‌ ||
agāraikadeśe praghaṇaḥ praghāṇaśca || 3.3.79 ||
dvāraprakoṣṭho bāhya ucyata iti | dvāra pradeśe dvau prakoṣṭhāvalindau---ābhyantaraḥ, bāhyaśca | tatra bāhye prakoṣṭhe nipātanam, nāgāraikadeśamātre | aitacca nipātanāllabhyate | praviśadbhirjanaiḥ pādaiḥ prakarṣeṇa hanyata iti ap‌ karmaṇi, pakṣe vṛddhiśca ||
ud‌ghano'tyādhānam || 3.3.80 ||
atyādhānamiti | atiśabda uparibhāve vartate, ādadhātiḥ sthāpane, adhikaraṇe lyuṭ‌ | ud‌ghana ityatrāpyadhikaraṇa evāp‌ ||
apaghano'ṅgam || 3.3.81 ||
apaghana iti | karaṇe'p‌ ||
karaṇe'yovidruṣu || 3.3.82 ||
drughana iti | druriti vanaspatinām, `vanaspatayo vai dravaḥ' iti nigamo bhavati | pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmaga iti veti | saṃjñā caiṣā kuṭhāraviśeṣasya ||
stambe ka ca || 3.3.83 ||

dhātvarthanirdeśa iti | kriyānirdeśa ityarthaḥ |
ikśatapau dhātunirdeśa iti | dhātvanukaraṇa ityarthaḥ | bahulavacanācca kvacinna bhavati---`guptijkidbhyaḥ san‌', `mānvadhadānśānbhyaḥ' iti | śtipaḥ śitkaraṇasāmarthyādakartṛvācinyapyetasmin‌ śabādayo bhavanti | evamabhāvakarmavācinyapi | kvacidyagapi bhavati, yathā---`vibhāṣā līyateḥ', atra līlīṅoryakā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, śyani tu līṅa eva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na tu līnāteḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ śitkaraṇasya sāmarthyam, yāvatā pibatijighratirityādau śtipi pibādyādeśārthaṃ glāyatyadāvātvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca śitkaraṇaṃ syāt‌ ? evaṃ tarhi `upasargātsunotisuvatisyati', `vibhāṣā līyateḥ', `bhavaterṇa upasaṃkhyānam', `dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ca' ityevamādinirdeśācchabādayo bhaviṣyanti |
varṇāditi | varṇavācino varṇānukaraṇādityarthaḥ, na tu varṇāduccāryamāṇāditi | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? kakāra ityādau sāckādapi saṃghātātkāraḥ siddho bhavati; akārasyoccāraṇāthatvena varṇamātrasyānukāryatvāt‌ | kakārasyetsaṃjñā pratyojanābhāvānna bhavati | bahulagrahaṇād‌ `asya cvau' `yasyeti ca' ityādau kārapratyayo na bhavati | bahulavacanādeva kvacidvarṇasaṅghātādanukaraṇādapi bhavati---ekakāra iti | adhātu vihitatve'pi kārapratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñādhikārasāmarthyādbhavati | tena kṛdantatvātprātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati, iḍāgamastvanārddhadhātukatvānna bhavati | kimarthaṃ punaḥ kārapratyayo vidhīyate, yāvatā karaṇaṃ kāraḥ, asya kāro'kāra ityevamastu ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne kakārakaraṇamiti na syāt, karoteḥ paunaruktyāt‌ |
rādipha iti | kārasyāyamapavādaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi `rakārādāni nāmāni'? vāsarūpavidhinā kāro'pi bhaviṣyati, pūrvavatkṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ prātipadikatvam | matvārthāccha iti | matunā samānārtho matvarthastataḥ svārthe chaḥ | bahulavacanādabhatve'pi yasyeti lopaḥ, pūrvavatpratipadikatvam | bahulavacanātkvacinna bhavati, yathā---`tasau matvarthe' iti | bahulavacanādeva ca matubarthaśabdādapi bhavati---śaiṣikānmatubarthīyāditi |
ājiriti | bahulavacanādvībhāvābhāvaḥ |
ikkṛṣyādibhya iti | dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvulo'pavādaḥ ||
saṃjñāyām || 3.3.109 ||
uddālaḥ-śleṣmatakaḥ, tasya puṣpāṇi bhajyante yasyāṃ sā uddālapuṣpabhañjikā | varaṇapuṣpāṇi pracīyante yasyāṃ varaṇapuṣparpacāyikā | abhyūṣaḥ-pūlikā'pūpaviśeṣaḥ, sa khādyate yasyāṃ sā abhyūṣakhādikā | tālasya bhañjanaṃ yasyāṃ sā tālabhañjikā | evaṃ śālabhañjikā ||
vibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoriñca || 3.3.110 ||
nanu pūrvaṃ paripraśnaḥ, paścādākhyānaṃ bhavati, tatkathaṃ kramavyudāsena sūtre pūrvamākhyānasya nirdeśaḥ, paścātparipraśnasya ? tatrāha---pūrvaṃ paripraśna ityādi | satyaṃ pūrvaṃ praśnaḥ paścādākhyānamiti, sūtre tu lakṣaṇavaśādviparyaya āśrita ityarthaḥ | svayaṃ tu vyatsyāsena vyācakṣāṇo'rthakrameṇa vyācaṣṭe, udāharati ca | kārikāmiti | ṇvul‌ | kriyāṃ kṛtyāmiti | `kṛñaḥ śa ca', cakārātkyapca | kṛtimiti | yogavibhāgāt‌ ktin‌ | gaṇimiti | `gaṇa saṅkhyāne' curādiradantaḥ | gaṇanāmiti | yuc‌ | evamityādi | kāṃ pācikāṃ, pacām | ṣittvādaṅ‌ | paktiḥ---`sthāgāpāpaca' iti ktin‌ | kāṃ yāji yājikāmim‌ | kāṃ pāṭhi pāṭhikāṃ paṭhitim | titutreṣvagrahādīnāmiti vacanādiṭ ||
paryāyārharṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc‌ || 3.3.111 ||
paripāṭīti | paṭeḥ paripūrvāt‌ `iṇajādibhyaḥ' iti iṇ‌ tadantāt‌ `kṛdikārāktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣ‌ | tadyorayateti | tacchabdena dhātvartha ucyate | parasmai iti | `dhāreruttamarṇaḥ' iti sampradānasaṃjñā | parasyeti tu pāṭhe parasya vistvityarthaḥ | dhāryate-bādhyate | grāmamāmiketi | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | udapādīti | `ciṇ‌ te padaḥ' iti karttari ciṇ‌ | svarārthamiti | `citaḥ' ityantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌ | ṇvuli tu `liti' iti pratyayātpūrvamudāttaṃ syāt‌ ||
ākrośe nañyaniḥ || 3.3.112 ||
ākreśaḥ-śapanam, na kṣepaḥ; svabhāvād‌ | akaraṇirityādikaṃ śapanavākyam ||
kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam || 3.3.113 ||
snānīyamiti | karaṇe kṛtyaḥ | dānīya iti | saṃpradāne avasecanādau karmaṇi lyuṭ‌ |
praskandanaḥ, prapatana iti | karttari | bahulagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, ārambhasāmarthyādeva kṛtyalyuṭo yatra vihitāstato'nyatra bhaviṣyanti, tato bahulagrahaṇāt‌ kṛnmātrasya svārthavyabhicāraḥ sādhito bhavati | `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' `kartari kṛt‌' ityayaṃ tvarthanirdeśaḥ `bāhulyādbhāvādiṣu bhavanti, kvacideva tvanyatra' iti jñāpanārthaḥ |
pādahāraka iti | karmaṇi ṇvuli pañcamyantasya sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ | galecopaka iti | `amūīrddhamastakāt‌' ityaluk‌ ||
napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ || 3.3.114 ||
nanu ca `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ siddhaḥ ? satyaṃ bhūte siddhaḥ, kālasāmānye tu napuṃsake na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | iha sakarmakebhyo'pi yathā bhāve ghañādayo bhavanti---odanasya pākaḥ, odanasya bhojanamiti, tathāyamapi ktaḥ sakarmakebhyo bhāve bhavati; atrākarmakebhya ityavacanāditi kecidāhuḥ | atha tadā karmaṇi kā vibhaktirbhavati ? kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | sā niṣṭhāyoge pratiṣidhyate ? napuṃsake bhāve upasaṃkhyānamiti ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati---odanasya bhuktamudakasya pītamiti | asminpakṣa etadarthopyayamārambhaḥ, na hi tayārevetyanena sakarmakebhyo bhāve ktaḥ siddhyati | anye tu tayorevetyetadasyāpi ktasya viṣayavyavasthāpakaṃ manyante | taddhi `niṣṭhā' iti vihitasya ktasya bhāvamarthaṃ vidyatte, `akarmakebhyaḥ' iti ca viṣayaṃ vyavasthāpayati | asya tu `bhāve ktaḥ' ityanuvādenākamakebhya iti viṣayaṃ vyavasthāpayati ||
lyuṭ‌ ca || 3.3.115 ||
yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti | uttaratra lyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌, ktasya mā bhūdityevamartham ||
karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśātkartuḥ śarīrasukham || 3.3.116 ||
karturiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' iti niyamādyeneti kartari tṛtīyā, tadāha---yena karmaṇā saṃspṛśyamānasyeti | kasya śarīrasukhamityapekṣāyāṃ kartuḥ sannidhānāttasyaiva vijñāyata ityāha---karttuḥ śarīrasukhamutpadyata iti | kimidaṃ śarīrasya sukhamiti ? nanu śarīravyatiriktasyātmano dharmaḥ sukham ? satyam; yasmin‌ sukhe samutpanne śarīre'pi svāsthyamutpadyate taccharīrasukhamityucyate | nityasamāsārthaṃ vacanamiti | kathaṃ tarhi `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' ityatrodāhṛtam---sādhu khalu payasaḥ pānaṃ devadatteneti ? yatra pratikūlatayā sukhaṃ notpadyate tatra tadudāhṛtaṃ draṣṭavyam | payaḥ pānaṃ sukhamiti | tatra pānena sukhaṃ na sparśena, idaṃ tūdāhartumucitam---candanānulepanaṃ sukhamiti ? naiṣadoṣaḥ; yatra saṃsparśanamantareṇa na sukhamutpadyate tadviṣayopalakṣaṇaṃ saṃsparśagrahaṇam | tatra sparśanādeva sukhaṃ bhavatu tatpūrvakātpānādervā sarvatra bhaviṣyati |
tūlikāyā iti | tūlena nirmitaḥ kaśipustūlikā, tatra śayitvotthānaṃ sukham | agnikuṇḍasyopāsanamiti | atrāgnikuṇḍenāspṛśyamānasyaiva sukham | guroḥ snāpanamiti | yadyapyatra guruḥ sukhānubhavasya karttā, tathāpi na tadatrāśritam; avyabhicārāt‌, kiṃ tarhi ? lyuṭ‌ prakṛtau yatkartṛtvaṃ tadāśritam, tadāha---snāpayaterna guruḥ karteti | mānasī tu prītiriti | puttreṇa balavatpariṣvajyamānasya śarīratoda eva bhavati, mānasī tu prītiḥ | nanu pratyudāharaṇeṣvapi sarvatra lyuṭ‌ prayujyate, tatkathaṃ pratyudāharaṇatvam ? tatrāha---sarvatrāsamāsaḥ pratyudāhriyata iti ||
karaṇādhikaraṇayośca || 3.3.117 ||
karaṇe cādhikaraṇe cābhidheye iti | upapade tu karaṇādhikaraṇe na bhavataḥ, karaṇādhikaraṇayorityata eva nirdeśāt‌ | kriyate'neneti karaṇam, adhikriyate'sminnitvadhikaraṇamiti karaṇādhikaraṇasādhanau hyetau | yadyevam, sati nirdeśe pratyayavidhānam, sati ca pratyayavidhāne nirdeśa | itītaretarāśrayaḥ prāpnoti ? na; nityātvācchabdānāṃ nāsmānnirdeśātkaraṇādhikaraṇaśabdaustaḥ | idhmapravraścana iti | karmaṇi, ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | dātrādirucyate | palāśaśātana iti || `śad‌lṛ śātane' hetumaṇṇica, `śaderagatau taḥ' iti tatvam | yena daṇḍena vṛkṣasya parṇāni pātyante sa evamucyate | godohanī, saktudhānī pātrī | yogaścāyaṃ yena nāprāptinyāyena ghaño'pavādaḥ | ajapau strīpratyayāṃśca paratvādvādhate | uktaṃ hi ---`ajabbhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalanau vipratiṣedhena' iti ||
puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa || 3.3.118 ||
dantacchada iti | `chada āvaraṇe' curādiḥ,`chāderghe'dvyupasargasya' iti hrasvaḥ | etyāsminkurvanti vyavahāramityākaraḥ- utpattisthānam ||
gocarasaṃcaravahavrajavyajāpaṇanigamāśca || 3.3.119 ||
gāvaścaratyasminniti | rūḍhiśabdo'yaṃ viṣayaparyāyaḥ, tasya yathākathaṃcinnirvacanam | tathā ca gocaraḥ, indriṃyagocara ityādyapi | sañcarante'neti | `samastṛtīyāyuktāt‌' ityātmanepadam | sañcaraḥ-mārgaḥ, vahaḥ- skandhaḥ, vrajaḥ-goṣṭham, vyajaḥ-tālavṛntam, āpaṇaḥ- paṇyasthānam, nigamaḥ-chandaḥ | ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, pūrveṇaivaghaḥ siddhaḥ | `halaśca' iti ghañ‌ kasmānna bhavati ? prāyeṇagrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvarttate, yathā---kaṣo nikaṣa ityatra ghañ‌ na bhavati, evaṃ gocarādiṣvapi na bhaviṣyati ||
ave tṝstrorghañ‌ || 3.3.120 ||
avatāraḥ-rūpādiḥ, avastāraḥ-javanikādiḥ | nadyavatāraḥ-tīrtham | prāyeṇagrahaṇānuvṛtterasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavatīti | nanu ghañ‌ vidheyaḥ pradhānam, tasya prāyagrahaṇamupādhiḥ, tataśca saṃjñāyāmeva kvacinna bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt‌ ? evaṃ manyate---saṃjñāyāmityupādhereva prāyagrahaṇamupādhiḥ | upāderupādhirbhavati, viśeṣaṇasyaiva vā viśeṣaṇamiti tu nāśrīyate; lakṣyānurodhāditi ||
halaśca || 3.3.121 ||
lekhaḥ-lekhanī | veṣṭaḥ- vastrādiḥ | `viṣṭa veṣṭane' | vidyete jñāyete anena dharmādharmāviti vedaḥ | apamṛjyate'nena vyādhyādirityapāmārgaḥ- vīrudviśeṣaḥ | vīmārgaḥ- samūhanī, pūrvavatkutvadīrghatve ||
adhyāyanyāyodyāvasaṃhārādhārāvāyāśca || 3.3.122 ||
āvayantīti | etyāvayantītyarthaḥ |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha iti | `ghañvidhāvavahārāvāyānāmupasaṃkhyānam' vārttikam | vṛttikārastu ādhārāvāyaśabdau sūtre prakṣipya cakāreṇāvahāraśabdaṃ sādhayati sma, vicitrā hi vṛtteḥ kṛtirvṛttikāreṇa ||
udaṅko'nudake || 3.3.123 ||
tailamudayacyate, ud‌dhriyate'sminniti tailodakam-carmamayaṃ bhajanam ||
ghaḥ kasmāditi | `puṃsi saṃjñāyām' ityādinā ghe prāpte ghañvihitaḥ, tataśca tena mukte gha eva bhavitumarhatīti bhāvaḥ | viśeṣābhāvāditi | nanu ghe sati pratyayasvaraḥ ghañi ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ, tatkathaṃ viśeṣābhāvaḥ ? statrāha---ghañyāpahītyādi ||
jālamānāyaḥ || 3.3.124 ||
`jala ghātye' ityataḥ `jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ' iti ṇe kṛte jālamiti bhavati | ānīyante matsyādayo'nenetyānāyaḥ ||
khano gha ca || 3.3.125 ||
ghitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā na khanaḥ kaścidavayavaḥ kutvabhāgasti ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etaj‌ jñāpayati---anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | tena bhajerbhagaḥ, padeḥ padam---karaṇe ghaḥ, `khala sañcalane' adhikaraṇe ghaḥ khala evamādi siddhaṃ bhavati | ākhanādayaḥ khanitravacanāḥ ||
īṣad‌duḥ suṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal‌ || 3.3.126 ||
tad‌dura iti | `suduroradhikaraṇe' itinirdeśād‌ duḥ śabdo rephānto'pyasti | sāmbhavāditi | dura eva kṛcchre sambhavaḥ itarayorevākṛcchre, ataḥ sāmānyenoktāvapi viśeṣaṇasya viṣayavibhāgo labhyata iti bhāvaḥ | īṣatkāryamiti | manāgityarthe īṣacchabdaḥ ||
kartṛkarmaṇeśca bhūkṛñoḥ || karttari karmaṇi copapade iti | pratyayārthatvaṃ tu kartṛkarmaṇorna bhavati; cakārasyopapadasamuccayārthatvāt‌ | kiṃ ca, yadi tayoḥ pratyayārthatvaṃ syād‌ īṣadādiṣvevopapadeṣu pratyayaḥ syāt‌, taśca khitkaraṇamanarthaṃkaṃsyād‌; anavyayasya hi num‌ vidhīyate | tasmātsuṣṭhūktam---kartari karmaṇi copapade iti | atra cakāraḥ sanniyogārthaḥ kriyate, yadā kartṛkarmaṇerīṣadādīnāṃ ca yugapadupapadatvaṃ tadā pratyayo bhavati, samāsastu yugapatparyāyeṇa vā bhavati | kiṃ punaratra paramupapadam ? kartṛkarmaṇī | kuta etat‌ ? khalaḥ khitkaraṇāt‌ | taddhimumartham, mumāgamaścānavyayasya | tatreṣadādīnāṃ dhātoścānantarye khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃsyāt‌ | nanu mā bhūdīṣado dhātoścānantaryam, yatraitannāsti---te prāgdhātoriti, yatra tvasti suduroḥ, tatra tayoreva prāk‌ prayogo yuktaḥ, khitkaraṇaṃ tvīṣadāḍhyambhavantīm ityādau mumarthaṃ syāt‌, sudurorapi `kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' iti tatrāpi mumarthaṃ syāt‌, yathā `udikūle rujivahoḥ' kūlamudruja iti ? vaktavyo'tra parihāraḥ---kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti | bahulagrahaṇaṃ vā'trāśrayaṇīyam | īṣadāḍhyambhavamiti | anāḍhyena bhavatā sukhenāḍhyena bhūyata ityarthaḥ | īvadāḍhyaṅkara iti | anāṭhyo devadattaḥ sukhenāḍhyaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ | svāḍhyena bhūyata iti | pramāda pāṭho'yam | atra hi khalabhāvātsuśabdasya dhātoḥ prāk‌ prayogeṇa bhāvyam, tasmādāḍhyena subhūyate iti pāṭhaḥ ||
anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate || 3.3.130 ||
anyebhyo'pi cātubhyo gatyarthebhya iti | gatyarthebhyo ye'nye dhātavastebhya ityarthaḥ | atha vā naño'tra praśleṣaḥ---anyebhyo'pi dhātubhyaḥ, ko'rthaḥ ? agatyarthebhya iti |
bhāṣāyāmiti | `chandasi' ityadhikārādayamārambhaḥ | `śāsu anuśiṣṭau', `yudha saṃprahāre', dṛśir‌ prekṣaṇe', `ñidhṛṣā prāgalabhye', `mṛṣa titikṣāyām'||
vartamānasāmīpye varttamānavadvā || 3.3.131 ||
atra kecidvyācakṣate---"samīpasya bhāvaḥ sāmīpyam, bhāve ṣyañ‌, vartamānasya sāmīpyaṃ vartamānasāmīpyam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, vartamānasya bhūtabhaviṣyantau prati yatsāmīpyaṃ tatra varttamānavatpratyayātideśo'narthakaḥ, ye hi vartamāne pratyayāste samīpabhūte'pi tasmin‌ bhavantyeva, ato vartamānaṃ prati bhūtabhaviṣyatoryatsāmīpyaṃ tadatra vartamānasāmīpyamityucyate, samīpadvārakācca vartamānasya sāmīpyenābhisambandhātsamāso nānupapannaḥ, yathā---devadattasya gurukulamiti | guṇena neti pratiṣedho'pi na bhavati; yasmād‌guṇaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvād‌ guṇākṣiptasya guṇina eva samāsaniṣedaḥ | na ca vartamānaḥ sāmīpyasya guṇī, bhūtabhaviṣyatostad‌guṇitvāt‌" iti | tadidaṃ kliṣṭaṃ vyākhyānam, ṣyañ‌nirdeśaśca kevalaṃ gauravāyaiva syādityanyathā vyācaṣṭe---samīpameva sāmīpyamiti | na cāsmin‌ pakṣe ṣyaño vaiyarthyamityāha---ṣyañaḥ svārthikatvaṃ jñāpyata iti | svārthe'pi ṣyañ‌ bhavatīti etamarthaṃ jñāpayituṃ ṣyañā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ityarthaḥ | cāturvarṇyādisiddhyarthamiti | ādiśabdena cāturāśramyam, anyasya bhāvo'nyabhāvaḥ, anyabhāva evānyabhāvyamityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam | kadā devadatta āgato'sīti | bhūtakālena praśnaḥ, udāharaṇe bhūtakālābhivyaktaye'yameṣa ityāgamanāvinābhūtaṃ yadrūpaṃ śvetaparikarabandhādiyuktaṃ tadrūpaṃ pratinirdiśyate | idānīmāgamamityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kadeti praśne cottaraṃ saṅgacchate, sāmīpyaṃ ca dyotitaṃ bhavati | āgamamiti | luṅ‌, mipo'mbhāvaḥ, lṛdittvādaṅ‌ | kadā devadatta gamiṣyasīti | atrāpi bhaviṣyatkālena praśna udāharaṇe bhaviṣyatkālābhivyaktaye | gantāsmīti | anadyatane luṭ‌ | atrāpi sāmīpyaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam |
atha vatkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'satyapi tasmin‌ pratyayādhikārādvartamāne ye pratyayā vihitāste vartamānasāmīpye bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyata eva, nārtho vatkaraṇenāta āha---vatkaraṇaṃ sarvasādṛśyārthamiti | asati vatkaraṇe vartamāne ye pratyayā ityanena pratyayānāṃ rūpamātraṃ lakṣyeta, tataśca saṅkaro'pi syāt‌---anyasmāddhātoryo vartamāne vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa dhātvantarādapi syāt‌ | vatkaṇe tu sati sarvasādṛśyāvagateḥ saṅkaro na bhavati | sarvasādṛśyāvagateḥ saṅkaro na bhavati | sarvasādṛśyameva darśayati---yena viśeṣaṇeneti | ādiśabdenopādherabhidheyasya ca grahaṇam | pacamāno yajamāna iti | vartamāne pūṅ‌yajoḥ śānanvihitaḥ, sāmīpye sa tābhyāmeva bhavati | alaṅkariṣṇuriti | tacchīlādiviśiṣṭe karttaryalampūrvātkṛñ iṣṇujvihitaḥ, sa sāmīpye'pi tasmādeva tatpūrvādeva tasminnevārthe bhavati |
parut‌ pūrvasmin‌ saṃvatsare |
yo hi manyate ityādinā pratipattṛviśeṣaṃ prati prakaraṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe | kālāntaragatistviti | kālāntaraṃ vartamānasamīpo bhūto bhaviṣyaṃśca kālaḥ tasya yā gatiḥ- pratītiḥ sā `ayaṃ gacchāmi' ityato vākyāt‌ `kadā devadatta gamiṣyasi' ityasyottaratvena prayuktādbhavati, tataḥ kimityatrāha---na ceti | vākyārthapratipattāramiti | vākyārtho'yaṃ na padārtha iti yaḥ pratipadyate sa vākyārthapratipattā, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | `kartari ca' iti pratiṣedhastvanityaḥ; `janikarttuḥ' iti nirdeśāt‌, śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā vā samāsaḥ | prakaraṇamiti | ita ārabhyāṣṭaḍasūtrī prakaraṇaśabdenocyate | tathā ca śvaḥ kariṣyatītyādi | yadi vākyagamyo'pi kālaḥ padasaskāra upayujyate, tadā naivamādyupapadyate---anadyatane luṭaiva bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā ||
āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca || 3.3.132 ||
tasyāśca bhaviṣyatkālo viṣaya iti | bhaviṣyatkālo'syeti bhaviṣyatkālo dhātvarthaḥ, sa āśaṃsāviṣayaḥ, sā tu vartamānakālaiva | evaṃ ca sāmarthyādbhaviṣyādviṣayo'yamatideśo vijñāyata ityāha---bhaviṣyatkāla iti | āśaṃsāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti | āśaṃsyamānakriyāvacanāddhātorityarthaḥ | upādhyāścedityādikamāṃśasāvākyam, tatropādhyāyāgamanaṃ vyākaraṇādhyayanaṃ cobhyamāśaṃsyamānamityubhayatrāpi pratyayaḥ | adhyagīṣmahīti | `vibhāṣā luṅ‌lṛṭoḥ' iti iṅoḥ gāṅādeśaḥ, `gāṅ‌kuṭādibhyaḥ' iti sico ṅittvam, ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam |
sāmānyātideśe iti | atra sūtre bhūtaśabdena bhūtamātramucyate, na tu tadviśeṣo'nadyatanaḥ | sāmānyātideśe ca viśeṣo nātidiśyate, vrāhmaṇavadasminkṣatriye vattitavyamityukte brāhmaṇamātraprayuktaṃ kāryaṃgamyate, na tu māṭharādiviśeṣapratyuktam, tenānadyatanaprayuktau laṅ‌liṭau na bhavataḥ | ihāniṣpanne niṣpannaśabdaḥ śiṣyaḥ śāsitavyaḥ, devaśced‌vṛṣṭo niṣpannāḥ śālaya iti vastusvarūpakathanametat, nātrāśaṃsā, tena sūtreṇāprāptiḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; apśālibījasaṃyoga eva niṣpattiḥ śālīnāṃ tatraiva niṣpattervṛtteḥ | ata eva loko bhaviṣyadvācinaḥ śabdasya prayogaṃ na mṛṣyati | devaśced‌vṛṣṭaḥ sampatsyante śālaya iti ukte, vaktāro bhavanti---maivaṃ vocaḥ, sampannāḥ śālaya iti brūhīti, hetubhūtakālasamprekṣitatvātsiddham | hetubhūtasya varṣāderyaḥ kālaḥ sa eva kāryasya samprekṣitaḥ sa eva kāryasyāpi kālo vyavasthāpyate kāraṇāntarāpekṣābhāvapratipādanāya | tataśca kāraṇasyaiva kāryarūpeṇa vivakṣitatvādabhedādhyavasāyātkāraṇasya bhūtatvātkāryasyāpi bhūtatvaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ |
iha tu kaścidadhvānaṃ jigamiṣuḥ paśyati amuṣminnavakāśe kūpo bhaviṣyatīti, anadyatane kūpo bhaviteti samāsādya kūpo'stīti, atikramyakūpo'bhūditi, atikramyoṣitatvāt‌ kūpa āsīditi, atikramyāṣitvā vismṛtya kūpo babhūveta; tadatra sarvatra kūpasattāyā vatemānatvaṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadrūpatvamiti sarvatra laḍeva prāpnoti, luṅādayastu vaktavyāḥ ? tadāha---`astyarthānāṃ bhavantyarthe sarvā vibhaktayaḥ kartuvidyamānārthatvāt‌' iti | bhavantīśabdo laṭaḥ pūrvācāryāṇāṃ saṃjñā | yadi vacanena vartamāna eva luṅādayo vidhīyante kūpo'bhūditi prayoktavye kūpo bhaviṣyatītyapi prayujyeta, tasmādyathāsvametā vibhaktayaḥ kāleṣu prayujyante | katham ? indriyavyāpārasya kālasya kūpasattāṃ prati bhedakatvenāśrayaṇāttasyā api tatkālatvam; tataścendriyavyāpāre bhāvini bhaviṣyādvibhaktiḥ, vartamāne vartamānavibhaktiḥ, bhūte bhūtavibhaktiriti siddhamiṣṭam | uktaṃ ca---
sattāmindriyasambandhātsaiva sattā viśeṣyate |
bhedena vyavahāro hi vastvantaranibandhanaḥ ||
astitvaṃ vastumātrasya buddhyā tu parigṛhyate |
yaḥ samāsādanādbhevaḥ sa tatra na vivakṣitaḥ || iti ||
kṣipravacane lṛṭ‌ || 3.3.133 ||
vacanagrahaṇaṃ paryāyārthamiti | asati tasmin‌ `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanātkṣipraśabda evopapade syāt‌, sati tu paryāyeṣvapi bhavati | nanu bhūtavaccetyasyāyamapavādaḥ, sa ca bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayastatra netyeva vaktavyam, tasminpratiṣiddhe `lṛṭ‌ śeṣe ca' ityanenaiva lṛṭ‌ siddhaḥ, tatkiṃ lṛḍ‌grahaṇena ? tatrāha---neti vaktavye ityādi | netyucyamāne `lṛṭ‌ śeṣe ca' ityanena lṛḍ‌ bhavannanadyatane na syāt‌; luṭā bādhitatvād‌ | ato luḍ‌viṣayo'pi yathā syāditi lṛḍ‌grahaṇaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ ||
āśaṃsāvacane liṅ‌ || 3.3.134 ||
adhīyīyeti | iṅo liṅaḥ `ico't‌', sīyuṭ‌, liṅaḥ salopaḥ, dhātoriyaṅ‌, upasargeṇa saha savarṇadīrghatvam | kṣipravacane lṛṭ‌, āśaṃsāvacane liṅ‌ vipratiṣedhena | kṣipravacane lṛḍityasyāvakāśaḥ---kṣipramadhyeṣyāmaha iti, āśaṃsāvacane liṅityasyāvakāśaḥ---āśaṃse yukto'dhīyīyeti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti---āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīyeti, liṅ‌ bhavati vipratiṣedhena | tadetadudāharaṇe darśayati---āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīyeti ||
nānadyatanavatkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ || 3.3.135 ||
kālānāṃ sāmīpyamiti | `vartamānasāmīpye' ityārabhya kālaprāyatvādasya prakaraṇasya sāmānyenoktāvapi kālasambandhina eva sāmīpyasyāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | lulyajātīyeneti | tatraiva loke sāmīpyavyavahārāditi bhāvaḥ | adāditi | `gātisthā' ityādinā sico luk‌ | adhyāpipaditi | iṅo ṇic‌, `krīṅ‌jīnāṃ ṇau' ityātvam, `arttihrī' ityādinā puk‌, luṅi caṅi `ajāderdvitīyasya' iti piśabdasya dvirvacanam, ṇilopaḥ |
yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrānteti | porṇamāsyantareṇāvyavahitā yā paurṇamāsī tāmadhikṛtyedamucyate | sāpi yadyapyamāvāsyayānyābhiśca tithibhirvyavahitā; tathāpi tulyajātīyena porṇamāsyākhyenāvyahitatvātsamīpyaṃ nātivarttate | ādhiteti | dadhāterāṅ‌pūrvasya `sthāghvoricca' itīttvam, `hrasvādaṅgāt‌' iti sico lopaḥ | ayaṣṭeti | `jhalo jhali' iti sico lopaḥ, vraścādisūtreṇa ṣatvam | aditeti | dadāte rūpaṃ pūrvavat‌ | yakṣyate iti | vraścādiṣatve `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvam, sarvatra `svaritañitaḥ' ityātmanepadam |
iha kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoradyatanapratyayau luṅ‌lṛṭau iṣyete, nānadyatanapratyayau laṅ‌lṛṭau, tau ca luṅ‌lṛṭau `adtanavat‌ kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ' ityacyamāne'pi siddhyata eva, kimarthaṃ dvau pratiṣedhāvucyete ? ityata āha---dvau pratiṣedhāviti | yathāprāptasyeti | yathā yena prakāreṇa prāptaṃ prāptiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | avyayībhāve tvambhāvaḥ syāt‌ | ihādyatanavacane sati vidhānamidaṃ vijñāyate, tatra laḍ‌vidhiprasaṅge pūrvavidhāne hyadyatanasaṃśabdanena vihitasya kasyacitpratyayasyābhāvādadyatane dṛṣṭasyātideśaḥ, laṭ‌ cāpyadyatane dṛṣṭastena tasyāpi bhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ prasaṅgaḥ, luṅ‌lṛṭoścāyathākālaṃ vidhiḥ prasajyeta---luṅo viṣaye lṛṭ, lṛṭaśca viṣaye luṅ‌ | nanu ca vatkaraṇātsādṛśyārthātsaṅkaro na bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; iha luṅ‌lṛṭau bhūtabhaviṣyatoradyatane ca dṛṣṭau, tatrādyatanavadityucyamāne tasminnevādyatane tayoratideśo'nathaka iti kaścidaṃśo hātavyaḥ | tatrādyatanāṃśatyāgenātideśe vijñāyamāne bhūtānadyatane luṅ‌, bhaviṣyadanadyatane lṛḍiti siddham | yadā tu bhūtabhaviṣyadaśaparityāgenātideśaḥ; tadā bhūtādyatane dṛṣṭasya bhaviṣyadadyatane, bhaviṣyadanadyatane ca dṛṣṭasya bhūtādyatane vidhānamiti saṅkaraḥ syādeva, laṭ‌ cobhayatra prasajyeta | vatkaraṇaṃtu yasmāddhātoryasminnupādhau yaḥ pratyayo vihitaḥ sa tasmādeva tasminnupādhāveva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ syāt | tena---`pūṅyajoḥ śānan‌' ityādau kālavyatyāsa eva bhavati, na dhātvādivyatyāsaḥ | yadi punarayaṃ dvau pratiṣedhau kṛtvā tūṣṇīmāste, svaireva vidhāyakairlaḍādaya utsargāḥ sveṣu sveṣu kāleṣu apavādavinirmukteṣu bhavantīti na saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ | ato yathāprāptasyābhyanujñānānnāyaṃ vatiḥ; kiṃ tarhi ? matup‌---anadyatanamasyāstītyanadyatanavat‌, sāmānyavivakṣyāṃ napuṃsakatvam | anadyatanavatpratyayavidhirna bhavatīti | asyāpyanadyatanavāṃścāsau pratyayaśca tasya vidhirityartha iti sarvathā yadanadyatane vihitaṃ tatsarvaṃ na bhavati | vattau `laṅ‌luṭau vihitau tayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' ityupalakṣaṇam ||
bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasmin‌ || 3.3.136 ||
akriyāprabandhārthamasāmīpyārthaṃ ca vacanamiti | `kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ' iti nānuvarttate, tadanuvṛttau hi niyamārthametat‌ syād‌---bhaviṣyatyeva maryādāvacana evāvarasminneveti vā | vidhiniyamasambhave ca vidhireva jyāyāniti bhāvaḥ | maryādāvacane satīti | maryādoktau satyāmityarthaḥ | vacanagrahaṇamabhividhyartham, vacanagrahaṇe hi sati maryādāmātravacane maryādāvacana ityartho bhavati | saiva hi maryādā yadā kāryeṇābhisambaddhyate tadā `abhividhiḥ' ityucyate | avarasminpravibhāga iti | aparabhāgaviṣayaśceddhātvartho bhavatītyarthaḥ, aparasminniti vacanādyasya maryādā tasya dvau bhāgau kalpayitavyāviti gamyate | gantavya iti | adhvagamanasya bhaviṣyatvaṃ darśayam̐statra karttavyasya bhojanāderbhaviṣyattvaṃ darśayati | tasya yadaparamiti | anenādhvano vibhāgo dvirityanenāpi kriyāprabandhābhāvo dvireva, nānavaratamiti |
yo'yamadhvāgata iti | bhūtakālatāṃ darśayati | adhyaimahīti | iṅo laṅ‌, śapo luk‌, `āḍajādīnām', `āṭaśca'| abhuñjmahīti | `bhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, `śnasorallopaḥ', cutvam |
tatra uttarasūtre viśeṣaṃ vakṣyatīti | anahorātrāṇāmityanena ||
kālavibhāgau cānahorātraṇam || 3.3.137 ||
kālamaryādāvibhāge satīti | maryādā ca vibhāgaśca maryādāvibhāgam---samāhāradvandvaḥ, tena kālaśabdasya ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ | na cedahorātrasambandhī vibhāga iti | etenānahorātrāṇāmiti sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī, na `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ' iti darśayati | evaṃ sati yadiṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ taddarśayati---tairiti | tairanyasya kālasya vibhāgo'nyena vā teṣāṃ taireva vā sarvathā pratiṣedhaḥ | nanu pūrvasūtre evānahorātrāṇāmiti vaktavyam, evamapi hi sāmarthyātkālavibhāgasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāyate, na hi deśavibhāgasyāhorātraiḥ sambandho'sti, tatkiṃ yogavibhāgena ? tatrāha---yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti | uttarasūtre kālavibhāga eva vibhāṣā yathā syād‌, deśavibhāge mā bhūditi | āgrahāyaṇī-mārgaśīrṣī |
trividhamudāharaṇamiti | prathamaṃ taivibhāgasya, dvitīyaṃ teṣāṃ vibhāgasya, tṛtīyaṃ taisteṣāmahorātrasaṃsparśe - ahorātragandhe, etacca prasajyapratiṣedhasamāśrayaṇāllabhyate | darśitaśca prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ `na cedahorātrasambandhī vibhāgaḥ' iti; anyathā `anahorātrasambandhini vibhāgaḥ' ityavakṣyat ||
liṅ‌nimitte lṛṅ‌ kriyātipattau || 3.3.139 ||
kutaścidvaiguṇyāditi | pratibandhakodayaḥ sāmagrīvaikalyaṃ vā vaiguṇyam | dakṣiṇena mārgeṇa na śakaṭaṃ paryābhaviṣyaditi | tasyamārgasya ṛjutvātsthāṇvāderabhāvācca | paryābhavanam-bhaṅgaḥ | kamalakaḥ-kaścitpuruṣaḥ, sa śakaṭādīnāṃ viṣameṣvapi sthāneṣu musalādyavaṣṭambhayogena netā | amokṣyata bhavān‌ ghṛteneti | ghṛtamātrasyātipattau bhojanakriyābhinirvṛttāvapi lṛṅ‌ bhavati; kāraṇabhedādvibhinnaiva bhojanakriyā, tato ghṛtātipattau ghṛtabhojanakriyāpyatipannaiva |
bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayametadvacanamiti | kathaṃ tarhi bhaviṣyato'rthasyedānīmavagatistatrāha---bhaviṣyadaparyābhavanamiti | hetumat‌ tatra hetubhūtamiti | etena liṅ‌nimittaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ darśayati | liṅ‌gena budhveti | asakṛtprākkamalakāhvāne sati śakaṭāparyābhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvino'pi kamalakāhvānasya śakaṭāparyābhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvino'pi kamalakāhvānasya śakaṭāparyābhavanahetubhūtvaṃ liṅgena budhvā | liṅgaṃ punaḥ kamalakāhvānatvam | `bhaviṣyatkamalakāhvānamapi śakaṭāparyābhavanasya hetuḥ kamalakāhvānatvātpūrvakamalakāhvānavat‌' iti evaṃ budhvetyarthaḥ | tadatapattimiti | prakaraṇād‌ dvicanāntasya samāsaḥ, tayorāhvānāparyābhavanayoratipattimityarthaḥ, tatra kamalakasya deśāntaragamanādinā tadāhvānasyātipattiravasīyate; tadatipattyaiva ca paryābhavanasyāpyati pattiḥ, śakaṭasya gurutarabhārāropaṇādinā | bhaviṣyatkālayoratipattirito vākyād‌ gamyati iti | nedānīṃ kamalaka āhvātuṃ śakyate, tacca śakaṭamapi paryābhaviṣyatyevetyavagamāt‌ ||
bhūte ca || 3.3.140 ||
annārthī caṅ‌kramyamāṇa iti | bhoktukāmaḥ kṣudhā kuṭilaṃ gacchannityarthaḥ | aparaśca dvijo brāhmaṇārthīti | caṅ‌kramyamāṇo dṛṣṭa ityanuṣaḍgaḥ | brāhmaṇārtho bhoktāraṃ mārgayamāṇa ityarthaḥ | so'pi saṃbhramātkuṭilaṃ gacchati | tataḥ kimityata āha---yadītyādi | yadi dṛṣṭo'bhaviṣyaditi kvacitpaṭhyate tattu `yadāyadyorupasaṃkhyānam' iti yadiliṅ‌nimittatvāt‌ lṛṅ‌, kiṃ tūttarasūtreṇa vikalpitaḥ | dṛṣṭa ityeva tu pāṭho yuktaḥ | na tu bhuktavāniti | kriyātipattiṃ darśayati | tatra hetuḥ---anyena pathā sa gata iti ||
votāpyoḥ || 3.3.141 ||
vā ā utāpyoriti āṅaḥ praśleṣaṃ darśayati | tatrāṅa utāpyorityanena sambandhādalpāpekṣatvenāntaraṅgatvādvā pūrvaṃ pareṇa sahād‌guṇe kṛte pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvād‌ `omāṅośca' iti pararūpam, yathā---ā-ūḍhā - oḍhā, adya oḍhā adyoḍhā, kadoḍheti | atrotāpyoḥ samarthayoriti yatsaptamyantaṃ tadavadhitvenāpādīyate, tatra prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatītyanukaraṇasyāpyapratyaya iti pratiṣedhenāprātipadikatvādāṅo'pi yoge pañcamyabhāvaḥ | maryādāyāmāṅiti | etacca vibhāṣā garhāprakṛtau prāgutāpibhyāmiti smaraṇādavasīyate | garhāprakṛtau garhāviśiṣṭe prakṛtyarthe | garhāgrahaṇamanavaklṛptyāderapi liṅ‌nimittasyopalakṣaṇam | `vibhāṣā kathami liṅ‌ca' iti liṅ‌nimittābhāvāduttarasūtrātikramaḥ ||
garhāyāṃ laḍapijātvoḥ || 3.3.142 ||
kālasāmanaye na prāpnotīti | vidhīyate ityanena bhaviṣyatītyādeḥ kālaviśeṣavācino nivṛttiṃ sūcayan‌ kālasāmānye vidhiriti darśayati | kālaviśeṣavihitāṃścetyādi | bhāṣye tveṣa nirṇayaḥ---`garhāyāṃ laḍ‌vidhānānarthakyam, kriyāsamāpteravavivakṣitatvāt‌ | tācchīlyapratipādanenātra garhā, tataśca yadanena kriyate tatsarvaṃ vṛṣalayājanārthamiti sarvadāsau vṛṣalaṃ yājayanneva bhavati, tataśca kriyāyāḥ samāptiravivakṣiteti `vartamāne laṭ‌' ityeva siddhaḥ | yadyevam, śatṛśānacāvapi prāpnutaḥ, dṛśyete ca śatṛśānacāvapi māṃ yājayantaṃ paśyata, api māṃ yājamānaṃ paśyeti, pratyuta sūtrārambhe satyavarttamānakālavihitatvālluṭastau na na prāpnuta iti doṣavānena sūtrārambhaḥ' iti ||
vibhāṣā kathami liṅ‌ ca || 3.3.143 ||
vibhāṣāgrahaṇamityādi | svasmin‌ svasmin‌ kāle ye lṛḍādayo vihitāsteṣāṃ ca bādhā mā bhūdityevamarthamityarthaḥ | yadyevam, vibhāṣāgrahaṇādeva laḍapi bhaviṣyati, nārthaścakāreṇa ? satyam; varttamāne siddhyati, kālāntare tu na siddhyati tasmāttadarthaścakāreṇa laṭaḥ gamuccayaḥ | atra liṅ‌nimittamastīti | kathamītyetad‌garhā ca ||
kiṃvṛtte liṅ‌lṛṭau || 3.3.144 ||
`kiṃvṛtte lipsāyām' ityatra kiṃvṛttaṃ vyākhyātam | iha kiṃvṛtte lṛṭ‌ ceti vaktavyam, cakārātprakṛto liṅ‌ bhaviṣyati, nārtho liṅ‌grahaṇena ? tatrāha---liṅ‌grahaṇamiti | cakāreṇa liṅa iva laṭo'pi samuccayaḥ syāt‌; tasyāpi prakṛtvāt‌, tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyarthamiti bhāvaḥ ||
anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi || 3.3.145 ||
apigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum, katham ? yathā `upakādibhyo'nyarasyāmadvandve' ityatrādvandvagrahaṇaṃ dvandvādhikāranivṛttyartham, tathehāpyakiṃvṛttagrahaṇaṃ kiṃvṛttādhikāranivṛttyartham, asminnavṛtte kiṃvṛtte cākiṃvṛtte ca pratyayadvayaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkriyate vispaṣṭārtham | tathā'kiṃvṛtta ityapi vispaṣṭārthameva, asvaritatvādeva `kiṃvṛtte' ityasyānanuvṛtteraviśeṣeṇa pratyayadvayaṃ bhaviṣyati | āha ca---kiṃvṛttasyānadhikārāduttaratrākiṃvṛttagrahaṇānarthakyamiti | nu cākiṃvṛttagrahaṇena kiṃvṛttādanyatpadaṃ paryudāsāśrayaṇena gṛhyate, tasyopapadasajñāṃ vakṣyāmītyakiṃvṛttagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | kiṃ punarupapadasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanam ? samāsaḥ ? na; atiṅiti pratiṣedhāt‌ | yadā tarhi lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau bhavatastadā samāso yathā syāt‌, nāsya lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ, `laṭaḥ sadvā' ityatra bhaviṣyatītyadhikārādbhaviṣyatītyevaṃ vihitasya lṛṭo grahaṇam | ayaṃ tu kālamātre vidhānādyadyapi bhavati, tathāpi bhaviṣyadadhikāravihito na bhavatīti nāsya śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ ||
kiṃkilāstyartheṣu lṛṭ‌ || 3.3.146 ||
samudāya upapadamiti | kevalasya kiṃśabdasyānavaklṛptyamarṣayorvṛttyasambhavāt‌ | liṅo'pavāda iti | pūrveṇāpraptasya | astitāmetyādi | bhavatkartṛkaṃ vṛṣalayājanamastītyarthaḥ | uktaṃ hi `pacyādayaḥ kriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavanti' iti ||
jātuyadorliṅ‌ || 3.3.147 ||
lṛṭo'pavāda iti | anavaklṛptyādisūtreṇa liṅ‌lṛṭordvayorapi prāptayorliṅeva yathā syāt‌, lṛṇmā bhūdityavamartha ityarthaḥ |
yadāyadyorupasaṅ‌khyānamiti | sūtravat‌ lṛṭo'pavādaḥ ||
yaccayatrayoḥ || 3.3.148 ||
lṛṭa evāpavāda iti | pūrvavatprāptasya | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ | yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti | uttaratra yaccayatrayorevānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌, jātuyadormābhūditi | ihānavaklṛptyamarṣau dvau, yaccayatrayorityupapade api dve eva, tataśca yathāsaṅ‌khyaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha---yathāsaṅ‌khyamiha neṣyate iti | pūrvavallakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt‌ bahvacaḥ pūrvanipātāt‌ ||
garhāyāṃ ca || 3.3.149 ||
daridraścedvṛṣalayājanamapi yuktaṃ syāt‌, tata uktam---ṛddhaiti | ṛddhasyāpyupabhogabāhulyena sambhāvyeta, ata uktam---vṛddha iti | vṛddhasyāpi jātimātrabrāhmaṇasya yuktaṃ syāt‌, ata uktam---sad‌brāhmaṇa iti | sadvaṃśajaḥ sadācāraścetyarthato garhāmarha iti ||
śeṣe lṛjayadau || 3.3.151 ||
yaccayatrābhyāmiti | citrīkaraṇāpekṣastu śeṣo na bhavati, tasyeha svaritatvenādhikārāt‌ | āścaryaṃ yadi sa bhuñjīteti | atrānavaklṛptirāścaryaṃ ca dvayaṃ gamyate, tatrāścaryanimitte lṛṭi pratiṣiddhe jātuyadorliṅ‌vidhāne yadāyadyorupasaṅkhyānamityanavaklṛptau liṅ‌ | bhāṣye tu "sambhāvanārtho yadiśabdaḥ prayujyate, tataśca sambhāvanamatra tātparyārthaḥ, na citrīkaraṇam; tataścāyadāviti na vaktavyam, liṅapi `sambhāvane'lam' ityanenaiva" ityuktam | yadāha---citrīkaraṇe yadipratipedhānarthakyamarthānyatvāditi ||
utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅ‌ || 3.3.152 ||
samarthayoriti | sūtre samaśabdasya nipātanād‌ `atolopaḥ' śakandhvāditvādvā pararūpatvam | saṃśabda eva vā vṛttau samaśabdena samānārthaḥ, yathā---`propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām', yathā---mukhasaṃmukhasyetyatreti bhāvaḥ |
praśnaḥ pracchādanaṃ ca gamyata iti | ādye praśno gamyate, dvitīye pracchādanam | nanu cāpiśabdo'pi praśne dṛṣṭaḥ---`apyagraṇīrmantrakṛtṛmṛṣīṇām' api prasannaṃ hariṇeṣu te manaḥ' iti tataśca praśne'pi samānārthatvamanayoriti uta daṇjaḥ patiṣyatīti pratyudāharaṇānupapattiḥ ? evaṃ manyate---apyagraṇīrityādau praṣṭavyamarthāntaramapekṣya samuccayārtha evāpiśabdaḥ, praśnastvarthaḥ prakaraṇādinā gamyate; tena nānayoḥ praśne samānārthatvamiti ||
kāmapravedane'kacciti || 3.3.153 ||
svābhiprāyāviṣkaraṇaṃ kāmapravedanamiti | etadevāvayavārthaprakāśanenopapādayayati---kāma iccheti |
mārāvida tvāṃ pṛcchāmīti | mārāviśabdaṃ dadātīti mārāvidaḥ, mārāvi ravo mākārītyarthaḥ | saṃjñaiṣā śukaviśeṣasya, taṃ haste nidhāya kaścillālayati | pārvatyapi śukasyaiva kācidiṣṭā | prāyeṇa tu mātāpitarau pṛcchāmīti pāṭhaḥ, tatra tadupakramaṃ vākyam---mātāpitarau pṛcchāmi | kimatra pṛcchyate ? kaccijjīvati te māteti ||
saṃmbhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge || 3.3.154 ||
yogyatādhyavasānamiti | yogyatāyā niścayaḥ | etadeva sphorayati---śaktiśraddhānamiti | śaktiḥ- sāmarthyam, śraddhīyate viṣayīkriyate yena jñānena tattathoktaṃ taditi | sambhāvanaparyāptyetyetena paryāptāvihālaṃśabdaḥ, na bhūṣaṇādāvityāha---yadyevaṃ sambhāvana iti | saptamyantasya kathamalamiti cedityedviśeṣaṇamupapadyata ityāśaṅ‌kya vipariṇāmena vyācaṣṭe---taccetsambhāvanamiti | sambhāvanamalamiti cāvartate---sambhāvane liṅ‌ bhavati taccetsambhāvanamalamātmakaṃ bhavatīti | evaṃ paryavasānenālamā sambandhaḥ, ato'tretiśabdo na sambandhanīyaḥ | tato'lamityasmin‌ siddhāprayoge satītyanvayaḥ | atra cecchabdo na sambandhanīyaḥ; saptamyantena sambandhāsambhavāt‌ | vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ darśitam---siddhaścedalamo'prayoga iti, na punaratra cecchabdasyānvayaḥ | paryāptamiti | svakāryanirvarttane samartham, svakāryaṃ punastasyāviparītamaviṣayaparicchedaḥ, taddarśayati---avitathamiti | atathābhūtārthaviṣayatvaṃ jñānasya vaitathyam, yathā---śuktikāyāṃ rajatajñānasya; tadviparītamavitatham, tathābhūtārthaviṣayamityarthaḥ | tadīdṛśasambhāvanopādhika iti | taditi vākyopanyāse īdṛśamalamarthaviśiṣṭaṃ sambhāvanamupādhiryasyeti tripado bahuvrīhiḥ | kvacittuīdṛśe sambhāvanopādhaka ityasamāsaḥ paṭhyate, tatredṛśa iti na saṅgacchate; na hi dhātvarthasya kiñcidrūpaṃ prāṅ‌nidarśitaṃ yadīdṛśamityucyeta | sarvalakārāṇamapavāda iti | sambhāvanasya bhaviṣyadviṣayatvādbhaviṣyadviṣayāṇāṃ sarvalakārāṇāmityarthaḥ | api parvataṃ śirasā bhindyāditi | atra yatparvatabhedaviṣayaṃ sāmarthyaṃ puṃsaḥ sambhāvyate tadyasya bhīmasenādervidyata eva, tatra sambhāvanamavitathamiti tadviṣayamudāharaṇam | api droṇapāka bhuñjīteti | yatpakvasya bhojanaṃ tadeva pākasya bhojanam, karmasādhano vā pākaśabdaḥ | videśasthāyī-deśāntaragataḥ | prāyeṇagamiṣyatīti | prāyikasvadakṣiṇākṣispandanāderliṅgābhāsādāgamanaṃ sambhāvya tata etatprayujyate, tattathyamapi bhavati, viparītamapi bhavati | alaṃ devadatta iti | paryāptaṃ haniṣyatītyarthaḥ | bhāviviṣayatvāt‌ sambhāvanasya sarvatra lṛṭ‌ pratyudāhṛtaḥ |
aparā vyākhyā---sambhāvanaṃ bhāvivastūtprekṣaṇam, asati viruddhapratyayopanipāte bhavitavyamaneneti jñānam, yathā pratyudāharaṇe---prāyeṇāgamiṣyatīti, tasya viśeṣaṇamalamiti cediti, alamiti cet‌ tatsambhāvanamiti vipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | tatra yathā ghaṭa iti jñānaṃ paṭa iti jñānamityukte jñānasya viṣayanirdeśaḥ pratīyate, tathehāpi sambhāvanākhyasya jñānasya viṣayanirdeśo'yamalamiti cet‌ tatsambhāvanamalamarthaviṣayaṃ cedityarthaḥ | alamarthaśca paryāptirna bhūṣaṇādiḥ, dhātośca pratyayavidhānāttadarthagocarameva sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyate | imaṃ dhātvarthamanuṣṭhātuṃ samartha ityevaṃ rūpaṃ cet‌ tatsambhāvanamityarthaḥ | siddhāprayoge kasmin‌ sannidhānādalaṃśabdaḥ | evaṃ tāvatsūtrākṣarāṇāṃ nirvāhaḥ | vṛttestu---yatkriyāsu yogyatādhyavasānamiti tadiha sūtre jighṛkṣitasya sambhāvanasya lakṣaṇaṃ na sambhavanamātrasya; anyathā pratyudāharaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt‌, na hi tatra śaktiścaddhānaṃ gamyate | kathaṃ punaratredṛśaṃ sambhāvanaṃ gṛhyata ityatrāha---tadidānīmiti | tatkhalu sambhāvanametatsūtrapraṇayanakāle'sminsūtra ityarthaḥ | alamarthena viṣayeṇāviśeṣyate alamiti cet‌ sambhāvanamiti, paryāptimiti | paryāptimiti | paryāptiralamarthaḥ, na bhūṣaṇādirityarthaḥ | vipariṇāmenānvayaṃ darśayati---taccetsambhāvanamiti | paryāptiviṣayatvāt‌ paryāptam, avitathaviṣayatvāt‌ avitatham, etaddhātvarthānuṣṭhāne paryāpto vitathārambho'yamasmin‌ dhātvartha ityevaṃrūpaṃ cetsambhāvanamityarthaḥ | api parvataṃ śirasābhindyāditi | evaṃ nāmāyaṃ balavānityarthaḥ, parvataṃ tu bhinattu mā vā bhidat‌ ||
vibhāṣā dhātau sambhāvanavacane'yadi || 3.3.155 ||
sambhāvayāmi bhuñjīta bhavāniti | bhojane bhavāṃśchakta ityutprekṣa ityarthaḥ ||
hetuhetumatorliṅ‌ || 3.3.156 ||
bhaviṣyati ca kāla iti | iṣyata ityapekṣyate | kathaṃ punaretad‌ dvayaṃ sūtre'nupāttameva labhyate ? ityāha---tatreti | liṅiti varttamāne iti | `utāpyoḥ' ityādeḥ sūtrāt‌ | hantīti palāyata iti | atra hananaṃ hetuḥ, palāyanaṃ hetumat | varṣaṇaṃ hetuḥ, saraṇaṃ hetumat | palāyata iti | `upasargasyāyatau' iti latvam | atra `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti śatrādeśo'pi na bhavati, `hatiyoge ca sadvidhiḥ' iti vyavasthitavibhāṣāsu paṭhitatvāt‌ ||
icchārtheṣu liṅ‌loṭau || 3.3.157 ||
kāmapravedana iti vaktavyamiti | `kāmapravedane'kacciti ityayaṃ tarhi yogaḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā kāmo me bhuñjīta bhavān, abhilāṣo me bhuñjīta bhavānityatrāpyanenaiva siddham ? yatrecchārthamupapadaṃ na bhavati, arthaprakaraṇādinā tu kāmapravedanaṃ gamyate, tatrāpi liṅ‌ yathā syāt‌ | idaṃ tarhi kimartham ? lorḍtham, liṅ‌grahaṇaṃ tu loṭā bādhā mā bhūditi | evamapi `leṭ‌ ca' iti vaktavye kiṃ liṅ‌grahaṇena ? prakṛtaṃ liṅ‌grahaṇaṃ vibhāṣāsambandham, atastadanukarṣaṇe vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyāpyanukarṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta ||
samānakartṛkeṣu tumun‌ || 3.3.158 ||
tumunprakṛtyapekṣamiti | tumunprakṛtau yaḥ karttā sa cedicchārtheṣvapi bhavatīti, etacca sānnidhyāllabhyate | icchati bhoktumiti | ātmano bhojanamicchatītyarthaḥ | ya eveṣeḥ karttā sa eva bhujerapītyastīha samānakartṛkatvam | icchāyā bhujikriyāṃ prati tādarthyasyāpratīteḥ `tumunṇvulau' ityādinā tumun‌ na siddhyatītyayamārambhaḥ | athāpi kathañcittādarthyaṃ syāt‌, evamapi samānakartṛkeṣviti vakṣyāmītyāyamārambhaḥ, tena devadattena bhoktumicchati yajñadatta iti na bhavati | icchankarotīti | atrārthe icchankartumiti na bhavatītyarthaḥ | icchankartuṃ gacchatītyādau `tumunṇvulau' ityādinā tumun‌ | nanu bhāve tumun‌ vidhīyate, tatkathamicchankarotītyatra karttari prasaṅgaḥ ? evamapīcchatā kriyate ityatra prasaṅgādanabhidhānamevāśrayaṇīyam ||
liṅ‌ ca || 3.3.159 ||
kimarthamidamucyate ? liṅ‌ yathā syāt‌ | siddho'tra liṅ‌ `icchārtheṣu liṅ‌loṭau' iti ? tasya samānakartṛkeṣu tumun‌ bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ | vāsarūpavidhiśca ktalyuṭ‌tumun‌khalartheṣu pratiṣiddhastatra yathā loṇna bhavati evaṃ liṅapi nasyāt‌ | athāpi vāsarūpavidhiḥ syād‌ ? evamapi liṅeva yathā syālloṇmābhūdityevamarthametadārabdhavyameva ||
icchārthebhyo vibhāṣā vartamāne || 3.3.160 ||
aśyāditi | `vaśa kāntau' adādiḥ grahivyādinā samprasāraṇam ||
vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭasaṃpraśnaprārthaneṣu liṅ‌ || 3.3.161 ||
vidhiḥ preraṇamiti | bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya kvacitpravartanamājñāpanamityarthaḥ | niyogato'vaśyambhāvena yatkaraṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ tannimantraṇam, sa nimantraṇasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ | avaśyakarttavye, śrāddhabhojanādau dauhitrādeḥ pravarttaneti yāvat‌, śrāddhe hi nimantrito dauhitrādirabhuñjānaḥ pratyavaiti | kāmacārakaraṇamiti | kāmacāra icchāpravṛttistayā yatkaraṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ tadāmantraṇam, tadviṣayamāmantraṇamityarthaḥ | yatrānanuṣṭhāne'pi na pratyavāyastatra pravarttaneti yāvat‌ | kalyāṇādau hyāmantrito'bhuñjāno'pi na pratyavaiti | adhīṣṭamiti | adhipūrvādicchaternapuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ | puṃlliṅgena pāṭhastvayuktaḥ | satkārapūrvako vyāpāra iti | gurvāderārīdhyasya vyāpāraṇetyarthaḥ, ṇyantāderac‌ | idaṃ vā karttavyamidaṃ vā karttavyamityeva bhūtavicāraṇāsampradhāraṇam | yathedamiha sampradhāryate iti yācñā prasiddhā |
nyāyavyutpādanārthaṃ ca prapañcārthamathāpi vā |
vidhyādīnāmupadānaṃ caturṇāmapaditaḥ kṛtam ||
asti pravartanārūpamanusyūtaṃ caturṣvapi |
tatraiva liṅ‌ vidhātavyaḥ kiṃ bhedasya vivakṣayā ||
ayaṃ vidhyādiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaḥ, prakṛtyatheviśeṣaṇam, pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ veti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | tatrādye pakṣe vidhyādiṣu vattamānāddhātorityarthaḥ syāt‌, tataśca yatra prakṛtireva vidhyādīnācaṣṭe tatraiva syāt‌---vidadhyānnimantrayeta, āmantrayeta, adhīcchet, saṃpracchet‌, prārthayeteti; tatrāpi prakṛtyarthā bhāvakarmakarttāraścetyetāvadagamyeta, na prakṛtyarthavyatirekeṇāparaṃ vidhyādikam | yathā cecchārthebhyaḥ `vibhāṣā varttamāne' ityatra liṅi icchediti laḍādayaśca na syuḥ; anena liṅā bādhitatvāt‌ | dvitīye nāprāptepu bhāvakarmakartṛpu vidhyādayo'rthā niddaśyamānāsteṣāṃ bādhakāḥ syuriti liṅā kartrādīnāmabhidhānaṃ na syāt‌, dvivacanabahuvacanānupapattiśca, vidhyādīnāmekatvāt | tṛtīye tu yatra prakṛtireva vidhyādīnācaṣṭe tatra na syāt‌---vidadhyānnimantrayeteti, na hyatra prakṛtyarthādanye tadviśeṣaṇabhūtā vidhyādayaḥ santi | caturthe tu vidhyādīnāṃ kartrādīnāṃ ca spaṣṭa eva bheda iti doṣābhāva iti tamevāśrayati---vidhyādayaścaita iti | vidhyādiviśiṣṭeṣviti | vidhyādayaḥ pravarttanāviśeṣāstairviśiṣṭeṣu pravatiteṣvityarthaḥ | sampraśnaprārthanayostu sampṛcchyamāne prārthyamāne ca karttari | nanu ca prakṛtyā yo'rtho nābhidhīyate tatraiva pratyayena bhāvyam, na tu prakṛtyābhihite; `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' iti nyāyāt‌, tataścāsminnapi pakṣe vidadhyādityādau tadavastha evāprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi santyevātra vyatiriktā vidhyādayo viṣayabhedāt‌, tathā hi---śrāddhe māṃ nimantrayeta bhavāniti matkarmakaṃ nimantraṇaṃ tavānuṣṭheyamityarthaḥ, tatra prakṛtyabhihitaṃ nimantraṇaṃ bhojanaviṣayam, liṅabhihitaṃ tu nimantraṇaviṣayamiti vispaṣṭa eva nimantraṇabhedaḥ | yathaiṣitumicchatīti kālasādhanabhedādicchayorbhedāśrayo yogastadvat | evaṃ vidhyādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'pi nātīva doṣaḥ | āmantraṇe iha bhavān bhuñjīteti | yadīcchatītyarthaḥ | adhyepyāmaha ityapapāṭho'yam; na hīcchateretadrūpaṃ sambhavati, iṣyatirapi parasmaipadī, guṇaśca śyani durlabhaḥ; iṅaścātrārtho nāsti, sūtre cādhīṣṭeti iṅ‌ na prayuktaḥ, tasmādadhīcchāma iti pāṭhaḥ | upanayeteti | ācāryakaraṇa ātmanepadam ||
loṭ‌ ca || 3.3.162 ||
yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti | uttaratra loṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syālliṅo mā bhūditi | adhyayai iti | iṭ‌, uttamaikavacanam, ṭeretvam, `eta ai', `āhuttamasya picca' ityāḍāgamaḥ, `āṭaśca' iti vṛddhiḥ, prakṛterguṇāyādeśau ||
praiṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca || 3.3.163 ||
kṛtya iti | `vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ' iti kyap‌ | bhavān‌ hi preṣita ityādirvākyaśeṣaḥ sarveṣvevodāharaṇeṣu yojyaḥ |
na sāmānyeneti | bhāvakarmaṇorityupalakṣaṇam; bhavyageyādīnāṃ karttaryapi bhāvāt‌ | evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayatīti | `praiṣādiṣveva kṛtyā bhavanti nānyatra' iti niyamārthaṃ caitanna bhavati, aniṣṭatvāt‌ | anyatrāpikṛtyādṛśyante---tṛṇenaśoṣyam, budhena bodhyamiti, agnistokaṃ tṛṇena dīpanīya iti | vastusvarūpakathanametat, na tvatra praiṣādipratītiḥ | adhikārātpareṇeti | enapā yoge pañcamī mṛgyā | nāvaśyamiti | kvacidbhavati, kvacinnetyarthaḥ |
ko viśeṣa iti | vidhiḥ preraṇamiti pūrvatra vyākhyātatvāt‌ nāstyeva bheda iti praśnaḥ | yadyaviśeṣaḥ, kathaṃ dvandvanirdeśa iti cet ? śabdarūpasyābhidheyatvāt‌ | `ko viśeṣaḥ' iti ko'nayoḥ śabdayoviśeṣo'bhidheya ityarthaḥ | keciditi | evamāmantraṇātisargayorapi viśeṣo jñeyaḥ | keciditi vacanādapare'nayorviseṣaṃ necchantītyuktaṃ bhavati | teṣāmapi praiṣātisargagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva, tatraiva kṛtyā yathā syuriti | `prāptakāle ca' iti hyukte nimantraṇādāvapi kṛtyāḥ syuḥ | cakāreṇa loḍapyanukarṣaṇīyaḥ---prāptakāle yathā syāditi ||
liṅ‌ cordhvamauhūrtike || 3.3.164 ||
cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti | loṭ‌, kṛtyāśca ||
sme loṭ‌ || 3.3.165 ||
