adhīṣṭe ca || 3.3.166 ||
aṅga sma rājanniti | aṅgaśabdo'nunaye | brāhmaṇānāmevādhyāpanaṃ vṛttirato rājannityabhyarhitetyarthaḥ ||
kālasamayavelāsu tumun‌ || 3.3.167 ||
praiṣādigrahaṇaṃ sambaddhyate iti | na ceha praiṣādayo gamyanta iti bhāvaḥ | iha kasmāditi | kālo bhojanasyeti | tasmād‌bhuṅ‌ktāṃ bhavāniti vākyārthaḥ, tena gamyate'tra praiṣa iti praśnaḥ | vāsarūpavidhineti | nanu praiṣādiṣu kṛtyavidhānāt‌ stryadhikārātpareṇa vāsarūpavidhiranāstīti jñāpitam ? tatrāha---uktamiti | anityatvameva tatra jñāpitaṃ na sarvathābhāva ityarthaḥ | paryāyopādānaṃ paryāyāntaravivṛttyartham | anye tvāhuḥ---avasaro bhoktumityādāvapi tumun‌ dṛśyate, `vyupayoḥ śeteḥ' ityatra rājānamupaśayituṃ paryāya iti prayuktovṛttikāreṇa | tasmādarthagrahaṇārthaṃ paryāyopādānam, yathā---`nimittakāraṇahetuṣu' ityatreti ||
liṅ‌ yadi || 3.3.168 ||
tumuno'pavāda iti | kartṛkarmaṇoḥ sāvakāśo'pi liṅ‌ pratipadavidherbalīyastvātparatvācca bhāve tumuno bādhaka ityarthaḥ ||
arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca || 3.3.169 ||
arhatītyarha iti | pacādyac‌ | tadyogya iti | tacchabdena dhātvarthaḥ parāmṛśyate | arhe karttari gamyamāna iti | kvacidvācye, kvacidgamyamāna ityubhayathānugrahāya gamyamāna ityuktam | kvacid‌ vācye gamyamāne veti pāṭhaḥ, tatra yathāsambhavamityanvayaḥ | tatra tṛc‌ ajaryakupyādiṣu, kṛtyāśca vācyatve bhavanti; liṅ‌ bhavyageyādiṣu, kṛtyāścobhayatra bhavanti | atha kasmāt‌ `kṛtyatṛcau' iti sūtre kṛtyabhedavivakṣayā bahuvacanam, iha tu sāmānyavivakṣayā dvivacanam ? kvacittu vṛttāvapi bahuvacanameva paṭhyate | tena bādhā mā bhūditi | vāsarūpavidhiśca nāvaśyaṃ bhavatītyanantaramevoktam ||
āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ || 3.3.170 ||
avaśyaṃ bhāva āvaśyakamiti | manojñāditvād‌ vuñ‌, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ | upādhiriti | pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ | nopapadamiti | `śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi', `senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyasca' iti nirdeśāt‌ | upapadatve hi kevalāṇṇinirna syāt‌, tatsāhacaryādādhamarṇyamapyupādhireva, nopapadam | śataṃ dāyīti | `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭīpratiṣedhād‌ dvitīyaiva bhavati ||
kṛtyaśca || 3.3.171 ||
bhavyageyādayaḥ kartṛvācakāḥ kṛtyā iti | bhavyageyādiṣvavayatvena sthitāḥ kṛtyā ityarthaḥ | ādiśabdena na bhavyageyādisūtranirddiṣṭānāmeva grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? ajaryarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāvyathyādīnāmapi grahaṇam | yogavibhāga uttarātheḥ ||
śaki liṅ‌ ca || 3.3.172 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti | nopapadam, `kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe' iti liṅgāt‌, upapadatve hi kevalau kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe na sambhavataḥ | bhavānkhalu śakta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ sarveṣu yojyaḥ | liṅā bādhā mā bhūditi | striyāḥ pareṇa vāsarūpavidheranityatvālliṅā bādhāśaṅkā | `parājesoḍhaḥ' ityatrāsoḍho yo'rthaḥ----soḍhuṃ na śakyata iti | śakyārthe ktapratyayo vyākhyātaḥ sa `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti vā, vāsarūpavidhinā vā samarthanīyaḥ ||
āśiṣi liṅ‌loṭau || 3.3.173 ||
āśīrviśaṣṭa ityāśāsyamāna ityarthaḥ | vidhyādisūtra evāśīrgrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam, `sme loṭ' ityādiviṣaye'pi paratvādeṣa vidhiryathā syāditi | avaśyaṃ cottarārthamihāśīrgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ||
kticktau ca saṃjñāyām || 3.3.174 ||
tantiriti | `anudāttopadeśa' ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ prāpanoti, `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' iti dīrghatvaṃ ca, tadubhayamapi na bhavati; `na ktici dīrghaśca' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ | sātiriti | sanaḥ ktici `lopaścāsyānyatarasyām' ityātvam | kticaścakāraścintyaprayojanaḥ; `na ktici dīrghaśca' ityatra ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā ktino nivṛtteḥ siddhatvāt‌ ||
smottare laṅ‌ ca || 3.3.175 ||
atrottaraśabda ādikyavacano na digvacanaḥ, tena pūrvabhūte'pi smaśabde bhavati, taddarśitam---smaśabdasahita iti ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ tṛtīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
<3.4>
atha tṛtīyādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ || 3.4.1 ||
prayoge svārthābhidhānavyagrayordhātvoḥ paraspareṇa sambandhābhāvādupacaritavṛttiratra dātuśabda ityāha---dhātvarthe dhātuśabda iti | dhātvarthānāṃ sambandho dhātusambandha iti | sambandhasyānekādhiṣṭhānatvāt‌ vṛttāvapi saṃkhyāviśeṣo'vagamyata iti bhāvaḥ | sakalaviṣayāpekṣayā ca bahuvacanam | ekaikaṃ vivakṣāyāṃ tu dhātvarthayoḥ sambandha iti draṣṭavyam | yadi tu karmatvaṃ samānakartṛkatvaṃ ca dhātorarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamitivaddhātvorevārthadvārakaḥ sambandha āśrīyeta, iha tu na syāt‌---gomānāsīt‌, gomān‌ bhaviteti, dvayorhi prayujyamānayoḥ sambandho bhavati, na cātra vartamānakāle'stiḥ prayujyate | kīdṛśaḥ punarayaṃ dhātusambandhaḥ ? ityāha---viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti | tatra tiṅantavācyo'rtho viśeṣyaṃ tatpradhānatvādvākyasya; subantavācyastu viśeṣaṇam, kārakasya kriyāṃ prati guṇabhāvāt‌ | ayathākāloktā apīti | yasminkāle vihitāstato'nyatrāpi prayuktā ityarthaḥ | etena kālamātrasyātra bādhaḥ, na tūpapadopādhiprakṛtipratyayārthānāmiti darśayati | etacca `varttamānasāmīpye' ityārabhya prāyeṇa kālānyatvapratipādanāllabhyate | agniṣṭomayājīti bhūtakāla iti | bhūtaḥ kālo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, etena bhaviṣyatkāla iti vyākhyātam | tatreti | tayormadhye | bhūtakālo'gniṣṭomayājītyevaśabdo bhaviṣyatkālena janitetyanena sambaddhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati | ayamapi bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sansādhurbhavatītyarthaḥ | atha vā---svayamapi bhaviṣyatkālenā bhisambaddhyamānaḥ, svakālaparityāgena bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sannityarthaḥ | ayaṃ hyatrārthaḥ---puttro'sya janitā sa cāgniṣṭomena yaṣṭeti, tatra yadi bhūtakāla eva ṇiniravatiṣṭhena tadā yāgasya bhaviṣyattāvagamo na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | evamitarayorapyudāharaṇayordraṣṭavyam | atha viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati, bhaviṣyatkālo bhūtakālenābhisambaddhyamānaḥ svakālaparityāgena bhūte sādhurbhavati, tataścāgniṣṭomayājyasya puttro jāta ityayaṃ vākyārtha iti ? tatrāha-viśeṣaṇaṃ guṇatvāditi | pradhānānuvarttā guṇaḥ, na guṇānuvatiṃ pradhānam, ubhayośca svakālaniṣṭhayoḥ smbandhānupapattiriti pradhānānurodhena guṇasya kālaparityāga ityarthaḥ |
pratyayādhikāra iti | yadyapi prakṛtaḥ pratyayaśabdaḥ svarūpapadārthakaḥ, tathāpīha saṃjñenāmanirdeśātsaṃjñipadārthako vijñāsyata iti bhāvaḥ | adhātvadhikāravihitā apīti | anyathā prakṛtānāṃ dhātupratyayānāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | pratyayagrahaṇāttu sarvaparigrahārthāttaddhitānāmapi kālāntare'pi sādhutvaṃ bhavati | gomānāsīt‌, gomānbhaviteti | `tadasyāstyasmin‌' iti matuppratyayo varttamānasattāviśiṣṭena prakṛtyarthena viśiṣṭe'rthe vihitaḥ | dhātusambandhe tu prakṛtyarthasya bhūtabhaviṣyatve'pi sādhurbhavati | tataścāyamatrārthaḥ---gāvo'syāsan‌ gomānāsīt‌, gāvo'sya bhavitāraḥ gomān‌ bhaviteti | dhātvadhikārādeva dhātugrahaṇe siddhe punardhātugrahaṇaṃ dhātuviśeṣaparigrahārtham, tenāstibhūjanisambandhe tadviśeṣaṇānāmeva kālānyatvena sādhutvaṃ bhavatīti kecit‌ | na cāyaṃ pakṣo bhāṣye siddhāntatvena sthāpitaḥ, tasmādaviśeṣeṇa bhavatītyanye | dṛśyate cānyatrāpi kālānyatvalam---`sāṭopamurvīmaniśaṃ nadanto ye plāvayiṣyanti samantato'mī' ityatra | nadanta iti varttamānakālaḥ plāvayiṣyantīti avarttamānenābhisambaddhyamāno bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sampadyate |
sūtrapratyakhyānaṃ tu---agniṣṭomayājīti bhūta eva ṇiniḥ, janitetyetatsambandhāttu kevalaṃ vyapadeśasya bhāvitvapratītiḥ, asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayetivat | tataśca bhāvivyapadeśavijñānādviśeṣaṇasya kālānyatvaṃ vākyārthavaśādasatyapi sūtrārambhe pratyeṣyate | avaśyaṃ ca svakāla eva pratyayavidhireṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā bhāvikṛtyamāsīdityatra bhāviśabdasya bhūtakālatve bhāvyāsīcchabdayoḥ paryāyatvādyugapatprayogo na syāt‌ | tasmādidānīmāsīdityevaṃ tatrārthaḥ | gomānāsīdityatrāpi devadattasya vidhamānatve'pi gomadrūpasyātītatvād‌ bhūtapratyayaḥ | tatrārthād‌ gavāmapyatītatvaṃ pratīyate, gomacchabdastu svamahimnā varttamānasattāviśiṣṭameva prakṛtyarthamāha ||
kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ‌ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ || 3.4.2 ||
dhātusambandha iti varttata iti | anuprayogadhātunā ca sambandhaḥ | kvacittvayaṃ grantho na paṭhyate | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi | upapadatvāśaṅkāṃ nirasyati | vyākhyānāccopapadatvābhāvaḥ | samabhihāraviśaṣṭakriyāvacanāditi | kriyādharme samabhihāramātre dhātorvṛttyasambhavādetaduktam | atra yadi `loṭo hisvau' iti vacanāttasyaiva hisvau syātām, tadā sāmānyavihitānāṃ tiṅāṃ śatṛśānaubhyāmiva hisvābhyāṃ bādhā syāt‌, tatastadhvamorloṭ‌sthānikayorabhāvāt‌ `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' iti tayoḥ sthānitvenopādānamanupapannamiti loṭ‌śabdena tadādeśānāṃ grahaṇamityupalakṣyate | astu tathā, ko doṣaḥ ? iha hi tipsip‌mipāṃ sthāne vihitasya heḥ sthānivadbhāvena pittvānṅittvābhāvāllunīhitīttvaṃ na syāt‌, brūhīti `bruva īṭ‌' syāt‌, tṛṇḍhīti `tṛṇaha im' syāt‌, anudāttatvaṃ ca heḥ prasajyeta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `serhyapicca' ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate, tatsāmarthyād‌ `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti nāśrīyate, serhirbhavati apicca bhavati yāvānkaściddhirnāmeti | yau tarhyuttamādeśau hisvau, taroyarāḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti---lunīhilunīhītyevāhaṃ lunāmi, adhīṣvādhīdhvetyevāhamadhīya iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āṭi kṛte sāṭ‌kasyādeśau bhaviṣyataḥ, sakṛtpravṛttyā lakṣaṇasya caritārthatvāt‌ | hisvayoḥ punarāṭ‌ na bhaviṣyati, iha hyāṭ‌ kriyātāṃ hisvāviti sampradhāraṇāyāmubhayoranityayoḥ `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvanvidhiranityo bhavati' iti paratvādāṭi kṛte sāṭ‌kasya hisvāviti siddhamiṣṭam | evamapi heryogavibhāgena pittvābhāve'pi svaśabdasyottamādeśasya pittvādbhuṅ‌kṣvabhuṅ‌kṣvetyevāhaṃ bhuñje ityatra `śnasorallopaḥ' ityakāralopo na prāpnoti, brūṣvabrūpvetyevāhaṃ bruve `bruva īṭ‌' prāpnoti, sarveṣāṃ ca tiṅāṃ dvāvapi hisvau paryāyeṇa syātāṃ na tu `parasmaipadānāṃ hiḥ, itareṣaāṃ svaḥ' iti niyāmakamasti | tasmād‌duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣa iti matvā lakārasyaivādeśau hisvāvāśrayaṇīyāviti darśayati | tasya ca loṭa iti | nanvasminpakṣe `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityanupapannamityuktaṃ tatrāha---tadhvambhāvinastu vā bhavati iti | mukhyārthāsambhave tadhvambhāvī loḍeva tathocyate ityarthaḥ |
yadi tarhi loṭa eva hisvāvādeśau na tadādeśānām, `laḥ parasmaipadam' iti dvayorapi parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt‌, tataśca dvāvapi parasmaipadibhya eva syātām | tiṅ‌kṣvasanniveśācca tadantasya tiṅantatā na syāt‌, tataśca `tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto na prāpnoti | hisvayośca kṛttvāttadantasya śatṛśānajantasyaiva prātipadikatvātsvādyutpattiḥ prāpnoti, tatra ca vibhaktisaṃjñakahisvasadṛśatvādanayorhisvayoḥ `vibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśca nipātāḥ' `nipāto'vyayam' ityavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ yadyapi vibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi tataḥ parasya `tiṅ‌ṅatiṅa' iti nighātaḥ prāpnoti, dvāvapi ca kartaryeva syātām, na tu svādeśo bhāvakarmakartṛṣu syāt‌ | tasmādayamapi pakṣo duṣṭa eva, tatrāha---loḍityeveti | etena dvitīyayoge prathamāntasya loḍ‌grahaṇasyānuvṛtti darśayati | tatra ca sāmānādhikaraṇyena loḍityanena hisvau viśeṣyete, na ṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇāmena, ca na hisvau loṭau bhavataḥ; ucyate cedaṃ loṭo hisvāviti, tataśca dharmātideśo vijñāyate, tadāha---loḍ‌dharmāṇau tau bhavata ityartha iti | atra ca loṭ‌śabdena loṭ‌saṃbandhinau hisvāvucyete mukhyaloṭ‌saṃbandhino dharmasyātideśyasyāsambhavātprasiddhau loṭ‌saṃbandhinau yau hisvau, `serhyapicca' `savābhyāṃ vāmau' iti vihitau, taddharmāṇāvityarthaḥ | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? taddarśayati---teneti | tayohi parasmaipadātmanepadatvaṃ bhedena vyavasthitam---heḥ parasmaipadatvam, svasyātmanepadatvamiti | atastaddharmātideśādihāpi tadubhayaṃ bhedena, vyavatiṣṭhate, bhedena bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | tiṅ‌tvaṃ ca bhavatīti | tathā ca---hītyasya karttā vācyaḥ, svaśabdasya tu bhāvakarmakarttāraḥ | puruṣaikavacanasaṃjñe tu vidhānasāmarthyānna bhavataḥ, yadi hi te api syātām, hisvayoranena vidhānamanupapannaṃ syād‌; vacanāntareṇaiva tayostādṛśayoḥ siddhatvāt‌ |
lunīhi lunīhītyādi | punaḥ punarlavanamayaṃ karotītyādirarthaḥ | tatra ca loḍantaṃ punaḥ punarlavanamāha, anuprayogadhātustu kṛtiṃ tadviṣayāṃ vadan‌ abhivyanakti, saṃmugdha tadgataṃ sādhanādikam | evaṃ ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvād‌ dhātusambandha upapadyate, ityevaśabdau, loḍantānuprayogayoḥ sambandhārthau, ayantvamahaṃśabdāḥ puruṣaviśeṣābhivyaktihetavaḥ | atha veti | `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityasya phalaṃ darśayati |
alāvīditi | luṅ‌, sici vṛddhiḥ, sica iṭ‌, tipaḥ `astisico'pṛkte' itīṭ‌, `iṭa īṭi' iti sico lopaḥ, `sijlopa ekādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ' iti savarṇadīrghatvam | evaṃ madhyamottamayorudāhāryamiti | lunīhi tunīhītyeva tvamalāvīḥ alāviṣṭamalāviṣṭa | athā vā lunīta lunītetyeva yūyamalāviṣṭa | lunīhi lunīhītyevāhamalaviṣam‌ alāviṣva alāviṣma | evaṃ madhyamottamayorapīti | lunīhi lunīhītyeva tvaṃ laviṣyasi laviṣyathaḥ laviṣyatha | atha vā lunīta lunītetyeva yūyaṃ laviṣyatha | lunīhi lunīhītyevāhaṃ laviṣyāmi laviṣyāvaḥ laviṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ sarveṣu lakāreṣūdāhāryamiti | lunīhilunīhītyevāyamalunāt‌ lunātu lunīyāt lūyāt‌ lulāva lavitā laviṣyati alaviṣyat‌; adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevāyamadhyaita adhītām adhīyīta adhyeṣīṣṭa adhijage adhyagīṣṭa adhyaiṣṭa adhyetā adhyaiṣyata adhyeṣyate | karmaṇi---lūyasva lūyasvetyevāyaṃ kedāro lūyata ityādi | bhāve tu prasiddhaḥ svaśabdo dṛṣṭo na veti cintyam |
athodāharaṇeṣu kathaṃ dvirvacanam, yāvatā kriyāsamabhihāraṃ dyotayituṃ dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, sa cātra tasminneva vidhīyamānena loṭaiva dyotitaḥ, atha dyotite'pi tasmin‌ `kriyāsamabhihāre dve bhavataḥ' iti vacanasāmarthyādatra dvirvacanaṃ yaṅante'pi prāpnoti, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? tatrāha---kriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktāviti | `laḥ karmaṇi ca' iti vacanādbhāvakarmakarttāro'sya vācyāḥ, samabhihārastu dvirvacanenaiva dyotyaḥ, yaṅastu na kiñcidanyadvācyaṃ dyotyaṃ vā vidyate iti tenaiva kriyāsamabhihārasya dyotitatvād‌ dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | nanu ca santu bhāvakarmakarttāro'sya vācyāḥ, samabhihāro'pyupādhitvena śrutaḥ, so'pi loṭo dyotyo bhavatu, yathā---laḍādiṣu varttamānādayaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyasati dvirvacane śuddhasya loṭo'sya ca sādhāraṇaṃ rūpamiti samabhihārābhivyaktaye'vaśyaṃ dvirvacanamapekṣyate | śabdaśaktivaicitryaṃ cātra hetuḥ, yathā strītvaṃ kvacidekenaiva pratyayena dyotyate, kvacid‌ dvābhyām, kvacit‌ dṛṣadityādo prātipadikenaivetyalaṃ prabandhena ||
samuccaye'nyatarasyām || 3.4.3 ||
`samuccaye' iti samānyoktāvapi kriyāsamuccaya eva dṛśyate, dhātoḥ pratyayavidhānādityāha---anekākrayādhyāhāraḥ samuccaya iti | anekāsāṃ kriyāṇāmekasmin‌ sambandhini nicīyamānatetyarthaḥ | etenaikakriyāviṣayātsamabhihārātsamuccayasya bhedo darśitaḥ | dhātoḥ kriyāvācitvātkriyādharme samuccayamātre vṛttirna bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha---samuccīyamānakriyāvacanāditi | ekasminsādhane yāḥ kriyāḥ samuccīyante tadvācibhyo dhātubhyaḥ pratya ityarthaḥ |
bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādi | bhrāṣṭrāṭanādīni karotītyarthaḥ | tatrānuprayujyamāno dhātuḥ sādhanabhedena bhinneṣvaṭaneṣvanuvartamānaṃ kṛtivyāpāraṃ vadam̐stadgatāni sādhanādīni prikāśayatīti parasparasambandhaḥ | bhrāṣṭram‌-culli, khasya dūraṃ khadūram-apavarakam, sthālyaḥ prakṣālitā yatra nidhāya pidhīyante tatsthālyapidhānam |
atha veti | prathamenāthavāśabdena `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' ityasya vyāpāraṃ darśayati, dvitīyenānyatarasyāṅgrahaṇasya | evaṃ dvitīye'pyudāharaṇe draṣṭavyam ||
yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ pūrvasmin‌ || 3.4.4 ||
yathāvidhīti | padārthanativṛttau `yathārthe yadavyayam' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, anuprayoga ityanuśabdo dhātvarthānuvādī, na paścādbhāvenānantarye'rthe | tena pūrvavyavahitaprayogo'pi bhavati | pūrvasminniti vacanaṃ vispaṣṭārtham | samuccaye hi sāmānyavacanasyānuprayogaṃ vakṣyati, tena tato'nyatrāyaṃ vidhiranyaśca viṣayaḥ pūrvameva loḍ‌vidhānam | dhātusambandhe pratyayavidhānāditi | nanu ca hisvāntametadanabhivyaktapadārthakam, sakhyākālapuruṣāṇāmanabhivyaktatvāt‌, atastadarthābhivyaktyarthabhevānuprayogaḥ siddhaḥ ? astvevam, kimetāvatā vṛttikārokto heturna bhavati | atha vā yāvantamarthamabhivyaṅ‌ktuṃ hisvāntaṃ samarthaṃ tāvato vivakṣāyāmanuprayogāsiddhi matvaivamuktam | yathāvidhyartha vacanamiti | nanu ca `samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya' iti vakṣyati, tatra niyamo vijñāsyate---samuccaya eva dhātvantarasyānuprayoga iti, tataśca kriyāsamabhihāre yathāvidhyanuyogo bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ manyate---samuccaye sāmānyavacanasyaivānuprayoga iti niyamādanyatra dhātvantarasyāpi syāditi chinattīti nānuprayujyata iti | pacatītyādebhinnārthasya tvaprasaṅgaḥ, loḍantenānanvayāt | samānārthasya tu sambhavati sambandhaḥ, yathā--tasyaiva | evaṃ sāmānyavacanasya karotyāderapyanuprayogaprasaṅgaḥ, tasyāpi hi sannihetaloḍantavācye viśeṣe paryavasānātsambhavatyevānvayaḥ | nanu caikasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayogo na dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāśca bhavati, etacca `kṛñjānuprayujyate' ityatra vyākhyātam, tatra yathā gavāṃ svāmī aśveṣu ceti na bhavati, tathehāpi yenaiva dhātunā loṭ‌prayogaḥ prārabdhastenaivāsau samāpayiṣyate ? na; asyāpi nyāyasya vede loke ca vyabhicārāt‌ | vede tāvat‌---indrāya rājñe sūkara iti caturthoprayogaprakaraṇe kṣipraśyenasya varttikā te dhāturiti ṣaṣṭhī, mayuḥ prājāpatya iti taddhitaśca devatāsambandhe dṛśyate | loke'pi---sasnuḥ, payaḥ papuriti liṭā sahānenijuriti laṅ‌ prayuktaḥ | tasmādārabhyamevaitat ||
samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya || 3.4.5 ||
nanu ca hisvāntasyānabhivyaktapadārthakatvāddhātusambandhe pratyayavidhānāccānuprayogaḥ siddhaḥ, nārtha etena ? tatrāha---sarvaviśeṣeti | asatyasminyato dhātorloḍ‌vihitaḥ sa tasyānuprayujyeta | evamapi hisvāntārthasyābhivyaktirbhavatyeva dhātusambandhaścopapadyate |
nanu ca sarveṣu viśeṣeṣu yadanugataṃ sāmaptnyaṃ tadvācino'nuprayoge'pi tasya sāmānyasya sannihiteṣu viśeṣeṣu paryavasānādarthābhivyaktiśca sarveṣāṃ bhavati, dhātusambandhaśca | tatra sāmānyavacanasyaikasyānuprayogo'stu, bahūnāṃ viśeṣavācināṃ veti sampradhāraṇāyāmekasyaiva bhaviṣyati, laghutvāttatrāha---lāghavaṃ ceti | anyathā tarudrumādīnāmeva prayogaḥ syāt‌, na vanaspatyādiśabdānāmiti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādau tasyaivānuprayogātkathaṃ sāmānyavacanatā ? tatrāha---bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādi | kārakabhedāt‌ kriyābhede satīti | bhedanibandhanaḥ samuccayo'pyevamevātropapādyaḥ ||
chandasi luṅ‌laṅ‌liṭaḥ || 3.4.6 ||
udāharaṇeṣu dhātusambandho mṛgyaḥ | akaraditi | `kṛmṛdṛruhibhyaśchandasi' iti cleraṅādeśaḥ, `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' ||
liṅarthe leṭ‌ || 3.4.7 ||
joṣiṣaditi | `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' anudāttet‌, vyatyayena parasmaipadam, `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu', `leṭo'ḍāṭau' iti tipo'ḍāgamaḥ, `sibbahulaṃ leṭi' iti sip‌, iḍāgamaḥ | tāriṣaditi | sibvidhau bahulaṃ ṇidvadbhāva uktaḥ, tato vṛddhiḥ | patātīti | `patlṛ gatau', tipa āḍāgamaḥ ||
upasaṃvādāśaṅkayośca || 3.4.8 ||
yadi me bhavānityādinopasaṃvādasya svarūpaṃ darśayati | kāraṇata ityādinā | śaṅkāyāḥ anusaraṇamanugamanamityarthaḥ | ahamevetyādi | tripuravijaye devaiḥ prarthitasya devasyaitadvacanam | `īśa aiśvarye', uttamaikavacanamiṭ‌, ṭeretvam, `vaitonyatra' ityaikāraḥ | paśavo dvipādaścatuṣpādaśca | `vāyuṃ devā abruvansomaṃ rājānaṃ hanāmeti, so'bravīdūraṃ vṛṇai, madagrā eva vo grahā gṛhāyāntai iti | mad‌graho'graṃ prathamaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ, graheḥ karmaṇyātmanepadaṃ yak‌, grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam, jhasyāḍāgamaḥ, pūrvavadaityam | `devāḥ somamaghnan‌, so'pūyadaśakyatāmāgamat‌, te vāyumabruvan‌ imaṃ naḥ svadayeti, so'bravīdvaraṃ vṛṇai, maddevatānyeva vaḥ pātrāṇyucyāntai iti | ahaṃ devatā yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni | ucyāntai iti vaceḥ `vacisvapi' ityādinā samprasāraṇam, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌ | nejjihyāyanta iti | icchabda āśaṅkāṃ dyotayati | jihmacaraṇena narakapātaḥ sambhāvyate, sa mā bhūdityarthaḥ | jihmam-kuṭilaṃ pāpam, `chandasi parecchāyām' iti kyac‌, `aśvāghasyāt' iti yogavibhāgonātvam | vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ darśitam | jihmācaraṇeneti | na punarācāre upamānādanyatra kyajasti | hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ | liṅartha evāyamiti | hetuhetumadbhāve, katham ? upasaṃvāde tāvatkaraṇaṃ hetuḥ, dānaṃ hetumat‌; anyathā yadi me bhavānidaṃ kuryāditi liṅ‌ na syāt‌, vibhāṣā tu liṅiti | ahamapi te idaṃ dāsyāmīti lṛṭ‌ | bhāṣye tu dadāterapi liṅ‌ prayuktaḥ | āśaṅkāpi kāraṇataḥ kāryānusaraṇam, tatra kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ, kāryaṃ hetumat‌ | athāpi karaṇamavadhiḥ, dānamavadhimadityavadhyavadhimadbhāva upasaṃvāde pratīyate, na hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, āśaṅkāyāmapi niścito hetuhetumadbhāvo nāstītyucyeta, tathāpi liṅ‌prayogasiddhaye'vaśyaṃ vaktavyo'tra hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, ato liṅartha evāyamityarthaḥ | nityārthaṃ tu vacanamiti | chandasi nityo'tra liṅ‌ dṛśyata iti manyate, tathāpi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā siddhamiti cettadeva tarhi vacanena jñāpyate ||
tumarthe sesenaseasenksekasenadhyaiadhyainkadhyaikadhyain‌śadhyaiśadhyaintavaitaveṅ‌ tavenaḥ || 3.4.9 ||
kathaṃ jñāyata iti | `kartari kṛt' iti vacanāt‌ bhāvastumartho nopapadyata iti praśnaḥ | apakarṣaḥ-apanayaḥ, svārthaśca dhātūnāṃ bhāva iti sādhyamānarūpaḥ | sa eva hi dhātuvācyo bhāvaḥ | ghañādivācyastu bhāvo dhātvarthavyatiriktaḥ siddhatārūpaḥ | pibadhyai iti | `yako bahulaṃ chandasi' iti luki pibādeśaḥ | mādayardhyai iti | yakaḥ prasaṅge vyatyayena śap‌ ||
dṛśe vikhye ca || 3.4.11 ||
yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||
īśvare tosunkasunau || 3.4.13 ||
vitṛda iti | `otṛdir‌ hiṃsānādarayoḥ' ||
kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ || 3.4.14 ||
kṛtyānāmartho bhākarmaṃṇī iti | yadyapi bhavyageyādiṣu karttāpyarthaḥ, vahyaṃ karaṇam, snānīyaṃ cūrṇityādiṣu karaṇādayaḥ; tathāpi na tatra kṛtyatvena kartrādiṣu vidhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? svarūpeṇa, ataḥ kṛtyatayā vidhānaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoreveti bhāvaḥ | didṛkṣeṇya iti | dṛśeḥ sannantātkenyaḥ | śuśrūṣeṇya iti | śrṛṇoteḥ | sayādisūtre'pīti | yena sayādayo vidhīyante tatra `tumarthe sesenase' ityatretyartaḥ | tasya tumarthādanyatreti | anyathā'nenaiva tumarthe bhāve'pi siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt‌ ||
avacakṣe ca || 3.4.15 ||
eśpratyaya iti | śitkaraṇaṃ sārvadhātukatvārtham, tena cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ‌ na bhavati ||
bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadicarihutamijanibhyastosun‌ || 3.4.16 ||
saṃsthānādīnāmavadhitvena lakṣaṇabhāvaḥ | ā samāpteriti | sampūrvo hi tiṣṭhatiḥ samāptau rūḍhaḥ; santiṣṭhate piṇ‍ḍapitṛyajña ityādau darśanāt‌ | ātāmitoriti | `tamu glānau' ||
alaṃkhalvāḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā || 3.4.18 ||
`tumarthe' ityeva | alaṃkṛtveti | `amaivāvyayena' iti niyamādupapadasamāsābhāvaḥ | na karttavyamityarthaḥ |
vāsarūpa iti cediti | pūrvaṃ tu praiṣādiṣu kṛtyānāṃ vacanena `stryadhikārādhūrdhvaṃ vāsarūpavidhirnāvaśyamasti' iti jñāpitatvādiha tadabhāvamabhipretya prāggrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktam ||
udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre || 3.4.19 ||
apamityeti | `meṅ‌ prāṇidāne' ktvo lyapi `gayateridanyatarasyām' itītvaṃ, hrasvasya tuk‌ | apūrvakālatvāditi | pūrva hyasau yācate paścādapamayate | yadā cāsmādvacanānmayateḥ ktvo bhavati tadā `samānakartṛkayoḥ' ityādinā yācane bhavati, anena bādhitatvāt‌, yathā---dvitīyadvirvacanena prathamadvirvacanam | anabhidhānādvā | meṅa ityādi | meṅo'yaṃ kṛtātvasya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na punaḥ `māṅ‌ māne' ityasya, tasya vyatihāre vṛttyasambhavādityarthaḥ | yadyevama , meṅa ityeva vaktavyam, tatrāyamapyartho vyatīhāragrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, tatrāha---jñāpanārthamiti | kiṃ jñāpyata ityāha---nānubandhakṛtamiti | prayojanamāha---teneti | yadyayamartho na jñāpyeta, tataḥ śrūyamāṇe pakāre daipa ātvaṃ na syāt; anejantatvāt‌, tataścādābiti pratiṣedhe tasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌, `dāp‌ lavane' ityasyaiva tu syāt‌ ||
parāvarayoge ca || 3.4.20 ||
parāvaraśabdayoḥ sambandhiśabdatvādyapadekṣaṃ parāvaratvam, tayoḥ pūrvaparayoreva parāvarābhyāṃ yogo gamyate, ityāha---pareṇa pūrvasyeti | pūrvaśabdenātrāvaro vivakṣitaḥ | aprāpya nadīmiti | nadyāḥ pūrvadeśa ityarthaḥ | tataśca nadī parā bhavatīti | paranadīyogena parvato viśeṣyati | atikramya parvatamiti | parvatasya parastādityarthaḥ | tataścāvaraḥ parvato bhavati tenāvaraparvatayogena nadī viśeṣyate | ayamapyapūrvakālārtha ārambhaḥ, atikramo'tra kīdṛśa iti cintyam ||
samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle || 3.4.21 ||
kriyāpekṣatvātkartṛbhāvasya dhātvadhikāre'pi tadarthasyaiva samānarktṛkatvaṃ vijñāyate, na dhātorityāha---samānaḥ karttā yayordhātvarthayoriti | kamānaśabdo'yamekavācī, tatreti nirddhāraṇe saptamīṃ darśayati | ṣaṣṭhyāmapi na doṣaḥ | saptamī tvāśritā | pūrvakāle dhātvarthe vartamānāditi | prābhākarāstu pūrvaprayujyamānāditi vyācakṣate, anuṣṭhāne paurvakālyaṃ nādriyante; tadbhāṣyavārttikavirodhādupekṣyam | uktaṃ hi---āsyaṃ vyādāya svapiti saṃmīlya hasatītyupasaṃkhyānamapūrvakālatvāditi | nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, sā ca pratikriyaṃ bhidyate, tatkutaḥ samānakartṛkatvam ? ityata āha---śaktiśaktimatoriti | iha samānakartṛkayoriti dvivacananirdeśaḥ kriyate, tena dvayoreva paurvakālye syāt, bahūnāṃna syāt‌, tatrāha---dvivacanamatantramiti | avaśyaṃ yena kenacidvavacanena nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, tatra samānakartṛkatvasya pūrvakālatvasya ca bhedādhiṣṭhānatvādbhedanibandhanayorvdivacanabahuvacanayoḥ prathamabhāvitvād‌ dvivacanaṃ prayuktam, na tvaitattantramityarthaḥ | evamapi lokavijñānānna siddhyati, tadyathā loke---amīṣāṃ brāhmaṇaānāṃ pūrva ānīyatām ityukte sarvapūrva evānīyate, evamihāpi sarvapūrvāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ prāpnoti, tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam---sarveṣāmevātra vraji prati paurvakālyam, snātvā vrajati bhuktvā vrajati pītvā vrajatīti | ākhyātavācyā hi kriyā viśeṣyatkātpradhānam, tena tāṃ prati sarvāsāṃ viśeṣaṇatvātparaspareṇāsambandhaḥ, taduktam---`guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvātsyāt‌' iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā prayogo'pyaniyato bhavati---snātvā bhuktvā pītvā vrajati, pītvā snātvā bhuktvā vrajatīti |
bhuktavati brāhmaṇa iti | nanu tumarthādhikārādbhāve ktvāpratyayaḥ, ktavatustu kartari ? evaṃ tarhyasminviṣaye bhāve na bhavatīti pratyudāharaṇatvaṃ vācyam, `śrīśailaśikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate' ityevamādīnāṃ kartṛbhedaviṣayāṇāṃ prayogāṇāmasādhutvameva | vrajati jalpati ceti | yaugapadyādiha pūrvakālatā nāsti | apūrvakālatvādi | pūrvaṃ hyasau svapiti paścād‌vyādadāti, yadaiva hasati tadaiva saṃmīlayati, na vā svapnasyāparakālatvāt‌, asyaṃ tvasau vyādāya muhūrttamapi svapiti saṃmīlya ca hasati, tataścottarakālabhāvistvāpahāsādyapekṣaṃ paurvakālyaṃ tadāśrayaśca pratyayaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati---pūrvaṃ bhuṅ‌kte, tato vrajatīti ? svaśabdenoktatvāt‌ | `vibhāṣāgre' ityanenāpi na bhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? sādhanapaurvākālyaviṣayāṇāmagryādīnāṃ tatra grahaṇam, anyebhyo bhoktṛbhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuktvā tato vrajatīti | iha tu vrajyapekṣaṃ bhojanasya yatpaurvakālyaṃ tatra ktvāpratyayaścodyate, tatpūrvaśabdenoktam | na ca vacanasāmarthyādukte'pi prasaṅgaḥ; sādhanapaurvakālyaviṣaye'gryādāvupapade caritāthetvāt‌ | kriyāviṣayatvācca kālavyavahārasya tad‌dvārakameva sādhanapaurvakālyaṃ draṣṭavyam | uktaṃ hi---
kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā | iti |
ihāsyate bhoktumiti vāsarūpeṇa laḍ‌ bhavati, yadā āseḥ ktvā bhavati tadā bhujerlaḍādaya eva bhavanti---āsitvā bhuṅ‌kta iti, na tu tumun‌ ; anabhidhānāt‌ | āsitvā bhoktumityukte prakramata ityādīnāṃ sambandhaḥ pratīyate ||
ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca || 3.4.22 ||
dvirvacanasahitāviti | kena punaratra dvirvacanamityāha---ābhīkṣṇaye dve bhavata ityupasaṅkhyānād‌ dvirvacanamiti | `nityavīpsayoḥ' ityatra tu vāmano vakṣyati---`tiṅ‌kṣu nityatā avyayakṛtsu ca' iti | tanmate nityagrahaṇādevātra dvirvacanam | pāyaṃpāyamiti | `āto yuk‌' ||
na yadyanākāṅ‌kṣe || 3.4.23 ||
anākāṅ‌kṣa iti | pacādyajantena nañsamāsaḥ, taddarśitam | nāparaṃ kiñcidākāṅ‌kṣate iti | ktvā tu pūrvasūtravihito'pīti | ṇamul‌ cetyuktam, tadapekṣaṃ pūrvatvamapiśabdādanantarasūtravihito'pi ābhīkṣṇyenābhīkṣṇye ca ktvāmātrasya pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ | etacca pūrvakāle yatprāpnoti tanna bhavatītyevaṃ prakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhavijñānāllabhyate ||
vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu || 3.4.24 ||
agraśabdo deśaviśeṣavacano'pyasti---prabhoragre bhuṅ‌kte iti, iha tu prathamaśabdasāhacaryātkālaviśeṣavācino grahaṇam | anukaraṇatvāccāgre iti vibhakterlugabhāvaḥ---asyavāmīyamiti yathā | āmīkṣṇya iti nānuvarttata iti | aprāptavibhāṣeyamityatreyaṃyuktiḥ | tadanuvṛttau hi pūrvasūtreṇa prāpte vibhāṣā syād‌, evaṃ ca bruvatā sādhanaporvakālyaviṣayā agryādaya ityuktaṃ bhavati | kriyāpaurvakālye hi agryādibhireva tasyoktatvādābhīkṣṇye'pi ktvāṇamuloraprāptiriti `ābhīkṣṇye' ityanuvṛttāvapyaprāptavibhāṣaiva syāt‌ | na ca dvirvacanamantareṇābhīkṣṇyaṃ dyotayituṃ śakyamiti na tad‌dyotanāyāpi ktvāṇamulorvidhānamupapadyate | nanvananuvartamāne'pyābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇe pūrvasūtrasyāvakāśo yatrāgryādayo na santi, asya tu yatrābhīkṣṇyaṃ nāsti so'vakāśaḥ; ābhīkṣṇye cāgryādiṣu ca satsūbhayaprasaṅge paratvādiyameva vibhāṣā prāpnotītyubhayatra vibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā ? evaṃ manyate---pūrvavipratiṣedhenābhīkṣṇye nitya eva vidhirbhavatīti---agrebhojaṃbhojaṃ vrajati, agrebhuktvābhuktvā vrajati | evaṃ pūrvaprathamayorapi draṣṭavyam | nanvevaṃ ṇamulyaprāpte ktvāpratyaye tu `samānakartṛkayoḥ' ityādinā prāpte satyayamārambha iti punarapyubhayatravibhāṣaiva yuktā ? naitadasti; saha vihitau yau ktvāṇamulau yadviṣaye vāsarūpavidherabhāvo jñāpayitumiṣṭaḥ, tāvanantarasūtravihitau ktvāṇamulāvabhipretyāprāptavibhāṣeyamucyate, na tu ktvāṇamulmātrapekṣayā | ktvāṇamulau pratyayau bhavata iti | kimarthaṃ punaḥ ktvā vidhīyate, yāvatā nābhīkṣmye'pi samānakartṛkayorityevāsau siddhaḥ ? satyam ; vibhāṣāgrahaṇena vāsarūpavidherabhāvo jñāpyata iti vakṣyati | na ca kevalaṃ ṇamulvidhau tadabhāvo jñāpayitumiṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ktvāsahitaṇamulvidhau | tasmāṇṇamulaḥ ktvāsahitasya vidhiryathā syāditi ṇamul‌ cetyanuvṛttyā ktvo'pyanuvādaḥ kriyate | evaṃ hi dvayoḥ saha vidhātumupādīyamānaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tādṛśa eva viṣaye vāsarūpavidherabhāvaṃ jñāpayatīti siddhamiṣṭam | agrebhojaṃ vrajatīti | anyebhyo bhoktṛbhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuktvā vrajatītyarthaḥ | āmīkṣṇye laḍādayo na bhavantīti | agre bhuṅ‌kte bhuṅ‌kte tato vrajatītyevaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
upapadasamāsaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti | prāptavibhāṣāyāmasyāmagryādīnāṃ pakṣe pratyayanivṛttau nimittatvam, na tu pratyayotpattau, tayoḥ `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca' ityanenāviśeṣeṇa vihitatvādityanupapadatvam | aprāptavibhāṣāyāṃ tvagryādīnāṃ pratyayotpattiṃ prati nimittatvānnimittasya copapadasaṃjñāvidhānādupapadasamāsaḥ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | amaiva yattulyavidhānamiti | etacca tatraiva vyākhyātam ||
karmaṇyākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ‌ || 3.4.25 ||
udāharaṇeṣu karotiruccāraṇe varttate, tasya śabdātmakameva karma bhavati | tatra corādiśabdāḥ śabdapradhānāḥ | coraṅkāram | ko'theḥ ? coraśabdamuccāryetyarthaḥ, tadāha---coro'sītyādi | corakaraṇamiti | coraśabdoccāraṇam | ākrośasampādanārthamiti | ninditaśabdoccāraṇamantareṇa tasya sampādayituśakyatvāt | na tvasāviti | na hi coro'sīti vacanena coraḥ kriyate ||
svādumi ṇamul‌ || 3.4.26 ||
svādumītyarthagrahaṇamiti | etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate | svādvartheṣviti | māntatvamapi sarveṣāṃ bhavati; arthe sambhāvat‌ | lavaṇasampannaśabdāvapi svāduśabdāparyāyo | atha `svādumi' iti makārāntanipātanaṃ kimartham, yāṣatā khamuñ‌ prakṛtaḥ, so'nuvattiṣyate, tatra `arudviṣadajantasya mum' iti māntatvaṃ siddhamiti ? tatrāha---makārāntanipātanamīkārābhāvārthamiti | bhāvapratyayaviṣaye māntatve nipātyamāne `voto guṇavacanāt‌' iti ṅīp‌ na bhavati, makārāntatvādukārāntatvābhāvādityarthaḥ | cvyantasyeti | khamuñyapi na sarvatra mum‌ siddhyati; tadvidau `anavyayasya' ityadhikārāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ tarhi māntatvameva nipātyatām, pratyayastu prakṛtaḥ khamuñeva vidheyaḥ ? naitadasti; avyayārthameva māntanipātanaṃ syāditi ṅīpsyādeva | ṇamuli tu māntatvamapūrvaṃ vidhīyamānamīkārābhāvārthaṃ ca cvyantasya ca makārāntārthaṃ vijñāyate | avaśyaṃ cottaratra ṇamul‌ vidheya iti lāghavābhāvādihaiva kṛtaḥ | asvādvīṃ svādvīṃ kṛtveti | dvayorvākyayostantreṇopādānametat | svādvīṃ kṛtvā yavāgūṃ bhuṅ‌kta itīkārābhāvasyodāharaṇam, asvāduṃ svāduṃ bhuṅ‌kta ityavyayasya | iha yadi ktvādayaḥ pratyayāḥ `karttari kṛt' iti vacanātkarttari syuḥ, iha paktvodano bhujyate devadatteneti devadattāttṛtīyā na syāt, ktvāpratyayenābhihitaḥ kartteti | atha ktvāpratyayenābhidhāne satyapi bhujipratyayenānabhihitaḥ karteti kṛtvā'nabhihitāśrayā vibhaktirbhavati tṛtīyā ? yadyevam, odane dvitīyā prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? bhujipratyayenābhidhāne'pi ktvāpratyayenānabhihitaṃ karmeti | tathā yadi karmaṇi syuḥ, paktvaudanaṃ bhuṅ‌kte devadattena, paktvaudanaṃ bhuṅ‌kte devadatta ityeva tu bhavati | tathāsmin‌ ṇamulyapi svāduṅkāraṃ bhujyate yāvagūrdevadatteneti yavāgvā dvitīyā na bhavati, svāduṅkāraṃ yavāgūṃ bhuṅ‌kte devadatta ityatrāpi karmaṇi dvitīyā bhavati, karttari tṛtīyā ca na bhavati | evamā tumuno draṣṭavyam | tathā `tamunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' `samānakartṛkeṣu tumun‌' ityatrāpi tumuni bhoktumodanaḥ pacyate devadattena, iṣyate grāmo gantuṃ devadattena, bhoktumodanaṃ pacati devadattaḥ, grāmaṃ gantumicchati devadatta iti sarvatrānuprayogāt‌ yatra lādayastadanurodhenaiva kartṛkarmaṇorvibhaktirbhavati | tasmādavyayakṛtaḥ samānādhikaraṇa iti vaktavyam, kena sāmānādhikaraṇye ? anuprayogeṇa | etaduktaṃ bhavati---anuprayujyamānāddhātoryasminkārake lādayo vihitāstatraivāvyayakṛto'pi bhavantīti | evaṃ hyubhābhyāṃ kartṛkarmaṇorabhihitatvādyathāyathaṃ vibhaktayaḥ siddhyanti |
vṛttikārastvimamarthamanyathā sādhayitumāha---tumarthādhikārācceti | tatra sayādisūtre tumarthagrahaṇāttamun‌ bhāve bhavatīti jñāpitam, tadeva ca tumarthagrahaṇaṃ `śakadhṛṣajñā' itiyāvadanuvarttate, ataḥ sarva ete ktvādayo bhāve bhavantīti tatra codayati----yadyevamiti | tṛtīyā kasmānna bhavatīti | etaccopalakṣaṇam, svāduṅkāraṃ yavāgūḥbhujyate devadattenetyatra karmaṇi dvitīyā kasmānna bhavatītyapi draṣṭavyam | `anabhihite' iti paryudāse caitaccodyam---tadā hi satyabhidhāne'nabhidhāne ca yato'nabhidhānaṃ tadāśrayā vibhaktiḥ prāpnoti | pariharati---bhujipratyayeneti | `anabhihite' iti prasajyapratiṣedha āśrīyate iti bhāvaḥ | tadā hi yato'bhidhānaṃ tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati | nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, anyā ca karaṇaviṣayā śaktiḥ, anyā ca bhujiviṣayā, tatra yadyekasyā śakterabhidhānamanabhidhānaṃ ca syāt, syādayaṃ parihāraḥ, yato'bhidhānaṃ tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedha iti śaktibhedāttvayuktaḥ ? ityatrāha---na cāsminniti | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ ? ityāha---samānakartṛkatvaṃ hi virudhyata iti | nanu ca mā nāmāsminprakaraṇe śaktibhedo vivakṣitaḥ, `anabhihitena' ityatra kasmānna vivakṣyate ? asambaddhametat‌ ; kathaṃ hi tasminneva prayoge tadaiva vivakṣāvivase syātām | kiñci---`anabhihite' ityekatvādīnāmādhāranirdeśo'nabhihite karmādau yadekatvādi tatreti, dravyameva caikatvādīnāmādhāro na śaktiḥ, atastatrāpi dravyamevānabhihitamityucyate, tasya ca śaktidvāreṇābhidhānānabhidhānayoḥ satoryato'bhidhānaṃ tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavatīti yuktameva | abhyupetyāpi śaktibhedavivakṣāṃ parihāramāha---pradhānaśaktyabhidhāne ceti | ākhyātapadavācyā kriyā viśeṣyatvātpradhānam, viśeṣaṇabhūtā tvapradhānam, tad‌dvāreṇa tadviṣayayoḥ śaktyorapi guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ | tatra pradhānānuvatitvād‌ guṃṇānāṃ tanmukhaprekṣitvāttadviruddhasvakāryārambhābhāvādyathāyathaṃ vibhaktisiddhirityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca---
pradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthake |
śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanuruddhyate ||
pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate |
yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktāpi pratīyate || iti |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---sakṛt‌ śrutasya yugapadubhābhyāṃ sambandhābhāvādekenaiva pradhānena śābdo'nvaya iti, itareṇa tu sannidhānādārtha iti ||
anyathaivaṃkathamitthaṃsu siddhāprayogaścet‌ || 3.4.27 ||
kathaṃ punarasau siddhāprayoga iti | siddha odana ityādau siddhaśabdo niṣpannavacanaḥ, tataśca siddhaścedaprayogaḥ kathamaprayujyamānāttato ṇamulvidhiriti praśnaḥ | `siddhe satyārambhoniyamārthaḥ' itivatprāptavacanaḥ siddhaśabda ityuttaram | nirthakatvāditi | niṣprayojanatvāt‌ | evameveti | nirarthaka eva sannityarthaḥ | etadeva sphorayati---anyathā bhuṅ‌kta iti | yāvānartha iti | udāharaṇeṣvanuprayogeṣu yā kriyā tatprakāravacanā atrānyathādayaḥ | anyathā kṛtvā śiro bhuṅ‌kta iti | atra tu vinā karotinā śiraso'nyathākaraṇaṃ na pratīyate, bhujikriyāgata eva prakāre gamyate, ato'vaśyaṃ prayojyaḥ karotiḥ ||
yathātathorasūyāprativacane || 3.4.28 ||
yadyasūyan‌ pṛcchati prativaktīti | pṛcchati sati yadyasūyanprativaktītyarthaḥ | `asu mānasopatāpe' kaṇḍ‌vādiḥ | tatreti | evambhūte viṣaye yatprativacanaṃ tadasūyāprativacanamityarthaḥ | yathākāramiti | praṣṭumanarhaḥ sanyadi pṛcchati tadedamuttaram | yathā kṛtvāhaṃ bhokṣya iti | tattvakathanametat | kathaṃ punaratra ktvāpratyayaḥ, yāvatā `siddhāprayoge' iti vacanādanarthako'tra karotiḥ, tataśca bhedanibandhanasya paurvakālyasya samānakartṛkatvasya cābhāvānnātra prāpnoti, ṇamul‌ punarubhayābhāve'pi vacanasāmarthyādbhavati ? ucyate; kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ karotistadviṣayaprakāro yathātathāśabdābhyāmucyate, tatra sāmānyasya sannihite viśeṣe paryavasānāttadviṣaya eva prakāra ukto bhavadi, tataśca yathā bhokṣyate iti yāvānarthastāvānena satyapi karotāvityetāvatā siddhāprayogatvamucyate, na punaratyantamabideyābhāvāt‌, tataśca kriyābhedanibandhana upapanna eva ktvāpratyayaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā pūrvasūtre'pi vāsarūpeṇa ktvā bhavati | bhāṣye'pi tatra tatra prayujyate--`anyathā kṛtvā coditamanyathā kṛtvā parihāra uktaḥ', `kathaṃ kṛtvā bādhakam' ityādi ||
karmaṇi dṛśividoḥ sākalye || 3.4.29 ||
karmaṇyupapade sākalyaviśiṣṭa iti | sakalasya bhāvaḥ sākalyam, tadviśiṣṭe karmaṇyupapade ityarthaḥ | kanyādarśaṃ varayatīti | atra darśanaviṣayabhūtānāṃ sarvāsāmeva kanyānāṃ vākyārthenānvayātsākalyam, sarvāḥ kanyā varayatītyatrāpi darśanaviṣayabhūtā ityarthaḥ | atiśayapratipādanaparaṃ caitat; yasmātkasyāścitparityāge'pi bhavatyeva | jānāti labhate vicārayati veti | sattārthasya tu viderakarmakatvādagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ ||
yāvati vindajīvoḥ || 3.4.30 ||
vindeti viderlābhārthasyānukaraṇam, tasya hi vindatītyādau `śe mucādīnām' iti numasti | yāvallabhate tākd‌ bhuṅ‌kte ityartha iti | etenāsākalyaṃ darśayati, sākalye hi pūrveṇaiva siddham ||
carmodarayoḥ pūreḥ || 3.4.31 ||
karmaṇītyanuvṛtteḥ pūreriti ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇam, kevalasyākarmakatvādityāha---pūrayateriti | udarapūraṃ bhuṅ‌kta iti | udaraṃ pūrayan‌ bhuṅ‌kta ityarthaḥ | evamādiṣu prāyeṇa paurvakālyaṃ nāsti, tasmāt‌ `pūrvakāle' iti na sambandhanīyamityāhuḥ ||
varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām || 3.4.32 ||
goṣpadapūramiti | goḥ padaṃ pūrayanvṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ, vṛṣarekarmakatvātkarttari ktaḥ | atrāpi `pūrvakāle' iti na sambandhanīyamityāhuḥ | sītāpūramiti | sītā-lāṅgalapaddhatiḥ |
asyagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti | sannidhānādeva pūrayaterūlopo vijñāsyata iti praśnaḥ | upapadasya mā bhūditi | asyetyanucyamāne varṣapramāṇavadūlopo'pi samudāyaviṣayo vijñāyeta---prakṛtyupapadasamudāye sannihito ya ūkārastasya lopa iti, tataścopapadasyāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ |
`ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām' iti śakyamakartum | kathaṃ goṣpadapramiti ? `prāpūraṇe' ityasmāddhātoḥ `āto'nupasarge kaḥ', kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmatvanapuṃsakatve, na rūpabhedaḥ, nārthabhedaḥ, na svarabhedaḥ | kapratyaye thāthādisūtreṇāntodāttatvam; ṇamulyūlope kṛte pūrvasya svarabhājo'bhāvāt‌ `liti' ityasyāpravṛttau pratyayakharaḥ, tasya kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāvasthānamityantodāttatvameva | nanu ca ṇamuli sati `kṛnmejantaḥ' ityavyayatvādvibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati, tarapi ca goṣpadapratarapamiti bhavati, kalpabādau ca goṣpadaprakalpa iti bhavati, ajñātādiṣu cāvyayatvādakajbhavati, ke tu sati sarvametanna siddhyati ? ucyate; iṣyate tāvadvibhaktīnāṃ śravaṇamekena goṣpadapreṇeti, tarabādiṣu copanyastāni rūpāṇi neṣyanta eva | etacca bhāṣye ūlopapratyakhyānādavasīyate |
nanu ca goṣpadapūramityādyapi ghañaiva siddham ? na siddhyati, yadi tāvatkaraṇe ghañaṃ vidhāya tadantena karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ kriyate, tatasthāthādisvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syād‌ | atha bhāve ghañi vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ kriyate---goṣpadasya pūraṇamasminvarṣa iti, tataḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtikharaprasaṅgaḥ | goṣpadapūrantarām, goṣpadapūraṅkalpamityādi ca na siddhyati, tasmād‌ `varṣapramāṇe' iti vaktavyam ||
celeḥ knopeḥ || 3.4.33 ||
asmāddhātorṇyantāditi | pukā nirdeśādeva ṇyantatvamavasīyate, vyākhyānāccela ityarthagrahaṇamityāha---celārtheṣviti | celaknīpaṃ vṛṣṭa iti | celaṃ knopayan‌-śabdāyayanvṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ | yathā varṣaṇe celāni śabdāyante tathā vṛṣṭa iti yāvat‌ ||
nimūlasamūlayoḥ kaṣaḥ || 3.4.34 ||
atra prakaraṇe samānakartṛkatvameva | nimūlakāṣamiti | kaṣatirhisārthaḥ | ekasyaiva dhātvarthasya sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhede sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | nigataṃ mūlamasya nimūlam | saha mūlena samūlaṃ kaṣaṇaṃ karoti, saha mūlena karṣatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra prakaraṇe draṣṭavyam ||
samūlākṛtajīveṣu hankṛñgrahaḥ || 3.4.36 ||
jīvagrāhamiti | jīvatīti jīvaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | jīvantaṃ gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ ||
karaṇe hanaḥ || 3.4.37 ||
nityasamāsārthaṃ ceti | `hisārthānām' ityanena ṇamuli `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti vikalpitaḥ samāsaḥ syād‌, ato hiṃsārthe'pyanenaiva ṇamuleṣitavya ityarthaḥ |
kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, yāvatā'hiṃsārthe hantau sāvakāśo'yaṃ vidhiḥ, `hiṃsārthānām' ityasya tu hantivyatirikto hiṃsārtho'vakāśaḥ; hiṃsārthe hantāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvātsa eva vidhiḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--pūrvavipratiṣedheneti | kathaṃ tarhi `hiṃsārthānām' ityatrodāhariṣyate---daṇḍopaghātaṃ gāḥ kālayati, daṇḍenopaghātaṃ veti ? atrāhuḥ---yatraika eva dhātvarthaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhidyamāno viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāvamanubhavati so'sya viṣayaḥ; `kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ' iti vacanāt‌ | atyantabhinnadhātvarthasambandhe tu tenaiva ṇamul‌ bhavatīti | evaṃ ca nityasamāsārtho yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaśceti, ko'rthaḥ ? yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaḥ sannityasamāsārtha ityarthaḥ |
iha dvarhangrahaṇaṃ samūlagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, sakṛdeva tu śakyaṃ kartum, katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---jīvākṛtayorgrahakṛñaḥ; śuṣkacūrṇarukṣeṣu piṣaḥ, nimūle kaṣaḥ, samūle hanaśca, cakārātkaṣaśca, tataḥ karaṇe hana ityeva, yadetatkaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayoga iti etad‌grahādiṣviti vaktavyam | tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
snehane piṣaḥ || 3.4.38 ||
vyākhyānātsnehane ityarthagrahaṇamityāha---snehanavācinīti | udapeṣamiti | `peṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca' ityudakasyodabhāvaḥ | `śuṣkacūrṇa' ityatra snehanagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam, karmaṇi tatra pratyayaḥ, iha tu karaṇe ||
haste varttigrahoḥ || 3.4.39 ||
`jīve grahaḥ, haste ca, vartteśca' iti noktam, tatra karmopapadam, iha tu karaṇam | varttirṇyanta iti | nirdeśa evātra pramāṇam | hastavarttaṃ varttayatīti | hastena varttayati, gulikāṃ karotītyarthaḥ ||
sve puṣaḥ || 3.4.40 ||
svapoṣamiti | pitparyāyavacanasya ceti | svarūpe'pi bhavati ||
saṃjñāyām || 3.4.42 ||
anadhikaraṇārtho'yamārambhaḥ, pūrvayogastvasaṃjñārthaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi grāme bandha iti ? vāsarūpavidhinā ghañ‌ bhaviṣyati ||
kartrorjīvapuruṣayornaśivahoḥ || 3.4.43 ||
jīvena naṣṭa iti | jīvena karaṇenāpadaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ | puruṣeṇoḍha iti | puruṣeṇa karaṇena deśāntaraṃ prāpito devadattādirityarthaḥ ||
ūrdhve śuṣipūroḥ || 3.4.44 ||
ūrdhvaśoṣaṃ śuṣyatīti | vṛkṣādirūrdhva eva tiṣṭhan‌ śuṣyatītyarthaḥ | ūrdhvaḥ pūryata ityartha iti | ūrdhvamukha eva san‌ ghaṭādirvarṣodakādinā pūrṇo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām || 3.4.47 ||
itaḥ prabhṛti paurvakālyamapyasti | mūlakopapadaṃśaṃ bhuṅ‌kte iti | nanu ca nātra tṛtīyāntasyopadaṃśinā saṃbandhaḥ, na hi mūlakenānya upadaśyate, kiṃ tarhi ? tadevopadaśyate, bhujinā tu saṃbandha upapadyate ; tamprati karaṇatvāt, kiṃ tūpadaṃśinā samārthyābhāvātpratyayo na prāpnoti, upapadasaṃjñā ca nasyāt‌, tadabhāvādupapadasamāso'pi na prāpnoti, vacanasya tu daśanairupadaśya bhuṅ‌kte ityādiravakāśaḥ syāt‌ ? ityata āha---mūlakādi ceti | satyaṃ mūlakāderbhujinaiva śābdo'nvayaḥ, upadaṃśinā tu karmāpekṣāyāṃ sannidhānādyogyatvācca vastutaḥ sambandho'styeva, bhujiṃ prati karaṇatvamanyathā nopapadyate, tataścāyamarthaḥ---mūlakena bhuṅ‌kte, kiṃ kṛtvā ? upadaśya, kimupadaśya ? tadeva mūlakamiti | yadi tu yatra tṛtīyāntenaiva śābdo'nvayastatraivāyaṃ pratyayo'bhimataḥ syāt‌, karaṇa ityeva brūyād‌, yathā--karaṇe hana iti | tasmādārthena sambandhena sāmarthye sati pratyayādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
hisārthānāṃ ca samānakarmakāṇām || 3.4.48 ||
`dhātusambanve' ityadhikārādanuprayogadhātunā samānakarmatvaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha---anuprayogadhātunāsamānakarmakāṇāmiti | kālayati | `kala vikṣepe' curādiḥ | daṇḍatāḍamiti | `taḍa āghāte' curādireva | upahatyeti | `vā lyapi' ityanunāsikalopaḥ, hrasvasya tuk‌ ||
saptamyāñcīpapīḍarudhakarṣaḥ || 3.4.49 ||
upaśabdaḥ pratyekamiti | pīḍādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvopapūrvaḥ `pīḍarudhakarṣa' ityuttarapadalopī samāsaḥ | sautraḥ puṃlliṃṅganirdeśaḥ | karaṇādhikaraṇavivakṣābhedenopapadeṣu vibhakartidūyam | karṣateriti bhauvādikasya, na kṛṣateriti; taudādikasya śapā nirdeśāt‌ | śapā nirdeśastu vihitaguṇasyoccāraṇādvijñāyate | sūtre tu pañcamyarthe prathamā, kiñca syādyadi taudādikasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, yāvatobhayorapi vilekhanārthatvānnārthabhedo nāpi rūpabhedaḥ ? yadyāpyubhayorapi vilekhane pāṭhaḥ, tathāpi taudādikasya kṣetraviṣaye vilekhane vṛttiḥ---pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatīti | tena kṣetre upakṛṣya halenopakṛṣyeti taudādikāt‌ ktvāpratyaya eva bhavati, na ṇamul‌ ||
samāsattau || 3.4.50 ||
saptamyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmityanuvarttate iti | pūrvasūtre'pi svaritatvādeva tṛtīyā'nuvarttate, saptamyāṃ tu tasyā nivṛttirmā vijñāyīti cakāraḥ kriyate | tena cānukṛṣṭamuttaratra nānuvarttate iti na codanīyam | yuddhasaṃrambhāditi | kopādinā manaḥ kṣobhapūrvako vākkāyavikāraḥ-saṃrambhaḥ, yuddhārthaḥ saṃrambho yuddhasaṃrambhaḥ, aśvaghāsādivatṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | atyantaṃ sannikṛṣya yuddhyante ityartha iti | sannikarṣapratipādanaparametatkeśagrahaṇaṃ bhavatu, mā vā bhūditi ||
pramāṇe ca || 3.4.51 ||
tṛtīyāsaptamyorityeveti | arthānuvṛttipradarśanametat, na hyevaṃvidhaḥ śabdaḥ prakṛto'sti | dvyaṅ‌gulotkarṣaṃmiti | dvayoraṅ‌gulyoḥ samāhāro dvayaṅ‌gulam, `tatpuruṣasyāṅ‌guleḥ' ityacsamāsāntaḥ, dvyaṅ‌gulenotkṛṣya paricchidyetyarthaḥ | hrasvāḥ khaṇḍāḥ-khaṇḍikāḥ |
apādāne parīpsāyām || 3.4.52 ||
parīpsā tvariti | `ñitvarā sambhrame' ghaṭādiḥ, `ghaṭādayaḥ ṣitaḥ', ṣittvādaṅ‌ | śayyotthāyamiti | `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ' iti tiṣṭhatisakārasya takāraḥ, pūrvadyuk‌ | avaśyakarttavyamapīti | akṣiprakṣālanādikam | dvitīyāyāṃ parīpsāyāmityeveti | `anudāttaṃ pademakavarjam' ityatrāpi parīpsā bhavatyeva, katham ? paribhāṣeyam, padagrahaṇaṃ ca paribhāṣārtham | tenodāttaḥ svarito vā yatra vidhīyate tatra tatsamakālamevaikamacaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭamanudāttaṃ karttavyam, na vilambitavyamiti ||
svāṅge'dhruve || 3.4.54 ||
svāṅgalakṣaṇaṃ caturthe vakṣyate---adravaṃ mūrttimadityādi | akṣinikāṇamiti | `kaṇa nimīlane' curādinipūrvaḥ | uttripya śiraḥ kathayatīti | nanu ca dhruvamiti nityamucyate---dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivīti yathā; adhruvamanityam, śiraścāpyanityameva, prāṇināmevānityatvādata āha---yasminnaṅga iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ---viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprakarṣa āśrīyate, prakarṣeṇa yadadhruvamiti | prakarṣaśca jīvatyapi prāṇini kadācidabhāva iti ||
parikliśyamāne ca || 3.4.55 ||
parikliśyamāna iti | `kliśū vibādhane' ityetasyaitad‌ rūpam, na tu `kliśa upatāpe' ityasya, pariśca sarvato bhāva ityāha---parikleśaḥ sarvaṃto vibādhanamiti ||
viśipatipadiskandāṃ vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ || 3.4.56 ||
anavayaveneti | sākalyena | padārthānāmiti | gehādīnām | tātparyamiti | paunaḥ punyamābhīkṣṇyamityarthaḥ | dravye vyāptirityādinā vyāptyasevayorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati | gehānupraveśamiti | nanu vyāptau vīpsā gamyate, āsevāyāṃ ca nityatvamiti `nityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tatkasmānna bhavatītyāha---samāseneti | yadyapi samāsa etayorarthayorna vidhīyate, tathāpi svabhāvata etayostenābhidānam, yathā---saptaparvā iti, parvagatāyā vīpsāyāḥ---parvaṇiparvaṇi sapta parṇānyasyeti | tathā ca vakṣyatīti | `nītyavīpsayoḥ' ityatra vakṣyati | bhāṣyakāraḥ | tiṅ‌kṣu nityateti | upalakṣaṇam, `avyayakṛtsu ca' ityapi draṣṭavyam |
ktvānivṛttyarthamiti cediti | `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca' ityanena ktvāṇamulau dvāvapi vihitau, tatra viśyādibhyo ṇamuleva yathā syāt‌, ktvāpratyayo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ punarmamulucyata iti cedityarthaḥ | dūṣayati---neṣṭatvāditi | iṣyate hyāsevāyāṃ viśiprabhṛtibhyaḥ ktvā---gehamanupraviśyānupraviśyāsta iti | dvitīyopapadārthaṃ tarhīti | atra hi `dvitīyāyāṃ ca' ityadhikārad‌ dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñā labhyate, kimarthaṃ punarupapadatvamiṣyate ? ityāha---upapadasamāsa iti | `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti vacanātpakṣa ityuktam | tena hi satyupapadābhāva iti | saptamīsthasya kasyacidabhāvāt ||
asyatitṛṣoḥ kriyāntare kāleṣu || 3.4.57 ||
`asu kṣepaṇe', `ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām' | kriyāmantarayatīti kriyāntara iti | vyavadhānavācino'ntaraśabdāttatkarotīti ṇici `karmaṇyaṇ' | pāyayatīti | pibaterṇici `śācchāsāhvā' ityādinā yuk‌ | atyasanenetyādi | yaccādya pānaṃ yacca dvyahe gate bhavitā, tanmadhyavarttitvādatyasanatarṣaṇayoḥ, etadeva spaṣṭayannudāharaṇasyārthamāha---adya pāyayitvetyādi |
dvyahamupoṣyeti | upapūrvādvaseḥ ktvā lyap‌, yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, `śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam, atropavāsena bhojanaṃ vyavadhīyate | ahariti | `kālādhvanoḥ' iti dvitīyā | kṛtsnamahariṣūnatyasya kṣiptvā gata ityarthaḥ | yojanamatyasyeti | kvacitsrughnādau pāyayitvā tatā yojanamatikramya pāyayatītyarthaḥ ||
nāmnyādiśigrahoḥ || 3.4.58 ||
ādiśergraheśceti | etenāṅo diśinaiva sambandhaḥ, na grahiṇeti darśayati ||
avyaye'yathābhipretākhyāne kṛñaḥ ktvāṇamulau || 3.4.59 ||
`ayathābhipretākhyāne' iti nañaḥ praśleṣaḥ paścānnirdeśādvijñāyate, anyathā'sandehārthaṃ pūrvaṃ nirdiśet‌, ayathābhipretaśabdaścākhyānakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ yathābhipretaṃ na bhavati tathākhyāna ityarthaḥ | puttrajanma prārthamānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gatvā kenacid‌gopanīyavannīcairākhyātam--brāhṇa puttraste jāta iti tamamṛṣyamāṇo brāhmaṇa āha--kiṃ tarhīti | puttrajanmākhyānasya priyatve'pi ākhyānaprakārasyānabhipretatvādbhavatyudāharaṇam, ta evāyathābhipretākhyāna ityuktam, na punarapriyākhyāna iti | ācakṣa iti | laṭ‌, `thāsasse', śapo luki `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti kakāralopaḥ, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' | udāharaṇe'yathābhipretākhyānaṃ darśayati---uccairnāmeti | nāmaśabdaḥ prasiddhau, na punaridaṃ brāhmaṇavākyamuktamiti `upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām' ityatredamuktam | samāsārthaṃ vacanamiti | etadevopapādayati---tathā hīti | `ktvā ca' ityatra `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' iti varttate, tasmādanena yaḥ ktvā vihitastenaiva pakṣe samāso labhyate, na tu samānādisūtravihitena, na hi tena tṛtīyāprabhṛtiṣūpapadeṣu ktvā vidhīyata ityarthaḥ | ṇamulgrahaṇamanarthakam, prakṛto hyasau tatra ktvā ceti vaktavyam ? ityata āha---ṇamuladhikāra ityādi | tulyakakṣatvam-tulyabalatvam || tenetyādi | yadi tu cakāreṇa ṇamulanukṛṣyeta, uttaratra nānuvartteta; yatnābhāvāt‌ | punarṇamulgrahaṇe tu dvandvanirdiṣṭayordvayorapyuttaratrānuvṛttiḥ siddhā bhavati ||
tiryacyapavarge || 3.4.60 ||
tiryavakṛtyeti | tiro'ñcatīti `ṛtvig‌' ityādinā kvin‌, `tirasastiryalope' iti tiryādeśaḥ | vyutpattimātraṃ caitat‌, na tvatrāvayavārtho'sti, samudāyo hyayamapavarge varttate taddirśitam | samāpya gata ityartha iti | tiryavakṛtveti | anṛju kṛtvā, agrataḥ sthitaṃ pārśve kṣiptvetyarthaḥ |
`tiryaci' ityayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, `acaḥ' ityakāralope tiraścīti bhavitavyam ? ata āha--tiryacīti śabdānukaraṇametaditi | `aca' ityarthavato'jityasya grahaṇam | sa cārtho lokaprasiddho gṛhte; `abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrā lokaviśrutāḥ' iti nyāyāt‌ | ato'ñceḥ svārthe vartamānasyāllopaḥ | etattu tatra sthitasya śabdarūpasyānukaraṇam, tenānukāryeṇa rūpeṇārthavanna tu laukikārthena, tena lopābhāva iti bhāvaḥ | nanvevamapi `prakṛtibadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' iti lopaḥ prāpnotyevāta āha---na ca prakṛtivadanukaraṇena bhavitavyamiti | kasmādityāha---anukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgāditi | yādṛśaṃ rūpamanukartumiṣṭaṃ tādṛśaṃ na pratīyeta, laukika eva tvarthaḥ pratīyetetyarthaḥ | kva ca yathā prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatītyāha---etado'śityādi | yadyanukriyamāṇarūpavināśe'pi prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ syāt‌, etadaḥ, adasa ityatrobhayatrāpi tyadādyatvādike prakṛtikārye sati etasya, amuṣyeti rūpaṃ syāt‌ | nanu prayojanānuvattiṃ pramāṇaṃ tataścellopaḥ prāpnoti karttavya pavāyam ? katham ? `yattadetebhyaḥ' iti tyadādyatvam , asyavāmīyamiti yasyeti lopaḥ, gavityayamāhetyavādeśaḥ, paṭiti karotītyanukriyamāṇarūpavināśe satyapi `avyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' iti pararūpatvaṃ vā bhavati | tasmādubhayathā nirdeśadarśanāt‌ kvacitprakṛtibadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati, kvacinneti vācyam | tathā cāsminneva sūtre bhāṣyam---sautro nirdeśa iti ||
svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ || 3.4.61 ||
`taspratyaye' iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa ityāha---taspratyayoyataḥ svāṅgāttadevamucyata iti | na ca `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' itivatkadācittaspratyayāntatvena dṛṣṭe saṃpratyatadante'pi svāṅga prasaṅgaḥ, taspratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌ | karmadhārayo vāyam---taspratyaye parato yatsvāṅgaṃ tasminnupapade iti | vṛttau tu vastumātraṃ pradarśitam | yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyata iti | vyākhyānāt‌ | mukhata iti | ādyāditvātsaptamyarthe tasiḥ |
mukhe tasyatītyādi | `tasu upakṣaye' ityasmānmukhaśabda upapade `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' iti kvip‌---mukhataḥ, `atvasantasya ca' iti dīrgho na bhavati; `adhātoḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ |
pratyayāpratyayaparibhāṣayaivātrāprasaṅgāt‌ nārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇena ||
nādhārthapratyaye cvyarthe || 3.4.62 ||
nārtho dhārthaśceti | nādhāsahacarito'rtho nādhā śabdābhyāmuktaḥ, nārtho yasya sa nārthaḥ, nārthārtha ityarthaḥ | etena dhārtho vyākhyātaḥ | pratyayo yasmāditi | yadi pañcamyāṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate, tataḥ prakṛterupalakṣaṇaṃ nādhārthagrahaṇaṃ syāditi sampratyatadantatve'pi prakṛtimātre prasaṅgaḥ ? na prasaṅgaḥ, evaṃ hi vinañsaṅkhyāsviti vaktavyaṃ syāt‌, ṣaṣṭhyā vigrahaḥ karttavyaḥ---nādhārthaḥ pratyayo yasya samudāyasyāvayava iti | lyablope vā pañcamī vyākhyeyā yaṃ samudāyāmuddiśya nādhārthaḥ pratyayo vidhīyata iti | vinākṛtya nānākṛtyeti | `vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha' iti nānāñau | dvidhākṛtyeti | `saṅkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā' | dvaidhaṃkṛtyeti | `dvitryosca dhamuñ‌' | hirakpṛthakśabdau vinārthe |
nānā kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni gata iti | pūrvameva nānā santi kāṣṭhānyanyatra kṛtvā gata ityarthaḥ | dhārthamarthagrahaṇamiti | bahavo hi dhārthāḥ pratyayāḥ, tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe pratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, nānyeṣām; tadarthānāmarthagrahaṇe tu teṣāmapi bhavati | yaścādhādeśo dhārthaḥ `dhamuñantātsvārthe ḍadarśanam' iti tadarthamarthagrahaṇam---dvaidhakṛtya dvaidhakāraṃ dvaidhabhūya dvaidhabhāvamiti | dhamuñādīnāṃ tu sthānivadbhāvādeva siddhaṃ tadvidhau dha ityadhikāreṇādeśapakṣasyāśrayaṇāt‌ | atha nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyata āha---nā punareka eveti | nanu ca nāpratyayāvapi dvau bhavataḥ---niranubandhakaḥ, sānubandhakaśceti, tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe niranubandhakasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, netarasya ? evaṃ manyate---tantrāvṛttyaikaśeṣāṇāmanyatamasyāśrayaṇāttasyāpi bhaviṣyati ||
anvacyānulomye || 3.4.64 ||
anvagbhūyeti | agrataḥ pārśvata- pṛṣṭhato vā'nukūlo bhūtvā''ste ityarthaḥ | anvagbhūtveti | pṛṣṭhato bhūtvetyarthaḥ | anukūlo'nanukūla iti śabdena na spṛśyate ||
śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun‌ || 3.4.65 ||
atrānantareṇāstiśabdenaivārthaśabdaḥ sambaddhyate, śakadhṛṣajñānāṃ ghaṭāīyośca pṛthagupādānāt, tadāha---śakādiṣūpapadeṣu astyartheṣu vaiti | tumun‌ pratyayo bhavatīti | bhāve | akriyārthopapadārtha ārambha iti | `kriyārthopapade tumunṇvulau' ityādinaiva siddhatvāt‌ | tatra tāvat śaknoti bhoktum, dhaṣṇoti, jānātīti bhojane prāvīṇyaṃ gamyate | glāyati bhoktumiti | tatrāśaktiḥ | ghaṭate'rhatīti yogyatā | ārabhate prakramata iti | bhujerevādyāvasthā | labhate bhoktumiti | apratyākhyātaṃ bhojanaṃ labhate ityarthaḥ | utsahate bhoktumiti | bhojane vyāpriyata ityarthaḥ | asti bhoktumiti | bhojanamastītyarthaḥ | pravīṇo bhoktum, kuśalo bhoktum, paṭurbhoktumityādau paryāptivivakṣāyāmuttarasūtreṇa tumun‌ bhavati ||
paryāptivacaneṣvalamartheṣu || 3.4.66 ||
paryāptiḥ-anyūnatā, paripūrṇatetyarthaḥ | anyūnatā ca dvidhā sambhavati---bhojanasya prabhūtatayā vā, bhoktuḥ samarthatayā vā, ataḥ sāmarthyenālamarthena viśinaṣṭi | alamartheṣu paryāptivacaneṣviti | prayāpto bhoktumiti | bhojane na nyūnībhavati samartha ityarthaḥ | puryaptamiti | prabhūtamityarthaḥ |
śakyamevaṃ karttumiti | sukarametadityarthaḥ | sambhavamātraṃ vā'tra vivakṣitam---sambhavatyevaṃvidhasya karaṇamiti ||
karttari kṛt‌ || 3.4.67 ||
kimarthamidamucyate ? karttarikṛdvacanamanodeśe svārthavijñānāt‌ | yatra vacanenārtho nirdiśyate tatra pratyāsattyā prakṛtyartha eva pratyayo bhavati, tadyathā---`guptijkidbhyaḥ san‌', `yāvādibhyaḥ kan‌' iti, evamimekṛtaḥ svārthe syuḥ, svārthe mā bhūvan‌ karttari syuriti | nanu ca yamicchati svārthe, āha taṃ bhāve ghañ‌ bhavatīti ? tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ghañeva bhāve nānyaḥ kṛditi | asati hyatetasminsūtre ghañityetāvatsūtraṃ karttavyam---dhātorghañ‌ bhavatīti, tatrānirdiṣṭārthatvādbhāva eva ghaña bhaviṣyatīti; tataḥ `padarujaviśa' iti dvitīyaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyam, tataśca `bhāve' iti na karttavyam, kriyamāṇaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ghañeva bhāve nānyaḥ kṛditi, tataścānyaḥ kṛddhātvarthākṣipte karttari bhaviṣyati | syādetat‌---karmādīnāmapi dhātvarthenākṣepātteṣvapi kṛtaḥ syuriti ? na; `dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran‌', `karaṇādhikaraṇayorlyuṭ‌', `dāśagāghnau sampradāne', `bhīmādayo'pādāne' ityatra `ṣṭraneva karmaṇi nānyaḥ' ityādiko niyamo vijñāsyate | yadyekaṃ karmādi niyataṃ pratyayāstvaniyatā iti kārakāntare'pi ṣṭhranādayaḥ syuḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekamidaṃ vākyam---dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭraniti, tena ca karmaṇi vidhīyamānaḥ kathaṃ kārakāntare'pi syāt‌ ! dvitīyo'pi vā niyamo vijñāsyate---karmaṇyeva ṣṭraniti, evaṃ sarvatra | ya idānīmato'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ śeṣaḥ so'ntareṇāpi vacanaṃ karttaryeva bhaviṣyati | `karttari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau' `karttari carṣidevatayoḥ' ityubhayatrāpi karaṇanivṛttyarthā kartṛśrutirvidhyarthaiveti khiṣṇujādiṣu kartṛniyamo na bhaviṣyati | tadeva tarhi prayojanam---svārthe mā bhūvanniti ? nanu coktam---`bhāve iti niyamo vijñāsyate' iti ? svārthādanyaḥ sa bhāvo dhātvarthasya siddhatā nāma | śuddhe svārthe kṛtaḥ syuḥ, laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve ceti | ayaṃ tarhi niyamo bhaviṣyati---la eva bhāve iti ? nāyaṃ niyamaḥ śakyo vijñātum, kartṛkarmaṇornirdeśena nirdiṣṭārthatvāt‌ lakārāḥ svārthe na syuḥ, `akarmkebhyaḥ' iti ca vakṣyāmītyevamarthametatsyāt‌ | ataḥ suṣṭhūktam---karttari kṛdvacanamanādeśe svārthavijñānāditi |
atra ca dvaidham---etadvākyanirapekṣaiḥ svairvidhāyakairvākyairvihitānāṃ kṛtāṃ paścādenenārtha ādiśyeta ? kṛdutpattivākyānāṃ vāyaṃ śeṣaḥ syāt‌ ṇvultṛcau karttari nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ karttarīti ? tatrādye pakṣe yathānena tṛjādīnāmartha ādiśyate, tathā khyunādīnāmapyādiśyeta; viśeṣānupādānāt‌ | tataścaite'pyanena karttari ca syuḥ, sveṣu sveṣu vidhivākyeṣu karaṇādīnāmapyupādānātkaraṇādiṣu ca | nanu ca khyunādiṣu karaṇādirartho viśeṣavihitatvāt‌ karttuśca bādhako bhaviṣyati ? na; nānāvākyatvāt‌ | iha `dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' iti abhinnakālatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ viśiṣṭadānasya pratipādakamiti takreṇa dadhi bādhyate | yadā tu pūrvāhṇe brāhmaṇabhojanaprakaraṇe `dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatām' ityucyate, aparāhṇe tu `takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya dīyatām' iti, na tadā bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ | tathāsminpakṣe'pi kālabhedena vākyadvayoccāraṇādvādhyabādhakabhāvo na labhyate | tasmād‌ duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣa iti dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---kṛdutpattivākyānāmayaṃ śeṣaḥ syāditi | prāgukto doṣastadavastha eva ? tatrāha---yeṣvityādi | kuta etadityāha---arthākāṅ‌kṣatvāditi | yeṣu vākyeṣvartho na nirdiśyate tānyarthākāṅ‌kṣāṇi | tathā hi---`ṇvultṛcau bhavataḥ' ityukte'rthaviṣayā ākāṅ‌kṣā jāyate---kvaitau bhavati iti ? `kartari kṛt' ityasyākāṅ‌kṣā bhavati---kaḥ kṛt‌ karttari bhavatīti ? atastṛjādividhyanupasthāne śeṣaśeṣiṇorubhayorapyākāṅ‌kṣāpūtaye tatastatraivopatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ | khyunādivākyeṣviti | upatiṣṭhata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | kāraṇamāha---sākṣādarthanirdeśe sati teṣāṃ nirākāṅ‌kṣatvāditi | na ca raktapaṭanyāyenākāṅ‌kṣotthāpanenoprasthānaṃ yujyate; svata eva sākāṅ‌kṣe tṛjādividhyanupasthānena śeṣasyāpi caritārthatvāt‌ | raktaḥ paṭo bhavatītyatra tu paṭo bhavatītyasya nirākāṅ‌kṣatve'pi raktapadārthasya sākāṅ‌kṣatvādāṅ‌kṣotthāpanenānvayaḥ | na ca videśasthānāṃ kathamekavākyatvamiti vācyam; śāstre videśasthānāmapyavāntaravākyānāmākāṅ‌kṣāvaśādekavākyatvadarśanāt‌ | yathā ---dvitīye'dhyāye lugucyate, tasya caturthaṣaṣṭhayoralugapavādaḥ `gotre'lugaci', `aluguttarapade' iti ||
bhavyageyapravacanīyopasthānīyajanyāplāvyāpātyā vā || 3.4.68 ||
bhavya iti | `aco yat', guṇaḥ, `vānto yi pratyaye' iti vāntādeśaḥ | geyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnāmiti | etena `kai gai śabde' ityasyedaṃ nipātanam, na `gāṅ‌ gatau' ityasyeti darśayati | etacca nipātanāllabhyate | `īdyati' itītvam | janya iti | `aco yat‌' ityatra `takiśasicatiyatijanīnāmupasaṅ‌khyānam' iti vacanādyat‌ | āplāvya iti | `orāvaśyake' | āpātya iti | `ṛhalorṇyat' ||
laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ || 3.4.69 ||
`laḥ' iti laṅ‌laṭorakārānubandhayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇamekavacanaṃ ceti śaṅkāmapākaroti---la ityutsṛṣṭānubandhasāmānyamekaṃ gṛhyata iti | prathamābahuvacanaṃ caitaditi | sāmānyasyaikatve'pi `jātyākhyāyāmekasmin‌ bahuvacanam' | athādeśāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhyekavacanaṃ kasmānnāśrīyate---laḥ lasya ya ādeśa iti, yathā---`laḥ parasmaipadam' iti ? ucyate; evaṃ vijñāyamāne lādeśānāmanenārtho nidiśyeta, tataścāmviṣayasya lakārasyārtho na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt‌, lugatrādeśaḥ | na cābāvarūpasya tasyārthādeśanaṃ yujyate, tataścāsau `karttari kṛt‌' iti kartaryeva syāt‌ | nanu ca tasya āmaḥ' iti lukāpahāre satyanuprayoge ye lādeśāstaireva bhāvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; yadā hyamviṣayo lakāraḥ kartaryeveti sthitam, tadā virodhādbhāvakarmavācipratyayaparo'nuprayogo naiva prāpnoti, śrutasyaiva ca saṃbandhopapattāvādeśa ityadhyāhāro na yuktaḥ | tasmātprathamābahuvacananāntameva yuktam | tatra dvividho lakāraḥ---tiṅ‌bhāvī, atiṅ‌bhāvī ca | tatra tiṅ‌bhāvaninaḥ kṛtsaṃjñāniṣedhāt‌ `kartari kṛt‌' ityasyānupasthānātsvārthe bhāve vidhānaṃ prāpnoti, atiṅ‌bhāvinastu `kartari kṛt‌' iti vacanātkarttaryeva sādhutvaṃ prāpnoti, na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ---āsyamānaṃ śayyamānamityādāviti vacanamidamārabhyate |
nanu ca bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate, śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam, tataśca lakārasya bhāvakarmakarttāro'rthā anumāsyante | yadvā lakārasya prayoge'samavāyādādeśānāmeva te'rthā bhaviṣyanti, nārtha etena ? ityāśaṅkyāha---sakarmakebhyo bhāve na bhavantīti | anārabhyamāṇa etasminyathā bhāve vidhīyamānā ghañādayaḥ sakarmakebhyo'pi bhāve bhavanti---odanasya pākaḥ, sūtrasya kṛtiriti, tathā `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ, ityanena bhāve ātmanepadaṃ sakarmakebhyo'pi syāt‌, tataśtaca pacyate yavagūṃ devadatteneti prayogaḥ prāpnoti, ataḥ `bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti vakṣyāmītyayamārabdhaḥ | atha tatraiva `bhāvakarmaṇorakarmakāt‌' ityucyate, tatrākarmakagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt‌, nanu cehāpi kriyate ? ihāvaśyaṃ kartavyam---`tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthā bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti, tasmātsakarmakebhyo bhāve mā bhūdityavamarthamayamārambha iti sthitam | kiṃ cāmviṣayasya lakārasyārthādeśanārthamapīdaṃ vaktavyam; itarathā pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgādityalamiyatā ||
tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ || 3.4.70 ||
tayorbhāvakarmaṇoriti | pūrvasūtre sākṣāt‌ śrutayorbhāvakarmaṇostacchabdena parāmarśaḥ, na cakāreṇa saṃnidhāpitasya karturiti bhāvaḥ | ata evottarasūtre punaḥ `kartari ca' ityuktam | yadi hyanantaravākye cakāreṇa saṃnidhāpitasya karturbhāvasya cātra ityavamarśaḥ syāt‌ tatra kartṛgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ ; kartaryanenaiva siddhatvāt‌ | evakāra ityādi | kṛttvātkartari kṛtyāḥ prāptā evakāreṇa karturavakṛṣyante-vyāvarttyante | nanu ca takrakauṇḍinyanyāyena na karturapa karṣo bhaviṣyati, yathā `vaḍavāyā vṛṣe vācye' ityatra vakṣyate---apatye prāptastato'pakṛṣya vṛṣe vidhīyate, apatye tvaṇeva bhavati iti ? satyam ; nyāyaprāpta evāthaṃ evakāreṇānūdyate |
śayitamiti | `niṣṭhāśīṅ‌ṣvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ' ityakittvād‌guṇo bhavati | bhāve cākamakebhya iti varttata iti | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---evakāraḥ karturapakarṣaṇāya na kartavya ityuktam, tasyātropayogaḥ---yayorbhāvakarmaṇorlakāra uktastayorevānyūnānatiriktayoḥ kṛtyādayo bhavantīti | yadi ca sakarmakebhyo bhāve syustayostādṛśayoreva tu na kṛtāḥ syuriti ||
ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca || 3.4.71 ||
karmadhārayaḥ, karmaśabdaśca kriyāvacana ityāha---ādibhūtaḥ kriyākṣaṇa ādikarmeti | sādhanakarma tu na gṛhyate, ādiśabdena viśeṣaṇāt | bahūnāṃ samavāye ādimadhyāntabhāvaḥ, sādhanakarma katvemeveti ki tatrādiśabdena | tasminnādikarmaṇi bhūtatvena vivakṣita iti | etena `niṣṭhā' ityanenaivādikarmaṇi ktaḥ siddhaḥ, na punarādikarmaṇi niṣṭhā vaktavyeti darśayati | ādye hi kriyākṣaṇe bhūte samūharūpāropādekadeśe samūhe ceti nyāyādvā dhātvartha eva bhūto bhavatīti yukta eva ktaḥ | prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadatta iti | prārabdhavānityathaḥ | prakṛtaṃ devadatteneti | atra karmaṇo'vivakṣitatvena dhātorakarmakatvādbhāva eva ktaḥ | evaṃ prabhuktaṃ devadattenetyatrāpi ||
gatyarthākarmakaśliṣaśīṅ‌sthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca || 3.4.72 ||
anūṣita iti | `vasati kṣudhoriṭ‌' | anuprāpya jāto'nujātaḥ | evamanujīrṇaḥ | sakarmakebhyaḥ karmāvivakṣāyāṃ bhāve ktaḥ ||
dāśagoghnau saṃmpadāne || 3.4.73 ||
goghna iti | atra dānapūrvake hanena hantirvartate | arghārha iti | arghaḥ-madhuparkaḥ, tadaṅgatvena gohananaṃ vihitam | etāvad‌ gorālambhanasthānam---atithiḥ, pitaraḥ, vivāhaśceti | yadi sampradāne goghna iti nipātyate cāṇḍālāderapi tenābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, asmai api hyāgatāya gāṃ dātumarhanti suhṛdādayaḥ ? ata āha---nipātanasāmarthyāditi | asatyapi ceti | yathā'pacannapi yogyatayā `pācakaḥ' ityucyate, tathehāpītyarthaḥ ||
bhīmādayo'pādāne || 3.4.74 ||
uṇādipratyayāntā eta iti | bāhulyādetaduktam, praskandanaprapatanayorapyauṇādikatvāt‌ | tābhyāmanyatroṇādaya iti paryudāse prāpta iti | yadyapyasatyasminsūtre'pādānasya prakṛtatvāttābhyāmiti nirdeśo nopapadyo tathāpyayamarthastāvattatra vaktavyaḥ---tato'pādānāccānyatroṇādaya iti, tataśca syādeva paryudāsa ityarthaḥ ||
tābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ || 3.4.75 ||
nanu ca `anyatroṇādayaḥ' ityapyukte prakṛtatvādeva tābhyāmanyatreti vijñāsyate ? ata āha---sampradānārtha iti | kṛṣita ityādinā karmaṇi vṛttiṃ darśayati | atreḍāgamaścintyaḥ | evaṃ tanita ityatraāpi |
kecidāhuḥ---`yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭ‌pratiṣedho'nityaḥ, kṛtinṛtyorīditkaraṇāt‌ | taddhi `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' itiṭ‌pratiṣedhārthaṃ kriyate tatra `se'sici kṛti' iti vibhaāṣiteṭ‌tvādeva `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭ‌pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti kimīditkaraṇena |
apara āha---curādāvadantau kṛpitanī paṭhitavyāviti ||
kto'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ || 3.4.76 ||
svanikāyaprasiddhiriti | yathā yūpacaṣālādayo yājñikānāmeva prasiddhāstathā vaiyākaraṇānāṃ nikāye eṣāṃ prasiddhiḥ | nighaṇṭuṣu tu abhyavahāraparyāyatayā pratyavasānaśabdasya pāṭho vaiyākaraṇaprasiddhimūlaḥ | idameṣāmāsitamiti | `adhikaraṇavācinaśca' iti ṣaṣṭhī |
kathamityādi | kartari niṣṭhāṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ | akāro matvarthīya iti | arśaāderākṛtigaṇatvādac‌ pratyaya ityarthaḥ |
iha dvirgatyarthākarmakagrahaṇaṃ ca ktagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, sakṛdeva tu śakyaṃ kartum, katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---`ktvo'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ, tato gatyarthākarmakebhyaḥ kartari ca, cakārādadhikaraṇe ca, anuvṛttāccakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, tataḥ śliṣaśīṅ‌sthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca, kartarītyeva, etebhyaśca kartari kto bhavati cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, adhigrahaṇagrahaṇaṃ tu nātrānuvartate, yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyāt‌, tata ādikarmaṇi ca kartari kto bhavati cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ca, tato dāśagoghnāvityādi ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
lasya || 3.4.77 ||
akāra uccāraṇārtha iti | nānubandhaḥ, anyathā laṅ‌laṃṭoreva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ ; tataśca parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalādayaḥ, `loṭo laṅ‌vat‌', `eruḥ' ityādikāryavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt‌ ; liṅ‌loṭostibādīnāmabhāvāt | lakāramātraṃ sthānitvenādhikriyata iti | nanu cetsaṃjñāyāṃ lopaḥ prāpnoti ? vacanasāmarthyātsatyāmapītsaṃjñāyāṃ lopo na bhaviṣyati | evamapi litsvaraḥ prāpnoti ? ṇalo litkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam---na lādeśeṣu litsvaro bhavatīti | kiñcedamiti | lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ prāpnotīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ | `dhātvadhikāro'nuvartate' iti vakṣyamāṇābhiprāyeṇāha---daśa lakārā iti | akṣarasamāmnāye yayānupūrvyā'kārādayaḥṣa tadānupūrvoviśiṣṭairakārādibhiranubandhaiḥ kathyante; na tu vidhānakrameṇetyarthaḥ |
lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna prāpnotīti | viśeṣānupādānātprāpnotyeveti bhāvaḥ | varṇagrahaṇeṣu cārthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravartate, tathā ca yasyeti lopo'narthakasyāpi bhavati---daivadattiriti, akurvahyatreti yaṇādeśaḥ | dhātvadhikāro'nuvartata iti | dhātugrahaṇamanuvartata ityarthaḥ | evamapyagnicillunāti---atrāpi prāpnoti ? vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ dhātugrahaṇam | evamapi `śāmāmalibhyo laḥ' auṇādikaḥ---śālā, mālā, mallaḥ, atrāpi prāpnoti ? uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni | tathāpi parihārāntaramāha---kartrādaya iti | `laḥ karmaṇi ca' ityatra nirdiṣṭā arthāḥ kartṛkarmabhāvā ihānuvartante, taiśca lakāro viśiṣyate---kartrādiṣu vihitasya lasyeti, tena viśiṣṭaviṣayasyaiva lasya grahaṇam, na sarvasya ||
tiptasjhisipthasthāmabvasmastātāṃjhathāsāthāṃdhvamiḍ‌vahimahiṅ‌ || 3.4.78 ||
tibādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ | pakāraḥ svarārtha iti | pradarśanametat‌, `sārvadhātukamapit‌' ityādyapi prayojanam | iṭaṣṭakāra ityādi | nanu `iṭo't‌' ityatra liṅityanuvartate, tenekārasyātvavidhāne'pi nāstyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? evamapi tibādyavayavasya prāpnoti, yathā `eruḥ' ityetalloṭa ityanuvṛttāvapi tibādyavayasya bhavati | na hi tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī, liṅa iti tu sthānaṣaṣṭhītyatra pramāṇamasti | atha `ādyantau ṭakitau' iti deśavidhyarthaṣṭakāraḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha---tibādimirityādi | tulyatvam-sadṛśatvam, taccaikayoganirdiṣṭatvena lasyetyekā ṣaṣṭhī, tatra tibādayaḥ saptadaśādeśāḥ sthāne yogaṃ prayojayanti, tāneko notsahate vihantumityarthaḥ | mahiṅo ṅakāra ityādi | tiṅityupalakṣaṇam | taṅityapi pratyāhāro bhavati | cinumahe ityādau tu guṇapratiṣedhārtho na bhavati ; sārvadhātukamapit‌' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt | yatra hyārdhadhātukam‌eṣiṣimahīti, tatra ṅittvārthaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? pratyāhāre caritārthasya samudāyānubandhasyāvayavānubandhatve pramāṇābhāvāt‌ | tṛni katham ? tasyāpi hi nakāra `na lokāvyaya' ityatra pratyāhāre caritārthaḥ, `auṅa āpaḥ' ityatra ca vakṣyate---`sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ, anyathā niranubandhakasya prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syād‌, na sānubandhakasyauṭaḥ' iti, tacca virudhyate; tasyāpi ṭakārasya suḍiti pratyāhāre caritārthatayā aukārasya niranubandhakatvāt‌ | tasmānmahiṅo ṅakāraḥ pratyāhārārthaḥ, na tvavayavānubandha ityācāryāṇāṃ smṛtiparamparaivātra śaraṇam ||
ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere || 3.4.79 ||
ṭito lakārasya sthaāne iti | etena ṭitaḥ, ātmanepadānāmiti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyāviti darśayati | yadi tu pratyekasaṃbandhādekavacanamityāśritya ṭitāmātmanepadānāmityāśrīyate, akurvītyatrāpi prasajyeteti bhāvaḥ |
prakṛtairityādi | ya ete tibādayaḥ prakṛtāsteṣaāṃ madhye yānyātmanepadāni vihitānītyevamātmanepadāni viśiṣyante | na ca tibādīnāṃ madhye śānac‌ sanniviśiṣṭastato na tasya prasaṅga ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca taṅāmityeva vaktavyam | kecittu `āne muk‌' iti nirdeśaṃ jñāpakaṃ varṇayanti---tiṅāmevaitvaṃ nānyeṣāmiti; itarathā hyānayīti vaktavyaṃ syāt‌ | neti vayam, yo'lādeśa ānaḥ `pūṅyajoḥ śānan‌' tasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syād‌---vayamānaḥ, yajamāna iti ||
thāsaḥ se || 3.4.80 ||
peciṣe iti | liṭ‌, `ata ekahalamadhye' ityādinā etvābhyāsalopau, krādiniyamādiṭ‌ | iha `thaḥ saḥ' iti vaktavyam, thakārasya sakāre kṛte parabhāgasya ṭeretve sati siddhamiṣṭam | pacathaḥ pacatha atrāpi prāpnoti ? `ātmanepadānām' iti vartate | evamapyāthāmasthakārasya prāpnoti ? dhātoriti vartate---dhātoranantaro yasthakāra iti | ihāpi tahi na prāpnoti---pacase, cinuṣe iti ? vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt‌ | kva tarhi syāt‌ ? ya ete lugvikaraṇāḥ, śluvikaraṇāḥ, śnamvikaraṇāḥ | tasmāt‌ `thāsaḥ se' iti vaktavyam | evamapi saśabda evādeśo vidheyo ṭeretvenaiva siddham ? jñāpakārtham | etajjñāpayati---ātmanepadānāṃ ya ādeśāsteṣāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti | tena paktā, paktārau, paktāra iti ḍāraurasāmetvaṃ na bhavati ||
liṭastajhayoreśirec‌ || 3.4.81 ||
pūrvasūtre jñāpitam---ātmanepadādeśānāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti, tena iśirac‌ ityetāvādeśau na vihitau | śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha iti | anyathā dhātorityadhikārād‌ `ādeḥ parasya'iti takārasya prasajyeta | atha `śe' ityeva kasmānnoktam, śairejiti hyukte mātrālāghavaṃ bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam ; `śe' iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā syāt‌ | iha ca pape somamiti pibādeśaḥ prāpnoti, jagle mamle ityādau cātvaṃ na syāt‌ | eśi tu na doṣaḥ, `varṇe yatsyāttacca vidhyāttadādau' iti nyāyāt ||
parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalatususthalathusaṇalvamāḥ || 3.4.82 ||
tibādīnāmiti | etacca prakaraṇāllabhyate, tena kvasorṇalādayo na bhavanti, vidhānasāmarthyādvā kvasorṇalādyabhāvaḥ | lakāraḥ svārtha iti | anyathā pratyayasya pittvādanudāttatve'pi dhātusvare kṛte dviḥ prayogo dvirvacanamiti dvayorapyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti | `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' iti nāsti, yaugapadyena sambhavaḥ paryāyeṇa prasajyeta | ṇakāro vṛddhyartha iti | idamanyathāsiddham, `ṇaluttamo vā' ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ---al‌ ṇidbhavatīti, tata uttamo vā---vā ṇidbhavatīti | papāceti | kathamayaṃ sarvādaśaḥ, yāvatā `nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam', tataśca `dhātoḥ' ityadhikārād‌ `ādeḥ parasya' iti vakārasya prāpnoti ? anittvātsiddham ? na hyayaṃ ṇalvidhānasamaye pratyaya ityanittvād‌ ṇakārasyānekālatvātsarvādeśaḥ, tato ṇakārasyotsaṃjñetyānupūrvyātsiddham | nanu ca ṇakāro na kartavya ityuktam ? evaṃ tarhi lakāra ādau kriyate tasyāpyanittvātsiddham, la uttamo veti vaktavyam, evam āta au lasyeti, halṅyādisūtre cāpyapṛktaṃ haliti halgrahaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvādaśo ṇaliti, taddhi papācetyādau mā bhūditi | sarvādeśatve ca tadupapadyate | papaktheti | krādiniyamātprāpta iṭ‌ `upadeśe'tvataḥ' iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati | kvacitpecitheti pāṭhaḥ, `ṛto bhāradvājasya' iti niyamādiṭ‌, `thali ca seṭi' ityetvābhyāsalopo | peceti | dhātorityadhikārāt‌ `tasmādityuttarasya `ādeḥ parasya' iti thakārasyākāre dvayorato guṇe pararūpatvam ||
vido laṭo vā || 3.4.83 ||
vida jñāne iti | sattāvicārārthayostvātmanepaditvāttibādīnāmasambhavaḥ, lābhārthasyāpi vikaraṇena vyavadhānādanantarāṇāmasambhava iti bhāvaḥ ||
bruvaḥ pañcānāmādita āho bruvaḥ || 3.4.84 ||
pañca ṇalādaya iti | ādeśā api pañcaiva, tatrāpyādito ṇalādayaḥ pañca, na punaricchātaḥ pañcetyarthaḥ | kathaṃ punadvitīyaṃ pañcagrahaṇamādigrahaṇaṃ cāntareṇādeśeṣvayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, nanu sarvaireva ṇalādibhiḥ pañcānāṃ sthāne yuktambhavitum ? ucyate; pūrvasūtre tāvadyathāsaṅkhyaṃ pravartate, tataśca tatraiva nirjñātaḥ sthāniviśeṣeṇa ṇalādīnāṃ sambandhaḥ, ta evehānuvartanta ityatrāpi tathaiva bhaviṣyati, tataśca sthānisambandhāditi pūrvasūtre sthāniviśeṣeṇa sambandhasya nirjñātatvādityarthaḥ | āttheti | `āhasthaḥ' | pareṣāmiti | thādīnām | nanu ca `bruvaḥ' iti yadetatpañcamyantaṃ tadevārthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatītyādeśasambandhe ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vijñāsyate, nārtho bruva iti punarvacanena ? tatrāha---bruva iti | punarvacanamityādi | parasmaipadānāmeva hi syāditi | asati śrute sambandhini vibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavati, iha tu parasmaipadānāmiti śrutatvātteṣāmeva syādityarthaḥ ||
loṭo laṅ‌vat‌ || 3.4.85 ||
loṭo laṅ‌vatkāryaṃ bhavatīti | atra loḍādeśeṣu loṭ‌śabdo vartate, laṅādeśeṣu ca laṅ‌śabdaḥ, loḍādeśānāṃ laṅādeśavatkāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ, tadāha---tāmādayaḥ salopaśceti | yadyapyete laṅyāhatya na vihitāstathāpi laṅidṛṣṭatvādatidiśyante | aḍāṭau kasmānna bhavati iti | laṅyevāhatya vihitatvāt‌, pratyuta tacorevātideśo yukta iti praśnaḥ | tathā jherjusādeśa iti | kasmānna bhavatīti vibhaktivipariṇāmenānuṣaṅgaḥ | `laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasya' iti jusbhāvo'pi laṅa evāhatya vihitaḥ | iha tu jāgratu, vidantu `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' iti laṅi dṛṣṭo jusbhāvaḥ prāpnoti | vāgrahaṇamanuvartata iti | loṭa ityupameye ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādupamānaṃ paṣṭhyantaṃ vijñāyate---laṅo yatkāryaṃ talloṭo bhavatīti, na tu laṅi yatkāryaṃ talloṭītyaḍāṭoḥ parihārāntaram | jherjusbhāvasya tu parihārāntaram `laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasya' ityatra svayameva vakṣyati ||
eruḥ || 3.4.86 ||
loḍādeśānāmikārasyeti | atha tu---loḍādeśo ya ikārastasya ityartho'bhipretaḥ syādiṭa ityeva brūyāta, `tuhyoḥ vidāṅ‌kurvantu' iti ca nirdeśo'nupapannaḥ syād‌ | athedānīmiṭo'pi vyapadeśivadbhāvenetvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt‌ ṭeretvaṃ bhaviṣyati | na voccāraṇasāmarthyāditi | yadi hinyorutvaṃ syāt‌ `serhuḥ' `mernuḥ' ityeva brūyād‌, evaṃ hi prakriyālāghavaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | `āni loṭ‌', hujhalbhyo hedhiḥ' iti liṅgaṃ hinayorutvābhāvasya ||
serhyapicca || 3.4.87 ||
lunīhīti | pittvābhāvānḍittve sati `ī halyaghoḥ' itītvaṃ bhavati | rāghnuhītyatra guṇābhāvaḥ | iha sehirṅicceti vaktavyam | nanvevaṃ ṅittvānṅitkāryaṃ bhavatu, sthānivadbhāvena pittvamapyastītyanudāttatvamapi prāpnoti ? `ṅicca pinna bhavati' iti vacanānna bhaviṣyati, yathā---api stuyādrājānamiti, atra `uto vṛddhirluki hali' iti piti vidhīyamānā vṛddhirna bhavati | brūtādbhavāniti, bruva iṇna bhavati | kiṃ ca nāprapte pittve ṅittvamārabhyamāṇaṃ tadvādhiṣyate ||
vācchandasi || 3.4.88 ||
apittvaṃ vikalpyata iti | anantaratvāt‌ | nādeśa iti, vyavahitatvāt‌ | yuyodhīti | `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapaḥ ślau dvirvacanam | atra pittvān‌ ṅittvābhāve `aṅitaśca' iti dhibhāvaḥ ||
merniḥ || 3.4.89 ||
utvalopayorapavāda iti | yathākramam `eruḥ' `loṭo laṅ‌vat‌' iti prāptayoḥ, `itaśca' itīkāralopasyāpi laṅi dṛṣṭatvādatideśataḥ prāptiḥ | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---`loṭo laṅ‌vat‌' iti prāptasyāmādeśasyāpavāda iti ||
āmetaḥ || 3.4.90 ||
loṭ‌sambandhina iti | loḍādeśasambandhina ityarthaḥ | etena loṭaikāro viśeṣyata iti darśayati | ekāreṇa tu loṭi viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhau satyekārāntasya loṭa āmvidhīyamāno'nekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ syāt‌, tatra hi `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' iti parihāro vācyaḥ syādityarthaḥ ||
āḍuttamasya picca || 3.4.92 ||

eta te || 3.4.93 ||

jhasya ran‌ || 3.4.105 ||

sijabhyastavidibhyaśca || 3.4.109 ||

laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasyaiva || 3.4.111 ||
ayuḥ, avuriti | śapo luk‌, `usyapadāntāt‌' iti pararūpatvam ||

ārdhadhātukaṃ śeṣaḥ || 3.4.114 ||

chandasyubhayathā || 3.4.117 ||
