<4.1>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ--4
padamañjarī
ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌ || 4.1.1 ||
adhikāro'yamiti | vidheyaparibhāṣyayoranirdeśādvakṣyamāṇānāṃ ca svādīnāṃ prakṛtyapekṣatsvaritatvācca | ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteriti | adhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati | adhikāro'nekaprakāraḥ----saṃjñādhikāraḥ, viśeṣaṇādhikāraḥ, prakṛtyadhikāraśceti, tatra kīdṛso'yamadhikāraḥ ? ityata āha---svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu prakṛtiradhikrayate iti | ṭābḍāpcāpāmāvritīti | sāmānyahaṇamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | samāhāranirddeśa iti | samāhāradvandvena teṣāṃ ṅyādīnāmayaṃ nirdeśa ityarthaḥ | tataśca samāhārasyaikatvādekavacanameva yuktam, na bahuvacanamiti bhāvaḥ |
kimarthamidamucyate ? ṅyāpprātipadikātpare svādayo yathā syuriti kevalānāṃ prayogo mā bhūt‌ | `paraśca' iti vacanātkevalānāṃ prayogo na bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---ṅyāpprātipadikādeva yathā syurita prakṛtyantarānmā bhūvan‌ | asatihyasminnadhikāre dhātuḥ, tiṅantam, vākyam, subantaṃ ceti ṅyāpprātipadikavyatiriktāti caturvidhā prakṛtirasti, vakṣyamāṇāśca pratyayāścaturvidhāḥ---svādayaḥ, ṭābādayaḥ, aṇādayaḥ, svārthikāśceti; tadiha caturvidhābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaścaturvidhāḥ pratyayā mā bhūvanniti karttavya evāyamadhikāraḥ |
na karttavyaḥ | nanu cāsatyasmin‌ dhātvadhikārāddhātoreva syuḥ, kṛdupapadasaṃjñe ca syātām, vāsarūpavidhiścasyāt‌ ? na; nivṛttatvāddhātugrahaṇasya | yadi paraṃ dhātorapi syuḥ, tadapi na; karmādīnāmabhāvāt | karmādiṣu ca kārakeṣvekatvādikāyāṃ ca saṃkhyāyāṃ svādayo vidhīyante, na ca dhātvarthasya karmādibhiryogaḥ sambhavati | kathaṃ tarhi karmaṇi tatryadādayo bhavanti ? naiva dhātvarthasya karmatve tavyadādayo bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātvarthaṃ prati yatkarma tasminvācye---karttavyaḥ kaṭa iti | svādayastu prakṛtyarthasya karmatve caritārthā nānyasya karmatve bhavitumarhanti, tavyadādibhiśca bādhitatvāddhātoḥ svādīnāmabhāvaḥ | nanu ca dhātvarthasyaiva karmatvaṃ dṛṣṭam---sanprakṛtau cikīrṣatītyādau ? evamapi saṃkhyābhāvaḥ siddha eva, avyayebhyastu `avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti jñāpakātsvādayo bhavanti | yatpunaḥ `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatroktam---yatra ca saṃkhyā sambhavatīti, tadasyāṃ daśāyāṃ tathā nāśrīyate | ṭābādayastarhi dhātormā bhūvanniti ? striyāṃ ṭābādayo vidhīyante, na ca dhātvarthasya strītvena yogo'sti | kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ ktinnādayo vidhīyante ? naivātra dhātvarthasya strītve ktinnādayaḥ smaryante, kasya tarhi ? yastasya siddhatvaṃ nāma dharmastasya | ktinnādibhiśca bādhitatvāṭṭābādīnāmabhāvaḥ |
aṇādayastarhi dhātormā bhūvanniti ? apatyādiṣvartheṣvaṇādayo vidhīyante, na ca dhātvarthasyāpatyādibhiryogo'sti, samarthavibhaktyabhāvāccāṇādīnāmanutpattiḥ, `tasyāpatyam', `tena raktam', `tatra bhavaḥ' ityevamādibhiḥ ṣaṣṭhyādivibhaktyantādaṇādayo vidhīyante, na ca dhātorvibhaktiḥ sambhavati | svāthikā api svārthakaistumunnādibhirbādhitatvādeva dhātorna bhaviṣyanti |
tiṅantāttarhi svādayo mā bhūvanniti ? tiṅanteṣu kriyā pradhānabhūtā, sādhanaṃ guṇabhūtam, tatra pradhānabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ karmādīnāmabhāvātsvādayo na bhaviṣyanti | pacati bhavati, bhavati vai kiñcidācāryāḥ kriyamāṇamapi codayantītyādau kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti cet‌, evamapi saṃkhyāyā abhāvaḥ siddha eva | yastu guṇabhūtaḥ karttā'bhīdhīyate; tatra abhihitatvādeva vibhaktyabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | na ca guṇabhūtasya kartuḥ kriyāntarāveśaḥ sambhavati; yataḥ pācakaṃ paśyetyādivad‌ dvitīyādayo bhaveyuḥ | nanu putrīyavadetatsyāt‌, tadyathā---putrīyaśabdādantarbhūtakriyākarmavācinaḥ karttari lakāra utpadyate---putrīyatīti, tathehāpi pacatiśabdāt‌ kartṛviśiṣṭakriyāvācinaḥ kramādiṣu dvitīyādayaḥ syureva ? naiṣa doḥ ; uktametat‌---prakṛtyarthasya karmatve caritārthāḥ svādayo nānyasya karmatve bhavitumarhantīti | na caikakriyāpekṣayorbhinnayoḥ sādhanayorekasminpade yugapadabhidhānaṃ sambhavati | putrīyaśabdastu jīvatyādidhātuvadviśiṣṭakriyāvacana iti, tataḥ karttari lakārotpattiraviruddhā | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---arthābhāvādeva tiṅantād‌ dvitīyādayo na bhavantīti | yo hi manyate---ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārānna bhavantīti; rūpabādyantāttasya dvitīyādayaḥ syureva, pacatirūpaṃ paśya, pacatirūpeṇa kṛtamityādi, bhavati hyetatprātipadikam | kathaṃ tarhi rūpabādyantātprathamaikavacanamapi bhavati ? uktatvātsaṅkhyāyāḥ, na hi tatkartuḥ saṅkhyāyāmekavacanam | yadi tathā syāt‌ pacaterūpaṃ pacantirūpamiti dvivacanabahuvacane syātām | `prātipadikārtha' ityatra tu prātipadikagrahaṇātprātipadikamātrānubandhinī prathamā bhavati | tatrāpyekavacanameva; `ekavacanamutsargaḥ kariṣyate' iti vacanāt‌ | na caivaṃ tiṅante'pi prasaṅgaḥ tasyāprātipadikatvāt‌ |
ṭābādayastarhi tiṅantānmā bhūvanniti ? striyāṃ ṭābādayo vidhīyante, na ca tiṅante pradhānasyārthasya strītvena yogo'sti | yadi paraṃ sādhanasya strītve ṭābādayaḥ syuḥ paced‌ brāhmaṇaḥ, paceran‌ brāhmaṇya iti ? tadapi na; svabhāvato hi tiṅantāni sādhanāśrayāṃ saṅkhyāmevopādadate, na liṅgam | uktaṃ ca---
ekatve'pi kriyākhyāte sādhanāśrayasaṃkhyayā |
bhidyate na tu liṅgākhyo bhedastatra tadāśrayaḥ || iti |
śobhanaṃ pacatītyādau kriyāviśeṣaṇasyaiva liṅgena yogaḥ, na kriyāyāḥ, tatrāpi napuṃsakena | pacati rūpamityādāvapi rūpabādyantavācyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ svabhāvato liṅgena yogaḥ, tatrāpi napuṃsakena | vicitrā hi śabdānāṃ śaktayo yathādarśanamabhyupagantavyāḥ, na sāmānyato dṛṣṭenānumānena vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyante | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---strītvābhāvāttiṅantāṭṭābādayo na bhavantīti, anyathā pacatirūpaṃ brāhmaṇītyādau rūpabādyantāṭṭāpsyādeva |
aṇādayastarihi tiṅantānmā bhūvanniti ? apatyādiṣvartheṣvaṇaādayo vidhīyante, na ca tiṅante pradhānasyāpatyādibhiryogo'sti | apradhānasya tvapradhānatvādevāpatyādibhiryogābhāvaḥ, samarthavibhaktyabhāvāccāṇādyabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā yaḥ pacatirūpaṃ tasyāpatyamiti rūpabādyantādaṇādayaḥ syureva |
svāthikā api jñāpakāttiṅantānna bhaviṣyanti, yadayaṃ kvacittaddhitavidhau tiṅ‌grahaṇaṃ karoti---`atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau', `tiṅaśca' iti | vākyādapi naiva svādayo bhavitumarhanti; armādīnāmabhāvāt | na khalu kriyārūpasya saṃsargarūpasya bhedarūpasya vā vākyārthasya karmādibhi strītvenāpatyādibhirvā yogaḥ sambhavati | `paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityādau dṛṣṭamiti cet‌ ? evamapi saṃkhyāyogābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | svārthikā apyabhidhānābhāvānna vākyādbhaviṣyanti | tathā hi---`devadattārohāśvam' ityasmādvākyātprāgivīyeṣvartheṣu ke sulbuki ca kṛte vākyārthasyāsattvabhūtat‌vācchaktiliṅgasaṅkhyāyogābhāvātsvādyutpatterabhāvād‌ devadattārohāśvaketi bhavitavyam, na caivambhūtena vākyārthagatāḥ kutsādayo gamyanta iti |
subantādapi naiva svādayo bhavitumarhanti | nahi svādiṣu vidhīyamāneṣu tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavati, yathoktam---`sanantānna saniṣyate' iti | kiñca subantamapi saṅkhyāpradhānaṃ kārakaśaktipradhānaṃ vā, na cāsyāparaiḥ karmādibhiryogaḥ sambhavati |
ṭābādayo'pi strītvābhāvānna bhaviṣyanti | aṇādiṣu punarnāsti viśeṣaḥ, subantādvotpattau satyāṃ prātipadikādvā | yathā caitattathā `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityatra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ | sarvathā rūpabādyantātprātipadikādapyaniṣṭaḥ pratyayo yadvāt‌ tadvaddhātvādikādapīti nārtha etenetyākṣeptā śaṅkate tāvat‌---yadyapīti |
pratyayaparatvena prakṛtirlabhyate | pāriśeṣyācceyameva prakṛtirlabhyata ityarthaḥ |
pariharati---tathāpīti | vṛddhādayo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya pratyayavidhestatra ṅyāpprātipadikasya viśeṣyatvena samprātyayo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | itarathā hīti | yadi ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyarthaḥ | samarthaviśeṣaṇametatsyāditi | `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityadhikārāt‌ | kiṃ ca samartham‌ ? subantam | samarthaviśeṣaṇe sati ko dāṣaḥ ? `udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt‌' iti phin‌ | iha ca prasajyeta---jñānāṃ brāhmaṇānāmapatyamiti, etaddhi samarthaṃvṛddham | iha ca na syāt‌---jñānāṃ brāhmaṇānāmapatyamiti, na hyetatsamarthamavṛddham | yatra hyādeśādivaśena saṅkhyāviśeṣābhivyaktirbhavati na bhavati tatra dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāmapi vṛttiḥ---tāvakaḥ, māmaka iti | yathā iha ca phiñutpadyamāno bahutvamantareṇa vṛddhatvānupapatterbahutvaṃ gamayet‌, evaṃ phinnapi dvitvamiti syādevāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ | avarṇa---`ata iñ‌' ihaiva syāt‌ dakṣasyāpatyamiti, dakṣayoḥ dakṣāṇāmityatra tu na syāt‌ | svara---`anudāttāderañ‌', iha ca prasajyeta---vāco vikāraḥ, tvaco vikāraḥ, etaddhi samarthamanudāttādi, `sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvāt‌ | nanvatraikāco nityaṃ mayaṭamicchantīti mayaṭā bhāvyam ? idaṃ tarhi pañcānāṃ vikāra iti `ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatve sati samarthamanudāttādi, prātipadikaṃ tu `nraḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ' ityādyudāttam | iha ca na syāt‌---sarveṣāṃ vikāra iti, `sarvasya supi' ityādyudāttaṃ padam, prātipādikaṃ tvantodāttaṃ nipātitam | dvyac‌---`naudvyacaṣṭhan‌', iha ca prasajyeta---vācā tarati, tvacā tarati,etaddhi samarthaṃ dvyac‌ | naugrahaṇaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ syāt‌---aukārāntādyadi bhavati nauśabdādeveti | iha ca na syāt‌---ghaṭena taratīti | sāmnā taratītyādau punarubhayathāpi siddham | ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇe tu sati tatsāmarthyāttasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vṛddhādi bhavati, samarthādhikārācca samarthātpratyayaḥ | tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ---vṛddhādi yad‌ ṅyāpprātipadikaṃ tasmāt‌ samarthāt‌ pratyayaḥ iti |
`yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ' iti pratyayavidhau pañcamīnirdiṣṭasya vidhīyamānā aṅgabhapadasaṃjñā ṅyāpprātipadikasya yathā syurityetattu prayojanaṃna bhavati, katham ? daivena hi jānatā yataḥ pratyayo vihitastasyaitāḥ saṃjñāḥ pañcamyā nirddiśyatāṃ mā vā nirdeśi | iha ca `kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau lukca' iti prātipadikātparayośchayatorlugyathā syādauṇādikayorukārasaśabdayormā bhūdityetadapi na prayojanam, katham ? `uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni', uṇaādiṣu nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | etacca `ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' ityatra kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhe punaḥ kaṃsagrahaṇādvijñāyate, tasmād‌ vṛddhādyeva prayojanamadhikārasya |
ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ kriyate; pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt | `yūnastiḥ' yuvatirityasya tu taddhitāntatvātprātipadikatvam | `ūṅutaḥ' ityuvarṇāntādūṅ‌ vidhīyate, tatraikādeśasyāntavadbhāvātprātipadikatvam | `śvaśurasyokārākāralopaśca' iti śvaśrūrityatra `śvaśuraḥ śvaśr‌vaśca' iti nipātanādvibhaktyādisiddhiḥ, evaṃ sthite codyam---atheti | na prātipadikagrahaṇa iti | nañaḥ kākvā prayogātsiddhamevetyathaḥ | anekārthatvādvā nipātānām | nanuśabdasyārthe naśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ | liṅgaviśiṣṭasyeti | liṅganimittapratyayenādhikasyetyarthaḥ |
asyāśca paribhāṣāyāḥ prayojanam---sarvanāmasvarasamāsopacāreṣṭhavadbhāvāḥ | sarvanāma---bhavacchabdasya vidhīyamānā sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhavatīśabdasyāpi bhavati, `sarvanāmnāstṛtīyā ca', bhavatā hetunā, bhavato hetoḥ, bhavatyā hetunā, bhavatyā hetoriti | svara---`kuśūlakūpavumbhaśālaṃ bile', kuśūlabilaṃ kuśūlībilam | samāsa---`pūrvasadṛśa', mātṛsadaśaḥ, mātṛsadṛśī; `sadṛśapratirūpayoḥ' iti svaro'pyatra bhavati | tathā `kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ' | kumārīśramaṇā, kumāraśramaṇā, evaṃ yuvatirvalinā, yuvavalinā | upacāra---`ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsakumbha', ayaskumbhaḥ, ayaskumbhī | iṣṭhavad‌bhāva---`ṇāviṣṭhavatprātipadikasya', kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayati | iha tu `acittahastidhenoṣṭhak‌', hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikaramiti, `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpi nivṛtte hastiśabda evāyamiti ṭhaksiddhiḥ | `taddhite' ityeṣā hi viṣayasaptamī | avaśyaṃ ca puṃvadbhāva evāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anyathā hastinīśabdāṭṭhaki yasyetilopagya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na syāt‌ | iha ca `nentsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca sthaṇḍilaśāyini' iti `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk‌ subutpatteḥ' iti vacanādanutpanna eva ṅīpi samāse satīnnantamevottarapadamityalukpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | evaṃ `śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt‌' grāmevāsinītyaluk‌ | tathā `kyaṅ‌māninośca' `svāṅgāccetomānini' darśanīyamāninī, dīrghamukhamāninī---māninśabda evottarapadamiti puṃvadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | iha ca `tṛjakābhyāṃ karttari' `karttari ca' iti karttari yau tṛjakau tābhyāṃ yoge yā ṣaṣṭhī tasyā yena saha samāsaḥ prāptaḥ sa sarvo na bhavatīti vijñānādapāṃ sraṣṭrītyatrāpi samāsaniṣedaḥ siddhaḥ | yadi `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' bhavati, atiprasaṅgo bhavati---`dviṣatparayostāpe' dviṣatītapa ityatrāpi syāt, uktamatra---`dviṣatparayoriti dvitakārako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ takārānto dviṣacchabdaḥ' iti | iha ca gārgyā apatyam, dākṣyā apatyamiti `yañiñośca' iti phakaṃ paratvāt‌ strībhyo ḍhagbādhate | iha ca `ñnityādinityam' dākṣiḥ, glucukāyanirityasyāmavasthāyāmādyudāttatve kṛte paścāt‌ `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣi sati śiṣṭaḥ pratyayasvara eva bhavati---dākṣī, glucukāyanī | na cāsyāmavasthāyāmādyudāttatvaṃ punaḥ pravarttate; pūrvameva pravṛttatvāt‌ | tathā bahavo gomanto'syāṃ bahugomatīti prāgeva bahusvare pravṛtte paścānṅīp‌, pittvādanudātto bhavati | na ca punarapi `bahornañvad‌' ityamya pravṛttiḥ pūrvameva pravṛttatvātsamāsāccātra ṅībutpanna ityuttarapadaṃ na liṅgaviśiṣṭam | iha tarhi `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac‌' madrāṇāṃ rājñīti ṭac‌ syāt‌, tataśca `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena īkāre nivṛtte ṭilope ca ṭittvānṅīpi madrarājīti syāt‌, madrarājñīti ceṣyate | tathā mahatī priyā yasya mahatīpriya iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaviṣaye `ānmahataḥ' ityātvaṃ syāt | tathā''ryayorbrāhmaṇakumārayoḥ, rājā ca rājabrāhmaṇītyatrāpi syāt‌ | tathā vibhaktyāśrayaṃ yatkāryaṃ vibhaktau parato vibhaktervā tatrāpi doṣaḥ, yathā---`na gośvan‌sāvavarṇa' iti śunā, śuna ityatra `sāvekācaḥ' iti prāptaṃ vibhakterudāttatvaṃ na bhavati | tathā gaurādiṅīṣantāt‌ śunyā, śunyai ityādāvapi `udāttayaṇo halapūrvāt‌' ityasyāpi niṣedhaḥ syāt | `ugidacām' iti num‌ gomatītyādāvapi syāt‌ | `caturanaḍuhorām' anaḍuhītyatrekārātparaḥ syād‌ | `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt‌' śobhanaḥ panthā asyāmiti `na pūjanāt‌' iti samāsānte niṣiddhe ṛnnebhyo ṅīpi bhasya ṭerlope supathītyatrāpi syāt‌ | aṅgādhikāre tadantasyāpi grahaṇātsupanthā itivat‌ `puṃso'suṅ‌' supaṃsītyatrāpi syāt‌ | śobhanāḥ pumāṃso|syāmiti, uraḥ prabhṛtiṣu pumāniti vibhaktyantasya pāṭhādekavacanāntādeva nityaṃ kap‌ bhavati, bahuvacanāntasya tu `śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti vikalpita eveti kababhāvapakṣe pūṅo hrasvaḥ, masuśca pratyayaḥ, ākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tatra pratyasyogittvāt‌ `ugitaśca' iti ṅīp‌ | `sakhyurasambuddhau' `anaṅ‌ sau' iti ṇittvānaṅau sakhau sakhyāvityādāvapi syātām | `sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām' iti ṅīṣvidhānaṃ tu sakhībhyāmityādyarthaṃ syāt‌ | `vibhāṣā bhavadbhagavadaghavatām' ityatra tvavaśabdaḥ sambuddhāviti viśṣyate, tatra `yena nāvyavadhānam' ityekena varṇena vyavāye otvaṃ pravarttamānamiha na bhavati---he bhagavati, he aghavatīti, tadabhāvāttatsanniyogaśiṣṭasya rutvasyāpyabhāvaḥ | `śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' ityatrāpi `allopo'naḥ' ityataḥ `anaḥ' ityapakarṣādyuvatīḥ paśyeti samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ |
tadevaṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāḥ santi prayojanāni, santi ca doṣāḥ | yāni prayojanāni tadarthameṣā kartavyā, pratividheyaṃ doṣeṣu | pratividhānaṃ ca `śaktilāṅgala' ityatra ghaṭagrahaṇenaiva siddhe ghaṭīgrahaṇamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārthamiti | tadevaṃ sthitametat‌---ṅyābgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇāditi |
paraharati---naitadastoti | svarūpavidhiviṣaya iti | svarūpāśrayo vidhiḥ svarūpavidhiḥ, sa cāsau viṣayaśca tatretyarthaḥ | kimuktaṃ bhavatītyāha---prātipadikasvarūpa grahaṇe satoti | kuta etadityata āha---tathā ceti | yathā ca yuvañchabdasya jaratīśabdena samāsavacanamatrārthe jñāpakaṃ tathā tatraiva pratipādikam | tādṛśameveti | `prātipadikasvarūpagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' iti yaduktaṃ tadanuguṇamevetyarthaḥ | yadi svarūpavidhiviṣaye paribhāṣeyam, kathamiṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ---kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayatīti ? bāhulakātsiddhiṃ manyate, curādau hīdaṃ paṭhyate---`prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' iti | bhāṣye tu yathākathaṃcitprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇamiti sthitam | tathā ca `sarvaprātipadikebhya ityeke' iti kvip‌ ṅyantādapi bhavati---yāminayantyahānīti |
kiñcetyādinā prayojanāntaraṃ samuccinoti | kālitareti | kālaśabdāt‌ jānapadādisūtreṇa ṅīṣi tarapi `gharūpakalpa' ityādinā hrasvaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ karāṇaṃ tadantāttaddhitavidhirna sidhyatītyāha--- vipratiṣedhāddhīti | strīpratyayasyāvakāśaḥ---prakarṣāvivakṣāyāṃ kālīti, prakarṣapratyayasyāvakāśaḥ---strītvāvivakṣāyāṃ kālatara iti ; ubhayavivakṣāyāmubhayaprasaṅge paratvāttaddhitaḥ syāt‌ | ṅyābgrahaṇe tu sati tarabvidhau prakṛtitrayādhikārasāmarthyātpūrvaṃ ṅyāpau bhavataḥ, paścāttarabiti siddhamiṣṭam |
nanu ca strītvasyāntaraṅgatvāttannimittaḥ pratyayo'ntaraṅgaḥ, prakarṣastu bāhyapratiyogyapekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, tatastannimittasya pratyayasyāpi bahiraṅgatvam | yo'pyajñātādiṣvartheṣu `prāgivātkaḥ' vidhīyate so'pyajñātādyarthāpekṣatvādbahiraṅga eva, vibhaktyantasya hi sataḥ paścādajñātādiyogo bhavati, vibhaktayaśca saṃkhyākarmādyapekṣāḥ | prāgeva saṃkhyākarmādiyogālliṅgena prātipadikaṃ yujyate | uktaṃ ca---`svārthamabhidhāya śabdo nirapekṣo dravyamāha samavetam, samavetasya tu vacane liṅgaṃ saṃkhyāṃ vibhaktiṃ cābhidhāya tānviśeṣānavekṣamāṇaśca pūrṇamātmānamapriyakutsanādiṣu tataḥ viśeṣye buddhiriti pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ svārtho'bhidhātavyaḥ, paścāttadviśiṣṭaṃ dravyam; tasya dharmitvena pradhānatvāt‌, tato liṅgamantaraṅgatvāt‌ | saṃkhyā hi bhedāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgā, sāpi tu sajātīyāpekṣā vijātīyakarmādikārakaśaktyapekṣebhyaḥ kārakebhyo'ntaraṅgeti tatastasyā abhidhānam, tataḥ kārakāṇām, evaṃ paripūrṇārthasya paścātkutsanādibhiryogaḥ | svārthādayo hi kutsanādihetavaḥ, dravyasya paṇḍitaka ityādau tathāvasāyāt‌ | tadevamantaraṅgaḥ strīpratyayaḥ, bahiraṅgāstaddhitāḥ, antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoścāyukto vipratiṣedhaḥ ? iha tahi `varṇe cānitye', `rakte' `kālācca' ityasyāvakāśaḥ strītvāvivakṣāyāṃ kālaka iti, strīpratyayasya kālītyavakāśaḥ; kāliketyatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvānkan‌ syāt‌ | tasya cātyantasvāthikatvānna tadapekṣaṃ strīpratyayasyāntaraṅgatvamasti | nāstyatra viśeṣaḥ, kālaśabdādapyutpattau `pratyayasthāt‌' itītve kāliketi siddham ? yadā tahiṃ haritaśabdāt‌ `na sāmivacane' iti ṅībnakārau bādhitvā paratvātkan‌ syāt‌, tataśca hariṇiketi na syāt‌ | haritaśabdena samānārtho hariṇaśabdo'sti, tataḥ karmatve ca bhaviṣyati, haritaśabdāttu haritiketi ? ayaṃ tahi---`lohitānmaṇo' ityatyantasvarthikaḥ kan‌ `varṇādanudāttāt‌' iti ṅībnakārau paratvādbādheta, tataśca lohitiketyeva syāt‌, na lohiniketi;ubhayamapīṣyate, tadarthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇam |
nanu ca `lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ ca' ityanenaivaitatsiddham, tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati, katham ? `varṇādanudāttāt‌' ityatra veti vartate, tatra ṅyābantābhyāṃ lohinīlohitāśabdābhyāṃ kani vihite yatāyogaṃ hrasvatvetvayoḥ kṛtayorlohinikā lohitiketi siddhamiṣṭam | tadevaṃ sati ṅyābgrahaṇe liṅganimittena pratyayena vikalpena bādhā yathā syānnityaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tāvanna vaktavyam---lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ veti | nāpi pratipadavihitatvena kanā liṅganimittasya pratyayasya nitye bādhe prāpte | vikalpena bādhā yathā syādityevamarthamapi vaktavyam; ṅyābgrahaṇasyānanyārthatvāt‌ | yadi hyetaśvetaśabdābhyāmatyantasvārthikaḥ kanniṣyate, tadā tatra ṅyābgrahaṇasya caritārthatvāllohitaśabdātpratipadavihitena kanā ṅīpo nitye bādhe prāpte tadvaktavyam ? tadāpi vā na vaktavyam, `lohitānmaṇau' ityasyāpi punannapuṃsakayoścaritārthatvāt‌ | tadevamatyantasvārthiko'pi kan‌ ṅyantādyathā syāditi ṅībgrahaṇaṃ tāvatkarttavyam |
ābgrahaṇaṃ tu vispaṣṭārtham | tatra samāsānteṣu doṣaḥ---bahavo gomanto'syāṃ nagaryāmiti bahuvrīhau kṛte striyā anyapadārthatvānṅīp‌ ca prāpnoti kap‌ ca, ṅyābgrahaṇān‌ ṅīpi kṛte kap‌ syāt‌, tataśca bahugomatīketi rūpaṃ syāt‌, bahugomatketi ceṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ samāsārthāduttarapadādakṛta eva samāse samāsāntā bhavanti paścāttadantena samāsaḥ, evaṃ hi samāsaṃ pratyantāvayavatvamupapadyate samāsāntānām, tathā ca `na kapi' ityatra vakṣyati | tatra cottarapade samāsārthāyā vibhakteḥ purastātsamāsāntā iti kecit‌ | parastātsamāsānteṣu subluki taddhitāntatvena tataḥ supi subantasya samāsa ityanye | sarvathā bahucarmiketītvaṃ prāpnoti, `asupaḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt‌, yathā bahuparivrājakā madureti ? karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ | `nañastatpuruṣāt‌' ityādau tu granthavirodhaṃ tatra tatra parihariṣyāmaḥ | tadevaṃ sthitametat---tadantāttaddhitavidhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ vipratiṣedhāddhi taddhitabalīyastvamiti |
yadyevam, `yūnastiḥ' `ūṅutaḥ' iti tyūṅorapi grahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ tadantāttaddhitavidhānārtham---yuvatitarā | bhāṣyakāraprayogāt‌ `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' iti puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati, khid‌dhādiṣu puṃvadbhāvād‌ hrasvatvaṃ vipratiṣedheneti vā parjanyavallakṣaṇapravṛttyā hrasvena bādhitatvāt‌ | brahmabandhūtarā `nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām' iti hrasvābhāvapakṣe `jāteśca' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ | pūrvatra tvanena pratiṣedho na labhyate; yauvanasyājātitvāt‌ | yāvad‌dravyabhāvinī hi jātiḥ, tathā ca yuvajānirityudāhṛtam | nanvatrāntaraṅgatvādeva tyūṅau bhaviṣyataḥ, atyantasvārthike tu kani brahmabandhuketyatra `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasve sati nāsti viśeṣaḥ---ūṅantādvotpattau satyām, ukārāntādvā, yuvatiśabdādapi kani puṃvadbhāvena bhvāyamiti nāstyeva viśeṣaḥ | na cāsmātkanniṣyata ityatrāpi pramāṇamasti | tasmānnārthastyūṅorgrahaṇena ||
svaujasamīṭ‌chaṣṭābhyāṃbhisṅebhyāmbhyasṅasibhyāmbhyasṅasosāmṅyossup‌ || 4.1.2 ||
ukārādayo'nubandhā ityādi | tatra prathamaikavacanasyokāraḥ `etattadoḥ sulopaḥ', `dīrghātsutisi' ityatra kevalasya vyañjanasyoccārayitumaśakyatvāduccāraṇārthaḥ | atra tu sūtre aukāropaśle ṣācchakyate sakāramātramuccārayitum | `anaṅsau' ityatra viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati; vyāvarttyasyābhāvāt‌ | na ca `anaṅ‌si' ityucyamāne varṇanirdeśe ca tadādividhisambhavātsaptamībahuvacane'pi prasaṅgaḥ; `sarvanāmasthāne' ityanuvṛtteḥ | jaso jakāro'sminneva sūtre'sandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ; anyathā hyaukārasyāvādeśe sandehaḥ syāt‌---kimaukārasyoccāraṇam, athāvityasyeti | `jasaḥ śī' ityādau viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati; `asaḥ śī' ityucyamāne'pyatiprasaṅgābhāvāt‌, śasādīnāṃ sānubandhakatvāt‌ | śasaśśakāra auṭaṣṭakārasyāsandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ; anyathā ḍakāraṣṭakāra iti sandehaḥ syāt| `tasmācchasaḥ' ityādau viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati; jasādīnāṃ sānubandhakatvāt‌ | `ṭā' ityatra ṭakāraḥ `ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ; anyathā `supāṃ suluk‌' ityādinā vihitasyākārasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | tadevameṣāṃ caturṇāmukārādaya uccāraṇaviśeṣaṇārthāḥ | itsaṃjñāpyeṣāṃ prayoge śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi, na punaritkāryaṃ kiñcidasti | auṭaṣṭakāraḥ suḍiti pratyāhāragrahaṇārthaḥ | ṅeprabhṛtiṣu ṅakāraḥ `gherṅiti' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ | ṅaserikāraḥ `yuṣmadasmadbhāṃ ṅaso'ś‌' ityatra grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ | pakāraḥ pratyāhāragrahaṇārtha iti | ukārādayo'nubandhā yathāyogamuccāraṇaviśeṣaṇārthā ityanenāgatārthatvādidamuktam | evaṃ ca---`auṭaṣṭakāraḥ suḍiti pratyāhārārthaḥ' ityagrimagranthena bhavitavyam |
kva punarime'rthe svādayo bhavantītyāha---saṃkhyākarmādayaśceti | śāstrāntareṇeti | `bahuṣu bahuvacanam', `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādinā | tena sahāsyaikavākyateti | pūrvaṃ tvavāntaravākyabhedāpekṣayā śāstrāntareṇetyuktam | ākāṃkṣāyogyatāvaśena bhinnaprakaraṇapaṭhitānāmapyekavākyatā bhavatyeva | prakaraṇabhedena tu pāṭhastiṅādividhināpyekavākyatvaṃ yathā syāditi | `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatra tu bhinnavākyatvamāśrityoktam-ṅyāppratipadikātsvādayo lasya tibādaya iti bahuvacanaṃ vihitaṃ tasyānena bahutvaṃ saṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyate iti | avyayeyastu niḥ saṃkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ khādayo vidyanta eveti ca | ekavākyatāyāṃ tu viśiṣṭe evārthe karmādisambandhinyekatvādau svādīnāṃ vidhānātsāmānyavihitatvaṃ nopapadyate | tasmād‌ `avyayādāpsupaḥ' ityavyayādutpannasya supo lugvidānālliṅgādavyayebhyo'sminpakṣe svādyutpattiḥ | udāharaṇāni yathāyogaṃ sve sve vākye prakaṭīkariṣyante ||
striyām || 4.1.3 ||
ṅyāporanenaiva vidhānāditi | prātipadikamātramatra prakaraṇe'bhisambadhyata ityatrāyaṃ hetuḥ | prakaraṇāpekṣayā caitaducyate, sūtrāntaravyāpārasamaye tu sūtrāntaravihitapratyayāntā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatyeva | nanu cātra prakaraṇe sarvatra sati sambhave `ataḥ' iti sambadhyarte, na ca ṅyābantamadantam | uktārthatvācca ṅyābantāt‌ ṅyāporaprasaṅgaḥ ? satyam ; nyāyastu nirūpyate |
codayati---striyāmityucyate iti | saptamīnirdeśena kāryāntaravidhānārthamanūdyate ityarthaḥ | tataḥ kimityāha---keyaṃ strī nāmeti | iha śāstre striyā aparibhāṣitatvāllaukikastrīgrahaṇe ca khaṭ‌vādāvavyāptiprasaṅgātprasiddhavadanuvādo'nupapanna ityarthaḥ | svarūpasya ca jijñāsitatvātprathamāntena praśnaḥ, kasyāṃ striyāmiti tūcyamāne viśeṣaviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ syāt‌ | strīgrahaṇaṃ ca prasaṅgena punnapuṃsakayorapi pradarśanārtham | ata evottare sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ strītvādaya iti trayāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ darśitam | evaṃ ca prathamopanipātini `hrasvo napuṃsake' ityatra liṅgasvarūpanirūpaṇamucitam, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | tatra laukikānāṃ lakṣaṇam---
stanakeśavatī strī syāllomaśaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ubhayorantaraṃ yacca tadabhāve napuṃsakam || iti |
bhūmādau matup‌, tathaiva lomaśa iti śaḥ | stanakeśavattvaṃ ca prasiddhatvādanyasyāpi kumāryādigatasya strīpratipattihetorupalakṣaṇam | lomaśatvaṃ ca puṃvijñānahetoḥ kumārādigatasya | ubhayorapi strīpuṃsayoryadantaraṃ sadṛśaṃ stanalomādyubhayavyañjanaṃ tannapuṃsakamityarthaḥ | tenāvyayākhyātārthasya strīpuṃsatvābhāve'pi napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavati, anyathā `tadabhāve' ityetāvatyukte syātpasaṅgaḥ, tadabhāva ityanena kukkuṭamayūryādeḥ strīpuṃsasamudāyarūpasya dvandvārthasya napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavati | bhavati hi samudāyaḥ samudāyinaḥ sadṛśa iti syātprasaṅgaḥ | nāyaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, `paravalliṅgam' ityanena samudāyasya paravalliṅgātideśāt‌ ? satyam; idaṃ tu vastusvarūpanirūpaṇaparaṃ draṣṭavyam | tadanena stanakeśādisambandhaḥ, stanādaya eva vā viśiṣṭasaṃsthānāḥ, tadupavyañjanā vā jātayaḥ strītvādaya ityuktaṃ bhavati |
atra pakṣe bhrukuṃse ṭāp‌ prasajyeta, bhrukuṃsaḥ-strīveṣadhārī naṭaḥ, tasya stanakeśasambandhaṃ upalabhyate, kharakuṭyādīnāṃ ca lomaśatvātpuṃstve sati kharakuṭīḥ paśyetyatra natvaṃ prāpnoti | kharakuṭī-nāpitagṛhamucyate | nanu ca svābhāvikapariṇāmaśālibhiḥ stanādibhiratra sambandho vivakṣitaḥ, na yathākathañcit‌ ; stanādi ca prasiddhasyānyasyāpyupalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tatkuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tahi khaṭvāvṛkṣau na sidhyataḥ, khaṭ‌vāvṛkṣādīnāṃ stanalomādyabhāvāt‌ | syādetat---yathā vastrāntarhitāni dravyāṇi nopalabhyante, tadvatkhaṭ‌vāvṛkṣayoḥ sadeva liṅgaṃ nopalabhyata iti ? tanna; vastrāntarhitāni dravyāṇi vastrāpāye upalabhyante khaṭ‌vāvṛkṣayostilaśastatkṣaṇe'pi liṅgaṃ nopalabhyate | yathā tarhyādityagatiḥ satī pratyakṣeṇa nopalabhyate deśāntaraprāptyā tvanumīyate, tathā khaṭ‌vāvṛkṣayorapi sadeva liṅgaṃ sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyate |
satāmapi hi bhāvānāṃ ṣaḍ‌bhiḥ prakārairanupalabdhirbhavati---atisannikarṣād‌, yathā---svacakṣurgatasyāñjanādeḥ | ativiprakarṣāt‌, yathā-uḍ‌ḍīnasya śakuneḥ | mūrtāntarddhānāt‌, yathā---kuḍyādivyavahitasya suvarṇādeḥ | andhakārāvṛtatvāt‌, yathāandakārākrāntasya ghaṭādeḥ | indriyadaurbalyāt‌-timirādyupaghāte cakṣurādeḥ | atipramādāt‌---`prāmādo'navadhānatā', viṣayāntaravyāsaktacitto hi sannikṛṣṭamaprayarthaṃ nopalabhyate | saukṣmyaṃ tu---indriyadaurbalya evāntarbhūtam, divyacakṣuḥ śrotro hi sūkṣmamapyarthamupalabhate | evaṃ samānābhihāro'pi tatraivāntarbhūtaḥ, tadyathā māṣarāśaumāṣaḥ prakṣiptaḥ pṛthagnopalabhyate | evamabhibhavo'pi, tadyathā---saurībhiḥ prabhābhirabhibhūtāni nakṣatrāṇi divā nopalabhyante | kema punaretadavasīyate khaṭ‌vāvṛkṣayoḥ sadeva liṅgaṃ nopalabhyata iti ? ṭābādestatkṛtasyānanyakāryasya darśanāt‌ | yadyevam, itaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti---liṅgāvagamāṭṭābādiśabdaprayogaḥ, tadyogālliṅgāvagatiriti ? indriyadaurbalyaṃ kadācidupalabdhasya kadācidanupalambhe kāraṇaṃ śakyamabhidhātum, khaṭ‌vādiṣu ca liṅgasya kadācidapyanupalambhālliṅgaviviktakhaṭ‌vādivastugrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa liṅgābhāvaniścayāttadviruddhamanumānaṃ nodetumarhati | na hi śakyate vaktum---bhikṣugṛhaṃ gajavad‌ deśatvādgajaśālāvat‌, pratyakṣeṇendriyadaurbalyāttu gajo nopalabhyata iti, tasmādasadeva liṅgaṃ śabdaprayogamahimna khaṭ‌vādiṣu pratīyate | bhavatvevaṃ śrotuḥ pratītiḥ, yastvasau prayoktā sa kena liṅgamagamya tadanurūpaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṅ‌kte ! kiñca---kumāryarthaḥ, kumārī vastviti kumāryādiṣvarthavastuśabdayoḥ punnapuṃsakayoranupapattiḥ | bhāṣye tu---
āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścetyanapāyinaḥ |
dharmā mūrttiṣu sarvāsu liṅgatvenānudarśitāḥ ||
āvirbhāvaḥ-upacayaḥ, puṃstvam ; tirobhāvaḥ-apacayaḥ, strītvam ; antarālāvasthā sthitirnapuṃsakatvamityarthaḥ | kasya punarāvirbhāvādikaṃ liṅgam ? sattvarajastamasāṃ gumānāṃ tatpariṇāmarūpāṇāṃ ca tadātmakānāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhānām | śabdādisaṅghātarūpāśca sarvā mūrtayaḥ pratikṣaṇapariṇāmasvabhāvāśca sattvādayo guṇā na svasminnātmani mūhūrtamapyavatiṣṭhante | evaṃ śabdādaya ākāśādayo ghaṭādayaśca |
uktañca---
sarvamūrttyātmabhūtānāṃ śabdādīnāṃ gaṇe gaṇe |
trayaḥ sattvādidharmāste sarvatra samavasthitaḥ || iti |
kvathitodakavaccaiṣāmanavasthitavṛttitā |
ajasraṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ bhāṣya evopavarṇitā || iti ca |
tathā---
rūpasya cātmamātrāṇāṃ śuklādīnāṃ pratikṣaṇam |
kācitpralīyate kācit‌ kathaṃcidabhivardhate || iti |
pravṛttimantaḥ sarve hi tisṛbhiśca pravṛttibhiḥ |
satataṃ na viyujyante vācaścaivātra sambhavaḥ || iti ca |
ṭābādyantaḥ śabda evaitā avasthā gocarayatītyarthaḥ | puruṣo yadyapyapariṇāmī, tathāpi---
ucetaneṣu saṅ‌krāntaṃ caitanyamiva dṛśyate |
pratibimbakadharmeṇa yattadvāco nibandhanam ||
tataśca---
yaścāpravṛttidharmārthascitirūpeṇa gṛhyate |
anuyātīva so'nyeṣāṃ pravṛttiviṣvagāśrayā ||
sāmānyamapi gotvādi vyakteravyatirekataḥ |
pravṛttidharmaṃ tad‌dvārā śaśaśrṛṅgādivākṣu tu ||
tasmāduktapadārthasya sambhavālliṅgayogitā |
pravṛtterapi vidyante tisro hyetāḥ pravṛttayaḥ ||
punnapuṃsakatā strītvaṃ tena syādanyaliṅgatā |
tadevaṃ sarvapadārthavyāpitvādupacayāntarālāvasthāstrīṇi liṅgāni | evaṃ ca nakṣatre tārakā tiṣyaḥ, kumāryartho vastu iti ekasyāpyarthasya nānāliṅgayoga upapadyate; āvirbhāvāditrayasyāpi guṇabhedena nasminnevārthe sarvadā sambhavāt‌ | na caivaṃ tad‌vṛtteḥ sarvasyaiva śabdasya triliṅgatāprasaṅgaḥ; na hyasti niyamaḥ---yaḥ śabdo yatrārthe paryavasyati tatra vidyamānaḥ sarva evākārastena śabdenābhidhātavya iti, kintu ya ākāro'bhīdhīyate tena satā bhavitavyamityetāvat‌ | tadyathā---takṣā, yuvā, kṛṣṇaḥ, kāmuka iti takṣādaśabdānāmekārthaparyavasitānāmapi vyavasthita evākāro vācyaḥ | tathā liṅgeṣvapi draṣṭavyam | uktaṃ ca---
sannidhāne padārthānāṃ kiñcideva pravartakam |
yathā takṣādiśabdānāṃ liṅgeṣu niyamastathā || iti |
upacīyate kumārītyatrāpi kumārīśabdaḥ svamahimnā kasyaciddharmasyāpacayamevāha | śabdāntaraprayogāttu dharmāntarasyopacayaḥ pratīyate | evaṃ kṣīyate vṛkṣa ityatrāpacayaḥ, tadevaṃ sarvamanākulamidaṃ darśanam |
vṛttikārastu laukikānāmevaṃ pratipatterabhāvāttatpratipatyanuguṇaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayati---sāmānyaviśeṣā iti | kānicitsāmānyānītyarthaḥ |
yadvā---sattāvyatirikteṣu sāmānyeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdo rūḍhaḥ | tisro'vāntarajātaya ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca---
tisro jātaya evaitāḥ keṣāñcitsamavasthitāḥ |
aviruddhā viruddhābhirgomahiṣyādijātibhiḥ ||
hastinyāṃ vaḍavāyāṃ ca strītvabuddheḥ samanvayaḥ |
atastāṃ jātimicchanti dravyādisamavāyinīm || iti |
nanu caiṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ sarvārtheṣu sadbhāvo'bhyupagantavyaḥ, na gotvādikatkatipayeṣvevārtheṣu, kathamanyathārthavyaktivastvādiśabdānāṃ bhinniliṅgānāmekasminnarthe prayogaḥ syāt‌ | tataśca sarvatra triliṅgapatibhāsaṃprasaṅga ityata āha---bahuprakārāvyaktaya iti | vyajyante sāmānyaviśeṣā ābhiriti vyaktayaḥ- āśrayāḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati---vicitratvādāśrayāṇāṃ vyañjakānāṃ kaścidāśrayaḥ kasyacitsāmānyaviśeṣasya vyañjakaḥ, na sarvaḥ sarvasyeti | tatra cetaneṣu stanādimatī vyaktiḥ strītvasya vyañjikā, lomaśatvādimatī puṃstvasya, ubhayavyañjanā napuṃsakatvasya ; acetaneṣu katham, na hi tatra kiñcidapi liṅgaṃ vyajyate ? tathā cetane'pyarthavyaktivastvādiśabdānāṃ bhinniliṅgānāmapyanupapattiḥ, dāraśabdasya ca puṃlliṅgasya bhāryāyāmanupattiḥ ? ata āha---kvacidāśrayaviśeṣābhāvāditi | tadabhivyañjanasamartha āśrayaviśeṣaḥ | tatrācetaneṣu sarvatropadeśādevābhivyaktiḥ | upadeśaḥ punarliṅgānuśāsanādiṣu | atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha---yathā brāhmaṇatvādaya iti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyādivyaktīnāmatyantasādṛśyādupadeśādeva brāhmaṇatvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhavati; no khalu brāhmaṇakṣatriyayoḥ puro'vasthitayorayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ, ayaṃ kṣatriya iti prāgevopadeśātpratyaya udeti | yathā gavāśvavyaktyorabhāve śaśaviṣāṇādāvapyuttarapadārthadvārakaḥ sāmānyayogaḥ, sāmānyaṃ jātiḥ, strītvaṃ strītā puṃstvaṃ puṃstetyādau sāmānve'pi sāmānyāntarasya sadbhāvaḥ, yathā---gotvādau sattāsāmānyasya | na hyasmākaṃ vaiśeṣikāṇāmiva niḥ sāmānyāni sāmānyāni |
strīśabdo'yaṃ śuklādiśabdavad‌guṇamātre guṇini ca vartate, tatra yadā guṇamātre strīśabdo vartate tadā dravyavācinaḥ prātipadikātstrītve'bhidheye ṭābādayo bhavantīti strītvaṃ pratyayārtha iti pakṣo bhavati | yadā tu strītvayuktaṃ dravyaṃ strīśabdenocyate tadā paraṃ pakṣadvayaṃ sambhavati---strītvamupalakṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇaṃ veti | tatrādye strītvopalakṣitadravyācinaḥ prātipadikāṭṭābādaya iti, ayaṃ strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi pakṣo bhavati | dvitīye tu strītvayuktadravyavācino'ṅgokṛtastrītvātprātipadikāditi prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ strītvamiti pakṣo bhavati | tatra strīsamānādhikaraṇāditi ced‌ bhūtādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ---būtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī, pradhānamiyaṃ brāhmaṇī āvapanamiyamuṣṭriketi | ubhayostu pakṣayornaiṣa doṣaḥ, katham ? bhūtādayaḥ caitanyaprādhānyasambhavanavad‌vṛttayaḥ, na tu strītvāṅgīkāreṇa vartante | tadevamatra pakṣe doṣadarśanāditarayoranyataradāśrayaṇīyamityāha---strītvaṃ ceti | ubhayathāpi yujyate iti | nanu pratyayārthapakṣe dvivacanabahuvacanānekapratyayānupapattiḥ, katham ? eko'yamarthaḥ strītvaṃ nāma, tadeva ca prakṛtyarthopasarjanaṃ pratyayenābhidhīyate, tasyaikatvādekavacanameva prāpnoti ? anekaśca pratyayo nopapadyate---gārgyāyaṇī, kārīṣagandhyā, kālitareti, katham ? eko'yamarthaḥ strītvaṃ nāma tasyaikenoktatvād‌ dvitīyaḥ pratyayo na prāpnoti---uktārthānāmaprayoga iti ? strīśabde cekāro na prāpnoti, saṃstyāne `styāyaterḍraṭ‌' iti ḍraṭ‌pratyayāntena strīśabdenoktatvāt‌ saṃstyānaṃ strītvam ? sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca na syāt‌---kumārī devadatteti, svasvaprakṛtyarthāvacchinnayoḥ strītvayoḥ prādhānyenābhidhānāt‌, tatra vyatirikanibandhā ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, kutaḥ ? na tāvadanya'nyataḥ ; parasparaṃ guṇaguṇibhāvābhāvāt‌, nāpi strīpratyayaprakṛteḥ ; ṭābādibhirbādhitvāt‌ ? yatra tarhi pratiyogini strīpratyayaḥ pratiṣidhyate tatra ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti---pañca brāhmaṇyaḥ, svasābhirūpeti ? pakṣāntare tu dvayorapi dravyaniṣṭhatvādvyatirekābhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bhavati, dravyasya cānekatvād‌ dvivacanabahuvacane api yukte | yathaiva ca prātipadikenokte'pi strītve ṭābādayo bhavanti, tathāneko'pi pratyayo nānupapannaḥ, tad‌dyotako hi tadā nānāpratyayaḥ, pradīpādeścānekasyāpi dyotakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | pratyayārthapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ | yadyapi strītvamātre vācye pratyayaḥ kriyate, tathāpi strītvatadāśrayayorabhedavivakṣayā svābhāvikatvādvā guṇapradhānabhāvasya dvayorapi dṛṣṭatvena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vacanabhedaśca bhaviṣyati | gārgyāyaṇītyādau ca dvābhyāmeva strītvamabhidhātuṃ śakyate, naikena; svabhāvāt‌ | yadvā---ṣphasya ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyānṅīṣ‌ siddhaḥ, ṣyaṅi `yaṅaścāp‌' iti vacanasāmarthyāccāb‌ bhaviṣyati | tathā hi---atra yaṅ‌ṣyaṅoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇāya tadavighātāya ca ṣyaṅonubandhadvayaṃ kṛtam, kālitaretyatrānyaḥ prakarṣayukto'nyaścāprakarṣayuktaḥ, tatrāvasthābhedādeka evārtho bhidyata iti prakarṣayuktasyānabhihitaṃ strītvamiti tadabhidhānāya ṭābapi bhaviṣyāta | strīśabde'pi `striyām' ityasmādeva nipātanādīkāraḥ siddha iti suṣṭhūktam---ubhayathāpiyujyata iti ||
ajādyataṣṭāp‌ || 4.1.4 ||
adantācceti | akārāntādityarthaḥ | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; acchabdāntāt‌ nītat parītat‌ kaliṅgagadityādeḥ strīliṅgāditi, `tadādyācikhyāsāyām' ityādernirdeśāt‌ | pakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha iti | `ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' ityādau | pakārānurodhastu ṭābḍāpoḥ svarthaḥ | ṭakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtha iti | anyathaikānubandhakatvādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na tu ḍāpcāpoḥ | khaṭ‌veti | kathaṃ punaratrākārāntā prakṛtiravadhāryate, yāvatā nityamevāyamābantaḥ striyāṃ vartate ? śāstrātprayogācca | śākaṭāyanadarśane hi sarveṣāmeva vyutpattiḥ | pañcabhiḥ khaṭ‌vābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcakhaṭ‌va ityādau strīpratyaye lupte prayoga evākārāntatvaṃ dṛśyate | śubhaṃyāḥ, kīlālapā iti | `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti vic‌ | kaḥ punaratra ṭāpi sati doṣa ityāha---halḍyābbhya iti sulopaḥ syāditi |
kvacijjātilakṣaṇa iti | gaṇapāṭhāvasare vibhāgaṃ darśayiṣyati |
halantānāṃ tvityādi | ajādigrahaṇamiti | prakṛtasya prathamāntasyānvayāsambhavāttadarthamajādigrahaṇamiti śeṣaḥ |
amahatpūrveti | mahacchabdasyānukaraṇatvāllaukikārthābhidhāyitvābhāvāt‌ `ānmahataḥ' ityāttvaṃ na bhavati | puṃyoge tuṅīṣaiveti | jātigrahaṇasya prayojanamāha | nanu puṃyoge so'yamityabhisambandhātparaśabdaḥ paratra vartata iti gauṇatvādeva na bhaviṣyati ? tasmātsukhapratipatyarthaṃ jātigrahaṇam | amahatpūrvetyasyāthemāha---mahatpūrvasveti | atrāpi jātiriti sambadhyate, iha pratiṣedho mā bhūt‌---mahatī śūdrā mahāśūdreti, na hyatra mahatpūrvaḥ samudāyo jātivacanaḥ | kva tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ ? yatra samudāyo jātau vartate | tadidaṃ darśitam---mahāśūdraśabdo hyābhīrajātivacana iti | yadyevam, samudāye jātivacane gaurakharādivadavayavārthā bhāvādvyutpattimātraṃ kriyate, tatrāvayavārthasya strītvasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌ puṃsi samāse kṛte ṭāpaḥ prasaṅga iti ? tatrāmahatpūrveti pratiṣedhaḥ sārthakaḥ | tataḥ kim ? amahatpūrvetyatra jātiriti na sambandhanīyam | kathaṃ mahatī śūdrā mahāśūdretyatrāntaraṅgatvāṭṭāpi kṛte paścātsup‌, subantasya samāsaḥ, tataścābhinirvṛttatvāṭṭāpaḥ pratiṣedhasyāprasaṅgaḥ ? satyam, vispaṣṭārthamevātrāpi jātiriti sambadhyate | nanu ca śūdraśabdaḥ paṭhyate, kaḥ prasaṅgo yanmahāśūdraśabdātsyāt‌ ? ata āha---tadantavidhirneti | atidhīvarī, atipīvarīti | dadhāteḥ pibateśca `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' iti kvanipi kṛte ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam, dhīvānamatikrāntā pīvānamatikrānteti prādisamāsaḥ, atra `vano ra ca' iti ṅībrau bhavataḥ | asati tu jñāpane vana iti pratyayagrahaṇam | athāpi kṛd‌grahaṇam ? sarvathātikrāntapradhāne samāse na syāt‌ | atibhavatī, atimahatīti | `ugitaśca' ityatrogidityugitprātipadikasyaivaṃ grahaṇamityaṅgīkṛtyedaṃ prayojanaṃ darśitam | tatra tu vakṣyati---`ugiditi prātipadikāprātipadikagrahaṇam, tena grahaṇavatā prātipadikeneti niṣedhābhāvāttadantavidhiḥ' iti | yadāha---`ugidyasya sambhavati yathākathciditi tadantātprātipadiṃkāt‌' iti ca ||
atimahatītyatra śatṛvadbhāvādauṇādikādugillakṣaṇo ṅīp‌ | kecidgaurādipāṭhād‌ ṅīṣaṃ varṇayanti, tadayuktam ; anupasarjanādhikārāt‌ | kiñca, gaurādipāṭhasya prayojanamapi na paśyāmaḥ | nanu ca mahatīśabdo'ntodātta iṣyate, satyam; `śaturanumaḥ' ityatra nadyajādyudāttatve `bṛhanmahatorupasaṃkhyānam' ityanenaiva siddham | vibhavatyudāttārthaṃ taditi cet ? tadeva ṅībudāttārthamapi bhaviṣyati | atimahatītyādau ca ṅīṣabhāvasyoktatvān‌ ṅībudāttārthamapyupasaṃkhyānameṣṭavyam, yudi tadantavidhirjñāpyate, pañcānāmajānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcājī---dvigorapi ṭāp‌ prāpnoti ? atrāhuḥ---`ajādyataḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī ajādīnāmajantānāṃ ca yā strī tadvācye'rthe yat‌ strītvaṃ samavetaṃ tatra ṭābiti, pratyāsatyā ca strītvaviśeṣopalakṣaṇānāmeva prakṛtitvaṃ vijñāyate iti matvā vṛttikāreṇoktam---`ajādibhyaḥ prātipadikebhyo'dantācca' iti | na ca pañcājītyatrājārthe samavetaṃ strītvam, kiṃ tarhi ? samāhāre |
evaṃ cāmahatpūrveti pratiṣedhaḥ śakyo'kartum, na hi mahāśūdrītyatra śūdrārthagataṃ strītvam | tadantavidhistu ` anupasarjanāt‌' ityatra jñāpayiṣyate | satprākkāṇḍeti | pākakarṇetyatra vārttikam---`sadackāṇḍaprāntaśataikebhyaḥ puṣpātpratiṣedhaḥ' iti, tatraiva bhāṣyam---`prākpuṣpā ca pratyakpuṣpā ca' iti | tasmādatrāpi prākśabdo na paṭhanīyaḥ, sadackāṇḍetyeva paṭhanīyam ||
ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌ || 4.1.5 ||
ṅakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha iti | `ṅyāppratipadikāt‌' ityādau |
`pakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthaḥ' iti tu pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam, atrāpi pakārānurodho'nudāttārthaḥ ||
ugitaśca || 4.1.6 ||
yathākathañciditi | yadi varṇa ugit‌ saṃbhavati, yadi vā pratyayaḥ, athāpi prātipadikam---sarvathā yatraiṣāmanyatamaḥ prakāraḥ saṃbhavatītyeṣa yathākathañcidityasyārthaḥ | etadeva spaṣṭayati---tadugicchabdarūpamiti | pratyayāpratyayoḥ prātipadikāprātipadikayoḥ śabdarūpamanyapadārthaḥ, na prātipadikameva, nāpi pratyaya evetyarthaḥ | tatrogitā prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇattadantavidhirbhavatītyāha---tadantāditi | pacantīti | atra śatṛpratyaya ugit‌ tadantaṃ prātipadikam---atibhavatī atimahatītyatrāpi bhavati | `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' ityayaṃ tu pratiṣedho yatra sūtropāttaṃ prātipadikasyāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ tatraiva bhavatītyatrāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhavati | `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityayaṃ tu niṣedhaḥ prātipadikasyaivā sādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇe atigomatītyatrāpi bhavati | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā tu pratyayasyaivāsādhāraṇarūpagrahaṇe bhavati |
ghātostūgitaḥ pratiṣedha iti | vaktavya iti śeṣaḥ | sa tarhi vaktavyaḥ ? na vaktavyaḥ, `ugidacām' ityatrogittvādeva siddhe'ñcatigrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham---iha śāstre ugito yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate taddhātoryadi bhavati añcatereveti kāryamātraṃ niyamyate, na numāgama eva | adhātugrahaṇaṃ cādhātupūrvasyāpi numarthamiti tatraiva vakṣyate |
apara āha---`ugitaśca' iti yo'yaṃ caśabdaḥ so'ñcaterluptanakārasyākaraṇam, vibhakteśca `supāṃ suluk‌' iti luk‌, bhāvinaṃ cākāralopamāśritya ceti nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataścāñcatigrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham---"akāranakāralopayoścātantratvāt‌ `nāñceḥ pūjāyām' iti lopaniṣedhaviṣaye'pi ṅīb‌ bhavati, prāñcī pratyañcī brāhmaṇī" iti | ukhāsrat‌, parṇadhvaditi | `kvip‌ ca' ityatrānayorvyutpattiḥ kṛtā ||
vano ra ca || 4.1.7 ||
`vanaḥ' iti kvanibvanibṅ‌vanipāṃ pratyayānāṃ sāmānyena grahaṇam, na `vana ṣaṇa saṃbhaktau', `vanu yācena' iti dhātvorvijantayoḥ, kutaḥ ? `pratyayāpratyayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam' iti | ata eva śuno niṣkrāntā yuvānamatikrāntā niḥ śunī atiyūnītyatrāpi na bhavati, anarthakatvādvā | śarvarīti | `śṝ hiṃsāyām', `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti vanip‌ | paralokadṛśvarīti | `dṛśeḥ kvanip‌' |
vano na haśa iti | vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ haśgrahaṇam, haśantāddhātoryo vanvihitastadantātprātipadikān‌ ṅībrau na bhavata ityarthaḥ, tena śarvarītyatra pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ | tathā `oṇṛ apanayena' vanipi `viḍ‌vanoranunāsikasyāt‌' ityāttve avādeśeavāvannityatra saṃprati haśaḥ | paratvābhāve'pi haśantādvihitatvāt‌ pratiṣedho bhavatyeva---avāvā brāhmaṇīti | taṣa eva sthitaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
bahulaṃ chandasi ṅībrau vaktavyau---yajvarīriṣaḥ | praīriśavostuṭ‌ ca---prertvarī ||
pādo'nyatarasyām || 4.1.8 ||
pāda iti kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pādaśabdo nirdiśyata iti | uttarasūtre ṛcyabhidheyāyāṃ tasyaiva sambhavāt‌, tena pādayate kvibantasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati | dvipadīti | dvau pādāvasya iti `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyāsupūrvasya' ityakāralope `pādaḥ pat‌' iti padbhāvaḥ ||
ṭābṛci || 4.1.9 ||
ṛcītyabhidheyanirdeśa iti | vyāpteḥ | viṣayanirdeśe hi ṛgvedaviṣaya eva prayoge syāt, nānyatra ||
na ṣaṭ‌svasrādibhyaḥ || 4.1.10 ||
`ṭābṛci' iti pādantādvihitasya ṭāpo'trāprasaṅgāttadanantarasya ṅīpo'yaṃ pratiṣedha ityāśaṅkāmapanayati---yo yata iti | tatra sarvebhya eva ṅīpprāpnoti, ṭāptu nalope satyakārāntatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ṣaḍ‌bhya eva | yo yaḥ prāpta iti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ, anyathā sa tato na bhavatīti vācyaṃ syāt‌, vyāptiśca na gamyeta | pañca brāhmaṇya iti | nanu cātra brāhmaṇīśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt‌ strītvāvagatiḥ, saṃkhyāśabdastu svamahimnā bhedagaṇanamāha | tathā hi---pañcetyukte nānātvamātraṃ dravyasya gamyate, na liṅgaviśeṣaḥ ; tathā ca liṅgānuśāsaneṣu `ṣṇāntā saṃkhyā' ityaliṅgatvamuktam | yadyevam, ekā, dve, bahvya ityatrāpi pratyayo na syāt‌ ? saṃkhyāśabdatvena bhedagaṇanāmātrasya śabdārthatvāt‌ | atha tatra strītvamapi śabdārthaḥ ? pañcādiṣvapi syāt‌ | vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ---sati tasmin‌ pratiṣedhe nāntareṇānuprayogaṃ pañcetyādau strītvādyabhivyaktiriti liṅgānuśāsaneṣvaliṅgatvamuktam ; asati tu pratiṣedhe pañcādibhyaḥ strīpratyayo na bhavati, ekādibhyastu bhavatīti na śāstraikaśaraṇaḥ pratipattumarhati | nanu vibhaktau parataḥ `tricaturoḥ striyām' tisṛcatasṛbhāvaḥ, tatraṃ saṃnipātaparibhāṣayaiva ṅībabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkiṃ tisṛcatasṛśabdayoḥ svasrādipāṭhena ? jñāpanārtha tu | etajjñāpayati---anityā saṃnipātaparibhāṣeti, tena tyadādyatve kṛte ṭāb‌ bhavati---yā, sā, ime, dve iti |
ṅīpo'nantarasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho yukta ityāśritya codayati---ṣaṭ‌saṃjñānāmiti | kasmānna syāditi | ata iti hi prāpnoti, asiddho nalopaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānnaitadadantam | parigaṇiteṣu kāryeṣu nalopo'siddho bhavati, `nalopaḥ supsvara' ityasya niyamārthatvāt‌ | nedaṃ tatra parigaṇyate ? idamapi tatra pigaṇyate, katham ? subiti na saptamībahuvacanena pratyāhāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yaṅ‌ścābiti cāpaḥ pakāreṇa, tataśca ṭāpo'pi pratyāhāre'ntarbhāvāttadvidhirapi subvidhireveti | tadetadāha---pratyāhārāccāpeti | na syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ, kasmānna syāditi praśnaḥ | cāpā pratyāhārānna syāditi parihāraḥ | idaṃ cācāryadeśīyasya vacanam |
ācāryasiddhāntaṃ darśayitumetad dūṣayati---siddhaṃ doṣastvittva iti | satyaṃ siddhamidaṃ cāpā pratyāhāre, ittve tu doṣo bhavati---siddhaṃ doṣastvittva iti | satyaṃ siddhamidaṃ cāpā pratyāhāre, ittve tu doṣo bhavati---bahūni carmāṇyasyāḥ bahucarmiketi, katham ? tatra subvidhirita sarvavibhakyantāvayavaḥ samāsa āśritaḥ---supo vidhiḥ, supi vidhiriti; tataśca yathā rājabhyāmityatra `supi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati, tathā ṭāpi supi vidhīyamānamittvamapi subvidhiriti tatra vartavye nalopasyāsiddhatvātkāt‌ pūrvo'kāro na bhavatītītvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | siddhāntamāha---tasmānnobhāviti | `striyām' ityarthamātramapekṣya tatra yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati, ityevaṃ ṅīpṭāpāvubhāvapi pratiṣedhyāvityarthaḥ | nanu ca sakṛtpratiṣedhasya pravṛttiḥ, sa ca svapravṛttisamaye yasya prasaṅgastameva pratiṣedhati, tataśca pūrvaṃ ṅīpi pratiṣiddhe nalope ca kṛte paścātprāpnuvataṣṭāpaḥ kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? ātmāśrayo hi syāt‌---svapravṛttimapekṣya svapravṛttiriti | tasmāttantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇena dvirasya pravṛttiḥ, tatra dvitīyayā pravṛttyā ṭāpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||
manaḥ || 4.1.11 ||
aninasmangrahaṇānīti | an‌, in‌, as‌, man‌---ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇe arthavatparibhāṣā na vyāpriyate, tenaiṣāmanarthakānāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati | ebhiścārthavadbhiranarthakaiśca tadantavidhirbhavatītyarthaḥ | sīmanśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikam | atikrāntā mahimānamatimahimā, atrāpīmanica evārthavattvam, na tu manaḥ ||
ano bahuvrīheḥ || 4.1.12 ||
ñanupadhālopī bahuvrīhirihodāharaṇamiti | kuta etat ? ityāha---upaghālopino hītyādi, vibhāṣāṃ vakṣyatīti | `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityanena | suparvetyādi | śobhanaṃ parvāsyāḥ, śobhanaṃ carmāsyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ | ayaṃ ca `na saṃyogādvamantāt‌' ityallopasya pratiṣedhātanupadhālopī |
bahuvrīheriti kimiti | samāsāditi vācyamiti bhāvaḥ |
atirājñīti | `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaḥ' iti ṭaj‌ na bhavati; samāsāntavidheranityatvāt‌ |
ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām || 4.1.13 ||
antarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimiti | ḍāpā mukte pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ tāvadetanna kartavyam, katham ? ḍābupyucyate, pratiṣedho'pi tāvubhau vacanādbhaviṣyataḥ | yadi hi nakārāntasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt‌, tadā ḍāpaivāpavādena ṅīpo bādhāt‌ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌ | atha ḍāppratiṣedhābhyāṃ mukte ṅībapi yathā syādityevamarthamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam ? tadapi na; bahurājñītyādau `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityanenaiva ṅīpaḥ siddhatvāt‌ | yatra tarhi tena na siddhayati---atiśarmetyādau, tadarthametatsyāt‌ ? yadyevam, anenaivopadhālopino'pi siddhatvād‌ `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityetadanarthakaṃ syāt‌ | evaṃ tarhi tadanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ na kariṣyāmītidamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, katham ? anenaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenopadhālopino'nupadhālopinaśca ṅīpi prāpite sati `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityetāvadapi kriyamāṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ano bahuvrīheryan‌ ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina eveti, tataśca tadanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? tadavaśyaṃ kartavyam, asati hi tasminnanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena bahuvrīhimātrād‌ ḍāppratiṣedhaṅīpsu triṣvapi prāpteṣūpadhālopino ḍāppratiṣedhau bādhitvā nityaṃ ṅībeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ tatsyāt‌ | atastadavaśyaṃ kartavyam, idaṃ tu na kartavyamiti praśnaḥ |
pariharati---bahuvrīhāviti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---ḍāppratiṣedhābhyā mukte ṅībapi yathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ tāvadanyatarasyāgrahaṇam | na ca `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityasya vaiyarthyam ; niyamārthatvāt‌---ano bahuvrīheryadanyatarasyāṃ ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina eveti | tena suparvā, suśarmetyādāvanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena prāpito ṅīb‌ na bhavati, bahurājñītyādāveva tu bhavati | nanvevamidamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūt‌, `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityetadeva vidhyarthamastu, ko vā viśeṣaḥ ? anenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena bahuvrīhimātrān‌ ṅīpi prāpite tanniyamārthaṃ syād‌, asati vāsmin‌ ḍāppratiṣedhayoreva prāptayorupadhālopino'prāpto ṅīp‌ pakṣe vidhīyate iti ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ---asminnanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe sati ḍāppratiṣedhābhyāṃ mukte svena svena sāstreṇa ṅīb‌ bhavan‌ vannanteṣu `vano ra ca' ityanenaiva bhavatīti bahudhīvarītyādau repho'pi bhavati | evamanena vannantādupadhālopino'nupadālopinaśca bahuvrīherbahudhīvansuparvannityāderṅībrephayoḥ prāpitayoranyatra bahurājansuśarmannityādau kevale ṅīpi prāpite sati`ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhavati, tena ca niyamena suśarmetyādau ṅīb‌ vyāvartyate | suparvetyādau ṅīpi vyāvarttite tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvādrepho'pi na bhavati | bahurājñītyādau tu yathāprāpto ṅībavasthitaḥ, bahudhīvarītyādau ca `vano ra ca' ityanena prāptau ṅībrephāvavasthitāviti sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyati | asati tvasmin‌, tasmiṃśca vidhyarthe'pūrva eva ṅīp‌ tena vidhīyata iti vannante bahuvrīhau `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' ityetatsanniyuktaṃ `vano ra ca' ityetanna pravarteteti kevale ṅīpi sati bahudhīvnīti syāt‌ | ataḥ `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatanniyamārthaṃ yathā syātsvatantro vidhirmā bhūdityevamarthamihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti | tadidam `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatra vṛttikāraḥ spaṣṭayiṣyati | yadyanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pakṣe ṅībapi prāpyate dāmetyādau mannantādapi prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate---ḍābubhābhyāṃ bhavati, tataḥ `anyatarasyām;' `ano baruvrīheḥ' ityeva vartte, `manaḥ' iti nivṛttam ||
anupasarjanāt‌ || 4.1.14 ||
prasajyapratiṣedho'yamityāha---uttarasūtreṣūpasarjanapratiṣedhaṃ karotīti | paryudāse ko doṣaḥ ? kukkuṭīpāda ityatra na syāt‌ pūrvapadasyopasarjanatvāt‌, na; antaraṅgatvātprāgeva ṅīṣi kṛte tadantasya samāsaḥ | na cedānīmupasarjanatve ṅīṣaḥ paryudāsaḥ, pūrvamevābhinirvṛttatvāt‌ | kiñca prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyeṣa doṣaḥ samānaḥ | kukkuṭītyatraiva tarhi na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? anvarthamupasarjanam, apradhānamupasarjanamiti ? astvevam ; anupasarjanaṃ tūpasarjanādanyatsarvam, na tu pradhānameva, tenāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāve'pyapradhānādanyatvādbhaviṣyati | yadā tarhyadharmānṛtādivadvirodhivacano'nupasarjaśabdastadā na prāpnoti, tasmātprasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | anupasarjanādityevaṃ taditi | upasarjanānna bhavatītyevamityarthaḥ | vakṣyati---ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañiti ṅībiti | kathaṃ prathamāntasya vakṣyatītyanena sambandhaḥ ? atrāhuḥ---vakṣyati ṭiḍḍhāṇañityetāvān‌ granthaḥ | ṭiḍḍhāṇañiti vakṣyatītyarthaḥ | kaḥ punaratra pratyaya ityatrāha---ṅībiti | evaṃ jāteriti ṅīṣ‌ ityatrāpi granthacchedaḥ, tatra ca pūrvasmin‌ `vakṣyati' ityanuṣaṅgaḥ . kurucarīti | `careṣṭaḥ' bahukurucareti | bahuvrīhiḥ sarvopasarjanaḥ |
kathaṃ punarityādiḥ | pratyudāharaṇe yadupasarjanaṃ na tat striyāṃ varttate, yadā ca striyāṃ vartate tadā bhavatyeva pratyayaḥ---bahvyaḥ kurucaryo'syāṃ bahukurucarīkā, bahukukkuṭīkā madureti, yaḥ striyāṃ vartate bahuvrīhistato'ṭittvādajātitvāccāprasaṅgaḥ | tathā hi---ṭitprātipadikaṃ gṛhyate, tacca kiñcitsākṣāṭṭidbhavati, yathā---nadaṭ, coraḍiti; kiñcittvavayavaṭittvadvāreṇa | yatra hyavayavaṭittvamakiñcitkaraṃ tatra samudāyārthaṃ tadvijñāyate | sa cāvayavaḥ kvaciddhātuḥ---stanandhayīti, kvacitkṛllyuḍādiḥ, kvacittaddhitaṣṭyuṭyulādiḥ | tatra yaṃ samudāyaṃ yo'vayavo na vyabhicarati tadarthaṃ tasya ṭittvamiti kurucaraśabda eva ṭit‌, tatkuto bahukurucaraśabdātprasaṅga iti praśnaḥ | pariharati---tadantavidhineti | nanu grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, grahaṇaṃ copādānamātram, na tu svarūpeṇoccāraṇameva, tatkathaṃ tadantavidhiḥ ? syādetat--yatra gṛhyamāṇaṃ rūpaṃ prātipadikasyaivāsādhāraṇaṃ tatra tadantavidhipratiṣedhaḥ, iha coraḍityādi prātipadikamapi ṭit‌, lyuḍādipratyayo'pi, dheḍiti dhāturapi, tataśca yathā `ugitaśca' ityatra varṇo'pyugitpratyayo'pi prātipadikamapīti tadantavidhirbhavati, tathehāpi prasaṅga iti ? syādayaṃ prasaṅgo yadi ṭitā prātipadikaṃ viśṣyeta, ṭiti ca prātipadikena viśeṣyamāṇe nānena viśeṣyeṇa tadantavidhiḥ, prātipadikena cāsambhavāditi naiva bahukurucaraśabdātprasaṅga ityata āha---jñāpitaṃ caitaditi | `śūdrā cāmahatpūrvā' ityatra jñāpitametat | avaśyañcaitaj‌ jñāpitamuttaratrāpi paripālanīyamityāha---tathā ceti | anāśrīyamāṇe jñāpake'ṇantādvidhīyamāno ṅīp‌ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā kāraśabdādeva syād‌, na tvaṇantātkumbhakāraśabdāt‌ | jñāpakāttu tato'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ |
nanu ca kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayā kumbhakāraśabdasyāṇantatvam ? netyāha---na cāṇiti | kṛd‌grahaṇamiti | kiṃ kāraṇamityatrāha---taddhito'pyaṇastīti | yatra tu gṛhyamāṇaṃ rūpaṃ kṛta evāsādhāraṇaṃ tatraiṣā paribhāṣā | iha tvaupagavīti taddhitasyāpi grahaṇamiti nāyamasyā viṣaya ityarthaḥ | atha kāraśabdādutpattau satyāṃ ko doṣaḥ ? kaumbhakāreyo na sidhyati, pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā kārīśabdātstrībhyo ḍhaki tasyaiva vṛddhisvarau syātām | ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇavadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---ṣyaṅantasyocyamānaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ paramakārīṣagandhīputra ityatrāpi bhavati, strīpratyaye tadādiniyamābhāvāt‌; tathā kāraśabdādapyutpattau kumbhakārīśabdasyāpi strīpratyayāntatvādbhaviṣyati, evamapi kārīśabdādapi kadācitsyāt‌ |
atha brūyāḥ---kārīśabdena kumbhaśabdaḥ samasiṣyate, `strībhyo ḍhak‌' ityatra ca `ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' iti tritayādhikārasāmarthyātstrīpratyayāntātprātipadikāditi pratyayo vidhāsyate, strīpratyayāntasya ca prātipadikatvaṃ samāsamantareṇānupapannamiti kumbhakārīśabdādeva ḍhagutpatsyate, ḍhyābgrahaṇāmuvṛttyā ca sauparṇeya ityatrāpi bhaviṣyatīti ? evamapiṅyābanuvṛtteḥ sauparṇeya itivat‌ kārīśabdādapi syāt‌ | `gatikārakopadānām' itivacanāccaṅyante samāso durlabhaḥ, tataḥ kumbhakāraśabdādevaṅībyathā syādityuttaratrāpi tadantavidhirabhyupagantavyaḥ | na ca kumbhakāraśabdādapyutpattau tadādiniyamābhāvātkārīśabdādapi ḍhakpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? `strīpratyaye cānupasarjane na' ityanena, pratyagrahaṇe yasmātsa tadāderadhikasya grahaṇamabhyanujñāyate, na nyūnasyāpi | nanu ca satyapyuttaratra tadantavidhau kumbhakārītyatra samudāyādapi bhavatu, kevalātkāraśabdādapi prasaṅgaḥ, yathā---aupagavītyādau, tataśca kaumbhakāreyaḥ pakṣe duṣyatyeva ? evaṃ tarhi kāraśabdādapyutpattau kumbhenaikārthībhūtasya tāvato niṣkṛṣyāpatyenāyogāttadādiniyamābhāvācca samudāyādeva ḍhgabhaviṣyati |
yadvā---kumbhenaikārthībhūtasya kārasya strītvenāyogātstrīpratyaya eva na bhaviṣyati, asati punaruttaratra tadantavidhau strīpratyayasyātrāprasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? yadaṇantaṃ na tasya niṣkṛṣya strītvena yogaḥ, yasya ca strītvena yogo na tadaṇantam, ata uttaratrāpyavaśyaṃ pradhānena tadantavidhirabhyupagantavyaḥ, tatra yathā pradhānena bhavati tathopasarjanenāpi syāditi pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate | tathā ca pūrvatropasarjanenāpi tadantavidhirbhavati, `na ṣaṭ‌svasrādibhyaḥ'----priyapañcā draupadīti, atikrāntā bhavantamatibhavatīti | syādetat‌---pūrvatropāttaṃ tadantaṃ vā `striyām' ityanena viśeṣyate, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādiṣūpāttemeva ṭidādikam, tena jñāpite'pi tadantavidhau bahukurucaretyādau ṭidāderastrītvānna bhaviṣyati, kumbhakārītyatra tvaṇantasya striyāṃ vṛttestadantādapi bhaviṣyati, nārtha eteneti ? tanna; tvaduktasya viṣayavibhāgasya durjñānatvāt, ato viṣayavibhāgajñāpanārthamadamārabhyate |
nanvārabde'pyasminnaiṣa viṣayavibhāgaḥ śakya āsthātum, pañcājītyatrājānāmastrītvena tadantasya striyāṃ vṛtteḥ `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' iti ṭāpprasaṅgāt‌ | ato viśeṣaṇaviśe,yabhāvaṃ prati kāmacārāt‌ `ajādyataṣṭap‌' ityatra `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' ityādau copāttaṃ strītvena viśeṣyate, `vano ra ca' ityādāvupāttaṃ tadantasya ceti nārtha etena ? evaṃ tarhi tadantavidhijñāpanārthamidamārabhyate | amahapūrvetyetattu śakyamakartum, na hi mahāśūdretyatra samudāye jātivacane śūdraśabdaḥ striyāṃ varttate |
apara āha---laukikasyāpradhānasyopasarjanasyeha grahaṇam, tenāpiśilinā proktam, `iñaśca' ityaṇ, tato'dhyetryām `tadadhīte' ityaṇ‌, tasya `proktālluk‌' iti luk‌ āpiśilā brāhmaṇī, atra `iñaśca' iti vihitasya proktapratyayasyāṇo'pradhānatvāttadantānṅīb‌ na bhavati | nanvidānīmadhyetṛpratyaye lupte prakṛtireva tadarthamāheti pradhānastriyāmadhyetryāmaṇantasya vṛtteḥ syādeva ṅīp‌ pratyayaḥ ? syādetadevam, yadyaṇantādanupasarjanādityucyeta | vayaṃ tvaṇamevānuparsajanatvena viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---amyo'nuparjana iti, arthadvārakaṃ cāṇaḥ prādhānyam, aprādhānyaṃ ca | tadetaduktaṃ bhavati---yasminnarthe'ṇutpannaḥ sa yadā prādhānyenocyate tadā tadantānṅīb‌ bhavati; yadā tu guṇabhāvene, tadā neti | iha cādhyetryāṃ saṅ‌krāntatvātprathamasyāṇo'rtho guṇabhūta iti tadāśrayastāvanṅīb‌ na bhavati | yastvadhyetryāmutpannastadāśrayo'pi na bhavati; tasya luptatvāt‌ | pratyayalakṣaṇenāpi na bhavati, aṇaākārasya viśeṣaṇāt | `ṭiḍṭhāṇañ‌' ityatra hyata iti vartate | tatrāṇantādakārāntāditi | vijñāyamāne syāt‌ pratyayalakṣaṇam, aṇā tvakāre viśeṣyamāṇe varṇanimitto ṅīppratyayaḥ kathaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena syāt‌ ! nanu striyāmityanuvṛttenāṇaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---yo'ṇ‌ striyāṃ vihita iti ? evamapi kāśakṛtsninā proktā mīmāṃsā kāśakṛtsnī, tāmadhīte kāśakṛtsnā brāhmaṇīti dvitīye'ṇi `proktālluk‌' iti lupte'pi prathamo'pyaṇstriyāmevotpannaḥ,tadantād‌ brāhmaṇyāṃ vatamānānṅīpprasaṅgaḥ | tasmātpradhānādyathā syādapradhānānmā bhūdityetatprayojanaṃ sūtrasyeti ||
ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañdvayasajdaghnañmātractayapṭhakṭhañkañkvarapkhyunām || 4.1.15 ||
iha kasmāditi | laḍādeśasya sthānidbhāvena ṭittvamastīti praśnaḥ | pavāmānā, yajamāneti | nanu śānannādiṣu laṭa ityasya nivṛttatvād‌ anādeśapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ, pavamānetyādiṣu śānajudāhartavyaḥ | dvyanubandhakatvāllaṭa iti | laḍādiṣvakārādayo'pyanubandhā iti bhāvaḥ | etena liḍ‌lṛṭau vyākhyātau---anūcānā, yakṣyamāṇeti |
lyuḍādiṣu kathamiti | dvyanubandhakatvātteṣāmapi grahaṇe na bhāvyamiti praśnaḥ | ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāditi | na ca laḍādiṣvapi ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyamityāha---itaratreti | paṭhitā vidyeti | kathamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | iṭaṣṭittvamubhayārthaṃ syāditi praśnaḥ | āgamaṭittvamanimittamiti | āgamānāṃ ṭittvaṃ ṅīpo nimittaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | kuta ityata āha---ṭyuṭyulau tuṭ‌ ceti liṅgāditi | yadyāgamaṭittvaṃ ṅīpo nimittaṃ syāttataḥ sāyantanītyādau tuṭa āgamasya ṭittvānṅīp‌ siddha iti ṭyuṭyuloṣṭitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu ca `purāṇaprokteṣu' iti nirdeśena yadā tuḍ‌ na bhavati tadā ṅībarthaṃ tayoṣṭittvaṃ syāt‌ ? tanna; purāṇaśabdādvahvādiṣu pāṭhānṅīṣā bhavitavyam, antodātto hi purāṇīśabdaḥ---punaḥ punarjāyamānā purāṇīti yathā | evamapi na jñāpakam, `bahvādibhyaśca' ityatra veti vartate, tataśca ṅīṣā mukte ṅīb‌ yathā syāditi ṭyuṭyuloṣṭittvaṃ syāditi cintyametat |
sauparṇeyīti | suparṇaśabdātpākakarṇādiṅīṣantātstrībhyo ḍhak‌ | nanu ca sānubandhakatvādasya grahaṇena bhavitavyamata āha---nira nubandhaka iti | yadyapi `śilāyāḍhaḥ' iti niranubandhako ḍhaśabdo'sti, sa iha svabhāvānnapuṃsakaliṅga iti striyāṃ nāstītyuktam | yo'pi `sabhāyā yaḥ', `ḍhaśchandasi' iti ḍhaḥ, so'pi striyāṃ na vartate, katham ? tatra `tatra sādhuḥ' iti vartate, kathaṃ ca strī nāma sabhāyāṃ sādhvī syādyajñasabhāyāṃ hi viduṣāmadhikāraḥ ! nanu mā nāma bhūdyajñasabhāyāṃ sādhvī, śālāyāṃ strīsabhe ca sādhvī bhaviṣyati, tatra yajñasabhāyāṃ sādhvī brāhmaṇapariṣadityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyevaṃvidhe viṣaye chandasi sabheyīśabdasya prayogābhāvo'tra hetuḥ |
ṇe'pi kvacidaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | śīlam `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ' iti yo ṇastatrāṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | katham ? jñāpakāt‌, yadaṃyam `kārmastācchīlye' iti ṭilopārthaṃ nipātanaṃ karoti | yadi hi tācchīlike ṇe'ṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ na syānnipātanamanarthakaṃ na syāt‌, karmaśabdācchattrādilakṣaṇe ṇe kṛte `nastaddhite' ityeva ṭilopasya siddhatvāt‌ | na ca `an‌' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ, aṇi hi sa prakṛtibhāvaḥ | caurī, tāpasīti | curātapaḥ śabdau chattrādiṣu paṭhitavyau | kvacidityasya vyāvarttyaṃ darśayati---dāṇḍā, mauṣṭeti | draṇḍamuṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ `tadasyāṃ praharaṇam' iti ṇaḥ |
autsī, audapānīti | utsodapānaśabdābhyāṃ bhavārthe `utsādibhyo'ñ‌' | atha sārṅgaravādisūtre punarañgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'nenaiva siddham, na rūpabhedo na svarabhedaḥ ? tatrāha---śārṅgaravādyaña ityādi | bidasyāpatyaṃ baidī, `anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ' gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātiḥ, tatrautsītyādau caritārthamimaṃ ṅīpaṃ bādhitvā jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ‌ prāpnoti | yadi tarhi tasya nibandhanamasti tadevāñ‌grahaṇamastu, kimatrāñgrahaṇena ? na vā jātyadhikārāt‌, `jāteḥ' iti hi tatra vartate, anadhikāre hi puṃyogādākhyāyāṃ ṅīpprasaṅgaḥ---baidasya strī baidī |
urudvayasītyādau `pramāṇe dvayasacdaghnañmātracaḥ' |
pañcatayīti | `sakhyāyā avayave tayap‌' | dvayasajādiṣu anubandhoccāraṇaṃ prātipadikānāṃ grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt‌---kimasya dvayasam, kisamasya mātramiti | tayaśabdo'pi tayateḥ pacādyajantaḥ sambhavati |
ṭhanādinivṛttyarthamiti | daṇḍo'syā asti `ata iniṭhanau' iṇḍikā, `kāśyādibhyaṣṭha
ññiṭhau' kāśiketyādau mā bhūdityevamartham |
tādṛśīti | `tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca', `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' | kaño ñakāroccāraṇam `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' godetyādau mā bhūt‌ | itvarīti | `iṇnaśjisarttibhyaḥ kvarap‌' | āḍhyaṅkāraṇīti | `āḍhyasubhaga' ityādinā khyun |
nañsnañīkaktaruṇatalunānāmiti | bhāṣye tu `kañkvarapaḥ' ityetāvatsūtram, khyunaḥ pāṭho'nārṣa iti tasyāpyupasaṃkhyānameva kṛtam | straiṇī, pauṃsnīti | `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt‌' | śaktīkī, yāṣṭīkīti | praharaṇādhikāre `śaktiyaṣṭyorīkak' | taruṇī, talunīti | etayoravayo'rthaṃ grahaṇam---taruṇī surati, vayasi tu `vayasi prathame' ityeva siddham ? na sidhyati; gaurādipāṭhānṅīṣa prāpnoti | tasmādvayasyavayasi ca ṅībṅīṣovikalpaḥ | kvacid‌ gaurādipāṭhātsiddhamiti paṭhyate, tadrūpamātrasiddhyabhiprāyaṃ draṣṭavyam, svarārthaṃ tūpasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyameva ||
yañaśca || 4.1.16 ||

prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ || 4.1.17 ||
ṣakāro ṅīṣathe iti | nanu ca ṣphapratyayenaiva strītvasya dyotitatvānṅīṣā na bhāvyam ? tatrāha---pratyayadvayeneti | taddhitagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārthamiti | prātipadikasaṃjñā tu ṅīṣarthā | nanu ca siddho'tra ṅīṣ‌, pitkaraṇasāmarthyāt‌, dhātostu trapādeḥ ṣittvamaṅ‌vidhau caritārthamiti trapā, kṣametyādau ṅīṣabhāvaḥ ? tadetatsānnyāsikaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvat‌ |
sarvatragrahaṇamityādi | sarvatragrahaṇaṃ tāvad‌ uttarasūtre na kartavyam, ārambhasāmarthyādeva `prācām' ityasya nivṛttau sarvatra siddhatvāt, atastadihāpakṛṣyate, tadayamartho bhavati---sarvatra bādhakaviṣayo'pi prācāṃ matena yañantātṣpho bhavatīti | evaṃ saptamyartho'pi samañjaso bhavati | āvaṭyāccāpaṃ vakṣyatīti | asati punarapakarṣe āvaṭyāccābudīcāṃ mate sāvakāśaḥ paratvātṣphaṃ bādheta, sarvatragrahaṇātṣpha eva bhavati | evaṃ ca `ṣācca yañaḥ' iti cābviṣaye'pi prācāṃ ṣpha eva bhavati---śārkarākṣyāyaṇī, pautimāṣyāyaṇī, gokakṣyāyaṇīti ||
sarvatra lohitādikatantebhyaḥ || 4.1.18 ||
lohitādīti pṛthakpadaṃ luptavibhaktikam, pūrvatra ca prācāṃ mate ṣpho vihitaḥ, iha tu sarvatra mate | ko'rthaḥ ? sarveṣaāṃ mata ityarthaḥ, tadāha---sarveṣāmācāryāṇāṃ mata iti | mateneti tṛtīyāntapāṭhe sūtre paṣṭhyantāttral | svatantramiti | yo'nyasyāvayavo na bhavati tatsvatantraṃ prātipadikam, kaḥ punarasāvityatrāha---kapiśabdātpara iti | lauhityāyanītyādirgargādyantargaṇaḥ | babhruśabdo'pi tatraiva paṭhyate, yañtu `madhubabbhr‌vorbrāhmaṇakauśikyoḥ' ityananaiva bhavati |
kaṇvāttvityādi | kaṇvaśabdātpūrvaḥ kataśabdāttūttaraḥ śakalaśabda iṣyate, kataśakalakaṇvetyevabheṣāṃ saṃniveśaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | kimevaṃ sati bhavati ? ityāha---pūrvottarāviti | śakalaśabdo'nta ādiśca yathākramaṃ yayoḥ pūrvottarayorgaṇayostau tathoktau | pūrvo gaṇo lohitādiḥ śakalaśabdānto bhavati, uttaraśca gaṇaḥ śakalaśabdādirbhavatītyarthaḥ | satyamevaṃ bhavati, prayojanaṃ tu kim ? ityata āha---ṣphāṇāviti |
ślokaṃ vyāṭaṣṭe---prātipadikeṣvanyathā pāṭha iti | kapikata, kurukata, anaḍuh‌, kaṇva, śakaletyevaṃ gargādiṣu gaṇasanniveśaḥ | sa evaṃ vyavasthāpayitavya iti | evamiti ślokoktayā''nupūrvyetyarthaḥ | anaḍuh‌kurukataśabdāvasmātsthānādapakṛṣyānyatra pāṭhyau, śakalaśabdastu katakaṇvayormadhye paṭhitavya iti yāvat‌ | nanvevaṃ gaṇadvayādapi pracyutaḥ śakalaśabdaḥ ṣphāṇau dvāvapi na pratipadyeta, tatrāha---katantebhya iti | bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekaśeṣa iti | katasyāntaḥ samīpabhūtaḥ katanta iti tatpuruṣeṇa śakalaśabda ucyate, śakandhvāditvānnipātanādvā pararūpam | tathā kato'nto yeṣāṃ tāni katantānīti bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayoḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ śiṣyate; `svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottarasvaravidhiḥ sa śiṣyate' iti vacanāt‌ | tathetyādi | `kaṇvādibhyaḥ' ityapi bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekeśeṣa ityarthaḥ | kaṇvasyādiḥ samīpabhūtaḥ kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdaḥ, kaṇva ādiryeṣāṃ tāni kaṇvādīni, tataḥ pūrvavadekaśeṣaḥ | tatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayormadhye tatpuruṣasamāsena | madhyavarttīti | gaṇadvayasya | pratyayadvayamapīti | ṣphāṇāvityarthaḥ | śākalā iti | `āpatyasya ca' iti yalopaḥ |
apara āha---pūrvottarau tadantādī grāhyāviti śeṣaḥ, pūrvo gaṇastadanto grāhyaḥ---sarvatra lohitādiśakalāntebhya iti, uttaro gaṇastadādirgrāhyaḥ---śakalādibhyo gotra iti | evaṃ ṣphāṇau prayojanamiti ||
kauravyamāṇḍūkābhyāṃ ca || 4.1.19 ||
kauravyamāṇḍūkayorityādi | asminsūtre āsurerapi grahaṇaṃ kartavyam | āsurikauravyamāṇḍūkebhyaśceti vaktavyamityarthaḥ |

vayasi prathame || 4.1.20 ||
śrutyeti | śravaṇamātreṇa prakaraṇādyanapekṣayetyarthaḥ | kumārīti | prathamavayovacana evāyam, na puṃyogābhāvahetukaḥ puṃsyapi prayogāt‌ | yastu vṛddhāyāṃ prayogaḥ---vṛddhakumārīti, sa puṃyogābhāvātsādharmyādveditavyaḥ |
vayasyacarama iti | caram - antyam, acarame - anatye | iha keciccatvāri vayāṃsīcchanti---kaumārap‌, yauvanam, madhyatvam, vṛddhatvamiti | yathāhuḥ---
`prathame vayasi nādhītaṃ dvitīye nārjitaṃ dhanam |
tṛtīye na tapastaptaṃ caturthe kiṃ kariṣyati' || iti |
anye tu trīṇi---
`pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane |
putrastu sthaviribhāve na strī svātantryamarhati' || iti |
anye tu bālatva-madhyatva-vṛddhatvāni trīṇi---
`āṣoḍaśādbhavedvālo yāvat‌ kṣīrānnavartakaḥ |
madhyamaḥ saptatiryāvatparato vṛddha ucyate' || iti |
eṣu sarveṣu darśaneṣu yauvanaṃ dvitīyaṃ vayo bhavati, yauvanavacanau ca vadhūṭaciraṇṭaśabdau, ato na prāpnoti, tadāha---dvitīyavayovacanāvetāviti | yadā tu dve eva vayasī upacayāpacayalakṣaṇe, tadaitanna vaktavyam ; yauvanasyāpi prathamavayorūpatvāt‌ |
śrutyā vartate iti yaduktaṃ tasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---uttānaśayā lohitapādiketi naitā vayaḥ śrutaya iti | śrutyā - śravaṇamātreṇa naite vayaḥ pratipādayantītyarthaḥ | iha tāvaduttānaśayeti kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, tadeva ca pravṛttinimittam | uttānādiṣu kartṛṣviti śeraterac‌ pratyayaḥ, sarvaiva ca kadāciduttānā śete, ucyate cedam---uttānaśayeti, tatra niyamo gamyate---anyathā svaptumasāmarthyāduttānaiva śeta iti | evamapi sandehaḥ---bālā, vṛddheti ? tasmāduttānaiva śeta iti niyame vṛddhatvābhāve ca prakaraṇādinā'vasite bālyaṃ gamyate, lāhitapādiketyatrāpi anyapadārthamātraṃ śrutyā pratīyate | prakaraṇādinā svabhāvata evāsya raktau pādo nālaktakādineti pratītau satyāṃ bāleti gamyate | itiśabdaḥ prakāre, evaprakārā na vayaḥśrutaya ityarthaḥ | ata eva bahuvacanam, tena dvivarṣetyādāvapi na bhavati | atrāpi prakaraṇādinā vayo gamyate, parimāṇamātraṃ tu śabdārthaḥ, śālādāvapi prayogāt‌ | dve varṣe bhūtā iti ṭhañaḥ `varṣāllukca', `cittavati nityam' iti luk‌ ||
aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitaluki || 4.1.22 ||
parasaptamī tvaṣā nopapadyate, abhāvarūpeṇa lukā paurvāparyāsambhavāt‌ | sarvato mānaṃ parimāṇamiti | `parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ' ityasya grahaṇam, na paricchedakamātrasyetyarthaḥ |
pañcamiśvaiḥ krīteti | taddhitārthe dviguḥ, ārhīyaṣṭhak‌ |
kālaḥ saṅkhyā ca na parimāṇamiti | na hi tābhyāṃ sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate | evaṃ ca kālaḥ saṅkhyā ceti pradarśanārthatvātpramāṇamapi parimāṇaṃ na bhavati, tathā cottarasūtre `kāṇḍaśabdasyāparimāṇavācitvāt‌' iti vakṣyati, `pramāṇaviśeṣaḥ kāṇḍam' iti ca | tena dvau śamau pramāṇamasyā iti mātracaḥ `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam' iti luki dviśam, triśameti bhavati | yadyevam, unmānamapi parimāṇaṃ na syāt‌ ? kaścidāha---iṣṭamevaitat, unmānamapi naivātra parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyate---dvābhyāṃ niṣkābhyāṃ krītā, prāgvatīyasya ṭhañoḥ `dvitripūrvānniṣkāt‌' iti luk‌, dviniṣkā triniṣveti bhavatīti | apara āha---bistakambalyagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---unmānamapyatra parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti; tayorunmānaviśeṣatvāt‌, suvarṇabistau hesno'kṣe, `kambalācca saṃjñāyām' kambalyamūrṇāpalaśatamiti | nyāsakārastu dvau vistau parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhṇan‌ bistaṃ parimāṇaṃ manyate | dvivarṣeti | kṛtavyutpādanametat | dviśatā, triśateti | dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krīteti `paṇapādamāṣaśatādyat‌' iti nitye yati prāpte `śāṇādvā' ityatra `śatācceti vaktavyam' iti vacanātpakṣe `saṅkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan‌' iti kan‌, tasya `adhyardhapūrvāt‌' iti luk‌ |
dvibisteti | parimāṇatve ṭhaño luk, unmānatve ṭhakaḥ | dvyāciteti | ācito daśabhārāḥ syuḥ | dvāvācitau pacati, `āḍhakācitapātrātkhonyatarasyām', `dvigoṣṭhaṃśca' iti pakṣa ṭhan‌khau, tābhyāṃ mukte prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ‌, tasya pūrvavalluk‌ | dvikambalyeti | krītārthe ṭhaño luk‌ | dvyāḍhakī dvyācitetyanena tulyam |
pañcāśvīti | samāhāre dviguḥ | imau dvau pratiṣedhāvucyete, tatraikaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---parimāṇāntāttaddhitalukīti, tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---parimāṇāntādeva taddhitaluki ṅīb‌ bhavatīti, tena dvyāḍhakītyādau ca bhaviṣyati, pañcāśvetyādau ca na bhaviṣyati, tato bistācikambalyebyoneti ? naivaṃ śakyam ; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta---dvikuḍavī, pañcāḍhakī | pañcāśvetyādau tu vyāvartakābhāvātsyādeva ḍīp‌ | tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu ||
kāṇḍāntātkṣetre || 4.1.23 ||
mānadaṇḍaḥ-kāṇḍam | `dvigoḥ' ityadhikārādeva pūrvasūtravattadantavidhau siddhe kimarthamantagrahaṇam ? akriyamāṇe'ntagrahaṇe kṣetra ityetat kāṇḍasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta---kṣetre yaḥ kāṇḍaśabdaḥ, tadantād‌ dvigoriti śrutatvāt‌ na tadantasya, yathottarasūtre pramāṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabdastadantāditi, tataśceha prasajyeta---dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍābhyāṃ kāṇḍāmitābhyāṃ kṣetrābhyāṃ krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti; iha tu na syāt‌---dve kāṇḍe pramāṇamasyāḥ dvikāṇḍā kṣetrabhaktiriti | antagrahaṇe tu sati tadantasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ kṣetram, na kāṇḍasya; bahuvrīhau guṇabhūtatvāt‌ ||
puruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām || 4.1.24 ||
pramāṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabda iti | pañcāratniḥ puruṣa iti śulbavidaḥ, tatra dvau puruṣo pramāṇamatyā iti vākye pramāṇaśabdena sambandhājjātivacano'pi puruṣaśabdaḥ pramāṇe vartate | vṛttau tu tatsvabhāvādeva pramāṇe vṛttirdraṣṭavyā ||
bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ‌ || 4.1.25 ||
`ūdhaso'naṅ‌' iti | samāsānte kṛta iti samāsārthāduttarapadādbhavansamāsāntaḥ pūrvaṃ bhavati, tataḥ strīpratyayaḥ | ano bahuvrīheriti | upala7ṇametatat | `ano bahuvrīheḥ', `ḍābubhābhyābhanyatarasyām' iti cetyarthaḥ | kuṇḍodhnīti | kuṇḍamiva ūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ, ṅīṣi `allopo'naḥ' ityakāralopaḥ |
prāptodhā iti | `prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' iti tatpuruṣaḥ, `atvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ |
ana upadhālopina ityādi | asatyāṃ punaranuvṛttau madhye'pavādanyāyena ḍāppratiṣedhayorevāyaṃ ṅīṣ‌ bādhakaḥ syāt, na `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityasya ṅīpaḥ |
nanu ca `ḍābubhābhyām' ityatrānenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena ṅībapi prāpyate, `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityaya tu niyama ityāvīdīti kuto'yamaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ ? satyam ; ana `upadhālopinaḥ' ityasya tu vidhitvābhyupagamenaitaduktam | iha bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ‌ naśceti vaktavyam, ūdhaḥ śabdāntādvahuvrīheḥ striyāṃ ṅīṣ‌ bhavati tatsanniyogena cāntyasya nakāraḥ, samāsāntaprakaraṇe tu ūdhasa'naṅiti na vaktavyam, `dhanuṣo'naṅ‌' ityeva paṭhitavyam, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati ? `ana upadhālopinaḥ' ityatrāsyānuvṛttirnāśrayitavyā bhavati; api ca mahodhāḥ parjanyaḥ, vuṇḍodho dhainukamiti siddhaṃ bhavati, anyathā `ūdhaso'naṅ‌' ityatra striyāmiti vaktavyaṃ syādata āha---samāsāntaśca striyāmeveti | iṣyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ, tatraiva striyāmiti vaktavyamityarthaḥ, itarathā hi kabvidhiprasaṅgaḥ | kapo'vakāśo'nyo bahuvrīhiḥ---ayavakaḥ avrīhikaḥ, ṅīṣastu---vibhāṣā kap‌, yadā na kap‌ so'vakāśaḥ; kapprasaṅge ubhayaṃ prāpnoti paratvātkap‌ syāt‌ ||
saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp‌ || 4.1.26 ||
pūrveṇa ṅīṣi prāpte ṅīb‌ vidhīyata iti | yatra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastatra bahuvrīhau | antodātte tu bahuvrīhau ṅībṅīṣornāsti viśeṣaḥ, sūdhnī, `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvam, tatrāllope ṅībapyadāttanivṛttanivṛttasvareṇodātto bhavati | dvyūdhnītyādi | dve ūdhasī yasyāḥ, atigatamūdho'syāḥ, nirgatamūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ |
ādigrahaṇaṃ kimiti | saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmuttaro ya ūdhaḥ śabdastadantādvabahuvrīheriti vijñāyamāne dvayūdhnītyādi siddhamiti praśnaḥ | dvividhodhnīti | asatyādigrahaṇe `saṃkhyāvyayābhyām' iti pañcamīnirdeśāttābhyāmanantaro ya ūdhaḥ--śabdastadantādeva syāt, padāntaravyavāye tu na syāditi bhāvaḥ ||
dāmahāyanāntācca || 4.1.27 ||
`svīritenādhikāraḥ' ityatra dvau pakṣau---śabdādhikāraḥ, arthādhikāraśceti | tatrādye pakṣe yasyaiva śabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratitrātaṃ sa evānuvartate, dvitīye tu dvandvārthasyaikatvāttasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syādvā na vā, tadihādyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---sakhyāgrahaṇamanuvartate nāvyayagrahaṇamiti |
hāyano vayasi smṛta iti | prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ | hāyanānto bahuvrīhirvayasi gamyamāne ṅīpaḥ prakṛtirācāryaiḥ smṛta ityarthaḥ | trihāyanā śāleti | prāṇidharmo vayaḥ śālāyā na sambhavati | atha mūlodāharaṇavat‌ `tricaturbhyā hāyanasya' ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ ṇatvaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyata āha---ṇatvaṃ cetyādi | bahuvrīhyadhikārādeva tadantavidhisiddherantagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||
ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām || 4.1.28 ||
iti parata upadhālope yasya sambhavati sa upadhālopī |
nanu siddhā evetyādi | etacca `ḍābubhābhyām' ityatraiva vyākhyātam |
anupadhālopino ṅīppratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanamiti | ano bahuvrīheryadanyatarasyāṃ ṅībvidhānaṃ tadupadhālopina evetyevaṃ niyamārthamityarthaḥ | asya ca niyamasyānupadhālopino ṅībnivṛttiḥ phalamiti phalataḥ pratiṣedhavāco yuktiḥ | bahurāje iti | `auṅa āpaḥ' iti śībhāvaḥ | dvivacananirdeśo ḍāpo'bhivyaktaye; evavacane ḍāppratiṣedhayo rūpasya tulyavāt |
bahumatsyeti | `sūryatiṣyāgastya' ityādinā upadhālopavidhānādupadhālopyeṣa bahuvrīhiḥ | suparveti | `na saṃyogādvamantāt‌' iti niṣedhānnāyamupadhālopī ||
nityaṃ saṃjñāchandasoḥ || 4.1.29 ||
nanu chandasi dṛṣṭamevānuvidhīyate nāpūrvamutprekṣyate; tatra ca ṅībeva ced‌ dṛśyate tasya ca lakṣaṇamasti, ka idānīṃ tadabhāvaṃ prayoktuṃ prabhavati, saṃjñāśabdā apyanadiprayuktā niyatānupūrvīkāstatrāpi ṅābeva cāyaṃ dṛśyate na tadabhāvaḥ śakyate kartum, kimarthamidaṃ sūtram ? saṃjñāchandasoriti padamuttarārthaṃ vaktavyam | nityagrahaṇamuttaratra vikalpanivṛttyartham ||
kevalamāmakabhāgadheyapāpāparasamānāryakṛtasumaṅgalabheṣajācca || 4.1.30 ||
kevaleti bhāṣāyāmiti | asaṃjñāviṣaye iti bhāvaḥ | māmakīti | mameyamiti `yuṣmadasmadoranyatasyāṃ khañca' ityam‌, `tavakamamakāvekavacane' iti mamakādeśaḥ, tatrāṇantatvāt `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ māmakagrahaṇam---saṃjñāchandasoreva ṅībnānyatreti | māmiketi | ṭāpi `māmakanarakayorupasaṃkhyānam‌' itītvam | bhāgadheyīti | bhāgaśabdāpuṃlliṅgātsvārthe dheyapratyayaḥ, svāthikāśca kvacidativartante prakṛtito liṅgamiti strīliṅgatā | pāpeti | abhedopacārāttadvati vartamānaḥ pāpaśabdo'bhidheyavalliṅgaḥ | avarītyatra dvitīyo varṇo dantyoṣṭhyaḥ, na pavargyaḥ | āryeṇa kṛteti | prāk‌ subutpateḥ samāse'kārāntatvam | bheṣajīti | bhiṣaja iyamityaṇi ādivṛddherabhāvo'smādeva nipātanādekāraḥ | evaṃ ca bheṣajagrahaṇamapi niyamārtham ||
rātreścājasau || 4.1.31 ||
kathamityādi | dīrghāntājjasi `dīrghājjasi ca' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghapratiṣedhādyaṇādeśe `rātryaḥ' iti prayoga upapadyate, hrasvāntasya tu `jasi ca' iti guṇe `rātryaḥ' iti rūpaṃ syāt‌ | dīrghāntaśca rātriśabdaḥ saṃjñāchandasorapi jasi na sambhavati, ajasāviti pratiṣedhāt‌, kiṃ punarbhāṣāyāmiti praśnaḥ | ṅīṣayamityādi | bahvādiṣu rātriśabdo na paṭhyata iti cet‌, tatrāha-tatra hīti | kṛta ikāraḥ kṛdikāraḥ, tadantānṅīṣ‌ bhavati `dṛjāgṛbhyāṃ viḥ', daviḥ, darvī; yastu ktinsambandhī tadantānna bhavati---kṛtiḥ, hṛtiḥ | sarvata iti | kṛdikārādakṛdikārāccetyarthaḥ | yastu ktinnarthastasmānna bhavati---`ākrośe nañyaniḥ', akaraṇiḥ, aharaṇiḥ | rātriśabdo'yam `rāśadibhyāṃ trip‌' iti vyutpattipakṣe kṛdikārāntaḥ, avyupattipakṣe `sarvato'ktinnarthāt‌' iti ṅīṣ‌ | sūtraṃ tu ṅībartham---rātrī vyakhyāt‌, rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyet‌; atrādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati ||
antarvatpativatornuk‌ || 4.1.32 ||
nipātanasamārthyācceti | kāryāntaravadarthaviśeṣavṛttirapi labhyata iti bhāvaḥ | kasminviśeṣa ityatrāha antarvatpativaditi | gabhabhartṛsaṃyoge iti | antarvaditi | garbhasaṃyoge, garbhiṇyāmityarthaḥ | pativaditi | bhartṛsaṃyoge, bhartṛmatyāmityarthaḥ, jīvapatyāmiti yāvat‌ | iha na bhavati antarasyāṃ śālāyāṃ vidyate iti | asminviṣaye evaṃvidhaṃ vākyameva bhavati, na tu matubādītyarthaḥ | kvacid‌ antarvatī śāleti paṭhyate, tadayuktam ; atra matubabhāvasyoktatvāt‌ | patimatī pathivīti | svāmiparyāyo'tra patiśabdaḥ |
matubnipātyata iti | adhikaraṇapradhānasyāntaḥ śabdasyāstinā'sāmānādhikaraṇyānna prāpnotīti kṛtvā |
vatvaṃ tu siddhamiti | `mādupadhāyāśca' ityanenādupadhatvāt‌ |
antarvatpativatorityādi | etayoḥ śabdayornipātanānmatubvatve bhavataḥ, nuktu vidhīyate yathākramaṃ garbhiṇyāṃ jīvapatyāṃ cābhidheyāyām--jīvaḥ patirasyāḥ jīvapatiḥ `vibhāṣā sapūrvasya' iti ṅīmnakārayorabhāvapakṣe rūpam | tatra ṅitihrasvaśca' iti nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe `idudbhyām' iti ṅerāmādeśaḥ, jīvapatyāmiti bhavati | vā tu chandasi nugvidhiḥ | chandasi viṣaye tu vikalpena nugvidhirbhavati---antarvatī, antarvatnī | puṃsyāpi dṛśyate---so'ntarvānabhavat‌ ||
patyarno yajñasaṃyoge || 4.1.33 ||
yadyatra yajñaśabdena patiśabdasya sambandhāt‌ yajñasaṃyoga ityarthaḥ syāt‌ ? yajñasya patiriyaṃ brāhmaṇītyatraiva syāt‌, asti hyatrārthadvārakaḥ sambandhaḥ, svarūpeṇa cānantaryalakṣaṇaḥ | atha yajñavācinā saṃyogo yajñasaṃyogaḥ ? tathāpi patnīsaṃyāja ityādāveva syāt‌, na tviyamasya patnītyādau | tasmādyajñaśabdasya yo'rthastena patiśabdārthasya sambandho yajñasaṃyoga ityāha---yajñena saṃyoga iti | anyathā `yajñaśabdena' ityavakṣyat‌ | evaṃ ca patiśabdārthasyetyapyuktaṃ bhavati, na hi patiśabdasya yajñenārthena vācyavācakabhāvaḥ sambandhāntaraṃ vā sambhavati | tatsādhanatvāditi | devatod‌deśena svadravyatyāgaḥ -yāgaḥ | madhyakaṃcadampatyordhanam, `kuṭumbinau dhanasyeśāte jāyāpatyorna vibhāgo vidyate' iti hi smaryate, tataśca tyāge bhāryāyā apyanumatirapekṣyata iti tatrāsyā anumatyā sādhanatvam | madarthaṃ karmetyevaṃrūpo'dhikāralakṣaṇasambandho'stītyāha---phalagrahītṛtvāditi | kartṛtvamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na strītvamiti ṅībna kṛtaḥ | `kartari ca' iti samāsapratiṣedhaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā eva, na śeṣapaṣṭhyā iti tasyānenopapannaḥ samāsaḥ | phalagṛhītatvāditi pāṭhe gṛhītaṃ phalaṃ yayeti bahuvrīhau phalaśabdasya jātivacanatvād‌ niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' iti gṛhītaśabdasya paranipātaḥ |
kathamityādi | śūdrasyaiva yajñe'nadhikṛtatvādyajñenāsaṃyogātkathaṃ tadbhāryāyā yajñasaṃyoga iti praśnaḥ | upamānāditi | agnisākṣikaṃ yatpāṇigrahaṇaṃ tad‌ vṛṣalādīnāmapyasti, tadāśrayamupamānam ||
vibhāṣā sapūrvasya || 4.1.34 ||
sahaśabdo'yamasti tulyayoge, yathā---saśiṣyo gururāgata iti; asti ca vidyamānavacanaḥ, yathā---`sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī' iti, itthambhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, vidyamāneṣveva putreṣvityarthaḥ | pūrvaśabdo'pyasti vyavasthāvacanaḥ---pūrvaṃ madhurāyāḥ pāṭaliputramiti; asti cāvayavaśabdaḥ---pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti | tatra tulyayoge sahaśabdaḥ, pūrvaśabdaśca vyavasthāyāmiti pakṣe grāmasya patiriyamiti vākye prāpnoti, pūrvasya cāpi prāpnoti, vidyamānavacanasahaśabdaḥ pūrvaśabdaśca vyavasthāvacana iti pakṣe pūrvasya mā bhūt‌, vākye tu syādeva | apayavavacanaḥ pūrvaśabdaḥ tulyayoge sahaśabda iti pakṣe vākye'pi syāt‌, tatrāpi patiśabdasya pūrvo'vayavaḥ pakārastasyāpi syāt‌, tasmādvidyamānavacanaḥ sahaśabdaḥ pūrvaśabdaścāvayavavacana iti pakṣa āśrīyate | `tena saha' ityatra `tulyoge' iti viśeṣaṇasya prāyikatvātsamāsaḥ | evaṃ ca sthite `sapūrvasya' iti patiśabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate, katham ? pakāreṇa sapūrvatvamavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam | śabdāntaraṃ tu patiśabdasyāvayavo na sambhavati, tataśca sāmarthyāt‌ prātipadikaṃ patiśabdena viśeṣyate, na tu tena | patiśabda iti | patiśabdena tadantasya grahaṇam, anupasarjanagrahaṇenāpi tadantaṃ prātipadikameva viśeṣyate, na viśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ patiśabdaḥ, anyathā bahuṃvrīhau na syāt‌---jīvaḥ patirasyāḥ jīvapatirjīvapatnīti | ṣaṣṭhī samāsa eva tu syād‌---āśāpatiḥ, āśāpatnīti | tadetat sarvamālocyāha---patiśabdāntasya sapūrvasyānupasarjanasyeti | grāmasya patiriyamiti | asati sapūrvagrahaṇe tadantavidherabhāvādatraiva syāt‌ | athāpyamahatpūrveti jñāpakāttadante'pi bhavet kevalasyāpi syādeva | tasmāt‌ `sapūrvasya' iti vaktavyam ||
nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu || 4.1.35 ||
yāni samānādipūrvapadāni patyantāni prātipadikāni te sapatnyādayaḥ | kuta etat ? samānādīnāmeva gaṇe paṭhāt‌, sapatnyādīnāṃ cāpāṭhāt‌ | yadyevam, samānādiṣviti vaktavyam, pūrvagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ; samādiṣu pūrveṣvavayaveṣu satsvityarthaḥ ? satyam ; samānasya sabhāvārthaṃ tu `sapatnyādiṣu' ityuktam | kvacittūdāharaṇānantaraṃ samānādiṣviti vaktavyaṃ sabhāvārthamevamuktamiti vṛttāveva paṭhyate |
apara āha---samudāyoccāraṇasāmarthyātsapatnībhārya ityatra puṃvadbhāvo na bhavatīti nātrāptoktirasti | kiñca---sabhāvārthaṃ samudāyoccāraṇamidamiti sāmarthyamapi cintyam | tathā he sapatni, niḥsapatniḥ, sapatnyṛcchati, sapatnyā, sapatnyai ityādāvapi hrasvayaṇādeśau na syātām | tasmātsabhāvārthameva sapatnyādiṣvityuktam | nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | dāsācchandasīti | dāsapatnīrahigopāḥ |
pūtakratorai ca || 4.1.36 ||
yadyayamaikāraḥ pratyayaḥ syāduttarasūtre udāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; pratyayatvādeva siddheḥ | tasmādādeśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityāha---aikāraścāntādeśa iti |
traya ete yogā iti | `puṃyogādākhyām' ityatrānuvartayitavyā ityarthaḥ | iha karaṇasāmarthyācca ṅīpsahitā evānuvartante, tena yadā puṃyogātstriyāṃ pūtakratvādayo vartante tadā ṅīṣaṃ bādhitvā aikārādisahito ṅīb‌ bhavati ||
vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusīdānāsudāttaḥ || 4.1.37 ||
vṛṣākapiśabdo madhyodātta iti | `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' iti vacanāt‌ | asyārthaḥ---ante ekasminlaghau dvayośca laghvoḥ parato bahvaṣaḥ śabdasya gururudātto bhavatīti | `bahvaṣaḥ' iti vahvaca ityarthaḥ | yo'smākaṃ cakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ so'nyeṣāṃ ṣakāreṇa | agnyādiṣu punariti | `phiṣaḥ' ityanenāgnyādīnāmantodāttatvam | phiṣiti prātipadikasyānyācāryasaṃjñā | ye tu kusīdeti madhye gurumadhīyate teṣām `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttaprasaṅgaḥ ||
manorau vā || 4.1.38 ||
