aikāraścodātta iti | aukārastvanudātta eva | vāgrahaṇena dvāvapi vikalpyete iti | yadā ca dvāvapi na bhavatastadā ṅībapi na bhavati; sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt‌ | manuśabda ādyudātta iti | `mana jñāne', `mṛmṛśītṝcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ' iti varttamāne `dhānye nit‌' iti ca, `śṝsvṝsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca' iti upratyayaḥ, nittvādādyudāttatvam, bharuḥ, maruḥ, śayuḥ, taruḥ, caruḥ, tsaruḥ, tanuḥ, dhanuḥ, mayuḥ, mad‌guḥ, nyaṅ‌kvādipāṭhāt‌ kutvam---prathamasyodāharaṇāni | śaruḥ, svarūḥ, snehuḥ, trapu, asuḥ, vasuḥ, hanuḥ, kleduḥ, bandhuḥ, manuḥ---iti dvitīyasya ||
varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ || 4.1.39 ||
varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānāmiti | taśabdāntānāmetādīnāṃ ṇaśabdāntānāṃ soṇādīnāṃ tiśabdāntānāṃ śitiprabhṛtīnāṃ niśabdāntānāṃ pṛśniprabhṛtīnāṃ takārāntānāṃ ca pṛṣatprabhṛtīnāṃ varṇavācināmādirudātto bhavatītyarthaḥ | gatisvareṇeti | `gatiranantaraḥ' ityanena | ghṛtāditvāditi | `ghṛtādīni' iti phiṣi paṭhyate | piśaṅgāditi | `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttatvāduttarasūtreṇa ṅīṣi prāpte hībvidhīyate |
asitapalitayoriti | `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām' ityādyudāttāvetau |
chandasītyādi | `to naḥ' iti nakāre prāpte knaśabdaṃ ṅīpsahitamicchanti |
bhāṣāyāmapīṣyate iti | bhāṣye tu naitatpradaśitam | avadātaśabdo na varṇavācī, kiṃ tarhi ? viśuddhavācī | evaṃ hyāha---
trīṇi yasyāvadātāni vidyā yoniśca karma ca |
etattrayaṃ vijānīhi brāhmaṇādhyasya lakṣaṇam | iti |
tenāvadātetyatra ṅībna bhavati |
anyato ṅīp‌ || 4.1.40 ||
sāraṅgakalmāṣaśabdau `laghāvante' iti madhyodātto, `śapa ākrośe', `kala tṛpaḥ', `śaperbaśca' iti kalapratyayaḥ, pakārasya bakāraḥ, pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ śabalaśabdaḥ | khaṭ‌vāśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ, `khaṭ‌ kāṅ‌kṣe', `asūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan‌' | kṛṣṇaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, `kṛṣervarṇe' iti nak‌ pratyayaḥ, ilaci prakṛte `kapeśca' iti uṇādiṣu sūtram | kapiḥ sautro dhātuḥ, kapilaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ ||
ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca || 4.1.41 ||
ṣidbhyaḥ prātipadikebhya iti | ṣvunādeḥ pratyayasya ṣittvamavayave'caritārthaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavatīti prātipadikānāṃ ṣittvam, dhātostu trapādeḥ ṣittvamaṅ‌vidhau caritārthamiti na tena prātipadikaṃ ṣidbhavati | rajakīti | `śilpini ṣvun‌' ityatra vyutpāditam |
gaurādiṣu gauraśabdasya varṇavācino'pyantodāttatvātpāṭhaḥ | matsyādānāṃ yopadhānām `ayopadhāt‌' iti jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣaḥ pratiṣedhātpāṭhaḥ | anyeṣāṃ jātiśabdānāṃ strīviṣayārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ | śvannakṣanniti etayorḍāpi prāpte | anaḍuhī, anaḍ‌vāhīti | anakārāntatvādaprāpte ṅīṣi sapratyayayoḥ pāṭhaḥ, ṅīṣi parato vikalpenānyathā syāt‌ | eṣaṇaḥ karaṇa iti | karaṇasādhana eṣaṇaśabdo ṅīṣamutpādayati---iṣyate'nayetyeṣaṇī | adhikaraṇe lyuḍiti ṭittvān‌ ṅībeva bhavati | anyeṣāmapi lyuṅantānāṃ ṅīpi prāpte pāṭhaḥ | medhaśabdasyājātivācitvād‌, gautamasya śārṅgaravāditvān‌ ṅīni prāpte vacanātpakṣe so'pi bhavati | āyasthūṇaśabdaḥ śivādyaṇantaḥ | bhaurikyādaya iñantāḥ, teṣām `aṇiñoḥ' iti ṣyaṅ‌prāptau | āpicchikā nāma rājānaḥ, `janapadaśabdātkṣatriyādañ‌', `tasya ātaśca' iti luki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena ṅīpprāpnoti | agre hāyanamasya āgrahāyaṇaḥ, prajñāditvātsvārthiko'ṇ‌, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇatvam---āgrahāyaṇaḥ, ṅīpi prāpte pāṭhaḥ | kecidāgrahāyaṇīti ikārāntaṃ paṭhanti, tasya prayojanam---āgrahāyaṇībhārya ityādau puṃvadbhāvo mā bhūdityāhuḥ | etena pratyavarohaṇīti vyākhyātam | sumaṅgalātsaṃjñāyāmiti | `kevalamāmaka' iti ṅīpi prāpte pakṣe so'pi bhavati | svare viśeṣaḥ, sumaṅgalaśabdo bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvānṅīpyapi satyudāttanivṛttasvareṇa bhāvyamiti nāsti viśeṣaḥ | tathā ca chandasi | sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrityantodāttatvaṃ dṛśyate | tasmājjātivacano'vyutpannaḥ strīviṣayaḥ sumaṅgalaśabdaḥ `laghāvante' iti madhyodātto draṣṭavyaḥ | taruṇatalunayoḥ `nañsnañīkaktaruṇa' iti ṅīpi prāpte pakṣe so'pi bhavati | bṛhanmahacchabdayoranarthakaḥ pāṭha iti prāgevoktam | ṛṣyaṇantaḥ saudharmaśabdaḥ | rohiṇī nakṣatre iti | nakṣatrādanyatra rohiṇī | revatī nakṣatra iti | rayiriti dhananāma, rayirvidyate'syā iti matupi `rayermatau bahulam' iti samprasāraṇam, nipātanādvatvam | nakṣatrādanyatra ṅīb‌ bhavati | vikalādīnāṃ ṭāpi prāpte | kaṭācchroṇivacane | kaṭī śroṇiḥ, anyatra kaṭā | piplyādayaśceti | gaṇasūtram, pippali, harītakītyādikaṃ tu tasyodāharaṇapradarsanam | pṛthivīti | `pratheḥ ṣivansamprasāraṇaṃ ca' iti ṣittvādeva siddhe pratyayāntasya pāṭhaḥ puṃvadbhāvanivṛttyarthaḥ---pṛthivībhārya iti | strīviṣayasyāsya puṃvadbhāvaprāptiścintyā | kroṣṭuśabdasya `striyāṃ ca' iti tṛjvadbhāvaḥ | kroṣṭrītyatra nirūpaṇīyamasti `striyāṃ ca' ityatra nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ |
ṣittvādeva siddha iti | `mātari ṣicca' iti vārttikakāravacanātṣittvam, nipātanasāmarthyādvā | uktaṃ hi---
dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyarthaṃ niyamasya ca |
anubandhavikārāṇaāṃ rūḍhyarthaṃ ca nipātanam || iti |
daṃṣṭreti | yeṣāmajādiṣu daṃṣṭreti pāṭo nāsti teṣāmidaṃ prayojanam ||
jānapadakuṇḍagoṇasthalabhājanāgakālanīlakuśakāmukakabarād‌ vṛtyamatrāvapanākṛtrimāśrāṇāsthaulyavarṇānācchādanāyovikāramaithunecchākeśaveśeṣu || 4.1.42 ||
vartate'nayā sā vṛttiḥ - jīvikā | svare viśeṣa iti | tameva darśayati---utsādipāṭhādañi kṛta iti | amatram-bhājanam | kuṇḍānyeti | kriyāśabdo'yam | `kuḍi dāhe', `gurośca halaḥ' ityakārapratyayaḥ | avaṭaparyāyastu kuṇḍaśabdo napuṃsake niyataḥ | yastu `patyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syāt‌' iti manuṣyajātivacanastato jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ bhavatyeva---kuṇḍīyaṃ na golīti | amatravācinastu jātiśabdādapi strīviṣayatvānṅīṣ‌ vidhīyate | āvapanaṃ cediti | yatra dhānyādi prakṣipya nīyate sā goṇī, yasyāḥ punaryādṛcchikaṃ nāma sā goṇā | sthalānyeti | kṛtrimā puruṣavyāpāreṇa niṣpāditā, yathā---sthalayodakaṃ parigṛhṇantīti | bhājīti | `bhaja viśrāṇane' curādiḥ, `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc‌' iti yuci prāpte'samādeva nipātanāt‌ striyāmapyerac‌ | śrāṇeti | `śrā pāre', ktaḥ, `saṃyogādeḥ' iti natvam | sthaulyaṃ cediti | dravye vartamānasya nāgaśabdasya sthaulyaṃ cetpravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ | nāgaśabdo guṇavacana iti | gajavācī nāgaśabdastatsahacaritaṃ stholyamupādāya stryantare prayukta udāharaṇam | sarpe dṛṣṭastadgataṃ dairghyamupādāya stryantare prayuktaḥ pratyudāharaṇamityarthaḥ | varṇaścediti | pravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ | kālānyeti | yasyā yādṛcchikīyaṃ saṃjñā | nīlānyeti | nīlyā raktā śāṭī, `nīlyā anvaktavyaḥ' ityan | ayovikāraścediti | `phāla' iti yasyābhidhānam | kuśānyeti | chandogāḥ stotriyā gaṇanārthānaudumbarān‌ śaṅ‌kūna `kuśā' iti vyavaharanti | kāmukānyeti | yasyā maithunādanyatkāmayituṃ śīlam | maithunecchāvato bhaṇyata iti | kāmukaśabdasya `laṣapatapada' iti kartari vyutpāditatvāt‌, icchāmātre vṛttyabhāvāt | sūtre tu pravṛttinimittamātraṃ niṣkṛṣyoktam | maithune icchā yasyāḥ sā maithuneccheti vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhirāśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ | keśaveśa iti | keśasanniveśaviśeṣa ityartaḥ ||
śoṇātprācām || 4.1.43 ||
śoṇaśabdo'yaṃ varṇavācī `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitantānām' ityādyudāttaḥ, tatra `anyato ṅīṣ‌' ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam---prācāmeva nānyeṣāmiti ||
voto guṇavacanāt‌ || 4.1.44 ||
guṇamuktavānguṇavacana iti | `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bhūte kartari lyuṭaṃ darśayati | sa punaryaḥ prāgguṇamabhidhāya paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvati vartate sa veditavyaḥ | śuciriti | uta ityasminnasattve'pi paṭ‌vītyādisidhyarthamevāta ityasyāsambandho vyākhyeyaḥ, tataścehāpi prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ |
guṇavacanānṅībiti | `manorau vā' ityasyānantaramidaṃ paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ | uttarasūtram `bahvādibhyo vā' iti paṭhitavyam |
ādyudāttārthamiti | ādyudātteṣu guṇavacanasya ṅībvidhānasya prayojanamityarthaḥ | antodātteṣu `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt‌' iti ṅībapyudātta iti nāsti viśeṣaḥ | ādyudātteṣu tu ṅībanudātta evāvatiṣṭhate | vasvīti | `śṝsvṛsnihi' ityādinā vaserupratyayaḥ, nittvādādyudātto vasuśabdaḥ, guṇavacanaścāyaṃ nairmalyavacanaḥ | praśastavacana ityanye | tathā ca---atiśayena vasurvasiṣṭho bhavati paṭuśabdo'pyādyudāttaḥ, `dhānye nit‌' ityadhikāre `phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk‌paṭinākidhataśca' iti upratyayaḥ, phalergugāgamaḥ, pāṭeśca paṭirādeśaḥ, phalguḥ, paṭuḥ, nākuḥ, madhuḥ, jatu---ityudāharaṇāni | mṛduśabdastvantodāttaḥ, `mrada kṣode' `kurbhraśca' ityadhikāre `prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ salopaśca' iti kupratyayaḥ, pṛthuḥ, mṛduḥ | `bhrasjeḥ salopaḥ samprasāraṇañca', nyaṅ‌kvāditvātkutvam, bhṛguḥ | kharurīti | `kharuḥ kanyā pativarā' iti nighaṇṭuḥ, tatra pāṇigrahaṇotkaṇṭhābhidhāyitvād‌ guṇavacanatvām | taparakaraṇaṃ kim ? paṭumicchati paṭūyati, paṭūyateḥ kvip‌, paṭūḥ strī---atra mā bhūt‌ | yadyapyayaṃ samprati kriyāvacanaḥ, tathāpi pūrvaṃ guṇamuktavāniti kṛtvā syātprasaṅgaḥ |
iha `utaḥ iti viśeṣaṇādvacanagrahaṇācca śāstrīyo'deṅ‌guṇo na gṛhyate | loke tūpasarjanaṃ muṇa ucyate, śāstre'pi yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāditi viśeṣaṇamātraṃ guṇo gṛhyate, śuklādau ca prasiddhataro guṇaśabdaḥ, vaiśeṣikādayastu rūparasādayaścaturviśatirguṇā iti pratipannāḥ; tadiha jighṛkṣitaṃ guṇaṃ lakṣayati---sattve niviśata ityādi | sīdantyasmiñjātiguṇakriyā iti sattvam-dravyam | tatra yo niviśate-samavaiti sa guṇaḥ | `yo niviśate sa guṇaḥ' ityucyamāne guṇakriyājātyorguṇatvaprasaṅgātsattva ityuktam | evamapi sattā jātirguṇaḥ syāt‌, sā hi dravyaguṇakarmasu triṣvapi samavaiti ? tadarthaṃ dravya evetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam | evamapi dravyatvajātirguṇaḥ syātsattve niveśāttatraiva ca niveśāt‌ ? ityata āha---apaitīti | tataḥ sattvādapaiti-apagacchati, kvacidvā kadācidvā na bhavatītyarthaḥ | yathā---āmraphale śyāmatā pūrvamupaiti, raktatāyāṃ tatra jātāyāmapaiti ca dravyatvajātistu sarvadā dravye niviśate nāpaiti, yadi hi kadācitkvacidvā na syād‌ dravyamevaitanna syāt‌ | evamapi gotvādijātirguṇaḥ syāt‌, sā hi sattve niviśate, apaiti ca, tato'śvādiṣvabhāvāt‌ ? ityata āha---pṛthag‌ jātiṣviti | pṛthagiti pṛthakpadam, pṛthagbhūtāsu jātiṣvityarthaḥ | jātyādhāreṣu dravyoṣu dṛśyamāno jātiṣu dṛśyata ityupacaryate, samāse tu sati `jātyantācchaḥ' iti nityādhikāraparigaṇitaśchaḥ prasajyeta | tadevamuktalakṣaṇopeto yaḥ pṛthagjātīyeṣu dṛśyate sa guṇaḥ, na caivaṃrūpā gotvādijātiḥ | yadyapi khaṇḍamuṇḍādirūpeṇa khaṇḍamuṇḍādayaḥ pṛthagjātīyāḥ, tathāpi gotvena tāsāmekajātīyatvameva | ye tvapaitītyasya satyevādhāre tatparityāgamarthamāhuḥ, teṣāṃ `pṛthagjātiṣu' ityanarthakam ; gotvādijāterapyapaitītyanenaiva vyāvṛttisiddheḥ | tasmātpūrvokta evārthaḥ |
evamapi hi kriyā guṇaḥ syāt‌, sā hi dravye niviśate yadā sakriyaṃ tatraiva ca niviśate, apaiti ca tato yadā niṣkriyaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthagjātīyeṣu gavāśvādiṣu dṛśyate ? ata āha---ādheyaśceti | ādheyaḥ-niṣpādyaḥ, yathā---pākanikṣipteṣu ghaṭādiṣu raktatā guṇaḥ | akriyājaḥ-anutpādyaḥ, yathā---tejaḥ paramāṇuṣu sa eva raktatā guṇaḥ | tadevamāśrayabhedenotpādyānutpādyasvabhāvo guṇa iti nityotpādyasya karmaṇo guṇatvābhāvaḥ|
evamapi dravyaṃ guṇaḥ prāpnoti, tadapi śarīrādikaṃ pādādiṣu dravyeṣveva pṛthagjātīyeṣu niviśate saṃyogavināśe ca tato'paiti, ādheyaṃ cākriyājam, avayavidravyasyotpādyatvādākāśādeścānutpādyatvādityata āha---so'sattvaprakṛtirguṇa iti | ya uktalakṣaṇopetaḥ sattvaprakṛtirna bhavati-dravyasvabhāvako na bhavati, sa guṇa ityarthaḥ | atrottarārddhenaiva sarvajātīnāṃ vyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvārddhaṃ vyartham, jātīnāṃ nityatvenotpādyatvābhāvāt‌ ? naitadevam ; asati pūrvārddhe na jātirvyāvartate, yathā---taijasānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ yadrūpam, yacceṣṭakādipākyadravyagatam---tadubhayaṃ milatamutpādyānutpādyasvabhāvamityubhayorapi guṇatvaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ pratyekam; ubhayasvabhāvatvāt‌ | tathā pākyadravyarūpaṃ jātiśca---ityubhayaṃ mititamutpādyānutpādyasvabhāvamiti jātirapi guṇaḥ syādeva, na hi sajātīyatve satīti viśeṣaṇamupāttam, ataḥ pūrvārddhena jātivyāvṛttiḥ |
nanvevamapi `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' ityanenaiva sarvajātivyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvakaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ vyarthameva, tasmāt `sattve niviśate' iti svabhāvakathanam | tataḥ `apaiti' `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' iti ca vikalpena jātīrvyāvartayataḥ, apaitītyasya ca tatraiva kiyantāñcitkālaṃ sthitvā tamādhāraṃ tyajatītyayamarthaḥ |
nanvevamapi `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' ityanenaiva sarvajātivyāvṛttisiddheḥ pūrvakaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ vyarthameva, tasmāt‌ `sattve niviśate' iti svabhāvakathanam | tataḥ `apaiti' `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' iti ca vikalpena jātīrvyāvartayataḥ, apaitītyasya ca tatraiva kiyantāñcitkālaṃ sthitvā tamādhāraṃ tyajatītyayamarthaḥ |
tadevam `sattve niviśate apaiti ādeyaścākriyājaśca' ityekaṃ lakṣaṇam | `sattve niviśate pṛthagjātiṣu' ityādikaṃ cāparamiti lakṣaṇadvayamanusarttavyam ||
bahvādibhyaśca || 4.1.45 ||
śaktiḥ śastra iti | śaktiśabdaḥ śastre'bhidheye ṅīṣamutpādayati---śaktiḥ, śaktī | śastra iti kim ? śaktiḥ-sāmarthyam | anye śaktiśastrī iti śabdadvayaṃ paṭhanti---śastriḥ, śastrī | itaḥ prāṇyaṅgādityādīni trīṇi vākyāni yathottaramadhikaviṣayāṇi | tatrottaraṃ vākyadvayam `rātreścājasau' ityatraiva vyākhyātam | ikārāntātprāṇyaṅgavācino vā ṅīṣ‌ bhavati---dhamaniḥ, dhamanī | `sarvato'ktinnarthāt‌' ityeva ṅīṣi siddhe śakaṭyādīnāmikārāntānāṃ pāṭhaḥ prapañcārthaḥ | paddhatiśabdaḥ ktinnantaḥ, pādasya hatiḥ paddhatiḥ, `himakāṣihatiṣu ca' iti padbhāvaḥ | ahanniti paṭhyate, na sa kevalaḥ striyāṃ vartate, tasmāttadanto bahuvrīhirudāhāryaḥ---dīrghamaharasyāḥ dīrghāhrī śarat, pāṭhasāmarthyāt‌ `anupasarjanāt‌' iti na pravartate | asya ṅīṣo vikalpitatvāḍ‌ ḍāppratiṣedhāvapi bhavataḥ, `ana upadhālopinaḥ' iti ṅīp‌ ca |
bahuśabdo guṇavacana iti | antodāttaśca `laṅghibaṃhyornalopaśca' ityapratyayāntaḥ | kimarthaṃ tarhi tasyeha pāṭhaḥ ? ityata āha---tasyeti ||
nityaṃ chandasi || 4.1.46 ||
nityagraṃhaṇamuttarārthamiti | iha tvārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhiḥ siddhaḥ, yogārambhaścintyayojanaḥ ||
bhuvaśca || 4.1.47 ||
vibhvī, prabhvīti | `viprasaṃbhyo ḍ‌vasaṃjñāyām' iti ḍupratyayāntād‌ ṅīṣ‌ | svayaṃbhūriti | bhavateḥ kvip‌ |
hrasvādeveyamiti | yadyevaṃ `gherṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte `bhoḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ prāpnoti tatrāha---sautro'yaṃ nirdeśa iti | guṇasyaiva kṛtasya chāndasa uvaṅādeśa ityarthaḥ ||
puṃyogādākhyāyām || 4.1.48 ||
puṃsā yogaḥ puṃyoga iti | yogaḥ - sambandhaḥ | puṃyogāddhetoriti | hetau pañcamīṃ darśayati | ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ guṇabhūtenāpi puṃsaiva sambadhyate; anyena sambandhāsambhavāt‌ | gaṇakādayo hi śabdāḥ puṃyogātstriyāṃ vartamānā na puṃyogasyākhyā bhavanti, striyāṃ ca puṃyogamantareṇa na pravartante iti striyā api nākyāstadāha---puṃsa ākhyābhūtamiti | būtagrahaṇenaitaddarśayati---yatprātipadikaṃ prāk‌ puṃso vācakamabhūt‌, samprati tu puṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartata iti | gaṇakītyādi | gaṇayatīti gaṇakaḥ, ṇvula | pratiṣṭhate praṣṭhaḥ, `praṣṭho'gragāmini' iti ṣatvam | kathaṃ punarete puṃśabdāḥ ? ityata āha---puṃsi śabdapravṛttinimittasya sambhavāditi | gaṇayati pratiṣṭhata iti vyutpattyā puṃsi rūīḍhā ete, na strī gaṇayati pratiṣṭhate vā | mahāmātraśabdasyāpi pravṛttinimittaṃ hastipakānāmājñāpanam | hastipakādhipatirhi mahāmātraḥ | yā tu svayaṃ gaṇayati pratiṣṭhate vā, na tasyāṃ puṃyogācchabdapravṛttiḥ, api tarhi svayameva kriyāsambandhāditi ṭāpaiva tatra bhāvyam | kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ pravṛttiritya āha---tadyogāditi | ko'rthaḥ ?
tasyedamiti sambandhāditi cettaddhito bhavet |
ṅīṣeva bādhaka- syāccennityaṃ bādhaḥ prasajyate ||
gaṇakasyeyamiti bhedasambandhe vivakṣite `tasyedam' iti taddhitaḥ prāpnoti | atha nāprāpte taddhite ṅīṣārabhyamāṇastasya bādhaka ityucyate, kadācidapi taddhito na syāta, ubhayamapi tviṣyate---prāṣṭhī, praṣṭhīti ? syānmatametat‌---`etadeva ṅīṣvidhānaṃ jñāpakam---bheda vivakṣāyāmapi taddhitamantareṇa praṣṭhādayaḥ striyāṃ varttate' iti | tena `na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā' iti niyamo'tra bādhyate, sati hi taddhite prāṣṭhītyaṇi ṅībeva siddhaḥ, tasya codāttanivṛttisvareṇodāttatvamiti kiṃ ṅīṣvidhāneneti ? tanna; ye'nīkārāntāstaddhitāḥ---bhānoriyaṃ bhānavīyeti, tadarthametatsyāt‌ | evaṃ tarhyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---nātra taddhitotpattiriti, na hi taddhitāntaḥ prakṛtyarthe puṃsi vartate ? evamapi jñāpakena taddhitasya nityaṃ bādhātprāṣṭhīti na syāt‌ | tasmād‌ duṣṭa evāyaṃ pakṣaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi yathā---mañcāḥ krośanti, gaurvāhīkaḥ, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ, yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyādau tātsthāttāddharmyāttatsāmīpyāttatsāhacaryāccātasminnapi tattvādhyāropeṇa tacchabdapravṛttistadvadatrāpi praṣṭhādisāhacaryāttacchabdapravṛttirbhaviṣyati ? tatrābhedena bhedasambandhasya nivṛttatvānna taddhitaprasaṅgaḥ | vivakṣite ca bhede taddhitotpattyā prāṣṭhītyādi bhaviṣyati ? tatrāhuḥ---yastvayā dharmaścaritavyaḥ so'nayā saheti bhāryāyāḥ śāstrasiddhaṃ sāhacaryamiti tasyāmevaitanṅīṣvidhānamiti | bhaṭṭikāvye tu duhitṛṣvapi dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ---`kausalyayā'sāvi sukhena rāmaḥ prakkekayīto bharatastato'bhūt‌' iti, kekayasya duhitā kekayī, janapadaśabdādapatyapratyaye tu kaikayīti prāpnoti, na ca tasya `ātaśca' iti luk‌, na prācyabhargādīti pratiṣedhāttat | tasmātso'yamityabhisambandha ityayameva pakṣo grāhyaḥ |
yadvā---yathā svāmidāsau pacata iti svāminaḥ saṃvidhātṛtvātpaktṛtvam, dāsasya tu sākṣāt‌; tathā puruṣaḥ sākṣātpratiṣṭhate stryapi saṃvidhātṛtvātpuruṣagatāyāḥ prasthānakriyāyāstasyāmāropātpratiṣṭhata iti, tasyāmeva praṣṭhaśabdo vyutpādyate, na tu puruṣe vyutpāditaḥ san‌ tena sahābhedopacārāttasyāṃ vartate | na caitāvatā puṃyogādeva hetoḥ striyāṃ vartata ityasya hāniḥ, sākṣātsvayamakartṛtvāt‌ | atra pakṣe prastha iti sthite subantasya samāsaḥ, sup‌ ca saṃkhyānimittam, prātipadikaṃ ca pūrvaṃ liṅgamabhidhatte, paścātsaṅkhyāmiti tannimittasubapekṣātsamāsātprāgevottarapadātsthaśabdāṭṭāpprasaṅgaḥ, na ca sthaśabdādapyanenaiva ṅīṣ‌ labhyate, praṣṭhaśabdo hi puṃsa ākhyā, na tu sthaśabdamātram, ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛddhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk‌ subutpatteḥ' iti kṛdantāvasthāyāmeva samāsaḥ, sā puṃsa ākhyeti ṅīṣ‌ bhaviṣyati | paribhāṣāprayojanāni `upapadamatiṅ‌' ityatra pratipāditāni |
devadatteti | striyā eva kasyāścideṣā saṃjñā---parisṛṣṭā, prajāteti | prasūtetyarthaḥ | puṃyogādete śabdāḥ striyāṃ vartanta iti | parisargaḥ, prasavaḥ, prajana ityarthāntaram | sa ca na puṃyogamantareṇa sambhavati, tasmātpuṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ vartate | parisṛṣṭā prajāteti | dvau prakṛtau | ete śabdā iti bahuvacanaṃ tu evaṃjātīyakāḥ śabdāḥ prasūtādayastadapekṣaṃ draṣṭavyam | gopālikādīnāmiti | siddhaye iti śeṣaḥ |
sūryāddevatāyāṃ cābvaktavya iti | ṅīṣa eva pratiṣedhe vaktavyeṃ cābvidhānamantodāttārtham | sūryaśabdo'yamādyudāttaḥ, tatra ṭāpi sati ādyudāttatvamevāvatiṣṭhena | sūrīti | sūryasya strī mānuṣī kuntyādiḥ, `sūryatiṣya' iti yalopaḥ ||
indravaruṇabhavaśarvarudramṛḍahimāraṇyayavayavanamātulācāryāṇāmānuk‌ || 4.4.49 ||
yeṣāyiti | indrādīnāṃ mṛḍāntānāṃ mātulācāryayośca | anyeṣāmiti | himādīnām |
himāraṇyayormahattva iti | mahattvayogenānayoḥ strītvam, anyatra napuṃsakatvam | duṣṭo yava iti pāṭhaḥ | yavānīti | jātyantaramevābhidhīyate, ayameva ca doṣo yaduta yavatvajāterabhāve tadākārānukṛtiḥ |
yavanāllipyāmiti | kecijjanapadino yavanāsteṣāṃ lipiḥ, `tasyedam' ityaṇo bādhako ṅīṣ‌ | lipiśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ |
upādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ veti | upādhyāyamātulābhyāṃ yo ṅīṣ‌ tatsanniyogenānayorvā''nugāgamo bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | tatropādhyāyasyāprāpto mātulasya tu nityaṃ prāpta ānugvikalpyate |
ācāryādaṇatvaṃ ceti | kṣubhnādiṣu paṭhitavyamityuktaṃ bhavati |
aryakṣattriyābhyāṃ veti | ṅīṣānukau dvāvapyaprāptau vikalpyete | svārtha evāyaṃ vidhiriti | yadi tu puṃyoge'yaṃ vidhiḥ syācchūdrāpi kṣattriyasya bhāryā kṣattriyāṇī syāt‌, brāhmaṇabhāryā ca kṣattriyāṇī na syāt‌ | tasmātsvārtha eva strītvaviśiṣṭo'yaṃ vidhiḥ |
mud‌galāditi | ṅīṣo littvādānugākārasya litsvaraḥ | atha kimarthamānugvidhīyate, na anugevocyeta, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyādato guṇe pararūpaṃ bādhitvā savarṇadīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathā nugevocyeta, yathaiva tarhi pararūpaṃ na bhavati tathaiva savarṇadīrghatvamapi na syāt‌ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, tasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate, tasmādānugeva vaktavyaḥ |
apara āha---`indramācaṣṭe indrayati, indrayateḥ kvip‌, ṇilopaḥ, indraḥ strī indrāṇī, atra dīrghasya śravaṇam, dīrghāccāraṇasāmarthyādata ityadhikāro bādhyate' iti, evamapi kvibantaḥ puṃsa ākhyā na bhavati ||
krītātkaraṇapūrvāt‌ || 4.1.50 ||
pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacana ityāha---karaṇaṃ pūrvamasminnityādi | vyavasthāvācini tu pūrvaśabde karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi vācyaṃ syāt‌ | evaṃ ca krītasya karaṇavāciśabdāntaramavayavo nopapadyata iti tadvyatiriktameva prātipadikaṃ karaṇapūrvatvena viśeṣyate, krītaśabdenāpi viśeṣitasyaiva viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirityāha---krītaśabdāntātprātipadikāditi | yadi tu vyavasthāvācinaṃ pūrvaśabdamāśritya krītaśabdo viśeṣyati---karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi, tato vākye'pi syād‌---aśvena krīteti | tasmādavayavavācī pūrvaśabdaḥ, prātipadikaṃ ca viśeṣyamiti samyaguktam | vastrakrītiti | `gatikārakopapadānām' iti vacanāt‌ prāgeva subutpatteḥ krītaśabdena saha samāsaḥ |
cābantena samāsa iti | ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavattvātkṛdantatāyā avighātādaviruddhaṣṭābantena samāsaḥ | atha ṭābantenāpi samāse kasmādevātra na bhavati ? tatrāha---ata itīti | nanūdāharaṇavatprāgeva ṭābutpatteratrāpi samāsaḥ prāpnoti, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? ata āha---gatikārakopapadānāmityādi | na tatra bahulagrahaṇamastīti cettatrāha---kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulamiti | `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityanena tāvadatra samāsaḥ, sa ca bahulagrahaṇāt‌ prāk‌ subutpatteḥ kvacidbhavati, kvacidutpanne supīti manyate | etāvataiva ca bahulaṃ taducyate iti sāmanyenoktam, na punaḥ `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ityayameva samāsaḥ prāk‌ subutpattariṣyate | yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā naitadiṣyate ||
ktādalpākhyāyām || 4.1.51 ||
alpākhyāyāmiti samudāyopādhiriti | nanu cālpairabhrairvilipteti pūrvapadārthasyaivālpatā gamyate, na viliptārthasya ? evaṃ manyate---abhrāṇāṃmalpatve sati tadvilepanasyālpatvamavaśyambhāvīti | abhraviliptīti | vṛttau gatārthatvādalpaśabdasyāprayogaḥ |
candanānulipteti | bahulena candanenānuliptetyarthaḥ | kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayā samudāyasya ktāntatvam ||
bahuvrīheścāntodāttāt‌ || 4.1.52 ||
bahuvrīhiryo'ntodākta iti | atra `ktāt‌' ityanuvṛttisāmarthyātpratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā, kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣā ca na pravartate iti bahuvrīheḥ ktāntatvam | śaṅkhabhinniti | `niṣṭhā' iti pūrvanipāto na bhavati; `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' iti vacanāt‌ | śaṅkhādayo hi jātivacanāḥ, ata eva `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' ityantodāttatvaṃ bhavati | galotkṛttīti | `kṛtī chedane', utpūrvāt‌ ktaḥ | galamutkṛttamasyā iti vigrahaḥ |
pādapatiteti | `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, thāthādisvareṇāntodāttatvam |
antodāttājjātapratiṣedha iti | antodāttādvahubrīherṅīṣvidhāne jātaśabdāntātpratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, sa tvantagrahaṇādeva siddhaḥ | katham ? ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, varṇādanudāttāditivad‌ udāttāntāditi vijñāsyate, tat‌ kriyate nityayoge yathā bahuvrīhirvijñāyeta | dantajātādau tu `vā jāte' iti vikalpenāntodāttatvam |
pāṇigṛhītyādīnāṃ viśeṣa iti | siddhaye iti śeṣaḥ | agnisākṣikaṃ yasyāḥ pāṇirgṛhyate sā pāṇigṛhītīti bhavati | kathañciditi | yathoktātprakārādanyena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ |
abahunañityādi | bahvādipūrvapadādvahuvrīherṅīṣ‌ na bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | bahukṛteti | bahuni kṛtānyanayeti vigrahaḥ, `bahornañvaduttarapadabhūmni' ityantodāttatvam | akṛtā, sukṛteti | na vidyate kṛtamanayā, śobhanaṃ kṛtamanayeti vigrahaḥ, `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvam | māsajāteti | māso jāto'tīto'syāḥ | sukhaṃ jātaṃ prāptamanayā, duḥ khaṃ jātamanayeti vigrahaḥ | sukhādayaḥ `sukhādibhyaḥ kartṛvedanāyām' ityatra paṭhitā gṛhyante | atha vā---bahuvrīheśca jātipūrvāditi vaktavyam, bahuvrīhāvantodāttanimitteṣvanyeṣu pratiṣiddheṣu jātirevāntodāttanimittaṃ ktāntasyāvaśiṣyate iti jātigrahaṇamevātra kartavyamityartaḥ ||
asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā || 4.1.53 ||
śārṅgajagdhītyādi | śārṅga jagdhamanayā, palāṇḍurbhakṣito'nayeti vigrahaḥ | śārṅgādirabhakṣyajātiḥ | sarvatra `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' ityantodāttatvam |
vastracchanneti | `chada apavāraṇe' curādiḥ, `vā dāntaśānta' ityādino channa śabdo nipātitaḥ, atra `anācchādanāt‌' iti pratiṣedhātpūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvameva bhavati |
pravṛddhā cetyādinā vigrahaviśeṣeṇa tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati ||
svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopaghāt‌ | atikeśīti | atikrāntā keśāniti tatpuruṣaḥ, `ekavibhakti ca' iti keśaśabdasyopasarjanatvam | aśikheti | asatyupasarjanagrahaṇe'traiva prāpnoti, na mūlodāharaṇeṣu; `anupasarjanāt‌' ityadhikārāt‌ | atha bahuvrīhyadhikārādatra na bhaviṣyatītyucyeta ? atikeśītyatrāpi tarhi na syāt‌ | `aṅgātra' ityādibhāṣye'nuktamapyetatprayogabāhulyād‌ vṛttikāreṇoktam |
yadyatra svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgaṃ gṛhyeta---ślakṣṇamukhā śālā, atrāpi prāpnoti, mukhasya śālāṅgatvāt ; dīrghakeśī rathyetyatra ca na syāt‌, keśānāṃ rathyāṅgatvābhāvāt ? tadavyāptyativyāptiparihārārthaṃ svāṅgaṃ paribhāṣyate---adravamiti | tatra prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgamityanena ślakṣṇamukhā śāletyatra na bhavati | evamapi bahukaphā atra prāpnoti ? tadarthamāha---adravamiti | dravatīti dravam, tato'nyadadravam | evamapi bahujñānā---atrāpi prāpnoti ? ata āha---mūrttimaditi | asarvagatadravyaparimāṇā mūrtiḥ, asarvagatāni yāni dravyāṇi teṣāṃ yatparimāṇaṃ hrasvatyādi sā mūrtiḥ; sparśavad‌ dravyaparimāṇaṃ mūtirityanye, sā yasyāsti tanmūrtimat | evamapi bahuśophā atra prāpnoti ? ityata āha---avikārajamiti | vikāraḥ-vātādivaiṣamyam, tato yajjāyate tanna bhavatītyavikārajam | śophastu śvayathusaṃjñako vikārajaḥ | yadi prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgam, rathyādiparigatānāṃ keśānāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na syāt‌, sampratyaprāṇisthatvāt‌, tataśca dīrghakeśī rathyeti na siddhyatyata āha---atatsthamiti | sampratyaprāṇisthamapi kadācitprāṇini dṛṣṭaṃ cettadapi svāṅgaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | evamapi pratimāvayavānāṃ mukhādīnāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na prāpnoti, aprāṇisthatvāt‌, tataśca dīrghamukhī pratimetyatra na siddhyati ? tatrāha--tena cediti | atatsthamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | aprāṇisthamapi mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tena cenmukhādinā tadaprāṇidravyaṃ tathā yutaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇidravyamityarthaḥ | anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ---tasya cettattathā yutamiti | tatrārthaḥ---aprāṇisthamapi mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tasya cedaprāṇinaḥ tanmukhādi tathā yutaṃ bhavati, tādṛśaṃ saṃsthānaṃ bhavati yādṛśaṃ saṃsthānaṃ prāṇina ityarthaḥ ||
nāsikodarauṣṭhajaṅghādantakarṇaśrṛṅgācca || 4.1.55 ||
sahaniñvidyamānalakṣaṇastu pratiṣedho bhavatyeveti | katham ? nāsikodarayostāvadayaṃ yogaḥ purastādapavādanyāyenānantaraṃ bahvajlakṣaṇameva pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, oṣṭhādiṣvapi madhye'pavādanyāyena pūrvaṃ saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇaṃmeva pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, na sahādilakṣaṇam; ato'sau bhavatyeva---sanāsikā, anāsikā, vidyamānanāsiketi | bimboṣṭhīti | `otvoṣṭhāyorvā samāse pararūpaṃ vaktavyam' iti pararūpam |
kabarapucchīti | kabaram-nānāvarṇaṃ pucchamasyāḥ sā mayūrī | maṇiḥ pucchamasyāḥ maṇipucchī, viṣaṃ pucchamasyāḥ viṣapucchī vṛścikī | ulūka iva pakṣo'syāḥ ulūka iva pucchamasyā iti vigrahaḥ ||
na kroḍādibahvacaḥ || 4.1.56 ||
kalyāṇakroḍeti | aśvānāmuraḥ kroḍā, strīliṅgo'yam | tatra bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, uttarapadasyopasarjanahnasvatvam | alyāṇanakheti | agrantho'yam; `nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām' iti pratiṣedhāt‌, asaṃjñāyāṃ ṅīṣa iṣṭatvāt‌, tasmāt‌ kalyāṇekheti pāṭhaḥ | ukheti hi paṭhyate---`kroḍā bālasurokhāḥ śapho gudaṃ bhagagalau ca' iti ||
sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca || 4.1.57 ||
pūrvagrahaṇamakṛtvā `sahanañvidyamānebhyaḥ' ityucyamāne sahādibhyaḥ paraṃ yatsvāṅgaṃ tadantānṅīṣ‌ na bhavatītyartho bhavati, tataśceha pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta---vidyamānaṃ mukhamasya vidyamānamukhaḥ, kalyāṇo vidyamānamukho'syāḥ kalyāṇavidyamānamukhīti, bhavati hyetad‌ yathoktaviśeṣaṇam; iha ca na syād‌---vidyamānakalyāṇamukheti, na hyatra yathoktaṃ viśeṣaṇamasti, tasmātpūrvagrahaṇam ||
nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām || 4.1.58 ||
śūrpaṇakheti | `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāyāmagaḥ' iti ṇatvam | evaṃ ca śūrpaṇakhā vā rākṣasī śūrpanakhī vā | yadi yogamātraṃ na saṃjñā---śūrpanakhī, saṃjñāyām---śūrpaṇakhā; na punaḥ śūrpaṇakhīti ṇatvaṅīṣo samāveśaḥ sādhuḥ ||
dīrghajihvī cacchandasi || 4.1.59 ||
nipātanaṃ nityārthamiti | `dīrghajihvāt‌' ityucyamāne prakṛtasya ṅīṣo vikalpitatvādihāpi vikalpo vijñāyate ||
dikpūrvapadānṅīp‌ || 4.1.60 ||
dikpūrvapadānṅīṣo'nudāttatvam, `svāṅgācca' ityādinā vihitasya ṅīṣa evāsminviṣaye'nudāttatvaṃ vaktavyam, ṅībvidhāne hyanyatrāpiṅīṣviṣayānṅīpprasaṅgaḥ | apūrve hi ṅīpi vidhīyamāne prāggulphā, prāgjaghaneti ṅīṣviṣayādanyatrāpi ṅīpprāpnoti; ṅīṣaḥ pratiṣedhābhāvāt‌ ? ityasminpūrvapakṣe idamāha---vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ sarvo'pyapekṣyate iti | tatra vidhiviṣayāpekṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati---yatra ṅīṣvihita iti | svare biśeṣa iti | ṅīpaḥ pittvādanudāttatvaṃ bhavati, ṅīṣastu pratyayādyudāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ | prāṅ‌mukheti | ṅīpā mukte `svāṅgācco pasarjanāt‌' iti ṅīṣapi na bhavati, katham ? uktametat‌---`yatrotsargāpavādau dvāvapi vikalpitau tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na pravartate' iti |
pratiṣedhāpekṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati---iha na bhavatīti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā vākyabhedaḥ karttavyaḥ---dikpūrvapadādasaṃyogopadhasvāṅgāntānnāsikādyantānṅīṣ‌ bhavati; kroḍādibahvajantāttu neti aparaḥ kalpaḥ, atra ṅīṣanuvartate, tasya dikpūrvapadāditi pañcamyā ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate, dikpūrvapadāduttarasya ṅīṣo ṅībādeśo bhavatītyarthaḥ | tena yatra ṅīṣ tatraiva ṅībiti siddham | evaṃ cottaratra ṅīṣeva svaryata ityupapannaṃ bhavati ||
vāhaḥ || 4.1.61 ||
sāmarthyāditi | karmaṇyupapade vaherṇvidhānātkevalasya vāhaḥ sambhavo nāstītyetatsāmarthyam | dityauhīti | `chandasisahaḥ', `vahaśca' iti ṇviḥ, upadhāvṛddhiḥ, ṅīṣi `vāha ūṭh', tatra samprasāraṇamityanuvṛtteḥ `samprasāraṇācca' iti pūrvarūpatvam, `etyedhatyūṭh‌su' iti vṛddhiḥ ||
sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām || 4.1.62 ||
bhāṣāyāmityucyate, tatraitanna sidhyati---sakhī saptapadī bhava, ā dhenavo dhunayantāmaśiśvīriti ? naiṣa doḥ; itikaraṇo'tra kriyate, sa bhinnakramo bhāṣāyāmityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, sa ca prakāre vartate, tena chandasyapi kvacidbhaviṣyati | bhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tu nityārtham ||
jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt‌ || 4.1.63 ||
astrīviṣayādityananyabhāve viṣayaśabda ityāha---na ca straiyāmiti | striyāmeva yasya niyamena vṛttistatstrīviṣayam, tato'nyadastrīviṣayamityarthaḥ |
iha laukikajātigrahaṇe brāhmaṇatvādīnāṃ gotrasya ca nāḍāyanāderjātitve vādināṃ vipratipatteḥ, caraṇaśabdānāṃ ca kaṭhādīnāmadhyayanakriyāsambandhanibandhanatvena pācakādivatkriyāśabdatvenāvyāptirityabhimatāṃ jāti lakṣayati---ākṛtigrahaṇā jātiriti | gṛhyate'neneti grahaṇamiti karaṇasāmānye padaṃ saṃskriyate, paścādākṛtiśabdasamavadhāne strītvaṃ pratīyamānaṃ bahiraṅgatvāt‌ pratyayasya nimittaṃ na bhavati | grahaṇamākṛtiryasyā iti grahaṇarūpod‌deśenākṛtirūpatā vidhīyate, na tvākṛtirūpod‌deśena grahaṇarūpatetyarthaḥ | ākṛtiḥ-saṃsthānam, sā grahaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā''kṛtigrahaṇā, avayavasanniveśaviśeṣavyaṅgyetyarthaḥ | anena gotvādijātirlakṣitā | brāhmaṇatvādijātistu na saṃgṛhītā bhavati, brāhmaṇakṣattriyādīnāṃ saṃsthānasya sadṛśatvāditi tatsaṃgrahāyā''ha---liṅgānāṃ ceti | sarvāṇi liṅgāni na bhajatītyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ | tatra sarvaśabdasya liṅgāpekṣatve'pigamakatvādbhajo ṇvipratyayaḥ, samāsaśca | `liṅgānām' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | aprāptaprāpaṇārthaṃ cedaṃ vacanam, na tvākṛtigrahaṇetyasya saṅkocakam; tena taṭādeḥ sarvaliṅgatve'pi ākṛtigrahaṇatvājjātitvaṃ bhavatyeva | iha kasmānna bhavati---devadattaḥ, devadatteti ?upadeśāpekṣamidaṃ lakṣaṇam | ko'rthaḥ ? asarvaliṅgeṣu yeṣu jātivācitvamācāryā upadiśanti teṣveva bhavatītyarthaḥ | ākṛtigrahaṇāyā jāterekatvanityatvapratyekaparisamāptatvalakṣaṇān‌ dharmānāha---sakṛditi | ekasminpiṇḍe sakṛdupadiṣṭā `ayaṃ gauḥ' iti piṇḍāntare nirgrāhyā, niścetuṃ śakyetyartaḥ | yadi caikā na syāt‌, naiva gṛhyeta | tathā nityatvābhāve'pi piṇḍena saha vināśātpiṇḍāntare na gṛhyeta | yadi ca pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā parisamāptā na syāt‌, tasminnapi tāvatpiṇḍe sarvātmanā na gṛhyeta yatrākhyātā, kiṃ punaḥ piṇḍāntare ! kathaṃ punarekameva vastu bahutra yugapatkārtsyena vartate, na hi devadattastadānīmeva srughne bhavati madhurāyāṃ ca ? dṛśyate cetko doṣaḥ, na hi dṛṣṭe'nupapannaṃ nāma ! gotramiti | apatyamityarthaḥ | caraṇaśabdena śākhādhyāyino gṛhyante, gotrasyānākṛtigrahaṇatvāt‌ sarvaliḍgatvācca pṛthagupādānam, `nāḍāyanaṃ napuṃsakam' iti darśanāt‌ | caraṇaśabdastvadhyayanakriyāsambandhena pravṛttatvātkriyāśabda eva, na jātiśabdaḥ |
kukkuṭī, sūkarīti | ākṛtigrahaṇāyā jāterudāharaṇam | brāhmaṇaī, vṛṣalītyasarvaliṅgāyāḥ | tatra brāhmaṇīti rūpodāharaṇam | śārṅgaravādiṣvasya pāṭhād‌ vṛṣalītyetadeva ṅīpa udāharaṇam | nāḍāyanī, cārāyaṇīti | gotralakṣaṇāyāḥ `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌' | apatyamātrasya grahaṇādanantarāpatye'pi bhavati---avantī, kuntīti, `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣbhavati | iha tu kulasyāpatyaṃ kulīnā brāhmaṇīti ṅīṣ‌ na bhavati; ajādiṣu darśanādityāhuḥ | kaṭhīti | kaṭhena proktam, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ, tasya `kaṭhacarakāt‌' iti luk‌, tataḥ `tadadhīte' ityaṇ‌, tasya `proktālluk‌' iti luk‌ | bahavṛcīti | bahvya ṛco'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `bah‌vṛścaraṇākhyāyām' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ strī nāmādhīte ? mā nāmādhigīṣṭa, tadvaṃśyatvāttu tācchadbyaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā---anadhīyamāne māṇavake |
atrāparaṃ jātilakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhāṣye---
prādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ sattvasya yugapad‌guṇaiḥ |
asarvaliṅgāṃ bahvarthāṃ tāṃ jātiṃ kavayo viduḥ || iti |
sattvasya prādurbhāvavināśābhyāṃ yā''virbhāvatirobhāvo prāpnoti, yāvad‌dravyabhāvinītyarthaḥ | guṇaiśca yugapad‌ dravyeṇa sambadhyate yathā nirguṇaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavati, tathā jātirahitamapītyarthaḥ | bahvarthāmiti | arthaśabdo viṣayavācī, bahuviṣayāṃ bahuvyaktivyāpinīmityarthaḥ | asarvaliṅgāmiti | pūrvallakṣaṇāntaram | tatra yathā pūrvalakṣaṇaṃ tathā kumārībhāryā iti bhavitavyam, katham ? kaumāramayāvad‌dravyabhāvyapi ākṛtigrahaṇatvādbhavanati jātiḥ, tataśca `jāteśca' iti puṃbadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ | vṛddhā, sthaviretyādau ca jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣprāpnoti, yathā punaruttaraṃ tathā kaumārādikaṃ jātirna bhavati; ayāvad‌dravyabhāvitvāt‌ | tatra pūrvakaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhāṣyakārasyābhimatam, nottaram; apara āhetyabhidhānāt‌ | tathā ca ṅyāpsūtre yuvatitaretyatra `tasilādiṣu' iti prāptasya puṃvadbhāvasya `jāteśca' iti niṣedha āśritaḥ | ata eva vṛttikāreṇāpyetadeva lakṣaṇamupanyastamiti kecidāhuḥ | evamapi yuvajānirityatra puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti, tasmād‌ dvitīyameva lakṣaṇaṃ sādhīyo manyāmahe | ata eva vṛddhā, sthavireti jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣna bhavati | yuvatitaretyatra tu bhāṣyakāraprayogātpuṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ |
muṇḍeti | guṇaśabdo'yam | makṣiketi | striyāmevāyaṃ niyataḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati---mālā, balāketi ? mālāśabdo malanaṃ māla iti ghañantaḥ puṃlliṅgaḥ, kṣetraviśeṣe napuṃsakaḥ, sraji strīliṅgaḥ | balākāśabdo hi balāṃ kāyatīti yaugikaḥ sarvaliṅgaḥ, bakajātivacanaḥ strīliṅgaḥ | nātra yathākathañcidastrīliṅgaviṣayatvaṃ vivakṣitam , kiṃ tarhi ? yasminpravṛttinimitte strīliṅgastasminneva nimitte yalliṅgāntare'pi varttate tadastrīviṣayam | yathā punarayaṃ śabdārthastathā `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ | tena nimittabhedena nānāliṅgeṣu nāyaṃ vidhirbhavati | yadyevam, droṇī, vuṭī, pātrītyatra na prāpnoti ? droṇaśabdaḥ pramāṇaviśeṣe puṃlliṅgaḥ; gavādinyāṃ tu strīliṅgaḥ; kuṭaśabdo ghaṭe puṃlliṅgaḥ, gehe tu strīliṅgaḥ; gaurādipāṭhātsiddham |
hayagavayetyādi | gaurādiṣvidānīntanairhayādayaḥ prakṣiptā iti vārtikakāravacanādvijñāyate ||
pākakarṇaparṇapuṣpaphalamūlabālottarapadācca || 4.1.64 ||
strīviṣayatvādeteṣāmiti | pūrvatra samānāyāmākṛtau yadastrīviṣayamityāśrayaṇānnimittabhedena nānāliṅgānāmeṣāṃ na sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | odanapākādayaḥ saṃjñāśabdā yathākathañcidvyutpādyāḥ ||
ito manuṣyajāteḥ || 4.1.65 ||
avantī, kuntīti | avanti-kuntiśabdābhyāmapatye'rthe `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' tasya `striyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca' iti luk‌ | dākṣaī, lpākṣīti | `ata iñ‌' |
viṭ‌, daraditi | viṭ‌śabdājjanapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ‌, daracchabdād‌ `dvyañmagadha' ityādināṇa, tayoḥ `ataśca' iti luk‌ | udāharaṇasiddhyarthameva `ataḥ' ityasyānuvṛttirna śakyā''śrayitumityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ |
audameyīti | udakaṃ meyamasya udameyaḥ, `udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām' ityudabhāvaḥ, `tasyāpatyam', `ata iñ‌'|
sautaṅgamī, maunicittīti | sutaṅgamamunicittaśabdābhyāṃ `tena nirvṛttam' ityatrārthe iñpratyayaḥ ||
ūṅutaḥ || 4.1.66 ||
kururiti | `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' tasya `striyāmavanti' ityādinā luk | vrahmabandhūrjīvabandhūriti | vṛttasvādhyāyahīnāyā brāhmaṇajātāvetau bahuvrīhī vartete |
ṅakāra ityādi | `nodhātvoḥ' ityucyamāne, yavāgvā, yavāgvai---atrāpi `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt‌' iti prāptasya vibhaktyudāttasya niṣedhaḥ syāt‌, varṇagrahaṇe hyarthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate | atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na `uṅutaḥ' ityevocyeta, savarṇadīrghatvena siddham ? na sidhyati; satyapi savarṇadīghatve, `gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti | na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? `ubhayata āśrayaṇe nāntādivat‌', tathā hi ekādeśasyāntavattvena pratipadikasaṃjñā sampādyā, `apratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhāt | ādivattvena ca strīpratyayatvaṃ sampādyam | iti tarhi brahmabandhūcchattram---ṣatvatukorasiddhatvād‌ hrasvalakṣaṇo nityastuk‌ prasajyeta, dīrghoccāraṇāttvekādeśasyāsiddhatve'pi dīrgha evāyamiti `dīrghātpadāntādvā' iti vikalpaḥ sidhyati ? etadapi nāsti prayojanam ; padāntapadādyorekādeśo'siddhaḥ, na caipa padāntapadādyorekādeśaḥ | tasmādanarthakaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam ? ityāśaṅkyāha---dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kapo bādhanārthamiti | `śeṣādvibhāṣaā' iti kapo'vakāśaḥ---ayavakaḥ, avrīhikaḥ, ūṅo'vakāśaḥ--kurūriti; brahmabandhvāderbahuvrīherubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkap‌ prāpnoti, dīrghoccāraṇānna bhavita, katham ? ukāradvayaṃ dīrgheṇa nirdiṣṭam, tatra dvitīya ukāraḥ kapo bādhanārthaḥ | adhvaryuriti | adhvaraṃ yātīti `mṛgayvādayaśca' ityuṇādiṣu darśanāt‌ kupratyayo'dhvaraśabdasyāntalopaśca | caraṇalakṣaṇeyaṃ jātiḥ, adhvaryuśākhādhyāyini vaṃśe bhavetyarthaḥ |
aprāṇijāteśceti | atra `utaḥ' iti nāpekṣyate tenālābū-karkandhūśabdābhyāṃ dīrghāntābhyāmapi bhavati | `kṛṣicamitanidhanisajikharjibhya ūḥ' iti vartamāne `ṇitkaśipadyarteḥ' ityato ṇiditi ca, `nañi lambernarlopaśca', `labi avusraṃsane', tasmānnañpūrvādūpratyayo bhavati nalopaśca ṇittvād‌ vṛddhiḥ, `andūdṛmbhūkarkandhūḥ' iti nipātanādūkārāntaḥ karkandhūśabdaḥ | evamalābū-karkandhūśabdau dīrghāntau | ūṅ‌vidhānamalābvā, karkandhvā ityādau `noṅ‌dhātvoḥ' iti vibhaktyudāttatvapratiṣedhārtham | kṛkavākuriti | `kṛke vacaḥ kaśca' kṛkaśabda upapade vakerdhātoruṇ pratyayo bhavati, kaścanāntādeśaḥ | rajjuriti | `sṛjerasum ca', ādilopaḥ prakṛtaḥ, sṛjeru pratyayaḥ, ādeśca lopo'sugāgamaśca, ṛto yaṇādeśaḥ, sakārasya jaśtvacartve, sṛjyate'sau rajjuriti | hanuriti | `yusnihi' ityādinā hanterupratyayaḥ ||
paṅgośca || 4.1.68 ||
śvaśurasyeti | puṃyogalakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo'pavāda ūṅ‌ vidhīyate, `śāvaśerāptau' śuśabde'śnoteruran‌ pratyayo bhavati | kimidaṃ śu iti ? āśuśabdasyāyamādilopo nipātitaḥ | āśvāptavyaḥ śvaśuraḥ, tasya strī śvaśrūḥ, `śvaśuraḥ śvavavā' ityadinipātanādvibhaktyādi prātipadikakāryaṃ bhavati ||
ūrūttarapadādaupamye || 4.1.69 ||
upamīyate'nayetyupamā, tadbhāva aupamyam | kathaṃ `vicakare ca kareṇukarorubhiḥ' iti ? niraṅkuśāḥ kavayaḥ; `kareṇa varorubhiḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ---kareṇa vicakare varorubhiriti ||
saṃhitaśaphalaṇakṣavāmādeśca || 4.1.70 ||
saṃhitaśabdaḥ sahitaparyāyaḥ, lakṣaṇaśabdo'rśaādyacpratyayāntaḥ, vāmaśabdaḥ śobhanaparyāyaḥ |
sahitasahābhyāṃ ceti | `samo vā hitatatayoḥ' iti malope sati yaḥ sahitaśabdastasya saṃhitagrahaṇenaiva siddham, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌ | yastu saha hitena vartate iti vyutpannaḥ sahitaśabdastasyedaṃ grahaṇamityāhuḥ | sahorūriti | sahete iti sahau, tādṛśāvūrū yasyā ityarthaḥ | vidyamānasya vā sahaśabdasya ūrvatiśayapratipādanāya prayogaḥ ||
kadrukamaṇḍalvośchandasi || 4.1.71 ||
guggulvādīnāṃ chandasi vyatyayena strītvam | patayāluśabdaḥ `spṛhigṛhi' ityādinā''lujantaḥ ||
śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn‌ || 4.1.73 ||
ete'ṇanta iti | śrṛṅgaru, kapaṭu, guggulu, brahman‌---ityetebhyaḥ prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌, gotamaśabdādṛṣyaṇ,, gaurādiṣvapyayaṃ paṭhitaḥ | ete ḍhagantā iti | bāhulyādevamuktam | kaṇaṇḍaluśabdāccatuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ‌, itarebhyastu śubhrādilakṣaṇo ḍhak‌ | etau phagantāviti | vātsyaśabdād‌ gargādiyañantādyūni `yañiñośca' iti phak‌ | nanu na striyāṃ yuvasaṃjñā, `gotrādyūnyastriyām' iti vacanāt‌, gotre ca `eko gotre' iti niyamaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi vātsyāyanaśabdasyāsmin‌ gaṇe pāṭhasāmarthyātstriyāṃ yuvasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, gotra eva vā pratyayadvayam | muñjaśabdo naḍādiḥ | jātiriti | gotralakṣaṇā | ḍhaganta iti | kīkasāśabdaḥ śubhrādiḥ | ñyaṅantāviti | `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ‌' iti kavi-śivibhyāṃ ñyaṅ‌, `yaṅaścāp‌' atra prāpnoti | ehi, paryehīti | `īha ceṣṭāyām' āṅ‌pūrvātparyāṅ‌pūrvācca `sarvadhātubhya in' itīn‌ pratyayaḥ, aśmarathaśabdo gargādiḥ, udapānaśabdaḥ śuṇḍikādiḥ, utsādiśca, tatrāha---śuṇḍikādyaṇantaḥ prayojayatīti | ante tu ṅīpo ṅīno vā nāsti viśeṣaḥ | jātiriti | arāla--caṇḍālayorasarvaliṅgatvājjātitvam | vataṇḍaśabdasya gotratvāt‌ | vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī `vataṇḍācca' iti yañ‌, `luk‌ striyām' iti tasya luk‌ | bhogavad‌gorimatoriti | matvantatvāt‌ `ugitaśca' iti ṅīpi prāpte vacanam | nanu bhogaśabdo ghañantaḥ, gauriśabdaḥ `ata iñ‌' itīñantaḥ, tau ñitsvareṇādyudāttau, tābhyāṃ matup‌, pittvādanudāttaḥ, tataśca na ṅībṅīnoratrāsti viśeṣaḥ ? tatrāha---ghādiṣu nityamiti | ugillakṣaṇe ṅīpi sati `nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām', `ugitaśca' iti vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ syāt‌, ṅīni tu sati `gharūpakalpa' iti nityaṃ sambhavati | kathaṃ bhavati, yāvatā ugitaḥ parā yā nadī tasyā vikalpo vihitaḥ, ṅīnapi cogitaḥ parā nadī, bogavad‌gaurimatorugittvāt‌ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ugitaśca' iti ityarthe'yaṃ caśabdaḥ, ugita ityevamugitsaṃśabdanena yā nadī vihitā na cānena vihito ṅīnevaṃ vihitā nadī bhavati | yathā tu `yuvoranākau' ityatra bhāṣyam, tathogitaḥ parā yā nadītyetadeva sthitam | saṃjñāyā anyatra hībeva bhavati hrasvaśca vikalpitaḥ |
nṛnarayorvṛddhiśceti | nṛśabdādṛnnebhyo ṅīpi, naraśabdājjātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte vacanam | vṛddhiśceti, vakṣyāmīti ca anyatarasya grahaṇe'pi nārītīṣṭaṃ siddham, anyatarasyāniṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ tu dvayorupādānam | tatra naraśabde'ntyasya vṛddhau satyāṃ yasyetilopādānarthakyamiti yasyeti lopastāvadbhavati, tatra kṛte rephasya vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, kā ? aviśeṣtparyāyeṇa sarvaiva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' ityatrāntaratame sthāne ṣaṣṭhītyapi pakṣo vyākhyātaḥ, tato nṛnarayoriti yaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī sā vṛddherantaratame nṛnarāvayave sthāninyanusaṃhriyate | yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī tatrādeśa ityakārasyaiva bhaviṣyati | atra puttraśabdaṃ kecitpaṭhanti, na sa kevalaḥ striyāṃ vartata iti tadantasya samāsasya grahaṇam | tatrāpi bahuputtrā, atiputtretyādāvanupasarjanādhikārānna bhavati | kva tarhi bhavati ? puttrapradhāne | nanu puttrapradhānaṃ samāse saiva puṃlliṅgatā ? satyam ; `sūtograrājabhojamerubhyo duhituḥ putraḍ‌ vā' iti vātikakāreṇa yatra putraḍādeśo vihitastānyudāharaṇāni | sūtaputtrī, rājaputtrīti---atra svabhāvātputtraśabdo duhitṛśabdena samānārthaḥ, na putraḍādeśa iti paṭhatāmabhiprāyaḥ |
anye tu `pradyotaputtrī śailaputtrīti vārttikaviṣayādanyadeva ṅīna udāharaṇam, putraḍādeśastu ṅīpi svarārthaḥ' iti manyante, nātrāptabhāṣitamasti ||
yaṅścāp‌ || 4.1.74 ||
pakāraḥ ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, svarastu paratvāccitsvara eva bhavati | ñyaṅaḥ ṣyaṅaśca sāmānyagrahaṇamiti | yadyapi ṣyaṅ‌striyāmeva vidhīyate, tathāpi ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyāttasyāpyatra grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | āmbaṣṭyetyādi | ambaṣṭhādibhyo'patye `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ‌' | kārīṣagandhyeti | svādisūtre vyutpāditam | varāhaśabdāt‌ `ata iñ‌'| śarkarākṣa-pūtimāṣagokakṣaśabdā gargādayaḥ |
nanu ca gaukākṣyaśabdaḥ krauḍyādiṣu paṭhyate, tataḥ ṣyaṅiḥ `yaṅa' ityeva cāp‌ siddhaḥ ? mā pāṭhi, tatra `ṣācca yañaḥ' ityanenaiva śarkarākṣyādivad‌ gaukākṣyeti siddham | yadyevam, gaukākṣīputraḥ---ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti ? nātra samprasāraṇamiṣyate, gaukākṣyāputra ityeva bhavati | evaṃ hi saunāgāḥ paṭhanti---`ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇe gaukakṣyāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' ||
taddhitāḥ || 4.1.76 ||
yuvatiriti | taddhitasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' iti prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati | bahuvacanamityādi | `pratyayaḥ' ityādivadekavacana eva kartavye bahuvacanenasaṃjñināṃ bahutvasūcanādanukto'pi taddhitaḥ parigṛhyata iti manyate | strīpratyayānāmāditastaddhitādhikāre kriyamāṇe `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' ityatra taddhitagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, `yasyeti ca' ityatra cakāragrahaṇam, `ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' ityatra tu tadantāttaddhitavidhānārthaṃ ṅyāvgrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva ? satyam; ṅībādīnāṃ ṅakārasyetsaṃjñā na syāt‌, `ataddhite' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ | satyāmapi vā paṭ‌vītyādau `orguṇaḥ' syāt‌ | tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu ||
yūnastiḥ || 4.1.77 ||
yuvatiriti | tyantāt‌ `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣna bhavati; tipratyayenaiva strītvasyoktatvāt‌ , yauvanasya vā'jātitvāt‌ ||
aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpottamayoḥ ṣyaṅ‌ gotre || 4.1.78 ||
iha sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, tena `gotre' `anārṣayoḥ' iti cāṇiñmātrasya viśeṣaṇam, `gurūpottamayoḥ' ityetattadantasya, tadāha---gotre yāvaṇiñau vihitāvanārṣau tadantayoriti | yadyapyapatyādhaikārādanyatra laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇam, tathāpyatra pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam ; laukikagrahaṇasya `anārṣayoḥ' iti paryudāsāśrayaṇenaiva siddhatvāt‌ | ihāyaṃ ṣyaṅ‌ pratyayo vā syāt‌ ? ādeśo vā ? pratyayavidhāvapi hi gāpoṣṭak‌' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīdarśanāt‌, uttaratra `krauḍyādibhyaśca' iti pañcamīnirdeśācca pratyayapakṣo'pi sambhavatyeva | tatrādyapakṣe udameghasyāpatyaṃ strī, `ata iñ‌', audameghi iti sthite tadantāt‌ ṣyaṅi vihite audameghyāyāśchāttrā audameghāśchāttrāḥ, audameghyānāṃ saṅghaḥ, `iñaśca' `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa' iti ca iñantādvidhīyamāno'ṇ‌ na syāt‌ | athāpi liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā iñantādvidhīyamāno'ṇ ṣyaṅantādapi syāt‌, evamapi `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' iti yalopo na syāt‌, ṣyaṅo'nāpatyatvāt‌ ? naiṣa doḥ ; `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvātprāgevaṇa utpatteḥ ṣyaṅ‌nivartate, tasminnivṛtte `iñaḥ' ityaṇbhaviṣyati, yakārasya ca śravaṇaṃna bhaviṣyati | iha tarhyaudameghyāyā upatyam `strībhyo ḍhak‌', audamegheya iti yalopo na syāt‌, puṃvadbhāvaśca nāsti, `aḍhe' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ ? itīmamādye pakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha---ṣyaṅādeśo bhavatīti |
nanvasminpakṣe uḍulomno'patyaṃ strī bāhvādiṣu lomanśabdasya pāṭhātkevalasyāpatyena yogābhāvātsāmarthyāttadantasya grahaṇādiñi tasya ṣyaṅādeśe sati `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvāt `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na syāt‌, tataścauḍulomanyeti syāt‌, auḍulomyeti ceṣyate, pratyayapakṣe iñā vyavadhānānnāsti prakṛtibhāvaḥ, yasyeti lope'pi kṛte sthānidbhāvādvyavadhānameva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ ; nātrākṛte ṭilope ṣyaṅ‌ prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? agurūpottamatvāt‌, tasmādiñyeva ṭilopaḥ, tato gurūpottamatvam, tataḥ ṣyaṅityānupūrvyātsiddham | ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ---pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā'ṇiñantayorgrahaṇam, tayorvidhīyamānaḥ ṣyaṅanekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti ? `ṅicca' ityantyasya bhaviṣyati, tātaṅ‌nyāyena sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti | yatra hi ṅakārasya prayojanāntaramapi sambhāvyate tatra `ṅicca' ityetadananyārthaṅittveṣvanaṅādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ bādhitvā `anekālśitsarvasya' ityetadbhavati, yathā tātaṅi | iha ca sarvādeśatve'pi `yaṅaścāp‌' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayojanaṃ sambhavati, tasmātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tatrāha---nirdiśyamānasyetyādi |
yadyayamuttamaśabdo vyutpannaḥ syāt‌, tadocchabdāttamapi kṛte `kimettiṅavyayaghād‌' ityāmprāpnoti ? na vā dravyaprakarṣatvāt‌ | ucchabdo hi sasādhanakriyāvacana ud‌gate vartate, tasya kriyādvārakaḥ prakarṣaḥ---atiśayenod‌gata iti, tataśca dravyaniṣṭhatvātprakarṣasya `adravyaprakarṣe' iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati | evamapi tamapaḥ pittvādādyudāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? na voñchādiṣu pāṭhāt‌, uñchādiṣu hi uttamaśaśvattamau sarvatreti paṭhyate | evamapi sa tāvatpāṭhaḥ katevyaḥ, kriyāmātrasya ca prakarṣe uttamāmityāmprasaṅgaśca, ato'nabhidānāvucchabdāttamapo'nutpattireṣitavyā | kiñcavyutpanna uttamaśabdaścatuṣprabhṛtiṣu vartate, katham ? ūrdhvamuccārita ud‌gataḥ, sa ca prathamoccāritamapekṣate, tataśca triṣu dvāvud‌gatau, tayośca dvitīyo'tiśayenod‌gataḥ, dvayośca sampradhāraṇāyāṃ tarapā bhāvyam, tataśca yatrod‌gatā eva trayastatraiva syāt‌---kārīṣagandhyetyādau; vārāhyetyādau tu na syāt‌ | tadevaṃ vyutpattipakṣe doṣaṃ paśyannavyutpattipakṣamāśrityāha---uttamaśabda iti | svābhāvāditi | na vyutpattivaśādityaraythaḥ | triprabhṛtīnāmiti vacanāddākṣī plākṣītyādau na bhavati |
ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañiti ṅībeva bhavatīti | prāptimātrābhiprāyeṇedamuktam | atra hi jātitvāt `śāऱgaravādyañaḥ' iti ṅīnā bhāvyam | vāsiṣṭhīti | `ṛṣyandhaka' ityādināṇ |
āhicchatrīti | jātādāvarthe'ṇ‌ | evamatrādeśapakṣaḥ sthāpitaḥ |
yadyevam, hastiśiraso'patyam, bāhvāditvādiñ‌, `aci śīrṣaḥ' iti śīrṣādeśaḥ, iñaḥ ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, tataḥ sthānivadbhāvena śīrṣaśabdasya śirograhaṇena grahaṇād‌ `ye ca taddhite' iti śīrṣannādeśaḥ prāpnoti ? astu; `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopo bhaviṣyati | `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tataśca hāstiśīrṣaṇyeti syāt‌, pratyayapakṣe tviñā'vyavahitatvānnāsti śīrṣannādeśaḥ, yasyeti lope'pi kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva, tena hāstiśīrṣeti siddhyati, tasmātpratyayapakṣa āśraṇīyaḥ | tadetad‌ `ye ca taddhite' ityatra vāmano vakṣyati---`yadi pratyayaḥ, kathamaudamegheya iti, āpatyādvihitaḥ ṣyaṅ‌ so'pyāpatya eva, tatra yalope siddham' iti |
jayādityastu mene---śīrṣādeśasannipātena ṣyaṅ‌, sa tadvighātaṃ na kariṣyatīti | yadyevam, ajādipratyayanibandhaḥ śīrṣādeśaḥ kathaṃ tamajādi vihanyāt‌ ? tataḥ kim ? ṣyaṅādeśo'pi na prāpnoti, anityā sannipātaparibhāṣā, tena ṣyaṅ‌ bhavati, śīrṣādeśaśca na bhaviṣyati | ayaṃ tarhyādeśapakṣe doṣaḥ---anubandhau kartavyau yaṅaścābiti sāmānyagrahaṇatadavighātārthau, anyathā'ṇādeśe ṣyaṅi `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīpsyāt‌, iñādeśe tu `iña upasaṅkhyānam' iti ṅaīṣprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ‌' ityatrāta iti vartate, tatra cāṇā'kāro viśeṣyate---aṇyo'kāra iti | tatra ṣyaṅādeśe `analvidhau' iti sthānivadbhāvābhāvānṅībna bhaviṣyati | aṇantādakārāntāditi hi vijñāyamāne svāśrayamakārāntatvaṃ sthānivadbhāvādaṇantatvaṃ ceti syānṅīpaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | `iña upasaṅkhyānam' ityatrāpi `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' ityata `itaḥ' ityapekṣyate---iñya ikāraḥ tadantāditi | iñantādikārāntāditi vā vijñāyamāne ṣyaṅādeśe sati vārāhyetyādivikārābhāvānḍīṣabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | evamapi svarārthaścābeṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā iñādeśaḥ ṣyaṅ‌ sthānivadbhāvena ñit‌, ṭābapi pittvādanudātta iti ñitsvareṇādyudāttaṃ padaṃ syāt‌ | syādetat---iño ñakārasyetsaṃjñāyāḥ prāgeva pratipadavidhānātṣyaṅādeśaḥ kāriṣyate, tatra ñitsvarābhāvāt‌ pratyayasvare sati ṭāpyapi siddhaḥ svara iti, yathaiva tarhi ñitsvaro na bhavati evaṃ vṛddhirapi na syād‌, ato ñakārasya satyāmitsaṃjñāyāmādeśa ityāstheyam, tataśca svare doṣaprasaṅgāccābarthamanubandhau kartavyāveva | pratyayapakṣe tu sati śiṣṭe ṣyaṅaḥ pratyayasvare kṛte tadantādāpi siddhamiṣṭam, na rūpabhedo na svarabhedaḥ | nanu ca ṣyaṅaiva strītvasya dyotitatvādābna syāt‌ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā gārgyāyaṇītyādau dvābhyāṃ strītvaṃ dyotyate, tathā'trāpi dvayoreva sāmarthyamiti ṭābapi bhaviṣyati | `ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaṃ tarhi tvayāpyanubandhau kartavyau, iha mā bhūt‌---pāśānāṃ samūhaḥ pāśyā, `pāśādibhyoyaḥ', pāśyāpatiriti ? evaṃ tarhyeko'nubandhaḥ kariṣyate, ka evaḥ ? ṣakīre ṅīṣprasaṅgaḥ | ṅakāre `yaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityucyamāne lolūyāputtra ityatrāpi prāpnoti ? apratyayādityakāre'to lope ca sati akāreṇa vyavahitatvānna bhaviṣyati | vārāhīputtra ityatraāpi tarhi ṭāpā vyavadhānam ? ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavattvānnāsti vyavadhānam | nanu `,ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' ityatra `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityatodhātugrahaṇamanuvartate, `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' ityāttvaṃ dhātoryathā syād‌, gobhyāmityādau mā bhūdityevamartham | tatra yaḍantasya dhātoḥ puttrapatyoranantarayoḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatītyukte yo dhāturlolūyādirnāsāvanantaraḥ, yaścānantaro vārāhyādirna sa dhātuḥ, tatra dhātutvānantaryayoranyatararūpaparityāgena bhavatsamprasāraṇaṃ yathā vārāhīputtra ityādau asatyapi dātutve ānantaryamātrāśrayaṇena bhavati, tathā lolūyāputtra ityatrāsatyapyānantarye dhātutvāśrayaṇena syāt‌ |
atha brūyāḥ---yaṅ‌dhātvorna paraspareṇa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, api tarhi samuccayaḥ---puttrapatyoranantarasya yaṅo dhātośceti ? tatra vārāhīputtra ityādau bhaviṣyati, na tu lolūyāpatirityādau; dhātorvyavadhānāt‌ | tataśca sāmarthyāddhātugrahaṇasyottarārthaivānuvṛttiḥ sampadyata iti | yadyevam, vākpatirityatra vaceḥ samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi dhātoriti nivarttiṣyate, āttvaṃ punargavādeḥ prātipadikasya na bhavati; upadeśobhāvāt‌ | svarūpajñāpanapradhāno nirdeśa-upadeśaḥ | `godvyacaḥ', `naudvyacaḥ' ityādo tu kāryāntarārthamuccāraṇam, na svarūpajñāpanārtham | tadevaṃ pratyayapakṣa eka evānubandhaḥ kartavyaḥ | atra saṃgrahaślokāḥ---
puṃvadbhāvādyajātau yalugaṇapi parasmin‌ ṣyaṅi hyaudameghe
svārthe ṣyaṅ‌ tadyalugḍhe kramata iha bhavedauḍulomyā parasmin |
ṣyaṅ‌śīrṣādhīnalābhastadabhivihataye na prabhūrhāsti śīrṣye
sarvādeśo'pi tātaṅ‌ṅiva na yaṅaṇiñoḥ sthāninoruktihetoḥ ||
stryuktāvapyāpparasminniha sulabha iti ṣṅau vidheyau na vā ye-
'ṇādeśe ṅīnivṛttyai tvaṇa iña iti ced‌ dvau viśeṣyau na doṣaḥ |
ñittvādāderudāttaḥ prasajati sahajādeśane vṛddhyabhāvaḥ
pāśyāputtre nivṛttyai yaṇa ika iha ṣittvekake ṅīṣyaṅostu ||
lolūyāputtra ityad‌vyavahita itaratrāpi dīrghā'ntavatsyād‌
dhātvānantaryayoge vidhiriti sa yathānantare'dhau tathā dhoḥ |
dhātvānantaryayoścenmitha iha na hi te'pekṣitā vākpatāvik‌
dhornātrādhikriyātve hyupadiśiriti gorno tadevaṃ mamaikaḥ ||
gotrāvayavāt‌ || 4.1.79 ||
gotraśabdo'yamasti pāribhāṣikaḥ `apatyaṃ pauttraprabhṛti gotram' iti, asti ca laukiko'patyamātravacanaḥ, asti ca vyutpannaḥ---gūyante śabdyante'nena svasantānaprabhavā iti pradhānabhūta ādipuruṣaḥ, svaprabhavasyāpatyaṃ santānasya saṃjñākārī gotramityucyate, yathā---bharataḥ, raghuḥ, yaduriti | avayavaśabdo'pyasti ekadeśe yatsambandhādavayavatīti samudāya ucyate; asti ca pṛthagbhāve, avayutyānuvāda ityādāvavapūrvasya yauteḥ pṛthagbhāve'pi darśanāt‌; asti cāpradhāne---avayavabhūto'yamasmin‌ grāma iti | tatra pāribhāṣike gotre ekadeśe cāvayave ca vacanamanarthakamidaṃ syāt‌, katham ? pauttraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo gotraṃ tadavayavaścaturthādistadapi gotrameva, tadvācino'ṇiñantātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ ṣyaṅ‌ | atha kasmiścinmahāgotre yānyavāntaragotrāṇi, yathā---bhārgavagotrasya cyavanādīni, te gotrāvayavāsteṣvagurūpottamārtho'yamārambhaḥ | yadyevam, saptarṣīṇāmagastyāṣṭamānāmaṣṭau mahāgotrāṇi pravarādhyāye paṃṭhyante tadvyatiriktebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ ṣyaṅaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; na caitadiṣṭam, agurūpottamebhyo'pi puṇikādibhya eveṣyate | pṛthagbhāvavacane tvavayavaśabde gotrādanyavācino'ṇiñantātṣyaṅi vidhīyamāne pūrvasūtre gotragrahaṇamanarthakam | athāpradhānavacano'vayavaśabdaḥ, pāribhāṣikameva gotraṃ pravarādhyāye pāṭhāccāprādhānyam, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt---ye'ṇiñantā gotrāpatyavācinaḥ pravarādhyāye na paṭhyante tebhyaḥ ṣyaṅiti | tatrānṛṣibhyo gurūpottamebhyaḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ, agurūpottamebhyastu saṃjñākāribhya eveṣyate, pāribhāṣike ca gotre saṃjñākāritvaṃ viśeṣo na labhyata iti | ihāpi prasajyeta---tuṣajako nāma kaścittasya gotraṃ strī `ata iñ‌' tauṣajakī, apatyamātre tu gotre yadyekadeśo'vayavastato'patyasamudāyasya pauttraprabhṛtyapatyamavayava iti tadvācino'ṇiñantātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ | pṛthagbhāve tvapatyādanyavācina āhicchatrādereva prasaṅgaḥ | apradhāne tvapradhānāpatyavācino'ṇiñantād‌ gurūpottamānna sarvatreṣyate, kintu saṃjñākāribhyaḥ, tatrāpi gotre | vyutpanne gotre ekadeśavacano'vayavaśabdo na sambhavati, na hi yena puruṣeṇa svasantānaprabhavā gūyante tadavayavāddhastapādādergotre'ṇiño'sambhavaḥ | atha gotraṃ ca tadavayavaśceti karmadhārayastadā bhārgavādigotreṣu ye'vāntaravyapadeśakāriṇaścyavanādayastebhyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | pṛthagbhāve ca ye saṃjñākāribhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtāstuṣajakādayastebhya eva syāt‌ | ata evameṣu pakṣeṣu doṣasambhavādvyutpanno gotraśabdaḥ, apradhānāvacano'vayavaśabdaḥ, karmadhārayaścasamāsaḥ | nipātanādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ, pravarādhyāye'pāṭhāccāprādhānyam | tadetadāha---gotrāvayavā gotrābhimatā iti | gotramityevamabhimatāḥ, gotrābhidhāyina ityeva loke prasiddhāḥ, na punaḥ pravarādhyāye paṭhitā ityarthaḥ | kāḥ punastā ityatrāha---kulākhyā iti | kulamākhyāyate ābhiriti kulākhyāḥ, puṇikādibhirhi kulamākhyāyate---puṇikāvayaṃgotreṇetyevamādi | tata iti | tathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭābhyaḥ kulākhyābhyaḥ | agurūpottamārtha ārambha iti | `gurūpottamayoḥ' iti nivṛttam, anyatsarvamanuvartata iti bhāvaḥ | pauṇikyetyādiḥ | puṇika-bhuṇika-mukharaśabdebhyaḥ `ata iñ‌', tasya ṣyaṅādeśaḥ | te krauḍyādiṣu draṣṭavyā iti | avṛtkṛtatvāttasyeti bhāvaḥ ||
krauḍyādibhyaśca || 4.1.80 ||
ṣyaṅ pratyayo bhavatīti | krauḍyādibhya iti pañcamīnirdeśātpratyayapakṣe'pyatra doṣābhāvāccaivamuktam | agurūpottamārtha ityādi | tatra kroḍyādayaḥ prākcopayataśabdādata iñantāḥ, caupayataprabhṛtayaḥ prāg‌ saudhātakiśabdādaṇantāḥ, saudhātakiśabdaḥ `sudhāturakaṅ‌ca' iti iñantaḥ | sūta yuvatyāmiti | sūtaśabdaḥ ṣyaṅamutpādayati yuvatyāṃ prāptayauvanāyāmabhidheyāyām---sūtyā, anyatra kriyāśabdāṭṭāb‌ bhavati---sūtā, jātivācinastu ṅīṣ‌ bhavati---sūtī | bhoja kṣattriye iti | jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo'pavādaḥ---bhojyā, kriyāśabdāttu ṭābeva bhavati---bhojayatīti bhojā, tataḥ pare iñantāḥ | gaukakṣyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ ||
daivayajñiśaucivṛkṣisātyamugrikāṇṭhevidbhibhyo'nyatarasyām || 4.1.81 ||
devā yajñā yaṣṭavyā asya devayajñaḥ, śucirvṛkṣo'sya śucivṛkṣaḥ, satyamugramasya satyamugraḥ, nipātanādviśeṣyasya pūrvanipāto mumāgamaśca, kaṇṭhe viddhamasya kaṇṭhe viddhamasya kaṇṭhe vā viddhaḥ, `amūrddhamastakāt‌' ityaluk‌ | kāṇḍevidbhibhya ityanye paṭhanti, kāṇḍena viddhaḥ, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, nipātanātkāṇḍaśabdasyaikāraḥ | sarve iñantāḥ ||
samarthānāṃ prathamādvā || 4.1.82 ||
pratyekamatra padānāṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, na samudāyasyaikamityāha---trayamapīti | atra ca prayojanam---ekasya nivṛttāvaparasya nivṛttirmā bhūditi | etadeva spaṣṭayati---samarthānāmiti ceti | svāthiṃkapratyayāvadhiścāyamiti | svasyāḥ prakṛterarthe bhavāḥ svārthikāḥ, adhyātmādiḥ, bhāṣyakāraprayogād‌ dvārādikāryābhāvaḥ, svaśabdasya tu dvārādiṣu pāṭhādasti prasaṅgaḥ | tadādividhirhi tatra bhavati; ādyajviśeṣaṇatvād‌ dvārādīnām, yathā---dvārapālasyedaṃ dauvārapālamiti | prāgdiśo vibhaktiriti yāvaditi | tata ārabhya hi svārthikāḥ pratyayā vidhīyante, kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ svārthikeṣveṣa na pravartate ? ityāha---svārthikeṣvityādi | tatra samarthānāmiti sambaddhārthānāṃ cetyarthaḥ | tatra vākye sambaddhārthatā, vyapekṣā hi tatra sāmarthyam, apekṣā ākāṅ‌kṣā, anyo'nyāpekṣā-vyapekṣā | anayā''kāṅ‌kṣāsannidhiyogyatveṣu satsu yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa lakṣyate | vṛttau saṃsṛṣṭārthatā | ekārthībhāvo hi tatra sāmarthyam | vṛttau hyupasarjanapadāni svārthamupasarjanīkṛtya pradhānārthaparāṇi bhavanti, yathā---gaṅgāyāṃ goṣa iti gaṅgopasarjanaṃ tīramāha | tathaupagava ityatropaguśabdaḥ khārthopasarjanamapatyamāha | ata eva ṛddhasyaupagava iti ṛddhatvamupagoviṃśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavati | yatra hi śabdaḥ payavasyati tatraiva viśeṣaṇasambandhaḥ | yadi ca vākyavad‌ vṛttāvapi khārtha eva paryavasyettadvadeva viśeṣaṇasambandho bhavet, pradhānapadānyapyupasarjanaviśiṣṭameva khārthaṃ bruvate | yadi tu vākyavad‌ vṛttāvapi pradhānapadāni svārthameva bruvīran‌ tato yathopagorapatyaṃ devadattaḥ kalyāṇaścetyubhābhyāmapatyārthasya sambandhaḥ, tathaupagavaḥ kalyāṇaścetyapyuktesyāt‌, na caivam | ato yādṛśasya sambandhasya bhāvādayaṃ viśeṣaḥ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ | na ca svārthikeṣu prakṛtyarthādarthāntaraṃ sambhavati yatpratyāyanāya śabdantaraṃ prayujyeta, yena saha samarthatā syāt‌ | etena prāthamyaṃ vyākhyātam | ataḥ pratiyogyapekṣayā sāmathyeprāthamyayorabhāvātsvāthikeṣu nāsyopayoga iti siddham | vikalpo'pi tatrānavasthita iti | kvacitpravartate | etaccāṣaḍakṣādisūtre vakṣyate | iha `prathamāt‌' ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ śāstravākyagatamāśrīyate, na vigrahavākyagatam; aniyatatvāt‌ | vākye hi prayogo'niyata iti sarveṣāṃ prāthamyasambhavāt‌ | kadācidapatyavadvācino'patye pratyayaḥ syāt‌, kadācidapatyavācinastadvati | ayaṃ ca prakāro'satyapi `prathamāt‌' ityasmillabhyata ityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt‌ |
nanu ca yasminvākye yatprathamoccāritaṃ tasmistata eva yathā syāt‌, caramoccāritānmā bhūdityetatprayojanaṃ syāt‌ ? tanna; na hi vṛttivākyayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ, tataśca vākyagate prāthamye vyavasthāpake sati vṛtteḥ prayogo na niyata iti vyarthameva `prathamāt‌' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, tasmācchāstravākyagatameva prāthamyaṃ vyavasthāpakamityāha---lakṣaṇavākyānītyādi |
samarthānāmiti nirdharaṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | tataśca nirdhāraṇasya tulyajātīyaviṣayatvātprathamātsamarthātpratyayo bhavati, tatra `samarthāt‌ prathamāt‌' iti vaktavye `samarthānāṃ prathamāt‌' iti vacanaṃ pradhānapadasyāpyupasarjanapadenaikārthībhāvapratipādanārtham; anyathā vākyavad‌ vṛttādapi pradhānapadasyānyenāpi sambandhaḥ śaṅkyeta | yadi tarhi lakṣaṇavākye prathamoccāritātpratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati `tasyāpatyam' ityādau sarvanāma prathamanirdiṣṭamiti tata eva pratyayaḥ syāt‌, nopagvādeḥ, na hi tallakṣaṇavākye prathamanirdiṣṭamityata āha---tasyeti | sāmānyamityādi viśeṣalakṣaṇam, viśeṣoṣalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | `tasmāpatyam' ityādau hi viśeṣā eva nirdeṣṭumiṣṭāḥ, teṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ pratyakamupādāne gauravaṃ syād‌, ekasyopādāne'nupāttādviśeṣāntarānna syād‌, yathā---adbhiḥ saṃskṛtamityādāviti sarveṣāmupalakṣaṇatvena tasyetyādikamupāttam | tasyopagvāderiti | na tu svayaṃ kāryitayā, na hi tasyetyasya sāmānyavacanasya prakaraṇādyabhāvena viśeṣe'navasthitasyāpatyaṃ prati sambandhiviśeṣapratipādanena sagbandhyantaravyavacchedākhya upakāraḥ sambhavati | sambandhisāmānyaṃtvapatyaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādevāvagatam, ato yatsūtre sākṣātprathamoccāritaṃ sāmānyavāci na tasmātpratyayaḥ, yasmācca pratyayo na tatsūtre sākṣātprathamoccāritamiti agatyā upalakṣaṇagataṃ prāthamyamupalakṣyāṇāṃ vijñāyate | tadāha---tadīyaṃ prāthamyaṃ viśeṣaṇāṃ vijñāyata iti |
kambala upagorityādi | yathāpatyaśabdasya pūrvaparābhyāṃ yatheṣṭamabhisambandho bhavati, evamaṇo'pi sambhāvyeteti bhāvaḥ | atra ca pratyaye satyanarthakasyāpi samudāyasya taddhitāntatvena prātipadikasaṃjñāyāmekatvādyabhāve'pi avyayebhya iva svādayaḥ syuḥ | nanu `tasyāpatyam' iti śrūyamāṇasambandhyapekṣāyāṃ vibhaktau vijñāyamānāyāṃ nātra prasaṅgaḥ ? naitadevam; na hi lakṣaṇavākye vibhaktyuccāraṇam, sambandhapratipādanārthasāmānyasya sambandhāsambhavāt, kiṃ tarhi ? ṣaṣṭhyantātpratyayavidhyartham | tathāpi viśeṣopalakṣaṇadvāreṇa sambandhaḥ syād‌ ? evamapi ṛddhasyopagorapatyamityādau sāpekṣādapi syādeva | samarthaparibhāṣayā tarhi vyavasthā bhaviṣyati ? syādeva yadyetasmātsūtrātprāgeva subantāttaddhitā iti vyavasthitaṃ syāt‌ | iha tu ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt‌ ṣaṣṭhyādivibhaktyarthavṛttestata eva taddhitāḥ syuḥ | sati tvasminsambandhapratipattervibhaktyāyattatvātsubantādeva taddhitā bhavanti, na caivaṃ sati padakāryaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā hi---rājanye vārtraghna ityādau bhasaṃjñayopajātayā luptavibhaktyāśrayāpi padasaṃjñā ekasaṃjñādhikārād‌ bādhiṣyate | rājatvaṃ rājatetyādau tu prātipadikādapyutpattau `svādiṣu' iti padasaṃjñā bhavatyeva | nanu taddhitaluki sarvanāmasthāne doṣaḥ, kāśyapena proktamadhīyate `kāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ', `chandobrāhmaṇāni' iti tadviṣayatāyām | `tadadhīte tadveda' iti dvitīyāntātkāśyapinśabdādutpannasyāṇaḥ proktālluki yadyapi kāśyapina ityādau bhasaṃjñāyā luptavibhaktinimittayā api padasaṃjñāyā bādhādadoṣaḥ, kāśyapibhyāmityādau tu bhavatyeva padasaṃjñā; tathāpi kāśyapanau, kāśyapina ityādau sarvanāmasthāne bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvālluptāmantarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā syāt‌ | na cāsarvanāmasthāna iti pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? svādiṣviti yā prāptistasyā eva saniṣedhaḥ | evaṃ tarhi `asarvanāmasthāne' iti vibhajyate, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāśrīyate, tatsāmarthyād‌ `anantarasya vidhirvā' ityetannāśrīyate, tena sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pūrvasyāvadheryā ca yāvatī padasaṃjñā svādiṣviti vā subantamiti vā sā sarvā pratiṣetsyate | yadyevam, rājā daṇḍītyādau sāvapi na syāt‌, `yaccibham' ityato'cītyetadasarvanāmasthāne ityatrāpekṣyate, tenājādāveva sarvanāmasthāne sarvā padasaṃjñā niṣetsyate ? sau halādau svādiṣviṃti vā subantamiti vā bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ | tadevaṃ satyasmin‌ vacane subantāttaddhite na kaściddoṣa iti sthitam |
ata eva pūrvāhṇetarāṃ pūrvāhṇetamāmityādau `ghakālataneṣu' ityaluk‌ vidhāsyate | nanu satyapyasmin‌ svārthikeṣvasyāvyāpārātkathaṃ subantāttarap‌ syāt‌ ? evaṃ tarhyarthakrama evāyamīdṛśo yaduta pūrvaṃ vibhaktyā yogaḥ, paścāttarapā | uktaṃ hi priyakutsanādiṣu tataḥ pravarttate'sau vibhaktyanta iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā'lugvidhānamapyupadyate | yadi tu tadevālugvidhānaṃ jñāpakam, tasyāpatyamityādau na vibhaktyarthamātre tātparyam, kintu ṣaṣṭhyādivibhaktyantā evopalakṣayitumiṣṭāḥ | ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārastu vṛddhādiviśeṣaṇtvenaivopayujyata iti, tathā sati padavidhitvāt‌ samarthaparibhāṣayaiva vyavasthā siddhyati | kiñci---anabhidhānādasāmarthyena bhaviṣyati, nārthaḥ samarthavacanena |
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---yadarthābhidhānasamarthaṃ tasmādyathāsyāt‌ | kiṃ punastat‌ ? kṛtavarṇaānupūrvīkaṃ padam---sautthitiḥ, vaikṣamāṇiriti, atra savarṇadīrghatve kṛte pratyayo bhavati, su-utthita vi-īkṣamāṇa---ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ na bhavati | yadi syāt‌, sāvutthitiḥ vāyīkṣamāṇiriti prāpnoti, `vārṇadāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iti vṛddhiprasaṅgāt‌ | nanvantaraṅgatvādvārṇeṣu kṛteṣu pratyayo bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetadarthaṃ samarthavacanaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati---astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' kṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivartayantīti | vyūhaḥ-śāstrakāryam, tadantaraṅgatvātprāptamapi paścādasya nimittavighāto bhaviṣyatīti buddhyā na kṛtaṃ yaiste'kṛtavyūhāḥ, evaṃbhūtā bhavanti pāṇinīyā ityarthaḥ | kṛtamapītyatra vāśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ, kṛmapi vā śāstrakāryaṃ nivartayanti nimittābhāva utpatsyamāne ityarthaḥ | tena papuṣa ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati | atrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvakṛto'pīḍāgama etatparibhāṣāvaśānnivartate, pūrvameva vāna kriyate, tataḥ śasi samprasāraṇe kṛte valāditvādiḍabhāvaḥ | prathamāntāditi | prathamānirdiṣṭādapatyaviśeṣavācino devadattādiśabdādityarthaḥ | anyathā `sāsya devatā' iti yathā indro devatāsya aindraḥ sthālīpāka iti prathamāntāt‌ ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyayo bhavati, evamihāpi syāt‌---devadatto'patyamasya daivadattirupaguriti |
vāgrahaṇaṃ kimiti | vṛttivākyayorvyapekṣaikārthībhāvalakṣaṇādarthabhedādeva bādhyabādhakabhāvo na bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | vākyamapi yathā syāditi | tadyathā gośabdena gāvīśabdo nivartate satyāmapi strītvapratipattau, tathehāpyaupagavamānayetyukte ya evānīyate `upagorapatyamānaya' ityukte sa eveti pradhānārthabhedād‌ vṛttyā vākyaṃ bādhyeteti bhāvaḥ | yadyevaṃ samāsavṛttistaddhitavṛttyā bādhyeteti | `yatrotsargāpavādau vibhāṣā tatrāpavādena mukte utsargo na pravartate' iti rājño'nantaro rājānantara ityādiṣu sāvakāśā samāsavṛttistaddhitavṛttyā bādhyeta, yathā---dākṣirityaṇ pratyaya iñeti bhāvaḥ | etadapīti | samāsavṛttyākhyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ ||
prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌ || 4.1.83 ||
tena dīvyatīti vakṣyatīti | yadi tasyedamanukaraṇaṃ prāgdīvyateriti vaktavyam, kathaṃ prāgdīvyata iti nirdeśaḥ ? ata āha---tadekadeśa iti | bhavati hi samudāyaguṇībhūtasyāpyekadeśasya pṛthakkṛtyānukaraṇam, yathā---asyavāmīyamityatreti bhāvaḥ | `pratyayaḥ' ityādivadaṇityevādhikāre sati `ata iñ‌' ityādināpavādaprakaraṇena vicchinnasyāṇaḥ `tena raktaṃ rāgāt‌' ityādiṣvartheṣūpasthānaṃ na syāt‌ | tasmādadhikāraparimāṇakhyāpanārthaṃ prāgdīvyaṃta ityuktam | triṣvapi darśaneṣvityādi | nanvadhikārapakṣe'pi pratiyogamupasthānādata iñ‌ aṇvetyaṇapi prāpnoti, paribhāṣāpakṣe'pi prāgdīvyatīyāḥ prakṛtayastābhyaḥ sarvābhyo'ṇ‌ paribhāṣyamāṇaḥ kenāpavādaviṣaye na syāt‌, evaṃ vidhipakṣe'pi sarvatra prasaṅgaḥ ? evaṃ manyate---yadayaṃ `pīlāyā vā' iti sūtramārabhate, tad‌ jñāpayati---nāpavādaviṣaye'ṇ‌ bhavatīti; anyathā `dvayacaḥ' iti ḍhak‌ siddhaḥ, anena cāṇityanarthakaṃ tatsyāditi | `udaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti vikalpavacanamapyasminnarthe liṅgam |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ---`prāgdīvyataḥ' iti nedaṃ dīvyatītiśabdaikadeśasya dīvyacchabdasyānukaraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? tatratyo'rtho nirdiśyate---dīvyato'rthātprāgiti | tatra diverlaṭi kṛte'rthādityanena gamyamānārthatvādaprayuktenāpyaprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | tatrāvadherarthatvādavadhimanto'pyarthā eva pratīyante, sajātīyaviṣayatvena prasiddhataratvādavadhyavadhimadbhāvasya, tataśca prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣvevāsya triṣvapi pakṣeṣu vyāpāraḥ | tatra samāne'rthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpadyamāno'pavādo'ṇaṃ bādhata iti siddhamiṣṭam ||
aśvapatyādibhyaśca || 4.1.84 ||
prāgdīvyatīyeṣviti | `apaparibarirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' ityavyayībhāvādbhavārthe `vṛddhācchaḥ' | `avyayānāṃ bhamātre' iti ṭilopo na bhavati; `luṅ‌mukhasvaropacārāḥ' iti parigaṇanāt‌ | ata evāvyayāttayabapi na bhavati, `amehakvatasitrebhyaḥ' iti parigaṇanādvā | gaṇapatiśabdasyātra pāṭhādgāṇapatyo mantra ityapaśabdaḥ | etena kṣaitrapatyaṃ vyākyātam | `kṣaitrapatyaṃ caru nirvapet‌' iti tu chāndasam | kṣaitrapatyaṃ prāśnantīti, chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvanti ||
dityadityādityapatyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ || 4.1.85 ||
patiśabdasyottarapadaśabdena bahuvrīhau kṛte paścād‌ dvandvaḥ, na tu dvandvasyottarapadaśabdena bahuvrīhirityāha---patyuttarapadācceti | etacca pratyāsattervyākhyānādvā labhyate | aditigrahaṇaṃ tu taduttarapadaparigrahārthaṃ syāt‌, na hyadityuttarapadaṃ dityuttarapadaṃ bhavati | patyantāditi noktam, bahucpūrvānmā bhūditi |
vāḍamatipitṛmatāmiti | kurvādiṣu matiputṛmacchabdayoḥ pāṭho'patyārtho bhāṣāyāmapi ṇyo yathā syāditi | anena tu chandasi sarveṣveva prāgdīvyatīyeṣu ṇyavidhiḥ | kecidvākśabdamapi tatraiva paṭhanti, tena `yānā vācyā ete vatsāḥ' iti prayogopapattiḥ |
yamācceti | yamaśabdo'pi sūtre paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ |
pṛthivyā ñāñāviti | ñāñoḥ striyāṃ viśeṣa ityāha---pāthivā, pārthivīti |
sthāmna iti | balavacano'yam | tasya kevalasya yadyapyapatyena yogo nāsti, jātādinā tu yogaḥ sambhavatyeva | sarveṣu ca prāgdīvyatīyeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ, tasmādaśvatthāma iti bhāṣyodāharaṇādatra tadantavidhirbhavati | aśvatthāma iti | aśvasyevra sthāma yasyeti bahuvrīhau akāraṣṭilopaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ |
lomno'patye bahuṣviti | bāhvādiṣvayaṃ paṭhyata itīñi prāpte bahuṣvakāraḥ, kevalasyāpatyeṃnāyogātsamarthyāttadantavidhiḥ | uḍulomā iti | uḍūnīva lomānyasya, śarā iva lomānyasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | nanu bāhvādilakṣaṇe iñyapi kṛte tasya bahvaca iti luki subantādiñutpanna iti pratyayalakṣaṇena `subantaṃ padam' iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopena siddham ? siddhyatu nāmedam ; uḍulomebhya ityevamādau subvidhau nalopasyāsiddhatvādaisādirna syāt‌, iño lugapi prācyabharatagotrādanyatra na sidhyati, na vātra padasaṃjñā, `asarvanāmasthāne' iti niṣedhāt‌ | yathā ca pratyayalakṣaṇena prāptāyāḥ subantamityasyā api padasaṃjñāyāḥ sa niṣedhastathoktaṃ purastāt‌ |
sarvatreti | nāpatya eva | yadvā prāgdīvyatīye'nyatra ca, tena gavā caratītyatrāpi gavya iti bhavati | gorūpyamiti | `hetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ', `mayaḍ‌ ca' iti rūpyamayaṭau | ṇyādaya iti | yena nāprāptinyāyenāṇa eva ṇyādayo'pavādāḥ, amāpavādaistu ḍhagādibhiḥ saha sampradhārāṇāyāṃ paratvātta eva syuriti vārttikārambhaḥ | arthaviśeṣo'patyādilakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya so'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ | yastu tasvedamityarthasāmānyalakṣaṇo'ṇapavādaḥ sa paratvādbhavati, uṣṭrapatirnāma pattraṃ tasyedamauṣṭrapatam `tattrādhvaryupariṣadaśca' ityañ‌ bhavati, na tu ṇyaḥ | diterapatyamiti | atra `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhagna bhavati, ḍauleya ityādāveva tu bhavati | vānaspatyamiti | acittādilakṣaṇaṣṭhagna bhavati, āpūpikādāveva tu bhavati |
kathaṃ daiteya iti | atra tarhīti | gamyamānatvānna prayuktam | yadi ṇyādayo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇādaṇapavādātpūrvavipratiṣedhena bhavanti, kathaṃ tarhi daitaiyaḥ sidhyatītyarthaḥ | ditiśabdādityādi | nanu `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti ṅīṣantādapi ṇya eva prāpnoti ? tatrāha---liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā cānityeti | anye tu bhāṣvārttikayoranuktatvād‌ daiteya ityasādhuriti sthitāḥ ||
utsādibhyo'ñ‌ || 4.1.86 ||
tadapavādānāṃ ceti | iñādīnām | baṣkayāsa iti | baṣkayaśabdo'ñamutpādayati, ase, asamāsa ityarthaḥ | pūrvācāryasaṃjñeyam, bāṣkayaḥ | asa iti kim ? gobaṣkayiḥ | grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādevātra na bhaviṣyati ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu | etajjñāpayati---bhavatyatra tadantavidhiriti | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? dhenuśabdo'tra paṭhyate, tadantādapi bhavati---adhenūnāṃ samūha ādhenavamiti | udasthāna deśa iti | udasthānaśabdo'ñamutpādayati deśe vācye---audasthāno deśaḥ | deśādanyatra yadṛcchayā kaścidudasthānaḥ, tasyāpatyamaudasthāniḥ | pṛṣadaṃśa iti | pṛṣacchabdo'ñamutpādayati aṃśe vācye---pārṣatoṃ'śaḥ, aṃśādanyatrāṇena bhavati | graiṣmī triṣṭubiti | grīṣmo devatā asyā ityaśeṣārthavivakṣāyāmautsargiko'ṇeva bhavati, grīṣme bhavetyādiśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṛtvaṇeva siddham | na hyanenāñā śaiṣikasyāṇo bādhaprasaṅgaḥ, arthaviśeṣalakṣaṇānāmeva pratyayānāṃ ṇyādibhirbādhanāt | ṛtvaṇ tu śeṣamātre vidhānānnārthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ, kakṣāntaraprāptaśca | katham ? `kālaṭṭhañ‌' aṇo'pavādaḥ, tsayāpyṛtvaṇ‌ | chandaśceha vṛttaṃ gṛhyata iti | yasya triṣṭubādayo viśeṣāḥ | na veda iti | tena vedaviṣaye'pi vṛtte'bhidheye'ñaḥ pratiṣedhādaṇeva bhavati---graiṣmī triṣṭubiti |
strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt‌ || 4.1.87 ||
strīśabdātpūṃśabdātpuṃsśabdācceti | stryadhikāravihitānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ `puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ' ityetadadhikāravihitānāṃ ca pratyayānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, strīpuṃsśabdayorasvaritatvāt‌ | nāpi strīpuṃsārthagrahaṇam, `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti vacanāt‌ | pauṃsnamiti | saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' iti puṃsśabdasakārasya lopaḥ, tatra karttavye'nusvārasyāsiddhatvātsakārasya saṃyogāntatvāt‌ | ata eva saṃyogāntalopaprasaṅgānnañevobhābhyāṃ na vidhīyate | evaṃ hi mā bhūnnañ‌, mā ca bhūtsnañ‌ , añ‌ prakṛtastatraitāvadastu strīpuṃsayornukyeti; tatrāyamapyarthaḥ, straiṇī pausnī aña itīkāraḥ siddho bhavati ? naiva śaṅkyam; straiṇāḥ, pauṃsnāḥ---`yañañośca' iti bahuṣu luk‌ prāpnoti | iha ca straiṇānāṃ saṅghaḥ `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñām' ityaṇ‌ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ubhayatrāpi gotra iti vartate, laukikasya ca gotrasya grahaṇaṃ ṛṣiprajanaṃ ca loke gotramupacaranti, na ca stryarṣiṇāpi puṃśabdavācyaṃ sāmānyam | `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopastarhi prāpnoti ? `prakṛtyaikāc‌' iti prakṛtibhāvo bhaviṣyati, `iṣṭhemeyassu' iti tatrānuvartate | evaṃ tarhi nugvidhānasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na bhaviṣyati ? yaṃ vidhi pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhibādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate, tatra ṭilopārthameva nugvidhānaṃ syāt‌ | strīśūbdasyāpi nugeva lopasya nimittam, anyathā yasyeti lopātparatvād‌ vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, yathā---śrīrdevatā asya śrāyaṃ haviriti | tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu |
yogāpekṣaṃ ceti | strīpuṃsābhyāmityayaṃ yogo vatyarthe na pravartata ityevaṃ jñāpanaśarīram, na tu snañ‌ vatyarthe na pravartata itiyarthaḥ | kathaṃ strītvaṃ strītā puṃstvaṃ puṃstā ceti ? `ā ca tvāt‌' ityatra parihāro bhaviṣyati ||
dvigorluganapatye || 4.1.88 ||
dvigoriti ṣaṣṭhīti | ānantaryalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu pañcamyāṃ pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedam `tasyedam' ityaṇ‌, pāñcakapālamityatrāpi prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyapi yadyānantaryayoge syātsa eva doṣo yaḥ pañcamyām, tataśca ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi matvā''ha---dvigoryaḥ sambandhī nimittatveneti | yasya taddhitasyārthe `taddhitārthottarapada' iti dviguvihitaḥ sa nimittatvena sambandhī | pañcakapāla iti | `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' ityatrārthe vivakṣite dviguḥ, am‌, tasya luk‌ | dviveda iti | `tadadhīte tadveda' ityatrārthe dviguḥ |
dvaidevadattiriti | dvayordevadattayorapatyam, `ata iñ‌', apatanādapatyam, yasya pitrādiṣu dvau devadattasaṃjñakau sa evamucyate, ekasya vā dattaputro'nyasya sākṣātputraḥ |
dvigunimittavijñānāditi | dvigunimittasya pratyayasya lugvidhānādityarthaḥ | pañcakapālasyedamiti | atra saṃskṛtārthe yaḥ prathamamutpannaḥ pratyayaḥ sa eva---dvigornimittaṃ na dvitīya iti tasya lugna bhavati | atha vaityādi | pūrvaṃ lugityanenopasthāpatisya pratyayasya dvigorityanena vaiyadhikaraṇyamāśritya vyākhyātam, idānīṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamityeṣa viśeṣaḥ | kathaṃ punadvigoreva lug‌ labhyata ityāha---dvigoriti sthānaṣaṣṭhīti |
nanu cetyādi | `pratyayasya lukślulupaḥ' iti pratyayādarśanasya lugādayaḥ saṃjñā vihitāḥ, tataśca dvigorlugiti naiva samañjasamiti bhāvaḥ | upacāreṇa tvityādi | atasmiṃstadrūpāropaḥ-upacāraḥ, paratra paraśabdaprayogaḥ-lakṣaṇā, upacāreṇa nimittena yā lakṣaṇā tayetyarthaḥ | anye tūpacāreṇetyasya vivaraṇaṃ lakṣaṇayetyetadityāhuḥ | advigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā yathā buddhyā vivakṣyate sā lakṣaṇā upacāra eveti | upacārasya nibandhanaṃ dvigunimittatvam | bhavati hi kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ---āyurghṛtamiti yathā | dvigunimittako'pi tarhītyādi | kārye'pi kāraṇavadupacāro dṛśyate, yathā---purātanaṃ karma bhujyata iti, tataśca dviguryasya pratyayasya nimittaṃ so'pi guṇakalpanayā guṇaśabdenopacārasya nimittabhūto dharmo vivakṣitaḥ, tannimittā kalpanā guṇakalpanā, mā punarupacāṃrātmikā buddhiḥ, tayā kasmānna dvigurityacyate ? arhatyevāyamevaṃvidhaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ | pariharati---na tasyeti | tatra hi sannihitamapi dvigutvaṃ pratyayotpattau nopayujyate, na hyasau dvigorityevaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikādityevamityarthaḥ | itarastviti | pratyayaḥ, yasya lugdarśitaḥ | dvigutvasyaiva nimittamiti | tadarthe hi samāso vidhīyate, tasyaiva ca dvigusaṃjñā, tenāsau dvigutvasyaiva nimittam |
yadyevamityādi | ubhayorapi pakṣayoretaccodyam | na hyatra dvigornimittatvena sambandhī taddhitaḥ, nāpi dvigunimittatvādu pacāreṇa tadvyapadeśārhaḥ, atra hi samāhāre dvigau niṣpanne paścāttaddhita utpadyate, sa ca dvigornimittaṃ na bhavatīti codyārthaḥ | pariharati---naivātra taddhita utpadyata iti | anabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | yadi notpadyate, kathamasminnarthe pañcakapāla iti rūpasiddhistasmādutpadyata evātra taddhitaḥ, tasya ca lugvidheyaḥ ? ityata āha---traiśabdyaṃ hīti | traya eva śabdāstraiśadbyam-cāturvarṇyādiḥ | iha hyasmābhistraiśadbyaṃ sādhyam, tacca pañcakapālīśabdāttaddhitotpattimantareṇāpi siddhyatīti nāsmāttaddhita utpadyate | tāneva trīn‌ śabdāndarśayati---pañcasu kapāloṣviti | dvayoḥ śabdayoriti | yaḥ samāhāre dviguḥ, yaśca taddhitārthe, dvāvapi tau samānārthau, tayorekena pūrveṇa vigrahaḥ | avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyaṃ vigraha eva, na taddhitotpattiḥ; anabhidhānāt‌ | aparasmāt‌ pañcakapālādutpattiḥ | so'yamavyavikanyāya ucyate, tadyathā avermāṃsamityaviśabdena vigraha eva, avikaśabdādutpattirvigrahaśca āvikamavikasya māṃsamiti |
sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣeti | evaṃ kṛtvā traividyaḥ, pāñcanadam, ṣāṭ‌kula ityatrāpi lugna bhavati | atha vā---tryavayavā vidyā trividyā, śākapārthivādiḥ, tāmadhīte traividyaḥ, vidyātrayarūpasya ca samudāyasya vidyātvaṃ vivakṣitamityarthabhedābhāvaḥ | pañcānāṃ nadīnāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcanadam, `nadībhiśca' ityavyayībhāvaḥ `godāvaryāśca nadyāśca' ityacsamāsāntaḥ, pañcanade bhavaḥ pāñcanadaḥ | atha vā---abhidhāne hi sati samāhāradvigorapi bhavatyeva taddhitaḥ | tathā ṣaṇṇāmādipuruṣāṇāṃ kulāni tatra bhavaḥ ṣāṭ‌kulaḥ | avyavikanyāyācca tisro vidyā adhīte, pañcasu nadīṣu bhavaḥ, ṣaṭ‌sukuleṣu bhava iti vigraha eva; na dviguḥ, nāpi taddhitaḥ ||
gotre'lugaci || 4.1.89 ||
pūrvatrottaratra ca lugvidhānādiha nañ‌ praśliṣyate | yaskādibhyo gotra ityādineti | `prāgdīvyataḥ' ityupajīvanāya tu prakaraṇotkarṣaḥ, prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam | acīti | yadyeṣā parasaptamī syācchavidhāvitaretarāśrayaṃ prāpnoti---gārgīyā vātsīyā iticche parato'lukā bhavitavyam, aluki ca sati vṛddhatvācchena bhavitavyamiti | nanu ca che parato'lugvidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? `ajādimātre, tatra ya evājādiḥ sambhavati tatraivālugbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---gargāṇāṃ chāttrāḥ, `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌', tatra parataḥ `yañañośca' iti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhe gargā iti bhavati | yadyapyatra satyasati vā luki nāstiviśeṣaḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite' iti yalopavidhānāt‌ | iha tvattrerapatyāni bahūni `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhakaḥ `attribhṛgu' iti luki kṛte'ttrīṇāṃ chāttrā ityaṇi parataḥ pratiṣedhe sati āttreyā iti bhavati, asati tu pratiṣedhe āttrā iti syāt‌ ? syādetadevaṃ yadi luptasya pratyayasya punaḥ prādurbhāvo vidhīyateta, iha tvalugiti vacanāllukaḥ pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ, prāptasya cānabhinirvṛsya pratiṣedhena nivṛttiḥ śakyate kartum, tataśca yadyatrāṇajādirabhipretaḥ syāt‌, prāgeva lukaḥ pravṛttirabhyupagantavyā; anyathā vṛddhatvāccha eva syāt‌, luka cetpravṛttaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ! yo hi bhuktavantaṃ prati brūyānmā bhuṅ‌kthā iti, kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt‌ ! tadihājādau pravṛtte'lukā bhavitavyam, aluki ca pravṛtte'jādinā bhavitavyamiti vyaktamitaretarāśrayam | vipratiṣedhātsiddham, luko'vakāśo yatra prāgdīvyatīyārtho na vivakṣyate---gargā vatsā iti, chasyāvakāśaḥ---śālīya iti; gargāya ityatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvāccho bhaviṣyati | tatra parato lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, antaraṅgo lug‌ apatyabahutvamātrāpekṣatvāt‌, bahiraṅgaśchaḥ prāgdīvyatīyārthāpekṣitvāt‌, antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoścāyukto vipratiṣedhaḥ | evaṃ tarhyucyate cedamajādau parato lugbhavatīti, yadi ca tāvatyeva nimittamastīti bahutvamātrāpekṣo luk‌ pravarteta pratiṣedhavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi yāvatprāgdīvyatīyo'jādirnotpadyate tāvallug‌ na pravartata iti kalpyate, tataśca vṛddhatvācche sati luki pratiṣiddhe gargīya iti siddhamiṣṭam | viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam, gargāṇāṃ chāttrā ityarthavivakṣāyāmajādau pratyaye vivakṣite buddhisthe'nutpanna eva luki pratiṣiddhe vṛddhatvāccho bhavatīti, tasmādviṣayasaptamīmāśrityāha---prāgdīvyatīye pratyaye viṣayabhūta iti | khārapāyaṇīyā iti | kharapasyāpatyāni bahūni `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌', `yaskādibhyo gotre' iti prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
kaubalam, bādaramiti | kubalī-badarīśabdau gorādiṅīṣantāvantodāttau, tābhyāṃ phale vikāre `anudāttādeśca' ityañ‌, tasya `phale luk‌' iti prāptasya lukaḥ tasyedamityarthavivakṣāyāṃ pratiṣedho na bhavati, tenāvṛddhatvādaṇena bhavati | gargarūpyamiti | yadyatrāluk‌ syād‌, sārgyarūpyamiti syāt‌ |
gārgīyamiti | `tasmai hitam' iti prākkrītācchaḥ |
viṣayasaptamyā eva phalaṃ darśayati---gotrasyetyādi | gotrasyeti gotrapratyayasyetyarthaḥ | vahuṣu lopina iti | bahuṣvartheṣu vidhīyamānalopasyetyarthaḥ | bahuvacanāntasya praṃvṛttāviti | pravṛttiḥ-arthāntarasaṃkrāntiḥ, bahuvacanāntasya sato'rthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāmityarthaḥ | dvyekayoriti | yatrārthāntare saṃkrāntasya dvitvaikatvayoḥ satorityarthaḥ | sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntistadantādyadā yani pratyaya utpadyate tasya ca luk‌ kriyate tadā bhavati lupte hi yuvapratyaye prakṛtireva tadarthamāheti bhavati saṃkrāntiḥ | bidānāmiti | badasyāpatyāni bahūni, `anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ‌', bidāḥ, teṣāṃ bidhānāmapatyaṃ yuvā yuvānau veti vivakṣāyām `ataḥ' iti iñi vivakṣite gotrapratyayasyāño lukaḥ prāptasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ | iñaḥ `ṇyakṣattriyārṣa' iti luki baidaḥ, baidāviti bhavati | parasaptamīpakṣe tvalugna prāpnoti; ajāderabhāvāt‌ |
