idamiha sampradhāryam---iño luk‌ kriyatāmayaṃ vā'lugiti ? paratvādalugbhavati | iño lugnityaḥ, kṛte'pyasminnaluki prāpnoti akṛte'pi, ayaṃ punaraluganityaḥ, na hīño luki kṛte prāpnoti; ajāderabhāvāt‌ ? pratyayalakṣaṇena bhaviṣyati | varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam ? nātra varṇo nimittam, kiṃ tahi ? pratyayaḥ, tasyaiva tu viśeṣaṇamacīti | tatra yathā halādau piti sārvadhātuke vidhīyamānaḥ `tṛṇaha im' atṛṇeḍityatrāpi bhavati pratyayalakṣaṇena tadvadihāpi bhaviṣyati ? satyam; viṣayasaptamīpakṣe naivaṃ kleśo'nubhavanīyo bhavati | nanūbhayorapi pakṣayorihāpi na prāpnoti---bidānāmapatyaṃ bahavo māṇavakā bidā iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dve atra bahutve---yuvabahutvaṃ gotrabahutvaṃ ca, tatra gotrabahutvāśrayasya lukaḥ pratiṣedho'stu punaryuvabahutvāśrayo lugbhaviṣyati | lugvidhau hi laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇam, yuvāpi ca loke gotramityupacaryate---gārgyāyaṇo'smi gotreṇeti |
atha yuvabahutvāśrayasyāpi lukaḥ punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? viṣayasaptamyāṃ tāvad‌ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ luk‌ prāptaḥ tasyāmavasthāyāṃ yadi kaścidajādirviṣayabhūtastato'lukā bhavitavyam, iha cājādirviṣayabhūta utpanno luptaśca, paścādyuvasu bahuṣu saṃkrāntau satyāṃ luk‌ prāptaḥ, na cāsyāmavasthāyāṃ kaścidajādiviṣayabhūta iti punarlugna bhaviṣyati | parasaptamyāmapi gotre vartamānasyā lugbhavatyajādau parataḥ | kasminnajādau ? prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣu yo'jādistasminnityucyamāne yasmin‌ gotre vartamānasya luk‌ prāptastadvyatirikte prāgdīvyatīye'rthe yo'jādistatreti gamyate | iha ceñevājādistadartha eva ca gotre lugiti pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati |
yadvā---`samarthānāṃ prathamāt‌' ityataḥ prathamāditi vartate, tacca ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vipariṇamyate, prathamārthavṛttitvācca prāthamyamāśrīyate, tadayamartho bhavati---prathamasya gotrapratyayasya lugna bhavati, yasminnarthe pratyaya utpannastatraivārthe vartamānasya yo luk‌ prāptaḥ sa na bhavati | iha tu dvitīyamarthamupasaṃkrāntasya luk‌ prāpta iti na pratiṣidhyate | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---prathamasya luk‌ pratiṣidhyata iti, anyathā attrerapatyam `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak‌, tasyāpatyaṃ bahavo yuvānaḥ, ata iñaḥ `ṇyakṣattriyārṣa' iti luk‌, ḍhakaḥ `atribhṛgu' iti luk‌, attrayaḥ; bharadvājaśabdādvidādyañ‌, tadantādyuvabahutve iño luk‌, añaḥ `yañañośca' iti luk‌, attrayaśca bharadvājāśca attribharadvājāsteṣāṃ maithunikād‌ dvandvād‌ vun‌---attribharadvājikā, tatrāluk‌ prāpnoti; kutsādṛṣyaṇaḥ `attribhṛgu' iti luk‌, kuśakādañantādiño luki kuśikāḥ, kutsakuśikikāḥ, vasiṣṭhakaśyapikāḥ, bhṛgvaṅgirasikāḥ | aya vā--gopavanādiṣu garghabhārgavikāśabdaḥ paṭhyate, bhārgavaśabdasya yuvabahutve prāptasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---etasyaiva dvitīyamarthamupasaṃkrāntasyālugbhavatīti | naiva vā punaratra yuvabahutve vartamānasyālukprāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? gotra ityucyate, yadyapyapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, iha tu pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇam, yuvaśabdasāhacaryāt‌ ; anyathā gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśe yo'yaṃ doṣo vakṣyate---śālaṅkerapatyaṃ `yañiñośca' iti phak‌, tasya `pailādibhyaśca' iti luk‌, śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyām `gotre'lugaci' ityaluk‌ prāpnoti, tataśca `yūni luk‌' ityasya `phakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti vikalpitatvātpakṣe phakaḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnotīti sa tadavastha eva syāt‌, asamāveśe'pi yūno laukikagotratvādevālukprasaṅgāt‌ | tadevaṃ gotrasya bahuṣu lopina ityādi na vaktavyamiti sthitam |
ekavacanadvivacananāntasyetyādi | ekavacanāntasya gotrapratyayasya dvivacanāntasya vā bahuṣvartheṣu yuvasaṃjñakeṣu pravṛtau saṃkrāntau satyāmityarthaḥ | lopa iti | lugityarthaḥ | lope hi pratyayalakṣaṇena vṛddhisvaraprasaṅgaḥ | nanu ca yuvabahutvāśrayo `yañañośca' ityevātra luk‌ siddhastatrāha---na hyatrāñbahuṣūtpanna iti | añyo bahuṣu, yañyo bahuṣviti vijñāyamāne lugna sidhyatītyarthaḥ | yadā tvañantaṃ yadvahuṣu, yañantaṃ yadvahuṣviti vijñāyate; tadāñantasya bahuṣu yuvasu vṛtterlaukikasya ca gotrasyāpatyamātrasya tatra grahaṇātsiddha eva luk‌ | tathā ca---gārgyaśca vātsyaśca vājyaśca gargavatsavājāḥ, baidaśca aurvaśca bhāradvājāśca bidaurvabhāradvājā iti yañañorutpattivelāyāmabahutve'pi dvandve yugapadhikaraṇavacanatayā yañantasyāñantasya bahutvopajanāllugbhavati | na caivaṃ kāśyapasyaikasya bahvyaḥ pratikṛtayaḥ kāśyapā iti `ive pratikṛtau' iti vihitasya kanaḥ `jīvikārthe cāpaṇye' iti lup‌, `harītakyādiṣu vyaktiḥ' iti vacanād‌ yuktavadvacanābhāve'ñantasya bahuṣu vṛtterlukprasaṅgaḥ; gotrabahutve lugvidhānāt‌ ||
yūni luk‌ || 4.1.90 ||
atrāpi yadyacīti parasaptamī syāt‌, pratyayasya yatheṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | yuvapratyaye śrūyamāṇe yaḥ prāpnoti sa tāvatkattavyaḥ, tatra kṛte yuvapratyayasya luki tasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, viṣayasaptamyāṃ tvajādau viṣayabhūta eva yuvapratyaye lupte yo yataḥ prāpnoti tataḥ sa sa bhavatīti siddhamiṣṭam | etaccodāharaṇeṣu vyaktīkariṣyate, tadetadāha---ajādau pratyaye vivakṣita ityādi | iñaścetyaṇ‌ bhavatīti | parasasaptamyāṃ tu vṛddhāccha eva syāt‌ |
pheścha ceti | `yamundaśca suyāmā ca vārṣyāyaṇiḥ phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ' iti parigaṇanaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa nāśritam, tena taikāyanerapiccho bhavati | taikāyanīyā iti | atra parasaptamyāmapyadoṣaḥ, `ṇyakṣattriyārṣañitaḥ' ityatra tu vṛttikāreṇāṇo lugudāhṛtaḥ---taikāyaniḥ pitā taikāyaniḥ puttra iti, sa parigaṇanāśrayeṇa draṣṭavyaḥ, tadā ca taikāyanīyā ityanudāharaṇam |
kāpiñjalādā iti | atrāpi parasaptamyāṃ vṛddhācchaḥ syāt‌ | evaṃ glaucukāyanā ityatrāpi draṣṭavyam | iha tu aupagaveryūnaśchāttrā iño luki vṛddhāccho bhavati, parasaptamyām, `iñaśca' ityaṇsyāt‌ | naitadasya yogasyodāharaṇam, katham ? `iñaśca' ityatra `gotre' iti vartate, teneñaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---gotre ya iñ‌ vihita iti pāribhāṣikaṃ ca gotraṃ gṛhyate, katham ? `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityatra tāvad‌ `gotrekuñjādibhyaḥ' ityasya gotrasyānuvādaḥ---kaṇvādibhyo gotre yaḥ pratyayo vihitastadantādaṇ‌ bhavatīti, tatra ca pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate tasyaiva cānuvādaḥ, tadeva ca `iñaśca' ityatrāpyanuvartate, tatkuto yuvapratyayāntādaṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ ! avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā lupte'pīñi pratyayalakṣaṇenāṇ‌ syādeva |
imāni tarhyatrodāharaṇāni---yatkhacchāntāḥ | yat‌---`rājaśvaśurādyat', śvaśurasyāpatyaṃ śvasuryaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ śvāśuristasya chāttrā iti luki `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' bhavati śvāśuraḥ, anyathā `vṛddhācchaḥ' syāt‌ ; `kulātkhaḥ' kulīnaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ kaulīniḥ, tasya chāttrāḥ, iño luki kaulīnaḥ; `svasuśchaḥ', svasrīyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ svāsrīyiḥ, tasya chāttrā iño luki svasrīyāḥ ? naitānyudāharaṇāni; `abrāhmaṇād‌ gotramātrādyuvapratyayasyopasaṅkhyānam' itīño luki kṛte śvaśuryaḥ pitā śvaśuryaḥ putraḥ, kulīnaḥ pitā kulīnaḥ putraḥ, svasrīyaḥ pitā svasrīyaḥ putra iti bhavitavyam | na ca brāhmaṇagotre kaścidavṛddhinimittaḥ pratyayaḥ sambhavati, yata iñi kṛte chaḥ prāpnoti; vṛddhinimitte tu gotrapratyaye nāsti viśeṣaḥ, yataḥ śrūyamāṇo'pīñi chena bhavitavyam | lupte'pi tasmin‌ gotrapratyayāntasyāpi vṛddhatvācchena bhavitavyam, tadyathā---aupagavīyā iti | tadevamiña udāharaṇaṃ na sambhavatīti sthitam |
yadi tu pūrvasūtre laukikasya gotrasya grahaṇaṃ tadā syādeveña udāharaṇam | tathā hiśvaśuryādibhya utpannasyeñaḥ, satyapyaupasaṅkhyānike luki tasya prāgdīvyatīyavivakṣāyām `gotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhena punaḥ prādurbhāvādiñāśrayaḥ `vṛddhācchaḥ' syāt‌, yadi tasya `yūni luk' iti lugna kriyeta | ato'smādiña udāharaṇatvapratiṣedhāyapyavasīyate---pāribhāṣikaṃ gotraṃ pūrvasūtre bhāṣyakārasyābhimatamiti |
kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā yūno'pigotrarūpe vivakṣite gotrapratyayenābhidhānāttannibandhana eva pratyayo bhaviṣyati, arthaprakaraṇādinā ca yuvaviśeṣasiddhiḥ, avaśyaṃ cārthaprakaraṇādinaiva viśeṣo'vasātavyaḥ, ārabdhe'piyasminsūtre śabdasya sādhāraṇatvāt‌ | na hi jñāyate---kiṃ bhāgavitteśchāttrā bhāgavittāḥ ? āhosvidbhāgavittikasyeti ? yadā tarhi viśeṣavivakṣā, tadāpi bhāgavittā ityeva yathā syād‌, bhāgavittikīyā iti jātucinmā bhūdityevamarthamidam ||
phikphañoranyatarasyām || 4.1.91 ||
kimarthamidam, yāvatā yuvarūpavivakṣāyāṃ gārgyāyaṇīya iti, gotrarūpavivakṣāyāṃ ca gārgīyā iti śabdasya sādhāraṇatvāt‌ ? ityata āha---pūrvasūtreṇeti | `yūni luk‌' ityetadārambhaṇīyamityuktam, tasmiścārabhyamāṇe yadīdaṃ nocyeta, phakphiñorapi nityameva luk‌ syāt‌, tataśca gārgyāyaṇīyā iti na syāt‌ | tasmādidamapyārambhaṇīyamityarthaḥ ||
tasyāpatyam || 4.1.92 ||
arthanirdeśo'yamiti | prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhyartho'patyarūpaḥ pratyayārtho'nena nirdiśyata ityarthaḥ | tena samarthavibhakterapi ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśo darśita eva | pūrvairuttaraiśceti | pūrvaistāvadaṇādibhiḥ sambaddhyate; asaṃyuktavidhānāt‌, anyathā `tasyāpatyamata iñ‌' ityekaṃ yogameva kuryāt‌, yatastvasaṃyuktaṃ karoti, tato jñāyate---pūrvaiḥ sambadhyata iti | uttarairapi sambadhyate; svaritatvātsākāṃkṣatvāccateṣām | tasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi | tasyeti sāmānyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantaviśeṣopalakṣaṇārtham, `samarthānām' iti ca nirddhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | tatra tulyajātīyasya nirddhāraṇādayamarthaḥ sampadyate---ṣaṣṭhyantātsamarthāditi | apatyamityetasminnartha iti | prathamāntasyāpatyaśabdasyānyathāsambandhānupapatterayamadhyāhāro labdhaḥ | yathāvihitamiti | `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ | `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' ityādibhiryo yato vihitaḥ sa tasmādityarthaḥ | iha `tasya' iti puṃnapuṃsakayoranyatareṇāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, ekavacanāntena ca, tena liṅgāntarādvacanāntarācca na syāt‌---sumāturapatyaṃ somātraḥ, kṣattrasyāpatyaṃ kṣāttriḥ, upagorapatyamaupagava iti | apatyamiti caikavacanena napuṃsakena ca nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tenaikasminnevāpatye syāt‌, na dvayoḥ, nāpi bahuṣu, napuṃsaka eva syāt, na strīpuṃsayorityāśaṅkyāha--prakṛtyarthetyādi | prakṛtyartha upagvādirviśeṣaḥ; tasyetyasya viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvāt‌ | apatyamātraṃ ceti | mātraśabdo'yaṃ liṅgavacanayorvyavacchedāya | liṅgavacanādikamiti | ādiśabdena kālasya grahaṇam; atra hi vartamānakālena nirdeśo'stīti pratīteḥ, yathoktam---yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ nāsti tatrāstirbhavatiparaḥ prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyata iti | tataśca tasya kālasya vivakṣāyataṃ kālāntare na syāt‌ | sarvamavivakṣitamiti | nāntarīyakatvādupādānasyāvaśyaṃ hi kenacilliṅgādinā nirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tasyedamityapatye'pīti | aṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ siddhamiti śeṣaḥ | tasyedaṃviśeṣā hyapatyasamūhavikārādayaḥ; sambandhasāmānye'pi sarvaviśeṣāntarbhāvāt‌, tataśca `tasyedam' ityanenaivāpatye'pyaṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ siddham, tatkiṃ yogavibhāgenāpatye'ṇādayo vidhīyante, na `tasyāpatyamata iñ‌' ityapavādaiḥ saṃyukta evāpatyārtho nirdiśyate iti codyārthaṃ pariharati---bādhanārthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavediti | `tasyedam' ityanena vidhīyamānānāmaṇādīnāṃ yo bādhakaśchaḥ, tasya bādhanārthamapatye'ṇādīnāṃ vidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ | nanu śaiṣikaśchaḥ, apatyādicaturthaparyantebhyo yo'nyo'rthaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tatkathamapatye chasya prasaṅgo yena tadvādhanārthamidam ? ityāha---utsargaḥ śeṣaṃ evāsaviti | yadi yogavibhāgamakṛtvā `tasyāpatyamata iñ‌' ityucyeta tadā prakṛtiviśeṣasambaddhasyaivāpatyārthasyopayogaḥ, ato'nyo'patyārthaḥ śeṣa eva syāditi syādeva vṛddhādapatye chaḥ | yogavibhāge tu---apatyārthasyāṇādividhāvupayogāccheṣatvābhāvācchasyāprāptireva, saivātrāprāptirbādhetyucyate | utsarga iti prakṛtisāmānyasambaddhaḥ sāmānyabhūto'patyartha uktaḥ | bādhanārthasyodāharaṇamāha--vṛddhānyasya prayojanamiti | śyāmagava iti | śyāmā gāvo'sya śyāmaguriti ||
eko gotre || 4.1.93 ||
ekaśabdo'yamanyapradhānāsahāyasaṅkhyāprathamasamānasādhāraṇavācī, anyārthe tāvad‌---`ekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām', `prajāmekā rakṣatyūrjamekā', `ekān‌ bandhuraparānnirāsuḥ', `ityeke manyante', `yajuṣyekeṣām' iti; kecittvanayoḥ prayogayoḥ kecicchabdaparyāya ekaśabda ityāhuḥ | `ekaḥ pārtho dhanuṣmatām' iti pradhānārthe | `ādyantavadekasmin', `ekahalādau', `ekahalmadhye' ityasahāyārthe | `eko dvau bahavaḥ' iti saṅkhyārthe | `eke'lpaprāṇaḥ |' iti prathamārthe | `tenaikadik‌' iti samānārthe | `devadattayajñadattāvekadhanau' iti sādhāraṇārthe | tatra saṅkhyāvacanaḥ sādhāraṇavacanaḥ, prathamavacano vā gṛhyate; arthāntarāṇāmasambhavāt | gotraṃ pāribhāṣikam; kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasampratyayāt‌, apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇācca |
kimarthamidamucyate, pauttraprabhṛtāvapatye vivakṣite mūlaprakṛteruparavādereva pratyayo yathā syād‌, aupagavādeḥ pratyayāntānmā bhūditi | naitadasti prayojanam, sanvidhivadetadbhaviṣyati, tadyathā---dhātorvidhīyamānaḥ san‌ sanantānna bhavati, tat kasya hetoḥ ? ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate, na ca sani vidhīyamāne sananto dhātuḥ sambhavati, tadvadihāpyapatyapratyaye vidhīyamānāpatyapratyayāntā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatīti tataḥ pratyayo na bhaviṣyati ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; ekaḥ san‌ pratyayaḥ, vidhāyakaṃ ca lakṣaṇamekameva tatra yuktam, na tasminvidhīyamāne tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatīti |
iha punaḥ `tasyāpatyam' `ata iñ‌' `yañiñośca' iti bahūni lakṣaṇāni, pratyayāśca bahavaḥ; tatra kasmiścitpratyaye vidhīyamāne pratyayāntareṇa tadantā prakṛtiḥ sambhavatyeva, tathā ca gupādīnāṃ sanaḥ san‌ bhavati---jugupsiṣate iti ? kiṃ punaḥ syādyadyetannārabhyeta ? ucyate; iha kecinmanyante---putraśabdaparyāyo'patyaśabdaḥ; nighaṇṭuṣu tathā pāṭhālloke ca dṛṣṭatvāt‌ | tadyathā pitāmahasyotsaṅge dārakamāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścitpṛcchati---kasya putro'yamiti, kasyāpatyamiti ? sa devadattasya yajñadattasya vetyutpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati, nātmānam, tataśca yathā pitāmahaṃ prati puttro na bhavati tathāpatyamiti | utpādayitaivaiko'patyena yujyate, na tu pitāmahādayo'pīti | anye tu---kriyānimittako'patyaśabdaḥ, na patantyanenetyapatyamiti auṇādiko yatpratyayaḥ, yasya ca yenāpatanaṃ tattasyāpatyam | vyavahitajanito'pi pautrādiḥ pitāmahāderapatanaheturbhavati, śrūyate hi---`jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣaibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ, eṣa vā anṛṇo yaḥ putrī' iti, etena putramutpādya pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavatīti pratipādanāt‌ putrotpāditayā prajayā pitṝṇāmupakārī dṛśyate | smaryate ca---
putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇānantyamaśnute |
atha putrasya pautreṇa bradhnasyāpnoti viṣṭapam || iti |
itihāseṣu ca jāratkāravādiṣu mahatī vārtā---vyavahitajanito'pyupakāraka iti | sūtrakāraśca śabdavidāṃ mūrddhābhiṣiktaḥ sūtrayati---`apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' iti, tato vijñāyate kriyānimittako'pyapatyaśabda iti; anyathā yathā pautraprabhṛtiḥ putra ityanupapannaṃ tādṛgeva tatsyāt‌ | evaṃ sati sākṣātparamparayā vā yasya ya utpādyaḥ sa taṃ pratyapatyāmiti sarve'pi pitāmahādayo'pyapatyena yujyante, na tūtpādayitaiveti | tatrādye pakṣe yadyetannārabhyeta, tatastatra tatrāpatye tattatpitṛvacanātsa sa pratyayaḥ syāt‌, tadyathā---upagoraupagavaḥ, tasyaupagaviḥ, tasyaupagavāyanaḥ | evaṃ śatatame'patye ekonaśatamapatyapratyayāḥ---ityaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti, iṣṭaṃ ca na siddhyati---aupagava iti, tṛtīyāderupaguṃ pratyanapatyatvāt‌ | dvitīye tūpagoḥ pañcamaḥ pūrveṣāṃ caturṇāmapatyaṃ tato yadopagoḥ pratyayastadaupagava itīṣṭaṃ tāvatsiddhyati; aniṣṭamapi ca prāpnoti, taccāniṣṭamaniyatamaupagaviḥ, tata aupagavāyanaḥ, tata aupagavāyaniriti | pañcame trīṇyaniṣṭāni, ṣaṣṭhe catvārītyevaṃ yāvatithamapatyamabhidhitsitam, tāvanti dvyūnānyaniṣṭāni prāpnuvanti, tadyathā---śatatame'ṣṭau navatiśceti | evaṃ sthite idamārabhyate |
ārabhyamāṇe'pyetasminyadi prathamaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato vidhyarthametatsyād‌, niyamārthaṃ vā ? kathaṃ cedaṃ vidhyarthaṃ kathaṃ vā niyamārtham ? yadi gotraśabdena pautraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāya ekaikamapatyamabhidhīyate tato vidhyartham, tarhi tathā niyamārthaḥ sambhavati, ekasminnapatye'nekapratyayaprasaṅgasyābhāvād‌ | na tāvadekasminprayoge ekasyāḥ prakṛteranekapratyayaprasaṅgaḥ; ekenaivoktatvāttsyārthasya | nāpi prayogabhedena nānāprakṛtibhyo nānāpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, sarvadā svapitṛvacanādeva prasaṅgāditi paramaprakṛtestṛtīyādāvapatye'prāptaḥ, evamaupagavāccaturthādāviti, tataḥ kiṃ na vidhīyate vacanavyaktibhedāt‌ ? evaṃ hyatra vacanaṃ vyajyate---gotra ekaḥ pratyayo bhavati, yata eka eva pratyayaḥ kartuṃ śakyate, tata eva pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | ekagrahaṇasāmarthyāccāyamartho labhyate | nanu vidhīyamāne'pi pratyaye prakṛtipratyayāvasambandhau syātām ? vacanasāmarthyādapatyāpatyasyāpatyatvopacārāt‌ pratyayo bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ |
mukhye'patye caritārthaḥ pratyayo na syāditi vidhātavyamapi, asminpakṣe sarveṣvaupagava itīṣṭaṃ siddhyati, pratyayamālāprasaṅgastadavastha eva | na hyanena tattatpitṛvacanātprāptaḥ pratyayaḥ pratiṣiddhyate | tathā pañcame'patye upaguśabdādanena pratyaye vihite tasyāpatyamiti ṣaṣṭha aupagaviḥ syāt‌ | yadā tu `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛtigotram' ityapatyaśabdena pautraprabhṛtyasamudāyaṃ lakṣayitvā tasyaiva gotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate, ekaikasminnapatye gotraśabdaprayogaḥ, samudāyeṣu vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapīti nyāyāt‌ | atratyena vā gotraśabdenāvayavadharmeṇa samudāyavyapadeśātpautraprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo'bhīdhīyate tadā niyamārtham---gotrasamudāye eka eva pratyayo bhavatīti |
yadyapyekaikasminnapatye ekaikaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi pautra ekastadapatye cāpara iti sakalanirūpaṇe samudāye bahavaḥ pratyayāḥ kṛtāḥ syuriti niyama upapadyate | asminpakṣe doṣaḥ---anantarāpatyapratyayāntāttṛtīye pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, gotraśabdopādānena hi niyamaḥ kriyate---gotra eka eveti, tataśca gotre'nekaḥ pratyayo mā bhūt‌ | anantara ekastṛtīye cāpara ityevamanekaḥ kasmānna syāt‌ ? evamapi gotre eka eva hi kṛto bhavati | atha vā---gotrasamudāye eva evetyanena kiṃ kriyate ? tṛtīyādeścaturthādau prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate | yadi tṛtīyādeḥ syātsamudāye'nekaḥ pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi | yastvanantarastṛtīye prāptaḥ so'bhyanujñāyate---eka evetītaravyāvṛttau niyameṣu tātparyam | tataśca yataḥ pratyaye kriyamāṇe samudāye'nekaḥ pratyayaḥ kṛto bhavati | tato na bhavatītyeva vacanārtho bhavati | evaṃ catuthasyāpatyapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti, dvitīyādutpannastṛtīyamevācaṣṭe na tṛtīyādutpadyata iti, kintu aupagaverapatyamiti vākyameva | pañcamādestu vākyenāpyabhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti, na hi tattatpitṛvacanaḥ kaścidapatyapratyayāntaḥ śabdo'sti yena vigṛhyeta | paramavakṛteśca tṛtīyādau na kutracitpratyayaḥ prāpnoti, oyogāt‌ | tadevamasminpakṣe paramaprakṛteścotpattirvaktavyā, anantarācca tṛtīye prāptasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ |
syādetat---na paramaprakṛterutpattirvaktavyā, abhedopacāreṇaiva siddheḥ | abhedopacāraścopagvaupagavayoraupagavatadapatyayorvā | tadevaṃ śatatame'pyapatye'bhedopacāraparamparayā aupagava ityabhidhānaṃ sidhyati, na caivamabhedopacāreṇaiveṣṭasya siddheḥ sūtrasya vaiyarthyam, bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayamālāprasaṅganivṛttyarthatvāditi ? evamapyanantarasya tṛtoyasya ca bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīya aupagaviḥ syāt‌, tathā'nantare tṛtīyādau ca yatra pratyayo bhidyate, yathā---gargādau, tatrāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | yadi tāvad‌ gārgye gargāpacārastadā tadapatyamapi gārgiḥ syād‌, gārgyaśceṣyate | athāpi gargestadapatyasya cābhedopacāraḥ, evamapi gārgiḥ syāditītyādau viṣaye doṣavānevābhedopacāraḥ | tadevaṃ prathamapakṣe vidhau niyame ca doṣaprasaṅgād‌ dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, tatrāpi niyamaḥ | yadyapyekaikasminprayoge ekasyāḥ prakṛtereka eva pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpyupagoḥ pañcame pūrvābhyaścatasṛbhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ prayogabhedena nānāpratyayaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyate---eva eveti | tadidamuktam---bhedena pratyayaprasaṅge niyamaḥ kriyate |
nanu na jñāyate--ka evo bhavatīti, yo vā paramaprakṛteryo vā pratyayāntāditi ? nanveka ityucyate, yadi ca pratyayāntātprāptaḥ pratyayaḥ syādanekaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt‌ | kva ? na tāvatpañcame; pūrveṣāṃ pratyayānāmasminprayoge prasaṅgo'patyāntaraviṣayatvāt‌ | atha gotrasamudāye kenāsau nivāryeta ? na tāvadanenaiva, na hi gotrasamudāyo gotragrahaṇena gṛhyate | athāpi gṛhyeta, evamapi na jñāyate---yo vā paramaprakṛteḥ, yo vā'nantarāditi ? yadi punargotragrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, kriyamāṇaṃ vā'patyamātraparaṃ vijñāyate, na syādeṣa doṣaḥ; apatye samudāye eka eveti niyamāt‌ | apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇāttveṣa doṣo jāyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; apatyamiti vartate, gotre'patye eka evāpatyapratyayo bhavatīti vacanavyaktiḥ | yadi ca pratyayāntātpratyayaḥ syādapatyapratyayo'neko gotre kṛtaḥ syāt‌, sāmarthyena vā pratyayo viśeṣyate---gotrābhidhāne samarthānāṃ madhye eka eveti | yadi ca pratyayāntāt‌ pratyayaḥ syād‌ gotrābhidānasamartho'nekaḥ kṛtaḥ syātprathamasyāpi samarthatvāt | yadyapyasminprayoge'patyāntare vartate pañcamaṃ pratyapi sāmarthyaṃ tāvadasti, yadi vā `tasyāpatyam' ityādilakṣaṇaireka eva pratyayaḥ kartavyaḥ, kva ? gotre, yasminpratyaye gotrambhiditsitaṃ tatretyarthaḥ | pratyayāntācca pratyaye tasminneva prayoge prakṛtirūpasampādanāyāpi tāvadaneka kṛtaḥ syāt‌ |
yadi vā prathamavacana ekaśabdaḥ, kaśca prathamaḥ ? yamakṛtvā pratyayāntaraṃ kartuṃ na śakyate | sādhāraṇavacano vā, apatyādhikārācca yaḥ sarvāpatyasādhāraṇaḥ sa eva gotre bhavatīti, gargaśabdādyañeva bhavatīti | gargaśabdādyo yañ‌ prāptaḥ sa eva bhavati, na prakṛtyantarebhyaḥ prāptāḥ pratyayā ityarthaḥ, tadāha---pratyayo niyamyata iti | pratyayāntaraṃ vāryata ityarthaḥ | etena prakṛtirniyamyate ityapi vyākhyātam |
atha vetyādi | asminpakṣe prathamavacana eva śabda iti darśitam | prathamā prakṛtiriti | sūtre tu śabdāpekṣayā puṃlliṅganirdeśa iti darśitam | eka eva śabda iti | atha vā---asminpakṣe sādhāraṇavacana ekaśabdaḥ paramaprakṛtiśca sarvapratyayasādhāraṇī, saṅkhyāvacano vā prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvātparamaprakṛtirekaśabdena gṛhyate | anayoḥ pakṣayoḥ prathamā prakṛtiriti | ekaśabdasyārthato vivaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
gotrādyūnyastriyām || 4.1.94 ||
atrāpyanārabhyamāṇe'sminyoge utpādayitaryapatyayukte gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā bādhitatvādasati pūrvasūtravyāpāre caturthe tṛtīyātpañcame caturthātṣaṣṭhe pañcamādau yūni tṛtīyādutpattirna prāpnoti, taṃ pratyanapatyatvāditīṣṭaṃ na sidhyati | sarveṣu tvapatyayukteṣu pañcame yūni pūrvebhyaścaturbhyaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | tatra yadā tṛtīyāttadā gārgyāyaṇa itīṣṭaṃ tāvatsidhyati, aniṣṭamapi prāpnoti; prakṛtyantarebhyo'pi pratyayaprasaṅgādityata idamārabhyate |
atrāpi yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tato vidhyarthametatsyāt‌, niyamārthaṃ vā ? yadi yuvaśabdenaikamapatyamucyate, tata ekasminyūni gotrādagotrācca prāptyabhāvāt‌ caturthena vyavahite pañcamādau yūni gotrādvidhyarthaṃ bhavati | atha caturthaprabhṛtyapatyasamudāyo yuvaśabdenocyate, tato gotrāccaturthe caturthādagotrātpañcama iti gotrādagotrācca yuvasamudāye pratyayaprasaṅge gotrādeveti niyamārthaṃ bhavati | tatra vidhau gargyāyaṇa itīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, pratyayamālāprasaṅgadoṣaḥ syādeva; tatpitṛvacanātprāptasya pratyayasyāniṣiddhatvāt‌ | niyame caturthādeḥ prāptasya pratyayasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ sampadyate---yadi caturthādeḥ syād‌ yuvasamudāye gotrādapi pratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi, tataśca nāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ; kintu pañcamādau yūni gotrādutpattirna prāpnoti, taṃ pratyanapatyatvāditi pañcamasya vākyenābhidhānaṃsyād‌---gārgyāyaṇasyāpatyamiti | ṣaṣṭhasya tu vākyenāpi na siddhyati, na hi tatpitṛvacano'patyāpratyayāntaḥ śabdo'sti, yena vigṛhyeta | tadevamatrāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, niyamaśca, tadāha---ayamapi niyama iti | gotrādeveti | yūnyevetyeṣa viparītaṃ niyamo na bhavati; `eko gotre' iti niyamādyūno'nyatra gotrapratyayasya prasaṅgābhāvāt‌ | na paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhya iti | anyathā prayogabhedena tebhyo'pi syāt‌ |
ki punaratra pratiṣidhyata iti | sarvasminnapi pratiṣidhyamāne doṣadarśanātpraśnaḥ | tameva doṣamāviṣkaroti---yadi niyama iti | tadekavākyatvātpratiṣedhasyeti bhāvaḥ | striyāmaniyamaḥ prāpnotīti | paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvalakṣaṇāḥ pratyayāḥ prayogabhedena paryāyeṇa syurityarthaḥ | atha yuvapratyayaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti | astriyāmiti yogavibhāgena prasajyaprateṣedhāśrayeṇa ceti bhāvaḥ | gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na prāpnotīti | tadyathā `gargādibhyo yañ‌' gārgī gārgyāyaṇī, apatyasāmānyalakṣaṇa eva tu pratyayaḥ syāt‌ | kiṃ kāraṇamanabhidhānaṃ prāpnotītyata āha---gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā bādhitatvāditi | yathā ca bādhastathā tatraiva vakṣyate | syādetat---yuvapratyayasya striyāṃ lukkariṣyate, katham ? `yūni luk' ityasyānantaraṃ striyāṃ ceti vakṣyāmi, yūni lugityeva, `prāgdīvyataḥ' ityetannivṛttam | yadvā `vataṇḍācca, luk‌ striyām, yūni ca' iti vakṣyāmi, luk‌ striyāmityeva, tataśca gārgyaśabdādutpannasya phako luki kṛte luptasyāpyarthaṃ prakṛtirevāheti yañantātstriyāṃ vartamānānṅīṣṣphau bhaviṣyata iti ? evamapyaupagavaśabdādata iño luki kṛte, anupasarjanādhikārādaṇyo'nupasarjanamityucyamāna īkāro na prāpnoti; aṇarthasyāpradhānatvāt‌, yūni saṃkrāntatvāt‌ | mā bhūdevamaṇyo'nupasarjanamiti, aṇantādanupasarjanādityevaṃ bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syād---āpiśalinā proktaṃ vyākaraṇam, `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌, tadadhīte āpiśalā brāhmaṇī, `tadadhīte' ityaṇaḥ proktālluki aṇantasyādhyetryāṃ pradhānastriyāṃ saṃkrāntatvānṅīpprāpnoti, tasmādaṇyo'nupasarjanamityevāśrayaṇīyam, striyāṃ yo'ṇvihita iti vā | yathā ca satyaupagavītīkāro na prāpnoti | yadyapyatra pratyayalakṣaṇena iña upasaṅkhyānamitīkāraḥ syāt‌, iha tu glucukāyanerapatyamautsargikasyāṇo luki ṅīnna prāpnoti, `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ‌ bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi yaskasyāpatyaṃ śivādyaṇ‌ yāskaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ strī, `aṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ‌, striyāṃ luki īkāro na prāpnoti ? na hyatra luptaḥ pratyaya īkārasya nimittam, yaśca śrūyate na sa striyāṃ vihita upasarjanaṃ ca | tarhi kā gatiḥ ? ityata āha---tasmāditi | yuvasaṃjñaiva pratiṣidhyata iti | nanu yūni yaduktaṃ tatstriyāṃ na bhavati' ityuktam, na ca yuvasaṃjñā yūnyūktā, nahi yuvasaṃjñāyāḥ prāgyuvasaṃjñāsti ? caturthāderjīvadvaṃśyasyāpatyasyopalakṣaṇaṃ yuvaśabda ityadoṣaḥ |
apara āha---svarūpaparo yuvaśabdaḥ, paribhāṣā ceyam---yatra yuvaśabdaḥ śrūyate tatra `astriyām' ityupatiṣṭhate | `jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā astriyām' iti vā vyaktameva paṭhitavyamiti ||
ata iñ‌ || 4.1.95 ||
akārāntātprātipadikāditi | `ata sātatyagamane' ityasya vā'cchabdāntānāṃ vā kurvadādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi syācchivādiṣu yeṣāmasyeño bādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ, śivaproṣṭhaprauṣṭhikaprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt‌ | vyapadeśivadbhāvādihāpi bhavati---asyāpatyamiriti, yasyeti lope pratyayamātrasya śravaṇam | iha tu---erapatyamasya yuvreti, `yañiñośca' iti phaki yasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā paratvādādivṛddhau kṛtāyām---āyāyana iti bhavati ||
bāhvādibhyaśca || 4.1.96 ||
kvaciditi | ajīgarttādiṣūdaṅkaparyanteṣvadantatvātpūrveṇeñ‌ prāptaḥ, tasya `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' ityaṇ‌ bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ | anye sarve'nakārāntāḥ, teṣu ca bāhuprabhṛtiṣūvarṇānteṣu, puṣkarasadādiṣu halanteṣu cāṇ‌ prāptaḥ | cūḍāśabdād‌ `dvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak‌, vṛkalādibhyastannāmikaṇprāptaḥ | śiras‌, lomanniti tadantayorgrahaṇam | `sambhūyombhomitaujasāṃ salopaśca' ityeva vaktavye pṛthak salopaśceti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham | udañcu iti paṭhyate, tatra nāyamukārāntātpratyayaḥ; kintu kvinnantātpratyayaḥ, nalopābhāvastu nipātyate---udīco'patyamaudañciḥ | etatsarvaṃ pailādiṣvaudañciśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate |
bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣviti | prabhṛtigrahaṇena vakṣyamāṇānāṃ kuñjādīnāṃ grahaṇam | loke vidito laukiko gotrabhāvaḥ, saṃjñākāritvam ādipuruṣatvamityarthaḥ | etacca nyāyasiddham, katham ? arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasyeti arthavatāṃ bāhvādīnāṃ grahaṇam, sa cārthaḥ prasiddhaḥ; jhaṭiti pratīteḥ | smṛtiśāstrasya cārthato'nāditvādanādyarthābhidhāyināmeva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam | bāhurnāma kaściditi | evaṃ kuñco nāma naḍo vā, tasmādiñeva bhavati---kauñjiḥ, nāḍiriti | yattu kāryaṃ na svarūpopādānena vidhīyate, kintu prakārāntareṇa; tadidānīntanārthābhidhāyināmapi bhavati, `ata iñ‌', daivadattiriti | sambandhiśabdānāṃ ceti kāryāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, sambandhiśabdānāṃ śvaśurādīnāṃ yatkāryamucyate tasya tatsadṛśe pratiṣedho bhavati | saṃjñāśvasurasyeti | saṃjñayā yaḥ śvasuraḥ, na sambandhena | śvāsuririti | uṇādiṣu nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavati, tena `sāvaserāptau' iti vyutpannasya śvasuraśabdasya `na yvābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati | tathā `mātṛpitṛbhyāṃ svasā' iti ṣatvaṃ dhānyamatari na bhavati | idamapi nyāyasiddham; saṃjñāśvaśurasyādimattvātsambandhiśabdasyānāditvāt‌ | mātṛpitṛbhyāmityatrāpi prasiddhataratvājjananīvācino grahaṇam | uktaṃ ca---
abhivyaktapadārthā ye svatantrāḥ lokaviśrutāḥ |
śāstrārthasteṣu kartavyaḥ śabdeṣu na taduktiṣu || iti |
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha ākṛtigaṇatāmasya bodhayatīti | paṭhitaśabdāpekṣaḥ samuccaya iti bhāvaḥ ||
sudhāturakaṅ‌ ca || 4.1.97 ||
vyāsaruḍetyādi | vedaṃ vyasyatīti devavyāsaḥ, `karaṇyaṇ‌', tasyaikadeśaprayogaḥ---vyāsa iti, bhīmaseno bhīma itivat‌ | varuḍādayo jātiviśeṣāḥ | tattarhi vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam ; prakṛtyantarāṇyevaitāni svārthikakan‌pratyayantāni, avyavikanyāyena ca kan‌, na hi tairvākyameva bhavati | vyāsaśabdādṛṣivācino'pi bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvādiñ‌ bhavati ||
gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ‌ || 4.1.98 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti | yadyatra cakāro na kriyeta tato `vrātaphañorastriyām' iti vaktavyam, tatoḥ `aśvādibhyaḥ phañ‌' ityasyāgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | kauñjāyanya iti | svārthe ñyaḥ bahuṣu tu `ñyādayastadrājāḥ' iti tadrājatvāt‌ `tadrājasya bahuṣu' ityādinā luk‌ |
kiṃ punaratra ñitsvaro bhavati ? uta citsvaraḥ ? ityatrāha---ekavacanadvivacanayoriti | tatra hi ñyapratyayaḥ śrūyate, sa ca paścādbhāvīti tannibandhano ñitsvaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ | bahuvacane tu ñye nivṛtte sampradhāraṇā---ñitsvaro vā, citsvaroveti ? tatra paratvād‌ ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti, citkaraṇasāmarthyāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati | ñitkaraṇasāmarthyād ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti, astyanyat‌ ñitkaraṇasya prayojanam, kima ? vṛddhyartho ñakāraḥ | citkaraṇe'pi tarhyastyanyatprayojanam, kim ? viśeṣaṇam | śakyo'tra viśeṣamārtho'nyo'nubandha āsaṃktum | tatra cakārānurodhāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati | vṛddhyartho'pi tarhyanyo'nubandhaḥ āsaṃktum | tatra cakārānurodhāccitsvaro bhaviṣyati | vṛddhyartho'pi tarhyanyo'nubandhaḥ śakya āsaṃktum, tatra ñakārānurodhād‌ ñitsvaraḥ prāpnoti ? evaṃ sthite idamucyate---paramapi ñitsvaraṃ tyaktvā citsvara eveṣyata iti | evaṃ manyate---svare yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, itamasti `citaḥ'---cito'nta udātto bhavati, tataḥ `taddhitasya' cita ityeva, taddhitasya cito'nta udātto bhavati | kimarthamidam ? paratvātprāptasya ñitsvarasya bādhanārtham | tataḥ `kitaḥ', kitaśca taddhitasyānta udātto bhavatīti | yadi tu kphapratyayaḥ kriyate, taddhitasyeti yogavibhāgaḥ śakyo'kartum | athaivaṃ kasmānna kriyate---`gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ‌, bahuṣu phak‌, naḍādibhyasca' iti ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hi doṣaḥ syāt‌---kauñjāyanānāmapatyaṃ māṇavakaḥ kauñjāyanyaḥ, kauñjāyanyau; aikena yaśabdaḥ śrūyate, dvyekayorhi cphañvidhīyate | yadā tu cphañantāt‌ ñyo vidhīyate tadā yūnyutpannasyeñaḥ `ṇyakṣattriyārṣañitaḥ' iti luki kṛte `tadrājasya' itiñyasya luki prāpte `gotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhādyaśabdasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati | yathā kauñjāyanyasyāpatyāni bahūni, ata iño luki tadrājasyaiva bahuṣu varttamānatvād‌ ñyasya luki kauñjāyanā iti bhavati ||
naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌ || 4.1.99 ||
śalaṅku śalaṅ‌kaṃ ceti | dve api prathamānte | śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ | `śalaṅku' ityetacchabdarūpaṃ śalaṅkaṃ bhavati, tadrūpeṇa pariṇamate ityarthaḥ | iñevānyatreti | bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ | amyupetyāpi gotramātre phako vidhānam, parihāramāha---atha veti | iño bhāvasyeti | śalaṅkabhāvāpatterapyupalakṣaṇametat‌, pūrvatra parihāre tasyāḥ sa eva pāṭho jñāpako veditavyaḥ |
agniśarmanvṛṣagaṇa iti | agniśarmanśabdaḥ phakamutpādayati vṛṣagaṇe gotre, āgniśarmāyaṇo bhavati vārṣagaṇyaśced‌, āgniśarmo'nyaḥ | amuṣyeti paṭhyate, tatrādaḥ śabde prātipadikamātre paṭhitavye vibhaktyantasya pāṭhādutpanne'pi phaki lugna bhavati | āmuṣyāyaṇā, āmuṣyaputriketyalugvidhāvasya grahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati | kṛṣṇaraṇau brāhmaṇavāsiṣṭhayoriti | kārṣṇāyano bhavati brāhmaṇaścet‌, kārṣṇiranyaḥ | rāṇāyano bhavati vāsiṣṭhaśced‌, rāṇiranyaḥ | kroṣṭu kroṣṭaṃ ceti | krauṣṭāyanaḥ ||
haritādibhyo'ñaḥ || 4.1.100 ||
`haritādibhyaḥ', `añaḥ' iti vyadhikaraṇe pañcamyau | haritādibhyaḥ paro yo'ñ‌ tadantātprātipadikādityarthaḥ | vṛttikāro'pyetadeva vastuto vyācaṣṭe---haritādibhyo'ñantebhya iti | `haritādibhyo gotrāpatye'ñpratyayo bhavati' ityayaṃ tvartho na bhavati; bidādiṣu pāṭhāt‌ |
sāmarthyāditi | gotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayo na bhavatītyetatsāmarthyam | tasmādgotrādhikāre'pi yūni pratyayo vijñāyate | na caivaṃ gotrādhikārasya viccheda ityāha---gotrādhikāra iti | uttarārthaṃ gotragrahaṇamanuvarttata evetyarthaḥ ||
yañiñośca || 4.1.101 ||
gotragrahaṇena yañiñau viśeṣyeti iti | gotre yau yañiñau vihitāvityevam | na caiva pratyayārthasyāpatyasyāviśeṣitatvādapatyamātre pratyayaprasaṅga ityāha---tadantādyūnyevāyaṃ pratyaya iti | evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ--na kevalaṃ pūrva eva pratyayo yūni bhavati, yamapi yūnyeveti | kasmāt‌ ? ityāha---gotrādyūnīti vacanāditi ||
śaradvacchunakadarbhād‌ bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu || 4.1.102 ||
śaradvadādīnāṃ bhṛgvādivaṃśaprabhavānāṃ kṛtrimā api putrāḥ santi, svavaṃśaprabhavā api, tatrāpatyaviśeṣaṇaṃ kriyate | tatra bhṛguḥ śaradvato'patyaṃ na bhavati; pūrvabhāvitvāt‌ | evaṃ śunakasya vatsaḥ, tasmādbhārgaṃvaśca vātsyaśca āgrāyaṇaśceti dvandve yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatayā varttipadasya bahuṣu vṛtterattribhṛgviti `yañañośca' iti ca gotrapratyayasya luk‌, tadāha---bhārgavaścedvātsyaścediti | dārbhiriti | darbhaśabda ṛṣivacano na bhavati, bāhvādiṣu vā pāṭhyaḥ ||
droṇaparvatajīvantādanyatarasyām || 4.1.103 ||
pūrvamuktam--gotrādhikāraśca śivādibhyo'ṇ‌ iti yāvaditi, ihāpyuktam---gotra ityeveti, tatra nodayati---kathamiti | naivātreti | yasya grahaṇamūrīkṛtya bhavānānantarye doṣamāha, sa naiva gṛhyata ityevaśabdasyārthaḥ | mahābhāratedroṇomahābhāratadroṇaḥ | anādiriti | idānīmeva hyuktam---bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣvityādi | nanvevaṃ prayogasyātyantamanupapattiḥ ? ityata āha---idānīṃ tviti | arvācīnādityarthaḥ, na punarmahābhāratadroṇo vṛttikāreṇa samānakālaḥ; anāderidānīntanasya ca droṇa iti śrutiḥ samānā | tatrānādidroṇasya ye vaṃśyā aśvatthāmnā samānakālāste droṇāyanā ityucyante | tatra yad‌ dṛṣṭaṃ gotratvaṃ tadaśvatthāmnyapi droṇaśabdāvācyāpatyatvāt‌ skhalitabuddhayaḥ pratipattāro'dhyāropayanti | tenādhyāropeṇaāśvatthāmani tathā drauṇāyana ityetad‌ gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ bhavati ||
anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ‌ || 4.1.104 ||
gotra ityeveti | etena ye'tra ṛṣiśabdā bidaurvaprabhṛtayastebhyo gotra evānyathā syāditi gotra ityetadihānuvarttanīyamiti darśayati---ye punarityādi |
kathaṃ punargotrādhikāre satyayamartho labhyate ? ityatrāha---anṛṣyānantarya ityasyāyamartha iti | `anṛṣi' iti pañcamyā lukā nirdeśaḥ, `ānantarye' iti svārtheṣyañ‌ | evaṃ ca pautrā ityādāvanantarasyaivābhidhānam, na gotrasya, nāpatyasāmānyasya ca | yadyayamartha iti | asmin‌ hyarthe'nṛṣibhyo'nantarāpatye vidhyarthamidaṃ bhavati, tataśca ṛṣyapatyanairantarye, ṛṣayaśca te'patyāni ca ṛṣyapatyāni, teṣāṃ nairantarye, ṛṣirūpāṇyapatyāni nirantarāṇi yatra tasminviṣaye pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt‌, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ityatrāha---tatredamiti | kaśyapa ṛṣistasyāpatyamapyṛṣiḥ, evam `sapta nairantaryeṇa ṛṣayasteṣāṃ saptama indrahūrnāma tatra kāśyapānām' iti prayogo nopapadyate; añi sati `yañañośca' iti lukprasaṅgāt‌ | tasmād‌ `anṛṣyānantarye' ityasya ṛṣīṇāmānantarye'vyavadhāne pratyayo na bhavatītyayamartho vyākhyeya iti bhāvaḥ | prayogaṃ tāvadupapādayati---anantarāpatyarūpeṇeti | apatyasāmānyarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | na punarṛṣyaṇanantarāpatye vidhīyate | tatra yathā `abhūnnṛpaḥ' ityādau vastuto bhūtaviśeṣe'pi sāmānyavivakṣayā lug‌ bhavati, tadvadihāpi vastuto gotre'pi tadrūpatiraskāreṇāpatyasāmānyarūpavivakṣayā ṛṣyaṇbhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamiyaṃ kliṣṭakalpanā''śrīyate ? ityāha---avaśya caitadevaṃ vijñeyamiti | ṛṣīṇāmapatyānāṃ nairantaryaṃ viṣayo yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ | kauśiko viśvāmitra iti duṣyatīti | ki kāranam ? viśvāmitrastapastepe---nānṛṣiḥ syāmapi tu ṛṣirevasyāmiti, tatra bhavānṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe---nānṛṣeḥ putraḥ syāmiti, tatra bhāvan‌ gādhirapyṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe---nānṛṣeḥ pautraḥ syāmiti, tatra bhavānkuśiko'pi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ | tadetadṛṣyānantaryaṃ sambhavati |
parastrī paraśuṃ ceti | dvitīyānirdeśādāpadyate iti śeṣaḥ | parastrīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, paraśuṃ cādeśamāpadyate, parastriyā apatyaṃ pāraśavaḥ, brāhmaṇasya śūdrāyāmūḍhāyāmutpannaḥ, sā ca jātitaḥ varastrī bhavati | yastu parabhāryāyāmutpannaḥ pārastraiṇeyaḥ sa bhavati kalyāṇyādiḥ, anuśatikādiśca | pāraśava ityatra pūrvottarapadasampramohādanuśatikādikāryābhāvaḥ ||
gargādibhyo yañ‌ || 4.1.105 ||
apatyasāmānye bhaviṣyatīti | anye tu---`manutantuśabdasamudāya ekaḥ, na tu dvau śabdau paṭhitau iti vadanti, tathā ca brāhmaṇe---mānutantavyamuvāceti prayogaḥ | kālavamanutantukuśikānāmiti ca pravare |
kathaṃ mānavīti | lohitādipāṭhānnityena ṣpheṇa bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ | anantarāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ tviti | gotrasyāpīti boddhavyam, tathā ca jāmadagnāḥ, vātsā iti pravare prayogaḥ | vājā'se iti | vājaśabdo yañamutpādayati, ase-asamāse | samāse tu sauvājiḥ, `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' ityasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ---`ase' iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
madhubabhrvorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ || 4.1.106 ||
gaṇa eva babhrukauśika iti vaktavyam, evaṃ hi dvibebhrugrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
kapibodhādāṅgirase || 4.1.107 ||
kāpeya iti | `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak‌ | baudhiriti | anṛṣitvādiñ‌, bāhvādirvā ||
vataṇḍācca || 4.1.108 ||
kimarthamiti | `vataṇḍālluk‌ striyām' ityeva kasmānnoktam, kimartho yogavibhāga iti praśnaḥ | pariharati---śivādiṣvapīti | vataṇḍo nāma ṛṣiḥ, tata ṛṣitvādevāṇi siddhe śivādiṣu tasya pāṭho gotre gargādiyañā samāveśārthaḥ | tatra yathā'nāṅgirase samāveśo bhavati, evamāṅgirase'pi syāditi tannivattyartho yogavibhāga ityarthaḥ ||
luk‌ striyām || 4.1.109 ||
vātaṇḍyāyanīti | lohitādilakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ | vātaṇḍīti | ṛṣitvāt‌ ṣyañna bhaviṣyati ||
aśvādibhyaḥ phañ‌ || 4.1.110 ||
ye tvatra gotrapratyayāntāḥ paṭhyanta iti | vailya, ānaḍuhya, āttreya---ityete | tatra bailyaśabda `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ‌' iti ñyaṅantaḥ, vilirnāma rājarṣaiḥ, ānaḍuhyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ, āttreyaḥ `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhagantaḥ |
śaya āttreye iti | śayaśabdātphañ‌ bhavati āttreyaścet‌, śāyāyanaḥ | āttreyādanyatra śāyiḥ, anṛṣitvādiñ‌, bāhvādirvā | anye tvaṇameva pratyudāharanti | puṃsi jāta iti | puṃsīti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam, jātasyāpatyaṃ jātāyanaḥ | striyāṃ tu jātāyā apatyaṃ jāteya iti ḍhageva bhavati, anyathā liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā phañeva syāt‌ | āttreya bharadvāje iti | āttreyāyano bhavati bhāradvājaścet‌, anyatrāta iñaḥ `ṇyakṣattriya' iti luk‌ | bhāradvājāttreye iti | attrigotrajo yadā bhāradvājagotrajena putratvena svīkriyate tadā pratyayaḥ | sa hyattreyaśca bhavati bhāradvājasya ca gotraṃ bhavati | bhāradvājāyana āttreyaśced‌, bhāradvājo'nyaḥ, bidādyañeva bhavati ||
śivādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.1.112 ||
yathāyathamityādi | tatrādanteṣviño'pavādaḥ, muni--sandhibhūmiprabhṛtiṣu `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhakaḥ, strīpratyayānteṣuṃ `strībhyo ḍhak' `dryacaḥ' iti prāptasya ḍhakaḥ, gaṅgāvipāṭ‌śabdayostu yasminprāpte sa vṛttikāraṇaivoktaḥ, jaratkāruśabdasya tu pāṭhe prayojanaṃ cintyam | kecidāhuḥ---śubhrādiṣvayaṃ paṭhanīyaḥ, jāratkāreya iti yathā syāt, tatra tu ḍhakā samāveśārtho'sya pāṭha iti |
ṇyapratyayasya tu bādho neṣyata iti | atrā hetum `udīcāmiñ‌' ityatra vakṣyati |
śubhrādiḍhakā ceti | `śubhrādibhyaśca' ityatra vakṣyati--`cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtha ākṛkigaṇatāmasya bodhayati, tena gāṅgeyaḥ pāṇḍaveya ityādisiddhaṃ bhavati' iti, tadabhiprāyeṇedamuktam | ravaṇaviśravaṇaśabdau paṭhyete, tau viśravaḥ śabdasyādeśau prakṛtyantare vā vṛttiviṣaye tatsamānārthe, viśravaso'patyaṃ vaiśravaṇo rāvaṇaḥ |
dvyaco nadyā iti | nadīvācino ye dvyacaḥ kulyāprabhṛtayastebhyastannāmikāṇo'pavāde `dvyacaḥ' iti ḍhaki prāpte'ṇ‌ bhavati | triveṇī trivaṇaṃ ceti | triveṇyā apatyaṃ traivaṇaḥ, tannamikāṇi siddhe ādeśāryaṃ vacanam | athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yatāvihitamityevocyeta, evagucyamāne iñādaya eva syuste vihitāḥ, punarārambhasāmarthyādyo vihito na ca prāpnoti sa evāṇ‌ bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---ṛṣṭiṣeṇaśabdo'tra paṭhyate, tatra yathāvihitamityucyamāne `ata iñ‌' prāptaḥ, tasya senāntalakṣaṇo ṇyo bādhakaḥ prāptaḥ, tatrārambhasāmarthyādiñ‌ prasajyeta, punaraṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati ||
avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyastannāmikābhyaḥ || 4.1.113 ||
apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti śāstrāntare yatparibhāṣitaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam, vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām `vṛddho yūnā iti, iha tu pratyāsatteretacchāstrasiddhasyaiva vṛddhasya grahaṇamityāha---vṛddhiryasyeti | avṛdbhābhya iti śabdadharma iti | vṛddhaparyudāse sati nañivayuktanyāyena tatsadṛśasyaiva śabdasya sampratyayāt‌ | strīliṅganirdeśastu `nadīmānuṣībhyaḥ' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt‌ | kathaṃ punararthavṛtteḥ śabdavṛttinā sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? abhedopacārāt‌ | avṛddhaśabdavācyatvānnadīmānuṣya evāvṛddhā uktāḥ | nadīmānuṣībhya ityarthadharma iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, bahuvacananirdeśāt‌, vṛddhaparyudāsācca saṃjñānadyā api grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; laukikārthavṛttinā mānuṣīśabdena sāhacaryāt‌ | tannāmikābhya iti sarvanāmnā pratyayaprakṛteḥ parāmarśa iti | tā avṛddhāḥ prakṛtayo nāmāni yāsāṃ nadīmānuṣīṇāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ | tadevaṃ tribhirapi padairartha eva nirdiśyate, tatrārthātpratyayavidhānānupapattestadvācinībhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyayo vijāyate | tadidamuktam---tenābhedātprakṛtayo nidiśyanta iti | tenārthonābedāt | etaduktaṃ bhavati---avṛddhaśabdācyāstannāmikā yā nadīmānuṣyastābhyo'ṇ‌ pratyayo bhavati, ko|rthaḥ ? tadvācinībhyaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti | tadetadāha---āvṛddhāni yānītyādi | evaṃ ca kṛtvā---avṛddhebhyo nadīmanuṣīnāmabhya iti vaktavyam, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | ḍhako'pavāda iti | strīliṅganirdeśāt‌ bhaidyoddhyaśoṇādiṣvayaṃ vidhirna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca || 4.1.114 ||
ṛṣayaḥ prasiddhā vasiṣṭhādaya iti | ṛṣayaḥ-mantradarśinaḥ, te ca prasiddhā vasiṣṭhādayaḥ, yathā indrādayo devatāḥ, tena tena paribhāṣaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥ | vaṃśākhyā iti | keṣāñcidvaṃśānāmetā ākhyā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ kecidvaṃśā ākhyāyanta iti yāvat‌ | `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān‌' ityabhiprāyeṇāha---iñoṃ'pavāda iti | attryādibhya iti | tatra ṛṣyaṇovakāśaḥ---vāsiṣṭhaḥ, `itaścāniñaḥ' iti; ḍhako'vakāśaḥ---ḍulerapatyaṃ ḍauleyaḥ; āttreya ityubhayaprasaṅge paratvāḍ‌ḍhag‌ bhavati | senāntalakṣaṇasya ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ--- hāriṣeṇyaḥ, atra hi `eti saṃjñāyāmagāt‌' iti ṣatvasyāsiddhatvātsenāntametadbhavati, ṛṣyaṇaḥ sa eva; jātaseno nāma ṛṣiḥ, tasmādubhyaprasaṅge paratvād‌ ṇyo bhavati--jātasenyaḥ | evamudīcāmiñ‌---jātaseniḥ, andhakāṇo'vakāśaḥ---śvāphalkaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva, ugrasenādandhakādubhayaprasaṅge paratvāṇṇyo bhavati---augrasenyaḥ | vṛṣṇyaṇo'vakāśaḥ---vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; viṣvaksenād‌ vṛṣṇervaiṣvaksenyaḥ | kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ---nākulaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva, bhīmasenātkurorbhaimasenyaḥ |
kākatālīyanyāyeneti | yadṛcchayā | asaṅkareṇeti | śabdāntarairasaṅkīrṇā ityarthaḥ | saṅkalitāḥ-saṃhatāḥ | subahava iti | vyutpapādayiṣitāḥ sarve ityarthaḥ | anityo'pāśrayeṇāpi nityasyānvākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā---śakāśrayeṇa kālasya | atha vetyādi | `tripuruṣānūkaṃ nāma kuryāt‌' ityanena nyāyenāndhakādivaṃśā api nityā eva | teṣu ye śabdā iti | andhakādiṣvevādyatve'pi ye śabdāḥ prayujyante tebhya ityarthaḥ |
māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ || 4.1.115 ||
dvaimātura iti | taddhitārtha dviguḥ, paścāttaddhitaḥ | ekasyā aurasaḥ suto'parasyāḥ kṛtrima iti dvaimāturatvam | sāmmātura iti | prādisamāsāttaddhitaḥ | bhādramātura iti | viśeṣaṇasamāsādaṇ‌ |
tenetyādinā'rthāpekṣyasya strīliṅganirdeśasya phalaṃ darśayati | dhānyamāturiti | dhānyaṃ yo mimīte sa dhānyamātā, yājakāditvātṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | dhānyamātari yo mātṛśabdastasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ, tena sammimīte tasyāptayaṃ sāmmātra ityutvaṃ na bhavati, nyāyānuvādaścāyaṃ strīliṅganirdeśaḥ | sambandhiśabdasya hi prasiddhataratvāttasyaiva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam |
saṅkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyā iti kimiti | na tāvatkevalātprasaṅgaḥ, na hi māturapatyamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati; apatye mātṛsambandhasyāvyabhicātat | tena tadantasya grahaṇāt‌ saṅkhyādipūrvasya tāvatsiddhamiti praśnaḥ | anyapūrvasyāpi syādityuttaram | saumātra iti |
kvacidasyānantaraṃ granthaḥ---śubhrādipāṭhādvaimātreya iti | tena vipūrvo mātṛśabdo na pratyudāhartavya iti bhāvaḥ | vayaṃ brūmaḥ---`strībhyo ḍhak‌' ityatra strīpratyayavijñānādasatyarthagrahaṇe iha na bhavati | aiḍaviḍo dāradaḥ (4.1.120 sūtre) ityasyānantaramayaṃ granthaḥ, iha tu lekhakaiḥ pramādāllikhita iti ||
kanyāyāḥ kanīna ca || 4.1.116 ||
ḍhako'pavāda iti | `dvyacaḥ' iti prāptasya | kanyāyā apatyaṃ kānīna iti | śāstroktavivāhasaṃskārapūrvasya puruṣasamprayogasyābhāvaḥ kanyāśabdanimittaṃ nākṣatayonitvam | yā tu vivāhasaṃskāreṇa vinā puruṣeṇa samprayujyate sā kanyātvaṃ na jahāti | tenaitanna nodanīyam---yadi kanyā nāpatyam, athāpatyaṃ na sā kanyā, kanyā cāpatyaṃ ceti vipratiṣiddhamiti | apara āha---munidevatāmāhātmyādyā puṃyoge'pi na kanyātvaṃ jahāti, yathā---kuntī, yathā---satyavatī, sātrodāharaṇamiti, tadāha---kānīnaḥ karṇaḥ, kānīno vyāsa iti ||
vikarṇaśuṅgacchagalādvatsabharadvājāttriṣu || 4.1.117 ||
atra vatsādīnāṃ mūlaprakṛtīnāṃ vakarṇādīnpratyapatyatvāyogādapatyapratyayāntānāṃ vātsyādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ dvandveyugadadhikaraṇavacanatayā pratyekaṃ bahutvopajananāttasya bahutvasya lopibhireva kṛtatvādapatyapratyayasya lukā nirdeśaḥ, tadāha---vaikarṇo bhavati vātsyaścedityādi ||
strībhyo ḍhak‌ || 4.1.120 ||
strīgrahaṇenetyādi | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśāt‌ | stryarthasyāpi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; vimātṛśabdasyārthasya subhrādiṣu pāṭhāt‌ | tasya tu stryarthatvaṃ vidhavāśabdasāhacaryādvijñeyam | kiñca---strīśabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, svaritena cādhikārāvagatirbhavati, tena ṭābādistrīpratyayāntānāmeva grahaṇaṃ yuktam | ktinnādayastu vyavadhānānna gṛhyante | aiḍaviḍaḥ, dārada iti | iḍaviṭ‌śabdāt‌ `janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ‌', daracchabdād‌ `dvyañmagadha' ityaṇ‌, tayoḥ striyām `ataśca' iti luk‌, tatastadapatye'ṇeva bhavati |
vṛṣa vācye iti | vṛṣaḥ-bījāśvaḥ, tena cārthena viśeṣavihitenāpatyalakṣaṇe'rthe ḍhakā bādhyate, tenāpatye'ṇeva bhavati | vāḍava iti | catuṣpāllakṣaṇo ḍhañapi na bhavati; acatuṣpādvācitvāt‌ |
aṇ‌ kruñceti | vṛṣa iti nāpekṣyate, apatya evāyaṃ vidhiḥ | ḍhako'pavādaḥ | kruñcā ca kokilā ca samāhāradvandve napuṃsakahrasvatvam ||
dvyacaḥ || 4.1.121 ||
tannāmikāṇo'pavāda iti | anyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌ ||
śubhrādibhyaśca || 4.1.123 ||
yathāyogamityādi | tatrādanteṣviño'pavādaḥ, śalākādiṣu tannāmikāṇaḥ, vidhavāśabdāttu kṣudrālakṣaṇasya ḍhrakaḥ, catuṣpādvāciṣu catuṣpāllakṣaṇasya ḍhañaḥ, godhāśabdādgodhāyā ḍhrakaḥ; vacanātso'pi bhavati | kvacidautsargikasyāṇaḥ | pāṇḍaveya iti | `ḍhelopo'kadravā' iti lopo na bhavati, kadrūparyudāsena strīliṅgasya grahaṇāt‌, pāṇḍavaśabdādvā pratyayaḥ |
lakṣaṇaśyāmayorvāsiṣṭha iti | lākṣaṇeyo bhavati vāsiṣṭhaścet‌, lākṣaṇiranyaḥ; śyāmeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, śyāmāyano'nyaḥ, aśvāditvātphañ‌ ||
kulaṭāyā vā || 4.1.127 ||
kulānyaṭatīti kulaṭeti | mūlavibhujādiṣu darśanātkaḥ pratyayaḥ | pacādyac‌ tu na labhyate, akārādanupapadātkarmopapado vipratiṣedhenetyaṇprasaṅgāt |
yā tu kulānyaṭantī śīlaṃ bhinattīti | ekatra kule praviṣṭā svairiṇī yā kulāntaramaṭati sā duḥ śīlā kulaṭetyarthaḥ | kṣudrābhyo veti paratvāditi | kṣudrāḥ-aṅgahīnāḥ śīlahīnāśca | yā punarbhikṣālipsayā suśīlāpi kulānyaṭati, tasyā iha grahaṇam ||
caṭakāyā airak‌ || 4.1.128 ||
strīliṅganirdeśātpuṃlliṅgānna prasajyata ityāha---caṭakācceti vaktavyamiti | evaṃ ca puṃlliṅganirdeśa eva karttavyaḥ, liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgādapi bhaviṣyati, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva |
striyāmapatye lugvaktavya iti | caṭakāyā apatyamiti | caṭakasyāpīti draṣṭavyam | caṭaketi | `luktaddhitaluki' iti ṭāpo luki kṛte punarajādilakṣaṇaṣṭāp‌ kartavyaḥ ||
āragudīcām || 4.1.130 ||
rakā, siddhatvāditi | `na lakṣaṇena padākārā anuvartyāḥ' ityavagrahe'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ | jñāpakārthaṃ tviti | bhāvapradhāno jñāpakaśabdaḥ | jñāpanārthamiti vā pāṭhyam . jāḍāraḥ, pāṇḍāraiti | hrasvāntādayaṃ pratyaya iti rakā nāsti siddhiḥ ||
kṣudrābhyo vā || 4.1.131 ||
aṅgahīnā iti | kāṇādayaḥ | śīlahīnā iti | aniyatapuṃskādāsīprabhṛtayaḥ ||
ḍhaki lopaḥ || 4.1.133 ||
kathaṃ punarityādi | ḍhagvidhau ṭābādistrīpratyayāntānāṃ grahaṇācchubhrādiṣvasyāpāṭhāt‌ praśnaḥ | etadevetyādi | na hyasato nimittabhāvaḥ sambhati ||
mātṛṣvasuśca || 4.1.134 ||
pitṛṣvasurityetapekṣyate iti | cakāreṇānukṛṣyata ityarthaḥ | tadanuvṛttau yo'rthaḥ sampadyate, taṃ darśayati---pitṛṣvasuryaduktamiti | kiṃ punastadityāha---chaṇ‌ pratyayo ḍhaki lopaśceti | tena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati prati ṣedho vā' iti ḍhaki lopa eva prāpnoti, na tu chaṇiti na codanīyamiti bhāvaḥ ||
catuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ‌ || 4.1.135 ||
kamaṇḍaluśabdaścatuṣpādvacano'sti, dṛśyate hi---kamaṇḍalupada ādadhīteti | jambuḥ-śrṛgālaḥ ||
gṛṣṭyādibhyaśca || 4.1.136 ||
aṇādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena ḍhakaḥ | bahuvacanaṃ tu prakṛtibhedena tayoreva bahutvāt‌ tatrājabasti-mitrayuśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ, śeṣāṇām `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhakaḥ |
gṛṣṭiśabdo ya iti | sakṛtprasūtā strī sarveva gṛṣṭirna dhevnādiścatuṣpādeveti bhāvaḥ | apara āha---sakṛtprasūtatvasādharmyeṇācatuṣpadīṣvapi gauṇo gṛṣṭiśabda iti ||
rājaśvaśurādyat‌ || 4.1.137 ||
kṣattriyajātiścediti | prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena kṣattriyajātiśced‌ gamyetetyarthaḥ | rājanya iti | `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | rājano'nya iti | sa punarvaiśyāśūdrayorutpannaḥ, `an‌' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ ||
kṣattrāddhaḥ || 4.1.138 ||
ghapratyayo bhavatīti | ghaśabda eva, na taraptamapau; anyathā sarvatraiva pratyayavidhau gha iti taraptamaporgrahaṇātpratyayāderghakārasyeyādeśavacanamanupapannaṃ syāt‌, na ca `tugrāddhan', `ghacchau ca' iti ghanghacāvavakāśau, tatrāpi saṃjñāśabdaḥ sānubandha upāttaḥ | anubandhastu saṃjñyartha iti sambhavāt‌, `ṅamuṇnityam' itivat‌ | `kimidabhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' ityatrāpi taraptamaporevādeśatvaṃ vijñaāyate | ayamapi jātiśabda eveti | rājanyajātyabhidhāne gho bhavati, vaiśyāśūdrayorutpādite tu iñevetyarthaḥ ||
kulātkhaḥ || 4.1.139 ||
uttarasūtra ityādi | pūrvapadapratiṣedhasyaitatprayojanam---āḍhyakulādermābhūditi | grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādevāḍhyakulāderna bhaviṣyati, paśyati tvacāryaḥ---nāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kulaśabde pravartata iti | tenātra tāvattadantasya grahaṇam `yena vidhistadantasya' ityatra svarūpamityanuvṛtteḥ kevalasyāti grahaṇam | sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakam---`prātipadikaśrutimatī paribhāṣā kuśalaśabde na pravartate iti, tena `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityasyā apyapravṛttiḥ | kulīna iti uttarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātkevalādapyanena kho bhavati | praśasto vaṃśaḥ-kulam, tasyāpatyaṃ tatprabhavasyāpatyamityarthaḥ ||
apūrvapadādanyatarasyāṃ yaḍ‌ḍhakañau || 4.1.140 ||
nanu ca pūrvapadaśabdaḥ samāsāvayave rūḍhaḥ, na sya kulaśabde prasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---samāsasambandhina ityādi | samāsasambandhipūrvapadaṃ kulaśabdasyāpi kathañcitsambandhi bhavati, dvayorapyekasamāsāvayavatvāt‌ | vyavasthāvacanastu naivātra śaṅkanīyaḥ; pūrvapadasabhdasya samāsāvayave rūḍhatvāt‌ | tena `devadattaḥ kulīnaḥ' ityādau vākye pratiṣedhaśaṅkā na kāryā |
bahucpūrvādapīti | apūrvādityucyamāne bahukulaśabdo bahucā sapūrva iti, tataḥ pratyayo na syāt‌ | kiñca---devadattaḥ kulīna ityādāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌ | tasmādrūḍhiparigrahārthamapi padagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ||
vyansapatne || 4.1.145 ||
nanu ca `nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu' iti sapatnīśabda eva strīliṅgo vyutpāditaḥ, tatkathaṃ puṃlliṅgasya prayogastatrāha---sapatnaśabda ityādi | ivārtha iti | sādṛśye, yathā patnī duḥ khahetustathā śattrurapītyetatsādṛśyam | samudāyena cediti | etena samudāyārthaḥ sapatno na prakṛtyarthaḥ, nāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam, anarthakāvevātra prakṛtipratyayāviti darśayati | athānuvṛttasyāpatyasya viśeṣaṇameva sapatnaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha---apatyārtho'tra nāstyeveti | etadevodāharaṇena spaṣṭayati---pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇeti | na hi pāpmā bhrātuṣputro bhavati, ataḥ sapatnamātre bhrātṛvyaśabdasya darśanādapatyārtho'tra nāsti | kiñca, yo'pi sapatno bhrāturapatyaṃ sambhavati, so'pyādyudāttād‌ bhrātṛvyaśabdātsapatnarūpeṇaiva pratīyate, nāpatyarūpeṇa | tathā ca bhrātṛvyo bhrātṛvya iti sahaprayogo'pi vyanvyadantayorbhavati, ataḥ suṣṭhūktam---`apatyārtho nāstyeva' iti ||
revatyādibhyaṣṭhak‌ || 4.1.146 ||
ḍhagādīnāmapavāda iti | tatra revatīśabdo ṅīṣantaḥ, aśva, maṇi, dvāraśabdopapadātpālayateḥ karmaṇyaṇi ṅīp‌, teṣu ḍhakprāptaḥ | `vañcu pralambhane', asmād‌vṛkopapadāt‌ `karttaryupamāne' iti ṇiniḥ, asmādaṇprāptaḥ vṛkakarṇadaṇḍopapadād‌ graheḥ `karmaṇyaṇ‌', kukkuṭasyevākṣiṇī yasya sa kukkuṭākṣaḥ, eṣviñ‌ prāptaḥ ||
gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca || 4.1.147 ||
pāribhāṣikasya gotrasya grahaṇamityāha---apatyaṃ pautreti | laukikasya tvapatyamātrasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi syāt‌ `tatstriyāḥ' ityeva brūyāt‌, tacchabdena prakṛtasyāpatyasya parāmarśādeva tadarthalābhāt‌ | gārga iti | gārgīśabdo `yañaśca' iti ṅībantaḥ, tasya `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena puṃśabdasyātideśāt‌gārgyaśabdādgotrastryabhidhāyinaḥ pratyayaḥ, `yasyeti ca', `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' ityallopayalaupau | glaucukāyana iti | glucukasyāpatyam `prācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam' iti phin‌, `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣ‌, tasya puṃvadbhāvena nivṛttiḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ, ṇasya ṇitkaṇabhatra vṛddhyartham, gārgyādau prakṛtereva vṛddhatvāt‌ | iha tu vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strī, `vataṇḍācca luk‌ striyāṃm' vataṇḍī, tasyā apatyaṃ vātaṇḍo jālma iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīni nivṛtte `luk‌' striyām' ityasya `gotre'lugaci' iti pratiṣedhādvātaṇḍyaśabdādeva pratyayaḥ | iha ca gārgyā apatyaṃ strī gārgā, sā bhāryā yasya sa gārgābhārya iti `jāteśca' ityeva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhasiddhiḥ, `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' ityapatyamātraṃ gṛhyate, tena vṛddhinimittasya ceti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na prayojanam | kiñca---gārgyā apatyaṃ strītyatrārthe nāsti pratyayaḥ, `astriyām' iti yuvasaṃjñāyā niṣedhādgotrasaṃjñaivāvatiṣṭhate, tatra `eko gotre' iti niyamānnaiva gotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayaḥ sambhavati, tena nāsti gārgā, natarāṃ gārgābhāryaḥ |
apara āha---asti gārgā, katham ? gārgyā apatyaṃ yā strī na sā yuvatirnāpi gotram; na hi sā gargasyāpatyaṃ pautraprabhṛteścāpatyasya sotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tadabhāvād‌ `eto gotre' iti niyamābhāvaḥ, tataśca ṇasya bhāvādasti gārgeti |
ye tu nāsti gārgetyāhuḥ, tena manyante---mātṛvaṃśaḥ pitṛvaṃśaśca dvāvapi vaṃśau pratīyamapatyaṃ bhavati; apātahetutvāt‌ | tataśca gārgyā apatyaṃ yatra strī sā gargasyā patyaṃ bhavatyeva, `pautraprabhṛtigrahaṇaṃ ca vyavahitāpatyopalakṣaṇ, tena gargāpekṣayā tasyā gotratvād‌ `eko gotre' iti niyamātpratyayāntarābhāva iti | vṛttau tu kvacitpaṭhyate---gotrādyūnīti yūni pratyayo bhavatīti | tadapyasminneva pakṣe ghaṭate, tadāha---gārgyā apatyaṃ pumānyuvā bhavati gārgeyo māṇavaka iti | mātāmahāderupalakṣaṇārtho'yaṃ prayoga iti nāsti kutsā ||
vṛddhāṭṭhak‌ sauvīreṣu bahulam || 4.1.148 ||
atra `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' iti vṛddhaṃ gṛhyate, na tvapatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti śāstrāntaraparibhāṣitam | uttarasūtre hi vakṣyati---phiño grahaṇaṃ na phinaḥ, vṛddhādhikārāditi | sauvīreṣviti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | `gotrastriyāḥ' ityato gotragrahaṇānuvṛttergotrapratyayāntā yā prakṛtistasyā viśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ | vṛddhātsauvīragotrāditi | idamapi pāribhāṣikasyaiva vṛddhasya grahaṇe ghaṭate, anyathā sauvīreṣu yad‌vṛddhaṃ tasmāditi vaktavyam | bhāgavittāyana iti | `yañiñośca' iti phak‌ | tṛṇabindorapatyamiti autsargiko'ṇ‌tārṇabindavaḥ, tataṣṭhak‌ | pūrvaṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi punariha grahaṇam |
bhāgapūrvapadau vittiriti | vittyanta ityarthaḥ | bhāgavittiśabda iti yāvat‌ | gotrāṭ‌ṭhagbahulaṃ tata iti | `gotrastriyāḥ' ityato gotragrahaṇānuvṛttyā gotravacanātprātipadikādvahulaṃ yaṣṭhagucyate sa tatastebhya eva bhāgavittiprabhṛtibhyastribhya eva bhavati, nānyebhya iti parigaṇanaślokārthaḥ |
nanu gotragrahaṇamanuvarttate, yacca sauvīrasagotravṛttiprātipadikaṃ tadvṛddhameva, tatkimarthaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam ? ata āha---vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ strīnivṛtyarthamiti | taddhi gotragrahaṇaṃ striyā viśeṣaṇam, atastadanuvṛttau strīgrahaṇamapyanuvartteta, vṛddhagrahaṇasāmarthyāttu gotragrahaṇamevānuvartate, na strīgrahaṇamiti vyācakṣate | apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamityasya tu vṛddhasya grahaṇe'samañjaso'yaṃ granthaḥ syāt‌ | aupagaviriti |
nanu ca parigaṇanādevātra na bhaviṣyati ? tanna; na hi sūtrakāro'rvācīnaparigaṇanāśrayeṇātiprasaṅganivāraṇaṃ manyate, vāgrahaṇa eva karttavye yadvahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya prayojanamāha---bahulagrahaṇamityādi | vaicitryameva darśayati---gotrastriyā ityārabhyeti | tatrāntyaḥ sauvīragotra eveti | ayamevārtho yatnasādhyaḥ ||
pheścha ca || 4.1.149 ||
yamundaścetyādi | atra vārṣyāyaṇīti śabdarūpāpekṣāyā napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ | phiña iti | phiñantā ityarthaḥ | smṛtā iti | ete trayaḥ phiñantāḥ prakṛtayaḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ | sauvīreṣu ca kutsāyāmiti | punaścakāro vṛttabhaṅgabhayānna paṭhitaḥ | bahulagrahaṇātsiddho'yamarthaḥ pūrvaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitaḥ, idānīṃ tu ślokavārttikakāreṇetyapaunaruktyam | suyāmaśabdo'pi tikādiḥ | vṛṣasyāpatyaṃ vārṣyāyaṇiḥ | ayamapi tikādireva, `dagukosalakarmāracchāgavṛṣāṇāṃ yuḍ‌ vādiṣṭasya' iti vacanād‌ āyanādeśe kṛte yuḍāgamaḥ ||
phāṇṭāhṛtimimatābhyāṃ ṇaphiñau || 4.1.150 ||
tena yathāsaṃkhyāmiha na bhavatīti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṇasya ṇitkaraṇamarthavadbhavati, taddhi mimataśabde vṛddhyartham | yathāsaṃkhye tu phāṇṭāhṛtervṛddhatvāṇiṇatkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ | iha tu phāṇṭāhṛtābhārya iti gārgābhārya itivatpuṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhādikaṃ draṣṭavyam | yathā tu vārttikaṃ tathā yathāsaṃkhyamatreṣyate, yathāha---`phāṇṭāhṛterṇasya ṇitkaraṇānarvasyaṃ vṛddhatvāt‌', `prātipadikasya puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhāryaṃ tu', `uktaṃ vā' iti ||
kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ || 4.1.151 ||
nanu ca `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' ityeva kuruśabdāṇṇayaḥ siddhaḥ, kimarthamiha paṭhyate ? ata āha---kuruśabdādaparo'pīti | satyamaparo'pi ṇyapratyayo bhaviṣyati | sa tu trattriyādityanenārthabhedamāha | tadrājasaṃjñaka ityajena rūpabhedamāha | tikādiṣu pāṭhāditi | kurukauravyaśabdau dvāvapi paṭhyete |
kāriṇastu rathakāraśabdāditi | kāriṇaḥ-śilpinaḥ | rathakārajātistu śilpivṛttirna bhavatīti manyate |
tasya puṃvadbhāvo na bhavatīti | `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti vidhīyamānaḥ, yadi hi syāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ syāt‌ | kasmānna bhavatītyāha---strīpratyayanirdeśasāmarthyāditi | puṃliṅgasyāpi pāṭhe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā keśinīśabdādapi siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, puṃlliṅgāttvanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ |
vāmarathasya kaṇvādivatsvaravarjamiti gaṇavākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe---vāmarathaśabda ityādi | tasyeti prakaraṇāṇṇyapratyayāntasyeti vijñeyam | kaṇvādibaditi | kevalānāṃ teṣāṃ kasyacitkāryasyāvidhānādyañantānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ yatkāryaṃ tasyātideśaḥ | lugādikamiti | kaṇvādiṣu yañanteṣu dṛṣṭamātrasya kāryasyātideśaḥ, na tu kaṇvāditvapratyuktasya, ata eva svaravarjamityāha | tena lugādikamapyatidiśyate, na tu `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityeva pratyayavidhiḥ | vāmarathā iti | `yañañośca' iti bahuṣu luk‌ | yañaśca `prācāṃṣpha taddhitaḥ', yūni `yañiñośca' iti phak; śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu che prāpte `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣu' iti cāṇ‌ bhavati | samrājaḥ kṣattriya iti | samrājo'patyaṃ sāmrājyo bhavati, kṣattriyaścet‌; sāmrājo'nyaḥ ||
senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca || 4.1.152 ||
lakṣaṇeti svarūpagrahaṇamityāha---lakṣaṇaśabdāditi | kārītyarthagrahaṇamityāha---kārivacanebhyaśceti | sādhu kurvantīti kāriṇaḥ-śilpinaḥ | nāpitya iti | prācāṃ mate ṇya udāhṛtaḥ | udīcāṃ tu mate paratvād‌ `udīcāṃ vṛddhāt‌' iti phiñeva bhavati---nāpitāyaniriti ||
udīcāmiñ‌ || 4.1.153 ||
tākṣṇa iti | `ṣapūrvahandhaṛtarājñāmaṇi' ityallopaḥ | tākṣaṇya iti | `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | iha `senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyo vā' iti vaktavyam, nārtho'neneñvacanena, nāpi śivādiṣu takṣanśabdasya pāṭhena, ṇye hi vikalpite yo yataḥ prāpnoti satato bhavatīti lakṣṇaḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌', anyebhyaśca `ata iñ‌' bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi jātasenādibhya ṛṣyādilakṣaṇo'ṇ‌ prāpnoti ||
tikādibhyaḥ phiñ‌ || 4.1.154 ||
kṣattriyavacana iti | yaḥ `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' iti vyutpāditaḥ | auraśaśabdeneti | urasā śete uraśaḥ kṣatriyaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvādrūpam, tasyāpatyam `janapadaśabdātkṣatriyāt' ityañ‌ |
kiṃ punarevaṃ prayatnena kṣattriyavacanasya grahaṇaṃ vyākhyāyate ? ityatrāha---tathā ceti | udāhṛtamiti | pūrvairapi vṛttikārairityarthaḥ |
tiknoterigupadhātkaḥ, tikaḥ | kiṃ tavāstīti pravarttate kitavaḥ, pṛṣodarādiḥ | sampūrvājjānāteḥ `ātaścopasarge' iti kaḥ, striyāṃ ṭāp‌, saṃjñā | bālairbaddhā śikhāsya sa bālaśikhaḥ | dvau śabdāvityanye, balaterṇijantādac‌ bālaḥ, tasya bālāyaniḥ | śikhāśabdena tadvān‌ lakṣyate, śaikhāyaniḥ | uraśaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ | `śaṭakutsāyām' pacādyac‌, tato gargāditvādyañ‌---śāṭyaḥ; tato yūni phiñ‌ | sindhuśabdād‌ `dvyañmagadha' ityaṇ‌, saindhavaḥ, atrāpi yūni phiñ‌ | yamamunattītiyamundaḥ, śakandhvādi | praśastaṃ rūpamasyāsti `rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap‌', rūpyaḥ | grāme bhavo grāmyaḥ | nīla varṇe, igupadhātkaḥ nīlaḥ | `am‌ roge', auṇaādika itraḥ, amitraḥ | gaukākṣyo gargādiyañantaḥ | `kṛgroruḥ', kuruḥ | devasyeva ratho'sya devarathaḥ | tiletilaḥ, titilaḥ, pṛṣodarādiḥ, tato matvarthīya in‌, titilino'patyamautsargiko'ṇ‌, `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ, taitilaḥ | auraśaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ | `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ', kauravyaḥ | bhūri asyāsti bhūriko vrīhyādiḥ, tasyaiva pakṣe kapilāditvāllatvaṃ bhūlikaḥ, tābhyāmata iñ‌, bhaurikiḥ, bhaulikiḥ | `cupa mandāyāṃ gatau' ṇyantāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ caupayataḥ, evaṃ caitayataḥ | `ciṭa parapreṣye', ṇyantāllaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ caiṭayataḥ | `śīkṛ secane', ṇijādi pūrvavat‌, śaikayataḥ | kṣitamācaṣṭe kṣitayan‌, tasyāpatyaṃ kṣaitayataḥ | dhvajo'syāsti dhvajavān‌, tasyāpatyaṃ dhvājavataḥ | dvau śabdāvityanye, `dhvaja gatau' ṇyantātpacādyac‌, dhvājaḥ; vanotestaḥṣa vataḥ | `cadi āhlādane', tato ramas‌ candramāḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ cāndramasāyanirbudhaḥ | śobhate'sau śubhaḥ, igupadhātkaḥ | gamergan‌, gaṅgā | vṛña eṇyaḥ, vareṇyaḥ | sarvadhātubhyo manin‌, yānaṃ yāmā, śobhanaṃ yāmāsya suyām | ārado nāma janapadaḥ, tato'patye `janapadaśabdāt‌' ityañ‌---āradaḥ | vahyaṃ karaṇam, vahyameva vahyakā, nipātanāditvābhāvaḥ | khalāya hitā khalyā, `khalayava' iti yat‌ | `vṛṣu secane' igupadhātkaḥ---vṛṣaḥ | lomāni kāmayati lomakā | udakamicchatyātmana udanyaḥ, `aśanāyodanyadhanāya' ityudakasyodanbhāvaḥ, tataḥ pacādyac‌ | yajñayogādyajñaḥ | ete tikādayaḥ ||
kausalyakārmāryābhyāṃ ca || 4.1.155 ||
kosalaśabdād‌ `vṛddhetkosalājādāñ‌ ñyaṅ‌', karmāraśabdātkārilakṣaṇo ṇyaḥ, etayoriha grahaṇamiti śaṅkāmapākaroti---paramaprakṛtereveti | kathaṃ tarhi vikṛtaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ śrūyate ? tatrāha---pratyayasaṃyogena tviti | na ceyaṃ svamanīṣiketyāha---tathā ceti | yuḍ‌vādiṣṭasyeti | pūrvāntakaraṇe dāṃgavyāyaniḥ, orguṇo na syāt‌, ataḥ parādikaraṇam | ādiṣṭesyeti | kṛtāyanādeśasyetyarthaḥ | etasminnanucyamāne'navakāśatvādyuṭi kṛte'nāditvādāyanādeśo na syāt‌ ||
aṇo dvayacaḥ || 4.1.156 ||
kārtrāyaṇiriti | karturapatyamityaṇ‌, kārtraḥ, tato yūni phiñ‌, tasyābrāhmaṇagotrāditi lugna bhavati, vidhānasāmarthyāt‌ | apara āha--- kartuśchāttraḥ kārtraḥ, `tasyāpatyam' ityādāvagotre caritrthaṃ vacanamiti | apara āha---apatyagrahaṇamāvartate, tatraikenāṇ‌ viśeṣyate, apareṇa pratyayārtho nidiśyate, tataścāpatyasyaivāṇo grahaṇādastyeva vacanasāmarthyamiti ||
udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt‌ || 4.1.157 ||
kāriśabdādapīti | kārilakṣaṇasyodīcāmiño'vakāśaḥ---tāntuvāyiḥ, phiño'vakāśaḥ---āmraguptāyaniḥ; nāpitādubhayaprasaṅge phiñ‌ bhavati | yājñadatiriti | `vā nāmadeyasya vṛddhasaṃjñā vaktavyā' | pakṣe yājñadattāyaniriti bhavatyeva ||
vākinādīnāṃ kuk‌ ca || 4.1.158 ||
yadiha vṛddhagotramiti | vākina-gāredha-kāka--ityete trayaḥ | vacanaṃ vākaḥ so'syāsti vākinaḥ, barhiṇavadupapādyaḥ | agāre edhate gāredhaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvādādilopaḥ, śakandhvāditvātpararūpam | kāyateḥ kākaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi' iti kaḥ | karkaṭasyāpatyaṃ kārkaṭyaḥ, gargādiḥ, kurvādirvā | `laṃghayaterlaṅkā, asmādeva nipātanād‌ ghasya kādeśaḥ | varmacarmaśabdau vrīhyādī |
iñādyapavāda iti | varmicarmiṇoraṇ‌ prāptaḥ, laṅkāśabdāt‌ `dvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak‌ prāptaḥ, yañantād‌ `yañiñośca' iti phak‌; seṣabhya iñ‌ prāptaḥ, `varmicarmiṇornalopaśca' iti kuki kṛte prātipadikasyānakārāntatvānnalopo na prāpnotīti vidhīyate | yadi punarayaṃ kuk parādiḥ kriyate, āyanādeśo na syāt‌; phasyānāditvāt‌ | yadā na liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā varmiṇī-carmiṇīśabdābhyāṃ pratyayo bhavati, tadā `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvo na syāt‌ ||
putrāntādanyatarasyām || 4.1.159 ||
pūrveṇaaiva pratyayaḥ siddha iti | tenāsāviha vidhīyate | kathaṃ tarhi pañcamyā nirdeśa ityāha---putrāntādityādi ||
prācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam || 4.1.160 ||
vikalpārthā iti | vikalpaprayojanam | tatrā''cāryopādānaṃ matāntare pratyayasyābhāvaṃ dyotayati, bahulagrahaṇaṃ tu kvacitpravṛttyādikam, anyatarasyāṃśabdastu vikalpameva, teṣāmekenaiva siddhyatīti prakaraṇādvikalpa iti gamyate | kimarthaṃ tarhi sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam ? tatrāha---tatreti | bahulagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārthamiti | pāriśeṣyādanyasya grahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktaṃ bhavati | vaicitryameva darśayati---kvaciditi ||
manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca || 4.1.161 ||
tathā ceti | apatyārthe tu sati `yañañośca' iti bahuṣu luk‌ prasajyeta; laukikasya gotrasya tatra grahaṇāt‌ |
apatye kutsita iti | ṇatvavidhānārthamidam, aṇaḥ siddhatvāt‌ | na ca `na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu' iti ṇatvasiddhiḥ, arthaviśeṣasyāniścāyād‌ | anadhītavedatvānmūḍhatvam | vihitākaraṇātpratiṣiddhasevanācca kutsitatvam ||
apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram || 4.1.162 ||
tad‌gotrasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti | apatyamātrasya loke gotratvādapatyaviśeṣe gotraśabdasya niyamātparibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā, na saṃjñeti cet‌ ? na; liṅgavatī paribhāṣā bhavati, yathā---`iko guṇavṛddhī' iti, vidhyantaraśeṣabhūtā vā, yathā---`vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam' iti, na ceyaṃ tathā; kiñca vṛddhyādayo'pi sarvārthapratyāyanayogyāḥ saṃjñiviśeṣe śaktyavacchedena niyamyante | atha ca tāḥ saṃjñāstatheyamapi bhaviṣyati | uktaṃ ca---
vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñānāṃ saṃjñini kvacit‌ |
nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat‌ ||
vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smin‌ śaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ |
akṛtrimo hi sambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat‌ || iti |
yadi pautraprabhṛterapatyasya gotrasaṃjñā kriyate, gargasyāpi prāpnoti, so'pi kañcitprati pautro bhavatyeva, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? `gotrādyūnyastriyām' iti yūni pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, gārgyādeva tu yūnīṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ihāpatyagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, pautrasyāpatyatvāttatprabhṛterapatyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ siddham, tat kriyate---apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsāmānasya yathā syāt‌, vastuto'patyasya mā bhūdityevamartham | ato'patyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya gargasya na bhaviṣyati | nanu cāsatyapyapatyagrahaṇe pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñāyā vijñānāttena rūpeṇāpratibhāsamānasya margasya na bhaviṣyatīti kimapatyagrahaṇena ! yadyevam, aupagavasyāpi na syāt‌, so'pi hyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsate, na tu pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa, apatyamātre pratyayavidhānād‌ gārgyādereva tu syād‌---yatra gotra eva pratyayaḥ | kutaścāyamartho labhyate---pautraprabhṛtirūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasyeti ? tad‌grahaṇasāmarthyāditi cet‌, sarvasyāpi yatkiñcitprativastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtitvāvyabhicārāt‌ pautraprabhṛtigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati | tad‌grahaṇasāmarthyādayamartho labhyata iti ? tanna; saṃjñinirdeśārthatvādacetanavyāvṛttyarthatvācca | `gotram' ityetāvati hyukte kasya saṃjñā syāt‌, rathādīnāṃ ca vastuto'pi pautraprabhṛtitvaṃ nāsti | ato vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtergargasya mā bhūt‌, apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ tvapatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | sambandhiśabdatvācca pautraprabhṛtyapatyaśabdayoryaṃ prati pautraprabhṛtitvamapatyatvaṃ ca tameva prati gotrasaṃjñā vijñāyate | tenāṅgirasaḥ pautre gargasyānantare na bhavati `gargādibhyo yañ‌' | tadetatsarvamuktam |
sambandhiśabdatvādityādi | yasya yadapatyamiti | pratibhāsata iti bhāvaḥ | tadayamatra sūtrārthaḥ---vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtirapatyarūpeṇaṃ pratibhāsamāno'rtho yaṃ pratyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsate yaṃ ca prati vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtiḥ, taṃ prati gotrasaṃjña iti |
apatyamiti vyapadeśāyeti | saṃjñina iti śeṣaḥ | apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñino vyapadeśo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati---gargāpatyasya tṛtīyāderapatyamiti, atra hi gargāpatyaśabdena gargaṃ pratyapatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya vastutaḥ pautraprabhṛtergargaṃ prati gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ gargasya caturthe jīvadvaṃśye `gotrādyūni' iti gargāpatyaśabdātpratyayaḥ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāprakaraṇa evāsminkartavye'patyapratyayeṣu vidhīyamāneṣu madhye saṃjñākaraṇaṃ pratyayavācyasyāpatyasya parigrahārtham | yadidaṃ `tasyāpatyam' ityārabhya pratyayārthatvena nirdiṣṭamapatyaṃ tadgotrasaṃjñamiti, tenāpatyaśabdena pratibhāsamānasyāpatyasya saṃjñā na bhaviṣyati | nanu ca `te tadrājāḥ' ityatra tacchabdenājādīnāmeva parigraho yathā syātpūrveṣāṃ mā bhūditi madhye saṃjñākaraṇaṃ syāt‌ | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syād‌, `añādayastadrājāḥ' ityeva brūyāt‌, tasmāduktameva sākṣātprayojanamasmin‌ prakaraṇe saṃjñākaraṇasya | sthite tvevamuktamapi prayojanaṃ bhavatyeva, ata eva tatra vakṣyati---gotrayuvasaṃjñā kāṇḍena vyavahitatvāditi ||
jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā || 4.1.163 ||
abhijanaprabandho vaṃśa iti | abhijanāḥ-pitrādayaḥ, abhijāyante yebhyaḥ putrādaya iti kṛtvā | prabandhaḥ-santānaḥ | tatra bhavo vaṃśya iti | digāditvādyat‌ | pautraprabhṛtyapatyamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yadyatrāpi pūrvavat‌ `pautraprabhṛti' ityetatsāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyaṃ viśeṣayet‌, tṛtīyasyāpi jīvadvaṃśyasya yuvasaṃjñā syāt‌; tatra ko doṣaḥ ? yuvasaṃjñayā gotrasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvādgargādibhyo yañ‌ syāt‌, na kaścidapatyapratyayaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam ? gotrādeva yūnīti niyamāt‌, nānantarānna mūlaprakṛteḥ | tasmādvākyenaivābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti---gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgerapatyamiti | etenopagostṛtīyo jīvadvaṃśyo vyākhyātaḥ, tasmādvaiyadhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇamityāha---pautraprabhṛtīti | ṣaṣṭhī vipariṇamya iti | atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam |
tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārtha iti | anekārthatvānnipātānāṃ bhinnakramo yuvaśabdānantaraṃ draṣṭavya ityāha---yuvaiva bhavati, na gotramiti | asatyavadhāraṇe ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra saṃjñāyāṃ samāveśābhyupagamātkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānāmiva gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt‌ | astu, ko doṣaḥ ? yaskasyāpatyaṃ gotram `śivādibhyo'ṇ‌' tadantādyūni `aṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ‌, vṛddhau, yasyeti lope kṛte yāskāyaniriti | bahuṣu `yaskādibhyo gotre' iti phiño luk‌ prasajyeta; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌ | yaskādibhyo'nantarasya gotrapratyayastha lugucyate, na cātrānantaraḥ phiñ‌ | śivādyaṇo yasyeti lopaḥ, tasya pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvādyaskādibhyo'nantarasya vihitasyeti vā vijñāsyate | iha ca kaṇvasyāpatyaṃ kāṇvyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ yuvā kāṇvyāyanaḥ, tasyacchāttrāḥ kāṇvāyanīyā iti, `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ‌ na bhavati, kaṇvādibhyaḥ paro yo'nantaro yo vā tebhyo gotre vihitastadantādityāśrayaṇāt‌ | iha ca aupagavasyāpatyamaupagaviriti `gotrādyūni' iti pratipadavidhānāt‌, `eko gotre' iti niyamo bādhiṣyate | yadi bādhyate, aupagaveryūno'patyamiti caturthasya yūno gotratvātpañcame yūni phak‌ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pañcame yūni vivakṣite utpannasyeñaḥ yūni `luk‌' iti luki kṛte aupagavaśabdādaṇantātpunarapīñeva bhaviṣyati | iha tarhi dākṣerapatyaṃ dākṣāyaṇasyāpatyamityarthavivakṣāyām `phakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti phako lugabhāvapakṣe tadantādiñ‌ prāpnoti ? kiñca aupagaverapatyamityatrāpi lupte'pīñi pratyayalakṣaṇena phakprāpnoti ? evaṃ tarhi `gotrādyūni' ityatra ekagrahaṇanuvartiṣyate, tenānekaḥ pratyayo na bhaviṣyati | yastarhi `gotre'lugaci' ityulak‌ so'ttrīṇāṃ yūnāṃ chāttra ityādau prāpnoti, yūno'pi gotratvāt‌ ? prāpnotu, taṃ bādhitvā paratvādyūni lugbhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam, phakphiñorhi doṣaḥ syāt‌---śālaṅkerapatyaṃ śālaṅkiḥ, pailādiṣu pāṭhādiñ‌ śalaṅkādeśaśca, tataḥ śālaṅkerapatyaṃ yuvā `yañiñośca' iti phak‌, `pailādibhyaśca' iti luk‌, tataḥ śālaṅkeryūnaśchāttrā iti prāgdīvyatīyārthavivakṣāyām `gotre'lugaci' iti pailādiṣu lukaḥ pratiṣedhe sati `yūniluk‌' iti luki nitye prāpte `phakphiñoranyatarasyām' iti pakṣe phakaḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | asatyāṃ tu yūno gotrasaṃjñāyām `gotre'lugaci' ityasyāpravṛttau pailādiṣu lugbhavatyeva | `phakphiñoranyatarasyām' ityayaṃ tu vikalpoḥ yūni `luk‌' ityasyānantarasya, na tu pailādiṣu luko vyavahitasyāntaraṅgasya, tata `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌---śālaṅkā iti bhavati | tathā pīlāyā apatyam, `pīlāyā vā' ityāṇ‌, pailaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ yuvā, `aṇo dvyacaḥ' iti phiñ‌, tasya `pailādibhyaśca' iti luk‌, tataḥ pailasya yūnaśchāttrāḥ pailīyā iti ||
bhrātari ca jyāyasi || 4.1.164 ||
kanīyān‌ bhrāteti | bhrātṛjyāyaḥ---śabdayoḥ sambandhiśabdatvādayamartho labhyate | akāraṇatvāditi | yaḥ sākṣātparamparayā vā kāraṇaṃ bhavati, sa loke `vaṃśya' ityucyate | gārgye jīvatīti | jyāyasi bhrātari jīvatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ vātsyāyanādāvapi draṣṭavyam ||
vānyasmin‌ sapiṇḍe sthaviratare jīvati || 4.1.165 ||
saptamapuruṣāvadhaya iti | ātmanaḥ prabhṛti pitrādiṣu putrādiṣu vā gaṇyamāneṣu saptamapuruṣo'vadhiryeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | prāyeṇa tu pūraṇapratyayo na paṭhyate, saptapuruṣāvadhaya ityeva paṭhyate, na tatra samīcīnamarthaṃ paśyāmaḥ | samānaḥ piṇḍo yeṣāmiti sapiṇḍāḥ, nipātanātsabhāvaḥ | smaryanta iti | tadyathā---`sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivarttate' iti | saptame'tīte vinivartata ityarthaḥ | ubhayatreti | janena maraṇe cetyarthaḥ |
evamādikāyāṃ kriyāyāmiti | ādiśabdena `dānaṃ pratigraho homaḥ svādhyāyaśca nivartate' ityādikā kriyā gṛhyate | jīvadeveti | vastuvyākhyānametat | sūtre tu jīvatītyākhyātapadam, taccedapatyaṃ jīvatīti, prathamārthe vā śatrantātsaptamī vyākhyeyā | tarabnirdeśa ityādi | asati tasminsthaviraśabdādvayaḥ prakarṣamātraṃ gamyeta, tarapā tu sthānaprakarṣo dyotyate, tatastadu pādānasāmarthyāt‌, yathā gotaraḥ, aśvatara ityādāvapravṛttinimittabhūtasyāpi vāhadohādeḥ prakṛtyarthasambandhinaḥ prakarṣetarab‌ bhavati, tathātrāpi | sthānam-padam, pitṛtvādikam |
sthānavayonyūne iti | sthānena vayasā ca nyūne ityarthaḥ | nanu ca jyāyasītyanuvṛtterevobhayoḥ prakarṣo labhyate, `praśasyasya śraḥ', `jya ca', `vṛddhasya ca' ityubhayorjyādeśavidhānāt‌ ? tanna; nahi sakṛtprayuktaḥ śabdo'nekārthamabhidhātuṃ samartaḥ | evamapi tarabnirdeśo na kartavyaḥ, jyāyasītyanuvṛttereva sthānaprakarṣalābhāt‌ ? etadapi nāsti; sthavira iti viśeṣaṇāntaropādāne sati jyāyasītyasyanuvṛttereva durjñānatvāt‌ | jīvatīti kimiti | śrutaṃ prakṛtaṃ cobhayamadhikṛtya praśnaḥ | ata evobhayoḥ prayojanaṃ darśayati---mṛte mṛto veti | tatra mṛta iti svapitari, mṛto veti pautraprabhṛterapatyabhūto'rtaḥ ||
vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām || 4.1.166 ||
apatyamantarhitamityādi | etaccāpatyagrahaṇena vṛddhasya viśeṣaṇād‌ iha paribhāṣitasya ca śabdātmakasyāpatyatvāsambhavāt‌ vijñāyate | pūjāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti | kā punaratra pūjā ? yadyuvatvameva | yadyapi yuvaśabdo'napekṣitapravṛttinimittameva saṃjñā, tathāpi prāyeṇālpavayaso jīvadvaṃśyatvaṃ sambhavatīti tadadhyārope sati tatsahacaritaṃ vayo'pi pratyāyitaṃ bhavatīti pūjā bhavati | saṃjñāsāmarthyāditi | gotrasya sato yuvasaṃjñā vidhīyate, gotrasaṃjñā cetpravṛttā `eko gotre' iti niyamaḥ prāpnoti, tataśca paramaprakṛterevotpannena pratyayenābhihitatvādaprāpto'pi pratyayo'smādvacanādbhavatītyarthaḥ | iha pūrvatra sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃjñāvidhānātprakramābhedāya tathaiva saṃjñā vidhātuṃ yuktā, ko'yaṃ vṛddhasyeti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ ityatrāha---vṛddhasyeti | ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa iti | itikaraṇo hetau, vāttiṃkakārīyaṃ cedaṃ sūtram | vṛttikāreṇa tu sūtreṣu prakṣiptam | etenottarasūtraṃ vyākhyātam ||
yūnaśca kutsāyām || 4.1.167 ||
nivṛttipradhāno vikalpa iti | na punaḥ pravṛttipradhāna iti; pūrvameva pravṛttatvāt‌ | yadāha---yūnaśceti | na hyapravṛttāyāṃ tasyāmeṣa nirdeśa upapadyate | nanu ca nivṛttirapyanirvṛttā yā na śakyate kartum, yo hi bhuktavantaṃ brūyānmā bhuṅ‌kthā iti kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt‌ | tasmād‌ `yūnaśca' iti nirdeśo yuvasaṃjñāviṣayo la7ṇārthaḥ | jīvadvaṃśyasya caturthāderiti, na tu yuvasaṃjñāśiṣṭasya nirdeśa iti vaktavyam | evaṃ ca pravṛttivikalpo'pyupapadyate, sā ta pravṛttirasatyapi sūtre labhyata iti matvā nivṛttipradhāna ityuktam | yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāmiti | tasyā abhāvapakṣa ityarthaḥ | gārgyo jālma iti | kā punaratra kutsā ? gotratvāropiṇāmeva, ajīvadvaṃśyā hi gotrasaṃjñakāḥ, te prāyeṇa caramavayaso bhavantīti tadārope bhavati kutsā ||
janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ‌ || 4.1.168 ||
janapadaśabdoyaḥ kṣattriyavācīti | nanvete pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṣattriyaśabdā eva, tatsambandhāttu `tasya nivāsaḥ' iti taddhite kṛte `janapade lup‌' iti ca lupi janapade vartante, tatkathamavarakālayā janapadaśabdatayā nityakṣattriyaśabdatā lakṣyate ? kaḥ punarāha---kṣattriyasambandhādeva te janapade vartanta iti, sūtrakārastāvat‌ `lubyogāprakhyānāt' iti vadan‌ kṣattriyeṣviva janapade'pi svābhāvikā pañcālādiśabdasya pravṛttirityāha---pāñcāla iti | yadapi pañcālādayaḥ śabdā janapade bahuvacanāntāḥ, kṣattriye tvekavacanāntāḥ, tathāpi prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇaṃ janapadatvam, na subantasyetyekavacanāntādapi pratyayo bhavatyeva | aikṣvāka iti | ikṣvākuśabdasya dāṇḍināyanādisūtre ṭilopo nipātitaḥ |
drauhyava iti | kṣattriyavacana evāyaṃ na janapadaśabdaḥ | brāhmaṇasya pañcālasyeti | bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣu yeṣāṃ darśanamityuktatvātkathamatra prasaṅga iti cintyam |
kṣattriyasamānaśabdāditi | samānaḥ śabdo yasya yamānaśabdaḥ, kṣattriyeṇa yasya samānaśabdastasmājjanapadaśabdāt‌ tasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādrājanyabhidheye'patyavatpratyayo bhavati | avṛddhādapīti prāptasya vuño'pavādaḥ | kvacitu vṛttāvevāya granthaḥ paṭhyate | māgadha iti | `dvyañmagadha' ityaṇ‌ ||
vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ‌ || 4.1.171 ||
ḍyaṇvaktavya iti | ḍakāraṣṭiloṣārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhinimittasyeti puṃvadbhāva pratiṣedhārthaḥ | anyasmāditi | guṇavacanādyudhiṣṭhirapitṛvacanācca | purīraṇvaktavyaḥ paurava iti kvacitpaṭhyate, tatra puruśabdasyājanapadaśabdatvātprāgdīvyatīye'ṇi siddhe tadrājasaṃjñārthaṃ vacanam | janapadavācitve `dvyañmagadha' ityeva siddham ||
kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ || 4.1.172 ||
ādiśabdo nakāreṇaiva sambadhyate, na kuruśabdena; tadāderjanapadasyābhāvāt‌, tadāha---kuruśabdānnakārādibhyaśceti | amañorapavāda iti | kuruśabdād‌ `dvyañmagadha' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ, nādibhyastvañaḥ | naiṣadhya iti | kathaṃ `naiṣadho'rhati cedagham' iti ? svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ | kathaṃ `sa naiṣadhasyārthapateḥ sutāyām' iti ? nirāṅkuśāḥ kavayaḥ | śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vobhayatrāṇsamarthanīyaḥ ||
sālvāvayavapratyagrathakalakūṭāśmakādiñ‌ || 4.1.173 ||
salvā kṣattriyeti pāṭhaḥ, tannāmiketi vacanāt‌, idaṃ hi tannāmikāṇaḥ prāptyarthamuktam | na ca sālvāśabdāttasya prāptiḥ, vṛddhatvāta, salervapratyayaḥ | aṇapīṣyata iti | sālvāvayave apadātau sālvāditi nirdeśāt, na ca nipātito'ṇ‌ ḍhako'pavādaḥ, `sālveyagāndhāribhyā ca' iti nirdeśāt‌ | tebhyaḥ kṣattriyavṛttibhya iti | `janapadaśabdātkṣattriyāt‌' ityanuvṛtteretallabhyate |
`udumbarāstilakhalāḥ' iti ślokaḥ pradarśanārthaḥ | tena busa, ajamīḍha, ājakanda--ityetebhyo|ñapi bhavati; tathā ca bhāṣya udāhṛtam---bausiḥ, ājamīḍhiḥ, ājakandiriti | sālvāvayavasaṃjñitā iti | sālvāvayava---ityevaṃ śabditā ityarthaḥ ||
te tadrājāḥ || 4.1.174 ||
tathā caivodāhṛtamiti | tatra `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām' mityatra kāryāśrayamudāhṛtam, iha tu prakaraṇe rūpāśrayam ||
kambojālluk‌ || 4.1.175 ||
colaḥ, śaka iti | `dvyañmagadha' ityasyāṇaḥ | kerala ityatrāñaḥ ||
striyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca || 4.1.176 ||
avantī, kuntīti | luki kṛte `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' iti ṅīṣa | kurūriti | `ūṅutaḥ' ||
ataśca || 4.1.177 ||
takāro vispaṣṭārthaṃ iti | asati hi tasmin‌ `asya' iti nirdeśaḥ syāt‌, tataśca sandehaḥ syāt‌---kimayaṃ varṇanirdeśaḥ ? āhosvididama iti ? idamaśca nirdeśe'nantarasyeño luk‌ prasajyeta, takāre satyeṣa doṣo na bhavati, taparanirdeśasya bhūyasā varṇeṣveva prasiddhatvāt‌ `taparastatkālasya ' iti saṃjñākaraṇācca | kathaṃ `mādrīsutau puṣpaphale samṛddhe' iti ? svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ, madrīsutāvityeva vā pāṭhyam |
avantyādibhyo lugvacanāditi | yadyatra tadantavidhiḥ syādavantyādibhyo lugvacanamanarthakaṃ syād‌; anenaiva siddhatvāt‌ | tadantavidhau tvasati akāramātrasya grahaṇena sidhyatītyavantyādibhyo lugvacanamarthavad‌ bhavati ||
na prācyabhargādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ || 4.1.178 ||
pāccālītyādi | pañcālādayaḥ śaravatyāḥ prāñco janapadāḥ | bhargādigrahaṇamaprāgartham | bhṛño gaḥ, bhargaḥ | kṛña uḥ, karuḥ, tamoṣati-dveṣṭi, mūlavibhūjāditvātkaḥ, karūṣāḥ | cinoteḥ kayaḥ ādeśca kaḥ, bahulavacanāditsaṃjñābhāvaḥ, kekayaḥ | kaśermiraḥ, kaśmīraḥ | sālvaśabdo niruktaḥ | śobhanāni sthalānyasya susthalaḥ | urasā śete uraśaḥ | `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' kauravyaḥ | yaudheyītyādi | yudhāyā apatyam, śubhrāyā apatyam, `dvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak‌ | śubhrāśabdāt‌ `śubhrādibhyaśca' iti, tataḥ svārthe `parśvādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ' ityañ‌ | yadyaño luk‌ syāḍḍhaglakṣaṇe ṅīpi sati utādattanivṛttisvaraḥ syāt‌, luki tu pratiṣiddhe `śārṅgaravādyañaḥ' iti ṅīni satyādyudāttaṃ bhavati |
kasya punariti | asya vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ, tameva prakāśayati---kathaṃ punariti | pariharati---etadeveti parśuriti | parśuḥ kṣattriyo janapadena samānaśabdaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ saṅghaḥ, strītvaviśiṣṭaḥ, `dvyañmagadha' ityaṇ‌, tasya `ataśca' iti luk‌, punaḥ parśvādilakṣaṇaḥ svārthiko'ṇ‌, tasyāpi luk‌ | evaṃ rakṣā iti | rakṣasaḥ kṣattriyasyāpatyam, strītvaviśiṣṭaḥ saṅghaḥ, pūrvavadaṇ‌, dvayasyāpi luk‌, `atvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ | āsurīti | janapadalakṣaṇasyāño luki parśvādilakṣaṇasyāṇo luk‌, jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ‌ | jñāpakatvameva draḍhayati---tathā coktamiti | vārttikakāreṇaiduktam | yaudheyādiṣu trayo niruktāḥ; jyāyāsahito bāṇo yasyāḥ sā jyābrāṇā, tasyā apatyaṃ jyābāṇeyaḥ | jyāvāneya ityanye paṭhanti, tatra jyāvāno yasyā jyāvānā | `ghṛ kṣaraṇe' `dhṛ dhāraṇe' ābhyāṃ ktijantābhyām `itaścāniñaḥ' iti ḍhak‌, ghārtteyaḥ, dhārtteyaḥ | trayo garttā yeṣāṃ te trigarttāḥ | `bhṛño'tac‌', bharataḥ | vaśeḥ karmaṇi kiḥ, uśiḥ, uśayaḥ, uṣṭā narā yasya sa uśīnaraḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghaḥ ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ caturthādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ
<4.2>
atha caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ ---4
padamañjarī
tena raktaṃ rāgāt‌ || 4.2.1 ||
rañjirayamastyevābhiṣvaṅge----bhojane rakta iti; asti varṇaviśeṣe---raktā gauḥ, lohitetyarthaḥ; asti śuklasya varṇāntarāpādane---raktaḥ paṭa iti | tatrādyayorarthayorgrahaṇe, rūpeṇa kāntāyāṃ raktaḥ, kopena raktaṃ mukhamityatrāpi prāpnotīti manyamānastṛtīyamarthamāśrityāha---śuklasyetyādi | etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate | rajyate'nena rāga iti | `ghañī ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nalopaḥ | bhāvasādhanastu rāgaśabdo na bhavati, na hi rañjanakriyaiva rañjanakriyāyāḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati | rāgaviśeṣavācina iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; uttaratra lākṣādīnāṃ rāgagrahaṇena viśeṣaṇāt‌ |
rāgāditi kimiti | anabhidhānādeva kartṛvācino na bhaviṣyati, `daivadattaṃ vastram' iti hyukte svasvāmibhāvasyaiva sampratyayāditi praśnaḥ | lakṣaṇaikaśaraṇo naitatpratipattumarhatītyuktam |
kathamiti | na hyatra varṇāntaramāhitamiti praśnaḥ upamānāditi | rūpasādṛśyanimittāt ||
lākṣāroṭanāṭṭhak‌ || 4.2.2 ||
