śakalakardamayorvārttike darśanātsūtre prakṣepaḥ |
nīlyā iti | oṣadhiviśeṣo nīli, ambādhanārthavacanam, nīlaśabdastu guṇaśabdatvādeva nīlīrakte vastre sidhyati |
pītāditi | rāgaviśeṣivācī pītaśabdaḥ | idamapi vacanamaṇbādhanārthameva | svārthikakanpratyayāntastu pītakaśabda guṇavacano vastre labhyate ||
nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ || 4.2.3 ||
iha pāramarṣāḥ kālaṃ kriyātmānamicchanti, yathoktam---
āditya---graha---nakṣatra---parispandamathāpare |
bhinnamāvṛtibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ || iti |
vaiśeṣikāstu dravyamākāśakalpam, uktaṃ ca---
vyāpāravyatirekeṇa kālameke pracakṣate |
nityamekaṃ vibhu dravyaṃ parimāṇaṃ kriyāvatām || iti |
dvayorapi darśanayornakṣatreṇa kālasya yogo na sambhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? aprāptipūrvikā prāptiḥ-yogaḥ, kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇārtho hi loke pauṣādiśabdaprayogaḥ, evaṃvidha eva ca yogaḥ kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturbhavati | dravyapakṣe tāvad‌ dvayorapi nakṣatrakālayornityatvātkālasya ca sarvagatatvānna kadācidayogaḥ | kriyāpakṣe'pi nakṣatragatāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kālakhyāyāḥ samavāyalakṣaṇo yogo'vyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam | sūryādigatāyāstvasambhavādaviśeṣaṇam | yadi tu yathākathañcidyogaḥ, tadā vyabhicārābhāvaḥ | na hi so'styahorātro yaḥ puṣyeṇa na yuktaḥ | tasmāt‌ `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' ityanupapanno nirdeśaḥ |
kathaṃ tarhi nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, nakṣatrāderyuktāntādyukte kāle pratyayavidhānaṃ yuktalopaśca, puṣyeṇa yuktaścandramāṃ puṣyayuktaḥ, puṣyayuktena yuktaḥ kāla iti puṣyayuktaśabdāccandramasi varttamānātpratyayaḥ, yuktaśabdasya ca lopaḥ, pauṣī rātriḥ, pauṣamahaḥ, evaṃ sarvatra | tatra yuktavad‌bhāve doṣaḥ, madhāyuktaśabdātpratyaye kriyamāṇe tasya lupi maghā iti strītvabahutve na siddhyataḥ, yuktasyaiva tu candramaso liṅgavacanaprasaṅgaḥ, ato nakṣatravācina eva pratyayayoryogaḥ sambhavatīti matvā pṛcchati---kathaṃ punariti | na candramasaiva yoge puṣyādīnāṃ nakṣatratā; jyotirmātravacanatvānnakṣatra śabdasya | ye tu puṣyādīnāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candramasā yoge bhavatītyāhuḥ, teṣāmayaṃ praśno'nupapannaḥ | puṣyādisamīpastha iti | mukhyārthāsambhave gauṇasyāśrayaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | tatra maghādayaḥ śabdā aparityaktasvaliṅgasaṅkhyā eva candramasi varttante, yathā---mañcādayaḥ, mañcān‌ striyaḥ paśyeti | tena yuktavadbhāvaviṣaye'pi doṣābhāvaḥ | puṣyasamīpasthena candramasā yukta ityartha iti | yadyapi candramasā kālasya yogo nityaḥ, candramaso nityatvāt‌; puṣyasamīpena tu kādācitkaḥ, puṣyasamīpatāyāḥ kādācitkatvāt‌ | pauṣīti `sūryatiṣya' ityādinā yalopaḥ ||
lubaviśeṣe || 4.2.4 ||
yadyaviśeṣe lub‌ bhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti---pauṣī rātriḥ, pauṣamahariti, atrāpyadya hyo veti viśeṣo na gamyate | atha rātrirahariti | viśeṣā vasāyāttadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, ihāpi tarhi na syād‌---adya puṣyo hyaḥ kṛttikā iti, adyatvādiviśeṣāvasāyāt‌; `puṣye pāyasamaśnīyāt‌' ityādāveva tu syād‌ yatra namanāgapi viśeṣāvasāyaḥ ? ata āha---nacedityādi | rātryādirityādiśabdena muhūrttādeḥ parigrahaḥ | viśeṣo'bhidhīyate iti | pratyayāntena | etadeva spaṣṭayati--yāvāniti | kiyām̐śca kālo nakṣatreṇa yujyate ? ityāha---ahorātra iti | ṣaṣṭināḍikātmaka ityarthaḥ tāvantaṃ hi kālamekasya nakṣatrasya samīpe candramā varttate | tadetadevaṃ yāvānkālo nakṣatreṇa yujyate tasya sarvasya pratyayāntenābhidhānamaviśeṣaḥ, tadekadeśasyābhidhānaṃ viśeṣaḥ | etacca pratyayānte'nupraveśādantaraṅgatvācca labhyate | prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam, tena pauṣo'horātra ityatra samudāyenāpi pratīyamāno'vayavadvayātmakaḥ pratīyata iti tadāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, iha puṣyeṇa yuktā paurṇamāsī pauṣī, maghābhiryuktā māghītyādau lup‌ prāpnoti ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `vibhāṣā phalgunīśravaṇākārttikīcaitrībhyaḥ' iti nirdiśati, tajjñāpayati---paurṇamāsyāṃ lubna bhavatīti | śravaṇāśabdāttu bhavati---`śravaṇākārttakī' iti nirdeśādeva | kathaṃ tarhi śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmiti ? abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti ||
saṃjñāyāṃ śravaṇaśvatthābhyām || 4.2.5 ||
viśeṣārtho'yamārambha iti | na tu saṃjñāyāṃ niyamārthaḥ; vidhisambhave niyamāyogāt‌, `śravaṇākārttikī' ityasaṃjñāyāmapi lupo darśanācca |
lupi yuktavad‌bhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti | śravaṇā rātrirityatra | nipātanāditi | ṅīptvatra pratyayalakṣaṇena bhavati; `aṇ‌ yo'kāraḥ' iti vijñānāt‌ ||
dvandvācchaḥ || 4.2.6 ||
nakṣatragrahaṇamanuvṛttaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantatayā vipariṇamyate, tacca dvandvasya viśeṣaṇamityāha---nakṣatradvandvāditi | rādhānurādhīyā rātririti | ekadeśadvāreṇa rātryādernakṣatradvayayogaḥ | adya rādhānurādhīyamiti | adyetyasyāliṅgatve'pi tadviśeṣaṇasya napuṃsakatvam, lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya, lupaṃ paratvādvādhate | cha iti | nanu yugapatprāptayorvipratiṣedhaḥ, na ca lupchayoryugapatprasaṅgaḥ, pratyayādarśanasya hi lupasaṃjñā, tasya kathaṃ pratyayena saha prasaṅgaḥ ? tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---`madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān‌' iti, evamayaṃ lubaṇa eva bhavati, nāsya chasya | tenāyaṃ cho lupo viṣaye śrūyate, etadeva lupaṃ paratvādvādhate ccha iti bādhakatvam | paratvāditi | yato'yaṃ parastena lubasya na bhavati, tena tadviṣaye'pyasau śrūyata iti ||
dṛṣṭaṃ sāma || 4.2.7 ||
yasya sāmno viśiṣṭakāryaviṣaye viniyogo yena jñātastena dṛṣṭamityucyate ||
kalerḍhak‌ || 4.2.8 ||
sarvatreti | na kevalamagneḥ `sāsya devatā' ityasminnevārthe ḍhak‌, nāpi kevalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sāmetyatraivārthe kalerḍhag; api tu sarveṣve va prāgdīvyatīyeṣvityarthaḥ |
saṃgrahaśloke jati ca dviraṇ‌ ḍidvā vidhīyate iti pāṭhaḥ | jāte'rthe yo'ṇ vidhīyate sa vā ḍidbhavatītyarthaḥ |
na vidyāyā iti | vidyāvācina īkag‌ na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
gotrādaṅkavaditi | aṅke yo dṛṣṭaḥ pratyayaḥ sa sarvo'tidiśyate, na tvaṅka evāhatya vihitaḥ, tena `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣu' ityasyāṇaḥ `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' ityasya ca vuño'tideśaḥ ||
vāmadevād‌ ḍyaḍ‌ḍyau || 4.2.9 ||
ḍiskāraṇaṃ kimarthamiti | yasyeti lopenaiva siddhi matvā praśnaḥ | anayorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi | atha `kriyamāṇe'pi ḍitkaraṇe kasmādevānayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? tatrāha---ananubandhaketi | `ananubandhakasya grahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' iti yagrahaṇe ḍyaḍyatorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā tu yad‌grahaṇe ḍyato grahaṇābhāvaḥ | avāmadevyamiti | avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvameva bhavati |
saṃgrahaśloke atadarthe ityanena `yayatoścātadarthe' ityetatsūtraṃ lakṣyate | nañsvara iti | nañāśrayaḥ svaro nañsvaraḥ, uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ tasminvidhīyamāne ityarthaḥ ||
parivṛto rathaḥ || 4.2.10 ||
cārmaṇa iti | `an‌' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | parivṛto ratha iti | tadekāntagrahaṇam, yena parivṛto rathastadekāntaścedbhavatīti vaktavyam | tena carmavastrādāveva bhavati, itarathā chāttrādāvapi prasaṅga ityāha---samantādveṣṭita ityādi | vṛṇotirveṣṭane pariḥ sarvato bhāve | yasya na kaścidavayava iti | bāhulyābhiprāyametat, na hi cakranemiprabhṛtayaścarmaṇā pidhīyante nāpyantarāvayavāḥ | nanu tatkārī cāyaṃ yadāha---chāttraiḥ parivṛta iti | tad‌dveṣī ca, yadāha---samantād‌veṣṭita ityādi | nāyaṃ tatkārī, aupacāriko'yaṃ prayogaḥ, parivṛtaḥ iva parivṛtaḥ ||
pāṇḍukambalādiniḥ || 4.2.11 ||
matvarthīyenaiva siddha iti | yo he yena parivṛtaḥ sa tasyāsti | aṇo nivṛttyarthamiti | yadyetannārabhyeta, parivṛto ratha iti vivakṣāyāṃ pūrveṇāṇ‌ prasajyeta ||
dvaipavaiyāghrādañ‌ || 4.2.12 ||
dvīpivyāghrayoriti | `virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ekaśeṣaḥ prāpnoti, tatrāvāntarajātibhedena bhinnārthatvānna bhaviṣyatīti samādhātavyam | carmaṇaiva rathasya parivaraṇaṃ sambhavati, na vikāramātreṇeti `carmaṇī' ityuktam | dvīṣivyāghraśabdābhyām prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ‌' ityañpratyayaḥ, dvīpinaṣṭilopaḥ ||
kaumārāpūrvavacane || 4.2.13 ||
apūrvavacana iti | apūrvaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ | apūrvatvasya vacanamapūrvavacanam, tasminnapūrvavacane | kasya punarapūrvatvoktāvityāha---pāṇigrahaṇasyeti | etacca nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate | ubhayataḥ | ādyāditvāttasiḥ | strīpuṃsayorubhayorapyetannipātanamiṣyate, ubhayośca pakṣayorapūrvatvaṃ striyā eva, na puṃsa ityarthaḥ | tatra kaumāreti strīpuṃsasādhāraṇaprātipadikamātranirdeśādavasīyate---ubhayorapi nipātanamiti | striyā evāpūrvatvamityetattu nipātanabalāllabhyate | apūrvapatimiti | yasyāḥ pāṇirna kenacid‌gṛhītapūrvaḥ sā'pūrvapatiḥ, na vidyate pūrvaḥ patiriti kṛtvā, tāmupapannaḥ-prāptaḥ, bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ | sa tu pūrvakṛtodvāho bhavatu mā vā bhūt‌ | apūrvapatiriti | ayamapi bahuvrīhiḥ, atrāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvavat‌ |
komāretyādi | kaumāreti nipātyate'pūrvacane | kimatra nipātyate ? kumāryā aṇ‌ vidhīyate | kadā ? apūrvatvaṃ yadā tasyāḥ | yadā kumāryā apūrvatvaṃ na puṃsastadetyarthaḥ | kumāryā bhavatīti veti | anena yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate; yaḥ kumārīmupapannastasyāmasau bhavati, tadāyattatvāddharmācaraṇādeḥ, tataśca `tatra bhavaḥ' ityavāṇa siddhaḥ | yadyapi vāṇyādyapi kumāryāṃ bhavati tathāpi satyabhidhāne `tatra bhāvaḥ' iti bhavatyeva | sūtrārambhe'pi hi nāsau daṇḍavāritaḥ, evaṃ tāvatkaumāra iti siddham | striyāmapi siddham, katham ? kaumārasya strī kaumārī, pratyāsattyā ca yasyāmasābhavan‌ kaumāravyapadeśaṃ labhate saivābhidhīyate na stryantaram, etacca sūtrārambhe'pyaṅgīkartavyam ||
tatrod‌dhṛtamamatrebhyaḥ || 4.2.14 ||
atroddharatiruddharaṇapūrvake nidhāne vartate, tena saptamīsamarthād‌ vibhaktirnopapadyatade | bhuktocchiṣṭamiti | śiṣṭamevocchiṣṭam, yathā vacchinaṣṭi na sarvaṃ juhotīti bhuktaśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | yasyoddharaṇamiti prāsiddhiriti | kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti bhūte karmaṇi lyuṭ‌ | śarāveṣūd‌dhṛta iti | ud‌dhṛtyanehita ityarthaḥ ||
sthaṇḍilācchayitari vrate | 4.2.15 ||
śāstrita iti | saṃjātaśāstra ityarthaḥ | yadvā---tṛtīyāsamarthādvidhāne'rthe `prātipadikāddhatvarthe' iti ṇic‌, karmaṇi ktaḥ, śāstreṇa vihita ityarthaḥ | sthaṇḍile śayituṃ vratamasyeti | tumunatra vaktavyaḥ; vratasyākriyārūpatvāt‌ ||
saṃskṛtambhakṣāḥ || 4.2.16 ||
saṃskṛtamityetat karmasāmānye vyutpādyate, tena napuṃsakaliṅgamekavacanaṃ ca, bhakṣā ityetattu apūpādyabhyavahāryaviśeṣe vyutpādyate, tena puliṅgaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca | tatra vākyārthagamyasyārthasya padasaṃskāre'nupayogātsaṃskṛtamityenadbhavati, ata eva viramya sambandhaṃ darśayati---yattatsaṃskṛtambhakṣāste ced‌ bhavantīti, aṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa kartetivat‌, tacchabdasya pratinirdiśyamānaliṅgatā | kharaviśadamiti | kharam- kaṭhinam, viśadam- vibhaktam | bhakṣaśabdenocyata iti | yadyapyabbhakṣo vāyubhakṣa iti bhakṣayateranyatrāpi prayogaḥ, bhakṣaśabdastu tatraiva prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ ||
śūlokhādyat‌ || 4.2.17 ||
śūlokhāditi | samāhāradvandvaḥ, ukhā-pātraviśeṣaḥ | yastu svāṅgavācyukhāśabdastasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; svāṅge saṃskartavyasyābhāvāt‌ | kathamukhyo'gniriti | na hyasau bhakṣaḥ, bhavārthe digāditvād‌ draṣṭavyaḥ ||
dadhnaṣṭhak‌ || 4.2.18 ||
iha tu dadhi kevalamādhārabhūtamiti | yathā śūre saṃskriyamāṇasyamāṃsasya śūlam | yadyapyatra dadhyapi saṃskārakam, tathāpi na tadvivakṣitam, kintu tadādhārasya dravyāntareṇa yaḥ saṃskāraḥ sa eva vivakṣita iti bhāvaḥ ||
udaśvito'nyatarasyām || 4.2.19 ||
audaśvitka iti | `isusuktāntātkaḥ' ||
kṣīrāḍ‌ḍhañ‌ || 4.2.20 ||
atra saṃskṛtamityeva sambadhyate, na bhakṣā iti; tena yavāgvāmapi bhavati | kṣeraiyīti | `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' ityādinā ṅīp‌ ||
sāsminpaurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām || 4.2.21 ||
tataścedvivakṣeti | tataḥ pratyayāntāllokasya vivakṣā bhavati ced‌ evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathetyarthaḥ | saṃjñāyāmiti samudāyopādhiriti | etadeva spaṣṭayati---pratyayāntena cediti | pauṣī paurṇamāsīti | `lubaviśeṣe' iti paurṇamāsyāṃ lubna bhavatīti pūrvamevoktam | bhṛtakamāse ceti | bhṛtā eva bhṛtakāḥ, karmakarāsteṣāṃ yo māsaḥ karmakaraṇādārabhya triśadrātralakṣaṇaḥ sa yadā pauṣyā paurṇamāsyā tadvān‌ bhavati | vastutaśca na māghādivyapadeśabhāk‌ tatretyarthaḥ |
tulyameva phalamiti | ki punastadityāha---prayogānusāraṇamiti | ṇyarthāllyaṭ‌ | saṃjñāśabdena tulyatāmiti | tulyaphalatāmityarthaḥ | iti kaṇasya jñāpayitumiti | kiṃ punaridaṃ jñāpakasādhyam ? tatrāha---na hyayamiti | jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati--saṃjñārthatve tviti | saṃjñābdena tulyaphalatve ityarthaḥ | pravṛttibhedena cāyamartho jñāpyata iti | saṃjñāyāmiti dvitīyāpravṛttiḥ, iha śāltre `saṃjñāyām' ityasyārthe itiśabdo veditavya iti paribhāṣā sampadyate |
pūrṇamāsādaṇiti | pūrṇo māso'syāṃ tathāviti bahuvrīhau prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādasmādeva vā nipātanādaṇ‌ | mā iti candramā ucyata iti | candramaśśabdaikadeśaprayogaḥ, satyābhāmā bhāmetivat‌ ||
āgrahāyaṇyaśvatthāṭ‌ṭhak‌ || 4.2.22 ||
agre hāyanamasyā ityāgrahāyaṇī, prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇ‌, `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' iti ṇatvam | aśvatthena yuktā paurṇamāsī aśvattha iti | nipātanātpaurṇamāsyāmapi lup‌ ||
sāsya devatā || 4.2.24 ||
yāgasampradānaṃ devateti | yadyapi devaśabdo manuṣyādivajjātivacanaḥ, svārthikaśca tal‌; tathāpi samudāyaśaktyā devatāśabdo yāge darśa pūrṇamāsau yadyatsampradānatvena coditaṃ tatra sarvatra vartate, na sa jātiviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | deyasya puroḍāśādeḥ svāminīti | diveraiśvaryakarmaṇo devatāśabdavyutpatti darśayati, evaṃ ca kṛtvā `vāyvṛtupitruṣaso yat‌',`kālebhyo bhavavat‌' iti vacanamupapadyate, na hyṛtuṣu pitṛṣu uṣasi vā jātirasti | tathā pitṛdevatyam, devadevatyamiti prayogo'pyevamevopapadyate |
kathamiti | puroḍāśādikasya deyasyābhāvādindrasya sampradānatvaṃ nāstīti praśnaḥ | mantrastutyāmapītyādi | nānenaupacārikatvaṃ prayogasyocyate, api tu mukhya eva prayogaḥ, yāgasampradāne sārvalaukikaḥ prayogaḥ, ayaṃ tu nairuktānāmityetāvānviśeṣaḥ | upacarantīti bruvate, prayuñjata ityarthaḥ |
kathamityādi | pūrvoktaṃ prakāradvayamatra nāstīti praśnaḥ | upemānāditi | kāṣāyau gardabhasya karṇāvitivad‌ gauṇo'yaṃ prayoga ityarthaḥ | seti prakṛta iti | prakṛtaṃ hi sāgrahaṇaṃ saṃjñayā sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau saṃjñāyā apyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌ ||
kasyet‌ || 4.2.25 ||
kimo vibhaktau kādeśaṃ kṛtvā kasyeti nirdiṣṭamityāśaṅkāmapanayati---kaśabda iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā kāyānubrūhīti sampraiṣaḥ | kasmai anubrūhīti, `na kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema' iti tu chāndasaḥ smaibhāvaḥ, yadindrāgnī avamasyāmityādivat‌ | kāyamiti | itve kṛte yasyeti lopaḥ prāptaḥ paratvādādivṛddhyā bādhyate, śrīrdevatāsya śrāyamitivat | `somāṭ‌ṭyaṇ‌' ityatra kagrahaṇe ca kriyamāṇe yadyapi yasyeti lopātparatvād‌ vṛddhirbhavati, kṛtāyāmapi vṛddhau yasyeti lopaḥ syādeva ||
aponaptrapānnaptṛbhyāṃ ghaḥ || 4.2.27 ||
aponapāt‌ apāṃnapāditi devatānāmadheye iti | pṛṣodarāditvādanayoḥ sādhutvam | tayostu pratyayasanniyogeneti | evaṃ ca aponapāte anubrūhi, apāṃnapāte'nubrūhi, aponapāttaṃ yaja, apāṃ napātaṃ yajeti sampraiṣaḥ | vede tu aponaptre svāheti chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ ||
cha ca || 4.2.28 ||
yogavibhāga ityādi | pūrvasūtra eva chagrahaṇe sati ghacchau dvau pratyayau, prakṛtī api dve iti syātsaṅkhyātānudeśaḥ | śatarudrīyamiti | śataśabdo'nantavacanaḥ, śataṃ rudrā devatā'syeti ghacchau, tayovidhānasāmarthyād‌ `dvigorluganapatye' lugna bhavati ||
mahendrād‌ghāṇo ca || 4.2.29 ||
saumīti | ṭittvānṅīp‌, `halastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||
vāyvṛtupitruṣaso yat‌ || 4.2.31 ||
vāyavyamiti | `orguṇaḥ', `vānto yi pratyaye' pitryamiti | `rīṅṛtaḥ' iti rīṅ‌, yasyeti lopaḥ ||
dyāvāpṛthivīśunāsīramaruttvadagnīṣomavāstoṣpatigṛhamedhāccha ca || 4.2.32 ||
aṇo ṇyasya cāpavāda iti | vāstoṣpatiśabdātpatyuttarapadasya ṇyasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyo'ṇaḥ | dyāvāpṛthivyāviti | `divo dyāvā', `divasaśca pṛthivyām' iti dyāvādeśaḥ | śunāsīrāviti | `devatā dvandve ca' ityānaṅādeśaḥ | śuno vāyuḥ, sīra āditya iti | anye tu ekameva śunasīramindrasya, guṇamamanyanta, yathāhaśvalāyanaḥ---`indro vā śunāsīraḥ' iti | mantraliṅgañca bhavati---indraṃ vayaṃ śunāsīramasminyajñe havāmahe' iti | maruto'sya santi marutvānindraḥ | agnīṣomīyamiti | `īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ' vāstoḥ patirvāstoṣpatiḥ, asmādeva nirdeśātsādhuḥ | gṛhamedhaśabdamakārāntaṃ bah‌vṛcā manyante | `marudbhyo gṛhamedhebhya uttarā' ityāśvalāyanaḥ | `gṛhamedhāsa āgatā' iti ca mantraliṅgam | `marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyaḥ sarvāsāṃ dugdhe sāyamodanam' iti tu taittirīyakam | tatra dekārānto nakārānto veti vipratipannāḥ ||
agnerḍhak‌ || 4.2.33 ||
kalerḍhagityatroktamevārthaṃ smarayati---prāgdīvyatīyeṣviti ||
kālebhyo bhavavat‌ || 4.2.34 ||
kālaviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśāt‌ | vatkāraṇamityādi | asati vatkaraṇe `kālebhyo bhavaḥ' ityucyamāne yadi tāvadevaṃ sambandhaḥ, kālebhyo bhave ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te `sāsya devatā' ityatrārthe bhavantīti devatāprakṛtiraviśeṣitā syāt‌, tataśca `kālaṭṭhañ‌' iti ṭhañindrāderapi prāpnoti | atha punarevaṃ sambandhaḥ---bhave ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te bhavanti kālebhyo devatābhya iti ? evamapi bhavapratyayā na viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ, tataśca `digādibhyo yat‌' iti yat‌ pratyayo'pi bhave vihitaḥ kālavācibhyo'sminnarthe prāpnoti | athāpyevaṃ sambandhaḥ---kālebhyo bhave ye pratyayāste bhavanti, kālebhya eva devatārthe iti tatra sakṛt‌ śrutasya tasya kālaśabdasyaivamubhayasambandha eva tāvad‌ durlabhaḥ | athāpi labhyeta, evamapi yaḥ kaścitkālādbhave pratyayo yataḥ kutaścidevatāyāḥ syād‌ ṛtubhyo'ṇ‌ muhūrttāderapi prāpnoti | vatinirdeśe tu sati sādṛśyaparigraho bhavati, tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena viśeṣaṇena bhave'rthe vidhāsyante ye pratyayāḥ, ihāpi tābhya eva prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā bhavantīti na kiñcidaniṣṭam ||
mahārājaproṣṭhapadāṭ‌ṭhañ‌ || 4.2.35 ||
mahārājo vaiśravaṇaḥ, proṣṭhapadaśabdātpūrveṇa nakṣatrāṇi prāpte vacanam, navayajña āgrayaṇam | pūrṇamāsādaṇiti | asminvartata ityeva | paurṇamāsīti | pūrṇo māso'syā tithau vartata iti vigrahaḥ, eṣeva ca vyutpattiḥ `sāsminpaurṇamāsī' ityatrāpi darśitā ||
pitṛvyamātulamātāmahapitāmahāḥ || 4.2.36 ||
pitṛmātṛbhyāmiti | svarūpapadārthakatvenābhyarhitatve viśeṣābhāvāllaghvakṣarasya pūrvanipātaḥ, ayonisambandhavācitvādanaṅo'bhāvaśca | ḍāmahajiti | kathaṃ tarhyākāre'vagrahaḥ---mātā-mahaḥ, pitā-maha iti ? tasamānmahapratyayaḥ pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ nipātitastayoścānaṅādeśa iti kecit‌ | vṛttikārastu saṃhitāpāṭhasyaiva nityatvāt‌ `nalakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ' iti nyāyenāvagraho mā kārīti manyate | mātari ṣiccheti | ṣittvamupasaṅkhyeyamityarthaḥ | na punaḥ ṣakāro'nubandhaḥ kartavya iti deśābhāvāt‌---mātāmahā ityapi mantre dṛśyate |
averdugdha iti | dugdhaṃ kṣīram | soḍhādīnām `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, sakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt‌ |
niṣphalastila iti | sasyāvasthāyāṃ phalarahita ucyate, dhānyāvasthāyāṃ prayojanaśūnya ityanye ||
tasya samūhaḥ || 4.2.37 ||
sarvasyaiva viṣayasyāpavādairavaṣṭabdhatvātpṛcchati---kimihodāharaṇamiti | kākaśukavakaśabdā ādyudāttāḥ `prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' ityanena, asyārthaḥ---vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau, athādiḥ prāk‌ śakaṭerityata ādirityanuvṛttaṃ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate, prāṇivācināṃ ye ādibhūtāḥ kavargātpūrve acasteṣāmudātto bhavatīti | tatra śaukamityanudāharaṇam ; khaṇḍikādiṣu pāṭhāt‌ | vakaśabdastūdāhāryaḥ ||
bhikṣādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.2.38 ||
aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārthamiti | bhikṣāśabdo'yam `gurośca halaḥ' ityakārapratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ, tataḥ `anudāttādeḥ' ityañ‌ aṇo bādhakaḥ prāpnoti, tasya bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam | nanu ca yadyatrāñ‌, syātpunarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ ? nānarthakam; paratvādaci tattallakṣaṇaṣṭhak‌ prāpnoti, tadvādhanārthamatra punarvacanaṃ syādityañ‌ syādeva, punaraṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati | gārbhiṇamiti | `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpo nivṛttiḥ, tato'ṇi `imaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ | tasya grahaṇasāmarthyātpuṃvad‌bhāvo na bhavatīti | yadi syāt‌, `siddhatvātpratyayavidhau' iti vacanādanutpanna eva taddhite puṃvadbhāvena bhavitavyam | yuvaśabdaśca' kaninyuvṛṣa' iti kaninpratyayāntatvādādyudātta ityautsagika evāṇ‌ siddha iti tasyeha pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt‌ | yauvatamiti | yathā tu vāttikaṃ tathā puṃvadbhāva iṣyate | āha hi---`bhikṣādiṣu yuvatigrahaṇānarthakyaṃ puṃvadbhāvasya siddhatvāt‌ pratyayavidhau' iti ||
gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhrarājārājanyarājaputravatsamanuṣyājād‌ vuñ‌ || 4.2.39 ||
apatyādhikārādanyatreti | yadyevam, rājanyamanuṣyayorupādānamanarthakam, gotra ityevasiddham | na tāvapatyapratyayāntau; jāteḥ pratyayārthatvāt‌ | uktaṃ hi---`rājño'patye jātigrahaṇam, manorjātāvañyatau ṣukceti | kiṃtarhyucyate `prakṛtyā'ke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' iti yalopo na bhavatīti, yāvatā'nāpatyayakāratvenaiva na bhaviṣyati ? satyam ; apatyārthatvamabhyupetyaitaducyate | yadyapatyārthatvamabhyupeyate, rājanyamanuṣyayorgrahaṇamanarthakam ? nānarthakam; jñāpanārthatvāt‌, etaj‌ jñāpayati---naitayorapatyakṛtaṃ bhavatīti, tena yalopo na bhavati, sarvathā `prakṛtyā'ke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' iti na vaktavyam | aupagavakamiti | yathātra paro'pyanudāttāderañ‌ na bhavati, tathā `khaṇḍikādibhyaśca' ityatra vakṣyate ||
brāhmaṇamāṇavavāḍavādyan‌ || 4.2.42 ||
nakāraḥ svārtha iti | `ñnityādirnityam' ityādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌ | kimarthaṃ punarbrāhmaṇādibhyo yanvidhīyate, na prakṛto yañeva vidhīyate, na hi vṛddheṣu yaño yano vā viśeṣo'sti---tadeva rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ, ṭhañastvasvaritatvādananuvṛttiḥ ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu | etaj‌ jñāpayati---anyebhya'pyayam | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? pṛṣṭhādupasaṅkhyānaṃ codayiṣyati tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati |
pṛṣṭhānāṃ samūha iti | pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ stutiviśeṣavacanaḥ | pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaha iti | tadvati tadupacāraḥ |
ṇasvaktavya iti | sakāraḥ padasañjñārthaḥ, tena pārśvamityatra bhatvābhāvādorguṇo na bhavati ||
anudāttāderañ‌ || 4.2.44 ||
acittātparatvād‌ ṭhakā bhavitavyamiti | cittavanta udāhṛtāḥ, kapotamayūraśabdau `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttau, igupadhātkaḥ, tarateḥ sanvattuk‌ cābhyāsasyeti kipratyayāntastittiriśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | sanvadbhāvenādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati; `uṇādayo bahulam' iti bahulavacanāt‌ ||
khaṇḍirakādibhyaśca || 4.2.45 ||
kṣudrakāśceti | kṣudrakasyāpatyāni, janapadaśabdāditi vihitasya tadrājasya luk‌, mālavāttu vṛddhalakṣaṇasya ñyaṅaḥ | pūrveṇāñi siddhe iti | samāsāntodāttatve sati śeṣanighātenānudāttāditvāt‌ ||
nanu ca paratvāditi | abhyupetya gotratvametaduktam, tadeva tu nāstītyāha---na ca gotrasamudāyo gotramiti | tatra ca yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyata iti kāśikosalāyā ityatra cha eva bhavati, na janapadalakṣaṇo vuñ‌, tadvadatrāpi gotralakṣaṇo vuñ‌ na prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | syādetat‌---mā bhūtsamudāyo gotram, mālavaśabdastu gotraṃ bhavati, tataśca tadantavidhinā samudāyādapi vuñprāpnotīti ? tatrāha---na ceti | `yena vidhistadantasya' ityatra hi `samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ' ityuktam | evaṃ tarhītyādi | kathamekena yatnenobhayaṃ śakyaṃ jñāpayitum ? śakyamityāha, anyathānupapattyā jñāpakaṃ bhavati, ubhayena ca vinā nāsmādañvidhānamupapadyata iti | kimātrānupapannam ? tatra pūrvavipratiṣedhajñāpanasya prayojanamaupagavakaṃ kāpaṭavakamiti | vuño'vakāśaḥ yadādyudāttam---glucukasyāpatyaṃ glucukāyaniḥ, `prācāmavṛddhātphin‌' teṣāṃ samūho glaucukāyanakamiti; añastu kāpotamityādyagotramavakāśaḥ; gotrādanudāttāderubhayaprasaṅge paratvādañ‌, syāt‌, asmāttu jñāpakād‌ vuñeva bhavati | tadantavidhijñāpanasya prayojanam---vanahastināṃ samūho vānahastikam | gaudhenumiti | `jaṅgaladhenuvalajānatasya' ityuttarapadavṛddhivikalpaḥ |
punarasyaiva niyamārthatvaṃ varṇayiṣyan‌ kathamekena yatnenobhayaṃ labhyam---jñāpanaṃ ca niyamaśca ? ityāśaṅkyāha---kṣudrakamālavādityetāvateti | yogavibhāgena yatnadvayamāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | kṣaudrakamālavī, kṣaudrakamālavakamiti | ubhayatrāpi mālavādutpannasya ñyaṅaḥ `gotre'lugaci' iti luki pratiṣiddhe `āpatyasya' iti yalopaḥ |
añsiddhirityādi anudāttāderiti | hetugarbhaṃ viśeṣaṇam; yato'yaṃ kṣudrakamālavaśabdo'nudāttādistena tasyādanudāttāderityevāñaḥ siddhirasti | korthaḥ tasya gaṇapāṭheneti śeṣaḥ | na kiñcitprayojanam ityarthaḥ | gotralakṣaṇo vuñ‌ prāpnoti, atastadvādhanārthaḥ pāṭha iti cettatrāha---gotrād‌vuñiti | gotrād‌vuñ‌ vidhīyate, na ca tatkṣudrakamālavetiśabdarūpagotramityarthaḥ | tadantāditi | mālavaśabdasya gotratvāttadantavidhinā prāpnotyeva | na sa sarvata iti | ādyāditvātsaptamyantāttasiḥ, sa tadantavidhiḥ sarvatra na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tadantatve iti | tadantavidhirastītyasminnartha ityarthaḥ | tathā ceti | dhenuranañikamutpādayatīti āpiśaleḥ sūtram | atra vṛddhyartho'nubandho mṛgyaḥ, ikasyaiva cesusuktāntātparasya kādeśo draṣṭavyaḥ | arthamātraṃ vā bhāṣkāreṇa nirdiṣṭam | ikagiti ṭhakamityarthaḥ | dhenūnāṃ samūho dhainukam | anañiti kim ? adhenūnāṃ samūha ādhenavam, utsādipāṭhādañ‌ | yadyapi dhenuśabdaḥ sūtre paṭhyate, tathāpi baṣkayāsa iti liṅgādadhenuśabdādapi bhavati | tatra yadi sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirna syāt‌, anañiti pratiṣedho'rthakaḥ syāt‌ |
prayojanāntaramapyāha---senāyāmiti | yatheti | pūrvavipratiṣedhena vuñā'ño bādhā yathā syādityevamarthaśca tasya gaṇe pāṭha ityarthaḥ | ulūkaśabdo'tra paṭhyate sa `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttaḥ | chandasi tu yadulūko vadati moghametat, itthā ulūka āpaptaditi yadādyudāttatvam, tacchāndasam | bhāṣāyāṃ tu madhyodāttameva, tatra pūrveṇaivāñ‌ siddhaḥ, tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam---aulūkyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ, yataḥ `yañañośca' iti bahuṣu luki kṛte rūpam, tadiha paṭhyata iti | asati hi tasya pāṭhe ulūkānāṃ samūha ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ `gotre'lugaci' iti lukaḥ pratiṣedhādaulukyaśabdād‌ gotrāśrayo vuñprapnoti | śukaśabdo'tra paṭhyate, `tasya samūhaḥ' ityatra tu `yasya ca nānyatpratipadavidhānamasti' ityuktvodāhṛtam--kākaṃ śaukamiti, tasmāttatra śaukamityasya sthāne bākamiti paṭhitavyam | bakaśabdaḥ `prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' ityādyudāttaḥ | yugavaratreti paṭhyate, tatsaṅghātavigṛhītārthamicchanti---yaugavaratram, yaugam, vāratramiti, tatra saṅghātapakṣe `jātiraprāṇinām' iti dvandvaikavadbhāve napuṃsakahrasvatve sati yugavaratreti dīrghanirdeśo'nupapannaḥ, tasmādyugasahitā varatreti samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ, jātiparatvābhāvādvā ekavadbhāvābhāvaḥ ||
caraṇebhyo dharmavat‌ || 4.2.46 ||
gotracaraṇād‌vuñityārabhya pratyayā vakṣyante iti | nanu ca na tatra dharmagrahaṇamasti, tatkathaṃ dharmavadityatideśo yujyata ityāha---tatredamiti | idameva dharmavaditivacanaṃ liḍgamasti, tatra caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoriti | vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārtha iti | asati tasmin‌ `caraṇebhyo dharmaḥ' ityucyamāne yadi tāvadevaṃ sambandhaḥ, caraṇebhyo dharme ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te bhavanti, samūha iti samūhaprakṛtiraviśeṣitā syāt‌, tataśca kākādibhyo'pi vuñādayaḥ prasajyeran‌ | atha punarevaṃ sambandhaḥ---dharme ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te caraṇebhyaḥ samūhe bhavantīti ? evamapi dharmapratyayā na viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ, tataśca `tasyedam' iti vidhāsyamānā aṇādayo'pi kaṭhādibhya āpadyeran‌ | athāpyevaṃ sambandhaḥ---caraṇebhyo dharme ye pratyayāste bhavanti caraṇebhya eva samūha iti ? tatra sakṛt‌ śrutasya caraṇaśabdasyaivamubhayasambandha eva tāvad‌ durlabhaḥ, athāpi labhyeta ? evamapi yaḥ kaściddharme pratyayo yataḥ kutaściccaraṇaśabdātsyāt‌, `kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ‌' kaṭhādibhyo'pi syāt‌, vatinirdeśe tu sati sarvasādṛśyaparigraho bhavati | tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena viśeṣaṇena ye pratyayā dharme vidhāsyante, ihāpi tābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva bhavantīti na kiñcidaniṣṭam | kāṭhakam, kālāpakamiti | gotracaraṇādvuñ‌ | chāndīgyamiti | `chandogaukthika' iti ñyaḥ | ātharvaṇamiti | `ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca' ityaṇ‌, ikalopaśca ||
acittahastidhenoṣṭhak‌ || 4.2.47 ||
aṇañorapavāda iti | acittārtheṣu yenanāprāptinyāyenāṇo'pavādaḥ | kapotādiṣu cittavatsu caritārthasyāño'pi paratvādvādhaka ityarthaḥ | hastidhenuśabdayostu pratyayasvareṇāntodāttayoranudāttādilakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ | hastiśabdaḥ `hastājjātau' itīnipratyayāntaḥ | dhenuśabdaḥ `gheṭo'nuśca' iti nupratyayāntaḥ | ādhenavamiti | atsādipāṭhādañ, `jaṅgaladhenuvalajāntasya' iti pakṣe vṛddhyabhāvaḥ ||
pāśādibhyo yaḥ || 4.2.49 ||
yapratyayayāntaṃ svabhāvataḥ strīliṅgam | vātaśabdo'tra paṭhyate---vātānāṃ samūho vātyā, pṛthagvātādarśanādayukto'tra samūhaḥ, tasmācchīghratve pratyayo vaktavyaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasyāpi vātāvayavino digbhedena bhedo'dhyāropaḥ, tadāśrayaśca samūhaḥ | atha vā---pratidiśaṃ vātāvayavina eva bhidyante, tathā ca pratibhāsaḥ---vūrvovātaḥ, uttaro vātaḥ, sarvato vānti vātā iti | āha ca---vāyorvāyusammūrchanaṃ nānātve liṅgamiti |
khalagorathāt‌ || 4.2.50 ||
atha kasmātkhalādayo'pi pāśādiṣveva na paṭhitāḥ, evaṃ hi vibhaktirnoccārayitavyā bhavati ? tatrāha---pāśādiṣvapāṭha iti ||
initrakaṭyacaśca || 4.2.51 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṅkhyārthaḥ, anyatā hanitrakaṭyacastrayaścakārādyaśceti catvāraḥ pratyayāḥ, prakṛtayastu tisra iti vaiṣamyaṃ syāt‌ |
khalādibhya iti | khalādayaḥ prayogato gamyāḥ | ete'pi pratyayāḥ svabhāvataḥ striyāmeva ||
viṣayo deśe || 4.2.52 ||
nanu ca viṣayasya deśatvāvyabhicārād‌ deśa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyarthamityata āha---viṣayaśabdo'yamiti | atyantaśīlitaḥ-atyantābhyastaḥ | tatra deśagrahaṇaṃ grāmasamudāyapratipattyarthamiti | yadyevam, deśagrahaṇamevāstu mā bhūdviṣayagrahaṇam ? naivaṃ śakyam; deśaśabdo'pi nānārthaḥ, deśanaṃ deśa iti kriyāśabdasyāpi bhāvāt‌ | śibīnāṃ viṣayo deśaḥ śaiba iti | kathaṃ śibayo deśa iti ? nivāsavivakṣāyām `tasya nivāsaḥ' `janapade lup‌' iti lupi bhaviṣyati | nanvarthabhedo bhavati, śibīnāṃ nivāso janapada ityatra svāsvāmibhāvo na pratīyate, anyadīye'pi janapade nivāsasambhāvat‌; śibīnāṃ viṣaya ityatra tu svasvāmibhāvaḥ pratīyate, na tu nivāsārthaḥ, tatrāvasatāmapi svāmitvasambhavāt ? satyam ; ya evāsau yeṣāṃ viṣayastatraiva teṣāṃ nivāse janapade lup‌ smaryate, na nivāsamātre | atra cābhidānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ | evaṃ ca śibīnāṃ viṣayaḥ śaiba ityatrārthe vibaya ityapi bhavati | evaṃ vasātīnāṃ viṣayo vāsātaḥ, teṣāmeva nivāso vasātayaḥ | tathā gāndhārīṇāṃ viṣayo gāndhāraḥ, nivāso gāndhārayaḥ | aṅgāḥ, vaṅgā, srughnāḥ puṇḍrā iti---nivāsarūpataiva vivakṣyate, na viṣayarūpatā |
eṣaṃ rājanyādibyo vuñityatrāpi viṣayavivakṣāyāṃ rājanyakam, nivāso rājanyāḥ | tatraiva bailvatādiṣu viṣayavivakṣaiva, tena bailvatakam, āmbarīṣaputrakamityādyeva bhavati | sarvatra cābhidhānaśaktireva hetuḥ, tadāha---viṣayābhidhāne janapade lup‌, bahuvacanaviṣayād‌ gāndhāryādibhyo vā rājanyādibhyo nityam, na vābhidheyasya nivāsaviṣayatvāt‌ | nivāsavivakṣāyāṃ lup‌, viṣayavivakṣāyāṃ tu pratyaya iti ||
so'syādiriticchandasaḥ pragātheṣu || 4.2.55 ||
chandasa iti na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi mantrabrāhmaṇayoḥ, kasya tarhi ? akṣarāṇāmiyatāvacanaśchandaḥ śabdo'sti, yasya jagatyādayo viśeṣāstasya grahaṇam ; prāgāthānāmādau tasyaiva sambhavāt‌, tena paṅ‌ktyādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ | yatra dve ṛcau tisraḥ kriyanta iti caturthaṣaṣṭhau pādau bārhato pragāye punarabhyasitvottarayoravasyedityevamādinā prakāreṇa | tadyathā---yajñāyajñā vaḥ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣoṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣamūje nipātamiti | tatra yo'yamuccāraṇaprakārastad‌grathanam | pragrathanāditi | pragāthaśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ darśayati, pragrathyata iti pragāthaḥ, `akartari ca kārake' iti karmaṇi ghañ‌, pṛṣodarāditvādrephanakārayorlopaḥ | prāgāṇādveti | `kṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvam, `kau gau śabde', pragīyata iti pragāthaḥ, `uṣikuṣigartibhyasthan‌' | traiṣṭubhamiti | kuṭīra iti svārthikasyāpi rapratyayasya yathā bhinnaliṅgatā, tathehāpi napuṃsakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
saṃgrāme prayojanayod‌dhṛbhyaḥ || 4.2.56 ||
`samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti vacanātsaṃgrāmavācibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, na prayojanayod‌dhṛbhyaścaramanirdiṣṭebhya ityāśaṅkyāha--so'syeti samarthavibhaktirityādi | prathamāsamarthaviśeṣaṇamiti | tena viśeṣyadvāreṇa prayājanayoddhāra eva prathamanirdiṣṭāḥ | pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ saṃgrāma iti | tena tad‌dvāreṇa saṃgrāmaścaramanirdiṣṭaḥ ||
ghañaḥ sāsyāṃ kriyeti ñaḥ || 4.2.58 ||
asyāmiti pratyayārthaḥ strīliṅga iti | tena liṅgasya vivakṣitatvaṃ darśayati | ghañantātkriyāvācina iti | bhāve yo ghañ‌ tadantādityarthaḥ | śyainampāteti | patanaṃ pātaḥ, śyenānāṃ pāta iti kartari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ, tato ñaḥ, `śyenatilasya pāte ñaḥ' iti mum | prākāra iti | dravyavacano'yaṃ karmaṇi ghañantaḥ, `upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' iti praśabdasyadīrghatvam | sāmānyena cedaṃ vidhānamiti | etadevodāharaṇena draḍhayāta---daṇaaḍapāta iti ||
tadadhīte tadveda || 4.2.59 ||
iha yo'yaṃ granthamadhīte sa taṃ svarūpatā vetti, yaśca vetti so'vaśyamadhīte---ityanyataropādānena siddham, kimarthamimāvarthāvupadiśyete, naitayorāvaśyakaḥ samāveśaḥ, adhyayanam - śabdapāṭhaḥ, arthāvabodhaḥ - vedanam, bhavati ca---kaścitsaṃpāṭhaṃ paṭhati nārthaṃ vetti, kaściccārthaṃ vetti na saṃpāṭhaṃ paṭhati |
dvistad‌grahaṇamityādi | `tadadhīte veda' ityucyamāne samuccayo vijñāyeta, tataśca yastadadhīte veda ca tatraiva syāt‌, yastu kevalamadhīte veda vā na tatra syāt‌; dvistad‌grahaṇe tu vākyabhedenādhīyānaviduṣoḥ pṛthakpratyayavidhānaṃ sidhyati | nanu ca `tadasya tadasminsyāt‌' ityatra nānārthanirdeśe pratyekaṃ samarthavibhaktiḥ sambandhanīyeti dvistad‌grahaṇena nyāyo vyutpādayiṣyate, ata eva `tena dīvyati' ityatra pratyarthaṃ pratyayo bhavati ? na brūmaḥ---ihaiva dvistad‌grahaṇamadhīyānaviduṣoḥ pṛthagvidhānārthamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? uttaratra `kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭhṭhak‌', `vasantādibhyaṣṭak‌' ityatrāpi, kiṃ ca kāraṇaṃ na syāt ? kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadeyaṃ vasantādayo'pyarthāḥ, na teṣāmadhyayanaṃ sambhavati, tasya śabdaviṣayatvāt‌, tatsahacarite tu granthe sambhavati, gauṇatvāttu na gṛhyate, mukhya eva tvarthe vedanaṃ sambhavatīti tebhyo viduṣyeva syād‌, nādhyetari | punastad‌grahaṇāttu yatnād‌ gauṇasyāpi grahaṇāttatrāpi bhavati ||
kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak‌ || 4.2.60 ||
kratuviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, yadi syādukthādiṣveva paṭhet | kratusāmānyavācināmapi sobhayāgādīnāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ na bhavati; ukthādiṣu yajñaśabdasya pāṭhāt‌ | tasmādviśeṣavācināmeva grahaṇaṃ tebhyo mukhyārthavṛttibhyo veditari pratyayaḥ, tatpratipādanaparagranthavṛttibhyastvadhyetari | vārttikasūtrika iti | vṛttau sādhu vārttikam `kathādibhyaṣṭak‌' | vārttikaṃ ca tatsūtraṃ ceti karmadhārayātpratyayaḥ | evaṃ sāṃgrahasūtrika iti | kalpasūtramiti karmadhārayaḥ, samāhāradvandvo vā |
yajñāyajñīyātpareṇeti | enapā yoge pañcamī cintyā, enabapi paraśabdātpākṣikaḥ, yadā tadvidhau `uttarādharadakṣiṇādātiḥ' iti nānuvartate, dikśabdebhya ityevānuvartate | na ca tānyadhīyāne pratyaya iṣyata iti | ṭhag‌, aṇ‌---ca pratyayadvayamapi neṣyate, tenokthānyadhīyata iti vākyameva bhavati | atra ca abhidhānameva śaraṇam, sāmalakṣaṇaṃ prātiśākhyam | aukthikya iti | aukthikānāmānnāyaḥ, idamarthe `chandogaukthika' iti ñyaḥ | aukthikyaśabdācca pratyayo na bhavatīti | aṇpratyaya ityarthaḥ, idaṃ prasaṅgāduktam | sūtrāntāditi | atyalpamidamucyata ityāha---vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāditi vaktavyamiti | vidyā cetyādivākyenātiprasaktasyāpavādaḥ | aṅgādipūrvo vidyāśabdaḥ pratyayaṃ notpādayatītyarthaḥ | traividya iti | tryavayavā vidyā trividyā, tāmadhīte traividyaḥ | tisro vidyā adhīta iti tu vigrahe `dvigorluganapatye' iti lukprasaṅgaḥ |
yāvakrītika iti | yavakrītamadhikṛtya kṛtamākhyānaṃ yavakrītaśabdenocyate, evaṃ praiyaṅgavamadhikṛtya kṛtamupacārātpraiyaṅgavamucyate | vāsavadattika iti | vāsavadattāmadhikṛtya kṛtā ākhyāyikā, `adhikṛtya kṛte granthe' ityatrārthe `vṛddhācchaḥ', tasya `lubākhyāyikābhyo bahulam' iti lup‌, tato'nena ṭhak‌ | evaṃ saumanottarikaḥ, aitihāsika iti | iti hāsīditi yatrocyate sa itihāsaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsādhuḥ |
sarvasāderiti | sarvādeḥ, sāderdvigoścotpannasya patyayasya lo bhavati lugbhavatītyarthaḥ, arthavataḥ saśabdasya grahaṇātsarvaśabdaḥ pṛthagupāttaḥ, `dvigośca' ityanena `dvigorluganapatye' ityayameva luk‌ smāritaḥ | sarvaveda iti | sarvavedānadhīte ityaṇo luk‌ | savārttika iti | varttikāntamadhīte iti antavacane sahaśabdasyāvyayībhāvaḥ, `avyayībhāve cākāle' iti sabhāvaḥ, tato'ṇo luk‌ |
anusūriti | anusūśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati, lakṣyalakṣaṇaśabdau cetyarthaḥ | ānusuka iti | anusūmadhīta iti ṭhak‌, tasya `isusuktantātkaḥ' iti kādeśaḥ, `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ |
padottarapāditi | padaśabda uttarapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ, pūrvapadamadhīte pūrvapadikaḥ | evamuttarapadikaḥ |
śataṣaṣṭeriti | śataśabdātṣaṣṭiśabdācca paro yaḥ pathinśabdastadantāt‌ ṣikan‌ bhavati | ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ ||
anubrāhmaṇādiniḥ || 4.2.62 ||
brāhmaṇāsadṛśa iti | `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti sādṛśye'vyayībhāvaḥ |
codayati---matvartha iti | pariharati---tatraitasmāditi | dūṣayati---anabhidhānāditi | sākṣātparihāramāha---aṇo nivṛttyarthaṃ tu vacanamiti | kvacittu matvartha ityādi na paṭhyate ||
vasantādibhyaṣṭhak‌ || 4.2.63 ||
vasantasahacarita iti | yatra vasanto varṇyate yo vā vasante'dhyeyaḥ | vasantasāhacaryāttācchadyaṃ labhate |
ukthādiṣvete paṭhitavyāḥ, te vā vasantādiṣu ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | atharvanśabdo'tra paṭhyate, sa upacāreṇa prokte granthe vartate | atharvaṇamadhīte ātharvaṇikaḥ, `dāṇḍināyanahāstināyana' iti nipātanāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopābhāvaḥ ||
proktālluk‌ || 4.2.64 ||
proktasahacarita iti | arthasya proktatvādarthena ca pratyayasya paurvāparyāyogānmukhyārthāsambhavād‌ gauṇasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ | apara āha---proktaśabda iha svaryate, tena tadadhikāravihitaḥ pratyayo gṛhyata iti | yadi vā prokte bhavaḥ prokta iti sautro'yamataddhaitanirdeśaḥ | pāṇinīyamiti | nanu paṇo'syāstīti paṇī, tasyāpatyaṃ pāṇinaḥ, pāṇinasyāpatyaṃ paṇino yuvā pāṇiniḥ, tataḥ `tena proktam' ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ `yūni luk‌' iti iño luki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `iñaśca' ityatra `kaṇaavādibhyo gotre' ityataḥ `gotre' ityanuvartate, teneñaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---gotre ya iñ‌ vihitastadantāditi | tatra ca pāribhāṣikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, tena yūnīño na bhaviṣyati, tato vṛddhācchaḥ; āpiśaliśabdād‌ `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌, ubhayatrādhyetṛpratyayasya luk‌ | nanvatra luki sati, asati vā tadeva rūpamiti nāsti viśeṣaḥ ? tatrāha---striyāṃ svareca viseṣa iti | asati luki striyām `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ‌' ityādinā ṅīp‌ syāt, aṇsvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ ca | luki tu sati ṭāb‌ bhavati, chasvareṇa madhyodāttatvaṃ ca | āpiśale tu svare nāsti viśeṣaḥ, yathā tu luki satyapiśaletyatra ṅībna bhavati, tathā `anupasarjanād‌' ityatra pratyapādi ||
sūtrācca sopadhāt‌ || 4.2.65 ||
aṣṭakaṃ sūtramiti | aṣṭāvadhyāyāḥ parimāṇamasya, `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' iti `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan‌' |
saṃkhyāprakṛteriti vaktavyamiti | saṃkhyā prakṛtiryasya pratyayasya tadantātkopadhāditi vaktavyamityarthaḥ | kālāpakamadhīte kālāpaka iti | kalāpinā proktamedhīyate kālāpāḥ, `kalāpino'ṇ‌', `nāntasya ṭilope sabrahmacāri' ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṣṭilopaḥ, tataḥ `tadadhīte' ityaṇ‌, proktālluk‌ | kālāpānāmāmnāya iti `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌', kālāpakam, tataḥ `tadadhīte' ityaṇ‌, tasya lugna bhavati | yadi syād‌ ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ syāt‌, lugabhāve tvaṇa eva svaro bhavati, striyāṃ ca ṅīb‌ bhavati |
catuṣṭaya iti | catvāro'vayavā asya `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap', `hrasvāttādau taddhite' iti mūrddhanyaḥ ||
chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi || 4.2.66 ||
proktagrahaṇamanuvartate iti | taddhyanuvartamānameva pūrvasūtra ārambhasāmarthyānna sambadhyate | chandāṃsi ca brāhmaṇāni ceti | tadvācīni śabdarūpāṇītyarthaḥ | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśāt‌, aproktapratyayāntatvācca | proktapratyayāntānīti | proktāditi pañcamyantaṃ prakṛtaṃ prathamābahuvacanāntaṃ vipariṇamyate, `chandobrāhmaṇāni' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāditi bhāvaḥ | adhyetṛveditṛpratyayaviṣayāṇītyanenaitaddarśayati---tacchabdenādhyetṛveditṛpratyayaḥ parāmṛśyate, vidheyatayā pradhānatvāt‌; nādhyetṛveditāsavarthau, tayoḥ pratyayavidhau guṇabhāvāditi | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? adhyetṛviṣayamapi vākyaṃ nivarttitaṃ bhavati | ananyabhāvo viṣayārtha iti | grāmasamudāyādivṛttistu viṣayaśabdo'sambhavānna gṛhyate | atra yadyadhīte vedetyanuvarteta, tato'dhyetṛveditṛvivakṣāyāmeva tadviṣayatā vidhīyeta, tataśca tadviṣayameva vākyaṃ nivartayet, na kriyāntaraviṣayam, nāpi svātantryamupādhyantarayogaṃ ca | yadāha---tatra `yathādhikārāttadviṣayaprasaṅgaḥ' iti | tasmātproktagrahaṇamevānuvartate, nādhīyate vedeti | tacchabdena ca pratyayaḥ parāmṛśyate, viṣayaśabdaśca ananyabhāvārthaḥ | tena sarvametatsvātantryādi nivartate | āha ca---`siddhaṃ tu proktādhikāre tadviṣayavacanāt‌' iti | proktagrahaṇamevādhikriyate, nādhīte vedetyetāvarthāvityarthaḥ |
iha proktapratyayāntasya bahuprakāratā dṛśyate---svātantryam, upādhyantarayogaḥ, vākyam, adhyetṛveditroḥ pratyaya iti | svātantryaṃ tāvat‌---pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyamiti | proktārtha eva vṛttiḥ; upādhyantarayogaḥ | mahatpāṇinīyamiti vākyam | pāṇinīyamadhīta iti pratyayaḥ---pāṇinīyāśchāttrā iti | chandobrāhmaṇavācināṃ tu proktapratyayāntānāṃ nityamadhyetṛveditṛpratyayāntavaiveṣyate, na tu svātantryādi, tadarthamidamārabhyate, tadāha---teneti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā'rthadvayasyāpiṃ tantreṇa vigrahaḥ kartavya iti darśayati | kaṭhena proktamadhīyate kaṭhāḥ, vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇiniḥ, tasya `kaṭhacarakālluk‌' iti luk‌ tataḥ `tadadhīte' ityaṇ‌, tatastasyāpi `proktālluk‌' iti luk | mudapippalādaśabdābhyāṃ proktārtho autsagiko'ṇ‌ | śeṣaṃ yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat‌ | ṛcābhaḥ-vaiśampāyanāntevāsī | evaṃ tāṇḍyaḥ | vājasaneyaśabdaḥ śaunakādiḥ | tāṇḍina iti | `apatyasya' iti yalopaḥ | bhāllaviśabda iñantaḥ | śāṭyaśabdād‌ gargādiyañantād‌ `yañiñośca' iti phak‌ | aitareyaśabdaḥ śubhrādiḍhagantaḥ, tebhyaḥ `purāṇaprokteṣu' iti ṇiniḥ, sarvatrādhyetṛpratyayasya luk‌ |
brāhmaṇaviśeṣapratipattyarthamiti | brāhmaṇasya viśeṣaḥ purāṇaproktatvam | yājñavalkyānīti | yājñavalkyaśabdaḥ kaṇvādiḥ, sulabhādautsargiko'ṇ‌, atra svātantryaṃ bhavati | `purāṇaprokteṣu' ityatra vakṣyati---`yājñavalkyādayo hyacirakālapravṛttā ityākhyāneṣu vārtā' iti | kāśyapinaḥ, kauśikina iti | `kāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ' | pārāśariṇa iti | pārāśaryaśabdād‌ gargādiyañantāt‌ `pārāśaryaśilālibhyām' iti ṇiniḥ, pūrvavadyalopaḥ | karmandina iti | `karmandakṛśāśvādiniḥ' | piṅgaśabdātpurāṇaprokteṣu' iti ṇiniḥ ||
tadasminnastīti deśe tannāmni || 4.2.67 ||
itikaraṇastataścedvivakṣeti | nanu tannāmagrahaṇādevātiprasaṅgo na bhaviṣyati ? tanna; dvividhaṃ nāma---kadācitkenacitsaṅketitam, nityaṃ vyavahārānupāti | tatra dvitīyasya parigrahārthamitikaraṇaḥ kriyate, bhūmādiviśeṣaparigrahārthaṃ ca | `tannāmni' ityetattu nāmadheyatāvirodhino balīyaso'pi pratyayān‌ bādhitum , anyathā nāprāpte matupyārambhāttasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ | tadapavādaistviniṭhanādibhiḥ saha sampradhāraṇāyāmapavādavipratiṣedhādiniṭhanādaya eva syuḥ ||
tena nirvṛttam || 4.2.68 ||
nirvṛttamityantarbhāvitaṇyarthād‌ vṛteḥ karmaṇi ktaḥ ||
tasya nivāsaḥ || 4.2.69 ||
ṛjunāvāmiti | ṛjvī nauryeṣāṃ teṣāmityarthaḥ ||
adūrabhavaśca || 4.2.70 ||
adūramantikaṃ tatra bhavatītyadūrabhavaḥ, nipātanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ | vidiśāyā iti | `dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyanyatarasyām' iti ṣaṣṭhī | cakāra ityādi | asati tu tasminnānantaryādayamevārtha uttaratra sambadhyeta ||
aurañ‌ || 4.2.71 ||
araḍuḥ-kṣattriyaviśeṣaḥ | nadyāṃ tu matupparatvāditi | āraḍavamityādiraño'vakāśaḥ, `nadyāṃ matup' ityasyodumbarāvatītyādiḥ ||
matośca bahvajaṅgāt‌ || 4.2.72 ||
caturarthika iti | caturṇāmarthānāṃ samūhaścaturarthī, tatra bhavaḥ, adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ‌ | taddhitārthe dvigau tu ṭhaño luk‌ syāt‌ |
aṅgagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | `matośca vahvacaḥ' ityevāstu, vyadhikaraṇe pañcamyau, bahvaco yo vihito matup‌ tadantāditi vijñāyamāne siddhyatyeva vivakṣitamiti praśnaḥ | matubantaviśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūditi | anyathā sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati, vaiyadhikaraṇyasyāyuktatvāt‌ tasyaiva | vaśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi vibhāvaḥ | asti cedidānīṃ kvacidabahvañ‌ matvānto yadarthaṃ bahvajgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ ? astītyāha---svavān‌, śvavān‌ ||
udakca vipāśaḥ || 4.2.74 ||
mahatī sūkṣmekṣiketi | evaṃ nāma svare'pyācāryo'vahita iti ācāryasya praśaṃsaiṣā ||
suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.2.77 ||
aña iti | `aṇgrahaṇarahitasūtrābhiprāyametat | tasya tu prayojanaṃ svayameva vakṣyati---aṇgrahaṇaṃ matupo bādhanārtham' iti | tena vastuto matupo'pyayamapavādaḥ | athāṇgrahaṇaṃkimartham, na suvāstvādibhyo yathā vihitamityevocyeta, punarvacanāddhai ko vihito na ca prāpnoti sa eva bhaviṣyati sa cāṇeva ? tatrāha---aṇgrahaṇamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe madhye'pavādanyāyena yatāvihitamityucyamāno'ṇaña eva bādhakaḥ syād‌, nadīmatupā tu paratvādvādhyeta, punaraṇgrahaṇāttu matupo viṣaye bhavatītyarthaḥ | kiñca---`orañ‌' ityasya nadyāṃ matupparatvādvādhaka ityuktam, tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe yatāvihitamityucyamāne nadyām `orañ‌' eva syād‌, vacanaṃ tu matupo bādhanārthaṃ syāt‌ | tasmādetadarthamapyaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ||
roṇī || 4.2.78 ||
kevalastadantaśceti | anyathā grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhātkevalādeva syāt‌, na tadantāt‌ | roṇīti punaḥ śāstranirapekṣeṇa nirdeśena śāstranirapekṣatvamiha sacyata iti paribhāṣayā anapekṣaṇāttadantādapi bhavati | nanu ca roṇīti nedaṃ prātipadikam, strīpratyayāntatvāt‌; na ca `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' ityatra liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam, yena strīpratyayāntenāpi tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyeta, svarūpavidhiviṣayā paribhāṣeyaṃ prātipadikasya svarūpagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyuktatvāt‌ ? yathākathañcitprātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti bhāṣyakārapakṣaḥ, tadāśrayeṇaitaduktam | evaṃ ca vṛttikārasyāpyayameva pakṣaḥ | ṅyāpsūtretu parapakṣo darśita iti gamyate | ki siddhaṃ bhavati ? kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayati---`ṇāviṣṭhavad' iti ṭilopaḥ siddho bhavati ||
vuñchaṇkaṭhajilaseniraḍhañṇayayaphakphiñiññyakakṭhakorīhaṇakṛśāśvaryakumudakāśatṛṇaprekṣāśmasakhisaṅkāśabalapakṣakarṇasutaṅgamapragadinvarāhakumudādibhyaḥ || sūtre kumudaśabdo dvirupādīyate, tatrārīhaṇakṛśāśvarśyakumudāśca kāśatṛṇādayaśceti dvandvayordvand3karaṇādekaśeṣābhāvaḥ | kumudādiṣviti | ṛśyāderanantareṣu autsargiko'pi tatra iṣyata ityādi yaduktaṃ tadevāptaprayogeṇa draḍhayati---tathā coktamiti | `lupiyuktavad‌' ityatra bhāṣyakāraṇaitaduktam | athāsmātprayogādviśeṣavihitānāmeva pakṣe lub bhavatīti kasmānnocyate ? tathā vā bhavatu; sarvathā cātūrūpyamevātra naḥ samīhitam ||
śarkarāyā vā || 4.2.83 ||
kumudādiṣviti | ṛśyādyanantareṣu | pāṭhasāmarthyāditi | nitye hi lupi gaṇayorasya pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt‌ | śakareti | aṇe lup‌ | śārkaramiti | tasyaiva śravaṇam | śarkarikamiti | kumudāditvāṭṭhac‌ | śārkarakamiti | varāhāditvātkak, `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ | śārkarikam, śarkarīyamiti | uttarasūtreṇa ṭhakchau ||
nadyāṃ matup‌ || 4.2.84 ||
`tadasyāstyasmin‌' iti matupi siddhe vacanamidaṃ tadasminnastīti prāptasyāṇo bādhanārthaṃ nivṛttādyarthaṃ ca, tatsūcitam---cāturathiṃka iti | deśasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nadīti | yadyapi `viśiṣṭaliṅga' ityatroktam---`nadīgrahaṇamadeśatvāt‌ janapado hi deśaḥ' iti, iha tu nadyāṃ deśa iti; sambandhasāmarthyādajanapado deśagrahaṇena gṛhyate, evaṃ ca parvateṣvapi cāturarthiko bhavati | anye tvāhuḥ---nadyapi deśa eva, lokaprasiddheḥ; `viśiṣṭaliṅga' ityatra tu nadīgrahaṇaṃ yasya dvandvasya sarva evāvayavo nadīvacanastatparigrahārtham, yatra kaścidavayavonadīvacanaḥ, kaścidanyadeśavācī---tatra mā bhūdityevamarthamiti | udumbarāvatītyādau `matau bahvaco'najirādīnām' iti dīrghatvam | bhāgīrathīti | `tena nirvṛttam' ityaṇ ||
kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ḍ‌matup‌ || 4.2.87 ||
kumudvānityādau jhayaḥ `mādupadhāyāśca' iti vatvam | atha vakārādireva kasmānna vihitaḥ ? jñāpanārtham, etajjñāpayati---anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | tena mahiṣmāniti siddhaṃ bhavati, mahiṣācceti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | etenaitadapi nirastam---prakṛtasyaiva matupo ḍittvātideśena siddhamiti, na hi ḍittvātideśe pūrvoktaṃ jñāpanaṃ samarthitaṃ bhavati ||

naḍādīnāṃ kuk‌ ca || 4.2.91 ||

śeṣe || 4.2.92 ||
apayuktādanyaḥ śeṣa iti | śabdārthakathanametat | tasyaiva prakaṃraṇādāgataṃ viśeṣamāha---apatyādibhya iti | ete hyatropayuktāḥ | caturarthaparyantebhya iti | catvāro'rthāḥ `tadasminnasti' ityādayaḥ paryanto yeṣāmiti vipado bahuvrīhiḥ | cāturarthyaparyantebhya iti pāṭhe samāhāradvigoścāturvarṇyāditvātsvārthe ṣyañ‌ | ye tu paṭhanti---cāturarthaparyantebhya iti, te prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇamicchanti | kimarthaṃ punaḥ śeṣavacanam ? śeṣe ghādayo yathā syuḥ, apatyādiṣu mā bhūvan‌ | ciranivṛttā apatyādayaḥ ? caturṣvartheṣu tarhi mā bhūvan‌ ; anyathā `orañ‌' ityādayaḥ `naḍādīnāṃ kuk‌ ca' ityevamantā yathā caturartheṣu bhavanti, tathā ghādayo'pi `vibhāṣaā pūrvāhṇābhyām' ityevamantāstatraiva syuḥ | na hyakasmātprakaraṇaṃ vicchidyate | nivartiṣyate tarhi caturjñthāḥ ? asvaritatvālliṅgācca, yadayamutkarādiṣu kāṃścid‌ vṛddhān‌ śabdānpaṭhati---ārdrakā, śāleti; anyathā `vṛddhācchaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ syāt‌ | svārthe tarhi ghādayo mā bhūvan‌ ? anirdiṣṭārthatvāddhi svārtha evasyuḥ, nāmī anirdiṣṭārthāḥ | jātādiṣvartheṣu ghādayo'nuvartiṣyante ? yadyanuvartante yā yā parā prakṛtiḥ tasyāstasyāḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | nārthanirdeśaṃ prati vyagrayoranyo'nyamabhisambandho bhavati | liṅgācca, yadayaṃ kkaciccakāreṇa prakṛtaṃ samuccinoti `raṅkoramanuṣye'ṇ ca' iti, tajjñāpayati---na pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pratyayaḥ parasyāḥ parasyāḥ prakṛterbhavatīti | atha vā---laukiko'dhikāro'pekṣālakṣaṇaḥ | na ca ghādīnāṃ prakṛtyantarāpekṣā, nāpi grāmādīnāṃ pratyayāntarāpekṣā, tasmādaprayojanametatsvārthe mā bhūvanniti | tadeva tarhi prayojanam---apatyādiṣu tarhi mā bhūvanniti | nanu coktam---ciranivṛttā apatyādayaścāturarthī ca nāpekṣyata iti ? na brūmo'patyādīnāmatrābhisambandha iti, kiṃ tarhi ? tasyedamityanenāpatyādiṣvapi prāpnuvanti | katham ? ityāha---tasyedaṃviśeṣā hyapatyasamūhādaya iti | yathā `tasyedam' ityanena pāṇinīyāśchāttrā iti chāttrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu pratyayo bhavati, evamapatyādiṣvapi viśeṣeṣu ghādayaḥ syuḥ; viśeṣeṣu sāmānyabhāvāt‌ |
nanu ca viśeṣaśabdasaṃnidhau sāmānyaśabda upāttaḥ, tatra viśeṣe paryavasyati---kauṇḍinyo brāhmaṇa iti, viśeṣāntare vā---dadhi brāhmaṇebhyastakraṃ kauṇḍinyāyeti | tatrāpatyādiviśeṣasannidhāvupāttaṃ tasyedamiti sāmānyam, yadyapatyādiṣveva paryavasyet‌ sāmānyopādānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi viśeṣāntara eva paryavasāsyati |
kiñca yadyapatyādiṣvapi ghādayaḥ syuḥ, `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' ityatraivāṇādibhiḥ saha vidhīyeran‌, liṅgāccāpatyādiṣu ghādayo na bhaviṣyanti, kiṃ liṅgam ? `pheścha ca' ityatra `phervā' ityeva ṭhagvidhānārthaṃ vaktavyam, ṭhakā mukte `vṛddhācchaḥ' iti tāvacchaḥ siddhaḥ, tadeva chavidhānaṃ jñāpanārtham---na hyapatyādiṣu ghādayo bhaviṣyanti | tathā gotracaraṇādvuñiti samūha idamarthāntarbhūte vuñi siddhe `gotrokṣoṣṭra' iti punarvidhānamapi liṅgamasyārthasya; tathā `rājanyādibhyo vuñ‌' iti rājanyādiṣu daivayātaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, sa ca devayātūnāmapatyāni daivayātavā iti gotrapratyayāntaḥ; tathā'rīhaṇādiṣu bhāstrāyaṇaśabdo gotrapratyayāntaḥ paṭhyante, tatrāpi `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' ityeva siddhaḥ; tadetairliṅgairapatyādiṣu ghādayo na bhaviṣyanti | tadevametatprayojanaṃ nopapadyata iti prayojanāntaramāha---kiñceti | asati he śeṣagrahaṇe prathamenaivārthena sambandhamanubhavatāṃ kṛtārthatā vijñāyeta, dvitīyādiṣu tvartheṣu `prāgdīvyataḥ' iti viśiṣṭāvadhiparicchinneṣvartheṣu vidhīyamānā aṇādaya eva syuḥ, śeṣaśabdastūpayuktādanyatamān‌ jātādīnarthānvīśīkṛtya śaknotyabhidhātumiti sarvatra ghādayaḥ sidhyanti | ataḥ sākalyārthamapi viśeṣavacanaṃ kartavyam | lakṣaṇaṃ cādhaikāraśceti | tatra `tasyedam' ityeva cākṣuṣādayaḥ sidhyanti, pārṣadādayastu `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' iti tasmāllakṣaṇatvaṃ nātīvopayujyate ||
rāṣṭrāvārapārāddhakhau || 4.2.93 ||
vigṛhītādapīṣyate iti | sūtre tu saṃghātasyaiva grahaṇam; anyathā vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na syāt‌ | viparītācceti | iyamapīṣṭireva ||
grāmādyakhañau || 4.2.94 ||

kattryādibhyo ḍhakaña || 4.2.95 ||

kulakukṣigrīvābhyaḥ śvāsyalaṅkāreṣu | ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham ? kauleyakaḥ śvā yadā kulaśabdaḥ śvakule vartate tadā tasyāpatyamapi śvaiva bhavati, tatra `apūrvapadādanyatarasyām' iti ḍhakañā siddham; kukṣigrīvāśabdābhyām `dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ‌' iti ḍhañi kṛte āsyalaṅkārayossvārthikaḥ kan‌ bhaviṣyati ||
nadyādibhyo ḍhak‌ || 4.2.97 ||

dakṣiṇāpaścātpurasastyak‌ || 4.2.98 ||

kāpiśyāḥ ṣphak‌ || 4.2.99 ||
bahalyudipardīti | `avṛddhādapi' iti vuñi prāpte vacanam ||
raṅkoramanuṣye'ṇca || 4.2.100 ||
raṅkavo nāma janapadaḥ, tataḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' prāptaḥ, tasya `avṛddhādapi' iti vuñ‌ bādhakaḥ, tasya ordeśe ṭhañ‌, tataḥ kopadhādaṇ‌, tataḥ `kacchādibhyaśca' ityaṇ‌ prāptaḥ, tataḥ ṣphagaṇau vidhīyete | kopadhatvādevāṇi siddhe raṅ‌kuśabdasya kacchādiṣu pāṭho manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānārthaḥ | manuṣye paratvāditi | utkṛṣṭatvād‌ apavādatvādityarthaḥ | kacchādipāṭhāramanuṣye'ṇapi siddha iti | nanu ca manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānārthastatra pāṭhaḥ syāt‌, tataśca tadvyatirikate viṣaye ṣphageva syāt‌, yatrāṇ‌ vidhīyate ? naitadasti; kacchādipāṭhasyobhayārthatve bādhakābhāvāt‌ | nañivayuktanyāyena manuṣyasadṛśe prāṇini pratipattiḥ kriyate iti | yastvamanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu rūḍhaḥ, na tasyaiva grahaṇam ; anabhidhānāditi manyate, athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate---paratvādeva vuñi siddhe manuṣyapratiṣedho jñāpayati---`manuṣyatatsthayoḥ' ityasyāpyetau ṣphagaṇau bādhakāviti, tena tatsthe ṣphagaṇāveva bhavato na vuñiti ? tanna; aniṣṭatvāt‌ | na hi tasthe ṣphagaṇāviṣyete, kiṃ tahi ? vujñeva | rāṅkavaḥ kambala iti ṣphagna bhavatīti | yathā tu vārttikaṃ bhāṣyaṃ ca tathātra ṣphagiṣyate, manuṣyapratiṣedhaśca pratyākhyātaḥ | yathā''ha---`raṅkoramanuṣyagrahaṇānarthakyaṃ manuṣyatatsthayorvuñvidhānāt‌, tatsthe ṣphagaṇorjñāpakamiti cennāniṣṭatvādaṇgrahaṇānarthakyaṃ ca kacchādibhyo'ṇivadhānāt‌' iti | viśeṣavihitena ca ṣphaketi | anyathā kacchādipāṭhasya prāṇini caritārthatvātprāṇini ṣphageva syāt‌ ||
dyuprāgapāgudakpratīco yat‌ || 4.2.101 ||

varṇau vuk‌ || 4.2.103 ||
tatsamīpo deśo varṇuriti | `adūrabhavaśca' ityarthe `suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ‌' ityaṇ‌, tasya `janapade lup‌' iti lup‌ | tadviṣayārthavācina iti | sa varṇurdeśo viṣayo yasyārthasya tadvācina ityarthaḥ | viṣayagrahaṇena varṇāviti viṣayasaptamī darśayati ||
avyayāttyap‌ || 4.2.104 ||
ameheti | yo'vyayāttyabvihitaḥ so'mādibhya eva smṛta ityarthaḥ |
amāśabdaḥ samīpavācī svarādiḥ, amā samīpe bhavo'mātyaḥ | aupariṣṭa iti | upariṣṭādbhava ityaṇi kṛte `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ | parataḥ śabdaḥ `vibhāṣā parāvarābhyām' ityatasujantaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ | ārātīya iti | `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' ityanityatvajñāpanādatra ṭilopābhāvaḥ |
tyabnerdhruva iti | niśabdād‌ dhruve vācye tyabbhavati | niyataṃ sarvakālaṃ bhavo nityaḥ |

araṇyāṇṇa iti | aṇi sati ṅīp‌ syāditi ṇo vidhīyate |

aiṣamohyaḥ śvaso'nyatarasyām || 4.2.105 ||

tīrarūpyottarapadādaññau || 4.2.106 ||

dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ || 4.2.107 ||

udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodāttāt‌ || 4.2.109 ||

kaṇvādibhyo gotre || 4.2.111 ||
gotramiha na pratyayārtha iti | śeṣādhikārasya bādhaprasaṅgāt‌ | na ca prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | kaṇvādīnāmagotrapratyayāntānāṃ gotre vṛttyasambhavāt‌ | kaṇvādibhyo gotre yaḥ pratyayo vihita iti | pratipadavihito yañeva gṛhyate | evaṃ ca kṛtvā gotramapi pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate, na tvapatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyata ityapatyamātrasya grahaṇam---kaṇvo devatā'syeti | nanu `kaṇvādibhyaḥ' ityucyamāne kathamaṇantātprasaṅgaḥ ? kathaṃ vā yañantebhyaḥ syād‌ yeneṣṭaṃ tāvatsidti ? evaṃ manyate---kevalebhyaḥ kaṇvādibhya autsargika evāṇ‌, sidhyati, chāpavādatvādyogasya kaṇvādyavayave taddhitānte kaṇvādiśbdo vartiṣyata iti ||
iñaśca || 4.2.112 ||
gotra ityeveti | pūrvatra pāribhāṣikasya gotrasya grahaṇamityuktam, ihāpi tadevānuvartate, tenātrāpi pāribhāṣikasyaiva grahaṇādiha na bhavati---pāṇineryūnacchāttrāḥ pāṇinīyā iti sautaṅgameridamiti | sutaṅgamaśabdād‌ vuñchaṇādisūtreṇa cāturthika iñ‌ | atrāpatyatvameva nāstīti sutarāmagotratvādbhavati pratyudāharaṇam ||
na dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu || 4.2.113 ||

vṛddhācchaḥ || 4.2.114 ||
avyayatīretyādi | avyayāttyab‌ bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ---amātyaḥ, chasyāvakāśaḥ---śālīyo mālīyaḥ, ārācchabdāccho bhavati---ārātīyaḥ | `amehakvatasitrebhyaḥ' iti parigaṇanamanapekṣyāyaṃ vipratiṣedhaḥ | tīrottaravidheravakāśaḥ---kāśyatīraḥ, chasya sa eva; vāyasatīrāccho bhavati vāyasatīriyaḥ | rūpyottaravidheravakāśaḥ---cārarūpyaḥ, chasya sa eva; māṇirūpyācchaḥ prāptaḥ, taṃ cāpi yopadhalakṣaṇo vuñ‌ bādhate---māṇirūpyakaḥ | prāptimātrāśrayeṇa tu chasya rūpyottarapadalakṣaṇasya ca ñasya vipratiṣedha uktaḥ | udīcyagrāmalakṣaṇasya vidheravakāśaḥ--śivapura---śaivapuraḥ, vāḍavakarṣāccho bhavati---vāḍavakarṣīyaḥ| kopadhavidhiḥ---`prasthottarapadapaladyādikopadhādaṇ‌' ityayaṃ vivakṣitaḥ, sa tasmāddhi parasthastasyāvakāśaḥ---`prasthottarapadapaladyādikopadhādaṇ‌' ityayaṃ vivakṣitaḥ, sa tasmāddhi parasthastasyāvakāśaḥ---nilīnaka---nailīnakam, ulūkā asminsanti `tadasminnasti' ityaṇ‌, aulako nāma grāmastatra bhavaḥ, tasmāccho bhavati---aulūkīyaḥ | yastu `kopadhādaṇ‌' ityaṇ‌, sa janapadavuño'pavādaḥ, tasyāpi `vṛddhādakekānta' ityatra `kopadhagrahaṇaṃ sosukādyartham' iti vihitaścho bādhako bhavati ||
bhavataṣṭhakchasau || 4.2.115 ||

avṛddhāttu bhavati iti | śatrantāt‌ | kvacittu bhavataḥ śaturityeva pāṭhaḥ ||
kāśyādibhyaṣṭhaññiṭhau || 4.2.116 ||

ordeśe ṭhañ‌ || 4.2.119 ||

dhanvayopadhād‌ vuñ‌ || 4.2.121 ||
dhanvavācina iti | dhanvaviśeṣavācina airāvatāderityarthaḥ | svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, vṛddhādhikārāt‌ | pāredhanvaka iti | `pāremadhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, `acaśca' iti ṭac‌ samāsantaḥ, vuñi yasyeti lopaḥ | yadi tu dhanvaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ, tataḥ `napuṃsakādanyatarasyām' iti ṭajabhāvapakṣe vuñi' nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ | sāṅkāśyakāmpilyaśabdau vuñchaṇādisūtreṇa ṇyāntau ||

ropadhetoḥ prācām || 4.2 123 ||
īkārāntācceti | hrasvasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tadantasya prāgdeśavācino'sambhavāt| ekacakra iti | ekacakrā nāma pāgdeśe nagarī, tatra `eṅ‌ prācāṃ deśe' iti vṛddhasaṃjñā, kakandena nirvṛttā nagarī kākaṃndī, strīṣu `sauvīrasālvaprākṣa' ityañ‌ | taparakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | na tu hrasvaplutayonivṛttyartham ; tadantasya prāgdeśavācino'sambhavāt‌, īkārasyānaṇtvena tayoraghaṇācca | asati tu takāre `ropadhayoḥ' ityucyamāne kimatra gṛhītamiti vispaṣṭaṃ na jñāyate | takāre tu sati varṇanirdeśo niścīyate, tatraiva tasya prasiddhatvāt | `īkāraropadhayoḥ' iti nirdeśe gauravaprasaṅgaḥ ||
janapadatadavadhyośca || 4.2.124 ||

madravṛjyoḥ kan‌ || 4.2.131 ||
