padamañjarī
yuṣmadasmadoranyatarasyāṃ khañca || 4.3.1 ||
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa uttarārthaḥ | ete trayaḥ pratyayā bhavantīti | nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena khañchayoḥ pakṣe'nutpattiḥ pratipādyate, tadanutpattāvapavādābhāvātsvaśāstreṇa `prāgdīvyataḥ' ityanenaivāṇ‌ bhavati, tatkuto'nena pratyayatrayasya vidhānam, cho'pi tarhi naivānena vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cakāro'bhyanujñāpaka eva---yadyanyo'pi kaścitprāpnoti so'pi bhavatīti, tataścho'pi svaśāstreṇa `vṛddhācchaḥ' ityanenaiva bhavati, eka eva tvapūrvaḥ khañ‌ vidhīyate | atha yasya pravṛttāvasya tātparyaṃ sa sarvo'nena vidhīyata iti chasyānena vidhānam | yadyevam, aṇo'pyanenaiva vidhānam, na khañchayoranutpattimātre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya tātparyam, tasya mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāt, kiṃ tarhi ? aṇaḥ pravṛttāvapi | tasmāttātparyatastraya ete pratyayā bhavantītyuktam, pratyekaṃ pratyayatrayaṃ vidhīyata iti ca | tatra khañpratyayo bhavatītyanena khaña evāpūrvasya vidhānamiti darśitam | anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādyathāprāptaṃ cetyanenāṇo'bhyanujñānam | tyadāditvādyuṣmadasmadośche prāpta ityanenāpi chaṃsyābhyanujñānam | bhāṣye tu yogavibhāgena yathāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ---`yuṣmadasmadoḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, atra `gartottarapadācchaḥ' ityataścho'nuvartate; tataḥ `khañca' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ ||
tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau || 4.3.2 ||
sākṣāditi | pratyakṣeṇa vihitaḥ, svarūpopādānena vihita ityarthaḥ | hetugarbhaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam---yataḥ sākṣādvihitaḥ tataḥ khañeva nirdiśyata iti | tasminniyukte tatraiva jhaṭiti pratyayo bhavati, na cānukṛṣṭaścha iti | cakāro hi samīpavartinaḥ khañaḥ sahāyatāmātramabhidhāya nivartate | tatra sahāyasyānirdeśātprakṛtānveṣaṇam, tatra `gartottarapadācchaḥ' iti yāvadanveṣaṇe chasya pratītiścireṇa bhavati, tena ca nāsau pratyavamarśārhaḥ | yadā tu yathāsaṃkhyanirāsāya pūrvasūtre yogavibhāgastadā naiva cakāreṇa chasyānukarṣaṇamiti na tasya parāmarśaśaṅkā |
nimittayorityādi | dve hi nimitte---khañaṇau, nimittināvapi dvāveva---ādeśau, tataśca sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti matvā praśnaḥ | yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyata iti | `khañaṇoryuṣmākāsmākau' iti vaktavye `tasminnaṇi ca' iti vacanāccakāreṇa vākyabhedasya sūcanādādeśayornimittābhyāṃ pratyekamanabhisambandha ityarthaḥ ||
tavakamamakāvekavacane || 4.3.3 ||
`kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrimasyaikavacanasya grahaṇam', tasya ca kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti luki kṛte yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaparatā na sambhavatīti pratyayalakṣaṇena samarthayitavyā | tadapi pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ vighaṭayannāha---nanu ceti | vacanāditi | yadi punarekavacanaparatvenāṇākhañau viśeṣyeyātām, ko doṣaḥ ? iha ca syātām---yuṣmākaṃ chāttro yauṣmākīṇaḥ, āsmākīna itiḥ, iha ca na syātām---tava chāttrāstāvakīnāḥ, māmakīnā iti | tasmātpūrvasūtre khañaṇparatayā viśeṣyete---yuṣmadasmadī, ekavacanaparatathāpi te evātra viśeṣyete, tataśca vacanād‌ āsmākīnaḥ---pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyeṣaiva gatiḥ |
anvarthagrahaṇamiti | eko'rtha ucyate yena tadekavacanam | atra ca pakṣe `ekavacane' iti prathamādvivacanāntam, na saptamyantam |
arddhādyat‌ || 4.3.4 ||
balyarthaṃ vastu bāleyam, tasyārdham-ekadeśaḥ, tatra bhavaṃ bāleyārddhikam ||
parāvarādhamottamapūrvācca || 4.3.5 ||
`sapūrvapadāṭṭhañ‌ vaktavyaḥ' ityaupasaṅkhyānike ṭhañi prāpte vacanam |
arddhāditi vartate iti | tataśca parāvarādhamottamebhyaḥ paro yo'rddhaśabda ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādevārddhaśabdasya parāvarādipūrvatā vijñāsyate, tatkiṃ pūrvagrahaṇeneti ? evamanantaroktasya codyasyaivaitatsamarthanaṃ parihati---parāvaraśabdāviti | asmāttu pūrvagrahaṇādyatpratyaya eva bhavatīti | pūrvavipratiṣedhasūcanadvāreṇeti bhāvaḥ |
dvikpūrvapadāṭṭhañca || 4.3.6 ||
aṇo'pavāda iti | sautrīṃ prāptimabhipretyaitaduktam, `sapūrvapadāṭṭhañ‌ vaktavyaḥ' ityuktatvāt‌ |
padagrahaṇamityādi | `dikpūrvāt‌' ityucyamāne svarūpavidhiḥ syāt‌, tataśca digardhe jāta ityatreva syāt‌ | padagrahaṇe tu sati---padyate'neneti padam, diśaḥ padaṃ pūrvamasmāditi nipātanātsamāsaḥ ||
grāmajanapadaikadeśādañṭhañau || 4.3.7 ||
paurvārddhā iti | grāmasya pūrvasminnarddhe bhava iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ | yadyapyarddhaśabdo grāmamapekṣate, tathāpyasya nityasāpekṣatvātpradhānatvācca vṛttidvayamapyaviruddham---samāsavṛttiḥ, taddhitavṛttiśca | ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nāñcetyevocyeta ? na caivamucyamāne yato'pi samuccaya prasaṅgaḥ; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt‌ | tasmādvispaṣṭārthaṃ ṭhañgrahaṇam ||
a sāmpratike || 4.3.9 ||
sāmpratikaṃ yuktaṃ nyāyyamucitaṃ samamucyata iti | kasyacitkaścitprasiddha ityanekaśabdopādānam | sampratiśabda idānīmityatraārthe prasiddho'pi nyāyye'pi vartate | dṛśyate hi---`anāptaścatūrātro'tiriktaḥ ṣaḍrātro'tha vā eṣa samprati yajño yatpañcarātra iti', na nyūno nātiriktaḥ, sama ityarthaḥ | sa ca prajñādau paṭhyate | tena sāmpratam, sampratīti ca paryāyau ||
dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ‌ || 4.3.10 ||
anusamudramiti | `anuryatsamayā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ | saptamyantaṃ caitad‌, tad‌ dvīpasya viśeṣaṇam, tadāha---samudrasamīpe yo dvīpa iti ||
kālaṭ‌ṭhañ‌ || 4.3.11 ||
kālaviśeṣavācina iti | svarūpasya ca paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; sandhivelādisūtreṇa sandhivelātrayodaśīprabhṛtibhyo'vṛddhebhyo'ṇvidhānāt‌ | taddhi ṭhaño bādhanārthaḥ, arthagrahaṇe ca tebhyaṣṭhañaḥ prasaṅgaḥ |
iha `gauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyayaḥ' iti nyāyānmukhyayā vṛttyā ye kāle vartante māso'rddhamāsa iti, tata evāyaṃ pratyayaḥ syād‌; na tu gauṇavṛttyā kālavṛtteḥ, kadambapuṣpasāhacaryātkadamba kālaḥ, vrīhipalālasāhacaryād‌ vrīhipalālaṃ kāla ityāderityāśaṅkyāha---yathākathañciditi | yena kenacitprakāreṇa | etadeva spaṣṭayati---guṇavṛttyāpīti | paratra paraśabdapravṛtteryannibandhanaṃ sa guṇaḥ, tannibandhanā vṛttirguṇavṛttiḥ | etacca sandhivelādisūtre'nena kālagrahaṇena nakṣatrāṇi yadviśinaṣṭi tato labhyate | na hi mukhyāthaḥ kālaśabdo'sti nakṣatrāṇāṃ sambhavati | puṣpādisamīpasthena hi candramasā yogāllakṣitalakṣaṇayā puṣpādiśabdānāṃ kāle vṛttiḥ | saiva ca `lubaviśeṣe' iti lubvidhānenāpyanvākhyāyate pauṣādinivṛttyartham, na tvetāvatā kālasteṣāṃ mukhyo'rthaḥ ||
śrāddhe śaradaḥ || 4.3.12 ||
śrāddha iti karma gṛhyate iti | śraddhāsminvidyata iti `prajñāśraddhārcā' iti matvarthīyo'ṇaḥ, śraddhayā sampādyaṃ pitryaṃ karma śrāddhaśabdena ucyata ityarthaḥ | na śraddhāvān‌ puruṣaṃ iti | yadā sa eva ṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthe bhavati tadā puruṣavṛttiḥ śrāddhaśabdaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ śabdasādhāraṇye'pyayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate ? ityāha---anabhidhānāditi | śāradikaṃ śrāddhamiti | yadyatra vihitaṃ tattatra bhavamiti bhave pratyayayaḥ ||
śvasastuṭ‌ ca || 4.3.15 ||
tasya ceti | ṭhañaḥ, na tu śvaḥ śabdasya | kuta etat ? ṭhaño vidheyatvena prādhānyāt‌ | sa ca tuḍāgama ikādeśe kṛte bhavatīti veditavyam | nanu cāntaraṅgatvādikādeśātprāk‌ ṭhañastuṭ prāpnoti, ikādeśastvaṅgadhikāre vidhānādasaṅgasaṃjñāyāmabhinirvṛttāyāṃ paścād‌ bhavanbahiraṅgaḥ, tuṭi ca kṛte pratyayādeṣṭhasyekādeśavidhānādyathā karmaṭha ityatra na bhavati evamatrāpi na syāt‌, yadi punarayaṃ tuk‌ pūrvāntaḥ kriyate; naivaṃ śakyam, `isusuktāntātkaḥ' iti kādeśaḥ syāt‌, tasmādastu parādireva | kathamikādeśaḥ ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ vuñchaṇaādiṣu ṭhacaścitkaraṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati---antaraṅgebhyo'pi pūrvamikādeśa eva bhavatīti | yadi na syāt‌, pratyayasaṃjñāsanniyogaśiṣṭe pratyayasvare kṛte paścādikādeśa iti siddhamantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌ | ṭyuṭyulāvapi bhavati iti | `sāyaṃciram' ityādinā śvaḥ śabdo'vyayam, kālavācī ceti kṛtvā | śauvastikamiti | dvārāditvād‌ vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
sandhivelādyṛtunakṣatrebhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.3.16 ||
aṇgrahaṇaṃ vṛddhāccasya bādhanārthamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe sandhivelādibhyo yathāvihitamityucyamāne yadyapyārambhasāmarthyātkālāṭṭhañ na bhavati; tathāpi sandhivelādiṣu paṭhitātpaurṇamāsīśabdātsvātyādeśca vṛddhācchaḥ syād‌, vacanaṃ tu kālāṭṭhaño bādhanārthaṃ syāt‌ | tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛddhācchasya bādhanārtham | sauvātamiti | `ata sātatyagamane' supūrvāt‌ `ajyatibhyāṃ ca' itīṇ‌ pratyayaḥ, svātyā yuktaḥ kāla ityaṇ‌, tasya `lubaviśeṣe' iti lup‌, tato bhavādāvarthe'nenāṇ‌, `na yvābhyām' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca | jātārthe tu `śrīviṣṭāphalgunī, iti luki svātiriti bhavati | taiṣamiti | atrāpi jātārthe pūrvavallukā bhavatavyamiti bhavādau pratyayaḥ, `tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi yalopaḥ' iti yalopaḥ | saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoriti | sāṃvatsaraṃ phalaṃ parva vā, sāṃvatsarikamanyat‌ ||
prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ || 4.3.17 ||
pravarpatīti prāvṛṭ‌, kvipi `nahivṛti' ityādinā dīrghaḥ | prāvṛṣeṇya iti | bhavārthe pratyayaḥ, jāte tu prāvṛṣaṣṭhapaṃ vakṣyati | `raṣābhyām' ityeva siddhe pratyaye ṇakāroccāraṇam---prāvṛṣeṇyamācaṣṭe prāvṛṣeṇyayateḥ kvip‌, ṇilopaḥ, `lopo vyorvali' iti yalopaḥ, prāvṛṣeṇityatra ṇatvārtham ; anyathā `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌ ||
varṣābhyaṣṭhak‌ || 4.3.18 ||
vārṣikaṃ vāsa iti | `kālātsādhupuṣpyatpacyamāneṣu' iti sādhvarthe ṭhak‌ ||
chandasi ṭhañ‌ || 4.3.19 ||
nabhaśca nabhasyaśca vārṣikāvṛt‌ iti | `tasyedam' ityatrārthe pratyayaḥ, ṛtuśabdaśca ṛtvavayavayormāsayorvartate, varṣartoretau māsāvavayavāvityarthaḥ ||
sarvatrāṇ‌ ca talopaśca || 4.3.22 ||
haimanamiti | yadā taśabdasya samudāyasya lopastadā `an‌' iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌ `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopo na bhavati | yadā tu takārasyānena lopo'kārasya tu yasyeti lopaḥ, tadā tasya `asiddhavadatrābhāt‌' ityasiddhatvātsthānivadbhāvācca ṭilopābhāvaḥ |
nanu ca chandasīti nānuvartiṣyata iti | asvaritatvāt‌ | saivetyādi | yāsāvasvaritatvādanuvṛttiḥ saiva sarvatretyanena śabdenākhyāyate, kimartham ? ityāha--pratyatnādhikyeneti | nanu ca tata evāsvaritatvātpūrvasūtre'pi chandasīti nānuvartiṣyate, tasmādvispaṣṭārthameva sarvatragrahaṇam | bhāṣāyāmapi ṭhañaṃ smarantīti | bhāṣye tu naitadiṣyate, tathā hi---sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam, katham ? hemantaparyāyo heman‌śabdo'sti---`hemannāganīganti karṇau, tasmādetau hemannaśuṣyataḥ, tadi heman‌ pramīyate hemanto bhavati' iti darśanāt, tatra bhāṣāyāṃ deman‌-hemantaśabdayorṛtvaṇi haimanaṃ haimantamiti rūpadvayaṃ siddham, chandasi tu hemno haimanam, hemantasya `hemantācca' iti ṭhañi haimantikam, `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' iti hemantaśabdādevāṇi haimantamiti rūpatrayaṃ siddhamiti | sūtrakāreṇa tu bhāṣāyāmetad‌vṛttiviṣayādanyatrartuvācino hemañchabdasya prayogābhāvān‌ nalopo vihitaḥ, yathāprāptaṃ ca ṛtvaṇiti, anantarastu ṭhañ‌ sarvatragrahaṇasya pūrvatrānvayenaiva sarvatra siddhiriti nāsau samuccīyate | kaḥ punaranayorviśeṣa iti | na kaściditi bhāvaḥ trīṇirūpāṇi bhavantīti | pūrveṇa ṭhañi ekam, anenāṇtalopayordvitīyam, ṛtvaṇi yasyeti lope paramiti trīṇi rūpāṇi ||
sāyamciramprāhṇeprage'vyayebhyaṣṭyuṭyulau tuṭ ca || 4.3.23 ||
iha `yuvoranākau' ityaṅgādhikāre vihitatvādanādeśo bahiraṅgaḥ, tuḍāgamastu pratyayasanniyogena vidhānādantaraṅga iti tenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam, tatra kṛte'nādeśo na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? aṅgasya nimittaṃ yo yustasyānādeśaḥ, tuṭi tvatra sati tyuśabdo'ṅgasya nimittaṃ na yuśabdamātram, tataśca yathā mṛtyurityatrānādeśo na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syāt‌ | yadi punarayaṃ tuk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate ? naivaṃ śakyam ; prātastanamityatra hri visarjanīyo na syāt‌, apadāntatvāt‌ | tasmātparādirevāyaṃ kartavyaḥ, tatra cānādeśo na prāpnoti ? tatrāha---tayoścādiṣṭayostuḍāgamo bhavatīti | ādiṣṭayoriti kṛtādeśayorityarthaḥ | eṣa cārtha ādiṣṭaśabdasya aśeādyacpratyayāntatvena labhyate, ādiśyata ityādiṣṭaḥ, sa yayorasti tāvādiṣṭau, tayorādiṣṭayoriti | etacca `ghakālataneṣu' iti nirdeśāllabhyate, na hyanādiṣṭayostuḍ‌vidhāne nataśabda upapadyate | prātastanamityatra vṛddhācchaṃ paratvādvādhata iti noktam ; chasya bādhakamapi ṭhañaṃ bādhamānayoṣṭyuṭyulorutkṛṣṭabalayordurbalena chena saha sampradhāraṇābhāvāt‌ | makārāntaṃ padamavyayamiti | svarādiṣu paṭhitam | antakarmaṇa iti | antakriyasya, `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' ityasyetyarthaḥ | yadyapyasāvavasānamātravanācī, ghañantastu sāyaśabdo divasāntavacana iti na kālādhikārasya bādhaśaṅkā | pratyayasanniyogeneti | anyatra tvakārānta eva, yathā---sāyāhnaḥ, sāyatara iti | āha ca---saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasyeti | ekārāntatvamiti | nipātyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ | yatra saptamyartho nāsti---prāhṇaḥ soḍho'syetyādau, tadarthaṃ nipātanam | jātādike tvarthe `ghakālataneṣu' ityalukā siddham |
ciraparutparāribhya iti | ciraśabdasya sūtra upādānāt‌ ṭyuṭyulāvāpa bhavataḥ, na tu `kiyattadvahuṣu kṛño'jvidhānāt‌' itivatsūtrasya bādhaḥ | parut‌ - pūrvasmin‌ saṃvatsare, parāri - pūrvatare | pratnaśabdaḥ purāṇavacanaḥ |
agrapaścāḍḍimajiti | kecidatrādiśabdamapi paṭhanti---agrādipaścāditi, te `madhyānmaḥ' ityatrādeśceti vaktavyamiti na paṭhanti | ḍitkaraṇaṃ paścādityatra ṭilopārtham | `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' ityasyaivāyaṃ prapañcārthaḥ ||
vibhāṣā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇābhyām || 4.3.24 ||
saptamyā alugiti `ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' ityatra niraṇāyi---subantāttaddhitotpattiriti, tattatraiva draṣṭavyam | yadi subantāttaddhita utpadyate, kathaṃ pūrvāhṇatana ityatra bhavati ? tatrāha---yadā tviti ||
tatra jātaḥ || 4.3.25 ||
teṣāmataḥ prabhṛtyarthāḥ samarthavibhaktayaśca nirdiśyanta iti | tadidamubhayamanirdeśyam, katham ? `śeṣa iti lakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca' ityuktam, tatra lakṣaṇatayā cākṣuṣaṃ rūpamityādāviva jātādiṣvapyartheṣvaṇādayaḥ siddhāḥ, adhikāratayā ca ghādaya ityarthāstāvanna nirdeśyāḥ pratyayārthena cābhidānasvābhāvyena samarthavibhaktayo'pi labhyante iti tannirdeśyāḥ pratyayārthena cābhidānasvābhāvyena samarthavibhaktayo'pi labhyante iti tannirdeśo'pi na kartavya eva | niyamārthamiti cenna; aniṣṭatvāt‌ | tatraitatsyāt‌---jātādiṣveva taddhitā yathā syuḥ, tatrāste tatra śeta ityādau mā bhūvanniti jātādayo'rthā anukramyanta iti ? tacca naivam; aniṣṭatvāt‌ | anyatrāpi hi taddhitā iṣyante---cākṣuṣaṃ rūpam, śrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ, cāturdaśaṃ rakṣaḥ, dārṣadāḥ saktava iti | yatra tu neṣyante, tatrāsta ityādau---tatrānabhidhānānna bhaviṣyanti, yathā---aṅ‌gulyā khanatītyādau | tasmānnārtho jātādyanukramaṇena |
apavādavidhānārthaṃ tu, prāvṛṣaṣṭhabādīnapavādām̐statra tatrāsaṅkareṇa vakṣyāmīti avaśyānukramitavyā arthāḥ, te'nyārthāḥ santo yogavibhāgenāṇādīnāmapyarthā nirdiśyante |
viśpaṣṭārtham, yāni punaranapavādānyarthādarśanāni, yathā---`kṛtalabhdhakrītakuśalāḥ' iti, tāni śakyānyavaktum ||
saṃjñāyāṃ śarado vuñ‌ || 4.3.27 ||
samudāyena cediti | prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaścetsaṃjñā bhavatītyarthaḥ | kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalā iti yāvaditi | yāvacchabdo'vadhidyotako nipātaḥ ||
amāvāsyāyā vā || 4.3.30 ||
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi | `amāvasyadanyatarasyām' ityatra `amāpūrvasya vaserṇyati pakṣe vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyate' ityuktam | ṇyati ca `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti sāmānyena vṛddhividhānāt‌, amāvāsyāśabdasya nyāyyatvādavṛddhyupadhastasyaivaikadeśavikāra iti bhāvaḥ | ye tviha sūtre sandhivelādiṣu ca hrasvopadhamadhīyate, teṣāṃ dīrghopadhasya na syāt; atadvikāratvāt‌ ||
a ca || 4.3.31 ||
kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na ca`amāvāsyāyā vā' ityucyeta, cakārād‌vuñ‌, vāvacanādubhayorabhāve'ṇapi bhaviṣyati ? sayatm ; uttaratra tu vikalpānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta | yogavibhāge tu sandhivelādyaṇo'bhyanujñānāya pūrvasūtre vāgrahaṇasāmarthyādasyāpi vikalpasiddheriha vāgrahaṇam̐ nānuvarttyamiti vyavadhānāduttaratra vikalpasya nivṛttiḥ siddhā bhavati ||
aṇañau ca || 4.3.33 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyārthaḥ ||
śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhāsvātitiṣyapunarvasuhastaviśākhāṣāḍhābahulālluk‌ || 4.3.34 ||
kṛttikāparyāyasya bahulāśabdasyātra dvandvaikavadbhāvena napuṃsakahrasvatvena nirdeśaḥ, na bahvarthādānanimittasya bahulāśabdasya; śraviṣṭādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt‌ | citreti | `luktaddhitaluki' iti luki kṛte punaṣṭāp |
gaurādipāṭhān‌ ṅīṣiti | `revatī nakṣatre, rohiṇī nakṣatre' iti tatra paṭhyate, na cemau nakṣatravācinau; jātārthavṛttitvāt‌ | tasmād‌ `gaurādiṣu pippalyādayaśca' iti pāṭhātteṣāṃ cāvṛtkṛtatvādatra ṅīṣityarthaḥ |
ṭānau vaktavyāviti | striyāmityapekṣyate, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ, nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, vidhānasāmarthyāccānayorlugna bhavati |
chaṇapi vaktavya iti | atra ca `striyām' iti nāpekṣyate ||
sthānāntagośālakharaśālācca || 4.3.35 ||
gośāleti | `vibhāṣā senā' iti napuṃsakatve hrasvatvam | tatsāhacaryātkharaśālasyāpi napuṃsakasya grahaṇam, na tu dvandvaikavadbhāvena hrasvatvam | ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvālliṅgaviśiṣṭayaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgābhyāmapi lugbhavatyeva | yadyapi ṭābantayorapi pāṭhe ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvānnapuṃsakābhyāmapi luk‌ siddhyati, lāghavārthaṃ tu hrasvasya pāṭhaḥ ||
vatsaśālābhijidaśvayuvachatabhiṣajo vā || 4.3.36 ||
vatsaśāleti | hrasvāntasya dīrghāntasya vā grahaṇam | bahulagrahaṇasyaivāyaṃ prapañca iti | aśvayukśatabhipakśabdāvabhipretyaitaduktam ; anyayoranakṣatravācitvāt‌ | abhijiditi | yadyapi nakṣatramapyasti---`abhijinnāma nakṣatrapumapariṣṭādaṣāḍhānāmiti', muhūrtamapyasti ||
nakṣatrebhyo bahulam || 4.3.37 ||
vāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca lugvyavasthāyāṃ siddhāyām, bahulavacanaṃ kvacidanyadevetyetadartham, tena ṭānau vaktavyāvityādi siddhaṃ bhavati | rohiṇa iti | `citrārevatīrohiṇīyaḥ striyāmupasaṅkhyānam' ityetattu striyāṃ niyamena lugarthe, na tu striyāmeva lugartham |
kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ || 4.3.38 ||
yadyatra kṛtaṃ jātamapi tattatra bhavatīti | yadyapi jātaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ na bhavati, svayaṃ jātasyāpi bhāvāt‌ ; kṛtaṃ tu sarvaṃ jātaṃ bhavati, na hyajananasvabhāvaṃkriyate, yathā--vyometi bhāvaḥ | yacca krīta labdhamapi tattatra bhavatīti | atrāpi labdhaṃ sarvaṃ krītaṃ na bhavati ; dānādināpi lābhasambhāvāt‌ | krītaṃ tu labdhameva ; krayasyāpi lābhahetutvādityarthaḥ | tatkimarthaṃ bhedenopādānaṃ kriyata iti | jātalabdhābhyāmeva gatamiti praśnaḥ | śabdārthasyābhinnatvāditi | paravyāpāropahitaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtamityucyate, tadrahitaṃ tu jātamiti; tathā mūlyapradānarūpo yaḥ svīkarturvyāpārastadupahitaṃ rūpaṃ krītāmatyucyate, tadrahitaṃ tu labdhamiti | tatra yathā---viklinna odanaḥ, pakva odana iti śabdārthābhedaḥ, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ | etadeva spaṣṭayati---vastumātreṇeti | vastuta ityarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati---krītaṃ vastuto labdhaṃ bhavatītyetāvat‌, śabdena tu rūpāntaramabhidhīyate | evaṃ kṛtamapi vastṛto jātaṃ bhavati, śabdena tu rūpāntaramabhidhīyata iti draṣṭavyam | upasaṃharati---śabdārthastubhidyata eveti | tatrākriyamāṇe kṛkrītayorupādāne yathā---kvāyaṃ ghaṭaḥ kṛtaḥ, krīto vā iti pṛṣṭe srughne jāto labdha iti cottaraṃ naṃ prayujyate; tathā taddhito'pi na syāt| tasmātkṛtakrītayostaddhitenābhidhānāya bhedenopādānamiti ||
prāyabhavaḥ || 4.3.39 ||
prāyeṇa bhavaḥ, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ |
tatra bhavena kṛtatvāditi | yatprāyabhava ityasya sādhyam, tasya `tatra bhavaḥ' ityanenaiva sādhitatvādityarthaḥ | yo hi rāṣṭre prāyeṇa bhavati tatraivāso bhavatīti `tatra bhavaḥ' ityeva siddham | śaṅkate---anityabhavaḥ prāyabhava iti cediti | yastatra kadācidbhavati kadācinna sa prāyabhavaḥ, yasya tu niyata ādhārādheyabhāvaḥ sa `tatra bhavaḥ' iti pṛthagupādānasāmarthyādbheda āśrīyata iti yadyucyetetyarthaḥ | nirākaroti---muktasaṃśayena tulyamiti | yaṃ bhavānmuktasaṃśayaṃ nyāyyaṃ tatrabhava udāharaṇaṃ manyate---sraughno devadatta iti, tenaiva tulyam, so'pi hi kadācittasmādudakdeśādabhiniṣkrāmati | tatra cedyuktā tatra bhavatā, ihāpi yuktā dṛśyatām | athaitadapi prāyabhavasyodāharaṇam---sraughno devadatta iti | tatrabhavanasya kimudāharaṇam ? tatra nityabhavaḥ sraughnaḥ prākāra iti | yadyevam, `tatra bhavaḥ' iti prakṛtya jihvāmūlāṅ‌guleścho vidhīyate sa tasmindṛṣṭāpacāre na syāt‌, dṛśyate ca--
vānaro'haṃ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dharmataḥ |
rāmanāmāṅkitaṃ cedaṃ paśya devyaṅ‌gulīyakam || iti |
tasmāttatrabhave sāmānye prāyabhavasya viśeṣasyāntarbhāvādanarthakaṃ prāyagrahaṇam ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---`upajānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak‌' prāyabhave yathā syānnityabhave mā bhūt‌---upajānu bhavaṃ gaḍ‌viti | athedānīṃ jānusamīpasthaśarīrāvayayavavācina upajānuśabdāttatra bhava iti prakṛtya `śarīrāvayavādyat‌' iti yatkasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt‌ | ṭhagapi tarhyanabidhānādeva na bhaviṣyati ? tadevaṃ sthitam---etatprāyagrahaṇamanarthakam, tatra bhavena kṛtatvāditi ||
upājānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak‌ || 4.3.40 ||
upajānvādayaḥ sāmīpye'vyayībhāvāḥ, samāhāradvandvasya sautraḥ puṃlliṅganirdeśaḥ ||
sambhūte || 4.3.41 ||
avaklṛptiḥ pramāṇanatirekaśceti | sakṛtprayuktasyāpyanekārthatvamaviruddham, tantrādyāśrayaṇaāditi bhāvaḥ | tatrāvaklṛptiḥ - sambhāvanā, idamevaṃ bhavediti buddhiḥ; pramāṇānatirekaḥ - ādhāraparimāṇādādheyaparimāṇāsyānatirekatā, yasyāṃ satyāṃ sarvamādheyamādhāre'nupraviśati | sraughna iti | devadatta idānīṃ srughne sambhāvyata ityarthaḥ, srughnapramāṇādvā'natiricyate senādiko'rtha ityarthaḥ ||
kośāḍ‌ ḍhañ‌ || 4.3.42 ||
kauśīyaṃ vastramiti | nanu ca na vastraṃ kośe sambhavati, vastradāyāṃ tatkāraṇasya kośasya parāvṛttatvāt‌, na ca kośāntare vastrasya sambhavaḥ, na ca tatreṣyate, tasmādvikāre kośāḍḍhañ sambhūte hyarthānupapattiriti vārttikameva śaraṇam | `tasya vikāraḥ' ityatra prakaraṇe `eṇyā ḍhañ' ityasyānantaram `kośācceti vaktavyam' ityarthaḥ | arthānupapattiriti | kauśeyaśabdasya yo'rtho laukikaḥ sūtravastralakṣaṇastasyānupapattiḥ syāt‌, laukiko'rthaḥ śāstreṇa nānusṛtaḥ syāt‌ | kṛmireva tvabhidheyaḥ prāpnoti sa hi kośe sambhavati | kiñcāviśeṣābhidhānātkhaṅgakośādapi pratyayaḥ prasajyeta, ityata āha---rūḍhireṣeti | rūḍhiśabdeṣu nāvaśyamavayavārtho'nveṣyaḥ, yathā tailapāyikādiṣviti manyate | sūtrakāreṇa tu satkāryavalādāśrayeṇa sambhūte pratyayo vihitaḥ, tatra hi kāraṇadaśāyāmapi kāryasya sattvāt‌ tatra tatsambhavati tadanupapannam | kāryakāraṇayorhi tādātmyamabhisambandhaḥ, na tvādhārādheyabhāvaḥ ||
kālātsādhupuṣyatpacyamāneṣu || 4.3.43 ||
kālaviśeṣavācibhya iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; uttaratrāśvayujyādīnāmanena kālaśabdena viśeṣaṇāt‌ ||
upte ca || 4.3.44 ||
sūtre bhūtakālasyāvivakṣāṃ darsayati | hemante upyante iti | yogavibhāga uttarārtha iti | uttarayogayorukta eva pratyayo yathā syāt‌, sādhvādiṣu mā bhūt‌ ||
āśvayujyā vuñ‌ || 4.3.45 ||
vuño ñakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, uttaratra vṛddhyarthaśca, aśvayugbhyāṃ yukteti pāṭhaḥ, aśvayujodvitvāt‌ `namo'śvibhyāmaśvayugbhyām' iti darśanāt‌ | aśvinīparyāya iti pāṭhaḥ | `tārā aśvayugaśvinī' ityamarasihaḥ | aśvanīparyāyaiti prasiddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ, tatrāśupūrvādanerauṇādika inpratyayaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvādāderhrasvaḥ ||
kalāpyaśvatthavyavabusād‌ vun‌ || 4.3.48 ||
mayūrādiṣu prasiddhānāṃ kalāpyādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ kāle vṛttirna sambhavati, tatkatham `kālaviśeṣavicibhyaḥ' ityuktam ? ata āha---kalāpyādayaḥ śabdā iti | aśvatthena vṛkṣeṇa kālasya sambandho'vyabicārādaviśeṣaṇamiti `phale luk‌' iti luganto'śvatthaśabda ityāha---yasminnaśvatthāḥ phalantīti | apakṛṣṭe yavo yavabusaṃ jātyantaraṃ vā yavādivat‌, yavānāmeva vā busaṃ yavabusam ||
grīṣmāvarasamād‌vuñ‌ || 4.3.49 ||
avarasamamiti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | na cāvaraśabdo digvācī, yena `diksaṅkhye saṃjñāyām' iti niyamātsamāso na syāt‌ | āvarasamakamiti | āgāmināṃ saṃvatsarāṇāmādyavatsare deyamityarthaḥ | apara āha---atīte vatsare deyaṃ yadadyāpi na dattaṃ tadāvarasamakamiti ||
saṃvatsarāgrahāyaṇībhyāṃ ṭhañca || 4.3.50 ||
veti vaktavye iti | vuñi vikalpite pakṣe yathā prāptaṣṭhañeva bhaviṣyatīti manyate | ṭhañgrahaṇamityādi | asati ṭhañgrahaṇe sandhivelādiṣu `saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ' iti pāṭhātphale ṛṇatvena vivakṣite vuñā mukte'ṇeta syāt‌, ṭhañgrahaṇāttu ṭhañeva bhavati ||
vyāharati mṛgaḥ || 4.3.51 ||
vyāharati - śabdāyate ||
tadasya soḍham || 4.3.52 ||
asyeti | neyaṃ soḍhāpekṣayā kartri ṣaṣṭhī, `na lokāvyaya' iti pratiṣedhāt‌, kiṃ tarhi ? kartureva sambandhitvamātravivakṣayā śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | niśāsahacaritamadhyayanamiti | kālasya svarūpeṇāsoḍhatvāttatsahacaritavṛtteratra sūtre grahaṇamiti darśayati ||
tatra bhavaḥ || 4.3.53 ||
kālāditi nivṛttamiti | `tatra jātaḥ' iti prakṛtaṃ tatragrahaṇaṃ kālādhikāreṇa sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāditi punariha tatragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam `saptamyarthamātraṃ yathā gṛhyeta kālasambandhaviśiṣṭaḥ saptamyartho mā grāhi' ityavamarthamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu ca prakṛtaṃ tatragrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre taditi prathamayā samarthavibhaktyā vyavahitam ? netyāha, śakyaṃ hi tadanyatrāpi paṭhitum ||
digādibhyo yat‌ || 4.3.54 ||
senāmukhyamiti | yadantasya senāśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, na tu senāmukhyaśabdātpratyayaḥ; tadantavidhyabhāvāt‌ ||
śarīrāvayavācca || 4.3.55 ||
śarīraṃ prāṇikāya iti | `vyākaraṇasya śarīram' ityādikastu prayogo gauṇaḥ | aṇo'pavāda iti | vṛddhāttu chaṃ paratvādvādhate, pāde bhavaṃ padyam, `padyatyatadarthe' iti padbhāvaḥ | nāsikāyāṃ bhavaṃ nasyam, `nasa nāsikāyā yattaskṣudreṣu' iti nasbhāvaḥ | katham `vego jaṅghorasyaḥ' iti ? kathaṃ ca na syāt‌, na śarīrāvayavasamudāyaḥ śarīrāvayavagrahaṇena gṛhyate | na ca tadantavidhirasti ? niraṅkaśāḥ kavayaḥ ||
dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ‌ || 4.3.56 ||
dṛtiścarmavikāraḥ, śarīrāvayavaśca | kukṣiśabdo dhūmādiḥ, vastirnābheradhaḥ śarīrāvayavaḥ | āheyam viṣādi |
astiśabdaḥ prātipadikamiti | vibhaktipratirūpaṃ nipātasaṃjñakam, tacca tiṅantena samānārtham---astikṣīrā gauriti, dhanavacanaṃ ca astimāniti ||
grīvābhyo'ṇca || 4.3.57 ||
dhamanīvacana iti | dhamanīsaṅghātavacana ityarthaḥ | sa ca yadod‌bhūtāvayavabhede saṅghāte varttate tadā bahuvacanam, yadā tu tirohitāvayavabhede saṅghāte varttate tadaikavacanāntaḥ prayogaḥ ||
gambhīrāññyaḥ || 4.3.58 ||
badirdevapañcajanebhyaśceti vaktavyamiti | `prāgdīvyataḥ' ityatroktam---`devasya yañañau, bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' iti | taccāvaśyaṃ vaktavyam---arthāntareṣvapi yathā syāditi | tasyaiva prapañcārtham, iha tu bahirdevayorgrahaṇam ||
avyayībhāvācca || 4.3.59 ||
kiṃ tahiṃ parimukhāderiti | kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktāvayaṃ viśeṣo labhyata ityāha---parimukhādīnāṃ ceti | caśabdo hetau | digāderanantaraṃ parimukhādigaṇaḥ paṭhyate, tasya nānyatprayojanaṃ sambhavati avyayībhāvagrahaṇasya, parimukhādiviśeṣaṇatayā'nvayasambhavāt‌, tasmātparimukhādereva bhaviṣyati, na sarvasmādavyayībhāvāt‌ | yadyevam, parimukhāderityeva vaktavyamata āha---teṣāmeveti | `parimukhādeḥ' ityucyamāne bahuvrīhitatpuruṣebhyo'pi ñyapratyayaḥ syāt‌, avyayībhāvagrahaṇāttu tebhyo'ṇeva bhavati | uttarārthaṃ cāvaśyamavyayībhāvagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, tatra ye paripūrvāstatra yadi varjanaṃ gamyate tataḥ `apaparibahirañcavaḥ | pañcamyā' ityavyayībhāvaḥ | atha sarvato bhāvaḥ, tato'smādeva nipātanādavyayībhāvaḥ | upapūrveṣu sāmīpye'nupūrveṣu `anuryatsamayā' `yasya cāyāmaḥ' `paścādarthe yadavyayam' iti ca yathābhidhānaṃ samāsaḥ ||
antaḥ pūrvadāṭ‌ṭhañ‌ || 4.3.60 ||
ādhyātmikamiti | `anaśca' iti ṭac‌ samāsāntaḥ | ādhividaikam, ādhibhautikamiti | anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ | adhyātmādirākṛtigaṇa iti | evaṃ ca samānaśabdādityādirasyaiva prapañcaḥ |
ūrdhvaśabdena samānārtha ūrdhvaṃśabda iti | sa caitad‌vṛttiviṣaya eva | apara āha---`ṭhañsanniyogena dama śabda uttare ūrdhvaśabdasyaiva māntatvaṃ nipātyate' iti |
ūrdhvadehācceti | nātra māntatvam |
aihalaukikamiti | pūrvavadubhayapadavṛddhiḥ |
mukhatīyam, pārśvatīyamiti | mukha-pārśva-śabdābhyāṃ saptamyāntābhyāmādyāditvāttasiḥ, tata īyaḥ, avyayatvāṭṭilopaḥ | ayaṃ gahādipāṭhasyaiva prapañcaḥ | etena paraṃ vyākhyātam |
maṇmīyāviti | gahādiṣu `madhyamadhyamaṃ cāṇ‌ caraṇe' iti yatpaṭhitaṃ tatra `pṛthivīmadhyavācī madhyaśabdo gṛhyate' ityuktam, bhavārthe tu tato'nyatrāpi madhyamīyamiti yatā syāditi mīyapratyayavacanam | jātādiṣu pṛthivīmadhyavācina eva madhyamīya iti bhavati, na madhyāntaravācinaḥ | tathā gahādipāṭhena pṛthivīmadhyaṃ nivāsā eṣāmityasminnevārthe mādhyamā iti sidhyati, madhyāntaravācino bhavārthe'pi yathā syāditi maṇ‌ pratyaya uktaḥ |
madhyo madhyaṃdinaṇ‌ cāsmāditi | madhyaśabdo madhyabhāvamāpadyate dinaṇcāsmāt‌ pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
sthāmna iti | sthāmanśabdāntādityarthaḥ | aśvatthāmeti | aśvasyeva sthāma balamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ, tato bhavārthe `sthāmno'kāraḥ' ityakāraḥ tasmānena luk‌ |
vṛkājina iti | aṇo luk‌ |
samānasya tadādeśceti | ānantaryatvalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | adhyātmādiṣviti | viṣayasaptamī urdhvandāmācca dehācceti | ūrdhvaṃśabdāddamaśabdāntāccetyarthaḥ | ūrdhvapūrvādeva ca dehāntādiṣyate | uktaṃ hi prāk‌ `urdhvadehācca, aurdhvadehikam' iti | sthāmno lugajināttatheti | pāṭhe ubhayatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ ||
aśabde yatkhāvanyatarasyām || 4.3.64 ||
vāsudevavargīya iti | `vṛddhācchaḥ' ityasya paratvādyatkhau bādhakāviti vṛddhādapyanena cha eṣitavyaḥ ||
tasya vyākhyāna iti ca vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ || 4.3.66 ||
tasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi | nanu cādhikārārtho'yamiti vakṣyati, bhavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāro'pavādavidhānārthaḥ, kṛtanirdeśau hi tāviti, tatkimityatra yathāvihitavidhānārthatvaṃ vyākhyāyate ? ucyate---tātparyato'pavādavidhānāyādhikārasyānuṣaṅgike'ṇādividhānārthatve ko doṣa iti manyate, agatikagatirhi viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ | ata eva `kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' ityādīnyanapavādānyarthādeśanāni bhavanti | tatra bhaveceti | ayamanuvādaḥ; etasminneva viśeṣe `tatra bhavaḥ' iti vihitatvāt‌ | nanu ca vyākhyānasya pratyayārthasya samīpe śrūyamāṇaścaśabdastatsamānajātīyasyaiva pratyayārthasya samuccayaṃ karoti, na samarthavibhakteḥ; yathā `kedārādyañca' iti pratyayasamīpavarttinā pratyaya eva samuccīyate, na prakṛtiḥ; `ṭhañkavacinaśca' iti prakṛtereva na pratyayaḥ; tataśceha tasyetyupādānādbhavārthe'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādeva pratyayo yuktaḥ, tatrāha---vākyārthasamīpe iti | ihetikaraṇaḥ kriyate---prakṛtaṃ vākyārthaṃ pratyavamarśāmīti | pratyavamarśasya ca prayojanam---nattulyajātīyasyaiva samuccayo yathā syādityetadeveti bhāvaḥ | etameva ca nyāyaṃ nirūpayituṃ pūrvam `tatra bhave ca' ityanuvādaḥ kṛtaḥ |
vyākhyātavyanāgna iti kimiti | vyākyānaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādyaprativyākhyānaṃ tadeva tasyetyanena nirdiṣṭamiti gamyata iti matvā praśnaḥ | pāṭaliputraṃ sukośalayā vyākhyāyata iti neyaṃ kartari tṛtīyā, kiṃ tarhi ? karaṇe sukośalayā karaṇabhūtayā puruṣairvyākhyāyata ityarthaḥ | kathamityāha---evaṃsanniveśamiti | tādṛśo hi pāṭaliputre prākārādisanniveśo yādṛśaḥ sukośalāyām, tena tayā tadvyākhyāyate | yadyevam, tasya vyākhyātavyasya pāṭaliputraśabdo nāmāpi bhavati, tatkathaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? ata āha---na tviti | yadiha vyākhyātavyamabhipretam, na tasya nāma bhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ punarihābhipretam ? yadvyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhaṃ granthātmakam, etadarthameva hi vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, vyākhyātavyamātrasya vyākhyānaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvenaivākṣepasiddheḥ | nanu ca bhavārthametatsyāt‌, na hi tatrākṣepato vyākhyātavyasya lābhaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi nāmagrahaṇaṃ prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ bhaviṣyati |
bhavavyākhyānayoriti | nātrāyamarthaḥ---yo'yaṃ bhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāraḥ so'pavādavidhānārtha iti; pūrvamadhikāratvasyāvyākhyātatvāt‌ | tasmādbhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāro'yaṃ na tvaṇādīnāmarthanirdeśa ityarthaḥ | kimartho'dhikārastatrāha---apavādavidhānārtha iti | aṇādīnāṃ cāyamarthanirdeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha---kṛtanirdeśau hi tāviti | ekaḥ `tatra bhavaḥ' iti, aparaḥ `tasyedam'---ityevaṃ kṛtanirdeśau hi tāvarthau | tasmāttadarthametanna bhavati | pūrvaṃ tvadhikārārthatayāvaśyakarttavyasyānuṣaṅgikamarthanirdeśārthamidamiti vyākhyātam ||
bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ‌ || 4.3.67 ||
amo'pavāda iti | vṛddhācchaṃ tu paratvādvādhate | sāmastaṃ nāma śāstraṃ tasya vyākhyānaṃ sāmastikam | ṣatvādividhāyakaṃ śāstraṃ ṣatvādiśabdenocyate | nataḥ - anudāttaḥ, anataḥ - udāttaḥ | antodāttāḥ prakṛtaya iti | udāhṛtayordvitve'pyevañjātīyāparaprakṛtyapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam, tāśca kutvarutvādayaḥ |
gatisvareṇeti | `gatiranantaraḥ' ityanena | udātta iti varṇagrahaṇam, tena siddhastadantavidhiḥ, yathā `varādanudattād‌' ityatra | tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||
kratuyajñebhyaśca || 4.3.68 ||
agniṣṭomādyartheṣu mantrabrahmaṇakalpeṣu varttamānā agniṣṭomādiśabdā ihodāharaṇam | anantodāttārtha ārambha iti | tatra rājasūya---vājapeyaśabdau kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttau, rājā sūyate, rājñā veha sūyate, vayap‌; tata eva nipātanātsamāsaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā | pīyate'sminniti peyaḥ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' ityadhikaraṇe yat‌; vājo yavāgūbhedaḥ, tasya peyaḥ pāyo vājapeya iti | stutiḥ-stomaḥ, agnestomo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, `parādiśca parāntaśca' ityantodāttaḥ | navairvrīhibhiryajanaṃ navayajñaḥ- āgrayaṇam, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, `kṛduttarapadaprakṛtibhāvena naṅa eva svaro'vatiṣṭhate' ityantodāttaḥ | alpa paryāyaḥ pākaśabdaḥ, pākaścāsau yajñaśca pākayajñaḥ, samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | satyanyārtha etasyārambhe, antodāttādapi yajñābhidhāyinaḥ paratvādanenaiva ṭhañpratyayo yukta ityantodāttānāmupanyāsaḥ |
kratubhya ityeva siddha iti | kratuyajñayoḥ paryāyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | asomayāgebhyo'pīti | anyathā kratuśabdasya somayāge rūḍhatvādanyatra na syāt‌, yajñagrahaṇāttu tebhyo'pi bhavati | evaṃ kevalayajñagrahaṇe'pi sa eva doṣo yaḥ kevalakatugrahaṇe, tasmād gauṇamukhyaparigrahārthamubhayorupādānam ||
adhyāyeṣvevarṣeḥ || 4.3.69 ||
aṣiśabdāḥ pravaranāmadheyānīti | hotrādhvaryuṇā ca pravriyanta iti pravarāḥ - bhṛgvādayaḥ, tadyathā bhārgavacyāvanāpravānaurvajāmadagneti hotā, jamadagnivadurvavadapravānavaccyavanavad‌bhṛguvadityadhvaryuḥ | etena yadyapi mantradarśiṣvṛpiśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tathāpi pravarādyāyapaṭhitānāme grahaṇamiti darśayati | vasiṣṭhasya vyākhyāna iti | vasiṣṭhena dṛṣṭo mantra upacārād‌ vasiṣṭha ityuktaḥ |
vāsiṣṭhī ṛgiti bhavārthe'ṇ‌, evakāraḥ sarvavākyānāṃ sāvadhāraṇatvajñāpanārthaḥ ||
pauroḍāśapuroḍāśātṣṭhan‌ || 4.3.70 ||
puroḍāśāḥ piṣṭapiṇḍā iti | `dāśrṛ dāne' karmaṇi ghañ‌, puro dāśyante dīyanta iti puroḍāśāḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsamāsaḥ, dakārasya ca ḍakāraḥ, etenaitadāha---ākṛtivacanaḥ puroḍāśaśabdaḥ, na yūpāhavanīyādivadadṛṣṭanimitta iti | teṣāṃ saṃskārako mantra iti | `makhasya śiro'si' ityevamādiḥ | puroḍāśasahacarito mantraḥ puroḍāśa iti | mantra eva hi vyākhyātavyo na puroḍāśaḥ ||
chandaso yadaṇau || 4.3.71 ||
atra bhavavyākhyānau dvāvarthau, yadaṇau pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; `tasya vyākhyāne' iti yadaṇau bhavataḥ, `tatra bhavaḥ' iti cetyevaṃ samuccayāt‌ | dvyaca iti ṭhaki prāpta iti | uttarasūtre dvyajgrahaṇena ṭhaki prāpta ityarthaḥ ||
dvyajadabrāhmaṇarkaprathamādhvarapuraścaraṇanāmākhyātāṭ‌ ṭhak‌ || 4.3.72 ||
aṇāderapavāda iti | ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ | tatra ṛkchabdhe dvyakṣu cāṇo'pavādaḥ, puraścaraṇaśabdo'pi lyuḍantaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ | asipratyayo hi saptamyantādutpadyata iti puraḥ śabdaḥ kārakam, `puro'vyayam' iti vā gatiḥ | tena tasmādapyaṇa evāpavādaḥ | brāhmaṇādiṣvantodātteṣu ṭhaño'pavādaḥ, ṛkārānteṣvapyaṇo'pavādaḥ | ye tu tatra bahvaco'ntodāttāsteṣu paratvādayaṃ ṭhañaṃ bādhate | nāmākhyātagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārthamiti | ākhyātārthaṃ vigṛhītagrahaṇam, nāmaśabdāttu dvyactvādeva siddham ||
aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ || 4.3.73 ||
ṭhañāderiti | ādiśabdena ṭhakaḥ chasya ca grahaṇam | tatra vidyānyāyaśikṣāśabdebhyo dvyajlakṣaṇasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ, vyākaraṇaśabdād‌ vṛddhācchasya, śeṣā bahvaco'ntodāttāḥ, teṣvañaḥ | athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na ṛgayanādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta, vacanaprāmāṇyādyo vihito na ca prāpnoti anyena bādhitatvāt‌, sa evāṇ‌ bhaviṣyati ? ata āha--aṇgrahaṇamiti | asatyaṇgrahaṇe yad‌ vṛddhamantodāttaṃ bahvaca, yathā---bāstuvidyeti, tasmād‌ vṛddhācche ṭhañā bādhite punarvacanāccha eva syād‌, aṇgrahaṇāttvaṇeva bhavati |
ṛgayanamiti | `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, `agaḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ | ayanaśabdaśca bhāvasādhano'bhedopacārād‌ granthe vartate, `ano bhāva karmavacane' ityantodāttaḥ | padavyākhyānaśabdaḥ `manktinvyākhyāna' ityantodāttaḥ | chandomānaśabda ṛgayanaśabdena vyākhyātaḥ | chando bhāveti kṛtsvareṇāntodātaḥ | chandovicitiśabdo manktinnityantodāttaḥ | punaruktaśabdasthāthādisvareṇa | niruktaśabdaḥ `saṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām' iti | nigamaśabdo gocarādisūtre ghānto nipātito'ntodāttaḥ | vāstuvidyā, kṣattravidyā, aṅgavidyeti samāsasvareṇa | utpātotpādaśabdau thāthādisvareṇa | aśeḥ saran, vaseḥ sampūrvācciditi saṃvatsaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ | muhūrttanimittaśabdau prātipadikasvareṇa | upanipūrvātsadeḥ kvip, upaniṣacchabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ ||
tata āgataḥ || 4.3.74 ||
tata iti mukhyaṃ yadapādānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tadiha gṛhyata iti | mukhyatvādeva | apādānasaṃjñā tu nāntarīyakasyāpi bhavati, kārakaprakaraṇe hi gauṇamukhyavibāgo nāśrīyate ||
ṭhagāyasthānebhyaḥ || 4.3.75 ||
āya iti svāmigrāhyo bhāga iti | etyenaṃ svāmī, svāmināṃ vā'yametīti kṛtvā ||
śuṇḍikādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.3.76 ||
āyasthānaṭhako'pavāda iti | upalakṣaṇametat | kṛkaṇaśabdāt‌ `kṛkaṇaparṇādbhāradvāje' iti chasyāpyapavādaḥ | tīrthaśabdād‌ dhūmādilakṣasya vuño'pyapavādaḥ | udapānaśabdādutsādyaño'pyapavādaḥ |
athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ na śiṇḍikādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta, vacanasāmardhyāddhi, yo vihito na ca prāpnoti anyena bādhitatvāt‌, sa evāṇ‌ bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---aṇgrahaṇamiti | udapānaśabda iha paṭhyate, sa cotsādiḥ tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe āyasthānaṭhakaṃbādhitvā `utsādibhyo'ñ‌' ityañeva syāt‌ | aṇgrahaṇāttveṇeva bhavati ||
vidyāyonisambandhebhyo vuñ‌ || 4.3.77 ||
vidyāyonikṛta iti | bahuvrīhau gatārthatvātkṛtaśabdasyāprayogaḥ ||
ṛtaṣṭhañ‌ || 4.3.78 ||
eṣūdāharaṇeṣu `isusuktāntātkaḥ' | evaṃ ca prakriyālāghavāya kañevāyaṃ vidheyaḥ, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
pituryacca || 4.3.79 ||
pitryamiti | `rīṅṛtaḥ', `yasyeti ca' |
gotrādaṅkavat‌ || 4.3.80 ||
ṛṅgagrahaṇena tasyedamityarthasāmānyaṃ lakṣyata iti | kathaṃ mukhye sambhavati lakṣaṇāśrīyate ? vyākhyānamatra śaraṇam | apara āha---aṅke yad‌ dṛṣṭaṃ tadatidiśyate, na tvaṅka āhatya vihitam | `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' ityayamapi vuñ‌ tasyedamiti sāmānye vihito'pyañādivyatirikte viṣaye'ṅke'pi dṛṣṭa iti tasyāpyatideśa iti | aupagavakamiti | vuña udāharaṇam | aṇastu---vaidam, gārgyam, dākṣamiti | vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthaḥ, `kālebhyo bhavavat‌', `caraṇebhyo dharmavat‌' iti yathā ||
hetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ || 4.3.81 ||
samādāgatamiti | samāddhetorāgatamityartaḥ | tatra `hetau' iti tṛtīyā prāpnoti, jñāpakatsiddham, yadayaṃ pañcamyantāddhetoḥ pratyayamāha tajjñāpayati---bhavati hetau pañcamiti | naitadasti jñāpakam, yatra `vibhāṣā guṇe' iti pañcamī, tadarthametatsyāt‌---jāḍyādāgata iti ? tasmāt‌ `vibhāṣā guṇe' ityatra vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgādaguṇavacanādapi pañcamī bhavati ||
mayaṭ‌ ca || 4.3.82 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārtha iti | vikalpārthenānyatarasyāṃ grahaṇena rūpyamayaṭoḥ pakṣe'bhāvaḥ pratipādyate, tadabhāve svaśāstreṇaiva prāptaḥ pratyayo bhavati | tena rūpyamayaṭorevānena vidhānādasati yogavibhāge syādeva yathāsaṅkhyamiti bhāvaḥ ||
prabhavati || 4.3.83 ||
prākāśate iti | utpattivacanastu prabhavatirna gṛhyate; `tatra jātaḥ' ityanena gatatvāt||
vidūrāññyaḥ || 4.3.84 ||
ayukto'yaṃ nirdeśa ityāha---nanu ceti |
vālavāyo vidūraṃ ceti | vālavāyaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, vidūraṃ cādeśamāpādyate, sūtre tvādeśa eva nirdiṣṭaḥ, tenānurūpaḥ sthānī vālavāyaśabda ākṣipyate, yathā---śivādiṣu viśravaṇaravaṇetyādeśābhyāṃ paṭhitābhyāṃ viśravaḥ śabdaḥ | prakṛtyantarameva veti | vidūraśabdo nagarasyeva parvatasyāpi vācakaḥ, sa evātra prakṛtirityarthaḥ | na vai tatreti cediti | cecchabdo'kṣamāyām, parvatavācī vidūraśabdo na prasiddha iti ced‌ brūyātsa jitvarīvadupacāret‌ - vyavaharet‌, yathā---vaṇija eva maṅgalārtha vārāṇasīṃ jitvarīti vyavaharanti, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā eva vālavāyaṃ vidūramupacaranti | niyatapuruṣāpebhāpi prasiddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
tad‌gacchati pathidūtayoḥ || 4.3.85 ||
prāptiphale parispande gamirvartate, na ca pathaḥ parispando'sti tasmātpuruṣavartti gamanaṃ pathyupacaryata ityāha---tatstheṣviti | athaveti | prāptāvapi gamirvarvate, yathā devabhūyaṅgata iti ||
abhiniṣkrāmati dvāram || 4.3.86 ||
dvāramabhiniṣkamaṇakriyāyāmiti | anenaitadāha---tatstheṣvabhiniṣkrāmatsu karaṇabhūte dvāre tadāropād‌ dvāramevābhiniṣkrāmatītyucyata iti | abhiniṣkramaṇaṃ dvāramiti noktam ; taditi dvitīyādhikārāt‌, tadā hi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti ||
adhikṛtya kṛte granthe || 4.3.87 ||
ākhyāyikābhya iti | tādarthye caturthī, ākhyāyikā-gadyagranthaprabhedaḥ, tadabhidhānāya yaḥ pratyaya utpannastasya barulaṃ lub‌ bhavatītyarthaḥ | na cedaṃ vaktavyam, abhedopacāreṇa tācchabdyalābhād‌ abhidhānalakṣaṇatvācca kvacittaddhitta utpadyate, kvacinna ||
śiśukrandayamasabhadvandvendrajananādibhyaśchaḥ || 4.3.88 ||
indrajananādirākṛtigaṇa iti | tena `viruddhabhojanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' iti siddhaṃ bhavati ||
so'sya nivāsaḥ || 4.3.89 ||
iha yasya srughno nivāsaḥ srughne'sau bhavati, tataḥ `tatra bhavaḥ' ityeva siddham, śabdārthabhedāttu pṛthagupādānam ||
abhijanaśca || 4.3.90 ||
abhijanāḥ pūrvabāndhavā iti | abhijāyate tebhya iti kṛtvā, pūrvabāndhavāḥ-pitrādayaḥ | bandhuśabdaḥ prajñādiḥ | tatsanbandhādeśo'pīti | yathā yaṣṭisambandhādyaṣṭiśabdaḥ puruṣe vartate, tathābhijanaśabdo deśe | kaḥ punarasau deśaḥ ? ityāha yasminniti | tadihetyādi | taditi vākyopanyāse | kathaṃ punarmukhye'bhijane sambhavati gauṇātpratyayo bhavati ? ityāha---nivāsapratyāsatteriti | pratyāsannenānantarasannihitena nivāsaśabdenābhijanasya viśeṣaṇādityarthaḥ | iha hi nivāse yo'bhijana iti viśeṣite, tasmād‌ deśavācina eva pratyayaḥ |
nivāsābhijanayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti | abhijanasyāpi nivāsabhūtasya grahaṇānnāstyeva viśeṣa ityarthaḥ | tatreti | yatra svayaṃ nivasati sa tasya nivāsaḥ | yatra tu pūrvaiḥ pitrādibhiruṣitaṃ so'bhijana ityarthaḥ |
āyudhajīvibhyaścha parvate || 4.3.91 ||
āyudhajīvibhya iti tādarthye caturthītyādi | yadi tu `āyudhajīvibhyaḥ' iti pañcamīsyāt‌, parvatāditi lyablope pañcamī vyākhyeyā syāt‌, tataścāyamarthaḥ syāt‌ āyudhajīvibhyaḥ parvatamuddiśya parvate'bhidheye cho bhavatīti, tatra so'bhijana ityadhikāro bādhyate ||
śaṇḍikādibhyo ñyaḥ || 4.3.92 ||
aṇaāderapavāda iti | ādiśabdena chādeḥ | tatra yadi śaṇḍikādayaḥ parvataśabdāḥ, tataḥ pūrveṇa chaḥ prāptaḥ; atha janapadaśabdāḥ, tato `avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt‌' iti vuñ‌, śaṇḍikāśabdātkopadhādaṇ‌ prāptaḥ ||
sindhutakṣaśilādibhyo'ṇañau || 4.3.93 ||
sindhuvarṇuprabhṛtaya iti | prabhṛtiśabdena madhumata, kamboja, sālva, kaśmīra, gandhāra---ityete gṛhyante | kiṣkindhādibhyaścaturbhyaḥ `avṛddhādapi' iti vuñi prāpte vacanam | takṣaśilādiṣvapi vṛddhebhyaśchaḥ prāptaḥ, śeṣebhyaḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' ||
acittādadeśakālāṭ‌ṭhak‌ || 4.3.96 ||
acittavācina iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, deśakālapratiṣedhāt‌ | tatsāhacaryādeśakālayorapi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ||
vāsudevārjunābhyāṃ vun‌ || 4.3.98 ||
chāṇorapavāda iti | `vāsudevaśabdaḥ saṃjñā' iti vakṣyati, tena tatrottarasya vuño'prāptiḥ | arjunaśabdo'pi yo vṛkṣaviśeṣavacano vaṇaviśeṣavacano vā, na tatra vuñaḥ prāptiḥ; kṣattriyavacanādapi bahulavacanād‌ vuño'prāptireveti bhāvaḥ |
nanu cetyādi | vasudevasyāpatyam, `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' ityaṇ | na cātreti | na tāvad‌ vṛddhau viśeṣaḥ; prāgeva vṛddhatvāt‌ | yo'pi `vṛddhinimittasya' iti puṃbadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, so'syāpi `na kopadhāyāḥ' ityasatyeva | saṃjñeṣā devatāviśeṣasyeti | vasatyasminsarvamiti vyutpattyā paramātmana eṣā saṃjñā | na kṣattriyākhyeti | upalakṣaṇametatat, nāpi gotrāśakhyetyapi draṣṭavyam |
prāsaṅgikaṃ prayojanāntaraṃ vāsudevagrahaṇasya darśayati---ajādyadantam, alpāctaramiti ceti | itikaraṇaḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhyate | yadyapyetajjñāpyate, tathāpi `śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' iti nirdeśātkvacidanyathāpi bhavati ||
gotrakṣattriyākhyebhyo bahulaṃ vuñ‌ || 4.3.99 ||
gotrakṣatriyākhyebhya iti | āṅ‌pūrvātkhyātermūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ | ākhyāgrahaṇamiti | āṅ‌pūrvasya khyātegrahaṇamityarthaḥ | yathākathañciditi | kṣattriyaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyādyeṣāṃ kṣattriye vṛttiḥ, yathā---śūraḥ kṣattriya iti, tebhyo mū bhūdityarthaḥ ||
janapadināṃ janapadavatsarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane || 4.3.100 ||
janapadinām janapadivācināṃ śabdānām janapadavat janapadavācināṃ śabdānāmiva, janapadena janapadavācinā śabdena, samānaśabdānām samanaśrutīnām, bahuvacane bahvarthābhidhāne | vṛtterapyeṣa evārthaḥ | pratyayaḥ prakṛtiśceti | anena sarvaśabdasyārtho darśitaḥ | janapadino janapadasvāmina iti | svasvāmibhāvasambandhe matvarthīyaṃ darśayati | aṅgā janapadā ityādinā dṛṣṭānte pravṛttiprakāramāha | tadvadityādinā tūdāharaṇam | sarvatra bahuṣvartheṣu `dvyañmagadha' ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ `tadrājasya bahuṣu' iti luki kṛte samānaśabdādavṛddhādapi bahuvacaneti vuñi vivakṣite `gotre'lugaci' iti vacanādāṅgaśabdād‌ vuñ‌ |
pañcālā brāhmaṇā iti | abhedopavārād‌ brāhmaṇeṣu pañcālaśabdasya vṛttiḥ, tatrātidheśābhāvādaṇeva bhavati |
sarvagrahaṇamityādi | asati sarvagrahaṇe prādhānyātpratyayasyaivātideśaḥ syāt‌, na prakṛteḥ | vatinirdeśastu yairjanapadairye janapadinasteṣāṃ tajjanapadapratyaya eva yathā syāt, janapadāntarapratyayo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt‌ | na tvenana prakṛtyatideśo labhyate, tasmāttadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate | sa ca dvyekayoḥ prayojayatīti pāṭhaḥ | sa ca prakṛtyatideśaḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ dvyekayoḥ prayojayati, na bahuṣu; tatra rūpasyā bhinnatvāt‌ | yadāha---`bahuvacane samānaśabdānām' iti | dvyekayostu janapadavācino rūpaṃ vṛddham, janapadavācinastvavṛddhamiti tatraiva sarvagrahaṇasya prayojanamityarthaḥ | atideśaḥ prayojayati, atideśaṃ prayojayatīti vā pāṭhe na samīcīnamarthaṃ paśyāmaḥ | vṛddhinimitteṣvityādi | tatra hyatidiṣṭe'pi prakṛtirūpe punarvṛddhyā bhāvyamiti nāsti veśeṣaḥ |
madravṛjyoḥ kati viśeṣa iti | tatra vṛddhyasambhavāt‌ | prakṛtinirhrāse kṛta iti | nirhrāsaḥ-apacayaḥ, alpatvamityarthaḥ | madrakaḥ, vṛjika iti | asati tu prakṛtyatideśe mādrakako vārjyaka iti syāt‌ |
bahuvacanagrahaṇamityādi | samānaśabdatāyā yo viṣayastasya lakṣaṇaṃ pradarśanaṃ tadartham | anyathā hīti | yadi bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate | yatraiveti | bahuvacane, tatraiva hi tadrājasya luki kṛte samānaśabdatā bhavati | ekavacanadvivacanayorna syāditi | lugabhāvena samānaśabdatāyā abhāvāt‌ | nanu sarvagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyatideśārtham, sa ca dvyekayoḥ prayojayatītyuktam, tatkathaṃ dvyekayorna syāt‌ ? tasmāt‌ sarvagrahaṇādhyatra kvacitsamānaśabdānāṃ sarvatrātideśaḥ siddhaḥ | asyaivārthasya viśpaṣṭapratipattyartham `bahuvacane' ityupalakṣaṇamupāttam ||
tena proktam || 4.3.101 ||
prakarṣeṇoktamiti | adhyāpanenārthavyākhyānena vā prakarṣeṇāprakāśitamityarthaḥ | prakarṣeṇeti vacanād‌ grāme grāme yadyapi kāṭhakādikaṃ devadattādibhiḥ procyate, tathāpi tebhyaḥ pratyayo na bhavati | na tu kṛtamiti | prapūrvo vaciḥ karaṇe'pi vartate iti bhāvaḥ | madhurāyāṃ bhavo mādhuraḥ, tato vṛddhācche prāpte `kalāpino'ṇ‌' ityaṇgrahaṇādadhikavidhānārthādaṇpratyayaḥ | pāṇinīyamiti | svayamanyena vā kṛtaṃ yatpāṇininā proktaṃ taducyate ||
tittirivaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ‌ || 4.3.102 ||
chandasi cāyamiṣyata iti | chandasyabhidheya ityarthaḥ | tittiriṇā proktaḥ śloka ityatra na bhavatīti | na kevalaṃ chaṇeva, api tvaṇapi na bhavatyanabhidhānādityāhuḥ | kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi chandasi labhyaḥ ? ityāha---śaunakādibhya iti |
kāsyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ || 4.3.103 ||
ṇakāra uttaratra vṛddhyartha iti | iha tu pūrvameva vṛddhe siddhatvāt‌ | yo'pi `vṛddhinimittasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, so'pi na prayojanam, ṇinyantasyādhyetṛveditṛviṣayatvena striyāmavṛtteḥ | vṛttāvapi `jāteśca' iti siddhatvāt‌, caraṇatvena jātitvāt‌ | tasyāpi ceti | kathaṃ chandobrāhmaṇānāmucyamānā tadviṣayatā kalpasya bhavati ? tatrāha---śaunakādibhya iti | nanu ca tatrānuvṛttau satyāmapyasya yogasya na kalpaḥ chando bhavati, nāpi brāhmaṇam ? ata āha---chando'dhikāravihitānāṃ ceti | `chandobrāhmaṇāni' ityatra chandograhaṇaṃ svaryate, tatra svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavatīti chandaḥ prakaraṇamadhyapātino'syāpi ṇinestadviṣayatā bhavatītyarthaḥ | yattu `chandobrāhmaṇāni' ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya kalpādestadviṣayatvapratipādanam, tatprakārāntaraṃ draṣṭavyam | idānīntanena gotrakāśyapeneti | na hyasāvṛṣiḥ; amantradarśitvāt ||
kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca || 4.3.104 ||
kalāpyantevāsināmityādi | sūtre tvabhedopacārāśrayo nirdeśaḥ | kalāpyantevāsinaścatvāra ityādi | nanu ca śiṣyaśiṣyeṣvapi śiṣyavyavahāro loke dṛśyate, tatkathamiyanta eveti niyamaḥ ? tatrāhapratyakṣakāriṇa iti | kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ karotiḥ prakaraṇaādihādhyayane vartate | kalāpikhāṇḍāyanagrahaṇāditi | etadeva vivṛṇoti---tathā hīti | vaiśampāyanasyāntevāsī kalāpī, yadi cāntevāsyantevāsino'pi gṛhyeran‌, kalāpigrahaṇamanarthakam, `vaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaḥ' ityeva siddham ; kalāpyantevāsināmapi vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāt | tathā vaiśampāyanāntevāsī kaṭhaḥ, kaṭhāntevāsī khāṇḍāyanaḥ, tatra vyavahitānāmapi grahaṇe vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvādanenaiva siddhe śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭho niṣphalaḥ syāt‌ | udāharaṇeṣu chandobrāhmaṇānīti tadviṣayatā, adhyetṛpratyayasya `proktālluk‌' iti luk‌ |
ulapena caturtheneti | sahayoge tṛtīyā | kalāpina idaṃ kālāpakam, `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' | tatra `dharmāmnāyayoḥ' iti paṭhyate, tasmādihopamānācchiṣyasamūhe prayogaḥ | ālambiścarakaḥ prācāmiti | ālambirnāma prācāṃ deśa utpannaścarakasya śiṣyaḥ | evaṃ phaliṅgakamalāvubhau prācāmeva traya ete prācyā uktāḥ | kaṭhakalā pinoriti | `kaṭhacarakālluk‌' iti kaṭhālluguktaḥ | kalāpiśabdādapi `kalāpino'ṇ‌' tyaṇuktaḥ ||
purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu || 4.3.105 ||
bhāllavina ityādi | bhallu, śāṭyāyana, aitareya, piṅga, aruṇa, parāji ityetebhyo ṇiniḥ |
yajñavalkāśmarathaśabdau kaṇvādī, tābhyāṃ yañantābhyāmapi `āpatyasya' iti yalopaḥ | nanu ca yājñavalkādīnyapi purāṇaproktānyeva, śāṭyāyanakādibhirbrāhmaṇāntaraistulyakālatvāt‌ ? ityata āha---yājñavalkyādayo hīti | ākhyānāni-bhāratādīni | tayā vyavaharatīti | arthastu tathā vā bhavatvanyathā veti bhāvaḥ | tadviṣayatā kasmānna bhavatīti | yājñavalkādiviṣayaḥ praśnaḥ, `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca' ityatra purāṇaproktatvaviśeṣasyānāśrayaṇātprāpnotīti bhāvaḥ | prātapadamiti | etallakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate | etadarthameva ca tatra brāhmaṇagraham; chandastvādeva siddheḥ |
kalpeṣu tarhi kasmānna bhavati yathā---kāśyapinaḥ, kauśikina ityatra ? ityata āha---na vāyamiti | yuktaṃ tatra chando'dhikāre tasya yogasyānuvṛtteḥ, ayaṃ tu na tatheti kalpeṣvapi tadviṣayatā na bhavatītyarthaḥ | na cātyantabādhaiveti | `siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca' iti nipātanādeva siddhe, `śuṣaḥ kaḥ' `paco vaḥ' iti liṅgam---`bādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' iti | yathā tu sarvādisūtre `bhāṣyam, tathā `anyaparāṇyapi nipātanāni bādhakānyeva' iti sthitam ||
kalāpino'ṇ‌ || 4.3.108 ||
yathāvihitamevocyeteti | tatra vacanasāmarthyādyo vihito na ca prāpnoti sa evāṇ‌ bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | evamādīnīti | ādiśabdena maudāḥ, paippalādāḥ, śākalā ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam| atra muda-pippalādaḥśākalya---ityetebhyaḥ `purāṇaprokteṣu' iti ṇinerapavādo'ṇbhavati ||
pārāśaryaśilālibhyāṃ bhikṣunaṭasūtrayoḥ || 4.3.110 ||
tadarthaṃ chandograhaṇamanuvarttyamiti | nanu tadanuvṛttāvapi kathaṃ bhikṣunaṭasūtrayośchandastvam ? tatrāha---guṇakalpanaya ceti | upacārasya nimittabhūto dharmo guṇo guruśuśrūpaṇādiḥ, tannimittā kalpanā guṇakalpanā | pārāśariṇa iti | pūrvavadyalopaḥ | śailālina iti | śilāmalate iti śilālī, `alaṃ bhūpaṇaparyāptivāraṇeṣu' ityetasmāt‌ `supyajāto' iti ṇiniḥ, tato'smin‌ ṇinau ṭilopaḥ |
pārāśaramiti | kaṇvādyaṇ‌ | śailālamiti | autsargike'ṇi `nāntasya ṭilope sabrahmacāri' ityādinā ṭilopaḥ ||
tenaikadik‌ || 4.3.112 ||
saudāmanīti | `an‌' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | sudāmādayaḥ-parvataviśeṣāḥ ||
tasiśca || 4.3.113 ||
svarādipāṭhādavyayatvamiti | tasminnevārthe vidhaīyamānasyāpyasya liṅgasaṃkhyānupādānamapi svābhāvikaṃ veditavyam ||
upajñāte || 4.3.115 ||
vinopadeśena jñātamupajñātamiti | upapūrvo jānātistatra prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ | akālakamiti | ānyāyyādutthānādityādikālaparibhāṣārahitamityarthaḥ | gurulāghavaṃ nāmārthaśāstram, yatropāyānāṃ gauravaṃ lāghavaṃ cintyate | `dūṣū' ityayaṃ saṅketaśabdo yatra kriyate, yathā pāṇinīye `vṛt‌' iti, tad‌ duṣkaraṇaṃ vyākaraṇam; kāmaśāstramityanye ||
kṛte granthe || 4.3.116 ||
`tittirivaratantu' ityādīni sūtrāṇyatra prakaraṇe na paṭhitāni | tittiryādayo hi chandasāṃ pravaktāro na karttāraḥ; nityāni hi chandāṃsi na kenacitkriyante ||
saṃjñāyām || 4.3.117 ||
agranthārthamidam ||
kṣudrābhramaravaṭarapādapādañ‌ || 4.3.119 ||
aṇo'pavāda iti | bāhulyādevamuktam, pādapaśabdāddhi chaḥ prāpnoti | anye tu pādapaśabdasya sthāne padapaśabdaṃ paṭhanti ||
tasyedam || 4.3.120 ||
`tasyā patyam' ityatroktamevārthaṃ smārayati---prakṛtipratyayārthayorityādi | prakṛtau ṣaṣṭhyarthamātraṃ vivakṣitam, pratyayārthe'pi tatsambandhimātraṃ yadyogātṣaṣṭhī, tasminnibhidheye pratyayaḥ | mātraśabdavyavacchedyaṃ darsayati---yadaparamiti | idaṃ śabdaḥ pratyakṣavacaṃnaḥ, tacchabdaḥ parokṣavacanaḥ | ādiśabdena sāmānyābhidhāyitvaṃ gṛhyate | tatsarvamavivakṣitamiti | atra kāraṇam `tasyāpatyam' ityatraivoktam |
vahesturiti | tṛntṛcoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam | sāvahitramiti | ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvamiheṭi kṛte nimittābhāvātteṣāmabhāvaḥ |
agnīdha iti | agnimindha iti kvip, agnīt‌ `ṛtvigviśeṣaḥ | `tvamagnidṛtīyate' ityatra tuchāndasaṃhrasvatvam | śaraṇam-gṛham, sthānam, yatrāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ tadāgnīdhram, tātsthyāttu mañcāḥ krośantītivadṛtviji prayogaḥ kalpasūtrakārāṇām---`pratyāśrāvayedāgrīdhaḥ āgnīdhraṃ potāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ' iti | chapratyayaṃ ca tataḥ śaraṇe kurvanti, `āgnīdhrīyasakāśamuttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ parītya' iti śaraṇavacanācchaḥ |
samidhāmādhāna iti | yayā samidhyate'gniḥ sā samit, sampadāditvātkaraṇe kvip‌ | sā samidādhīyate yayā sā sāmidhenī ṛk‌, ṣitvānṅīṣ‌, `halastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||
rathādyat‌ || 4.3.121 ||
rathāṅga eveṣyata iti | yastu rathasya voḍhā rathya iti voḍhari prayogaḥ, saḥ `tadvahati rathayugaprāsaṅgam' iti draṣṭavyaḥ | syādetat---ayameva tadvoḍharyapīṣyatām, `tadvahati' ityatra rathagrahaṇaṃ mā kārīti ? naivaṃ śakyam, iha dvau rathau vahati dvirathya iti `dvigorluganapatye' iti prāgdīvyatīyo luk‌ prāpnoti | yattu dvayo rathayoraṅgaṃ tatra dvirathamityeva bhavati ||
pattrapūrvādañ‌ || 4.3.122 ||
patantyaneneti pattramiti | `dāmnīśasa' ityādinā ṣṭran‌ | aśvayukto ratho'śvarathaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse vṛttisvabhāvādyuktārthāvagatiḥ | tasyāṅgamāśvaratham ||
pattrādhvaryupariṣadaśca || 4.3.123 ||
pattretyarthagrahaṇamitarayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇam | vyākhyānaṃ cātra śaraṇam ||
dvandvād‌ vun‌ vairamaithunikayoḥ || 4.3.125 ||
vairam - virodhaḥ, vīrāṇāmidamiti kṛtvā, mithunakarma maithunikā, manojñāditvād‌ vuñ‌ | mithunam - dampatī, karma - kriyāniṣpādanam | bābhravaśālaṅkāyaniketi | vuñantaṃ svabhāvataḥ striyāṃ varttate ||
gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌ || 4.3.126 ||
vuni prakṛte vuño vidhānamavṛddheṣu vṛddhyartham | vṛddheṣu vuni vuñi ca viśeṣo nāsti---tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva svaraḥ, puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho'pi `na kopadhāyāḥ' ityabhayorasti ||
saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñāmaṇ‌ || 4.3.127 ||
pūrvasya yuño'pavāda iti | gotragrahaṇānuvṛtterajādīnāṃ gotrapratyayānāmatra grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ |
ghoṣagrahaṇamatra kartavyamiti | ghoṣaḥ - ābhīrasthānam, tatrapi pratyayo yathā syādityevamartham | ghoṣagrahaṇasyānuṣaṅgikaṃ prayojanāntaramāha---tena vaiṣamyāditi |
athāṅkalakṣaṇayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti || nighaṇṭuṣu paryāyatayā pāṭhānnāstyeva viśeṣa ityarthaḥ | pṛthugupādānasāmarthyādviśeṣo'trāśrīyatām ? ityāha---lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyasyaiveti | svamātmīyaṃ sambandhītyarthaḥ | bedī vidyā asyeti | bidānāmasādhāraṇī yā vidyā sā yasyāsti sa baidīvidyaḥ ||
śākalādvā || 4.3.128 ||
vuño'pavāda iti | śākalaśabdasya caraṇaśabdatvāt‌, taddarśayati---śākalena proktamiti ||
chandogaukthikayājñikabah‌vṛcanaṭāññyaḥ || 4.3.129 ||
vuñaṇorapavāda iti | caraṇaśabdebhyo vuño'pavādaḥ, naṭādautsargikasyāṇaḥ ||
na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu || 4.3.130 ||
daṇḍaprādhānā māṇavā iti | arthakathanametat samāsastu karmadhārayaḥ | sadā daṇḍadhāraṇāddaṇḍaśabdo māṇaveṣu vartate ||
raivatikādibhyaśchaḥ || 4.3.131 ||
pūrveṇeti | `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' ityanena raivatikīya iti | revatyā apatyam `revatyādibhyaṣṭhak‌' raivatikaḥ, tataśchaḥ | anye iñantāḥ, tatrānantarasūtrātpratiṣedho'nuvarttiṣyate, raivatikādibhyo vuñaḥ pratiṣedhe vijñāyamāne yatrāpavādo nāsti---raivatīkīya iti, tatra `vṛddhācchaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ; kṣemavṛddhiśabdadapi gahāditvācchaḥ; anyeṣu `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌ syāt‌, tasmācchagrahaṇam ||
kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ‌ || 4.3.132 ||
gotravuño'pavāda iti | kuta ityāha---gotrādhikārāditi | kaupiñjala iti | kupiñjalasyāpatyam, asmādeva nipātanādaṇ, tadantātpunaraṇ | hāstipada iti | hastina iva pādāvasya hastipādaḥ, pādasya lopo na bhavati; `ahastyādibhya' iti vacanāt‌ | hastipādasyāpatyam `tasyāpatyam' iti asmādeva nipātanādaṇ‌, padbhāvaśca, hāstipadasyedam, punaraṇ‌ | athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? asatyaṇgrahaṇe'nantaraśchaḥ prāpnoti | siddho'tra chaḥ `vṛddhācchaḥ' iti ? na siddhyati; `gotracaraṇād‌ vuñ‌' iti vuñprāpnoti | evaṃ tarhi yadyetābhyāṃ cha iṣṭaḥ syāt‌, raivatikādiṣvemevau paṭhet‌, evaṃ hi vibhaktyanuccāraṇāllāghavaṃ bhavati | tasmātpṛthagārambhādeva cho na bhaviṣyati | anyastu yo vihito na ca prāpnoti sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa cāṇeva | evaṃ tarhyasatyaṇgrahaṇe yatra vuñ‌ prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu, tatra vuño vidhānārthametatsyāttasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | ṇitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham, puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca---kaupiñjalī kriyā asya kaupiñjalīkriya iti ||
ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca || 4.3.133 ||
caraṇavuño'pavāda iti | atharvaṇā prokto vedo'bhedopacārādatharvā, tamadhīte vasantāditvāṭhṭhak‌,---ātharvaṇikaḥ, dāṇḍināyanādisūtre nipātanāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ | atha vā---atharvaṇā prokto vedaḥ `tena proktam' ityaṇ‌ tataḥ `chandobrāhmaṇāni' iti tadviṣayatāyāmātharvaṇaśabdasyāpi vasantādiṣu pāṭhādadhyetari ṭhak‌, tasya vidhānasāmarthyāt‌ `proktālluk‌' iti lugna bhavati---ātharvaṇikaḥ |
purvasūtramidañca vārttike darśanātsūtreṣu prakṣiptam ||
tasya vikāraḥ || 4.3.134 ||
prakṛteriti | upādānakāraṇasya | avasthāntaramiti anyathātvam | apavādenānākrāntasya viṣayasya durlabhatvātpraśnaḥ | kimihodāharaṇamiti | aprāṇīti | prāṇibhyo'ñaṃ vakṣyati | ādyudāttamiti | anudāttāderapyañaṃ vakṣyati | avṛddhamiti | vṛddhānmayaṭaṃ vakṣyati | yasya ca nānyaditi | yathā `gopayasoryat‌' iti | nitsvareṇeti | aśmabhasmaśabdau maninpratyayāntau | `mṛdastikan‌', mṛttikā |
tasya prakaraṇe iti | `tasyedam' ityasmin‌ | punarvacana śaiṣikanivṛttyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ hi tasyagrahaṇaṃ śaiṣikairghādibhiḥ sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau te'pyanuvarteran, idaṃ tvapūrvaṃ tasya grahaṇaṃ kriyāmāṇaṃ ghādisambaddhasya tasyagrahaṇasya nivarttakaṃ ghādīnapi nivarttayati | nanu ca vidheyatayā pradhānabhūtā ghādayaḥ, na te guṇabhūte tasyagrahaṇe nivartamāne'pi nivartitumarhanti, na hi guṇānuvartti pradhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? pradhānānuvarttī guṇaḥ ? satyam ; tasya grahaṇasāmarthyātpradhānabhūtānāmapi ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ, aṇaādayastu nanivartante, `prāgdīvyataḥ' `prāgbhavānāt‌' iti ca viśiṣṭāvadhiparicchedenādhikṛtatvāt‌ | vikārāvayavayoriti | parastāttu prāgvahateḥ `prāgghitāt‌' iti cādhikārāntareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvādeva ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ | syādetat--mā bhūvannanena ghādayaḥ, tasya grahaṇena nivartitatvāt‌ ; `tasyedam' ityanena tu prāpnuvanti, tasyedaṃviśeṣatvādvikārāvayayavayoriti ? tanna; `tasyedam' ityeva vikārāvayavayoraṇādiṣu siddheṣu panasteṣāṃ vidhānaṃ śaiṣikāṇāṃ bādhanārthameva | kiṃ tarhyucyate---tasyeti punarvacanaṃ śaiṣikanivṛttyarthamiti, yāvatā sūtraprakṛttireva śaiṣikanivṛttyarthā ? satyam ; tasya grahaṇe tvasati sūtrapravṛttiḥ śaiṣikānapi viṣayīkuryāditi tasyagrahaṇasyaivāyaṃ bhāraḥ yaduta vai śaiṣikā nivartante | hālaḥ saira iti | halaśabdaḥ `navviṣayasyānisantasya' ityādyudāttaḥ | sīraśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ, nātra vakṣyamāṇasyāpavādasya kasyacitprasaṅga ityaṇbhavati |
idaṃ ca yogavibhāgenāṇādividhānasya prayojanaṃ darśitam | yadi hi `tasya vikāraḥ' `bilvādibhyo'ṇ‌' ityevāpavādavidhānārthamucyeta, tato halasya vikāra ityatra `tasyedam' ityanena pratyayo vidhātavyaḥ, tataścāṇaṃ bādhitvā `halasīrāṭṭhak‌' iti ṭhak‌ prāpnoti, tathānyasmistasyedaṃviśeṣe; yogavibhāgena tvaṇādīnāṃ vidhānādaṇeva bhavati, tasyagrahaṇe tu ghādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ prayojanam | vṛjīnāṃ vikāro vārja iti, vṛjiśabdasya phiṭ‌sūtreṣu vikalpenāntodāttatvavidhānātpakṣe ādyudāttatvādaṇ | yadi tvatra `tasyedam' ityaṇpratyayaḥ syāt‌; yadi vānena ghādayo vidhīyeran‌ tato madravṛjyoḥ kanniti kansyāt‌ | tathā trigartānāṃ vikāraḥ traigarta iti, trigartaśabdo bahuvrīhipūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttaḥ, atra prathamaḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' prāptaḥ, janapadalakṣaṇo vuñ‌ dvitīyaḥ, gartottarapadalakṣaṇaśchastṛtīyaḥ, tadavadhigrahaṇena vihito vuñ‌ caturthaḥ; anena tvaṇeva bhavati | yathā raṃkūṇāṃ vikāro rāṅkava iti---atra `prāgdīvyatoṇ‌' prathamaḥ, tadapavādayoḥ `avṛddhādapi' iti `ordeśeṭhañ‌' iti vuñṭhañostulyakakṣayoranyataro dvitīyaḥ, `kopadhādaṇ‌' iti vā kacchādipāṭhādvā'ṇtṛtīyaḥ, `manuṣyatatsthayorvuñ‌' caturthaḥ; anena tvaṇ‌ prāpta orañā bādhitaḥ `kopadhācca' iti pratiprasūyate | yadi tarhi vikārāvayavayorghādayo na bhavanti pāṭaliputrasyāvayavāḥ pāṭaliputrakāḥ prāsādā dati, `tasyedam' ityatrārthe `ropadhetoḥ prācām' iti vuñna prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo hi ghādīnāmavayave nivṛttiḥ, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo yadaprāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo'vayave nivṛttiḥ syāt‌ ! ||
avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ || 4.3.135 ||
maurvamiti | mūrvāśabdaḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvyaṣām' ityādyudāttaḥ . khadiramiti | khādeḥ khadiraśabdaḥ kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ, tenānudāttādilakṣaṇo vuñ‌ prāpnoti | yadi tvaṇiṣyate, bilvādiṣu paṭhitavyaḥ |
kṛtanirdeśau hi tāviti | `tasyedam' ityanena | yadyapi śaiṣikanivṛttyarthatvaṃ pūrvayogasya prayojanamuktam, tathāpi tadanapekṣya bhāsmanam, mārtikamityādau tāvadaṇādayaḥ siddhā ityabhisandhāyedamuktam ||
bilvādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.3.136 ||
añmayaṭorapavāda iti | tatra kāṇḍa-pāṭalīśabdābhyāṃ vṛddhalakṣaṇasya mayaṭo'pavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvanudāttādilakṣaṇasyāñaḥ, bilvaśabdasya `vilvatiṣyorvāntaḥ svaritaḥ' ityantaḥ svaritaḥ, udātto vā | vrīhimud‌gaśabdau ghṛtāditvādantodāttau | masūra-godhūma-gavīdhukaśabdāḥ `laghāvante dvayāśca' iti madhyodāttāḥ | iṣeḥ ksaḥ, ikṣuḥ, pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | veṇuśabdaḥ `vibhāṣā veṇvindhānayoḥ' iti pakṣe'ntodāttaḥ | karpāsīśabdo jātilakṣaṇaṅīṣantaḥ | karkandhūśabdaḥ `alābūkarkkandhūdidhiṣūḥ ' iti nipātanānmadhyodāttaḥ, `kuṭīśamīśuṇḍābhyo raḥ' iti kuṭīraśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | mayaḍ‌bādhanārthamiti | `mayaḍ‌vaitayoḥ' ityādinā prāptasya mayaṭo bādhanārtham, śeṣebhyastvavṛddhebhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ pakṣe mayaḍ bhavatyeva | aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārthaṇ | bilvādibhyo yathāvihitamityucyamāne'pi hi pāṭalīśabdānṅīṣantādanudāttādilakṣaṇasyāño mayaṭā bādhe prāpte punarvacanādañeva syāt‌ ; aṇgrahaṇāttvaṇeva bhavati |
kopadhācca || 4.3.137 ||
año'pavāda iti | `orañ‌' `anudāttādeśca' iti prāptasya, tittiḍīkādayaḥ `laghāvante' ityādinā madhyodāttāḥ ||
trapujatunoḥ ṣuk‌ || 4.3.138 ||
aprāṇyāditvāditi | prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣeṣvanyatamatvasyābhāvādityarthaḥ ||
oraña || 4.3.139 ||
devadāru-bhadradāruśabdau `pītadravarthānām' ityādinādyudāttau | pītadruḥ - saralo navaspatiḥ, pītadrurartho yeṣāṃ teṣāmādirudātto bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
anudāttādeśca || 4.3.140 ||
dādhitthaṃ kāpitthamiti | dadhani tiṣṭhatīti `supi sthaḥ', upapadasamāsaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvātsakārasya takāraḥ, kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvam |
palāśādibhyo vā || 4.3.141 ||
ubhayatravibhāṣeyamiti | kathamityāha---palāśakhadiretyādi | palāśaśabdo ghṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ | khadiraśabdaḥ `ajiraśiśara' ityādau kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ | śiṃśapāśabdo `dvitīyaṃ prāgīṣāt‌' iti vartamāne `pāntādīnāṃ gurvādīnām' iti madhyodāttaḥ | `spadi kiñciccalane', `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' iti yuc‌, kiraterīran‌, karīram, `kṛhṛbhyāmīṣan‌', śṝpṝbhyāṃ kicca', śirīṣam, śeṣe nitsvareṇādyudāttāvetau | vikaṅkatamūlāsayavāsaśabdāḥ `grāmādīnāṃ ca' ityādyudāttāḥ ||
śamyāṣṭ‌lañ‌ || 4.3.142 ||
año'pavāda iti | śamīśabdo gaurādiṅīṣantaḥ | śāmīlī srugiti | cāturmāsye varuṇapraghāseṣu śamīmayyaḥ sruco bhavantīti śrutam ||
mayaḍ‌vaitayorbhāṣāyāmabhakṣyācchādanayoḥ || 4.3.143 ||
maud‌gaḥ sūpaḥ, kārpāsamācchādanamiti | ubhayatra bilvādyaṇ‌, vikārāvayavayorabhakṣyācchādanayośca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; vikārāvayavayorasamāsanirdeśena pratyekamabhisambandhāt‌ |
tadviṣaye'pi yathā syāditi | yadyetayoriti nocyeta, uttarairviśeṣapratyayairañādibhiḥ sampradhāraṇāyāṃ paratvātta eva syuḥ, pūrveṣāṃ viśeṣapratyayānāṃ mayaḍabhāvapakṣe sāvakāśatvānmayaṭ‌pakṣe paratvānmayaḍeva labhyata iti prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñādaya etyuktam | `etayoḥ' iti vacanaṃ punarvidhānārthaṃ sampadyata iti pareṣāmapi viṣaye mayaḍ‌ bhavati ||
nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ || 4.3.144 ||
nityaṃ mayaṭ‌pratyayo bhavatīti | prāgdīvyatīyānāmapavādaḥ | aṇaṃ tu kopadhalakṣaṇamañeva paratvādvādhate | śākamayam, āmramayamiti | āmraśabdaḥ `amitamyordīrghaśca' iti ranpratyayāntaḥ |
tadanena kriyata iti | nityaṃśabdo'tiricyamānaḥ pūrvācāryapaṭhitasya vākyasya smāraka iti | evaṃ ca mṛcchabdasya śarādiṣu pāṭho'syaiva prāpañcārtho draṣṭavyaḥ ||
gośca purīṣe || 4.3.145 ||
gavyaṃ paya iti | kathaṃ punaratra prasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā vikārāvayavayoriti vartate, payaśca na vikāro nāṣayavaḥ ? tatrāha---purīṣaṃ naṃ vikāra ityādi | akriyamāṇe purīṣagrahaṇe iṣṭasidhyarthameva `tasyedam' ityadhaikāre `gormayaṭ‌' iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, tataścātrāpi prasaṅga ityarthaḥ ||
piṣṭācca || 4.3.146 ||
piṣṭamaṃya bhasmeti || paiṣṭī sureti tu sāmānyavivakṣāyām `tasyedam' ityaṇ‌, `pradīyatāṃ dāśarathāya maithilī' itivat‌ ||
asaṃjñāyāṃ tilayavābhyām || 4.3.149 ||

notvadvardhabilvāt‌ || 4.3.151 ||
mauñjamiti | muñjaśabdāt‌ `tṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvyaṣām' ityādyudāttatvādautsargiko'ṇ‌ | gārmutamiti | garmucchabdaḥ `mṛgrerutiḥ', `grormuṭ‌ ca' ityutipratyayāntatvādantodātta iti `anudāttādeśca' ityañ‌ | kathaṃ tarhi `tasmā etaṃ gārmutaṃ caruṃ nirvapet‌' ityantodāttatvam ? sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvādaṇ‌ bhaviṣyati | vādhrīti | vardhraśabdaḥ `laghāvante' ityādyudāttaḥ, tamādaṇ‌, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' iti ṅīp‌ |
matubnirdeśe ityādi | asati tasminvarṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhi prayojayatīti tadantavidhiḥ syāt‌ | vaiṇavīti | bilvādyaṇ‌ ||
tālādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.3.152 ||
mayaḍādīnāmapavāda iti | ādiśabdenāño grahaṇam, bahuvacanaṃ tu tayoreva prakṛtibhedena bahutvāt‌ | tatra tālaśyāmākābhyāṃ vṛddhatvānmayaṭ‌ prāptaḥ barhiṇasya vikāro bārhiṇam---`prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ‌', tasmād‌ `ñitaśca tatpratyayāt‌' ityañ‌ prāptaḥ, śeṣebhyo'nudāttādilakṣaṇasya | liśidṛśibhyāmindraśabda upapade mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghatvam | `cap‌ sāntvane', pacādyac‌ | pīyūkṣāśabdaḥ `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttaḥ, tatra hi `phiṣa' ityadhaikārātprāgeva ṭāpaḥ svarapravṛttiḥ, indrāyudhaśabda samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ |
tālāddhanuṣīti | anyatra tālamayamityeva bhavati | aṇgrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham, anyathā yathāvihitamityucyamāne bārhaṇaśabdādvṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṭ‌ syāt‌, vacanaṃ tu `ñitaśca tatpratyayāt‌' ityaño bādhanārthaṃ syāt‌ ||
jātarūpebhyaḥ parimāṇe || 4.3.153 ||
mayaḍādīnāmapavāda iti | ādiśabdenāño grahaṇam, bahuvacanaṃ tu pūrvavat‌ | tatra vṛddhebhyo hāṭakādibhyo mayaṭo'pavādaḥ, tapanīyādibhyonudāttādibhyo'ñaḥ ||
prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ‌ || 4.3.154 ||
aṇādīnāmiti | ādiśabdena mayaḍ‌ gṛhyate, bahuvacanaṃ tu pūrvavat‌ | tatrādyudāttebhyaḥ prāṇiśabdebhyo'ṇo'pavādaḥ, vṛddhebhyo mayaṭaḥ, rajatādiṣvapi yadādyudāttaṃ tasmādaṇo'pavādaḥ anudāttādeśtu mayaṭaḥ | kāpotam, māyūram, taitiramiti | tittiriśabdastarateḥ ` sanvaccābhyāsasya' iti kipratyayānto'ntodāttaḥ, śeṣau `laghāvante' iti madhyodāttau | pariśiṣṭamihādāharaṇamiti coktam, tasmācchuka-baka-gṛdhādaya ihodāhāryāḥ | śukabakaśabdau `prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' ityādyudāttau | gṛdhraśabdo ranpratyayānta ādyudāttaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi kāpotamityādyudāhṛtam, satyudāttārthe prāṇigrahaṇe'nudāttāderapi prāṇinaḥ paratvādanenaivāñbhavitumarhatīti manyate, āha ca `anudāttāderañaḥ prāṇyañvipratiṣedhena' iti ? kaḥ punaratra viśeṣastena vā satyanena vā ? sāpavādakaḥ sa vidhirmayaṭā pareṇa bādhyate, ayaṃ punarnirapavādaḥ, anenaiva hi paratvānmayaḍ‌ bādhyate | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? śvāvidho vikāraḥ śauvāvidha iti siddhaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? śvānaṃ vidhyatīti kvip‌, `nahivṛti' iti dīrghaḥ, grahijyādisamprasāraṇam, kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvādanudāttādiḥ | tatrānudāttalakṣaṇasyāño bādhakaṃ mayaṭaṃ paratvādayamañ‌ bādhate, dvārāditvādvṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
ñitaśca tatpratyayāt‌ || 4.3.155 ||
tayorvācakatvena yaḥ sambandhī pratyaḥ sa tatpratyayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | vikārāvayavayoreveti | yadi tu ñitpratyayāntaḥ prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣavācī sambhavati tato'vayave'pi bhavati; dvayoḥ prakṛtatvāt‌ | lakṣyamanapekṣyaivamuktam | nanu ca pūrve pañcālāḥ, paṭo dagdha ityavayave samudāyaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ, vikāre ca prakṛtiśabdaḥ---śālīnbhuṅ‌kte mudgairiti śālivikārānmudgavikārairityarthaḥ; tataśca devadārvādyavayavavikāravṛtterdevadārvādiśabdāttadvikārāvayavayostena tenāñādayo bhaviṣyanti, nārtho'nenetyāśaṅkyāha---mayaṭo'pavāda iti | satyamasti yathākathañcidiṣṭasiddhaḥ, tathāpi vṛddhalakṣaṇo mayaṇmā bhūdityevamarthamevāñvidheyaḥ | anyathā yenaiva hetunaitadvākyaṃ bhavati---daivadāravasya vikāraḥ, śāmalasya vikāraḥ, tenaiva mayaḍapi syāt‌, vikāryāttenaiva hetunā mayaḍapi prāpnoti ? anabhidānānna bhaviṣyati, tadeva tarhyanabhidhānaṃ vidhānena pratipādyate | yadyevam, `tasya vikāraḥ', `uṣṭrād‌ vuñ‌', auṣṭrakaṃ carma, tasya vikāra auṣṭrikopānaditi, `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ‌' iti ṅīpprāpnoti, na ceṣyate, evaṃ hi saunāgāḥ paṭhanti---`vuñaścāña ītaḥ prasaṅgaḥ' iti | tasmādavayave samudāyaśabdo vikāre ca prakṛtiśabda iti tena tena lakṣaṇenāñādayo bhaviṣyanti | anabhidhānāttu vikārāvayavapratyayāntānna mayaḍ‌ bhaviṣyatītyetadeva sāmpratam | bailvamayamiti | `ñito yatnena mayaṭaṃ sūtrakāro nivarttayan‌ anyato vaṣṭi mayaṭam' iti vṛttikṛto matam | bhāṣyavāttikakārau punarāhatuḥ---`taccānabhidānamāśrayitavyam, abhidhāne hyanyato'pi mayaṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ---bailvasya vikāraḥ' iti ||
krītavatparimāṇāt‌ || 4.3.156 ||

plakṣādibhyo'ṇ‌ || 4.3.164 ||

kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau luk‌ ca || 4.3.168 ||

prāgvahateṣṭhak‌ || 4.4.1 ||
tadāheti | `vākyādetatpratyayavidhānam' iti vakṣyati, na ca vākyād‌ dvitīyā sambhavati; aprātipadikatvāt‌ | tena taditi karmamātraṃ nidiśyate, na tu dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktiḥ |
māśabda ityāheti | śabdo mākārītyāhetyarthaḥ | saṃsargarūpasya vākyārthasyetikaraṇena pratyavamarśe sati vacanakriyāṃ prati karmatvaṃ sambhavati, nānyatheti matvaiṣa vigrahaḥ | vākyādetatpratyayavidhānamiti | etaccāhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ punarvacanāllabhyate, anyathā prabhūtādayo māśabdādaya eva bhavantu, kiṃ pṛthagvacanena !
āhāviti | āheti pade prakṛtibhāgasyāgantukenekāreṇedamo'nukaraṇam | tatra śabde kāryasyāsambhavādarthapratyayavidhiḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇāditi | tadantābhidhāyina ityarthaḥ |
pṛcchatāviti | tiṅantānukaraṇametat | evaṃ gacchatāviti | tiṅantārthe tu pratyayaḥ | susnātaṃ pṛcchatīti | susnātaṃ bhavatā, susnāto bhavānityevaṃ vā pṛcchatītyarthaḥ | saukharātrika iti | sukharātriṃ pṛcchati | evaṃ yaḥ pṛcchati, sā evamucyate | etena saukhaśāyaniko vyākhyātaḥ | anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ | gaurutalpika iti | talpaśabdena bhāryā lakṣyate ||
tena dīvyati khanati jayati jitam || 4.4.2 ||
sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyeti | dīvyatyādāvabhihitatvātkartari tṛtīyā nopapadyata iti tatsāhacaryājjitamityanenāpi yoge karaṇa eva tṛtīyeti sarvaśabdārthaḥ | tena devadattena na jitamityatra na bhavati | hetutṛtīyā tu nāśaṅkitā; anabhidhānāt‌ | na hi hetutṛtīyāntāvutpadyamānena ṭhakā vigrahavākyārthasyābhidhānamasti |
pratyayārtha iti | nirddhāraṇa eṣā saptamī, sāmānyāpekṣamekavacanam | iha dīvyatītyādau tipo bahavo'rthāḥ---ekatvasaṅkhyā, varttamānakāle, yuṣmadasmadvyatireka iti, teṣu madhya ityarthaḥ | tadeva darśitam | saṅkhyākālayoravivakṣeti | nāntarīyakatvāt‌ | avaśyaṃ hi yayā kayācitsaṅkhyyā yena kenacitkālena nirdeśa iti tayorupādānam, na tu tayorvivakṣā | tata ākṣikau ākṣikā iti dvibahvorapi bhavati, akṣairadīvyadityādau kālāntare cākṣika iti bhavati, nyāyasya tulyatvāt‌ puruṣasyāpyavivakṣā, tenākṣikastvam, ākṣaiko'hamityatrāpi bhavati | yathaiva tarhi saṅkhyākālapuruṣāṇāmavivakṣā tathā karturapi prāpnoti, ekapratyayavācyatvāt‌ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; karturavivakṣāyāmākhyātopādānamakiñcitkaraṃ syāt‌ | viparyayastu na bhavati---karturavivakṣā kālādīnāṃ vivakṣeti; kartuḥ pradhānatvāt‌ | saṅkhyādiviśiṣṭo hi karttā''khyātānāṃ pradhānabhūto'rthaḥ, tena sa tāvadvivakṣyate, itareṣāṃ nāntarīyakatvādavivakṣā | kiñca, sādhanasyāpyavivakṣāyāṃ jitamityasyopādānamanarthaṃ syāt‌ |
ihākhyāteṣu kriyā pradhānabhūtā, guṇabhūtaḥ karttā, ata eva kiṃ karoti devadatta iti kriyāpraśne pacatītyākhyātenottaraṃ dīyate, na tu kṛdantena pācaka itiḥ tasya sattvapradhānatvāt‌ | kiñca, yadi kṛdanteṣvivākhyāteṣvapi kartā pradhānabhūtaḥ syād‌, yathā pācakasyāpatyamityapatyādibhiryogo bhavati, tathā''khyātavācyasyāpi syāt‌ pacatyayamiti, kriyāveśaḥ syād‌, yathā---pācakastiṣṭhatīti | tasmātkriyāpradhānamākhyātam | tataśca tadrathe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayo'pi kriyāpradhānaḥ syāditi tadantasyāpatyādibhiryogaḥ kriyāveśaśca na syāt‌---ākṣikasyāpatyamākṣikaṃ paśyeti | tatrāha---kriyāpradhānatve'pi cākhyātasyeti | ākhyāyate'nena kriyā pradhānabhūtetyākhyātastiṅantaḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe ktaḥ, svanikāyaprasiddhireṣā | svabhāvāditi | yathā `tenaikadik', `tasiśca' ityetasminnarthe vidhīyamānayoraṇtayossattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvam, viparyayaśca---saudāmanī vidyutsudāmato vidyuditi, tathātrāpi | na hi svabhāvaḥ paryanuyogamarhati ||
saṃskṛtam || 4.4.3 ||

naudvyacaṣṭhan‌ || 4.4.7 ||
