āyudhāccha ca || 4.4.14 ||
āyudhyate'neneti āyudham, `ghañarthe kavidhānam' iti kapratyayaḥ ||
haratyutsaṅgādibhyaḥ || 4.4.15 ||
harati - nayati, upādatte vā ||
bhastrādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan‌ || 4.4.16 ||
bhastram - carmavikāraḥ, yena lohādi dhmāyate, yena vā dhānyādikaṃ nīyate, `hūyāmāśrubhasibhyastran‌' iti karaṇae tran‌ | śīrṣabhāraḥ, śīrṣebhāra iti paṭhyate, nipātanācchīrṣabhāvaḥ saptamīsamāsaśca, `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' iti saptamyā aluk‌ ||
vibhāṣā vivadhavīvadhāt‌ || 4.4.17 ||
paryāhāre ceti | parita āhriyate'nena taṇḍulādiko'rtha iti paryāhāraḥ - ubhayato baddhaśikyoṃ'savāhyaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣa ucyate |
vīvadhaśabdo vārttike darśanātsūtre prakṣiptaḥ ||
aṇkuṭilikāyāḥ || 4.4.18 ||
kuṭilavyādhānāmuparamaṇam - kuṭilikā, saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌ ||
trermamnityam || 4.4.20 ||
ḍ‌vitaḥ ktrirityayaṃ triśabdo gṛhyata iti | saṅkhyāvacanastvanabhidhānānna gṛhyate | uptrimamiti | vacyādisūtreṇa saṃprasāraṇam |
nityagaṃrahaṇaṃ svātantryanivṛttyarthamiti | pratyayarahitasya tryantasya prayogaḥ svātantryam, svātantryanivṛttau satyāṃ yo guṇastaṃ darśayati---tryantaṃ nityaṃ mappratyayāntameva bhavatīti | evakāravyavacchedyaṃ darśayati---viṣayāntare na prayoktavyamiti | nanu vibhāṣayā vākye prasakte nityagrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ nirvṛttādhaikāre tadviṣayameva vākyaṃ nivartayitumarhati---paktriṇā nirvṛttamiti, yathā---`ana upadhālopinonyatarasyām' `nityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ' iti, tataśca viṣayāntaragatatryantasya svātantryaṃ syādeva kṛtrimarhatsuvihitamiti ? evaṃ manyate---yogavibhāgo'tra kartavyaḥ, `trermabbhavati nirvṛtte' ityeko yogaḥ, tataḥ `nityam' | atra trermabityevāpekṣyate na nirvṛtta iti; yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt‌ | tena sarvaviṣayasvātantryasya nityagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ kriyata iti | nanvevamapi `nityam' ityatra nirvṛttamityasyānapekṣaṇātsvātantryāntare | nityamupādhiḥ prāpnoti ? satyam ; anabhidhānāttu tathānāśrīyate |
bhāvapratyayāntādimab‌ vaktavya iti | `tena nirvṛttam' ityetasminnarthe | pākena nirvṛttaṃ pākimamiti | evaṃ ca tryantādapi bhāvābhidhāyina imapi kṛte yasyeti lope ca kṛtrimamityādi siddhaṃ bhavati, svare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ, udāttanivṛttisvareṇaivodāttatvam | sūtrārambhastu nityagrahaṇena svātantryaṃ nivartayiṣyāmītyevamarthe veditavyaḥ ||
apamityayācitābhyāṃ kakkanau || 4.4.21 ||
apamityeti | `udīcāṃ māṅo vyatihāre' iti ktvāpratyaye'paśabdena samāse ktvo lyap‌, `mayateridanyatarasyām' itītvam, `ktvātosunkasunaḥ' ityavyayasaṃjñā | tena nātra tṛtīyāsamarthātpratyayaḥ ||
saṃsṛṣṭe || 4.4.22 ||
nanu yadyena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tattena saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati; tataśca saṃskṛtamityeva saṃsṛṣṭe'pi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ ? na sidhyati; sata utkarṣādhānam - saṃskāraḥ, ekībhāvastu - saṃsargaḥ, na ca yatrāsau tatrāvaśyamutkarṣo'sti, aśucidravyasaṃsarge hi pratyutāpakarṣa eva bhavati | tasmātsaṃsṛṣṭa iti vaktavyam | yadyasya nibandhanamastyetadevāstu, mā bhūtsaṃskṛtamityetat‌ ? tadavaśyaṃ kartavyam, ihāpi yathā syāt‌---vidyayā saṃskṛto vaidyaka iti, na hyatra saṃsargo'sti; mūrttidharmatvāt‌ | kiñca `kulatthakopadhādaṇ‌' saṃskṛta eva yathā syātsasṛṣṭe mā bhūdityemavarthaṃ saṃskṛtamityetadbhavatīti vaktavyam ||
cūrṇādiniḥ || 4.4.23 ||
cūrṇae ye saṃsṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamastīti matvarthīyenaiveninā siddham ? satyam ; tadrūpavivakṣāyāṃ siddham | saṃsargavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṭhak prāpnoti | anabhidhānaṃ tu durjñānam ||
lavaṇālluk‌ || 4.4.24 ||
lavaṇadravyavācītyādi | lavaṇaśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavacanaḥ--ṣaṇṇāṃ rasānāmanyatamasya vācakaḥ, asti ca dravyavacano yaḥ saindhavādiṣu vartate; tatra yo guṇavacanaḥ sa na lukaṃ prayojayati, madhurādiśabdavadabhedopacārādeva dravye vṛttisiddheḥ | dravyaśabdastu so'yamityabhisambandhād‌ dravye vartamānaḥ | yadyapi praṣṭhī pracarī yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetyādau dravyaśabdasyapi kvacidabhedopacāro dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpi bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tatstho'pi dṛśyate---praṣṭasyeyaṃ prāṣṭhī yaṣṭimataḥ puruṣāniti | tasmād‌ dravyavācyeva lavaṇaśabdo lukaṃ prayojayati, sa ca prayojayatyeva ||
vyañjanairupasikte || 4.4.26 ||
odanādiṣu raso yena vyajyate tadvyañjanam | bahuvacananirdeśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsārthaḥ | upasiktaḥ - secanena mṛdūkṛtaḥ | iha yadyenopasiktaṃ tattena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ bhavati, tatra saṃsṛṣṭa ityeva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam---vyañjanebhya upasikta eva saṃsṛṣṭe yathā syātsaṃsṛṣṭamātre mā bhūt‌, dadhnā saṃsṛṣṭā sthālīti ||
tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam || 4.4.28 ||
kriyāviśeṣaṇamityādi | ākhyātaṃ hi dhātvarthasya kartavyatāmācaṣṭe---vartate - vartanaṃ karoti, supyate - svāpaḥ kriyate, śobhanamodanaṃ pacyate - odanakarmakaḥ pākaḥ śobhanaḥ kriyate iti | pacidhātvarthaḥ kartavya eva sambadhyamānaḥ karma sampadyate, tasya yatsamānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ tadapi karmaiva bhavati |
prātīpikaḥ, ānvīpika iti | pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityikāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, `dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt‌' itītvam | vyutpattimātraṃ caitat, pratikūlānukūlaparyāyau tvetau | `ūdanordeśe' ityūtvamatra na bhavati; adeśatvāt, deśatve kriyāviśeṣatvāsambhavāt | sūtre īpśabdasya nirdeśāt‌ | prātilomikaḥ, ānulomika iti | pūrvavadvahuvrīhiḥ, `ac‌ pratyanvavapūrvāt‌' ityac‌ samāsāntaḥ | atrāpi vyutpattimātram, arthastu pūrvokta eva | prātikūlika iti | pūrvavadvahuvrīhiḥ | atrāpi kūlārtho nāsti | pratisaraṇaṃ caitayorarthaḥ ||
parimukhaṃ ca || 4.4.29 ||
pārimukhika iti | paririha vartate, tasya ca `apaparī varjane' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, `pañcamyapāṅ‌paribhiḥ' iti pañcamī, `apaparibahirañcavaḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, anena ṭhak‌ | svāmino mukaṃ varjayitvā yaḥ sevako vartate sa pārimukhikaḥ | sarvato bhāve vā pariśabdaḥ, parito mukham, prādisamāsaḥ, yato yataḥ svamino mukhaṃ tatastato vartate ityarthaḥ | evaṃ pāripārśvikaḥ ||
prayacchati garhyam || 4.4.30 ||
dviguṇārthaṃ dviguṇamiti | dvaiguṇika uttamarṇa ucyate, na cāsau dviguṇaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ tarhyekaguṇaṃ dattvā dviguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti, ata eva tad‌garhyaṃ bhavatīti | tasmād‌ dviguṇārthe dviguṇaśabdo vartayitavyaḥ |
vārdhuṣika iti | vṛddhyarthe dhane vṛddhiśabdaḥ | prakṛtyantarameveti | etacca vārdhuṣika ityetadvṛttiviṣayameva | niyataviṣayā api hi śabdā bhavanti, vṛddhiśabdādanabhidhānānnaiva bhaviṣyati, tena vārdhika ityaniṣṭaprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ | ata katham `vārdhudāsamakampata vavānyasya ca vārddhuṣeḥ' iti ? svacchandavāca ṛṣayaḥ ||
kusīdadaśaikādaśāt‌ ṣṭhanṣṭhacau || 4.4.31 ||
tadarthaṃ dravyaṃ kusīdamiti | atrāpi kusīdika ityuttamarṇasyābhidhānamiṣyate, na cottamarṇaḥ kusīdaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ tahi ? adhamarṇaḥ, na ca tasya vṛddhipradānaṃ garhyam, tasmāttādarthyāttācchadbyamiti bhāvaḥ | ekādaśārthaṃ daśa daśaikādaśaśabdenocyanta iti tatraikādaśaśabdasyāpi tadartheṣu daśasveva vṛtteḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye sati viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' iti daśaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ | daśaikādaśāditi nirdeśādakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ | evaṃ vākyamapyakārāntenaiva bhavati---daśaikādaśānprayacchatīti ||
rakṣati || 4.4.33 ||
sāmājika iti | samājaḥ - samūhaḥ, samajatyasminniti kṛtvā, evaṃ sanniveśaḥ ||
śabdadarduraṃ karoti || 4.4.34 ||
śabdaṃ karotīti | karotiriha jñāne vartate, prakṛtyādivibhāgena jānātītyarthaḥ | etaccābhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate, iha na bhavati---śabdaṃ karoti khara iti | pātraviśeṣavācī darduraśabdaḥ | anukaraṇaśabda ityanye ||
pakṣimatsyamṛgānhanti || 4.4.35 ||
svarūpasya tadviśeṣaṇāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ ca grahaṇamiṣyata iti | atra hetuḥ `svaṃ rūpam' ityatraivoktaḥ | mātsyika iti | `sūryatiṣya' iti lopo na bhavati; matsyasya ṅyāmiti parigaṇanāt‌ | hāriṇikaḥ, saukarika iti | atra mṛgaparyāyasyodāharaṇaṃ kimita na pradarśitam, yathā pūrvayoḥ dvāvapi hyetasmādviśeṣau, āraṇyāścatuṣpādo mṛgāḥ ucyante, hariṇaparyāyo'pi mṛgaśabdo'sti, tadapekṣayā hāriṇika iti paryāyodāharaṇam ||
paripanthaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 4.4.36 ||
taditi dvitīyāsamarthāditi | paripanthaśabdaḥ parimukhaśabdavadavyayībhāvaḥ, tatpuruṣo vā | tatrāpyavyayībhāvapakṣe kriyāviśeṣaṇāttiṣṭhaterakarmakatve'pi paripanthasya karmatvam; tatpuruṣe tu paritaḥ panthāḥ paripantha iti `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ' iti vacanātkarma, tadityadhikārasāmarthyādityanye | pāripanthikaścora iti | yaḥ panthānaṃ varjayitvā tiṣṭhati yo vā panthānaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati sa evamucyate |
laukikavākyapradarśanārthamiti | paripanthaṃ tiṣṭhatītyetallaukikavākyaṃ tasya pradarśanārthaṃ dvitīyoccāraṇam | athaivamarthe dvitīyoccāraṇe kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha---paripathaparyāya ityādi | kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ? ityāha---sa viṣayāntare'pīti | asati tu jñāpane pratyayasanniyogena paripanthaśabdasya nipātanaṃ vijñāyate, tataśca tato'nyatra prayogo na syāt‌ ||
māthottarapadapadavyanupadaṃ dhāvati || 4.4.37 ||
māthaśabdaḥ pathiparyāya iti | mathyate praśādyate gantṛbhiriti kṛtvā | daṇḍākāro matho daṇḍamāthaḥ ||
ākrandāṭṭhañca || 4.4.38 ||
ākrando deśa iti | duḥ khitānāṃ rodanasyāyanamārttāyanamucyate, ārttairīyate prāpyata iti kṛtvā | ārttāyanamārttānāṃ trātā ākranda ityucyate, ākrandyate ārttairāhūyata iti kṛtvā ||
padottarapadaṃ gṛhṇāti || 4.4.39 ||
padagrahaṇe svarūpaṃ gṛhyate, na suptiṅantamuttarapadasya padatvāvyabhicārād‌, ata evāha---padaśabda uttarapadaṃ yasyeti ||
pratikaṇṭhārthalalāmaṃ ca || 4.4.40 ||
kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ prati pratikaṇṭham, `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ | ābhimukhye vā, `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' iti | yastu pratigataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pratikaṇṭha iti prādisamāsaḥ, tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati' anabhidhānāt‌ ||
dharma carati || 4.4.41 ||
adharmācceti vaktavyamiti | grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādvacanam | ādharmika iti | nañatra virodhivacanaḥ, pāpācāra ityarthaḥ ||
pratipathameti ṭham̐śca || 4.4.42 ||
pratipathamiti | pūrvavadvīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ ||
samavāyān‌ samavaiti || 4.4.43 ||
samavāyaḥ samūha ucyata iti | samavayanti tasminniti kṛtvā | na sampradhāraṇeti | samayapūrvasyeṇaḥ sampradhāraṇāyāmapi prayogo'stītimanyate | samāgatya tadekadeśībhavatītyartha iti | tatra guṇabhūtasamāgamāpekṣayā samavāyamiti dvitīyānirdeśaḥ | loke tu prāyeṇa saptamī prayujyate---dravye guṇāḥ samavayantīti ||
pariṣado ṇyaḥ || 4.4.44 ||
paritaḥ sīdantyasyāmiti pariṣat‌, sampadāditvādadhikaraṇe kvip, `sadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam ||
saṃjñāyāṃ lalāṭakukkuṭyau paśyati || 4.4.46 ||
saṃjñānaṃ saṃjñā - pratītiḥ, prasiddhirityarthaḥ | abhidheyaniyamārthamiti | abhidheye sevakaviśeṣe bhikṣuviśeṣe ca niyamaḥ, tatraiva vṛttiryathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | na rūḍhyarthamiti | lālāṭika-kaukkuṭikaśabdayorḍitthādivadarūḍhatvāt‌ tanniyogena varttate, yāvadyoge ca varttate | yoge'pi lalāṭakukkuṭīdarśanamātreṇa ṭhañ‌ na bhavatītyetāvatsaṃjñāgrahaṇena prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthe na kriyate |
yādṛśastu yogo'tra vivakṣitastaṃ darśayati---sarvāvayavebhya ityādi | anupaśleṣasya vivaraṇaṃ kāryeṣvanupasthāyitvamiti, dūre sthito lalāṭameva paśyati, na punaḥ kāryeṣūpatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ |
kukkuṭīpāto lakṣyate iti | yāvati deśe kukkuṭī patati yāvantaṃ deśaṃ samatītya nipatītuṃ samarthā sa deśo lakṣyata ityarthaḥ | anenāpi prakāreṇa deśasyālpatvaṃ lakṣyate, kukkuṭī patatu mā vā'patadityāha---deśasyālpatayeti | etadeva spaṣṭayati---yo hi bhikṣuriti | bhikṣuḥ - saṃnyāsī ||
tasya dharmyam || 4.4.47 ||
dharmaḥ - anuvṛtta ācāraḥ, tato'napetaṃ dharmyam, `dharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete' iti vacanāt| dauvārikamiti | `dvārādīnāṃ ca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca ||
ṛto'ñ‌ || 4.4.49 ||
hoturdharmyaṃ hautramiti | hotṛśabdasya mahiṣyādiṣu pāṭhādapapāṭho'yam, poturdhamyamiti tu pāṭhaḥ | apara āha---yajamānasāhacaryādṛtvigvacanasya hotṛśabdasya mahiṣyādiṣu pāṭhaḥ, ayaṃ tu kriyāśabda udāhṛta iti |
narācceti vaktavyamiti | nṛśabdātsūtreṇaivāñi nāramiti siddhe naraśabdāṭṭhako nivṛttyarthaṃ vacanam, anabhidhānaṃ tu durjñānam ||
avakrayaḥ || 4.4.50 ||
avakrīyate'nenetyavakraya iti | krayo nāma - svadravyatyāgena paradravyasvīkaraṇam, tasyāvamatvamavaśabdo dyotayati | vāṇijyārthaṃ tailadhānyādikaṃ deśāntaraṃ nayatā'smin‌ śulkasthāne pratibhārametāvad‌ deyamiti tad‌deśādipatinā yatkalpitaṃ so'vakrayaḥ, piṇḍaka iti cocyate | tatra svadravyameva datvā svadravyameva svīkriyate ityayamavakrayo bhavati, na tu mukhyaḥ |
nanvityādi | avakrayasyāpyanādipravṛttatvāditi bhāvaḥ | lokapīḍayeti | arthalobhena dharmātikrameṇa dharmāpetatvaṃ darśayati ||
tadasya paṇyam || 4.4.51 ||
paṇyamiti viśeṣaṇāmatyādi | iha yo viśeṣaṇamupādhirvopādīyate dyetye tasmistena bhavitavyam, tadyathā---`sāsya devatā', indro devatā asya aindraḥ sthālīpāka iti devatātvaṃ vṛttāvantarbhavati, tadvadatrāpi paṇyatvamantarbhavatīti nātrāpūrvaṃ kiñcit‌ ||
kiśarādibhyaṣṭhan‌ || 4.4.53 ||
kiśarādayo gandhaviśeṣavacanāstadvati vartante, gandhānpinaṣṭīti yathā ||
śalāluno'nyatarasyām || 4.4.54 ||
śalāluka iti | `isusuktāntātkaḥ' ||
śilpam || 4.4.55 ||
kauśalamiti | kriyābhyāsapūrvako jñānaviśeṣaḥ | mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpamasyeti | mṛdaṅgo vādyate yena tanmṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpam bhāvasādhanasya gauṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | mṛdaṅgavādanaviṣayaṃ śilpamasyetyarthaḥ | mārdaṅgika iti |
nanu mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śalpimasyeti vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataśca mārdaṅgavādanika iti bhavitavyam ? tatrāha---mṛdaṅgetyādi | mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdāttu pratyayo na bhavatyanabhidhānāt‌, kiṃ tūpacaritavṛtterapi mṛdaṅgaśabdādeva bhavati | ata evānabhidhānāt‌ mṛdaṅganiṣpādanaṃ ślipamasya mārdaṅgikaḥ kumbhakāra ityatra na bhavati ||
maḍ‌ḍakajharjharādaṇanyatarasyām || 4.4.56 ||
ayameva nirdeśo jñāpayati---`tadvādanavṛttibhyo mṛdaṅgādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ' iti | na hi mukhyamaḍ‌ḍukajharjharayoḥ śilpena samānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate ||
praharaṇam || 4.4.57 ||
praharaṇamāyudham, prahriyate'neneti kṛtvā | dhānuṣka iti | pūrvavat kādeśaḥ, `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam ||
paraśvadhāṭ‌ṭhañca || 4.4.58 ||
paraśvadhaḥ - paraśu ||
śaktiyaṣṭyorīkak‌ || 4.4.59 ||
śakyate'nayā prahartumiti śaktiḥ, yaṣṭiśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikam | kimarthamīkagucyate na kagevocyate, kā rūpasiddhiḥ ? śaktiyaṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ bahvādiṅīṣantābhyāṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā kaki kṛte śāktīko yāṣṭīka iti siddham ; na sidhyati ? `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti | vibhāṣā ṅībuktaḥ, tadabhāvapakṣe dīrghasya śaṅkaiva nāsti ? evaṃ tarhi ikagevocyeta, ikāre'pi hi savarṇadīrghatve sidhyati, yasyeti lopa ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati | padasyāvagrahanivṛttirikārasya prayojanam | evaṃ tarhi sūtrārambho niṣphalaḥ syāt‌, pūrvasūtravihitena ṭhakaivāvagrahanivṛtteḥ siddhatvāt‌ ? nānarthakam ; vākyanivṛttyarthatvāt‌ | evamapi pratyayāntaramanarthakaṃ śaktiyaṣṭyorityetāvadvaktavyam, ṭhak‌ prakṛtaḥ, tasya punarvidhānaṃ vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, kimīkako vidhānena, tadvidhānāttuyasyeti lopo na bhaviṣyati | yathaiva tarhi yasyeti lopo na bhavati evaṃ savarṇadīrghatvamapi na syāt‌; yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate, yasyetilopaṃ ca prati ikāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ savarṇadīrghasya punarnimittameva ||
astināstidiṣṭaṃ matiḥ || 4.4.60 ||
yadyasti matiryasya sa āstikaḥ, core'pi prāpnoti, tasyāpi matisadbhāvāt‌ ? tatrāha---na ceti | tadviparīta iti | paraloko nāstīti matiryasya tannāstikaḥ- laukāyatikaḥ, na tvacetanaḥ padārthaḥ, matyabhāvamātre pratyayasyāniṣṭatvāt‌ | diṣṭam - daivam, tadviṣayā matiryasya sa daiṣṭikaḥ, vṛttāvapi pramāṇānupātinī matiryasyeti daivavit, pramīyate tebhyo daivamiti | pramāṇaśabdenetihāsapurāṇādivivakṣitam |
astināstiśabdau nipātāviti | tena prātipadikādhikāro na bādhyate iti bhāvaḥ | vacanasāmarthyāccetyabhyupagamyavādaḥ ||
śīlam || 4.4.61 ||
śīlaṃ svabhāva iti | śīlyate punaḥ punaḥ kriyate'neneti kṛtvā | apūpabha7ṇaṃ śīlamasyeti | śīlaviṣaye śīlatvamārepya sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyapadeśaḥ | bhakṣaṇakriyetyādi | śīlaṃ tāvadupāttatvādantarbhavati, kriyāviṣayatvācca śīlasya kriyādyantarbhavati, svabhāvācca bhakṣaṇakriyā, na niṣpādikā ||
chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ || 4.4.62 ||
chattraśīlatā śiṣyasya darśayitumāha---chādanādāvaraṇācchatramiti | chādayateḥ ṣṭrani `hasmantrankviṣu ca' iti hrasvaḥ | chattraśīla iti | chattrasahacaritā chādanakriyā śīlamasyetyartha | yadi tvapūpabhakṣaṇaṃ śīlamasyāpūpika itivat‌ chattrāvaraṇaṃ śīlamasya chāttrika iti vyutpādyate, tadā dāse'pi prāpnoti; abhidhānasvābhāvyāttu tathā nāśrīyate |
upasargapūrvo gṛhyate iti | tataśca tasya `ātaścopasarge' ityādinā vyutpattiḥ; kevalasya sthāśabdasyābhāvāt‌ | kevalasya tu pāṭhaḥ sarvopasargagrahārthaḥ | cureti paṭhyate, tatra corayateḥ `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc‌' iti yuci prāpte'smādeva nipātanādakāraḥ, guṇābhāvaśca | na ca yuco'nyatra bādhaḥ, coraṇetyapi bhavati ||
karmādhyayane vṛttam || 4.4.63 ||
karma - kriyā, tacca skhalitamapacārarūpaṃ vivakṣitam, na tacchīlaṃ karma, teneha na bhavati---adhyayane japo vṛtto'syeti | etaccabhidhānasvābhāvyāllabhyate | tadetadvakṣyati---yasyādhyayane niyuktasyetyādi | ekamanyaditi | samyakpāṭhāpekṣayā ||
bahvacpūrvapadāṭṭhac‌ || 4.4.64 ||
svarabhede'pyanyatvaṃ bhavati, na varṇabheda evetyāha---udātte karttavye iti | udāttagrahaṇaṃ samyaksvarasyopalakṣaṇam | anudāttagrahaṇaṃ cāsamyaksvarasya ||
hitaṃ bhakṣāḥ || 4.4.65 ||
hitam, bhakṣāḥ---iti padayoḥ paryavasānena sambandhaḥ | atra `hitam' iti sāmānyopakramatvādekavacanaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca | `bhakṣāḥ' ityapūpādiviśeṣeṣūpasaṃgrahātpuṃlliṅgaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca | ata evāha---yattatprathamāsamarthaṃ hitaṃ cettadbhavati tacca bhakṣā iti |
evaṃ tarhīti | evaṃ ca caturthyarthe pratyayo na ṣaṣṭhyarthe | kathaṃ tarhi pūrvamuktamasyeti ṣaṣṭhyartha iti ? evaṃ tarhyadhikāramātrāpekṣayā taduktam | apara āha---`hitaṃ bhakṣāstadasmai' iti sūtracchedaḥ, tataḥ `dīyate niyuktam' iti tasyā eveti |
hitārthaḥ kriyā ceti | hitārthastāvadu pāttatvādantarbhavati | bhakṣaṇakriyāpyapūpādiśabdānāṃ lakṣaṇayā tatra vṛtterantarbhavati ||
tadasmai dīyate niyuktam || 4.4.66 ||
avyabhicāroniyoga iti | asminpakṣe niyuktamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmaṇi dvitīyā | agrabhojanamasmai niyuktaṃ dīyata iti | yadyagrabhojanaṃ dīyate tadāsmai evetyeṣa niyogārthaḥ | tena kadācillope'pi na niyuktatāyā hāniḥ |
kecittviti | atra pakṣe niyuktamityantasaṃyoge dvitīyā ||
śrāṇāmāṃsaudanāṭṭiṭhan‌ || 4.4.67 ||
`śrā pāke' ktaḥ, kṣīrahaviṣoreva nipātanācchabhāvābhāve `saṃyogāderāto dhātoḥ' iti niṣṭātakārasya nakāraḥ | śrāṇā - yavāgūḥ | māṃsamiśra odano māṃsaudanaḥ |
ṭhañeva kasmānnokta iti | lāghāvātsa eva yukto vaktumiti bhāvaḥ | na hyatreti | dve apyete prakṛtī pūrvameva vṛddhe, yo'pi `vṛddhinimittasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, sa ṭiṭhanyapi `na kopadhāyāḥ' iti bhavati | māsaudanagrahaṇamityādi | ṭhañyeva vaktavye ṭiṭhano vacanamevātra pramāṇamiti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ ||
bhaktādaṇanyatarasyām || 4.4.68 ||
bhajerbhaktam - annam ||
tatra niyuktaḥ || 4.4.69 ||
niyuktamiti prakṛte punaniyuktagrahaṇamarthabhedārthameva, tamevārthabhedaṃ darśayati--niyukto'dhikṛta ityādi | kiñca--prakṛtaṃ niyuktagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇasya dīyata ityasyopādhiḥ, na tasyeha pratyayārthatvaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum ||
adhyāyinyadeśakālāt‌ || 4.4.71 ||
adhīte ityadhyāyī, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ, grahyādilakṣaṇo vā | adhyanasya yau deśakālau śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhau tāvadeśakālaśabdenocyete iti | apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālaśabdābhyāmanyatvātparyudāsavṛttyā, abhakṣyāsparśanīyavat‌ | tadyathā---śūdrādiprāṇibhirbhakṣyamāṇamapi laśunamabhakṣyamityucyate, spṛśyo'pi caṇḍālo'spṛśya ityucyate, apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ bhakṣyaspṛśyābhyāmanyatvāt‌; tadvadihāpi śmaśānacaturdaśyau svarūpeṇa deśakālāveva santāvapratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālābhyāmanyatvādadeśakālaśabdenocyete | `adhyanasya' ityetadadhyāyinā pratyayārthena sannidhāpitatvāllabhyate ||
kaṭhināntaprastārasaṃsthāneṣu vyavaharati || 4.4.72 ||
vyavaharati sambhavati paṇinā samānārthaḥ, āha hi---`vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ' iti; asti vivāde---vyavahāre parājita iti, asti vikṣepe---śalākāṃ vyaharatīti, asti kriyātattve; tadiha caramasya grahaṇaṃ taddhitasvabhāvādityāha---vyavahāraḥ kriyātattvamiti | yatra deśe yā kriyā yathānuṣṭheyā tatra tasyāstathānuṣṭhānamityarthaḥ | vaṃśāḥ-veṇavaḥ kaṭhinā yasminvaṃśakaṭhino deśaḥ | vardhrī - carmavikāraḥ kaṭhinā asminvardhrakaṭhinaḥ, āhitāgnyāditvādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | cakrayuktena śakaṭena caratīti cakracaraḥ, sa deśānanukrameṇa caran‌ tatrānuṣṭheyāviparītaṃ carannevamucyate | saṃsthānaprastārau sanniveśau ||
nikaṭe vasati | 4.4.73 ||
araṇyaṃ nivāse yasya sa āraṇyakaḥ, `araṇyānmanuṣye' iti vuñ‌ | bhikṣuḥ - saṃnyāsī | grāmātkrośe iti | `yataśca nirddhāraṇam' iti pañcamī | ayaṃ ca viviṣo'bhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate ||
āvasathāt‌ ṣṭhal‌ || 4.4.74 ||
āvasatyetamiti āvasathaḥ, `upasarge vaseḥ' itiyathapratyayaḥ | ṭhakaḥ pūrṇo vidhiriti | prāgvahatīyasya ṭhako vidhānaṃ pūrṇāmityarthaḥ, avadhiriti pāṭhe pūrṇaḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ ||
tadvahati rathayugaprāsaṅgam || 4.4.76 ||
nanu ya evārtho rathaṃ vahatīti sa eva rathasya voḍheti, tatra tasyedaṃ rathādyadityeva siddhaṃ nārtho rathagrahaṇena ? nanu tatroktaṃ rathāṅgaeveṣyata iti, voḍharyapi prayogadarśanādiṣyatām ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---dvau ratau vahati dvirathyaḥ, `dvigorluganapatye' iti prāgdīvyatīyo lugmā bhūt‌, `rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau' iti tadantavidhiḥ | `yugyaṃ ca pattre' ityeva siddham | iha yugagrahaṇamayugyamityatra `yayatoścatadarthe' iti svarārtham, nipātanasya tu kyabantattrādeṣa svaro na syāt‌ | rathāṅgavacano'yaṃ yugaśabdaḥ, iha na bhavati---yugaṃ vahati rājā kaliṃ dvāparaṃ veti | prāsaṅgaśabdo vatsānāṃ damanakāle skanghe yatkāṣṭhamāsajyate tadvācī gṛhyate, prasajyate iti prāsaṅgaḥ, iha na bhavati---prasaṅgādāgataḥ prāsaṅgastaṃ vahatīti | etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate ||
dhuro yaḍ‌ḍhakau || 4.4.77 ||
dhūrdhūrvateḥ, `bhrājabhāsa' iti kvip‌, `rāllopaḥ' | dhuraṃ vahatīti dhurya iti | `na bhakurchurām' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ `hali ca' iti iti dīrghābhāvaḥ | ḍhañatra vidhīyate, na tu ḍhakañ | dhaureyo bhavitā pituriti ca dṛśyate, dhaureyaka iti svārthike kani bhavati |
iha `dhuro ḍhak‌ ca' iti vaktavyam, cakārātprāgghatīyo yadbhaviṣyati ||
khaḥ sarvaghurāt‌ || 4.4.78 ||
strīliṅganirdeśo nyāyya iti | sarvā cāsau dhūśceti `pūrvakāla' ityādinā samāsaḥ, ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tatra dhūḥ śabdasya strīliṅgatvāt‌ `paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' iti vacanāt‌ strīliṅganirdeśasya nyāyyatvam, yathā---`bandhuni bahuvrīhau' ityatra | dakṣiṇadhurīṇaḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ dhuraṃ vahati, uttarāṃ dhuraṃ vahatīti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tato'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ ||
ekadhurālluk‌ ca || 4.4.79 ||
ekadhurāditi nirdeśaḥ sarvadhurādityanena vyākhyātaḥ | cakāreṇa kho'nukṛṣyate, tena sa tāvadvidheyaḥ, pratyayādarśanasya ca luk‌ saṃjñā | na cānyo'tra pratyayaḥ, tena khasyaiva lugvijñāyate, tasya yadi luk‌ syāccakāreṇānukṛṣya vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ | ekadhurāllugiti vaktavyam, luk‌ svabhāvādanantarasva khasya prākaraṇikasya yato vā vidhiranumāsyate, tadāha---tasya ca tugbhavatīti ekadhurīṇa iti | ekāṃ dhuraṃ vahatīti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tatrokto'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tataḥ khaḥ ||
śakaṭādaṇ‌ || 4.4.80 ||
śakaṭādaṇvidhānamanarthakam | kathaṃ śākṭa iti ? `tasyedam' ityaṇ‌ bhaviṣyati, yo hi śakaṭaṃ vahati śakaṭasyāsau voḍhā bhavati ? tatrāhuḥ---ārambhasāmarthyādatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ, tena dve śakaṭe vahati, dvaiśakaṭa iti prāgdīvyatīyo lugna bhavati ||
halasīrāṭ‌ṭhak‌ || 4.4.81 ||
iha yo halaṃ vahati sarīṃ ca tasyāsau voḍhā bhavati, tatra tasyedaṃ halasīrāṭṭhagityeva hālikaḥ saurika iti siddham, nārtho'nena ? atrāhuḥ---ārambhasāmarthyādatrāpi tadantavidhiḥ, dvaihālikaḥ, dvaisīrikaḥ, traisīrika iti luṅ‌ na bhavatīti ||
saṃjñāyāṃ janyāḥ || 4.4.82 ||
jāmāturvayasyeti | sā hi praṇayakalahādau janīṃ jāmātuḥ samīpaṃ prāpayati | janī vadhūrucyata iti | jāyate'syāṃ garbha iti kṛtvā | `janivadhyośca' iti vṛddhipratiṣedhe `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣ‌ ||
vidhyatyadhanuṣā || 4.4.83 ||
pādau vidhyanti padyā iti | tadantītyarthaḥ | `padyatyatadarthe iti padbhāvaḥ | ūravyā iti | `orguṇaḥ', `vānto yi pratyaye' |
nanvasamarthatvāditi | sāpakṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītyasāmarthyam, pratyayārtho hyatra bāhyam, karaṇaṃ dhanurapekṣate | nanu vyadhanamatra sāpekṣam, karaṇakriyayoḥ sambandhāt‌, vyadhanaṃ ca pradhānam, kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya, bhavati ca pradhānasyaṃ sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ, yathā---rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana iti ? bhavatu kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, taddhitastu svabhāvātsādhanapradhānaḥ | kriyā tu guṇabhūtetyuktam sā ca dhanurapekṣata ityasāmarthyam | anabhidhānacceti | atraikopapatyantaramanabhidhānameva darśayati | na hīti | `dhanuṣā padyaḥ' ityukte itthambhūtalakṣaṇā sahayogalakṣaṇā vā tṛtīyā gamyate, na tu pādau dhanuṣā vidhyatītyayaṃ vivakṣito'rthaḥ | avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam---asamarthatvādanabhidhaānāccātra pratyayo na bhavatīti | yo hi manyate---`adhanuṣeti pratiṣedhātpratyayo na bhavati' iti, tasya śarkarābhiḥ pādau viddhyati kaṇṭakairūrū viddhyatītyatra pratyayaḥ syādeva ? evaṃ tarhi viśeṣopalakṣaṇaparo'tra dhanuṣeti nirdeśaḥ, na tu dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvapratiṣedhapara ityarthaḥ | dhanuṣpratiṣedheneti | `nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvamupalakṣaṇatvameva pratipādayati | yasyāmiti | teneha na bhavati---cauraṃ viddhyatīti | sambhāvyate hi pracyavacchedanādikāyāṃ corasya vyadhanakriyāyāṃ dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvam ||
dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā || 4.4.84 ||
labdheti tṛnantametat, tṛjante tu `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam | tṛnante tu `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' iti pratiṣedhād‌ dvitīyaiva bhavati ||
vaśaṅgaṃtaḥ || 4.4.86 ||
`vaśa kāntau', vaśanaṃ vaśaḥ, `vaśiraṇyorupasaṅkhyānam' ityac‌ | kāmaḥ-icchā, tāṃ prāpta iti | parecchānugāmītyarthaḥ ||
padamasmin‌ dṛśyam || 4.4.87 ||
nirdeśādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktiriti | dvitīyā tu na bhavati; dṛśyamiti kyapā karmaṇo'bhihitatvāt‌ | śakyārthe kṛtyapratyaya iti | tena yogyatve sati padasparśanābhāve'pi padyaḥ kardama iti prayoga upapadyata iti bhāvaḥ | mudrā- sanniveśaḥ, pratirūpā mudrā pratimudrā | nātidravo nātiśuṣka iti | pāṃsavo'ti nātyalpā nātibahulāḥ padyāḥ ||
mūlamasyāvarhi || 4.4.88 ||
prathamāsamarthāditi | dvitīyāyā nimittābhāvānnirdeśādeva prathamaiva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | `vṛhū udyamane', vādirayaṃ na bādiḥ | dṛśyate hi `ud‌vṛha rakṣaḥ sahamūlamindra hyasmuṣmik‌ pravṛhāṇa', `tadvavarhātmanodevā' iti ca āvarhaṇamāvarhaḥ-utpāṭanam, āvarho'syāstītyāvarhi, suṣṭhu pakvā na śakyante saṃgrahītum | madhyato lūyamāne kośasthā api yasyāmavasthāyāṃ pateyustāmavasthāṃ prāptā ityarthaḥ ||
saṃjñāyāṃ dhenuṣyā || 4.4.89 ||
yaśca pratyayo nipātyata iti | kutra ? anirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe, tadāha---yā dhenuruttamarṇāyeti | kathaṃ punaryati prakṛte yapratyayo nipātyate ? tatrāhaantodātto'pi hyayamiṣyata iti | yati hi `titsvaritam' iti svaritaḥ syād‌, antodāttaśceṣyate, na kevalaṃ saṃjñāyām, api tvantodātto'pītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ ||
gṛhapatinā saṃyukte ñyaḥ || 4.4.90 ||
anyasyāpītyādi | gṛhapatirhi yajamānaḥ, sa yathā gārhapatye kāryāṇi karoti tathā dakṣiṇāgnāvāhavanīye ca, bhūyo vā''havanīye; tasmādanyasyāpi gṛhapatinā yogo'sti | yadyevam, tatrāpyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---tatreti | apara āha---gṛhapatiragniviśeṣaḥ, tena saṃyogo gārhapatyasyaivāgnihotre'pi gārhapatye agnaye gṛhapataye prajāpataye, patnīsaṃyājeṣu ca tatraivejyate iti , tatrāpi gṛhapatiragnirgṛhyate na yajamāna ityatra saṃjñādhikāra eva śaraṇam ||
nauvayodharmaviṣamūlamūlasītātulābhyastāryatulyaprāpyavadhyānāmyasamasamitasammiteṣu || 4.4.91 ||
tatra nāvādīnāṃ prathamamūlāntānāṃ pañcānāṃ dvitīyamūlādīnāṃ ca trayāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak‌ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā tato dvayoraparo dvandvaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tvaṣṭānāṃ yugapatsahavivakṣā; ki siddhaṃ bhavati ? na mūlayoḥ sārūpyādekaśeṣo bhavati | kā punaratra samarthavibhaktiḥ ? ityata āha---pratyayārthadvāreṇeti | dvāram - mukham, upāyaḥ | iha tāryādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ, tatsambandhe karaṇe kartari hetau tulyārthayoge ca yathāsambhavaṃ tṛtīyaiva bhavati | nāvyamiti | atra tāvattaraṇakriyāyāṃ karaṇatvam |
vayasā tulya iti | tatra hetumāha---yo yena vayastulyaḥ sa taṃ prati vayasyaḥ | śatrau na bhavatīti | kiṃ tu mittra eva bhavati |
nanu ceti | dharmeṇa prāpyaṃ sukhādi, phalamapi dharmādanapetameva; kāryasya kāraṇāvinābhāvāditi praśnaḥ | dharmaṃ yadanuvartata iti | anādiḥ śiṣṭasamācārastajjanyo vā''tmaguṇo dharmaḥ, yadanuṣṭhānamanuvartate taddharmādanapedatam, phalaṃ tu dharmādapaityeveti kutaḥ ? ityāha---kāryavirodhitvāditi | dharmasya kāryaṃ sukhānubhavaḥ, kāryaṃ virodhi nāśakaṃ yasya sa kāryavirodhī, tasya bhāvaḥ kāryavirodhitvaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ | utpanne hi phale dharmo naśyati, anyathā sakṛddharme kṛta svargamanubhavataḥ prabhavo na syāt‌ |
vadhamarhatītyartha iti | vadhyaśabdasya `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' ityatrārthe vyutpāditatvāt|
anāmyamabhibhavanīyamiti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāmāpūrvo namirabhibhave vartate |
paṭādīnāmutpattikāraṇamiti | paṭādīnāmutpattyarthaṃ vaṇigbhirviniyuktaṃ yadvastu tanmūlaśabdavācyamityarthaḥ | teneti | mūlena | taditi | mūlyam | śeṣīkriyata iti | śeṣīkaraṇamevātrābhibhava ityarthaḥ | guṇabhāvamāpadyate kathamityāha---mūlaṃ hi saguṇaṃ mūlyaṃ karotīti | mūlyamiha kartṛ, mūlaṃ karma, paṭādiṣu vikrīyamāṇeṣu yanmūlātiriktaṃ vastu lābho nāma tanmūlyam, guṇo bhāgaḥ, sa punariha mūlyameva, tena saha vartate saguṇaḥ, hiśabdo hetau | etaduktaṃ bhavati---yasmānmūlyamātmanaiva bhāgabhūtena sabhāgaṃ mūlaṃ karoti tasmānmūle mūlyabhibhūyate śeṣīkriyate, mūlye sati tena guṇena saguṇaṃ mūlaṃ bhavatiḥ iyameva cāvanatiḥ, ayamevābhibhavaḥ, idameva śeṣīkaraṇam | loke tu yāvatā dravyeṇa paṭādiko vikrīyate tatra samudāye mūlyaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, naṃ mūlatirikte bhāge, sa ca mūlyasambhavādautatrāpi krayadravye mūlyaśabdaprayogaḥ siddho bhavati |
sītā - halāgram, sampūrvādiṇaḥ ktaḥ, samitam - saṅgatam, nimnonnatādirahitaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ, samīkṛtamiti yāvat‌ | dvisītyamiti | dvābhyāṃ sītābhyāṃ samīkṛtamiti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ |
tulayā sammitaṃ tulyamiti | atra tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā | yadyapi tadyoge ṣaṣṭhyati bhavati, tathāpi nāvādibhissāhacaryāttulāśabdādapi tṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayaḥ | ata eva pūrvamuktam---`tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate' iti | ṣaṣṭhyantādapi na kaściddoṣaḥ, nyāyastu kathitaḥ | kathaṃ punastulyasya tulayā sadṛśatvamata āha---yatheti | evaṃ tadapīti | tadapi tulyaṃ pratiyoginaṃ sādṛśyena paricchinatti, etad‌ vyutpādyatvena pradarśitam | sadṛśaparyāyastulyaśabdaḥ, nāvayavārthaḥ kaścit‌, ata eva `tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam' ityatroktam---`tulyaśabdaḥ sadṛśaparyāyaḥ' iti ||
dharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete || 4.4.92 ||
nirdeśādeveti | satyarthasambhave'rthāntarasya vā sambhave sati nirdeśāditi draṣṭavyam, `dhuro yaḍḍhako' ityatrātiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ | saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyasya niyata iti | śāstrīyāt‌ patho yadanapetaṃ tat pathyam, na tu tasmādanapetaścoraḥ ||
chandaso nirmite || 4.4.93 ||
pratyayārthasāmardhyaṃ labhyate iti | nirmāṇe chandasaḥ karaṇatvāt‌ | iṣṭaparyāyaścandaḥ śabdo gṛhyate iti na vedavacanaḥ, nāpi triṣṭubādivacanaḥ | etacca saṃjñādhikārāllabhyate | yadyapi svacchandato hi vacasāṃpravṛttiḥ, `chandānuvṛttidutsādhyā' ityādāvakarāntaśchandaśabda icchāparyāyaḥ, tathāpi tasyaiva dhātorasunnantasyecchāvācitvamaviruddhaṃ ceti manyate ||
uraso'ṇ‌ ca || 4.4.94 ||
aurasaḥ putra iti | ātmanotpādita ityarthaḥ | saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyaniyama iti | urasā nirmitaṃ sukhamityādau na bhavati ||
hṛdayasya priyaḥ || 4.4.95 ||
hṛdayam - antaḥ karaṇam, priyam - prītikaram | hṛdyamiti | `hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' iti hṛdādeśaḥ ||
bandhane carṣau || 4.4.96 ||
ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāditi | bandhanayoge kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | ṛṣirvedo gṛhyate iti | `taduktamṛṣiṇā' ityādau darśanāt‌ | yatsvādhyānasampanne vasiṣṭhādavṛṣiśabdaḥ, tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; saṃjñādhikārāt‌ ||
matajanahalātkarṇajalpakarṣeṣu || 4.4.97 ||
pratyayārthasāmarthyalabdheti | karaṇādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ, tadvacanāḥ karaṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṛdantāḥ, tadyoge yathāyatham `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati | saṃjñādhikārāddhalasambandhācca karpaśabdo'pi kriyāvacano gṛhyate, na parimāṇaśabdaḥ | matasya karaṇamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | janasya jalpa iti karttari | jalpaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, ata evātra bhāvaḥ sādhanaṃ veti noktam | halasya karṣaṃ iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, karaṇasya vā kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ kartari | dvihalya iti | `rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau' iti tadantavidhiḥ ||
tatra sādhuḥ || 4.4.98 ||
sāmanya iti | `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | pravīṇaḥ - nipuṇaḥ, yogyaḥ - samarthaḥ | tatra hi paratvāditi | `tasmai hitam' ityanena caturthīsamarthātpratyayo vidhīyate, anena tu saptamīsamarthāttena nātra `vipratiṣedhe param' ityetatparatvāparatvaṃ vivakṣitam, ki tarhi ? iṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ, upakāralakṣaṇe sādhau prākkrītīyānāmeveṣṭatvāt‌ `tasmai hitam' ityanena vidhinā bhavitavyamityarthaḥ | etacca saṃjñādhikārāllabhyate ||
pratijanādibhyaḥ khañ‌ || 4.4.99 ||
janaṃ janaṃ prati pratijanamiti `yathārthe--yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ | pratijane sādhuriti | `tṛtīyāsamaptamyorvahulam' | parasyakulam, amuṣyakulamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'smādeva nipātanāta ṣaṣṭhyā aluk‌ | pūrvasūtra uktam---`sādhuḥ pravīṇo yogyo vā gṛhyate, nopakārakaḥ', tatra prākkrītīyānāmeveṣṭatvāditi, iha tu na tathetyāha---yatreti | prākkrītīyā bādhyante iti | aprāptiratra bādhaḥ; na hi caturthyantādvidhīyamānānāṃ saptamyantebhyaḥ prāptirasti | tatra prākkrītīyā na bhavantīti vaktavye bādhyata ityuktam---`caturthyantebhyo'pyanabhidhānātprākkrītīyā na bhavanti' iti darśayitum ||
bhaktāṇṇaḥ || 4.4.100 ||

pariṣado ṇyaḥ || 4.4.101 ||
ṇapratyayo'pyatreṣyate iti | `pāriṣadā kṛtireṣā tatrabhavatām', `sarvavedapāriṣadaṃ hīdaṃ śāstram' iti ca bhāṣyakāraprayogāt‌ ||
pathyatithivasatisvapaterḍhañ‌ || 4.4.104 ||
patantyaneneti panthāḥ, `gameriniḥ' `patestha ca'; atati satataṃ gacchatītyatithiḥ, na vidyate tithiryasya so'pyatithiḥ, ekamapi dinamatrāsthita ityarthaḥ | vasanaṃ vasatiḥ, `vaseśca' ityatipratyayaḥ, tatra yogyā vāsateyī rātriḥ | svapatirādyaḥ, svapateryogyaṃ svāpateyaṃ dhanam ||
samānatīrthe vāsī || 4.4.107 ||
vasatīti vāsī, nipātanāṇṇiniḥ, grahyāderākṛtigaṇatvādvā sādhuriti | nivṛttamiti | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha---vāsīti pratyayārtha iti | sādhurityasyānuvṛttau tu tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vāsigrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ | tīrthaśabdeneha gururucyata iti | prayāgāditīrthasādharmyāt‌ | tarantyaneneti tīrtham, tarateḥ kthan | mukhyasya tīrthasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; saṃjñādhikārāt‌ ||
samānodare śayita o codāttaḥ || 4.4.108 ||
okāraścodātta iti | titsvaritasyāpavādaḥ | śayitaḥ sthita iti | śeteḥ sthitāvapi vṛtteḥ, āmāśayaḥ, jalāśaya iti yathā | samānodarya iti | uddīryata ityudaram, udi dṛṇāteralacau pūrvapadāntalopaścetyalacoranyataraḥ | samānaṃ ca tadudaraṃ ca samānodaram, `pūrvāparapratham' ityādinā samāsaḥṣa tataḥ pratyayaḥ ||
sodarādyat‌ || 4.4.109 ||
yakārādau pratyaye vivakṣita iti | `vibhāṣodare' ityatra `tīrthe yaḥ' ityato ya ityanuvartate, tatra ya ityeṣā viṣayasaptamīti darśayati | o codātta iti tu nānuvartata iti | yavidhānasāmarthyāt‌ ||
bhavecchandasi || 4.4.110 ||

pāthonadībhyāṃ ḍyaṇ‌ || 4.4.111 ||

veśantahimavadbhyāmaṇ‌ || 4.4.112 ||

tugrād‌ ghan‌ || 4.4.115 ||

agrādyat‌ || 4.4.116 ||

ghacchau ca || 4.4.117 ||
cakārastugrāddhanityasyānukarṣaṇārtha iti | pūrvameva vihitasya yato'nukarṣaṇe prayojanābhāvāt‌ ||
samudrābhrāda ghaḥ || 4.4.118 ||

barhiṣi dattam || 4.4.119 ||

rakṣoyātūnāṃ hananī || 4.4.121 ||
rakṣerasuni rakṣaḥ `kamimanijani' ityādinā | yātestau yātuḥ | yātuśabdo rakṣaḥ paryāyaḥ | `virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām' ityekaśeṣastu na bhavati; bahvarthābhidhāyisvarūpaparatvena sūtre bhinnārthayornirdeśāt‌ | nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punaḥ `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī | vahuvacanaṃ stutivaiśiṣṭyajñāpanārthamiti | taddhi bahuvacanātpratyayavidhyartham, anyathā dvitvād‌ dvivacanameva nyāyyaṃ syāt‌ | kathaṃ punarbahuvacanena stutivaiśiṣṭyaṃ jñāpyate ? tatrāha---bahūnāmiti | bahuvacanāntātpratyaye bahūnāṃ rakṣasāṃ hanane sāmarthyamudbhāvyate mantre | tathā ca stutiviśiṣṭā sampūrṇā bhavati | yogaścāyaṃ śaiṣikayoraṇchayorapavādaḥ ||
revatījagatīhaviṣyābhyaḥ praśasye || 4.4.122 ||

asurasya svam || 4.4.123 ||

tadvānāsāmupadhāno mantra itīṣṭakāsu luk‌ ca matoḥ || 4.4.125 ||
matunirhrāsaḥ - matorapacayaḥ | tadvānityavayavena samudāyo nidiśyata iti | sa vivakṣito varca śabdādiravayavo'sminmantralakṣaṇe samudāye'stītyevamekadeśārthābhidhāyinaḥ sarvanāmnaḥ samudāye matubayaṃ vihita ityarthaḥ | varcaḥ śabdo yasminmantre'stīti | sa punaḥ kumbheṣṭakopadhānamantraḥ---`bhūtaṃ ca stha bhavyaṃ ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasavaḥ' ityādikaḥ | varcasyā upadadhātīti | yathā varcasyā bhavanti tathopadhātītyarthaḥ | tejasvānmantraḥ---`vasu ca stha vāma ca stha devasya vaḥ savituḥ' ityādikaḥ | vayasvanto mantrāḥ---`tryavirvayastraṣṭub‌' ityādikāḥ, ṛtumanto mantrāḥ---`madhuśca mādhavaśca' ityādikāḥ | mantrasamudāyādeva mā bhūditi | nanu tadvānityasminnasati `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' iti vacanādāsāmiti prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭatvāt ṣaṣṭhyantādiṣṭakāvācina upadhāne mantre pratyayavidhiḥ prasañjanīyaḥ ? satyam ; āsāmiti prathamaṃ na kariṣyata iti matvā praśnaprativacane, tataśca tadvānityasyābhāve `tryavirvayastriṣṭuplandaḥ' ityamupadhānamantra āsāmiṣṭakānāmiti vākyaṃ syāt‌, tataścetinā parāmṛṣṭānmantrasamudāyādeva pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | varcasvānupasyānamantra ityādi | upasthānaṃ mantreṇābhimantraṇaṃ vivakṣitam, `śivena mā cakṣuṣā' ityādikaḥ kumbheṣṭakābhimantraṇe viniyuktaḥ | aṅ‌gulimānityādi | yadyapi sarvāsāmiṣṭakānāmaṅ‌gulimānhasta upadhānaḥ, tathāpi yāstūṣṇīmupadheyā iṣṭakāstāsu mantravyāvṛttyarthatayā viśeṣaṇamarthavat‌---eṣāṃ kapālānāmityatra mā bhūditi | strīliṅganirdeśādatrāprasaṅga iti ceti ? evamapi śarkarāsu prasaṅgaḥ |
anekapadasambhave'pīti | asati tvitikaraṇe mantre bahūnāṃ sambhavādyena kenacetpadena tadvānmantro gṛhyaṃ ta tathā padaikadeśena varṇasamudāyena, itikaraṇāttvaya matiprasaṅgo na bhavati |
matubgrahaṇamuttarārtham aśvimānityatra matupa eva lugyathā syāt‌, hanemābhūditi | iha tu mattvantātpratyayavidhānāttasyaiva tugbhaviṣyati | varcaḥ śabdādāvasuprabhṛteraprasaṅgaḥ, uṇādīnāmatryutpannatvāt‌ iha `prāṇabhṛta upadadhāti' ityādāvabhedopacārātpratyayābhāvaḥ ||
aśvimānaṇ‌ || 4.4.126 ||

vayasyāsu mūrdhno matup‌ || 4.4.127 ||
vayasyāsviti | chandasi yā vayasyā iṣṭakā ucyante tāsvityarthaḥ | tāśca bahvyaḥ, tāsvantaścatasro mūrdhanvatyaḥ, `viṣṭambhovayaḥ' ityādivayasvadbhirmantrairupadheyāḥ, tatra ca yadyapi mūrddhā vayaḥ prajāpatiśchanda ityantima ekasminneva mantre mūrddhaśabdo'sti, tathāpi sāhacaryād‌ `viṣṭambho vayaḥ' ityādyāścatvāro mūrdhanvanta ucyante, yathā---chattriṇo yāntīti, tena mūrddhanvatīrupadadhātīti bahuvacanam | mūrddhanvānapi bhavatīti | nanu `ano nuṭ‌' iti chandasi nuḍ‌ vidhīyate ? satyam ; yathā sūtrakāreṇa chāndasameva padaṃ prayuktam---`vayasasyāsu' iti, tathedamapi vṛttikāreṇa, mūrdhanvānapi bhavati chandasītyarthaḥ | `vayasyāśca tāḥ mūrdhanvatyāśca' iti `ubhayathāpi chandasyabhidhīyate' ityuktaṃ bhavati |
yatra mūrddhanśabda eva kevala iti | yathā---`agne yaśasvinyaśase samarpaya' ityādike mantre | tato mā bhūditi | tadabhidhāyino mūrddhanśabdādityarthaḥ | mūrddhanvata iti vaktavyamiti | `tadvān‌' iti ca' luk‌ ca matoḥ' iti cānuvartate, tataśca mūrddhanvata iti yuktaṃ vaktumiti bhāvaḥ | iha tu gāyatrīḥ purastādupadadhāti, `tejo vai gāyatrī teja eva mukhato dhatte mūrddhanvatī bhavati' iti mukhyo gāyatrīṣu mūrdhaṃnvatīśabdaḥ prathamaṃ matubantaḥ prayuktaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadupadhānamantreṣu `agnirmūrdhā bhuvaḥ' ityādiṣu vayaḥ śabdasyābhāvāt‌ ||
matvarthe māsatanvoḥ || 4.4.128 ||
matvarthagrahaṇāllabdharmarthaṃ darśayati---prathamāsamarthādityādi | māsatanvoriti `kṛṣicamitanidhanisajjikharjjibhya ūḥ' ityūkārāntastanūśabdaḥ sūtre nirdiṣṭaḥ, na tu `bhṛmṛśīṅ‌ tṝcaritsaritanimimasjibhya uḥ' ityukā rāntaḥ; `dvandve ghi' iti pūrvanipātaprasaṅgāt‌ | anantarārthe ceti | na kevalaṃ matvarthamātra iti caśabdasyārthaḥ |
lugakārekārarephāścetyādi |` rādiphaḥ' ityatra varṇāditi na sambadhyate, tena samudāyanirdeśe'pi iphaḥ kṛtaḥ | anye tu raśabdā iti paṭhanti, pratyaya ityadhikāro'kārādibhiḥ sambadhyate, na tu lukā | tapanaṃ tapaḥ, sahanaṃ sahaḥ, bhāvo'sun‌, `tadasminnasti' iti sūtreṇa vihitasya yato luk‌ | kathaṃ punaratra napuṃsakatvam, yāvatā taddhitaluki satyabhidheyavalliṅgena bhavitavyam ? ata āha---napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ chāndasatvāditi | iṭ‌ - annam, iṣyamāṇatvāt | ūrk‌ - balam, `ūrja balaprāṇanayoḥ', tābhyāmakāraḥ pratyayaḥ---iṣaḥ, ūrjaḥ | śocanaṃ śuk‌, pūrvavatkvip‌, ātapātirekeṇa śarīrādeḥ śoṣaḥ, tadvānmāsaḥ śuciḥ | evaṃ śukraḥ |
atra chāndasatvādevāyasmayāditvadbhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ, tadeva chando'dhikāre lugādīnāṃ vidhānādbhāṣāyāṃ śuciśukādīnāmanyāyyaḥ prayogaḥ syāt‌, vyutpatyantareṇa vā, avyutpannā vā nabhasyādayaḥ śabdā māseṣu vartante | iṣorjaśabdāvarśaādyacpratyayāntau, matvarthīye rapratyaye pṛṣodarāditvājjaśtvābhāve śukra iti bhavati, śocaterantarbhāvitaṇyarthādauṇādike kipratyayaye kṛte śuciriti bhavati, śocayati saṃtāpayati prāṇina iti kṛtvā | abhedopacārānnabhaḥ prabhṛtīnāṃ māseṣu vṛttiḥ, nabhasyaprabhṛtayastu `tatra sādhuḥ' iti yadantāḥ, `matau chaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ' ityatra yathāntareṇāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ matvarthe pratyayo labhyate, tathehāpi lapsyate; nārtho'rthagrahaṇena ||
madhorña ca || 4.4.129 ||
atrāpi bhāṣāyāṃ madhuyogānmāso madhuḥ, tasya prajñādiṣu pāṭhādādyudāttatvam ||
ojaso'hani yatkhau || 4.4.130 ||
yad‌grahaṇamanarthakam, `khaśca' ityeva vaktavyam, cakārātprākaraṇiko yadbhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; `khaśca' ityucyamāno'nantarasūtravihitasya ñasya samuccayo vijñāyeta, tasmādyad‌grahaṇam ||
kha ca || 4.4.132 ||
yogavibhāga ityādi | kecitpunarekameva yogamadhīyate | tathā ca---`yathāsaṃkhyāmanudeśaḥ samānām' pratyayavidhyartho bahuvacananirdeśaḥ, bahuvacanāntāt‌ pratyayotpattau yathāsaṃkhyamiṣyata iti | uttarārthaśceti | uttaratra khasyaivānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌, yato mā bhūditi ||
pūrvaiḥ kṛtaminiyau ca || 4.4.133 ||
bahuvacanāntenetyādi | bahuvacanāntātpratyayavidhyartho bahuvacananirdeśaḥ | bahuvacanāntātpratyayotpattau yathā praśaṃsā gamyate---pūrvairbahubhiḥ kriyata iti pratīteḥ, tena pūrvaśabdaśca vṛddheṣu puruṣeṣu pravartata ityarthaḥ ||
sahasreṇa saṃmitau ghaḥ || 4.4.135 ||
nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punastulyārthayoge tṛtīyā | sammita eva lakṣayitavya iti | kiṃ kāraṇ ? ityāha---tatreti | chandasi hi tatra sammite prayogo dṛśyate ||
somamarhati yaḥ || 4.4.137 ||
`chandasi' ityadhikārādbhāṣāyāṃ somyaśabdasya sādhutvaṃ cintyam---`āyuṣmānbhava somyeti vācyo vipro'bhivādane' iti | kecitsaumyeti vṛddhiṃ paṭhanti | saumyaśabdo darśanīyavacanaḥ sukhādivat‌ ||
maye ca || 4.4.138 ||
maya iti mayaḍartho lakṣyate iti | śabde kāryasyāsambhavāt‌ | tatra yathāyogaṃ samarthavibhāktariti | āgate pañcamī, vikārāvayavayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī, prakṛtavacane prathamā ||
vasoḥ samūhe ca || 4.4.140 ||
ośrāvayetyādikasyākṣarāṇi gaṇyante, saptadaśātmakaśchandasyo'kṣarasamūhaḥ | prajāpatiḥ prajāpatinā dṛṣṭaḥ | hastau pṛṇasveti pṛṇātiḥ pūraṇakarmā ||
nakṣatrād‌ ghaḥ || 4.4.141 ||
samūha iti nānuvartata iti | tenānirdiṣṭārthatvātsvārthe pratyaya utpadyata iti bhāvaḥ ||
śivaśamariṣṭasya kare || 4.4.143 ||
karotīti kara iti | pacādyac‌ | sāmarthyalabhyā ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiriti | sā punaḥ kṛdyogalakṣaṇo karmaṇi | bhāṣāyāṃ śivatātiprabhṛtīnāṃ sādhutvaṃ cintyam |
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ caturthasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ
<5>
<5.1>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ

padamañjarī

prāk krītācchaḥ āvatsīya iti| || 5.1.1 ||
atidohanādvatsānprati hito na bhavati godhugityevaṃ prakṛtyā nañā ca yugapatpratyayārthasya sambandhaḥ, pradhānabhūtaśca pratyayārthaḥ| bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ, pradhānatvādevānekopakāryatvasyāvirodhāt, `sāmānyāprayogaḥ' iti liṅgācca| kiñca--viśeṣato'tra jñāpakamasti yadayaṃ natro guṇapratiṣedhe `sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' ityāha, tajjñāpayati--`bhavatyevañjātīyake'pi viṣaye taddhitaḥ' iti, anyathā sampādyarhahitālamarthā ye taddhitāstadantānyuttarapadāni natro guṇapratiṣedhe pravṛttinimittapratiṣedhe varttamānātparāṇi na sambhaveyuḥ| tatra pūrvaṃ pratyayaḥ, praścānnañsamāsaḥ| ata eva yatnasādhyatvādavatsīya ityāderupanyāsaḥ| yastu vatsādanyasmai hitaḥ, yo vā vatsīyādanyaḥ, na tatra kiñcidayatnasādhyam |
atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, yāvatā na hyasya `prāgvateṣṭhañ' ityārabhya ye yogāḥ `tena krītam' ityetasmātprāk paṭhitāḥ, teṣu vyāpāro'sti, na hi tatra kaścidartho nirddiśyate, tataśca `prākṭhañaḥ' iti vaktavyam, `prāgvateṣṭañ' ityayameva ca pratyāsannaṣṭhañagrahīṣyate, na viprakṛṣṭaḥ `lokasarvalokāṭṭhañ' ityādiḥ? ityata āhaartho'vadhitvena gṛhīta iti| gṛhīto grahītumiṣṭaḥ| ayamabhiprāyaḥ-- avaśyamatrārtho'vadhitvena grāhyaḥ, anyathā `prāk ṭhañaḥ' ityucyamāne'vadhinā sajātīyasyāvadhimato'bhāvādarthāḥ, prakṛtayo vā'vadhimattvena gṛhyoran-prāk ṭhaño ye'rthāḥ, yā vā prakṛtaya iti| tatra prakṛtipakṣe'dhikārasya nadīsrotorūpeṇa pratiprakṛtyupaśthānād `ugavādibhyo yacchaśca' iti yacchayoḥ sannidhānādaviśeṣādutsargāpavādabhāvo na syāt, tavyattavyānīyarāmiva vikalpa eva syāt| arthe tvavadhitvena gṛhīte prāk krītādye'rthāsteṣvasyopasthānaṃ bhavati| avadhisajātīyo hyavadhimān bhavati, yathā--`māsātparaḥ' iti kālaḥ pratīyate, `grāmātpūrvaḥ' iti deśaḥ, `alo'ntyātpūrvaḥ' ityaleva, tato'tiprasaṅgo na bhavati| katham? samānārthe prakṛtiviseṣā dutpadyamāno yadādiḥ prakṛtyantare sāvakāśaṃ chaṃ bādhate| yathā--takraṃkauṇḍinye dadhi, ato'rtho'vadhitvena gṛhīta iti| nanu ca `prāka ṭhañaḥ' ityucyamāne bhavatu nāmaighaṃ prākṭhaño yāḥ prakṛtaya iti, tathāpi yadādiviṣaṣaye cho na bhaviṣyati, jñāpakāt, yadayam `vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' iti vibhāṣāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-nānyaviṣaye cho bhavatīti, evaṃ ca kṛtvā cha ityevādhikāro'stu, nārtho'vadhinirdesena, jñāpakācca pratisūtramupasthāne'pyanyaviṣaye na bhaviṣyati, prāgvateṣṭhañityādike tu prakāraṇe nāsyādhikāraḥ, adhikārantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvāt ? satyam; pratipattigauravaparihārārthastvavadhinirdeśaḥ, sa cāvadhirartha eva nirdeśyaḥ, na pratyayaḥ, anyathā `laśunaṃ ca bhakṣitaṃ vyādhiśca na nivṛttaḥ' ityetadāpadyeta ||

ugavādibhyo yat || uvarṇāntātprātipadikād gavādibhyaśceti || 5.1.2 ||
uvarṇādergaśabdādervaśabdādeśca yadbhavatītyartho na bhavati, gavādigaṇapāṭhataḥ| sanaṃgurityādi| carmavikāralakṣaṇasyāño'vakāśaḥ-vārdhra carma, vāratraṃ carmeti, uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya yato'vakāśaḥ--śaṅkavyam, picavyamiti; sanaṅgorubhayaprasaṃṅge paratvādañprāpnoti| carurnāma iviriti| sthālīvacanasya caruśabdasya takadadhikaraṇe haviṣyupacāradvṛttiḥ| `vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' ityatra havirviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇam, na svarūpasya; tasya gavādiṣu pāṭhāt| viparyayastu na bhavati--iha viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ tatra svarūpagrahaṇamiti; gavādiṣvasañjātavirodhitvena svarūpagrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| ataḥ `vibhāṣā ivirapūpādibhyaḥ' ityatraiva viśeśagrahaṇamiti sthite tasyāvakāśaḥ--āmikṣyam, āmikṣīyam; puroḍāśyāḥ, puroḍāśīyā iti|
annavikārebhyaśceti paṭhyata iti| tasyāvakāśaḥ--surāḥ, suryāḥ, surīyāḥ, odanyāḥ, odanīyā iti, uvarṇaāntasakṣaṇasya yataḥ sa eva; carusaktubhyāmubhya prasaṅge paratvādvibhāṣā prāpnoti, tatra sarvatra pūrvavipratiṣedhena yatpratyaya eveṣyata iti| ayameva nityo yatpratyaya ityarthaḥ|
nabhaṃ cādeśamāpadyata iti| bhasaṃjñakaṃ ca na bhavatadītyayaṃ tvartho na bhavati, vyākhyānāt| tadarthameva hi gaṇasūtraṃ vyākhyātam, prāyeṇa hi vṛttikāro gaṇasūtrāṇi na vyācaṣṭe| nabhyo'kṣa iti| chidravadrathāṅgaviśeṣaḥ-- nābhiḥ, tacchidrānupraviṣṭakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ--akṣaḥ, sa tadanuguṇatvāttasmai hita ityucyate| añjanaṃ tailakṛtābhyaṅgaḥ, tadapi snehanatvānnābhaye hitam| yattu bhāṣya uktam--`nābhernabhabhāve pratyayānupapattiḥ prakṛtyabhāvāt' iti, tannabhyaṃ cakramiti prayogābhiprāyam| na hi cakrasya nābhivikṛtiḥ, api tvavayavaḥ| nāpi tādarthyamasti; avayavino'vayavārthatvābhāvāt| tena `tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau' ityatrārthe nabhyaṃ cakramiti naiva siddhayati| hitārthastvāśaṅkya eveti na sarvathā pratyayānupapattistatra vivakṣiteti bhāvaḥ| śarīrāvayavādyaditi yati kṛte iti| paratvāditi bhāva| nābhyaṃ tailamiti bhavitavyamiti| athātrāpi nabhabhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha--gavādiyateti| śuna ityādi| śvanityasya samprasāraṇaṃ yatpratyayaśca bhavati, pakṣe dīrghaśca tatsañiyogeneti| yadā dīrghatvaṃ tadā śune hitaṃ śunyaṃ śūnyamiti vā, `nastaddhite' iti tatra varttate, samprasāraṇe ca kṛte nedamannantam, kāmaṃ dīrghapakṣe tadvidhānasāmarthyāṭṭilopo na syāt, pakṣāntare tu prāpnoti, samprasāraṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham, anyathā prakṛtibāvaprasaṅgāt ? evaṃ tarhi cakāradvayamatra paṭhyate, tatrekaḥ samprasāraṇasamuccaye draṣṭavyaḥ, tatrānyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvātsamprasāraṇameva punarvidhīyate| tatra punarvidhānaṃ tu tadrūpasyaivāvasthānārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| ūdhaso'naṅ ceti| `naśca' iti noktam; lāghave viśeṣābhāvāt| ūdhaḥśabdasyānaṅādeśo bhavati yatsanniyogena--ūdhanyaḥ, `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ ||

kamlācca saṃjñāyām || 5.1.3 ||
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| kathaṃ kambalya iti ? nipātanādevaitatsiddham `aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitaluki' iti| idaṃ tarhiprayojanam--saṃjñāyāmiti vakṣyāmiti ? etadapi nāsti prayojanam; parimāṇaparyudāsena paryudāse prāpte tatra kambalyagrahaṇam--parimāṇasya ca saṃjñā kambalyaśabdaḥ| evaṃ tarhi svarārthaṃ vacanam, nipātanena hi parimāṇe kambalyaśabdaḥ sādhurityetāvadavagamyate, na tu yadanto'yamiti, tataścāntasvaritatvaṃ na syāt| atha nipātana evāntasvaritatvaṃ paṭhyeta ? tatra vyākhyānaṃ śaraṇam, vyākhyānācca laghu sūtram ||

vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ || 5.1.4 ||
havirviśeṣavācibhya iti| svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; tasya gavādiṣu pāṭhāt| vipararyayastu na bhavati-tatra viśeṣāṇaṃ grahaṇamiha svarūpasyeti; asañjātavirodhitvena tatraiva svarūpagrahaṇasya nyāyyatvāt| annavikārebhyaśceti| annavikārāḥ-annaprakārāḥ, adanīyaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ, tebhyaśca vibhāṣā yad bhavati-odanyāḥ, odanīyāḥ| yadyevam, apūpādīnāṃ kiṇvaparyantānāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ, annavikāratvādeva siddheḥ, surāprakṛtidravyaṃ kiṇvam ? nānarthakaḥ, prāpañcārthatvāt|
apara āha-yadā sādṛśyādināpūpādibhyo'rthāntare upacaryante, tadartha eṣāṃ pāṭha iti ||

tasmai hitam || 5.1.5 ||
tasmai iti| `hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' iti caturthī| apara āha-ayameva nirdeśo jñāpako hitayoge caturthī bhavatītyasyeti, taccintyam; `caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ' iti aśiṣi viṣayaviśeṣe hitayoge caturthyāḥ sambhavāt ||

śarīrāvayavādyat || 5.1.6 ||
śarīraṃ prāṇikāya iti| etenaitaddarśayati-śīryata iti śarīramiti śrṛṇāterīranpratyayamutpādya yadyapi śarīraśabdo vyutpādyate, tathāpi yogarūḍhatvātprāṇikāya eva varttate, na ghaṭādāviti ||

khalayavamāṣatilavṛṣabrahmaṇaśca || vrahmaṇyamiti| || 5.1.7 ||
pūvavaṭṭilopābhāvaḥ| vṛṣaśabdo'yamakārānto gṛhyate, na tu nakārāntaḥ; anyathā'sandehārthaṃ nakāralopamakṛtvaiva nirdiśeta, yathā-ātmanviśvajaneti| asti ca nakārāntastatra vaktavyam, tato'pi yadbhavatīti, anyathā tatra che ṭilope ca valṛṣīyamiti prāpnoti, tasya ca vṛṣaśabde ādeśo vaktavyaḥ, anyathā vṛṣaṇya iti syāt; brahmaśabdo nakārānto gṛhītaḥ, brāhmaṇaśabdaścākārānto'sti, tatra vaktavyam-brāhmaṇaśabdādapi yaddhavatīti, anyathā tataśchaḥ syāt, tasya ca brahman-śabda ādeśo vaktavyaḥ; anyathā brāhmayaṇyamiti prāpnoti ? ityasminpūrvapakṣe idamāha---vṛṣṇo hitamityādi|
chapratyayo'pi na bhavatīti| yatpratyayastu tāvatsūtre'nupādānādeva na bhavati, na kevalaṃ sa eva, api tu chapratyayo'pītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ| kuta ityāha--anabhidhānāditi| tadanenāpyavyavikanyāyo darśitaḥ| traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam--vṛṣāya hitam, vṛṣṇe hitam; tathā vrahmaṇe hitam, vrahmaṇyam, brāhmaṇāya hitamiti; tatra dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ samānārthayorekatra vigraha eva, aparatra vigrahaśca vṛttiśca bhaviṣyati, tadyathā--avikasya māṃsam, āvikam, avermāṃsamiti| rathāya hitārathyeti| hitārtha eva yathā syādarthāntare mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ gavādiṣu pāṭho nāṅgīkṛtaḥ|
kecittadantavidhimicchanti---rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhāviti| apare tuhalasītābhyāṃ sāhacaryāccāturarthika eva tadantavidhirbhavati, na tvasminniti ||

ajāvibhyāṃ thyan || 5.1.8 ||
ajaśabdo'yamiha puṃlliṅga upāttaḥ, ata eva `dvandve ghi' ityaviśabdasya pūrvanipātaṃ bādhitvā `ajādyadantam' ityajaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ, `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' iti strīliṅgādapi thyanbhavatyeva--ajāyai hitamajathyam, `tasilādiṣu thyantālau' iti parigaṇanātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ ||

ātmanviśvajanabhogottarapadātkhaḥ || 5.1.9 ||
ihottarapadagrahaṇaṃ vyāptinyāyena sarvairvā sambadhyeta, pratyāsattinyāyena bhogaśabdenaiva vā ? tatrādyaṃ pakṣaṃ nirākaroti---ātmanniti nalopo na kṛta iti| vivakṣitāṃ prakṛti kārtsnyena nirddiśeyamiti nalopo na kṛtaḥ, pratyekaṃ sambandhe cottarapadagrahaṇasya naitāvatī prakṛtiḥ syād, ato nalopākaraṇena pratyekaṃ sambandhe nivārite bhogaśabdenaiva sambadhyate ityarthaḥ| karmadhārayādiṣyata iti| vyāśyānamatra śaraṇam| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāditi| viśvasya jano viśvajanaḥ-sarvasādhāraṇo vesyādiḥ| bahuvrīheśveti| viśvo jano'syeti, sa eva veśyādiranyapadārthaḥ|
pañcajanāditi| rathakārapañcamāścatvāro varṇāḥ- pañcajanāḥ| `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti samāsaḥ| pañcajanīyamanyaditi| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsād bahuvrīheśca cha eva bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadā ca prakaraṇādivaśādviśiṣṭasaṃkhyeyavṛttitvāvasāyaḥ saṃkhyā śabdānāṃ tadā sāpekṣatvābhāvādaviruddhaḥ samāsaḥ, janādinaiva sākṣātsambandhād; anyathā tu saṃkhyeyasyaiva janāpekṣayā vyatirekaḥ, taddvāreṇa tu saṃkhyāguṇasyeti sākṣātsambandhābhāvād durlabhaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|
sarvajanāditi| `pūrvakālaikasarva' iti karmadhārayaḥ|
mahājanānnityamiti| nityagrahaṇaṃ sarvajanādukto kho mā bhūditi|
tatpuruṣādeviti| atra `karmadhārayādeva' iti noktam, tvanirdeśenaiva ṣaṣṭhīsamāsavyāvṛttisiddheḥ|
iha pitṛbhogīṇādiśabdaiḥ pitrādihitasyārthasyābhidhānamiṣyate, pitrādibhogahitasya tu prāpnoti| bhogaśabdaścāyamastyeva dravyapadārthakaḥ, tadyathā-bhogavānayaṃ deśa ucyate, yasmin gāvaḥ sasyāni ca varddante, bhujyata iti bhogaḥ; asti ca kriyāpadārthaḥ, tadyathā-bhogavānayaṃ brāhmaṇa ucyate yaḥ samyak snānādikāḥ kriyā anubhavati; asti ca śarīravācī, ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhumiti darśanāt, atra samudāye pravṛttasya bhogaśabdasyaikadeśeṣu phaṇeṣu prayogaḥ, na cāhereva śarīraṃ bhogaḥ, api tu sarvaṃ śarīram; anantatvātprayogaviṣayasyāvadhāraṇasya karttumaśakyatvāt| nighaṣṭuṣu tu prayogabāhulyādahiśarīre prayogaḥ| sarveṣvapi cārtheṣu vivakṣitābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| tasmānnāyaṃ bogottarapadātkho vidheyaḥ, pitrādibhya eva tu bhogīnacpratyayo vidheyaḥ--pitre hitaḥ pitṛbhogīṇa iti| yadyevam, vāvacanaṃ karttavyam, mātrīyaṃ pitrīyamiti yathā syād; anyathā bhogīnacā bādhitatvāccho na syāt| iha ca grāmaṇibhogīnaḥ senānibhogīna iti `iko hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya' ityuttarapadanibandhanaṃ hrasvatvaṃ na syāt, iha cābbogīna iti `apo bhi' iti bhakārādau gratyaye vidhīyamānaṃ tatvaṃ prāpnoti, bogottarapadāttu khavidhāne naite doṣāḥ| arthavirodhastu bhavati, taṃ pariharati--bhogaśabdaḥ śarīravācīti| tatra śarīraśarīriṇorabhedādya evārtho mātre hita iti, sa eva mātṛbhogāya hita ityapi vigrahe bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ bhogottarapadātkhavidāne'pyarthavirodhaṃ parihṛtya tatraiva guṇamāha--kevalebhyo mātrādibhyaścha eva bhavatīti| evakāro bhavatītyasyāntaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| bhogīnacpratyayavidhāne tu cho na syādeva--ityevaśabdasyārthaḥ|
rājācāryābhyāmiti| rājācāryābhyāṃ hitārthe yadi pratyayo bhavati nityam, bhogottarapadābhyāmeva sa ca kha evetyarthaḥ| na kevalābhyāmiti| atra `pratyaya iṣyate' ityetāvadapekṣyate, na tu `khapratyaya iṣyate' iti; prāptyabhāvāt| ata eva kecit `khaḥ pratyaya iṣyate' iti vyastaṃ paṭhanti|
ācāryādaṇatvaṃ ceti| bhogottarapadāditi gamyate, idānīmeva hyuktam--rājācāryābhyāṃ nityaṃ bhogottarapadābhyāmeveti ||

sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ ṇaḍhañau || sarvāditi| || 5.1.10 ||
anukaraṇatvātsarvanāmakāryābhāvaḥ, sarvanāmāni' ityanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt `prakṛtivadanukaraṇam' ityapi sarvanāmatvaṃ na bhavati; anāśritārthasya śabdarūpasyānukaraṇāt|
puruṣādvadheti| pratyayārthasāmarthyena ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate, kṛte tu tenatyupāttaiva tṛtīyā| bhāṣyakāraprayogācca dvandvamadhye'pi tenetyasya niveśaḥ, tatra vadhe-`tasyedam' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ, vikāre--`prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ityañaḥ, samūhe'pi `tasya samūhaḥ' ityaṇa eva, tena kṛte'pi granthātmake--`kṛte granthe' ityaṇa eva| pauruṣeyaḥ prāsāda ityatra na kasyacidapavādaḥ ||

māṇavacarakābhyāṃ khañ || 5.1.11 ||
manorapatyaṃ kutsitaṃ māṇavaḥ, `apatye kutsite mūḍhaḥ' iti ṇatvam, caratīti caraḥ, `pacādyac' `caricalipativadīnām' iti dvirvacanaṃ vikalpitatvādiha na bhavati, tataḥ saṃjñāyāṃ kan-carakaḥ| khaño ñitkaraṇaṃ vṛddhayarthaṃ svarārthaṃ ca| carake vṛddhyartham, māṇave `vṛddhinimittasya ca' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārtham-māṇavībhāryaḥ ||

tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau | prakṛtirupādānakāraṇamiti| || 5.1.12 ||
upādīyate'smātkāryamityapādānm, upādānaṃ ca tatkāraṇaṃ ca upādānakāraṇam| kāryasya hi trīṇi kāraṇāni-upādānakāraṇam, asamāvāyikāraṇam, nimittakāraṇamiti, tatra kāryeṇāpṛthagdeśaṃ yadbuddhiḥ kāryeṣvanuvarttate, tadyathā-mṛdayaṃ kumbhaḥ, tantaghaḥ paṭa, hiraṇyaṃ kuṇkaḍalamiti tadupādānakāraṇam| upādānakāraṇapratyāsannamasamavāyikāraṇam, yathā-tantusaṃyogaḥ paṭasya| taṭasthaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ nimittakaraṇam-tantu-vāyadi, tadeteṣu triṣu yadupādānaṃ sā prakṛtiḥ, tasyavopādānakāraṇasyottaramavasthāntaraṃ vikṛtiriti| anena kāryopādānayorabhedamāha| yathā hi-śikyaṃ rajjuriti na tattvāntaram, atha na ca rajjumātre śikyapratitiḥ, evamatrāpi mṛdeva ghaṭaḥ, tanvava eva paṭaḥ, suvarṇameva kuṇḍalam, atha ca na mṛdādimātre ghaṭādipratītiḥ| yadyapi vṛkṣādiṣu na bījādipratītirbhavati, yā tu bījasyānantarāvasthā tatra tatpratītirbhavtyeva| evaṃ tadanantarādiṣvapyavasthāsu pūrvapūrvā pratītirdraṣṭavya| vṛkṣasya tu bījaṃ para parayopādānakāraṇamiti sarvamavadātam| vikṛtivācina iti| nanu `samarthānāṃ prathamāt' iti vacanāttadarkhasya ceha prathamanirdeśātparakṛteśca tadarthatvāttadvācina eva pratyayaḥprāpnotītyata āha-taditi sarvanāmnā vikṛtiḥ pratyavabhṛśyata iti| tena vikṛtireva sarvataḥ prathamanirdiṣṭeti bhāvaḥ| vikṛtyarthāyāṃ prakṛtau pratyaya iti ||
aitena tadarthamiti saptamyāḥ sthāne prathamā, strīliṅgasya ca sthāne napuṃsakaliṅgamiti darśayati| tadarthagrahaṇenetyādi| iha prakṛtivikāravākye kvacidyogyatāmātraṃ vivakṣyate-mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti; kvacitprakṛtyantaravyāvṛttiḥ, yathā--yavānāṃ dhānāḥ, dhānānāṃ saktava iti; kvacitprakṛterananyārthatā, yathā--aṅgarebhya etāni kāṣṭhānīti, tatreha caramo'rtho vivakṣita iti pratipādanāya tadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? tadāha--na prakṛtivikāreti| pratyayārthasya cetyādi| vikṛtyarthāyāṃ hi prakṛtau pratyaya ucyate, tacya tasyāstādarthyaṃ caturthyaiva śakyate bodhayitumityetatsāmarthyam| kecittviti | teṣāṃ vacanādeva labhyā caturthī|
yavānāṃ dhānā iti| yeṣāṃ sāmarthyalabhyā caturthī teṣāmidaṃ pratyudāharaṇām| ye tu `tasmai' ityanuvarttayanti, teṣāṃ mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti draṣṭavyam|
yā kāciditi| anupadānakāraṇabhūtāpītyarthaḥ| tatraitatsyād--na kūpa udakasya kācidapi prakṛtistatrāha--bhavatadi ceti| kuta ityāha--tatreti| yathaiva hi prayājādīnāṃ dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāratvāddarśapūrṇamāsau prakṛtiḥ sauryādīnāma, evamudakadharmāṇāṃ kṣāratvādīnāmutpattyādhāratvātkūpa udakasya prakṛtirityarthaḥ| yadyevam, udakamapi tasya vikṛtireva sauryādivat ? ityata āha--na tviti| kuta ityata āhaatyantabhedāditi| tasyaivottaramavastāntaraṃ vikṛtirityatra-kāryakāraṇayornātyantabhedaḥ, mṛdayaṃ kumbha iti pratīteḥ. nāpyekāntatasyattvamaḥ mṛnmātre kumbhapratītera bhāvat| tasmātkathañcid bhedaḥ, kathañciccābhedaḥ| etena jātitadvatorguṇaguṇinośca bhedābhedau vyākhyātau|
na tu kośī tasya prakṛtiriti| atatkāraṇatvādanutpattyādhāratvācca, carmapinaddhaṃ dārvādinirmitamasyādīnāṃ prakṣepasthānaṃ kośī| nanu ca prakṛtirvikṛtiriti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau, sambandhiśabdāśca niyatameva sambandhinamupasthāpayanti, tadyathā--mātari varttitavyamityukte na cocyate svaśyāmiti, atha ca yā yasyā mātā tasyāmiti gamyate, evaṃ cātrānyataropadāne'pyanyatarasya pratītiḥ siddhayati ? ata āha--dvayorapīti| evaṃ manyate--vipūrvo'yaṃ karotiraratyevāpakāre-daivaṃ me dausthye vikarotīti, asti ceṣṭānānātve-vikurvate chāttrā iti, astyanaucityevikṛtireṣā strīṇāṃ yatsvātantryaṃ nāmeti, asti kārye--tantūnāṃ vikāraḥ paṭa iti; tathā prapūrvo'pi karotiranekārthaḥ, āsti kāraṇe-tantavaḥ prakṛtiḥ paṭasyeti, sāṃkyāstu sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ sāmyāvasthāṃ prakṛtimāhuḥ, asti doṣāpagameprakṛtisthaṃ mana iti, asti svabhāve-prakṛtyābhirūpa iti, asti dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāre--yathoktaṃ purastāt, tadevamanekārthatvānnānayoraikāntikaṃ sambandhiśabdatvamityanyataropādānena vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvo labhyata iti| `tasya vikāraḥ' ityatra tu abhidhātasvabhāvādeva kāryasya grahaṇam, nāpakārādeḥ ||

chadirupadhibalerḍhañ || 5.1.13 ||
chādyate'neneti chadiḥ, `arciśucihusṛpiccadibhya isiḥ' `ismantrankviṣu ca' iti hrasvatvam| chādiṣeyāṇi tṛṇānīti| yadhā tu carmavikāraśchadistadā paratvāt `carmaṇo'ñ' ityañaprāpnoti, tatra pūrvavipratiṣedhena ḍhañeveṣyate-chādiṣeyaṃ carmeti, āha ca `yaññyāvañaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena ḍhañca' iti| vṛttikāreṇa tu pratipadavidherbalīyastvānnaitadupanyastamityāhuḥ| neti vyam; ḍhaño'pi chādiṣeyāṇi tṛṇānītyatra caritārthatvāt| bāleyāstaṇkaḍulā iti| kathaṃ punaratra prakṛtivikṛtibhāvaḥ, yadā balyavasthāyāmapi ta eva taṇkaḍulāḥ ? nāvaśyaṃ yatprakṛtyupamardanenaiva bhavati sa eva vikāraḥ, tadeva guṇāntarayuktamapi vikāraḥ| asti ca balyavastāyāṃ haridrāyogena taṇḍulānāṃ guṃṇāntarayogaḥ, antataḥ prakṣālanena śvaityamārdratā mārdavaṃ sānniveśaviśeṣo vā bhavati| upadhiśabdātsvārthe pratyaya iti| iṣṭireṣā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamadhikāraprāpto neṣyate ? ityā--upadhīyat ityupadhirityādi| yadeva hi tadrathāṅgamupadhīyamānatvādupadhiśabdena karmaṇi kipratyayāntenocyate, yadyapi tasya prakṛtirasti, tathāpi tatra na ḍhañantaṃ vartate, kiṃ tarhi? tatraiva hi rathāṅge| svabhāvaścātra hetuḥ, na ca tadeva tasya prakṛtirbhavati, ataḥ svārthe pratyaya eṣitavyaḥ| athāyamupadhānamupadhiriti ? kriyāvacana upadhiśabdastādarthyamapi sambhavati, upadhānakriyārthatvād dravyasyetyucyate| evamapi kriyāvikāro na bhavati, kriyāpi vikāro bavati; bahuvikāro'yaṃ manuṣyo hasati nṛtyati gāyatīti darśanāt ? satyam; `tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau' ityatra tu viśiṣṭa eva prakṛtivikārabhāvo gṛhyate--yatra prakṛterucchedaḥ, yatra vā rūpāntarāpattiḥ| ata eva tatra vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāva ityuktam ||

ṛṣabopānahorñyaḥ || ārṣabhyo vatsa iti| || 5.1.14 ||
mahāprāṇaḥ saṃhananavān sujātāvayavo yo vatsa ṛṣabhāvasthāprāptaye poṣyate| carmaṇyapīti| ñyasyāvakāśaḥ--aupānahyo muñjaḥ, atro'vakāśaḥ--vāhyaṃ carma, upānacchabdāccarmaṇi prakṛtitvena vivakṣite sati paratvādañprāpnoti pūrvavipratiṣedhena ñya eva bhavati| ye tu sāvakāśatve styapi pratipadavidhānaṃ balīyastve kāraṇamāhuḥ, teṣāmayaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedo'saṅtaḥ syāt ||

carmaṇo'ñ || 5.1.15 ||
carmaṇa iti ṣaṣṭhīti| pañcamyāṃ tu carmanśabdātyarmārthāyāṃ prakṛtau pratyayaḥ syāt--carmaṇe dvīpītyādau, na caivamabhidhānamasti ||

tadasya tadasmin syāditi || 5.1.16 ||
sambhāvane liṅiti| `sabhyāvane'lamiti ca' ityādinā| iṣṭakānāṃ bahutvenetyādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇeṣu darśayati|
prakṛtivikārabhāva ityādinā `tadartha vikṛteḥ' ityādinā siddhaṃ darśayansūtrārambaṃ samarthayate| yogyatāmātrāmiti| tathā cānyārthāsvapīṣṭakāsu vaktāro bhavanti--prākārīyā iṣṭakā iti| dvistadgrahaṇamityādi| nanu viparītamidam, pratyekaṃ sambandhe hyatra dvistadgrahaṇamanarthakam, ato'tra dvistadgrahaṇādanyatra samudāyena sambandho yukta iti ? satyam; ayamapi tu prakāraḥ sambhavatīti nyāyaprāptaṃ pratyekaṃ sambandhamasminsūtre sthitvā udāharaṇarūpeṇa darśayatīti tadidamuktam| nyāyapradarśanārthamiti| pradarśanaṃ digudāharaṇamityartha| yadi punarayaṃ nyāyo'tra na pradarśyeta, tadā `tadasyāstyasminnati matup' ityatra samudāyena samarthavibhktisambandho vijñāyeta, tataśca śākāvānvṛkṣa ityādau yatra dvābhapyāṃ pratyayārthābhyāṃ samarthavibhakteḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati, tatraiva syāt; yatra tvanyatareṇa sambandhaḥ---gomāndevadatto vṛkṣvānparvata iti, tatra na syāt|
atheheti| yadā brāhmaṇārthaṃ nirmitaṃ prāsādaṃ guṇavantaṃ ca devadattaṃ paśyansambhāvayati tadā tasya prasaṅgaḥ ||

prāgvateṣṭhañ || 5.1.18 ||
vakṣyati pārāyaṇaturāyaṇeti| atra tu pradeśe'sya karaṇamuttarasūtre yeṣāṃ paryu dāsastebhyaṣṭhañyathā syāditi--gaupucchikaḥ, sāmpratikaḥ| ṭhañityevādhikāre siddhe `prāgvateḥ' iti vacanaṃ madhye yo'dhikāravānapavādaḥ `sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau', `śīrṣacchedādyacca' ityevamādistena vicchede'pi `pārāyaṇaturāyaṇa' ityevamādau ṭhañeva yathā syādityevamartham| yadyapyatra pratyayo'vadhitvena gṛhītaḥ, tathāpyartheṣvevopatiṣṭhate, na tu prakṛtiṣu; tenāpavādaviṣaye na bhavati| tatā ca `śūrpādañanyatarasyām' ityanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamarthavadbhavati ||

ārhādagopucchasaṃkhyāparimāṇāṭṭhak || 5.1.19 ||
tadarhatīti vakṣyatīti| tadekadeśo'rhaśabdo nirdiśyata iti bhāvaḥ, tadāha--ā etasmādarhasaṃśabdanāditi| tadarhamityayaṃtvavadhirna bhavati, yadi syādārhādityanarthakam; prāgvaterityeva siddhatvāt| nanu ca vatyarthe'pi ṭhako vidhiryathā syādityevamarthamārhāditi vacanaṃ syād ? evamapyāṅ eva nirdeśaḥ karttavyo vaterityevābhividhāvākāraḥ| evamapi `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' ityatrāpi vatyarthe ṭhakprāpnoti| tasmādvyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam| gopucchādīnvarjayitveti| agopucchaśabdātsaṅkhayāvācinaḥ parimāṇaśabdāccetyayaṃ tvartho na bhavati| yadi syānniṣkādiṣa droṇaśabdasya parimāṇavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhiśabdasya saṅkhyāvācinaḥ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syād ? anenaiva siddhatvānnānarthakaḥ| niyamārtha punarvacanaṃ syāt-asamāsaeva yathā syāditi ? naitadasti; vidhiniyamasambhave videreva jyāyastvāt| abhividho vāyamākāra iti| yadi tu maryādāyāṃ syāttasya grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, prāggrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt, tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? tadāha--arhatyarthe'pi ṭhagbhavatyeveti|
saṅkhyāparimāṇayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti| parimīyate paricchidyate yena tatparimāṇam, saṅkhyāpi ca paricichidyate iti praśanaḥ| bhedagaṇanaṃ saṅkhayeti| bhidyata iti bhedaḥ, mitho bhinnāḥ padārthāḥ te gaṇyante yena tad bhedagaṇanam| ekatvādisaṅkhaṣāsāmānyopakramatvād bhedagaṇanī saṃkhyeti na bhavati, bhedagaṇanamityanena pṛthaktavaniveśitatvamāha| yathoktaṃ pṛthaktavaniveśitatvātsaṅ‌yayā karmabhedaḥ syāditi| ekatvasaṅkhayāpi bahuṣu buddhyā sanniveśiteṣu bhedamekamashāyamāha| gurutvamānamunmānamiti| tulādāvāropya yena dravyāntaraparicchinnagurutvena palādiśabdavācyena pāṣāṇādinā suvarṇādergurutvamunmīyate, tadunmānamityarthaḥ| āyāmāmānaṃ pramāṇamiti| āyāmaḥ-dairghyam, sa yena mīyate tadāyāmamānam| etacca kvacittriyagabhimukhasya vastuno bhavati, yathā--vastrāderhastādi, kvacidūrdhvādharadigavasthitasya bhavati--hāstinamudakam, ūrudvayasamudakamiti| ārohapariṇāhamānaṃ parimāṇamiti| ārohaḥ-ucchrāyaḥ, pariṇāhaḥ- vistāraḥ; tābhyāmārohapariṇāhābhyāṃ svagatābhyāṃ yena kāṣṭhādinirmitena vrīhyādi parimīyate tatparimāṇam| pariḥ sarvatobhāve, saṃkhyāparimāṇayorviśeṣe pṛṣṭhe unmānādaviśevapradarśanaṃ prasaṅgena tadviśeṣasyāpyajñānasyāpanayanārtham|
ūrdhvamānamiti| ūrdhvāropaṇād gurutvamānamunmānamiti pūrvokta evārthaḥ| kilaśabdaḥ prasiddhau| parimāṇaṃ tu sarvata iti| ūrdhvamānamityupasamastamapi mānamityetadatrāpekṣyate| etadarthame kecid ūrdhvaṃ mānamiti vyastaṃ paṭhanti| āyāmasteti| mānamityapekṣyate, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| prasiddhastu pāṭhaḥ āyāmastviti| tatrāyāmaparicchedyartha upacārādāyāmaśabdenoktaḥ| sahkhyā bāhya tu sarvata iti| pūrvoktādunmānādeḥ sarvato bāhyā, tatrānantarbhāvāt| tasyāśca saṃkhyāyate'nayeti nirvacanaṃ bhedagaṇanalakṣaṇatvaṃ vyākhyātavyamityanusandhātavyam ||

asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ || 5.1.20 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| yena nāprāptinyāyena niṣkādibhyo hi droṇaparyantebhyaḥ parimāṇaśabdātṣaṣṭhiśabdāṭṭhakaḥ paryudāse ṭhañeva prāpnoti, atastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ|
tadantāpratiṣedhasyeti| tadantavidhāvapratiṣedhasyetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhi tadantātpratyayo vijñāyate, evaṃ tarhi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' iti kevalebhyo nopapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asmāsagrahaṇena hi grahaṇavatparibhāṣāyā nivṛttirākhyātā, tannivṛttau `yena vidhistadantasya' iti tadantatā, atra svasya ca rūpasya prakṛtatvātkevalādapi bhavati| yastu manyate---pūrvatropādānasāmarthyātkevalādapi syāditi, tasya hi lāghavārthaṃ kevalānāṃ pāṭhaḥ syāditi yat kiñcidetat|
ita uttaraṃ ceti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi tadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā `grahaṇatratā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna bhavati' iti pratiṣdhyate ? asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvaṃ ca tasyā gargādiṣu `vājāse' iti samāsapratiṣedhād gamyate| nityatve hi sati vājaśabdādutpdyamānasya pratyayasya samāse prāptireva nāstīti samāse pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt| dviśūrpamiti| dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītamiti taddhitārthe dviguṃ kṛtvā na tāvagadeṣā lugantā prakṛtiriti `saṃkhyāpūrvapadādapi `śūrpādañnyatarasyām' ityañeva kriyate, tasya `adhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām' iti luk| dviśorpikamiti| `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| yaduktam--`ita uttaraṃ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānaṃ tadantavidhiriṣyate' iti, yaccoktam--`lugantāyāstu prakṛterneṣyate' iti, tadubhayamāptāgamena sthirīkarttumāha--tathā coktamityādinā ||

śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate || 5.1.21 ||
kano'pavāda iti| uttarasūtreṇa prāptasya|
śatakamiti| `tadasya parimāṇam' iti varttamāmane `saṃkyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṃghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' iti saṃghe pratyayārthe vivakṣite uttarasūkṣatreṇa kaneva bhavati| pratyayārtho'tra saṅgha iti| śatamadhyāyānāṃ parimāṇaṃ yasya nidānākhyasya granthasya sa iha pratyayārthaḥ, sa ca śatasaṃkhyāvacchinnāghyāyasamudāyātmaka iti saṃghaḥ pratyayārtho bhavati| śatameva vastuta iti| śatāttasyānanyatvāt tataśca prakṛtyarthānna bhidyate,yadevādhyāyānāṃ śataṃ prakṛtyābhidhīyate pratyayāntenāpi tadeveti neha prakṛtyarthātpratyayārthasya bhedaḥ| etena yatrāvyatiriktaḥ pkayyayārthātprakṛtyarthastatra pratiṣedho bhavati, na vyatirikta ityetadākhyātam| nanu ca `saṃghe cānauttarādharye', `saṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṃghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' ityatra ca prāṇisamūhe saṃghaśabdo gṛṅyate, tatkathamatra granthaviṣayo gṛhyate ? upacāreṇetyadoṣaḥ| yadi vā saṃjñāsaṃghasūtre śabdasāhacaryādviśiṣṭaḥ saṃgho gṛhyate, `saṃghe cānauttarādharye' ityatrāpi `chandonāmni' ityataśchandograhaṇānuvṛtteḥ prāṇī gṛhyate| iha tu yatnāntarābhāvādgranthasyāpi grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ| nanu ca śate'bhidheye na bhavitavyam, ihaca śatyaṃ śāṭakaśatam, śatikaṃ śāṭakaśatamityukte śataṃ pratīyata eva tatkimiti pratiṣedho na bhavati ? ityata āha--vākyenetyādi| śatyaśatikaśabdhau sāmānyaśabdau, sāmānyaśabdāsca prakaraṇādikamantareṇa na viśeṣe varttante| na yāvacchāṭakaśatamityetatpadāntaraṃ prayujyate tāvatpratyayārthasya śatatvaṃ nāvasīyate| tasmātpadāntarasannidhau gamyamānatvādvākyārtho'sau bhavati| na śrutyeti| gamyate iti sambandhaḥ| yatra pratyayāntena padāntaranirapekṣeṇa pratyayārthasya śatatvamākhyāyate, tatra śrutyā pratyayāntaśravaṇamātreṇaiva gamyate, yathā pratyudāharaṇe śataṃ parimāṇamasya śatakamityukte gamyate-ekatpratyayārtho'pi śatameveti| iha tu vākyācchatatvaṃ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskārakāle vākyārthasyāṅgabhāvo'sti, tadā tasyānupathānāt| prakṛtyarthādavyatirikte pratyayārthe pratiṣedho bhavati, na hyatirikte vākyagamya ityetadāptavacanena draḍhayitumāha--tathā coktamityādi| śatapratiṣedhe karttavye prakṛtyarthādanyasya ca pratyayārthasya śatatve satyapratiṣedhaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yatrānyat prakṛtyarthaṃ śatam, anyatpratyayārthaśatam, tatra vidhireva bhavati na pratiṣedhaḥ|
kena punaḥ samāse prāpnoti yatastatpratiṣedhārthamasamāsānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate ? ityāha--prāgvaterityādi ||

saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan || 5.1.22 ||
pañcakaḥ paṭa iti| laukikyāḥ saṃkhyāyā udāharaṇam| bahuka iti| pāribhāṣikyāḥ| cātvāriśaṃtka iti| `isusuktāntātkaḥ'|
arthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇāditi| arthavadragrahaṇaparibhaṣayā| ḍateriti| ityavayavasya tiśabdasyetyarthaḥ| paryudāso na bhavatīti| na hyasāvarthavalān| katika iti| kā saṃkhyā parimāṇaṃ yeṣāmiti `kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe iti ca' iti itiḥ| saptatiśabde tu saptadaśadarthābhidhāyinaḥ saptaśabdātparimāṇopādhikādasyeti ṣaṣṭhayarthe tipratyayo bavatīti tiśabdo'rthavān| evaṃ navatiśabde| aśītiśabde tu yadyapyaśīśabdasyāṣṭasvanyatra na dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ| śāstro tveṣā vyavasthā--aṣṭānāmaśībhāvastiśca pratyaya iti| viśatiśabde tu dvayordaśatorvinbāvaḥ śatīśca pratyaya iti tiśabdo'narthaka eva, tataśca tataḥ kan bhavatyeva-viṃśatikaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā `viśatikātkhaḥ śatamānaviśatikaḥ' iti nirddeśa upapadte; kintu `viśatitriṃśadbhayāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām' ityasaṃjñāyāṃ ḍuvunvidhānātsaṃjñāyāmeva kan bhavati| `atiśadantāyāḥ' ityatrāntagrahaṇamekasaptatyā krītamityatrāpi paryudāsārtham, anyathā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā na syāt ||

vatoriḍ vā || 5.1.23 ||
tasya tvaneneti| `careṣṭaḥ' ityādivatpratyayāntaraṃ tviṇna bhavati; ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| astyanyaṭṭitkaraṇasya prayojanaṃ ṭita iti ṅībyathā syāt ? ata ityadhikāre ṅīp, na caiṣo'kārāntaḥ, ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādanadantādapi ṅīp syāt, yathā--ḍityabhasyāpyanubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāt saraja ityatra ṭilopaḥ| eghaṃ tarhi svaritatvapratijñānena kano'nukarṣaṇasāmarthyādāgamo bhaviṣyati ? astyanyadanuvṛtteḥ prayojanam--iṭā bādho mā bhūt kanopi vidhiryathā syāditi ? vāvacanādevala kan bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanaṃ syāt-iṭkanau vā bhavataḥ, pakṣe sāmanyavihitaṣṭhañiti ? tasmādvyākhyānameva śaraṇam| nanu neha kangrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtam, tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭama, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, vatoriti pañcamī kaniti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayiṣyati--`tasmādityuttarasya' iti| tāvatka iti| tatparimāṇamasya `yattadetephabhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup', `ā sarvanāmnaḥ'||

viṃśatitriśadbhyāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyam || 5.1.24 ||
viṃśaka iti| `ti viṃśaterḍiti' iti tiśabdasya lopaḥ, `ato guṇe' iti pararūpatvam| yasyeti lopastu na bhavati, `asiddhavadatrābhāt' iti tilopasyāsiddhatvāt| nanu subantāttaddhitotpattiḥ, tataścāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā bhavati, tatkathaṃ pararūpatm; yā tu ḍvunamapekṣya bhasaṃjñā, sā yena nāpraptinyāyena `svādiṣu' iti yā padasaṃjñā tāmeva vādhate, na `suptiṅantaṃ padam' ityetāmapi ? etāmapi bādhate| katham ? paratvāt| ata eva `sāmanyaḥ' ityādau nalopādyabhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaratreti| triṃśatkamadhikṛtya praśnapraticane| viṃśatiśabdāttu kanaḥ siddhiḥ prāgeva pratipāditā| yadā tu dvayordaśatorvaliśabhāvastiśca pratyaya iti pakṣaḥ, tadā viṃśatikamapyadhikṛtya bhavataḥ ||

kaṃsāṭṭiṭhan || 5.1.25 ||
kaṃsaśabdo'yaṃ kāṃsyapātravācī parimāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, pūrvottaraiḥ parimāṇaśabdaiḥ sāhacaryāt, na lohaviśeṣavacanaḥ, nāpyugrasenasutavacana iti darśayati| ṭhaño'pavāgada iti| ikāra uccāraṇārtha iti| evaṃ ca prakriyālāghavāya ṭikaneva vaktavyaḥ ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
adhikaṃ iti| ardhaśabdaḥ kārṣāpaṇasyārdhe nirūḍha iti bhāgavadapekṣayārdhe'sāmarthyaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam|
apara āha--prakaraṇādivaśena bhāgavadviśeṣe niścite sati nāsāmarthyamiti ||

śūrpādañanyatarasyām || 5.1.26 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| śūrpaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt| yadyapi paripavanaviśeṣaḥ śūrpam, tathāpi viśiśṭasaṃsthānaṃ dhānyādeḥ parimāṇamapi| śūrpaparimito vā vrīdyadiḥ śūrpaśabdenocyate||

śatamānaviśatikasahasravasanādaṇ || 5.1.27 ||
ṭhakaṭhañorapavāda iti| śatamānaṃ| parimāṇam, sahasraṃ saṃkhyā; tābhyāṃ ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| viṃśatyā krītaṃ viṃśatikaṃ saṃjñāśabdo'yam, asaṃjñāyām `viṃśatitriṃśadbhayāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām' iti ḍvunā bhavitavyam, sā yadi parimāṇasya saṃjñā ? tadā tato'pi ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| atha tvarthāntarasya, tataṣṭhakaḥ| vasanaśabdāttu ṭhaka eva ||

adhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasañjhāyām || 5.1.28 ||
adhyārūḍhamarddhamasminnatyadhyardham, prādibhyo dhātujasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| adhyardhapūrvadvigoriti samāhāradvandvaḥ, sautraḥ puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ| tasmādadhyardhapūrvātprātipadikād dvigośca parasyeti| tena `adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' iti pañcamyāśriteti lakṣyate| yadyevam, dvigorluki tannimittagrahaṇam, dvigornimittaṃ yastaddhitastasya lug bhavatīti vaktavyam, dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītaṃ dviśūrpam, dviśūrpeṇa krītaṃ dviśaurpikamityatra dvitīyasya mā bhūt| tathārthaviśeṣāsaṃpratyaye tannimittādapi yatra taddhitārthadvigunā sahārtho na bhidyate, tatrātannimittādapi| sa taddhito yasya nimittaṃ na bhavati tasmādapi dvigoḥ parasya lugbhavatīti vaktavyam-dvayoḥ śūrpayoḥ samāhāro dviśūrpī, dvaśūrpyā krītamityapi vigrahe dviśūrpamityeva yathā syāt| tasmād dvigoriti naiṣā pañcamī, kā tarhi ? ṣaṣṭī--dvigoryastaddhitaḥ| kaśca dvigostaddhitaḥ ? yastasya nimittaṃ yasmin dvigurmavati| dviśūrpyā krītamityatra tvanabhidhānātpratyayo na bhaviṣyati| tryaiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyamdvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītam, dviśūrpam, dviśūrpyā krītamiti; tatra dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ samānārthayorekena vigraha eva dviśūrpyā krītamiti, na tu vṛttiḥ, anabhidhānāt| apareṇa vigrahaśca vṛttiśca-dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītaṃ dviśūrpamiti, avyavikanyāyena| vyākhyāto'vyavikanyāyaḥ| idaṃ tāvadarthatattvam, `dvigorluganapatye' ityatra ca vṛttikāreṇāpyevameva vyākhyātam, iha tu tadanusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnaivaṃ vivicya vyākhyātam, yasya taddhitasya lugiṣyate so'pi dvigoḥ para ityetāvatā dvigoḥ parasyetyuktam| pāñcalohitikam, pāñcakalāpikamiti| pañca lohinyaḥ parimāṇamasya, pañca kalāpāḥ parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhya taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, `tadasya parimāṇam' iti ṭhañ, `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvāllohinīśabdasyekāranakārayornivṛttiḥ, parimāṇaviśeṣasya nāmadheye ete|
pratyayāntasya viśeṣaṇamasaṃjñāgrahaṇāmiti| na tu sannihitasyāpi dvigoḥ; asaṃjñāyāmiti saptadamīnirddeśāt| vāttiṃkakārastu manyate--`dviguviśeṣaṇamasaṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ pañcalohita-pañcakalāpaśabdāvapi dvigū kṛtataddhitalukāveva saṃjñe, tato nārtho'saṃjñāyāmiti pratiṣedhena' iti, tadāha--`saṃjñāpratiṣedhānarthakyaṃ ca tannimittatvāllopasya' iti| tasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ lopa eva nimittamityarthaḥ|
adhyarddhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiveti| saṃkhyāvācyevetyarthaḥ| adhyarddhasyāpyekādivat paricchedahetutvāt| ata evādhyarddhena krītamadhyarddhakamati saṃkhyālakṣaṇaḥ kan bhavati, adhyarddhakaṃsamityādau taddhitārthe dviguśca| kvaciditi| kansamāsottarapadavṛddhibhyo'nyatra| saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane iti| yadā sakṛtphalāṃ tāṃ kriyāmabhinirvarttya tāmeva kurvannardhe nivarttate, tadā kṛtvasuco'bhāvadadhyardha karotītyeva bhavati ||

vibhāṣā kārṣāpaṇasahasrābhyām || 5.1.29 ||
adhyardhasahasramiti| `śatamānaviśatika' iti vihitasyāṇo lak, alukpakṣe `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ, idānīmeva hyuktam--`adhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva' iti|
adhyardhasuvarṇamiti| ṭhaño lug, na tu ṭhakaḥ, ārhādityatra kriyānimittakasya parimāṇasya grahaṇād| yeṣāṃ tu rūḍhiparimāṇasya tatra grahaṇam, tanmate ṭhako luk| adhyarddhasauvarṇikamiti| parimāṇāntasyetyuttarapadavṛddhiḥ, tatra hyunmānasyāpi grahaṇam; śāṇapratiṣedhāt| adhyarddhe kārṣāpaṇasya, dvigau sahasrasyetyevamatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate||

dvitripūrvānniṣkāt || 5.1.30 ||
adhyarddhapūrvagrahaṇamuttarārthamanuvarttate, iha tu na sambadhyate| dvigugrahaṇaṃ tu sambadhyate, dvayorniṣkaṃ trayāṇāṃ niṣkamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse mā bhūt| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam; anyathā `adyardhapūrvād dvitripūrvācca niṣkāt' iti samucyayo vijñāyeta| dvinaiṣkikamiti| `grāgvateṣṭhañ', `parimāṇāntasya' ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| dvitribhyāṃ niṣkādityeva siddhe pūrvagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam ||

vistācca || 5.1.31 ||
cakāreṇānukṛṣyata iti| tena cānukṛṣṭamuttaratra nānuvarttate ityuttaratrānuvṛttyabhāva iti bhāvaḥ| bistaśabdaḥ parimāṇavācī ||

viṃśatikātkhaḥ || 5.1.32 ||
`śatamānaviśatika' ityaṇi prāpte tasya ca luki kho'tra vidhīyate|

khāryā īkan || 5.1.33 ||
khāri parimāṇamiti ṭhañi prāpte tasya ca luki īkanvidhīyate|
kevalāyāśceti| `adhyarddhapūrvadvigoḥ' ityadhikārātkevalāyā na prāpnotīti vacanam| athādhyardhapūrveti na sambadhyeta, tataḥ kevalāyāmīkanaścaritārthatvādadhyardhapūrvadvigorluk prāpnoti, dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimarthaṃ nekanevocyeta, savarṇadīrghatve sati siddham ? yasyetilopaḥ prāpnoti, ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, anyathā kanameva vidadhyāt, `ke'maḥ' iti hrasvatve kṛte sati siddham| avagrahaḥ prāpnoti ? na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ, padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvarttyam ||

paṇapādamāṣaśatādyat || 5.1.34 ||
padbāvo'tra na bhavatīti| `padyatyatadarthe' ityanena| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha--prāṇyaṅgasyeti| `pādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' ityatra tāvat prāṇyaṅgasya pādasya grahaṇaṃ tasyaivājyādibhirgativacanaiḥ sabandhasadbhāvāt padyatītyādāvapi tasyaivānuvṛttiḥ| iha tu parimāṇamiti| gṛhyate iti śeṣaḥ| paṇamābhyāṃ sāhacaryāditi bhāvaḥ ||

śāṇādvā || 5.1.35 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| yadyapyunmānavacanaḥ śāṇaśabdaḥ, tathāpyārhādityatra kriyāparimāṇasya grahaṇādasyapi paryudāsāṭṭhaña eva prasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ|
śatācceti vaktavyamiti| pūrveṇa nitye yati prāpte vacanam| yadabhāvapakṣe saṅkhayālakṣaṇasya kano luk ||

dvitripūrvādaṇ ca || 5.1.36 ||
vārtitake darśanātsūtreṣvetatprakṣiptam| trairūpyaṃ bhavatīti| aṇyekam, yati dvitīyam, ṭhaño luki tṛtīyam ||

tena krītam || 5.1.37 ||
teṣāmiti| asya samarthavibhaktaya ityanenaiva sambandhaḥ, na pratyayārtha ityanena| na hi teṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ pratyayārthā nirdiśayante ityanvayo ghaṭate| odanapākaṃ pacatītivadvā kathañcidanvayaḥ|
teneti mūlyāditi| mūlyabhūtārthābhidhāyinaḥ karaṇe yā tṛtīyā sā ceha samarthavibhatmirityarthaḥ| mūlenānāmyaṃ mūlyam-lābha ityuktam| anyatreti| amūlyādakaraṇe vā yā kṛtīyā tatretyarthaḥ| anabhidhānādeveti| evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ| kiñca- prasthādayaḥ śabdā niyataparimāṇānāmarthānāṃ vācakā na mātrayāpi nyūnādhikabhāve pravarttante, na hi yathā jalamiti prasthe'pi bhavati, kuḍave'pi bhavati, yathā vāgniriti bhrāṣṭrāgnāvapi bhavati, dāvāgnāvapi bhavati; yathā vā eko vrīhiḥ sampanna ityādau jātyātmanā sarvāsāṃ vyaktīnāmaikyaṃ pratīyate, tathā prasthādiṣu bhavati| tasmātteṣu vibhaktayabhāve yāvatasye vācakāstāvadeva gamyate| vākye tu prasthābhyām, prasthairiti dvivacanabahuvacanabalāttāvato'nekasyāvagatirbhavati|
dvakam, trikamiti| atra hi prakṛtereva vācye dvitvabahutve vibhaktistu karaṇatvamātramācaṣṭe, sā ca prakṛtirvṛttāvapi vidyate| na hyekena mudreneti| ekayā mudgavyaktyetyarthaḥ| jātyākhyāyāṃ tvekavacanāntādapi bhavatyeva| nanu yad niṣkeṇa krītaṃ tasya niṣko vasno bhavati, tataśca `so'syāṃśavasrabhṛtayaḥ' ityeva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, nārtha etena ? evaṃ tarhi yasya śataṃ mūlyaṃ na bhavatyatha ca tena krītaṃ kāryavaśātadarthamidam ||

tasya nimitta saṃyogotpātau || 5.1.38 ||
śubhāśubhasūcaka iti| tatprayojaka itivatvaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| mahābhūtānāmiti| pṛthivyādīnām| dakṣiṇākṣispandanamiti| pāñcabhautikaśarīre dravyameva ca kriyārūpeṇa pariṇamate iti dakṣiṇākṣispandanaṃ mahābhūtapariṇāmaḥ, tasya ca śubhasya prati nimittatvam; jñāpakahetutvād, na tu kārakahetutvāt| vātikamiti| śamanakopane evātra pratyayārthau, na tu nimittaṃ tābhyāṃ viśeṣyate| prakaraṇādinā ca tayoranyatarāvasāyaḥ|
