sannipātaḥ-vātādīnāṃ yugapadudbhavaḥ ||

godvyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyat || 5.1.39 ||
ṭhañādīnāmiti| ādiśabdena ṭhako grahaṇam| atadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ, bahuvacanaṃ tu ṭhaka evaikasya viṣayavahutvamāśritya kṛtam, ṭhako'pavāda ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥkāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ? saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvādivarjitādgodvyacaṣṭhaka eva prāptatvāt| brahmavarcasāditi| brahmaṇo varco vrahyavarcasaṃ vṛttasvādhyāyasaṃpat, `brahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ' ityac samāsāntaḥ ||

putrāccha ca || 5.1.40 ||
kathaṃ putrīyaḥ kraturiti, na hi kratuḥ saṃyoga utpāto vā bhavati ? saṃyujyate'neneti vyutpatyā kraturapi saṃyoga eva| yena yāgādikaraṇena puruṣaḥ phalena saṃyujyate sa yāgādirapi saṃyogaḥ, na kevalaṃ sambandha evetyarthaḥ| etena `puroḍāśasaṃ lokyam' ityādivyākhyātam ||

sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau || 5.1.41 ||
saṃyogotpātau prati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, tayoḥ pratyayārthaviseṣaṇatvena prakṛtibhyāṃ pratyayābhyāṃ cāsambandhāt ||

tatra vidita iti ca || 5.1.43 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṅkhyanirāsārthaḥ, uttarārthaśca ||

tasya vāpaḥ || 5.1.45 ||
tasyeti vāpāpekṣayā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, na tu karttari, tena devadattasya vāpaḥ kṣetramityādau na bhavati ||
tadasmin vṛddhyāyalābhaśulkopadā dīyate|| dīyata ityekavacāntaṃ vṛddhyādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhyata iti| tena vṛddhayādīnāṃ bahutve'pi bahuvacanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| pratyekaṃ sambandhastu dvandvaparttināṃ padānāṃ buddhyā niṣkarṣāllabhyate etacca dīyata ityasya viseṣaṇasya vṛddhyupakramatva uktam, yadā tu yattatprathamāsamartha dīyate cettadbhavatītyevamupakramyate, paścāttu kiṃ punastaddīyata ityapekṣāyāṃ vṛddhyādayaḥ saṃtadyante tadā na kiñcidyatnasādhyam| uttamarṇadhanātiriktamiti| uttamarṇena yaddattam dhanaṃ tasmādadhikamityarthaḥ, saṃjñā vṛddhistu na gṛhyate; āyādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt| upādānamūlātiriktamiti| paṭādīnāmupādānaṃ tantvādi, tasya mūlamutpattikāraṇaṃ dravyam, tasmādadhikaṃ paṭādi vikrayeṇa yallabhyate sa lābhaḥ, nirveśo bhṛtiḥ, rakṣānimittako nirveśo rakṣānirveśaḥ, sambandhaṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| śulkagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham, tasyāpyāyaviśeṣatvāt, tathā ca `ṭhagāyasthānebhyaḥ' iti śulkasthānādapi bhavati śaulkaśālika iti| yatra grāmādau vṛddhyādi dīyate tatra pratyayo vidhīyamānaḥ saṃpradāne na prāpnotītyata āha--caturthyartha upasaṃkhyānamiti| siddhaṃ tviti| vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti saṃpradānasyaivādhikaraṇatvena vivakṣitatvātsiddhamiṣṭamityarthaḥ| kva yathetyāha--samamiti ||

pūraṇārddhāṭṭhan || 5.1.47 ||
pūraṇavācina iti| pūryate yenārthaḥ sa pūraṇaḥ, tadvācina ityarthaḥ| etena `pūraṇa' ityarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na tu pratyayasyeti darśayati| yadi tu pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svaryeta tataḥ svaritenādhikāragatirbhavatīti `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ' iti pūraṇādhikāravihitā ḍaṭādayaḥ pratyayā gṛhyeran, yathā-gostriyorityatra stryadhikāravihitāṣṭābādayaḥ, tataśca `pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan' ityanantānna syāt, arthagrahaṇe tato'pi bhavati, tahantamapi hi pūraṇa evārthe varttate, svārthikatvādanaḥ| tasmādarthagrahaṇameva nyāyyam| ṭhakṭiṭhanorapavāda iti| pūraṇādārṅīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ| arddhādapiarddhācyati vaktavyamiti ṭiṭhanaḥ| striyāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ, ṭiṭhini hi sati ṅīp syāt, ṭhani tu ṭāp bhavati| arddhaśabdo rūpakārddhasya rūḍhiriti| rūpakam-kārṣāpaṇam, tadīyasya bhāgasyārddhaśabdo vācakatvena prasiddha ityarthaḥ| tenārddhika iti bhāgavatsāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyaṃ nodbhāvanīyamiti bhāvaḥ ||

bhāgādyacca || 5.1.49 ||
bhāgaśbdo'pīti| na kevalamarddhaśabda evetyapiśabdārthaḥ ||

taddharati vahatyāvahati bhārādvaṃsādibhyaḥ || 5.1.50 ||
prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti | prakṛtiḥ prātipadikam, tasya viśeṣaṇam, viśe,ṇaprakārameva darśayati--vaṃśādibhya ityādi| vaṃśādibhya iti kimiti| bhārāntāditi kasmānnoktamiti bhāvaḥ| ata eva tadantaṃ pratyudāharati--vrīhibhāraṃ vahatīti| bhārabhūtebhyo vaṃśādibhya iti| nanu vaṃśādayaḥ śabdāste kathaṃ bhārabhūtā ityata āha--bāraśabdo'rthadvāreṇa vaṃśādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| bārabhūtārthābhidhāyitvādbhārabhūtebyo vaṃśadibhya ityuktamityarthaḥ| sūtre tu pratyekaṃ sambandhādekavacanam ||

vasnadravyābhyāṃ ṭhankanau|| 5.1.51 ||
vasnaśabdena mūlyamucyate ||

saṃbhavatyavaharati pacati || 5.1.52 ||
pramāṇānatireka iti| ādhāragramāṇādādheyapramāṇasyānādhikyamityarthaḥ| tadupasrjane ca dhāraṇe saṃbhavatervṛttiriti sakarmakatvam| upasaṃharaṇamavahāra iti| ādhārapramāṇādādheyapramāṇasya nyūnatetyarthaḥ, tadupasarjane ca dhāraṇe'vaharatervṛtteḥ sakarmakatvam, sūtre spaṣṭa upasargaḥ| nāstyatra niyoga iti| niyogaḥ-avaśyambhāvaḥ| tatpacatīti droṇādaṇ ceti| pacatigrahaṇaṃ sambhavatyavaharatīti nivṛttyartham, droṇaparimite ca vrīhyādau droṇaśabdastasya pākasambhavāt ||

āḍhakācitapātrātkho'nyatarasyām || 5.1.53 ||
ṭhaño'pavāda iti| na ṭhakaḥ, āḍhakādīnāṃ parimāṇatvāt| pātraṃ bhājanamapyasti, tasya tu sambhavatyādibhiḥ sambandhānupapatteḥ, āḍhakācitasāhacaryacca parimāṇasyaiva grahaṇam ||

dvigoṣṣṭham̐śca || 5.1.54 ||
dvyāciteti| ṭhaño luk, `aparimāṇabistācita' iti ṅīpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||

kulijāllukkhau ca | 5.1.55 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛttyā lugapi vikalpyata iti| tacca lukkhagrahaṇādvijñāyate, anyathā kulijāccetyeva vaktavyam‌, dvigoścetyeva kho'nyatarasyāmiti ca tatra ṭhankhābhyāṃ mukte pakṣe ṭhañ, tasya `adhyarddhapūrva' iti luk| evaṃ rūpatraye siddhe lukkhagrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya `luko'pi vikalpa iṣṭa iti lakṣyate' iti manyate| vāktekakārastu ṭhaño nityaṃ lukaṃ manyamānaḥ pūrvasūtravat trairūpyamevecchan lukkhagrahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, `kulijācca' iti siddhe lukkagrahaṇānarthakyam, pūrvasmin trikabhāvāditi ||

so'syāṃśavasrabhṛtayaḥ || 5.1.56 ||
iha ca śataṃ yasya vakno bhavati sa tena krīto bhavati, tatra tena krītamityeva siddham nārtho vasnagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; yogyatāmātre'pyasyedaṃ mūlyamiti vyavahārat ||

tadasya parimāṇam || 5.1.57 ||
iha paricchadahetumātraṃ parimāṇam, na sarvato mānameva; uttarasūtre saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇena viśeṣaṇāt| khāraśatika iti| khāraśabdo'kārānto vārtikakāravacanātsādhuḥ, tena hi `tadasya parimāṇam' ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ kartavya iti darśayitumuktam-`anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate khāraśatādyartham' iti| vārṣaśatika iti| yajñādau parimāṇini pratyayaḥ| ṣaṣṭi jīvitaparimāṇasyeti| saṃvat sareṣu ṣaṣṭhiśabdaḥ,saṃvatsarasaṃkhyāyā hi jīvitaṃ prāyeṇa paricchadyate, jīvitaparicchedadvāreṇa tadvato'pi ṣaṣṭiḥ saṃvatsarāḥ parimāṇamiti| tadasminparimāṇini pratyayaḥ| nanu yasya ṣaṣṭirjīvitaparimāṇaṃ ṣaṣṭimasau bhṛto bhavati tatra tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvītyeva siddham| evaṃ ca dviṣāṣṭika ityādau naivādhyarddhapūrvati lukprasaṅgaḥ, tasyānārhīyatvāt, tataśca samarthavibhakteḥ pratyayārthasya ca punarupādānena vidhānamapi na kartavyam, na ca jīvitaparimāṇādanyatra punarvidhānena lugabāva ityate ? evaṃ manye-tamadhīṣṭa ityatra kālāditi varttate, na ca ṣaṣṭayādayaḥ kālaśabdāḥ| atha kāle saṃkhyeye varttamānatvātte'pi kālaśabdāḥ ? ramaṇīyādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, ramaṇīyaṃ kālaṃ bhūta iti| tasmādyaḥ kālaṃ na vyabhicarati sa eva kālaśabda iti| dviṣāṣṭika iti| `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ ||

saṃkhyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu || 5.1.58 ||
parimāṇopādhikāditi| nātra rūḍhiparimāṇaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? kriyāśabdaḥ--parimīyate yena tatparimāṇam| saṃkhyāpi ca parimīyata iti nāsambhavi viṣeṣaṇam, nanvevamapyavyabhicārādaviśeṣaṇam, na hyaparicchedikā saṃkhyāsti, satyam; iha tu pratyayārthasya saṃghāderyadā paricchedikā saṃkhyā tadā pratyayo yathā syāt--pañca gāvaḥ parimāṇamasya pañcako gosaṅga iti; iha mā bhūt--pañca gāvaḥ saṃbhūtā asya brahmaṇasaṅghasyeti, na hyatra saṅghasyeyattāgamyate, tasmātpratyayārthasya yadā paricchedikā saṃkhyā tadā yathā syāditi viseṣaṇamarthavadbhavati|
tatretyādi| ihādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye vartanta, ?????? sakhyānamātre| tatra ya eva śakunayaḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyāyuktāḥ pañcanśabdavācyāsta eva pañcakaśabdasyāpi, tataśca parimāṇaparimāṇibhāvābhāvātsvārtha eva pratyayo vaktavyaḥ| yadā tu vṛttiviṣaye sambhavatyeva parimāṇī pratyayārthaḥ--pañcatvasaṃkhyā parimāṇameṣāṃ pañcakāḥ śaṃkunaya iti| pañcakamadhyayanamiti| pūrvaṃ tu pañcako'dhīte iti sampāṭhāpekṣayā puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ, `adhīte' iti ca kṛta ityarthaḥ| yathā-odanapākaṃ pacatyodanapākaṃ karotītyarthaḥ|
steme ḍavidhiriti| somayāgeṣu chandogaiḥ kriyamāṇā pṛṣṭādistutiḥ stemaḥ| pañcadaśa mantrāḥ parimāṇamasyeti| sāmrā stuvīta, ekaṃ sāma tṛce kiyate iti stutividhiḥ| tatra trikasya pañcakṛtva āvṛttyā pañcadaśa mantrā bhavanti, saptadaśasome antyāyāḥ saptakṛtva āvṛttiḥ ekaviśe tṛcasya| ḍitkaraṇamekaviśe tilopārtham, trayastriṃśādau ṭilopārthaṃ ca| pañcadaśaḥ, saptadaśa ityatra tu `nastaddhite' ityanenaiva ṭilopaḥ siddhaḥ|
śanśatorḍiniriti| `stome' iti na sambadhyate| atrāpi ḍitkaraṇaṃ śadantasya ṭilopārtham| pañcadaśina iti| pañcadaśāhāni parimāṇameṣāmiti ḍiniḥ| etena triṃśino vyākhyātāḥ|
viṃśino'ṅgirasa iti| `āṅgirasāyāsya gautama' ityādipravarabhedena bhinnāni viṃśatiravāntaragotrāṇi parimāṇameṣāmityarthaḥ|
yogaścāyaṃ pūrvasyaiva prapañcaḥ ||

paṃktiviṃśatitriṃśaccatvāriśatpañcāśatṣaṣṭisaptatyaśītinavatiśatam || 5.1.59 ||
paṃktyādayaḥ śabāda nipātyanta iti| prakṛtinirdeśastvayaṃ na bhavati; paṃktyādibhyaḥ prakṛte'rthe'dhikṛtaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti pañcamyā anupadānāt, pūrveṇaiva ca siddhatvāt, uttareṇa nipātanena sāhacayacci| pratyayanirddeśo'pi na bhavati--ṅyāpprātipadikātprakṛte'rthe paṃktayādayaḥ pratyayā bhavantīti, loke śāstre ca `śatacca ṭhanyatāvaśate' ityādau kevalānāṃ prayogadarśanād| yatra samudāyaḥ śrūyate, avayavā anumīyante tannipātanam, viparīto vidhiḥ| pañcānāmiti| arthagatasya bahutvasya śabde samāropād bahuvacanam, pañcaśabdasyotyarthaḥ| ṭilopasticca pratyaya iti| nipātyaya ityarthaḥ| avayavanipātananāntarīyakatvātsamudāyanipātanasya| yadvā--`nipātanātsiddham' ityasya puṃlliṅgavipariṇāmenānvayaḥ, kutvaṃ tu cakārañakārayorna nipātyam, `coḥ kuḥ' ityeva siddham| pañca padānīti| padaśabdaḥ pādaparyāyaḥ| paṃktiśachanda iti| tatpunaḥ padapaṃktiḥ, yasya pañcākṣarāḥ pañca pādā bhavanti| dvayordaśatoriti| daśadvayarūpasaṃkhyeyamācakṣāṇasya dviśabdasyetyayamatrārtho vivakṣitaḥ| evaṃ trayāṇām daśatāmityādāvapi draṣṭavyam| śaticca pratya iti| citkaraṇamantodāttārtham| apadatvaṃ ceti| tena jaśtavacarttve na bhavataḥ| atra `tadasya parimāṇamiti varttate' ityuktam, dvau daśatau parimāṇamasyetyādiśca vigraho darśitaḥ| yadā tu nanuvarttate tadā dviśadāderdaśabdarthābhidhāyinaḥ svārthe pratyayo nipātyaḥ-- dvau daśatau viṃśatiḥ, trayodaśatastriṃśad iti; tataśca svarthikānāṃ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānuvṛttedviśabdāderiva dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| viṃśatyādi bhiśca daśatāmabhidhānamiti gavādibhirvaikyadhikaraṇyameva syād--gavāṃ viṃśatiriti, na tu viṃśatirgāva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam, nāpi dviguḥ---viṃśatigavamiti, tasmādanuvarttayam|
athāsyetyanena kaḥ pratinirdiśyate ? parimāṇī| kaḥ punarasau ? bhinnāni dravyāṇi--dvau daśatau parimāṇameṣāṃ viśatiriti| yadyevam, viṃśatyādibhirdravyāṇāmabhidhānamiti bahuvacanaprasaṅgādviśatirgāva iti na syāt, gavāṃ viṃśatirgoviṃśatiriti ca na syād, vyatirekābhāvāt ? athāsmin pakṣe kiñcicadiṣṭamapi siddham, āhosviddoṣāntamevāsti ? ityāha--iha viśatigavaṃ triṃśatpūlīti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇo dviguḥ siddhaḥ; tasmānna bhinnāni dravyāṇi parimāṇīni, etacca sarveṣveva vigrahavākyeṣvasyetyekavacanena darśitam| kastahiṃ parimāṇī ? saṅghaḥ---dvau daśatau parimāṇamasya gosaṅgasya `viṃśatitriśadbhayāṃ ḍtun' viśakaḥ saṅga iti na syāt; saṅgāntarasya parimāṇino'sambhavāt| atomayaṃ parimāṇibhinnā dravyāṇi tatsaṃghaśca, tatra saṅghaparimāṇini vyadhikaraṇaprayogāḥ, dravyeṣu tu parimāṇiṣu samānādhikaraṇaprayogāḥ, tatraiva viṃsatirgāvaḥ parimāṇamasya viṃśako gosaṅga iti bhaviṣyatītyucyet ? evamapi viṃśatirgāva ityatra bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ, tathā saṅghasya parimāṇatve viṃśatirgosaṅga iti prāpnoti, na ceṣyate, vim̐śaka ityeva hi tatreṣyate| evaṃ tarhi dvāvatra saṅgau staḥ--dvavyāṇāmekaḥ, dravyavargayordaśatoścāparaḥ; tatra nipātanasāmarthyāddaśatsaṃghe parimāṇini pratyayaḥ, saṅśca samudāyamātraṃ na prāṇināmeva kiṃ hi nipātanādalabhyam, tatra daśatsaṅghasya viṃśatiśabdenābhidhānād gosaṃghe vivakṣite viśatiḥ parimāṇamasya viśako gosaṅgha iti ca bhaviṣyati, viśatirgosaṅgha iti ca na bhaviṣyati, gavāṃ viṃśatirgoviṃśatiriti ca bhaviṣyati| nanu daśatsaṅghasya daśatau guṇinau na gāvaḥ, tena daśatorviśatiriti prāpanoti, gavāṃ viśatiriti tuna siddhayati ? ucyate; dravalyāṇāṃ dravyasaṅgasya daśatāṃ daśatsaṅsya ca na pāramāthiko bhedo'sti, kevalaṃ bapuddhayā parikalpyate, tataśca gavāṃ daśatośca tāttvikabhedābhāvaddaśatsaṅghamapi pratigavāmapi guṇitvamupapadyate| vyabhicārabhāvāttu daśadbhyāṃ viśatitarna viśeṣyate gavādibhireva tu viśeṣyate, yathā--paṭasya śauklyamiti bhavati, na śuklasya śauklāmiti vyamicārābhāvāt, tadvadatrāpi| aivaṃ tāvadvyādhikaraṇaprayogā upapāditāḥ, viṃśatirgāva ityādikāstu samānādhikraṇaprayogā upapādanīyāḥ, dharmavacanā ete viśatyādayo guṇavacanā iti śuklādivadbhaviṣyati| yathā hi-paṭasya śuklo guṇa iti guṇamātre dṛṣṭaḥ śuklaśabdo guṇaguṇinoravyatirekavivakṣāyāṃ matublopādvā samānādhikaraṇo bavati śuklaḥ paṭa iti| evaṃ viśatyādayo'pi|
yadyevam, yathānye guṇavacanā dravyasya liṅgasaṃkhye anuvartante, yathā---śuklaṃ vastram, śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklau, śukla iti, evaṃ viṃśatyādayopyanuvatteran ? iha punarviśatirgāvaḥ viṃśatirbalīvarddāḥ viśatirgokulānīti nityamekavacanaṃ strīliṅgaṃ ca bhavati, śataśabdāttu napuṃsakatvam, viṃśatī viśatayaḥ śate śatānīti tu pracayabhedavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣaḥ ? atrocyate--yasya dhamesya dhamiṇā sahābhedaḥ pratipādyate, sa cetteṣu pratyekaparisamāptaḥ tadā tasyāpi dharmivadbhinnatvād dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ, yathā śuklau, śuklā iti| śauklyaṃ hi kambaleṣu pratyekaparisamāptam, ko'rthaḥ ? ekaikasminnapi kambale śuklaśabdārthaḥ puṣkalaḥ, na mātrayāpi nyūna ityarthaḥ| viśatirgāva ityatra tu viṃśatisaṃkhyā na pratyekaparisamāptā, kiṃ tarhi ? bahuṣviti| tadrūpabhedābhāvādekavacanameva bhavati, yathā--gāvo dhanam, indrāgnī devatā, vedāḥ pramāṇamiti| dhinorterdhanaṃ prītihetuḥ, samuditānāṃ ca gavāṃ prītihetutvaṃ vivakṣitam, naikaikasyā iti dhanamekaṃ gobhirviśeṣyate, tatra dhanākāre bedābhāvād bahuvacanābhāvaḥ. indrāgnī devateti divaraiśvaryakarmaṇordevatāsaṅghasya ca devatātvamekaṃ iviḥ pratīti dvivananābhāvaḥ| devate iti tūcyamāne pratyakamaiśvarya pratīyeta, tataśca vrīhiyavayoriva vikalpaḥ syāt| vedāḥ pramāṇamiti caturṇā samuditānāṃ vedānāmekaṃ pramāṇatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti tasminnākāre bhedābhāvād bahuvacanābhāvaḥ, pratyekaṃ tu prāmāṇye vedāḥ pramāṇānīti bhavatyeva| yadyevam, trayaścatvāraḥ pañca ṣaṭ saptetyatrāpyekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi tritvādikamapi pratyekaparisamāptam ? ucyate; tryādayo nityaṃ saṃkhyeyavacanāḥ, na tu kadācidapi saṃkhyānamātravacanā ityekena dhrameṇa vyāsajyavṛttinā sahānekasya dhamiṃṇo bhedapratipādanābhāvāddharmibedāśrayaṃ bahuvacanameva bhavati| yadyapi tritvamityādau saṃkhyānamātramapi niṣṭaṣṭaṃ pratīyate, tryādibhistu na pratīyate| devatāśabdastu yadyapi niṣkṛṣṭadevatātvamācaṣṭe, tathāpyannirdevatetyekenāpi sa bhinnadevatātvamācaṣṭe, nānekenaiva sarvadā| tryādayastu na kvacidapyevamiti viśeṣaḥ| liṅgamapi lokāśrayatvādyathādarśitaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate, na taddhitāntatvenābhidheyavaditi sarvamanākulam|
evaṃ bhāṣyakāramatena vyākhyāya saṃprati vārttikakāramataṃ darśayati--`viśatyādaya iti| guṇaśabdā iti| rūḍhirūpā iti bhāvaḥ| yathākathañaacidvyutpādyā iti| svaravarṇānupūrvījñānārtham, na tvavayavārthapradarśanāya, tadāha--nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveṣṭavyamiti| avayavārthaviṣayo'bhiniveśo na karttavya ityarthaḥ| sa tu pratītipathaṃ nārohatīti parityajyate|
yā caiṣāmityādi| darśitā ca guṇamātre guṇini ca vṛttiḥ, etadapi sartraṃ svābhāvikameveti darśitāmupapatti sthirāṃ manyate|
sahasrādayo'pyevañjātīyakā iti| guṇamātre guṇini ca vartante, svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhāyinaścetyarthaḥ| tadvadeva draṣṭavyā iti| svaravarṇāpūrvījñānārthaṃ viṃśatyādivadvyutpādyā ityarthaḥ| tadyathā-śataśya daśatāṃ sahabhāvaḥ sracca pratyayaḥ|| kva punarete vyutpādyāḥ ? pṛṣodarādiṣu| udāharaṇāmātram pradarśanamātrametadviśatyādīnāmupādānam| itiśabdaḥ samāptau| atra vārttikam--`anārambho vā prātipadikavijñānādyathā sahasrādiṣu' iti ||

pañcaddaśatau varge vā || 5.1.60 ||
saṅghagrahaṇe prakṛte vargagrahaṇaṃ sūtrādhyayanayoranuvṛttirmā bhūditi, aprāṇyarthaṃ ca; saṅghaśabdasya prāṇiviṣayatvāt ||

triṃśaccatvāriṃśatorbrāhmaṇe saṃjñāyāṃ ḍaṇ || 5.1.61 ||
na viṣayasaptamīti| brāhmaṇaviṣayaścetprayogo bhavatīti naivamatrārthaḥ, naivamatrārthaḥ, tathā hi sati mantre bhāṣāyāṃ ca prayogo na syāt, brāhmaṇādanyasya ca saṃjñāyāṃ śaṅkyeta, evaṃ ca `brāhmaṇasaṃjñāyām' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena nirdeṣṭavyam, tathā tu na kṛtamiteyeva sūtre ca ye okārādantaraṃ rephamadhīyate teṣāṃ pañcamyarye ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam| ye tu na, teṣāṃ samāhāradvandve pañcamyekavacanam ||

tadarhati || 5.1.62 ||
arhati labdhu yogyo bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

chedādibhyo nityam || 5.1.63 ||
nityagadrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇāmiti| atha yathā `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayo' ityatra mahāvibhāṣayā prāptasya vākyasya nivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam, tathehāpi kasmānna bhavati ? iṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭatvācca| ityate ca dṛśyate ca chedamarhatīti| na ca vākyanivṛtyarthameva nityagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, `chedādibhyaḥ' ityevāstu, pūrveṇa siddhe punarārambho vākyanivṛtyartho bhaviṣyati| yathā tarhi `trermapnityam' ityatra svātantryanivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam, tatheha kasmānna bhavati ? iṣṭatvāt, dṛṣṭatvācca| iṣyate ca svātatryam, dṛśyate ca chedādiṣu paṭhitasya sampraśanaśabdasya svatantrasya prayogaḥ, vidhinimantraṇādisutre yathā| tarhyekagopūrvādityatra pratyayāntarya matupo nivṛt‌yarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam, tadeha kasmānna bhavati? aprāptatvāt| na hyatra kasyacitpratyayāntarasya prāptiḥ| yathā tarhi `nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau' ityatrārthāntaranivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam--gativacanāddhātoḥ kauṭilya eva, na kriyāsamabhihāra iti, tatheha kasmānna bhavati ? iṣṭatvād, iṣyate hyarthāntare'pi yathāyogaṃ chedādibhya arhīyaḥ pratyayaḥ| tasmādyathoktameva prayojanaṃ nityagrahaṇasya| chedaṃ nityamarhatīti| nanu na kaścit padārtho nityaṃ chedamarhati, yo'pi vetasādiśchinnaśchinnaḥ prarohati so'pi na sadaivacchedanārhaḥ; prarūḍhastu bhavati| yastārha dasyuvaṃsādirnityaṃ chedanārhaḥ sa pratyayārthaḥ| apara āha--ābhīkṣṇaye nityaśabdaḥ, yathā--nityaprahasitādāviti|
virāga viraṅgaṃ ceti| virāgaśabdāḥ pratyayamutpādayati, tatsanniyogena viraṅgamādeśamāpadyate--virāgaṃ nityamarhati vairaṅgikaḥ ||

śīrṣacchedādyacca || 5.1.65 ||
pratyayasanniyogeneti| tathā ca śiraḥśabdena vigraho darśitaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi pūrvamuktam-śīrṣacchedaśabdād dvitīyāsamarthāditi ? na prayogārhe vākye dvitīyāsamarthatā, kiṃ tarhi ? yadupamarddanena vṛttirbhavati tatra prakiyāvakye pratyayau dvau--yacca, ṭhakca, evaṃ ca pratyayāmabhyāṃ sanniyoga iti dvivacanāntena samāsaḥ ||

daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ || 5.1.66 ||
upāyaviśeṣaḥ-daṇḍaḥ, hastālambaśca| iha `daṇḍādibhyaḥ' ityetāvatsūtram, anantaraśca yatpratyayo vidhīyate'| tathā ca vadhyaśabdavalyutpādanāya kyabvidhāvuktam--`hano vadha ca tadvito vā' iti, yadi cātra yadvidhīyate tata eva tadupapadyate taddhito veti| katham ? kyapyādyudātatvam, yatyapi taddhite `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvameva| yadi tvatra yo vidhīyeta tataḥ svare viśeṣādanupapannametatsyāt| uttarasūtre cāsya yasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syāt, na yataḥ| athāpi svaritatvādyata evānuvṛttirucyate ? evamapi vṛttikārasyaitadvaktumāpadyeta--`yadanuvarttate nānantaro yaḥ' iti| ye tvibha-vadha-medhaśabdānā yadantānāmādyudāttānāṃ chandasi prayogāḥ--`ibhyānna rājā vanānyatti, tasmādapi vadhyaṃ prapannaṃ na pratiprayacchanti, apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam' ityādyāḥ, te daṇkaḍādibhyo yavidhāne'pyupapadyante| katham ? daṇkaḍādibhyo yaḥ' daṇḍādibhyaśchandasyubhayaprasaṅge paratvādyadbhavipyati| tasmādete prayogāḥ `daṇḍādibhyo yadvidhīyate' ityatrārthe pramāṇatvena nopanyasanīyāḥ ||

pātrāddham̐śca || 5.1.68 ||
ṭhakṭhañorapavāda iti| tatra ṭhako'pavādatvamupapādayati--pātraṃ parimāṇamapyastīti| bhājanaviśeṣastu prasiddha eva, tatra ṭhako'pavādaḥ, parimāṇavacane tu ṭhaña ityarthaḥ| pātriya iti| pātraparimitaṃ taṇḍulādikaṃ yaḥ sthālyādirarhati, sambhavanadhāraṇakṣamatvāt, sa evamucyate| yena vā bhukte bhojanabhājanaṃ saṃskāreṇa na śuddhyati ||

kaḍaṅkaradakṣiṇāccha ca || 5.1.69 ||
`kaḍa made', kaḍatīti kaḍaḥ, kaḍaṃ karotītyata eva nipātanātkhac, kaḍaṅkaraṃ māṣamudgādikāṣṭhamucyate| dakṣerutsāhakarmaṇaḥ karaṇe `dudakṣibhyāminan' itīnanpratyayaḥ---dakṣiṇā| cakārādyacyeti| gham̐stvanantaro'pi na samuccīyate, ya eva; svaritatvāt| kaḍaṅkarīya iti| yo balīvarho durjaramapi kaḍaṅkaraṃ jarayituṃ prabhāvati sa tadarhatadītyacyate|
alpāccassyetyādi| yaddhā--yathāsaṃkhye'bhiprete yasmādyadiṣṭaḥ, taṃ daṇḍādiṣu paṭhaṃt ||

sthālībilāt || 5.1.70 ||
chayatāvanārttete iti| pūrvasūtre'pi na yaccakāreṇānukṛṣṭaḥ, tathā sati ghana eva prasaṅgāt| kiṃ tarhi ? svaritatvāt| ato na satyānuvṛttirdulebheti bhāvaḥ| pākayogyā ityartha iti| triphalīkṛtā iti yāvat ||

yajhartvigbhyāṃ ghakhañau || 5.1.71 ||
yajñamarhatīti| sa punaryasya viduṣo'rthinaḥ śāstreṇāmaryudastasya dravyavato yajhe'dhikāraḥ, sa veditavyaḥ| deśasyānaivaṃvidhatvādvacanam|
yajñatvigbhyāṃ tatkarmārhatītyupasaṃkhayānamiti| yajñakarmārhatīti| yajñakarmānuṣṭhanayogya ityarthaḥ| ṛtvikkarmārhatīti| ṛtvigbhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ ||

pārāyaṇaturāyaṇacāndrāyaṇaṃ vartayati || 5.1.72 |
pārāyaṇam-ādita ārabhyāntādavicchedena vedādhyayanam, turāyaṇam-saṃvatsarasādhyo iviryajñaviśeṣaḥ, cāndrāyaṇam-tapoviśeṣaḥ, vartanam-niṣpādanam| tatra pārāyaṇaṃ guruṇā śiṣyeṇa ca nirvarttyate; anyatarāsannidhāvadhyayanakriyāyā aniṣpādanāt; śiṣya eva tviṣyate| tathā turāyaṇamubhau vartayataḥ--ṛtvigyamānaśca; ṛtvik carupuroḍāśādi nirvarttayati, yajamāno devatoddeśena dravyaṃ tvajati; yajamāna eva tviṣyate| ubhayatra kasmānta bhavati ? anabidhānāt ||

saṃśayamāpannaḥ || 5.1.73 ||
sāṃśayikaḥ sthāṇuriti| sthāṇurvā puruṣo vetyevaṃrūpasya saṃśayasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ| ananaitaddarśayati-yadyapi dve api kartṛkarmaṇī saṃśayamāpanne, tathāpi yadviṣayakaḥ saṃśayastatraiva pratyayo bhavati, na kartari paruṣe; anabhidhānādhiti ||

yojanaṃ gacchati || 5.1.74 ||
krośaśatayojanaśatayoriti| guṇena neti pratiṣedhaḥ saṃkhyāyā na bhavati; ata eva nirdeśāt, `śatashasrāntācca niṣkāt' iti vacanācca|
tato'bhigamanamiti| atra pañcamyantātpratyaḥ ||

pantho ṇa nityam || 5.1.76 ||
nityagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamiti| vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ tu na bhavati; panthādeśo hi pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyamāno naiva vākye sambhavati; pathinśbdena tu vākye'nabhiprete pūrvasūtra eva nityagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt| yatra pathinśabdaḥ śrūyate, pratyayāntaranivṛttyarthamapi na bhavati; pathaḥ kano vidhānasāmarthyāt, pratyayāntarasya prāptyabhāvāt| panthānaṃ nityaṃ gacchatīti| nanvayamartho na sambhavati, viśramasyāvaśyambhavitvāt; sambhavatu vā kathañcidādityādau, tathāpi na tatraiveṣyate, udāhṛtaṃ hi--pāntho bhikṣāṃ yācate iti ? tasmādābhīkṣaṇm-nityam, parityāgābhāvo vā ||

uttarapathenāhṛtaṃ ca || 5.1.77 ||
cakāraḥ pratyayārthasamuccaya iti| pratyayārthamātrasamuccaye, na yu samarthavibhaktiyuktasya vākyārthasyetyarthaḥ| `tasya vyākhyāna iti ca' itivad vākyārthaparāmaśina itiśabdasyābhāvaditi bhāvaḥ| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha--atrāpīti| dvitīyapakṣe cākrānte'nākrānte ca prakṛtyarthe pratyayaḥ syāt, ākrānta eva tu bhavati|
vārijaṅgaletyādi| vāryādīni pūrvapadāni yasminprātipadike tatmātpathinśabdāntādityarthaḥ|
ajapathaśaṃkupathābhyāṃ ceti| pūrvasminnevavākye'jaśaṃkuśabdau paṭhitavyau, tathā tu na kṛtamityeva|
madhumaricayoraṇ sthalāditi| sthalaśabdottaro yaḥ pathin-śabdaḥ, tadantānmadhumaricayorabhidheyayoraṇ bhavati| sthalapathenāhṛtamiti| gacchatyarthe tu pratyayo na darśitaḥ; mukhyagamanāsambhavāt| sthālapathaṃ madhukamiti| madhumaricayoranyataranirṇayāyānuprayogo na viruddhaḥ ||

kālāt || 5.1.78 ||
svarūpagrahaṇamiha na bhavati, `tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhīṣī' ityatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyānirddesāt `māsādvayasi' ityādau māsādīnāṃ kālagrahaṇena viśeṣaṇācca ||

tena nirvṛttam || 5.1.79 ||
teneti karaṇe tṛtīyā| nivṛttam-niṣpāditam| antarbhāvitaṇyarthe vṛttiḥ ||

tamadhīṣṭo mṛto bhūto bhāvī || 5.1.80 ||
bhāvīti tādṛśa evānāgata iti| svasattayā vyāpyamānakāla ityarthaḥ| nanu ceti| yadyapi kvacitkadācinmāsamapyadhyeṇaṃ bharaṇaṃ ca kriyate, tathāpi yāvantaṃ kālaṃ kriyate, na tāvataḥ pratyaya iṣyate, api tu phalabhūtakriyāvyāpyakālādiṣyate| sa cādhyeṣaṇabharaṇābhyāmavyāpta iti dvitīyānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ| adhyeṣaṇabharaṇe kriyārthe iti| adhyāpanādikriyārthaṃ hi tayoḥ karaṇam| phalabhūtayā kriyayeti adhyāpanādikayā|
tābhyāmeva vyāpta ityucyata iti| yathā caurairāhṛtenāgninā dagdhe grāme vaktāro bhavanti--caurairdagdo grāma iti ||

māsādvayasi yatkhañau || 5.1.81 ||
vayasyabhidheya iti| pratyayārthasya tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vayaḥ, tatra viśiṣṭābhidhāne viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ vayo'pyabhidheyamiti bhāvaḥ| sāmarthyāditi| na hi māsamadhīṣṭo bhṛto vetyakte kācitkālakṛtā śarīrāvasthā gamyate, bhāvinyapi nāñjasā gamyate| jātaḥ kumāro māsaṃ bhāvītyatrāpi pūrṇe māse yā'vasthā saiva vayaḥ, tataśca tatrāpi bhūta eva māso vayaḥpratīterheturityetatsāmarthyam| khaño tritkaraṇaṃ svarārtham, puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca--māsīnābhāryaḥ ||

dvigoryap || 5.1.82 ||
prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidherabhyupagamātpūrveṇa yatkhañoḥ prāptayoryabvidhīyate| yapaḥ pittvādanudāttatvam, tena kālānte dvigāviti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara evāvatiṣṭhate ||

ṣaṇamāsāṇṇyacca || 5.1.83 ||
autsargiko'pi ṭhañiṣyate iti| sa kathamiṣyamāṇo'pi labhyaityāha--sa iti| yadi cakāraṣṭhañaḥ samuccayārthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi yabbhavati ? ityāha--svaritatvācceti| etacca vyākhyānādeva labhyate ||

avayasi ṭham̐śva || 5.1.84 ||
cakāro'nantarasya ṇyataḥsamuccayārtha iti| na tu pūrvavat ṭhañaḥ samuccayārthaḥ| tathā ca vārtikam-- `avayasi ṭhaṃścetyanantarasyānukarṣaḥ' iti||

samāyāḥ khaḥ || 5.1.85 ||
sarvatreti| pūrvatra, atra, paratra ca| tena parijayya-labhya-kārya-sukaramiti yāvat ||

rātryahassaṃvatsarācca || 5.1.87 ||
dvaiyahnika iti| `aṅnaṣṭakhoreva' iti kaniyamādasati ṭilope `allopo'naḥ' ityakāralopaḥ| nanvatra `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' iti paratvāṭṭacā bhavitavyam, na ca mahāvibhāṣayā ṭaṭo vikalpaḥ, bṛhatījātyantāḥ samāsāntāśceti nityeṣu parigaṇanāt ? evaṃ tarhi samāsāntavidharenityatvādatra na bhaviṣyati ||

cittavati nityam || 5.1.89 ||
yadi cittavati nityaṃ lugbhavati, kathaṃ `varṣasyābhaviṣyati' ityatra vakṣyati-dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyati dvivārṣiko manuṣya iti, na hi nitye luki adhīṣṭabhṛtayorutpannasya cittavati śravaṇamupapadyate ? evaṃ tarhi bhūta evotpannasya pratyayasya lugiṣyate, na sarvatra| etacca nityagrahaṇāllabhyate| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityo luk siddhaḥ, tatra nityagrahaṇaṃ viśiṣṭe'rthe nityaṃ lug yathā syāt| sa punarviśiṣṭo'rtho bhūta eva; vyākhyānāt| tenādhīṣṭādau pūrveṇa vibhāṣayaiva lugbhaviṣyati ||

ṣaṣṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante || 5.1.90 ||
laghutvātprathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvācca ekavacanenaiva nirdeśādvivakṣitaṃ taditi manyamānaṃ pratyāha--bahuvacanamatantramiti| tathā ca vārttike--`ṣaṣṭike saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam' ityekavacanaṃ prayuktam| prayogabāhulyāttu sūtre bahuvacanaprayogaḥ, ṣaṣṭirātreṇa paccanta ityatrārthe nipātyamānasya ṣaṣṭikaśabdasya dhānyaviśeṣa eva prayogo yathā syāt, ṇudgādiṣu mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti vārttikakāroṇoktam| tadetannipātanādeva siddhamityabhiprāyeṇāha--saṃjñaiṣetyādi ||

vatsarāntācchaśchandasi || 5.1.91 ||
idvatsara-idāvatsaraśabdau pañcavarṣe yuge dvayorgharṣayoḥ saṃjñe| evaṃ saṃvatsara-parivatsaraśabdāvapi ||

tena parijayyalabhyakāryyasukaram || 5.1.93 ||
parijayya ityasya vivaraṇam--śakyate parijetumiti| `kṣayyajasyau śakyārthe' ityayādeśaḥ ||

tadasya brahmacaryam || 5.1.94 ||
māso'sya brahmacaryasyeti| yadyapyatrātyantasaṃyogo gamyate, tathāpi dvitīyā na bhavati; māsasya pradhānatvāt, ṣaṣṭhīviṣaye ca dvitīyā vidhānāt|
ubhayathā hi sūtrapraṇayanāditi| ubhayorapyarthayoḥ sūtrakāreṇaiva sūtrasya vyākhyātatvādityrathaḥ| mahānāmnyādibhya iti| brahmacaryasya pratyayārthatvātsāmarthyāt ṣaṣṭhīsamarthebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ|
mahānāmnyo nāma ṛca iti| mahannāma yāsāṃ tā mahānāmnyaḥ, vidāmaghavannityādyāḥ, `nityaṃ saṃjñāchandasoḥ' iti ṅīp| mahānāmnīścaratīti| caraṇamanuṣṭānm, tacca kriyāviṣayamiti tatsahacaritaṃ vrataṃ tacchabdenocyate| tatra ca sa liṅgasaṃkhyāparityāgenaiva mahānāmnīśabdo vrate varttata iti mahānāmnīśvaratīti vigrahaḥ| māhānāmika iti| `bhasyāḍhe taddhite puvadbhāva' iti ṅīpi nivṛtte ṭilopaḥ|
avāntaradīkṣādibhyo ḍiniriti| ḍitkaraṇasaṣṭācatvāriṃśataṣṭilopārtham| anyatra syoti lopena siddham|
aśṭācatvāriṃśaka iti| vṛttiviṣaye varṣeṣu, saṃkhyoyeṣu aṣṭaṭatvāriṃśacchabdo varttate--prativedaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi vratacaraṇāccaturṣuṃ vedeṣvaṣṭācatvāriṃśataṃ varṣāṇi vrataṃ carati|
cāturmasyānāmiti| abhideyabahutvādvahuvacanam|
kimidaṃ cāturmāsyānāmiti ? tatrāha--caturmāsāṇṇayo yajñe tatra bhava iti| cāturmāsyānīti| saṃvatsarasādhyo iviryajñaviśeṣastasya catvāryavāntaraparvāṇi tadapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam| cāturmāsīti| `tatra bhavaḥ' ityevāṇsiddhaḥ, tasya `dvigorluganapatye' iti luki prāpte punaraṇ vidhīyate| `kālāṭṭhañ' ityasya tvaprāptiḥ samudāyasyākālavācitvāttadantavidhyabhāvācca| apara āha--yathākathañaacitkālavṛttibyo'pi ṭhaña iṣṭatvāṭṭhañyeva prāpte tasya lukīdamaṇvidhānamiti ||

tasya ca dakṣiṇāyajñākhyebhyaḥ || 5.1.95 ||
yajñamācakṣate yajñākhyāḥ sopasārgādapi mūlavibhujāditvādasyamādeva nipātanādvā kaḥ |
ākhyāgrahaṇamiti| āṅpūrvasya `khyā' ityasya dhātorgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| ākhyāgrahaṇāmiti| hrasvāntapāṭhastu yuktaḥ| akālavācino'pi yathā syāditi| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu bahuvacananirdeśādipi śakyaṃ nirākattumiti bhāvaḥ| nanvekāhādayaḥ kratuśabdaḥ kālavācī na samudāyaḥ, kathaṃ te eva gṛhyeran ? ata āha--prāgvateriti| nanu yā'gniṣṭomasya dakṣiṇā sāgniṣṭome bhavati, tatra `bahraco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ', `kratuyajñebhyaśca' iti ṭhañ siddhayati ? na siddhayati; `vāyakhyātavyanāmnaḥ' iti tatra varttate, nāmagrahaṇācca vyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhasya granthasya grahaṇam| kiñca--dvayorvājapeyayorbhavā dvaivājapeyikī--atra na prāpnoti; iha tu `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānām' iti tadantavidhiścāsti, lukca na prāpnoti; apragdīvyatīyatvāt, anārhīyatvācca|

tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat || 5.1.96 ||
haimanamiti| yadyapi bhavavatpratyayā bhavantītyuktam, tathāpi `sarvatrāṇca talopaśca' ityaṇpratyayo'tidiṣṭe tatsānnayogaśiṣṭastalopo'pi bhavati| vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārtha iti| `kālebhyo bhavavat' ityatraitad vyākhyātam| agniṣṭome dīyate āgniṣṭomikaṃ bhaktamiti| yadyevam, agniṣṭomasya yā dakṣiṇā sāgniṣṭome dīyate tatra `yajñākhyebhyo dīyate ityanenaiva siddham, tathā yanmāse kāryaṃ tanmāse bhaghaṃ bhavati, tataśca kāryagrahaṇamanarthakam, tatra bhavena kṛtatvāt ? atrāhuḥ--``dvigorluganapatye' iti luk prāpnoti| athānenāpi pratyaye sati lukkasmānna bhavati, yāvatā `vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthe' ityuktam ? satyam; pratyayamātrasyātideśo na luk, iti| tadapare na sahante--vatiḥ sarvasādṛśyārthaḥ, tatra tathā bhave tadantavidhirna bhavati, evamatrāpi na bhavitavyam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā `tatra ca dīyate' ityatrāpi tadantavidhirna bhavati| vibhakte tu yoge bhavatyeva, tatra bhavavadityasyābhāvāt-dvayorvājapeyayordīyate dvaivājapeyikī| sūkṣmadṛśāmeṣa santhāḥ ||

vyuṣṭadibhyo'ṇ || 5.1.97 ||
pyuṣṭaśabdaḥ kālavācī divasamukhe varttate, tatsāhacaryānnityaśabdasyāpi kālavācino grahaṇam, nākāsādivṛtteḥ| tatra cātyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā bhavatīti saptamyadhikare'pi dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ| nityaṃ dīyate kāryaṃ vā naityam|
`aṇaprakaraṇe'gripadādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' ityetatpratyācaṣṭe--na vaktavyamiti| na karttavyamityarthaḥ| kathamityāha--atreva paṭhitavyāsta iti| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācyāśrayaṇīya ityuktaṃ bhavati; anyathā tatraiva paṭhayeran, upasaṃkhyānaṃ vā kriyeta, ko viśeṣaḥ ? aṇgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ bhavavadityanuvattiṣyate, tenāṇeva bhaviṣyati| na caivaṃ vyuṣṭanityaśabdābhyām `kālāṭṭhañ' ityasya prasaṅgaḥ, pūrveṇaiva ṭhañaḥ siddhatvāt ? satyam; `ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī' ityuktam, tatra yadī vṛddheṣvapyetatkadācipravartate, tadā chaḥ syāt| paṭhiteṣu tu nāsti doṣaḥ ||

tena yathākathācahastābhyāṃ ṇayatau || 5.1.98 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthābhyāmiti| tṛtīyārthayuktābhyāmityarthaḥ| tathā ca yathākathācaśabdaṃ prati vakṣyati--tṛtīyārthamātraṃ ca sambhavatīti hastaśabde tu tṛtīyāntatvameva sambhavatīti pratyekamarthasambandha iti| nanu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate iti| pratyayau tu prati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavatyeva, atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| tṛtīyārthamātraṃ ca sambhavatīti| arthastāvatsambhavati--yathākathāca dattamityukte, anadareṇa dattamiti pratītestāvanmātrameva sambhavati| mātraśabdasya vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati--na tviti| yathākathācaśabdasya vākyatvāt| pratyayastu vacanasāmarthyādvākyādapi bhavati ||

sampādini || 5.1.99 ||
sampādinītyatra sampaderarthamāha--guṇotkarṣaḥ sampattiriti| karṇaveṣṭakam-karṇābharaṇam| vastrayugeṇeti| `kumaci ca' iti ṇatvam ||

karmaveṣādyat || 5.1.100 ||
karmṛ-vyāyāmaḥ, veṣaḥ-kṛtrima ākāraḥ ||

tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ || 5.1.101 ||
alamarthe caturthīti| alamarthe `prabhavati' ityasminnupapade śeṣaviṣaye caturthātyarthaḥ| saktumāṃsaudanādvigṛhītādapiti| apiśabdātsaṅghātādapi--sāktumāṃsitaḥ; audanikaḥ, āktumāṃsaudanikaḥ ||

karmaṇa ukañ || 5.1.103 ||
kārmukaṃ dhanuriti| anyatra tu na bhavati; anabhidhānāt ||

samayastadasya prāptam || 5.1.104 ||
samarthavibhaktinirdeśa uttarārtha iti| iha tu samaya iti nirdeśādeva prathamāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyate, uttarārthatvādeva ca samayaśabdasya puṃlliṅgatve'pi taditi napuṃsakanirddeśaḥ, tadapekṣayā ca prāptaśabdasyāpi napuṃsakatvam, iha tu vākyabhedena sambandhaḥ, yadāha--`yattaprathamāsamarthaṃ prāptaṃ cetattadbhavatīti ||

ṛtoraṇ || 5.1.105 ||
tapavastā prāpto'steti| upavatsā-upavāsasya karttā sa prāpto'sya aupavastram-upavāsaḥ, prāśitram-brahmabhāgaḥ ||

chandasi ghas || 5.1.106 ||
ṛtviya iti| `siti ca' iti padatvena bhatve niraste `orguṇaḥ' na bhavati ||

kālādyat || 5.1.107 ||
kālyastāpa iti| prātaḥkāle kālyaśabdasya vyutpattyantaraṃ mṛgyam ||

prakṛṣṭe ṭhañ || 5.1.108 ||
prakarṣeṇeti| prakṛṣṭaśabde prakṛtyarthasya niṣkṛpya kathanametat, evaṃ prakṛṣṭe -prakarṣe| varttamānāditi| prakarṣaviśiṣṭe'rthe varttamānādityarthaḥ| na tvatra `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' darśitaḥ, karmaṇi ktānto'yaṃ prakṛṣyate, sa prakṛṣṭa iti; anyathā prakṛṣṭo dīrghaḥ kālo'syeni vigraho na ghaṭeta| ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti| anyathānantarasya yato'nuvṛttirāśaṅkyeta ||

prayojanam || 5.1.109 ||
prayujyate'neneti prayojanam, karaṇe lyuṭ| kiṃ punastatphalam ? yathāhuḥ--yamarthamadhikṛtya pravartate tatprayojanamiti| indramahaḥ-indrotsavaḥ ||

viśākhāṣāḍhādaṇmanthadaṇyoḥ || 5.1.110 ||
viśākhā prayojanamasyeti| viśākhāṣāḍhaśabdau rūḍhirūpeṇa manthadaṇḍayorvartete, tayoryathākañcidvyutpattiḥ kriyate| manthaḥ-viloḍanadaṇḍaḥ| āṣāḍhaḥ-vratīnāṃ daṇḍaḥ|
śraddhā prayojanamasyeti| atra karaṇaṃ prayojanam ||
anupravacanādibhyaśchaḥ || 5.1.111 ||
viśipūrītyādi| viśa praveśane', `pūrī apyāyane', `pallṛ gatau' `ruha bījajanmani'--etāḥ prakṛtayo yasyānasya `yuvoranākau' iti vihitasya tasmādvidyamānapūrvapadāccha upasaṃkhyeyaḥ, kevalasyānasya sapūrvapadatvāsambhavatsāmarthyāttadantagrahaṇam| gṛhapraveśanīyamiti| evaṃ cānupravacanādiṣu saṃveśanānuprarvaśānānvārohaṇaśabdānāṃ prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| svargyamiti| ṭhañi prāpte yadvidhiḥ| puṇyāhavācanādibhya iti| sāhacaryādabhidhāne siddhe bhedavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaśravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi lugvacanam ||

aikāgārikaṭ caure || 5.1.113 ||
ekāgāraṃ prayojanamasyeti| ekaśabdo'sahāyavacanaḥ, asahāyaṃ hi gṛhaṃ mumūṣiṣataścorasya prayojanam| sasahāye tu gṛhe moṣituṃ na śaktate| ekāgāraṃ prayojanamasya bhikṣoriti| `ekāgāraṃ cared bhaikṣyaṃ tatpurāṇamunervratam' iti śāstrādekāmeva yo bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇāti na dvitīyāṃ sa evamucyate| nanvevamapyekāgārāccore ṭhañeva niyamārthaṃ vaktavyaḥ, kiṃ nipātanena, ṭakāreṇa vā prayojanam ? ata āha--ṭakāraḥ kāryāvadhāraṇārtha iti| avadhāraṇameva darśayati--ṅībeva bhavati, na ñitsvara iti| vṛddhaistu nipātanādbhavatyeva| nanvevaṃ ñitsvaranivṛttireva nipātanasya| mā bhūdvā niyamaḥ; bhikṣau kasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt|
yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā ñitsvara eveṣyate| tatra hi sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātm-`ekāgārānnipātanānarthakyaṃ ṭhañprakaraṇāt' iti, prayojanamityatra ṭhañaprakṛtaḥ, tenaivaikāgārikaśabdaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ| ikṭpratyayamiti| idamapi pratyākhyānena viruddham ||

ākālikakaḍādyantavacane || 5.1.114 ||
ākālikakaḍiti nipātye iti| samudāyaviṣayamuktavā tatraiva vibhajya nipātanaṃ darśayati--samānakālaśabdasyetyādi| sarveṣāmeva vākyānāṃ nipātyata iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva sambandhaḥ| ādyantayoścaitadviśeṣaṇamiti| etatsamānakālatvamādyantayorviśeṣaṇaṃ nipātyate `ādyantavacane' iti sūtre śrutatvādityarthaḥ| ikaṭ ca pratyaya iti| kvārthe? asyetyadhikārātṣaṣṭhyarthe| tadāha--samānakālāvādyantāvasyeti| samānakālau ekakālāvityarthaḥ| ādiḥ-janma, antaḥ-vināśaḥ, na cotpādavināśayorekakālatvasambhava ityavyavahitakālatvemekakālatvam| nirantare hi kāle bhedāgrahaṇātsa eva kāla iti bhavati pratipattiḥ| tadāha--utpannānantaraṃ vināśītyartha iti |
ākālāṭṭham̐śceti| vāktikakāro manyate| na samānakālaśabdasyākālaśabda ādeśo nipātyaḥ, nāpīkaṭ pratyayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? ākālāṭṭhaṃśceti sūtraṃ karttavyam| cakāraḥ prakṛtasyaiva ṭhañaḥ samucyāyārthaḥ| kimidamākālāditi ? āvṛtaḥ kālo'syetyākālaḥ| na ca kālasyāvṛttiḥ sambhavatītyayamartho bhavati-utpattikālena samāno nirantaro yasya vināśakāla iti| evaṃ hyutpattikāla eva vināśo'syāvṛtta iti bhavati pratyayaḥ| tataḥ svārthe ṭhanvidheya ādyantavacane viṣaya iti| tatra ṭhañpakṣe ṅībādyudāttatvaṃ ca bhavati, pratyayāntaranipātane tu nādyudāttatvaṃ siddhayati, tadāha--`ākālanipātanānarthakyaṃ ṭhañprakaraṇā diti|
vṛttikārastu ṭhakāroccāraṇātpratyayāntarasyaiva nipātanaṃ manyamāno ñitsvaraṃ necchati, tanmate nipātanāpekṣayāṃ samuccayārthaścaśabdaḥ, nipātanaṃ ca karttavyam| ākālaśabdācca ṭhanapi vidheya iti| ākālaśabdasya cokta evārthaḥ svārthikaśca ṭhan| ādyantaviṣayā cāvṛttakālatā|
apara āha--āvṛttaḥ kāla iti tatpuruṣo'yam, tato'syetyadhikārāt ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyaya iti| sarvathā tipātanasya ṭhanaścaika evārthaḥ--samānakālāvādyantāvasyeti|
anye varṇayanti--yeṣāṃ varṣādīnāṃ yasminneva kāle madhyahnādāvutpattiḥ, tasminneva dvitīyadivasasambhandhini vināśaśca tānyākālikāni, tasmātkālādanuvarttanta iti kṛtvā| teṣāṃ hyadyantayoreka eva kālo bhavati madhyāṅnādiriti ||

tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ || 5.1.115 ||
yattattulyaṃ kriyā cetsā bhavatīti| etena samānavibhaktikatvātprādhānyācca prtyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇamiti darśayati| nirdeśānurodhe tu prathamanirdiṣṭasya prakṛtyarthasya viśeṣaṇe bhinnavibhaktikatvādvākyaśeṣe'dhyāhāryaḥ syāt--yattat tṛtīyāsamarthaṃ kriyā cetsā bhavatīti| tulyamitye tacca prathamāntam, na kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena yadāha--tulyamityetasminnarthe iti| tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| sāmānyopakramatvāttu `hitaṃ bhakṣāḥ' itivattulyamiti napuṃsakanirddeśaḥ| brāhṇaṇena tulyaṃ varttata iti| nanu brāhmaṇaśabdena jātirdravyaṃ vocyeta, na tābhyāṃ kriyāyāstulyatvam; atyantabhedāt| yatra tu kiñcitsāmānyam, kaścicca viśeṣaḥ, sa eva viṣayastulyatāyāḥ| syādetat--brāhmaṇasahacaritāyāmadhyayanīdikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇaśabdasya vṛttiḥ- brāhṇaṇena tulyaṃ vartate, ko'rthaḥ ? yathā vrāhṇaṇo varttate tathā varttata ityarthaḥ| varttanam -adhyayanādikriyānuṣṭānam, tena yuktameva tulyatvamiti| evamapi mukhye sanbhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| kaḥ punarmukhyaḥ ? kriyāvācī| pacatyādīnāṃ tāvatkriyāvācināmaprātipadikatvādasattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvācca tṛtīyāsamarthatvaṃ na sambhavati| avyayakṛtānāṃ tu--kṛtvā, hṛtvā, kartum, hartumityevamādīnāṃ yadyapi kriyāvācitvam, yathā pañaacakṛtvaḥ kṛtveti kṛtvo'rthotpattirbhivati; tathāpyasattvabhūtārthābhidhāyitvāttatīyāntatvābhāvaḥ ghañādayaśca dātvarthasya siddhatāyāṃ bhavantaḥ sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyino na kriyāvacanāḥ. ata eva hi tatra kṛtvo'rthapratyayābhāvaḥ| na hi bhavati pañcakṛtvaḥ pāka iti, bhavati tu pañcapākā iti| yathā pañcaghaṭā iti bhavati, na tu bhavati pañcakṛtvo ghaṭa iti| bhoktuṃ pāka ityādau dhātuvācyakriyopekṣastumunpratyayaḥ| ghṛtapākena tulyastailapāka ityādirapi viṣayo na bhavati|
nanu pañcakṛtvaḥ śayitavyamiti kṛtvasuco devanācchayitavyādayaḥ kriyāvacanāḥ, tataḥ kim ? rājaśayitavyena tulyaṃ devadattaśayitavyamityādiravakāśaḥ syat, tatā skhathātavyena tulyaṃ gamanaṃ mandatvāt, tathā nartitavyena tulyaṃ gamanaṃ vahuvikāratvāditi, tatā bhokagtuṃ pāka ityādau yathā prakṛtivācyakriyāpekṣastumun bhavati, tathā dhṛtapākena tulyastailapāka ityadau vatirapi syāditi so'pyavakāśaḥ; tadevaṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe'pi kriyāgrahaṇe sāmarthyātprakṛtyartho'pi kriyaiva bhavati, na hyakriyayā kriyā tulyā bhavatīti kriyāvācibhya eva vatinā bhavitavyaṃ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇe sutarāmiti kathaṃ kleśena kriyāyāṃ vartitebhyastebhyo brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ ? ucyate; yenopamīyate, yaśyopamīyate, yaśca tayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ-- ettrayamapyapekṣyopamānopameyabhāvaḥ pravarttate| tatra yadā kriyopamānatvena vivakṣyate, tadā sāvaśyāpekṣyasādhāraṇadharmādhāratvātkriyārūpātāṃ hitvā sattvarūpatāṃ prapadyate, tataśca sāmarthyād bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇam--yasyārthasya kriyārūpatāpūrvamabhūt samprati kriyāऱūpātikrameṇa sattvabhāvāpanno'pi tṛtīyāntavācyaḥ parigṛhyate| tadevaṃ samprati mukhyakriyāvācyasambhavād bhūtapūrvakriyārūpārthavācinaḥ śayitavyādayo'pi gauṇā eva| gauṇaṃ ca kriyāvācitvaṃ brāha ṇādīnāmapi sambhavatīti tebhyo'pi bhavati pratyayaḥ| teṣāṃ tu na kasyāñcidapi daśāyāṃ mukhyakriyāvācitvamityetāvām̐stu viśeṣaḥ| yadi tarhi kriyayostulyatvale pratyayaḥ brāhmaṇādhyayanena tulyamadhyayanaṃ karoti brāhmaṇavadadhīta ityanyaḥ sādhāraṇo dharmo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ syāt| tasmād dravyayoreva tulyatve pratyayaḥ, kriyā tu sādhāraṇo dharma iti yuktam| na yuktam; evaṃ hi yathā brāhmaṇena tulyaḥ kṣattriyo'dhyayaneneti, dravyasya liṅgasaṃkhyāyogitvāt| svarādiṣu pāṭhādbhaviṣyati ? ihapi tarhi prāpnoti-upasargocchandasi dhātvarthe ya udvato nivato yāsi|
kiñca pāṭhādbhavatu saṃjñā, liṅgasaṃkhyākārakaśaktiyogastu kena vāryate--svaḥ paśyetyādivat ! laukike ca prayoge kriyayoreva sādṛśyaṃ pratīyate, na tadvatorderavyayoḥ| yatpunaruktam--sādhāraṇo dharmo'pekṣaṇīyaḥ syāditi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; candra iva mukhamasyā ityādau yathā śabdānupāttā api kāntyādayaḥ pratīyante, tathātrāpi sauṣṭhavādayaḥ pratyeṣyante| tasmātsuṣṭhūktam--yattatulyaṃ kriyā cetsā bhavatīti| guṇatulya iti| guṇaistulya iti ? `pūrvasadṛśa' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| putreṇa tulyaḥ syūla iti| putrasya yādṛśaṃ sthaulyaṃ piturapi tādṛśamityarthaḥ ||

tatra tasyeva || 5.1.116 ||
kimarthamidamucyate na pūrveṇaiva siddham, na siddhayati, tṛtīyāsamarthāttatra pratyayaḥ, iha tu saptamīṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt ? evaṃ tarhi tulyārthairiti yā tṛtīyā tayevaśabdayoge sarve vibhaktayarthā vyāptāḥ, tadyathā--brāhṇaṇa ivādhīte, brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte; brāhmaṇamiva paśyati, brāhṇena tulyaṃ paśyati; brāhmaṇaenevādhītam, brāhmaṇena tulyamadhītam; brāhmaṇāyeva dadāti, brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ dadāti; brāhmaṇādivādhīte, brāhmaṇena tulyamadhīte; brāhmaṇasyeva kṣattriyasya svam, brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ kṣattriyasya svam; brāhṇa iva kṣattriye varttate, brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ kṣattriye varttata iti--tataśca tṛtīyāntadeva pūrvasūtreṇa pratyayo bhaviṣyati| tathā ca `pūrvavatsanaḥ' iti pañcamyantādvatirdṛśyate| evamapi na siddhayati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? pūrvatra kriyātulyatve pratyayaḥ, taccāvaśyaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, gavā tulyo gavaya ityādau mā bhūdityevaramarthaḥ; tataśca dravyaguṇayostulyatve vatirna syāditi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamayantādivārthe'nena vidhīyate ||

tadarham || 5.1.117 ||
taditi dvitīyāsamarthāditi| arhaśabdaḥ pacādyajantastadyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam, nipātanāttu dvitīyā| apara āha--vigrahavākyābhiprāyametat; yadā rājānamarhatītyevaṃ tihntena vigrahyate tadā dvitīyā samarthamiti| sūtre tvarhamiti karmopapadādacpratyayaḥ kṛta iti| iha kriyāgrahaṇamanuvarttate--yattadarha kriyā cetsā bhavatīti, rājānamarhati vṛttaṃ rājavadvarttate, iha na bhavati--rājānamarhati chattram, vrāhmaṇamarhati dadhīti| yadyevam, rājñā tulyaṃ vartate iti vigrahāśrayaṇena pūrveṇaiva vatiḥ siddhaḥ ? iha tarhi rājavadvarttate rājeti bhedābhāvena tannibandhanasya sādṛśyasyābhāvādaprāpto vatiranena vidhīyate| atrāpi rājatvena ye prasiddā bharatādayasta upamānānīdānīntanānāmiti siddho vatiḥ| yadā tarhi rājaśabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ prasiddhaviśeṣaviṣayo vā--rājavadayaṃ varttate bharata iti, tadā sādṛśyābhāvādaprāptiḥ| vinītavadupasyitaṃ ciccheda kṛtahastavaditi vinītānāmidaṃ yogyamupasthānam kṛtahastānāmidaṃ yogyaṃ chedana miti gamyate, na tu sādṛśyam| uktaṃ ca--
`yuktamaupayikaṃ rājña ityarthasya nidarśanam|
upamānavivakṣāyāṃ tadarhamiti paṭhyate ' || iti |
yadā tvekameva vastu avasthābhedaparikalpitabhedamupamānopameyatvena vivakṣyate, tadā nārtho'nena| tathā cevaśabdasya prayogo dṛśyate--rājevāyaṃ rājā yudhyate, vaiyyākaraṇa iva vaityākaraṇo brūte, rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoriveti| uktam----
`tadarhamiti nārabdhaṃ sūtraṃ vyākarṇāntare|
sambhavatyupamātrāpi bhedasya parikalpanāt' || iti |

upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe || 5.1.118 ||
sasādhane dhātvarthe iti| kriyāmātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ, statkathaṃ sasādhana iti labhyate ? ucyate; ihārthagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, dhātāvityeva siddham, kathaṃ punardhātau nāmopasargo varteta, śabde śabdāsambhavāt ? arthe vṛttirvijñāsyate| tathā--dhātusambandhe' ityatra tat kriyate bahuvrīhiryathā vijñāyeta--dhāturdhātvarthaḥ kriyā, arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sādhanasya tasminvarttamānāditi| `sasādhane dhātvarthe' atyasyāpyayamevārthaḥ---dhātvarthaviśiṣṭe sādhana iti, na punaḥ sādhanaviśiṣṭe dhātvartha iti| upasargāśca punarevamātmakāḥ yaduta śrutāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tāmeva viśiṃṣanti, yathā--āgacchatīti| yatra tu na śrūyate tatra kriyāviśiṣṭaṃ sādhanamāhuḥ---niṣkauśāmbiriti, tatra yatra kriyā na śrūyate tatra yathā syādityevamarthaṃ dhātvartha ityuktam| udgatāni nigatānīti| vanānāṃ viśeṣyatvānnapuṃsakatvam| udvato nivata iti tu chāndasaṃ puṃstvamiti manyate| yaccāsmābhiruktam-- `kriyā guṇabhūtā sādhanaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ tatropasargasya vṛttiḥ' iti tadapyatena darśaitm| sādhanaśabdena śaktimad dravyamucyate,na śaktimātramiti liṅgasaṅkhyāyogādanvarthāvyayasaṃjñā na bhavati ||

tasya bhāvastvatalau || `tasyedam' ityasyāpavādo'yam| bhāvaśabdo'yam `bhavateśceti vaktavyam' iti ṇapratyayānto'styevābhiprāye, yathā--athaṃ bhāvaḥ' iti; asti ca padārthamātravacanaḥ,--`vicitrā hi bhāvaśaktayaḥ' iti; asti ca śrṛṅgārādiṣu--stāyībhāvaḥ sañcārībhāva iti; ghañantastu bhavatyarthe kartṛvarjite ca kārake varttate| bhavatiścānekārthaḥ, tadyathā--`tatra bhavaḥ' iti sattārthaḥ; `dhānyānāṃ bhavane' ityutpattyarthaḥ; `itthambhūte' iti prāptyarthaḥ; `bhūṣṇurbhūtikāmaḥ' iti samṛddhyarthaḥ; `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' ityādau dhātvarthamātravacanaḥ; vṛttikāropadarśitaścāparaḥ, tataśca `tasya bhāvaḥ' ityabhiprāyādiṣvatpirasaṅgaḥ? ityata āhabhavato'smādityādi| yasmād gotvāderhetorgavādau gaurityevamādikamabhidhānaṃ pravarttate, gaurgaurityevamādiścābhinnākāraḥ pratyayo bhavati, so'rtho gavādeḥ śabdasya pravṛttinimittamiha bhāvaśabdenocyate|
tatra bhavato'smādityarthapradarśanametat, na tu hetau kenacid ghañvavihaḥ| tasmāt `śriṇībhuvo'nupasarge' iti karaṇe ghañ draṣṭavyaḥ| abhiprāyādīnāṃ cānabhidhānānna grahaṇam| uktaṃ ca---`yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau' iti| gueṇaśabdena yāvānkaścitparāśrayo bhedako jātyādirarthaḥ sa sarva iha gṛhyate| `yasya bhāvāt' ityetāvatyucyamāne putrasya bhāvātpitṛśabdasya niveśa iti pitatvamiti putre pratyayaḥ syāt, putratvamiti ca pitarīti guṇagrahaṇam; bhāvād vidyamānatvāt| dvavyamiti viśeṣyabhūtaḥ sattvabhāvāpanno'rta ucyate, tasmin śabdaniveśaḥ-śabdasya pravṛttiḥ, satvatalorabhidheya ityarthaḥ| tatra ye rūpādayaḥ śabdā guṇamātravṛttayastebhyo guṇasamavāyini sāmānyaviśeṣe bhāvapratyayo rūpatvamiti| ye tu śuklādayo guṇaguṇivṛttayo guṇaguṇinorabedopacārāt, matublopādvā, tebhyo guṇavṛttibhyo guṇasamavāyini sānānye bhāvapratyayaḥ; guṇivṛttibyastu guṇe| aṇumahaddīrghadayo nityaṃ parimāṇini varttante, tebhyaḥ parimāṇo guṇe bhāvapratyayaḥ, ṣatvaṃ ṇatvamiti bhinnavarṇavyaktisamavete sāmānyaviśeṣe pratyayaḥ| gavādayo yadā jātimātravācinastadā tebhyaḥ śabdasvarūpe pratyayaḥ, tathā hayarthe jātau śabdasvarūpamadhyasyate--yo gośabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti| śabdasvarūpameva tatra pravṛttinimittam, nānyat| dravyavācibhyastu gavādibhyo jātau pratyayaḥ, samāsakṛttaddhitāstu yadyapi kevalaṃ sambandhaṃ nābhidadhati, tathāpi sambandhini varttamānāḥ sambandhaṃ pravṛttinimittamapekṣanta iti tebhyaḥ sambandhe bhāvapratyayaḥ| tathā ca rājapuruṣatvamiti svasvāmibhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ pratīyate, pācakatvamiti kriyākārakasambandhaḥ, aupagavatvamityādāvapatyāpatsisambandhaḥ|
kecidaupagavatvamityapatyapratyayasya jātimabhidheyāmicchanti; tanmate, arthāntaravṛttistaddhaita udāhāryaḥ--`samāsakṛttiddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānamanyatra rūḍhyabhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ' iti, rūḍhiśabdā gaurakharasaptaparṇalohitaśālyādayo jātiviśeṣāvacchinnadravyavācina iti tebhyo jātāveva bhāvapratyayaḥ| evaṃ kumbhakāratvam, hastitvamiti abhinnarūpāḥ| śuklādayo matuvluki vijñāyamāne yadyapi taddhitāntāḥ, tathāpi tebhyo bhāvapratyayo guṇa eva bhavati; na tu sambandhe guṇaguṇinorjātitadvatoriva so'yamityabhisambandhena lokanirūḍhena bhedasambandhasya nyagbhāvāt| `guṇavacanebhyo luk' iti lugvidhānadvāreṇābedenaiva guṇināmabhidhānam, na tu bedāśrayā matvarthīyotpattirityākhyāyate| avyabhicāri sambhandhāt sato bhāvaḥ satteti jātāveva bhāvapratyayaḥ| na hi sadvastu sattāsambandhaṃ vyabhicaratīti sattāsambandhānapekṣaṇād na sambandhe pratyayaḥ| rājapuruṣayostu sambandhasya kādacitkatvāttadapekṣo rājapuruṣaśabdaḥ svārthamabhidhatte iti tataḥ sambhande pratyayo yuktaḥ| tasmātsatsu padārtheṣu nityasamavāyini śabdapravṛttihetuḥ sattaiva bhāvapratyayavācyā, na tu satsattyoḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyākhyaḥ| dhavakhadiratvamiti jātidvandvājjātisamudāyaḥ kutvamityādau saṃjñāsvarūpe saṃjñiṣvadhyaste pratyayaḥ| anye tu `saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaḥ' ityāhuḥ| uktaṃ ca----
jātiguṇājjātiguṇe samāsakṛttadvitācca sambandhe|
ḍitthādeḥ sve rūpe dhavakhadirājjātisaṅghāte || iti |
iha tu nānātvam, sahatvam, yaugapadyamityādau vṛttiviṣaye nānāśabdo'sahabhūte'rthe vartate, sahaśabdaśca sahabhūte, yugapacchaśabdo'pi yugapadbhūte, tato'sahabhāvādau bhāvapratyayaḥ| evamanyatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyam| iha na brāhmaṇasya bhāva iti kayugapadbhāvena nañarthena ca sambandhe vivakṣite pūrvaṃ nañsamāsaḥ, paścāttvatalau, tenābrāhmaṇatvamabrāhmaṇateti satiśiṣṭatvāttvapratyaye nañsamāsaḥ, paścāttvatalau tenābrāhmaṇatvaṃ bhavati, nāvyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvam| nanu parattāvattvatalau prāpnutaḥ, na vā sāpekṣatvādbrāṇārtho yatra nañarthamapekṣate| nañsamāṃso'pi tarhi na prāpnoti, brāhmaṇasya bhāvapekṣatvāt ? naivam; pradhānamatra brāhmaṇapadam, uttarapadārthapradhāno hi nañsamāsaḥ| bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ, yathā--rājapuruṣo'bhirūpa iti| `vā chandasi' chandasi viṣaye kvacitpūrvaṃ tvatalau paścānnañsamāsaḥ--ayonitvāya, aśithilatvāya| atra nañsvara eva bhavati, kvicidviparyayaḥ| tvatalvyatirikte bhāvapratyayo pūrvaṃ sa eveṣyate, paścānnañsamāsaḥ, tenāprathimetyādau sati siṣṭatvānnañsvara eva bhavati| aśauklyamityādau ca nañaḥ prakṛtāvanantarbhāvācchuklaśabdādau vṛddhiḥ pūrva nañsamāse `na nañpūrvāt' iti pratiṣedhāt ṣyañeca na syāt, satyapi vā ṣyañi naño vaddhaiḥ syāt ? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ yuvādiṣu puruṣāse, hṛdayāme iti nañsamāse viṣayabhūte bhāvapratyayapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--tvatalāpavādapratyayo nañarthāpekṣādapi paratvānnañsamāsaṃ bādhitvā bhavatīti ||

ā ca tvāt || 5.1.120 ||
prathimeti| `turiṣṭhemeyassu' `ṭeḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ, `raṛto halāderlaghoḥ' iti ṛkārasya rādeśaḥ| pārthavamiti| `igantācca laghupūrvāt' ityaṇ|
apavādairityādi| imanijādīṃstvatalorapavādānvakṣyati, taiḥ saha samāveśo yathā syādityevamarthamidam| nanu svaritatvādeva tvatalāvanuvarttiṣyete tenāpavādaviṣaye bhaviṣyataḥ ? tanna; ita uttaravākyānāṃ pratyayanirddeśena nirākāṃkṣatvāttvatalorapi pūrvasūtre vidhānādākāṃkṣāyā abhāvānnaitacchakyaṃ vijñātum-anuvarttete tvatalāviti| karmaṇi ca vidhānārāthamiti| yebhya eva karmaṇi ṣyañādividhistebhya eva tvatalāvapi karmaṇi bhavataḥ, na tu ṅayāpprātipadikamātrāt| cakāro nañasnañbyāmapi samāveśārtha iti| anyathā `strīpuṃsābhyām' ityasya vidhitvapakṣe prāgbhavanādye'rthāstānapekṣya tatraiva pradeśe nañsnañorvidhānādatra prakaraṇe sannidhānābhāvānnemanijādivatsamāveśasiddhiḥ| paribhāṣātve'pi yathoddeśapakṣe `strīpuṃsābhyām' ityatraiva prakaraṇe nañsnañoḥ sannidhiḥ| na punarimanijādimadhye kāryakālapakṣe'pi prāgbhavanādye'rthāḥ, tatra nañsnañbhyāmupasthātavyam| tatra yadi tāvadbhāve ityarthavijñānamātra eva nañsnañorupasthānam--`tasya bhāvastvatalau' `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ bhāve nañsnañau' iti, tadasminpradeśe sannidhāne'pi `ā ca tvāt' ityasmātpūrvai bhavataḥ| atha tūtsargāpādavidhānopayogavijñānānantaraṃ nañsnavyorupasthānam, tadā brahmaṇastva ityasmātparau nañasnañau bhavataḥ| sarvathā `ā ca tvāt' ityasminpradeśe nābhyantarau| `guṇapacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ kamaṇi ca' ityatra karmaṇi nañsnañorupasthānaṃ nāśaṅnīyam; prakṛtiviseṣasambaddhasya karmārthasyopādānāt prakṛtyantareṇa tasyāsambandhāt| adhikārapakṣe tu pratisūtramupasthānānnañsnañorimanijādiṣvantarbhāvād `ā ca tvāt' ityeva nañsnañbhyāmapi samāveśaḥ sidhyati| atha tatrāpyarthasyaivāvadhitvādartheṣvevopasthānam, tato'dhikārapakṣe'pi nābhyantaratvamiti sarvathā cakāreṇaiva nañsnañbhyāṃ samāveśo vācyaḥ ||

na nañpūrvāttatpuruṣādacaturasaṅgatalavaṇavaṭacabudhakatarasalasebhyaḥ || 5.1.121 ||
`anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti tvatalorayaṃ pratiṣedha iti bhrānti vārayati| ita uttare ye pratyayā iti| etacca `ā ca tvāt' iti sambandhāllabhyate| caturādīnīti| caturādyantām̐statpuruṣānnañpūrvānityarthaḥ| nanu `pṛthvādibhya imanijvā' ityādibhiḥ pariṇaṇitābhyaḥ prakṛtibhya uttaro bāvapratyayo vidhīyate| na ca tatra kācinnañpūrvā prakṛtirgṛhyate| tadantavidhiśca grahaṇavatā prātipadikena pratiṣidhdhaḥ| yatra tarhi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nāsti patyantādyagbhavati, hāyanāntādaṇ bhavati, `igantācca laghupūrvāt', `yopadādgurupottamādvuñ' iti, tatra nañpūrvāttatpuruṣādastyeva prasaṅgastaddarśayati--vakṣyati patyanta purohitādibhyo yagiti| apatitvamapatiteti| tattu `ā ca tvāt' ityadhikāra ityuktam, tataśca patyantetyanenaiva tvatalorapyadhikṛtayovidhānam| tataḥ kim ? yaka iva tvatalorapyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| astvevamadhikṛtayo stvataloḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, `tasya bhāvaḥ' ityanena punastvatalau bhaviṣyataḥ; bādhakābhāvāt| yadi patyantādipvevāsyopayogaḥ, patyantetyasyaiva purastādidaṃ paṭhitavyam, tadevottaratrāpyanuvarttiṣyate| evaṃ tarhtra pradeśe pratiṣedhādhikārasyopādānādimanijādīnāmapi pratiṣedo vijñāyate| nanu coktam--`tadantavidhyabhāvādaprasaṅgaḥ' iti ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-astyuttaratra tadantavidhirita| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam ? nañpūrvādbahuvrīheranyapūrvācca tatpuruṣātpṛthvādyantādimanijādiḥ siddho bhavati--na vidyante pṛthvo yasya apṛthuḥ, paramapṛthuḥ, tasya bhāva iti| nātromanijādiriṣyate, ata eva vṛttikāreṇāpi nāsya paṭavaḥ santītyapaṭurityādi vyāvartya darśitam, tasmādihāsya karaṇe prayojanaṃ cintyam| ācaturyamityādau brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ ||

pṛthvādibhya imanijvā || 5.1.122 ||
vāvacanamaṇīdisamāveśārthamiti| iha ye igantā laghupūrvāḥ pṛthumṛduprabhṛtayasteṣvaṇaḥ samāveśaḥ| caṇḍakhaṇkaḍādiṣu guṇavacaneṣu ṣyañaḥ, bālavatsādiṣu vayovacanalakṣaṇasyāñaḥ| tvatalostu masāveśaḥ `ā ca tvāt' ityeva siddhaḥ ? ityāha--tvatalau tu sarvatra bhavata eveti ||

varṇadṛḍhādibhtayaḥ ṣyañ ca || 5.1.123 ||
varṇaviśeṣavācibhya iti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati| yadi syād, dṛḍhādiṣveva varṇaśabdaṃ paṭhet| varṇaśabdaśca rūpasya vācako na brāhmaṇādīnām; dṛḍhādibhirguṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt| ata eva sāhacaryādvarṇagrahaṇātparyāyāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| katham ? dṛḍhāyayo hi guṇopasarjane dravye varttante, atastatsāhacaryādvarṇaśabdā api tādṛśā eva gṛhyante| evañca varṇadṛḍhādīnāṃ guṇavacanatvādeva siddhe punarvacanamanijartham |
aucitī, yāthākāmiti| brāhmaṇaāderākṛtigaṇatvātṣyañ, ṅīṣ, `halastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ|
veryātalābhamatimanaḥśāradānāmiti| visabdāduttare ye yātādayastadantānāṃ samāsānāmanantaraḥ ṣyañ bhavatītyarthaḥ| viyātatvam, viyātatā, viyātimā, vaiyātyam| vilābhatvam, vilābhavatā, vilābhimā, vailābhyam| vimatitvam, vimatitā, vimatimā, vaimaṣyam; igantatvādaṇapi bhavati, vaimatam,| vimanastvam, vimanastā, vimanimā, vaimanasyam| viśāradatvam, viśāradatā, viśāradimā, vaiśāradyam, samo matimanasoriti| sama uttare ye matimanasī tayoḥ samāsayoranantaraḥ ṣyañ--saṃmatitvam, saṃmatitā, saṃmatimā, sāmmatyam; pūrvavadaṇsāṃmatam| saṃmanastvam, saṃmanastā, saṃmanimā, sāṃmanasyam ||

guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca || 5.1.124 ||
karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacana iti| na sādhanakarmavacanaḥ; kriyāyā hi sādhanaṃ sambhavati| sattvaśabdāśca guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādayaḥ, atasteṣāṃ nāsti sādhanakarmaṇā sambandhaḥ| kriyā tvātmalābhaya tairyajyate| kathaṃ tarhi kaveḥ karma kāvyam, na hi tatra kriyābhidhīyate, kiṃ karhi, tatkṛto granthaḥ ? atrāhuḥ--kriyākarmaṇyeva pratyayavidhānam, aupacārikastu tatkṛte prayoga iti| apara āha--sūtre yaḥ karmaśabdo yaśca vṛttau kriyāśabdaḥ, tadubhayamapi karmasādhanaṃ karma, kriyākāryamityarthaḥ, tena kṛtivyāpye sādhanakarmaṇyeva pratyaya iti| bhāhmaṇādirakṛtigaṇa iti avṛtkṛtatvāt| etadevopapādayati--ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacana iti|
kimarthaṃ tarhi guṇavacanagrarahaṇam, brāhmaṇādīnāṃ cānukramaṇam ? keṣāñcitprapañcārtham; keṣāñcitsvārthe pratyayavidhānārtham, keṣāñcid vādhakabādhanārtham| tatra brāhṇamaśabdātprāṇabhṛjjātilakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte, `māṇavavāḍavābhyāṃ gotralakṣaṇe' vuñi| `arhato num ca' iti numarthaḥka pāṭhaḥ; `arhaḥ prāśaṃsāyām' iti śatṛpratyayaḥ--ārhantyam| coradhūrtayormanojñāditvādvuñiprāpte so'pi bhavatyeva| ārādhyādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ janapadavācitvādañi kṛte, tasya ca `kambojādibhyo lugvavacanam' iti luki gotravuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ| ekabhāvādīnāmanyabhāvaparyantānāṃ svārthe vidhānārtham| tathā ca vārttike prayogaḥ--`ānyabhāvyaṃ tu kālaśabdavyavāyāt' iti| akṣetrajñānīśvaraśabdayoḥ `na nañpūrvāt' iti niṣedhe prāpte, kuśalādīnāṃ yuvāditvādami prāpte, bāliśaśabdādvayolakṣaṇo'ñi prāpte, rājaśabdasya purohitāditvādyaki prāpte, gaṇapatyadhipatyoḥ patyantalakṣaṇe yaki| śeṣāṇāmalasādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ prapañcārthaḥ|
sarvavaledādibhyaḥ svārthe iti| sarve vedāḥ sarvavedāḥ, pūrvakāloti samāsaḥ, sarvavedānadhīt ityaṇ, `sarvasāderddhigośca laḥ' iti luk, sarvaveda eva sārvavedyaḥ| caturvedasyobhayapadavṛddhiśceti| caturo vedānadhīte iti taddhitārthe dviguḥ, aṇo luk, caturveda eva cāturvaidyaḥ| kvacittu cāturvaidyasyeti pāṭhaḥ, tatra siddhaya iti śeṣaḥ, catasro vidyā adhīta ityādi ṣūrvavad vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāditi ṭhak, pūrvavalluk, caturvidhya eva cāturvaidyaḥ ||

stenādyannalopaśca || 5.1.125 ||
`stena caurye', pacādyattu, stenaḥ| naśabdasyeti| etena saṅghātasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayati| varṇagrahaṇe tu nakāralope kṛte'kārasya yasyeti lopaḥ| tasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvādayādeśaḥ prāpnoti| nanu sahghātagrahaṇe'pi `allo'ntyasya' ityantyasya prāpnoti ? siddho'ntyalopaḥ `yasyeti ca' iti; tatrārambhasāmarthyātsarvasya bhaviṣyati, `nānarthake'lontyavidhiranabhyāsavikāreṣu' iti ca paribhāṣāṃ paṭhanti| stenāditi yogavibhāgaṃ kurvantīti| bhāgye'nuktamapi stainyaśabdasya prayogabāhulyādidamuktam ||

kapijñātyorḍhak || 5.1.126 ||
iha kapijñātī dvau, bhāvakarmaṇī cārthau dvāveveti saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ prāpnoti, evam `patyantapurohitādibhyo yak', `hāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ' ityatretyāśaṅkayāha--yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prakaraṇe neṣyata iti| tadarthasya svaritatvasyāpratijñānāditi bhāvaḥ ||

patyantapurohitādibhyo yak || 5.1.127 ||
rājāsa yiti| rājaśabdo'se'samāse yakamutpādayati--rājño bhāvaḥ karma vā rājyam| `ase' iti kim? ādhirājyam, brāhmaṇāditvalātyañ| yadyapi tatra rājaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tathāpyayamevāsa iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati--`astyatra rājaśabde tadantavidhiḥ' iti| evaṃ ca brāhmaṇādipāṭhasya samāse caritārthatvādasamāse viśeṣavihito yageva bhavati|
apara āha--`brāhmaṇāderākṛtigaṇatvādeva tadantāt ṣyañi siddhe rājaśabdasya tatra pāṭho yakā saha samāveśārthaḥ' iti, tathā cāveṣṭyadhikaraṇe śābarabāṣye uktam--`tasya karmaṇi ṣyañ' iti ||

prāṇamṛjjātivayovacanodgātrādibhyo'ñ || prāṇabhṛtaḥ-prāṇinaḥ, prāṇigrahaṇameva na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham| prāṇabhṛdgrahaṇāttṛṇatvaṃ tṛṇatetyādau na bhavati, jātigrahaṇāddevadattatvamityādau na bhavati| yattvihegantaṃ laghupūrvaṃ tasmātparatvādaṇ bhavati--taittiram| udgātrādiṣu ya ṛtvigvacanāstebhyaḥ `hotrābyaśchaḥ' iti che prāpde'ñ cavidhīyate| suṣṭhuduṣṭhubhyāṃ guṇavacanalakṣṇe ṣyañi, vadhūśabdādigantalakṣaṇe'ṇi, śeṣebhyastvataloḥ prāptayoḥ| subhagaṃ mantre iti| subhagamityetacchabdarūpaṃ mantraviṣaye prayoge'ñamutpādayati--`mahate saubhagāya', sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpitatvāt `hṛdbhagasindhvanta' ityuttarapadavṛddhirna bhavati| ata eva mantre kvacidañ na bhavati--saubhāgyamasyai datvāya ||

hāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ || hāyanāntāttvataloḥ prāptayoraṇvidhānam| yauvanamiti| `an' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ, manojñāditvadvuñapi bhavati| sthaviraśabdasya vayolakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ, hotṛśabdasyāpyudgātrāditvādañyeva| puruṣāsa iti| puruṣaśabdo'samāse'ṇamutpādayati, pauruṣam, prāṇabhṛjjātivācitvādañ prāptaḥ, manuṣyajātivacano hrasau na puṃsśabdaparyāyaḥ puṃlliṅgavacanaḥ; striyāmapi daśanāt--tasyāmasyāṃ ca puruṣīśca dhenuke dadyariti| asa iti kim? rājapuruṣatvam| kamaṇḍaluśabdasyegantatvādevāṇi siddhe tvatalnivṛttyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| hṛdayāsa iti| dṛdayaśabdo'samāse'ṇamutpādayati-hṛdayasya bhāvo hārdam, `hṛdayasya hṛllokhayadaṇlāseṣu' iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| ase iti kim ? ahṛdayatvam| grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādeva siddhe samāsapratiṣedhaścintyaprayojanaḥ| kuśalādīnāṃ kṣetrajñāntānāṃ brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañapi bhavati|
śrotriyasya ghalopaśceti| yadā `śrotriyam̐śchandodhīte' ityatra chandasaḥ śrotṛbhāvo ghaśca pratyaya iti pakṣaḥ, tadā ghalopaḥ; yadā tu `vākyarthe padavacanam' iti pakṣaḥ, tadā ghaśabdena ya iti rupaṃ lakṣyate| kvacittu yalopaśceti pāṭhaḥ; tatra yalope saṅgātagrahaṇam, varṇagrahaṇe tvakārasya yasyetilope sati ikārasya yaṇādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, saṅghātalope tvikārasya yasyeti lopaḥ---sarvathā śrotriyasya bhāvaḥ śrautramiti ||

igantācca laghupūrvāt || 5.1.131 ||
laghupūrvagrahaṇena prātipadikasamudāyo viseṣyate iti| yadyevam, pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, vyavasthāvacano vā, tatrādye pakṣe yasya sarvapūrvo varṇo laghustasmādeveṣvaṇuprabhṛteḥ syāt, dvitīye tu pāṇḍuprabhṛtibhyo'pi syāt| yadā laghuḥ pūrvo bhavatītyāśakhaṅkyāvayavavacana eva pūrvaśabdaḥ, so'pyavadhyapekṣa eva pravarttate, tatra kasyacidanirddeśe sarvapūrvaḥ pratīyate, iha tu sannidhānādika eveti ? darśayati---laghuḥ pūrvo yasyetyādi| teneti laghupūrveṇegantena| asminvyākhyāne, antagrahaṇamatiricyata iti laghupūrveṇekā prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇāttadantavidheḥ siddhatvāt|
kathaṃ kāvyamiti| kāvamiti bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ ||

yopadhād gurūpottamād vuñ || tripramṛtīnāmityādi| etacca `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' ityatra vyākhyātam| sahāyādveveti vaktavyamiti| sūtreṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ ||

dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca || 5.1.132 ||
yaḥ patyanto dvandvastasmādyak prāptaḥ, yastu hāyanāntastasmādaṇprāptaḥ, anyasmāttvalau, manojñādiṣvapi guṇavacanāt ṣyañ prāptaḥ, coradhūrttābhyāmapi brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañeva, yuvaśabdādyuvāditvādaṇ, śeṣebhyastvatalau| amuṣyaputreti| nipātanātṣaṣṭhyā aluk ||

gotracaraṇācchlādhātyākāratadaveteṣu || 5.1.133 ||
gotravācina iti| apatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, apatyavācina ityarthaḥ| apatyapratyayāntāditi yāvat|
apara āha--gravarādhyāye paṭhitānāṃ gotrāṇāmiha grahaṇamiti| caraṇavācinaśceti| caraṇaśabdaḥ śākhādhyāyiṣu puruṣeṣu rūḍhaḥ, anayośca gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saheti jātitvāt `prāṇabhṛjjāti' ityañprāptaḥ| pratyeka bhāvakarmaṇorarthayoriti| `yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tu sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe neṣyate' iti pūrvamevoktam| slāghādiṣu viṣayabhūteṣviti| pratyayārthatvaṃ ślāghādīnāṃ na bhavati, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyayārthayoradhikṛtatvāt nāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam--ye te bhāvakarmaṇī ślāghādayaścette bhavata iti; asmbhavatā| śabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ hi bhāvaḥ, na ca gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ pravṛttinimittam, nāpi gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādikarmattvena prasiddhiḥ| tasmāt ślāghādiṣu bhāvakarmaṇoḥ sādhyatayā viṣayabhūteṣvityevārthaḥ| tadavetastatprāpta iti| iṇaḥ prāptyarthatvāt| tajjño veti| avapūrvasyeṇo jñāne prasiddhatvāt| tacchabdena ceha gotracaraṇayorbhākavarmaṇī pratinirddiśyate| gārgikayeti| `āpatyasya ca' iti yalopaḥ ||

hotrābyaśchaḥ || hotrāśabda ṛtvijāṃ vācaka iti| juhoteśtran, svabhāvataścāyamṛtvikṣvapi strīliṅgaḥ| acchāvākīyam brāhmaṇācchaṃsīyamiti| vede strīliṅgatāpi dṛśyate `so'syācchāvākīyāṃ kuryāt' iti ||

brahmaṇastvaḥ || 5.1.136 ||
brahmaṇastvaḥ || neti vaktavye iti| chapratyaye pratiṣiddhe `tasya bhāvastvatalau' ityeva pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ, vibhakteranuccāraṇāllāghavaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yastu jātiśabda iti `hotrābhyaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati ||

iti kaśrīharattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ prañcamasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ
<5.2>
kāśikāvṛttī

atha pañcamādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ

dhānyānāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ || 5.2.1 ||
dhinoteḥ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari ṇyat, asmādeva nipātanādantyasya lopaḥ, ikārasya cātvam| dhinotīti dhānyam| `dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān' iti hi dṛśyate| dhānyānāmiti bhavanāpekṣayā karttari ṣaṣṭhī| bhavanamityadhikaraṇe lyuṭ| kṣiyaṣṭran, kṣetram| bhavati jāyate'sminniti bhavanamiti| etenotpattivacano'tra bhavatirgṛhyate, na sattāvacana iti darśayati| etacca kṣetragrahaṇāllabhyate| kṣetraśabdo hi tṛṇānāṃ dhānyānāṃ cotpattyādhāramācaṣṭe| na hi dhānyānāṃ sattāṃ prati bhūmiḥ kṣetravyapadeśamāsādayati| mudrānāṃ bhavanaṃ kusūlamiti| asati kṣetragrahaṇe sattāvacanasyāpi bhavatergrahaṇaṃ syādisi bhāvaḥ| kiñca--bhavanaśabdo gṛde ruḍha iti mudgānāṃ gṛhamityatraiva prasaṅga ityapi śakyate vaktum|
yadi tarhiha kṣetragrahaṇamavaśyaṃ karttavyam, tadevāstu, kiṃ bhavanagrahaṇena ? dhānyānāmiti śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī, kṣetraṃ pratyayārthaḥ| na caivaṃ kṣetraśabdasyāpi śarīrabhāryādyanekārthatvādatiprasaṅga; dhānyasambandhādutpattibhūmireva pratyaṣyate| tadetadbhavanagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam ||

vrīhiśālyorḍhak || 5.2.2 ||
atrāpi nirddeśādeva paṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ, vṛttikāreṇa tu pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam ||

yavayavakaṣaṣṭikādyat || 5.2.3 ||
atra pratyayārthasāmarthyalabhyā ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktiḥ ||

vibhāṣā talamāṣomābhaṅgāṇubhyaḥ || 5.2.4 ||
khañi prāpto vacanaṃ pakṣe so'pi bhavatīti| yuktaṃ yadaṇutilamāṣebhyaḥ pakṣe kañapi bhavatīti, teṣāṃ dhānyatvāt; umābhaṅgayostvadhānyatvādayuktam, dhānyānyeva hi camakānuvākeṣu paṭhyante `vrīhayasya me' ityādīni, tānyeva dhānyāni, na comābhaṅgāvatra paṭhyete ? ata āha--umābhaṅgayorapi dhānyatvamāśritameveti| na camakānuvāko dhānyaparigaṇanārthaḥ, tatrādhānyānāmapyaśmādīnāṃ pāṭhād, dhānyānāmipi kepāñcit kodravādīnāmapāṭhāt| tasmādanyata eva thadhānyanirṇayaḥ, tatra `śaṇasaptadaśāni dhānyāni' iti smṛtiḥ, tatra comābhaṅge api paṭhite| tasmādyuktameva yattābhyāmapi pakṣe khañ bhavatīti ||

sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ śakhañau || 5.2.5 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthāditi| kṛta iti pratyarthārthe carmaṇaḥ karaṇatvātsāmarthyalabhyā tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| sarvaśabdasya carmaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvāyaṃ nirddeśaḥ| sarvacarmaṇa iti samāsaśca sāmarthye sati bhavati, tataścarmaśabdenāsya sambandha iti kaścidbhāmyettaṃ ptayyāha--sarvaśabdaścātreti| kathaṃ tarhi samāsaḥ? ityāha--tatrāyamiti| asmādeva nipātanāditi bhāvaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ kṛtena sambadhyate na carmaṇā ? ityāha--sarvaścarmaṇetyādi| sarvaścarmaṇā kṛta iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ, asmiṃstaddhittavṛttiriṣyate, yadi carmaṇā sambadhyeta, tato yadi sarvacarmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tataḥ sarvasmbandhainā carmaṇā kṛta ityarthaḥ syāt| atha karmadhārayaḥ, tataḥ sarveṇa carmaṇā kṛta iti, na tu kṛtasya sarvatvamubhayathāpi labhyate| tasmātkṛtenaiva sambandho nyāyya iti bhāvaḥ ||

yathāmukhasammukhasya darśanaḥ khaḥ || 5.2.6 ||
dṛśyate'smindarśana iti| adhikaraṇe| lyuṭ, kaḥ punarasau ? ityāha--ādarśādiriti| ādiśabdena jalādikaṃ gṛhyate| pratibimbāśraya iti| yo hi mukhādiprativimbasyāśrayastatra mukhādikaṃ dṛśyate| mukhasya sadṛśaṃ yathāmukhaṃ prativimbam, sādṛśyapratiṣedhātkathamatra samāsaḥ? tatrāha--nipātanāditi| bhaṭṭikāvye tu padārthānativṛttau yathāśabapda āśritaḥ, tathā ca māyāmṛgaṃ prakṛtya bhavati ślokaḥ--`yathāmukhīnaḥ sītāyāḥ pupluve vahulo bhavan' iti, yathāmukhaṃ darśana ityavyayībhāvasyāpi yathāmukhaśabdasyonmattagaṅgādivat sattvacanatvātkarmaśaktiyoge sati darśanaśabdayoge kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tasyāḥ `nāvyayībhāvāt' ityambhāvaḥ| ata eva pūrvamuktam--`yathāmukhaśabdātsaṃmukhaśabdācca ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt' iti| samaṃ mukhaṃ saṃmukhamiti samaśabdaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ| nipātanādantyalopaḥ, saṃmukhasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| pratyayasanniyogenāntyalopanipātanānnedaṃ prayogārham, kiṃ tarhi ? prakriyāvākyam| saṃśabdastu na samaśabdasyārthe dṛśyate| sammukhīna iti| yatrādarśādau sarvaṃ mukhaṃ dṛśyate tadevamucyate| kathaṃ tahi `saṃyuge saṃmukhīnaṃ tamudyantaṃ prasaheta kaḥ' iti ? abhimukhāvastānātsādharmyādbhaviṣyati ||

tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātraṃ vyāpnoti || 5.2.7 ||
pariśiṣṭaṃ prakṛtiviśeṣaṇamiti| tatra kevalānāṃ pathyādīnāṃ sarvāditvāsambhavātprātipadikairapi taistadantavidhiḥ, pañcamyarthe ca prathamā dvitīyā vetyāha---patyaṅgakarmapattrapātrāntāditi| sarvapathīna iti| `pūrvakāla' ityādinā samāsaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, tasya pathyantasamāsagrahaṇena grahaṇātpathyantameva prātipadikamiti khapratyayaḥ ||

āprapadaṃ prāpnoti || 5.2.8 ||
prāpadamiti pādasyāgramucyata iti| prārambhaḥ padasyeti kṛtvā| tayoravyayībhāva iti| ???????????????????? ityanena| dvitīyāsamarthāditi| kriyāviśeṣaṇe `karmaṇi dvitīyā'| āprapadaṃ yathā tathā sarvaśarīraṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ. śarīreṇāsambaddhasyāpi paṭasya pramāṇamākhyāyata iti| yogyatvāt, yogyo hyasāvāprapadaṃ śarīraṃ prāptum| vyāpnotīti prakṛte prāptanotīti vacanamarthabhedāt--sambandhamātram-prāptiḥ, sambandhaḥ sākalyopādhikaḥ-vyāptiḥ| `āprapadam' ityatra tvabhividhau vyāptrigamyate, na garyādāyām ||

anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ baddhābhakṣyatineyeṣu || 5.2.9 ||
anurāyāma iti| `yasya cāyāmaḥ' iti vā, `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti vā 'vyayībhāva ityarthaḥ. padapramāṇetyartha iti| āyāme tāvadayamevārthaḥ, sādṛśye'pi tulyaparimāṇatayā sādṛśyamityamevārtho bhavati| sarvānnīno bhikṣuriti| prakārakārtsnye sarvaśabdaḥ, yānyannāni labhyante uṣṇāni śītāni sarasāni virasāni tāni sarvāṇi bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ| ayanamaya iti gamanamātramayaśabdenocyate, tatpratiṣedhastvanayaśabdenetyāśaṅkāmapanayati--ayaḥ pradakṣiṇamiti| pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanamityarthaḥ| evam anayaḥ prasavyam| vāmaparyāyagamanam| etacca rūḍhivaśāllabhyate| rūḍho hyayamayānayaśabdaḥ śāraṇāṃ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamane--śrṛṇantyebhirdūtakārāḥ parasparamiti śārāḥ, dyūtasādhanaviseṣāḥ, śvān iti yeṣāṃ prasiddhaiḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe ghañ| tatrābhimukhayoḥ krīḍatoḥ kitavayoryadaivaikaṃ prati pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanaṃ tadevetaraṃ prati prasavyamityayaścāsāvanayaśca ayānaya iti karmadhārayaḥ |

atha vā--ekameva pratyayānayatvam, katham? vīthībhedena| catasro vīthayaḥ, tatrātmīyāḥ śārāḥ parapārśve sthitāḥ prathamāyāṃ vīthyāmātmanaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ dacchanti, dvitīyasyāṃ prakañm, evamuttarayoḥ; tatra samāhāradvandve lokāśrayatvena puṃlliṅgatā|
apara āha--ekadeśadvāreṇa gamanasamudāyasyānayavyapadeśaḥ, kṛtākṛtadivatsāmānādhikaraṇasamāsa evāyamiti| pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre'pi neṣyate, kintu viśeṣa ityāha---pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmināmityadi| yasmin gativiśeṣe sati gāmināmityādi| bahuvacanamayānayanimittapradarśanārtham| yadi śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca gacchantyevamayānayau bhavataḥ, nānyathā| tatrāmīyāḥ śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchanti, parakīyāḥ prasavyam| teṣāmevaṅgāmināṃ yāni stānāni teṣāṃ yasmin pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanātmake gativiśeṣe sati parairvivakṣabhūtaiḥ śārairasamāveśaḥ-anadhyasanamanākramaṇaṃ so'yānaya ityucyate, na tu pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre sa evāyam| evaṃrūpo'thānayo yadā sasahāyaiḥ śāreḥ padānyadiṣṭhīyante yadā veditavyaḥ | sasahāyānāmeva hi śārāṇāṃ padāni parairna śakyante'dhyāsitum| asahāyānāṃ tu bhaktayat eva| phalakaśirasi sthita iti| yatra phalake'ṅke'kṣairdīvyanti tasya śirobhūtaṃ yatra sthānaṃ kitavānāṃ prasiddhaṃ tatra sithitaḥ śāraḥ `ayānayīnaḥ' ityacyate; tatraivāyānayīnaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt|
apare tu-neyo netavyaḥ, na nītastataḥ. tatra `śirasi stitaḥ' ityarthānupapātteḥ `phalakaśirasi sthāpyate' ityartha iti granthena bhavitavyamityāhuḥ| nīto vā neyaḥ; tadupalakṣaṇatvāt| bhāvinyāvasthāyoktaḥ| ayānayasambaddhitve'pi sarveṣāṃ viśeṣyādeva pratyayotpattiruktaiva| satyapi dvalitīyādhikāre purdditīyoccāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭād dvitīyāntād yathā syādi tyevamartham| tena viśiṣṭārthaneyavacanādayānayaśabdād dvidīyāntād pratyayo bhavati, na neyavacanamātrāt| sa eva viśiṣṭo yo nayaṛḥ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmītyādinā granthena darśaitaḥ|
arthāyānaya iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yadi hyayaṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ, tasya napuṃsakatvādayānayamiti bhavitavyam ? athetaretarayoge, dvyarthatvādayānayāviti bhavitavyam ? nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt tatpuruṣaḥ--ayasahito'nayo'yānaya iti| atha baddābhakṣayatineyeṣviti kathaṃ tiṅantasya dvandvaḥ ? kaḥ punarāhāyaṃ dvandva iti? yadi na dvandvaḥ, kathaṃ neyeṣviti bahuvacanam ? sautratvānnirdeśasya| subbyatyayena vā cchandasyekavacanasya sthāne bahuvacanamupapannam| nanu cchandasi subvayatyaya uktaḥ, neda chandaḥ ? nayaśca bhavati tenāsāvayānayaṃ neyaḥ| `baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣu' iti nipātanāttiḍantasya dvandvaḥ asamāsapakṣe tu baddhetyatra prathamaikavacanam, neyeṣviti saptamībahuvacanamityasamañjasamāpadyeta ||

parovaraparamparaputrapautramanubhavati || 5.2.10 ||
parasyotvavacanamiti| parasya śabdarūpasyāderutvaṃ nipātyata ityarthaḥ, tatra `ādguṇaḥ'| atha vā--paraśabdasya otvaṃ nipātyate'ntyasyālaḥ, tataḥ `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpaikādeśaḥ, parasyautvamiti prāpnoti `śakandhvādiṣu pararūpaṃ avkavyam' iti pararūpeṇa nirddeśaḥ| paraparatarāṇāṃ ceti| cakāraḥ pūrvanipātanāpekṣyā samucyayārthaḥ| aऱtagatasya bahutvasya śabde samāropād bahuvacanam| tacchabdāntarameva draṣṭavyamiti| avyutpannameva prabapandhasya vācakam| ata evastrīliṅgamekavacanaṃ ca| pāramparyamityapi tasmādeva svārthe ṣyañi bhavati kathaṃ parovaryavaditi ? asādhurevāyam; khapratyayasanniyogena parovareti nipātanāt ||

avārapārātyantānukāmaṃ gāmī || 5.2.11 ||
gāmīti| `gameriniḥ', `āṅi ṇicca' iti bahulavacanātkevalādapi ṇinirbhaviṣyati| gamyādaya iti| yadyapyāṅpūrvā gamirgamyādiṣu paṭhyate, tathāpi bahulavacanādeva ṇiniriva bhaviṣyatkālatmapi bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| akernorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoriti ṣaṣṭhīpritiṣedha iti| `gatyarthakarmaṇi' ityatra yaduktam--`dvitīyāgrahaṇamapavādaviṣaye vidānārthaṃ tena kṛtpratyayaprayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati--grāmaṃ gantā' iti, tannāśritamam; pratiṣedhe ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgasyaivābhāvāt| avārapārīṇa iti| dvandvātpratyayaḥ| avārapāre tīre āhitāgnayādiṣu pakṣepādubhayaṃ bhavati--avārapāre, pārāvāre iti | atntamiti | kriyāviśeṣaṇam, evamanukāmamiti| kāmaḥ-icchā, tasya sadṛśamanukāmam-kāmānurūpam, `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti samāsaḥ ||
samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate || 5.2.12 ||
samāṃsamābhiti vīpseti| praṣṭavyeti śeṣaḥ| atra nirdeśe vīpsā draṣṭavyā, tena dvicanamityarthaḥ| atha vā--vīpsāvācī samudāyo vīpsā, vīpptāvācītyarthaḥ| subandamudāyaḥ prakṛtiriti| prātipadikādhikāre'pi vacanasāmarthāt| garbha dhārayatītyartha iti| dṛśyate ca vijanirrbhadhāraṇe, `sa vijāyamāno garbhaṇātāmyat' iti|
pūrvapade supo'lugvaktavya iti| anyathā taddhite utpanne yathottarapade lugbhavati `supo dātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti, tathā pūrvapade'pi syāt|
kecittvivatyādi| nanvatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyayā bhavitavyam ? tatrāha--garbhavimocane tviti| tatra vamocanena yakāramātralopo na sarvasyā vibhakteriti mātraśabdasyārthaḥ. pariśiṣṭasyeti| āmśabdasyālugvaktavyaḥ| nanu yāṭaḥ subbhaktatvātsublukaiva lopaḥ siddhaḥ tatra yalopavacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--yakārasyaiva lopo na tu sarvasya pratyayasyeti, tatkimucyate `alugvaktavyaḥ' iti ? evaṃ manyate--yathaiva nipātanātpūrvapadapariśiṣṭisya lopo na bhavati evamuttarapade'pi na syāditi|
anutpattāviti| vākye pūrvottarapadayorapi pakṣe yalopo vaktavyaḥ, tena dvairūpyaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ||

adyaśvīnāvaṣṭabdhe || 5.2.13 ||
avaṣṭabdha, vijana--ityetayoryathākramaṃ vivaraṇam--āsanne prasava iti| kathaṃ punaravaṣṭabdhaśabdasyāsannamarthaḥ ? ityāha--āvidūrye hīti| yadyapyālambane'pi ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate; tathāpi vijanasyālambanatvāsambhavādāvidūryamevārthaḥ| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate ? adya vā viśvo veti vārthe samāsaḥ khapratyayaḥ, ṭilopastvavyayatvādeva siddhaḥ| adyaśvīnā vaḍaveti| vijāyata ityasyānukūlatayā strīliṅgamudāhṛtam, na punaḥ sūtre strīliṅganirddeśaḥ| adyaśvīno gosamūhaḥ, adyaśvīnaṃ gomaṇḍalamityatrāpīṣṭhatvāt| ????????? hrasvāntasyāvibhiktiko nirdeśaḥ|
kecittviti| teṣāṃ yathābhidhānaṃ kriyādhyāhāraḥ| avaṣṭabdhamātre iti| bhavatyādyarthe'pītyarthaḥ| adyasvīnaṃ maraṇamiti| adya vā śvo vā bhaviṣyatītyatrārthe pratyayaḥ ||

āgavīnaḥ || 5.2.14 ||
gorāṅpūrvāditi| gośabdāntādāṅpūrvātprātipadikādityarthaḥ| ā tasya goḥ pratidānāditi| pratidānam-pratyarpaṇam| etena vṛttiviṣaye gośabdo gopratidāne varttata iti darśayati| kariṇīti| kṛña āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| āgavīna iti| `āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ' ityavyayībhāve upasarjanahrasvatve ca kṛte khapratyayaḥ, `orguṇaḥ' ||

anugvalaṅgāmī || 5.2.15 ||
alaṅgagāmīti| `supyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ| goḥ paścādanusviti| paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, upasarjanahrasvaḥ| paryāptamiti| kriyāviśeṣaṇameva| anugviti| tataśca dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ| kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇānna bhavati, tadyathā--śobanaṃ pācaka iti ||

adhvano yatkhau || 5.2.16 ||
dvitīyāsamarthāditi| yadā tiṅntena vigrahaḥ--adhvānaṃ gacchatīti, tadā dvitīyāsamarthatvam| yadāpi sūtropāttena gāmītyanena viprahaḥ, tadāpi dvitīyaiva kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati; `akenoḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt| iha `adhvano yacca' iti siddham, cakārātkhaśca? evamucyamāne uttarasūtre cakāreṇānantaro yadevānukṛṣyate, na cānukṛṣṭaḥ khaḥ| ato yatkhayordvayorapyanuvṛttyarthaṃ yatkhāvityuktam ||

abhyāmitrāccha ca || 5.2.17 ||
abyacāmitrāmiti| `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' ityavyayībhāvaḥ, kriyāviśeṣaṇatvātkarmaṇi dvitīyā ||

goṣṭhātsañ bhūtapūrve || 5.2.18 ||
gāvastiṣṭhantyasminniti goṣṭha iti| chañarthe kavidhānam, `sthāsnāyāvyadhirhāna yudhyartham' ityadhikaraṇe kaḥ, `ambāmbagobhūmi' iti ṣatvam| pūrva bhūto bhūtapūrvaḥ, `supsa,upā' iti samāsaḥ| goṣṭhaśabdasyārthadvārakaṃca viśeṣaṇatvam, na svarupeṇa, na hi bhūtapūrvād goṣṭhaśabdātpratyayo vidhātuṃ śakyate| goṣṭho varttata iti| samprati gavāmavastānaṃ darśayati ||

asvayaikāhagamaḥ || 5.2.19 ||
ekāhena gamyata ityekāhagamaḥ, `grahavṝdṛniścigamaśca' ityapaṃ bādhitvā `parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ' iti, asti kacātra parimāṇākhyā, ekāhena gamyata iti paricchedāvagamād, asmādeva nipātanādapdraṣṭavyaḥ, `kakartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ| aśvasyeti| karttari ṣaṣṭhī| aśvīnāni śataṃ patitveti| yāvanti yojanānyekāhenāśvena gamyate, tāvatāṃ śataṃ gatvetyarthaḥ ||

śālīnakaupīne adhṛṣṭākāryayoḥ || 5.2.20 ||
yathākathañciditi| nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| abhiniveśe tu yaḥka śālāyāmadhṛṣṭo bhāryājitatvādanyatra dhṛṣṭaḥ, yacca kūpe akāryaṃ mūtraṇādi, kathaṃ tasyābhidhānaṃ prāgoti, kathaṃ tarhi vivakṣitārthaḥ ? ityāha--śālāpraveśamarhatīti| yadakāryaṃ tatpracchādanīyatvātkūpāvataraṇamarhatītyarthaḥ| uttarapadālopaśceti| vṛttiviṣaye śālākūpaśabdau tatkarmikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vartetate iti gamyamānatvādaprayoga eva lopaḥ| kaupīnaṃ pāpamiti| pāpasādhanatvāttu puruṣaliṅge kaupīnaśabdaḥ, sādhārmyādvā; sādharmyaṃ gopyatvāt| tatsāhacaryācca tadācchādane vāsaḥkhaṇḍe| apara āha---kāryaśabde karotiḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanaḥ, tena lajjāhetutvenādraṣṭavyatvātpuruṣaliṅgaṃ kaupīnam, aspṛśyatvācca tadācchādanamiti ||

vrātena jīvati || 5.2.21 ||
vrātaśabahdo loke sahghamātravacanaḥ, iha tu na tatheti darśayituṃ bhāṣyagranthaṃ paṭhati| nānajītīyā iti| anena caikajātīyakṣattriyādisahghanirākaraṇam| aniyatavṛttaya iti| niyatavṛttyāyudhajīvisaṅganiṣedhaḥ| utsedhajīvina ityetadvyācaṣṭe| utsedhaḥ śarīramiti| ucchrāyatvāt| tadāyāsyeti| āyāserṇyantāllyap, tena sakarmakatvam| aṇyantapāṭhe tvantarbhāvitaṇyarthatvātsakarmakatvaṃ draṣṭayam| śarīrāyāsena bāravahanādinā jīvanti, na tu buddhibhāvenetyarthaḥ| vrātā iti| saṅghavacano'yamiha saṅghiṣu prayuktaḥ| evaṃbhūtānāṃ yaḥ saṅghastadvrātamityarthaḥ| evamapi tathābhūtena saṅghena ye jīvanti tatra prāpnoti,na ceṣyate ? tatrāha--teṣāṃ karma vrātamiti| idamarthe che prāpte'smādeva nipātanādaṇ| yastvanya ityādi| anabhidhānamatra hetuḥ ||

sāptapadīnaṃ sakhyam || 5.2.22 ||
sāptapadīnamiti nipātyata iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate ? samarthavibhaktistṛtīyā| avāpyata iti pratyayārthaḥ, saptabhiḥ padairavāpyata iti tadvitārthe dviguḥ samāsaḥ, saptapadaśabdātkhañ| kathamiti| sakhyurbhāvaḥ karma vā sakhyam, tatra vyutpāditasya na sakhiśabdena praśnaḥ, upacāreṇetyuttaram, guṇapradhāna iti| guṇo bhāvaḥ, karma ca bhāvaḥ, pravṛttinimittatvādguṇaḥ| yasya hi guṇasya bhāvāditi karmāṇi hi sakhyaśabdavācyatvādguṇa ityuktam ||

haiyaṅgavīnaṃ sañjhayām || 5.2.23 ||
hyogodohasya vikāra iti| duhyata iti dohaḥ-kṣīram, gordoho godoha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, hyaḥ śabdasya tena `supsupā' iti samāsaḥ, tato vikāre'nudāttalakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ, khañ| ghṛtasyaiṣā saṃjñeti| ghṛtasyāpi na sarvasya, kiṃ tarhi ? tasyaivāvikṛtagandharūpasya| hyaḥśabdena kālapratyāsattipratipādanād navanītaṃ haiyaṅgavīnamutyate, ghṛtaśabdo'pi tatraiva prayuktaḥ ||

tasya pākamūle pīlvādikarṇādibhyaḥ kuṇabjāhacau || 5.2.24 ||
pākaḥ-pariṇāmaḥ, mūlaḥ-upakramaḥ| `tasyedam' ityaṇādiṣu prāpteṣvayamārambhaḥ, jakārasya prayojanābhāvāditsaṃjñābhāvaḥ ||

pakṣāttiḥ || 5.2.25 ||
ekayogaśiṣṭānāmapi śabdānāṃ śabdādikārapakṣe yasyaiva śabdasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, tasyaivānuvṛttirbhavati| tathā ca `dāmahāyanāntācca' ityatra saṅghayā haṇamanuvarttate, nāvyayagrahaṇam| arthādhikārapakṣe tu yugapadanyo'nyārthābhidhāyināṃ dvandvavidhānād dvandvārthavicchedānna syādekadeśānuvṛttiḥ| pakṣasya mūlaṃ pakṣatiḥ-pratipadi, pakṣiṇaśca pakṣamūle prayujyate ||

tena vittaracuñcupcaṇapau || 5.2.26 ||
