vittaḥ pratīta iti| `vitto bogapratyayayoḥ' iti nipātanāt, cuñaacupcaṇapoścakārasya yathetsaṃjñā na bhavati, tathā `cuṭū' ityatraiva vṛttikāreṇoktam ||

vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha || 5.2.27 ||
nasaheti prakṛtyarthaviseṣaṇamiti| yadi pratyayārthaḥ syāttato dvau pratiṣedhau prakṛtamevārtha gamayata iti sahārtha eva gamyeta, na nasaha, api tu sahaiveti| tasmātprakṛtyartha eva bhavati| etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate| yadyevam,sahetyeva pratyayārtho'stu, vinañoḥ pratiṣedhārthatvāt, vigardabhārathaka ityādau viśabdasyāpi pratiṣedhe vṛttirdṛṣṭaiva ? satyam; kriyāvācino viśabdātsahārthe pratyayo vijñāyeta--vigatau saha vikṛtau saheti, nāño ñakāro vṛddhyārthaḥ, svarārthaśca ||

veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭaccau || 5.2.28 ||
kva punarete śālajādayo bhavanti ? ityāha--sasādhanakriyāvacanāditi| kriyāviśiṣṭasādhanavacanādityarthaḥ| etacca `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' ityatra pratyapādi| upasargāditi| anyatropasargasaṃjñādarśanādviṣayāntare'pi prādīnāmabhidhānam| svārtha iti| anirddiṣṭārthatvāt| vigate iti| vigamanakriyākarttari vervṛtti darśayati| tadyogāditi| viśālāvayavayogāt, vyutpattipakṣe nānyā gatiriti bhāvaḥ|
vastugatimāha--paramārthatastviti| viśālatvam-vistīrṇatvaṃ nāma guṇaḥ, tasmādguṇavacanā ete| vakṣmayāṇapratyayāpekṣayā bahuvacanam; tataśca yadguṇayogācchaṅge vṛttistadgaṇayogādeva gavyapi vṛttiḥ siddheti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca-viśālo deśa ityapi dṛśyate ||

saṃprodaśca kaṭac || 5.2.29 ||
kaṭacpratyayo bhavatīti| pūrvavatsasādhanakriyāvacanebhyasvārthe| saṅkaṭaḥ-prajñātaḥ, prakāśa ityarthaḥ| utkaṭaḥ-udbhūtaḥ| vikaṭaḥ-vikṛtaḥ|
alābūtiletyādi| bhaṅgābhya iti pāṭhaḥ, bhahgāśabdaṣṭāvantaḥ| yathālābūprabhṛtibhyo rajasyabhidheye kaṭacpratyayo bhavati, rajaso vikāratvādvikārapratyayānāmapavādaḥ| tatrālābūśabdādorañaḥ, `mayaḍ vaitayoḥ' iti mayaṭaścāpavādaḥ| tilomāśabdābhyāṃ ghṛtāditvādantodāttābyām `anudāttādeśca' ityaño mayaṭaśca| `umorṇayorvā' iti vuñśca, `asaṃjñāyāṃ tilayavābhyām' iti mayaṭaśca| bhaṅgāyāḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvayaṣām' ityādyudāttatvādaṇo mayadasca|
goṣṭhādaya iti| prayogasamavāyipratyayarūpaṃ nirdiṣṭam| cakārastu svarārthe'nubandvavyaḥ| tathā hi--samāsāśrayeṇa bhāṣye etatpratyākhyātam, samāse cāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| sarvatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| gavāṃ sthānamiti| `tasyedam' ityatrārthe `sarvatra gorajādipratyayaprasaṅge yat' iti yati prāpte goṣṭhacpratyayaḥ; aprasṛtāvayavaḥ samūhaḥ-saṅghātaḥ, prasṛtāvayavastu-vistāraḥ, ubhāvapi sāmūhitānāmapavādau|
dvitva iti| prakṛtyarthasya dvitve dyotya ityarthaḥ| uṣṭagoyugamiti| dvayaṃ yugamityādivad dvayavayavasaṅghābhidhāyitvādekavacanam| evaṃ hasti???gavamityādāvapi draṣṭavyam|
sneha iti| snihayantyaneneti snehaḥ-dravarūpa iṅgudādīnāṃ vikāraḥ| tatra iṅgudaśabdaḥ `laghāvante' ityādyudāttaḥ, tataḥ `tasya vikāraḥ' ityaṇpratyayaḥ prāptaḥ; tilaśabdād `anudāttādeśca' ityañ prāpta, so'pi tviṣyate-tilānāṃ vikārastailamiti, tattarhīdaṃ bahu vaktavam ? netyāha; upamānātsiddham| katham ? gāvastiṣṭhantyasminnati goṣṭham, tatsādharmyāduṣṭrādisthānamapi goṣṭhamityucyate| tatra viseṣapratipattyarthamuṣṭādibhirviśeṣṭate--uṣṭragoṣṭham, mahiṣagoṣṭham; mukhyārthapratipattaye gobhirapi gogoṣṭhamiti| yathā gopatiśabde svāmimātraparatayā prayukte gobhirapi viśeṣaṇam--`gavāmasi gopatireka indraḥ' `vijñā hitvā gopatiṃ śūra gonām' iti, tathā nānādravyāṇāṃ rajjuvīraṇādīnāṃ saṅghātaḥ kaṭaḥ, tatsādharmyādanyo'pi saṅgātaḥka kaṭaśabdenocyate, sa cāviprabhṛtibhirviśeṣayiṣyate, evaṃ paṭavadvistīrṇo'visahgo'vipaṭa iti| tathā yugaśabdena dvayamucyate--gavoryugaṃ goyugam, dvayātmatvasāmānyādanyadapi yugalaṃ goyugamityucyate, tata uṣṭrādibhirviśeṣyate, mukhyagoyugapratipattaye gavāpi| tathā ṣaḍ gāvaḥ samāhṛtāḥ paḍgavam, `gorataddhitaluki' iti ṭac, pātrāditvānnapuṃsakatvam| tatsādharmyādityādi pūrvavat| tathā tilavikāro mukhyaṃ tailaṃ tatsādṛśyād dravarupaṃ vikāramātraṃ tailam, tata iṅgudādibhistilaiśca viśeṣaṇam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā tilānāṃ vikārastailamityapi bhavati, vākyaprārambhe cu tailacā bādhitatvādana syāt|
upara āha--`yathā prakṛṣṭo vīṇāyāṃ pravīṇa iti vyutpattimātraṃ kriyate, kauśalameva tvasya nimittam, tathā ca vīṇāyāṃ praviṇa ityapi bhavati; tathā tilānāṃ vikārastailamiti vyutpattimātram, dravarūpo vikārastvasyārthaḥ| tathā ceṅgudādibhirviseṣaṇasiddhiḥ'tattu na rocayāmahe; na hi tailamityukte dravarūpaṃ vikāramātraṃ pratiyanti| śākaṭacśākinau tu vaktavyāveva ||

avāt kuṭāracca || 5.2.30 ||
avakuṭāram, avakaṭamiti| avācīnam, aprasiddhamityarthaḥ ||

nate nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṭīṭañnāṭajbhraṭacaḥ || 5.2.31 ||
namanaṃ natamiti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' nīcaistvamityarthaḥ| nāsikāyāḥ sambandhainīti| sambandhaśca namane kartṛtvena, sūtre tu `napuṃsake bhāva upasaṃkhyānām' iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| yadvā--śeṣavijñānātsiddhamiti śeṣalakṣaṇaiva| avaṭīṭādiṣu nāsikāsādhane namane varttamānādupasargātsvārthe pratyayaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi nāsikā puruṣaśca tathocyate ? ityāha---tadyogāditi| ṭīṭañaṣṭakārasyetsaṃjñabhāvaḥ `cuṭū' ityatraiva vyakhyātaḥ ||

inacpiṭaccika ci ca || 5.2.33 ||
kakāraḥ pratyaya iti| akāro vivakṣitaḥ; cakāraḥ, evakāra ityādivat kāraśabdaḥ, kapratyaya ityarthaḥ| tathā coktamiti| sūtre niśabdasya dvāvādeśau dvau ca pratyayau vihitāvityādeśapratyayātravidhānārthametad vārttikakāroṇoktam| asya cakṣuṣī ityetasminnartha iti| yadyapi cakṣuṣī prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam, asyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyayaḥ, tathāpi klinnatvasya cakṣurgatatvaṃ pratyayasyaiva dyotyabhiti matvaivamuktam|
asyetyaneneti| vākyaikadeśaṃ pratyācaṣṭe, kasmāt? nārthaḥ, ityāha| cakṣuṣorevabhidhāna iti| cakṣuṣorvarttamānātklinnaśabdātsvārthe pratyaya ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhipuruṣasyābhidhānam ? ityāha--tadyogādityādi| arśaādiṣu `svāṅgāddhīnāt' iti paṭhyate, tena matvarthe'kāraḥ ||

upādhibyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ || 5.2.34 ||
niyataviṣayamiti| parvataviṣayam| āsa tena vṛkṣasyāsannam, plakṣasyārūḍhamityatra na bhavatītati bhāvaḥ| athopatyakā, adhityaketyatra `pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasya' ityanenettvaṃ karamānna bhavati ? ityata āha---pratyayasthāt kāditi| yadyatrettvaṃ syāt saṃjñārūpaṃ na sidhyet; nopatyikādhityiketyevaṃrūpā saṃjñā| tasmāt saṃjñādhikārādittvaṃ na bhavati ||

karmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac || 5.2.35 ||
`karmaṇi' ityanena karmaṇīti svalarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayati| atha pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇaṃ karamānna bhavati ? asambhavāt| asambhavattu ghaṭaterakarmakatvāt| aṭhacpratyeye'kāroccāraṇaṃ ṭhasyekādeśanivṛttyartham ||

tadasya sañjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac || 5.2.36 ||
tārakādiṣu bubhukṣā-pipāsāśabdau paṭhyete, tayoḥ kimarthaḥka pāṭhaḥ, yāvatā sannantābhyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṭi ca kṛte bubhukṣitaḥ, pipāsito pipāsita iti ? satyaṃ karmaṇi siddham--bubhukṣita odanaḥ, pipāsitamudakamiti; karttari tu na prāpnoti--bubhukṣito devadattaḥ, pipāsito devadata iti| anena tu yasya bubhukṣāpipāse sañjāte tatra pratyaya utpadyate|
puṣpādīnāṃ tarhi kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ, `puṣpa vikasane', `mūtra prasravame,' `vraṇa gātravicūrṇane'--- ebyo'karmakatvātkartari kte--puṣpitaḥ, mūtrita ityādi siddham ? satyam bhūte siddham; varttamāne tu na siddhayati, ato kavarttamānārthasteṣāṃ pāṭha| kathaṃ punaranena vartamāne bhavati, yātā'trāpi `sañjāta' iti bhūte niṣṭhā ? evaṃ tarhi gaṇe puṣpādīnāṃ pāṭhasāmarthyātsañjātamityatra bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate| garbhādaprāṇinīti| garbhaśabdādaprāṇinyabhidheye itañbhavati--garbhitāḥ śālayaḥ, prāṇini tu garbhiṇī gauḥ ||

pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ || 5.2.37 ||
yattatprathamāsamarthaṃ pramāṇaṃ cettadbhavatīti| anena prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ pramāṇasya darśayati| yadi tu pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt--yattadasyeti nirddiṣṭa pramāṇaṃcettadbhavatīti; tadā pramāṇasya prameyāpekṣatvātprameyaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ syāt yathā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatve prameyaṃ pratyathārthaḥ, tataśceha prāpnoti--udakaṃ prameyamasyororiti, etaccāyuktam; aniyataprameyaviṣayatvātpramāṇānāmekena viśeṣaṇasyānyāyyatvāt, prameyasya tu niyatapramāṇatvapratipādanāyorumātrādayaḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante|
prathamaśca dvitīyaśceti| urdhvāvastitena yena mīyate tadūrdhvamānam, urvādi| tatra kecidāhuḥ--`āyāmamāmanameva pramāṇaṃ sūtre gṛhyate, tiryaṅmānameva cāyāmamānam, tataścordhvamāne'praptau dvayasajjaghnacau pramāṇādapakṛṣyeha vidhīyete' iti| apara āha--`ūrdhvāvastitenāpi yenāyāmaḥ paricchidyate tadapyāyāmamānatvāt pramāṇamiti sūtre gṛhyate| vacanaṃ tūrdhvamāna eva yathā syātāṃ tiryaṅmāne mā bhūtāmiti niyamārtham' iti| anyastvāha--`pariccedakamātraṃ pramāṇamihara gṛhyate' iti; tatrāpi niyamārthametat| mātraṃ pramāṇam, tato nyāyaprāptānuvādo'yam| prasthāmātramityapīti| api śabdādūrumātramityapi bhavati|
pramāṇe la iti| luka eṣā pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| pramāṇamiti ye prasiddhā iti| `prabāṇaśabdā ete' iti ye prasiddhāḥ---diṣṭivitastyādaya ityarthaḥ śamaḥ, diṣṭiḥ, vitastiriti| atra mātrayo lug; itarayorasambhavāt| śamādīnāmanūrdhvamānatvād|
dvigornityamiti| dvigorapramāṇatvāttadantavidhyabāvācca pūrveṇāprāpto lugvidhīyate| nityagrahaṇaṃ kimiti| nātra vikalpaḥ prakṛta iti praśnaḥ| saṃśaye śrīviṇaṃ vakṣyatīti| śravaṇaṃ śrāvaḥ, `kṛyalyuṭo vahulam', iti ghañ, so'syāstīti śrāvī, `pramāṇaparimāṇābhyāṃ saṅkhayāyāścāpi saṃśaye' iti vakṣyamāṇasya mātracaḥ `pramāṇe laḥ' ityanena lugna bhavati, paratvād; ato'mau śrāvī| asya dvigāvapi śravaṇe prāpte lugvidīyata ityarthaḥ| dvau śamau pramāṇamasya dviśamaḥ| kathaṃ punarava saṃśaye mātraca utpattiḥ ? tadantavidhainā| etadeva lugvacanaṃ jñāpakam-astyatra tadantavidhiriti| prakāraṇādivaśādasya niścayasaṃsayavipayatā prayogasyāvaseyā|
stome ḍaḍvaktavya iti| atrāyāmamānasyāsambhavātparicchedopādhikāyāḥ saṅkhyāyāḥ stome'bhidheye ḍaṭpratyayaḥ| ḍitkaraṇamekaviṃśa ityatra ti śabdasya lopārtham, trayastriṃśādau ṭilopārthaṃ ca| pañcadasādau `nastaddhite' ityeva siddham---pañcadaśa mantrāḥ parimāṇamasya pañcadaśaḥ stomaḥ, saptadaśī rātririti| stomasāhacaryādrātryādau striyāṃ vṛttiḥ, ṭittvānṅīp `tadasya parimāṇam' `saṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñā' ityatra tu steme ḍo vihitaḥ, tatra ṭāb bhavati yadyasti prayogaḥ, atha tu nasti tato'syaiva sa prapañcaḥ|
śansatorhinirvaktavya iti| evaṃ ca chandasi ca bhāṣāyāṃ ca ḍirnervidhānāt `saṅkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅgha' ityatra `śanśatorḍiniśchandasi' iti vacanaṃ prapañcārthameva|
viśino'ṅgirasa iti| pravarabhedena viṃśatirbhedā ucyante, tatra viṃśatiśabdātsaṅkhayānamātravācinaḥ saṃkhyeye prameye ḍiniḥ, `ti viṃśaterḍiti' iti lopaḥ, yasyetilopaśca|
pramāṇaparimāṇābhyāmiti| rūḍhiśabdāvetau; bhedenopādānāt| śamamātramiti| śamaḥ pramāṇamasya syānna vetyatrārthe mātrac| pañcamātrā iti| pañca syurna veti saṃśayyamānārthavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyayaḥ| pañcatvasaṅkhyā pramāṇameṣāṃ syādvā na veti pañcamātrāḥ| tāvadeviti| tatparimāṇamasya dhānyādistāvat, tataḥ svārthe ??????| uttarasūtre tu `bhāvaḥ siddhaśca ḍāvatoḥ' ityarthāntare vakṣyate ||

puruṣahistibhyāmaṇ ca || 5.2.38 ||
hāstinamiti| `inaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ|
dvigornityaṃ lugiti| nāyam `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam' ityasyānuvādaḥ; puruṣahastinoḥ śamādivatpramāṇatacvenāprasiddhatvāt| ata eva puruṣadvayasamityādau `pramāṇe laḥ' iti lugna bhavati; anyathāṇo vidhānasāmarthyāllugabhāve'pi dvayasajādīnāṃ syādeva| tasmād pūrvo'tra lugvidhīyate| sa ca dvayasajādīnāṃ nāṇaḥ, grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhād dvigoraṇaḥ prāptyabhāvāt| dvipuruṣīti| `pūruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām' iti ṅīp ||

yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup || 5.2.39 ||
yāvāniti| `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' ityātvam| `ugidacām' iti num, `atvasantasya' iti dīrghaḥ, halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| pramāṇaparimāṇayorekatvaṃ matvā yaścodayet--halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| pramāṇaparimāṇayorekatvaṃ matvā yaścodayet--parimāṇagrahaṇamanarthakam pramāṇādhikāraditi ? taṃ pratyāha--pramāṇa iti vartamāne ityādi| sa punaranayorbhedaḥ `parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ, āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt' iti pūrvameva vyākhyātaḥ| ḍāvatāviti| ihāsmābhirvatupaṃ vidhāya `ā sarva nāmnaḥ' ityātvaṃ vihitam| pūrvācāryāstu ḍāvatuṃ vidadhire, tadapekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| viśiṣyata iti viseṣaḥ, tasya bhāvo vaiśeṣyam, arthavaiseṣyādarthabedātparimāṇasya pramāṇāt pṛthagnirdeśaḥ, ucyate kriyata ityarthaḥ| syādetat--`yadyapi pramāṇaparimāṇaśabdayorartho bhidyacate, tathāpi pramāṇagrahaṇamevānuvarttya tadupādhikebhya eva vatubvideyaḥ| tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati---yāvānadhvā, yāvatī rajjuriti, atra hyāyāmamānaṃ gamyate| ye tu parimāṇe prayogāḥ---yāvān dhānyarāśirityādayaḥ, te'pyupamānādbhaviṣyanti| yathā siddhānte yāvānadhvā yāvatī rajjuḥ yāvatkṛtvo bhuṅkta ityādayaḥ' iti, tatrāha---mātrādyapratighātāyeti| yadi yathoktaṃ kriyeta tato ḍāvaturviśeṣavihitatvātsāmānyavihitānmātrajādīnbādhena| parimāṇagrahaṇe tu sati bhinnopādhikatvād bādhyabādhakabhāvābhāvaḥ, tena tanmātraṃ yanmātramityādi pramāṇe siddhaṃ bhavatīti| bhāvaḥ siddhaśceti| tatparimāṇamasya dhānyasya dairghyaṃ tādṛgasyāpītyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ bhinnaviṣayatve sati vatvantānmātrādayaḥ siddhayanti| ekaviṣayatve tu vatupaiva viśiṣṭasya prameyasyoktatvāttadantānmātrādayo na syuḥ,| yasyā hi tāvatpramāṇaṃ tasya tatpramāṇamiti tāvacchabdasyaiva tatrāpi prayogaḥ syād; anyathā hi mātrajādipratyayamālāprasaṅgaḥ|

kimidambhyāṃ vo ghaḥ || 5.2.40 ||
kiyān, iyāniti| `idaṃ kimorīśkī', yasyetilopaḥ| etadeveti| ādeśavidhānānyathānupapattyā pratyayo'numīyate| yogavibhāgena veti| evaṃ pratipādite lāghavaṃ bhavati| `ādeḥ parasya' ityeva siddhe `vaḥ' iti kavacanamādeśapratipattyartham; itrathā hi ghaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ vijñāyeta ||

kimaḥ saṅkhyāparimāṇe iti ca || 5.2.41 ||
saṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇamiti| karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣayā kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karttari ṣaṣṭhī| parimitiḥ-parimāṇam| saṅkhyā pariccheda iti|| sahkhyā yaṃ paricchedaṃ paroti tatretyarthaḥ| tasya ca vakārasya ghakāra iti| `vo ghaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ| nanu kā saṃkhyā parimāṇameṣāmityatra kiṃśabdaḥ pariccedikāyāṃ saṅkhayāyāṃ varttate, na punaḥ paricchede? tatrāha---pṛcchyamānatvāditi| paricchedakatvaviśiṣṭā saṃkhyā pṛcchayate--kā saṃkhyā paricchedikaiṣāmiti, tatra paricchedasyāpi pṛcchayamānākārāntarbhāvātsaṃkyāparicchede varttamānādityuktamityarthaḥ| apara āha--``saṃkhyāyāḥ' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, saṃkhyāparicchedārthapraśne varttamānaḥ saṃkhyāparicchede vartata ityucyate| saṃkhyāyāṃ paricchettumiṣṭāyāṃ yaḥ praśnastatra vartamānādityarthaḥ' iti| kati| `ṣahuṣviti vṛttau bahuvacanameva bhavati| uktaṃ ca--`anirjñāter'rthe bahuvacanaṃ prayoktavyam' iti| kathaṃ tarhi kiyān, kiyantāviti ? nātra saṃkhyāpraśne kiśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? parimāṇamātrapraśne| saṃkhyāpraśne tu tatrāpi bahuvacanameva bhavati--kiyanto brāhṇā iti| yadīyā ca saṃkhyā pṛcchayate tatra pratyayāḥ, tena kā saṃkhyā hi tadā pratyayena bhāvyam--kati gāvo'sminvarga iti| saṅghasaṅghinorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu--kati gāvo'??? varga iti, na tu vyavasthitasaṃkhyāsambandhe varge, vargasaṃkhyāpraśne tu kati vargā iti bhavati|
atha vetyādi| asminpakṣe saṃkhyāparimāṇa iti karmadhārayaḥ, nipātanācca viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ, karaṇasādhanaśca parimāṇaśabdaḥ| evamātmiketyasya vivaraṇam--paricchedasvabhāveti| yatrāparicchedakatvena vivakṣyate iti| paricchedakatvena na vivakṣyata ityarthaḥ| tathaiva vā pāṭhaḥ| kva punarevaṃ na vivakṣyate ? ityāha--kṣepe hīti| keyameṣāmiti| keyamīdṛśānāṃ daśatvasaṃkhyā yeṣāṃm |
avratānāmamantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām|
sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate || iti|
evaṃ saṃkhyeyadvāreṇa saṃkhyāyāṃ kṣepaḥ| prakṛtaḥ parimāṇaśabdo rūḍhiśabdatvāt saṃkhyāyā parisambanddhuṃ nārhatīti paricchaittimātrāvacanaḥ punarihopāttaḥ ||

saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap || 5.2.42 ||
ihāsyetyadhikārātsaṃkhyāyā avayave varttamānāyāḥ svārthe tāvatpratyayo na bhavati; avayavasvāmini tu prāpnoti--pañca avayavā asya devadattasyeti| tatrāha--avayavāvayavinaḥ sambandhina iti| avayavaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādyaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ tatraivāvayavini pratyaya ityarthaḥ| yathā dvayasajādiṣu pramāṇe prakṛtyarthe prameyaḥ pratyayārthaḥ, tadvat| ????????? rephasya visarjanīye tasya satve `hrasvāttādau tadvite' iti ṣatvam, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' iti ṅīp ||

dvitribhyāṃ tayasyāyajvā || 5.2.43 ||
nanu tayaḥ prakṛtaḥ so'nuvarttiṣyate, `dvitribhyām' iti pañcamī, `tasmādityuttarasya' iti tasya ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ sampādayipyati; tatkiṃ `tayasya' ityanena ? tatrāha--tayabgrahaṇamityādi| asatyāmapekṣāyāmanuvṛttiḥ ṣaṣṭhīprakṛtiśca durjāneti bāvaḥ| atha pratyayāntare ko doṣaḥ ? trayī gatiriti tayabnibandhana īkāro na syāt, `prathamacaramataya'ka iti caiṣa vidhirna syād--dvaye, dvayā iti| kvacit tatra ko doṣa ityādi vṛttāveva vṛttāveva paṭhyate| cakāraḥ svarārtha iti| tena sthānivadbhāvenānudāttatvaṃ na bhavati ||

ubhādudātto nityam || 5.2.44 ||
udāttavacanasāmarthyāditi| antodāttatvasya citsvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| sarvodāttatvaṃ tu na bhavati, `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' iti vacanāt| nāpi he ubhayetyatrāmantritānudāttatvam, ubhayetyatra cāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ bādhitumudāttavacanam; purastādapavādanyāyena citsvarasyaiva bādhanāt|
ubhaśabdo yadi laukikī saṃśyeti| ubhāvityukte dvāviti pratīteḥ| atha na saṃkyeti| kṛtvasujādisaṃkhyākāryādarśanāt; ekaḥ, ubhau, traya ityevaṃ loke gaṇanā'darśanācca| tasya nityamayajādeśa iti| atha pratyayāntaramevāyaḥ kasmānnāśritaḥ, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--udātta iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham; yacca sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāmuktamubhayaśabdasya jasi sarvādipāṭhānnityā saṃjñā bhavati, na `prathamacaramataya' iti vibhāṣā; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñāṇatpūrvavipratiṣedhādveti, tadapyayatnasitaddhaṃ bhavati, katham, na hyayaṃ tayapa ādeśaḥ ? satyam; ubhayītyatra tu tayabnibandhana īkāro na syāt| yadi tu ṅībbidhau mātrajityayacaścakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam, tataḥ pratyayāntaratve'pyayacaḥ siddha īkāraḥ|
udāttagrahaṇaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ ca śakyamakartum, ṅībvidhau ca tayapo grahaṇam|
atha vā--daghnañmātracorapi tatra grahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, dvayasajityevāyacaścakāreṇa pratyāhāro'stu; tattu tathā nāśritamityeva|
ubhayo maṇiriti| ubhau pītalohitāvavayavāvasyetyavayavadvinibandhano'vayavino vyapadeśaḥ| ubhaye devamanuṣyā iti| vargadvayāpekṣamatirohitabhedānāṃ vargiṇāmidamabhidhānam ||

tadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ || 5.2.45 ||
asminnadhikam, yasmādadhikamiti ca nirddeśādadhikaśabdayoge saptamīpañcamyau bhavataḥ| adhikā khārī droṇeneti karttari tṛtīyāpi bhavati| ekādaśa adhikā asmin śata iti| vyapadeśivadbāvo'pi prātipadikena pratiṣiddhaḥ| pratyayārthena cetyādi| prakṛtipratyayārthayostulyajātīyatve pratyaya ityarthaḥ| nyāyasiddhaścāyamarthaḥ| tathā hi--vākye tāvadekādaśa adhikā asmin goste iti śataviśeṣaṇatvenāpyupāttā gāvaḥ sannidhānātprakṛtyarthamapi spṛśānti| vṛttāvapyekādaśaṃ gośatamityukte prakṛtyarthatayā gāvaḥ sannihitā eva pratīyante| yatra tu vijātīyasaṃkhyeyavācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra śabdasannihitena tenānyadarthaṃ sannihitaṃ bādhyate| na ca vṛttau tādṛśena śabdena prakṛtyarthaḥ śakyo viśeṣayitum; pratyayārthenaikārthībhūtatvāt, yathā---vṛddhasyaupagava iti ||
śatasahasrayośceṣyata iti| iyamiṣṭireva|
itikaraṇo vivakṣārthastataḥ, idaṃ sarva labhyata iti| yadyapi pūrvārtho nyāyā deva labhyate, tathāpi `śatasahasrayośceṣyate' ityayamratha itikaraṇādeva labhyate iti lāghavāya sādhāraṇo heturupadiṣṭaḥ|
kathamityādi| śate sahasre cābhidheye pratyayo bhavannatra na prāpnoti, atra hi saṃkhyāntaramadhikaṃ śatasahasraṃ nāma, na śataṃ sahasraṃ veti bhāvaḥ| atrāpi śatasahasrayorevānyatarasya pratyayārthatvaṃ na saṃkhyāntarasyetyāha--śatānāmiti| sahasrāṇāṃ vā śatamiti| atrāpi pakṣe `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' iti dvandve cādvandve ca smaraṇācchatasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ| tatra pūrvasminvigrahe śatāni saṃkhyāyanta iti tānyeva prakṛtyarthaḥ--ekādaśa śatānyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti, uttaratra tu sahasrāṇāṃ saṃkhyeyatvāttānyeva prakṛtyarthaḥ--ekādaśasahasrāṇyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| prakaraṇādivaśācca śatānāṃ vā saṃkhyeyatvāvasāyaḥ |
uktamevārthaṃ ślokena darśayati--adhike samānajātāviti| pratyayārthasambandhinyā jātyā prakṛtyarthasya jātau samānāyāṃ satyāmadhike'rthe varttamānāt pratyaya ityarthaḥ| yadvā--`samānajātau' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| jātyantalakṣamastu cho na bhavati; bhāṣyaprayogāt| pratyayārthena samānajātīye'rthe varttamānādityathaḥ| iṣṭamiti| pratyayākhyaṃ kāryam| ekādaśaṃ śatasahasramityatra nirvāhārthamāha--yasya saṃkhyeti| `śatāni sahasrāṇi saṃkhyāyante', ityuktam, `adhike samānajātau' iti ca, tena yasya saṃkhyā yajjātīyaṃ saṃkhyāyate| sāmānyapekṣamekavacanam| tadādhikye sa kartavyo mato mama| etaccodāharaṇa eva vyaktīkṛtam, nātra kiñcidapūrvamuktam ||
śadantaviṃśateśca || antagrahaṇamanarthakam, kevalasya śataḥ prātipadikasyābhāvāt; pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati, paṅktayādisūtre triṃśadādīnāṃ śatpratyayāntatvena nipātitatvāttatrāha--śadgrahaṇe'ntagrahaṇamiti| pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhau sati tadādiniyamaḥ syāt, asmistvantagrahaṇe sati yāvataḥ samudāyasyānte śacchabdastāvato grahaṇaṃ bhavati| saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ceti| `saṃkyāyā avayave tayap' ityataḥ saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvarttanīyamityarthaḥ| tena saṃkhyāvācinaḥ śadantātpratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ| ekatriśadādayaśca saṃkhyāntarasya vācakāḥ, na tu samudāyasya; tena teṣāmapi grahaṇam, gotriśadādayaśca na saṃkhyāvacanā iti teṣāmagrahaṇam|
viṃśateśceti| viṃśatiśabdānantaramantaśabdaḥ paṭhitavya ityarthaḥ; anyathā `grahaṇavatā' iti niṣedhāttadantānna syāt ||
saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ || tadasya sajjātamityata iti| tatra tāvat `tadasya' iti samudāyasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñātam, anuvṛtaṃ ca bahuṣu yogeṣu| `tadasminnadhikam' ityatra tu punastacchabdopādānānta sambaddhayata ityetāvat| iha tu pratibanadhābhāvātsa eva samudāyo'nuvartata ityarthaḥ, tena `tadasmin' ityasyaiva tacchabdasyānantaryādanuvṛttiryuktā| `asmin' ityanena vicchainnatvādasyetyanuvṛttiścāyukteti na codanīyam| nimānaṃ mūlyamiti| `meṅ praṇidāne' ityasmānnipūrvātkaraṇe lyuṭ, nimīyateṛkrīyata ityarthaḥ| guṇasyeti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| so'pi sāmarthyāditi| guṇaśabdo'pi sāpekṣaṃ rūpamācaṣṭe, tathā hi--dviguṇam, triguṇamityukte kiñcidapekṣyeti gamyate; tatra nimeyasya guṇatvaṃ sannihitaṃ nimānamapekṣyetyetatsāmarthyam| yavānāṃ dvau bhāgāviti| yadyapi tulyamubhayatrāpi svatyāgaḥ parakīyasya grahaṇam, tathāpi kvacitkācitprasṛtatarā gatiḥ, tadyathāsamāne tyāge dhānyaṃ vikrīṇīta ityucyate, na kaścidāha--kārṣāpaṇī vikrīṇīta iti, tena yavabhāgayoreva nimānatvam, nodaśvidbhāgasya| deśakālāpekṣo vā nimānanimeyabhāvaḥ| nimānasya ca nimeyāpekṣatvānnimeyaṃ pratyāyārthaḥ, ekaguṇasyadaśvito dviguṇā yavā mūlyamityarthaḥ| tadyathā--prasthasyodaśvito dvau prasthau yavāḥ, dvimayamudaśvidyavānāmiti| bhāgaviśeṣapratipattyatha prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇasya yavādeḥ prayogaḥ| dviśabdaśca vṛttiviṣaye bhāgayoreva saṃkhyeyayorvartata iti sambāndhiśabdatvena nityasāpekṣatvāttaddhaitavṛttiraviruddhā| kathaṃ punaḥ pratyayāntasyodaśvicchabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatodaśvidbāge pratyayo vihitaḥ, nodaśviti ? tatrāha--bhāge'pi tu vidhīyamāna iti| atra cābhidhānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| apara āha--yatrodaśvito bhāgo dviguṇairyavaiḥ krīyate, tatrārthātsamudāyo'pi dviguṇairyavaiḥ krīto bhavati bahubhirekena vā, tadapekṣaṃ sāmānādhikāraṇyamiti| guṇasyeti caikatvaṃ vivakṣitamityetadarthameva hi `guṇanimāne' iti laghurapi nirdeśo na kṛtaḥ| dvau bhāgau yavānāṃ trayaṃ udaśvita iti| na tāvad `bhūyasaśca vācikāyāḥ' ityuktamiti matvedamudāhṛtam, na tvatra dviśabdo bhūyaso vācakaḥ| yadvā udāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, trayo yavānāṃ dvāvudaśvita iti darśayitavyam, nimānanimeyabhāvasya vivaryayo vā praṣṭavya| bhūyasaśceti| pratyayārthātprakṛtyarthasya bhūyaso yā vācikā saṃkhyātataḥ pratyaya ityarthaḥ| iha na bhavatīti| nimānanimeyayoḥ sāmyaviṣaye na bhavatītyarthaḥ; anyathā guṇasyetyekatvavivakṣāyāmapi syādeva prasaṅgaḥ| kutastarhi na bhavati? anabhidhānāt |
`bahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ' iti bhūyaḥśabdasya vyutpāditatvātprakṛtyarthasya bahutaratve sati pratyayena bhāvyam, tataśca dviśabdānna syādityāśaṅkayāha--bhūyasa iti ceti| guṇaśabda ityādi| na hyayaṃ bhāgamātravacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? samānatāmapi tasya bhāgasya brūte |
nimeye cāpi dṛśyate iti| kathaṃ tallabhyate ? tantrāvṛttekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇena| dve atra vākte; tatraikaṃ vyākhyātm, dvitīye nimānamiti, kṛtyalyuṭo `bahulam' iti karmaṇi lyuṭ|
guṇasyeti| karaṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ kartari ṣaṣṭhī, nimeyasya nimānāpekṣatvānnimānaṃ pratyayārthaḥ, pariśiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavat| saṃkhyāyā iti kim ? yavabhāgau nimānamudaśvidbhāgasya dvivacanāntādyavabhāgaśabdātpratyayo na bhavati| vrīhiyavāviti| atrodaśvita eva nimānaṃ dvau na tadbhāgasya, tena dvimayamuśvid vrīhiyavāviti na bhavati| dviguṇaṃ tailaṃ pacyate kṣīreṇiti| kṣīrasambanvinau dvau guṇāvasmistaila tattenaiva subhagaṃ saha kṣīreṇa pacyata ityucyata iti ||

tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ || 5.2.48 ||
tasyetyekatvamavivakṣitam| ekaśya pūraṇāsambhavāt, tena dvyādibyo dvivacanabahuvacanāntebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ| pūryate'neneti pūraṇamiti| karaṇe lyuṭ| pūryate iti| ṇyantātkarmaṇi yak, na prakṛtyantarāt, kartari śyat| yadi saṃkhyāvācinaḥ śabdātpūraṇe pratyayo bhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti-pañcānāmanyato labdhapañcasaṃkhyānāmuṣṭrikāṇāṃ pūraṇo ghaṭa iti ? tatrāha--yeneti| saṃkhyetyasya vivaraṇam--saṃkhyānamiti| iha saṃkhyāvācinaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate, tatra pratyāsattyā yasya saṃkhyāvācino yatpravṛttinimittaṃ saṃkhyānaṃ pañcatvādi, tasya pūraṇa iti vijñāyate; na tu viprakṛṣṭe pañcādiśabdavācyānantarbhūtam, yathā `atiśāyane tamaviṣṭhanau' kutsita ityādāviti bhāvaḥ| ekādaśānāṃ pūraṇa iti| tathā vaiyākaraṇapāśa ityatra pravṛttinimittakutsāyāmapi yāpyo vaiyākaraṇa iti vigrahaḥ, na tu yāpyaṃ vaiyākaraṇatvamitiḥ tathehāpi saṃkhyānapūraṇe vivakṣite saṃkhyeyavācināpi vigraho na virudhyate| ekādaśa iti| punargaṇanāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ caraṇabuddhisthena yenaikādaśatvasaṃkhyā pūryate sa iti veditavyaḥ| evaṃ ca vyutkrameṇāṣṭādhyāyeṣu gaṇyamāneṣu `samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ityadhyāyo yadā caramaṃ gaṇyate tadā nirmāṇādvitīyasyāpi gaṇanākrameṇāṣṭamatvavyapadeśa e bhavatyeva| nanu prakṛtyarthavyatiriktena pratyayārthena bhavitavyam, iha tvekādaśasvantarbhūta ekādaśānīyantāmityukte ekādaśasyāpyānayanāt ? satyam, samudāyāvacavayostu bhedāsamudāyaḥ prakṛtyartho'vayavaḥ pratyayārthaḥ, yathā-vṛkṣasyāvayavo vārkṣī śākheti ||

nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ || 5.2.49 ||
ḍaṭo maḍāgamo bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarayamāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum, nātrāgamī nirdiṣṭaḥ, yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamāntam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ ? ata āha--nāntāditi| pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ tāvadanuvartate, na ca tasya vidhānārthānuvṛttiḥ, pūrvameva vihitatvāt| na ca viśeṣavihitena maṭā bādhaprasaṅge vidhānārthā ḍaṭo'nuvṛttiḥ, evaṃ hi prakṛtasya samuccayārthaścakāraḥ kriyeta, maṭ ceti; yathānyatra| tato'nuvṛttisamāmarthyātṣaṭhīpraklṛptāvāgamitvameva vijñāyate| kaḥ punarmaṭaḥ pratyayatve āgamatve vā viśeṣaḥ, yāvatā tadeva rūpaṃ sa eva svaraḥ? satyam; ḍaṭi maṭi ca nāsti viśeṣaḥ, `viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām' ityayaṃ tu tamaḍyadi pratyayaḥ syādādyudāttaḥ syād, āgamatvenāgamānudāttatvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratyayasvara iti viṃśatitama ityasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati|
ekādaśa iti| nāyaṃ saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃkhyāntarameva| ata evātra ḍaḍbhavati; anyathā so'pi na syāt| na hi saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ saṃkhyāgrahaṇena gṛhyate, yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena-kāśikośalīyāḥ| athāpyayaṃ saṃkhyāsamudāyaḥ; tathāpi saṃkhyāgrahaṇena tatsamudāyo gṛhyata iti jñāpanārthameva `asaṃkhyādeḥ' iti vaktavyam; tena sarvameva saṃkyākāryamekādaśādīnāmapi bhavati ||

ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk || 5.2.51 ||
tadiha saptamyā vipariṇamyata iti| yadi pūrvavat ṣaṣṭhyā vipariṇāma iṣṭaḥ syāt, pañcamyā nirddiśet; ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśāttu ṣaṣādīnāmevāgamitvaṃ vijñāyate| tataścānuvṛttasya ḍaṭo'rthātsaptamyā vipariṇāma ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ dvitīyatṛtīyaturtheti nirddeśa upapadyate| katipayaśabdo na saṃkhyeti| yadyapyasāvatipracayarahitaṃ bahutvamācaṣṭe, tathāpi loke saṃkhyātvena na prasiddhiḥ, yathā--dvitrāḥ pañcaṣā iti| sāśtre'pi naivāsya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā, kathaṃ tarhi ḍaṭpratyayaḥ ? ityāha--tasyeti| kiṃ punasthugvidhīyate, na pañcamīnirddeśena prakṛtasthaḍeva vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha ṣaṣṭha iti jaśtavaṃ prāpnoti, caturtha iti rephasya visarjanīyastasya ca satvaṃ prāpnoti; thaṭaḥ parāditvena pūrvasya padatvāt| yadi punaḥ pūrvasūtre thugeva vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; pañcathaḥ, saptathaḥ--nalopo na syāt| iha liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā katipaśabdādābantādapi thugbhavati, tatra `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' iti ḍaṭi viṣayabhūta eva puṃvadbhāvaḥ, katipayānāṃ pūraṇī katipayathīti bhavati|
caturaśchayatāviti| chayadbhayāṃ ḍaṭ na bādhyate; iṭi paratasthugvidhānāt| ādyakṣaralopaśceti| acsahitaṃ vyañjanamakṣaraśabdenocyate, acsahitasyādervyañjanasyetyarthaḥ| vyañjanasahitājvacane tvakṣaraśabde dvirvacananyāyena takārasyāpi lopaḥ syāt ||

bahupūgagapasaṅghasya tithuk || 5.2.52 ||
atrāpi ṣaṣṭhīnirddesād bahvādīnāmevāgamitvam| pūgasaṅghayorityādireka eva grantha| iha bahvīnāṃ pūraṇīti pūrvavaḍḍaṭ pratyayaḥ puvad‌bhāvaśca ||

vatorithuk || 5.2.53 ||
atrāpi pūrvavadvatvantasyaivāgamitvam| iha tāvatīnāṃ pūraṇī tāvatithīti liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā pratyayaḥ, puṃvadbhāvaśca| kathaṃ punaratra liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā, yāvatā prātipadikasvarūpagrahaṇe sā bhavatītyuktam ? yatrāpi prātipadikaviśeṣaṇaṃ svarūpeṇopādīyate, tatrāpi sā bhavati, yathā--`tṛjakābhyāṃ karttari'--apāṃ sraṣṭrīti| ihāpi vatoriti viśeṣaṇaṃ svarupeṇopādīyate, tena bhavatyeva liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam| uktaṃ ca--bahukatipayavastūnāṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭādutpattiḥ; prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇāditi ||

dvestīyaḥ || 5.2.54 ||
tīyapratyayo bhavatīti| ḍaṭo dviśabdasya cādeśo na bhavati; dvitīyeti nirddeśāt| yadyevam, tasmādeva nirddeśānna siddhamasya sādhutvam ? siddhyatu sādhutvam, pūraṇaārthastu kartha labhyate! kiñca tadāśrayaṇe prakṛtipratyayavibhāgābhāvātprātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syāt, `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' iti pakṣe ḍaṭaḥ prasaṅgaśca ||

treḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca || 5.2.55 ||
aṇa iti tatrānuvartata iti| `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' ityataḥ| evamapi yadi pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ syātpunarapi syādeva dīrgaḥ, sa tu na tathā? ityāha--pūrveṇoti| etacca `laṇ' ityatraiva pratipāditam|
`trestṛ ca' iti noktam, pratyayo mā vijñāyīti ||

viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām || viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasyeti| kathaṃ punaḥ `dvestīyaḥ' iti tīyapratyayena satyaṃ ḍaṭpratyayo vicchinnaḥ; pūraṇārthastu na vicchinnaḥ, so'nuvarttete, tena pūraṇe yo vihitaḥ sa āgamī vijñāyate| na ca ḍaṭo'nyo viṃśatyādibhyaḥ pūraṇe vihito'sti|
kaḥ punaḥ paṅktyādisūtranirddiṣṭānāṃ grahaṇe sati doṣaḥ ? tatrāha--tadgrahaṇe hīti| syādetat--tadantavidhinā ekaviṃśatiprabhṛtibhyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti ? tatrāha--grahaṇavateti| nanu yadayaṃ `ṣaṣṭyādeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ' ityāha, tajjñāpayati--bhavati pūraṇaprakaraṇe tadantavidhiriti| tenaikaviṃśatiprabhṛtibhyo'pi bhaviṣyati| atstavetat, kevalebhyastu na syāt, atadantatvāt| vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhaviṣyati, `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena'| evaṃ cetyādi| laukikānāṃ viṃśatyādīnāṃ yadīdaṃ grahaṇam, tadā `ṣaṣṭyādeśca' ityatrāpi laukikānāmeva ṣaṣṭyādīnāṃ grahaṇam, tataścaikaṣaṣṭiprabhṛtibhyo nityasya tamaṭaḥ prasaṅge `asaṃkhyādeḥ' iti paryudāso yujyata eva, na kathañcinna yujyate; aniṣṭaleśasyābhāvāt| sūtrasanniviṣṭānāṃ tu grahaṇe tadantavidhaijñāpanārthaṃ paryudāso yujyate| kevalaṃ na tu yujyata eva, kevalānāmaprasaṅgāditi tāvadvṛtterarthaḥ| yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā sūtrasaṃniviṣṭānāṃ grahaṇam, jñāpanācca tadantavidhiriti sthitam| na ca kevalānāmaprasaṅgastadantānāmapi bhavatīti jñāpanaśarīram, na tu tadantānāmeva bhavatīti| yadi vā yatra prātipadikasya śrutirasti--`grahaṇavatā prātipadikena', vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' iti, tadubhayamapi na pravarttate iti sāmānyena jñāpanam| evaṃ ca kṛtvedamapi siddhaṃ bhavatiekānnaviṃśateḥ pūraṇaḥ ekānnaviṃśatitama iti| bhavati hyetatsūtrasanniviṣṭaviṃśatyantaṃ saṃkhyādi saṃkhyāvāci ca| laukikānāṃ tu grahaṇe naitatsidhyati; viṃśateḥ prāgbhāvitvādasyāssaṃkhyāyāḥ ||

nityaṃ śatādimāsārdhamāsasaṃvatsarācca || 5.2.57 ||
māsādaya ityādirvijñāyata ityanta eko grandhaḥ|
atha śatādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `ṣaṣṭyādeśca' iti vakṣyamāṇenaivasiddham ? tatrāha--ṣaṣṭyāderityanenaiveti| yadi tena syād, ekaśatādibhyo na syād; asaṃkhyāderiti pratiṣedhāt ||

ṣaṣṭyādeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ || 5.2.58 ||
saṃkyādestu viklapa evabhavatīti| na hyayaṃ vikalpasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ| paryudāso hyayaṃ saṃkhyādeḥ, na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ, yadi kenacit prāpnoti bhavatyeva pūrveṇa ca prāpnoti, prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyanantarā prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate, na vyavahitā ||

matau chaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ || 5.2.59 ||
matāviti matvartha ucyata iti| sāhacaryād mukhyasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| kathaṃ hi maturabhidheyaḥ syācchabdasya śabdaḥ ? matvarthagrahaṇenetyādi| samarthavibhaktiḥ prathamā, prakṛterarthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇam astitvam, pratyayārthaḥ--asyāsminniti ca| tatra yadyapi pratyayārtho matorabhideyam, itaradanabhidheyam; tathāpi sāhacaryamaviśiṣṭamiti sarvametadākṣipyate-sannidhāpyate, upasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| atha vā--pradhānavaśabtitvād guṇānāṃ pradhāne pratyayārthe upasthāpite samarthavibhaktyādikamapi guṇabhūtamupasthāpyate eva, ācamanādivat, yathā--vrahāhṇā bhojyantāmityukte'nuktā apyācamanādayo'hgabhūtā ākṣipyante|
ihāsyavāma ityasminnastīti ṣaṣṭhīprathamayorupalambhādanekapadasamudāyo'yam, tataścārtavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhābādevaṃvidhebhyaḥ pratyayo na prāpnotītyata āha--anukaraṇaśabdāśceti| svarūpamātrapradhāna iti| nātra tadānīmuccaritamanukaraṇasvarūpaṃ vivakṣaitam, kiṃ tarhi ? anukāryasvarūpam| mātraśabdo bāhyarthavyavacchedārthaḥ, etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā gavādayaḥ śabdāḥ sāsnādimadākṛtimarthaṃ pratyāyantastenārthena tadvati matupamutpādayanti--gomān, vṛkṣavāniti; tathānukaraṇaśabdāḥ prathamāsamarthāḥ svenānukāryeṇa tadvati chapratyayamiti| tatra `anukaraṇaśabdāḥ' ityanena padasamudāyatvaṃ nirasyati| anukārtho hi padasamudāyaḥ na tvanukaraṇam| kiṃ punaranyadanukāryamanukaraṇaṃ ca, nanu rūpabhedo nopalabhyate ? yadyapyevam, tathāpyarthabhedād bhedaḥ, anukāryasya bāhyo'rthaḥ, anukaraṇasya tu tadevānukāryam| ata evāsyāvāmīyamityādau vibaktyarthāpratipādanātsuptvābhāvātsyaśabdādīnāṃ lugna bhavati| ye cāmnāyaśabdānāṃ niyamāḥ- `śmaśāne nādhyeyam', `caturddaśyāṃ nādhyeyam', `śūdsya vedamupaśrṛṇvastrapujatubhyāṃ śrotrapūraṇam' ityevamādayaḥ, te'pyanukaraṇeṣu na bhavanti| asyavāmīyamiti hi sarvatra sarvadā sarvepāṃ ca sakāśe prayujyate| tasmādanye'nukaraṇaśabdāḥ| anukāryaśabdāśca svarūpamātrapradāna ityanena tvarthavattvamāha|
anekapadādapīti| anekaṃ padaṃ yatra samudāye tasmādapītyarthaḥ| paraprasiddhyā caivamucyate, yambhavānanekapadasamudāyaṃ manyate tasmādapītyarthaḥ| na tvatra vastuto'nekapadatvamasti---asyavāmīyamiti, asyavāmasyeti vede yatpadadvayaṃ paṭhitaṃ tadaikadeśasyāsyavāmaśabdasya chapratyayaprakṛtirasyavāmaśabdaḥ| pratipādaka ityarthavattvam, padasamudāyatvābhāvācca prātipadikatve sati pratyayaḥ| kiṃ punaratra chapratyayaprakṛtateranukaraṇatve pramāṇam ? chapratyaya eva| na hyasāvanukaraṇatvamantareṇa sambavati| tasmāditiśabdavacchapratyayo'pyunukaraṇatve pramāṇam ||

adhyāyānuvākayorluk || 5.2.60 ||
kena punariti| sūktasāmnoreva cho vihita iti praśnaḥ| idameviti| na hyasatī lugvidhānamupapadyate| vikalpena ceti| tatkathaṃ matupprakaraṇe evāsminsūtre kartavye tadatra chasya lugvidhānam ? tasmātpākṣiko luganumīyate| atra kecidāhuḥ--anuvākasāhacaryādvaidiko'dhyāyo gṛhyata iti| anye punaḥ---pauruṣeyagranthaviśeṣasyāpyadhyāyasya grahaṇamicchanti|ca tathā ca `dīrghajīvitīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ' ityadivaidyakagrantheṣu dṛśyate ||

tatra kuśalaḥ pathaḥ || 5.2.63 ||
pathi kuśala iti| `āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām' iti saptamī, kauśalasya kriyāviṣayatvātpathinśabdena gamanādikā tadviṣayā kriyā lakṣyate| yogaścāyam `kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' ityaṇo'pavādaḥ ||

ākaṣādibhyaḥ kan || 5.2.64 ||
kan || ākaṣatyasminsuvarṇādikamityākaṣaḥ, `puṃsi saṃjñāyām' iti ghaḥ| `halaśca' iti ghañ tu na bhavati; prāyagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ, yathā nikaṣa iti| ye tu ākarṣādabhya iti sarephaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāmākṛṣyate'sminniti ghañi rūpam| tsaruka iti| `tsakara chadmagatau', `bhṛmṛśrṛ' ityādinauṇādika upratyayaḥ| tsaruḥ-khaḍgagrahaṇapradeśaḥ| etadarkhaṃ pratyayāntarakaraṇamivarṇāntārthaṃ ca| akārānteṣvākarṣādiṣu prakṛtena vunāpi siddham ||

dhanahiraṇyāt kāme || 5.2.65 ||
kāma iccheti| kāmayitā tu na gṛhyate; anabhidhānāt ||

svāṅgebhyaḥ prasite || 5.2.66 ||
prasitaḥ prasakta iti| `ṣiñ bandhene' karmaṇi ktaḥ, yo yatra prasaktaḥ sa tatra prakarṣeṇa baddha iva bhavatītyupamānādidamabhidhānam| keśeṣu prasita iti| `prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīya ca' iti saptamī| keśādiracanāyāmiti| keśādisthāyāṃ racanāyāṃ keśādiśabdasya vṛtti darśayati| etaśca kriyāviṣayatvāt prasaklelebhyate|
bahuvacanamityādi| svarūpavidhinirāsārthaṃ tu bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati, `adravam' ityādinā svāṅgasya paribhāṣitatvena svarūpagrahaṇāsambhavat ||


udarāṭṭhagādyane || 5.2.67 ||
ādyuno vijigīṣuriti| `vivo'vijikagīṣāyām' iti tatra niṣṭhānatvavidhānāt| udaraka iti| udaraparimārjanādau prasita ucyate ||

sasyena parijātaḥ || 5.2.68 ||
sasyaśabdau guṇavācīti| na dānyavācī; anabhidhānāt| kecittu `śaṃsiduhiguhibhyo vā' iti kyavantaṃ śasyaśabdaṃ paṭhanti| sasyeneti karttari kṛtīyā| parigato jātaḥ parijātaḥ, `prādayo gatādyarthe prathamayā' iti samāsaḥ| samantātsanbaddhaḥ parigataḥ, tatra sasyasya kartṛtvam, tadāhṛ--yo guṇaiḥ sambaddho jāta iti ||

aṃśaṃ hīrī || 5.2.69 ||
tatra ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāditi| `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' ityanena| nanu tatra bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasya grahaṇam ? satyam; inastvaviśeṣaṇa grahaṇam, asmādeva dvitīyānirddeśāt ||

tantrādacirāpahṛte || 5.2.70 ||
tanyante tantavo'sminnati tantram-tantuvāyaśalākā, tantrātervā eraci ṇilopaḥ| acirāpahṛta iti| aciraḥ kālo'pahṛtasyeti `kālāḥ parimāṇinā' iti samāsaḥ| pañcamīsamarthāditi| apahṛtayoge `apādāne, pañcamī' ||

brāhmaṇakoṣṇike saṃjñāyām || 5.2.71 ||
kanpratyayāntau nipātyete iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate, brāhṇaṇaśabapdādāyudhajīvyupādhikātprathamāntātsaptamyarthe kanpratyayaḥ, annaśabdādalpatvopādhikātsaptamyartha eva kanpratyayaḥ, annaśabdasyoṣṇasyoṣṇayādeśaḥ ? tadāhayatrāyudhajīvina ityādi ||

śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi || 5.2.72 ||
śitaṃ karoti sa śītakaḥ, yaścoṣṇaṃ karoti sa uṣṇakaḥ| kiṃ cātaḥ? tuṣāre āditye ca prāpneti, śītoṇaśabdayohi sparśaviseṣo mukhyo'rtheḥ, taṃ ca tāvavaśyaṃ kuruta eveti mukhyārthagrahe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā gauṇārthayorgrahaṇamiti darśayannāha--kriyāviśeṣaṇāditi| tatra śītoṣṇaśabdayorupamānād vṛttiḥ---śītamiva śītam, mandakaraṇamityarthaḥ| śītaṃ hi mandatāyuktam; sati śīte kāryakaraṇe pāṭavābhāvāt| evamuṣṇamivoṣṇam-paṭukaram, śīghrakaraṇamityarathaḥ| evaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇābhyāṃ pratyayaḥ| dvitīyāsamarthāditi| `kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇānta bhavati' iti prāgevoktam| mukhyārthavṛttibhyāṃ tu pratyayo na bhavati; anabhidhanāt ||

adhikam || 5.2.73 ||
adhyāruḍhaśabdasyeti| yadi punaradhiśabdātsasādhanakriyāvacanāt kannipātyate, tadā kartṛkarmaṇoranyatarasyaivābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti| adhyārūḍhaśabdastūbhayārtha iti tasyaivedamaṅgīkṛtasādhanabhedaṃ nipātanamucitamiti bhāvaḥ| adhiko droṇaḥ khāryām, adhikāka khārī droṇeneti| yathaitatprayogadvayamupapadyate tathā darśayatikarttari karmaṇi cādhyārūḍhaśabda iti| `gatyarthākarmaka' ityādinā ruheḥ karttari karmaṇi ca kto vihitaḥ| nipātanasāmarthyācca sakṛdupātto'pyaṅgīkṛtasādhanabhedaḥ saṃgṛhyate| tatra yadā kartari tadā tatrābihitatvātprathamaiva bhavati, na tṛtīyā; yadā tu karmaṇi tadā karturanabhihitatvāttṛtīyā, karmaṇastvabhihitatvātprathamā| yadā ca karttari ttastadā karmaṇo'nabhidānādadhyārūḍhayoge yathā dvitīyā bhavati--adhyārūḍho droṇaḥ khārīmiti, grāmaṃ gata itivat, tathādhikaśabdenāpi yoge dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām `yasmādadhikam' `tadasminnadhikam' iti ca nirddesāt pañcamīsaptamyau bhavataḥ ||

anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamitā || 5.2.74 ||
sūtre samāhāradvandve liṅgavyatyayaḥ, anuśabdādabhiśabdācca sasādhanakriyāvacanātsvārthe kannipātyata ityāha--anukāmayate'nuka iti| `abhikāmayate' ityetad gamyamānatvānnoktam ||

pārśvenānvicchati || 5.2.75 ||
anujurupāyaḥ pārśvamiti| tiryagavastānātpārśvaṃ tāvadanṛju, tadvadanyo'pyanṛjurupāya evabhucyata ityarthaḥ| ya ṛjunopāyenānveṣṭavyānarthānanṛjunā'nvicchati sa pārśvakaḥ| kutsito mārga-kusṛtiḥ, jālam-ānāyaḥ, tābhyāṃ caratīti kausṛtikau jālikaḥ ||

athaḥśūladaṇḍājinābhyāṃka ṭhakṭhatrau || 5.2.76 ||
tṛtīyāsamarthābhyāmiti| nirddeśādeva tṛtīyā hīyam, na pañcamī; pūrveṇa sāhacaryāt| tīkṣṇa upāyo'yaḥśūlamiti| yathāyaḥśulaṃ tīkṣaṇaṃ tathānyo'pi tīkṣaṇaṃ upāyo'yaḥśūlamityupacārāducyata ityarthaḥ| dambhodaṇḍājinamiti| dambhasādhanatvāt| dambhavanto hi prāyeṇa daṇkaḍamajinaṃ ca dhārayanti| teneti| dambhena tu dhārayatu mā vā'dīdharadityarthaḥ, sarvatra mukhyārthāgrahaṇe'nabhidhānameva hetuḥ ||

tāvatirthaṃ grahaṇamiti lugvā || 5.2.77 || yathā `tasyāpatyam' ityatra tasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantānāṃ sāmānyanirdeśaḥ, tathā tāvatithamiti pūraṇapratyayāntānāṃ sāmānyanirddeśaḥ| pūraṇapratyayasya ceti| na tu kanaḥ luk; vāgrahaṇānarthakyaprasaṅgāt, mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena kana utpatteḥ pañcamaṃ grahaṇam, pañcamakaṃ grahaṇamiti rūpadvayasya siddhatvāt| tathā ca vārtitakam--`tāvatithaṃ grahaṇamiti lugvacanānarthakyaṃ vibhāṣāprakaraṇāt' iti| ato lugvāgrahaṇaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasya pūraṇapratyasya vā lugvidhīyata iti pakṣo lakṣyate dvitīyena rūpeṇa granthaṃ gṛhṇātīti| atra grahaṇe dvitīyasya karaṇatvaṃ pradarśayitumidaṃ vākyam| vastutastu dvitīyaṃ grahaṇaṃ devadattasyeti vigrahītavyam| dvikaṃ grahaṇamiti| grahītaryapi pratyayo vakṣyate, tena prakṛtyupādhibhūtasya grahaṇasya niyamenāpratītergrahaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ| dvikaṃ rūpaṃ devadattasyetyeva tu nodāhṛtam, svacchandato hi vacasāṃ pravṛttiḥ| catuṣka iti| sanniyogaśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā ḍaṭi nivṛtte thuko'pi nivṛttiḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ, `idudupadhasya' iti ṣatvam|
tāvatitheneti| svārthe pratyayo vidhīyamāno grahītari na prāpnotīti vacanam| nityaṃ ca lukaṃ vakṣyāmīti| ṣaṭka iti| rūpaśabdasya vākye prayuktasyāpi vṛttau gamyamānatvādaprayogaḥ, padatvājjaśtvacarttve| iha yaḥ ṣaṣṭhena rūpeṇa gṛhṇāti ṣaṅbhirasau rūpairgṛhṇāti, tataḥkiṃ saṅkhayāyāḥ, tena gṛhṇātītyeva vaktavyam, evaṃ hi lugveti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hyucyamāne ihāpi prāpneti--ekena rūpeṇa gṛhṇātīti| pūraṇapratyayastvekaśabdānnāsti, tena granthaviṣayameva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata iti| teneha na bhavati--dvitīyo hasto grahaṇo daṇḍasyoti ||

sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ || 5.2.78 ||
iha tvatko matko vā vijaya ityādāvanena kan| tvaṃ grāmaṇīrasya tvatkaḥ, ahaṃ grāmaṇīrasya matkaḥ| prāyeṇa tvidamarthamātre prayujyate ||

śṛṅkalamasya bandhanaṃ karabhe || 5.2.79 ||
nanu na śṛṅkhalamātreṇa karabho baddhayate, kiṃ tahi ? rajjvā, kīlena ca, tasmācchṛṅkalamasya bandhanamiti na yuktaṃ vaktum, evaṃ tu vaktavyam---`śṛṅkhalavadasya sambanadhanaṃ karabhe kukca matoḥ iti ? tatrāha--yadyapīti| astu rajjvāderapi karaṇatvam, śṛṅkhalasyāpi karaṇatvamastveva; tadantareṇa bandhanasyānirvṛtterityarthaḥ ||

utka unmanāḥ || 5.2.80 ||
ucchabdātsasādhanakriyāvacanāditi| sādhanam-manaḥ, kriyā-gamanam, udrate manasi varttamānādityarthaḥ| yadvatīti| udgataṃ mano yasya tasminnityarthaḥ| utsukaḥ-utkaṇṭhitaḥ ||

kālaprayojanādroge || 5.2.81 ||
arthalabhyeti| artha-sāmardhyam, tena labhyā| tatra kāle saptamī samarthavibhaktiḥ, bhavo hi tatra pratyayārthaḥ| prayojane tṛtīyā, janito hi tatra pratyayārthaḥ| phale tu prayojane prathamā| prayojanaṃ kāraṇaṃ rogasya phalaṃ ceti| ubhayamapi prayojayatīti prayojanamucyate| yadi tarhi kāraṇamapi prayojanamucyate, kālagrahaṇamanarthakam, katham ? yo'sau dvitīye'hni bhavo jvarastasya dvitīyamapyahaḥ kāraṇam; aharantare tadanutpatteḥ? satyam; sadapi kāraṇatvaṃ yadā na vivakṣyate `tatra bhavaḥ' ityeva tu vivakṣyate, tadāpi yathā syādivyevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇam| dvitīye'hni bhava iti| sāmānyaśabdasyāpi dvitīyaśabdasyārthaprakaraṇādinā vṛttiviṣaye kāle'pi vṛtteḥ kālaśabdatvam| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sākṣātkālavācibhyo māsādibhyaḥ pratyayo na bhavati dvitīyādibhyaśca bhavati, tatrāpi saptamīsamarthebhyo bhavārtha eva bhavati kāraṇavācinastṛtīyāsamarthāt, phalavācinastu prathamāsamarthāt, na hyetatsarva sūtrākṣarairupāttam ? tatrāha--uttarasūtrāsaṃjñāgrahaṇamihānukṛṣyata iti| siṃhāvalokitanyāyena, yathā siṃhā dhāvantaḥ pṛṣṭhato'valokayante| apara āhauttarasūtre yogavibhāgaḥ, `tadasminnannaṃ prāye', tataḥ `saṃjñāyām', yadetadanukrāntaṃ tatsaṃjñāyāṃ draṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| saṃjñāgrahaṇamubhayoḥ śeṣaḥ, etadeva cānukarṣaṇaṃ vivakṣitam |
tadasminnannaṃ prāye saṃjñāyām || 5.2.82 ||
annam-abyavahāryam, adyate smeti kṛtvā| gukaḍāmiśrā apūpā guḍāpūpāḥ-kṛsarastilaudanaḥ, tilakṣoda ityanye| traibilo'pūpastripuṭaḥ| vaṭakebhya ini riti| kani prāpte vacanam| nanu saṃjñāgrahaṇātkanna bhaviṣyati, tasmiṃścāsati matvarthīya inirbhaviṣyati ? na siddhayati; `saptamyāṃ ca na taṃ smṛtau' iti vacanāt ||

kulmāṣādañ || 5.2.83 ||
kulmāṣāḥ-mudgāḥ ||

śrotriyam̐śchandodhīte || 5.2.84 ||
vākyārtha iti| vākyārthagrahaṇena tadāśrayaśchando'dyāyī puruṣa upacārāducyate, kutaḥ ? mukhyo hi vākyārthaḥ kriyārūpaḥ, sambandharūpo vā, sa cāsattvabhūtaḥ| śrotriyaśabdastu sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyī, tasminvākyārthe'vidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaḥ śrotriyaśabdo nipātyata ityarthaḥ| atha kathamasminapakṣe svarasiddhiḥ, yāvatā nakāra idyasya tatra parataḥ svaro vidhīyate, na cātraivaṃ vyapavargo'sti ? mā bhūdvayapavarge, nitkaraṇasāmarthyāttadabhāve'pi bhaviṣyati| yadvā, nitīti karmadhārayo'yam--naścāsāvicca nit, tatra parata iti|
kathamityādi| chandasaḥ śrotrabhāvo ghan ca pratyayaḥ, chāndasa iti na siddhyati; ghanā'ṇo bādhitatvāt, śrotrabhāvena ca chandaḥśabdasya nivartitatvāditi praśnaḥ| vāgrahaṇamanuvartata iti| apara āha--yaśchando'dhīte tadarthaṃ cānutiṣṭhati tatra śrotriyaśabdaḥ, adhyetṛmātre tu chāndaśabda ityarthabhedānnāsti bādhyabādhakatvamiti| `ekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriyo bhavati' iti dharmasāstram ||

śrādbhamanena bhuktaminiṭhanau || 5.2.85 ||
śrāddhaśabdaḥ kamanāmadheyamiti| śraddhayā niṣpādyasya piñyasya karmaṇaḥ śrāddhaśabdaḥ saṃjñā, śraddhāsminnastīti `prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ' iti ṇaḥ| tatsādhane dravya iti| mukhyaśraddhasya bhojanāsambhavāt| samānakālagrahaṇamitiṣa| bhujinā samāne kāle pratyayāntasya prayogo yathā syāt, yadyapi bhujikriyā katipayakṣaṇasādhyā, tathāpi yāvantaṃ kālaṃ tadāśinastṛptiśeṣastalliṅgaṃ cānuvartate tāvatsamānakālaḥ, sa ca prāyovṛttyā'dyatana eveti tasminneva pryayāntasya prayogaḥ| yadā tu kasyaciddurbalasya dvitīye'pyahni bhuktamapariṇataṃ tadā prayogābhāvaḥ| tadidamāha-adya bhukte śvaḥ śrāddhika iti kaprayogo mā bhūditi ||

pūrvādiniḥ || 5.2.86 ||
pūrvaṃ gatamanenetyādi| kriyāviseṣaṇād dvitīyāntātpratyayaḥ ||

sapūrvacca || 5.2.87 ||
vidyamānaṃ pūrvamasminniti sapūrvamiti| `tena saheti tulyayoge' ityupādhivacanasya prāyikatvādvidyamānavacanasyāpi samāsaḥ| pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca śabdāntaraṃ pūrvaśabdasyāvayava upapadyate| pakārastvavyabhicārī, tena prātipadikasyaitadviśeṣaṇam--sapūrvaṃ yatprātipadikamiti| evaṃ ca pūrvaśabdo'pi tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirityāha--tasya pūrvaśabdena tadantavithadhiriti| sapūrvādityādi| yadyapi pūrvaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ sapūrvameva, tathāpi asati sapūrvagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna labhyata iti `sapūrvāt' ityuktam| kṛtakarmaṇoḥ kṛti' ityatrāyaṃ prayoga upapāditaḥ|
yogadvayenetyādi| yadi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt `pūrvādiniḥ sapūrvāt' ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāt, vyapadeśivadbhāvātkevalādapi bhaviṣyati, kiṃ yogadvayakaraṇena! atra cakāraḥ karttavyo na bhavati| yadi ca `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt, `pūrvādiniḥ' ityetāvadeva brūyāt, tadantavidhinā sapūrvādapi bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ dvitīyena yogena ! tadiha yogadvayena paribhāṣādvayaṃ jñāpyate ||

chandasi paripanthiparipariṇau paryavasthātari || 5.2.89 ||
atra paryavasthātṛśabdātsvārthe inipratyayo'vasthātṛśabdasya ca panthi, pari--ityetāvādeśau nipātyete| bhāṣāyāṃ tu paripanthiśabdasyāsādhuḥ prayogaḥ ||

anupadyanveṣṭā || 5.2.90 ||
padasya paścādanupadam, paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, anveṣṭarīnipratyayo nipātyate| anupadī gavābhiti| padāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, gopadasya paścādanveṣaṇaṃ gavāmeva, hiraṇyādāvanveṣye na bhavati; padābhāvāt| yadi tvanveṣṭaśabdātsvārthe inipratyayaḥ, eṣṭṛśabdasya ca padaśabda ādeso nipātyeta; yadi vā--śrotriyavadavidyamānaprakṛtipratyamanveṣṭari nipātyeta, tato gavāmiti ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnotikṛtapūrvī kaṭam, anuko bhāryāmabhiko dāsīmitivat dvitīyā prāpnoti; hiraṇyādau cānveṣye--anupadī hiraṇyamiti| tasmādyathoktameva sādhīyaḥ ||

sākṣād draṣṭari saṃjñāyām || 5.2.91 ||
sākṣācchabdo'vyayamiti| tena prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti sūtre pañcamyā aluk, udāharaṇe ca `avyayānāṃ bhamātre' iti ṭilopa iti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñāgrahaṇādityādi| tribhiḥ sākṣād dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati--yaśca dadāti, yasmai ca dīyate, yaśca pārśve sthitaḥ paśyati, tatra sarvatra pratyayaḥ prāpnoti| saṃjñāgrahaṇāddhanikādhamarṇayorna bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

kṣetriyac parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ || 5.2.92 ||
`kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' ityasmādyathāyogamadhikaraṇādau ṣṭran, kṣetram| parakṣetraṃ janmāntaraśarīramiti| ātmano nivāsasthānatvātkṣetram, paraṃ ca tatkṣetra ceti karmadhārayaḥ| tatra cikitsyaḥ-pratikāryopaneya ityarthaḥ, na tu tatra bhiṣajitavya iti| yadāha--nāmṛtasyeti |
atha veti| samuccaya evātra vivakṣitaḥ, na tu vikalpaḥ| vakṣyati--`sarvacaitatpramāṇam' iti| kṛtyaḥ śakyārthe, pūrvatra tu karmamātre, uttarayorarhārthe| sasyārtha iti| anena kṣetrasya parakīyatvamāha---paradārāḥ parakṣetramiti| karmaṇi ṣṭran, kṣetavyāḥ-gantavyāḥ, upagamanārhā dārāḥ-kṣetram| tatreti| tasminviṣaye| nigṛhītavya iti| daṇkaḍādinā ||

indriyamindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭamindrasṛṣṭamindrajuṣṭamindradattamiti vā || 5.2.93 ||
antodātta iti| `kṣetriyac' ityetatsāhacaryāt| rūḍhireveti| kimatra pramāṇam? ityāha tathā ceti| na hi yaugikeṣu vyutpatteraniyamo bhavati| indra ātmeti| kāryakāraṇasaṅgātaṃ pratīśvaratvāt| vijñiyate ca tamindraṃ santamindra ityācakṣate parokṣeṇeti| karaṇeneti| hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam| yathā punarayaṃ hetustathā darśayati--nākartṛkamiti| itikaraṇo hetau| na hi vāśyādikaraṇamanadhiṣṭhitaṃ kartrā pravartate| indreṇa dṛṣṭamiti| dṛṣṭam-jñātam, tathā ca kāryakāraṇasaṅghātaṃ prastutya bhavati vādaḥ---`sa etameva puruṣaṃ brahmatatamapaśyat', `idamadarśam' ityādi| kathaṃ punaścakṣurādikamātmanā sṛṣṭam ? ityāha--tatkṛteneti| śubhaṃ karma-vihitam, pratiṣiddham-aśubham--tadubhayaṃ militaṃ kāraṇānāmutpādakam; iṣṭāniṣṭānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ cakṣurādibhirupalambhāt| yathāyathāmiti| yo yasya viṣayaḥ--cakṣuṣo rūpam, ghrāṇasya gandha ityādi, tadgrahaṇāyetyarthaḥ|
anyathāpi karttavyeti| tadyathā--indreṇa durjayamiti| pratyokamabhisambadhyamāna iti| hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam; yasmātpratyekamabhisambadhyate tasmādityarthaḥ ||

tadasyāstyasminniti matup || 5.2.94 ||
asyāsminniti pratyayārthāviti| nanu ca yadyasya bhavati tasminnapi tadvati, yacca yasmin bhavati tasyāpi tadbhavati; yathā--vṛkṣasya śākhā, vṛkṣe śākheti; tatrānyataranirddeśenaiva siddham, kimarthamubhāvarthau nirddiśyete ? naitayauravaśyambhāvī samāveśaḥ; tathā hi--ṣaṣṭhyarthamātranirddeśe yatrādhikaraṇaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇa vivakṣyate, na tajjanyaḥ śeṣasambandhaḥ, yathā--vṛkṣā asminparvate santīti na tatra pratyayaḥ syāt| na hyatra kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ śeṣasambandho dṛśyate; vṛkṣaiḥ parvatasyānārambhāt nāvayavāvayavibhāvaḥ| ānantaryādisambandhastu sambhavati| na tu tatra matvarthīyo bhavati; anabhidhānāt| tathā kevalasaptamyarthanirddeśe kārakāntarapūrvaḥ sambandho na gṛhītaḥ syāt; tataśca putravān, gomānityādau na syād| utpādanapratigrahādikriyāviṣayakartṛtvajanyo hyatra sambandhaḥ, nādhārapūrvakaḥ; deśāntaragate'pi putrādau tadvāniti vyapadeśyasya bhāvāt| sāmīpikasyāpyadhikaraṇasyāsambhavaḥ| syādetat--putrasya pitradhīnatvādgavāṃ ca svāmyadhīnatvādgurau vasatītivadadhikaraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, karaṇasaṃjñāyāṃ hi tamabgrahaṇena kārakaprakaraṇe prakarṣasyānāśrayaṇādgauṇasyāpyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatyeveti ? bhavatvevamadhikaraṇasaṃjñā, matvarthāyastu mukhya evādhikaraṇe syāt--vṛkṣavān parvataḥ, gomāñjanapada ityādau; na gauṇe--putravān gomāndevadatta ityādau, na hyatra gauṇagrahaṇasya liṅgamasti| tasmādubhayorapi nirddeśaḥ kartavyaḥ| astīti prakṛti viśeṣaṣaṇāmiti| arthadvāreṇeti draṣṭavyam|
nanu sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇaviseṣyabhāvo bhavati nīlotpalavat, na ca sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati, tāmantareṇa padasyoccārayitumapyaśakyatvāt; tathā hiyāvadbudvayā padārtho na viṣayīkṛtastāvatpadasya prayogābhāvaḥ, tena buddhisattāsamāviṣṭamarthaṃ śabdo gocarayati, tasyaiva bahirasattvāsattvapratipādanāya vṛkṣo'sti, vṛkṣo nāstīti prayogaḥ| yadi bāhyasattāsamāvaliṣṭaṃ vastu vācyaṃ bhavet, tadā virodhapaunaruktyābhyāṃ prayogo na bhavedayam| evamevātyantāsato'pi bahiḥ śaśaviṣāṇādīnarthānbuddhyā viṣayīkṛtya tadvaciśabdaprayogaḥ| tasmād buddhyupārūḍhopacaritā sattā śabdaprayogasya nimittamiti na tāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati| taduktam---`na sattāṃ padārtho vyabhicarati' iti| kasyacitpadasyārthaḥ sannevaṃvidhāṃ sattāṃ na vyabhicaratītyarthaḥ ?
idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--yā sampratisattā mukhyā vartamānalakṣaṇā bāhyā tasyāṃ yathā syād, bhūtabhaviṣyatoryā sattātītānāgatavastuparāmārśinyā budvyotprekṣitopacaritarūpā tasyāṃ mā bhūt| tena gāvo'syāsan, gāvo'lasya bhavitāra ityatrārthe gomāniti prayogābhāvaḥ|
yadyevam, vidyamāna eva devadatte tadravīnāmatītānāgatatvapratipādanāya gomānāsīt gomānbhaviteti prayujyate, tatra prakṛtyarthasya sampratisattāyā abhāvātpratyāyāprasaṅkaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātra sākṣādgavāṃ sattā kathyate, kiṃ tarhi ? gomata eṣā sattā kathyate| yadi punargavāṃ sattā kathyeta; yathehāsteḥ prayogo na bhavati--gāvo'sya santi gomāniti pratyayenaiva prakṛtyarthopādheḥ pratītatvāt, tathehāpi na syāt--gomānāsīd, gomānbhaviteti| satyapi vā prayoge yatheha bahuvacanaṃ bhavati--gomānāsīd, gomānbhaviteti| satyapi vā prayoge yatheha bahuvacanaṃ bhavati--gāvo'syāsan, gāvo'sya bhavitāra iti; evamihāpi syādgomānāsīd, gomānbhaviteti| tasmānnaiṣā gavāṃ sattā kathyate, kiṃ tarhi ? gomatsattaiṣā kathyate| tatra yadyapi yo gomānsa vidyate, gomattārūpaṃ tu tasyādītamanāgataṃ veti bhūtabhaviṣyatprayogaḥ| yathā--īśvaro'yamāsīddaridro'yaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| tatrārthātprakṛtyarthasyāpyatītānāgatatvapratītirbhavati, sā vākyārthavaśādupajāyamānā bahirahgeti nāntaraṅgaṃ śabdasaṃskāraṃ nivartayati, yathā--grāmaṃ na gacchatīti| tadevaṃ samprati sattāyāṃ yathā--grāmaṃ na gacchatīti| tadevaṃ samprati sattāyāṃ yathā syād, bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamastītyucyata iti sthitam|
nanu ca yatrānyatkriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāstirbhavatiparaḥ prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pi gamyate, tataśca gāvo'sya gāvo'sminnityukte kimityapekṣāyāṃ santīti gaṃstate, nārtho'stigrahaṇena ? na sārvatrikametat; yadā khalu gāvo'sya nānyasya, gāvo'sminnānyasminnityevaṃ vivakṣā, na tadāstitvaṃ pratīyate| tasmādastīti vaktavyam|
atha kriyamāṇe'pyastigrahaṇe iha kasmānna bhavati--gāvo'sya santyanantarā iti ? sāpekṣatvenāsāmarthyāt| iha kasmānna bhavati-citraguḥ, śabalaguriti ? bahuvrīhiṇoktatvāt| vākye tu citrā gāvo'sya sannīti pratyekamasāmarthyānna bhavati, samudāyāttvaprātipadikatvāt| iha tu pañca gāvo'sya santi pañcaguḥ daśaguriti `taddhitārtha' iti dviguśca prāpnoti, bahuvrīhiśca; tatracitragurityādau sāvakāśaṃ bahuvrīhiṃ saṃkhyāvāciṣu dvigurbādheta, tataśca taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte vihitena dvigunā'nuktastaddhitārtha iti yatheha taddhito bhavati-dvaimāturaḥ, pāñcanāpitiriti, `dvigorluganapatye'ka iti lugapi prāgdīvyatīyasya vidhīyate, tena matupo lugalabhyaḥ| tasmāt `tadvitārtha' ityatra yaduktam `sarvatra matvarthe pratiṣedhaḥ' iti tadevātraka śaraṇam|
bhūmetyādi| astivivakṣāyāṃ ye matubādayo vidhīyante te bhūmādiṣu viṣayabhūteṣu bhavantītyarthaḥ|
bahūnāṃ bhāvo bhūmā, tatra bhūmni; gomān, yavamān| bahutvaṃ cābhidhānavaśādviśiṣṭamevāśrayaṇīyam, yadāha--`yāvatībhiḥ khalvapi gobhirvāhadohaprasavāḥ kalpante tāvatīṣu sattā kathyate, kasyaciccatasṛbhirapi kalpante kasyacicchatenāpi na kalpante' iti| evaṃ ca yavamāniti triprabhṛtiṣu bahutvasadbhāve'pi na bhavati| iha yavamatībhiradbhiryūpaṃ prokṣatīti jātimātrasambandho vivakṣita iti bhūmābhāve'pi bhavati| bhūmādigrahaṇaṃ tvabhidhānasvabhāvapradarśanārtham| nindāyāṃ kakudāvarttinī kanyā, praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpavān, nityayoge kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ, atiśāyane udariṇī kanyā| saṃsarge, saṃsargaḥ-saṃyogaḥ; daṇḍī saṃsaktadaṇḍa ucyate| gṛhāvasthite tu daṇḍīti na bhavati| kvacid vṛttau granthaḥ astivivakṣāyāmastimāniti| tatra bhūmādiṣvastivivakṣāyāṃ ca bhavati matubādaya iti samuccayo vyākhyeyaḥ| astiśabdo vibhaktipratirūpako nipātaḥ kartṛviviśiṣṭasattāvācī, naiṣo'sterlaṭ| pratyayāntaramapi dṛśyate--astitvam, astiteti| avyabhicārādastisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāstītyastivivakṣāyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyate| etacca sūtre `asti' iti tantreṇa luptapañcamīkaprakṛtinirddeśāśrayaṇāllabhyate| astimāniti ca vṛttiviṣaye kartṛviśeṣe dhane'stiśabdo varttate| na hi kartṛsāmānyena pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati, sarvasyaiva hi sarvadā yatkiñcidasti|
guṇavacanebhya iti| atra śuklādaya evābhinnarūpā guṇe tadvati ca vartamānā gṛhyante, na tu sarvadā guṇamātravacanā rūpādayaḥ| tatra yadyapyabhedopacārādeva śuklaḥ paṭa ityādisiddhiḥ, tathāpi paṭasya śukla iti bhedavivakṣāyā api darśanātpakṣe matupa utpannasya śravaṇaprasaṅgāllugvaktavya iti ||

rasādibhyaśca || 5.2.95 ||
na pūrveṇaiveti| naśabdasya kākvā prayogātsiddha evetyarthaḥ| nanvarthe vā naśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ| anye iti| `ata iniṭhanau' ityādayaḥ|
kathamiti| anyanivṛttyarthe punarvacane rūpiṇītyādi na siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ| prāyikamiti| prayogabāhulyābāhulyenāsyānyanivṛttiḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ| tataḥ kim? ityāha-kvaciditi| kathaṃ punaḥ prāyikatvamityāha--itikaraṇa iti| tena yatra matubantādeva lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, tatraivānenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate, na sarvatretyayamartho bhavati| etacca guṇāditi gaṇāditi gaṇapāṭhamanapekṣyoktam, tadapekṣāṃ matvā''ha-
atha veti| atra gaṇe guṇāditi paṭhyate, tacca rasādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na svatantram, nāpi `ekācaḥ' ityanena samānādhikaraṇam| tena ye rasanendriyādigrāhyaguṇā iti ādiśabdena cakṣurādiparigrahaḥ| teṣāmevāyaṃ pāṭha iti| tebhya evānenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate| rūpiṇī, rūpikaḥ śobhāyoga iti| nanu śobhāpi puṇastathā bhāvaḥ ? satyam; guṇāditi viśeṣaṇasāmarthyātprasiddhatarāṇāṃ rasanādīndriyagrāhyāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ pāṭhaḥ| bhāvayoga iti| bhāvāḥ-ratihāsādayo nāṭyadharmāḥ|
bhāṣye tu `urvaśī vai rūpiṇyapsarasāṃ sparśiko vāyuḥ' iti darśanādyathābhidhānaṃ pratyayāntaramapi bhavati, tena niyamasyāniṣṭatvātsūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam|
ekāca iti| atra guṇāditi nāpekṣyate--svavān, khavān ||
prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām || cūḍāla iti| cūḍā-śikhā, na tvāpīḍākhyo'laṅkāraḥ| evaṃ karṇikāpi na karṇikāpi na karṇālaṅkāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tatsadṛśaḥ prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣaḥ| prāṇyaṅgādeva hīṣyate|
śikhāvāndīpa iti| pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā; śikhāśabdasya vrīhyādipāṭhāllaco'prasaṅgāt| cūḍāvānvṛkṣa iti pratyudāhāryam|
prāṇyaṅgāditi vaktavyamiti| etaccetikaraṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| cūḍālo'sīti| asītyasya `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ, cūḍālaśabdātsuḥ, rutvam, `ato roraplutādaplute' ityukāraḥ, sa ca halāṃ sraṃsanadharmatvādanudāttaḥ, pūrveṇa `ādguṇaḥ', `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ', tataḥ `eḍaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpatvamekādeśaḥ, tasya `svarito vānudātte'padādau' iti svaritaḥ prāpnoti, citkaraṇasāmarthyānna bhavati| yadyevam, cūḍālaḥ--āmantritādyudāttatve śeṣanighāto na syāt, he cūḍālaāmantritanidhāto na syāt, cūḍālatvamityādau ca pratyayasvare śeṣanighātaḥ ? yadīṣyate, vaktavyo'tra parihāraḥ; atha neṣyate, prayojanamevaitaccitsvarasya bhavīṣyati ||

sidhmādibhyaścaḥ || 5.2.97 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena bhatupsamuccīyata iti| anekārthatvānnipātānām, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha samuccaye varttata ityarthaḥ| tathā ca vārttikam--`lajanyatarasyāmiti samuccayaḥ' iti| na tu pratyayo vikalpyata iti| yathānyatrānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ na tathātretyarthaḥ| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavati ? tatrāhatasmāditi| vikalpārthe'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe lacā mukte yathāprāptame syāt, tataścākārāntebhya iniṭhanau syātām, samuccayārthe prakṛto matubeva samuccīyata iti na doṣaḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyate-samuccayo'trārthaḥ, na vikalpo'rtha iti ? jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ picchādīn, tundādīśca pṛthak paṭhati| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam ? iha `tundādibhya ilacca' iti catvāraḥ pratyayā iṣyante-ilac, iniṭhanau, matubiti; tatra yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ syātpicchādibhyo'pipratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ syāt| katham ? ilaco vikalpitatvādiniṭhanau, tayorapi vikalpitatvānmatubiti; tataśca tundādiṣveva picchādayaḥ pāṭhyāḥ, picchādiṣu vā tundādayaḥ; pṛthakpāṭhādvijñāyate-`anyatassyāṃgrahaṇena matupsamuccīyate,na yathāprāptamabyanujñāyate' iti| evaṃ hi picchādibhyaḥ pratyayadvayam--ilacca, matup ca; tundādibhyaścatvāra iti pṛthak pāṭho'rthavānbhavati| nanu ca tundādibhyo'nakārāntebhyo'pīniṭhanāviṣyate, picchādibhyastvakārāntebhya eva; tatra yadi tundādiṣu picchādayaḥ paṭhyeran, tadā picchādibhyo'pyanakārāntebhya iniṭhanau syātām ? atha picchādiṣu tundādayaḥ paṭhyeran, tadā tundādibhyo'pyākāranteyya iniṭhau na syātām ? cattarhi kānicidakārāntāni picchādiṣu paṭhati, kāni cittundādiṣu, tadyathoktasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ bhaviṣyati| tathā `keśādvo'nyatarasyām' iti na vaktavyam; prakṛtānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvattyā inṭhanmatupāṃ siddhatvāt| tadiniṭhanoḥka prāptyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ pūrvasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya samuccayārthatvaṃ jñāpayati|
pārṣṇidhamanyordīrdhaśceti| pārṣṇīlaḥ, dhamanīlaḥ| vātadantabalalalāṭānāmūṅ ceti| vātādibhyo laj bhavati, tasya ca laca ūḍāgamo bhavati--vātūlaḥ, dantūlaḥ, balūlaḥ, lalāṭūlaḥ| jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepa iti| etai śabdāḥ kṣepe gamyamāne lacamutpādayanti--jaṭāla ityādi| kṣepa iti kim ? jaṭāvāṃstāpasaḥ| kṣudrajantūpatāpayośceti| cudrajanturānakulāt, upatāpaḥ-rogaḥ| vipādikāla iti| `pādasphoṭo vipādikā'| sidhma-gaḍuśabdayoranupatāpārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ ||

vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale || 5.2.98 ||
kāmavati balavati ceti| matvantanirddeśena kāmabalaśabdayorarśaādyacpratyayāntatāṃ darśayati|
nanu ca vatsāṃsaśabdau vayoviśeṣe prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣe ca rūḍhau, na kāmabalayo; tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ lajantābhyāṃ kāmavān balavāṃścocyate ? ityata āha--vṛttiviṣaya iti| kuta etad jñāyate ? ityāha-na hyatreti| vākye yo'nayoḥ prāsiddho'rthaḥ sa vṛttau nāstītyartha| yastvasti taṃ darśayatadi--vatsala iti snehavānupyata iti| snehaḥ-rāgaḥ, kāmaḥ|
sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe matupsamuccīyata ityatrāpi matupā bhavitavyamiti śaṅkāmapanayati--na ceti| anenaiva hetunā vākyamapi na bhavati| atra vatsāṃsabdau dvau, asyāsminniti ca pratyayarthāvapi dvāveva tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, katham ? ajādyadantaṃ laghvakṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ nipatatītyaṃsabalaśabdayoḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātalakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt| evaṃ sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe draṣṭavyam ||

lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ || 5.2.100 ||
aṅga kalyāṇa iti| `aṅga' ityetat kalyāṇaviśiṣṭe'rthe varttamānaṃ pratyayamutpādayati--kalyāṇānyaṅgānyasya aṅganā, striyā evābhidhānam| kalyāṇa iti kim ? aṅgavatī| śākīpalālīdadravāṃ hrasvatvaṃ ceti| śākyādīnāṃ napratyayo bhavati hrasvatvaṃ ca-śākinam, palālinam| mahacchākaṃ śākī, nānājātīya ekasamāhāro vā| palālakṣodaḥ-palālī, bhinnāni vā śalikodravādipalalāni| `daridrāteryālopaśca' iti daridrāterūkāraḥ pratyayo bhavati, rikārākārayośca lopaḥ| dadrūḥ-tvagrogaviśeṣaḥ, sa yasyāsti sa dadruṇaḥ| viṣvagiti| viṣvakśabdānnapratyayo bhavati uttarapadalopaśca, sa cākṛtasanderakṛtasandhikāryasya, akṛtayaṇādeśasyetyarthaḥ| viṣu nānā añcantīti viṣvañci, tānyasya santīti viṣuṇaḥ- viṣuṣuvadākhyaḥ kālaḥ, tasya hi nānāgatīni dināni santi, tadāśrayatvāddivasāntarāṇāṃ nyūnādhikabhāvasya| tathā mṛtyuḥ, vayuḥ, anavasthitaprakṛtirmanuṣyādiśca viṣuṇaḥ, tatra vṛttiviṣaye gamanakriyāntarbhāvādviṣvaggamanamasyāskatītyevaṃ vākyaderabhidānamicchanti| yadi tu kṛte yaṇādeśe uttarapadalopaḥ syād, vali lope sati viṣṇa iti prāpnoti| lakṣmyā acceti| lakṣmīśabdānnapratyayo bhavati akāraścāntādeśaḥ, lakṣaamīrasyāsti lakṣmaṇaḥ| jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepa iti| jaṭādayaḥ kṣepe gamyamāne ilacamutpādayanti--jaṭilaḥ, ghaṭilaḥ, kalilaḥ| kṣepādanyatra jaṭāvān ||

prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ || 5.2.101 ||
sūtre vṛttiśabdo vārtike darśanātprakṣiptaḥ---`vṛttirvicchedapratividānāt' iti|
prajñāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham? prājña ityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| `prajñādibhyaśca' ityaṇi kute siddhametat, prajña eva prājñaḥ, yasya hi prajñā'sti sa prajānāti ? satyam; striyāṃ tvaṇi ṅīb bhavati--prājñī, asmistu ṇe ṭāveva bhavati--prājñā| iha tu guṇabhūtayā kriyayā vyākaraṇādināṃ sambandhe ṇāṇorubhayorapi vyākaraṇam--prājñaiti bhavati, yathā--kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti taddhitaprayoge hi ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyuktam ||

tapassahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī || 5.2.102 ||
vinīnyorikāraḥ--nakārasyetsaṃjñā mā bhūditi| kecittu vinīnāvitīkārākārau paṭhanti, nakārāntapāṭhe tvitsaṃjñā prāpnoti| pratyayārthayostvityādi| yathā tvaniṣyamāṇamapi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati tathā pūrvamevoktam| asantatvādityādi| tapaḥ śabdād `asmāyāmedhā' ityādinā vinipratyaye siddhe sahasraśabdādapi `ata iniṭhanau' itīnipratyaye siddhe, yatpunaridaṃ vidhānaṃ tadvakṣyamāṇenāṇā bādhā mā bhūdityevamartham| aṇeti| hetau tṛtīyā| kartari tu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na prāpnoti, ubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeveti niyamāt tṛtīyā bhaviṣyati, vinīnyorbādhā mā bhūditi karmaṇo'pi gamyamānatvāt, yathā-` yenādarśanamicchati' iti ? naitadasti, akākārayoḥ prayoge niyamasya pratiṣedhāt, tasmāddhetāveva tṛtīyā| ghañnto vā bādhaśabdaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ| sahasraśabdādaṭṭhanapi bādhyata iti| bādhā tu ṭhana inaṇoḥ pratipadavidhānāt ||

aṇ ca || 5.2.103 ||
aṇprakaraṇe ityādi| prakaraṇam prastāvaḥ, kāṇḍaṃ vā| jyotsnātamisretyādisūtre paṭhitānāṃ grahaṇam| jyautsnaḥ pakṣa iti| sa punaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ tatra hi pañcadaśasvapi tithiṣu jyotsnā bhavatīti kṛtsnaḥ pakṣo jyotsnayā vyāpyate| etena tāmisro vyākhyātaḥ, tamaḥsamūhastāmisram, matvarthīyo raḥ| tatra hyavayavabhūtāni tamāṃsi vidyante tadhasminnasti sa tāmisro|paraḥ pakṣaḥ| tamisrārātriryasminvidyata iti vā tāmisraḥ, narakaviśeṣasyaiṣā saṃjñā| kuṇkaḍalārhaḥ kauṇkaḍalaḥ| tatra yathākathañcinmatvarthīya upapādyaḥ| yastu saṃsaktakuṇkaḍalaḥ sa kuṇḍalī bhavati| ayaṃ ca niyama itikaraṇānuvṛtterla bhyate ||

sikatārśarkarābhyāṃ ca || 5.2.104 ||
śārkaraṃ madhviti| śarkarā mādhuryam, na tu guḍaḥ, madhuni tasyābhāvāt|
adeśa ihodāharaṇamiti| deśe viseṣasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt ||

deśe lubilacau ca || 5.2.105 ||
matup ceti| anyatarasyāgrahaṇena matupaḥ sarvatra samuccayāt| sikatā deśa iti| lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ|
deśe iti kimiti|| etena yogavibhāgo'pi paryanuyukta eva bhavati, tena `sikatāśarkarābhyāṃ lubilacau ca' ityeva kasmānna kṛtamityarthaḥ ||

danta unnata urac || 5.2.106 ||
dantaśabdādunnatopādhikāditi | sūtre tu pañcamyarthe prathamā, saptamī vā| dantā unnatā asya dantura iti| `himaśilāśarkarādanturāṇi' ityādayo lakṣaṇāprayogāḥ ||

ūṣasuṣimuṣkamadho raḥ || 5.2.107 ||
samāhāradvandve sautraḥ pulliṅga nirdeśaḥ| suṣimadhubhyāṃ matupi prāparte itarābhyāminiṭhanośca ro vidhīyate| ūṣāḥ-hariṇapāṃsavaḥ, suṣiḥ-chidram, muṣkau-aṇkaḍau| madhu-mādhuryākhyo rasaviśeṣaḥ, na mākṣikaṃ mādhvīkaṃ vā; anabhidhānāt| evaṃ ca madhvidaṃ madhuramiti madhunyapi prayogopapattiḥ| iha ca na bhavati--madhvasmin ghaṭo vidyata iti|

raprakaraṇa iti| prakaraṇam-prastāvaḥ| kaṇṭhavivaraṃ mahaditi| gardabhe vyutpattiṃ darśayati| taikṣaṇye tvavyutpannaḥ kharaśabdaḥ| mukharaḥ-vācāla; tasya hi sarvasminvaktavye mukhamasti; vaktavyāvaktavyavivekābhāvāt| mukham-vāgindriyam| hastihanuḥ kuñjaśabdenocyata iti| vṛttiviṣaye| etacca sambhavannavayavārthaḥ kimiti tyajyata ityabhiprāyeṇoktam| jātiśabdastu kuñjaraśabdo hastiśabdavat|
nagaramiti| nagāḥ-vṛkṣāḥ, parvatāśca| ayamapi jātiśabda eva, tathā canagarī, jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ bhavati| nagaśabdo'yamaśmādiṣu paṭhyate iti vuñchaṇādiśūtreṇāsya siddhatvāt, tasmādro na vaktavyaḥ| pāṇḍuramiti| pāṇḍuḥ-śuklo varṇaḥ, tadvatpāṇḍuraḥ| pāṇkaḍaraśabdastvavyutpanna eva guṇamātre guṇini ca vartate ||

dyudrubhyāṃ maḥ || 5.2.108 ||
dyuśabdo'pyutpannaṃ prātipadikamukārāntam| rūḍhiṣu ca matubna vikalpyate iti| tadarthasya matupābhidhātumaśakyatvāt ||

keśādvo'nyatarasyām || 5.2.109 ||
matupsamuccayārthaṃ tadityuktamiti| etacca `sidhmādibhyaśca' ityatraiva vyākhyātam|
vaprakaraṇa iti| prakaraṇam-prastāvaḥ| maṇivaḥ-nāgaviśeṣaḥ| hiraṇyavaḥ-nidhiviseṣaḥ, kuñjaraviśeṣa ityanye| vimbāvaḥ, kurarāva iti| `anyeṣāmapi dṛśthate' iti dīrghaḥ| rājīva iti| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣantātpratyayaḥ|
arṇava iti| arṇam-udakam, `artterasunnuṭ ca'| chandasīvanipau ceti| cakārādvalaśca, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛttestu matup, tadāha---
vaśca matup ceti| rathīriti| ratho'syāstītyarthaḥ| sumaṅgalīriti| suṣṭhumaṅgalam, `suḥ pūjāyām' iti prādisamāsaḥ, tato'nena matvarthīya īkāraḥ, lāghavādbahuvrīhiṇā bhavitavyamiti nyāyaśchāndasatvādāśritaḥ|
maghavānamiti| maghaṃ dhanaṃ tadasyāstīti vanip| matupi tu maghavacchabdaḥ, kimarthaṃ tarhi `maghavā bahulam' iti ? tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| udvā ceti| ucchabdādudgatābhidhāyinā vapratyaye ṭāp| udvatīti| matupaḥ `jhayaḥ' iti vatvam, ṅīp|
medhārathābhyāmiti| idamapi chandoviṣayam ||

gāṇḍyajāt saṃjñāyām || 5.2.110 || gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuriti| arjunasya| ajagavaṃ dhanuriti| pinākametat| ubhayathā sūtraṃ praṇītamiti| tantranyāyāśrayeṇa| prayogaścobhayathāpi bhavati--`gāṇḍīvī kanakaśilānibhaṃ bhujābhyām' `adhirohati gāṇḍivaṃ maheṣau' iti ca| saṃjñāgrahaṇasyaiva prapañcaḥ ||

rajaḥ kṛṣyāsutipariṣado valac || 5.2.112 ||
āsutīvala iti| `ṣuñ abhiṣave', ktin, āsutiḥ-abhiṣavaḥ| pariṣadūla iti| paritaḥ sīdantīti pariṣat, `satsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip, `sadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam| parṣacchabdamanye paṭhanti, `śadibhaso'diḥ' bāhulakātpṛṣerapi bhavati--`parṣadeṣā daśāvarā' iti hi dṛśyate; `pārṣadakṛtireṣā tatra bhavatām' `sarvavedapārṣadaṃ hīdaṃ śāstram' iti ca bhāṣye| `parṣadvalāmahābrahmaurāgataiḥ kaṭhakāśramāt' iti ca bhaṭṭikāvye| pariṣacchabdastu prasiddha eva--`sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate' iti manuḥ| atra ca sūtre ubhayorapi ubhayathā sūtrapraṇayanāt|
bhrātṛvala iti | `valaḥ' ityatrāṇgrahaṇānuvatterdīrghābhāvaḥ| putravalaḥ, utsāhavala ityatra tvasaṃjñayāṃ dīrghābhāvaḥ| saṃjñāyāṃ tu dīrghatvam, `valaḥ' ityatra hi `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām' ityataḥ `sajñāyām' ityanuvarttate ||

dantaśikhātsaṃjñāyām || 5.2.113 ||
dantāvalaḥ-gajaḥ, `dantī dantāvalo hastī' ityamarasiṃhaḥ| śikhāvalaṃ nagaramiti| nanu deśe `śikhāyā valac' iti cāturarthikenaiva siddham, taccāvaśyaṃ karttavyam--nirvṛttādyartham ? satyam; ihāpi sikhāgrahaṇamadeśārthamavaśyaṃ karttavyam, ihāpi yathā syāt--śikhāvālā sthūpeti| yadyevaṃvidhā saṃjñā bhavati, tatra deśe matvarthe paratvādanenaiva lajyukta iti matvā śikāvalaṃ nagaramityudāhṛtam ||

jyotsnātamisrāśrṛṅgiṇorjasvinnūrjasvalagominmalinamalīsāḥ || 5.2.114 ||
jyotsnā candraprabheti| tatrāvayavabhūtaṃ jyotirastīti matvarthopapattiḥ| etena tamaḥ samūhe tamisraśabdo vyākhyātaḥ| nighaṇṭuṣu tu tamaḥ paryāyastamisraśabdaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tatra samūhasamūhinorabhedopacāraḥ| strītvamatantramiti| vyākhyānamatra śaraṇam| śrṛṅgādinacpratyaya iti| yadyapi sūtre cakāro'nucyāritaḥ, tathāpyantodāttasyoccāraṇādevaṃ kalpyate| urjo'sugāgama iti| urjasvatīḥ, payasvatīḥ| ūrjasvat, payasvadityasunantānmatup dṛśyate, iha tvanāśrayaṇe heturmagyaḥ| sūtre ūrjasvingominniti nāntatvābhivyaktaye nalopo na kṛtaḥ ||

ata iniṭhanau || 5.2.115 ||
akārāntāditi| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati, acchabdāntātkurvat, pacadityevamāderiti `rasādibhyaḥ' punarvacanāt| taddhyanena prāptayoriniṭhanorbādhanārthamityuktam|
tapakaraṇaṃ kimiti| vrīhāyādiṣu mālādīnāmākārāntānāṃ pāṭho niyamārtho bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| kimākārāntaviṣayo niyamaḥ ? uta strīpratyayāntaviṣayaḥ ? āhosvidābantaviṣayaḥ ? iti sandehasambhavādaghaśyaṃ karttavyaṃ taparakaraṇamityuttare'bhiprāyaḥ| ekākṣarāditi| rasādibhyaḥ punarvacanamanyanivṛttyarthamityuktam, tatra ca `ekācaḥ' iti paṭhītam, tenaitatsiddham| kāryīti| kāryaśabdātkṛdantāt pratyayaḥ| tandulīti| jāteḥ ||

vrīhyādibhyaśca || 5.2.116 ||
śikhādibhya iti| śikhādayo'traiva vakṣyante|
ikanyavakhadādiṣviti| viṣayasaptamyeṣā| ete'pyatraiva pakṣayante| ikanniti| ṭhannityarthaḥ| pūrvācāryaprakriyāpekṣastvikanniti nirddeśaḥ ślokapūraṇārthaḥ| pariśiṣṭebhya ubhayamiti| etacca sarvamitikaraṇānuvṛtterlabhyate|
evaṃ tarhīti| viparyayastu na bhavati--tatra svarūpagrahaṇam, ihārthagrahaṇāmiti; asañjātavirodhitvenānaiva svarūpagrahaṇasya yuktatvāt ||
śīrṣānnaña iti| nañaḥ paro yaḥ śīrṣaśabdastasmādiniṭhanau bhavataḥ---aśīrṣī, aśīrṣikaḥ| na vidyate śiro yasya sa evamucyate| `aci śīrṣe' iti śirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ, vākye'pi tasyaiva bhīvino nirddeśaḥ ||

tundadibhya ilacca || 5.2.117 ||
svāṅgādvivṛddhāditi| vivṛddhyupādhikātsvāṅgavācina ilajādayo bhavanti, vivṛddhau karṇāvasya kaṇilaḥ, karṇī, kaṇikaḥ, karṇavān ||

ekagopūrvāṭṭañ nityam || 5.2.118 ||
ekaśatamasyāstīti| ekaṃ ca tacchataṃ ceti `pūrvakāle' ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣād bahuvrīherdvandvācca na bhavati; anabhidhānāt; itikaraṇānuvṛtteśca|
kathamiti| ekagośabdasyāpyanakārāntatvātpraśanaḥ| samāsānte kṛta iti| `gorataddhitaluki' iti ṭaci| kathamiti| ivarṇānta eva śakakaṭiśabdo'stīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ--anabhidhānādeva ekaviṃśatyādibhyo na bhaviṣyati, kim `ata' ityasyānuvṛttyā? tatrāha--avaśaṃ ceti| evamādyarthamiti| evamādi yatsūtraṃ tadarśamityarthaḥ| tataḥ pare tu ye yogāḥ `vātātīsārābhyām' ityevamādayaḥ, teṣu `ataḥ' ityasyopayogo nāstīti|
nityagrahaṇamityādi| anyathānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sarvatraivānna prakaraṇe matupsamuccayādatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ| ekena veti| yadyavaśyaṃ samarthayitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra `supsupā' iti samāsaḥ| kathamekadaṇkaḍīti ? `ekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe' iti nirdeśo jñāpayati--inirapi kvacidbhavatīti ||

śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt || 5.2.119 ||
niṣkādityetad guṇabhūtābhyāmapi śatasahasrābhyāṃ sambadhyate, na tadantenetyāha---tau cediti|
suvarṇāniṣkaśatamityādi| yatra niṣkaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ|
antagrahaṇaṃ kim ? `niṣkācchatasahasrābhyām' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt--kiṃ pūrvapadam ?--iti ||

rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap || 5.2.120 ||
rūpyo dīnāra iti| puruṣādyākāracihnitau suvarṇaparimāṇaviśeṣau vyavahārāya kalpitau dīnārakārṣāṇau| nigātikātāḍanādineti| tīkṣṇāgrā āyasī śalākā-nigātikā, yayā puruṣādyākakāraṃ suvarṇādau suvarṇakārā udbhāvayanti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti karaṇe ṇval--nihānyate'nayā nighātikā, tayā yattāḍanam, tadādinā| ādiśabdena mudrāpratimudraṇādi gṛhyate| kvacinnighātikātāḍanena puruṣādyākāra udbhāvyate, kvacinmudrayā pratimudrayate dīnārādiṣu, tadāhatamityucyata iti| āhananena niṣapāditatvāt|
prāyeṇa kedāraśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tasyaivaṃvidhe'rthe prasiddhirmṛgyā|
himyāḥ parvatā iti| himavān tatparyantavarttinaśca bhūmni yap| gupyāḥ-guṇavantaḥ| inirapi dṛśyate--`guṇyaguṇya iti na vyajīgaṇat ' ||

āsmāyāmedāsrajo viniḥ || 5.2.121 ||
matup sarvatra samuccīyata eveti| pūrvaṃ nityagrahaṇena anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ tatraiva na sambadhyate, iha tu sambadhyata evetyeva śabdasyārthaḥ| tathā ca `tasau matvarthe' ityatra payasvān yaśasvāniti bhāṣye udāhṛtam| payasvīti| `tasau matvarthe' iti bhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ ||

bahulaṃ chandasi || 5.2.122 ||
aṣṭrāvīti| aśeṣṭrani aṣṭrā, daṃṣṭāparyāyo'yaṃ mantreṣu prayujyate--`aṣṭrāṃ pūṣā śithirāmudvarīvṛjat', `śunamaṣṭrā vyacaratkapardī' iti, tatrāsmādeva pāṭhāṭṭāpa| dvayobhayahṛdayāniti| anyeṣāṃ svata eva dīrghatvāt|
hṛdayāccāluranyatarasyāmiti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇeneniṭhanau prāpyete, cakārasya `cuṭū' itītsaṃjñā| evamuttaratrāpi| ante tu cakāro naivāsti|
himācceluriti| ekārādiḥ pratyayaḥ|
balādūlajiti| sidhmādiṣu matvarthe balūlavālūlayoḥ prakārāntareṇa vyutpattirdarśitā|
parvamarudbhyāṃ tanniti| ādyudāttārtho nakāraḥ| marutto nāma rājā, yatredaṃ kṣūyate--`marutaḥ pariveṣṭāro maruttasyāvasn gṛhe' iti| upasargasaṃjñāyāṃ tu marucchabdasyopasaṃkyānād `aca upasargāttaḥ' iti tatvamanajantatve'pi bhavati| `maruta enaṃ deyāsurmaruttaḥ' iti vyutpattirdarśitā| tatra `tṛtīyā karmaṇi' iti pūrvapadaprakatisvaraḥ prāpnoti| marucchabdaḥ `mṛgorutiḥ' iti utipratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ tatra `upasargāścabhivarjam' ityādyudāttatvaṃ draṣṭavyam ||

ūrṇāyā yus || 5.2.123 ||
ūrṇāyuriti|ka padatvādyasyetilopo na bhavati ||

vāco gminiḥ || 5.2.124 ||
vāggmīti| cakārasya kutvajaśtve, dvayorgakārayoḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavati| atha minireva kasmānnocyate, tatrāpi hi kutvajaśtvayorvāggmīti siddhyatyeva; nanu caivameko gakāraḥ syāt, na ca `anaci ca' iti dvirvacanam, `dīrghādācāryāṇām' iti kapratiṣedhāt| athāpi dvayorekasya vā śravaṇe viśeṣo nāstītyucyeta ? evamapi `yaro'nunāsike' `pratyaye bhāṣāyāṃ nityavacanam' iti nityamanunāsikaḥ prāpnoti, tathā--vāṅbhayam, tvaṅbhayamiti ||
ālajāṭacau bahubhāṣiṇi || 5.2.125 || yo hi samyagagbhāṣata iti| bapahvapīti bhāvaḥ ||

svāminnaiśvarye || 5.2.126 ||
svaśabdādaiśvaryavācina iti| anyatrātmātmīyajñātidhānavacino'pi svaśabdasyaitadvṛttiviṣaye aiśvaryavācitvaṃ svabhāvato bhavati, tena dhanavānnirdhano veśitā svāmītyucyate, na tvayaṃ dhanavacanaḥ| tathā ca dhanasya svāmītyapi bhavati; anyathā matupa āminacā bādhaprasaṅgaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena matupsamuccaye'pi dhanasya śvāmativad dhanasya svavānityapi prāpnoti| tasmādaisvaryavacanaḥ svaśabdaḥ, na dhanādivacana iti sthitam| dhanayogādaiśvaryamityapi nāsti; kavāgādiviṣaye'pi darśanāt--vācaspatiḥ, vācaḥ svamīti; na ca tatra dhanatvaprasiddhirasti ||

arśaādibhyo'c || 5.2.127 ||
svāṅgāddhīnāditi| hīnam-vikalam| hīnasvāṅgavācino'ñbhavati| khañjaḥ pādo'syāstīti khañjaḥ| kāṇaṃ cakṣurasyāstīti kāṇaḥ| kathaṃ kuṇirhasto'syāsti kuṇiriti ? abhedopacārāt| khañjādiṣvapi tarhi tathaiva bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-bhedavivakṣāyāṃ matubmā bhūditi| atha kuṇiśabdānmatup kasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt| śañjādibhyo'pi tarhyanabhidhānādeva matubna bhaviṣyati ? antodāttārthaṃ tu| ye ādyudātā hīnasvāṅgavācinasteṣvantodāttatvaṃ yathā syād, yadi sambhavati| varṇāditi| varṇavācinaḥ śuklaśabdādacpratyayo bhavati-śuklo'syāstīti śuklaḥ paṭaḥ| `guṇavacanebhyo matupo lugvaktavyaḥ' iti siddham ? antodāttārthaṃ tu| ye ādyudāttā varṇavācinasteṣu tadvatyantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| apara āha--guṇivacanebhyo'yaṃ tadvati pratyayo vidhīyate, tena śuklāḥ prāsādā asminnagare śuklaṃ nagaramiti bhavatīti ||

dvandvopatāpagarhyatpraṇisthādiniḥ || 5.2.128 ||
tadviṣayebhya iti| tacchabdenopatāpo garhyaṃ ca pratyavamṛśyate, na dvandvaḥ; tasyaiva tadviṣayatvāsambhavāt| prāṇisthārthavācibhya iti| idaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam| citralalāṭikāvatīti| niyatadravyavivakṣāyāṃ `jātiraprāṇinām' ityekavadbhāvābhāvāṭṭāpaḥ śravaṇam| siddhe pratyaya iti| `ata iniṭhanau' ityanena| ṭhanādibādhanārthamiti| ādiśabdena matupo guhaṇam ||

vātātisārābhyāṃ kuk ca || 5.2.129 ||
vātātisārayorupatāpatvāditi| atisārasāhacaryādvātasyāpi vyādhereva grahaṇam, na vāyoriti bhāvaḥ| siddhe pratyaya iti| ināvevetyarthaḥ| roge cāyamiṣyate iti kvacitpaṭhyate, tatrokto hetuḥ ||

vayasi pūraṇāt || 5.2.130 ||
māsaḥ saṃvatsaro veti| prakaraṇādivaśātpañcamādiśabdasya kāle vṛttiḥ, tataśca `vayasi dyotye' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ tatropapannamiti bhāvaḥ ||

sukhādibhyaśca || 5.2.131 ||
iniḥ pratyayo niyamyate iti| pūrvasūtre inireva bhavatīti niyamasvarūpaṃ darśitam, ihāpi tathaiva niyamaḥ| nanvevaṃ yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti sukhādaya eva niyatā bhavanti, tatkimucyate--`pratyayo niyamyate' iti? anyanivṛttiviśiṣṭaṃ vyasthāpanagatra niyama ityadoṣaḥ|
matubbādhanārthaṃ vacanamiti| na tu ṭhanbādhanārtham; `śikhādibhya inirvācyaḥ' ityanenaiva ṭhano nivarttitatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||

dharmaśīlavarṇāntācca || 5.2.132 ||
brāhmaṇavarṇiti| brāhmaṇānāṃ varṇaḥ-jātiḥ, tadvān brāhmaṇavarṇī brāhmaṇa eva ||

hastājjātau || 5.2.133 ||
iniḥ pratyayo niyamyate iti| matvarthasambhavamātreṇātra prakarame niyamavācoyuktiḥ| paramārthatastu vidhirayam, katham ? gajaśabdavajjātiśabdo'yam, nātra matvarthagandho'sti| tathā ca vihaste'pi gaje hastīti bhavati; jātisadbhāvāt| hastasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ ca hastinyapi matubbhavati--hastavān, hastī; hastavānpuruṣa itivat| evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu draṣṭavyam| hastagrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇārthaṃ manyate, tena dantī, viṣāṇī, kesarītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati ||

varṇād brahmacāriṇi || 5.2.134 ||
brahmacārīti traivarṇiko'bhimata iti| yadyapi gurukulavāsini prathamāśrame brahmacāriśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tathāpīha lakṣyānurodhāttraivarṇikamātramabhimataḥ, na tvāśrama ityarthaḥ, tasya kādācitkaṃ vrahmacaryayogaṃ darśayati| sa hīti| brahma caratīti brahmacārī, brahma-vedaḥ| iha tu tadadhyayanārtho niyamaviśeṣo'bhimata ityāha--niyamamiti| tatra brahmacārīti `vrate' iti ṇiniḥ| brahmacāriśabdasya mukhyārthaparityāgena traivarṇikamātraparatve kāraṇamāha--brāhmaṇādayastrayo varṇā iti ||

puṣkarādibhyo deśe || 5.2.135 ||
arthīti| asannihito'rtho'syetyarthaḥ| kālataścāsannidhiḥ, na deśataḥ| tatra virodhādastīti na sambaddhyate, tataścāprāpta evenirvidhīyate, takrakauṇḍinyanyāyena ca sattopādhikādinerabhāvaḥ| arthavāniti| sannihitārtha ucyate| tadantācceti| grahaṇavatā prātipādikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādayamārambhaḥ| dhānyārthīti| dhānyarupo'rtho'sannihito'stetyarthaḥ, karmadhārayādiniḥ| nanvarthayaterṇininaitatsiddham--dhānyamarthayate dhānyārthī ? evamapi ṇinīti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhīdaṃ syāt--arthanamarthaḥ-prārthanā, sā yasyāsti so'rthī, dhānyasyārtho dhānyārthaḥ-dhānyaprārthanā, sā yasyāsti sā dhānyārthīti| evaṃ ca kṛtvedamapi siddhaṃ bhavati--arthikaḥ, pratyarthika iti|
`arthāccāsannihite' iti tūcyamāne inereva vidhānāṭṭhanna syāt| `ekākṣarātkṛto jāteḥ' iti pratiṣedho'nityaḥ, tena kāryī kāryika itivad iniṭhanau bhaviṣyataḥ, matubanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyati| na ca dhanavācino'rthaśabdātsannihitādapīniṭhanoḥ prasaṅgaḥ; anabhidhānāt| evam `arthāccāsannihitāttadantācca' iti na vaktavyamiti sthitam ||

balādibhyo matubanyatarasyām || 5.2.136 ||
anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenetyādi| pūrvavatsamuccaye tasya vṛtteḥ? cakāra eva tu na kṛtaḥ, kiṃ kurmaḥ! yadi tu vikalpārthenānena pratyayo vilpyeta, tato matupā mukte yathāprāptaminiṭhanau dvāvapi syātām| nanvevaṃ sati sūtrārambho'narthakaḥ syāt, vināpyanena pratyayatrayasya siddhatvāt, tata inireva bhaviṣyati| kuto nu khalvetad--inireva bhaviṣyati na punaṣṭhaneva syāditi ? tasmātsamuccayaḥ ||

saṃjñāyāṃ manmābhyām || 5.2.137 ||
prathamini, dāminīti| `aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca' iti tadantavidhiḥ, `nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ ||

kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ babhayustitutayasaḥ || 5.2.138 ||
