kaṃśamiti makārāntāviti| `kaśabdaḥ sukhavārvāyubrahmamastakavācakaḥ'ka ityakārāntaḥ kaśabdo yadyapi prasiddhaḥ, makārānto'pi kvacidastīti pradarśanārtham `makārāntau' ityuktam| udakasukhayorvācakāviti| na yathāsaṃkhyam, kiṃ tarhi ? yathāsambhavam| kamityudakasukhayorvācakam, śamiti sukhasya| `alpāctaram' iti sukhasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāptaḥ na kṛtaḥ sūtrakāreṇaiva; tatra vyabhicaritatvāt| udāharaṇeṣvalanusvāraparasavarṇau, tatra yakāravakārayoḥ sānunāsikau yakāravakārau ||

ahaṃśubhayoryus || 5.2.139 ||
ahamiti śabdāntarameveti| nanu nātra kaścicchabdaḥ prakṛto yadapekṣaṃ śabdāntaratvaṃ syāt ? satyam; `tvāhau sau' ityasmadādeśo'haṃśabdaḥ prasiddhivasādh buddhistho nirddiṣṭaprāyaḥ, tadapekṣaṃ śabdāntaratvam| ahaṅkakāre varttate iti| anenārthabedamāha--`garvo'bhimāno'haṅkāraḥ'| ahaṃyuḥ, śubhaṃyuriti| pūrvavadanusvāraparasavarṇai| `ūrṇāyā yus' ityatra ye `chandasi' iti nānuvartayanti teṣāmatraivorṇāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ||

iti kṣīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ pañcamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
<5.3>
kāśikāvṛtti
atha pañcamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ

prāgdiśovibhaktiḥ || 5.3.1 ||
vibhaktisaṃjñāste veditavyā iti| vibhaktiriti śabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| nanu vibhaktiśabdaḥ pūrvameva suptiṅāṃ saṃjñātvena viniyuktaḥ,ka saṃjñā ca pradeśeṣu saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayati na svarūpam, ataḥ suptiṅāmeva saṃjñātvaṃ yuktam, na vibhaktiśabdasya ? satyam; suptiṅastu saṃjñā bhavantaḥ pratyekam, samuditā vā bhaveyuḥ; na tāvatpratyekam, anekasaṃjñākaraṇe prayojanābhāvāt; nāpi samuditāḥ, gauravādanāvṛtteśca| āvarttinyo hi saṃjñā bhavanti, na ca samudāya āvartate| apara āh--``yathā `kinau liṭ ca' iti liḍvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tathātrāpi vibhaktivadbhāvo vidhīyate iti| suptiṅāṃ tu vidhānamatra nāśaṅkanīyam; pūrvamevavihitatvāt| tyadādividhaya iti| tyadādīnāṃ yāni kāryāṇi tyadāditvaprayuktāni svarūpaprayuktāni vā te tyadādividhayaḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat, dānīmo makārasya `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi prayojanam| tataḥ, yata iti| `tyadādīnāmaḥ' ityatvam| atra sakārasyānantyatvādevetsaṃjñābhāvaḥ| kṛta iti| `kuti hoḥ' iti kubhāvaḥ| kadeti kimaḥ kādeśaḥ| kvetyatra `kvāti' kaiti kvabhāvaḥ iheti| `idamo haḥ,' `idama iś'| atra pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamudāttatvam| tasmādita ityevalodāharaṇaṃ vibhaktisvarasya; anyathā `liti' iti pratyayātpūrvamudāttaṃ syāt| nanu ca `madhye'pavādāḥ' iti nyāyād `anudāttau suppitau' ityasyaiva vibhaktisvaro'pavādaḥ, na litsvarasya, litsvara eva tu vibhaktisvara paratvādbādheta? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātrākṛte litsvare vibhaktisvaraḥ prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇaṇ ? `antodāttāt' iti varttate, tatra nimittameva litsvaro vibhaktisvarasya| yadyapi `ūḍidam' ityatra `sāvekāca:' ityatastṛtīyādigrahaṇamanuvarttate, tathāpyā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteryāvānpratyayo vibhaktisaṃjñakaḥ sarvo'sau tṛtīyādiriti tasilādayo'pi tṛtīyādigrahaṇena gṛhyanta eva|
ataḥ paramityādi| etat `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' ityatraiva vyākhyātam| vāvacanaṃ tvanuvarttata eveti| tasya pṛthakasvaritatvāt| atha `supaḥ, vibhaktiśca' ityatraiva `prāgdiśaśca' ityucyeta? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hyucyamāne na jñāyate--kuta ārabhya prāgdiśīyā ? iti| bahavaśca dikśabdāḥ--digādibhyo yat'ka ityevamādayaḥ, tataścāvadhirapi na niścitaḥ syāt| `kiṃsarvanāmabahubyaḥ' ityādeśca kāryasya viṣayaniyamārthaṃ punariha `prāgdiśaḥ' iti vācyameva syāt| yadi punarihaiva `suptiṅau ca' ityucyeta? evamapi `tiṅastrīṇitrīṇi' ityatra tiṅgrahaṇam supa iti ca tatra vaktvyaṃ puruṣavacanasaṃjñārtham, tatra nāsti viśeṣaḥ ||

kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo'dvyādibhyaḥ || adhikāro'yam, paribhāṣā veti darśayati| pratyayo veditavya iti| dvābhyām, dvayorityatra tasiltralau na bhavataḥ|
prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānam-prakṛtiparigaṇanam| vaiyākaraṇapāśa iti| astātyādayo grahaṇavadbhyo vidhīyanta iti prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānasya tatrāsambhavādvyavahito'pi pāśap pratyudāhṛtaḥ| dvyādiparyudāsāditi| yadi punarayaṃ dvyādibhyaḥ prāk kiṃ paṭhyeta, naivaṃ sakyam; ekaśeṣe hi doṣaḥ syāt, tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ tatcciṣyatetvaṃ ca kaśca kau, bhavāṃśca kaśca kau|
bahugrahaṇe saṃkhyāgrahaṇamiti| kathamiha sarvanāmasaṃjñayā saṃjñino nirddiśyante ? taiḥ sāhacaryād bahuśabdasyāpi saṃjñino grahaṇam, yasya `bahugaṇavatuḍatisaṃkyā' iti saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā, na ca tatra vaipulyavācino grahaṇamiti atrāpi tasya grahaṇābhāvaḥ ||

idama iś || 5.3.3 ||
śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha iti| anyathā viśeṣavihitatvāttyadādyatvaṃ bādhitvā `alo'ntyasya' iti makārasyetve halilope ca-etaḥ, ehetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt ||

etetau rathoḥ || 5.3.4 ||
iśo'pavāda iti| bhāve ghañ, iśo bādhanametābhyāṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ| yogāpekṣaṃ tvekavacanam, ayaṃ yoga iso'pavāda ityarthaḥ| ādeśābhyāṃ vā pratyekamabhisambandhādekavavanam, yathā `bhūśādibhyo bhuvyacveḥ' iti| iśo'pavādāviti vā paṭhitavyam| rephe'kāra uccāraṇārtha iti| akāravato rephasya prāgdiśīyasyābhāvāt ||

etado'śu || 5.3.5 ||
śakāraḥ sarvādeśārtha iti| anyathā `alo'ntyasya' ityantyasya syāt| nanu cāntyasya tyadādyatvenaiva siddhamatvam, kṛte tarhi tasminnakārasyākāraḥ prāpnoti, akārasya akāravacane prayojanābhāvatsarvādeśo bhaviṣyati ? astyanyadakārasyāpyakāravacane prayojanam, kim ? yo'nyo vidhiḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi| kaḥ punarasau ? `liti' iti svaraḥ| yathā--`mo rāji samaḥ kvau' iti makārasya makāravacanamanusvārabādhanārtham|
yogavibhāga iti| aśo bādhanārthaḥ| thamupratyayaḥ punariti| anyathā ya evāsāvaviseṣavihitasthākārādiḥ `prakāravacane thāl' iti tatraiva syāt| sa tarhyupasaṃkhyeyaḥ ? netyāha, idamā thakarādiṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-- idamo yasthakārādiśtatreti, sa ca thamureva| tataścāsmādeva jñāpakātthamurbaviṣyati, tena ca thālbādhyate|
bhāṣye tu `etado'n' iti nakārānta ādeśa iti sthitam| sa cānekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ, tataḥ sthānivadbhāvātprātipadikatve sati nalopaḥ---ataḥ, atra||

sarvasya so'nyatarasyāṃ di || 5.3.6 ||
`di' iti dakāradiyaṃ saptamī, tatra `yasmin vidhiḥ' iti tadādergrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--dakārādau pratyaye parata iti|
sarvadā brāhmaṇīti| kimarthaṃ strīliṅgopanyāsaḥ ? yo hi manyate--dīti dāśabdādiyaṃ saptamī na tu dakārāt, tatra ktvo lyap, `halaḥ' `śnaḥ' ityādivadāto lopa iti, taṃ prati dāśabdaḥ pratyudāhṛtaḥ| evamapi lākṣaṇikatvādatra dāśabdasya na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ vijantametad draṣṭavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā puṃlliṅgamapyudāharaṇaṃ bhavatyeva ||

pañcamyāstasil || 5.3.7 ||
tasilpratyayo bhavatīti| yadi punaḥ `pañcamyāḥ' `saptamyāḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyāśrayeṇa pañcamyādīnāṃ tasilādaya ādeśā vijñāyeran, subluksvaraguṇadīrghatvaitvautvasmāyādividhipratiṣedhaḥ| subluk--`avyayāttyap', tatastyaḥ, tatratyaḥ, `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti tasitralorluk prāpnoti| svaraḥ---tadā, yadā, `anudāttau suppitau' ityanudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| guṇaḥ--kutaḥ, `gheṅiti' iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti| dīrghatvam--tarhi, `ato dīrgo yañi', `supi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti| etvam---tarhi, `ato dīrgho yañi',`supi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti| etvam--teṣu, tatra, `bahuvacane jhalyet' prāpnoti| autvam-kasmin, kutra, `aut' `acca gheḥ' ityautvaṃ prāpnoti| smāyāditasmāt, tasmin, tatra, `ṅasiḍyoḥ smātsminau' iti smātsminau prāpnutaḥ| tasmāt `pañcamyāḥ saptamyā iti pañcamī, tasilādayaśca pratyayāḥ' iti yuktam| ata eva `itarābhyaḥ' iti pañcamīnirddeśaḥ; itarathā `itarāsām' iti vaktavyaṃ syāt| yadi tarhi tasilādayaḥ pratyayāḥ, nādeśāḥ, `taseśca' iti tasyaterdhātorapi doṣaḥ; `pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ', `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' ityatrāpyadeśatvātpañcamyādeśasya tasestasilādeśavidānāt ? pratyayapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ; taseritīkāro vivakṣitaḥ, tena dhātorna bhaviṣyati ||

taseśca || 5.3.8 ||
tasya taseriti| paratvātkṛtasya tasilo'vakāśaḥ--kuto'vahīyate, kuto'varohatīti, tasestu gramata āgacchatītyādiḥ; kuta āgacchatītyādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvāttasakirbhavati, tasyānena tasilādesaḥ| tasestasilvacanaṃ svarārthamiti| litkaraṇasyoktaṃ prayojanam| vibhaktyarthaṃ ceti| vibhaktisaṃjñārthaṃ cetyarthaḥ| anyathā paratvāttasau kṛte tasyāprāgdiśīyatvādvibhaktisaṃjñāyā abhāvāttyadādyatvaṃ na syāditi rūpameva na siddhyet ||

paryabhibhyāṃ ca || 5.3.9 ||
sarvobhayārthe vartamānābhyāmiti| atra cābhidhānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ, teneha na bhavati-pariṣiñcati, abhiyātīti; uparyarthe pariḥ, ābhimukhye'bhiḥ| iha tvodanaṃ pariṣiñcatīti sarvatobhāve'pi vāvacanānuvṛtteḥ pakṣe tasilabhāvaḥ| sarvataḥ, ubhayata iti| saptamyantābhyāmādyāditvāttasiḥ ||

kimo't || 5.3.12 ||
takārasya `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedho na bhavati; anityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu `idamasthamuḥ' iti thama ukārānmakārasyetsaṃjñāparihāṇārthājjñāyate| dānīmastu makārasya bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| anityatvaṃ hi jñāpyate, na punastaddhiteṣvasyābhāvaḥ|
uttarasūtrāditi| `kimo'dvā' iti sūtraṃ paṭhitavyam| `ha ca chandasi' ityatra cakāreṇa trataloḥ samuccayādiṣṭasiddhiriti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ| bhāgavṛttikārastu bhāṣāyāmetannecchati ||

itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante || 5.3.14 ||
pañcamīsaptamyapekṣamitaratvamiti| tayoranantaranirddiṣṭatvāt| prāyikavidhyarthamiti| prāyiko'yaṃ vidhiryathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha-teneti| sa, bhavān tato bhavānityādi| ayaṃ bhavāniha bhavānityādi hasyodāharaṇam, ko bavān, kva bhavānityādi ataḥ| dīrgāyuḥpramṛtiṣviti| `nityaṃ samāse' iti satvaṃ na bhavati; uttarapadasthatvāt| `isusoḥ sāmarthye iti vikalpo'pi na bhavati; vyapekṣāyāstatrāśrayaṇāt|

sarvaikānyakiṃyattadaḥ kāle dā || 5.3.15 ||
saptamyā iti vartata iti| svaritatvāt| na tvitarābhya iti| viparyayāt ||

idamo rhil || 5.3.16 ||
lakāraḥ svarārtha iti| yathā hīta ityatra `ūḍidam' ityādinā svaro bhavati, tatheha na bhavati; littvasyācarītārthatvāt| tasilastu littvalamidamo'nyatra caritārtham ||

adhunā || 5.3.17 ||
idamo'śū bhāvo dhunā ca pratyaya iti| tatra `ūḍidam' ityādinā vibhaktisvaraḥ, sa ca `ādeḥ parasya'ka ityāderbhavati| bhāṣye tvadhunāpratyaya āśritaḥ, tatredama iśo yasyetilopaḥ, nipātanācca madhyodāttatvam ||

tado dā ca || 5.3.19 ||
dāvacanamiti| apara āha--`adāpratyayo'yaṃ na dāpratyayaḥ' iti, tatrādyudāttatvaṃ pakṣe bhavati ||

tayordārhilau cacchandasi || 5.3.20 ||
tayoriti prātipadikanirddeśaḥ, vyatyayena pañcamyāḥ sthāne ṣaṣṭhī ||

sadyaḥ parutparāryaiṣamaḥ paredyavyadya pūrvedyuranyedyuranyataredyuritaredyuraparedyuradharedyurubhayedyuruttaredyuḥ || 5.3.21 ||
ahanyabhidheya iti| saptamyantasyāhanśabdasyārtha ityarthaḥ| taddarśayati--samāne'hni sadya iti| evaṃ saṃvatsare'bhidheya ityādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam |
ubhayorahnorubhayedyuriti pāṭhaḥ| prāyeṇa tu ubhayasminnahanīti paṭhyate, tatrobhe ahanī avayavau yasya samudāyasya tadahardvayamubhayamaharityuktam ||

prakāravacane thāl || 5.3.23 ||
sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāra iti| yathā brāhmaṇasāmānyasya māṭharādayaḥ| anenaitaddarśayati--yadyapi sādṛśyamapi prakāraḥ, yathā `prakāre guṇavacanasya' ityatra vakṣyati--`prakāro bhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ ca, tadiha sādṛsyaṃ prakāro gṛhye' iti; tathāpi neha sādṛsyaṃ gṛhyate, anabhidhānāditi| tena prakāreṇa tatheti| prathamāntāttu na bhavati--sa prakārastatheti; anabhidhānādeveti bhāvaḥ|
kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo viśe,vihiṃtena thālā sāmānyavihitasya jātīyaro bādhaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkyā''ha--jātīyaro'pīti| satyaṃ jātīyaro'pīdṛśameva lakṣṇaṃ `prakāravacane jītīyar' iti, kathaṃ tarhyabādha? ata āha--sa tviti| arthabhedād bheda ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā prakāramātre thālaṃ vidhāya tadantātprakāravati jātīyaraṃ prayuñjate--tathājātīyaḥ, yathājātīya iti ||

kimaśca || 5.3.25 ||
yogavibhāgā uttaratra kima evānuvṛttiryathā syādidamo mā bhūditi||

dikśabdebhyaḥ || 5.3.27 ||
saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāleṣvastātiḥ || diśāṃ śabdāḥ dikśabdāḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| diśāṃ ye vācakāste divaśabdā iti| diśāṃ ye vācakatvena dṛṣṭāḥ, ta iha dikśabdā vivakṣitā iti, na tu diśamabhidadhānā evetyarthaḥ| tebhya iti| yadyapi pūrvādiśabdā diśi vartamānāṣṭābantāḥ, deśakālayostu prakṛtyantā iti rūpabhedaḥ, tathāpi ṭāpaḥ svārthikatvādvācakarūpe bhedābhāvāt ta eva dikśabdā deśakālayorvarttanta iti vācoyukternāsti virodhaḥ| ye tvarthabhedaṃ manyante, teṣāṃ sādṛśyanibandhanastebhya iti vyapadeśaḥ| kathaṃ punarddikśabdā deśakālayorvarttante ? svabhāvākat| pūrvādayo hi diśāmiva deśakālayorapi svabhāvādeva vācakāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi triṣu varttamānā diśaikayā vyapadiśyante-disśabdebhya iti? ko doṣaḥ; anvayena hyayaṃ vyapadeśaḥ, na tu diśāmeva ye śabdāḥ-ityavadhāraṇena|
atha deśakālayoranyatareṇa kasmānna vyapadiśyante ? śiṃśapācodyametat| kiṃ ca, diśāṃ nirddeśe lāghavaṃ bhavati| dikśabdasyopalakṣaṇatvātpunardiggrahaṇam, anyathā deśakālavṛttibhya eva syāt, na digvṛttibhyaḥ| iha saptamyādīnāṃ vibhaktīnāmarthānāṃ digādīnāṃ ca sāmyātsaṃkhyātātudeśaḥ syāditi ? tatrāha---yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyata iti| asvaritatvāt| purastād, adhastāditi| pūrvādharaśabdayoḥ `astāti' iti pura, adh--ityetāvādeśau| aindryāṃ diśi vasatīti| aindrīśabdo'yam indrasaṃbandhistrīliṅgavastumātramāha, dikśabdasannidhau tu diśi varttate iti na dikśabdaḥ| kiñca, dikśabdebhya ityetasminnasati ye deśavācinaḥ pañcālādayaḥ, ye ca kālavācino māsādayaḥ, tebhyo'pi prasaṅgaḥ| asmiṃstu sati dikśabdā eva ye deśakālayorvartante tebhya eva bhavati| digdeśakāleṣviti kimiti| `dikśabdebhyaḥ' itiśabdagrahaṇāddiśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda iti vyutpattyā deśakālavṛttibhyo'pi siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, `dikśabdāñcūttarapada' iti pañcamīvaditi mattvā praśnaḥ| pūrvasmingurāviti| pūrvaśabdo'tra digādisambandādgurau varttate, na digādiṣu ||

dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasuc || 5.3.28 ||
kimarthamatasujucyate, na tasujevocyet, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ-- svarārthaścakāro na karttevyo bhavati, pratyayasvareṇaivaka siddham, kā rūpasiddhiḥ ? dakṣiṇottaraśabdāvakārānetau| yadā tarhi diśi varttamānau dābantau bhavatasyadā yasyetilopena ṭāpo nivṛttiryathā syādityevamartho'kāraḥ, siddhā'tra ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ, katham ? `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' kaiti puṃvadbhāvāt| nanu ca samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskasya tena puṃvadbhāvaḥ, ākṛtyantare caitau bhāṣitapuṃskau, katham ? diśi varttamānāḥ pūrvādayo nimittāntaranipekṣāḥ, deśakālayostu vyavasthāpekṣāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi diśi vartamānānāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhavati, yāvatā vyavasthāyāmityucyate ? atrāhuḥ--yadyapi diśi ṣartamānānāṃ vyavasthā na pravṛttinimittam, vastutastu vyavasthā vidyate iti bhavatyeva saṃjñā| vyavasthāyāmiti hi viṣayo nirddiśyate, na tu pravṛttinimittam| tathā cottarāḥ kurva ityatra nirūḍhatvādvyavahārasya prayoktṛbhiranapekṣyamāṇāyā api vastuto vyavasthāyāḥ sadbhāvātsarvanāmasaṃjñāprasaṅge'saṃjñāyāmiti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛta iti| tadevamākṛtibhedāttasilādiṣvati puṃvadbhāvo na siddhayati| evaṃ tarhi `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti puṃvadbhāvo bhavi,yati, yathā dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmityatra, tasmānnārtho'kārakaraṇena ? ityata āha--akāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| `ṣaṣṭhī tasarthapratyena' ityucyamāne tato grāmādāgata iti tasilāpi yoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt ? `apapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'| iha tarhi tato grāmādanya ityanyādiyoge yā pañcamī, tāṃ bāyatvā ṣaṣṭhī syāt ? `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' ityevaṃ tasilādiyoge na bhaviṣyati| yastarhi niranubandhakaḥ `pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ' `tenaikadik', `tasiśca', tatra mā bhūtarjunataḥ pratyabhimanyuḥ, sudāmato vidyuditi ||

añcerluk || 5.3.30 ||
añcatyantebhya iti| kevalebhyaḥ, liṅgaviśiṣṭebhyaśca| srīpratyayo'pi nivarttata iti| evaṃ cākāralopaḥ, `cau' iti dīrghatvaṃ ca nāstīti, prāgityatra savarṇadīrghatvam, pratyagityatra yaṇādeśaḥ ||

paścāt || 5.3.32 ||
aparasya paścabhāva iti| kevalasya liṅgaviśiṣṭasya ca | dikpūrvapadasya ceti| digvacanaḥ pūrva padaṃ yasya tathoktaḥ| dakṣiṇapaścāditi| dakṣiṇasyā aparasyāśca diśo yadantarālamiti `diṅnāmānyantarāle' iti bahuvrīhiḥ, dakṣiṇāparā, tasyāṃ vasatītyātipratyayaḥ, aparasya ca paścabhāvaḥ| ardhottarapadasya ceti| aparasya cetyeva| vināpī pūrvapadeneti| aparasya, ardhottarapadasyeti sambandhaḥ ||

uttarādharadakṣiṇādātiḥ || 5.3.34 ||
ātipratyayo bhavatīti| dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasujapi bhavati, adharaśabdādastātirapi; `astāti ca' ityadharaśabdasyādhādeśavidhānālliṅgāt| atra cottarādīnāṃ saptamyādīnāṃ ca sāmye satyapi pūrvavadyathāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ| astādistūttarādīnāṃ na sambhavati, dakṣiṇaśabdasya kāle vṛttyasambhavāt ||

enabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ || 5.3.35 ||
adūre cetyādi| yadyapyavadhiravadhimān vā sūtre na śrūyate, tathāpi dikśabdānāmavadhyapekṣā pravṛttirbhavati| avadhiścāvadhimantamapekṣate iti sāmarthyādeva viśeṣo labhyate| tatra deśakālayoravadhyapekṣāyāṃ na vivādaḥ, diśi tu vivadante|
prāgaseriti| `asipuradhavaścaiṣām' ityasmāt| divaśabdamātrāditi| tena pūrveṇa vasatītyādyapī bhavati| añcatyantāttu na bhavati; vyavasthaitavibhāṣāvijñānāt| astu vā tadantādapi, `añcerluk' ityanuvṛtterlugbhaviṣyati|
pakāraḥ svarārtha iti| `enapā dvitīyā' iti viśeṣaṇārthastu na bhavati| astveneneti, `atasarthapratyayena' ityanuvṛtteḥ `dvitīyāṭauḥsvenaḥ' ityasyātra grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||

dakṣiṇādāc || 5.3.36 ||
cakāro viśeṣaṇārtha iti| anyathā vākyasmaraṇayorya ākāro'nanubandhakastenāpi yoge pañcamī syāt| athāpyañcūttarapadenāhinā ca sāhacaryādatasarthasyākārasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tathāpi paścāśabda ākārānto nipātita hati tenāpi yoge pañcamī syāt| chāndasaḥ paścāśabdaḥ, dṛṣṭānuvidhiśchandasi bhavati? asandehārthaṃ tarhi, `añcūttarapadāhiyukte' iti hyucyamāne ākārapraśleṣo vyākhyātavyaḥ syāt| `añcūttarapadāhyāyukte' iti sūtraṃ kariṣyate, tasmākṣaiṇāsītyatra `svarito vānudātte'padādau' iti vidhirmā bhūditi cakārasya prayojanaṃ vācyam ||

āhi ca dūre || 5.3.37 ||
cakārādācceti| anyathā dūre vivakṣite viśeṣavihita āhireva syāt ||

uttarācca || 5.3.38 ||
ājāhī prayyayau bhavata iti| yadyapyāhiranantaraḥ, tathāpi cakāreṇa vyavahitasyāpi ācaḥ samuccaya iti bhāvaḥ ||

pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām || 5.3.39 ||
ānantaryayoge ṣaṣṭhī| asītyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ| eṣāmiti vacanaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| sannidhānāddhi pūrvādaya eva stāninaḥ śakyā vijñātum ||

astāti ca || 5.3.40 ||
astātīti saptamyantam| asipratyayeneti| adharaśabdādātināpi ||

vibhāṣā'varasya || 5.3.41 ||
avityayamādeśo bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarbahuṣvādeśeṣu prasakteṣu ayameva bhavatu? asyaivānuvṛtteḥ| atha vā--avarasya yaduktaṃ tadasatātau vibhāṣā bhavatīti vijñāsyate ||

saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā || 5.3.42 ||
vidhā prakāra iti `gṛhyate' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| yadyapyodanapiṇkaḍo'pi vidhāśabdenocyate, tathāpīha prakāra eva gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| etena ekā govidhetyādau na bhavati| etaccārthagrahaṇāllabhyate| iha hi vidhāyāmiti vaktavye yadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaitatprayojanam----vidhāśabdo yatrārthe prasiddhatarastasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| yathā ca trividham, bahuvidhamityādau prakāre prasiddho vidhāśabdaḥ, na tathaudanapiṇkaḍe| sūtre ca--vidhāśabdasyārtho vidhārtha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| evaṃ vṛttāvapi| sa ca kriyāviṣaya iti| etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyate| tadayamartha ityāha--kriyāprakāre iti| kathaṃ tarhi navadhā dravyam, bahudhā guṇāḥ, ekaviśatidhā bāhvṛcyam, navadhātharvāṇo veda iti/ atrāpi hi sarvatra kriyā pratīyate--upadiśyate iti, bhavatīti vā| dvidhā gacchatītyādāve kasyā eva gamanakriyāyā avāntaraprakārabhedaḥ pratīyate| ekadhā bhuṅkte ityatra tu prakāraikyapratipādanena tannivṛttiḥ| ekaḥ pāka ityādau tu pākavyakterektvaṃ vivakṣitam, na tvavāntaraprakārabhedābhāvenaikaprakāratvamiti dhāpratyayābhāvaḥ| tadvivakṣyāṃ tu bhavatyeva--ekadhā pāka iti| pañca pākā ityādau ca bhinnā eva pākā vivakṣitāḥ, na tvekasya prakāravattvam| tadvivakṣāyāṃ tu tatrāpi bhavitavyameva--pañcadhā pākā iti ||

adhikaraṇavicāle ca || 5.3.43 ||
adhikaraṇaṃ dravyamityādi| jātyādīnāmādhāratvāt| vicālanaṃ vicālaḥ-anyathākaraṇam ṇijantād `erac'| tacceha saṃkhyāsannidhānātsaṃkhyāntarāpādanenetyāha--tasya vicālaḥ saṃkhyāntarāpādanamiti| ekaṃ rāśi pañcadhā kurviti| pañca rāśīnkurvityarthaḥ| nātra prakārabhedo gamyate, natarāṃ kriyāviṣaya iti sūtrārambhaḥ| tatra dravyasyāpi svabhāvāddhāpratyayāntenāsattvarupeṇa pratipādanamityavyayatvam, yathā--sudāmato vidyuditi tasantasya ||

ekāddho dhyamuñanyatarasyām || 5.3.44 ||
`ekād' iti śabdapradhānatvātsarvanāmakāryābhāvaḥ ekadhā rāśi kurviti| adhikaraṇavicāle udāharaṇaṃ| aikadhyaṃ bhuṅkta iti| vidhārthe|
prakaraṇādeva labdha iti| kasmin labdhe? dhāpratyayasya sthānitve| iha hi pūrvasūtrāddhāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sa ca pūrvameva vihita iti vidhānāsambhavāt sthānitvameva vijñāsyate|
vidhārthe vihitasyāpi yathā syāditi| sthānyādeśābhāvo'pyetadarthamevāśritaḥ; pratyayāntare'pyasmindoṣābhāvāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vidhārthe vihitasya tasya na syād? ata āha--anantarasyaiva hīti| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti bhāvaḥ ||

dvitryośca dhamuñ || 5.3.45 ||
bhatidvaidhānīti| ekaśeṣeṇa bahuvacanam| kvacit pathi dvaidhānīti pāṭhaḥ| dhamuñantasyāliṅgasaṃkhyatve'pi tadantātsvārthe vihitasyāpyasya svabhāvālliṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ, tenāvyayatvaṃ na bhavati ||

edhācca || 5.3.46 ||
yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārthaḥ ||

yāpye pāśap || 5.3.47 ||
yāpyaśabdo'kayamastyapādānasādhanaḥ--yāpitā asmād guṇā iti yāpyaḥ-kutsitaḥ, asti karmasādhanaḥ-yāpayitavyo yāpyo deśāntaraṃ prāpayitavyaḥ, śarīrādvā'panetavyaḥ, aśakyapratīkāro yāpyo vyādhiḥ| tatrehābhidhānaśaktisvabhāvādādyasya grahaṇamityāha--yāpyaḥ kutsita ucyata iti|
tatra kasmānna bhavatīti| vyākaraṇe pravīṇasyāpi duḥśīlatvena kutsitatvād bhavitavyameveti bhāvaḥ| yasya guṇasyeti| guṇo viśeṣaṇam, dravyaṃ viśeṣyam| tasya kutsāyāṃ pratyaya iti| etaccāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate| pravṛttinimittaṃ hi pratyāsannam; śabdavācyatvāt| dharmāntaraṃ tu tatra vastutaḥ sadapi na śabdena spṛśyate| yatra tu pravṛttittinimittasya kutsitaṃ na sambhavati--asako devadattaka ityādau, tatra sahacaritaguṇakriyākutsāśrayaḥ pratyayo bhavatyeva| evaṃ ca devadattapāśa ityādyapi satyabhidhāne bhavati|
`kutsite' ityatraivāyaṃ na vihitaḥ; tiṅantādapi prasaṅgāt ||

pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan || 5.3.48 ||
pūraṇārthavihitatvāttīyapratyaya eva pūraṇaśabdenokta ityāha--pūraṇapratyayo yastīya iti| svarārthaṃ vacanamiti| bhāge nitsvareṇādyadāttatvaṃ yathā syāt, rūpe tu nāsti viśeṣaḥ| pūraṇagrahaṇamuttarārthamiti| nehārtham, kutaḥ? ityata āha--na hīti| nanu cāyamasti--`mukhapārśvatasorlopaḥ, bhukhatīyaḥ' iti ? tatrāha--mukhatīyādiranarthaka iti| mukhatīyādau yastīyaśabdaḥ so'narthaka ityartha ||

prāgekādaśabhyo'cchandasi || 5.3.49 ||
prāgīkādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāśabdebhya iti| ekādaśaśabdātprāñco ye saṃkyāśabdāstebhya ityarthaḥ, ekādaśabhyaḥ prācīneṣu saṃkhyeyeṣu ye saṃkhyāśabdāstebhya itī vā ||

ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ ña ca || 5.3.50 ||
yathāsaṃkhyamatra na bhavati, anyatarasmādanaḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ||

mānapaśvaṅgayoḥ kanlukau ca || 5.3.51 ||
mānaṃ vrīhiparimitaṃ suvarṇam‌| aṣṭamo bhāga iti| kasya punaratra luk ? ityāha--ñasya luk, ano veti| aṣṭhanśabdādbhāgo tayoreva vihitatvat| lugvacanaṃ kim, yāvatā mahāvibhāṣayaiva pakṣe ñānorabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etajjñāpayati--pūrvasūtre ñānau nityāviti ||

ekādākinicchāsahāye || 5.3.52 ||
ākinicaḥ kano veti| tayorevānena sūtreṇa vidhānāt| ekadhetyādau tu sūtrāntaravihitasya lug na bhavati; asannidhānāt|
saṃkhyāśabdanirāsārthamiti| anyathā prasiddhatvātsaṃkhyāprakaraṇācca tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ svāt| astu, ko doṣaḥ ? tatrāha---tadupādāne hīti| dvibahvoriti| dvitve bahutve cetyarthaḥ| na hi dvayorbahuṣu vā ekatvasaṃkhyāsti| asahāyatvaṃ tu parasparavyatiriktasahāyābhāvena bahūnāmapi bhavati| iha akinijevāyaṃ vaktavyaḥ, savarṇadīrghatvesiddhamiṣṭam, yasyetilopaścākāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati ? na cāvagrahanivṛttyartho'kāraḥ, nahi lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ, padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvarttyam ||

bhūtapūrve caraṭ || 5.3.53 ||
bhūtapūrvaśabda ityādi| kevalabhūtaśabdaḥ `pautanye'pi varttatebhūtamiyaṃ brāhmaṇīti, satye'pi varttate--bhūtavādīti, atra bhūtaśabdo vidyamānavacanityanye; pūrvaśabdaśca digdeśayorapi varttate, tasmādanyataropādāne vivakṣito'rtho na gamyata ityubhayorupādānam| āḍhyacara iti| yathātra cakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati, tathā `cuṭū' ityatra pratipāditam|
`goṣṭhātkhañ' ityatraiva noktam, viśeṣavihitena khañā caraṭo bādhā mā bhūditi| sannidhau hi bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, na kālabhede ||

ṣaṣṭhyā rūpya ca || 5.3.54 ||
śeṣaviṣaye vidhānāttadantavyavacchedakatvādviśeṣaṇamapradhānam| yatpunaḥ ṣaṣṭhyākṣiptaṃ sambandhimātram, tadvyavacchedyatvādviśeṣyaṃ pradhānam| pradānetarasannidhau ca pradhāne kāryasampratyayo bhavatīti pratyayastāvacattatraiva vijñāyate, tataśca bhūtapūrvagrahaṇamapi tasyaiva viśe,ṇamityāha-ṣaṣṭyantātpratyayavidhāna iti| hetugarbha cedamabhidhānam-yasmāt ṣaṣṭhyantātpratyayavidhānaṃ tasmāditi| sampratīti| yadyapi pūrvaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikenaiva sambaddhamāsīdidānīṃ tvevamityarthaḥ| tatra vidhāna iti saptamyantasya sampratītyasya ca pauranaruktyaṃ manyamānā vidhānaśabdamadhikaraṇasādhanaṃ sūtraparaṃ vyācakṣate ||

atiśāyate tamaviṣṭhanau || 5.3.55 ||
atiśayanamatiśāyanamiti| bhāve lyuṭ| yadyapyanantarameva vakṣyati--nipātanāddīrghatvamiti, tathāpi `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' ityadīrgheṇāpyarthanamupapadyate| anye tu--atiśayo'tiśāyanamiti paṭhanti, atiśāyanaṃ prakarṣa ityevānye| prakarṣa iti| yadyapi kevalaḥ śetiḥ svapne varttate, tathāpyatipūrvasya prakarṣe vṛttiḥ ||
upasargavaśāddhāturarthāntaravilāsakṛt|
vihārāhārasaṃhāraprahāraparihāravat ||
prakarṣaścātra nādhikyaṃ kiṃ tarhyatiśayo mataḥ|
sakarmako hyayaṃ śuklamatiśeta hatīṣyate ||
nipātanāditi| yadidamasminsūtre dīrghoccāraṇaṃ tadeva nipātanam| `sautronirddeśaḥ' ityeṣa parihāro'tra noditaḥ; yasmātsūtrādbahirapi prayogo'syābyupeyate| etadarthameva ca laghurapi prakarṣaśabdo nopāttaḥ| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| na prakṛtyarthaḥ, atiśāyane varttamānāditi| tathā hi sati atiśayaprakarṣādibhya eva syāt| nāpi pratyayārthaḥ, tathā hi sati āḍhyasyātiśayanamāḍhyatamamiti syāt| āḍhyasyeti karmaṇi karttari vā ṣaṣṭhī, ubhayathāpyāḍhyatamo devadatta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt| nāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam, anyasya kasyacit pratyayārthasyānirddeśāt| nāpi prakṛtereva viśeṣaṇam, atiśāyanīveśiṣṭānṅyāpprātipadikāditi| pratyayadyotyamatiśāyanaṃ prakṛtyabhihitasya pradhānasyaivārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam, na tvarthābhidhānaṃ prati vyagrasya guṇabhūtasya śabdasya| yadā tvasāvaguṇabhūtaḥ, tadā bhavatyeva prakarṣayogaḥ--uccataraḥ śabdaḥ, nīcataraḥ śabda iti| nanu śuklādivadetatsyāt, tadyathā--śuklataraḥ paṭa iti guṇabhūtasyāpi śauklyasya prakarṣo dravyaprakarṣahetuḥ, tathā śabde'pyastu ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; śauklyasya prakarṣo dravyaprakarṣahetuḥ, tathā śabde'pyastu ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ; śauklyādayo hi dravyasamavetāḥ, yuktaṃ yatsvayaṃ prakṛṣṭā prakarṣayanti, śabdastu na tatheti kathaṃ tatprakarṣeṇa dravyaṃ prakarṣyatām! prātipadikāditi| prakṛteridamupalakṣaṇam| subantāttu pratyayaḥ| uktaṃ hi--`priyakutsanādiṣu' tataḥ pravarttate'sau vibhaktyantaḥ' iti, `ghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ' ityalugvidhānamapyevamevopapadyate| svārtha iti| yadyevam, kumāritametyavyatiriktaṃ vaya iti kṛtvā `vayasi prathame' iti ṅīp prāpnoti ? kumāraśabdādutpannena ṅīpā vayoviśiṣṭasyārthasya strītvaṃ dyotitimati ṅībna bhaviṣyati, tarabantāttu strītvamātrābhivyaktaye ṭāb bhaviṣyati| kumāritama iti hyucyamāne kuṭīraḥ, śamīra itivalliṅgāntaraṃ gamyeta| yadvā--nātra prajña eva prājñaḥ yāva eva yāvaka ityādivadatyantasvāthikatvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? īṣacchukle śuklatare ca guṇayogasya bhāvāt śuklaśabda eva pravarttitumarhati, aupagavādau tu naivamityetāvatā svārthikatvavācoyuktiḥ| paramārthatastvasminprayoge prakṛṣṭe śuklaśabdasya pravṛttinimittam, tamabantasya tu tadgataḥ prakarṣa iti kuto'tra ṅīpaḥ prasaṅgaḥ! tadidamuktam--prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca svarthikānāṃ dyotyaṃ bhavatīti|
atrāpi yadyapi tasmindravye bahavo guṇāḥsanti, tathāpi yasya guṇasya bhāvād dravye śabdaniveśaḥ pratyāsattestatprakarṣāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ| tadyathā--śuklādibhyo guṇaprakarṣe, pācakādibhyaḥ kriyāprakarṣe, vāhadohādayo dharmāḥ, tatprakarṣe pratyayaḥ| tadyathā--gaurayaṃ yaḥ śakaṭaṃ vahati, gotaro'yaṃ yaḥ śakaṭaṃ vahati sīraṃ ca, gauriyaṃ yā samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate, gotareyaṃ yā samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate strī vatsā ca, aśvo'yaṃ ścatvāri yojanāni gacchati, aśvataro'yaṃ yo'ṣṭau gacchatīti| etena saṃkhyāparimāṇapramāṇonmānaśabdā vyākhyātāḥ| na hi svatado bhavati, dvitaraḥ prasthataraḥ vitastitaraḥ suvaparṇataramiti, sarvathā dharmadvārako dravyasya prakarṣo na svataḥ, yathā--śuklaguṇayogātpaṭasya śuklavyapadeśaḥ, tathā prakarṣavyapadeśo'pi, tatprakarṣādevetyarthaḥ|
uktaṃ ca---
dravyasyāvyapadeśyasya ya upādīyate guṇaḥ|
bhedako vyapadeśāya tatprakarṣo'bhidhīyate|| iti|
`avyapadeśyasya' iti dharmayogamantareṇa svarūpeṇa vyapadeṣṭumaśakyasyetyarthaḥ| tadevamatiśāyanaśabdo bāvasādhanaḥ, prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca, svārthikaśca pratyaya iti sthitam| ata eva prakṛtito liṅgavacanāni bhavanti| yadi tu kartṛsādhanaḥ syāt, tadā yadi prakṛtyarthastato'tiśāyanātiśāyakātiśayitṛprabhṛtibhya eva syāt, tatrāpi svārthe na pravṛttinimittaprakarṣe; atha pratyayārthaḥ, tataḥ sāmarthyalabhyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| sā ca yadi tiṅntena vigrahastādā dvitīyā---śuklamatiśete śuklatara iti| atha kṛ-dantenātiśāyanaśabdena, tadā ṣaṣṭhī--śuklasyātiśāyanaḥ śuklatara iti| tathā ca kālīmatiśete kālaḥ kālitara iti prāpnoti, kālamatiśete kālī kālatareti prāpnoti| iha ca gargānatiśete gārgyaḥ kargatara iti prāpnoti, tathā gārgyamatiśerate gargāḥ gārgyatarā iti prāpnoti| atha karaṇasādhanaḥ tatrāpi prakṛtyarthaścedyena guṇenātiśete tadvācinaḥ śauklyādereva syāt, śauklyena hi śuklaḥ śuklāntaramatiśete| pratyayārthe tu śuklādiśabdādatiśāyane guṇo pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, guṇisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt--śuklataraḥ paṭa iti| atha vyantātkarttari lyuḍ--atiśāyayatītyatiśāyan iti, evamapi sa eva doṣo yaḥ karaṇapakṣe| guṇā hi guṇinaṃ prayuñjate---asmābhiḥ prakṛṣṭaistvaṃ sajātīyamatiśeṣeveti, tataśca prakṛtyantātkaraṇe lyuṭi yo doṣaḥ sa evātrāpi bhavati| atha śetiravastānārthaḥ--pakvāśayo jalāśaya itivat, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--guṇā guṇini śerate, avatiṣṭhante, tānguṇyatiśāyayati-ātmanyatiśayenāvastāpayatīti, tataśca sa eva doṣo yaḥ prakṛtyantātkarttari lyuṭi| atiśāyanaśabdaśca prakṛtyanto na sādhitaḥ syāt| tasmād vṛttikāropadarśita evārtho nyāpyaḥ ||
paṭiṣṭha iti| `turiṣṭhemeyassu' ṭeriti ṭilopaḥ| gariṣṭha iti| `priyasthira' ityādīnā guruśabdasya garādeśaḥ|
`prakarṣapratyayāntādapareṇa prakarṣapratyayena na bhavitavyam, ekenaiva prakarṣasya dyotitatvāt' iti manyamānaṃ pratyayāha--yadā ceti|ātiśāyikāntāditi| atiśaye bhava ātiśāyikaḥ, adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ, anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| śreṣṭhatamāryati| `praśasyasya śraḥ' atra prakarṣarahitapratiyogyapekṣayā yaḥ prakarṣastatreṣṭanvihitaḥ, tamappratyayastu prakarṣavatpratiyogyapekṣayā yaḥ prakarṣa iṣṭhanpratyayenadyotitastasminnityapaunaruktyam| pratyayadvayasya vidhīyamānapratyayabhedācca dve ete vākye, tatraikeneṣṭhan, apareṇa tadantāttamap| tenaitanna codanīyam--yathā sanantānna san bhavati, tadvidānavelāyāṃ tadantasya dhātorabhāvāt; tathā prakarṣapratyāntādapareṇa prakarṣapratyayena na bhavitavyamiti ||
bhāṣye tu prakarṣapratyayāntādaparaḥ prakarṣapratyayo naiva bhavatīti sthitm| tatkayam? na tāvattarabantādaparasya prasaṅgaḥ--yatra hi trayāṇāmekaḥ śuklaḥ, dvitīyaḥ kiñcitprakṛṣṭaḥ, tṛtīyaścātyantam, tatra kila prasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyate; tatra dvitīyasya sadapyutkṛṣṭatvaṃ tṛtīyasannidhāvakiñcitkaram, rājasannidhāvivāmātyasyeti| dvitīyāttāvattarabna bhavati| tṛtīyādapi na bhavati, tasminneva prayoge trayāṇāmapekṣitatvena dvivacanopapadatvābhāvāt| eteneyasunvyāśyātaḥ| nāpi tamabantādaparasya prasaṅgaḥ| yatra hi caturṇā dvau śuklau, tṛtīyaḥ kiñcicadutkṛṣṭaḥ, caturthaścātyantam, tatra kila prasaṅgaḥ śaṅkyate; tatra tṛtīyasya sadapyutkṛṣṭatvaṃ caturthasannidhau pūrvavadakiñcitkaram, caturthāttu tamabeva bhavati| eteneṣṭhanvyākhyātaḥ|
kathaṃ tarhi śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe iti? chāndasatvātsvārthikastamab draṣṭavyaḥ| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kuruṇām iti tvanyāpyameva manyate ||

tiṅśca || 5.3.56 ||
pacatitamāmiti| `kimettiṅavyaya' ityādinā''mpratyayaḥ|
guṇavacane tasya niyatatvāditi| ata eva sūtrārthakathanavelāyāmapi tamap pratyayo bhavatītyuktam| na cānuvṛttisāmarthyānniyamasya bādhaḥ, tamabvidhāne'pyanuvṛtterupapannatvāt ||

dvivacanavibhajyacopapade tarabīyasunau || 5.3.57 ||
dvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanamiti| karaṇe lyuṭ, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| yena padena dvāvarthāvucyete tad dvivacanamityarthaḥ| etenānvarthasya dvivacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣikasya hi grahaṇe, asmākaṃ ca devadattasya ca devadatto'bhirūpatara ityatra na syāt| anvarthagrahaṇe tu bhavati, tathā hi--asmākamityanenaiko'rtha ucyate, `asmado dvayośca' ityekasminnevārthe bahuvadbhāvavidhānād; devadattasya cetyanenāpi dvitīyo'rtha ucyate iti kabhavatyetadanvratham--dvivacanamupapadam| vibhaktavyaḥ-pṛthakkarttavyaḥ, sa cātiśayyamānaḥ| tasya hyupapadatvam, na atiśayituḥ; tataḥ pratyayavidhānāt| apara āha--ādyāderatiśayitṛviśeṣaṇātpratyayo vidhīyate, nātiśayiturmādhurāderiti tasyāpyupapadatvamavirūddham| pṛthakkāro'pi tasyāpyaviśiṣṭa iti| nipātanādyaditi| `ṛhalorṇyat' iti ṇyato'pavādaḥ| tena vibhāgyamiti naiva bhavati| vibhājyaśabdasyatu smṛtiṣu prayuktasya sādhutvaṃ cintyam| dvyarthe vibhajye copapada iti| sūtre tu dvivacanaṃ ca vibhajyaṃ ca dvivacanavibhajyam, tacca tadupapadaṃ ceti karmadhārayātsaptamī| anvarthaṃ copapadam-upoccāritaṃ padamupapadamiti| tacca vigrahavākya eva prayujyate| vṛttotu gatārthatvānnāvaśyaṃ prayujyate| evaṃ copapadagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| iha dve upapade, dve ca prakṛtī--`ṅyāpprātipadikāt' `tiṅśca' iti, pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyaprasaṅgaḥ? ityata āha--yathāsaṃkhyāmiti| iṣṭireveyam| ayamanayoriti| anayorityetadatra dvyarthamupapadam| paṭīyāniti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ, agittvānnum, `sāntamahataḥ' iti dīrghatvam, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau|
mādhurā ityādi| kiṃ punaratra vibhajyam? pāṭaliputrakā hatyāha| tathā ca tatra `pañcamī vibhakte' iti pañcamī bhavati| yadyapyatrāpī mādhurāṇāmeko rāśiḥ, pāṭaliputrakāṇāṃ cāpara iti rāśyapekṣaṃ dvyarthatvamasti; tathāpi nāsau śabdenopādīyate, pratyutāvayavabheda eva| ata eva bahuvacanam| iha ca-mādhurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhyaḥ sāṃkaśyakebyaścābhirūpatarā iti na rāśyapekṣamapi dvyarthatvamasti| tasmādvibhajyopapadagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|
iha dantoṣṭhasya dantāḥ snigdhatarāḥ, pāṇipādasya pāṇī sukumāratarāvityatra tarabna prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? samāhārasyaikatvāt; na ca guṇabhūtavarttipadārthāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ, teṣāṃ bahutvāt--dvātriṃśaddantāḥ, dvāvoṣṭhau ? atrā''huḥ--vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmupādadate varttipadāni, tataśca bhedaparityāgādabedaikatvasaṃkhyāyāścopādānād--evambhūtadantoṣṭhalakṣaṇārthadvayāśrayaḥ pratyaya iti| itaretarayogadvandve tvavayavārthabedasadbhāvād dvyarthatā nāstīti tarabna bhavati| plakṣanyagrodhānāṃ plakṣā dīrghatamā iti vibhajyopapadāśrayo'pi na bhavati, katham? pratiyogyapekṣatvātprakarṣasya| sāmarthyalabhye vibhāge vibhajyopapadagrahaṇamavadhāraṇārtham--vibhāgā eva yatra śabdena pratipādyata iti| iha tu nirdhāraṇāśrayanirddeśo nirdhāryamāṇasyāpi sādhāraṇa iti na vibhāga eva kevalaḥ, kintvavibhāgo'pi| etena `pañcamī vibhakte' iti pañcamī vyākhyātā| iha `parudbhavānpaṭurāsīt, paṭutaraścaiṣamaḥ' ityekasyāpi dharmiṇo guṇabhedena dvitvādhyāropātpratiyogyapekṣaḥ prakarṣaḥ, tadāśrayaśca pratyayaḥ| vyapadiśati ca--`anya evāsi saṃvṛttaḥ' `kaccitsa evāsi dhanañjayasatvam' iti ||

ajādī guṇavacanādeva || 5.3.58 ||
evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ ? niyamo yathā vijñāyeta; anyathā prakarthe'jādyorvidhānādaprakarṣe vidhiḥ syāt| `atiśāyane' ityanuvarttiṣyate, tatraiva punarvacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati,nārtha evakāreṇa? tatrāha--evakāra iṣṭato'ḍavadhāraṇārtha iti| asati hyasminviparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyate--ajādī eva guṇavacanāditi| tatra ko doṣaḥ ? guṇavacanād vyañjanādī na syātām; tasyājādyorniyatatvāt| yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti| ajādyoścāniyatatvādaguṇavacanādapi tayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ| idamatibahu kriyate--ajādī guṇavacanādeveti, evaṃ tu vaktavyam--atiśāyane tamap, guṇavacanādiṣṭhan, dvivacanavibhajyopapada iyasun, guṇavacanādityeva, tatastarap ca, gumavaṭacanāditi nivṛttam? sāpam; `praśasyasya śraḥ' ityevamādyarthaṃ tu `ajādī' ityuktam| evaṃ tarhi `praśasyasya śro'jādyoḥ' ityevāstu, evamapi hyevakāro na vaktavyo bhavati? tvatpakṣe'pi `tarap ca' iti cakāraḥ kriyate, tattulyaṃ bhavati ||

tuśchandasi || 5.3.59 ||
pūrveṇetyādi| niyamabādhena prakṛtyantarasyābyanujñānamātraṃ kriyate, na tpapūrvo vidhirityarthaḥ, tenopādhisaṅkaro na bhavati| kariṣṭha iti| kartṛśabdāttṛnnantādiṣṭhan| ata eva karmaṇi dvitīyā bhavati| tṛjantādeva vā bhavatu, dvitīyā tu kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivad draṣṭavyā| dohīyasīti| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā dogdhrīśabdātpratyayaḥ| bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpo nivṛtti| yadvā, `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau' iti vacanānṅīpi nivṛtte dogdhṛśabdādeva pratyayaḥ, tataḥ `turiṣṭhemeyasmu' iti tṛci nivṛtte nimittābhāvād ghatvajaśtvayorapi nivṛttiḥ ||

praśasyasya śraḥ || 5.3. 60 ||
ajādyoḥ pratyayayoḥ parata iti| nanu cājādī iti prathamāntaṃ prakṛtam| na saptamyantam, tatkathamayamartho labhyate ? ityata āha--ajādī iti prakṛtasyetyādi| prakṛtasya yā vibhaktiḥ prathamā sā saptamīrūpeṇa vipariṇamyate, ūhyata ityarthaḥ|
evaṃ tarhītyādi| atha yāveva sambhavataḥ--taraptamapau, tayoreva parato'yamādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? naivaṃ bhavitumarhati; `ajādī' ityanuvṛttisāmarthyāt| athātraivājādyorvidhiḥ kasmānna vijñāyate--praśasyaśabdādajādī bhavataḥ, śraścāsyādeśa iti, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--vibhaktivipariṇāmo na kartavyo bhavati? naivaṃ śakyam; taraptamapau hi syātām, viśeṣavihitāvajādī bādheyātām, upādhīnāṃ ca saṅkaraḥ syād-iṣṭhanviṣaye īyasun, tadviṣaye ceṣṭhanniti| tadviṣaya iti| sa praśasyaśabdo viṣayo yasya sa tadviṣayaḥ| saptamyantapāṭhe tu sa eva viṣayastatretyarthaḥ| niyamo na pravartata iti| nayamāpravṛttijñāpanadvāreṇājādibhāvo jñāpyate, na tu sākṣādityarthaḥ; anyathā punaranajādyorbādha upādhisaṅkaraśca syāt, uktena prakāreṇa svaśāstreṇaivājādyorvidānānnaitaddoṣadvayamapi bhavati| kathaṃ punarthāśrutasambandhasambhave'pi vipariṇāmaḥ śakya āśrayitum ? śrṛṇu; ajādyorvidhiriṣṭaścetpañcamyā niradekṣyat| kiñca evaṃ sanniyogārthaścakāro'pyakariṣyata|
ṭilopa-yasyetilopāviti| `yasyeti' ityanena lopo yasyetilopaḥ, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, tatrānukaraṇatvādasyavāmīyamityādivadbibhakteralopaḥ| `ādguṇaḥ' iti tvanaṅgatvānna pratiṣidhyate ||

jya ca|| 5.3.61 ||
yogavibhāgā uttaratra jyādeśa eva yathā syāt, ādeśo mā bhūditi| ayamanayoriti| atiśayena praśasya iti vipariṇāmenāpekṣyate, na punaruttareṇaikagranthatā| evaṃ sarvatra ||

vṛddhasya ca || 5.3.62 ||
svarūpagrahaṇam, na tu `vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ' iti pāribhāṣikasyetyāha--vṛddhaśabdasyeti| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| tayoścetyādi| yatpūrvamuktam--`evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu vijñeyam' iti, tadevānena smāritam|
vacanātpakṣe so'pi bhavatīti| nanu ca varṣādeśasyemanijavakāśaḥ syāt? na; vṛddhaśabdādimanico'bhāvāt| yadyevam, varṣādeso'pīhaiva vaktavyaḥ--vṛddhasya varṣiśceti, evaṃ hi dvirvṛddhagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva| apara āha---iṣṭhanīyasunorimavemanico'pi sadbhāvaḥ kalpyate, tena varṣimetyapi bhavati| tasya mate---varṣādeśasyemanici caritārthatvādiṣṭhannīyasunoranena jyādeśa eva prāpnoti| tasmād `yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām' ityatredamanuvartate, tena jyādeśena mukte pakṣe varṣādeśaḥ ||

antikabāḍhayornedasādhau || 5.3.63 ||
nimittayoryathāsaṃkhyamiha neṣyata iti| `ajādyoḥ' iti prakṛtayoriṣṭhanīyasunorgrahaṇāttayośca krameṇopadeśādajahatkramayoreva pratīteryathāsaṃkhyāprasaṅgaṃ manyate| kasmātpunariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati ? viparītakramasyāpi sambhavāt| tathā hi--kayorajādyorityapekṣāyāmānantarthādīyasuṃstāvatpratīyate, dvivacanānurodhātviṣṭhannapītyevamapi kramaḥ sambhavati| tadanayoḥ kramayornānyataraḥ kramo nirddhārayituṃ śakya ityanāśrayaṇameva tayoryuktam ||

yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām || 5.3.64 ||
yuveti na saṃjñāyūno grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi? svarūpasya; alpasāhacaryāt vyākhyānācca| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamalpaśabdārtham| yuvaśabdasya tu `sthūladūrayuva' iti vacanātsiddho vikalpaḥ| yaviṣṭha iti| sthūladūrādisūtreṇa yaṇādiparaṃ lupyate, pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ| kanīyāniti| prakaraṇādivaśādyuvālpayoranyatarāvasāyaḥ| `prakṛtyaikāc' iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, `allopo'naḥ' ityallopaśca na bhavati|

vinmatorluk || 5.3.65 ||
vinmatorityutsṛṣṭānubanadhayorvinimatupordvandvātṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam| atha vingrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā yebhyo vin tebyo matubapi bhavati, tasyaiva luki srajiṣṭha ityādi siddham, na ca vina iṣṭhacīyasunoḥ śravaṇaprasaṃgaḥ, tadantāttayorabhāvāt? asmādeva hi lugvacanādvinantāttayorbhāvo jñāpyate| yadā tarhi vinantāt `tatkaroti tadātaṣṭe' iti ṇic kriyate, tadā vinaḥ śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vino lugvacanam--sragviṇamācaṣṭe srajayati ||

praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap || 5.3.66 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣṇaṃ caitaditi| pratyārthatve tu vaiyākaraṇasya praśaṃsā vaiyākaraṇarūpa iti prāpnoti, vaiyākaraṇarūpo devadatta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt, tasmātprakṛtyarthaviseṣamam--praśaṃsāviśiṣṭebhya iti| sa punaḥ praśasto na tu praśaṃsitā; anabhidhānāt| svārtha iti| yadyevam, kumārīrūpetyatrānatiriktaṃ vaya iti kṛtvā ṅīp prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kumārīśabdādutpannena ṅīpā vayoviśiṣṭārthagatasya strītvasya dyotitatvādrūpabantasya strītvamātramabhivyaṅktuṃ ṭābeva kriyate, na ca ṅīpaiva tadabhivyaktamiti ṭāpo'prasaṅgaḥ| kumārīrūpa ityucyamāne hi kuṭīrādivalliṅgāntaraṃ pratīyeta| yatadvā--pravṛttinimittabhedānṅīpo'prasaṅgaḥ, kumāraśabdasya vayo nimittam, rūpabantasya tu tadgatā praśaṃsā, tadāhasvāthiṃkāścetyādi| atrāpi pravṛttinimittasya praśaṃsāyāmayaṃ pratyayaḥ, tena yo vyākaraṇe'nipuṇaḥ praśastaśca vaṃśaśīlādinā, tatra vaiyākaraṇarūpa iti na bhavati| kvacittu sahacaritadharmapraśaṃsāyāmapi bhavati--gorūpo'yaṃ yaḥ samyagvahatīti|
atha kathaṃ vṛṣalādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ, te hi tadā nindāvacanāḥ, tadabhidheyānāṃ kākādivannikṛṣakhṭatacvāt ? ata āha--prakṛtyarthasyeti| vaiśiṣṭyam-paripūrṇatā, tasminsati praśaṃsā bhavati| tathā ca vṛṣalādiśabdā api svārthasya pūrṇatve sati prasaṃsāviśiṣṭa evārthe pravarttanta iti tebyo'pi siddhaḥ pratyaya iti bhāvaḥ|
vṛṣalarupa iti| yadyapyayaṃ jātivacanaḥ, jāteśca nyūnatvam pūrṇatvaṃ vā na bhavati; tathāpi sahacaritadharmālpatvaṃ bahutvāpekṣaṃ nyūnatvaṃ pūrṇatvaṃ ca draṣṭavyam| yadvā--gumasamudāye śabdapravṛtteḥ śabdārthasyaivaitadubhyaṃ bhavati| yaḥ palāṇḍuneti| sahayoge tṛtīyā| kaścid vṛṣalaḥ palāṇkaḍuṃ bhakṣayati, kaścitsurāṃ pibati, yastūbhayaṃ karoti tasya paripūrṇavṛṣalatvam| tathā coraśabdārthasyāpi suguptavastvapaharaṇena paripūrṇatā bhavati| akṣṇorabyañjanaṃ harediti| sambhāvane liṅ, evaṃvidhamapyasya cauryasambhavatītyartaḥ| akṣṇorapyañjanaṃ haratu vā mā vā hārṣīt, nanvevamapi yadā nindāpratipādanāya vṛṣalarūpa ityādi prayujyate tadā na siddhyati, nindaiva hi tadā prakṛtyarthasya vaiśiṣṭyādbhavati, tasmātpraśaṃsāgrahaṇamapanīya vaiśiṣṭyagrahaṇameva karttavyam, yadāha--`siddhaṃ tu prakṛttayarthasya vaiśiṣṭyavacanāt' iti| vṛttikārastu manyate---corarūpo'yamityādau praśaṃsaiva śabdārthaḥ, nindāpratītistu vākyanibandhaneti| dṛśyate ca praśaṃsāparāṇāmapi nindāparatvam, yathā--rākṣasa iti, pauruṣātiśayapraśaṃsāvacane praśaṃsā gamyate, nirghṛṇatvapratipādane tu nindā|
pacatorūpam, pacantirūpamiti| ???????dvivacanabahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ, svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartanta iti kṛtvā? tatrāha--kriyāpradhānamākyātamiti| yadyapyākhyātasya kriyāsādhanapuruṣasaṃkhyākālopagraharūpo'neko'rthaḥ, tathāpi teṣu tasya kriyaiva pradānamarthaḥ| kathaṃ jñāyate? yat kriyāṃ pṛṣṭastadantenācaṣṭe--devadattaḥ kiṃ karoti? pacatīti| nanu ca dravyamapi pṛṣṭastiṅantenācaṣṭe, yathā--ka eṣu devadatto yaḥ pacatīti ? yuktamatra ya iti hi padāntareṇa dravyopalakṣaṇāya guṇabhāvaṃ kriyā nīyate| ata eva kevalenākhyātena prativacanābhāvaḥ, na hi bhavati--ko devadattaḥ, pacatīti| tasmāt kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, tiṅanto pāttārthāpekṣaṃ ca kriyāyāḥka prādhānyamucyate| vrīhinavahantītyādau tu dravyasaṃskārārthatvādavaghātādervrīhyapekṣamaprādhānyamastyeva|
apara āha--atrāpyavaghātādereva śābdaṃ pradhānyam; sādhyatvāt| na tu vrīhyādeḥ; sādhanatvāt| ārthaṃ tu tasya pradhānyamiti|
ekā ca kriyeti| `nivṛttabhedā sarvatra kriyākyāteṣu gamyate'| kathaṃ tarhi dvivacanabahuvacane bhavataḥ--pacataḥ, pacantīti? naite kriyābedāpekṣe dvivacanabahuvacane, kiṃ karhi? sādhanabedāpekṣe| ata eva bhavadbhirāsyate hatyādau kevalakriyāvacane dvivacanabahuvacanābhāvaḥ| na ca kartṛbhedaḥ kriyābhedena vyāptaḥ; ekaphaloddeśena pravṛttāmekāmeva pākavyakti bahuṣvapi kurvatsu-bhavantaḥ pacanti, bhavadbhiḥ pacyata iti darśanāt| tasmādākhyātavācyā kriyaiketi siddham| tena rūpappratyayāntād dvivacanabahuvacane na bhavataḥ|
atha yathā tiṅnte sādhanabhedāśraye dvicanabahuvacane bhavataḥ, tathā rūpabantādapi kasmānna bhavataḥ? uktottarametat--kriyāpradhānamākhyātamiti| svārthikasya hi prakṛtito liṅgavacanaprāptiḥ, tatra ca kriyā pradhānabhūtā, sā caikā, tataśca pradhānabhūtaprakṛtyarthānurodhena bhavadvacanamekavacanameva bhavati| pacatirūpamityādāvapi kartuḥ saṃkhyā'bhidhīyate| supā tu kriyāyā ekatvam| atha vātiṅoktatvādrūpappratyayāntād dvivacanabahuvacane na bhaviṣyataḥ| ekavacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati; tasyautsargikatvāt--`ekavacanamutsargaḥ kariṣyate' iti| etacca tatratatra vyākhyātam| yadi tarhi kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, napuṃsakaliṅgamapi rūpabantasya na syāt, kriyāyā asatatvabhūtatvena liṅgābhāvāt? ata āha--napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tviti| atha tamabādeḥ rūpapaśca ko viṣayavibhāgaḥ, yāvatā'tiśāyanamapi pūjānindāviṣayam--paṭutamaḥ, pāpīyāniti; rūpappratyayo'pyubhayaviṣayaḥ--paṭurūpaḥ, corarūpa iti? ucyate--atiśāyanaṃ samānaguṇapratiyogyapekṣam, vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tu tannirapekṣamiti spaṣṭa eva viṣayabhedaḥ ||

īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ || 5.3.67 ||
sampūrṇateti| pravṛttinimittasya pauṣkalyamityarthaḥ| padārthaśabapdena paryavasānabhūmirvivakṣitā| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| na pratyayārthaḥ| yadi tathā syād, guḍasyeṣadasamāptirdrākṣāyā guḍakalpā drakṣāyā iti syāt, guḍakalpā drākṣeti dravyeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt, ekavacanameva ca syāt, iṣyate cābhidheyavalliṅgavacane syātāmiti| tasmātprakṛtyarthaṃviśeṣaṇam| svārtha iti| na ca kumārikalpetyatrāpyanatiriktaṃ vaya iti ṅīpaḥ prasaṅgaḥ; na hi kalpabantasya vayaḥpravṛttinimittam, kiṃ tarhi? tadgateṣadasamāptiḥ| īṣadasamāptaḥ paṭuḥ paṭukalpaḥ, mṛdukalpa iti|
nanu ca yo'rtha etāvāneveti parijñātaḥ, tasya samāptirvā bhavatyasamāptirvā, na ca pāṭavādiguṇa etāvāniti nirjñātaḥ, yāvattāvadapi hi pāṭavaṃ bhavatyeva, tat kathamasyeṣadasamāptiḥ; etena jātiśabdā vyākhyātāḥ, na hi te'ktaparimāṇamarthamācakṣate ? idaṃ tu yuktamudāhartum--kṛtakalpam, bhuktakalpamiti| dhātvartho hi phalāvacchinno vyāpāranicayo'ktaparimāṇaḥ| nanvatrāpi bhūte ktaḥ, phalaniṣpattau ca dhātvartho bhūto bhavati, bhūtasya ca tasya kuta īṣadasamāptiḥ? yadā tahi kriyaikadeśāpavargāśrayo bhūte ktaḥ, tadodāharaṇam--kṛtakalpaṃ vastramiti| tathā ca kṛtādaya ekadeśakaraṇāśrayā prayogā dṛśyante| yadā bhaviṣyatkālāyā īṣadasamāptāyāḥ kriyāyā āśasyamānatvāt `āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' iti bhaviṣyati ktapratyayaḥ, tadāpi bhavatyudāharaṇam| evam `ñītaḥ ktaḥ', `matibuddhipūjārthebyaśca' iti varttamānaviṣayaktāntādapi yuktaḥ pratyayaḥ--pūjitakalpam, jātakalpamiti| tathā tiṅantamapi kālatraviṣayaṃ bhavatyudāharaṇam--pacatikalpam, pakṣyatikalpam, apākṣītkalpamiti| guṇavacanaṃ tvayuktam| tadapi yuktam, nanu coktaṃ yāvattāvadapi pāṭavaṃ bhavatyeva nāsyeṣadasamāptiriti? naitadasti; lokata eva guṇasyāpīyattāyā nirjñātatvāt| loke hi paṭurayamityucyate, yo laghunaivopāyena sādyārthānsādhayati| yasyu na tathā sādhayati, kintvīṣadūnam, sā paṭukalpaḥ| tadviparyayeṇa mṛdu-mṛdukalpau vyākhyātau| jātivacane kathaṃ guḍakalpā drakṣā, tailakalpā prasanneti? ucyate; guḍagatamādhuryaśrayeṇa drākṣāyāṃ guḍatvāropād guḍajātyabhāvācca īṣadasamāptaṃ guḍatvaṃ drākṣāyāḥ| tathā guḍakalpo guḍa ityapi bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ sa eveṣadasamāptaḥ sambhavati? guṇahāneḥ---yāvanmādhuryaṃ guḍasya prasiddham, na tāvatpurāṇatvādidoṣopahatasya| tenāsāvīṣadasamāpto guḍa ityucyate ||

vibhāṣā supo bahucpurastāttu || 5.3.68 ||
īṣadasamāptiviśiṣṭe'rthe varttamānāditi| lyablopa eṣā pañcamī| evambhūtaṃ subantaṃ prakṛtitvenāśrityetyarthaḥ| sūtre tu `supaḥ' iti `ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena' iti ṣaṣṭhī| sa ca purastādeveti| etenānekārthatvānnipātānām `tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe varttate' iti darśayati| asati tu tuśabde pratyayāt pūrvatvasyāpi vidheyatayā prādhānyādvibhāṣāgrahaṇena sambandhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
bhāṣyakārastu manyate--`udaśvito'nyatarasyām' ityādau yathā paratvaṃ na vikalpate, tatkasya hetoḥ? pratyaya eva paratvaviśiṣṭo vidhīyate, tatra viśeṣaṇasya gumatvādvikalpena na sambandhaḥ, guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāditi nyāyāt; tadvadihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇena bahujeva sambhantsyate, na purastādityetat| tuśabdasya tvavadhāraṇārthasyānyadeva prayojanam--purastādeva sarvaṃ bhavatīti| tena liṅgasaṃkhye api prākpratyayotpatteḥka prakṛtyavasthāyāṃ ye dṛṣṭe te eva bhavataḥ| prayogaśca prāk kṛterbhavatīti| tena bahuguḍo drākṣā, laghurbahutṛṇaṃ nara iti prakṛtivalliṅgaṃ bhavati, nābhidheyavat| evaṃ ca bahuguḍeti strīliṅgapāṭhaḥ pramādajo draṣṭavyaḥ; itarathā bhāṣyavirodhāt| nanu ca svārthikatvādeva prakṛtito liṅgavacane bhaviṣyataḥ, evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--īṣadasamāptau ye svārthikāsteṣvabhidheyavadeva liṅgavacane bhavata iti| tena guḍakalpā drakṣā,tailakalpā prasanneti siddhaṃ bhavati|
citkaraṇamantodāttārthamiti| taccāntodāttatvaṃ saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya bhavati, na bahucaḥ; citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajarthamiti vacanāt| yadyevam, bahupaṭava iti subantasya purastādutpattau jasa udāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? syādevam, yadi prāgutpanno jasavatiṣṭheta; iha tu bahucyutpanne samudāyasyeṣadasamāptilakṣaṇenārthavattvātprātipadikatve sati `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti luki punaraparo jasutpadyate, tasya ca prakṛtyanekadeśatvānnodāttatvam| nanu samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvātprakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā na prāpnoti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamapratyayaiti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--bhavati prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā, na tu samāsagrahaṇena vyāvṛttiriti|
vibhāṣāvacanādityādi| anyathā tiṅnteṣu sāvakāśāḥ kalpabādayaḥ subante viśeṣavihitena bahucā deśabhede'pi samānārthena bādhyeran|
subgrahaṇamityādi| anyathā `tiṅsca' ityadhikārātkalpabādivadbahujapi tiṅntasyāpi purastātsyāt| prātipadikanivṛttyarthaṃ tu subgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; viśeṣābāvāt| nanu cāyamasti viśeṣaḥ--bahusecauḥ, bahusecaḥ, subantādutpatau satyām `sātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ siddhyati, prātipadikāttūtpattau ṣatvaprasahgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, subantādapyutpattāvavaśyamatra kutvaniṣedārtho yatnaḥ karttavyaḥ, sa eva prātipadikādutpattau ṣtvaniṣedārthaḥ kariṣyate| sa ca `na lumatāṅgasya' ityatraiva darśitaḥ, iha taraptamaporavakāśaḥ prakarṣasya vacanamīṣadasamāpteravacanam--paṭutaraḥ, paṭutamaḥ, kalpabādīnāmavakāśa īṣadasamāptervacanaṃ prakarṣasyāvacanam--paṭukalpaḥ, mṛdukalpaḥ; ubhayavacanādubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkalpabādiṣu kṛteṣu prakarṣadyotanāya punaḥprasaṅgavijñānāttadantāttaraptamapau bhavataḥ---paṭukalpataraḥ, mṛdukalpatara iti| yadi yadantādbhavantau yatpradhānastadantastatprakarṣe prāpnutaḥ, kiṃpradhānaśca tadantaḥ? īṣadasamāptipradhānaḥ, prakṛtyarthaprakarṣe ceṣyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, neṣadasamāpteḥ prakarṣaḥ sambhavati, na hīṣadarthasyāsamāptervā prakarṣe īṣadasamāptirbhavati ||

prakāravacane jātīyar || 5.3.69 ||
tasya vacana iti| vacanam-dyotam| subantāditi| atrāpi tiṅnivṛttyartham `supaḥ' ityanuvarttate iti darśayati| prakāravati cāyamiti| tena viṣayabedādviśeṣavihitenāpi thālā jātīyaro bādhā na bhavati, thālntācca jātīyar siddho bavatīti bhāvaḥ| svabhāvaścātra hetuḥ ||

prāgivātkaḥ || 5.3.70 ||
tiṅantādayaṃ pratyayo neṣyata iti| tadarthamatra `supaḥ' ityeva sambandhanīyamiti bhāvaḥ|
akajiṣyata iti| tadarthaṃ tatra `supaḥ' ityeva sambandhanīyamiti bhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaranuvartamānaṃ śakyamasambhanadhum ? tatrāha--tiṅścetyanuvṛttamiti| atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| iha `prākkuṭyāḥ' iti vaktavyam, na hi `kuṭīśamīśuṇḍābyo raḥ' ityārabyāsyopayogaḥ; pratyayāntarairavaṣṭabdhatvāt? uttarārthaṃ tviyato'vadhergrahaṇam, `vā bahūnām' ityatra hi vāvacanamakajartham| evamapi prākkana iti vaktavyam `avakṣepaṇe kan' ityayamavadhiḥ| kuto nu khalvetad? ayameva kanavadhiḥ, na punarhasve, `saṃjñāyāṃ kan' `kutsite saṃjñāyāṃ kan' ityetayoranyataro'vadhiḥ syāt ||
avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ || kasyāpavāda iti| nanu ca virodhe sati bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati, kākacośca deśabhedānnāsti virodhaḥ, tatkathaṃ tasyāpavādaḥ? nāvaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva virodhaḥ, ki tahi? arthakṛto'pi| kākacośca prayojanamekam--ajñātādyarthadyotanaṃ nāma, tasminnakacā kṛte prayojanābhāvātko na bhaviṣyati| sarvake iti| akacastanmadhyapatitasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt `jasaḥ śī' bhavati, ke tu sati na syāt|
dvayamapīhānuvarttata iti| yadyevam, sarvatra subantasya prātipadikasya ca prāk ṭeḥ pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ? tatrāha--tatreti| kvacitpratipadikasyeti| okārasakārabhakārādau vibhaktau| kvacitsubantasyeti| uktādanyatra vibhaktau| tvayakīti| akaco dvitīyo'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| citkaraṇaṃ tu samudāyasyāntodāttārtham; `citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham' iti vacanāt| idameva citkaraṇaṃ liṅgam--saprakṛteścito'ntodāttatvam, na cinmātrasyeti|
tūṣṇīmaḥ kāmiti| yathāsambhavamajñātādiṣvartheṣu| makāro deśavidhyarthaḥ| antyādacaḥ paraḥ kām bhavati| ajñātādyarthāvivakṣāyāṃ tūṇṇīmityeva bhavati|
śīle ka iti| śīlam-svabhāvaḥ, niyamaśca| ajñātādyapavādaḥ| śīlaṃ tūṣṇīṃ svabhāvāccā dadvān tūṣṇīka ityucyate, na tacchīlamātram ||

kasya ca daḥ || 5.3.72 ||
na sarvanāmagrahaṇamiti| tadiṅgrahaṇaṃ ceti draṣṭavyam; hetostulyatvāt| adhok, avak ityādāvasiddhaṃ kutvam| śaknotiprabhṛteryaṅluki laṭi tipīḍabhāve halṅyādilope aśāśagityādau chāndaso yaṅo luk, chandasi ca dṛṣṭānuvidhānam| dhigiti| kakārāntatvamavyayasya darśayati ||

ajñāte || 5.3.73 ||
ajñāta iti sāmānyenocyate, na ca sarvathā'vijñāte śabdaprayoge evala sambavati, na khalvasva ityajānannaśvaśabdaṃ prayoktumarhati, tasmādviśeṣasya grahaṇamityāha--ajñātaviśeṣo jñāta iti| viśeṣameva darśayati--svena rūpeṇeti| viseṣarūpeṇeti asya vivaraṇam--kasyāyamaśva ityādi| ihājñātaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ paṭurityarthadvayavivakṣāyāṃ paścātkaḥ---paṭutamaka iti bhavati| iha ca kutsitamarddhapippalyā iti vivakṣāyām pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ, paścātkaḥ---arddhapippalīketi bhavati| etena kalpabādayo vyākhyātāḥ| āha ca--`kavidestamabādayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddham ekadeśipradhānaśca samāsaḥ' iti| iha tu chinnakataramiti--`anatyantagatau ktāt' iti paratvātkani kṛte tarab bhavati| kadācid dvandvaḥ--plakṣanyagrodhakau, plakṣakanyagrodhakau iti vā ||

kutsite || 5.3.74 ||
prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitaditi| prakṛtyarthasyaitadviśeṣaṇam, na tūpalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| upalakṣaṇatve hi yaḥ kutsitastatra varttamānāditi vijñāyamāne idaṃ ghṛtakam, idaṃ tailakamityatredaṃśabdādapi prāpnoti| viśeṣaṇatve tvaṅgīkṛtakutsātpratyayaḥ, na tvanupātakutsāt; kutsisamānādhikaraṇāt| pratyayārthatve tu `prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtastayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam' iti prakṛtyarthasya viśeṣaṣaṇatvaṃ kutsitasya viśeṣyatvaṃ prāpnoti, viparyayaśca loke gamyate| tasmātprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti suṣṭhūktam| aśvaka iti| yo'śva eva san tatsādhyāṃ kriyāṃ suṣṭhu na karoti sa evamucyate| svārthikepu hi yatra pravṛttinimittasya viśeṣaṇāsambhavaḥ, tatrābhidheyasahacaritadharmāntarāśrayaḥ pratyayo bhavatītyuktam| evaṃ ca devadattakaḥ, ḍitthaka ityapi bhavati yastatsādhyāmarthaṃ samyaṅ nānutiṣṭati| sambhave tvihāpi śabdopāttamarmāśrayaiva kutsā, tadyathā--paṭukaḥ paṇḍitaka iti svārthe kutsā; `prāpya gāṇkaḍīvadhanvānaṃ viddhi kauravakān striyaḥ' iti liṅgakutsā, kauravakāniti kimete'rjunasaṃnidhau pumāṃsa ityarthaḥ; kvacitsaṅkhayākutsā, yathā--idamekameva śanakamiti, śanabharaṇe yadduḥkhaṃ tadekasyaiva bharaṇa iti śatatvarūpeṇa kutsā| sarvathāṅgīkṛtakutsātpratyaya| atheha kathaṃ pratyayaḥ---kutsitaka iti ? kathañca na syāt ? svaśabdenopāttatvāt kutsāyāḥ ? anukampādāvarthāntare bhavipyati| atha vā--kutsitasya yatkutsanaṃ tatra pratyayaḥ| kutsitatvaṃ yadā kutsyate--nāsya samyakkutsitatvamiti, tadetyarthaḥ| yathā--prakarpasya prakarpe prakṛṣṭatama iti tamappratyayo bhavati tadvadatrāpi| etenānukampitaśabdādanukampāyāṃ pratyayo vyākhyātaḥ ||

anukampāyām || 5.3.76 ||
kāruṇyeneti| karuṇaiva kāruṇyam| abhyupapattiriti| anugrahaḥ, upakāra iti yāvat| parasyoti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| tasyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti| anenagrayoktṛdharmo'nukampā āvādhavad, na tu praśaṃsādivatprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| anye tu prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇameva manyante, tathā cājināntasyetyādiṣu vigraha darśayipyanti--`anukampito vyāvrājinaḥ, anukampito bṛhaspatidattaḥ, anukampitaḥ śevaladattaḥ' iti, na ca prayoktṛdharmasya vigrahe darśanamasti| svapitaki, śvasitakīti| adāditvācchapo luk, `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' itīṭ ||

nītau ca tadyuktāt || 5.3.77 ||
sāmadānādiriti| ādiśabdena bhedadaṇḍayorgrahaṇam, yadyanukampāyāṃ tau sambhavataḥ| asambhave'pi nītisvarūpapradarśanaparaṃ draṣṭavyam| ehakīti| āṅpūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo hiḥ pūrveṇetyādi| anukampāyāṃ hi vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ pratyāsatteranukampyamānādeva yukto vidhātum, tasya hi anukampāsambandhaḥ prattayāsannastadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ| tena vyavahitānnītyupāyāddhānāderna syād; atadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ. tena vyavahitānnītyupāyāddhātāderna syād; atadviṣayatvādanukampāyāḥ| dhānāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ, tataḥ ke vihate `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatve ca svāthikānāṃ prakṛtivalliṅgaṃ bhavatīti kapratyayāntādāpi kṛte `pratyayasthāt' itītvena bhavitavyam| prāyeṇa tu hanta te dhānakā paṭhyate, tatra liṅgātivṛttirdraṣṭavyā ||

bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā || 5.3.78 ||
prakaraṇamapekṣyate, na tvanantaramityāha--anukampāyāṃ nītau ca tadyuktāditi vartata iti| madrabāhuka iti| nāmagrahaṇasyedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, yaugiko'yam--madrau bāhū yasyeti| manuṣyagrahaṇasya tu stamberamādiḥ pratyudāharaṇam| apara āha--madrabāhuriti catuṣpājjātiviśeṣo manuṣyagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇam, nāmagrahaṇasya tvaupagavādiḥ pratyudāharaṇamiti||

ghanilacau ca || 5.3.79 ||
cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti| nanu ca ṭhac pūrvaṇa vihitaḥ, vāvacanāt ko'pi, kātra cakāreṇābhyanujñā ? iti cintyam| yogavibhāgo'pi cintyaprayojanaḥ ||

jātināmnaḥ kan || 5.3.81 ||
yo śabdā jātyantare prasiddhā manuṣyeṣu nāmatvena viniyuktāsta ihodāharaṇam| jātireva nāma, jātirvā nāma-jātināma| vyāghriya iti| anekārthatvānnipātānāmanuvṛttasya vāśabdasya samuccayārthatvād ghanilacau bhavataḥ| ye tu vikalpārthameva vāśabdaṃ manyanate, te kaṃ pratyudāharanti--vyādhrakāḥ, siṃhakā iti| svare viśeṣaḥ| ghanilacostu śarabhila ityādyudāharaṇam ||

ajināntasyottarapadalopaśca || 5.3.82 ||
vyāghrājino nāma kaściditi| vyāghrasyevājinamasyeti kṛtvā| `ajinalopaśca' ityucyamāne mahadajinaṃ mahājinam, vyāghrasyeva mahājinamasya vyāghramahājinaḥ, so'nukampita vyāghraka ityatra mahacchabdasya lopo na syāt; tasmāduttarapadagrahaṇam| lopaścāyaṃ sarvāpahārī; uttarapadagrahaṇāt ||

ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ || 5.3.83 ||
`ṭhājādau' iti samāhāradvandve sautraḥ puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ| ādigrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, `yasminvidhistadādau' ityeva siddham| asminprakaraṇa iti| pratyāsattyā tayoreva buddhau sannidhānāditi bhāvaḥ| ūrdhvamiti prathamāntasyādhyāhāreṇānvaya ityāha--ūrdhvaṃ yacchaśabdarūpaṃ tasyeti| dvitīyāditi pañcamyā ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate, prathamā tu nirdeśārthaiva| `supāṃ su' iti vā ṣaṣṭhīsthāne prathamā bhavatīti| ūrdhvagrahaṇamanarthakam, `tasmādityuttarasya' ityūdhvasyaiva bhaviṣyati? tatrāha-ūrdhvagrahaṇaṃ sarvalopārthamiti| anyathā `ādeḥ parasya' iti dvitīyādaco yaḥ parastasyādereva lopaḥ syād, ūrdhvagrahaṇaṇasāmarthyāttu sarvamevordhvaṃ lupyate|
ṭhagrahaṇamanarthakam, ikādeśe kṛte'jādāvityeva siddham? ata āha--ṭhagrahaṇamiti| akṛta evaikādeśe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva lopo yathā syād ityevamarthaṃ tāvaṭṭhagrahaṇam, kimevaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? uko dvitīyatve sati parasyāṃśasya lope kṛte `isusuktāntātkaḥ' iti kādeśaḥ siddho bhavati, tatraitatsyād-ikādeśe kṛte'jādilakṣaṇa eva lopo'stu, ikādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇādukaḥ paratvena kādeśo bhaviṣyati? tatrā''ha--ājādilakṣaṇo hīti| ṭhajādiṣu yadi varṇamātraṃ pratyayaḥ, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, tataṣṭhasya ka ityatrāpi varṇasyaiva ṭhasya sthānitvam, tataścālvidhitvātsthānivadbhāvo nopapadyate, saṅghātasya tu pratyayatve tatrāpi saṅghātasya grahaṇam| tatra yadyapyupapadyate sthānivadbāvaḥ, tathāpi sannipātaparibhāṣayā kādeśo na syādeva| ajādeḥ pratyasya prakṛtyā yadānantarthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ hyukaḥ pratyayenānantaryaṃ tatkathaṃ tasyājāditvaṃ vihanyāt! ata eva mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika ityatra yasyetilope kṛte satyapi takāreṇa pratyayasyānantarthe kādeśo na bhavati| tasmāṭṭhagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| kiñca---yadā citrabhānuprabhṛtibhyaṣṭhajvidhīyate, tadekādeśābāvādajādilakṣaṇo lopo na syāditi tadarthamapi ṭhagrahaṇam|
caturthādacca iti| idaṃ saṃgrahaśloka nāsti, kvācitkaṃ caitat|
anajādau vibhāṣā lopo vaktavya iti| dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasyetyeva|
lopaḥ pūvapadasya ceti ślokavātikam, tasyopaskāraḥ--ṭhājādāvanajādau ca vaktavya iti| tatra ṭhājādau pūrvottarayoranyatarasya nityaṃ lopaḥ, anajādau vikalpaḥ|
uvarṇālla iti| lopasya `la' iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñā, tatra `ādeḥ parasya' itīkāralopaḥ|
tadāderiti| sandhyakṣarātparasya lope prāpte tata ārabhya lopārthaṃ vacanam
ekākṣarapūrvapadānāmiti| akṣaraśabdo'yamaci varttate, vyañjanasahite kevale vā| dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lope prāpte tena saha lopārthaṃ vacanam| vāgāśāriti| vāci āśīryasya sa vāgāśīḥ| vācika iti| atra yadi dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lopaḥ syāttadā `akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' iti paribhāṣayā kutvajaśtvayonivṛttau vāc-ā-ika iti sthite ākārasya yasyetilopena nivṛttāvapi tasya sthānivadbhāvādākārāntasya bhasaṃjñāyāṃ tvantarvattinīṃ vibhaktimākṣitya padasaṃjñā, sā cakārāntasyeti bhinnāvadhikatvādbhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñā na bādhyate, tataśca kutvajaśtvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ-vāgika iti syāt| uttarapadalope tu tasyānajādeśatvāt sthānivattvābhāvāttulyāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyāstaddhitāśrayāyāstāvadapavādatvādbādhaḥ| yā tvantarvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyāstaddhitāśrayāyā stāvadapavādatvādbādhaḥ| yā tvantarvattinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya subanthaṃ padamiti padasaṃjñā, tasyā api ekasaṃjñādhikārātparatvācca bādha iti siddhamiṣṭam |
kathamiti| acāpyuttarapadalope kṛte bhasaṃjñayā padasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvājjaśtvaṃ na syāditi praśnaḥ| ṣaṣa iti| sautra evātra lopa iṣyate, na tvaupasakhyānika ityarthaḥ |
saṃgrahaślokatṛtīyapāde tathāśabdānantaraṃ vāśabdaḥ pāṭhyaḥ, na tvevaśabdaḥ,| sa ca pūrvatrāpi yatheṣṭaṃ sambandhanīyaḥ, iṣṭaṃ ca pūrvameva darśitam| atra codayati---saṃjñāśabdasyaikadeśe lupte kathaṃ saṃjñino'vagamaḥ, na hi deva iti vā datta iti vā saṃjñā kṛtā, kiṃ tarhi, devadatta iti ? atrāhuḥ--ekadesena samudāye'numīyate, viṣāṇeneva gauḥ, so'numito'rthasya vācaka iti| nanu cocyāryamāṇā eva śabdo'rtha pratyāyayati, na pratīyamānaḥ? netyāha; smṛtyanumiti śrutiḥ ki nārtha pratyāyayati! pratyāhāreṣu vā madhyavarttino varṇāḥ kiṃ savarṇānna pratyāyanti! kiñca---
aśaktijairapabhraṃśaiḥ sādhavaḥ smāritā yathā|
śabdāḥ pratyāyayantyarthaṃ tathātrāpi bhaviṣyati ||
samudāye saṃjñātvena viniyujyamāne'vayavānāmapi saṃjñātvamamunippadyate| kimarthaṃ tarhi lopo vidhīyate? padānāmeva saṃjñaikadeśabhūtānāṃ sādhutvaṃ yathā syād, varṇānāṃ mā bhūditi| uktaṃ ca---
tulyāyāmanuniṣpattau de-ya-so ityasādhavaḥ|
na hyanvākhyāyake śāsre dattādivadanusmṛtiḥ ||

śevalasupariviśālavaruṇāryamādīnāṃ tṛtīyāt || 5.3.84 ||
śevalādīnāmityādi| yo'yaṃ śevalādīnāṃ tṛtīyādaca ūrdhvasya lopa ucyate, so'kṛtasandhīnāmeva vaktavyaḥ| sandhīyate'neneti saṃhitākāryamucyate ||

hrasve || 5.3.86 ||
yadyapi vaṃśādiṣvalpatvahrasvatvayoḥ samāveśo dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpi ghṛtādiṣu dravadravyeṣu na kaścidāha--hrasvaṃ ghṛtam, hrasvaṃ tailamiti; tathā vistīrṇeṣvāyāmahīneṣu hrasvaḥ paṭa hatyucyate, na kaścidāha--alpaḥ paṭa iti; tasmādubhayanirdeśaḥ--`alpe', `hrasve' iti ||

kutvā ḍupac || 5.3.87 ||
kutūrityāvapanasyākhyeti| yadyapyāvapanamātrasyākhyā, tathāpi ḍupacpratyayāntasvabhāvāduktam--carmamayaṃ snehabājanamucyata iti ||

vatsokṣāśvarṣabhebhyaśca tanutve || 5.3.91 ||
`tanutve' iti sāmānyābhidhānātkārśye'pi pratyayaprasaṅgaḥ, tatrāha--yasya hi guṇasyeti| etacca pratyāsatterlabhyate| pratyāsannaṃ hi śabdasya pravṛttinimittam| prathamavayā vatsa iti| prathamaṃ vayo vatsaśabdasya pravṛttinimittamityrathaḥ| tasyeti guṇabhūtamapi vayo'tra parāmṛśyate, tasya prathamasya vayasa ityarthaḥ| dvitīyavayaḥprāptiriti| dvitīyaṃ hi vayaḥ prāpnuṣato vatsasya prathamaṃ vayo'lpaśeṣaṃ bhavati| taruṇa iti| dvitīyavayā ityarthaḥ| tasya tanutvamityādi pūrvavat| anyapitṛkateti| gardabhapitṛkatetyarthaḥ| gardabena tvaśvāyāmutpādito'śvatara ucyate| anaḍvāniti| anaso voḍhetyarthaḥ, anasi vaheḥ kvip, ḍaścānasaḥ ||

kiyattadonirddhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac || 5.3.92 ||
dvayorekasya nirddhāraṇe kaḍatarajbhavatītyucyate, tatrehāpi prāpnoti--kayoranyataro devadattaḥ, yayoranyataraḥ, tayoranyatara iti; kimādīnāṃ samudāyavacitve'pi nirddhāraṇasya gamyamānatvāt? ata āhanirddhāryamāṇavācibhya iti| etaccābhidhānasvabhāvāllabhyete| kriyayā guṇena saṃjñayā veti| jātyā vetyāpi draṣṭavyam; kataro bhavatoḥ kaṭa ityāderapi sambhavāt|
samudāyānnirddhāraṇavibhaktiriti| sā punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī, na saptamī; vā bahūnāmiti darśanāt| ekasyetīti| nirddhāryamāṇanirdeśa iti| nanu ca dvayorekasyaiva nirddhāraṇaṃ sambhavati, nārtha etena? naitadasti; `ekasya' ityanucyamāne dvayoriti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyeta, tataścāsmin grāme kau devadattāvityatrāpi prāpnoti| tasmādekagrahaṇam ||

vā bāhūnā jātiparipraśne ḍatamac || 5.3.93 ||
jātiparipraśnaviṣayebhya iti| jātiparipraśnau yathāsambhavaṃ viṣayau yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| sūtre punaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ| sannidhānācca paripraśno'pi jātereva vijñāyate, yathā--`guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' ityatra yaṅ ca yaṅlukceti| evaṃ ca kṛtvā jātiparipraśnagrahaṇaṃ kima eva viśeṣaṇam| `jātigrahaṇaṃ tu sarvairapi sambadhyate' iti vakṣyamāṇamupapadyate| ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu guṇabhūtasya jātigrahaṇasya niṣkṛṣya sambandho'nupapannaḥ syāt|
paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ kṣepanivṛttyartham|
vāvacanamakajarthamiti| kathaṃ tarhi vākyasya siddhiḥ? tatrāha--mahāvibhāṣetyādi|
kimo'sminviṣaya iti| dvayorekasya nirddhāraṇa uktau bahūnāmekasya nirddhāraṇe na syāditi vacanam| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate? tatrā''ha--tatratyādi| nanu kataro bhavatoḥ kaṭha iti dvayorekasya nirddhāraṇe'pi jātiparipraśnasya sambhavānnānena vacanena bahūnāmekasya nirddhāraṇe ḍatarac śakyo jñāpayitum? evaṃ tarhi--`samāsavidhau katarakatamau jatiparipraśne sādhū bhavataḥ' ityapi vyākhyeyamiti manyate| ajātiparipraśne'pi kimo ḍatamaj bhavati--katamo bhavatordevadatta iti, katham ? katarakatamāvityatra jātiparipraśnagrahaṇāt| yadi hi katamaśabdo jātiparipraśnādanyatra na syāt, tatastatsāhacaryātkataraśabdo'pi tadarta eva grahīṣyata ityanarthakaṃ tatsyāt ||

ekācca prācām || 5.3.94 ||
ḍatarajḍatamajityetāviti| kathaṃ punarvyavahitasya ḍataraco'nuvṛttiḥ? ityāha--cakāra iti| ḍatamacastvanantaratvadevānuvṛttiriti bhāvaḥ| `svasminniṣaye' iti yaduktaṃ tadeva vivṛṇoti--dvayornirdhāraṇa iti| etacca dvayorekasya ḍataraja, bahūnāṃ ḍatamajityanuvṛttervākyabhedena ca sambandhāllabhyate ||

avakṣepaṇe kan || 5.3.95 ||
avakṣepaḥ-nindā| vyākaraṇakeneti| yadyapi vyākaraṇaṃ svato vakṣepaṇaṃ na bhavati, pratyayuta vedāhghatvātpraśaṃsanam; tathāpi yasya tadavalepamāvahati tasyāvakṣepaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| yājñīkyakena nāmeti| yājñikānāmāmnāyo yājñikyam-kalpasūtrādi| parasyetyādinā kutsita ityasyāsya ca kano viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati ||

ive pratikṛtau || 5.3.96 ||
ivārthaḥ sādṛśyamiti| kan pratyayastu svabhāvātsadṛśe bhavati, na sādṛśyamātre; yathā-prakāre'pi vihito jātīyar-pratyayastadvati bhavati | ???????? śeṣaṇaṃ pratikṛtigrahaṇamiti| pratikṛtiviṣayaṃ yatsādṛsyaṃ tatra pratyayo yathā syātī ko'rthaḥ? pratikṛtisvarūpaṃ yatsadṛśaṃ yatsadṛśaṃ tatretyarthaḥ| aśva ivāyamaśvapratikṛtiriti! aśvapratikṛtirūpo'svasadṛśo'yaṃ padārtha ityarthaḥ| aśvaka iti|
kecidāhuḥ--`aśvaśabdo'śva eva vartate, kanpratyayastu pratikṛtirūpe sadṛśa iti svārthiko'yaṃ na bhavati' iti| apara āha--`sādṛśyanibandhanādabhedopacārād gaurvāhīka itivad aśvaśabda eva pratikṛtau varttate, pratyayastu tasyaivopacārasya dyotakaḥ' iti|
gauriva gavaya iti| gavayo gona pratikṛtiḥ, tṛṇacarmakāṣṭhādinirmitaṃ hi praticchandakam-pratikṛtiḥ, na caivaṃ gavayaḥ ||

lummuṣye || 5.3.98 ||
cañcā-tṛṇapuruṣaḥ, tatsadṛśo manuṣyaścañcā| lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ| `manuṣyalupi pratiṣedhaḥ' ityetattu viśeṣaṇaviṣayam ||

jīvikārthe cāpaṇye || 5.3.99 ||
vāsudevaḥ, śiva ityādi| yāḥ pratimāḥ pratigṛhya gṛhād gṛhaṃ bhikṣamāṇā aṭanti tā evamucyante, tā hi jīvikārthā bhavanti|

devapathādibhyaśca || 5.3.100 ||
ādiśabdaḥ prakāre iti| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāhaākṛtigaṇo'yamiti|
arcāsu-pratimāsu, pūjanārthāsu gṛheṣvāyataneṣu vā yāḥ pūjyante tāsu, citrakarmadhvajābhyāṃ tadgatāḥ pratikṛtayo lakṣyante ||

samāsācca tadviṣayāt || 5.3.106 ||
tadityanena prakṛta ivārtho niddiśyate iti| chapratyayastu pradhānatayā prakṛto'pi na parāmṛśyate, anenaiva tasya vidhānāt, samāsasya tadviṣayatvānupapatteḥ| aparasminnivārtha eveti| evakāraḥ paunarvacanikaḥ| śasrīśyāmādau tveka ivārthaḥ samāse'ntarbhūta iti cho na bhavati| ajākṛpāṇīyamiti| ajāyā gacchantyāḥ kṛpaṇenādhaḥ patatā yathā vadhastatsadṛśamityarthaḥ| andhakavattikīyamiti| varttikā-śakuniviśeṣaḥ, tasyā andhahaste patanaṃ grahaṇaṃ ca yādṛcchikaṃ tādṛgityarthaḥ|
atakiṃtopapannamiti| acintitopapannam yādṛcchikamityarthaḥ| citrīkaraṇam-vismayakaraṇam| kathamiti| sāmānyenāyamarthaḥ kathamucyata ityarthaḥ|
samāsaścāyamityādi| ki punaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñāpakātsamāsasadbhāvaḥ pratipādyate ? ityata āha--na hyasteti| sa ca evaṃviṣaya eveti| chapratyaviṣaya evetyarthaḥ| ananyatra bhāvo viṣayārthaḥ; tena svātantryamupādhyantarayogoḥ, vigrahaśca na bhavati ||

ekaśālāyāṣṭhajanyatarasyām || 5.3.109 ||
anekārthatvannipātānāmanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha samuccayārtham, na vikalpārthamityāha--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenetyādi ||

karkalohitādikak || 5.3.110 ||
svayamalohita ityādi| upāśrayaḥ-upādānabhūto lākṣādiḥ ||

pratnapūrvaviśvemātthāl chandasi || 5.3.111 ||
ima śabda idamā samānārthaḥ prakṛtyantaram ||

pūgāñ ñyo'grāmaṇīpūrvalāt || 5.3.112 ||
pūgavācina iti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; `agrāmaṇīpūrvāt' iti vacanāt| pūrvaśabdo hyavavavacanaḥ, na ca pūgaśabdasya grāmaṇīvacano devadattādiśabdaḥ pūrvāvayava upapadyate| lohadhvajā iti| `ñyādayastadrājāḥ' iti tadrājasaṃjñā, `tadrājasya bahuṣu' iti luk|
devadattakā iti| `sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ' iti kan, atra devadattaśabdo grāmaṇīvacanaḥ pūrvo'vayavaḥ, samudāyaḥ pūgavacanaḥ ||

vrātacphañorastriyām || 5.3.113 ||
utsedhajīvitvaṃ vrātasya pūgādviśeṣaḥ| kauñjāyanīti| `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ', `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātitvānṅīṣ ||

āyudhajīvisaṅghāñ ñyaḍ vāhīkeṣvabrāhmaṇarājanyāt || 5.3.114 ||
yadā vāhīkaśabdaḥ puruṣepu varttate, tadā `vāhīkeṣu' iti nirddhāraṇe saptamī, yadā tu deśe tadā'dhikaraṇe|
brāhmaṇe tadviśeṣagrahamamiti| svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; brāhmaṇaśabdavācyasyāyudhajīvisaṅghasya vāhīkeṣvabhāvāt| rājanye tu svarūpagrahaṇamiti| tadvācyasyaiva bhāvāt| tenāstriyāmiti nānuvarttata iti| tena striyāmapi--kauṇḍībṛsī, kṣaudrakī, mālavīti bhavati| `halastaddhitasya' iti yalopaḥ ||

dāmanyāditrigartaṣaṣṭhācchaḥ || 5.3.114 ||
`dāmanyāditrigartaṣaṣṭhāt' iti samāhāradvandvaḥ, dāmanyāderāyudhajīvisaṅghāttrigartaṣaṣṭhāccāyudhajīvisaṅghādityanvayaḥ| trigartaṣaṣṭhādityasyārthamāha--yeṣāmiti| antavargāḥ-antragaṇaḥ| te punaḥ ke? ityāhateṣu ceṃ sbhṛtiriti| trigarttaṣaṣṭhāḥ smaryante-jñāpyante'nayeti smṛtiḥ|
sā punaḥ-āhustrigartaṣṣaṭhānityādiḥ ślokaḥ| atra jānakayastrigarttavargāḥ, teṣu ca trigarttaṣaṣṭhetaṣu, prathamapañcamau śivādyaṇantau, śeṣāstu iñantāḥ| kecittu-ataddhitāntameva pañcamaṃ brahmaguptaśabdaṃ paṭhanti ||

parśvādiyaudheyādibyo'ṇañau || 5.3.115 ||
pārśva ityādi| parśū, rakṣas, asura--ityete janapadaśabdāḥ, tatrākārāntādbahuṣvapatyeṣu `janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ' ityañ, itarābhyām `dvyañmagadha' ityādināṇ, tadrājatvālluk, punaḥ saṅghavivakṣāyāmanenāṇ| yaudheya iti| yudhete'sau, yudherigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ--yudhā, tasya apatyam `dvyacaḥ' iti ḍhak, tadantātsaṅgharūpavivakṣāyāmanenāñ--yaudheya ityādyudāttaṃ bhavati| tathā yaudheyasyāṅko lakṣaṇaṃ vā yaudheya iti--saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañlakṣaṇo'ṇ bhavati| etena yaudheyādiṣu ye ḍhagantāste sarve vyākhyātāḥ| yaudheyādīnāmasminpradeśe na pāṭhaḥ, paṭhitā hi te caturthe--`na prācyabhārgādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ' ityatra ||

abhijidvidabhṛcchālāvacchikhāvacchamīvadūrṇāvacchrumadaṇo yañ || 5.3.116 ||
abhijayatītyabhijit, vettīti vidaḥ, igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, tānbibharttīti vidabhṛt, anye manvantāḥ| abhijidādibhyo'ṇantebhya iti| sūtre'bhijidādaya evāṇiti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ| abhijidādiprakṛtayaścāṇantā abhijidādayaḥ ucyante| gotrapratyayasyeti| apatyapratyayasyetyarthaḥ| ābhijito muhūrtta iti| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ' ityaṇ, uttarasya--`sāsya devatā' iti| ihābhijityasyāyam ābhijitaka iti `gotracaraṇādvuñ' bhavati, `āpatyasya' iti yalopaḥ| gotrapratyayāntāddhyayamiṣyate| tena svārthikatvādayamapi yañ gotrapratyaya eva bhavati ||

iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ pañcamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ ||
<5.4>
oṃ namonārāyanāya namaḥ

kāśikāvṛtti
atha pañcamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ

pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vunlopaśca || 5.4.1 ||
ādiśabdo'yamavayavavācī, na tu vyavasthāvācī; `saṃkhyāyāḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśenaiva siddheḥ| na ca saṃkhyāvacanaḥ śabdaḥ pādaśataśabdayoravayava upapadyate; anārambhakatvāt| tasmātsaṃkhyāderiti vacanādiha grahamavatāpi prātipadikena tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--pādaśatāntasyeti| ānantaryalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī vunvidhau, lopavidhau tu sthānaṣaṣṭhī| tatsaṃniyogena ceti| cakārasya saṃniyogārthakatvāt|
anaimittikatvārthamiti| nimitte bhavo naimittikaḥ, adhyātmādiḥ| yasyotilopaḥ paranimittaka iti| īti taddhite ca parato lopavidhānāt| padbhāvo na syāditi| pacchabdo hi tatra sthānyupāttaḥ, sthānivattve ca sati pādaśabdāntamaṅgaṃ bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, na pācchabdāntamiti pādāyetyādivadatrāpi padbhāvo na syāt| asya tvanaimitikatvāditi| na hyatra vunnimittam; sahavidhānāt|
dvipadikāmiti| taddhitena dyotitatvādvīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| taddhitārtha iti samāsa iti| prakṛtyupādhirapi vīpsā vunā dyotyata iti taddhitārtho bhavati|
dvau pādau dadātīti| uttarasūtrevakṣyati--`dānaṃ vyavasargeḥ' iti, `avīpsārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti ca, tasmādbhavitavyamatra vunā| kriyāntaraṃ pratyudāharttavyam-dvau pādau labhata ityādi|
apara āha--daḍito vyavasṛjatīti prayoga evottaro'vidhiriti| yadvāparasvatvāpādanaṃ dānam-vyavasargaḥ, iha tu samarpaṇamātre dadātirvarttate; yatharajakasya vastraṃ dadātīti|
anyatrāpi darśanāditi| dvau dvau māṣau dadātītyādau tvanabhidhānādatiprasaṅgabhāvaḥ ||

daṇḍavyavasargayośca || 5.4.2 ||
daṇkaḍanaṃ daṇḍa iti| `damu upaśamane' ityasmādbhāve `ñamantāḍuḥ' daṇḍatervā curādiṇyantāderac| yadyapi daṇkaḍaśabdaḥ karaṇasādhano yaṣṭāvapi varttate, tathāpi tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dhātvarthena vyavasargeṇa sāhacaryāt| atrāpyudāharaṇe `taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ strīliṅgastaddhitārthaḥ| uktaṃ ca-`svabhāvācca vunpratyayaḥ striyāṃ varttate' iti| kathaṃ tarhi dāne vīpsāyāṃ vunpūrvasūtra udāhṛtaḥ, yāvatā nāprāpte vīpsāyā vunyārabhyamāṇo'vīpsāvunetayorarthayostasya bādhakaḥ prāpnoti, yathā `matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti `varttamāne ktaḥ'---bhūtaktasya, yathā ca `avṛddhādapi' ityapiśabdaḥ kriyate? ihāpi tarhi cakāraḥ kriyate, tenādhikavidhirayamabādhakaḥ| evamapi paratvādanenaiva dāne vīpsāyāṃ vunyuktaḥ? satyam; aviśeṣāttu pūrvatrodāhṛtaḥ| yadvā--dānasya padāntaravācyatvādeṣa vunbahiraṅgaḥ, vīpsāyāstu tadvitadyotyatvātpūrvo vunnantaraṅgaḥ ||

sthūlādibhyaḥ prakāravacane kan || 5.4.3 ||
prakāravacane dyotya iti| prakāravacane kan dyotya ityarthaḥ| yathaudanaṃ pacatītyatraivārthe odanapākaṃ pacatīti| yadvā-prakāraucyate sthūlādibhiriti dyotanāyetyarthaḥ| prakāravācibhyaḥ kan bhavati, tadeva prakāravacanatvaṃ dyotayitumiti yāvat| jātīyaro'pavāda iti| tenāyamapi tadvadeva prakāravati kabhavati, na prakāramātra ityuktaṃ bhavati| prakāraḥ-bhedaḥ, sādṛśyaṃ ca, ubhayatrāpi yathābhidhānaṃ kan bhavati| vṛttau tu prakāro bheda ityupalakṣaṇam|
cañcadbṛhatoriti| etāvapi sthūlādiṣu paṭhitavyāvityuktaṃ bhavati| cañcatka iti| cañcatiścalanakarmā cañcatprakāraścañcannevaṃ kaścidviśeṣa ucyate| tathā bṛhadviśeṣo bṛhatkaḥ| apara āha--sādṛśye'tra kan, acañcannapi yaścañcanniva lakṣyate sa bṛhatka iti| cañcā-bṛṇamayaḥ puruṣaḥ, tatsadṛśaścañcakaḥ| `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ|
sthūlāṇumāṣeṣviti| sthūla, aṇu, ṇāpa, ipu--iti catasraḥ prakṛtayaḥ kṛṣṇatileṣviti| kṛṣṇaprakārāstilāḥ kṛṣṇakāḥ| yavakāḥ yavasadṛśāḥ| pādyakālāvadātāḥ surāyāmiti| pādyikā, kālikā, avadātikā, surāviśeṣā ete| gomūtrakam-gomūtraprakāraṃ gomūtravarṇamācchādanam| yadvā--vinyāsaviśeṣo gomūtram, tatsadṛśaṃ tu gomūtrakam| yatra tu śuklakṛṣṇādivarṇavinyāsaḥ surāvarṇo'hiḥ surakaḥ, pūrvavad hrasvaḥ| jīrṇaprakārāḥ jīrṇakalpāḥ śālayo jīrṇakāḥ|
jātīyaro'nantaramevāyaṃ kan vidheyaḥ, evaṃ hi punaḥ `prakāravacane' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| iha tu karaṇe'jñātaḥ sthūlaprakāra iti prakārasyājñātādīnāṃ ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ paratvādanena kani kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādajñātādidyotanāya punaḥ ko bhavati| tatra tu karaṇe paratvātke kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādajñātādidyotanāya puna ko bhavati| tatra tu karaṇe paratvātke kṛte kanna syāt; śabdāntaratvāt| satyapi vā kani sthūlakaka ityādyudāttaṃ syāt ||

anatyantagatau ktāt || 5.4.4 ||
aśeṣasambandha iti| ktaprakṛtivācyayā kriyayā sādhanasya vyāptirityarthaḥ| bhinnakamiti| īṣadbhinnamityarthaḥ|
bhinnamiti| yadaśeṣaṃ bhidikriyāyā vyāptaṃ ghaṭādi tadabhidhīyate| ihānatyantagateḥ prakarṣasya ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhena pūrvamātiśāyika iṣyate, tadantātkanvaktavyaḥ, aktāntatvāddhi na prāpnoti--bhinnatarakaṃ chinnatarakamiti| āha ca--`anatyantagatau ktāntāttamabādayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddhaṃ tadantācca svārthe kanvacanam' iti| svārthaḥ punaranatyantagatiyukta eva, na śuddhaḥ| tathā hi sati anatyantagatirdyotitā na syāt ||

na sāmivacane || 5.4.5 ||
sāmyartha ucyate'nena tatsāmivacanam| sāmivacane upapade iti| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam, tacca samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ satkevalaṃ gṛhyate| sāmikṛtamiti| `sāmi' iti samāsaḥ| arddhakṛtaṃ nemakṛtamiti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā|
prakṛtyabhihitatvāditi| kā punaratra prakṛtirabhipretā ? na tāvatsamāsaḥ, aktāntatvāt, na hi sāmikṛtādayaḥ ktāntāḥ; pratyayagrahaṇe tadādiniyamāt| na ca kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā ktāntatvam; sāmyādīnāmagatitvād, akārakatvācca| atha yadatra ktāntaṃ sā prakṛtiḥ? tadapi na; hi samāse ekārthībhūtasya pṛthak prakṛtitvabhūpapadyate| atha vākyagataḥ kṛtādiśabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ? evamapi prakṛtyabhihitatvādityanupapannam| evaṃ tu vaktavyam--upapadenābhihitatvāditi? atrāhuḥ--vākyagatātkṛtādiśabdāt, samāsāvayavādvā prasaṅga śaṅkyate| yattūktam--prakṛtyabhihitatvādityanupannamupapadenābhihitatvāditi vaktavyamiti? satyam; śabdāntareṇābhihitatvād dyotyābhāvātkanaḥ prasaṅgo nāstītyarthaḥ| yadapyuktam--samāsa ekārthībūtasya pṛthakprakṛtitvāsambhava iti ? tadapi na; prakṛtyarthasya pratyayārthenaikārthībhāve sati prakṛtitvam| na cārthāntareṇaikārthībhūtasya pratyayārthenaikārthībhāvaḥ sambhavatīti kila prakṛtitvāsambhavaḥ syāt| na cātra pratyayasyā dyot vācyaṃ vā'rthāntaramasti, yena sahaikārthībhāvaḥ prārthyeta| tasmādupapannamekārthībhūtasyāpi prakṛtitvam| ata eva vṛttau samāsa udāhṛtaḥ|
kena punariti| svārthamātre kanvidheḥ pratyakṣeṇādarśanātpraśnaḥ| anumāsvata ityuttaram| yadetadutyata iti| bhāṣyakāraiḥ ucyata iti, prayujyata ityarthaḥ, bhāṣyakāraprayoga upapanno bhavatīti yāvat| sākṣisthānīyasya bhāṣyakāraprayogaḥ, na punaranyatra svārthe kan na bhavatīti ||

bṛhatyā āccādane || 5.4.6 ||
bṛhatikā-prāvāraḥ ||

aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṅkarmālampuruṣādhyuttarapadātkhaḥ || 5.4.7 ||
avidyamānāni ṣaḍakṣīṇi yasminniti bahuvrīhiriti| akṣiśabdo'tra śrotrendriye varttate `bahuvrīhau sakathyakṣaṇoḥ' iti ṣac| mantraḥ-mantraṇam, yad dvābyāmeva kriyata iti, tribhistu kriyamāṇaḥ ṣaḍakṣo bhavati, catuḥprabhṛtibhistu kriyamāṇasya yadyapyaṣṭākṣatvādi sambhavati, tathāpyavarjanīyarūpeṇa ṣaḍakṣatvamapi bhavati| tasmād dvābhyāmeva kriyamāṇo'ṣaḍakṣīṇo bhavati| āśitā iti| aśnoterāṅpūrvādāśitaḥ karteti jñāpakātkarttari ktaḥ| yadvā--ṇyantātkarmaṇi| āśitaṅgavīnamaraṇyamiti| prabhūtayavasamityarthaḥ|
adhiśabdaḥ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭhyata iti| yatra `adhirīśvare' ityadheḥ karmapravacanīyatvād `yasya ceśvaravacanam' iti saptamyantā rājādayo'dhinā samasyante| vākyamapi bhavati| rājanyadhi, rājādhīnamiti| yathā--adhi brahmadatte pañcālā iti, adhiśabdaśca vṛttiviṣaye īśitavye varttate| apara āha--adhikaraṇe eṣā saptamī, vṛttiviṣaye ca sasādhanakriyāvacano'dhiḥ, na tu vākya ityasvapadena vigrahaḥ, vṛttiviṣaye ca sasādhanakriyāvacano'dhiḥ, na tu vākya ityasvapadena vigrahaḥ, rājanyadhikṛtaṃ rājādhīnam, rājāyattamityartha iti| uttarasūtre vibhāṣāgrahaṇāditi| dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityā vidhaya iti nyāyāt |
tamabādaya iti| `atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' ityādayaḥ| prākkana iti| `avakṣepaṇe kan' ityasmāt śukla ityukte sāmānyaśabdatvātprakarṣasyānavagamāttattadupādhidyotanāyāvaśyaṃ prayojyāstamabādaya iti nityāḥ| atiśayena śukla ityādikaṃ tu vākyaṃ bhavatyeva; padāntaradyotyatvādatiśayasya| ñjādaya iti| `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt' ityādayaḥ| prāgvuna iti| pādaśatādiśūtravihitāt, tasya tu purā vigraho darśita eva| āmādaya iti| `kimettiṅavyayaghādāmu' ityādayaḥ, `tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭ' ityataḥ prāgityarthaḥ| bṛhatījātyantā iti| bṛhatīśabdena `bṛhatyā ācchādane' iti vihitaḥ kanupalakṣyate| jātyantaśabdenāpi`jātyantāccha badhuni' iti vihitaśchaḥ| bahuvacananirddeśādetatsūtravihitasya khasyapāśabādīnāṃ ca grahaṇam| yo hi vaiyākaraṇapāśāditatsūtravihitasya khasya pāśabādīnāṃ ca grahaṇam| yo hi vaiyākaraṇapāśādiśabdebhyo'rthaḥ pratīyate, nāsau jātucit vaiyākaraṇādisāmānyaśabdebhyaḥ pratīyata iti te'pi tamabādivannityā eva| samāsānta śceti| `samāsāntāḥ' ityadhikṛtya vihitāḥ ||

vibhāṣāñceradikstriyām || 5.4.8 ||
dik cāsau strī ceti dikstrī, tatra pratiṣedhaḥ na tu diśi striyāṃ ca; strīliṅgaikavacananirdesāt| udāharaṇeṣu `acaḥ' ityakāralope kṛte `cau' iti dīrghaḥ| udīcīnamityatra tūda `uda īt' itītvam|
