diggrahaṇaṃ kimiti| añjatyantaḥ striyāṃ vatamāno diśyeva vartata iti praśnaḥ| prācīnā brāhāmaṇīti| kriyānimittako deśakālanimittako vā brāhmaṇyāṃ striyāṃ varttate, na diśīti pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ| strīgrahaṇaṃ kimiti| digvṛttirañcatyantaḥ strīliṅga eveti manyate| prācīnaṃ digraṇaṇīyamiti| prācīnaśabdāddigvācinaḥ prathamāsamarthād dikśabdebhya ityutpannasyāstāteḥ `añcerluk' iti luk, ṅīpo'pi `luk taddhitaluki' iti luk, tataḥ `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' ityavyayatvātstrīliṅgābhāvaḥ| khe tu kṛte svabhāvādeva napuṃsakatvam ||

jātyantāccha bandhuni || 5.4.9 ||
jātyantātprātipadikād bandhuni varttamānātsvārthe chaḥ pratyayo yasya bandhuśabdasyeti darśayati| etacca napuṃsakanirddeśādavasīyate, āptaparyāyastu puṃlliṅgaḥ| yena brāhmaṇatvādijātirvyajyata iti| vyaktyadhīnā hi jātarabhivyaktiḥ, na hi svātantryeṇa jātucijjātirupalabhyate| etadevābhipretya--badhyate'sminniti bandhivatyuktam| brāhmaṇajātīya iti| bhāvapradhāno'tra brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, `dvyokayoḥ' itivat, tena bahuvrīhiḥ| brāhmaṇādirevocyate iti| brāhmaṇatvajātyādhāro dravyātmakaḥ piṇḍa ucyaya ityarthaḥ|
brāhmaṇajātiriti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, karmadhārayo vā ||

sthānāntādvibhāṣā sasthāneneti cet || 5.4.10 ||
sasthānena cediti| karaṇe eṣā tṛtīyā, sasthānena sasthānaśabdavācyenārthena tulyaparyāyeṇa sthānāntaṃ yadyarthavadbhavati, evaṃ pratyayo bhati, nānyatetyartha| sasthāna iti tulya ucyata iti| stānata iti śeṣaḥ| sthānam-prāptiḥ, sambandhaviśeṣaḥ, padamiti yasya prasiddhaiḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sasthānaśabdena tulya ucyate? ityāha--sāmānaṃ sthānamasyeti| yasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa sasthāna ityucyate yaścaivaṃvidhaḥ sa yadapakṣayā tasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ tena tulyo bhavati, tatra śabdabhede'pi ????tuvṛttena sasthānaśabdasya tulyo vācyo bhavati| sabhāvaḥ punaratra `jyotirjanapada' ityādi sūtreṇa| pitṛstānīya iti| pituriva sthānamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ|
gosthānamiti| tiṣṭhatyasminnati sthānaṃ deśaḥ na tu tatpuruṣa iti| samānaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ cetyevaṃrūpastatpuruṣaḥ| sthānaśabdo nārthamupasthāpayati| yadyupasthāpayet, tulyaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ ca tulyasthānamityādeḥ karmadhārayādapi pratyayaḥ syāt| atha bahuvrīhestulyasthānaśabdātsasthānaśabdādvā'yaṃ pratyayaḥ karamānna bhavati? kaḥ punarāhaḥ-na bhavatīti! neṣyate iti karaṇādeva tu na bhaviṣyati| cecchabdaḥ sambandhārtha iti| cecchabde sati vibhaktivipariṇānenaidhyāhareṇa vā vākyaparyasānena ca sambandho bhavati| asati tu tasminpañcamyantena tṛtīyāntasya sambandho'nupapannaḥ syāt ||

kimettiṅavyaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe || 5.4.11 ||
kima ekārāntādityādi| arthapradarśanaparametat, sūtre tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yogavibhāgādvā pañcamīsamāsaḥ| yadyapīti| dravyaṃ viśeṣyaṃ paryavasānabhūtam, tasya svarūpeṇa prakarṣo nāsti, pravṛttimittadvāraka eva tu tasya prakarṣaḥ, yathoktaṃ bhāṣye--guṇasyaiva prakarṣo na dravyasyeti| guṇaḥ pravṛttinimittam| harirapyāha---
dravyasyāvyapadeśyasya na vinā bhedahetunā|
prakarṣo vidyate nāpi śabdasyopaiti vācyatām ||
kriyāguṇasya iti| pravṛttinimittabhūtasya sahacaritasya dharmamātrasyopalakṣaṇaṃ kriyāguṇagrahaṇam| dravya ucyata iti| dravyaniṣṭho'bhidhīyata ityarthaḥ| kriyāguṇayoreveti| yo dravyaniṣṭhayoranuvidhīyate sa tayoreva prakarṣaḥ| kiṃtarāmiti| idaṃ ca kimidaṃ ca kim, idamanayoratiśayena kim iti tarap pratyayaḥ| yatra svarūpeṇa jñātasya vastuno viśeṣākārā bahavo jijñāsitāstatra kiṃśabdārthaḥ praśnaprakṛṣṭa iva bhavati, tadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ| pūrvāhṇetarāmiti| `ghakālataneṣu' iti saptamyā aluk| tatrāsattvabhūtasya vibhaktyarthasya prakarṣaḥ, na kālasyeti nāyaṃ dravyaprakarṣaḥ |
uccaistarāmiti| ātrāpyucacaiḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvānnāyaṃ dravyaprakarṣaḥ| utcaistaraḥ parvata iti| nātrādhikaraṇapradhāna uccaiḥśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? uccaistvaṃ nāma guṇastadgataḥ prakarṣaḥ parvataniṣṭho'bhidhīyate, svabhāvācca tarabantasyātra sattvabhūtārthābhidāyitvam, liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaśca|
uditkaraṇaṃ kim? `āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' ityatrāsya sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ mā bhūt| yadi syāt? kintarāmityatra paratvādyasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā `hrasvanadyāpaḥ' iti nuṭ prasajyeta, makārasya tvitsaṃjñā prayojanābhāvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti ||

amu cacchandasi || 5.4.12 ||
pratarāmiti| praśabdārthasya prakarṣasya prakarṣe tarap prakṛṣṭatara itivat| atraāpyuditkaraṇam `ica ekāco'mpratyayavacca' ityatrāsyāpi grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| yadi syādatrāpi yad dṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ tadapyatidiśyeta, tatra ko doṣaḥ? iha--striyammanyaḥ, yasyetilopaḥ prāpnoti ||

anugādinaṣṭhak || 5.4.13 ||
anugadatītyanugādī, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇiniḥ, prakṛtisvarūpapradarśanaparaṃ caitat| na tvayaṃ kevalaḥ prayogārhaḥ; ṭhako nityatvāt |

ṇacaḥ striyāmañ || 5.4.14 ||
vyāvakrośīti| vyavapūrvātkruśerṇac, `kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' ṇajante'nupraveśātsamudāyādañ, tasyāṅgatvādādivṛddhiḥ| `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām' ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati; `na karmavyati hāre' iti niṣedhāt|
tata iti| ṇacaḥ, ṇajantādityarthaḥ| svārtikastatraiva bhaviṣyatīti| `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvartante' iti kṛtvā| ativarttante'pīti| vyabhicarantyapītyarthaḥ| apiśabdādanuvarttante'pi, anuvṛttistu `kāsūgoṇībhyāṃ ṣṭharac' iti ṣitkaraṇānṅīṣarthādavasīyate| ekāntato nivṛtte hi ṣakāro'rthako bhavet, tenetyādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| prasannā-surāviśeṣaḥ| devateti| devaśabdātpuṃlliṅgādeva tal ||

aṇinuṇaḥ || 5.4.15 ||
saṃrāviṇamiti| `ru śabde,' `kūṭa dāhe' dīrdhopadhaḥ, `mṛjūṣ śuddhau'--etebyaḥ saṃpūrvebya inuṇ, pūrvavatsagateraṇ, `inaṇyanapatye' iti prakṛti bhāvaḥ, ekānubandhakaparibhāṣayā ghinuṇo'tra grahaṇābhāvaḥ ||

visāriṇo matsye || 5.4.16 ||
visārīti| pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ| vaisāriṇa iti| pūrvavatprakṛtibhāvaḥ ||

saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc || 5.4.17 ||
atra `upāya evābhyupāyaḥ' itivad āvṛttirevābhyāvṛttirityāśrīyamāṇe ādyā''vṛttirna bhavatīti ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pravṛttau pañcakṛtva iti syāt, abhigrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam, kriyāvṛttigaṇana ityeva vācyaṃ syāt, ato'tra vivakṣitaṃ vaktavyam? tadāha--paunaḥ punyamabhyāvṛttiriti| punaḥ punarbhavitari varttamānāt punaḥpunaḥśabdātpravṛttinimittasya bhavanasya niṣkṛṣyābhidhānāya bāvapratyaya| paunaḥpunyam-punaḥ purbhavanamityarthaḥ, asakṛtpravṛttiriti yāvat| tatra cādyā pravṛttirantarbhavati, tadyathā--paunaḥpunyaṃ bhṛsārtho vā kriyāsamabhihāra ityatra yo'pi dviḥ pacati tatrāpi pāpacyate iti bhavati| uktamevārthaṃ spaṣṭayatiekakartṛkāṇāmiti| bahuvacanamatantram| dvayorapi jananasaṃkhyānamāvṛttirbhavatyeva jananasaṃkhyānam-utpattigaṇanam| bhinnakartṛkāsu bhinnajātīyāsu ca kriyāsu nirantaramanuṣṭhīyamānāsvapi kriyābyāvṛttipratyayābhāvādubhayamupāttam| evambhūtānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ janmana utpatteryatsaṃkhyānaṃ gaṇanaṃ tatkriyābhyāvṛttigaṇanam| etaccābhyāvṛttiśabdasya tatraiva prasiddherlabhyate, ata eva abhigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte iti| ekaivātra bhujikriyā nivṛttabhedākhyātenābhidhīyate, āvṛttyājaniyena phalenaikīkṛtatvāt tasyā utpattayaḥ pañcasaṃkhyānena gaṇayante| āvṛttikṛtaṃ phalamicchanbhujikriyāyāḥ pañcotpattyāvṛttīḥ karotītyarthaḥ| avāntaraphalāpekṣaṃ pañcatvam, utpattibhedaśca|
bhūrivārāniti| vāraśabdasya kriyotpattyādhārajālavācitvāt `kālādhvanoḥ' iti dvitīyā. tathā ca punaḥpunaḥśabdādutpattyādhārakālābhidhāyitvāt `kālāṭṭhañ' bhavati--paunaḥpunika iti| yadi kālaśabdaḥ, vāraśabdaḥ, bhūriśabdo'pi tatsamānādhikaraṇaḥ kāla eva varttate, na kriyābhyāvṛttāviti kathamatra prasaṅgaḥ? atrāhuḥ--kālṛvācitve'pi kriyāvṛtterapi gamyamānatvātprasaṅga iti| apara āha---vāraśabdaḥ kriyāgatāmāvṛtti dyotayan kriyāviseṣaṇatvātkarma| napuṃsakatvaṃ tu na bhavati, lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya; vāraśabdasya nityapuṃlliṅgatvāt--bhūrivārān bhuṅkte| ko'rthaḥ? āvṛttāni bahūnibhojanāni karotītyarthaḥ| atra `bahugaṇavatuḍatisaṃkhyā' ityatra bahugaṇagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham--aniyatapracayavācināṃ madhye etayoreveti, tena bhūriśabdasya laukikasaṃkyāvācitve'pyatra grahaṇābhāvaḥ|
ambhāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavatītī| sādhyārthaviṣayatvāttasyāḥ| na dravyaguṇayoriti| tayoḥ siddhasvabhāvatayā śabdenābhidhānāt| punaḥ punardaṇḍī, punaḥ punaḥ sthūla ityatrāpi gamyamānāyā bhavatikriyāyā evābhyāvṛttiḥ, na tu dravyaguṇayoḥ| ekasya sakṛccetyatrāpītyādi| ekaśabdena hyekaiva kriyāvyaktirākhyāyate| na ca tasyāmāvṛtteḥ sambhavaḥ; tatrāsati kriyāgrahaṇe `eko bhuṅkte' ityatrāpi syāt| tasmāduttarārthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| evaṃ ca--kriyā cābhyāvṛttiśca kriyābhyāvṛttī, tayogarṇanaṃ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇanamiti dvandvagarbhaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iti kecita| anye tu--ihārthamapi sukhapratipattaye kriyāgrahaṇaṃ manyamānāḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣagarbha tatpuruṣaṃ varṇayanti| tatra guṇabhūtasyāpi kriyāgrahaṇasya niṣkṛṣya sambandhaḥ tadgrahaṇasāmarthyādveditavyaḥ|
pañcapākā iti| atra kartṛbhedena vā bhinnakālāḥ kriyā eva gaṇayante, nābhyā vṛttiḥ| sā hi bhinnakālānāmekakartṛkāṇāmekakarmakāṇāṃ ca nairantarthe sati bhavati| yadyapyatra dhātvarthasya siddhatākhye dharme ghaño vidhānam, tathāpi dhātunā'trāpi sādhyasvabhāvā kriyaivābhidhīyata iti tadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ syādeva| tatā ca---kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya vrajyetyatra `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' iti ṇvul bhavati|
akriyamāṇa ityādi| ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeya eva varttante, ataḥ paraṃ saṃkhyāne saṃkhyeye ca | tatrāsati gaṇanagrahaṇe kriyābhyāvṛttau saṃkhyeyāyāṃ varttamānebhyaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanebhya eva pratyayaḥ syāt, saṃkhyāne tu varttamānebhyo na syāt, tadāha--iha na syāditi| śataṃ vārāṇāmiti| iyamapyatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na syāt? ityata āha--na hyatreti| kāraṇamāha--saṃkhyānamātravṛttitvāditi| gaṇanagrahaṇāttviti| `kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane' iti viṣayanirdeśaḥ, tatra ye saṃkhyeyavacanāḥ, ye ca saṃkhyānamātravacanāḥ---dvaye'pi te gaṇanāviṣayā bhavantīti sarvatra siddhiḥ| nanu śataṃ vārāṇāmityatra yadā vārāṇāmiti prayujyate, tadā sāpekṣatvāt pratyayena na bhāvyam? yadā tarhyarthāt, prakaraṇādvā'pekṣayaṃ nirjñātaṃ bhavati tadā bhaviṣyati yadyevam, saṃkhyeyavacanādeva śatakṛtva iti bhaviṣyati, na hi `śatakṛtvo bhuṅkte' ityatra vārāṇāmiti vārāniti vā prayogārham, tasmātprayojanadigiyaṃ darśitā| idaṃ tu prayojanam--yatra sākṣādabhyāvṛttigaṇanaṃ tatra yathā syād, abhyāvṛttigaṇanasambhavamātre mā bhūt--saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūnālabhata iti| asti hyatrālabhatikriyāyāḥ pratipaśu vastuto'bhyāvṛttiḥ, tasyā viṣayabhūtāyāḥ sādhanagaṇanavṛtterapi saptadaśaśabdāt pratyayaḥ syāt ||

dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc || 5.4.18 ||
sakṛditi| `rātsasya' iti suco lopaḥ| sucaścakāraḥ svarārta iti| `citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham' iti vacanāccaturityasyāntodātto bhavati; anyathā`cateruran' ityuranpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ syāt ||

ekasya sakṛcca || 5.4.19 ||
sakṛditi | `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' iti suco lopaḥ| sucaścakāro'trāpyantodāttārthaḥ, anyathā `iṇbīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan' iti kanpratyayānta ekaśabda ādyudātta iti tasya sthāne bhavansakṛcchabda āntaryata ādyudāttaḥ syāt| ekaḥ pāka ityatretyādi| apara āha--`abhyāvṛttigrahaṇādeva siddhe pūrvasūtre kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyāviśeṣapratipattyartham, tena sādhyasvabhāvaiva kriyā gṛhyate| pākādibhistu śabdaiḥ siddhasvabhāvā'bhidhīyate, yādṛśī ca pūrvasūtre kriyā gṛhītā tādṛśyevātrāpyanuvarttate' iti| tatra ca pākādiśabdaprayoge pratyayābhāva iti ghañantādyantaprayoge'pi kṛtvo'rthapratyayaḥ kvacit liṅgād `dvirvacane'ci' iti sādhanīyo manīṣibhiḥ ||

vibhāṣā bahorddhā'viprakṛṣṭakāle || 5.4.20 ||
aviprakṛṣṭakālagrahaṇaṃ kriyābhyāvṛttiviśeṣaṇamiti| yadyapyevam, tathāpi gaṇanagrahaṇenaivāsya śābdo'nvaya iti napuṃsakaliṅgameva bhavati, na strīliṅgam| gaṇanasyāviprakṛṣṭakālatvaṃ gaṇyamānānāmabhyāvṛttināmaviprakṛṣṭakālatve satītyarthaprāptaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitam| bahudhā divasasya bhuṅkte iti| `kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe' iti ṣaṣṭhī, aviprakṛṣṭakālatvaṃ cābhyāvṛttīnāṃ tattatkriyāvaśena vyavatiṣṭhate| bahukṛtvo māsasya bhuṅkte iti| atrābhyāvṛtterviprakṛṣṭakālatā'śaktidāridryādyapekṣayā draṣṭavyā ||

tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭ || 5.4.21 ||
prācuryeṇa prastutaṃ prakṛtamiti| yadyapi prastutamātravacanaḥ prakṛtaśabdaḥ, tathāpīha vacanagrahaṇādayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate| vacanagsarahaṇaṃ hi yādṛśasya prakṛtasya loke mayaṭā vacanaṃ pratyāyanaṃ tatra yathā syādityevartham| prathamāsamarthāditi| kena punaḥ prathamāntasya sāmarthya pratyayastāvatsvārthikaḥ? yadyapi svārthikaḥ, prācuryaṃ tu tasya dyotyam| tacca prakṛtyarthagatamityetāvadatra sāmarthyam|
apare punarityādi| atra prakṛtyārthādarthāntara eva pratyayaḥ, tatpunararthāntaraṃ lyuṭā pratipāditam| saptamyartha ucyamānatā prakṛtatā ca prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam, taddarśayati--annaṃ prakṛtamasminnati|
ubhayathā sūtrapraṇayanāditi| prakāradvayasādhāraṇyena sūtrasya praṇayanādityarthaḥ| atra prathame vyākhyāne taditi vispaṣṭārtham; `devāttal' ityevamādivatsamarthavibhakteḥ siddhatvāt ||

samūhavacca bahuṣu || 5.4.22 ||
āpūpikam, maudakikamiti| `acittahastidhenoṣṭhak' ||

anantāvasathetihabheṣajāññyaḥ || 5.4.23 ||
āvasantyetamityāvasathaḥ, `upasarge vaseḥ' ityathapratyayaḥ| nipātasamudāyo'yamiti| vacanāccāprātipadikādapi pratyayaḥ| upadeśapāramparye varttate iti| tadyathā--iti ha smopādhyāḥ kathayantīti| bhiṣajyateḥ kaṇḍvādiyagantātkivapi bhiṣaka, bhiṣaja idamityaṇ--bheṣajam, asmādeva nipātanādekāraḥ ||

devatāntāttādarthye yat || 5.4.24 ||
caturthīsamarthāditi| tādarthye caturthyā upasaṃkhyānādetallabhyate| pitṛdevatyamiti| parmadhārayātpratyayaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra sāmānādhikaraṇyam? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? jātibhedāt, anyā hi pitṛjātiranyā ca devatājātiḥ, darśayati ca--devā manuṣyāḥ pitaraste'nyata āsanniti, deva eva devatā--svārthikastal ? evaṃ tarhi talpratyayasya prakṛtirdevaśabdaḥ pacādyaci aiśvaryārthāddiveḥ sādhyaḥ; na jātivacanaḥ; tataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāddevatāpitṛśabdayoḥ| evaṃ ca devadevatyamityetadapi siddhayati| yāgasampradānamantrastutyaṃ vā devatā, na jītiviśeṣa ityarthaḥ ||

pādārghābhyāṃ ca || 5.4.25 ||
gandhodakādisamudāyo'rghaḥ, tadarthabhudakādi-arghyam| chandasya iti| yathā gāyatryādivṛttaṃ chandaḥśabdo'bhidhatte, tathā''śrāvayetyādikamapi saptadaśākṣarasamāhāram, tatra varttamānācchandaḥśabdātsvārthe pratyayaḥ, vyatyayena puṃlliṅgatā|
dvitīyābahuvacanasya lugiti| chāndasatvāt| ata eva yadantātprathamaikavacanaṃ puṃlliṅgaṃ ca bhavati|
amuṣyaśabdo naḍādiḥ, amuṣyaputraśabdo manojñādiḥ; ubhayatra ṣaṣṭhyā alugupasaṃkhyāyate| pratyayaprakaraṇe prāsaṅgikametat, sa cāluk tayoreva gaṇayostathaiva pāṭhātsiddhaḥ|
samaśabdādāvatupratyaya iti| ukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ--samāvatī yajñasyāśīriti ṅīb bhavati|
`agnīdhaḥ śaraṇe raṇ bhatvaṃ ca'--āgnīdhram, tato'ñ-āgnīdhrī| samānaṃ dhāraṇamasya sādhāraṇam, anekaṃ pratyaviśiṣṭasambandham| pṛṣodarāditvātsamānasya sabhāvaḥ, tato'ñ sādhāraṇi| ṅībarthaṃ vacanam| kṣemaśabdādyo vaktavyaḥ, yati hi sati `yato'nāvaḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ syād, antodāttatvaṃ ceṣyate ||

yāvādibhyaḥ kan || 5.4.29 ||
ṛtāvuṣṇaśīte iti| upṇaka ṛtuḥ, śītaka ṛtuḥ| ṛtoranyatra tu---uṣṇo'gniḥ, śītamudakam| paśāviti| lūnakaḥ paśuḥ, viyātakaḥ paśuḥ| anyatra--lūnā darbhāḥ, viyāto nīcaḥ| aṇu nipuṇa iti| aṇukaḥ-sūkṣmadṛka, nipuṇaḥ, anyatrāṇureva| putra kṛtrime| putrako lohādinirmitaḥ, anyatra putra eva| snāta vedasamāptau| yasyādhyetavyo vedaḥ samāptaḥ-pāraṃ prāptaḥ, sa vedamadhītya snāsyannityādisvagṛhyoktaprakrāreṇa snānāya coditaḥka snātakaḥ-samāvṛtta ucyate| anyatra--nadyāṃ snātaḥ| śūnya rikta iti| udakādinā rikto ghaṭaḥ śūnyakaḥ| anyatra--śūnyaḥ pratyayaḥ, bāhyārtharahita ityarthaḥ| tathā śūne hitaḥ śūnyaḥ, gavādiṣu `śunaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ vā ca dīrghatvaṃ ca' iti paṭhyate| dāna kutsite| kutsitaṃ dānaṃ dānakam| tanu sūtre| tanukaṃ sūtram-sūkṣmatantuḥ, anyatra tanuḥ-śarīram| īyasaśca|īyasunnantācca svārthe kan bhavati-śreyaskam| kumārīkrīḍanakāni ca| kumārīṇāṃ yāni krīḍanakāni-krīḍāsādhanāni tāni kanamutpādayanti---kaṇḍu(du)kam ||

varṇe cānitye || 5.4.31 ||
satyevāśraye yallauhityamapagacchati tadanityam| lohitakaḥ kopeneti| kope sati bhavati kopāgagame ca satyevāśraye nivarttata ityanityametat lauhityam|
lohito gauriti| yāvadāśrayabhāvitvādayaṃ nityo varṇaḥ|
lohitai rudhiramiti| viṣādidūṣitaṃ rudhiraṃ kadācitkṛṣṇamapi bhavatīti viseṣaṇam| varṇagrahaṇaṃ kim ? anityatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā vijñāyet, anyathā lohitaśabdo varṇapravṛttinimittamupādāya yatra dravye paryavasyati, tatrāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| tatra ko doṣaḥ? iha ca syāt--lohito gauriti| iha ca na syāt--lohitakāḥ pārthivāḥ paramāṇavo'gnisaṃyogeneti| tathā varṇanirapekṣo rudhirākhye dravye lohitaśabdasyasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt, anityagrahaṇamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ syāt! nanu sarvameva rudhiramanityaṃ yatsatyevāśraye kādācitkam, yathā--strīṇāmārttavam, tasya grahaṇārthaṃ syāt, tasmādvarṇagrahaṇam|
lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ vā iti| ṅyāpsūtra etadvyākhyātam ||

rakte || 5.4.32 ||
yatra dravyāntarasamparkeṇa lauhityaṃ tathādhīyate tathā yāvadāśrayamavatiṣṭhate, tatrānityatvābhāvātpūrveṇa na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ| nanvevamapi rañjanāt prāk satyeva padādāvāśraye lauhityasyāvasthānābhāvādastyevānityatā, na kāraṇāvasthāyāmeva rañjanāt? tadetadeva vacanaṃ jñāpakam--pūrvatrāyāvaddravyabhāvitvamanityatvam, na punarādyantabhāva iti| tādṛśasya tvanityatvasya grahaṇo taijasānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ yallauhityaṃ tadvyatiriktasya sarvasyaiva lohityasya nityatvādidaṃ vacanamanarthalaṃ syāt ||

kālācca || 5.4.33 ||
dvayamapyanuvarttata iti| dvayasyāpi svaritatvāt, na tvanantaraṃ `rakte' ityetadevetyapiśabdārthaḥ| vailakṣyeṇeti| vilakṣasya bhāvo vailakṣyam-lajjā| kālakaḥ paṭa iti| nīlyādinā kālatāmāpādita ityarthaḥ ||

vinayādibyaṣṭhak || 5.4.34 ||
upāyād hrasvatvaṃ ceti| upāyaśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati, hrasvatvaṃ cāpadyate| sa ca hrasva ākārasyaiva bhavati; anyasyācaḥ svata eva hrasvatvāt| akasmādityatra paṭhyate, taddakārāntam, tena `hasusuktāntātkaḥ' iti kādeśo na bhavati--ākasmikaḥ, avyayatvāṭṭilopaḥ ||

vāco vyāhṛtārthāyām || 5.4.35 ||
vyāhṛta iti| ukta ityarthaḥ| anyeneti| saṃdeṣṭrā| tena hi pūrvamuktastasyārthaḥ saṃdeśaharaṃ prati| sandeśavāgiti| sandeśarūpā vāk sandeśavāk, sandiśyate iti sandeśaḥ, tasya vāk saṃdeśavāk yayā saṃdiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate|
apara āha--lekhyādināvadhārite'rthe pravarttamānā vāk vyāhṛtārtheti| `ativarttante ca svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanāni' iti napuṃsakatvam ||

tadyuktātkarmaṇo'ṇ || 5.4.36 ||
karmaśabdāditi| etena `karmaṇaḥ' iti svarūpagrahaṇam, nepsitatamāderiti darśayati| etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate| kārmaṇamiti| `an' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| tathaiveti| yathaiva vyāhṛtārthayā vācā pratipāditam-evametattvayā karttavyamiti, tathaivetyarthaḥ|
aṇprakaraṇa iti| prajñādiṣvapāṭhaḥ---eteṣāṃ bhāṣāyāmaṇmā bhūditi| sānnāyyetyādi| sānnāyyādayaḥ śabdāḥ prajñādiṣu draṣṭavyā ityarthaḥ| antodāttārthaṃ ceha sānnāpyaśabdasya grahaṇam, rūpaṃ tu `pāyyasānnāyya' iti nipātanādeva siddham| ānujāvara iti| anujādavara ityasmādeva nipātanātpañjamīsamāsaḥ, tato'ṇ| ānuṣūka iti| sūtiḥ sūḥ, sampadāditvāt kvip, anugatā sūretamiti bahuvrīhiḥ, kap, `pūrvapadāt' iti ṣatvam| cātuṣprāśyamiti| caturbhiḥ prāśyamiti `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, tato'ṇ| ādhāne vrīhyedanasyedamabhidhānam| `idudupadhasya' iti ṣatvam| rākṣoghnamiti| rakṣāṃsi hanyante'neneti dhañarthe kaḥ| viyātavikṛtaśabdābhyāmaṇ-vaiyātaḥ, vaikṛtaḥ| varivaḥ-paricaryā, tatkaroti varivaskṛt, kvip, `ataḥ kṛkami' iti satvam, variskṛdeva vārivaskṛtaḥ-paricārakaḥ| agramayanamasya, agre hāyanamasyetika bahuvrīhibhyāmaṇ---āgrāyaṇaṃ karma| nāniṣṭvāgrāyaṇenāhitāgnirnavasyāśnīgaditi| āgrahāyaṇī, aṇantān ṅīp| sanpyate'neneti santapanaḥ, santapana eva sāntapanaḥ-kṛcchraḥ ||

oṣadherajātau || 5.4.37 ||
auṣadhaṃ pibatīti| pathyā-śuṇṭhī-saindhavādīnāṃ kalke auṣadhaśabdo varttate, auṣadhayaḥ kṣetrarūḍhā iti| phalapākāvasāneṣu jātiviśeṣepvatrauṣadhiśabdaḥ ||

prajñādibhyaśca || 5.4.38 ||
prajānātīti prajña iti| `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' iti kaḥ| atha kimarthamubhayaṃ kriyate, iha ca prajñaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, matvarthe ca prajñāśabdāṇṇo vidhīyate, yaḥ prajānāti tasya prajñā'sti, yasya ca prajñāsti sa prajānātīti, tataścānyataraiṇaiva prājña iti siddham?-- ityāśaṅkya striyāṃ viśeṣa iti darśayati--striyāmityādi|
vidan, ṣoḍanniti vibhaktyantayoḥ pāṭha ekatvavivakṣārthaḥ| vaicitryārthaḥ ityante| śrotra śarīre| yaḥ śrotraśabdaḥ śarīre varttate, asau aṇamutpādayati--śrautram| anyatra śrotrāmindriyam| juhvatkṛṣṇamṛga iti| kṛṣṇamṛge varttamānājjuhvacchabdādaṇpratyayo bhavati--jauhvataḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ| anyatra juhvat| apara āha---kṛṣṇamṛge varttamānātkṛṣṇaśabdādaṇpratyayo bhavati--kārṇṇo mṛgaḥ| anyatra tu kṛṣṇaḥ juhvacchabdāttvaviśeṣeṇāṇbhavatīti| satvantviti| sacchabdo matvanta āgatanumko gṛhyate, satvāneva sātvataḥ ||

mṛdastikan || 5.4.39 ||
`pratyayasthāt' ityeva siddhe tikana hakāroccāraṇam yatrāpo luk kriyate tadartham---pañcabhirmṛttikābhiḥ krītaḥ paṭaḥ pañcamṛttika paṭaḥ ||

sasnau praśaṃsāyām || 5.4.40 ||
uttarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇāditi| mṛcchabdasya sāmānyaśabdatvāt, mṛdityukte praśaṃsāyā anavagamācca|
iha `praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap' ityasyānantaram--`vṛkajyeṣṭhābhyāṃ tiltātilau ca chandasi, mṛdassasnau, tikaṃśca' iti vaktavyam? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||

bahvalpārthācchaskārakādanyatarasyām || 5.4.42 ||
kārakābhidhāyinaḥ śabdāditi| pañcakapakṣe prātipadikāt, trikapakṣe subantāt| gahādiṣu `madhyamadhyamaṃ cāṇcaraṇe' ityaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi pṛthivīmadhyasya madhyamabhāva ityuktam, iha tu na tathetyāhaaviśeṣābhidhānācceti| evamādīti| ādiśabdenāpādānādhikaraṇayorudāharaṇaparigrahaḥ---bahubhya āgacchati bahuśa āgacchati; bahuṣu nidadhāti bahuśo nidadhāti; evamalpebyo'lpaśaḥ, alpeṣvalpaśaḥ|
bahūnāṃ svāmīti| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhīvidhānānna kārakābhidhāyī bahuśabdaḥ|
paryāyebyo'pīti| apiśabdādviśeṣebhyo'pi| tatra vṛttau paryāyasyodāharaṇam| viśeṣasya tu---triśo dadātīti, vīpsāyā anyatra| vīpsāyāṃ tūttareṇa siddham|
ābyudayikeṣviti| abyudayaprayojaneṣu agnyādheyādiṣu aniṣṭeṣu bhayādinimitteṣu dāneṣu| prāyikaṃ caitanmahgalavacanam, anyatrāpi hi dṛśyate| `apetāpoḍhanuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ' iti kārakatvaṃ samāsakriyāṃ prati pañcabhyāḥ karmatvāttadabhidhāyitvāccālpaśabdasya draṣṭavyam| udīritaṃ ca---`alpā pañcamī samsyate' iti ||


saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām || 5.4.43 ||
`nityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacane prāpte tadapavādaḥ sasvidhīyate| kathaṃ tahi `ekaikaśaḥ pitṛsaṃyuktām' iti śasdvirvacanayoḥ sahaprayogaḥ? chandovadṛṣayaḥ kurvanti|
yadyatra pāribhāṣikasyaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt-sarvebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo ghaṭaṃghaṭaṃ dadātītyatrāpī syāt; ghaṭaśabdasyaikavacanāntatvādityālocyānvarthasyaikavacanasyātra grahaṇamityāha--eko'rtha ucyate yeneti| nanvevamapi sa doṣastadavastha eva, ekavacanānkatasyaikārthatvāt? ityata āha-kārṣāpaṇādayaśceti| anena vṛttisthaikārthatā''śrīyate, na vākyagateti darśayati| vṛttau na ghaṭādayo jātiśabdā anekārthā bhavanti, jātiyogasyaikānekasādhāraṇatvāt; kintvabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāmupādadate; kārṣāpaṇādayastu paribhāṇavacanā aktaparimāṇamarthamācakṣāṇā ityekaśeṣabalāt akṣāḥ, pādāḥ, māṣā itivadekajātyanvayarahitānekārthapratītiḥ| vṛttau tu vibhaktyaikaśeṣayorabhāvātsa eva kevalo'ktaparimāṇortho'vatiṣṭhate| ataḥ kārṣāpaṇādaya evodāharaṇamiti jayādityo manyate|
vāmanastu `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' ityatrodāhariṣyati--`jasā sahacaritasya śaso grahaṇādiha na bhavati-kuṇḍaśo dadāti, vanaśaḥ praviśati' iti| sa manyate-jātiśabdo'pi yadā arthaprakaraṇādinā vṛttāvekārthībhavati, bhavatyeva tadā tato'pi śasiti--dvayordvayoḥ svāmīti| kathaṃ tarhi--
avratānāmavidyānāṃ jātimātropajīvinām|
sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ ************ || iti ?
kathaṃ ca na syād? vīpsāyā abhāvād, akārakatvād, anekavacanatvācca, ayaṃ hyatrārthaḥ- evambhūtānāṃ brāhmāṇāṃ sahasrasyāpi pariṣattvaṃ na vidyata iti? nāyamatrārtho yathā tvamāttha, ki tahi ? sahasraṃ sahasraṃ ye sametāstepāmapyevambhūtānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ nāstīti, tatra samavāyakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvādvīpsāyāścābhāvācchas bhavati ||

pratiyoge pañcabyāstasiḥ || 5.4.44 ||
pratinā karmapravacanīyenetyādi| `pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt' iti pañcamī |
ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānamiti| `tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam' ityetadatra liṅgam|

āpādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ || 5.4.45 ||
sārthāddhīyata iti| `ohāktyāge', karmaṇyātmanedam, yak, ghumāsthādisūtreṇetvam| kathaṃ punaḥ karmasaṃjñā, yāvatā `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma'? na cātra sārthaḥ kartṛsaṃjñakaḥ, kintu dhruvatvena vivakṣitvādapādānasaṃjñakaḥ| mā bhūtkartṛsaṃjñā, jahāti tāvatsārtho devadattaṃ yadi na jahyādapāya eva na saṃvartteta| svātantryopalakṣaṇaṃ ca karmasaṃjñāyāṃ kartṛgrahaṇam, kartṛsaṃjñā bhavatu mā vā bhūt| evaṃ cāpādanasyāpi sataḥ sārthasya hāne yatsvātantryaṃ vāstavam, tadāśrayā karmasaṃjñā bhavati| yadyevam, māṣepvaśvaṃ badhnātītyatra karmaṇo'pyaśvasya vastuto yadbhakṣaṇe svātantryaṃ tadāśrayā māṣāṇaṃ karmasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tasmātkarmakarttaryatra lakāraḥ| kathamiha ḍajahātirapagamanāyāṃ varttate? devadattaṃ sārtho jahāti, apagamayatītyarthaḥ| eṣaiva ca sārthasyāpagamanā yat kṣudupaghātādinā devadattasyāpagamane tatsamarthācaraṇam, yadā tu kṣudhādinā svayamevāpagacchati tadā karmakartṛtvam, tataśca hīyata iti| ko'rtha ? svayamevāpagacchatītyarthaḥ| punaḥ `kutohīyate'--ityapekṣāyāṃ sārthena sambandhaḥ|
vikāranirdeśa iti| vikṛtirvikāraḥ, iha tu tadvetutvādyagabhipretaḥ| tatra hi ghūmāsthādisūtreṇetvavidhānāddhāturūpaṃ vikriyate| yakā nirddeśaḥ-yasya yakītvamasti, tasya grahaṇārthamityarthaḥ| jihīteriti| śtipo ṅittvābāvādītvānupapatterjihāteriti paṭhītavyam| tiḍantānukaraṇaṃ vā jihīteriti draṣṭavyam|
naiṣā pañcamīti| yadantāttasiḥ, naiṣā pañcamītyarthaḥ| kiṃ tarhi tṛtīyeti| hetau, karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, tadantād `hīyamānapāpayogācca' iti tasirityarthaḥ| svareṇa, varṇena vā vivakṣitādarthāddhīna ityarthaḥ sampadyate ||

atigrahāvyathanakṣepeṣvakatari tṛtīyāyāḥ || 5.4.46 ||
atikramya graho'tigraha iti| atiśabdo'trātikramaṇe varttate iti darśayati| atiśabdo hi sasādhane'pyatikramaṇe dṛṣṭaḥ, tadyathā--`tasmādbrāhmaṇe rājanyavānatyanyaṃ brāhmaṇam' iti, `na vai devā namaskāramati' iti ca| tena tasyātikramaṇamātre vṛttirna sambhavati| vṛttenātigṛhyata iti| bahuṣvāsīneṣvanyātikrameṇāyamasāviti vijñāyata ityarthaḥ, tatra vṛttaṃ kāraṇam| cāritreṇeti| `carervṛtte hrasvaśca vā' iti ṇitranpratyayaḥ-caritram, cāritram ||

hīyamānapāpayogācca || 5.4.47 ||
udāharaṇeṣu vṛttasya hīyamānena pāpena ca yogaḥ, hetau
karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, karttā tvatra bandhujanādiḥ| kṣepasyāvivakṣāyāmityādi| kasmādevamityāha--kṣepe hīti ||

ṣaṣṭhyā vyāśraye || 5.4.48 ||
nānāpakṣasamāśrayo vyāśraya iti| tathā ca `hetumati ca' ityatra bhāṣye prayogaḥ---vyāśritāśca bhavanti, kecitkaṃsabhaktā, kecidvāsudevabhaktā iti| devā ityādi| arjuna indraputraḥ, karṇaḥ sūryaputraḥ| ṣaṣṭhī cātreti | pakṣaśabdastu tasau sati na prayujyate: gatārthatvāt, nānāpakṣasamāśrayaṇa evāsya vidhānāt ||

rogāccāpanayane || 5.4.49 ||
pravāhikāta iti| pravāhiphāśabdātpratīkārāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, tadantāttsiḥ, pratīkāraśabdasya tu pūrvavadaprayogaḥ||

abhūtatadbāve kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakartari cviḥ || 5.4.50 ||
vārttikakāreṇa cvividāvabhūtatadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityuktam, tadavaśyaṃ karttavyamiti manyamānaḥ sūtra eva prakṣipya vayācaṣṭe--kāraṇasyeti| upādānam, nimittam, asamavāyīti--trīṇi kāraṇāni, tatropādānakāraṇasyetyarthaḥ| vikārarūpeṇeti| kāraṇasyaivottaramavasthāntaram-vikāraḥ, tena rūpeṇa tadātmanā'bhūtasyājātasyāpariṇatasyetyarthaḥ| tadātmanā vikārātmanā bhāvaḥ-janma, pariṇāma ityarthaḥ| anena kāryakāraṇayorabhedo daśitaḥ| yathā rajjuḥ śikyamiti na tattvāntaram, atha ca na rajjumātre śikyapratītiḥ| evaṃ hiraṇyameva kuṇḍalam, mṛdeva ghaṭaḥ, tantava eva paṭaḥ, dārveva yūpaḥ| atha ca na dihaṇyādimātre kuṇkaḍalādipratītiḥ, no khalu kuṇḍalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ na bhavatīti kaścitpratyeti| yadi ca kuṇḍalaṃ hiraṇyaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? hiraṇyaṃ piṇḍaḥ nanu so'pi piṇḍaḥ, evaṃ vṛttamevaṃ dīrghamiti na kiñcana hiraṇyaṃ syāt, tasmadanuvṛttaṃ kāraṇam, vyāvarttamānastvavasthābhedo vikāra iti yuktam| kutaḥ punarayamabhūtatadbhāvaviśeṣo labhyate, na punarabhūtvā bhavanamātraṃ bhavantyasminkṣetre śālaya iti ? tacchabdopādānāt| yena rūpeṇa grāgabhūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ tena rūpeṇa tasya bhāvo'bhūtatadbhāva iti hi tasyārthaḥ, anyathā'bhūtabhāva ityeva vācyam| tadapi vā na vaktavyam; sampadyakartṛtvādeva siddheḥ|
yadvā-janmagrahaṇa eva karttavye `abhūtatadbhāvaḥ' iti vacanādyathoktārthalābhaḥ, sarvathā yatra prakṛtireva vikārarūpatāmāpadyamānā vikārabhedena vivakṣyate tatraiva pratyayaḥ, tatreva hi darśito'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ sambhavati| sampadyateḥ karteti| śabdātmakasya dhātoḥ svarūpeṇa kartrā sambandhāsambhavādarthadvārakamidamabhidhānam, sampadyarthasya yaḥ karttā sa sampadyakartetyarthaḥ| arthakathana caitat, vigrahastu sampadyaścāsau karttā ceti, `pāghrādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ śaḥ' asmādeva nipātanātsampado'pi bhavati| divāditvāt śyan| kvacittu sampadyate karteti| tiṅntaṃ paṭhyate, yaḥ sampadyate karttā sa sampadyakartetyarthaḥ| śuklīkarotīti| prakṛtau vikārāvasthāṃ prāpnuvatyāṃ varttamānādvikāraśabdātsvārthe cvipratyayaḥ, ikāraḥ `verapṛktasya' iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ| cakārastu tadavidhātārthaḥ, prakṛterantodāttārthaśca| vakārasya `verapuktasya' iti lopaḥ, `asya cvau' itītvam, `ūryādicviḍācaśca' iti nipātatvenāvyayatvātsorluk|
nātra prakṛtirvivakṣiteti| prakṛtivivakṣāyāmevābhūtatadbhāvaḥ sambhavatītyuktam|
abhūtatadbhāvasāmarthyakṣiteti| yo vikārarūpeṇābhūtaḥ san vikārātmanā bhavati, sa niyogatastena rūpeṇa sambadyamānaḥ sampadyakarttā bhavatītyetatsāmarthya yadrūpāntareṇa sampadyate na tadavaśyaṃ kartṛsaṃjñameva bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--kārakāntarasampattau mā bhūditi| adevagṛhe devagṛhe sampadyata iti| adevagṛhe prāgabhūdyo vṛkṣādiḥ, sa idānīṃ tasminpradeśe devālayībhūte devāgṛhe sampadyata ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇadikceyaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitā| kṛbhvastiyogābhāvādvinaivātra cviḥ prasajyate| tasmādadeva gṛhe devagṛhe bhavatīti pratyudāhāryam| atra vṛkṣādeḥ sampattiṃ pratyadhikaraṇasyāpyadevagṛhasyābhūtatadbhāvo'styeva; tasya prāgadevagṛhasyāpi samprati devagṛhatvena pariṇāmāt| evaṃ hi vṛkṣādestadādhāraviśiṣṭatayā'bhūtatadbhāvo yadyapi vastutaḥ sampadyakartṛtvamapi devagṛhasyāsti, tathāpi na tadvivakṣitam, kiṃ tahi? ādhārabhāva eveti bhavatyudāharaṇam| nanu caivaṃ sati suklīkarotītyatrāpi na syād, atrāpi hi kāranāntarasya karmaṇaḥ sampattiḥ, na kartuḥ? asyatra viśeṣaḥ, karmavayāpāropasarjanaṃ kartṛvyāpāraṃ karotirāha, karmavyāpāraśca sampattiḥ--śuklaṃ karotīti, ko'rtha? śuklaṃ sampadyamānaṃ sampādayatītyarthaḥ| tataśca sampadyakartṛtvamasminprayoge śabdenaivopāttam| itaratra tu vṛkṣādereva sampadyakartṛtvaṃ śābdam, devagṛhasya tvārtham| ādhārabhāva eva tu śābda iti na kaśjid doṣaḥ| iha tarhi kathaṃ samāpībhavati, abhyāśībhavati, antikībhavatīti? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? na hyasamīpaṃ samīpaṃ bhavatītyatrārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? asamīpe sthitaṃ samīpe sthitaṃ bhavatīti? tātsthyāttācchabdyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||

arurmanaścakṣuścetorahorajasāṃ lopaśca || 5.4.51 ||
atra sarvaviśeṣaṇasambandhādityādi| yadi tvabhūtatadbhāvādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ madye'nyatamaṃ na sambadhyate, tataścverapi vidhyarthametatsyāt| yatastu sarvāṇi viṣepaṇāni sambadhyanete, tato lopamātramevana na prāpranetīti tadatha vacanam, na cvervidhānārtham| `cviśca pratyayaḥ' iti tu pūrveṇaiva vihitasya cveranuvādaḥ kṛtaḥ, tatsanniyogaśiṣṭatvaṃ lopasya darśayitum| yadi punaviśeṣavihitena bādhā mā bhūditi cvirapyanena vidhīyeta, tata unmanīkarotītyādāvanena pratyayo na syād; grahaṇavacā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt| tataścaitatsanniyogaśiṣṭo lopo na syāt, pūrveṇa tu kevala eva cviḥ syāt| tasmātpūrveṇa vihite cvau parato'ruḥprabhṛtīnāṃ lopo bhavatītyeva sūtrārthaḥ| pūrveṇaiva ca kevalebhyastadantācca cvirbhavati ||

vibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye || 5.4.52 ||
yadi prakṛtiḥ kṛtsnā vikāratāmāpadyata iti| abhūtatadbhāvaviṣayaṃ kārtsnyamāśrīyata iti darśayati--vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakamiti| vikalpārthasyāpyasya prāpayitavyāntarābhāvāt| nanu vākyaṃ prāpayitavyaṃ syāt? tatrā''ha-pratyayavikalpastiti| apara āha--anekārthatvānnipātānāṃ samucyayo'rthaḥ|
vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakamiti| vibhāṣāśabdastu nipāto na bhavati, `dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye' iti vibhakterdarśanāt, kiṃ tahi? `gurośca halaḥ' ityakāra pratyayāntaḥ--vibhāṣyate vikalpyate iti vibhāṣeti ||

abhividhau sampadā ca || 5.4.53 ||
sa tu kṛbhvastibhireva yoge bhavatīti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya vikalpārthatvātsvaśāstreṇaiva cvirbhavatīti sampadāyoge tasyāprasaṅgāt| spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ caitatpūrvagranthe|
vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteścvirapyabhyanujñāyata iti| samuccayārthe tu tasminnanenaiva cvirbhavansampadāpi yoge syād, abhyanujñāya iti cānupapannaṃ syāt| atheti| ubhayatra vyāptisambhavātpraśnaḥ| sarvā prakṛtiriti| prakārakārtsnye 'tra sarvaśabdaḥ, yathā---sarvānnīno bhikṣuriti| yathāsyāṃ senāyāmityādi| atrāpi prakārakārtsnya eva sarvaśabdaḥ, khaṅgaprāsādīnāmaśeṣāṇāṃ sastrāṇāmekadeśenāpyagnyātmabhāvo'tra vivakṣitaḥ, na tvekasyā api sastravyakteḥ sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ| evaṃ varṣāsu lavaṇamityatrāpi| kārtsnya tvityādi| yatraikasyāpi dravyasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ, na kaścidavayavaḥ parihāpyate, tatra kārtsnyaṃ bhavati| tasmādarthabhedādubhayamuktam, na tvekatraivānyataratra sampado grahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti ||

tadadhīnavacane || 5.4.54 ||
svāmisāmānyamityādi| iha `adhirīśvare' iti adhiśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tena yoge `yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanam' iti īśvaravācinaḥ saptamī, īśvaraśceśitavyāpekṣaḥ| adhiśabdaścāyaṃ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭhyate iti saptamīsamāsaḥ, tato'dhyuttarapadalakṣaṇaḥ khaḥ, tatra kṛte brahmadattādhīnāḥ pañcālā iti sāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanādadhiśabda īśitavyasāmānyabhidhāyī, pañjālādayastu tadviśeṣavacanā iti gamyate; tataśca svāmisāmānyam, īśitavyasāmānyaṃ ca tadadhītaśabdenocyate, tatra svāmisāmānyaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthamiti viśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata itvāhasvāmiviśeṣavācina iti ||

deye trā ca || 5.4.55 ||
brāhmaṇatrākarotīti| svarādiṣvayaṃ trāntaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, tenāvyayatvātsorluk| apara āha--tatraiva `cavyarthāśca' iti paṭhyate, tatra bahuvacananirddeśādacvyarthasyāpi trāpratyasya sāhacaryeṇa parigrahādavyayatvamiti|
rājasādbhavati rāṣṭramiti| pūrveṇa sātireva bhavati ||

devamanuṣyapuruṣapurumartyebhyo dvitīyāsaptamyorbahulam || 5.4.56 ||
sātīti nivṛttamiti| pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt `kṛbhvastiyoge' iti na sambadhyata iti tadarthamatra svaritatvaṃ karttavyam| svarite sati nādhikāra ityayaṃ ca pakṣa āśrayaṇīyaḥ| maṇ‌ḍūkaplutyāuttaratra sambandhaḥ| `sampadā ca' ityetattu sarvathaivaṃ nivṛttatvānna sambadhyate ||

avyaktānukaraṇād dvyajavarārddādanitau ḍāc || 5.4.57 ||
yatra dhvanāvityādi| yadyapyanukāryameva rūpamanukaraṇe varṇaviśeṣarūpeṇa prakāśate, tathāpi `avyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' ityanukaraṇasthasyācchabdasya pararūpaṃ vidhatte| dhvanimātrasāmyena tu tasyānukaraṇa mucyate| avaraśabdo'pakarṣe iti| apakarṣaḥ-nyūnatā, pravṛttinimittakathanaṃ caitat, apakṛṣṭaṃ tvavaraśabdasyārthaḥ| yasyāpakarṣe kriyamāṇe ityādi| atrāpakarṣaḥ-vibhāgaḥ, samapravibhāge'rdvaśabdaḥ, avaratvaṃ cāckṛtameva, dvyacsannidhānāt| yasminvibhajya nirūpyamāṇe suṣṭhu nyūnamapi alpamapi ardha dvyacchabdavatsampadyate na tato nyūnam, adhikaṃ tu sambhavatu mā vā bhūt, tad dvyajavarārddhamityarthaḥ. yasyetyādi| yadi tvakṛte dvirvacane yasya dvyajavarārddhatā tato ḍāj bhavatīti vijñāyate, tadā paṭacchabdārdarna syāditi bhāvaḥ|
nanvedhaṃ sati ḍāci parabhūte tadāśraye dvirvacane dvyajavarārddhatā bhavati, tasyāṃ ca satyaṃ kaḍācā bhavitavyamitītaretarāśrayatvaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--ḍāci bahulamitītyādi| satyaṃ parasaptamyāṃ syādeṣa doṣaḥ; viṣayasaptamī tveṣā, tato na doṣa ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇe parabhāgasya ṭacilopaḥ, `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti pūrvatakārasya paradeśca pakārasya pararūpam--ekaṃ pakāraḥ, dvitīya udāharaṇe dakāraḥ|
dṛṣatkarotīti| vyaktānukaraṇametat, prakaraṇādinā cānukaraṇatvānugatiḥ| kharaṭakharaṭākarotīti| kharaṭadityasya dvirvacanādi pūravavat| `dvyajarddhāt' ityucyamāne'tra na syāt, na hyatrārddhaṃ dvyackam, kiṃ tarhi? tryackam| avaragrahaṇe tu sati bhavati; nyūnanivṛttyarthatvādavaraśabdasya| paṭiti karotīti| `avyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' iti acchabdasya pararūpatvam| tadyatra syād, ḍājantasya satitvaṃ syāditi śabdamanuccārya karotirantaraḥ syāt, itiśca, tataḥ paraḥ ekāctvādasya pratyayasvereṇaiva siddhamudāttatvam, `lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ' ityatrāpi `ḍābhyaḥ' ityucyamāne'pi na kaścihoṣaḥ|
iḍāyāṃ ḍāśabdo'narthakaḥ, `nābhā pṛthivyāḥ' ityādau suvādeśasyāpi ḍāśabdasyāgrahaṇam; chandasi tataḥ kyapo'darśanāt, tasmānnārthaścakāreṇa ? tatrāha--cakāra ityādi| paṭapaṭā asīti sthite `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ, ekādeśaḥ| atrāsati cakāre `svarito vānudātte'padādau' iti pakṣe svaritaḥ syāt| citkaraṇasāmarthyāttu cidacitorekādeśasya pūrva pratyantavadbhāvāccitsvareṇāntodātta eva bhavati|
sa svārthiko vijñeya iti| arthāntarasyābhāvāt| svārthe tu yakāro'smādeva nipātanādvijñeyaḥ ||

kṛtro dvitīyatṛtīyaśambabījāt kṛṣau || 5.4.58 ||
kṛṣāvabhidheyāyāmiti| kasyābhidheyāyām? dvidīyādiśabdānāṃ ḍājantānāṃ kṛñśca| taddarśayati--dvitīyaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ karotītyartha iti| pratilomaṃ karṣatītyarthaṃ iti| śambaśabdasyātra prātilomye vṛttiḥ, kṛñśca karṣaṇe| saha bījeneti| bījaśabdasya bījāvāpasahite vilekhane vṛtterayamartho bhavati ||

saṅkhyāyāśca guṇāntāyāḥ || 5.4.59 ||
saṅkhyāvācinaḥ śabdasyeti| etena saṅkhayyā ityasya vaṣṭyantatāṃ darśayati| guṇānteti| vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ, antaśabdaśca samīpavacana ityāha--guṇaśabdo'nte samīpa iti| antaśabdasya saṅkhyāyā ityetadapekṣamāṇasyāpi sambandhiśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ, nipātanācca saptanyantasyāpi tasya paranipātaḥ| yatretyanena prakṛtirnirdiśyate| setyādinā prakṛtisaṅkhyā| guṇāntetyucyate| saṅkhayāśabdasyānte guṇaśbado yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| atrāpi gamakatvātsamāsaḥ| tādṛśāditi| saṅkhyāśabdasamīpavattiguṇaśabdādityarthaḥ| antaśabdaścāyaṃ niyatameva paratvaviśiṣṭaṃ sāmīpyamācaṣṭe, na sāmīpyamātram| tena guṇaviśatirityādau pūrvabhūte guṇaśabde'tiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ| anabhidhānādvā'tra pratyayābhāvaḥ| dviguṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ karoti kṣetrasyeti| atra vilekhanaśabdasya kṛdantasya prayogātkṛdyogadalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭī kṣetrādbhavati| utpanne tu taddhite tadabhāvād dvitīyaiva bhavati|
athaivaṃ kasmānna vyākhyāyate--saṅkhyāyate-saṅkhayāyā iti pañcamī, antaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, saṅkhayāvācinaḥ paro yo guṇaśabdastadantāyāḥ prakṛteriti ? ucyate; evaṃ hi sati guṇāntāyā eva saṅkhyāyā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, na guṇaśabdasya samāse guṇabhūtasya| evaṃ tarhi mā būdantagrahaṇam, saṅghyāyā guṇādityevāstu, vyadhikaraṇe ca pañcamyau-- saṅkhyāyāḥ paro yo guṇaśabdastasmāditi? evamapi vākye prasaṅgaḥ--pañca guṇānkarotīti, viparyayaśca sambhāvyeta---guṇaśabdātparā yā saṅkhyā tadantāditi| evaṃ tarhi saṅkhyāderguṇādityevāstu? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtamityeva, pratyuta yathānyāse dviguṇabhāgaṃ kṣetraṃ karotītyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ||

samayācca yāpanāyām || 5.4.60 ||
samayākarotīti| `adya me pāravāśyaṃ śvaḥ paraśvo vāsya samayaḥ' ityevaṃ yo bahuṣu divaseṣu ativarttate sa evamutyate| samayaṃ karotīti| samayaḥ-niyamaḥ, saṅgamo vā--samayanaṃ samaya iti ||

sapattraniṣpattrādativyathane || 5.4.61 ||
patatyaneneti pattram-śarāṇāṃ puṅkhagato barhaḥ| sapattraṃ śaramiti| saha pattreṇa varttata iti| sapattraḥ, āpuṅkhānmṛgaśarīre śaraṃ praveśayatītyarthaḥ| niṣpattrākarotīti| nirgataṃ pattramasmānniṣpattraṃ mṛgaṃ karotīti| yathāsya śarīre puṅkhapradeśo'pi na lagati, tathā śaraṃ śarīrānniṣkrāmayatītyarthaḥ|
sapattraṃ vṛkṣamiti| pattrāṇi-parṇāni| jalasecanata iti| `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| bhūmiśodhaka iti| `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' iti jīvikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||

niṣkulānniṣkoṣaṇe || 5.4.62 ||
niṣkulākarotīti| niṣkośitaṃ kulamantaravayavānāmasmāditi bahuvrīhau ḍāc ||

sukhapriyādānulomye || 5.4.63 ||
ārādhyacittānuvartanamiti| ārādhyāḥ-svāmyādayaḥ, teṣāmiṣṭāniṣṭakaraṇākaraṇābhyāṃ yaccittasyānuvarttanam- ārādhanaṃ tadānulomyam| priya karotyauṣadhapānamiti| prītiḥ-priyam, ghañarthe kaḥ|

duḥkhātprātilomye || 5.4.64 ||
cittapīḍanamiti| svāmyāderyadaniṣṭasyācaraṇena iṣṭasyākaraṇena vā cittasya pīḍanaṃ tatprātilomyam ||

śūlātpāke || 5.4.65 ||
śūlaṃ karoti kadannamiti| śūlam-udaratodaḥ, kutsitamannaṃ kadannam ||

satyādaśapathe || 5.4.66 ||
satsu sādhu satyam, prāgghitīye yati prāpte'smādeva nipātanādyaḥ antodātto hi satyaśabdaḥ--satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ, ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ceti| śaperathaḥ śapathaḥ, bhāṇḍam-ratnādidravyajātam| tathyamiti| tathaiva-tathyam, `pādārghābhyāṃ ca' iti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvātsvārthe yat ||

madrātparivāpaṇe || 5.4.67 ||
parivāpaṇamiti| karmavyāpāramātravācino vaperhetumaṇṇici lyuṭ, māṅgalyaṃ muṇḍanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ, coladīkṣādau| bhadrācceti vaktavyamiti| madrādityarthagrahaṇamiti tu vyākhyāne maṅgalādibhyo'pi syāt|

samāsāntāḥ || 5.4.68 ||
avayavavacano'ntaśabda ityāha-avayavā ekadeśā iti| samīpavacanastu na gṛhyate; pratyayaparatvenaiva siddhatvāt| avayavavacanaṃ cāntaśabdamāśrayatā samāsārthāduttarapadādakṛta eva samāse samāsāntā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi te samāsasyaikādeśā bhavanti, yadi prāgeva tānpratyayānkṛtvā tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate| tathā ca `na kapi' ityatra vakṣyati--`samāsārthe hyuttarapade kapi kṛte paścātsamāsena bhavitavyamiti| ye punaratra pakṣe doṣāste ṅayāpsūtre eva prativihitāḥ|
adhirājam, uparājamiti| vibhaktyarthe sāmīpye cāvyayībhāvaḥ, `avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' `anaśca' iti ṭac| dvipurīti| samāhāradvandvaḥ| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityakāraḥ| koṣaśca niṣacca koṣaniṣadam, srukca tvak ca sruktvacam-dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti ṭac| vigato dhuraḥ, pragato dhura iti| prādisamāsaḥ| tatpuruṣe tulyārtetyeṣa svaro bhavatīti| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ, pūrvapadaṃ cātra `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ', `upasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyudāttam, uccairnīcaiḥ- śabdau svarādiṣvantodāttau paṭhitau| atha samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye,' `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ', `avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' ` dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt' iti prāyeṇa samāsaviśeṣagrahaṇamasti? yatrāpi nāsti tatrāpi saṅgāta eva gṛhyate, yathā `ac pratyanvavapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ' iti| yatra tarhyetadubhayaṃ nāsti `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' ityādau, samāsagrahamamiti ||

na pūjanāt || 5.4.69 ||
yān śabdānupādāyeti| pūjanavacanātsamāsānto na bhavatītyayamartho na bhavati; parigaṇitābhya eva prakṛtibhyaḥ samāsāntavidhānāt| tatra ca pūjanārthasya kasyācidabhāvāt, abhāve pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ| surājetyādau prādisamāsaḥ |
pūjāyāṃ svalatigrahaṇamiti| pūjanagrahaṇamapi karttavyameva, avakṣepaṇe atikramaṇe ca varttamānayoḥ svatyorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| prāgbahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ ceti| `vahuvrīhau sakthyakṣaṇoḥ' ityataḥ prāgayamadhikāra iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ|

kimaḥ kṣepe || 5.4.70 ||
kirājeti| `kiṃ kṣepe' iti samāsaḥ| kasya rājā kirāja iti| praśne'tra kiṃśabdaḥ|
`kṣepe' iti śakyamākarttum, kasmādatra na bhavati--lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇamiti? kaśṭidāha--kṣepagrahaṇenaijjñāpayati--iyamiha paribhāṣā nāpatiṣṭhata iti, tena ninditā dhūrasya śakaṭasya kiṃdhūḥ śaṭakamiti bahuvrīhāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavatīti| tadbhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| tasmādvispaṣṭārthaṃ kṣepagrahaṇam ||

bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt || 5.4.73 ||
`bahuvrīhau' iti subbyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| tasyaiva saṃkhyeye vṛtteḥ| yo'pi vārthe varttate-dvitrāḥ, pañcaṣā iti, yo'pi ,sujarthe-dvidaśāstridaśā iti; tāvubhāvapi saṃkhyeya eva varttete; saṃkhyeyasyaiva vārthasya sujarthasya cābhidhānāt| upadaśā ityādau ṭilopaḥ| upaviṃśā ityatra `tiviṃśaterḍiti' iti tilopaḥ dvayorakārayoḥ `ato guṇe' pararūpatvam|
saṃkhyeya iti śakyamavaktum| iha kasmānna bhavati---citraguriti? natrivayuktanyāyena bahugaṇapratiṣedhāttatsadṛśavijñāne sati saṃkhyottarapado bahuvrīhirgrahīṣyate| syādetat--vaipulyavacano'pi bahuśabdo'sti, na saṃkhyāpadameva, gaṇaśabdo'pi saṅghavacano'pyasti, tasmādaśakyaṃ bahugaṇasādṛśyena saṃkhyottarapadaṃ grahītumiti ? tanna; parasparasāhacaryātsaṃkhyāpadayoreva paryudāsāt| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi samāsasambhavātsādṛśyasya cānavasthitatvāt saṃkhyeyagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| upabahavaḥ, upagaṇā iti| aniyatapracayavacanayorapi bahugaṇaśabdayorarthaprakaraṇādinā yadā viśiṣṭeṣveva daśādiṣu vṛttistadā tatsamīpagatā navādaya upabahava ityaviruddhaṃ bahuvacanam| atreti| upagaṇā ityatra svare viśeṣa iti| ḍaci satyantodāttatvaṃ syāt, tasmi, tasmistvasati pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvameva bhavati|
saṃkhyāyāstatpuruṣasyeti| tatpuruṣasyāvayavabhūtaṃ yatsaṃkhyāvācyuttaparapadaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| nistriśādyathamiti| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre, avyayādayaḥ saṃkhyāntāstatpuruṣā nistriṃśaprakārāḥ| goviṃśatirityādau na bhavati| nistriśānivarṣāṇīti| triṃśallākṣaṇāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā nirgatāni adhikāniṃ ekatriṃśadādīnītyarthaḥ| nirgatastriśato'ṅgūlibhya iti| tato'pi dīrghatara ityarthaḥ| rūḍhiśabdasyeyaṃ yathākathañcidvyutpattiḥ|
ḍacaścitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham; anyathā samāsārthāduttarapadātpratyaye kṛte paścādvahuvrīhau satiśiṣṭaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ syāt| idameva citkaraṇaṃ liṅgam-samāsārthāduttarapadātsamāsānte kṛte paścātsamāsaḥ iti, anyathā pratyayasvara eva satiśiṣṭaḥ svaraḥ syāt| yastu manyate--`kṛte samāse samāsāntagrahaṇasāmarthyāccāgamavattadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' iti, tasyāpi jñāpakārthaṃ citkaraṇam; svaravidheḥ prāgeva samāsānto bhavatīti| tena mahādhura ityādau bahuvrīhisvaro bhavati ||

ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe || 5.4.74 ||
sāmārthyāditi| dhura evākṣeṇa sambandho'sti, netareṣāmityetatsāmarthyam| etadviśeṣaṇamiti| `anakṣe' ityatrottarapadārtha etadā pratyavamṛśyate, ata evāha--akṣasambandhinī yā dhūriti| sūtre tvakṣasya dhūrapekṣayā'dhikaraṇatvādanakṣa iti saptamī| cakrasambaddhaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣo rathādyavayavaḥ-akṣaḥ, tatsambandhinī dhūstasyāṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadi tvakṣe samāsārthe na bhavatīti vijñāyeta, ihaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt-dṛḍhā dhūrasya dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti, iha tu na syād--akṣasya dhūrakṣadhūriti| athāpyevaṃ vijñāyeta--akṣe pūrvapade na bhavatīti, evamapīhaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syād--akṣadhūriti, iha tu na syāddṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti| tasmādvyāptinyāyā dukta evārtho nyāyyaḥ| arddharca iti| `adha napuṃsakam' iti samāse `arddharcāḥ puṃsi ca' iti puṃlliṅgatvam| bahvaca iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| lalāṭapuram, nāndīpuramiti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| paravalliṅgatā tu na bhavati, lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya| yadyapyakārāntena puraśabdena samāse kṛte etatsiddhyati, tathāpi vyañjanāntena samāse tasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūditi pūrvagrahaṇam, dvīpaṃ samīpamiti| dvirgatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, `dvyantarupasargebyo'pa it' itītvam| rājadhurādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| mahādhura iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, `striyāḥ puṃvat' iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ, `ānmahataḥ' ityātvam|
anṛco māṇavaka ityādi| ṛgantasya bahuvrīhernañpūrvasya māṇavaka evābhidheye pratyaya iṣyate, tathā bahupūrvapadasya caraṇākhyāyāmevetyarthaḥ| anṛkkaṃ sāma, bahvṛkkaṃ sūktamiti| `jñeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap, `coḥkuḥ' iti kutvam ||

ac pratyanvavapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ || 5.4.75 ||
pratisāmamityādau prādisamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhiḥ, avyayībhāvaśca yathāsambhavaṃ veditavyāḥ|
kṛṣṇodakpāṇkaḍurvāyā iti| kṛṣṇādiśabdāḥ pūrve yasyāstasyā bhūmerac pratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇā bhūmirasmin kṛṣṇabhūmo deśaḥ, udīcī bhūmirasminnudagbhūmo deśaḥ| kaḥ punassau pṛthivyā dakṣiṇasīmā? bhūmiśabdo vā tadviśeṣe sasvasaṃpanne draṣṭavyaḥ. yasya dakṣiṇataḥ khilaḥ saṃdeśa udambhūma| godāvaryāśca nadyāścāc pratyayaḥ| samṛtaḥ, te nadi saṃkhyā*** uttare bhavataḥ---pañcagodāvaram, pañcanadam| `nadībhiśca' iti samāhāre'vyayībhāvaḥ|
padmanābha iti| padmākāro nābhirasyeti prathamāntaryorvahuvrīhiḥ| padmaṃ nābhāvasyeti vigrahe gaḍvādipu darśanātsaptamyāḥ paranipātaḥ ūrṇanābha iti| `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorvahulam' ityūrṇaśabdasya hrasvaḥ| tadetaditi| kṛṣṇabhūmādikam|
ogavibhāgeneti| ata eva prāk pratyayanirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ||

akṣṇo'darśanāt || 5.4.76 ||
`adarśanāt' iti vacanādakṣīvākṣītyakṣisadṛśārthavṛttirihākṣiśabda upāttaḥ| lavaṇākṣam, putkarākṣamiti| lavaṇamakṣīva, putkaraṇakṣīveti `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' iti samāsaḥ|
kathamityādi| nanu darśanādanyatra yo'kṣiśabdastadantādityuktam, gavākṣakabarākṣayośca samudāyo darśanavacanaḥ, nākṣiśabda iti kātrānupapattiḥ? satyam; akṣyantādadarśanāditi sūtrārthaḥ kasmānna bhavatīti manyamānasyāyaṃ praśno draṣṭavyaḥ| cakṣuḥparyāya iti| tasya prasiddhataratvāditi bhāvaḥ ||

acaturavicaturasucaturastrīpuṃsadhenvanaḍuharksāmavāṅmanasākṣibhruvadāragavorvaṣṭhīvapadaṣṭhīvanaktaṃdivarātriṃdivāhardivasarajasaniśreyasapuruṣāyuṣadvyāyuṣatryāyuṣargyajuṣajātokṣamahokṣavṛddokṣopaśunagoṣṭhaśvāḥ || 5.4.77 ||
samāsavyavasthāpīti| kvacidbahuvrīhereva, kvacid dvandvādevaityevaṃmādiko niyamaḥ-vyavasthā| apiśabdādanyadapi ṭilopādikaṃ tannipātanādeva| striyāḥ pumāniti| striyaṃ prati pumān śūra ityarthaḥ|
akṣibhruvamiti| prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāvaḥ| dāragavamiti| `sarvo dvandve vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati'| saptamyarthe vṛttayoravyayayoḥ samāso'pi nipātanādeveti| cārthena yogābāvāt, na hi bhavati-iha ca, evaṃ ceti| ahardivamiti| `ro'supi' iti rephaḥ| kathamanayordvandva iti| na kathañaacit, virupāṇāmapi samānārthānāmekaśeṣārambhāt| vīpsāyāmityādi| cārthe vidhīyamāno vīpsāyāṃ na prāpnoti, ekaśeṣārambhācca| tasmādvīpsāyāṃ dvandvo nipātyate, vīpsādyotanāccaikena gatārthatvamapi nāśaṅkanīyam, yathā dvirvacane--grāmogrāmo ramaṇīya iti|
sarajasamiti| `avyayībhāve cākāle' iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| niḥśreyasamiti| prādisamāsaḥ. niḥśreyaska iti| niścitaṃ śreyo'neneti bahuvrīhiḥ, śepalakṣaṇaḥ kap, `so'padādau' iti satvam|
ṛgyajurunmuggha iti| ya ṛco yajuṃpi manyate|
trayo vā catvāro vā tricaturāḥ| caturṇāṃ samīpa upacaturāḥ, `bahuvrīhau saṅkhyete' iti prāptasya kaḍaco'pavādo'dajvidhīyate ||

brahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ || 5.4.78 ||
varcaḥ-dīptiḥ| udāharaṇeṣu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||

avasamandhebhyastamasaḥ || 5.4.79 ||
avagataṃ tamo'vatamasam, santataṃ tamaḥ santamasam, prādisamāsau| andaṃ karoti andhayati, andhayateḥ pacādyac--andham, tacca tattamasca andhatamasam ||

śvaso vasīyaḥ śreyasaḥ || 5.4.80 ||
vasuśabdātpraśastavacanādīyasun--vasīyaḥ, `praśasyasya śraḥ'--śreyaḥ| svabāvāccetyādi| yadyapi śvaḥśabdo'ntra kālaviśeṣe vartate, tathāpīha samāse uttarapadārthapraśaṃsāmāśīrviṣayāmācaṣṭe| kutaḥ ? svabhāvat| asyaiveti| śvaḥ śreyasaśabdasyetyarthaḥ ||

anvavataptādrahasaḥ || 5.4.81 ||
rahaḥśabdo'yamaprakāśe varttate| anugataṃ raha iti| prādisamāsaḥ, anugataṃ raho'sminniti bahuvrīhirvā| evamavahīnaṃ rahaḥ, avahīnaṃ raho'sminnati avarahasam| taptaṃ ca tadrahaśca taptarahasa****| atyantaṃ raha ityarthaḥ ||

praterurasaḥ saptamīsthāt || 5.4.82 ||
saptamyarthe varttata iti| na hyanyaduraḥśabdasya saptamīsthatvaṃ nāmeti bhāvaḥ ||

anugavamāyāme || 5.4.83 ||
āyāme'bhidheya iti| pravṛttinamittamāyāmaḥ, tadvati tu paryavasānam| matvarthīyākārānto vā āyāmaśabdaḥ, āyāmavatyabhidheya ityarthaḥ; anyathā'nugavaṃ yānamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt| yasya cāyāma iti samāsa iti| nanu tatra lakṣaṇeneti varttate ? satyam; ihāpi bāhyaṃ yānaṃ prati gavāmastyeva lakṣaṇabhāvaḥ| anuguśabdātpratyaye'bhidhātavye nipātanāśrayaṇaṃ prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham, tena yadgavāṃ bāhyaṃ tatraiva bhavati ||

dvistāvā tristāvā vediḥ || 5.4.84 ||
samāsaśca nipātyata iti| lakṣṇābhāvāt| yāvatī prakṛtatāvityādinā nipātanasya viṣayaṃ darśayati, yasminkarmaṇyupadiṣṭā dharmāḥ karmāntareṇopajīvyante sā prakṛtirjyotiṣṭomādiḥ, yenopajīvyate sā-vikṛtiḥ| kasyāñcidvikṛtāviti| aśvamedhādau| dvistāveti| tāvatīśabdena tatsambandhinyā vṛttirlakṣyate, saiva ca dviśabdanaṃ saṃkhyāyata iti suc pratyayaḥ, parasparasāmarthya ca| dvistāvatītyasamāso'yam| sūtre liṅgamavivakṣitamaa| dvistāvo'gnirityapi dṛśyate| na cātrāgniramidhiyate, na vediḥ? agnirapi vedireva; uttaravedivikāratvāt, `uttaravedyāmagniśacīyate' iti vacanāt ||

upasargādadhvanaḥ || 5.4.85 ||
adhvaśabdasyākriyāvacanatvāttaṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñābhāvādupa sargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇam ||

tatpuruṣasyāṅgaleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ || 5.4.86 ||
aṅguliśabdāntasyetyādi| sarvatra samāsāntasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī ||

ahaḥsarvekadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ || 5.4.87 ||
ahargrahaṇaṃ dvandvārthamiti| na tu tatpuruṣārtham; mukhyārthavṛttayostatpuruṣāsambhavāt| na hyasti sambhavaḥ- rātriśceti, nāpyahorātrirityasti| yadi tu rātriśabdena tadguṇamaharucyate ahaḥ śabdena tadguṇā rātriḥ, tataḥ sambhavedapiviśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| gauṇārthatā tu bhavati| na ca mukhye sambhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tasmādahargrahaṇaṃ dvandvārtham| tathā ca--`hemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca chandasi' iti dvandve samāsānto nirdyiṣṭaḥ| ahorātra iti| samāhāradvandvaḥ, `rātrāhnāhāḥ paṃsi', ahno rutve `rūparātrirathantareṣu' iti nakārasya rutvam, tasya `haśi ca' ityutvam| dvirātra iti| samāhāre dviguḥ| nīrātra iti| prādisamāsaḥ, `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' ||

ahne'hna etebhyaḥ || 5.4.88 ||
tasminparabhūta iti| samāsāntaprakaraṇāttatra parato'yamādeśo vijñāyate, na tadapavādaḥ sa ca ṭajeva vihita iti sāmarthyādayamartho labhyate, vyākhyānāccāhnādeśaḥ| svayaṃ samāsānto na vijñāyate `ūdhaso'naṅ' ityādivat| sāmarthyāccetyādi| sāmāsānto navijñāyate `ūdhaso'nah' ityādivat| sāmarthyāccetyādi| sāmarthyameva darśayati| na hīti| ekaśeṣavidhānād dvandvastāvanna sambhavati, tenaiva tasyāsambandhānna ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, nāpi viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, na hi tadeva tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati| etena bahuvrīhirvyākhyātaḥ| dvyahna iti| taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, `tatra bhavaḥ' ityaṇ, tasya `dvigorluganapatye' iti luk| sarvāhna iti| `ahno'dantāt' iti ṇatvam|
ahno'hnavacanānarthakyam, ahnaṣṭakhorniyamavacanāt,`ahna etebhyaḥ' ityetāvadeva sūtraṃ karttavyam, ajanuvarttate, etebhyaḥ paro yo'hanśabdastato'jbhavati, ṭaco'pavādaḥ, tatrāci kṛte'hnaṣṭakhoreveti niyamāṭṭilopābāve'llope sati dvayahna ityādi sidhyati, `rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' iti vacanāt striyāṃ pravṛttyabhāvāṭṭajacoraviśeṣaḥ| `etebhyaḥ' iti vacanaṃ saṃkyāvyayārtham; itarathā cānukṛṣṭatvānna sambaddhyeta ||

na saṅkhayādeḥ samāhāre || 5.4.89 ||
`saṅkhayādeḥ' iti na vaktavyam; anyasya samāhāre vṛttyasambhavāt ||

uttamaikābhyāṃ ca || 5.4.90 ||
kecitatvityādi| yathā `prathamayoḥ' iti prathamādvitīyayorgrahaṇaṃ dvivacananirddeśāt, tathaivātrāpyuttamagrahaṇasāmarthyādupottamottamayordvayorapi grahaṇamiti tepāmabhiprāyaḥ| atra pakṣe uttamau dvāvekaścāpara iti bahuvacanaprasaṅgāt sautro dvivacananirdeśaḥ| ekaśabdasyāpūrvanipātaḥ `alpāctaram' ityasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ ||

rājāhassakhibhyaśṭac || 5.4.91 ||
iha kasmāditi| kiṃ ca syādyadyatra ṭac syāt ? `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' iti puṃvadbhāvena ṅīpi nivṛtte ṭaci ṭilāpe sati ṭittvānṅīpi madrarājīti syāt, bhadrarārjñīti cepyate| tasmādatra ṭaco'nutpativaktavyeti bhāvaḥ| ṭacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham; anyathā prayayasya samāsekadaśatvādvidhuraḥ, pradhura ityādāviva pratyayasvaro'vyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa bādhyeta ||

gorataddhitaluki || 5.4.92 ||
pañcagavāmiti| samāhāre dviguḥ, pañcagurityatra tadvitārthe| pañcagavarūpyam, pañcagavamayamiti| yathātra `dvigorluganapatye' iti rūpyamayaṭorlugna bhavati tathā tatraivoktam ||

agrākhyāyāmurasaḥ || 5.4.93 ||
`agrākhyāyām' iti pañcamyarthe saptamī, pañcamyantenoraḥ śabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tu `sa ceduraḥśabdaḥ' ityādinā darśitam ||

ateḥ śunaḥ || 5.4.94 ||
javana ityartha ityādi| viṣayaviśeṣādiyamarthavyavasthā śvaśabdasya ||

upamānādapraṇiṣu || 5.4.97 ||
aśvā loṣṭa iti| atra ` nañastatpuruṣāt' iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyam, tasmānniḥ śvā loṣṭa iti pratyudāharttavyam ||

khāryāḥ prācām || 5.4.101 ||
dvikhārīti| ṭajabhāvapakṣe napuṃsakahnasvatvam|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum trikhāramiti? khārīśabdena samānārthaḥ khāraśabdo'sti yathā ca `tadasya parimāṇam' , `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñā' ityatra `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate khāraśatādyartham' iti vārtikam ||

dvitribhyāmañjaleḥ || 5.4.102 ||
dvābhyāmañjalibhyāṃ krīto dvayañjaliriti| añjaliparimito vrīhyādirañjaliḥ; na pāṇidvayam, tasya mullatvāsambhavāt| tataśca parimāṇatvātprāgvatīyasya ṭhakaḥ `adhyarddhapūrva' iti luk| dvyañjalipriya iti| vyavasthaitavibhāṣātvāduttarapadadvigorna bhavatītyāhuḥ ||

anasantānnapuṃsakācchasi || 5.4.103 ||
sutrāmāṇamiti| suṣṭhu trāyate iti `āto manin', upapadasamāsaḥ| anehasamiti| `nañyāhana eha ca' ityāṅpūrvāddhantaresipratyayaḥ, dhātūpasargayoścehādeśaḥ, naña upapadasamāsaḥ, dvitīyaikavacanam|
antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||

brahmaṇo jānapadākhyāyām || 5.4.104 ||
antareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ jānapadaśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ, `dvyekayoḥ' itivadityāha-samāsena ced brahmaṇo jānapadatvamākhyāyate iti| yadyapyekaṃ brahmagrahaṇam, tena ca samāso viśeṣitaḥ, tathāpi pratyāsatterbrahmaṇa eva jānapadatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tasmādetatpratyayavidhānamiti| tata eva hi pratyayavidāne brahmaṇo jānapadatvaṃ śakyamākhyātum|
devabrahmeti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, karmadhāro vā ||

dvandvācyudaṣahāntātsamāhāre || 5.4.106 ||
tatpuruṣānmā bhūditi| tatpuruṣādeva mā bhūdityarthaḥ| `dvandvāt' ityanucyamāne hi tatpuruṣādhikāro na nivartteta ||

avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ || 5.4.107 ||
jarāyā jaras ceti| jarāśabdādac pratyayo bhavati, avyayībhāve jarasādeśaśca--upajarasam| pratiparasamanubhyo'kṣṇaṃ iti| prādibhyaḥ paro yo'kṣiśabdastataṣṭajbhavati, tatra paraśabdasyāvyayībhāvasambhavāttatpuruṣātha grahaṇam| pratyakṣamiti| `yathārthe yadavyayam' iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, parakṣmaṇaḥ parokṣam, `parokṣe liṭ' iti nirddeśātpañcamīsamāsaḥ, upasarjanasya ca paranipātaḥ, akṣyakārasya cotvam| akṣiyogyam-samakṣam, yathārthe yogyatāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| anvakṣamiti| paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ||

napuṃsakādanyatarasyām || 5.4.109 ||
napuṃsakagrahaṇamuttarapadaviśeṣaṇamiti| nāvyayībhāvaviśeṣaṇam; avyabhicārāt ||

nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ || 5.4.110 ||
`nadi' iti svarūpagrahaṇam, na saṃjñāyāḥ; paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt ||

jhayaḥ || 5.4.111||
jhaya iti pratayāhāragrahaṇamiti| jhakārayakārayostu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; tadantasyāvyayībhāvasyāsambhavāt| yogavibāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||

gireśca senakasya || 5.4.112 ||
antargiramiti| vibhaktayarte'vyayībhāvaḥ| vikalpo'nuvarttata eveti| anyathā keṣāñaacijjhayantānāṃ śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt; `jhayaḥ' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| etenaitanna codanīyam---`dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityā vidhayaḥ' iti pūrvasya vidhernityatvārthamidaṃ senakagrahaṇaṃ syāditi ||

brahmavrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt ṣac || 5.4.113 ||
svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate| duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīnīti| dur-nindāyām| ninditaṃ yathā tathā śliṣṭāḥ sambaddhāḥ vibhakyo yeṣu tāni tathoktāni, tathā hi--bahuvrīhiśabdātpañcamyā bhavitavyam, samāsāntasambanadhe ṣaṣṭhyā vā, yathā--`tatpuruṣasyāhguleḥ' iti; iha tu saptamyekavacanaṃ śrutam| `sakthyakṣaṇeḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam, saptamīdvavacanaṃ vā| na caivambhūtenānena bahuvrīhiḥ śakyo viśeṣayutum; bhinnavibhaktivacanatvāt| svāṅgāditi pañcamyekavacanam, tacca na sakthyakṣaṇoḥ samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamavakalpate, tatcābhipretam| tasmādvibhaktivyatyayamāśritya vibhaktayaḥ sambandhayitavyā iti `duḥślaṣṭavibhaktīni' ityuktam|
sthūlākṣirikṣuriti| `akṣṇo'darśanāt' ityacātra bhavitavyam| yadi tu neṣyate, samāsāntavidhiranitya iti vaktavyam; tata eva tarhi ṣajapi na bhaviṣyati| tasmātsthūlākṣā, sūkṣamākṣā veṇuyaṣṭiriti ajeva ṭāpi pratyudāharttavya ityāhuḥ| dīrghasakthīti| dīgha sakthyasyāḥ sā dīrghasakthī, atra ṣaci satika ṅīṣudātto bhavati, ṭaci tu sati ṅībanudāttaḥ syāt| nanu ṭacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham, tataśca ṅībapyudāttanivṛttisvareṇodātta eva bhaviṣyati ? tatrāha--sakyaṃ cākrāntādityādi| vibhāyeti| `vibhāṣotpuccha' ityato'nuvṛtteḥ ṣacaścitkaraṇamakṣyartham| sakthyapi yadākrāntātparaṃ tadā nityamantodāttaṃ bhavati--cakrasakthaḥ, vakrasaktha iti| gaurasakthādau tu nārthaścitkaraṇena ||

aṅgulerdāruṇi || 5.4.114 ||
aṅgalisadṛśāvayavamityādi| dāruṇi samāsārthe mukhyābhiraṅgulībhiḥ sambandho noparpadyata iti bhāvaḥ|
nanu ca dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasya dāruṇa ityatra sambhavati? tatrāha--yasya tvalityādi| iha ca bahuvrīherayaṃ pratyayo vidhīyate, tvadukte codāharaṇe taddhitārthe tatpuruṣaḥ karttavyaḥ, tatra ca `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' ityacā bhavitavyam| tasmādbahuvrīhau dāruṇi vācye gauṇa evāṅguliśabda iti suṣṭhūktamityarthaḥ ||

dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūdhnaḥ || 5.4.115 ||
atha kimartha ṣaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate, na prakṛtaḥ ṣajanuvarttiṣyate? dvimūrddhaḥ, trimūrddha ityatra `dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu' iti pākṣikamantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| ṣaci tu sati cittvānnityamantodāttatvaṃ syāt| `dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhaśu bahuvrīhau' ityasya tu samāsāntavidheranityatvāttadabhāve dvimūrddhā, `trimūrddhāna saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe' iti, so'vakāśaḥ syāt| ṣe tu sati yadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate, tadāpi pakṣe'ntodāttatvam, pakṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtiśvareṇādyadāttatvamiti svaradvayasiddhiḥ| anityatvaṃ ca ṣavidhānādeva vijñāyate| nitye hi sati prakṛte ṣacyapi vihite dvitribhyāmapi svaraḥ prāptamibhāṣārūpeṇa citsvaraṃ vādhiṣyate; viṣayāntarābhāvāt| anityatve tu samāsānātābhāvapakṣe sāvakāśam `dvitribhyām' iti svaraṃ citsvaro vādheteti pratyayāntarakaraṇamarthavadbhavati| evaṃ ca kṛtvā mūrdhasviti nakārāntanirdaśa upapanno bhavati; anyathā `sakyaṃ cākrāntāt' itivadakārāntameva niddiśet| yadi nakārānto nirddiśyate,kathaṃ samāsānte kṛte bhavati? naipa dopaḥ; vakṣyati hi tatra--`yadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadā bahuvrīheḥ kāryitvāttadekadeśatvācca samāsāntasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva' iti |

appūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ || 5.4.116 ||
pūraṇapratyayānta iti| `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ' ityevamādayaḥ pūraṇārthe ye pratyayā vihitāstadantā ityarthaḥ| strīliṅgā iti| `pūraṇī' iti ṅīpā nirddeśāt| pūraṇīgrahaṇena gṛhyante iti| pūraṇārthasāhacaryāt|
api pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇamiti| api vidhīyamāne pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī sā gṛhyata iti vaktavyamityarthaḥ| kvaca punaḥ pūraṇyāḥ prādānyam? ityata āha--yatreti| na kevalaṃ varttipadārtha eveti| samāsāvayavabhūtaṃ padaṃ varttipadam, tasyārtho varttipadārthaḥ. prathamāntaṃ caitat, na saptamyantam| pūraṇītyetadanuṣajyate, na punaranupraviśatīti| tatrodāharaṇe udbhūtāvayavabedasya samudāyasya kṛtaikaśeṣeṇa rātriśabdenābhidhānādrātriṣu pañcamyā antarbhāvaḥ| kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣa iti| `nadyṛtaśca' iti ap| atra vartipadārtha eva pūraṇī, na tvanyapadārthaḥ; tirohitāvayavalabhedasya pakṣasyānyapadārthatvāt| yathā-vṛkṣaśabdasyāvayavyabhideyaḥ, na tu śākhādayo'vayavāḥ; anumīyamānasyāśabdārthatvādityaprādhānyaṃ pūraṇyāḥ|
neturnakṣatra iti| yo netṛśabdastadantādbahuvrīherityarthaḥ| chandasi ceti| anakṣatrārthamidam| pañcakamāsika iti| pañcabhṛtirasya māsasya pañcako māsaḥ, so'syāṃkhavasnabhṛtayaḥ' iti saṃkhyāyā kan, pañcako māso'syeti bahuvrīhau kṛteṭac| apaḥ pitkasṇaṃ yatra bahuvrīhāvantodāttatvamāramyate tadbādhanārtham--apañcamāḥ, supañcamāḥ, `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvaṃ na bhavati ||

añnāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ nasaṃ cāsthūlāt || 5.4.118 ||
nasamiti| dvitīyānirddeśo vaicitryārthaḥ| draṇasa iti| druriva nāsikāsya `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāgaḥ' iti ṇatvam| vadhre bhavā vādhrī, sā nāsikāsya vādhrīṇasaḥ, `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhaitasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ| gauriva nāsikā'sya gonasaḥ|
khurakharābhyāṃ nas vaktavya iti| kevalādeśavacanaṃ pratyayanivṛttyartham| khuraṇāḥ, kharaṇā iti| `atvasantasya ca' iti dīrghaḥ|
śitiḥ kṛṣṇā nāsikāsya śitināḥ, aheriva nāsikā'sya ahināḥ| arcā-pratimā, tasyā iva nāsikāsya arcanāḥ, `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasoḥ' iti hrasvatvam ||

upasargācca || 5.4.119 ||
upasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇam; nāsikāṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt| vergro vaktavya iti| viśabdātparasya graśabda ādeśo bhavati; pratyayastvajeva ||

suprātasuśvasudivaśārikukṣacaturaśraiṇīpadājapadaproṣṭhapadāḥ || 5.4.120 ||
ṭilopādikamiti| suprātaḥ, sukhva ityatra ṭilopaḥ| `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' ityetattu nāśritam| ādipadena ṇaṇīpadājapadayoḥ padbhāvaḥ| śobhanaṃ prātarayeti| prātaḥ śabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt, prātastanaṃ karma prātaḥśabdena lakṣyate, devadattādiścānyapadārtha ityāhuḥ| kathaṃ ca `varadaḥ karotu suprātamahnāmayaṃ nāyakaḥ' iti? na hyayaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, śobhanaṃ prātastavārkaḥ karotviti hyatrārtha? ucyate; śobhanaṃ prātastanaṃ karma yasya sandhyādestatte karotviti kleśenāsya nirvāhaḥ ||

nañduḥsubhyo halisakthyoranyatarasyām || 5.4.121 ||
haligrahaṇamanarthakam? kathamahalaḥ, suhala iti? akārānto halaśabdo'sti? nanvarthabhedo'sti-mahaddhalaṃ halirityucyate, halamātraṃ tu halam? nāyamarthabhedaḥ kiñcitkaraḥ, kriyamāṇe'pi haligrahaṇe halaśabdenāpi samāso na daṇkaḍavāritaḥ, tataśca prakaraṇādivaśena viśeṣo'vagantavyaḥ; sati caivamakārāntenāpi samāse prakaraṇādinaiva mahasvamavagaṃsyate? iha tarhi---durhala ityakārāntenāpi samāse pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti, samāsānte tu vihite citsvaro bhavati| ahalaḥ, suhala ityatra `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttavidhānānnāsti viśeṣaḥ| `śeṣādvibāṣā' iti ca haliśabdātkap pratyayaḥ prasajyeta; tasmāddhaligrahaṇam| kecittu haliśaktyoriti paṭhanti| asthiparyāyaḥ śaktiśabdaḥ ||

nityamasic prajāmedhayoḥ || 5.4.122 || asevāyaṃ na vihitaḥ, sakāsyetsaṃjñā mā bhūditi|
evaṃ tarhītyādi| bhāṣye etannāśritam| citkaraṇam--duḥprajāḥ, durmedhā ityatrāntodāttārtham| anyatra `nañsubhyām' ityeva siddham ||

dharmādanic kevalāt || 5.4.124 ||
paramaḥ svo dharmo'sya paramasvadharma iti| `sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam' iti svaśabdasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; prāptasya cābādhā vyākhyeyeti, āhitāgnyāderākṛtigaṇatvādvā ||

jambhā suharitatṛṇasomebhyaḥ || 5.4.125 ||
dantavacano veti| `imamambhasutaṃ piba' iti darśanāt ||

dakṣiṇermā lubdhayoge || 5.4.126 ||
lubdho vayādha iti| kavayastu hiṃsāmātre prayuñjate--`bālīhemābjamālī guṇanidhiriṣuṇā nirmito dakṣiṇermā' iti yathā| vraṇitamiti| vraṇaśabdāditac| `vrama gātravicūrṇane' ityasmādvā caurādikaṇijantāktaḥ ||

ic karmavyatihāre || 5.4.127 ||
ayaṃ bahuvrīhirgṛhyata iti| asyaiva karmavyatihāre vṛtteḥ| udāraharaṇeṣu `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvayamic paṭhyate iti| tenāvyayībhāvasaṃjñakatvādavyayatve sati sublugbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yadyevam, avyayībhāvasaṃjñayā bahuvrīhisaṃjñāyā bādhanātsamāsasvareṇaivāntodāttatvaṃ siddhamiti nārthaścitkaraṇena? viśeṣaṇārthaṃ tu| asati hi tasmistiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvikāramātraṃ paṭhyeta, tataśca `aca iḥ' ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt ||

dvidaṇḍyādibhyaśca || 5.4.128 ||
yadi `dvidaṇkaḍyādayaḥ sādhavo bhavanti'--ityayamartho'bhipretaḥ, `dvidaṇḍyādibhyaḥ' iti sūtrapadasya kathaṃ nirvāhaḥ? ata āha-dvidaṇḍyādibhya iti| tādarthya eṣā caturthītyādi| samudāyanipātanācyeti| samudāyā yatra prasiddhāstatraiva teṣāmavarodhaḥ-avasthāpanaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ samudāyanipātanamityarthaḥ| dvidaṇkaḍi praharatīti| dvau daṇḍāvasminpraharaṇe iti vigrahaḥ| iha na bhavatīti| kiṃ na bhavati? dvidaṇḍītyetacchabdarūpaṃ sādhu na bhavatītyarthaḥ|
bahuvrīhyadhikāre'pīti| atrāpi `samudāyanipātanācca' ityayameva hetuḥ| nanu prātipadikeṣvicpratyayāntapāṭhādeva siddhaṃ dvidaṇḍyādīnāṃ sādhutvam, tatkimanena? tanna; na hi pāṭhamātreṇejantatvaṃ śakyamavagantum; tataścāvyayībhāvasaṃjñā na syāt| anārṣaśca pāṭhaḥ śaṅkyeta; kvacidapyanupayogāt ||

prasambhyāṃ jānunorjñaḥ || 5.4.129 ||
jñurityayamādeśa iti| pratyayastvayaṃ na bhavati; ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanena nirdeśāt| iha hi jānuśabdasyaikatve'pi arthagataṃ dvitvam, upapadanibandhanaṃ vā dvitvamāśritya jānunoriti nirdeśa etadartha- kriyate--sthānaṣaṣṭhītvamasandigdhaṃ kathaṃ vijñāyeteti| chandasi tu svatantro'pi jñuśabdo dṛśyate--`upajñubādho nabhasā', `sadema vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya' iti ||

ūdhaso'naṅ || 5.4.130 ||
ṅitkaraṇādantyādeśatvam, akārāditvaṃ ca niścityā''haanaṅādeśo bhavatīti| kuṇḍodhnīti| `bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ', `allopo'naḥ'|
anaṅ‌vidhānamuttarārtham, iha tu nakārādeśenāpi siddham ||

gandhasyedutpūtisusurabhibhyaḥ || 5.4.135 ||
ikārādeśo bhavatīti| ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśādādeśatvāvasāyaḥ| prakaraṇabhedāya cādeśatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate, na tvasminpratyaye'pi kaściddoṣaḥ|

gandhaśabdo'yamasti dravyavacanaḥ---vahati jalamiyam, pinaṣṭi gandhāniyamiti, asti ca guṇavacanaḥ---candanasya gandha iti, tatra guṇavācino grahaṇārthamāhagandhasyettvaṃ iti| rūpādisamudāyaḥ-dravyam, tasya gandhalakṣaṇo guṇa ekānta ekadeśo bhavati, ūpādivyatiriktamavayavi dravyamiti tu pakṣe ekānta ivaikāntaḥ; tatsthasyopalambhāt|
sugandha āpaṇika iti| āpaṇe niyukta āpaṇikaḥ; prāgvahatīyaṣṭhak| bhavārthe vā adhyātmāditvāṭṭhak| atha vāyau kathaṃ sugandhiḥ, dugandhiriti, na hyayaṃ gandho vāyorguṇaḥ? mā bhūttasya guṇaḥ, tena tāvadavibhāgāpanno lakṣyate, etāvadeva ca tadekāntatvaṃ vivakṣitam, na tadguṇatvam| evaṃ ca kṛtvā kuṅkumādyanulepanamapi yadā devadattāderavibhāgapannaṃ bhavati tadettvaṃ bhavatyeva--sugandhirdevadatta iti, sarvathā dravyavacananivṛttiḥ ||

alpākhyāyām || 5.4.136 ||
supo'lpo'sminsūpagandhīti| arthapradarśanametat, vigrahastu sūpasya gandho leśo'sminniti; inyathā viśeṣaṇatvād gandhaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| yadvā--asmādeva nipātanād gandhaśabdasya paranipātaḥ ||

pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ || 5.4.138 ||
lopo bhavati samāsānta iti| yadi tvayaṃ samāsānto na syād, `ādeḥ parasya' ityādeḥ syāt, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap ca prasajyet; samāsāntāpekṣasya śeṣasyāśrayaṇāt| kathaṃ punarabhāvarupo'ntāvayavo bhavati? tatrāha--sthānidvāreṇeti ||

kumbhapadīṣu ca || 5.4.139 ||
bahuvacananirddeśātprabhṛtyartho'vagamyata ityāha-- kumbhapadīpramṛtaya iti| samudāyā eva nipātyanta iti| kathaṃ tarhi sūtre bhūtavibhaktayā saptamyā nirddeśaḥ? ityata āha--tatreti| viṣayagrahaṇena sūtre viṣayasaptamīti darśayati---yathā kumbhapadyādayaḥ siddhyantīti| yattadornityasambandhātpūrvatra tathā lopo bhavatītyartho grāhyaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaḥ samudāyā eva nipātyante, na kumbhādīneva gaṇe paṭhitvā tebhyaḥ parasya pādaśabdasya lopo vidhīyeta ? tatrāha--samudāyapāṭhasya ceti| viṣayaniyamameva darśayati--striyāmeveti| atra ca striyāmapi ṅīppratyaya eva| `pādo'ntarasyām' iti yadā ṅībviṣayabhūtastadaivetyarthaḥ|
yaccetyādi| upamānapūrvapadam-kumbhapadī, jālapadītyādi; saṃkhyāpūrvapadamekapadī, śatapadīti| aṣṭāpadīti paṭhyate, tatra nipātanāddīrghatvam, `aṣṭanaḥ saṃjñāyām' iti vā''kāraḥ ||

vayasi dantasya datṛ || 5.4.141 ||
dvitanniti| ṛkārasyogtkāryārthatvād `ugidacām' iti num ||

triyāṃ saṃjñāyām || 5.4.143 ||
acchando'rthamidam| ayogatīti| aya iva dantā asyā ayodatī, ugittvānṅīp| samadantīti| `nāsikodaroṣṭha' ityādinā ṅīṣ ||

vibhāṣā śyāvalārokābhyām || 5.4.144 ||
aroko nirdīptiriti| `ruca dīptau',rocanam-rokaḥ, sa na vidyate yasyeti kṛtvā ||

agrāntaśuddhaśubhravṛṣavarāhebhyaśca || 5.4.145 ||
cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ|
ahidannityādi| bhāṣye etannāśritam ||

kakudasyāvasthāyāṃ lopaḥ || 5.4.146 ||
kālādikṛtā iti| sādiśabdenāhārapariṇāmādergrahaṇam ||

trikakut vartate || 5.4.147 ||
parvate'nyapadārthe mukhyasya kakudasyāsambhavādāha--kakudākāraṃ śrṛṅgamityādi| na cetyādi| ucyata ityasyānuṣaṅgaḥ| saṃjñaiṣetyādi| etacca nipātanāllabhyate| evaṃ ca parvatagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||

araḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ kap || 5.4.151 ||
vyūḍhoraskaḥ, priyasarpiṣkaḥ| iti| `so'padādau', `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ', upapūrvānnahyateḥ sampadāditvātkarmaṇi kvip, upanaddhā upānat, `nahivṛti' iti dīrghaḥ, avamukte upānahau yena so'vamuktopānatkaḥ| `naho dhaḥ' jaśtvacarttve ||
vikalpa eva bhavatīti| lakṣmīśabdāt `nadyṛtaśca' iti nityaḥ kab na bhavati; ekavacanāntapāṭhasya niyamārthatvāt| arthānnaña iti| nañaḥ paro yo'rthaśabdastadantādbahuvrīhernityaṃ kabbhavati| nāsyārtho'sti anarthamaḥ ||

inaḥ striyām || 5.4.152 ||
`aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhaṃ prayojayanti' ||

nadyṛtaśca || 5.4.153 ||
nadyantādbahuvrīheriti| atrāntaśabda uttarapade varttate, nadyuttarapadādbahuvrīherityarthaḥ| yadvā--bahuvrīhyarthamuttarapadaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, tasmānnadyantādityarthaḥ| kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? bahugrāmaṇīrnagarī,bahukhalapūrnagarītyatra kab nivarttito bhavati ||

śeṣādvibhāṣā || 5.4.154 ||
yasmādbahuvrīheriti| karmaṇi lyablope eṣā pañcamī, bahuvrīhimāśritayetyarthaḥ, tena yatrāpyādeśaḥ samāsāntaḥ--vyāghrapāt, sugandhiḥ, kuṇḍodhnīti; asāvapi śeṣo na bhavati| pratyayaprāyatvādvā samāsāntasya `yasmāt' ityuktam|
iha śeṣaḥ kabapekṣo vā syād, anantaro yo bahuvrīhyadhikārastadapekṣo vā, samāsāntamākṣatrāpekṣo vā-iti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti| tatrādye pakṣe-vyāghrapāt, sugandhiḥ, dvidaśāḥ, anṛcaḥ, vidhura ityādau nityakabviṣayavarjaṃ sarvatra prasajyeta| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam, na hi nityakabviṣaye vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ; nityakavidherānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| dvitīye'pi dvidśā ityādau syādeva prasaṅga iti manyamānastṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrayati--samāsānto na vihita iti| bahukhaṭvaka ityādau `āpo'nyatarasyām' iti hrasvaḥ, bahukhaṭva ityādau `gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti|
kathamityādi| yadi samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti praśnaḥ| viśeṣe sa iṣyata iti| tataśca viṣayāntare sūkte sāmani ca bahuvrīheḥ samāsāntāpekṣaṃ śeṣatvamastyeveti bhāvaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaḥ śeṣagrahaṇam, yāvatā yatra samāsāntā vihitāstatra ta eva bādhakā bhaviṣyanti, anavakāśā vidhayo bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśāśca te, ko'vakāśaḥ ? vibhāṣā kap, yadā na kap so'vakāśaḥ--kapo'pyanyāḥ prakṛtayaḥ; viśeṣaprakṛtibhya ubhayaprasaṅge paratvātkap syāt| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇam ||

īyasaśca || 5.4.156 ||
sarvā prāptiḥ pratiṣiddhyata iti| na tu `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti śeṣalakṣaṇasyaiva kapaḥ pratiṣedha iti sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ| etacca śeṣādityetasya nivṛttatvātkabmātrasyānuvṛtterlabhyate| bahuśreyasīti| liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇādatra pratiṣedhaḥ| yathātra sorhalṅyādilopaḥ, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ| hrasvatvamapi na bhavatīti| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti prāptam| kasmāt? ityāha--īyaso bahuvrīhāvityādi| puṃvadvacanenātra na strīpratyayasya nivṛttirvivakṣitā, kiṃ tarhi? hrasvaprakaraṇāttadabhāvaḥ| tathā ca `gostriyoḥ' ityatra vṛttau-`īyaso bahuvrīhau pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' ityevoktam ||

vandite bhrātuḥ || 5.4.157 ||
vanditaḥ stuta iti| yadyapi `vadi abhivādanastutyoḥ' ityabhivādane'pi vadiḥ paṭhyate, tathāpi vyākhyānātstutyarthasyaiva grahaṇamiti darśayati| tena vanditabhrātṛka ityatra kabbhavatyeva ||

nāḍītantryoḥ svāṅge || 5.4.159 ||
nāḍīśabdo jātilakṣaṇaṅīṣantaḥ| tantrīśabdaḥ `avitṛstṛtantribhya īḥ' itīkārāntaḥ| baharunāḍiriti| upasarjanahrasvam| bahutantrīrityatra tu `kṛtstriyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanānna bhavati ||

niṣpravāṇiśca || 5.4.160 ||
proyate'syāmiti pravāṇīti| veño'dhikaraṇe lyuṭ, `kṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvam ||

iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ pañcamāsyādhyāyasya caturtha pādaḥ
<6>
<6.1>
kāśikāvṛttī
atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ

ekāco dve prathamasya || 6.1.1 ||
iha yadyapi svārthatve sambhavati pārārthyamayuktm, vidheyakāryiṇordvayornirde śāt sambhavati ca svārthatvam, tathāpi `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityādau vidheyānirddesena vaiyarthyaprasaṅgānnāyam `aṇkuṭilikāyāḥ' ityādivatkevalo vidhiḥ, nāpi `śeṣe' ityādivallakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca| tathā hi sati sarveṣāmeva śabdānāṃ prathamasyaikāco'nena dvirvacane siddhe `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityāhi vyarthaṃ syāt| dhātorliṭhyeva, liṭi dātoreva-iti niyamānna vaiyarthyamiti cet ? na; vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva jyāyastvāt| asca hi pārārthyemiti cet? na; vidhiniyamasambhave vidhereva jyāyastāvāt| asya hi pārārthyo'vambhāvini sati yathā teṣāṃ vidhitvaṃ tathāsya varṇanaṃ yuktamataḥ parārtha evāyam| tatrāpi na paribhāṣā-dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ prathamasyaikāco veditavyamiti; evaṃ hi sati `sarvasya dve' ityatraivāsya vyāpāra iti tatraivaikācaḥ prathamasyeti vācyaṃ syāt| `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityādikaṃ ca vidheyānirddeśādvyartha syāt| ataḥ pāriśepyātsvaritatvāccādhikāra evāyamiti niścityāha--ekāca itadi ceti| adhikāro'yamiti vaktavye pṛthak svaritatvapradarśanārthamevamuktam| etattritayamiti| tasya prayojanam--yatra yadapekṣitaṃ tatra tasya sambandhaḥ, yathā--`ajāderdvitīyasya' ityatra `ekāco dve' iti, `abhe abhyastam' ityatra `dve' iti, liṭi dhātorityādau sarva sambadhyate| ita uttaramityādi| anantaroktasyaiva vivaraṇam| prāk samprasāraṇavidānāditi| tata ārabhya tu nāsya sambandhaḥ; vidheyāntaranirdeśātsvarite kṛte nādhikāra iti vā vyākhyānāt|
sāmānyenoktamudāharaṇaniṣṭhaṃ darśayati--vakṣyatīti| atra yadi `dhātorerekācaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ syāt, paciprabhṛtīnāmeva syāt, na jāgartyādīnām| prathamagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, na hyekācāṃ dhātūnāṃ dvitīyādirekājasti| na ca prathamasya dhātoriti sambandhaḥ| tathā hi sati dhātupāṭhe prathamapaṭhitasya bhavatereva syāt, tataśca bhavatigrahaṇameva kartavyaṃ syāt| athaikāco dhātoḥ prathamasya varṇasyeti sambandhaḥ ? tadayuktam; sahanirddiṣṭayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya svataḥ prāptasya tyāgāyogāt| ato vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambandha ityāha-dātoravayavasyeti| dvitīyasya ceti| yadyapyatra dvitīyagrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi `liṭi dhātoḥ' ityatra tvadhikṛtamasti, tasya cārthaḥ pradarśyate iti nāsaṅgataṃ kiñcita| jajāgāra-ityādīni mukhyagauṇatayā krameṇodāharaṇāni|
ekāca iti yadyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ syāttadā `dhātoḥ' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ cet? iyāya āretyādāveva syād, vaiyadhikaraṇye tu papācetyādiṣu bhavadapi dvirvacanamajmātrasyaiva syāt, tataśca `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ', `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ', `liṭyabyāsasyobhyeṣām' ityādyanupapannaṃ syāt| ekagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakama, prathamasyāca iti viśeṣaṇādekasya ca dhātoranekaprathamājasambhavādaca ityekatvaṃ vā vivakṣiṣyate, kimekagrahaṇena ? tasmād bahuvrīhirayam| tadāha--ekāca iti bahuvrīhinirdeśa iti| bahuvrīhiṇā vivakṣitasyārthasya pratipādanaṃ bahuvrīhervā uccāraṇaṃ bahuvrīhinirddeṣaḥ| vigrahapradarśanaṃ vispaṣṭapratipattyartham| yadi bahuvrīhinirddeśastato bahuvrīheranyapadārthapradhānatvādyathā `citragurānīyatām' ityukte yasya tā gāvaḥ sa evānayate na citrā gāvaḥ, tadvadatropalakṣitaṃ tadubhayapārśvavatti vyañjanadvayameva dvirucyeta, na tūpalakṣaṇabhūto'jityata āha--tatreti| bhavati vai bahuvrīhāvapi kvacidvartipadārthasyāpi kāryayogaḥ, tadyathā--śuklavāsasamānayeti matvarthe bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra yathā daṇḍī, viṣāṇīti saṃsarge matvarthīya utpanne tasya dviṣṭhatvād guṇasyāpi kāryayogaḥ; tadvad bahuvrīhāvapi yatra saṃsargo vācyastatrāviruddho gumasyāpi kāryayogaḥ| abhyantaraśceti| antarbhūta ityarthaḥ| ānyantaramiti pāṭhe abhyantaram-madhyam, tatra bhavamābhyantaram| sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti| yathā tatsannihitamavayavāntaraṃ dvirucyate, tathopalakṣaṇībhūto'pyajityarthaḥ| atra ca jñāpakam `dīrgho'kitaḥ' ityādi| codayati--evaṃ ca pacityatreti| tenaiva tadavayavocchabdaḥ paśabdaśceti| cakārādakāraśca vyapadeśivadbhāvādekājeva, yathaivāṅgulyā devadatto'ṅgulimāṃstathā hasto'pi, tadvadatrāpi| tataśca sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti śeṣaḥ| nanvarthavadghahaṇe nānarthakasyeti samudāyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nāvayavānām, nanvevaṃ jāgatryādīnāṃ na syāt, kiñca yatra `śe' ityādau viśiṣṭaṃ śabdasvarūpaṃ gṛhyate tatraiveyaṃ paribhāṣā, atra tu `dhātoravayavasyaikācaḥ' iti taṭasthenopalakṣaṇena jāg, pac-ityevamādikaṃ gṛhyate, na tu svarūpeṇeti neha tasyāḥ pravṛttiḥ? pariharati--tatreti|
teṣu samudāyādiṣvekākṣu madhye'vayavaikācaḥ prathamā na dvirucyante, kutaḥ ? ityāha--tathā hītyādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ---kimekasminneva prayoge yugapacca sarvaprayogaścodyate? paryāyeṇa vā ? kiṃ vā prayogabhedena kasyacit kvacaneti ? na tāvadādya kalpaḥ, pramityanuṣṭhānayordvayorapyasambhavāt| tathā hi--ekāctvena nirupitaṃ dvirvacanaṃ pramātavyam, na caiko'vayavo yugapadanekāvayavatvena śakyonirūpayitum, tatkathaṃ yugapatpramīyatām, pramitaṃ vā kathamanuṣṭhīyatām! na hyekasminnekāci dvirucyamāne tadaivānya ekācchakyo dvirvaktum; vācaḥ kramabhāvitvāt| nāpi dvitīyaḥ; `anabhyāsasya' iti pratiṣedhādanavasthāpātācca| tasmātprayogabhedena sarvaprasaṅga ityeṣa eva pakṣaḥ sambhavati| tatra `ṇijir śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ' ityasya ślau yadā niśabdasya dvirvacanam, tadā nenekti, nenikta ityatra na kaściddoṣaḥ| nenijati, anejijuḥ, nenijadityatra `adabhyastāt', `sijabyastavidibhyaśca', `nābhyastācchatuḥ' ityadbhāvajusabhāvanumpratiṣedhā na syuḥ; jakāreṇa vyavadhānāt, ikārasyecchabdasya ca dvirvacane rupameva na sidhyatītyeṣa eva doṣaḥ ? tasya parihāraḥ--`śāstrahāniprasaṅgāt' iti| avayave hi dvirucyamāne'vayavāntaraviṣayasamudāviṣayaṃ ca śāstraṃ hīyate| nanu śāstreṇa pramitameva yadi nānuṣṭhīyeta syācchāstrahāniḥ, atra tu paryāyeṇa pratīyata ityuktam, taccānuṣṭhitameva kathaṃ sāstrahāniḥ? aṅga tu bhavānācaṣṭām--paśabde dvirucyamāne cakāraḥ kimiti na dvirucyate, tadā taddvirvacanasyāpratītatvāditi cetkimiti na pratīyate, tena sahaikāctvenānirūpitatvāditicetkimiti na nirūpyate? maunamatrottaram, tasmādyasmin prayoge yacca yāvacca prathamaikāctvena śakyate nirūpayitum, tasya sarvasya dvirvacanaṃ pramātavyamanuṣṭātavyaṃ ca; anyathā tu kriyamāṇaṃ pratītyanuṣṭhānayorubhayorapi śāstrahānimāvahati| tasmātsamudāyasya dvirvacanamiti| na cātrāpi pakṣe'vayavaviṣaye śāstrahāniḥ; avayavātmakatvātsamudāyasya na khalvavayavānāṃ dvirvacanamakṛtvā samudāyaḥ śakyo dvirvaktum, tadyathā-vṛkṣaḥ pracalansahāvayavaiḥ pracalati|
atha kathaṃ papāceti dvirvacanam, yāvatā dhāturevāyaṃ na dhātvavayavaḥ, nāpi prathamaḥ, dvitāyādiṣu hi satsu yasmātpūrvo nāsti sa prathamaḥ? kathantarāṃ ceyāyetyādau yatraiko'jasyeti vyatirikto'nyapadārtho nāsti? tatrāha--papācetyatreti| ekāctvamapīti| apiśabdātprathamatvamapi, ubhayatrāpi dhātuṃ pratyavayavatvam| vyapadeśivadbhāvāditi| mukhya ekājvyapadeśaḥ, avayavavyapadeśaśca yeṣāmasti te vyapadeśino jāgrādiṣu jāgityevamādayaḥ, teṣāmivaiṣāmapi kārya bhavatītyarthaḥ| na cedaṃ vacanam, lokiko'yaṃ nyāyaḥ, loke hi `śilāputrakasya śarīram' iti bahirvastubhede'satyapi bedavyavahāro'vasthābedāśrayo dṛśyate| śilāputrakaḥ krīyamāṇavikrīyamāṇatvādyavasthāyukto yo dṛṣṭastasyedaṃ śarīramiti paridṛśyamānāvasthābhedena vyapadiśyate| papācetyatrāpi paceranantaprayogaviṣayasya samprati prayujyamānaṃ liṭparaṃ rūpamavayava iti śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭum, prathamaśabdo'pi prathamagarbeṇa hatetyādāvasato'pi dvitīyādīn buddhyā parikalpya mukhyaprathamasādharmyādyathā loke ekasminnapi prathama iti prayujyate, tadvadatrāpi| iyāyetyatrāpi itaḥ, yanti, āyan, āgāt, jigamiṣatītyanantaprayogasthenaiko'yamikāra ityanyapadārtho'pi kalpitaḥ. prasiddhyaprasiddhikṛtaśca gauṇamukhyavivekaḥ| evaṃ vidhastu vyavahāro mukhyādapi prasiddha iti na gauṇatvadoṣaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvā--`vyatho liṭi' `bhavateraḥ',`liṭyabhyāssayobhayeṣām', `dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti' ityādikamupapadyate|
