atra `dve' ityasya saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdarūpe sakhyeye `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vacanādekācaḥ prathamasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyāmekasya sthāne dve śabdarupe ityartho bhavati, yathā--`asterbhūḥ' ityādau, tadā `sthāne dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo bhavati| yadā śabdasambandhinī uccāraṇe saṃkhyeye kriyārūpasya śabdasya ca sthānyādeśasambandhāyogādadhyāhṛtoccāraṇakriyāpekṣayaikāca iti karmaṣaṣṭhī--ekāco dve uccāraṇe bhavataḥ, ekācaṃ dvirucyārayedityarthaḥ, tadā `dviḥprayogo dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo bhavati| tatrādye pakṣe `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' iti vacanācchabdataścāntaratamayordvayovidhānād yadyapi ye kecana prāpnuta iti doṣanavatāraḥ| cicīṣatītyatra tu `sanyaṅoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāccis ityasya stāne ciscis iti śabdāntara ādeśe sati tatsthasya sakārasya santve pramāṇābhāvāt `ajjñanagamāṃ sani' iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt; ādeśasya sthānivadbhāva ucyate nādeśāvayavasya syānyavayavavadbhāva iti sthānivadbhāvenāpi santvaṃ nāsti| tasya tu yatra sanmātrasya dvirvacane sthānivadbhāvena santvaṃ so'vakāśaḥ, yathā--iṇaḥ san, īṣiṣatīti|
nanu śabdāntaraprāptyā dvirvacanamanityam, aprāptyā tu dīrghatvamityubhayoḥ paratvāddīrghatve kṛte dvirvakṣyate? iha tarhi hvayateḥ sani hnās ityasya dvirvacanam, samudāyasya samudāya ādeśastatra ādośa etannāsti--iyaṃ prakṛtirayaṃ pratyaya iti, tataśca `hvo'bhyastasya' iti saṃprasāraṇaṃ na syāt, juhāva juhuvaturityādāveva tu syād--yatra hvāmātrasya dvirvacanātsthānivattvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `hvo'bhyastasya' iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau, hvayaterabhyastasya bhaviṣyataḥ prāgeva saṃprasāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvam, `halaḥ' iti `ajjñanagamām' iti vā dīrghatvam, `hvās' ityasya dvirvacanam| iha ca pipakṣati, udvivakṣatītyatra `pūrvatrāsiddhamadvirvacane' iti tarhi āṭiṭad, āśiśad iti ṇilope kṛte'pi `dvirvacane'ci' iti rūpasthānivadbāvācchabdāntaraprāptyabhāvena nityatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacane sati samudāyasya samudāya ādeśastatra samprabhugdhatvātprakṛtipratyayatvaṃ naṣṭam, sa ṇijna bhavatīti ṇilopo na syāt, tasya tu kāraṇetyādiravakāśaḥ| iha ca jighāṃsatīti samudāyasya samudāya ādeśe kṛte hanterabhāvād `abhyāsācca' iti hanteriti kutvaṃ na syāt| tasya tu jaghanitha, jaghantha, ahaṃ kila jaghana, jaghanvānityādiravakāśaḥ, yatrahantimātrasya dvirvacanātsthānivadbhāvaḥ| tadevamādyapakṣasya duṣṭatvād dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-dviḥprayoge dvirvacanamiti| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| kathaṃ punaḥ `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ dviḥprayogapakṣaḥ śakya āśrayitum? tatrāha--āvṛttisaṃkhyā hīti| yadyāvṛtteḥ saṃkhyā vidhīyate, evaṃ sati trirvacanaṃ prāpnoti| na hyādyamuccāraṇamāvṛttiḥ, atastadekam, āvṛttī ca dve iti trirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmādāvṛttikṛtā saṃkhyā| āvṛttisaṃkhyā kasya? uccāraṇasya, āvṛttamuccāraṇaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ| tatra ca sthānyādeśabhāvo na sambhavatītyuktam| atra pakṣe yathāṭiṭadityādau doṣau na bhavati tathā darśayati--tenetyādinā |
nanvatrāpi pakṣe nematuḥ, sehe ityādau natvasatvayoḥ kṛtayordhātorādeśāditvasya dviḥprayoge'pyanivṛtteretvābhyāsalopau na syātām, pakṣāntare tu nādeśādivyapadeśaḥ? alāśrayatvena sthānivattvābhāvātsamudāyādeśatvenādeśāditvābhāvācca na doṣa)ḥ; `liṭi ādeśaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaānnatvasatvayoranaimittikatvād| iha tarhi vebhiditeti vebhidyaśabdāttṛci allopayalopayoḥ kṛtayorupadeṣe ya ekājanudāttaḥ sa evāyamitīṭpratiṣedhaḥ syāt, pakṣāntare tvekājvyamapadeśasyālāśrayatvād bebhidyetyasya dvyacakatvānniṣedhābhāvaḥ? dviḥprayoge'pi na doṣaḥ; pūrvasmādapi vidhau allopasya sthānivadbhāvāt| iha tarhi jarīgṛhiteti grahervaliṭi dīrghatvaṃ syāt, na hyatra sthānivattvam, dīrghavidhau niṣedhāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ekāca upadeśe' ityata `ekāca' ityanuvarttayiṣyate| yadvā-- grahervihitaṃ yadārddhadhātukaṃ tasya ya iṭ tasya dīrgha iti jarīgṛhyaśabdādvihitasya na bhaviṣyati| ica ca siṣecati, yadyapi sicerliḍvihitaḥ; tathāpi dvirvacane kṛte samudāyasyaikā padasaṃjñā na tadavayavasya, secaśabdasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ tadādigrahaṇānivṛtterabhyāsasya varjanāyogāditi `sātpadādyoḥ' iti ṣatvaniṣedhābhāvaḥ| iha tarhi vibhidvānityādau śatakṛtvo'pyuccāraṇe ekāctvaṃ na yāti, kiṃ punardviruccāraṇa iti `vasvekājāddhasām' itīṭprasaṅgaḥ? tanna; uccāraṇabhedādviruddhasaṃkhyāprādurbhāve pūrvasaṃkhyākṛtavyapadeśanivarttanāt| ata evādgrahaṃṇaṃ kṛtaṃ papivānityādāviḍaryam| iha tarhi viśuṣvāpeti, tasyaivārthavato dviruktibhāvamātramityabhyāsasyārthavattvātsupeḥ ṣatvamityatrānarthako visuṣupuriti vakṣyamāṇaṃ vihanyeta? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdasyāśeṣārthāvasāyaḥ, na cātrābhyāsopajanane kaścidartha upajāyate, apāye cāpayāti| nanu sa eva ced dvirucyate, arthapratyayenāpyāvatitavyam, yathā--ahirahirbudhyasvabudhyasveti? kimatropālabhyemahi, na tāvadarthapratyayā āvartante! tadetadevaṃ dṛśyatām-yathā svapnaḥ, suptaḥ, asvapadityādau kvacidavikṛtaḥ, kvacidvikṛtaḥ, kvicidaḍāgamāpekṣo'rthaṃ pratipādayati, tathā suṣvāpetyādāvāvṛtta eva pratipādayatīti ||

ajāderdvitīyasya || 6.1.2 ||
prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yamiti| nanu virodhe samānaphalatve ca bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, yathā--`aṣṭaśriryūpaḥ kartavyo vājapeyasya caturaśriḥ' ityaṣṭāśritvacaturaśritvayortathā naivāraścarurnakhāvapūtānāmiti nakhāvapanena vaituṣyaphalakena tatphalako'vaghāto bādhyate, nakhaiscolūkhalamusalam; yatra tvetadubhayaṃ na bhavati na tatra bādhaḥ, yathā--kṛtkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānām, yathā vā--taddhitatadrājapratyayasaṃjñānām| iha tu na samānaphalatvam; phalasya kasyacidabhāvāt, asti ca sabhbhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt? syādetat--dvayorāsīnayormadhye kasmiścidupaviṣṭe dvitīyastṛtīyo bhavati, tathā prathame dvirukte dvitīyastṛtīyo bhavatītyastyevākṣatrāpsasambhāva iti, syādapyevam, yadi prathamadvirvacanameva niyogataḥ pūrvaṃ syāt, kiñca nātrautpattikasya dvitīyasya dvirvacanamucyate, kiṃ tarhi? dvitīyamātrasya, tataḥ kim? prathame dvirukte yo dvitīyastasya bhaviṣyati|
nanvevamanārambhasamaṃ syāt, kathamaṭeḥ san, prathamasya dvirvacanam, aṭ-aṭ iti sthite halādiḥśeṣaśca prāpnoti, dvitīyadvirvacanaṃ ca, paratvānnityatvācca halādiḥśeṣaḥ, tato dvirvacanam, a-aṭ-aṭ iti sthite halādiśeṣe trayāṇāmakārāṇāmato guṇe pararupatve'ṭiṣatītyetadrūpaṃ syād, akṛte'pi dvirvacane etadeva rūpam, dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpamityetāvad nānārambhasamam, katham? prathamaṃ dvirvacanam, halādiḥśeṣaḥ, a-aṭ iti sthite `sanyataḥ' itītvaṃ ca prāpnoti dvirvacanaṃ ca, dvayornityayoḥ paratvāditvam| nanvitvaṃ sanamabhyāsaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgam, tataḥ kim? antaraṅgam `ato guṇo' iti pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, samānāśraye ca vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya? evaṃ tarhi kṛte'pi pararūpe tarayāntavadbhāvāditvaṃ prāpnoti, akṛte ceti nityatvaṃ paratvaṃ ceti dve tasya prābalyakāraṇe| pararūpasya tvantaraṅgatvamekamevetītvameva tāvad bhavati| sati tu tasmin `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe' itīyaṅ ca prāpnoti dvirvacanaṃ ca, tatra dvirvacanamiyaṅi kṛte yaṅityasya prāpnoti; akṛte tvaṅityasyeti śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam, tena paratvānnityatvācceyaṅi kṛte yaṅśabdasya dvirvacane halādiḥ śeṣaḥ, itvam, iyiyaṭiṣati, oṇeḥ--uvuvoṇiṣatīti bhavati| asati dvitīye dvirvacane--iyaṭiṣati, uvoṇiṣatīti bhavatīti nānārambhasāmyam |
evaṃ tarhi `anabhyāsasya' iti niṣedhādekasmin dvirukte nāparo dvirvaktuṃ śakyata ityasyaivāsambavaḥ| atha vā--sāmānyavihitasya viśeṣavihitaṃ satyapi sambhave bādhakaṃ bhavati, tadyathā--dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇkaḍinyāyeti| odanasekākhyasya phalasya samānatvādatra dadhibādha iti ced? ihāpi tarhyarthābhidhānākhyaṃ phalamekam, arthābhidhānāya hi dviruccāraṇam, taccaikenaiva sādhyate| atha rūpaviśeṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ bhinnam, anyaddhi rūpaṃ prathamasya dvirvacane, anyacca dvitīyasya ? itaratrāpi tṛptiviśeṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ bhidyate, anyā hi dadhnastṛptiranyā hi takrasya, ato nāprāpte tasminnārabhyamāṇatvameva bādhanibandhanam, nāsambhavaḥ, sāmānyaśabdā hi viśeṣaśabdasannidhau tatraivopasaṃhriyante, tato'nyatra vā, yathā--vasiṣṭho brāhmaṇaḥ, brāhmaṇāḥ āyātā vasiṣṭho'pyāyāta iti|
nanu kauṇḍinyasyāpi brāhmaṇatvād dadhi prāptam, iha tu prathamasyocyamānaṃ dvirvacanaṃ dvitīyasya na prāpnotīti kathaṃ yena nāprāptiḥ? na kramo dvitīyasya prāptamiti; kintu dhātusāmānyavihitaṃ prathamadvirvacanamajāderdhātoḥ prāptamiti; tatra dadhitakrākhyaṃ vidheyaṃ bhidyate, iha tu kāryaṃ bhidyate, vidheyaṃ dvirvacanamekamityetāvān viśeṣaḥ| yadvā-tatrāpi dānameva vidheyaṃ tasya tu deyabhedād bhedaḥ, ihāpi kāryibedādbhedaḥ, taddamuktam--prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yaṃ dvitīyadvirvacanamiti| sarvathā prathamadvirvacanaṃ dvitīyadvirvacanena bādhyate| yadyaṃvam, yathābhūtasyaikācaḥ prathamadvirvacanaṃ prāptaṃ tathābhūtasyaivadvitīyadvirvacanaṃ bādhakaṃ syāt, savyañjanasyaitatprāptamiti tena sahavyañkajanānāmapyanāvṛttiprasaṅgaḥ? syādevaṃ yadyajādiṣu prathamasyaikācaḥ kiñcidvihitaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ vā bhavet, iha tu viśeṣasannidhau sāmānyaśabdasya tato'nyatra vṛtterajādiṣu prathamadvirvacanarūpāpratītatvādaprāptyanumānameva bādhaḥ| vyañjanāni ca yadā yasya kārthaṃ tadā tadaṅgānīti dvitīyaikācyantarbhāvāttena saha dvirvacanaṃ kena vāryate! atra ca liṅgam `na ndrāḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ| atheyāya, āretyādau kena dvirvacanam? na tāvadanenādvitīyatvāt, nāpi pūrveṇājādiṣu tasyāpravṛtteḥ, yatraitadapravṛttiḥ, yatra tu dvitīyābhāvādetanna pravarttate na tatra tasya pravṛttirvāryate ? tatrāpi vāryate, ajāderiti sāmānyanirddeśāt| sāmānyanirddeśe hi kvacidapi dvitīyavatyāṃ vyaktau sarvatra bādheta, yathā halādiḥśeṣe vakṣyate--`kvacidapi pravarttamāno halādiḥśeṣaḥ sarvatra nivṛttiṃ karoti' iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ;

jātyopalakṣitā vyaktiḥ prādhānyeneha gṛhyate|
dvitīyavatyāmevedaṃ vyaktau tena pravarttate ||
pravartate ca yatredaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ nivarttate|
jātirhalādiśeṣe tu prādhānyena samāśritā || iti|

guṇe ceti| nityatvātparatvācca| sthānivadbhāvaḥ prāpnotīti| tataśca isa ityasya dvirvacane halādiḥśeṣe ca dīrghatve sati arīṣatīti prasaṅgaḥ| na cātra dvirvacanamanimittamiḍiti| yatra parato dvirvacanamucyate, tadeva tasya nimittamiti bhāvaḥ| ki tarhi kāryīti| `sanyaṅoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇāt| tataḥ kim? ityāha na ceti| tadbhāvabhāvitve satyapi kāyiṇaḥ saptamīnirddeśābāvānna nimittatvaṃ śāstre sthitamityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyamityāha--tathā hīti| guṇavṛddhyoriti| `kṅiti ca' ityatra vṛddherapi pratiṣedhād guṇavṛddhyorityuktam| śayitetyatra na bhavatīti| guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kvacittu--śāyaka ityapi paṭhyate, tadayuktam, aprakṛtitvādatra vṛddheḥ| yathā cottaragranthe guṇagrahaṇameva kṛtam |
teṣāṃ dvitīyasyeti vispaṣṭārthamiti| `tasmādityuktarasya' ityanantarasya dvirīyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, na tṛtīyādeḥ| yadā tu bahuvrīheḥ ṣaṣṭhī-ajādiryasya dhātoriti, tadā sāmarthyādaprathamārthe'pyārambhe tṛtīyāderapi prasaṅgaḥ ||

na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ || 6.1.3 ||
`undī kledane,' `adḍa abhiyoge' dopadhaḥ, ṣṭutvam, `arca pūjāyām', `īkṣa jarśanāṅkanayoḥ' ana prāṇane', `drā kutsāyāṃ gatau', ubjirviṣaye yadvaktavyaṃ tatsarvam `hayavaraṭ' ityatraivoktam |
yakāraparasyeti| yakāraḥ paro yasmādrakārāttasyetyarthaḥ.
vyañjanasyeti| tṛtīyavyañjanasahitasyaikāca ityarthaḥ| tatra ṣakārasya dvirvacanaṃna bhavati| apare punariti| asminpakṣe īrṣyatessani kṛte iti vyākhyeyam, tatsambandhitastṛtīyasyaikāco'sambhavāt| nāmadhātavaḥ-subdhātavaḥ|

pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ || 6.1.4 ||
arthāditi| sāmarthyātpūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ, avayavaścāvayavino bhavati, sa ceha kaścinna nirddiṣṭaḥ, ato'vaśyam `dve' iti atrānuvarttanīyam| na vānuvṛttamapi prathamāntamevāvasthimavayavyapekṣāṃ pūrayitumalamityetatsāmarthyam| asminprakaraṇa iti| anena `sarvasya dve' ityatra prakaraṇe iyaṃ saṃjñā na bhavati, tena tatra halādiśeṣādyabhāvaḥ| yadyevam, `dyutigamijuhotyādīnāṃ dve' ityatra na prāpnoti? karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ| tayoḥ pūrvo'vayava iti| avayavavācibhirdikśabdairyoge pañcamī na bhavati; `tasya pramāmreḍitam' iti liṅgāt| papācetyādau `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ', `sanyataḥ', `dīrgho'kitaḥ', `kuhoścuḥ', `abhyāse carca', `sanvallaghuni', `dīrgho laghoḥ' ityādīni yathāyogamabyāsakāryāṇi ||

ubhe abhyastam || 6.1.5 ||
dve iti varttamāna ityādi| dviruktasamudāyasyaikā'bhyastasaṃjñā yathā syād, dvayordve saṃjñe mā bhūtāmityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam, na tu saṃjñinirdeśārtham| dve ityasyānuvṛttyaiva saṃjñinirdeśasya siddhatvādityarthaḥ| dadatītyādau `adabhyastāt' ityadbhāvaḥ, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' ityākāralopaḥ|
nenijatītyatretyādi| asatyubhe grahaṇe `vṛddhirādaic' ityādau pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptidarśanādihāpi pratyekaṃ syāt, tataśca nenijatītyatra pṛthagādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| na ca `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' ityekasyānudāttatvam; varjanīyaviśeṣāvagamahetoḥ satiśiṣṭatvāderasambhavāt| athāpi syāt, evamapi paryāyaḥ syāt| nanu ca `bhīhnībhṛhumada' iti jñāpakātparasya na bhaviṣyati? pūrvasyāpi tarhi na syāt, pareṇa vyavadhānāt| ucyate ca svaraḥ, tataśca sa eva paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ|
yadi tu saṃyogasamāsādisaṃjñāvadanvarthatvapratipacyarthaṃ mahāsaṃjñākaraṇam, tenānvarthatāvijñāne samudāyasyaiva saṃjñetyucyate, tadobhegrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| nanu yatrobhe śrūyete tatra yathā syāt, anyatarābhāve mā bhūd-ityevamarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ karttavyam; anyathā ṛdherāpaśca `sanīvanta' iti iḍabhāvapakṣe paratvāt pratipadavihitatvācca `āpjñapyṛdhāmīt' itītve `na ndrāḥ' iti pratiṣedhādrephavarjaṃ dvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacane kṛte`atra lopo'bhyāsasya' ityataḥ prāgantaraṅgatvādabhyastasaṃjñā syāt| sā ca pratyekam, samudāyasya vā? tatra pratyekapakṣe'bhyāsalope'pi parasya na nivartteta| samudāyapakṣe'pi pūrva saṃjñā samudāye pravṛttā; paścādekadeśanivṛttāvapyavaśiṣṭe'vatiṣṭheta| yatheyasuna īkāre lupte'pi tadvitasaṃjñā--bhūyānityatra| satyāṃ ca saṃjñāyām--īpsanti, aipsan, īrtsanti, airtsan, ityatrādbhāvajusabhāvanumpratipedhāḥ syuḥ, ataḥ śrūyamāṇapratipattyarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ karttavyam? tanna; pratīṣiṣatītyādivatsiddheḥ| tathā hi-`ajāderdvitīyasya' iti sani dvirukte śrūyamāṇayorubhyoḥ satyāmapyabhyastasaṃjñāyāmadbhāvādayo na bhavanti| yathā ca putrīyaṣiṣantītyādau `yatheṣṭaṃ nāmadhātūnām' iti sani dvirukte, tadvadatrāpi na bhaviṣyati| atra hi īpsa-jhi, īrtsa-jhīti sthite'dbāvātprāgnityatvācchap, adbhāvo hi śapi kṛte tena vyavadhānānna prāpnotītyanityaḥ tataḥ `jño'ntaḥ' prāpnoti, pūrveṇa sahaikādeśaśca, paratvādantādeśaḥ| nitya ekādeśaḥ-kṛte'pyantādeśe prāpnoti, akṛtepi| antādeśastvanityaḥ, kṛte ekādeśe tasyāntavadbhāvādabhyastagrahaṇena grahaṇādadbhāvena bādhyate| yasya ca nimittaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihanyate tadanityam| antaraṅgastarhye kādeśaḥ; varṇāśrayatvāt| antādeśastvāṅgatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, samānāśraye ca `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ'; antādeśo'pyantaraṅgaḥ, vakṣyati hi-āyannādiṣūpadeśivadvacanamiti| tadevamubhayorapyantaraṅgayornityayośca paratvādantādeśaḥ, tato jhakārābhāvādalāśrayatvena sthānivadbhāvābhāvāccādādeśo na bhavati|
astu vā pūrvamekādeśaḥ evamapi `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' ityatra `anataḥ' ityasya `adabhyastāt' iti pūrveṇāpi sambandhātpūrvasmādapi vidhāvekādeśasya sthānivattvādvā'dbhāvo na bhaviṣyati| evamaipsannityatrāpi, īpsa-jhi iti sthite śap ca prāpnoti, jusbhāvaśca, nityatvācchapi kṛte tena vyavadhānānna jusbhāvaḥ| na ca pūrveṇa sahaikādeśe kṛte tasyāntadbhāvātpunarjusprasaṅgaḥ, pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivattvāt| īpsannityatrāpi laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, īpsa-śatṛ iti sthite sārvadhātukamātrāpekṣatvādantaraṅgatvācchapi kṛte tatra sano'kāreṇāto guṇe pararūpe paścātsarvanāmasthāne cotpanne numaḥ prasaktasya tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ śatrabhyastayorvyapavargābhāvādubhayavarṇāśrayatvenāntādivadbhāvābhāvacca niṣedhābhāvaḥ| evaṃ pratīṣiṣantītyādāvapi| cikīrṣantītyādau tu yatra sano'kāro na dvirucyate, tatra tenaiva vyavadhānādadbhāvādyabhāvaḥ ||

jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ || 6.1.6 ||
atra jakṣeḥ śtipi `rudādibyaḥ sārvadhātuke' itīṭi kṛte jakṣitiriti bhavati, sa ādiryaṣāṃ te jakṣityādaya iti vijñāyamāne vevyateḥ saptamasya na syāt, lāghavārthamasandehārthaṃ ca hakaiva nirddeṣṭavyaṃ syāt-jakṣyādaya iti| tasmānnāyamuktavigrahiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `jakṣa' iti pṛthak padamityāha-jakṣa ityayaṃ dhāturityādayaḥ ṣaḍiti| itinānantaro jakṣirnirddiśyate| ādiśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ, atadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ| seyamiti| yeyamuktaprakārā, seyamityarthaḥ|
eṣa svara iti| anyathā ṅittvāllasārvadhātukānudāttatvaṃ dhātusvaraḥ, yaṇādeśe `udāttasvaritayoḥ' iti svaritatvaṃ prasajyate| śatari vyatyayena sampādita iti| ṅittvātparasmaipadāsambhavādvyatyayaḥ|
ṣaḍgrahaṇamanarthakam, santvāgaṇāntā jakṣityādayaḥ| vevīṅo'pi pare ye paṭhyante teṣāṃ kasmānna bhavati? atraivaṃ gaṇapāṭhaḥ, vevīṅo'nantaram `ṣasa svapne, vaśa kāntau, carkarītaṃ ca, hnuṅ apanayane' iti, kecidvevīṅo'nantaram `āṅaḥ śasu' iti paṭhanti, `ṣasti svapne' iti ca| tatrāśāso na viśeṣaḥ; abhyastakāryāṇi bhūyiṣṭhāni parasmaipadiṣu, ātmanepadī cāyam| abhyastasvare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ, katham? anabhyaste'pi tasminnanudāttetaḥ paraṃ lasārvadhātukamanudāttaṃ dhātusvaraśca, carkarītamabyastameva, ṣasaṣastī chāndasau, vaśirapi, tasyāpi bhāṣāyāṃ na prayogassādhuḥ--bāṣyavārttikakārau cetpramāṇam| hnuṅo'pi ṅittvātparasmaipadāsambhavaḥ| svarastarhi prāpnoti, `aṅnviṅoḥ' iti pratiṣedhavacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, yadi syāt, tarhyapahnavata ityādāvabhyastasvare sati lasārvadhātukasya bhavitavyameva nighāteneti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmātpratyayasvaro yathā syatāt, lasārvadhātukānudāttatvaṃ mā būdityahanviṅoriti pratiṣedho'rthavān bhavatīti pratiṣedhasāmarthyātpratyayasvaraḥ eva bhaviṣyati, nābhyastarasvaraḥ| nanu cābhyastasvaro'jādau vidhīyate, tataḥ kim? ajādau tasminpravṛtte'pi hrute, ṣehnu, hnuve-ityatra tasyāpravṛttau yadyahnviṅoriti pratiṣedho na kriyate, tato dhātusvareṇādyudāttaṃ padaṃ syāt| antodāttaṃ yathā syāditi pratiṣedhaḥ kriyeta| tadevaṃ sati prayojane na pratiṣedhasāmarthyādabyastasvaraṃ bādhitvā pratyayasvaraḥ sidhyati| evaṃ tarhi `abhyastānāmādiḥ' ityatrāpyahnviṅorityanuvarttiṣyate, tadevaṃ nārthaḥ ṣaḍgrahaṇena| taduktam--aparigaṇanaṃ vā gaṇāntatvāt ||

tujādīnāṃ dīrghā'bhyāsasya || 6.1.7 ||
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum, katham? chāndasametaddīrghatvaṃ chandasi ca dīrghatvaṃ na śakyaṃ parigaṇayitum, anyeṣāmapi darśanāt pūruṣaḥ, nāraka iti| anekājaṅgatvācca yeṣāṃ cārabhyacate teṣāmeva tasminprayoge na dṛśyate--māmahānaḥ, mamahāna iti vā ||

liṭi dhātoranabhyāsasya || 6.1.8 ||
dhātoriti kimiti| liṭi parato'nyo na sambhavati; tasya dhātoreva vidhānāditi praśnaḥ| viśrṛṇvire iti| `chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvāt `śruvaḥ śrṛ ca' iti śnupratyayaḥ, śrṛbhāvaśca| atra vikaraṇāntasya samudāyasya liṭparasyādhātutvāttadīyasya prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanābhāvaḥ| īkṣāñcakre ityādau tvāmantasya liṭaparatvaṃ nāsti; `āmaḥ' iti lukā kuptatvāditi dvirvacanābhāvaḥ| siddhaḥ| anabhyāsasyeti kimiti| na tāvad nunāva, papācetyādau tatraiva liṭi punardvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; sakṛtpravṛttyā lakṣaṇasya caritārthatvāt, anavasthāpātācca| yastu pratyayāntare sanādau sābhyāsaḥ, na tasya liṭi sambhavaḥ; tato hi `kāspratyayād' ityāmā bhavitavyamiti praśanaḥ| nonāveti| `amantre' iti pratiṣedhādatrāmabhāvaḥ| sammimikṣuriti| sampūrvānmiheḥ sani `ho ḍhaḥ',`ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' liṭ, jherus, atolopaḥ| dvivacanaprakaraṇa iti| prakaraṇagrahaṇānna kevalaṃ sarva dvirvacanaṃ chandasi vikalpyate| evaṃ ca `dhātoḥ', `anabhyāsasya' ityubhayamuttarārtham| etasmādeva vikalpādvikaraṇāntasābhyāsayorna bhaviṣyati ||

sanyaṅoḥ || 6.1.9 ||
ṣaṣṭhyantametaditi| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā tadantasya dvirvacanam, na tu sanyaṅoreva, yadāha--sanantasya ceti| saptamīpakṣe tu sanyaṅoḥ parataḥ pūrvasya dhātordvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyayamarthaḥ syāt, tataśca sanbhaktasyeṭo dvirvacanaṃ na syāt--aṭiṭiṣati, aśiśiṣatītyādau; tathā pratīṣiṣatītyādau sano na syāt| evamarāryata ityādau yaṅaḥ, tathā saptamyāmiṣṭāyāṃ pūrveṇāpareṇa vā sahaikameva yogaṃ kuryāt|
jugupsiṣata iti| gupe `guptijkidbhayaḥ san' tatra sani dvirvacanam, punaricchāsan, tatrākṛtatvātpunardvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| lolūyiṣate iti| atrāpi yaṅidvirvacanam, na tu sanīti dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ|
bhāgavṛttikārastāvāha--``pūrvasūtre `dhātoranabhyāsasya' iti dvayamapi pratyākhyāya bhāṣyakāreṇoktam---`tiṣṭhatu tāvatsāṃnyāsikaṃ dhātugrahaṇam' iti, uttarārthamiti bhāvaḥ| anabhyāsagrahaṇasya tu na kiñcitprayojanamuktam, tataścottarārthamapi tanna bhavatīti bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyo lakṣyate| tenātra bhavitavyameva dvirvacanena iti ||

ślau || 6.1.10 ||
ślau parata iti| varṇānāmapi yugapadavasthānābhāvād buddhiparikalpitaṃ porvāparyam, taccābhāvarūpeṇa ślunāpyupapadyat iti bhāvaḥ| anabyāsasyeti| adhīkāramātraiṇaitaduktam, na tu ślau sābhyāso bhavati| evaṃ dvitīyasya cetyatra draṣṭavyam ||

caṅi || 6.1.11 ||
eṣāṃ kāryāṇāṃ pravṛttikrama iti| etacca `acaḥ parasmin' ityatropapāditam, tata evāvadhātavyam| na kevalaṃ nyāpyatvādayaṃ krama āśrīyate, kintu prayojanamapyananyathāsiddhamastītyāha--yathā hīti| hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvānna pratiṣidhyata iti| `hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvātpratiṣidhyate' iti yattanma bhavati, sthānivadbhāvābhāvādityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarasmin kāryakrame sati sathānivadbhāvo na bhavati? ityata āha--anādiṣṭāca iti| [karaṇe hetau?]| `acaḥ parasmin' ityatra yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvo bhavatīti siddhāntaḥ sthāpitaḥ| na cāsmin krame satyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo'bhyāso bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? ādiṣṭādeva; hrasvatve kṛte'bhyāsopajananāt| tena tasya vidhau karttavye h‌rasvasta sthānivadbhāvo na bhavatīti laghutvānivṛtteḥ sanvadbhāvo na vyāhanyeta| yadi tu dvirvacane kṛte hrasvaḥ kriyate, tarhyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ syāt, tataśca tasya sthāvanivadbhāvaḥ syādeva vidhau, tataśca dīrghatvāllaghusaṃjñāyā abhāvātsanvadbhāvo na syāt| kva tarhi syād? aśīśamadityādau| atra hi ṇāveva ṇitāṃ hrasvo vidhīyate| yadi tarhyayaṃ kāryakramaḥ, āṭiṭadityādau dvitīyasyaikācaṣṭiśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti ? atrāha--āṭiṭadityādi|
`ślucaṅoḥ' ityekayoga eva karttavye yogavibhāgo vaicitryārthaḥ ||

dāśvānsāhvānmīḍhavāṃśca || 6.1.12 ||
dāśvādīnāṃ prācuryeṇa chandasi prayogadarśanācchāndasametatsūtramiti manyamānaṃ pratyāha--aviśeṣeṇeti| viśeṣānupādānāditi bhāvaḥ| parasmaipadamiti| bhauvādikasyātmanepaditvāt, caurādikasya tu `ā dhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāvapakṣe dīrghatvamaniṭtvaṃ ca nipātyata ityanye| mīḍhvastokāyeti| `matuvasoḥ' iti numo rutvam|
kiṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam? ityāha--halādiśeṣe hīti| carācara iti| dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyād hrasvo na bhavati|
ṇilukceti| `ṇoraniṭi' iti ṇilope siddhe punarvacanaṃ prat.yayalakṣaṇena punarvṛddhirmā bhūditi| pāṭūpaṭa iti| pūrvavaddhalādiśeṣābhāvo hrasvatvābhāvaśca| dīrghoccāraṇādeva `abyāsasyānaci' iti vacanādvā ubhayatrāpi halādiśeṣābhāvaḥ. abhyāsasya yaducyate tadaci na bhavatītyarthaḥ ||

ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ putrapatyostatpuruṣe || 6.1.13 ||
`igyaṇaḥ saṃprasāraṇam' ityatroktam--`vākyārthaḥ saṃjñī varṇaśca' iti, tatra vidhau vākyārtha upatiṣṭhate iti tadāśrayeṇā''ha--yaṇaḥ sthāna igbhavatītyartha iti|
tadantāt ṣyaṅiti| ṣyaṅvidhāvādeśapakṣasya sthitvāllyablopa eṣā pañcamī, tadantamāśrityetyarthaḥ| atadguṇasaṃvijñāne'tra bahuvrīhiḥ, aṇ pratyayo'ntaḥ samīpo yasya kārīṣagandhestasmātparaḥ ṣyaṅityarthaḥ| pratyayapakṣa eva vāmanācāryasya tatrābhimataḥ| tathā ca `ye ca taddhite' ityatra vakṣyati--`aṇiñantādvā paraḥ ṣyaṅ pratyaya eṣitavyaḥ' iti|
ibhamarhatītībhyā, `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' iha kārīṣagandhyāmatikrāntasya putro'tikārīṣagandhyāputra iti pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā samudāyasyāṣyaṅantatve'pi yo'traṣyaṅntastasya prasaṅgaḥ| tathā putrasya kulaṃ putrakulam, kārīṣagandhyāputrakulamiti varṇagrahaṇe tadādividhivijñānādiha ca tadabhāvāttadādividhyabhāve'pi putrapatyānantaryāśrayaṃ saṃgrasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti| nātra tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati--kārīṣagandhīputrakulamiti| bhavati ca yadaitadvākyaṃ bhavati--kārīṣagandhāyāḥ putraḥ kārīṣagandhīputrastasya kulaṃ kārīṣagandhīputrakulamiti| na sidhyatīti codyārthaḥ| tathā-atikārīṣagandhyāputrakulamityādāvapi sarvatra putrapatyoḥ ṣyaṅntasya cānantaryamāśritya samprasāraṇaprasaṅgaḥ|
syādetat--yathā vṛkṣe śākheti vṛkṣaḥ śākhāyā avayavī pratīyate, tathehāpi, ṣyaṅntasya putrapatyośca tatpuruṣaḥ, tatra pratyāsattyā yasya tatpuruṣasya pyaṅnto'vayavastasyaiva putrapatī iti gamyate, iha na tatheti? evamapyavayavāvayavasya samudāyāvayavatvādastyeva prasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; putrapatyoriti saptatīnirddeśāt ṣyaṅantasya putrapatyośca paurvāparyaṃ pratīyate, pūrvoktena nyāyena tatpuruṣāvayavatvaṃ ca| tatpuruṣaśca paurvāparyāvasthitāvayavadvayātmakaḥ| tadiha tatpuruṣāvayavayoḥ paurvāparyoṇāvasthitayoridaṃ bhavatītyukte yayoḥ sa tatpuru,stāvetāviti gamyate, ṣyaṅntasya pūrvapadasya putrapatyoruttarapadayorityarthaḥ. samāse ca yasāmācca pūrvaṃ nāsti tatpūrvapadam, yasmācca paraṃ nāsti taduttarapadam,---yat ṣyaṅntaṃ na tatpūrvapadam, yaccottarapadaṃ na tatputrapatyātmakam, yacca putrapatyātmakaṃ na taduttarapadamiti nāsti prasaṅgaḥ. ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti--paramakārīṣagandhīputra iti? tatrāha---pyaṅ iti strīpratyayagrahaṇamiti| `striyām' iti prakṛtya vihitatvātsthānivadbhāvena svayameva vā pratyayatvācca strīpratyayatvam| yadi strīpratyayagrahaṇam, tataḥ kim? ityata āha-teneti|
apradhānam-upasarjanam| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yatrārthe strīpratyayo vihitaḥ sa yāvati tadante prādhānyenocyate tāvānsamudāyastadantatayā grāhyaḥ| apradhāne ca yato vihitastadādike ca tadante ca na bhavati| yadā tatpuruṣākṣiptamuttarapadaṃ putrapatibhyāṃ viśeṣyate tadā tadante prasaṅgaḥ, iha tūttarapadena putrapatī viśeṣyete iti bhāvaḥ|
nirdiśyamānasyeti| etacca `ṣaṣṭhīsthāne yogā' ityatra vyākhyātam| `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' iti tu paribhāṣā prayojanābāvānnāśritā|
samprasāraṇagrahaṇamuttarārtham| iha tvīśāpi siddham, śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ| tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--samprasāraṇasyeti yogavibhāgena dīrghatvaṃ na vidheyaṃ bhavati, tadevottarārthatvaṃ darśayati--samprasāraṇamiti cetyādi|
pūrvaṃ yatra ṣyaṅantaṃ padamuparitanaṃ putrapatyātmakaṃ syād
dṛṣṭvā tatra ṣyaṅ tatpuruṣa iha yaṇa sthāna igbhāvanīyaḥ|
yatrārthe ṣyaṅ sa yāvatyapi sati na guṇo'sāviheṣṭastadante
yatretyarthaḥ pradhāno na bhavati sa yataḥ ṣyaṅ tadādyeva tatra ||

bandhuni bahuvrīhau || 6.1.14 ||
śabdarupāpekṣayeti| `bandhu' ityetasmin śabdarupamityevaṃ śabdarupamapekṣya napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| kimarthamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityata āha--puṃlliṅgābhidheyastvayamiti| yo'yamasminsūtre bandhuśabda upāttaḥ sa ityarthaḥ| kuta etat? nupuṃsakaliṅgasyāpi vidyamānatvāt, badhyate'smin jātiriti bandhu-dravyam, `jātyantāccha bandhuni' iti| yadyevam, tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣadoṣaḥ; pariputrasāhacaryājjātivacana eva grahīṣyate|

vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti || 6.1.15 ||
ādiśabdo'yaṃ yajinaiva sambadhyate, na vacyādibhiḥ pratyekam; svapigrahaṇāt| anyathā `vaca paribhāṣaṇe', `vida jñāne', `asabhuvi', `mṛjūṣ śuddhau', `rūdir aśruvivacaneḥ', `ñiṣvap śaye'--ityevaṃ gaṇapāṭhād vacyādigrahaṇenaiva svapādīnāmapi grahaṇasiddheḥ pṛthak svapādigrahaṇam̐ na kuryāt| āgaṇāntā iti| gaṇasyānto gaṇāntaḥ, āgatā gaṇaāntamāgaṇantāḥ| ukta iti| `coḥ kuḥ' iṣṭa iti| vraścāditvātṣaḥ| ūḍha iti| `ho ḍhaḥ', `jhaṣasthotardhodhaḥ',ṣṭutvam, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ'| uṣita iti| `vasatikṣudhoriṭ', `śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam| saṃvītadau `halaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| śūna iti| `oditaśca' iti niṣṭānatvam|
dhātoḥka svarūpagrahaṇa iti| yatra dhātuḥ svarūpeṇopādīyate, na dhātuśabdena tatra tatpratyaye dhātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ pratyayastatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| etacca `bhrauṇahatya' iti tattvanipātanena jñāpayiṣyate| vācyati, vācikamiti| atra tu yadyapi kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati, tathāpi dhātorityevaṃ pratyayasyāvidhānātsamprasāraṇābhāvaḥ ||

grahijyāvayivyadhivaṣṭivicativṛścatipṛcchatibhṛjjatīnāṃ ṅiti ca || 6.1.16 ||
gṛhītaḥ, yadyapi prathamaṃ ṅiti pratyaye parataḥ samprasāraṇaṃ cakārātkiti ceti kramo vyākyātaḥ, tathāpyanāsthayā prathamaṃ kityudāhṛtam| vijādeśo gṛhyata iti| pūrvaparasāhacaryādyasya vapeḥ parasmaipadasaṃbhavastasya grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam, yastu `aya vaca gatau' iti vayiḥ, so'nudāttedātmanepadī| yadyevamiti| veñādeśasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ| yajādiṣu veñ paṭhyata iti| tataśca pūrveṇaiva samprasāraṇaṃ siddhimiti bhāvaḥ| naivaṃ śakyamiti| vijñātumiti śeṣaḥ| nānayopapattyā vayigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātumityarthaḥ| evaṃ pratiṣedho'pi prāpnotīti| nātrāviśabdena samuccaya ucyate, kiṃ tarhi? yathā sthānivadbhāvādvidhiḥ prāpyate, tathā pratipedho'pi prāpnoti, tatrāpi stānivadbhāvasya tulyatvāt iti hetostulyatvamapiśabdena dyotyate, tena pratiṣedha eva bhavedityarthaḥ| uṣṭa iti| tasantam| vyadhirdivādiḥ, vyaciprabhṛtayastudādayaḥ| vṛkṇa iti| `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, pūrvavanniṣṭhānatvam| varīvṛścyata ityādau `rīgṛtvataḥ' iti rīgbhāvaḥ ||

liṭyabyāsasyobhayeṣām || 6.1.17 ||
vivyatheti| `vyaceḥ kuṭāditvamanasīti vaktavyam' ityatra paryudāsavṛttyāspratyayasadṛśasya kṛto grahaṇādiha ṅitvābhāvāddhātoḥ samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ|
`vṛścatipṛcacatibhṛjjatīnāmaviseṣaḥ' iti vārttikam, tad vṛścativiṣaye bhāṣyakāreṇa dūṣitam--`yaducyate vṛścateraviśeṣaḥ' ityādi| tatra vāttikakārasyābhiprāyamāha--vṛścateriti| asati sūtre yadrūpaṃ tadeva satītyabhiprayeṇa vāttikakāreṇaitaduktamityarthaḥ. bhāṣyakārasyābhiprāyamāha--yogārambhe satīti| rephasya samprasāraṇe satyasati vā nāsti viśeṣa iti vārttikakāreṇoktamityadhyāropyabhāṣyakāreṇoktamityartha| akidartamidamiti| kiti katham? ityata āha--kiti hīti|
adhikārādeviti| nātra sāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? apekṣālakṣaṇa, tena pūrvasūtre vacyādeḥ sambandho nāśaṅkanīyaḥ| yogavibhāgasāmarthyādvā pūrvasūtre teṣāmasambandhaḥ|
halādiḥśeṣamapi bādhitveti| anyathā paratvāddhalādiḥśeṣaḥ syāt| samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditi| punarvidhānamubhayepāṃgrahaṇādbhavati tadvādhakabādhanārthamiti bhāvaḥ ||

śvāpeścaṅi || 6.1.18 ||
svāperṇyantasya grahaṇamiti| āpranotestu supūrvasya grahaṇaṃ na aṇyantasya; caṅo'sambhavāt| ṇyantasyāpi na bhavati; `dhātoḥ' ityadhikārāt| svāpyata iti| karmaṇi laṭ, ṇilopaḥ|
svāpita iti| `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' iti ṇilāpaḥ
nanu ca `grahijyā' ityādisūtrānṅitītyanuvarttiṣyate, na cānyaḥ svāperṅidasti, yaṅ tāvadanekāctvannāsti, apitsārvadhātukaṃ tu vikaraṇairvyavahitam, aṅādayastvavihitā eva? tatrāha--ṅitīti kevalamityādi| nanu kitītyetaccānukṛṣṭaṃ pūrvasūtra iti nehānuvartiṣyate, kimarthaṃ durjñānaṃ ṅidgrahaṇam? ṅidgrahaṇamapi tarhi pūrvasūtre nānuvartate; liṭo ṅito'sambhavāditi tasyehānuvṛttirdurvijñānā ||

svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅi || 6.1.19 ||
svapnagiti| `svapitṛṣornajiṅ' ||

cāyaḥ kī || 6.1.21 ||
kīti dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakam, hrasvādeśe'pi `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghasya siddhatvāt? tatrāha--dīrghāccāraṇamityādi| kathaṃ punaryaṅcyamāna ādeśo yaṅluki syāt? pratyayalakṣaṇena| `na lumatāṅgasya'? evaṃ tarhi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāllukyapi bhaviṣyati, pūrvasūtravihitaṃ tu prasāraṇaṃ yaṅluki na bhavatyeva| na ca `samprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca kāryaṃ balavat' iti prāgeva lukaḥ samprasāraṇam; pratyāthyātatvādasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ| tathā ca pūrvatrobhayeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ kṛtam, anayatā'nayaiva paribhāṣayā halādiśeṣātprageva samprasāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| sāsvapīti, sāsvapti| sāsvaptaḥ, sāśvapītaḥ| vāvyeti, vāvyāti ||

styaḥ prapūrvasya || 6.1.23 ||
dvayorapyetayoriti| dvayorapi syārupasya lākṣaṇikatvāt| samprasāraṇe kṛte iti| tasyāsiddhatvātprāgeva samprasāraṇam |
prastya ityeva siddha iti| yathā `prastyo|nyatarasyām' ityatra| na caivamucyamāne praśabdasyāpi yo rephastasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ; dhātorityadhikārāt| prasaṃstīta iti| `prastyo'nyatarasyām' iti matvamatra na bhavatyeva| tatkathamiti| kathamayamarthaḥ śabdenābhihito bhavatīti praśnaḥ| ṣaṭhyarthe bahuvrīhiriti| pūrvaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāt, yathā--pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭyāviti| prapūrvasyeti styāśabdāpekṣayāvayavaṣṣṭhī, stya ityeṣāpi yaṇavayavāpekṣyā ṣaṣṭhī| yathā punarayamarthaḥka prakṛtopayogī tathā darśayati--tatreti ||

dravamūrtisparśayoḥ syaḥ || 6.1.24 ||
dravakāṭhinya iti| dravāvastāyā uttarāvasthāviśeṣaḥ-kāṭhinyam| sparśe ceti| rūpādisahacarito guṇaḥ-spaśaḥ|
śīto vāyuriti| kathaṃ punaḥ sparsamātrābhidhāyinaḥka śītaśabdasya tadvaddravyavācinā vāyuśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? tatrāha--guṇāmātra ityādi| śuklādiśabdavaditi bhāvaḥ ||

vibhāṣā'bhyavapūrvasya || 6.1.25 ||
seyamubhayatra vibhāṣeti| dravamūrtiviṣaye pūrveṇa prāpte'nyatrāprāpte| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `vibhāṣābyavābhyām' ityevocyeta, tatrāhapūrvagrahaṇasyetyādi| kriyamāṇe'pi pūrvagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavati? ityāha--na kileti| kilaśabdasūcitāmaruci darśayati-yo'treti| mā bhūnmahāsamudāyo'bhyavapūrvaḥ, avāntarasamudāyastvabhyavapūrvo'pyasti, tadāśrayo vikalpaḥ prāpnoti| yatnāntaramāstheyamiti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣārthamāśrayaṇīyamityarthaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇasya cānyatprayojanaṃ vaktavyamiti| tatpunarabhisaṃśīnam, abhisaṃśyānam, avasaṃśīnam, avasaṃśyānamityatrāpi vikalpapravṛttireva| tacca pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe yathā labhyate tathā `styaḥ prapūrvasya' ityatra vyākhyātam ||

śrṛtaṃ pāke || 6.1.27 ||
śrā pāka ityasya dhātoriti| `śrā pāke' ityadādau paṭhyate, `śrau pāke' iti curādau, ghaṭādiṣvapi mittvārthaḥ `śrā pāke' iti paṭhyate, tatreha sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam| śrāyaterapi kṛtātvasyaitadrapaṃ bhavati, nipātanasāmarthyācca lakṣaṇapratipadaktaparibhāṣā nāśrīyate| ṇyantasya cāṇyantasya ceti| tathā coktam--`śrāśrapyoḥ śrṛbhāvo nipātyate' iti| ata eva prakṛtaṃ samprasāraṇameva na vihatam, śraperapi śrṛtamityeva yathā syāditi|
yadi vibhāṣetyatadatrāvarttate, kṣīrahaviṣoranyatra ca vikalpaḥ prāpnoti sarvatra, tatrāha--vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyamiti| yadā tvityādi| prayojakavyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādilakṣaṇa prayojakaśabdenoktaḥ, tasya ca bāhyatvaṃ bahirbhūtaṇijvyāpyatvāt| tadāpi neṣyata iti| tathā coktam--śrapeḥ śrṛtamanyatra hetoriti| śrapitaṃ kṣīraṃ devadattena| prayojakavyāpāreṇāpyamānasyāpi prayojyasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati, `gatibuddhipratyavasāna' iti niyamāt| kathaṃ punarṇyantasya nipātanaṃ labhyate, yāvatā pāka ityucyate, ṇyantena ca pācanābhidhīyate, na pākaḥ; atha pācanāyāmapi guṇabhūtaḥ pākaḥ pratīyate, tadāśrayaṃ nipātanaṃ syacāt? yadyevam, dvitīye'pi ṇici prasaṅgaḥ| na hi tatra pāko guṇabhūto na gamyate|
athaṃ tatra guṇabhūtatvādeva pradhānabhūte pāke caritārthaṃ nipātanaṃ na bhaviṣyatī tyucyeta ? prathame'pi na syād, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ| tamāha-śrātirayamityādi| athamabhiprāyaḥ--dvividhaḥ pākaḥ--viklittilakṣaṇaḥ, vikledanālakṣaṇaśca;, ubhayatrāpi paceḥ prayogadarśanāt, pacyate odanaḥ svayameva, pacatyodanaṃ devadatta iti| śrātiścāyaṃ yadyapi `pāke' ityaviśeṣeṇa paṭhyate, tathāpi karmakartṛviṣayasya pacerarthevarttete| sa ṇyanto'pi prākṛtacaṃ prakṛtau bhavaṃ ṇijrahitapacivācyaṃ pacyarthamāha| so'pi pāka eva, na pācayaterarthaḥ, yathā--siddhayatyodanaḥ, sādhayatyodanamiti| tatra yadā śrāteḥ kta ****tpadyate, tadā'karmakatvātkarttari bhavati--śrṛtaṃ kṣīramiti, śrapestu karmaṇai--śrṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ devadattena| dvitīye tu ṇici pācayitṛvyāpāraḥ pācanālakṣaṇaḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyate, na tu pāka iti nipātanābhāva iti| `śrapeḥ śrṛtvamanyatra hetoḥ' iti vārttike `śrāśrapyoḥ śrṛbhāvo nipātyate' iti pūrvamuktatvādādyaprakṛtalakṣaṇaprayojakavyāpārāṅgīkaraṇasāmarthyātpācayitṛlakṣaṇaprayojakavyāpāraniṣedho vijñeyaḥ ||
pāko'yaṃ pākyapaktyoradvividha iha sa viklittivikledanātmā
śrātirvaktyekamanyaṃ śrapayatirubhayatraubhayokteḥ śrṛbhāvaḥ|
sve sve vācye śrapestu prasajati sati vā pācane na dvitīye
nityaṃ kṣīre śṛbhāvo haviṣi ca na tu pākyeṣu cārthāntareṣu ||

pyāyaḥ pī || 6.1.28 ||
andhuḥ kūpaḥ ||

liḍyaṅośca || 6.1.29 ||
vibhāṣeti nivṛttamiti| uttarasūtre punarvibāṣāgrahaṇāt| pyāyaḥ pītyetaccakāreṇānukṛṣyate iti| asati cakāre prakaraṇinaḥ samprasāraṇasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syād, yathottaratra| paratvātpībhāve kṛte iti| nanu dvayoḥ sāvakāśayoḥ paratvaṃ bhavati, anavakāśaśca pībhāvaḥ, evaṃ tarhi paratvādutkṛṣṭatvādanavakāśatvāditi bhāvaḥ| punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāditi| atrāpi `vipratiṣedhe param' ityatra yaduktaṃ na tadvivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi? dvirvacanasya punaḥ prasaṅgo'stīti kṛtvetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhyanavakāśaḥ pībhāvo nāprāpte dvirvacana ārabhyamāṇena tena dvirvacanasya bādhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; parasparasannidhau bādhyabādhakabāvaḥ| iha tu samprasāraṇaprakaraṇena dvirvacanaprakaraṇaṃ vicchinnam| ata eva vakṣyate--`digyādeśena dvitvabādhanamitaṣyate' iti||

vibhāṣā śveḥ || 6.1.30 ||
śuśāveti| parāvapi vṛddhyāyādeśau bādhitvā nityatvāt samprasāraṇamantaraṅgatvātpūrvatvam| śuśuvaturiti| atrāpi paratvātprāpamiyaṅaṃ bādhitvā nityatvātsamprasāraṇam| tatra kṛte paramapi `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇaṃ bādhitvāntaraṅgatvātpūrvatvam, paścāduvaṅādeśaḥ| anyatreti| pitsu vacaneṣu| tatra sarvatra vikalpa iti| pitsu tāvadvikalpyate; pratiṣedhakābhāvāt| kitsvapi paratvādayaṃ vikalpaḥ| yajādilakṣaṇasyāvakāśaḥ--śūnaḥ, śūnavān, asyāvakāśaḥ pidvavacanāni; kiti liṭyubhayaprasaṃge paratvādayaṃ vikalpaḥ| abyāsasyāpi na bhavatīti| kimiti na bhavati? na tāvat paratvādanena kalpena bādhaḥ, dhātorayaṃ vikalpaḥ, nābhyāsasya| kiñca--ubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇasya sa eva vidhiryathā syāditi| tasmādvacanamevātra śaraṇam| yadāha--`sverliṭyabhyāsalakṣaṇapratiṣedhaḥ' iti ||

ṇau ca saṃścaṅoḥ || 6.1.31 ||
`ṇau' itika śvayatyapekṣayā parasptamī, `saṃścaṅoḥ' iti ṇyapekṣayā| tadāha--sanpare caṅpare ca ṇau parata iti| antaraṅgamapīti| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu ṇijmātrāpekṣatvāt| vṛddhyādikamiti| ādiśabdenāyādeśo gṛhyate, yadā tu `saṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃprasāraṇāśrayaṃ ca kāryaṃ balīyaḥ' iti paribhāṣā prayojanābāvātpratyākhyātā, tadā `ṇau ca saṃkhcaṅorviṣayabhūtayoḥ' iti| oḥ puyaṇjītyādi| yathā caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā `dvirvacane'ci' ityatra pratipāditam| atra sthānivadbhāvādityataḥ pūrvam `dvitīyo'pi' itiśabdaḥ pāṭhyaḥ| `tena' iti vā paṭhitavyam ||

hvaḥ samprasāraṇam || 6.1.32 ||
saṃprasāraṇasya balīyastvāditi| balīyastvaṃ ca pūrvavat|
ekayogenaiva siddha iti| uttarasūtre kasyacinnimittasya saptamīnirdiṣṭasyābhyastaṃ pratyaśravaṇāṇṇāvapi saṃścaṅpare hverabhyastakāraṇasya siddhameva samprasāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| anabhyastanimittapratyayeniti| abhyastasya yannimittaṃ na bhavati tena| vyavadhāne iti| yadyuttarasūtraṃ pravarteta, tadā yogavibāgo'narthakaḥ syāditi jñāpakatvam ||

abhyastasya ca || 6.1.33 ||
atra `hvaḥ' ityanuvarttamānasya yadyabhyastaryetyanena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt, tadā kṛte dvirvacane'bhyastasaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāṃ samprasāraṇena bhavithavyam, tataścābhyāsasya samprasāraṇaṃ na syāt; `na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam' iti niṣedhāt| ākārahakārābhyāṃ vyavahitatvādapratiṣedha iti cetu? na; samānāṅge samprasāraṇapratiṣedhāt| samānāhgagrahaṇaṃ tatra codayiṣyati, na; samānāṅge samprasāraṇapratiṣedhāt| samānāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tatra codayiṣyati, etacca tatraiva vyaktaṃ vyākhyāsyate| tamimaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye doṣaṃ paścannāha--tadabhyastasyetyanena vyadhikaraṇamiti| etadeva sphorayati--abyastasya yo hvayatiriti| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--teneti ||

apaspṛdhethāmānṛcurānṛhuścicyuṣetityājaśrātāḥ śritamāśīrāśīrttāḥ || 6.1.36 ||
apara āheti| kasyāñcicchākhāyāmapaspṛdhethāmityādyudāttaṃ paṭhyate, anyasyāṃ tu padadvayam, ubhayamapyanena nipātanena saṃgṛhyate| tatraikapadye `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighātaḥ prāptaḥ, `yadvṛttānnityam' iti pratiṣiddhaḥ| tatrāṭsvareṇādyudāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati| yadā tu dve pade, tadā nighātapratiṣedhe `tāsyanudāttet' iti lasārvadhātukānudāttatve dhātusvareṇa spṛdhethāmiti padamādyudāttam,`tiṅi codāttavati' ityapaśabdasya nighātaḥ|
bahuvacanasyāvivakṣitatvāditi| somasyaiva bahutve śrābhāva iti niyamānāśrayaṇācca, anyathā bahutvātavivakṣāyāmapi somādanyatra śrābhāvo na syād viṣayavibhāgavāditanām ||

na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam || 6.1.37 ||
yeṣāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ vihitaṃ teṣāṃ yāvanto yaṇasteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ samprasāraṇe prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| nanu cālontyaparibhāṣayāntyasyaiva bhaviṣyati? nānayā paribhāṣayā śakyamihopasthātum, vacyādīnāmantyasya yaṇo'sambhavāt| `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' ityanayā paribhāṣayā tarhi antyasadeśasyaiva bhaviṣyati, netarasya? naiṣāsti paribhāṣā; prayojanābhāvāt| etaccāsmābhiḥ paribhāṣāprakaraṇākhye granthe upapāditam|
evaṃ tarhi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ pyāyaḥ pībhāvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--na sarvasya yaṇaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti| yadi syāt, pyāyaḥ samprasāraṇameva vidadhyāt| dvayoryakārayoḥ samprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca `halaḥ' iti dīrghatve ca siddhaṃ syātpīnaṃ mukhamiti| nanu ca pyāyo'ntya yaṇaḥ| sambhvākattasyaiva syāt? syādevaṃ yadi `pyāyaḥ' iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī vijñāyeta, avayavaṣaṣṭhī caiṣā vijñāsyate--pyāyo yo yaṇ tasyeti| evamapyetāvadevānena jñāpyate-na jñāpyate--na sarvasya yaṇaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti, tatra kut etat-- parasyaiva bhavati na pūrvasyeti, na ca vidhyatītyādinirddeśātparasyaiveti śakyamavagantum? paryāyeṇa pravṛttāvapi tadupapatteḥ| tasmādārabhyamevaitat|
nanu pūrvaparayoryaṇorekayogalakṣaṇaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ tadyadi parasyābhinirvṛttaṃ pūrvasyāpyabhinirvṛttameva, na cābhinirvṛttasya pratiṣedhena nivṛttiḥ śakyā vijñātum, yo hi bhuktavantaṃ brūyād mā bhuṃkthā iti, kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt! atha pūrvasyānabhinirvṛttaṃ parasyāpyanabhinirvṛttameva, tatra nimitttvenāśrayaṇamanupapannam? ityata āha--ekayogalakṣaṇamapīti| aparaḥ kalpaḥ-- astu dvayorapyabhinirvṛttam, kathaṃ tarhi pratiṣiddhyate? na samprasāraṇaṃ pratiṣiddhyate, kiṃ tarhi? tadāśrayaṃ pūrvatvam| tadeva tvatra samprasāraṇaśabdenopacārāducyate, tasminpratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśena siddhamiṣṭam| astu vā dvayorapyanabhinirvṛttam| kathaṃ tarhi nimittatvam? naivātra samprasāraṇanimittam, kiṃ tarhi? tadbhāvī yo yaṇ sa eva ca saptamyantena samprasāraṇaśabdenocyata iti|
punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇamiti| asati tasmin, `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti pūrvaprakaraṇavihitasyaiva samprasāraṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ syānna videśasthasya| vibhinanno deśaḥ-videśaḥ|
sampabrasāraṇagrahaṇādeveti| iha tu `vyatho liṭi' vivyathe iti halādiḥśeṣāpavādaḥ samprasāraṇam, prakaraṇādutsargadeśaścāpavādo bhavatīti parasyaiva saṃprasāraṇātsiddham| ata eva punaḥ saṃprasāraṇādvideśasthepi saṃprasāraṇe pratiṣedha itīṣṭavyam, anyathā tatreti vācyaṃ syāt| vyavadhānametāvadāśrayiṣyata iti| tenopapūrvādvaseḥ `bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ' iti liṭaḥ kvasau vibhaktau ca parato vasossamprasāraṇe upeyuṣetyādau dhātoḥ prāptasya yajādilakṣaṇasya saṃprasāraṇasya pratiṣedho na bhavati, pratyakṣeṇa ṣakāreṇa vyavadānāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi tu vyavadhānamātre syāt, tadā samānāṅgagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| nimittanimittinau yatraikasminnevāṅge bhavataḥ, tatra pratiṣedho bhavatīti vaktavyam| upeyuṣītyatra kvasau dhāturaṅgam, kvasvantaṃ ca vibhaktāviti pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ| antaraṅgatvādvā'tra pūrvameva dhātoḥ samprasāraṇam|
ṛci treriti| kalpasūtrakārāstu dviśabdasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prayuñjate--`tṛcāḥ pratipadanucarāḥ', `dvacāḥ pragāthāḥ' iti ||

liṭi vayo yaḥ || 6.1.38 ||
liṅgrahaṇamuttarārthamiti| nehārthaṃ liṭaḥ; anyatra vayādeśasyāsambhavāt ||

vaścāsyānyatarasyāṃ kiti || 6.1.39 ||
asyagrahaṇena vayo yakāraḥ pratinirddiśyate, anyathādeśākārasyoccāraṇārthatve pramāṇābhāvādvaya evāyaṃ sarvādeśaḥ sambhāvyeta| asyagrahaṇe tu sati yadyaṣyakāravānādeśaḥ tathāpyato lopena siddhamiṣṭam|
vaścāsyagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum| katham? `anyatarasyāṃ kiti veñaḥ' iti sūtraṃ kartavyam, liṭītyeva, kiti liṭi parato veñaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ na bhavatyanyatarasyām--vavatuḥ, vavuḥ; samprasāraṇapakṣe upaṅādeśe sati dvirvacanam, savarṇadīrghatvam--ūcatuḥ, ūcuḥ; `veño vayiḥ' --ūyatuḥ ūyuriti| kathaṃ vavau, vavitha? `lyapi ca' iti cakāreṇa liḍanukṛṣyate, tatpiti nityaniṣedhārthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||

lyapi ca || 6.1.40 ||
pūrvaṃ vaścāsyagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe `lyapi vyo jyaśca' iti ekayoga eva karttavyaḥ, evaṃ hi dviścakāro'pi na karttavyo bhavati ||

ādeca upadeśe'siti || 6.1.45 ||
ādeca upadeśe'śiti || atra yadi `dhātoḥ' iti nānuvartteta, tato viseṣyābhāvādevala nāsti tadantavidhirityupadeśe ya ec tasyāttvamityartho bhavati; tataśca ḍhaukitā, traukitā ityatrāpi prāpnoti| nanu cāśitītyucyate, na cātrāśitaṃ paśyāmaḥ; na ca kakāra evāśit, kiṃ kāraṇam? nañivayuktanyāyena śitsadṛśasya pratyayasyaiva grahaṇāt ? syādevaṃ yadyaśitīti paryudāsaḥ syāt, prasajyapratiṣedhastvayamiti vakṣyate| tasmāddhātorityanuvarttayamityāha--dhātoriti varttata iti| tasya caico viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhirityāha--ejanto yo dhāturiti| upadeśa iti| anirjñātasvarūpasya svarūpajñāpanārthamādyamuccāraṇam-upadeśaḥ|
cetā, stoteti| ārdhadhātuke guṇavidhānaṃ tvāttvārthameva syāt; yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśa iti nyāyāt| karttā, harttā hatyādau ca guṇavidhiścaritārthaḥ| evamapi lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati? jñāpakācca; yadayaṃ krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāvāttvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-na paranimittasyaica āttvaṃ bhavatīti| naitadasti jñāpakam, niyamārthametat syāt--krīṅjīnāṃ ṇāveveti| tattarhi `mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca' ityāttvaṃ sāsti? evaṃ taharyuttarārthamavaśyaṃ karttavyamupadeśagrahaṇam, tadihaiva kriyate mandadhiyāmanugrahāya|
kathamiti| aśidityayaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, tatra śiti pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇe śinmātrasya prāpnoti, tataśca jaglāye iti bhavitavyamiti praśnaḥ| bhāve lakāraḥ, tatpuruṣāśrayeṇottaram| kaḥ punastatpuruṣe sati guṇaḥ? ityata āha--tatreti| tatpuruṣe hi varṇagrahaṇamidaṃ bhavati, varṇagrahaṇe ca tadādau kāryaṃ bhavati| stanandhaya ityatra tu `nāsikāstanayoḥ' iti khaśi kṛte madyapātinaṃ śapamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ| prayojanābhāvādevātra na śapapā bhitavyamiti cet? nanvidameva prayojanaṃ yadutāttvanivṛttiḥ| aśitīti| yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt--śito'nyo'śit, tasminnaśitīti, tato glāyanti, malāyantītyatra śabakārasyāntyākārasya caikādeśe kṛte tasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvādasti śito'nya iti kṛtvā''ttvamatra prāpnoti| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu na doṣaḥ; ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt sidgrahaṇena grahaṇāt śiti pratiṣedha eva bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamekādeśaviṣaya eva āttvaprāptiścodyate, na punarglāyatītyādāvapi lakāra evāśiti parata āttvaṃ prāpnotīti? naivaṃ śakyaṃ codayitum; evaṃ hyaśitīti pratiṣedho nirvaṣayaḥ syāt, na ca `pāghādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ' hṛti dheṭaḥ śapratyayo'nanyapūrvo viṣayaḥ| na hyekamudāharaṇaṃ sitpratiṣedhaṃ prayojayati| yadyetāvat| prayojanaṃ syād `aśe' ityeva brūyāt| yadvā--antaraṅgatvānnityatvācca pūrvaṃ codyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekādeśasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvenādiśito'nyasya pratyayasyābhavāt| iha tarhi--suglaḥ, suglā, suglānamityākārāntalakṣaṇāḥ kāṅyano na syuḥ? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ;
āttvabhāvina ejantādākārāntanimittakaḥ|
pratyayo jñāpyate sarvo hvāvāmaścetyaṇā punaḥ ||
iha tarhi glai-glānīyam, pai--pānīyam, anīyari kṛte āttvaṃ ca prāpnoti, āyādayaśca, paratvādāyādayaḥ syuḥ? satyam; kṛteṣu teṣvalontyasyātve savarṇadīrghatve glānīyamityādi siddham| nanvāyādiṣu kṛteṣu nāyamejantaḥ, na ca sthānivadbāvo'lāśrayatvāt? syādetadevaṃ yadi samprati yadejantaṃ tasyāttvaṃ bhavatītyucyeta, iha tūpadeśagatamejantatvaṃ na sampratitanamiti nāsti sthānivadbāvāpekṣā| nanvevamapi jaglaturityādau yakārasyātve kṛte jaglā-ā-atusiti sthite'ntaraṅgamapyākārayorekādeśaṃ bādhitvā `āto lopa iti ca' ityāto lopaḥ syāt, na ca pūrvasyākārasya punarlopo labhyate, yakārākāralopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvāt `asiddhavadatrābhāt' ityasiddhatvācca? naiṣa doṣaḥ; samānāśraye `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' iha tu vyāśrayatvādantaraṅga ekādeśe sati paścādāllopa iti siddhamiṣṭam| evamapi `dvirvacane'ci' ityāyādīnāṃ sthānivattāvta glaiśabdasyadvirvacane'bhyāsasyevarṇāntatā prāpnoti, pakṣāntare tvanaimittikatvādātvasya dvirvacananimitte'cyavihitatvānna doṣaḥ? paryudāsapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ, liṭi vayo yaḥ' iti dvilakārako'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tathānirddeśasya ca tatra prayojanābhāvādihānuvṛttaṃ vākyabhedena sambaddhyate--aśityeva ātvaṃ bhavati, liṭi tu lakārādau lāvasthāyāmeveti| tataścāttvasya dvirvacananimittājnimittatvābhāvāttsya tāvanna sthānivadbhāvaḥ. āyādayastu liṭyaprāptā eva| tadevaṃ paryudāsapakṣasya bahupratividheya tvātprasajyapratiṣedho'yamityāha--aśitīti prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--tenaitadityādi| evamādi siddhaṃ bhavatīti| ādiśabdena sugletyatra `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅo grahaṇam| anyāni bahunī prayojanāni prāgevāsmābhirddarśitāni |
iha kasmānna bhavati-gobhyām, naubhyāmiti? jñāpakāt| yadayam `rāyohali' ityāttvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-na prātipadikasyāttvaṃ bhavatīti| naitadasti jñāpakam, niyamārthametatsyāt--rāyo halyeva; `automsasoḥ' ityettattu gāṃ paśyetyatra, `goto ṇit' ṇittvādvṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, gāḥ paśyetyatra tvaśitīti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnotīti kṛtaṃ bhavedityajñāpakam ? evaṃ taharyupadeśa ityucyate, na ca gonauśabdayorupadeśo'sti, yaḥ `gopayasoryan', `nauvayodharma' ityādau uccāraṇaṃ nāsāvupadeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? uddeśaḥ, siddhavadupānāt| mā bhūd gaunauśabdayorupadeśaḥ, ecastūpadeśo'sti--`gamerḍoḥ', `glānudibhyāṃ ḍauḥ' iti, na ca ḍoḍāvorvidhānavaiyarthyam, śasi caritārthatvāt? evaṃ tarhi `dhātoriti varttate'--ityuktatvānna bhaviṣyati ||

na vyo liṭi || 6.1.46 ||
kittyātve satyasati vā viśeṣābhāvātpityudāharaṇametasya vṛttikāreṇa darśitam| thali `iḍatyartivyayatīnām' itīṭa ||

krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau || 6.1.47 ||
yadyapi karoteḥ `īṅ gatau' ityetasya yaṇādeśe ṅiti rūpaṃ sambhavatati, tathāpi `ecaḥ' ityadhikārātkarotestāvad grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati| tathā īṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, hrasvāntena pareṇa jayatinā sāhacaryāt ||

sidhyaterapāralaukike || 6.1.48 ||
paralokaḥ prayojanamasya tatpāralaukikam `prayojanam' iti ṭhak, anuśatikāditvādubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| jñanaviśeṣe varttata iti| heyopādeyatattvāvabodhaḥ-jñānaviśeṣaḥ| tāpasaḥ sidhyatīti| heyamupādeyaṃ ca tattvato jñātukāmaḥ pravartta ta ityarthaḥ| tadāha--jñānaviśeṣamāsādayatīti| tapaḥ prayuṅkte iti| jñānaviśeṣavantaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| paraloka ityasya vivaraṇam-janmāntara iti| iha vā bhavatu, svargādau vā, śarīrāntaropalakṣaṇārthaṃ pāralaukikagrahaṇamiti| upasaṃharanniti| hetau śatṛpratyayaḥ|
iha kasmāditi| brāhmaṇebhyo dāsyāmītyanenābhiprāyeṇānuṣṭhito dhātvarthaḥ paralokaprayojano bhavatīti praśnaḥ| siddhyaterartha ityādinā aihalaukikatvaṃ dhātvarthasya darśayati| tasyaprayojanamiti| taduddiśya pravṛttatvāt| punaḥ siddhireveti| pāralaukikīti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhanīyam| siddhiḥ- siddhireveti| pāralaukikīti liṅgavipariṇāmena sambandhanīyam| siddhiḥ-niṣpattiḥ| yasyāṃ siddhau dhāturvarttate sā ca pāralaukikī na bhavati, tasmādāttvaṃ na paryudasyate| sākṣāditi| yadi sākṣādavyavadhānena pāralaukiko yaḥ siddhyaterarthastatra paryudāso na caritārthaḥ syāttadā pāramparyāśrayaṇam| idaṃ tu sākṣātparalokārthe jñānaviśeṣe caritārtham, ato naivaṃvidhe viṣaye pravarttate ityarthaḥ ||

mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca || 6.1.49 ||
upadeśa evāttvavidhānāllyapaḥ paratvāsambhavāllyapīti viṣayasaptamītyāha--lyapi viṣaya iti| ekācca iti| yadyapi prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ prāgāsīt, tathāpīhopadeśādhikārānmīnātyādīnāṃ copadeśa ejantatvāsambhavātsāmarthyādeva ityetadapi viṣayaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--ecaśca viṣaya iti| yatra pratyaye ejbhāvī tasminbuddhistha ityarthaḥ| upadeśa evetyasya vivaraṇam--prāk pratyayotpatteriti|
upadeśa evāttvavidhāne yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayati--upadeśa evāttvavidhānāditi| ivarṇāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyaya erac, ākārāntalakṣaṇastu ghañ| yadyapi ghañākārāntāditi nocyate, tathāpyatrāttve sati bhavati, asati tu na bhavatītyetāvatā ghaña ākārāntalakṣaṇatvam| upadāyo varttata iti| `ghañi `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' iti yuk| īṣadupadānamiti khalarthe `āto yuc'| mīnātiminotyestu khalacāveva bhavata; `nimīmiliyāṃ khalacoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ato dī***vodāhṛtaḥ ||

vibhāṣā līyateḥ || 6.1.51 ||
tayorubayorapi yakā'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ kriyate iti| yadi tu daivādikasyaiva śyanā nirddeśaḥ kriyeta, `līṅaḥ' ityeva brūyāditi bhāvaḥ| śitapaḥ śitkaraṇasāmarthyāccābāvakarmavācitve'pi yag bhavati, yathā--akartṛvācitvaśabādayaḥ--`bhavateraḥ' ityādau| khalacoriti| pacādyaca eracaśca sāmānyena grahaṇam| evaṃ ceti| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādevetyarthaḥ| ullāpayata iti| `liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca' ityātmanepadam ||

khideśchandasi || 6.1.52 ||
cakhādeti| vyatyayena parasmaipadam, āttvasyānaimittikatvād `dvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivattvābhāvadabhyāsasyevarṇāntatā na bhavati|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktam| katham? khādeḥ--cakhāda, khideḥ--cikhedeti, anekārthatvāddātūnāmarthabhedo|pyakiñcitkaraḥ ||

apaguro ṇamuli || 6.1.53 |||
yadi giratirgurerarthe vartate, tadāyaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktam| katham ? gireḥ--apagāramapagāram, guroḥ--apagoramapagoram ||

prajane viyateḥ || 6.1.54 ||
yadi vātiraprajane'pi vartate, tadā yogo'yaṃ śakyo'kartum| katham? vāteḥ--pravāpayati, vīyateḥ--pravāyayatīti| vīyaterityayamapi yakā nirddaśaḥ smaryate, veterādādikatvena śyano'sambhavāt| prayojanaṃ hi yakā nirddeśasya cintyam| janmana upakrama iti| janerbhave ghaña, praśabda ādikarmaṇi| garbhagrahaṇamiti| gṛhīto hi garbho jāyate, tato garbhagrahaṇaṃ janmana upakramaḥ|

bibheterhetubhaye || 6.1.55 ||
hetubhayamiti| `pañcamī bhayena' iti samāsaḥ, tadāha--hetorbhayamiti| kiṃ punastat? ityāha-sa yasya bhayasyeti| sa cāttvapakṣe na bhavatīti| ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyaṭvātprāpnoti, kuto na bhavati? ityāha--lībhiyorīkārapraśleṣanirddesāditi| `līlornuglukau' iti liyo nugvidhīyate, yaśca `bhiyaḥ ṣuk'--tāvubhāvapyākārāntayorna bhavataḥ, kutaḥ? lī-ī bhī-ī iti īkārapraśleṣeṇekārāntayorvidhānāt| lībhiyoḥ praśleṣanirddeśāditi vārttike saha pāṭhādiha liyo grahaṇam ||

nityaṃ smayateḥ || 6.1.57 ||
dhātvarthasāmānyāditi| sāmānyam-sādṛśyam, dhātvarthayoḥ sāmānyaṃ dhātvarthasāmānyam, dvayorapi dhātvorartho cittavikārasvabhāvau, tena bhayaśabdena smayaterarthe'bhidhīyate, `krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau' ityatra smayatirnoktaḥ, `hetubhaye' ityupādhiṃ vakṣyāmīti ||

sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti || 6.1.58 ||
dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryaṃ vijñāyata iti pratyaya iha sannidhāpito jhalā viśeṣyata iti tadādividhirvijñāyata ityāhajhalādāviti| akiti pratyaye parata iti| kiti parato na bhavatītyarthaḥ| prasajyapratiṣedho hyayamiṣyate, etacca gāṅkuṭādisūtra samyagupapāditam| laghūpadhaguṇāpavā do'yamiti| akitīti vṛddhistu bhavati, na bādhyateḥ yena nāprāptyabhāvāt| sāpyami kṛte bhavati| tasyaiva vyākhyā| pūrva tu bādhyata iti| amāgamena; nityatvāttasya| rajjusṛḍbhyām, devadṛgbhyāmiti| ubhayatra vraścādisūtreṇa ṣatve jaśtvamiti kecit| anye tu `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' iti kutvamitchanti| nanu na kvinnantāvetau, kiṃ tarhi? kvibantau? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāddhātoḥ kvacitkvin vihitaḥ, tasya pratyayāntare kutvaṃ bhavati, `kvinaḥ ku' iti vaktavye pratyayagrahaṇāditi vakṣyate| padāntasyetyadhikārāt sraṣṭā, draṣṭetyatra na bhavati, kutvavidhāveva tasya nirṇayaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||

anudāttasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām || 6.1.59 ||
upadeśa iti varttata iti| anudāttasya viśeṣaṇārtham, tena draptetyatra tṛni vihite yadyapi nitsvareṇa dhātorudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tathāpi upadeśe'nudātta ityambhavati| varḍhetyatra tṛci kṛte yadyapi śeṣanighātena dhāturanudātto bhavati, tathāpyupadeśe nāyamanudātta ityamna bhavati| kimarthaṃ punaranudāttasyetyucyate, nāniṭa ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi sati laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? tatrāhatṛpa prīṇana ityādi| iḍāgamo radhādibhyaścetyanena vikalpita iti| tataśca pākṣikeṇeṭā seṭtvāttayorna syāt| atha pākṣikeṇeḍabhāvena tayorapi syāt, varḍhā, varḍhumityatrāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi tarhi tayoḥ `radhādibhyaśca' itīṅvikalpyate, anudāttopadeśaḥ punastayoḥ kimarthaḥ? ityāha--anudāttopadeśaḥ punaramartha eveti|

śīrṣaṃśchandasi || 6.1.60 ||
na punarayamādeśaḥ śiraḥśabdasyeti| yadyapi sūtre śirasa iti sthānī nopāttaḥ, tathāpi samānārthatvādādeśenākṣipyate, yathā-śivādiṣu viśravaṇaravaṇaśabdābhyāṃ viśravaḥśabda ityādeśatvaśaṅkā| so'pi hi chandasi prayujyata iti| ādeśakṣapakṣe tu tena nivartitatvācchiraḥśabdo na prayujyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca `anyatarasyām' ityanuvṛttestasyāpi prayogo bhaviṣyati, satyam; uttaratrāpi vikalpānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeteti prakṛtyantarapakṣa evāśritaḥ ||

ye ca taddhite || 6.1.61 ||
chandasi pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti| bhāṣārthamidam, yadi pūrvasūtravadihāpi śīrṣanniti prakṛtyantaraṃ vijñāyeta tadā| yadā śiraḥ śabdādyacakārādistaddhita utpadyate tadā tasya śravaṇaṃ prasajyeteti matvā''ha--ādeśo'yamiṣyata iti| sa kathamiti| sa ādeśaḥ kathaṃ labhyate, na kathañcit, sthānino'nupādānāt pūrvasūtravaditi praśnaḥ| tannanimittamanurūpāṃ śabdataścārthataścāntaratamāṃ prakṛtiṃ śiraśabdamevākṣipati| śirasyātīti| `supa ātmanaḥ kcan'|
vā keseṣviti| sūtreṇa ntye prāpte vikalpitaḥ| atra śirasyaśabdasya keśaikaviṣayatvāttatprayoge keśaśabdo na prayoktavyaḥ, śīrṣaṇyaśabdastu sāmānyavācīti tatprayoge viśeṣāvagamāya keśaśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ ||

aci śīrṣaḥ || 6.1.62 ||
śīrṣanbhāve hyanniti prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāditi| ato'kārāntamādeśāntaraṃ vihitamiti bhāvaḥ|
karttavyo'tra yatna iti| tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ--śīrṣannādeśasanni pātakṛtaḥ ṣyaṅādeśastadvighātasya nimittaṃ na bhavatīti| aṇiñantādvā para iti| `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' ityādeśapakṣaprahāṇena pratyayapakṣa āśrayaṇīyaḥ, ādeśapakṣa eva vā sthitvā yatnaḥ karttavya iti vāśabdārthaḥ ||

padannomāshṛnniśasanyūṣandoṣanyakañchakannudannāsañchasprabhṛtiṣu || 6.1.63 ||
ihāpi `śasprabhṛtiṣu' iti nimittopādānādanurūpāḥ prakṛtayaḥ ākṣipyante, padādayaścādeśa vijñāyante ityāha--pādadante tyādi| ante āsanaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, āsyaśabdastu paṭhitavyaḥ, āsno vṛkasya varttikāmabhīke, grīvāyāṃ baddho api kakṣa āsani, āsno yatsīsamuñcataṃ vṛkasyetyādau hyāsyārtho'vagamyate| āsanīti| `vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' ityallopābhāvapakṣe rūpam| aparake punaraviśeṣaṇecchantīti| bhāṣye tu chāndasmevaitaditi sthitam|
prakārārthe prabhṛtiśabda iti| vyavasthāvācini tu śasaḥ pūrveṣu vacaneṣu na syuḥ| doṣaṇīti| prathamādvivacane, doḥśabdasya doṣannādeśaḥ, auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ| māṃsapacāyā ukhāyā iti| `māṃsasya paci yuṭghañoḥ' ityantalopo vakṣyate, tadvyutpacyantaram| nasyamiti| hitārthe bhavārthe vā `śarīrāvayavādyat'| nasta iti| `apādāne sāhīyaruhoḥ' iti tasi| naḥ kṣudraḥ iti| `tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena' iti samāsaḥ| `saptamī' iti yogavibhāgādityanye| bahuvrīhau viśeṣaṇasya kṣudraśabdasya rājadantāditvātparanipāta ityanye |
yati varṇanagarayorniti vaktavyamiti| tattarhi vaktavyam? na vaktavyam; iha tāvannāsikyo varṇa iti, parimukādipāṭhād ñyaḥ, nāsikyaṃ nagaramiti saṅkāśādipāṭhād ṇyaḥ, `rājanyasāṅkāśyakāmyilpanāsikyadārvāghāṭānāmā dirvānto vā' iti pratipadasvaravidhānātsvare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ, pratyuta yatpratyaye satyanāsikyamityatra `yayatoścātadarthe' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ prasajyeta, avyayapūrvapadakṛtīsvaraśceṣyate ||

dhātvāde ṣaḥ saḥ || 6.1.64 ||
siñcatīti| `se mucādīnām' iti num|
ṣoḍanniti| ṣaḍ dantā yasyeti bahuvrīhau `vayasi dantasya datṛ' `ṣa, uttvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsu' iti ṣaṣa utvamuttarapadādeṣṭutvaṃ ca, `ugidacām' iti num, halṅyādisayogācantalogau| kvacittu ṣoḍa iti paṭhyate, tattu ,ṣoḍantamācaṣṭa iti ṇici kṛte ṭilope pacādyaci rūpam| ṣaṭaśabdo'valyutpannaṃ prātipadikam| anukampitaḥ ṣaḍaṅguliḥ ṣaḍikaḥ, `bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā', `ṭhājādāvūrdhvam' ityaṅgaliśabdasya lopaḥ| laṣatīti| ṣakāropadeśastu pranilaṣatītyādau `śeṣe vibhāṣā'khakādāvaṣānta upadeśe' iti nerṇatvapratiṣedhārthaṃ syāt, leṣatuḥ leṣurityatra `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti ṣatvārtham| kvacittu kaṣatītyapi paṭhyate; tadayuktam; ṣakāropadeśasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyati; pranikaṣatītyatrāpi kakhādāvityeva ṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ; ādeśāditvābhaphyāsalopau ca na staḥ---cakaṣatuḥ, cakaṣuḥ|
kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣādayo dhātava upadiṣṭā;, na sādaya evopadiśyeran, evaṃ hyetatsūtraṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati? tatrāha--ādośapratyayayorityādi| vyavasthāniyamaḥ-- ādeśapratyayayoriti sahādīnāmeva ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt, sṛpisṛjīprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ṣādayaḥ kecidupadiṣṭāḥ; anyathā sahādīnāṃ ṣatvārthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyam, tacca guru bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ke punasta iti| pāṭhe bhraṃśasambhavātpraśanaḥ| ye tathā paṭhyanta iti| apramādena paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ| atha vā lakṣaṇaṃ kriyata iti| mandadhiyo'nugrahītumiti bhāvaḥ| ajdantyaparāḥ sādaya iti| ajdantyau parau yeṣāṃ te'jdantyaparāḥ, paraśabdo'vayavavācī| taccājdantyayoḥ paratvamavayavāntarāpekṣaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ sannidhānātsakārāpekṣaṃ vijñāyate| smiṅsviditi| `ṣmiṅīṣaddhasane', `ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe',`ṣvanja saṅge', `viṣvap śaye'--ete svarūpeṇaiva paṭhyante| vakāramakārayoranajdantyatvādvakāro'pi kevaladantasthāno na bhavati| `svada āsvādane' iti| svadimapi kecitpaṭhanti| sṛpisṛjītyādi| `sṛprṛ gatau', `sṛja visarge',`stṝñ ācchādane', `satyai ṣṭyai śabdasaṅghātayoḥ', `sekatirgatyarthaḥ', `sṛ gatau'---etānvarjayitvā ye'nye'jdantyaparāste ṣopadeśāḥ|
subdātvityādi| subdhātuḥ kyajādyantaḥ, `ṣṭivu nirasane', `ṣvaṣkatirgatyarthaḥ' anudāttet--eṣāṃ satvasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| tatra subdātūnāṃ tāvanna vaktavyaḥ, upadeśa iti vartate, na ca subdhātavaḥ kvacidupadiśyante, evaṃ ca kṛtvā dhātugrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| upadeśābhāvādeva ṣoḍāderna bhaviṣyati, tat kriyate dhātorityasya nivṛttiṃ sūcayitum| tena `lopo vyorvali' iti aviśeṣeṇa bhavati, ṣṭhīvatiṣvaṣkatī dviṣakārakau, tatra pūrvasyāstu satvam, pareṇa sannipātena ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam, liṭ ṣvaṣkate, ṣatvasyāsiddhatvād `ḍaḥ si dhuṭ' iti dhuṭ prasajyeta ? evaṃ tarhi yakārādī ṣṭhivuṣvaṣkatī, yakārastu `lopo vyorvali' iti lupyate| ṣṭhīvatīti| `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' iti dīrghatvam| athāsya dvitīyo varṇo yadi ṭhakāraḥ, teṣṭhīyata iti na sidhyati; atha thākaraḥ, ṭeṣṭhīyata iti na siddhyati; ubhayaṃ ceṣyate, tatrāha--ṣṭhīvata ityasyetyādi| ubhayathā hyācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pāṭhitā iti bhāvaḥ ||

ṇo naḥ || 6.1.65 ||
aṇatīti| ṇopadeśastu niraṇatītyādau `upasaragādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya' iti ṇatvārthaṃ syāt| subdhātorayamapi neṣyata iti| pūrvavadeva sarve nādaya iti prayoge| nṛtīnandītyādi| `nṛtī gātravikṣepe', `ṭunadi samṛddhau', `narda gardda śabde', `nakka nāśane', `naṭa avasyandane' curādiḥ, `nāthṛ nādhṛ yācñopatāpaiśvaryeṣu' ||

lopo vyorvali || 6.1.66 ||
dhātoriti prakṛtamityādi| etad `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' ityatra vyākhyātam| didivāniti| diveḥ kvasau rūpam| `vasvekājādghasām' iti niyamādiḍabhāvaḥ| atra vaktavyamasti tad `vasvekājādghasām' ityatra vakṣyāmaḥ| `ūyī tantusantāne', `knūyī śabde'| āsremāṇamiti| `srivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ', auṇādiko manin, nañā samāsaḥ|
nanu ca sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti pūrvaṃ kāryinirddeśo yuktaḥ, paścātkāryanirddeśaḥ--`vyorvali lopaḥ' iti, lāghavaṃ ca bhavatyarddhamātrayā, tatkimarthaṃ pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam? ityata āha--pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇamityādi| pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ sūcyate--vidhyantarātpūrvamevāyaṃ lopo bhatīti, kaṇkaḍūyateryalopaśca prāpnoti, verapṛktalopaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopena bhavitavyam|
kaṇḍūyateḥ kvibiti| `kaṇḍvādibhyo yak' ityatra bhāṣyam--`naitebyaḥ kvib dṛśyate' iti, tasmātkaṇḍūmicchatīti kyajantātkvib dṛṣṭavyaḥ| dvividhā hi kaṇkaḍvādayaḥ--dhātavaḥ, prātipadikāni ca| tatra dhātubhyo yagvidhānātprātipadikebhyaḥ kyajādayo bhavantyeva, tatra kyajantātkivapi kṛte--ato lopaśca prāpnoti, verapṛktalopaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopena bhāvyam| athāpyārddhadhātuka iti viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇātpūrvamato lopaḥ, paścātkivap? evamapi kvilopaśca prāpnoti, verapṛktalopaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamapṛktalopaḥ stāt, tasmiśca sati nimittābhāvādalāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvātsthānivadbhāvābhāvācca vali lopo na syāt pūrvalopagrahaṇācca bhavati| athātra lopasya sthānivadbāvāduvaṅ karamānna bhavati ? ucyate; kyajantātkvibityuktam, tataḥ kim ? sthānivadbhāvenāpi kaṇkaḍūmātrasya dhātutvābhāvāduvah na bhavati| yaṇādeśastarhi prāpnoti ? astu yaṇ, tasyoṭh kariṣyate| na coṭhayapi karttavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ, ādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvatvādvakārasya, ata eva kaṇkaḍuvāvityādāvūṅuvaṅādiṣu karttavyeṣu nāstyallopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ|
atha vraścakaḥ, vraścanamityādau rephe vali parato vakārasya lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tatrāha--vraścādīnāmityādi| nanu vṛścati, vavraścetyādau samprasāraṇe kṛte halādiśeṣe ca vakārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syādityetadupadeśasya prayojanaṃ syāt, na hyatra lopaḥ pravartate, valparatvābhāvadityata āha--vṛścati vavraścetyādāvapītyādi| bahiraṅgatvāditi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ samprasāraṇasya kḍitpratyayopekṣatvāt, halādiśeṣasya tvabhyāsāpekṣatvāt, tataścākṛtayoreva tayorvalopaḥ prāpta upadeśasāmarthyādeva na bhavati|
atra bhāṣye valopaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ| āsremāṇam, jīradānurityatra chāndaso varṇalopaḥ, kvasāvapi chāndasa eva, diviprabṛtīnāṃ yaṅlugantānāṃ tasādiṣūṭhā bhavativyam, tipsiporīḍabhāvapakṣeṣūṭhā bhavitavyam| ye tatra kṅitīti nānuvarttayanti-dediviti dedyoti, dedivīṣi dedyoṣi, mipi tvanunāsikatvādeva bhavati, dedivīmi dedyomi; ye tvanuvarttayanti teṣāmapi chāndaso yaṅlugiti ||

verapṛktasya || 6.1.67 ||
kvibādayo gṛhyanta iti| tato'nyasya verapṛktasyābhāvāt| ghṛtaspṛgiti| `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' apṛktagrahaṇādvakāramātrasyedaṃ grahaṇam, ikāra uccāraṇāthaḥ ||

halṅyābbhyo dīrghatsutirayapṛktaṃ hal || 6.1.68 ||
dīrghagrahaṇaṃ sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ ṅbhāporeva viśeṣaṇam| ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ ca soviśeṣaṇam| halapṛktagrahaṇaṃ ca tisyoḥ| sutisīti trīṇi padāni| tadihetyādi| prakṛtasya lopaśabdasya śāstrīyasya bhāvasādhanasya sutisīti prathamāntena sambandhābhavāditi bhāvaḥ| apara āha-ilṅyābbhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā sutisītyādikāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyāṃ śāstrīye'pi lāpaśabde na doṣa iti| abhino'treti| bhidarlaṅi silopaḥ, `daśca' iti dakārasya rūtvam, tasya `ato roraplutādaplute' ityutvam, śnamo'kāreṇa `ādguṇaḥ', `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpam|
niṣkauśāmbirati| nanu ca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadādigrahaṇādevātra na bhaviṣyati, ihāpi tarhi na syāt--paramakumārī, paramakhaṭveki? `strīpratyaye cānupasarjane na' iti tadādiniyamābāvādbhaviṣyati| niṣkauśāmbirityādau upasarjanatvādbhavatyeva tadādiniyamaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati--arddhapippalītyādau `ekavibhakti ca' ityupasarjanatve satyapi lopo bhavati| nātropasarjanaṃ piplalī; ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantamiti vacanāt| ata eva `gostriyoruparjanasya' iti hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati| mā bhūcchāstrīyamupasarjanam, apradhānaṃ tāvadbhavatyeva--bahvyaḥ śreyasyo'sya bahuśreyasīti? śāstrīyamapyusarjanatvamasti, `īyasaśca' iti kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, `īyaso bahuvrīhau pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti hrasvābhāvaḥ| apara āha--`niṣkauśāmbirityādau samudāyasya ṅyābantatve'pi yadatra ṅyābantaṃ kauśāmbyādi, tataḥ parasya sorlopaḥ prāpnoti dīrghagrahaṇādvyāvarttate' iti| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate--ṅyābantādvihitasyeti? naivaṃ śakyam; yā, sā, ketyādau na syāt, na hyatra ṭābantātsubvihitaḥ| mā bhūdevam, halantādvihita ityevaṃ bhaviṣyiti| yadyevam, yaḥ, saḥ, ka ityatrāpi syāt, karttā hartetyādau cana syāt, na hyatra halantāt tsurvihita iti ? ato'nyasmādapi vihitasya halṅ‌yābbhyo'nantasya lopa ityāstheyam| evaṃ ca niṣkauśāmbyādāvapi lopaḥ prāpno dīrghagrahaṇena vyāvarttanīyaḥ| tipā sahacaritasyeti| tipā tiśabdena sāhacaryātsahāpi tiṅa eva grahaṇamityarthaḥ|
atha kimarthamityādi| `ṅyāpordīrghātsuḥ' ityeva vaktavyamiti codyārthaḥ| na lopo na syāditi| nanu ca `na ṅisambuddhayoḥ' iti kajñāpakānnalope karttavye saṃyogāntaloparaḥ siddha eva bhaviṣyati? na; pacannityādāvapi prasaṅgāt| nakārasaṃbuddhayorānantarte pratiṣedho vijñāyamānastulyajātīye nakāravibhaktayorānantarya eva saṃyogāntalopasya siddhatvaṃ jñāpayati| pacannityādau tu takāreṇa vyavahitatvād jñāpakābhāvāllopābhāvaḥ?--ityāśaṅkya doṣāntaramāha--ukhāsrat, parṇaghvaditi| datvamiti| na syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ| ukhāsras-su iti sthite saṃyogāntalopamapavādatvādbādhitvā `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti prakṛtisakārasya lope śrūyamāṇaḥ sakāro na vasvādisambandhīti `vasusraṃsu' iti datvaṃ na syāt| na ca saṃyogādilopaṃ bādhitvā pūrvameva prakṛtisakārasya datvaṃ labhyate; apadāntatvāt| na hi sau śrūyamāṇe pūrvasya padasaṃjñā'sti; `asarvanāmasthāne' iti pratiṣedhāt| athāpisāvapi padatvamiti pakṣāśrayeṇa syātpadatvam? evamapi datvasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃsaṃyogādilopa eva syāt| nanu ca vasvādīnāṃ datvaṃ sau dīrghatve siddhamiti vakṣyati tatra, sau dīrghagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate vasvādīnāṃ datvamityeva, tataśca pūrvameva datvaṃ bhaviṣyati? evamapi rājā, takṣetyādau sāvapi padatve sati saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ nalope sati asaṃyogāntatvātsorlopo na syāt| tasmātsuṣṭhūktam--datvaṃ na syāditi| utvamiti| na syādityanuṣaṅgaḥ| sa eva hetuḥ-- saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāditi| utvamiti| na syādityunuṣaṅgaḥ| sa eva hetuḥ-- saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāditi| etacca `saṃyogāntalopo rorutve siddho vaktavyaḥ'---ityetadanāśrityoktam| tadāśrayaṇe tu--harivo medinīmityādivatsiddham| rātsasyeti niyamāllopa eva na syāditi| nanu `rātsasya' iti dvitakārakanirddeśāktakārasyāpi praśleṣādrephāduttarasya ca takārasyāpi lopo vidhāsyate? yadyevam, kīrttayateḥ kvipi `kīḥ' iti syāt, yathānyāse tu kīrditi bhavati| tadevaṃ sigrahaṇamekaṃ na karttavyam, anyatsarvaṃ karttavyamiti sthitam|
saṃyogāntasya lope hītyādi| saṃgrahaślokaḥ| hiśabdo hetau, nalopādītyādiśabdena datvotvayorgahaṇam| ye tu saṃyogāntalopavādinasteṣāṃ repāduttarasya takārasya abibharbhavānityatra naiva lopaḥ syāt, tasmāddhala uttareṣāṃ sutisīnāṃ lopo vidhīyate ||

eṅhrasvātsambuddheḥ || 6.1.69 ||
atra yadi halgrahaṇaṃ nānuvarteta, tata eṅhrasvābhyāṃ sambuddhireva viśeṣaṇīyā--eṅantād hrasvāntācca parasyāḥ sambuddherlopa iti, tataśca he kuṇḍetyatra na syāt| katham? kuṇḍa-su iti sthite lopaśca prāpnotyam‌bhāvaśca, tatra lopaḥ śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityāḥ, sa hi kṛte'mbhāve `ādeḥ parasya' ityamo'kārasya prāpnoti, akṛte tu sakārasya ambhāvastu lope kṛte'tyantāprāptyā'nityaḥ- ityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādambhāve kṛte'mi pūrvasya prāpnoti lopaśca| tatrāmi pūrvatve kṛte vyapavargābhāvādubhayat āśraṇaṇe'ntādivadbhāvābhāvācca lopo na prāpnoti, lope ca kṛte'mo'bhāvādamipūrvatvaṃ na prāpnotītyubhayoranityayoḥ paratvādami pūrvatve kṛte lopo na syāt, tasmādanuvartyaṃ halgrahaṇam| tadāha-haliti ceti| `varttate' ityapekṣate| apṛktamiti nādhikriyata iti| yadyadhikriyeta, he kuṇkaḍetyatra na syāt; apṛktasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--nāyamadhikriyata iti? tatrā''ha--tathā ceti| anuvartamāne'pi halgrahaṇe yadyeṅhrasvābhyāṃ sambuddhirviśeṣyeta, tayā hal viśeṣyeta--eṅantād hrasvāntācca parā yā sambuddhistasyā hallupyate iti, tataḥ he kuṇḍetyatra na syāt pūrvoktādeva hetoḥ| ata eṅhrasvābhyāṃ sambuddhyā ca haleva viśeṣaṇīya iti matvā''ha--eṅantātprātipadikādityādi| sambuddhyākṣiptapratipadikameṅhrasvābhyāṃ viśeṣyata iti tadantavidhilābhaḥ| atra pakṣe kuṇḍetyatrāmi pūrvatvasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvād hrasvāntātparo halbhavati| vastutaśca sambuddheriti lopaḥ siddhayati|
acchabda iti| etacca tatraiva vyākhyāsyate| hrasvābhāvāditi| nanu cādaḍevākāro hrasvaḥ, tataḥ paro hal bhavati, sambuddheśca sambandhīti lopaḥ syādeva, sambuddhautu viśeṣyamāṇāyāṃ prakṛtyakārasya lope hrasvātprā sambuddhirna bhavatīti lopāprasaṅgaḥ? ucyate; `sambuddhyākṣiptaṃ prātipadikameṅhrasvābhyāṃ viśeṣyate' ityuktam, tena kuṇkaḍetyatra na bhaviṣyati; ekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt prakṛtigrahaṇena grahaṇāt| he kataradityatra ca na bhaviṣyati; ṭilope kṛte prakṛterahrasvāntatvāt| sambuddhiguṇabalīyastvāditi| anyathā agni-su iti sthite sambuddhiguṇaśca prāpnoti, hrasvāditi lopaśca; tatra nityātvātparatvācca sambuddhiguṇe kṛte'hrasvāntatvānna bhavet| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate--hrasvāntādvihitā yā sambuddhiriti? evamapi he khaṭvetyatra na syāt| mā bhūdanena, ābantatvātpūrveṇa bhaviṣyati ? evamapi he khaṭvetyatra na syāt| mā bhūdanena, ābantatvātpūrveṇa bhaviṣyati? evamapi he nadi, he yavāgu, he kumārītyatra na syāt, na cātra ṅyantatvāllopo labhyate, dīrghagrahaṇāt| evaṃ tarhyubhayaṃ vijñāsyate--vihitaviśeṣaṇam, paraviśeṣaṇaṃ ca; tenāgne, kumārītyādau sarvatra bhaviṣyati? tatra sakṛcchrutasya hrasvagrahaṇasyobhayaviśeṣaṇatvameva tāvad durlabham| athāpi labhyate? evamapi he kataradityatra yadyapi ṭilope kṛte sambuddherhra svaparatvābhāvaḥ, tathāpi hrasvāntādvihitā sambuddhiriti syādeva lopaḥ| tasmādeṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam|
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ--ye svabhāvata eṅantāstadarthamapyeṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti| tadyathāheśabdamatikrānto brāhmaṇo'tiheḥ, tasya sambodhanaṃ he atihe; anukṛtaḥ pacateśabdo yena tasya sambodhanaṃ he'nukṛtapacate; vihita īrepratyayo yena sa vihitereḥ pāṇiniḥ, tasya sambodhanam--he vihitere ityādi| atra saṃgrahaślokaḥ---
sambuddhirhra svabhedyā yadi hi na ca bhavennādivannāntavatsyād,
doṣo'sau halnivṛttāvapi lupi bhavato'm pūrvarūpe paratvāt|
hrasvāntāllubvidhiḥ syāddhala iti kataraḍḍittvato no halo lup,
hrasvaśrutyā na śakyaḥ paravihitavidhirnātihe'to'pyakārye'ṅ ||
lopanaṃ lup, lopa ityarthaḥ ||

śeśchandasi bahulam || 6.1.70 ||
yā kṣetreti| śerlope kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti num, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' iti dīrghaḥ, nalopaḥ|
ayaṃ yogaḥ sakyo'vaktum, katham? ḍādeśena siddhatvāt| kathamagnetrīti? tri-i iti sthite prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvenaiva siddham| na siddhyati, numā vyavahitatvāt? chandasi napuṃsakasya puṃvadbhāvo paktavyaḥ, madhorgṛhṇātītyevamādyarthaṃ puṃvadbhāvenaiva numo nivṛttiḥ| evamapi `jasi ca' iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, vakṣyatyetat--`usādiṣu chandasi vāvacanaṃ prāṅ ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ' iti| api ca yā kṣetrā, tā tā piṇḍānāmiti ta-i iti sthite `supāṃ suluk' itīkārasyākāre kṛte `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' iti dīrghatvena siddham ||

hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk || 6.1.71 ||
kṛtā dhāturākṣipyate, sa ca hrasvena viśeṣyate, tena tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--hrasvāntasya dhātoriti| agnicit, somasuditi| `agnau ceḥ', `some suñaḥ' itika kvip|
grāmaṇikulamiti vyastaṃ cennapuṃsakahrasvatvam, ṣaṣṭhīsamāse tu `iko hrasvo'ṅ‌yo gālavasya', `some suñaḥ' iti kvip|
yadi punarayaṃ tuṭ parādiḥ kriyate? canaivaṃ śakyam; ihāgnicitsomasut, `verapṛktasya' iti valopo na prāpnoti| iha ca paritanotīti kvip, `kvau ca gamādīnām' ityanunāsikalopaḥ, `nahivṛti' ityādinā dīrghaḥ--parītat, tuṭa ārddhadhātukabhaktatvādiṭprasaṅgaḥ| iha cāvacchyād `vā'nyasya saṃyogādeḥ' ityetvaṃ prasajyeta| athābhaktaḥ syād, madhucchādayatīti `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nighāto na prāpnoti; takāreṇa vyavadhānāt| na ca takāra evātiṅ; apadatvāt| tasmātpūrvānta eva karttavyaḥ| yadyevam, napuṃsakahrasvatvamupasarjanahrasvatvaṃ dvigusvaraśca na siddhyati| napuṃsakahrasvatvam--ārāśaṣkulicchatram, dhānāśaṣkulicchatram| upasarjanahrasvatvam--niṣkauśāmbicchatram; dvigusvaraḥ--pañcāratnicchatram, tuki kṛte'nantyatvādete vidhayo na prāpnuvanti ? na vā bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt| bahiraṅgastuk--chakārasannipātāpekṣatvāt, antaraṅgā ete vidhayaḥ prāgeva tatsannidhā nādbhaviṣyanti ||

saṃhitāyām || 6.1.72 ||
`saṃhitāyām' iti viṣayasaptamīyam| kāryinimittayoḥ saṃhitāyāṃ viṣayabhūtāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| vakṣyati---`iko yaṇaci' iti, antaraṃ tu vidhimatikrāmato'bhiprāyo mṛgyaḥ| dadhi atreti| nanu ca `ikoyaṇaci' ityadhikaraṇasaptamyeṣā, taccādhikaraṇamaupaśleṣikādanyadvarṇeṣu na sambhavati, tatrācyupaśliṣṭasyeko vidhīyamāno yaṇvarṇāntaravyavāye kālavyavāye ca na bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ saṃhitādhikāreṇa? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etajjñāpayati--`kālavyavāyo nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāṃ nāśrīyate' iti| tenottarapadādikāre'pi vidhīyamānaṃ kāryamalugādi kālavyavadhāne'pi bhavatyeva--ākhareṣṭha ityākhare sthaḥ, agnāviṣṇū ityagnā viṣṇū ityādi ||

che ca || 6.1.73 ||
chakārekāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, `vidibhidicchideḥ', `śācchoranyatarasyām' ityādirnirddeśāt| adhikāre dvau pakṣau--artādhikāraḥ, śabdādhikāra iti| tatrādye pakṣe pūrvasūtre kṛtākṣiptasya dhāterhrasvena viśeṣaṇāttadantaṃ hrasvaśabdena pratyāyitamiti ihāpi tadantasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| śabdādhikāre tu hrasvaśabda evātrānuvarttate, na pūrvaḥ prakṛto'rthaḥ, na ceha kiñcidviśeṣyamastīti tadantavidhyabhāvād hrasva evāgamī bhavati| tatreha dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrita ityāha--hrasva evātrāgamīti| kimevaṃ sati siddhaṃ bhavati? tatrāha--teneti| yadi tu hrasvāntasya tuk syāt, tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt| hrasvamātre tvāgamini nāyamabhyāsasyāvayavo haliti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| kathaṃ punarhrasva agamini gugabhyāsagrahaṇena na gṛhyata ityata āha--nāvayavāvayava iti| itikaraṇo hetau| yadyavayavāvayavassamudāyāvayavo na bhavati, evaṃ tarhi śerata ityatra rūḍāgamaḥ sārvadhātukāvayavasyādādeśasyāvayava iti so'pi sārvadhātukasya samudāyasyāvayavo na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ ? `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' iti guṇo na syāt; ruṭā vyavadhānāt| sa hyavayavabhaktastameva na vyavadadhyāt, sārvadhātukaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| kutaścaiṣa nyāyaḥ--`avayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na bhavati' iti ? loke tāvaddevadattāvayavasya hastasyāvayavo'ṅgulirdevadattasyāpyavayavo bhavatyeva--sāṅgulirdevadatta iti| tasmādayamatrābhiprāyaḥ--`cha āhbhāṅośca' ityeka eva yogaḥ karttavyaḥ, cakārādanantarasya prākkṛtasya ca; evaṃ siddhe yadyogavibhāgaṃ cakāraṃ ca karoti, tasyaitprayojanam--prakṛtasya tadantasya prahāṇena kevalaṃ hrasvamevānuvarttayiṣyāmiti| yadi tvāgamastuk samudāyasyāvayavaḥ syād, eṣa yatno'narthakaḥ syāditi ||

āṅmāhośca || 6.1.74 ||
āṅbhāḍorṅidviśṣṭayorupādāne prayojanamāhaḥ--āṅo ṅita iti| arthaviśeṣasampādanārthaṃ ṅidviśiṣṭayorupādānamityarthaḥ| ācchāyāyā iti| `āṅ maryādāvacane' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, `pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī| ācchāyamiti| `āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| mācchidaditi| `irito vā' ityaṅ|
āchāyā, ācchāyeti| smaraṇe cātrākāraḥ, `vākyasmaraṇayoraṅit'| prameti| pramūrvānmāṅaḥ `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅ, atra dhātorṅitve'pi ṭābanto na ṅit, `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti lākṣaṇīkasyāpyasya grahaṇasya prasaṅgaḥ| atrobhayatrāpi `padāntādvā' iti vikalpa eva bhavati ||

dīrghāt || 6.1.75 ||
`abhayanirddeśe pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān', acaritārthā ca pañcamī, tena dīrghāditi pañcamyā cha ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyāṃ chakārasyaiva tukā bhavitavyamiti bhrāntimapākāroti--dīrghātparo ya ityādi| anena pañcamyā anvayo darśitaḥ, prakramābhedāya tu chakārasya nimittatvam, dīghasya ca kāryitvaṃ darśayati| tasminpūrvasya tasyaiva dīrghasyeti| atra ca liṅgam--`śācchā', `vibhāṣāsenāsurācchāyā' ityādi nirddeśaḥ, avadhyavadhimadbhāvasya vivakṣitatvādadhikaraṇabhāvasya ca vivakṣitatvāt `tasminpūrvasya' iti saptamī kṛtā| hrīcchatīti| `hrīccha lajjāyām'| mlecchatītiṣa| `mleccha avyakte śabde'| apacācchāyata iti| `cho chedane', yaṅ, `dīrgho'kitaḥ'||

padāntādvā || 6.1.76 ||
prakṛtena dīrghaṇa padaviśeṣaṇādeva tadantavidhau siddhe'ntagrahaṇampadāntavidhirayaṃ tug yathā syāt, padavidhirmā bhūditi| tena samarthaparibhāṣānupasthānāt--tiṣṭhatu kumārīcchatraṃ hara devadattasyetyatrāpi vikalpo bhavati ||

iko yaṇaci || 6.1.77 ||
iko yaṇādeśo bhavatīti| ikāṃ yaṇāṃ ca sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati, āntaryato vā vyavasthā| ika iti kim? vyañjanasya mā bhūt--vāgratra| kutvajaśtavayorasiddhatvācchakārasya yakāraḥ prāpnoti| yatra ca kutvāderaprasaṅgo'padānte pacatīti, tatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `dīrghāt' iti varttete, tacca tatraiva pañcamīnirddeśe'pi sthānibūtamihāpi tathaivānuvartate| yadi dīrghasya yaṇ bhavati, kathaṃ dadhyatra madhvatreti, `hrasvasya' ityetadapyanuvarttate, tadevaṃ hrasvadīrghayoryaṇvidhānānna vyañjanasya prasaṅga ? plutasya ca prakṛtibhāvena bhavitavyam, cayanam, cāyaka ityādāvecāmayādayo'pavādāḥ, nāprāpte tasmiṃstadārambhāt ? devendraḥ, khaṭvaudanamityādau guṇavṛddhī bādhike bhaviṣyataḥ, yathā--satyapīggrahaṇe dadhīndrādau savarṇa dīrghatvam, ato nārtha haggrahaṇena ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--iko yaṇevāci yathā syād, yadyadanyatprāpnoti tanmā bhūditi| kiñcānyat prāpnoti ? śākalm| na ca tasyāpyatyantabādhaḥ; ārambhasāmarthyāt| evaṃ sati sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedha iti yatpūrvācāryaiḥ smaryate tadaneneggrahaṇena sampādyate|
ikaḥ plutapūrvasyeti| plutaḥ pūrvo yasmātsa tathoktaḥ, plutātparasyetyarthaḥ| bho 3 i indreti| bho-i-indra iti sthite bhośabdasya gītivaśāt plutaḥ, ikāraḥ svarādipāṭhānnipāta pragṛhyasaṃjñakaḥ, tasya prakṛtibhāve prāpte yaṇvidhīyate, savarṇadīrghabādhanārthamityetattvādyaprāptyabhiprāyeṇoktam| plutapūrvasyeti| plutagrahaṇamapi mātrikadvimātrikavyatiriktācparigrahārtham, tena caturmātrādāvapi bhavati, tathā ca chandogā gāyanti, sāmanyeva cāyamiṣyate, bhoyindraṃ gāyatītyetadapi sāmagasyānukaraṇam| evaṃ tāvadbhāṣye sthitam, vṛttāvapyevameva draṣṭavyam ||

vānto yi pratyaye || 6.1.78 ||
kasya punarayaṃ vāntādeśaḥ ? eca iti varttate| yadyevamedaitorapi prāpnoti--ceyam, jeyam, raiyatīti? evaṃ tarhi vāntagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityeva| ihāpe tarhyādeśaḥ prāpnoti--ceyam, jeyamiti? `kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe', `kryyastadarthe' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--ecau yadi bhavati kṣijyoreveti| evamapi raiyatītyatrāyādeśaḥ prāpnoti? raiśabdaśchāndasaḥ, `dṛśṭānuvidhiśchandasi'| bhāṣāyāṃ tu raiśabdaprayogo bhāṣyavirodhādasādhuḥ| yadvaivaṃ niyama āśrayiṣyate--anauṣṭhasya yadi bhavati kṣijyoreveti; tataḥ `śakyārthe' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, kṣijyorapi śakyārtha eveti ? sidhyati; sūtrasya tu ko nirvahaḥ ? ucyate; vāntaśabdo'yaṃ sannihite vānte varttate, na yatra kutracit; sannihitaścaudautsthānikaḥ pūrvatra, yathāsaṃkhyāsambandhāt| tatra yathā yaḥ kaścana vāntādeśo na bhavati, tathānyasthāniko na bhaviṣyati; viśiṣṭasyaiva sannidhānāt| tadidamuktam--yo'yamecaḥ sthāne iti| bābhravya iti| `madhubabhravorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' iti yañ| maṇkaḍuśabdo gargādi| śaṅkupicuśabdābhyām `tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtau' ityatrārthe `ugavādibhyo yat' | nāvā tāryaṃ nāvyam, nauvayodharma' ityādinā yat|

adhvaparimāṇe ceti| bhāṣārthamidam| gavyūtiḥ-krośayugam ||
dhātaustannimittasyaiva|| dhātoriti kimiti| na tāvadaviśeṣeṇa niyamaprasaṅgaḥ--
yi pratyaye yadi bhavati tannimittasyaiveti; evaṃ hi `vānto yi pratyaye tannimittasya' iti viśiṣṭavidhirāśrayaṇīyaḥ, yogavibhāga evakāro niyama iti sarvametadanarthakamāpadyeta| tasmādasatyapi dhātugrahaṇe viśiṣṭaviṣayo niyamo bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ| sa tu viśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ prātipadakamapi sambhāvyetetyuttaram| vābhravya ityatraiva syāditi| ecastannimittatvāt| atra na syāditi| viparyayāt| upoyata iti| veñaḥkarmaṇi laṭa, ātmanepadam, yak, yajñāditvātsaṃprasāraṇam, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ', tasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāddhātugrahaṇena grahaṇam| oyate iti| karmaṇyeva laṅ| lauyamāniriti| `ata iñ' ādivṛddhiḥ| nanu cātra guṇaḥ padadvayāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, vṛddhirapi bāhyataddhitāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaiva ? satyam; auyatetyatraitadubhayaṃ nāsti, tadarthamavaśyaṃ yoga ārabdhavyaḥ, ārabdhenaiva siddhatvādupoyate ityādikaṃ pratyudāhṛtam|
evakārakaraṇaṃ kimiti| siddhe satyārambho niyamārthatve hetuḥ, na tvevakārakaraṇamapīti praśnaḥ| iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārtha ityuttaram ||

kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe || 6.1.81 ||
udāharaṇe śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ, pratyudāharaṇe tvāvaśyake ||

krayyastadarthe || 6.1.82 ||
krayya ityatra pratyayārthaśca karma vidyate, karmaṇi kṛtyavidhānāt prakṛtyarthaśca dravyavinimayaḥ, tatra pratyayārthaḥ pradhānam, prakṛtyarthastūpasarjanam, tatra yadi prādhānyāttadityanena pratyayārthaḥ parāmṛśyameva krayyaśabdasya tasminnarthe vṛtternārthastadarthagrahaṇena| atha so'rtho yasya tadarthaḥ śabdastasminnabhidheya ityarthaḥ ? tadapyayuktam; śabdasya vṛttyasambhavāt| ato guṇībhūto'pi prakṛtyarthe eva nirddaśyata iti darśayati--tadarthe krayārthaṃ yattasminnabhidheya iti| krayārthaṃ yaḥ prasārita iti| kretāraḥ krīṇīyuriti buddhyā''ṇe yadvyavasthāpitamityrathaḥ| kreyamiti| mūlyenopādeyamityarthaḥ|
