na cehāsti krayyamiti| āpaṇe vikrayāya prasāritaṃ dhānyaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ| kecittu krayyaśabde krīṇātirvikraye varttata ityāhuḥ| tenāpaṇe vikrayāya prasāritaṃ dravyam `krayyam' ityucyate ||

bhayyapravayye cacchandasi || 6.1.83 ||
vītyetasyeti| `vī gatyādiṣu', `ajervyaghañapoḥ' iti vā|
hradayyā iti| ākārasyāyādeśaḥ ||

ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ || vakṣyamāṇaprakaraṇe paurvāparyeṇāvasthitau nirdiśyete--ādaci, ādecītyādi, tayoḥ pūrvaparayoḥ sthāne vakṣayamāṇo guṇādirekādeśo bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ |
atha pūrvaparayoriti kimartham? sthāninirddeśārtham, asati hi tasmin `ādguṇaḥ' ityādau sthāninirddeśābhāvāt kakya guṇādirādeśaḥ syāt| naitadasti prayojanam, ādityādikā pañcamī acītyādikāyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati, sā ca tasyāstena tayoreva pūrvaparayorguṇo bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena ? tadāha--pūrvaparagrahaṇamityādi| dvayorādeśapratipattyarthamiti| yugapadādeśapratipattyarthamityarthaḥ.| asati tu tasminkasya syāt? ityata nobhe saptamīpañcamyāviki| nobhe prakalpike bhavataḥ, yugapanna prakalpike bhavata ityarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| tatra `ādguṇaḥ' ityatrācītyeṣā saptamī yaṇādividhau caritārthā; ādityeṣā tu pañcamī na kvaciccaritārthā, tataśca saiva saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati ityaca eva sthāne guṇaḥ syād| `vṛddhireci' ityatra tu guṇavidhau pañcamī kṛtārtheti tasyāḥ `eci' iti saptamyakṛtārthā ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayedityavarṇasyaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt| `upasargādṛti dhātau' ityādau dvayorapyakṛtārthatve'pi paryāyeṇa parasparaṣaṣṭhīprakalṛptiḥ syāt, na yugapatkāryitvaṃ nimittatvaṃ ca; dvayoryugapadvirodhāt, tataśca kāryamapi paryāyeṇa syāt| tasmātpūrvaparayoriti vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam; ekagrahaṇasāmarthyād| `antādivacca' iti vacanācca pūrvaparayordvayorevādeśo bhavaṣyati, nānyatarasya ? satyam; sukhapratipatyarthaṃ tu pūrvaparayorityuktam; anyathā yugapat ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanadvāreṇa vivakṣitapratipattau pratipattigauravaṃ syāt |
atha kimarthamekagrahaṇam, prathamanirdiṣṭamatikramya caramanirdiṣṭasya `pūrvaparayoḥ' ityasya prāk prayojanamuktam; pāṭhakramādarthakamasya balīyastvāt| katham ? sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyam, kāryasya ca guṇāderviśeṣaṇamekagraṃhaṇam| nanu ca `ādguṇaḥ' ityādāvekasyaivādeśasya sūtre upādānam, saṃkhyāyā vivakṣitatvādupāttasaṃkhyātyāge kāraṇābhāvāt, tataścaika eva guṇādirādeśo bhaviṣyati| syādetat--ādeśasya vidheyatayā prādhānyāt pradhāne ca grahaṃ sammārṣṭītyādau saṃkhyāyā avivakṣitatvādanekādeśaprasaṅga iti ? tadasataḥ grahaṃ śeṣitayoddiśca sammārgo hi vidhīyate, śāstrāntare ca vihitaṃ śeṣetvamupagacchati, śāstrāntaro ca vijñātā grahāḥ saṃkhyāntarānvitāḥ, tatraikatvavivakṣāyāṃ vākyabhedaḥ prasajyeteti kṛtvā grahaikatvamavivakṣitamucyate| naivaṃ guṇādirādeśa ityekatvaṃ vivakṣitam; `prājāpatyā nava grahāḥ' iti śāstrāntaravihitanavagrahoddeśena saṃskāraḥ sammārgo vidhīyate, tatra śrutamapyekatvaṃ noddeśyakoṭau niveśayituṃ śakyate; tatra saṃkhyāntarānvitatayā vihitatvāt| tataśca tadvivakṣāyāṃ tadapi vidheyaṃ syāt, tataśca vākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ| vacanavyaktibhedādyo grahastaṃ sammāṣṭi, taṃ caikamiti| iha tu vidheyatayā guṇādeḥ prādhānye'pi viśiṣṭavidhisambhavād na vākyabedaprasaṅgaḥ, avivakṣākāraṇābhāvādviyakṣitamekatvaṃ lokavat, tadyathā--loke'nayormṛtpiṇkaḍayorghaṭaṃ kurviti, na cocyate ekamiti ekameva cāsau karoti| na cārthaprakaraṇādinā tatraikasya karaṇam, tadabhāve'pi darśanāttasmānnārtha ekagrahaṇena? tatrāha--ekagrahaṃ pṛthagādeśanivṛttyarthamiti| yathā punaḥ pṛthagādeśaprasaṅgastathā darśayati--sthānibhedāditi| `pūrvaparayoḥ' iti nirddeśātsthānibhedaḥ pratīyate, tataśca tadvaśādādeśe'pi śrutamapyekatvamavivakṣitaṃ syādityanekādeśaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ| avaśyaṃ caitadevamabhyupagantavyamiti dṛṣṭāntena darśayati| bhinnādiṣu natvavaditi| yathā `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ' iti natvamekatvāvivakṣayā pratisthāni bhavati, tadvadatrāpītyarthaḥ|
bhāṣye tvekagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātm| na tāvad guṇabhūtasthānyanurodhena pradhānasyādeśasya bhedakalpanā yuktā, pradhānānurodhī hī guṇo bhavati,na punarguṇānurodhī pradānam| yaccoktam--bhinnādiṣu nanvavaditi, tatra na khalu natvavidhāvekatvasyāvivakṣitatayā dvau nakārau bhavataḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasya ceti cakārādvākyabhedo'vagamyate| tatra pūrveṇa niṣṭhāto natvam, pareṇa dhātudakārasya, iha ca `ubhausābhyāsasya' iti prāṇiṇiṣatītyupasargādanantarasya nakārasya `aniteḥ' ityeva ṇaatve siddhe sābhyāsasyeteyetāvataiva dvayornakārayormatvaṃ siddhamiti sthāninirddeśārthamubhaugrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam--ubhau nakārau ṇatvamāpadyate iti| tasmādādeśārthamubhaugrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate--sābyāsasyāniterthau nakārau dvau tayorubhau ṇau bhavata iti| tenātrāpi naikatvasyāvivakṣitatvād dvayordvau bhavataḥ, kintūbhaugrahaṇāditi na kaściddoṣaḥ|
iha śrutismṛtivihitaṃ karma kiñcitsakṛdanuṣṭhīyate, yathā--upanayanam, ādhānam, ācamanamiti; na hyupanītaḥ punarupanīyate, nāpyagnyāhitaḥ punaragnīnādhatte, nāpyācāntaḥ punarācāmati| asati nimitte, kiñcidasakṛdyathā--jyotiṣṭo mādayaḥ. yathā--`pūrvavayā brāhmaṇaḥ pratyuttheyaḥ' iti yo yo vṛddhavayāstasya tasyāgamanaṃ pratyutthīyate| `brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ', `surā na peyā' iti prativyaktiviṣedho'nuṣṭhīyate, na punarekaṃ brāhmaṇamahatvaikāṃ ca surāmapītvānyatra kāmacāraḥ| vyākaraṇaṃ ca smṛtiḥ, tadiha `ādguṇaḥ' ityanayā smṛtyā `guṇaḥ karttavyaḥ' iti codite yadi sakṛdanuṣṭhānaṃ khaṭvendra ityekasyāṃ vyaktau guṇe kṛte kṛtaḥ śāstrārtha iti kṛtvā mālendra ityādiṣu na kriyeta, tasmātpratyutthānādivadāvarttate| kiṃ punaratra nibhandhanam--kiñcitsakṛtkriyate, kiñcitpunaḥ punariti? upanayanaṃ tāvanmāṇavakasya saṃskāraḥ, sakṛccāsau saṃskṛto'dhyayanādiṣu yogyo bhavati, ādhānamapyagnisaṃskārārtham, sampanneṣvagniṣu prayojanābāvātpunarna kriyate, ācamanamapi śaucārthamitya sati nimitte punarna kriyate| jyotiṣṭomādayastu nityāścetpratyavāyaparihārāya vasante kriyante; atha kāmyāḥ `amuṣmin loka enamapsaraso jāyā bhūtvopaśerate iti tatastamabhyudayam', bhūyobhūyaḥ parīpsubhiḥ punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyante| pūrvavayobrāhmaṇapratyutthānākaraṇe doṣaḥ, karaṇe cābyudayo darśitaḥ--
`ūrdhva prāṇā hyutkāmanti yūnaḥ sthāvira āyati|
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastān pratipadyate'|| iti|
tacca pratyāgamanamaviśiṣṭam, ato doṣanirhāṇātha punaḥ punaranuṣṭhīyante| naimittikatvādvā pratinimittamāvṛttiḥ| tathā brāhmaṇavadhe ca surāpāne ca do, uktaḥ| sa brāhmaṇamātre surāmātre ca bhavati, tato doṣavanto mā bhūmeti sarvatraivānuṣṭhīyate| iha śabdasya jñāne prayoge cābhyudayo daśitaḥ--`ekaḥ śabda samyag jñātaḥ suprayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhug bhavati' iti| pratyavāyaśca yājñe karmaṇyapaśabduprayoge darśitaḥ--`te'surā helayaḥ' iti, `āhitāgnirapaśabdaṃ prayujya' iti ca| ata eva tadapi guṇādika punaḥpunaranuṣṭhīyate| tadevaṃ nityatvaṃ naimittikatvaṃ kāmyatvaṃ bhūyobūyo'nuṣṭhānanibandhanam| etacca sarvaśāstrasādhāraṇamapi vāttikakāreṇa proktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇopapāditamityasmābhirapyatraiva pratyapādi ||

antādivacca || 6.1.85 ||
antādiśabdayoravayavaviśeṣavācitvādavayaviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ pavaparayorityanuvṛttestasya ca vakṣyamāṇaguṇādyādeśaviśeṣaṇatvādekādesa iti labhyate, tadidamuktam--ekaḥ pūrvaparayoriti varttata ityādi| kaḥ punaratrātideśārthaḥ, kiṃ yāvekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau tayorantādivadbhavati? kiṃ vā--akṛta ekādeśe tamevaikādeśamapekṣya yau pūrvaparau samudāyau tayorantādivadbhavatīti ? yadi vā--ekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau varṇai, tayoḥ samudāyayorantādī, yatorekādeśo'pyantādivadbhavatīti ? tatrādyapakṣastāvanna sambhavati, ekādeśena pūparayostatsthāninornivarttitatvāt! kathamasatoḥ pūrva parayorantādivatsyāt! dvitīye pakṣe vṛkṣāvityatra vṛkṣa-au iti sthite subasuporekādeśaḥ subapekṣasya kasyacitparasyābhāvātparādivanna syāt ?
ataḥ tṛtīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate| nanvayamapi pakṣo na sambhavatyeva| tathā hi--brahmabandhūrityatra brahmabandhu-ū iti sthite pūrvo varṇa ukāro yasyānto brahmabandhuśabdasya sa ekādeśe nāstyeva, ukārasya nivarttitatvāt; yaścāsti dhakārānto na tasyānta ekādeśasya sthānī ukāraḥ, anārambhakatvāt? evaṃ tarhi yadv‌yapadeśayuktasya sthāninau pūrvaparāvantādī tadvyapadeśayuktasyaikādeśo'pyantādivadityarthaḥ| edaduktaṃ bhavati--ekādeśātprāk pūrvaparayoḥ pṛthagavasthitayostābhyāṃ saha yo vyapadeśaḥ pūrvaparasamudāyaviṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ--prātipadikamiti vā, subantamiti vā, sa vyapadeśa ekādeśe kṛte'pi bhavatīti| tadidamuktam--yathā tasyānta ādirvā tadantarbhūta ityādi| tasyetyanena ekādeśātprāgavasthitaḥ pūrvaḥ paraśca samudāyo nirddiśyate, antādiśabdābhāyāṃ ca ekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau| tadgrahaṇīna gṛhyata ityanenāpi `etaduktaṃ bhavati' ityārambhāyantaraṃ ca ekādeśasya sthāninau pūrvaparau| tadgrahaṇena gṛhyata ityanenāpi `etaduktaṃ bhavati' ityārabhyānantaraṃ yaduktamasmābhistaddarśitam| eṣo'tideśārtha iti| atidiśyata ityatideśaḥ, atideśaścāsāvarthaścetyatidesārthaḥ karmadhārayo'yamartho'trātidiśyata ityarthaḥ|
varṇāśrayavidāvityādi| varṇasvarūpamāśritya yadvidhīyate na tadantādivadbhāvenātidiśyata ityarthaḥ| tatkatham? nātra tādrūpyanibandhanaṃ kāryamatidiśyate, yo'yamānta ādirvā prāgekādeśādavasthitaḥ pūrvaḥ paraśca tadvadayamekādeśo bhavati| tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ labhata iti| evaṃ ca tadvaccetyeva vaktvya stāt, tacchabdena pūrvāparau parāmṛśyate| evaṃ hi siddhe'ntādivaditi vacanādantāditvaprayuktaṃ kāryamekādeśasya bhavatu, pūrvaparasvarūpaprayuktaṃ tu kāryaṃ kena bhavet ! liṅgaṃ cātra bhavati tukyasiddhavacanam; anyathā adhītyetyādāvekādeśasyādivadbhāvādeva tukaḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| khaṭvābhiriti| taparakaraṇaṃ tu yatraikādeśo nāsti tadarthaṃ syāt--śubhaṃyābhiriti| juhāveti| `abhyastasya ca' iti hvayateḥ samprasāraṇe kṛte juhu-ā iti yatpūrvarūpatvamākārasya tannādivadbhāvati, yo'yamādirākārastadvanna bhavati, tena `āta au ṇalaḥ' iti na bhavati| asyai aśva iti| syāṭo vibhaktyekārasya yo'yaṃ `vṛddhireci' iti vṛddhirekādeśaḥ sa parasyādivanna bhavati, tena `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti na bhavati| yatra ca yugapadubhayamāśrīyate--antaścādiśca, tatrāpyantādivadbhāvo na bhavati, yathā `eteliṅi' iti hrasvatvamupasargātparasyeṇo vidhīyamānam-abhīyātparīyādityādau na bhavati| yadi hyayamekādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavad buddhyā gṛhyeta, sa tadānīmeva kathaṃ paraṃ pratyādivatsyāt! evaṃ paraṃ pratyādivattve tadānīmeva pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbāvo'pyanupapannaḥ; ekasyobhayāpekṣayā yugapatpāratantryasya virodhāt |
pūrvāpareti| yo yena nivartyate sa tasya stānī, yathā--bhuvo'stiḥ| samudāyaścātra nivartyate, tataśca tatprayuktameva kārthaṃ sthānivadbāvātsyād yadi kiñcidasti, na tu pratyekaṃ pūrvaparayuktm| syādetad--avayayorapi nivartyamānatvāttayorapi sthānitvam? ityata āha--tatreti| itikaraṇadvayamapi hetau| tatra samudāye sthāninyavayavayoryatsthānitvaṃ tadānumānikamavayavanivṛttimantareṇāvayavino nivarttayitumaśakyatvādavayavayornivṛttiḥ, na tvādiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ| tataśca tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ sthānivadbhāvānna prāpnoti; sākṣācchrutasyaiva ca sthāninastatrāśrayaṇāt| iṣyate ca tadarthamantādivadbhāvo vidhīyate| nanu viparītamidam--avayavayorānumānikaṃ sthānitvamiti ? `pūrvaparayoḥ' iti dvirvacananirddeśāt tayoreva sthānitvaṃ śrutaṃ na samudāyasya śabdo'sti, dvayostu nivartamānayorarthātsamudāyo nivartata ityetāvat| tathā ca pūrvasūtre `sthānibedādbhinnādiṣu natvavat' ityuktam| taccānyatrāpi uktam--yo hyubhayasthāne bhavati labhate so'nyataravyapadeśam, tena khaṭvarśya ityatra pararatvaṃ bhavatyṛkārasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaḥ, kathama? `sthānivadādeśaḥ' ityatra sthāniśabdasya sam‌bandhiśabdatvādevādeśaparigrahe siddhe ādeśagrahaṇamānumānikasyāpyādeśasya sthānivadbhāvārtham, tataśca sthānyapyānumānika āśritaḥ, yathā `eruḥ' pacatvityatra | atra hi ikāreṇekārāntaḥ stānyanumīyate, ukāreṇāpyukārānta ādeśaḥ, tasya sthānivadbhāvāt `tiṅntaṃ padam' iti padasaṃjñā bhavati| evamapyatrāvayavayorānumānike sthānitve siddhaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ ? evaṃ tarhyanalvidhau sthānivadbāva uktaḥ alvidhyarthamidam, yathā--kṣīrapeṇa, surāpeṇottarapadavibhaktyorekādeśasyāntavadbhāvāt `ekājuttarapade ṇaḥ' iti ṇatvamalvidhirapi bhavati| nanu ca `analvidhau' iti pratiṣedhaḥ sthānyalāśrayeṣveva kāryeṣu, asaya tvekādeśasyottarapadaṃ pratyavayavatvameva sthānivattvena prārthanīyam; actvaṃ tu svata eva siddam, tataśca yathā--aruditāmityatra svāśrayaṃ valāditvaṃ sthānivadbāvakṛtaṃ ca sārvadātukatvamāśritya `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke'itīṅ bhavati, tadvadihāpi sthānivaddhāvakṛtamuttarapadāvalayavatvaṃ svāśrayaṃ cāctvamāśritya ṇatvaṃ bhavati| tattu sthānyalkharūpanibandhanam, tatreṣyata eva, yathā khaṭvābhirityādāvaisbhāvādi| tasmāt cintyabhasya prayojanam ||

ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ || 6.1.86 ||
ṣatve tuki ceti| ṣatvaśāstre, tukśāstre cetyarthaḥ| ekādeśa iti| ekādeśaśāstram `ādguṇaḥ' ityādītyarthaḥ| asiddho bhavatīti| siddhaḥ-niṣpannaḥ, tato'nyo'siddhaḥ| tatra śāstrasvarūpaṃ tāvanniṣpannamiti paratra paraśabdaprayogādivārtho'vagamyate, tatkāryakaraṇācca sādṛśyam, tadāha--siddhakāryāṇi na karotītyartha iti| ṣatvatukśāstrasannidhāvekādeśaśāstraṃ svakāryamekādeśākhyaṃ kāryaṃ na karoti-na pravarttayati, na pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| sūtrasya prayojanamāhṛ--asiddhavacanamiti| ādeśe kṛte yatkāryaṃ taddhetukaṃ prāpnoti tadādeśalakṣaṇam, ādeso lakṣaṇaṃ nimittamasyeti kṛtvā; tasya pratiṣedhārthamasiddhavacanam| utsargaḥ-sthānī, sāmānyotsṛṣṭatvāt sa lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam, tasya bhāvaḥ pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ cāsiddhavacanam| ko'sicaditi| `lipisicihvaśca' iti cleraṅ, kaśabdātsorutvam, `ato roraplutādalute' ityutvam, guṇaḥ| eṅaḥ padāntādatīti| parampratyādivadbhāvāditi| ādivadbhāve hi osicadityetadantaṃ padam, tataḥ sakāraḥ padādirna bhavatīti `sātpadādyoḥ' iti niṣedhābhāvādekādeśamokāramiṇamāśritya ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadasiddhatvānna bhavati| asiddhatve hi ṣatvaśāstraṃ pratyekādeśaśāstrasyāpratipādakatvāt ko asicadityevamavasthitaṃ padarūpaṃ bhavati, tatrākāreṇa vyavadhānātṣatvābhāvaḥ| ko'syeti| idamaḥ ṣaṣṭyekavacanam, tyadādyatvam, `ṭāṅasiṅsāminātsyāḥ' iti syādeśaḥ, hali lopaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| evamādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇāni darśitāni|
itarasya darśayati--adhītya, pretyeti| ekādeśasyāsiddhatvādityādi| asiddhatve hitukśāstrasannidhāvadhi-i-iyetyeva sthitaṃ padarūpaṃ bhavati, tataśca hrasvāśrayastuk pravarttate| yadi tu mukhyasyaikādeśasyaiva kāryasyāsiddhatvamucyate, tadā ṣatve nāsti doṣaḥ, katham? okārastāvatsvakāryaṃ ṣatvaṃ na karoti, yau tu tataḥ pūrvau kakārayakārau tadāśrayamapi ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, tenaivaukāreṇa vyavadhānāt| tuki neṣṭasiddhiḥ| katham ? ekādeśena hrasvasya nivatitatvāt, na caikādeśaḥ svakāryaṃ na karoti| anena sthāninaḥ pratyāvṛttiḥ śakyā, tasmāttiḥ śakyā, tasmāttuki śāstrāsiddhatvāmevāśrayaṇīyam| āha ca--sthānivadvacanānarthakyaṃ ca śāstrāsiddhatvāditi|

samprasāraṇaṅīṭsviti| samprasāraṇe ṅau iṭi ca ya ekādeśastasyāsiddhatvapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| śakahūṣviti| śakān hvayatīti yajñāditvātsamprasāraṇaṃ pūrvatvam, kvip, `halaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ| parivīṣviti| vyeñaḥ paripūrvāt kvibādi pūrvavat| asiddhatvātṣatvaṃ na prāpnotīti| pūrvarūpasyāsiddhatve hi śakahu-ā ityevamavasthitaṃ padarūpaṃ bhavati| vṛkṣecchatramiti, apacecchatramiti| pacerlaṅ, uttamaikavacanamiṭ śap| ādguṇasyāsiddhatvāditi| asiddhatve hi tasya vṛkṣa i cchatram, apaca i cchatramityevamavasthitaṃ padarūpaṃ bhavati| atra samprasāraṇe tāvatpratiṣedho na vaktvyaḥ, ekādeśo'siddha ityucyate, na cātraikādeśaṃ paśyāmaḥ; dīrgheṇa nivarttitatvāt| na cadīrghasya sthānivadbhāvādekādeśagrahaṇena grahaṇam; alvidhitvāt| ṅiṭostu pratiṣedho vaktavya eva|
atha vā--lāghavārthaṃ padasyeti vaktavyam| antādigrahaṇaṃ ca pūrvasūtrādanuvarttanīyam, tena padāntasya padādeśca ya ekādeśaḥ so'siddha ityeṣo'rtho bhavati| yadyevam, supippalā oṣadhīskṛdhītyatrauṣadhiśabdād dvitoyābahuvacanam, `auṣadheścavibhaktāvaprathamāyām' iti dīrghaḥ, tataḥ prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ, rutvavisarjanīyau| atraidānīm `kaḥkaratkaratikṛti' iti visarjanāyasya satvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti;`padāntapadādyoḥ' iti vacanāt| ekādeśasyāsiddhatvābhāvād iṇa uttaro visarjanīya iti `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti, aviśeṣeṇāsiddhatve oṣadhī-as kṛdhītyevamavasthānādiṇa uttaratvābhāvātṣatvāprasaṅgātsatvaṃ sidhyati ? jñāpakātsiddham; yadayaṃ kaskādiṣu bhrātuṣputraśabdaṃ paṭhati, tajjñāpayati--naikādeśātparasya visarjanīyasya ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti| yadi syād, bhrātṛśabdānṅasi `ṛta ud' ityuttve ekādeśe rapare ca kṛte `rātsasya' iti sakāralope kṛte ṣaṣṭhīsamāse `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ' ityaluki rephasya visarjanīye `ṛta ud' ityukārasyaikādeśasya siddhatvāt `idudupadhasya ca' ityeva ṣatve siddhe kaskādiṣu tanna paṭhet, paṭhati ca, tato jñāyate--naikādeśātparasya ṣatvamiti| śakahūṣvityatrāpi tarhi na prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tulyajātīyasya jñāpakaṃ bhavati| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ ? yaḥ kupvoranantaraḥ. iha caṭa veñaḥ kvipi samprasāraṇe pūrvatve ca `hrasvasya piti kṛti' iti tuki prāpte pūrvatvasya sūtreṇāsiddhatve prāpte `padāntapadādyoḥ' iti vacanādasiddhatvābhāvāduditi tugbhavatyeva| na hi u-ā ityekādeśātprāgavastāyāmākāraḥ padāntaḥ| nāpyakāraḥ padādiḥ; vibhakterabhāvāt| na caikādeśātprāgeva kṛdantatvādvibhaktayutpattiḥ; ekādeśasyāntaraṅgatvāt| athāpi prāgeva vibhaktyutpattiḥ; evamapi u-āsu iti sthite ukāraḥ padādiḥ sakāraḥ padāntaḥ, subantaṃ hi padam, na tu tataḥ pūrvam| athāpi bhyāmprabhṛtau u-ābhyamiti sthite `svādiṣu'iti padasaṃjñāyāṃ padāntapadādyorekādeśaḥ ? tathāpi na dosaḥ; `pūrvaparayoḥ' iti varttate, antādigrahaṇañca; tatra yathāsaṃkyasambandhātpūrvapadasya yo'ntaḥ parasya cādistayorekādeśo'siddha ityarthaḥ sampadyate| ākāraścātra padādirna bhavati, nāpyukāraḥ padānta ityasiddhatvāttug bhavatyeva|
kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣatvatukorekādeśasyāsitaddhatvāducyate, yāvatā dvipadāśrayatvād bahiraṅgasyaikādeśasyaikapadāśrayatvenāntaraṅgayoḥ ṣatvatukoḥ `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityevāsiddhatvaṃ siddham? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etajjñāpayati--`yatra bahiraṅgasyāntaraṅgasya vā'corānantaya nimittatvenāśritaṃ tatra bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na pravarttate' iti| tenākṣadyūrityatra bahiraṅgasyāpyūṭho'siddhtavābhāvādyaṇādeśaḥ siddho bhavati| ayamevārthaḥ paribhāṣārūpeṇa paṭhyate `nājānantaryaṃ bahiṣṭvapraklṛptiḥ' iti ||

ādguṇaḥ || 6.1.87 ||
guṇagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā'cīti varttate, `ekaḥ pūrvaparayo' iti ca, tatrāntaryataḥ kaṇṭhatālavyayorakārekārayoḥ sthāne tādṛśa evaikāro bhaviṣyati, kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyayoścākārokārayoḥ sthāne tādṛśa evaukāro bhaviṣyati, kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyayoścākārokārayoḥ sthāne tādṛśa evaukāro bhaviṣyati; caikāraukārayorapi prasaṅgaḥ, vṛddirecīti niyamāt ? tadidānīṃ niyamārtham, aicoranenaiva siddhatvāt, ecyeva vṛddhibharvati| ubhayathā niyamaśca vyākhyāsyate, vṛddhirevaicīti| ira tarhi khaṭvarśyaḥ mālārśya iti pramāṇato'ntaratamo mūrddhanta ṛkāraḥ prāpnāti ? māṇa eva raparo bhavatīti sthānat ubharorantaratamaḥ. ākārastarhi prāpnoti ? `ipasargādṛti dhātau' ityetannyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati---ṛti dhātāvevākāro nānyatreti| prutastarhi prāpnoti ----khaṭvendraḥ, `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ', plutavidāne hi sati yasminviṣe bluto vihitastasminnapyanainaiva bhāvyam ? asminkarttavye āṣṭamikasya plutasyāsiddhatvāt, tataśca pakṣe'nuvādadoṣapasaṅgat plugo na bhavatīti|
iha tarhi śaṭvā īṣā khaṭveṣā,śaṭvā ūḍhā khaṭveḍhā, āntaryataścaturmātra ādeśaḥ prāpnoti, guṇagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe guṇasaṃjñāyānparakaraṇaṃ sarvārthamiti trimātracaturmātrāṇāmaguṇatvādaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmād guṇagrahaṇam| ślekau cātra bhavata----
ādeśaśced guṇaḥ kena sthāne'ntaratamo hi sāḥ|
aidautau naici tāvuktāvṛkāro nobhayantaraḥ ||
ākāro narttidhātau sa plataśca viṣaye smṛta|
āntaryāttricaturmātro guṇaśca taparaḥ samṛtaḥ ||
iha vṛkṣaśabdānṅiḥ, vṛkṣa-i-indramiti sthite akārekāyorguṇaśca prāpnotīkārayoḥ savarṇadīrghaśca, tatra śabdaparavipratiṣedhāddīrghaprasaṅgaḥ, tathā tacchapabdān `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ', na i indram, paceruttamaikavacanamiṭ śap paca i candram ? naiṣa doṣaḥ ekapadātaraṅgo guṇe bhaviṣyate prageva padāntarasannidānāt |

lṛkārasya stānata itai| yathā caitallabhyate tathā| `laṇ' ityatra vyākhyātam ||

etyedhatyūṭhūsu || 6.1.89 ||
na punaredhateravyabhicārāditi| bāhulyābhiprāyeṇaitaduktam| asti hyasyāpi vyabhicāraḥ--caṅyupadhāhrasvatve bhavān mā predidhadityatretyāhuḥ| praṣṭhauha iti| praṣṭhaṃ vahatīti `dhandasi sahaḥ', `vahaśca' iti ṇviḥ, `vāha ūṭh' ityūṭha, samprasāraṇam, pūrvatvam, tato vṛddhiḥ| etyedhatyorehi pararūpāpavāda iti| vṛddhirvidhīyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ|
yathaiva tarhi `eṅi pararūpam' bādhate, evamāṅi pararūpamapi bādheta: nāprāpte pararūpe'syā vṛddherārambhāt? ityata āha-omāṅoścaitaccivati| kutaḥ? ityāhayeneti| sa tasya bādhako bhavatīti| tasyaiva bādhako bhavatīti yāvat, tadbādhasyāvaśyambhāvitvāt, tāvatā ca bādhakasya caritārthatvāt| na cāprāpte eṅi pararūpe iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyate, āṅi pararūpe tu ā itaḥ-etaḥ, pretaḥ, pareta ityatra prāpte; upaiti, praitītyatra tvaprāpte tasmānna bādhate| parihārāntaramāha--purastāditi| anantare bādhye jñāte tadbādhayā vacanasya caritārthatvāduttareṇa saha sparddhāyāṃ paratvāttadeva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
akṣauhiṇīti| akṣairūhate'vaśyamiti āvaśyake ṇiniḥ, sādhanam `kṛtā' iti samāsaḥ|
svairamiti| `īra gatau', īraṇamīraḥ, bhāve ghañ, svenābhiprāyeṇa īraṇaṃ svairam, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ, kriyāviśeṣaṇātvāllokāśrayatvādvā liṅgasya napuṃsakatvam| svenābhiprāyeṇerate gacchatīti svairī, `supyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ. īrigrahaṇamanarthakam, svenābhiprāyeṇerate gacchatīti svairī, `supyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ| īrigrahaṇamanarthakam, `padāsvairibāhya' iti nipātanātsiddham, padāsvairaśabdādinā matvarthīyena siddham, ṇinistvanabhidhānānna bhaviṣyati|
prādityādi| ūḍha, ūḍhi, eṣya--ityetānyuttarapadāni| iṣyatericchateriṣṇātervā yadā ṇyat tadā--praiṣyaḥ, yadā ghañ tadā-praiṣaḥ, eṅi pararūpāpavādo vṛddhiḥ| īṣyaśabde tu preṣya iti bhavati| tathā ā-ūḍhā oḍhā proḍheti `omāṅośca' iti pararūpaṃ bhavati| pūrvopāttasya ṛṇasyāpanayanāya yadṛṇamanyadupāttaṃ tad ṛṇārṇam| daśārṇaśabdo nadīviśeṣasya, deśaviśeṣasya ca saṃjñā ||

āṭaśca || 6.1.90 ||
`īkṣa darśane', `ubha umbha pūraṇe', `ubja ārjave',`ṛdhu vṛddhau'-- ityeteṣāmudāharaṇāni| cakāro'dhikavidhānārtha iti| asyaiva vivaraṇam-- usyomāṅośceti| pararūpabādhanārthaṃ iti| usi, omi, āṅi ca yatpararūpaṃ prāpnoti tadbādhanārtha ityarthaḥ; anyathā paratvāttadeva pararūpaṃ syāt| ausrīyaditi| anarthake'pyusi pararūpavidhānādatra prasaṅgaḥ ||

upasargādṛti dhātau || 6.1.91 ||
upārcchatīti| `ṛccha gantīndriyapralayamūrtibhāveṣu'|
prarcchako deśa iti| atra yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayaḥ iti gamiṃ prati praśabdasyopasargatvaṃ narcchatiṃ pratīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam|
vā supyāpiśaleriti hi vikalpaḥ syāditi| tenottarārthantaparakaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|
dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam, yatra copasargatvaṃ na sambhavati, tatropasargagrahaṇena prādayo'pilakṣyante, yathā-nāsikāyā nasbāvavidhau; iha tu mukhyamevopasargatvaṃ sambhavati tatkiṃ dhātugrahaṇena ? ityata āha-upasargagrahaṇādeveti| śākalyasyedaṃ śākalam, tasya nivṛttyarthaṃ punarddhātugrahaṇam| sati tu dātugrahaṇe yogavibhāgena punarvṛddhirvidhīyata iti śākalaṃ bādhyate| asati tu tasmin śākalyamatena paratvāt prakṛtibhāvaḥ syādeva ||

vā supyāpiśaleḥ || 6.1.92 ||
subantasya dhātorasambhavātsubityetyetaddhātoravayavadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamityāha--subantāvayave dhātāviti| ācāryagrahaṇenaiva pūjāvikalpayorapi siddhayoḥ punarvāgrahaṇamācāryagrahaṇasya prādhānyena pūjārthatāṃ khyāpayituṃ kṛtam ||

auto'msasoḥ || 6.1.93 ||
gāṃ paśyeti| nanu cātra `goto ṇit' iti ṇittve sati paratvā dvaddhau kṛtāyāmokārābhāvādātvena na bhāvyam, ātvavidhānaṃ tu dyośabdārthaṃ syāt, na hi tatra ṇittvamasti, `gotaḥ' iti vacanādityata āha-dyośabdo'pītyādi| satyaṃ yadi ṇittvaṃ na syāt, asti tu tatrāpi ṇittvam, `gotaḥ' ityasyaukārāntopalakṣaṇatvāt, varṇanirddeśeṣu taparatvaprasiddheḥ| tataḥ kim? ityāha--teneti|
śasā sāhacaryāditi| supa eva hi śaśo'tra sambhavaḥ, nānyasya;`aci' ityadhikārāt|
acitavamasunavamiti| cinoteḥ, sunoteśca laṅ, `tasthasthamipāṇ' ityami kṛte vikaraṇasya guṇāvādeśau ||

eṅi pararūpam || 6.1.94 ||
`ila preraṇe' curādiḥ, `okhṛ śākhṛ' iti bhūvādau paṭhyete|
kecidvā supyāpiśalerityanuvarttayantīti| yadyevam, tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyām asubdhātuṣu nāsya pravṛttiḥ syād? ityata āha--tacceti| atra vyākhyānameva śaraṇam|
śakandhvādiṣviti| śakandhvādayaḥ prayogato'nusartavyāḥ, teṣu pararūpaṃ vaktavyam| `kulaṭāyā vā', `katantebhyaḥ' ityādinirddeśo'sminnarthe liṅgam| andhuḥ-kūpaḥ, bahūni kulānyaṭati naikasminkule'vasthiteti kulaṭā| pacādiṣvayaṃ paṭhitavyaḥ, anyathā `karmaṇyaṇ' syāt|
eve cāniyoga iti| niyogaḥ-avaśyambhāvaḥ, niyamaḥ-avadhāraṇam, tato'nyatrārthe pararūpaṃ sambhavati| udāharaṇe'navaklṛptāvevaśabdaḥ, yathā--kveva bhokṣyasa iti| avadhāraṇe tu vṛddhireva bhavati---`amaivāvyayena', `dhātostannitittasyaiva', ihaiva santatvāya, mamaiva havyānyagna ityādi|
otuḥ-viḍālaḥ| `tunvorvi nipāta upasaṃkhyānam', vīti saptamīnirddeśāttadādividhiḥ, vakārādau nipāte parataḥ tunu-ityetayoḥ pararūpaṃ bhavati--tu vai tvai, anubhūtatamaṃ caikam| nuvai nvai| eka evāyaṃ nipātaḥ, arthābhedāt, yadāha--`na vā, nipātaikatvāt' iti| ata eva naitad vṛttikāreṇa paṭhitam |
sūtre pararūpagragrahaṇabhuttarārtham, iha tveṅītyeva siddham--eṅi parata ekādeśo bhavatīti| rūpagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam, tathā ca `ami pūrvaḥ' ityatra rūpagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam |

omāṅośca || 6.1.95 ||
adyoḍheti| āṅanāṅorekādeśa āṅgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti bhavatyudāharaṇam| atra ca `dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgam' iti pūrvamādguṇae kṛte paścādadyaśabdena sambandhe vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, evamāṅo rūpamavitaṣṭam| adya gaāgata ityādau tatra savarmadīrghatvena siddhaṃ rūpam|
akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhyata iti| nanu ca madhye'pavādanyāyena vṛddhereva bādho yuktaḥ na dīrghatvasya? naiṣa doṣa; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa punarvidānārtho bhaviṣyati ||

usyapadāntāt|| 6.1.96 ||
bhindyuriti| bhiderliṅ, yāsuṭ, jherjus, śnasorallopaḥ, `liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' iti salopaḥ, bhindyā-us--anena pararūpam| aduriti| dāño luṅ, `gātisthā' ityādinā sico luk, `ātaḥ' iti jherjus, adā-us--anena pararūpam |
kosreti| nanu cānarthakatvādevāsyoso grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--anarthasyāpyuso grahaṇamiti, tena bhidyurityādāvapyusi pararūpaṃ bhavati| atra hi yāsuḍādiḥ samudāyo'rthavān, na tu tadavayava us| koṣiteti| vaseḥ ktaḥ, `vasatikṣudoriṭ', yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam, `śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' iti ṣatvam, tasyāsiddhatvādusi na pararūpaṃ bhavati| asya tu lākṣaṇikatvādevāgrahaṇaṃ siddham| abibhayuriti| bhiyo laṅ, śapaḥ śluḥ, `sijabhyasta' ityādinā jherjus, `jusi ca' iti guṇaḥ ||

ato guṇe || 6.1.97 ||
akaḥ savarṇe dīrghasyāpavāda iti| nanu ca madhye'pavādanyāyena vṛddherevāyamapavādo yuktaḥ, na dīrghasya? guṇagrahaṇāddīrghasyāpi bādhako bhaviṣyati, anyathā--`ato'padāntāt' ityeva vaktavyam| eṅītyeva, tato jusi ca, apadāntādityeva| evaṃ siddhaṃ guṇagrahaṇād guṇamātre'yaṃ vidhaiḥ pravartamāno dīrghamapi bādhiṣyate|
ata iti kimiti aditi varttata eveti praśnaḥ| taparakaraṇe tātparyamityuttaram ||

avyaktānukaraṇasyāt itau || 6.1.98 ||
avyaktamaparisphuṭavarṇamiti| aparisphuṭā-anabhivyaktā akārādayo varṇā yasmintattathoktam| yadyevam, tadanukaraṇenāpi tathāvidhenaiva bhāvyam, sadṛśaṃ hyanukāraṇaṃ bhavati, tataścānukārya iva tatrāpi naivācchabdo'vadhāryate, anavadhārite cāśakyaṃ pararūpaṃ karttum ? tatrāha-tadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatyatiprasaṅgāt? ityata āha--kenacitsādṛśyeneti| tatpunaḥ sādṛsyaṃ dhvanestulyatayā, tena hyavyaktamanukāryamanukaroti puruṣaḥ, anukaraṇaṃ kartṛ avyaktaṃ karmānukaroti, karaṇasya kartṛtvāvivakṣayāṃ kartṛpratyayaḥ, anukaraṇaśabdastu karaṇasādhana eva| pararūpamekādeśo bhavatīti| acchabdasayāpi sarvasya nālontyasya; `nānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ' iti vacanājjñāpakācca| yadayam `āmreḍitasyāntyasya tu vā ' iti antyagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati --`nātrālontyaparibhāṣā pravarttate' iti| kiñca--pūrvāparasamudāya ekādeśasya sthānītyuktam, tataśca tadekadeśe pūrvasmin khalvetatparibhāṣāpravṛttiḥ kīdṛśīti cintyam| paṭaditīti| prakriyāvākyametat, na prayogārham; pararūpasya nityatvāt| pāṭitīti kathaṃ punaḥ pararūpe kṛte tadanukāryasya pratipādakaṃ bhavati, kutaśca tasyānukaraṇatvam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā gavityayamāheti kṛtāvādeśamapi gośabdasyānukaraṇaṃ bhavati śāstrāvāsanayā, tadvadatrā'pi bhaviṣyati|
dakārāntānukaraṇametaditi takārāntānukaraṇe tu rūpamevaitanna syāt; apadatvena jaśtvābhāvād, yathā--paṭiti karotīti ||

nāmreḍitasyāntyāsya tu vā || 6.1.99 ||
avyaktānukarasyāmreḍitasyeti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau, avyaktānukaraṇasya yadavayavabhūtamāmreḍitam, tasyetyarthaḥ| nityavīpsayoriti dvirvacanamiti| vīpsāyogastu yayākathañcid draṣṭavyaḥ|
apara āha--`nityavīpsayoḥ' ityupalakṣaṇametat, `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve bhavataḥ' ityatra bahulavacanādanyasyāpi dvirvacanamiti|
yadi tviti| dvirūktasya samudāyānukaraṇasya vārthabhedo bhavaṃti|

nityamāmreḍite ḍāci || 6.1.100 ||
vārttikamevedam| vṛttikṛtā sūtrarūpeṇa paṭhitam| ḍāci vivakṣita iti| `āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' iti bhaviṣyati ktaḥ, vidhitsita ityarthaḥ| anyathā kaḍājeva na syāt; dvyajavarārdhatvābhāvāt| tathā ca ḍājvidhāvuktam--`yasya ca dvirvacane dvyajavarārddhatā tataḥ pratyayaḥ' iti, aṣṭame ca vakṣyatiḍācīti viṣayasaptamīti|
ḍāci vidhitsita eva dvirvacanaṃ kriyata ityatra prayojanāntaramāha--tacceti| hyarthe caḥ, taddhi dvirvacanaṃ ṭilopātpūrvamiṣyate| evaṃ ca pūrvaṃ siddhayati, yadi ḍācividhitsita eva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| yadi hi parabhūte dvirvacanaṃ syāt, tato'ntaraṅgatvātpūrvaṃ ṭilope kṛte ṭakārāntasya dvirvacane paṭapaṭeti na siddhyet|
yadvā--ḍāci vihite utpanne ityarthaḥ| nanu coktam--ḍājeva na syāditi? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `dvyajavarārddhāt' iti bhāvivyapadeśo'yam| yasya dvyajavarārddhatā bhaviṣyati dvirvacane kṛte tasmādityarthaḥ. yadi ḍāci vihitaṃ dvirvacanaṃ paratvāṭṭilopaprasaṅga ityuktam ? tatrāha--taccetyādi| `ḍāci bahulam' iti bahulagrahaṇād dvirvacane kṛte ṭilopa ityarthaḥ ||

akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ || 6.1.101 ||
agnaya iti| `gherṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ| dadhyatreti| asati savarṇagrahaṇe yaṇādeśasya dīrghasya ca viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta, tataśca paryāyaḥ syāt|
kumārī śeta iti| nanu ca tulyāsyaprayatnatve'pi sāvarṇyamatra nāsti, `nājjñalau' iti pratiṣedhāt? ityata āha--nājjhalāvityartrati| `āṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' iti grahaṇakavākyam, tacca `nājjhalau' ityasya pravṛttisamaye nābhinirvṛttam, tasya hi savarṇasaṃjñāṅgam, tena yāvatsā na pravarttate tāvadanabhinirvṛttam| savarṇasaṃjhā'pi svāpavāde `nājjhalau' ityasminnapravṛtte na pravarttate, tataśca pūrvaṃ `nājjhalau' ityasya pravṛttiḥ, paścātsavaṇasaṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ, paścād grahaṇakavākyasyeti eṣa kramaḥ| tena `nājjhalau' ityatrāgṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇamiti ikāraśakārayoḥ sāvarṇyamapatiṣiddham, tasmādacītyanuvarttyamiti|
ṛti rṛ va vacanamiti| madhye rephabhaktī dve, ādito'jbhakterarddhamātrā, evamantataḥ|
evam lṛtītyatrāpi madhye dve lakārabhaktī, abhitaḥ pūrvavat| evaṃ dvimātrayaurapyetayorīṣatspṛṣṭatvādvivṛttābhyāmṛkāralṛkārābhyāmasāvarṇyādagrahaṇāddīrghasaṃjñāyā abhāvādvacanam| arddhatṛtīyamātratvāttatkālatvābhāvādityanye| etacca savarṇasaṃjñāyā prapañcitam| dīrghapakṣe tviti| ṛkāralukārayoḥ samudāyaḥ sthānī, na ca tasyāntaratamo dīrghaḥ sambhavati, ato'vayavasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva bhavati| tatrāpi lṛvarṇasya dīrghāsambhavādṛkārasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva bhavati| tatrāpi lṛvarṇasya dīrghāsambhavādṛkārasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa ṛkāra eva bhavati ||

prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ || 6.1.102 ||
prathamāśabdo vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍha iti| supāmādyatrike `sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyāḥ',`saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyaḥ' ityādau tasyaiva grahaṇāt| nanu ca strīliṅgaḥ prathamāśabdastatra rūḍhaḥ, na cāsya strīliṅgatve pramāṇamasti, pratyuta prathamaśabdastiṅāṃ trikadvaye'sminneva śāstre saṃjñātvena viniyuktaṃ iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam; tataśca pacati, pacataḥ, pacanti, pacate, pacete, pacante, cakāra, cakratuḥ, cakruḥ; cakre, cakrāte, cakrire--ityādau yathāprāptavidhyantarabādhenāyaṃ vidhiryuktaḥ| kiñcaiva sati mukhye'pi prathamaśabde `prathamayoḥ' iti dvivacanamupapadyate, ātmanepadaparasmaipadabhedena prathamasya bhedāt? ucyate; evaṃ sati dvivacananirdeśo'narthakaḥ; `luṭaḥ prathamasya' ityādivatsiddhatvāt| yadvā--`vā supyāpiśaleḥ' ityataḥ supītyanuvarttayiṣyate, tena supa eva prathamasya grahaṇam, liṅgācca, kiṃ liṅgam? `dīrghājjasi ca' `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' iti| ata evala liṅgātsupāmapyāditaḥ prathamayordvayorgrahaṇaṃ bhavati, acītyadhikārācca, na hi surajādiḥ| surapi kuṇḍaṃ tiṣṭhatītyadāvajādiḥ ? nātrāyaṃ vidhiḥ prāpnoti, kāraṇam ? ami pūrvatvena bādhyate| tasmāt strīliṅgasya grahaṇamiti sthitam| tatsāhacaryād dvitīyāpi prathametyukteti| dvivacanaṃ cātra pramāṇam| nanu sakṛcchrutaḥ śabdo mukhyavṛttireva vā bhavati, jaghanyavṛttireva vā, na punarubhayavṛtti ? prathaṇādvitīyāsamudāye jaghanyavṛttirevāyam, sa ca samudāya udbhūtāvayavabheda iti dvivacanopapattiḥ, yathā--chattriṇo gacchantīti|
vṛkṣāḥ, plakṣā iti| nanvatrāpi `ato guṇe' iti pararūpeṇa bhavitavyam, nāprāpte vidhyantare tasyārambhāt| syādetat--prathamayorityetadapi dīrghatvaṃ nāprāpte vidhyantare ārabhyamāṇam agnī ityādau yathā bādhate, tathā pararūpamapi bādhiṣyate iti? tatra, svarasandhiṣu guṇayāvutsargau, vṛddhiḥ savarṇadīrghatvaṃ pūrvasavarṇādeśaśca tayorapavādā iti dvitīyakakṣāprāptāḥ, pararūpaṃ tu tṛtīyakakṣāprāptamiti tadeva prāpnoti| evaṃ tarhi yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate--prathamayoriti, akaḥ savarṇa ityeva, tena vṛkṣā ityādau pararūpaṃ bādhitvā prathamayorakaḥ savarṇo dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati; yathaiva tarhi yogavibhāgaḥ pararūpaṃ bādhate, tathā vṛkṣamityādāvami pūrvamapi bādheta, tasya tvagnimityādiravakāśaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ:; `ami pūrvaḥ' ityatrāmīti yogavibhāgena prāptaṃ dīrghatvamapi na bhavatītyarthaḥ. evamapi `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' ityatra tacchabdenānantaro dīrghaḥ paramṛśyate, etān gāścarato balīvarddānpasya ityatra `automśasoḥ' ityekādeśānmā bhūditi, tataḥ kim ? yogavibāge kriyamāṇe agnīn, vāyunityādāveva natvaṃ syāt, na tu vṛkṣānityādau yatra prathamayoriti yogavibhāgād dīrgho vidhīyate ? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; tasmādityanenāksthāniko dīrghaḥ parāmṛśyate, nānantaraḥ, nāpi dīrghamātram, etaccāka ityanuvṛtterlabhyate| mā bhūdvā yogavibhāgaḥ---prathamayoriti| nanu coktam--vṛkṣā ityādau pararūpaprasaṅga iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--na jassāsoḥ pararūpaṃ bhavatīti, yadayaṃ `nādici' itījgrahaṇaṃ karoti; anyathā avarṇāntasya nāstyeva dīrghaprasaṅga itika kimijgrahaṇena? kevalottarārthe hi tasmiṃstatraiva karttavyaṃ syāt| yadvā--`dīrghācchasi' ityeva brūyāt, kimarthamidam? nīyamārtham---dīrghācchasyeveti| tena jasśasorna bhaviṣyati|
vṛttikārastu yathokte parihāre pratipattigauravaprasaṅāganyāyataḥ parihāramāhaato guṇa iti yadakāre pararūpamityādi| nyāyaṃ darśati--purastuditi| itikaraṇo hetau ||
agnī ityatreti| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe pūrvasamudāyasya sthānino'ntaratamasya dīrghasyābhāvādavayavāntaratamo bhavan pūrvasyaiveti niyamakāraṇābhāvātparasavarṇo'pi syāt, tatastannivṛttyartham| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ tu vipratiṣedhanirākaraṇārtham; anyathā agnī ityatra vipratiṣiddhamāpadyate| katham? `dīrghaḥ' iti vartate, yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ, yadi dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| nanu dīrghagrahaṇānuvṛttisāmarthyāt pūrvaśabdena pūrvākṛtirgrahīpyate ? kathaṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam, yāvatā yatra pūrvavyaktirdīrghabhūtā--kumārīḥ paśya, bhastrāḥ paśyetyādau tatraiva yathā syāt, agnī ityādau mā bhūdityevamarthā dīrghānuvṛttiḥ syāt? yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syād-`dīrghācchasi pūrvo'mi ca' iti brūyāt; yatastu valu prathamayorityārabhyate tato jñāyate--na kevalaṃ kumārīḥ paśyetyādau dīrghasyaiva prathamayorityanena dīrgho vidhitsitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? agnī ityādāvapīti, taccākṛtivivakṣāyāmupapadyate ? satyam; tadeva savarṇagrahaṇenāpi vispaṣṭīkriyate--trimātre stānini trimātrādeśanivṛttyarthamiti| āntaratasyāt trimātra eva prāpnoti| yatra plutāplutaprasaṅgaḥ sa eva `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ' ityasya viṣayaḥ, iha tu plutasyaiva prasaṅga iti nāyamasya viṣayaḥ ||

tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi || 6.1.103 ||
tasmādityanenāntaraḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrgho nirddiśyata ityāha-tasmātpūrvasavarṇadīrghāditi| uttarasya śaśo'vayavasyeti| uttarasyetyetacchasavayavasya viśeṣaṇam, tasmāduttaro yaḥ śaso'vayavastasyeti, na tu śaśaḥ; asambhavāt| na hi pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt paraḥ kvacicchas sambhavati| antādivadbhāvo'pi na bhavati; ubhayata āśrayaṇāt| ata evānupāttamapyavayavasyeti labhyate| `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityatra `trikaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ' ityuktam, tena `pusi' ityetatprakṛtiviśeṣaṇam--puṃśabdāt parasya śaso'vayavasyeti| yadyevam, vṛkṣānityādikaṃ padaṃ nakārāntamudāharaṇamupapadyate| ṣaṇukaṣaṇḍhakaśabdāviha lokaprasiddhyā napuṃsake varttamānāvapi puṃstāvanugatamevārthamāhatuḥ, yathā kumāryādiṣu varttamāno'rthaśabdaḥ, sāmānyaviśeṣā eva strītvādayo na punastanādayaḥ| strīsūtre caitadupapāditam| sthūrakānityādi tūdāharaṇadvayamayuktam, katham? sthūrakāyā apatyāni, ararakāyā apatyāni `gargādibhyo yañ', bahuṣu luk, strīpratyayasyāpi `luk taddhitaluki' iti luk, sthūraka, araraka-ityetau strīśabdau, tābhyāṃ paro'tra śas bhavati; na tu puṃśabdābyāmityata āha--sarva eta iti| na kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ, api tvetāvapīti sarvaśabdasyārthaḥ, lupte'pi pratyaye prakṛtireva tadarthe varttate, pratyayārthaścātrāyamanyarūpaḥ| puṃstvaviśiṣṭa iti| strīvācakatvena prasiddhāvapyetāvasmin prayoge puṃśabdāviti bhāvaḥ|
yadyevam, cañceva cañcāḥ pumāṃsa iti `ive pratikṛtau' iti kanaḥ `lummanuṣye' iti lupi kṛte prakṛtireva cañcāśabdaḥ puṃstvaviśiṣṭaṃ pratyārthamasmin prayoga āheti natvaprasaṅgaḥ? ityata āha-iha tvityādi| pratyayārtho'pi naivātra puṃstvaviśiṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? atideśāt strītvaviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ|
tasmāditi kimiti| prakṛtasya dīrghagrahaṇasya pañcamyā vipariṇāmātsiddhamiti praśnaḥ| etān gāḥ paśyeti| `auto'mśasoḥ' ityātvamekādeśaḥ, `ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ' iti mahāprakaraṇam, tataśca tadviṣayameva natvaṃ syāditi manyate| nanvevaṃ `ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' iti ca tatraiva karttavyam--śaśo naḥ puṃsīti, iha tu prakaraṇādanantaramevopajīviṣyate? tadeva tarhi tasmādgrahaṇena vispaṣṭyate ||

nādici || 6.1.104 ||
khaṭve iti| `auṅa āpaḥ' iti auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ| kuṇkaḍe iti| atrāpi `napaṃsakācca' iti ||

dīrghājjasi ca || 6.1.105 ||
āditi nānuvartate, cakāreṇeco'nukarṣaṇasāmarthāyat; anyathā pūrveṇaiva dīrgādapyavarṇādici siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti kiṃ tadanuvṛttyarthena cakāreṇa! dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā ṛvarṇasya `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' iti guṇavidhānānnātiprasaṅgaḥ ? evamidutorakapi, `jati ca' iti guṇo vidhīyate| iha tahi vṛkṣāḥ, agnī, vāyū; iti hrasvādapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nādici' ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati, agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāccobhyathāniyamaḥ---ādicyeva, ādevecīti| tatrādyena niyamena vṛkṣā ityādi siddham; dvitīyenāgnī, vāyū ityādi| yathaiva tarhyagnī, vāyū hatyādau niṣedhau na bhavati; evaṃ kumārthau, vadhvāvityādāvapi na syāt, tasmād dīrghāditi vaktavyam| jasgrahaṇaṃ śasnivṛttyartham, anyathā kumārīḥ paśya, vadhūḥ paśyetyādau śasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayam, `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' iti puṃgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--na śasi pratiṣedho bhavatīti; taddhi napuṃsake savarṇadīrghatvāsambhavāt strīnivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtam, yadi ca striyāmapyayaṃ kumārīḥ paśyetyādau śasyapi pratiṣedhaḥ sayāttadā pūrvasavarṇadīrgha tvābhāvādeva tatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, kiṃ puṃgrahaṇena? naitadasti jñāpakam; hrasvāntaṃ yat strīliṅgaṃ tadarthametat syāt--kṛtīḥ paśya, dhenūḥ paśyeti| tasmāt `jāsi ca' ityetadapi vaktavyameva|

vā chandasi || 6.1.106 ||
mārutīriti| maruto devatā āsāmiti `sāsya devatā' ityaṇ, ṅīp, jasi pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| vārāhīti| varāhasya vikāra iti `avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ' iti `prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ', ṅīp, dvivaṃcane pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ| upānahau viśeṣye ||

ami pūrvaḥ || 6.1.107 ||
`dūrghāt' iti nānurkttate, ārambhasāmarthyāt|
pūrvagrahaṇamityādi| yaḥ pūrvaḥ śrutaḥ, sa eva yathā syāt, kaḥ punaranyaḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--pūrvasavarṇo dīrgho mā bhūditi| kvacittu samāsaḥ paṭhyate, sa karmadhārayo draṣṭavya| etaduktaṃ bhavati--asatīha pūrvahrahaṇe prakṛtaṃ pūrvagrahaṇamanuvartyam, tasmiṃścānuvarttamāne tatsambaddhaṃ savarṇagrahaṇamapyanuvartyam, tataśca pūrvasya yaḥ savarṇaḥ sa evāntaratamaḥ prasajyeta, tatra ko doṣaḥ ? na tāvadvṛkṣamityātadau dvimātrasya sthānitvena dvimātraprasahgaḥ, vacanasāmarthyāt `prathayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' ityeva dīrghasya siddhatvāt ? ata āha--kumārīmityatreti|
vā chandasītyeveti| etacca vākyabhedena sambaddhyate, anyathā bhāṣāyāṃ na syāt| śamyaṃ ceti| vikalpavidānasāmarthyātpūrvatvābhāve pūrvasavarṇadīrgho'pi na bhavati, tayoratra viśeṣābhāvāditi yaṇādeśa eva bhavati ||

samprasāraṇācca || 6.1.108 ||
samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāditi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmarthyam, yāvatā saṃhitāyāṃ yaṇ vidhīyate, asaṃhitāyāṃ saṃprasāraṇaṃ caritārtham ? naita dasti; `saṃhitaikapade nityā' iti vacanāt|
vā chandasītyeveti| pūrvavadvākyabhedena sambandhaḥ| yajyamāna iti| nanvidānī mevoktam--vigṛhītasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tatkathamatra yaṇādeśaḥ ? ata āha-pūrvatvavidhāne hīti| satyam, anārabdhe pūrvatve vigṛhītaśravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, samprasāraṇavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ mā bhūditi, pūrvatvavidhāne hi sati tatpratipattiviṣaye arthavatsamprasāraṇamiti pūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśe bhavatyeva, `samprasāraṇapūrvatve samānāṅgagrahaṇam', yasminnaṅge saṃprasāraṇamavasthitaṃ tadantarbhūto yo'c tenaiva saha yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt--śakahvau, śakahvarthamiti, śakān hvayatīti kvipi yajñāditvātsamprasāraṇam, yo'ntyo dhātorākāraḥ tasminnevāṅge'ntarbhavati tasya tāvat pūrvatvam, vibhaktyokāro'rthaśabdākāraśca na tasminnaṅge'ntarbhavata iti tayoḥ pūrvatvaṃ na bhavati| atra parihāraḥ--yaṇaḥ sthāne ya ik sa saṃprasāraṇam, ekādeśastu na yaṇstānikaḥ, varṇāśrayatvāccāntādivadbhāvo'pi nāsti, evaṃ pūrvatvameva tāvanna samprasāraṇam, kiṃ punaḥ, tatsthānika ūkāra iti pūrvaikādeśābhāvaḥ| samprasāraṇadīrghatve tu vacanasāmarthyādekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt samprasāraṇavyapadeśaḥ| vṛttikārastu samprasāraṇatvamabhyupetya parihārāntaramāha--antaraṅge ceti |
deśato viprakarṣo'tra bāhyatvenopavarṇitaḥ|
kālato viprakarṣastu paścādupanipātataḥ ||
dhātāvanantarbhāvakṛtaṃ bāhyatvam, paścādupanipātastu spaṣṭa eva ||

ṅasiṅasośca || 6.1.120 ||
eṅa uttarayoriti| eṅa uttarau yau ṅasiṅasau, tayoryaḥ sambandhayakāraḥ, tasmin parata ityarthaḥ| agnerāgacchati, agneḥ svamiti| yadyapi dvāveṅau, ṅasiṅasāvapi dvāveva; tathāpi yatāsaṅkhyaṃ na bhavati, na hyatra ṅasiṅasoḥ kāya vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsambandhinyati; sa caika eva| athāpi sambandhibhedena tasya bhedaḥ syāt ? evamapi na doṣaḥ; `īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ', `dhātoḥ' ityādinirdeśāt ||

ṛta ut || 6.1.121 ||
dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭīnirddiṣṭayorityādi| nyāyaprāptipradarśanametat, na punāparatve'kriyamāṇe kiñcidaniṣṭam `ṛtaḥ' iti taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham, `unnyorgrahaḥ' `prestro'yajñe' ityādau na bhavati| `uc' ityapi taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyarthameva, āntaryato hi dvimātrasya dvimātra eva prāpnoti| nanu `bhāvyamāno'ṇsavarṇānna gṛhṇāti' iti ? evaṃ tarhyejjñāpayati-`bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti' iti, tenāmūbhyāmityatra `adasoserdādu do maḥ' iti dīrghasya dīrgha ūkāro bhavati| iha gamlṛprabhṛtibhyo ṅasiṅasoḥ kṛtayoḥ ṛkaralukārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñāvidānādasminnutve laparatve ca kṛte saṃyogāntalope gamuliti rūpaṃ bhavati ||

khyatyāt parasya || 6.1.122 ||
khiśabdaśīśabdayorityādi| yaṇādeśe kṛte tulyarūpatvād dvayorapi grahaṇam| etadarthamevāgantukenākāreṇa yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā vikṛtanirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ; anyathā khityoriti hrasvayorgahaṇe dīrghayorna syāt, dīrghayorgahaṇe hrasvayornasyāt| vikṛtanirddeśe tu dvayorapi bhavati| akārāntayostu mukhyāpatyādivarttinorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, `sakhyuryaḥ' `patyurno' `āpatyasya ca' ityādirnirddeśāt|
sakhīyateḥ kvip sakhīriti| nanu cāllopasya sthānivadbhāvadyāṇā bhāvyam, tatra kṛte yalope sthānivattvaniṣedhādādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvatvācca pūnaḥ sthānivattvābhāvāt `lopo vyorvali' iti yalope saśyurityādi na siddhyati ? naitadasti; `kvau luptaṃ na syānivat' iti sthānivattvaniṣedhāt|
vikṛtanirddeśaśya prayojanāntaramapyāha--vikṛtanirdeśāditi| atisakheriti| atikrāntaḥ sakhā yeneti bahuvrīhiḥ| yadvā--śobhanaḥ sakhā atisakhā, `na pūjanāt' iti samāsāntaniṣedhaḥ| atha sa eva yaṇādeśo'tra kasmānna bhavati, `gheṅiti' iti guṇena bādhitatvāditi cet? na; `śeṣo ghyasakhi' iti ghisaṃjñāpratiṣedhādityata āha--sakhiśabdasya kevalasyaiva hīti| etacca tatraiva pratipāditam ||

ato roraplutādaplute || 6.1.123 ||
ukārānubandhakasyeti| yadi ruśabdasamudāyaḥ sthānī syād, agurvartham, tarvarthamityādāvapi prasajyeta| `sasajuṣo ruḥ' ityatra cokārasyānunāsikatvapratijñayā'nubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, taddhyatraiva sūtre viśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyate| rutvamapīti| apiśabdaḥ punaḥ śabdasyārthe| yadi punā rutvamasiddhaṃ syāt, sthānitvenāśrayaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt; ukārānubandhakasya kasyacidrorabhāvāt|
tasyāpīti| nimittabūtasyāpītyarthaḥ| susrotā3 atra nvasīti| `dūrāddhūte ca, iti plutaḥ, nuśabdaḥ praśne| aśvin ātreti| aśvaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ, sambuddhyantaṃ caitat, `guroranṛtaḥ' iti plutaḥ, he aśvin atraiva pradeśe payastiṣṭhatvityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa tu takārāntaṃ paṭhyate, tatrāśvicchandasya vyutpattirmṛgyā| nanu taparakaraṇādeva plutātparasya plute vā parato na bhaviṣyati, yathā dīrghe ? tatrāha--plutasyāsiddhatvāditi| nanu ca siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu yadayaṃ `plutapragṛhyā aci' iti prakṛtibhāvaṃ śāsti, yasya hi vikāraḥ prāpnoti tasya prakṛtibhāvo vidhātavyaḥ, na ca plutasyāsiddhatve plutasya sato vikāraprāptirityanarthakaṃ tat syāt? astu svarasandhiṣu plataḥ siddhaḥ, rorutvaṃ tu svarasandhirna bhavati|
yadi tu saṃhitādhikāre yadvidhīyate tanmātraviṣayaṃ jñāpakamāśrīyate śakyamakarttam--`aplutādaplute' iti ||

iśi ca || 6.1.124 ||
aplutādityeva--susrotā3 dehīti| cakāro'tītyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tenottaratra tasyaivānuvṛttirbhavati, na haśītyasya, nahi tadanukarṣaṇasyānyatprayojanamasti ||

prakṛtyāntaḥpādamavyapare || 6.1.125 ||
atītyeveti| na tu haśīti| atra hetuḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ| eṅa iti yat pañcamyantamityādi| `eṅaḥ' iti tāvad vyavahitamapyanuvarttate, na tvanantaramapi rorita, atra ca vyākhyānameva śaraṇam; tenāvyapare haśi parato ru prakṛtyā bhavatītyartho na bhavati| tadarthāditi| nahi pañcamyantasya `prakṛtyā' ityanena sambandhaḥ sambhavati| prakṛtirityādi| ubhatrāpi prakṛtiśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ--dustyajā prakṛtiḥ, dadhnaḥ kṣīraṃ prakṛtiriti| antarityavyayamityādi| tena madhyavācināntaḥ--śabdenopajanite vyatireke pādaśabdātṣaṣṭhī, tadantena sahāvyayībhāvaḥ| ṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇamiṣyata iti| iṣṭirevaiṣā |
anye tu `vā chandasi' ityato maṇḍūkaplutyā `chandasi' ityanuvarttayanti| evamavayavārthaṃ darśayitvā samudāyārthaṃ darśayati--avakārayakārapara ityādinā| svabhāvenāvatiṣṭhata iti| yadā prakṛtiśabdaḥ svabhāve varttate tadāyamarthaḥ--svabhāvaparityāgena na saṃhitākāryamāpadyata ityarthaḥ| yadā tu kāraṇe varttate tadāyamarthaḥ--eṅkāraṇātmanā bhavatīti| kāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvādeḥ kāryasyaiṅ, tasyātmā- svarūpam, tenaiva bhavati| prāka saṃhitākāryādeṅo yadrūpaṃ tenaivāvatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| anantaroktamevārthadvayaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti--
iti| evaṃ hi svabhāvena bhavati, yadi svabhāvādanyathālakṣaṇāṃ
prāpnoti; tathā evaṅkāraṇātmanā bhavati, yadi vikārarūpaṃ nāpadyate, yadi kāryātmanā na vipariṇamatītyarthaḥ| tau cediti| nimittam-akāraḥ, kāryam-eṅ| udāharaṇeṣu `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvatvasyāyavādeśca yathāyogamabhāvaḥ |
ete'rcayantīti| atraitatpadānte varttate, arcayantītyakāraśca parasya pādasyādau|
keciditi| yadi `nāntaḥ pādam' iti paṭhanti, evaṃ sati pūrvatvasyaivānantarasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, nāyavorvyavahitayoḥ ? ityata āha-saṃhitāyāmiti| `saṃhitāyām' ityetāvadevātrāpekṣyatace, na tu pūrvarūpatvam; tenaiṅaḥ saṃhitādhikāre yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatītyarthaḥ| tenaitadapi na codanīyam--anārabdhe'smin pratiṣedhe'yavoḥ prāptirnāsti, pūrvatvena bādhitatvāt, anena tu pratiṣedhena pūrvatve bādhite tayorudbhavaḥ syāt, tasyāṃ daśāyāmasya vyāpāro nāsti, ātmāśrayadoṣaprasahgāditi| kathametacyodyaṃ parihṛtam ? yadi pūrvatvasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāttatastadevāpekṣya pratiṣedhayet, yatastu khalu saṃhitāyāmityapekṣya sāmānyena pratiṣedhati tasyaitatprayojanam--svapravṛttyuttarakālamudbhavatorayavorapi pratiṣedho yathā syāditi| atra ca `padāntād' ityanuvartyam, anyathā agnerahaṃ suhuvasya praṇītau, vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarkka ityādau `ṅasiṅsośca' iti yatpūrvarūpam, tasyāpi prakṛtibhāvapratiṣedhau prāpnutaḥ ||

avyādavadyādavakramuravratāyamavantvavasyuṣu ca || 6.1.116 ||
avyādīnāmanukaraṇatvātsamāso vibhaktiśca| avyāditi| averāśiṣi liṅ| avadyāditi| pañcamyekavacanāntam| avakramuriti| avapūrvasya kramerliṭyusi `dirvacanaprakaraṇe chandasi vā vaktavyam' iti dvirvacanābhāve rūpam| kecittu sūtre avacakramuriti kṛtadvirvacanaṃ vaṭhanti, teṣāmudāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam; bahvṛcastāvad--avakramurityadhīyate| avrateti| vṛṅvṛñoḥ `mantre ghasa' ityādinā clerluk, `ātmanepadepvanataḥ' iti adādeśaḥ| ayamiti| idam-śabdāt suḥ, `ido'y puṃsi'| avaterloṭ, avantu, tasmādevāsunantāt kyac, `kyācchandasi' ityupratyayaḥ-- avasyuḥ| tenovantu pitaro haveṣviti bahvṛcāḥ pūrvarūpamevādhīyate| adhibruvantuṃ te'vantvasmāniti ||

āpo juṣāṇo vṛṣṇo varṣiṣṭhe'mbe'mbāle'mbikepūrve|| 6.1.118 ||
āpo ityādīni pṛthak padāni anukaraṇāni, vibhaktistvanukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvānna bhavati| `supāṃ suluk' iti vā vibhakterlug bhavati, ambikepūrva ityetadapyanukaraṇameva| tatra prathamaṃ jasantam, dvitīyaṃ svantam, tṛtīyaṃ śasantam, caturthaṃ ṅayantam, itare sambuddhyante| ambikeśabdātpūrvāviti| asmādeva nipātanātpañcamīsamāsaḥ| asmādeva nipātanāditi| ambetyetadviṣayametat| itarayostu `ambārthaṃ dvyakṣaram' iti vakṣyamāṇatvānnaiva hrasvaprasaṅgaḥ ||

aṅga ityādau ca || 6.1.119 ||
aṅgaśabde ya eṅiti| `sa prakṛtyā bhavati' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ. tadātau cākāre yaḥ pūrva iti| `eṅ' ityapekṣyate, pūrvavacca sambandhaḥ| tacchabdenātikrāntapratyavamarśinetiśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe, tasyāṅgaśabdasyādistadādiḥ| cakāra kimarthaḥ, asati cakāre'ṅgaśabdasyaivaiṅ tadādāvati parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataścāṅge'ṅge ityatraiva syāt| sati tu tasminnaṅgaśabdasya evaiṅ yatra kvacidati parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavati, tadādau cāti parato yaḥ kaścideṅ prakṛtyā bhavatītyayamartho bhavati| tena aṅge adīdhyat, prāṇo aṅge-- ityubhayatrāpi bhavati ||

anudātte ca kudhapare || 6.1.120 ||
kavargadhakārapare iti| kavargadhakārau parau yasmātsa tathoktaḥ| dhakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| agniśabdaḥ `aṅgenirnalośca' iti nipratyayānto'nto'dāttaḥ adhvaraśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareyaṇāntodāttaḥ|
ādyudātto nipātyata iti| `ṛnnendrāgra' ityādāvuṇādisūtre agraśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ ||

sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ || 6.1.122 ||
sarvatra cchandasi bhāṣāyāṃ ceti| yadyapi `chandasi' iti na prakṛtam, tathāpi `antaḥ pādaṃ yajuṣi' iti vacanāt avakramuḥ, avratāvasyuriti chāndasānukaraṇācca chāndasāni pūrvasūtrāṇīti bhāvaḥ| sarvatragrahaṇaṃ tu yajuṣi, anyatra cetyapyupapantam| padāntādityeva--gorāgataṃ goḥ svam ||

avaṅ sphoṭāyanasya || 6.1.123 ||
sphoṭo'yanaṃ parāyaṇaṃ yasya sa sphoṭāyanaḥ-spoṭapratipādanaparo vaiyākaraṇācāryaḥ| ye tvaukāraṃ paṭhanti, te naḍādiṣvaśvādiṣu vā pāṭhaṃ manyante| atīti nivṛttamiti| anyathā gavaudanādau na syāt| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityāha---acītyetattviti| sarvatra cātra vyākhyānameva śaraṇam| yadyacītyanuvarttate katham `iko yaṇici' ityatrauktam--``acīti cādhikāraḥ `samprasāraṇācca' iti yāvat iti ? nirantarānuvṛttyabhiprāyaṃ tadityadoṣaḥ| gavāgram, gavājinamiti| bahuvrīhiḥ, tatpuruṣo vā| gavoṣṭramiti| dvandvaḥ, goragvacanam goragvaktavyaḥ, tatrāpi avādeśena siddhyatyeva| na ca `eṅaḥ padāntāt' iti pūrvatvaprasaṅgaḥ; agāgamasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇādokārasyāpadāntatvāt| kiṃ prayojanam? lāghavaṃ tāvadbhavati, svare ca na doṣaḥ|
kathamāgamā anudāttāḥ ? tatra gavāgrādau bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇāgamānudāttatvaṃ sambhavati, avaṅādeśe tvāntaryato'ntodāttasyāntodātto'vaṅādeśaḥ syāt| nanu cāsyaikācaḥ sato vyapadeśivadbhāvenāntodāttatvameṣṭavyam, tata evādyudāttatvamapi bhaviṣyati, tataḥ kimādyudāttasyādyudātta ādeśo bhaviṣyati ? satyamevametat; na tvidaṃ lakṣaṇamasti--prātipadikasyādirudātto bhavatīti, idaṃ punarasti--prātipadikasyānta udātto bhavatīti| yo'sau lakṣaṇenāntodāttaḥ, tatrāntaryato'ntodātta ādeśaḥ prāpnoti| nanu gamerḍo vidhīyate? tataḥ kim, pratyayādyudāttatve kṛte āntaryata ādyudātta ādeśo bhaviṣyati| kathaṃ punarayamādyudāttaḥ, yāvatā ekāc vyapadeśivadbāvena? yadyevam, tata evāntodātto'pi, tatrāntaryato'ntodāttasyāntodātto'vaṅādeśaḥ prasajyate ? satyam; nanviḍaṃ lakṣaṇamasti--pratyayasyāntodātto bhavatīti, idaṃ punarasti--pratyayasyādirudātto bhavatīti| yo'sau lakṣaṇenādyudāttastatrāntaryata ādyudātta ādeśo bhaviṣyati| syādevaṃ yadi `ādyantavadekasmin' iti śāstrātideśaḥ syāt| yadā tvanena kāryamātramudāttatvam, antatve asatyevāditve cātidiśyate tadaukārasyaivāditvavyapadeśābhāvāt kutastadādeśasyādyudāttatvam! tataśca paryāyeṇa tvaniyatadeśamādyudāttatvaṃ syāditi pakṣe doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | tatra sūtrakāreṇa tāvallāghavamanādṛtyāvaṅgādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tatra yathā svare doṣo na bhavati, tathā darśayati--ādyudātto'vaṅādeśo nipātyata iti| ekaśrutyā sūtrapāṭhe yadatra yatnenādyudāttoccāraṇaṃ tadantodāttatvabādhanārthaṃ vijñāyate, anyatra samāsāntodāttatvena vādhyata iti| etacca bhāṣye `upadeśivadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanena labhyate, anyathā paratvāt pūrvaṃ samāsāntodāttatve kṛte avaṅi avaṅsvara eva satiśiṣṭatvāt syāt| upadeśivadbhāve tu pūrvamavaṅi kṛte paścāt samāsa iti satiśiṣṭatvāt samāsasvara eva bhavati| padāntādityeva--gavo, gavoḥ, gavām, gavi ||
indre ca || 6.1.124 ||
atra yadi `aci' iti viseṣaṇam, indraśabdo viśeṣyam, tadā'jādau indraśabda ityarthaḥ syāt| tataśca gavendrayajña ityādau na syāt, anuttarapadatvāt| yadyapyatrottarapadagrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpyarthātsamāsa etadvidhānam, na hyanyatra goranantara indraśabdaḥ sambhavati| samāse ca vidhānamarthāduttarapada eva syāt--ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇavat, tasmādajviśeṣyam, indraśabdo viśeṣaṇam, aci parataḥ kasminnindre yaḥ sthitastasminniti, tadidamuktam--indraśabdasthe'cīti ||

plutapragṛhyā aci nityam || 6.1.125 ||
nanu yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ, na ca plutasya vikāraḥ prāptaḥ, svarasandhiṣu tasyāsiddhatvāt? ityata āśrayātplutaḥ siddhaḥ iti| yadidaṃ plutasya prakṛtibhāvaṃ prati kāyitvenāśrayaṇam, āha--asmādeva jñāpakāt `svarasandhiṣu plutaḥ siddhaḥ' iti kalpyata ityarthaḥ|
ādeśanimittasyācaḥ parigrahārthamiti| yasminnādeśo vidhīyate sa eva prakṛtibhāvasyāpi nimittatvena parigṛhīto yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ| jānu u asyeti| uñ nipātaḥ, tasya pūrveṇa sahaikādeśasya yannimittaṃ na sapragṛhyāduttaraḥ, yaśca tataḥ paro na sa ekādeśasya nimittamiti prakṛtibhāvābhāvādekādeśo bhavatyeva| asati punarajgrahaṇe `pragṛhyo'ci parataḥ prakṛtyā bhavati' ityucyamāne pūrveṇasaha yo vikāraḥ prāptastasyāpi prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt| punarajgrahaṇe tu na bhavati, tatraikādeśe kṛte tasyādivadbhāvātpragṛhyagrahaṇena grahaṇāt| `iko yaṇaci' iti yaṇādeśaḥ prakṛtivadbhāvānna bhavati, `maya uño vo vā' iti pakṣe vakāraḥ|
nityagrahaṇamanuvarttata iti| pūrvasūtre nityagrahaṇametadarkhameva kṛtam, tatra tvāranbhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhiḥ siddhaḥ| nityameva prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāditi| ayameva prakṛtibhāvo nityaṃ yathā syāt, śāstrāntareṇa kāryāntarasahito mā bhūdityarthaḥ ||

āṅo'nunāsikaśchandasi || 6.1.126 ||
teneha na bhavatīti| anarthakasyaivākārasya bhavati, abhra ām̐ apa ityādau saptamyaiva tadarśasyoktatvāttadaryavṛttirāṅnarthakaḥ; anurthāntaravācitvāt| ātaradityatra tu kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādarthavān|
kathaṃ punaranarthakasya ṅittvam, yāvatā---
`īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādā'bhividhau ca yaḥ|
etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyādvākyasmaraṇayoraṅit' || ityuktam ?
satyam; `vākyasmaraṇayoraṅit' ityatraiva tātparyam, anyatra sarvatra āṅ ṅidveditavyaḥ--evaṃ tāvadbhāṣye sthitam ||

iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca || 6.1.127 ||
kimarthaścakāraḥ, prakṛtyetyetadanukṛṣyate'nena ? nanu ca hrasvavidhānasāmarthyādeva svarasandhirna bhaviṣyati ? bhaveddīrghāṇāṃ hrasvavacanasāmarthyādeva svarasandhirna syāditi hrasvānāṃ tu prāpnoti| na hi hrasvānāṃ hrasvo bhavati; prayojanābhāvāt| asti prayojanam--svarasandhirmā bhūditi? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---prakṛtibhāvamātraṃ kvacidyathā syāditi, teneṣā akṣādiṣu cchandasi prakṛtibhāvamātraṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|
śākalyagrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti| atha vikalpārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--ārambhasāmarthyādeveti| savarṇe'ci dīrghavidhānādyaṇādeśasyāsavarṇa evājviṣayaḥ, asyāpi vidheḥ sa eva viṣayaḥ, tataśca viṣayaikyādeva vikalpe siddhe na tadarthaka mācāryagrahaṇam |
sinnityasamāsayoriti| nityādhikāravihito'svapadavigrahaśca samāso nityasamāsaḥ, ekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyate, siti parato nityasamāse ca viṣaya iti, śāklyasyāyāṃ vidhiḥ śākalaḥ, `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ| ṛtviya iti| ṛturasya prāpta iti `ṛtoraṇ', `chandasi ghas'| vyākaraṇamiti| `kugatiprādaya' iti samāsaḥ, tatra `nityam' ityanuvarttate| kumāryathamiti| kumāryai idaṃ kumāryartham, asvapadavigraho'yaṃ nityasamāsaḥ ||

ṛtyakaḥ || 6.1.128 ||
savarṇarthamanigarthaṃ ca vacanamiti| hotṛ ṛśyaḥ, khaṭva ṛśya ityādau; inyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ||

aplutavadupasthite || 6.1.129 ||
ṛṣiḥ-vedaḥ tatra bhava ārṣaḥ, tato'nyonārṣaḥ, samudāyādvākyādavacchidya pṛthakakṛtya svarūpe'vasthāpyate| kaiḥ? padakāraiḥ. padasyeyattāparijñānāya aplutena tulyaṃ varttata ityaplutavat| tatra yena sādharmyeṇāplutavattvam, taddarśayati--aplutakāryamiti| tatrāpi plutaśabdena vihitasya kāryasya pratiṣedha iti darśayati--prakṛtibhāvaṃ karotīti| anyathā svarasandherapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tasyāpi plukāryatvāt| udāharaṇeṣu plutakāryapabratiṣedhādekādeśo bhavat plutamevopamṛdya bhavati; svarasandhiprakaraṇe plutasya sidvatvāt|
tatra ko doṣa iti| ekādeśena nivarttyamānatvāt plutasya śravaṇena na bhavitavyamiti pluta eva niṣidhyatām, kimarthamatideśāśrayaṇamiti praśanaḥ| agnī3 itīti| yatra plutāśrayo'pi prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, pragṛhyāśrayo'pi; tatra plutāśrayasya pratiṣedhe'pi pragṛhyāśrayasya prakṛtibhāvasya pratiṣedhābhāvāt plutasya śravaṇaṃ siddhyati, platapratiṣedhe tu kriyamāṇe'trāpi śravaṇaṃ na syāt ||

ī3 cākravarmaṇasya|| 6.1.130 ||
sūtre ī ceti trimātrikasya nirddeśaḥ| aci parata iti| upasthitagrahaṇaṃ cāsvaritatvānnivṛttam| astu hī3 ityabrūtāmiti| `vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ' iti plataḥ, asterloṭi tip, `eruḥ'|
tadupasthite nivṛttyarthamiti| tatra pūrveṇāplutavadbhāvasya nityaprāptatvāt, anupasthite prāptyarthamiti, tatra kenacidaprāptatvāt|
īkārādanyatrāpīti| tathā ca bhāṣyam--`īkāragrahaṇena nārthaḥ' ityādi ||


diva ut || 6.1.131 ||
padagrahaṇamanuvarttata iti| antagrahaṇenopasamastamapi kevalaṃ padagrahaṇamevānuvarttate, tataścārthāt ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ jāyate, divaśabdena viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ, `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' iti tu pratyayavidhiviṣayam| vyapadeśivadbhāvāt kevalasyāpi bhavitavyam, `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' ityetadapi pratyayavidhiviṣayameva| sānubandhakatvāditi| dīvyaterdhātorukāro'nubandhaḥ, prātipadikasya tu na kaścidanubandhaḥ. divaḥ padasyeti| tadantasya padasyetyarthaḥ. dyukāma iti| divaṃ kāmayate iti `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ' vimaladyu iti| vimalā dyaura'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| akṣadyubhyāmiti| akṣaśabda upapade dīvyateḥ kvip, tatra `cchvoḥ śūḍanāsite ca' ityūṭh|
atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, yadyapi `ṛta ut' iti taparakaraṇena jñāpitam--`bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇāti' iti, tathāpyāntarthato'rddhamātrākālasya vyañjanasya mātrika eva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--taparakaraṇamiti| yadyapyanena dīrgho na prāpneti, prāpnoti, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tu prāptotītyāha--dyubhyām, dyubhiriti| utvasyāvakāśo yatrāyajādiparaḥ--vimaladyu, ūṭho'vakāśaḥ--dyūtvā, dyūtam; yatra tūbhayoḥ prasaṅgastatra paratvādūṭha prāpnoti, taparakaraṇādutvameva bhavati| yadi prāptasyoṭho nivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamityucyate evaṃ tarhi `cachvoḥ śūḍanunāsite ca' ityatra `kathaṃ dyubhyām, dyubhiḥ' iti pareṇa codite yadvakṣyati--`ūṭhi kṛte diva uditi taparakaraṇānāmātrākālo bhaviṣyati', tadviruddhyate, tasya hyūṭhi kṛte tasyaivoṭho mātrākālo bhaviṣyatītyayamarthaḥ ? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; `ūṭhi kṛte' ityetasya pūrveṇa codyagranthena sambandhaḥ--`kathaṃ dyubhyāṃ dyubhiriti, ūṭhi kṛte' iti; `diva ut iti taparakaraṇāt mātrākālo bhaviṣyati' ityetāvān parihāragranthaḥ. taparakaraṇasya tūṇnivṛttireva prayojanam| tasmāduttvamevātra karttavyam, na punaruḍityarthaḥ ||

etattadoḥ sulopo'koranañsamāse hali || 6.1.132 ||
etena `etattadoḥ' iti suśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhītyācaṣṭe| yadyevam, su ityetasya sāpekṣatvāllopaśabdena samāso na prāpnoti ? naivāyaṃ samāsaḥ, su iti pṛthakpadam `supāṃ suluk' iti luptaṣṭhīkam| kaśca tayoḥ suśabda iti| yadi yastābhyāṃ vihitaḥ suḥ sa tayoḥ sambandhī bhavati, tadā paramasa dadāti, paramaiṣa dadātītyādo na syāditi manyamānaḥ pṛcchati| itaro viditābhiprāyaḥ parihati-yastadarthena sambaddha iti| arthadvārakaśca sambanadhaḥ, yastadarthagatamekatvamācaṣṭa ityarthaḥ| paramasa dadātītyādāvapi uttarapadārthapradhānatvāttadarthagatamevaikatvamācaṣṭa iti siddho lopaḥ| prathamaikavacanasyātra suśabdasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya| `syaśchandasi' `so'ci lope cetpādapūrṇam' ityatra hyasyaiva sambhavaḥ| dvayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ tarhi kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ tarhi `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubanadhakasya' iti prathamaikavacanasyaiva grahaṇam, tasya hyukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, nānubandhaḥ| eṣa iti| `tadoḥ sa sāvanantyayoḥ' iti sakāraḥ, tyadādyatvam, ṣatvam| eṣaka iti| `avyasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' ityakac |
nanu rūpabhedātsākackāvetattadāveva na bhavataḥ, tatkim `akoḥ' iti pratiṣedhena ? tatrāha--tanmadhyapatiti iti| asyāśca paribhāṣāyā astitve ayameva pratiṣedho liṅgam |
uttarapadārthapradhānatvāditi| etacca nañsūtra eva vyākhyātam| `halṅyābbhyaḥ' ityasyānantaramidaṃ na kṛtam--saṃhitāyāṃ yathā syāt, asaṃhitāyāṃ mā bhūditi ||

syaśchandasi bahulam || 6.1.133 ||
sya iti yadityasya prathamāntasyānukaraṇam `supāṃ suluk' iti luptaṣaṣṭhīkam| anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādanutpattireva vā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ| udāharaṇe satvādi pūrvavat ||

so'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam || 6.1.134 ||
sa iti nirdeśaḥ pūrvavat|
keciditi| svayaṃ tu chando'dhikārādṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ manyate ||

suṭ kāt pūrvaḥ || 6.1.135 ||
saṃskarttati| saṃmpuṃkānāṃ so vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanāt `samassuṭi' iti dvisakārakatvādvā nirdeśasya samo makārasakya sakāraḥ, `atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā' iti pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ| iha `samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe', `kiratau lavane' ityādau kakārādāvāgamini ṭittvādeva suṭ kātpūrvo labhyate| `hrasvāccandrottarapade' ityādau kātpūrvatvasambhavādanupayoga evetyanarthakaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇ| syādetat--saṃcaskāretyādāvabhyāse sañjāte sābhyāsasya karotitvāccātpūrvaḥ suṭa syāt, mā bhūccātpūrvaḥ, kātpava eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇamiti ? tanna; atra hi liṭi dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, suṭ ca; tatra dvirvacanamakṛte suṭi kṛśabdasya prāpnoti, kṛte tu skṛśabdasya| suḍapi kṛte dvirvacane cakṛśabdasya prāpnoti, akṛte tu kṛśabdasyetyubhayoranityayoḥ paratvāt suṭi kṛte tasya dhātugrahaṇena grahaṇāt sahaiva tena dvirvacane `sarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' iti khayaḥ śeṣe saṃcaskāreti siddham| na ca sābhyāsasyākṛtaḥ sukaḍiti punaḥ suṭprasaṅgaḥ; asminneva prayoge lakṣaṇasya pravṛttatvāt |
nanu `pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' iti darśane pūrvaṃ sādhanavācini lakāre tadāśraye ca dvirvacane ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅge kṛte padadvayāśrayatvādbahiraṅgaḥ suṭ paścādbhāvan cātpūrvaḥ syāt, samaskārodityādau cāntaraṅgatvāt paratvāccāṭi kṛte tena vyavadhānānnaiva suṭ syāt, vikaraṇāntāṅgabhakto hyaḍāgamastameva na vyavadadhyāt, karotiṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva; iha ca samaskṛta, saṃskṛthā iti yatra karotirevāऱṅgaṃ tatrāṭaḥ kṛgrahaṇena grahaṇādaṭa eva pūrvaḥ suṭ syāt, ato'ḍabhyāsayorapi kṛtayoḥ kāt pūrvaḥ suḍyathā syāditi karttavyaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇam? na karttavyam; `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityetasmādeva nirdeśādetatsiddham| na ca tatra kariṣyāmīti kātpūrvagrahaṇam, kṛte'pyasminnasiddheḥ| tathā hi-kriyamāṇamapyetatkālāvadhāraṇārthaṃ vā syāt--karotestasyāmavasthāyāṃ suḍ bhavati yasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhavan kātpūrvo bhavatīti| karotyavadhāraṇārathaṃ vā--tasya karoteḥ suḍ bhavati yasya bhavan kātpūrvo bhavatīti| tatra pūrvasminpakṣe yadyapyantaraṅge apyaḍadvirvacane bādhitvā kātpūrvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrvaṃ suḍ bhavati, paścāttayoḥ kṛtayoriṣṭaṃ siddhyati| dvitīye tu pratyutābhyāsavatornirvṛttyarthameva kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ syāt, na hi tadvatorbhavan kātpūrvaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt| syādetat--na karotyavadhāraṇārthaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇam, kiṃ tahi ? apakṛṣya vidhiḥ, karoteḥ sarvatra suḍa bhavati, sa tu pradeśāntare prāptaḥ kātpūrvaḥ karttavya iti ? evamapi samaskṛta, samaskṛthā iti siddhyati, aṭaṛḥ prākprāpnuvan kātpūrvo nīyata iti, samāskarodityādau tvasiddhireva, katham ? pradesāntare prāptasya vidhirapakṛṣya bhavati,na cātra suṭ prāpto'cā vyavadānāditi kathamapakṛṣya vidhirbhavet| kathaṃ ca saṃcaskāretyādāvapi ddhiḥprayoge dvirvacane uccāraṇabhedācchabdabheda iti dvau karotī, tatra yaḥ samo'nantaro na tasya kakāraḥ, yasya ca kakāro nāsau samo'nantaraḥ--iti aprāptatvān na kātpūrvaṃ vidhīyeta ? sthāne dvirvacane ca sthānivadbhāvādeka eva karotiḥ, sa cāvyavahita iti kātu pūrvaḥ prāptaḥ kāt pūrvaḥ kṛta iti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tadevaṃ dhātuḥ pūrvaṃ sādhanena yujyate, tataśca kriyamāṇe'pi kātpūrvagrahaṇe naiveṣṭaṃ sidhyatīti `aḍbhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityetadeva karttavyam| kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ tu śakyamakarttumati vāttiṃkakārasya pakṣaḥ|
yadi tu `samparyupaiḥ karotau' iti tṛtīyānirddaśena samādibhirupasṛṣṭasya suḍvidhīyate, tadā vyavahitasyāpyupasṛṣṭatvātkātpūrvagrahaṇenāpyayamarthaḥ śakyate sampādayitam| katham? samaskarodityādau tāvadantareṇāpi kātpūrvagrahaṇamaṭo na bhaviṣyati; tasya karotiṃ pratyanavayavatvāt| karotestu bhaviṣyati; vyavahitasyāpyupasṛṣṭatvāt| samaskṛtetyādau tvaṭaḥ pūrva prāpartaḥ kātpūrvaṃ ceṣyate| saṃcaskāretyādau ca sthāne dvirvacane kātpūrvaṃ ceṣyate| saṃcaskāretyādau ca sthāne dvirvacane kātpūrvaṃ prāptaḥ kātpūrvaṃ kariṣyate| dviḥprayoge tu dvayorapi karotyoḥ prāptaḥ pūrvasmādeva kariṣyate, na hi tasya kṛtaḥ kātpūrvaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi siddhamiṣṭamga|
bhāṣyakārastu mene--ubhayaṃ na karttavyam| pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate, tataścānu tpanna eva pratyaye saṃkṛ iti sthite suṭi kṛte lakāraḥ, tatastannibandhanāvaḍabhyāsau sasuṭkasyaiva bhaviṣyataḥ| nanu ca labdhasvarūpā kriyā viseṣaṇamākāṅkṣati, tallābhaśca sādhanāntara iti pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate, labdhvasvarupeti, ko'ratha ? kiṃ pratipannasvarūpā, uta niṣpannasvarūpā? niṣpattistāvadviśeṣaṇasambandhenopayujyate, pratipattistu viśeṣaṇasambandhātprāgapi kriyāyāḥ sambhavati| viśiṣṭā ca kriyā sādhanena yujyate, tatā hi--tiṣṭhatīti gatinivṛtteḥ sādhanasambandhaḥ pratīyate, pratiṣṭhata iti gateḥ, gacchatīti gamanasya, āgacchatītyāgamanasya, karotīti vyāpāramātrasya, saṃskarotīti bhūṣaṇasya| viśiṣṭā ca kriyopasargasambandhe satyeva pratīyata iti dyotakatvena vācakatvena vā pūrvamupasrgasambandho'pekṣaṇīyaḥ| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam; anyathā bhavaterakarmatvādbhāve lakāra utpanne paścādanuśabdena sambande anubhūyate kambalo devadatteneti kathaṃ karmaṇi lakāraḥsyāt? ataḥ `pūrvaṃ dhāturūpasargeṇa yujyate' ityetadeva sampratipannam| evaṃ ca pūrvoktanyāsena siddhamiṣṭamiti nārthaḥ kātpūrvagrahaṇena, nāpi `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' ityanena| yadi pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate; adhyetā, pratyetā, pratyāyaka ityādau pūrvaṃ dhātūpasargayorekādeśe tasya dhātuṃ pratyādivattvāttata eva pratyayotpattāvaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `nendrasya parasya' ityatra jñāpitametat--pūrvottarapadayostāvatkāryaṃ bhavati, paścāt svarasandhirati| pratyaya iti vā nirdeśo'syārthasya jñāpakaḥ|
vṛttikārastu--ubhayaṃ vaktavyamiti manyamānaḥ kātpūrvagrahaṇasya tāvatprayojanamāha--kātpūrvagrahaṇamityādi| kiṃ punarabhaktatve prayojanam ? ata āha--tathā hīti| saṃskṛṣīṣṭeti| āśiṣi liṅ, ātmanepadam, `uśca' iti kittvam, suṭ,tayoḥ kātpūrvaḥ suṭ, tasya karotibhaktatvāt karotigrahaṇeṇa grahaṇāt kṛñaḥ saṃyogāditā jñāyeteti `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' itīṭ prasajyeta| saṃskriyata iti| karmaṇi laṭ `riṅ śayagliṅkṣu'| atrāpi bhaktatve suṭaḥ kṛñaḥ saṃyogāditvāt `guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' iti guṇaḥ syāt, atasyau mā bhūtāmiti abhaktaḥ suḍeṣitavya iti bhāvaḥ| nighāto'pi tarhi na prāpnoti? samaḥ padasya suṭā vyavahitatvāt, suṭaścāpadatvāt|
guṇaḥ kathamiti| suṭo'bhaktatvenāṅgasya saṃyogāditvābhāvātpraśanaḥ| `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate'iti sthānedvirvacanapakṣe dviḥprayoge ca samudāyasyaivāṅgasaṃjñetyukt, tataśca tadaṅgamadhyapatitaḥ tadaṅgagrahaṇena gṛhyate|
nanvevamapi asaṃyogāditvaṃ tadavastham ? ata āha--saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ ceti| antyādacaḥ pūrvasya varṇasyopadhāsaṃjñāvidhānāt `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' ityetaduktaṃ bhavati, yadi na sambhaktaḥ suṭ ṭitkaraṇaṃ kimartham ? ityata āha---ṭitkaraṇamamiti| `suṭastusvañjām' ityucyamāne suretyādau yaḥ suśabdau yaścopasargastasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataśca surāṃ paricaṣṭe parisurayatītyādāvapi prāpnoti ||

aḍbhyāsavyavāye'pi || 6.1.136 ||
vyavāyaḥ-vyavadhānam, apiśabdādavyavadhāne'pi, asati tu tasmin vyavāya eva syāt| saṃcaskaritheti| `ṛto bhāradvājasya' ityetadapyasuṭa eveṣyata iti vacanādiḍāgamaḥ| pūrvaṃ dhāturityādi| yadyapi `pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate' ityatrāpi darśane sutarāmetadanārambhaṇīyam, tathāpi svadarśanatvādupapannatvāccedameva darśanamupanyastam| apara āha--`kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate' ityasyānantaraṃ yāvateti paṭhitavyam, tataśca paścādaḍabhyāsāvityevamantaścodyagranthaḥ' iti| pariharati--abhaktuśceti| castvarthe| tatreti| abhakte| etasmistu satītyādi| nanu cāsmādeva vacanātkṛtayorabhyāsayostadvyavāye'pi suṭ kātpūrvaḥ kriyatām, yastu saṃkṛ ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ suṭ prāpnoti sa kena vāryeta? ucyate; nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāttasyānena bādhaḥ| apare tu-etaccodyabhayādbhāṣyakāramatameva jyāyo manyante| yakatpunaruktamādguṇaprasaṃga iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' ityatra tāvadupadeśa iti varttate, kva prakṛtam? `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' iti, tataḥ kim? `apadeśe saṃyogādeḥ' iti suṭi kṛte na bhaviṣyati| `guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' ityatrāpi nityamityanuvarttate, kva prakṛtam ? `nityaṃ chandasi'iti, tataḥ kim ? nityaṃ yaḥ saṃyogādistasya guṇaḥ ? suṭi kṛte na bhaviṣyati ||

samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe || 6.1.137 ||
sampūrvasya kvacidabhūṣaṇe'pīṣyata iti| etacca `saṃskṛtaṃka bhakṣāḥ' iti nirdesāllabhyate ||

samavāye ca || 6.1.138 ||
udāharaṇeṣu bhāve niṣṭhā| evaṃ samuditamityatrāpi ||

upāt pratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu || 6.1.139 ||
sata ityādi| labdhasattākasyārthasya pūrvaṃ ye guṇā ādhīyante| yena tadguṇāntarādhāna tatpunaḥ kimartham ? ityāha--ādhikyāyeti| ādhikyam-vṛddhiḥ| vṛddhasya vā tādavasthayāyeti| tasya vṛddhiyuktāvasthāyāḥ pracyutiparihārāyetyarthaḥ| samīhā-ceṣṭā| agamyamānārthasyeti| arthaprakaraṇādinā| vākyasyeti| vākyaikadeśasyetyarthaḥ| edho dakasyeti| jātidvandvaḥ, `kṛñaḥ pratiyatne' iti ṣaṣṭhī, `pratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ' ityātmanepadam| upaskṛtaṃ bhuṅktu iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇam, vikṛtaṃ bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| upaskṛtaṃ jalpatīti| sādhyāhāraṃ yathā tathā jalpatītyarthaḥ|
athaivaṃ kasmānna kṛtam--`sampratibhyāṃ karotau bhūṣaṇasamavāyayoḥ, upātpratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu ca' iti ? sūtrakāraṃ pṛccha ||

kiratau lavane || 6.1.140 ||
kiratau lavanaviṣaya iti| arthadvārakaṃ kiraterlavanaviṣayatvam, lavanaviṣaye vikṣepe yaḥ kiratirvarttate tatretyarthaḥ| tadāha--vikṣipya lunantītyartha iti| sākṣāttu viṣaye kiraterlavanamevārthaḥ syāt|
ṇamulatra vaktavya iti| ābhīkṣaṇyāderṇamularthasyābhāvāt ||
hisāyāṃ prateśca || hisāyāṃ viṣaya iti| na tvabhidheyāyām| vikṣepa eva tvabhidheyaḥ, tadeva darśayati--tatheti| udāharaṇe napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ, haṃśabda kope| parinivibhya eva suṭaḥ ṣatvam, na prateḥ ||

apāccatuṣpācchakuniṣvālekhane || 6.1.142 ||
tasminviṣaya iti| na tvabhidheye| vikṣepa eva tvabhidheyaḥ, tadāraha---ālikhya vikṣipatītyartha iti|
harṣajīviketyādi| harṣaḥ-pramodaḥ, jīvikā-prāṇaparitrāṇopāyaḥ, kulāyaḥ-āśrayaḥ|
kiṃ punarudāharaṇa evātmanepadaṃ bhavati, na pratyudāharaṇe? ata āhaharṣajīviketyādi ||

kustumburūṇi jātiḥ || 6.1.143 ||
sūtre napuṃsakaliṅgena bahuvacanena ca nirddeśāt phalajātāveva suṭā bhavitavyam, na tvoṣadhijātau ? ityāśaṅkyāha--sūtranirdeśa iti| napuṃsakaliṅgagrahaṇaṃ bahuvacanasyāpyupalakṣaṇam ||

aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye || 6.1.143 ||
aparasparā iti| apare ca pare ceti dvandvaḥ, nipā tanādalpāctarasya paranipātaḥ| sārthā gacchantīti| sārthabhūtā gacchantītyarthaḥ| satatamavicchedeneti| na kadācidasmin mahāpathe gamanaṃ vicchidyata ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ cārthaḥ suṭā dyotyate| kimidamiti| `asmādeva nipātanān malopaḥ' ityucyamāne satatamiti na siddhayati, sūtre `pyañantoccāraṇāditi praśnaḥ| kathamiti malopasya lakṣaṇaṃ na dṛśyate| atha `sātatye' ityetadeva nipātanaṃ sāmānyena tataśabde parataḥ samo makārasya lopo bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpakaṃ kalpyate, santatamiti na siddhyet, bādhakatvānnipātanānāmiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ|
samastate vikalpeneti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ---sātatyaśabdaṃ pūrvācāryalakṣaṇasiddhamuccārayatā pūrvācāryalakṣaṇamāśritam, atastena samo makārasya lopo vidhīyata iti evañca kṛtvāvaśyaṃprabhṛtīnāmapi kṛtyādiṣu makāralopaḥ siddho bhavati, tadeva pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti--lumpedityādi| antyamiti śeṣaḥ| kṛtyapratyayānte parato'vaśyaṃśabdasyāntyaṃ lumpet, lopamasya kuryādityarthaḥ| `śe mucādīnām' iti num| avaśyakāryamityudāharaṇam| tumiti vṛttabhaṅgabhayātṣaṣṭhī na kṛtā| tumpratyayāntasyāntyaṃ lumpet, kāmamanasoḥ śabdayoḥ parataḥ--karttu kāmo'sya karttukāmaḥ, kartuṃ mano'sya karttumanāḥ, tumapyatropasaṃkhyāyate, akriyopapadatvādityāhuḥ| saṃśabdasyāntyaṃ lumpet, vā-vikalpena, hitatayoḥ śabdayoḥ parataḥ--sahitam, saṃhitam, satatam, saṃtatam| nagisamāsaḥ| māṃsaśabdasyāpyantyaṃ lumpet, kva? paci, pacatidhātau| kiṃviśiṣṭe ? yuḍghañoḥ, yuṭi ghañi ca parato yaḥ pacistasminnityarthaḥ, māspacanam, māspākaḥ, karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| saṃhitāyāṃ samāse caiṣa malopa ityāhuḥ|
atha santataśabdāt pyañ bhavati vā na vā sāntatyamiti, tetyāhuḥ ||
goṣpadaṃ sevitāsevitapramāṇeṣu || gāvaḥ padyante'sminniti| `puṃsi saṃjñāyām' ityadhikaraṇe ghaḥ, karttari ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| agoṣpadānyaraṇyānīti| nanu ca sūtre goṣpadaśabda upāttaḥ, tat kimidam? ityata āha--asevita ityādi| kriyate cedamasevitagrahaṇam, na ca tatra goṣpadaśabdaḥ sambhavati, tasmādasevite goṣpadaśabdārthanipātanaṃ vijñāyate| nārtha eteneti| asevitagrahaṇena| kathaṃ tena vinā siddhiḥ ? tatrāha--goṣpadapratiṣedhāditi| satyamiti| goṣpadapratiṣedhāditi yaduktam, tat satyaṃ manyate, na tu nārtha eteneti| tad yadi satyam, kimarthaṃ tarhyasevitagrahaṇam ? ityāha--yatra tviti| nañsamāso hi tatpuruṣaḥ svabhāvāduttarapadārthasadṛśamarthamācaṣṭe-abrāhmaṇavat, tataśca na goṣpadamagoṣpadamiti nañsamāse kṛte yatra sevitasya sevanasya prasaṅgo'sti, tatraivāgoṣpadamiti syāt, sa eva goṣpada sya deśasya sadṛśaḥ; yatra tvatyantāsmbhava eva sevitasya tatra na syāt| asevita grahaṇasāmarthyāttu bahuvrīhirāśrīyate, sa cātyantābhāve'pi bhavati| tena yeṣu gavāmatyantāsambhavaḥ, tānyaraṇyānyāsevitaśabdenocyante| tataśca tatrāpyagoṣpadamiti bhavati| atyantāsambhavaṃ spaṣṭayati--yāni hi mahāntyaraṇyānīti| tatra kecidāhuḥ--yatra gavāmatyantāsambhavaḥ, tatraivāgoṣpadaśabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ, na tvasambhava iti| anye tvaviśeṣeṇecchanti| na caivamasevitagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyam, asati hyasminnatyantāsambhave na syāt| goṣpadapūramiti| `varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām' iti ṇamul| nanu ca goṣpadamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam, tasya goḥ sambandhi padamarthaḥ, na tu pramāṇam? tatrāha--nātra goṣpadaṃ svārthapratipādanārthamupādīyata iti| tathā ca goṣpadapūraṃ vṛṣṭe deva iti| asatyapi goṣpadapūraṇe prayujyate, yathā--celaknopaṃ vṛṣṭo deva ityasatyapi celakrope ||

āspadaṃ pratiṣṭhāyām || 6.1.146 ||
ātmayāpanāyeti| prāṇadhāraṇam-ātmayāpanam, tadartha yatsthānam, sā pratiṣṭhā| āspadamiti| āṅpūrvātpadeḥ pūrvavadadhikaraṇe ghaḥ, lokāśrayatvādasmādeva nipātanādvā napuṃsakaliṅgatā, āpadamityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ ||

āścaryamanitye || 6.1.147 ||
yadyāścaryamanitye nipātyate, ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha--anityatayetyādi| loke yadanucitamadṛṣṭapūrvamupalabhyate, tadanityātayā vyāptaṃ kādācitkatvam, ato'nityatā viṣayabhūtā bhavati| tathā viṣayabhūtayā adbhūtatvaṃ pismayahetutvamupalakṣyate| udāharaṇe `anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi' ityanavaklṛptāvasambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ| rugṇasya mandakarṇasya cāviśiṣṭe kālādau bhojanamadhyayanaṃ cādṛṣṭapūrvaṃ dṛśyamānamadbhūtaṃ bhavatīti| āścaryamiti| `carerāṅi cāgurau' iti yan| ācaryamanuṣṭheyamityarthaḥ ||

varcaske'vaskaraḥ || 6.1.148 ||
kutsitaṃ varco varcaskam, `kutsite' iti kan, `so'padādau' iti satvam| kanā nirddeśo dīptau mā bhūditi, dīptāvapi hi varcaḥśabdo varttate| annamalamiti| bhāṇḍeṣu yallagnaṃ kāṣṭhādinā'pakṛṣya kākādibhyo vikīryate tadannamalam| avakīryata iti| bhūmāvavakṣipyata ityarthaḥ| tatsambandhād deśopīti| yatra bhāṇḍāni parimṛjyante deśe sa deśaḥ| tathā ca yājñavalkayaḥ--- `sammārjitāvaskarayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā' iti| apara āha--purīṣaṃ varcaskaṃ taddeśaśceti| avakara iti| brahmacāriṇaḥ striyāṃ retaḥ seka-avakaraḥ, yato'vakīrṇo bhavati ||

apaskaro rathāṅgam || 6.1.149 ||
atra sūtre tṛtīya upasargaḥ, pūrvatra ṣaṣṭhaḥ ||

viṣkiraḥ śakunirvikiro vā || 6.1.150 ||
viṣkiro vetyādi| śakunāvabhidheye viṣkira iti vā suṇnipātyata ityetāvataiva suṅvikalpaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ| vikiragrahaṇamityādi| asati tasmin kapratyayāntasya vikiraśabdasya śakunau vikalpārthamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāditi vikiraśabdasyānyatra prayogo na nivarttitaḥ syāditi| punarvikiragrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| yathā tu bhāṣyaṃ tathā `viṣkiraḥ śakunau vā' ityetāvat sūtram ||

hrasvāccandrottarapade mantre || 6.1.151 ||
suḍāgamo bhavatīti| pūrvaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇādabhaktaḥ suḍityuktam, iha tu kātpūrvatvaṃ na sambhavati, āgamaliṅgaṃ ca ṭittvamastītyāgama eva suḍukta iti bhāvaḥ| sa ca bhavan `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān' iti candraśabdasyaiva bhavati, sūryācandramasāviti| dvandvaḥ, `devatādvandve ca' ityānaṅ|
uttarapadamityādi| svanikāyaprasiddhireveṣā ||

pratiṣkaśaśca kaśeḥ || 6.1.152 ||
atra yadyapītyādi| kaśeriti| yaddhātorupādānaṃ tasya nānyatprayojanamiti bhāvaḥ||

praskaṇvahariścandrāvṛṣī || 6.1.153 ||
hariścandro rājarṣiḥ| prakaṇvo deśa iti| kaṇvam-pāpam, tatpragataṃ yasmātsa evamucyate| ihiḥ candro yasya mugdhasya sa haricandraḥ|

maskaramaskariṇau veṇuparivrājakayoḥ || 6.1.154 ||
parivrājake tvinirapīti| matvarthābhāvādiniraprāptaḥ, ataḥ so'pi nipātyate, na hi parivrājako makareṇa tadvān, maskareṇa tu veṇunā tadvān bhavati; daṇḍadhāraṇāt, tataḥ kim ? maskaraśabdādininā siddham| evamapi saṃyoge matvarthīyavidhānānmaskarasaṃyukta eva maskarītyucyeta, mā bhūdevaṃ parivrājakamātravacano yathā syāditīnirnipātyate, vyutpatteradarśanādvā nātra spaṣṭaṃ nipātyam, taddarśayati--keciditi| mākaraṇaśīla iti| pratiṣedhaśīlasa ityarthaḥ| karmāpavāditvāditi| karmaśabdeneha kāmyamarmāṇi vivakṣitāni, na nityanaimittikāni, tāni hi mamukṣorapi karttavyāni| yathā''huḥ--
mokṣārthī na pravartteta tataḥ kāmyanipiddhayoḥ|
nityanaimittike kuryāt pratyavāyanivṛttaye || iti |
tāni karmāṇyapavadituṃ pratiṣeddhuṃ śīlamasya sa karmāpavādī| paramahaṃsāstu karmamātramapavadanti| mā kuruteti| na karttavyānītyarthaḥ| karmaṇi luṅ ||

kāstīrājastunde nagare || 6.1.155 ||
kecinnagare iti prathamādvivacanāntabhāhuḥ| vṛttau tu saptamyantaṃ vyākhyātm| kātīramiti| `īṣadarthe ca' iti kābhāvaḥ ||

kāraskaro vṛkṣa || 6.1.156 ||
pāraskaraprabhṛtiṣveveti| nedaṃ sūtramadhīyata ityarthaḥ ||

pāraskaraprabhṛtīni ca saṃjñāyām || 6.1.157 ||
rūḍhiśabdā ete yathākathañcidvyutpādyāḥ| pāhaṅkarotīti pāraskaraḥ, `kṛño hetu' ityādinā ṭaḥ| rathaṃ yātīti rathaṣyā| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ'| ṣatvāgapyatra nipātyate| anye tu sakārameva paṭhanti| kiṃ karotīti karoterḍuḥ, kimo'ntyalopaḥ, suṭ, kiṣkuḥ| kimapi dhatte kiṣkindhā | pūrvavatkaḥ, kimo dvirvacanaṃ pūrvasya malopaḥ, suṭa, ubhayatrāpyatra ṣatvamapi nipātyate| tatkarotīti taskaraḥ| atra hi tacchabdena corakarma prasiddhaṃ nindyaṃ parāmṛśyate|
prāttumpatāviti| `tupa tumpa hiṃsārthau' ityetasmindhātau parataḥ praśabdātparaḥ suḍ bhavati dhātvarthasya ced gauḥ karttā bhavati, prastumpatīti yatne tibante suṭ| svaśabdena dhātugrahaṇāttadādāvapi bhavati prastumpato gāvau, prastumpanti gāva iti|
citticittayoriti| `citī saṃjñāne', ktin, `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ'|
prāyo nāma tapaḥ proktaṃ cittaṃ niścaya ucyate|
tapo niścayasaṃyogātprāyaścittamiti smṛtam ||

anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam || 6.1.158 ||
ekavarjamiti| ekaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| `dvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti ṇamul| tatra hi parīpsāyāmiti prāyikam| atra yadi padamiti jātāvekavacanaṃ syāttadaikavarjanamityekaśabdenāpi pratyāsattyā padamevocyeta, tataścāyamartho bhavati--vākye padānyanudāttāni bhavanti ekaṃ padaṃ varjayitveti| anudāttaśabdaścedānīṃ laukikaḥ, loke hyacāmanudāttādiguṇāyoge halapi tadanuraktatvāttaddharmā gṛhyata iti ajjñalsamudāyarūpaṃ padamevānudāttamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyena vyapadiśati| atra pakṣe kimekaṃ varjanīyamiti niyamakāraṇābhāvāt sarveṣāmeva padānāṃ paryāyeṇa varjanātsvaraniyamo na syāt| tasmātpadamiti vyaktinirddeśaḥ, vivakṣitaṃ caikatvam| anudāttaśabdaśca `nīcairanudāttaḥ' ityajviśeṣe pāribhāṣika iti tasyaivagrahaṇaṃ yuktam| ekaśabdenāpi sannidhānādajevocyate| kathaṃ tarhyajjhalsamudāyarūpasya padasyājmātravācinānudāttaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? avayavāvayavinorabhedopacārāt arsaādyacpratyāyāntatvādvā'nudāttāckaṃ padamevānudāttam| yadyevam, anudāttaśabdenāpi padameva prādhānyenocyate ajguṇābhāveneti punarapyekaśabdasya saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ pradhānabhūtapadameva saṃkhyeyaṃ prāpnoti ? ucyate; padamityekatvaṃ vivakṣitamityuktam, tatraikaṃ padamanudāttāckaṃ bhavatyekaṃ padaṃ varjayitveti nāyamarthaḥ sambhavatīti sāmarthyād guṇabhūto'pyajevaikaśabdenocyate |
yadvā, padaśabdo'pi lakṣaṇayā tatstheṣvaktu varttate, tatrācāṃ padaśthatvāvyabhicārādekatvavivakṣārthameva padagrahaṇam| sarvathā tvayamartho vivakṣitaḥ---ekasminpade varttamānā aco'nudāttā bhavanti ekamacaṃ varjayitveti| evaṃ sthite yadīdaṃ svatantraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syāttadā niyamo vā syād--ekamacaṃ varjayitvā, pariśiṣṭamanudāttameva bhavatīti vidhirvā|
