tatrādye pakṣe yeṣāmacāṃ lakṣaṇaāntareṇodāttaḥ svarito vā vidhīyate, tatrāniyamaprasaṅgābhāvāttadvyatiriktaviṣayamevedaṃ bhavati| asti hi tatrāniyamaprasaṅgaḥ; asvarasyāca uccāraṇāsambhavāt| ekavarjamiti| yasya yasyodāttasvaritavidhānaṃ sa sa varjya ityartho bhavati| tataścatvāra ityādāvāgamādīnāṃ pṛthak svaraprasaṅgaḥ, āmalakīja ityatra ṅīṣaḥ pratyayādyudāttatvam, `gatikārakopapadātkṛt' iti jaśabdasyodāttatvam, `dīrghakāśatuṣabhrāṣṭravaṭaṃ je'iti pūrvapadādyudāttatvam, `antyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ' iti lakārākārasyodāttatvamiti yugapadudāttacatuṣṭayaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu ca nāprāpte kṛtsvara ārabhyamāṇena `dīrghakāśa' ityādyudāttatvenāpoditatvādeva kṛtsvaro na bhaviṣyati, tathā''dyudāttatvaṃ kuṭīja ityādau sāvakāśam, upasaraja ityādau sāvakāśena `antyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ' ityanena paratvādbādhiṣyata iti kathamudātuṣṭayaprasaṅgaḥ ? ucyate; virodhe samānaphalatve bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, vipratiṣedho'pi virodha eva, taccobhayaṃ svareṣu nāstīti kṛtkṛtyapratyayasaṃjñānāmiva samāveśaprasaṅgaḥ| satyapabi vipratiṣedhe ṅīṣa udāttatve kṛte paścāt `antyātpūrvaṃ bahvacaḥ' ityetasminpravṛtte'pi pūrvakṛtasya ṅīṣa udāttasyānivṛtteraniṣṭameva| yadi ca yasya yasyodāttasvaritavidhānam, taṃ taṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭamanudāttamevetyrathaḥ syāt, tadā padamekavarjamiti dvayamapi vyarthaṃ syāt| sāmānyenāco'nudāttā ityevāstu, pratyayādyudāttatvādiviṣaye tairbādhitatvādevānudāttatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati| tasmātpadamekavarjamiti vacanānnāyaṃ svatantro niyamaḥ|
atha vidhiḥ ? tadā yeṣāmacāṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇodāttaḥ svarito vā na vidhīyate, taṣvapyanudāttasya pakṣe prāptatvādvidhiranupapanna iti lakṣaṇāntareṇa yeṣāmudāttaḥ svarito vā vihitaḥ, ta ekasminpade vartamānā anudāttā bhavantyekamacaṃ varjayitvetyrathaḥ syāt| ka eka varjya iti na jñāyeta! athāpi paranityādibhirvyavasthā ? evamapi satiśiṣṭenāpi vyavasthā na syāt| kathamaupagavatvamityatra dve pratyayādyudāttatve ? tatraikasyānudāttatvaṃ vidīyamānaṃ kasya bhavatu ? udāttasvaritavyatiriktānāṃ cācāmaniyamaprasaṅga evāvatiṣṭheta| tadevaṃ svatantre'smin vidhau niyame vā neṣṭaṃ siddhyati|
athādhikāraḥ syāttadā `kakarṣātvato ghaño'ntaḥ' ityatrāsyopasthāne satyayamartho bhavati--karṣaśabapdasyākāravato'nta udātto bhavati, tamekaṃ varjayitvā tasminpade varttamānāḥ pariśiṣṭā aco'nudāttā bhavantīti| evamanyatrāpi--yatra yatropasthānaṃ tatra tatra vidhīyamānasya svarasyopalakṣaṇārtham| tena `tavai cāntaśca yugapat', `ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' ityādau dvayorapi varjanaṃ bhavati| indrābṛhaspatī ityatra bṛhaspatiśabdo vanaspatyāditvād dvayudātte indraśabdena dvandve `devatādvandve ca' iti dvayorapi prakṛtisvaratvamiti trayaṇāṃ varjanaṃ bhavatītyevaṃ ṣāṣṭhike svare na kīściddoṣaḥ|
`ādyudāttaśca', `samānodare śayita o codāttaḥ' `asthidadhisakthyakṣaṇāmanaṅudāttaḥ' ityādiṣu pradeśāntaravarttiṣu svavidhiṣvasyānupasthānātteṣu pariśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ na syāt, ekavarjamiti ca vyarthaṃ syāt| kathamanudāttaṃ padamityevādhikāro'stu, na cevaṃ tattatsūtravihitasyāpi svarasyānudāttaprasaṅgaḥ, tadvidhānasāmarthyāt| tadevaṃ pakṣāntarasambhavātparibhāṣeyamiti niścityāha--paribhāṣeyamiti| liṅgavatī ceyam, svaravidhiśca liṅgamityāha--svaravidhiviṣayeti|
yatrānya iti| anudāttāpekṣamanyatvam| udāttaḥ svarito veti| anudāttasyānudāttavarjanaṃ vyarthamiti tadvirodhād udāttaḥ svarito vā parisaṃkhyeyaḥ, tadvidhāvevāsyopasthānamiti bhāvaḥ| upariyatamityanena svaravidhibhirasyaikavākyātā darśatā| kaḥ punariti| varjyaviśeṣasya sūtre'nirdeśātpraśanaḥ| yasya svaro vidhīyata iti| yatredamupatiṣṭhate tatra yaḥ svaro vidhīyate sa ucyate| asāviti| yadi hyasāvapi na varjyeta tasya tatsvaravidānamanarthakaṃ syāt| dhātusvaraṃ śanāsvaro bādhata iti| satiśiṣṭena vyavasthāyā vakṣayamāṇatvāt| śnāsvaraṃ tassvaraṃ iti| bādhata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ| atrāpi heturvakṣyate, vikaraṇasvarastu satiśiṣṭo'pi' ityatra tassvaramāmsvara iti| pūrvavadanuṣaṅga| satiśiṣṭatvaṃ hetuḥ|
āgamasyetyādi| upalakṣaṇametat| anena hi tattallakṣaṇābhinirvṛttānāṃ bahūnāmudāttasvaritānāṃ samāveśanivṛttiḥ prayojanamasyetyucyate| na caitāvadeva prayojanam, yeṣāmapi kenāpi svarita udātto vā na vidhīyate, yathā'nekākṣu pratyayeṣu dhātuṣu vā''dhantavyatiriktānāmacāṃ teṣāmapyanudāttaniyamasyaitadadhīnatvāt|
catvāra iti| `cateruran' iti catur‌śabda ādyudāttaḥ| anaḍvāha iti| `anasi vaheḥ kvivab uścānasaḥ' iti kvip, yajāditvāt samprasāraṇam, anaḥ--śabdo'sanpratyayānta ādyudāttaḥ, `gatikārakopapadātkṛt' ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa dhātoranta udāttaḥ| asthanīti| `asisañjibhyāṃ kyin' ityādyudātto'sthiśabdaḥ, dadhiśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' ityādyudāttaḥ| nabiti napuṃsakākhyā| yasyāsau svaro vidhīyate sa varjyate ityuktam| sarveṣāṃ cāgamādīnāṃ svaro vidhīyata ityaviśeṣaṇa varjanaprasaṅga ityata āha--paranityāntaraṅgāpavādairiti| sa tasminyoge sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ svakasvaravarjyamanyamanudāttaṃ cikīrṣatā parasparavirodha upajāyate, paratvādibhiryuktaiva vyavastā| satiśiṣṭena ceti| vyavasthetyapekṣate| etadeva vivṛṇoti--yo hīti| sāmānyenoktamudāharaṇaniṣṭhaṃ karoti--tathā hīti| etacca satiśiṣṭasya bādhakatvaṃ nyāyatassiddham| kathamudāttasvaritavidibhirekavākyatāpannayā'nayā śeṣanighātaḥ kriyata ityuktam, tataḥ kim? utsargasyāpavādasya vā yā caramā pravṛttistasyāmidamupatiṣṭhate, evañca tasyaiva lakṣaṇasya yacā caramā pravṛttistatrāsyā upasthāne pūrvā pravṛttirbādhyate, tadyathaupagavatvamiti| atra hi `ādyadāttaśca' ityasya pratipratyayamāvṛttau tvapratyaye yadā pravarttate tadā'nayā nighātaḥ kriyate| yadi satiśiṣṭasvaro bādhakaḥ, vikaraṇasvaro'pi lasārvadhātukasvarasya bādhakaḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha--vikaraṇasvarastiviti| evaṃ manyate--yadayaṃ tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvaṃ śāsti tajjñāpakamuktasvārthasya; anyathā yadyapi lāvasthāyāṃ tāsividhīyate, tathāpi lakāramāvāpekṣatvādantaraṅgeṣu ca lādeśeṣu kṛteṣu paścāttāsiriti tatsvarasya satiśiṣṭatvāccheṣanighātenaiva siddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāditi|
vibhaktisvarāditi| satiśiṣṭatvādvibhaktisvare prāpte vacanam| nañsvareṇeti| `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' iti prakṛtibhāvavihitena|
vibhaktinimittasvarāditi| vibhaktirnimittaṃ yasya tasya yaḥ svarastasmādityarthaḥ| vākye hītyādi| devadattaśabda ārmontratasvareṇādyudāttaḥ, gābhityādyudāttaḥ, gamerḍoḥ pratyayasvaraḥ, `oto'mśasoḥ' ityātvamekādeśaḥ, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ', `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' `upasargāścābhivarjam' ityādyudāttatve varjitatvādabheḥ phiṣityanenāntodāttatvam| phiṣiti prātipadikasya pūrvācāryāṇāṃ saṃjñā| āṅ upasargasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ajerloṭ, `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' iti nidhātaḥ, khuklaśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| ṭāpā vibhaktayā ca `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ'| tadevaṃ padagrahaṇādvākye pṛthageva svaro bhavati|
nanu ca yadi vākye'pi śeṣanighātaḥ syāt, tataśca satiśiṣṭasvaratvādināṃ vyavasthāpakānāṃ tatrāsambhavātka eko varjanīya iti na jñāyeta? satyam; viśeṣāgrahaṇātparyāyeṇa varjanaṃ bhaviṣyati| yadi tarhi padagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, evaṃ sati yāvat padasaṃjñā na bhavati, tāvaccheṣanighātena na bhavitavyam, tataśca kuvalyā vikāraḥ kauvalamityatrānudāttādeścetyañna prāpnoti, yataḥ kuvalaśabdo'yaṃ grāmāditvenādyudāttaḥ, gaurāditvānṅīṣi vihite'pi padavyapadeśābhāvādādyudāttatvaṃ na parityajati ? ityata āha--parimāṇārthaṃ ceti| padamatra gauṇamabhipretam, yasya padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati na mukhyam; padādhikāre punaḥ padagrahaṇāt| kiṃ codāttasvaritavidhibhirekībhūya śeṣanighātaḥ kriyata ityuktam, tasyāṃ ca daśāyāṃ yuṣmadasmadorṅasi, ṅayi cetyādāveva padatvaṃ niṣpannaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ `dhātoḥ' ityādiṣu dhātvādyupadeśānantaraṃ pravarttamāneṣu| ataśca tairekībhūtasya padaśabdasya tadaikadeśe'pi bhaviṣyati vṛttiḥ| yadyevam, yatra yatrāsyopasthānaṃ tatra tatra sava padam, tato'pi cānyatra nyūnaṃ na kāryitvena saṃnihitamiti tatraivākṣu pariśiṣṭamanudāttaṃ bhaviṣyati, nārtho vākyanivṛttyarthena padagrahaṇena? ucyate; asati padaghaṇe dātoranta udātto bhavati pariśiṣṭamanudāttamityukte dhātoreva yatpariśiṣṭaṃ tadanudāttamiti gamyeta; evam `ādyudāttaśca' ityādau, tataśca dhātupratyayayoḥ pṛthaksvaraḥ syādeva| ata ekapade bhaviṣyatāṃ sarveṣāmevānudāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ padagrahaṇam|

padādhikārasya nivṛttiṃ karotīti| gauṇārthametatpadagrahaṇaṃ mukhyapadādhikārasya nivṛttiṃ kārayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? tatrāha-teneti| jñāpakamapyasminnarthe darśayati--garbhiṇīśabdaśceti| garbho'syā astīti matvarthīya iniḥ, ṅīp| garbhaśabdo grāmādiḥ| tatra yadīnipratyayasyodāttavidhisamakālamevānudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tato garbhiṇīśabdasyānudāttāditvād `anudāttādeḥ' ityāñi prāpte tadbādhanārthaṃ yujyate tasya bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ| atha padasaṃjñāyā uttarakālaṃ śiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavet, tato garbhiṇīśabda ādyudāttaḥ syāt, tataścāño bādhanārthaṃ bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhitavyaḥ syāt|
kuvalagarbhaśabdāvādyudāttāviti| tatra cokta eva prakāraḥ, tataḥ kuvalaśabdādañsiddhaye āśrayaṇīyam| garbhiṇīśabdaśca jñāpakamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| atredaṃ codyate-udāttasvaritavidhibhirekībhūtamapyetanniyamārthaṃ ced vihitasvararahitaṣvevasyāt, vidhyarthaṃ ced vihitasvareṣveva syād--iti prāgukto dośastadavastha eva? ucyate; uktaṃ padagrahaṇamekasminpade'ntarbhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmanudāttatvamiti, ato yathaitadupapadyate tathā vidhirūpeṇa, niyamarūpeṇa, ubhayarūpeṇa vā pravṛttirbhaviṣyati|

karṣātvato ghaño'nta udātaḥ || 6.1.159 ||
ādasyāstītyātvān, `tasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñā, karṣaścātvāṃśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ| vikṛtanirdeśa iti| vikaraṇāntasyedamanukaraṇam, na tu ghañantanirdeśa iti bhāvaḥ| atha kimartho matubnirdeśaḥ, yāvatā na kvacidapyākārātparo ghañastīti sāmarthyāttadvato grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati? ucyate; ghañākṣipto dhāturāta ityanena viśeṣyeta, tatra tadantavidhau jñāyamāne ānantaryasyāsambhavādvidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta--ākārāntādyo vihita iti, tataśca dāya ityādāveva syāt, pāka ityādau tu na syāt; matubnirddeśāttu sarvatra bhavatīti| lākṣaṇikasyāpyātvato grahaṇamiṣyate; vṛṣādiṣu kāmapāmapadānāṃ pāṭhāt|
`alo'ntyasya' ityeva siddhe'ntagrahaṇamuttarārtham ||

uñchādīnāṃ ca || 6.1.160 ||
`uchi ucche', `mleccha avyakte śabde'| `jaji yuddhe', atra kutvābhāvo nipātanāt, `jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' `vyadha tāḍane', `vyadhajaporanupasarge' ityap| vadha iti| `hanaśca vadhaḥ' ityap| kālaviśeṣa iti| katadvāparādau| `ghṝ gṝ nigaraṇe', `ṛdorap'|
viṣamityanena dūṣyaśabdasya viśeṣa vṛttiṃ darśayati|
`vida jñāne', `ovijī bhayacalanayoḥ', `veṣṭa veṣṭane', `bandha bandhane', `ṣṭuñ stutau', `yu miśraṇe', `dru gatau'|
upasamastārthametaditi| kevalānāṃ dhātūnāṃ kvibantānāṃ dhātusvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| pariṣṭuditi| sampadāditvātkvip, tena prādisamāsaḥ, `pūrvapadāt' iti ṣatvam| avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte'ntodāttatvam| sopapadāttu kvipi kṛtsvareṇaiva casiddham|
anyatra madhyodātta iti| sa hi `vṛtu varttane' ityasmādinipratyayena vyutpādyate| `dṝ vidāraṇe'|
sāmbatāpau bhāvagarhāyāmiti| sāmbo bhikṣate, ambayā saha bhikṣaṇaṃ garhitam| bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyāpavādaḥ| tāpo dasyūnām| dhārmikeṣu dasyukartṛkastāpo garhitaḥ| `karṣātvataḥ' ityeva siddhe bhāvagarhāyā anyātrā''dyudāttārthaṃ vacanam|
uttamaśaśvattamāviti| tamabantāvetau| dravyaprakarṣavivakṣāyāmāmabhāvaḥ, pittvādanudātte prāpte pāṭhaḥ| sarvatreti| bhāvagarhāyām, anyatra ca| chandasi, bhāṣāyāṃ cetyanye|
`bhakṣa adane' curādiḥ, `mantha viloḍane', `bhuja kauṭilye', `diha upacaye'| erajaṇyantānāmiti| ye tu anārṣametadacanamityāhuḥ, teṣāṃ bhakṣaśabdasya pāṭhe prayojanaṃ mṛgyam ||

anudāttasya ca yatrīdāttalopaḥ || 6.1.161 ||
kumāraśabdo'ntodātta iti| phiṣityanena| anyatrāpi prātipadikasyāntodāttatvamanenaiva draṣṭavyam| pathinśabdo'ntodātta iti| `patestha ca' itīnpratyayāntatvāt| kumudādayo'ntodāttā iti| kumudaśabdo mūlavibhujāditvātkapratyayāntaḥ, naḍaśabdo'vyutpannaḥ, `vi gatyādiṣu' asmādasac, tuḍāgamaśca| vetasaścitsvareṇāntodāttaḥ|
prāsaṅgya iti| prāsajyata iti prāsaṅgaḥ, karmaṇi ghañantaḥ, `tadvahati' iti `prāgghitādyat' iti yat| naitadastīti| udātto lupyata iti| yattasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kathaṃ naitadasti ? ityāha--svarite hīti| `prāgeva padasaṃjñāyāḥ svaravidhisamakālameva śeṣanighāto bhaviṣyati' ityuktaṃ purastāt| tat kuta udāttalopa iti| na kutaśicidityarthaḥ| tadetadityādi| yasmādevamanudāttagrahaṇasya vyāvarttya na sambhavati, tasmādetadanudāttagrahaṇamāderanudāttārtham |
athāsatyanudāttagrahaṇe kasya syāt? ityata āha--anta iti| mā hi dhukṣātāmiti| duhermāṅi luṅātmanepadam, ātāmāthāmau, cleḥ ksaḥ| `adupadeśāt' iti lasārvadhātukānudāttatvam, ksaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, `ksasyāci' ityakāralopaḥ| māṅaḥ prayogo'ḍāgamanivṛttyarthaḥ, aṭi hi sati padamādyudāttaṃ bhavati, hiśabdaprayogaḥ `hi ca' iti nighātapratiṣedhārthaḥ| atrāsatyanudāttagrahaṇe ātāmāthāmordvitīyasyāca udāttaḥ syāt, antādhikārāt; sati tvasminnāderbhavati| idaṃ du vaktavyam, `yatrodāttalopaḥ' ityucyamāne kathamantyasya prasaṅgaḥ, na hi tadudāttalopasya nimittamiti ? ucyate; āderapi tarhi na prāpnoti, tasyānudāttalopaṃ pratyanimittatvāt, `ksasyāci' ityajādau pratyaye vidhānāt| tasmādyatra pratyaya udāttalopastatsambandhino'nudāttasyodātto bhavatīti sūtrārthe'ntādhikārādantyasya prasaṅga| yadi tu nimittatvānādareṇa yatrānudātte parataḥ udāttalopaḥ, tasyodātto bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ, tadā nāntyasya prasaṅgaḥ|
bhṛgava iti| `atribhṛgukutsa' ityādinā bahuṣu luk| tatra bahuṣvityarthagrahaṇam, na bahuvacanasya| vaidīti| vidādyañantāt `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' ||

citaḥ || 6.1.163 ||
bhaṅguramiti| `cajoḥ ku ghiṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam| kuṇḍinā iti| kuṇkaḍaśabdānmatvarthīya iniḥ, striyāṃ ṅīp, kuṇḍinīśabdo madhyodāttaḥ, kuṇḍinyā apatyāni bahūni, gargādiyaño bahuṣu luk, pariśiṣṭasya kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ|
citi pratyaye iti| nanu ca nātra citīti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kuṇkaḍinajāderapi grahaṇāt ? tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---yatra citpratyayastatra samudāyasyeṣyata iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhayate? cita ityavayavādeṣā ṣaṣṭhī, na kāryiṇaḥ, cito'vayavasya sambandhī yaḥ samudāyaḥ sa kāryā| atha vā--cidasyāstīti citaḥ, arśaāderākṛtigaṇatvādac pratyayaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā, tena cidvataḥ samudāyasyetyarthaḥ| atra ca liṅgam-akaḥ citkaraṇam, anyathā tasyaikāctvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt| kuṇkaḍinajādervyapadeśivadbhāvena cidvattvam ||

taddhitasya || 6.1.164 ||
kauñjāyanā iti| kuñjasyāpatyāni bahuni, `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ', `vrātacphañorastriyām' iti ñyaḥ, `ñkayādayastadrājāḥ', `tadrājasyabahuṣ' luk|
kimarthaṃmiti| pūrveṇa siddhamiti praśnaḥ| paramapīti| cakāraḥ `brātacphañorastriyām' ityatra viśeṣaṇena caritārthaḥ| ñakāro'pi vṛddhyarthaḥ, tatrāsatyasminparatvād ñitsvaraḥ ||

tisṛbhyo jasaḥ || 6.1.166 ||
arthagataṃ bahutvaṃ śabde āropya bahuvacananirddeśaḥ| tisna iti| antodāttasya triśabdasya sthāne tisṛśabda ādeśaḥ sthānivapadbhāvādantodāttaḥ| `anudāttau suppitau' iti jasanudāttaḥ, tatrā'ci parataḥ `aci ra ṛtaḥ'| `jasaḥ' iti kimartham ? tisṛkā, svārthe ka pratyayaḥ, `tisṛbhāve saṃjñāyāṃ kani' iti tisrādeśaḥ ? nitsvro'tra bādhako bhaviṣyati| nāprapte svarāntare tisṛsvara ārabhyate, sa yathaiva `suppitāvanudāttau' ityetaṃ bādhate evaṃ nitsvaramapi bādheta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yena nāprāpte ityetasya bādhanaṃ bhaviṣyati, na vāprāpte `anudāttau suppitau' ityetasmin tisṛsvara ārabhyate, tisṛketyatrāpi hi ṭāpā sahaikādeśasya sthānivadbhātpitsvaraḥ prāpnoti| atha vā `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante' iti tisṛsvaraḥ `anudāttau suppitau' ityetameva bādhiṣyate, na nitsvaram; bahuvacanaviṣayatvād dvivacanaikavacane na staḥ| śasi tu bhavitavyam `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti| anyāḥ sarvā halādayo vibhaktayastatra `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' `jhalyupottamam' ityanena svareṇa bhavitavyam, tatrāntareṇāpi jasgrahaṇaṃ jasa eva bhaviṣyati ? ata āha-jasgrahaṇamupasamastārthamiti| samāse'pi tisṛśabdātparo jas bhaviṣyati|
atitisrāviti| atra `aterakṛtpade' ityatra `aterdhātulopa iti vaktavyam' iti vacanātprāptamantodāttatvaṃ bādhitvā vibhakterudāttatvaṃ syāt| jasgrahaṇāttu `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' iti svarito bhavati| atitisra ityatra tvanena jasa udāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||

caturaḥ śasi || 6.1.167 ||
anukaraṇatvenārthaparatvābhāvādekavacanam| iha catasraḥ paśyaityatra catasrādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvādayaṃ svaraḥ prāpnoti? tatrāha--catasrādeśa iti| sthānivadbhāvādevādyudāttatve siddhe punarādyudāttatvanipātanamasya svarasya bādhanārthamiti| bhāvaḥ| yathaiva tarhi nipātanasvaraḥ śassvaraṃka bādhate, evam `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' ityetamapi vibhaktisvaraṃ bādheta--catasṛṇāmiti? jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti halādigrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--`na nipātanasvaro vibhaktisvaraṃ bādhate' iti| taddhi tatra na kartavyam, katham ? sarveṣāmapi bahuvacanaviṣayatvād dvivacanaikavacane na sambhavataḥ| na copasamaste sambhavaḥ; vihitaviseṣaṇāśrayaṇāt| tatra ṣaḍbhyastāvat jaśśasorlukā bhavativyam| anyāḥ sarvā halādayo vibhaktyaḥ| strīśabda'pi jasi na bhavitayam; asarvanāmasthānamityadhikārāt, śasi bhavitavyam `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' iti, anyā halādayaḥ| tisṛśabde'pi jasi `tisṛbhyo jasaḥ' iti bhavitavyam, śasyapi `udāttayaṇo halapūrvāt' iti, anyā halādayaḥ| catur-śabde'pi jasyasarvanāmasthāna iti niṣedhaḥ, śasi `caturaḥ śaśi' ityayameva bhavati, anyāstu halādayaḥ| tadetaddhalādigrahaṇaṃ catasraḥ paśyetyatra mā bhūdityetadarthameva kṛtam| yadi ca nipātanasvareṇa vibhaktisvaro bādhyeta halādigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| catasraḥ paśyetyatra nipātanasvareṇaiva bādhitatvād vibhaktisvarasyāprasaṅgāt kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena halādigrahaṇena! tatkriyamāṇam--vibhaktisvarasya balīyastvaṃ jñāpayatīti catasṛṇāmityatra vibhaktisvaraḥ siddhaḥ| yaṇādeśasya ceti| `aci ra ṛtaḥ' iti rādeśasyāsmātsvarātpūrvaṃ paratvātkṛtasya| etaduktaṃ bhavati--paratvādādeśe kṛte ṛkārasya tāvanna bhavati, taśabdākārasyāpi na bhavati; rādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāditi| na ca svaravidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ, `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopajādeśa eva na sthānivat' iti vacanāt ||

sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ || 6.1.168 ||
sāviti saptamībahuvacanasya suśabdasya guhaṇamiti| na prathamaikavacanasya; vyākhyānāt| prayojanaṃ tūttaratra vakṣyati| pāteti| pāterlaṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ| rājñeti| `sau' ityetsminnasatyekācaḥ parā tṛtīyādivibhaktirudāttā bhavatītyartho bhavati, bhavati cāyamallope kṛte ekāc| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate-ekāco yā vihitā tṛtīyādiriti ? na; pramāṇābhāvāt| saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇāditi| prathamaikavacane tu `tvāhau sau' iti tvādeśe kṛte yuṣmacchabda ekāc bhavati, śeṣe lope kṛte'kārāntatvāt `sāvavarṇa' iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| tadiha prathamaikavacanāgrahaṇe ko heturiti cintyam ||

antodāttāduttarapadādanyatarasyāmanityasamāse || 6.1.169 ||
nityaśabdaḥ svaryate iti| svaritatvamasya kriyata ityarthaḥ| tatra svarito guṇaḥ kriyārūpeṇa nirddiṣṭaḥ, svaritatve sati kiṃ bhavati? ityāha--teneti| `svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityatrāyamapyartho vyākhyātaḥ--svaritena liṅgena yadatrādhikāraḥ sa pratyetavya iti, tato nityādhikāravihitaḥ samāso'tra pratiṣidhyate| avāceti| nañsamāsaḥ| tatpuruṣo'yamiti| na bahuvrīhiḥ| tena `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvaṃ na bhavati, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| prāyeṇa tu suvācā, sutvacā iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra pratyudāharaṇādigiyaṃ darśiteti vyākhyeyam, na punaratra prasaṅgaḥ; prādisamāsasya nityasamāsatvāt|
athottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `anityasamāse' ityādhārasaptamī vijñāsyate---anityasamāsasthāntodattādekācaḥ parā tṛtīyādirvibhaktiriti, caccottarapadameva? tatrāha--uttarapadagrahaṇamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--satsaptamī vijñāyeta, tataśva samāsasyāśrayatvāttasyaivekātttvamantodāttvaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi|
agnicitā, somasuteti| `agnau ceḥ', `some suñaḥ' iti kvip|
`nityaśabdaḥ svarthate' iti yaduktam, tasya prayojanamāha--yastviti ||

añceśchandasyāsarvanāmasthānam || 6.1.170 ||
dadhīca iti| dadhyañcatīti `ṛtvik' ityādinā kvin, anunāsikalopaḥ, `acaḥ' ityakāralopaḥ, `cau' iti dīrghatvam|
śaso'pi parigraharthamiti| śasādigrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, napuṃsake śasi mā bhūt, suṭi ca yathā syāditi ||

ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ || 6.1.171 ||
praṣṭhauha iti| `chandasi sahaḥ', `vahaśca' iti ṇviḥ| vāha ūṭhi `etyedhatyūṭhasu' iti vṛddhiḥ|
ūṭhyupadhāgrahaṇamiti| upadhābhūta ūṭh gṛhyate, na tvantya ityarthaḥ| pañcamīnirddeśādantyasyaiva grahaṇe prāpte vacanam|
antodāttādityadhikārādanvādeśe na bhavatīti| ata eva hetoḥ `sāvekācaḥ' ityanenāpi na bhavati| yadi syāt, ihāntodāttādhikāro vyarthaḥ syāt| nanu ca yadīme nānuśaso abhyavarṣāditi śaso'nvādeśena mā bhūditi prayojanam, `ekācaḥ' ityadhikārādeva siddham, tathā ca tadasmai tathya tadasya priyaṃ preṇā tadeṣāmityādi sarvānudāttaṃ padamadhīyate|
padādayo niśparyantā gṛhyanta iti| `padannomās' iti sūtre nirddiṣṭāḥ, tatra ekāca ityanuvṛtteniśaḥ pare na gṛhyante| yadā tvallope kṛte ekāco bhavanti, tadodāttanivṛttisvareṇa vibhakterudāttatvaṃ siddham| ye'pyādyudāttānāṃ sthāne vidhīyante ādeśāste tatraivāntodāttā nipātyante| vṛttāvapyetadevoktaṃ draṣṭavyam| āsanīti| āsyaśabdasyāsanādeśaḥ| yatraikācasteṣāṃ śasarthaṃ grahaṇam ||

aṣṭano dīrghāt || 6.1.172 ||
ghṛtādipāṭhādantodātta iti| tenottarārthamanuvartamānasya `antodāttāt' ityasya nehāpi virodha iti bhāvaḥ| aṣṭasviti|
nanu cātra dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakam, yāvatā `aṣṭana ā vibhaktau ityanena bhavitavyam, tadvidhau vikalpasyābhāvāt ? ityata āha--idameveti| nitye hyātve vyāvartyābhāvādiha dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| kṛtātvasya ca ṣaṭsaṃjñāmiti| idameva dīrghagrahamamaṣṭano jñāpayatīti sambandhaḥ| kathametat ? ityata āha--anyathā hīti| ātvābhāvapakṣe'yaṃ svaro mā būdityetadarthaṃ hi dīrghagrahaṇam| yadi ca kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt, tadā''tvapakṣe sāvakāśamimamaṣṭanaḥ svaramanātvapakṣe ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `jhalyupottamam' iti ṣaṭsvaraḥ paratvādbādhiṣyate--ityanarthakaṃ dīrghagrahaṇaṃ syāt| yadā tu kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñā bhavati, tadā nāprāpte ṣaṭsvare ārabhyamāṇo'ṣṭanaḥ svaro'nātvapakṣe'pi syāditi tannivṛttaye kriyamāṇamarthavadbhavati| kathaṃ punarekena yatnenobhayaṃ śakyaṃ jñpayitum ? ko doṣaḥ ! anyathānupapattyā hyaneko'pyartho jñāpyate, tenaitadubhayamantareṇānupapadyamānamubhayamapi jñāpayati|

śaturanumo nadyajādī || 6.1.173 ||
tudatī, nudatīti| tudāditvācchaḥ, `ācchīnadyornum' vikalpitaḥ| tatra numabhāvapakṣe udāharaṇam, numpakṣe pratyudāharaṇam|
tudantīti| `śnābhyastayorāta' ityākāralopaḥ| atra pratyayasvareṇa śatrantamantodāttam| tatretyādinā pratyudāharaṇasya dvyaṅgavikalatāṃ pariharati--tatra pūrvatrāsiddhamiti neṣyati iti| atra ca jñāpakamayamevānuma iti pratiṣedhaḥ, na hi kiñcidekādeśasvaramantareṇa śatrantaṃ sanumkamantodāttamisti|
buhanmahatorupasaṃkhyānamiti| śatṛvadbhāvādeva siddhe niyamārthamidam--pṛṣṭadādīnāṃ mā bhūditi| `gaurādiṣu bṛhanmahatoḥ pāṭho'narthakaḥ' iti strīprakaraṇa evoktam ||

udāttayaṇo kahalpūrvāt || `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' iti prāpte vacanam| vahutitavā brāhmaṇyeti| strīliṅgopādānaṃ nābhāvanivattyartham| `tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca' iti, `cālanī titauḥ pumān', tato bahuvrīhiḥ, `bahornañvaduttarapadabhūmni' ityuttarapadāntodāttaḥ, tatra `udāttasvaritayoḥ' iti vibhakteḥ svaritatvam |
nakāragrahaṇaṃ ca karttavyamiti| udāttasthāne yo nakārastato'pi parasyā nadyā udāttatvaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tadarthaṃ kecid `udāttahalo halpūrvāt' iti paṭhanīyamiti manyante| vākpatnīti| tatpuruṣaḥ| `patyāvaiśvaryye' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya `na bhūvākciddidhiṣu' iti pratiṣedhātsamāsāntodāttatve `vibhāṣā sapūrvasya' iti nakāraḥ ||

noṅdhātvoḥ || 6.1.175 ||
ūṅo dhātośca ya udāttayaṇ halpūrva iti| anena pūrvasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| tasmātparā tṛtīyādirvibhaktiriti| yadyapi pūrvasūtre `nadyajādī' ityanuvarttate na `tṛtīyādiḥ' iti, tathāpyatra bāhulyena tṛtīyādereva sambhavādidhamuktam| tathā hi--ūṅdhātuyaṇaḥ parā nadī tāvanna sambhavati, nāpyūṅyaṇaḥ śas sambhavati, dhātuyaṇastu sambhavati ||

hrasvanuḍbhyāmmatup || 6.1.176 ||
akṣaṇvateti| `chandasyapi dṛśyate' ityanaṅ, `ano nuṭ' iti nuḍāgamaḥ, pūrvasya nakārasya lopaḥ| śīrṣatvateti| `śīrṣañchandasi' iti nipātitaḥ| vasuśabdra ādyudātta iti| vaserupratyayaḥ, `dhānye nit' ityadhikāre| athehakasmānna bhavati--maruto'sya santi marutvāniti ? marucchabdo hi `mṛgrorutiḥ' iti utipratyayāntatvātpratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| na ca takāreṇa vyavadhānam, svaravidhau vyañjanasyāvidyamānatvāt ? ityata āha--atreti| kathaṃ punarjñāyate nākṣī yate iti ? nuḍgrahaṇāt| taddhyakṣaṇvatetyādau yathā syādityevamartham, anyathā nakārasya luptasyāpi svaravidhāvasiddhernakāreṇa vyavadhānānna syāditi| yadi cātra vyañjanamavidyamānavatsyāt, tato'siddhalopasyāpi tasyāvavidyamānatvādeva svaraḥ siddha iti nuḍgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt ? naitadyuktamucyate; yadi hi nakāralopasyāsiddhatve'pi nakāro'vidyamānavatsyāt, svaravidhau nakāralopasyāsiddhavadvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmānnalopaviṣaye'vidyamānavadbhāvo na pravarttata iti karttavyameva nuḍgrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhīṣṭireveyam--`atra svare'vidyamānavatparibhāṣā na pravarttate' iti|
reśabdācceti pāṭhaḥ| ārevāniti| rayi asyāstīti matupi `raryermatau bahulam' iti samprasāraṇam, pūrvatvam, ādgraṇaḥ, tato hrasvābhāvādvacanam|
trivatīriti| `chandasīraḥ' iti vatvam, `vā chandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ ||

nāmanyatarasyām || 6.1.177 ||
matubiti ceti| caccārthātsaptamyantaṃ sampadyate|
anyathā hi sāmpratika eva syāditi| sāmpratikābhāve hi bhūtapūrvagatirbhavati, na tu tasminsatyapi; tatastisṛṇām, catasṛṇāmityatra `na tisṛcatasṛ' iti dīrghapratiṣedhātsāmpratika eva hrasvo vidyate iti tatreva syāt; agnīnām, vāyūnāmityādau paratvānnityatvācca dīrghatve kṛte hrasvābhāvānna syāt, tasmānmatupā hlasvo viśeṣyate| yadyevam, `matau bahvaco'najirādīnām', `śarādīnāṃ ca' iti yeṣāṃ matau dīrghatvamucyate teṣāṃ na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāyāmiti varttate, tataścāturarthika eva matau dīrghatvam, na tu `tadasyāsyāsmin' ityatra; tatra matau hrasvāntatvādbhaviṣyati| evamapi tisṛṇām, catasṛṇāmityatra na syāt, tisṛcatasṛbhāvasyaiva tatrābhāvāt ? iṣṭamevaitatsaṃgṛhītam| atra hi `ṣaṣṭatricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti nityameva vibhakterudāttatvamiṣyate| dhenvām, śakaṭyāmiti| `dheṭa icca' iti nupratyayānto dhenuśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, `śakaṭiśakaṭyorakṣaramakṣaraṃ paryāyeṇa' iti śakaṭīśabdo'pi pakṣe'ntodāttaḥ| trapuśabdo vasuśabdaścādyudāttaḥ ||

ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ || 6.1.179 ||
antodāttāditi nivṛttamiti| yadyetadanuvartteta pañcānām, navānām, caturmāmityatra na syāt; `nraḥ saṃkhyāyā' ityādyudāttatvāt, kva tarhi syāt ? saptānām, aṣṭānām| saptāṣṭaśabdau ghṛtāditvādantodāttau| `nraḥ' iti rephanakārāntāyā ityarthaḥ|
catasraḥ paśyeti| yathaitadiha halādigrahaṇasya vyāvarttyaṃ tathā `caturaḥ śasi' ityatrāvocāma ||

jhalyupottamam || 6.1.180 ||
jhalādau vibhaktau parataḥ ṣaṭtricaturṇāṃ triprabhṛtyakṣarābhāvāt jhalādivibhaktayantasya padasya grahaṇam, yadāha--vibhaktyante pade upottamamudāttambhavatīti ||

na gosvansāvavarṇarāḍaṅkruḍkṛdbhyaḥ || `sau' iti yadi saptamībahucanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tebhyaḥ, kebhya ityatra na syāt, tatkiṃśabdayoḥ saptamībahuvacane paratastyadādyatve kṛte `bahuvacane jhalyet' ityetvavidhānāt; tābhiryābhirityādāveva syāt, tāsuyāsvityatrāvarṇāntatvāt| tasmātprathamaikavacanasya grahaṇāmityāha--sau prathamaikavacana iti| anantarasya pratiṣedhyasyāsambhavātsarvasyaiva ṣāṣṭhikasvarasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate ityāha-ityebhyo yaduktaṃ tanna bhavatīti| evaṃ ca vṛkṣavānityādau `hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' ityapi pratiṣedho bhavati, udāttanivṛttisvarasya pratiṣedho neṣyate| suguneti | bahuvrīhau `gostriyorupasarjanasya' iti hrasvaḥ, `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatvam |
śuneti| nanu ca nalope kṛte sāvavarṇāntametat ? na ; svaravidhau nalopasyāsiddhatvāt| na cāyaṃ svaravidhiḥ, svarapratiṣedho'yam ? evaṃ tarhi śunaḥ pratiṣedhaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati--asminpratiṣede nalopo'siddho bhavatīti| tena nṛśabdātsaptamyekavacane narītyatra `sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvaṃ bhavati, pitṛmānityādau `hrasvanuḍbhyāṃ matup' iti matupa udāttatvaṃ bhavati, anyathā `sāvavarṇa' iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt|
prāceti| pūrvavannalopadīrghādi| kruñceti| `kuñca kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ', `ṛtvik' ityādinā kvin, tatraiva sūtre kruñceti nipātanānnalopābhāvaḥ| kṛtirveti| `kṛtī chedane' ||

divo jhal || 6.1.183 ||
jhalādiriti| kathaṃ punarasati saptamīnirdeśe tadādividhirbhavati; kevalajhalātmikāyā vibhakterabhāvāt, astu tarhi tadantavidhiḥ, kā punarjhalantā vibhakti, śasādiḥ sakārāntā ? evaṃ tarhi `ṣaṭtricaturbhyā halādiḥ' ityata ādigrahaṇamanuvartate, divaḥ parā vibhaktirnodāttā bhavati, kīdṛśī ? yasyā jhalādiriti|
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum| katham ? evaṃ vakṣyāmi---`aṣṭano dīrghāt, divojhalādiḥ, śataranumo nadī ca' iti, `ūḍidam' ityādau ca divo grahaṇaṃ na kariṣyami ? evamapi `nṛ cānyatarasyām' ityuttarasūtre tatra jhalgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam, `nadi ca' iti cakāraśca kriyata iti nāsti lāghave viśeṣaḥ ||

titsvaritam || 6.1.185 ||
iha kasmānna bhavati `ṛta iddhātoḥ' āstīrṇam, vistīrṇam, tatkālagrahaṇārthatayā caritārthatvāditi cet ? na; anekaprayojanadarśanādanubandhānām| tadyathā ākṣika ityādau ṭhaki sati svaro vṛddhiśca bhavati| evaṃ narhi nāyamikārastaparaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? daparaḥ| yadyevam, ṛkārasya sthāne āntaryyato dīrghaḥ prāpnoti ? `bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhyāti' | idyevam, `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' imūbhyām dīrghasya sthāne dīrgho na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ jñāpitametat `diva ut' `ṛta ut' iti taparakaraṇena--bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātīti| tayoreva tarhyukārayoḥ svaritatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? tāvapi tahi na taparau, kiṃ tarhi ? daparau| kathaṃ tarhiṃ jñāpakam? `taparastatkālasya' ityatra dakāro'pi cartvabhūtonirdiśyate, `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayastaparastatkālasya' iti, yadi dakāro'pi nirdiśyate `ṛdorap' ityatrāpi dadgrahaṇādihaiva, syādyavaḥ, stavaḥ; lavaḥ, pava ityatra na syāt; `tādapi parastaparaḥ' iti tādapi parasya taparatvāt| evaṃ tarhi ṛdorap' ityatra dhakāro jaśtvabhūta uccāraṇārtho nirdiśyate, tatra jaśtvasyāsiddhatvānnāyamṛkāro daparaḥ| ye tu `pratyayāpratyayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam' iti paribhāṣāṃ paṭhanti, teṣām `ṛta iddhātoḥ' ityādau satyapi tittvenāsya svarasya prasaṅgaḥ| `taparastatkālasya' ityatra dakāro'pi na praśleṣṭavyaḥ|
tasyāstu paribhāṣāyā bhāṣyavārttikayohira|
adarśanādayaṃ yatno mahānasmābhirādṛtaḥ ||
tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttamah‌nviṅoḥ || tāsyādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ| adupadeśāditi| upadiśyata ityupadeśaḥ, tasyākāreṇa viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ, accāsāvupadeśaścādupadeśaḥ, upadiśyamānadaśāyāṃ yadavarṇāntaṃ tasmārityarthaḥ| akāropadeśāditi| akārāntādupadeśādityarthaḥ| karttetyādi| luṅātmanepade prathamapuruṣasya ḍāraurasaḥ, tāsiḥ| ekavacane ṭilopaḥ, itaratra `ri ca' iti salopaḥ|
āste ityādāvadāditvācchapo luk|
tudata ityādīni tasantāni| kathaṃ punaḥ śabupadeśe'danto bhaviṣyati, yāvatā pakārānto'yaṃ tatra? ityata āha---anubandhasyānekāntatvādakārāntopadeśa eveti| `udīcāmāṅaḥ'iti kṛtātvanirddeśājjhāpakādanumīyate---kāryeṣvanubandhāḥ śrūyamāṇā api na pratibandhakā iti| pacamāno yajamāna iti| laṭaḥ śānac| nanvatra mukā vyavadhānam ? ata āha--yadyatreti| syāditi| sambhāvane liṅ| aṅgasya yo'kārastasya mugityāśrayaṇādasya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ| tadā lasārvadhātukamadupadeśādanantaramiti| pravarttate nighātaḥ| `āto ṅitaḥ' itīyādeśastu na bhavati; kaata ityatra taparakaraṇāt| anantarayoge pañcamī mṛgyā, paramiti vā'dhyāhāraḥ| athākārāntasyāṅgasyeti| akāreṇāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| lasārvadhātukasyeti| `siddham' iti vakṣyamāṇena sabandhaḥ, nighāta iti cānuṣaṅgaḥ, tathā ca lasārvadhātukasya nighātaḥ siddha ityarthaḥ| asiddha iti| prakṛtatvānmugiti gamyate| bahiraṅgatvāditi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu muko bahvapekṣatvāt| sa hi akārāntaviśiṣṭamaṅgamāśrayati ānañca pratyayaviśeṣam| ayaṃ tu svaro'dupadeśaṇātraṃ lasārvadhātukamātraṃ cāpekṣata ityantaraṅgaḥ| citsvaro'pītyādi| citsvarasyāvakāśaḥ--calanaḥ, `calanaśabdārthādakarmakādyuc' asyāvakāśaḥ--āste, śete iti; pavamāna ityādau paratvādayaṃ nighātaścitsvaraṃ bādhate| nanu caikasya dvikāryayoge vipratiṣedhaḥ, na cātraiko dvikāryayuktaḥ, katham? āderanudāttatvamantyasya citsvara nātrāderanudāttatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? saṅghātaḥ kāryī| atra jñāpakamuttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ| tataścānasya sarvānudāttatvena bhavitavyam, na tvāderityastyeva virodha iti paratvalādayaṃ bādhate iti yuktameva|
cinutaḥ, cinvantīti| nanu ca `sārvadhātukamapit' iti śnurapi ṅideva tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? ata āha--ṅidayaṃ śnuḥ pūrvasya kāryaṃ pratīti| tatra hi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tadatidiśyate, yadāha--siddhaṃ tu pūrvasya kāryātideśāditi| nāyaṃ sthitaḥ siddhāntaḥ, `āto ṅitaḥ' ityatra vakṣyati--```sārvdhātukamapit' ityatra ṅita iva ṅidvadityaṅgīkriyate ityādi| atra tu pakṣe parihāraḥ--upadeśagrahaṇamubhābhyāmapi sambhadhyate--ṅidupadeśāt, adupadeśāditi| pacāvaḥ, pacāma iti| asatyupadeśagrahaṇe paratvānnityatvācca dīrghe kṛte taparakaraṇānna syāt| nanu ca taparakaraṇaṃ na kariṣyate ? yaditu na kriyate--yātaḥ, vāta ityatrāpi prāpnoti| hataḥ, hatha iti| atra `anudāttopadeśa' ityādinānunāsikalope kṛte satyakārātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ bhavati, tathāpyupadeśagrahaṇānna bhavati| na hi hantiradanta upadiśyate| atha yo'trādanto haśabdastadāśrayamanudāttatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? tāvato'nupadeśāt, samudāyaparo hi hantyupadeśaḥ| katīha pacamānā iti| `pūṅyajoḥ śānanu', tatra ca `laṭaḥ' iti nivṛttatvānna lādeśo'yam| śiśya iti| `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ, `liṭ ca' ityārddhadhātukametat| yadadhīta iti| yacchabdaprayogaḥ `nipātairyadyadi' iti nidhātapratiṣedhārthaḥ|

ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām || 6.1.187 ||
mā hi kārṣṭāmiti| heḥ, māṅśca prayoge pūrvameva prayojanamuktam| aparo madhyodātta iti| nanu na valādiriha pratyayaḥ, iḍāgamaḥ, āgamāścānudāttā bhavanti, tasmādihāpyantodāttatvena bhavitavyam ? ata āha--sicaścitkaraṇāditi|
aniṭaḥ pita iti| aniṭaḥ sicaḥ paraḥ pitpakṣe udātto bhavati, pakṣe tvanudāttaḥ, tena mā hi kārṣamiti tiṅantaṃ pakṣe ādyudāttam, pakṣe tvantodāttam; anyathā dhātusvareṇa nityamādyudāttaṃ syāt| madhyodātta eveti| sicaḥ svareṇa, evakāreṇa na tvantodātta iti darśayati ||

svapādihiṃsāmacyaniṭi || 6.1.188 ||
svapādirā vṛtkāraṇāditi| ā gaṇāntādityarthaḥ| tatra `ñiṣvap śaye', `śvasa prāṇane', `ana ca' ityetebyaḥ pare jakṣityādayo'bhyastasaṃjñakāḥ, teṣu paratvātad `abhyastānāmādiḥ' iti svaro bhavati, ye tu tataḥ pare `ṣas svapne' , vaśa kāntau', `hnūṅ apanayane', carkarītamiti; tatra carkarītītamabhyastam| anye tu `ṣasivasī chāndasau', chandasi ca dṛṣṭānuvidhānam| hnuṅo'pyayaṃ svaro na bhavati `ahanviṅoḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ| pārīśeṣyādāditastrivevāyaṃ svaraḥ| hisantīti| `hisi hiṃsāyām' rudhādiḥ, `śnānnalopaḥ', `śnasorallopaḥ'|

abhyastānāmādiḥ || 6.1.189 ||
ādiriti varttamāna iti| `ādiḥ sico'nyacarasyām' ityataḥ| punarādigrahaṇaṃ nityārthamiti| anyathā ādigrahaṇasambaddhamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarteta |

anudātte ca || 6.1.190 ||
anajādyarthemidam| jihīte, mimīta iti| `ī halyaghoḥ', ṅittvāllasārvadhātukānudāttatvam| `avidyamānodātte' iti vadatā `anudātta iti bahuvrīhinirdeśo'yam' ityuktam| tatra prayojanamāha--anudātta iti| bahuvrīhinirdeśa ityādi| na vidyate udātto yasminnityanudāttaḥ| mā hi sm dadhāditi| śāstrīye'nudātte gṛhyamāṇe nityatvādantaraṅgatvādvā ikāralope kṛte'co'nudāttasya parasyābhāvādādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt, bahuvrīhau vijñāte tu bhavati| dadhātyatreti| atra yaṇādeśasya bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvādapi svaraḥ siddhaḥ ||

sarvasya supi || 6.1.191 ||
sarvaśabda uṇādiṣu antodātto nipātitaḥ, sarvasya vikāraḥ sārva ityanudāttādilakṣaṇo'ñ yathā syāditi|
pratyayalakṣaṇenāpītyādi| `na lumatāṅgasya' ityatraitadupapāditam| sarvasvaro'nakackasyeti|

bhīhrībhṛhumadajanadhanadaridrājāgarāṃ pratyayātpūrvaṃ piti || ādyudāttasyāpavādo'yam| jāgarāmiti sautrau nirdeśaḥ| atra madirdivādiḥ, daridrājāgrāvadādī, anye juhotyādayaḥ| pañcame lakāra iti| lasyetvatra darśitakrame pañcamakalakāro leṭ| leṭśabdastu vṛttikāradeśe jugupsitaḥ, yathā'tra dravihadeśe nīvīśabdaḥ| dadhanaditi| `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu', `leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityaṭ| daridratīti| atra paratvādākāralope kṛte ikārasyodāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā bhyādibhyaḥ paraḥ pitpratyaya eva sambhavati, nanu cāyamasti--`āḍuttamasya picca', bibhayāti, atrāpi loḍuttamasyaiva pittvaṃ vidhīyate, na tvāṭ iti, āṭasahito loḍuttamaḥ pidbhavati sa ca pratyaya eva| ata eva loṅādeśātpitaḥ pūrvamāḍ bhavati, pratyayāttu pūrvo na bhavati, āṭasahitasyāpratyayatvāditi tannivṛttyarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇamiti na vācyam, kathaṇ? yathaiva pratyayatvamāṭsahitasya , tathā pitttavamapi tasyaiva| ihaṃ tarhi prayojanam-- pratyayātpūrvasyāca udāttatvaṃ yathā syātsaṅghātasya mā bhūditi, etadeva jñāpakam--svaravidhau saṅghātaḥ kāryīti, tena `tāsyanudāttet' iti nighātaḥ `pacamānaḥ' ityādau citsvaraṃ paratvādbādhata iti yaduktaṃ tadupapannaṃ bhavati| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, pratyaye pitīti vaktavyam, tatra `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' iti pūrvasyaiva bhaviṣyati ? idaṃ tarhi prayejanam--piti pūrvaṃ kāryabhāgyathā syāt, pidantaṃ mā bhūditi| kathaṃ punaḥ saptamīnirddeśe tadantasya prasaṅga? etadeva jñāyati--svaravidhau saptamyastadantasaptamya iti | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? upottamaṃ
riti, ritpratyayayānte upottamamudāttaṃ bhavati, na tu riti parataḥ pūrvasya; `caṅyanyatarasyām' caṅntasya| yadyevam, `caturaḥ śasi' iti śasantasya prāpnoti, śasgrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati| yadi hi `caturaḥ śasi' ityanena śasa udāttatvamiṣṭaṃ syāt, tataḥ `ūḍidam' ityasyānantaram `caturaśca' iti brūyāt tatrāsarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛttyā `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' iti halāderudāttatvavidhānācca śasa eva bhaviṣyati ||

liti || 6.1.193 ||
pparatyayātpūrvamiti varttate, tena lidante svaraprasaṅgo na codanīyaḥ ||

ādirṇamulyanyatarasyām || 6.1.194 ||
lolūyaṃlolūyamiti| ekākṣu dhātuṣu litsvarasya, asya ca viśeṣābhāvādanekājudāhṛtaḥ| āmreḍitānudāttatve kṛta iti| `anudāttaṃ ca' ityanena ||

acaḥ kartṛyaki || 6.1.195 ||
kartṛvācini sārvadhātuke vihito yak kartṛyak| upadeśa iti varttata iti| `adupadeśāt' itiyatra yadupadeśagrahaṇaṃ tadupasamastamapi svaritatvapratijñānādiha sambaddhyate, taccārthātsaptamyantaṃ sampadyata iti matvoktam, na tu saptamyantamupadeśagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtamasti| yadi tūpadeśagrahaṇaṃ nānuvartteta, kāryata ityādau raparatve sati na syāt, tasmādupadeśa ityanuvarttyam|
yadyevam, jāyate svayamevetyādau na syāt, `ye vibhāṣā' ityātve satyuttarakālamajantā janādayaḥ, na tūpadeśe ? ityata āha--janādīnāmiti| `ye vibhāṣā' ityatra `anudāttopadeśe' ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca viṣayasaptamīti upadeśaeva janādīnāmātvaṃ bhavati| jāyate svayameveti| antarbhāvitaṇyartho janiḥ karmakartṛviṣayaḥ| dṛśyate cāntarbhāvitaṇyarthasya prayogaḥ, yathā--ekaṃ dvādaśadhā jajñe iti ||

thali ca seṭīḍanto vā || 6.1.196 ||
`anyatarasyām' iti varttamāne vāgrahaṇaṃ kāryivikalpārtham| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena kāryaṃ vikalpyate, vāgrahaṇena kāryiṇaḥ| teneḍādayaḥ paryayeṇa kāryaṃ pratipadyante| nanu ca `antaśca tavai yugapat' ityādau yugapadgrahaṇādevānyatra paryāyaḥ siddhaḥ ? satyam; aderapi prāpte vāgrahaṇam; anyathā śrutayohiḍantayoreva kāryitvaṃ vikalpet, vāgrahaṇe tu sati yadyevaṃ vikalpo'rthaḥ, athāpi samucyayaḥ, sarvathāderapi bhavati |
seṭīti kimiti| iḍgrahaṇādeva thal seṭ grahīṣyata iti praśnaḥ| yayātheti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ--iḍgrahaṇaṃ yadeḍāgamaḥ kriyate tadā tasyodāttārthaṃ syāt, tataśca yathā lulavithetyādau caturṇāṃ paryāyeṇodāttavalidhāne yayithepyādau caturthābhāve'pi paryāyeṇodāttatyaṃ bhavati, evamiḍabhāve'pi syāditi ||

ñnityādirnityam || 6.1.197 ||
pratyayasvarāpavāda iti| bāhulyādevamuktam| `śrotriyaṃśchando'dhīte' it, atra hi vākyārthe padavacanamityatra pakṣe na pratyayaśvaraprasaṅgaḥ |
pratyayalakṣaṇamatra neṣyata iti| nanu ca `na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhādeva pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, kimucyate--pratyayalakṣaṇamatra neṣyata iti ? evamanyato jñāpitametat--`svaravidhau saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti| tataśca yathā pūrvasūtre thalantaṃ kāryi; tathātrāpi ñnidantaṃ na tu tataḥ pūrvamaṅgamityanaṅgakāryatvātpratiṣedho na siddhyatīti| yañi kani ceti| cakārādbidādyañi ca ||

āmantritasya ca || 6.1.198 ||
atra `kārakādattaśrutyorevāśiṣi' iti prāptiḥ pratiṣiddhyate, śeṣanidhātena bādhya ityarthaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇamatreṣyata iti| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena tatkāryasya spaṣṭatvāt| sarpiriti| sṛperisi sarpiḥ sabdo'ntyodāttaḥ, `svamornapuṃsakāt' iti sorluk| saptaśabdau ghṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ, `ṣaṅbhyo luk' iti jaso luk ||

pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne || 6.1.199 ||
pathimathiśabdāvityādi| `gameriniḥ', `puṣaḥ kit', `manthaḥ', `patestha ca' itīnipratyayaḥ, manthaḥ kittvādupadhālopaḥ--panthāḥ, manthā iti| `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt' ityādikāryam |
pathaḥ paśyeti| bhasya ṭerlopaḥ| pratyayalakṣaṇamatrāpi neṣyate| atiprasaṅgastu pūrvavat ||

antaśca tavai yugapat || 6.1.200 ||
karttevai iti| `kṛtyārthe tavalaikenkenyatvanaḥ' iti tavaipratyayaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttaye yatnaḥ kriyate ? ityāha--ekavarjamiti hītyādi ||

kṣayo nivāse || 6.1.201 ||
`kṣi nighāsagatyoḥ'--ityāsmād adhikaraṇe ghaḥ| kṣayo dasyūnāmiti| kṣayerac, karttari ṣaṣṭhī ||

vṛṣādīnāṃ ca || 6.1.203 ||
`vṛṣu secane', `janī prādurbhāve', `jvara roge', `hi gatau', `kai gai rai śabde'| ete sarve'cpratyayāntā iti| pacāditvāt| bāhulyāccedamuktam| vṛṣaḥ--ityatregupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ| `ṇīñ prāpaṇe', `tāyṛ santānapālanayoḥ'| kecittaya iti paṭhanti, `aya paya taya gatau', kvaciccayaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, sa cinoterdraṣṭavyaḥ| `iṇ gatau', aṃsa samādhāne', `vida jñāne', `ṣūda nirāse', `du dāhe',| `vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci', `ata sātatyagamane'| kecidetau na paṭhanti| `guhūsaṃvaraṇe', `śama upaśame', `aṇa raṇa śabde'|
sammatau bhāvakarmaṇoriti| śamaraṇāviti varttate, sammatāvarthe śamaraṇau bhāvakarmaṇoryathākramamādyudāttau bhavataḥ| `mātri guptabhāṣaṇe'| śāntiriti| śameḥ ktici `kamu kāntau', `yamu uparame', kecidyamaśabdaṃ na paṭhanti|
`ṛ śabde gatau', `ghṛñ dhāraṇe', `kṝ vikṣepe', bhidādipu nipātanādvṛddhiḥ| `vaha prāpaṇe', `kṛpū sāmarthye', `pada gatau' ||

saṃjñāyāmupamānam || 6.1.204 ||
yadyevamiti| yadyatra kano lubityarthaḥ| etadevetyādi| jñāpakābhāve tu saptamīnirdeśe'pi pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho na syāt, `svaravidhau saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti jñāpanena tadantasya kāryitvāt| kvaciditi| vacanātkvacidbhavatyeva, yathā--`sarvasya supi' ityatra ||

niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt || 6.1.205 ||
ihādyāktaḥ adyātta ityekādeśasya bahiraṅgatvādasiddhatvād `anāt' itika pratiṣedhābhāvaḥ| bhīṣmaśabdaḥ `bhiyaḥ ṣukca' iti manpratyayāntaḥ|
cintita iti| `citi smṛtyām' curādiḥ ||

āśitaḥ karttā || 6.1.207 ||
aśeriti| `aśa bhojane' ityasmāt| āṅpūrvādavivakṣite karmaṇīti| uktaṃ hi--`prasiddheravivakṣātaḥ karmaṇo'karmikā kriyā' iti| kartari kta iti| `gatyarthākarmaka' ityādinā| bhāṣye tu `karttari kto nipātyate' iti sthitam| yadi tarhyāṅpūrvakasyāśerāśita iti rūpam, avagrahaḥ prāpnoti, tasmāt `upadhādīrghatvamapi nipātyate' iti vārttikakāraḥ. vṛttikārastu--`saṃhitāpāṭha eva nityaḥ, padapāṭhastu paurupeyaḥ, tataśca na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvarttyam' iti manyate| apara āha---aśerṇyantasya prayojyakarttari `gatibuddhipratyavasānārtha' iti karmasaṃjñake niṣṭhāyāmāśita iti rūpam, sa evātra bhūtapūrvagatyā karttā vivakṣita iti ||

rikte vibhāṣā || 6.1.208 ||
rikta iti| `ricirvirecane'| saṃjñāyāmityādi| `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--dattaḥ, guptaḥ, asyāvakāśo'saṃjñāyām--rikto ghaṭa iti; saṃjñāyāmubhayaprasaṃge pūrvavipratipedhaḥ ||

juṣṭārpite cacchandasi || 6.1.209 ||
juṣṭa iti| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ', `śvīdite niṣṭhāyām' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| apita iti| `atirhrī' artterṇic, artyādinā puk ||

nityaṃ mantre || 6.1.210 ||
ārambhasāmarthyādeva siddhe nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham ||

yuṣmadas‌madorṅasi || 6.1.211 ||
`yuṣyasibyāṃ madik', yuṣiḥ sautro dhātuḥ| tava, mameti| `yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso's', `tavamamau ṅasi' iti maparyantasya tavamamādeśaḥ, śeṣe lopaḥ, `ato guṇe' iti pararūpatvam, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatve prāpte idamucyate ||

ṅayi ca|| 6.1.212 ||
tubhyam, mahyamiti| `ṅe prathamayoram', `tubhyamahyau ṅayi'|
atha kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na `yuṣmadasmadorṅeṅasoḥ' ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi cakāro na karttavyo bhavati ? ata āha--pṛthagyogakaraṇamiti| āśaṅkāgrahaṇenāsvaritatvādeva yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktumiti darśayati| atrāpi pūrvavadvibhaktisvaraḥ prāptaḥ ||

yato'nāvaḥ || 6.1.213 ||
atra `anāvaḥ' iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati--svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavaditi; anyathā ya ādirnakāro nāsau svarayogyaḥ, yaśca svarogya akāro nāsāvādiriti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt ||

īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ || 6.1.214 ||
`īha stutau', `vadi abhivādanastutyoḥ', `vṛṅsambhaktau', `śaṃsu stutau', `duha prapūraṇe'| kathaṃ vārya ityatra ṇyat, yāvatā `etistuśāsu' ityādinā viśeṣavihitena kyapā bhāvyam ? ata āha--vārya ityādi| atha vṛṅo'pi kyabeva kasmānna bhavati ? ata āha--kyabvidhau hītyādi| etacca tatraiva pratipāditam ||

vibhāṣā veṇvinadhānayoḥ || 6.1.215 ||
ṇupratyayānta iti| `tiṣṭhaterṇuḥ' iti tatrānuvartate| udāttanivṛttisvareṇeti| `śnasorallopaḥ' iti śnaso'kārasyodāttasya lopāt|
veṇurityādi| `saṃjñāyāmupamānam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--cañcā vardhrikā, vibhāṣāyā avakāśaḥ--anupamānabhūto veṇuḥ śuṣka upavane; veṇuriti saṃjñāyāmupamāne pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ|

tyāgarāgahāsakuhaśvaṭhakrathānām || 6.1.216 ||
`kuha vismāpane', `śvaṭha kratha bhāṣaṇo' caurādikāvadantau| nidhākatasyaivāyamapavādo yuktaḥ ? naitadevam; yadyayaṃ nighātasyāpavādaḥ syāt, tatraivāyaṃ brūyāt--`anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam, na hi svārtham ||

caṅyanyatarasyām || 6.1.218 ||
udāharaṇe ekavacanātikramaṇe heturmṛgyaḥ| mā hi daghaditi| `vibhāṣā dheṭśyoḥ' itika cleścaṅādeśaḥ|

matoḥ pūrvamātsaṃjñāyāṃ striyām || 6.1.219 ||
matoḥ pūrvaṃ ākāra iti| arthavyākhyānametat| sūtre tu śabdarūpāpekṣaya napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ| kecittu sūtre pūrvaśabdaṃ puṃlliṅgameva paṭhanti| udāharaṇe cāturathikaḥ `nadyāṃ matup', `matau bahvaco'nacirādīnāṃ ca' iti dīrghatvam| matoriti kim ? gavādinīti| matorityasminnasati pūrvagrahaṇamapi na kriyeteti saṃjñāśabdasambandhina ākāramātrasya prasaṅgaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ matoranantarasya pūrvasya yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt--sānumatīti ||

anto'vatyāḥ || 6.1.220 ||
ihāsandehārtham `vatyā antaḥ' ityavacanādakārapraśleṣo niścitaḥ|
tatra prayojanaṃ pṛcchati--avatyā iti kimucyata iti| athāvatyā ityucyagāne'pi rājavatītyatra kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hyetadapi nalope kṛte'vatīśabdāntam ? ata āha--svaravidhāvityādi| nanu codāharaṇe'pi matorvatvasyāsiddhatvādavatīśabdāntatvaṃ nāsti ? ityāhṛ--vatvaṃ punariti| punaḥśabdo nalopādviśeṣaṃ dyotayati ||

īvatyāḥ || 6.1.221 ||
ahīvatītyādau pūrvaṃ dīrghaḥ, `saṃjñāyām' iti vatvam| yogavibhāgaścintyaprayojanaḥ ||

cau || 6.1.222 ||
udāttanivṛttisvarāpavādo'yamiti| kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇodāttasyāñcatyakārasya vibhaktinimiktakaḥ `acaḥ' iti lopaḥ|
cāvataddhita iti vaktavyamiti| cau yaḥ svaraḥ sa taddhite parato na bhavatītyarthaḥ; inyathā yo'nudāttaḥ pratyayaḥ--dadhīcaḥ paśyetyādau, tatra yathodāttanivṛttisvaraṃ bādhate, tathā dādhīca ityādau pratyayasvaramapi satiśiṣṭa svaro vādeta, tasmādataddhita iti vaktavyam, asmiśca sati udāttanivṛttisvarasyāyamapavādo bhavati ||

samāsasya || 6.1.223 ||
rājadṛṣaditi| nanu ca yo'tra samāsasyānto dakāro nāsau svarabhāk, yaśca tataḥ pūrvo'kāro nāsau samāsasyāntaḥ ? ata āha--svaravidhāviti| na svarasyaiva vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yo'pi `anudāttāderañ' ityādiḥ, so'pi svaravidhiḥ; svarāśrayatvāt| tena so'pi vidhirvyañjanādau vyañjanānte ca bhavati| atra ca jñāpakam--`nottarapade'nudāttādau' ityuttavā pṛthivyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ|

nānāsvarāpavāda iti yadyapi `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' ityasti, tathāpi varjane viśeṣāśrayaṇātparyāyeṇa nānāsvaraprasaṅgaḥ| tatra rājaśabdaḥ `kaninyuvṛṣitakṣi' ityādinā kaninpratyāntatvādādyudāttaḥ; `puraḥ kuṣan'----puruṣaḥ; brahmaṇo'patyaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ--aṇantaḥ; `kalatṛpaśca'; `vṛṣādibhyaścit';`kamerbuk ca'---kambalaḥ; `kanyārājanyaśipyāmanupyāṇāmantaḥ' iti kanyāśabdo'natasvaritaḥ; `svanahasorvā' ityap, dhātusvaraḥ; paṭatpaṭaddhanyata iti paṭahaḥ, pṛṣodarādirantodāttaḥ; `svanahasorvā' ityap, dhātusvaraḥ; paṭatpaṭaddhanyata iti paṭahaḥ, pṛṣodarādirantodāttaḥ; `śāśapibhyāṃ danau', pacādiṣu nadaḍiti paṭhyate, ṭittvānṅīp-nadī; udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ; poṣaśabdo ghañantaḥ; `śradṛbhaso'diḥ' `dṛṇāteḥ ṣug hrasvaśca' dṛṣat, pratyayasvaraḥ; samidhyate yayeti samit, sampadāditvātkvip, kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ--ete nānāsvarāḥ, teṣāmapavādaḥ ||

iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ṣaṣṭhasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ
<6.2>
atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ
padamañjarī
bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam || 6 - 2 - 1 ||
iha yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ| na ca kṛtsnasya pūrvapadasya śeṣanighātalakṣaṇo vikāraḥ prāptaḥ kintu tatsthayorudāttasvaritayoreva, tasmāttyoreva pūrvapadaśabdo vartate,tadāha - pūrvapadagrahaṇamityādi| samāsāntodāttatve hītyādinā vikāraprāptiṃ darśayati| samāsāntodāttatvāpavādo'yamiti| nāprāpte tasminnārambhāt | nanu ca yatra sāmānyavidhiprapṛttimanapekṣya viśeṣavidhipravṛttistatrāpabādatvam, yathā -- karmaṇyaṇ āto'nupasarge kaḥ iti iha tu satyāṃ vikāraprāptau prakutibhāvo vidheyaḥ, vikāraprāptiśca samāsasyetyasmin pravavṛtta iti kathaṃ tatpravṛttyapekṣastadapavādaḥ, ataḥ samāsasyetyasminpravṛtte prāptasya śoṣanidhātasyaivāyamapavādo yuktaḥ naitadedhama, yadyayaṃ nighātāpavādaḥ syāt, tatraivāyaṃ brūyād - anudāttampadamekavarjama bahuvrīhau pūryapadam iti | nanvevanutyamāne samapāda ityādau svābhāvikasyāpi pūrvapadānudāttasya pratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratipedho vā iti tasmātsamāsasyeteyasyānantaramārabhyamāṇastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ| nanu cektam -- kathaṃ tatpravṛkattyapekṣastadapavādaḥ iti ucyate nidānecchedena nidānina ucchedaḥ śakyate kartum, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ ca śeṣanidhātalakṣaṇasya pūrvapadavikārasya nidānam, atastadabhāvadvayoreṇa nidānabhūtasya samāsāntodāttasyaivāsmin viṣaye'pravṛttirākhyāyate | nanvevaṃ nānāpadasvaraprāptau samāsasāntodāttasyārambhāttadapravṛttau dvayorapi pūrvettarapadayoḥ prakṛtsvaraprasaṅgaḥ, tathā hi sati na bahuvrīheḥ iti samāsāntodāttatvameva ptipevet, astu vā samāsāntodāttatvam, astu vā soṣavidhātaḥ, paścāttu prakṛtvetyanena svaraviśeśamupalakṣya sa svaraḥ pūrvapadasya vidhīyate, śeṣavidhātātprāk pūrvapadāsya prakṛtyā yaḥ svarastatsvarakaṃ pūrvapadaṃ bahuvrīhau bhavatītiḥ yadi vā prakṛtyā ityanenasvaraviśeṣe upalakṣite satyayamartho bhavati bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasya svabhāviko yaḥ svara ādyudāttatvādikaḥ sa bhavatīti, evaṃ ca yathā pūrvapadasyādirudātto bhavatītyuktena samāsasyetyetatpravṛttyapekṣā, tādṛgotaditi yujyate tadapavādatā|
kṛṣṇo mṛga iti| yasyājinaṃ kṛṣṇājinamityucyate|
brahmacārinśabdaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodātta iti| tathā cādhīyate---
brahmacārī carati viṣayadviṣām| kasya brahmacāryasītyādau ṇiniḥ, pūrvapadādyuta dāttatvaṃ tu na bhavati, pravṛddhādiṣu pāṭhādākutigaṇo hi sa iṣyate | vṛttau tu kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇetyupalakṣaṇam | apara āha-chandasi parādiśca parāntaśca ityantedāttatvam| vṛttestvayamarthaḥ -- brahmeva carati brahmacārītyupamānamatra pūrvapadam, tataḥ kim upamānaṃ śabdārthaprakṛtāveva iti niyamātkṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavatīti | snātakaśabdaḥ kanpratyayānta iti| yāvādiṣu snāta vedasamāptau iti paṭhyate |
manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca, manuṣyaḥ | yadi tarhmayaṃ prakṛtibhāvaḥ samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bādhate, sarvānudātte'pi pūrvapade bādheta, tatrāpi hyasya pravṛttirna kenacidvāryate, viśeṣavidhiśca pravartamānaḥ satyapi sambhave, sāmānyavidherbādhako bhavati, takradānamiva dadhidānasya ityata āha -- udāttagrahaṇamityādi | nyāyate'pyayamarthaḥ siddhaḥ, kathaṃ yasya vikāraḥ prāptastasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ, vikāraprāptiścodāttasvaritayoreva, ata eva pūrvamuktamudātte svarite vā vartate iti|
samabhāga iti | samaśabdaḥ suño ḍamap iti vyutpāditaḥ sarvānudāttataḥ | nanvatrāsatyapi samāsāntodāttattve bhāgaśabdasya karṣātvataḥ iti antodāttātvat samābhāgaśabdo'ntodātta eva bhaviṣyati| tasmādudāharāṇadigiyaṃ darśitā, samapāda ityudāhartavyam, pādaśabdo vṛṣāditvādādyudāttaḥ|
kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro yathā syāt, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ mā bhūditi,nañsubhyām ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - yadi bahuvrīhauvantodāttatvaṃ bhavati nañsubhayāmeveti| na caivaṃ nānāpadasvaraprāptau samāsāntodāttatvavidhānānniyamena tasminvyāvittite'pi pūrvottarāpadayordvayorapi paryāyoṇa prakṛtisvaraprasaṅgaḥ,
śiternityābahvac ityasya niyamārthatvāt yadi bahuvrīhāvuttarapadaṃ prakṛtyā bhavati śitereva paramiti ucyate nañsubhayām ityeṣa tāvanniyame nepapadyate anudaraḥ, sūdara ityādau udārāśveṣu kṣepe iti pūrvapadāntodāttasya prāptasya bādhanādvidhisambhavāt| śiternityābahvac ityetadapi -- śiternityābahvajevetyanena niyameta śītilalāṭādiṣevevottarapadāprakṛtisvaraṃ nivartayet, na citraguprabhṛtiṣvityārabhyamevaitat |
bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ tu śakyamakartum tatpuruṣe kasmānna bhavati tatpuruṣe tulyārtha ityādiniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - tatpuruṣe tutyārthādyeveti, gantavyapaṇyameva vāṇije,gatādiṣvevottaravadeṣu dvigāvityādi| dvandve kasmānna bhavati rājanyabahuvacane ityetanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - dvandve bhavati rājanyabahuvacanadvandva eveti| avyayībhāve kāsmānna bhavati paripratyupāpāvarjyamāna ityādi niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati -- paripratthupāpā evāvyayībhāva iti | viparītastu niyamaḥ sarvatra na bhaviṣyati nāniṣṭārthā śāstrapravūttiriti| evamapyasati bahuvīhigrahaṇe samāsāntodāttasya pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya caikaviśayatvādvirodhācca tulyaśvataḥ, pañcāratnirityādau paryāyaḥ prāpnoti tatpuruṣādiṣu tulyārthādīnyeva pūrvapadāni prakṛtisvarāṇi bhavanti nānyāni ityeva hi niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ, na tulyārthādipūrvapadeṣu tatpurupādiṣu pūvapadāprakṛtisvalatvameva iti | athāmyagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādubhayaniyamaḥ tatpurupādiṣu tulyārthādīnyeva, teṣu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvameveti tathā ca bahvanyatarasyām iti vartamāne diṣṭivitastyośca iti vikalpo vidhīyate, pañcadiṣṭiḥ, pañcavitastirityādau igante dvigau iti nityapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro mā bhūditi tathāpi citragurityādau bahuvrīhau paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam dvitribhyāṃ pādadanmūrddhasu iti dvipādityādāvāntodāttavikalpaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati - na bahuvrīhāvantodāttatvaṃ paryāyoṇa bhavati iti evamapyudāttaviṣayameva jñāpakaṃ syāt -- bahuvrīhāvantodāttatvaṃ paryāyeṇa bhavati iti | kiñca syāt udāttasvaritayostu pūrvottarapadasthayoḥ paryāyaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca svarite ya udāttastadāśrayaṃ jñāpakaṃ yujyate, aco hyudāttasaṃjñā, na ca varṇaikadeśo gṛhmate | atha varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛnyodāttaśrutiparaṃ jñāpakaṃ vaṇyaita, tadā bahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum ||
tatpuruṣe tulyārthatutīyasaptamyupamānāvyayadvitīyākṛtyā || 6 - 2 - 2 ||
sadṛkśabdo'pītyādi| kṛduttarapadaprakṛtīsvareṇetyetadapekṣate|
kumudaśabdo'pītyādi | tatra yadā kapratyayāntastadā thāthādisvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tathā ca anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ ityatra kumudvānityudāhṛtam, uktaṃ ca -- kumudātayo'ntodāttā iti| yadā tvavyutpannaṃ tadā nabviṣayasyanisantasya ityādyudātta ityuktam | apara āha - jalaje napuṃsakaviṣayaḥ kumudaśabdaḥ, yastu vānaraviśeṣe kumudaśabdaḥ sa puṃlliṅgaḥ, tatreha jalajavācyudāhṛtaḥ, anudāttasya ca ityatra tu vānaravacana iti |
dūrvākāṇḍaśarakāṇḍaśabdāvityādi| ādyaprāptipradarśanametat, ṣaṭ ca kaṇḍādīni ityuttarapadādyudāttatvena tatra bhāvyam|
nañkunipātānāmiti| nipātatvādeva siddhe nañgrahaṇam akaraṇirityādau parasyāpi kṛtsvarasya bādhanārtham | tathā cāvyathītyatrāpi kṛtā saha nirdiṣṭo yatra nañ, tatrāpi naña eva svaro bhavati, tathā vibhaktissarānnañsvaro balīyān bhavati | kugrahaṇaṃ tu cādiṣu pāṭhābhāvāt, paṭhitavyastvasau, anyathā'vyayasaṃkṣā na syāta svarādiṣvapi pāṭhābhāvāt | snātvākālaka iti | mayūravyaṃsakādirayam | yadyevam,sa tatraivāntodāttaḥ paṭhiṣyate evamapi parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam,sāmikṛtam,svayandhautamityādau prakṛtiravaro mā bhūditi| iha kasmānna bhavati-paramaṃ kārakaṃ paramakārakam,parameṇa kārakeṇa paramakārakeṇa,parame kārake paramakārake iti na hi viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ prathamāntānāmeveti niyame'sti | tena dvitīyādyantaṃ pūrvapadamit codyam | parihārastu lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā tṛtīyādīnāṃ pratipadaṃ yaḥ samāsastatrāyaṃ svaraḥ| ayaṃ tu vibhaktiviśaiṣamanupādāya viśeṣaṇasamāsa iti ||
varṇe varṇoṣvanete|| 6 - 2 - 3 ||
anete taiti pratiṣedhādvahuvacananirdeśāccottarapade svarūgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tatsāhacaryātpūrvapade'pi| kṛṣṇāśabdo nakpratyayānto'ntodātta iti | phiṣi tu kṛṣṇasyāmṛgākhyā cet ti chandasyantodāttatvam, anyatrādyudāttatvaṃ vyavasthitam||
gāṃdhalavaṇāyoḥ pramāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 4 ||
śambagādhamiti|gādhṛ pratiṣṭhāyām,gādhyata taiti gādhaḥ arddharcādiḥ, iyattāyāḥ paricchittaḥ - iyattāparicchedaḥ | kriyāśabdo'tra pramāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, na tvāyomamāne rūḍha ityarthaḥ ||
dāyādyaṃ dāyāde|| 6 - 2 - 5 ||
dātavyo dāyaḥ - bhāgaḥ, aṃśa ityarthaḥ | dāyamādatte dāyādaḥ, mūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ, dāyādāsya bhāvo dāyādyam | kiṃ punastat dāyāsyādānaṃ tatsambandho vā| iha tu lakṣyamāṇo''dīyamāne eva dāyadyaśabdo vartate |
athetyādi | vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ | tamevāviṣkaroti - yadyevamiti | śeṣalakṣaṇauveti| sāmānyalakṣaṇaivātra ṣaṣṭhī, na pratipadamityevaśabdasyarthaḥ | yadi śeṣalakṣaṇaivātra ṣaṣṭhī, kimarthaṃ punastatra vidhānam ityāha - tāsyāstviti | saptamī tāvadvidheyā, aprāptatvāt | tatra yadi saiva vidhīyeta, tato'sau viśeṣavihitatvāt ṣaṣṭhyā bādhikā vijñāyeta, maivaṃ vijñāyīti punaḥ saiva śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhyabhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrvā vidhīyata ityarthaḥ ||
pritibandhi cirakṛcchayoḥ || 6 - 2 - 6 ||
kāryasiddha pratibadhnātīti pratibandhi, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ | viśeṣaṇasamāsa iti | nanu ca sāmānādhikaraṇye sati sa bhavati, na ceha tadasti gamanaśabdasya gativācitvāt ciraśabdasya ca kālavācitvāt naiṣa doṣaḥ cirakālabhāvini gamane'tra ciraśabdo varttate | mayūravyaṃsakādirvaiṣa iti | gamanamatra viśeṣyam, tadviśeṣaṇe tu cirakṛcchre, ato viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātārthaṃ mayūravyāsakāditvameṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvapadasya pratibandhivācitvamupapannayati | gamanaṃ hītyadi | karāṇanaikalyāddhi cirakārabhāvi gamanaṃ kṛcchrayogi ca, kṛcchram - duḥkham, tadyogi ca kāryasiddheḥ pratibandhi jāyate ||
pade'padeśe || 6 - 2 - 7 ||
accāraḥ - pulīṣakriyā ||
nivāte vātatrāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 8 ||
ḍyakpratyayānto'ntodātta ityapare iti | kavaterḍyak iti sūtramadhīyate | ḍakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati guṇapratiṣedhārthātkakārānubandhāt ||
śārade'nārtave || 6 - 2 - 9 ||
udāharaṇe ऱjjūd‌dhṛte rajjuśabdo dṛṣatpiṣṭeṣu dṛṣacchabdaḥ, tataḥ karmadhāraya'svapadavigrahaḥ| sṛjerasum ca ityatra skandeḥ salopaśca ityataḥ salopa iti vartate, tena sṛjerantyādacaḥ paro'yamasum, salope yaṇādeśe'sumaḥ sakārasya jaśtve ca rajjuriti bhavati ||
adhvaryukaṣāyayorjātau|| 6 - 2 - 10 ||
niyataviṣayā iti| varaṇaviśeṣaniyatā ityarthaḥ||
sadṛśapratirupayoḥ sādṛśye || 6 - 2 - 11 ||
sadṛśāgrahaṇamanarthakam tutīyāsamāsavacanāt| sadṛśaśabdena tutīyāsamāsa ucyate - pūrvasadṛśasamonārtha iti, tatra tutīyāpūrva padaṃ prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatītyeva siddhamata āha - ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthaṃ ceti| tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭhyapi vidhīyate, tatra yadā tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ kriyate, tadāpi yathā syādityevamartha sadṛśagrahaṇam| nanu cānabhidhānātṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhaviṣyati traiśabdyaṃ hi naḥ sādhyam -- mātuḥ sadṛśaḥ,mātrā sadṛśaḥ mātṛsadṛśa iti etacca vināpi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena siddhyatyeva ata āha -- ihetyādi| aluki sati rūpaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvādavaśyakartavyaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tadarthaṃ ceha sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | yadyevam, tṛtīyāsamāse sadṛśagrahaṇam, yathā -- vidyā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti| na hyatra ṣaṣṭhyartho'sti,kintu tṛtīyārthaḥ, vidyayā hetunā sadṛśa ityarthaḥ, anyo devadattādiratra pratiyogī | apara āha -- tṛtīyāsamāso'pyaluki prayajayati -- manasaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ manasāsadṛśa iti| atretyādi| daśi daśanasparśanayoḥ daṃśeṣṭo na ā ca iti ṭapratyayaḥ nakārasya cākāraḥ ṭittvānṅīp, yasyotilopaḥ, anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ iti udāttatvam | vṛṣalaśabdājjātilakṣaṇo
ṅīṣ ||
dvigau pramāṇe|| 6 - 2 - 12 ||
kardamādīnāñca ityatra makarakuktakuṭapārevatetyādeḥ sūtrādādigrahaṇamanuvartate| atha dvitīyaṃ prāgīpāt ityate dvitīyagrahaṇam | paramasaptasamamiti|samāhāre dviguḥ pāttrāditvānnapuṃsakatvam,mūlodāharaṇe tu taddhitārthe dviguruttarapadam||
gantavyapaṇyaṃ vāṇije|| 6 - 2 - 13 ||
vaṇigeva vāṇijaḥ prajñāditvādaṇ| saptamīsamāsā eta eti | saptamī iti yogavibhāgāt | govāṇijādayastu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ||
mātro pajñopakamacchāye napuṃsake|| 6 - 2 - 14 ||
phipiti ādimena yogena śāntanavīyaṃ na catuṣkaṃ sūtramupalakṣaṇayati | tatra samudraśabdaḥ gāgarārthatvādantodāttaḥ ||
sukhapriyayorhite || 6 - 2 - 15 ||
samānādhikaraṇasamāsā ete iti | gamanādīnāṃ viśeṣa ṇatvātpūrvanipātaṃ manyate | atha tu sukhapriyayorviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tadā mayūravyāṃsakāditvameṣṭavyama | āyatyāmiti | pariṇāme, āgāmikāle, bhāvikāla iti yāvat ||
prītau ca || 6 - 2 - 16 ||
iha tu sukhapirayayoḥ taityetāvatsūtraṃ kṛtvā hite ca iti vaktavyam, tatrādye sūtre sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārādeva prītau gamyamānāyāṃ bhaviṣyati tatrāha - sukhapriyayorityādi | brāhmaṇaśabdo'ṇantaḥ | chāttraśabdaḥ chattrā dibhyo ṇaḥ iti ṇapratyayāntaḥ | kanyāśabdaḥ svaritānta iti | tilyaśikyamartyakāśmaryadhānyakanyārājanyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ iti phiṣi pāṭhāt ||
patyāvaiśvarye|| 6 - 2 - 18 ||
dhānyamantaḥ svaritamiti | ānantarapaṭhitena phiṭ‌sūtreṇa|| gavādīnāṃ tu pūrvameva svarakathanam ||
na bhūvākciddidhiṣu|| 6 - 2 - 19 ||
bhūvādīnāṃ samāhāradvandve napuṃsakahasvatvam, atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarapratiṣedhād vṛttikāreṇa pūrvapadānāṃ svaro vyākhyātaḥ | tatrāditastrayaḥ kkibantāḥ | andūdṛbhbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ iti kūpratyayānto didhiṣūśabdo nipātitiḥ ||
vā bhuvananam|| 6 - 2 - 20 ||
bhuvanaśabdo bhāṣāyāṃ bahulavacanātsādhuḥ ||
āśaṅkābādhanedīyassu samābhāvane || 6 - 2 - 21 ||
śaki śaṅkāyām bādhṛ viloḍane, āṅ‌pūrvābhyāṃ karmaṇi ghañ | atiśayenāntiko nedīyaḥ, antikabāḍhayornedasādhau | astitvādhyavasāyaḥ - astitvaniścayaḥ| gamanāśaṅkādayo viśeṣaṇasamāsāḥ, mayūravyaṃsakādayo vā ||
pūrve bhūtapūrva|| 6 - 2 - 22 ||
āḍhyo bhūtapūrva iti| yaḥ pūrvamāḍhya āsītsa evamucyate| atretyādi| paramaścāsau pūrvaśceti| so'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūjyamānatālakṣaṇaḥ, tasminniha pratyudaharaṇe samāsa ityarthaḥ| na tviti | paramo bhūtapūrva iti| yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūrva parama āsīdityavaṃrūpaḥ, na tasmin tatra samāsa iti yāvat, kiṃ kāraṇam ityāha-tathā
ceti | hyarthe ||
savidhasanīḍasamāryādasaveśasadeśeṣu sāmīpye|| 6 - 2 - 23 ||
udāharaṇeṣu ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ, madrādīnāṃ pūrvameva svara uktaḥ||

vispaṣṭa iti | spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ ityasya niṣṭāyām vā dānta ityādinā spaṣṭhaśabdo nipātitaḥ viśabdena gatisamāsaḥ| citra citrīkaraṇe curādiḥ, tasmāderace, viśeṣeṇa citraṃ vicitram, prādisamāsaḥ | citī saṃjñāne vigataṃ citamasya vicittaḥ, āñjū vyaktyādiṣu tasya vipūrvasya niṣṭāyā gatisvaraḥ, tatrekārasya yo yaṇ sa udāttayaṇ bhavati |

etadapi nāsti prayojanam yatkriyāyuktāḥ iti naivaṃ vijñāyate - yasya kriyā yatkriyā yatkriyāyuktāstaṃ pratīti, evaṃ vijñāyamāne tvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātoreva kriyā vācyeti tameva prati gatyupasargasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi vijñāyate | yā kriyā yatkriyā taṃ kriyālakṣaṇamarthaṃ pratigatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, kevalāyāśca kriyāyā vācakamuttarapadaṃ nāstīti kriyāviśiṣṭasādhanavācini praṇīḥ, prakāraka ityādau kriyāyāṃ siddhatābhidhāyini, prabhavanamityādau ca sarvatra bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etena kṛd‌grahaṇena ata āha - kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | ya evaṃ pratipattumasamarthastaṃ prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ |

alaguttarapade || 6 - 3 - 1 ||
alugiti cetyādi | pratyekaṃ svaritatvapratijñānaṃ daśeyati, asya porayojanam - ekasya nivṛttāvaparasya nivṛttirmā bhūditi | stokānmukta iti | karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchra ityādinā pañcamī, stokāntika ityādinā samāsaḥ | uttarapada iti kimiti | luk tāvatsamāsa eva prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate iti sāmarthyāduttarapada taityetallabhyate | nalopo nañaḥ ityādau ca na samāse ityayo hi samāsagrahaṇānuvṛtteruttarapadalābhāt natarāmityādau naño nalopādyabhāvaḥ siddha iti paśnaḥ | nistoka iti | atrottarapadabhūtebhyo'pi stokādibhyaḥ parasyāḥ pañcamyā alukprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā stokādibhyaḥ pratipadaṃ yā pañcamī vihitā, yaśca teṣāṃ pratipadoktaḥ samāsastasyā eva tatraiva vā lugbhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛttyarthenottarapadagrahaṇena ityata āha - anyārthamityādi | ānaṅṛto dvandve uttarapade parato yathā syāt, uttarapadasya mā bhūd - hotāpotārau, taanyathā paramapi sarvanāmasthānāpekṣatvena bahiraṅgama ṛto ṅi guṇaṃ bādhitvā dvandvakriyānantaraprāpta ānaṅ syāt, hotāpotṛbhyāmityādau ca syādeva | tathā iko hrasvo'ṅyo gālavasya iti uttarapade yathā syād , grāmaṇīrityādāvuttarasya padasya mā bhūdityevamādyarthamuttarapadādhikāro'vaśyaṃ kartavyaḥ sa ihaiva kriyeta, samāsānuvṛttiḥ - lakṣakaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā nākṣayitavyā bhavatīti | ā kuta taimāvadhikārau ityapekṣāyāmāha - alugadhikāra ityādi | ṛkārāntasya hyuttarapade'nantare pitṛputra ityādau ānaṅā bhavitavyam | yadi cātrāluk syādvibhaktyā vyavadhānaṃ syāt | yadvā - sākṣānnirdiṣṭamānaṅādikāryaṃ prakaraṇapptasyāluko nivartakamiti alugadhikāraḥ pragānaṅaḥ tathāṅgasya vidhīyamānaṃ kāryaṃ yatrāṅgamityetadbhavati tatraiva bhavati | kasmiṃścaitadbhavati pratyaye, na tūttarapada tathaiti sāmarthyād uttarapadādhikāraḥ prāgaṅgādhikārāt ||
pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ || 6 - 2 - 2 ||
stokādīnāṃ pratipadikagaṇe'pāṭhātsūtrapaṭhitānāṃ grahaṇamityāha - stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchāṇi stokādīnīti | karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchra ityādīni tustokādīni na gṛhyanta avyāptaḥ | stokāntika ityatratyāni bhūyiṣṭhāni arthagrahaṇāt | alugbhavatīti | lugna bhavatītyarthaḥ | supo luki prāpta iti | supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ ityanena | pratiṣedhaḥ kriyata iti | alugiti prasajyapratiṣedha iti darśayati, uttarapadādhikāropajīvanāya tu nāvyayībhāvāt ityasyānantaramidaṃ prakaraṇaṃ nārabdham, ekavacca, sarvasyālukprakaraṇasya śeṣabhūto'yamarthātideśaḥ, yasyā vibhakteralugvidhīyate, tadartho dvyātmako bahvātmakarścaikavadbhavatīti vaktavyam | tena stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ, stokebhayo mukta ityapi vigrahe stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ stokebhyo mukta ityatrāpyaikapadyamaikasvaryaṃ syāt naiṣa doṣaḥ, stokādibhyaḥ pratipadaṃ yā pañcamī - karaṇe ca stokālpa iti, tasya aluk, sā cāsattvavacanebhyo dvibahvorna sambhavatīti stokābhyām, stokebhya ityapādāna eṣāṃ pañcamītyeva na bhaviṣyati | evamapi dūrābhyāmāgataḥ, durebhya āgata ityatra prasaṅgaḥ atra hi dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca iti pratipadameva pañcamī | tathā'ntikābhyāṃ kṛtam, antikebhyaḥ kṛtamityādāvapyalukprasaṅgaḥ tasmādekavacceti vaktavyam | nanu vṛttāvupasarjanapadāni ekādisaṅkhyāṃ vihāyābhedaikatvāsaṅkhyāṃ pratipadyante, kā punariyamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā viśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthānam, yathā - madhunyoṣadhirasānām, na hi tatrāsyā oṣadherayaṃraso'syā ayamiti vibhāgo dṛśyate, atha ca ta eva viśeṣā anubhūyante na punā rasasāmānyam, tadvadatrāpi rājapuruṣa taiti rājārtho naikatvādiviśeṣāḥ | uktaṃ ca -
yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhunyāhitaśaktayaḥ |
avibhāgena vartante tāṃ saṅkhyāṃ tādṛśīṃ viduḥ || iti |
yadvā - anupāttasaṅkhyāviśeṣamekatvādiṣvanugataṃ sāmānyamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā, yathā santamase rupamātraṃ
gṛhyate na punaḥ śukla iti vā, kṛṣṇa iti vā, tadvadatrāpīti saṅkhyāvān rājārthaḥ, na cāvyayārthavanniḥsaṅkhya ityetāvatpratīyate | uktaṃ ca
bhedānāṃ vā parityāgātsaṅkhyātmā sa tathāvidhaḥ |
vyāpārajjātibhāgasya bhedāpohena vartate ||
antarhitaviśeṣeṇa yathā rupeṇa rupanān |
prakhyāyate na śuklādibhedo rupasya gamyate || iti |
tadevamabhedaikatvasaṅkhyopādānād dvivacanabahvacanāntānāṃ sarvā vṛttirna bhavati, kiṃ punaḥ samāsa eva, tataśca samāsābhāvādalugna bhaviṣyatīti kimekavadbhavena ucyate kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam - vṛttāvabhedaikatvasaṅkhyā pratīyate saṅkhyāviśeṣapratipādakābhāvāt | vibhaktirhi tasya pratipādikā, sā ca vṛttau nivṛttā, nivṛttāyāṃ ca tasyām trikaṛ prātipadikāryaḥ iti pakṣe saṅkhyāsāmānyasyāpi tāvatpradipādakābhāvaḥ | yadi paraṃ guḍa ityukte māghuryādivadavyabhicārātsaṅkhyā pratīyate, avyabhicāraśca casāmānyasyāniyatasya vā viśeṣasyeti, saivābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | pañcakapatre'pi saṅkhyāviśeṣapratipattau dyotakatvenāpi tāvad vibhaktayo'pekṣyanta iti tadabhāvātsāmānyo'niyate vā viśeṣaḥ pratīyata iti saivābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | yatra hyarthaprakaraṇādikaṃ viśeṣāvagatau pramāṇaṃ bhavatyeva tatra vṛttithaḥ | tadyathā, aryād mud‌gauḥ krītaṃ maudgikam, na hyekena mudgena krayaḥ sambhavati, kārakamadhya iti ca, na hyekasya madhyaṃ sambhavati prakaraṇāt - bhavadgirāmavasarapradānāya iti ādeśāt - tāvakīno māmakīna iti śaiṣikaḥ | māsajāta ityādau tu prātipadikārthasyaivāktaparimāṇatvāt | dviputra ityādau saṅkhyāśabdasannidhānāt | tadevaṃ yatra viṣeṣe pramāṇābhāvastatrābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā |
yadyevam, atrāluki sati vibhaktireva pramāṇamiti dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ samāsa syādeva yadā tvarthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣāvagatau dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ vṛttirbhavati tadā kā śaṅghā vibhaktāveva satyām | yadi cābhedaikatvasaṅkhyopajanād dvicanabahuvacanayoralugabhāvaḥ, ekavacanasyāpi na syāt, tasyāpi hi suddhamekatvaṃ vācyam, mābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā | atha vibhāktyabhāve saṅkhyāsāmānyasya pratītasya viṣeṣapayevasānāpekṣāyāṃ yo hi bahūn kalpayati kalpayatyasāvekamiti nyāyena vṛttāvapi śuddhamekatvaṃ pratīyata ityucyeta, abhaidaikatvasaṅkhyetyanupapannaṃ syāt| tasmādekavacanāntamya, dvivacanāntasya, bahuvacanāntasya vā yatheṣṭaṃ vṛttiḥ, vṛttau
cābhedaikatvasaṅkhyā, arthaprakaraṇādinā viśeṣāvagatiriti vācyam| evaṃ ca pūrvoktena nyānena dvivacanabahucanayoralukprasaṅgādatideśa āśrayitavyaḥ |
yadyevam, gopucaraḥ apsuyoniḥ, apsavya iti ye nityabahuvacanāntāḥ teṣā mapyaluki ekatvātideśādekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ evaṃ tarhyanabhidhānamatra hetuḥ | tadāha dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ tvanabhidhānāditi | vākyamapi tarhi na prāpnoti | na ca vācyam - samāse nāstyabhidhānam, vākye punarastīti | nu hi samāsasaṃjñā'rthābhidhāne upayujyate, yatpunarupayujyate - prātipadikam, vibhaktiśca, tatsarvamavikalamiti kimatrānabhidhānaṃ kariṣyati | tatrāha - tenātretyādi | svarasyāpyarthābhidhāna upayogāt, pṛthaksvarayuktasya vākyasya pratipādakatvamaikasvaryayuktasya samāsasyāpratipādakatvaṃ ca yuktamityarthaḥ |
brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ityādi | kiṃ punaratropasaṅkhyāyate dvitīyārthe pañcamī, brāhmaṇāni śaṃsati brāhmaṇacchaṃsī, aluk tu tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam ityeva siddhaḥ | nanu śāsrāṇyasau śaṃsati, na brāhmaṇāni naiṣa doṣaḥ brāhmaṇavihiteṣu śāsreṣu brāhmataṇaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ | apara āra - yukta evātra pañcamyarthaḥ, āharaṇapūrvake śaṃsane śaṃsatirvartate, brāhmaṇādāhṛtya sūktāni śaṃsatīti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī | evamāpi hotṛprabhṛtiṣvapi brāhmaṇācchaṃsīti prāpnoti tatrāha - ṛtvigviśeṣasya ruḍhiriyamiti | tasyā iti | brāhmaṇācchaṃsītyasyā ruḍherityarthaḥ | sateti | brāhmaṇācchaṃsītyatra pakṣe pañcamyartho na sambhavati, pakṣāntare tu sambhavati ||
ojaḥsahombhastamasastṛtīyāyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 3 ||
ojaḥsahogbhastamasastṛtīyāyāḥ || udāharaṇeṣu kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam iti samāsaḥ | iha kasmānna bhavati - satatanaiśatamovṛtāmiti ucyate uttarapadena pūrvapadamākṣipyate, tenopāttamojaḥprabhṛti viśeṣyate pūrvapadabhūtebhya
ojaḥ prabhṛtibhya iti | na cātra tamaḥ śabdaḥ pūrvapadam, kiṃ tarhi satatanaiśatamaḥ śabdaḥ | yatra tadantāvidhiriṣyate tatropāttenākṣiptaṃ pūrvapadaṃ viśeṣyate, tena tasya tadantasya ca bhavati - iṣṭakacitam, pakveṣṭakacitamiti | kvacittu - yadevopāttaṃ tasyauvottarapade'nantare tatkāryaṃ bhavati, na tūpāttasya tadantasya vā pūrvapadatvamapekṣyate, yathā - ānaṅ ṛto dvandve hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgātāraḥ iti, atra neṣṭṛśabdaśca na pūrvapadam, nāpi tadantaṃ pūrpadam, kiṃ tarhi hotṛśabdaḥ na tasyottarapadamanantaram |
añcasā - ārjavena | yasya pumānagrajaḥ sa puṃsā hetunā'nuja iti kṛtvā, januṣāndhaḥ - jātyandhaḥ, janu - janma |
ātmanaśca pūraṇe || 6 - 3 - 6 ||
vārtikamevedaṃ sūtrarupeṇa paṭhitam | pūraṇaśabdasya svaritatvāttadadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāmatra grahaṇaṃ na svarupasya grahaṇamityāha - pṛraṇapratyayānta iti | yadyapyuttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna bhavatīti dṛdayasya dṛllekha ityatra jñāpayiṣyate, tathāpyātmanśabdāt pūrṇapratyayasyāsambhavātsāmarthyādatra tadantavidhiḥ | ātmānā vā kṛta iti | vṛttau kṛtārthasyāntarbhāvāt kartari karaṇe vā tṛtīyā, tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena iti samāsaḥ, yathā - kuṅkamalohitādāvityarthaḥ |
ātmā caturtho yasyeti | ekasyāpi vastuno buddhiparikalpitavibhedasya vattipadārthatvam, taanyapadārthatvaṃ cāviruddham ||
vaiyākaraṇāruyāyāṃ caturthyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 7 ||
vaiyākaraṇānāmityādi | yadi tu vyākaraṇe bhavā vaiyākaraṇī, aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ ityaṇ, vaiyākaraṇī cāsāvākhyā ceti vaiyākāraṇākhyetyeṣaṃ vyākhyāyeta ātmanebhāṣaḥ , parasmaibhāṣa ityatra na syāt anayoraṣṭādhyāyyāmapaṭhitatvāt | tasmādyayopadaśitameva vyākhyātam | yadyevam, kuberabalirityādau lokikasajñāśabde prasaṅgaḥ, vaiyākaraṇānāmapi tena vyavahārāt ata āha - yayota | viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇamāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | yadā tu dhātusūtragaṇoṇādivākyātmakaṃ pañcasthānaṃ vyākaraṇam, tadā vaiyākaraṇī cāsāvākhyā cetyāsman vyākhyāne'pi na doṣaḥ | ātmanepadamiti | anvarthatmasya samāsavidhau darśitam |
parasya ca || 6 - 3 - 8 ||
kimathemidamucyate alug yathā syāt - parasmaipadam, parasmaibhāṣaḥ | siddho'trāluk pūrveṇeva na sidhyati ātmanaḥ iti tatra vartate | nivartiṣyate yadi nivarteta, tebhyo hitāstaddhitā ityatrāpi prāpnoti | tasmāt atmanaḥ thaiti tatrānuvartate, tasmaścānuvartamāne parasya ceti vaktavyam ||
haladantātsaptamyāḥ sajñāyām || 6 - 3 - 9 ||
udāharaṇeṣu saṃjñāyām iti samāsaḥ | gaviṣṭhira ityādi | anyathā antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate ityavādeśasyākaraṇādahaladantatvānna syāt, yathā - bhūmyāṃ pāśo bhūmipāśa ityatreti bhāvaḥ |
hṛd‌dyubhyāmiti | asaṃjñārthamidam | hṛdispṛk, divispṛgiti | dvitīyārthe caiṣā saptamī | tathā hi bhāṣyam - anyārthe caiṣā saptamī draṣṭavyā, hṛdayaṃ spṛśatīti hṛdispṛk, divaṃ spṛśatīti divispṛk iti | ākhyāgrahaṇasyopasamastatvādiha saṃjñāgrahaṇam | tatraiva tvasamāstamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ||
kāranāmni ca prācāṃ halādau || 6 - 3 - 10 ||
vaṇimbhiḥ paśupālaiḥ karṣakaiśca kalpito rājagrāhyo bhāgaḥ - karaḥ, kara kaeva kāraḥ, prajñāditvādaṇ |
niyamavikalpā iti niyamaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ | tāneva darśayati - kāranāmnye netyādi | prācāṃ deśe halādau yadi bhavati kāranāmnyeva iti prathamo niyamaḥ, aprāgdeśāvartini tu tvacisārādāvakāranāmnyapi bhavatyeva | tathā kāranāmni halādau yadi bhavati pracāmeva iti dvitīyaḥ | prācāṃ kāranāmni ca yadi bhavati halādāveva iti tṛtīyaḥ | avīnāṃ samūho'vikaṭam, saṅghāte kaṭac | kathaṃ purekasminvākye niyamatrayaṃ labhyate kaḥ punarāha - ekamidaṃ vākyamiti āgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvena pratyekamevakāradhyāhārāt trīṇyeva vākyāni | saṃjñāgrahaṇena prakṛte'pi
nāmagrahaṇaṃ kriyate niyamārthatvaṃ vispaṣṭayitum anyathā'saṃjñāyāṃ vidhyarthatā'pi samābhāvyeta | kathaṃ purasaṃjñāyāṃ saptamīsamāsaḥ etadeva jñāpakaṃ syāt - pracāṃ kāre halādinottarapadenāsaṃjñāyāṃ saptamīsamāsaḥ etadeva jñāpakaṃ syat - pracāṃ kre halādinottarapadenāsaṃjñānāmapi bhavati samāsa iti | yasminvidhiḥ ityeva siddhe ādigrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham ||
amūrddhamastakāt svāṅgādakāme || 6 - 3 - 12 ||
udāharaṇeṣu pratyudārahaṇeṣu ca vyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ | akṣaśauṇḍa iti | saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ iti tatpuruṣaḥ ||
bandhe ca vibhāṣā || 6 - 3 - 13 ||
svāṅgāt itadi nivṛttm, sāmānyanāyaṃ vidhiḥ | bandhe iti dhāturevātra sahakāreṇā'nukṛtaḥ | nentsiddhabadhnādiṣu ca iti dhātāveva pratiṣedha uktaḥ, tataśca bahuvrīhirevāsya vikalpasya viṣayaḥ | tatrāpi hastabandhādau svāṅe praptavibhāṣā, cakrabandhādāvasvāṅge tvapraptavibhāṣetyubhayatravibhāṣā samāpadyate ttapuruṣe tu naivāsya pravṛttiḥ itīmāṃ śaṅkāmapanayati bandha iti ghañanto gṛhyata iti | tataśca tatpuruṣe'pi ghañantasya vṛttirviruddhā, pratiṣedhasya bandhanādau caritārthatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ubhayatra vibhāṣeyamiti | kathamityāha - svāṅgād bahuvrīhāviti | tatpuruṣe tviti | yadyapi bahuvrīhāvevāsvāṅgādaprāpta iti śakyaṃ vaktum, tathāpyasya tatpurṣe pravṛtti darśīyituṃ tatpuruṣe cāsya pravṛttiḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena anyathā bahuvrīhirasyāvakāśaḥ, badhnātipratiṣedhasya ca bandhanādiraṣakāśaḥ ghañante tu tatpuruṣe ubhayaprasaṅege paratvātpratiṣedha eva syāt ||
tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam || 6 - 3 - 14 ||
atrāpi kṛdantasya grahaṇ, na kṛnmātrasya, tatra parataḥ saptamyā asambhavat iha kasmānna bhavati - parame kārake paramakāraka iti ucyate - antaraṅgā kṛtpratipādyakriyānimittā saptamī, iha tu kriyāntaranimittāparame kārake nidhehīti, tena bahiraṅgatvānnāsyā grahaṇam |
kurucara iti | haladantāt ityadhikāramanāśrityaitadudādṛtam | vibhāṣāgrahaṇe prakṛte bahulagrahaṇaṃ kvacit prakṛtyādīnāmupasaṃgrahārtham | tena karṇejapādāvalugeva, madracarādau lugeva, brāhmaṇācchaṃsyādau asaptamyā apyaluk | evaṃ ca sarvamevālukprakaraṇamasyaiva prapañcaḥ ||
prāvṛṭ‌śaratkāladivāṃ je || 6 - 3 - 15 ||
prāvṛṭ‌śaradoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇātkāleti svarupagrahaṇam ||
ghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ || 6 - 3 - 17 ||
gha iti taraptamaporgrahaṇam| kāla iti svarupagrahaṇ, tana iti ṭyuṭyulorādeśasya satuṭ‌kasya grahaṇam |
pūrvāhṇetanamiti | saptamyarthaprakarṣe pratyaḥ, tasyādravyaprakarṣatvādalukpakṣe, kimettiṅavyayaghāt ityāmupratyayaḥ | lukpakṣe tu nimittābhāvādadravyaprakarṣe'pyāmabhāvaḥ | tarabantāt saptamī | kvacittu - alukpakṣe'pi saptamī samudāyātpaṭhyate, tatra prakṛtyarthavivakṣayā adravyaprakarṣe iti pratiṣedho vyākhyeyaḥ | pūrvahṇe iti | vibhāṣā pūrvahṇāparāhṇābhyām iti ṭyuṭyulau, anādeśāstuṭ ca |
kathaṃ punarghatanapratyayamātre'luk udāhṛtaḥ, yāvatā pratyayagrahakaṇavaribhāṣayā tadanta uttarapade'lugudārartavyaḥ ata āha - uttarapadādhikāra iti | kuta ityāha | lekhagrahaṇāditi | yadayam hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇalāseṣu ityaṇgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe lekhagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjhāpayati - nottarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirbhavatīti | yadi syāt, lekhagarhaṇaṃ na kuryāt aṇanta ityeva siddhatvāt | nanu ca ghañarthaṃ lekhagarhaṇaṃ syāt, na vai ghañanta iṣyate | kāleti na svarupagrahaṇamiti | nāmagrahaṇāt | kvacinnañ na paṭhyate, tatra ghakāle svarupagrahaṇamityarthaḥ ||
śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt || 6 - 3 - 18 ||
atrākāla ityarthagarhaṇ, vyākhyānāt | tadāhaakālavācina iti | khaśaya iti | adhikaraṇe śeteḥ ityac | vāsa iti | ghañ | grāmevāsīti | supyajātau ṇiniḥ |
apo yonītyādi | śabdapradhānatvādapa ityekavacanam, yoniḥ - utpattiḥ apsuyoniryasya so'msuyoniḥ | apsavya iti | orguṇaḥ, vānto yi pratyaye | apsumantāviti | saptamyantāntupo'sambhavādapsviti śabdo yayorasti tāvapsumantau kārīryāmājyabhāgau, tayorhi apsvagne sadhiṣṭavaḥ, apsu me somo abravīt, ityanuvākyayorapsuśabdo'sti | yadyevam, anukaraṇatvādasyavāmīyādivallugana bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ matubgrahaṇena anya tu matiśabdaṃ paṭhanti, udārahanti - atra somo vāpsumatiriti tattu bhāṣye na dṛṣṭam ||
nentsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca || tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam iti prāptaṃ pratiṣidhyate, saptamyāṃḥ parasyāḥ parasya kevalasyeno'sambhavāduttarapadādhikāre'pi pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirityāha - innanta uttarapada iti | sthaṇḍilavartīti | vrate iti ṇiniḥ | upapadasamāsaḥ | sāṅkāśayasiddha iti | siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca iti samāsaḥ | cārabaddha thaiti | baddhaśabdo niṣṭhāntaḥ | yogavibhāgāt samāsa iti | baddhaśabdena |

ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ || 6 - 3 - 23 ||
vidyā ca yoniśca vidyāyonī, abhyarhitatvādvidyāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ, tatkṛtaḥ sambandho yeṣāṃ te vidyāyonisambandhāḥ, kṛtaśabdo gamyamānatvānna prayujyate | pituḥputra iti | prakhyātātpiturutpanna ityarthaḥ |
vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ pūrvottarapadagrahaṇamiti | sūtre pañcamīnirdeśātpūrvapadānāmeva vidyāyonisambandhavāvitvaṃ labhyate, nottarapadānām atha saptamīnirdeśaḥ kriyate | uttarapadānāmeva labhyate, na pūrvapadānām | tasmādubhayeṣāmapi tadvācitve'yaṃ vidhiriti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | anyavṛttiparatvāccāsya teṣāṃ parasparavyatikare'pi bhavati - hotuḥ putraḥ, piturantevāsīti ||
ānaṅ‌ ṛto dvandve || 6 - 3 - 25 ||
atra yadyṛkārasya dvandve ānaṅ bhavatītyavaṃ vijñāyeta, pitṛpitāmahādapyāṅ syāt ṛtaḥ ityetaccānarthakaṃ prakṛtatvāt, tasmād dvandvaviśepaṇamṛta iti | jātau cedamekavacanamiti manyamāna āha - ṛkārāntānāmityādi| iha kāryārthaḥ śravaṇārtho vā varṇānāmupadeśaḥ, nakāraścāyaṃ na kvacit śrūyate sarvatra nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya iti nalopena bhavitavyam, kāryamapi cāsya na kiñcidupadiśyate, tasmānnārtha etena ityata āha - nakāroñcāraṇamityādi | asati nakāre uḥ sthāne'ṇeva śiṣyate iti uraṇ raparaḥ iti raparatvaṃ syāt, tasmiśca nyamaṇeva śiṣyate, kiṃ tarhi thaaṇ cānyacceti, nāsti raparatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādraparatvanivṛttyarthaṃ nakāroccāraṇam | ṅakāraḥ ṅicca ityantyādeśārthaḥ | yatra ca nirdiśyamānaṃ kāryiṇo viśeṣaṇam, tatra nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavantītyetadbhavati, nātra ṛtaḥ iti kāryiṇo viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam | putra ityatrānuvartata iti | putre'nyatarasyām ityataḥ | yadyatra putra thaiti vartate, vibhāṣā svasṛpatyoḥ ityatrānuvarteta, tataśca bhrātuṣputra ityādāvanākrośe'pi vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ evaṃ tarhi vyākhyānādatraiva sambadhyate, ata eva hyatretyuktam | evamapi putra uttarapade pūrvapadamātrasyānaṅ prapnoti, kāryiṇo'nirdeśāt, ṛtaḥ iti śrutasya dvandvaviśeṣamatvādata taāha - ṛta iti ceti | anuvartate ityuṣaṅgaḥ | ñatovidyāyoni ityataḥ ñataḥ ityanuvartate, tatkāryiṇaṃ viśeṣayiṣyatītyarthaḥ | yadyapi tat pañcamyantam, tathāpi tadiha vyākhyānātṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vipariṇamyate ||
devatādvandve ca || 6 - 3 - 26 ||
anṛkārantārthamavidyāyonisambandhārthaṃ vacanam| dvandva iti vartamāna ityādi | prakṛtaṃ dvandvagrahaṇaṃ
samāsaviśeṣapratipattyartham, idaṃ prasiddhaṃ sāhacaryaṃ yasya yugalasya tatparigrahartham | kathaṃ punarna parigrahaḥ taityata āha atyantasahacārata ityādi | dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādā ityatrābhivyaktigrahaṇenātyantasahacaritayugale dvandva iti nipātyate, tasyātra grahaṇaṃ devatāpadena, samastaṃ cedamprakṛtasya dvandvasyārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇam - atyantasahacaritayugalābhidhāyini dvandva iti yāvat | sāhacaryameva viśinaṣṭi - tatreti | sahavāpaḥ - sahanirvāpaḥ | agnīṣomābhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ityādi | ubhayatreti | pūrvapatvenottarapadatvenetyarthaḥ ||
id vṛddhau || 6 - 3 - 28 ||
atra vṛddhimaduttarapadaṃ vṛddhiśabdenocyate, vṛddhyātmakasyottarapadatyāsambhavāt | agnīvaruṇau devate asya, agnāmarutau devate asyoti vigrahaḥ, pūrvatretvam, uttaratrānaṅ | dvyadhiṣṭhānaṃ devatātvamiti | devatetyekavacanam | ānaṅamītvaṃ ca bādhitumiti | varuṇe hītvasya prasaṅgaḥ, anyatrānaṅaḥ | yadyapi prāg vṛddhevigrahavākya evānaṅītvayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ, tathāpyapavādaviṣayatvātprakriyāvākye na kriyete, laukike tu vākye bhavata eva |
