divasaśca pṛthivyām || 6 - 3 - 30 ||
divasaḥ iti prathamāntam | akāroccāraṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā prayojanābhāvātsakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati tatrāha - akārīñcāraṇamiti | asati tasmin pṛthivīśabde parataḥ sakārasya rutvam, visarjanīyaḥ, kupvoḥ - ka - pau ca ityete vikārāḥ prāpnuvanti, akāre sati sakārasyoccāraṇaṃ bhavati, tena prayoge'syāvikṛtasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavati |
kathamityādi | dvandve ityanuvṛttervākye naiva prāpnotīti praśnaḥ | kartavyī'tra yatna iti | chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ, dṛṣṭānuvidhaśchandasi ityeṣo'tra yatnaḥ |
uṣāsoṣasaḥ || 6 - 3 - 31 ||
uṣāsānakteti | chāndaso'yaṃ prayogaḥ | uṣāśca naktaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ, prathamādvivacanasya ḍādeśaḥ | atra padakāle padakāle padakārāḥ - uṣasānakteti hrasvamadhīyate ||
striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ samānādhikaraṇe striyāmapūraṇīpriyādiṣu || 6 - 3 - 34 ||
atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti - striyā iti srīpratyayagrahaṇam, arthagrahaṇam śabdagrahaṇaṃ ceti | tatra yadi srīgrahaṇaṃ svaryate, svaritenādikārāvagatirbhavatīti stryadhikāravihitāṣṭābādayo gṛhyanta, yathā - gosriyorupasarjanasya ityatra tadā cāyamartho bhavati - bhāṣitapuṃskātpare ṭābādisrīpratyayā yathā puṃsi na bhavanti tathā uttarapade na bhavantīti | nanvaśrutakriyāpadesu vākyeṣu bhavatītyadhyāhāro'nyatra dṛṣṭaḥ ucyate vatinirdeśeṣūpamāne sattā, asattā vā yā prasiddhā sopameye'tideśyā yathā - uśīnaravanmadreṣu yavāḥ santi, na santīti tataḥ puṃsi srīpratyayasyābhāvātsriyāmapyabhāvo'tidiśyata iti na bhaviṣyatityeva vākyaśeṣaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ, tadā tvanūṅityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sriyāḥ iti prathamārthe ṣaṣṭhī, puṃvaditi saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ | tatra ca prageva samāsādvigraddavākya eva srīpratyayasya kṛtatvānna tasyottarapade parataḥ na kroḍādibahvacaḥ itivat pragabhāvaḥ śakyaḥ pratipādayitumiti luk taddhitaluki ityādivatkṛtasya nivṛttireva pratipādyā | vigrahavākya eva kṛtāḥ srīpratyayā uttarapade parato nivartante, lupyanta ityarthaḥ |
yadā tu puṃvat srītvayuktaṃ dravyaṃ srīśabdenocyate, tadārthagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, sriyāḥ stryarthasya puṃsa iti pumarthasyevala kāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | tadā ca ṣaṣṭhīsamārthādvatiḥ | yadā tu stryarthavācī śabdaḥ srīśabdenocyate tadā śabdagrahaṇam, sriyāḥ - srīliṅgasya śabdasya puṃvad rupaṃ bhavatīti rupatideśaḥ, vṛttiviṣaye puṃśabdasambandhinaḥ kāryasyātideṣṭavyasyābhāvāt | tatra ca prattyāsatteḥ puṃbhāvabhājaḥ srīśabdasya prayogāntare pumāṃsamācakṣāṇasya yadrūpaṃ tadevātidiśyate, na yasya kasyacit |
anūṅ iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā, tatrārthagrahaṇe srīśabde mukhyaḥ | arthasya tūttarapadena paurvāparyamanūṅaḥ, tattvaṃ ca svato'nupannamiti śabdadvārakamāśrayaṇīyam | itrayostu pakṣayoḥ strīśabdo gauṇaḥ | paurvāparyādikaṃ tu samañcasamiti na pramāṇataḥ pakṣaviśeṣaparigrahaḥ sambhavatīti nirdoṣataḥ pakṣaḥ parigrahyaḥ |
tatrādye pakṣe etabhārya ityetaśabdād varṇādanudāttāt iti ṅīpi takārasya ca nakāre ekadeśāvikṛtasyānanyatvādetaśabdādbhāṣitapuṃskātpara īkāra iti tannivṛttāvapyarthasya strītvamanivṛttamiti nakāraḥ śrūyeta | na ca sanniyogaśiṣṭatvādīkāranivṛttau nakārasya nivattiḥ, uttarapadanimittāyāḥ strīpratyayanivṛtternakāranivṛttyākhye pūrvavidhau sthānikadbhāve satyanyatarābhāvasyāsiddheḥ | na ca nakārasyāpi adikāravihitatvādikāravatpuṃvadbhāvenaiva nivṛttiḥ tasya bhāṣitapuṃskātparatvābhāvāt, apratyayatvenoṅ‌sādṛśyābhāvācca | tathā paṭh‌vī bhāryāsya paṭuvī bhāryāsya paṭubhārya iti nivṛttasyāpi srīpratyayasya sthānivadbhāvādyaṇādeśaḥ syāt |
atha tūttarapade parato'nūṅ strīpratyayo bhāṣitapuṃskānna bhavatīti na kroḍādibahṇacaḥ itivat prāgabhāva evātra vidheyaḥ tatsāmarthyācca vigrahavākya taeva prāpto'ntāraṅgo'pi strīpratyayo na kriyate ityucyeta tadaitaddoṣābhāve'pi lugalugastrīviṣayadvistrīpratyayeṣu doṣaḥ | luk - vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī vataṇ‍ḍācca luk striyām, śārṅgaravādipāṭhānṅīn, vataṇḍī cāsauvṛndārikā ca vātaṇḍyavṛndāriketi puṃvat karmadhāraya iti ikārasya nivṛttāvapi arthagatasya strītvasyānivṛttatvāt luk striyamā iti yaño lukprāpnoti | syādetat - strī - ī strīti īkārapraśleṣeṇa striyāṃ ya īkārastatra parato lopaḥ, atra tu puṃvadbhāvenekārasyānutpannatvālluṅ na bhaviṣyatīti tanna, itretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt | katham śārṅgaravādiṣu vataṇḍaśabdaḥ kṛtayañluk paṭhyate, tataścākṛte luki īkāro nāsti, akṛte cekāre luko'prasaṅgaḥ | aluk - gargasyāpatyaṃ striyaḥ, gargādibhyo yañ yañaśca iti ṅīp , gārgyaśca tā vṛndārikāśta gargavṛndārikā iti ṅīpi nivṛtte'pi strītvasyānivṛttatvād yañañośca striyāmiti lugna prāpnoti, vākyavadalugeva syāt | astrīviṣayaḥ - kuñjasyāpatyaṃ strī gotre kuñjādibhyaścaphañ, gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha iti jātitvān ṅīṣ, kauñjāyanī cāsau vṛndārikā ca kauñjāyanavṛndārikāḥ ṅīṣi nivṛtte'pi strītvasyānivṛtteḥ vrātacphañorastriyām ityastrīviṣayo na syāt | dvistrīpratyayaḥ - gargasyāpatyaṃ strī gargādibhyo yañ, prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ, ṣillakṣaṇo ṅīṣ, gārgyāyaṇī cāsau vṛndārikā ca gārgyavṛndāriketyādau yatra dvau strīpratyayau tatra yo bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ ṣpho nāsāvuttarapade, ṅīṣā vyāvadhānāt| yaścottarapade ṅīṣ nāsau bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ, ṣpheṇa vyavadhānāt, tasya ca striyāmeva vihitatvāt iti puṃvadbhāva eva na syāt | tathā iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ strī janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ darado'patyaṃ strī dvyañmagadha ityaṇ, tayoḥ ataśca iti luk - iḍavḷḍadarat, sa cāsau vṛndārikā ca aiḍavḷvṛndārikā - atra puṃvadbhāvo na syāt adhikāravihitasya kasyacitpratyasyābhāvāt |
dvitīye tu pakṣe'rthasya pumarthatve'tidiṣṭe tadvācī śabdaḥ pravartata iti naite doṣāḥ, kintu khityanavyayasya iti hrasvatvasyāsya puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho nopapadyate bhannaviṣayatvāt | aco hrasvatvamarthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, tataḥ kālimmanyetyatra vipratiṣedhe param itihrasvatvamiṣṭam, tanna prapnoti | śabdapakṣe tu dvayorapyekaviṣayatvādvipratiṣedho'sti, puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ, yatra khidantaṃ nāsti - darghanīyabhāryaḥ, hrasvatvasyāvakāraśo yatra puṃvadbhāvo nāsti - kālimmanyaḥ pumāniti kālimmanyā strītyatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvād hrasvatvaṃ bhavati | na ca kṛte'pi hrasvatve punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātpuṃvadbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, sakṛd‌gatinyāyasyāśrayaṇāt | na cārthapakṣe'pyasatyapyekaviṣayatve'sambhavādvipratiṣedhaḥ, asambhavādityasyaivāsiddheḥ | yadyapi hi puṃvadbhāve sati strīpratyayasya nivṛttau dīrghāntatvābhāvād hrasvasyāpravṛttiḥ, tathāpi hrasve pravṛtte'pyarthasyānivṛttatvātpuṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnotyeva |
tadevamādyayorduṣṭatvāttṛtīyaṃ pakṣmāśrityāha - bhāṣitaḥ pumānyenetyādi | bhāṣitaḥ pumānyena śabdeneti śabde'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhirāśrīyate, tataḥ striyāṃ puṃsi ca vartamānasya yasya pravṛttinimittaṃ bhidyate, tasyāpi prāpnoti - droṇībhāryaḥ, pātrībhārya iti | droṇaśabdaḥ parimāṇe puṃlliṅgaḥ, pātraśabdo'rddharcāditvātparimāṇe puṃlliṅgaḥ, bhājanaviśeṣe tu strīliṅgaḥ, sarvatrāpyatra pravṛttinimittabhede'pi ya eva prayogāntare pumāṃsamākhyat, sa eva samprati striyāṃ vartata iti syādeva puṃvadbhāva iti matvā viśinaṣṭi - samānāyāmākṛtāviti | bhāṣyagrahantho'yam, ato vyācaṣṭe - ekasminpravṛttinimitta iti | sa bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ
śabdaḥ, ayaṃ tāvadartho vivakṣita ityarthaḥ | yathā punarayamarthaḥ sūtrākṣaraireva labhyate, tathā pṛcchati - tadetadevamityādi | tadetadartharupam evamprakāraṃ kathaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇe'nyapadārthe saptamyarthe bahuvrīhirityuttaram | etaduktaṃ bhavati - yasminpiravṛttinimitte pumān bhāṣitaḥ pumāsamācakṣāṇasya yatpravṛttinimittaṃ tena yuktaṃ stryarthamāckṣāṇo bhāṣitapuṃska iti |
nanvevamapi droṇībhārya ityādau doṣaḥ syadeva, katham yasyāṃ gavādanyāṃ droṇīśabdo vartate, so'pi yadā artha ityucyate tadā bhāṣitapuṃskena pravṛttinimittena yujyate, tatra cārthaṃ śabdapravṛttinimittamapyarthyamānatvād gavādanyāṃ sannihitamiti tatra vartamāno drotathaṇīśabdaḥ svayaṃ tatpravṛttinimittamanabhidadhāno'pi vastutastadyuktamarthamāha naitadasti, evaṃ hi bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt sarvatra sulabhatvāt | ato yaḥ śabdo bhāṣitapuṃsakena pravṛttinimittena yuktaṃ svārthaṃ tenaiva rupeṇāha, na rupāntareṇa, sa bhāṣitapuṃsko gṛhyate | droṇīśabdastu droṇītvajātiyuktena rupeṇa gavādanyāṃ vartate, nārthyamānatayā |
evamapi dyaurbhāryā yasya dyubhārya ityatra divyaśabdasya strīliṅsya svarga iti puṃlliṅgaḥ prāpnoti, yenaiva rupeṇa svargaśabdenocyate, tenaiva rupeṇa divśabdenāpīti kṛtvā evaṃ tarhi prattyāsatteryaṃsya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tenaiva yatra pumān bhāṣita iti vijñāyate, ātmanaḥ prayogāntare pumāṃsamācakṣāṇasya yatpravṛttinimittaṃ tadyuktaṃ stryartham, sampratyācakṣāṇasya strīśabdasya pumbhāṣaṇadaśāyāṃ yadrū paṃ tadevādyāpi bhāvatītyarthaḥ | ātideśikabhedācca puṃvaditi vatinirdeśaḥ |
anūṅiti paryudāse sati nañivayuktanyāyena ūṅ‌sadṛśasya ṭābādergrahaṇādaiḍaviḍavṛndāriketyādau strīpratyayābhāvānna syāditi prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ darśayati - ūṅo'bhāvo'nūṅiti | bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅiti | yadyayamasamāsaḥ syāt - anūṅiti, tadā prathamā syāt, luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ vā | ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'yamartho bhavati - bhāṣitapuṃskātparasya strīśabdasyeva rupaṃ bhavati, ūṅantasya tu neti | tataśca puṃvadbhāvabhājaḥ strīśabdasya bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ iha ca prasajyeta - aṅgārakā nāma śakunayaḥ teṣāṃ kālikāḥ striyaḥ tata etāḥ kālikāvṛndārikā iti | etacchabdādbhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ kālikāśabda iti tasya strīviṣayasyāpyaṅgārakaśabdatā syāt| śakyante hi tāḥ sāhacaryādaṅgārakaśabdenābhidhātum | tathā aśvasya vaḍavā, puruṣasya yoṣit, haṃsasya varaṭā, kacchapasya ḍulītyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ | darśanīyabhārya ityādau ca na syāt, na hyatra darśanīyaśabdo bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ | prathamāyāṃ tu bhāṣitapuṃskādityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyātstriyā iti pañcamī ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kasyacidarthasyāsambhavāt | tataśca bhāṣitapuṃskāt strīliṅgātpara ūṅo'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ puṃvadityartho bhavati, tatra sa eva doṣo yaḥ prathamapakṣe | tadevaṃ samāse deṣaprasaṅgādvyadhikāraṇapado bahuvrīhirāśrayaṇīya ityāha - bhāṣitapuskādanūṅityādi | ālukca nipātanātpañcamyā iti | alaukikatvādasya nipātanādityaparihāraḥ | lugapi tarhi na prāpnoti alaukikatvādeveti yatkiñcadetat | anūṅ‌ iiti ṣaṣṭhyarathe prathamā, tadāyamarthe'vasthitaḥ - bhāṣitapuskātsvasmādūṅo'bhāvo yasmin | ko'rthaḥ yasmin strīśabde bhāṣipuṃskātpara uṅ‌na kṛta ityartha taiti | apara āha - bhāṣitapuṃskāditi ṣaṣṭhyarthe pañcamī, sarvamanyatpūrvavat | bhāṣitapuṃskasya strīśabdasya puṃśabdasyeva rupaṃ bhavati,
ūṅantasya tu neti |
nanvevamāśrīyamāṇe yatra bhāṣitapuskasyaivānantaramuttarapadaṃ tatraiva syāt darśanīyabāya ityādau, atra hi bhāṣitapuṃskasya darśanīyaśabdasya ṭāpaścaikādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvādbhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇena gṛhyate, gārgī cāsau vṛndārikā ca gārgyavṛndāriketyādau na syāt, yo'tra bhāṣitapuṃsko gārgyaśabdo na tasyānantaramuttarapadam ṅīpā vyavadhānāt | yasya cānantaraṃ gārgīśabdasya nāsau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ syādetadevam, prayogāntare bhāṣitapuṃskasya samprati striyāṃ vartamānasya puṃvadbhāva ucyeta | striyāṃ vartamānasya tadaiva bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāvaṃ brūmaḥ, sambhavati ca strīyāṃ vartamānasya tadaiva bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ bhāṣitapuṃskena pravṛttinimittena yuktāṃ striyamāheti kṛtvā | evaṃ ca strīśabdasyaivāntara uttarapade puṃvadbhāva iti sarvatra sidhyati |
grāmaṇi dṛṣṭirasyeti | atra grāmaṇiśabdo'parityaktasvaliṅga taeva dṛṣṭiśabdena samānādhikaraṇo bhavati
| atra yadi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syānnapuṃsakahrasvatvaṃ nivartetaḥ
kathamityādi | anavayavabhūtagarbhasambandhaḥ striyāṃ garbhiṇīśabdasya pravṛttinimittam, puṃsi tvavayavabhūtagarbhasambandhaḥ | prasūta - prajātaśabdayorapi striyāṃ garbhamocananimittama, puṃsitugarbhādhānam | kartavyo'tra yatna iti | antarvartivastusambandhamātraṃ garbhiṇīśabdasya pravṛttinimittamavayavatvānavayavatvena tantram | evaṃ prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapi ādhānavimocanatyāgenāpatyasambandhamātraṃ nimittamāśrīyata ityayamatra yatnaḥ |
brahmabandhūbhārya iti | ūṅo nivṛttirna bhavati | na kopadhāyāḥ ityatraivoṅ‌grahaṇe kartavye pṛthakpratiṣedhādasya vailatraṇyaṃ jñayate | tena brahmabandhūvṛndariketi puṃvatkarmadhāraya iti niṣedhavipaye vidhīyamāno'pi puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati | eṣa cārtho'nūṅityasya tatrānuvṛtterlabhyate | apūraṇīpriyādiṣvityayaṃ tu pratiṣedhastatraiva kartavyaḥ, na hyasya puṃvatkarmadhāraya ityatrānuvṛttiriṣyate mahānavamī, mahādvādaśī, akṣayatṛtīyā, kṛṣṇacaturdasītyādau pūraṇyāmapi karmadhāraye puṃvadbhāvasyeṣṭatvāt |
pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti | pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī tasyāmeva pratiṣedho bhavatīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | evacca pradhāne kāryasampratyayāllabhyate | kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣa iti | atra tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ pakṣo'nyapadārtha iti tatra pūraṇyā ananupraveśānnāsti prādhānyam, kalyāṇapañcamā rātraya ityādāvud‌bhūtāvayavabhedā rātramo'nyapadārthaḥ, tatra yathā rātrayaḥ samāsābhidheyā, evaṃ pañcamyapīti pūraṇyāḥ prādhānyam |
atha dṛḍhabhaktiḥ, śobhanabhaktirityatra kathaṃ puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā priyādiṣu bhaktiśabdaḥ paṭhyate ata āha - dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādiṣviti | strīvācitvaṃ pūrvapadasyāvivakṣitam, ato dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādisiddhirityevaṃ codyasamādhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ | dṛḍhaśabdo'tra dārḍhyanivṛttiparaḥ, tatra dārḍhyanivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ strīliṅgopādānamakiñcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ | na caivaṃ sūtrasyānādaraṇīyatvam, liṅgaviśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ darśanīyabhārya ityādyaniṣṭaprasaṅgāt | atheha kathaṃ bhavitavyam - paṭ‌vīmṛdvyau bhārye asyeti, paṭ‌vīmṛdubhārya iti bhavitavyam yasyottarapadamanantaraṃ tasya puṃvadbhāvo netarasyeti ||
tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ || 6 - 3 - 35 ||
anuttarapadārthamāsambhaḥ | tatastatreti | prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ iti vibhaktitvāttyadādyatvam, ṭāp, anena puṃvadbhāvaḥ |
iha kecittasilādiṣu paṭhyante, yeṣu puṃvadbhāvo neṣyate, keciccānyatra paṭhyante, yeṣu puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, tasmādāha - parigaṇanamiti | tratasorudāhṛtam | taraptamapo darśanīyatarā, darśanīyatamā | caraṭ‌jātīyaroḥ paṭucarī, paṭujītīyā | kalpadeśīyaroḥ - darśanīyakalpā, darśanīyadeśīyā | deśyapratyayasya nāsti pāṭhaḥ | rupappāśapoḥ darśanīyarupā, paṭupāśā | thamthāloḥ - idamasthamuḥ, kimaśca iti vihitasthamuḥ, prakāravacane thāl anayā prakṛtyā ittham, kayā prakṛtyā katham, tayā tathā | dārhiloḥ - tasyāṃ velāyāṃ tadā, tarhi | tilthyanoḥ - vṛkajyeṣṭābhyāṃ tiltātilau cacchandasi, vṛkī praśastā vṛkatiḥ | tātilo nāsiti pāṭhaḥ | ajāvibhyāṃ thyan ajāyai hitā ajathyā | atra gharupakalpeṣu ṅyantasya paratvāt hrasvaḥ - paṭivatamā, paṭivakalpā, paṭivarupā |
śasi bahūlpārthasyeti | bah‌valpārthāt ityayamapi śas tasilādiṣu draṣṭavya ityarthaḥ |
ṅāstikamiti | yadyatra puṃvadbhāvo na syat, tadā hastinīśabdasya yastetilope kṛte tasya sthānivattvād asiddhavadatrābhāt ityasiddhatvācca nastaddhite iti ṭilopo na syāditi puṃbadbhāvo vidhīyate | ṭhakchasośca ityenana puṃpadbhāvo na labhyate chasā sahacaritasya ṭhako grahaṇāt | śyaineyaḥ, rohiṇeya iti | śyetarohitābhyām varṇādanudāttāt iti | ṅībnakārau | atra puṃvadbhāve sati - śyaiteyaḥ, rauhiteya iti syāt |
kathamityādi | yadi ḍhe puṃvadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate, tato'gneḥ srī vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusidānāmudāttaḥ iti agniśabdān ṅīpi kṛte aikāre āyādeśe ca agnāyī, sa devatāsya agnerḍhak iti, sarvatrāgnikalibhyāṃ ḍhak iti ḍhaki puṃvadbhāvanipedhādāgnāyeya iti prāpnoti, tatkathamāgneya iti kartavyo'tra yatna iti | kecidāhuḥ - aḍhe ityapanīyānapatya iti vaktavyam | idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati - kuṇḍinyā apatyamiti gargādibhyo yañ, tatra puṃvadbhāvābhāvādyasyeti lope tasya sthānivadbhāvāt nastaddhite ityasati ṭilope kauṇḍinya iti bhavati,
puṃvadbhāve tu sati kauṇḍya iti prāpnoti | tathā sapatnyā apatyaṃ śivāditvādaṇ, tatra puṃvadbhāvābhāvāt sāpatna iti bhavati, puṃvadbhāve tu sati nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu iti vihitayorṅībnakārayonivṛttayoḥ sāpata iti syāt | tadevam, anapatye iti vacanād ḍhe'pyanapatye puṃvadbhavati sa āgneya iti | apatye tu na bhavati - śyaineyaḥ, rauhiṇeya iti | yadyanapatya ityucyate, gargasyāpatyaṃ strī gārgyāyaṇī, tasyā apatyam gotrasriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca iti ṇapratyaye kṛte puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti, tataśca gārgyayaṇo jālma iti syāt, gārgyo jālma iti ceṣyate, tasmādanapatya iti na śakyaṃ vaktum| kathaṃ kauṇḍinyaḥ āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ iti nipātanāt siddham | kathaṃ sāpatnaḥ śatruparyāyaḥ sapatnaśabdo'stiḥ vyansapatne iti liṅgāt | sa śārṅgaravādiṣu paṭhitavyaḥ, tataḥ śivādyaṇ, tasmāt strībhyoḍhak ityatraiva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedha iti vyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam |
ṭhak‌chasoriti | chasaḥ sittvāt siti ca iti padasaṃjñāvidhānādbhatvābhāvād vacanam, ṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, ikādeśe kṛte bhasyāḍhe ityeva siddhe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva yathā syāt kimevaṃ sati bhavati isusuktāntātkaḥ iti kādeśāḥ siddho bhavati anyathā yadīkādeśe kṛte puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, tato yathā māthitika ityatrekādeśe kṛte kādeśo na bhavati, evaṃ bhāvatka ityatrāpi na syāt ||

na kopadhāyā || 6 - 3 - 37 ||

saṃjñāśabdā ye dānādikriyānibhittāḥ puṃsi ca striyāṃ ca loke prayujyante tadarthaḥ saṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ | ye tvekadravyanimittā deśanimittā vā saṃjñāśabdāstatrābhāṣitapuṃskatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ | dattāyate, guptāyate iti | atra yadyapi satyasati vā pratiṣedhe viṣeṣābhāvaḥ, tathāpi vastutaḥ pratiṣedhasyaca viṣaya ityetāvatā'syopanyāsaḥ ||
vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre || 6 - 3 - 39 ||
vṛddhenimittaṃ ṇakāraḥ | iha nimittagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, vṛddhestaddhitasya ityeva vaktavyam - vṛddheryastaddhitaḥ, kaśca vṛddhestaddhitaḥ yastasyā nimittamevaṃ siddhe nimittagrahaṇādvyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhiḥ | apara āha - ṣaṣṭhīsamāsādarśaādyacpratyaya iti | yadvā - nimittagrahaṇādvahuvacanāntasya samāsaḥ vṛddhīnāṃ tisṛṇāmapi nimittaṃ vṛddhinimittamiti | vatustvākārasyaiva nimittam | iha tu sarvasmai hitā sārvā sā bhāryā yasya sa sārvabhārya iti yadyapi sarvapuruṣābhyām iti ṇapratyaye ākāra eva vṛddhirbhavati, tathāpi nāsau svarupeṇa vṛddhernimittam, kiṃ tarhi ṇittvena | tacca tisṛṇāmapi nimittam |

nanu karmadhāraye striyāḥ puṃvat ityādinā siddhaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ jātīyadeśīyayorapi tasilādiṣviti, kimartho'yamārambhaḥ ityata āha - pratiṣiddhārtho'yamiti | pratiṣiddho'pi puṃvadbhāvo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | pratiṣedhārtho'yamiti pāṭhe pratiṣedhāviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ | nivṛttivacano vārthaśabdaḥ |
kukkuṭyādīnāmityādi | astryarthemasamānādhikaraṇārthaṃ vacanam | na vetyādi | upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe | na vā vaktavyam, kiṃ kāraṇam strīpūrvapadasyāvivakṣitatvāt | nātra strītvāvasāyaḥ ārabhyamāṇe'pi puṃvadbhāve samāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anārambha'pi tathā bhaviṣyati | yadi tarhi strīliṅgena samāso na bhaviṣyati | yadyapi tāvadatraitacchakyate vaktum, iha tu kathaṃ mṛgyā kṣīraṃ mṛgakṣīramiti, nahi puṃsaḥ kṣīreṇa sambandho'sti atrāpi jātyantaranivṛttiparatvāccodanāyāḥ strītvamākiñcitkaratvādavivakṣitam | yatra tu liṅga, viśeṣa upakārakastatrāsau vivakṣita eva yathā - aḍāmūtreṇa paryukṣitaṃ dātavyamiti | pūrvapadārtho'tra jātiriti | kukkuṭāṇḍājau pūrvapadārtho jātiḥ sa ca samāmānyena strītvādiviśeṣarahitena rupeṇa vivakṣita ityarthaḥ |
khid‌ghādiṣviti | tatra khiti vipratiṣedhaḥ striyāḥ puṃvat ityatraivodāhṛtaḥ | ghādiṣu nadyā hrasvo bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ - nartakitarā, nartakitamā, nartakirupā, nartakikalpā, yatra puṃvadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate na kopadhāyāḥ iti - tasilādiṣviti | puṃdbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ yad ṅyantaṃ na bhavati - darśanīyataretyādi | paṭvitaretyādāvubhayaprasaṅge vipratiṣedhaḥ | ke'ṇo hrasvo bhavatītyāvakāśaḥ - nartakikā, puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāraḥ - darado'patyaṃ strī, dvyañmagadha ityaṇ, tasya ataśca luk, tataḥ prāgivātkaḥ, tasilādiṣviti puṃvadbhāvāddāradaśabdaḥ, pratyayasthāt itītvaṃ dāridikā | nanu ca parigaṇitāstasilādayaḥ na ca kapratyayasteṣu samasti evaṃ tarhi vipratiṣedhādeva kapratyayo'pi tatrābhyupagamyata iti anumīyate, paṭ‌vikā mṛṭ‌viketyādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvād hrasvaḥ, sarvatra cātra sakṛdityāśrayaṇād puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ |

suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ khadirāṅgāravarṇe kuṇḍale bhavati iti | tathā klṛpi sampadyamāne caturthī vaktavyā iti sampadyakartari vidhīyamānā caturthī vikārādbhavati - mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti, na prakṛteḥ | tathā asaṅgho brāhmaṇasaṅgho bhavati, apaṭastantavaḥ paṭo bhavatīti vikārāśrayaṃ vacanaṃ dṛśyate tatra yadi vikṛteḥ kartṛtvamāśritya sāmānādhikaraṇyāśrayaḥ puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyeta, āttvamapi syāt | atha prakṛteḥ kartṛtvādvaiyadhikaraṇyādāttvaṃ na syāt, puṃvadbhāvo'pi na syāt ucyate, darśitaṃ tāvadidaṃ yathā cviviṣaye dvayorapi prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ kartṛtvamiti | yuktaṃ caitat, yadi vikṛteḥ kartṛtvamāśritya pratyayaḥ | yadā caiko'rthaḥ prakṛtivikārātmaka āśrīyate, tadā pariṇāmavyavahāraḥ | uktaṃ ca - jahaddharmāntaraṃ pūrvamupādtte yadā param | tattvādapracyuto dhamī pariṇāma saḥ ucyate || iti | yadā tvanyataravyavasthā na vivakṣyate, tadā cvarabhāvaḥ - tantavo bhavanti, paṭo bhavatīti, tajña yo'yaṃ pūrvakaṃ dharmaṃ jahaduttaraṃ copādadatsammṛchito'rthaḥ sañjāyamānaḥ sampadyakarteti cocyate, tadabhedācca pūrvottarāvasthayorapi kartṛtvam, ata etadapi nirastam| asatyā uttarāvasthāyā utpattau śaśaviṣāṇamapyutpadyeta, satyāśca pūrvavasthāyā utpattau sarva eva paṭādayaḥ sarvadotpadyamānā eva bhaveyuriti | kathaṃ nirastam kiṃ sadutpadyataṃ, kiñcāsat pūrvottarayoravasthayoranuvartamānaṃ vastu tasmānna bhinnena nāpyabhinnena kenacidrūpeṇotpadyate, yathā - tadevaṃ sati cvyarthe vākye kvacitprakṛtereva kartṛtvam, cvyantasya gatitvād, gatīnāṃ ca kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādanyaddhi bhanam, anyaddhi saṅghībhavanam tatra kevale bhavane saṅghaḥ kartā, saṅghībhavane tu brāhmaṇaḥ | yathā - vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karotīti satraṃ tadviśeṣaṇam, vyākaraṇaṃ satrayatītyatra viśiṣṭakarotervyākaraṇaṃ karma tadvadatrāpi | tatra maddadbhataścandramā iti cvyanto'yaṃ mahacchabdau bhūtaśabdasya pravṛttinimitte bhavane paryavasyati | bhūtaśabdastu mahattvenāsaṃspṛṣṭaścandramāḥ svarupe vartata iti vaiyadhikaraṇyādāttvābhāvaḥ | mahadbhūtā brāhmaṇītyatra tu mṛgakṣīrādivatstrīpūrvapadasyāvivakṣitatvātsiddham | yatra tu strītvaṃ vivakṣitam, na bhavatyeva tatra puṃvadbhāvaḥ -- agaumatī gomatī sampanna gomatībhūtā brāhmaṇīti |

rephe akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | yadyayaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ syāt, tadāṇaḥ pūrvatvaṃ nopapadyate, lopasyābhāvarupatvāt | athāpi buddhiparikalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśrīyate evamapi karaṇīyamityādāvapyanīyaro rephasya lope parataḥ pūrvasya dīrghaprasaṅga iti tatpuruṣe evaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaṇṭhekālavadvyadhikaraṇapado bahuvrīhirityāha - ḍhakārarephayorlopo yasminniti | atra liṅgam - bhavyageyapravacanīya iti nirdeśaḥ | līḍhamiti | liha āsvādane, niṣṭhā, ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopeṣu rupam, miha secane, guha saṃvaraṇe, muha naicittye | pūrvagrahaṇamanarthakam, tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya iti siddheḥ ityata āha - pūrvagrahaṇamityādi | sati pūrvagrahaṇe yadyapi ḍhalope vacanaprāmāṇyādanuttarapade'pi syāt, ralope tvanuttarapade na syāt nīraktamityādābuttarapadasyāpi sambhāvta | ātṛḍhamiti | tṛhūhiṃsāyām yasya vibhāṣā itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ | kvacidādṛḍhamiti pāṭhaḥ, tadasat ,seṭ‌tvādasya dhātoḥ dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ iti halopo nipātyate | āvṛḍhamiti vṛhū udyamane ||

dā ityetasyādi | atra takārādiśabdaḥ karmadhārayaḥ | tasminparata iti | yasminvidhistadādau iti vacanāttadādāvuttarapade parata ityarthaḥ | dā ityetasya sambandhī yastakārastadādāvuttarapade dīrgha ityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ | nīttamiti | nanu cātra takāra ādirna bhavati, yastāvad aca upasargāttaḥ iti takāraḥ sa alo'ntyasya ityantasya kriyate, yo'pi dakārasya khari ca iti takāraḥ, so'pyasmindīrghe kartavye'siddhaḥ ata āha - aca upasargātta ityādi | ucyate cedaṃ takārādāvuttarapada taiti | yadi cartvamasiddhaṃ syād, dīrghavidhiranarthakaḥ syāt, ata āśrayātsiddhaṃ cartvam | tena takāra ādiruttarapadasya sambhavatītyarthaḥ | yadyapīti | anenaitaddarśayati - dvitakārapakṣasyāśrayaṇe na kiñcidvaktavyamiti | sudattamiti ||

niṣātasya ca || 6 - 3 - 136 ||
evaśabdaścādiṣu pāṭhānnipātaḥ, accha gatyarthavadeṣu ityacchaśabdaḥ ||
anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate || 6 - 3 - 137 ||
mantre iti nivṛttam| keśākeśīti | tatra tenedam ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, ic karmavyatihāre | jalāṣāḍiti | chandasi sahaḥ iti ṇviḥ, saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ iti ṣatvam | pūruṣa iti | puruṣaśabdasyādyaco dīrghaḥ |
sunodantetyādi | tatra śvādaṃṣṭ‌ iti bahuvrīhiḥ | anyatra tatpuruṣaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā | daṃṣṭreti hrasvāntasya grahaṇāddīrghante nāyaṃ dīrgho bhavatītyāhuḥ | anye tu dīrghāntameva paṭhanto'viśeṣeṇecchanti ||
cau || 6 - 3 - 137 ||
añcatirgṛhyata iti | cavargasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati vyākhyānāt | daghīca iti | nanu cāntaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśenaiva prāgbhavitavyam, akāralopo bhasya vidhīyate, bhasaṃjñā ca yakārādāvajādau ca sambhavatīti bahiraṅgaḥ, dīrghatvaṃ tu lopamapekṣata iti bahiraṅgam ata āha - antaraṅago'pīti | evaṃ manyate - iha dīrghaśrutyā acaśca ityupatiṣṭhate, tatrācā pūrvapadaṃ viśeṣyate - ajantasya pūrvapadasyeti | yadi ca yaṇaādeśaḥ syānna kvāpyajantapūrvapadaṃ syāt | prāca ityādāvapi pūrvameva savarṇadīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmādantaraṅgo'pi vidhirbādhyata iti | atra ca liṅgaṃ pratīca iti nirdeśaḥ ||
samprasāraṇasya || 6 - 3 - 139 ||
akṛta evetyādi | kārīṣagandhiputra iti sthite hrasvatvaṃ ca prāpnoti, anena dīrghatvaṃ ca tasyāvakāśaḥ - grāmaṇi kulam, hrasvābhāvapakṣe dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ, pakṣāntare ubhayaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyapi hrasvābhāvapakṣe sāvakāśaṃ dīrghatvam, tathāpi tena paratvād hrasvo bādhyate |
athedānīṃ dīrghe kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgaḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānaṃ ceti |
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ṣaṣṭhasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
<6.4>
atha ṣaṣṭhādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
aṅgasya || 6 - 4 - 1 ||
adhikāro'yamiti | svaritatvāt | iha kecinmanyante - prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'yamaṅgādhikāraḥ | evaṃ hi guṇo yaṅa‌lukoḥ ityatra lugprahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, katham pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva siddham | yadi tvabhyāsavikāre'pyayamadhikāraḥ syāt, tato'ṅgādhikāravihitamiti na lumatāṅgasya iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi | vṛttikārastu manyate - yadi prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ, vavraśceti vṛścaterliṭi liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām iti rephasya samprasāraṇe uradatve halādiśerṣe ca kṛte vakārasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasya na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam iti pratiṣedha iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti uradatvasyāsamprasāraṇatvāt | na ca tasya sthānivattvam, aparanimittatvāt | ā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ punaraṅgādhikāre satyuradatvaṃ parinimittakaṃ bhavati, aṅgena svanimittasya pratyayasyākṣepāt | yadaṣyuktam - luggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatīti, tadapi na na hi tatrāṅgādhikāravihitasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ, kasya tarhi lumatā lupte pratyaye vastuto yadaṅgaṃ tasya pāraptaṃ yatkāryamāṅgamanāṅga vā tasya sarvasya pratiṣedhaḥ | tasmādāsaptamādhyāyaparisamāpterayamaṅgādhikāro yukta iti | hūta ityādau yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam | jīna iti | grahijyā iti sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam, lvādibhyaḥ iti niṣṭhānatvam |
nirutam, turutamiti | gheñ tantusantāne, yajādiḥ, atrāṅge'nantarbhūtayornirduroravayavau yau halau tadāśrayaṃ dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | krimiṇāmiti | krimipāmanśabdābhyāṃ matvarthe pāmādibhyo naḥ, pāmano nalopaḥ, striyāṃ ṭāp, dvitīyaikavacanam | atra nāmiti samudāyasyāpratyayatvānna tadapekṣaṃ pūrvasyāṅgatvamiti napratyayāpekṣayā'ṅgatve'pi dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati, pāmanāmityatra nalope kṛte'jantatvād dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca nalopasyāsiddhatvam, asubvidhitvāt | na hyasyāṃ daśāyāṃ dīrghatvaṃ subvidhirbhavati | astu vā'siddhatvam, nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
bhismā - odanaḥ bhissadā- didhi | nanu krimiṇāmityatra pratyayasyārthavattve'pi samudāyo'narthakaḥ, parasparāsambandhāt, evaṃ bhissābhissadayorbhisśabdaḥ, tataśca arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya ityeva na bhaviṣyati tatrāha - aṅgā dhikāra ityādi | sansamprasāraṇadīrghatvaitvatātaṅiyaṅavaṅanuṭhrasvatvatve cāṅgasyetyadhikāre prayojanam | sani dīrghaḥ prayojanam - dadhi sanotīti dadhisetyatra mā bhūt | samprasāraṇadīrghatvam - nirutam, durutabhityatra mā bhūt | etvama erliṅi vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ niryāyāt, nirvāyādityatra mā bhūt | tātaṅ - nipātsya tormā bhūt, jīva tu tvam | ivaṅuvadṛ - śayartham, vartham ityatra mā bhūt | nuṭ - hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ, kumārī āmityāhetyatra mā bhūt | hrasvatvam - ke'ṇaḥ, kumārī kasmai spṛhayati, kumāryāḥ kaṃ sukhaṃ kumārīkamityatra mā bhūt | tatvam - apo phiḥ abbhāra ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kartavyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ | so'nyārthaḥ kṛto nāmītyatrāpi dīrghatvaṃ vyavasthāpayati - abhimate viṣaye niyamayati | arthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayeti | upalakṣaṇametat | anane muk, prāṇa ityatra mā bhūt| akṛtsārvadhātukayodīrghaḥ dadhi yātamityatra mā bhūt - ityevamarthaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā, nañivayuktanyāyaśca nāśrayitavyo bhavati |
ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā iti vacanādaṅgasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyam, tataśca ato bhisa ais ityatrāta iti pañcamyantamaṅgasyetyasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate ityakāramātrasya grahaṇāt brāhmaṇabhissetyādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ | avayavaṣaṣṭhyādīnāṃ cāprasiddhiḥ, tataśca ūdupadhāyāṃ gohaḥ aṅgasya iti sthānaṣaṣṭhyā antye'lyupasaṃhārād gohaścāntyasya syāt, upadhāyāśca iti vacanādupadhāmātrasya ca | evaṃ śāsa idaṅhaloḥ ityādāvapītyāśaṅkāyāmāha - aṅgasyeti sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhīti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - adhikāro'yam, sa ca pararthaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīsthāne yogā ityapi paribhāṣā parārthā, na ca parārthayoḥ parasparaṃ sambandho'sti, yaśroktam - guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samātvātsyāt iti, tataścāṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhī svabhāvaprayuktaṃ sambandhasāmānyamevārthamabhidhatta iti | yathāyogamiti | yasminyoge yasya sambandhaviśeṣasyābhivyañjakamasti tasminyoge tatraiva viśeṣe paryavasyatītyarthaḥ |
tadyathā hanterjaḥ ityādau sthānaṣaṣṭhī, ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ ityavayavaṣaṣṭhī, yuvoranākau ityādau nimittanimittisambandha ṣaṣṭhī, lokavat, tadyathā - loke devadattasyetyabhedena prakṛttā ṣaṣṭhī- putraḥ pāṇiḥ kambala iti pratisambandhavaśāttatratatra viśeṣe paryavasyati |
atha vetyādi | pūrva vivakṣito'pi ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ sāmānyarupa ityuktam, idānī tu prayogāsādhutvāyaiva ṣaṣṭhyuccāryate, na tvarthavivakṣayetyucyate | avaśyaṃ ca yayā kayācana vibhaktayā nirddeṣṭavyam | ṣaṣṭhyanurodhastu bāhulyena tadarthasyopayokṣyamāṇatvāt | yathāyogaṃ vibhaktiṣu vipariṇamyata iti | lokavadeva | tadyayā - uccāni devadattasya gṛhāṇi, āḍhyo vaidhaveyo devadattaḥ, āmantrayasvainaṃ devadattam, kimanena kṛtyaṃ devadatteneti, tena ato bhisa ais ityatra pañcamyā vipariṇāme sati akārāntadaṅgadityayamarthe bhavati | ādiśabdena yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś ityevamādirgṛhyate | apiśabdenaitaddarśayati - na kevalaṃ ṣaṣṭhyartha eva sasa viśeṣaḥ sidhyati, api tu pañcamyarthe'piti | pūrvatra tu pakṣe ato bhisa ais ityatra nimittanimittisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī - aṅgasya nimittaṃ yo bhis | kaścāṅgasya nimittam yasminnaṅgamityetadbhavati | kasmiṃścaitadbhavati pratyaye ||
halaḥ || 6 - 4 - 2 ||
hala iti kimiti | kenedānīmudāharaṇeṣu dīrghasiddhaḥ eṣaṃ manyate - yathā śeṣe iti lakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśca, tathāṅgasyetyetadapi, tataścābhimate viṣaye dīrgho bhaviṣyatīti | atiprasaṅga iti tūttaram | viddhaḥ, vicita iti | vyadhatāḍane, vyaca vyājīkaraṇe, grahijyā ityādinā samprasāraṇam |
aṇa ityeveti | ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ ityataḥ | na ca tasya ikaḥ kāśe itiggrahaṇena vicchedaḥ | tatra hi virodhābhāvādiggrahaṇenāṇeva viśeṣyate - iko'ṇa iti | athedānīm cau ityārabhyāṇa ityevānuvartiṣyate, neka iti | tṛtiyeti vā nipātanāditi | mā nāmāṇa ityetadanuvṛtat, dvitīyatṛtīyacaturtheti yo'yaṃ nirddeśastasmādeva nipātanādanaṇo dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ |

nāmi || 6 - 4 - 3 ||
nāmityetasya śāstre kvacidapyavihitatvāttatparijñānārthamāha - nāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamityādi | nāmīti dīrghapāṭhastu na samācīnaḥ | āgatanuṭ‌kamiti | gatyarthatvādrameḥ kamaṇi kartari vā ktaḥ | āgato nuḍyena āgato vā nuḍyaṃ tadā gatanuṭ‌kam | agnīnāmityādi | akārantasya tu supi ca iti dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ |
kartaṇāmiti | nanvaṇa iti varttate tatrāha - aṇa ityetaditi | na tisṛcatasṛ iti pratiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ |
uttarārthamiti | nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatvaṃ sanuṭ‌ke āmi yathā syāt - pañcānām, saptānām, ṣaṭ‌catubhyaśca iti nuṭ carmaṇāmityādāvanuṭ‌ke mā bhūt | kṛte ca nuṭi dīrghatvapratipattyarthamiti | āgatanuṭ‌kasya grahaṇamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | anyathā hītyādi | yadyāgatanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ agni - ām iti sthite dīrghatvaṃ ca prāpnoti, nuṭ‌ ca paro nuṭ, nityaṃ dīrghatvam, kṛte'pi nuṭiprāprotyakṛte'pi, tato dīrghe kṛte'hrasvatvānnuḍeva na syāt, yo'yaṃ siddhānte nimittatvenopādānādayatnena siddho nuṭ, sa eva na syādityevaśabdasyārthaḥ | nanu cāha cāyaṃ hrasvāntānnuḍiti , na ca nityatvāddīrghe kṛte kvacidapi hrasvāntamasti, tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ - bhūtapūrva yad hrasvāntamiti, nanu cedaṃ samprati hrasvāntamasti, na tisṛcatasṛ tisṛṇām,
catasṛṇām naitadasti iha tāvaccatasṛṇāmiti ṣaṭ‌caturbhyaśca iti nuṭ siddhaḥ tisṛṇāmityatrāpi hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ ityatra trestrayaḥ ityatastrerityanuvṛttereva nuṭ siddhaḥ | yadā tarhi nṛ ca iti dīrghatva pratiṣadhastadāstyavakāśaḥ na caikamudārahaṇaṃ yogārambhaṃ prayojayati, yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt nṛnadyāpo nuṭ ityeva brūyāt, hrasvagrahaṇāttu bhūtapūrvagativiṃjñāyate | yadyevam, asthnām, dadhnām, asthidadhisakthyakṣṇām ityanaṅi kṛte'pi bhūtapūrvametad hrasvāntamiti nuṭ prāpnoti, tataśca nopadhāyāḥ iti dīrghatve nalope ca asthānāmiti prāpnoti | yadvā - yadā nuṅvidhau bhūtapūrvagatistadā nuṇnityo bhavati, anaṅ‌ tvanitya iti pūrvaṃ nuṭi kṛti'sthīnāmiti prāpnoti, dvipadāmityādau pādasya lope kṛte nuṭ‌prasaṅgaḥ | evam paddannomās ityatra ye hrasvāntasyādeśāsteṣvapi prasaṅgo yojyaḥ, tasmānna śakyaṃ bhūtapūrvagativijñānam | yaccoktam - trerityanuvṛttereva tisṛṇāmityatra nuṭ siddha iti tadapyapramāṇam, na hi dvayoranyatarasya vā'pekṣāyāmasatyāṃ cakāre cāsatyanuvṛttiḥ svadhyavasānā | tasmād - anyathā hi nuḍeva na syāditi sthitametat |
ukta evārthe saṃgrahaślokaṃ paṭhiti | nāmidīrgha iti | yadi nuṭamakṛtvā āmītyeva sūtraṃ kriyetetyarthaḥ | vacanāditi | vacanasāmarthyād bhūtapūrvagativijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | yatra tannāstīti | tisṛṇāmityatra yatra dīrghatvaṃ nāsti sa vacanasyāvakāśa ityarthaḥ | nopadhāyāśceti | caśabdaḥ samuccaye ||

nopadhāyāḥ || 6 - 3 - 7 ||

vā ṣapūrvasya nigame || 6 - 4 - 9 ||

sāntamahatassaṃyogasya || 6 - 4 - 10 ||
sakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, so'nto yasya sa sāntaḥ | sānteti pṛthakpadaṃ luptaṣaṣṭhīkaṃ saṃyogasya viśeṣaṇam, tadviśiṣṭasaṃyogo nakārasya viśeṣaṇam, mahacchabdo'pi tasyaiva viṣeṣaṇ, sarvanāmasthāne ityanenānuvṛttena sāntaḥ saṃyogo mahacchabdaśca viśeṣyate, tena haṃsaḥ, haṃsāvityatra dīrghābhāvaḥ | mahataśceti | yo nakāra ityapekṣyate | tasyeti nakārasya, kaḥ punarnakārasyopadhāyāśca sambandhaḥ, yāvatā yasminsamudāye yo'ntyādalaḥ pūrvaḥ sa taṃ pratyupadhā satyam iha tu gatyabhāvāt sāmīpyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ,
nakārasamīpavarttinyāstameva nakārāntaṃ samudāyaṃ pratyupadhāyā ityarthaḥ | kalpasūtreṣu ca prauḍho'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ tadyathā - visarjanīyo'natyakṣaropadho riṣita iti | śreyāniti | praśasyasya śraḥ , ugidacām iti num | śreyāṃsīti | jaśśasoḥ śiḥ, napuṃkasya jhalacaḥ iti num | mahāniti | bṛhanmahacchatṛvacca iti vacanād ugidacām iti num ||
aptṛntṛcsvasṛnaptṛneṣṭaṛtvaṣṭaṛtvaṣṭṛkṣattṛhotṛpotṛpraśāstṝṇām || 6 - 4 - 11 ||
āpa iti | apśabdasya nityaṃ bahuvacanāntatvād dvivacanaikavacanayorasambhavaḥ | bahvāmpīti | bahuvrīhiḥ | aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca iti tadantavidhirabhyupagataḥ | kiṃ punaratreṣṭavyam, na tāvad ṛkpūrabdhūḥ iti prāptasya samāsāntasyābhāvaḥ ityāha - tatreti | yatpunareṣṭavyaṃ taddarśayati - nityamapīti | kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityo num |
janāpavādāniti | na lokāvyaya ityādinā tṛnyoge ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāt karmaṇi dvitīyaiva bhavati | etacca tṛnnantatvābhivyaktaye prayuktam , etena kaṭasyetivyākhyātam | turiṣṭhemeyassu, tuśchandasi itivat sāmānyanirddeśe karttavye, tṛntṛcornedenopādāne prayojanaṃ cintyam |
avyutpattipakṣe iti | nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyetad ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa ityatra kaṃsagrahaṇāllabhyate, jñāpakāditi bhāvaḥ | vyutpattipakṣa iti | namestṛci makārasya pakāraḥ - naptā, nayatestṛni ṣuk guṇaśca - neṣṭā, tviṣeraccopadhāyāḥ - tvāṣṭā kṣadestṛnyaniṭtvam - kṣattā hotā, potā - tṛneva prapūrvācchāsestṛc, aniṭ‌tvaṃ ca - praśāstā | evambhūtānāmiti | evambhūtānāmiti | asyaiva vivaraṇam - saṃjñāśabdānāmiti ||
inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau || 6 - 4 - 12 ||
aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti iti ingrahaṇena tadantaṃ gṛhyate | itarebhyo'pi kevalebhyaḥ śirna sambhavati, katham inniti hanteḥ kvibantasya grahaṇam, brahaṇam, brahmadyupadācca hanteḥ kvibvihitaḥ, itarau ca puṃlliṅgau, tasmātsavaireva tadantavidhiviṃjñāyate, ityāha - inhanpūṣannaryamannityevamantānāmiti | bahudaṇḍīnīti |
baiṣamyaparihārārthamādyayorbahupūrvayoḥ |
upanyāso bahutvaṃ ca pūṣādau kālabhedataḥ || iti |
iha daṇḍīni brāhmaṇakulāni, brahmahāṇi brāhmaṇakulāni - ityantareṇāpi bahuśabdabhādyayorinhannityetayorudāharaṇatvenopanyāsaḥ sambhāvatīti codyam, vaiṣamyaparihārārthaṃ tu bahupūrvayorupanyāsa ityuttaram | vṛtrahā indraḥ, sa ekaḥ , evaṃ pūṣāryamaṇau, teṣāṃ kathaṃ bahutvaṃ viṣeṣaṇamiti codyam, manvantarādikālabhadenendrādayo bhidyante ityuttram | yadvā - bahuṣu yajñeṣvāhūtā indrādayo yairbrāhmaṇakulaistāni tathocyante |
nanu ca sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau iti dīrghatvaṃ siddham, tatkimartho'yamārambhaḥ ityāha - siddhe satyārambha iti | innādīnāmupadhāyāḥ śāveveti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati - innādīnāmeva śāviti sarvanāmāni tāyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ iti nirdeśāt | vṛtrahaṇāviti | nanvatrāstu sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau thaiti prāpto dīrghaḥ kasmānna bhavati, na hyasau tasya niyamaḥ aprakṛtatvādasaṃśabditatvācca satyam niyamavidhānasāmarthyāttu tasyāpyanena nivṛttiḥ |
astvevaṃ sarvanāmasthāne, vibhaktyantare tu sarvatrānunāsikalalakṣaṇo dīrghaḥ prāpnoti ata āha - dīrghavidhiriti | ya iha śāstre innādīnāṃ dīrghavidhistaṃ viniyamya - tasya niyamaṃ kṛtvā, kva suṭi sarvanāmasthāne | upalakṣaṇametat | tena śasādeśo'pi śirgṛhyate | itiśabdo hetau, sa ca bhinnakramaḥ ślokante draṣṭavyaḥ |
tataḥ kiṃ kuryāt śau niyamaṃ punaviṃdadhyāt | evakāro bhinnakramo netyasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | ekasmanyoge niyamadvayasya kartumaśakyātvādyogavibhāgaḥ karttavya ityarthāduktaṃ bhavati | inhanpūṣāryamṇām ityeko yogaḥ, sarvanāmasthāne iti ca vartate, innādīnāṃ ca sarvanāmasthāna eva dīrgho bhavatītyarthaḥ | atra hanvyatiriktānāṃ grahaṇamuttarārtham | tataḥ śau iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, sarvanāmasthāne'pi śāveva na sarvatra | tataḥ sau ca iti sūtraṃ
vidhyartham | evaṃ ca yogadvayaṃ kriyamāṇe ca sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayati - bhrūṇahanīti tathāsya na duṣyediti | tatheti yogādvaye satītyarthaḥ | asyeti ācāryasya | bhrūṇahanīti saptamyekavacane vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ ityallopābhāvakṣe'nunāsikalakṣaṇo dīrgho na bhavatītyarthaḥ | saptamyekavacanamupalakṣaṇam sarvatra dīrghaprasaṅgasyoktatvāt |

murcheti | murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ | hurcheti | hurchā kauṭilye | nanu ca pūrvatra satukkasya chakārasya grahaṇaṃ vitukkaścāyam, tatkathamatra lopaḥ ityāha - rāllopa ityādi | nanu yadi nāma rephātparaḥ satukkaśachakāro na sambhavati, kimetāvatā'prakṛtasyāsaṃsthitasya kevalasya chasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati tasmādevaṃ vyākhyeyam - pūrvatra dvicchakāro nirddeśaḥ, tatraikaḥ satukkaḥ, aparastu kevalo gṛhītaḥ, ta tra ca rāllopa satukkasya chasyāsambhāvtakevalo gṛhyata iti | yadi dvicchakārakaḥ pūrvatra nirddeśaḥ, cchvoriti nirddeśo nopapadyate, katham samāhāradvandve ekavacanaprasaṅgaḥ naiṣa doṣaḥ pūrvaṃ dvayorachakārayoḥ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścādvakāreṇetaretarayoga dvandvaḥ kariṣyate | evamapi dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamahāre iti samāsāntaḥ prāpnoti tarhi chakāravakārayoḥ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā tena saha satukkasya chasyetaretarayoge dvandvo bhaviṣyati | yadi pūrvatra vitukko gṛhyate, vāñchateḥ kvipi śatvaṃ prāpnoti iṣṭamevaitatsaṃgṛhītam - vāṃśau, vāṃśa ityeva bhavitavyam ||
asiddhavadatrā bhāt || 6 - 4 - 22 ||
ā bhāditinirddaśaḥ ā kaḍārāt ityanena vyākhyātaḥ | siddhaśabdo niṣpannavacanaḥ, na siddho'siddhaḥ - yaḥ punaḥ siddho'pi siddhakārya na karoti, sa tena tulyaṃ varttata iti asiddhavat | kiṃ punastat prādhānyātkārya miti prāptam, śāstraṃ hi kāryārthatvādapradhānam | kāryasya cāsiddhatve ādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedha eva sidhdyet - āgahi, jahīti na tūtsagalakṣaṇasya bhāvaḥ - edhi, śādhīti | kāryasyāsiddhatve hyayamarthaḥ - ā bhācchāstrīyaṃ kārya pravṛttamapi pravṛttakāryaṃ na krotīti, ataḥ pravṛttakāryanibandhanasyaiva kāryasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | na ca edhi, śādhītyatra etvaśābhāvanibandhanaṃ kiñcitkārya prāptaṃ yasya pratiṣedho vijñāyeta | ābhīyaṃ tu śāstraṃ svakārya kuryādeva | ata etvaśābhāvaśāstrābhyāṃ svakāryayoretvaśābhāvayoḥ pravarttitayoḥ sthāninorabhāvāttannibandhanaṃ dhitvaṃ na syādeva | śāstrāsiddhatve tvayamarthaḥ - ābhīyaṃ śāstraṃ niṣpannamapi svakārya na karotīti | ata etvaśābhāvaśāstrābhyāṃ svakāryayoretvaśābhāvayorapravṛttatvādanivarttitatvāccaitvadhibhāvaśāstrasya sthānibuddhireva varttate iti tannibandhanaṃ kāryasidhyati | ato vyāpakatvācchāstrasyaivāsiddhatvam, ā bhāditi śāstrasyaiva viṣayatvena nirddeśācca |
yadyayaṃ svatantravidhiḥ syāt, tadā bhād‌grahaṇaṃ viṣayanirddeśārya vā syāt - ā bhācchāstre|thatra karttavye'siddhavaditi, asiddhavadbhavato vā nirddeśārtham, atragrahaṇaṃ tu viṣayārtham - ā bhādyacchāstraṃ tadasiddhavadbhavati atraivābhīye śāstre karttavya iti tatrādye pakṣe asiddhavadbhavato nirddeśābhāvādyatkiñcanāṣṭādhyāyyāṃ kārya tatsarvamābhīye kartavye asiddhavat, tataśca cadhinvikṛṇvyora ca ityasyāsiddhatvaddhinute, kṛṇuta ityeto lopo na syta | atragrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, aparipūrṇatvādadhyāhāreṇauvā bhādyattatra karttavya ityarthalābhāt | ddhitīye tu pakṣe samānāśrayatvaṃ viśeṣo na labhyeta, tataśca praśamayyeti mito hrasvasyāsiddhatvāllaghupūrvo makāro na bhavatīti lyapi laghupūrāt ityayādeśo na syāt prabebhidayyeti, bhidaryaṅantād ṇaci yasya halaḥ iti yalopasyāsiddhatvāllaghupūrvāduttaro ṇajna bhavati, yakāreṇa vyavadhānādityayādeśo na syāt prastanyyeti, adantātstanaśabda ityasmād ṇicyallopasyāsiddhatvāllaghoreva paro ṇic, na tu laghupūrvādityayādeśāpraptiḥ, paśuṃ sanotīti janasanakhana iti viṭ, viḍ‌vanoḥ ityātvam, sanoterenaḥ iti śatvam - paśuṣāḥ, tataḥ śasi paśuṣo navājānityādāvātvasyasiddhatvāt āto dhātoḥ ityālopo na syāt cākhāyiteti, khaneryaṅi dvirvacanātparatvāt ye vibhāṣā ityātve dvirvacane tṛci ātvasyāsiddhatvāt yasya halaḥ iti yalopaḥ syāt papuṣa ityādau ca doṣo vakṣyate |
adhikāre ā bhād‌grahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt, thaadhikārādeva tadarthalābhāt | tathā hi - śanānnalopaḥ ityatrāsminnupasthite sati śnāduttarasya nakārasya lopo bhavati sa cāsiddhavadbhavatītyayamartho bhavati | evam anudāttopadeśa ityādāvapi, tatkimasiddhavadbhavato nirddeśārthenābhād‌grahaṇena | na cāsiddhavadbhavata ityattāvadhāraṇārthamābhād‌grahaṇam, adhikāre hyasminnavadhyanirddeśād yuvoranākau ityādīnāmapi asiddhatvaṃ syāditi vācyam, ṅyāppratipadikāt itivadantareṇāpyavadhinirddeśamadhikāraparimāṇāvagateḥ | nanvasatyābhādgrahaṇe'dhikāre'smin sati yatraitadadhikṛtaṃ tadeva sūtraṃ taddhihitaṃ vā kāryamatragrahaṇena paramṛśyeta, anyasya sannihitasyābhāvāt, tataśca śnānnalopaḥ ityasyāyamarthaḥ syāt - śnāduttarasya nakārasya lopo bhavati, sa cāsiddhavadbhavatyatraiva śnānnalope karttavya iti | evaṃ sarvatra | tataśca ciṇo luk ityatraiveṣṭaṃ sidhyet - akāritarāmiti , gataḥ, gatavānityādāvanyasminnābhīye'nyasyābhīyasyāsiddhatvānāpādanādato lopādi syādeva | ā bhād‌grahaṇaṃ tu kṛtvā vidhāvāśrīyamāṇe tasyaiva sannihitasyātragrahaṇena parāmarśādābhīyamābhīye'siddhavatsvasminnanyasminbetyayamartho labhyate ucyate, adhikāre'pyasminsati anudāttopadeśa ityādau tatraiva karttavye tasyaivāsiddhavacane na kiñcitprayojanamastīti tatkāryaviśeṣarupaparityāgena idamasiddhavadbhavati | atra karttavye ityevaṃ sāmānyarupeṇa parāmarśādanyasminnapyanyasyāsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, tadevamā bhād‌graṇamatiricyamānaṃ viṣayārtha vijñāyate | adhikārāccāsiddhavadbhavato'vagatiḥ |
atragrahaṇaṃ tu samānāśrayatvapratipattyartham, yadyubhe apyābhīye ekameva nimittamāśritya prāpnutaḥ, evamanyo'nyasminnasiddhavadbhavati, kimatragrahaṇamatiricyate ityataḥ samānāśrayatvapratipattiḥ netyāha akṣarārtha
evāyam tathā hi - anudāttopadeśa ityatrāsminnupasthite satyayamartho bhavati - anudāttopadeśānāṃ lopo bhavati jhalādau kṅiti parataḥ, sa cāsiddhavadbhavati | kutra karttavye atra yadā bhāttatreti | ko'rthaḥ kṅityanunāsikalopo bhavatītyuktam, atraiva kṅitinimitte sati yadābhīyaṃ prāpnoti tatra karttavya iti | evaṃ sarvatra | evaṃ ca vispaṣṭamakṣaraireva samānāśrayatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati |
yadyayamadhikārastato yatrāsyopasthānaṃ tata evārabhya yadā bhāttatraiva tasyāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, na tu svasmātpurveṣvitareṣu, yaddeśasthena hi vaktā āṅuccāryate tata taevārabhya maryādābhividhipratipattiḥ yathā - ā pāṭaliputrādvṛṣṭo deva taiti, evaṃ ca dhvasoredvau ityasyāyamartho bhavati - astehau ekāraḥ, sa ceta ārabhya yadā bhāttatrāsiddhavaditi, tataśca pūrvatra dhitve nāsiddhavatsyāt svatantre tu vidhau atraiva pradeśe āṅartha pratipadāyan ata evārabhya yadā bhāttadasiddhavadbhavatyatraiva karttavya iti śnānnalopaḥ ityārabhya ṛtvyavāsttvya ityevamāntānāṃ sarveṣāmevānyo'nyasminnasiddhatvamāpādayati ucyate dvau pakṣau - śabdādhikāraścārthādhikāraśca, tataśca śabdādhikāre syādeṣa doṣaḥ, arthādhikāre tvasminneva pradeśo āṅartha pratipādayan pūrvavatpratipādayati, sa ca pratipāditārthāduttaratropatiṣṭhate, upasthitaśca tatratatropasthitenātragrahaṇena viśeṣyata iti sarvamiṣṭaṃ siddham | tadanena sūkṣeṇāyamarthaḥ sampāditaḥ śnānnalopaḥ ityārabhyāpādaparisamāpteryāni sūtrāṇi tānyanyo'nyasminnasiddhavadbhavanti, tāni cettulyanimittānīti | tadetatsarva vṛttau yathāsthānaṃ yojyam | tadāśrayameva bhavatītyatrāsiddhavaditi vakṣyamāṇamapakraṣṭavyam | vibhinnāśrayam - vyāśrayam, vibhinnanimittamityarthaḥ |
asiddhavacanamityādi | utsṛjyate ādeśena nivartyata ityutsargaḥ - sthānī, sa lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam, tasya bhāvaḥ - pravṛttiryathā syāt | etacca śāstrāsiddhatvāśrayaṇāllabhyata ityuktam | āgahīti | bahulaṃ chandasi iti śapo luk anudātopadeśa ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ | jahīti | hantarjaḥ |
abhājīti | bhañjeśca ciṇi ityanunāsikalopaḥ | rāga iti | rañceśca ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ ityanunāsikalopaḥ |
atragrahaṇaṃ kimiti | yadyapi samānāśrayatvapratipattyarthamiti pūrvamevātragrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam, tathāpi samānāśrayatvapratipatteḥ ki phalamiti praśnāvasaro'styeva | papuṣa iti | pā pāne, āto lopa iṭi ca | cicyuṣa iti | ciñ cayana, eranekācaḥ iti yaṇādeśaḥ | luluviṣa iti | lūñ chedane | kathaṃ punaratra vyāśrayatvam ityāha - ālopādīni hīti | nanvevamapi naivātrālopādīni sidhyanti, antaraṅgāṇi hi tāni, tadantarbhūtasamprasāraṇāpekṣatvāt bahiraṅgaṃ samprasāraṇam, bahirbhūtavibhaktyapekṣatvāt, tataḥ kim asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge tatrāha - asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge ityādi | etaditi vacanāpekṣaṃ napuṃsakatvam | krimiti na pravarttate ata āha - eṣā hīti | ā bhācchāstrīyeti | vāha ūṭha ityatra jñāpitatvāt | tataḥ kim ityāha - tasyāmiti | antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoryugapatsannidhānaṃ nāstīti paribhāṣayā saha yaugapadyameṣṭavyam | paribhāṣāsannidhāvantaraṅgabahiraṅgayoravasthānābhāvādityarthaḥ | vasusamprasāraṇaṃ caikaṃ paribhāṣāyā āllopādīnāṃ cāśraya iti samānāśrayatvamapyasti | etacca nājānantarye ityanāśrityoktam | āllopādayo hi acorānantaryamāśritya prāpnovanti |
vugyuṭāviti | tatra yuṭā tāvatsiddhatvaṃ na vaktavyam, yuḍvidhānasāmarthyāt yaṇ na bhaviṣyati | tatra yakāradyaśravaṇārtha yuḍvidhānam yaṇo mayo dve bhavataḥ iti dvirvacanavidhānāt | halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ iti pakṣe lopavidhānācca pakṣe yakāradvayaśravaṇasya siddhatvāt | vuko'pi siddhatvaṃ na vaktavyam, katham nāprāpte uvaṅyārabhyamāṇo vuk tasyāpavādo bhaviṣyati | nanu ca bādhakapravṛttivelāyāṃ yadvirudhyate tadvādhakena nivarttitaṃ na pravarttate, uvaṅ‌niravakāśe vuki pravarttamāne'siddhatvātsvamātmānamadarśayannaśakyo bādhitumiti vuki kṛte tasyāsiddhatvātsyādeva evaṃ tarhi vugna kariṣyate, bhuvo luṅ‌liṭoruṭupadhāyāḥ iti sūtramastu, tatra ca oḥ supi ityataḥ orityanuvattiṣyate, tena bhuvā'ṅgasyopadhāyā ukārasya ūdbhavatītyāśrayaṇe uvaṅi kṛta ūkāro bhaviṣyati | yadyevam, babhūva, babhūvitheti guṇavṛddhyoravāvośca kṛtayoruvarṇa upadhāṃ na bhavatītyūtvaṃ na syāt tatrāpi indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca iti pito'pi liṭaḥ kittvād guṇavṛddhyorabhāve uvaṅi ūdbhaviṣyati | yadyevam,
indhiśchandoviṣayatvādbhuṣo vuko nityatvāditi nyāyāttanna karttavyaṃ bhavati avaśyaṃ ca vuko nityatvamāśritya babhūveti śādhayitavyam anyathā aco ñṇiti ityatreka ityunapasthānādaniglakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ syādeva evaṃ tarhi nārtho vukā, nāpi kittvena, oḥ supi ityatrāvarṇamapi priślaṣyate, akārokārayorād‌guṇe kṛte ṅasiṅasośca iti pūrvaikādeśena nirdeśāt | tena babhūvatheti guṇavṛddhyoravādhośca kṛtayoravarṇasyāpyupadhāyā ūdbhaviṣyati, babhūvaturityādāvuvaṅi kṛti uvarṇasyāpi | yadyevam, oḥ supi ityavarṇasyāpi nirdeśātkīlālapaḥ paśyetyādāvapi yaṇ syāt paratvād āto dhātoḥ iti lopo bādhako bhaviṣyati, lopasyāvakāśaḥ saṃyogapūrvākāranto dhātuḥ, akārapraśleṣasyottaratrāvakāśaḥ - babhūva, babhūvitha, kīlalapaḥ paśyetyatrobhayaprasaṅge paratvādākāralopaḥ, vipratiṣedhe hyasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti jñāpayiṣyate | evamapi kīlālapau sarvanāmasthāne bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvādākāralopāprasaṅgādyaṇ syāt evaṃ tarhi oḥ supi ityatra aci śnudhātu ityataḥ yvoḥ ityanuvarttiṣyate, tataścakārokāka,mujānirdeśe'pi yvoḥ ityanena viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādukārasyaiva yaṇ bhaviṣyati, na tvavarṇasyeti sāmarthyādavarṇagrahaṇamuttarārthameva sampadyate | tadevaṃ satyapyasminyoge vugyuṭoḥ siddhatvaṃ na vaktavyamiti bhāṣye sthitam |
ye tvāhuḥ - bhuvo vugluṅaliṭoḥ ityatra oḥ ityanuvartanīyam, uvarṇāntasya bhuvo vugyathā syāt - bobhāva, bobhavitheti yaṅ‌luki piti liṭi indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca ityatra śtipā nideśādesati kittve guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoranuvarṇāntasya mā bhūdityevamartham | evaṃ ca babhūva, babhūvithatyatrāpi guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoḥ vuko'prasaṅgādanityātvāt indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca iti kittvamāramabhaṇīyam | tatra ca ṅidityadhikārātkittvaṅittvayorubhayorapi vidhānad babhūvetyaniglakṣaṇāpi vṛddhirna bhavati | eṣa taeva ca kittve śtipā nirdeśaṃ vuki ca tadabhāvaṃ kurvataḥ sūtrakārasyābhiprāya iti teṣāṃ vukaḥ siddhatvaṃ vaktavyameva | na ca vatkaraṇaṃ svāśrayamapi yathā syāditi vukaḥ siddhatvaṃ labhyate, satyasati vā vatāvatideśeṣvātideśikāviruddhasyāśrayakāryāvivarttanāṃtsiddhatvāsiddhatvayostu virodhātkathaṃ vatinā siddhatvaprāpathaṇam kathaṃ vā viṣayavibhāgo labhyeta sthānivadityādau tu vatimantareṇa saṃjñā syāditi vatkaraṇamatideśārtha sat svāśrayapratipattyarthaṃ varṇyate evaṃ tarhi śnasorallopaḥ iti taparakaraṇālliṅgāt kvacitsiddhatvamanumīyate, taddhi āstāmityādāvāṭo mā bhūditi | yadi cedamasiddhatvaṃ nityaṃ syāt, āṭo'siddhatvādeva lopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ taparakaraṇena vatkaraṇaṃ tu pratipattilāghavārthameva | tathā ca ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ, goto ṇid ityādo vatimantareṇāpi paratra paraśabdaprayogādevātideśa āśritaḥ, tatrāpi cāviruddhaṃ svāśrayaṃ bhavatyeva |
atrāṅ‌ maryādāyāṃ yadi syād, bhādhikārīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na syāt | na cābhādgrahaṇaṃ viṣayārtham, asiddhavadbhavatastu parijñānamadhikārādevetyuktam | ato maryādārthe'pyāṅi bhādhikāre'pyasyopasthānaṃ na vihanyate | tasmādevaṃ vaktavyam - bhādhikārīye karttavye bhādhikārīyasya pūrvasyaiva prakāraṇasyāpyasiddhatvaṃ noktaṃ syāditi satyam ayameva doṣaḥ - tatra sūryeṇaikadigiti aṇi kṛte yasyetilopaḥ, ṅīp, punaraṇo yasyetilopaḥ, taatredānīm sūryatiṣya iti yalopa iṣyate - saurī balāketi, sa na prāpnoti bhādhikārīye yalope yasyeti lopasyāsiddhatvābhāvādyakārasyānupadhātvāt | sthānivadbhāvaśca yalopavidhiṃ prati niṣiddhaḥ tamimaṃ maryādāpatre doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha - ā bhādityayamabhividhāvāṅiti | bhādhikāre'pyasiddhavadbhavatīti | bhādhikāre'pi tadavasthitam, tatrāpi karttavye tatra tyamanyaccāsiddhavadbhavatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ vyākhyātā vṛttiḥ |
kāni punarasya yogasya prayojanāni iha pādo'syāstīti ata iniṭhanau, pādikaḥ, taudakaṃ vahatītyaṇ saṃjñāyāmudabhāvaḥ, udavāhasyāpatyam ata iñ audavāhiḥ, sāraṇaśabdābhyāṃ lyuhantābhyāmata iñ, sāraṇiḥ, vāraṇiḥ, śātanapātanaśabdābhyāṃ ṭittvānṅīp, śātanī, pātanī sraṃserdhvaṃserṇyantādyaki sraṃsyate, dhvaṃsyate, atra yasyetilope ṇilope ca kṛte padbhāvaḥ, ūṭha, nastaddhite allopo'naḥ, aniditām ityete vidhayaḥ prāpnavanti, lopasyāsidhdatvānna bhavinti tanna, acaḥ parasmin iti sthānivadbhāvenāpyetāni siddhāni | śā hau ityatra śās hau iti padacchedaḥ, śāsaḥ śāsityayamādeśo bhavati, kimarthamidam itvabādhanārtham tataḥ hujhalbhyaḥ iti dhitvam, dhi ca iti salopaḥ śādhīti siddham, dhi sakāre sico lopa iti nāśrīyate, cakādhītyeva bhavitavyamiti nirṇeṣyate |

yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate iti | yadi na kriyate, tadāpatya ityanuvarttate vā, na vā tatrānuvṛttāvanantarasūtreṇa prakṛtibhāvapratiṣedhāt nastaddhite ityeva ṭilopasya siddhatvānniyamārthametadbhavati - ajātāvevāpatye iti, tatrāpatye siddhamiṣṭam - brāhmo nāradaḥ, brāhmaṇajātiriti | anapatye tu jātāvajātau ca na kvaciṭṭilopaḥ syād - brāhmī oṣadhiḥ, brāhmaṃ haviriti | ananuvṛttau tu vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyāniti anapatye an iti prakṛtibhāve prāpte ajātau ṭilopārthaṃ vidhyarthametadbhavati , tatra brāhmaṃ havirityādi siddham, brāhmī oṣadhiriti na sidhyati ajātāviti pratiṣedhāt, brāhmaṇī oṣadhiriti prāpnoti | apatye ca jātau brāhmaṇa iti na sidhyati, pūrvasūtreṇa prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe ṭilopaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | vibhaktasyārthamāha - brāhma ityetaditi | sāmarthyāditi | apatye pūrveṇaiva ṭilopasya siddhatvādbhāhma ityetāvatā niyamasya karttumaśakyatvācca, tatrāpatye'pi brāhmo nārada iti paratvādanenaiva ṭilopaḥ | apatye veti | anyathā anapatye vāpatye ca jātau pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, prasajyapratiṣeścāyamityāha - apatye jātāviti ||

yuvoranākau || 7 - 1 - 1 ||
śāstrasya lāghavārthaṃ yuvū pratyayau upadiṣṭau, tayoranenānākāvādeśau vidhīyete tatratatra hyanākayorevopadeśe śāstrasya gauravaṃ syāt | iha kasmānna bhavati - yu mikṣaṇe, yutaḥ yutavān uditoryuvoridaṃ grahaṇam | katham lyaḍādiṣūkāro'nunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ | evamapi dyūtvā, dyūtaḥ, dyūtavāna - atra prāpnoti, ūṭhastvanudidavakāśaḥ athārthavato yuvuśabdasya grahaṇam, anarthakaścanāyam, tena dhātvantasya na bhavati | bhujyuḥ, mṛtyuḥ, kaṃyuḥ śaṃyuḥ ūrṇāyurityādāvukārasyānitsaṃjñakatvādādeśābhāvaḥ | yadi tarhi lyuḍādiṣūkāra itsaṃjñakaḥ - nandanaḥ, kārakaḥ, ugidacām iti num prāpnoti ugito jhalantasya num, na cautau jhalantau | tattarhi jhalgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam netyāha, yadetat napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ iti jhalgrahaṇaṃ tatpurastādapakrakṣyate, ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātorjhalaḥ yujerasamāse, tataḥ - napuṃsakasya jhalaḍha, ityeva, tataḥ, acaḥ, napuṃsakasya ityeva, taccāvaśyaṃ jhalgrahaṇamapakraṣṭavyam, anyathogito liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi num prasajyeta - gomatī bhavatī | iha tarhi nandanā, kārikā - ugitaśca iti ṅīp prāpnoti jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ kvacidyuvū ṣiṭṭitau karoti - śilpini ṣvun, ṭyuṭyulau tuṭ ca iti, tajjñāpayati - na yuvorīkāro bhavatīti | naitadasti jñāpakam ṣitkaraṇaṃ ṅīṣartham, ṭitkaraṇamanupasarjanārtham, ṭito hyanupasarjanāt ṅīp bhavati, ugitaḥ punaraviśeṣeṇa | tathā śātanapātanaśabdau lyuḍantau gaurādiṣu paṭhitau, tatra śātanitarā, pātanitarā, nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām ugitaśca ityugillakṣaṇo hrasvavikalpaḥ prāpnoti | nanu cogita ityevamugitasaṃjñāśabdanena yā nadī vihitā tasyāstatra grahaṇam netyāha, iha hi doṣaḥ syāt - bhogavatitarā, gaurimatitarā, śārṅgaravādiṅīnantāvaitau, tatra hrasvavikalpo na syāt, iṣyate cātrāpi hrasvavikalpo bhāṣyakāreṇa | tasmānnaivaṃ śakyam - uditoryuvorguhaṇam iti | na cedevaṃ yutaḥ, yutvā, bhujyuḥ, śaṃyurityatrāpi prāpnoti tatrāha - anunāsikayaṇoriti | santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikāḥ, niranunāsikāśca, tatra yeṣāmādeśa iṣyate teṣu yakāravakārāvanunāsikau paṭhitavyau, tena kvāpyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | pratyayoriti | vastukathanametat, na tvapratyayanivṛttyartham, tathāvidhāsyānunāsikasya yaṇo'sambhavāt ||
mutyuriti | bhujimṛṅbhyaṃ yuktyukau iti sūtre sahanirdiṣṭatvādidamudāhṛtam, śakyate hyatra vaktum - aṅgasya yau yuvū, kau cāṅgasya yuvū, yayoraṅgamityetadbhavati, kayoścaitadbhavati pratyayoḥ na caiṣa pratyaya iti | ānarthakyācca ṭyuṭayulostvanādeśe kṛte paścāttuḍityarthavatt‌vaṃ pratyayatvaṃ ca | kimucyate'nunāsikatvaṃ na pratijñāyata iti , na punarna paṭhyate ityata āha - pratijñānunāsikyā iti | pratijñayānunāsikyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | sarvatra pāṭhābhāvātsato'pi vā pāṭhasya saṅkīrṇatvātpratijñāsamadhigamyamevānunāsikatvamityarthaḥ |
yuvoriti samāharadvandveścet sa napuṃsakam iti napuṃsakatve sati autvaguṇavṛddhitṛjvadbhāvebhyo num pūrvavipratiṣiddham iti vacanāt gherṅiti iti guṇaṃ bādhitvā iko'ci vibhaktau iti numi sati yuvuna iti bhavitavyam itaretarayogadvandve tu dvirvacane yaṇādeśe ca sati dvayorvakārayoḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | sthānivadbhāvādvali lopo'pi nāsti, tatkathamayaṃ nirddeśaḥ ityāha - yuvoriti | napuṃsakaliṅgatā ceti | na bhavatīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | madhye hetuḥ | liṅgamaśiṣyamiti | chāndaso varṇalopa iti | akṛta eva yaṇādeśa ukārasya lopaḥ, kṛte vā tasminnanyatarasya vakārasya apara āha - karmadhārayo'yam, avayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya vyapadeśaḥ | yuścāsau samudāyo yuvulakṣaṇo vuścāsāviti tatra samudāyayasya kvacidabhāvādavayavayorevānākādeśāviti |
āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ phaḍhakhacchaghāṃ pratyayādīnām || 7 - 2 - 2 ||
phakārādiṣvakāra uñcāraṇārthaḥ | vyañjanamātraṃ sthāni ante phaḍhakhachaghām ityanackanirdeśāt | evaṃ ca niranuvandhakaparibhāṣā na pravarttate | āḍhyakulīna iti | apūrvapadāt iti vacanāt kulātkhaḥ ityanena sapūrvapadādapi kho bhavati |
phakka nīcairgatau ḍhokṛ taukṛ gatyarthau | iha pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ saṃjñāsanniyogena vidhānādantaraṅgam |
ete tvāyannādayo'ṅgādhikāre vidhānādvahiraṅgāḥ, tataśca yatra svarārtho'nubandho nāsti - śilāyā ḍhaḥ ,
vṛddhacchaḥ ityādau tatrādyudāttatve kṛte paścādbhavanta ete ādeśā asvarakasyāca uccāraṇasambhavādaniyatasvarāḥ syuḥ ityāṅkyāha - āyannādaya ityādi | ayamabhiprāyaḥ - pratyayādīnāṃ phakārādīnāmaṅgasambandhāvyabhicārātprayojanābhāvādiha aṅgasya iti na sambadhyate, tena ete'pyantaraṅgā, tatra paratvādeteṣu kṛteṣu paścādādyudāttatvamiti | atraiya jñāpakamāha - tathā ceti | yadi pratyayasvare kṛte āyannādaya ādeśāḥ syuḥ, tato ghaśabdākārasyodāttatve kṛte ghakārasya halaḥ sraṃsanadharmiṇaḥ sraṃsanadhamiṇyanudātta ādeśe kṛte'ntodāttatvaṃ siddhamiti citkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | iyaṅiti | vāvacanaṃ jñāpakamiti | yadi dhātupratyayānāmapyete ādeśāḥ syuḥ ṛteśchaṅ‌ ityeṣa brūyāt | na ca chaṅi sati valādilakṣaṇe iṭi kṛte anāditvādiyādeśo na syāditi vācyam, idānīmeva hyuktam - antaraṅgā ādeśā iti |
apara āha - yadi dhātupratyayeṣvetajjñāpakaṃ prātipadikapratyayeṣvapi śakhyaṃ vaktuṃ yadayamīyasunaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ na prātipadikapratyayānāmime ādeśā iti | yadi syustarhi chasunameva vidadhyāt | etāvantaśca pratyayāḥ - dhātupratyayāḥ, pratipadikapratyayāśceti, ucyante cādeśāḥ te vacanātsarvatraiva syuriti |
itsaṃjñayā bhavitavyamiti | na ca vacanasāmarthyāditsaṃjñāyā bādhanamityāhatiddhiteṣu hīti | pratividhānaṃ karttavyamiti | pratividhānaṃ tu prācāmavṛddhātphin bahulam iti phino nitkaraṇāditsaṃjñāyā abhāva iti | na ca pheścha ca ityatra phinaḥ, phiñaśca sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ nitkaraṇam , vṛddhādityadhikārāddhi phiña eva tatra grahaṇam, na phinaḥ ||
jho'ntaḥ || 7 - 1 - 3 ||
ādigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttamiti | tadanuvṛttau hi śayāntai ityatra śīṅo leṭi leṭo'ḍāṭau iti lāvasthāyāmeva prāpte āṭi sati jhakārasyānāditvānna syāt | kathaṃ punaḥ samāsanirddiṣṭānāmekadeśo'navarttate naiṣa doṣaḥ, anāśritārthakaṃ śabdamātraṃ svaritatvavaśādanuvarttate - iti pakṣe yasyaiva svaritatvaṃ pratijñātaṃ tasyaivānuvṛttiḥ | arthādhikārapakṣe tu samāsārthasyaikatvāttasyaivānuvṛttiḥ syādvā, na vā | yadvā - pratyayagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre pṛthak padaṃ luptavibhaktikam, tena tasyaivānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati | ādeśe tvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ tena pacantītyādau śravaṇaṃ na bhavati ||

ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ || 7 - 1 - 5 ||
anabhyastārthamidaṃ vacanam | cinvatāmiti | loṭ, ṭeretvam āmetaḥ | cyavanta iti |

śīṅo ruṭ || 7 - 1 - 6 ||
jhādeśasyāt iti | nanu ca nehād‌grahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, śīṅa ityeṣā pañcamī aditi prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati, tasmādityuttarasya iti | śerata iti | sārvadhātukāvayavasya jhasyādādeśastadāgamo ruṭ tad‌grahaṇena gṛhyate | avayavasya samudāyaṃ pratyavayavatvaṃ loke'pi dṛśyate, yathā - devadattasyāṅguliriti | sārvadhātukasyāpyavayavo ruḍiti śīḍaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ iti guṇo bhavati |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ruḍāgamo jhadeśasyāto vidhīyate, najhakārasyaiva vadhīyate, evaṃ hi na ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyā
bhavati ata āha - ruḍayamiti | yadi tu kakārāsañjanena pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, śerata ityatra guṇo na syād anigantatvāt | tasmāt parādireva vaktavyaḥ | sa yadica jhakārasyaiva syāt, tato yathā śayāntai ityatrāṭā vyavahitatvājjhasyādādeśo na bhavati, tathā śerate ityatrāpi na syāt ruṭā vyavahitatvāt |
nanu ca yuktamāṭā vyavadhānam, sa hi sārvadhātukabhaktastadeva na vyavadadhyāt, jhakāraṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva, ruṭ punarjhakārabhaktaḥ sa kathaṃ tasya vyabadhāyakaḥ ucyate gṛhyatā tāvattadgrahathaṇena , tathāpi nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti yadatra nirddiśyate jha iti viśiṣṭaṃ rupaṃ na tadanantaram, yaścānantaro rephajhakārasamudāyo na sa nirddiśyata iti na syādevādeśaḥ | apara āha - ādeśo na syāditi, ko'rthaḥ jhasya na syāditi, kasya tarhi syāt ādeḥ parasya iti ruṭa eva syāt | na ca ruṭeḥ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, jhakārasya śravaṇārthatvāt iti, taccintyam anekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti | sarvādeśe ruṭo vaiyarthyamiti cet kiṃ kurmaḥ mā bhūdādeśaḥ | śīṅaḥ ityanubandhoccāraṇaṃ yaṅ‌lugnivṛttyartham - vyatiśeśyate | guṇo'pi na bhavati tatrāpyanubandhanirddaśāt ||
vettervibhāṣā || 7 - 1 - 7 ||
saṃvidrata iti | samo gamyṛcchi ityādinātmanepadam | vitta ityādi | vida vicāraṇe, rudhādiranudāttet | sattālābhārthayostu vikaraṇavyavadhānādevāgrahaṇam | atra ca bahuvacanaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, itarayorupanyāso vicāraṇārthasyedaṃ bahuvacane rupamiti pradarśanārtham | vidante iti rupasya lābhārthe taudādike svaritettvādātmanepade ekavacane śe mucādīnām iti numyapi kṛte sambhavāt | kiñca - vetteriti śtipā nirddeśādeva yaṅ‌luki na bhavati - vyativevidate iti ||

ato bhisa aisaṃ || 7 - 1 - 9 ||
atijarasairiti | atraiva caikārasya śravaṇārthamaisādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | vṛkṣairityādāvesādeśe'pi vṛddhyā rupaṃ siddham | ato guṇe iti pararupaṃ tu na bhavati yadi syāta, isameva vidadhyāt |
paratvāditi | etvasyāvakāśaḥ - vṛkṣeṣu, aiso'vakāśaḥ kṛta etve, prāgetvādubhayaprasaṅge paratvādetvaprasaṅga iti cenmanyase, ata esa kva bhaviṣyati etve kṛte mukhyamakārānta na bhavatīti praśnaḥ kṛta etve bhautapūrvyāditi | bhūtapūrvasya bhāvo bhautapūrvyam, sāmpratikābhāvādbhūtapūrvagatirāśrīyata iti bhāvaḥ | es tu nityastathā satīti | evaṃ hi satyaisbhāvo nityaḥ, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt | etvaṃ tvaisi kṛte na prāpnoti ajhalāditvāt | na ca tatra bhūtapūrvagatiḥ mukhyasyaiva sambhāvāt | etaccodyaparihāramutsargāpavādabhāvamanāśritya kṛtaṃ draṣṭavyam, tadāśrayaṇe hi nāprāpta etva ārambhādaisapavāda ityayukto vipratiṣedhaḥ syāt ||
nedamadasorakoḥ || 7 - 1 - 11 ||
idamadasoḥ iti bhisapekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | ebhiriti | tyadādyatvam, hali lopaḥ itīdbhāgasya lopaḥ | amībhiriti | aisi pratiṣiddhe bahuvacane jhalyet ityetvam eta īdvahuvacane itītvamatve |
akorityetadanarthakam, katham viśiṣṭarupāśrayo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ - idamadasoḥ iti, tatrākaci kṛte rupabhedādeva na bhaviṣyati tatrāha - akorityetadeveti | jñāpanasya parayojanam - sarvake ityādau sarvanāmakāryapravṛttiḥ |
imau dvau pratiṣedhāvucyete, dvāvapi śakyāvavaktum | katham evaṃ hi vakṣyāmi - idamadasoḥ kāt iti, tanniyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati - idamasoreva kāditi | tataśca sarvakairityādau na syāt, ebhirityādau ca syādeva - tanmadhyaparibhāṣā ca na jñāpitā syāt | kvacittu vṛttāveva paṭhyate - idamadasoḥ kāditi noktam, viparīto'pi niyamaḥ syāt - idamadasoreva kāditīti ||
ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ || 7 - 1 - 12 ||
atijarasinetyādi | samāse hrasvatve kṛte inādeśaḥ, tataḥ sannipātparibhāṣāyā anityatvājjarasādeśaḥ |
evamatijarasādityatrāpyādādeśe kṛte jarasādeśaḥ | nanu ca ṭāṅasyorevājāditvātprāginādādeśābhyāṃ jarasādeśaḥ
prāpnoti, sa hi nityaḥ paraśca, tatra kṛte'nadantatvādevenādādeśayorabhāve atijarasā, atijarasa iti bhavitavyam | naiṣa doṣaḥ, evaṃ hi inādeśasya, adādeśasya ca vidhānamanarthakam, nādeśo'deśaśca vidheyaḥ syāt, kā rupasiddhaḥ
iha tāvad vṛkṣeṇeti etve yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate - bahuvacane jhalyet, osi ca, tataḥ āṅi ca - āṅi ca parato'ta etvam- vṛkṣeṇa | naivaṃ śakyam, thaiha hyaneneti hali lopaḥ iti idrapalope sati eneti prāpnoti hali lopaḥ ityapanīya jhali lopaḥ iti sūtre kariṣyeta, tatra nakārasyājhaltvāllopābhāvaḥ | na sa śakyo jhali lopo vaktum, iha hi na syāt, - ayāviṣṭa, ajanayat, ayeti idamaścaturthyakavacanasya supāṃ suluka ityādinā yādeśaḥ, supi ca iti dīrghābhāvaḥ chāndasaḥ, tatrāsyājhalāditvādidrūpalopo na syāt | tasmāddhali lopa eva karttavyaḥ, tataścāneneti na sidhyati evaṃ tarhi anāpyakaḥ iti dvinakārako'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ, tatrādeśasambandhī padāntatvālluptaḥ naśca āp ca nāp, tatra parata ido'nādeśa iti sūtrārthāśrayaṇādidrūpalopāpavodo naśabde parato nādeśa eva bhaviṣyati | yadyavam, ādeśena lopasyāsiddhatvādrājetyādāviva sūtre dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ - anāpyakaḥ iti naiṣa doṣaḥ, supāṃ suluk iti luki kṛte na lumatāṅgasya iti pratiṣedhaḥ | vṛkṣādityatrāpi savarṇatvenaiva siddham, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyādato guṇe pararupaṃ na bhaviṣyati | tadevaminādeśasyādādeśasya ca vidhānasamarthyātpūrvaminādādeśau, paścājjarasādeśa ityaṣāmabhiprāyaḥ |
yathā tvityādi | bhāṣye hi pūrvoktaprakriyāśrayaṇena nādheśo'dādeśaśca vyavasthāpitaḥ | yadi caitadrūpadvayamiṣṭaṃ syāt, tayorādeśayoḥ pratyākhyānamanupapannaṃ syāt | tatra sannipātaparibhāṣayā jarasādeśābhāvādatijareṇa, atijarāditi bhāṣyakārasyābhipretimiti kecit | prāgeva jarasādeśe - atijarasā, atijarasa ityabhipretamityanye ||
ṅeryaḥ || 7 - 1 - 13 ||
ṅe iti caturthyakavacanasya grahaṇamiti | tasya hi ṅe iti rupaṃ pratipadoktaṃ saptamyekavacanasya gherṅiti iti guṇe lākṣaṇikam | yadyapi ṅeḥ iti vibhaktyantamupāttam, taccobhayorapi lākṣaṇikam, thathāpi pratyayātpūrvasya bhāgasya lākṣaṇikatvapratipadoktatvāpekṣeyā paribhāṣāpravṛttiḥ | yadyevam, ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ ityatrāpyevameva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāvdyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam | liṅgaṃ ca - tasmai prabhavati, tadasmai dīyate, tasmai hitam, tadasyaiṃ praharaṇamiti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ ityādi | vṛkṣāyeti | supi ca iti dīrghaḥ |
kathaṃ punarakārasannipātakṛto yaśabadstadvidhātanimittaṃ bhavati ata āha - sannipātalakṣaṇa iti | anityatvaṃ tasyāḥ kaṣṭāya kramaṇe iti nirddeśādavasīyate ||
sarvanāmnaḥ smai || 7 - 1 - 14 ||
bhavata iti | dviryantāstyadādayaḥ iti vacanādanyatra tyadādyatvābhāvādanakārantatvam | anvādeśe'śadeśe kṛta iti | ananvādeśe tvatrāsmai cedrūpalopaḥ, na cākṛte idrūpalope ekādeśaḥ prāpnotīti | na cād‌guṇaprasaṅgaḥ, nityenedrūpalopena bādhitatvāt | ekādeśaḥ prāpnotīti | nityatvāt | vākyasaṃskārapakṣe caitaccodyam | taddhyarthapratipādanāya loke prayujyate, tadeva ca śāstre vibhajyānvākhyāyate | antaraṅgatvāditi | ekapadā(yatvādantaraṅgatvam, padadvayāśrayatvādekādeśo bahiraṅgaḥ ||
pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā || 7 - 1 - 16 ||
dvaye pūrvādayaḥ - sūtrapaṭhitāḥ, gaṇapāṭhapaṭhitāśca, sarvanāmnaḥ iti cehānuvarttate tatrāsati navagrahaṇe ṅasiṅyoryena sarvanāmasaṃjñā sa gaṇapāṭha eva gṛhyata iti navagrahaṇam |
iha jasiṅasiṅīnāṃ śīsmātsminaḥ pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā, auṅa āpaḥ, śī napuṃsakācca iti sūtranyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ, evaṃ jasi vibhāṣārthāni trīthaṇi sūtrāṇi na karttavyāni bhavanti tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
jasaḥ śī || 7 - 1 - 17 ||

auṅa āpaḥ || 7 - 1 - 18 ||
auṅaḥ iti nirddeśaṃ kriyamāṇamanuvādapūrvamākṣipati |
aukāro'yamiti | ko'yaṃ prakāraḥ, kṛtsito'yaṃ sūtrapraṇayanaprakāraḥ, siddhasya hyanuvāda upapadyate, yathā - ṅeryaḥ iti, ayaṃ tu na kvāpi siddha iti pariharati - kāmānyārtha iti | autaḥ ityucyamāne prathamādvivacanasyaiva syāniranubandhakatvāt, na sānubandhakasyauṭaḥ | yadyapi ṭakāraḥ pratyāhārārthatvātsamudāyānubandhaḥ, tathāpi pratyayānubandhatvamapi tasyāviruddham | vdyarthā api hetavo bhavanti, tadyathā - āmrāśca siktāḥ pitaraśca prīṇitāḥ iti, auṭa ityucyamāne prathamādvivacanasya na syāt | tasmād dvayorapi sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅakārānubandhanirddeśaḥ | nanvasato'vuvādo'nupapanna ityākṣepaḥ, tatra prayojanābhidhānamasaṅgatam naiṣa doṣaḥ, odauṭorauṅiṃti vadhivākyamasmādevānuvādādanumāsyate, tasyaiva prayojanābhidhānam | punaścodayati - tasya ceti | tasya ṅakārānubandhasyāsañjane'sminnevaṃ vijñāyamāne ṅitkāyaṃ yāḍāpaḥ ityetatte evaṃvādinastava, śyāṃ śīśabde parataḥ, prasaktam | prasajatu nāma tatrāha - sa doṣa iti | doṣa ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyātsa iti puṃlliṅganirddeśaḥ | pariharati - ṅittva iti | varṇamātranirddeśaḥ iti vavakṣitam, vṛttabhaṅgabhayāttvasthāne mākṣaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | yāḍāpaḥ ityatra ṅitīti yadanuvṛttaṃ na sa bahuvrīhiḥ ṅa idyasyeti kiṃ tarhi karmadhārayaḥ - ṅaścāsavicceti, tataḥ kim ityata āha varṇe yatsyāditi | yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe |
ayaṃ tāvanṅittvamabhyupetya parihāra uktaḥ, ṅitvameva tu nāstītyāha - varṇaścāyamiti | caśabdo vārthe paṭhitaḥ | varṇo vāyamityeva vā pāṭhaḥ | auṅiti varṇo vāyamupātto na pratyayaḥ | ṅakārastu mukhasukhārthaḥ, yathā - ṛdorap ityatra dakāraḥ | aṅgākṣiptasya pratyayasya tena viśeṣaṇādaukārāntasya pratyayasyetyarthaḥ | varṇarupatayā caukāragrahaṇe sati dvayorapyaukārayorgrahaṇaṃ bhavati pratyayaviṣayatvādananubandhakaparibhāṣāyāḥ | ṅitve'pyadoṣa iti | ṅittve sati yo doṣaḥ so'pi na bhavati, ṅittvasyaivābhāvādityarthaḥ, pūrveṇa vā parihāreṇāsyānvayaḥ |
parihārāntaramāha - nirdeśo'yamiti | pūrvācāryāṇāṃ hi sūtre dve apyete dvivacane auṅiti paṭhyete, tadāśrayeṇāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tena dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati | na ca ṅitkāryaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi pūrvācāryānubandhairiha kāryāṇi kniyante ||

svamornapuṃsakāt || 7 - 1 - 23 ||
su iti prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya amā ekavacanena sāhacaryāt | tadbhāhmaṇakulamityatra paratvāttyadādyatve kṛte lugna prāpnoti ato'm ityambhāvena bādhitatvāt, tasmāttyadādibhyaśceti vaktavyam ata āha - tad brāhmaṇakulamityatreti | nityatvādveti | lukā tyādādyatvaṃ bādhyata ityanuṣaṅgaḥ |

ato'm || 7 - 1 - 24 ||

ad‌ḍḍarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ ||7 - 1 - 25 ||
ad‌ḍḍādeśo bhavatīti | vavikṣitādeśarupapratipādanāya ṣṭutvaṃ na kṛtam | kathaṃ punarjñāyate - ḍidayamādeśa
iti yadi hi ḍinnasyāt ḍatarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyo't ityeva brūyāt | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sāveva dīrghanivṛttiḥ prayojanamucyate, na tvami ityāha - iha tviti | evaṃ tarhīti | pūrvasūtravihitamamamanuvartya ḍatarādibhya iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpya tasyaivāmo dakāro vidhāsyata iti codyārthaḥ | he kataradityatra sambuddhilopo mā bhūditi | ayaṃ ca doṣa pūrvasminnapi pakṣe samānaḥ |
nanu ca sambuddhilope halḍyābbhyaḥ ityato'pṛktagrahaṇamanuvartayiṣyate, iha ca ādeḥ parasya ityamo'kārasya dakāre kṛte makārasya saṃyogāntalopaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānnāyamapṛktaḥ, evamadādeśo nāpṛktaḥ, yadyapṛttagrahaṇamanuvartate, he kāṇḍetyāmo'pi na syāditi doṣaḥ | tadidamuktam -- atha nivṛttamapṛktagrahaṇam, tato nivṛtte ḍatarādiṣu doṣaḥ - he kataradityādau lopaḥ syāditi | ato ḍittvādad‌ḍādeśavidhānāttasya ca ḍittvānna sambuddhilopaḥ, nāpi pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvamityarthaḥ |
yadi punaḥ pūrvasūtrabihitamamamanuvartya tasyaivādādeśo vidhīyate śakyaṃ ḍittvamakarttum ||

yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś || 7 - 1 - 27 ||
śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārthamiti | anyathā ādeḥ parasya ityādeḥ syāt | nanu cākārasyākāravacane prayojanābhāvādādyanusaṃhāre bādhite alontyasya iti makārasyākāre sati ato guṇe iti pararupeṇaiva siddham ata āha - anyathā hīti | ādeśa iti vyapadeśa ādeśavyapadeśaḥ, yasyādeśasya prayojanaṃ nāstīti manyase tasayaiva syādityevaśabdārthaḥ | kiṃ punarādeśavyapadeśena prayojanaṃ yata ādereva syāt tatrāha -tataśceti | hyarthe caḥ
paṭhitaḥ | tato hyādeśavyapadeśād yo'ci iti yatvaṃ na syāt, yatvābhāvaḥ prayojanamādeśavyapadeśasya syādityarthaḥ | yo'ci ityatra yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe iti varttate | nanu cānādeśo yā vibhaktirityevaṃ tatra vijñāsyate, na hi tadādividhirasti yata anādeśādāviti vijñāyeta tataśca satyaṣyādeśāditve vibhakteranādeśatvātsyādeva yatvamiti vyarthamevākārasyākāravidhānam evaṃ manyate - sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ iti nyāyenādivikāradvāreṇa vibhākterevādeśo vidhīyata iti vibhaktirevādeśa iti | sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ ityatra na padaśabdena suptiṅantamucyate, kiṃ tarhi padyate gamyate'nenārthaṃ iti padam, tataśca pacatvityatra yathā tiśabdasya tuśabdo bhavati, tadvadatrāpi ṅaso'śeva vidhīyata iti bhavatyevādeśātvaṃ vibhakteḥ ||
ṅe prathamayoram || 7 - 1 - 29 ||
ṅe ityāvibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśa iti | prathamayoriti prathamādvitīyayorgrahaṇam iti vakṣyati, tadatra samāse sati bahuvacanaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | prādhānayalakṣaṇasya prathamārthasyehāsambhāvatsanniveśaviśeṣāpekṣayā prathamasya grahaṇamiti tāvanniścitam | tiṅ‌prathamayostu yusmādasmadbhyāmasambhava eva, tatra pratyayayorgrahaṇam, vibhaktyorveti saṃśayaḥ | yadi strīliṅganirddeśastato vibhaktyorgrahaṇam, puṃlliṅganirdeśe tu pratyayayoḥ | tatra nirvayamāha - prathamayośca vibhāktyoriti | etadeva spaṣṭayati - prathamādvitīyoriti | kathaṃ kunaḥ prathamāśabdena dvitīyocyate, sāhacaryāta | nanu sakṛtprayuktaḥ śabdo mukhyavṛttirvā bhavatu, jaghanyavṛttirvā, na panarubhayavṛttiḥ satyam prathamādvitīyāsamudāye jaghanyavṛttirevāyamudbhatāvayavabhedaśca samudāya iti dvivacanam | kathaṃ punarjñāyate - vibhaktyorgrahaṇamiti dvitīyāyāṃ ca ityātvavidhānāt | taddhyadeśārthamucyate, anādeśe yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe ityeva siddhatvāt | yadi cātra vibhaktyorgrahaṇaṃ syāt, evamasyādeśārthatopapadyate | nanu ca yo'ci iti yatvabādhanārthaṃ tatsyāt yadyetābatprayojanaṃ syāt, yatvamevāyaṃ viśiṣya brūyāt - yo'cyāpīti | ābiti pratyāhāraḥ anāpyakaḥ iti vat | yatastu dvitīyāyāmātvaṃ śāsti, tato jñāyate - vibhaktyoriha grahaṇamiti ||
śaso na || 7 - 1 - 29 ||
netyavibhaktiko nirddeśaḥ, tathā ca pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasyāyamamaḥ pratiṣedha iti māṣye śaṅkitam - kaḥ punaḥ pratiṣedhe sati doṣaḥ, yāvatā'mi pratiṣiddhe yo'ci iti yatve ca dvitīyāyāṃ ityātve kṛte prathamayoḥ pūrvasyarṇadīrghatve kṛte tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi iti natve ca yuṣmāniti siddhyatyeva satyaṃ puṃsi siddhyati strīnapuṃsakayostu na siddhyati, tadidaṃ darśitam - yuṣmān asmān brāhmaṇīrityādi |

āta au ṇalaḥ || 7 - 1 - 34 ||
papāvityādau pā - a iti sthite yugapat trīṇi kāryaṇi prāpnuvanti dvirvacanam, savarṇadīrghatvamekādeśaḥ, autvamiti, tatra yena krameṇaitāni kartavyāni, taddarśayati - atreti | litsvaraṃ tu nopanyasyāti, sarvathāntodāttatvasiddheḥ | uktakrame hetumāha - ekādeśāditi | yadi pūrvamekādeśaḥ syāvdyapavargābhāvādautvaṃ na syādityanavakāśaṃ tat | paratvādekādeśa iti | atra vṛddhirekādeśaḥ, tasya sthānivadbhāvād dvirvacanam, sthānivadbhāvastu dvirvacane'ci iti | tatra hyacīti na sthānivadbhāvasya nimittanirddeśaḥ kiṃ tarhi ajādeśasya - dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśa iti | tena sampratyacparatvābhāve'pi sthānivadbhāvo bhavatyeva | okāraukārayorlāghave viśeṣābhāvātprayogasamavāyyaukāra eva vihitaḥ | apara āha - āṅ‌praśliṣṭākāra okāraḥ, tasyoccāraṇe prayatnalāghavaṃ bhavati viśliṣṭākāra aukārastasyoccāraṇe prayatnagauravaṃ bhavati, tadvidhānaṃ daridrātyarthamdadaridrau, atra daridrāterārddhadhātuke lopo vaktavyaḥ ityākāralope'pyaukārasya śravaṇam bhavati | yadyapi siddhaśca pratyayavidhau iti vacanālliṭi vivakṣita evākāra lope satyautvasyāprasaṅgaḥ, yadyapi ca sāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ culumpādyartham ityāmi sati ṇala evāsambhavaḥ, tathāpyautvavidhānasāmarthyād dvayamapyetanna bhavati ||
tuhyostātaṅāśiṣyanyatarasyām || 7 - 1 - 35 ||
jīvatāttvamiti | atra sthānivadbhāvena tātaṅo higrahaṇena grahaṇād ato heḥ iti luk prāpnoti naiṣa doṣaḥ hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ, ityanuvarttamāne punaḥ ato heḥ iti higrahaṇam - hireva yo histasya yathā syāt, sthānivadbhāvena yo histasya mābhūdityevamartham |
ṅitkaraṇamityādi | yadyapi sarvādeśatāyāḥ prāgguṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvamaniścatam, tathāpi sarvādeśatve'pi ṅittvasya prayojanaṃ tātaṅi sambhavati, anaṅādiṣu tu naiva sarvādeśatve prayojanaṃ sambhavatīti teṣvananyārthaṅittveṣu ṅicca ityetat sahasā pravarttate, tātaṅi tu prayojanāntarasambhāvanayā kiyānapi vilambo bhavati | tenāsminviṣaye utsargāpavādayostulyakālā pravṛttirityapavādamapi ṅicca ityetadvādhitvā anekālśitsarvasya ityetadeva paratvātpravarttata iti bhāvaḥ | etacca ṅicca ityatra samyagupapāditam | tatra brūtādityādau guṇapratiṣedhaḥ, mṛṣṭādityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ | ṅittvāccāsyeti | nanu ca ṅitkāryaṃ bhavatu, sthānivadbhāvaprāptapittvātpitkāryamapi, ko virodhaḥ ata āha - ṅicca pinna bhavatīti | vacanamidam sārvadhātukamapit ityatra yogavibhāgena kalpitam | bruva īḍiti | upalakṣaṇametat, tṛṇḍhādbhavān ityatra tṛṇaha im na bhavatīti |
tātaṅi ṅittvamityādi ślokadvayaṃ kvacitpaṭhyate | tātaṅi vyavasthitaṃ ṅittvaṃ saṃkamakṛtsyāt, saṃkramo nāma - guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, arhārthe liṅ, guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhakṛddhavitumarhati | antyavidhiścet, antyavidhihetutvādantyavidhirṅittvam | karaṇasādhano vā vidhiśabdaḥ anttyasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ cet ṅittvamityarthaḥ | nirākaroti - tacca tathā na | caśabdo'vadhāraṇe pratiṣedhena sambadhyate, tat ṅittvaṃ tathā sati naiva karttavyam | eruḥ ityasyānantaram tuhyostādāśiṣi iti vaktavyam, erurityeva, evaṃ siddhe ṅitkaraṇaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthamiti niścīyate | na ca sarvādeśatāmantareṇa tat tatpratiṣedhārthatvaṃ ṅittvasyopapadyata iti
sarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati | nanu cāntyavidhiścāstu avayave kṛtaṃ liṅgam iti nyāyena guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaścāstu ṅitkaraṇasāmarthyādityāśaṅkya parihārāntaramāha - heradhikāra iti | ato heḥ ityatra lopavidhau hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ ityato herityadhikāre satyeva tayo'yaṃ herityadhikārastaṃ jñāpakamāha sūtrakāraḥ, tasya hyetataprayojanam -sa hireva yo histasya yathā stāt, sthānivadbhāvena yo histasya mā bhūditi | tacca sarvādeśatve satyupapadyate |
nanu ca hireva yo histasya yathā syādvikṛto yo histasya mā bhūdityantyā deśatve'pi tātaṅo herityadhikāra upapadyata ityādaśaṅkya sākṣātparihāramāha - tātaṅo ṅittvasāmarthyāditi | ṅittvasāmarthyātkilāyamāntyavidhiḥ syāt, tacca sāmarthyaṃ nāsti, sarvādeśatve'pi prayojanasambhavāt | tataśca pūrvoktayā rītyā vipratiṣedhātsarvādeśa eva tātaṅ bhavati | anaṅ‌ sau tityādāvanaṅādīnāṃ naivaṃ ṅittvasāmarthyābhāvaḥ, tena te'ntyavikāradā jātāḥ ||
videḥ śaturvasuḥ || 7 - 1 - 36 ||

samāse'navpūrve ktvo lyap || 7 - 1 - 37 ||
pūrvaśabdo'vayavacanaḥ,, anañpūrvo'vayavo yatra samāse so'nañpūrvaḥ | prakṛtyeti | samānakartukayoḥ pūrvakāle iti ktvā, kugātiprādayaḥ iti samāsaḥ, lyapi sati hrasvasya tuk | pārśvataḥkṛtyeti | ādyāditvātsaptamyantāttasiḥ, svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ iti ktvā, tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām ktvā ca iti samāsaḥ | nānākṛtya, dvidhākṛtyeti | nādhārthapratyayecvyarthe iti ktvā, pūrvavatsamāsaḥ |

nirdhāraṇe saptamīti | jātāvekavacanam, vacanavyatyo vā | samāsa eva nirdhāryata iti | nirdhāraṇasya tulyajātīyāpekṣatvāt | kathaṃ punaḥ samāsaḥ ktvānto bhavati, yāvatā pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādestadantasya grahaṇ, na ca samāsāt ktvā vihitaḥ atha kṛd‌grahaṇae gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇātsamāsasya ktvānttā evamapi prakṛtya, pārśvataḥkṛtyetyādāveva syāt, uccaikṛtyetyevamādau tu na syāt, agatitvādakārakatvācca ityāśaṅkyāha - sa ceti | tatra nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti ktvāmātrasyaiva lyabbhavati | nanu pratyayaviṣaye pūrveṇa paribhāṣādvayena tadantavidhivyavasthā, na tu yena vidhistadantasya ityanena tatrāha - tathā ceti | kathaṃ punaretajjñāpakam ityāha - gatikārakapūrvasya tviti | kathaṃ nāsti prasaṅgaḥ ityāha - nañna gatiriti | ado jagdhirlyapti kiti ityatra yaduktam - jagdhau siddhamantaraṅgatvāt ityādi, tatsmārayati - pradhāya, prasthāyatyevamādiṣviti |

ktvāpi chandasi || 7 - 1 - 38 ||

supāṃ sulukpūrvasavarṇāccheyāḍāḍyāyājālaḥ || 7 - 1 - 39 ||
suśabda ādeśa ucyamāne anye supo na prāpnuvanti, tasmāt sugrahaṇamapanīya suḍgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityāha - supāṃ supa iti | tiṅāṃ tiṅa iti | etacca vyātyayo bahulam iti siddham | supāṃ supa ityayamapi tasyaiva prapañcaḥ | takṣṇvantīti prāpta tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ |

anaṅo dvitīyo'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, ṅakāro'ntādeśārthaḥ, asthyādayaḥ nabviṣayasyānisantasya ityādyudāttaḥ, śeṣamanudāttam | tatrāntaryato'nudātta ādeśe prāpte udāttavacanamasthnetyādau allopo'naḥ ityakāralope anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ iti vibhakterudāttatvārtham | vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ ityallopābhāvapakṣe tvakārasya udāttasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati - asthanīti, yathā chandasyapi dṛśyate ityatra - indro dadhīco asthamiriti |
