ācchīnadyornum || 7 - 1 - 80 ||
avarṇāntādaṅgāduttarasya śaturiti | sūtrākṣaraistāvadayamevārthaḥ pratīyate ityevaṃ vyākhyātam, na punarayaṃ vyavasthitaḥ sūtrārthaḥ, dūṣaṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasmānnāpradarśitaviṣayaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ śakyaṃ vaktumiti viṣayapradarśanaparamidaṃ draṣṭavyam | yātī kule iti | napuṃsakācca ityauṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ | yātī brāhmaṇīti | ugitaśca iti ṅīp | kariṣyatīti | lṛṭ, lṛṭaḥ sadvā, ṛdvanoḥ sye itīṭ |
atretyādi codyam | antaraṅgatvaṃ punarekādeśasya śatṛmātrāpekṣatvāt | numastu bahiṅgatvam śīnadyutpattyapekṣatvāt | vyapavargaḥ - bhedaḥ - idamavarṇāntamaṅgam, ayaṃ śatṛgratyaya ityevaṃrupaḥ | sa ekādeśe kṛte nāsti, kṣīrodakavat | tadyathā - kṣīrodake saṃyukte na jñāyete - idaṃ kṣīramidamudakam, amuṣminnavakāśe kṣīramamuṣminnavakāśe udakamiti |
avarṇāntādaṅgāduttarasya śaturiti na yujyate vaktumiti | yathā pūrvamavocastathā na yujyata ityarthaḥ | tathā hi sarvatraivāvarṇasya nivṛttyā bhavitavyam, kvacillukā - adatī, dhnatīti, kvacicch‌lunā - juhvatīti, tudatītyādāvekādeśena, lunatītyādau śnābhyastayorātaḥ ityākāralopena | syādetate - ekādeśaviṣeye'ntādivadbhāvena vyāpavargo bhaviṣyatīti tatrāha - ubhayata āśraya iti | yatra ca pūrva paraṃ cobhayaṃ yugapadāśrīyate na tatrāntādivadbhāvo'stīti, yathā upasargād‌dhrasvaḥ ūhate, prohate eterliṅi abhīyāditi | ihāpyavarṇāntamaṅgaṃ śatā cetyubhayaṃ yugapadāśrīyate, iti nāstyantādivadbhāvaḥ | etarhyacyate cedamavarṇāntādaṅgāduttarasya śaturiti, na ca sampratyevaṃvidhaḥ śatā kvacitsambhavati, tatra bhūtapūrvagatirāśrayiṣyate - pūrvaṃ yaḥ śatā kvacitsambhavati, tatra bhūtapūrvagatirāśrayiṣyate - pūrvaṃ yaḥ śatā avarṇāntādaṅgāduttara āsīditi tatrāhabhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇe veti | samādhiḥ - samādhānam, parihāraḥ | avarṇāntācchabdāditi | aṅgāditi draṣṭavyam, anyathā dadatītyādāvapi prasaṅgāt | bhavati hyatrāpi śatravayavādakāratparastakāraḥ | kathaṃ punaravarṇāntasyāṅgatvam ekādeśasyāntavadbhāvāt | na hīdānīṃ parampratyādiṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam takārasya svayameva satravayavatvāt | evaṃ tena takāreṇa punaraṅgasya tadantavidhiḥ, aṅgasya ityetadatrāvartyate |
apare punariti | atrāpi pakṣe yugapadubhayaṃ nāśrīyate, kintu krameṇetyastyantādivadbhāvaḥ | nanu ca tudantītyādāvantādivadbhāvādavarṇāntamaṅgaṃ bhavatuḥ tathāpi na tataḥ pare śīnadyau, takāreṇa vyavadhānāt ityata āha - tatreti | prakṛto num pratiṣedhena sambaddha iti tadanuvatattāvihāpi pratiṣedha eva vikalpena, śīnadyorvā num na bhavati avarṇāntāditi, kena punaḥ prasaṅga idameva jñāpakaṃ syāt - asti śīnadyornumiti, tataśca kurvatītyādāvanavarṇāntannityaṃ numaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, maivaṃ vijñāyīti numgrahaṇam ||

sāvanaḍuhaḥ || 7 - 1 - 82 ||
iha caturanaḍuhorāmudāttaḥ ityāmāgamaḥ sarvanāmasthānamātre vidhīyamānaḥ soranyatra sāvakāśo niravakāśena numā bādhyeta, tathā sambuddheranyatra sau sāvakāśo num sambuddhau viśeṣavihitena am sambuddhau ityanena bādhyeta ityāśaṅkyāha - atra kecidityādi | kathaṃ punarādityāsyānuvṛttau satyāmapyāmamoḥ kṛtayornuma bhavati, na punartha evānaḍuhi nityaḥ sannihito'kārastata eva paraḥ syāt ucyate evaṃ sati midaco'ntyātparaḥ iti paribhāṣā bādhyate, tatrābādhenopapattau satyāṃ bādho na nyāyyaḥ | tatra yathā paribhāṣā na bādhyate ādityanuvṛttiśca sārthikā bhavati, tathā vaktavyam | yadi cāmamorakṛtayornum syāt, nedamubhayamanugṛhītaṃ syāditi kṛtayoreva tayornum bhavi,yati | āmāmau ca na bādhyete iti | na kevalamameva na bādhyate, api tvāmamāvubhāvapi na bādhyete ityarthaḥ | amatra dṛṣṭāntatvenopāttaḥ | yathā'm na bādhyate tathā āmiti bhāvaḥ | na punaramo numā bādhaśaṅkā, amo viśeṣavihitatvāt | āmambhyāṃ ca numitita | na bādhyate iti vacanavipariṇāmenānuṣaṅgaḥ | atrāpi yathā āmā na bādhyate tathā'māpītyarthaḥ | na punarāmā numo vādhaśaṅkā tasya sāmānyatvāt | apare tvityādi | icchanti

panthā iti | ito'tsarvanāmasthāne itīkārasyākāraḥ, savarṇadīrghatvam, tho nthaḥ | anunāsikasya nakārasyāntaryato'nunāsika ākāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ityāśaṅkyāha - sthāninyanunāsike'pīti | akṣa kāraṇamāha - bhāvyamāneneti | kecidbhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇānna gṛhyati iti paṭhanti, teṣāmpyaṇgrahaṇaṃ grāhakopalakṣaṇārtham, tenākāro'pi bhāvyamāno grāhako na bhavati | taparastatkālasya ityanena tu grahaṇaśaṅkā, uktaṃ hi tatra - anaṇi vidhyarthametaditi | syādetat - mā bhūtsavarṇāgrahaṇam, anunāsikasyaiva tu sūtre uccāraṇātsa eva syāt ityata āha - śūddho hyayamiti | akāravidhāne ato guṇe parupaṃ syāt | akāravidhānaṃ tu nakāranivṛttyartha syāt lopavidhau gauravaprasaṅgāt | tasmādākara eva vihitaḥ ||

asuṅo ṅakāro'ntādeśārthaḥ | ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | pumāniti | puṃsśabdasyogittvānnum, sa hi puño ḍumasun iti vyutpādyate | ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ ukāra ugitkāryarthaḥ - bahupuṃsīti ṅīb ugillakṣaṇo bhavati | nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ | makāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ |
ihetyādi | codyam | prāgeva ca pratyayotpatteriti | pratyayaḥ, sarvanāmasthānam | samāsāntodāttatvamiti | puṃsśabdokārasya | aniṣṭaḥ svara iti | sraṃsanadharmaṇaḥ sakārasya halaḥ sthāne taddharmā'nudātta ādeśaḥ syādityarthaḥ
| nanu cokārasyakṛtamapi samāsāntodāttatvamasuṅi kṛte'nantyatvānnivarttiṣyate, asuṅaścāntyatvātpravarttiṣyate naitadasti, thaantaraṅe svare karttavye bahiraṅgasyāsuṅo'siddhatvāt, pravṛttasya nivarttanāyogācca | tadarthamityādi | parihāraḥ | arthaśabdo nivṛttavacanaḥ, tasyāniṣṭasvarasya nivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ | upadeśivadvacanamiti | upadeśo'syāstītyupadeśī, sakāraḥ, sa yathopadeśāvasthāyāṃ sannihitastayā'suṅapītyarthaḥ | sarvanāmasthāne kaiti viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇīyetyuktaṃ bhavatīti, tatra samāsānantarameva paratvādasuṅi kṛte paścādudāttatvaṃ bhavadasuṅa evākārasya bhavatīti siddhamiṣṭam | yadyavam, pumānityādāvasamāse'pi upadeśāvasthāyāmasuṅi kṛte pratipadikasvaro bhavannasuṅa eva syāt ityata āha - pumānityayaṃ punariti | puṃsśabde pratyayo nidityuktam, tatsāmarthyādādyudāttatvam ||
gotā ṇit || 7 - 1 - 90 ||
gāṅ‌kuṭādisūtre yāvantaḥ pakṣāḥ, ihāpi tāvanta eva, ta thaeva guṇā doṣaśca, tadvadeva cātideśapakṣa āśrīyate, yadāha - ṇidbhavatīti | paratra paraśabdaḥ prayukto'ntareṇāpi vatiṃ vatyarthaṃ gamayati, yathā - siṃho māṇavaka iti | ṇidityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sarvanāmasthāne iti saptamyantaṃ prathamayā vipariṇamyate, tatra sarvanāmasthānasya ṇityāryaṃ vidheyaṃ na sambhavatīti ṇiti yatkāryaṃ tatsarvanāmasthāne pūrvasyātidiśyate | tadāha - ṇitkāryāṇi tatra bhavantītyartha iti |

ṇaluttamo vā || 7 - 1 - 91 ||

anaṅ sau || 7 - 1 - 93 ||

atra sici, parasmaipadeṣviti dve api parasaptamyau, tatra sico'hgāpekṣaṃ paratvam, parasmaipadānāṃ sijapekṣam | iko guṇavṛddhī iti vacanādika ityupatiṣṭhate, tatrekāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāttdantavidhirbhavatītyāha - igantasyāṅgasyeti | udāharaṇeṣu astisico'pṛkte itīṭ, seṭaḥ sicaḥ iṭa īṭi iti lopaḥ | nanu cāntarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvād guṇo'ntaraṅgaḥ, bahirbhūtaṃ parasmaipadaṃ sicaṃ cāpekṣata iti vṛddhirbahiraṅgā, tataśca pūrva guṇe kṛte igantasyāṅgasyeti nopapadyate ityata āha - antaraṅgamapīti |
yathaivata tarhi guṇaṃ bādhate tathovaṅamapi bādheta, tatrāha - nyanuvīnnyadhuvīdityatreti | ṇū stutau, dhūñ vidhūnane kuṭādī | yatra hi vṛddhiḥ pravarttate tatrāntaraṅgaṃ bādheta, iha tu pratiṣedhādapravṛttā satī notsahate vādhitam | nanu ca yathā guṇo bādhyate, taevaṃ pratiṣedho'pi bādhanīyaḥ yena nāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati, guṇe ca nāprāpte vṛddhirārabhyate, pratiṣedhe ca prāpte cāprāpte ceti | athaivaṃ kasmānna kalpyate - antaraṅgatvād‌guṇe kṛte vacanādaniko'pi vṛddhirbhavati, yathā - acaiṣīdityādāvekārasya, ahauṣīdityādāvokārasyeti tatrāyamarthaḥ - hmyantakṣaṇa ityatra ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, katham aunayīt, aśvayīdityādau taantaraṅgatvād guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ hmyanta ityeva pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ naivaṃ śakyaṃ kalpayitum , thaevaṃ hi kalpyamāne abhaitsīdityādau vyañjanasyāpi vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ | vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ ityeṣā vyañjanavṛddhiṃ bādhipyate nāprāptāyāṃ tasyāmārambhāt | yatra tarhi sā pratiṣidhyate - anandīt, adevīdityādau, tatra vyañjanasya sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti - naiṣa doṣaḥ neṭi ityanena halantasya yā ca yāvatī ca vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti - vadavrajaḥ iti vā, sici vṛddhiḥ iti vā, sā sarvā pratiṣidhyate | iha tarhi āgavīditi gośabdasyācārakvibantasya sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti ātrāpyantaraṅgatvādavādeśo kṛte halantalakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ | ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vakalpastu satyapi sici vṛddheriglakṣaṇatve bhavati | iha tarhi nyanuvīt, nyadhurvīditi - kṅiti ca iti pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, aniglakṣaṇatvāt mā bhūtpratiṣedhaḥ antaraṅgatvāduvaṅādeśo bhaviṣyati | iha ca akārṣīditi - guṇe raparatve ca kṛte halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ yatrāpi sā pratiṣidhyate - atārīt, astārīditi, tatrāpi ato lrāntasya iti vṛddhiḥ siddhā | iha tarhyalāvīt, ayāvīdantaraṅgatvād guṇāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorhalantalakṣaṇāyāḥ neṭi iti pratiṣedhe ato halādarlaghoḥ iti vakalpaḥ prāpnoti ato lrāntasya ityatra vakāro'pi praśliṣyate | kiṃ vakāro na śrūyate luptanirddiṣṭo vakāraḥ | ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti - mā bhavānavīd, amavīditi ṇiśvigrahaṇamiha pakṣe na karttavyamityuktam, tayoḥ sthāne avimavī prakṣepsyāmi | yattarhi lāghavamasminpakṣe pradarśitam -- ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatīti, tadevaṃ sati hīyate kiṃ cāgavīdityatrāpi ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vikalpaṃ bādhitvā vakārapraśleṣānnityā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti tathā ciprabhṛtibhyo yaṅlugantebhyo luṅi acecāyīdityādau guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoryāntānāṃ neti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, tathā ciriṇoti - ciriṇotyoḥ acirāyīta, ajirāyīd | tasmādantarahgamapi guṇameṣā vṛddhirvacanādvādhata ityetadeva sāmpratam | na punarantaraṅagasya pravṛttimabhyupetya vacanādaniko'pi bhavatīti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamiyameva kalpanā bhavati ṇiśvigrahaṇāt anyathā ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatītyanantaramevoktam ||
ato lrāntasya || 7 - 2 - 2 ||
antaśabdo'yamastyavayavavacanaḥ - vastrāntaḥ, vasanānta iti , asti samīpavacanaḥ - udakāntaṃ gata iti tatrādye pakṣe lrāntasya iti bahuvrīhiḥ, aṅgamanyapadārthaḥ, anyasyārthasyāsambhavāt | tatra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra bahuvrīhiḥ aṅgamanyapadārthaḥ anyasyārthasyāsambhavāt | tatra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhirityeva siddhatvādantagrahaṇamatiricyate | tasmātsamīpavacano'ntaśabdaḥ | tatrāpi yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāta - rephalakārayoḥ samīpabhūtasyāto vṛddhirbhavatīti, tato laṣiraṇiprabhṛtiṣveva syāt‌ | yadi parasamīpavacano'ntaśabdaḥ, atha tu samīpamātravacanasatadā iṣṭaviṣye tāvatsidhyati, aniṣṭe'pi tu viṣaye prāpnoti, tathā akhallīdityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ | tasmātkarmadhāyaḥ, nipātanācca viśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ | samīpabhūtau rephalakārau lrāntaśabdena
vivakṣitau | kasya samīpabhūtāvityapekṣāyām ata ityanena sambandhaḥ | evaṃ viśeṣitābhyāṃ rephalakārābhyāmaṅgasya viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhiḥ | ataḥ samīpabhūtau yau rephalakārau tadantasyāṅgasyeti | yadyevam, ekatvād ataḥ ityasya tasya ca rephalakārayoḥ viśeṣaṇe evaṃ upakṣīṇatvānna vṛddhibhāṅ‌ nirddiṣṭaḥ syāt viśeṣaṇatvenāi tāvadakārasya śrutatvāttasyaiva vṛddhirbhavatītyadoṣaḥ, tadidamuktam - rephalakārau yāvataḥ samīpabhūtāvityādi |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ - samīpabhūtarephalakārāntasyāṅgasyātaḥ sthāne vṛddhirbhavatītyevā kṣaravyāpāraḥ | tatra kasya samīpabhūtāvityapekṣāyāṃ sannidhānādataḥ samīpabhūtāviti gamyate iti | apara āha - raśca laśca lram, āgantuko'kāraḥ, ṣaṣṭhyā lukā nirddeśaḥ, atra lreṇāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāttadantavidhau lrāntasyāṅgasya yo'kārastatra vṛddhirbhavati | kīdṛśasyātaḥ samīpabhūtasya | sannidhānācca lraṃ prati samīpabhūtasyeti | anyaśabdaśca samīpamātravacano na tu paramasīpavacanaḥ iti |
udāharaṇeṣu , kṣara sañcalane, tsara chadma gatau, jvala dīptau, hvala calane |
nyakhorīt, nyamīlīditi | khura chedane, mīla nimeṣaṇe | mā bhavānityādi | aṭa gatau, aśa bhojane māṅaḥ prayoga aḍāgamanivṛttyarthaḥ |
avamrīt, akhallīditi | vabhrirgatyarthaḥ, khallirāśu gamane | athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na lraḥ ityavocyeta ihāpi tarhi prapnoti - avabhrīt, akhallīditi akārameva sicparatvena viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ lrāntasyāṅgasya yo'kārastasya sicyanantare vṛddhirbhavatīti | na ca rephalakārantasyāṅgasya yo'kārastasya sijavyavahitaḥ sambhavatīti sāmarthyāt yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyādityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrayiṣyate | atha vā ato halāderlaghoḥ ityasyānantara midaṃ karttavyam, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ ata ityapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, tatra laghoḥ, ityanuvṛtterakhallīdityādau na bhaviṣyati | evamapi catuśśabdādācārikvipi luṅi sici cakārasyāpi prāpnoti tatrāpi sicā''nantaryaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, tatra yathā acakāsīdityatra ato halāderlaghoḥ iti cakārākārasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tatkasya hetoḥ sicā ānantarthaṃ viśeṣyata iti | evaṃ catuśśabde'pi na bhaviṣyati | evaṃ ca kṛtvā laghoḥ ityapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ || 7 - 2 - 3 ||
vikalpabādhanārthamiti | ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vikalpo vakṣyate | neṭi iti pratiṣedhe prāpta iti tu noktam vikalpasyaiva vastutaḥ prāptatvāt | atretyādi | vadavrajyoḥ ityeko yogaḥ, acaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ tatrāṅgenājviśeṣyata iti - aṅgasya yo'c yatra tatra sthitastasyeti , tena halantasya siddhā vṛddhiriti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamaṅgenājviśeṣyate, na punaracā'ṅgasyeti asambhavāt | acikīrṣīdityādau adantasya tāvat neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ ākārantaṃ tu sici na sambhavati, yamaramanamātāṃ sakca iti sagmavidhānāt | sambhave vā nāsti viśeṣaḥ satyāṃ vā vṛddhāvasatyāṃ vā | igantasya tu sici vṛddhiḥ ityeva siddhā vṛddhiḥ | ejantamapyātvavidhānānnaiva sambhavati | agavīdityatra tu neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ | tadevamaṅgenājviśeṣyata iti sahṛdayamabhidhānam | evaṃ pratyākhyāte halgrahaṇe, prayojanamāha - tadetaditi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamantareṇa hal‌grahaṇaṃ halsamudāyasya parigraho na siddhyati ata tathaāha - anyathā hīti | etacca yadā vṛddhibhāgājeva sicparatvena viśeṣyate, tadā veditavyam | aṅge tu viśeṣya māṇe sarvatra sidhyati | na caivamacakāsīdityādiṣvanekākṣu pūrvasyāpyaco vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ, neṭi iti pratiṣedhāt | na cānekājaniḍasti | na cāpākṣīdityādāvaṭaḥ prasaṅagḥ, kiṃ kāraṇam luṅi yadaṅgaṃ sijantaṃ tadbhakto'ḍāgamastad‌grahaṇenaiva gṛhyate na tu sici yadaṅgaṃ tad‌grahaṇena | yatrāpi sico luk kriyate - adātu, adhāt iti, tatra sicparatvābhāvād vṛddheraprasaṅgaḥ |
udavoḍhāmiti | vaherluṅ, tasastām, sic, vaha - stāmiti sthite - vṛddhiśca prāpnoti ḍhatvādīni ca, ādipadena jhalo jhali iti sico lopaḥ, jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ iti dhatvaṃ ṣṭutvaṃ ḍhalopa ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam | tatra ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ vṛddhiḥ kriyate, paścāt ḍhalopanimittamottavam | atha tasya punarvṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - tatra kṛta iti | kṛtatvāditi | yadyapyekārasya na kṛtā vṛddhiḥ tathāpi prayoge'smin kṛteti bhāvaḥ |
yatra tviti | na hyokāratvanibandhano vṛddherabhāvaḥ, kintu kṛtatvanibandhana iti bhāvaḥ | soḍhā abhibhūtā
amitrā yena sa soḍhāmitraḥ ||
neṭi || 7 - 2 - 4 ||
udāharaṇeṣu - divu krīḍādau , sivu tantusantāne, kuṣa niṣkarṣe, muṣa steye iti dhātavaḥ |
nanucetyādi codyam | naitadevamityādi parihāraḥ | ubhayamapyetat sicivṛddhisūtre vyākhyātam ||
hmyantakṣaṇaśvasajāgṛṇiśvyeditām || 7 - 2 - 5 ||
udāharaṇeṣu graha upādene, syamu svanadhvana śabde, ṭuvama ud‌giraṇe, vyayavittasamutsarge, kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām, śvasa praṇane, jagṛ nidrākṣaye, ūna parihāṇe ila preraṇe curādī, ṭuośvi gativṛddhyoḥ, rage lage sage sarvaraṇe, kakhe khage kage hasane iti dhātavaḥ | ūnayatyelayatyornonayatidhvanayatīti caṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
yadi ca pūrva guṇaḥ syādityādi | etadapi sicivṛddhisūtra eva vyākhyātam | atha jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti | yena pṛṣṭaṃ sa eva yathaitanna karttavyaṃ tathā darśayati - jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsviti | kṛte guṇe ityādi | aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhiḥ ityetat nāśritam, niṣṭhitatvasya durjñānatvāt | atha tviti | anyathā vṛddhiviṣaye guṇavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tathā ceti | ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhena uttarakālabhāvivṛddhimātraṃ na bhavatīti sāmānyena jñāpyate, na tūpadhālakṣaṇavṛddhirna bhavatītyevaṃ viśeṣeṇeti bhāvaḥ | jāgṛgrahaṇe sati cāyaṃ sūtrāṇāṃ prāptikramaḥ, jāgṛ - is - īt iti sthite pūrva yaṇ prāptaḥ, tamapavādatvāt sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ iti guṇo bādhate, tamapi sici vṛddhiḥ, tāmapi jāgartiguṇaḥ, tatra kṛte halantalatraṇā vṛddhiḥ, tasyāḥ neṭi iti pratiṣedhaḥ, tataḥ ato halāderlaghoḥ iti vakalpaḥ, tataḥ ato lrāntasya iti nityā vṛddhiḥ, tato'yaṃ pratiṣedha thaiti | āha ca

ato halāderlaghoḥ || 7 - 2 - 7 ||
nyukuṭīt, nyapuṭīditi | kuṭa kauṭilye, puṭa saṃśleṣaṇe | nanvatra kuṭāditvānṅittve sati khiti ca pratiṣedhādeva vṛddhirna bhaviṣyati, kimatra ataḥ ityanena tatrāha - ata ityetasminnasatīti | atakṣīt, arakṣīditi | takṣū, tvakṣū, tanūkaraṇe, rakṣa pālane, sicparatvenāṅgasya viśeṣaṇādatra prasaṅgaḥ |
atheha kasmānna bhavatīti | yadi sicparatvenāṅga viśeṣyate, tato'trāpi prasaṅga iti praśnaḥ | sicparatvenāko viśeṣyate ityāśrityottaram | yena nāvyavadhānamiti vacanaprāmaṇyāditi | apipaṭhiṣīdityādāvanantatarasyākārasyāto lopena bhavitavyam | nanu cobhayorapyanityayoḥ paratvādvaddhiḥ prāpnoti astu vṛddhiḥ, āto lopa iṭi ca ityākāralopo bhaviṣyati na bhaviṣyati paratvātsagiṭau syātām evaṃ tarhi ṇyallopāviyaṅuvaṅyaṇguṇavṛddhidīrghabhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣiddhau ityato lopo bhavithyati, yathā - cikīrṣaka ityatra | yukataṃ tatra aco ñṇiti iti vṛddhiranyatra caritārthā, iyaṃ tu sicyantarasyātau vidhīyamānā niravakāśā eṣaṃ tarhi halantasya ityanuvṛtteranantaro'kāro na sambhavatītyetsāmarthyam |
atha tviti | vyavadhānena bhavitavyamiti sthite halā vyavadhānamiti kalpanāyāṃ laghugrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, ekena varṇeneti tu kalpanāyāṃ na kartavyamityarthaḥ ||
neḍ‌vaśi kṛti || 7 - 1 - 8 ||
vaśi kṛtīti saptamīnirddeśastadādividhyarthaḥ tasya ca vayaṃ purastātkaraṇasya prayojanaṃ krādisūtre vakṣyāmaḥ| īśitetyaderupanyāsaḥ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedho na sidhyati iti pradarśanārthaḥ | īśvara iti | stheśabhāsa ityādinā varac | dīpramiti | namikampi ityādinā raḥ | bhasmeti | anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante iti manin | auṇadike tvavyutpattipakṣāśrayaṇenāpi siddham | yācñeti | yajayāca ityādinā naṅ |

ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt || 7 - 1 - 10 ||
anudāttāditi bahuvrīhiḥ na vidyate udātto yasmin so'yamanudāttaḥ | pāribhāṣike tvanudātte'jmātrāṇāmiṇādīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nājjhalsamudāyarupāṇaṃ paciprabhṛtīnāma | tataśca teṣāmanudāttopadeśo'narthakaḥ syāt | atha vā - upadeśe|ṛnudāttādekācaḥ śrūyamāṇāditi krādisūtre niyamo nopapadyeta cakṛva, cakṛmetyādau śrūyamāṇarupasyānekāctvādvidhireva syāt, tatra ko doṣaḥ bibhidiva, bibhidima atreḍāgamo na syāt | nanu ca sampratyanekāctvādatra pratiṣedhāsyāprasaṅgādeveḍ‌ bhaviṣyati iha tarhi peciva, pecim, etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayorekācaḥ śrūyamāṇādiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | paratvādiṭi kṛte etavābhyāsalopau bhaviṣyataḥ nityāvetvābhyāsalopau kṛte'pīṭi prapnato'kṛte'pi iṭ punaranityaḥ - krādaya eva liṭyaniṭa iti | liṭyeva krādayo'niṭaḥ ityeṣa tu viparīto'tra niyamo na bhavati krādīnāmanudāttopadeśasāmarthyāt | kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ, tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūtaḥ, parivṛto rathaḥ stutastomayoḥ ityādinirdeśācca |
kena punareṣāmiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, yato niyamārtho'yamārambhaḥ ityata āha - anudāttopadeśānāmityādi | vṛṅvṛñbhyāmanye'nudāttopadeśāsteṣāṃ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ ekāca upadeśe itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | vṛṅavṛñostu pratyayāśrayaḥ śryukaḥ kiti ityeṣaḥ | tasmādubhayasyāpi - prakṛtyāśrasya, pratyayāśrayasya ca | kathaṃ punarayaṃ pratyayāśrayacasya niyamaḥ, yāvatā vṛgrahaṇaṃ vṛñasthali vidhyarthaṃ sambhavati, na hi tatra prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, vṛña udāttatvāt, nāpi ptyayāśrayaḥ thalaḥ kittvābhāvāt, asati pratyayāśrayasya nitayame luluvithetyādāviṇna syāt ityata āha - vṛño hīti | vyavasthā - niyamaḥ | iha tuṣṭothetyādau ṛto bhāradvājasya ityetasmānniyamādiṭ prāpnoti, yayithetyādivat | yathā hi yayitha, papithetyādau ādhedhātukasya itīṭ praptaḥ ekācaḥ iti niṣiddhaḥ, punaḥ krādiniyamāt prāptaḥ acastāsvatthali iti pratiṣiddhaḥ, tataḥ ṛto bhāradvājasya thali pratiṣedho nānyebhyaḥ iti niyamātpakṣe iḍ‌ bhavati, tathātrāpi syāt | kathaṃ khalu krādiniyamasya bādhakam acastāsvat iti pratiṣedhaṃ bādhamāno bhāradvājaniyamaḥ krādipratiṣedhaṃ na bādhate kṛsubhṛvṛ ityeteṣu purvāyaṃ doṣasteṣāmṛkārāntatvena bhāradvājapakṣe'pīṭaḥ pratiṣedhāt | evaṃ tarhi studrusruśruvāṃ grahaṇaṃ vidhyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, taasati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati, iha cāsti vidheyam, kim thali bhāradvājaniyamādiṭaḥ prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ, itareṣāṃ tu krādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ niyamārtha bhaviṣyatīti | bibhidiva, luluvivetyādāvapi na doṣaḥ | kathaṃ punastuṣṭumaḥ atra hi krādiniyamādiṭ‌ prāpnoti naiṣa doṣaḥ studrusruśruvāṃ grahaṇamubhayorapi pratiṣedhārtham | yaśca krādiniyamādiṭ prāptaḥ yaśca bhāradvājaniyamāt, tayorubhayorapītyarthaḥ |
yadyevam, yena nāprāptinyāyena krādiniyamameva studrusruśruvāṃ pratiṣedho bādheta, na tu vikalpena prāptaṃ bhāradvājaniyamam, tataścāsau syādeva ityāśaṅkyāha -- pūrvakatvātapratiṣedhasya pūrva vidhiprakaraṇaṃ paṭhitavyam, ārdhadhātukasya ityārabhya īḍaḍajanordhve ca ityevamantam, paścātapratiṣedhaprakaraṇam, tadyathā'nyatrāpi - karttari karmavyatihāre , na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ iti | tatrāyamartho dviriḍ‌grahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, prakṛtamanuvarttate | nanvevam, rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke iti sārvadhātukagrahaṇam, liṅaḥ salopo'nanttayasya ityatra vicchidyeta evaṃ tarhi na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ ityatraiva paṭhitavyam, evaṃ hi vidhyuttarakāraśca pratiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavati, dviśceḍ‌grahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ ca salope na vicchidyate, api ca dviḥpratiṣedho na karttavyo bhavati, so'yamevaṃ siddhe yatpurastātapratiṣedhakāṇḍaṃ karoti, tasyaitataprayojanam - thaanāśritavidhānaviśeṣamiṇmātramanārabhyādhītena pratiṣedhena yathā bādhyeteti | yadi tu bhāradvājaniyamātparamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ kriyeta, tato madhye'pavādanyāyeva māradvājaniyamaḥ acastāsvat iti pratiṣedhemeva, bādheta, na tu krādiniṣedhamiti purastātapratiṣedhakaraṇe na kaściddoṣaḥ |
apara āha - yatra tatra vā pratiṣedhakaraṇamastu, sarvathā tu bhāradvājaniyamaḥ acastāsvat iti yogadvayena thali yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāptastasyaiva niyāmakaḥ, anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā iti, tataśca studrusruśruvāmapi bhāradvājaniyameva thaacastāsvat iti pratiṣedha eva nivarttate, na tu krādipratiṣedhaḥ iti | tanmate purastātpratiṣedhakaraṇasya prayojanamuttaratra darśayiṣyāmaḥ |

sārvadhātuka iti tatrāha - rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuka ityetastaminniti | niyame tvetasmin vijñāyamāne viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyate - rudādibhayaḥ sārvadhātuke eveti | tatra ca vaktavyaṃ rudavideti ktvāsanoḥ kittvavidhānānna bhaviṣyati | taaniṭaḥ sano jhalāderhalantācca ityeva siddhatvāt | ktvo'pyaniṭa aupadeśikakittvasadbhāvāditi, tataśca pratipattigauravaṃ syāt | nanu cāsatyārdhadhātukagrahataṇe aṅagsya ityadhikārattasyaiveṭ‌ prāpnoti, yathā luṅ‌laṅ‌lṛṅ‌kṣvaḍudāttaḥ iti jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam ekāca upadeśeṣanudāttāt iti pratyayasyaṭ‌pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, yacca niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi na ktvā seṭ ityāha, tajjñāpayati - pratyayasyaivāyamiḍiti | na ca vṛkṣatvamityādau pratipadikapratyayasya prasaṅagaḥ, ṝta taiddhatoḥ ityadhikārāt | evamapi jugupsate, l‌bhyām, lūbhirityādau prasaṅgaḥ idito num dhātoḥ ityato dvitīyamapi dhātugrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, tatraikaṃ svarupapadārthakam, tataśca dhātoḥ ityevaṃ dhātusaṃśbadanena vihitasya dhātoḥ parasyeḍ‌vidhānānna kvāpyaniṣṭaṃ rūpam | tadevaṃ bahupratividheyatvāt pratipattigauravaparihārtham ārdhadhātukasya ityuktam |
pratiṣedhanivṛttyarthamiti | kena punaḥ prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ śaṅkyate idameva vacanaṃ kalpakaṃ syāt - astyārddhadhātukamātrasyeṭ‌, yato valādeḥ pratiṣidhyata iti | taneṅvaśi kṛti thaityādikastu pratiṣedho niyamārthaḥ syāt ||
snukramoranātmanepadanimitte || 7 - 2 - 36 ||
snukramorudāttatvādiṭi siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam - anātmanepadanimitta eva yathā syādanyatra mā bhūditi | atha prasnutaḥ, prasnutavān, prasusnūṣati, krāntaḥ, krāntavān - ityatra śryukaḥ kiti, sani grahaguhośca, yasya vibhāṣā iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vidhyarthametatkasmānna bhavati purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇāt | tasya hi prayojanam - anāśritavidhānaviśeṣasyeṇmātrasya pratiṣedho yathā syāditi | yadyanātmanepadanimitta iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ snukramorātmanepadanimittatve satīṇna bhavatīti, evaṃ ca pratiṣedhaprakaraṇa evaitatpaṭhitavyam, tatrāyabhaṣyatheḥ - nañupādānaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati tathā tu na kṛtamityeva |
atra yadyātmanepadaśabdena nañaḥ samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścānnimittaśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kriyeta - ātmanepadādanyadanātmanepadam, parasmaipadamiti yāvat, tasya nimittam, tataśca yatra snukramau parasmaipadanimitte - cakramitha, cakramiva, cakramima, prāsnāvīt, prasusnuvivetyādau - tatraiveḍ‌bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataśca kṛti na syāt - prasnavitā, prastravitum, prasnavitavyam, prakramitā, prakramitum, prakramitavyamiti, tathā cikramiṣatītyatrāpi na syāt, na hi sanantādutpadyamānasya parasmaipadasya kramirnimittam, parasmaipadagrahaṇameva ca karttavyaṃ syāt, tasmādātmanepadaśabdasya nimittaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścānnañā samāsaḥ karttavyaḥ | prasajyapratiṣedhe tvanunmeṣa evāsya pakṣasya syāt | tatra yadyanātmanepadanimitta iti saptamyekavacanaṃ syāt, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt - ātmanepadasya yannimittaṃ ṅakārādi tasminsati na bhavatīti, tataśca prasnavitrīyata ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, vidyate hyatrātmanepadasya nimittam kyaṅo ṅakāra iti | prathamādvivacanāntaṃ snukramorviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati - na cet snukramau ātmanepadasya nimittamiti | vedāḥ pramāṇam itivadekavacanam | sūtre tu pratyekaṃ nimittatvasya vivakṣitatvāt dvivacanam | nimittaśabdo'yamasti yogyatāmātre - kusūlastheṣvapi bījeṣu vaktāro bhavanti - aṅkuranimittānyatānīti asti ca kurvadrūpe | tatrādye pakṣe kṛtyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - prasnavitā, prasnavitum, prasnavitavyam, prakramitā, prakrimitum, prakramitavyamiti | asti hyatra yathāyogaṃ bhāvakarmakartṛviṣayatvādātmanepadaṃ prati yogyatvam, tadiha kiṃ vivakṣitam iti pṛcchati - kva ca tāvātmanepadasya nimittamiti | itaro'pi kurvadrūpapakṣāśrayaṇena pariharati - yatretyādi | atraivaṃ vyākhyeyam - yatrātmanepadaṃ tadāśrayaṃ bhavati tatraivātmanepadasya
nimittam | kiṃ punastadyatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati ityata āha - bhāvakarmetyādi | atra hi viṣaye snukramyoḥ śrūyamāṇamātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, kurvadrūpa eva nimittaśabdo mukhyaḥ, yogyatāmātre tvaupacārika iti bhāvaḥ | nanu ca bhāvakarmādiṣu ta evārthā ātmanepadasya nimittam, snukramī, kva tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ syād yatra hi krimireva nimittam, anupasargādvā - kraṃsyate naiṣa doṣaḥ, bhāvakarmakarttāraḥ krameśca vṛttyādayaḥ | sarvamevaitaddhātoreva viṣayatayā viśeṣaṇam, dhātureva tu sākṣādātmanepadasya mimittam - bhāvādiviṣayāddhātorātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti | tenetyādi | yata
evaṃ kurvadrūpamevātra nimittam, tenāyaṃ satyātmanepade pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ |
kimucyate pratiṣedha iti, yāvatā paryudāsāśrayeṇokapakrame vyākhyātam tatrāha - pratiṣedhaphalaṃ cedaṃ sūtramiti | satyaṃ paryudāse'pi niyamārthatvānniyamasya cetaravyāvṛttiphalakatvādevamuktamityarthaḥ |
prasnoṣīṣṭeti | āśiṣi liṅ, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityātmanepadam | prakaṃsīṣṭeti | atra tu propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām iti karttari | sarvatretyādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe darśayati | nanu sanantādvidhīyamānasyātmanepadasya sa eva dhāturnimittaṃ na snukramī tatrāha - sanantādapīti | pūrvavaditi vacanātprakṛtigatameva sanante'pi nimittamiti bhāvaḥ | yadā tarhi sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ tadā pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, na hi tadā prakṛtigataṃ nimittamapekṣitam, kiṃ tarhi sanantameva svatantraṃ nimittam, putrīyata ityādivat evaṃ tarhi sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorapi pūrvavatsanaḥ ityātmanepadaṃ bhaviṣyati etayorarthayoḥ sanprakṛtāvātmanepadasya dṛṣṭatvāt | tatra yadyapi sanantamapi svayameva nimittamupapadyate, tathāpi bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityasyāvakāśaḥ - bhūyate, pacyate pūrvavatsanaḥ ityasyāvakāsaḥ - śiśayiṣate sanantādbhāvakarmaṇorubhayaprasaṃge paratvāt pūrvavatsanaḥ ityanena bhaviṣyati | yadi paraṃ viśeṣo nāstītyucyate tadapi na atraiva viśeṣasya sambhavāt | evamapi na sidhyati, pūrvavatsanaḥ ityatra karttari karmavyatihāre ityataḥ kartarītyanuvṛtteḥ | tatra hi prakaraṇe sarvajñaiva kartariti sambadhyate | athāpi na sambadhyate, evamapi yadā sanantād ṇici kṛte ṇicaśca iti, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ iti vā ātmanepadam, tadā pratiṣedho na sidhyati - cikraṃsyate, cikraṃsyata iti | kiṃ ca - bhostadānīmapi pratiṣedha iṣyate bāḍhamiṣyate | yadāha vārttikakāraḥ - siddhaṃ tu snorātmanepadena samānapadasthasyoṭ‌pratiṣedhāt, krameśca iti | tadevamātmanepadena samānapadasthatve pratiṣedhaṃ kurvato vārttikakārasyaivaṃvidhe viṣaye pratiṣedha iṣṭo lakṣyate | yathā punarvṛttikāreṇa vyākakhyātaṃ tathā na prāpnoti karttavyo'tra yatraḥ |
yadi satyātmanepade pratiṣedhaḥ mā kāri nimittagrahaṇam anātmanepade ityevāstu, satisaptamī vijñāsyate - ātmanepade sati na bhavatīti, yadyetallabhyate kṛtaṃ syāt, tattu na labhyam, śāstre yāḥ saptamyastāḥ sarvā parasaptamya iti niyamāt parasapatamyāṃ tu yadi snukramorviśeṣaṇaṃ snukramorātmanepade'nantara iti, siddhaṃ prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakrasīṣṭa, prasnoṣyate, prakraṃsyate - atra na prāpnoti, syena vyavahitatvāt | ārthārdhadhātukasya viśeṣaṇam - snukramibhyāṃ parasyārdhadhātukasyātmanepade'nantara iti siddhaṃ prasnoṣyate, prakraṃsyate, prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭa - atra na prāpnoti, sīyuṭa ātmanepadabhaktatvāt | ubhayathāpi pracikraṃsiṣyate - atra na prāpnoti, na hyatra kramestatparasya sārvadhātukasyātmanepadamanantaram | tasmānnimittagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam | tadāhanimittagrahaṇamityādi | tadātmanepadaṃ paraṃ yasmātsa tatapraḥ, pracikrasiṣyate ityādau syapratyayaḥ, sa paro yasmātsa tatparaḥ, sanpratyayaḥ | iha tvityādi | prageva vyākyātam | prasnavitrīyata iti | rīṅ‌ ṛtaḥ | vāttikakāramate'pyatra pratiṣedho na bhavati, katham samānapadasthasya iti vacanāt iḍāgamena padāvasthāpekṣaṇīyā | tatra tṛci vibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ labdhe'pi padatve ātmanepadasyāsannidhānādiṭ‌ pravarttate | pratikraṃsiṣyata ityatra tu padāvasthāyāmātmanepadasannidhānāt pratiṣedhapravṛttiḥ|
ātmanepadaviṣayāditi | tadyegyādityarthaḥ | satyātmanepade pratiṣedha ityuktatvādidamārabhyate | anupasargātkrameḥ krantā, kramitā - ityubhayamapi bhavati anupasargādvā iti vakalpenātmanepadanimittatvādityeke | anye tvātmanepadaviṣayāditi ananyabhāve viṣayaśabdaṃ varṇayantaḥ krimitetyeva bhavitavyamityāhuḥ |
snauteḥ sani kiti ceti | upalakṣaṇametat | krameśca niṣṭhāyām yasya vibhāṣā iti draṣṭavyam | pratiṣadho bhavatīti | atra hetuḥ prāgevoktaḥ ||
graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ || 7 - 2 - 37 ||
graha uttarasyeṭa iti | kathaṃ punariṭo dīrghatvaṃ labhyate, iḍiti yatprakṛtaṃ tadvai prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ evaṃ tarhi ṣaṣṭhyantapraparaṃ kariṣyāmi | evamapi doṣaḥ, prakṛtamiṭamanapekṣyeṭa ityucyamāne'viśeṣācciṇvadiṭo'pi dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ astu tarhi praśamāntameva | tatra dīrgha iṭ‌ bhavatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye sāmarthyādīḍāgame vidhiḥ sampadyate | iṭ‌ dīrgha iti cedvipratiṣiddham, yadiṭ na dīrghajha,
atha dīrgho neṭ, iṭ‌ dīrghaśceti vipratiṣiddham syādetat - dīrgha iḍadbhavatītyukte sāmarthyāvdyaktiparatyāgera ikārajātirāśrīyate, dīrghagrahaṇācca tavdyaktisamavetā sā vidhīyata iti | evamapi doṣaḥ, vivarīṣate ityatra sanīṭi prapte vṝto vā ityanena pakṣe dīrgha iṭi ca prasakte sani grahaguhośca ityubhayasminnapi pratiṣiddhe iṭ‌ sani veti pakṣe iḍvidhīyate | tatra punariṭo vidhānābhāvātpakṣe dīrgha īkāro na śrūyeteti naiṣa doṣaḥ iṭ sani vā ityatra dīrgha iṭ iti, vṝtaḥ iti cānuvartiṣyate | yattarhi videśasthamiṭaṃ pratiṣidhya purvidhānaṃ tatra na sidhyati - jṝvraścoḥ ktvi, jaritvā, jarītvā, atrodāttatvādiṭ prāptaḥ vṝto vā ityanena ca dīrgha iṭ, tato dvayorapi śryukaḥ kiti caiti pratiṣedhe punariḍvidhīyate, na ca tatra dīrghagrahaṇasyānuvṛttisambhavaḥ | nanu ca śryukaḥ kiti ityatra neḍvaśi ityadhikārāvdyaktipakṣāśrayaṇācca iṭa ekamātrasya niṣedhaḥ, na dīrghasyeṭaḥ, tataḥ kim vṝto vā ityanena vihito dīrgha iṭ tatheva sthitaḥ, jṛvraścoḥ ktvi ityanena ceṭ pratiprasūyate iti jaritvā, carītveti davyamapi siddhaṃ bhavati syādevaṃ yadyāgamāntaramīḍvīdhīyate, iha tu iḍ dīrghaḥ, iti vacanādiṭakāryamasyāpi bhavatyeva | anyathā agrahīdityatra hmyantakṣaṇa iti vṛddhapratiṣedhaḥ iṭa īṭi iti sijlopaśca agrahīḍh‌vam, agrahīdhvam, vibhāṣeṭaḥ iti mūrddhanyavikalpaḥ, jarītveti na ktvā seṭ iti kittvapratiṣedhaḥ ityete vidhayo na sidhyeyuḥ | tasmādiṭ‌kāryamasyāpīṭo bhavatītyaṅgīkarttavyam, tataśca videśasthaṃ pratiṣidhya punarvidhāne sthita eva doṣaḥ syāt, tasmāddīrdha iḍaśakyo vidhātum | evaṃ tarhi ārdhadhātukasya iti varttate, graha uttarasyārddhadhātukasya dīrgho bhavati | ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti - grahaṇīyam valādeḥ iti vartate | ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti - grītā, grahītumiti bhūtapūrvagatirvijñāsyate | ihāpi tarhi prāpnoti - grāhaka iti astu tarhi iḍityeva | nanu coktaṃ ṣaṣṭhīnirddeṣṭena cehārtha iti grahaḥ iti pañcamī iḍiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayiṣyati - tasmādityuttarasya iti |
prakṛtasyeti | ārdhadhātukasyeḍ‌ ityanantaraṃ vihitasya | ciṇvadiṭo na bhavatīti | jaritvetyatra tu ārdhadhātukasyeḍ‌ ityayameveṭ pratiṣiddhaḥ pratiprasūyate iti bhavatyeva dīrghaḥ | iha jarīgṛhiteti yaṅantātṛcyallopayalopayoḥ kṛtayordviṣprayogo dvirvacanamiti sa evāyaṃ grahiriti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti pūrvasmādapi vidhau yaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ so'pi dīrghavidhau pratiṣiddhaḥ | tasmādvihitaviśeṣaṇamihāśrayaṇīyam - graheryadvihitamārdhadhātukaṃ tasya ya iṭ tasya dīrgha iti |

svaratisūtisūyatidhūñūdito vā || 7 - 2- 44 ||
atra svarateranudāttatvādaprāpte, taitareṣāṃ tu prāpte vibhāṣā |
veti vattamāna iti | iṭ‌ sani vā ityataḥ | liṅ‌sicornivṛttyarthamiti | anyathā vāgrahataṇasambaddhayostayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt | pūpreraṇa ityasya nivṛttyartha iti | anyathā niranubandhakatvāttasyaiva grahakakaṇaṃ syāt | evaṃ tarhi sūṅiti vaktavyam evamapi lugvikaraṇālugvikarakaṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahakaṇam iti sūyatereva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sūteḥ | tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā astitve'yameva vikaraṇanirddeśo jñāpakaḥ | dhūvidhūnana ityasya nivṛttyartha iti | anyathā pūrvavattasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt | dhuviteti | kuṭāditvānḍittvam |
svarateriti | asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ - svarttā, svaritā, ṛddhanoḥ sye ityasyāvakāśaḥ - kariṣyati, svarateḥ sye ubhayaprasaṅge vipratiṣedhaḥ | kiti tu pratyaya śryuka iti | nanu cāyaṃ vikalpo yathā ekājlakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate tṛjādau, tathā killakṣaṇamapi pratiṣedhaṃ bādheta na bādheta, katham yena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ bhavati | tasmādapabādatā tāvadekājlakṣaṇameva pratiṣedhaṃ pratyasya bhavati, kityubhayaprasaṅge purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇātpratiṣedha eva bhavati | liṅgācca, yadayam svṛyūrṇubharajñapisanām iti vikalpaṃ śāsti, anyathā anenaiva satyapi vikalpasya siddhatvātpunastaṃ na vidadhyāt | vṛttau tu vipratiṣedhaśabdenāpi purastātpratiṣedhakāṇḍakaraṇameva vivakṣitam, samānaphalatvāt ||

yadā tu tvāmocaṣṭe, māmācaṣṭa iti vigṛhya kvip kriyate, tadā pratyayottarapadayośca iti tvamayoḥ kṛtayoḥ prakṛtyaikāc iti prakṛtibhāvādasati ṭilope ata upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ | yadi niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ tato vadaddhyabhāvaḥ | tvads tvāds, mads camādas iti sthite maparyantābhāvāt tvāhau sau ityāderapravṛttau vṛddhipakṣe tvāmiti bhavati | pakṣāntare tu tvamiti | dvivacane tu tvām, jasi tvam | dvitīyādiṣu tu tvām, tvām, tvān, tvayā, tvābhyām, tvābhiḥ, tvam, tvābhyām, tvabhyam, tvat, tvābhyām, tvat, tva, tvayoḥ, tvākam, tvayi, tvayoḥ tvāsu | evamasmado'pi |

| tena pāṭhopajīvanena pravartamānamidamapi saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ na bhavati | tyadādīti | tyādādīnāmarthaḥ pradhānaṃ yatra samāse tatretyarthaḥ | na hi te pāṭhātparyudastāḥ ||
kimaḥ kaḥ || 7 - 2 - 103 ||
tenākāra eva kimo na vidhīyata iti | kathaṃ punarakāravidhāne kaḥ ityādirūpasiddhiḥ, yāvatāntyasya prāpnoti, na cāntyasya pūrṣeṇa siddhaḥ, dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ ityuktatvāt apare punaretaccodyabhayādevaṃ paṭhanti - tenākāra eva imo na vidhīyata iti | ayamarthaḥ - imaḥ ityetāvatsūtramastu, tyadādīnāmaḥ ityeva tyadādīnāṃ sambandhina imo'kāro bhavati tatra nānarthake'lentyavidhiḥ iti sarvasyaivemo'kāro bhavati | teṣāmevaṃ paṭhatāmuttaratra kimo grahaṇaṃ karttavyam na karttavyam uti hoḥ iti vakṣyāmi imaḥ ityevra, tato vāti imaḥ ityeva, imo vakārādeśo bhavati | tasmātsākackārthameva kādeśo vihitaḥ ||
ku tihoḥ || 7 - 2 - 104 ||
tiśabdasya vibhaktisaṃjñakasyābhāvāttakāre ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | kuheti | vā ha ca chandasi iti hapratyayaḥ ||
kvāti || 7 - 2 - 105 ||
kveti | kimo't ityatpratyayaḥ ||
athadeśāntarakaraṇaṃ kimartham, na prakṛtaḥ kuśabda eva vidhīyate, evaṃ ca kṛtvā yogāvibhāgo'pi na kartavyaḥ kutihātsu ityevāstu kā rūpasiddhiḥ yaṇādeśe kṛte kveti siddham, orguṇastu aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttau iti vacanānna bhaviṣyati, yaṇadeśastvanāṅgatvādbhavatyeva tatrāha - ādeśāntarakaraṇamorguṇanivṛttyarthamiti | niṣṭhitatattvaṃ durjñānamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ tarhi kimo't ityetat kimoḍ‌vat iti vaktavyam, ṭilopo kṛte kveti siddham ata āha - kimoḍ‌vaditi ceti | kathaṃ punaḥ pratyayāntare rūpasiddhiḥ, yāvatā kakārasya jaśtvaṃ prāpnoti ṭilopo hi ḍitpratyabhaviṣyati | kathamasiddhatvam asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅe | ṭilopo hi ḍitpratyayāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgaḥ jaśtvaṃ tu tadanapekṣatvādantaraṅgam | sākackārthamiti | sākacke hi pratyayāntare vihite kakveti syat | yathānyāse tu tatrāpi kvetyeva bhavati ||
tadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ || 7 - 2 - 106 ||
sau, iti prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya, syaśchandasi, so'ci lope cet ityādinirdeśāt | nāpyubhayoḥ tathāhi sati si ityeva brūyāt, sakārādau vibhaktāviti |
anantyayoriti kimiti | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārāttyadādiṣu takārāntasyāsambhāvacca tyadādibhistadorviśeṣaṇādanantyayostāvastāvastiddham, antyasya tu tyadādyatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | atvasya soranyakṣa sāvakāśatvātsau paratvādidameva syādityuttaram | tatra kevale sau puṃlliṅge viśeṣābhāvāt sambuddhau, striyāṃ ca pratyudāhṛtam | kimarthaṃ punaḥ tadoḥ ityucyate, tavargagrahaṇameva kriyeta - toḥ saḥ sāvanantyasya iti nakārasyāpi tarhi prāpnoti tasmānnuḍaci - aneṣaḥ, taanayam, anasāviti | nuyaṃ parādistad‌grahaṇena gṛhyate ||
adasa au sulopaśca || 7 - 2 - 107 ||
asuka iti | adakas su iti sthite autvapratiṣedhāttyadādyatvaṃ dakārasya satvaṃ sakārāduttarasya cākaco'kārasya utvam |
uttarapadabhūtānāmityādi | samāsādyā vibhaktirutpadyate, tadapekṣatvādādeśo bahiṅgaḥ, tataścāntaraṅgatvādekādeśe kṛte tasyādivadbhāvādādeśeṣu kriyamāṇeṣu paramayam, paramahamityādyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmādakṛtasandhikāryāṇāmevāmī ādeśā vaktavyāḥ | etacca nendrasya parasya ityatra jñāpayiṣyate |
adasaḥ sorbhavedityādi | adasa au ityetāvadeva sūtramastu, sau ityeva adasaḥ iti pañcamī, tayā pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyām adasa uttarasya soraukāro bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra tyadādyatve kṛte asāviti siddhe kiṃ sulopo vidhīyate | hrasvāllupyeta sambuddhiḥ | yadi soraukāro vidhīyate, tadā hi asāvityatra tyadādyatve hrasvātparasyāḥ sambuddheraukārasya lopaḥ syāt, na halaḥ naiṣa doṣaḥ, halaḥ salope vidhīyate
| yadyevam, tatra halgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam netyāha - prakṛtaṃ hi tat | halṅyābbhyo dīrghāt ityatra | nanu cedaṃ prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati tasmādityuttarasya iti | pūrvasūtravadvā prathamāyā taeva yathākathañcinnirvāho bhaviṣyati | āpa etvaṃ bhavettasmin | iha tarhi striyāṃ sambuddhau asā - au āṅi cāpaḥ sambuddhau ca thaityevaṃ prāpnoti, prakṛte reva tvautve ṭāpo'bhāvādetvābhāvaḥ, na, jhalītyuvarttanāt naiṣa doṣaḥ, bahuvacane jhalyet ityato jhalīti tatrānuvarttate - jhalādau sambuddhāviti, autve kṛte ajhalāditvānna bhaviṣyati | pratyayasthācca kāditvamiti | iha tarhi striyāmakaci asakā - au iti sthite pratyayasthātkātpūrvasya itītvaṃ prāpnoti, prakṛtereva tvaukāre ṭāpo'bhāvāditvābhāvaḥ | śībhāvaśca prasajyate | iha ca striyām asā - au iti sthite auha āpaḥ iti śībhāvaḥ prāpnoti, autvavidhānaṃ tu puṃsi caritārtham pākṣika eṣa doṣaḥ, yadā auṅa āpaḥ iti pūrvācāryanirdeśastadā nāsti, itarayorastu pakṣayorasti ||
yaḥ sau || 7 - 2 - 110 ||
striyāmayaṃ yakāra iti | napuṃsake tu svamamornapuṃsakāt iti lumatā luptatvāt sorabhāvaḥ ||
hali lopaḥ || 7 - 2 - 113 ||
angrahaṇamanuvarttata iti | yadyapi tatprathamāntam, tathāpi halīti saptamyā tasya ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate ||
mṛjervṛddhiḥ || 7 - 2 - 114 ||
dhātośca kāryamucyamānamiti | vastuto dhātoryatkāryamucyate, tadiha dhātorucyamānamiti vivakṣitam | sa dhātuḥ svarūpeṇaiva gṛhyatāṃ mā vā, grāhitena anudāttasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām ityayamapyamāgamo dhātupratyaya eva bhavati, na pramṛj‌bhyāmityādau | tatpratyaya iti | dhātorityevaṃ vihite | kaṃsaparimṛḍ‌bhyāmiti | atra tadantavidhinā prasaṅgaḥ ||
aco ñṇiti || 7 - 2 - 115 ||
taṇḍulaniścāya ityādau parimāṇākhyayāṃ sarvebhyaḥ iti ghañ |
gauḥ, gāvau, gāva iti | atra gaurityetatsākṣādudāharaṇam, itaratrāvādeśe kṛte ata upadhāyāḥ ityeva siddham | sakhāyau, sakhāya iti | atrāpi sakhāyāvityetadudāharaṇam, jasi tu jasi ca iti guṇe ayādeśe ca kṛte pūrvavatsiddham | cyautnamiti balanāma, chāndasam -- tamiccyautnairāryanti | kimartha punaridamucyate, yāvatā jetṛyotṛśabdābhāyāṃ prajñādyaṇi jaitram, yautramiti siddham | cyautnamiti uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni | taṇ‍ulaniścāyaḥ ścāvakaḥ, lāvaka ityādau goto ṇit ityetaṭ gota aut iti vaktavyam - gota aukārādeśo bhavati sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ | kathaṃ sakhāyau, sakhāyaḥ sakhyurasambuddhau ityetat sakhyurait taiti vakṣyāmi, atrocyate ñṇiti iti tāvaduttarārthaṃ vaktavyam | kiñca - priyamācaṣṭe prāpyayatītyādau prādyādeśeṣu vṛddhine syāt | atha te dīrghāntā vidhīyeran tadatiguru syāditi yathānyāsamevāstu ||
taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ || 7 - 2 - 117 ||
ajāmāderaco vṛddhiriti | nanu ca ikparibhāṣopasthānādika eva sthānitvena bhavitavyam, yadyapi tulyajātīyasya nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavati, yathā - gavāṃ kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratametyukte gaureva pratīyate, tathātrāpyacāmādirajeva tathāpi sākṣād acaḥ iti nirdeśābhāvādikparibhāṣopatiṣṭhetaiva - igātmakasyāca iti, tasmātsathāninirdeśārthamaca iti vaktavyam tanna vaktavyam prakṛtamanuvarttate -- aco ñṇiti iti, tatra nirdiṣṭasthānikatvādikparibhāṣāyā avyāpāraḥ |
atha tvāṣṭraḥ, jāgata ityatra tvaṣṭrajagacchabdābhyām tasyedam ityaṇi kṛte yathākramam aco ñṇiti, ata upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati tatrāha - tvāṣṭraḥ jāgata ityatreti | antyopadhālakṣaṇāṃ vṛddhi bādhata iti | paratvāditi bhāvaḥ | antyopadhālakṣaṇāyā vṛddheravakāśaḥ - gauḥ, yācakaḥ, asyā avakāśaḥ suśrut sauśrutaḥ, tvāṣṭraḥ, jagata ityatrobhacaprasaṅge paratvādādivṛddhirbhavati | sakṛdratinyāyaścāśrīyate, na punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā puṣkarasacchabdasyānuśatikādiṣu pāṭho'rthavānna bhavati | yadi tvādivṛddhiviṣaye'ntyopadhāvṛddhiḥ syāt, tadopadhālakṣaṇayaiva vṛddhyā pauṣkarasādeḥ siddhatvādanuśatikādiṣu tanna paṭhet, ṭhagarthaṃ tatra pāṭhaḥ syāt -
pauṣkarasādikaḥ | na hyatropadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, añṇitvāt naitadasti, na hyasmāccaratyarthe ṭhagutpadyate, anabhidhānāt | yadvāpratipadavihite bāhvādilakṣaṇa iñyovobhayapadavṛddhiḥ, nānyatreti ṭhagarthaḥ pāṭho na bhavati | yatra tvādivṛddhiḥ pratiṣiṣyate, tatrāntyopadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ | kasmānna bhavati -- vyamorbhavo vaiyasavam, igantācca laghupūrvāt ityaṇ, vyāpadi bhaṣaṃ vaiyāpadamiti tatrāpyaicau paratvāt bādhakāviti siddham ||
kiti ca || 7 - 2 - 117 ||
nāḍāyanaḥ, cārāyaṇa iti | naḍādibhyaḥ phak | ākṣikaḥ, śālākika iti | dīvyatyarthe ṭhak ||
iti śrīharadattamaśravirācatāyāṃ padamañjarayau saptamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaścaraṇaḥ
<7.3>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ---6
atha saptamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
devikāśiṃśapādityavāḍ‌dīrghasattraśreyasāmāt || 7.3.1 ||
atra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārād devikādibhiraṅgaṃ viśeṣyate, tena vā tāni, tatrāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyena, vaiyadhikaraṇyana vā---iti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ | tatra devikādibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenāṅgasya viśeṣaṇāt tadantavidhisambhavāddevikādyantasyācāmāderākāro bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt | tatra kevalānāṃ na syāt, na hi tadeva tadantaṃ bhavati | vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadikena niṣiddhaḥ | yadi tu pratyayavidhiviṣayaḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ | tadā kevalānāṃ bhavatu, tadādau tu na syāt‌---devikākūle bhavā dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti | tadante cātiprasaṅgaḥ---sudevikādau bhavaṃ saudevikamiti; atra sorukārasyākāraḥ syāt | atha vaiyadhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇam---devikādīnāṃ yadaṅgamiti, kiñci---devikādīnāmaṅgaṃ yatra ca te'vayavabhūtāḥ, tataśca kevalānna syāt, na hi sa eva tasyāvayavo bhavati | vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pi prātipadikena pratiṣiddhaḥ | yadi tu pratyayaviṣayaḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ, tadā kevalānāṃ bhavatu, tadante tvatiprasaṅgaḥ pūrvavat | kevalaṃ tadādāvaprasaṅga evāsminpakṣe parihṛtaḥ | athāṅgaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam---aṅgaṃ ye devikādaya iti, tadā tadante'tiprasaṅgaḥ parihṛtaḥ, tadādau tvaprasaṅgaḥ syādeva | tadeva tarhi vyadhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam---aṅgasya ye avayavabhūtā devikādayasteṣāmacāmāderākāra iti ? tadā kevale tadādau ca na doṣaḥ, kintu parapadabhūtānāmapi teṣāmākāraprasaṅgaḥ | tatra prāggrāme pūrvaśāṃśapa ityādāviṣṭa evākāraḥ, sudevikādāvagrāme tvaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ | tadevamete catvāro'pi pakṣā duṣṭāḥ |
athāparaḥ pakṣaḥ---aṅgena devakādibhiścācāmādiviśeṣyate---aṅgasyācāmāderākāro bhavati sa ceddevikādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavatīti | atra pakṣe kevaleṣu tadātau cāṅge nāsti doṣaḥ, nāpi saudevikamityatra pūrvapadasyottarapadasya vā prasaṅgaḥ; kintu prāggrāme pūrvaśāṃśapaḥ---ityādāvuttarapadabhūtānāṃ devikādīnāmākāro na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' ityatraitadanuvartiṣyate, tatra ca vākyabedena sambandhaḥ---prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇāmuttarapadasyācāmāderaco vṛddhirbhavati, devikādīnāmuttarapadānāmacāmāderākāra iti | ayamapi vṛttikārasya pakṣo na bhavati; yadyayaṃ pakṣo'bhaviṣyat, uttarapadavṛddhāvapyetadanuvarttiṣyata ityevāvakṣyat |
kastarhi vṛttikārasya pakṣo'yamabhidhīyate ?
paribhāṣeyamāntaryaparibhāṣā'pavādinī ||
devikāderacāmāderyatra vṛddhiḥ prasajyate |
tatropatiṣṭhate, tena sarvamiṣṭaṃ prasidhyati || iti |
anārabhyamāṇe etasmin, devikādīnāmāderaco vṛddhirbhavantī sthāne'ntaratamavacanādaikāraḥ prāpnoti, tadapavādenākāraḥ prāpyate, tatrāṅgaṃ bhavatu devikādayaḥ pūrvapadamuttarapadaṃ vā; sarvathā yatra devikādīnāmacāmāderaco vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ, tatrākāro bhavatīti paribhāṣyate | nanu ca `aṅgasya' iti varttate ? satyam; naivamasyābhisambandhaḥ---aṅgasyācāmāderākāro bhavati sa ceddevikādīnāṃ sambandhīti, kiṃ tarhi ? devikādīnāmacāmāderākāro bhavati sa cedaṅgasya sambandhīti | athaivamabhisambandhe kiṃ vyāvartyam ? na kiñcit, anuvṛttasya tu sambandho vaktavya ityetāvat | sāpyākāra eva bhavatīti | ukto'tra hetuḥ |
vahīnarasyeti | vaho'syāstīti vahī, vahī cāsau naraśceti vahīnaraḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti dīrghatvam | vaihīnaririti | atrākāravṛddhiḥ prāptā ikāreṇa bādhyate | tasya tvaikāravṛddhirbhavatyeva, na hi tasyāṃ nāprāptāyāmikāro vidhīyate, evaṃ ca kṛtvā sūtre'pyakāra eva vidheyaḥ, tasyākāravṛddhau siddhamiṣṭam ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva | kecittviti | vihīno naro vihīnaraḥ, pṛṣodarāditvānnaśabdasya lopaḥ ||
kekayamitrayupralayānāṃ yāderiyaḥ || 7.3.2 ||
laukikaṃ hi tatra gotraṃ gṛhyata iti | mitrayu śabdo'bhedhopacārāttadapatyasantāne yadā varttate na paraṃ prakṛtāveva, tadedamucyate | yadā tu gṛṣṭyādibhyaṣṭhaño yaskāditvād bahuṣu luk kriyate, tadā pāribhāṣike'pi gotre na doṣaḥ | atra yadyapi vṛddhiprasaṅge'yamādeśa ucyate, tathāpi vṛddhirna bādhyate; viṣayabhedāt---acāmādervṛddhiḥ, yāderiyādeśaḥ, aṅgaṃ tūbhayoviśeṣaṇam, na kāryi ||
na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic || 7.3.3 ||
atrārthadvayavidhānādvākyabhedaḥ, tasyaiva dyotakastuśabdaḥ, `pūrvau' ityanena sambandhādaicāviti prāpte ekavacanaṃ sautram | vṛttau tu kriyāviśeṣaṇatvādekavacanam | tābhyāṃ tu pūrvamiti | aijāgamo bhavatīti | ṭittvādyāgamaliṅgābhāve'pi pūrvaśabdena deśaviśeṣe bhavannāgama ityucyate---āgacchatītyāgama iti | vaiyasanamiti | `gatikārakopapadānāṃ prāksubutpatteḥ samāsaḥ' ityuttarapadaviṣayamityavīcāma | tena vaiyasanādiṣu yvoḥ padāntatvam | svaśvaśabdaḥ śivadiḥ |
yāṣṭīka iti | `śaktiyaṣṭyorīkak' | nanu cātrācāmādeḥ sthāne yau yvau tābhyāmityāśrayaṇaādeva na bhaviṣyati ? tatrāha---yata ima iti | `iṇ‌ gatau' laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, śapo luk, `iṇo yaṇ‌' | ihāsatyapi pratiṣedhe vaiyasanamityādau vyasana-a iti sthite vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, aijāgamaśca; tatra vṛddhiranityā, śabdāntaraprāpteḥ | sā hyeci kṛte tasyaiva prāpnoti; tanmadhyapatitasya tad‌grahaṇena prahaṇāt | aijāgamastu nitya iti sa eva tāvadbhavati | tatra kṛte yadyapi punaḥ---prasaṅgavijñānād vṛddhiḥ, tathāpyāntaryata aikārasyaikāraḥ, aukārasyaukāra iti na kaściddoṣaḥ, kiṃ pratiṣedhena !
nanvasati tasmin, vaiyākaraṇī bhāryā asya vaiyākaraṇabhārya iti `vṛddhinimittasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, sati tu pratiṣedhe na bhavati; kathaṃ na bhavati, yāvatā vṛddhernimittaṃ ñaṇakā yasmiṃstaddhita iti bahuvrīhiḥ, vidyate cātra ṇakāraḥ ? satyaṃ vidyate, nimittaṃ tu na bhavati; `kurvadrūpe hi nimittaśabdo mukhyaḥ' ityuktam | nanu ca mā bhūt `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' ityasyā vṛddhernimittam, ya eva tvasau ṇittaddhitāścaya aijvidhīyate tasyaiva vṛddhisaṃjñakasya nimittaṃ ṇakāra iti syādeva puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ ? ucyate; na hi vastuto yā vṛddhistasyā yannimittaṃ ñakārādistadvati pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? bṛddhirityevaṃ yā vidhīyate tannimitte | ataḥ puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhanivṛttyarthaṃ vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya eva ? na vaktavyaḥ; ekasminnaṅge viśeṣavihitāvaicau sāmānyavihitāyā vṛddherbādhakau bhaviṣyataḥ, satyapi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavatīti nyāyāt; tataśca pūrvavatpuṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na bhaviṣyatīti `yvābhyāṃ pūrvamaic' ityevāstu, nārthaḥ pratiṣedhena ? ityata āha---pratiṣedhavacanamiti | pratiṣedhavacane sati yābhyāṃ yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddhiḥ prāptā pratiṣidhyate, tābhyāmeva pūrvāvaicau bhavata ityarthau bhavati, asati hi tasmin yau kaucana yvau gṛhyeyātām | tasmādaicorviśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ pralkṛpto yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pratiṣedhavacanaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ | dādhyaśviḥ, mādhvaśviriti| dadhipriyo'śvo yasya sa dadhyaśvaḥ | evaṃ madhvaśvaḥ, tābhyām `ata iñ‌' |
nanu ca `achāmādeḥ' ityanena yvau viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---acāmāderacaḥ sthāne yau yvāviti ? evamapi dve aśīti adhīṣṭaḥ, `taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ, tamadhīṣṭa iti `prāgvateṣṭhak‌', dvyāśītikaḥ---atra prāpnoti | sati tu pratiṣedhe `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' ityanuvṛtteryābhyāṃ parasya `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' iti vṛddhiḥ prāptā pratiṣidhyate, tābhyāmiti vijñāyate; atra tu `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' ityevamuttarapadavṛddhirvidhīyata iti tasya niṣedhābhāvādaijāgamābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | syādetat---acāmāderityanuvṛttaṃ svarūpaparaṃ sad‌ vṛddherviśeṣaṇam, acāmāderityevaṃ yā vṛddhistasyāḥ prasaṅge tadapavādau yvābhyāṃ pūrvamaico bhavata ityarthaḥ, iha tu naivaṃ vṛddheḥ prasaṅga ityaicau na bhaviṣyata iti ? evamapi yvāvaviśeṣitau syātām, tataśca dādhyaśvādau prasaṅgaḥ | na ca sakṛcchrutamacāmāderityetadevobhayaṃ viśeṣayitumarhati, yenācāmādeḥ sthāne yvau tābhyāṃ pūrvāvaico bhavataḥ, sati tasminnacāmāderityevaṃ vṛddheḥ prasaṅga ityāśrayaṇānna kvāpi doṣaḥ syāt | na ca tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇe pramāṇamasti, tasmātsuṣṭhūktam---pratiṣedhavacanamaicorviṣayapralkṛptyarthamiti |
uttarapadavṛddherapīti | etacca tatrālasyādhikārāllabhyate | yatra tviti | etadapyuttarapadena yvorviśeṣaṇāllabhyate---uttarapadasya yau yvau tābhyāṃ parasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tābhyāṃ ca pūrvamaijāgama iti | iha---iśca ajaśca yajau, uśca ajaśca vajau, tayoridaṃ aiyajam, auvajamiti aicorabhaktatvādatanmadhyapatitatvācca aṅgagrahaṇenāgrahaṇādaiyajīyam, auvajīyamityādau śeṣanighāto na syāt, śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca vṛddhāccho na syāt, prātipadikasyāvṛddhatvāt ? ucyate; yadyevaṃvidhamabhidhānamasti, tataḥ pūvaśabda āvartayitavyaḥ, tatraiko'vayavavacanaḥ, aparo vyavasthāvacanaḥ---yvābhyāṃ pūrvāvaicau bhavatastau cāṅgasyāvayavāviti|
atra saṃgrahaślokau----
nāprāptāyā hi vṛddheḥ pratipadavidhiraijbādhako nañ‌ kimartho

ryvau tābhyāmaijihaivaṃ na bhavati iti ced dve aśīti adhīṣṭe ||

dvārādīnāṃ ca || 7.3.4 ||
dauvārika iti | `tatra niyuktaḥ' iti ṭhak‌ | dvārapālasyedaṃ dauvārapālamiti | `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti vṛddhalakṣaṇaścho na bhavati, `kalāpino'ṇ‌' ityatrāṇgrahaṇasyādhikavidhānārthatvādvā | kathaṃ punardvāraśabdasya pāṭhe dvārapālaśabdasya vidhirayaṃ bhavati ? tatrāha---tadādividhiścātra bhavatīti | atra ca kāraṇaṃ devikādisūtra evoktam | jñāpakaṃ cātra vakṣyati | sauvaro'dhyāya iti | sa punaḥ śantanupraṇītaḥ, phiṣityādikaḥ | `sauvaryaḥ saptamyastadantasaptamyaḥ' iti bhāṣye |
śobhano'dhyāyaḥ svādhyāya iti | āṅatra madhye prakṣeptavyaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti vā uttarapadādedīrghatvam | evamapītyādi |
yadyatra svaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, kimāyātaṃ svādhyāyaśabdasya ? tatrāha---tadādāvapi hīti | svārthika-svābhāvikādayastu bhāṣyaprayogātsādhavaḥ | sphaiyakṛta iti ṛṣitvādaṇ | śauvādaṃṣṭro maṇiriti | `śuno dantadaṃṣṭrā' iti dīrghatvam, pūrvavadaṇ ||
nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya || 7.3.5 ||
naiyagrodha iti | nīcairgatau prarohairvardhata ityarthaḥ |
avyutpattipakṣe tu vidhyarthamiti | apadāntatvādyakārasya | athāsminnapi pakṣe kevalagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā nyagrodhasyetyujyate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo yattadādau syāt ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu | etajjñāpayati---asaminprakaraṇe yānyupāttāni tāni tadādivṛddhibhājo'co viśeṣaṇānīti ||
na karmavyatihāre || 7.3.6 ||

śvāderiñi || 7.3.8 ||
tatra cetyādi | yadi tatra tadādividhirna syāt etadvacanamanarthakam, katham ? kevalaśvanśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhyate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgo yattadādeḥ syāt ! tadādividhirbhavatīti | asminprakaraṇe yaduktaṃ tadvṛddhibhājo'co viśeṣaṇamityasminnarthe jñāpakamityarthaḥ | ikārādigrahaṇaṃ cetyādi | śvāderitīti vaktavyamityarthaḥ | tatra varṇagrahaṇe saptamīnirdeśāttadādividhiḥ | śvāgaṇika iti | `śvagaṇāṭṭhañ‌' iti ṭhañ‌ | tadantasyeti | iñantasya | śvābhastramiti | `iñaśca' ityaṇ‌ | tannimitto vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca bhinnakakṣatvādaśakya iñāśrayeṇa pratiṣedhena nivārayitumiti vacanārambhaḥ ||
uttarapadasya || 7.3.10 ||
uttaratra `acāmādeḥ' ityanuvṛtteruttarapadasyācāmādervṛddhirveditavyā |
nanu ca`avayavādṛtoḥ' ityādau `avayavād' ityādikā pañcamī, tatrāntareṇāpyuttarapadagrahaṇamuttarapadasyaiva bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---yatreti | ādipadena `hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca', anuśatikādīnāṃ ca', `devatādvandve ca'---ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam | eṣu yogeṣu pañcamīnirdeśābhāvādasatyasminnadhikāre'ṅgasyācāmāderaco vṛddhiḥ syāt, nottarapadasya | vacanaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ syāt---ja eva proṣṭhapadānām, nānyatra | proṣṭhapadānāmeva vā je iti | vacanasāmarthyādvā pūrvapadasyaivānādyaco vṛddhividhānārthaṃ syāt | tasmādetadarthamevāyamadhikāraḥ karttavyaḥ |
kimidānīṃ pañcamīnirdeśeṣvasyānuyoga eva ? netyāha---pañcamīnirdeśeṣvapīti | vṛddheśca vyapadeśārthamiti | uttarapadādhikāre vihitā yā vṛddhiriti vyapadeśo yathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | kva punarevaṃvidhena vyapadeśena prayojanam ? ityata āha---uttarapadavṛddhau sarvaṃ cetyatreti | sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāra ityādau mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tatraivamāśritam ||
avayavādṛtoḥ || 7.3.11 ||
ṛtorvṛddhimadvidhāvityādi | ṛtoḥ-ṛtuvācinaḥ śabdādvṛddhimadvidhau-vṛddhinimitte pratyaye vidhīyamāne tadantavidhiḥ, ṛtuśabdāntādapi pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | kiṃ sarvatra ? netyata āha---avayavāditi | avayavavacanāt paro yadā ṛtuvacanastadetyarthaḥ | ye tu---avayavānāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanāntaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ na samīcīno'rthaḥ | tathā ca `susarvārdhadikśabdebhyaḥ' iti pañcamyā niradeśi | pūrvāsu varṣāsu bhava iti | `taddhitārtha' iti samāsaḥ | anye tu---adikśabdatvādviśeṣasamāsaṃ manyante | athātrāpi tadantavidhinā varṣābhyaṣṭhageva kasmānna bhavati ? ata āha---avayavapūrvasyaiva hīti ||
susarvārdhājjanapadasya || 7.3.12 ||
janapadavācina iti | svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; uttarasūtre madrapratiṣedhāt | susarvārdhetyādi | janapadavācinaḥ śabdasyānantare pratyaye vidhīyamāne tadantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, yadi suprabhṛtibhyaḥ paraḥ sambhavatītyarthaḥ ||
diśo'madrāṇām || 7.3.13 ||
pūrvapāñcālaka iti | taddhitārthe samāsaḥ | paurvapañcālaka iti | avayavavācyatra pūrvaśabdaḥ, ekadeśisamāsād vuñpratyayaḥ | adikśabdatvād ādivṛddhireva bhavati | yadyevam, vuñāpi na bhavitavyamadikśabdatvādeva ? astyatra viśeṣaḥ, susarvārddhāddikśabdebhya iti tadantavidhau śabdagrahaṇaṃ kriyate---diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda ityevaṃ yathā vijñāyeta, vṛddhividhau tu diśa ityetāvaducyate | ante tvaṇantameva pratyudāharaṇaṃ paṭhanti ||
prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām || 7.3.14 ||
`prācām' iti nācāryanirddeśaḥ; janapadādibhirdeśaiḥ sāhacaryāt |
pūrvaiṣukāmaśama iti | pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti samāsaḥ, tato bhavārthe `dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ' iti ñapratyayaḥ |
pūrvapāṭaliputraka iti | pūrvavatsamāsaḥ, `ropadhetoḥ pracām' iti vuñ‌ | yadyapyekameva pāṭaliputram, tathāpi pāṭaliputrasyaikadeśe pāṭaliputraśabdasya vṛtteḥ pūrvatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktameva |
janā yatra santi sa grāmaḥ, tataśca nagaramapi grāmaḥ | ye hi grāme vidhayo neṣyante sādhīyaste nagare'pi na kriyante | tadyathā---`abhakṣyo grāmakukkuṭaḥ' iti sutarāṃ nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate | `grāme nādhyeyam' iti sādhīyo nagare'pi nādhīyate | śāstre'pi--`udīcyagramācca bahvaco'ntodāttāt', `vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca', `dikśabdāḥ grāmajanapadākhyānacānarāṭeṣu'---nagaramapi gṛhyate, tasmādihāpi nārtho nagaragrahaṇena ? ityata āha---grāmatvādeveti | sambandhabhedapratipattyarthamiti | aṅgasyeti prakṛtam, uttarapadasyeti ca, tatra grāmāṇāmityetadaṅgasyetyanena sambadhyate---grāmavācināmaṅgānāmiti | nagarāṇāmityetaduttarapadasyetyanena---nagaravācināmuttarapadānāmiti | na cāyaṃ sambandhabhedaḥ sakṛdupātte grāmaśabde sambhavati, tasmānnagaragrahaṇaṃ kriyate | tatra dikpūrvapado hītyādinā sambandhabheda āśrayaṇīya ityatra heturdarśitaḥ | tatraityādinā tu sa eva sambandhabhedaḥ | iha pūrvaiṣukāmaśama iti samasanakriyānantaraṃ pūrvottarapadayorguṇaḥ prāpnuvannantaraṅgaḥ, uttarapadavṛddhistu paścādupanatataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā, tatra guṇe kṛte pūrvottarayorvyapavargābhāvādvṛddhirna prāpnoti; antādivadbhāvo'pyubhayata āśrayaṇe pratiṣiddhaḥ | atra hi dgvāci pūrvapadamuttarapadaṃ ca yugapadāśrīyate, tatrāha---pūrvaiṣukāmaśama ityevamādiṣviti | yathā `nendrasya parasya' iti jñāpakam, tathā tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ ||
saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca || 7.3.15 ||
saṃvatsaraśca saṃkhyā ca saṃvatsarasaṃkhyam, samāhāradvandvaḥ | dvisāṃvatsarika iti | `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌', tasya `adhyardhapūrva' iti lugna bhavati, anārhīyatvāt |
