nanu ca `paramāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' ityatra paricchedahetutvamātraṃ gṛhyate, na tvārohataḥ pariṇāitaśca yena mīyate tadeva prasthādi; anyathā śāṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; kālaścāpi paricchedaheturbhavatyeva, tataśca saṃbatsaragrahaṇamanarthakam, parimāṇāntasyetyeva siddhatvāt ? ityata āha---saṃvatsaragrahaṇamiti | dvaisamika iti | adhīṣṭādiṣu `samāyāḥ khaḥ', `dvigorvā' iti pakṣe ṭhañ‌ |
na kevalaṃ vṛddhiviṣayameva jñāpakam, kiṃ tarhi ? sārvatrikamityāha---dvivarṣā māṇaviketi | dve varṣe bhūtā iti pūrvavaṭṭañ‌, tasya `varṣālluk‌', `cittavati nityam' iti luk | paryudāso na bhavatīti | pratiṣedhasya | tena pratiṣedha eva bhavati |
atha saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā saṃkhyayāpi paricchidyate, tatra `parimāṇāntasya' ityeva siddham ? kecidāhuḥ---saṃkhyāgrahaṇamapi jñāpakārthameva, parimāṇagrahaṇena saṃkhyāpi na gṛhyata iti | tathā ca `aparimāṇabistācita' ityatra vṛttāvuktam---`kālaḥ saṃkhyā ca parimāṇaṃ na bhavati | dvivarṣā, trivarṣā, dviśatā, triśatā' iti | apara āha---sākṣācchiṣṭena nimittabhāvenānumitaṃ kāryitvaṃ mā bādhīti parimāṇātpṛthagiha saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti ||
varṣasyābhaviṣyati || 7.3.16 ||
yasyetyādi | yasya yiyakṣoryāgavarṣādārabhya trīṇi varṣāṇi dhānyaṃ bhāvi-tāvantaṃ kālaṃ jīvanāya paryāptam, sa somayāge'dhikārī, na nyūna ityarthaḥ | gamyate hīti | vākyārthastatra bhaviṣyattā, na padārtha ityarthaḥ | dvivāṣiṃko manuṣya iti | `varṣālluk‌', `cittavati nityam' iti nityaṃ lugna bhavati; bhūtārtha eva hi sa iṣyate, anyatra cittavatyapi vikalpa eva ||
parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ || 7.3.17 ||
dvikauḍavika iti kuḍeravapratyaye kuḍavaḥ- prasthacaturthabhāga ityuṇādiṣu vyutpattiḥ | kuḍavamityetadavyutpannaṃ śabdāntaraṃ draṣṭavyam | tataḥ `prāgvateṣṭañ', anārhīyatvāllugabhāvaḥ | dvābhyāṃ suvarṇaābhyāmiti | śāṇapratiṣedhātparicchittisādhanamiha parimāṇam, tenonmānasyāpi bhavati---lohinī-guñjā, tābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ parimitamākāraviśeṣayuktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ pāñcalohitikam | kalāpaḥ-kaścinmānaviśeṣaḥ |
yogavibhāgāditi | pūrvāsu vṛttiṣu `tadasya parimāṇaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñā' ityekayogena paṭhitatvād, bhāṣye tatra yogavibhāgasyoktatvādevamuktam | taddhitāntaścāyamiti | yathā tu `adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' ityatra vārttikaṃ tathā taddhitaluki sati saṃjñeti tatraivāvocāma | dvaiśāṇa iti | yadyatrottarapadavṛddhiḥ syāt, pūrvapadasya na syāt | kulijam-dhānyamānam | antagrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam ||
je proṣṭhapadānām || 7.3.18 ||
ja iti jātārtho nirdiśyata iti | upasaraja ityādau dṛṣṭasya padaikadeśasya prayogaḥ, bhīmaseno bhīma itivat |
bahuvacananirdeśāditi | yadyapi jyotiṣāṃ bahutvādbahuvacanāntaproṣṭhapadāśabdaḥ, tathāpi tasyaiva śabdarūpāpekṣāyāmekavacanaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyate ||
hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca || 7.3.19 ||
suhṛda iti | `suhṛd‌durhṛdau mittrāmitrayoḥ' iti nipātitaḥ suhṛcchabdaḥ | yadā tu suhṛdayasyedamiti pāṭhaḥ, tadā `hṛdayasya hṛllekha' ityādinā hṛdbhāvaḥ | sauhārdyamiti | `vā śokaṣyañrogeṣu' iti hṛdbhāvaḥ | sindhavo janapadaḥ, nadīvacanasyāpi grahaṇam, tathā samudravacanasyāpi ||
anuśatikādīnāṃ ca || 7.3.20 ||
ānuśātikamiti | śatena krītaṃ śatikam, `śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate, iti ṭhan‌, anugataḥ śatikena anuśatikaḥ, tataḥ `tasyedam' ityaṇa | ānuhauḍikaṃ iti | `carati' iti ṭhak‌ | ānusāṃvaraṇamiti | `tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat' ityaṇ | ānusāṃvatsarikamiti | `bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ‌' |
kurukata-śabdo gargādiḥ |
sārvalaukikamiti | `lokasarvalokābhyāṃ ṭhañ‌' | sārvabhauma iti | `sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau' | prayogādhidevādhibhūtetyadhyātmādayaḥ | kulaṭāyā vetīnaṅiti | apapāṭho'yam, tatra hi svarūpagrahaṇam, | kalyāṇyādiṣu parastrīśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tasmāt kalyāṇyādīnāminaṅiti pāṭhaḥ | cāturvaidyamiti | cāturvarṇyāditvātsvārthe ṣyañ, tāḥ punaścarasro vidyāḥ-catvāro vedāḥ ||
devatādvandve ca || 7.3.21 ||
agnivaruṇau devatā asya āgnivāruṇam, agnimarutau devatā asya āgnimārutam | `idvṛddhau' ityagniśabdasya ittvam |
yo devatādvandva ityādi | yaḥ sūktaṃ bhajate stutyatayā sa sūktasambandhī, haviryasmai nirūpyate sa haviḥ sambandhī | arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam | skāndaviśākha iti | `sāsya devatā' ityaṇ‌ | brāhmaprajāpatyamiti | `patyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ' | nanu `sāsya devatā' ityatra na jātivacano devatāśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yasyai havirnirūpyate, yā vā mantrastutyā sāsya devatā gṛhyate; na caivambhūto'tra dvandvārthaḥ, evambhūtatve vā yathā taddhitā bhavanti tathāyamapi vidhiḥ prāpnoti ? atrāhuḥ---taddhitaḥ kvacidanyatrāpi bhavati---jñā devatāsya jñaḥ, sthālīpāka iti hi bhāvye dṛṣṭamiti ||
nendrasya parasya || 7.3.22 ||
āgnendram, saumendramiti | `ajādyadantam' itīndraśabdasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; prāyikatvāttasya |
indraśabda ityādi | indraśca maruccetyādau vyañjanāntena saha dvandve indraśabdasya pūrvanipātena bhāvyam | yathā---aindrāmārutīṃ bhedakāmālabheteti | vāyvindrāvityādikastu dvandvaḥ sūktahaviḥ sambandhī na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
dīrghācca varuṇasya || 7.3.23 ||
atra hītyādi | udāharaṇeṣu `devatādvandve ca' ityānaṅikṛte dīrghātparo varuṇaśabdaḥ ||
prācāṃ nagarānte || 7.3.24 ||
prācāṃ deśa iti | ācāryagrahaṇaṃ tu na bhavati; uttarasūtre `vibhāṣitam' iti vacanāt ||
jaṅgaladhenuvalajāntasya vibhāṣitamuttaram || 7.3.25 ||
jaṅgalam-vanaprāyo deśaḥ, kuruṣu jaṅgalaṃ kurujaṅgalam | dhenuḥ-navaprasūtā, viśveṣāṃ dhenurviśvadhenuḥ | suvarṇavikāraḥ-valajam, sauvarṇavalajam | `uttaram' ityuttarapadaṃ lakṣyate, tasya nityasannihitatvāt svarūpeṇa vibhāṣitatvānupapattervibhāṣitavṛddhikatvād vibhāṣitamiti gauṇo vādaḥ ||
arddhātparimāṇasya pūvasya tu vā || 7.3.26 ||
arddhadrauṇikamiti | prāgvateṣṭhañ‌ |
vāvacanamanarthakam, vibhāṣitamityanuvṛtteḥ, tatraivaṃ vaktavyam---pūrvaṃ tviti ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
nātaḥ parasya || 7.3.27 ||
ārdhaprasthikam, ārdhakaṃsikamiti | pūrvavaṭṭhañ‌ | kaṃsāṭṭiṭham̐stu na bhavati; tadantavidherabhāvāt | prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhiḥ, na vārdhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācī |
kiṃ ca syāditi | ākāro vṛddhireva, tatra satyasati vā vṛddhipratiṣedhe nāsti viśeṣa iti manyate | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt ? ityata āha---yatra hīti | taduktam---`kurvadrūpe nimittaśabdo mukhyaḥ' iti |
parasyeti kim ? pūrvasya mā bhūt, ata iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmamarthyāt‌pūrvasya na bhaviṣyati, na hi pūrvasyādhaśabdasyākārādanyo vṛddhibhāgasti | kiñca---yadi pūrvasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, `pūrvasya tu vā' ityetadanarthakaṃ syāt | idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---tadantavidhirmā bhūditi, anyathā'kārāntasyottarapadasyaivaṃ vijñāyeta | tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ihapratiṣedhaḥ syāt---ardhadrauṇikam, ardhakauḍavikamiti | pūrvastu vidhiḥ---ardhamuṣṭinā krīto'rdhamauṣṭika ityādau caritārthaḥ | tasmāttadantavidhinirāsārtham `parasya' ityuktam ||
pravāhaṇasya ḍhe || 7.3.28 ||
pravāhaṇaśabdasya ḍhe parata uttarapadasyeti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau | pravāhaṇaśabdasya avayavabhūtaṃ yaduttarapadaṃ tasyetyarthaḥ | nanu vṛddhimadevātra svata evottarapadam, kasmai prayojanāyāsya punarvṛddhirvidhīyate ? ucyate; yadā pūrvapade vṛddhirna bhavati tadā yadyuttarapade'pi vṛddhirna syāt, `vṛddhinimittasya' iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt---pravāhaṇeyībhārya iti | mā bhūdevam, `jāteśca' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati, `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' iti jātitvam ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati---anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti | tena hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikamityatra bhasyāḍhe' iti vā, `ṭhakchasośca' iti vā prāptasyaupasaṃkhyānikasya puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedho na bhavati | pravāhayatīti pravāhaṇaḥ, ṇyantād vahernandyāderlyuḥ, `ṇervibhāṣā' iti ṇatvam |
tatpratyayasya ca || 7.3.29 ||
pravāhaṇeyiriti | yūnyapatye `ata iñ‌' | pravāhaṇeyakamiti | `gotracaraṇād vuñ‌' |
kimarthamidamucyate ? ḍhe parataḥ pūrveṇa vikalpa uktaḥ, ṭhāntasyeñādau nityavṛddhirmā bhūditi | vaitadasti prayojanam, iñādinimittāyā api vṛddherḍhāśraya eva vikalpo bādhako bhaviṣyati, `ḍhe' iti hi parasaptamī, na nimittasaptamī, tenā nyanimittāyā api vṛddherḍhe parataḥ pratiṣedho labhyata eva ? ata āha---brāhyataddhitanimitteti | ayamabhipāyaḥ---ḍhe utpanne tadāśrayāṃ vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā vikalpastāvatpravṛttaḥ, paścādiñādirutpannaḥ, tannimittā ca vṛddhiḥ prāptā, na tvidānīṃ ḍanimitto vikalpaḥ, pūrvameva pravṛtatvāt, āvṛttyayogāditi ||
nañaḥ śucīśvarakṣetrajñakuśalanipuṇānām || 7.3.30 ||
aprāptaiva vidhīyata iti | aprāptimevopapādayati---na nañpūrvāditi | uttaro bhāvapratyaya iti | tvatalbhyāmuttaraḥ ṣyañādiḥ, tataścottaro bhāvapratyayaḥ prāgeva nañsamāsāt śucyādibhya eva vidheyaḥ, paścānnañsamāsaḥ; tatra naño'ṅge'nantarbhāvādaprāptā vṛddhirvidhīyata iti |
tadapare ityādi | asati viṣaye'ṅgādhikāra upamṛdyaḥ, asti ca viṣayaḥ; kaḥ punarasau ? bhāvavacanādanyo'patyādiṣu vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ | athāpi bhāvavacane śraddhā, so'pi śakyata eva darśayitumityāha---bahuvrīheśceti |
`uttaro bhāvapratyayaḥ pratiṣidhyate' ityetadapyatra na sārvatrikamityāha---akṣetrajñeti | tadevamaṅgādhikāro na bādhanīya iti sthitam | evaṃ ca `tadupasparśādaśaucam' ityādiprayogopapattiḥ | `daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucam' ityādau tvidamartho'ṇ‌ draṣṭavyaḥ ||
yathātathayathāpurayoḥ paryāyeṇa || 7.3.31 ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu nañsamāsāvetau draṣṭavyāviti | tena `na nañpūrvāt' iti ṣyañaḥ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | yathā'sādṛśya ityavyayībhāvasamāsa iti | padārthānativṛttau | tathābhāvamanatikrāntaṃ yathātatham-satyamucyate, yadvastu purā yathābhūtaṃ tadadyāpi tathābhāvamanatikrāntaṃ yathāpuramucyate | kiṃ punaravyayībhāvatve pramāṇam ? ityata āha---tathā hīti | bhāṣye tviti | na hi hrasvatvamakṛtvā | vigrahapradarśanamavyayībhāvasyopapadyate |
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham ? yadā pūrvapadasya vṛddhiḥ, nañsamāsādbhāvapratyayaḥ | yadā tūttarapadasya vṛddhistadā ṣyañantena nañsamāsaḥ | svare'pi nāsti viśeṣaḥ;avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇaādyudāttatvāt | pratyayāntaraṃ cābhyāṃ na bhavati; anabhidhānāt ||
hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ || 7.3.32 ||
taddhiteṣviti nivṛttamiti | dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryavijñānāt | tatsambaddhaṃ kitītyapīti | nivṛttamityapekṣyate | ñṇid‌grahaṇaṃ tu pratyayamātreṇa sambaddham, ataḥ `taddhiteṣu' ityasminnivṛtte'pi tadanuvarttata eva | udāharaṇaeṣu `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' iti kutvam ||
āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ || 7.3.33 ||
ciṇgrahaṇamakṛdartham | dadau, dadhāviti | nanu ca `āta au ṇalaḥ' ityautvamatra bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati, anavakāśā hi vidhayo bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśaṃ cautvam, ko'vakāśaḥ ? yadā uttame ṇali ṇitvābhāvaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi `aciṇaaṇaloḥ' ityanuvartiṣyate, ciṇi tu vacanādbhaviṣyati, tatrāha---cauḍirbālākiriti | bāhvāditvādiñ‌ | atra dākṣyādau caritārthaṃ yasyetilopaṃ bādhitvā paratvādyuk syāt | acāmāderityanuvṛtterna bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---jñā devatā asyeti | ādivadbhāvātra prasaṅgaḥ | kiñca---`acāmādeḥ' ityanuvṛttau daridrāyaka ityatra na syāt ||
nodāttopadeśasya māntasyānācameḥ || 7.3.34 ||
upadeśe udātta udāttopadeśaḥ | asmādeva nipātanātsādhuḥ | kiñcoktamiti | sannihitasya kasyacidaprasaṅgātpraśnaḥ | ata upadhāyā iti vṛddhiriti | ciṇkṛdupajīvanārthaṃ tu na tadanantaramidamārabdham |
nipātanādanugantavyamiti | yeṣāṃ tu `apāṇinīyo dhātupāṭhe'rthanirddeśaḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, teṣāmatra `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' iti vṛddhyabhāvaḥ | śamī, tamīti | `śamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ‌', atra pratyayasvare kṛte samprati dhāturanudāttaḥ | yāmakaḥ, rāmaka iti | litsvare kṛte bhavatyayaṃ sampratyudāttaḥ |
`anācameḥ' ityalpamidamucyate ? ityāha---anācamikamivamīnāmiti vaktavyamiti | `ṭuvama ud‌giraṇe', `kamu kāntau', `camu adane', tatra sūtre āṅ‌pūrvasya paryudāsaḥ, vākye tu kevalasya | vṛttau tu vākyodāharaṇamapyāṅ‌pūrvasyaiva darśitam, nātrāptairniraṇāyi | kāma iti | kameḥ `āyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā' iti ṇiṅabhāva pakṣe ghañ‌, vṛddhiḥ | ṇici vṛddhau satyamiti | na hi tatrāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ; ṇico'kṛttvāt | nanu ca satyāmapi vṛddhau `janījṝṣknasurañjau'mantāśca' iti mittve sati `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvena bhāvyam ? ata āha---tatra hīti | nānye mito'hetāvitīti | ahetau curādiṇicyanukrāntebhyo'nye'mantādayo mito na bhavantītyarthaḥ | anyāyyameva manyanta iti | `viśrāntibhūmiḥ' iti paṭhitavyamityarthaḥ | tena `viśrāmaṃ labhatā midaṃ ca śithilajyābandhamasmaddhanuḥ' iti vyākhyātam ||
janivadhyośca || 7.3.35 ||
vadhiḥ prakṛtyantaramiti | `vadha hiṃsāyām' iti bhūvādau pāṭhāt | bhakṣakaścediti | yo'pi māṃsaṃ krītvā bhakṣayati, tasyāpi hiṃsānuṣaṅgo'stītyetadanena pratipādyate | yathāha manuḥ (mao smṛo 5.51)---
anumantā viśasitā nihantā krayavikrayī |
saṃskarttā copaharttā ca khādakaśceti ghātakāḥ || iti |
hanādeśasyeti | avadhi bhavatā dasyurityatra | jajāna garbhamiti | vyatyayena parasmaipadam, antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt sakarmakatvam ||
artihrīvvīrīknuyīkṣmāyyātāṃ puṅ‌ ṇau || 7.3.36 ||
`vlīṅ‌ varaṇe', `knūyī śabde', `kṣmāyī vidhūnane' | udāharaṇeṣu pugantalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ | dvayorapi grahaṇamiti | viśeṣānupādānāt |
rī ityapīti | yadyapi prasravaṇārthaḥ sānubandhakaḥ tathāpi tasyāpi grahaṇamācāryaiḥ smaryata iti bhāvaḥ |
pūrvāntakaraṇaṃ na yādṛcchikam, kiṃ tarhi ? vivakṣitamityāha---pukaḥ pūrvāntakaraṇamiti | adīdapaditi | yadi punarṇeḥ puṭ‌ syāt, tasya ṇigrahaṇena grahaṇāṇṇau parato yadaṅgaṃ na tasyākāra upadheti hrasvo na syāt | doṣopalakṣaṇaṃ caitat, dāpyate ityādau `ṇeraniṭi' iti ṇerlopenāpahṛtatvātpakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi lopaḥ sarvāpahārī, `alo'ntyasya' ityantyasya lopaḥ | iha tarhi knopayatītīḍāgamaḥ prāpnoti |
lābho'pi kaścinnaivātra parādau sati dṛśyate |
pugantasya guṇo vācyo vṛddhiḥ syādanyathā yataḥ ||
yatkiledamucyate---puṭi sati guṇavidhau pugantagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' ityeva siddhatvāditi, tadapyāśāvādamātram; yataḥ parādāvapyavaśyaṃ puṭi guṇo vidheyaḥ, anyathā `aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiprasaṅgāt ||
śācchāsāhvāvyāvepāṃ yuk || 7.3.37 ||
pāgrahaṇe ityādi | iṣṭireveyam; lākṣaṇikatvāt pārūpasya |
lugāgamastviti | yadyapi pālayatīti rūpam `pāla rakṣaṇe' ityasyaiva curādiṇijantasya punarhetumaṇṇici siddham, tathāpi pāteḥ puki pāpayati, yuki tu pāyayati iti mā bhūditi lugvacanam |
dhūñprīñoriti | `dhūñ‌ kampane', `prīñ tarpaṇe', ñāntasyānukaraṇam; tena na daivādikasya nugbhavati |
ete'pīti | ete yugādayaḥ, vakṣyamāṇāśca jugādayaḥ | kṛtātvānāṃ grahaṇamiti | ākārāntānāṃ yukaṃ vidhāya tadanantaramākārānteṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣu yukaḥ prāptirākhyātā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | evamādīti | ādiśabdena---krāpayati, nijāpayati, vilāpayate, muṇḍo vismāpayate, priyamācaṣṭe prāpayatītyādergrahaṇam ||
vo vidhūnane juk || 7.3.38 ||
`vidhūnane' ityayameva nirdeśo liṅgam---dhūño ṇau nugbhavatīti | vā ityetasyeti | `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' ityasya | `vaja vraja gatau' ityasya ṇici rūpe vājayatīti siddhe, vāteḥ pugnivṛttyarthaṃ juko vidhānam ||
līlornuglukāvanyatarasyāṃ snehavipātane || 7.3.39 ||
snehaḥ- ghṛtādiḥ, tasya vipātanam-vigacchataḥ kāṭhinyaṃ tyajataḥ prayojanakavyāpāraḥ | snehavipātanaṃ kāṭhinyamupagatasyāgnau niṣṭapanādinā dravatvāpādānamityarthaḥ |
na tu kṛtātvasyeti | ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt prasaṅgaḥ | jaṭābhirālāpayata iti | `liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca' ityātmanepadam |
lī iti līlīṅorgrahaṇamiti | kraiyādikadaivādikayoḥ | niranubandhakapari bhāṣā tu neṣyate | kṛtātvasya ca līyateriti | grahaṇamityapekṣyate ||
bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk‌ || 7.3.40 ||
hetuḥ pāribhāṣikaḥ, bhīḥ-bhayam, hetorbhayaṃ hetubhayam, tatra vartamānasya | bhīṣayata iti | `bhīsmyorhetubhaye' ityātmanepadam | bhāpayata iti | `bibheterhetubhaye' ityātvam ||
ruhaḥ po'nyatarasyām || 7.3.43 ||
ayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham ? `rupa vimohane' iti divādau paṭhyate, sa ṇyanto'tra janmani vatiṣyate; anekārthatvāddhātūnām, tasya ropayatīti | rūhestvārohayatīti |
pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyāt idāpyasupaḥ || 7.3.44 ||
atra yadi kādityatrākāro vivakṣitaḥ syāt, etikāścarantītyatretvaṃ na syāt | etado'kaci jasi tyadādyatve ṭāpi ca rūpam | akaco hyantyo'kāra uccāraṇārtho na śravaṇārthaḥ; bhindhiki, rundhaki ityāderasiddhiprasaṅgāt, tataśca kaśabdasyābhāvādetikā ityatra na syādeva | `na yāsayoḥ' iti ca pratiṣedhaḥ saṅghātagrahaṇe'narthakaḥ syāt | tasmāduccāraṇārtho'kāraḥ, varṇamātrameva vivakṣitamityāha---pratyayasthātkakārāditi | sa cediti | sa cedāpsupaḥ parastānna bhavati tadetvamityarthaḥ | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā subanthāditi draṣṭavyam | jaṭilikā, muṇḍiketi | ṭābantābhyāmajñātādiṣu `prāgivātkaḥ', `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvam, tataṣṭāp, tata itvam | yadyapyayamakāro lākṣaṇikaḥ, tathāpi `udīcāmātaḥ sthāne' iti liṅgāttasyāpi bhavati |
kakāramātraṃ hāti | uktamidam---`kāditi varṇamātraṃ vivakṣitam' iti, na kakāramātraṃ kaścipratyayo'sti, tasmāt kātpratyayādityucyamāne'pi pratyayāvayave pratyayaśabdo varttiṣyate iti kiṃ sthagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ |
paṭukā, mṛduketi | paṭumṛduśabdābhyāṃ stryarthavṛttibhyāṃ ke kṛte ṭāp | asati pūrvagrahaṇe `tasmādityuttarasya' iti kātparasyaivākārasya `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' ityekādeśaṃ bādhitvā ittvaṃ syāt | yadyapi jaṭilikā, muṇḍiketyādāvayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ śakyo darśayitum; tathāpi vispaṣṭārthamudāharaṇāntaramupanyastam | rākā, dhāketi | `kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ' |
athāpītyanena kiṃ viśiṣyati iti | kakāraḥ, pratyayo veti sandehātpraśnaḥ | kakāra iti | pratyaye tu viśiṣyamāṇe rathakaṭyādiṣvatiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | yadyapi pratyayo'pi śrutaḥ, tathāpi tasyopasarjanatvāt kakāra eva viśiṣyate | kāriketyatrāpi na syāditi | atiprasaṅgastiṣṭhatu tāvat, iṣṭamapi na siddhyatītyapiśabdasyārthaḥ | `āpi parato yaḥ kakāraḥ'---ityevaṃ vijñāyamāne kāriketyapi na syāt; ekādeśasya yo dvitīyo'kārastena vyavadhānāt | vacanādvyavadhānamīdṛśamiti | āśrīyata iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ | īdṛśamityetadvyācaṣṭe---sthānikadbhāvakṛtamiti | ekena varṇenetyupalakṣaṇam | sthānivadbhāvakṛtamityetāvati tātparyam; anyathā etiketyatra dvābhyāmakārābhyāṃ vyavadhānādittvaṃ na syāt | eka etadaḥ sambandhī, dvitīyaḥ `tyadādīnāmaḥ' ityakāraḥ; tatrākārayoryaḥ pararūpamekādeśaḥ, yaśca ṭāpā saha dīrghaḥ---dvayorapi tayoḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ | anye tvāhuḥ---atrāpi ṭāpā saha ya ekādeśastasyaiva sthānivadbhāvaḥ, na tvakārayoḥ kṛtasya pararūpasya; sakṛtpavṛttyā lakṣaṇasya caritārthatvāt | tenātrāpyekenaiva vyavadhānamiti | vacanādvyavadhāne'pi bhaviṣyatīti vaktavye, īdṛśaṃ vyavadhānamiti yaduktam, tasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---rathakaṭyādiṣviti | rathānāṃ samūho rathakaṭyā, `initrakaṭyacaśca' | ādiśabdena gargakāmyādegrahaṇam | gargamicchatyātmana iti kāmyajantādapratyayaḥ, tataṣṭāp | etaduktaṃ bhavati---āpīti saptamyā yadānantaryamupāttaṃ tannātyantāya tyajyate, kintu yāvatsambhavamāśrīyata iti |
suvantādayaṃ parivrājakaśabdāditi | pratyayalakṣaṇena subantatvam | paryadāse hīti | supo'nyo|ḍasup, tataścedāppara ityāśrīyamāṇa ityarthaḥ | samudāyādasubantāditi | avayavātparivrājakaśabdātsubutpannaḥ, na samudāyāditi tasyāsubantatvam | evamapi nāśrīyate iti | bahuvrīhirapi nāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam ? ityata āha---tathā hīti | bahucarmiketi | bahūni carmāṇyasyāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | tatpuruṣe tvasmin, nātra subantātparaṣṭāv bhavati; kapā vyavahitatvāt |
māmiketi | mameyamityaṇ‌, `tavakamamakāvekavacane' iti mamakādeśaḥ | dākṣiṇaātyiketi | `dakṣiṇādāc', dakṣiṇā, tato bhavādau `dakṣiṇāpaścātpurasastyak'| ihatyiketi | `avyayāttyap‌' ||
na yāsayoḥ || 7.3.45 ||
pūrveṇa nityamittve prāpte niṣedho'yamucyate, prāptipūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasya | yadā yattadorakajbhavati tadā pratiṣedhaḥ | yakā, saketi | yattadorakac, sau tyadādyatve ṭāp | yā seti prathamaikavacanāntayorupādānādvibhaktyantare pratiṣedho na syādityata āha---yāseti nirdeśo na tantramiti | yattadorupalakṣaṇamiti | yadyevam, yattadorityeva vaktavyam ? satyam; tathā tu na kṛtaṃ kiṃ kurmaḥ ! yakāṃyakāmadhīmaha iti | ṛcaṃ gāthāṃ ca | takāṃtakāmpacāmaha iti | oṣadhiṃ śākinīṃ vā, dvāvetau prayogau |
upatyaketi | `upādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ' | atra kaścidāha---`strīviṣayo'yaṃ tyakanpratyayāntaḥ; tataśca prakriyālāghavāya tyikanniti vaktavye tyakannityakāroccāraṇasāmarthyādittvābhāvaḥ' iti tadayuktam; pañcabhirupatyakābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcopatyaka ityādāvārhīyasya ṭhakaḥ `adhyardhapūrva' iti luki kṛte `luk taddhitaluki' iti ṭāpo luki nimittābhāvādittvaṃ na syāditi taddhitalugarthametatsyāt, bahiraṅgo luk, `antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate' | nanu ca `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' ityetadviṣayametat ? netyāha; yaśca yāvām̐śca tuggrāmaḥ, sarvo'pyantaraṅgānvidhīnbādhate, yathā---`sanīsraṃsa' ityādau nalopo na bhavati | pañcakhaṭ‌va ityādau ṭāpā sahaikādeśo na bhavati; yadi syāt, ādivadbhāvādāvgrahaṇena grahaṇālluki sati akāro'tra na śrūyeta |
pāvakā iti | punanti pāvayantīvi vā pāvakāḥ | alomakā iti | bahuvrīheḥ kap |
jīvaketi | `āśiṣi ca' iti vun |
devaketi | devadattaśabdāt `anukampāyāṃ kan', `anajādau ca vibhāṣā lopo vaktavyaḥ' iti dattaśabdasya lopaḥ |
kṣipaketi | kṣiperigupadhātkaḥ | `dhru gatisthairyayoḥ', pacādyaci kuṭāditvād guṇābhāve uvaṅ‌, ubhābhyāmajñātādiṣu `prāgivātkaḥ'|
taraterṇvul‌---tārakā | varṇayati mahattvādikaṃ guṇamiti vaṇakā-prāvāraviśeṣaḥ, tantūnāṃ vikārastāntavam `orañ‌' | vaṇiketi | bhāgurī vyākhyā, ṭīkāviśeṣaḥ | vṛterṇyantāt ṇvul---varttikā |
aṣṭaketi | aśnanti brāhmaṇā odanamasyāmityaṣṭakā, `iṣyaśibhyāṃ takan' iti takan | pitaraśca tā devatāśca pitṛdevatāḥ, tadarthaṃ karma pitṛdaivatyam `devatāntāttādarthye yat' iti yat | aṣṭiketi | aṣṭau parimāṇamasyāḥ, `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' |
sūtaketi | `na sāmivacane' iti pratiṣedhena jñāpitaḥ svārthe kan | putriketi | śārṅgaravāditvānṅīni kṛte svāthikaḥ kan, `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasva ikāraḥ, tasya pakṣe'tvaṃ vidhīyate | vṛndāriketi | `śrṛṅgavṛndābhyāmārakan vaktavyaḥ' ityārakan ||
udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ || 7.3.46 ||
yakau pūrvau yasyāḥ sā yakapūrvā, ko'nyapadārthaḥ ? ākāraḥ | arthagataṃ strītvaṃ śabde samāropya strīliṅganirdeśaḥ, pūrvaśabdo vyavasthāvacanaḥ | ibhyiketi | ibharhatīti `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ'---ibhyā, tataḥ pūrvatkaḥ, hrasvatvaṃ ca | caṭaka--mūṣakaśabdābhyāmajāditvāṭṭāp | sāṅkāśyiketi | saṅkāśaiḥ nirvṛttaṃ sāṅkāśyam, `saṅkāśādibhyo ṇyaḥ', tato bhavārthe `dhanvayopadhādvuñ‌' iti vuñ‌ |
sthānagrahaṇamanarthakam, `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti siddhatvāditi ? ata āha---sthānagrahaṇamityādi | paribhāṣāyā vidhiśeṣatvādanuvāde upasthānaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | anuvādatvameva spaṣṭayati---āta ityanena hīti | ato yo'kārastasyettvaṃ bhavatīti vacanavyaktau nākārasya vidhisparśaḥ kaścidastītyarthaḥ |
strīpratyayasya pratipattyarthamiti | yaḥ `striyām' ityadhikṛtya vihitaṣṭābādiḥ sa strīpratyayaḥ, tasya pratipattiryathā syādityevamarthamityarthaḥ | asati hi strīliṅgeyaḥ kaścanākāro gṛhyeta |
śubhaṃ yāti, bhadraṃ yātīti | kvip | śubham, bhadramiti makārāntau nipātitau, pūrvatkaḥ, hrasvatvaṃ ca |
pratiṣedha iti | tena vidhireva bhavati | sunayikā, suśayiketi | nīśībhyām `erac', suśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ, ṭābādi pūrvavat | supākikā, suśokiketi | paciśucibhyāṃ ghañ‌, `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' iti kutvam | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat ||
bhastraiṣācajājñādvāsvā nañpūrvāṇāmapi || 7.3.47 ||
`svā' iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prathamā | eṣeti kṛtaṣatvanirdeśastantram | tathā ca---etikāścarantīti jasi nityamittvamudāhṛtam ||
atrātaḥ sthāna ityetat svaśabdasya viśeṣaṇaṇ |
sambhavavyabhicārau hi tatra staḥ kākacoḥ satoḥ ||
dvyetadoḥ sambhavo nāsti, nānyatra vyabhicāritā |
sarvanāmnaḥ svaśabdasya tena nāyaṃ vidhirbhavet ||
dvake iti | dvakiśabdād dvivacane tyadādyatve ṭāpi auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ | tasyāṃ satyāmiti | samāsārthāttu yā vibhaktistasyāṃ tyadādyatvaṃ na bhavati; `antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate' iti vacanāt | so'ntaverttinyā vibhaktyā subantātpara iti | pratyayalakṣaṇena subantatvam |
svaśabdo'pi tarhyanayaiva yuktyā nañpūrvo na prayojayedityata āha---svaśabdastviti | svaśabdo hi `svamajñātidhanākhyāyām' iti vacanājjñātidhanayorasarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ, tena tasmātkapratyayenaiva bhavitavyam, nākacā | tatra yadā nañsamāse kapratyayaḥ kriyate tadantācca ṭāp, tadāsau supaḥ paro na bhavati; kena vyavahitatvāt | tenāsarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ svaśabdo nañpūrvo'pi bhavatyeva prayojakaḥ |
abhastrakā, abhastriketi | `alpe' iti `prāgivātkaḥ' | asati tu bhastrāgrahaṇe yathā na sidhyati tathā darśayati---atreti | bahuvrīhiḥ puṃsyapi varttate---abhastraḥ puruṣa iti | vihitagrahaṇenaitaddarśayati---yadyapyabhāṣitapuṃskādbhastrāśabdātparo bhavati, tathāpi tasmādvihito na bhavati | vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ cottaratrāpi bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇam, anyathā na vidyate khaṭ‌vā yasyāḥ sā'khaṭ‌vā, tato'khaṭ‌vikā---ityādāvapi prasaṅgāditi |
apigrahaṇena kevalānāmeva bhastrādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ, nānyapūrvāṇāmiti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyāha---nañpūrvāṇāmapītyapiśabdāditi | iṣyate iti | anena neyaṃ svataḥ prāptiriti darśayati | yadi tarhi sarvatreṣyeta, nañpūrvāṇāmapīti na vaktavyam `aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' ityeva sarvatra bhaviṣyatyata āha---tatreti ||
abhāṣitapuṃskācca || 7.3.48 ||
abhāṣitapuṃskāditi vihitaviśeṣaṇamityāha---abhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyeti | khaṭ‌vāśabdaḥ striyāmeva niyata ityabhāṣitapuṃskaḥ, bahuvrīherabhidheyaliṅgatvādabhāṣitapuṃskatvābhāvādanena vikalpena na bhavitavyamiti manyamānaṃ pratyāha---bahuvrīhāviti | kathaṃ bhavatītyata āha---tatrāpīti | itikaraṇo hetau |
yadā tviti | kababhāvapakṣa etat | akhaṭ‌vā iti sthite upasarjanahrasvatvam, ṭāp, punaḥ `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ | sa ca samāsādbhāṣitapuṃsakādutpannasya ṭāpa iti na bhavatyayaṃ vikalpaḥ | `abhāṣitapuṃskātparasyātaḥ' iti vijñāyamāne syādevātra vikalpaḥ | atikhaṭ‌viketi | atrāpi samāsādbhāṣitapuṃskāṭṭābutpannaḥ ||
ādācāryāṇām || 7.3.49 ||
ittvāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ | `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvāpavādaśca | ācāryāṇāmiti | udīcāmityuktam, tato'nyeṣāmācāryāṇāmityarthaḥ | apara āha---ācāryasya pāṇinerya ācāryaḥ sa ihācāryaḥ, gurutvāttu bahuvacanamiti | sarvathā abhāṣitapuṃskeṣu trairūpyam---akhaṭ‌vakā, akhaṭ‌vikā, akhaṭ‌vāketi ||
ṭhasyekaḥ || 7.3.50 ||
atra dvau pakṣau---ṭheti vyañjanamātraṃ sthānitvena nirddiśyate, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ ḍhagādiṣvapītyekaḥ pakṣaḥ; saṅghātaḥ pratyayaḥ, sthānyapyatra sa eveti dvitīyaḥ | tatrādye pakṣe paṭhitā, paṭhitumityādau dhātvantasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ; dvitīye tu aṭhaci karmaṭha ityatrāpi prāpnoti | tatra dvayorapi pakṣayoryathā doṣo na bhavati tathā darśayannāha---aṅgasya nimittaṃ yaṣṭha iti | sambandhastatra nāvayavāvayavibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, paṭhitetyādāvapi prasaṅgāt; kiṃ tarhi ? nimittanimittibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ | aṅgasya sambandhītyukte tadrūpasambandhyeva pratīyate; pratyayaśca tadrūpasambandhī, tadāyattatvādaṅgavyapadeśasya | tadevamaṅgavyapadeśanimittasya pratyayasya grahaṇādubhayorapi pakṣayordoṣābhāvaḥ | kiñca---saṅghātapakṣe arthavataṣṭhaśabdasya grahaṇānna bhavati karmaṭhaḥ---ityatra prasaṅgaḥ | varṇagrahaṇe tvarthavatparibhāṣā na pravartate | tatra saṅgātapakṣe doṣāntaramāśaṅkya pariharati--tatreti | punarapi tasminneva pakṣe codayati---mathitaṃ paṇyamasyeti | varṇagrahaṇame tu `analvidhau' iti sthānivattvaniṣedhādikasya kādeśāprasaṅgaḥ | kādeśaḥ | prāpnotīti | nanu tāntādaṅgādityucyate, na cātra tāntamaṅgam, tataḥ pratyayasyāvidhānāt ? naitadasti; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādaṅgaṃ bhavati, tāntaṃ ca; tataśca yathā---anukampito bhānudatta iti ṭhaci dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lope kādeśo bhavati---bhānuka iti, tathātrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ? pariharati---sannipāteti | ajādisannipātena tāntatvamupajāyate, tataśca tadvighātasya nimittaṃ nopapadyate | parihārāntaramāha---yasyetilopasyeti | sthānivadbhāvastu `acaḥ parisminpūrvavidhau' ityanena | nanu pūrvasya vidhāvityucyate, parasyāyam ? tatrāha---pūrvasmādapihīti | pañcamīsamāso'pi tatrāśrīyata ityarthaḥ | anye tvāhuḥ---varṇagrahaṇādeva tadantavidhau siddhe, antagrahaṇaṃ pratyayopadeśakāle tāntapratipattyarthamiti ||
isusuktāntātkaḥ || 7.3.51 ||
sārpiṣka iti | `tadasya paṇyam' iti ṭhak‌, `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam | dhānuṣka iti | praharaṇamiti ṭhak‌ | yājuṣka iti | dīvyatyarthe ṭhak‌ | naiṣādakarṣukaḥ, śābarajambuka iti | bhavādāvarthe `ordeśe ṭhañ‌', kādeśe kṛte `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvam | mātṛkam, paitṛkamiti | tata āgataḥ, `ṛtaṣṭhañ‌' | audaśvitka iti | `saṃskṛta bhakṣāḥ', `dadhnaṣṭhak‌', `udaśvito'nyatarasyām' iti saptamyantāṭṭhak | śākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtka iti | `saṃsṛṣṭe' iti ṭhañ‌ | āśiṣeti | `āṅaḥ śāsu icchāyām' ityasmādāśāsanamāśīriti sampadāditvād bhāve kvip‌, `āśāsaḥ kvāvupasaṃkhyānam' itītvam | uṣeti | vaseḥ kpip, yajāditvātsamprasāraṇe lākṣaṇikaṃ rūpamiti | sarpirādau tu `arciśucihūsṛpicchādibhya isiḥ', `janerusiḥ', `artivapiyajitrāpidhanibhyo nit' iti pratipadoktamisuso rūpam |
doṣa upasaṃkhyānamiti | varṇaikadeśānāṃ varṇagrahaṇenāgrahaṇādokāre ya ukāraḥ, tasya ukāragrahaṇenāgrahaṇādupasaṃkhyānam ||
cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ || 7.3.52 ||
pāka ityādau bhāve ghañ‌ | pākyamityādau karmaṇi `ṛhalorṇyat' | yathāsaṃkhyamatra na bhavati---ghiti cakārasya, ṇyati jakārasyeti; `bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ', `prayājānuyājau yajñāṅge', `vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām' ityāderliṅgāt |
kvacitu paṭhyate---yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate, tena raktaṃ rāgāditi liṅgāditi ||
nyaṅ‌kvādīnāṃ ca || 7.3.53 ||
nyaṅ‌ku ityevamādīnāṃ ceti | `siddhaye' iti śeṣaḥ, kṛtakutvānāmeva gaṇe pāṭhāt | kimarthaṃ tarhi sūtram, yāvatā yathaiva kutvādanyadapi ghatvaguṇadīrghatvādikaṃ nipātanādbhavati, tathā kutvamapi bhaviṣyati ? satyam; asati tasmin, anuvāde gaṇasya kvacidapyanupayogātpramādapāṭhaḥ śaṅkyeta | pacādyacīti | ghañi kutvasyāsiddhatvāt |
saṃjñāyāṃ megha ityādi | meghaḥ-paroyagharaḥ, nidāghaḥ-gharmaḥ, avadāgho'pi sa eva | arghaḥ-vikrīyamāṇasya dhānyāderiyattā, mūlyamityanye | vīruditi | nipātanādupasargasya dīrghatvam ||
ho hanterñṇinneṣu || 7.3.54 ||
ñaśca ṇaśca ñṇau, tāvitau yayostau ñṇitau, tau ca naśca ñṇinnāḥ, teṣu ñṇinneṣu | nakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tena vṛtraghni, vṛtraghnorityādāvapi bhavati | ghnantītyādau `gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ |

athetyādi | jusbhaktasya yāsuṭastad‌grahaṇena grahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ | sārvadhātukāśrayaṅittvanimitta iti | sārvadhātukamāśrayo yasya tatsārvadhātukāśraṃya tan ṅitvaṃ nimittaṃ yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ | etena yāsuḍāśrayaṅittvanimittamiti vyākhyātam | tatra hi prāpte cāprāpte ceti | cinuyurityādau prāpte, ajuhavurityādāvaprāpte | ksasyācītyanuvarttate iti | parihārāntaram, jakāroccāraṇaṃ tu cakruḥ---ityādau liṭi mā bhūt ||
sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ || 7.3.84 ||
sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoriti kimiti | evaṃ manyatepratyaya iti vaktavyam, evamapi hīṣṭe viṣaye siddhyatīti | saṅiti pratyāhāraḥ; sanaḥ saśabdādāharabhyā mahiṅo ṅakārāt | agnitvamiti | pratyaya ityucyamāne, atrāpi prāpnoti | agnikāmyatīti | saṅītyucyamāne atrāpi prāpnoti ||
jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu || 7.3.85 ||
aviciṇṇalṅitsu parata iti | viciṇṇalṅidbhyo'nye ye pratyayāsteṣu parata ityarthaḥ | jāgārayatītyādīni vṛddhiviṣaye udāharaṇāni | jāgaritaḥ, jāgaritavāniti pratiṣedhaviṣaye |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣayāṇyevodāharaṇāni upanyastāni ? tatrāha---vṛddhiviṣaye, pratiṣedhaviṣaye ceti | anyatra pūrveṇaiva guṇasya siddhatvādetadviṣaya evāyaṃ guṇaḥ, tatrāpyubhayaviṣayaḥ, katham ? ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhāt vṛddhiviṣaye tāvadbhavati, ṅitpratiṣedhāt pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pīti | tasminkṛta iti | `aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttau' ityetadanāśrityocyate | sā na bhavatīti | kiṃ kāraṇam ? ityāha---yadi hīti | yadyapi jāgaritaḥ, jagaritavānityatra guṇavidhiścaritārthaḥ, tathāpi vṛddhiviṣaye'pyetadvidhānamityuktam, tatrāsyānarthakyamucyate | kiñcetyāha---ciṇṇalośceti | yadi guṇe kṛte `ata upadhāyā' iti vṛddhiḥ syācciṇṇalorguṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt | astu tatrāpi guṇaḥ; vṛddhau satyāmajāgāri, jajāgāreti siddham |
jāgṛta iti | laṭ‌, tas, adāditvācchapo luk, `sārvadhātukamapit' iti ṅittvam |
atra vīti keciditi | `aviciṇṇalṅitsu' ityatra yo vakārātpara ikārastamuccāraṇārthaṃ varṇayanti, tatra `yasminvidhiḥ' iti vakārādau pratiṣedhaḥ | kimarthaṃ punasta evaṃ varṇayanti ? ityata āha---kvasāvapīti | jajāgṛvāniti | `neḍvaśi kṛti' iti iṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ | tatra krādiniyamādiṭ prāptaḥ `vasvekājād‌ghasām' iti niyamānna bhavati | ye tu kvipo lopādvarṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhācca paryudāsaṃ necchanti, teṣāṃ jāgariti guṇo bhavatyeva | anye tvāhuḥ---yathā atṛṇeḍiti pratyayalakṣaṇenebhāgamī bhavati, varṇasya pratyayaviśeṣaṇatvāt; evaṃ kvipo'pi paryudāsaḥ, tatastu jāgṛditi bhavati |
codayati---kathamajāgaruriti | evaṃ manyate--prasajyapratiṣedho'yaṃ viciṇṇalṅitsu na bhavatīti, tataśca `jusi ca' ityasyāpi guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tathottame ṇali ṇittvābhāvapakṣe guṇa iṣyate--`sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' iti, tasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnotīti | pariharati---nāpratiṣedhāditi | nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, kutaḥ ? apratiṣedhāt | nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, kastarhyayam ? ityāha---aviciṇṇalṅitsviti paryadāso'yamiti | paryudāse hi viciṇṇalṅitsu na vidhirna pratiṣedhaḥ, tato'nyatra vidhānam, tena jusi ṇali ca lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāpto guṇo bhavatyeva |
prasajyapratiṣedhe'pyāha---atha veti | `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' iti bhāvaḥ | keciddarvirityatra guṇadarśanādauṇādikaṃ vicpratyayayaṃ varṇayanti, teṣāṃ jāgṛvirityatra guṇaḥ prāpnoti | na ca veḥ pratiṣedhavaiyarthyam; kvipi kvasau ca caritārthatvāt | tasmājjāgarteḥ kidvaktavyaḥ ||
pugantalaghūpaghasya ca || 7.3.86 ||
bhettā, chetteti | kathaṃ punaratra guṇaḥ, yāvatā dhātvantapratyayādyorhalorānantarye `saṃyoge guru' iti gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyā bādhanānna prāpnoti, bhedanamityādau sāvakāśo guṇaḥ ? ata āha---pratyayāderiti | knusanoḥ kitkaraṇeneti | `trasigṛdhidhṛṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ' iti knoḥ kikkaraṇasyaitatprayojanam---gṛdhnurityādau guṇo mā bhūditi | yadi caivaṃvidhe viṣaye gurūpadhatvād guṇo na syāt, knoḥ kitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | tathā `halantācca' iti sanaḥ kittvavidhānasyaitatpratyojanam---pitsatītyādau guṇo mā bhūditi, tadapi jñāpakamuktārthasya | idaṃ tu jñāpakaṃ nopapadyate; sisṛkṣati, didṛkṣate ityatra `sṛjidṛśoḥ' ityamāgamo mā bhūdityevamarthametatsyāt, tathā dhipsatītyatra nalopārthaṃ tatsyāt | tasmāt knoreva kitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam | bhinatti, chinattītyatra śramo'kāreṇa laghūpadhamaṅgam, tatra dhātorikārasya guṇaḥ prāpnoti, ata āha---upadhātreti | na hyatra yā kācidupadhā gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? `iko guṇavṛddhī' ityasyopasthānāt sthānitvena sannihita igeva |
apare tviti | varṇayantīti sambandhaḥ | puki anta iti | antaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ | yadyapi `puganta' ityatra bahuvrīhāvapi na doṣaḥ, tathāpyaikarūpyeṇa viśeṣaṇārthamayamapi tatpuruṣa eva vyākhyātaḥ | laghvī upadheti | karmadhārayaḥ | atra pakṣe śābda evopadhāyā ikā sambandhaḥ---laghvyā upadhāyā ika iti | pugantalaghūpaghamiti | samāhāradvandvaḥ |
kvacid `upadhātra' ityādergranthasya purastāt saṃyoge gurusaṃjñāyāmiti ślokatrayaṃ paṭhyate | dhātvantapratyayādyorhalorānantarye sati gurusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ guṇo bhetturbheśabdasya na sidhyati | pariharati--vidhyapekṣamiti | idaṃ vidhānamiti śeṣaḥ | laghūpadhādye vihite sārvadhātukārdhadhātuke, tayoraṅgasya guṇa ityarthaḥ | nanu pañcamyabhāvāt kathaṃ vidhānamupapadyate ? ucyate; ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe'pi viśeṣyata iti cetko doṣaḥ---laghūpadhasya ye sārvadhātukārdhadhātuke | ke ca te ? ye tasmādvihite ityupapadyate | laghoścāsāviti pāṭhe laghūpadhāccāsau tṛjvihita ityarthaḥ | upadhāśabdastu vṛttabhaṅgabhayānna prayuktaḥ | kathaṃ kuṇḍiriti | aṅgādhikāre numo vidhānādakṛta eva numi pratyayo laghūpadhādvihitaḥ, tatra parato nimitte sthite kuṇḍitetyādau guṇaḥ prāpnoti, yadi vidhānaṃ viśeṣyata ityarthaḥ | pariharati---dhātornuma iti | hetau pañcamī, yasmāttatra dhātornumaṅgasya tasmādityarthaḥ | uktaṃ hi tatra---`dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanam---dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num yathā syāt' iti, tataśca prāgeva num, paścātpratyayaḥ; na cāsau laghūpadhādvihito bhavati | kathaṃ rañjeriti | yadi ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pi vidhānaṃ viśeṣyate, tadānyatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ, tataśca `ata upadhāyāḥ' ityakāropadhādvihite pratyaye vidhīyamānā vṛddhī rañjerna syāt; prāk pratyayotpatternakāropadhatvāt--rāga iti, `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti nakāralopaḥ | yadyapyu padhāyā akārasya vṛddhirucyate, na ca tataḥ pratyayasya vidhānaṃ sambhavati, tathāpyakāropadhādyadvidhānaṃ tadevopadhāyā vidhānaṃ manyate | syandiśranthyoriti | yadayam `syado jave', `avodaidhodmapraśrathahihaśrathāḥ' iti syandiśranthyorvṛddhyabhāvaṃ nipātayati, tajjñāpayati----bhavatyevañjātīyakānāṃ vṛddhiriti | tatra hi nalopārtham, vṛddhyabhāvārthaṃ ca nipātanamāśrayaṇīyam | yadi ca vṛddhiviṣaye vidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta, tato vṛddhiprasaṅgābhāvānnipātanāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | nalopasya siddhaye vidhirevāśrayaṇīyaḥ, anekaprayojanasiddhaye hi nipātanāśrayaṇam | anallopeti | anantasya yo'llopaḥ so'nallopaḥ; śau dīrghatvam, śidīrghatvam---tayordvandvaḥ, anallopaśidīrghatve vidhyapekṣe na siddhyataḥ | yadi ca ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśe'pi vidhānaṃ viśeṣyeta, allopo rājña ityādāveva syāt; asthnā, asthne, dadhnā, dadhne---ityādau na syāt | śau dīrghatvaṃ ca sāmāni ityādāveva syāt, kuṇḍānītyādau tu na syāt | tasmātṣaṣṭhīnirdeśeṣu vihitaviśeṣaṇagrahaṇe doṣaprasaṅgād guṇo bhetturna siddhyatīti | evaṃ tarhi jñāpakātsiddham, yadayam `nābhyastasyāci' ityajgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati---bhavatyevañjātīyake viṣaye guṇa iti | tasya hi prayojanam---nenaktītyādau halādau guṇapratiṣedho mā bhūditi | yadi ca halādāvalaghūpadhatvād guṇo na syāt, tadā guṇasya prāptyabhāvātkiṃ tannivāraṇārthenājgrahaṇena ! naitadasti jñāpakam; abhyastasya yadāhāci laṅarthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhavet | abhyastasyājādau pratiṣedhamāheti yat tallaṅarthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet, yatra halādirlupyate---anenegiti, tasmānna jñāpakam | evaṃ tarhi---knusanoryatkṛtaṃ kittvaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāllaghorguṇe | vyākhyātametat ||
nābhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke || 7.3.87 ||
nenijānītyādi | loṭ‌, `merniḥ', `āḍuttamasya picca' śapaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam, `ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' | anenijamityādi | laṅ‌, mipo'mbhāvaḥ |
vedānīti | `vida jñāne', loḍādi yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat, śapo luk | nenektīti | laṭ, tip, kutvam | pid‌grahaṇamuttarārthamiti | `tṛṇaha im' piti yathā syāt, iha tu pito'nyatrāpi `sārvadhātukamapiti' iti ṅittvādbhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena | ninejeti | ṇal, sa ca `liṭ‌ ca' ityārddhadhātukasaṃjñaḥ |
jujoṣaditi | `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ', leṭ, vyatyayena parasmaipadam, tip, `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu', `leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityaṭ‌, vyatyayena śapaḥ śluḥ, dvirvacanam | yadyatra guṇapratiṣedha iṣyate, paspaśāte ityādau upadhāhrasvatvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti | tasmādabhyastānāmupadhāyā hrasvatvameva vidheyam, na guṇapratiṣedhaḥ | kathaṃ nenijānītyādi, guṇe kṛte upadhāhrasvatvam, `eca igghrasvādeśa', siddhamiṣṭam ? ata āha---paspaśāte ityādi | spaśirvārttikakāravacanādapaṭhito'pi dhātuḥ, tasmālleṭ, vyatyayenātmanepadam, ṭeretve `leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityāṭ, śapaḥ `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śluḥ, dvirvacanam | atha vā---yaṅ‌luki chāndasamabhyāsasya hrasvatvam | cākaśītiti | `kāśrṛ dīptau', yaṅ‌luk, laṭ, tip, `yaṅo vā' itīḍāgamaḥ | vāvaśītiriti | `vāśrṛ dīptau', yaṅ‌luk‌, laṭ‌, śatrādeśaḥ, ṅīp, śas | chāndasaṃ hrasvatvamiti | yadi tu guṇaniṣedhaṃ pratyākhyāyopadhāhrasvatvamucyeta, tadā narnṛtītītyādau ṛdupadhe rapare guṇe kṛte hrasvabhāvinyupadhā nāstīti rūpaṃ na siddhyet | tasmācchāndasameva hrasvatvameṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ | prakṛtyantarāṇāmeveti | `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ' `kaśa gatiśāsanayoḥ', `vaśa kāntau' ||
bhūsuvostiṅi || 7.3.88 ||
abhūditi | luṅ‌, `gātisthā' ityādinā sico luk | suvai, suvāvahai, suvāmahai iti | `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇigarbhavimocane', loṭ, ceretvam, `eta ai', `āḍuttamasya picca', śapo luk, uvaṅādeśaḥ |
suvatisūyatyostviti | `ṣū preraṇe' tudādiḥ, `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇiprasave, divādiḥ | bhavatīti | śapi guṇaḥ |
vyatibhaviṣīṣṭeti | āśiṣi liṅ‌, `liṅāśiṣi' ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā, `kartari karmavyatihāre' ityātmanepadam |
atheti | prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅ‌lugantasyāpi grahaṇātprasaṅgaḥ | jñāpakāditi | sūtestu nipātanābhāvād guṇaniṣedho bhavatyeva---soṣuvītīti ||
uto vṛddhirluki hali || 7.3.89 ||
yavānīti | loḍuttamaikavacanam |
api stuyāditi | apiḥ sambhāvane karmapravacanīya iti `upasargātsunoti' ityādinā ṣatvaṃ na bhavati | ṅicca pinna bhavatīti | yāsuḍādeḥ sārvadhātukasya sākṣācchiṣṭaṃ ṅittvamanavakāśam, tibādīnāṃ tu pittvaṃ lakārāntareṣu sāvakāśam, tena `ṅicca pinna bhavati' iti `picca ḍinna bhavati' iti vacanadvayasadbhāve'pi `ṅicca pinna bhavati' ityetadevātra pravarttata iti bhāvaḥ | `kṅiti ca' iti pratiṣedhastvatra na labhyate, kiṃ kāraṇam ? ika ityevamiksaṃśabdanena yā vṛddhistasyāḥ sa pratiṣedhaḥ, iha tu `uttaḥ' iti nirdiṣṭasthānikatvādikparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate ||
guṇo'pṛkte || 7.3.91 ||
nanu ca `hali' iti varttate, `piti' iti ca, aṅgena ca pratyaya upasthāpyate; tatra halātmake pratyaye piti vidhāyamāno guṇo'pṛkta eva bhaviṣyati, nārtho'pṛktagrahaṇena ? ityata āha---halīti varttamāna iti | apṛktagrahaṇaṃ hyevamarthaṃ kriyate--halādau mā bhūditi, yadi ceyaṃ paribhāṣā na syāt, apṛktagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtaṃ tu, jñāpayati--bhavatyeṣā paribhāṣeti | idaṃ tvatra vaktavyam---tadantavidhinivṛtyarthamapṛktagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti, tadantavidhau hi laṅi mipo'mbhāve'pi prasaṅgaḥ syāt | nanu bhavatyeva tatra guṇaḥ, kathaṃ bhavati ? yadā pūrvatra vṛddhividhāvapi tadantavidhireva bhavati | tadetadapṛktagrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ tadādividherjñāpakamiti cintyam | `nāpṛkte' ityucyamāne'nantarāyā vibhāṣitāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, nityā tu vṛddhaiḥ syādeva | tasmād guṇagrahaṇam ||
tṛṇaha im || 7.3.92 ||
tṛṇeḍhīti | imi kṛte śnamo'kāreṇa saha `ād‌guṇaḥ', `ho ḍhaḥ', `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', ṣṭutvam, ḍhalopaḥ | tṛṇekṣīti | `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' | atṛṇeḍiti | laṅ‌, tipsiporanyataraḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ, ḍhatvajaścacartvāni |
nanuṃ ca `halādau' ityucyate, na cātra halādiṃ paśyāmaḥ ? pratyayalakṣaṇena | varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam ? ata āha--varṇāśraye'pyatreti | yatra kevalo varṇa eva nimittaṃ yasya sa varṇāśrayaḥ, yathā---gave hitaṃ gohitamityavādeśaḥ | iha tu piti sārvadhātuka iti pratyaya eva nimittam, hal‌ tasya viśeṣaṇam, tenāsau pratyayanimittatvādbhavatyevetyarthaḥ | tṛṇahānīti | loṭ, `meniḥ' | tṛṇaaḍha iti | tas‌ ḍhatvādi pūrvavat, `śnasorallopaḥ', anusvāraparasavarṇau |
atha kimarthaṃ tṛhirāgataśnamko gṛhyate ? raudhādikasya `tṛha hiṃsāyām' ityasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, `tṛhi hiṃsāyām' ityasya taudādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt | nāsya piddhalādisārvadhātuka manantaraṃ sambhavati; vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt | nanu cāsyāpi yaṅ‌lugantasya sambhavati, evaṃ tarhi sānubandhakatvāt tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? ata āha---tṛṇaha itītyādi | yadyāgataśnamko na gṛhyeta, tato nāprāpte śnamyārabhyamāṇa im tasya bādhakaḥ syāt | athāpi na bādhakaḥ, evamapi śnami kṛte imitīṣṭavyavasthā na syāt | viparyayo'pi syāt---pūrvamimāgamaḥ, paścāt śnamiti | saśnamkanirddeśe tu na śnamo nivṛttirbhavati, iṣṭā ca vyavasthā sidhyati---pūrvaṃ śnam, paścādimiti | atastadarthamāgataśnanko gṛhyate | kiñca---raudhādikasyāpi yaṅ‌lugantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati saśnamkanirddeśādeva ||
bruva īṭ || 7.3.93 ||
`bruvaḥ' iti pañcamī, na ṣaṣṭhī; vyākhyānāt | tayā'caritārthayā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ sārvadhātuka iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate | tadāha---bruva ityetasmāduttarasyeti | iha brūtādbhavāniti tātaṅa aupadeśikena ṅittvena sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ pittvaṃ bādhyate---`ṅicca pinna bhavati' iti, teneḍ na bhavati ||
yaṅo vā || 7.3.94 ||
lālapītītyādi | lapivadirautibhyo yaṅ‌luk, dvirvacanam | rauterabhyāsasya guṇaḥ | itarayordīrghatvam | vavartīti | vṛte rūpam, `rugrikau ca luki' ityabhyāsasya ruk | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ yaṅ‌lugantamevodāhṛtam, na punaryaṅantam ? tatrāha---halāderiti | yaṅante hi śapā bhavitavyam, sa ca halādirna bhavati ||
turustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke || 7.3.95 ||
tu iti sautro'yaṃ dhāturiti | sa ca vṛddhau varttate, gatyartha ityanye, hiṃsārtha ityapare | uttavītiti | `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo luk | śamīdhvamiti | śamerantarbhāvitaṇyarthātpraiṣe loṭ, vyatyayenātmanepadam, śap, tasya `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti luk |
āpiśalā iti | āpiśaleḥ śiṣyāḥ | sāvadhātukāsviti | ṭābantam | tatra saṃjñātvena viniyuktaṃ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanarthakam, `nābhyastasya' ityādeḥ sūtrādanuvṛtteḥ ? ata āha---sārvadhātuke iti vartamāna iti | taddhi sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ pitītyanena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tadapyanuvarteta, tanmānuvṛtadityevamarthaṃ punaḥ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamiti | `hali' itiyetattvanuvarttata eva; na hi tatsārvadhātukagrahaṇena sambaddham ||
astisico'pṛkte || 7.3.96 ||
`apṛkte' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī, tenāpṛktasyaivāyamāgamaḥ | āsīditi | `as bhuvi', śapo luk, tipa īṭ | alāvīditi | luṅ‌, `iṭa īṭi iti sico lopaḥ |
āhibhuvorīṭ‌pratiṣedha ityādi | sthānivatsūtra etadvārttikam | āhibhuvoḥ sthānivadbhāvasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, īṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ | āttheti | `vruvaḥ pañcānām' ityādinā sipasthal, bruva āhādeśaḥ, `āhasthaḥ' iti hakārasya thatvam, tasya `khari ca' iti cartvam---takāraḥ | abhūditi | luṅ‌, `asterbhūḥ' `gātisthā' ityādinā sico luk | atra sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhādastyāśrayastāvadīṇna bhavati | sijāśrayo'pi na bhavati, sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasāmarthyāt | astvevamastyādeśe bhuvi, śuddhe tu bhavatau sijāśraya īṭ prāpnoti, tasmādīḍevātra pratiṣedhyaḥ | āhiviṣaye parihārāntaraṃ jñāpakātsiddham, yadayaṃ jhalādiprakaraṇe `āhasthaḥ' iti thatvaṃ śasti | nanu ca bhūtapūrvagatyarthametasyāt---jhalādiryo bhūtapūrvastatreti ? naitadasti; evaṃ tarhi pañcānāmapi tibādīnāṃ bhūtapūrvajhalāditvamiti sarvatra thatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tataścāthameva vidadhyāt ||
bahula chandasi || 7.3.97 ||
ā iti | asterlaṅ‌, tip, śapo lup, rutvavisarjanīyau akṣāḥ, atsā iti | `kṣara sañcalane', `tsara chadmagatau', luṅ‌, tipo halṅyādilopaḥ, `rātsasya' iti sico lopaḥ, dāturephasya visarjanīyaḥ | chāndasatvāditi | `bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityanena na kevalamamāṅyoge'ḍāṭorabhāvaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? māṅyoge tatsadbhāvo'pīti bhāvaḥ | iḍabhāvaśca sica iti | chāndasatvādityapekṣate ||
rudaśca pañcabhyaḥ || 7.3.98 ||
rudiḥ svapiḥ śvasiranirjakṣiḥ pañca rudādayaḥ |
rudaḥ iti bahuvacanasthāna ekavacanam | `pañcabhyaḥ' iti nirddeśādādyarthāvagatiḥ ||
aḍ‌ gārgyagālavayoḥ || 7.3.99 ||
gāgyagālavayorgrahaṇaṃ pūjārthamiti | na vikalpārtham; vidhānasāmarthyādevāḍīṭorvikalpasya siddhatvāt | anekācāryagrahaṇamapyata eva ||
adaḥ sarveṣām || 7.3.100 ||
sarveṣāṃgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham, anyathā gārgyagālavagrahaṇamiha vikalpārtha sambhāvyeta ||
ato dīrgho yañi || 7.3.101 ||
kecidatra tiṅityanuvarttayantīti | `bhūsuvostiṅi' ityataḥ | bhavavāniti | bhavateḥ kvasuḥ, tasya `chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvācchap, `liṭi dhāto' ityatra dhātugrahaṇācchabantasya dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | ye tu `sārvadhātuke' ityevānuvarttayanti, teṣāṃ chāndasatvāddīrghābhāvaḥ | atha prakṛto'ḍāgama eva kasmānna vidhīyate---`ato yañi' iti, akārāntādaṅgāduttarasya yañādestiṅo'ḍāgamo bhavati, paca avas, savarṇadīrgatve pacāva iti siddhaṇ, vidhānasāmarthyācca `ato guṇe' iti pararūpatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; iha hyadhukṣāvahi, adhukṣāmahīti `ksasyāci' iti lopaḥ prasajyeta | iha cātijarābhyāmiti jarasbhāvaḥ | evamapi dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakam, ādityākāra eva vidheyaḥ ? iha tarhi prayojanam---apākṣī rodanaṃ deva dattaḥ | nanu pacāmi bhorityatrāpi `anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' iti plutaḥ prāpnoti ? sa mā bhūddīrgha eva yathā syāditi dīrghagrahaṇam |
ata iti taparakaraṇamuttarārtham, `bahuvacane jhalyet' ityetvaṃ khaṭ‌vābhirityatra mā bhūt ||
supi ca || 7.3.102 ||
vṛkṣāyeti | sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvādatra dīrghatvam | anityatvaṃ ca `kaṣṭāya' iti nirdeśādavasitam ||
bahuvacane jhalyet || 7.3.103 ||
vṛkṣāṇāmiti | `jhali' ityanucyamāne'gnīnāmityādau sāvakāśam `nāmi' iti dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvedametvamakārānteṣu syāditi bhāvaḥ ||
āṅi cāpaḥ || 7.3.105 ||
khaṭ‌vayā, khaṭ‌vayorityādīni ṭābḍāpcāpāṃ krameṇodāharaṇāni | kīlālapeti | kīlālaṃ pibati `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' iti vic, tṛtīyaikavacane `āto dhātoḥ' ityālopaḥ, asati tu pidviśiṣṭasya grahaṇe kīlālapaḥ paśyetyādau caritārthaṃ lopaṃ bādhitvā paratvādāṅosoridamevaitvaṃ syāt |
ḍyābgrahaṇe'dīrghagrahaṇāditi | yatra ṅyāpau gṛhyete tatra dīrghayorgrahaṇam, na hrasvayoḥ | sthānivadbhāve tu prasaṅgaḥ, tatra sthānivatpratiṣedhasūtraprastāve vārttikam---`ṅyābgrahaṇe'dīrghaḥ' iti, ṅyāporgrahaṇe'dīrgha ādeśo na sthānivaditi | tatrārthādidamuktaṃ bhavati---ṅyāporgrahaṇe dīrghayorgrahaṇamiti, tadidaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitam ||
ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ || 7.3.107 ||
ambārthāḥ- mātrārthāḥ |
ḍalakavatīnāmiti | arthagatena strītvenāmbārthāḥ śabdā nirdiṣṭāḥ, śrutyapekṣo vā strīliṅganirdeśaḥ---`ḍalakavatīnāṃ śrutīnāmityarthaḥ' iti | asaṃyuktāśca ḍalakā gṛhyante; tenākka, alleti hrasvo bhavatyeva |
devate bhaktiriti | hrasvatve kṛte, `ṅyābgrahaṇe'dīrghaḥ' iti sthānivattvaniṣedhādyāḍāgamo ṅerāmapi na bhavataḥ |
mātṝṇāmiti | pūrvapadabhedana bahavo mātṛśabdā iti bahuvacanam | putrārthamiti | putramabhidhātuṃ yo mātṛśabda upādīyata ityarthaḥ | bahuvrīhau ca varttipadairanyapadārtho'bhidhīyata iti tatraivayamādeśaḥ | kīdṛśāya putrāyeti | samāse guṇībhūtasyāpi putrastha buddhyā pravibhajya nirddeśaḥ, yathā---`atha śabdānuśāsanam, keṣāṃ śabdānām' iti | mātrā vyapadeśamarhatīti | yaḥ putraḥ ślāghyaguṇatvātkulasambhūtayā mātrā vyapadeśamarhatītyarthaḥ | yatra tu piturasaṃvijñānena mātrā vyapadeśastatra na bhavati, etaccārhata iti praśaṃsāyāṃ laṭaḥ śatrādeśavidhānāllabhate | samāsāntāpavāda iti | nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt ||
hrasvasya guṇaḥ || 7.3.108 ||
hrasvavidhānasāmarthyāditi | nanu hrasvavidhānaṃ tasya guṇavidhānārthameva syāt, anyathā hrasvatvābhāvād guṇo na syādata āha---yadīti | hrasvaṃ vidhāya guṇe vidhīyamāne prakriyāgauravaṃ bhavatīti lāghavārthaṃ sākṣādeva guṇaṃ vidadhyādityarthaḥ | nanu `nadīhrasvayorguṇaḥ' ityucyamāne `jasi ca' ityatra nadyā apyanuvṛttiḥ syāt, ekasamāsanirdiṣṭatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasamāsanirdiṣṭayorapyekadeśo'nuvarttate, tadyathā---`saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp', `dāmahāyanāntācca' ityatra saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, nāvyayagrahaṇam ||
jasi ca || 7.3.109 ||
jasādiṣviti | ādiśabdaḥ prakāre, tena pūrvayoganirdiṣṭānāmapi grahaṇam | darvīti | `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti ṅīṣvikalpamanapekṣyaitaduktam, tata eva tu siddhaṃ rūpadvayam | śatakratva iti | `jasi ca' iti guṇābhāvapakṣe `prathamayoḥ' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrgho'pi `vā chandasi' iti vacanānna bhavatīti yaṇādeśaḥ pravarttate | kikidīvyeti | `āṅo nāstriyām' iti nābhāvo na bhavati | kikidīviśabdaḥ `kṛvidhṛṣvi' ityuṇādiṣu nipātitaḥ ||
ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ || 7.3.110 ||
taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārthamiti | ṅisarvanāmasthānayordīrghāntasyāsambhavāt | dhātvanukaraṇamapi na sambhavati, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' itītvavidhānāt | karta ṇītyatyādāvapi numaḥ pūrvāntatvādasambhavaḥ ||
gherṅiti || 7.3.111 ||
dhyantasyāṅgasyeti | `varṇamātrasya ghisaṃjñā' ityāśrityedamuktam | `tadantasya saṃjñā' ityatra tu pakṣe ghyekadeśe varṇe ghiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ | etena nadyantāditi vyākhyātam |
supītyeveti | `supi ca' ityataḥ | paṭ‌vīti | `vāto guṇavacanāt' iti | kuruta iti | yasya nadīsaṃjñā nāsti sa sarvo'pi ghisaṃjñaḥ, na liṅgavadeveti | kuruśabdasya ghisaṃjñā, tasya tasi ṅiti guṇo na bhavati | etacca ṅicchabde bahuvrīhimāśrityocyate | yadi tu ṅaścāsāvicceti karmārayastadā naivātra prasaṅgaḥ, `sārvadhātukamapit' ityanena hi bahuvrīhau ṅito yatkāryaṃ tadatidiśyate, na caitāvatā taserṅakāra ādirbhavati ||
āṇnadyāḥ || 7.3.112 ||
`nadyāḥ' iti pañcamyakṛtārthā ṅitīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati, tena ṅita evāyamāgamo vijñāyata ityāha---nadyantādaṅgāduttarasyeti | kumāryā iti | `āṭaśca' iti vṛddhiḥ | atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, aḍevocyeta, `vṛddhireci' iti vṛddhyā savarṇadīrghatvena ca kumāryai, kumāryā iti siddham ? na siddhyati; `ato guṇe' pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti | aḍ‌vacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati ? astyaḍ‌vacane prayojanam, kim ? śriyai, śriyā ityatra `sāvekācaḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi | āgamānudāttatvaṃ hi pratyayasvaramiva vibhaktisvaramapi bādhate, viśeṣato'trāḍ‌vacanasārthyāt ||
yāḍāpaḥ || 7.3.113 ||
dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, na yaḍevocyeta, vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ savarṇadīrghatve ca khaṭ‌vāyai, khaṭ‌vāyā iti siddham ? na sidhyati; `ato guṇe' pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati | astyanyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam---jñāye, jñāyā ityatra `sāvekācaḥ' ityādyudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi | kiñca---uccāraṇārtho'pyakāraḥ sambhāvyeta, iha khaṭ‌vāmatikrānta iti prādisamāse hrasvatve ca tasya sthānivadbhāvāttataḥ parasya caturthyekavacanasya `ṅeryaḥ' iti yādeśaṃ bādhitvānena yāṭ prāpnoti, tatra kṛte dīrghatve cātikhaṭ‌vāyai devadattāyeti prasaṅgaḥ, tatrāha---ātakhaṭ‌vāyetyatreti | akṛte dīrghatva iti | yādeśāt prāgavasthāyāmidamuktam | kṛte tahi yādeśe dīrghatve ca ṅiccāsau bhūtapūrva iti yāṭ prāpnoti ? ata āha---kṛte ca lākṣaṇikatvāditi ||
sarvanāmnaḥ syāḍ‌ḍhrasvaśca || 7.3.114 ||
dīrghoccāraṇaṃ sarvasyā ityatra vṛddhiryathā syād, `ato guṇe' pararūpatvaṃ mā bhūt | akāroccāraṇaṃ tu asyā ityatra `ūḍidampadādi' iti vibhakterādyudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt, āgamānudāttatvaṃ yathā syādevamartha syāt | kiñca uccāraṇārtho'pyakāraḥ sambhāvyeta ||
vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtīyābhyām || 7.3.115 ||
aprāptavibhāṣeyam; asarvanāmatvāt | nanu ca `tīyasya vā ṅitsūpasaṃkhyānam' ityanenaiva siddhatvānnārtha etena, taccāvaśyaṃ vaktavyaṃ liṅgāntare'pi smāyādayo vikalpena yathā syuriti ? naitadyuktamucyate; yaddhi sūtreṇāsiddhaṃ tadupasaṃkhyānena sādhanīyam, na punarupasaṃkhyānāśrayaṇena sūtrasya pratyākhyānaṃ yujyate |
yadi punaratra hrasvayorgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā syāḍ‌grahaṇaṃ ca nivartya `sarvanāmnaḥ' ityevā nuvartyātideśa āśrīyate---sarvanāmno yaduktaṃ tadvibhāṣā bhavati dvitīyātṛtīyayoriti, tadopasaṃkhyānaṃ śakyamakarttum ||
ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ || 7.3.116 ||
`ṅeḥ' iti saptamyekavacanagrahaṇam; icchāyām, striyāmityādinirdeśāt | grāmaṇyāmiti | `satsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip‌, `agragrāmābhyām' iti ṇatvam, `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ‌ ||
idudbhyām || 7.3.117 ||
nadīgrahaṇamihānuvarttate | yadyevam, apārthakamidam, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt, tataśca `idudbhyāmaut' ityekayoga eva karttavyaḥ ? naivaṃ śakyam; aukāro hi syāt, nadīlakṣaṇasyāmo'vakāśaḥ---kumāryāmiti, autvasyāvakāśaḥ---patyau, sakhyāviti; kṛtyāmityatra yadā nadīsaṃjñā tadā paratvādauttvaṃ prāpnoti ||
aut || 7.3.118 ||
yanna nadīsaṃjñamityādi | nadīsaṃjñake pūrveṇām vihitaḥ, ghisaṃjñe'pyuttareṇātvasaṃyuktamautvaṃ vakṣyati, tasmādābhyāmanyadevodāharaṇam | tatra pūrvatra `ghyantānnadyantāt' ityuktam, iha tvikārokārāntamityuktm, saṃjñāvidhau ca pakṣadvayaṃ darśitam---varṇamātrasya saṃjñā, tadantasya veti; tena nāsti virodhaḥ ||
acca gheḥ || 7.3.119 ||
kṛtau, dhenāviti | athātrātve kṛte `ajādyataṣṭāp' iti ṭāpkasmānna bhavati, astu ko doṣaḥ ? `ḍerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ', `yāḍāpaḥ' ityetau vidhī prāpnutaḥ, autvavidhānaṃ tu puṃsi caritārtham ? ata āha---taparakaraṇaṃ striyāmāpo nivṛttyarthamiti | iha hi sthānino mātrikatvādbhāvyamānatvāccāṇo dīghasya prasaṅgo nāsti, yasya nivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ syāt | tasmācchāstrantareṇāpi dīrgho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate, etacca sannipātaparibhāṣāmanāśrityoktam | ṅisannipātakṛtaṃ hyatvaṃ tadvighātakasya ṭāpo nimittaṃ na bhavati |
audacca gheriti yeṣāmityādi | iha kecit `audacca gheḥ' ityekayogamevādhīyate, tatra yadi samuccaye caśabdaḥ syāt, yatrātvaṃ tatraivautvaṃ syāt---dhenāviti; gheścātvamityaghau sakhyau, patyāvityatrautvamapi na syāt, asya doṣasya nivṛttaye pradhānaśiṣṭamautvamanvācayaśiṣṭamatvamiti varṇayanti | tatra yathā `karttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' ityatra salopasyānvācayaśiṣṭasyābhāve'pi śyenāyata ityādau kyaṅ‌ bhavati, tathā atrāpi sakhyau, patyāvityatvābhāve'pi autvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
āṅo nā'striyām || 7.3.120 ||
`āṅaḥ' iti sthānyantarasyopādānād gheriti ṣaṣṭhī pañcamyā vipariṇamyata ityāha---gheruttarasyeti | atha kimarthamastriyāmityucyate, `āṅo nā puṃsi' ityevocyeta, evaṃ hi mātrayā lāghavaṃ bhavati, iṣṭaṃ ca sidhyati ? evamucyamāne trapuṇā, jatunetyatra napuṃsake na prāpnoti | mā bhūnnābhāvaḥ, `ikoci vibhaktau, iti numi kṛte siddhamiṣṭam ? ata āha--puṃsīti noktamityādi | amunā brāhmaṇakuleneti | `puṃsi' ityucyamāne nābhāvo na syāt | numapīglakṣaṇo nāsti; mutvasyāsiddhatvāt | `astriyām' ityucyamāne napuṃsake'pi nābhāvo bhavati | nābhāve karttavye mutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ nāsti | `na mune' iti pratiṣedhāditi `napuṃsake' ityucyamāne'pi na sidhyati | tasmādastriyāmityeva vaktavyamiti ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ saptamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ
<7.4>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ---6
atha saptamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ || 7.4.1 ||
`ṇau' ityaṅgāpekṣayā parasaptamī, `caṅi' iti ṇyapekṣayā | udāharaṇeṣu kṛhṛlūpūbhyo ṇic, luṅ‌, caṅa, ṇilopaḥ, hrasvatvam, dvirvacanam | tatra ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti kṛ ityādi dhāturūpaṃ dvirucyate, kṛ hṛ ityetayoruradatvam, `sanvallghuni' iti sanvadbhāvāditvam | itarayorapi `oḥ puyaṇjyapare' itītvam | sarvatra `dīrgho laghoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | atreti | anantarodāhṛteṣu | paratvāditi | caṅīti dvirvacanasyāśiśrayadityādiravakāśaḥ, hrasvasya tu kṛtadvirvacanamavakāśaḥ; akṛte tu dvirvacane vipratiṣedhaḥ | tatra kṛte dvirvacanamiti | tataśca sanvadbhāve karttavye hrasvatvaṃ na sthānivadbhavati; abhyāsasyādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāditi bhāvaḥ | codayati---iha tviti | māṅ‌prayoga āḍ‌ mā bhūditi | nityatvāditi | dvirvacanaṃ hi kṛte'pi hrasvatve prāpnoti, akṛte'pi, tataśca tadeva syāttatra ko doṣaḥ ? ityata āha---tathā satīti | pariharati---naiṣa doṣa iti | oṇeriti | `oṇṛ apanayane' ityasya ṛditkaraṇaṃ etatprayojanam---ṛdito neti pratiṣedho yathā syāt | yadi cātra dvirvacanaṃ syāt, ṛditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syād, dvirvacane kṛte pararūpeṇa vyavahitatvādeva hrasvatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, paśyati tvācāryaḥ---dvirvacanād hrasvatvaṃ balīya iti, tata oṇimṛditaṃ karoti | ṇāviti kimiti | hrasvaśrutyā acparibhāṣopasthānādaca upadhāyā hrasvena bhāvyam | na cāṇyantānāṃ caṅi upadhā hrasvabhāvinī sambhavati, na hi śridrusnudheṭ‌śvīnāmajupadhā | kamigupyostu hrasva evopadhā, tataśca caṅi yaḥ pratyayastasminnupadhāyā hrasvo bhavati sa ca ṇireva, tatra ṇāvantaraṅgatvād vṛddhyādiṣu kṛteṣu upadhāyā hrasva iti siddhamiṣṭamiti praśnaḥ | itaraḥ---yathāśrutasambandhasambhave caṅi yaḥ pratyaya ityadhyāhāro na yukta iti vacanādantaraṅgamapi vṛddhyādikaṃ bādheteti matvā''ha---caṅyupadhāyā iti | hrasvaḥ syāditi | nanu ca ūkārasya hrasvaḥ, tasmiṃśca kṛte bādhitatvānmā bhūd vṛddhiḥ, guṇastu kenacidabādhitatvādbhaviṣyati, tato'vādeśe siddhamalīlavaditi ? naitadasti; guṇasya vṛddhyā bādhitatvād vṛddheśca hrasveneti bhraṣṭāvasarasya guṇasya kutaḥ punaḥ pravṛttirityuvaṅ‌ prasajyeta | astu vā tatra guṇaḥ, doṣāntaramāha---adīdapadityatreti | yadā tu caṅ‌paranirhnāse sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ, tadā vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ puki ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvābhāvāccaṅi yadaṅgaṃ tasyaivopadhā hrasvabhāvinī sambhavatīti ṇāviti na vaktavyam | sūtrakāreṇa sthānivattvaniṣedho na kṛta iti `ṇau' ityuktam |
caṅīti kimiti | mitāṃ hrasvavidhānādanena ṇau sarvatra hrasvo na bhaviṣyati, prayogadarśanācceṣṭato vyavasthāśrayiṣyate iti praśnaḥ | itaraḥ---nāntareṇa vacanamiṣṭāniṣṭavibhāgaḥ sujñāna iti matvā''ha--kārayati, hārayatīti | kiñca---mitāṃ hrasvavacanam `asiddhavadatrābhāt' ityetadarthaṃ syāt | upadhāyā iti kimiti | hrasvaśrutyā `acaḥ' ityupatiṣṭhate, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārādaṅgenājviśaṣyate, aṅgasya yatra tatra sthitasyāco hrasvo bhavati, tenopadhāyāstāvatsiddhaṃ hrasvatvamiti praśnaḥ | itaro'pyatiprasaṅgamudāharati--acakāṅ‌kṣaditi | nanu `ṇau' ityanenācaṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ---ṇau parato'ṅgasya yo'jiti, tatra sāmarthyādakavarṇavyavadhānamavaśyambhāvitvādāśrayiṣyate ? ityāha---tadetaditi | uttarārthamiti | `lopaḥ pibaterīccābhyāsasya'---upadhāyā yathā syādantasya mā bhūdityevamarthamavaśyamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam | yadyuttarārthamupadhāgrahaṇam, tatraivaṃ karttavyam | yadyevam, tatraiva kriyatām ? ata āhatadihāpīti | āllopaḥ pibateriti | evamucyamāne'ntaraṅgamapi yukamanavakāśatvādāllopo bādhate, upadhāgrahaṇe tvantaraṅgatvādyuki kṛte ākārasya upadhāyā lopa iti na kaścid doṣaḥ | tasmāduttarārthamupadhāgrahaṇam | apara āha---ihārthamapyupadhāgrahaṇam, anyathā ṇāvanantarasya hrasvo vidhīyamāno'ntaraṅgamapi vṛddhyādika vādhitvā lū-i at iti sthite ukārasyādeśaḥ prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam `nāglopiśāsvṛditām' iti pratiṣedhe śāsti, tajjñāpayati---nāntyasyeva hrasvatvamiti |
ṇau ṇicyupasaṃkhyānamiti | ṇau parato yo ṇistasminnityarthaḥ | ṇeṇicīti pāṭhe ṇyantātpare ṇici vihita ityarthaḥ | vāditavantaṃ prayojitavāniti | luṅo bhūtakālatvātprayojitavāniti bhūtakālena vigrahaḥ | vāditavantamityatra tu katham, yadyasau vāditavān kathaṃ prayuktiḥ, kurvato hi prayuktiḥ kariṣyato vā, na tu kṛtavataḥ ? na brūmaḥ---prayuktikālāpekṣayātra bhūtakālatvamiti, ki tahi ? yathāśabdaprayogakālapekṣayā | prayojitavānityatra bhūtakālatvaṃ tadapekṣayaiva prayojyavyāpārasyāpīti | avīvadaditi | vaderṇyantāṇṇici luṅādi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyati ? ata āha---yo'sāviti | sthānivadbhāve hi sati yaścaṅ‌paro ṇirna tatropadhā hrasvabhāvinī, yatropadhā hrasvabhāvinī na sa caṅ‌paraḥ; dvitīyena ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | tena ceti | ṇilopena | aglopitvāditi |
nanu ca ṇyantāṇṇici vihite ṇilopaśca prāpnoti, `aco ñṇiti' iti vṛddhiśca, tatra lopaḥ śabdāntare prāpteranityaḥ, vṛddhestu lope kṛte'tyantāprāptirityubhayoranityayoḥ paratvād vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaikārasya lopaḥ, tannāglopyaṅga bhavati ? evaṃ tahi yadaglopināṃ neti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---vṛddherlopo balīyāniti; anyathā sarvatrāko vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaikāraukārayorlopaḥ, na tvakaḥ | naitadasti jñāpakam; yatra vṛddhāvapi kṛtāyāmageva lupyate tadarthametatsyāt---rājanamatikrāntavānnatyararājat, yattahi pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ karoti; anyathāllopināṃ netyeva brūyāt ? etadapi nāsti jñāpakam; svāminamākhyadasasvāmat, gomucamākhyadajugomat, prāvṛṣamākhyadapaprāvat, yādṛśamākhyadayayādat--ityevamādyarthametatsyāt | atrāhuḥ---ṇijatra nāsti; anabhidhānāt ! etacca bhāṣyakāreṇa jñāpakatvasamarthanādavasitamiti | yatra tarhyabhidhānamaṅgīkṛtaṃ tadrathametatsyāt `vinmatorluk'---bhāsvantamākhyat ababhāsat ? naitatpratyāhāragrahaṇasya prayojanam, akāra eva hyatra matupo lupyate | yatra tarhi vino luk---sragviṇamākhyadasasrajat ? atrāpi nopadhā hrasvabhāvinī | tasmātpratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti sthitametat | evamapi harikalyoratvanipātanaṃ sanvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthamiti yaduktaṃ tenaidvirudhyate | tathā hi---asatyapyatvanipātane vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā ikārasya lope sati naiva sanvadbhāvasya prasaṅgaḥ | tasmādaglopitvāditi nāyaṃ svapakṣaḥ, paramatena tvetaduktaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
bhāṣyasyāpyevamevātra nirvāho dṛśyatāṃ budhaiḥ |
viparyaye tūcyamāne yuktiḥ kācinna dṛśyate ||
evaṃ ca paṭumākhyat balimākhyat apīpaṭat, abībaladiti bhavati | yathā tvatra bhāṣyaṃ tathā apapaṭat, ababaladiti bhavatītyalamiyatā |
upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---ṇyākṛtinirdeśātsiddhamiti | ākṛtiratra jātirnirddiśyate---caṅ‌parā yā ṇyākṛtirjātistatreti | tataśca satyapi sthānivattve ṇyākṛterevatvādyaścaṅ‌paro ṇiḥ sa eva pūrvaḥ, yaśca pūrvaḥ sa eva caṅ‌para iti siddhaṃ hrasvatvam | yadapyuktam---`aglopitvāt' iti, tadapi na; ākṛtinirddeśe hi hrasvasya na ṇyākṛtinimittatvenāśrīyate | tatra gobalīvardanyāyena tasyā ṇyākṛteranyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣayatvenā''śrīyate iti sarvamavadāt ||
nāglopiśāsvṛditām || 7.4.2 ||
yatra ṇau parato'glopastadihāglopi gṛhyate |
dīvyatiprabhṛternāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ śāsvṛdid‌grahāt ||
śakyaḥ śāsigraho'kartumṛdideṣa paṭhiṣyate |
ṛśāsū anuśiṣṭāvityevameke pracakṣate ||
vadantyanye tu sūtre'smin śāsiṃ niranubandhakam |
paṭhantaḥ pratiṣedho'sya yaṅ‌lukyapi bhavediti ||
tatra sthānivadbhāvādapi siddhamiti | sthānivadbhāve hi sati hrasvabhāvinyupadhā na sambhavati | halacorādeśe tu na siddhyatīti | yathā `sudhāturakaṅ‌ ca' iti samudāyasyādeśatve'vayavasyānādeśatvādaṇo raparatvaṃ na bhavati---saudhātakiriti, tathā samudāye sthāninyavayavasyāsthānitvādajādeśatvābhāvānnāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | iha tvaglopigrahaṇasāmarthyāt samudāyalopo'pyaglopa āśrīyate ||
bhrājabhāsabhāṣadīpajīvamīlapījāmanyatarasyām || 7.4.3 ||
`bhrāja dīptau', `bhāsṛ dīptau', `bhāṣa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' bhauvādikāḥ; `dīpi dīptau', daivādikaḥ, sarve'nudāttetaḥ; `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe' bhauvādikaḥ; `mīla nimeṣaṇe', `pīḍa avabādhane'---curādī |
bhrājabhāsorityādi | avaśyamanayoranudātto'nubandha āsaṅ‌ktavyaḥ, ṛkārānurodhastvapāṇinīya ityucyate | ṛkārānubandhe prāpte vibhāṣā, varṇāntare tvaprāpte vibhāṣeti | ṛkārānurodhe phalaviśeṣābhāvādapāṇinīyatvam |
kāṇyādīnāmiti | kāṇivāṇirāṇiheṭhilopiprabhṛtayaḥ kāṇyādayaḥ | ādiśabdaḥ | prakāre ||
lopaḥ pibaterīccābhyāsasya || 7.4.4 ||
apīpyaditi | nanu ca paratvānnityatvādupadhālope kṛte, anackatvād dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti ? ata āha---upadhālope kṛta iti | upadhāyā eva paryāyeṇettvaṃ mā bhūditi abhyāsasya grahaṇam | ākāralopenāṅgasyāglopitvāllaghunaśca parasyāsambhavāt `sanvallaghuni' itīttvadīrghatvayorabhāvādīttvavidhiḥ | tipā nirdeśo yaṅ‌lugnivṛtyarthaḥ ||
tiṣṭhaterit || 7.4.5 ||
atiṣṭhipaditi | ṇau kṛtasyetvasya sthānivadbhāvāt sthāśabdasya dvirvacanam, sanvadbhāvādabhyāsasyettvam | tipā nirdeśaḥ pūrvavat ||
urṛt || 7.4.7 ||
upadhāyā ṛvarṇasyeti | atha artterdhātorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati, mā bhavānarpipad iti yathā syāditi ? taparakaraṇāt | taddhi dīrghe'pi sthānini hrasva eva yathā syāditi | hararārāmapavāda iti | `kṛta saṃśabdane'---ityasya `ṛta iddhātoḥ' itītvaṃ prāpnoti, `vṛtu varttane' ityādīnāṃ guṇaḥ, `mṛjervṛddhiḥ'---te ca raparāḥ santa hararāro bhavanti | acikīrttaditi | ṇau kṛtamapīttvaṃ na sthānivad‌ bhavati | yatra dvirukte parabhāgasyādyo'javarṇastatra sthānivattvam | tathā ca `oḥ puyaṇjyapare' iti jñāpakamapyetādṛśameva | nanu cāntaraṅgā irarāraḥ, ṇijmātrāpekṣatvāt; ṛkārastu bahiraṅgaḥ, sa hi paścādbhāvinaṃ caṅamapekṣate, tatkathaṃ tenaite bādhyante ? ata āha---vacanasāmarthyāditi | yadyantaraṅgatvādirarāraḥ syuḥ, vyarthamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt |
taparakaraṇamityādi | asati tasminyatra sthānī dīrghastatrāntaratamyāddīrgha eva syāt | nanu bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti, tatkathaṃ dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---na cāyamiti | asati taparakaraṇe iti bhāvaḥ | kathamabhāvyamānaḥ ? ata āha---ādeśāntareti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---prāptapratiṣedhasya pratiprasave sambhavati nāpūrvavidhānaṃ yuktamiti tāvannyāyaḥ, tataścāsati taparakaraṇe ādeśāntarāṇāmirarārāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ yathāvasthitamṛvarṇasvarūpamevābhyanujñāyeta | sambhāvane liṅ‌, sambhavati ca savarṇagrahaṇe sati svarūpābhyanujñānam | tatra svarūpamevābhyanujñāyatāmiti savarṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt, taparakaraṇe tu sati svarūpābhyanujñānaṃ na sambhavati, ato bhāvyamānatvasampattaye taparakaraṇamiti | prāyeṇa tu abhyanujñāyate iti uḍantaṃ paṭhyate, na tatra samīcīno'rthaḥ; kriyamāṇānuvāde hi laḍ‌ bhavati | anye tu vyācakṣate---ādeśāntaranivṛttyartha svarūpamevābhyanujñāyata ityevamāpadyeteti ||
dayaterdigi liṭi || 7.4.9 ||
avadigya iti | `deṅ‌ rakṣaṇe', ṅittvādātmanepadam, `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇ‌ |
na tu dayetyasyeti | `daya dānagatirakṣaṇeṣu' ityasya | tasya liṭyāmvihita iti | `dayāyāsasaśca' ityanena |
digyādeśena dvirvacanasya bādhanamiṣyata iti | nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt | nanu dayateḥ prāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bādhyatām, digyādeśasya tu sthānivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tatkathaṃ bādhyate, na hi tasminnāprāpte tasyārambhaḥ ? ucyate; bādhyabādhakabhāve hi dvetam---lakṣyaṃ vā lakṣaṇena bādhyate, lakṣaṇaṃ vā teneti | tatrādye pakṣe syādetaccodyam, dvirvacanaśāstrasyābādhitatvāt; dvitīye tu dvirvacanaśāstramevāsmin viṣaye digyādeśaśāstreṇa bādhitamiti kṛte'pi digyādeśe nāsti dvirvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ | yadyevam, `astarbhūḥ'---babhūva, atra dvirvacanaṃ na syāt, anavakāśā hi vidhayo bādhakā bhavanti, sāvakāśaścāyam, ko'vakāśaḥ ? bhavitā, bhavitum; yastarhi liṭyeva vidhīyate--`cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ‌', `vā liṭi' iti, tatra dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti---ācakhyau ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ārdhadhātuke liṭīti viṣayasaptamī, tataśca dvirvacananimittasya liṭa utpatteḥ prāgeva khyāñādeśaḥ, paścālliṭi parato dvirvacanam | iha tu parasaptamyāśrayaṇānnāprāpte dvirvacane digirārabhyamāṇastad bādhate | evamanyatrāpi, yatra bādho neṣyate tatra lakṣya bādho vaktavyaḥ, viṣayasaptamī vāśrayaṇīyā ||
ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ || 7.4.10 ||
sasvaraturityādi | `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ', `dhvṛ hūrcchane', `smṛ cintāyām' | atra paratvād guṇe kṛte paścād dvirvacanamiti guṇavidhānasamaye saṃyogāditvamaṅgasya | yadvā---dvirvacane halādiśeṣe kṛte sāmpratikāsambhāvād bhūtapūrvasaṃyogāditvamāśritya guṇaḥ ||
pratiṣedhaviṣaya iti | thali, uttame ṇali ṇittvābhāvapakṣe ca sāmānyalakṣaṇo naiva guṇaḥ siddhaḥ---sasvartha, ahaṃ kila sasvara | vṛddhiviṣaye tarhi paratvādayameva guṇaḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha---vṛddhiviṣaye tvityādi | guṇasyāvakāśaḥ---sasvaratuḥ, ṇiti vṛddheravakāśaḥ---kārakaḥ, hārakaḥ; sasvāretyādau vṛddhiviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ | nanu ca paratvād guṇe'pi kṛte tasmin `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti siddham ? satyam; parihārāntaraṃ tvidaṃ draṣṭavyam---taparakaraṇaṃ nirdeśārtham | dīrghasya tu ātastarurityādāvuttarasūtreṇa guṇo bhavatyeva | na ca tasyā api prāpteḥ saṃyogādiṣu taparakaraṇasāmarthyādvyāvṛttiḥ; nirdeśārthatayā tasyopapatteḥ |
saṃyogāderityādi | aṅgasyāsaṃyogāditvādvacanam | upadhāgrahaṇaṃ deśaviśeṣopalakṣaṇam, almātrasyopadhāsaṃjñāvidhānāt saṃyogasyopadhātvāsambhavāt, saṃyogāvayave vā saṃyogaśabdo varttate, upadhātvaṃ tu mukhyam | sañcaskaraturiti | `samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe', `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' iti suṭ | yadi saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, nārthaḥ saṃyogādigrahaṇena; ihāpi sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruriti `saṃyogopadhasya' ityeva siddham ? bhavetsiddham---sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruriti; idaṃ tu na siddhyati--sañcaskaratuḥ, sañcaskaruriti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt---bahiraṅgaḥ suṭ‌, antaraṅgo guṇaḥ | kathaṃ suṭo bahiraṅgatvam ? ata āha---atra hīti | atra darśane sādhanābhidhāyī liṭ tāvadbhavati, tataśca tāvatyeva nimittamastīti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, suṭ tu paścādupanatamupasargamapekṣata iti bahiraṅgaḥ, tenāsau guṇe karttavye'siddha iti asaṃyogopadhatvād guṇo na syāt | sasvaraturityādau ca sāvakāśaṃ vacanam | saṃyogādigrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe saṃyogopadhagrahaṇasyānanyārthatvādasiddhatvaṃ bādhyata iti guṇasiddhaiḥ | avaśyaṃ ca suṭo bahiraṅgatvameṣitavyamityāhaevaṃ ca kṛtveti | `suṭkātpūrvaḥ' ityatroktam---kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ suṭo'bhaktatvajñāpanārthamiti, iha tu bhāṣyakārapakṣāvalambanena bhaktatve'pi parihāra ukta iti na virodhaḥ ||
ṛcchatyṝtām || 7.4.11 ||

tatra prāpatijñamityatra prāptiṃ vyācaṣṭe---tatreyaṃ prāptiriti | taparakaraṇasāmarthyāditi | abhyāsaviśeṣaṇe tu bhūtapūrvadīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamiti vyākhyeyam | na hi mukhyanivarttyasambhave gauṇakalpanā nyānyeti aṅgaviśeṣaṇamṛta ityāśrita mityarthaḥ ||
sanvallaghuni caṅ‌pare'naglope || 7.4.93 ||
`laghuni caṅ‌pare' iti vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau, na sāmānādhikaraṇe; caṅ‌parasya laghuno'sambhavāt | caṅ‌pare ṇau parata iti | kṛthaṃ punarṇāviti labhyate ? caṅ‌parasyānyasyāsambhavāt | nanu cācakamatetyatra makāraḥ | sambhavati, adudruvad, asusravadityatra vakāraḥ ? evaṃ tarhi `caṅ‌pare' ityaṅgasya viśeṣaṇam---caṅ‌pare yadaṅgaṃ tasya yo'bhyāsastasya sanvatkāryaṃ bhavati | laghuni dhātvakṣara iti | caṅ‌pare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya sambandhi yallaghvityarthaḥ | sāmarthyāṇṇyantasya grahaṇamite | ṇeḥ samīpabhūtasyāṅgasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ | ṇyantasyāvayavabhūtaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tasya grahaṇamiti vā | anaglopa iti | nāsminnaglopo vidyata iti anaglopaḥ | etacca `caṅ‌pare' ityanena samānādhikaraṇam | tenāyamarthaḥ---caṅ‌pare ṇāvako lope'satīti | atatakṣadityatra saṃyogaparatvād gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyā bādhaḥ, ajajāgaradityatra ākāraḥ | paraḥ |
atra kecidityādi | nanu ca gakāro jāśabdena vyavahitaḥ ? ata āha---sarvatraiveti | acīkaradityādāvapi kakārādinā vyavadhānāllaghorānantaryaṃ nāsti, tataśca vacanaprāmāṇyādvyavadhāna eva sanvadbhāvena bhavitavyamiti teṣāmabhiprāya ityarthaḥ | dūṣayati---tadasaditi ||
yadi tahi varṇasaṅghātena vyavadhānaṃ nāśrīyate vyañjanasaṅghātenāpi vyavadhāne na sidhyatīti manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---kathamiti | evañjātīyakānāmiti | saṃyogavyavahitānāmityarthaḥ |
acakamateti | `kamerupasaṃkhyānam' iti cleścaṅādeśaḥ | acakathaditi | `katha vākyaprabandhe' curādāvadantaḥ, `ato lopaḥ' | atrāllopasya sthānivadbhāve sati vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyati, ataḥ pratyudāharaṇāntaropanyāsaḥ | adadṛṣaditi | `tadācaṣṭe' iti ṇica iṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopaḥ | atrājjhalorlopaḥ, nāca eva kevalasyeti nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | etadarthaṃ ca `anaglope' ityetatkriyamāṇamacakathadityatra sanvadbhvāvaṃ nivarttayatīti tasyopanyāsaḥ |
yadi caṅ‌pare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya yallaghu tatra parato'bhyāsasya sanvadbhāvo vidhīyate, vāditavantaṃ prayojitavānavīvadadityatrāpi tarhi na prāpnoti, kiṃ kāraṇam ? yaścaṅ‌paro ṇirna tatra laghuḥ; pūrveṇa ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | lope kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam | ajādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivad bhavatīti sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānameva | yadyapi dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvo nipiddhaḥ, sanvadbhāve tu prāpnoti | yasmiṃśca ṇau laghurnāsau caṅ‌paraḥ; dvitīyena ṇicā vyavahitatvāt | bhavatu vā sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ, aglopitvānna prāpnoti | vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ ṇelepiḥ, tannāglopyaṅgaṃ bhavati | aglopi vāstu, prāgeva vṛddherṇilope kṛte ? tatrāpi parihāramāha---yo'sau ṇau ṇerlopa ityādi | tato'nyo'glopa iti anyākāro'nya uktaḥ | jātyāśrayaṇe hi gobalīvardanyāyena ṇijāteniṃmittatvena parigṛhītāyā anyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ parigṛhyate, na tu tasyā ṇijāteḥ; tataścāsya lopasyāglopatvenānāśrayaṇaāttenāglopyaṅgaṃ na bhavatīti bhavatyevātra sanvadbhāvaḥ | mīmādīnāmatra grahaṇāditi | tatra hyaca iti `abhyāsalopaśca' ityeva siddhe'tragrahaṇaṃ viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham | atra mukhye sanyeva bhavati, na sanvadbhāvaviṣaya iti |
kiñcetyādi | anenedamāha---na kevalaṃ mukhyasanparigrahamātramatra kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? hasbhāvadyapi viṣayatvena nirdiśyate | iha ca dhātoḥ sanvadbhāvādisbhāvādi na bhavati, tataścābhyāsalopo'pi na bhavatīti | yadvā---sakārādau sanyabhyāsalopo vihitaḥ, na sanmātre, tataśca sāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśāt lopābhāvaḥ ||
dīrgho laghoḥ || 7.4.94 ||
abribhrajaditi | `bhrājabhāsa' ityādinā pakṣe upadhāhrasvanipedhaḥ ||
utsmṛdṝtvāraprathamradastṝspaśām || 7.4.95 ||
taparakaraṇasārthyāditi | sthānino hrasvatvād bhāvyamānatvena savarṇagrahaṇācca nānena dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ, ato lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptaṃ dīrghatvaṃ taparakaraṇena vyāvartyate ||
ī ca gaṇaḥ || 7.4.97 ||
`gaṇa saṃkhyāne' curādāvadantaḥ, tasyāto lopenānaglopa iti pratiṣedhādvacanam | kṛtayorhalādiśepadīrghatvayorītvamatvaṃ ca vidhīyate |
`lopaḥ pibateḥ' ityetadatraiva paṭhitavyam---pibaterālopaśceti, cakārāt ī cābhyāsasya ? satyam; vibhāṣetyasyānuvṛttiḥ śaṅkyeta ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ saptamasyādhyāyasya turīyaścaraṇaḥ

<8.1>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ --- 6
sarvasya dve || 8.1.1 ||
`nityavīpsayoḥ' ityevamādīnāṃ vidheyakāryiṇoranirdeśena sākāṅ‌kṣatvātsvaritatvāccādhikāro'yam, tadāha---savasyeti dve iti ceti | `sarvasya' ityukte yatpratīyate, `dve' it cetyukte yatpratīyate, etadarthasvarūpamityarthaḥ | yadyapi `svaṃ rūpam' iti vacanādubhayorapi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ yuktam, tathāpi `nāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu vā', `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti dvirukte'cchabdasya sattāmaṅgīkṛtya kāryavidhānāttadabhāvaḥ | na hi dvayoranyatarasya vā svarūpagrahaṇe dvirukte'cchabdasya sambhavaḥ, tathā `tasya paramāmreḍitam' iti pūrvaparābhāvādanupapannaṃ syāt | tasmādarthagrahaṇam | sarvaśabdaścāyaṃ dravyaprakārāvayavakārtsnyavṛttiḥ, dravyakārtsnye yathā---sarvasvaṃ dadātīti, yacca yāvacca svaṃ tatsarvaṃ dadātīti gamyate | prakārakārtsnye yathā---sarvānnīno bhikṣuriti, sarvaprakārakamannaṃ bhakṣayatīti gamyate | avayavakārtsnye yathā---sarvaḥ paṭo dagdha itiḥ, sarvāvayavaḥ paṭo dagdha iti gamyate | iha tu paryādīnāṃ viśiṣṭārthānāṃ śabdānāmupādānād dravyaprakārakārtsnyayorasambhavaḥ | yatrāpi kiñcinnopādīyate `nityavīpsayoḥ' iti, tatrāpi viśeṣānupādānādeva sarvasya śabdasya siddham | tasmādavayavakārtsnyavṛttirgṛhyate | pareḥ sarvasya dve bhavataḥ, na kaścidavayo dvirvacanena varjyata ityarthaḥ |
atra `ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye vartante' iti `dve' ityasya saṃkhyeyāpekṣāyāṃ śabdānuśāsanaprastāvācchabdarūpe saṃkhyeye `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vacanātsarvasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, sarvasya paryādeḥ sthāne dve śabdarūpe bhavata ityarthaḥ, yathā---`asterbhūḥ' iti, tadā `sthāne dvirvacanam' ityayaṃ pakṣo bhavati | śabdasambandhini tūccāraṇe saṃkhyeye sthānyādeśabhāvo na sambhavati, nivṛttidharmā hi sthānī śabdaścennivṛtta kasyoccāraṇaṃ syāt | ato'dhyāhṛtoccāraṇaśabdāpekṣayā `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti sarvasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, sarvasya paryāderdve uccāraṇe bhavataḥ, sarvaḥ paryādidviruccāraṇīya ityarthaḥ, tadā `dviḥ prayogo dvirvacanam' ityeṣa pakṣo bhavati |
tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃma darśayati---sarvasya sthāne dve bhavata iti | ke dve iti | viśeṣānupādānādye kecana dve prāpnuta iti praśnaḥ | itaro'pyantaratamaparibhāṣāmāśrityāha---śabdataśceti | bibhītakādivācināmakṣādiśabdānāṃ śabdata evāntaryam, tarupādapādīnāmaryata eva, dvayostu pacatiśabdayorubhayathāntaryam; tatra te eva yathā syātāmityubhayagrahaṇam | te evobhayathāntaratame darśayati---ekasyeti |
nanu cārimanpakṣa rājārājā, vākvāk, liṭ‌liṭ‌, godhuggodhuk, śabdaprāṭ‌śabdaprāṭ‌, upānadupānat, gaurgaurityatra nalopa-kutvā-ḍhatva-ghatva-ṣatva-dhatva-dīrghatvā(vṛddhī) nāmasiddhatvādakṛteṣveteṣu dvirvacane kṛte padasya sthāne samudāyasyādiṣṭatvāttasyaiva sthānivadbhāvena padatvaṃ nāvayavayoriti pūrvatra bhāge nalopādīni na syuḥ, uttaratra tu samudāyapadatvenāpi siddhyati ? nanu ca nalopādīnyataraṅgāṇi padatvamātrā pekṣatvād, dvirvacanaṃ tu bahiraṅgaṃ vīpsādyarthāpekṣatvāt, tataśca teṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati ? evamapi kṛtānāmapi teṣāṃ dvirvacane kartavye'siddhatvānnakā rādiyuktasya dvirvacanamiti punaḥ pūrvapade nimittabhāvānna syureva, yathā aujaḍhadityatra kṛtānāvapi ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāt hata ityetasya dvirvacane'bhyāse hakārasyaiva śravaṇaṃ bhavati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyatyetat `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' iti, tataśca paratvādantaraṅgatvādvā nalopādiṣu kṛteṣu tadyuktasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yāni tarhi padakāryāṇi nākṛte dvirvacane prāpnuvanti, tāni na syuḥ; tadyathā kiṅkimiti---`vā padāntasya' iti parasavarṇavikalpaḥ, apacannapacanniti ṅamuṭ‌, agnāagnāviti valopaḥ, chāyācchāyeti tugvikalpaḥ, vṛkṣatvakṣāniti `padantasya' iti ṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ, aje'je iti, `eṅaḥ padāntādati' iti pūrvarūpatvam | kiṃ cātra `svarito vānudātte padādau' ityeṣa vidhirna syāt, uttarabhāgasyāpadatvāt; tathā'padatvāttadāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi prāpnuvanti, tadyathā---aṅganāṅganetyato guṇe pararūpatvaṃ syāt, payaḥ paya iti `so'padādau' iti satvaprasaṅga ityeṣā dik | ato dvayorapi pṛthakpadatvameṣitavyam; taducyate---yadi pratyastamitāvayavabheda eka evādaśaḥ syād‌, `dve' iti dvirvacanamanupapannaṃ syāt; tataḥ `dve' iti vacanādekasya padasya sthāne dve pade samudite yugapadādeśatvena vidhīyete, tatra sthānivadbhāvena samudāyasyāpi padatvaṃ svataḥ, evaṃ cāvayavayorapīti samudāyasyāvayavayośca padakāryāṇi bhaviṣyanti | evamapi visaṃvisam, musalaṃmusalamiti `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naivaṃ vijñāyate---ādeśasya sakāra iti, kathaṃ tarhi ? ādeśo yaḥ sakāra iti | atra ca samudāyasya samudāya ādeśaḥ, na sakāramātrasya sakāramātramiti na bhaviṣyati | iha tahi nṛbhirnṛbhiriti samudāyasya padatvādrephanakārayoḥ samānapadasthatvādraṣābhyāmiti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ; tatra samānagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, `pade' ityevāstu, tatrāpadasthayornimittanimittinorasambhavādekatvavivakṣārthameva padagrahaṇamiti samānapadasthatvaṃ sidhyati, tataśca samānagrahaṇāda yatra samānapadasthatvameva, tatra ṇatvam | iha tu sthānivadbhāvādekapadatvam | vastutastu padadvayātmaka ādeśa iti pṛthakpadasthamiti ṇatvābhāvaḥ | tadevaṃ nirdoṣaḥ `sthāne dvirvacana' pakṣaḥ |
idānīṃ dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayati---yadā tviti | dvirāvarttata iti | uccāryamāṇasya śabdasya yo vyāpāra uccāraṇaṃ nāma sehāvṛttivivakṣitā | dviruccaratītyarthaḥ | dve āvṛttī bhavata iti | dve uccāraṇakriye bhavata ityarthaḥ | na punarmukhye evāvṛttī dve bhavataḥ, tathā sati trirvacanaprasaṅgāt | nanvasminpakṣe āṃ pacasipacasi devadatta3---ityatrāvṛttibhedanibandhanayā dvitvasaṃkhyayā svāśrayasyaikatvasya nivarttanādekāntaratāyā abhāvād `āma ekāntaram' iti nighātapratiṣedho na syādyathā kiriṇetyādāvāvṛttibhedanibandhanenāpi dvyactvena svāśrayasyaikāctvasya nivartānāt `sāvekācaḥ' iti vibhattayādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati, tadvat | sthāne dvirvacane tu samudāyasyāpi sthānivadbhāvena padatvātsidhyati, tathā paunaḥ punyamiti punaḥ punarbhavitari vartamānātpunaḥpunaśabdādbhāve ṣyañi yate; punaḥ punarbhavaḥ paunaḥ punika iti ca kālāṭṭhañ‌', tatra dviḥ prayoge padasya vijñāyamāne samudāyasva vīpsālakṣaṇenārthena satyapyarthavattve'rthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamityaprātipadikatvāttadvito na rayātaḥ subantādutpattipakṣe'pi samudāyasyāsubantatvānna syādeva, pakṣāntare tu sthānivadbhāvādubhayamapyastīti sidhyati | yadyapyasya sthānī subantaḥ, tathāpi subluki kṛte `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' iti niṣedhājjñāpakāt pratyayalakṣaṇena `apratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhābhāvātprātipadikatvamavyāvṛttamiti ? atraivaṃ bhāpye parihāra uktaḥ---pacasipacasītyartharūpayoḥ samānatvātsa eva pacśabdaḥ, sa eva ca tiṅ‌, tataśca yaḥ pūrvasmādvidditaḥ sa parasmādapi yaśca parasmātsa pūrvasmādapi, tadādigrahaṇaṃ ca padasaṃjñāyāmanuvarttate, tatra samudāyasyāvayavayośca tulye'pi tiṅantatve samudāyasyaiva padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati dvirvacanavat, tadyathā---papācetyatra samudāyasyāvayavānāṃ ca tulye'pyekāctve samudāyasyaiva | dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, nāvayavānām; tatkasya hetoḥ ? śāstrahāneḥ, avayavadvirvacane hyavayavāntare viṣaye samudāyaviṣaye ca śāstraṃ hīnaṃ syāt, tadvatpadasaṃjñāpi samudāyasyaiva bhaviṣyatītyekāntaratā yujyate | paunaḥ punyamityādau taddhito'pyuktena nyāyena samudāyasya subantatvāt prātipadikatvācca siddhyatīti |
atraivaṃ codayanti---prāgeva dvirvacanāt pacasītyasyāmavasthāyāṃ pravṛttā padasaṃjñā kimati punaḥ kṛte'pi dvirvacane pravarttate, pravarttamānā vā kimiti samudāyasyaiva pravarttate, na tu pratyekamavayavayoḥ, na hyevaṃvidho dvirvacananyāyasya viṣaya iti saṃyogasaṃjñāyāmuktam; nirgleyādityādau triṣvapi dvayoḥ saṃyogasaṃjñābhyupagamāt | kiñca yatra samudāyasyaiva padatvam---apacannapacannityādau, tatrāvayaveṣu padakāryābhāvaprasaṅga iti |
