apara āha---uccāraṇakriyaivātra paraṃ bhidyate, tadbhedāttvaupacārikaḥ padabhedaḥ; tattvatastvekameva padamityekāntaratā yujyate, paunaḥ punyamityau ca vīpsālakṣaṇenārthena samudāyasyāpyarthavattvāt prātipadikatvam | na ca samāsagrahaṇānnivṛttiḥ; atulyajātīyatvāt | yepāṃ hi bhinnārthānāṃ satāṃ parasparasambandhamātramadhikaṃ tatsamudāyasyaiva tulyajātīyasya tena nivṛttiḥ | na cātraitadubhyamasti | na hi dvayoḥ punaḥ śabdayorartho bhidyate, nāpi tatsamudāye tatsambandho'dhikaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? vīpsārūpo'nya eveti | yadyevam, kiriṇetyādau `sāvekācastṛtīyādiḥ' iti vibhaktisvaraḥ syāt ? tatrāpi hyuccāraṇakriyaiva bhidyate, tattvatastveka evekāraḥ | kiñca----nityānāṃ vibhūnāṃ varṇānāṃ tadātmakānāṃ ca padānāṃ svarūpeṇa vyavadhānamavyavadhānaṃ ca na sambhavatītyupalabdhigatameva tadāśrayitavyam | tatra ca yathā padabhede'pyupalabdhibhedaḥ, tathā tadabhede'pīti kathamekāntaratā ! yadi ca paunaḥ---punyamityādāvuktena nyāyena samudāyasyāpi prātipadikatvam, hantaivaṃ grāmogrāmo ramaṇīya ityādāvapyevameva prātipadikatve sati subluk syāt, tasmātsthāne dvirvacanamevātra rocayāmahe | ata eva `sthāne dvirvacanam' pūrvaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitam, paścātsambhavamātreṇa `dviḥ prayogo'pi' darśitaḥ |
iha sarvasyeti vacanamalo'ntyanivṛttyarthaṃ vā syāt, ṣaṣṭhyarthaprasiddhayarthaṃ ca | tatra sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe tāvacchabdato'rthataścāntaratamābhyāṃ dvābhyāmādeśābhyāṃ bhāvyam | ye caivaṃ prakārāste niyogato'nekālsvabhāvāḥ---ityantareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇam `anekālśitsarvasya' iti sarvasya bhaviṣyati | ṣaṣṭhyartho'pi `parervarjane' ityādau yatra ṣaṣṭhyuccāryate tatra tāvat siddhaḥ; yatrāpi ṣaṣṭhī nāsti---`nityavīpsayoḥ' iti, tatrāpi sāmarthyāllabhyate---nityavīpsayoyaḥ śabdastasya dve bhavata iti | dviḥ prayogapakṣe tvalontyavidhiprasaṅga eva nāsti; sthānaṣaṣṭhyabhāvāt | ṣaṣṭhyartho'pi labhyata evaḥ, uccāraṇasya śabdadharmatvād | ato nāthaḥ sarvagrahaṇenetyabhiprāyeṇāha---sarvasyeti kimiti | vispaṣṭāthamiti | ya evaṃ pratipattumasamarthaḥ, taṃ prati sukhapratipattaye sarvasyetyucyata ityarthaḥ | athetyādi | evaṃ manyate---samāsataddhitavākyanivṛttyarthamavaśyam `padasya' iti vaktavyam | samāsanivṛttyartha tāvat---saptaparṇo'ṣṭāpadam, atra saptasaṃkhyāni parṇāni vīpsyante, na tu tadvānvṛkṣa iti vīpsāyāmekatvasyānantarbhāvātprāgeva vibhaktedvivacanaprasaṅgaḥ, padādhikārāttu na bhavati; taddhitaḥ---dvipadikāṃ dadāti, atra dvitvasaṃkhyāyuktaḥ padārtho vīpsyata iti strītvaikatvalakṣaṇayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoranantarbhāvātprāk taddhitotpatteḥ samāse kṛte prāptaṃ dvirvacanaṃ padatvābhāvānna bhavati; vākyam---grāmegrāme pānīyam, atra vākyasyāpadatvād dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati grāme pānīyamiti | kiñcottaratra padasyeti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati; `padasya padāt' ityasyaivānuvṛtteriti | naivaṃ śakyamiti | asyāpyayamabhiprāyaḥ---`padasya' ityucyamāne'pi saptaparṇābhyāmityādau svādiṣu pūrvasya padatvād dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; tasmādevamatra parihāro vācyaḥ---yadvīpsāyuktam, na adaḥ prayujyate; kiṃ punastat ? parvaṇiparvaṇi saptaparṇānyasyeti, yacca prayujyate na tadvīpsāyuktam---saptaparṇānyasyeti parṇaśabda iti | taddhite tu taddhitenaivoktatvād dvirvacanābhāvaḥ, sa hi `vīpsāyām' ityucyate | vākyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati; padadvirvacanenoktatvādvīpsāyāḥ | tasmāt samāsādinivṛttyarthaṃ tāvatpadādhikāro na kartavya iti |
pratyuta kriyamāṇe padādhikāre'vyāptilakṣaṇo doṣa ityāha---iha hi na syāditi | prapacatīti | dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ kriyāviśeṣavācī | aḍādivyavasthārthaṃ tu dhātūpasargayoḥ pṛthak kalpanam, tataśca kriyādharmo nityatā samudāyasyeti tasyaiva dvirvacanam | ihetyādi | druhestṛci vihite `vā druhamuha' iti ghatvaḍhatve prāpnutaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ ca; tatra ghatvaḍhatvayorasiddhatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti | astu, ko doṣaḥ ? tatrāha---tatreti | paścādvikalpe pravarttamāne yadā paratra ḍhatvaṃ tadā pūrvatrāpi ḍhatvameveti niyamābhāvāt ghatvamapi kadāciṃt syāt | evaṃ ghatve'pi draṣṭavyam---paratra ghatvaṃ pūrvatra ḍhatvamiti | etaccaikasyā ākṛteścaritaḥ prayogo na dvitīyasyāstṛtīyasyāśca bhavatīti nyāyamanāśrityoktaṃ draṣṭavyam | ayaṃ ca nyāyaḥ `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' ityatraiva vyākhyātaḥ |
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamiti | `pūrvatrāsiddham' ityasminnadhikāre bhavaṃ nalopādikāryaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyam, tad‌ dvirvacanādanyatrāsiddhaṃ bhavati | atha vā---pūrvasyāṃ sapādasaptādhyāyyamasiddhaṃ nalopādi pūrvatrāsiddham, tatra bhavamasiddhatvaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyam; tad‌ dvirvacane karttavye na bhavati, tataśca ghatve ḍhatve vā pravṛtte tadyuktasyaiva dvirvacanamiti nāsti doṣaḥ |
sarvasyetyetadevetyādi | pūrvaṃ `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' iti vacanāśrayeṇa droḍhādroḍheti sādhitam, idānīm `sarvasya' ityanena sādhitamityekasminsādhye dvayorhetvorvikalpaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ `sarvasya' ityanena kṛtasarvakāryapratipattiḥ ? arśaādyacpratyayānto'yaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ---sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasminnasti tadidaṃ sarvam, tasya dve bhavataḥ | sarveṣu kāryeṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanamityarthaḥ ||
tasya paramāmreḍitam || 8.1.2 ||
`tasya' ityavayavayoge ṣaṣṭhī, paraśabdo'vayavacanaḥ | `dikśabdāñcūttarapada' ityatra yadyapi `diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabdaḥ'---ityāśrayaṇātsampratyadikśibdatve'pi pañcamī vihitā, tathāpyasmādeva nirdeśādavayavavācibhiryoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati | evaṃ ca pūrvaṃ kāyasyetyādi siddhaṃ bhavati | udāharaṇe---`āmraḍitaṃ bhartsane' iti plutaḥ | tasya grahaṇaṃ viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham--tasyaitasyānantarasya dviruktasyeti, tena pāṣṭhike dvirvacane iyaṃ saṃjñā na bhavati | nanu āmreḍitaśabdo nighaṇṭuṣu prasiddhaḥ---`ārmraḍitaṃ dvistriruktam' iti ? satyamarthe prasiddhaḥ; iha tu śabde paribhāṣyate
mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ pūrvācāryānurodhena ||
anudāttaṃ ca || 8.1.3 ||
paramityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāttasya cājjhalsamudāyarūpatvādanyartho'trānudāttaśabdaḥ---avidyamānamudāttamanudāttamiti | svarite'pyudāttasya bhāvāttasyāpi nivṛttiḥ | evamapi na jñāyate---kena svareṇāmreḍitaṃ prayoktavyamiti ? ucyate; udāttasvaritau tāvanniṣiddhau, na cāsvarakasyāca uccāraṇaṃ sambhavati, tatra pāriśeṣyādanudāttatvameva bhaviṣyati | yadvā---anudāttāckamanudāttam, āmreḍitasthā aco'nudāttā bhavantītyarthaḥ | bhuṅ‌ktabhuṅakta iti | `bhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, tasya `tāsyanudāttet' ityanudāttatvam, śnamaḥ pratyayasvaraḥ, tasya `śnasorallopaḥ' ityallope udāttanivṛttisvareṇa bhuṅ‌kteśabdo'ntodruttiḥ, dvirvacanena parasyānudāttatvam | paśuśabdaḥ kupratyayānto'ntodāttaḥ ||
nityavīpsayoḥ || 8.1.4 ||
nitye cārthe vīpsāyāṃ ca yadvarttate iti | anena saptamīyamarthanirdeśārtheti darśayati | prayoktṛdharmabhūtā vīpsā, na ca sā grāmādiśabdairabhidhīyate | pacatipacatītyatrāpi vastuto yannityaṃ na tattiṅantenābhidhīyate | nityatvaṃ tu dvirvacanadyotyam | tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---nityatve dyotyatvena viṣayabhūte, vīpsāyāṃ va dyotyatvena viṣayabhūtāyāmiti | eṣaiva ca tatra vṛttiḥ, śabdasya yadvattā tadviṣayatā | yadi punareṣā ṣaṣṭhī syātsavrūpavidhiḥ prasajyeta, tataśca `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ', `pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyām' ityādinirdeśo nopapadyate | yadi tu `nityārthaviṣayaḥ śabdo nityaḥ' ityucyeta, vīpsārthaviṣayaśca vīpseti; tadā ṣaṣṭhyāmapyadoṣaḥ ? gauṇatvaprasaṅgāttadanāśritam | nityaśabdo'yaṃ sarvakālāvasthāyino ya ātmākāśādayaḥ, yeṣāmutpattivināśau prayoktṛbhirnopalabhyete, teṣvapi prayujyamāno dṛśyate---nitya ātmā, nitya ākāśaḥ, nityā dyauriti; ābhīkṣṇye'pi---nityaṃ prahasitaḥ, nityaṃ prajalpita iti | tatrāviśeṣādubhayorapi grahaṇādākāśādiśabdānāmapi dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti manyamānaḥ pṛcchati--keṣu nityateti |
atha vā---nityaśabdasya kūṭasthalakṣaṇa eva mukhyo'rthaḥ, śabdāntarasannidhyanapekṣaṇāt | ābhīkṣṇyaṃ tu kriyāpadaprayogasamadhigamyaṃ gauṇo'rthaḥ; avicchedopalabdhisāmānyamāśritya tatra prayogāt | tataśca `gauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyayaḥ' iti kūṭasthavācināmeva dvirvacanaprasaṅga iti manyamāna āha---keṣu nityateti | itaro'pi viditābhiprāya āha---tiṅ‌kṣviti | aviśeṣameva manyamānaḥ pṛcchati---kuta iti | ābhīkṣṇyamiheti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---kūṭasthavacanagrahaṇe tiṅantāni na saṃgṛhītānisyuḥ, ābhīkṣṇyalakṣaṇe tu nityatve gṛhyamāṇe tallakṣaṇaṃ dvirvacanaṃ tiṅantānām, vīpsālakṣaṇaṃ tu subantānāmityubhayānugraho bhavati | gauṇo'pi cārtho lakṣyadarśanavaśādihāśrīyate---yathā `śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi', pārśvenānvicchatītyādau | ubhyavidhe'pi nityatve gṛhyamāṇe tadvācināṃ subantānāṃ svārtha eva dvirvacanaṃ syāt, na caivaṃ loke prayogo'sti---ātmātmeti | evaṃ hyukte vīpsā pratīyate, na tu svārthaḥ | tasmādābhīkṣṇyasyaiva grahaṇamiti bhavatyābhīkṣṇyamiha nityatā | sā ca tiṅ‌kṣvavyayakṛtsu ceti | etatkutasatyam ? ityāha--ābhīkṣṇyaṃ ca kriyādharma iti | paunaḥ punyam-ābhīkṣṇyam | tacca sādhyarūpāyāḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati, tajjātīyasya tu punaḥ karaṇaṃ ghaṭādiṣvapi rūmbhavati; tathāpi kriyāviṣayaiva punaḥ kriyata iti pratītiḥ | tadvacanāśca punaḥ punaḥ, ābhīkṣṇyam, nityamityādayaḥ śabdāḥ, yathā yugapatpṛthagityādayaḥ śabdāḥ kriyāviṣayāḥ, tadvat | kriyā ca taṅikṣvavyavakṛtsu cābhidhīyate, pācakādiṣu tu sādhanaṃ pradhānam | pākādiṣvapi tu siddhatā pradhānam, na kriyā |
kīdṛśī punaḥ sā kriyā yasyā ābhīkṣṇyaṃ dharmaḥ ? ityāha---yāṃ kriyāmiti | tannityamiti | nityaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvāttadvṛtti tacchabdasyāpi napuṃsakatvam, yathā---aṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartetyatra puṃstvam | lunīhilunīhīti | kriyāsamabhihāre loṭu | yadyapi tiṅantasya darśitamudāharaṇaṃ tathāpyastyatra vaktavyamiti punarupanyāsaḥ, taddarśayati---katvāṇamulorloṭaśceti | `samānakartṛkayoḥ' ityādinārthāntare'pi ktvāṇamulau vihitau, loḍapi vidhyādāvarthāntare vihita iti sāmānyaśabdatvāt dvirvacanāpekṣā eva paunaḥ punyaṃ prakāśayanti | yaṅ‌ tu tannirapekṣa iti | sa hi kriyāsamabhihāraṃ na vyabhicarati, tatkiṃ tasya taddyotane dvirvacanāpekṣayā ! nanu yaṅantasyāpi kadācid dvirvacanamiṣyate, tatkatham ? ityāha---yadā tviti | dvividho hi kriyāyāḥ samabhihāraḥ---paunaḥ punyam, bhṛśārthaśca | tatra yadā dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, tadā bhṛśārthe yaṅ‌, tasyaiva paunaḥ punyaṃ dyotayituṃ dvirvacanam, tasya yaṅā'dyotitatvādityarthaḥ | vṛttau ca sāmānyaśabdasyāpi kriyā samabhihāraśabdasya bhṛśārthalakṣaṇe kriyāsamabhihāre vṛttivijñeyā | pāpacyata iti | sakalā avayavakriyāḥ svayameva sampādayan punaḥ punaḥ pacatītyarthaḥ | loḍapi bhavati---pāpacyasva pāpacyasvetyevāyaṃ pāpacyata iti | atha nityatāyāṃ dvirvacanamucyamānaṃ dhātumātrasya kasmānna bhavati, sa hi kriyāvacanaḥ ? ucyate; parigṛhītasādhanā kriyā vyavahāropayoginī bhavati, tadabhidhānācca dhātumātrasya dvirvacanābhāvaḥ | padādhikāro vāśrayaṇīyaḥ | anenaivābhiprāyeṇa pūrvamuktam---`atha padasyetyeva kasmānnocyate' iti, asminpakṣe sagatikasya dvirvacanaṃ vaktavyameva | etenaitadapi nirastam---bhṛśārthe sāvakāśo yaṅ‌ paunaḥ punye pareṇa dvirvacanena bādhyata iti | kathamidaṃ nirastam ? padasya dvirvacanaṃ dhātoryaṅ‌, tatrāntaraṅgasya na yukto bādha it vyākhyātam |
nityaṃ vīpsāṃ vyākhyāsyan viṣayaṃ tāvatpṛcchati---atheti | supsu vīpseti | supāmeva tadabhivyaktau samarthatvāt | evaṃ viṣayamuktvā svarūpaṃ pṛcchati---kā punariti | yadi sāmānyena vyāptumicchā vīpsā, tadā cikīrṣatītyādau dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; karotyādikriyābhiḥ kaṭādīnāṃ yā vyāptumicchā tadvicitvāt | itaro `yogarūḍhirvīpsāśabdaḥ' ityabhiprāyeṇāha---vyāptiviśeṣaviṣayeti | prayokturiccheti | anena nābhidheyā vīpsā gṛhyate---vīpsāvācino dve bhavata iti, kiṃ tarhi ? prayoktṛdharmaḥ, ābādhavat | gatagata ityukte priyasya ciragamanādinā pīḍito vākyaṃ prayuṅ‌kta iti pratīyate, tena cikīrṣatītyādau dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti darśayati | vyāptiviśeṣavipayetyuktam, sa tu viśeṣo nādyāpyabhihitada iti punaḥ pṛcchati---kā punarasāviti | nānāvācināmityādi |
pūrvavṛttiṣu paṭhitaṃ vīpsālakṣaṇam, tad vyācaṣṭe---nānābhūtārthavācināmiti | tatra nānāvācināmiti vacanājjātivācināṃ dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati---brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ, sampanno vrīhiriti | nahi jātiśabdā nānābhūtārthavācinaḥ; jāterekatvāt | yugapad‌grahaṇātkramavivakṣāyāṃ dvirvacanābhāvaḥ, yathā---asminvane'yaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śobhano'yaṃ vṛkṣaḥ śobhana iti krameṇa śobhanatvapratipādane bahūnāmapi śabdānāṃ prayogo bhavati, tathaikaśeṣo'pi na bhavati---asminvane vṛkṣāḥ śobhanā iti; nānāvācitvābhāvāt | pṛthagarthaparyavasāyitvaṃ hi nānāvācitvam, na caikaśeṣe tadasti | ata eva tatra na pratyekaṃ vidheyasambandho niyamena pratīyate | na `hi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śataṃ deyam' ityukte niyamena pratyekaṃ śataṃ deyaṃ bhavati | brāhmaṇāya brāhmaṇāya śataṃ deyamityukte pratyekaṃ śataṃ dīyate, tatkaraya hetoḥ ? pṛthagarthaparyavasāyitayā pṛthagdeyasya sambandhāt | yadā ca pṛthagarthaparthavasāyitā, tadā yāvanto'rthā abhidhitsitāḥ, tāvantaḥ śabdāḥ pṛthagekaikaparyavasāyinaḥ prasaktāḥ, teṣāmanena nivṛttiḥ kriyate---vīpsāyāṃ dve eva prayoktavye, na tu bahu prayoktavyamiti | kathaṃ tahi nivṛttānāmarthaḥ pratīyate, yāvatā pratyekaparyavasāyitve dvayoreva pratītiḥ syāt ? ucyate---
ekaśeṣe yathānyeṣāmarthaḥ śiṣṭena gamyate |
tadvadatra viśeṣe'pi śiṣṭābhyāmitarārthadhīḥ ||
yathaiva hi vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityekaśeṣaviṣaye śiṣyamāṇameva nivṛttānāmapyarthamāha, tathehāpi śiṣyamāṇe dve eva vivakṣitānarthānabidhāsyataḥ | na ca bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ; parigṛhītaikatvānāṃ bahūnāmabhidhānāt; anyathā prateyakasambandhasyāpratīteḥ dvirvacanāduttarakālaṃ satyāmapi bahutvāvagatāvaprātipadikatvādvahuvacanābhāvaḥ, yathā---paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti satyapi darśanakriyāpekṣe karmatve dvitīyābhāvaḥ | ekaikamityatra tu satyapi bahuvrīhivadbhāvena prātipadikatvaṃ parigṛhītaikatvasyaikārathasya vīpsāyogādantaraṅgatvādekavacanaṃ bhavati, na bahuvacanam ; bahutvapratīterbahiraṅgatvāt | asyaivāryasya `ekaikasya prācām' iti nirdeśo liṅgamityalamiyatā | tadayamatrārthaḥ---nānābhūtārthavācināṃ yānyadhikaraṇāni vācyāni teṣāṃ sahavivakṣitānāṃ pṛthak saṃkhyāyuktānāṃ pratyekaṃ kriyayā guṇena vā vyāptumicchā vīpseti | kriyāguṇagrahaṇaṃ dravyasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | grāmegrāme pānīyamiti | dravyavyāpterudāharaṇam | puruṣaḥ puruṣo nidhanamupaitīti | nidhanam-maraṇam | jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurityarthaḥ | apara āha---sāmnāṃ bhaktiviśeṣaḥ-nidhanam, sarva eva ṛtvijo nidhanamupayantītyartha iti |
yattiṅantamityādi | atra vipratiṣedho hetuḥ, dvirvacanasyāvakāśo yatra nityatā vivakṣitā, na prakarṣaḥ---pacatipacatīti, prakarṣapratyayasyāvakāśo yatra prakarṣa eva vivakṣyate, na nityitā---pacatitarāmiti; ubhayavivakṣāyāmubhayaprasaṃge paratvād dvirvacanam, tataḥ punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānātprakarṣapratyayaḥ | yadvā---pratiyogyapekṣaḥ prakarṣo bahiraṅgaḥ, paunaḥpunyamantaraṅgamiti pūrvaṃ dvirvacanam |
iha tvityādi | iṣṭireveyam | yadvā---prakarṣayuktā evāḍhyādaya ānayanakriyāyāmupayujyanta iti laghuprakarṣā eva vīpsyante | kiñca---kṛtadvirvacanāttarapi satyāḍhyātaramiti bhavitavyam, tathā ca prakarṣārtho gamyeta, na vīpseti pūrvaṃ prakarṣayogaḥ ||
parervarjane || 8.1.5 ||
paripari trigartebhya iti | `apaparī varjane' iti karmapravacanīya saṃjñā, `pañcamyapāṅ‌paribhiḥ' iti pañcamī | pariṣiñcatīti | pariḥ sarvato bhāve, `upasārgātsunoti' ityādinā ṣatvam |
parervarjana ityādi | `parervarjane' ityatrā `asama se' iti vaktavyam, `vā' iti ca vaktavyam, tenāsamāsa eva bhavati, tatrāpi visaplena |
anyatra tu naiva bhavati, tadāha---samāse tviti | tenauvoktatvāditi | nanu vākye tāvadvarjanaṃ parereva dyotyam, samāse'pi pariḥ sannihitaḥ, tatkiṃ samāsasya varjane śaktiḥ kalpyate ? tatrāhuḥ---`jahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ' iti pakṣe samāsa eva varjyamānopasarjane varjane varttate, avayavau tvanarthakāviti | yadā tu `ajahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, tadā vākye kevale varjane parirvartata iti tatraiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati | samāse tu varjyamānārthāskandānānna dvyarthaḥ pariḥ kevale varjane varttata iti dvirvacanābhāvaḥ ||
prasamupodaḥ pādapūraṇe || 8.1.6 ||
prādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ, `dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre' iti samāsāntastu na bhavati; samāsāntavidheranityātvāt | udityaṃ jātavedasamiti kvacidudāhṛtam, tadayuktam; na hyatra dvitīya ucchabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? uśabdaḥ |
uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye || 8.1.7 ||
uparyādīnāṃ yo'rthastasya sāmīpyadyotanāya dvirvacanam | sāmīpyam-pratyāsattiḥ, tacca deśakṛtaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vā | uparyupariduḥ khamiti | kālakṛtasyodāharaṇam | duḥ khasya sāmīpyenopariṣṭādityarthaḥ | `ubhasarvatasoḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānena dvitīyā | uparyupari grāmiti | grāmasya sāmīpyenopariṣṭāddeśa ityarthaḥ | adhyadhi grāmamiti | adhiruparibhāve, yathā---`samidhaṃ srucaṃ cādhyadhi gārhapatyaṃ hṛtvā' iti | adho'dho grāmamiti | grāmasya sāmīpyenādhastād deśa ityarthaḥ | yathā `navānadho'dho bṛhataḥ payodharān' iti |
uparyupari paśyantaḥ sarva eva daridrati |
adho'dho darśane kasya mahimā nopajāyate ||
iti tu vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam |
upari candramā iti | atra bhūgatamapekṣyoparibhāvasya sāmīpyaṃ nāsti | upari śirasa ityādi | na hi vastusattaiva śabdatyutpatteḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? vivakṣā, sā ceha nāsti | śirasa upariṣṭād‌ ghaṭaṃ dhārayati nādhastāditi hyatra vivakṣitam | sāmīpyaṃ tu vastutaḥ sambhavati ||
vākyāderāmantritasyāsūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu || 8.1.8 ||
ekārthaḥ padasamūho vākyamiti | yathāha bhagavāñcaiminiḥ---arthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṃkṣaṃ cedvibhāge syāt' iti | kvacittu `ekatiṅ‌padasamūho vākyam' iti paṭhyate, ekā tiṅ‌vibhaktiryatra sa ekatiṅ‌ | kvacittu na kiñcidapi vākyalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhyate | asūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu yadi tadvākyaṃ bhavatīti | yadyapi vākyāderiti samāse guṇībhūtaṃ vākyam, tathāpyasūyādīnāṃ tenaiva sambandhaḥ---asūyādiṣu yadvākyaṃ tadāderiti, na tu pradhānena vākyādinā''mantritena | prayoktṛdharmā hyasūyādayo nābhidheyadharmāḥ, te ca vākyenaiva dyotyante, nāmantritena | udāharaṇeṣu sammatāvanukampāyāṃ kan, itaratra kutsite kaḥ | riktam- śūnyam, kṣudramityarthaḥ | śaktiyaṣṭiśabdābhyāṃ tadvatyoḥ striyorvartamānābhyāṃ kutsite kaḥ | evaṃ hi kutsanam, sambodhanaṃ ca samīcīnaṃ bhavati | bhartsane tvityādi | yadyapi `bhatsene paryāyeṇa' iti vacanātpūrvasyāpi tatra vidhīyamānaṃ bhartsanakutsanayorapi siddhyati; kāraṇatvena tatrāpi kopāsūyayorbhāvāt, tetaśca nārthaḥ kutsanabhatsenagrahaṇena ? naitadasti;
guravo hi hitaiṣitvādakupyanto'pi bhartsanam |
kurvate bhartsyamānāstu kupitānpratiyanti tān ||
vināpyasūyayā kutsāṃ kurvantīti pṛthaktayoḥ |
nirdeśaḥ sūtrakāreṇa vihitaḥ sūkṣmadarśinā ||
sāmṛtaiḥ pāṇibhirghnanti guravo na viṣokṣitaiḥ |
lālanāśrayiṇo doṣāstāḍanāśrayiṇo guṇāḥ ||
abhiprāye duṣṭe lālane'pi doṣā bhavanti, viparyaye tu tāḍane'pi guṇā ityarthaḥ ||
evaṃ bahuvrīhivat || 8.1.9 ||
atra yadi kevalo bahuvrīhivadbhāvo'nirdiṣṭaviṣayo'nena vidhīyate, tataścehāpi prāpnoti---eka iti, tataśca subluk, syāt | astu, bahuvrīhivadbhāvādaparaḥ suḥ prabhaviṣyati ? naiva cātra subluk prāpnoti, eka ityasya pratyayāntatvenāprātipadikatvāt | `kṛttiddhitasamāsāśca' ityatra ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham, na vidhyarthamiti tenāpi nāsti prātipadikatvam | iha tarhyeketi puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti ? syādevatan---`dve' ityadhikārād dvirvacanasanniyogena vidhīyamāno bahuvrīhivadbhāvastadabhāvādiha na bhavatīti | atha tadapi dvirvacanaṃ tena vidhīyamānamatra kasmānna bhavati ? tasmādvaktavyo'sya viṣayaḥ | ata āha---ekamityetacchabdarūpaṃ dviruktamiti | satyam; `dve' ityanuvarttate, na ca tena dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anyena vihitanūdya tatra bahuvrīhivadbhāvo vidhīyate | kva cānyena dvirvacanaṃ vihitam ? vīpsāyām | yadi punarvīpsāgrahaṇamanuvartya tatra bahuvrīhivadbhāvo vidhīyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; bahuvrīhivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bādhyate | atha yadi vīpsāyāṃ dve ityevamubhayamanuvartya dvirvacanaṃ bahuvrīhivadbhāvaḥ---ityubhayamanena vidhīyate, na doṣo bhavati | vṛttikārastu kimanayā vīpsāgrahaṇānuvṛttyeti `dve' ityevānvavīvṛtat |
sublopapuṃvadbhāvāviti | yadyapyetau bahuvrīhāviti nocyete, tathāpi tatra dṛṣṭāvityetayoratideśaḥ | kvacittu vṛttāvevāyamarthaḥ paṭhyate | ekaikamiti | ekamityasya dvirvacane dvayorapi suporluki sati punarbahuvrīhivadbhāvādeva sup | ekaikayeti | ṭābantāttṛtīyā, tadantasya dvirvacanam, subluki puṃvadbhāvena pūrvabhāge ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ | kaḥ punaratra ṭāpo nivṛttau satyāmasatyāṃ vā viśeṣaḥ | ? avagrahe'sti viśeṣaḥ---aikaikayetyeka---ekayeti bhavati | uttaratra ca gatagatetyādau puṃvadbhāvasya prayojanam |
nanu yadi yacca yāvacca bahuvrīhau dṛṣṭaṃ kārya tasya sarvasyātideśaḥ; sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ, svaraḥ, samāsānta ityete vidhayaḥ prāpnuvanti ? ata āha---sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhasvarasamāsāntā iti | na bahuvrīhāviti pratiṣedho na bhavatīti | tatra hi `vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau' ityataḥ `bahuvrīhau' ityanuvarttamāne punarvahuvrīhigrahaṇam---bahuvrīhireva yo bahuvrīhistatra yathā syād, bahuvrīhivadbhāvena yo bahuvrīhistatra mā bhūditi | tena saṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvatsamāsādhikāre bahuvrīhau vijñāyate | nana, susu iti | `ābādhe ca' iti dvirvacanam | nana karoti, susu jāgartītyādivākyaikadeśa udāhṛtaḥ | nañsubhyāmityantodāttatvaṃ na bhavatīti | tatra hi `vanaṃ samāse' ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena `samāse' iti sambadhyate, `bahuvrīhāvidametattadbhyaḥ' ityataḥ `bahuvrīhau' iti ca | tatra bahuvrīheḥ samāsatvāvyabhicāre punaḥ samāsa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ samāsādhikāravihitabahuvrīhiparigrahārthaṇ | athātra `nañsubhyām' ityantodāttatve sati kaḥ svaro bhavati ? atra hi catvāraḥ svarāḥ prāpnuvanti---samāsāntodāttatvaṃ ca | tatra `nañsubhyām' ityayaṃ svaro na bhavatītyuktam | āmreḍitānudāttatvamapi na bhavati, kiṃ kāraṇam ? kāryātideśe tāvadidameva kāryāṇāṃ vidhāyakamiti paratvādāmreḍitānudāttatvaṃ bahuvrīhisvareṇa bādhyate | śāstrātideśe'pi viruddhasya svāśrayasyātideśena nivarttanānnaivāmreḍitānudāttatvaṃ bhavati, `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' ityatra ca na samāsagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena bahuvrīhivadbhāvātpūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavan samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bādhate | ṛgṛgiti | `ābādhe ca' iti dvirvacanam | ṛkpūriti samāsānto na bhavatīti | tatra hi `samāsācca tadviṣayāt' ityataḥ `samāsāt' ityanuvarttamāne punaḥ samāsagrahaṇaṃ samāsādhikāre vihito yaḥ samāsastatparigrahārtham | tenātideśike samāse samāsānto na bhavatīti | evamete saṃjñāpratiṣedhādayaḥ samāsādhikāravihite bahuvrīhau vijñāyante |
vārttikakārastu sarvamevaitadvācanikaṃ manyate, yadāha---`sarvanāmasvarasamāsānteṣu doṣaḥ' iti | atha nanetyatra bahuvrīhivadbhāvānnalopaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ucyate; `uttarapade' iti vartate, naña iti ca kāryiṇo nirdeśaḥ, tatra sākṣācchiṣṭena kāryitvena naño nimittabhāvo bādhyate, yathā---madrahrado bhadrahrada ityatra rephasya `aco rahābhyāṃ dve' iti dvirvacanaprasaṅge uktam---`nemau rahau kāryiṇau, kiṃ tahi ? nimittamimau dvirvacanasya' iti | ayaṃ tu parihāraḥ pūrvatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ ||
ābādhe ca || 8.1.10 ||
ābādhanamābādha iti | bhāve ghañ‌ | prayoktṛdharmo nābhidheyadharmaiti | abhidheyadharmatve hi bādhitapīḍitādiśabdānāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt, na gatādiśabdānām, prayoktṛdharmatve hi teṣāmapi bhavatīti vyāptirbhavati | tatra varttamānasyeti | dvirvacane satyābādhasya gamyamānatvād gatādiśabdānāṃ tatra vṛttiḥ, na tu tadabhidhānāt | priyasya ciragamanādineti | prayoktṛdharmatvamābādhasya darśayati | ādiśabdena nāśādergrahaṇam ||
karmadhārayavaduttareṣu || 8.1.11 ||
kopadhāyā api karmadhārayavadbhāvāt puṃvadbhāvo bhavatīti | tena bahuvrīhivadbhāve prakṛte karmadhārayavadbhāvo vidhīyate iti bhāvaḥ | samāsāntodāttatvamanena vidhīyata iti | kāryātideśapakṣe idamuktam | śāstrātideśe tu yadyapyāmreḍitānudāttatvameva param, tathāpi na tadbhavati; viruddhasya svāśrayasyāti deśena nivarttanāt ||
prakāre guṇavacanasya || 8.1.12 ||
prakāro bhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ ceti | ubhyatrāpi prakāraśabdasya dṛṣṭatvāt | bhede tāvat---bahubhiḥ prakārairbhuṅ‌kte, bahubhirbhedaiḥ, viśeṣairiti gamyate; sādṛśye---brāhmaṇaprakāro'yaṃ māṇavakaḥ, brāhmaṇasadṛśa iti gamyate | tadiheti | taditi vākyopanyāse | avyayaṃ vā saptamyarthavṛtti, tatretyartaḥ | sādṛśyaṃ prakāro gṛhyata iti | dviruktāt tasyaiva pratīteḥ | atra cābhidānasvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ | prakāre vartamānasyeti | dvirvacanapravṛttidvāreṇa taddyotanāttatra vṛttiḥ | aparipūrṇaguṇa ityartha iti | kathametat ? ityāha---paripūrṇaguṇeneti | yasya pūrṇaṃ pāṭavam, yaḥ paṭukāryāṇi karoti, tena yadā nyūnapāṭavamupamīyate, tadā puṭupaṭuriti prayogo bhavati, tenārthādaparipūrṇaguṇa ityartho bhavati |
jātīyaro'nena dvirvacanena bādhanaṃ neṣyata iti | tadvidhau dvividhasyāpi prakārasya grahaṇaṃ manyate | jayādityastu tatrāha---`sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāraḥ' iti | iṣṭiśceyam, anyathā brāhmaṇajātīya ityādāvaguṇavacane, paṭujātīya ityādau guṇavacane'pi sādṛśyādanyatra bhede caritārthasya jātīyaro guṇavacaneṣu sādṛśye bādhaḥ syāt |
paṭurdevadatta iti | paripūrṇaguṇa evātra paṭuśabdo varttate, natatsādṛśyānnyūnaguṇe |
agnirmāṇavaka iti | agniśabdo vahnau vṛttaḥ so'yamatisādṛśyanimittādabhedopacārānmāṇavake varttata iti dravye pūrvavṛttaḥ sampratyapi dravyavacana iti guṇavacano na bhavati | evaṃ gaurvāhīka ityatra gośabdaḥ sāsnādimati vartitvā vāhīke vartamānaḥ | nanvagniśabdo'gnigatataikṣṇyaṃ māṇavake pratipādayituṃ prayujyata iti guṇavacana eva, tathā gośabdo'pi sāsnādimadgatajāḍyapratipādanāya vāhīke prayujyata iti guṇavacana eva ? ityata āha---yadyapyatrāgniśabda iti | agniśabdo māṇavake prayujyamāno yādṛśamagnestaikṣṇyaṃ paraśvādibhyo vyāvṛttaṃ tadeva pratipādayati, na taikṣṇyamātramiti, gośabdo'pi yādṛśaṃ gavāṃ jāḍyaṃ manuṣyebhyo vyāvṛttaṃ tadeva pratipādayati, āśrayaviśeṣasambandhāddhi taikṣṇyajāḍyādikaṃ bhidyate, tadetadāha---mukhyārthasambandhādavadhṛtabhedaṃ taikṣṇajāḍyādikamiti | śabdāntarasannidhīmantareṇa śabdaśravaṇamātrād yo'rthaḥ pratīyate sa mukhyaḥ | viparīto gauṇa | avadhṛtabhedam---niścitabhedam | ādiśabdena paiṅgalyabhāravahanādergrahaṇam | arthāntare, gauṇe māṇavake vāhīke ca | sarvadā guṇavacano na bhavatīti na dvirucyata iti | `prakāre varttamānasya' ityeva guṇavacanatve siddhe punarguṇavacanagrahaṇāt sarvadā guṇavacanasyetyāśrīyate | na cāyaṃ sarvadā gumavacanaḥ; prāk prakārād dravyavacanatvāt |
atra kecit---`guṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ' iti guṇopasarjanadravyavacanasya dvirvacanamicchanti | anye tu guṇavacanasya guṇivacanasya ca aviśeṣeṇecchanti---śuklaśuklaṃ rūpam, śuklaśuklaḥ paṭa iti | `navaṃnavaṃ prītiraho karoti' ityatra vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam, anena tu dvirvacane sublopaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā---navanavāvanavāyubhirādedhe' iti | mūlemūle iti | ekasya vastuno veṇudalāderekameva mukhyamagraṃ mūlaṃ ca, itareṣāṃ tu bhāgānāmāpekṣiko mūlāgravyapadeśaḥ | sthaulyasaukṣmye api naikarūpe, kiṃ tarhi ? yathāmūlamupacīyate sthaulm, yathāgraṃ ca saukṣmyamiti vīpsāyā atrāsambhavaḥ | iha `mūlemūle pathi viṭapinām' iti vīpsāyāmeva dvirvacanam |
svārtha iti | arthāntarābhāvapradarśanārthamidamuktam | asmārtkārṣāṇāditi | anekamāṣasamudāyaḥ-kārṣāpaṇam | tatra na sarve māṣā dānakriyayā vyāpyante, kiṃ tarhi ? dvāveveti vīpsāyā abhāvaḥ | nanu yathā dvāveva māṣau nirjñātau dānakriyayā vyāpyete, tadā māṣaṃmāṣaṃ dehi---iti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati; evamanekamāṣasamudāyādapi kārṣāpaṇād dvayorevāsti dānakriyāvyāptiḥ ? maivam, tatra hi sannihitasyārthasya na kasyacid varjanamasti; iha tu varjanamasti, yato māṣaṃmāṣamasau datvā śeṣaṃ pṛcchati---kimanena kriyatāmiti | tadidamuktam---atra hīti | māṣaṃ dehi dvau māṣau dehi trīnmāṣāniti | anena yathecchaṃ dehīti vivakṣayā avadhāraṇābhāvaṃ darśayati | cāpala iti prayoktṛdharmo'yam, tasmin dyotye subantasya tiṅantasya ca sarvasya vākyagatasya padasya dvirvacanaṃ nāvaśyamiti nedaṃ śāstrīyaṃ dvirvacanam, kiṃ tarhi ? parapratyāyanāyānekasya svatantrapadasya prayoga ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvā āmreḍitānudāttatvābhāvādyathāprāptaḥ svaro bhavati |
kriyāsamabhihāra iti | loḍantasyevedaṃ dvirvacanam, na yaṅantasya; loṭaḥ samuccaye'pi vidhānāt kriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktau kevalasya sāmarthyābhāvāt | yaṅ‌ tu kriyāsamabhihāraviṣaya eveti taddyotane svayaṃ sāmarthyānnāpekṣate dvirvacanam |
ābhīkṣṇya iti | pūrveṇa vākyena kriyāsamabhihārasaṃśabdanena yo vihitastadantasyaiva dvirvacanamiti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyasya vākyasyopanyāsaḥ | nitya ityeva siddhamiti tatroktamiti | `nityavīpsayoḥ' ityatra hi `ktvāṇamulorloṭaśca dvirvacanasāpekṣāṇāmeva paunaḥ punyaprakāśane śaktiḥ' ityuktam | anye tvāhuḥ---`punaḥ punaḥ kriyāyā utpādanamābhīkṣṇyam | tathā hi---bhuktvābhuktvā vrajatītyukte satyapi kriyāyā vicchede punaḥ punarbhuṅ‌kte punaḥ punarvrajatīti kriyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate, nityatā tu kriyāyā avicchedaḥ, yatā jīvatijīvatītyukte jīvatyevāyamiti pratīyate, na tvasau jīvitvā mriyate mṛtvā ca jīvatīti, jīvanameva tvavicchinnaṃ pratīyate | tasmādābhīkṣṇyaṃ nityamiti bhinnāvetāvarthau' iti |
apara āha---bhuktvā vrajatītyādau ktvāṇamulantasya tiṅantasya ca dvirvacane prāpte ābhīkṣṇyasaṃśabdanena yo vihitastadantasya yathā syāt, tiṅantasya mā bhūditi niyamārthamidamiti |
ḍācīti | viṣayasaptamīyam, tenānutpanna eva ḍācyakṛtaṭilopasya paṭadityāderdvirvacanam, tataḥ `avyaktānukāraṇāt' iti ḍāci ṭilopaḥ, `nityamāmreḍite `ḍāci iti pararūpatvam | apara āha---idamevācchabdasya pararūpavidhānaṃ liṅgam---`ḍāci' iti parasaptamyāmapi ṭilopātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasyeti, tadasata; patadityādau ṭilopāduttarakālamapyacchabdasya sambhavāt | dvitīyā karotīti | `kṛño dvitīyā' ityādinā ḍāc | tattarhi ḍāci dvirvacanaṃ vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati---`ḍācyavyaktānukaraṇasya dvircanaṃ bhavatīti, yadayam `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' iti pararūpatvaṃ śāsti |
pūrvaprathamayoriti | pūrva, prathama---ityetayordvirvacanaṃ bhavati, kva ? arthātiśayavivakṣāyām | anayoryo'rthastasyātiśaye vivakṣite | ātiśāyiko'pi dṛśyata iti | dvirvacanena bādhe prāpte vacanam | atiśayaśabdo'nuśatikādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ | kecittu arthabedādātiśāyikasyābādhyatvamāhuḥ | tathā hi---`pūrvataraṃ bhuṅ‌kte' ityukte kimātmasādhyakriyāntarāpekṣaṃ bhojanasya pūrvatvam ? atha bhoktrāntarasādhyabhojanakriyāpekṣam ? iti sandeho bhavati | evaṃ pūrvataraṃ puṣpyatītyukte'yamartho gamyate | na tāvadeṣa kisalayito yāvadeṣa puṣpyatīti | pūrvaṃpūrvaṃ | puṣpyatītyasmāttvanyebhyaḥ puṣpitṛbhyo'tiśayena pūrva puṣpyatītyarthaḥ pratīyate |
ḍataraḍatamayoriti | ḍataraḍatamāntasya dve bhavataḥ, samenāḍhyatvādinā dharmeṇa sampradhāraṇāyāṃ viṣaye | strīnigade bhāva iti | bhāvaḥ-bhūtiḥ, sampat-āḍhyatā, nigadyata iti nigadaḥ, `nau gada' ityādinā karmaṇyap | strīśabdena strīliṅgaḥ śabdo'bidhīyate, striyā nigadaḥ, karttari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | strīliṅgaśabdābhidheyāyāṃ bhūtau varttamānasyetyarthaḥ | katarākatarā anayorāḍhyateti | kiṃ sādhanasampatkṛtā ? uta bhāgyakṛtā ? iti praśnārthaḥ |
karmavyatihāra iti | kriyāvyatihāre ityarthaḥ | tatra dvirvacanaṃ nityam, samāsavadbhāvastu bahulam | tatrānyo'nyaśabde samāsavadbhāvābhāvātsubluk, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ ca na bhavati, āmreḍitānudāttatvaṃ bhavati | itaretaraśabde tu nityaḥ samāsavadbhāva iti subluksamāsasvarau bhavataḥ | anyo'nyamiti . dvitīyaikavacanāntasya dvirvacanam | anyo'nyasyeti | ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntasya | anyo'nyasambandhinaḥ putrādīnityarthaḥ | strīnapuṃsakayoriti | uttarapadasthāyā vibhakterāmbhāvaḥ; anyathā'nekālatvātsa sarvasyottarapadasya syāt | tatra `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti pūrvottarapadayordvayorapi puṃvadbhāve kṛte pakṣe āmvidhiḥ | anyāśabdasya tu dvirvacane samāsavadbhāvābhāvādvahulavacanātstriyāṃ ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ | napuṃsake ca `ad‌ḍutarādibhyaḥ' ityasya nivṛttiḥ | vārttikeṣu `karmadhārayavat' iti na sambadhyata iti sublugādi na bhavati ||
akṛcchre priyasukhayoranyatarasyām || 8.1.13 ||
priyapriyeṇeti tṛtīyaikavacanāntasya dvirvacane karmadhārayavadbhāvāt subluki punastadeva vacanam | atyantadayitamapi vastvanāyāsena dadātītyarthaḥ ||
yathāsve yathāyatham || 8.1.14 ||
`yathāsve' iti `yathā'sādṛśye' iti vīpsāyamavyayībhāvaḥ | svaśabda ātmavacanaḥ, ātmīyavacano veti darśayati | yo ya ātmeti | jñātidhanavacanasya tu grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; dvirvacanasya tatrāsamarthatvāt ||
dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādāvacanavyutkramaṇayajñapātraprayogābhivyaktiṣu || 8.1.15 ||
pūpavadasyeti | dvi au dvi sthite karmadhārayavadbhāvātsubluki kṛte pūrvapadāvayavabhūtasyekārasyāmbhāvaḥ, uttarapadāvayavasya cātvaṃ nipātyate, cakārānnapuṃsakatvam, kvacidekavadbhāvaśca nipātyate, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu karmadhārayavadbhāvād bhavati | tatra rahasyaṃ dvandvaśabdavācyamiti | dvābhyāṃ nirvṛtte rahasye yogarūḍhirepetyarthaḥ | dvandvaṃ mantrayanta iti | dvau dvau bhūtvā mantrayanta ityarthaḥ | evaṃ hi tadrahasyaṃ bhavati | ācaturamiti | āṅabhividhau | caturṇāṃ pūraṇe catuḥ śabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, ācaturthādityarthaḥ | dvandvaṃ mithunīyantīti | mithunaśabdena maithuṃ tatkarma lakṣyate, tadicchatīti kyac, prāyeṇa mithunāyanta iti kyaṅantaṃ paṭhyate, tatropamānārtho mṛgyaḥ | mātā putreṇetyādinā maryādāvacane vyanakti | tatputreṇāpīti | etāvadeva paśūnāmāyuḥ | dvandvaṃ vyutkrāntā iti | dvau pakṣau bhūtvā pṛthagavasthitā ityarthaḥ | svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvaśceti | dvandvaṃ nyañci pātrāṇi prayunakti - sādayati, nyañci-nyagbhūtāni, avāgbilāni | dvandvaṃ sphyaśca kapālāni ceti dvedve ityarthaḥ | atra vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam, ambhāvādi, ekavadbhāvaśca | dvāvabhivyaktau sāhacaryeṇetyartha iti | atra svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvādikaṃ sarvaṃ nipātyate |
dvandvaṃ yuddhamiti | atrāpi vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | dvandvāni sahanta iti | śītamuṣṇaṃ cetyekaṃ dvandvam, sukhaduḥ khe cāparam, kṣuttṛṣṇe cāparam | atrāpi svārthe dvirvacanamekavadbhāvādi, tatraikaśeṣavaśādvahutvam | cārthe dvandva iti | dve cārthanirddiṣṭe pade samaste dvandvaḥ | atrāpi svārthe dvirvacanādi, puṃstvaṃ ca ||
padasya || 8.1.16 ||
prāgapadāntādhikārāditi | `apadāntasya mūrddhanyaḥ' ityatra tu prakaraṇe virodhyupādānānnādikriyate | pacantau, yajantāviti | saṃyogāntasthe'pi lopo na bhavati | evaṃ rājānāvityatra nalopo na bhavati, praśāmāvityādau `mo no dhātoḥ' iti natvaṃ na bhavati | anantareṣu yogaṣvāmantritādeḥ subantasya tiṅantasya ca padasyaiva kāryavidhānātteṣāmullaṅghanam | na ca samarthaparibhāṣopasthānaṃma teṣu prayojanam, anantareṇāpyetaṃ vastutaḥ padakāryatvādeva siddheḥ | kiñca---`samānavākye nighātayuṣmapadasmādādeśāḥ' iti vakṣyate | kutvādīni tvavayavasya bhatve'pi samudāyasya padatvāśrayeṇeṣyanta eva---vaktari, dogdharīti | tasmānna bhasaṃjñakavyāvṛttirapi prayojanam |
`ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti vacanāt `padasya' iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tataśca `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' ityasyāyamartho bhavati---udāttasvaritayoryoyaṇ‌ tataḥ paro yo'nudāttastadantasya padasya svaritatvamalo'ntyasya bhavatīti | tataścātraiva syāt---kumāryāviti; kumārya ityatra na syāt, sakāro hyatra padasyāntaḥ, halsvaraprāptau ca vyañjanamavidyamānavadbhavati | evam `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' ityatrāpi ayamartho bhavati---udāttānudāttayorya ekadeśastadantasya padasyālontyasyādeśo bhavatīti | tadaścehaiva syāt---vṛkṣāviti; vṛkṣānityatra na syāt, nakāro hyatra padasyāntyaḥ ? ---ityāśaṅkyāha---vakṣyamāṇavākyāpekṣayeti | amayabhiprāyaḥ---adhikāro'yaṃ parārthaḥ, paribhāṣāpi parārthā, tataśca `guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasambandhaḥ samatvātsyāt' iti nyāyena nātra sthāneyogaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate | yatra tvasyā adhikāro vakṣyamāṇeṣu vākyeṣu tetvevopasthānam, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārādyaṇekādeśasvarayoḥ `padasya' ityanuvṛttaṃ kāryiviśeṣaṇārtham, na tu kāryapratipattyartham | tena padāvayavayoranudāttaikādeśayoḥ svaravidhānādanantyayorapi bhavati | saṃyogāntalopādau tu saṃyogādinā padasya viśeṣaṇāt sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tasmādvakṣyamāṇāni vākyānyapekṣya paryālocya padasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā artho vyavasthāpyaḥ, na tvetatsūtraparyālocanayeti | vyavasthāmeva darśayati---kvaciditi | yadyeṣā sthānaṣaṣṭhyeva syāt `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' ityatrāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | taddhi padāntasya yathā syāt, padāvayavasya mā bhūdityevamartham | sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu `alontyasya' ityasya siddhatvādantagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | tasmādantagrahaṇāt kvacidviśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyapi vijñāyate ||
padāt || 8.1.17 ||
prāk‌ kutsane ca supyagotrādāvityetasmāditi | yadi tvatra padādityetadanuvarteta, yatpacati pūtītyatraiva tiṅantasya nighātaḥ syāt, na tu pacati pūtītyatra ||
anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau || 8.1.18 ||
yatte niyatamityādi | atra mṛtyo ityasya pādādau nighātābhāvaḥ, yadaṅgadāśuṣe tvamityekaḥ pādaḥ, agne ityaparaḥ, agne bhadraṃ kariṣyatītyādīni codāharaṇāni |
rudro viśveśvara ityādi | atra yuṣmākam, asamākamityanayorādeśābhāvaḥ |
ṛkpādaḥ ślokapādaśca gṛhyate iti | viśeṣānupādānāt | atha sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `ananudātta padamekavarjam' iti vacanādekasminpade eka evodāttaḥ svarito vā sambhavati | ye tu dvyudāttāḥ---`ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat' iti, na yeṣāmatra prakaraṇe kvacidanudāttattvaṃ vidhīyate | yadā tu teṣāmāmantritatvam, tadā dvyudāttatvameva | idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---anāderapyudāttasyānudīttatvaṃ yathā syāt, anyathā padīdityadhikārād `ādeḥ parasya' ityādereva syāt, tataśca `tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' iti ihaiva syāt---devadattaḥ pacatīti, atra hi śaptipāvanudāttau, dhātoḥ svaraḥ; iha tu na syāt---devadattaḥ karotīti, vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodāttametat padam | sarvagrahaṇe tu sati padasya sarvo'vayavo'nudātto bhavatītyarthaḥ saṃpadyate, luṭi pratiṣedhātsiddham, yadayaṃ `na luṭ' iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjhāpayati---`nātrādeḥ parasyetyetadvyāpriyate' iti | na hi luḍantaṃ kiñcidādyudāttamasti | evamapi jñāpakenāpavāde ādividhāvapanīte alo'ntyasyaiva svād‌---ubho kuruta ityādau ? atra asārvadhātukasya pratyasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ vikaraṇasya tu nighātaḥ, na tu vikaraṇasvaraḥ satiśiṣṭo'pi sārvadhātukasvaraṃ bādhate, tāseḥ lasārvadhātukānudāttatvavidhānena jñāpanāt | evaṃ tahi lṛṭi pratiṣedhātsiddham, yadayaṃ `gatyarthaloṭā lṛṇna cet' iti lṛḍantasya pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---nātra `alo'ntyasya' ityetadvyāpriyata iti, na hi lṛḍantaṃ kiñcidantodāttamasti, adupadeśātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ nihanyate ? naitadasti; jñāpakamiḍarthametat syāt bhokṣya iti | etaddhaṣekādeśasvareṇāntodāttam |
evaṃ tarhyuktametat---padasyeti kvacidviśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyapi bhavati na sthānaṣaṣṭhyeveti, tataḥ kim ? anudāttavidhau viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyāśrayiṣyate, tatsāmānādhikaraṇyāttiṅiti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā, tiṅantasya padasyāvayavo'janudātto bhavatītyarthaḥ, tatra sthānaṣaṣṭhyabhāvād `alo'ntyasya' iti na pravarttate, tasmānnārthaḥ sarvagrahaṇena ? ityata āha---sarvagrahaṇamityādi | asati sarvagrahaṇe yatra vidheyāntaraṃ nāstyāmantritasyetyādau, tatraivānudāttatvaṃ vidhīyeta | tatra hyetadvidhānārthamāmantritādyanūdyate, vidheyāntarasadbhāve tu na tasyānudāttatvaṃ vidhīyeta; vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | tathā hisiddhasya vastuno dharmāntaraṃ śakyate vidhātuṃ nāsiddhasya, na hyasati kuḍye citrakarma; tataśca vāṃnāvādaya ekena vākyena vidheyāḥ, apareṇa ca teṣāmanudāttatvamiti vākyabhedaḥ | viśiṣṭavidhāne'pyanekārthavidhānādvidhigauravalakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ syādeva | sambhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedaśca neṣyate | sati tu sarvagrahaṇe tansāmarthyādvākyabhedaḥ sahyate ? ityāha---teneti |
prayojanāntaramāha---yuṣmadasmadādeśāśca savasya subantasya yathā syuriti | anyathā kevalayoryuṣmadasmadoreva syuḥ, ṣaṣṭhyekavacane ṅaso'si `ṅasiṅasośca' iti pūrvaikādeśe yadyapi doṣābhāvaḥ; tathāpi vacanāntare doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | sarvagrahaṇena tu sati yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ tadavayavakaṃ padaṃ lakṣyata iti sarvasya padasya vāṃnāvādayo bhavantīti | nanu na padasyeti vartate, vibhaktyantaṃ ca padam, tatrāntareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ vibhaktyantasya bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha---yatrāpīti | bhavedevaṃ yatra vibhaktyantaṃ padam, yatra tu vibhaktau padaṃ tatra yuṣmadasmadoreva prasaṅga ityarthaḥ | grāmovāṃ dīyata iti | caturthodvivacane, `svādiṣu' iti pūrvaṃ padaṃ bhavati ||
āmantritasya ca || 8.1.19 ||
sarvamanudāttaṃ bhavatīti | āmantritasambandhinaḥ sarve'co'nudāttā bhavantītyarthaḥ | etaccānuvṛttasya sarvaśabdasyānvayamātraṃ pradarśitam, na tvatrāsyopayogaḥ kaścit |
samānavākya ityādi | arthaikatvādikaṃ laukikaṃ vākyalakṣaṇam, iha tu pāribhāṣikaṃ vākyam | ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamiti, ākhyātamityekatvaṃ vivakṣitam, nimittanimittinoḥ samāna ekasminvākya ādhārabhūte sati nighātādayo bhavantīti vaktavyam, kimarthamityāha---iheti | `bhavatīha viṣṇumitraḥ, devadattāgaccha' iti vākyadvayametat; tiṅantadvayayogāt | tatra devadattetyasyāmantritasya nighāto na bhavati | nanu ca padavidhirayam, tataścāsāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyati, astyatra sāmarthyaṃ viṣṇumitramanviṣyānyatra gacchantaṃ devadattaṃ pratīdamucyate, tataśca viṣṇumitrasyeha bhavanaṃ devadattāgamanasya nimittatvenocyata itiyasti vyapekṣā | kvacidetadudāharaṇaṃ na paṭhyate | ayaṃ daṇḍa iti | astīti gamyamānatvādetāvadekaṃ vākyam | atrāpyaneneti sarvanāmnā paramṛṣṭasya daṇḍasya karaṇatvādasti sāmarthyamiti tiṅantasya nighātaprasaṅgaḥ | odanaṃ paceti | tvatkartṛkatvena tvatsvāmiko matsvāmikaścaudano bhaviṣyatītyevaṃ pākasya yuṣma dasmadarthasya ca vyapekṣā'stītyādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, evamatiprasaṅgaparihāraḥ prayojanamityuktam | idānīmavyāpriparihāro'pi prayojanamityāha---iha ceti |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇameṣūdāharaṇeṣu nighātādayo na syurityata āha---āmantritāntamityādi | iha sthitā mātetyanvayaḥ, na tviha devadatteti; nadyāḥ kūlamityanvayaḥ, na nadyāstiṣṭhatīti; śālīnāmodanamityanvayaḥ, na śālīnāṃ te iti, tataścāsāmarthyānna syurityarthaḥ ||
yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorvānnavau || 8.1.20 ||
dvivacanāntayoreveti | tena vacanāntareṇodāhṛtamiti bhāvaḥ |
sthagrahaṇamanarthakam, ṣaṣṭhyādiṣvādeśavidhānādeva tātsthyaṃsiddheḥ ? ityata āha---sthagrahaṇamiti | śrūyamāṇavibhaktikayorevādeśā yathā syuḥ, luptavibhaktikayormā bhūvannityarthaḥ | śrūyamāṇāyāṃ hi vibhaktau tatsthatvaṃ bhavati, na punarluptāyām | patyayalakṣaṇenāpi kāryaṃ śāstraṃ vā'tidiśyate, na tātsthyam | yadi vā tiṣṭhatiravamavihānāvapi dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā---samaye tiṣṭha sugrīveti, samayaṃ mā vihāsīrityarthaḥ | tenāyamarthaḥ---ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyā ajahatoryuṣmadasmadorādeśā bhavantīti | iti yuṣmatputra iti | itiśabdātpadātparayoḥ ṣaṣṭhyantayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena vānnāvau na bhavataḥ ||
na cavāhāhaivayukte || 8.1.24 ||
caḥ samuccaye, vā vikalpe, ha ahetyadbhute, ha khede ca, evo'vadhāraṇe | ebhiryukta iti | ebhiryoge satītyarthaḥ | yadvā---ebhiryukte yuṣmadasmadārartha ityarthaḥ | yuktagrahaṇamanarthakam, tṛtīyānirddeśata eva siddham, yathā `tulyārthairatulopamābhyām' ityatra ? ityata āha---yuktagrahaṇamiti | yadā yuṣmadasmadarthagatānsamuccayādīṃścādayo dyotayanti, tadā taistayoḥ sākṣādyogaḥ; tatraivāyaṃ pratiṣedho yathā syāt, yuktayukte mā bhūdityevamartha yuktagrahaṇamityarthaḥ | etadeva yuktagrahaṇaṃ liṅgam---atra prakaraṇe yuktayuktasyāpi grahaṇamiti, tenottaraḥ pratiṣedho yuktayukteṣu bhavati ||
paśyārthaiścānālocane || 8.1.25 ||
darśanam - paśyaḥ | asmādeva nipātanād bhāve śapratyayaḥ, pāghrādisūtreṇa paśyādeśaḥ, paśyo'rtho teṣāṃ te paśyārthāḥ, tadāha---paśyārthā darśanārthā iti | yadi tu `pāghrādhmādheṭ‌dṛśaḥ śaḥ' iti karttari śapratyayaḥ syāt, tato draṣṭrarthairityarthaḥ syāt, tathā cālocanaparyudāso'narthakaḥ syāt, na hyālocanārthā draṣṭrarthā bhavanti | darśanaṃ jñānamiti | yadyapi dṛśiścakṣurvijñāne prasiddhaḥ, tathāpi tasya paryudāsāt jñānamātre dṛśiriha vartata ityarthaḥ | grāmaḥ - janasamudāyaḥ | samīkṣya manasā nirūpyetyarthaḥ ||
sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā || 8.1.26 ||
vidyamānapūrvāditi | `tena saheti tulyayoge' ityatra `tulyayoge' ityapādheḥ prāyikatvādvidyamānavacanasyāpi sahaśabdasya samāsaḥ, `vopasarjanasya' iti sabhāvaḥ |
yuṣmadasmadorvibhāṣā'nanvādeśa iti | yeyaṃ yuṣmadasmadorvibhāṣā sā'nanvādeśe bhavati, anvādeśe tu nityamādeśavidhirityarthaḥ |
apara āheti | pūrvasyaiva vākyasya vyākhyānāntaram | pūrva vibhāṣā'nuvādena `viṣayo niyamyate' ityuktam, idānīṃ tu `viśiṣṭe viṣaye vikalpa eva vidhīyate' ityucyate | na kevalaṃ sūtroktaviṣaye ye prāptāsta eva vikalpyante, api tu sarve sarvaviṣayā ityarthaḥ |
na tarhīti | vaktavyenaiva siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anvādeśārthamiti | nanu pūrvam `anvādeśe sūtraṃ na vyāpriyate, ityuktam, idānīṃ tu `tatrāva vyāpriyate' ityucyate, tatko'tra nirṇayaḥ ? ityāha---tadayamiti | taditi tatretyarthe | vākyopanyāse vā | pūrvā vyākhyayā bādhyata ityarthaḥ ||
tiṅo gotrādīni kutsanā''bhīkṣṇyayoḥ || 8.1.27 ||
pacati gotramiti | pacirvyaktībhāve, yathā---lokapaktiriti, bhojanādyarthaṃ gotraṃ khyāpayatītyarthaḥ, evaṃ hi kutsā bhavati | pacatipacati gotramiti | vivāhādiviṣaye punaḥ punargotraṃ khyāpayatītyarthaḥ | tatra kutsāyā abhāvādābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇam | `nityavīpsayoḥ' iti dvirvacanam | bruvaśabdaḥ kutsitavacanaḥ, ata evāsyābhīkṣṇye pṛthagudāharaṇaṃ pradarśitam | pacati pravacanamityādāvātmapraśaṃsayā kutsā | pravacanam-adhyāpanam |
`vā nāma' iti gaṇasūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe---nāmetyetaditi | pacati pāpamiti | pāpamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | khanati gotraṃ sametya kūpamiti | gotraṃ kulaṃ samuditaṃ bhūtvā kūpaṃ khanatītyarthaḥ |
kimidaṃ kutsanā''bhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ gotrādīnāṃ pāṭhaviśeṣaṇam---etayorarthayorgotrādīni bhavanti, tāni ca tiṅaḥ parāṇyanudāttāni bhavantīti ? āhosvidanudāttaviśeṣaṇam---tiṅaḥ parāṇi gotrādīni anudāttāni bhavantyetayorarthayoriti ? asminvivāde nirṇayamāha---kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ ceti | paṭhyata iti pāṭhaḥ, sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ | tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam | ayaṃ cārtho yogavibhāgāllabhyate, `tiṅo gotrādīni' ityeko yogo'nudāttavidhānārthaḥ, `kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, gotrādīnītyeva, paribhāṣeyam | iha śāstre gotrādīni kutsanābhīkṣṇyaviṣayāṇyeva grāhyāṇīti, tena kiṃ siddhaṃbhavati ? ityata āha---teneti | anyatrāpīti | `canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ', `kutsane ca gotrādau' ityatra ||
tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ || 8.1.28 ||
bhavati pacatīti | pacatītyetadbhavati, pākakriyā bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatra sādhyasādhanabhāvena dvayoḥ kriyayoranvayādasti sāmarthyam | yathoktam---pacyādikriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavantīti | tatra pākasya svasādhanāni prati sādhyasyāpi bhavanaṃ prati siddhatvam | yathāha bhartṛhariḥ---
`tatra yaṃ prati sādhyatvamasiddhaṃ taṃ prati kriyā |
siddhā tu yasminsādhyatvaṃ na tameva punaḥ prati' || iti |
astyetat ? kim ! tarhi atiṅ‌grahaṇamanarthakam; samānavākyādhikārāt, `samānavākye' iti varttate, na caikasminvākye tiṅantadvayamasti, taduktaṃ purastāt | sūtrakāreṇa tu samānavākyādhikāro na kṛta ityatiṅ‌grahaṇamakāri ||
na luṭ‌ || 8.1.29 ||
śvaḥ karttetyādi | athātra nighāte pratiṣiddhekaḥ svaraḥ śrūyate ? ityāha---tāseḥ parasyeti ||
nīpātairyadyadihantakuvinnecceccaṇkaccidyatrayuktam || 8.1.30 ||
yadyadārthe ca hetau ca vicāre yadiceccaṇaḥ |
hanta harṣe'nukampāyāṃ vākyārambhaviṣādayoḥ ||
kaccitpraśne nenniṣedhe praśaṃsāyāṃ kuvitsmṛtam |
yatrādhāre nipātatvaṃ yadādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam ||
samāse guṇabhūtānāmapi gatyantaraṃ na hi |
naiva vā'thaṃ samāsaḥ subavyayatvena lupyate ||
tatra bahvṛcāḥ---`necced‌' iti nipātasamāhāramadhīyate---nedevamāyunajannatra devāḥ | anyaścennābhigacchatīti cedarthe varttata iti | ya eva samuccayādiṣu dṛṣṭaścaśabdaḥ sa eva cedarthe varttate, tadarthavarttinastu cihnaṃ ṇakāraḥ | tathā ca cādayo'nudāttā ityayaṃ cedartho'pyanudātaḥ, indraśca mṛḍayāti naḥ; nataḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat, indraścedasmānmṛḍayet, sukhayedityarthaḥ | tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe---he soma tvaṃ cedasmān jīvātuṃ jīvituṃ vaśaḥ uśyāḥ kāmayethā ityarthaḥ |
samuccayādiṣu yaścaśabda iti | eṣvartheṣu na bhavatītyarthaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu karotiśabdo vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ | bhuṅ‌kta iti | udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttaḥ | adhīta iti | `ahanviṅoḥ' iti lasārvadhātukānudāttatvapratiṣedhādantodāttaḥ | iṇaḥ śatari rūpamiti | `iṇo yaṇ‌' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | nanu pratipadoktatvādyadyādibhiḥ sāhacaryācca nipātasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati---atra prakaraṇe nedamubhayaṃ vyavasthāpakamiti | tena `yāvadyathābhyām' ityatra `yattadetetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup' iti vyutpāditasya lākṣaṇikasyānipātasyāpi yāvacchabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati---tāvaduṣo rādho asmabhyam, rāsva yāvatstotṛbhyo arado gṛṇānā iti; yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāditi ca |
yatra kva ceti | atra yatretyasya uttaramityanena sākṣātsambandhaḥ | dadhasa iti | `tadha dhāraṇe' anudāttet | iha---
hantā'haṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ nidadhānīha veha vā |
hanto nu kimāsa se prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi || iti chāndasatvānnighātaḥ ||
naha pratyārambhe || 8.1.31 ||
naheti nipātasamāhāraḥ pratiṣedhe varttate | pratyārambhaḥ-punarārambhaḥ | tasya viṣayamāha---coditasyeti | bhuṅ‌kṣva, adhīṣvetyevaṃ coditasya kartaṣyatayopanyastasya bhojanāderavadhīraṇe'vajñāte sati tasyāvadhīrayiturupālipsayā-upālabdhumicchayā tasyaiva bhojanādeḥ pratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ pratyārambhaḥ, punarupanyāsaḥ kriyate iti yāvat ||
aṅgāprātilomya || 8.1.33 ||
prātilomyam-pratikūlakāritvam, tato'nyadabhimatakāritvamaprātilomyam | evaṃ cānulomya iti vaktavyam | aṅgaśabda udāharaṇe'nujñāyām | pratyudāharaṇe tvamarṣe ||
hi ca || 8.1.34 ||
hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe hetau vā, sa ca pratyudāharaṇe tvamarṣe ||
chandasyanekamapi sākāṅ‌kṣam || 8.1.35 ||
atra hetuhetumadbhāvasya dyotako hirityanekamapi tiṅantaṃ hiyuktaṃ bhavati | tatra pūrveṇa sarvasya nighātapratiṣedhe prāpte kvacidanekasya kvacidekasya yathā syāditi vanacam | tadāha---kadāciditi | tatra chandasi dṛṣṭānuvidhānādyathāprayogaṃ vyavasthā | anṛtaṃ hīti | pāpmā - mada ucyate | yasmādasau matto'nṛtaṃ vadati tasmādanṛtavadanadoṣeṇa yujyata ityarthaḥ |
udajayadityādyudāttamiti | atrājayadityādyudāttamityarthaḥ | ajaniṣṭa garbhamiti antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvājjaneratra sakarmakatvam ||
yāvadyathābhyām || 8.1.36 ||
yāvatsākalye, adhyavasāye vā, yathā yogyatādiṣu | `yāvadyathābhyām' iti tṛtīyeti darśayituṃ parabhūtayorapi prayoga udāhṛtaḥ | tenaitadapi na codanīyam---`yadvṛttānnityam' ityeva yathāśabde yāvacchabde ca vatubantai siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti ||
pūjāyāṃ nānāntaram || 8.1.37 ||
dvau pratiṣedhau prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayata ityāha---ki tarhyanudāttamiti | yāvaddevadatta iti | nanu cottaratra niyamo vijñāsyate---vyavāye yadi bhavati upasargeṇaiveti ? evaṃ tarhyuttaratrāsya prayojanam---upasargavyapetasya yāvadyathāśabdayośca madhye śabdāntaraṃ mā bhūt | atha tu `vyavāye yadi bhavati upasargeṇaiva' ityasmādeva niyamāttatrāprasaṅgaḥ ? tato'nantaragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum ||
upasargavyapetaṃ ca || 8.1.38 ||
vyavāyaḥ - vyavadhānam | anantaramityeveti | taccānantaryaṃ sopasargasya, na tiṅantamātrasya ||
tupaśyapaśyatāhaiḥ pūjāyām || 8.1.39 ||
tuprabhṛtīni pūjāviṣayāṇi | māṇavakastu bhuṅ‌kta iti | āścarye tuśabda iti bhojanasya pūjā gamyate, evamanyatrāpi---paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti | tattvakathanametat |
nanu `pūjāyāṃ nānantaram' ityataḥ pūjāyāmityanuvarttata evaṃ, tatkiṃ pūjāyāmityanena ? tatrāha---pūjāyāmiti vartamāna iti | taddhīti | tataśca tadanuvṛttāvihāpi `na luṭ' ityādike viṣaye pratiṣedhasya priṣedhaḥ syāt, mā bhūdevam; nighātasyaiva pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pūjāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ | kiñca---anantaramityevaṃ tadabhūt, iha tvaviśeṣeṇeṣyate ||
aho ca || 8.1.40 ||
pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārthamiti | uttaro yogo'hoyoga eva yathā syāt, tuprabhṛtibhiryoge mā bhūt ||
śeṣe vibhāṣā || 8.1.41 ||
aśūyāvacanametaditi | anāśvaryabhūtameva vastvasūyannāścaryavatpratipādayatītyarthaḥ |
śeṣavacanaṃ kim, yāvatā yogavibhāgasāmarthyādeva pūrvaprakṛteṣu kiñcinnānuvarttata iti jñātam, tatra cānukṛṣṭatvāt `pūjāyām' ityetannivartiṣyate ? ata āha---pūjāyāmityasyeti ||
purā ca parīpsāyām || 8.1.42 ||
purāśabdo'tra bhaviṣyadāsatti dyotayatīti | bhaviṣyato vidyotanāderadhyayanāntarāyabhūtasyācirakālabhāvitvaṃ dyotayati, tenātra tvarā gamyate iti bhāvaḥ | vidyotanādāvadhyayanaṃ dharmaśāstre pratiṣiddham, atastadupanyāsena tvaritamadhīṣveti gamyate ityarthaḥ | udāharaṇe `yāvatpurānipātayoḥ' iti bhaviṣyadarthe laṭ‌, pratyudāharaṇe `laṭ‌ sme' iti | atra bhūtakālaviprakarṣamiti | bhūtasyādhyayanasya cirakālapravṛttatvaṃ dyotayati | tena nātra tvarā gamyata iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanvityanujñaiṣaṇāyām || 8.1.43 ||
kiṃcitkartu svayamevodyuktasyaivaṃ kriyatāmityevaṃ rūpo'bhyupagamaḥ - anujñā | sūtrārthamudāharaṇena darśayati---karaṇaṃ pratīti | upalakṣaṇametat, karaṇagamane pratītyarthaḥ | udāharaṇe `varttamāne laṭ‌' | pratyudāharaṇe tu bhūte `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' ityenena |`aṅgāpratilomye' ityādivat siddhe itikaraṇa ekanipāto'yamiti darśanārthaḥ; anyathā dvayorapi nipātayorgrahaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta ||
kiṃ kriyāpraśne'nupasargamapratiṣaiddham || 8.1.44 ||
apratiṣiddhamiti | apratiṣiddhārthamityarthaḥ |
pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktamiti | tatsamīpe kimaḥ śrūyamāṇatvāt | uttaraṃ tu na kiṃyuktamiti | viparyayāt |
apare ityādi | na samīpe śrūyamāṇatvaṃ kiṃśabdena sambandhe hetuḥ, kintu saṃśayaviṣayatvam | tacca dvitīyasyāpyasti, atastasyāpi tena yoga ityubhayatra pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ | ye tvāhuḥ---pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktamiti, te manyante---astu dvayoḥ saṃśayaviṣayatvam, kiṃśabdena tu samīpe śrutakriyāviṣaya eva praśno dyotyate, kriyāntaraviṣayastu praśna āhosvidityanena, kriyāpraśna iti cocyate, tasmāttasyaiva nighātapratiṣedha iti ||
lope vibhāṣā || 8.1.45 ||
prakṛtatvātkima eva lopo vijñāyata ityāha---kimo lopa iti |
kva cāsyeti | śāstre kvacidapi kimo lopasyāvihitatvāt praśnaḥ | na śāstrīyasyaivādarśanasya lopasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi ? adarśanamātrasyetyuttaram | yatreti | na ca prayujyata iti | arthaprakaraṇādinā gamyamānatvāt | udāharaṇe āhosvicchabdaḥ pakṣāntarapraśne, sa ca nāntareṇa pūrvapraśnamityarthāt pūrvatra kimartho gamyate, tadāha---vinaiva kimeti |
prāptavibhāṣeyamiti | kathaṃ punaḥ prāptiḥ, yāvatā kiṃśabdena yogena pūrvo yogaḥ ? tatrāha---kimartheneti | pūrvavatpratyudāharaṇānīti | tānyeva kiṃśabdarahitānītyarthaḥ ||
ehimanye prahāse lṛṭ‌ || 8.1.46 ||
ehimanya ityaneneti | samudāyābhiprāyamekavacanam, anyathā ākhyāte dve āṅ‌ cāpara iti bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ | udāharaṇe `prahāse ca manyopapade' ityādinā puruṣavyatyayaḥ |
suṣṭhu ca manyase iti | bhūtamarthaṃ darśayan prahāsābhāvamāha, ata eva puruṣavyatyayo'pi na kṛtaḥ |
gatyarthaloṭā lṛḍityeva siddha iti | āṅ‌pūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo hiḥ | anyatra mā bhūditi | kvānyatra mā bhūt ? vṛttikāreṇa yatpratyudāhṛtam--ehi manyasa ityādi tatra |
kathaṃ punarehimanye ityanena yoganiyamaḥ kriyamāṇa ehi manyasa ityanena yoganivṛttiṃ karoti ? ityāha---uttamopādānamatantramiti | atantratve kāraṇamāha---prahāsa eva hīti | tantratve niyamasya vyāvartyaṃ na sambhavedityarthaḥ | bhāṣye tu pratyudāharaṇe'pyuttama eva prayuktaḥ, tatrāyamarthaḥ---ehi rathena tvaṃ yāsyasītyevamahaṃ manya iti ||
jātvapūrvam || 8.1.47 ||
jātvityetadapūrvamiti | atha tiṅantaviśeṣaṇamapūrvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yuktaṃ caitat, viśaṣaṇena sambandhuṃ yogye sati nimittini nimittasyāpradhānasya na hi yuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam ? ucyate; yadayam `āho utāho cānantaram' ityatrānantaragrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato jñāyate---nimittasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti; anyathā tatrāpi `apūrvam' ityanuvṛttereva kevalatiṅantasyānantaya labhyata iti kiṃ tena ! nanu ca śeṣapraklṛptyarthaṃ tatsyāt---`śeṣe vibhāṣā', kaśca śeṣaḥ ? sāntaraḥ śeṣa iti ? antareṇāpyanantaragrahaṇaṃ praklṛptaḥ śeṣaḥ | katham ? apūrvamiti prakṛtam, sapūrvaḥ śeṣa iti ||
kivṛttaṃ ca ciduttaram || 8.1.48 ||
vṛttimityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, kimo vṛttaṃ kiṃvṛttamiti, `adhikaraṇavācinaśca' iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī, `adhikaraṇavācinā ca' iti samāsapratiṣedhe prāpte'smādeva nipātanātsamāsaḥ | yadi yatra kiṃśabdo vartate tatsarvaṃ gṛhyeta---kimīyaḥ, kaimāyaniḥ, kiṃtarāmityādergrahaṇaprasaṅga iti matvā parisañcaṣṭe---kiṃvṛttagrahaṇeneti | ciduttaramityetatkiṃvṛttasya viśeṣaṇam, na tiṅantasya; pūrvoktāt sāmānyāpekṣayā jñāpakāt ||
āho utāho cānantaram || 8.1.49 ||
apūvimityeveti | ata evotāhograhaṇam, utaśabdapūrvatvādāhośabdasya ||
śeṣa vibhāṣā || 8.1.50 ||
kaśca śeṣa iti | bahūnāṃ prakṛtatvātpraśnaḥ | yadanyadantarāditi | pratiṣedhasya nimittabhūtamāho--utāhīgrahaṇaṃ tāvadavaśyamanuvartyam, utāhograhaṇāccāpūrvamityapyanuvartate; tatra pāriśeṣyādanantarāpekṣa eva śeṣa iti bhāvaḥ ||
gatyarthaloṭā lṛṇna cetkārakaṃ sarvānyat || 8.1.51 ||
gaminā samānārthā gatyarthā iti | arthapradarśanametat, gatirartho yeṣāmiti tu vigrahaḥ, gatyarthaloṭā yuktamiti yogaḥ, punararthadvārako nimittanimittibhāvaḥ, loḍantavācyaṃ hi nimittaṃ lṛḍantavācyasya | na cetkārakaṃ sarvaṃmanyadbhavatīti | sarvaṃ cetkārakamanyat, tadā nighātapratiṣedho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | atra---
loḍante ca lṛḍante ca yāvatkiñcana kārakam |
kṛhyeta yadā tatsarvaṃ vācyāvācyavivekataḥ ||
tadehāpi tarhi prāpnoti---
`vaha brāhmaṇa śālīṃstvaṃ pitaitāṃstava bhokṣyate' iti ?
yatra hi sarvaṃ bhidyate, tatraiva na bhavitavyam, yathā vṛttāvupanyastayoḥ pratyudāharaṇayoḥ |
na cātra bhidyate sarvamabhedācchālikarmaṇaḥ |
athāyamarthaḥ syāt---sarvasminkārake'nanyasminnaghātapratiṣedhaḥ, na tu kvacidapi bhinna iti tadehāpi na syāt---āgaccha devadatta grāmamodanaṃ bhokṣyasa iti, bhidyate hyatra karma, tasmādvyākhyeyametat ? tatrāha---yatraiveti | evakāreṇa vācyavyatiriktasya nirāsaḥ, na tu sarvasyānanyatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tatspaṣṭīkṛtam | kartṛkarmaṇī eveti | etacca pratyāsatterlabhyate, pratyāsannaṃ hi tattasya, yattenaivābhidhīyate | udāharaṇeṣu prathamatṛtīyayoḥ sarvamananyat | drakṣyasītyasya tu nighātaprasaṅgaścintyaḥ; nānāvākyatvāt, dvitīyacaturthayorvācyamātraṃ vaherguṇabhūtagamanābhiprāyaṃ gatyarthatvam, prāpaṇārthastvayam | tathā ca---
`nīvahyorharateścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca' |
iti bhedena gaṇanaṃ kṛtam | nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakam, sā ca pratikriyaṃ bhidyate, tatkathamihābhinnaṃ kārakam ? śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādadoṣaḥ |
āgaccheriti | liṅayaṃ na leṭ | paśyatīti | laḍayaṃ na lṛṭ, pratyudāharaṇayoḥ sarvamanyat | kārakaśabdenāpi sūtre kārakavyaktirevāśrīyate, tena kartṛkarmatvābhede'pi vyaktibhedāt kārakabhedaḥ---tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca drakṣyāva iti | akriyamāṇe sarvagrahaṇe yatra vācyaṃ na bhidyate tatraiva bhavitavyam, iha ca bhidyate vācyam---ekatraikam, aparatra dvayamiti nighātapratiṣedho na syāt | kriyamāṇe tu sarvagrahaṇe yathā sidhyati, tathā darśayati---lṛḍantavācye hīti ||
loṭ ca || 8.1.52 ||
śādhīti | śārserloṭ, sip, sipo hiḥ, `śā hau' iti śādeśaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāt jhallakṣaṇaṃ dhitvam | praśādhīti prāyeṇa pāṭhaḥ, sa na yuktaḥ; sopasargatvenottarasūtraviṣayatvāt |
pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārthamiti | uttaro vikalpo loṭa eva yathā syāt, lṛṭo mā bhūditi ||
hanta ca || 8.1.54 ||
hanta prabhuñjāvahai iti | bhujerloṭ, `bhujo'navane' ityātmanepadam, vahiḥ, ṭeretvam, `āḍuttamasya picca', `eta ai', anudāttetvāllasārvadhātukamanudāttatvam, vikaraṇasvaraḥ |
āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike || 8.1.55 ||
antarayatītyantaram - vyavadhāyakam | ekamantaraṃ yasya tadekāntaram, udāharaṇe nighāte pratiṣiddhe ṣāṣṭhikamādyudāttatvam, `dūrāddhūte ca' iti plutaḥ; bhavacchabdasya `vibhāṣā bhavadbhagavadaghavatām' iti rutvam, avaśabdasya ca okāraḥ, `bhobhago' ityādinā yatvam, tasya `hali sarveṣām' iti lopaḥ |
nanu ca `āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' iti bhoḥ śabdasyāvidyamānatvādekāntaratā nopapadyate ? ata āha---bho ityetaditi |
tadubhayamapyanena kriyata iti | kathaṃ punaraprakṛtāyā asaṃśabditāyāścaikaśruteḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śakyo vijñātum ? ucyate; nañatra vipakṣavacanaḥ, adharmānṛtādivat, antikaviruddhamanantikam, dūramityarthaḥ, tatra caikaśrutirucyate, tataśca pacasi devadattetyādāvantike sāvakāśamāmantritanighātaṃ bādhitvā ekaśrutiḥ prāpnoti, sā tāvatpratiṣiddhyate, tato'pavāde pratiṣiddha utsargabhūto nighātaḥ prāpnoti, so'pi pratiṣidhyate, ekaśrutimātrapratiṣedhe hi tatraivāyaṃ brūyāt---nāma ekāntaramiti | evaṃ hi `āmantritamanantike' iti ca na vaktavyaṃ bhavati, so'yamevaṃ siddhe yannighātaprakaraṇe idaṃ bravīti tena vijānīmaḥ---nighāto'pi pratiṣidhyata iti | kevalasya nighātasyekaśrutyā bādhitasya pratiṣedho'narthaka iti sāmarthyādubhayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
nanu caikaśrutirapi devadattā3 āgacchetyādau sāvakāśā kathamāṃ bho devadatta ityādau nighātasya bādhikā, pratyuta paratvādekaśruternighāta eva bādhaka iti tasyaivātra prasaṅga iti pratiṣedho'pi tasyaiva nyāyyaḥ, tasya ca pratiṣedhe ekaśrutiḥ syādeva ? atrāhuḥ---padadvayamātranibandhanatvādantaraṅgo nighātaḥ pūrvaṃ pravarttate, tato dūrātsambodhanamadhikaṃ nimittamapekṣamāṇaikaśrutiriti saivānantaraṃ prāpnoti, tāṃ tāvadvādhate pūrvoktena nyāyena nighātamapīti suṣṭhūktam---tadubhayamanena kriyata iti |
yathaiva tarhi ekaśrutirbādhyate, tathaiva plutodātto'pi bādhyeta ? ata āha---plutodāttaḥ punariti | apareṣāmiti | te manyante---sādṛśye'tra nañ‌, na vipekṣe; anyathā dūra ityeva brūyāditi prāptireva nāsti, adūratvāt | kathaṃ tarhi pluta udāhriyate ? ata āha---pluto'pīti ||
yaddhituparaṃ chandasi || 8.1.56 ||
jāye svo rohāvaihīti | ruherloṭ, vas, śap, `āḍuttamasya picca', `loṭo laṅ‌vat' iti laṅ‌vadbhāvāt `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' iti salopaḥ, āh‌pūrvādiṇo loṭ, sipo hiḥ, ehītyanena parabhūtena yuktasya rohāvetyasya `loṭ‌ ca ' iti prāpto nighātapratiṣedho niyamena nivartyate, tena svaśabdāśrayo nighāto bhavati | nanu `paramapi chandasi' iti vacanāt svaḥ śabdasya pūrvāṅgavadbhāvajjāyesvarityāmantritam, tataśca `āmantrita pūrvamavidyamānavat' ityavidyamānatvānnighāto na prāpnoti, pratiṣidhyate'trāṅgavadbhāvaḥ---avyayānāṃ pratiṣedha iti ? naivam; atrāṅgavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, uktaṃ hi tatra---`ṣaṣṭhyāmantritakārakavacanam' `tannimittagrahaṇaṃ ca' iti | na hi svaḥ śabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhyanta āmantritakārakaṃ tannimittaṃ vā svare vāṅgavadbhāvo nāvidyamānavatvam | svaḥ śabdasya `ro ri' iti lopo na bhavati, utvaṃ ca bhavati; chāndasatvāt | athedānīṃ rohāvetyanena yuktasya ehītyasya `loṭ‌ ca' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna bhavati, na ruhirgatyarthaḥ, `gatyarthākarmaka' ityatra pṛthaggrahaṇāt ? yadi na gatyarthaḥ, ārohanti hastinaṃ manuṣyāḥ ārohayati hastī manuṣyān, `gatibuddhipratyavasānārtha' iti karmasaṃjñā na prāpnoti | tasmāduparigamanarūpavyāpāro ruherarthaḥ | `gatyarthākarmaka' ityatra ca ruhigrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham | ehītyasya tu nighātapratiṣedho na bhavati; `vibhāṣita sopasargamanuttamam' iti vacanāt ||
canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ || 8.1.57 ||
ihāpīti | na kevalaṃ tiṅo gotrādīnītyatraivetyapiśabdārthaḥ | tatra hetustatraiva pratipāditaḥ | śuklīkaroti caneti | agateriti pratiṣedhābhāvādatra nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva | yatkāṣṭhamiti | śuklīśabdasya nighāto na bhavati ||
cādiṣu ca || 8.1.58 ||
ta iha gṛhyanta iti | pratyāsatteḥ | `cādayo'satve' ityatra yeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ te viprakṛṣṭaḥ | `samuccayo vikalpaścānekasya dharmaḥ' ityuttarasūtre vakṣyati, ataḥ khādati cetyasyopanyāsaḥ | na tvasya nighātaprasaṅgaḥ; nānāvākyatvāt | khādati hetyādestu prakramābhedāyopanyāsaḥ |
paraṃtu nihanyata eveti | praśabdātsamānavākyagatāt padātparatvāt ||
cavāyoge prathamā || 8.1.59 ||
agateriti | pūvasūtra ityādi | ata eva pūrvasūtre pratyudāharaṇāvasara uktam---prathamasyātra tiṅantasya cavāyoge prathameti nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyata eveti | prathameti strīliṅgasya nirvāhamāha---prathamā tiṅ‌vibhaktiriti |
prathamāgrahaṇavyāvartyasya dvitīyādeḥ sambhavamāha---cavāyogo hīti ||
heti kṣiyāyām || 8.1.60 ||
ācārabhedaḥ - ācārollaṅghanam | udāharaṇe---upādhyāye padātau gacchati śiṣyasya rathena gamanaṃ pratiṣiddham---ityācārabhedaḥ ||
aheti viniyoge ca || 8.1.61 ||
nānāprayojana iti | aneka prayojano niyogaḥ - preṣaṇam | plutaśceti | sa punaḥ kṣiyāyāṃ kṣiyāhetukaḥ, viniyoge praiṣahetukaḥ ||
cāhalopa evetyavadhāraṇam || 8.1.62 ||
udāharaṇe calopaṃ darśayati---grāmaṃ ceti | evamahalope'pi draṣṭavyam | tatra prathame grāma karmakasyāraṇyakarmakasya ca devadatta eva karteti samānakartṛkatvam, dvitīye tu viparyayānnānākartṛkatā draṣṭavyā | anavaklṛptiḥ - asambhavanam | yo hi devadattasya bhojanaṃ kvacidapi na sambhāvayati, sa evaṃ prayuṅ‌kte---kveva bhokṣyasa iti | `eve cāniyoge' iti pararūpatvam | kvacittu vṛttāvevaitat paṭhyate ||
cādilāpe vibhāṣā || 8.1.63 ||
pūrvo yoga evaśabdaprayoge nityārthaḥ ||
vaivāveti ca chandasi || 8.1.64 ||
vai sphuṭārthe, kṣamāyāṃ ca | vāva prasiddhau, sphuṭārthe ca |
ekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām || 8.1.65 ||
samau tulyāvarthau yayostau samarthau, śakandhvādiṣu darśanātpararūpatvam | nipātanādvā'ntalopaḥ | parasparaṃ samānārthatā na; tiṅantena asambhavāt | tiṅantena saṅgatābhyāmityayaṃ tvartho na bhavati, `cavāyoge prathamā' ityato yogagrahaṇānuvṛtterevāsyārthasya siddhatvāt | jinvatīti | jiviḥ prīṇānārthaḥ, idittvānnum, laṭ‌tipśapaḥ | cākaśītīti | kāśinā samānārthaḥ kaśiḥ prakṛtyantaramastītyuktam, tasyaitadyaṅ‌luki rūpam |
ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ ceti | atastasyaiva pratyudāharaṇaṃ darśitam, nānyaśabdasyeti bhāvaḥ | vyabhicāritvāttasyeti | ekaśabdo hyanyātha vyabhicaratīti | nānārtho hyayamiti hi `eko gotre' ityatra dasitam | tatrāsati samarthagrahaṇe'nyaśabdena bhinnārthasyāpi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca sāhacaryamatra prakaraṇe vyavasthāpakamiti `nipātairyadyadihanta' ityatrāvocāma ||
yadvṛttānnityam || 8.1.66 ||
`kiṃvṛttaṃ ca ciduttaram' ityatra kiṃvṛttaśabdasya darśitā vyutpattirihānugantavyā | etannāśrīyata iti | tadāśrayaṇe hi yadryaṅ‌, yadīyam, yādāyanirityādibhyaḥ parasya na syāt | juhuma iti | pratyayasvareṇāntodāttametat, `abhyastānāmādiḥ', `bhīhrībhṛhumada' iti cobhayatrāpi acīti varttate | yadryaṅiti | yadañcati, kvin, `viṣvagdevayośca' iti ṭeradryādeśaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ pañcamīnirddeśe sati yatkāmāste, yadryaṅ‌ vāyurityādau vyavadhāne bhavati ? ata āha---pañcamīnirdeśe'pyatreti | etaccottarasūtre jñāpayiṣyate | yāthākāmye veti | yāthākāmyam - yathecchapravṛttiḥ, deśakālānapekṣā, tatra gamyamāne vā nighātapratiṣedhaḥ, yatra kvacana yajate ||
pūjānāt pūjitamanudāttaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ || 8.1.67 ||
`kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ' iti vārttike dṛṣṭaṃ sūtrāvayavatvena paṭhitatvāttadanurodhena pūjanādityekavacanaṃ bahuvacanasthāna iti vyācaṣṭe---pūjanebhyaḥ kāṣṭhādibhya iti | uttarapadamiti | uttarasūtre tiṅ‌grahaṇādasya ca sūtrasya samāsaviṣayatvātsubantamiti draṣṭavyam | kāṣṭhādayaścaite'dbhutaparyāyāḥ pūjanavacanā bhavanti, tatra yeṣāṃ vṛttiviṣaya evādbhutaparyāyatvamamātāputrādīnāṃ tepvanyapadena vigrahaḥ | kāṣṭhādhyāpaka iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | kāṣṭhaśabdo dvitīyāntaḥ samasyate | kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tu ṣaṣṭhī kriyāviśeṣaṇepu na bhavati, dhātvarthaṃ prati yatkarma tatraiva ṣaṣṭhīḥ, kartṛpadena sāhacaryāt | yo hi dhātvarthaṃ prati karttā tatra ṣaṣṭhī, tatsāhacaryāt karmāpi tādṛśameva gṛhyate | viśeṣaṇaṃ tu dhātvarthena samānādhikaraṇatvānna taṃ prati karma | sarvathā kriyāviśeṣaṇānna ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, ata eva malopa iti vakṣyate | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyāṃ makārābhāvādanupapannametatasyāt | kathaṃ punaḥ kartṛpradhāne kṛdante guṇabhūtāyāḥ kriyāyā viśeṣaṇena sambandhaḥ, sādhanasambandhavadupapadyate; tadyathā---grāmaṃ gata ityādau guṇabhūtāyā api kriyāyāḥ sādhanena yogaḥ, tathā viśeṣaṇenāpi nānupapannaḥ | kāṣṭhābhirūpaka iti | ābhirūpyaṃ kāṣṭhena viśeṣyata iti napuṃsakaprathamāntasya samāsaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra pravṛttinimittamātreṇa kāṣṭhādīnāmanvayād dravyavācibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt mayūravyaṃsakāditvamāśritam |
samāse cetyādi | cakāro'vadhāraṇe, yadi samāse evaitadiṣyate, kathaṃ vārttikakāreṇoktam---pūjitasyānudāttatve kāṣṭhādigrahaṇaṃ malopaśceti; na hi samāse teṣāmantyo makāraḥ sambhavati, vibhakterluptatvāt ? ityata āha---malopaścetyanenāpīti | kathaṃ purathaṃ viṣayo'nenākhyāyate ? ata āha---yatreti | samāse hi vibhakterabhāvānmakāro na śrūyate ayameva lopa iti | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ kāśakuśāvalambanena vāttikaṃ vyākhyāyate ? ata āha---asamāse hīti | anye tvāhuḥ---yadi samāsa evaitadabhimatamabhaviṣyat `samāse' ityevāvakṣyat‌; malopavacanāttu vākyaviṣayamevaitat | dāruṇamadhyāpaka ityādikaṃ tu rūpaṃ yadīṣyate vikalpena malopo vaktavya iti |
pūjanādityeva pūjitaparigrahe siddha iti | pūjanasya pūjatāpekṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anantarapūjitapratipattyarthamiti | `pūjanātpūjitam' iti sūtre sāmānyagatamānantarya viśeṣāṇāṃ vijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ pañcamīnirdeśe vyavahitasya prasaṅgaḥ ? ityāha---etadeveti | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---tathā ceti |
anudātta iti vartamāna ityādi | prakṛtaṃ hyanudāttagrahaṇam `na luṭ‌' ityādinā pratiṣedhena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau pratiṣedho'pyanuvarteta | tatra yadyapyasya yogasya samāsaviṣayatvāttādṛśo viṣayo na sambhavati, yatrāmantritādau nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyate; tathāpi `kutsane ca supi' ityādau uttaratra pratiṣedha eva syāt | tasmāttannivṛttyarthaṃ punaranudāttagrahaṇam ||
sagatirapi tiṅ‌ || 8.1.68 ||
yatkāṣṭhaṃ pacatīti | ye'pi `malopaśca' ityanena vākyena malopamāhuḥ te'pi tiṅante parato naiva lopamicchanti | sagatigrahaṇādratirapi nihanyata iti | katham ? tulyayoge'tra sahaśabdaḥ, yatra tulyayoge sahaśabdastatra dvayorapi kāryayogo bhavati, tadyathā---saputro bhojyatāmityukte putro'pi bhojyate apigrahaṇaṃ yatra gatirna prayujyate tatra kevalasyāpi tiṅantasya yathā syāt, gatiprayoge tu dvayoḥ sahaiva bhavati, tiṅ‌grahaṇātpūrvo yogaḥ subantaviṣaya eva vijñāyate ||
kutsane ca supyagotrādau || 8.1.69 ||
pacati kliśnātīti | kathamatra samānavākyatvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ceti cintyam |
kartuḥ kutsane mā bhūt, pacati pūtīti | kartṛtvamatra kutsyate---asyedamayuktamiti | kriyā tu śobhanaiva, tatra kartṛtvasya viśeṣaṇaṃ pūtitvaṃ na kartrā samānādhikaraṇamiti dāruṇamabhirūpakamityādivannapuṃsakatvam | evaṃ dvibahvorapyekavacanameva bhavati---pacataḥ pūti, pacanti pūtīti | prāyeṇa pūtiriti puṃlliṅgaṃ paṭhyate | nanu kriyāpradhāne'sminnākhyāte sādhanaṃ kathaṃ viśeṣaṇena sambandhamapradhānaṃ paṭhyeta ? ucyate;
ekārthībhāvamāpannaṃ vṛttau yadupasarjanam |
viśeṣaṇena sambandhastasya naivopapadyate ||
na hi bhavati---ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa iti | yasya tu naikārthībhāvastadapradhānamapi viśeṣaṇena saṃyujyate, yathā---ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣa iti | evaṃ sādhanaṃ kriyāṃ prati guṇabhūtamapyekārthībhāvādviśeṣaṇena yujyate, tathā sādhanapradhāneṣu kṛdanteṣu kriyā guṇabhūtā'pi viśeṣaṇena yujyate---dāruṇamadhyāyaka iti | yathaiva tahi sādhanasya viśeṣaṇena yogaḥ, evaṃ kriyāntareṇāpi prāpnoti---pacati paṭhati, pacati dṛśyati, pācakaḥ paṭhati, pācakaḥ paśyatītivat ? kiṃ kurmaḥ, na tāvadevaṃ dṛśyate ! tadetadevaṃ pratipattavyam---
bhāryā stryantarasambandhaṃ patyurna sahate yathā |
snānādikaṃ tu saṃskāraṃ svārthamevānumanyate ||
tathā kriyāpi---
viśeṣaṇena sambandhaṃ karttuḥ svasyānumanyate |
svānuraktaṃ tu karttāraṃ na kriyāntaragāminam || iti |
pūtiśceti | tibantaḥ pūtiśabda ādyudāttaḥ | vasestibiti | tib‌ bāhulakātpūño'pi bhavati, bāhulakādeva guṇābhāvaḥ | tasya nighātanimittasyāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi cittvamupasaṅkhyāyate | vibhāṣitamiti | bahvatha tiṅantaṃ vibhāṣā nihanyate, yadā nihanyate tadā pūtirantodāttaḥ |
kriyākutsane ityādi yaduktam, tatra pramāṇatvena bhāṣyapaṭhitāmāryāṃ paṭhati---supi kutsana iti | malopa iṣṭo'tiṅi coktārthamiti | bhāṣye tāvadayamarthaḥ | malopaśceti vārttikakāreṇokte malopastiṅi neṣṭaḥ---dāruṇaṃ pacatīti | ityevaṃ malopaśceti vākyamuktārthamācāryairiti | vṛttau tu ślokāntargatatvādayaṃ pādaḥ paṭhito na tvatrāsyopayogaḥ kaścit; `samāse caitadanudāttatvamiṣyate' ityuktatvāt ||
gatirgatau || 8.1.70 ||
abhyuddharatīti | sarvopasargasādhāraṇī haraṇakriyā pratīyate, tāmudviśinaṣṭi uddharatīti | udaivordhvatā viśiṣṭā'vagamyata tāmabhirviśinaṣṭi abhyaddharatīti | tatra---
anyo'nyāpekṣayā nāsti gatitvaṃ yadyapi dvayoḥ |
kriyāṃ prati gatitvāttu nihato'bhirgatirgatau ||
samudānayatīti | atra samudordvayorapi nighātaḥ | abhisamparyāharatīti | atra trayāṇām ||
gatāviti kimiti | kriyāṃ prati gatirbhavati, kriyā ca dhātuvācyā | dhātuśca dvividhaḥ---sagatiḥ, agatiśca | pratyayā api dhātordvaye bhavanti---kṛtaḥ, tiṅaśca | tatra kṛdante sagatāvagatau ca kṛtsvarathāthādisvareṣu kṛteṣu śeṣanighātena gatirnihanyata eva | tiṅante'pi kevale udāttavati tāvaduttarasūtreṇa bhavatyeva nighātaḥ, anudāttettu niyamāśrayaṇānna bhaviṣyati, tiṅante yadi bhavati udāttavatyeva bhavati, tataśca sagatireva tiṅavaśiṣyate iti praśnaḥ | āmandrairiti | nanu ca kriyāyoge gatibhavati, na cātrāṅaḥ kriyāyogo'sti, mandraśabdasyākriyāvācitvāt ? ata āha---yāhītyetatpratīti | `te prāgdhātoḥ' iti prayoganiyamaḥ, na saṃjñāniyamaḥ, tataśca vyavahitaprayoge'pi gatitvamastyeveti bhāvaḥ | nanu yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavanti, tataśca yāhītyetatprati gatitvena mandraṃ pratyagatitvādaprasaṅgaḥ, ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti---abhyuddharatīti, udaṃ pratyagatitvāt ? mā bhūdudaṃ prati gatiḥ, samudāyaṃ tu prati gatirbhavati, udā viśiṣṭā hi kriyā abhinā viśeṣyate | ā mandrairityatrāpi mandrādikaraṇakamindrakartṛkaṃ yānamāṅā viśeṣyata iti samudāyaṃ kriyāviśeṣavācinaṃ pratyāṅo gatitvānnighātaḥ prāpnoti ? na prāpnoti ; pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate paścātsādhanena, āyāne hi mandrādeḥ sādhanatvaṃ mandrairharibhirāyāhīti, na tu yāne; tataśca na samudāyaṃ pratyāṅo gatitvamiti nāstyevātra prasaṅgaḥ | tatrāha---tasyeti | na hi paranimittānupādāne `yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati' iti gamyate, tataśca vastuto gatitvāśrayo nighātaḥ syāditi manyate |
yadi punaḥ `padasya' ityadhikārātsamarthaparibhāṣopasthānādyena gateḥ sāmarthyaṃ taṃ prati gateriti vijñāyate, tadā śakyaṃ gatāvityavaktum, yadāha---`gateranudāttatve gatigrahaṇānararthakyam, tiṅyavadhāraṇācchando'rthamiti cennāgatitvāt' iti ||
tiṅi codāttavati || 8.1.71 ||
udāharaṇe `nīpātairyadyadi' iti nighātapratiṣedhāttiṅantamudāttavat | tiṅ‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham ? tiṅante yathā syāt, mandraśabde mā bhūt‌---ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi | mandraśabdo rakpratyayānto'ntodāttaḥ |
nanu ca `yatkriyāyuktāḥ' iti vacanādgatiśabdaḥ pitrādiśabdavat sambandhiśabdatvāt svasambandhinamākṣipatīti kriyāvācinyevodāttavapi bhaviṣyati kṛdante cātiprasaṅgābhāvaḥ pūrvasūtre evoktaḥ, tasmānnārthastiṅagrahaṇena ? ityāśaṅkyāha---tiṅ‌grahaṇamiti | parimāṇam-iyattā | parimāṇārthatvameva spaṣṭayati---anyathā hīti | akriyamāṇe tiṅ‌grahaṇe dhātureva kriyāvācitvād gatisaṃjñānimittamiti tatraivodāttavati nighātaḥ syāt, na tu pratyaye | tiṅ‌grahaṇāttu prakṛtibhāgaṃ prati gateḥ pratyayodāttatvenāpyudāttavati tiṅantamātre bhavati | dhātumeva prati gatisaṃjñeti | yasya kriyā yatkriyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yasya vācyā kriyā taṃ pratītyarthaḥ | dhātoreva cāsau vācyeti tameva prati gatitvam |
āmante tarhi na prāpnotīti | nanu cākriyamāṇe'pi tiṅ‌grahaṇe naivāmante prāpnoti, yadā hi tiṅante'pi pratyayodāttatvenodāttavati na syāditi sthitam, tadā kā vārtā āmante ! tatkimucyate---āmante tarhīti ? evaṃ tarhyayamatrārthaḥ---yadi tiṅ‌grahaṇādyatnātprakarotītyādau bhavati, tarhi tasyāmante'bhāvānna prāpnoti; tasmādyā kriyā yatkriyā---iti karmadhāraya āśrayaṇīyaḥ | evaṃ hi kriyālakṣaṇamarthaṃ prati gatitvam, tatrārthe kāryasyāsambhavāttadvācini kāryaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ kriyāpradhāne sarvatra sidhyatīti | anantaroktaṃ codyaṃ pakṣaviśeṣe vyavasthāpayitumāha---atra keciditi | atra pakṣe gatikārakopapadānāmityasyāyamarthaḥ---gatyādīnāmaviśeṣeṇa samāso bhavati, kṛddhistu prāk subutpatteriti | avyayapūvapadaprakṛtisvaratve iti | `gatikārakopapadāt' ityatra prapacatideśyādyarthaṃ kṛd‌grahaṇaṃ sthitam, na pratyākhyātamiti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasyaivātra prasaṅga iti manyate | akriyamāṇe'pi tiṅ‌grahahaṇa iti | yathā vā kriyamāṇe tiṅ‌grahaṇe udāttattve sati nighātaḥ sidhyati, tathā'nantaramevoktam |
atha tarabantasyeti | yathāyaṃ pakṣaḥ sambhavati, yaścātra pakṣe doṣaḥ---tatsarvam `gatikārakopapātkṛt' ityatraivoktam |
yeṣāṃ tvityādi | kugatyādīnāṃ kṛdantenaiva, tatrāpi prāk subutpatterityarthaḥ | tadarthaṃ yatnaḥ karttavya iti | tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ---tiṅagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate; yā kriyā, yatkriyeti vā''śrayiṣyata iti |
āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat || 8.1.72 ||
kimadamavidyamānavat ? ityāha---tasminsatītyādi | tatra tasminsati yatkāryaṃ tanna bhavatītyatrodāharaṇamāha---āmantritatiḍanighāteti | asati ca yatkāryaṃ tadbhavatītyatrodāharaṇamāha---pūjāyāmityādi | āmantritādyudāttatve karttavye iti | asati pūrvagrahaṇe `āmantritamavidyamānavat' tyucyamāne svasyādyudāttatve'pi ṣāṣṭhike kartavye'vidyamānavat syāt, ka idānīṃ tasyāvakāśaḥ ? yatrāvidyamānavadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate, vikalpyate vā; tathā `apādādau' vityadhikārātpādādirapyavakāśaḥ---uṣo no adhaṣu havā vyucchanan, nasbhāvo hyatrāvidyamānavadbhāvādeva bhavati; indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam, tvādeśo bhavati | evaṃ tu indra piba tulyaṃ suto madāya, indra piba vṛṣabhūtasya vṛṣṇaḥ, agne yāhi śastribhiḥ, vāyo yāhi śivādiva---ityādau tiṅ‌nighātaḥ prāpnoti ? karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ, uktaṃ hi purastāt---`āpādaparisamāpterapādādāvityadhikāraḥ' iti |
yadi `āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' devadatta pacasītyatra pacasītyetadapekṣavā devadattaśabdasya pūrvatvamastītyavidyamānavattve sati āmantritādyudāttatvaṃ na syādityata āha---pūrvatvaṃ ceti | pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvādyaṃ prati pūrvatvaṃ tatkāryaṃ pratyevāvidyamānavattvam, na svakāryaṃ prati; tena nāyaṃ doṣa ityarthaḥ | kāryaśabdenaitaddarśayati---avidyamānavat kāryamatrātidiśyate | tatra pūrvaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvena parasya kārye karttavya ityetāvadāśrīyate, na tu paraṃ pratyavidyamānavat; pūrvaṃ tu prati vidyamānavadityartha iti syāt | imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvatītyatra gaṅgeśabdasya yamuneśabdaṃ pratyevāvidyamānavattvaṃ na meśabdaṃ pratīti vyavadhānād yamuneśabdasya nighātaṃ prati meśabdo nimittaṃ na syāt | yathopadarśite tvarthe, parasya kārye karttavye ityetāvattatkāryaṃ svanimittamanyanimittaṃ veti viśeṣābhāvād meśabdāpekṣe'pi nighāte gaṅgeśabdasyāvidyamānavattvaṃ sidhyati | tadetat svanimitte'nyanimitte cetyatra sūcitam |
tadevamuktaṃ darśayati---ihetyādi | gaṅgeśabdo'vidyamānavattvātsvayaṃ nimittaṃ na bhavatītvetāvat, na tu meśabdasya nimittabhāvaṃ pratibadhnātītyarthaḥ | paraṃ pratyavidyamānavadbhavatītyāśrīyamāṇe hi tathā syāt |
nanu vatkaraṇamantareṇāpi `goto ṇit' ityādāvatideśo dṛśyate, tatkimatra vatkaraṇena ? nanvasati vatkaraṇe `pūrvamāmantritamavidyamānam' ityucyamāne pūrvasyāmantratasya nivṛttiḥ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; arthapratyayanāya śabdaprayogādanivṛtte'rthe śabdanivṛttyabhāvāt | athāpi paraprayogo bhavatu, pūrvaprayogo mā bhūdityarthaḥ kalpeta ? tathāpi rājadantādiṣu paramāmantritaṃ veti vaktavyaṃ syāt | paramevāmantritaṃ bhavati, na pūrvamityarthaḥ | tadevamantareṇāpi vatimatideśaḥ siddhaḥ ? idaṃ tarhi prayojanam---svāśrayamapi yathā syāt---āṃ bo devadatta `āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike' ityekāntaratā yathā syāt | ekavacanāntaṃ hyuttarasūtrasya viṣayaḥ, bahuvacanānte tu `vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam' iti pakṣe nighātaprasaṅgaḥ | yadyapyatideśikakāryāviruddhaṃ svāśrayamatideśepyavasatyapi vatkaraṇe bhavati, iha tu vatkaraṇādyatnādviruddhamapi kvacitprāpyate | avidyamānavattvavirodhinī hyekāntaratā | vyākhyānāccātiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ ||
nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe sāmānyavacanam || 8.1.73 ||
dvau nañau prakṛtamarthaṃ sūcayata ityāha---ki tarhi vidyamānavadeveti | māṇavaka jaṭilakādhyāpaketi | atra jaṭilaśabdo māṇavakaśabdāpekṣayā viśeṣavacanaḥ, adhyāpakaśabdāpekṣayā tu sāmānyavacana iti dvayorapyavidyamānavattvaṃ na bhavati | pūrvasyetyādinā pratiṣedhasya phalaṃ darśayati | devadattayajñadatteti | `sāmānyavacanaṃ viśeṣavacanāpekṣam' iti vakṣyatyuttarasūtre, tataśca yathā yajñadattaśabdaḥ samānādhikaraṇo na bhavati, evaṃ pūrvāmantritārthagataviśeṣākāravacano'pi na bhavatīti devadattaśabdo'pi sāmānyavacano na bhavati, tasmād dvyaṅgavikalatvāccintyamet | evaṃ hyuktamiti | taittirīyake brāhmaṇe sahasratamīṃ prakṛtya iḍe rante'dite sarasvati priye preyasi mahi viśrute---etāni te aghniye nāmānīti | vṛttau tvanyathā pāṭhaḥ śākhāntare draṣṭavyaḥ ||
vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane || 8.1.74 ||
bahuvacanamiti vārttike darśanāt prakṣiptam | śaraṇatvena prāptiḥ śaraṇam, tatra sādhavaḥ śaraṇyāḥ | śaraṇaśabdo hi śaraṇye'pi dṛśyate---śaraṇaṃ bhavantamatikāstraṇakamiti | śarmaṇyā iti pāṭhe śarmaṇi sādhavaḥ śarmaṇyāḥ |
sāmānvavacanādhikārādeveti | sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣatvādyaṃ prati sāmānyamityetadbhavati, tasminviśeṣavacana eva bhaviṣyati ||
