pūrvatrāsiddham || 8.2.1 ||
pūrvatrāsiddhamityayamadhikāra iti | yadi tu svatantro vidhiḥ syāt, tato vakṣyamāṇasya tripādīlakṣaṇasamudāyasya pūrvatra sapādasaptādhyāyīlakṣaṇe samudāye'siddhatvamuktaṃ syāt, na tu tripādyāṃ pūrvatra parasyāsiddhatvamāpāditaṃ syāt; tataśca guḍaliṇmān, godhuṅ‌mānityādau ḍhatvaghatvāderasiddhatvābhāvāt `jhayaḥ' iti matupo vatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmānna vidhiḥ | atha paribhāṣā syāt, sarvatraivāṣṭādhyāyyāṃ pūrva prati parasyāsiddhatvāt tena, taiḥ, tasya---ityādāvinādiṣu karttavyeṣu tyadādyatvasyāsiddhatvādakārāntanimittā inādayo na syuḥ | tasmād‌---adhikāraḥ | evaṃ sati yadanena sampāditaṃ bhavati taddarśayati---tatreti | tatrādhikāre satītyarthaḥ | adhikāre hi tripādīgatānāmapyaviśeṣeṇa sapādasaptādhyāyīgatānpratyasiddhatvaṃ tripādyaṃ ca pūrvatra parasyāsiddhatvaṃ siddhyati | vidhau tu naitāvatsampādayituṃ śakyam; tripādyāṃ pūrvatra parasyāsiddhatvānāpādanāt | paribhāṣāyāṃ ca naitāvati paryavasyati; sarvatraiva prasaṅgāt | tasmādadhikāratvādetāvatsanpadyate | etāvadeva ca sampadyata ityarthaḥ | na caivamatra bhramitavyam---yeyaṃ sapādasaptādhyāyī anukrāntetyanena vidhirūpeṇa pravṛttirdarśitā, ita uttaramityā dinā tvadhikārarūpeṇa, tataśca śeṣa itivallakṣaṇaṃ cādhikāraśceti ? niṣprayojanatvād, adhikāro'yamityuktatvācca | kiṃ hi nāmādhikāra evāsminna sidhyati, yadartho vidhirāśrīyate ! saptānāmadhyāyānāṃ sāmāhāraḥ saptādhyāyī, sapādācāsau saptādhyāyī ceti karmadhārayaḥ, sapādeti ṭābantapāṭhe tvasamāsaḥ | uttarauttaro yoga iti pāṭhaḥ;vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacane subluko'sambhavāt | atrādhyāyagrahaṇena yogagrahaṇena ca śāstrāsiddhatvamāśrīyata iti darsayati | etacca pūrvatreti vacanāllabhyate | śāstrasya hi mukhyaṃ pūrvatvam; sanniveśaviśeṣayogitvāt | kāryasya tu śāstradvārakamaupacārikam, na hi mukhye sambhavati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam | kathaṃ punaruccaritaṃ śāstramasiddhamityucyate, na hi vacanaśatenāpi siddhamapi asiddhaṃ bhavati ? ata āha---siddhakāyaṃ na karotītyartha iti | vacanādatideśa āśrīyata ityarthaḥ | śāstrāsyāsiddhatvamāśrīyate, na kāryasyeti darśitam |
tatra prayojanamāha---tadetaditi | yadidaṃ śāstraviṣayamasiddhavacanaṃ tadetadityarthaḥ | ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya kāryasya tasya pratiṣedhārthamutsṛjyate ādeśena nivartata iti utsargaḥ-sthānī, sa lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tasya bhāvaḥ pravṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ cāsiddhavacanam | kāryāsiddhatve tūtsargalakṣaṇasya bhāvo na na sidhyati | tatrādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇamāha---asmā uddharetyādi | āyāvoḥ kṛtayoḥ `lopaḥ śakalyasya' iti lopaḥ | vyalopasyāsiddhatvāditi | śāstradvārakaṃ vyalopasyāsiddhatvam | yadā hi pūrvaśāstrasannidhau paraśāstramasiddham, tadā tatpratipāditaṃ kāryaṃ sutarāmasiddhaṃ bhavati | utsargalakṣaṇabhāvasyodāharaṇamāha--amuṣmai iti | atrāsatyasiddatve paratvād `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' ityutve satyata iti smāyādayo na syuḥ | asiddhatve tu pūrvaṃ smādayaḥ, paścādutvamiti siddhamiṣṭam | utvasyeti | utvaśāstrasyetyarthaḥ |
śuṣkiketyādiślokaḥ | atra nidarśanamiti pratyekamabhisambadhyate | nidarśanamudāharaṇadigityarthaḥ | matorvatve karttavye `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' iti jaśtve'siddhe sati guḍaliṇmāniti darśanam |
na kopadhāyā iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na bhavatīti | kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇamityetanāśrityedaṃ prayojanamuktam | kṣāmimāniti | `kṣāyo maḥ' iti niṣṭhātakārasya matvam, tataḥ `ata iñ‌' iti iñantād `ata iniṭhanau' itīn, tadantādvā matup |
vaherityādi | `vaha prāpaṇe', niṣṭhā, samprasāraṇam, `ho ḍhaḥ', `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', ṣṭutvam, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ', `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ', ūḍha iti sthite ṇici ṭilopaḥ, luṅ‌, ccheścaṅ‌ | hataityetad‌ dvirucyate iti | `ajādervitīyasya' iti vacanāt, tataḥ `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ', `kuhoścuḥ', iti cutvam---hakārasya jhakāraḥ, tasya `abhyāse carca' iti jaśtvaṃ jākaraḥ | athātra `sanvallaghuni' itītvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tatrāha--anaglopa iti vacanāditi | kathaṃ punaraujiḍhaditi bhavati ? ityata āha---anaglopa iti vacanāditi | kathaṃ punaraujiḍhaditi bhavati ? ityata āha---aujiḍhadityetattviti | pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' ityetattviha pravarttate; anisyatvāt | anityatvaṃ ca `ubhau sābhyāsasya' iti vacanādvijñāyate, anyathā `aniteḥ' iti ṇatve kṛte tasya siddhatvāt saha ṇakāreṇa dvirvacane sati siddhaṃ syāt---prāṇiṇivatīti |
guḍaliṇmāniti | guḍaṃ leḍhīti kvip, tadantānmatup, ḍhatvajaśtvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ `yaro'nunāsikatve taddhite bhāṣāyāṃ nityavacanam' iti ṇakāraḥ |
ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśā iti | `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' ityādayaḥ, pañcamīnirdeśāḥ `hrasvādaṅgāt' ityādayaḥ, saptamīnirdeśāḥ `jhalo jhali' ityādayalasteṣām | asiddhatvaṃ na bhavatīti | yadi syāt `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' ityatra `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā ityetasyābhāvāttaccheṣasya `alo|ñantyasya' ityasyāpravṛtteḥ sarvasya padasya lopaprasaṅgaḥ; `hrasvādaṅgāt' ityatrāpyaniyamena dikśabdādhyāhārātpūrvasya parasya ca lopaprasaṅgaḥ; `jhalo jhali' ityatrāpyaupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe saptamī vijñāyeteti pūrvaparayoraviśeṣeṇa prasaṅgaḥ, satsaptamīvijñāne tu vyavahitasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ pūrvāsu paribhāṣāsu kartavyāsu teṣāmasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati ? ata āha---kāryakālaṃ hīti | saṃjñāparibhāṣamiti samāhāradvandvaḥ | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---
saṃjñāḥ parārthā atyantaṃ paribhāṣāśca tadvidhāḥ |
na svātantryeṇa tāstasmāt kāryāvagatihetavaḥ ||
anekasya pradhānasya śeṣabhūtā bhavantviti |
etāḥ kevalamācāryaḥ pṛthandeśā upādiśat ||
vidhivākyaistu saṃhatya yatra tatra sthitairapi |
bodhayantyaḥ svakāryāṇi naikapūrvāḥ parā imāḥ || iti |
yadi kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam, `vipratiṣedhe param' ityeṣāpi paribhāṣātropatiṣṭheta, tataśca visphoryam, avagoryamityatra guṇaṃ bādhitvā paratvāt `hali ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ syāt ? ityata āha--vipratiṣedhe paramityeṣā tviti | eṣā tu na pravarttata iti sambandhaḥ | madhye heturyeneti | vipratiṣedho hi tasyā nimittam | kaśca vipratiṣedhaḥ ? dvayostulyabalayorekasminviṣaye tvaṃ cāhaṃ ceti pravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ | na cāyamatra sanbhavati, tasmānnimittābhāvānna pravarttata ityathaḥ | yadyevam, apavādo'pi paraḥ pūrvamutsaga na bādheta ? ata āha---apavādasyeti | yadyapavādasyāsiddhatvādutsarga eva syāt, apavādavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt ||
nalopaḥ supsvarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣu kṛti || 8.2.2 ||
atra sūtre, uttarasūtre ca kāryopādānāt kārye kāryasyāsiddhatvamucyate | `kṛti' ityetattu sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ tugvidhinaiva sambadhyate | vidhiśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, karmasādhanaśca; tatra bhāvasādhanānāṃ trayāṇāṃ karmasādhanasya caikasyaikaśeṣaḥ; bhinnārthānāmapi sarūpāṇāmekaseṣavacanāt | vidhiśca vidhiśca vidhiśca vidhayaḥ, tato bahuvacanāntena vidhiśabdena subādīnāṃ dvandvasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | sarvatra ca śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī | tatra subvidhau śeṣa eva śeṣaḥ, itareṣu tu karma śeṣatvena vivakṣitam | tadidamuktam---vidhiśabdo'yamityādi | sambandhasāmānyaṣaṣṭhyanteneti | sambandhasāmānyamucyate ṣaṣṭhyā, tadantenetyarthaḥ | sāmānyaśabdena sthāneyogavyavacchedaḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' iti paribhāṣāyāṃ satyāṃ sāmānyavacanatā labhyate ? ucyate; nātra supaḥ sthāne kiñcidvidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anuvādo'yam---supo yo vidhistatreti | anuvāde ca paribhāṣā na pravarttate; `udīcāmātaḥ sthāne' iti sthānegrahaṇālliṅgāt | sambandhasāmānyavacanaṣaṣṭhyanteneti yaduktam, tatra prayojanamāha---supāṃ sthāna ityādi | sarvo'sau subvidhiriti | sarvasya supsambandhitvātsubarthameva cedaṃ vidhigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | svarādiṣu tu nārthaḥ; tena yathā `na mu ne' ityatra nābhāve karttavye ityarthī bhavati, tathā svarādiṣu karttavyeṣvityartho bhaviṣyati | dvandvātparasya tu pratyekaṃ sambandho durnivāra iti bhāvasādhanatvamaṅgīkṛtam | `subvidhisvarasaṃjñātukṣu' ityucyamāne tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam |
rājavatīti | matubantād `ugitaśca' iti ṅīp, rājaśabdaḥ kaninpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ | pañcārmamiti | `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām' iti samāsaḥ, tatra nalope kṛte pūrvapadamavarṇāntaṃ jātamiti svaraḥ prāpto'siddhatvānna bhavati, samāsodāttatvameva bhavati |
pañcadaṇḍīti | samāhāradviguḥ | nalopasyāsiddhatvāt ṣṇāntā ṣaḍiti ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā bhavatīti | etacca yattatroktam---`astagrahaṇamaupadeśikapratipattyartham' iti, tadanāśrityoktaṃ draṣṭavyam | na ṣaṭ‌svastrādibhya iti ṭāpaḥ pratiṣedho bhavatīti | atra hi nāntatvādāpprāptaḥ, so'pi niṣidhyate; `striyāṃ yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati' iti sāmānyena niṣedhavidhānāt | tadetatprayojanaṃ kathaṃ bhavatīti | pākṣikatvaṃ prayojanasya darśayituṃ praśnaḥ | keṣāñciddarśanam---anārabhya kāryaviśeṣamādau tāvatsaṃjñā kriyate, tato yasyāṃ daśāyāṃ yatkāryaṃ prāptaṃ tatkriyate lokavat, tadyathā---loke daśamyāmutthitāyāṃ putrasya nāma dadhātīti sakṛtkṛtayā saṃjñayā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi kriyante, na tu pratikāryaṃ nāma kurvanti, tadvaditi | ayaṃ ca `yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam' iti pakṣaḥ | kāryakālapakṣe tu tenatena vidhivākyenekavākyatāpannena saṃjñāsūtreṇa saṃjñā praṇīyata iti pratikāryaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttiḥ | tatrādye darśane jaśśasorlugarthā yā saṃjñā tayaiva ṭāppratiṣedhasyāpi siddhatvānnedaṃ prayojanam, dvitīye tu pakṣe bhavati prayojanamityāha---yadi pratikāryamiti | kathaṃ tadā prayojanam ? ityāha---yā hīti | jaśśasorlugartheti | upalakṣaṇametat, ṅīppratiṣedhārthetyapi draṣṭavyam | strīpratyayasyeti | ṭāpa ityarthaḥ | atha prathame pakṣe na karttavyaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇam, iha hi---daṇḍiguptau, guptadaṇḍināviti nalope kṛte daṇḍiśabdasya ghisaṃjñā prāpnoti, tataśca tasyaiva pūrvanipātaḥ syāt; nalopasyāsiddhatvāddhi saṃjñāyā abhāvādaniyamaḥ pūrvanipātasya bhavati |
atra ke cadityādi | supaḥ sannipātena nalopaḥ, sa yadi tukaṃ pravarttayet tatsannipātaṃ vihanyāt | kathaṃ punaḥ sannipātasya vighātaḥ, yāvatā pūrvāntastuk sa tuggrahaṇena gṛhyate ? satyam; hrasvamātrabhaktastugityāśrityedamuktam | bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvena veti | bahirbhūtavibhaktyapekṣo nalopo'ntarbhūtakvibapekṣe tukyasiddho bhavatītyarthaḥ |
paribhāṣādvaysāpyanityatvaṃ jñāpayitumiti | tatra sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvād vṛkṣāyetyādau `supi ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ bhavati | bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyāstvanityatvād eṣā, dve ityatra vibhaktyāśrayaṃ tyadādyatvaṃ bahiraṅgamapi prātipadikāśraye ṭāpi na siddhaṃ bhavati |
vṛtrahacchatramiti | nātra sannipātalakṣaṇo nalopaḥ, nāpi nalopasya bahiraṅgatvam; tuko'pi chakārāpekṣatvāt | rājīyatīti | `kyaci ca' itītvam | rājāyata iti | `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | rājāśva iti | `akaḥ savarṇa dīrghaḥ' ||
na mu ne || 8.2.3 ||
`mu' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | ghilakṣaṇo nābhāvo na syāditi | yadyetannārabhyeteti śeṣaḥ | anena sūtrārambhasya prayojanamuktam | kṛte tu nābhāve ityādi | yadyatra dīrghatvaṃ syāt bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātīti, yathā---amūbhyāmityādau dīrghasya sthānino dīrghokāro bhavati, tathātrāpyākārasya dīrghokāraḥ syāt, tataśca hrasvasannipātakṛto nābhāvastaṃ vihanyāditi bhāvaḥ | atra codayanti---mubhāvasya siddhatvātkila dīrghaprasaṅgaścodyate, tat kiṃ mubhāvamapaśyad dīrghaśāstraṃ ghilakṣaṇaṃ nābhāvamapi na paśyati, vṛkṣādiśabdasthānīyaṃ hyetaddīrghaśāstraṃ prati, tataśca yañāderabhāvātkathamatra dīrghaprasaṅga iti ? atrāhuḥ---prayoge tāvannābhāvaḥ śrūyate, śāstramapi tasya siddhakāṇḍe paṭhitam, kevalaṃ tannidānabhūtaṃ mubhāvameva dīrghaśāstraṃ na paśyatiṃ, tanmā drākṣīt, nābhāvaṃ tāvatpaśyati, tataśca dīrghatvaṃ pravarttayediti |
atha veti | yathā kaścitkuśalamatiḥ kiñjātīyo dhāvati, kiṃvarṇo dhāvati---ityekenānekena vā pṛṣṭastantreṇa prativakti---śveto dhāvatīti; tathātrāpi yogadvayametat; tatraikaṃ ne karttavye mutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ niṣedhati, aparaṃ ne parato yatprāptaṃ tatra | tadidamuktam---ubhayārthamiti | tantraṇeti | sādhāraṇaṃ bhavettantram, yathā---tulyakakṣayorbhuñjānayoḥ pradīpaḥ, iha tu sādhāraṇaprayatnastantram |
idānīmekasminneva yoge yathobhayaṃ sādhyate, tathā darśayati---atha veti | arthātsaṃgṛhītamiti | vṛddhakumārīvākyavat, tadyathā---vṛddhakumārīndreṇoktā varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti sā varamavṛṇot---putrā me bahukṣīraghṛtamannaṃ kāṃsyapātryāṃ bhuñjīranniti, patireva tāvadasyā na bhavati kutaḥ putrāḥ, kuto gāvaḥ, kuto dhānyam ! anenaiva khalvekavākyena patiḥ putrāḥ gāvo dhānyamiti sarvaṃ vṛtaṃ bhavati; tadvadatrāpi ne parato yatkāryaṃ tatra karttavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvasya pratiṣedhaṃ bruvatā nābhāve'pi karttavye'rthānmutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ bhavati |
ekādeśasvaro'ntaraṅga iti | ekādeśasvare catvāri darśanāni---udāttānudāttayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ svarito'bhinirvṛttasya sthāne' ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' ityanenodāttaguṇādeśaḥ kriyata ityekaṃ darśanam | tathaivābhinivṛtta ekādeśasvare svaritaguṇamātrasyodāttamātraṃ vidhīyata iti dvitīyaṃ darśanam | tṛtīyaṃ tu darśanam `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' iti paribhāṣā ekādeśavidhiṣūpatiṣṭhate; tatrāyamartho bhavati---ād‌guṇo bhavati, udāttānudāttayostvād‌guṇa udātta iti; evaṃ satyekādeśo vidhīyamāna evodātto bhavati | caturthadarśanamudāttānudāttayorekādeśaḥ svaritaguṇaḥ prāpta udātto bhavatīti | tatra yenanāprāptinyāyena svaritatvāpavāda udāttavidhiḥ sampadyate, tatra paribhāṣāpakṣe siddhamudāttatvamayādiṣu | itareṣu tu pakṣeṣu asiddhatve prāpte siddhatvamucyate, āntaryato'yādeśa udātto yathā syāditi, anyathā svaritaḥ syāt |
kumāryā idamiti | kumāraśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tasmād `vayasi prathame' iti ṅīp‌, `yasyeti ca' iti lopaḥ, `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' iti ṅīpa udāttatvaṃ caturthyekavacanam, kumārī-e iti sthite' āṇnadyāḥ' ityāṭ‌, yaṇādeśaḥ, `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' ityāṭa udāttatvam, `āṭaśca' iti vṛddhirekādeśaḥ, sa āntaryataḥ svaritaḥ prasaktaḥ `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' ityanenodāttaḥ kriyate, tatsiddhatvaṃ vaktavyam--ayādeśa udātto yathā syāt | yadītyādi | pūrvamudāttatvaṃ kriyate paścādekādheśaḥ | yathānantaraṃ darśitaṃ tadā bhavatīdaṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | atha tvityādi | kumāryā e iti sthite `āṭaśca' iti vṛddhiśca prāpnoti, `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' iti āṭaḥ svaraśca, dvāvapyanityau; svaraḥ śabdāntaraprāpteranityaḥ, sa hi prāgākārasya prāpnoti kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhāvaikārasya, vṛddhirapi prāganudāttayoḥ paratvātsvare, āṭastu svare kṛte udāttānudāttayoḥ svarabhinnasya prāpnuvanvidhiranityo bhavati, ubhayoranityayoḥ paratvātsvare prāpte varṇāśrayatvenāntaraṅgatvādvaddhiḥ, svarastu vibhakterucyamānaḥ padāśrayo bahiraṅgaḥ |
gāṅge'nūpa iti | gaṅgāyā idamityaṇ, pratyayasvareṇontodāttaḥ, tato ṅiḥ, suptvādanudāttaḥ, tayorekādeśa udāttaḥ | āpo'nugatamanūpamiti prādisamāsaḥ, avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte `anorapradhānakanīyasī' ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ śeṣanighātaḥ | tasya siddhatvādityādi | ekādeśasvarasya siddhatve `eṅaḥ padāntādati' ityayamekādeśa udāttena saha bhavati | tataśca `svarito vānudātte padādau' iti pakṣe svaritaḥ pakṣe udātto bhavati | yadi tvasiddhatvaṃ syāt, tadāsāvekāra udāttānudāttasthānikatvādāntaryataḥ svaritaḥ syāt | tathā ca sati tasya `eṅaḥ padāntādati' ityayamekādeśa udāttena na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? `svaritena' iti pakṣe svarito na syāt | api tu svaritānudāttayoḥ sthāne bhavannāntaryato nityameva svaritaḥ syāt | sa udāttenetyata iti pāṭhaḥ, sa ekādeśa udāttena sahetyato hetorityarthaḥ |
śatṛsvara iti | tudivadinadibhyo laṭ‌, tasya śatrāśrayo nadyajādyoḥ svaraḥ śatṛsvaraḥ, `śaturanumo nadyajādī' ityatra `antodāttāduttarapadāt' ityantodāttāduttarapadādītyanuvartate | tudatī, nudatīti | tudinudibhyāṃ laṭa, śatrādeśaḥ, `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ', pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ | anuma iti pratiṣedho jñāpaka iti | tena naitadarthaṃ siddhatvaṃ vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | kathametat jñāpakam ? ityāha---nadīti | anuma iti pratiṣedha syetatprayojanam---nudantītyatra `ācchīnadyornum' iti yadā num bhavati, tadā mā bhūditi | asiddhe caikādāśasvare'ntodātatvābhāvādeva śatṛ na bhaviṣyati, kimanuma iti pratiṣedhena ! pratiṣedhāttu siddhatvamanumīyate | nanu yatra lasārvadhātukānudāttatvasya nimittaṃ nāsti, tadarthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; yāntī, vāntītyatra hi dhātupratyayorudāttayorāntaryata ekādeśa udāttaḥ, sa ca śatṛsvare siddhaḥ ? atrāpi pratyayasvare sati tadanantarameva dhātoḥ śeṣanighāto bhavati, tataścātrāpi nāntareṇaikādeśasvaramantodāttatvaṃ bhavati |
ekānudāttatvamiti | evaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭasya yadanudāttatvaṃ tadekānudāttattvam | bhāṣye tvekānanudāttamiti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāpi `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' ityayameva svaro vivakṣitaḥ, tatra hi `ekamevānudāttamanyatsarvamudāttam' ityucyate | tathā ca tatroktam---`siddhaṃ tvekānanudāttatvāt' iti | tudantīti | śavikaraṇa udāttaḥ, lasārvadhātukamanudāttam, tayorekādeśaḥ | aneneti | ekādeśasvareṇa siddhena | varjyamānateti | `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' ityasyārtho lakṣyate | yadi tvasiddhatvaṃ syāt, tato'satyāṃ varjyamānatāyāṃ dvayorudāttayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt | nanu codāttasyāsiddhatve'piyo'sāvudāttānudāttayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ svarito'bhinirvṛttastadāśrayā varjyamānatā bhaviṣyati ? satyam; siddhyati yadā svaritasyodātto bhavatīti pakṣaḥ, yadā tu svaritāpavāda udātto vidhīyate tadā tasyāsiddhatvāt sthāninaśca svarāntarābhāvātkena varjyamānatā syāt ! tasmātsiddhatvamucyate | na ca kāryakālapakṣāśrayeṇa paribhāṣāntaravadvajyamānaparibhāṣāyā api tripādyāṃ pravṛttiḥ śakyābhyupagantum; atiprasaṅgāt | `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya', `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' ityatrāpi śeṣanighātaprasaṅgāt | yathā tu yāntītyatra prāgevaikādeśāccheṣanighāto bhavati, tathātrāpītyaprayojanamityāhuḥ |
brāhmaṇāstudantīti | atrāpi svaritatvāpavāda udāttatvamiti darśane siddhatvamucyate, anyathodāttasyānudāttatvābhāvādudāttaḥ prayoge śrūyeta | bahariraṅgasyāsiddhatvameva bhavatīti | `asiddha bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityanena | pacatīti | itiśabdo nipātatvādādyudāttaḥ | atra bāhyapadāpekṣatvādādekādeśasya bahiraṅgatvāttatsvaro'pi bahiraṅgaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāttena varjyamānatā na bhavati | prapacatīti | atrāpi `tiṅi codāttavati' iti gatinighāto na bhavati | ubhayatrāpi pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvātprasaṅgaḥ |
hariva iti | yadā `chandasīvanipau' iti vanippratyayaḥ kriyate `vana upasaṃkhyānam' iti, tasya ca rutvam, tadā nārthaḥ siddhavacanena |
alāvīditi | luṅ‌, cleḥ sic, iṭ‌, `astisico'pṛkte' itīṭ‌, sici vṛddhiḥ nanu ca `iṭa īṭi' ityatra iṭa iti ṣaṣṭhī vijñāsyate, na pañcamī, sasyetyanuvartate, tatreḍādeḥ sasya lopo vidhīyamāna iṭo bhaviṣyatīti siddhamalāvīditi ? satyaṃ rūpaṃ siddham; svare tu doṣaḥ syāt---yadi lopenekāro nivartyeta, anudāttasya īṭaḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta, udāttanivṛttisvare lopasyāsiddhatvād | yadā tu sakāramātrasya lope savarṇadīrghatvaṃ tadā sicaścitkaraṇādiḍudātta ityekādeśasvaro bhavati |
vṛkṇa iti | `oditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam | ṣatvasvarapratyayeḍ‌vidhiṣvityasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati---kutvaṃ tu pratīti | kṣībaśabda evodāhriyata iti | kathaṃ punarekameva triṣu vidhiṣūdāharaṇam ? ityata āha---tatra hīti | tatra kvacitpakṣe kiñcit prayojanaṃ pratyudāharaṇamityāha---yadeti | saṃjñāyāmiti vacanam, tatra saṃjñāyāmupamānam' ityataḥ `saṃjñāyām' ityanuvṛtteḥ | eṣa svara iti | ādyudāttatvam | kṣībika iti | `naudvyacaḥ ṣṭhan' |
plutasahito vikāraḥ plutavikāraḥ | agnā3i, paṭā3u iti | agnipaṭuśabdayoḥ sambuddhiguṇe kṛte `eco'pragṛhyasya' ityādinā pūrvasyārdhasyākāraḥ plutaḥ, uttarasya tvidutau | nityastugna prāpnotīti | `padāntādvā' iti dīrghalakṣaṇo vikalpaḥ syāt | cha iti kim ? anyatra plutavikārasyāsiddhatvameva yathā syāt---khalapu brāhmaṇakulam, tatra sambuddhāviha kiñcitrapo iti nyāyena guṇe khalapā-u iti sthite `hrasvasya piti kṛti' iti tug‌ na bhavati | dvividhaṃ cātrāsiddhatvam---bahiraṅgalakṣaṇam, pūrvatrāsiddhamiti ca |
kimartha punariti | sakārasya kvacidapi śravaṇābhāvātpraśnaḥ |
ucicchitīti | `uchī vivāse', tuk, san, iṭ, `ajāderdvitīyasya' iti chisśabdasya dvirvacanam, `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ, chasya `abhyāse carca' iti cakāraḥ |
saṃyyantetyādau `mo'nusvāraḥ', `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' |
padādhikāraścediti | yadi latvādividhipu padasyetyapekṣyate, tadā latvādīnāṃ dvirvacanasya ca samakakṣatvam, anapekṣāyāṃ tu bahiraṅgaṃ dvirvacanamantaraṅgeṣu latvādiṣvasiddhamiti `pūrvatrāsiddham' ityetanna pravarttate iti latvādiṣu kṛteṣu dvirvacanamiti siddhamiṣṭam | galogala iti | `aci vibhāṣā' iti latvam | dogdheti | `vā druha' iti vā ghatvam, tadabhāve `ho ḍhaḥ' | nunna iti | `nudavida' iti vā niṣṭhānatvam | abhina iti | bhiderlaṅ‌, sipi śnami halṅyādilopaḥ, `sipi dhāto rurvā', `daśca' iti vā rutvam, āḍāgamaḥ | mātuḥ ṣvaseti | `mātuḥ piturbhyāmanantarasyām' iti vā ṣatvam | māṣavāpāṇīti | `prātipadikānta' iti vā ṇatvam | vāṅ‌nayanamiti | `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' iti vā gakārasya ṅakāraḥ | vākśayanamiti | `śaścho'ṭi' iti vā chatvam | latvādīnāmityādinā'siddhatve latvādīnāṃ yo doṣastaṃ darśayati---aniṣṭo'pi vikalpaḥ syāditi | pūrvottarayoḥ padayorekatra pravṛttiḥ, aparatrāpravṛttirityeṣo'niṣṭo vikalpaḥ | etatsarvamityādi | yogavibhāgārthameva ca pratiṣedhāśrayaṇam, anyathā lāghavārthamamuneti nipātanamāśrayaṇīyaṃ syāt, tataḥ `mu ne' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ | kimarthamidam ? pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvakhyāpanārtham, tenātiprasaṅgo nodbhāvanīyaḥ ||
udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya || 8.2.4 ||
`udāttasvaritayoḥ' ityanuvāde'pi sthānaṣaṣṭhyeṣā; vyākhyānāt | tena udāttasvaritayoḥ samīpavarttī yo yaṇ tataḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvaṃ na bhavati | sakṛllvyāśā, khalapvyāśā iti | tataḥ parasya saptamyekavacanasya svaritatvamiti | kena ? ityata āha---udāttayaṇ ityaneneti | yo'yamasminsūtre pūrvo bhāgaḥ, tenetyarthaḥ | `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' ityudāttatvaṃ tu na bhavati, `noṅ‌dātvoḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt, āśāśabdaḥ `āśāyā adigākhyā cet' iti antodāttatvādanudāttādiḥ | tatkathamayaṃ svaritayaṇ bhavatīti | na kathañcit, na hyayaṃ svaritamapanīya tatsthāne bhavati | na hi pūrvaṃ śāstraṃ sthānibudhyā ādeśe pravarttate, kiṃ tarhi ? sthāninyeva | yathoktam---`hata ityetad dvirucyate' iti, na punastadvudhyā ḍhaśabdo dvirucyata iti | āśrayāditi | āhāyam---svaritayaṇa iti, na cāsti siddhaḥ svaritaḥ, tatrāśrayāt siddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
evamucyamāne'tiprasaṅgamudbhāvayati---yadyevamiti | dadhyāśeti | daviśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' ityādyudāttaḥ, seṣanighātaḥ, `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' iti tasya svaritatvam, tasyāśrayātsiddhatve sati tatsthānikādapi yaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | tasmādityādi | yata evamāśrayātsiddhatve doṣaḥ, tasmādayameva yaṇsvaro yatā siddho bhavati tathā vaktavyam | tatkatham ? yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate--`udāttayaṇaḥ', udāttayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svarito bhavati; tataḥ `svaritayaṇaḥ;, svaritayaṇaśca parasyānudāttasya svarito bhavati, udāttayaṇa ityeva | tena udāttayaṇa ityevaṃ yo'bhinirvṛttaḥ svaritaḥ, tadyaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | tenāsyaiva svaritasyāśrayātsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yadyevamityādinā yo'tiprasaṅga udbhāvitaḥ, taṃ keṣāñcinmatena pariharati---kecittviti | udāttātsvaritayaṇo pīti | udāttātparo yaḥ svaritaḥ `udāttādanudāttasya' iti vihitaḥ tasya yo yaṇ‌ tasmādapi parasyetyarthaḥ | taittirīyaka iti | tittiriṇā proktamadhīyate taittirīyāḥ, teṣāmāmnāyastaittirīyakam, caraṇalakṣaṇo vuñ‌ | śākhāntara iti | vṛttikāradeśe yā śākhā tadapekṣaṃ śākhāntaratvam | ekaśataṃ hyadhvaryuśākhāḥ, viśeṣavacano vāntaraśabdaḥ | yāste viśvā iti | `yadvṛttānnityam' iti santītyasya nighātapratiṣedhaḥ, agneśabdasyāmantritanighātaḥ | brāhmaṇa iti | tatraiva taittirīyake dadhiśabda uktasvaraḥ, āśayatītyasya tiṅ‌nighātaḥ | nanu cobhayatrāpyatra yaṇādeśe kṛte `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' ityeva svaritaḥ, tathā ca yatra sa pratiṣidhyate `nodāttasvaritodayam' iti, tatra svarito na dṛśyate ca---svasmabhyamābhara pratyagnirupasāmagramakhyāditi, ayaṃ tu svarita udāttasvaritaparasyāpi bhavati---dahāśaso rakṣasaḥ pāhyasmāniti | tathā ca bhāṣye'pyudāttapara evānudātteti prasaṅga udbhāvitaḥ---dadhyāśeti | tasmāt pūrvoktasyātiprasaṅgasya nāyaṃ vyabhicāra iti cintyametat |
nirākariṣyamāṇatvādvāsya nātra suṣṭhu nirbandhanīyaṃ darśayati---yathā tviti | atra vārttikam---`yaṇsvaro yaṇādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ', `svaritayaṇaḥ svaritārthaḥ āśrayātsiddhatvamiti cedudāttāt svarite doṣaḥ' iti | yadi ca `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' iti yaḥ svaritaḥ tasya yo yaṇ‌ tataḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvamiṣṭaṃ syād, doṣatvena vacanamanupapannaṃ syāt | bhāṣye tu yathāyamarthaḥ sthitaḥ, tathā darsayati---tathā ceti | atra bhāṣyam---`atha vā svaritagrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate; yadi na kriyate, kenedānīṃ svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvaṃ bhavati ? udāttayaṇa ityeva, svaritayaṇā vyavahitatvānna prāpnoti, `svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat' iti nāsti vyavadhānam" iti | yadi codāttāt svaritayaṇaḥ parasyānudāttasya svaritatvamiṣṭaṃ syāt pratyākhyānaṃ na yujyeta | yadi pratyākhyānam, kimarthaṃ tarhi svaritayaṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityāha---tatkriyata iti | sthānivadbhāvādvyavadhānamastīti | yaṇsthānikenekāreṇa | vyañjanasya hyavidyamānavadbhāvaḥ, nācaḥ | nanu ca `na padāntadvirvacana' iti svaravidhau pratiṣiddhaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ ? tatrāha---svaradīrgheti | baidyāśeti | bidasyāpatyaṃ strī `anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ‌', `śārṅgavādyaño ṅīn‌', nitsvareṇādyudātto baidīśabdaḥ ||
ekādeśa udāttenodattaḥ || 8.2.5 ||
`anudāttasya' iti varttate | agnyādiśabdāḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttāḥ, vibhaktiranudāttā |
pacantīti | atra śabakārasya yatsvaritatvam `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' iti, tasyāsiddhatvād dvayoranudāttayorekādeśaḥ ||
svarito vānudātte padādau || 8.2.6 ||
prāditvātsamāse satīti | `prādiprasaṅge karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' ityasya tu tatraiva `svatī pūjāyām' iti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ | gatisamāsastvanāśritaḥ; `gatirgatau' iti nigātaprasaṅgāt | vasukaśabdaḥ pūrvavadantodāttaḥ |
svaritagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiti | katham ? ityāha---udātte hīti | āntaryata eva svarito bhaviṣyatīti | yadyevam, tasya siddhatvāccheṣanighātaḥ syāt---gāṅge'nūpa iti ? ekādeśasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvādanūpaśabdo'nudāttaḥ prāpnoti, svaritagrahaṇe tu sati asyāsiddhatvādyathoktadoṣābhāvaḥ | atha kriyamāṇe'pi svaritagrahaṇe yaḥ siddhaḥ svaritaḥ tena varjyamānatā kasmānna bhavati---kanyānūpa iti ? kanyāśabdaḥ `kanyārājanyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ' ityantasvaritaḥ, tataḥ svaritānudāttayorekādeśa āntaryataḥ svaritaḥ, tasya siddhatvāttena varjyamānatā prāpnoti ? tataścātra yaḥ parihāraḥ sa eva gāṅge'nūpa ityatra bhaviṣyati | kaḥ punarasau ? padadvayāśrayatvena ekādeśasya bahiraṅgatvātsvaro'pi tadīyo bahiraṅgaḥ, śeṣanighātastu ekapadāśrayatvāt svaro'pi tadīyo'ntaraṅgaḥ; tataḥ kim ? `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅga' ||
nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya || 8.2.7 ||
viśeṣyamantasyetyasya netyetadavibhaktikam |
tathaiva prātipadiketyetat padaviśeṣaṇam ||
prātipadikasya, padasya---iti samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau | ahanniti | hanterlaṅ‌tipo halṅyādilopaḥ |
antagrahaṇaṃ kimiti | `nalopaḥ prātipadikasya' ityevāstu, `padasya' iti vartate, tatra nakāreṇa pade viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhinā nakārāntasya padasya lopo vidhīyamānaḥ `alo'ntyasya' ityantyasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti praśnaḥ | rājānāviti | asatyantagrahaṇe prātipadikasya padasya yo'vayavo nakāraḥ, tasya yatra tatra sthitasya lopo bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt, tataścehāpi syāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ ca narābhyāmityādāvapi prasaṅgo darśayitavyaḥ | nanu ca kriyamāṇamapyantagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇena samastam, tataśca prātipadikāntasya padāvayavasya nakārasyetyeṣo'rtho bhavati, na punaḥ padāntasyeti; tataścāhan, narābhyāmityādau mā bhūt‌; rājānāvityādau tu syādeva ? ata āha---prātipadikagrahaṇamiti |
ahariti | `svamornapuṃsakāt' iti svamorluk, `na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhātsupparatvābhāvāt `ro'supi' iti rutvam | ahobhyāmiti | `ahān' iti rutvam |
nanu cātra ratvarutvayoḥ kṛtayornakārābhāvādeva nalopo na bhaviṣyatyata āha---rutvarephayīrasiddhatvāditi | nanvanavakāśatvādratvarutve eva bhaviṣyataḥ, uktaṃ hyapavādasya parasyāpi vacanaprāmāṇyāda siddhatvaṃ na bhavatīti ? ata āha---sāvakāśaṃ vai tadubhayamiti | sambuddhau hi `na ṅisaṃbuddhyoḥ' iti nalopaḥ pratiṣiddhyate | he ahariti | `vā napuṃsakānām' iti pakṣe nalopapratiṣedhaḥ, atra ratvaṃ sāvakāśam | he dīrghāho nidāgheti | puṃlliṅge'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ, sambuddherhalṅyādilopaḥ | nidāghaśabdasya parasya prayogo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, `haśi ca' ityutvam | atha ahaḥ, ahobhyāmityādau nalopekṛte'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātsa evāhaḥ śabda ityavasiṣṭasya yo'ntyākāraḥ so'vakāśā iti kasmānnoktam ? evaṃ manyate---ahanniti nakārāparityāgena nirdeśānnakārāntasyaiva sthānitvam, anyathā hasyetyeva brūyāditi | ahanniti prathamaikavacanāntamiti | ādeśamātre vidhitsite ahna iti nakārāntasyaiva ṣaṣṭhyā prathamaikavacanāntamiti | ādeśamātre vidhitsite ahna iti nakārāntasyaiva ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaṃ kuryāt; prathamāntasya nirdeśe prayojanam---etasya rūpasyānvākhyānameveti bhāvaḥ ||
na ṅisambuddhyoḥ || 8.2.8 ||
ārdre carmanniti | `supāṃ suluk' ityādinā ṅerluk |
nanu ca ṅisambuddhyordvayorapi luptayoḥ pūrvasya prātipadikasajñā nāsti, pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya iti niṣedhāt; ṅau tu padasaṃjñāpi nāsti, pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva pravṛttayā bhasaṃjñayā bādhitvātaḥ tatkuto'tra nalopaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---etasmādeveti | nanu ca he surājannityādyarthametatsyād, atra hi `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' iti prātipadikasaṃjñā, na ca tasyā api `apratyayaḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ, sūtrāntargatatvāt ? evaṃ tarhyatrāpi `apratyayaḥ' ityanuvarttate, anyathā surājetyādau vidhyarthatvasambhavāt samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ na syāt | tasmādupapannamevāsya jñāpakatvam | etacca pratikāryaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttiriti pakṣāśrayeṇocyate, tatra hi vibhaktyarthamutpannayā prātipadikasaṃjñayā nalopo na prāpnoti | bhasaṃjñā ca na bhavatīti | atrāpi `etasmādeva pratiṣedhavacanātpratyayalakṣaṇena jñāpyate'---iti ca sambadhyate | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---tathā ceti | nalopaśca bhavatīti | prātipadikatvāt | allopaśca na bhavatīti | bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt | apara āha---``nāyamartho jñāpakasādhyaḥ bhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti | katham ? `yaci' ityucyate, na cātra yajādiṃ paśyāmaḥ; pratyalakṣaṇena ? `na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ, tatra hi lumatā lupte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ tasya yatkāryamāṅgamanāṅgaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ pratiṣidhyate" iti |
carmatila iti | vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ | nanu cātyalpamidamucyate, ṅāviti sambuddhāvapyuttarapade pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; anyathā he rājan vṛndāraketi vigṛhya `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam' iti sambuddhyantayoḥ samāse sati lopo na syāt | tathā ca vārttikama---ṅisambuddhyoranuttarapada iti | ata āha---he rājavṛndāraketyatra tviti | tatra na pūrvapadārthasambhodhanamiti | na hi pṛthagavayavārthayorabhimukhīkaraṇe parasparamekārthībhāvaḥ sambhavati | kiñca `sambuddhau' ityucyate, na cātra sambuddhiṃ paśyāmaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇena ? `na lumatāṅgasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | vacanaṃ tu he rājannityādau yatra lopaśabdena sambuddhirlupyate tatra caritārtham | ṅau tu nāyaṃ parihāraḥ sambhavati; sarvatra lumatā luptatvāt |
vā napuṃsakānāmiti | aprāptivibhāṣeyam; sambuddherlumatā luptatvāt |
mādupadhāyāśca matorvo'yavādibhyaḥ || 8.2.9 ||
atra cakārādvākyabhedaḥ, maśca aśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ | tasmānmātparasya matorvo bhavati | `upadhāyāśca', mādityeva, upadhāyāśca mātparasya matorvo bhavati, pūrveṇānantarye vihitaṃ vyavadhāne'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ | evaṃ vyākhyātavye matoriha kāryitvenetyādi yaduktam, tatrābhiprāyo mṛgyaḥ | kaścidāha---`makārāntānmakāropadhāvarṇāntādavarṇopadhācceti vaiyākaraṇagoṣṭhīṣu paṭhyate, tasyedamupapādanam' iti; tatrāpi makāropadhādakāropadhāditi bahuvrīhyarthasya nopapādanaṃ dṛśyate | va ityayamādeśo bhavatīti | atretiśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, tadayamartho bhavatītyupakramāt, yavādivipratiṣedhe prakāre ādiśabdaḥ | payasvāniti | `tasau matvarthe' iti bhatvādrutvābhāvaḥ, |
iha naro'syāstīti nṛmān, tasyedaṃ nārmatamiti vṛddhau kṛtāyāmavarṇopadhāditi vatvaṃ prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ ? ityata āha---iheti | bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā vṛddhirantarbhūtamatubapekṣe vatve asiddhā bhavatītyarthaḥ ||
jhayaḥ || 8.2.10 ||
agnicitvāniti | pūrvavadbhatvājjaśtvābhāvaḥ ||
saṃjñāyām || 8.2.11 ||
ahīvatītyādau cāturarthiko nadyāṃ matup ||
āsandīvadaṣṭīvaccakrīvatkakṣīvadrumaṇvaccarmaṇvatī || 8.2.12 ||
āsandīvadahisthalamiti | deśaviśeṣaḥ, yatredamucyate---
āsandīvati dhānyādaṃ rukmiṇaṃ haritasrajam |
aśvaṃ babandha sāraṅgaṃ devebhyo janamejayaḥ || iti |
tathā coktamiti | prayogaśāstreṣu | rājāsandī - somarājasyāsanam | yadi tasyaiva saṃjñāyāmiti vatvena siddham, āsandīvadityetatkimarthaṃ tahi nipātanam ? ityata āha---prapañcārthaṃ tviha paṭhyata iti | atretiśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, apare tvāhurityupakramāt | śarīraikadeśasyeti | sa punarjānvoḥ sandhiḥ | cakrīvanti sado havirdhānānīti | sārasvate satre jaṅgamāni sadohavirdhānāni, na tvekatrāvasthitāni, tāni tatra tatra karṣaṇāya cakrayuktāni bhavanti | kakṣīvāniti | `halaḥ' iti dīrghatvam | rumanniti prakṛtyantaramastīti | `rumā ca lavaṇākaraḥ' | ṇatvārthaṃ ceti | `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt | matorvā nuḍarthamiti | atra pakṣe pūrvasya nakārasya lopaḥ, ṇatvamapi `raṣābhyām' ityeva siddham ||
udanvānudadhau ca || 8.2.13 ||
udanvānnāma ṛṣiriti | yasya ca kāmavarṣo parjanyaḥ---yasminnudakaṃ dhīyata iti, sa punastaṭākādiḥ | `karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca' iti kipratyayaḥ, `peṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca' iti udakasyodbhāvaḥ |
udakasattāsambandhasāmānyamiti | tacca devadattādiṣvapi sambhavati | asaṃjñārthaṃ vodadhigrahaṇam ||
rājanvān‌ saurājye || 8.2.14 ||
śobhano rājā tasya bhāvaḥ saurājyam, brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ‌, ṭilopaḥ | tatpunaḥ śobhanena rājñā deśasya sambandhaḥ | samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānam; bhāvapratyayeneti vacanāt | etacca rājanvānityasya pravṛttinimittam, deśa eva tvabhidheyaḥ, yadāha---saurājye gamyamāna iti | rājanvāniti | praśaṃsāyāṃ matup, nalopābhāvo nipātyate | sūtre puṃlliṅgasyāvivakṣitatvaṃ darśayati---rājanvatī pṛthivīti ||
ano nuṭ‌ || 8.2.16 ||

kṛpo dhātoriti pāṭhaḥ | bhāṣye---`kṛpo ro laḥ' iti paṭhitatvāt | `nuḍ‌vidhilādeśavināmeṣvṛkāre pratividhātavyam' ityuktam, tatrāvasare prāpte lādeśe pratividhatte---iti sāmānyamiti | varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtabhedatiraskāreṇa varṇātmikāyāmavarṇātmikāyāṃ ca rephavyaktau yatsāmānyaṃ varttate yato dvayorapi tayo ra ityabhinnābhidhānapratyayau bhavataḥ, tadupādīyate; na tu varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktirityarthaḥ | tataḥ kim ? ityata āha---teneti | ityapi sāmānyaṃ ceti | upādīyata ityapekṣate | atrāpi tena yaśca kevalo lakāraḥ, yaśca lṛkārasthaḥ, tayordvayorapi grahaṇamiti paṭhitavyam, pūrvānusāreṇa tu gamyamānatvānna paṭhitam | yadi dvayorapi grahaṇam, tato'pi kim ? ityāha---tato'yamiti | kevalasya-śuddhasya | lakāra ādeśa iti | atrāpi kevala iti draṣṭavyam | ṛkārasyāpi lṛkāra iti | āntaratamyāt | nanu satyapi dvayorapi grahaṇe ṛkārasthasya rephasya lṛkārastho lakāra ādeśo bhavatu, kathaṃ tu kṛtsnasya kṛtsno varṇa ādeśo labhyate ? ityāśaṅkyoktam---ekadeśadvāreṇeti | ekadeśavikārastho rephaḥ, tasya vikāra ekadeśavikāraḥ | yadvā---atra ekadeśa lṛkārastho lakāraḥ, sa eva vikāra ekadeśavikāraḥ, tad‌dvāreṇa | tata etaduktaṃ bhavati---ajbhaktisampuṭitayo rephalakārayorniṣkṛṣya kartumaśakyatvātsamudāyasya samudāya ādeśa iti | yadi niṣkarṣo'śakyakriyaḥ, mā bhūttayorupādānam, na punaretāvatā sūtre'nupāttayoḥ samudāyayoḥ sthānyādeśabhāvo vidyate ? ityata āha--tathā ceti | evamādaya iti | ādiśabdena `tāsi ca klṛpaḥ', `ṛdupadhāccāklṛpi cṛteḥ' `anavaklṛptyavamarṣayoḥ' ityādergrahaṇam | kalpteti | ūdittvātpakṣe iḍabhāvaḥ | atra latvasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvaṃ parasmaipade `tāsi ca klapaḥ' itīḍabhāvaḥ, anyatra tu guṇe kṛte rephasya lakāraḥ | ciklṛpsatīti | `halantācca' iti sanaḥ kittvam |

bāleti | `bala valla saṃvaraṇe', balyata iti bālaḥ | mūlamiti | `mūla pratiṣṭhāyām' ityasmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | `laṅghivaṃhyornalopaśca' iti kupratyayānto laghuśabdaḥ | alamityavyayam | `aṅgeḥ kuliḥ' aṅgulaḥ | `amergurī raśca lo vā' iti nāśritam |
kapilakādiṣucārasya laḥ | romāṇīti | rautermanin, `roman nāman sīman stoman homan soman loman vyoman vidharman pāpman dhāman' ityatra `loman samān' iti nipātanaṃ nāśritam | pāṃsuramiti | pāṃsurasminnastīti `nagapāṃsupāṇḍubhyaśca' iti raḥ | `kṛño manin' karma | śukraḥ, śukla iti | `ṛjrāgra' iti nipātanaṃ nāśritam | atha `klṛpū sāmarthye, ityeva kasmānna paṭhitam, evaṃ hi latvaṃ na vidheyaṃ bhavati ? naitadasti; acīklṛpaditi hi na sidhyet | `ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇavidhiḥ' iti lṛkārasya `urat' iti akāre kṛte acīkṛpaditi syāt, latvavidhau tasyāsiddhatvātpūrvamṛkāraḥ, tato latvamiti siddhamiṣṭam | tathā calīklṛpyate iti rīko pi latvasiddhirbhavati ||
upargasyāyatau || 8.2.19 ||

nisdus ityetayostviti | sakārāntaviṣayo granthaḥ, rephāntayostu bhavitavyameva latvena ||

`itaḥ prabhṛti sicaḥ sakārasya lopaḥ' iti vakṣyati, tataśca sicā pratyaya ākṣipyate, tasya dhakāreṇa viśeṣaṇāttadādividhirvijñāyate, ityāha---dhakārādau pratyaya iti | bhāṣyakāramate tu dhakāre para iti draṣṭavyam | alaviḍh‌vamiti | luṅ‌, cleḥ sic, iṭ, sico lopaḥ, `vibhāṣeṭaḥ' iti pakṣe mūrdhanyaḥ | dhakāro na śrūyeteti | ṣṭutve kṛte alaviḍh‌vamityeva syāt | vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tu tatra ṣīdhvamartham, liṅarthaṃ ca syāt |
itaḥ prabhṛtītyādi | `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya' iti pūrvasavarṇavidhānamatra jñāpakamāhuḥ | anyathā ut‌-sthā iti sthite takārātparasya sakārasya `jhalo jhali' iti lope sati utthānamityādeḥ siddhatvādanarthakaṃ tat syāt | sāmānyāpekṣaṃ ca jñāpakam---asmin prakaraṇe yo lopaḥ sa sica iti | cakāddhīti | he śiraḥ palitaṃ saccakāddhi, śobhasvetyarthaḥ | `cakāsṛ dīptau' adādiḥ, loṭ, sipo hiḥ, herddhiḥ, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' iti sakārasya dakāraḥ | payo dhāvatīti | `haśi ca' iti rorutvam | yadi sico lopa iṣyate, sagdhiḥ, babdhām---`jhalo jhali' iti lopo na syāt ? ata āha---sagdhirbavdhāmiti | adeḥ ktini `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti ghaslādeśaḥ, `ghasibhasorhali ca' ityupadhālopaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti salopaḥ, `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' jaśtvena ghakārasya gakāraḥ, samānā gdhiḥ sagdhiriti `pūrvāparaprathama' ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ, `samānasya chandasi' iti sabhāvaḥ | babdhāmiti | `bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ' juhotyādiḥ, loṭ, tasastām, ślau dvirvacanam, pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, sakārasya ca lopaḥ, takārasva dhakāraḥ, pakārasya jaśtvam---bakāraḥ | payo dhāvatītyevamādāvapīti | anyathā rutvasya siddhatvāt pūrvaṃ salopaḥ syāt |

saṃyogādyoḥ padasyānte skoryasmānnāsti sambhavaḥ ||
iti matvā''ha---padasyānta iti | jhali ca parata iti | padasya yaḥ saṃyoga ityapekṣate | lagna iti | `olasjī vrīḍe', niṣṭhā, īdittvādiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ | atra takāre jhali parataḥ sajayoryassaṃyogaḥ tadādiḥ sakāraḥ, `oditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam, tasyāsiddhatvāt kutvam | sādhulagiti | sādhu lajjata iti kvip | magna iti | `masjinaśorjhali' iti num, sa ca jakārātpūrvaḥ, `masjerantyātpūrvaṃ numamicchanti' iti vacanāt | tena `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ, salopādi pūrvavat | taṣṭa iti | `takṣū tanūkaraṇe', ūdittāvadvikalpiteṭ, `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ |
jhali saṅīti vaktavyamiti | saṅītyayaṃ prakaraṇaśeṣaḥ | kiṃ prayojanam ?
giro'bhodhirdviṣṭarāṃ ca dṛṣatsthaḥ kāṣṭaśaksthiraḥ |
kruñcā dhuryeti mā smaiṣu satvādīni bhavantviti ||
gira iti---atra `aci vibhāṣā' iti latvaṃ mā bhūt | abhodhiriti---`dhi ca' iti salopo na bhavati | dviṣṭarāmiti---`hrasvādaṅgāt' iti na bhavati | dṛṣatsthaḥ---`jhalo jhali' iti na bhavati | kāṣṭhaśaksthiraḥ---`skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti na bhavati | kruñcā---`coḥ kuḥ' iti kutvaṃ na bhavati | dhuraṃ vahatīti dhuryeti---`hali ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | tathā ca vārttikam---`saṅi latvalopasaṃyogādilopakutvadīrghatvāni' iti | saṅīti prakṛtya latvādīni vaktavyānītyarthaḥ | tadevaṃ vārttikakāramate'pi cakādhītyeva bhavitavyam; saṅīti vacanāt | sanaḥ pramṛtīti | dhātupratyayānāṃ grahaṇamityarthaḥ | atra saṃyogādilopaṃ prayojanaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---taditi | taditi vākyopanyāse | śakeriti | kakārāntopalakṣaṇametat, tena `kaka laulye', `kuka vṛka ādāne' ityāderapi kvibantasya prayogo nāstyeva | āhuriti | bhāṣyakārādayaḥ | tatra bhāṣyaṃ tāvat paṭhati---kāṣṭhaśageveti | vākyarthamityatra sthānivadbhāvo'pi śakyo vaktum `tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopa' ityuktatvāt ||
coḥ kuḥ || 8.2.30 ||
nakāropadho veti | pūrvamautpattikaṃ ñakāropadhatvamāśrityektam, idānīṃ tu nakārasyānusvāraparasavarṇābhyāmāgato ñakāra ityucyate | nakāralope hīti | tathā sannipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ prayojaneṣu paṭhitam---udupadhatvasya nikucita iti | kucitaśabde kittvasannipātakṛtamudupadhattvam `udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām' kittvasya nimittaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanvastu nopadhaḥ, tathāpyanusvāraparasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ nakārasya kutvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---tatreti | cutvasya tvatra prasaṅgo nāsti; anusvāraṃ prati tasyāsiddhatvāt ||
ho ḍhaḥ || 8.2.31 ||
soḍheti | `tīṣasaha' itīḍ‌ vikalpaḥ | turāṣāḍiti | `chandasi sahaḥ' iti ṇviḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam; `saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ' iti ṣatvam | praṣṭhavāḍiti | `vahaśca' iti ṇviḥ ||
dāderdhātorghaḥ || 8.2.32 ||
kiṃ tarhi tadviśeṣaṇamiti | yadyapi samānādhikaraṇaṃ na bhavatītyasyaitatpratipakṣabhūtaṃ na bhavati, samānādhikaraṇasyāpi viśeṣaṇatvopapatteḥ, tathāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyapakṣe `dhātoḥ' ityetadviśeṣyam; atra tu pakṣe viśeṣaṇamityasyaiva pratipakṣatā | avayavaṣaṣṭhyantamiti | avayavasambandhe yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantamityarthaḥ | atra spaṣṭameva pratipakṣatvam---dhātoravayavo yo dādiḥ śabda iti | evaṃ copakrame'pi dakārādeḥsa dhātoḥ---iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau | kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatīti | kimiṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | adhogityatrāpīti | sāmānādhikaraṇye tvaḍāgamena dāditvasya vihitatvānna syāt | kathamiti | dhāturevāyaṃ na dhātoravayava iti praśnaḥ | atha veti | asminpakṣe upakrame'pi `dāderdhātoḥ' iti yathāśrutameva | dhātūpadeśa iti | etacca dhātugrahaṇāllabhyate |
na hyadhātordakārāderhakārāntasya sambhavaḥ |
devānaḍud‌bhyāmityādau yasmāḍ‌ḍhatvaṃ pravarttate ||
tadetadasamīcīnamavadhānacyutaṃ vacaḥ |
yasmāddāmaliḍityāderadhātorapi sambhavaḥ ||
tasmāddhātugrahaṇamāvartanīyam | tatraikamatiricyamānamupadeśakālaṃ lakṣayati | tathā ceti | pūrvatra tu pakṣe vyapadeśivadbhāvena dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ ||
vā druhamuhaṣṇuhaṣṇihām || 8.2.33 ||
druhādaya ete divādiṣvanenaiva krameṇa prapaṭhyante, radhāditvādvikalpiteṭaḥ | tatra `vā druhādīnām' iti vaktavye pratipadapāṭho yaṅ‌lukyapi yathā syāt---dodhruk, dodhruṭ‌; anyathā `nirddiṣṭaṃ yadgaṇena ca' iti na syāt ||
naho dhaḥ || 8.2.34 ||
parīṇaditi | sampadāditvātkvip, `nahivṛti' iti dīrgatvam, `upasargādasamāse'pi' iti ṇatvam | prakriyālāghavārthaṃ dakāra eva vidhātavye dhakāravidhānam `jhaṣastathoऱdho'dhaḥ' iti dhatvaṃ yathā syāt, naddhamityatra radābhyāṃ niṣṭhānatvaṃ ca mā bhūditi |
āhasthaḥ || 8.2.35 ||
atha prakṛto dhakāra eva kasmānna vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cartvena āttheti siddham, thakārasyāpi cartvena bhavitavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvā `āhanahordhaḥ' ityeka eva yogaḥ karttavyaḥ ? ata āha--ādeśāntarakaraṇamiti | evamapi takāra eva karttavyaḥ |
hṛgrahoriti | hakārasyeti vacanaṃ haratyartham | nigrābhamiti | `udi grahaḥ' ityatra `chandasi nipūrvādapīṣyate srugudyamananipātanayoḥ' iti vacanādvā ghañ‌ ||
vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrājacchaśāṃ ṣaḥ || 8.2.36 ||
atra śakārāntasya jaśtve prāpte, itareṣāṃ tu kutve tadapavādaḥ ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | mūlavṛṭ, dhānāmṛḍiti | grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam, `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' iti salopaḥ, ṣakārasya jaśtvam---ḍakāraḥ, `vāvasāne' iti pakṣe ṭakāraḥ |
jhalādirābhyāmityādi | paryavapadyate-vyavadhīyate | rāṣṭiḥ, bhrāṣṭiriti | `gurośca halaḥ' ityakāre prāpte `ktinnābādibhyaḥ' iti ktinpratyayaḥ, `titutratatha' ityādineṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ |
śabdaprāḍiti | `kvibvaci' ityādinā kvip, dīrghatvam, samprasāraṇābhāvaśca | chagrahaṇamanarthakam; `cch‌voḥ śūḍ‌' ityādinā chasya śatve kṛte śāntānāmityeva ṣatvaṃ siddham ? ata āha---cch‌voḥ śūḍityādi ||
ekāco baśo bhaṣ‌ jhaṣantasya sdhvoḥ || 8.2.37 ||
`dhātoḥ' iti yadihānuvarttate tadvyadhikaraṇamavayavaṣaṣṭhyantam `ekācaḥ' ityasya viśeṣaṇam | `jhaṣantasya' ityetadapi tasyaiva samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam | evaṃviśiṣṭaṃ tu `ekācaḥ' ityetadavayavaṣaṣṭhyantiviśeṣaṇam | tadāha---dhātoravayava ityādi | jhali sakāra iti | etenānuvarttamānasya jhalo viśeṣaṇaṃ sakāra iti darśayati | kimatha punariha jhalītyanuvarttate ? `anta' ityasyānuvṛttiryathā syād, anyathā jhalītyasya nivṛttau tatsambaddhamanta ityapi nivartteta | nanu
catvāro bhaṣa ādeśāḥ sthāninastu baśastrayaḥ |
ḍakārasya tu na kvāpi sambhavo'sti kathañcana ||
tataśca vaiṣamyātsaṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnoti ? tatrāha---catvāro baśaḥ sthānina ityādi |
śāstrapratītivelāyāṃ saṃkhyāsāmyasya sambhavāt ||
pravarttate yathāsaṃkhyamanuṣṭhāne tvasambhavaḥ ||
ityarthaḥ | kvacittu nāyaṃ granthaḥ paṭhyate | bhotsyanta iti | budhiranudāttet, lṛṭi syaḥ, tatra vyapadeśavadbhāvena dhātuṃ pratyekāco'vayavatvam | abhughvamiti |
`dhi ca' iti sico lopaḥ | guhiduhī svaritetau |
ajardhā iti | gṛdheryaṅ‌luki dvirvacane dhātuṃ pratyekāco'vayavatvam, `rugrikau ca luki' iti ruk, jargṛdh‌ iti sthite laṅādi |
gardabhayateriti | gardabhamācaṣṭa iti ṇic | aśrāvī pratyayo'pratyayaḥ kvidiḥ |
asatyekājgrahaṇe ityādi | yadyekājgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato'nyasyehāśrutatvād baśeva dhātorityanena viśeṣyeta | baśo jhaṣantatvasyāsambhavājjhaṣantasyetyanenāpi dhātureva viśeṣyeta, tataścāyamarthaḥ syāt---jhaṣantasya dhātoryo'vayavo vaś‌ tasya bhaṣiti, tato dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasaṅgaḥ | `ekācaḥ' ityasmiṃstu sati vṛttikāropadarśita evārtho bhavatīti ca tatra prasaṅgaḥ | atra hi yo jhaṣanta ekāc liḍiti na tasyāvayavo braś‌ dakāraḥ, yasya cāvayavo dāmityasya na sa jhaṣantaḥ | krotsyatīti | atra kakārasya ghakāro na bhavati ||
dadhastathośca || 8.2.38 ||
dadhātirnirdiśyata iti | `dadha dhāraṇe' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; śapā tayorvyavāyāt |
nanu yaṅ‌luki vyavāyo nāsti, tataśca tasyaiva grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, evaṃ ca varcanasāmarthyāditi vakṣyamāṇaṃ nāśrayitavyaṃ bhavati ? tasmādvyākhyānamevātra śaraṇam |
vacanasāmarthyāditi | na hi dadhātirākāralopena vinā jhaṣanto bhavati | etacca `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ityanāśrityoktam | abhyāsajaśtvasya cāsiddatvamiti | vacanasāmarthyānna bhavatītyapekṣate | na hyabhyāsasya jaśtvena vinā dadhāterbaś kvacit sambhavati |
tathoriti kimiti | `jhali' iti varttate, `jhaṣantasya' iti ca; na ca takārathakārābhyāmanyo dadho jhalasti, sdhvostāvadiṣṭameva | tasmāttathoriti na vaktavyam | evaṃ ca kṛtvā cakāro'pi na karttavyaḥ, sarvatra jhalītyeva siddhamiti praśnaḥ | ānantaryāditi | nanu ca sdhvoḥ pūrveṇeva siddham ? na sidhyati; āllopasyasthānivadbhāve sati ajhaṣantatvāt | nanu ca pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ ? evamapyabhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvānna sidhyati |
yadi tu `abhyāsajaśtvacartvametvatukoḥ siddhaṃ vaktavyam' ityatra etvatukorityapanīyāviśeṣeṇa siddhatvamucyeta, phalibhajigrahaṇaṃ vā sāmānyena jñāpakamāśrīyeta, na tvetvaviṣayameva; tataḥ `tathośca' iti śakyamakarttum | katham ? sdhvoḥ pūrveṇaiva siddham, idaṃ tu vyatirikte jhali yathā syādityevamarthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
jhalāṃ jaśo'nte || 8.2.39 ||
padasyānte varttamānānāmiti | padāvasāne varttamānānām | antaśabdo'vasānavacanaḥ, na tvavayavavacanaḥ | śvaliḍiti | atra hakārasya jaśtve prāpte tasyāsiddhatvāt pūrvaṃ ḍhatvam, ḍhakārasya jaśtvam---ḍakāraḥ |
jhaṣastathordho'ghaḥ || 8.2.40 ||
dadhātiṃ varjayitveti | anenādha iti dhātupratiṣedhaṃ darśayati | yadi dhakārapratiṣedhaḥ syāt---dhakārātparayorneti, tataḥ `gatibuddhi' ityādayo nirdeśā nopapadyeran | alabdhaṣa alabdhā iti | luṅi ta-thāsau | evamalīḍha, alīḍhā iti | dhattaḥ, dhattha iti | dhatve pratiṣiddhe dhakārasya cartvam |
`adhaḥ' iti śakyamavaktum | iha kasmānna---dhattaḥ, dhattha iti ? jaśtve yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate, `dadhastathośca', `jhalāṃ jaśaḥ'---jhalāṃ jaśo bhavanti dadhastathoḥ, tataḥ `ante'---ante ca jhalāṃ jaśo bhavanti, tatra `pūrvatrāsiddham' iti bhaṣbhāve jaśtvasyāsiddhatvājjhaṣantatvam | dhatve parasmin siddhaṃ jaśtvamityajhaṣantatvāddhatvābhāva iti siddhamiṣṭam ||
radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ || 8.2.42 ||
`niṣṭhātaḥ' iti samāsanirdeśaḥ | tatra pradhānabhūtatakāraḥ `radābhyām' ityanena viśeṣyate, na guṇabhūtā niṣṭhetyāha--rephadakārābhyāmuttarasyeti | tena caritam, muditamityatra niṣṭhāyā avyavadhāne'pi tasyeṭā vyavahitatvānnatvaṃ na bhavati | avagūrṇamiti | `gurī udyamane', `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' itīṭapratiṣedhaḥ, pūrveṣu `śryukaḥ kiti' iti | bhinnaḥ, bhinnavāniti | ādeśe `na' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tena dakārasya sthāne śuddho nakāro bhavati | kṛtaḥ kṛtavāniti |
nanu yathā `kṛpo ro laḥ' ityṛkārasyāpi rephasya lakāro bhavati, tathehāpi ṛkārasya rephamāśritya natvaṃ prāpnoti ? ata āha---ra ityatreti | yuktaṃ tatra sāmānyopādānāt, iha tu na sāmānyamupādīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? vyañjanam | kimātmakam ? arddhamātrātmakam, ṛkārastu mātrācaturbhāgātmakaḥ | astu vā sāmānyanirdeśaḥ, tathāpi na doṣa ityāha---sāmānyanirdeśe ceti | ṛkāre hyabhito'jbhaktiḥ, madhye rephabhaktiḥ, tataśca parayā'jyabhaktyā vyavadhānānnāsti natvaprasaṅgaḥ |
caritam, muditamiti | `ta' ityanucyamāne iṭo niṣṭhābhaktatvāttasya natvaprasaṅgaḥ | parasya mā bhūditi | parasyaiva mā bhūdityarthaḥ | asati pūrvagrahaṇe pāṭhakrame niṣṭhā pratyāsanneti taddakārasyeva natvena bhāvyam | tenaitadapi na codanīyam---bahiraṅgatvāllākṣaṇikatvācca na bhaviṣyatīti | kiñca---padasyetyadhikārāt padāvasthāyāṃ natvavidhānādvahiraṅgatvamapi nāsti | kevalasya varṇasyānupadeśāt pratipadoktatvamapi nāsti | athāpi pratyāsattirnāpekṣyate, tathāpi pañcamīnirdeśāt parasyaiva prasaṅgaḥ | kārtirityatra bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ | vṛddheśca yannimittaṃ tadeva rephasyāpi; `uraṇ‌ raparaḥ' ityasya vṛddhividhinaikavākyatvāt ||
saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ || 8.2.43 ||
pradrāṇa iti | `kṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvam |
niryāta iti | yo'tra dāturnāsau saṃyogādiḥ, yaśca saṃyogādirnāsau dhātuḥ | na cātra saṃyogāditvasya bahiraṅgatvam | katham ? pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate, tataśca niṣṭhotpatteḥ prāgeva saṃyogaḥ sannihitaḥ | pradrāṇa ityādāvapyetāvadeva ||
lvādibhyaḥ || 8.2.44 ||
jīna iti | `jyā vayohānau', grahijyādinā samprasāraṇam | niṣṭāvaditi | natvasannidhau vacanāttadevātidiśyate, tena pūnirityatra `kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ', `pūṅaśca' itīḍvikalpo na bhavati |
dugvoriti | `du gatau' ityasyaiva dorgrahaṇam, na tu `ṭudu upatāpe' ityasya; sānubandhakatvāt | tathā māghe prayuktam---`mṛdutayā dutayā' iti | `gu purīṣotsarge'|
pūnā iti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ pūñ‌ vināśārthaḥ |
sino grāsa iti | `ṣiñ‌ bandhane', badhyamānaḥ-piṇḍīkriyamāṇo grāso yadā dadhyadivyañjanavaśena tatrānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tadā karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmayaṃ prayogaḥ | sitā pāśeneti | śuddhe karmaṇi ktaḥ, samudāyapratyudāharaṇametat | idānīmavayavapratyudāharaṇaṃ darśayati---grāso'pīti |
oditaśca || 8.2.45 ||
āpīna iti | `pyāyaḥ pī' iti pībhāvaḥ | svādayaḥ `ṣūṅ‌ māṇiprasave' ityādayaḥ `brīṅ‌ vṛṇotyarthe' ityevamantā divādau paṭhyante ||
kṣiyo dīrghāt || 8.2.46 ||
`kṣi kṣaye', `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ'---dvayorapi grahaṇam | kṣīṇā iti | akarmakatvāt karttari ktaḥ, `niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe' iti dīrghaḥ | kṣīṇastapasvīti | atrāpi `vā''krośadainyayoḥ' iti |
`dīrghāt' iti śakyamavaktum, `kṣiyaḥ' iti nirdeśādeva dīrghasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, hrasvasya hi grahaṇe iyaṅādeśātparatvāt `ghirṅiti' iti guṇe kṛte kṣeriti nirdeṣṭavyaṃ syādityata āha---hrasvāntasyāpīti | yathābhūtasya dīrghatvaṃ vidheyaṃ tathābhūtamevānukartuṃ yuktam | hrasvāntasya ca dīrghatvaṃ vidheyamiti tasyaiva dīrghavidhāvanukaraṇam | tatrāpi ceyaṅādeśo dṛṣṭaḥ, tasmādiyaṅādeśo na dīrghagrahaṇe pramāṇamityarthaḥ |
yadi tarhi hrasvāntasyāpi dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅādeśo bhavati `viparābhyāṃ jeḥ' ityādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---viparābhyāṃ jerityevamādau tviti | avivakṣitveti pāṭhaḥ | tatra hi dhātāvanukārye'vasthitaṃ dhātutvaṃ kriyāvācitvalakṣaṇamavivakṣitatvāttasya vivakṣāmakṛtvā rūpasāmānyasya---vijitam, kūjitamityādisādhāraṇasya rūpasyānukaraṇam, tataśca viśeṣanibandhanasya kāryasya sāmānye'bhāvātprakṛtāvadṛṣṭatvādanukaraṇe'pyabhāva ityarthaḥ | yadā tu viśeṣo'nukriyate, tadā tannibandhanaṃ kāryamanukaraṇe pravarttate, yathātreyaṅādeśaḥ | yadyevam, vibhaktyutpattirna prāpnoti, `adhātuḥ' iti pratiṣedhena prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ? naiṣa doḥ; adhāturiti paryudāso'yam, na prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | tataḥ kim ? ātideśikasya kasyacit kāryasyābhāvāt dhātoranyatvātsvāśrayā prātipadikasaṃjñā pravarttate | iyaṅādeśastvātideśiko dhātorvidhīyamānatvādbhavati ||
śyo'sparśe || 8.2.47 ||
śīnamiti | `śyaiṅ‌ gatau', `dravamūrttisparśayoḥ śyaḥ' iti samprasāraṇam |
guṇabhūto'pi sparśa iti | etacca vyākhyānāllabhyate, sparśaśabdo'yamasti guṇavacanaḥ, `spṛśa saṃsparśane', bhāve karmaṇi vā ghañ‌---sparśastvagindriyagrāhyo guṇaḥ; asti rogavacanaḥ, `spṛśa upatāpe', ghañ‌---sparśaḥ; tadiha viśeṣānupādānād dvayorapi grahaṇam |
tataśca roge'pi pratiṣedhātpraśīna iti na sidhyet ? ata āha--guṇe ceti | guṇa evetyarthaḥ | evaṃ manyate---yadayam `dravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ' iti sparśe saṃprasāraṇaṃ vidhāyapunaḥ `prateśca' ityāha, tajjñāpayati---śyāyatergrahaṇe sparśaśabdo rogaṃ na pratyāyayatīti | yadi pratyāyayet punarna vidadhyāt, pratipūrvo roga eva śyāyatirvartate ||
añco'napādāne || 8.2.48 ||
na cedapādānaṃ tatra bhavatīti | tatrāñcatyarthe viṣaye'pādānaṃ cenna bhavatītyarthaḥ | samakāviti | saṅgatāvityarthaḥ | `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `aniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ |
udaktamiti | uddhatamityarthaḥ | vyaktamityetaditi | `añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' ityasyedaṃ rūpam, nāñcateḥ; tena natvamidaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
divo'vijigīṣāyām || 8.2.49 ||
ādyūna iti | `cchavoḥ śūṅ‌' | ādyūnaḥ-audarikaḥ | paridyūnaḥ-kṣīṇaḥ |
dyūtaṃ vartate iti | nanvatrākṣādipatanalakṣaṇā krīḍā pratīyate, na vijigīṣā ? ata āha---vijigīṣayā hīti ||
nirvāṇo'vāte || 8.2.50 ||
vātādhikaraṇa iti | vātakartṛka ityarthaḥ | yadi `vātaścedabhidheyo na bhavati' ityarthaḥ syāt, tadā nirvāto vāta ityatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ syādyatra karttari ktaḥ; yatra tu bhāve tatra na syāt---nirvātaṃ vāteneti |
nirvāṇo'gniriti | upaśānta ityarthaḥ | nirvāṇo bhikṣuriti | uparata ityarthaḥ | vātastu karaṇamiti | yathāsambhavaṃ karaṇatve hetau vā tṛtīyā draṣṭavyā | yathā tu vārttikaṃ tathā bhāve pratiṣedho na bhavati, nirvāṇaṃ vātenetyeva bhavati ||
prastyo'nyatarasyām || 8.2.54 ||
prastīma iti | `styaḥ prapūrvasya' iti samprasāraṇam ||
anupasargāt phullakṣībakṛśollāghāḥ || 8.2.55 ||
phulla iti | `āditaśca' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `utparasyātaḥ', `ti ca' ityutvam |
ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvamiṣyata iti | niṣṭhāyāstaśabdāntaṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya phullaḥ---ityetannipātyata iti bhāvaḥ | kṣībādiṣu tu naitadiṣyate |
iḍabhāva iti | anyathā talopasyāsiddhatvādvalāditvādiṭ‌ prasajyeta | kṛte vā iṭi icchabdalopa iti | nipātyata ityapekṣate | lāgherudo'nya iti | udastu pratiṣedho na bhavati; nirdeśasāmartyāt | kṛśi pratyanupasarga eveti | `yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati' iti vacanāt | kriyāntarayogameva darśayati---parigataḥ kṛśa iti | kārśyena parigata ityarthaḥ | yadyapi phullādayaḥ pacādyaci igupadhalakṣaṇe ke ca sidhyanti, tathāpi `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt' ityādikāryasiddhaye, kṣībitādyaniṣṭaśabda nivṛttaye ca nipātanam; phullaśabde tu phullāvanityetadarthaṃ ca ||
nudavidondatrāghāhrībhyo'nyatarasyām || 8.2.56 ||
atrānantarasya nipātanasya vidhātumaśakyatvādvyavahitaṃ vidheyamiti sthite `śuṣaḥ kaḥ' ityādibhirādeśāntarairvyavahitamapi natvameva vidhīyate | katham ? uttarasūtre tāvattadeva pratiṣidhyate; prāptipūrvakatvātpratiṣedhasya | tasmāttadeva buddhau viparivarttamānamatrāpi vikalpyate | samunna iti | `undī kledane', īdittvādiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `aniditām' ityupadhālopaḥ |
ubhayatra vibhāṣeyamityāha---hrī ityetasyeti |
vida vicāraṇa ityasyeti | raudhādikasya; undinā raudhādikena sāhacaryāt | yadyapi taudādikena nudināpi sāhacaryam, tathāpi parasāhacaryameva vyavasthāpakam; `vipratiṣedhe param' ityasyaivamādāvapyupayogāt |
vicāraṇārthasya grahaṇamityetadāptāgamena draḍhayati---evaṃ hyuktamiti | vitterdhātorniṣṭhāntaśabdarūpaṃ vidita itīṣyate, tasya seṭ‌tvāt; iha ca `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhātaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ vidyateḥ sattārthasya vidervinna itīṣyate; tasyāniṭ‌tvāt, iha ca tasyāgrahaṇāt | vinteriti | tiṅantānukaraṇāt ṣaṣṭhī | bhogavitta iti | ekārthībhāvābhāve'pi bhāṣyakaranipātanātsaptamīsamāsaḥ | bhogagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam | bhoga pratyayayorarthayoḥ vindatestaudādikasya vidervitta itīṣyate, anyatra vinna iti natvameva bhavati, na tvayaṃ vikalpa ityarthaḥ | ukto'tra hetuḥ ||
na dhyākhyāpamūrcchimadām || 8.2.57 ||
mūrtta iti | `āditaśca' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `rāllopaḥ' iti chasya lopaḥ | matta iti | īdittvādiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ ||
vitto bhogapratyayayoḥ || 8.2.58 ||
lābhārthāditi | jñānārthādiṭā bhāvyam | sattāvicāraṇārthayorapi na bhogapratyayayorvṛttiḥ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punarbhoge nipātyamāno vittaśabdo dhane bhavati ? ityata āha---dhanaṃ hīti | karmasādhanaḥ sūtre bhogaśabda ityarthaḥ | etena `pratyayaḥ' iti vyākhyātam |
vinna iti | `vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' iti taudādikasya kvasau vikalpiteṭatvād `yasya vibhāṣā' iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭh‌pratiṣedhaḥ ||
bhittaṃ śakalam || 8.2.59 ||
śakalaparyāyo'yamiti | yathā śakalaśabdo jātiśabdaḥ, na kriyāśabdaḥ, tathā bhittaśabdo'pītyarthaḥ |
nanvayaṃ bhiderdhātoḥ vyutpādyamānaḥ kriyāśabdaḥ, sa kathaṃ jātiśabdasya paryāyo bhavati ? ata āha---atreti | santi hi te śabdā yeṣu vyutpattimātropayoginī kriyā, jātireva tu samudāyaśaktyā śabdārthaḥ, yathā---tailaṃ pibatīti tailapāyiketi | kimarthaṃ punarevamāśrīyate ? ityāha---bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ hīti | sāmyapratipādanārthaṃ śakalagrahaṇam | yatā vidāharaṇavivakṣāyāṃ bhinnaṃ śakalamiti bhavati, tathā bhinnaṃ bhittamityeva prayoga ityarthaḥ | kriyāśabdatve tu bhinnaśabdenaiva kriyāyā upāttatvādbhinnamityasyaiva prayogo na syāt | anye tvāhuḥ---yathā vidāraṇakriyayā śakalaṃ nivartate, tadā tāmaṅgīkarotyeva bhinnaśabdaḥ, yat śakalasya sato vidāraṇaṃ tadā tatpratipādanāya bhinnaṃ bhittamiti prayoga iti ||
ṛṇamādhamarṇye || 8.2.60 ||
ṛ ityetasmāditi | `ña sṛ gatau', `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' iti vā |
etasmādeveti | śauṇḍādivyatirekeṇa saptamīsamāsa eva mṛgyaḥ, prāgeva saptamyantottarapada iti bhāvaḥ | kālāntaretyādi | ṛṇagrahaṇakālāpekṣayā kālāntaratvam, tatra deyaṃ kālāntaradeyam, tatra yo vinimayaḥ-viparivarttanaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthamādhamarṇyagrahaṇam, na tu svārthapratipādanārtham | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate ? ityāha---uttamarṇa ityapi hīti | etacca `dhāreruttamarṇaḥ' iti nirdeśādavasitam ||
nasattaniṣāttānuttapratūrtasūrtagūrtāni chandasi || 8.2.61 ||
nasattetyādīnāmanukaraṇapadānāṃ dvandvaḥ | niṣattamiti | `sadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvam |
anunnamiti bhāṣāyāmiti | `nudavidondatrā' iti vikalpo na bhavati; etannipātānārambhasāmarthyādityāhuḥ |
pratūrtamiti | yadā tvarateḥ, tadā `jvaratvara' ityādinā ūṭh‌ | udā tu `turvīhiṃsāyām' ityasya, tadā `rāllopaḥ'| utvamiti | raparatvam `uraṇ‌ raparaḥ' ityava siddham; parabhāṣāṇāmasiddhaprakaraṇe'pi pravṛtteḥ ||
kvinpratyayasya kuḥ || 8.2.62 ||
kvinaḥ kuriti vaktavye iti | na hi kvinpratyayatvaṃ vyabhicaratīti bhāvaḥ | na caivamucyamāne `verapṛktasya' iti lopaṃ bādhitvā kvina eva vakārasya kutvaṃ ghakāraḥ prāpnotīti śaṅkanīyam; tathā kvina iti pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya grahaṇe sati kvino vakārasya lope karttavye sati kutvasyāsiddhatvāt `rāllopa' eva bhavati, tasmiṃśca sati paścādbhavatkutvaṃ pariśiṣṭasya dhātoreva bhaviṣyati | syādetat---kvibādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ lopaṃ viśeṣavihitaṃ kutvamapavādo vacanaprāmāṇyāditi nyāyena bādheteti ? tanna; evaṃ hi vargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃsyāt | anekasya sthānino'nekādeśapratipattaye hi vargagrahaṇam, vakārasyaiva tu sthānitve ghakāra eva nirdiśyeta, `vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ' iti śikṣāyāṃ vakāraghakārayorguṇasāmyapratipādanāt | tasmāt `kvinaḥ kuḥ' ityeva vaktavyam | bahuvrīhivijñānārthamiti | bahuvrīhivijñānārthamiti | bahuvrīhiścopalakṣaṇe'pi bhavati, yathā---citragurānīyatāmiti gavāmabhāve'pi citragavībhirupalakṣitasyānayanaṃ bhavati, tathehāpyasatyapi kvipi kvinopalakṣitasya dhātoḥ kāryaṃ bhavatīti | asrāg, adrāgiti | sṛjidṛśibhyām `māṅi luṅ‌', tip‌, cleḥ sic, halṅyādilopaḥ, `vadavraja' iti vṛddhiḥ | atra vraścādiṣatve prāpte kutvam---jasya gaḥ, śasya khaḥ, tasyāpi jaśtvam, `vāvasāne' iti cartvam---kakāraḥ | `pūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhatvaṃ ṣatve kutvasya nāsti; pratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyāt ṣatvāpavādatvāt kutvasya |
kvibantasyāpīti | draṣṭetyādau tu na bhavati; apadāntatvāt | evaṃ ca satītyādi | tadvadeva | dṛgbhyāmiti kutvamudāhṛtam |
pratividhātavyamiti | pratividhānaṃ kartavyamiti | pratividhānaṃ vacanameva ||
naśervā || 8.2.63 ||
jīvanāśahetutvādāhutiḥ-jīvanagityucyate, sampadāditvādbhāve kvip ||
mo no dhātoḥ || 8.2.64 ||
nalopo na bhavatīti || natvaṃ tu lopārthameva syāditi manyate ||
sasajuṣo ruḥ || 8.2.66 ||
sajūriti | pūrvavadbhāve kvip, rutve kṛte `rvorupadhāyāḥ' iti dīrghatvam, bahuvrīhau sahasya sabhāvaḥ | saprītirityarthaḥ ||
avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca || 8.2.67 ||
ṇvini kṛta iti | prāpta ityarthaḥ | śvetavahādīnāṃ yatra padatvaṃ bhātri tatra ṇvino'pavādo ḍas vaktavya iti hi tatrārthaḥ, na punarṇvinantānāṃ padatve sati ḍas vaktavya iti |
nanu śvetavobhyāmityādisiddhyarthamavaśyaṃ ḍas vaktavyaḥ, sa ceducyate nārtho'nena, sāntatvātpūrvoṇaiva ruḥ siddhaḥ, dīrghatvam `atvasantasya' ityeva siddham ? tatrāha---sambuddhau dīrghārthamiti ||
ahan || 8.2.68 ||
ahobhyāmiti | `haśi ca' ityutvam | nalopamakṛtvetyādi | nalopavidhāvetadvyākhyātam |
lākṣamikatvāditi | aḍāgamena ahanniti rūpalābhāt |
hrasvavidhāviti | samāse ca lumatā lopād rādeśe prāpte rutvamutvārthamucyate | ahorūpamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | gatamaho rūpaṃ paśyetyasamāsaḥ | ahorātra iti | `ahassarvaikadeśa' ityādināc samāsāntaḥ, ikāralope kṛte'pyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādutvam | rātragrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam; gatamaho rātrirāgatetyasamāse'pi rutvārtham ||
ro'supi || 8.2.69 ||
pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ | `ra' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | adardadātīti | atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | ahno ruvidhāviti | yathā caitatsūtreṇaiva siddham, tathā `na lumatāṅgasya' ityatroktam | dīrghāho nidāgha iti | `asupi' iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ | paryudāse tu supsadṛśo halparo'stīti syādevātra rephaḥ | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pratyayalakṣaṇena pratiṣedhe sati rureva bhavati, tataśca tannibandhane yatvotve bhavataḥ ||
amnarūdharavarityubhayathā chandasi || 8.2.70 ||
nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe ro'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ | amnasśabda īṣadarthe, amnarastamita iti yathā | avaḥ-rakṣaṇam |
pracetā rājanniti | sakārasya rephaḥ, tasya `ro ri' iti lopaḥ, `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ |
aharādīnāmityādi | ubhayatrāpyādiśabdaḥ prakāre | idamapi chandasi bhāṣāyāṃ ca ||
bhuvaśca mahāvyāhṛteḥ || 8.2.71 ||
tisro mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ---pṛthivyantarikṣasvargāṇāṃ vācikāḥ, iha tu madhyamāyā grahaṇam | bhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣviti | tiṅantametat | bhavateḥ `chandasi luṅ‌laṅ‌liṭaḥ' iti vartamāne laṅ‌, sip, śapi guṇābhāvaśchandasaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityaḍabhāvaḥ | lākṣaṇikatvādevāsyāgrahaṇe siddhe mahāvyāhṛtigrahaṇam---asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham | tena krāpayatītyādau puk siddho bhavati ||
vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ || 8.2.72 ||
sa iti vartata iti | ananuvṛttau tu tasya vidvānityādau nakārasya datvaṃ prāpnoti | na tu sraṃsudhvaṃsū iti | viśeṣyete iti vipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | asambhavāccānaḍucchabda iti | na viśeṣyata ityanvayaḥ |
ihedaṃ vasordatvaṃ nāprāpte vidhyantare ārabhyamāṇaṃ yathā vidvadbhyāmityādau rutvaṃ bādhate, tathā vidvānityādau saṃyogāntalopamapi bādheta ? ityata āha---rutve nāprāpta iti |
athānaḍvānityatra numo dakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ata āha---numastviti | datvaṃ yadi nakārasya syāt numo'narthako vidhiḥ, hakārasyāpi datvena hyanaḍvāditi sidhyati | yathaiva tarhi numo vidhānasāmarthyāddatvaṃ na bhavati, tathānaṅ‌vān atretyādau `dīrghādaṭi samānapāde' iti rutvamapi na prāpnoti ? `yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhenimittameva nāsau bādhyate' datvaṃ ca pratinumo vidhiranarthakaḥ, ruvidheḥ punarnimittameva ||
sipi dhāto rurvā || 8.2.74 ||
dhātugrahaṇamuttarārthamiti | iha tu sipi parato dātoranyasyāsambhavaḥ | rugrahaṇaṃ ceti | uttarārthamityanuṣaṅgaḥ, iha tu datve vikalpite sāntatvāde pakṣe ruḥ sidhyati ||
daśca || 8.2.75 ||
abhinaditi | tanmadhyapatitasya śnamastadbhaktasya vāṭastad‌grahaṇena grahaṇādatra padasya dhātutvam ||
rvaurupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ || 8.2.76 ||
dhātoḥ, padasya---ityubhayaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ rephavakārābhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha---rephavakārāntasyeti |
vagrahaṇamuttarārthamiti | iha tu vakārāntasya padasya dhātorasambhavaḥ | abhyāsekārasya mā bhūditi | yadi syāt, tasyāsiddhatvād `hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvo na syāt ||
upadhāyāṃ ca || 8.2.78 ||
`rvorupadhāyāḥ' ityādi sarvamanuvarttate | idamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ rvorviśeṣaṇam | ṣaṣṭhīdvicanasya tu sthāne saptamyekavacanam | prakṛtamupadhāgrahaṇamiko viśeṣaṇam, tacca rvapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ pratipādayati, tena vṛttikāropadarśitaḥ sūtrārtho bhavati | hūrchitetyādi | `hurchā kauṭilye', `murchā mohasamuchrāyayoḥ', aco rahābhyām' iti dvirvacanasyāsiddhatvādrephasyopadhātve sati pūrvavaddīrghatvam | `cirijirī hiṃsārthau' |
iha riryatuḥ, vivyaturiti `ri gatau', `vī gatyādiṣu', liṭ, atus, dvirvacane `eranekācaḥ' iti yaṇādeśaḥ | atrābhyāsekārasya dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ, tataśca tasyāsiddhatvād hrasvo na syāt, tatrāha---riyeturityādi | yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāditi | na ca dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ; alopājādeśatvāt | evamapi `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ityāśaṅkya parihārāntaramāha---asiddhatvāttveti | aṅgādhikāre vidhānāt pratyayāśrayatvādyaṇo bahiraṅgatvam, dīrghasya tu tadanapekṣatvādantaraṅgatvam |
iha caturyiteḥ kyajantāttṛc‌, iṭ‌, ato lope kṛte `kyasya vibhāṣā' iti yadā'yaṃ lopo na bhavati, tadā dhātorupadhābhūto repho halparaśceti dīrghaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityāśaṅkāyāmāha---caturyitetyatrāpīti | atrāpyantaraṅgatvabahiraṅgatve pūrvavat | iha pratipūrvāddiveḥ `kaninyuvṛṣitakṣi' iti kaninpratyayāntāttṛtīyaikavacane `allopo'naḥ' ityakārasya lope pratidīvneti dīrghatvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti; vakārasya dhātuṃ pratyanupadhātvādityata āha---pratidīvnetyatreti | kathaṃ punaḥ `hali ca' iti dīrghatvam, yāvatāllopasya sthānivadbhāve sati halparo vakāro na bhavati ? ityata āha---dīrghavidhāviti | nanu mā bhūtsthānivadbhāvaḥ, vibhaktyāśrayatvenāllopo bahiraṅgaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāddhalparo na bhavati ? ityata āha---asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅga ityetattviti | anāśrayaṇaṃ tvasyāḥ paribhāṣayā anityatvāt |anityatvaṃ ca `nalopaḥ supsvara' itiyatra tugvidhigrahaṇena jñāpitam | iha jīryateḥ krin raśca vaḥ---jivriḥ, kṛgṛbhyāṃ kipratyayaḥ---kiriḥ, giriḥ, tābhyāmos, yaṇādeśaḥ---kiryoḥ, giryo ratra `hali ca' iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti ? tatrāha---uṇādayo'pyutpannānīti | uṇādiṣu nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | etacca `ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' ityatra kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhe kaṃsagrahaṇena jñāpitam---kvacid vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatyeva, yathā---pratidīvneti | kiryorityatra yaṇo bahiraṅgatvamanāśrityayaṃ parihāra uktaḥ ||
na bhakurchurām || 8.2.79 ||
