pitryāyāmanusvadheti sampreṣyetyatrāpi anusva3dheti pluto bhavati; brūhisthānāpannatvātsvadhāśabdasya | tathā astu svadheti pratyāśravaṇamityatrāpi bhavati; astu svadheti śrauṣaṭ‌sthānāpannatvāt | tathā ca vaṣaḍityeke samāmananti, vauṣaḍityeke, vāṣaḍityeke, vaukṣaḍityeke, vākṣaḍityake, vakṣāḍityeke iti ṣaḍvidhasyāpi vaṣaṭ‌kārasya pluto bhavati; vaṣaṭakāropalakṣaṇatvādvauṣaṭ‌śabdasya |
āvaha devān yajamānāyetyevamādiṣviti | ādiśabdena--āvaha jātavedaḥ, suyajā yajetyādegrehaṇam ||
agnītpreṣaṇe parasya ca || 8.2.92 ||
atraivāyaṃ pluta iṣyata iti | osvadhetyāśravaṇamityatra tu tatsthānāpannātvādbhavati | ā3svadheti | tathā cāśvalāyanaḥ--`nityāḥ plutayaḥ' iti | uddhara3 uddhareti | cāpale dvirvacanam ||
vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ || 8.2.93 ||
prativacanaśabdo'yaṃ viruddhe'pi śabde varttate, pratiśabdasya virodhe prasiddheḥ---pratimallaḥ, pratikuñjara iti; vacanaṃ vacanaṃ pratīti prativacanamiti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāve'pyasti; samādhāne'pyasti---anenābhihitasya mayā prativacanaṃ vihitamiti; pṛṣṭaprativacane'pi vartate; tatrāsati pṛṣṭagrahaṇe vivakṣitaṃ prativacanaṃ na gamyeta | udāhaṇe hiśabdo'vadhāraṇe ||
nigṛhyānuyoge ca || 8.2.94 ||
nigṛhyeti | lyabantametat | svamatāditi | svapakṣāt | pracyāvanam-apanayaḥ | tasyaiveti | yasmādasau pracyāvitastasyaiva svapakṣasyāviṣkaraṇam-śabdena prakāśanam--evaṃ kila tva nirupapattikamāttheti | sūtrārthamudāharaṇe darśayannevodāharati---anityaḥ śabda iti kenacitpratijñātamiti | tamevaṃ vādinamupālipsurupālabdhukāmo nigṛhya svamatātpracyāvya sābhyasūyaṃ sāmarṣamanuyuṅ‌kte āviṣkṛtasvamatakaroti | kvacittvayaṃ grantho na paṭhyate, ante tu paṭhyate | adyāmāvāsyā ityevaṃvādī pracyāvya svamatādevamanuyujyata iti ||
āmreḍitaṃ bhartsane || 8.2.95 ||
udāharaṇeṣu `vākyāderāmantritasya' ityādinā dvirvacanam | `vākyasya ṭeḥ' ityadhikāre'pyatrānantyasya bhavati; vākyādereva padasya bhartsane dvirvacanavidhānāt |
tadarthamiti | paryāyeṇa pūrvottarayorbhāgayoḥ pluto yathā syādityevamartham | dviruktopalakṣaṇārthamiti | dviruktasamudāye bhāgadvayopalakṣaṇārthamityarthaḥ | etaccāmreḍitamātrasya bhartsane vṛttyasambhavāllabhyate, paryāyasya tu `ekaikasya' ityanuvṛtterlābhaḥ ||
aṅgayuktaṃ tiṅākāṅ‌kṣam || 8.2.96 ||
ākāṅ‌kṣatītyākāṅ‌kṣam, pacādyac | idānīṃ jñāsyasi jālmetyeṣa dvayorapyudāharaṇayoḥ śeṣaḥ | kūjanaphalaṃ vyāhāraphalaṃ vāsminneva kṣaṇe jñāsyasītyarthaḥ | aṅgaśabdo'marṣe, pratyudāharaṇe tvanunaye |
aṅga devadattetyetāvadekaṃ vākyam | etacva vākyaṃ mithyā vadasītyetadapekṣate ||
vicāryamāṇānām || 8.2.97 ||
koṭidvayasya vijñānaṃ vicāra iti kathyate |
vicāryamāṇastajjñānaviṣayībhūta ucyate ||
iha tu vicāryamāṇārthaviṣayatvādvākyāni vicāryamāṇāni | gṛha3i iti | gṛheśabdasya pūrvavat plutavikāraḥ | anupraharediti | anuprahāraḥ - śāyanam, vyatyayena karmaṇi kartṛpratyayaḥ, śāyayetetyarthaḥ | atha vānupraharedityatra yūpaṃ yajamāna ityasyādhyāhāraḥ, kiṃ yūpaṃ yajamānaḥ śāyayediti vicārārthaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ tu bhāṣāyām || 8.2.98 ||
pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat, tuśabdastviṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, yarthevaṃ vijñāyeta--pūrvameva bhāṣāyāmiti, maivaṃ vijñāyi---pūrvaṃ bhāṣāyāmeveti | pūrvartvaṃ ca prayogāpekṣam | udāharaṇe nuśabdo vitarke | loṣṭaḥ - mṛtpiṇḍaḥ ||
pratiśravaṇe ca || 8.2.99 ||
pratiśravaṇamabhyupagama iti | aṅgīkāraḥ | pratijñānamiti | prāthitasya deyatvena saṃvādaḥ | atrobhayatrāpi gatisamāsaḥ, arthadvaye'pi pratipūrvaḥ śrṛṇotiḥ prasiddhaḥ | śravaṇābhimukhyaṃ ceti | atra `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' ityavyayībhāvaḥ | udāharaṇāni tu vyutkrameṇa dattāni | kimāttha3 iti | kiṃ brūṣeityetatpṛcchati | atra ca śravaṇābhimukhyaṃ gamyate | hanta te dadāmi3 iti | atra prārthitasya saṃvādo gamyate | devadatta bhorityāmantritam | sa yadarthamāmantritastacchravaṇārthaṃ kimāttha iti | gāṃ me dehi bhoḥ, nityaḥ śabdo bhavitumarhati, tasmin tṛtīye tūdāharaṇe svābhyupagamo gamyate ||
anudāttaṃ praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ || 8.2.100 ||
praśnavākye yaccaramaṃ prayujyate sa praśnāntaḥ | kvacitpaṭhyate---nānena pluto vidhīyate, kintu dūrāddhatādiṣu vihitasya `anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' iti svaritaplutasyānudāttatvaṃ guṇamātraṃ vidhīyata iti | tatraiṣā vacanavyaktiḥ---praśnānte abhipūjite ca yaḥ plutaḥ so'nudātto bhavatīti | tatrābhipūjite `dūrāddhūte ca' iti pluta iti | itaratra tu `anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' iti | agamaḥ pūrvān grāmānityeṣāṃ svaritaḥ plutaḥ | agnibhūte, paṭo---ityanyatareṇa vākyaparisamāptirbhavati | tatra yadā yena vākyaparisamāptistadā tasyānenānudāttaḥ plutaḥ, sa ca pūrvabhāgasya; uttarabhāgasya tūdāttāvidutau bhavataḥ ||
ciditi copamārthe prayujyamāne || 8.2.101 ||
itikaraṇaḥ kimarthaḥ ? akriyamāṇe tasmin upamānārthe kasmiṃścicchabde prayujyamāne cicchabdaḥ pluta iti vijñāyeta | itikaraṇe tu sati `prayujyamāne' ityetaccicchabdasya viśeṣaṇam, plutastu `vākyasya ṭeḥ' ityadhikārāttasyaiva bhavati |
kathañciditi | atra kaṣṭe cicchabdaḥ | agnirmāṇavako bhāyāditi | agniriva māṇavako dīpyetetyarthaḥ | atropamārthasya gamyamānatvādasti cicchibdasya pratītiḥ, prayogastu nāsti | yadyapyanyepāmapyupamānārthānāmivādīnāmasti pratītiḥ, tathāpi cicchabdasyāpi tāvadastīti syādeva plutaḥ | cakāro'sya plutasya samuccayārthaḥ | samuccayaśca bhedādhiṣṭhāna iti plutāntaramevedamākhyātaṃ bhavati; anyathā pūrvasūtravat pūrvetveva plutanimitteṣvanudāttatvaguṇamātraṃ vidhīyata iti vijñāyeta | etadeva ca jñāpakam---pūrvasūtre guṇamātraṃ vidhīyata iti |
uparisvidāsīditi ca || 8.2.102 ||
atrāpi `vicāryamāṇānām' iti vihitasya plutasya guṇamātraṃ vidhīyate ||
svaritamāmreḍite'sūyāsammatikopakutsaneṣu || 8.2.103 ||
vāvacanaṃ karttavyamiti | `sarva eva plutaḥ' iti vacanamanyadīyamiti vārttikakāreṇa tāvadidaṃ paṭhitaṃ vṛttikāro'pi tadevāpaṭhat ||
kṣiyaśīḥ praiṣeṣu tiṅākākṣam || 8.2.104 ||
kṣiyā - ācārābhedaḥ, ācārollaṅghanam | iṣṭāśaṃsanam-āśīḥ | śabdena vyāpāraṇam - praiṣaḥ | kvacid vṛttāvapyayaṃ granthaḥ paṭhyate |
dīrga te āyurastu, agnīnvihareti | kṣiyāyāṃ tu na pratyudāhṛtam; nityasākāṅ‌kṣatvāt | na hi `svayaṃ ha rathena yāti' ityetāvatyukte ācārabhedo gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ? `upādhyāyaṃ padātiṃ gamayati' ityukte |
iha `uparisvidāsīditi ca' ityasyānantaram `aṅgayuktaṃ tiṅākāṅ‌kṣam' iti vaktavyam, tataḥ `kṣiyāśīḥ praiṣeṣu svaritaḥ' iti, tataḥ `āmreḍite'sūyāsammatikopakutsaneṣu' iti, evaṃ hi tiṅākāṅ‌kṣagrahaṇaṃ dvirna karttavyaṃ bhavati ? tathā tu na kṛtamityeva ||
anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ || 8.2.105 ||
sarveṣāmeva padānāmiti | nanvantyasyānudāttam, `praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ' ityanudāttaplutena bhavitavyam, tatkathameṣa svaritaḥ pluto bhavati ? ata āha---anantyasyeti | yadyapyatra vikalpo na śrutaḥ, tathāpyanenāpiśabdenāntyasyāpyayaṃ svaritaḥ pluto bhavati, tataścānudāttaplutaḥ pākṣikaḥ sampadyate iti bhāvaḥ | nanu cāpiśabda ākhyāne'ntyasamuccayena caritārthaḥ, tataḥ kim ? praśne'ntyasyānudāttasya nityaṃ plutaḥ prāpnoti, tatra vikalpābhāvānnaiṣa doṣaḥ | praśne'pyapiśabdasya tātparyaṃ gamyate; sahanirdiṣṭatvāt, tataśca praśnānte svaritānudāttayoḥ plutayorvikalpo bhaviṣyati ||
plutāvaica idutau || 8.2.106 ||
lakṣaṇāntareṇaivaicoḥ plutaprasaṅge tadavayavayoridutoḥ plutārthaṃ vacanam | vacanasāmarthyādvarṇaikadeśayorapīdud‌grahaṇena grahaṇam | aicaḥ plutaprasa,ṅge iti | kecidāhuḥ--`sūtre plutāviti plutiśabdātsaptamī, aicaḥ plutau prāptāyāmiti tadanena darśitam' iti, tadayuktam; `plutau' iti hi kriyānimitto'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ---iti prathamādvivacanāntatvena vyākhyāsyamānatvāt | tasmāt prakaraṇaprāptaye taduktam | udāharaṇe dūrāddhūte `guroranṛtaḥ' ityeva plutaḥ | yadi aikāraukārayoravayavayoridutoḥ plutaḥ kriyate, samudāyasya caturmātratā'rdhacaturthamātratā vā prāpnoti, katham ? imāvaicau samāhāravarṇau; mātrā'varṇasya, mātrevarṇovarṇayoḥ apare tvāhuḥ---ardhamātrā'varṇasya, adhyardhamātrevarṇovarṇayoriti | tatra pūrvasminkalpe idutoranena plute kṛte tayostisro mātraāḥ, avarṇasya caikā mātreti samudāyaścaturmātraḥ prāpnoti, pakṣāntare tvarddhacaturthamātraḥ prāpnotyata āha---atreti |
nanu ca trimātrasyācaḥ plutasaṃjñā kṛtā, tatkathaṃ dvimātrāvidutāvanena śakyete kartum ? ata āha---plutāviti hīti | anena plutāviti karttari niṣṭhā, na saṃjñāśabda iti darśayati | vṛddhiṃ gacchata ityartha iti | anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ plavatirvadhane'pi varttate | nanvevamapi na jñāyate---kimayatī sā vṛddhiriti ? ata āha---tāvatī ceti | evaṃ manyate---prakṛtamapi plutagrahaṇamatra sambadhyate, tataścāyamartho bhavati---aico'vayavāvidutau tathā vardhete yathā aicau plutau sampadyate iti | tasmādanabhimatāyā vṛddheraprasaṅga iti |
ardhatṛtīyamātrāviti | ardhūrūpā tṛtīyamātrā yostau tathoktau | iṣyate caturmātraḥ pluta iti | caturmātratayā vṛddhiriṣyata ityarthaḥ | asminpakṣe caturmātrasyāctvamapi bhavati | tena pratyaṅ‌ṅaitikāyana iti ṅamuḍ bhavati; glau trāteti `anaci ca' iti takāradvirvacanaṃ bhavati ||
eco'pragṛhyasyādūrāddhūte pūrvasyārdhasyāduttarasyedutau || 8.2.107 ||
viṣayaparigaṇanaṃ kartavyamiti | evadvivṛṇoti---praśnānteti | yathāviṣayamiti | praśnānte'nudāttaḥ svarito vā, śeṣa tūdāttaḥ | idutau punarudāttāveveti | anuvṛttasya udāttagrahaṇasyābhisambandhāt |
viṣṇubhūte iti | kathaṃ punaridaṃ parigaṇanasyodāharaṇam, yāvatā sūtre tu `adūrāddhūte' ityucyate ? ata āha---parigaṇanaṃ ceti | anyārthe'vaśyakarttavye parigaṇane tenaiva siddhatvād `adūrāddhūte' iti na vaktavyam, tataścedamapi parigaṇanasya pratyudāharaṇamupapadyata iti | gauriti | `asarvanāmasthāne' iti pratiṣedhāt sau parataḥ pūrvaṃ padaṃ na bhavati | atha yadā sāvapi padaṃ bhavatīti pakṣaḥ, tadā kasmānna bhavati ? uktametad `vākyapadayorantyasya' iti, visarjanīyaśabdaścātra vākyāntaḥ | nanvevaṃ padāntagrahaṇamityatra padaśabdena vākyamucyate'nvarthagrahaṇāt---padyate pratīyate'nena hetunārtha iti ? etacca `yājyāntaḥ' ityato'ntagrahaṇānuvṛttyā labhyate | agnibhūtā3iti | agnibhūtiśabdasya sambuddhau rūpam |
āmantrita iti | aprāpta eva plute vacanam || ||
tayoryvāvaci saṃhitāyām || 8.2.108 ||
kimarthamidamucyate, na `iko yaṇaci' ityeva siddham ? ata āha---idutorasiddhatvāditi | nanu siddhaḥ | plutassvarasandhiṣu, kathaṃ jñāyate ? `plutapragṛhyā aci' iti plutasya prakṛtibhāvavidhānāt | yasya hi vikāraḥ prāptaḥ, tasya prakṛtibhāvo vidheyaḥ; plutasya cāsiddhatve na tasya svarasandhyākhyo vikāraḥ prāpnoti | astu plutaḥ siddhaḥ, kimāyātamidutoḥ ? ucyate, plutaprakaraṇe yatkāya tatsvarasandhiṣu siddhamiti sāmānyena jñāpakamāśrayiṣyate, tataścedutorapi siddhatvātsiddha eva yaṇādeśaḥ, ata āha---athāpi kathañciditi | sāmānyapekṣaṃ jñāpakamityasyārthasya durjñātatvāt kathañcidityāha; yadīdaṃ nocyeta, agnā3i indram, paṭā3u udakamityatra ṣāṣṭhikaṃ yaṇādeśaṃ bādhitvā savarṇadīrghatvaṃ syāt, aganā3yāśetyādau ca `iko'savarṇe śākalyasya' iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt, atastadvādhanārthamidaṃ vaktavyameva | nanu ca tannivṛttaye yatnāntarasti, kiṃ punastat ? `iko yaṇaci' ityatroktam---`ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇādeśo vaktavyam', ya ik‌ plutapūrvaḥ na ca plutavikāraḥ, bho3yindraṃ gāyatīti bhoḥ śabdasya chāndasaḥ plutaḥ, tataḥ parasyekārasya nipātatvātprakṛtibhāve prāpte taṃ bādhitvā yaṇādeśaḥ, tadevaṃ tasyāvaśyakarttavyatvāttenaiva yaṇ‌ siddhaḥ ? ata āha---athāpīti | yaṇsvaranivṛttyarthamiti | yaṇaāśrayaḥ svaro yaṇsvaraḥ, etadeva vivṛṇoti---yaṇādeśasyeti |
uktamevārthaṃ ślokābhyāṃ saṃgṛhṇāti---kintviti | iko yaṇādeśena kiṃ na siddhaṃ rūpam, yato'yamācāryaḥ idutoryvau vidadhāti, tau cedutau svarasandhiṣu siddhau | mameti sūtrakāreṇaikībhūtasya vacanam | evaṃ codite pariharati---śākaladīrghavidhau tu nivartyāviti | śākalyasyedaṃ śākalam, `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' ityaṇ | punaścodayati---ik‌ ca pareti | vārttikakāro'pi ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇaṃ vidadhāti, sa ca prakṛtibhāvasyeva śākaladīrghavidhyorapyapavādaḥ, tataśca tenaiva yaṇā etayorapīdutoḥ śāvaladīrghau na bhaviṣyataḥ, nārtha etena ? pariharati---yaṇsvareti | yaṇsvarabādhanameva hetuḥ sūtrārambhasyeti ||
iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ padamañjaryāmaṣṭamādhyāyasya dvitīyaścaraṇaḥ
<8.3>
kāśikāvṛttiḥ --- 6
atha aṣṭamādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ
matuvaso ru sambuddhau chandasi || 8.3.1 ||
`yuvoranākau' itivanmatuvasoriti nirdeśo'nubandhaparityāgena vā sakārāntasya vasorgrahaṇam, nipātanāccālpāctarasya paranipātaḥ | ru---ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | marutva iti | `jhayaḥ' iti vatvam' tasau matvarthe' iti bhasaṃjñā | harivo medinamiti | `chandasīraḥ' iti vatvam, `saṃyogāntalopo ro rutve siddho vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanāt `haśi ca' ityutvam |
vana iti | kvanibvanipoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam | anubandhānirdeśādatra tadanubandhakaparibhāṣāyā anupasthānāt kvanipo'pi grahaṇam | prātaritva iti | prātaretīti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti kvanipi hrasvasya tuk | avaśabdasya ceti | sarvasyeti draṣṭavyam; anarthake'lontyaparibhāṣāyā abhāvāt | upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---nipātavijñānādveti | etadeva vivṛṇoti---atha veti | avaśyaṃ caitannipātatvameva vijñeyamityāha---asambuddhāvapi hīti |
striyāmiti | bho brāhmaṇīti | vibhaktinimitteṣu kāryeṣu liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata ityuktam---`na vā vibhaktau liṅgaviśiṣṭāgrahaṇāt' iti, tena bhavatīśabdasya rutvautve na syātām | athāpi syātām ? evamīkārasya rutve avaśabdasya caukāro rūpaṃ na sidhyati | tasmādasambuddhau striyāṃ ca darśanānnipātā eveti vijñeyam | nipātatvaṃ ca vibhaktisvarapratirūpakatveneti | nanvasatyasminnupasaṃkhyāne bhoityādikaḥ śabdo vibhaktyanto nāsti, yatpratirūpakā ete syuḥ ? tasmātsautrā ete nipātāḥ, `bhobhagoaghoḥ' ityatra sūtre nirdiṣṭāḥ, cādiṣu vā paṭhitavyāḥ | tadevaṃ pratyākhyātamupasaṃkhyānam |
anye tvāhuḥ---`itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante' iti bhavadādiyoge vidhīyamānāstasilādayaḥ, tataḥ `bho' ityādāvapi yathā syuriti vārttikārambha iti |
anye tu---bhavadāderaparigaṇitatvād nipātā bhoityādayo bhaviṣyantīti manyante ||
atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā || 8.3.2 ||
pūrvatvamidamāpekṣikam, rutvaṃ ca sannihitam | na ca tadapekṣaṃ pūrvatvaṃ sambhavati; roranunāsikasya ca sahavidhānāt | tasmādyasya rurvidhīyate tadapekṣameva pūrvatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha---yasya sthāna iti |
athātragrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? atra ruprakaraṇe yathā syāt | adhikārādapyetat siddham, adhikāre hi sati rutvānunāsikayoḥ saha vidhānānnānyatra prasaṅgaḥ ? atha āha---atragrahaṇamiti | avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam---ruṇaiva saheti | nanvadhikārādapyetatsiddhamityuktam ? ata āha---adhikāreti | asatyatragrahaṇe anunāsikādhikārasya parimāṇaṃ na jñāyeta---etāvatsu yogeṣvasya vyāpāra iti, tataśca ruprakaraṇātparatrāpyasyādhikāraḥ sambhāvyetetyarthaḥ | tuśabdaḥ parasmātkāryiṇaḥ pūrvasya viśeṣadyotanārthaḥ---parasya nityaṃ rutvam, pūrvasya tu vānunāsika iti |
vāvacanamanarthakam, jñāpakātsiddham, yadayamuttaratra sūtre yasyānunāsiko na vihitastasmādroḥ pūrvasmātparamanusvāraṃ śāsti; tato jñāyate---vikalpenāyaṃ bhavatīti | na hi nitye'sminvidhau sa roḥ pūrvaḥ sambhavati, yasyānunāsiko vihita ||
āto'ṭi nityam || 8.3.3 ||
keciditi | taittirīyāḥ | anusvāramadhīyata iti | śuddhā dākārātparam | nityagrahaṇamanarthakam, arambhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhiḥ siddhaḥ ? astyārambhe prayojanam niyamo yathā syāt---āta evāṭi, anyeṣāṃ tu neti | kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati vidheyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā, iha cāsti vidheyam, kim ? nityo'nunāsikaḥ ||
anunāsikāt paro'nusvāraḥ || 8.3.4 ||
anyaśabdo'trādhyāharttavya iti | asatyadhyāhāre paraśabdasya śrutatvāttadapekṣayevaṃ `anunāsikāt' ityeṣā pañcamī syāt---paraśabdasya digvṛttiḥ, anyārthavṛttirvā, pūrvavṛttirvā | pūrvasminkalperoḥ pūrvasmādanunāsikādevaparo'nusvāro vijñāyeta, na ca tasmātpara iṣyate | itarasmiṃstvamanunāsikādanyo'nusvāro bhavatītyartho bhavati, tatra cānarthakaṃ paragrahaṇam, na hyanusvāro'nunāsikāpekṣayā'nyatvaṃ vyabhicarati | tasmādanyaśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | sa ca paraśabdāpekṣayā pañcamyanto'dhyāhāryaḥ | pūrvasyetyetadapyatrānuvṛttaṃ para ityanena yogātpañcamyantaṃ vipariṇamyate | evaṃ sthite yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayati--anunāsikādanya iti | kaḥ punarasau ? ityāha---yasyānunāsiko na kṛta iti | anusvāra āgamo bhavatīti | ṭittvādyāgamaliṅgābhāve'pi paraśabhdenānusvārasya deśaviśeṣasampādanādāgamatvam, yathā---`na yvābhyāṃ pūrvāvaic' iti ||
samaḥ suṭi || 8.3.5 ||
`mo'nusvāraḥ' ityanusvāre prāpte vacanam | saṃskartteti | `samparyuyebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' iti suṭ‌, samo makārasya rutvam, tasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasya `vā śari' iti vikalpe yathā nityaṃ sakāro bhavati tathā darśitam |
kathaṃ punarasminsūtre sakāro nirdiśyate ? ityāha---samaḥ ssuṭīti dvisakārako nirdeśa iti | sa ca suṭaḥ sakāre sandehābhāvāttadvyatirekeṇa dvisakārakatvam | vastutastu trayaḥ sakārāḥ---eko vibhaktisambandhī, dvitīya ādeśaḥ, tṛtīyastu rusambandhī | yadi tarhi sakāre ādeśo vidhīyate, anunāsiko na prāpnoti; yasmādatragrahaṇaṃ ruṇā saha sanniyogapratipattyarthamityuktam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra ruprakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthaṃ tatra rugrahaṇam | etena pūrvasūtre roḥ pūrva iti vyākhyātam | tadatra satve kṛte yadā pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ, tadā satvasyāsiddhatvādrutvābhāvāt `anaci ca' iti dvirvacane `jharo jhari' iti pākṣike lope dvisakārakaḥ, trisakārako vā prayogaḥ | yadā tvanusvāraḥ, tadā'yogavāhānāṃ aṭ‌pratyāhāra upadeśacodanāttasya ca haltvāt `jharo jhari' iti vā lope dvisakārakaḥ, ekasakārako vā prayogaḥ | yadā tvanusvārasya haltvavadactvamapīṣyate, tadā tataḥ parasya dvirvacanapakṣe sakāratrayamapi bhavati | tadevaṃ pañca rūpāṇi bhavanti---anunāsikapakṣe dvau sakārau, trayo vā, anusvārapakṣe dvāvekastrayo vā | pañcasvapi pakṣeṣu `śaraḥ khayaḥ' iti vā kakārasya dvirvacane kṛte daśa rūpāṇi bhavanti | samo vā lopameke | eke ācāryāḥ samo vikalpena lopamicchanti, atrāpyanunāsikānusvārau bhavataḥ | tasyāpi ruprakaraṇe vidhānāttatrānunāsikapakṣe sakārasya `anacica' iti dvirvacane pākṣike ca lope ekasakārakatvamapi kadācidbhavati | tatrāpi kakārasya pakṣe dvirvacanamiti dvādaśa rūpāṇi bhavanti ||
pumaḥ khayyampare || 8.3.6 ||
puṃsaḥ sakārādavaśiṣṭo yo bhāgastasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sakārasya saṃyogāntalope kṛte tasyaiva kāyitvāt | amiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam, na dvitīyaikavacanasya; khayā pratyāhāreṇa sāhacaryāt | puṃścalīti | pacādau calaḍiti pāṭhānṅīp, puṃścalīti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | puṃskāmeti | pumāṃsaṃ kāmayata iti `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇaḥ' iti ṇaḥ | tasmādatra sakāra evādeśo vaktavya iti | `kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca' ityatraitadvaktavyam |
dvisakārakanirdeśapakṣe tviti | yadā pūrvasūtre `dvisakārako nirdeśaḥ' iti pakṣaḥ, tadetyarthaḥ | sa ityanuvartate iti |
nanu ca rurapi prakṛtaḥ, so'pi prāpnītītyata āha---rutvaṃ tviti | asambandhe kāraṇamāha---sambandhānuvṛttistasyati | itikaraṇo hetau, yasmādasau svasambandhinā yaḥ sambandhastamanuvarttate taṃ na jahāti tasmādityarthaḥ | yadvā---sambadhyata iti sambandhaḥ | yasmādiha svasambaddhameva tadanuvartate tasmādityarthaḥ | rutvaṃ khalvihānuvarttamānamapi `matuvaso ru sambuddhau' iti svena sambandhinā sambaddhamevānuvarttate, tasya prayojanam---sambandhyantareṇa roḥ sambandho mā mūditi |
puṃdāsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ | puṃgava iti | `gorataddhitaluki' iti ṭacsamāsāntaḥ | paragrahaṇe kriyamāṇe khayi parato yo'm tatretyapi vijñāyeta, tataśca pumakṣaḥ pumācāraḥ---ityatraiva syāt; tasmātparagrahaṇam ||
naśchavyapraśān || 8.3.7 ||
praśānvarjitasyeti | sūtre tu `apraśān' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā | ṭīkatirgatyartho'nudāttet | tsaruḥ - khaṅgagrahaṇapradeśaḥ, tatra kuśalaḥ tsarukaḥ, ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan ||
dīrghādaṭi samānapāde || 8.3.9 ||
ekaparyāyaḥ samānaśabdaḥ -samānapāda ityucyate, tatredaṃ na sidhyati---yajāmahe yajñiyānhanta devān ilāmahayiti ? chāndasatvād bhaviṣyati |
nṝnpe || 8.3.10 ||
nṝniti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā | evamuttaratrāpi `pe' ityakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, pakāramātraṃ nimittam ||
svatavānpāyau || 8.3.11 ||
`tu vṛddhau' sautro dhātuḥ, tato'sun---svaṃ tavo yasyā'sau svatavān, `dṛksvavaḥ svatasāṃ chandasi' iti num ||
kānāmreḍite || 8.3.12 ||
`kānkān' iti vaktavye āmreḍitagrahaṇaṃ yatra dvirvacanaṃ tatraiva yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt---kānkān paśyatīti, eko'tra kiṃ śabdaḥ praśne, dvitīyaḥ kṣepe |
samaḥ suṭītyato vā sakāro'nuvartata iti | yadyevam, pūrveṣvapi yogeṣu sa eva prāpnoti ? ityata āha---pūrveṣu yogeṣviti |
ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ || 8.3.13 ||
ākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, ḍhakāramātraṃ nimittam; tena leḍhā, leḍhītyādāvapi bhavati | līḍhamityādau `ho ḍhaḥ', `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ', `jhaṣastathordho'dhaṛ', ṣṭutvam, tato'nena ḍhalopaḥ | nanu cāsiddhaṃ ṣṭutvaṃ tatkathamatra lopaḥ ? tatrāha---ṣṭutvasyeti | ucyate cedam---ḍhe parato ḍhasya lopo bhavatīti, tatra ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatve nirviṣayametatsyāt |
nanu ca yatrautpatiko ḍhakāraḥ---śvaliḍ‌ḍhaukata ityādau, tatra sāvakāśaḥ syādata āha---śvaliḍ‌ḍhaukata ityatreti | jaśtve kṛta iti | ekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgatvāt `pūrvatrāsiddham' iti lopasyāsiddhatvādvā pūrvaṃ jaśtvam | nanu ca nirviṣayatvād ḍhalopo jaśtvaṃ bādheta ? netyāha---na ceti | kutaḥ ? ityāha---tasya hīti |
kathaṃ punarlīḍhādiravakāśaḥ, yāvatā yathā śvaliḍ‌ḍhaukate ityatra jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo'bhāvaḥ, tathā līḍhādāvapi ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvānnimittasyābhāvaḥ; atha tatra vacanasāmarthyāt ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ bādhyate, tadetaratrāpi jaśtvaṃ bādhanīyam, vaktavyo vā viśeṣaḥ ? ata āha---tatra hīti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---lopena tāvadasiddhatvamavaśyaṃ bādhyam, tatra līḍhamityādāvekameva `pūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhatvam, atastadeva bādhyate; śvaliḍ‌ḍhaukata ityatra tu ḍhalopasya jaśtvāpekṣayā bahiraṅgatvāt paratvācca dvividhamasiddhatvamiti na tadvādhyate | tato jaśtve kṛte na śrutikṛtamānantaryam, nāpi śāstrakṛtam; jaśtvasyāsiddhatvābhāvāditi ḍhalopasyāyamaviṣaya iti ||
ro ri || 8.3.14 ||
kimidaṃ sānubandhakasya rorgrahaṇam ? āhosvidrephasya ? kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? tulyātra saṃhitā---roḥ ri, raḥ rīti | kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadi sānubandhakasya grahaṇam, siddhamindūrathaḥ agnīrathaḥ; idaṃ tu na sidhyati---nīraktam, dūraktamiti | atha rephasya grahaṇam, siddhaṃ nīraktaṃ dūraktamiti; idaṃ tu na sidhyatiagnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti, `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, varṇagrahaṇeṣu naiṣā paribhāṣā pravarttate |
padasyetyatra viśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhīti | etacca `padasya' `padāt' ityatraiva vyākhyātam | tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? ityāha---teneti | sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu repheṇa padasya viśeṣaṇādrephāntasya padasya lopena bhavitavyam | ajarghā iti | `ekāco baśo bhaṣ‌' ityatraitad vyutpāditam | apāspā iti | `sparddha saṅgharṣe', yaṅ‌luki `dīrgho'kitaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ, laṅi sipi śapo luk, sipo halṅyādilopaḥ; jaśtvam, `daśca' iti rutvam ||
kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ || 8.3.15 ||
yadyatrāpi padasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī syāt, tadā cakarṣa, karkaśa ityādāvapadāntasyāpi rephasya visarjanīyaḥ syāt | sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu repheṇa pade viśeṣite rephāntasya padasyālontyasya visarjanīyavidhānānna kaściddoṣa iti manyamāna āha---rephāntasya padasyeti | khari parato'vasāne ceti | `parataḥ' ityetatkharaiva sambadhyate, nāvasānena; asambhavāt | yena varṇena viramyate sa evāvasānaṃ syāt | viratiḥ-varṇasyānuccāraṇam | tatra padāntasya rephasya yena varṇana viramyate sa tāvatparo na sambhavati | itaratpunaravasānamabhāvarūpam, na cābhāvena paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati | tasmāt `kharavasānayoḥ' ityekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedāddhidyatekhari parasaptamī, avasāne viṣayasaptamīti |
apara āha---varṇeṣvapyuccaritapradhvaṃsiṣu buddhiviracitaṃ paurvāparyamasti, tattvabhāvenāpi sambhavati; tasmādubhayatrāpi parasaptamīti | udāharaṇeṣu khari visarjanīyasya satvam, cavarge ścutvam, ṭavarge ṣṭutvam |
nārpatya iti | patyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ | vṛddherbahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāditi | bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvād ??vṛddherbahiraṅgatvam | tadāśrayasya rephasyeti | tadāśrayatvaṃ tu tayā saha vidhānāt | `uraṇ‌ raparaḥ' ityetaddhi guṇavṛddhividhibhirekatāmāpādya raparatvaṃ vidhatte, tena vṛddheryannimittaṃ tadeva rephasyāpi, tatastasyāpi bahiraṅgatvam | visarjanīyastu kharmātramāśritya bhavannantaraṅgaḥ | nanu bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā `vāha ūṭh‌' ityatra jñāpitatvāttaddeśā, tataḥ kim ? tasyāṃ karttavyāyāṃ visarjanīyaḥ `pūrvatrāsiddham' ityasiddhaḥ, sā kathamantaraṅgamapaśyantī bahiraṅgasyāsiddhatvamāpādayati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam', tataśca paribhāṣāntaravad bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apyatra prakaraṇe pravṛttiraviruddhā ||
roḥ supi || 8.3.16 ||
payaḥ sviti | yatra sakāradvayaṃ paṭhyate tatra `vā śira' iti visarjanīyasya vā sakāraḥ | sarpiḥ ṣviti | yatra visarjanīyaḥ paṭhyate tatra `numvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' iti pratyayasakārasya ṣatvam | ṣakāradvayapāṭhe tu pūrvavaddhisarjanīyasya sattvam, parasya pūrvavadeva ṣatvam, pūrvasya ṣṭutvam | saptamībahuvacanaṃ gṛhyata iti | na pratyāhāraḥ; `khari' ityanuvṛtteḥ, na hi saptamībahuvacanādanyaḥ sup kharādirasti | tena payobhyāmityādau vidhyarthaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? niyamārtham, yadāhasiddhe satyārambho niyamārtha iti | roreva supīti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---roḥ supyeveti; `halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ' ityādinirdeśāt ||
bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi || 8.3.17 ||
aśgrahaṇamanarthakamanyatrābhāvāt, aśo'nyaḥ kharbhavati, tatra ca `pūrvatrāsiddham' iti yatvasyāsiddhatvādvisarjanīyena bhāvyam, kṛte visarjanīye sthānivadbhāvād rugrahaṇe grahaṇāt syātprasaṅga iti cet ? na; alsthānikatvāt | atra hi roryo rephasya visarjanīyasya sthānī, na punā rureva | kiñca---yatvasyāpyasya roryo rephaḥ sa eva sthānī, na punā rureva | tasmādalvidhitvādapi nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | saṃhitādhikārāccāvasāne yatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tasmādaśgrahaṇamanarthakam ? ityata āha---aśgrahaṇamuttarārthamiti | etadeva vyanakti---hali sarveṣāmiti | vṛkṣavayaterapratyaya iti | sa punarvica, na kvip | kvipi hi ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvayati grahaṇena grahaṇādvakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ syāt | `lopo vyorvali' iti valopaḥ | sthānivattvaṃ ca ṇeratra kvau luptatvānna vidyate | vici tu ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvādvalopo nāsti | samprasāraṇasya tvaprasaṅga eva | `hali sarveṣām' ityanena tu lope kartavye `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' iti sthānivattvaniṣedhād valopaḥ syāditi viśeṣyate | atha kakāre parataḥ `lopo vyoḥ' iti valopaḥ kasmānna bhavati, ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvo nāsti, padāntavidhau pratiṣedhāt, vakārasya padāntatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhāvasādhanastvatra vidhiśabdaḥ, tataśca padānte vidhīyamāne sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ | na ca lopaḥ padāntaḥ; tasyābhāvarūpatvāt |
atheti | yadi `hali sarveṣām' ityatrāśgrahaṇasya prayojanam, tatraivaṃ vaktavyam---`haśi' iti, tatkiṃ halgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā'śgrahaṇena tadviśeṣyata iti praśnārthaḥ | evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, tatra haśgrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtamiti | uttarārthamiti | yadi tatra haśgrahaṇam̐ kriyate, `mo'nusvāraḥ' ityatra punarhalgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | halmātre yathā syāditi | sarvathobhābhyāṃ grahaṇābhyāṃ na mucyāmahe iti bhāvaḥ | tathāpyatrāśgrahaṇānurodhe prayojanaṃ vaktavyam ? tadāha---vyorlaghuprayatnatara iti ||
vyorlaghuprayatnataraḥ śākaṭāyanasya || 8.3.18 ||
atiśayena laghuprayatnaḥ-laghuprayatnataraḥ | varṇoccāraṇaheturātmadharmaḥ - prayatnaḥ | udāharaṇeṣvāntaryato vakārasya vakāraḥ, yakārasya yakāraḥ | kiṃ punaridaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam ? ityāha---laghuprayatnataratvamiti | sthānam-tālvādi, jihvāyā agropāgramadhyamūlāni-karaṇāni, prayatnasya laghutve tāni śithilāni-laghūni bhavanti ||
lopaḥ śākalyasya || 8.3.19 ||

oto gārgyasya || 8.3.20 ||
ākārāduttarasya yakārasyeti | vakārastvasminviṣaye na sambhavati | nityārtho'yamārambha iti | vikalpasya pūrvaṇaiva siddhatvāt |
