uñi ca pade || 8.3.21 ||
bhūtapūrveṇa ñakāreṇeti | bhūlodāharaṇe'pi bhūtapūrveṇaiva ñakāreṇoñiti pratipattiḥ; anubandhasya prayoge'samavāyāt | uttarārthamiti | `ṅamo hrasvādachi ṅamuṇnityam' ityeṣa vidhirajādau pade yathā syāt, ida mā bhūt---daṇḍineti | naitadasti prayojanam; `padasya' iti varttate | iha tarhi paramadaṇḍinā, atra hi subantasya samāsa iti padatvamasti ? nāsti; uktaṃ hi `uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti | tadetatpadagrahaṇaṃ tiṣṭhatu tāvat | ayamapi nityārtho yogaḥ ||
hali sarveṣām || 8.3.22 ||
yakārasya padāntasyeti | vakārastu bhobhagoaghopūrvo na sambhavati | avarṇapūrvastu sambhavati--vṛkṣav karotīti | tasya tu lopo na bhavati, aśi halīti viśeṣaṇādityuktam | tasmādyakārasyetyuktam | nanu vṛkṣav hasatītyādau sambhavati ? na sambhavati; anabhidhānāt, nahyevaṃvidhamabhidhānamasti | tathā ca `laṇ‌' ityatra bhāṣyakāra āha---`na padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santi' iti | evaṃ ca vṛkṣav karotītyayamapi prayogaścintyaḥ ||
mo|ñanusvāraḥ || 8.3.23 ||
atra padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, makāreṇa padasya viśeṣaṇānnakārāntasya padasyālontyasyānusvāro vijñāyate | tadāha---makārasya padāntasyati ||
naścāpadāntasya jhali || 8.3.24 ||
ākraṃsyata iti | kramerlṛṭ‌, `āṅa ud‌gamane' ityātmanepadam ||
mo rāji samaḥ kvau || 8.3.25 ||
samrāḍiti | `satsūdviṣa' ityādinā kvip, vraścādinā ṣatvam | sāmrājyamiti | kvibantād brāhmaṇaāditvāt ṣyañ‌ | adhikasadbhāve'pi kvibanto rājatistāvadastītyatrāpi bhavati, kvibantāvasthāyāmeva vā prāgeva ṣyaña utpattermatvam |
saṃyaditi | `gamaḥ kvau' ityatra gamādīnāmiti vacanāllopaḥ, hrasvasya tuk | kirāḍiti | `kiṃ kṣepe' iti samāsaḥ ||
he mapare vā || 8.3.26 ||
hmalayatīti | `hmala calane', ṇic, `jvalahvalahmalanamāmanupasargādvā' iti pakṣe mitsaṃjñā, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasvatvam |
yavalapara iti | yavalāḥ pare yasmādvakāratsa tathoktaḥ, yavalāścaite bhavanta āntaratamyādanunāsikā bhavanti, vāvacanātpakṣe'nusvāro'pi bhavati |
paragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum; saptamyaiva tadarthalābhāt---makāre parato yo hakārastatreti | viparyayastu na bhavati; asambhavāt | na hi makārātparo hakāraḥ kvacit sambhavati ||
ṅaṇoḥ kukṭuk śari || 8.3.28 ||
udāharaṇeṣu `khayo dvitīyāḥ śari pauṣkarasādeḥ' iti pakṣe kakārasya khakāraḥ, ṭakārasya ṭhakāraḥ |
pūrvāntakaraṇamityādi | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃpadādau chatvaṃ na sidhyatītyata āha---śaścho'ṭīti | virapśinniti | mahannāmaitat, vipūrvādraperauṇādikaḥ karmaṇi śinipratyayaḥ | yadi vā virapaṇaṃ virap, so'syāstīti virapśaḥ - śabditaḥ, saṅkīrtata ityarthaḥ |
ṣatvapratiṣedhārthamiti | parādau tu sakāraḥ padādirna syāt |
ṣṭutvapratiṣedhārthamiti | parādau tu ṭakāraḥ padānto na syāt ||
ṅaḥ si dhuṭ‌ || 8.3.29 ||
`ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān' iti `ḍaḥ' iti pañcamyā sīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyata iti matvā''ha---ḍakārāntāditi | saptamīnirdeśastu lāghavārthaḥ | udāharaṇeṣu dhuṭi kṛte cartvam--takāraḥ, tasya pūrvavatpakṣe thakāraḥ |
atha kimarthaṃ dhuṭ parādiḥ kriyate---na dhugeva pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ hi `śituk' ityatra tuggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, eṣa dhuk tatrānuvarttiṣyate ? ata āha---parādikaraṇamiti | prakriyālāghavārthaṃ tuḍiti vaktavye dhuḍ‌grahaṇamuttarārtham---`naśca' iti dhuḍyathāsyāt, tuṇmā bhaūt | kiñca syāt, bhavāntsāya ityatra `naśchavyapraśān' iti rutvaṃ prasajyeta ? naitadasti; ampara iti tatrānuvarttate | kiñca---tuṭo'siddhatvādapi roraprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāttuḍeva vaktavyaḥ ||
naśca || 8.3.30 ||
atrāpi parāditvāt kurvan sīdatītyādau `padāntasya' iti ṇatvapratiṣedho bhavati |
dhuṭaścartvasyāsiddhatvāditi | dhuṭo yaccartvaṃ tasyāsiddhatvādityarthaḥ | yadyapi dhuḍapyasiddhaḥ, tathāpi na taducyate; siddhe'pi tasminvinā cartvena rutvasyāprāpteḥ | nanvastu cartvamasiddham, tathāpi naiva ruḥ prāpnoti, anamparatvāt ? satyam; yastvasau dhuṭa ukāraḥ, tena bhūtapūrveṇāmparatvamaṃbhyupetyaitaduktam | anye tu granthamimaṃ na paṭhanti ||
śi tuk || 8.3.31 ||
`śi' ityeṣā saptamyakṛtārthā pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati, tadāha---nakārasyeti |
atha kimarthamapūrvaḥ pūrvāntastuk kriyate, na prakṛtaḥ parādirdhuḍeva vidhīyeta, tatrāpi cartvena sidhyatyeva ? ata āha---pūrvāntakaraṇamiti | pūrvāntasyāpūrvasyatukaḥ karaṇamityarthaḥ | nakārasyāpadāntatvāditi | tukā padāntatāyā vihatatvāt | parādau tu `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhādadoṣaḥ | tatretyādi | tatra tuko yaccutvaṃ tadāśrayātsiddhaṃ bhavati ||
ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ‌ nityam || 8.3.32 ||
ṅamaḥ, ṅamuṭ---ityubhayatrāpi pratyāhāragrahaṇam | uḍiti pratyekaṃ ṅakārādibhiḥ sambadhyate | saṃjñāyāṃ hi kṛtamāgamaliṅgaṃ saṃjñināṃ bhavati | hrasvādityetanṅamo viśeṣaṇam, so'pi ṅam padasya viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavati | padasyeti prakṛtaṃ yadyapi ṣaṣṭhyantam, tathāpi `hamaḥ' ityanena sambandhāt pañcamyantaṃ vipariṇamyate | `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān' iti `ṅamaḥ' iti pañcamyā `aci' iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate | saptamīnirdeśastu lāghavārthaḥ, uttarārthaśca | tadetatsarvaṃ manasi kṛtvāha---hrasvātpara iti | saṃkhyātānudeśaśca devatitavyaḥ; āgamānāmam, āgamināṃ ca samatvāt |
paramadaṇḍinetyādau subantayoḥ samāsaḥ, tatra samāsārthāyāṃ vibhaktau luptāyāmapi pratyayalakṣaṇena daṇḍinnityasya padatvamastīti ṅamuṭ‌ prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha---iheti | samāse ya uttaro bhāgastasya padatve karttavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati, apadādividhau-padādividhiṃ varjayitvā | `sātpadādyoḥ' ityatra padādividhau pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | etadvārttikakāramatenoktam |
sūtrakāramatenāpyāha---atha veti ||
maya uño vo vā || 8.3.33 ||
`iko yaṇaci' ityanenaiva siddhatvānnārtho'nena ?---ityāśaṅkyāha---pragṛhyatvāditi | pragṛhyatvaṃ ca `nipāta ekājanāṅ‌' iti | evamapi `iko yaṇaci' ityasyānantaram `maya uño vā' iti vaktavyam, evaṃ hi vagrahaṇa na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? tatrāha---tasyāsiddhatvāditi | yadā tvitipara uñ‌ bhavati mayaśca paraḥ, tadā `uñaḥ' iti prakagṛhyasaṃjñāyā vikalpaḥ, ūm̐ādeśaśca; tatra yadā pragṛhyasaṃjñā na bhavati tadānena vatvaṃ ca prāpnoti yaṇādeśaśca, tatrāsya vatvasyāsiddhatvādyaṇādeśe satyanusvāro'pi bhavati---kiṃviti | pragṛhyasaṃjñaāpakṣe tvanena vā vatvam---kivviti, kimu iti | ūm̐ādeśasyāpi sthānivadbhāvādanena pakṣe vakāro bhavati, sa cāntaratamatvādanunāsikaḥ, taccaturthaṃ rūpam | ūm̐ādeśasyaiva vatvābhāvapakṣe śravaṇam, tatpañcamaṃ rūpam ||
visarjanīyasya saḥ || 8.3.34 ||
iha kharavasānayordvayorapi rephasya visarjanīya uktaḥ, tatreha nimittaviśeṣānupādānātkhari vāvasāne'pi satvaṃ prāpnoti--vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣa iti ? sahitāyāmiti vartate, na cāvasāne saṃhitāsti; parasyābhāvāt | mā bhūtparaḥ, pūrveṇa yā saṃhitā tadāśrayaṃ satvaṃ prāpnoti, `iko yaṇaci' ityādau tu kāryinimittayordvayorapyupāttatvāttayoreva parasparaṃ saṃhitāśrīyata iti dadhi-atreti pūrvaparābhyāmigacoḥ saṃhitāyāṃ satyāmapi kāryaṃ na bhavati; parasparamasaṃhitatvāt | syādetat | sāmānyavihitā saṃhitāsaṃjñā, viśeṣavihitāvasānasaṃjñā; kāryayorekavarṇaviṣayatvātkāryārthatvācca saṃjñānāṃ saṃjñayorapyekaviṣayatvādvādhyabhādakabhāvaḥ | yadvā---`sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā' itīyatā siddhe paragrahaṇamatiśayapratipattyartham---prakṛṣṭo yaḥ sannikarṣaḥ | kaśca prakṛṣṭaḥ ? yaḥ pūrvaparābhyāmubhābhyāmapi | tadabhāvādavasānasya saṃhitāsaṃjñāyā abhāvaḥ | yadyevam, aṇo|ñapragṛhasyānunāsike doṣaḥ, tatra hi `vāvasāne' iti varttate; saṃhitādhikāraścottarārtho'vaśyamanuvartyaḥ---`toli' iti parasavarṇo'saṃhitāyāṃ mā bhūt---agnicit lunātīti, tataśca saṃhitāvasānobhayāśrayo'nunāsiko dadhi ityādau na syāditi saṃhitāvasānasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśa eṣitavyaḥ, tataścāvasāne'pi satvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---kharītyanuvarttata iti | tadanuvṛttiśca maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena, sambandhānuvṛttyā vā veditavyā; anyathā hi pūrvatrāpi khari kārya vijñāyeta |
kiṃ punaratra pramāṇaṃ kharītyanuvarttate iti ? uttaratra śarpara iti vacanam, sa hi bahuvrīhiḥ, tasyānyapadārthāpekṣāyā yo visarjanīyātparaḥ sambhavati sa evānyapadārthaḥ, sa ca kharevaḥ, avasānasya śarparatvāsambhavāt | yadvā---yadi kharavasānayordvayorapi satvaṃ syāt visarjanīyavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; `kharavasānayossaḥ' ityeva vācyaṃ syāt | evaṃ hi `visarjanīyasya' iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | avaśyam `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasya sthāninirdeśārthaṃ visarjanīyasyeti vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam; purastādapakarṣeṇāpyetatsiddham, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---`ro ri kharavasānayoḥ saḥ, roḥ supi śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti, śarpara ityatra `ra' iti varttate, na tu `roḥ' iti, tena sugīḥ tsarukaḥ, puruṣaḥ tsarukaḥ ityādau sarvatra bhavati | atha `bhobhaghoagho' ityādisūtraṃ kutra kariṣyasi ? `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityasyānantaram | yadyevam, svaratra, svarnayatītyādāvapi yatvaprasaṅga iti punā rugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam ? evaṃ tarhi `roḥ supi' ityasyānantaram `bhobhago' ityādi rusthānikādeśavidhānārthaṃ paṭhitvā `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityādikaṃ paṭhiṣyate | evamapi punāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyam; ruṇā vicchinnatvāt ? evamapi yathānyāse sati trīṇi grahaṇāni---dve visarjanīyagrahaṇe, tṛtīyaṃ sagrahaṇam; anyathānyāse tu dve sagrahaṇe rugrahaṇaṃ ca | tadevaṃ laghīyasā nyāsena siddhe visarjanīyavidhānasāmarthyānna sarvatra satvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
evamapi kuta etat---khari bhavati, na punaravakhāna iti ? jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ śarpare khari visarjanīyaṃ vidhatte, tajjñāpavati---khari tāvadasti satvamiti | viparyaye hi puraṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau satvābhāvādastyeva visarjanīya iti tadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | naitadasti jñāpakam; astyetasya vavane prayojanam, kim ? vāsaḥ kṣaumam, adbhiḥ psātamityādau jihvāmūlayopadhmānīvau mā bhūtāmiti ? naitadasti; yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāt `kutvoḥ ḥkaḥpau vā śari' ityeva brūyāt | tadevaṃ vidhānasāmarthyātkharyevāyaṃ vidhiḥ | anena caivābhiprāyeṇa `kharītyanuvarttate' ityuktam ||
śapare visarjanīyaḥ || 8.3.35 ||
śarparo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ, paragrahaṇe'kriyamāṇe śaraeva kevalasya nimittatā vijñāyeta, na kharītyanuvṛtteḥ, `vā śari' ityabhidhānācca | viparyayastarhi vijñāyeta---kharpare śarīti, nityaḥ sphoṭaḥ, puruṣaḥ sthāteti | tasmātparagrahaṇam |
atha kimarthaṇ, `visarjanīyaḥ' ityucyate, na `na' ityevocyeta, satve hi pratiṣiddhe visarjanīyaḥ svenaiva rūpeṇāvasthāsyate ? atha āha---visarjanīyasyeti | satyam; puruṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau satvaniṣedhenāpi siddham, yatra tu kupū śarparau---vāsaḥ kṣaumam, addhiḥ psātamiti, tasya visarjanīyasya yo vikāro jihvāmūlīyādiḥ sa eva syāt | visarjanīyagrahaṇe tu sati visarjanīya eva bhavati | jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāvapi na bhavata iti | kevalaṃ sakāra evetyapi śabdārthaḥ ||
vā śari || 8.3.36 ||
vṛkṣā sthātāra iti | lopābhāvapakṣe visarjanīyaḥ, satvaṃ vā ||
kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca || 8.3.37 ||
visarjanīyaśceti | anena cakāro visarjanīyānukarṣaṇārtha iti darśayati | atha vāgrahaṇamevānuvartya jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyau kasmānna vilpyete, evaṃ hi cakāro na karttavyo bhavati ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hyābhyāmukte `visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti satvameva syāt | tasmāccakāreṇaivānukṛṣya visarjanīyo vidhātavyaḥ, vāgrahaṇaṃ ca nānuvartyam | tadanuvṛttau hi tribhirapi mukhye pakṣe satvaṃ prasajyeta |
sūtre kakārapakārasahitayorjihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyayoruccāraṇāttathābhūtāveva visarjanīyasyādeśāviti śaṅkamānaṃ pratyāha---kapāvuccāraṇārthāviti | tābhyāṃ vinā tayoruccārayitumaśakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kīdṛśau tarhyādeśau ? ityāha---jihvāmūlīyeti | iha visarjanīyasya sthāne ādeśatrayaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca śarparayoreva kupvoḥ prāpnoti---vāsaḥ kṣaumam, adbhiḥ psātamiti, atra hi `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti visarjanīyo'sti, na ca tasya vaiyarthyam; yatra kupubhyāmanyaḥ śarparaḥ kharastipuruṣaḥ tsaruka ityādau, tatra sāvakāśatvāt | aśarparayostu kupvorna syāt, na hi tasya visarjanīyo'sti, `visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti satvena nirvartitatvāt | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ satvameva tāvadbhavati ? tatra karttavye tasya vidherasiddhatvāt | tasmādatra sakāraḥ sthānī nirdeṣṭavyaḥ---yaḥ `visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti saḥ, tasya sthāne kupvorādeśatrayaṃ bhavatīti |
evaṃ hi śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ sakārāpavādo visarjanīyo vidhīyeta iti sakārābhāvādādeśāprasaṅgaḥ, kevalayostvādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, tasmātsasyeti vaktavyam, yadāha vārttikakāraḥ---`sakārasya kupvorvisarjanīya---jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāḥ, visarjanīyādeśe hi śarparayorevādeśaprasaṅgaḥ' iti ? atra parihārāmāha---visarjanīyasya sa ityetasminniti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---`visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti sakārasya sthānī visarjanīya upāttaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ sambhavati---śarparalakṣaṇaḥ, kharavasānalakṣaṇaśca | tatra śarparalakṣaṇasyāsiddhatvāditaraḥ sakārasya sthānī, sa eva cehānuvartate; tataśca nāprāpte satve idamārabhyate; sarvasya viṣayasya tena vyāptatvāt | `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' ityetattu śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ prāptam, kevalayostvaprāptamiti na taṃ pratyasya bādhakalakṣaṇayoga iti | syādetat, mā bhūdapavādatvam, paratvāttu śarparayorapi kupvorayameva vidhiḥ prāpnoti ? tatrāha---pūrvratrāsiddhe iti |
parihārāntaramāha---kecittviti | `kupvoḥ' ityeko yogaḥ, atra `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' iti vartate, śarparayoḥ kupvoḥ visarjanīya eva bhavati, na ḥkaḥpāviti | kiñca---pūrvaṃsūtre `neti vaktavye visarjanīyavidhānaṃ tadvikāranivṛttyartham' ityuktam | tena śaparayoḥ kupvorasya vidheraprasaṅga eva ||
so'pavādādau || 8.3.38 ||
`apadādau' iti kupvoretadviśeṣaṇam, vyatyayena tvekavacanam | pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ | pāśakalpakakāmyeṣviti | sambhavapradarśanametat, na parigaṇanam; anyasyāsambhavāt | prātaḥ kalpamiti | adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyāpi prātaḥ---śabdasya vṛttiviṣaye śaktimadvācitvādīṣadasamāptyā yogaḥ, yathā---doṣābhūtamahaḥ, divābhūtā rātrirityatrābhūtatadbhāvayogaḥ |
roḥ kāmye niyamārthamiti | etadeva vivṛṇoti---roreveti | gīḥ kāmyatīti | uttarasūtreṇa ṣatvaṃ na bhavati | yadi punastatraivedamucyate ? naivaṃ śakyam ; ṣatvamātrapratiṣedhe'pyanena satvaṃ prāpnoti | upaghmānīyasya ceti | asyaiva vivaraṇam---kavargeparata iti | ubjirayamityādi | yathā punarayaṃ dakāropadha eṣitavyaḥ, tathā `hayaraṭ‌' ityatroktam ||
iṇaḥ ṣaḥ || 8.3.39 ||
pūrveṇa satve prāpte tadapavādaḥ ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | atra kecidāhuḥ---``yo'yam `so'padādau' iti sakāraḥ, sa evottaratra sarvatra kupvoḥ prakaraṇe vidhīyate, anena tu tasyaiva sakārasyeṇa uttarasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, na visarjanīyasya, `apadādau' iti cātra na sambadhyate" iti | sa tarhi sakāraḥ sthānī nirdeṣṭavyaḥ ? netyāha; prakṛto'nuvarttate---`so'padādau' iti, tasya `iṇaḥ' iti pañcamyā ṣaṣṭhī prakalpyate |
evamapi vakṣyamāṇairyogairvihitasya sakārasya ṣatvaṃ na prāpanoti, asminkarttavye teṣāmasidvātvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; acāryapravṛttirjñāpayati---na yoge yogo'siddhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhamiti; yadayam `upasargādasamāse'pi' ityatra `asamāse'pi' grahaṇaṃ karoti | kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam ? antareṇāpyasamāsepigrahaṇaṃ viśeṣānupādānātsamāsāsamāsayorṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, na ca samāse `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' iti niyamāṇṇatvasya nivṛttiḥ, niyame karttavye `upasargāt' ityasya ṇatvasyāsiddhatvāt | paśyati tvācāryaḥ---prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhamiti, tataḥ `asamāsepi' grahaṇaṃ karoti, tadā hi saha niyamena sarvameva ṇatvaprakaraṇamekamiti niyame kartavye upasargāditi ṇatvasya siddhatvānniyamena vyāvṛttiḥ syāditi karttavyaṃ samāse'pigrahaṇam | tadevaṃ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, na visarjanīyasya; uttaratra ca satvamevānuvarttate, na ṣatvamiti |
ayamapi pakṣo nirdoṣa eva, kintu ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ jñāpakāśrayaṇaṃ ceti pratipattigauravaprasaṅgād vṛttikāreṇa nāśritaḥ | kastarhi tasya pakṣaḥ ? uttaratra dvayamapyanuvarttate---sakāraḥ, ṣakāraśceti | yadyevam, sarvatra dvayamapi prāpnoti---atha sakāro vānuvartate `idudupadhasya ca' ityādau yatreṇaḥ paro visarjanīyastatrāpi sakāra eva prāpnoti; atha ṣakāra evānuvarttate `namaspurasorgatyoḥ' ityādau yatrāniṇaḥ paro nisarjanīyastatrāpi ṣakāra eva prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti samudāyasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate | yadāha---iṇaḥ ṣa iti varttata iti | tataḥ ṣatvaṃ tāvadaniṇviṣaye na bhaviṣyati | evamapi ṣatvaviṣaye satvamapi prāpnoti ? na; ṣakāreṇa tasya bādhanāt, cakārākaraṇācca | yadi paramanuvṛttisāmarthyāttatprasaṅgaḥ ? tadapi na; uttarārthamapyanuvṛttisambhavāt | tadidamuktam---ya iṇaḥ pare visarjanīyastasya ṣakāra ādeśo bhavatyanyasya tu sakāra iti | kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyate, yāvatā satvamevātra prakaraṇe vidhīyatām, tasya tvādeśasakāratvāt `iṇkoḥ' iti ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ? sidhyati; `apadāntasya' iti tatra varttate, padāntārtho'yamārabhaḥ ||
nasaspurasorgatyoḥ || 8.3.40 ||
ataḥ prabhṛti `apadādau' iti nivṛttam | namaḥ śabdasya tu `puro'vyayam' iti |
puraḥ paśyeti | `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ', `bhrājabhāsa' ityādinā kvip, tadantācchas | asya tadantatāṃ darśayitum--pūḥ purāvityanayorupanyāsaḥ ||
idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya || 8.3.41 ||
idutāvupadhe yasya sa idudupadhaḥ samudāyaḥ, tasya yo visarjanīya iti vaiyadhikaraṇyena sambandhaḥ | apratyayasyetyetadapi vyadhikaraṇameva | nirdurbahirāviścatuṣprāduriti | anyeṣāṃ sambhavatāṃ pratiṣedhasya vakṣyamāṇatvānnedaṃ parigaṇanam, kiṃ tarhi ? sambhavapradarśanam | catuṣkapālamiti | taddhitārthe dviguḥ, `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' ityaṇaḥ `dvigorluganapatye' iti luk | catuṣkaṇṭakamiti | bahuvrīhiḥ |
mātuḥ karotītyādi | codyam---atra hi mātṛ-as iti sthite `ṛta ut' ityukāro bhavan `yo hyubhayoḥ sthāne' iti nyāyena raparo bhavati, tataśca `rātsasya' iti pratyayasakārasya lope kṛte rephasya visarjanīyo bhavati | pariharati---karakādiṣviti | ekādeśanimittāditi | karmadhārayaḥ, ekādeśarūpanimittādityarthaḥ, ekādeśaśāstraṃ vā nimittaṃ yasyokārasya tasmādityarthaḥ |
pummuhusoriti | avyutpannāvetāviti pratiṣedha ucyate | tatra puṃsaḥ pratiṣedhena nārthaḥ | ṣatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? visarjanīyābhāvāt, uktaṃ hi `sampuṃkānāṃ satvam' iti, tatra satvasyāsiddhatvābhāvādvisarjanīyābhāvaḥ | taccāvaśyaṃ satvaṃ vaktavyam, ruvidhau visarjanīyasya ṣatyapatiṣedhe'pi `kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca' ityeva vidhiḥ prāpnoti---muhuḥ kāmo yasyāḥ sā muhuḥ kāmā, tatra `kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca ityeṣa eva vidhirbhavati | kvacittu muhuskāmeti satvaṃ paṭhyate so'papāṭhaḥ, na hyatra satvasambhavaḥ; sūtravārttikayoranibaddhatvāt | naiṣkulyamiti | brāhmaṇaāditvāt ṣyañ‌ | ni3ṣkulaṃ du3ṣkulamiti | `guroranṛtaḥ' ityādinā plutaḥ | bahiraṅgalakṣaṇayoriti | bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvadvirbahiraṅgā, pluto'pi dūrāddhūtādikamarthaṃ vākyaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgaḥ ||
tiraso'nyatarasyām || 8.3.42 ||
`tiro'ntardhau' iti tiraḥ śabdasya gatisaṃjñā |
tiraḥ kṛtveti | atrāntardheravivakṣitatvādagatitvam ||
dvistriścaturiti kṛtvo'rthe || 8.3.43 ||
ubhayatravibhāṣeyam, `catur' ityasyāpratyayavisarjanīyatvād `idudupadhasya ca' iti prāpte, itarayoraprāpte | `isusoḥ sāmarthye' ityanena tvatra siddhirna śaṅkanīyā; isaḥ pratyayasya tatra grahaṇāt |
kṛtvortha iti kimiti | sujantāḥ kṛtvo'rthaṃ na vyabhicarantīti praśnaḥ | catuḥ---śabdasya sujantatve pramāṇaṃ nāstītyuttaram | yadi tu sāhacaryaṃ vyasthāpakam, tadā tadarthamapi kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, kriyate ca ? tajjñāpakārtham, etajjñāpayati---na sarvatra sāhacaryaṃ vyavasthāpakamiti | kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati ? `dīdhīvevīṭām' ityatra dhātusāhacaryeṇāpyāgamasyeṭo grahaṇaṃ bhavati |
dvistriścaturiti kim ? pañcakṛtvaḥ karotītyatra satvaṃ mā bhūt | naitadasti prayojanamityāha--idudupadhasyetyasyānuvṛttau satyāmityādi | kṛtvo'rtho viṣayo yasyatattathoktam | kṛtvorthe yatpadaṃ vartate tasya yo visarjanīyaḥ---ityevaṃ viśeṣyamāṇaṃ ityarthaḥ | yadi tu kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena visarjanīyo viśeṣyeta, tadā caturo na syāt | etacca ślokeṣu vyaktīkariṣyati |
evaṃ ślokavārttikakāramatena dvistriścaturgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam | tāneva ślokānudāharati---kṛtvasujarthe iti | kasmāddhetoḥ kṛtvasujarthe ṣatvaṃ vravīti, kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇasya kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | atra ca vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ | prayojanamāha---catuṣkapāla iti | codayitā svābhiprāyaṃ prakāśayati---nanu siddhamiti | nanvityabhyupagame | bhavatvanena catuṣkapāle'pi vibhāṣā, tathāpi nityaṃ ṣatvaṃ siddham | katham ? anena mukte `idudupadhasya ca' iti ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
pariharati---siddhe hyayamiti | siddhe prāpta ityarthaḥ | kathaṃ prāptiḥ ? ityāha---lupte iti | caturas iti sthite `rātsasya' iti suco lopaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ | so'yamapratyayavisarjanīyo bhavati, yadi suco rutvaṃ pūrvasya `rori' iti lopaḥ, rorvisarjanīyo bhavati, kintu `ḍhralope' iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, rutvasyāsiddhatvāt, pūrvameva ca lopena bhavitavyam, evaṃ ca kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityuktam |
idānīṃ tadāśrayaṇena dvistraścaturgrahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe---evaṃ satīti | kiṃ kāryamiti | na kiñcidityarthaḥ | katham ? ityāha---anyo hīti |
itaro'sati dvirādigrahaṇe doṣaṃ darśayati---akriyamāṇa iti | visarjanīyo viśeṣyeteti | tasya kāryitvena prādhānyāditi bhāvaḥ | sambhāvane liṅ‌ | viśeṣyatāṃ visarjanīyaḥ, ko doṣaḥ ? ityata āha---catura iti | tatheti | anantarokte viśeṣaṇaprakāre caturo na sidhyatīti | kasmāt ? ityāha---rephasyeti |
kriyamāṇe tu dvirādigrahaṇe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, ityāha---tasmistviti | itarayorviśeṣābhāvāccaturo viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityuktam | pratyākhyānavādyāha---prakṛtaṃ padamiti | yaduktam---`kāryitvena pradhānabhūto visarjanīyaḥ' iti, tanna; so'pi prakṛtasya padasya ṣatvamiti, sa tvarthād `alo'ntyasya' iti visarjanīyasya bhavatītyetāvat padameva tu kāryi, tadidamuktam---tadantamiti | tasyāpīti | apiśabdo'vadhāraṇe, tasyaivetyarthaḥ |
evaṃ ślokavārttikakāreṇa pratyakhyāte dvirādigrahaṇe vṛttikāraḥ sthāpayitumāhaevamiti | pūrveṇeti | `idudupadhasya ca' ityanena | nityaṃ ṣatvaṃ syāditi | asya tu dvistriḥ śabdāvavakāśau | na ca paratvādayameva vidhiḥ siddhyatītyāha---pūrvatrāsiddha iti |
ślokavārttikakārasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ---prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddham, na yoge yogaḥ, tenāsyāsiddhatvaṃ bhavatīti | atha vā---`idudupadhasya kṛtvo'rthavṛtternāprāpte nitye ṣatvasyārambhādapavādatvamityapavādatvādeva, vacanaprāmāṇyāditivā siddhatvamiti |
atha `sucaḥ' ityeva kasmānnoktam, kimanena mahatā prabandhena ? evamucyamāne suci visarjanīyo viśeṣyeta---suco yo visarjanīya iti, tataśca caturo na syāt | evaṃ tarhi sujantasyeti vaktavyam---sujantasya yo visarjanīya iti ? evamapi `padasya' ityanuvṛtteryatra sujantaṃ padaṃ tatraiva syāt---dviṣkarotīti, iha tu na syāt---paramadviṣkarotīti | yatpadaṃ tanna sujantam, tasmātsuco'vihitatvāt | yacca sujantaṃ dviriti na tatpadam;`uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti padasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhāt |
isusoḥ sāmarthye || 8.3.44 ||
tiṣṭhatvityādi | atrasaparirityasya tiṣṭhatvityanena sambandhaḥ, `piba' ityasya tūdakamityaneneti parasparalasambandhābhāvādasāmarthyam | sāmarthyamiha vyapekṣeti | avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam--vyapekṣaiveti | prayojanamuttaratra vakṣyate | na punarekārthībhāva iti | atrāpyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam---ekārthībhāva eva gṛhyata iti yattanna vyapekṣaivetyarthaḥ | nanu ca sāmarthyaśabdaḥ sāmānyaśabdaḥ, na ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate, tatkathaṃ vyapekṣaiva sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyate, na punarekārthībhāva ityucyate, ubhayaṃ tu kasmānna gṛhyate ? ata āha---ubhayaṃ veti | netyeva; ubhayamapi gṛhyata iti yattadapi naivetyarthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ---padavidhitvādeva samarthaparibhāṣopasthānāt sāmarthye labdhe punaḥ sāmarthyagrahaṇādiṣṭasya vyapekṣālakṣaṇasyaiva sāmarthyasya parigrahaḥ; netarasya, nāpyubhayoriti ||
nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya || 8.3.45 ||
parasamarpiṣkuṇḍiketi | nanu ca `arciśucihusṛpicchadicchādibhya isiḥ', `janerusiḥ', `atipayajitanidhanivapibhyo nit' ityevaṃ sarpiḥ, yajurityādaya isusantā vyutpādyante, tataśca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā sarpirādīnāmevesusantatvam, na paramasarpirādīnām, tatkathamatra prasaṅgaḥ; avaśyaṃ coṇādīnāmapi vyutpattipakṣa evāśrayaṇīyaḥ; avyutpattipakṣe hyāśrīyamāṇe sarpiṣā, yajuṣetyādau ṣatvaṃ na siddhyati, apratyayasakāratvāt; tasmādanarthakamanuttarapadagrahaṇam ? ata āha---etadevetyādi | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha--teneti | atha pūrvasūtreṇa samāse'pi vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ityata āha--vyapekṣā ceti | kecittu ```nityaṃ samāse' ityeko yogaḥ, `anutarapadasthasya' iti dvitīya iti yogavibhāgena samāse sarvā ṣatvaprāptiruttarapadasthasya pratiṣidhyate" iti vadantaḥ pūrvatra dvividhe'pi sāmarthye samāśrite na doṣa ityāhuḥ ||
ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsakumbhapātrakuśākarṇīṣvanavyayasya || 8.3.46 ||
kṛ, kamīti dhātugrahaṇam | itareṣāṃ svarūpagrahaṇam | ayaskāra iti | `karmaṇyaṇ' | ayaskāma iti | `śīlikāmi' ityādinā ṇapratyayaḥ, ayaskaṃsādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ | kaṃsagrahaṇamanarthakam, kamigrahaṇenaiva siddhatvāt, kaṃsaśabdo hi `vṝtṝvadihanikamibhyaḥ saḥ' iti kamereva vyutpādyate ? jñāpanārthaṃ tu, etat jñāpayati---uṇādiṣu nāvaśyaṃ vyutpattikāryaṃ bhavatīti | ayaskumbhīti | kumbhaśabdājjātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ‌ | ayaspātrīti | pātraśabdaḥ ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ, ṣittvānṅīṣ | ayaskuśeti | nātrāyovikāro vivakṣitaḥ, tena `jānapada' iti sūtreṇa ṅīṣ‌ na bhavati | ayaskarṇīti | aya iva karṇī yasyāḥ sā ayaskarṇī, `nāsikodara' ityādinā ṅīṣ | śunaskarṇa ityayaṃ tviti | sūtre tvīkārāntasya karṇīśabdasya nirdeśādatrāprasaṅgaḥ |
bhāḥ karaṇamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | bhāskara ityayaṃ tviti | `divāvibhā' ityādinā ṭapratyayaḥ | jayādityastu tasminsūtre'vocad‌---`bhāskarānteti pratyayasanniyogena satvaṃ nipātyate' iti | śvaḥ kāraḥ, punaḥ kāma iti | dhañantena mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ ||
adhaḥ śirasī pade || 8.3.47 ||
ityetayoriti | sūtre tu ṣaṣṭhīsthāne prathamā | pada iti svarūpasya grahaṇam na suptiṅantasya; tasya samāsādhikārādeva siddhatvāt | tadāhapadaśabde parata iti |
mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsāmāsa iti | adhaspadamityatra tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ||
kaskādiṣu ca || 8.3.48 ||
`kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca' ityasyāpavādaḥ | yathāyogamiti | iṇaḥ parasya ṣatvam, anyasya satvamityeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ | kaska iti | svantasya kimo vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | kautaskuta iti | kutaḥ śabdasya pūrvavad dvirvacanam, tasmāt `tata āgataḥ' ityaṇ‌, `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' | bhrātuṣputra iti | `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ' ityaluk | śunaskarṇa iti | `ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe' ityaluk | pārāyaṇena dīvyanti vyavaharantīti pārāyaṇikāḥ | pārāyaṇaṃ dvividham---dhātupārāyaṇam, nāmapārāyaṇamiti |
bhāṣye vṛttāvityādinā'nantaroktamarthaṃ nirākaroti | avihitalakṣaṇa ityādinā''kṛtigaṇo'yamiti darśayati | visarjanīyasthānikayoḥ sakāraṣakārayoḥ upacāra iti saṃjñā ||
chandasi vā'prāmreḍitayoḥ || 8.3.49 ||
ayaspātramiti | asamāso'yam | samāse hi`ataḥ kṛkami' ityādinā nityaṃ satvaṃ prāpnoti; asya vikalpasyāsiddhatvāt, asamāse cāsya vikalpasya caritārthatvāt | yadi vā `prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddham' iti pakṣe samāse'pyudāharaṇam, kintvanena mukte tena nityaṃ prāpnoti, tasmādasamāsa evāyam | samāse tu yadi vikalpo dṛśyate, sa chāndasatvenopapādyaḥ | viśvataspātramiti | atrāvyayatvād `ataḥ kṛkami' ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ | uruṇaskāra iti | asmado nasādeśaḥ, `naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ' iti ṇatvam | kāraśabdo ghañantaḥ, atrāsamāsatvādaprasaṅgaḥ |
agniḥ pravidvāniti | atra ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, ubhyakrame tu sakāra ādeśa ityupalakṣaṇam | paruṣaḥ paruṣa iti | vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | aṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣyaru, catuṣyaṣpā viśaste---ityādayastu kaskādiṣu draṣṭavyāḥ | harikeśaḥ purastādityāderatropayogaṃ na paśyāmaḥ | kathamatraiva sūtre vāgrahaṇāt satvaṣatvayorbhāvābhāvau pratipāditau ? kimatra ? `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' ityanena ||
kaḥ karatkaratikṛdhikṛteteṣvanaditeḥ || 8.3.50 ||
kariti | kṛño luṅ‌, `mantre ghasa' ityādinā clerluk, tipo halaṅyādilopaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅyoge'pi' ityaḍabhāvaḥ | karaditi | kṛña eva luṅ‌, `kṛmṛdṛhibhyaśchandasi' iti cleraṅ‌ | karatīti | laṭ‌, vyatyayena śap | kṛdhīti | kṛño loṭ, serhiḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' iti śapo luk, `śruśrṛṇupṝkṛvṛbhyaśchandasi' iti herdhirādeśaḥ | kṛtamiti | kṛña eva ktaḥ | sakāra ādeśa iti | ṣatvasyāpyupalakṣaṇametat | viśvataskariti | avyatvādasamāsatvācca `ataḥ kṛkami' ityasyāprasaṅgaḥ | itareṣu tvasamāsatvādaprasaṅgaḥ | śanna karat, yathā naḥ śreyasaḥ karadityādau chāndasatvātsatvābhāvaḥ | tathā kṛdhītyatra sakāra-ghakāra-kaśabdeṣu paratastaittirīyake satvaṃ na bhavati---tanma āmanasaḥ kṛdhi svāhā, urukṣayāya naḥ kṛdhi ghṛtamanyāsai, śaṃ ca naḥ kṛdhi kratve ||
pañcamyāḥ parāvadhyarthe || 8.3.51 ||
adhyartha iti | pareridaṃ viśeṣaṇam | himavataspari, himavata uparītyarthaḥ | vyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne pañcamyāḥ prayogaḥ |
paryoja udbhatamiti | atra pariḥ sarvatobhāve varttate ||
pātau ca bahulam || 8.3.52 ||
kvacit paṭhyate---pātāviti dhātunirdeśa iti | anye tūdāharaṇaparyālocanayā loḍantānukaraṇaṃ manyate ||
ṣaṣṭhyāḥ patiputrapṛṣṭhaparāpadapayaspoṣeṣu | vācaspatiriti | `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' ityaluk ||
apadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ || 8.3.55 ||
mūrdhanyagrahaṇamanarthakam, `ṣa' ityeva siddham ? ata āha---ṣa ityeva siddhe iti | `ṣa' ityucyamāne `iṇaḥ ṣīdhvam' ityatrāpi ṣatvaṃ prasajyeta, ḍhatvaṃ ceṣyate | athātraiva mūrdhanyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, uttareṣu yogeṣu punaḥ ṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam | mūrdhanyagrahaṇe tu kreyamāṇe na doṣo bhavati ||
saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ || 8.3.56 ||
sāḍ‌rūpasyeti | sāḍiti rūpaṃ prāptasyetyarthaḥ | jalāṣāḍiti | `bhajo ṇviḥ', `chandasi sahaḥ', upadhāvṛddhiḥ, ḍhatvam, jaśtvacartve, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' ityupapadasya dīrghaḥ, sakārasyāntaratamo mūrdhanyaḥ ṣakāraḥ |
saheriti kimiti | anyatra sāḍaśabdasyāsambhavaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ | saha ḍeneti | aḍaḥ - vṛścirakalāṅgalam, tasyāpatyaṃ sāḍiriti | sāḍa ityatra tu sāḍ‌śabdasyānarthakatvādaprasaṅgaṃ matvā taddhitāntaḥ pratyudāhṛtaḥ, tatra hi yasyetilope kṛte sāḍaśabdo'rthavān bhavati | na ca yasyetilopasya sthānivattvam; `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivata' iti vacanāt | evamapi `ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' ityakādeśasyāsiddhatvāt sāḍ‌śabdasyābhāvaḥ | tasmātsaha ḍena varttata iti saḍa iti pāṭhaḥ | yasya nāmni ḍaśabdo varttate sa saḍaḥ, yathā---mṛḍa iti, tasyāpatyaṃ sāḍiḥ | nanvatrāpi bahirbhūtataddhitāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ, kva tarhi syāt ? jalāṣāḍiti | nanvatrāpi bahirbhūta-ṇavyapekṣayā bahiraṅgaiva vṛddhiḥ ? atha tatra vacanādbhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti---turāsāhamiti ? turāsāhaṃ purodhāyetyādau tu ṇvireva durlabhaḥ, prāgeva ṣatvam |
ākārasya mā bhūditi | `antyasya mā bhūt' iti tu noktam; ḍakārasya ḍakāravacane prayojanābhāvāt | athāpyanantaratamamūrdhanyārthaṃ vacanaṃ syād ? evamapyapadāntasyetyantyasya na bhaviṣyati | nanvevamapi `alo'ntyasya' ityasminbādhite sarvādeśo mūrdhanyaḥ prāpnoti, tatkimucyate---ākārasya mā bhūditi ? ucyate; `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' ityākarasya mūrdhanyaḥ prāpnoti ||
iṇkoḥ || 8.3.57 ||
`iṇ‌' iti pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāharaḥ, `ku' iti kavargasya grahaṇam, tayoḥ samāhāradvandve ekavacanam | numāgamastu satyapi napuṃsakatve na kṛtaḥ, `anityamāgamaśāstram' iti kṛtvā | vākṣviti | `coḥ kuḥ' iti kutve kṛte kavargātparaḥ sakāraḥ | vargagrahaṇam `śāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' ityatra ghakārasyāpi grahaṇārtham---jakṣaturiti; anyathā cartvasyāsiddhatvānna syāt | atha vacanasāmarthyāt cartvasya siddhatvamāśrīyeta; cintyaṃ vargagrahaṇasya prayojanam | dāsyatīti | nanu ca `nājjhalau' ityatrāgṛhītasavarṇānāmacāṃ grahaṇam---ityasakṛduktam, tataśca yathā kumārī śete---ityatrekāraśakārayoḥ sāvarṇyamapratiṣiddham, tataśca yathā kumārī śete---ityatrekāraśakārayoḥ sāvarṇyamapratiṣiddham, tathā ākārahakārayorapi, tataḥ kim ? hakāreṇeṇākārasya grahaṇāt ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; hakāro vivṛtaḥ, ākāro vivṛtataraḥ | evaṃ hi paṭhanti---vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarāḥ, tebhya eo vivṛtatarau, tābhyāmaiau, tābhyāmapyākāraḥ saṃvṛtokāra iti | evaṃ ca kṛtvā---`iṣṭakāsu', `vayasyāsu'---ityādayo nirdeśā upapadyante | asāviti | `adasa au sulopaśca', `tadoḥ saḥ sau' ityādeśasakāro'yam, na tviṇkoḥ paraḥ ||
numvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi || 8.3.58 ||
`iṇkoḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśāt vyavāye ṣatvaṃ na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇam; numā vyavāyāsambhavāt, `naścāpadāntasya jhali' ityanusvārasya vidhānāt | anusvāragrahaṇameva tu na kṛtam, numsthānikenaivānusvāreṇa vyavadhāne yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt---puṃsviti; pumsśabdātsupi `sayogāntasya lopaḥ', makārasyānusvāraḥ | sarpīṣīti | `napuṃsakasya jhalayaḥ' iti num, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' iti dīrghaḥ | sarpiḥ sviti | `vā śari' iti pakṣe visarjanīyaḥ | sarpiṣṣviti | pakṣe satvam, tenaiṃva vyavāye ṣatvam, sakārasya ṣṭutvam |
sakāragrahaṇe karttavye śariti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam |
iha yathā vṛṣalairna praveṣṭavyamiti vṛṣalanivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pratyekaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca praveśo na bhavati, tathā numādīnāṃ ṣatvāpratibandhahetutvaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pratyekaṃ samudāyena ca vyavāye ṣatvaṃ prāpnotīti tatra sarvavyavāyasya kvacidasambhavāt, kvacitpratyekam, kvacid dvābhyāṃ vyavāye ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityata āha---numādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ vyavāya iti | evaṃ manyate---vyavāyaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyatenumvyavāye, visarjanīyavyavāye, śarvyavāya iti | yathādarśitamupakrame, tatra `iṇkoḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśenānantarye ṣatvapratipādanādanena ca vākyatrayeṇaikaikavyavāye ṣatvābhyanujñānāt `yena nāvyavadhānam' iti nyāyena adhikavyavāye ṣatvābhāva iti | niṃssa iti | `ṇisi cumbane', adādiranudāttet | nissveti | loṭ, `savābhyāṃ vāmau' ||
ādeśapratyayayoḥ || 8.3.58 ||
kimavayavayogaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī---ādeśasya yaḥ sakāraḥ, pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāra iti ? āhosvitsamānādhikaraṇe---ādeśo yaḥ sakāraḥ, pratyayo yaḥ sakāra iti ? tatrādye pakṣe `saḥ' ityasyānuvṛttasyeha vacanavipariṇāmo na karttavyo bhavati, kāryeṇa tvādeśapratyayayoḥ sākṣāt śrutayorasambandhaḥ; sakāraviśeṣaṇatvāt | dvitīye tvādeśapratyayayoḥ sakārayoriti dvivacanaṃ vipariṇamyam | kāryeṇa tu sākṣācchrutayoḥ sambandha iti vacanadoṣasāmyānna yuktitaḥ pakṣaviśeṣanirṇayaḥ | tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī ced dvirvacane doṣaḥ---visaṃbisam, musalaṃmusalam | tatrāvayavaṣaṣṭhī ced dvirvacane doṣaḥ---visaṃbisam, musalaṃmusalam | āṣṭamike hi dvirvacane sthāne dvirvacanapakṣo'pi sthāpitaḥ, tataśca `nityavīpsayoḥ' ityekasya visamityetasya sthāne bisaṃbisamityetasminnādeśe kṛte tasyāvayava sakāraḥ iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ ? kariṣyati, hariṣyatītyatra na prāpanoti; samudāyo hyatra pratyayaḥ, na sakāramātram | kva tarhi syāt ? yatra sakāramātraṃ pratyayaḥ---indro mā vakṣat, sa devānyakṣat ; vaciyajibhyāṃ leṭ, tip, `itaśca lopaḥ' ityādinekāralopaḥ, `leṭo'ḍāṭau' ityaṭ, `sibbahulaṃ leṭi' iti sip, vaceḥ kutvam, yajeḥ ṣatvakatve | athāparau dvau pakṣau---ādeśasya yaḥ sakāraḥ, pratyayo yaḥ sakāra iti; viparyayo vā---ādeśo yaḥ sakāraḥ, pratyayasya yaḥ sakāra iti ? tatrādye pakṣe tāveva doṣau yau pūrvayoḥ pakṣayoḥ bisabisamityādau prasaṅgaḥ, kariṣyatītyādau cāprasaṅga iti | tasmādantyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, tadāha---ādeśapratyayayoriti ṣaṣṭhī bhedena sambadhyata ityādi |
atra ca jñāpakaṃ yadayamuttarasūtre ghasigrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati---ādeśe samānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī, na vyadhikaraṇeti; anyathā ghaserādeśatvādeva tasya sakārasyānenaiva ṣatvasiddheranarthakaṃ tatsyāt | yacca `sātpadādyoḥ' iti sātipratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati---pratyaye'vayavaṣaṣṭhī, na samānādhikaraṇeti; anyathā sātisakārasyāpratyayatvāt ṣatvasya prāptyabhāvādanarthakaṃ tatsyāt | nanu cādeśasyeti ṣatvāpekṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī, pratyayasyeti sakārāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhīti sahavivakṣābhāvād dvandvanupapattiḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvoktāt jñāpakadvayāt sahavivakṣāyā abhāve'pi dvandvo bhaviṣyati |
yadi pratyayāvayavasya ṣatvamucyate, indro mā vakṣat, sa devānyakṣadityatra ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti, pratyaya evātra sakāro na tu pratyayasyāvayavaḥ ? ata āha---indro mā vakṣadityādi | iha `aśeḥ saran'---akṣaramityatra ṣatvaṃ bhavati, tasyaiva tu `kṛdhūmādibhyaḥ kit' iti vihitasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, kṛsaram, dhūsaram | tathā `vṛtṝvadi' ityādinā vihitasya kakṣamityatra bhavati, varsamityatra na bhavati; bahulavacanāt pratyayasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt ||
śāsivasighasīsāṃ ca || 8.3.60 ||
anviśiṣaditi | `sartiśāsti' ityādinā cleraṅ‌, `śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ' itītvam | uṣita iti | yajāditvāt samprasāraṇam, `vasatikṣudhauriṭ‌' | jakṣatuḥ, jakṣuriti | `liṭyanyatarasyām' ityaderghaslādeśaḥ, `gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ | akṣanniti | aderluḍ `luṅ‌sanorghaslṛ', `mantre ghasa' `ityādinā clerluk |
tatra yuktaṃ śāsivasyoranādeśārthaṃ vacanamiti, ghasestvayuktamādeśatvāt ? ityata āha---ghasiryadyapyādeśa iti | ādeśa iti | ādeśo yaḥ sakārastatra sthitamiti bhāvaḥ | yastvanādeśo ghasistasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; viralaprayogatvāt ||
stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇyabhyāsāt || 8.3.61 ||
ṣatvabhūt iti | ṣatvaṃ prāpte, kṛtaṣatva ityarthaḥ | ādeśasakārasyeti | pratyayasakārastvasambhavānna sambadhyate | suṣvāpayiṣatīti | `dyutisvāpyoḥ' ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇam | sisikṣatīti | `sici kṣaraṇe' | susūṣata iti | `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇiprasave' | parasmaipadapāṭhe tu `ṣū preraṇe'---ityasya rūpam |
yadi siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ, evakārastahi kimarthaḥ ? tatrāha---evakārakaraṇamiti | atha viparīte'vadhāraṇe ko doṣaḥ ? ityata āha---stautiṇyoḥ ṣaṇyeveti | iha ca syādeveti | ṣaṇyevetyanena hyavadhāraṇena pratyayāntare stautiṇyoḥ ṣatvaṃ vyavacchinnam, na tu dhātvantarasya ṣaṇi, tataścābhihitadoṣadvayaprasaṅgaḥ |
siṣeceti | ṣaṇītyanucyamāne pratyayamātre niyamaḥ syād---abhyāsātparasya yadi ṣatvaṃ bhavati stautiṇyoreveti, tataśca siṣecetyādau na syāt |
ko vinate'nurodha iti | vinatamiti patvaṇatvayoḥ prātiśākhyeṣu prasiddhiḥ---ekavarṇamanokāraṃ vinate susmeti, naḥ para iti yathā | anurudhyate ānukūlyena prāpyata ityanurodhaḥ-prayojanam | kṛtaṣatvasya nirdeśe kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | suṣupsatīti | `rudavida' ityādinā sanaḥ kittvam, `vacisvapi' ityādinā samprasāraṇam | sanītyucyamāne sanmātre niyamaḥ syāt, tataśca yathā---ṣatvabhūte sanidhātvantarasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, evamihāṣatvabhūte'pi na syāt |
kaḥ sānubandhe'nurodha iti | nakārānubandhavato grahaṇe kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | ṇatvasya tu prayojanaṃ na pṛcchati; tasya lakṣaṇaprāptatvāt | suṣupiṣa indramiti | svaperliṭ, chāndasatvād `vyatyayo bahulam' iti thās, `thāsaḥ seḥ', `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' iti liṭaḥ kittvāt pūrvavatsamprasāraṇam, dvirvacanam, krādiniyamādiṭ, indraśabde parato yādeśaḥ, `lopaḥ śākalyasya' iti yalopaḥ | atra niyamābhāvādabhyāsāt parasya ṣatvaṃ bhavatyeva, `ṣa' ityucyamāne tu yāvān kaścit ṣaśabdastatra sarvatra niyamaḥ syāt, tasmātsānubandhakagrahaṇam |
abhyāsāditi kimiti | abhyāsād yā prāptistasyā niyamo yathā syādupasargād yā prāptistasyā niyamo mā bhūt; abhiṣiṣikṣatītyetattāvadaprayojanam, katham ? asiddhamupasargātpatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānniyamo na bhaviṣyati | syādetat---yathā `ata ekahalmadhye' ityatra liṭā ādeśo viśeṣyate, tatheha sanābhyāsaḥ, sani yo'bhyāsastasmāt stautiṇyoreveti, tena yaṅi yo'bhyāsastasmātṣaṇi dhātvantarasyāpi ṣatvaṃ bhavati, svaperyaṅ‌, svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅi' iti samprasāraṇam, soṣupyateḥ san, iṭ, `ato lopaḥ', `yasya halaḥ', soṣupiṣate---tadetadbhavati prayojanamiti ? tanna; antaraṅgamatra ṣatvam, bahiraṅgo niyamaḥ; tasmādanarthakamabhyāsagrahaṇamiti praśnaḥ | pariharati---pratiṣiṣatīti | iṇo bodhanārthatvād gamyādeśābhāvo'jāderiti saśabdasya dvirvacanam, `sanyataḥ' itītvam | tatrābhyāsāśraye pratyayasya ṣatve kṛte'sya niyamasyābhāvād dhātvāśrayaṃ ṣatvamabhyāsasya pravarttate | nanu ṣaṇīti parasaptamī, tataśca ṣaṇi pare stautiṇyoreveti ṣatvaniyamaḥ kriyamāṇastulyajātīyasya ṣaṇvasya sisikṣatītyādeḥ ṣatvaṃ nivartayati | pratīṣiṣatītyatra tu sani eva dvirvacanamiti ṣaṇparatvābhāvādayaṃ niyamo na pravatiṣyate | `sanyataḥ' itītvamapi tarhi na prāpanoti, samudāyasya sanrūpatvāttasya ca sanparatvābhāvāt | tasmātsanpradeśeṣu satsaptamī vijñeyā, tataśca yathettvaṃ pravarttate tathā ṣatvaniyamo'pi syādityabhyāsagrahaṇam ||
sa svidisvadisahīnāṃ ca || 8.3.62 ||
`sa' ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ | ṇyantānāmiti | ṣatvaprāptau satvamucyate, ṣatvaprāptiśca ṇyantānāmiti sāmarthyalabhyametat, kimarthaṃ punaḥ sakārasya sakāra ucyate ? ata āha---sakārasyeti |
neti pratiṣedha eva vaktavye sakāravacanaṃ lāghave viśeṣābhāvāt ||
prāksitādaḍ‌vyavāye'pi || 8.3.63 ||
`iṇkoḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśādvyavāye na prāpnotīti vacanam | aḍityāgamasya grahaṇam, na pratyāhārasya | etacca `hayavaraṭ' ityatropapāditam | prāk sitasaṃśabdanāditi | `parinivibhyaḥ sevasita' ityataḥ | apigrahaṇaṃ kim ? avyavadhāne'pi yathā syāt, anyathā viśeṣavacanādvyavāya eva syāt | abhyaṣuṇoditi | `ṣuñ‌ abhiṣeve', laṅ‌, `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ', aḍāgamaḥ, pāgeva yaṇādeśāt ṣatvam; kṛte vā yaṇi yakārameveṇamāśritya ṣatvam ||
sthādiṣvabhyāsena cābhyāsasya || 8.3.64 ||
dve ete vākye---sthādiṣvabhyāsena vyavāye tvaṃ bhavati; abhyāsasya ca ṣatvaṃ bhavati teṣveva sthādiṣviti | tatrādyaṃ vidhyartham, dvitīyaṃ niyamārtham | aṣopadeśārthamiti | ṣopadeśe tu paritiṣṭhāsatītyādau sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddham | abhiṣiṣeṇayiṣatīti | senayā'bhiyātumicchatīti vigṛhya `satyāpapāśa' ityādinā ṇic, ṭilopaḥ, tataḥ san, dvirvacanam, hrasvaḥ, eca `igghrasvādeśe' avyutpannaḥ senāśabdaḥ | yadvā sahenena vattata iti senā, `sahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām' iti sādeśaḥ | yadā tu sinoternapratyaye seneti vyutpādyate, tadāstyevā bhiḥ ṣoṣadeśatvameti | abhitaṣṭhāviti | ādeśasakārasyāpyasya ṣatvaṃ na siddhyati; iṇaakorabhāvāt | abhiṣiṣikṣatīti | yadyapyayamādeśasakāra iṇaśca paraḥ, tathāpyabhyāsamapekṣa ṣatvaṃ na siddhyati; stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇīti niyamāt | ataḥ ṣaṇi yatpratiṣiddhaṃ ṣatvaṃ niyamena vyāvartitaṃ tadapyupasargamāśritya bhavati |
athābhyāsasyeti kimartham, yāvatābhyāsenetyatra kriyāpekṣāyāṃ prakaraṇādvyavāya iti sambadhyate, taccāpiśabdasannihitameva prakṛtamiti avyavāye'pi ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati pūrvasūtravat, nārthaḥ `abhyāsasya' ityanena ? ata āha---abhyāsasyeti vacanaṃ niyamārthamiti | niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati---sthādiṣveveti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---sthādiṣvabhyāsasyaiveti | yadi syāt, abhyāsena vyavāye ṣatvavidhānamanupapannaṃ syāt | abhisusūṣatīti | `ṣū preraṇe', san, `sani grahaguhośca' itīḍ‌niṣedhaḥ | atra dhātusakārasya stautiṇyoreveti niyamādaṣatvam | abhyāsasakārasya tvasmānniyamāt ṣatvābhāvaḥ ||
upasargātsunotisuvatisyatistautistobhatisthāsenayasdhasicasanjasvanjām || 8.3.65 ||
`ṣuñ‌, abhiṣave' svādiḥ, `ṣu preraṇe' tudādiḥ, `ṣo antakarmaṇi' dvivādiḥ, `otaḥ śyani' iti lopaḥ, `ṣṭuñ‌ stutau' adādiḥ, `uto vṛddhirluki hali', ṣṭubhastambhe', anudāttet | eteṣāṃ śtipā nirdeśo yaṅ‌lugnivṛttyarthaḥ---`abhisoṣavātītyādi | `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' | senayatirṇyanta | śapā nirdeśena nārthaḥ; yaṅo'sambhavāt | `ṣidha gatyām', ṣidhū śāstre māṅgalye ca' bhauvādikau; tatra `sedhatergatau' iti pratiṣedhādanyatra ṣatvam | śapā nirdeśo yaṅ‌lugnivṛttyarthaḥ, daivādikanivṛttyarthaśca `ṣidhū saṃrādvau' iti | `ṣica kṣaraṇe' tudādirmucādiḥ, `ṣanja saṅge', `ṣvanjapariṣvaṅge', anudāttet, `daśaṃsañjasvañjāṃ śapi' iti nalopaḥ, sivādīnāṃ yaṅ‌lukyapi bhavati, abhiṣeṣicītītyādi | eteṣāmaḍ‌vyavāye, abhyāsavyavāye ca yathāsambhavaṃ ṣatvam | `iṇkoḥ' iti varttate, tatra kavargasyāsambhavādiṇa iti sambadhyate, tatra yadīṇā upasargo viśeṣyeta---iṇantādupasargāditi, iha na syāt---niṣṣuṇoti, duṣṣuṇotīti | tasmādupasargeṇeṇviśeṣaṇīyaḥ---upasargasyeṇa iti | nanūpasargāditi pañcamī, tatkathamiṇviśeṣyate ? na brūmo vaiyadhikaraṇyena viśeṣyata iti, kiṃ tarhi ? tātsthāttācchabdyam---upasargādiṇaḥ, upasargasthādiṇa iti | tatra śarvyavāyasyāśritatvānniso'pi parasya ṣatvaṃ bhavati, tadidamuktam---upasargasthānnimittāditi |
dadhi siñcatīti | `sātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedha evātra bhavati, tadapavādo hyam |
niḥ secaka iti | nirayamupasarga eva, tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? ata āha---tāyaṃ sicerupasarga iti | yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ | abhisāvakīyatīti | sāvakaśabdāt ṇvulantātkyac, tasyābhinā yogaḥ | sunotinā yoge tu bhavatyeva, abhiṣāvakamicchati abhiṣāvakīyatīti | ṇyante'pi tarhi ṇijarthena praiṣādinopasargasya yogo na prakṛtyartheneti ṣatvāprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---abhiṣāvayatītyatreti | abhiṣavaviṣayā prayuktiḥ, na tu prayukterabhinā yoga ityarthaḥ | yadā tu prayukterabhinā yogaḥ, tadā naiva ṣatvaṃ bhavati; kintu prakṛtyarthenāsaṃsṛṣṭasya prayuktimātrasyābhinā yogaḥ kīdṛśa iti cintyam |
sadiraprateḥ || 8.3.66 ||
`sadiḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathamā | niṣasādeti | sadisvañjyoḥ parasya liṭīti pratiṣedhādabhyāsāt parasya na bhavati ||
stanbheḥ || 8.3.67 ||
stanbhiḥ sautro dhātuḥ | abhiṣṭabhnātīti | `stunbhustunbhuskanbhuskunbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca' iti śnāpratyayaḥ, `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ |
apraterityetadiha nānuvarttata iti | yadyanuvartteta, pūrvasūtra eva stambhigrahaṇaṃ kuryātkiṃ yogavibhāgena ? asti prayojanam, kim ? `avāccālambanāvidūryayoḥ' iti vakṣyati, tatstambheryathā syāt, sadermā bhūt ? naitadasti; ekasminnapi yoge yasyālambanāvidūrye staḥ, sa evānuvartiṣyate, stambhereva ca te sambhavataḥ ||
avāccālambanāvidūryayoḥ || 8.3.68 ||
ālambanam-āśrayaṇam | vidūram-viprakṛṣṭam, tadanyadavidūram, tasya bhāva āvidūryam, ata eva nipātanāt nañpūrvādapi tatpuruṣādbhāvapratyayaḥ | avaṣṭabhyeti | yaṣṭyādikamavalambyetyarthaḥ | avaṣṭabdheti | āsannetyarthaḥ | avastabdha iti | abhyādita ityarthaḥ ||
veśca svano bhojane || 8.3.69 ||
udāharaṇeṣu svārthaparityāgena bhojanamātre svanirvartata iti śaṅkāmapanayati---abhyavahārakriyāviśeṣa iti | tameva viśeṣaṃ darśayati---yatreti | viṣvaṇatīti | saśabdaṃ bhuṅ‌kta ityarthaḥ ||
parinivibhyaḥ sevasitasayasivusahasuṭ‌stusvañjām || 8.3.70 ||
sevatirbhūvādiṣvanudāttet | sita iti | `ṣiñ‌ bandhane' ktāntaḥ | saya iti | sa evairajantaḥ, `ṣivu tantusantāne' divādiḥ, `ṣaha marṣaṇe' anudāttet |
suḍiti | `suṭ kātpūrvaḥ' ityasya grahaṇam | stusvañjī uktārthau, tayoḥ `upasargātsunoti' ityādinaiva siddhe paryādipūrvayoruttarasūtreṇāḍ‌vyavāye vikalpārthaṃ vacanam ||
sivādīnāṃ vā'ḍ‌vyavāye'pi || 8.3.71 ||
sivādayaḥ pratyāsatteḥ pūrvasūtre sanniviṣṭā gṛhyante | abhyatravibhāṣeyam, stusvañjyoḥ `prāk sitād' iti prāpte, itareṣāmaprāpte ||
anuviparyabhinibhyaḥ syandateraprāṇiṣu || 8.3.72 ||
`syandū prasravaṇe' anudāttet |
anusyandete matsyodake iti | matsyaścodaka ca matsyodake | `jātiraprāṇinām' ityanena yatra sarvāṇyavayavapadānyaprāṇivācīti, tatraikavadbhāvaḥ; iha tu matsyaśabdasya prāṇivācitvādekavadbhāvābhāvaḥ | atrāprāṇiṣviti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, tena prāṇyaprāṇisamudāye'pi prāṇyastīti pratiṣedho bhavati | anye tu paryudāsaṃ manyamānā bhavitavyamevātra ṣatvenetyāhuḥ |
iha paryādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, evaṃ vakṣyāmi---`anvabhibhyāṃ ca' iti, cakārāt parinivibhyaśceti ||
pareśca || 8.3.74 ||
pṛthagyogakaraṇasāmarthyāditi | anyathā `viparibhyāṃ skanderaniṣṭhāyām' ityeva brūyāt ||
veḥ skabhnāternityam || 8.3.77 ||
skambhiḥ sautro dhātuḥ ||
iṇaḥ ṣīdhvaṃluṅ‌liṭāṃ dho'ṅgāt || 8.3.78 || iṇantādaṅgāduttareṣāmityādinā iṇantamaṅgaṃ ṣīdhvamādīnāṃ viṣeṇam, te'pi dhakārasyeti darśayati | dhakārasya tviṇantamaṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na bhavati---iṇantādaṅgāduttarasya dhasya sa cet ṣītvamādīnāmiti | tathā hi sati yoṣiḍh‌vamityādau vacanasāmarthyātṣīśabdena vyavāya āśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt | acyoḍh‌vamiti | `dhi ca' iti salopaḥ |
iṇgrahaṇaṃ kavarganivṛttyarthamiti | prakṛtaṃ hīṇgrahaṇaṃ kavargeṇa sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt | pakṣīdhvamiti | `co kuḥ' iti kutve kṛte ḍhatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yakṣīdhvamiti | vraścādinā ṣatve kṛte `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvam |
studhve iti | ṭeretvam | astudhvamiti | laṅ‌ | pariveviṣīdhvamiti | `viṣlṛ vyāptau' juhotyādiḥ svaritet, `ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, `liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' iti sīyuṭaḥ sakāralopaḥ | atra dhātuṣakārasya, īdhvaśabdasya ca yaḥ samudāyastadātmakaḥ ṣīdhvaṃśabdo'sti, na tvasāvaṅgāduttaraḥ | ṣakārāntaṃ hyatrāṅgam, na tu vevītyetāvat |
codayati---arthavad‌grahaṇādapīti | pariharati---etattviti | etadarthavato grahaṇamatra nāśritam | kiṃ kāraṇam ? na kiñcit, nāśritamityeva ||
vibhāṣeṭaḥ || 8.3.79 ||
atreṇgrahaṇamiṭo viśeṣaṇam, so'pi ṣīdhvamādīnām, te'pi dhakārasyeti darśayannāha---iṇaḥ parasmādiṭa ityādi | tatra ṣīdhvamo liṭaśca śrutikṛtamānantaryam, śāstrakṛtaṃ tu na sambhavati, iṭastadbhaktatvāttad‌grahaṇena grahaṇāt | ata evānayoḥ prāptavibhāṣeyam |
tathaiva luṅyapyalaviḍh‌vamādau dhi ceti lupte sati sicsakāre |
iṇantamaṅgaṃ dhvami jātamātaḥ pūrvasya nityasya vidheḥ prasaṅgaḥ ||
evaṃ ca dhātāvaniṇanta iṣṭamaidhiḍh‌vamityādiṣu nityaḍhatvam |
yadi tviṇantādvihitasya ḍhatvaṃ tathā na te ḍhatvamadhiḍh‌vami syāt ||
tathā---lihidogdhinahāṃ ḍhatvaghatvadhatveṣu satsvapi |
iṇantādvihitaḥ ṣīdhvamiti ḍhatvaṃ prasajyate ||
tatheṇo luṅi gādeśe vihite dhvami karmaṇi |
agādhvaṃ yūyametenetyatra ḍhatvaṃ prasajyate ||
evaṃ `brūvo vaciḥ' vakṣīdhvamiti |
iṣyate sarvamevaitaditi cennāptavāgiha |
tasmātpāptavibhāṣaiva sarvatreyamiti sthitam ||
tathā ca taittirīyake `tān rudrā abruvanprayūyamajaniḍh‌vam' iti ḍhatvaṃ prayuktam | laviṣīḍh‌vam, laviṣīdhvamiti | anye tviṭo vibhāṣāyā vakṣyamāṇatvād gobalīvardanyāyena tadvyatiriktamiṇantamaṅgamiha gṛhyata iti vadanta edhidhvamityādau ḍhatvaṃ necchanti, teṣāmapyadhiḍh‌vamityatra bhavatyeva, natsīdhvamityādau ca na bhavati |
āsiṣīdhvamiti | `āsa upaveśane' | kathaṃ bhavitavyamiti | kimatrānena vikatpena bhavitavyam, uta neti praśnārthaḥ | upadidīyadhva iti | `dīṅ‌ kṣaye', liṭ‌, dhvami krādiniyamādiṭ, dīṅo yuḍaci kṅiti' iti yuṭ‌ | yuṭā vyavahitamiti | samudāyabhakte hi yuṭ tameva na vyavadadhyāt, iṭaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva | na bhavitavyaṃ ḍhatveneti | anena vikalpeneti bhāvaḥ | pūrveṇa tu nityaṃ prāpnotyeva | apareṣāmiti | asminpakṣe vikalpa eva bhavati ||
samāse'ṅgaleḥ saṅgaḥ || 8.3.80 ||
saṅga iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prathamā | evamuttareṣvapi yogeṣu | sañjanaṃ saṅgaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌, aṅgalīṣu saṅgo yasyāḥ sā'ṅguliṣaṅgā |
aṅgaleḥ saṅga iti | atra `śarvyavāye' ityadhikārātprasaṅgaḥ | anye tu `aṅgule saṅgaḥ' iti sambudhyantamudāharanti ||
bhīroḥ sthānam || 8.3.81 ||
bhīro sthānamiti | pūrvavatsambuddhyantam, ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vā |
`samāse'ṅgalibhīrubhyāṃ saṅgasthāne' ityucyamāne bhyāmityadhikaṃ prāpnoti, tasmādyogavibhāgaḥ ||
agneḥ stutstomasomāḥ || 8.3.82 ||
agniṣṭuditi | sampadāditvādadhikaraṇe kvip, yatrāgniḥ stūyate so'gniṣṭut-kratuviśeṣaḥ, tatredaṃ bhavati---api vā sarveṣu devatāśabdeṣvagnimevābhisannamediti | agniṣṭoma iti | somayāgasya saptaṃ saṃsthāḥ; tatrādyā saṃsthocyate |
agnerdīrghāditi | devatādvandve ṣatvamityarthaḥ; tatraiva dīrghasya vidhānāt |
agnisomau māṇavakāviti | atra māṇavake saṃjñātvena viniyuktāvagnisomaṣatvābhāvaḥ | agnisomau tiṣṭhata iti | āśvalāyanastu tatrāpi dīrghaṣatve prāyuṅ‌kta---agnīṣomau praṇeṣyāmīti ||
jyotirāyuṣaḥ stomaḥ || 8.3.83 ||
jyotiṣṭoma iti | atra `śarvyavāye' ityadhikārāt ṣatvam | evamāyuṣṭome'pi ||
mātuḥ piturbhyāmanyatarasyām || 8.3.85 ||
ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvād, `visarjanīyaśarvyavāye' ityadhikārācca pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ | mātuḥ ṣvaseti | `vibhāṣā svasṛpatyoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhyā aluk |
rephāntayoridaṃ grahaṇamiti | taccottarapade spaṣṭaṃ pūrvapadamapi tatsāhacaryādrephāntameva | yadyevam, rephasya visarjanīye kṛte tasya `vā śari' iti pakṣe satve kṛte'rephāntatvānna prāpnoti ? ata āha---ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāditi | yadi tu sakārāntayorgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta, visarjanīyāntayorna syāt | visarjanīyāntayostu grahaṇe bhyāmi parato nirdeśo durghaṭaḥ syāt ||
abhinisastanaḥ śabdasaṃjñāyām || 8.3.86 ||
abhinis ityetasmāditi | etena samudāyo nimittaṃ na pratyekamiti darśayati | abhiniṣṭāno visarjanīya iti | tathā cāpastambaḥ---`dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā nāma pūrvamākhyātottaraṃ dīrghābhiniṣṭhāntaṃ ghoṣavadādyantarantarastham' iti | dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā nāma karttavyam, kīdṛśam ? nāmapūrvam, nāma prātipadikamakriyāvāci tatpūrvapadam, ākhyātottaraṃ kriyāvācyuttarapadaṃ dīrghātparo yo'bhiniṣṭāno visarjanīyastadantaṃ dīrghāntaṃ visarjanīyāntaṃ cetyanye | goṣavānvarṇa ādiryasya taddhoṣavadādi, antarantasthaṃ yaralavānāmanyatamaṃ madhye yasya tattathoktamevaṃbhūtaṃ nāma karttavyam | draviṇodā varivodā ityādyudāharaṇam ||
upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacyaraḥ || 8.3.87 ||
y ca acca yacau, tau parau yasmātsa yac‌paraḥ | yacoriti saptamīnirdeśenaiva siddhe paragrahaṇaṃ cintyaprayojanam | abhiṣantīti | adāditvācchapo luk, `śnasorallopaḥ' |
anusṛtamiti | kathaṃ punaratra prasaṅgaḥ, yāvatā sakārasya prakṛtatvāttameva pratyupasargatvamāśrayiṣyate; na cātra sakāraṃ pratyupasargatvamasti, tāvanmātrasyākriyāvacanatvāt, tatkimastigrahaṇena; na ca prāduḥ śabdārthamastigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, tasya kṛbhvastiviṣayatvena niyatatvāt, tadetadāśaṅkate tāvat | tathāpīti | anusuśabdaḥ śubhrādiḥ, catuṣpādvacana ityanye, tato ṭhakṭhañoranyataraḥ, `ḍhe lopo'kadr‌vā' ityukāralope sakāramātrasya kriyāvācitvāt ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ||
suvinirdurbhyaḥ supisūtisamāḥ || 8.3.88 ||
supītyāgantuka ikāraḥ, na punarikā nirdeśaḥ | tatra `vacisvapi' iti lakṣaṇaprāptena sanprasāraṇena dhātorevāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syāt, tataśca yatrāsyaitadrūpaṃ tatra ṣatvamityayamartho na labhyate | tasmādāgantukenekāreṇa prayogasthasya kṛtasamprasāraṇasya rūpasyedamanukaraṇam | tadāha---supīti svapiḥ kṛtasamprasāraṇo gṛhyate iti | etacca `supi' iti nirdeśādeva labhyate, anyathā `vacisvapi' itivannirdiśet |
sūtīti svarūpagrahaṇamiti | sūteḥ ktinnantasya grahaṇamityarthaḥ | sametyapi svarūpagrahaṇameva, na `ṣama ṣṭama vaiklavye' iti dhātorgrahaṇam; ikśitaporanyatarasyābhāvāt |
atha kimatha svapeḥ supi bhūtasya ṣatvamucyate ? supeḥ ṣatvaṃ svapermā bhūt, supeḥ ṣatvamucyate, svapermā bhūditi---visvapnaḥ, visvapnamiti | visuṣvāpeti | atha kriyamāṇe'pi vikṛtagrahaṇe visuṣvāpeti kena na hetunā kena visuṣvāpetyatrābhyāsasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavati, `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' iti samprasāraṇe kṛte supirūpasya bhāvāt prāgeva halādiśeṣāt, kṛte vā tasminnekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādasti prasaṅgaḥ | halādiśeṣānna supiḥ | dvirvacane kṛte paratvāddhalādiḥ śeṣeṇa yakāre nivṛtte vakārasya samprasāraṇam, tataśca supirūpasya kadācidapyabhāvāt ṣatvābhāvaḥ | iṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ prasāraṇam | uktaṃ tatrobhayeṣāṃ grahaṇasya prayojanam---paramapi halādiśeṣaṃ bādhitvā ubhayeṣāṃ samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditi, tena samprasāraṇameva pūrvamiṣṭam, viśeṣataścātreṣṭam, anyathā ṣakāravadvakāro'pi nivartteta | na hyatra heturasti---ṣakāro nivarttate vakāro'vatiṣṭhata iti | evaṃ tarhi sthādiṣvevābhyāsasyetyetasmādeva niyamādatra ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? sthādīnāṃ niyamo nātra | kiṃ kāraṇam ? prāvisatāduttaraḥ supi | `prāksitāt' iti tatra varttate, tena prāksitā ye dhātavasteṣāṃ madhye sthādiṣvevābhyāsasya ṣatvamiti niyamena sunotisuvatisyatistobhataya eva nivartyante, supistvayaṃ tato'vadheruttaraḥ | evaṃ tahi `arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya' ityeṣametasya na bhaviṣyati, sthāne hi dvirvacanena samudāyo'rthavān, avayavau tvanarthakau, dviṣprayoge'rthapratyāyanasyānāvarttanād dvābhyāmarthaḥ pratyāyyata ityekasyānarthakyameva ? tadetadāha---anarthake viṣuṣupuḥ | yadyanarthakasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, viṣuṣupuriti na siddhyati ? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; ṣuṣibhūto dvirucyate | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate, tatra dvirvacanāt paratvātsamprasāraṇam, paratvādeva ṣatvam, kṛtaṣatvasyaiva tasya dvirvacanamiti |
nanu ṣatvasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ dvirvacanameva prāpnoti ? ata āha---pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacana iti ||
ninadībhyāṃ snāteḥ kauśale || 8.3.89 ||
niṣṇātaḥ kaṭakaraṇe iti | tatra kuśala ityarthaḥ | nadīṣṇa iti | nadīsnāne kuśala ityarthaḥ | kavayastu kuśalamātre prayuñjate | nadīsnāta iti | `saptamī' iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ ||
sūtraṃ pratiṣṇātam || 8.3.90 ||
`sūtraṃ prateḥ' iti vaktavye nipātanāśrayaṇaṃ pratyayāntare mā bhūt ||
kāpiṣṭhalo gotre || 8.3.91 ||
gotramiha pravarādhyāyapaṭhitaṃ gṛhyate, tatra ca svasantānasya vyapadeśaheturādyaḥ puruṣo gotramityucyate | pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe tu kāpiṣṭhalirityatraiva syādyatra gotrābhidhāyī pratyayaḥ | yadi tu gotraṃ na ṣatvasya viṣayeṇa nirddiṣṭam, kiṃ tarhi ? darśanasya gotre yo dṛṣṭaḥ kapiṣṭhalaśabdaḥ sa sādhurbhavati, kva ? yatra tatretyāśrīyate, pāribhāṣike'pi gotre na doṣaḥ ||
praṣṭho'gragāmini || 8.3.92 ||
prasthe himavata iti | `ghañarthe kavidhānam' ityadhikāraṇe kaḥ ||
vṛkṣāsanayorviṣṭaraḥ || 8.3.93 ||
vistīryata iti viṣṭaraḥ, `prathame vāvaśabde' iti ghañi prāpte | asmādeva nipātanādap | ruḍhiśabdatvādvā pacādyaci vyutpādyaḥ | ulapena kṛtā ṭīkā aulapī, sā vākyasya vistaraḥ, aśabda iti pratiṣedhādap ||
chandonāmni ca || 8.3.94 ||
viṣṭāra iti nipātyata iti | nanu ca viṣṭara iti prakṛtam, tatkathaṃ viṣṭāra iti nipātyate ? ata āha---vipūrvāditi |
yadi tviha chandonāmni viṣṭāra ityātvaṃ kriyeta, ghañvidhau `chandonāmni ca' iti śakyamakarttum, iha vā `viṣṭāra' ityucyeta, tatra vā `chandonāmni' iti, ko nvatra viśeṣaḥ, apara āha---ghañvivau vāviti nānuvarttate; tena prastārapaṅ‌ktiḥ, saṃstārapaṅ‌ktirityapi bhavatīti ||
gaviyudhibhyāṃ sthiraḥ || 8.3.95 ||
gaviṣṭhiraḥ, yudhiṣṭhira iti | `saṃjñāyām' iti saptamīsamāsaḥ | gośabdādahalantādapīti | yadyapyavādeśe kṛte samprati halanto bhavati, tathāpi utpattivelāyāmahalantatvānnipātanamāśritam ||
vikuśamiparibhyaḥ sthalam || 8.3.96 ||
vi, ku, pari---ityeteṣām `kugatiprādayaḥ' iti samāsaḥ, śamīśaśabdasya tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam' iti hrasvatvam | sūtre hrasvoccāraṇe hrasvapakṣa eva ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt | tena prayoge bahulavacanādyadā hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, tadā ṣatvamapi na bhavati ||
ambāmbagobhūmisavyāpadvitrikusekuśaṅ‌vavaṅgumañjipuñjiparamebarhirdivyagnibhyaḥ sthaḥ || 8.3.97 ||
sthaśabdasakārasyeti | etena `stha' iti sūtre svarūpagrahaṇaṃ prathamāntamiti darśayati | yadi tu `āto dhātoḥ' iti tiṣṭhaterākāralopaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaḥ syāt, tadā gosthānam, bhūmisthānamityādāvapi ṣatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | ambe tiṣṭhatyambaṣṭhaḥ, `supi sthaḥ' iti kapratyayaḥ, `ṅyāpoḥ' iti hrasvatvam | āmbaṣṭha iti | saṃjñeyaṃ janapadaviśeṣasya | goṣṭha iti | `ghañarthe kavidhānam' ityadhikaraṇe kapratyayaḥ | bhūmiṣṭhādau `supi sthaḥ' | savyeṣṭha iti | `haladantātsaptamyāḥ' ityaluk |
yadi `sthaḥ' iti svarūpagrahaṇam, sthāsthinsthaṇāṃ na prāpnotītidamāha---sthāsthinniti | sthāśabdaḥ kvibantaḥ | savyeṣṭhā iti | `ītve vakārapratiṣedhaḥ' iti vacanāt pratyayalakṣaṇenetvaṃ na bhavati | `gameriniḥ' iti varttamāne `parame sthaḥ kicca' iti kidinipratyayaḥ, parameṣṭhīśabda ipratyayāntaḥ bāhulakādākāralopaḥ | savye tiṣṭhati savyeṣṭhā sārathiḥ ||
suṣāmādiṣu ca || 8.3.98 ||
kvacit `sātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedhe prāpte kvaciccādita evāprāpte ṣatve suṣāmādiṣu mūrdhanyo vidhīyate | duṣṣāmeti | `visarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' ityadhikārādatra ṣatvam | suśabdasyetyādi | atraivamabhisambandhaḥ---sudusśabdayostu kriyāviśeṣaviṣayatvādanupasargatve sati---niṣedhaḥ, duḥ ṣedha iti pāṭho'yamiti | tatra suśabdasya `suḥ pūjāyām' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, sā copasargasaṃjñāyā bādhikā; ākaḍārādhikārāt | nirdurorapyupasargatvābhāvaḥ, kriyāntaraviṣayatvāt | gamikrayāviṣayau hi tau---nirgataḥ sedho niḥ ṣedhaḥ, durgataḥ sedho duṣṣedha iti | tena `upasargātsunoti' ityādinā naiteṣu ṣatvaprāptiḥ | evaṃ tāvat `ṣidhū hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyoḥ' ityasya ghañi sedha iti rūpamityāśrityoktam | yadā tu `ṣidha gatyām' ityasya ghañantasya rūpam ? tadāpyāha---seghatergatāviti pratiṣedhabādhanārthaṃ ceti | suṣandhirityādau `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ', samaḥ ṣatvam | uṇādiṣvetāviti | `pṝbhidivyadhidhṛṣibhya' kuḥ' iti vartamāne `apaduḥ supu sthaḥ' iti kupratyayaḥ |
gauriṣaktha iti | `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ' iti ṣac | pratiṣṇaketi | pratipūrvātsnāteḥ `ātaścopasarge' ityaṅ‌, tadantāṭṭāp, tato'jñātādiṣu kaḥ `ke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvatvam, `pratyayasthāt' itītvam | nauṣecanamiti | sicerlyuṭ | dundubhiṣevaṇamiti | sevateḥ, sīvyatervā lyuṭ |
etasaṃjñāyāmagāditi gaṇasūtram | tadvyācaṣṭe---ekāraparasyeti | harayaḥ senā asya hariṣeṇaḥ | paritaḥ senāsya pariṣeṇaḥ | pṛthvī senā yasyeti | `striyāḥ puṃvat' iti pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ |
nakṣatrādveti | pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ | cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, ākṛtigaṇatāmasya sūcayati, tadāha---avihitalakṣaṇa iti ||
hrasvāttādau taddhite || 8.3.99 ||
`apadāntasya' ityadhikārādaprāptaṃ ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, tarabādaya eva tāvattaddhitāḥ sambhavantītyāha---taraptamabiti | sarpiṣṭaramiti | sarpirjāteḥ prakarṣābhāve'pi sahacāriṇo guṇasya gandhādeḥ prakarṣe pratyayaḥ | catuṣṭaya iti | `jasaḥ śī' | sarpiṣṭa iti | pratiprayoge pañcamyāstasiḥ | āviṣṭya iti | avyayāttyap' ityatrāviḥ śabdāt `chandasi' iti vacanāttyap |
sarpiḥ sāditi | `vibhāṣā sātiḥ kārtsnye' | nanu ca `sātpadādyoḥ' iti pratiṣedhādevātra ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha---pratyayasakārasyeti |
bhindyustarām, chandyustarāmiti | bhidichidibhyāṃ liṅ‌, jherjusi yāsuṭ, `tiṅaśca' iti tarap, `kimettiṅavyayaghāt' iti āmupratyayaḥ |
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, `ti' ityeva `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe', puṃsaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, puṃstvam, puṃstā ||
nisastapatāvanāsevane || 8.3.100 ||
nistaptaṃ rakṣaḥ, nistaptā arātaya ityatreti | evamapi kasyāñcicchākhāyāṃ pāṭhamupalabhya parihāra ucyate | taittirīyakāstu ṣatvameva paṭhanti ||
yuṣmattattatakṣuḥ ṣvantaḥ pādam || 8.3.101 ||
tatakṣuḥ ṣviti sakārāntānukaraṇātparasya suṣsakārasya `numvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' iti ṣatvam | takārādiṣviti | etadyuṣmada eva viśeṣaṇam; itarayoravyabhicārāt | tvaṃ tvā ityādi | eteṣāmeva sambhava ityarthaḥ |
agnistatpunarāheti | agnirityayaṃ pūrvasya pādasyāntaḥ---yanma ātmano mindābhūdagniriti; tenāyaṃ pādānte sakāraḥ, na pādamadhye ||
stutastomayośchandasi || 8.3.103 ||
pūrvapadādityeva siddha iti | pūrvapadamiti sāmānyena tatrāśrīyate, na tu samāsāvayava eveti vākye'pi tenaiva siddhaṃ ṣatvamiti bhāvaḥ | tataśca stutastomagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham | chandograhaṇaṃ tūttarārthaṃ karttavyameva ||
pūrvapadāt || 8.3.104 ||
asamāse'pīti | etacca savanādiṣu `savanesavane' ityādīnāṃ pāṭhādevāvasīyate ||
suñaḥ || 8.3.105 ||
abhīṣuṇa iti | `ikaḥ suñiḥ' iti dīrghatvam, `naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ' iti ṇatvam | kvacittu vṛttāvevaitatpaṭhyate ||
sanoteranaḥ || 8.3.106 ||
goṣā iti | `janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ‌', `viḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' | kvacittvidamapi vṛttāvevāsti |
gosanimiti | `chandasi vanasanarakṣimathām' itīnpratyaḥ | sisānayiṣatīti | yadyapyaṇyantaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, tathāpyaṇyantasya pratiṣedhavacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā ṇyartho vijñāsyate | iha tu sisanīyatīti stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇītyetasmānniyamādaprasaṅgaḥ ṣatvasya | sisanīriti | kvipyato lopaḥ, tataḥ suḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ, sanaḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti rutvaṃ ca, tatra ṣatvasyāsiddhatvādrutvam, `rvorupadhāyā dīrghaḥ' iti dīrghatvam | atra san ṣatvabhūto na bhavatīti stautiṇyorevetyasya niyamasyāyamaviṣaya iti ṣatvaṃ prasaktam, asmānniyamānna bhavati | etasmiṃśca prayojane sati sāmarthyābhāvād ṇyantasya niyamābhāvāt siṣāṇayivatīti ṣatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||
saheḥ pṛtanartābhyāṃ ca || 8.3.107 ||
yogavibhāgamiti | tatra dvitīyo yogaḥ pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthaḥ | saṃhitāyāmeveti | ubhayatrāpi saṃhitādhikārādayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, `nahivṛtivṛṣa' ityādinā dīrghatvam |
na raparasṛpisṛjispṛśispṛhisavanādīnām || 8.3.108 ||
visraṃsikāyā iti | `rogākhyāyām' iti ṇvul | visrabdhamiti | `sṛmbhu viśvāse' ktaḥ, `yasya vibhāṣā' itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ | visṛpa iti | `sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' |
savanesavana ityādau vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam | kiṃsa ityatra `ayogavāhānāmaṭ‌suṇatvaṃ śarṣu jaśbhāvaṣatve' iti vacanāccharvyavāye iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yathā tu śaṣūpadeśo na kartavyastathā `hayavaraṭ‌' ityatroktam |
aśvasanigrahaṇamanarthakamaniṇantatvāt ? ata āha---aśvasanigrahaṇamiti | jñāpanasya prayojanamāha---jalāṣāhamiti ||
sātpadādyoḥ || 8.3.109 ||
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, padāditi pañcamīnirddeśaḥ karttavyaḥ---padātparasya sakārasya neti | ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti--agniṣu, vāyuṣu, tvakṣu ? sātipratiṣedho jñāpayati---svādau yatpadaṃ na tasmātpratiṣedha iti | tatrāyamapyarthaḥ---dadhisik, madhusigityādau pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati, na hyayaṃ sakāraḥ padādiḥ | gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛddhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ' iti vacanāt padātparastu bhavati, tatrāpi pūrvapadasya subantatvāt | bahucastu pratiṣedhaḥ | bahuvastu parasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ---bahusektā, na hyatra padātparaḥ sakāraḥ ||
sico yaṅi || 8.3.110 ||
parisesicyata iti | atrābhyāsasakārasya `upasargātsunoti' ityādinā prāptiḥ, dhātusakārasya tvādeśasakāratvāt `sthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' ityetasmācca | nanu copasargātpratiṣedhaviṣaye ṣatvamārabhyate, tadyathaiva padādipratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, evaṃ `sico yaṅi' ityetamapi bādheta ? ata āha---upasargādyā prāptiriti | yena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ bhavati, nāprāpte ca padādilakṣaṇe pratiṣedhe upasargāt ṣatvamārabhyate, `sico yaṅi' ityetasmiṃstu prāpte cāprāpte ca | atha vā---`purastādapavādā anantarānvidhīnbādhante na parān' iti | anenaitadapi nirastam---`sthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' ityanena yathābhiṣiṣikṣatītyatra stautiṇyoreveti niyamaṃ bādhitvā ṣatvaṃ bhavati, tathainamapi pratiṣedhaṃ bādhitvā dhātusakārasya prasaṅga iti ||
sedhatergatau || 8.3.111 ||
`upasargāt' iti prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate ||
pratistabdhanistabdhau ca || 8.3.112 ||
`stanbheḥ' iti prāptiḥ prati ṣidhyate ||
soḍhaḥ || 8.3.113 ||
soḍ‌bhūto gṛhyate iti | niṣṭhāntasya prathamayā nirdeśaśaṅkāmapākaroti | parisoñeti | `parinivibhyaḥ' iti prāpte pratiṣedhaḥ ||
stambhusivusahāṃ caṅi || 8.3.114 ||
atrādyasya `stambheḥ' iti prāptiḥ, itarayostu `parinivibhyaḥ sevasita' iti | abhyatastambhaditi | `prāksitādaḍ‌vyavāye'pi' iti `sthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' iti prāptiḥ | paryasīṣivaditi | atrāpi `sivādīnāṃ vāḍ‌vyavāye'pi' iti prāptiḥ ||
upasargāditi vaktavyamiti | kimartham ? ityāha---upasargādyā prāptiriti ||
sunoteḥ syasanoḥ || 8.3.115 ||
atretyādi | itikaraṇo hetau, yasmāt stautiṇyoreveti niyamādabhyāsādaprāptiḥ, rathādiṣvevābhyāsasyeti niyamādupasargādapyaprāptiḥ, tasmādabhisusūrityudāharanti | atha vā kathaṃ ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ? ata āha---atra hīti | yathā cātra sanṣa--------------------ityatroktam | abhyāsātprāptimiti | abhyāsagrahaṇamupasargātprāpterasambhavādabhyāsena vyavahitānna dhātusakārasya prasaṅgaḥ, nāpyabhyāsasakārasya, sthādiniyamena vyāvatitatvāt | evaṃ cātrābhigrahaṇamatantram, susūrityevodāhartavyam ||
sadisvanjyoḥ parasya liṭi || 8.3.116 ||
liṭi dvirvacane kṛte dvau sakārau bhavataḥ, tatra sadeḥ `sthādiṣvabhyāsena ca' iti vacanāt `sadiraprateḥ' iti ṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ, svañcerapi `upasargātsunoti' ityādinā | pariṣasvaja iti | kathaṃ punaratra nalopaḥ, yāvatā saṃyogāntatvānnātra liṭaḥ kittvamasti ? ata āha---svañjeriti | etacca `indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca' ityatra vyākhyātam, svañjigrahaṇañca vārttike darśanātsūtre prakṣiptam, yathāha---`sado liṭi pratiṣedhe svañcerupasaṃkhyānam' iti ||
nivyabhibhyo'ḍ‌vyavāye vā chandasi || 8.3.117 ||
prakaraṇe prāptasya satvamātrasya pratiṣedhaḥ | nyaṣṭauditi | `uto vṛddhirluki hali' iti vṛddhiḥ, abhyasthādviṣoḥ pṛtanā arātīrityapyudāharaṇam ||
