kāśikāvṛttiḥ----6
atha aṣṭamādhyāye caturthaḥ pādaḥ
raṣābhyāṃ no ṇaḥ samānapade || 8.4.1 ||
nimittayorādeśe cakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | samānaṃ ca tatpadaṃ samānapadam | nimittanimittinoścāyamādhāranirddeśaḥ | tadāha---samānapadastho cediti | ekaparyāyaḥ samānaśabdaḥ | nimitte raṣau, nimittī nakāraḥ | yadyapyasau prāgeva siddhasvarūpaḥ, tathāpi tatsthāne bhavato ṇakārasya yannimittam, tasyāpi tena sambandho'styeva | ṇakāra eva vā nimittī, tasya tu vidhānottarakālaṃ samānapadasthatvam |
ṣagrahaṇamuttarārthamiti | aḍādivyavāye ṇatvaṃ vakṣyati, tadasmādapi yathā syāt | athehārthamapi kasmānna bhavati ? ata āha---ṣṭutvenaiva siddhametaditi |
ṛvarṇācceti vaktavyamiti | raṣābhyāṃ ṇatvamucyamānamṛkārānna prāpnoti vacanam | na ca śakyaṃ vaktum---ṛvarṇasthādrephād bhaviṣyatīti | varṇo hyatra rephaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, ṣakāreṇa sāhacaryāt | na ca varṇaikadeśā varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyante | tisṛṇāmiti | `na tisṛcatasṛ' iti pratiṣedhāt `nāmi' iti dīrghatvābhāvaḥ |
tattarhi vaktavyam ? netyāha---raśrutisāmānyanirdeśātsiddhamiti | ra iti śrutiḥ-śrotreṇopalabdhiryayoste raśrutī-varṇātmikā cāvarṇātmikā ca vyaktiḥ, tayoryatsāmānyaṃ tannidiśyate; na tu varṇātmikaiva vyaktirityarthaḥ | nanvevamapi ṛkāre trayo bhāgā abhito'jbhaktirmadhye rephabhaktirmātrā caturbhāgātmikā, tataśca parayājbhaktyā vyavadhānānna prāpnoti ? `aḍ‌vyavāye' ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati | na parājbhaktiraṭ‌sanniviṣṭā, sā hyarddhamātrā caturbhāgātmikā ṛkārabhaktiḥ | na ca tasyāḥ savarṇagrahaṇena nāpyaḍ‌grahaṇena grahaṇam; asavarṇatvāt, na hi tasyāḥ sthānaṃ prayatno vā pṛthagasti | tasmātsāmānyanirdaśe'pi nai ṇatvaṃ sidhyati, ata āha---varṇabhaktyāceti | varṇasya samudāyasyāvayavabhūtā yā parājbhaktistayetyarthaḥ | nanu ca nṛnamanagrahaṇaṃ vṛddhyarthaṃ syāt---nṛnamanasyāpatyaṃ nārnamaniriti ? naitadasti; bahiraṅgā vṛddhiḥ, antaraṅgaṃ ṇatvam, `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' |
atha veti | vyaktinirddeśe'pi doṣa ityarthaḥ | aparaḥ prakāraḥ---abhito'jbhaktī caturbhāgātmike, madhye śuddho repho'rdhamātrātmakaḥ, tena vyaktinirdeśe'pyadoṣa ityarthaḥ | nanu ca parayājbhaktyā vyavadhānam ? evaṃ tarhi uttarasūtre yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate---`vyavāye'pi' iti, vyavāye'pi ṇetvaṃ bhavati; tataḥ `aṭ‌kupvāṅ‌numbhiḥ' iti | idamidānīṃ kimartham ? niyamārtham---varṇātmakairvyavāye yadi bhavati aḍādibhireveti | `apadāntasya mūrdhanyaḥ' ityadhikārādatra ṇagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum | uttaratra ca `padāntasya' iti pratiṣedhaḥ ||
aṭ‌kupvāṅ‌numvyavāye'pi || 8.4.2 ||
`raṣābhyām' iti pañcamīnirddeśādvyavāye na prāpnotītyayamārambhaḥ | paryāṇaddhamiti | `ṇaha bandhane', paryāṅ‌pūrvaḥ niṣṭhā, `naho dhaḥ' |
nanu ca `aḍ‌vyavāye' ityevātra ṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ tatkimarthamāṅ‌grahaṇam ? ityata āha---aḍ‌vyavāya ityeva siddhamiti | kvacittu āṅ‌grahaṇaṃ padavyavāye'pītyasya bādhanārthamityetāvat paṭhyate | bṛṃhaṇamiti | `bṛhi vṛddhau', `idito num', `naścāpadāntasya jhali' ityanusvāraḥ |
yadyevam, anusvāreṇātra vyavāyo na numā ? ata āha---numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇārthamiti | jhalparasya numo'nusvāravidhānātsthāninā numānusvāra upalakṣyate | evamapi yo'nusvāro numsthāniko na bhavati tadvyavāye na prāpnoti `tṛṃha stṛṃha hiṃsārthau', tṛṃhaṇamiti ? ata āha---teneti | nātra numsthāniko'nusvāra upalakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anusvāramātraṃ tenātrāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ | yatra tarhi numa eva śravaṇaṃ nānusvārasya tatra ṇatvaṃ bhavati vā, na vā ? ata āha---satyapi ceti | yathā `nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vācaṃ visṛjet' iti kālaviśeṣopalakṣaṇaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ satyapi divā nakṣatradarśane vāg na visṛjyate, upalakṣitasya kālasyābhāvāt; asatyapi nakṣatradarśane rātrau visṛjyate, tasya kālasya bhāvāt; tathehāpi draṣṭavyam | prenvanamiti | `iviḥ prīṇanārthaḥ', `idito num', atra `ijādeḥ sanumaḥ' iti ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
iha samudāye vākyaparisamāptirdṛṣṭā, yathā---gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍyantāmiti, arthinaśca rājāno hiraṇyena bhavanti, na ca pratyekaṃ daṇḍayanti; pratyekamapi dṛṣṭā, yathā---vṛddhiguṇasaṃjñe pratyekaṃ bhavataḥ | tatreha yadi pūrvaḥ kalpa āśrīyate, na kvacit syāt, na hi samastairaḍādibhirvyavāyaḥ kvacidapi sambhavati | dvitīye tu arheṇetyādau na syāt; aṭā kavargeṇa ca vyavāyāt | ata āha---vyavāyopa lakṣaṇārthatvāditi | iha ye yadupalakṣaṇāyopādīyante teṣāmekena dvābhyāṃ bahubhirapyupalakṣitaḥ sa gṛhyate, tadyathā---`gargaiḥ saha na bhoktavyam' ityukte pratyekaṃ ca saha na bhujyate, samuditairapi, tathehāpi śaknuvantyaḍādayaḥ samastā vyastāśca vyavāyamupalakṣayitumiti sarvatra bhavati | aḍādivyavāye ṇatve'nyavyavāye pratiṣedhaḥ---ādarśena, sparśena | yadyapyatrānyenāpi vyavāyaḥ, yastvaṭā vyavāyastadāśrayaṃ ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti, yatra tvanirdiṣṭaireva vyavāyastatraiva na syāt---kṛtsnam, mṛdhnotīti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `raṣābhyām' ityatra `tasmāt' iti paribhāṣopasthānādvyavāye ṇatvāsaṅgāt sūtramidamārabhyamāṇamaḍādivyavāya eva ṇatvamanujānāti, nānyavyavāye; tasya nirdiṣṭagrahaṇena nivartitatvāt, yadi ca nidiṣṭavyatiriktairapi vyavāye ṇatvaṃ syāt, numgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; kevalena numā vyavāyāsambhavāt ||
pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ || 8.4.3 ||
`raṣābhyām' iti vartate, na ca tayoḥ pūrvapadatvaṃ sambhavatīti sāmarthyātpūrvapadasthānnimittāduttarasyetyeṣo'rtho vijñāyata ityāha---pūrvapadasthāditi | rephaṣakārāntāpūrvapadādityayaṃ tvartho na bhavati; vyākhyānāt | draṇasa iti | druriva nāsikā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, `añnāsikāyāḥ' ityañpratyayo naśādeśaśca | vārdhrīṇasa iti | vadhrarthā vikāro vārdhrī rajjuḥ, vārdhrīva nāsikā yasya sa vārdhrīṇasaḥ-mṛgaviśeṣaḥ | tatra pūrvapadasyopamānaniṣṭhatvādvyadhikaraṇatvāt puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ, nasśabdaḥ priyādiṣu vā draṣṭavyaḥ | śūrpaṇakheti | `nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām' iti pratiṣedhaḥ | yadā tu yogo vivakṣyate, na saṃjñā---śūrpākārāṇi nakhāni yasyā iti; tadā ṅīṣ‌ bhavati, ṇatvaṃ tu na bhavati---śūrpanakhī | evaṃ ca ṇatvaṅīṣau na samavetaḥ---`tataḥ śūrpanakhīvākyāt' iti |
`agaḥ' iti śakyamavaktum | kasmānna bhavati---ṛcāmayanamṛgayanamiti ? nipātanādetatsiddham---`aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ' iti | yathānyatroktam--sarvanāma saṃjñāyāṃ nipātanāṇṇatvābhāva iti |
pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti | viparītastu niyamo na bhavati---pūrvapadādeva saṃjñāyāmiti, śivādiṣu suṣeṇaśabdasya pāṭhāt | siddhe satyārambho niyamāya bhavati, kathamatra siddhiḥ ? ityāha---samānapade'pi hīti | yadyapi pūrvapadasthaṃ nimittamuttarapadastho nimittīti bhinnapadasthatvamapyasti, tathāpi samāse kṛte tato vā vibhaktirutpadyate, tayā samudāyasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tasminsamāne'pi pade bhāvādastyeva pūrveṇa prāptiḥ, samānapadatvaṃ hi tatrāśritam, na bhinnapadatvaṃ pratiṣiddham | tasmādupapannaṃ niyamārthatvam | yadyevam, yathottarapadasthasya nakārasya ṇatvaṃ niyamena vyāvarttyate---carmanāsika iti; tathā taddhitapūrvapadasthasyāpi vyāvarttyeta---kharapasyāpatyam `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌'---khārapāyaṇaḥ, mātṛbhogāya hitaḥ `bhogottarapadātkhaḥ'---mātṛbhogīṇaḥ, karaṇaṃ priyamasya karaṇapriyaḥ ? ityāha---sa ceti | sambandhiśabdo niyatameva pratiyoginamupasthāpayati, tadyathā---mātari vartitavyaṃ pitari śuśrūṣitavyamiti, na cocyate---svasyāṃ mātari svasminpitarīti, atha ca sambandhādetad gamyate---yasya yā mātā tasyāmiti, yo yasya pitā tasminniti | pūrvapadam, uttarapadamiti ca sambandhiśabdāvetau---pūrvapadamapekṣyottarapadaṃ bhavati, uttarapadaṃ cāpekṣya pūrvapadam | tatra sambandhādetadavagantavyam---yatprati pūrvapadamityetadbhavati tatsthasya niyama iti | kiñca pratyetadbhavati ? uttarapadam |
ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ---`agaḥ' iti niyamasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, tenaikavākyatvāt, na ṇatvasya, tataśca saṃjñāyāñca gāntare ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti ? ata āha---aga iti | `agaḥ' iti yo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ sa ṇatvasya, na niyamasya | atra hetuḥ--yogavibhāgeneti | `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityeko yogaḥ, `agaḥ' iti dvitīyaḥ; anena ca yā ca yāvatī ca ṇatvaprāptiḥ sā sarvā pratiṣidhyate, yogavibhāgasāmarthyāt |
apare tvityādi | katha punaḥ samānamevetyavadhāraṇaṃ labhyate ? ata āha---samānagrahaṇāditi | `pade' ityeva vaktavyam, tatrāpadasthayornirmittinimittanora sambhavāt padagrahaṇamekatvavivakṣārthaṃ vijñāyate | evaṃ siddhe yatsamānagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasyaitatprayojanaṃ yathaivaṃ vijñāyeta---samānameva yatpadamiti | teṣāmevaṃ bruvatāṃ vidhyarthametadvijñāyata ityāha---teṣāmiti | vidhyarthatvamevopapādayati---samāse hīti | athāsminpakṣe khārapāyaṇa ityatra kathaṃ ṇatvam, yāvatā kharapaśabde kharaśabdasyāpi padatvamasti, tatsthatvādrephasya samānapadasthatvameva na bhavati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yatra dvāvapi nimittanimittinau samānapadasthatvaṃ vyabhicarataḥ, tatra ṇatvābhāvaḥ; iha rephasya vyabhicāre'pi nakārasya samānapadasthatvāvyabhicārāṇṇatvaṃ pravarttate ||
vanaṃ puragāmiśrakāsidhrakāśārikākoṭarāgrebhyaḥ || 8.4.4 ||
`vanam' iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prathamā | udāharaṇe `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām' iti pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam | agrevaṇamiti | ṣaṣṭhīsamāse rājadantāditvādvanaśabdasya paranipātaḥ, `haladantāt' iti saptamyā aluk, atha na saṃjñā tato rājadantādiṣu nipādanādaluk |
siddhe satītyādi | puragādiṣvetaducyate, agreśabde tvasaṃjñāyāṃ vidhyarthamityāhuḥ | etebhya eva vananakārasyeti | `etebhyo vananakārasyaiva' ityayaṃ tu niyamo na bhavati; dīrghīccāraṇāt | taddhi dīrghānteṣvayaṃ niyago bhavediti | na ca vanādanyatrottarapade dīrghāntatvameṣāṃ sambhavati, yatrāsya ṇatvaṃ dīrghānteṣu vyāvarttyeta ||
pranirantaḥ śarekṣuplakṣāmrakārṣyakhadirapīyūkṣābhyo'saṃjñāyāmapi || 8.4.5 ||
atrāditastriṣu saṃjñāyāmasajñāyāmaprāptaṃ ṇatvaṃ vidhīyate, katham ? saṃjñāyāṃ tāvat `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityetadyadyapi niyamārtham, athāpi vidhyartham---ubhayathāpi avaśyam `vanaṃ puragā' ityādisūtraṃ niyamārtham---puragādiṣveva vananakārasyeti, tataśca prādiṣvaprāptiḥ | asaṃjñāyāmapi niyame tāvadaprāptiḥ; saṃjñāyāmeveti niyamāt | vidhāvapi saṃjñāyāṃ vidhānādanyatrāprāptireva | śarādiṣu tvoṣadhivanaspativāciṣu saṃjñāyāmasaṃjñāyāṃ cottarasūtreṇa prāptasya vikalpasyāpavādaḥ | `asaṃjñāyāmapi' ityanucyamāne `saṃjñāyām' ityadhikārāttatraiva syāt | nivartiṣyate saṃjñāyāmiti ? yadi nivartate, saṃjñāyāṃ na prāpnoti; puragādibhya eva vananakārasyeti niyamāt | ayaṃ tu vidhirasaṃjñāyāṃ sāvakāśaḥ, saṃjñāyāmapi paratvādayameva vidhirbhaviṣyati, `pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedhaḥ', tasmādasaṃjñāyāmapīti vaktavyam | pravaṇam, nirvaṇamiti | prādisamāsau | antarvaṇamiti | vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, śaravaṇādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsasāsāḥ ||
vibhāṣauṣadhivanaspatibhyaḥ || 8.4.6 ||
`asaṃjñāyāmapi' ityanuvarttate, tena saṃjñā'saṃjñāyordvayorayaṃ vikalpaḥ | anye tu vṛttāvanuktatvāttasyādhikāraṃ necchanti, teṣāṃ saṃjñāviṣaye puragādibhya iti niyamatvena bhavitavyam | yadi tviṣyate yatnāntaramāstheyam |
iha ye puṣpyanti phalanti ca te vānaspatyāḥ; ye phalantyeva na puṣpyanti te vanaspatayaḥ; ubhaye'pi te vṛkṣā ityabhidhānavidaḥ | tataśca vanaspatiśabdopādānena ṇatvaṃ vikalpyamānaṃ śirīṣavaṇamityatraiva syāt, śirīṣādayo hi puṣpyanti phalanti ca, tasmādvṛkṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, tadidamāśaṅkate tāvat---
phalī navaspatirityādi | phalameva yasya na puṣpaṃ sa vanaspatiḥ-udumbarādi, puṣpopagā vetasādayaḥ, phalopagā udumbarādayaḥ, ubhayopagā āmrādayaśca vṛkṣāḥ | antātyantādisūtre `ḍo'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti vacanāḍuḥ | phalapākena vināśo yāsā tā oṣadhyaḥ---śālyādayaḥ, latāpratānavatyo mālatyādayaḥ, gulmāḥ-hrasvaskandhāstaravaḥ, bahukāṇḍapatrāḥ vīrudha iti---yadyapi vṛkṣavanaspatyorbhedaḥ smaryata iti śaṅkāṃ paraharati---ihābhedena grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti | atra ca `lupi yuktavadvyaktivacane' ityatra bhāṣyakāravacanaṃ liṅgam | uktaṃ hi tatra---"vyaktivacana iti kim, śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhavo grāmaḥ śirīṣāḥ, tasya vanaṃ śirīṣavanamiti---vanaspatitvaṃ nātidiśyate | yadyatidiśyeta, `vibhāṣauṣadhivanaspatibhyaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ prasajyeta" iti | yadi cokto bheda ihāśritaḥ syāt, śirīṣaṇāmavanaspatitvādvanaspatitvaṇatvayoḥ prasañjanaṃ nopapadyeta ||
ahno'dantāt || 8.4.7 ||
pūrvāhṇa iti | ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāga iti `pūrvāpara' ityādisūtreṇa samāsaḥ, `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac‌', `ahno'hna etebhyaḥ' itya ahnādeśaḥ | nirahna iti | nirgato'hna iti prādisamāsaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | dīrghāhnī śarādati | bahuvrīhirayam, tena ṭajna bhavati; ṭajvidhau tatpuruṣādhikārāt | `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' iti ṅīp, `allopo'naḥ' | akārāntasya grahaṇādatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavati | yadi tu nakārasyāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaḥ syāt, atrāpi ṇatvaṃ syāt | akārāntasya tu grahaṇaṃ prakaraṇādvijñāyate | sarvatra prakaraṇe sthānī prathamayā nidiśyate---vanam, vāhanam, yānamiti | yadvā---yuvādiṣu pāṭhādasya ṇatvābhāvaḥ | avaśyakartavyaśca yuvādiṣu pāṭhaḥ; prātipadikānteti vikalpena ṇatvaṃ mā bhūditi | antagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam---atra prakaraṇe na yatnamantareṇa varṇenāpi tadantavidhirbhavatīti | tena `raṣābhyām' ityatra tadantavidhine bhavati ||
vāhanamāhitāt || 8.4.8 ||
uhyate'neneti vāhanam-śakaṭādi, karaṇe lyuṭ, asmādeva nipātanādupadhāvṛddhiḥ | āhitamāropitamucyate | yadā bāhyaṃ nāropitaṃ kevalaṃ sannihitaṃ tadāna na prāpnoti, tadāpīṣyate | yadāha---āhitopasthitayoriti vaktavyamiti | na vā bhūtakālasyāvivakṣitatvāt, svāmibhāvanivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāmāhitamiti bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate, tenāhitādādhāyiṣyamāṇācca bhaviṣyati | kevalaṃ svasvāmibhāvavivakṣāyāmeva na bhavati, yathā pratyudāharaṇe uktam---dākṣisvāmikamityartha iti | dākṣyādayo'pi yadā vāhyatvena vivakṣyante na svāmitvena, tadā ṇatvaṃ bhavatyeva ||
pānaṃ deśe || 8.4.9 ||
kṣīraṃ pānaṃ yeṣāmiti | karttari ṣaṣṭhī | uśīnarādayaḥ śabdā deśadvāreṇa puruṣeṣu vartanta iti deśābhidhāyino bhavanti |
dākṣaīṇāṃ pānamiti | atrāpi karmasādhana eva pānaśabdaḥ ||
vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ || 8.4.10 ||
girinadyādīnāmiti | saṃjñāyāṃ prāpte, asaṃjñāyāmaprāpte---ityubhayatravibhāṣeyamityāhuḥ ||
prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca || 8.4.11 ||
māṣavāpiṇāviti | `bahulamābhīkṣṇye' iti ṇiniḥ | māṣavāpāṇīti | māṣānvapantīti `karmaṇyaṇ‌', `jaśśasoḥ śi', `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' iti num |
iha kasmānna bhavati---gargāṇāṃ bhaginī gargabhaginīti | bhaginnityasya prātipadikasyānto nakāra ityasti prāptiḥ ? ityata āha---pūrvapadādhikārāditi | etacca `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' ityatraiva vyākhyātam | kimidānīṃ naiva bhavati---gargabhagiṇīti, bhavati vivakṣāntare śāstrāntereṇa nityam, na tvanena ? ityāha---yadā tviti | mātṛbhogīṇavaditi | etadapi tatraiva vyākhyātam |
yadyuttarapadaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate māṣavāpiṇītyatra ṇatvaṃ na prāpnoti, yaduttarapadaṃ vāpinīti na tasyānto nakāraḥ, yasya cānto nakāro vāpinniti na taduttarapadam ? ata āha---māṣavāpiṇītyādi | `upapadamatiṅ‌' ityatraitadvyākhyātam | `uttarapadabhūtaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate' ityatra jñāpakamāha---tathā ceti | kathametajjñāpakam ? ityāha---sa hīti | aṅgasya numvidhīyate, tataśca tadbhakto num tad‌grahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, nottarapadagrahaṇena | yadi ca yatkiñcana prātipadikaṃ gṛhyeta nottarapadameva, tato numgrahaṇamakarttavyameva syāt; `samāsaprātipadikānta' ityeva siddhatvāt |
āryayūneti | viśeṣaṇamāsaḥ | `śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' iti samprasāraṇam | prapakvānīti | gatisamāsaḥ | atra `kumati ca' iti nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti | dīrghāhnī śaraditi | ayamapi yuvādiṣu draṣṭavya ityuktam ||
ekājuttarapade ṇaḥ || 8.4.12 ||
vikalpādhikāranivṛttevispaṣṭīkaraṇārthamiti | anyathā yadyapyatrārambhasāmarthyānnityo vidhiḥ śakyo vijñātum, uttaratra tvanuvṛttiḥ sambhāvyeta ||
kumati ca || 8.4.13 ||
anekājuttarapadārtho'yamārambhaḥ | vastrayugiṇāviti | yugaśabdādini kṛte paścādinnantena samāsaḥ kartavyaḥ | evaṃ tarhi uttarapadasya prātipadikasyānto nakāro bhavati; anyathā mātṛbhogīṇavallakṣaṇāntareṇaiva ṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ syāt, `kau' ityucyamāne'pi kavargamātrasyottarapadasyāsambhavānmatubartho labhyate, nārtho matupā ? satyam; `kau' ityucyamāne tadādividhivijñāyeta---kavargādāvuttarapada iti ||
upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya || 8.4.14 ||
ṇa upadeśe yasya sa ṇopadeśaḥ | pranāyako deśa iti | atra gatikriyāyogamātrameva prati prasyopasargatvam, na namatiṃ prati |
asamāse'pīti kimiti | viśeṣānupādānādeva samāsāsamāsayordvayorapi bhaviṣyatiti praśnaḥ | pūrvapadādhikārāditi | sarvatraivātra prakaraṇe `pūrvapadāt' iti vartate, samāse eva pūrvapadaṃ bhavati, tena samāsa eva syāt | tadadhikāranivṛttidyotanārthamiti | nānena vispaṣṭārthamasamāse'pigrahaṇamicyute | tathā hi---yadyapyasvaritatvāt `pūrvapadāt' iti nivarttate, tathāpyasamāse'pigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, anyathā'saṃjñāyāṃ samāse na syāt; pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti niyamādasya ca vidherasamāse caritārthatvāt | tasmātpūrvapadādhikāranivṛttidyotanamukhena samāsāsamāsayordvayorapi yathā syādityasamāse'pigrahaṇamityayamartho draṣṭavyaḥ | nanvasiddhamupasargaṇatvam, tasyāsiddhatvānniyamo na bhaviṣyati, tena `pūrvapadāt' ityasminnivṛtte na karttavyamasamāse'pigrahaṇam ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati---na yoge yogo'siddhaḥ, api tu prakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhamiti | yadā tu `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyām' iti sūtraṃ niyamārthamiti pakṣaḥ, tadaitaducyate | yadā tu vidhyartha tadā naitadupapadyate ||
hinumīnā || 8.4.15 ||
`hi gatau' svādiḥ, `mīñ‌ hiṃsāyām' kriyādiḥ, dīrghāntaḥ |
hinumīnāgrahaṇae vikṛtasyopasaṃkhyānam, ihāpi yathā syāt---prahiṇoti, pramiṇītaḥ ? siddhaṃ vā sthānivattvāt; ītvaguṇayoḥ sthānivadbhāve sati upāttameva rūpamiti ṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | nanu `pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat' ? doṣa evāyamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ `tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' iti |
āni loṭ || 8.4.16 ||
pravapāṇīti | vaperloṭ, `merniḥ' | `āḍuttamasya picca', prayāṇīti yāte rūpam | pravapānīti | prakṛṣṭā vapā yeṣu tāni pravapāni | āniloḍ‌grahaṇamanarthakam; arthavad‌grahaṇāt, arthavata āniśabdasya grahaṇam, na caiṣo'rthavān | anupasargādvā, yat kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, na caitamāniśabda prati kriyāyogaḥ, tadantaṃ tu prati bhavati | kathaṃ naivaṃ vijñāyate---yasya kriyā yatkriyā, yatkriyāyuktā iti ? kathaṃ tarhi yā kriyā yatkriyā yatkriyāyuktā iti, prayogaviṣayā ca kriyā na kvacidasaṃsṛṣṭāstīti samudāyasyāśrīyata iti āniśabdāntaṃ samudāyaṃ prati kriyāyogaḥ | tatrāyaṃ ca sūtrārthaḥ---upasargāt parasyāvayavo ya āniśabdastannakārasya ṇatvamiti | tadevaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ loḍ‌grahaṇam ||
nergadanadapatapadaghumāsyatihantiyātivātidrātipsātivapativahatiśāmyaticinotidegdhiṣu ca || 8.4.17 ||
`gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti vacanāt `mīnātiminotidīṅām' ityātve kṛte yanmārūpam, yacca `mā māne' iti, teṣāmapi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityā śaṅkyāha---māṅ‌meṅorgrahaṇamiṣyata iti | iṣṭireveyam | praṇiṣyatīti | `otaḥ śyani', `upasargātsunoti' ityādinā ṣatvam | hantiprabhṛtayaḥ psātiparyantā adādayaḥ, `mā māne ca' | praṇiśāmyatīti | `śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani' |
sytyādiṣu tipā nirdeśo yaṅ‌lugnivṛttyarthaḥ |
aḍ‌vyavāye'pīti | anyathāṅgasyāḍucyate, vikaraṇāntaṃ cāṅgam, so'sau saṅghātabhakto'śakyo gadādigrahaṇena grahītumiti na syāt | āṅā ceti vaktavyam---praṇyāgadaditi | tattarhi vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam, `aṭakupvāṅ‌numvyavāye' iti varttate, tena nergadādīnāṃ cāḍ‌vyavāye ca bhaviṣyati | pranyupagadatītyādau tu `padavyavāye'pi' iti pratiṣedhādapresaṅgaḥ ||
śeṣe vibhāṣā'kakhādāvaṣānta upadeśe || 8.4.18 ||
`akakhādāvaṣānte' iti copasargasannidhāpitasya dhātorviśeṣaṇamityāha---akakhādiraṣānta upadeśe yo dhāturiti |
ādigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum, `akakhe iti vaktavyam, `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' | antagrahaṇaṃ tu karttavyam, asati hi tasminna jñāyate---kena tadādividhiḥ, kena vā tadantavidhiriti |
śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kim ? gadādiṣu mā bhūt | yadi teṣvapi syāt, pūrvayogo nirviṣayaḥ syāt;tasmāccheṣa iti śakyamavaktum |
pranipekṣyatīti | `ṣaḍho kaḥ si' iti katve kṛte sampratyaṣānto bhavati | pranicakāreti | `kuhoścuḥ' ityabhyāsasya cutve kṛte sampratyayaṃ na kakārādirbhavati | praṇiveṣṭeti | `vraśca' ityādiṣatve kṛte samprati ṣānto bhavati, upadeśe tvaṣāntatvāṇṇatvaṃ bhavati ||
aniteḥ || 8.4.19 ||
prāṇitīti | `śvasa prāṇane', `ana ca', rudādibhyassārvadhātuke' itīṭ ||
antaḥ || 8.4.20 ||
aniterantasyeti | aniteḥ sambandhinaḥ padāntasya nakārasyetyarthaḥ | he prāṇiti | kvibantātsambuddhiḥ, `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' iti nalopapratiṣedhaḥ | anyatra tu padāntasya nakārasya lopena bhavitavyamiti sambuddhyantamudāhṛtam | antaśca padāpekṣo gṛhyata iti | nānityapekṣaḥ; vyabhicārābhāvāt |
kecittvityādi | `aniterantaḥ' ityekameva yogaṃ paṭhanti, samīpavacanaṃ cāntaśabdamāśrayantītyarthaḥ | kimartham ? ityāha---nimittasamīpasyeti | nanu ca nāstyeva sa viṣayo yatra nimittasya samīpabhūto'niternakāraḥ, prāṇitītyādāvekādeśe kṛte ākāreṇa vyavāyaḥ, niraṇitītyatrākāreṇa, tatkathaṃ nimittasamīpasthasyetyucyate ? ata āha---ekavarṇavyavahitasyeti | sāmarthyādekavarṇana vyavadhānamāśratamityarthaḥ | na ca prāṇitītyatraikādeśasya pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivadbhāvād varṇadvayavyavāyaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ; pūrvatrāsiddhe sthānivattvaniṣedhāt | nanu coktam---`tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu' iti ? evaṃ tarhyanityaḥ pūrvasmādvidhau sthānivadbhāvaḥ; `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' iti seḍ‌grahaṇāt, etacca sthānivatprakaraṇa eva vyākhyātam | tairityādi | ekaṃ hyantagrahaṇam, tacca sāmīpyārthaṃ paryanitītyatra ṇatvavyāvṛttyā caritārtham, tataśca he prāṇityatra padāntasyeti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti; tasmāttaidvitīyamapyantagrahaṇamāvṛttyā tantreṇa vā''śrayitavyam |
nanu ca ye'pi yogavibhāgaṃ kurvanti, avayavavacanaṃ cāntaśabdamāśrayanti, terapi pūrvasūtre sāmīpyavācyantaśabdaḥ paṭhitavya eva; anyathā paryanitītyatrāpi syāt ? ata āha---yeṣāṃ tviti | te naikavarṇavyahitasyāpi ṇatvamicchantyeva, tasmānnārthasteṣāṃ pūrvasūtre'ntagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ ||
ubhau sābhyāsasya || 8.4.21 ||
prāṇiṇiṣatīti | sani `ajāderdvitīyasya' iti niśabdasya dvivarcanam | prāṇiṇaditi | ṇyantālluṅ‌, cleścaṅ‌, ṇiṃlopaḥ, `dvirvacane'ci' iti sthānivadbhāvānniśabdasya dvirvacanam |
pūrvatrāsiddhīyamityādi | `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' ityasminnasati prānisatītisthite dvirvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti, ṇatvaṃ ca, tatra ṇatvasyāsiddhatvātpūrva dvirvacane kṛte'bhyāsaṇakāreṇa vyavāyāddhātunakārasya ṇatvaṃ na syāt | asmiṃstu sati paratvāṇṇatve kṛte kṛtaṇatvasyaiva dvirvacane antareṇāpyetadvacanaṃ prāṇiṇiṣatītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati | yadyevam, kimarthamidamārabhyate ? ityāha---etattviti | śakyārthe kṛtyāḥ, itikaraṇo hetau | tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe | yasmādetadapavādavacanametadarthaṃ naiva śakyamāśrayitum, tasmādetadārabhyate | ayamabhiprāyaḥ---asya vacanasyānityatvajñāpanārthamidamārabhyata iti | tena---`aujaḍhadityatra ḍhatvādīnāmasiddhatvāt hat ityetad dvirucyate'---ityupapannaṃ bhavati |
atha `ubhau' iti kimartham, yāvatābhyāsanakārasya pūrveṇaiva ṇatvaṃ sidhyati, ārambhasāmarthyāddhātunakārasya vyavāye'pyanena bhaviṣyati ? satyam; vyavahitasya sidhyati, anantarasya tu takrakauḍinyanyāyānna syāditi `ubhau' ityucyate ||
hanteratpūrvasya || 8.4.22 ||
hanterityavayavaṣaṣṭhī, atpūrvo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ, nakāro'nyapadārthaḥ | yadyapi nakāraviśeṣaṇāni prathamayā niddiśyante---antaḥ, ubhāviti, tathāpīha ṣaṣṭhyā nirddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | idaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ vyatikramo'lpaḥ | prahaṇyata iti | bhāve, karmaṇi vā laṭ | praghnantīti | `gamahana' ityupadhālopaḥ, `ho hanteḥ' iti kutvam | atra `kuvyavāye' iti prasaṅgaḥ | prāghānīti | `ciṇ‌ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti ciṇ |
śtipā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na yaṅ‌lugnivṛttyarthaḥ---prajaṅ‌ghanīti | atra hi cutve kṛte jakāreṇa vyavāyādeva na bhaviṣyati ||
vamorvā || 8.4.23 ||
pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpaḥ ||
antaradeśe || 8.4.24 ||
`antaḥ śabdasyāṅ‌kividhiṇatveṣūpasaṃkhyānam' ityupasargasaṃjñāyā bhāvād `hanteratpūrvasya' iti siddhe deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanam | antarhanano deśa iti | adhikaraṇe lyuṭ ||
ayanaṃ ca || 8.4.25 ||
antarayaṇamiti | ayeḥ, iṇo vā lyuṭi rūpam | `kṛtyacaḥ' iti siddhe idamapi deśapratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanam ||
chandasyṛdavagrahāt || 8.4.26 ||
avagṛhyate-vicchidya paṭhyate ityavagrahaḥ, ṛccāsāvavagrahaśca ṛdavagrahaḥ | ṛkārād, avagrahāt, pūrvapadāt---iti tisro'pi samānādhikaraṇāḥ pañcamyaḥ | tatra ṛkāramātrasya pūrvapadasyāsambhavādṛkāreṇa tadantavidhiḥ---avagrahaṇabhūto ya ṛkārastadantāditi | saṃhitādhikārācca saṃhitākāla eteṣāṃ ṇatvam; padakāle cāvagrahaḥ kriyate, tenāvagrahayogayatvādṛkāro'vagraha ityuktaḥ, na tu taddaśāpannaḥ | tathā cāvagrahaṃ darśayatā ṇatvaṃ na prayuktam | anavagṛhyamāṇāditi | anavagrahayogyādityarthaḥ | apadāditi | pade hyavagrahaḥ kriyate, padamatra vicchidyata iti darśanāya ||
naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ || 8.4.27 ||
dhātau tiṣṭhatīti dhātustho rephaḥ, ṣakāraśca | ūru iti svarūpagrahaṇam, ṣu iti kṛtaṣatvasya suño grahaṇam, na saptamībahuvacanasya; tena indro dhatā gṛheṣu na ityatra na bhavati | nasiti nāsikādeśasyāsmadādeśasya ca sāmānyena grahaṇam, tato'trāsmadādeśa eva kāryī; tasyaiva dhātusthādibhyaḥ parasya sambhavāt, uttarasūtre tūbhayoḥ kāryitvam | rakṣā ṇa iti | rakṣeti loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanāntam, `dvyaco'tastiṅaḥ' iti dīrghaḥ | śikṣā ṇa iti | śikṣatirdānakarmā chandasi | uruṇaskṛdhīti | kṛño loṭ, serhiḥ `śruśṛṇupṝkṛvṛbhyaśchandasi' iti herdhirādeśaḥ, `kaḥ karat' ityādinā visarjanīyasya rutvam | abhīṣu ṇa iti | `ikaḥ suñi' iti dīrghaḥ | evamūṣu ṇa ityatrāpi ||
upasargādvahulam || 8.4.28 ||
na samprati kriyāyogābhāvāt prādyupalakṣaṇamupasargagrahaṇam | praṇa ityasmado nasādeśaḥ, praṇasa iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `upasargācca' ityac samāsāntaḥ, nāsikāyāśca nasbhāvaḥ |
upasargādanotpara iti pāṭhāntaram, upasargātparasya naso nakārasya ṇatvaṃ bhavati, otaḥ parasya okāre vā na bhavatītyarthaḥ | ubhayathāpyativyāptyavyāptisambhavādvyākhyāta eva pāṭho vṛttikāreṇāśritaḥ ||
kṛtyacaḥ || 8.4.29 ||
kṛtstho yo nakāra aca uttara ityanenāca iti nakārasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na kṛta iti darśayati | yadi hi kṛta etadviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt, prāpaṇamityādau na syāt, `na bhābhūpūkamigamiṣyāyivepām' ityatra ca kamyādīnāṃ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt | anamānetyādi | sambhavodāharaṇadarśanaparam, na parigaṇanam; anyasyāsambhavāt | ana iti | yoranādeśaḥ | māna ityāgatamuka, śānajādiḥ | tavyadādisūtravihito'nīyaḥ, `ākrośe nañyaniḥ'| `supyajātau ṇiniḥ', āvaśyake ṇiniḥ | niṣṭhādeśaḥ `radābhyām' iti vihitaḥ | prahīṇa iti | `ghumāsthā' ityādinā ītvam |
pramagnaḥ, prabhugna iti | `oditaśca' iti niṣṭhānatvam | nirviṇṇasyeti | acaḥ paraḥ kṛtstho nakāro na bhavatīti vacanam | tatra parasya nasya ṇatvam, pūrvasya ṣṭutvam ||
ṇervibhāṣā || 8.4.30 ||
ṇyantādyo vihita iti | etena ṇerityasya vihitaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśayati, prayojanaṃ vṛttāveva vakṣyate | aparaḥ prakāraḥ---`aḍ‌vyavāye' iti vartate, tena ṇyantasya kṛtaścāḍ‌vyavāye'pi ṇatvasyābhyanujñānāt ṇyantātparaḥ kṛdityevamāśrīyamāṇe'pi prayāpyamāṇityādau yakāravyavāye'pi ṇatvasiddhiriti ||
halaścejupadhāt || 8.4.31 ||
prakopaṇamiti | `kupa krodhane' | prehaṇam, prohaṇamiti | `īha ceṣṭāyām', `ūha vitarke'| atra `kṛtyacaḥ' iti ṇatvaṃ nityameva bhavati |
kathaṃ punarasatyādigrahaṇe halādiriti labhyate ? ata āha---ijupadhasyeti | ijupadhasya halantatvāvyabhicārāt sāmarthyādādiviśeṣaṇaṃ halgrahaṇamityarthaḥ ||
ijāpeḥ sanumaḥ || 8.4.32 ||
hala iti vartata iti | prayojanamuttaratra vakṣyati | nanu tatrādiviśeṣaṇaṃ halgrahaṇam, antaviśeṣaṇena cehārthaḥ | ata āha---teneti | ijāderhalāditvāsambhavātsāmarthyam | praṅkhaṇamiti | `ikhi gatyarthaḥ', idittvānnum |
nanu cātrānusvāre kṛte nāyaṃ sanumko bhavati, kāmamatra sthānivadbhāvāt siddhyati---prambhaṇamiti, atra tvādita eva num bhavatītyatra na siddhyati, autpattiko hi tatra nakāraḥ; prenvanamityatra ca prāpnoti, yatra numevāvikṛtaḥ śrūyate; tasmādihāpi numgrahaṇamanusvāropalakṣaṇārthaṃ vyākhyeyam | nakṣatradarśananyā yeneṣṭaviṣaye sarvatra bhaviṣyati, aniṣṭe ca na bhaviṣyati, evaṃ ca kṛtvā niyamārthatopapadyate; anyathā prenvanamityatra vidhyarthatā sambhāvyeta | na ca `aṭ‌kupvāṅ‌numvyavāye'pi' ityetena siddhiḥ, tatrāpi numgrahaṇasyānusvāropalakṣaṇatvāt | nanu `kṛtyacaḥ' ityanenaiva siddhe nārtho'nena ? ata āha---siddhe satīti | pramaṅganamiti | magirapi gatyartha eva | pramaṅkanamiti pāṭhe maṇḍanārthaḥ |
nanu ca kaimarthyānniyamo bhavati, vidheyaṃ nāstīti kṛtvā, iha cāsti vidheyam, kim ? ṇyantādvibhāṣā prāptā, tatra nityaṃ ṇatvaṃ vidheyam ? ata āha---halaityadhikārāditi | nanu caṇilope kṛte ṇyanto'pi halanto bhavati, tataḥ kim ? satyapi haladhikāre vidhyarthatā sambhavati ? naitadasti; vihitaviśeṣaṇasyāśrayaṇāt | etadeva hyabhipretya vṛttikāreṇoktam---`halantāddhātoryo vihitaḥ' iti ||
vā niṃsanikṣanindām || 8.4.33 ||
`ṇisi cumbane' `ṇikṣa ropaṇe', ṇidi kutsāyām' ṇopadeśatvādeteṣāṃ nitye ṇatve prāpte vikalpaḥ ||
na bhābhūpūkamigamipyāyīvepām || 8.4.34 ||
pūgrahaṇena pūñograhaṇameṣṭavyamiti | iṣṭireveyam | ṇyantānāṃ ceti | ṇyantasyādhātvantaratvānna prāpnotīti vacanam, kiñca ṇyanteṣvasya pravṛttau pakṣe'nuvādadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ; `ṇevibhāṣā' ityeva pakṣe nivṛtteḥ siddhatvāt ||
ṣāt padāntāt || 8.4.35 ||
niṣpānam, duṣpānamiti | `idudupadhasya ca' iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam, atra `kṛtyacaḥ' iti prasaṅgaḥ | sarpiṣpānamiti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ | yajuṣpānamiti | `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' iti samāsaḥ | ubhayatrāpi `nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' iti ṣatvam, atra `pānaṃ deśe' `vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' iti prāptiḥ |
pade anta iti | `saptamī' iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ | susarpiṣkeṇeti | śobhanaṃ sarpirasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, kap, `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' iti ṣatvam | nāyaṃ pade parataḥ pūrvamavasthitasyānto bhavati | padasya tvanto bhavati; `svādiṣu' iti padasaṃjñāyā vidhānāt, tataśca ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'trāpi prāpnoti | kathaṃ punarjñāyate---saptamīsamāso'yamiti ? antagrahaṇāt; anyathā varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhirityeva ṣakārantāt padāditi labhyate ||
naśeḥ ṣāntasya || 8.4.36 ||
pranaṣṭa iti | `maśjinaśorjhali' ityāgatasya numaḥ `aniditām' iti nalopaḥ, vraścādiṣatvam | * naśeraśaḥ * | aśakārāntasya naśeriti vaktavyam, na tu ṣāntasyeti, ihāpi yathā syāt---pranaṅ‌kṣyatīti, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' iti katvaṃ bhavati | tattarhi tathā vaktavyam ? netyāha---antagrahaṇamiti | ṣakāreṇa naśerviśeṣaṇāt `ṣantasya' iti siddhe punarantagrahaṇasāmarthyādyaḥ samprati ṣānto yaśca bhūtapūrvaḥ, tasya bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ ||
padāntasya || 8.4.37 ||
he karinnityādyapyudāharaṇam ||
padavyavāye'pi || 8.4.38 ||
māṣakumbhavāpeneti | atra kecidāhuḥ---yadā māṣāṇāṃ kumbho māṣakumbhaḥ, tasya vāpa iti pakriyā, tadā `uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau' iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt padatvābhāvānniṣedhāpravṛtterbhavitavyameva ṇatvena, tasmāt kumbhasya vāpaḥ kumbhavāpaḥ, māṣāṇāṃ kumbhavāpo māṣakumbhavāpa iti prakriyāśrayeṇodāharaṇamiti | atra `kumati ca' iti prāptiḥ | prāvanaddhamiti | `upasargādasamāse'pi' ityavaśabdavyavāye'pi `aḍ‌vyavāye' iti prāptiḥ | pragānnayāma iti | chandasyayaṃ vyavahitaḥ prayogaḥ | gāmiti dvitīyāntena padena vyavāyaḥ |
